mon_an.mo_ta: Sugar-glazed sweet potato cakes are delicious, easy to eat, and healthy, especially for those with digestion issues. Learn how to cook this healthy treat! Please refer to the guide below.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Wash the sweet potatoes, then steam or boil until cooked through.
Peel and mash the sweet potatoes finely.
Step 2:
Mix the all-purpose flour, rice flour, baking powder, and 100g of sugar in a bowl.
Pour the flour mixture into the mashed sweet potatoes. Wear plastic gloves and mix thoroughly; avoid over-mixing or the cakes will not rise beautifully.
Step 3:
Slowly pour the hot milk into the potato and flour mixture.
Use a spoon to mix until a smooth, uniform consistency is achieved.
Step 4: Shape the potato mixture into equal-sized round balls so the cakes look uniform and attractive.
Step 5:
Fry the cakes in a pan with oil.
Fry until the sweet potato cakes are golden and evenly cooked, then remove from the pan.
While the cakes are still hot, roll them in a bowl of sugar. You can sprinkle a little cinnamon powder if desired.

mon_an.mo_ta: Baked cassava cake, a familiar snack full of childhood memories, always evokes nostalgic feelings. With its nutty aroma and rich taste, this cake captivates anyone from the first bite. Using simple ingredients, you can easily make cassava cake to enjoy with your family during leisure time. Let's discover the recipe for this delicious baked cassava cake right now! Explore how to make wonderful baked cassava cake with simple ingredients. A familiar snack associated with childhood, this fragrant and rich cassava cake will make you fall in love from the very first taste.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Grate the cassava

First, peel the cassava, clean it, and remove the woody core. Then, soak the cassava in water for about 1-2 hours. If you don't have a grater, you can cut the cassava into small pieces and use a blender. However, this method will not yield as good a result as traditional grating.
After grating, the cassava will be quite wet. Use a straining bag to squeeze the cassava, ensuring it is squeezed very dry.
Step 2: Mix the ingredients

After squeezing the cassava dry, mix it with the settled starch. Add 50g of cooked mung beans, 250g of granulated sugar, 125g of tapioca starch, and 2 egg yolks. Use your hands to mix all ingredients thoroughly.
Next, add 150g of condensed milk and 50g of melted butter to the cassava mixture. Knead by hand to ensure all ingredients are well incorporated.
Finally, pour 700ml of coconut milk into the mixture. Add a small tube of vanilla and mix well to ensure all components are perfectly combined.
Step 3: Bake the cake

Once the mixture is well mixed, pour it into a mold and place it in the oven. Before lining the mold with parchment paper, brush a little butter or oil on the mold to help the paper stick, making it easier to remove the cake later.
Bake at 170-175 degrees C for about 60-70 minutes. When the cake is cooked, remove it, let it cool, and then cut into bite-sized pieces.
Step 4: Finished product

The baked cassava cake has a soft, chewy texture with the delicious flavors of cassava, mung beans, and coconut milk. This is a characteristic, familiar rustic flavor. To achieve a delicious result, use an oven thermometer to adjust the temperature accurately.
To prevent the cake from burning, monitor the baking process frequently and rotate the mold to ensure even cooking. If necessary, reduce the temperature and extend the baking time.
If you don't eat all the cake, store it in a bag or airtight container to keep it fresh for 1-2 days.
Notes on making baked cassava cake
Choosing cassava: Choose fresh cassava with smooth skin and no damage. Fresh cassava will provide a better flavor for the cake.
Squeeze the cassava dry: After grating, squeeze it dry to remove excess water. This helps the cake have a smoother texture.
Use quality ingredients: Choose fresh mung beans, clean granulated sugar, and pure tapioca starch to ensure the best flavor.
Mix ingredients thoroughly: When mixing, ensure everything is well combined. Use your hands to knead and ensure all components blend together.
Bake at the right temperature and time: Set the oven to 170-175 degrees C and bake for 60-70 minutes. Monitor the process and adjust the heat if necessary to avoid burning.
Proper storage: If there are leftovers, put them in a bag or airtight container and store in the refrigerator for 1-2 days to keep the cake fresh.

mon_an.mo_ta: Let's make baked potato cakes according to this recipe. With this method, you will have baked potatoes – a unique and delicious dish shaped like beautiful flowers with an appealing aroma. This dish will attract any diner with its special taste, featuring golden, crispy edges and a soft interior filled with the rich scent and flavor of butter, milk, eggs, and pepper. Give it a try.
cac_buoc: Preparation: Preheat the oven to 170-180 degrees C.
Wash the potatoes, peel them, and cut into small pieces. Place them in a steamer and steam until soft.
Spread the cooked potatoes on a tray and place in the oven for about 10-15 minutes to dry out the surface.
After 10-15 minutes, remove the potatoes from the oven and use a sturdy spoon to mash them finely. Note that you should mash the potatoes while they are still hot to save time and effort.
Leave the butter at room temperature to soften, then melt it in the microwave. Add 2/3 of the butter to the bowl of mashed potatoes.
Add the egg yolks, salt, pepper, 1 tsp of nutmeg, and more than half of the fresh milk (or heavy cream) to the potatoes, then mix well.

Put the potato mixture into a piping bag fitted with a star tip. Slowly pipe the potatoes into a spiral shape, building it upwards to create an attractive look. Repeat until the bag is empty. Then, place the tray in the refrigerator for 20-30 minutes.
Mix the remaining egg with the rest of the heavy cream and 1/3 of the butter, whisking until combined...
...Then use a brush to coat the egg-milk mixture over the surface of the potato cakes.
Place the potatoes in the oven and bake until the edges turn golden brown.
Here is the finished product after taking it out of the oven. It looks very beautiful, doesn't it?
Some notes for delicious baked potato cakes:
Choosing good potatoes is the fundamental factor for a great dish. You can refer to how to choose good potatoes in the guide for crispy fried potatoes.
You should mash the potatoes very quickly while they are still hot and fluffy. If the potatoes cool down, they will be harder to mash and take much more time.
You should put the tray of shaped potato cakes in the refrigerator to let them firm up; this will make the next step (brushing the egg-milk mixture) much easier.

mon_an.ten: Madeleines – Have You Tried Them with Tea?
mon_an.mo_ta: Enjoying these madeleines with a cup of hot tea every morning makes the mind feel very relaxed!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, melt the butter.
Step 2:
Sift the flour and baking powder into the bowl of sugar, then mix everything together.
Step 3:
Whisk the eggs, vanilla, and 15ml of fresh milk together.
Step 4:
Add the egg mixture to the flour bowl and mix well. The mixture will become thick and sticky!
Step 5:

Divide the melted butter into 2 parts; add each part to the batter and mix well before adding the rest. The final mixture will be slightly thick; when you lift the whisk, the batter should fall in ribbons.
If you like orange flavor, add the zest of 1 orange and mix well; the cake will be very fragrant!
Place the batter in the refrigerator to rest for at least 1 hour. If you can leave the batter overnight, it will be even better.
Step 6:
Preheat the oven to 150 degrees C.
Grease the mold by brushing a thin layer of butter all over the inside, sprinkle with flour, and tap the mold to remove excess flour.
Step 7:
Use a spoon or an ice cream scoop to divide the batter into 2/3 of each mold cavity. For a standard madeleine mold, using the smallest ice cream scoop is a perfect fit!
Step 8:
Place the cakes in the oven for 18-20 minutes; the cakes will gradually rise to form a hump.
Bake until the edges turn golden and the cake springs back when pressed!
Remove from the oven, let cool for 5 minutes, then take the cakes out of the mold!
If well-greased, the cakes will easily release from the mold when tapped firmly on the table or pushed gently at the tail with a spoon.
Before eating, you can sprinkle a layer of powdered sugar over the cakes!
These perfectly uniform madeleines are so fragrant and fluffy that anyone would love them!
Drinking them with a cup of hot tea is just perfect!
This madeleine recipe is simple but serves as a basic formula that allows you to be creative with future batches.

mon_an.mo_ta: Garlic Bread – A delicious and easy-to-make dish popular when served with pasta, pizza... the method for making Garlic Bread is simple and tasty.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Cut the bread lengthwise into two halves or into bite-sized crosswise slices. Preheat the oven to 200 degrees.

Step 2: Wash and finely chop the cilantro. Peel and mince the garlic very finely. If the butter was just taken from the fridge, you can melt it over steam for 2 minutes or leave it at room temperature for 30 minutes. Mix the softened butter, cilantro, and garlic in a small bowl. If you like your garlic bread slightly sweet, you can add a little sugar.
Step 3: Spread the garlic butter and cilantro mixture onto the inner surface of the two bread halves. Place the bread in the oven for 10 minutes at 200 degrees C.
Step 4: Then take the tray out, sprinkle cheese on top, and return it to the oven at the highest temperature for 2-3 minutes to complete this favorite easy dish.

Note: This article describes how to make crispy bread. If you prefer soft bread, instead of placing it directly in the oven, spread the garlic butter on the inside and wrap it in foil before baking; the bread will be much softer.
Source: Phununet.com

mon_an.mo_ta: The crispy fried bread crust paired with smooth, cool, and sweet custard filling will truly make you want to eat forever! Let's get into the kitchen and make this dish.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Put the sugar, condensed milk, and egg yolks into a pot and whisk until combined.
Then add the fresh milk and cornstarch and mix together.

Step 2: Place the milk pot on the stove and cook over low heat. Stir constantly until the custard is smooth and thick, then turn off the heat. Now add the vanilla, butter, and cream cheese and whisk until smooth.
Step 3: Wait for the cream cheese custard to cool, then pour it into a plastic bag, seal it, and store it in the refrigerator.

Step 4: Put the flour, yeast, milk powder, sugar, and salt into a bowl and mix well. Then add the warm milk and butter to mix and knead. When the dough is smooth, elastic, and non-sticky, it is ready. Proof the dough in a warm place for about 50-60 minutes.
Step 5: When the dough has doubled in size, take it out and knead briefly.
Divide the dough into 6-8 small portions.
Roll the dough out lengthwise and then roll it up. (At this point, you can roll the dough in breadcrumbs if desired).
Arrange the dough rolls on a tray, cover with a towel, and let them rest for 20 minutes.
Step 6: Place a pan of oil on the stove; when the oil is hot, add each piece of bread to fry over medium heat.
While frying, use chopsticks to turn the bread so it turns golden brown evenly before removing it to a tray lined with paper towels.
Step 7: Once the bread has cooled slightly, pipe the cream cheese custard inside to finish.
Complete these steps and you will have crispy, delicious, and rich fried bread with custard filling.

mon_an.ten: Homemade Bánh Mì with Grilled Beef
mon_an.mo_ta: Bánh mì with grilled beef – simple yet delicious for breakfast or an afternoon snack that is very filling.
cac_buoc: Step 1: For the best flavor, choose beef rib meat with some fat so it doesn't dry out when grilled. Place the beef in a clean bowl, add minced lemongrass, salt, oyster sauce, honey, pepper, seasoning powder, minced garlic, and cooking oil, then mix well. Adjust the seasoning to your preference. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and marinate for 4-5 hours.

Step 2: Peel and crush the garlic, then sauté until fragrant. Add about two tablespoons of hoisin sauce and one teaspoon of sugar to the pot, pour in a little filtered water, bring to a boil, then turn off the heat and pour into a separate bowl.

Step 3: Prepare the garnishes for the grilled beef bánh mì: Wash the cucumber, peel, and slice thinly. Peel the carrot and shred it into strips. Wash and chop the cilantro. Marinate the carrots with a little salt, sugar, and vinegar to make a sweet and sour pickle.

Step 4: After marinating the beef, wear plastic gloves or grease your hands with a little oil. Scoop some meat into your hand, flatten it, and wrap it around a skewer while rotating your hand so the beef is spread evenly to ensure it cooks through. Repeat for the remaining meat. Arrange the beef skewers on a grill, occasionally brushing a little cooking oil or sesame oil on the surface to keep them glossy and prevent drying.
Step 5: When ready to eat, cut the bánh mì lengthwise, spread a layer of the sauce from step 2, then add the grilled beef and the garnishes from step 3.

mon_an.mo_ta: Fruit yogurt mousse cake is simple to make, doesn't require much technique, looks beautiful, and is refreshing without being heavy thanks to the gentle taste of yogurt combined with fresh fruit. This will be a perfect gift for a warm Christmas!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Sponge cake base
Separate the egg yolks and whites. Whisk the whites with sugar until stiff peaks form (the mixture should not slide when the bowl is inverted), then add the yolks and continue whisking.
Step 2:

Sift the flour and fold it gently into the mixture, then add the fresh milk and melted butter. Avoid being heavy-handed or over-mixing, which could deflate the air bubbles and cause the cake to sink after baking.
Step 3:

Pour the mixture into a 22cm diameter round cake mold lined with parchment paper. Bake for 10-12 minutes at 180 degrees; test with a toothpick—if it comes out dry, the cake is done. Remove the cake from the oven and let it cool on a rack. Use a knife to slice the sponge cake to a thickness of about 1.5cm and trim the edges so it is 1cm smaller than the mold.
Step 4: Mousse layer

Put sugar, gelatin, and 1 container of yogurt into a pot over very low heat (or use a double boiler) until the gelatin is completely melted. Remove from heat, stir in the remaining container of yogurt, and mix well.
Step 5:
Keep the whipping cream very cold and whip until it just forms peaks; do not over-whip or the cream will separate.
Step 6:

Gently fold the yogurt mixture into the whipped cream, then pour the new mixture into the mold with the cake base at the bottom. Smooth the surface and place in the refrigerator for about 2 hours for the mousse to set. If you don't want too much cream, you can halve the mousse recipe.
Step 7:
Use any fruit you like, such as mango, kiwi, strawberries... slice them thinly and arrange them on top of the cake for decoration. Then you can remove the mold and enjoy the cake immediately.
Note: If you want a beautiful mirror glaze, melt a mixture of 10g sugar, 3g gelatin, and 40ml water. Let it cool, then pour over the cake surface and refrigerate for another 20 minutes to set.

mon_an.mo_ta: Let's make Crispy Wafer Rolls – a gift from childhood!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Whisk the eggs with sugar, then melt the butter and add it in. You only need to whisk until the sugar is dissolved; no need to whip the eggs until fluffy!
Step 2: Sift the flour and add the sesame seeds and vanilla, then mix well with the egg mixture.
Step 3: Heat a pan. Then, scoop 1 tablespoon of batter and spread it thinly, keeping the heat at medium. (Note: Use a non-stick pan and do not add oil to the pan!)
Step 4: When you see the edges of the cake drying out, flip the cake and continue to leave it on the stove until it turns golden brown. Remove it and quickly roll it up.
Step 5: Once the wafer rolls cool down, they will be perfectly crispy and fragrant! Enjoy these Crispy Wafer Rolls with tea! Here is the actual finished product:

mon_an.mo_ta: Matcha Cookies – A simple and delicious treat with a fragrant green tea aroma. These cookies are buttery, crisp, and have a vibrant green color, making them a meaningful gift. Learn how to make delicious Matcha Cookies.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Cream the butter until smooth, then gradually sift in the granulated sugar and beat at high speed until the butter turns a pale cream color. Note: the butter must be at room temperature before beating; if it is cold, leave it out for 30 minutes or use a quick double boiler method.

Step 2: Add the egg yolks one by one and beat into the butter at the lowest speed until well combined. Mix the matcha powder with the milk, then add it to the butter-sugar mixture and continue beating.

Step 3: Divide the flour into 3 parts. Gradually sift each part into the egg and sugar bowl, using a hand mixer at low speed to incorporate the flour. Finally, add the vanilla and beat into the matcha cookie dough.
Step 4: Line a baking tray with parchment paper. Transfer the dough into a piping bag with your choice of nozzle and pipe the cookies onto the parchment paper.

Step 5: Preheat the oven for 10 minutes at 180 degrees. Place the tray in and bake for 7 minutes at 180 degrees, then lower the temperature to 165 degrees and bake for another 10 minutes. Now you have a delicious, easy-to-make treat to enjoy or give to friends.

mon_an.ten: Purple Sweet Potato Fried Balls with Black Bean Filling
mon_an.mo_ta: Purple sweet potato fried balls with black bean filling is an easy-to-make dish that offers a vegetarian flavor while remaining delicious and healthy. Check out how to make these purple sweet potato fried balls at home in the article below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Black beans - 1 small bowl, soaked in cold water overnight
Purple sweet potato - 1 large sweet potato
cac_buoc: Step 1: After soaking the black beans for 8 hours until they expand, rinse them thoroughly. Place the beans in a pot with cold water and simmer until soft. Then, put the black beans and sugar into a blender and blend until smooth. Blending the beans while they are still hot prevents them from sticking and protects the motor. Stir-fry the blended bean mixture in a pan.

Step 2: Stir-fry for about 18 - 20 minutes until the beans gradually dry out and become thicker. At this point, add the shredded coconut and stir for another 3 minutes before turning off the heat. Let the beans cool so they don't stick to your hands when shaping them into even, bite-sized balls. Place these balls in the refrigerator for 3 - 4 hours.

Step 3: Peel the purple sweet potato and steam until cooked. Once cooked, weigh out 250 - 270g and mash until smooth. You should buy a large tuber to ensure you have enough after steaming. Mix the salt, sugar, and both types of rice flour with the mashed potato. No water is needed as the potato already contains enough moisture to bind the dough. Wrap with plastic wrap and let it rest for 15 minutes to prepare the dough.

Step 4: Use your hands to pinch off small pieces of dough and flatten them. Place a black bean filling ball in the center and seal it tightly, ensuring there is no air trapped between the filling and the dough to prevent the balls from bursting during frying. Roll evenly in sesame seeds.

Step 5: Heat a small pot or pan with enough oil to submerge the balls. Cook over low heat so the balls expand gradually, rolling them continuously to ensure they brown evenly. Once cooked, remove and place in a basket to drain excess oil. Serve hot.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Bánh Rán Lúc Lắc (Hollow Sesame Balls) with Mung Bean Filling
mon_an.mo_ta: Bánh rán lúc lắc is a simple treat featuring the sweetness of mung beans and a crunchy sesame coating. You only need basic ingredients like mung beans, sugar, lard, glutinous rice flour, sesame seeds, and a bit of time. Today, let's learn how to make these golden, crispy hollow sesame balls with mung bean filling as a weekend snack. This is a detailed guide to making delicious and attractive bánh rán lúc lắc. A traditional Vietnamese pastry with a crispy shell and fragrant sweet mung bean filling, coated in sesame for extra flavor.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Mix the dough for the crust

Thoroughly mix the glutinous rice flour, rice flour, and baking powder together in a large bowl. Steam the potatoes until cooked, then mash them while still warm. Take 180g of the mashed potatoes and mix them with the dry flour mixture in the bowl.

Dissolve the sugar in boiling water. Slowly pour the boiling water and cooking oil into the flour bowl, mixing so the dough rises evenly. Depending on the type of flour, the water absorption may vary, so add the water gradually until the dough is elastic, smooth, and no longer sticks to your hands. Cover the bowl tightly and let the dough rest for 40 minutes.
Step 2: Prepare the "shaking" filling

Soak the mung beans in water for 4 hours to soften, then rinse thoroughly. Steam the mung beans with a pinch of salt until tender. Place the mung beans, sugar, and a bowl of water into a blender and blend until smooth.

Pour the mung bean mixture into a non-stick pan and cook down. Stir-fry over low heat until the water evaporates and the mixture thickens, then add cooking oil and continue to stir-fry. Mix a little glutinous rice flour with water and add it to the filling to make it pliable. Continue cooking the mung bean filling until it is smooth and flexible, then turn off the heat. If you want to add shredded coconut, add it at the end and mix well.
While the mung bean filling is still warm, divide it into small portions and roll them into balls. With the above amount of filling, you can divide it into about 25 small portions.
Step 3: Shape the sesame balls

After the dough has rested sufficiently, remove it from the bowl and knead gently. Divide the dough into 25 equal portions. Roll each portion into a ball, then flatten it. Place a mung bean ball in the center and wrap the dough tightly around it. The crust needs to be rounded and balanced to create a beautiful shape. Continue until all portions are used.

Using a spray bottle, spray a light mist of water over the balls to keep them moist. Finally, roll the balls in sesame seeds so they stick evenly. Gently roll them in your palms to ensure they are round and the sesame seeds are firmly attached to the surface.
Step 4: Fry the sesame balls

Place a pan on the stove and pour in enough oil to deep-fry the balls. When the oil reaches the boiling point, check by dipping the tip of a chopstick into the oil; if it bubbles vigorously, the oil is ready. Drop each ball into the pan, but do not overcrowd it. Use chopsticks to gently push and rotate the balls so they expand evenly and roundly without breaking.
Once the balls are evenly golden brown, remove them and place them on paper towels to absorb excess oil.
Step 5: Finished product

After being "shaken" (bánh cam), the fried balls become perfectly round and aesthetic. The crust has a soft, airy structure that puffs away from the filling. When you pick up a ball and shake it gently, you can hear a "rattling" sound from inside, indicating it is perfectly cooked.
The balls are best enjoyed while still hot and freshly fried. The crust is golden and crispy, while the inside is soft and smooth with the sweet fragrance of mung bean filling.

The final requirement is that the balls must be evenly golden and not burnt. The crust should be puffed, airy, and crispy. The filling should not be too sweet and should not stick to the crust; when you pick up the ball and shake it, you will hear the filling moving inside, which is very satisfying.
A few secrets for delicious bánh rán lúc lắc:

When frying, use plenty of oil to submerge the balls. The oil should only be heated moderately, not too hot (otherwise the balls will burn easily and won't be crispy or airy). Wait for the oil to heat up before adding the balls. Once added, use rounded chopsticks (to prevent breaking the balls) to roll them so they expand evenly and stay round.
You should have a tray or basket to arrange the balls so the oil drains while maintaining the crispness of the crust, ensuring they aren't greasy when eaten.
Notes when making bánh rán lúc lắc with sesame-coated mung bean filling:
The mung bean filling must be cooked until pliable but not hard and dry. If the filling is too wet, it will flatten out and prevent the ball from "shaking."

To ensure the fried balls have a beautiful shape and don't crack or leak filling, the wrapping process must be done carefully. The crust must be wrapped tightly around the filling, leaving no gaps or air inside. After wrapping, you can use a sharp toothpick to prick small holes for air to escape, then gently roll them round again.
In some cases, the balls do not expand during frying because the oil is too hot or too cold. The ideal temperature for the balls to expand is between 140°C and 150°C.
When frying, make sure the balls are submerged in oil and flipped constantly so they don't break and expand into a perfect sphere.
After frying the first batch, set the pan aside to let the oil cool slightly before adding the second batch. If you drop the balls into oil that is too hot, they may burn and fail to expand.

mon_an.ten: Crispy and Airy Bánh Tai Yến - Love at First Bite
mon_an.mo_ta: The recipe for Bánh Tai Yến (Bird's Nest Cake) with a crispy outer edge and a soft, chewy center is truly stimulating from the first bite; you won't be able to stop eating.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Place the glutinous rice flour, rice flour, sugar, and a pinch of salt into a clean bowl and mix well. Then pour in the coconut milk and 100ml of warm water, and mix the ingredients thoroughly.
Step 2: Next, crack the egg into the mixture and mix again until the ingredients are well combined and the mixture becomes thick and stretchy. Let the batter rest for 20 minutes before frying.

Step 3: Place a pan on the stove and pour in enough oil so the cake is submerged while frying. Test the oil by placing the tip of a chopstick in the pan: if bubbles form around the tip, the oil is ready. Scoop a ladle of batter and pour it into the center of the pan; after about 5 seconds, the cake will gradually rise to the surface.

Step 4: Flip the cake and continue frying until both sides are golden brown and crispy. Remove the cake and let it drain, placing it on paper towels. Continue frying each cake until all the batter is used.
Bánh Tai Yến has a crispy rim and a soft, chewy, rich center with a perfectly balanced sweetness, offering a very special flavor that is guaranteed to be addictive.

mon_an.ten: Delicious Apple Fritters Without an Oven
mon_an.mo_ta: Apples are a delicious and affordable fruit. You can make these fragrant crispy fried apple fritters, with a crunchy outer layer and a sweet-tart apple center, to treat the whole family. This apple cake is incredibly simple to make and doesn't require an oven, so anyone can do it! Check out how to make these delicious apple fritters with this no-oven recipe!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Separate the egg yolks and whites, and prepare the remaining ingredients.

Step 2: Put the beer, egg yolks, butter, sugar, ginger powder, cinnamon powder, and salt into a bowl. Add the flour and whisk until the ingredients are just combined. Cover the bowl tightly and let the batter rest for 30 minutes.

Step 3: Peel the apples, cut them into round slices about 1cm thick, and remove the seeds. Place the apple slices on paper towels to dry them thoroughly; this ensures the fritters stay crispy for a long time after frying. After drying one side, flip them over to dry the other side.
Step 4: After the batter has rested for 30 minutes, beat the egg whites until stiff peaks form, then fold them into the batter mixture from Step 3.
Step 5: Dip each apple slice into the prepared batter until fully coated.
Step 6: Heat plenty of oil in a deep pan or fryer. Add the apples and fry until the fritters are an even, beautiful golden brown. Remove and drain on paper towels.
Step 7: Mix 150g of sugar with 1 tsp of cinnamon powder to make cinnamon sugar. Sprinkle the cinnamon sugar over the apple fritters and enjoy your delicious no-oven apple cake!

mon_an.mo_ta: Instead of the usual hollow donuts, try this special version with a fragrant, creamy custard filling that will have everyone raving!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Dough - 250g all-purpose flour; 5g instant yeast; 5g baking powder; 60g sugar; 135-145ml water; 5g softened butter; 1/4 tsp salt; white sesame seeds
Custard filling - 2 egg yolks; 20g all-purpose flour; 20g cornstarch; 90g sugar; 250ml unsweetened milk; 30ml whipping cream; 1 tsp vanilla.
cac_buoc: Ingredients you need to prepare:
Step 1: Whisk the egg yolks and sugar in a bowl until dissolved. Add the milk, whipping cream, and vanilla, then stir together. Finally, add the flour and cornstarch and mix well.

Strain the mixture through a sieve. Pour it into a pot and stir over low heat. Continue stirring until the custard is smooth and thickened into a paste, then turn off the heat. Let it cool, transfer to a piping bag, and keep in the refrigerator.

Step 2: Combine the flour, sugar, salt, yeast, and baking powder in a bowl and mix well. Add the water and butter, then knead until the dough forms a slightly sticky ball. Let the dough proof for 60 minutes.
Step 3: After 60 minutes, the dough should have doubled in size. Remove and knead again for 5 minutes. Divide into 6 small portions.
Roll each portion into a ball and flatten it. Pipe the custard filling into the center, pinch the edges to seal, and roll in white sesame seeds.
Step 4: Heat a pan with plenty of oil. Once the oil is hot (but not smoking), drop each dough piece in and fry over medium heat.
Flip the dough 2-3 times until it puffs up and turns golden brown, then remove and place on a plate lined with paper towels.
Custard-filled bánh tiêu tastes amazing and is loved by everyone.
Enjoy your delicious and creamy custard-filled bánh tiêu made with this easy recipe!

mon_an.ten: Russian Napoleon Torte with Condensed Milk
mon_an.mo_ta: Napoleon torte is a wonderful dessert featuring thin, delicate layers and a rich condensed milk filling. While the process requires patience, the final result is stunning. Let's work through each step together to create a beautiful and delicious Napoleon torte. This Russian-style version attracts everyone with its many stacked layers, buttercream filling, and crushed walnuts. Each bite offers a unique, unforgettable flavor. Let's get into the kitchen and learn how to make this treat! Discover the recipe for a super delicious Russian Napoleon torte with condensed milk. Detailed instructions to create a traditional pastry with thin crusts and a bold milk filling.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Mix the ingredients
First, take a bowl and whisk together 2 eggs, 200ml cold water, 1 tsp white vinegar, and 1/2 tsp salt. Stir well until the ingredients are combined.

Next, mix and chill the dough: In a blender, combine 690g flour and 400g chilled unsalted butter. Blend until the mixture is fine and smooth. Transfer the flour to a large bowl, add the prepared wet ingredients, and mix until combined.
Turn the dough onto a flat surface and knead by hand until it becomes a uniform, smooth, non-sticky mass. Use a knife to divide the dough into 10-12 equal parts and shape each into a ball.
Place the dough balls in a container and seal tightly with plastic wrap. Place the container in the refrigerator for 1 hour.
Step 2: Make the cream:
Next, separate 6 egg yolks into a bowl. Add 175g sugar and 43g cornstarch to the yolks and whisk until the mixture is smooth.
Place a pot on the stove and heat 720ml fresh milk, but do not let it boil. Stir frequently with a ladle to ensure the milk doesn't scorch at the bottom.

Slowly pour the hot milk into the egg yolk mixture, stirring constantly to combine. Pour the mixture back into the pot and cook over low heat. Stir continuously for about 8 minutes until thickened, then turn off the heat.

Add 230g unsalted butter and 2 tsp vanilla extract to the mixture. Stir until smooth and well combined. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and wait for it to cool completely. You now have a delicious cream filling.
Step 3: Shape the cake
First, lay a piece of parchment paper on a flat surface and sprinkle with a little flour. Place each dough ball on it and use a rolling pin to roll it into a very thin sheet.

Place a 20cm cake mold on top of the dough. Press down lightly without cutting all the way through to create a circular outline. Use a fork to prick the dough all over, then place it on a baking tray.
Preheat the oven to 190°C for 15 minutes. Place the prepared tray in the oven and bake at 190°C for 10-12 minutes until the surface is slightly golden.
Continue baking the remaining dough sheets one by one at the same temperature and time. Let the layers cool.
Step 4: Completion
First, trim the edges to create perfect circular cake layers and place one on a plate. Take the trimmed scraps, place them in a blender, and grind into fine crumbs.
Line the edges of the plate with strips of parchment paper. Stack the cake layers on the plate, spreading a layer of cream evenly over each layer. Continue stacking until the final layer.
Next, coat the sides of the cake with cream and sprinkle the ground cake crumbs all over the surface. The cream will help the crumbs stick.
Finally, pull out the parchment strips from under the cake to remove any excess crumbs.
Notes for making Russian Napoleon Torte:
1. When mixing butter with flour, ensure they are thoroughly combined to avoid lumps.
2. Knead the dough carefully so it is soft, smooth, and rises well. Divide the dough into appropriately sized balls; if they are too large, the crust will be thick and heavy.
3. Roll the dough thin enough so it becomes crispy when baked without breaking.
4. Watch the oven closely to ensure the layers are evenly golden and do not burn.
5. Use a moderate amount of cream for each layer to prevent the cake from becoming too rich or cloying.

mon_an.mo_ta: Peach Turnovers – fragrant, soft, and sweet with a delicious peach filling. How to make Peach Turnovers.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 230g unsalted butter, cut into small pieces
cac_buoc: Step 1: Mix the flour and salt in a separate bowl. Place the butter in another bowl and refrigerate both for 1 hour. After 1 hour, combine them and crumble until fine. In another bowl, whisk together the sour cream, lemon juice, and ice water.

Step 2: Add 1/2 of the sour cream mixture to the flour mixture and knead by hand until smooth. If there are still dry lumps, move them to another bowl, soften with the remaining cream mixture, and knead again. Do not over-knead to ensure the pastry stays flaky when baked.

Step 3: Dust a flat surface with flour, take the dough out, and roll it thin. Cut the dough into your desired shapes. To make triangular turnovers, cut the dough into squares. Place the rolled pieces on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and refrigerate for 30 minutes.

Step 4: Peel and dice the peaches into small cubes. Add flour, sugar, bourbon, salt, and vanilla extract, then mix well. Remove the dough from the refrigerator and let it sit at room temperature for a few minutes. Place the peach filling in the center of each dough piece, brush the edges with a little water, and fold over.

Step 5: Use a fork to press down and seal the edges. Once finished, refrigerate the turnovers again for 30 minutes. Preheat the oven to 190°C. Remove the turnovers, use a knife to lightly score diagonal lines on the surface, brush with egg wash, and sprinkle with sugar. Bake for 20 minutes until golden brown.
Source: Kenh14

mon_an.mo_ta: Spend the weekend in the kitchen making these incredibly fragrant and attractive shell-shaped Madeleines for the whole family!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Cornstarch (can be replaced with almond flour) - 10g
Unsalted butter (if using salted butter, omit the salt above) - 40g
Vanilla extract or almond extract - 1/4 tsp
cac_buoc: Step 1: Grease the mold: Coat the inside of the shell molds with butter, sift over some flour, then tap upside down to remove excess flour.
Step 2: Sift the flour, cornstarch, and baking powder together, then mix well with a whisk.
Step 3: Melt the butter, then stir in the honey and milk until dissolved. Add the vanilla or almond extract.

Step 4: Separate the egg white and yolk. Whisk the egg white with a bit of sugar until foamy. Add a pinch of vinegar and continue whisking until fine bubbles form, then gradually add the rest of the sugar and whisk until stiff peaks form.
Step 5: Add the egg yolk and whisk with the whites for about 10 seconds. Then, add the butter mixture tablespoon by tablespoon, stirring gently with a whisk until the mixture thins out.
Step 6: Sift the flour mixture into the egg mixture.
Use a spatula to fold gently using an over-and-under motion.
Step 7: Transfer the batter into the prepared molds, filling only 2/3 full to allow room for rising.

Step 8: Place in a preheated oven at 180°C for 15 minutes, then bake for 10-12 minutes. Once cooked, remove from the oven and let cool in the mold for 5 minutes before turning them out onto a rack to cool completely.
Enjoy these eye-catching shell-shaped cakes with your family!

mon_an.mo_ta: What happens when red velvet and brownies are combined into one? Let's try making them to find out!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, put the cocoa powder in a bowl, then add the food coloring and vanilla and stir well.
Step 2:
Place the butter and sugar in a bowl and beat until smooth. Then, crack the 2 eggs in one by one and continue to beat well.
Step 3:
Add the cocoa mixture from step 1 into the butter mixture.
Step 4:
Beat until the mixture is uniform and thickened as shown in the image.
Step 5:
Line a baking tray with a layer of foil and pour in the batter.
Preheat the oven to 176°C for 10 minutes, then bake the cake for about 25-30 minutes. Use a toothpick to check if the cake is cooked through.
Step 6:
To make the frosting, place the butter and sugar in a bowl and beat until smooth.
Step 7:
Once the cake is baked, remove it and let it cool down.
Step 8:
Melt the white chocolate, add it to the butter and sugar mixture, and stir well.
Step 9:
Add fresh milk to thin the mixture slightly, then continue to mix well.
Step 10:
When the cake has cooled, spread the frosting evenly over the surface and cut into bite-sized squares. The cake is ready to enjoy!
The red velvet brownies are now complete!
These red velvet brownies with frosting are definitely unique and worth a try!
You can also add cream cheese to the frosting for extra richness!
The cake still has a bold chocolate flavor but wears a seductive red color with a sweet frosting. This brownie will surely be very attractive!
You can even use a marble technique to create patterns for the frosting on these brownies!

mon_an.ten: Easy Steamed Vegetarian Buns for Breakfast
mon_an.mo_ta: Vegetarian buns are even better when served with a glass of milk for a nutritious breakfast.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Place the flour in a large bowl or a stand mixer bowl. Add all the prepared ingredients (except the oil) and mix well.
Step 2: Knead the dough until it becomes soft and elastic, then add the oil and continue kneading for a few more minutes. Cover the bowl tightly and let the dough rest for 20 minutes.

Step 3: Dust a clean surface with flour to prevent sticking, then take the dough out. Flatten it and use a rolling pin to roll it into a thin rectangle. Gently roll the dough from top to bottom, rolling tightly to push out air bubbles so the buns won't have large holes after steaming.

Step 4: Divide into 6 equal portions and use a knife to cut them into 6 pieces. Line the steamer with parchment paper, then adjust the shape of each bun for a better appearance before placing them in the steamer. Depending on the size of your steamer, arrange them accordingly. Note: The buns will expand when steamed, so space them out to prevent them from sticking together.
Step 5: Pour water into the steamer, turn the heat to high, and steam for about 5 minutes until cooked. Remove the buns and enjoy while hot for the best taste.
The buns are soft, smooth, and snowy white, making them very attractive. They are perfect for breakfast or an afternoon snack when paired with a glass of soy milk.

mon_an.ten: Easy and Delicious Matcha Vegetarian Buns
mon_an.mo_ta: These cute and fun matcha-filled buns look so good you'll want to eat them immediately!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Pour the flour into a bowl, add 5g yeast, 100g sugar, and 5g matcha powder, then mix well.
Step 2: Mix 260ml water with 5g matcha powder and slowly pour it into the flour bowl. Knead the dough into a uniform, smooth, and non-sticky mass.
Step 3: Proof the dough until it doubles in size.
Step 4: While waiting for the dough, wash the mung beans and soak them in warm water or overnight. Once the beans are soft, steam them until cooked.

Step 5: Mix the mung beans with 50g sugar and mash them thoroughly while still hot. Place a pan on the stove, add a little oil, and sauté the mung beans over medium heat until the mixture no longer sticks to your hands. Roll the mung bean paste into small balls.
Step 6: Once the dough has doubled, take it out, knead briefly, and divide into equal portions.
Flatten each piece of dough, place a mung bean ball in the center, and roll it into a ball. Repeat until all ingredients are used.
Step 7: You can shape them however you like. (You can use molds or shape them by hand like this).
Step 8: Boil some water, place the buns in the steamer, and steam for about 15-20 minutes or until cooked through.

mon_an.ten: Delicious Steamed Milk Buns for Breakfast
mon_an.mo_ta: Learn how to make fragrant milk buns that aren't greasy at all, perfect for the whole family to enjoy for breakfast or as a light snack during the day!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 35g milk powder (this makes the buns more fragrant; skip and increase flour if unavailable)
155g warm unsweetened milk (increase slightly if the dough is dry)
cac_buoc: Here are the ingredients needed for these milk buns!

Step 1: Combine flour, sugar, milk powder, yeast, and salt in a bowl and mix well. Add the fresh milk and knead for 5 minutes. Then add the oil and continue kneading until the dough is smooth, elastic, and non-sticky. Proof the dough for 50-60 minutes.

Step 2: After proofing, the dough should be significantly larger. Take it out and knead briefly. Divide the dough into 6-7 small portions. Roll them into balls, flatten slightly, and arrange on a tray to rest for another 20 minutes.
Step 3: Place a non-stick pan on the stove, arrange the buns inside, cover tightly, and pan-sear for 3 minutes on low heat.
Step 4: Flip the buns and continue flipping 1-2 times until both sides are evenly golden and cooked through.
Turn off the heat and remove the buns.
Serve the sweet milk buns on a plate; they are very convenient and delicious for children's breakfast with milk.

mon_an.ten: Delicious Fried Buns with Chinese Sausage Filling
mon_an.mo_ta: With a savory Chinese sausage filling inside and a crispy fried crust outside, this combination will surely delight anyone who tries it!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Filling: 3 Chinese sausages; 1 white radish; salt, sesame oil
cac_buoc: Step 1:
To make the filling, steam the Chinese sausages for a few minutes.
Step 2:
Peel the white radish, grate it finely, then marinate with a little salt for about 15 minutes.
Step 3:
After marinating, squeeze the radish firmly to remove all excess water.
Step 4:

Place a pan on the stove, sauté the radish for 2-3 minutes, then add the sausages and stir-fry for another 30 seconds before turning off the heat. Add 1 tbsp sesame oil and 1/2 tsp pepper, then let the filling mixture cool completely.
Step 5:
To make the oil dough, mix the ingredients together and knead until the mixture looks like the image.
Similarly, mix the water dough ingredients together and knead thoroughly.
Step 6:
Divide the water dough into 10 small pieces, then roll them out into oval shapes. Divide the oil dough into 10 pieces and roll them into balls.
Place an oil dough ball inside the water dough and gently wrap it up.
Flatten the wrapped dough into an oval shape.
Step 7:
To create a spiral pattern, roll the dough up, flatten it again, and roll it up once more. After rolling, cut it in half horizontally to get 2 pieces of dough.
Roll the cut piece into a circle.
Step 8:
To create a striped pattern, roll the dough as in step 7, but instead of cutting horizontally, cut it vertically as shown, then roll into a circle.
Step 9:
Place about 1 tbsp of the sausage filling in the center of the dough. Fold the dough over and seal the edges.
Step 10:
Deep-fry the buns in a pan of oil for about 3-4 minutes until the sides turn dark golden, then flip and fry for another 3-4 minutes.
After frying, drain the oil thoroughly before eating.
These fried buns will amaze you with their high-quality crust!
Once fried, the buns will have a very unique pattern!
Eat them while they are hot for the best taste!
The crispy crust paired with the sausage and radish filling is wonderful!

mon_an.ten: How to Make Beautiful Rose Steamed Buns
mon_an.mo_ta: Making a delicious and beautiful dish doesn't always require complicated steps. To prove that, we will guide you on how to make beautiful, fragrant rose buns to invite your friends over to enjoy. Let's get started on these rose buns.
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients
Use a fine-mesh sieve to sift the flour until it is very smooth.
Mix the flour, yeast, a pinch of salt, and sugar in a large bowl.
Cooking steps
Pour the milk into a clean pot and heat until lukewarm.
Slowly pour the milk into the flour mixture, kneading by hand as you pour until the dough becomes a thick, elastic mass.
Next, add strawberry juice and knead for another 5 minutes.
Dip a towel in warm water, wring it dry, and cover the dough to let it rise for 40 minutes.
Take the dough out, knead it again, and use a rolling pin to roll it thin. Use round cutters of different sizes to cut the dough into petals.
Arrange 4 dough circles in a row, overlapping slightly. Roll a small piece of dough into a stamen, place it in the center of the circles, and roll the 4 circles up.
Use a sharp knife to cut the roll in half to create 2 roses.
Gently pinch the base of the flower to secure them, then adjust the petals to look beautiful.
Place the buns on a steaming rack and steam for 10-15 minutes until cooked.
Finally, remove the buns and decorate with rose leaves.
Note:
You can color the petals by mixing the dough with carrot juice or pandan juice.
Do not steam for too long, as excessive steaming will make the rose buns soggy and mushy.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Beautiful Purple Sweet Potato Buns
mon_an.mo_ta: Let's learn how to make beautiful purple sweet potato vegetarian buns following this recipe.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Shredded coconut or black sesame seeds - optional
cac_buoc: Step 1: Boil the purple sweet potatoes or microwave them until cooked. Peel and mash them through a sieve until very smooth. Divide into two equal portions.
Step 2: Microwave the milk or heat it in a pot over low heat until warm (about 50°C). Turn off the heat, let it cool, and divide into 2 equal portions.
Step 3: Mix the dough

Divide the flour into two portions: one 200g and one 150g. Divide the yeast (included in the bun flour pack) proportionally. Add milk to both portions. Mix the 150g portion with one part of the mashed potato and yeast. Do the same with the remaining flour. Knead thoroughly until the dough is smooth and uniform. Let the dough rest for 2-3 hours until it doubles in size.
Step 4: Mix the remaining purple sweet potato with sugar and shredded coconut or black sesame until smooth. Divide into equal portions and roll into balls for the filling.
Step 5: Roll the dough

Once the dough has risen, dust a flat surface with flour and roll the dough out thin. Do this for both portions, then stack them and roll so they stick together. Roll the combined dough up tightly (like a Swiss roll).
Step 6: Shape the buns

There are two ways to shape them. First, simply use a knife to cut the roll into 3cm thick slices to get a beautiful two-tone swirl pattern. Second, cut thinner 1cm slices, flatten them, add the filling from step 4, and roll into a ball.
Step 7: Steam the buns
Bring water to a boil, place the buns in the steamer, and steam for about 20 minutes until cooked.
Here is the finished purple sweet potato bun.

The secret to delicious buns lies in the kneading and steaming. Bun dough must have yeast. Knead evenly until smooth, then proof the dough so the buns are soft and fluffy. Note: Do not use too much baking powder, or the buns will have an unpleasant smell after steaming.

When steaming, wait for the water to boil before putting the buns in. Occasionally open the lid to prevent water from dripping onto the buns, or place a clean towel under the lid to catch condensation. This ensures the buns are shiny and smooth.

A small tip: You can boil, steam, or microwave the potatoes. I use an Electrolux microwave; for 4 potatoes, I set it to 1000W for 10 minutes. After 5 minutes, pause to turn the potatoes, then continue. Check every 2 minutes until soft. It's fast and saves cleaning pots!

mon_an.ten: How to Make Unique and Delicious Salted Egg Custard Buns
mon_an.mo_ta: Salted Egg Custard Buns (Liu Sha Bao) – a famous Dim Sum dish with a filling completely different from traditional buns. The fragrant, rich, and creamy milk filling will surely delight you. Let's explore how to make this at home! Enjoy the wonderful taste of these unique buns with our detailed guide. You will discover an attractive recipe for buns with a special, unique flowing custard filling.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning: salt, vanilla powder, cooking oil
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Mix flour, yeast, baking powder, salt, and 20g sugar together. Slowly add 135ml milk and knead until the dough no longer sticks to your hands.
Next, proof the dough for 40 minutes until it doubles in size. Check by pressing a finger into the dough; if the indentation remains, it is ready.
Step 2:
While waiting for the dough, mix 4 egg yolks, cornstarch, and vanilla with the remaining milk and sugar. Mash the salted egg yolks and mix into this mixture.
Pour the mixture into a pot and stir until thickened. Note: use low heat and stir constantly.
Step 3:
Take the proofed dough out and divide it into small portions as shown in the image.
Step 4:
Flatten the dough into circles about 7-8mm thick. Roll the filling into balls and place in the center of the dough.
Step 5:
Gently wrap the dough around the filling to form a ball. Do not steam immediately; wait for 20 minutes.
Step 6:
Place each bun on a piece of parchment paper or use cupcake liners to prevent sticking.
Steam for about 30 minutes, and you will have a special, delicious bun.
When you break the bun in half, you will see the smooth, attractive filling inside.
Make this for your family to enjoy on the weekend!
Notes for Salted Egg Custard Buns
If you don't have a mold, you can put the filling in the fridge to harden before shaping by hand. If using instant dry yeast, ensure it is the gold label version and does not require activation.
If using active dry yeast, you must activate it first. Add yeast to warm milk (32–38°C) and stir. Wait until it foams up like crab roe; then it is ready.

Fold the dough and use your palm to knead gently, rotate 90 degrees, and repeat for 15–20 minutes. Knead until non-sticky, smooth, and uniform. Proofing time depends on room temperature. Usually, at 21–23°C, it takes 45–60 minutes to double.
To check if it has risen enough, press one or two fingers 1–2 cm into the dough. If the hole stays, it's ready. Do not open the lid during steaming to prevent the filling from leaking.
Steaming time depends on size. For 30g buns, steam for 10 minutes; larger buns need more time.
Tips for Salted Egg Custard Buns
Common mistakes
Filling becomes hard and doesn't flow: Reduce steaming time, as over-steaming overcooks the filling.
Kneading by hand: Bun dough kneads faster than bread dough. Just knead until soft and elastic.
Crumbly dough: Add a little milk and knead until it binds together.
Storage
For unsteamed buns:
Wrap tightly in plastic wrap and freeze. To use, move to the fridge to thaw, then leave at room temperature for 5 minutes before steaming as usual.
For steamed buns:
Wrap in plastic and refrigerate. Re-steam for 3–5 minutes or microwave for 30–45 seconds (at 500W). If microwaving, cover tightly to prevent drying. Lasts 2–3 days.
Wrap in plastic and freeze. Thaw in the fridge before re-steaming. Lasts 4–6 weeks.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Delicious Pork and Cabbage Steamed Buns
mon_an.mo_ta: Learn how to make pork and cabbage buns, a twist on the familiar version by replacing wood ear mushrooms and quail eggs with cabbage and eggs. These hot, sweet, and savory buns are perfect for cold days. Let's get into the kitchen.
cac_buoc: Add yeast to warm water for about 5 minutes until it blooms and the mixture turns milky and foamy.

In a bowl, combine flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar. Mix well, then slowly add the yeast water and milk. Mix until a uniform dough forms (add milk gradually). Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and let it rest for 45-60 minutes (depending on room temperature) until it rises.
Clean the scallions and ginger, then mince them and set aside.
Wash the cabbage and shred it into a bowl. Add about 1 tsp salt and let it sit for 15-20 minutes to soften and release water.

Squeeze out the water from the cabbage, then add the scallions, ginger, and ground pork. Add the filling seasonings (2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp sugar, 1.5 tsp rice wine, 1 tsp five-spice powder, 1 tbsp sesame oil, 2 tsp pepper, salt, egg, and 2 tbsp oil) and mix thoroughly.

Divide the dough into equal portions and roll them out thin (remember to dust the surface and rolling pin with flour to prevent sticking). Repeat until the dough is finished. Place about 2 tbsp of filling in the center of each piece, carefully wrap it, and pleat the edges in one direction until the filling is completely sealed.
Bring water to a boil, place the buns in the steamer, and steam for 15-20 minutes on high heat. Turn off the stove and let them sit for another 5 minutes before removing.
When serving, you can place chopped scallions on the top pleats for a more attractive look. These pork and cabbage buns are great for breakfast or an afternoon snack.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Fragrant Steamed Rice Cakes with Coconut Milk
mon_an.mo_ta: The aroma of fresh coconut water and coconut milk makes these steamed rice cakes (Banh Bo) rich and irresistible! How do you make them? Let's find out in the article below! Enjoy the sweet, fragrant, and captivating taste of these cakes with our detailed guide. Each bite is soft, smooth, and full of flavor. Discover the recipe to create these wonderful cakes for your family or parties.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Coconut sauce: 200ml coconut milk + 20g sugar + a pinch of salt + 50ml water, boiled together, then add cornstarch slurry to thicken slightly.
cac_buoc: Ingredients to prepare:
Step 1: Combine rice flour, tapioca starch, yeast, salt, sugar, and baking powder in a bowl and mix well.
Step 2: Add nearly 2/3 of the coconut water and knead by hand for 10 minutes (the longer you knead, the more air pockets the cake will have).
Now add the remaining coconut water and the coconut milk and knead together.
Step 3: Cover with plastic wrap and proof for 3-4 hours or longer. It is ready when the batter is bubbly.

Step 4: Boil a pot of water. Place bowls or a large mold greased with a little oil into the steamer for 5 minutes (to heat the mold), then pour in the batter. Cover and steam for 15-17 minutes until cooked.
Remove the cakes and let them cool slightly before slicing.
Serve the rice cakes on a plate, drizzle with coconut sauce, and sprinkle with roasted sesame seeds to finish.
Notes for Steamed Rice Cakes
Choose quality ingredients: Use fresh rice flour and coconut milk without preservatives for the best flavor.
Measure accurately: Follow the ingredient ratios exactly for consistent results.
Knead thoroughly: Focus on kneading each part evenly so the dough becomes smooth and lump-free.
Check the proofing: Before steaming, check for small air bubbles on the surface. This ensures the batter is ready.
Steaming care: Keep the lid tight and do not open it too often to maintain pressure and temperature.
Check for doneness: Use a toothpick to poke the cake. If it comes out clean, the cake is cooked.

mon_an.ten: Quickest Air Fryer Sponge Cake Recipe
mon_an.mo_ta: Passionate about baking but looking for a quicker, less oily method? Try making sponge cake with an air fryer! This is a new way to create soft, attractive cakes without traditional grease. With a simple process from prep to baking, you can enjoy delicious sponge cakes at home. Explore it now! Learn how to make wonderful sponge cake using only an air fryer. Detailed instructions from ingredients to baking to ensure a soft, fluffy cake.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Tools: Air fryer, hand mixer, and cake mold
cac_buoc: 1. Prepare the ingredients
To start, sift the flour and cornstarch to get the finest mixture. Use a whisk to combine the two flours evenly. Next, separate the egg whites and egg yolks into different bowls.
2. Mix the batter
Step 1: Mix the flours
Sift the flours for the smoothest mixture. Then, whisk the mixture together with the egg yolks.
Step 2: Beat the egg whites
First, separate the whites and yolks. Use a hand mixer to beat the whites at low speed. When bubbles appear, add 1 tsp salt and the lemon juice.
Continue beating until the mixture is fluffy. Add 100g sugar to the whites and beat until they form soft, fluffy peaks.
Step 3: Combine the batter
Add each yolk one by one into the bowl of beaten whites, using the mixer to combine. Do not pour all the yolks in at once; add them individually for a smooth, even mixture.
Add 40g oil and 20g unsweetened milk to the mixture. Next, add the flour and cornstarch mixture and use the mixer to blend until the batter is uniform.
Step 4: Bake the cake
Slowly pour the prepared sponge cake batter into the mold. Lift the mold and gently tap it on the table several times to remove air bubbles.

Place the mold into the air fryer. Set the temperature to 150°C and bake for about 40 minutes. Afterward, remove the mold and place it upside down on the table for 3-5 minutes to prevent the cake from collapsing.
Finally, use a knife to run around the edge of the mold and remove the cake. Peel off the parchment paper and slice into portions.
3. Finished product

When tasting, you will experience the wonderful aroma and natural sweetness of the cake. It is truly a delicious experience! Anyone who loves sweets shouldn't miss this homemade recipe! With just an air fryer and a mixer, you can create such a fragrant and attractive cake.
Notes for Air Fryer Sponge Cake
Ensure the mold size fits your air fryer. The cake won't cook evenly if the mold is too large.
Beating the eggs is crucial for creating air bubbles that help the cake rise. Beat the whites until stiff and smooth before adding other ingredients.
Do not over-mix the batter, as it can deflate the air bubbles, causing the cake not to rise or to collapse after baking.
Depending on the air fryer model, temperature and time may vary. Monitor the cake carefully and adjust as needed.
Avoid opening the air fryer too early, as this drops the temperature and affects the rise.
Use a liner or parchment paper for easy removal and cleaning.
Check for doneness by inserting a toothpick into the center. If it comes out clean, it's done.
After baking, let the cake cool naturally in the fryer for a while before removing to prevent collapsing.
Clean the air fryer after each use to avoid old odors affecting the next cake.
How many minutes does it take to make sponge cake in an air fryer?
Actually, baking time depends on the amount of batter and the type of cake. For best results, adjust the temperature and time accordingly. Usually, it takes 30 to 40 minutes.
However, to ensure it is evenly cooked and fluffy, refer to the specific measurements and times in this guide.
Why you should make sponge cake in an air fryer
Making sponge cake isn't hard, and you don't always need an oven. An air fryer can fully meet your baking needs.
With its compact design, low power consumption, ease of use, and cost-effectiveness, the air fryer offers many advantages.
Currently, there are many modern air fryer models with advanced features like auto-shutoff, ensuring safety during use.

mon_an.mo_ta: Learn how to make this special lemon blueberry sponge cake with our easy-to-follow recipe.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Sugar - 150g for the batter and a little for sprinkling on top
Fruit - 150g (you can choose blueberries, strawberries, etc.; this recipe uses blueberries)
cac_buoc: Mix the flour, baking powder, salt, and baking soda together; set aside.
Beat the butter with sugar for 2-3 minutes until the butter is soft and fluffy.
Add the vanilla, lemon juice, lemon zest, and egg to the butter-sugar mixture and beat well.
Gradually add the flour mixture and beat well, then add the milk and mix until the batter is smooth and uniform.
Fold in the blueberries, then pour the batter into a pan greased with a thin layer of butter or lined with parchment paper. Sprinkle a little powdered sugar evenly over the surface.

Bake in the oven for about 3 minutes until the cake is golden brown (check if it's done by inserting a toothpick into the center; if it comes out clean, it's ready). Remove the cake and let it cool before removing it from the pan.

When serving, cut the sponge cake into bite-sized triangles and sprinkle with a little powdered sugar for decoration (optional). The final result should be a perfectly baked sponge cake with an even golden surface, soft and fluffy texture, a fragrant lemon aroma, and the signature taste of blueberries.

mon_an.mo_ta: With this chocolate sponge cake recipe, anyone who tries it will be completely won over by its irresistible flavor!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: For the cake: - 170g dark chocolate (chopped or chocolate chips)
6 eggs (room temperature, separated into yolks and whites)
3ml vanilla extract or 1-2 tsp brandy/liquor of choice
Chocolate ganache: - 230g semi-sweet chocolate chips + 235ml heavy cream
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, preheat the oven to 176°C. Grease a shallow baking tray with butter or vegetable oil. Line the tray with parchment paper.

Place the chocolate and water (or coffee) in a small saucepan over very low heat. Stir constantly until the chocolate is about 3/4 melted, then remove from the heat and continue stirring until completely melted. Set aside to cool slightly.
Step 2:
Place the egg yolks in a large bowl and beat until they turn pale yellow and smooth. Gradually add the sugar while continuing to beat.
Pour the melted chocolate from step 1 into the mixture and mix until well combined.
Step 3:
In a separate bowl, beat the egg whites with a pinch of salt until stiff peaks form.
Step 4:
Divide the egg whites into 4 parts and fold each part into the chocolate mixture one by one.
Step 5:
Once mixed, the batter should look like this!
Step 6:
Pour the batter into the prepared tray and bake for 15 minutes, until the cake is just dry but still soft and moist to the touch. Test the cake with a toothpick to ensure it is baked through.
Step 7:
Remove the cake from the oven and cover the surface with a damp cloth for 10 minutes, then remove the cloth. Sprinkle a layer of cocoa powder over the surface.
Cover the surface with the cloth again, then flip the cake over. Gently peel off the parchment paper and sprinkle another layer of cocoa powder on the other side.
If you use parchment paper to roll the cake, it will easily break like this.
Step 8:
Instead, use the damp cloth the cake is resting on to roll it up. Because the cloth is moist and thicker than parchment paper, it will prevent the cake from breaking!
Once rolled, let the cake cool completely inside the cloth.
Step 9:
While waiting for the cake to cool, prepare the cream filling. Place all the cream ingredients in a bowl and beat until stiff and glossy.
Step 10:
Once the cake has cooled completely, unroll it, spread the cream evenly over the surface, and roll it back up. This time, use the cloth only to help shape the roll, do not roll the cloth inside.
The sponge cake roll base is now complete!
Now, let's move on to making the chocolate ganache!
To make the chocolate ganache, you will need:
230g semi-sweet chocolate chips
235ml heavy cream
How to make the chocolate ganache:
Step 1:
Pour the heavy cream into a saucepan and heat over low heat, stirring constantly until it just begins to boil and bubbles form around the edges, then turn off the heat.
As soon as the cream boils, remove it from the heat and pour it over the chocolate chips in a lidded bowl.
Step 2:
Cover and let the mixture sit undisturbed for 5 minutes. Do not stir.
Step 3:
After 5 minutes, uncover and whisk until the mixture is completely smooth.
Step 4:
The more you whisk, the glossier and smoother it will become. Once fully mixed, let the mixture cool completely.
Our chocolate ganache will look like this!
You should use the sauce to coat the cake 15 minutes after making it for the best results!
To coat the cake with chocolate sauce, place the cake on a wire rack with a tray underneath, then pour the sauce evenly over the cake, letting it drip down. This process is very satisfying to watch!

mon_an.mo_ta: A wonderful cake recipe featuring a combination of cream cheese, yogurt, butter, and the unique flavor of mulberries. You are sure to be enchanted by the irresistible aroma of this mulberry sponge cake.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: This recipe is for a 22 cm tube pan, 10 cm high - All-purpose flour 350g
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Sift the flour, baking powder, and baking soda until very fine.
Beat the cream cheese with butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add the eggs one by one, beating well after each addition until combined. Stir in the vanilla and yogurt.
Step 2:
Divide the flour into three parts. Add each part to the butter-egg mixture, using an electric mixer on low speed until fully incorporated.
Step 3:
Wash the mulberries and pat them dry. Toss them with a tablespoon of flour, then sift off the excess. Fold the mulberries into the batter (remember to do this step quickly and decisively).
Grease the pan with butter. Bake the cake at 170°C for about 60 - 70 minutes (test with a skewer; if it comes out clean without sticking to the batter, the cake is done).
The cake is delicious served cold with cream or warmed up (microwave for 1 minute) and enjoyed with tea.

mon_an.mo_ta: Some people may not enjoy drinking fresh tea because of its bitterness, but no one can resist a cake or ice cream made from matcha! Check out the matcha cream sponge cake recipe below to see for yourself!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Round cake pan - any diameter (a larger pan will result in a thinner cake)
Caster sugar - 80g (can be substituted with granulated sugar; adjust amount to taste)
Cooking spray (if unavailable, grease the pan with butter/oil or line with parchment paper)
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Apply cooking spray and use a brush to coat the inside of the pan evenly to prevent sticking.
Step 2:
Melt the butter in the microwave, then add 1 teaspoon of matcha powder and whisk until completely dissolved.
Step 3:
Add the sugar and ¼ teaspoon of salt, whisking until dissolved.
Add the eggs one by one, whisking well after each addition.
Slowly sift the flour into the mixture and stir until combined.
Step 4:
Pour the batter into the prepared pan.
Bake at 180°C for 30 minutes (baking time may vary depending on the oven. You can test the cake with a toothpick; if it comes out clean, the cake is done).

When serving, you can add 1-2 layers of buttercream or matcha cream according to your preference. To add two layers of cream, slice the cake horizontally in half, then spread a layer of cream in the middle and another on top. To make a simple matcha cream, whip heavy cream with a bit of sugar and matcha powder until it reaches your desired sweetness and aroma.

mon_an.mo_ta: Have you ever wanted to try making a special sponge cake that is both delicious and visually stunning? Today, we will share a unique Red Velvet sponge cake recipe. The highlight of this cake is its seductive velvet red color. The combination of cocoa powder and red food coloring creates a smooth texture and captivating hue. When sliced, the inside reveals a soft, moist, and sweet cake. Let's explore this special Red Velvet recipe together! Discover how to make a unique Red Velvet sponge cake with a smooth finish and attractive color. Follow this detailed recipe to create a special treat and impress everyone with your creativity at parties and special occasions!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Whisk, cake pan (20cm diameter), oven - tools
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Begin by cutting the butter into small pieces, cracking the eggs into a bowl, and sifting the flour and sugar to ensure they are smooth.
Step 2: Make the batter
Before preparing the batter, preheat the oven to 350°F or 180°C.
First, cream the butter and sugar together in a bowl, then slowly add the eggs one by one and whisk well.
Next, take another small bowl to mix the cocoa powder with the food coloring, then stir in the milk.
Add the flour, baking powder, food coloring mixture, salt, and vanilla to the bowl containing the butter-sugar-egg mixture. Whisk until the batter is smooth and free of lumps.
Finally, add the vinegar to the batter and continue to stir well.
Step 3: Bake the cake
Prepare the cake pan by greasing it with a thin layer of oil or butter to prevent sticking, then pour the batter into the pan.
Place the pan in the oven and bake for approximately 1 hour.
Step 4: Make the buttercream frosting
While waiting for the cake to bake, blend the cream cheese and butter together. Add the powdered sugar and whisk until the frosting is smooth and creamy.
Add the vanilla for aroma and continue to whisk until well combined.
Step 5: Frost the cake
Once the cake is baked, remove it from the pan and let it cool for about 20 minutes, then slice it into thin layers.
Use a knife to spread an even layer of frosting on each cake layer, then stack them on top of each other.
Continue using the knife to spread the frosting around the outside of the stacked cake. Using a knife will help the frosting look smoother and more even than using a spoon.
Finally, let the cake set in the refrigerator for 1-2 hours before serving.
Notes for making Red Velvet sponge cake

During the baking process, pay attention to the time and temperature to suit your specific oven. To check if the cake is done, insert a toothpick into the center. If it comes out clean, the cake is ready.
If you do not like cream cheese or butter, you can replace the frosting with whipped cream.

Regarding the color, there are many types of food coloring available, from liquid to powder. Choose a safe and suitable option. Alternatively, you can create a natural red color using ripe pomegranate juice, beet juice, or beetroot.
To frost the cake smoothly and evenly, it is recommended to use a palette knife instead of a spoon.
Additionally, you can sprinkle some grated cheese, chocolate shavings, or top with fruits like cherries to enhance the flavor and presentation.

Red Velvet sponge cake is a special, attractive, and unique dessert. The vibrant red color is sure to catch everyone's eye. When tasting, you will experience a unique flavor profile from the combination of the sponge cake and the rich cream cheese frosting.

mon_an.ten: How to make delicious sponge cake using only a rice cooker
mon_an.mo_ta: Making sponge cake with a rice cooker is very easy, fast, and effortless. You can make it anytime you want to treat your whole family!
cac_buoc: The ingredients you need to prepare to make the cake are:
Step 1:
Prepare a non-stick rice cooker. Line the bottom with a layer of parchment paper to make it easier to remove the cake once it is cooked.
Step 2:
Whisk the eggs: Using 4 eggs, separate the yolks and whites into 2 different bowls. In the egg white bowl, add ½ tsp salt and 4-5 drops of lemon juice, then whisk well.
During the whisking process, gradually add 70g sugar and continue whisking until stiff peaks form.
Step 3:
Sift 60g flour and 40g cornstarch until smooth.
In the bowl containing the egg yolks, add the vanilla, fresh milk, cooking oil, and sifted flour, then whisk until well combined. Next, gently fold this mixture into the whipped egg whites.
Note: Do not mix for too long to prevent the cake from becoming dense.
Step 4: Bake the cake in the rice cooker:
Pour the mixture into the rice cooker, press Menu and select the cake baking mode, then press Start and cook for 40 minutes.
Step 5:

After the time is up, open the lid and press down on the cake with your finger. If the cake springs back and does not sink, it is cooked. Alternatively, you can use a toothpick; if it comes out clean, the cake is done.

mon_an.ten: Guide to 2 simple and quick ways to make sponge cake at home
cac_buoc: Sponge cake is one of the traditional treats loved by many Vietnamese people. With its soft, fluffy texture and rich aroma, sponge cake has become a popular snack or gift. In this article, we will guide you through simple and quick ways to make sponge cake at home.
I. Guide to making sponge cake in the oven at home
1. Prepare ingredients
Cake flour (or all-purpose flour): 80g
Eggs: 4
Cornstarch: 20g
Unsalted butter: 15g
Sugar: 90g
Unsweetened fresh milk: 45ml
Cooking oil: 50ml
Lemon juice: 1 tbsp
Vanilla: 1 tube
Tools to prepare:
Electric hand mixer
20cm diameter cake mold
Parchment paper
2. Steps to make oven-baked sponge cake
Step 1: Preheat the oven
First, start the oven and preheat it for about 10 minutes. Set the baking temperature to about 150-170 degrees C. This helps the cake cook and rise evenly from the outside in.
Step 2: Whisk the egg whites
To whisk the eggs, you need to separate the yolks and whites. Then, whisk the egg whites.
Place the egg whites in a large bowl and use a mixer at low speed for about 7 seconds.
Add 1 tbsp lemon juice and increase the mixer speed to medium.
Add sugar and continue whisking the whites until smooth and stiff.
Step 3: Make the batter
Mix the fresh milk, cooking oil, and vanilla into the egg yolks.
You can use the mixer to whisk until the mixture is smooth and well combined.
Sift the flour and cornstarch to make the powder finer and avoid lumps.
Mix the sifted flour into the egg yolk mixture. You should only mix in one direction with a steady hand.

Finally, divide the prepared egg whites into 3 parts and gradually fold them into the egg yolk mixture. Mix gently and evenly in one direction. If you mix too vigorously, the cake may deflate or become tough because the air bubbles are broken.
Step 4: Bake the cake

First, line the sides and bottom of the mold with parchment paper to prevent sticking, then pour the prepared batter into the mold. Note to only fill the mold about 2/3 full and distribute it evenly. Next, gently tap the mold on the surface to help the cake bake more evenly. Finally, place the cake in the oven and bake at 150 degrees C for about 30 minutes for perfect results.

When the cake is cooked, open the oven and let it cool for about 5 minutes before taking it out. Wait for the cake to cool completely, remove the mold and parchment paper, then cut the cake into bite-sized pieces. To know if the sponge cake meets the requirements, ensure the crumb is soft and slightly moist.
The outer crust should not be burnt. The cake should have a light aroma, no fishy egg smell, and an even, attractive golden color.
II. How to make sponge cake in a rice cooker
Flour: 60 g
Cornstarch: 40 g
Sweetened fresh milk: 30 ml
Lemon: 1/2 fruit
Cooking oil: 15 ml
Vanilla: 1/2 tsp
Sugar: 70 g
Salt: 1/2 tsp
2. Cooking steps
2.1. Whisk the eggs
First, sift 60g flour and 40g cornstarch until smooth. Then, separate the yolks and whites of 4 eggs into 2 separate bowls.

Add 1/2 tsp salt and 4-5 drops of lemon juice to the egg whites, then use a whisk to beat until small bubbles appear. At this point, start gradually adding 70g sugar, whisking as you go until stiff peaks form and the whisk leaves a sharp tip when lifted.
2.2. Mix the batter
Add 1/2 tsp vanilla, 30ml sweetened fresh milk, and 15ml cooking oil to the egg yolk bowl, then whisk thoroughly.
Next, pour the sifted flour and cornstarch into the yolk bowl and whisk until a smooth mixture is formed.
2.3. Combine the mixtures
First, add about 1/3 of the whipped egg whites to the egg yolk mixture and use a whisk to mix evenly until fully incorporated.

Then, combine this mixture with the remaining whipped egg whites and mix using the Fold method (scraping and flipping ingredients from the bottom up). During the mixing process, only move in one direction and stop as soon as the flour is just incorporated (about 5 minutes). Avoid overmixing as this can make the batter dense and prevent it from rising.
2.4. Bake the cake

Line the bottom of the pot with parchment paper for easier removal. Then, pour the batter into the rice cooker and press the cook button. For rice cookers with a cake baking mode, select the menu for baking for about 40 minutes.
2.5. Check the cake

When the time is up, open the lid and press your finger on the cake surface. If the surface does not sink, the cake is cooked. At this point, wait for the cake to cool slightly before taking it out to serve.
If the cake is not yet cooked, close the lid and press the "cook" button again, waiting another 5-10 minutes for the cake to cook through completely.
2.6. Finished product

Making sponge cake with a rice cooker saves time and effort while producing a delicious, soft, and fluffy result. This cake is perfect for afternoon tea or family gatherings. It is highly rated for its suitability and flavor.
III. Notes when making sponge cake
Choose quality ingredients: Use all-purpose flour or specialized cake flour. Ensure you buy fresh, high-quality ingredients for the best cake.
Ensure enough moisture: When mixing the batter, add fresh milk so the cake isn't too dry and stays soft.
Pay attention to the eggs: Use room temperature eggs and whisk them well for a smooth, elastic structure.
Set the correct temperature: Read the oven instructions and set the right temperature. Adjust the time and temperature depending on your specific oven.
Do not open the oven too early: Avoid opening the oven too soon to prevent the cake from collapsing. Check the cake at the end of the baking process.
Let the cake cool before removing from the mold: Leave the cake in the oven for a few minutes after baking, then let it cool completely before enjoying.
Store properly: If not finished, store the cake in a cake box or plastic bag to preserve moisture.
Following these principles will help you create delicious, beautiful cakes that stay moist for a long time.

mon_an.ten: How to make irresistibly soft milk sponge cake
mon_an.mo_ta: With a soft, warm, sweet crumb and a rich milky aroma, Tres leches is a very popular milk cream sponge cake loved by people in South American regions like Costa Rica, Ecuador, Mexico... Let's learn how to make this wonderful cake!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
