In this first step, prepare a bowl (or a large basin) and add the flour, baking powder, and a pinch of salt. Mix everything together.
Step 2:
Prepare 2 small bowls to separate the 5 egg whites and 5 egg yolks into each bowl.
Step 3:
With the egg yolk bowl, add sugar and use a mixer. You should turn the mixer to high speed so the eggs become fluffy, until the mixture turns pale and looks aerated.
Step 4:
Next, add the vanilla extract and fresh milk to the mixer, switch to low speed, and whisk until everything is well combined.
Step 5:
After completing the egg + sugar + milk + vanilla mixture, pour it into the flour bowl mixed in step 1 and stir until fully incorporated.
Step 6:
Now we will use the mixer to whisk the egg whites. Whisk at high speed until they turn white, then add 55g sugar and continue whisking until stiff peaks form.
Step 7:
Add the whipped egg whites to the mixture from step 5 and fold everything together.
When the mixture is well mixed, light, soft, and smooth, spread it onto a baking tray. Remember to spread it evenly so the cake doesn't rise unevenly or burn in some spots.
Place in the oven and bake at 180 degrees C for 35-40 minutes. When the cake is cooked, remove it and let it cool.
Step 8:

Next, put 1 can of sweetened condensed milk, the evaporated milk, and the heavy cream into a pitcher (as shown in the picture if possible, otherwise use a bowl or basin) and use a whisk to mix them all together.
Step 9:
When the cake has cooled completely, use a fork to poke holes all over the surface (as shown) to create paths for the milk to soak in.
Then, slowly and evenly pour the milk mixture over the cake surface to let it soak in and wait for 10 minutes.
Note: You should pour evenly over the entire cake, including the edges and the surface.
Step 10:
The final step is to simply whip the heavy cream with sugar and spread it evenly over the cake surface to finish this delicious sponge cake.
Place the cake in the refrigerator for 30 minutes before serving.

This sponge cake is called Tres leches. With its soft, warm, sweet crumb and rich milky aroma, Tres leches is a very popular milk cream sponge cake loved by people in South American regions like Costa Rica, Ecuador, Mexico...
"Tres Leches" means "3 types of milk"; the cake is named after the ingredients used to soak the cake, creating its characteristic moisture and aroma.

mon_an.ten: Discover 2 ways to make authentic salted egg sponge cake
mon_an.mo_ta: Discover the recipe for salted egg sponge cake with a soft, moist crumb, coated in a rich sauce and savory pork floss, combined with the special flavor of creamy salted eggs. This cake is sure to win everyone over. With just a few simple steps, you can hand-make a wonderful cake for the whole family to enjoy. Let's get into the kitchen and make these 2 salted egg sponge cake recipes! I. How to make authentic salted egg sponge cake with cheese sauce and egg oil sauce
cac_buoc: 1. Ingredients
6 salted egg yolks
4 egg yolks (about 20g each)
2 egg whites
110g granulated sugar
10g powdered sugar
110g cooking oil
40g cake flour (No. 8)
15g tapioca starch
15g all-purpose flour
280ml unsweetened fresh milk
5g lemon juice
4 Laughing Cow cheese wedges (60g total), softened at room temperature
30g unsalted butter
White wine
Ginger
Tools: Whisk, sieve, cake mold, etc.
2. How to make salted egg sponge cake
Step 1: Make the chiffon cake base

First, take 2 egg yolks and mix well with 10g granulated sugar, 30ml unsweetened fresh milk, 10g cooking oil, and 40g cake flour. In another bowl, whisk 2 egg whites with 5g lemon juice until small bubbles appear, then add 30g granulated sugar and continue whisking until the mixture reaches soft, glossy peaks. Next, fold the yolk mixture and the white mixture together.

Then, pour the mixture from a height into a 15cm diameter, 5.7cm high mold. Gently tap the mold 5-7 times to remove large air bubbles and make the cake smoother. Finally, bake in the oven at 150 degrees C for 50 minutes, then remove.
Step 2: Make the cheese sauce
First, put 250ml unsweetened fresh milk, 4 cheese wedges, and 70g granulated sugar into a pot, then cook until the cheese is completely melted. Turn off the heat and let the mixture cool.
Next, in another bowl, whisk 1 egg yolk, 15g tapioca starch, and 15g all-purpose flour. Then, pour in the cooled milk mixture and continue to mix well.

Next, strain the mixture through a sieve to remove lumps. Place the pot back on the stove and cook over medium heat until the milk mixture thickens, then turn off the heat. Add 30g unsalted butter and stir until completely melted. Pour the sauce onto a plate and wait for it to cool. Then, whisk the sauce again to achieve a smooth, fine texture.
Step 5: Decorate the cake

Start by cutting the cake in half horizontally. On the first half, spread a layer of egg oil sauce. Next, add crushed salted eggs on top to create the filling. On the second half of the cake, apply a layer of cheese sauce, then sandwich the two parts together so the sauce layers meet, forming a filling.
Step 6: Finished product

Start by coating the outside of the cake with cheese sauce until it is smooth. Next, add a layer of pork floss to the surface. On the top of the cake, you can mix a little cocoa powder into the cheese sauce to write words or decorate as you like.
The salted egg sponge cake with its smooth cheese sauce melts in your mouth. With the blend of salty and sweet salted eggs, the cake is ready to be enjoyed.
II. How to make a salted egg sponge birthday cake
1. Prepare ingredients
Salted egg part:
12 salted egg yolks
Sesame oil (or olive oil)
Toasted sesame seeds
White wine (or cooking wine)
Egg oil sauce part:
1 egg yolk
1.5 tbsp sugar
⅓ tsp salt
4 – 5 drops lemon juice
120ml cooking oil
Cheese sauce part:
200g cream cheese
170ml unsweetened fresh milk
30g sugar
15g unsalted butter
15g cornstarch
Vanilla
Sponge cake part:
6 eggs
170g cake flour (can substitute with 110g all-purpose flour + 60g cornstarch)
80g cooking oil
90g unsweetened fresh milk
100g sugar
10ml lemon juice
Salt
Tools: Parchment paper, toothpicks, molds.
2. How to make
Step 1: Bake the salted eggs

Start by separating the yolks from 12 salted eggs and soaking them in white wine or cooking wine for about 10 minutes to remove the fishy smell. Then, rinse the eggs and pat dry with paper towels. Next, dip the eggs in sesame oil (or olive oil). Bake the eggs in the oven at 180 degrees C for about 15 minutes.
After baking, let the eggs cool slightly and then mash them. You can add toasted sesame seeds for extra aroma.
Step 2: Make the egg oil sauce

In this step, put 1 egg yolk, 1.5 tbsp sugar, and ⅓ tsp salt into a bowl. Use a whisk or mixer to beat the egg until it becomes fluffy and lighter in color. Once the egg is aerated, slowly add 120ml cooking oil. Continue whisking until the mixture is well combined and has an even golden color.
Step 3: Make the cheese sauce

To make the cheese sauce, mix 170ml fresh milk with 15g cornstarch and sugar, stirring well. Next, cook the milk and cream cheese mixture in a pot over medium-low heat until the sauce thickens. Turn off the heat and add 15g unsalted butter and vanilla, stirring until the cheese sauce is fragrant and smooth.
Step 4: Mix the cake batter

Start by separating the whites and yolks. With the whites, add a pinch of salt and 10ml lemon juice, then whisk until light and foamy. Next, add 100g sugar in batches and whisk until stiff peaks form. Then, add 6 yolks in two batches, whisking lightly after each to avoid deflating the batter. Next, add 80g cooking oil and 90g fresh milk, and mix well.
Once the mixture is uniform, sift in 170g cake flour in two batches and mix well. Note: do not overmix to avoid a dense cake.
Step 5: Bake the cake

Once the batter is mixed, proceed to bake immediately. Pour the batter into a mold lined with parchment paper and use a toothpick to swirl the surface for a smoother finish. Gently tap the mold 3-4 times to reduce air bubbles. Before baking, preheat the oven for 15 minutes at 145 degrees C. Place the cake in the oven and bake for about 70 – 75 minutes at 145 degrees C.
After the cake is cooked, leave it in the oven for another 15 minutes before taking it out; do not remove it immediately. Then, let the cake cool and remove it from the mold.
Step 6: Decorate the cake

Using a knife or cake leveler, divide the cake into two equal horizontal parts. Next, spread ½ of the cheese sauce evenly on one part of the cake and sprinkle a layer of pork floss. Place the remaining cake part on top and repeat the steps.
Finally, decorate the cake by adding salted eggs and egg oil sauce on top. The cake is finished and ready to be enjoyed.

mon_an.ten: Guide to making Bánh Bột Lọc with meat and shrimp (Hue specialty)
mon_an.mo_ta: If you love specialty flavors and are looking for a unique and interesting dish to enjoy, today we will guide you on how to make Bánh Bột Lọc, a signature dish from Hue – a land famous for its rich cuisine and wonderful specialties. Discover how to make authentic Bánh Bột Lọc at home with detailed instructions. Learn the steps and secrets to creating perfect, easy, and light Bánh Bột Lọc. Express your culinary passion and enjoy this special dish with family and friends.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning - Salt, pepper, sugar, fish sauce, minced shallot, minced garlic
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare ingredients

To remove the fishy smell of the shrimp, follow these steps. First, dissolve one teaspoon of salt in 300ml of water, then soak the shrimp in this solution for about 5-10 minutes. Next, rinse the shrimp thoroughly several times with water to remove all impurities. After washing, drain the shrimp.
Once the shrimp are cleaned, gently remove the heads and shells. Then, use a sharp knife to slit along the back of the shrimp and slowly pull out the black vein. Repeat for all shrimp.
To prepare the pork, start by rinsing the meat briefly with diluted salt water for about 3 minutes. Then, remove and drain. Once drained, cut the meat into small pieces for the filling.
For the scallions, remove any yellowed leaves and the roots. Next, wash the scallions and chop them finely for use.
Step 2: Marinate the shrimp and meat

To marinate the shrimp, combine 1 tsp salt, 3 tsp sugar, 1/2 tsp MSG, 1 tsp seasoning powder, and 1/2 tsp pepper. Mix well so the shrimp absorb the spices and marinate for 20 minutes to make them more flavorful.

Similarly, the meat needs to be marinated with a combination of 1 tsp salt, 3 tsp sugar, 1/2 tsp MSG, 1 tsp seasoning powder, and 1/2 tsp pepper. Mix the spices and meat well, then let it marinate for about 20 minutes so the flavors penetrate evenly.
Step 3: Stir-fry the shrimp and meat

To stir-fry the shrimp, place a pan on the stove and add 2 tbsp cooking oil. Wait for the oil to get hot, then add the shrimp to the pan and stir-fry for about 15 minutes. After 15 minutes, when the shrimp turn orange and are cooked, remove them from the pan and place them in a bowl.

Similarly, place a pan on the stove and add 2 tbsp cooking oil. Wait for the oil to get hot, then add the meat to the pan and stir-fry for 15 minutes until the meat firms up. When the meat is cooked, turn off the heat, remove the meat from the pan, and transfer it to a bowl.
Step 4: Knead the dough
To knead the dough for the cakes, start by placing 800g of tapioca starch in a bowl and making a well in the center. Then, boil about 300ml of water.
Once the water is boiling, slowly pour it into the well; you should divide it into several pours, about 100ml of boiling water each time.
Next, carefully use a spatula to mix the dough quickly, then use your hands to knead. If you find the dough is still dry during kneading, continue adding water.
Continue this process until the dough becomes a smooth, elastic mass that does not stick to your hands. When the dough reaches this consistency, it has met the requirements.
Step 5: Wrap the cakes
After the dough has been thoroughly kneaded, to make the wrappers, take a small portion of dough (about the size of a marble or slightly larger), roll it into a ball, and flatten it very thinly.
Next, gently place the filling, consisting of meat and shrimp, in the center and use your hands to press the edges of the dough firmly together to ensure the cake does not tear when boiled.

To boil the cakes, place a pot on the stove and add about 500ml of water along with one tablespoon of cooking oil and bring to a boil. Then, gently drop each cake into the boiling water and cook for about 5 - 10 minutes until the wrapper becomes translucent. After boiling, remove the cakes and place them in a bowl of cold water for 2 minutes to cool, then arrange them on a plate.
This is the result after following the steps!
Step 6: Prepare the dipping sauce

Place a pan on the stove and heat about 5 tbsp of cooking oil. Once the oil is hot, turn off the heat and carefully ladle about 4 tbsp of the oil into a small bowl containing the chopped scallions to make scallion oil.
In the remaining pan, add 1 tbsp chili powder and mix well to create chili satay.

To make the dipping sauce, in a bowl, mix 2 tbsp fish sauce, 3 tbsp sugar, and all of the freshly made chili satay. Stir well to completely dissolve the seasonings, then taste and adjust the flavor to suit your family's preference.

mon_an.mo_ta: A new brownie recipe that is extremely easy yet delicious and doesn't take too much time. With this method, you can create lovely, sweet gifts for friends and family, or pack them for your picnics and outings.
cac_buoc: Brownies are very simple to make, but to ensure your batch is perfect, there are a few secrets! With this method, your brownies will have an amazing flavor!
Step 1:
Prepare a small pot, add the butter, chocolate, and brown sugar, then melt over medium heat.
You must use medium heat; if you use high heat to melt the mixture quickly, it can easily burn, or the chocolate might melt before the sugar has dissolved, resulting in an uneven texture.
Step 2:
Use a whisk to beat the mixture until melted and well combined.
Let the mixture cool for 2 minutes, then add the eggs and vanilla extract, whisking until the mixture is well incorporated and smooth.
Step 3:
Sift the flour into the mixture, then use a spoon to stir gently until the flour is evenly incorporated and the batter is thick, tacky, and smooth.
Step 4:
For a beautiful presentation, you should use a 24-cup mini muffin tin.
Brush a very thin layer of oil onto the tray so the cakes don't stick when you remove them.
Step 5:
Preheat the oven to 180°C, then pour the batter into each cup of the mold. You should only fill the cups 3/4 full, as the cakes will rise during baking.
Bake in the oven for 14-16 minutes.
Step 6:
Once baked, quickly remove the cakes from the mold and place them on a wire rack to cool.
Note: To check if the cakes are done, insert a toothpick into a cake; if the toothpick comes out clean, the cake is done. If you see batter sticking to the toothpick, continue baking until finished!
Step 7:
While waiting for the cakes to cool, proceed to make the frosting.
Place the white chocolate in the microwave and heat until melted. Gradually add the vegetable oil to the melted white chocolate, stirring gently until dissolved.
Stop adding oil once the mixture reaches the desired consistency for dipping the brownies.
Step 8:
Once the mixture is ready, dip each brownie into the white chocolate, then place them on a rack for the chocolate to set. You can also use a spoon to drizzle the white chocolate over the brownies.
To make the cakes even cuter and more appealing, you can sprinkle colored sprinkles on top for decoration.
These brownies are small and convenient for picnics with friends and family, as gifts, or as a school snack to stave off hunger during breaks.
The cakes look like buttons coated in an eye-catching layer of white chocolate with an irresistible flavor!
You can also put them in glass jars or cupcake liners to give to friends and relatives.
Eating brownies with vanilla cream sauce and chocolate sauce is absolutely delicious!

mon_an.ten: Soft and Fluffy Pandan Chiffon Cake
mon_an.mo_ta: Fragrant pandan combined with eggs, milk, and other ingredients creates a beautiful green pandan chiffon cake that is incredibly aromatic and soft!
cac_buoc: Preheat the oven to 160°C to prepare for baking.
Step 1: Wash the pandan leaves thoroughly, cut into short segments, and place in a blender with 50ml of water. Cover and blend until smooth, then strain to get 40ml of pandan extract.
Step 2: Separate the egg whites and yolks into two bowls. Note: do not let any yolk get into the whites. In the yolk bowl, add the oil and pandan extract, then whisk well.
Step 3: Sift the flour and cornstarch into the yolk mixture and mix with a whisk until no dry flour remains.

Step 4: In the egg white bowl, add a pinch of salt and lemon juice. Use a hand mixer to beat until foamy, then gradually add the sugar while continuing to beat. Continue until the egg whites reach stiff peaks.
Step 5: Take 1/3 of the egg whites and add them to the yolk bowl, then use a whisk to mix well.
Step 6: Pour the entire mixture back into the egg white bowl and use a spatula to fold gently from the bottom up until the mixture is uniform.
Step 7: Pour the batter into the chiffon mold and level the surface. Tap the mold lightly on the table a few times to break large air bubbles.

Step 8: Place the mold on the lowest rack of the oven and bake for about 45 minutes until done. You can test the cake by inserting a toothpick into the center; if it comes out clean, the cake is ready.
Invert the mold onto a wire rack and let it cool completely before removing the cake from the mold. Slice and serve on a plate.
Good luck with this delicious, soft, and smooth pandan chiffon cake!

mon_an.mo_ta: Today, "Delicious Cooking" brings you an extremely simple cake recipe to add to your list. With easy-to-find ingredients already in your kitchen and just a few minutes of prep, you can pop the cake in the oven and relax with a movie, music, or browse the web. In less than an hour, you'll have a fragrant chocolate pie. Check out our chocolate pie recipe now!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 180°C.
Step 2: Prepare the ingredients.
Put the sugar and cocoa powder in a bowl.
Mix well with a whisk.
Then crack in the eggs...
...add the milk and melted butter.
Use a whisk to mix all ingredients together into a smooth, uniform mixture.
Step 3: Bake the pie.
Place the tart crust into the mold and prick the surface evenly with a fork.
Slowly pour the cocoa and milk mixture into the crust.
After pouring the mixture, the semi-finished product will look like this.
Place the pie in the preheated oven and bake for 40-50 minutes until done. To check, insert a toothpick; if it comes out clean, turn off the oven and remove the pie.

Chocolate pie can be served for breakfast, an afternoon snack, dinner, or at parties. You can choose any mold shape and decorate as you like—for example, use a round or square mold, spread fruit jam in the middle, and decorate with whipped cream and fruit for a birthday cake, or simply sprinkle some cocoa powder or chocolate shavings on top for flavor and beauty.
Doesn't the chocolate pie look tempting? Don't hesitate, roll up your sleeves and bake a delicious chocolate pie for yourself and your family.

mon_an.mo_ta: Learn how to make a delicious and nutritious chocolate banana cake for the whole family's breakfast with this special recipe.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Bananas - 3 ripe ones, peeled and mashed
Shredded coconut - 100g (80g for the batter, 20g for topping)
Cane sugar - 5g (for topping, can be replaced with brown sugar)
cac_buoc: Finely chop the chocolate, place in a bowl, and melt over a double boiler, then set aside. This chocolate will be used for the topping.
Sift the flour into a bowl and mix thoroughly with cocoa powder, baking soda, baking powder, salt, and cinnamon.
Place eggs and sugar in a large bowl and use a hand mixer to beat at medium speed for about 1 minute.
Next, add the mashed bananas, coconut oil, and yogurt, then mix well.
Slowly add the dry flour mixture (already mixed with cocoa, baking powder, and baking soda).
Whisk while adding the flour until the mixture is uniform, then stop.

Add the shredded coconut and mix well. Spray a pan with non-stick spray, brush with coconut oil, or line with parchment paper, then pour in the batter. Drizzle the prepared melted chocolate over the surface.
Sprinkle a little sugar and the remaining shredded coconut on top, then bake for 50-60 minutes until the cake is done. When a toothpick comes out clean, remove and place on a rack to cool.

The finished cake is cooling on the rack. The layer of chocolate, shredded coconut, and sugar on top looks very appetizing. When eating, simply use a knife to cut the cake into thin slices and serve immediately.

mon_an.mo_ta: Surely many of you have enjoyed cakes with that signature chocolate flavor! Today, let's cook together and make this chocolate cake! This chocolate cake is absolutely superb, with every slice being fluffy, soft, moist, and irresistibly fragrant.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Use a hand mixer to cream the butter and sugar together until the mixture is soft, smooth, and pale yellow as shown below.
Step 2:
Add the egg and beat well, then add the fresh milk and vanilla and mix together.
Step 3:
Sift the cocoa powder until smooth to remove any lumps, then mix it into the mixture from step 2.
Step 4:
Mix the flour and baking powder together, then slowly sift them into the mixture from step 3. Mix until the batter is smooth, silky, and uniform.
Step 5: Bake the cake
Grease the mold with butter or line it with parchment paper (if not using a non-stick mold), then pour the batter into the mold.
Tip: I used a loaf pan to bake the cake, but you can use any type of mold.
Place the mold in the oven at 180°C. During baking, you can check if the cake is done by inserting a toothpick; if it comes out clean, the cake is ready.
With this extremely simple recipe and method, you have a very fragrant and attractive chocolate cake. Here are some small tips for a delicious chocolate cake I want to share:
The time for beating the eggs and ingredients in steps 1 and 2 depends on the power of your mixer. My mixer takes about 3 minutes.
Use a sifter for the cocoa powder and flour so the mixture is uniform and the cake turns out fluffy without lumps.

Baking time depends on the amount of ingredients. With the quantities in this article, it takes about 1 hour. If you use more or less, adjust the time by checking frequently; when the toothpick comes out clean, it's done.
When taking the cake out of the oven, let it cool for about 10 minutes before removing it from the mold; it will be much easier.

The finished chocolate cake should be airy, fluffy, and soft, not dry, with a vanilla aroma, rich egg, butter, and milk flavor, and especially a strong cocoa scent. Chocolate cake can be served for breakfast, an afternoon snack, dinner, or at parties. You can choose any mold and decorate as you like—for example, use a round or square mold, spread fruit jam in the middle, and decorate with whipped cream and fruit for a birthday cake, or simply sprinkle a little powdered sugar on top for decoration and add a strawberry Santa Claus for Christmas. Even simpler, just serve the cake with a bit of whipped cream and fruit jam, which is also great.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Crispy, Puffed, and Hollow Fried Banana Cakes
mon_an.mo_ta: These golden, puffed fried bananas feature a crispy, fragrant outer shell interspersed with nutty black sesame seeds, while the inside remains naturally soft and sweet. Notably, these cakes retain their crunch for a long time. Don't miss the chance to discover how to make these crispy fried bananas in the guide below! I. Traditional Crispy Fried Banana Cake Recipe
cac_buoc: 1. Prepare ingredients
15 ripe Siamese bananas (quantity can be adjusted based on your preference)
250g rice flour
370ml water
1 bowl of leftover cold rice
1 tsp salt
1 tbsp all-purpose flour
1/2 tbsp turmeric powder
3 tbsp sugar
2. How to make delicious crispy fried bananas
Step 1: Prepare the batter
Start by pouring 250g of rice flour into a bowl. Then, add 1 tsp of salt, 3 tbsp of sugar, and 1 bowl of leftover cold rice. Using cold rice helps the banana cakes become crispier.

Next, pour 370ml of water and 1/2 tbsp of turmeric powder into the bowl. If you want a deeper color, you can add more turmeric, but be careful not to add too much as it can make the cakes bitter. Put on gloves and mash the rice thoroughly to mix the batter until smooth. To save time, you can use a blender to make the mixture smoother.
Step 2: Flatten and prepare the bananas

Start by peeling the bananas and removing any strings. Place a banana in a plastic bag and use a cutting board to press it down. Use moderate force and press only once to avoid crushing the banana. Flatten all prepared bananas and arrange them on a plate.
Step 3: Coat the bananas with batter

After the batter has rested in the refrigerator for about 15 minutes, take it out and place each flattened banana into the batter bowl. Coat the bananas thoroughly so the batter covers every side, then arrange them on a plate.
Step 4: Fry the bananas
Add cooking oil to a pot. For fried bananas, ensure they are deep-fried so the dish becomes crispier and more delicious. Once the oil is hot, gently drop the bananas into the pan.
Note: Do not put too many bananas in the pan at once as they may stick together during frying.
When the mixture is smooth and free of lumps, add 1 tbsp of all-purpose flour and whisk gently until combined. Finally, cover the mixture and let it rest in the refrigerator for about 15 minutes.

When the outer batter turns light golden, remove the bananas and dip them into the batter bowl a second time before continuing to fry. Over high heat, fry the bananas until they are golden brown and crispy, then remove and drain on paper towels. Repeat the process until all bananas are fried.
Step 5: Finish and enjoy

The long-lasting crispy fried bananas are now ready. The golden, crunchy banana pieces make the dish very attractive. When you bite into a piece, you will feel the crispiness of the crust with a characteristic "crunch" sound.
The inside is soft and sweet, creating a delightful sensation. This dish is perfect for afternoon snacks and is a delicious, ideal choice.
II. Thai-Style Crispy Fried Banana Recipe
8 ripe bananas
140g rice flour
7g baking powder
10g white sesame seeds
65g shredded coconut
30ml coconut milk
140ml filtered water
1/2 tsp salt
65g sugar
2. Cooking steps
2.1. Mixing and Preparing Bananas

Start by mixing the ingredients in a bowl in the following order: rice flour, baking soda, white sesame seeds, sugar, shredded coconut, salt, coconut milk, and filtered water. Once everything is in the bowl, stir well until the components are fully combined.
Next, peel the Siamese bananas and cut them lengthwise into thin slices about 1cm thick. Place all banana slices into the batter bowl, then gently mix so the batter coats each piece evenly.
2.2. Frying
Place a pan on the stove and pour in enough oil to deep-fry the bananas. Heat the oil until hot, then lower to low heat and start frying the bananas.
Fry the bananas until the outer batter puffs up and turns a vibrant golden brown, then remove them and place them in a basket lined with paper towels.
2.3. Completion
Wait for the banana cakes to cool and drain the oil, then place them on a plate. When enjoying Thai-style fried bananas, you can dip them in a little honey for extra flavor!
III. Puffed Fried Bananas with Sesame Seeds Recipe
8 bananas
100g toasted sesame seeds
500ml cooking oil
300ml water
200g all-purpose flour
50g non-glutinous rice flour
50g glutinous rice flour
2 tsp baking powder
50g sugar
2 tsp turmeric powder (optional for a more golden color)
2.1. Prepare the Bananas
Peel the bananas and cut them in half lengthwise. Place the bananas on a plastic sheet and gently press to flatten them slightly.
2.2. Mix the Batter

In a bowl, add the all-purpose flour, non-glutinous rice flour, glutinous rice flour, baking powder, sugar, salt, turmeric powder (optional), and filtered water one by one. Stir the mixture well and let the batter rest for 30 minutes to rise. Once the batter has risen evenly, add the sesame seeds and stir well.
2.3. Fry the Cakes

Place the flattened bananas into the batter bowl and roll them so they are evenly coated without breaking. Pour oil into a pan (enough to submerge the bananas). When the oil is hot, place the coated bananas into the pan to fry (be gentle when picking them up so excess batter drips back into the bowl instead of onto the stove).
Reduce the heat and flip the cakes frequently until they are golden brown on both sides. Then, remove the cakes and place them on a plate with paper towels.
Step 4: Completion

After finishing the process, you can immediately enjoy the delicious sesame fried bananas while they are hot. With golden-brown cakes, a crispy crust, nutty sesame seeds, and the mild sweetness of ripe bananas, every bite will be incredibly appealing!
IV. Tips for making delicious fried bananas
Choose ripe Siamese or King bananas with thin skins to ensure a sweet flavor. Avoid using unripe bananas to prevent a bitter taste and to keep the cakes from collapsing when fried.
Using the "double-dipping" method is a traditional way to keep cakes (like orange cakes, ring cakes, banana cakes...) crispy for a long time after frying.
It is important to let the batter rest long enough so it can rise, creating small air pockets when frying, which helps the cakes become naturally light and crispy.
To make the cakes more fragrant, you can add a little cheese powder or custard powder to the batter for a special flavor.
This batter mixing method also works well for making crispy sweet potato or corn cakes during cold winter days.

mon_an.ten: Delicious Black Sesame Fried Banana Cakes
mon_an.mo_ta: These delicious sesame fried banana cakes are guaranteed to be sweet, crispy, and fragrant with the scent of ripe bananas! Check out this black sesame fried banana recipe now.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel the bananas, then cut them in half or into thin slices (as preferred).
Step 2: Combine all-purpose flour + rice flour + sugar + turmeric powder and mix well.
Step 3: Add cold water + lemon juice and stir until dissolved. Let the mixture rest in the refrigerator for 30 minutes.
Step 4: Take the batter out and sprinkle black sesame seeds into it, then mix well.
Step 5: Heat oil in a pan; when the oil is slightly hot, dip the bananas into the batter and place them in the pan to fry over medium heat. Fry until golden brown on both sides.
Step 6: When the banana pieces are golden and crispy, remove them to a basket lined with paper towels.

With this batter mixing method, you will have fried banana pieces that are crispy, fragrant, and visually appealing. Fried bananas made this way are delicious whether eaten hot or cold; everyone will love them.
Good luck with this recipe for crispy, hot sesame fried bananas!

mon_an.ten: Discover 2 Ways to Make Delicious Steamed Banana Cake with Coconut Milk
mon_an.mo_ta: Soft and fragrant steamed banana cake served with coconut milk has long been a rustic specialty of the Mekong Delta. Anyone who tries it is easily won over by its wonderful flavor. The small, soft, chewy pieces of cake blend with the mild sweetness of ripe bananas, the richness of coconut milk, and a touch of toasted sesame or crushed roasted peanuts to create an incredibly attractive flavor. Today, we will guide you through 2 ways to make delicious steamed banana cake with coconut milk! Prep: 20m
cac_buoc: Cooking: 30m
Prepare ingredients
2kg ripe bananas: Choose bananas that are yellow or soft-ripe to enhance the sweetness.
260g tapioca starch or rice flour: Used to create the chewiness for the cake.
200g white sugar: Used to sweeten the banana cake.
200ml coconut milk: Creates the characteristic rich flavor for the cake.
Banana leaves (optional): Used for steaming the cake to add a special aroma.
Toasted sesame seeds or roasted peanuts (optional): Used to sprinkle over the cake for extra flavor and crunch.
2 ways to make delicious steamed banana cake with coconut milk
1. Traditional Steamed Banana Cake with Coconut Milk
Step 1: Prepare the bananas
Peel the bananas and cut them into thin slices, about 0.2cm thick.
Mix the sliced bananas with 200g of sugar and marinate for 15-20 minutes until the sugar dissolves into the bananas.
Step 2: Make the chewy batter
In a large bowl, mix together tapioca starch, 200g tapioca starch, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp vanilla, and 200g sugar.
Sift the flour mixture to make it smoother.
Next, add 3 cups of water to the flour mixture and stir well to create a homogeneous mixture.
Add the marinated bananas to the bowl and stir gently so as not to crush them.
Apply a thin layer of cooking oil to the bottom of the cake mold for easy removal after cooking.
Step 3: Steam the cake
Pour the banana cake batter into the mold, creating a layer about 2-3cm thick so the cake cooks easily.
If desired, you can place a few banana leaves on top of the batter to increase the aroma.
Place the mold into the steamer and steam for about 30-40 minutes until cooked.
Check if the banana cake is done by seeing if the starch has set and a chopstick inserted comes out clean.
Step 4: Completion
Remove the cake once cooked and wait for it to cool completely. Cut the cake into bite-sized pieces and arrange them on a plate.

Drizzle coconut milk over the cake for extra flavor. If desired, sprinkle roasted peanuts or toasted sesame seeds on top for crunch and a special taste. Your traditional steamed banana cake is now ready for the family to enjoy.
How to make Steamed Banana Cake with Coconut Milk
1. Prepare the bananas
After buying the bananas, peel and cut them into bite-sized thin slices. Place the prepared bananas in a bowl and marinate with 200g of sugar.
2. Make the batter

To make the batter, prepare a large bowl. Mix 300g tapioca starch, 50g rice flour, and 350ml pandan leaf juice into the bowl to create a beautiful green color and a special flavor. Once all ingredients are in the bowl, stir until completely dissolved. Then, add the prepared bananas and mix well.
3. Make the coconut milk
Heat a pan, then add 200ml coconut milk, one tablespoon of tapioca starch slurry (to thicken the coconut milk), and 100g sugar. Stir until the sugar is completely dissolved and the mixture thickens.
4. Make chocolate sauce for dipping
Melt chocolate on the stove until it is completely smooth and thick.
5. Steam the banana cake

Place the steamer on the stove, pour in 1 liter of water, and bring to a boil. Prepare the cake mold and grease it with a layer of oil (to prevent sticking). Pour the banana batter into the mold and place it in the steamer. Cover and steam for about 30 minutes.
6. Finished product

The steamed banana cake will be soft and chewy, fragrant with a beautiful green color from the pandan leaves. You can dip the cake in bittersweet chocolate sauce or rich coconut milk. This is a simple and attractive dessert you should try making for your family.
Tips for delicious steamed banana cake with coconut milk
1. Steaming tips
Do not make the cake too thick so it cooks quickly and the pieces are a good size for eating.
Regularly wipe away condensation on the steamer lid.
You can eat the cake while hot or keep it in the refrigerator to eat later.
2. How to choose ripe bananas
To make steamed banana cake, you should use Siamese bananas (chuối sứ). They have a chewy, soft texture, a beautiful yellow color, and are less fibrous when ripe.
Choose naturally ripe bananas. They should be medium-sized with dark yellow skins and black spots. The stems should be firm and still slightly green.
Squeeze gently to feel the softness of the fruit; it should also have a characteristic aroma.
Avoid buying bruised bananas with perfectly smooth, shiny yellow skins, as they may have been treated with chemicals.

mon_an.ten: Discover 3 Ways to Make Baked Banana Cake in an Air Fryer
mon_an.mo_ta: Banana cake, with its delicious flavor and simple preparation, is an essential item on any favorite sweets list. But have you ever tried making baked banana cake in an air fryer to enjoy with friends and family? With these simple and quick steps, you will confidently show off your baking skills and enjoy a tasty dessert with your family. ## I. Traditional Air Fryer Baked Banana Cake ### 1. Prepare ingredients
cac_buoc: Step 1: Start by peeling the bananas and placing them in a large bowl, then mash them until smooth.

Step 2: Add 4 tablespoons of all-purpose flour to the bowl and mix well with the bananas. Next, add the eggs and condensed milk, then use a whisk to beat the mixture until it is creamy yellow with fine bubbles. Add a little baking powder and continue to whisk. Then, cover with plastic wrap and let the batter rest for 2 hours.
Step 3: Line the baking mold with parchment paper and brush a thin layer of oil on the surface. Pour the banana mixture into the tray. Sprinkle almonds on top for decoration and aesthetic appeal.
Step 4: Turn on the air fryer and preheat for about 5 minutes at 180°C.
Step 5: Pull out the tray and place the banana cake mold into the air fryer. Set the temperature to 160°C and bake for 25-30 minutes.
Step 6: Check the cake's doneness by inserting a toothpick into the surface.
Step 7: Turn off the power and use oven mitts to remove the tray. Let the cake cool slightly, then slice and present on a plate to enjoy.
II. Whole Wheat Air Fryer Baked Banana Cake
1. Ingredients
160g bananas (about 4 bananas)
100g whole wheat flour
2 tsp cocoa powder
1/2 tsp baking powder
2 eggs
20ml honey
40ml fresh milk
2. Execution steps
Step 1: Prepare the bananas
Start by peeling the bananas, then chop them and use a fork to mash them.
Step 2: Mix flour with bananas
In a bowl, combine the mashed bananas with 2 eggs, 40ml fresh milk, 20ml honey, 100g whole wheat flour, 2 tsp cocoa powder, and 1/2 tsp baking powder.
Once all ingredients are in the bowl, mix well until perfectly combined.
Step 3: Bake the banana cake
Place the air fryer on the counter and preheat at 160°C for about 5 minutes.
While waiting, line the mold with parchment paper and pour the batter in, filling it to about 2/3 of the mold's height.
Then, place the mold in the air fryer and bake for 30–35 minutes at 160°C.
Once finished, you can enjoy the fragrant and soft banana cake.

The whole wheat air fryer banana cake emits an irresistible aroma right after baking. The cake has a spongy, soft texture combined with the nutty and rich sweetness of bananas. This cake is a perfect choice for those on a diet.
III. All-Purpose Flour Air Fryer Baked Banana Cake
2 bananas
4 tbsp all-purpose flour
1 egg
1 tbsp condensed milk
A little cooking oil
A little topping (dried nuts or dried fruit as preferred)
2. Cooking method
2.1. Mix the banana batter
Step 1: Prepare bananas – Peel and chop the bananas, then place them in a bowl.
Step 2: Mash bananas – Use a fork or masher to mash the bananas in the bowl.
Step 3: Add flour – Next, add 4 tbsp of all-purpose flour to the bowl and mix until combined.
Step 4: Mix other ingredients – Crack the egg into the bowl and stir until well blended. Add 1 tbsp of condensed milk and use chopsticks or a whisk to stir until the mixture is smooth and lump-free.
Step 5: Add toppings – Finally, you can add a few toppings like raisins, dried fruit, or nuts to the batter.
2.2. Bake the cake
Apply a little oil to the cake mold and ensure it is spread evenly.
Take the prepared banana batter and pour it into the greased mold. Level the surface to fit the mold.
Next, preheat the air fryer at 180°C for about 5 minutes.
Then, place the mold into the air fryer and bake at 160°C for 25 to 30 minutes.
To check if the cake is done, use a toothpick to poke the cake. If the toothpick comes out clean, the cake is ready to be enjoyed.
After completing these steps, you will have a delicious, fully cooked banana cake.
2.3. Finished product

The air fryer baked banana cake is golden brown and emits a characteristic banana aroma. The cake has a chewy, soft texture and moderate sweetness. The light, slightly tart toppings add an interesting flavor.
IV. Tips for delicious air fryer baked banana cake
Choosing bananas: Use bananas with yellow skins and even ripeness to ensure the cake has great texture.
Choosing flour: Using Flour No. 8 (cake flour) is ideal for making banana cake.
Using Baking Powder: Adding baking powder helps the cake cook evenly, provides a fluffy structure, and enhances the flavor.
Adjusting temperature: Set the appropriate temperature so the cake cooks from the inside out, avoiding cracking or uneven sponginess. This helps the cake have a uniform structure.
Using the air fryer: Choose an air fryer with stable heat distribution to ensure the cake cooks without burning.
V. How to buy fresh bananas
Color and spots: Choose bananas that are not uniformly colored, with some black or dark pink spots. This usually indicates natural ripening without chemicals.
Stem and body color: Naturally ripened bananas will have yellow stems and bodies. If the stem is still green while the fruit is yellow, it may have been chemically treated.
Aroma and sweetness: Naturally ripe bananas have a natural fragrance and sweetness. Check the smell and taste to ensure they meet these criteria.
Avoid damaged fruit: Avoid buying bruised or damaged bananas.
Size and naturalness: Limit buying oversized bananas, as they may have been treated with growth stimulants.
VI. How to store banana cake
Cut into portions: If the cake is not finished, cut it into small portions for easy storage.
Airtight packaging: Place the slices in food containers or zip bags and seal tightly to prevent air contact and maintain moisture.
Store in the freezer: Place the packaged cake in the freezer to extend its shelf life. Freezing helps maintain freshness and quality longer.
When you want to eat the cake:
Thaw: Take the cake from the freezer and let it thaw naturally in the refrigerator compartment.
Reheat: To make the cake warm and delicious again, use a microwave. Place the portion in the microwave and heat for 5 to 7 minutes. This will make the cake warm and soft without being dry or hard.
By applying these methods, you can effectively store and reuse leftover baked banana cake while ensuring it remains delicious.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Delicious and Nutritious Baked Banana Cake
mon_an.mo_ta: Bananas are a highly nutritious fruit that is very good for health, yet not everyone enjoys eating them. To change this habit, it is recommended that you learn how to make baked banana cake—a very fragrant and easy-to-eat treat. With this delicious and simple recipe, you will be surprised by the flavor of the bananas you usually dislike.
cac_buoc: Prepare ingredients
Peel the bananas and cut them into rounds 0.5 cm thick.
Let the butter sit at room temperature until melted.
Mix the sliced bananas with granulated sugar.
Preheat the oven to 375°F. Spray a thin layer of oil into a 22.4cm round mold lined with parchment paper; set the mold aside.
Steps to make baked banana cake
Mix the eggs, condensed milk, coconut milk, cinnamon, vanilla, and butter in a large bowl until a homogeneous mixture is obtained.
Slowly pour in the flour, whisking constantly so the flour dissolves evenly without lumps.
Next, add the prepared bananas into the batter.
Spread the batter evenly into the baking mold and bake until the cake is done (about 40 minutes).
While waiting for the cake to bake, place a non-stick pan on the stove, melt some butter, add a tablespoon of sugar, and whisk until the sugar dissolves, then turn off the heat.
Pour in the fresh cream, vanilla, rum, and a pinch of salt, whisking until the mixture is very smooth.
Once the cake is baked, cut it into 6 pieces, drizzle with the caramel sauce, and enjoy.
Notes for making baked banana cake:
The bananas used should be just ripe, still slightly firm to the touch, with a bit of green on the ridges. If you choose overripe bananas, the cake will taste sour after baking.
Since sliced ripe bananas brown easily, you should only prepare them while waiting for the cake to finish or just before mixing.
To check if the cake is done, use a small toothpick; after about 40 minutes of baking, insert it into the cake. If it comes out dry, the cake is done.

mon_an.mo_ta: These crispy and fragrant banana cheese rolls are an incredibly attractive treat for children. The process is not difficult at all; you only need to set aside a little time to make a favorite snack for the whole family to enjoy together. Here is how to make banana cheese rolls in just 10 minutes—the more you eat, the more you'll crave them. Let's find out how.
cac_buoc: After preparing all the ingredients:
Step 1:
First, peel the bananas and slice them into thin rounds.
Step 2:
Use a knife or scissors to cut off the crusts of the sandwich bread, then use a rolling pin to flatten them.
Step 3:
Place a slice of cheese on the bread, then add the banana slices on top. Gently roll it up and use a toothpick to secure both ends of the roll. Remember to remove the toothpick before eating.
Step 4:
Crack the eggs into a bowl and beat them well. Dip the banana rolls into the egg so the coating is evenly applied to the outer layer.
Step 5:
Place a pan on the stove, add cooking oil, and heat it up. Drop the banana rolls in to fry, turning them regularly until they are golden brown and cooked through.
And that's it—the banana cheese snack is finished. It's very simple, isn't it?
Give it a try. Good luck!

mon_an.ten: 4 Simple and Delicious Banana Oatmeal Cake Recipes
cac_buoc: Banana oatmeal cake is one of the easiest sweets to make, with a simple formula and easy-to-find ingredients. It is suitable for both sweet lovers and those following a "healthy" diet. Instead of using regular white flour, the cake is made from fiber-rich oats, bringing out the natural sweetness of the bananas. You can enjoy this cake at any time, from breakfast to a snack. Discover how to make banana oatmeal cake through this article!
I. Banana Oatmeal Cake with Yogurt
1. Ingredients
3 bananas
300g oatmeal
2 eggs
100g unsweetened yogurt
60ml olive oil
60ml honey
15ml vanilla extract
½ tbsp chia seeds
20g almonds
3.5g baking powder
5g cinnamon powder
2g salt
A little cooking oil.
2. Cooking Steps
Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Peel 3 bananas and place them in a large bowl. Mash the bananas until they form a smooth mixture.
Prepare another large bowl and crack 2 eggs into it. Add 60ml olive oil, 60ml honey, 15ml vanilla extract, and whisk until the mixture is uniform.
Step 2: Mix the batter
In the bowl with the eggs, add 300g oatmeal, 5g cinnamon powder, and 3.5g baking powder. Then, pour the mashed bananas into the bowl.
Next, add ½ tbsp chia seeds and 100g unsweetened yogurt to the bowl and mix well until all ingredients are combined.
If you want to balance the sweetness, you can add 2g salt to the mixture. If the batter is too thin, you can add a little more oatmeal.
Continue mixing until the batter is well combined and there are no lumps.
Step 3: Pour the batter into the mold
Prepare the cake mold or line it with parchment paper by brushing a layer of oil on the surface to prevent sticking.
Pour the banana oatmeal mixture into the mold and use a chopstick or spatula to tap the surface gently to even out the batter and remove air bubbles.
Sprinkle some almonds on top of the batter.
Place the mold in an oven preheated to 170°C and bake for 25 to 30 minutes.
Step 4: Completion

Once the cake is cooked, remove the mold from the oven. Cut the cake into slices or bite-sized pieces and enjoy. The banana cake will have a fragrant aroma, a soft, warm texture, and a moderate sweetness that everyone will love. You can serve this for breakfast or an afternoon snack, depending on your preference.
II. Banana Oatmeal Cake with Cocoa and Cheese
Bananas: 160g
Egg: 1
Oatmeal: 50g
Cocoa powder: 10g
Baking powder: 1/2 tsp
Fresh milk: 20ml
Sugar: 20g
Laughing Cow cheese wedge: 1 wedge
Step 1: Mash the bananas
Peel the bananas (160g) and place them in a bowl. Use a whisk to mash them thoroughly.
Crack 1 egg into the bowl with the mashed bananas, then use the whisk to beat well until the ingredients are combined.
Step 2: Mix the batter
Next, gradually add 50g oatmeal, 1/2 tsp baking powder, 10g cocoa powder, 20g sugar, and 20ml fresh milk to the bowl. Use a whisk to mix the ingredients, creating a beautiful brown batter.
You can use an electric mixer to mix the batter more evenly and quickly. If you don't have baking powder on hand, you can substitute it with baking soda.
Step 3: Shape the cake
After mixing the batter, pour the mixture into a round cake mold.
Cut the cheese wedge into small pieces, then place them between the layers of batter in the mold.
Step 4: Bake the cake
Place the prepared mold into the air fryer. Bake the cake at 160°C for 25 minutes.
Depending on your preference, you can replace the Laughing Cow cheese with other types like cheddar or mozzarella.
Avoid placing the cheese directly on the surface of the cake to prevent it from burning during baking.
Before baking, preheat the air fryer at 160°C for 15 minutes to ensure a stable temperature.
Final Step: Finished product
The cocoa banana oatmeal cake, once baked, will have a glossy brown color and a naturally soft texture, creating an appealing look.
This dish harmoniously combines the sweetness of milky oats, the richness of cheese, and a slight bitterness from the cocoa. Enjoying the cake with a cup of hot tea is wonderful!
III. Instructions for Baked Banana Oatmeal Cake
4 bananas
2 eggs
1 tsp vanilla
1/2 tsp olive oil
1 tbsp honey
100g instant oats
100ml fresh milk
1 tsp cinnamon powder
1 tsp cocoa powder
1/2 tsp baking powder
2. Cooking Steps
Step 1: Prepare the bananas and batter: Take three bananas, peel them, and cut them into bite-sized pieces.
Step 2: Mix the ingredients: In a bowl, add 1/2 tsp vanilla, 1 tsp cinnamon powder, and 1/2 tsp olive oil. Mix well. Next, add 3 heaping tbsp of oatmeal to the bowl and stir well.
Step 3: Add remaining ingredients: Add 1 tsp baking powder and 1 tbsp honey for sweetness. Then, add the cocoa powder and stir all ingredients together.
Step 4: Pour batter and arrange bananas: Pour the batter into a baking mold. Slice the remaining banana into rounds. Ensure the bananas are fully submerged in the batter.
Step 5: Bake the cake: Before baking, preheat the oven to 180°C. Place the mold in the oven and bake for about 20 minutes or until the cake is evenly golden brown.
Step 6: Completion: In just 20 minutes, you will have a wonderful baked banana oatmeal cake. This cake perfectly balances oats and bananas, offering a soft texture and natural creamy sweetness.
IV. Air Fryer Banana Oatmeal Cake
Ingredients:
Ripe bananas: 4.
Eggs: 2.
Rolled oats: 250 grams (or oatmeal as a substitute).
Unsweetened fresh milk: 150 ml.
Other ingredients: baking powder, vanilla, cinnamon powder, honey, and unsalted butter.
Tools:
Cake mold.
Fork.
Large bowl.
2. Cooking Steps
Step 1: Prepare the bananas
Peel the ripe bananas and cut them in half. Use a fork to mash three of the bananas, but be careful not to mash them too finely so you can still feel the banana pieces when eating.
Use a knife to slice the remaining banana lengthwise into thin strips. These will be used to decorate the top of the cake later.
Step 2: Mix the ingredients
Add the mashed bananas to a large bowl.
Add the prepared rolled oats to the bowl, then add two eggs and the unsweetened fresh milk. Stir well until the mixture is uniform.
Next, add 3 grams of baking powder and optionally add a vial of vanilla or a bit of cinnamon powder to taste to give the cake a fragrant aroma.

Since ripe bananas already provide natural sweetness and aroma, you don't need to add sugar. However, if you want it sweeter, you can add 1-2 tsp of honey. For extra flavor variety, many people add chocolate chips or raisins. Depending on your family's preference, you can consider adding these.
After finishing the batter, let it rest for about 30 minutes before baking.
Step 3: Bake the cake in the air fryer
Prepare the mold: First, brush a thin layer of unsalted butter all over the inside of the mold to prevent sticking.
Pour the mixture: Pour the mixed banana oatmeal batter into the mold, ensuring it fills about 2/3 of the mold.
Decorate: Arrange the thin banana slices on top, and if desired, sprinkle some chocolate chips to make it look better.
Bake: Place the mold in the air fryer and bake at 160°C for 20 minutes.

Check for doneness: After baking, open the fryer and check if the cake is done by inserting a skewer. Rolled oats and eggs cook quickly, so if the skewer comes out clean, the cake is done. If it's not quite ready, bake for another 5-7 minutes.
V. Notes for making Banana Oatmeal Cake
To ensure success, it is very important to measure the oatmeal ratio correctly according to the recipe. Too much or too little oatmeal can lead to failure.

If using baking powder or baking soda, it's best to mix them with a little water in a separate cup before adding them to the batter. This helps the cake rise evenly and prevents it from being misshapen. If possible, substitute regular yogurt with Greek yogurt for a more delicious result.

For air fryers with a capacity under 5 liters, you should bake at 150-160°C for the first 15 minutes, then gradually increase the temperature. After 15 minutes, check once and increase the heat if the surface hasn't reached the desired golden color.

mon_an.mo_ta: These lovely heart-shaped cookies are easy to make but serve as a very meaningful gift for your loved ones on Valentine's Day. Below are the detailed instructions for this recipe.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Heart-shaped cookie cutter, serrated pastry cutter - tools
cac_buoc: Step 1: Mix the flour with the powdered sugar thoroughly so the powder is smooth and free of lumps.
Step 2: Use a whisk to cream the butter, then slowly pour the beaten egg into the bowl.
Step 3: Once the butter and egg are well combined, add the sugar and flour mixture and knead until you have a smooth dough.
Step 4: Divide the dough into 2 parts; mix one part with cocoa powder and leave the other part plain.

Step 5: Use a rolling pin to flatten both pieces of dough. Use the heart-shaped cutter to create heart shapes, and use the serrated cutter to cut squares. Cut the squares larger so the heart can fit inside. You can poke a hole to thread a ribbon through for a prettier look.
Step 6: Bake the cookies at 180°C for about 7 minutes until done. You can use chocolate to write messages on the cookies.

mon_an.ten: Kuih Dadar (Pandan Crepes with Coconut Filling)
mon_an.mo_ta: Kuih Dadar is a famous sweet treat in Southeast Asia, especially in countries like Malaysia, Singapore, and Indonesia. There are many variations of Kuih Dadar, and today I will guide you through making the Pandan version. The shell has a gentle, cool green color and a fresh aroma, while the filling is sweet with palm sugar and rich with coconut, so it isn't cloyingly sweet. Kuih Dadar is soft and spongy, much like European crepes, which is why it's often called the Southeast Asian crepe. Do you want to try this wonderful flavor and explore our Southeast Asian cuisine? If so, follow the recipe below.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Wash the pandan leaves; set aside 1-2 leaves, and chop the rest, leaving them in a basket to drain.
Open the coconut milk.
Crack the eggs into a bowl.
Finely grate the palm sugar.
Step 2: Execution
Place the chopped pandan leaves in a blender with a small cup of filtered water and blend until smooth.
Pour the pandan juice into a bowl through a mesh strainer. Squeeze the pulp to extract all the juice.
Next, put the flour in a large bowl, add the baking soda + eggs + pandan juice + coconut milk. Use a whisk to mix the batter thoroughly until it is smooth and fine.
To make the green color deeper, you can add 1-2 drops of food coloring to the batter.
Next, place a pot on the stove with about 70ml of water and add the reserved pandan leaves (tied into a bundle). Add the palm sugar and stir constantly until the sugar is completely dissolved.
Then, add half of the shredded coconut and simmer together.
After boiling for 1-2 minutes, strain the sugar syrup into a bowl.

Pour the syrup back into the pot and add the remaining shredded coconut. Stir constantly so the coconut and sugar don't stick to the pot. When the mixture becomes thick and the water has mostly evaporated, turn off the heat and transfer the coconut to a bowl.
Next, prepare a large, heavy-bottomed pan. Heat the pan on the stove and grease the surface with a thin layer of butter. This prevents sticking and adds a nice aroma.
When the pan is hot, ladle a spoonful of batter into the center and use the spoon to spread it out thinly.
Once the crepe is cooked, move it to a plate to cool. Continue until all the batter is used.
Finally, lay a crepe on a plate, place a spoonful of coconut filling near the edge, and roll it up like a spring roll. You can roll it into a long shape or a square.
Arrange on a plate and enjoy.
Notes:
For this dish, palm sugar is almost mandatory, but if you cannot find it, you can use brown sugar or molasses.
Pandan leaves should be very fresh, not bruised, and deep green throughout.
When making Kuih Dadar, ensure you use low heat for all steps.
Good luck and enjoy your Pandan Kuih Dadar!

mon_an.mo_ta: French crepes are a simple dish that doesn't require elaborate preparation. With a little skill, anyone can make delicious crepes. Let's learn how to make the perfect crepes for breakfast with this recipe.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Mix the batter

Place all ingredients in a bowl and mix well until you get a uniform, slightly thin batter (only slightly thicker than steamed rice roll batter). Place the batter in the refrigerator for about 30 minutes to rest.
Step 2: Fry the crepes
Remove the batter from the fridge and whisk it well.
Turn on the stove to medium-low heat. Brush a little butter on the pan to prevent sticking, and pour any excess butter into a bowl.
Lift the pan off the heat, ladle some batter into the pan, and tilt the pan as you pour...
Swirl the batter to create a thin layer over the surface.
You can use the sides of the pan to increase the size of the crepe by tilting it so the batter flows up the sides like this.
Place the pan back on the heat and cook for about 1 minute until the surface begins to set...
Then flip the crepe and fry for another minute until cooked and slightly golden.
Transfer to a plate and repeat the process until the batter is gone.
Step 3: Presentation

You can enjoy crepes with any favorite ingredients, from fruit, jam, whipped cream, and chocolate to ham or cold cuts... Simply fold the crepe, decorate as desired, or add fillings like ham and asparagus and roll it up. It's very easy.
Here are some decoration suggestions for your crepes. They look delicious, don't they? Feel free to get creative with your own style.
Notes for great crepes:

Ensure the batter is very smooth and free of lumps. If there are lumps you can't whisk out, strain the batter through a sieve. Let the batter rest in the fridge for 30 minutes so the liquid fully hydrates the flour. After taking it out, stir it again with a spoon or chopsticks.

When frying, don't use too much oil; just enough to coat the pan. Don't cook on high heat, as the batter burns easily and a hot pan makes it hard to spread the crepe thinly. This is why I use medium/low heat and lift the pan off the stove before pouring the batter to reduce the pan's temperature.
Use a flat-bottomed pan for easier spreading. If the crepe is uneven or has holes, you can use a spoon to add a tiny bit of batter to fill them for a perfect crepe.
Depending on whether you are eating savory crepes (ham, cold cuts...) or sweet crepes (jam, fruit...), you can adjust the sugar and salt in the batter.

mon_an.mo_ta: Crostata is a famous Italian pastry, characterized by its diamond-patterned lattice crust. Today, to give you a new recipe from beautiful Italy, we will guide you on how to make this wonderful Strawberry Crostata!
cac_buoc: Step 1: First, take a large bowl and add the butter, refined sugar, pastry flour, and egg.

Step 2: Use an electric mixer to beat the mixture until it is soft, smooth, and lump-free. Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and place it in the refrigerator to firm up for 30 minutes. Meanwhile, wash the strawberries. Take 250g of strawberries, remove the stems, and slice them thinly; set aside in a bowl for decoration.
Step 3: With the remaining 500g of strawberries, dice them and add water to cook in a double boiler.
Step 4: Stir well for 5 minutes until the sugar melts. Then, add the finely grated lemon zest and continue cooking in the double boiler for another 20 minutes.

Step 5: Remove the strawberries and strain the juice through a mesh sieve, pressing as hard as possible with a spoon so the strawberries are smooth like jam. Then, return to the double boiler with the butter.
Step 6: Add the eggs and stir until the mixture is very smooth. In another bowl, mix the cornstarch and water together. Pour this into the simmering strawberry mixture.
Step 7: Continue cooking and stirring for 5 minutes, then pour into a bowl to cool. Take the dough out of the fridge, knead it once, and roll it out to a thickness of about 0.5 cm.
Step 8: Use a 22 cm tart mold, place the dough inside, press gently around the edges, and trim the excess.

Step 9: Prick the bottom of the crust with a fork, line it with parchment paper, and fill it with pie weights, beans, or beads (this helps the crust keep its shape during baking). Bake in the oven at 185°C for 20 minutes (if using a convection oven, 165°C for 10 minutes). Remove the crust, take out the paper and weights, and bake for another 10 minutes.
Step 10: Finally, pour the strawberry mixture into the crust, arrange the sliced strawberries in layers as shown in the picture, and place 2-3 whole strawberries in the center.
Step 11: Melt the white chocolate in a double boiler, put it in a plastic bag, and pipe decorations on top to finish.
Note: How to choose good strawberries
Do not choose strawberries that are still green or have white patches. Strawberries do not continue to ripen after being picked, so these will be sourer and have fewer vitamins.
Choose plump, red strawberries that are not bruised.
Choose those that still have the stem and green calyx attached; these are fresher than those without stems.
If buying strawberries in plastic containers, ensure the boxes are dry and clean.

Strawberries can be stored in the refrigerator for 3 days. Place them in a plastic bag or on paper towels while waiting to use them. Never leave strawberries at room temperature or in direct sunlight for too long, as they will become mushy and spoil.

mon_an.mo_ta: Cupcakes are not only loved abroad but have remained incredibly popular since being introduced to Vietnam. Besides buying them at bakeries, many mothers now skillfully make them at home. However, many want to try but are hesitant because they don't have an oven. Therefore, today I will help you solve this problem with lemon cupcakes. These cupcakes are simple but have a very alluring flavor with a fresh lemon scent. Best of all, this recipe doesn't require an oven and is very easy to follow.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 6-8 small ceramic ramekins, electric mixer, pastry brush, stainless steel sieve, spatula, steamer - tools
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Wash the lemon and finely grate 1/2 of the zest.
Squeeze the remaining part for juice, making sure to remove all seeds.
Crack the eggs into a bowl.
Sift the flour into a bowl until fine.
Step 2: Execution steps
First, combine the lemon juice, grated zest, and cooking oil in a bowl and stir well.
Next, add the white sugar to the bowl of eggs and use an electric mixer to beat well until the eggs turn pale and foamy.
Then, use the sieve to gradually sift the flour into the egg and sugar mixture.
Once the flour is in, add the baking powder. Use the mixer to combine, then use a spatula to fold the batter one last time until it is smooth, soft, and uniform.
Next, lightly dip a brush in oil and coat the inside of the ceramic ramekins with a thin layer. Pour the batter into each cup and let it rest for a few minutes.
While the batter rests, add water to the steamer and place it on the stove.
When the water boils, lower the heat, place the cups in the steamer, and close the lid tightly.
Adjust the heat to medium.

Steam the cakes for about 15 minutes, then use a long toothpick to test them. If the toothpick comes out clean, you can turn off the heat and remove the cakes. If batter sticks to the toothpick, steam for a few more minutes.
Once cooked, let them cool slightly before removing them from the cups. Decorate with a few mint leaves for a nice look.
Notes
The cakes will rise as they cook, so do not fill the cups too full.
Steaming time must be flexible as it depends on the size of the cups you use.
If you want a richer aroma, you can add a little butter to the batter. However, do not use strong flavorings like vanilla, as they may overpower the lemon scent.
The fluffiness and quality of the cake depend heavily on how you beat the eggs and mix the batter. Therefore, perform these steps carefully to ensure the batter is smooth and soft.
Sifting the flour directly into the egg mixture also helps with easier mixing and prevents lumps.

mon_an.mo_ta: Let's learn how to make a baked coconut pie. This rich, fragrant coconut pie will be the perfect dessert for your family meal.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Add sugar, melted butter, eggs, vanilla, and white vinegar to a bowl.
Add a pinch of salt and the shredded coconut.
Use a spoon to mix the ingredients thoroughly.
Step 2: Place the pie crust into a mold, then pour the egg and coconut mixture into the crust.
Step 3: Place the pie in the oven at 180°C until the surface turns golden brown (this will take about 1 hour). Remove the pie and let it cool.

This is the finished baked coconut pie. The surface has a beautiful golden brown color. The top is crispy due to the dried coconut but not burnt, and it is very fragrant. The coconut pairs perfectly with the crispy, aromatic crust and the soft egg custard layer in the middle, making for a fragrant, soft, and rich bite. This coconut pie is a perfect dessert for dinner, family gatherings, or birthday parties.
When serving, cut the pie into small bite-sized pieces. You can refrigerate the pie to serve it cold if you prefer.
You can also refer to the Chocolate Pie recipe and other cakes to make delicious treats for the whole family.

mon_an.mo_ta: An exquisite pastry born in 19th-century France, featuring a smooth, rich custard filling and a sweet, seductive charm. Let's learn how to make these Éclairs with us!
cac_buoc: Step 1:

First, we will make the craquelin topping! Cut the butter into small pieces and place them in a bowl with the flour, sugar, and vanilla extract. Use a mixer to combine the ingredients until they are well incorporated.
Next, use your hands to knead the mixture into a smooth dough. Knead repeatedly until very smooth, then place the dough in the refrigerator for 1 hour.
Step 2:
Prepare a small pot and melt the butter, milk, and water together. Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 180°C.
When the butter and milk mixture boils, add the flour and a little salt. Use a wooden spoon to stir constantly until the mixture forms a smooth, flexible dough ball as shown in the picture.
Step 3:
Place the dough in a bowl and add the eggs one by one, beating well after each addition until the mixture becomes smooth and glossy.
Next, prepare a baking tray lined with parchment paper.
Put the mixture into a piping bag with a 2.5 cm round tip and pipe into 10 cm long logs (as shown).
A small note: you should pipe the dough pieces about 6cm apart so they have room to expand during baking without sticking together.
Step 4:
Now, take the craquelin dough out of the fridge and knead it until soft. Roll it out very thin (1-2mm), then cut into 4 x 12 cm rectangles, sized to cover the éclair dough you just piped.
Next, place a piece of craquelin on top of each éclair and bake for 10 minutes.
After 10 minutes, prop the oven door open slightly (about 3mm) and bake for another 20 minutes until the shells are puffed and golden.
Step 5:
Next, we will make the pastry cream while waiting for the shells to bake.
In a bowl, whisk the egg yolks with the sugar, then add the cornstarch. Whisk until the mixture turns pale yellow and thickens.
Scrape the seeds from the vanilla bean and add them to a pot with the milk. Heat on the stove. When it starts to simmer, turn off the heat.
Step 6:
Pour all the hot vanilla milk into the egg mixture, whisking quickly and constantly.
Then, pour the mixture back into the pot and cook, continuing to stir constantly.
Step 7:
When the mixture becomes thick (as shown), let it cool for 10 minutes, then add the butter and whisk until melted.
Step 8:
Transfer the pastry cream to a bowl, cover tightly with plastic wrap (touching the surface), and let it cool.
When ready to fill the éclairs, whip the whipping cream until stiff peaks form, then fold it into the cooled pastry cream until smooth and combined.
Step 9:

Finally, use a chopstick to poke a hole in the end or bottom of the éclair to create space for the filling. Put the cream into a piping bag and pipe it into the shells. Sprinkle with powdered sugar to finish.
The name "éclair" in French means "lightning," implying that these pastries are so delicious they are eaten in a flash.
Similar to cream puffs, but Éclairs have a shell baked until slightly dry and are topped with powdered sugar or craquelin, creating a very attractive sweet and crispy sensation.

mon_an.mo_ta: Flan, also known as caramel, is a favorite snack that is delicious and suitable for all ages; you can also serve flan as a dessert after daily meals. Let's try making flan according to the recipe below.
cac_buoc: Recipe based on Candy - Candycancook.com
Step 1: Make the caramel
Put sugar in a pot and cook until it turns an amber color (like the color used for braising meat), then add the lemon juice and stir.
Quickly pour the caramel into the molds while it is still hot, swirling to coat the bottom with a thin layer.
Step 2:

Crack the eggs into a bowl. Note: with 6 eggs, you should only use about 3-4 egg whites. Using too many whites will make the flan tough rather than soft and delicious. Add sugar and whisk gently so the eggs and sugar combine without creating too many bubbles.

Put the milk in a pot and heat over medium heat until it just begins to simmer, then turn off the heat. Slowly pour the milk into the egg and sugar mixture, stirring constantly with a spoon so the eggs do not curdle.
Pour the egg and milk mixture into the molds already coated with caramel from step 1. Note: use a sieve when pouring to remove any cooked egg bits and air bubbles.

Step 3: Place the flan in a steamer. Note: during steaming, you must frequently open the lid to wipe away condensation so water doesn't drip onto the flan, which keeps the surface smooth. If using jars with lids, you can close them to prevent dripping. Alternatively, place a clean towel over the pot before closing the lid. Steam for about 20-30 minutes until cooked. Steaming time varies depending on the heat conductivity of your molds. The best way to check is to insert a toothpick; if it comes out clean, the flan is done. Turn off the heat and carefully remove the molds. Let them cool, then refrigerate.
When serving, use a sharp knife to loosen the edges and flip the flan onto a plate. This is the final product. You can add ice, coconut milk, and a little condensed milk if desired.
To make great flan, pay attention to these points:

The most important part is choosing the eggs. I often use farm eggs, which have large yolks and small whites and are more fragrant. Do not use all the egg whites, as the flan will be tough. I usually use 6 yolks and 3-4 whites for a soft, delicious caramel. However, adjust based on the egg size; if the yolks are small, you might need 7 or 8 eggs.
When whisking the eggs, only whisk gently to dissolve the sugar. Do not whisk vigorously, or the eggs will have too many air bubbles, causing the flan to be pitted after steaming.

mon_an.mo_ta: Matcha flan is creamy with milk and fragrant with matcha, offering a unique and interesting taste. Let's get into the kitchen to make this matcha flan for your whole family.
cac_buoc: Step 1:

Place a pot on the stove over low heat. Once the pot is hot, add sugar and cook until it turns golden brown, then turn off the heat. Remove the pot and pour the caramel into the bottom of the molds. Be careful not to use high heat to avoid burning the sugar and making it bitter.
Step 2:

Place another pot on the stove. Add milk and heavy cream and bring to a boil, stirring well to combine. Crack the eggs into a bowl, removing the whites to avoid a fishy smell. Use a whisk to beat well, then pour the eggs into the milk mixture and continue whisking for 2-3 minutes until the ingredients are well combined and the mixture is smooth.
Step 3:
Add matcha powder and stir well until the mixture has the characteristic green color of matcha.
Pour this mixture into the molds with the prepared caramel.
Step 4:
Preheat the oven to 160°C, then bake for about 30 minutes. Turn off the oven, let the flan cool, then store in the refrigerator.
This flan is excellent served with fruit or crushed ice.
Japanese matcha powder is the easiest to use and most fragrant. Good luck and enjoy your matcha flan!

mon_an.mo_ta: Korean rice cakes are a unique treat with a soft, fragrant dough and sweet filling, coated in an attractive crust. Learn how to make this delicious dish!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Roasted and ground black sesame - 50 gr
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the beans and soak overnight, then cook until very soft.
Then, blend the beans with brown sugar, salt, and vanilla until smooth.
Step 2: Put glutinous rice flour in a bowl, add a bit of sugar and salt.
Slowly pour boiling water into the bowl and knead until the dough is smooth and no longer sticks to your hands.
Step 3: Divide the dough into small balls weighing about 30g each.
Flatten the dough into 8mm thick pieces, place the red bean filling in the center, and fold the edges together. Roll into a ball. Repeat with the remaining dough.
Step 4: Drop the rice balls into a pot of boiling water. When they float, quickly remove them and place them in a bowl of cold water.
Then, take them out and drain.
Step 5: When the rice cakes are dry and sticky, roll them through coatings of matcha, black sesame, or desiccated coconut... and you're done!

mon_an.ten: Coconut Cream Sponge Cake for Children's Day
mon_an.mo_ta: This coconut cream sponge cake is covered in a delicious white chocolate cream and coconut. Simple yet beautiful, it's a special gift for kids.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Chocolate cream - 250ml heavy cream (unsweetened) + 70g white chocolate + 10g unsalted butter + Desiccated coconut, cherries for decoration
cac_buoc: Ingredients to prepare:
Step 1: Preheat the oven to 150°C.
Step 2: Sift the flour and baking powder together. Separate the egg yolks and whites.
Step 3: Use a mixer to beat the egg whites with a pinch of salt until foamy.
Add cream of tartar and continue beating until fine bubbles form, then slowly add 30g of sugar and beat until stiff peaks form.
Step 4: Beat the egg yolks with the remaining sugar until pale. Add oil, milk, and vanilla, and mix well.
Step 5: Sift the flour into the yolk mixture and use a spatula to mix until smooth. Fold 1/3 of the egg whites into the yolk mixture at a time, using a gentle folding motion from bottom to top.
Step 6: Pour the batter into a mold and bake for about 30 minutes until cooked through.
Step 7: Once baked, remove and let cool.
Step 8: While waiting for the cake, make the chocolate cream:
Melt the white chocolate with butter and about 70ml of heavy cream.
Whip the remaining heavy cream until soft peaks form (be careful not to overbeat so it doesn't separate when mixed with chocolate; the cream should hold its shape but still be smooth).
Let the melted chocolate cool completely, then fold it into the whipped cream using a bottom-to-top motion. Refrigerate the cream to firm it up.
Slice the cake in half, spread cream in the middle, then cover the entire cake with cream. No need to smooth it perfectly as it will be covered with coconut.
Put the remaining cream in a piping bag to decorate.

mon_an.mo_ta: Learn how to make hot Bánh Giò, a popular and steaming snack for winter days. Follow this recipe to ensure hygiene compared to street food.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Bánh giò flour - 1 pack (can be replaced with 50g rice flour and 100g tapioca starch)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Make the filling

Mix the meat with seasoning, pepper, wood ear mushrooms, and minced onion and shallots (reserve some for sautéing). Heat a bit of oil in a pan, sauté the reserved aromatics, then stir-fry the mixture for about 5 minutes and let cool.
Step 2: Make the dough.

Simmer bones for broth and let cool. Pour all dough ingredients into the broth (bones removed) and dissolve. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly until the dough is thick and opaque. Stir well to avoid lumps.
If using pre-mixed Bánh Giò flour, just dissolve it in the broth and stir over heat until thickened.
Step 3: Wrap the cakes
Roll a banana leaf into a funnel shape, then pour in a layer of dough.
Place the filling in the center and cover with another layer of dough. Carefully wrap and tie securely with bamboo strings.
Step 4: Boil the cakes
Place the cakes in a pot and boil for about 30 minutes until cooked. Remove, unwrap, sprinkle with pepper and chili sauce, and serve with pickled vegetables and Vietnamese sausage for extra flavor.
Besides serving with giò or chả quế, a famous shop on Nguyen Cong Tru street also serves it with nem chua, which is delicious. You can also try making nem chua to eat with Bánh Giò.

mon_an.mo_ta: This Bánh Giò recipe provides a great breakfast or snack for your family, boosting energy for a productive day! Check out our recipe below.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Boiled quail eggs or chicken eggs (optional)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Mix the pork with all seasonings in a bowl. Heat 1 tbsp of oil in a pan, add the meat and stir-fry over medium heat until cooked and crumbly. Turn off the heat.

Step 2: Dissolve the flours, chicken broth, seasoning powder, and oil in a pot. Place on the stove and stir over low heat. When the dough starts to thicken slightly, turn off the heat. Continue stirring until the dough is smooth and thick.

Step 3: Spread a banana leaf, place a spoonful of dough and spread it out. Add the filling and a quail egg. Cover with another spoonful of dough. Place a small piece of banana leaf on top and fold the sides to seal.
Step 4: Arrange the cakes in a steamer. Bring water to a boil and steam for 20 minutes until cooked.
Unwrap the Bánh Giò and place on a plate. Serve with pickles, lettuce, cilantro, and sweet and sour fish sauce or chili sauce. The cakes are fragrant, soft, and flavorful.

mon_an.mo_ta: Instead of traditional fillings, why not try chicken curry? We'll show you how to make this fragrant and delicious chicken curry Bánh Gối that will impress from the first bite.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
