Next, take the ground cassava and place it on a mesh cloth. Squeeze all the water out, keeping the cassava pulp to make the dough.
Mix the dough well with 2 tsp salt and 1 tbsp water. Then, let the dough rest for about 5 minutes.
2.5. Make the filling
Add 1/2 tsp salt and the fried shallots to the mashed mung beans. Use your hands to mix well until combined. Divide the mung beans into small balls weighing about 20g each.
Then, flatten the mung bean ball and wrap it around a bit of meat, forming small bite-sized round balls.
2.6. Shape and steam the cake
1. First, take a bit of cassava dough and roll it into a ball. Next, use your hand to flatten the dough ball, then place the prepared mung bean and meat filling in the center.
2. Seal the filling inside, then shape it into a thick, long cylinder about the size of a thumb. Then, wrap a banana leaf around the cake. Repeat with the remaining dough and filling.
3. Finally, place the steamer on the stove, arrange the cakes in the pot, and steam for about 20 minutes over medium heat. When the dough becomes translucent, the cake is cooked and ready to serve.
2.7. Finished product

When you peel the cake, the outside has a light green color from the banana leaf, the inside is white, and the filling is in the center. Bánh sắn from Phú Thọ has the rich aroma of cassava combined with the nutty, savory taste of the mung bean and meat filling, creating an extremely attractive flavor.

It is even more delicious when eaten while still hot. With this recipe, you will have cakes with a soft outer shell and a filling that is both sweet and nutty, making it incredibly fragrant and flavorful.
See also: How to make rich and nutty baked cassava cake
II. Instructions for making Steamed Banana Leaf Wrapped Cassava Cake
1. Prepare ingredients
Glutinous cassava flour: 1kg
Pork belly: 200g
Mung beans: 100g
Wood ear mushrooms: 5 pieces
Shallots: 2 bulbs
Banana leaves
2. Steps to perform
First, put the cassava flour into a large bowl, then slowly pour in water and stir until you get a smooth, pliable dough that doesn't stick to your hands.
Next, soak the mung beans in water for about 1 hour, then wash them clean and steam until cooked. The mung beans are then mashed very finely and divided into small round balls for the filling.

For the pork belly, first wash it and then grind it small. Soak the wood ear mushrooms until they expand, wash them, and mince finely. Mince the shallots. Then, sauté the shallots in a pan, add the meat and wood ear mushrooms to stir-fry together, and season to taste.
Wash the banana leaves, wipe them dry, and blanch them briefly in boiling water to make them soft and pliable. Then, cut the banana leaves into small pieces about 3 fingers wide.

Finally, divide the cassava dough into small balls, with a 1:1 ratio of shell to filling. Use a rolling pin to flatten the shell, then place the stir-fried meat and wood ear filling or the mung bean filling in the center, wrap it up, and roll it into a ball. Then, wrap the banana leaf around the cake. Place the cakes in a steamer and steam for 40 minutes until the cakes are fragrant and the shell becomes opaque.

This banana leaf wrapped cassava cake originates from Phú Thọ, also known as Bánh Sắn Phú Thọ. In addition to separate meat and mung bean fillings, you can also mix the two together for the filling, which will have the saltiness of the meat and the nuttiness of the mung beans along with the chewy cassava shell.
Refer now: Instructions for making three-color cassava cake
III. Notes for a successful cassava cake
When choosing cassava, select fresh, long, tapered roots with a thick body that feel heavy in the hand. These characteristics indicate the cassava will be less fibrous, soft, and sweet.

Use your fingernail to gently scrape the outer skin to check the inner layer. If the inner skin is light pink, choose it; if it is white, avoid it. Pink-skinned cassava contains fewer toxins than white-skinned cassava.
Do not leave cassava out for too long as it will make the root hard and lose its flavor.

Before processing, note that cassava contains Hydrocyanic Acid (HCN), a toxic substance. Therefore, you need to soak the cassava in water for many hours or overnight to remove all toxins, changing the water frequently during the soaking process. Additionally, parts like the head and skin of the cassava also contain many toxins, so they must be removed when cooking. It is best to prepare the cassava one day before cooking.

mon_an.mo_ta: Breakfast is a main and very important meal of the day, and a sandwich is the perfect choice for you. The method is very simple and takes little time, so don't worry. Let's get in the kitchen and try this delicious dish!
cac_buoc: Simple sandwich method
Step 1: Prepare ingredients
Wash and finely shred the cabbage.
Wash and thinly slice the cucumber diagonally.
Cut the ham into small strips.
Wash and finely mince the pickled cucumber and carrot.
Step 2: Execution steps
Crack 3 eggs into a bowl, add all the ingredients: ham, carrot, and minced pickled cucumber, then mix well.

Place a pan on the stove, add a little oil, heat it up, and fry the egg, ham, carrot, and pickled cucumber mixture. Next, place 2 slices of cheese on one side of the pan and fold the egg over the top.
Warm the sandwich bread in the oven, then place 1/2 of the fried egg on top, followed by 4 slices of cucumber, a layer of shredded cabbage, and drizzle ketchup on top.
Finally, just place the remaining sandwich slice on top. Insert a small toothpick flag in the middle of the sandwich to make it look attractive.
Note
If you cannot eat raw cabbage, you can substitute it with kale or lettuce.
Similarly, you can flexibly replace ingredients with sausage or cold cuts; they are all great.

mon_an.mo_ta: The Yule Log cake, with its delicious flavor and meaningful symbolism, makes the atmosphere of these days more bustling and attractive. Refer to this recipe to make a Christmas gift.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: All-purpose flour - 50g (can use 25g flour and 25g cornstarch)
Orange juice, water, or fresh milk - 25ml
cac_buoc: Making the Cake Body:
Preheat the oven to 160°C 5 minutes before baking.
Mix the flour, cornstarch, and baking powder together and sift until smooth. Combine the cooking oil and orange juice. Separate the egg yolks and whites.
Use a whisk to beat 1/2 of the sugar with the egg yolks until the mixture is pale yellow.

Add the milk, oil, and sifted flour and mix well. Beat the egg whites with the remaining 1/2 of the sugar until stiff peaks form. Fold 1/2 of the egg white mixture into the yolk mixture and mix gently.
Pour the combined mixture back into the remaining 1/2 of the egg whites. Mix well.
Pour into a rectangular mold lined with parchment paper. Place in the oven and bake for about 10 to 12 minutes. When the cake is done, remove from the mold and wait for it to cool.
Decorating the cake:
Melt the dark chocolate using a double boiler.
Use a hand mixer to whip the heavy cream until stiff.
Add the melted chocolate and mix well. If you like a coffee flavor, add some coffee, or simply use white cream as desired.
Creating the bark texture
After the cake has cooled, spread a thin layer of cream on the cake and roll it up.
Continue using a fork or bamboo skewer to draw long, irregular lines on the cake body to create a bark-like appearance.
Decorate with Christmas items to create a festive atmosphere.
And enjoy your Christmas Chocolate Cake with your loved ones!

mon_an.mo_ta: Swan-shaped cream puffs with their unique, whimsical shapes and irresistible delicious flavor will make you very happy just by looking at them. Moreover, the method for this delicious dish is not difficult at all. Let's get in the kitchen and make them!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare ingredients
Before making the cake, sift the flour gently through a fine mesh sieve to make it smooth and the cake more delicious.
Crack the eggs into a bowl and beat well.
Preheat the oven.
Step 2: Execution steps

Melt the butter in a pot over low heat, then pour in the salt and milk (or water) and stir until it simmers. Then turn off the heat, add the flour to the pot, and stir well until the dough is pliable, moist, and smooth throughout.
Then turn the heat back on and stir the dough continuously until you see a thin film sticking to the pot like spring rice paper; then turn off the heat and transfer the dough to a bowl.

Pour the eggs in small batches (about 4 times) into the dough bowl and stir well. You can use a whisk to beat the dough and eggs into a uniform, smooth mixture without lumps, then transfer it into a piping bag.

Next, cut a small piece off the tip of the piping bag so you can squeeze the dough into a round strip slightly smaller than a chopstick. Pipe the dough into the shape of a number 2 or the letter S on parchment paper to make the swan necks. Make 24 such shapes for 24 swan necks (using the number 2 will make the neck look more beautiful).

At the top of the number 2 or S, pipe a teardrop shape with the pointed part as the beak and the rounded part as the head. After shaping the heads and necks, place the tray in the oven at 180°C (preheated) for about 5 minutes.

Next, we will make the swan bodies. Similar to making the neck and head, for the body, you also cut the tip of the piping bag but with a larger opening. Pipe the dough into an elongated teardrop shape: first pipe a large round drop, then pull it out and taper it. Intentionally pull the sharpest part of the dough slightly upward like a swan's tail. Then increase the oven temperature to 190°C and bake for 10 minutes, then let them cool naturally on a rack.

Making the filling: Use a hand mixer to beat the heavy cream and sugar at high speed until stiff peaks form; when you lift the whisk, the cream should hold its shape and not dissolve when dropped into water. Transfer the cream into a piping bag fitted with a large 6-point star tip.

After that, cut the swan body in half to add the filling (remember not to cut all the way through, only to the middle): the top half should be slightly larger than the bottom half. Cut the top half in half again to get 2 swan wings. Pipe the cream to fill the bottom half of the body, then attach the swan neck to the center of the front, attach the two wings to the sides, and adjust the neck to be balanced between the wings. Use a toothpick to dot chocolate sauce for the eyes and pull the tip slightly to make the eyes long and elegant.
Note:
For the flour, you should choose cake flour or sponge cake flour with low gluten content so the cake will be soft.
When mixing the dough with eggs, remember to beat well so the dough is not lumpy and is smoother.
When making the filling, pay attention to mixing the eggs (cream) with sugar and beating until fully whipped so the cake is delicious and does not become watery.

mon_an.mo_ta: Cream puffs with butter cream are already delicious, but now combined with durian filling, they are even more attractive. The shell is soft and smooth, and the filling has the characteristic fragrant aroma of durian. If you love durian, these durian cream puffs are beyond reproach. Let's make this dish together.
cac_buoc: Ingredients prepared for 4 servings
Execution steps
Extract the durian flesh into a bowl.
Mix the flour, salt, and sugar in a separate bowl.
*- P*lace the butter and water in a pan and heat over low heat until the mixture melts.
Then, add the mixed dry ingredients to the melted butter solution.
Use a spatula to mix the flour and melted butter until combined as shown and let it cool slightly.
Crack 2 eggs into a bowl and beat well.
Pour the eggs into the cooled butter-flour mixture.
Use a spatula to mix until the dough and eggs are well combined.
Use a plastic bag to pipe the dough into small spiral shapes on a sheet of foil.
Preheat at 200°C for about 10 minutes.
Place the foil and cakes on a baking tray. Bake for about 20-30 minutes until golden brown.
Remove the cakes and let them cool. Then cut the cakes in half.
NOW MAKE THE FILLING
Whip the whipping cream until stiff, then add the durian flesh and beat well.
Place a desired amount of durian cream filling in the middle of the previously cut cake layers.
Dust a layer of powdered sugar on top.
Repeat for the remaining cream puff shells.
Arrange on a plate and enjoy ;D
Durian cream puffs with thin, smooth shells and a rich, fragrant durian cream layer will make you remember them forever.

mon_an.mo_ta: Let's learn how to make super delicious cream puffs according to this baking recipe.
cac_buoc: How to make the shell
Preheat the oven to 190°C to prepare for baking the shells.

Place water, butter, sugar, and salt in a pot and cook over medium heat until the butter melts. Stir while cooking to dissolve the sugar and salt. When the mixture boils, remove from the heat and immediately add the flour.

Use a wooden spoon to stir well until the mixture is pliable and smooth, then place the pot back on the stove over medium heat. Use the spoon to stir the dough until it is flexible and pulls away from the sides of the pot as shown in the picture.

Beat the eggs. As soon as you remove the dough from the stove, add 1/2 of the eggs to the dough and beat well until the mixture is thick and smooth, then continue to add the remaining eggs and beat until the mixture is smooth, uniform, and glossy as shown below.

Place the dough in a piping bag and pipe into equal-sized pieces; you can create a spiral shape for a beautiful look (A tip for equal-sized cakes is to use parchment paper to line the mold, use a small cup rim to draw equal circles, remember to leave space between the cakes, then pipe the dough according to those circular outlines).
Place the cakes in the oven and bake for about 25 minutes until the cakes expand evenly and the shells turn golden brown. Turn off the oven and remove the tray to let the cakes cool completely.
Making the filling

Place the milk in a pot and cook over medium heat until it simmers. While waiting for the milk to boil, beat the egg yolks with sugar until the yolks turn pale yellow and the mixture falls in a ribbon when the whisk is lifted. Sift the flour into the egg-sugar bowl and mix well. Then, slowly pour the hot milk into the mixture, stirring constantly until all the milk is added. Then, place the pot back on the stove over low heat. Stir constantly while cooking until the mixture thickens, then turn off the heat. Add butter, salt, and vanilla, then continue to stir for about 3-4 more minutes until the filling thickens into a cream.
Stuffing the filling into the cream puffs
When the cakes and filling are completely cool, start putting the filling into the cakes. There are many ways to stuff the filling. You can refer to the following methods:
Place the filling in a piping bag with a small round tip. Poke a small hole in the bottom of the cake and slowly pipe the cream filling inside.
Use a sharp knife to cut a horizontal line in the middle of the cake (you can shift it slightly toward the top) then use a piping bag to pipe the cream in or use a spoon to scoop the cream in.

mon_an.mo_ta: Golden milk bars with a crispy outer shell; take a bite and you will clearly feel the soft, rich, and creamy milk inside. Wonderful! But be careful when eating them hot, as the hot cream inside can easily burn your lips! You can add flavor to the crispy batter by adding matcha powder, fruit flavors, or any of your favorite flavors! Guaranteed to be a delight... Try making fried milk now!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Pour the milk into a small pot, add sugar, condensed milk, and cornstarch, then stir well.

Step 2: Place the milk pot on the stove and cook over low heat. When the milk starts to get hot, use a wooden spoon to stir continuously in one direction until it becomes a thick paste. Remember to stir constantly so the milk doesn't stick to the bottom of the pot and burn! Stir until it feels heavy, and the milk is thick and smooth, then turn off the heat.

Step 3: Pour the milk mixture into a rectangular mold and place it in the freezer for about 1 hour until firm. While waiting for the milk to freeze, prepare the crispy batter. Pour the flour into a bowl, add baking powder and mix well, then slowly pour in water and stir into a thick, smooth paste. After stirring, let the batter rest for half an hour to expand.

Step 4: Take the frozen milk tray out of the freezer, flip the tray over, place the block on a cutting board, and cut into rectangular bars about 1.8cm wide. Dip the milk bars into the crispy batter mixture.

Step 5: Heat oil in a pan with enough oil to submerge the pieces, then drop the batter-dipped milk bars in to fry. When the milk bars are evenly golden brown, remove them to a plate lined with paper towels to drain.
Step 6: Finally, arrange on a plate and eat directly or sprinkle with a little sugar for extra flavor!

mon_an.mo_ta: Cone-shaped tacos attract diners with their appealing outer color, crispy shell, and soft, fresh filling that is thoroughly seasoned. When enjoying them, you can taste the deliciousness of the cake, the sweet and sour flavor of the sauce blending with the filling and the fragrant shell. Just spend a little time in the kitchen with simple, easy-to-find ingredients, and you can create these delicious tacos to treat your family, friends, and loved ones. Refer to the method for making cone-shaped tacos below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Old El Paso refried beans - 1 can
cac_buoc: How to make Cone Tacos for 8 servings:
Step 1: First, heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the onion and ground beef to sauté.
Next, stir until the meat is browned and the onion is soft, then add the taco seasoning mix.
Continue to stir until the liquid has evaporated, then turn off the heat.

Step 2: Once the ingredients are prepared, warm the taco shells in the microwave for about 15-30 seconds and remove them; if they are not warm enough, continue for another 15-30 seconds until they feel warm to the touch.
Step 3: Next, take one taco shell and spread a layer of refried beans on the top part of the shell.
Move to the middle of the taco shell, add cooked rice, cheese, meat, tomatoes, and other favorite ingredients, then roll it into a cone shape.
You can use a little bit of refried beans to keep the edges of the taco shell from coming apart.
Step 4: Finally, enjoy the tacos with sour cream.
Notes for delicious Cone Tacos
The method for making taco shells is very simple: use all-purpose flour or cornstarch (flour will be softer and cornstarch will be crispier).

Next, knead the dough with water or fresh milk, a little salt, and cooking oil, let the dough rest for 10 minutes, then roll the dough into thin, round pieces about 1-2mm thick, wide enough to roll the taco.
Then, place them in a pan and toast both sides until golden; remember to use a spatula to press down so the shell doesn't puff up.

You should use fresh milk to enhance the flavor of the shell. Additionally, to make the shell crispy, you can lightly bake it in the oven for about 1 minute or until the shell is cooked, soft, and not hard.
You can add fillings such as: bell peppers, bacon, canned tuna, mushrooms, corn... You can also omit the rice and replace the ingredients according to your preference.
You can eat tacos with tomato sauce and lettuce.

mon_an.mo_ta: Colorful cassava silkworm cakes (bánh tằm khoai mì) are a cherished childhood memory for many. If you're craving this treat but don't know where to find it, let's learn how to make this rustic yet wonderful dish! This guide provides a detailed and easy way to make these colorful cakes at home, bringing back the sweet flavors of childhood.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Sugar, salt, cooking oil - as needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients

Peel the cassava, wash it, and slice it into thin pieces. Soak the cassava in diluted salt water for about 2 hours, then rinse and drain. After 2 hours, place the cassava in a blender and grind until smooth.
Step 2: Squeeze the cassava
Once the cassava is finely ground, place it in a mesh cloth and squeeze thoroughly to extract the juice. Continue squeezing until no liquid remains.
Wait for the cassava juice to settle. Once settled, discard the liquid and keep the starch at the bottom.
Step 3: Mix the dough
Scrape the starch from the bottom of the bowl and mix it back into the ground cassava. Add 400g of tapioca starch, 100g of sugar, and 1 tsp of salt to the bowl and mix well.
Pour the coconut milk into the cassava mixture and stir thoroughly. Divide the mixture into 4 equal portions.
Step 4: Create the colors
Today's cakes will be made in 4 colors: white, green, purple, and pink.
For green: Cut pandan leaves into small pieces, blend with a little water, and strain to get the green extract.
For pink/red: Peel the beetroot, cut into small pieces, blend with a little water, and strain to get the red extract.
For purple: Boil 50g of magenta leaves in 300ml of water for about 5 minutes to obtain 250ml of purple extract.
For white: Keep the mixture as is; do not mix it with any coloring liquid.
Step 5: Mix colors with the cassava dough

Place the 4 portions of dough into 4 separate bowls. Gradually mix the pandan extract, magenta leaf extract, and beetroot extract into each bowl. Use 4 tablespoons of coloring liquid for each bowl to achieve the desired shade.
Step 6: Steam the cakes
Prepare a steamer. Line the bottom with banana leaves (brush a layer of oil on the leaves to prevent sticking).
Steam each portion of dough. Place the 4 portions in the steamer and steam for about 20 minutes. Repeat for all portions.
Once steamed, let the cakes cool completely before cutting them into strips.
Step 7: Presentation
Place each portion of cake on a plate and cut into small strips. Repeat until all cakes are sliced.

Prepare a clean plate. Spread some shredded coconut on the plate and place the cake strips on top. Layer the cake strips with more shredded coconut so they are evenly coated. Finally, sprinkle with sesame salt and enjoy.
Step 8: Finished product

The bánh tằm khoai mì is now complete. While the process requires several steps, the result is truly worth it. Each color carries its own unique aroma, and every bite is delicious. The cakes are sweet, fragrant, creamy, and very chewy. Imagine enjoying these cakes with a cup of tea while watching a movie—it's wonderful.

This guide has shown you how to make delicious bánh tằm khoai mì. Through mixing, steaming, and processing, we've created soft, attractive cakes in 4 vibrant colors. They are not only beautiful but also carry the distinct flavors of each ingredient. Try this recipe and enjoy your homemade treats. Discover the joy of sharing these cakes with family and friends!

mon_an.mo_ta: Apple cake can be seen as both easy and difficult. It's easy because it's quick to make with few steps—just kneading, rolling the dough, adding the filling, and baking. The chance of failure is very low. However, it's difficult because each step requires care and good technique; a small mistake can affect the final result. A standard delicious apple cake needs a crispy, flaky crust that isn't hard or dry, and a filling that is perfectly sweet and sour—not too raw but not mushy, with a slightly thickened sauce. Let's learn how to make this unique Blooming Apple Cake! It's guaranteed to be delicious and as beautiful as a flower!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the apples. Melt about 125g of butter and place in a bowl. Whisk until smooth, then add sugar, vanilla sugar, salt, and lemon juice. Continue whisking until slightly thickened. Add eggs one by one, whisking for about 30 seconds after each addition.

Step 2: Mix the flour and baking powder together, then divide into two parts. Similar to the eggs, add each part and whisk gently and evenly for about 2 minutes per part. Finally, pour in the milk and mix gently until the mixture is smooth and consistent.
Step 3: Melt the remaining butter. Brush some onto the cake mold, then pour the batter into the mold and spread it evenly.

Step 4: Peel the apples, cut them vertically, and remove the seeds. Slice them thinly but do not cut all the way through, keeping the slices attached at the base like the pages of a book. This way, when baked, the slices will fan out like a blooming flower.
Step 5: Arrange the apples in the mold with the attached side facing the center, working in concentric circles. Brush the remaining butter over the apple layers and bake for 45 minutes.
Step 6: Remove the cake from the mold, let it cool, and dust the surface with powdered sugar.
Slice and enjoy your apple cake with a cup of tea!

mon_an.mo_ta: Using apple and pastry ingredients but presented in the form of a spring roll, this unique combination prevents the apple cake from being boring and stimulates both your taste buds and senses.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Spring roll wrappers (egg or mung bean type) - 12
Seasonings - cinnamon powder, butter, salt, lemon juice, cinnamon sugar
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Peel, core, and dice the apples into small cubes.
Step 2:
Place the diced apples in a large bowl and add sugar and lemon juice.
Step 3:
Add salt, cinnamon powder, and flour to the bowl.
Step 4:
Use a spoon to mix all the ingredients thoroughly.
Step 5:
Whisk the egg in a small bowl.
Lay each spring roll wrapper on a cutting board and brush the egg wash along the edges.
Step 6:
Spoon about 30g of apple filling onto the wrapper.
Fold the edges and carefully roll it up tightly.
Step 7:
Repeat the process with the remaining wrappers and filling.
Place the rolls on a baking tray lined with parchment paper.
Step 8:
Bake at 190°C for about 15-20 minutes or until the crust turns golden brown.
Brush a thin layer of melted butter over each roll and sprinkle with cinnamon sugar.
Bake for another 5 minutes to finish.
Let the rolls cool after baking and arrange them on a plate.
Serving them with milk or offering them to guests is a great idea.

mon_an.ten: Bánh Tẻ (Rice Cake with Meat Filling)
cac_buoc: Bánh tẻ, also known as bánh răng bừa in some regions, is a popular dish in Northern Vietnamese culinary culture. It uses simple ingredients but carries a distinct flavor that makes it particularly attractive. With a straightforward process, it's a perfect dish for your family. Let's explore how to make delicious bánh tẻ at home!
I. Ingredients
Ground pork: 150g
Rice flour: 200g
Wood ear mushrooms: 3 pieces
Shiitake mushrooms: 6 pieces
Seasoning powder: 1.5 tsp
Salt: 1.5 tsp
Ground pepper: 1 tsp
Shallots: 2 bulbs
Banana leaves: 2 leaves
Bamboo strings or nylon ties: 10g (about 10 strings)
Cooking oil: 2.5 tbsp
II. How to make fragrant Northern-style Bánh Tẻ
1. Preparation
Soak wood ear and shiitake mushrooms in warm water for 15 minutes, then wash and finely chop.
Peel and mince the shallots.
Wash the pork, chop it, and grind it finely.
2. Cooking the filling
Heat a pan and add cooking oil and minced shallots.
When the shallots are fragrant, add the ground pork. Once the meat is firm, add seasonings: 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp seasoning powder, and 1 tsp ground pepper.
Add the mushrooms and stir-fry for another 5-7 minutes before turning off the heat.
3. Preparing the dough

Pour rice flour into a large bowl, mix with 800ml of water, add 1/2 tbsp cooking oil, 1 tsp seasoning powder, and 1 tsp salt, then stir well. Let the batter rest for 1-2 hours to allow the flour to hydrate.
After resting, pour the batter into a pot and cook over low heat. When the batter becomes thick and smooth, stir constantly until it feels heavy in your hand, then turn off the heat.
Continue stirring for 1-2 minutes after turning off the heat to make the dough smoother.
Pro tip:
Keep the heat low and stir constantly while cooking the dough to prevent sticking.
Continue stirring after turning off the heat to prevent the bottom from burning due to residual heat.
4. Wrapping the cakes
Wash fresh banana leaves, dry them, or blanch them briefly to make them pliable. Rinse with cold water, drain, and tear into pieces about half the size of an A4 sheet.
Wipe the leaves dry, stack 2 pieces, spread a layer of dough on top, then add the stir-fried meat filling. Add another layer of dough to cover the filling evenly.
Fold the edges of the leaves, roll them up to shape the cake, and fold the two ends underneath.
Pro tip:
Wrap the cakes while the dough is still warm for better results.
Use strings to tie the cakes to ensure they don't open during cooking.
5. Steaming the cakes
Prepare a steamer with boiling water.
Place the cakes in the steamer and steam for 15-20 minutes from the time the water boils. Turn off the heat and remove the cakes.
Bánh Tẻ can be eaten hot or cold. It pairs well with chili sauce or sweet and sour fish sauce. With these instructions, you can confidently make delicious cakes for holidays or special occasions.
III. Tips for delicious Bánh Tẻ
1. Important notes
The dough-stirring step is crucial and determines the success of the dish. Stir carefully to ensure the cake is delicious and authentic.
You can use fresh banana leaves or phrynium leaves (lá dong) for wrapping.
2. Storage tips
If you have leftovers, place the cakes in a container and store them in the refrigerator. Re-steam before eating for the best flavor. They can be stored for 4-5 days.
If you're short on time, microwave the cakes at medium power for 3-5 minutes to warm them up.
IV. How to buy fresh ingredients
1. Choosing fresh pork
Buy pre-ground meat or grind it yourself: You can buy ground pork or buy whole cuts to grind at home.
Select fresh pork: Choose meat with a bright red color, shiny fat, and a slightly moist surface that isn't slimy.
Check elasticity: Press the meat; if it bounces back, it is fresh.
Avoid bad signs: Avoid meat that is pale green, dark red, has black bruises, a sticky surface, or a strange odor.
2. Choosing good wood ear mushrooms
Use dried mushrooms: Ensure there is no white mold. Avoid moldy mushrooms as they become mushy when soaked.
Choose large, thick caps: These will be chewier and crunchier. Select amber or coffee-colored mushrooms; avoid those that are too black.
V. Origin of Bánh Tẻ
Bánh Tẻ is also called bánh lá or bánh răng bừa because its shape resembles the teeth of a traditional harrow (răng bừa).
This is a traditional dish common in the Northern Delta and Thanh Hoa. Previously, it was only made for special occasions like festivals or Lunar New Year, but now it is enjoyed daily.
VI. Conclusion

In this article, we've learned how to make Northern Bánh Tẻ—a traditional, chewy, and flavorful dish. By choosing ingredients carefully, stirring the dough properly, and steaming for the right amount of time, you can create a rustic memory of this land.

mon_an.mo_ta: Fragrant and crispy Bánh Tiêu is not only a breakfast staple for many families but also a favorite snack for young people. Today, we will guide you through making this delicious treat!
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients:
Dissolve about 80-100g of sugar in warm water, then add the yeast and baking powder. Stir well and wait 10 minutes for the yeast to foam on the surface.
Mix the flour and 1 tsp of salt in a bowl. Pour in the yeast mixture and knead with clean, oiled hands until the dough is smooth, shiny, and no longer sticks to your hands (about 15-20 minutes).
Place the dough in a bowl, cover with a damp cloth, and let it proof in a draft-free place for 40-50 minutes until it doubles in size.
Sesame seeds: Clean and toast the sesame seeds until golden and fragrant.
Execution steps:
Step 1: Gently press the dough to release air bubbles, add vanilla, and knead again.
Step 2: Shape the dough into a long cylinder and cut into 20-25 equal pieces. Roll them into balls, press both sides into the sesame seeds, and let them rest for 20 minutes.
Step 3: Use a rolling pin or a glass bottle to flatten the sesame-coated dough pieces.

Step 4: Heat oil in a pan or small pot. Once the oil is very hot, lower to medium heat and drop the dough pieces in. Use chopsticks to press the edges so the center puffs up. Flip the cake and fry until golden brown on both sides. Remove and place on paper towels to drain.
Notes for making Bánh Tiêu:
When frying, use a small, deep pot with enough oil to submerge the cakes for an even color.
Fry them one by one to prevent burning.
The cakes are best served hot and crispy; they may become hard when cold.

mon_an.mo_ta: On Valentine's Day, unique Valentine's cookies can be a meaningful gift for your loved one. Learn how to make these simple cookies that don't take much time!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Whisk the egg with butter, brown sugar, and vanilla until smooth.
Step 2: Mix the flour, baking powder, cinnamon, cocoa powder, and salt together. Combine this with the egg mixture. Place in a plastic bag, press firmly, roll thin, and refrigerate for 2 hours.
Step 3: Use heart-shaped molds and letter stamps to create your desired shapes. Dust the cookies with powdered sugar to make the letters stand out.
Step 4: Bake the cookies in the oven for 5-10 minutes until done. You now have a meaningful gift for your loved ones.

mon_an.mo_ta: Tiramisu, a signature Italian dessert, has become a staple in international cuisine. Today, we will guide you on how to make a smooth, creamy, and delicious tiramisu with authentic Italian flavor right at home. Discover simple yet attractive ways to create this rich treat. Let's explore the secrets to making a truly Italian tiramisu.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the coffee
To prepare the coffee, dissolve 1 tsp of instant coffee with 20g of sugar and 200ml of hot water, then let it cool.
Step 2: Whisk the eggs
In a new bowl, combine 2 egg yolks, 60g of sugar, and 1 tsp of vanilla sugar. Place the bowl over a pot of warm water and use a hand mixer to whisk the mixture until it turns pale yellow.

The purpose of heating the eggs is to dissolve the sugar and help the eggs become fluffy quickly with a stable structure. Only heat to about 40 - 50°C; if it's too hot, the eggs will cook and won't fluff up.
Step 3: Whip the cream
In another bowl, pour 250ml of whipping cream. Use a mixer at medium speed and whip until soft peaks form—the cream should hold its shape when the whisk is lifted but the tip should slightly curl.
A tip for whipping cream quickly is to place the cream and the whisk in the freezer for 15 minutes or place the bowl in an ice bath while whipping.
Step 4: Make the tiramisu cream
Add 300g of Mascarpone cheese to the bowl of whipped cream. Use the mixer at low speed to combine.
Add the egg mixture and use a spatula to gently fold until the mixture is well-combined and smooth.
Step 5: Assemble the cake
Prepare a square or rectangular container.
Quickly dip the ladyfingers into the coffee and arrange them in the container.
Note: Avoid soaking the ladyfingers for too long to prevent them from becoming mushy.
Spread a layer of tiramisu cream over the ladyfingers. Repeat the process to create two layers, ending with a layer of cream on top.
Cover the container tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 4 - 6 hours or overnight.
Step 6: Finished product
When taking the cake out of the fridge, simply dust a layer of cocoa powder on top before serving.
Each spoonful of smooth tiramisu combines the bitterness of coffee and cocoa with the rich, sweet mascarpone cream for an irresistible flavor.
Notes for making Tiramisu
Use good ingredients: Choose fresh, high-quality ingredients for the best flavor.
Choose quality cocoa powder: Use good cocoa powder for a fragrant topping.
Use authentic Mascarpone: Mascarpone is the key ingredient; choose a reputable brand for the best results.
Whisk cream and eggs correctly: Ensure they are mixed well but not over-whisked to avoid curdling or collapsing.
Ladyfingers should absorb enough coffee: Dip them so they are flavored but not falling apart.
Even cream layers: Ensure the cream is distributed smoothly for a balanced cake.
Chilling time: Let it set in the fridge for at least 4-6 hours or overnight so the flavors meld perfectly.

mon_an.mo_ta: Small, round, white Bánh Trôi and fragrant Bánh Chay are indispensable for the Cold Food Festival (Tết Hàn Thực). Today, we will guide you through making these dishes. This recipe will surely give you a meaningful holiday!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the dough
Mix the glutinous rice flour and rice flour in a small basin.
Slowly add water and stir until the flour dissolves.
Let the mixture sit for at least 3 hours for the flour to settle.
Pour the mixture into a cheesecloth, tie it up, and hang it to drain the water.
When the dough is smooth and no longer sticks to your hands, it is ready.
Step 2: Make Bánh Trôi
Roll the dough into small balls and place a piece of slab sugar in the center.
Roll it between your palms to form a smooth sphere.
While rolling the balls, bring a pot of water to a boil. Drop the balls into the boiling water.
Cook over low heat until the cakes float and become translucent, then remove them.
Drop the cakes into cold water, then transfer them to a plate.
Sprinkle toasted sesame seeds over the Bánh Trôi.
Step 3: Make Bánh Chay
Wash the mung beans and drain.
Cook the mung beans until soft, then mash or grind them finely.
Stir-fry the mashed beans with 50g of sugar.
Once the sugar dissolves, add a little vanilla and mix well.
Roll the mung bean filling into thumb-sized balls. Roll the dough into balls twice the size of the filling.
Flatten the dough, place the filling in the center, and roll into a sphere.
Drop the cakes into boiling water. Cook until they float and turn translucent, then transfer to cold water.
Dissolve tapioca starch with 100g of sugar and water. Cook on the stove until the mixture is thickened, clear, and smooth. Turn off the heat and add grapefruit flower water for aroma.
Place the Bánh Chay in a bowl and pour the starch sauce over them.
Top with shredded coconut to finish the dish!
With these simple steps, you have completed the traditional and fragrant Bánh Trôi and Bánh Chay.

mon_an.ten: Bánh Trôi Tàu with Roasted Peanut Filling
mon_an.mo_ta: The sweet flavor and rich peanut filling combined with the soft dough will be irresistible. Today, we will explore how to make delicious Bánh Trôi Tàu with roasted peanut filling. Let's look at the recipe and get started! Prepare to enjoy this wonderful dessert with your family and friends. This guide shows you a simple recipe for sweet, fragrant cakes with rich peanut filling and smooth dough.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 1 ginger root, a little dried tangerine peel
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Toast the black sesame seeds and peanuts, then grind them finely in a mortar.
For the mung beans, soak them in water for at least 4 hours (overnight is best). Steam or boil until cooked, then blend until smooth.
Mix rice flour and glutinous rice flour together, then use a wet grinder and let it sit overnight to hydrate. Wash the ginger and slice thinly or crush it.
Step 2: Make the filling
To make the filling, mix the smooth mung beans with 5g of sugar, 1/3 bowl of shredded coconut, and a pinch of salt. Roll into small, equal-sized balls.

In a pot, heat the ground peanuts and sesame seeds with 1/3 bowl of shredded coconut, a pinch of salt, and 5g of sugar. Stir-fry over low heat for 5-7 minutes. When the mixture is slightly moist, turn off the heat and roll into small balls for the filling.
Step 3: Shape the cakes
Take the prepared dough and divide it into small portions. Flatten a piece of dough, place the filling in the center, and carefully roll it into a ball so the dough completely covers the filling.
Continue until all ingredients are used. You can shape the cakes according to your preference.
Step 4: Cook the Bánh Trôi Tàu
To cook the cakes, first boil 80g of slab sugar (or molasses), tangerine peel, ginger, and 2 tbsp of coconut milk in a pot until the syrup begins to thicken.

In another pot, bring water to a boil. Drop the cakes into the boiling water. When the cakes float to the surface and stay there for a while, they are cooked. Remove them and soak in a bowl of cold water.
Step 5: Enjoy

To serve, place the cakes in a bowl (you can mix one mung bean filling ball with two peanut filling balls for variety). Pour the ginger syrup over the cakes and sprinkle with shredded coconut and black sesame seeds. Enjoy while hot.
It's so simple to make delicious Bánh Trôi Tàu!
The dish is much better when eaten hot!
The chewy, soft crust combined with the fragrant, rich peanut filling is a perfect, irresistible combination!
Notes for delicious Bánh Trôi Tàu:
Choose quality ingredients: Ensure the quality of mung beans, rice flour, sugar, sesame, and coconut. Use fresh ingredients for the best flavor.
Soak the mung beans: To ensure they are soft and easy to grind, soak them for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Water for cooking: Ensure there is enough water for the cakes to float and cook without burning.
Boil water before adding cakes: Always wait for the water to boil before dropping the balls in. This ensures they cook evenly and stay smooth.
Maintain stable temperature: Adjust to low heat to keep the water temperature stable while cooking.
Cooking time: Once the cakes float, cook for another 2-3 minutes to ensure they are fully done. Do not overcook or they may break.

mon_an.mo_ta: Mid-Autumn Festival is approaching. Many remember the childhood joy of watching lion dances and eating mooncakes. Traditional mooncakes usually had a single type of filling with fat, lime leaves, candied melon, and melon seeds. Today, mooncakes have evolved with many delicious fillings like lotus seed, mung bean, and taro. You can easily buy them at traditional shops or hotels, but making them at home ensures hygiene and shows love for your family. Let's learn how to make Red Wine Mooncakes. This recipe offers a unique pink crust with the enticing aroma of red wine and lotus seeds.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Mashed steamed lotus seeds mixed with rose water - 480g
cac_buoc: Step 1: Mix the crust ingredients including roasted glutinous rice flour, red wine, oil, and sugar until very smooth. The crust will have a beautiful pink color from the wine.
Step 2: Divide the crust dough into 4 equal parts and roll into balls. Do the same for the lotus seed filling and the rose-flavored lotus seed filling.
Step 3: Flatten the rose-flavored lotus seed portion and wrap it around the plain lotus seed filling, sealing it tightly.
Step 4: Roll out the crust dough into a thin sheet, place the prepared filling in the center, and wrap it up.
Step 5: Place the cake into a mold to shape it, then bake in the oven until the crust is firm and fragrant.
The finished product is ready. The mooncakes will have an eye-catching pink crust from the wine, a slightly darker pink layer from the rose water, and a delicious lotus seed center.

mon_an.ten: Ash Cake (Bánh Tro) for Dragon Boat Festival
mon_an.mo_ta: This article will guide you through making Northern-style ash cake (bánh ú tro) for the Dragon Boat Festival. We hope this guide helps you create a delicious batch of ash cakes! Discover the traditional way to make these flavorful cakes for the holiday. Try these simple steps to create special, aromatic ash cakes for your family!
cac_buoc: 1. How to make Northern-style ash cake (bánh ú tro) with filling for Dragon Boat Festival
Step 1:
Rinse the glutinous rice several times until the water runs clear. Soak the rice in a bowl of cold water with a pinch of salt for 5-6 hours, then rinse again.
Step 2:
Pour the lye water into a bowl. For convenience, you can use pre-made lye water; mix one tablespoon of lye water with 1 liter of filtered water.
Step 3:
Place the rice in a clean bowl and add the lye water mixture. The water must cover the rice. Soak for 20-22 hours.
Occasionally, test the rice by taking a few grains and squeezing them between your fingers; if they break easily, the rice has absorbed enough lye water.
Step 4:
Once the rice is ready, rinse it thoroughly with cold water several times. Toss with a little salt and leave in a colander to drain.
Step 5:
Rinse the peeled mung beans and soak in warm water for 1-2 hours. Place the beans in a pot with a little water and cook until soft.
Step 6:
While the beans are still hot, add sugar and stir vigorously with a wooden spoon until smooth, or use a blender to puree them.
Transfer the mung beans to a pan and stir-fry over low heat until the surface is slightly dry. Adjust the sugar to your taste, then turn off the heat and let it cool.
Step 7:
Wash the bamboo leaves. Bring a pot of water to a boil and blanch the leaves briefly to soften them for easier wrapping. Drain well.
Step 8:
Roll the prepared mung bean paste into small round balls.
Step 9:
Stack two bamboo leaves together and fold the end into a funnel shape.
Step 10:
Spoon a portion of rice into the funnel, place 1-2 small mung bean balls in the center, and cover with more rice. Press down gently with the spoon to pack it tightly.
Step 11:
Fold the remaining leaf over to seal the cake completely and secure it with bamboo strings or small twine.
Continue until all rice and beans are used. Tie the cakes into bundles of 5-8.
Step 12:

Place the cakes in a large pot and fill with cold water until submerged by about one hand-span. Bring to a boil. If the water evaporates, top it up with boiling water; do not use cold water as it will make the rice tough.
Step 13:
Boil for 1.5 to 2 hours depending on the size of the cakes. Once cooked, remove and rinse with cold water, then hang them in a cool, airy place.
Requirements: The rice should be translucent, chewy, and nutty, complemented by the sweet mung beans. Serve with sugar or honey.
2. How to make plain ash cake (without filling)
Prepare ingredients
2kg glutinous rice
2 lye water tablets
Bamboo leaves
Prepare ingredients

First, dissolve 2 lye water tablets in 200ml of hot water and stir well. Soak the glutinous rice several times until fully saturated, then cover with water and soak for 4 hours. Add the 200ml lye water mixture and continue soaking for 20 hours.
Next, wash the bamboo leaves and steam them for 5 minutes, then let them cool. Use a clean towel to wipe both sides of the leaves dry to ensure the cakes last longer.
Make the plain ash cake

After soaking the rice for 24 hours, drain it well. Fold a bamboo leaf into a funnel, spoon in the rice, and press firmly. Fold the top to form a pyramid shape. Secure tightly with string. Repeat until all rice is used.
Finally, arrange the cakes in a pot and cover with cold water. Boil for 5 hours until the cakes are soft and chewy.
Plain ash cake has a beautiful glossy amber color. When eating, you will enjoy its sweet, chewy texture. Even without filling, this dish is delicious and light.
3. How to make molasses dipping sauce for ash cake

Place a pot on the stove and add 3 tbsp brown sugar and 3 tbsp thick coconut milk. Turn on the heat and stir until the ingredients dissolve together. Add ½ tsp salt to balance the sweetness, then stir well. Cook for another 3 minutes, then turn off the heat and pour into a bowl.
The molasses sauce will be thick with a beautiful caramel color. With its rich sweetness and creamy aroma, this sauce is the perfect accompaniment for plain ash cakes.
How to make molasses dipping sauce for ash cake
Notes for making ash cake
Soak the rice long enough: Ensure the glutinous rice is soaked sufficiently to become soft and chewy. Soaking usually takes 6 to 8 hours or overnight.
Boil the lye water: When preparing the water, wait for it to boil before adding the rice. This helps the rice absorb the flavor and color of the lye.
Wrap carefully: When folding, ensure the mouth is sealed and the cake is packed tightly. This helps the cake maintain its shape and prevents the rice from falling out during boiling.
Boil for sufficient time: Boil the cakes in bubbling water for 3-4 hours to ensure they are soft, chewy, and delicious.
Proper storage: After boiling, let the cakes cool completely before packing. You can store them in the refrigerator to keep them fresh longer.

mon_an.mo_ta: A famous street snack in Thailand that you cannot miss. Although the name sounds similar to Vietnamese bánh xèo, it is quite different. Let's see how to make these Thai-style crepes!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Filling - Shredded coconut, shredded mango, pumpkin jam, roasted sesame seeds
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Mix the rice flour, mung bean flour, and sugar together.
Step 2:
Separate the egg yolk, add a little water, and whisk well. Gradually pour the yolk into the flour mixture, stirring until it forms a thick paste.
Step 3:
Add the lime juice to the mixture and stir well until the batter is slightly thin. The lime juice helps make the crepes extra crispy.
Step 4:
Take the separated egg white and whisk it until frothy.
Step 5:
Add brown sugar and coconut milk to the egg white and mix well.
Step 6:
Heat a pan, pour in a spoonful of batter, and spread it out very thinly.
Step 7:
Add a spoonful of the coconut milk mixture on top.
Step 8:
Add shredded coconut, mango, pumpkin jam, and a sprinkle of roasted sesame seeds.
Step 9:
Use a spatula to remove the cake, fold it in half, and you're done!
It looks very attractive; sprinkle a few more sesame seeds for a perfect treat.
You can customize the fillings to create your own variations.

mon_an.mo_ta: Bánh xèo attracts diners not only with the delicious flavor of shrimp and pork, the crunch of bean sprouts and crust, but also its vibrant color. Spend some time in the kitchen making this for your family!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Cooking oil, fish sauce, chili, lettuce, mixed herbs. - ingredients
cac_buoc: Place the bánh xèo mix in a clean bowl with 1 tsp turmeric powder, then pour in 500ml water and add chopped scallions. Whisk well and let it rest for 30 minutes before frying.
Wash the shrimp and pork. Thinly slice the pork. Soak the shiitake mushrooms until soft, remove the stems, and slice into strips.
Heat a little oil in a pan, sauté the pork, then add the shrimp and mushrooms. Season with ½ tsp seasoning powder and set aside in a bowl.
Rinse the mung beans, soak for 30 minutes, then steam until cooked. Wash the bean sprouts and drain; peel and shred the carrot.
Coat the pan with 2-3 ladles of batter, swirling the pan so the batter covers the surface evenly.
Arrange a few shrimp, pork slices, mung beans, bean sprouts, and carrots on top, then cover with a lid.
Cook over high heat for 3-4 minutes. Use a spatula to fold the crepe in half, fry until the crust is as crispy as you like, then remove to a plate.
Repeat the process until all batter and filling are used.

mon_an.mo_ta: Japanese savory pancakes are no longer strange to young people. This dish attracts diners with its delicious flavor and appealing colors. Let's get in the kitchen and learn how to make this simple, time-saving dish!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients:
Wash the pork and cut into thin strips about 5cm long. Marinate with seasoning powder and pepper for 10 minutes.
Clean the seafood (peel and devein shrimp if using), then dice. Mix with 1 tsp seasoning powder and a little pepper; marinate for 10 minutes. Sauté briefly in a pan until just cooked.
Wash the cabbage, soak in diluted salt water for 10 minutes, drain, and slice thinly.
Peel and finely mince the red ginger.
Wash and thinly slice the scallions.

Mix the flour, baking powder, and tapioca starch with water until completely dissolved. (Note: Okonomiyaki flour is usually pre-seasoned. If using all-purpose flour, add a pinch of salt and a little sugar if desired). Let the batter rest for 10 minutes.
Step 2: Frying the pancake
1. Add the seafood, cabbage, red ginger, and scallions to the batter. Crack in an egg and mix well. Stir gently so the ingredients combine without overworking the batter, which can make it too tough.
2. Brush a thin layer of olive oil on a non-stick pan. Heat over high heat until hot, then pour the batter into the pan and reduce to low heat. Keep a little batter in the bowl for later.
3. Arrange the pork belly slices on top of the pancake, then pour the remaining batter over the meat. This keeps the meat tender, prevents burning, and helps it stick to the pancake.
4. Cover the pan and fry until the bottom is cooked (about 2 minutes). When the bottom turns golden brown, flip the pancake.
5. Once both sides are browned, turn the heat to low, flip again, and cook until the inside is fully done (about 3-4 more minutes).
When cooked, transfer to a plate. Drizzle with Okonomiyaki sauce and mayonnaise. Sprinkle seaweed flakes and bonito flakes on top to enhance the flavor.

To serve, cut the pancake into bite-sized pieces or pizza-style wedges. These attractive pancakes are great for breakfast or a light snack. They contain lots of vegetables and use very little oil, making them easy to digest and healthy.

mon_an.mo_ta: With a soft, sweet outer shell wrapping a crunchy Oreo center, you won't find these unique cookies in any store! Let's get in the kitchen and learn how to make them!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, vanilla, chocolate chips, Oreo cookies - as desired
cac_buoc: Step 1: Place the butter in a large bowl, melt it, then add the sugars and whisk well with a hand mixer.
Step 2: Add the egg to the bowl and continue whisking until the mixture is smooth and creamy.
Step 3: Sift the flour into the bowl, then add the baking powder, a pinch of salt, and vanilla. Mix well.
Next, fold the chocolate chips into the dough.
Step 4: Once the dough is well combined, divide it into equal small balls.
Step 5: Flatten one dough ball with your hand, place an Oreo in the center, and cover it with another flattened dough ball. Pinch the edges to seal and roll it into a smooth ball.
Repeat with the remaining dough and Oreos.
Finally, place the cookies on a tray and bake at 180°C for 15 minutes.

mon_an.ten: Irresistible Fish Balls in Curry Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: Home cooks can learn this recipe for fried fish balls in curry sauce to treat their family to a delicious meal. It's a unique combination of savory fish balls and rich curry sauce for cold days. Let's make this dish to treat your whole family! Follow this guide for an irresistible curry fish ball dish. Enjoy the tasty fish balls and flavorful sauce. Explore the detailed recipe and enjoy a meal you can't miss.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare ingredients
Steps to prep taro without itching:
Wear gloves: Simple and convenient. Just wear nylon or rubber gloves before peeling the taro.
Boil with salt: Dissolve 2 tsp salt in 1 liter of water, bring to a boil, and add the taro. After boiling, soak in cold water to reduce itchiness, then peel.
Keep taro dry before peeling: Leave a little dirt on the taro, keep your hands dry, and peel. Soak in diluted salt water for 10 minutes after peeling, avoiding direct contact.
Additionally, wash and cut the onion into wedges. Wash, smash, and cut the lemongrass into 3 sections. Mince the garlic and shallots. If you like it spicy, slice the chili.
Step 2: Boil the fish balls
Start by boiling the fish balls:
Fill a pot halfway with water and bring to a boil.
Add the fish balls and boil for about 2 minutes.
Remove the fish balls and rinse with cold water.
Step 3: Cook fish balls with curry sauce
Heat oil in a pot.
Add the minced shallots, garlic, and smashed lemongrass; sauté until fragrant.
Once fragrant, remove them from the pot.
Next, fry the taro:
Fry the taro until golden brown.
Add the sautéed aromatics and fish balls back into the pan and stir-fry.
Step 4: Season the curry
Add 1/2 tbsp turmeric powder to the pan and continue to stir-fry.
Add 150ml water and mix well.
When the water boils, add 400ml coconut milk.
Season with 1 tbsp seasoning powder, 1/2 tbsp sugar, and 1/2 tbsp chili powder. Mix well and cook until the taro is tender.
Step 5: Finish the dish
Turn off the heat and add the onion and chili slices.
The curry fish balls are now finished and ready to serve.
Serve the curry fish balls on a plate or skewer them on sticks! This dish is delicious with steamed white rice!
Notes for making irresistible curry fish balls
When making this dish, keep the following in mind:
Choose fresh ingredients: Ensure you select fresh fish balls and high-quality aromatics like garlic, lemongrass, and taro for the best flavor.
Pre-process fish balls: Before boiling, rinse the fish balls to remove any impurities. This ensures they look good and taste fresh.
Balance the spices: When cooking the sauce, adjust the turmeric, seasoning powder, sugar, and chili powder to your family's taste. Taste and adjust as needed.
Cook evenly: When frying taro and simmering the curry, ensure everything is cooked through but not mushy. Taro should be golden and hold its shape, while fish balls must be fully heated.
Add fresh aromatics: Before turning off the heat, add the onion and fresh chili for a touch of freshness and extra flavor.
Enjoy hot: This dish is best served hot. Present and serve immediately to enjoy the full flavor.
Apply these tips to create an irresistible curry fish ball dish your family will love.

mon_an.ten: Traditional Chè Lam (Sticky Rice Ginger Candy)
mon_an.mo_ta: As the New Year approaches, there's nothing better than sipping tea and enjoying rustic, sweet, and spicy chè lam with your family. Check out this simple recipe below!
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients for this rustic and delicious chè lam!
Step 1: Peel and wash the ginger, then crush and mince it very finely. Remove the skins from the roasted peanuts and crush them into halves or thirds.
Step 2: Combine sugar and water in a pot and stir to dissolve. Bring the sugar water to a boil, add the ginger, cook for another 1-2 minutes, then turn off the heat.
Step 3: Add the glutinous rice flour one tablespoon at a time, stirring until dissolved before adding more. Set aside a little flour to use for dusting.
As the mixture thickens, continue adding flour and mixing well. Transfer to a clean surface and knead. Add the roasted peanuts and knead for a few minutes until the dough is smooth and elastic.
Step 4: Use a rolling pin to flatten the dough into a large sheet and let it cool. Use a knife to cut into bite-sized pieces and roll them in the reserved flour so each piece is lightly coated.
In winter, enjoying chè lam with a cup of hot tea is truly wonderful.

mon_an.mo_ta: With these detailed instructions, you will create a beautiful and delicious heart-shaped jelly cheesecake!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, place the butter in a bowl and microwave for 30-40s until melted.
Step 2:
Use a brush to coat the bottom of the cake mold with a thin layer of butter.
Step 3:
Place the biscuits in a blender and grind into fine crumbs.
Step 4:
Pour the crumbs into a bowl and add the melted butter. Mix well until combined.
Step 5:
Press the biscuit mixture firmly into the bottom of the mold, cover, and place in the refrigerator.
Step 6:
Dissolve the gelatine powder in boiling water, stir well, and set aside to cool completely.
Step 7:
In a large bowl, beat the cream cheese and sugar until smooth. Add the vanilla extract.
Step 8:
Add the cooled gelatine to the cream cheese mixture and whisk until smooth and creamy.
Step 9:
Take the mold out of the refrigerator. Use a fork to prick the surface of the crust, then pour the cream cheese mixture on top.
Let it sit at room temperature for about 10 minutes.
Step 10:
Meanwhile, trim the strawberries into heart shapes.
Place the strawberries into the cream cheese mixture, pressing down slightly so they sink in a bit.
Step 11:
Cover the mold with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 4 hours. The cream cheese layer must be completely set, otherwise the jelly will ruin the cake!
Step 12:
Dissolve the strawberry jelly powder in boiling water and stir until fully dissolved. Add the cold water and stir again. Wait for the mixture to cool completely.
Step 13:
Gently pour the strawberry jelly over the cream cheese layer, covering the fresh strawberries. Pour carefully to avoid breaking the cream cheese surface!
Finally, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 4 hours until the jelly is completely set.
Your heart jelly cheesecake is now ready!

mon_an.mo_ta: Chocolate truffles or Nama chocolate are famous Japanese treats. Each piece is cool, aromatic, and melts in your mouth. While there are many flavors like hazelnut or cocoa, Matcha is the most popular. You can taste the sweetness of the chocolate, the richness of the cream, and the fresh aroma of green tea perfectly blended in a tiny truffle. This recipe is extremely simple. Let's try making these green tea truffles following our formula.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Unsalted butter - 15g (baking butter, not table butter)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Finely chop or grate the white chocolate and butter (this helps them melt faster in the following steps).
Step 2: Pour the whipping cream into a bowl and heat it over a double boiler until hot.
Step 3: When the cream is hot and simmering (about 80-90°C), add 1/2 of the matcha powder and stir well.

Quickly add the grated chocolate and stir until completely melted and smooth. Since the chocolate is grated, it will melt very fast. Next, add the butter and sugar, stirring until everything is dissolved into a uniform mixture.

Step 4: Line a mold with parchment paper and pour the chocolate mixture in. Place in the refrigerator for 1-2 hours. If you have professional tools, you can use a silicone mold with a bit of non-stick spray, or simply use parchment paper for easy removal.

Step 5: Sprinkle some matcha powder on a clean surface. Take the chocolate out of the fridge, lift it out of the mold using the parchment paper, and flip it onto the matcha-dusted surface. Gently peel off the paper, dust the top with more matcha, and use a knife to cut into bite-sized squares. Your Matcha Nama Chocolate is ready!
Final product:

Note: Because the main ingredient is whipping cream, these melt easily, especially in hot weather. When cutting and dusting, work quickly so the chocolate doesn't lose its shape. Store the final product in the refrigerator.

mon_an.mo_ta: These adorable monster cupcakes will add a splash of color to your Halloween party. Do you know how to make them? If not, let's learn how to create these super cute one-eyed monster cupcakes!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Candy bones, candy eyes, chocolate chips - as needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: To make these one-eyed monster cupcakes, first preheat your oven to 350°F. In a large bowl, mix the cake mix, water, oil, and eggs. Divide the batter into 24 cupcake liners. Bake for 18 minutes. Let cool.
Step 2: Frost each cupcake with a layer of white frosting.

Step 3: Use the red gel to draw a smiling mouth on the mint chocolate cookies. Then, use a bit of white frosting to attach a candy eyeball above the smile. Attach two candy bones to the mouth. Place the cookie face on top of the cupcakes. Add two chocolate chips to serve as ears, and you're done.
We've finished these super cute treats for Halloween. Have a vibrant and fun party!
Source: ST

mon_an.mo_ta: Hurry into the kitchen to make these beautiful and delicious crispy fried rose-shaped wontons!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Wonton wrappers, round or square (available at specialty pastry shops)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the shrimp and drain well, then mince finely. Place the shrimp and carrots in a bowl with the seasonings listed above and mix well.
Step 2: For the wonton wrappers, use a knife to cut 4 slits as shown in the illustration.
Step 3: Place the filling in the center, fold 2 opposite petals over the filling to create the bud. Then arrange the remaining 2 petals to form the flower.
For a multi-petaled flower, add another wrapper to create a more beautiful rose.
Step 4: Heat oil in a pan. Once the oil is slightly hot, add each wonton rose and fry over medium heat. When the wontons are golden and crispy, remove them to a plate lined with paper towels.
Arrange the crispy rose wontons on a plate with lettuce and a small bowl of ketchup.
This dish is very crispy and delicious when served hot.

mon_an.mo_ta: Don't think that you can't eat ice cream in winter! This fried ice cream dish will leave you mesmerized. Eating cold ice cream in winter is cool, but what does it taste like when fried? Seeing is believing, but tasting is everything. Let's practice making fried ice cream with us!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Dip two spoons into warm water to make scooping the ice cream easier.
Step 2: Use the spoons to scoop the ice cream into round balls and place them on a tray lined with parchment paper so they don't stick.
Place the ice cream in the freezer for about 1 hour until the balls are frozen solid; this is essential before frying.

Step 3: While waiting, prepare the coating. Place the popcorn or wafer crumbs in a bag and crush them with a rolling pin, then mix in 1 tbsp of shredded coconut. Add 1 tsp of cinnamon powder for aroma and mix everything together.
Step 4: Whisk 2 egg yolks with the fresh milk until well combined.
Step 5: Once the ice cream is frozen solid, take it out and roll it in the popcorn mixture, then dip it into the egg mixture, and roll it a second time in the popcorn.
Step 6: Finally, heat a generous amount of oil in a pan. Bring to a boil, then add the ice cream and fry. The ice cream is ready when all sides are evenly golden.
Since this is fried ice cream, remember to serve it with fruit to balance the richness.

mon_an.ten: Homemade Crispy Sweet Potato Cocoons (Khoai Lang Kén)
mon_an.mo_ta: Discover how to make sweet potato cocoons so delicious you won't be able to resist. Enjoy the rich flavor of these fragrant, soft, and smooth sweet potato bites. Learn the recipe and secrets to preparing wonderful sweet potato cocoons today!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the potatoes
Boil the sweet potatoes until tender, peel, cut into small pieces, and mash until smooth.
Mix 20g of tapioca starch, 2 tbsp of sugar, and a bit of coconut milk into the mashed potatoes for a rich aroma, then mix into a smooth dough.
Shape the potato mixture into small, thumb-sized cylinders.
Roll each potato piece through a layer of tapioca starch until evenly coated.
Step 2: Fry the potatoes
Mix frying flour with a little water to create a thick, non-watery batter.
Place a non-stick pan or small pot on the stove and heat a generous amount of oil until very hot.
Sequentially dip each potato piece into the batter so it is fully coated, then drop into the hot oil for deep-frying.
Fry until each piece turns a vibrant golden brown, then remove to a plate lined with paper towels.
Enjoy the potatoes while hot, served with chili sauce or ketchup. The golden crispy shell and the sweet, soft, fragrant interior create a unique and delicious snack.
The 'khoai lang kén' trend is quite hot; with our method, you can prepare it easily.
If you want the potatoes to stay crispy longer, fry them twice: the first time lightly, and the second time until golden and crispy.
You can store them in the freezer for long-term use; when ready to eat, thaw and deep-fry again.
Notes for making sweet potato cocoons
Choose the right sweet potatoes: Select potatoes with smooth skin, no blemishes or damage. They should be relatively uniform in size to ensure even cooking.
Boil until just tender: To check if they are cooked, pierce with a chopstick. If it goes through easily and the potato is soft, it's ready. Do not over-boil to prevent them from becoming too mushy.
Mash evenly: Mash the potatoes in a clean bowl using gloves to avoid direct contact. Mash until completely smooth and fine.

Knead the dough and shape: When mixing the flour, knead well to form a smooth mass. Take a small portion of dough and roll it into a cocoon shape. Ensure black sesame seeds (if using) are rolled evenly onto the surface.

Fry at the right temperature and time: Heat the oil on high until boiling, then lower to medium or low before adding the potatoes. Fry for about 5-7 minutes per batch, turning them to brown all sides.
Check oil temperature: Ensure the oil reaches about 170-180°C. This ensures the potatoes cook evenly and have a crispy shell.
Storage and re-frying (optional): If making a large batch, you can store them in the refrigerator after the first fry. When ready to serve, fry a second time to make them crispier.
How to choose fresh sweet potatoes
Choose potatoes that are round or oblong, without narrow 'waists,' and are not too hard when pressed. These usually have less fiber, more starch, and a characteristic sweet flavor.
When buying, choose potatoes with a smooth exterior, no cracks or chips. They should feel heavy and firm in your hand, not soft or bruised.
Avoid potatoes with black spots or signs of pitting, as these are signs of spoilage. Avoid very small, misshapen, or crooked potatoes, as they tend to be fibrous and less tasty.

mon_an.mo_ta: Lava cake with a perfectly soft exterior and a warm, thick matcha chocolate center. You will be absolutely delighted when enjoying this cake. Let's learn how to make this sweet lava cake!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, preheat your oven to 200°C.
Chop the chocolate and melt it with the butter over a water bath (double boil) until smooth.
Step 2:
Whisk the eggs and mix well with the flour, then add 1/2 of the melted chocolate mixture from step 1 and stir to combine.
Step 3:
With the remaining chocolate, add the matcha powder and mix until the mixture is smooth and thick.
Tip: To achieve a beautiful green color, you should replace the dark chocolate with white chocolate.
Step 4:
Place the egg whites, sugar, and vanilla in a large bowl and whisk until stiff peaks form.
Step 5:
Fold the whisked egg whites into the chocolate mixture from step 2. To make mixing easier, divide the egg whites into 3 parts and fold them in one by one.
Be careful to fold gently, decisively, and quickly so the egg whites do not deflate!
Step 6:
Put the two types of batter into two separate piping bags for easy layering. Line a cylindrical mold with parchment paper and begin piping the batter. Start with a layer of chocolate at the bottom.
If you don't have a cylindrical mold, you can use ceramic ramekins. If using ramekins, brush the inside with butter and keep chilled until ready to pipe.
Next, pipe a layer of the matcha mixture, then another layer of chocolate on top.
After filling the molds, refrigerate for about 30 minutes before baking.
Step 7:

Bake for about 8-9 minutes. Watch carefully while baking: as the cake nears completion, the surface will change from wet to smooth. The cake is done when the surface color is even and feels just dry to the touch.
Every batch may have a slightly different baking time, so watch very carefully. Once finished, wait about 10 minutes before enjoying!
A good lava cake will have a perfectly soft shell and a warm, thick matcha chocolate filling.
Lava cake is also known as 'Fire and Ice' to describe the wonderful contrast between the warm cake and cold ice cream.

mon_an.mo_ta: Eating matcha allows you to enjoy all the benefits of tea leaves and a high concentration of antioxidants. Combine matcha with sweet white chocolate and you will melt into its wonderful flavor. Practice making matcha chocolate to prepare for a warm Valentine's Day!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Finely chop the white chocolate and set aside in a bowl.
Step 2: Bring the whipping cream to a boil. While the cream is still hot, add the white chocolate and butter, stirring until both are melted and the mixture becomes thick and smooth.
Step 3: Use a fine-mesh sieve to sift the matcha powder into the mixture and stir well until it turns a vibrant matcha green.
Step 4: Pour the mixture into a parchment-lined mold and refrigerate for 4-5 hours.
Step 5: Once the chocolate has set, use a knife to cut it into small squares.
Step 6: Arrange on a plate, dust evenly with more matcha powder, and enjoy.

mon_an.mo_ta: Making regular mochi is already familiar, but with the recipe below, you'll be nodding in approval at its irresistible flavor!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 1/2 tsp pomelo blossom water or vanilla for aroma
1 cup shredded dried coconut (if unavailable, plain mochi is also delicious)
Fresh fruits such as: mango, strawberry, or kiwi...
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the strawberries in diluted salt water, drain, and remove the stems. Cut the mango or kiwi into bite-sized pieces.
Step 2: Combine the flours, sugar, oil, and milk in a bowl, then strain through a sieve for a smooth consistency.
Step 3: Bring a pot of water to a boil and steam the bowl of batter for about 20-25 minutes until cooked (the dough is cooked when it forms a solid mass with no liquid remaining).
Place the dough on a surface, let it cool slightly, then wear gloves and knead briefly until smooth and elastic.

Step 4: Divide the dough into portions of about 30g each. Roll into balls and flatten. Place a piece of strawberry, kiwi, or mango in the center, pinch the edges to seal, and roll into a ball. Roll the ball in the shredded coconut to finish.
Place the fresh fruit mochi on a plate and enjoy.
Good luck and enjoy this delicious fresh fruit mochi with your family!

mon_an.mo_ta: Crepes are delicious and very easy to eat. Therefore, they have been adapted in many ways with diverse ingredients. However, making a good crepe requires a bit of skill. Today, we will guide you through a very simple apple crepe recipe perfect for beginners. Though simple, these apple crepes are incredibly attractive due to the gentle sweetness and slight tartness from apples, lemon juice, yogurt, and a wonderful aroma. Let's get in the kitchen and try it!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Wash the apples, peel them, and cut them into small pieces.
Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk well.
Sift the flour until fine.
Squeeze the lemon for juice and remove all seeds.
Step 2: Cooking steps
First, put the flour into a large bowl, then add the eggs and unsweetened milk.
Use a whisk to beat the flour mixture until completely dissolved, smooth, and well combined without lumps.
Let the batter rest for a while; meanwhile, we will marinate the apple filling.
Place the sliced apples in a large bowl, sprinkle cocoa powder evenly over them, and mix well so every piece is coated with cocoa flavor.
Next, place a non-stick pan on the stove over low heat, add a tiny bit of oil, and coat the surface of the pan.
Scoop a ladle of batter into the pan and spread it thinly across the surface, similar to making a pancake.
When one side is golden brown, flip it over and fry the other side until cooked. Remove the crepe gently to avoid tearing.
Next, melt the butter in a pan, then add the white sugar and lemon juice, stirring constantly.
Once you have a caramel-colored butter-sugar mixture, pour in all the marinated apples and stir quickly and evenly.
Add a little filtered water to simmer the apples until soft.
Simmer for a few minutes, then taste; if the apples are soft and flavorful, turn off the heat.
Finally, lay a crepe on a plate, then scoop the filling and spread it lengthwise across the center.
Add a little yogurt on top of the filling, then carefully roll the crepe up to complete.
Repeat the process with the remaining crepes and filling.
Notes
To ensure the dish is perfect, be very careful when frying the crepes so they don't tear. Use a completely non-stick pan and don't make the crepes too thin.
If the batter feels too thick while mixing, you can add more milk or water.
Additionally, since the filling is already quite sweet, you should not add sugar to the crepe batter; keeping the shell plain makes for a better balance.
Adjust the sweetness of the filling to suit your personal taste.
Besides using yogurt as a topping, you can use whipping cream or your favorite ice cream (vanilla, chocolate, strawberry, etc.) for a unique and exciting flavor.

mon_an.mo_ta: Strawberry tarts are a familiar treat, especially for those with a sweet tooth. However, today we introduce a simple yet attractive version where the filling—consisting of strawberries, cream cheese, and a bit of raspberry jelly—is not enclosed but beautifully exposed. With the harmony of the golden crust, white cream, and red strawberries, no one will be able to take their eyes off them. One bite and you'll never forget the taste. Let's get in the kitchen and try this delicious dish!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: A little oil or butter to grease the molds
200g cream cheese (seasoned with: 1 tbsp powdered sugar, ½ tsp vanilla)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Crack the egg and separate the yolk.
Remove the green stems from the strawberries, wash, and drain. You can soak them in diluted salt water to sanitize, then cut each strawberry in half.
Wash the mint leaves and drain them thoroughly.
Step 2: Cooking steps
First, put the flour and butter into a large bowl and mix by hand, gently rubbing the butter into the flour until it is evenly incorporated.
Add the granulated sugar and vanilla to the bowl and continue mixing until the sugar is dissolved.
Next, pour the egg yolk and water into the center of the flour mixture.
Mix thoroughly until the dough is smooth, non-lumpy, and forms a soft, pliable mass.
Once the dough is well mixed, place the bowl in the refrigerator for about 30 minutes.
Next, use a brush to coat the tart molds with a thin layer of oil or butter to prevent sticking.
When the dough is ready, take it out, place it on a surface, and divide it into 4 equal parts.
Use a rolling pin to roll the dough out to a thickness of 5mm. (A thinner crust will be crispier and more delicious when baked).
Use a circular cutter to cut the dough into smaller rounds and repeat until all the dough is used.
Once the crusts are shaped, place them into the molds and return them to the refrigerator for another 15-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 200°C.
After 15-20 minutes, take the molds from the fridge and put them immediately into the oven. Bake for about 7-10 minutes.
Once the crusts are cooked, remove them and let them cool naturally.
Next, put the cream cheese in a large bowl, add the powdered sugar and vanilla, and mix well.
Place a small pot on the stove, add the raspberry jelly, and turn on low heat.
Use a spoon to stir until the jelly is completely melted. Simmer for 2-3 minutes, then add a few tablespoons of water. When the jelly is fully melted and bubbling, turn off the heat.
For the final step, scoop a spoonful of the cream cheese mixture into each tart shell, then place a strawberry on top.
Quickly drizzle a little raspberry jelly over the top before it sets, decorate with a few mint leaves, and enjoy.
Notes
When baking, adjust the temperature and time to suit your specific oven.
Chilling the crusts a second time helps them maintain their shape and prevents over-expanding while baking. It also makes the crust crispier.
Choose fresh, ripe strawberries. If they have green patches, they will be very sour.

Finished product requirements: The tart should have the richness of the cream, the cool sweetness of the strawberries, and the refreshing aroma of the raspberry jelly, with a crispy crust and eye-catching colors.

mon_an.mo_ta: This Korean seafood pancake features a special combination of seafood and green onions; it's very fragrant and definitely worth a try! Experience this delicious dish!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, salt, pepper, garlic, white wine - for seasoning
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the green onions and celery, then cut the white parts of the onions and the celery stalks.
Next, lightly sauté the ground beef with soy sauce, sugar, salt, pepper, garlic, and wine.
Step 2: Mix the rice flour, all-purpose flour, and glutinous rice flour with water until you get a smooth, slightly thick batter.
In another bowl, whisk the three eggs together.
Step 3: When the pan is hot, add a little sesame oil, then carefully arrange the green onions and celery in the pan.
