Step 4: Pour a layer of batter over the green onions and celery.
Step 5: Add the shrimp, scallops, beef, and eggs on top.
Step 6: Fry the pancake until golden brown on both sides to complete.

mon_an.mo_ta: If you're looking for something quick and simple yet with a unique flavor, Baked Cheese Enchiladas are exactly what you need. This is a very popular dish in the US and Mexico, but not yet widely known in Vietnam. Baked Cheese Enchiladas are made from corn tortillas rolled with a cheese filling and served with a spicy sauce. You will surely love this dish from the first bite. Let's get in the kitchen and learn how to make it!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Shred or grate the cheese.
Peel and wash the onion, then finely dice or grate it.
Clean the green onions, remove any wilted leaves, wash, and chop finely.
Peel and wash the garlic, then mince it.
Step 2: Cooking steps
First, preheat the oven to 180°C.

Prepare a medium pot and add the following ingredients: tomato sauce, basil, minced garlic, flour, chili powder, cocoa powder, and a little salt. Use a spoon to mix well so the flour doesn't lump and the ingredients are well combined.
Place the pot on the stove over low or medium heat. Stir while cooking to dissolve and combine the ingredients, which also prevents sticking or burning.
Next, place a pan on the stove and add a tiny bit of oil to heat.
When the oil is hot, add the corn tortillas and fry until golden on both sides. Each side only needs about 1 minute.
Repeat with the remaining tortillas.
Next, lay a tortilla on a plate, add some onion, shredded cheese, and green onions, then roll the tortilla up.
Repeat with the remaining ingredients.
After rolling the tortillas, arrange them in a baking dish, pour the spicy sauce over them, and sprinkle with more cheese.
Finally, place the dish in the preheated oven for about 5 minutes or until the cheese is completely melted and has a beautiful golden-brown crust.
When the dish is done, take it out, sprinkle more green onions on top, and enjoy.
Notes:
If the sauce becomes too thick while cooking, you can add a little water to thin it out for a better taste.
Instead of using a pan to fry the tortillas, you can use an oven or a charcoal grill.
If you like meat, you can add it to the enchiladas. Commonly used meats are chicken, pork, or beef; you can also add sausage if you like.

When finished, this baked enchilada dish will have eye-catching colors with golden cheese, crispy tortillas, nutty corn, and melted cheese in your mouth along with a flavorful sauce. This is a perfect dish for parties or simply a delicious weekend treat. It is especially good on chilly days and should be eaten while hot!

mon_an.ten: Delicious and Nutritious Mango Mousse for Hot Days
mon_an.mo_ta: With its nutritious benefits and naturally delicious flavor, mango mousse is often chosen by restaurants as a dessert on their menus. Beautiful and healthy, you might not realize how simple it is to make. Believe it or not, this mango mousse recipe takes only 30 minutes. If you don't believe it, try it for yourself right now!
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients
Peel all the mangoes and dice them. Put 2 mangoes into a blender and blend until smooth.
Extract the juice from the remaining mango and set it aside in a bowl.
Squeeze 1/2 a lemon for its juice.
Cooking steps
Step 1: Pour the 2 blended mangoes into a pot and add the lemon juice. Place on the stove and cook over medium heat for about 5 minutes.
Step 2: Remove the pot from the heat, let the mixture cool slightly, then pour in the milk and stir well.
Step 3: Pour the mixture into a bowl, add the heavy cream, and fold gently. Continue until the mixture is uniform and well combined.
Step 4: Prepare 3 beautiful small glasses, then divide the mixture evenly into each glass. Place in the refrigerator for about 2 hours until the mixture is slightly set.
Step 5: Take the bowl containing the juice of the remaining mango, add the gelatin, and dissolve it. Pour into a pot and simmer for about 2 minutes, then remove from the heat.

Step 6: After 2 hours, take the 3 glasses out. Wait for the gelatin and mango juice mixture to cool completely, then pour it evenly over the 3 glasses. You can decorate with a bit of whipped cream or mango slices on top, then return them to the fridge. They will be ready to eat in another 2 hours!
Note
The finished mousse must be firm, not watery or runny, with a distinct mango aroma and flavor.

mon_an.mo_ta: Let's get into the kitchen and make this mud pie to treat the whole family! This cake is also perfect as a gift for special occasions like birthdays, Christmas, Valentine's Day, and more.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Pecans - 120g (can be substituted with walnuts or almonds)
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, to make the crust, place the Oreos in a blender and blend until fine. Then, mix the crumbs thoroughly with the sugar and butter.
Step 2:
Once the mixture is well combined, transfer it to a pie dish and press it firmly into the bottom and up the sides.
Note: You should use a cup to press the mixture down so it sticks firmly to the dish!
Step 3:
Next, for the filling, use a knife to finely chop the pecans and chocolate, then place them together in a bowl.
Step 4:
Next, add the corn syrup, butter, and heavy cream to a pot and cook over low heat until the mixture just begins to boil and the butter is completely melted.
Step 5:
While the mixture is still hot, pour the butter mixture into the bowl of chopped chocolate and use a whisk to stir until the chocolate is melted.
Step 6:
Once the chocolate and butter mixture is well combined, add the powdered sugar and bourbon, then whisk vigorously.
Pour this mixture over the crust prepared in step 2.
Step 7:
When the chocolate layer has cooled and hardened, spread the coffee ice cream on top and use a spatula to smooth it over the surface.
Step 8:
Next, sprinkle a layer of pecans over the top of the cake!
Step 9:
To make the topping, add the corn syrup, butter, and heavy cream to a small pot and heat until the mixture just begins to boil.
Add the chocolate and stir until completely melted.
Step 10:
Pour in the bourbon and continue to stir.
Step 11:
Place the topping into a piping bag and pipe a decorative lattice pattern over the surface of the cake.
Finally, store the cake in the freezer for about 20 minutes before serving!
Finished product requirements:
The cake should be smooth and creamy, with just the right amount of sweetness—not too sugary and not too bland.
You should let the ice cream just set; avoid letting it get too hard, as this will reduce the deliciousness of the cake.
This irresistible mud pie recipe, combining cake and ice cream, is sure to enchant you!
You can make a whole mud pie without even needing an oven! What are you waiting for? Let's get started!

mon_an.mo_ta: Passion fruit panna cotta, with its creamy milk pudding layer and the harmonious sweet and sour taste of the passion fruit jelly, is the perfect dessert for the family or a mid-afternoon snack. Follow this article to discover the recipe for passion fruit panna cotta right now! Passion fruit panna cotta - The perfect dessert. Featuring a soft, creamy, and sweet milk pudding layer perfectly balanced with a tangy passion fruit jelly.
cac_buoc: I. How to make passion fruit panna cotta
1. Ingredients preparation
This recipe is for:
One glass of unsweetened fresh milk (210 ml)
Combined with 60 ml of honey
One passion fruit and 6 grams of gelatin.
2. Cooking instructions for passion fruit panna cotta
2.1. Making the milk pudding

The first step is to soak 4 grams of gelatin in about 3 tablespoons of filtered water for 10 minutes to let it bloom. Meanwhile, mix 210 ml of unsweetened fresh milk and 30 ml of honey in a bowl and stir well.

Next, pour the bloomed gelatin and the milk-honey mixture into a pot. Place it on the stove and cook over low heat, stirring constantly until the gelatin is completely dissolved. Once dissolved, turn off the heat.
Finally, pour the mixture into glasses and cover tightly with plastic wrap. Place the glasses in the refrigerator for about 2-3 hours to set.
2.2 Making the passion fruit pudding
Next, soak the remaining 2 grams of gelatin in about 2 tablespoons of water for 10 minutes until fully bloomed.

Then, cut the passion fruit in half, use a spoon to scoop out the pulp, and strain it through a sieve to remove the seeds. Add 1 tablespoon of hot water and 30 ml of honey to the passion fruit pulp and stir well.

Next, pour the passion fruit mixture and the cooled gelatin solution into a pot. Simmer over low heat for about 5 minutes, stirring until the gelatin is completely dissolved. Turn off the heat and let it cool.
Take the set milk pudding out of the fridge, pour a layer of the cooled passion fruit and gelatin mixture on top, then cover and return to the fridge for another hour.
To make the panna cotta more visually appealing, you can sprinkle a few passion fruit seeds on top.

The passion fruit pudding brings a fragrant and sweet flavor. The milk pudding is not too sweet, and when combined with the light acidity, it creates a refreshing and cool sensation without being cloying.
II. How to make vanilla passion fruit panna cotta
300ml unsweetened fresh milk
300ml whipping cream
2 sheets of gelatin
1 vial of vanilla extract
5 passion fruits
130g sugar
20ml water
2. Steps to make vanilla passion fruit panna cotta
Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Wash 4 passion fruits, cut them in half, and use a spoon to scoop out the pulp.
Soak 2 sheets of gelatin in water for 10 minutes.
Step 2: Cook the cream-milk mixture
Place a pot on the stove and add the whipping cream, heating it for about 10 minutes.
Add 300 ml of unsweetened fresh milk, 100g of sugar, and the 2 soaked gelatin sheets to the pot.
Stir the mixture well and cook at 80°C for about 15 minutes until the mixture is smooth and slightly thickened, then turn off the heat.
Step 3: Pour into molds
Use glass jars and pour in the cooked cream-milk mixture. Be careful not to fill them to the top; leave some space at the rim for the passion fruit layer.
Place the jars in the refrigerator for 2 hours to set.
Step 4: Prepare the passion fruit sauce
Place a pot on the stove and add the passion fruit pulp, 30g of sugar, and 1 cup of water. Cook until it boils, then turn off the heat and let it cool.
Finally, decorate the panna cotta by pouring the prepared passion fruit sauce over the surface of the set cream jars. Keep in the refrigerator for 2-3 hours before serving.
3. Finished product:

The passion fruit panna cotta will offer a rich, creamy milk flavor combined with the sweet, sour, and refreshing taste of passion fruit. This is a delightful dessert that cools the body and stimulates your taste buds.
How to choose fresh ingredients
1. Choosing fresh passion fruits with dense pulp
Color and skin: Choose passion fruits that are deep purple-red or bright yellow, with a shiny, smooth, and plump outer skin.
Scent: Choose fruits with a characteristic aroma. When held, they should feel heavy and solid. Give them a gentle squeeze to check for moderate firmness; avoid fruits that are too soft or hollow.
Color and uniformity: Avoid passion fruits with patchy or uneven coloring. It is best to choose those with a consistent and attractive color.
Firmness: Avoid buying fruits that are too hard or mushy, as this may indicate they are no longer fresh and may have lost their flavor and pulp density.
By following these criteria, you will be able to select fresh passion fruits with dense pulp for your dish.
2. How to choose good honey
Good, pure honey will have the following characteristics:
Viscosity: Real honey will have a thick texture and will not run or feel too watery.
Color: Pure honey is usually a deep amber color, without cloudiness or impurities.
Aroma: Real honey will have a distinct, strong fragrance.
To check the quality of honey, you can apply the following method:
Drop a bit of honey into a glass of water. Real honey will not dissolve immediately but will sink to the bottom, while fake honey will dissolve right away.
To ensure quality and family health, you should buy honey from reputable sources or large supermarkets. This ensures the honey you buy is high quality and not adulterated.
Avoid buying honey with the following signs, as they may indicate a poor product:
The honey has turned black.
White air bubbles appear on the surface.
The honey has a pungent, unpleasant smell.
The honey tastes sour or bitter, which may be a sign that it has expired.
In summary, choose pure honey and ensure quality by using the principles and testing methods above.
Notes when making passion fruit panna cotta
Choose fresh ingredients: Ensure you select ripe passion fruits with bright colors and a characteristic aroma. Fresh fruit will bring the best flavor to your panna cotta.

Use quality gelatin: Gelatin is the key ingredient for setting the panna cotta. Choose high-quality gelatin, follow the package instructions, and ensure it is completely dissolved in the amount of water specified.

Heat milk and sugar until completely dissolved: When heating the milk and sugar, ensure the sugar is fully dissolved and the mixture is smooth. This ensures a perfect blend of ingredients and an even sweetness.

Always ensure the correct amount of gelatin: When adding gelatin to the hot milk mixture, be sure to measure the exact amount according to the recipe. Using too little may prevent it from setting, while using too much can make it too rubbery.
Make fresh passion fruit sauce: When making the sauce, choose fresh fruit and follow the steps to ensure the color, sweet-sour balance, and characteristic aroma are preserved.

Chill the panna cotta long enough: For the panna cotta to set and have the right structure, leave it in the refrigerator for the full time specified. Usually, at least 2-3 hours are needed for it to fully set.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Cute Reindeer Cheese Snacks
mon_an.mo_ta: These adorable reindeer cheese snacks, made with easy-to-find ingredients and a simple method, will be a wonderful Christmas gift for family, friends, and loved ones. Kids will be absolutely delighted by these whimsical reindeer and will gobble them right up. Moreover, they are easy to eat and easy to make, perfect for home parties, weekend picnics, and especially suitable for this Christmas season!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Black peppercorns (or any ingredient for eyes) - a few
Red bell pepper, tomato, or any red ingredient for the nose - as desired
cac_buoc: Phase 1: Preparation and processing of ingredients
Step 1:
Place all necessary ingredients in one place, including black peppercorns, cheese, pretzels, and red pepper.
Step 2:

Prepare the reindeer noses: Cut the red bell pepper into small triangles. Remember not to cut them too large if you don't want your reindeer to have oversized noses. You should only cut enough triangles for the number of cheese pieces you have, keeping a few extra in case some don't look right.
Step 3:
Prepare the reindeer eyes: Have your black peppercorns ready in a small jar.
Step 4:

Prepare the cheese triangles: Carefully peel the four sides of the cheese foil so that the cheese remains on the bottom foil and keeps its original shape. Then, place the peeled cheese pieces on a tray.
Step 5:
Prepare the ears: Count the number of pretzels needed for the number of reindeer you plan to make. Discard any broken ones so the reindeer have perfect ears.
Step 6:

Prepare the serving plate: Prepare clean plates and ensure there is no paper on them, as paper can stick to the cheese and ruin the dish. It is best to choose a plate made of plastic, silicone, or a non-stick material.
Phase 2: Assembly
Step 1:
Place the pretzels at the top of the triangle to make ears, so that the openings in the pretzel fit the corners of the cheese piece.
Step 2:
Next, take the small pieces of pepper you cut and place them at the tip of the triangle. You may need to trim the pepper pieces slightly so they fit perfectly as a nose.
Step 3:
Then, place 2 peppercorns to make the eyes for the reindeer. Make sure to balance them on both sides.
Step 4:
Finally, arrange the finished reindeer on the plate. Take a look to see if you are happy with the arrangement. Also, check if any parts have fallen off before serving.
You can serve them immediately or store them in the refrigerator until ready to use.
Good luck with this delicious treat, and have a peaceful Christmas season with these adorable reindeer alongside your family and friends!

These adorable reindeer cheese snacks, made with easy-to-find ingredients and a simple method, will be a wonderful Christmas gift for family, friends, and loved ones. Kids will be absolutely delighted by these whimsical reindeer and will gobble them right up. Moreover, these lovely reindeer are easy to eat and easy to make, perfect for home parties, weekend picnics, and especially suitable for this Christmas season!

mon_an.mo_ta: An extremely simple way to make small, cute pizza calzones with a flavor that is beyond reproach. What are you waiting for? Let's get in the kitchen and learn how to make them!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 1 pizza crust - (available at bakery supply stores)
cac_buoc: Let's prepare the ingredients to make these cute little cakes!
Step 1:
First, preheat the oven to 200°C. Spread the pizza dough on a flat surface and cut into circles about 8cm in diameter.
Step 2:
Cut the cheese into small pieces about 3cm. Place 1 or 2 slices of pepperoni on the dough and add the cheese on top.
Step 3:
Roll the dough into small balls so that the dough completely encloses the pepperoni and cheese as shown.
Step 4:
Place the dough balls into the mold and bake for 15 minutes. If you don't have a round mold, you can use a muffin tray; brush a little butter inside before placing the dough balls in!
When the cakes are golden brown, leave them in the oven for about 5 minutes before taking them out.
Step 5:
With this calzone recipe, you will decorate them like basketballs! To decorate, use a black food coloring pen to draw black lines on the cakes to look like basketball seams.
Step 6:
To make the cakes orange, mix the butter thoroughly with orange food coloring, then brush the butter over all the dough balls to finish.
You can eat the cakes with tomato sauce for a better taste!
This mini pizza version is not only much easier to make but also bite-sized and simple for you to get creative with!

mon_an.mo_ta: Fried pizza is a new way of preparing pizza compared to the usual method. Fried pizza brings a wonderful sensation to the eater with a crispy crust, rich flavor, and a topping fragrant with cheese. Everything blends together to create a wonderful dish. Let's get in the kitchen and learn how to make this delicious dish!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Mozzarella or smoked provolone cheese - as desired
Fresh basil leaves - finely chopped for sprinkling
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Add sugar, oil, yeast, and water to a large bowl. Let it sit for about 8-10 minutes until the water is foamy or the yeast has fully bloomed.

Next, mix the flour with salt, then slowly pour in the yeast mixture and knead thoroughly. We need to knead until the dough no longer sticks to your hands, is soft and smooth, and the mixture is well combined so the salt is evenly distributed.
Step 2:
At this point, sprinkle a layer of flour on a wide flat surface, then place the dough on the surface and continue to knead until the dough becomes a smooth mass.
After mixing, put the dough back into the bowl, cover with a towel, and let the dough rest for 1 hour so it can double in size.
Step 3:
After 1 hour, once the dough has risen, cut the dough into 12 equal parts, then roll them into balls and arrange them on a large tray.
Step 4:
Similar to step 2, cover with a towel again and let the dough continue to rest for a few hours.
Step 5:
After proofing the small dough balls, take one piece out and press it flat. Note to press with your fingertips to create airiness, then use a fork to prick holes on the surface of the crust.
Step 6:
Next, heat the oil. Make sure to use enough oil to deep-fry the crust, which will help the pizza become crispy and more delicious.
When the oil is hot, drop the crust in to fry, flipping it as you go, for about 1-2 minutes until the crust puffs up and turns slightly golden.
Step 7:
Time to decorate with toppings! First, spread a layer of marinara sauce evenly across the surface of the crust. If you like it tangy, you can spread a bit more; otherwise, just enough to taste.
Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 245°C.
Step 8:
Next, sprinkle the smoked provolone and grated Romano on top.
Step 9:
Finally, it's the fresh basil's turn.
Step 10:

When the oven is hot enough, put the pizza in to bake. Note to only bake until the cheese has just melted, then remove immediately. The reason Pizza Montanara only needs a short baking time is that the crust is already cooked; we only need the topping to be hot.
Step 11:
Finally, take the pizza out, cut into bite-sized pieces, and enjoy.
Note:

When mixing the dough, remember to knead thoroughly and evenly so the crust is soft, the mixture is well combined, and the dough is not lumpy. Remember to proof the dough for at least 1 hour to give it time to rest and rise. If you want the pizza to be even better, you can proof the dough a bit longer.
Once divided into 12 small pieces, remember to proof the dough for 2-3 hours so it continues to expand, making the pizza soft and crispy when fried without the crust being too thick.
For the pizza toppings, besides the ingredients above, you can add anything you like such as sausage, Chinese sausage, or various types of seafood.

mon_an.mo_ta: These hot pull-apart pizza pieces have a crispy outer edge and a rich, cheesy center with savory ham that is simply addictive. Treat your family or friends to this pizza over the weekend with the recipe below.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Melt the butter.
Mince the garlic.
Slice the sausage and ham into bite-sized pieces.
Grate the cheese.
Step 2: Execution steps
Gently roll the dough into a rectangle measuring 11x20cm, then spread a layer of tomato sauce over the surface.
Next, sprinkle an even layer of grated cheese and arrange the beef sausage on top.
Then, cut 5 lines along the long edge and 4 lines along the short edge to create 20 small squares.
Next, stack the layers of dough on top of each other, cover with plastic wrap, and let rise for 30 minutes or until the dough has doubled in size.
Preheat the oven to 250°C for about 10 minutes. Brush a thin layer of butter on the baking tray before arranging the dough layers inside.

Bake the pizza for 15 minutes, then remove from the oven. Mix the remaining butter with the minced garlic, brush it over the surface of the loaf, and bake for another 15-20 minutes until the pizza turns golden brown.
Remove the pan from the oven, let it cool for 10 minutes, then remove the pizza from the mold.

mon_an.mo_ta: Halloween is so vibrant with all kinds of spooky costumes and eerie, deathly decorations. To make your Halloween party even more unique, learn how to make this one-of-a-kind graveyard pudding! Wishing you a vibrant and memorable Halloween!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Dark chocolate, bone-shaped candies, eye-shaped candies - as needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: To make this graveyard pudding, place all the chocolate into a bag, then microwave for about 30 seconds until the chocolate is melted. Remember to tie the bag carefully so the chocolate doesn't leak out!

Step 2: Take the bag of melted chocolate out and snip a very small corner for decorating. Take each oval biscuit and pipe a border in the middle of two biscuits with the melted chocolate. Write "RIP" on the biscuits or any words that evoke a graveyard or cemetery! ^^
Step 3: Pour the prepared pudding into individual disposable plastic cups.
Step 4: Crush the Oreos into a powder and pour them into each pudding cup.

Step 5: Then, insert the biscuit tombstone you wrote on into one part of the cup, standing it upright! After that, sprinkle bone candies, eye candies, and add a bit of strawberry jam to make our cemetery look even scarier.
Source: ST

mon_an.mo_ta: This tiramisu recipe might be a bit difficult, but the taste and appearance are impeccable. Let's see how to make this tiramisu!
cac_buoc: Here are the ingredients needed for this delicious cake:
Step 1:
First, place the sugar, eggs, salt, and coffee liqueur in a large bowl and whisk together.
Step 2:
Cook the mixture over a double boiler on low heat, stirring constantly for about 6 minutes until the mixture becomes thick and creamy.
Step 3:
In another bowl, combine the mascarpone cheese and heavy cream.
Step 4:
Whisk until the cream mixture is uniform, stiff, and smooth.
Step 5:
Slowly fold the cream mixture into the egg mixture from step 2, mixing until well combined.
Step 6:
Once all the cream is folded in, your mixture should look like this!
Step 7:
Prepare the ladyfingers by dipping them quickly into the espresso, then arrange them on a tray.
Step 8:
Spread a layer of cream on top, then repeat the process with ladyfingers and cream two more times.
Step 9:
Place the remaining cream into a piping bag with a large round tip and pipe it onto the top surface as shown in the picture.
Step 10:
Finally, dust an even layer of cocoa powder over the top of the cake, then store it in the refrigerator for 1 day to allow the ingredients to set.
Your tiramisu is now ready to enjoy!
The taste of homemade tiramisu will surely be very different from the tiramisu you usually eat out...
Plus, with this extremely eye-catching appearance, it's absolutely perfect!
"Authentic" tiramisu will have the kick of alcohol, the heartiness of the cake, and the richness of the cream and cheese—one bite and you'll remember it forever.

mon_an.mo_ta: The name might sound strange, but the method is very simple. Let's try making this royal mochi in your kitchen!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 100g warabi mochi starch (can be substituted with potato starch or tapioca starch, though the quality won't be as good)
cac_buoc: When people think of mochi, they usually think of glutinous rice as the main ingredient. However, there is a high-end type of mochi that uses bracken starch, called warabi mochi. Not only that, the cake must go through many complex and meticulous manual steps to create a chewy texture, a smooth surface, and a characteristic cool taste without needing refrigeration.

In the past, because the process was so elaborate, warabi mochi was mainly served to the nobility and royalty in Kyoto. As food technology developed and pre-made warabi mochi starch became available in supermarkets, people were able to make this cake at home more often. Additionally, you can substitute it with potato starch or tapioca starch to create the transparency and coolness for the cake. Furthermore, the recipe with soybean powder will help the cake taste like the authentic traditional version.
Let's look at the method below!
Step 1:
Place the mochi starch, sugar, and water in a pot and mix well.
Step 2:
Place on the stove and cook, stirring constantly.
When the mixture begins to boil, turn the heat down to low.
Step 3:
Use a wooden spoon to stir vigorously for about 10 minutes until the mixture is thick and translucent.
Step 4:
Spread a layer of soybean powder on a tray, then pour the mochi mixture out to form a layer 1-2cm thick.
Continue to sprinkle soybean powder evenly over the top surface.
Step 5:
After waiting for the mochi to cool, use a knife to cut it into squares.
Warabi mochi tastes better if you refrigerate it for about 20 - 30 minutes before eating. When serving, you can add sugar syrup for a richer flavor.
This warabi mochi can be kept for 1 - 2 days at room temperature. You can put it in the refrigerator to keep it longer.

mon_an.mo_ta: This fried sticky rice dish features a super crispy outer crust that, when bitten into, releases savory meat juices and the soft, chewy texture of glutinous rice, creating an unforgettable signature flavor. Let's explore this simple way to make extra crispy puffed sticky rice with easy-to-find ingredients. Discover the secret to a crispy shell, sweet meat filling, and tender rice grains. Don't miss the chance to enjoy this delicious dish that evokes the flavors of home.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
To soften the glutinous rice and mung beans, soak them in water for 4-5 hours or overnight. If you want to save time, soak the mung beans in hot water for about 2-3 hours to reduce the soaking time.
Step 2: Steam and mash the beans
Next, steam the mung beans for 10 minutes until soft. Place the beans in a large bowl and use a ladle to mash them thoroughly. You can also use a blender to puree the beans to save time.
Once the beans are smooth, mix them well with the glutinous rice, add a tablespoon of sugar to the mixture, and stir well.
Step 3: Steam the sticky rice

Place the rice mixture into a steamer, add 70 ml of coconut milk, and steam for about 40 minutes until the rice is soft and cooked through. To ensure even cooking, poke a hole in the middle of the rice to allow steam to escape.

Once the rice is cooked, knead it so the grains stick together into a single mass. Gradually add a little oil to the rice and knead for about 10 minutes until the dough is soft, pliable, and no longer sticks to your hands.
Step 4: Press the rice

Next, place the rice into a mold and press firmly, or press by hand by skillfully flattening the grains so they bond together. Be sure to knead thoroughly so the cake has no gaps, which prevents it from puffing up.
Step 5: Fry the rice

Heat a pan of oil. Once the oil is hot, drop the cut rice pieces in to fry. Initially, the rice will sink, then it will float. Use a ladle to press down on the rice to help it puff up evenly. Fry until golden brown on all sides, then remove and drain on paper towels.

Successful puffed sticky rice should be perfectly round, crispy on the outside, and hollow on the inside with a characteristic aroma. You can serve it with chili sauce or roasted meats like roast chicken, roast duck, or grilled pork for a wonderful flavor experience.
Good luck making this delicious crispy puffed sticky rice for your family!
Tips for extra crispy frying
Use high-quality rice: Choose good quality glutinous rice with the right softness to ensure the best crispiness after frying.
Soak the rice long enough: Before cooking, soak the glutinous rice in water for 4-6 hours or overnight to soften the grains.
Puree the mixture: After steaming the mung beans and rice, use a blender or ladle to mash the mixture into a smooth, uniform paste.
Add a little starch if necessary: If the rice mixture doesn't feel sticky enough or is hard to shape, you can add a little glutinous rice starch to increase elasticity and adjust the texture.

Use the right frying oil: Use a cooking oil with a high smoke point. Heat the oil to about 170-180°C before adding the rice. Ensure there is enough oil so the rice can float and fry evenly without being submerged.
Fry over medium heat: Keep the heat at a medium level to ensure the rice fries evenly without burning or cooking too quickly.
Flip and turn frequently: While frying, flip and turn the rice frequently to ensure both sides achieve an even golden color.
Pour oil over the rice: During the frying process, you can ladle hot oil from the pan over the top of the rice to help the crust become crispier.
Drain oil after frying: After frying, let the rice drain on paper towels or kitchen paper to absorb excess oil.

mon_an.mo_ta: Word has it this cake has been around for a very long time! Cheesecake reportedly appeared in the first Olympic Games, held in 776 BC! The earliest version is believed to have originated in ancient Greece, though at that time, the flavor was very different and the texture wasn't as thick and smooth as it is today. Nowadays, when people think of cheesecake, they immediately imagine a seductive European-style dessert. Let's spend some free weekend time learning how to make this delicious and beautiful cheesecake!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Place the biscuits in a food storage bag and use a rolling pin to crush them into fine crumbs.
Step 2: Melt the butter using a double boiler or a quick burst in the microwave, then add the crushed biscuits and mix well.
Step 3: Line the bottom of the mold with foil, pour in the biscuit mixture, press down firmly with a spoon, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Step 4: Place the cream cheese in a bowl and melt it over a double boiler until smooth.
Step 5: Add the granulated sugar and whisk well.
Step 6: Add the milk in two batches, whisking constantly until combined.

Step 7: Soak the gelatin in water until soft, melt it over a double boiler with a little water, then pour it into the cream cheese mixture. Meanwhile, scoop a small amount of the cream cheese into a small bowl, add the matcha powder, and stir until the powder is completely dissolved.

Step 8: Take the crust out of the refrigerator, pour the plain cream cheese on top, then drop small amounts of the matcha cream cheese onto the surface. Use a toothpick or a piping tool to create patterns as desired. If bubbles appear on the surface, gently blot them with a napkin. Finally, refrigerate the cake for at least 4 hours.
Remove the cake, cut into small pieces, and enjoy your delicious no-bake cheesecake!

mon_an.mo_ta: A basic sponge cake recipe for skillful home cooks! Start your culinary journey with these fundamental recipes. This versatile base can be used to create many delicious fruit-based sponge cakes.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Preheat the oven to 165°C.
Grease the baking mold with butter and dust with a little flour. Rotate the mold so the flour coats it evenly, then tap upside down to remove excess flour.
Step 2:
Take the butter and eggs out of the refrigerator 30-60 minutes beforehand so they reach room temperature.

Using a hand mixer, beat the butter and salt starting at low speed. After 15-20 seconds, gradually sift in the sugar. Continue increasing the mixer speed while beating the butter and sugar. Stop when the mixture turns pale white or light yellow. Do not overbeat, as this basic sponge cake recipe can become tough.
Step 3: Use a whisk to mix the eggs, egg yolks, and vanilla extract until well combined.
Step 4: Divide the egg mixture into 3 parts. Turn the mixer to low speed, then gradually move to medium. Beat the butter-sugar mixture and eggs together. Beat as quickly as possible.
Step 5: Divide the flour into 3 parts. Sift one part of the flour into the bowl and use a spatula to mix.
Place the spatula against the side of the bowl at the 2/3 position, then plunge it straight down toward the bottom.

Move the spatula upward in a 3/4 circle motion. Plunge it back down at the 2/3 position and repeat the upward 3/4 circle motion. Remember to only fold in one direction (this is the folding technique). This is how you mix the batter for this basic sponge cake.
Basic Sponge Cake Recipe

This mixing method prevents the air bubbles created during the butter-creaming step from popping, ensuring the cake rises and stays fluffy. Popping too many bubbles or using an uneven folding technique will cause the air to escape or create large holes, making the cake tough or pitted. Generally, for beginners, proper folding will help your cake rise much more beautifully.
Step 6: Pour the batter into the mold, smooth the surface, and bake at 165°C for 55-60 minutes. If the top gets too brown, cover it with foil.
Test for doneness by inserting a toothpick; if it comes out clean and not sticky, the cake is done.

mon_an.ten: Irresistible Soft Salted Egg Sponge Cake Roll
mon_an.mo_ta: A unique salted egg sponge cake roll with a fragrant, soft, and fluffy texture combined with the slightly salty taste of salted eggs. This combination is sure to delight you!
cac_buoc: These are the ingredients you need to prepare for this delicious cake!
Step 1:
First, separate the salted egg yolks and soak them in Mai Que Lo wine for 5 minutes to remove any fishy odor.
Step 2:
After soaking, arrange the yolks on a tray, brush with a layer of cooking oil, and bake in the oven at 100°C for 10 minutes.
Step 3:
Next, place the fresh milk and butter in a stainless steel bowl and melt them over a double boiler until the butter is completely melted.
Step 4:
In another bowl, whisk the egg yolks. Once whisked, pour them into the bowl containing the melted milk and butter mixture. Use a whisk to mix well.
Step 5:
Sift the flour into the mixture and stir well. You should not sift all the flour at once; divide it into 2 batches to ensure the batter is smooth and even.
Step 6:

For the egg whites, use a mixer at medium speed. When the whites become foamy, add the cream of tartar. Then turn the mixer to the highest speed and beat well, gradually adding the sugar spoon by spoon.
Step 7:
Beat until the egg whites reach stiff peaks; when you lift the whisk and the peaks hold their shape without drooping, it is ready, as shown in the reference image.
Step 8:
Now, gradually fold the egg whites into the yolk mixture. It is best to divide this into 3 batches to prevent the eggs from deflating.
Step 9:
Once the whites and yolks are combined, pour the mixture into a baking tray lined with parchment paper. A 20x30 cm tray is ideal. Spread the mixture evenly so the cake bakes uniformly.
Place the cake in a preheated oven at 150°C.
Step 10:

After baking for about 10 minutes, quickly open the oven and arrange the salted egg yolks on top of the cake, then close the door and bake for another 25 minutes. Arrange the eggs as shown in the image.
After 25 minutes, remove the cake and let it cool. Before removing, check for doneness by inserting a toothpick; if it comes out clean, it's done. If batter sticks to it, bake for a few more minutes.
Step 11:
Once completely cool, place the cake on a large towel and carefully peel off the parchment paper. Be careful not to tear the surface of the cake to keep it looking beautiful.
Step 12:
Next, spread a layer of mayonnaise and sprinkle the chopped Chinese sausage evenly over the surface.
Step 13:
Gently and firmly roll the cake up.
Step 14:
Once rolled, spread another thin layer of mayonnaise on the outside of the cake.
Step 15:
Finally, cover the surface with pork floss. The mayonnaise acts as an adhesive to keep the pork floss from falling off.
And there you have it, the salted egg sponge cake roll is finished!
It looks so appetizing, you'll want to eat it immediately!
The soft, smooth cake combined with the slightly salty egg yolks, the sausage and mayonnaise inside, and the savory pork floss outside creates a truly wonderful treat.

mon_an.mo_ta: Try this brownie recipe; you are guaranteed to be enchanted by its delicious flavor!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: A pinch of salt, vanilla extract
cac_buoc: Ingredients you need to prepare for these delicious brownies!
Step 1:
First, melt the chocolate and butter over a double boiler until the mixture is completely melted and well combined. Remove from heat and let it cool slightly.
Step 2:
Add the sugar, salt, and about 1 teaspoon of vanilla extract, then mix well.
Step 3:
Crack the eggs in one by one. Make sure to mix the batter thoroughly before adding the next egg.
Step 4:
Add the flour and continue mixing until the batter becomes thick and starts to pull away from the sides of the bowl.
Step 5:
Chop the nuts and add them to the mixture, then stir to distribute evenly.
Step 6:
Pour the brownie batter into a tray lined with parchment paper. Note that you should use a metal tray for baking in this recipe.
Bake the brownies for about 20-25 minutes at 175°C, until the cake pulls away from the paper.
Step 7:

Here is the secret to a perfect batch of brownies: place ice in a large tray (large enough to hold the brownie tray), then add water. As soon as the brownies are done baking, place the tray immediately into the ice water bath and leave it until the cake is completely cold. Then remove, cut into squares, and enjoy.
With this method, your brownies will have an excellent flavor!
By cooling the cake in ice water, the brownies will have a much richer chocolate taste...

mon_an.mo_ta: A new recipe for the family using salted egg yolks. You will experience a very different flavor through the outer crust and the inner filling! Let's check out this salted egg pastry recipe!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Mai Que Lo wine (or white wine)
Mung bean, black bean, or red bean paste
Water dough: - 225g flour + 37ml shortening + 70ml water + a pinch of salt
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, to prepare the filling, place the salted egg yolks in a bowl, add the wine, and soak for about 60 minutes. Then remove and drain.
Step 2:
Take a portion of bean paste, flatten it, place a salted egg yolk in the center, and gently wrap the paste around the egg until it is evenly covered.
Step 3:
To make the dough for the crust, you need to prepare two types: water dough and fat dough.
After mixing the doughs, wrap the dough around the bean and egg filling, smoothing it carefully so the dough covers the filling completely.
Step 4:
Whisk the egg and milk together in a bowl to create an egg wash for the pastry.
Step 5:
Line a baking tray with foil, place the pastries on it, and brush the top with the egg-milk mixture.
Step 6:
Sprinkle black sesame seeds on half of the pastries, and place an almond on top of the other half.
Step 7:
Preheat the oven to 180°C for 10 minutes, then bake the pastries for 20-22 minutes. Once finished, remove the tray and let them cool completely before taking the pastries out.
These sweet buns with a fragrant, crispy crust will be delicious!
When cut open, your pastry will have 3 layers, each with its own unique flavor.
Instead of a standard bun dough, this crust recipe makes the buns less heavy and is definitely worth a try!

mon_an.mo_ta: If you are passionate about baking, you definitely cannot miss this Ezhiki hedgehog cookie recipe. It is extremely simple, easy to make, and super delicious, coming all the way from beautiful Russia!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Filling of choice (this recipe uses raisins)
Chocolate coating: - 100g butter + 125ml milk + 30g cocoa powder + Sugar + Wafers
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Preheat the oven to 350°C. Sprinkle a layer of sugar onto parchment paper.
Boil the eggs, then separate the yolks into a bowl.
Step 2:
Mash the egg yolks and mix with butter and sugar until very smooth, about 3-5 minutes.
Add the sour cream and vanilla, then mix in the flour and baking powder. Mix until the dough is no longer sticky to the touch.
Step 3:
Roll the dough into small balls and flatten them. Place a raisin in the center and roll back into a ball.
Step 4:
Once shaped, place the cookies on the parchment paper and bake for about 12 minutes.
Step 5:
To make the chocolate coating, melt the butter in a small pot. When the butter boils, add the milk and cocoa powder. Bring the mixture to a boil, then pour it into a large bowl.
Step 6:
Finely crush the wafers.
Step 7:
Dip the cookies into the melted chocolate.
Then quickly roll them in the crushed wafers to create a crispy shell.
Ezhiki originates from a Russian meatball and rice recipe, but in this variation, Ezhiki is a sweet treat.
Ezhiki are considered a type of cookie and are usually made for holidays or special parties.
The recipe using egg yolks gives these Ezhiki cookies a very unique flavor compared to standard cookies.
Try making this unusual treat for your family today!

mon_an.mo_ta: Learn how to make this soft, fragrant, and sweet cherry-filled sponge cake. You'll be hooked from the very first bite!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
In this first step, prepare a small bowl and mix the sugar and cinnamon powder together.
Step 2:
In a large bowl, pour in the sugar, vegetable oil, orange juice, eggs, and vanilla extract.
Use a whisk to beat until the sugar is dissolved and all ingredients are well combined.
Step 3:
Next, add the dry ingredients (flour, baking powder, salt) to the bowl. Whisk until everything is fully incorporated.
Step 4:
Prepare a baking mold and brush it with a thin layer of oil so the cake doesn't stick when removed.
Pour half of the batter from step 3 into the mold.
Step 5:
Now, place the cherry filling on top of the batter layer. Use a spoon to spread the cherries evenly across the entire surface.
Step 6:
Pour the remaining batter over the cherry filling layer.
Step 7:
Sprinkle the sugar and cinnamon mixture from step 1 over the surface of the batter. The preparation is now complete. Time to bake!
Step 8:
Preheat the oven to 180°C, then place the mold in the oven and bake for 55 minutes.
When the time is up, check for doneness by inserting a small toothpick. If it comes out clean, the cake is done. If batter sticks to it, bake for a few more minutes until fully cooked.
Once the cake is done, remove it from the oven, let it cool, and enjoy!
Finished product requirements:
The cake is evenly baked with a moist, soft, and smooth crumb;
The cake has a beautiful golden color and a characteristic aroma of cake, cherries, and cinnamon;
The sweetness is well-balanced and not overpowering;
The soft sponge combined with the sweet-tart red cherries and the fragrant cinnamon crust is truly irresistible.
The crust is fragrant and soft, and the sweet and sour cherries provide a unique and delightful taste!
Cut a slice, serve with a cup of tea, and slowly enjoy the wonderful flavor with family and friends.

mon_an.mo_ta: These passion fruit cream cupcakes will delight you with the combination of rich cream and fragrant passion fruit.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Yolk mixture - 3 egg yolks; 20g sugar; 40ml cooking oil; 40ml unsweetened milk; 60g cake flour.
White mixture - 3 egg whites; 40g sugar; ½ tsp cream of tartar.
Sugar - 2-3 tbsp (depending on the acidity of the fruit and your taste)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Make the cake
Preheat the oven to 180°C and prepare paper cupcake liners.
Whisk the egg whites until foamy.
Step 2:

Add the cream of tartar and continue whisking until fine bubbles form. Gradually add the sugar and whisk until stiff peaks form (be careful not to overbeat as the whites will become dry and hard to fold into the yolks).
Step 3:
Whisk the egg yolks with sugar until the mixture is light and creamy. Add the oil and milk and continue whisking.
Step 4:
Sift the flour into the yolk mixture and use a whisk to mix until smooth.
Step 5:
Fold 1/3 of the egg whites into the yolk mixture at a time. Use a spatula to fold gently in one direction, using an upward motion from the bottom.
Divide the batter into the paper liners and bake for 20-25 minutes until cooked through.
Step 6: Make the cream filling
Whisk the egg and sugar in a pot. Add the passion fruit pulp along with 1 tbsp of water (15ml), butter, and a pinch of salt.
Step 7:
Place the mixture on the stove and stir constantly over low heat until it thickens and coats the back of a spoon. Turn off the heat and let it cool.
Step 8:

Whisk the heavy cream until soft peaks form; over-whisking will cause it to separate when mixed with the passion fruit. Fold the cooled passion fruit mixture into the cream. Keep the cream in the refrigerator; if it gets too firm, just leave it out for a few minutes to soften.
Step 9:
Pipe the passion fruit cream into the center of the cupcakes and decorate the outside with whipped cream. Your fragrant passion fruit cupcakes are ready.
Enjoy!
Good luck making these easy-to-eat passion fruit cream cupcakes for your family!

mon_an.mo_ta: Hidden deep inside is a delicious, rich, and smooth poached egg, wrapped in a golden, crispy fried potato shell—this is the potato-wrapped egg.
cac_buoc: Step 1: First, wash and boil the potatoes until cooked, then mash them thoroughly. Season with a little salt to taste and knead with a bit of flour until you get a smooth, cohesive mixture. Step 2: - Now, let's poach the eggs. - Bring a pot of water to a boil, add the vinegar, and turn the heat down to the lowest setting. Use a spoon to stir the water into a small whirlpool. Gently pour an egg into the center of the whirlpool and use the spoon to very gently help the white "wrap" around the yolk. Cook for about 1 minute, then remove the egg to a plate. Step 3: - Cut the bacon into small pieces and fry slightly to render the fat; chop the cheese. - Next, roll the potato dough into a circle and place the cheese and bacon inside. Step 4: - Then, place the poached egg on top. Step 5: - Gently bring the edges of the dough up to wrap around the egg, bacon, and cheese filling. Step 6: - Roll into a ball, ensuring the filling is completely sealed inside. Step 7: - Finally, deep-fry the balls in a pan of oil until golden brown and cooked through. When removing, place them on paper towels to drain excess oil before eating! Enjoy the delicious taste! Good luck and bon appétit!

mon_an.mo_ta: With this almond cake recipe, you'll have a truly sweet, delicious, and attractive treat for the whole family to enjoy.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Wash the oranges to remove dirt from the peel, place them in a pot, cover with water, and simmer over low heat for 2 hours.
Step 2:
After 2 hours, check if the oranges are soft, then remove them.
Slice the oranges as shown in the picture, then place them in a blender and puree.
Step 3:
Place eggs and sugar in a large bowl and beat with a mixer until fluffy.
Once the egg-sugar mixture is fluffy, add almond flour and baking powder, and mix well.
Next, add the pureed orange mixture to the bowl and continue to beat well.
Step 4:
Prepare a cake mold and grease it with a layer of cooking oil or butter.
Next, pour the batter from step 3 into the mold.
Place the mold in the oven at 200°C for 30-45 minutes.
Step 5:
While waiting for the cake to bake, mix the remaining ingredients: powdered sugar + orange extract (or vanilla) + grated orange zest + a little water (if difficult to mix) in a bowl.
Once the cake is baked, remove it and let it cool, then pour this mixture around the cake to create a sugar glaze.
Note: To check if the cake is done, insert a toothpick; if it comes out clean, the cake is ready. If batter sticks to the toothpick, bake for a little longer.
Your delicious orange cake is now complete!
Finished product requirements:
The cake should have an eye-catching, even golden-brown color without being burnt.
The cake must be fully cooked, both outside and inside.
The cake shouldn't be too sweet; adjust the sugar next time if needed!
Enjoying this orange cake with hot milk is absolutely wonderful! The cake is fragrant, soft, and perfectly sweet—it melts in your mouth with the milk. Truly delicious!
This orange cake is very easy to make with simple ingredients; you can definitely make it for the family this weekend.

mon_an.mo_ta: If you're looking for a delicious and pretty dessert to refresh your party, Australian Lamingtons are the perfect choice. With a unique flavor and special structure, Lamingtons have become a culinary icon of this country. In this article, we will explore a simple way to make delicious Lamingtons. Discover the simple recipe to create this signature Australian dessert.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Whisk the egg whites
To whisk the egg whites, first separate the whites and yolks of 4 eggs.
Use a hand mixer to beat the egg whites until large bubbles form. Then, add 1/3 tsp salt and 10ml lemon juice.
Continue beating until small bubbles form, then slowly add 60g sugar and continue beating.
When the whites are fluffy and you see trails, lift the whisk to check for peaks. If the peaks are soft, stop.
Note: Do not overbeat at this stage. If beaten too long, the cake will be hard and dry after baking.
Step 2: Mix the batter
Gently whisk the 4 egg yolks.
Combine the whisked egg whites with the yolks. Whisk until well blended.
In another bowl, add 23g unsalted butter and 13ml unsweetened fresh milk. Microwave for 30 seconds at 650 watts. Remove and stir until cooled.
Once the butter mixture has cooled, pour it into the egg bowl along with 1/2 tsp vanilla. Mix until well combined.
Sift 60g all-purpose flour and 20g cornstarch into the egg bowl. Whisk by hand until the mixture is smooth. The batter is now ready.
Step 3: Bake the cake
After mixing, pour the batter into a square mold lined with parchment paper.
Tip: Before placing in the oven, gently tap the mold on the table a few times to reduce air bubbles.
Bake in the oven for 20 minutes at 170°C. Once done, remove and let cool.
Step 4: Spread strawberry jam and cut the cake
Once cooled, trim the edges and slice the cake horizontally into two equal layers.
Spread strawberry jam on the surface of one layer. Use as much jam as you like.
Place the other half of the cake on top of the jam-covered layer.
Use a knife to cut the cake into 16 equal small squares (4 vertical and 4 horizontal lines).
Step 5: Melt the chocolate
First, chop 200g chocolate into small pieces to help it melt faster.
Pour 200ml fresh cream into a pot and heat over low heat until it boils, then turn off the heat.
Pour the hot whipping cream over the chocolate.
The hot cream will melt the chocolate. Stir well until smooth and combined. Once fully melted, add 20g unsalted butter and continue stirring for a smooth, glossy chocolate glaze.
Step 6: Coat with desiccated coconut
Take the 16 small sponge cake pieces, skewer each with a stick, and dip them into the melted dark chocolate mixture.
Roll each cake in desiccated coconut and use a spoon to pour coconut over the top for an even coating. Repeat for all 16 pieces.
These cute Lamingtons offer soft sponge cake combined with sweet strawberry jam and coconut. This pairing, along with the slight bitterness of the chocolate, creates a special flavor.
Besides the great taste, this cake is aesthetically pleasing with its dark chocolate and white coconut coating. It's a perfect treat for family or friend gatherings on the weekend.
Your cute Lamingtons are finished!
Finished product requirements:
The cake should be soft, evenly cooked, and have a glossy golden color when removed from the oven.
The chocolate coating should be perfectly sweet.
The cake will have the attractive fluffiness of sponge cake, plus the irresistible chocolate and coconut shell.
When eating Lamingtons, remember to prepare a cup of hot tea to sip along!
You can also try a 2-layer Lamington recipe with chocolate filling, which is also very interesting!

mon_an.ten: Rich and Creamy Cheese Potato Pancakes
mon_an.mo_ta: If you love cheese, you can't miss this delicious, rich, and intoxicating Swiss cheese recipe!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, cut the bacon into bite-sized pieces and sauté over medium heat. You don't need to add oil because the bacon will release its own fat.
Step 2:
Finely chop the onion and green onions, then sauté with the bacon for 5 minutes.
Step 3:
Mash the potatoes, grate the cheese, and mince the two garlic cloves into a bowl.
Step 4:
Pour the bacon mixture into the bowl, season with salt and pepper, and mix well.
Step 5:
Shape the mixture into large, flat round patties. Heat a little butter in a pan and fry both sides of the cakes (about 5 minutes per side) over low heat.
Once fried, serve on a plate and sprinkle with some chopped green onions for a nice look!
Rosti has a crispy outer shell and a soft, melting interior!

mon_an.mo_ta: Strawberry jam cinnamon rolls are a treat you can't miss, featuring delicious homemade strawberry jam, soft fragrant dough, and a rich, creamy frosting on top. Let's get started!
cac_buoc: Here are the ingredients you need to prepare for the dough, filling, and frosting.
Step 1:
Pour the milk into a pot and heat over low heat until lukewarm, then turn off the heat.
Next, add the yeast to the milk, followed by the remaining dough ingredients: egg, butter, sugar, salt, and vanilla.
Step 2:
After adding the above ingredients, add the flour and use a wooden spoon to mix well until the dough is smooth and no longer sticks to your hands.
Step 3:
Once you have a smooth dough ball, place it in a large bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let it rest for 2 hours until the dough doubles in size.
Step 4:
Next, we will make the strawberry jam. Wash the strawberries and cut them into quarters, then place them in a pot on the stove, add sugar, and mix well.
Simmer over medium heat for about 30 minutes until the sugar is completely melted!
Step 5:
Once the sugar has melted, you will have strawberry jam as shown in the picture! Looks tempting, doesn't it?
Step 6:
After the proofing time, take the dough out and roll it to a thickness of about 5-7 mm. Roll evenly so the dough doesn't tear when rolling!
Step 7:
Spread a thin layer of butter over the entire surface of the dough, covering it completely.
Next, sprinkle the mixture of cinnamon powder and brown sugar over the butter layer.
Then spread the strawberry jam on top, leaving about 1-2 cm at the edges to make rolling easier.
Step 8:
Now, simply roll the dough up carefully so the filling doesn't spill out.
Once rolled, gently press the edge to seal, then use a knife to cut the dough into small rounds.
Step 9:
Grease the baking tray with butter, then arrange the cut dough pieces on the tray (as shown) and let them rest for 45 minutes to rise further.
Near the end of the proofing time, preheat the oven to 180°C, then bake for 25-35 minutes until golden brown.
Step 10:
While waiting for the rolls to bake, prepare the frosting. Mix the cream cheese with powdered sugar in a bowl, add a pinch of salt and vanilla, and stir until smooth.
Once the rolls are baked, let them cool slightly and spread the frosting on top.
And that's it—you've finished these excellent strawberry jam cinnamon rolls!
The rolls look much more attractive with the frosting on top, don't they?
Decorating with sliced fresh strawberries will make them even more enticing!
The baked cinnamon rolls are incredibly fragrant, eaten with sweet and sour strawberry jam and rich frosting—truly wonderful.
You should eat them right after frosting; that's when they taste best.

mon_an.mo_ta: These apple donuts will make you fall in love; simple ingredients and easy to make, one bite and you'll never forget!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 5g ginger powder, 3g cinnamon powder, 3g nutmeg powder
cac_buoc: Here are the ingredients you need to prepare for these delicious apple donuts!
Step 1:
First, prepare a large bowl and add cinnamon powder, ginger powder, nutmeg powder, 2 egg yolks, and the beer.
Step 2:
Use a whisk to beat the mixture until smooth.
Cover the bowl with a towel and let the batter rest for 30 minutes.
Step 3:
While the batter rests, wash the apples thoroughly and peel them.
Step 4:
Once peeled, lay the apples sideways and slice them into rounds about 1-1.5cm thick. Remember to remove the seeds. Then, pat the apple slices dry.
Step 5:
In a small bowl, beat the egg whites (separated in step 1) until stiff peaks form, then gently fold them into the batter from step 2.
Step 6:
In a deep pan, heat vegetable oil. Dip the apple slices into the batter, then fry until golden brown.
Step 7:
Fry all the apple slices in batches, then place them on a rack to drain the oil.
Step 8:
Finally, mix the powdered sugar with cinnamon powder and sprinkle over the apple donuts.
These apple donuts would go perfectly with tea!
Fragrant fried apple donuts with a cinnamon coating—you'll remember this taste forever!
Easy to make and extremely delicious, let's try it now!!

mon_an.ten: German Apple Strudel with Sugar Glaze
mon_an.mo_ta: This German-style sugar-glazed apple cake will enchant you from the first bite; the crust and filling blend perfectly and are irresistibly delicious. Check out the recipe below! German Apple Strudel with Sugar Glaze. You'll find a simple and detailed recipe to create a delicious apple treat with a premium sugar coating. Enjoy traditional German flavors right at home with this wonderful apple cake.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Ready-made pastry sheets, room temperature - 2 sheets
Walnuts - 120g (can substitute with hazelnuts or almonds)
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, peel the apples and cut them into small cubes (as shown).
Step 2:
Prepare a large bowl and add all the chopped apples, then add flour, cinnamon powder, and sugar.
Step 3:
Use a spoon to mix the ingredients well and let it sit for 20 minutes so the apples can release their juices.
Step 4:
While waiting for the apples, finely chop or mince the walnuts.
If you don't have walnuts, you can substitute with hazelnuts, almonds, cashews, etc., for a new, delicious, and unique flavor.
Step 5:
In another bowl, add the chopped walnuts, white sugar, brown sugar, and breadcrumbs. Mix well with a spoon.
Step 6:
Roll out each pastry sheet to a size of 25 x 30 cm. Don't roll it too thin or it will tear when wrapping, but don't leave it too thick or it won't be crispy.
Step 7:
After rolling the pastry, spread half of the walnut mixture from step 5 and half of the seasoned apple mixture from step 3 onto the sheet.
Step 8:
Gently lift one side of the pastry and begin to roll it up.
Step 9:
Roll until the end and seal both ends tightly so the filling doesn't fall out.
Step 10:
Repeat the process with the remaining pastry sheet and the rest of the walnut and apple mixture.
Place both rolls on a baking tray lined with parchment paper.
Step 11:
Beat the egg in a small bowl with 5ml water.
Brush the egg wash over the surface of the two rolls so they turn a beautiful golden color when baked.
Step 12:
Use a knife to make light scores on the dough to allow steam to escape easily during baking.
Step 13:
Preheat the oven to 190°C and bake for 40-45 minutes.
Once baked, remove and sprinkle a little sugar on top for decoration and extra flavor!
Finished product requirements:
The cake should have a glossy, beautiful golden-brown color from the egg wash, without being burnt.
The crust should be crispy and appropriately thin.
The filling should have the delicious taste of apples and the sweetness of sugar, perfectly blended.
The perfect combination of the pastry crust and the sweet apple filling will make you fall in love with this wonderful apple cake!
This sugar-glazed apple cake served with a scoop of cool, sweet vanilla ice cream is absolutely heavenly!
Tips for making delicious German Apple Strudel:
Choose the right apples: Choose sweet, crunchy apples that aren't overripe. Varieties like Granny Smith or Honeycrisp are usually good choices.
Prepare all ingredients: Read the recipe carefully and ensure you have all necessary components before starting. Measure accurately for the right proportions.
Handle the pastry carefully: Peel the apples carefully and remove seeds. Ensure the pastry doesn't tear to maintain a beautiful shape.
Coat with sugar properly: When applying sugar to the surface, do it evenly and thoroughly. Ensure every piece of apple is well-coated.
Bake for the right time: Monitor the baking process to ensure the cake bakes evenly without burning. Baking time is usually 25-30 minutes, depending on the apples and thickness.
Enjoy warm: Once the German Apple Strudel is done, enjoy it warm straight from the oven. It tastes best when served warm.

mon_an.mo_ta: If you're a pizza lover but afraid of weight gain, this low-carb pizza recipe is the solution—eat as much as you want without worrying about getting fat!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Wash the cauliflower, cut into small pieces, and blend until it looks like small grains of rice (blend in 2-3 batches to avoid damaging the blender and to ensure a fine texture).
Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Step 2:
Place the blended cauliflower in a glass bowl and microwave for 4–5 minutes. Let it cool for another 5 minutes. Once completely cooled, place it in a thin cloth and squeeze out all the water.
Step 3:
Mix the cauliflower with the egg, garlic, cheese, and seasonings.
Step 4:
Spread the cauliflower mixture onto parchment paper to form the pizza crust.
Step 5:
Bake the cauliflower crust for 10-15 minutes until golden and crispy.
Step 6:
Once the crust is golden, remove it and add your favorite toppings. In this recipe, we use marinara sauce and various cheeses for a simple, easy-to-eat Margherita pizza.
Step 7:
After adding toppings, bake the pizza for 2-5 minutes until the cheese is melted.
For those on a low-carb diet, this dish is absolutely fantastic!
This cheese topping recipe is the simplest and easiest; you can add some Tabasco sauce if you like!
Or sprinkle some basil leaves for an authentic pizza flavor!
You can also add cherry tomatoes for some fresh produce...

mon_an.mo_ta: Instead of the usual sweet sponge cake, try this delicious savory version; you'll surely love this flavor. Let's learn how to make it!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Savory filling - 1 finely chopped Chinese sausage (lap xuong)
Optional other fillings: bacon, salted egg yolks...
cac_buoc: Ingredients needed:
Step 1: Preheat the oven to 165°C. Sift the all-purpose flour and cornstarch.

Step 2: Separate the egg whites and yolks. Beat the egg whites with sugar until bubbly, add a splash of vinegar, and continue beating until fine bubbles form, then slowly add sugar and beat until stiff peaks form.
Step 3: Add the yolks and beat with the whites for about 10 seconds. Sift the flour into the egg mixture and fold gently from bottom to top.
Step 4: Add the milk and oil mixture and mix well.
Step 5: Sauté the filling ingredients in a pan until cooked.
Step 6: Divide the batter into cupcake molds and sprinkle the savory filling on top.
Step 7: Bake for 15-20 minutes or until cooked; check by inserting a toothpick—if it comes out clean, it's done.
Enjoy your savory sponge cake with your family!

mon_an.mo_ta: This transparent raindrop mochi can only hold its shape for 30 minutes at room temperature. Therefore, you should enjoy it immediately at the shop rather than taking it home. So, let's make it ourselves to enjoy right away instead of traveling all the way to Japan. Let's learn how to make this dish!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Granulated Sugar - fine refined sugar used for fluffy cakes and cookies that require a uniform batter and high fat content
cac_buoc: Step 1: Pour 12g granulated sugar and 15g jelly powder (Agar) into a pot and mix them well.
Step 2: Slowly add 500cc of clear water while stirring the mixture. Note: Repeat several times as Agar powder is difficult to dissolve.
Step 3: Heat the mixture until the Agar powder is completely dissolved, then let it cool completely.
Step 4: Pour the solution into molds and refrigerate for about 3 hours.
Step 5: Finally, remove the Mizu Shingen Mochi from the molds and decorate with brown sugar syrup (Kuromitsu) and Kinako soybean powder.

mon_an.mo_ta: Custard-filled Papparoti with the richness of butter and milk and the signature aroma of coffee will make you fall in love from the very first bite.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Dough - 100g fresh milk; 3g white vinegar; 20g water; 5g yeast; 40g unsalted butter; 35g sugar; a pinch of salt; 1 egg (55-60g including shell); 260g all-purpose flour.
Topping - 10g unsweetened fresh milk; 4g instant coffee; 30g unsalted butter; 25g sugar; a pinch of salt; ½ egg (25g); 35g all-purpose flour.
Filling - (double or triple the filling for the above amount of buns): 1 egg yolk; 15g sugar; 10g cornstarch; 100g fresh milk; 10g unsalted butter; ½ tsp vanilla extract; a pinch of salt.
cac_buoc: Ingredients needed: Step 1: Sift the flour with a pinch of salt. Mix the vinegar into 60g of fresh milk and let sit for 10 minutes. Dissolve the yeast in 20g water and 5g sugar, let it sit until it foams up. Step 2: In a large bowl, cream the butter with sugar, then add the egg, remaining milk, milk-vinegar mixture, and yeast. Step 3: Gradually add the flour and knead into a smooth, elastic dough. Knead for 20-30 minutes (if by hand) until smooth; if the dough is sticky, add a little dusting flour but not too much. Step 4: Cover with plastic wrap and proof in a warm, draft-free place for about 1 hour until doubled in size. When pressed, the dough should not spring back. Step 5: While waiting for the dough, make the filling: Whisk the egg yolk with sugar, cornstarch, and salt, then add the milk. Stir over low heat until the mixture thickens. Add butter and vanilla, stir until the butter melts, then turn off the heat and let cool. You can refrigerate the filling to make it easier to shape. Step 6: Make the topping: - Dissolve the coffee in warm milk. - Cream the butter with sugar, add the egg, then add the flour and coffee mixture. Put the topping in a piping bag and refrigerate. - Deflate the proofed dough and divide into equal portions.
Roll into balls, flatten, pipe the custard filling into the center, and seal the buns. You can shape them into rounds or ovals as desired.
Place the buns on a tray lined with parchment paper and let them rest for another 20 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 170°C. Pipe the topping over the surface of the buns. Place in the oven; during baking, the topping will melt and cover the buns.
Step 7: Bake for 15-20 minutes until cooked and the topping is crispy. Watch carefully so the surface doesn't burn. Good luck with your soft and fragrant custard-filled Papparoti!

mon_an.mo_ta: This two-tone jelly made from pandan leaves and milk is both fragrant and delicious, a favorite for everyone. It's a perfect treat to impress your guests.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the pandan leaves and cut them into small pieces.
Step 2: Place the leaves in a blender, blend until fine, and mix with about 200ml of filtered water.
Step 3: Strain out the leaf pulp and keep the extract to make the jelly.
Step 4: Mix the extract with jelly powder, sugar, and about 200ml of water. Dissolve the mixture and let it sit for 15 minutes to allow the powder to bloom.
Step 5: Place the pot on the stove over low heat and stir constantly until the powder and sugar are completely dissolved.
Step 6: For the white jelly layer, dissolve the sugar with fresh milk and jelly powder. Let it sit for 15 minutes, then cook while stirring constantly.

Step 7: Once both mixtures are cooked, pour a portion of the white jelly into cups or small bowls. Wait a few minutes for the jelly to set slightly, then pour the green jelly layer on top. Continue alternating layers until you reach your desired number of layers.
Step 8: Once the jelly has cooled completely, refrigerate the cups for 2-3 hours before serving.

mon_an.mo_ta: Crispy chocolate chip cookies are an easy-to-make snack for kids' afternoon treats. These cookies have a balanced sweetness, a rich buttery aroma, and occasional hints of bitter chocolate chips.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
To prepare the crispy chocolate chip cookies, preheat your oven to 180°C.
Whisk together the baking powder, flour, and salt, then sift the mixture until smooth.

Soften the butter at room temperature or warm it slightly until melted. Use a hand mixer to beat the butter until pale and creamy, then add the brown sugar and beat for a moment. Gradually sift in the flour mixture and add the chocolate chips, mixing well with a spatula.
Step 2:
Use a whisk to beat the egg until well combined.
Pour the egg into the mixture from step 1 and mix well. Cover the bowl tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 15-20 minutes.
Step 3: Remove the dough from the refrigerator and roll it out to a thickness of 7mm. Use a cookie cutter to cut into individual cookies.

Step 4: Line a baking tray with parchment paper, place the cookies on top, and put them in the oven. Bake for about 15 minutes. Once removed from the oven, sprinkle some powdered sugar over the cookies.
You can store the crispy chocolate chip cookies in an airtight container for later use.

mon_an.mo_ta: A smooth and enticing cupcake with a light cream filling and fresh strawberries—simply wonderful!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
To make the cake, preheat your oven to 165°C. Place the egg yolks and 20g of sugar in a large bowl. Whisk until the mixture is pale yellow and slightly thickened.
Step 2:
Add the cornstarch and fresh milk, then continue to whisk well.
Step 3:
Sift the flour into the egg and milk mixture.
Step 4:
Place the egg whites in another bowl and whisk until stiff peaks form (the peaks should hold their shape when the whisk is lifted).
Step 5:

Gently fold 1/3 of the egg whites into the yolk mixture. Pour this mixture back into the remaining egg whites and fold with a spatula until completely smooth. Spoon the batter into the molds until about 2/3 full.
Bake the cakes for about 20 minutes until they have puffed up. Let the cakes cool completely.
Step 6:
Whip the cream with the powdered sugar. Transfer to a piping bag and inject the cream into the center of each cake.
Finally, decorate with chopped strawberries and a dusting of powdered sugar!
These cupcakes are soft, airy, and filled with a smooth, silky cream! They look absolutely mouth-watering!

mon_an.ten: Taco Cupcakes – Have You Tried Them?
mon_an.mo_ta: Taco cupcakes are a unique dish that will leave a lasting impression from the very first bite. They entice diners with their unusual appearance, featuring two layers of crispy shells wrapping a savory meat filling blended with cheese and taco flavors. Everything comes together to give you a wonderful sensation. Don't hesitate any longer—let's get into the kitchen and learn how to make this delicious treat!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 1 can Old El Paso refried beans
Sour cream, diced tomatoes, cilantro, onions - for serving
cac_buoc: Steps to make delicious taco cupcakes:
Step 1: Preheat your oven to 190°C.
Next, grease 18 cupcake molds with cooking oil.

Step 2: Brown the ground beef in a pan to render the fat, then add the taco seasoning and the amount of water specified on the packet. Simmer over low heat for 4-5 minutes until the beef is cooked through. Turn off the heat and set aside.
Step 3: Place one wonton wrapper into the bottom of each cupcake mold (muffin cup).
Next, add a spoonful of Old El Paso refried beans onto the wonton wrapper.
Place a fried tortilla round on top.
For the next layer, add 1 tbsp of the cooked beef and 1 tbsp of shredded cheese.
Place another wonton wrapper on top and repeat the layers as above to create a 2-tier taco cupcake.
Step 4: Once the cupcakes are assembled, bake for 15-18 minutes until the taco cupcakes are cooked through or the shells turn golden brown.
Finally, remove the cupcakes from the oven and top with your favorite ingredients such as sour cream, tomatoes, onions, cilantro, etc., and enjoy.
Tips for perfect Taco Cupcakes:
If you don't want to use wonton wrappers, you can make your own outer shell using flour, water, and baking powder.
If you love cheese, you can place an extra piece of cheese on top of the cupcakes 10 minutes before taking them out so it melts into the taco cupcake.
How to choose good beef:
Identification:
Good beef is usually bright red with fine fibers, a characteristic beefy aroma, and pale yellow fat.
Dark red meat with deep yellow fat and coarse fibers is old beef, which will be very tough.
Dark red meat with white fat and a slightly fishy, non-beefy smell is buffalo meat.

Meat with parasites is easy to spot as they look like grains of rice embedded in the muscle fibers; they pop out easily with the tip of a knife, unlike small white tendons which are tough and firmly attached.
How to remove beef odors:

To remove the odor from beef, simply take a piece of ginger, grill it until cooked, scrape off the burnt skin, crush it, and rub it over the beef. Rinse with clean water afterward to ensure the smell is gone.

To tenderize beef, add a little salt while cooking. For sinewy beef, shanks, or ribs, to speed up the process without long stewing, add a piece of pineapple, an ice cube, or an aluminum spoon to the pot.
To buy the best beef:

You should buy fresh beef and avoid dark red pieces. Beef fat should be yellow and firm, not soft. Choose fine-grained, soft meat rather than coarse fibers. When buying, press your fingertip into the meat; it should not be sticky and should have no unusual odors.

mon_an.ten: Unique and Delicious Steamed Egg Cupcakes
mon_an.mo_ta: Steamed eggs are no longer a
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Green onions, bell peppers, fresh mushrooms
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, wash the bacon, bell peppers, green onions, and mushrooms, then dice them finely.
Next, shred the cheese.
Step 2:
Prepare the cupcake molds and grease them with a thin layer of oil so the eggs don't stick.
Step 3:
Next, place the prepared ingredients from Step 1 into the molds. Ensure each cupcake has a good mix of all ingredients!
Step 4:
Crack the eggs into a bowl, add a little salt and black pepper, and whisk until well combined. Pour the egg mixture into each cupcake mold.
A small note: do not fill the molds to the brim; leave some space for the ingredients to expand as they cook.
Step 5:
Now that the preparation is done, simply bake in the oven for 15 - 20 minutes and enjoy.
It's that simple!
If you don't want the surface of the eggs to brown, use a water bath method (place a tray of water beneath the baking mold)!
And here is the final product of the vegetable steamed egg cupcakes:
You can enjoy these on their own or serve them with rice!
strange dish to us, but making steamed eggs in cupcake molds is truly unique, isn't it!

mon_an.mo_ta: With easy-to-find ingredients and simple steps, you can completely make yourself these delicious ham pizzas!
cac_buoc: Prepare your ingredients.

Step 1: Place the crust ingredients (except butter) into a bowl and knead into a pliable dough, then add the butter and continue kneading until the butter is fully incorporated. Shape the dough into a ball, place it in a bowl, cover tightly, and let it proof until doubled in size.
Step 2: Once the dough has doubled, take it out and press to release air bubbles. Divide into 2 pieces for medium pizzas, or you can make 1 large pizza.

Step 3: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Roll the dough out thinly into a circle, then use a fork to lightly prick the surface. Brush a thin layer of cooking oil over the dough and bake for 15 minutes. When the crust is lightly golden, remove it from the oven.

Step 4: Spread a layer of ketchup over the surface, staying away from the edges. Sprinkle a thin layer of shredded cheese, then arrange sausage slices around the border. Evenly distribute the ham and cold cuts in the center, and finish with another layer of cheese on top.
Step 5: Place the pizza back in the oven and bake until it reaches a beautiful golden color and smells fragrant.
Drizzle mayonnaise evenly over the top, then sprinkle with sesame seeds and shredded seaweed. Place on a cutting board and cut into 8 triangles.
Enjoy your delicious homemade sausage and ham pizza!

mon_an.mo_ta: What could be better than enjoying delicious, refreshing Pandan Bánh Trôi Tàu in the summer heat! Check out our recipe for Pandan Bánh Trôi Tàu in the article below.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Black sesame, peanuts, coconut - As needed
cac_buoc: Ingredients you need to prepare for Pandan Bánh Trôi Tàu!
Step 1:
Wash the mung beans, soak in water for about 3-4 hours, then set aside.
Step 2:
Wash the pandan leaves and blend thoroughly with a little water.
Step 3:
Filter to get the pandan juice and discard the pulp.
Mix the fresh milk with the pandan juice.
The milk will make the dough soft; the crust can stay soft for 1-2 days without hardening!
Step 4:
Slowly pour the milk and pandan mixture into the flour, stirring constantly with a large wooden spoon until the dough is smooth, pliable, and no longer sticks to your hands.
Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and let it rest for 30 minutes.
Step 5:
After that, pour enough water to cover the beans and cook on the stove until soft.
Pour the mung beans into a pan, stir well, add sugar, and stir-fry until the beans are completely dry. Finally, add the shredded coconut.
Step 6:
Use your hands to roll the beans into small round balls to make the mung bean filling.
