Step 7:
Roast the black sesame seeds and peanuts until fragrant, then crush them finely.
Step 8:
Mix the crushed sesame and peanuts with shredded coconut and sugar to taste. Add a little warm water to make the mixture thick and pasty.
Step 9:
Roll this mixture into round balls similar to the mung bean balls to make the second type of filling: black sesame.
Step 10:
After resting, divide the dough into small portions, roll into balls, and flatten them.
Step 11:
Place a mung bean or black sesame filling ball in the center, wrap it up, and roll it smooth.
Step 12:
Bring a pot of water to a boil. Drop the rice balls in and cook until they float to the surface, indicating they are done.
Then, remove the balls and drop them into a bowl of cold water.
Step 13:
Boil 500ml of water with brown sugar and ginger, cooking until the sugar dissolves.
Drop each rice ball into the syrup, simmer on low heat so they absorb the flavor, then turn off the heat.
Serve the rice balls in a bowl and enjoy!
It looks so attractive, doesn't it!
This version of Bánh Trôi has a unique green color and a fragrant pandan aroma!
This beautiful green color is completely natural!
Show off your skills and enjoy, everyone!

mon_an.mo_ta: Each tangy, refreshing, delicious, and creamy slice of cake will give you a completely new but wonderful flavor experience! Let's start making this lemon cheesecake!
cac_buoc: Ingredients you need to prepare to make lemon cheesecake!
Step 1:
First, place the finely crushed biscuits into a large bowl and mix well with the sugar.
Step 2:

Place the butter in a bowl and microwave to melt. Place a paper towel over the bowl and microwave for 10 seconds. After 10 seconds, take the butter out, stir to continue melting, then microwave for another 10 seconds. Repeat until the butter is completely melted, using a fresh paper towel each time.
Once the butter is melted, slowly pour it into the biscuits and mix well.
Step 3:
Prepare a cake tin, then add the biscuit mixture and press down firmly to form a base layer.
Step 4:
Whip the cream in a large bowl until stiff peaks form. In another bowl, beat the cream cheese and powdered sugar until the mixture is thick and smooth.
Add 1/2 of the whipped cream and fold until the mixture is well combined.
Step 5:
Spread this mixture over the biscuit base in the mold. That's the first cream layer finished!
Step 6:
In a large bowl, mix the sweetened condensed milk, lemon juice, and a little finely grated lemon zest (if desired) until the mixture thickens.
Step 7:
Pour this mixture over the first cream layer and spread evenly. Finally, spread the remaining whipped cream on the very top.
Remember to store the cake in the refrigerator for about 2 hours before serving!
Sprinkle a little more lemon zest on top for decoration!
Each tangy, refreshing, and creamy slice will surely make you fall in love!
Using some colorful fruit for decoration will look very beautiful!

mon_an.mo_ta: Add this sweet and attractive chocolate cheesecake recipe to your collection; anyone who tries it will be mesmerized by its wonderful flavor!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 400ml sour cream (can substitute with unsweetened yogurt)
cac_buoc: Step 1:

First, preheat your oven to 165°C. Prepare a rectangular mold, line it with parchment paper, and brush cooking oil evenly over the paper. This oil layer will help you remove the cake easily after baking!
Step 2:
Grind the biscuits until very fine and place them in the mold. Press down firmly to create an even, compact base.
Step 3:
Mix the cream cheese and sour cream together, stirring until very smooth. Then add the cocoa powder, corn syrup, sugar, vanilla, and eggs, beating until the mixture is smooth again.
Step 4:
Slowly pour the mixture into the mold.
Step 5:
Next, sprinkle chocolate chips on top.
Step 6:
Bake the cake for about 35-40 minutes. When finished, let the cake cool in the oven, then refrigerate for 1 hour.
Step 7:
When ready to eat, cut the cheesecake into small squares!
Eating cheesecake this way will be very appealing to guests!
If you want to eat it the classic way, you can still serve it on a plate with other types of cream.
Or you can eat it by hand, which is super convenient!
The chocolate chips will add extra flavor to the cheesecake, making it incredibly attractive.
You can also decorate it with various candies if you like!

mon_an.ten: Delicious Pumpkin Rolls with Red Bean Filling
mon_an.mo_ta: Pumpkin rolls with red bean filling are a nutritious, simple, and easy-to-make snack that tastes just as good as store-bought cakes. Let's learn how to make these delicious pumpkin rolls for the whole family!
cac_buoc: Peel the pumpkin, remove the seeds, wash, and steam until tender.
Once the pumpkin is steamed, mash it finely, removing any fibers if present.
Slowly add the glutinous rice flour to the pumpkin, kneading the mixture to create a smooth, pliable dough.
Wash the red beans, discard any bad ones, then cook (or steam) until the beans are soft.
Drain the beans and place them in a blender; blend until smooth. Add sugar and blend into a slightly thick paste; if it's too thick, you can add a little bean cooking water.
Place the blended bean mixture into a pot and cook over low heat. Stir until the beans reach a suitable dryness. It's ready when the stirring feels heavy and the beans look dry.

Use a rolling pin to roll the pumpkin dough several times to ensure a smooth and pliable mixture. Then roll the dough out thinly into a rectangle. Spread the prepared red bean paste over the pumpkin dough and level it out. Roll the dough up tightly.
Place the roll into a steamer. The steaming time depends on the thickness of your roll. On average, it takes about 20-30 minutes for the cake to cook.
Remove the cake; while it is still warm, roll it through shredded coconut or toasted sesame seeds to coat the outer crust.
Cut the roll into slices about 2-3 cm thick. The cake is chewy, pliable, and very delicious.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Soft and Fragrant Mung Bean Bánh Giầy
mon_an.mo_ta: Soft mung bean bánh giầy is a favorite treat for festivals and family gatherings. Today, let's discover how to make these incredibly soft and fragrant cakes, from the recipe to the preparation process. Prepare your ingredients and let's get started to create these delicious, memorable mung bean cakes. This guide provides a detailed recipe and process for making soft and fragrant mung bean bánh giầy. Discover how to create these delicious and attractive cakes for holidays and family reunions.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Filling: 150g peeled mung beans, 70g sugar, 1 tbsp cooking oil, a splash of water, a pinch of salt.

200g glutinous rice flour, 10g rice flour, a pinch of salt, 50g sugar, 1 tbsp cooking oil, 170ml warm water (50-60°C). - 200g glutinous rice flour, 10g rice flour, a pinch of salt, 50g sugar, 1 tbsp cooking oil, 170ml warm water (50-60°C).
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients

First, wash the mung beans and soak them in warm water for about 30 minutes to soften. Next, place the beans in a steamer and steam for 30 minutes until soft. Then, mash the beans into a smooth paste. You can divide the beans into two parts to create sweet and savory fillings.
Peel and wash the shallots, then slice them thinly. For the green onions, wash and drain them, then finely chop and place in a bowl. Finally, roast the peanuts and crush them.
Step 2: Make the mung bean filling
First, place a pan on the stove and heat it up. Add 25g of mung bean paste and 2 tsp of sugar to the pan, then cook the mixture over low heat for about 10 minutes.

After 10 minutes, add 1 tsp of cooking oil to the pan and continue to stir-fry until the mung beans become smooth, pliable, and well-combined. Once the desired texture is reached, stop the cooking process.

Next, place another pan on the stove and make the savory filling following the same steps as the sweet filling, but season with: ½ tsp seasoning powder, ½ tsp sugar, and ½ tsp MSG. When turning off the heat, sprinkle with a little pepper to make the savory filling more fragrant.
Step 3: Knead the dough

First, pour 400g of glutinous rice flour into a bowl and slowly add 300ml of warm water. While pouring, mix the flour and water together. Once all the water is added, use your hands to knead the dough until it is smooth and elastic. Let the dough rest for 15 minutes.

Next, divide the dough into small portions and roll them into balls. Use your hand to flatten each ball, place the filling in the center, fold the edges, and roll into a ball again. Prepare banana leaves or a plate brushed with oil, arrange the cakes on top, and steam for 7-10 minutes.

Now, place a pan on the stove and add 3 tbsp of cooking oil. Heat the pan and add the shallots, sautéing until golden and fragrant. Next, add the green onions and 1 tbsp fish sauce, 1.5 tbsp sugar, 1/2 tsp MSG, and 1 tsp seasoning powder. Stir well for 2 minutes and taste to ensure a balanced salty flavor. Then, turn off the heat.
Once finished, arrange the bánh giầy on a plate and sprinkle a little mung bean paste on top. You can now enjoy your delicious bánh giầy.
Now, enjoy these fragrant, soft, and nutty mung bean cakes right away.
Wishing you and your family a delicious meal with this soft mung bean bánh giầy recipe!
Which type of flour should be used?

To make delicious bánh giầy, glutinous rice flour is typically used. This flour has a high starch content, giving the cake its characteristic soft and elastic texture. You can easily find glutinous rice flour at specialty cooking stores or grocery stores. Choose fresh, high-quality flour to ensure the final bánh giầy is fragrant and appealing.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Delicious and Attractive Butter Sugar Toast
mon_an.mo_ta: Each slice of bread is brushed with a layer of rich butter and a sweet layer of sugar, providing you with energy for the whole day. It is extremely easy to make and incredibly delicious! Join us to learn how to make this fragrant and attractive butter sugar toast.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Remove the crusts from the bread and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Step 2: Put the milk and butter in a bowl and heat until the butter melts (you can also do this in a pot on the stove).

Step 3: Dip each piece of bread quickly into the butter-milk mixture, then arrange them on a tray lined with foil or parchment paper. Once arranged, sprinkle a layer of sugar over the surface of the bread. Note: Dip the bread quickly; do not leave it in too long or it will become soggy, take longer to crisp up, and won't look as nice.
Step 4: Preheat the oven to 180°C. Place the tray on the middle rack and bake for about 18-20 minutes or longer, until the bread slices are golden brown and crispy.
Wait for the butter sugar toast to cool completely before storing in a jar or plastic bag, tied tightly to keep for later use.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Unique and Delicious Fruit Cream Sandwiches
mon_an.mo_ta: Instead of ordinary sandwiches, try changing the filling to this fresh fruit cream that is both cool and delicious! Let's learn how to make fruit cream sandwiches through the content below!
cac_buoc: These are the ingredients you need to prepare for this wonderful sandwich!

Step 1: Put the cream, sugar, and vanilla in a bowl and use a mixer to whip until stiff peaks form. You can whip the cream by hand if you don't have a mixer. Place the bowl of cream in the refrigerator for 20 minutes.
Step 2: Wash and slice the fruit into bite-sized pieces or slices.
Step 3: Spread a little cream onto a slice of bread. Arrange the fruit around it.
Step 4: Spread another layer of cream over the fruit. Finally, top with another slice of bread to close the sandwich.
Step 5: Use a square mold to press down firmly on the sandwich, while simultaneously cutting off the crusts to finish.
Cut the fruit cream sandwiches into halves or quarters and arrange them on a plate. This is a perfect treat for summer days.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Crispy and Addictive Bánh Nhúng
mon_an.mo_ta: Have you ever made these rosette cookies? They are extremely easy yet super delicious; one bite of the crispy texture will make you want to keep eating! Let's learn how to make crispy bánh nhúng!
cac_buoc: Step 1: First, put the all-purpose flour, rice flour, and sugar into a bowl and mix well.
Step 2: Add the water, coconut milk, and egg, then whisk until well combined. Strain the mixture through a sieve to remove any lumps. Let the batter rest for 20 minutes before frying.
Step 3: Pour plenty of oil into a pot and heat it up. Meanwhile, place the mold into the hot oil to heat it.

Once the mold is hot, lift it and dip it into the batter. Only dip until the batter reaches the rim of the mold; do not let the batter cover the top of the mold, or you won't be able to release the cookie.

After a few seconds, gently shake the mold and the cookie will release itself. When the cookie is golden brown, flip it and fry until both sides are evenly golden. Remove and place on paper towels to drain. Repeat until all ingredients are used.

Note when frying: After releasing a cookie from the mold, dip it back into the batter and continue frying. If you are not frying immediately, keep the mold in the hot oil so it stays hot; the batter will only stick to a hot mold.
The bánh nhúng are fragrant, rich, and incredibly crispy.
Good luck with this crispy bánh nhúng recipe for the whole family to snack on!

mon_an.ten: How to Make Valentine's Day Love Macarons
mon_an.mo_ta: Do you have any plans for Valentine's Day this year? Let's learn how to make Love Angel Macarons to give to the guys! These cute cookies are even more meaningful when handmade! ^^ You can substitute the dark chocolate filling with red bean paste! 😀
cac_buoc: Step 1: Put 30g sugar, egg whites, and 1 drop of food coloring into a large bowl and whisk until stiff and smooth. (Note: use very little coloring to achieve a pastel pink color).
Step 2: Gradually add the almond flour and powdered sugar, then fold together until well combined. (Tip: you can pulse regular granulated sugar in a blender to make powdered sugar quickly).
Step 3: Add a little fresh cream (about 30ml) and mix until the mixture is smooth and thick as shown.
Step 4: Put the mixture into a piping bag and pipe heart shapes onto parchment paper.
Step 5: Bake the macarons at 150°C for about 20 minutes.
Step 6: Put melted white chocolate into a piping bag and pipe wing shapes onto parchment paper. Then, place in the refrigerator until the chocolate hardens.
Step 7: Mix the remaining fresh cream with melted dark chocolate.
Step 8: Spread a bit of the dark chocolate mixture onto one macaron shell as filling, then attach two small wings and top with another macaron shell.
Step 9: Repeat the process with the remaining macarons!
Source: ST

mon_an.ten: Guide to Making Sweet Strawberry Sponge Cake for Valentine's Day
mon_an.mo_ta: Doesn't it look attractive? You can make this for birthdays, parties, or as a gift—it's unique and easy to succeed. With Valentine's Day coming up, what could be better than showing off your skills by making this cake for your loved one? Check out the strawberry sponge cake recipe below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Cooking oil - 50g (corn oil recommended, do not use olive oil)
A pinch of cream of tartar + salt (optional) - Note: keep ingredients at room temperature
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Separate the egg yolks and egg whites into two separate bowls.
Add sugar to the egg yolks. Use a mixer or whisk to beat until the sugar and yolks are smooth and light in color.
At first, you will see the deep yellow color of the eggs and sugar. Once beaten, the color should be pale as shown in the image.
Continue adding water or milk to the yolk mixture. Add a bit of vanilla (liquid vanilla is used here—use whatever type you have). Mix until smooth.
Sift the flour into the bowl and mix on low speed or by hand gently.
Step 2:

Using a mixer, start beating the egg whites on low speed, then gradually increase to medium. When the whites become foamy, pause and add the cream of tartar and a pinch of salt to help the whites reach stiff peaks.
Continue beating the eggs at medium speed. Then beat at the highest speed until the egg whites become glossy and pure white.
When the mixture forms stiff, smooth, and elastic peaks, it is ready.
Step 3:
Fold about 1/3 of the egg whites into the yolk mixture using a whisk or spatula; mix well (don't forget to use the spatula to fold this first portion in).
Then pour the yolk mixture into the remaining egg whites. Use a whisk to fold gently and lightly. Note: do not overmix, as this will cause the mixture to deflate, resulting in a tough, flat cake.
Step 4:

Pour the batter into the cake mold, smooth the surface, and bake in the oven at 160°C for about 40-45 minutes, depending on the oven. Don't forget to check after 30 minutes by inserting a toothpick; if it comes out clean, the cake is done.
Remove the cake from the mold and turn it upside down to cool completely. Use a knife to help release the cake. The cake is very soft, so handle it gently.
Step 5: Make the cream and syrup
Make the rum syrup by boiling a little water and sugar together. Then add the rum and let it cool.
Cut the cake horizontally into two layers.
For the topping cream, put it in a clean bowl and use a mixer starting from the lowest speed and gradually increasing.
Whip the topping until it reaches the desired consistency. To check, lift the whisk; if the cream holds its shape and doesn't slump, it's ready.
Step 6:
Prepare the strawberries. For this style of cake, choosing fresh, large strawberries will look more beautiful.
Cut the strawberries as shown in the image below.
Step 7:
Place the bottom cake layer on a cake board.
Brush a layer of rum syrup onto the cake surface.
Cover with a layer of cream, ensuring it is spread evenly across the surface.
Arrange a layer of strawberries on top like this.
Place the second cake layer on top.
Repeat the process by brushing with rum syrup.
Step 8:
Apply fresh cream to the top surface.
Then cover the sides and smooth the entire surface.
Put fresh cream into a piping bag and choose a nozzle to pipe roses on the surface: 1 in the center and 8 in a circle.
Remove the stems from the strawberries.
Place one strawberry on each cream rose.
Tada! You have completed this sweet cake yourself... Anyone who loves strawberries will be obsessed with this cake.

mon_an.ten: Guide to Making Fragrant Fruit Rum Cake
mon_an.mo_ta: Fruit rum cake is a perfect combination of cake batter, dried fruit, fruit-flavored gummies, and spirits. The method is quite simple but elaborate and time-consuming. However, the resulting flavor is well worth the effort. Let's show off your skills and learn how to make this delicious and attractive fruit rum cake to treat your family!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Dried fruit - kiwi, raisins, or cherries
Tools - tube pan, oven, whisk, plastic container, thin cloth, aluminum foil.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients

First, place the dried fruit and gummies into a plastic container and pour in enough rum to completely submerge them. Seal the container and marinate the fruit for 24 hours at room temperature so they absorb the aroma of the rum.
Next, crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk thoroughly.
Melt the butter in the microwave.
Step 2: Execution steps
First, preheat your oven to 150°C.
Use a brush to coat the tube pan with a layer of butter to prevent sticking.
Next, take a large bowl and add the following: flour, salt, baking soda, and baking powder.

Use a spoon to mix the ingredients thoroughly. Create a well in the center of the flour mixture and pour in the eggs, white sugar, and vegetable oil. Pour slowly into the well so the eggs and other ingredients incorporate into the flour faster.
Next, use a whisk to mix the batter until it is smooth, velvety, and free of lumps, and the sugar is completely dissolved.
Once the batter is smooth, add the rum-soaked fruit and gummies to the bowl and mix well.
Pour the batter into the mold and place it in the preheated oven. Bake for 1 hour or until the cake is a beautiful golden color and fragrant.
When the cake is done, remove it and let it cool completely before taking it out of the mold.
Next, use a small brush to coat the entire surface of the cake with a layer of rum. Spread a piece of plastic wrap on the table, then place a clean, thin cloth on top.
Brush another layer of rum onto the cake, place it on the cloth, and wrap the cake tightly.
Wrap the outside with the plastic wrap, and finally, a layer of aluminum foil.
Place the cake in a plastic container and seal it tightly.
Let the cake age for several hours, occasionally taking it out to brush on another layer of rum.
When serving, arrange the cake beautifully on a plate.
Note:

When baking, pay attention to the time and temperature to suit your specific oven. It also depends on the size of the tube pan. To check if the cake is done, insert a toothpick; if it comes out clean, the cake is ready.

Do not remove the cake from the oven immediately after baking. Let it cool slightly in the oven because the cake has expanded at high heat; if moved to a cold environment too quickly, it may suffer thermal shock and collapse, losing its shape.
Instead of rum, you can substitute with Kirsch or brandy.

mon_an.ten: Guide to Making Delicious Chinese Sausage Steamed Buns
mon_an.mo_ta: A new steamed bun recipe for bun lovers! It's quick and easy with this delicious Chinese sausage filling. Check out the guide on how to make these tasty Chinese sausage steamed buns below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Water dough - 225g all-purpose flour + 37ml shortening + 70ml water + a pinch of salt
Filling - 3 Chinese sausages + 1 daikon radish + Salt, sesame oil
cac_buoc: Step 1:
To make the filling, steam the Chinese sausages for a few minutes.
Step 2:
Peel the daikon radish, grate it finely, then marinate with a little salt for about 15 minutes.
Step 3:
After marinating, squeeze the radish very dry to remove all water.
Step 4:

Place a pan on the stove, add the radish and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes. Add the sausages and stir-fry for another 30 seconds, then turn off the heat. Add 1 tbsp sesame oil and 1/2 tsp pepper, then let the filling cool completely.
Step 5:
To make the fat dough, mix the ingredients together and knead until the mixture looks like the image.
Similarly, mix the water dough ingredients together and knead thoroughly.
Step 6:
Divide the water dough into 10 small pieces, then roll them out into oval shapes. Divide the fat dough into 10 pieces and roll them into balls.
Place one fat dough ball inside a piece of water dough and gently wrap it up.
Roll the wrapped dough out into an oval shape.
Step 7:
To create a spiral pattern, roll the dough up, roll it flat again, and roll it up once more. After rolling, cut it in half horizontally to get 2 pieces of dough.
Roll the cut piece into a circle.
Step 8:
To create a striped pattern, roll the dough as in step 7, but instead of cutting horizontally, cut it vertically as shown and roll into a circle.
Step 9:
Place about 1 tbsp of the sausage filling in the center of the dough. Fold the dough and secure the top.
Step 10:
Deep-fry the buns in a pan of hot oil for 3-4 minutes. When the sides turn deep golden brown, flip and fry for another 3-4 minutes.
After frying, drain the oil well before eating.
This fried bun dish will fascinate you with its high-quality crust!
After frying, the buns will have a very unique pattern!
Eat while hot for the best taste!
The crispy crust paired with the sausage and radish filling is wonderful!

mon_an.ten: Guide to Making Incredibly Tasty Pork Belly Steamed Buns
mon_an.mo_ta: This dish is extremely simple, from the method to the ingredients. You won't spend too much time to have these perfectly fragrant pork belly steamed buns!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Served with: Fresh cilantro, pickles, dipping sauce of choice
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, place the pork belly in the freezer for 1-2 hours, then take it out and slice it thinly.
Step 2:
Add salt, five-spice powder, hoisin sauce, oyster sauce, and honey. Mix well for a few minutes, then add the shallots. Marinate for 3-4 hours or overnight.
Step 3:
Place the bun dough on a surface lightly dusted with flour and knead until completely smooth. Shape the dough into a long log and cut into 10 portions.
Step 4:
Continue kneading each portion for another 1-2 minutes until very smooth, then roll the dough out into a flat shape. Dust with a little flour and fold the dough in half.
Step 5:
Place the buns in a steamer. Turn the heat to high for 2-3 minutes, then turn off the heat and wait for 10 minutes. After 10 minutes, turn the heat back on and steam for another 15 minutes.
Step 6:
Now let's prepare the meat! Brush a little oil on a pan, add the meat, and fry over medium heat until golden brown on both sides.
Now, arrange the meat, buns, and side dishes!
The fried meat with rich sauce is going to be delicious!
Sandwich the meat, cilantro, and some pickles inside the bun for the perfect bite!
It tastes great and the method is quite simple!

mon_an.ten: Guide to Making Soft and Fragrant Egg Custard Steamed Buns
mon_an.mo_ta: With this guide for making soft egg custard buns, you will have a bun that is absolutely wonderful!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Whisk the eggs with sugar and salt until foamy, then pour in the milk and mix well.
Step 2:
Next, mix the above mixture with the flour, and finally add the melted butter and mix again.
Step 3:
Place the egg mixture into a steamer.
Step 4:
Every 5 minutes, open the steamer and use chopsticks to stir the eggs until they are fluffy.
Step 5:
Repeat this process about 4 times until the eggs are light and fluffy.
Step 6:
Divide the egg custard into equal portions and roll them into balls.
Step 7:
Roll the bun dough out thinly, place the filling in the center, and roll into a ball. Then, let them rest for about 30 minutes to allow the dough to rise!
Step 8:
Steam the buns for about 15 minutes.
Hot steamed buns are ready!
The golden, fluffy filling harmonizes with the white bun crust—it looks so good you'll want to eat it immediately!

mon_an.ten: Nutritious Chestnut Butter Cake for Breakfast
mon_an.mo_ta: You can prepare a nutritious and delicious breakfast with this chestnut butter cake. The method is very simple!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Cream the butter until soft, then add the sugar and beat until the mixture is light and pale.
Step 2:
Divide the egg into 2 or 3 parts. Gradually pour into the butter-sugar mixture, whisking well after each addition.
Step 3:
Add the vanilla extract, flour, baking powder, and milk into the bowl one by one.
Step 4:
Fold the chopped chestnuts into the cake batter.
Step 5:
Pour the batter into a rectangular cake mold lined with parchment paper and smooth the surface.
Step 6:
Bake at 170°C for 30-35 minutes.
The chestnut butter cake is now ready!
The rich, buttery flavor of the chestnut cake paired with a cup of bitter tea is a wonderful combination for a relaxing afternoon tea.

mon_an.mo_ta: Coconut caramel sponge cake is a snack that is easy to make with accessible ingredients. This simple method creates a delicious cake with an attractive appearance: the brown of the caramel, the fresh white of the young coconut, and a soft, smooth texture. Let's get into the kitchen and learn how to make this treat for your family!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Small cake molds or as desired - tools
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients for the fresh coconut caramel sponge cake.
Wash the peeled fresh coconut and grate it into shreds. Mix the shredded coconut with a small pinch of salt. Stir well so the salt dissolves and seasons the coconut evenly.
Crack the eggs into a bowl.
Sift the flour once to ensure it is smooth and free of lumps.
Step 2: Steps to make the delicious fresh coconut caramel sponge cake.
First, place a pot on the stove over low heat.
Add 200g of granulated sugar to the pot.
Stir the sugar constantly until it melts completely. When the sugar turns a deep amber color, turn off the heat and pour it into a bowl. You now have the caramel for the cake.
Next, add 100ml of water to dissolve the caramel.
Add 75g of granulated sugar to the bowl of eggs and beat vigorously until the eggs and sugar are light and fluffy. Using an electric mixer will be more convenient and produce a fluffier result.
Add water to a steamer and bring it to a boil.
Meanwhile, prepare the batter:
Mix the flour, baking powder, baking soda, and milk powder together, then pour the prepared caramel water into the flour mixture.
Use a whisk to mix the batter until it is very smooth and free of lumps. Stop once all ingredients are fully incorporated.
Add the caramel batter to the beaten eggs and continue to stir well.
Grease each cake mold with a thin layer of oil to prevent sticking.
Pour the batter into the molds.
Once the water in the steamer is boiling, place the molds inside to steam.
Steam for about 15-25 minutes until the cake is cooked through.
Finally, remove the cakes, sprinkle the shredded coconut on top, and enjoy.
Notes for a perfect fresh coconut caramel sponge cake:
When pouring batter into the molds, do not fill them to the brim to leave room for the cake to rise. Fill them about 2/3 full.
Steaming time may vary depending on the size of your molds. To check if the cake is done, insert a toothpick; if it comes out clean without batter sticking to it, the cake is ready.
This recipe uses both baking soda and baking powder, so be sure to distinguish between them.
Instead of making caramel from scratch, you can melt caramel candies to get a liquid caramel for the batter, which will provide a stronger aroma.
You can also mix some raisins or roasted peanuts into the batter for an interesting texture.

mon_an.mo_ta: Roll cake is familiar to many, but not everyone knows how to make it perfectly. Today, we will share the secret to a delicious roll cake with a soft, spongy, and fresh interior along with an irresistible aroma. Let's get cooking!
cac_buoc: Instructions for making a colorful roll cake.
Step 1: Prepare the ingredients.
Separate the egg yolks and egg whites into two large bowls.
Add the flour and cornstarch to the bowl containing milk and oil. Add the egg yolks and mix thoroughly. Stir well until the mixture is smooth, free of lumps, and elastic without sticking to the bowl.

Add a little lemon juice to the egg whites and use a mixer to beat until frothy. Gradually add the sugar and beat until stiff peaks form. If you don't have a mixer, you can whisk by hand until the mixture is stiff and holds its shape.
Step 2: Assembly and cooking.

Fold 1/3 of the beaten egg whites into the yolk mixture and stir gently. Add another 1/3 and fold from the bottom up; finally, add the remaining 1/3 and continue folding until the mixture is uniform. Mix gently to keep the batter airy and prevent it from deflating or forming bubbles.
Scoop out a small amount of the batter and mix with food coloring as desired. You can make pink for strawberries, orange for carrots, etc.

Transfer the colored batter into a piping bag, snip the tip, and draw your desired patterns on the parchment paper placed in the baking tray. You can draw oranges, strawberries, carrots, apples, or any shape you like.
Preheat the oven to 170°C for 10 minutes. Bake the patterned batter for 3 minutes until slightly set, then remove from the oven.
Pour the remaining plain batter over the patterns and bake for another 25 minutes or until the cake is beautifully golden.
Once baked, remove the cake. After about 5 minutes, roll it up while still warm to set the shape.
Unroll gently, spread whipped cream or jam on the surface, and roll it back up.
To serve, slice the cake into small rounds.
Notes for a delicious roll cake:
The ingredient quantities above are for a 22 cm mold. Adjust the quantities proportionally for larger or smaller cakes.
The colorful patterns depend on your creativity; you can draw flowers, fruits, or cute characters like Santas or trees to make the cake more vibrant.
Remember to grease the mold or parchment paper with a thin layer of oil before pouring the batter to ensure easy removal after baking.

mon_an.mo_ta: Nothing beats treating your family to a homemade roll cake. This cream roll cake recipe will help you create a perfect dessert. Follow these detailed steps to make a soft, smooth sponge cake filled with delicious cream. From making the batter to the filling and the rolling technique, this is a perfect dessert for family and friends.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: For the cream filling: - 300ml whipping cream
cac_buoc: 1. Instructions for a simple cream roll cake.
Step 1:
Before starting, preheat the oven for 10 minutes at 170°C, using both top and bottom heat with the convection fan on.
Sift together the 65g all-purpose flour, 15g cornstarch, and 1/3 tsp baking powder.
Step 2:
Beat 4 egg whites with 1/3 tsp cream of tartar in a bowl. When large bubbles appear, add 80g sugar. Continue beating until stiff peaks form (the tip should be slightly curved).
Step 3:

Add the sifted flour mixture to the bowl with 4 egg yolks. Add 1/3 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp vanilla, 35ml milk, and 35ml oil, then mix well. Using a dedicated mixer will yield better results for a tastier cake.
Fold one ladle of the beaten egg whites into the yolk mixture.
Turn the mixer to the lowest speed and mix briefly.
Then, gently fold the yolk mixture into the remaining egg whites using a spatula, being careful not to deflate the batter.
Step 4:
Spread the batter onto a 23x33 cm tray lined with parchment paper. Tap the tray lightly to release air bubbles for a smoother sponge.

Place the tray on the middle rack and bake for 15-20 minutes. To check for doneness, press lightly on the cake; if it springs back, it is done. Alternatively, use a toothpick; if it comes out clean, the cake is ready.
To remove, place a sheet of parchment paper over the cake, flip it onto a wire rack, and cover with the baking tray until completely cool.
Step 5:
Prepare the cream filling.
Combine 300ml whipping cream and 15g sugar in a bowl. Beat until stiff peaks form.
Step 6:
Place the sponge on parchment paper. Trim the edges to prevent cracking. Flip the cake and roll from the inside.
Spread the cream evenly over the cake and roll it up. Use a ruler to pull the parchment paper tight to shape the roll.
The cream roll cake is finished; slice and enjoy.
2. Cream Roll Cake using Cake Flour (Flour No. 8)
Ingredients:
80g cake flour (flour No. 8)
5 eggs
40ml fresh milk
1/2 lemon
2 vials vanilla powder
100ml whipping cream
40ml cooking oil
90g sugar
1/5 tsp salt
Method:
Mixing the batter:
Separate egg whites and yolks. In the yolk bowl, add 20g sugar and whisk until dissolved.
Add vanilla, 40ml milk, and 40ml oil; whisk until no oil streaks remain. Sift in the flour and whisk until smooth.
In the white bowl, add 1/5 tsp salt (about 1g) and the juice of half a lemon. Beat until frothy.
Gradually add 40g sugar and beat until stiff peaks form.
Gently fold the yolk and white mixtures together until combined. You can use a mixer on low speed to incorporate them.
Baking:
Preheat the oven to 160°C for 20 minutes. Line a tray with parchment paper.
Pour the batter into the tray and spread evenly.
Tap the tray on the counter 2-3 times to pop large air bubbles.
Bake at 160°C for 40 minutes until golden brown.
Turn off the oven and remove the cake. Let it cool for 5-7 minutes.
Place parchment paper on top, flip the cake, and roll it gently while still slightly warm to set the shape, then let cool completely.
Making the cream:
Whip 100ml cream with 30g sugar until stiff.
Rolling:
Once the cake is cool, spread the cream evenly. Carefully roll the cake from one end to the other.
Refrigerate for 2-3 hours to set the shape.
Slice into pieces. The cake should be soft, not too sweet, and delicious with the cold cream.
This cake is a favorite for all ages. Try it now!
Notes:
Use high-quality ingredients for the best results.
Measure accurately.
Whip the cream at medium-low speed to prevent it from breaking.
Roll gently to avoid cracking.
Allow enough time in the fridge to set.
Slice only when fully set and chilled.

mon_an.mo_ta: Cannoli is a traditional Italian pastry. It is not too complicated to make and serves as an excellent dessert after a meal. You can easily make this to treat your family! Let's explore the recipe.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Filling: - 500ml half and half (or heavy cream)
cac_buoc: Step 1:
In a bowl, combine the flour, sugar, and cinnamon. Mix well with a spoon.
Step 2:
Add the egg, vinegar, and water to the flour mixture. Knead until the dough forms a smooth ball that doesn't stick to your hands.
Step 3:
Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Step 4:
Once chilled, remove the dough and roll it out very thin. Roll evenly to a thickness of about 3mm.
Step 5:
Cut the dough into circles with a diameter of 12 cm.
If you don't have a circular cutter, you can use the rim of a glass or a bowl.
Wrap each dough circle around a metal cannoli tube to create the shape.
These tubes can be found at baking supply stores.
Important note: To prevent the dough from opening while frying, dab 1-2 drops of water on the edge to seal it shut.
Step 6:
Heat a generous amount of oil in a pot. Using plenty of oil ensures the shells are crispy and golden brown.
When the oil is hot, place the cannoli tubes into the pot. Fry until the shells are crispy and golden brown, then remove.
Step 7:
Let the shells cool completely before sliding out the metal tubes. If you remove them while hot, the shells may lose their shape.
Now that the shells are ready, let's make the filling.
Step 8:
In a bowl, mix the powdered sugar and cornstarch.
Heat the cream in a double boiler. Once warm, gradually add the sugar and starch mixture, stirring constantly.
Add a cinnamon stick if desired for extra flavor. Cook until the mixture thickens significantly, then turn off the heat.
Step 9:
Wait for the mixture to cool completely, then refrigerate. Once cold, transfer to a piping bag and pipe the filling into the prepared shells.
Step 10:
Finally, dip the two ends into chocolate chips to enhance the flavor.
The cannoli are finished! Dust with a little powdered sugar for an attractive look.
Drizzling some thick chocolate sauce on top makes it even more delicious and visually appealing.
Alternatively, you can dip the ends in chopped almonds.
You can be creative with different flavors, such as adding cocoa powder to the shell dough or different ingredients to the cream filling.

mon_an.mo_ta: These Thai-style dumplings (Chor Muang) are delicious with a taro and scallion filling. The exterior is shaped like colorful roses, making them almost too beautiful to eat. Follow the instructions below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: A bit of cayenne pepper and seasoning powder
cac_buoc: Step 1:
In a pot, combine all shell ingredients: tapioca starch, rice flour, all-purpose flour, vegetable oil, and water. Mix well with a spoon, excluding the food coloring for now.
Place the pot on the stove over medium heat. Stir constantly until the dough is smooth, elastic, and pulls away from the sides of the pot. Turn off the heat and remove.
Step 2:
Prepare a large, flat tray. Dust it with a thin layer of flour. Place the dough on the tray, add a little oil, and knead by hand until the dough is very smooth and pliable.
Step 3:
Divide the dough into equal small portions. Add different food colors to each piece and knead until the color is evenly distributed.
Step 4:
Repeat with the remaining dough and roll them into balls. Using more colors will make your dumplings more vibrant.
Step 5:
For the scallion filling: wash and finely chop the scallions; mince the garlic.
Combine all scallion filling ingredients in a bowl and mix well.
Step 6:
For the taro filling: combine all ingredients in a bowl and mix well.
Divide the filling into equal small portions as shown.
Step 7:
Flatten the dough balls prepared in steps 3 and 4.
Step 8:
Place a portion of scallion or taro filling in the center of the dough and wrap it up.
Step 9:
Roll the dough into a smooth ball, ensuring the filling is completely sealed.
Step 10:

Use specialized tweezers (brass crimpers) to gently pinch the dough to create rose petals. Work in concentric circles until the entire ball is covered. This step requires patience and dexterity to create delicate petals.
Repeat for all remaining dough balls.
Note: You can find these petal-shaping tweezers at craft stores or clay flower supply shops.
Step 11:
Place the dumplings in a steamer. Line the steamer with banana leaves to prevent sticking. Steam until the dough becomes translucent, indicating they are cooked.
The dumplings are beautiful and colorful!
The taro and scallion fillings are fragrant and flavorful.
To make these Thai dumplings even better, serve them with a sweet and sour dipping sauce made from vinegar, sugar, and soy sauce.

mon_an.mo_ta: These baked strawberry treats are visually appealing with a golden crust and bright red strawberries. The interior is soft and moist with a wonderful aroma. Enjoying these with a glass of milk is a perfect choice for breakfast!
cac_buoc: How to make strawberry scones for 3-4 people.
Step 1: Prepare the ingredients.
Cut the unsalted butter into small pieces.
Wash the strawberries, drain well, and cut into small pieces (not too fine).
Crack 1 egg into a bowl and whisk.
Crack the other egg into a separate bowl, add the milk, and whisk together.
Step 2: Cooking steps.
To make the scones, first mix the flour, baking powder, and a pinch of salt.
Add the butter to the flour and use a pastry cutter or fork to incorporate the butter until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Add the strawberries to the flour mixture, then pour in the egg and milk mixture. Mix vigorously until the dough comes together.
Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and pat or roll it into a large circle.
Use a knife to cut the circle into wedges, like a cake.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and place the wedges on it.
Brush the surface of each wedge with the beaten egg and sprinkle with a little sugar for a beautiful golden finish.
Place the tray in a preheated oven. Bake at 200°C for 20-30 minutes or until the scones are beautifully golden brown.
Once baked, let them cool slightly in the oven before serving on a plate.
Notes for delicious strawberry scones:
You can replace strawberries with other fruits like kiwi, but avoid fruits that are too watery.
When rolling the dough, keep it relatively thick so the scones are crispier and hold their shape better.
You can add a small amount of baking soda to make the scones softer and crispier.
Since oven temperatures vary, adjust accordingly. Check for doneness with a toothpick; if it comes out clean, they are ready.

A warm strawberry scone with a cold glass of milk provides a nutritious start to the day. The crispy exterior and tart-sweet strawberries prevent the dish from being too heavy. Children will especially love these fragrant, beautiful treats!

mon_an.mo_ta: Taiwanese pineapple cakes are delicious with a soft, chewy, sweet, and tart filling. They are surprisingly easy to make.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Filling: 1/2 pineapple (approx. 300g); 50g brown sugar or palm sugar (add more if the pineapple is tart); 1 tsp lemon juice; a pinch of salt.
Shell: 140g cake flour; 1/3 tsp baking powder; 115g softened butter; 20g milk powder; 30g powdered sugar; 1/2 egg yolk.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel the pineapple, slice it, and pulse in a blender until slightly crushed.
Strain to remove some of the juice.
Step 2: Place the pineapple in a non-stick pan with the other filling ingredients. Cook over medium heat.
Step 3: Simmer for about 10 minutes, then lower the heat and continue cooking until the filling is thick and no longer sticks to the pan. Stir in a tiny bit of butter and turn off the heat.
Step 4: Scoop small portions of filling (20g each) onto a tray lined with parchment paper. Once cool, roll them into balls.
Step 5: Cream the butter and powdered sugar in a bowl, then stir in the egg yolk.
Finally, add the cake flour, baking powder, and milk powder. Mix well. Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and refrigerate for 40-50 minutes.
Step 6: Divide the dough into 30g portions. Roll into balls, flatten, place a filling ball in the center, and wrap it up.
Press the balls into small molds to shape them. Arrange on a baking tray lined with parchment paper. Note: You can also shape them by hand by simply flattening the balls.
Step 7: Preheat the oven for 10 minutes at 170°C. Bake the cakes for 17-20 minutes. When golden and fragrant, remove from the oven.
Wait for the cakes to cool before storing them in an airtight container. A good pineapple cake has a soft, crumbly crust and a chewy, not hard, filling.

mon_an.mo_ta: Pineapple buns (Bolo Bao) are a very popular snack in Hong Kong. The harmonious blend of flour, eggs, butter, and milk creates an irresistible aroma that will keep you coming back for more.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
To prepare the bread dough, combine all ingredients (except butter) in a large bowl or stand mixer. Mix until smooth. Add the butter and knead until you have a smooth, elastic dough.
Place the dough in a cool place to rest. Let it rise until it has reached 2.5 times its original size.
Step 2:
To make the cookie topping, use a mixer to beat the unsalted butter until smooth and creamy.
Gradually add the sugar, eggs, sifted flour, and milk powder one by one (do not add all at once) and continue beating until smooth.
Place the topping mixture in the refrigerator for 30 minutes.
Step 3:
Take the bread dough out, knead it to release air bubbles, and divide into equal round balls.
Cover them with plastic wrap and let the dough balls rest for another 10-15 minutes.
Divide the chilled topping mixture into the same number of small balls.
Step 4:
Place a topping ball onto a dough ball. Cover with plastic wrap and roll gently on a flat surface so the topping covers the top of the dough smoothly as shown.
Step 5:
Place the buns on a baking tray lined with parchment paper. Use a knife to lightly score a diamond (crosshatch) pattern on the top and brush with egg yolk.
Step 6:
Preheat the oven and bake at 180°C for 15 minutes.
Once baked, transfer to a rack to cool slightly before enjoying.
This bun is a Hong Kong favorite because it is easy to make and features a wonderful buttery, milky aroma.

mon_an.ten: Sweet Pandan Rice Cake with Coconut Milk
mon_an.mo_ta: The flavor of this rice cake (Bánh đúc) combined with fragrant, cool coconut milk is rich but not overly greasy. It's a treat you'll want to eat again and again! Today, we will guide you through making this delicious sweet pandan rice cake.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Combine the rice flour, cornstarch, all-purpose flour, and granulated sugar in a large bowl. Add the filtered water and mix into a smooth, pliable batter.
Step 2: Add the pandan syrup to the batter and mix thoroughly until the batter turns a uniform green.
Step 3: Pour the batter into a mold and let it rest for 15 minutes. Then, place the mold in a steamer and steam for about 30 minutes until the cake is cooked.
Step 4: Once the cake is cooked, let it cool before removing it from the mold. Cut into bite-sized pieces.

Step 5: Add 350ml of warm water to the fresh grated coconut and squeeze to extract the coconut milk. Mix this with 1 tbsp tapioca starch and 1 tbsp sugar. Bring to a boil until the mixture becomes a thick, rich, and sweet coconut sauce.
Roast the peanuts, remove the skins, and crush them into small pieces (quarters or finer as desired).
Arrange the cake pieces on a plate, pour the coconut sauce over them, and sprinkle with roasted peanuts. This sweet cake can be enjoyed warm or cold.
The cake has a beautiful green color, a chewy texture, and a sweet flavor that pairs perfectly with the rich coconut sauce and crunchy roasted peanuts.

mon_an.mo_ta: Chocolate flan is both easy to make and delicious. With simple ingredients and a straightforward method, you can treat your whole family to this dessert. Let's learn how to make it!
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients:
Step 1:
Dissolve the sugar and water in a pot over low heat until the mixture turns a dark amber color, then turn off the heat.
Pour the caramel into each flan mold. Remember not to use a spoon or chopsticks to stir while cooking the caramel.
Step 2:
Place the eggs in a bowl and use a whisk to beat them. Whisk evenly but not too vigorously.
Step 3:
Combine the milk and condensed milk in a pot over low heat. When the milk is hot (but not boiling), add the chocolate and stir until melted, then turn off the heat.
Step 4:
Slowly pour the hot milk mixture into the egg bowl while whisking constantly.
Stir the vanilla into the mixture. Strain the mixture through a sieve before pouring it into the molds containing the caramel.
Place a thin towel in a baking tray and arrange the flan molds on top. Pour boiling water into the tray until it reaches 2/3 of the height of the molds.
Step 5:
Preheat the oven to 150°C for 15 minutes. Place the tray in the oven and bake for 40-45 minutes until the flan is set.
Once cooked, run the tip of a knife around the edge of the flan before inverting it onto a plate.
Following this chocolate flan recipe ensures your cake will be smooth, soft, and as delicious as any bakery version.

mon_an.mo_ta: You can make this refreshing and silky flan pudding yourself to treat your family on a relaxing weekend!
cac_buoc: Prepare these ingredients for this refreshing flan pudding!
Step 1: Soak the gelatine leaves in ice-cold water for about 15 minutes.

Step 2: Combine the milk, heavy cream, condensed milk, sugar, and egg yolks in a pot. Stir well and place over medium heat. Once the milk boils for a few minutes, turn off the heat and skim off any foam.
Step 3: Strain the milk mixture through a sieve, then add the vanilla and the soaked gelatine leaves, stirring until completely dissolved.
Step 4: Combine the sugar and water in a pot over low heat. Watch closely and turn off the heat once the syrup turns brown.
Step 5: Pour the caramel into individual cups, then pour the milk mixture on top. Place the cups in the refrigerator for 4-5 hours before serving.
Invert the flan pudding onto a plate and decorate with a few slices of seasonal fresh fruit. This dish is best served cold.

mon_an.mo_ta: The name 'Chrysanthemum Flower Pastry' sounds very interesting and appealing. Not only perfect for breakfast, but these pastries paired with a cup of afternoon tea are enough to make anyone feel relaxed. Today, let's learn how to make them.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Steamed and sautéed red bean paste - 100g
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Mix the flour with 1 teaspoon of sugar. Dissolve the dry yeast and pour it into the flour bowl. Gradually add water and lard, then mix the dough.
Knead the dough by hand on a kitchen counter. Use the force of both hands to knead and slap the dough until pressing down with a finger leaves a permanent indentation.
Place the dough in a bowl and cover tightly with plastic wrap; let it proof in a draft-free place for 1-2 hours. It is ready when it has doubled in size.
Once proofed, divide the dough and the red bean filling into equal portions.
Step 2:
Roll the dough into circles with thin edges and a slightly thicker center. Flatten the dough, place the red bean filling in the middle, and seal it tightly. Flatten the pastry again.
Step 3:
Use the back of a knife to score the surface of the pastry into petal shapes pointing toward the center (here, the pastry is divided into 12 petals).
Take one petal and twist it 90 degrees so the petal opens up, revealing the red bean filling inside.
Repeat for all petals, making sure to twist them in the same direction, either clockwise or counter-clockwise.
Step 4:
Beat an egg yolk in a bowl. Use a brush to apply a layer of yolk to the center of the flower to mimic the pistil. Sprinkle a few roasted sesame seeds for a lively look.
Preheat the oven to 220°C. Place the pastries on a baking tray and bake for 15-20 minutes.
Step 5:
This pastry is delicious whether served hot or cold!

The Chrysanthemum Flower Pastry has a crispy outer shell surrounding a soft, fragrant, and rich red bean filling. The pastry is visually appealing, mimicking a stylized chrysanthemum. To save time for breakfast, you can prepare the dough the night before and bake it the next morning.

mon_an.mo_ta: Hotteok features a crispy exterior with a cinnamon aroma, and a crunchy, nutty filling with the sweetness of brown sugar. All these elements blend harmoniously to create the unique Hotteok brand. With just a little time in the kitchen, you'll have a wonderful treat! Follow this guide to make Korean Hotteok at home, just like in a Korean restaurant.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Chestnuts, peanuts, almonds, walnuts - mixed nuts
cac_buoc: 1. How to make Hotteok for 3-4 servings
Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Toast the black sesame seeds until fragrant.
Peel and crush the chestnuts, peanuts, almonds, and walnuts.
Heat the milk and let it cool until it is lukewarm.
Step 2: Cooking steps
Proofing the dough
In a large bowl, combine the flour, glutinous rice flour, 2 teaspoons of white sugar, 1 teaspoon of salt, yeast, and the toasted sesame seeds. Mix well so all ingredients are combined.

Next, add the warm milk and 1 teaspoon of oil to the mixture. Stir until the dough is smooth and the ingredients are well incorporated. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and let it proof for 30 minutes.
After 30 minutes, when the dough has risen, use a spoon or your hand to press the dough down to deflate it, then proof for another 10-15 minutes.
The filling

Mix the following: 1 teaspoon of cinnamon powder, the crushed nuts, brown sugar, and a little water to help the filling bind. Stir well with a spoon. (Note: the filling should not be mushy, just slightly bound to make shaping easier).
Once the dough has risen, start shaping the cakes. Rub a little oil or dry flour on your hands or use plastic gloves to prevent sticking.
Take a small portion of dough, flatten it into a large disc, scoop some filling into the center, and pinch it closed into a ball.
Repeat until all dough is used.
Frying the cakes
Heat oil in a pan. Place the dough balls in the pan and use a large spatula to slowly press them flat. Be gentle so the filling doesn't burst out.
Fry until both sides are golden brown, then remove and drain on paper towels. Serve on a plate.
2. Korean Hotteok with Walnuts and Almonds (Method 2)
Ingredients
To make delicious Hotteok, prepare the following:
160g flour
40g glutinous rice flour
2 tsp yeast
150ml fresh milk
Additionally, prepare walnuts, almonds, and toasted white sesame seeds. Use seasonings like salt, brown sugar, white sugar, and oil.
Instructions
Step 1: Mix the dough
In a bowl, combine 160g flour, 40g glutinous rice flour, 2 tsp yeast, 150ml milk, 1/2 tsp salt, and 2 tbsp sugar. Mix until fully combined.
Knead the dough for about 10 minutes until elastic. Place in a container, seal tightly, and proof for about 1 hour.
Step 2: Make the filling
Crush 30g of almonds and walnuts, then place in a bowl. Add 50g brown sugar and 10g toasted sesame seeds; mix well.
Step 3: Shape the cakes
After proofing for 1 hour, take the dough out and use a little oil to prevent sticking. Place a spoonful of filling into a piece of dough and fold it into a ball.
Step 4: Fry the cakes
Heat oil in a pan. Place the cakes in the pan. While frying, use a spatula to flatten the surface. Once one side is golden, flip to fry the other side.
3. Cheese Hotteok
To make Cheese Hotteok, prepare the following:
60g glutinous rice flour
240g bread flour (No. 13)
260ml warm milk, 6g yeast
4g baking powder
30g sugar
4g salt
20ml oil
15ml unsalted butter.
Instructions
Step 1: Mix the milk mixture
In a bowl, combine 260ml warm milk, 6g yeast, 4g baking powder, 30g sugar, 4g salt, 20ml oil, and 15ml unsalted butter. Mix until well combined.
Step 2: Mix the dough

Add 60g glutinous rice flour and 240g bread flour to the milk mixture. Mix until it forms a smooth, elastic dough. Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and place it over a basin of warm water. Let it proof for about 1 hour.
Step 3: Shape and fry
After 1 hour, take the dough out and apply a little oil to the surface. Place a slice of mozzarella cheese in the center of a dough portion and seal it tightly.
Heat oil in a pan. Fry the cakes until both sides are evenly golden. Remove and place on a plate.
Step 4: Finished product
Cheese Hotteok has a golden, crispy, and sweet crust. When eating, you will experience the combination of soft dough and rich, stretchy melted cheese.
Notes for making simple Korean Hotteok
Yeast: Ensure the yeast is properly activated. Check the expiration date and use the correct temperature.
Dough moisture: Adjust the milk and oil to control moisture. If too dry, the cake will be hard. If too wet, it will be sticky and hard to shape.
Proofing time: Ensure proper temperature and conditions for the dough to develop. Follow the timing for the best elasticity.
Filling: Choose suitable fillings and ensure they are sealed tightly to prevent leaking during frying.
Frying: Use medium heat to cook evenly without burning. Flip only when one side is golden.
Enjoying: Hotteok is best eaten hot. Enjoy immediately after frying for the best crispy crust and soft filling.

mon_an.mo_ta: These potato balls are deep-fried until perfectly crunchy. They are incredibly satisfying to bite into. Head to the kitchen now to make this treat for the whole family!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the potatoes, then boil until soft. Remove and let cool.
Step 2: Peel the potatoes, place them in a bowl, and mash until smooth.
Step 3: Add the milk, a pinch of salt, heavy cream, and flour. Mix the ingredients thoroughly.
Step 4: Take small portions of the potato mixture and roll them into balls. Place them on a plate. You can make the balls large or small according to your preference.
Step 5: Roll each potato ball in the frying flour, then dip into the beaten eggs. Finally, roll the ball in breadcrumbs until evenly coated. Repeat until all ingredients are used.

Step 6: Heat oil in a pan. Once the oil is hot, drop the potato balls in to fry. Roll them gently so they brown evenly. When they are golden and crispy, remove and place on a plate lined with paper towels.
Enjoy while still hot for the best taste.
Good luck with this crispy fried potato ball recipe for your family!

mon_an.mo_ta: Simple in both ingredients and method, if you love cooking, you cannot miss this delicious curry-flavored potato korokke.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, pepper, curry powder, cooking oil
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, bring a pot of water to a boil.
While waiting for the water to boil, wash the potatoes, peel them, cut into large chunks, and rinse again.
Step 2:
Once the water is boiling, add the potatoes and boil for 8-10 minutes until soft.
Drain the potatoes in a colander and let them cool completely.
Step 3:
While waiting for the potatoes to cool, finely mince the half onion.
Step 4:
Melt the butter in a pot over medium heat, then sauté the onion for 10 minutes. Stir constantly to ensure the onion cooks evenly without burning.
Once the onion turns brown, turn off the heat and set aside.
Step 5:
Next, place the potatoes in a large bowl and mash them until smooth.
Step 6:
Once mashed, add the sautéed onions, curry powder, salt, and pepper. Mix the mixture well with chopsticks or a spoon.
Step 7:
Now for the shaping. Shape the potato mixture into round, slightly flattened discs. If the mixture is too soft to shape, add a little cornstarch to make it easier.
Repeat with the remaining mixture until finished.
Step 8:
Beat the eggs in a separate bowl. Place the flour and breadcrumbs in separate bowls as well.
First, dredge the potato discs in flour, then dip into the egg, and finally roll in the breadcrumbs.
Remember to work quickly!
Step 9:
Heat oil in a pot. Using a pot saves more oil than a pan, and the cakes will be much better when deep-fried.
When the oil is hot, fry the cakes for 8-10 minutes. Once golden, flip them to ensure even cooking.
When both sides are golden brown, remove the cakes and place them on paper towels to drain excess oil. Continue frying the remaining cakes.
And that's it, we've finished the potato korokke!
Final requirements:
The cakes should be evenly cooked with a beautiful golden-brown color, not burnt.
The exterior should be crispy while the interior is soft and savory, with the aroma of potato and curry.
Enjoy while hot with chili sauce or ketchup for a wonderful experience.
You can also get creative with different shapes like rounds, thin discs, or long sticks to make the dish more diverse.
This potato dish is very easy to make. You can prepare it whenever you have free time, for a weekend family treat, or for gatherings and picnics with friends.

mon_an.mo_ta: As Christmas approaches, gathering with loved ones to enjoy a homemade Yule Log cake is truly sweet and warm. Today, we will guide you through making a Christmas Yule Log cake.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Strawberry, apricot, or plum jam - 1/3 cup (90g)
Corn syrup or honey - as needed
Tools: Wood grain silicone impression mat - as needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Make the sponge cake roll
Place eggs in a bowl and beat with a mixer at high speed for 5 minutes until thick and pale yellow. While beating, gradually add sugar and oil, followed by butter and vanilla.
In another bowl, sift the flour, cocoa, baking powder, and salt. Fold this flour mixture into the egg mixture until just combined.
Pour the batter into a tray and spread evenly with a spatula.
Bake for 12-15 minutes. Remove the cake and place it on a towel dusted with powdered sugar. Sprinkle more sugar on the cake, roll it up, and let it cool.
Step 2: Make the vanilla buttercream
In a stand mixer, cream the butter and powdered sugar. Start at low speed, then increase and beat for 3 minutes.
Add vanilla and mix for another minute. Add 2 tablespoons of heavy cream at a time until the mixture is light and smooth. Transfer the buttercream to a piping bag.
Unroll the cooled cake, spread the jam over it, then pipe the vanilla buttercream on top. Roll the cake back up and wrap it in plastic wrap. Refrigerate for about 1 hour.
Step 3: Make the wood grain chocolate fondant
Knead the chocolate fondant and roll it out on a flat surface. Place the fondant onto the wood grain silicone mat and roll firmly with a rolling pin to emboss the texture onto the fondant.
Step 4: Assemble the cake
Brush the sponge roll with simple syrup, then wrap the embossed fondant around the cake. Trim off any excess fondant. Refrigerate for 1 hour to set. The log cake is now ready.
Step 5: Decoration
Separate the macaron shells into halves.

Brush the macaron shells with corn syrup or honey, then scatter white sprinkles on top to create mushroom spots. Attach the macaron shells to the chocolate meringues to form mushrooms. Let dry for 10 minutes. Use these to decorate the log cake.
Once the log cake has set in the fridge, place it on a plate and decorate with powdered sugar, chocolate twigs, and the macaron mushrooms. Dust with powdered sugar to create a snow effect.
Note: Decorative elements can be purchased ready-made at bakery supply stores or supermarkets.

mon_an.mo_ta: The tart passion fruit filling paired with the sweet crust will surely delight you. Let's look at the instructions for making these passion fruit malasadas originating from Hawaii!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, to make the dough, combine 1 egg, sugar, and butter and beat well.
Step 2:
Next, add the yeast and 1kg of flour (from the total) and beat well.
Step 3:
Slowly pour in the milk and hot water, continuing to beat.
Step 4:
To finish the dough, add the remaining flour and 1 egg, then beat until the mixture is smooth and slightly sticky.
Place the dough in a bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let it rise for about 2 hours.
Step 5:
To make the passion fruit filling, first, strain the passion fruit juice through a sieve.
Step 6:
Combine the sugar, salt, butter, lemon juice, and passion fruit juice in a pot and bring to a simmer.
Step 7:
Place the egg yolks in a bowl, then slowly ladle the hot passion fruit mixture into the eggs, whisking constantly and vigorously.
Step 8:
Whisk until the mixture reaches the consistency shown.
Step 9:
Roll out half of the dough and cut into small squares.
Step 10:
In hot oil, drop the squares in and fry until they puff up and turn golden brown on both sides.
Once cooked, drain the oil and let them cool slightly. Place sugar in a large plastic bag, add the cakes, and shake gently to coat them in sugar.
Step 11:
Place the passion fruit filling in a piping bag. Use a knife to poke a hole in each cake and pipe the filling inside.
These malasadas bring a very characteristic summer flavor!
Malasadas are both sweet and tart; you will surely love every bite!
Make a batch of malasadas now to bring the taste of Hawaiian summer into your home!

mon_an.mo_ta: Breakfast is an essential meal that provides energy for study and work. Therefore, we introduce this delicious, nutritious, and energy-rich baked sausage bread roll recipe that will surely satisfy your family.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 65g sugar; 1/2 cup cake flour; 3 1/2 cups bread flour; 15g dry yeast; 7g salt; 15ml oil; 12 sausages
Egg wash - 1 egg beaten with 5ml water
Simple syrup - 10g sugar dissolved in 10ml hot water
cac_buoc: Step 1: In a mixer bowl, add the heavy cream, milk, egg, sugar, cake flour, bread flour, yeast, and salt (add them one by one). Run the mixer for about 15 minutes, occasionally stopping to scrape down the sides of the bowl with a spatula.
Step 2: After 15 minutes, the dough is ready. Place the dough in a bowl, cover with a damp towel, and leave in a warm place for about 1 hour. The dough should rise to 1.5 times its original size.
Step 3: While waiting for the dough to rise, heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a medium pan and fry the sausages until golden brown. Set aside on a rack to cool.
After 1 hour, return the dough to the mixer and mix for another 5 minutes to remove air bubbles. Place the dough on a floured surface and cut into 12 equal pieces. Preheat the oven to 350°F.

Step 4: Roll each piece of dough into a long rope and wrap it around a sausage. Leave the ends of the sausage exposed. Place the rolls on a tray lined with parchment paper. Space them 5-7cm apart to allow for rising. Repeat with the remaining ingredients.
Step 5: Cover the tray with a towel and let the rolls rest in a warm place for about 1 hour. Then, brush the rolls with egg wash and bake for 14 minutes. Flip the tray once during baking.
Remove from the oven and brush with simple syrup. The bread will be delicious and shiny.

mon_an.mo_ta: Fried meatball banh mi can be enjoyed at any time: for breakfast, a light office lunch, or a dinner when you want a change from rice. This dish is incredibly easy to make and tastes fantastic.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Pickled radish and carrots - 2 carrots, shredded; 1 radish, shredded; 30g sugar; 2.5g salt; 45ml vinegar; 30ml sesame oil
Meatballs - 450g ground pork; 30g chopped cilantro; 1 scallion, minced; 15ml fish sauce; 15g chili sauce; 10g sugar; salt and pepper; 15g cornstarch
Assembly - 15ml oil; 50g mayonnaise; 10g chili sauce; 1 baguette, cut into 4 equal segments; 1 chili, deseeded and sliced; fresh cilantro
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Place the shredded carrots and radish in a bowl and mix well with sugar, vinegar, salt, and sesame oil. Let sit for 1 hour, stirring occasionally.
Step 2:
Place all the meatball ingredients in a bowl.
Step 3:
Mix everything thoroughly.
Step 4:
Shape the meat into round balls (about 20 meatballs).
Step 5:
Place the meatballs on a tray lined with parchment paper and refrigerate for 20 minutes. Once chilled, fry them. Use a non-stick pan to prevent sticking.
Step 6:
Fry the meatballs until cooked through and evenly golden brown, then turn off the heat.
Step 7:
In a small bowl, mix the mayonnaise with the chili sauce.
Step 8:
Finally, slice the baguette pieces open, spread the mayonnaise-chili mixture inside, then add the pickled carrots and radish, fried meatballs, chili, and cilantro. Enjoy!
Notes for making meatball banh mi
Ingredients: Choose fresh, high-quality meat. If possible, use pork tenderloin for a soft and delicious texture.
Slice meat thinly: If using sliced meat, cut it thinly so it cooks quickly and evenly, keeping it tender and preventing it from drying out.
Seasoning: Adjust seasonings like garlic, onion, fish sauce, pepper, or BBQ spices to your personal taste to create a special flavor for the meatballs.
Balance: Ensure a good ratio of meat to bread to maintain a balanced flavor.
Grilling/Frying: Ensure the correct temperature so the meatballs are cooked through, crispy, and not dry. Cook until they have a beautiful golden color.
Garnish: Add fresh greens like lettuce, tomatoes, onions, chilies, and fish sauce to add freshness and flavor to the banh mi.
How to store meatball banh mi
Short-term storage
Banh mi can be stored in the refrigerator for about 1-2 days.
Place the banh mi in a food container or wrap tightly in a plastic bag to prevent it from drying out and to protect it from the environment.
Long-term storage
If you want to store it longer, you can freeze it.
Place the banh mi in a freezer bag or airtight container and put it in the freezer.
When ready to use, let it defrost in the refrigerator or reheat in the microwave for a few minutes.
Proper storage ensures the banh mi stays fresh and high-quality, allowing you to enjoy it over a longer period without losing flavor or moisture.

mon_an.mo_ta: The baguette is a world-famous French bread known to almost everyone. French baguettes always offer a wonderful flavor with a crispy crust and a soft, airy interior. Mothers, try this recipe to make them at home for your family.
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients
Sift the flour until smooth for a better bread texture.
Cooking steps
Step 1: Create a sponge/starter first.
Prepare a large bowl and add the yeast, 1/4 of the flour, and 1 cup of warm water.
Use a whisk to mix the flour and yeast thoroughly. Mix steadily until you get a bubbly sponge.
Next, put the remaining flour and a bit of salt into another large bowl. Use a spoon to mix well.
Pour the sponge you just mixed into the flour bowl and use a whisk to mix until the mixture is uniform.

Next, add the remaining cup of warm water and mix the dough gently until it is smooth, fine, and elastic. (You can test by stretching the dough; it should be stretchy and soft without breaking). Let the dough rest for a few minutes after mixing (about 3-5 minutes).
After the rest period, continue mixing. If the dough feels too dry, add a little water; if it is too wet, add a little more flour.
Continue mixing until the dough no longer sticks to the sides of the bowl; if it still sticks, add a little flour for dusting.

Transfer the dough to a work surface and begin kneading by hand. To prevent sticking, rub a little flour on your palms before kneading. Knead for about 10–15 minutes or until the dough is soft, non-sticky, and uniform.
Once thoroughly kneaded, place the dough in a bowl three times the size of the previous one. Grease the bowl with a thin layer of oil and leave it to proof.
Cover the bowl with a damp towel or plastic wrap and place it in a warm spot. Let the dough proof for about one hour.

After one hour, when the dough has nearly tripled in size, remove the plastic wrap and punch the dough down to its original size, then let it rise for a second time. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and proof in a warm spot.
When the dough has doubled in size, punch it down again and let it rise for a third time. Cover with a damp towel and proof in a warm spot.
Once the dough has doubled in size again, move to the next step.
Step 2: Divide the dough into three or four equal portions.
Take one portion onto the table, use a rolling pin to roll it out thin, and then roll it up. Repeat for the remaining portions.
Sprinkle cornstarch over a baking tray and arrange the prepared dough portions on top.
Next, let the dough rise for the final time. Cover the bread with a damp towel. This final proofing takes about 45 minutes or more depending on the humidity and warmth of your kitchen.
Wait until the dough has doubled in size.
Step 3: Bake the bread
Preheat the oven to 280°C.
Use a sharp knife to score each loaf. Make 3-4 longitudinal slashes along the body of the bread, each about 2.5cm long.
Place the bread in the preheated oven and place a bowl of water under the baking tray, or use a spray bottle to mist the oven to increase humidity.
Bake for the first 10 minutes.
After the first 10 minutes, lower the oven temperature to 180°C and bake for another 20 minutes.
Once the bread is done, remove it from the oven, let it cool, and enjoy.
Notes
When baking, regularly check the time and temperature; if the heat is too high, the bread will dry out, while low heat will make it soggy.

You can create a salty crust by spraying a thin layer of water and sprinkling coarse salt, or brush on a mixture of 1 egg white + 1 tbsp salt + a little warm water (the egg wash method makes the bread more fragrant and gives it an attractive color).
Placing a bowl of water or spraying water around the baking area prevents the bread from drying out, over-expanding (which loses its shape), or cracking the score marks too much.

mon_an.mo_ta: Vegetarian sticky rice cakes are a perfect choice for your meatless days, and they are also convenient for trips and picnics. You can make this for a delicious snack! Today, we will guide you through the process. Please refer to the recipe below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: A little roasted peanuts and toasted black sesame seeds
cac_buoc: Step 1: Place the glutinous rice flour in a bowl, then slowly pour in the hot water while kneading. Knead until the mixture forms a smooth, elastic dough. If the dough is still dry, add a little more water and continue kneading. Do not add too much water at once to avoid making the dough soggy.
Next, roll the dough into small round balls. Use your finger to press gently in the center of each ball to create a small indentation.
Step 2: Bring a pot of water to a boil and add sugar to sweeten the water. Drop the dough balls in and boil until they float to the surface or are fully cooked, then remove them into a bowl.
Step 3: Roast the peanuts in a pan until cooked. Remove, rub off the skins, and crush coarsely. Mix with a little black sesame seeds.
Step 4: Remove the cakes into a bowl and coat them with a little vegetable oil to prevent them from sticking together.
Finally, sprinkle the crushed peanut and sesame mixture over the cakes and enjoy!

mon_an.ten: Delicious Peanut Butter Oreo Cookies Recipe
mon_an.mo_ta: Instead of buying Oreos at the store, you can completely make them at home. With very simple steps, you can treat your family to rich and delicious peanut butter Oreo cookies. Check out the instructions below!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Prepare a microwave-safe bowl, then add the chocolate chips and butter to the bowl.
Step 2:
Place the bowl of chocolate chips and butter in the microwave. Every 30 seconds, take the bowl out and use a whisk to stir the mixture well.
Continue microwaving and stirring until the chocolate and butter mixture is completely melted.
Step 3:
Add the sugar to the mixture and use a whisk to beat until the sugar dissolves.
Step 4:
Once the sugar has dissolved, add the vanilla extract to the bowl.
Step 5:
Add the egg to the bowl and whisk until well combined, then set aside.
Step 6:
In another bowl, combine the flour, cocoa powder, baking soda, and salt. Use a whisk to mix the dry ingredients thoroughly.
Step 7:
Once mixed, pour the entire dry mixture into the liquid mixture from Step 5. Use a mixer to blend until the mixture is smooth and velvety.
Step 8:

Prepare a piece of parchment paper. Place the entire dough mixture onto the paper, use your hands to shape the dough into a long log, then roll the parchment paper up to wrap the dough tightly. (as shown in the image)
Step 9:
Note that when rolling the parchment paper, you must twist the two ends tightly to create a rounded log shape for the dough.
Place the dough log in the refrigerator for about 2 hours or until it is firm.
Step 10:
Preheat the oven to 160°C. Line a baking tray with parchment paper, unwrap the dough, and place it on a cutting board.
Step 11:
Use a sharp knife to slice the dough log into rounds about 0.5 cm thick.
Step 12:
Place the sliced rounds onto the lined baking tray and bake for 12-18 minutes until the cookies are cooked and have reached a certain firmness.
Remove the tray from the oven and let the cookies cool completely.
Step 13:
Next, we will make the cream filling. Place the butter in a bowl and use a mixer to beat until very smooth. Then add the powdered sugar and vanilla extract, continuing to mix until smooth.
Step 14:
Then, add the salt and milk!
Step 15:
Use the mixer to beat until the filling is fluffy and smooth.
Step 16:
Finally, simply spread the fluffy cream filling and the peanut butter onto each cookie round, sandwich them together, and enjoy.
The method is very simple to get a delicious and attractive treat, isn't it!
These Oreo cookies are fragrant with peanut butter and milk, quite different from store-bought ones, with a unique flavor you'll remember forever.
To be more creative, you can customize the filling to your preference, such as strawberry, durian, jackfruit, grape, or pineapple flavors...

mon_an.mo_ta: Danish pastries are extremely crispy, flaky, and fragrant; you will be enchanted by them from the very first bite. Combining these pastries with jam and fruit is simply wonderful.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Filling (optional) - strawberries, fruit jam, almonds, raisins, etc.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, mix the yeast with 60ml of warm water for 3 minutes until the mixture starts to bubble slightly.
Note that the yeast and warm water mixture must bubble; if no bubbles appear, it means the yeast is dead and you must start over.
Next, add the eggs and sugar, then use a whisk or mixer to beat well.
Continue beating the eggs and sugar, then add a bit of salt (about 5g is enough).
Step 2:
Cut the butter into small pieces, then put the butter into a blender along with 100g of the flour.
Blend until the butter and flour mixture is completely smooth!
Note: If you don't have a blender, you can knead by hand, but you must work very quickly so the butter doesn't melt too much.
Step 3:
Mix the butter and flour mixture from above with the mixture prepared in Step 1.
Step 4:
Place the dough on plastic wrap and wrap it up once the mixture is smooth.
Place the dough in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours.
If you are not in a hurry, you should proof the dough longer than 4 hours; you can proof it for up to 3 days for a more even rise.
Step 5:
Once the proofing time is up, take the dough out.
Prepare a large flat surface for rolling and sprinkle a layer of flour over the dough.
Step 6:
Fold 1/3 of the dough from the right into the center, then fold the other side over (like a letter fold).
If the dough feels too soft while kneading, put it back in the fridge for about 30 minutes before continuing; this keeps the dough firm and easier to handle.
Step 7:
Use a rolling pin to roll the dough out, then fold it again, wrap tightly in plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
For the dough to rise evenly and the pastry to be tastier, the ideal time for this second proofing is 1 day!
Step 8:
After the proofing time, take the dough out of the fridge and cut it in half. Put one half back in the fridge.
Step 9:
Use the rolling pin to roll the remaining dough into a rectangle.
