At one end, cut two corners of the dough; at the other end, cut into 2 small triangles (as shown in the image below).
Step 10:
Prepare your favorite filling; here we use strawberry jam.
Spread the filling along the center of the dough piece, then cut the dough around the spread filling.
Fold the cut dough pieces over each other and let the dough rest for about 20 minutes before baking.
After folding, our dough will look like the image!
Step 11:
Preheat the oven to 100°C for 10 minutes before baking.
Before putting the pastries in the oven, brush on a layer of milk and egg wash for a beautiful golden color and fragrance.
Place the pastries in the oven and bake for about 8-10 minutes or until they turn light brown.
Finally, remove the pastries and wait 10 minutes for them to cool before enjoying!
You can drizzle a little milk over the pastries; they will taste even better!
Danish pastry is a popular type of bread in Denmark; bakers there can transform the dough into many different shapes, and you can do the same if you like!
Good luck and enjoy your delicious Danish pastries!

mon_an.ten: Baked Raspberry Pie with Sugar Topping
mon_an.mo_ta: Ripe, juicy fresh raspberries are the ingredient for many delicious dishes like raspberry jam, smoothies, or simply eaten fresh. Additionally, we have an extremely delicious and attractive dish: baked raspberry pie with a sugar topping. This pie is very easy to make and suitable for all ages; furthermore, you can use it as a dessert, a snack, or a birthday cake. Let's get into the kitchen and learn how to make it!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Wash the raspberries and drain them thoroughly.
Preheat the oven to about 165°C.
Next, dissolve the cornstarch in the cup of cold water and stir well until smooth and free of lumps!
Line a round cake tin with a layer of aluminum foil.
Step 2: Execution steps
First, put the raspberries into a pot and pour about 200g of sugar over them.
Place the pot on the stove over low heat. Occasionally stir gently with chopsticks so the raspberries are evenly coated in sugar and to prevent the sugar from sticking to the bottom and burning.
Cook until the fruit juice and sugar melt together and reach a gentle simmer (about 10 minutes).
Next, pour the cornstarch mixture into the pot and stir well. When the raspberry mixture thickens, turn off the heat and let it cool naturally.
Take one pre-made pie crust, place it in the round tin, and bake in the preheated oven for 7-10 minutes.
When the crust is slightly golden, remove it from the oven but do not turn the oven off.
Pour the raspberry filling into the crust.
Next, use the second pie crust to cover the filling and carefully tuck the excess edges inward so the filling is completely sealed.

Use a toothpick to prick a few small holes in the top crust so that steam can escape during baking, preventing the pie from puffing up or breaking. At the same time, sprinkle the remaining sugar over the crust.
Place the pie in the oven at 120°C and bake for 25 minutes.
Once the pie is done, remove it and let it cool slightly before eating.
Remove the pie from the tin, arrange it on a plate, and enjoy.
Notes:
If you cannot find fresh raspberries, you can use frozen ones, though fresh fruit is much better.

If you don't want to use store-bought crusts, you can make your own at home with simple ingredients like flour, baking powder, or baking soda. You can add fresh milk, sugar, and eggs to enhance the flavor of the crust.
If you don't like it too sweet, you can reduce the amount of sugar or skip the step of sprinkling sugar on the crust.
When cooking the raspberries with sugar, always keep the heat at the lowest level to avoid burning the fruit and sugar.

Finished product requirements: The crust is very crispy and fragrant, the filling inside is delicious with a balanced sweet and sour taste. The filling should not be dry and the sweetness should be moderate.

mon_an.mo_ta: Just follow these steps to make fragrant lemon cookies. The tangy lemon flavor and sweet sugar blend perfectly to create an irresistible treat.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Preheat the oven to 180°C. In a large bowl, combine the flour, baking powder, and salt, then mix well.
In another bowl, cream the butter and sugar together, then add the egg yolk, lemon juice, and lemon zest.
Step 2:
Gradually mix the dry ingredients into the wet mixture until it forms a smooth, uniform dough.
Step 3:
Roll the dough into small balls and place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Step 4:
Bake for 20 minutes, or until the cookies are lightly golden brown.
Step 5:
While the cookies are still warm, coat them with a layer of powdered sugar and let them cool. Once completely cooled, dust with another layer of powdered sugar before serving.
The unique tangy flavor of these cookies will surely delight you on hot days!
Tangy lemon cookies with a sweet sugar coating are truly irresistible!
You can use powdered rock sugar to ensure the cookies aren't too sweet!

mon_an.ten: Delicious and Refreshing Three-Color Cassava Cake Recipe
mon_an.mo_ta: This eye-catching three-color cassava cake will be a hit with the whole family, especially children, thanks to its refreshing taste and fragrant cassava aroma. This guide will show you how to make this delicious, cool treat.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Cassava layer - 400g cassava (grate the cassava, blend until smooth, squeeze out excess liquid to get 300g of pulp)
Sweet potato layer - 135g sweet potato, steamed
Pandan layer - 45g all-purpose flour; 10g cornstarch; 15g tapioca starch; 2 large eggs; 125g sugar; 125ml pandan juice (blended from 10 pandan leaves); 180ml coconut milk
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the cassava layer
Grate the cassava, then blend it until smooth. Squeeze out the excess liquid and set aside 300g of the pulp.
Combine the cassava pulp, flour, coconut milk, sugar, and salt. Pour the mixture into a greased round tray and steam for 10 minutes over high heat.
Step 2: Prepare the sweet potato layer

While the cassava layer is steaming, mash the sweet potato and mix it with the remaining ingredients. Set aside. After the cassava layer has steamed for 10 minutes, slowly pour the sweet potato mixture on top and steam for another 15 minutes.
Step 3: Prepare the pandan layer
Place the flour mixture in a bowl and set it over a pan of boiling water, stirring the mixture constantly until it thickens. Turn off the heat.
After the sweet potato layer has steamed for 15 minutes, pour the pandan batter over it and steam for a final 15 minutes. Turn off the heat and let it cool completely before slicing!
This three-color cassava cake is delicious when chilled and very refreshing for the summer!

mon_an.mo_ta: Cinnamon roll scones are a delightful snack, perfect for tea parties. They feature a soft, tender crumb, a melt-in-your-mouth filling with a signature cinnamon aroma, and a delicious glaze that you will love. Enjoying these wonderful scones with a cup of hot tea on a winter afternoon while chatting with friends will make your day much more interesting.
cac_buoc: Preparing the ingredients for the scones
Step 1: First, cut the butter into cubes as shown in the image.
Step 2: Next, mix the dry ingredients together: all-purpose flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Remember to mix well so the ingredients are fully combined.
Then, add 140g of butter and mix well with the dry ingredients until they are thoroughly incorporated.
Step 3: Separate the yolks and whites of the 2 eggs into 2 separate bowls.
Step 4: In the bowl with the egg whites, add 30ml of maple syrup, the pureed pumpkin, and the buttermilk. Mix thoroughly until the ingredients are well combined and the mixture is smooth.
Steps to make the delicious scones
Pour the mixture from step 4 into the mixture from step 2 and mix until the dough thickens, the ingredients are well combined, and the mixture is soft and smooth.

Next, sprinkle a little flour on a flat surface, take the dough out, and flatten it. You can knead the dough for a bit longer to make it soft and elastic before flattening it to make the scones tastier.
Melt the remaining 60g of butter, then add 30ml of maple syrup and the cinnamon powder, and stir well.
Next, pour the mixture over the dough and use a brush to spread it evenly.
Now, roll up the dough. Press gently to flatten it, then cut the dough into triangles as shown in the image.
Add 1 egg yolk to the filling mixture, mix well, and brush it over the surface of the scones so they have a beautiful color when baked.
Next, preheat the oven and bake the scones for about 12-15 minutes, or until the crust is firm and turns a beautiful golden brown.
To make the icing, put the powdered sugar, the remaining maple syrup, and the fresh milk in a bowl and whisk until smooth.
Finally, when the scones are out of the oven, let them cool slightly and drizzle the icing over them.
Plate the scones and enjoy.
Notes for making delicious cinnamon roll scones
Butter will be easier to cut and cube when kept at room temperature, or you can place the butter container in the refrigerator for about 30 minutes to let it firm up.
When baking, set the temperature to 220°C and bake until the scones are golden brown.

Cinnamon roll scones are a delightful snack, perfect for tea parties. They feature a soft, tender crumb, a melt-in-your-mouth filling with a signature cinnamon aroma, and a delicious glaze that you will love. Enjoying these wonderful scones with a cup of hot tea on a winter afternoon while chatting with friends will make your day much more interesting. Just spending a little time in the kitchen will give you a wonderful treat to serve your family, friends, and loved ones!

mon_an.mo_ta: Scones are a classic treat often served at tea parties and make for a wonderful snack. Follow this guide to make these delicious cinnamon roll scones!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, let the butter sit at room temperature after purchasing.
Note: Avoid putting the butter in the freezer; the fridge is fine, but use it one hour after taking it out. Keeping butter at room temperature makes it easier to cut.
Then, cut the butter into cubes as shown in the image.
Step 2:
Next, use a whisk or spoon to mix the dry ingredients together: all-purpose flour + baking powder + baking soda + salt.
Step 3:
Add 140g of butter to the above mixture and mix well.
Mix until the mixture is uniform and smooth.
Step 4:
Next, separate the yolks and whites of the 2 eggs into 2 separate bowls.
In the bowl with the egg whites, add 30ml of maple syrup and the pumpkin puree.
Continue by adding the buttermilk as well!
Step 5:
Then, pour the mixture from step 4 into the mixture from step 3 and mix until the dough thickens.
Step 6:
Now, sprinkle a little flour on a flat surface, take the dough out, and flatten it down.
Step 7:
Melt the remaining 60g of butter, then add 30ml of maple syrup and the cinnamon powder, and stir well.
Next, pour the mixture over the dough and use a brush to spread it evenly so the mixture covers the entire surface.
Step 8:
Now, gently and skillfully roll up the dough!
Step 9:
Press gently to flatten the dough, then cut it into triangles as shown in the image.
Step 10:
Add 1 egg yolk to the filling mixture from step 7, mix well, and brush it over the surface of the scones.
Step 11:
Preheat the oven to 220°C, then bake the scones for 12-15 minutes until the crust is firm and turns golden brown.
Step 12:
To make the icing, put the powdered sugar, the remaining maple syrup, and the fresh milk in a bowl and whisk until smooth.
Step 13:
When the scones are done, remove them from the oven, let them cool for about 10-15 minutes, then drizzle the icing over the surface and enjoy!
Finished product requirements:
The scones should be evenly baked from the inside out, with a crispy, beautiful golden-brown crust.
They should have the pleasant aroma of cinnamon and milk.
This is an indispensable treat for British-style tea parties!
Scones have a light flavor that is not too sweet; they are fragrant with cinnamon and have a crispy crust that makes them taste wonderful!
You can enjoy these for breakfast, as a midday snack, or they are also a great idea for a picnic.

mon_an.mo_ta: These delicious and attractive Sủi Cảo dumplings feature a chewy skin and a rich, savory filling that will surely leave a lasting impression. With just a little time in the kitchen using easy-to-find ingredients and simple steps, you can create a wonderful dish to treat your family and friends.
cac_buoc: How to make Sủi Cảo for 3-4 servings:
Step 1: Prepare the ingredients for Sủi Cảo
Wash the pork, drain well, and mince it.
Remove any wilted or damaged leaves from the cabbage, wash thoroughly, and chop finely.
Soak the shiitake mushrooms until soft, wash them, and chop finely.
Remove any wilted leaves and roots from the scallions, wash, and mince them.
Peel the garlic and ginger, wash them with water, drain, and mince finely.
Step 2: Steps to make Sủi Cảo
First, marinate the meat with soy sauce, salt, rice wine, and pepper, then mix well.
Next, add the mushrooms, cabbage, scallions, garlic, and ginger to the meat bowl and mix well so the ingredients absorb the seasonings.

For the dough, mix the all-purpose flour with a little salt, gradually add water, and mix until the dough is smooth and can be formed into a ball. Continue adding the dumpling flour, mix well, and let the dough rest for about 30 minutes.
Next, divide the dough into small portions for each dumpling, then use a rolling pin to roll the dough out thin.
Then, place a small amount of filling in the center of the wrapper.
Use your hands to fold the two edges together, shaping the dumpling into a half-moon. Repeat until all the filling is used.
Next, place the dumplings in a pot, cover with water, and boil for about 15-20 minutes until cooked.
Once cooked, remove the dumplings, drain, and enjoy while hot.
Notes for delicious Sủi Cảo
Besides boiling, you can also steam or pan-fry the dumplings, depending on your preference.
When removing the dumplings, place them in a bowl of warm water for a moment before taking them out so they don't stick together.
You can replace the pork filling with beef, or add some peeled fresh shrimp or any other filling you like.
When mixing the dough for the wrappers, remember to mix thoroughly so the ingredients are well combined; you should knead the dough well for a tasty, fragrant skin that isn't too tough.
If you don't have time to make the wrappers, you can buy pre-made ones!
You can enjoy Sủi Cảo with soy sauce, sweet and sour fish sauce, chili sauce, or any dipping sauce you prefer!

These delicious and attractive Sủi Cảo dumplings feature a chewy skin and a rich, savory filling that will surely leave a lasting impression. With just a little time in the kitchen using easy-to-find ingredients and simple steps, you can create a wonderful dish to treat your family and friends. Everyone will be very excited about your delicious dish and you will receive countless compliments!

mon_an.mo_ta: You don't need to worry about an oven anymore because this upside-down apple cake is made entirely in a rice cooker. The method is extremely simple—give it a try! Refer to the recipe below for instructions. A delicious and unique dessert. Enjoy this special treat right at home with these detailed steps.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Apple topping - 2 apples, 45g granulated sugar, 15g brown sugar, 15g butter
Cake base - 200g flour, 5g baking powder, 1 egg, 30g powdered sugar, 160ml milk, 10g butter (softened)
cac_buoc: 1. Instructions for making upside-down apple cake in a rice cooker
Step 1:
First, peel the apples, remove the seeds, and slice them into pieces about 5mm thick.
Step 2:

Place the sliced apples in a pan with the sugar, brown sugar, and butter. Cook over medium heat for about 5 minutes, stirring gently occasionally until the sugar dissolves completely and infuses into the apples.
Step 3:

In a large bowl, whisk the egg whites with sugar, then sift in the flour and add the remaining ingredients. Mix gently by hand. We don't need to beat the eggs until fluffy because the cake rises with baking powder, and the fresh milk helps keep the cake from becoming dry and hard.
Step 4:
Pour the syrup from the apples in step 2 into the rice cooker first, then arrange the apple slices in a spiral pattern.
Next, gently pour the mixed batter over the apples so that it just covers the surface.
Step 5:

Press the "Cook" button and bake for about 35 minutes. Open the lid, check if the cake is done with a toothpick, and turn off the cooker. Keep the lid closed and let the cake rest for another 10 minutes to finish.
Enjoy this delicious cake!
2. Making apple cake with an air fryer
Ingredients
1 apple
200g all-purpose flour
5g baking powder
2 eggs
150g sugar
100ml milk and 30g butter.
Instructions

To make the caramel, add 15g butter, 1 tbsp sugar, and 15ml water to a pot. Stir over medium heat until the mixture turns amber, then turn off the heat. Next, clean the apple, remove the seeds and stem, and cut into thin slices.

Line the mold with parchment paper and arrange the apple slices in overlapping layers. Drizzle the caramel evenly over the apples. Next, to mix the batter, put 200g flour, 5g baking powder, 15g butter, 2 eggs, 135g sugar, and 100ml milk into a bowl. Whisk until the mixture is smooth and uniform.

The upside-down apple cake carries the rich aroma of caramel and butter, with crisp and sweet apple slices. When eaten with the soft, nutty, and fluffy cake layer, you'll fall in love after just one bite!
3. Baked Apple Pie
Flour: 500g
Egg: 1
Butter: 10g
Fresh milk: 200ml
Water
Apples: 6
Salt: 1 tsp
White granulated sugar: 1/3 cup
Brown sugar: 1/3 cup
Lemon juice: 2 tsp
Nutmeg powder: ½ tsp
Cinnamon powder: 1 tsp
Cooking oil
Pie mold: 18cm
Steps to make baked apple pie

To make the crust, knead the dough as follows: In a large bowl, place the flour, salt, and fresh milk. Cut the butter into small pieces and add to the bowl, then knead by hand until the ingredients combine into a mass. While kneading, add water bit by bit to the beaten egg in a bowl. Continue kneading until the dough becomes smooth. Ensure you don't add too much water at once as it will make the dough too sticky and hard to knead. During the process, if needed, add a little dry flour if the dough is too wet, but don't add too much or the cake will be dry.
Once kneading is complete, wrap the dough tightly in parchment paper or plastic wrap. Place the dough in the refrigerator for 45-90 minutes until it is firm enough to roll.
Next, roll the dough: Take 2/3 of the dough and spread it on a work surface, then roll it into a circle about 3mm thick.

Gently place the rolled dough into the pie mold, then trim the excess dough to create a neat crust. Continue rolling the remaining 1/3 of the dough into a circle with a diameter equal to the mold size to make the top cover.
Cover the mold with the 1/3 portion of rolled dough, then place the mold in the refrigerator to rest for 30 minutes.

To make the apple filling, follow these steps: Wash the red apples, peel, and dice them into uniform small cubes for a nice appearance. Place the apples in a bowl and add white sugar, brown sugar, lemon juice, nutmeg, cinnamon, and a pinch of salt. Mix well until all ingredients are combined.

To bake the pie, follow these steps: Take the crust out of the refrigerator and place the prepared filling inside, ensuring it doesn't overflow. Brush a layer of oil around the crust to make the surface shiny and vibrant.

Cut the remaining round dough into strips about 0.8-1cm wide to decorate the top. You can arrange them in a lattice pattern or vertical lines. Alternatively, use cookie cutters to create shapes like stars or hearts to replace the lattice.
Place the pie in the oven and bake at 190°C. Monitor the baking process and remove to enjoy once the pie is cooked through.
Notes for making apple cake
Choose the right apples: Select apples that are sweet, crisp, and not too soft. Red apples are usually a good choice for baked pies as they provide good color and flavor.
Prepare the crust: Ensure the crust is thick enough to hold its shape and contain the filling. Consider cutting dough strips for decoration or using cookie cutters for shapes.
Choose the right filling: The filling can be made from chopped apples combined with sugar and spices like nutmeg and cinnamon. Ensure the filling ingredients are well mixed for a balanced flavor.
Manage baking temperature: Bake the apple pie at 190°C until cooked and golden brown. Monitor the process to prevent burning or uneven cooking.
Dough resting time: Let the dough rest in the refrigerator for 45-90 minutes after kneading. This helps the dough become pliable and easy to roll.
Check for doneness: Before removing from the oven, check by inserting a bamboo skewer into the filling. If it goes in easily without much resistance, the pie is done.
Enjoying: Once the baked apple pie is done, let it cool for a few minutes before serving. You can add whipped cream, vanilla ice cream, or caramel sauce to enhance the flavor.

mon_an.ten: Bánh Trôi and Bánh Chay for Cold Food Festival
mon_an.mo_ta: Bánh trôi and bánh chay are familiar snacks for many, especially on afternoons after hard working hours. These cakes feature a chewy, slightly firm skin with mung bean or palm sugar fillings, served with fresh coconut shreds and toasted sesame seeds for a wonderful sensation. Spend a little time in the kitchen and learn how to make this delicious dish!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Ground flour - A mix of glutinous and non-glutinous rice, wet-ground, then hung in a cloth bag to drain
Palm sugar - cut into small square pieces
Condensed milk, fresh coconut, toasted sesame - for serving
Tapioca starch, grapefruit blossom essence, shredded coconut, sugar - ingredients
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the filling

For peeled dry mung beans, soak them in water for 2 hours to soften. After soaking, steam the beans until cooked. Make sure to monitor and steam until the beans are soft and powdery so the filling is tender, delicious, and fragrant.
Step 2:

When the mung beans are cooked, set aside 1/2 to sprinkle over the bánh chay later; mash or blend the remaining part until smooth. If not using a blender, put them in a non-stick pan with some water, and while cooking, use a wooden spoon to mash them. To save time, you should blend them, but for better texture, you can pound them.
Step 3:

After the beans are mashed, place a non-stick pan on the stove and add a tablespoon of condensed milk to sauté with the beans. Once the milk is absorbed, taste for sweetness and add more milk if necessary.
Step 4:
Sauté over low heat. Once the beans and milk are combined, add finely chopped shredded coconut and mix well. Sauté until the coconut, beans, and milk are incorporated but still retain some moisture.
Step 5:

Mix the flour with water and knead until you get a soft, smooth, and elastic dough, similar to bao bun dough. Then, roll the dough into logs and pinch off pieces larger than a thumb for bánh trôi, and pieces twice that size for bánh chay.
Step 6:
After dividing the dough, start shaping. Use your finger to flatten a piece of dough and place a palm sugar cube in the center.
Step 7:
Wrap the dough around the sugar so that the palm sugar is not exposed. Roll it into a ball, and you have finished shaping a bánh trôi.
Step 8:
For bánh chay, roll the mung bean-milk-coconut filling into balls the size of a bánh trôi. Flatten the dough, place the filling in the center, and seal it tightly.
Step 9:
Gently roll the ball in your hands so it is round and the filling isn't exposed. Then press lightly to give the bánh chay a flattened round shape.
Step 10:
Next, boil a large pot of water. Once boiling, drop the bánh trôi in to cook. To know if they are done, wait until they float to the surface. Use a slotted spoon to remove them.
Step 11:

When removing the cakes, prepare a bowl of clean, cool water nearby. Drop the cakes immediately into the cool water to reduce the temperature, helping them hold their shape and preventing them from becoming mushy.
Step 12:
Once cooled, transfer the cakes to a plate, drain any excess water, and sprinkle toasted sesame seeds on the surface of each piece. This makes the plate look more attractive and taste better.
Step 13:
Boil bánh chay similarly to bánh trôi, then remove to bowls, usually 3 pieces per bowl. Use your thumb or a small spoon to press a dimple in the center of each cake, then set aside for the sauce.
Step 14:

How to make the sauce: Dissolve a full tablespoon (soup spoon) of tapioca starch in a large bowl of water, pour into a pot, and stir over the stove. Add enough sugar so the sauce is not too sweet. You can add a bit of ginger to enhance the aroma.
Step 15:

When the starch water boils, turns clear, and begins to thicken, turn off the stove. Pour the cooked starch sauce into the bowls of bánh chay. Sprinkle the reserved steamed mung beans on top. Finally, add toasted sesame seeds and a bit of shredded coconut to complete a delicious and beautiful bowl of bánh chay.

mon_an.mo_ta: Bánh trôi nước is a favorite winter snack for many. Pandan Bánh Trôi Nước brings a familiar Vietnamese flavor with the fragrant scent of young pandan leaves. The chewy skin pairs with a sweet, nutty filling and crunchy young coconut shreds. Everything comes together in a ginger syrup to provide a warm feeling during winter. Get in the kitchen and make this wonderful dish to boost your winter warmth!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Pandan juice - 50 ml or 500g pandan leaves
cac_buoc: Wash the pandan leaves and cut them into segments. Place them in a blender and blend until smooth. Strain to get the pandan extract, pour into a clean bowl, and set aside. If you don't have a blender, you can use a mortar and pestle to crush the leaves and extract the juice, then strain it. The more concentrated the extract, the more beautiful the color of the cakes.

Next, pour the glutinous rice flour into a bowl. Boil a pot of water with the pandan leaves in it. When the pandan water boils, turn off the heat and let it cool slightly until warm. Slowly pour the warm pandan water into the flour and knead by hand until the dough is smooth, soft, and has a beautiful green color.
You can buy mung bean paste at the market or make it yourself using the following method:

Soak the mung beans for 4-5 hours until they expand, then rinse and steam until cooked. Once steamed, put the beans in a blender with some sugar and blend until smooth. Blend until the sugar and beans combine into a thick, smooth mixture. Use a non-stick pan to sauté the blended beans over low heat until they thicken, then pour in coconut milk and continue cooking over low heat. While cooking, remember to stir constantly with a spoon so the beans and coconut milk form a single mass that doesn't stick to the pan, then turn off the heat. Add the shredded young coconut, mix well, and roll into small bite-sized balls so the filling isn't too large or falling out when assembling.

Next, divide the pandan-infused dough into equal small pieces and roll them into balls. Use your hand to flatten each piece, place a mung bean ball in the center, and roll it back into a sphere. Be careful when rolling to prevent the filling from leaking out during cooking. Bring a pot of water to a boil and drop the balls in to cook.

When the balls float to the surface, cook for a few more minutes, then remove them and place them in a bowl of cold water to firm up and prevent them from becoming mushy. After about 1 minute, remove the balls and place them into the pot of ginger-sugar syrup. Bring the syrup back to a boil, and it's finished.
Finally, ladle the bánh trôi nước into small bowls, drizzle with coconut milk, and sprinkle with some toasted sesame seeds and shredded young coconut. You now have a bowl of hot dessert to enjoy.
Notes for making Pandan Bánh Trôi Nước:
When kneading the flour with pandan water, knead thoroughly so the color is even and the dough is well-combined.
Do not pour boiling hot pandan water directly into the flour as it may partially cook the dough, making it difficult to knead.
If you prefer it sweet, you can add more sugar to the filling or increase the sugar in the ginger syrup.
If you don't like it hot, you can enjoy the bánh trôi nước with some ice for a refreshing version.

mon_an.ten: Simple and Delicious Egg Milk Cake
mon_an.mo_ta: This egg milk cake uses familiar ingredients like flour, fresh milk, and baking powder. With a simple method, it produces wonderful treats. Once baked, the cakes have a crispy outer shell and an eye-catching color, with a fragrant aroma that never gets boring. This cake is perfect for home parties, outdoor picnics, or simply as a treat for the family after hard work. Let's learn how to make these delicious cakes!
cac_buoc: 1. Instructions for making simple and delicious egg milk cake
Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Crack the egg into a bowl and beat well.
Place the butter in a bowl and microwave until completely melted. If you don't have a microwave, you can melt the butter in a non-stick pan over the stove, then pour it into a small bowl.
Step 2: Steps to make the delicious egg milk cake
First, put the flour into a bowl, then add the other ingredients: baking powder and salt.
Use a spoon to mix them thoroughly.

Next, add the fresh milk, egg, and butter to the flour bowl, then continue whisking until the batter is smooth and fine. You can use an electric mixer to whisk faster and achieve a smoother texture. If you don't have a mixer, mix by hand until the batter is soft, smooth, not lumpy, not too thin, and well-combined.
Let the batter rest for about half an hour to allow it to rise.

Next, pour the batter into the oven and bake until the cake is cooked and has a beautiful golden-brown color. Remember not to put too much batter in at once, as the cake might burn quickly on the outside while remaining undercooked or not fully risen on the inside.
When the cake is done, transfer it to a plate and repeat with the remaining batter.
Enjoy the cake with jam, syrup, or powdered sugar as desired.
2. How to make Matcha Steamed Egg Milk Cake
Ingredients
200g white sugar
500ml unsweetened fresh milk
3 eggs
10 grams matcha powder
130ml water
Steps to make Matcha Steamed Egg Milk Cake

Step 1: Over low heat, dissolve about 150g white sugar with 80ml water and stir to create an amber caramel. Then, add 50ml water and pour the caramel into the molds. Place the molds in the refrigerator to cool.
Step 2: In a pot, stir 500ml fresh milk and the remaining 50g sugar. Take a portion of the milk to mix thoroughly with 3 egg yolks and matcha powder until the mixture is uniform.
Step 3: Use a sieve to strain the egg and matcha mixture to remove lumps. Then, pour this mixture into the pot of milk and stir well.
Step 4: Pour the mixture into the caramel-lined molds, cover tightly, and place in a steamer. Steam for about 30 minutes over low heat.

The matcha steamed egg milk cake will have a characteristic aroma and rich taste. To enhance the flavor, you can chill the cake in the refrigerator for about 2 hours before serving. The matcha flavor combined with the creaminess of the eggs and milk will melt in your mouth.
3. How to make Steamed Egg Milk Cake with Pumpkin
1 pumpkin
600ml fresh milk
200ml condensed milk
4 eggs
1 tsp vanilla
Steps to make Steamed Egg Milk Cake with Pumpkin
Step 1: Carve out the stem of the pumpkin and hollow out the inside to create space for the custard and a decorative look.

Step 2: Boil the fresh milk and condensed milk in a pot, then combine with 4 beaten eggs and add vanilla. Pour the milk mixture into the eggs and strain through a sieve to remove air bubbles and impurities.
Step 3: Pour the mixture into the hollowed pumpkin, then steam in a water bath for about 40 minutes until the pumpkin is soft and fragrant.
Step 4: After steaming, let the cake cool slightly before refrigerating for about 2 hours. Then, you can enjoy the delicious pumpkin egg milk cake.
4. How to make Steamed Cheese Egg Milk Cake
210 grams sugar
1/4 lemon
6 eggs
4 egg yolks
1L fresh milk
100g cream cheese
10ml vanilla
Instructions
Step 1: Over low heat, dissolve 70g sugar and 5 tbsp water in a pot until the sugar turns dark golden. Then, add the lemon juice. Pour this mixture into the cake molds and refrigerate to cool.
Step 2: In a pot, combine fresh milk, cream cheese, vanilla, and the remaining sugar. While cooking, stir well to dissolve all ingredients. Turn off the heat and let the mixture cool.
Step 3: Use a whisk to beat the 4 egg yolks. Then, pour the milk mixture in and stir well for 2 minutes. Strain the mixture to remove any residue.
Step 4: Pour the mixture into the caramel-lined molds, cover tightly, and place in a steamer. Steam for about 30 minutes over low heat.
The delicious cream cheese cake with its rich flavor will keep you coming back for more. This steamed cake is an excellent choice for dessert after any meal.
5. How to make Mango Egg Milk Cake
6 eggs
300g ripe mango
100g white sugar
300ml fresh milk
Steps to make Mango Egg Milk Cake
Step 1: Start by making the caramel as in the previous recipes. Please refer to the instructions above for details.
Step 2: Peel the mango and cut the flesh into small pieces. Blend the mango with a little water and strain to remove fibers, keeping only the smoothest puree.
Step 3: In a pot, combine the pureed mango, fresh milk, sugar, and the beaten and strained egg yolks. Heat over low heat and stir well.

Step 4: When the mixture boils, turn off the heat and pour it into the caramel-lined molds. Place the molds in a steamer and steam for about 30 minutes. Then, place the cake in the refrigerator to cool for at least 2 hours.

The mango steamed egg milk cake has the characteristic slight tartness of mango, providing an interesting and non-greasy experience. This is an ideal dessert to cool down on hot summer days, especially when paired with shaved ice.
Notes for a perfect egg milk cake

The egg milk cakes we are making do not use sugar in the batter, so they are quite bland on their own. You should serve them with jams, fruits, or milk. If you don't prefer that, you can add some sugar to the batter so the cake is sweet enough to be eaten alone.

When adding milk to the flour, remember to pour it in slowly to avoid making the batter too runny, which would cause the cake to fail. Furthermore, stir while adding milk to prevent lumps and ensure the cake is soft and smooth.
If you want to make a large batch to eat gradually, remember to put the cakes in plastic bags or containers to prevent them from losing their crispness.

mon_an.ten: Zeppole – Super Easy Italian Mini Doughnuts
mon_an.mo_ta: Zeppole are Italian mini doughnuts that are very simple in terms of both ingredients and method. You can easily make them yourself to treat the whole family.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, put the butter, sugar, salt, and water into a pot and melt over medium heat.
Step 2:
When the butter has formed a liquid mixture, add the flour and stir constantly with a wooden spoon until the dough is smooth.
Once the dough is smooth, cook for another 1-2 minutes then turn off the heat.
Note: You must stir the dough constantly, otherwise it will burn or stick to the sides of the pot.
Step 3:
Transfer the dough to a large bowl and use a mixer to beat it until it stops steaming.
Step 4:
Next, crack one egg into the bowl and use the mixer to beat until the egg is fully incorporated into the dough.
Only after the first egg is well mixed should you add the next egg.
Repeat with the remaining eggs.
Step 5:
The dough and egg mixture will look like this after you have added all 4 eggs.
You can see the mixture is lighter in color compared to the dough just cooked on the stove.
Step 6:
Pour oil into a pot and heat it up. You need enough oil so that the dough can be deep-fried. To save oil, you should use a small, deep pot!
Step 7:
Put the dough into a piping bag and pipe small balls into the hot oil. To make it easier, you can use scissors to cut the dough into neat, uniform balls quickly!
In case you don't have a piping bag, you can use two teaspoons to scoop the dough (as shown in the image below).
Step 8:
Fry until the doughnuts are golden brown on all sides.
Usually, the doughnuts will flip themselves to brown evenly, but if any don't flip, you need to turn them over to ensure they are cooked through!
Step 9:
When the doughnuts are cooked, remove them and place them on paper towels to drain the excess oil.
Before eating, transfer the doughnuts to another plate and sprinkle a layer of powdered sugar on top for a delicious and beautiful finish!
Finished product requirements:
The doughnuts should be evenly cooked, with a beautiful golden color, not burnt or dark brown.
When eaten, they should have the aroma of butter and eggs, with a characteristic crispy and airy texture.
Enjoy this delicious treat!
This dish is perfect for breakfast, snacks, outings, or picnics with family and friends.

Zeppole are famous doughnuts from the Rome and Naples regions of Italy. You can eat them with a layer of cream on top; they will be much more delicious due to the richness of the cream. Or eating them while drinking milk is also a great idea.
These zeppole are very small and cute, perfect for snacking with friends! The inside of the doughnut will look like this—looks tempting, doesn't it!

mon_an.mo_ta: If you are a matcha lover, you cannot miss this matcha truffle recipe. The richness of chocolate and heavy cream combined with the characteristic flavor of green tea creates an irresistible attraction! Check out the instructions for making these special matcha treats below!
cac_buoc: Ingredients you need to prepare:
Step 1:
First, put the heavy cream and butter in a pot on the stove, and sprinkle in a little salt for flavor.
Have the matcha powder ready in a large bowl.
Step 2:
When the butter has melted completely, turn off the heat, then pour the mixture into the bowl with the matcha powder and stir until completely dissolved.
Step 3:
Next, finely chop the white chocolate and place it in a separate bowl.
Step 4:
Then, melt the white chocolate using a double boiler until it is completely liquid, then turn off the heat.
Step 5:
When the chocolate is fully melted, remove the bowl from the pot, pour in the matcha mixture, and stir well.
Step 6:
If you find the matcha and chocolate mixture is still lumpy, add a tablespoon of hot water to help it smooth out. The proper mixture should have a thickness as shown in the photo!
Step 7:
Now, pour the matcha chocolate mixture into a piping bag.
Step 8:
Prepare molds of your choice and pipe the mixture into them. If you don't have molds, you can use an ice cube tray or a large square tray.
Step 9:
Scrape off the top of the truffles to make them look even and neat.
Step 10:
Then, place the truffles in the refrigerator for 4-5 hours to allow the candies to harden.
Step 11:
Once the candies have hardened, carefully remove them from the molds.
Step 12:
Coat the candies in a layer of matcha powder, followed by a layer of dried raspberries. If you don't have raspberries, you can skip this part!
Dried raspberries will balance the flavor of the matcha truffles, but if you don't have them, you can also enjoy the truffles with tea, which is a great pairing.
Matcha truffles are both fragrant and rich with chocolate flavor, while carrying the very characteristic taste of matcha powder—definitely a must-try for green tea fans!

mon_an.ten: Cheesy Pancakes with Sautéed Corn Filling
mon_an.mo_ta: This nutritious and simple dish will make you want to eat forever. Quickly get into the kitchen to show off your skills with these cheesy pancakes filled with sautéed corn!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 280ml buttermilk (can be replaced with 280ml unsweetened fresh milk mixed with 8g lemon juice or vinegar, let sit for 10 minutes)
cac_buoc: Step 1:

Put the bacon in a pan and sauté with butter over medium heat for about 5 minutes. When the meat starts to darken in color, add the corn kernels and increase the heat. Season with salt, pepper, and a little scallion, then cook for another 3 minutes.
Step 2:
Mix the ingredients including salt, flour, baking powder, baking soda, honey (or sugar), eggs, buttermilk, oil, scallions, and half of the cooked bacon and corn until the mixture is well combined.
Step 3:
Finally, chop the cheese and add it to the batter, stirring gently.
Step 4:

Heat a pan over low heat for about 5 minutes, then add oil and use a paper towel to wipe away the excess. Use a spoon to scoop the pancake batter into the pan and spread it into a round shape. Sprinkle the remaining bacon and corn onto each pancake.
Step 5:
When the edges of the pancake start to dry and small air bubbles appear on the surface (about 2 minutes), gently flip the pancake.
Cook for another 2 minutes until the pancake is evenly cooked on both sides.
Sprinkle some scallions on the pancakes to make them look more attractive!
It's delicious when eaten with a little honey!
Just looking at it makes me hungry...
Let's get in the kitchen and make this right now, everyone!

mon_an.mo_ta: Try making this delicious Oreo jelly instead of the usual Oreo-and-milk snack to treat the whole family; the kids will surely love it!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, dissolve the milk with sugar and place on the stove to heat. Then, add the jelly powder and stir until the powder is completely dissolved.
Step 2:
While waiting for the milk and jelly powder to heat, separate the Oreo cookies. Place the halves with cream into silicone molds, cream side facing up.
With the halves without cream, place them in a zip-top bag and use a rolling pin to crush them into small pieces.
Step 3:
Now, remove the jelly milk pot from the stove and let it cool at room temperature. Use a whisk to beat the mixture until frothy.
Next, add the Oreo crumbs and stir well. Since the jelly will start to set quite quickly at room temperature, remember to work fast.
Step 4:
Finally, pour the milk jelly into the prepared molds and glasses. Place an Oreo cookie on top for decoration if you are using glasses to hold the jelly.
Don't hesitate to enjoy it right away!

mon_an.mo_ta: Chè trôi nước is a very popular snack. What makes this version special is the delicious matcha filling. Let's see how to cook this extremely attractive matcha chè trôi nước!
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients to make this wonderful chè trôi nước!
Step 1:

First, wash the sweet potatoes, cut off both ends, and boil them in a pot until cooked. To check if they are done, use a chopstick to poke the potato; if it's soft and the chopstick goes through easily, the potato is cooked!
When the potatoes are cooked, peel them and put them in a blender to puree. If you don't have a blender, you can mash the potatoes by hand!
Step 2:
Blend for a while, then add about 1 tsp of matcha powder to the blender.
Step 3:
Next, add about 20g of sugar to the blender and continue blending until the mixture of sweet potato + matcha + sugar is smooth.
Step 4:
Next, divide the matcha filling into equal portions (about the size of a dracontomelon fruit), then roll the filling into balls.
Step 5:
With the bánh trôi dough bought from the market, knead it thoroughly to make it smooth!
Step 6:
Divide the dough into equal portions, flatten them, and place the filling in the center.
Step 7:
Roll the balls until they are perfectly round. Note: do not use too much force while rolling, or the balls won't be round.
Step 8:
Bring a pot of water to a boil. Then, drop the balls in to cook.
Step 9:
When you see the balls float to the surface, it means they are cooked.
Step 10:
After that, soak the balls in cold water for about 2 minutes, then remove them to a dry bowl!
Step 11:
Now, boil another 1 liter of water with the remaining sugar, then pour in the dissolved tapioca starch and stir until the syrup thickens.
Now you just need to arrange the balls in a bowl and pour the cooked starch syrup over them, and it's ready to serve!
With the soft and chewy outer skin and the sweet matcha filling inside, it might seem unusual, but it's a very unique and harmonious combination!

mon_an.mo_ta: Breaded sweet potato cakes have a crispy outer shell and a fragrant filling of sweet potato and coconut milk.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the sweet potatoes thoroughly, peel them, then slice into thin pieces. Rinse again to remove all the sap.
Step 2: Place a steamer on the stove and steam the potatoes until they are soft.
Step 3: Put the potatoes in a bowl and mash until smooth.
Step 4: Add a pinch of salt, fresh milk, and heavy cream, then mix the ingredients well.
Step 5: Next, add the flour and mix once more until well combined.

Step 6: Take a small amount of the potato mixture in your hand and roll it into a cylinder shape. The size can be large or small according to your preference. Once shaped, set aside on a plate and continue until all ingredients are used.

Step 7: Take each potato roll and roll it through the tempura flour, then dip it into the beaten eggs. Finally, roll it through the panko breadcrumbs so that it is evenly coated, then place on a plate. Repeat for all the potato rolls.

Step 8: Place a pan of oil on the stove and heat it up. You should use plenty of oil so that the potatoes are submerged while frying. Place each sweet potato cake in and fry until golden brown and crispy, then remove to a plate lined with paper towels.
When eating, you can dip them in ketchup or chili sauce; both are very delicious.
Good luck with making these crispy and delicious breaded sweet potato cakes!

mon_an.mo_ta: Many people think mooncakes must be baked or made from sticky dough, requiring an oven to achieve that golden, fragrant crust. Try a refreshing twist with these no-oven jelly mooncakes using this delicious daily recipe.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fruit - As desired (for flavor and color)
cac_buoc: The standard ratio for jelly powder is 10gr of agar powder mixed with 1l of water. However, the filling needs to be slightly softer, so you can reduce the agar powder slightly or add more water.
Step 1: Make the mooncake filling

Choose your favorite fruit (e.g., mango, pineapple, orange, etc.). Soak the agar powder in cold water for about 15 minutes. Then, bring to a boil until the agar powder is completely dissolved. Add sugar and fruit juice or finely chopped fruit (according to your preference) and stir well. Wait for the jelly mixture to cool slightly, then pour it into small round molds (an ice cube tray works too). Let it cool and place in the refrigerator until the filling sets.
Step 2: Make the crust

Similar to the steps above, soak the agar powder and then bring it to a boil. Add sugar and your favorite fruit flavor (for the crust, you should puree the fruit or use only juice; you should also add a little fresh milk to make the crust slightly opaque, resembling traditional mooncakes). Pour the mixture into 1/3 of the mooncake mold. Wait for the surface to set slightly, then remove the prepared filling and place it in the center. Continue pouring the crust jelly over it until the filling is covered or the mold is full. Place the cakes in the refrigerator to set completely.

mon_an.mo_ta: This Vietnamese Tiramisu recipe is written in a neater and simpler way, yet the flavor remains as authentic as the traditional version. No more worrying about missing mascarpone cheese.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Hura sponge cakes (available at supermarkets or any sponge cake base)
cac_buoc: Ingredients needed:
Step 1:
First, pour the milk pudding into a clean, dry bowl.
Step 2:
Gradually add the powdered sugar to the bowl and whisk until dissolved.
Then, add the rum and mix well.
Step 3:

Measure 200ml of whipping cream into a bowl. Use a hand mixer to beat until stiff peaks form. You can add a drop of lemon juice to make it easier to whip. Watch closely and stop as soon as it reaches the right consistency to avoid over-beating and curdling.
Step 4:
Fold the milk pudding mixture into the whipped cream until well combined, then place in the freezer.
Step 5:
Dissolve the instant coffee in 45 ml of boiling water.
Step 6:
Separate the Hura cakes; you can remove the cream filling. Use a mold, glass, or any container to layer the cake pieces at the bottom.
Step 7:
Finally, drizzle the coffee over the cake, add a layer of cream, then another layer of cake... continue until the top layer is cream. Sift cocoa powder over the top.
And that's it! It's very easy to make.
Store in the refrigerator overnight, or if you want to eat it sooner, place it in the freezer for 1 hour before serving.

mon_an.mo_ta: This fresh orange sponge cake is soft, fluffy, and irresistibly fragrant. Add this to your list and get cooking!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Cooking oil - 48 g (can be replaced with unsalted butter)
cac_buoc: With a fresh orange like this, don't hesitate to start making this orange sponge cake. Let's go!!!
First, use a hand mixer to beat the egg whites until stiff peaks form.
Next, mix the egg yolks, flour, cooking oil, and a little water (about 30ml) and whisk until smooth.
Gently fold the two mixtures together (the egg whites and the yolk-flour mixture). Remember to fold lightly and evenly.
Thinly slice the orange and soak the slices in the remaining 220ml of water. Add sugar to sweeten. If the orange is already naturally sweet or if you prefer a tart flavor, you can skip this step!
Line the mold with parchment paper, then place the orange slices on the bottom.
Pour the batter from step 3 into the mold. Bake in the oven at a moderate temperature, around 180°C, for about 20-30 minutes until the cake is done.
Remove the cake from the oven and the mold, then roll it up. The fresh orange slices are not only beautiful but also make the cake delicious.

mon_an.mo_ta: This sesame wheat pancake dish is extremely simple and perfect for a quick breakfast. Let's make it together!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Place the ground pork in a bowl, crack in the egg, and whisk well. Add the flour to the bowl and stir until the mixture is smooth and thick. Then add the salt, wine, and sesame seeds to the batter and continue to whisk thoroughly.
Note: If the batter is too thick, add a little water.
Step 2: Heat the oil in a pan. When the oil is hot, pour half of the batter into the pan and use a spatula to spread it evenly. When one side is golden brown, flip and fry the other side.
Step 3: Repeat the process with the remaining half of the batter, frying both sides until golden and cooked through.
And here is the result—simple and quick (for a nicer look, you can sprinkle more sesame seeds on the surface just before it finishes browning).
Good luck!

mon_an.mo_ta: Have you ever tried making sweet potato cookies? This is a non-greasy treat because it uses no butter or oil. It has a crispy outer shell covering a chewy, fragrant center flavored with sweet potato, honey, and sweet syrup. The method is very simple; with just a little skill, you'll have a delicious dessert for the whole family. Let's make it!
cac_buoc: Let's get into the kitchen!

Step 1: First, steam the sweet potatoes, peel them, and mash them with a spoon or fork. Mix the mashed sweet potatoes thoroughly with syrup, honey, sugar, and glutinous rice flour. Make sure to mix very well!
Step 2: Next, add milk to the mixture from step 1 and knead until you have a uniform, non-sticky dough.
Step 3: Use your hands to roll the dough into balls, about 15gr each (the diameter of a standard cookie).

Step 4: For a nice look, use a tool with a grid pattern (like a grill rack) to press lightly onto the balls to create a flat disc about 1cm thick. If you don't have a grid tool, you can flatten the dough ball and use the back of a knife or a hard stick to press a crosshatch pattern onto the surface. Place the flattened, patterned cookies on a baking rack.
Step 5: Place the rack in the oven and bake at 180°C for 10 - 12 minutes, or until the surface is a beautiful golden color.
Remove and arrange on a tray or plate. Here is the final result!

mon_an.ten: Bánh Dày Giò for a Tasty Breakfast
mon_an.mo_ta: Making Bánh Dày Giò is not difficult. With glutinous rice flour as the main ingredient, you can hand-make these small cakes yourself. The cakes are fragrant thanks to the milk, chewy from the glutinous rice, and paired with a slice of Vietnamese ham—the flavors melting in your mouth are truly wonderful!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Mix the glutinous rice flour, rice flour, and salt together.
Step 2:
Gather the flour and make a well in the center. Gradually pour in the water and oil, mixing steadily so the dough doesn't clump.
Step 3:
Place the dough in a microwave-safe bowl with a lid. Microwave on medium heat for 5 minutes. After 5 minutes, remove from the microwave and wait about 3 minutes before opening the lid.
Step 4:
Apply a little oil to your hands, pinch off pieces of dough, and shape them into round cakes.
Step 5:
Spread a little oil on a plate and place the cakes on it. Wait a moment for the surface of the cakes to set.
Slice the ham thinly to serve with the cakes.
Final result:

The advantage of this method is that the cakes won't dry out even if left until the afternoon. However, the downside is that your hands will have to handle high heat because the dough is very hot when it first comes out of the microwave. Bánh Dày Giò is a quick and delicious breakfast for the family. In just 15 minutes, you'll have white, fragrant cakes to enjoy with beef ham or pork ham. The most important factor for quality is choosing high-quality glutinous rice flour!
Good luck with this recipe!

mon_an.mo_ta: Bánh Khảo (also known as Bánh In in some regions) is closely associated with the childhood Lunar New Year of many people. Today, let's make Mung Bean Bánh Khảo to prepare for the upcoming Tet holiday!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Bánh khảo flour (cooked glutinous rice flour) - 500 gr
cac_buoc: Step 1: Make the sugar syrup:

Combine the sugar and filtered water in a pot and bring to a boil until the sugar dissolves. Simmer over low heat for 10 minutes until the syrup reaches a soft-thread stage, then remove from heat and let cool. Add the lemon juice to the pot and stir with chopsticks until the sugar thickens into a wet paste, then mix in the pomelo flower water.
Step 2: Make the filling:

Soak the mung beans in water for 4 hours. Drain and place in a pot with fresh water; cook until tender. Once cooked, drain and puree the beans. Sauté the pureed beans with sugar until the mixture no longer sticks to your hands, then fold in the candied winter melon.
Step 3: Assemble the cake:

Place the flour and the prepared sugar syrup in a bowl and mix thoroughly until the sugar and flour are well combined. Press the mixture into 2/3 of a mold, add a layer of filling in the middle, then cover with another layer of the flour mixture to fill the mold. Use your hands to press the mixture firmly into the mold. Let it sit for at least 30 minutes before cutting into square pieces (do not cut too early or the soft cake will crumble).

mon_an.mo_ta: Hello everyone, wishing you all a happy New Year. Today, let's start the year with these delicious baked sweet potato cakes.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Boil the sweet potatoes until tender, peel, and mash thoroughly.
Step 2: While the potatoes are still hot, mix them with flour, baking powder, egg, sugar, and a pinch of salt. Knead the mixture with fresh milk and add enough cooking oil to form a dough.
Step 3: Let the dough proof for about 1 hour.
Step 4: Divide the sweet potato dough into equal portions, each about the size of a ping-pong ball, then let them proof for another 15 minutes.
Step 5: Bake the portions in the oven at 140-160°C for 30 minutes. If you don't have an oven, you can fry them.
Here is the result:
Good luck to everyone!

mon_an.mo_ta: A cake that will leave you swooning with its irresistible deliciousness—rich, fragrant caramel lava cake that is soft and melts in your mouth!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: For the lava cake: - 100g dark chocolate 70%
For the caramel filling: - 80ml heavy cream
cac_buoc: Step 1:
If you have caramel candies at home, you can skip the caramel-making step!
Melt the sugar and water in a small pan until it turns golden brown, then remove from heat and immediately add the heavy cream. Stir for a few seconds and finally mix in the salt and vanilla.
Step 2:
Brush a thin layer of butter inside the molds and dust with cocoa powder to prevent sticking.
Step 3:
Melt the chocolate and butter together. Once melted, stir in the flour and salt.
Step 4:
Beat the eggs and sugar with a hand mixer until light and fluffy.
Step 5:
Fold the chocolate mixture into the whipped eggs.
Step 6:
Divide the batter into the molds. In each mold, place a spoonful of caramel in the center as the filling. If using caramel candies, add them at this step! Bake at 170°C for about 15-20 minutes.
Top with a bit of whipped cream or vanilla ice cream for perfection!
The cake has a soft sponge with a rich, sweet molten center!

mon_an.ten: Bánh Phú Sĩ (Pandan Steamed Sponge Cake)
mon_an.mo_ta: You can create delicious and soft Bánh Phú Sĩ without using a special mold; a simple rice bowl will do. The process is very simple and engaging! Let's explore how to make this special Bánh Phú Sĩ!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Whisk the eggs for the cake
Bring water to a boil in a pot, then reduce the heat and place a large bowl over the pot so the bottom of the bowl does not touch the water.
Add 4 eggs, 100g sugar, oil, and 2 tubes of vanilla to the bowl. Use a whisk to stir until the sugar is completely dissolved.
Once the sugar is dissolved, remove the bowl from the pot and use a hand mixer at low speed. When the eggs become foamy like soap bubbles, increase the speed.
Continue beating until the mixture is thick, fluffy, and pale ivory. When you lift the whisk and the mixture falls in a ribbon-like trail (Ribbon Stage), stop beating.
Step 2: Mix the batter
First, prepare water in a steamer and bring to a boil.

Sift 210g flour, 4g baking powder, 1g baking soda, and 3/4 tsp salt into the egg mixture. Use a spatula to gently fold the flour using the fold method—lifting the batter from the bottom up—to avoid popping the air bubbles and losing the fluffiness.
Step 3: Steam the cake
Next, brush a little oil onto the molds for easy removal. If you don't have molds, you can use bowls. Pour the batter into the molds until 2/3 full to leave room for the cake to rise.
When the steamer water is boiling, lower the heat to medium and place the cakes inside to steam for 20-30 minutes.

Steam until you press the surface and it springs back. Let the cakes sit in the pot for 5 minutes after turning off the heat, then remove. Gently run a knife around the edges to unmold and let them cool before use.
Step 4: Mix the custard topping ingredients
Wash the pandan leaves and place them in a blender with 100ml water. Blend thoroughly and strain to get the juice.
Add one egg and 40g sugar to the juice, then stir until dissolved. Add 25g tapioca starch, 26g flour, 30ml milk, and 70ml coconut milk. Whisk until perfectly combined.
Finally, pass the mixture through a sieve once more to ensure it is smooth.
Step 5: Cook the custard topping
Place a pan on the stove, pour in the mixture, and cook over low heat. Use a spatula to stir constantly until the mixture warms up. Add 50g butter and stir until melted.
Continue stirring until the mixture becomes thick, smooth, and glossy, then turn off the heat.
Tip: The thickness depends on the cooking time. The longer you stir on the stove, the thicker it gets. A slightly thinner custard is easier to pour and coat the cake, but it may run down more.
Step 6: Coat the cake
Start by spreading a layer of the custard topping over the cake. Once the custard has cooled slightly, gently apply a generous amount. Sprinkle shredded coconut over the surface to finish.

The result is a soft, fluffy cake combined with a rich, creamy topping and the wonderful aroma of pandan. This sponge cake is even more delicious when chilled. If you have time, refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving.

Bánh Phú Sĩ, also known as Pandan Sponge Cake, uses the steaming method, making it convenient for those without an oven. The fluffy base with a vibrant green topping and shredded coconut will surely delight you. Let's get started!
Good luck with this Bánh Phú Sĩ recipe!
Notes for a perfect Bánh Phú Sĩ:
Ensure cake quality: Choose high-quality flour to ensure the cake has the right structure and fluffiness.
Mixing technique: Always sift the flour once to remove lumps. Fold gently and not for too long to avoid losing the air inside the batter.
Steaming alternative: Instead of an oven, use the steaming method. Place the cake in a steamer once the water is boiling and steam for the appropriate time.
Choosing molds: Use suitable molds to shape the cake. You can use traditional molds or silicone ones.
Steaming time: Ensure the cake is steamed long enough to cook through, usually 20 to 30 minutes depending on size.
Checking for doneness: Use a toothpick or skewer. If it comes out clean without wet batter, the cake is done.
Adjusting sweetness: You can adjust the sugar level in the recipe to suit your taste.

mon_an.mo_ta: Anyone who loves cooking has likely tried their hand at making cookies, cream cakes, or delicious sponge cakes for their loved ones. These cakes, handcrafted with care, carry all your affection. Today, let's make a strawberry chocolate birthday cake with a soft, fluffy sponge base, topped with fresh cream and attractive strawberries—a perfect gift for a special someone on their once-a-year celebration.
cac_buoc: Prepare the chocolate sponge cake
Step 1: Preheat the oven to 180°C.
Step 2: Place 2 sticks of butter in a pot and melt over medium heat.
Add the cocoa powder, stir well, then pour in the boiling water. Bring to a boil, let it sit for about 30 seconds, then turn off the heat.
Step 3: Mix the flour, sugar, and salt together. Slowly pour the butter and cocoa mixture from step 1 into the dry ingredients, stirring constantly with a spoon.
Mix the whole milk, eggs, vanilla, and baking soda until well combined, then add this to the flour mixture and stir thoroughly.
Step 4: Bake the sponge cake
Line the bottom of the cake pans with parchment paper and grease the sides with butter to prevent sticking.

Slowly pour the batter into the pans. Note: Since we are making a two-layer cake, divide the batter equally into two identical pans and bake for about 20 minutes or until a toothpick inserted comes out clean.
Remove the cakes from the pans, peel off the parchment paper, and let them cool completely for 15-20 minutes.
Prepare the strawberries
Choose ripe, fresh strawberries. Wash, hull, and slice them thinly lengthwise.
Add sugar and vanilla.
Mix well and refrigerate for at least 15 minutes to allow the strawberries to macerate and release their juices.
Prepare the whipped cream
Pour the heavy cream into a mixer and whip until it doubles in volume and forms stiff peaks. When you lift the whisk, the cream should hold its shape without dripping.
Assemble the strawberry chocolate birthday cake
Place one layer of sponge cake on a cake stand, ensuring the flat side is facing up. Spread a layer of Nutella on top.
Follow with 1/2 of the whipped cream and 1/2 of the sliced strawberries.

Place the second sponge layer on top of the cream and strawberries. Repeat the process by spreading Nutella, the remaining whipped cream, and finally arranging the rest of the strawberries beautifully on top. Your strawberry chocolate birthday cake is now complete.

The finished cake should have a soft, fluffy, and fragrant sponge. The strawberries should be tender with a balanced sweet and tart flavor that complements the richness of the whipped cream and Nutella. When serving, cut into small slices and gently plate them to share the joy with your loved ones.
A few small tips:
You can substitute strawberries with mango, peaches, bananas, or any of your favorite fruits. Similarly, you can replace Nutella with corresponding fruit jams to enhance the flavor of the cake.
The quantities above are sufficient for a two-tier cake. You can halve the ingredients for a single layer or double them for an impressive four-tier cake.
I used two pans to bake the layers separately. If you only have one pan, you can bake the entire batter at once. Once cooled, use a sharp knife to slice the cake horizontally into two even layers.

Don't worry if you don't have an oven; you can use a rice cooker instead. Grease the inner pot with butter, pour in the batter, and place a clean towel over the top (to absorb moisture and prevent water from dripping onto the cake). Cook until a toothpick comes out clean, then unplug and remove the cake.
Notes for making strawberry chocolate birthday cake

Ingredients: Choose high-quality ingredients, especially the chocolate and fresh strawberries. Use dark chocolate with at least 70% cocoa for a rich flavor. Strawberries should be fresh, juicy, and free of bruises.
Pan preparation: Use round or rectangular pans and line the bottom with parchment paper or foil for easy removal after baking.
Temperature and baking time: Follow the recipe's instructions strictly for temperature and time to ensure the cake is evenly cooked and neither burnt nor raw.
Cream and strawberry layers: When layering, ensure they are distributed evenly and save a specific amount for decorating the top.
Frosting: Use enough cream to cover the entire surface of the cake, ensuring no gaps. You can use a spatula or a piping tip to create different patterns or textures on the surface.
Decoration: Use melted chocolate, strawberries, or other toppings to decorate according to your preference. You can create flowers, letters, or simple animations.

Storage: This cake should be stored in the refrigerator to keep the cream and strawberries fresh. Before serving, let it sit at room temperature for a short while to soften the cream for a better experience.

mon_an.mo_ta: When we think of baking, flour is usually the first ingredient that comes to mind. However, with this flourless recipe, this chocolate truffle cake becomes even more delicious and special!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 225g unsalted butter (room temperature, cut into small pieces)
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, use a knife to finely chop the chocolate.
Step 2:
Place the chopped chocolate into a blender and blend until completely smooth.
Step 3:
Place the sugar and coffee in a small pan and heat until everything is melted.
Be careful not to let the mixture boil; turn off the heat as soon as it is hot and bubbles start to form around the edges.
Step 4:
Turn on the blender containing the chocolate from step 2, then slowly pour in the hot sugar mixture. Blend for another 10 seconds until the chocolate is fully melted.
Step 5:
Stop the blender, stir the bottom of the jar once, then blend for a few more seconds.
Step 6:
While the blender is running, divide the butter into 2 parts and add them one by one, blending for 20 seconds after each addition.

Place the eggs in a bowl, whisk lightly, and gradually pour into the mixture. Add in several batches; after each batch, blend for a few seconds before adding more. Do not blend too long after adding eggs to avoid incorporating too much air.
Step 7:
Prepare 2 trays: a small one for the cake batter and a larger one for the water bath. Pour the batter into the small tray and place it inside the larger one.
Boil a pot of water, then pour it into the large tray until the water reaches about 1cm up the sides.
Preheat the oven to 180°C and bake for about 25-33 minutes, until the surface is no longer sticky.
No flour needed, yet the cake is still delicious!
Let it cool before eating!
Add some whipped cream too!

mon_an.mo_ta: If you haven't thought of a gift for your loved one yet, why hesitate? Head to the kitchen and make these sweet, delicious, and adorable love cupcakes right away!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Frosting part: - 400g butter, 240g powdered sugar, 360g cream cheese, 3ml vanilla
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, put the flour, cocoa powder, and salt into a bowl.
Step 2:
In another bowl, mix the sugar and oil together, then gradually crack the eggs in one by one.
Step 3:
Add the food coloring and vanilla to the mixture.
Step 4:
Divide the flour into 3 parts and add them to the mixture one batch at a time. Do the same with the buttermilk.
Step 5:
In a small bowl, mix the vinegar and baking soda together, then stir it into the batter above.
Step 6:
Line the cupcake molds with paper liners and pour the batter in until 2/3 full. Bake at 140°C for 20 minutes, then remove and let them cool completely.
Step 7:
Mix the butter and cream cheese together to make the frosting, then gradually add the powdered sugar. Finally, add the vanilla to finish the frosting.
Sprinkle some decorative sprinkles on top for a beautiful look!
These vibrantly colored cakes will surely brighten your day!
Thanks to the buttermilk, the cake is very soft and has a subtle, sophisticated tang!

mon_an.mo_ta: Chilled Cherry Cheese Mousse is a delicious and easy-to-make Western dessert. This recipe is simple yet incredibly tasty, making it a treat you'll absolutely love.
cac_buoc: Let's start making the Chilled Cherry Cheese Mousse right away:
Step 1:
Beat the cream cheese until smooth.
Add the cherry jam to the cream cheese and beat until well combined.
Step 2:
Soak the gelatin in cold milk for about 15 minutes to bloom.
Heat the gelatin and milk mixture over a double boiler until dissolved, then pour it into the bowl from step 1 and mix well.

Step 3: Place another bowl and the whisk attachment in the refrigerator for 15 minutes, and the heavy cream in the freezer for 5 minutes; this helps the cream whip faster and more evenly. Pour the heavy cream into the stainless steel bowl and use a mixer at the lowest speed, gradually increasing until the cream is whipped to stiff peaks.
Step 4: Pour the mixture from step 2 into the whipped cream, adding it gently and a little at a time. Fold decisively, evenly, and quickly so the mixture doesn't become flat or tough.
Step 5: Pour the mixture into molds. Wait 4 hours for it to set. For the best Chilled Cherry Cheese Mousse, leave it in the refrigerator overnight.

mon_an.mo_ta: Passion Fruit Mousse – with its tart, fragrant passion fruit flavor and rich whipped cream, is surely a refreshing treat that both mothers and children will love. Learn how to make this novel refreshing dessert.
cac_buoc: Step 1: First, prepare the gelatin: Pour the gelatin into a bowl and mix with 2 tablespoons of hot water, stirring until dissolved.
Step 2: Wash the passion fruit and drain. Cut them in half and use a spoon to scoop the pulp and seeds into a bowl. Keep the shells to use as serving cups for the mousse.

Step 3: Put the passion fruit pulp into a blender with 100ml of filtered water and blend until the seeds are finely ground. After blending, use a sieve to strain and keep the juice for the mousse. You should have about 300ml of passion fruit juice.
Step 4:
Whip the heavy cream until stiff peaks form.
Add sugar to the passion fruit juice to taste. Heat the juice until warm, then add the gelatin and stir until dissolved. Keep the juice over low heat so it stays warm but not hot.
Step 5: Let the passion fruit solution cool, then slowly pour it into the whipped cream.
Step 6: Use a ladle to scoop the mixture into the passion fruit shells or pour into glasses. Refrigerate for 5 - 8 hours until the mousse is completely set.
Source: Ngoi sao

mon_an.mo_ta: Lime Mousse – tart and refreshing, this set mousse is a delight to eat. Learn how to make Lime Mousse.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Pour the gelatin powder into a small bowl and mix with a little warm water to dissolve.
Step 2: Wash the limes, soak in diluted salt water, drain, and then finely zest the green skin. Cut in half and squeeze for juice, discarding the seeds.

Step 3: Place the egg whites in a clean bowl and set it over a pot of boiling water for a double boiler. Heat until the egg whites reach about 65 - 70°C, then add the sugar. Remember to stir occasionally.

Step 4: Remove the bowl of egg whites and use a mixer to beat until stiff peaks form. In another bowl, whip the heavy cream until stiff. Ensure that when you lift the whisk, it forms a sharp peak that doesn't fall; do not over-whip or it will separate.

Step 5: Put the lime juice and zest into a pot and cook over low heat. When it starts to boil, add the gelatin and stir until dissolved. Remove from heat and let it cool. Mix the yogurt and whipped egg whites into the lime mixture, then fold in the whipped cream. Strain through a sieve to remove any lumps.
Step 6: Divide evenly into 4 glasses and refrigerate for 4-5 hours until the surface is completely set. For the best results, leave it overnight to set more firmly.
Source: Ngoi sao

mon_an.mo_ta: Cream puffs are crispy and fragrant with butter and eggs, chilled with vanilla cream, and sweetened with a chocolate glaze. Perfect as a dessert after a cozy dinner, a morning snack, or even for picnics and gifts! Let's get started!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Boil 25cl of water with the chopped butter, sugar, and salt.
Meanwhile, sift the flour. When the butter has melted, pour the flour into the pot and stir with a wooden spoon until the dough is smooth and pulls away from the sides of the pot.
Remove from heat, add 1 egg, and beat until fully incorporated. Repeat with the remaining 3 eggs.
Beat until the dough is smooth and glossy. If it's too thick, add one more egg.
Note: When you lift the dough, it should be smooth and form a peak (neither too dry nor too runny).
Step 2:
While shaping the puffs, preheat the oven to 200°C.
Grease the baking sheet with a little butter or use parchment paper.
After piping the puffs, brush the tops with egg yolk for color and gently press down any peaks so they bake into a round shape.
Step 3:
Bake for about 20 minutes.
While waiting for the puffs to cool, melt 200g of chocolate over a double boiler or in the microwave. (If you aren't serving them all at once, only melt enough chocolate for the portion you need.)
Once the puffs are cool, cut them open, fill with vanilla cream, and spread the chocolate glaze on top...
Enjoy these cream puffs filled with the sweet aroma of butter, milk, vanilla, and chocolate!
Note: Cream puffs can be stored in the refrigerator or freezer if you want to keep them longer.

mon_an.mo_ta: Pandan Chiffon Cake is a soft, fluffy, and fragrant cake that is very easy to make. It's perfect for kids, birthday parties, or family gatherings. Try making this over the weekend!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Lemon juice (or cream of tartar) - 1/4 tsp
cac_buoc: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 125°C. Mix the flour, cornstarch, and baking powder together, then sift the mixture until smooth.
Step 2: Place 60g of sugar, cream of tartar/lemon juice, and salt into the bowl with the egg whites. Whip until stiff peaks form and the mixture is smooth but not dry.
Step 3: In another bowl, whisk together the egg yolks, pandan juice, coconut milk, oil, and sugar. Divide the flour mixture into 3 parts, sift, and fold into the yolk mixture.
Step 4: Divide the whipped egg whites into 3 parts and fold them one by one into the yolk and flour mixture. Pour quickly into the mold, then shake and tap the mold gently to level the batter.
Step 5: Bake on the bottom rack at 125°C for 60 minutes until the cake is done.

mon_an.mo_ta: Using puff pastry as a pizza crust makes it incredibly crispy. The perfect combination of toppings makes it absolutely delicious!
cac_buoc: For the toppings, you can choose according to your preference! For example: minced beef with tomato sauce, sweet corn, bell peppers, BBQ chicken...
Step 1:
If using mushrooms, slice them thinly and sauté briefly with garlic and a pinch of salt.
Step 2:
Cut the pastry dough into rectangles of about 8x15cm.
Step 3:
Brush a little olive oil in the center of each pastry piece.
Step 4:
Spread the shredded cheese in the center of the pastry. Then add your desired toppings. Note: Place the toppings in the center, covering only about 1/2 of the surface area.
Step 5:
Preheat the oven to 200°C and bake for about 15 minutes.
Step 6:
When the pizza is done, let it sit in the oven for 10 minutes, then take it out, cut into bite-sized pieces, and sprinkle with fresh basil.
When baked, the edges of the pastry will puff up beautifully!
This will taste slightly different from regular pizza because of the buttery aroma!
The golden-brown color looks very appetizing!
The texture is wonderfully light and flaky!

mon_an.mo_ta: Crispy Sausage Pizza – A simple dish for pizza lovers to make at home. Learn how to make this delicious crispy sausage pizza.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Mix the flour and other dough ingredients together. Knead thoroughly until a uniform mixture is formed. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and place in a warm spot. Once the dough has doubled in size, knead it again to deflate the air bubbles. Knead for another 10 minutes, then cover and let it proof for about 2 hours and 15 minutes.

Step 2: Prepare a baking tray by brushing it with a layer of olive oil to prevent the pizza from sticking or burning. Roll the dough into a rectangle or circle as desired. Brush a layer of oil onto the surface of the dough.

Step 3: Spread a layer of tomato sauce over the dough, followed by a layer of cheese, and finally arrange the sausage on top. Sprinkle a bit more cheese and bake in the oven for 20 minutes at 210°C. A delicious homemade meal for the whole family.
Source: Tri thuc tre

mon_an.ten: Tako Haew: A Delicious Thai Snack
mon_an.mo_ta: Make your weekend more exciting with Tako Haew – a super delicious Thai snack. Since this jelly uses no thickening agents other than rice flour, it is very soft and quite similar to pudding. The crunchy water chestnut jelly pairs perfectly with the rich coconut layer. This Tako Haew pandan jelly is not too difficult to make, yet the result is beautiful and full of Thai culinary flavor. Good luck with this tasty treat!
cac_buoc: To make this Thai dish, wash the pandan leaves, drain well, then cut and fold them into boxes as follows:
Cut a length of pandan leaf 5 times its width, mark 5 equal sections, and cut one side from the edge to the midrib at each mark:
Fold the pandan leaf into a box shape. At the final fold, use a staple or toothpick to secure the leaf so it doesn't come apart.
Blend about 10 pandan leaves and strain to get the juice.
The jelly layers are prepared as follows:
Peel the water chestnuts, wash, and dice them into small cubes.
To make the first jelly layer, add 1.5 liters of water, jasmine essence, and sugar to a large pan, add 700g of rice flour, and bring to a boil while stirring constantly.
To create a beautiful green color, add a little of the prepared pandan juice to the mixture and stir. Then, add the water chestnuts, mix well, and pour this mixture into 1/2 of each leaf mold.
To make the coconut layer for the top, pour the coconut milk into a pot and bring to a boil, then add the remaining rice flour and a pinch of salt, stirring until the flour is cooked.
Fill the pandan boxes to the top with the coconut jelly, let them cool completely, and they are ready to serve.

mon_an.ten: Soft and Delicious Green Tea Swiss Roll
mon_an.mo_ta: This green tea Swiss roll, with its fragrant tea aroma and rich, soft cream filling, is an ideal treat for the whole family! Check out our recipe for this soft and delicious green tea Swiss roll in the article below.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
In a large bowl, combine hot water, green tea powder, and cooking oil, stirring well. Then sift in the flour and cornstarch.
Step 2:
