Add the egg yolks and whisk until smooth.
Divide the sugar into 3 parts and add to the egg whites, beating until the mixture is stiff and glossy.
Step 3:
Divide the egg white mixture into 3 parts and fold them into the green tea mixture one by one, whisking gently after each addition.
Step 4:
Pour the batter into a mold lined with parchment paper and smooth the surface. Place the mold in a preheated oven at 180°C and bake for 20 minutes. Remove the cake and let it cool.
Step 5:
In a large bowl, combine yogurt, cream cheese, and white sugar. Place over a double boiler, stirring constantly. Add the softened gelatin, whisk until dissolved, then remove from heat and let cool.
Step 6:
Whip 200g of whipping cream until stiff peaks form, then pour in the cooled cheese mixture and fold together.
Step 7:
Remove the cake from the mold by lifting the parchment paper and trim the edges. Place another sheet of parchment paper on top, flip the cake over, and peel off the bottom parchment paper.
Step 8:
Spread the cream evenly over the surface of the cake, applying a thinner layer at the beginning and end edges. Roll it up tightly and keep chilled.
Step 9:
When ready to serve, take it out and cut the cake into slices about 2cm thick.
Finished Product:

The green tea roll with its fragrant tea scent and creamy filling is perfect as a dessert or an afternoon snack with a cup of hot tea. The key to this cake is beating the egg whites until smooth and stiff so that the cake remains soft and doesn't crumble after baking.
Good luck and enjoy your meal!

mon_an.mo_ta: Time flies; Christmas is less than 10 days away. Everywhere you look, there are bright lights, and the characteristic biting cold of the festive season has arrived. Only the weather has been a bit moody lately, with drizzling rain. Wait another 1-2 days, and the weather will be dry again, perfect for holiday festivities. Around this time last year, we welcomed the season with a series of Christmas party posts. This year, we are adding more Christmas-themed dishes and treats for the whole family to enjoy. First up is the recipe for Christmas Tree Cookies. Butter cookies have long been an indispensable part of Christmas parties. This year, let's add a little creativity and heart to make these fragrant and beautiful cookies.
cac_buoc: Baking the cookies
Preheat the oven to 180°C.
Mix the flour and baking powder together and set aside.

Beat the butter and sugar at high speed until soft and smooth, then add the vanilla and egg. Continue beating at high speed for about 2 minutes. Gradually add the flour mixture and beat until well combined. (You should divide the flour into 4 parts and add them slowly to ensure even mixing).

Divide the dough into two equal parts and roll them into two round balls. Sprinkle flour on a clean surface (you can use a cutting board or a clean tray) and roll out each piece of dough into a circle about 30cm in diameter and 3mm thick.

Dust the Christmas tree cookie cutter with flour to prevent sticking (the fastest way is to press it into a bowl of flour and lift it out), then use the cutter to shape the cookies. Arrange the cookies on a baking sheet (remember to leave about 2cm of space between them).
Place the cookies in the preheated oven and bake for about 6-7 minutes or until they turn a beautiful light golden color. Remove from the oven and let them cool completely.
Making the frosting

In a mixer, beat the butter and powdered sugar until soft and smooth, then add the vanilla and heavy cream. Turn the mixer to high speed and beat until the mixture is very smooth, then add the green food coloring and mix until the color is even.

If you have a piping tip (the smallest type, often used for writing), place it in a piping bag and fill it with the frosting. If you don't have a tip, put the frosting in a bag and snip a small hole at the corner. Pipe short lines to cover the surface of the cookies to create the tree shape. Afterward, you can use uncolored frosting to pipe decorative lines or use M&M candies to decorate the Christmas tree cookies.
Here is the finished product after decorating. You can set aside a little uncolored frosting to pipe lines that look like Christmas tree lights for a very beautiful effect.

mon_an.mo_ta: Add these cherry butter cookies to your Christmas party dessert menu. These fragrant, rich, and golden butter cookies are decorated with green and red cherry jam – the two signature colors of the Christmas season.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Cherry jam - as needed (choose green and red)
cac_buoc: Place the butter and sugar in a bowl and beat at high speed until soft and smooth.
Whisk the egg yolks and add them to the bowl along with the orange zest, lemon zest, lemon juice, and vanilla. Continue beating until well combined.
Add the flour to the bowl and mix well, then place the dough in the refrigerator to rest for about 2 hours.
Preheat the oven to 180°C. Cut the cherry jam pieces in half. Use both green and red cherry jam for Christmas decoration.
Roll the dough into small balls, then press half a cherry into the center of each ball and place them on a baking sheet.
Place the cookies in the oven and bake for about 20 minutes or until they turn golden brown. Remove and place on a wire rack to cool.
Here are the cherry butter cookies once plated. Just looking at them brings the Christmas spirit!

mon_an.mo_ta: Christmas party menu: introducing the recipe for Christmas cream sponge cake!
cac_buoc: Making the sponge cake
Preheat the oven to 190°C.
Line the mold with parchment paper, brush butter on the paper and the sides of the mold to prevent sticking.
Sift the flour and salt to remove lumps and set aside (Mixture 1).
In a bowl, combine milk, eggs, vanilla, baking soda, and vinegar. Mix well and set aside (Mixture 2).
Mix the cocoa powder and food coloring together to form a thick paste.
Cream the sugar and shortening until the mixture is fluffy and smooth.

Alternately add small amounts of Mixture 1 and Mixture 2, mixing well after each addition (remember to add slowly to ensure even mixing). Then add the food coloring and cocoa mixture and mix thoroughly.
Pour the batter into the mold and bake for about 20 minutes until cooked through (a toothpick inserted should come out clean). Remove from the oven and let the cake cool completely.
Making the frosting
Whisk the flour into the milk until dissolved, then heat on the stove over low heat. Stir constantly until the mixture thickens, then remove from heat. Stir in the vanilla and let it cool completely.
Beat the butter with sugar until fluffy, then gradually add the milk and flour mixture. Beat until the mixture is smooth (similar to whipped cream).
Decorating the cake

Spread the prepared frosting evenly over the cake. Use red fruits (such as strawberries, raspberries, or red cherries) to decorate the top, then use a knife to cut the cake into beautiful square pieces.
Here is the finished cream sponge cake.

mon_an.mo_ta: Christmas party menu: here is how to make gingerbread cookies in the shape of a train for Christmas.
cac_buoc: How to make the gingerbread
Mix the butter, brown sugar, molasses, and baking soda until the mixture is smooth.
Add the flour and beat until a uniform dough forms. Let the dough rest for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 190°C. Meanwhile, roll out the dough and cut it into shapes to form the train.
To make the engine, you need 5 pieces shaped like the engine parts shown below, then cut out the details as illustrated.
To make the train cars, prepare 4 template pieces as shown below.
Use a mold to create windows for the cars (only for the two outer pieces; the other two will be sandwiched in the middle). Also, cut off the wheel sections from the two middle pieces.
Place the cookies in the oven and bake for 15-20 minutes or until they are cooked and turn golden brown. Remove from the oven and let them cool completely.
How to make the frosting

Place all frosting ingredients in a bowl. Use a mixer on low speed, then gradually increase the speed until the ingredients blend into a uniform mixture. Put the frosting into a piping bag with the smallest tip (used for writing or grass effects).
Decorating and assembling the train
Decorate the patterns on the cookie pieces as shown, then use the frosting to glue the pieces together to form the train. Finally, attach the strawberry candies to serve as the train wheels.
Here is the final product. Delicious and beautiful!

mon_an.mo_ta: Using just two very familiar main ingredients, eggs and potatoes, let's learn how to "transform" them into eye-catching "bird nests" to create a wonderful baked potato egg dish!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Bake the potatoes until cooked, peel them, and grate them finely. Add a little salt and pepper to the grated potatoes for flavor.
Step 2: Coat the cupcake tin with a thin layer of cooking oil. If you don't have an oil spray, you can use a pastry brush instead.
Step 3: Place the grated potatoes into each cup of the tin. Use your fingers to press the potatoes against the sides of the cups to create a hollow center.
Step 4: Sprinkle with a little more salt and pepper, and brush on another thin layer of oil.
Step 5: Place the tin in the oven and bake at 220°C for 20–25 minutes. Bake until the potatoes are crispy and turn golden brown.
Step 6: Once the potatoes have cooled slightly, crack an egg into each cup of the tin.
Finally, put the tin back into the oven and continue baking at 220°C for another 10-15 minutes until the eggs are set.

mon_an.ten: Sweet Butter Milk Bread for Breakfast
mon_an.mo_ta: Make your own sweet bread rolls, perfect for breakfast! The method is extremely simple. Check out how to make sweet butter milk bread for breakfast in the article below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Egg - Half an egg (beaten), one yolk for brushing
cac_buoc: Knead the flour with the beaten half-egg, milk, sugar, and yeast. Mix well until the dough comes together and becomes tacky.
Melt the butter and add it to the kneaded flour mixture, then stir well.
Sprinkle in a little extra flour and mix briefly; the dough should be very soft and not stick to your hands.

Let the dough proof until it has doubled in size, then shape it into hand-sized round balls and let them rise a second time (about 40-45 minutes). To prevent sticking, place each dough ball on a small piece of parchment paper.
Whisk the egg yolk with a little fresh milk and brush this mixture over the surface of the dough balls, then sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Bake at 180°C for about 20 minutes.

mon_an.mo_ta: Make your own beautiful heart-shaped sweet bread as a special gift for your loved one. A lovely gift to give!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: All-purpose flour - 320g divided into 2 parts (170g and 150g)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Kneading the dough: Dissolve the yeast in a little warm water, then add 170g of flour and knead thoroughly until the dough no longer sticks to your hands. Cover the dough with a towel or plastic wrap and let it proof for 1 hour 30 minutes. Afterward, add the butter, egg, and the remaining 150g of flour to the proofed dough and knead thoroughly again. Note that the butter must be at room temperature.

Step 2: Dissolve the sugar and milk in another bowl, then pour this milk mixture into the dough. Knead again until the mixture is uniform and let it proof for another 2 hours. This completes the dough preparation.

Step 3: Divide the dough into equal parts, roll them into balls, and then roll them out into oval shapes. Roll each oval up into a long strip. Fold the strip in half and repeat with another strip of dough.

Step 4: Join the ends of the two folded dough pieces together and open the top parts outward to form a heart shape. Place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake in the oven at 180°C for 18 minutes. Remove, let the bread cool, and give it to your loved one or friends!
Source: Kenh14

mon_an.mo_ta: Doraemon's pancakes are called Dorayaki, a traditional Japanese treat. They are shaped like buns, made from flour and beans, with a honey-brushed crust that is very delicious and nutritious. If you can't find a shop selling the famous cat's pancakes, try getting into the kitchen and making this magical dish yourself!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Cake flour - 150g (if unavailable, mix 100g all-purpose flour + 50g tapioca starch or cornstarch)
Red bean filling: - Red beans - 1/2 cup
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Clean the red beans, remove any damaged ones, and soak them in warm water for about 5-6 hours.

Rinse the beans thoroughly, put them in a pot, add salt and enough water to cover the beans. Boil until the beans are soft and tender, then turn off the heat. You can cook the beans faster using a pressure cooker.
Step 2:
Once the beans are soft, put them in a blender with a little of the cooking water to make blending easier and prevent the motor from burning. Blend until the beans are smooth.
Step 3:
Put the beans in a pan, add sugar, and stir over low heat until the water evaporates and the bean paste thickens. Let it cool and store in the refrigerator.
Step 4:
Mix the salt, baking powder, and cake flour in a large bowl, then sift until fine.
Step 5:
Crack the eggs into a large bowl, add sugar, and use a whisk to beat until the sugar is dissolved.
Step 6:
Slowly add the honey and oil, stirring in one direction to incorporate the oil into the egg mixture.
Step 7:
Add the flour mixture from step 4 into the egg mixture and fold gently.
Step 8:

Pour the water into the bowl and mix until thick. When you lift the whisk, the batter should fall in a continuous stream. Add the vanilla and mix well. Adjust the amount of water depending on the absorption of the flour.
Cover with plastic wrap and let it rest for about 30 minutes.
Step 9:

Turn on the stove and place a non-stick pan over the heat. When the pan is hot, drizzle a little oil on the surface, then use a paper towel or brush to wipe it off so only a very thin layer remains. Too much oil will prevent the pancakes from browning evenly.
Step 10:
Keep the heat low. Use a small ladle to pour the batter from a height into the pan so the pancakes are perfectly round, then cook over medium-low heat.
Step 11:
Fry until the top surface of the pancake sets and small bubbles appear, then flip and fry the other side until golden. Each side takes about 3-4 minutes.
Continue frying the rest of the batter. You don't need to re-grease the pan for subsequent batches, but turn the heat to low before pouring the next one.
Step 12:
Place the finished pancakes on a wire rack.
Step 13:
Spread a layer of red bean paste on the surface of one pancake.
Step 14:
Place another pancake on top and press gently.

mon_an.mo_ta: Raisin butter cake is a very popular treat, often served at tea parties. It is easy to make and incredibly delicious! The cake features a rich buttery aroma, sweet raisins, and a creamy milky flavor. This guide will show you how to make raisin butter cake at home.
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients
Servings: 4 people. Use an 11x21x7 (cm) mold
Let's start:
Step 1:
Preheat the oven for 10 minutes at 155°C, using top and bottom heat mode with the convection fan (if available).
Step 2:
Soak the raisins in rum until soft and fragrant.
Step 3:
Line the baking mold with parchment paper.
Step 4:
Mix the flour with baking powder and salt.
Step 5:
Sift the flour mixture until smooth.
Step 6:
Mix the vanilla into the milk.
Step 7:
Crack the eggs into a bowl.
Step 8:
Turn the hand mixer to medium speed and beat the butter until fluffy.
Step 9:
Gradually add the sugar, beating until the butter turns a pale ivory color.
Step 10:
Add the eggs one by one.
Step 11:
Beat until the mixture is light and airy.
Step 12:
Set the mixer to low speed.
Step 13:
Gradually add the flour.
Step 14:
Slowly pour the milk into the mixture while continuing to beat.
Step 15:
Mix well.
Step 16:
Remove the raisins from the rum and place them in a small bowl.
Step 17:
Gently fold the raisins into the batter; do not overmix to avoid a tough cake.
Step 18:
Pour the batter into the mold.
Step 19:
Sprinkle almonds on top and level the batter.
Step 20:
Place in the oven.
Step 21:
Bake for 40-55 minutes depending on the oven capacity. For a 35L oven, bake for 40 minutes.
Step 22:
When the time is up, remove the cake from the oven.
Step 23:
Check for doneness with a toothpick; if it comes out clean, the cake is done.
Freshly baked raisin butter cake is ready to serve:

mon_an.mo_ta: Egg tarts, also known as Tart shells, originated in Spain (and Portugal), featuring a crispy layered crust and a rich, creamy egg custard filling. If you often visit KFC, you'll know how popular these are. Let's learn how to make KFC-style egg tarts.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: A pinch of salt, sugar, and vanilla
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Cut the butter into small pieces and place in a bowl. Sift the flour into the butter bowl and add a pinch of salt.
Use your hands to gently rub the butter into the flour, then slowly pour in cold water and mix until the mixture forms a smooth dough without lumps.
Step 2:
Dust a work surface with a little flour, place the dough on it, and use a rolling pin to roll it out thin.
Fold both ends of the dough inward and roll it out again into a rectangle.
Step 3:
Roll the dough up tightly, press it gently into a small rectangle, wrap it in plastic wrap, and let it rest in the refrigerator for 1-2 hours.
Step 4:
Take the dough out, place it on the floured surface, and roll it out thin.
Use a pastry cutter or the rim of a glass to cut the dough into appropriately sized circles.
Gently press each piece of dough into the tart molds. Use a fork to prick the bottom of the crust to prevent it from puffing up during baking, then place the tray in the refrigerator.
Step 5:
Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk well with a little sugar.
Heat the whipping cream and milk in a pot, then slowly pour it into the egg mixture while stirring constantly (do not pour it all at once as the hot milk may curdle the eggs).
Pass the mixture through a sieve to remove any lumps, then stir in the vanilla and a pinch of salt.
Step 6:
Take the tart tray out of the refrigerator and pour the custard filling into the molds until nearly full.
Place the tray in the oven and bake at 180°C for about 25-30 minutes until golden.
Remove the tarts from the oven. They are best enjoyed warm with a cup of hot tea.
Making KFC-style egg tarts with this recipe doesn't take much time. They are delicious, easy to eat, nutritious, and loved by many—and the process is quite simple!

mon_an.mo_ta: If you are a pizza lover, you cannot miss this amazing recipe. The rich, savory filling combined with a crispy, chewy crust will capture your heart instantly. Check out our Chicago pizza recipe below!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Add sugar and yeast to warm water and let it sit for 10 minutes.
Step 2:
Knead the flour, salt, and yeast mixture for about 15 minutes until the dough forms a ball. You can knead by hand if you don't have a mixer!
Step 3:
Add olive oil and continue mixing until all ingredients are well combined.
Step 4:
Cover with plastic wrap and let the dough rest for 40-50 minutes.
Tip: To save time, you can buy pre-made pizza dough at the supermarket!
Step 5:
While the dough is proofing, start making the sauce. Sauté the onion and minced garlic with olive oil (or cooking oil) until fragrant.
Step 6:
Add the tomatoes and stir with the onion and garlic. Use the back of a spoon to crush the tomatoes while cooking.
Step 7:
Season the tomato sauce with salt, pepper, and oregano.
Step 8:
After the proofing time, press a finger into the center of the dough. If the indentation remains, the dough has proofed enough.
Step 9:
Roll out 2/3 of the dough and place it into the mold. Prick small holes with a fork to ensure a crispy crust.
Step 10:
Place the mozzarella cheese in the center of the mold.
Step 11:
Roll out the remaining dough and cover the cheese layer.
Step 12:
Layer the smoked sausage on top and pour the tomato sauce over it. Bake at 180°C for 20 minutes.
Once baked, remove from the oven and sprinkle with parsley and powdered Parmesan cheese to make it more appealing!
This oozing cheese is a sight to behold!
This trending Chicago pizza is actually not that difficult to make!

mon_an.ten: Secret Recipe for BBQ Char Siu Steamed Buns
mon_an.mo_ta: These char siu steamed buns are better than ever thanks to the special savory BBQ filling. You won't be able to stop eating them!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: For the filling: - 120ml water (broth is even better)
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Prepare the filling: finely dice the char siu pork. Sauté the onion until fragrant, then add the pork and stir. Season with a little salt and pepper.
Step 2:
When the meat begins to firm up, add the water (or broth), oyster sauce, ketchup, sugar, cornstarch, and dark soy sauce. Simmer for a few minutes.
Step 3:
Once the sauce has thickened, remove from heat and quickly stir in the sesame oil. Let it cool, then place the filling in the refrigerator.
Step 4:
Prepare the dough: Dissolve the yeast, warm water, and sugar; let it sit for 5 minutes. Add the baking powder and butter, then add the flour and knead thoroughly for about 10 minutes.
Step 5:
Once the dough is smooth and elastic, place it in a bowl and cover with plastic wrap or a damp towel. Let it proof for 20 minutes.
Step 6:
Roll the dough into a long log and divide it into 24 equal portions. Place the char siu filling inside and pleat the edges to seal the buns.
Step 7:
Place each bun on a piece of parchment paper and steam over boiling water for 10 minutes.
Note: You should wipe the inside of the pot lid frequently so that condensation doesn't drip onto the buns, ensuring a beautiful finish.
Remove the buns and enjoy them while they are hot!
The aroma of char siu combined with the glossy BBQ sauce is simply irresistible!

mon_an.mo_ta: Learn how to make delicious peanut butter cream pots following this recipe.
cac_buoc: Place the butter in a bowl and melt it over a double boiler. Crush the Oreo cookies. You can leave them in the bag and crush them with a rolling pin or pulse them briefly in a blender. Then, use your hands (remember to wear gloves) to crumble the cookies into a fine texture.
Add the melted butter to the bowl of Oreo crumbs and mix thoroughly. Place the mixture into the bottom of serving cups. Use a spoon to press down gently.

Place the whipping cream in a bowl and whip until it doubles in volume and forms stiff peaks, then set aside in the refrigerator. Mix the cream cheese and peanut butter until smooth. Add sugar (in syrup form) to taste, and vanilla if desired, then mix well. Gently fold in the whipped cream until the mixture is uniform. Divide the cream into the prepared Oreo-lined cups. Garnish with grated chocolate and refrigerate for about 2-3 hours. (You can eat it immediately, but it tastes better and more refreshing when chilled).
Here is the final result. You can also sprinkle extra Oreo crumbs on top for decoration and extra crunch.

mon_an.ten: Homemade Refreshing Coconut Lime Ice Cream
mon_an.mo_ta: Ice cream is a highly popular summer snack. Quickly learn how to make this unique coconut lime ice cream to keep in your freezer whenever you crave it or simply to treat your friends!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Blender (or sieve), ice cream molds, 4 wooden popsicle sticks - tools
cac_buoc: Wash the limes thoroughly and soak them in salt water for 10 minutes. Use a zester to grate the lime peel into small shreds (use the zest of 3 limes).
Next, juice all 4 limes and remove the seeds.
Combine the yogurt and powdered sugar with the lime juice and zest. Stir the mixture well.

Pour the mixture into a blender along with the coconut milk and blend until smooth. Alternatively, you can pass the mixture through a sieve 3-4 times to achieve a smooth consistency similar to blending.
Mix the shredded coconut into the mixture. Then, pour it into the ice cream molds.
Place a wooden stick into the center of each mold and store in the freezer for 3-4 hours.

If you don't have molds, you can pour the mixture into a tray and use a round scoop to form balls later. Garnish with extra lime zest or dried coconut; the coconut lime ice cream will be even more fragrant and rich.

mon_an.mo_ta: Learn how to make passion fruit ice cream following this recipe. With this method, you will have a creamy, chilled passion fruit ice cream with an enticing aroma and the refreshing tartness of passion fruit.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Mix 1/2 of the whipping cream with the milk and sugar, then place on the stove over low heat. Heat until the milk just begins to simmer (do not let it reach a full boil).

Step 2: Place the egg yolks in a bowl and whisk until they turn a pale yellow. Slowly pour the hot cream-milk mixture from step 1 into the yolks. Whisk continuously while pouring to prevent the eggs from curdling due to the heat.
Step 3: Pour the egg and milk mixture back into the pot and cook over low heat until the mixture thickens, then turn off the heat.

Step 4: Pass the mixture through a sieve to ensure it is smooth and to remove any small lumps of cooked egg. Whisk the remaining whipping cream until it doubles in volume and forms peaks, then gently fold it into the strained mixture. Mix in the prepared passion fruit juice until the mixture is uniform.
Step 5: Pour the mixture into an ice cream maker and run the machine until finished, then transfer the ice cream to the freezer.

If you do not have an ice cream maker, whisk the mixture from step 4 until it cools down. This step incorporates air into the mixture, making the ice cream fluffy and soft rather than icy. Place the cream in the freezer; after about 2 hours, when it starts to set, use a spoon or fork to fluff it up and return it to the freezer. Repeat this every hour for 3-4 times before serving.

When serving, use an ice cream scoop to form small round balls. You can drizzle a bit of fresh passion fruit juice (with seeds) or passion fruit syrup over the top to make the dish more beautiful and delicious. You can also use the passion fruit shells as cute serving cups (ensure they are washed thoroughly before use).
Note the following points for perfect passion fruit ice cream:
The amount of sugar depends on the tartness of the passion fruit. Season to taste to avoid the ice cream being too sour or too sweet.
Add the passion fruit juice at the final step without cooking it to preserve the vitamins and aroma.
In steps 1 and 3, ensure you only cook the milk/cream mixture over low heat; do not boil it over high heat or the ice cream will fail.

In step 2, pour the milk into the egg yolks very slowly, spoon by spoon, while whisking constantly. Do not pour all the milk in at once, as the eggs will curdle quickly, and the ice cream will lose its creamy texture and flavor.

Using the same basic ingredients, you can make other types of ice cream by replacing the fruit or flavorings, such as matcha, strawberry, mulberry, or young rice (cốm) ice cream. You can refer to other delicious ice cream recipes to create treats for the whole family.

mon_an.mo_ta: Fried ice cream with a crispy outer shell and a cold center is wonderful, isn't it? This recipe guarantees a delicious result!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Strawberry, vanilla, or your favorite ice cream
cac_buoc: Ingredients needed for fried ice cream:
Step 1:
Place a scoop of ice cream onto plastic wrap and wrap it tightly into a ball. You can make the scoops as large or small as you like.
Place the ice cream balls in the freezer for 1 hour to firm up.
Step 2:
Whisk the egg and milk together in a bowl.
Step 3:
After 1 hour, take the ice cream balls out and roll them in the panko breadcrumbs first.
Then dip the ball into the egg mixture. Continue rolling in breadcrumbs and dipping in egg 3-4 times. Wrap the ball in plastic wrap again and return to the freezer for 2-3 hours.
Note: In this step, try to work as quickly as possible so the ice cream doesn't melt.
Step 4:
Heat a pot of oil (the oil must be deep enough to submerge the ice cream balls). When the oil is hot, take the ice cream balls from the freezer and fry them over high heat.
Once the shell is golden and crispy, quickly remove the ice cream.

Presentation: Serve the fried ice cream on a plate, garnish with whipped cream and colored sugar for a more attractive look. The fried ice cream will have a very crispy shell while the inside remains frozen.

mon_an.ten: Simple and Delicious Homemade Boxed Banana Ice Cream
mon_an.mo_ta: The sweltering summer heat makes chilled ice cream more appealing than ever. This is also the season for many delicious fruits, providing abundant ingredients for you to showcase your skills in making refreshing treats for the family. Don't hesitate—try this simple banana ice cream recipe that preserves the natural flavor of ripe bananas. Make delicious boxed banana ice cream at home with these easy instructions. Enter a world of sweetness from ripe bananas, full-cream condensed milk, and a touch of vanilla. Freeze and enjoy this unique, cold treat whenever you like.
cac_buoc: Once you have all the ingredients ready, follow these steps to make the banana ice cream:
Step 1: Use a knife to slice the bananas lengthwise into 3 or 4 equal pieces.
Step 2: Mix the yogurt, condensed milk, and coconut milk in a large bowl.

Step 3: Scoop 1 tablespoon of the mixture into the container, then arrange a layer of bananas. Sprinkle with roasted peanuts and shredded coconut, then add another tablespoon of the coconut milk mixture. Repeat until all bananas are used. For the top layer, sprinkle generously with peanuts and shredded coconut, pressing down slightly so they stick to the cream.
Step 4: Place the container in the freezer for at least 4 hours until the banana ice cream is completely set.

Step 5: Once frozen solid, dip the container into a basin of water, then remove and flip it upside down so the ice cream slides out. Use a knife to cut the ice cream into bite-sized pieces and invite everyone to enjoy this cool, sweet treat.

This banana ice cream method is simple and not too elaborate, but you will be surprised by its deliciousness. Making it in a plastic container is very neat; when eating, just slice what you need, then close the lid and return it to the freezer. Start making this banana ice cream right away.
Notes for making banana ice cream:
Use ripe bananas: Ensure the bananas are fully ripe for the best flavor. Ripe bananas provide natural sweetness and aroma.
Choose sweet jackfruit: (Optional variation) Select ripe and fragrant jackfruit for a smooth, creamy texture.
Freezer storage: After making the ice cream, place the container in the freezer for the required time to harden. Ensure the freezer temperature is cold enough to freeze it completely.
Shake before freezing: Before placing the container in the freezer, give it a gentle shake to ensure the ingredients are evenly distributed.
Be patient while freezing: It takes about 8-10 hours (or as specified) for the ice cream to freeze completely. Do not try to take it out too early, as it may not be set.
Preservation: Once frozen, keep it in the freezer to maintain freshness. For longer storage, cover the container tightly with plastic wrap or foil to prevent loss of aroma and quality.

mon_an.ten: Quick and Easy Banana Ice Cream
mon_an.mo_ta: Bananas are rich in fiber, vitamins, minerals, and energy. Eating bananas helps supplement vitamins, reduce stress, stimulate digestion, and prevent constipation. Today, we bring you a super-fast banana ice cream recipe that doesn't require an ice cream maker. With this method, it only takes 5-10 minutes to complete the process using simple, easy-to-find ingredients.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the coconut sauce for the banana ice cream.
Take about 200g of shredded coconut and blend with 250ml of water, then strain and squeeze to get the coconut milk. Add sugar, stir to dissolve, and heat over low heat.

Mix the tapioca starch with a little water and pour it into the coconut milk. Stir constantly while adding the starch to prevent lumps until the mixture thickens. Bring to a boil, then turn off the heat. Let it cool.
Step 2:
Peel the bananas and place each one into a plastic bag. You can use clean plastic bags, zipper bags, or plastic wrap.
Use a heavy object (a cutting board, plate, or clean knife) to flatten the banana.
You can cut the flattened banana in half for easier serving.
Next, coat both sides of the banana piece with the coconut sauce prepared in Step 1.
Sprinkle crushed roasted peanuts and shredded coconut on top.
Wrap it up with the plastic bag/zipper bag or plastic wrap and place in the freezer. After a few hours, you will have a sweet, cool banana treat.

If you don't want to make coconut milk from fresh coconut, you can use canned coconut milk instead. However, since this recipe still requires shredded coconut, buying a small amount at the market might be difficult. I recommend buying shredded coconut, setting some aside for the topping, and blending the rest to make the coconut milk.
When making coconut milk, use hot water to extract the most liquid. Divide the water and blend/squeeze in batches rather than adding all the water at once.
If you prefer popsicles, instead of wrapping the banana, insert a wooden stick through the banana piece, then wrap it and place it in the freezer. The result will be a banana popsicle.
If this banana ice cream doesn't satisfy your cravings, try other recipes like Japanese ice cream or strawberry ice cream. You will surely love them!
Above is the method for making delicious banana ice cream. If you have any questions while reading, please give us feedback. We will answer your questions in detail.

mon_an.mo_ta: The fragrant and chewy taste of green rice (cốm) is a signature culinary feature of Hanoi. Try this recipe to make your own refreshing and delicious green rice ice cream for the whole family.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Place the milk and pandan leaves in a pot and bring to a gentle simmer, then turn off the heat.
Scoop a small ladle of milk into another pot or bowl and soak the green rice until softened. Set the remaining milk aside.
Step 2: Separate the egg yolks and whisk them with sugar until the mixture turns a pale yellow.
Step 3: Slowly pour the hot milk mixture from Step 1 into the whisked eggs from Step 2.
Whisk continuously while pouring to prevent the eggs from curdling.

Step 4: Place the egg and milk mixture on the stove and cook over low heat. Meanwhile, pour the heavy cream into a bowl and whip until stiff peaks form. Once the egg-milk mixture has thickened and is hot, fold in the whipped cream, stir well, and turn off the heat.
Step 5: Pass the mixture through a sieve to remove any lumps from the eggs.
Add the green rice that was soaked in milk, pour into a blender, and blend until smooth.
Step 6: Pour the final mixture into an ice cream maker and follow the specific instructions for your machine.

If you don't have an ice cream maker, don't worry. Here is an easy manual method: Pour the blended mixture into a container and freeze for 3-4 hours. Take it out and whisk thoroughly to break up ice crystals, then return it to the freezer. Repeat this every 30 minutes to 1 hour for about 3-4 times to complete the process.

The most important part of making green rice ice cream is choosing the rice. You should choose natural, chewy, and soft green rice with a natural pale green color. Avoid buying dark green rice, as it often contains artificial coloring and is not as safe to eat.

In Step 5, blending the green rice into the mixture ensures it is finely ground so that the grains don't get stuck in the ice cream maker's mixing paddles, which could damage the motor. If making it manually, you can skip the blending step and leave the grains whole for a chewy texture. If using a machine, you can also sprinkle some whole green rice on top when serving to enjoy the rustic fragrance.
Using a similar method, you can also try making other flavors like Japanese-style ice cream or strawberry ice cream following the same principles.

mon_an.mo_ta: Summer has arrived, bringing sweltering heat. To cool down, we introduce this delicious, nutritious, and refreshing strawberry ice cream recipe. The ingredients and method are very simple; just follow these steps for a perfect summer treat!
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients:
Step 1:
Place the strawberries in a bowl, add 70g of sugar and the lemon juice, and mix well.
Place the mixture in the freezer for about 40 minutes. After 40 minutes, take the strawberries out and mash them thoroughly (you can also use a blender).
Step 2:

Place the egg yolk in a bowl with the remaining 60g of sugar, condensed milk, and salt. Use a hand whisk to beat until the mixture is smooth and fluffy. Remember to whisk steadily and gradually increase your speed.
Step 3:
Add the fresh milk to the egg mixture along with the mashed strawberries and stir well. Then, add the whipping cream and mix everything together.
Step 4:
Pour the mixture into a container, seal the lid tightly, and place it in the freezer.
After 1 hour, take it out and stir the ice cream once. Repeat this 3 times to ensure the ice cream is smooth and free of ice crystals.
Your delicious and refreshing strawberry ice cream is now ready!

mon_an.mo_ta: Learn how to make delicious chocolate chip strawberry ice cream. This recipe features a strawberry base studded with fresh strawberry pieces and chocolate cookies for a delightful treat.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 250ml sour cream (can be substituted with yogurt)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Make the strawberry ice cream base
Wash the strawberries and remove the stems. Halve 350g of the strawberries.
Place the strawberries, cream cheese, sour cream, and whole milk into a blender.
Add the lemon juice, sugar, and a pinch of salt, then blend until smooth.
Pour the mixture into an ice cream maker.
Step 2:
Thinly slice the remaining strawberries and toss with a few tablespoons of sugar.
Place the chocolate and heavy cream in a bowl and melt over a double boiler.
Spread the melted chocolate onto the chocolate cookies and place them in the refrigerator until the chocolate sets.
Monitor the ice cream maker; when it has been running for about 25 minutes, add the sugared strawberry slices...
...and the chocolate-coated cookies, chopped into small pieces.
Let the machine run for another 5 minutes, then transfer the ice cream to the freezer.
This is the final product after taking it out of the freezer!
When serving, use an ice cream scoop to create round spheres and arrange them beautifully in a bowl.

Strawberries are rich in vitamin C, antioxidants, and folic acid, which are great for health. You can eat them whole as dessert or process them into ice cream, drinks, and smoothies. When buying strawberries, don't just look for large ones; medium-sized berries are often tastier and sweeter. Choose firm, plump berries with uniform color and shiny skin, free of bruises or rot (bruised berries spoil quickly and spread to others). The stems should be intact and bright green.

Good strawberries must have a characteristic aroma; if they look beautiful but have no scent, do not choose them. Pick berries that are just ripe, as strawberries do not ripen further once picked (unlike many other fruits).

Chocolate chip strawberry ice cream is the perfect cooling dessert for the whole family in summer. The naturally beautiful pink color accented with fresh strawberry bits and chocolate cookies makes it irresistible.

mon_an.mo_ta: Today I want to share a refreshing mulberry ice cream recipe to quench your thirst on hot days. Add this to your summer dessert collection!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the mulberries
Choose plump, ripe mulberries. Wash them, place them in a pot, and add the juice of 1/2 a lemon.
Add sugar and cook over low heat...
Until the mulberries release their juice and thicken into a syrup, then turn off the heat.
Use a fine-mesh sieve to strain and set the mulberry syrup aside.
Step 2:
Combine the remaining 1/2 of the sugar with the milk. Stir and cook over low heat until the milk just begins to simmer.
Place the egg yolks in a bowl and use a whisk to beat until slightly fluffy and pale yellow.
Slowly ladle the hot milk into the egg mixture, whisking constantly to prevent the yolks from curdling due to the heat.
Once about half of the milk is incorporated into the yolks, stop pouring and stir well.
Pour the mixture back into the pot with the remaining hot milk. Cook over low heat until the mixture thickens, then turn off the heat.
Strain the mixture through a sieve to remove any lumps caused by the heat.
Step 3: Place the heavy cream in a bowl and whip with a mixer until stiff peaks form, then pour in the mixture from Step 2.
Add the mulberry syrup prepared in Step 1 and stir well.
Continue until the mixture is uniform.
Pour the mixture into an ice cream maker and run for a few hours until you have delicious mulberry ice cream.
This is the final result. You can set aside some fresh or cooked mulberries from Step 1 to garnish the ice cream.

Don't worry if you don't have an ice cream maker. Simply whisk the mixture from Step 3 until it cools completely (to incorporate air for a soft texture), then place it in the freezer. After about 2 hours, when it starts to set, take it out and whisk to break up ice crystals (you can also use a spoon), then return it to the freezer. Repeat this every hour for 4-5 times until the ice cream is fluffy. This manual method also works for Japanese-style ice cream.

mon_an.mo_ta: Pineapple ice cream is a perfect choice for summer with its fragrant aroma, sweet and sour notes, and icy coolness. Try making this wonderful treat!
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients:
Peel the pineapple and cut it into small pieces.
Peel the banana and cut it into 4 pieces.
Halve the lemon, squeeze for juice, and remove the seeds.
Making the pineapple ice cream:
Place the banana, sugar, lemon juice, and pineapple into a blender. Blend until completely smooth.
Pass the fruit mixture through a fine-mesh sieve into a large bowl.
Chill the fruit mixture in the refrigerator for 3-4 hours before making the ice cream.
After chilling, take the mixture out and stir in the Cointreau.

Pour the mixture into an ice cream maker or the freezer. If using a freezer, take it out every 30 minutes to whisk away ice crystals with a mixer, then return to the freezer. Repeat for 2-3 hours until the ice cream is soft, fluffy, and free of ice crystals.
Note:
To peel a pineapple quickly, cut it into quarters lengthwise, then run your knife along the flesh at a depth that removes the eyes while keeping the fruit intact.

mon_an.mo_ta: Summer is here! Discover these delicious cooling snacks. Chocolate-covered kiwi popsicles are a must-try this summer, especially for kids. A cool, sweet-bitter chocolate layer with creamy coconut milk coats fresh, attractive kiwi slices. The method is incredibly simple—just a few basic steps and you're done. Let's get started!
cac_buoc: Steps to make chocolate-covered kiwi popsicles:
Peel the kiwis and cut them into thick slices.
Insert a wooden stick into each kiwi slice (from the bottom up as shown in the photo).
Place the kiwi sticks in the freezer for 20-30 minutes to firm up.
Finely chop the dark chocolate.
Place the coconut milk and dark chocolate in a small pot over low heat.
Stir the chocolate continuously until completely melted and smooth, taking care not to burn it.
Once melted, pour the chocolate into a bowl.
Take the kiwi sticks out of the freezer, dip them completely into the chocolate, then quickly return them to the freezer for at least one hour until the chocolate sets hard.
Note: You can roll the kiwi popsicles in crushed roasted peanuts or colorful sprinkles to make them more attractive.
After 1-2 hours, take the chocolate-covered kiwi popsicles out and enjoy.
It's that simple! You have now finished your kiwi popsicles.
You can also use mango, apple, or pear to replace the kiwi if you prefer.
These popsicles are sweet, slightly tart, and very refreshing. They are a healthy snack that is much better than store-bought fast food.

mon_an.mo_ta: Another simple and delicious ice cream recipe to help you quench your thirst on hot summer days. Let's learn how to make these strawberry popsicles!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, soak and wash the strawberries, then drain them thoroughly.
Step 2:
Slice 4 strawberries for decoration. For the remaining strawberries, remove the stems, cut them in half, and place them in a blender with the sugar and a little milk if desired.
Step 3:
Blend until smooth and taste to adjust the sweetness.
Step 4:
Once blended, place a few strawberry slices into the molds, trying to press them against the sides.
Pour the blended strawberry mixture into the molds and insert the sticks.
Step 5:
Place the popsicles in the freezer for 3-4 hours or until frozen solid.
To easily remove the popsicles from the molds, dip the mold in warm water for about 10 seconds and then pull them out.
Your strawberry popsicles are finished!
The strawberries give the popsicles a beautiful color, and the decorative slices make them look very appealing!
On a hot day, having a few strawberry popsicles in the freezer to snack on is wonderful!
If you prefer a creamier version, you can add more milk during the blending step.
Other fruit popsicle suggestions for you:
Mango popsicles
Peach and orange popsicles
Watermelon popsicles

mon_an.mo_ta: In summer weather, a glass of cold ice cream is perfect for beating the heat. Make this delicious and nutritious chocolate caramel ice cream yourself!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, finely chop the chocolate.
Step 2:
Prepare 2 pots. Put the heavy cream and sugar into separate pots and heat them up. Keep the heat low for both as cream boils over easily and sugar burns quickly.
Step 3:
When the sugar begins to melt and turns a deep amber color, turn off the heat and pour in the heated cream, stirring constantly.
Step 4:
Continue stirring until all the cream is incorporated; if the mixture foams, keep stirring.
Step 5:

Add the chopped chocolate and salt, and continue stirring until the chocolate is completely melted. Stir firmly to incorporate any caramel stuck to the bottom of the pot. Once smooth, pour the mixture into a bowl and set aside.
Step 6:
Separate the eggs and place the yolks in a bowl.
Place the remaining sugar and whole milk in a pot and heat. When the mixture just begins to boil, pour it into the bowl with the egg yolks, whisking constantly.
Step 7:
Whisk until the eggs are cooked by the heat, then strain the mixture through a sieve for a smooth texture.
Step 8:
Add the chocolate mixture and vanilla extract, and whisk until completely smooth. Pour into a tray and place in the freezer.
Step 9:
Every 30 minutes, take the ice cream out of the freezer, stir well, and return it to the freezer. Repeat this until the ice cream reaches your desired thickness.
This chocolate caramel ice cream is very smooth and rich!
The signature flavor of chocolate combined with the sweet aroma of caramel makes this ice cream irresistible.
On a hot day, serving a glass of cool chocolate ice cream to friends is a delight!
With a little patience, you will have a delicious treat to enjoy!
Try making this chocolate ice cream to treat your friends on a hot day!

mon_an.mo_ta: Yogurt pouches are a wonderful dessert, combining the richness of milk with the refreshing tartness of yogurt. The best part is you can easily make them at home without a complex ice cream maker. With this simple recipe and easy-to-find ingredients, you can create delicious yogurt treats for the whole family. Enjoy the natural flavor of yogurt and share it with family and friends.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Mix the ingredients:
First, boil 1 liter of filtered water. Once boiled, add the condensed milk and stir until completely dissolved. Turn off the heat and let the milk cool to about 60-70°C.
Next, add 1 liter of fresh milk to the cooled condensed milk mixture and stir well.
Finally, add 2 containers of yogurt (as a starter) to the mixture and stir gently to dissolve. Let the mixture sit for about 5 minutes.
Step 2: Incubation
Method 1: Incubate directly in bags

Once the mixture has cooled slightly, pour it into small plastic bags and tie them tightly with rubber bands. Place the bags in a rice cooker and cover with a warm towel. Close the lid and incubate for 6-8 hours, preferably overnight. Once the yogurt has fermented in the bags, place them in the freezer for a few hours until frozen.
Method 2: Incubate before bagging
Pour the milk mixture into a large bowl or bottle and seal tightly. Place it in a rice cooker, microwave, oven (turned off), or wrap it in a blanket to incubate. Incubate for 8-10 hours.
After the yogurt has fermented, scoop it into plastic bags and tie them tightly. Place the bags in the freezer or refrigerator for about 3 hours, and your yogurt pouches are ready to enjoy.
You can also use strawberry, orange, chocolate, or grape-flavored milk to create different varieties to suit your taste.
Notes for making yogurt pouches at home:
Hygiene: Before starting, ensure all tools and surfaces are clean. This prevents unwanted bacteria from growing in the yogurt.

Temperature: Ensure the incubation temperature is correct. For direct bagging, incubate for 6-8 hours at around 45-50°C. For the bowl method, incubate for 8-10 hours at the same temperature. This helps the yogurt bacteria develop the characteristic flavor and texture.
Do not move: During incubation, avoid moving the yogurt bags too much. This can disrupt the fermentation process and cause an uneven texture.
Incubation location: Place the yogurt in a quiet, stable spot away from direct sunlight or extreme ambient temperatures.
Check the results: After the incubation time, check if the yogurt has reached the desired thickness and tartness. If needed, you can incubate it a bit longer to achieve the desired result.

mon_an.mo_ta: Summer brings sweltering heat. Cooling down with delicious eggnog ice cream will help you feel much more refreshed! Check out the recipe below!
cac_buoc: Ingredients you need to prepare:
Step 1:
First, if using a vanilla bean, split it and scrape out the seeds. Add both the pod and the seeds to a pot. Add the cinnamon, nutmeg, salt, milk, and 1/2 of the heavy cream.
Step 2:
Heat the mixture over low heat until very hot but not boiling, then remove from the heat and add the sugar. Stir until the sugar is completely dissolved.
Cover the pot and let it steep for 30 minutes.
Step 3:
Place the egg yolks in a large bowl. Pour in a small amount of the warm milk mixture while whisking constantly.
Step 4:
Once well-blended, pour the egg-milk mixture back into the pot.
Step 5:
Pour the remaining heavy cream into a large bowl, then strain the egg-milk mixture through a sieve into the cream.
Step 6:
Add the rum or brandy to the mixture.
Step 7:
Pour the mixture into a tray and place it in the freezer. Every 30 minutes, take it out and stir well, then return it to the freezer until the ice cream reaches your desired consistency.
This whipped egg ice cream has a flavor reminiscent of the eggnog typically enjoyed during Christmas!
You can adjust the amount of sugar to suit your taste!
This sweet, creamy recipe with a light hint of alcohol is sure to delight you!

mon_an.mo_ta: Eating ice cream in cool weather is a pure delight. You don't have to go far; you can make your own at home and enjoy it to your heart's content. Let's get started with this simple ice cream recipe below!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Pour the fresh milk into a pot and heat it; remove from heat once it boils.
Separate the egg yolks and whisk them with sugar. Add this to the pot of milk and continue to simmer over low heat, stirring constantly.
When the milk mixture boils, stir well until the egg and milk mixture slightly thickens and coats the back of a spoon. Remove from heat, add the vanilla, and stir well again.
Strain the mixture through a sieve and let it cool.
Step 2:
Pour the mixture into an ice cream maker and churn for 25-30 minutes until the ice cream is fluffy.
To make the ice cream richer and creamier, you can fold in 300 ml of heavy cream after the ice cream has been churned.
Place in the freezer. When serving, use a scoop to take the ice cream out. It is delicious with fruit or shaved chocolate. You can also buy waffle cones at stores or supermarkets to serve with it.
Good luck and enjoy your meal!

mon_an.mo_ta: Blueberry yogurt ice cream is not only delicious but also has an extremely attractive color. Learn how to make blueberry yogurt ice cream to show off your skills to your family! The process is not difficult, so you can completely make it at home. On a hot summer day, enjoying a cold, refreshing cup of blueberry yogurt ice cream is the best! Let's find out how to make it in the article below!
cac_buoc: To make this blueberry yogurt ice cream, first place the blueberries, sugar, lemon juice, and salt in a medium saucepan.
Heat over medium heat and stir constantly until the sugar is completely dissolved.
Use a hand masher to crush the blueberries; you can also use a blender to purée them.
After mashing, turn off the heat and let the mixture cool for 20 minutes.
Add the yogurt and milk, then stir well until the mixture is completely combined.
Place the mixture in the refrigerator for a few hours, or ideally overnight.

Pour the mixture into an ice cream maker for 25 minutes or follow the manufacturer's instructions. Transfer the blueberry yogurt ice cream to an airtight container and freeze for a few hours before serving. If you don't have an ice cream maker, pour the mixture into a container and stir every few hours (repeat 3-4 times) to break up ice crystals until the ice cream is finished. Now you have completed your blueberry yogurt ice cream!

mon_an.mo_ta: A cool, fragrant dessert is perfect for this weather. Learn how to make chocolate pudding to treat the whole family!
cac_buoc: Check out the ingredients needed for this delicious chocolate pudding!
Step 1: Sift the cocoa powder, cornstarch, and salt together into a bowl.

Step 2: Slowly pour the heavy cream into the cocoa mixture. Whisk constantly while adding. It will become a thick paste, so you can use a spoon to mix. Mix until completely combined. Add two egg yolks and continue to mix well. Set aside.
Step 3: Stir the milk and sugar together in a saucepan over medium heat until the sugar is completely dissolved.

Step 4: When the milk starts to simmer at the edges of the pan, turn off the heat. Slowly pour half of the milk into the cocoa mixture, stirring constantly. Add only a little milk at a time to make mixing easier. Then, pour the entire cocoa mixture back into the milk pot and place it on the stove. Cook while stirring constantly to prevent the powder from burning at the bottom.
Step 5: Cook until the pudding boils. Lower the heat and whisk vigorously for 2 minutes.

Step 6: Turn off the heat, add the vanilla, and stir well. Then, pour the hot pudding into a 23 x 23cm baking dish. Gently shake the mold to level the pudding, then place a piece of plastic wrap directly on the surface. Refrigerate the chocolate pudding for at least one hour before serving.
When eating, take the pudding out and whisk it to loosen the texture!

mon_an.mo_ta: Rich with an attractive chocolate flavor, this chocolate sorbet will make you feel much cooler in this hot weather.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
In a large saucepan, mix 375ml of water with sugar, cocoa powder, and salt. Bring to a boil, stirring frequently during the process.
Once boiling, continue to stir for another 45 seconds.
Step 2:
Turn off the heat, add the chocolate, and stir until the chocolate is melted.
Step 3:
Then add the vanilla and the remaining 180ml of water, and stir well. Pour the mixture into a blender and blend for 15 seconds.
Step 4:
After that, pour the chocolate mixture into an ice cream maker and follow the instructions.
This refreshing chocolate sorbet is perfect for summer weather.

mon_an.mo_ta: With this whipped cream recipe, you'll have authentic "made by me" delicious dishes!
cac_buoc: Step 1:

Place the can of coconut milk in the refrigerator overnight to separate the fat from the coconut water. Note: Do not rush this step by putting the coconut milk in the freezer, as it will freeze solid and won't separate.
Step 2:
Open the can of coconut milk and scoop out the thick cream layer on top into a bowl that has been chilled in the refrigerator for 15 minutes.
Step 3:
You can use the coconut water at the bottom of the can directly or store it in the refrigerator for other dishes.
Step 4:
Whip the coconut cream just like regular heavy cream on high speed for 2 minutes. When the cream forms stiff peaks, it is ready.
Use it to decorate drinks...
... or eat with fruit.
If you want to enhance the flavor of the whipped cream, you can definitely add chocolate...
It can also be used as a filling or frosting for cakes.

mon_an.mo_ta: Banana coconut ice cream is very easy to make. You can keep it in the freezer and take it out whenever you want, helping to beat the heat and providing extra energy to keep working.
cac_buoc: Step 1: In a small saucepan, mix the coconut milk with sugar and salt. Heat the mixture until the sugar dissolves. Let it cool in an ice bath for 30 minutes.
Step 2: Spread a piece of plastic wrap on a table or flat surface. Place the halved banana on the plastic wrap. Fold the plastic wrap over and use a rolling pin to flatten the banana.

Step 3: Open the plastic wrap and drizzle the coconut milk mixture over the banana. Sprinkle crushed roasted peanuts on top. Then sprinkle shredded coconut. Finally, add 1 more tablespoon of coconut milk to cover any exposed banana.
Fold the plastic wrap back over, flip it over, and repeat the process on the other side.
Step 4: Insert a bamboo skewer through the plastic wrap into the banana. Fold the plastic wrap and place it in the freezer. This banana coconut ice cream can be eaten after 4 hours.

mon_an.mo_ta: Lime coconut ice cream has a unique flavor: the tartness of lime and the fragrant, rich taste of coconut blend together to bring a refreshing sensation. This dessert doesn't take much time and will surely delight you!
cac_buoc: First, wash the limes thoroughly and soak them in salt water for 10 minutes to reduce the bitterness of the peel. Next, zest the limes into small strips (use the zest of 3 limes).
Then, juice the 4 limes and remove the seeds.
Next, mix the yogurt and powdered sugar with the lime juice and zest. Stir the mixture well until the ingredients are combined and the sugar is completely dissolved.
Then, put the mixture into a blender along with the coconut milk and blend until smooth. You can also use a sieve to strain the mixture 3-4 times to achieve a smooth consistency similar to blending.
Once done, mix the mixture with 30g of shredded coconut, stirring well to combine. Then, pour the mixture into the ice pop molds.
For each mold, place a wooden stick in the center and store in the freezer for 3-4 hours.
Finally, take the ice cream out and enjoy.
Notes for delicious lime coconut ice cream:

If you don't have molds, you can pour the mixture into a tray and place it in the freezer. Every 3 hours, take the ice cream out and whisk it to keep it fluffy. Repeat this 3-4 times for a delicious result. Finally, just use a scoop to serve the ice cream in a glass, accompanied by some dried coconut, biscuits, and fresh coconut for a wonderful treat.

mon_an.mo_ta: On a hot summer day, making pure pineapple ice cream like this can replace glasses of pineapple juice. The mildly sweet and tart, cold flavor with a fragrant pineapple aroma will make you love it. Let's learn how to make simple pineapple ice cream using ice cube trays to treat your family!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Pineapple juice or any juice of your choice
cac_buoc: An ice tray like this is probably only enough for one person! 😀
Step 1: Preparation
Dice the fresh pineapple.
You should place the ice tray in the freezer to chill beforehand.
Step 2: Execution
Take the ice tray out and pour the juice into each slot just like making regular ice cubes.
Note: You can add sugar, milk, or coconut milk if you prefer a richer flavor. 😀
Drop a few pieces of diced pineapple into each slot; add more if you like! 😀
Cover the tray tightly with plastic wrap.
Insert a toothpick into the center of each pineapple ice cube.
Place the tray in the freezer until the ice cream is frozen solid.
Peel off the plastic wrap and enjoy! 😀
Without needing an ice cream maker or complicated ingredients and time-consuming steps, you still have delicious, cold pineapple ice cream bites to enjoy during the hot summer.

mon_an.mo_ta: A cold cup of coffee granita will lift your spirits significantly. With this recipe, you won't have to brave the sun to go to a shop; you can enjoy it whenever you like.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients for the Italian coffee granita.
Whip the cream until stiff peaks form; set aside.
Use a grater to shave a little chocolate.
Cut the remaining chocolate into small square pieces.
Step 2: Steps to make the Italian coffee granita.
First, place a pot on the stove and pour in 250 ml of water to boil.
Add the granulated sugar and the vanilla bean. Remember to stir so the sugar dissolves completely.
When the water boils, add the Espresso coffee, stir a few times, then turn off the heat.
Pour the coffee into a metal bowl through a fine-mesh sieve to remove the vanilla bean bits.
Place the coffee bowl in the freezer for about 1 hour.
Then, take the bowl out and use a whisk to break up the frozen coffee.

Put the bowl back in the freezer; after about 30 minutes, take it out and whisk again. Repeat this process until the coffee ice is granular and cannot freeze solid anymore; this is your coffee granita.
Put the coffee granita into a glass and sprinkle with a little powdered sugar if you like it sweeter.
Put the whipped cream into a piping bag and pipe it into each glass.
Decorate each glass with chocolate pieces or shaved chocolate.
Notes for making Italian coffee granita:
Espresso is a type of coffee originating from Italy; however, if you cannot buy this type, you can use regular black coffee.
Similarly, if you cannot buy a vanilla bean, you can substitute it with a few drops of vanilla extract. Actually, buying these ingredients is not difficult; you can find them all at the supermarket.
When pouring the coffee into a bowl, I recommend using a metal bowl because it will freeze faster than plastic or ceramic bowls.

Granita is a traditional Italian dish, and coffee granita is the most popular variety. The aroma of Espresso is very seductive; the slightly bitter coffee frozen into refreshing ice helps dispel the summer heat. Additionally, the rich whipped cream and a bit of chocolate make the granita more diverse and special.

The hot summer makes you feel extremely uncomfortable, so dispel the fatigue with a glass of Italian coffee granita as instructed above. I am sure this dish will lift your mood instantly. Making Italian coffee granita is very simple and doesn't take much time; I think anyone can do it. On free weekends, explore Italian snacks with your friends and family, starting with this coffee granita.

mon_an.mo_ta: In hot weather, enjoying this beautiful 2-layer mango yogurt jelly is wonderful. It's so delicious and refreshing that you'll definitely want more!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Bottom jelly layer: - 10g agar-agar powder (for a crunchy texture)
5g flexible jelly powder (for a chewy texture)
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, add the agar-agar powder, flexible jelly powder, and sugar to a pot. Pour in the drinking yogurt and water as well!
Step 2:
Turn on the stove and stir until the sugar is completely dissolved.
Note: Do not over-boil, as bubbles trapped in the jelly will not look attractive.
Step 3:
In a separate bowl, mix the mango purée with the hot milk.
Step 4:
Pour this mixture into the jelly mixture you just made.
Step 5:
Pour the mixture into small cups, filling them partially to leave room for the top jelly layer!
Then, place them in the refrigerator (for about 30 minutes).
Step 6:

Next, make the top jelly layer while waiting for the bottom layer to set. Add the agar-agar powder, flexible jelly powder, sugar, and water to a pot and heat. Stir until the sugar is completely dissolved.
Step 7:
Take the jelly cups out of the refrigerator and pour the newly made mixture into each cup.
Add the diced mango pieces onto the top jelly layer.
Step 8:
Finally, place them back in the refrigerator and wait for about 2 hours before serving.
You can be more creative with a layer of coconut jelly; it matches the flavor perfectly and looks very beautiful.

mon_an.mo_ta: Mint chocolate chip ice cream appeals to everyone from its color to its flavor: the mint provides a refreshing sensation and a cool green hue, while the fluffy layers of ice cream melt in your mouth, blending with moderately sweet chocolate for a delightful treat. Take some time to make this wonderful ice cream for your family! Check out our recipe below.
cac_buoc: Step 1:

First, pour the fresh milk into a pot and heat it up. Then, add the fresh cream and sugar, stirring well. Remember to stir steadily so the ingredients blend together, ensuring the ice cream has an even sweetness and a fluffier texture.
Step 2:
Clean the mint leaves by removing the roots and any wilted, yellowed, or damaged parts. Wash the leaves thoroughly and pat dry with paper towels or let them drain completely.
Once the milk, sugar, and cream mixture is uniform, add the mint leaves. Stir for another 3-4 minutes then turn off the heat (the mixture should be about 40°C, feeling warm to the touch).

Let the mint leaves steep in the pot for at least 1 hour, then strain through a mesh sieve into a bowl. Steeping for 1 hour helps the ice cream achieve an eye-catching green color and a signature mint aroma.
Step 3:
Next, keep half of the mint leaves and put them in a blender to process with the milk mixture (if you prefer a strong mint flavor, use all the leaves from the recipe).
Place a clean cheesecloth over a sieve and strain the mixture until smooth (this step ensures the ice cream is silky and free of grit).
Step 4:
Squeeze the cheesecloth firmly to ensure all the liquid is extracted.
Pour the cream mixture into an ice cream maker and run for 30 minutes.
Step 5:
While waiting, finely chop the dark chocolate.
Finally, add the dark chocolate to the ice cream maker for another 2-3 minutes.
Use an ice cream scoop to serve into glasses and enjoy.
Notes for perfect mint chocolate chip ice cream:
To make the ice cream delicious, stir the mixture well while heating so the ingredients blend into a soft, smooth, and fluffy base.
If you like more chocolate or a stronger mint flavor, simply add more chocolate and mint leaves.

If you don't have an ice cream maker, you can use the traditional method: Mix the milk-cream mixture with the chocolate first, then pour into a plastic container with a lid and place in the freezer. Every 30 minutes, take it out and stir well until the mixture is uniform. Freeze for 2-3 hours before eating. Remember to keep stirring until the ice cream is fluffy, colorful, and aromatic.
Since this is fresh ice cream, it can only be stored in the freezer for a maximum of 1 week; after that, the quality will decline, so only make a sufficient amount.

Mint chocolate chip ice cream delights with its color and flavor: from the refreshing minty sensation and cool green look to the fluffy layers that melt in your mouth with sweet chocolate. Take some time to treat your family to this wonderful dessert!

mon_an.mo_ta: A sweet gift for your "special someone," both delicious and refreshing for this summer! Let's get into the kitchen and make this cookie ice cream right away!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 450g chocolate cookie crust (or any cookies of your choice)
cac_buoc: Ingredients you need to prepare for the cookie ice cream!
Step 1:
First, you need a deep tray. Line the inside of the tray with a layer of plastic wrap.
Step 2:
Place the cookies in a bowl, crush them finely, and mix well with the melted butter.
Step 3:
Place the cream, powdered sugar, and vanilla in a bowl and whip until the cream is stiff.
Step 4:
Add the chocolate chips and fold them in.
Step 5:
Spread 1/3 of the crushed cookies evenly into the tray, followed by 1/2 of the cream.
Step 6:
Repeat until you have 3 layers of cookies and cream.
Step 7:
Wrap tightly with plastic wrap and place the tray in the freezer overnight.
Step 8:
Once the ice cream is completely frozen, remove the top plastic layer, place a plate over the tray, flip it over, and slowly lift the tray off.
With this cookie ice cream recipe, you don't have to take the ice cream out to stir every 30 minutes, yet it remains soft and fluffy!
Depending on the type of cookies you choose, the ice cream will have different flavors.
Instead of layering, you can mix all the ingredients together, and the cookie ice cream will look like this!
Mix in some regular cookies to add extra richness!

mon_an.ten: Delicious Coffee Chocolate Chip Ice Cream
mon_an.mo_ta: This coffee chocolate chip ice cream, made primarily from fresh cream and milk, is rich but not cloying. Furthermore, the seductive coffee aroma makes anyone who smells it want to eat it immediately. If you don't mind getting in the kitchen, make this ice cream to enjoy during these hot summer days!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Ice cream maker, round ice cream scoop - tools
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients for the coffee chocolate chip ice cream.
First, place the ice cream bowl in the freezer for about 12 hours before you start making the ice cream.
Step 2: Steps to make the delicious coffee chocolate chip ice cream.
First, place a pot on the stove over low heat and add the instant coffee, powdered sugar, and fresh milk one by one.
At this point, you can increase the heat slightly.
While heating, pay attention to stirring constantly so the sugar and coffee dissolve completely and do not burn.
Once the coffee has dissolved, turn off the heat and let it cool.
Next, add the whipping cream to the coffee-milk mixture and stir thoroughly until you get a soft, smooth mixture where all ingredients are well blended.
Then, pour the mixture into the pre-frozen ice cream bowl and place it in the ice cream maker.
Next, turn on the machine and let it run for about 30 minutes, then stop.
After the machine finishes, open the lid and add the chocolate chips. Turn the machine on for another 2-3 minutes then stop. This step helps the chocolate chips mix evenly into the ice cream.
Now our ice cream is finished. Use an ice cream scoop to form round balls into glasses, add a few wafer sticks for decoration, and enjoy.
Notes for perfect coffee chocolate chip ice cream.
For any leftover ice cream, place it in a plastic container, cover with a lid, and store it in the freezer.
If you prefer firmer ice cream, you can place it in the freezer for about 1 hour before serving.
To save time, you should put the ice cream bowl in the freezer the night before so you have the tools ready the next morning.
If you don't have an ice cream maker, you can use the following traditional method:

After mixing the coffee cream mixture, add the chocolate chips immediately, then put everything in the freezer for about 2-3 hours. Take the ice cream out and use a spoon to beat it until fluffy, then return it to the freezer. Repeat this beating process about 3-4 times with decreasing intervals; this way, the ice cream will be soft, smooth, not icy, and just as delicious as using a machine.

This coffee chocolate chip ice cream, made primarily from fresh cream and milk, is rich but not cloying. Furthermore, the seductive coffee aroma makes anyone who smells it want to eat it immediately. If you don't mind getting in the kitchen, make this ice cream to enjoy during these hot summer days!

mon_an.mo_ta: Fresh fruit ice cream with an appealing flavor and eye-catching colors is incredibly refreshing and will give you a sense of bliss when you taste it!
cac_buoc: How to make refreshing fruit ice cream
Step 1:

First, you need to wash all the fruits. For the strawberries, remove the stems. For the raspberries and blueberries, wash them gently so they don't get crushed. Then, put all the ingredients into a blender.
Blend until the mixture is soft and smooth.
Once uniform, strain through a mesh sieve to remove seeds so the ice cream will be smooth.
Step 2:
Next, squeeze the juice of 1 lemon (if hard to find, you can skip it or use 1/3 of a regular lime for aroma).
Pour the juice into the bowl of pureed fruit and mix well.
Next, place a pot on the stove, pour in the milk to heat it up, and add the egg whites.
Step 3:
Add sugar to the pot and stir well over low heat. When the mixture reaches 83°C, turn off the heat.
Next, pour the mixture into a bowl and place it in an ice bath to cool quickly, stirring constantly (this prevents the mixture from solidifying).
Once the mixture is cool, add the pureed fruit and stir until all ingredients are well combined.
Step 4:
Next, pour the liquid fresh cream into a pre-chilled metal or stainless steel bowl and use a hand mixer to whip until the cream is fluffy.
Add the whipped cream to the fruit-milk mixture and use a spoon to fold gently from bottom to top for about 3-5 minutes.

Finally, transfer the entire mixture into a large, wide-bottomed bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and place in the freezer. After 1 hour, take it out and stir with a fork, then return to the freezer for another hour. Repeat at least 3 times until the ice cream reaches the desired consistency.
Notes for perfect Italian-style fruit ice cream
When buying fruit, choose fresh, unbruised pieces.
When washing fruit, do not be too rough or they will be crushed and lose nutrients.
When straining the fruit mixture, do it thoroughly so there are no seeds or lumps.
Fruit ice cream can be made according to personal preference. Besides the suggested fruits, you can use any fruit you like.
When re-mixing the ice cream, stir and return to the freezer multiple times until the ice cream is fresh, aromatic, and has a certain fluffiness.

Since this is fresh ice cream, store it in an airtight container in the freezer for only 1 week to ensure the best flavor! Fresh fruit ice cream with an appealing flavor and eye-catching colors is incredibly refreshing and will give you a sense of bliss when you taste it!

mon_an.mo_ta: Avocados can be used to make many delicious snacks, and one of them is avocado ice cream. With the instructions below, you will have a truly delicious ice cream treat!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 1 packet of roasted peanuts or cashews
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, peel the avocados, chop them, and put them in a blender with the yogurt and powdered sugar. Blend until the mixture is smooth and uniform.
Step 2:
Whip the fresh cream. Note: whip on low speed and gradually so the cream becomes fluffy without becoming too thick!
Step 3:
Fold the whipped cream into the blended avocado mixture.
Step 4:
Next, crush the roasted cashews or peanuts and mix them into the avocado-cream mixture.
Step 5:
If you have an ice cream maker, simply chill the mixture, pour it into the machine, and turn it on according to the instructions.
If you don't have a machine, cover the mixture tightly with foil and leave it in the freezer overnight for a delicious peanut avocado ice cream.

Note: For a smoother texture, every 4 hours take it out and use a spoon to beat the mixture well, then return to the freezer. Repeat 2-4 times; the more you beat it, the fluffier and smoother it will be!
Look how appealing your avocado ice cream looks after one night!
You can replace peanuts with slivered almonds for another delicious version!
Try something new with dried coconut toppings!
Peanut avocado ice cream is both nutty and refreshing, perfect not just for hot days but also great to enjoy on cold rainy days!

mon_an.mo_ta: Patbingsu is a dessert loved by many young people, captivating them from the first taste with its smooth shaved ice, delicious milk, fresh vitamin-rich fruits, cool ice cream, and aromatic syrup. Make this delicious treat yourself to serve the whole family!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Korean rice cakes - a small amount
Sweetened condensed milk - a small amount
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, wash the red beans thoroughly with water.
Step 2:

Next, put the washed beans into a thick-bottomed pot, add water, and bring to a boil over medium heat for 10 minutes. Then, reduce the heat to the lowest setting and simmer for another hour until the beans are very soft and tender. To save time and gas, you can simmer the red beans in a rice cooker.
Step 3:
After more than 1 hour, check if the beans are soft, then drain them through a sieve.

Next, put the beans back in the pot, add sugar, vanilla extract, and salt. Mix gently so the beans absorb the flavors, becoming sweet and fragrant with vanilla. Adjust the sweetness of the beans to your preference!
Step 4:
After mixing, cook the sweetened beans over low heat for about 5 minutes. Remember not to cover the pot and stir gently so the sugar dissolves completely and the beans don't stick to the bottom.
Then, turn off the heat, let it cool, and place the stewed beans in the refrigerator.
Step 5:
Next, peel the banana and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Peel the kiwi and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Wash the strawberries, drain well, and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Boil the Korean rice cakes, let them cool, and cut into small pieces.
Shave the ice finely.
Step 6:

Finally, scoop about 100g of the stewed red beans into a glass. Then, pour the shaved ice on top and arrange the fruit on the top layer. Drizzle with condensed milk, sprinkle some prepared rice cakes, and enjoy your Patbingsu.
Notes for perfect Patbingsu:
In addition to fruit, you can also add a scoop of ice cream on top to enhance the flavor of this wonderful dish!
How to choose good fruit:

Strawberries: Strawberries do not continue to ripen after being picked, so avoid those with white spots or green colors. Choose bright red ones. Avoid bruised, moldy, or mushy berries. Fresh, juicy strawberries are shiny, evenly colored, lightly fragrant, with intact stems and green caps, and usually heart-shaped. Avoid wet berries as sellers might have sprayed them with water. If buying boxed strawberries, avoid boxes with stains on the bottom or moisture inside.

Kiwi: There are green and gold kiwis. Since green kiwis are often sold firm and unripe, choose ones that are fragrant, plump, and full. Avoid those with bruised skin, leaking juice, or those that feel mushy, scarred, or wrinkled. To check if a kiwi is ripe, press gently; if it yields like a peach, it is ripe and ready to eat.

mon_an.mo_ta: Refreshing avocado ice cream – a treat for the ladies, both cooling and good for the skin. Why not enjoy it now? Learn this delicious recipe for the gentlemen to show off their skills in the kitchen.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Halve the avocados, remove the pits, and scoop the flesh into a cup. Place the fresh cream and whisk in the freezer for 10 minutes, then pour into a clean bowl and whip. Start at low speed and increase to high until stiff peaks form; however, do not overbeat or the cream will separate when mixed.
Step 2: Pour the avocado, fresh milk, and condensed milk into a blender and blend until completely smooth to create a delicious avocado ice cream base.

Step 3: Slowly pour the avocado mixture into the whipped cream, using a spatula to fold gently and lightly. Then pour into an ice cream container that has been chilled in the freezer for 4-6 hours and cover with a lid. Every 30 minutes, take the container out and stir thoroughly.
