Repeat 3-4 times before serving.
Source: Ngoisao

mon_an.mo_ta: Pink grapefruit and mint sorbet, with grapefruit juice as the main ingredient, contains no fat but carries all the health benefits, making it a favorite for many women. Additionally, the refreshing aroma of mint leaves helps dispel the summer heat. Get in the kitchen and try this unique sorbet!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Juicer, blender, ice cream tray, round ice cream scoop - tools
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients for the pink grapefruit and mint sorbet.
Peel the grapefruits, remove the pith, then separate the segments and carefully remove all seeds.
Pick the mint leaves, removing roots and wilted leaves, then wash and drain.
Step 2: Steps to make the pink grapefruit and mint sorbet.
First, put the grapefruit segments into a juicer to extract the juice.
Then, pour 1/3 of the juice into a deep pan or pot and add the mint leaves.
Place on the stove and bring the juice to a boil.
Once boiling, turn off the heat and let it steep for 5-10 minutes, then remove the mint leaves. If you leave the mint in too long, the liquid will become bitter, ruining the flavor.
Add the remaining grapefruit juice to the pan and stir well.
Next, prepare a tray or container. Pour the prepared juice into the tray and place it in the freezer to set.
Leave it in the freezer for about 2 hours or until the grapefruit juice is frozen, then take the tray out.
Use a scoop to transfer the frozen grapefruit mixture into a blender and blend until smooth.
After blending, pour the mixture back into the tray and return it to the freezer.
Finally, after a few hours in the freezer, take the sorbet out, scoop into glasses, and enjoy.
You can garnish with a few mint leaves for a beautiful presentation.
Notes for a refreshing pink grapefruit and mint sorbet.
If you don't have a juicer, you can use a blender to puree the grapefruit segments and then strain through a sieve to get the juice.

Similarly, to save time, you can use a whisk or a wooden spoon to beat the sorbet after the first freezing instead of using a blender. You should beat it about 2 times so the sorbet is soft and fluffy rather than icy.

Choose high-quality grapefruits; they must be ripe and sweet so they aren't bitter. You can use pomelo or other varieties if preferred. A good grapefruit makes the dish delicious and visually appealing.

Pink grapefruit and mint sorbet, with grapefruit juice as the main ingredient, contains no fat but carries all the health benefits, making it a favorite for many women. Additionally, the refreshing aroma of mint leaves helps dispel the summer heat. Get in the kitchen and try this unique sorbet!

mon_an.mo_ta: Vanilla coffee ice cream – an appealing blend of aromatic coffee and vanilla flavors. How to make vanilla coffee ice cream.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Place the ground coffee into a filter bag, such as cheesecloth or a clean linen cloth. Put the milk and sugar into a small pot on the stove along with the coffee bag. Heat until the mixture reaches about 80°C, then turn off the heat. Leave the coffee bag in the pot for about 30 minutes, then use a spoon to press the bag firmly to extract all the coffee flavor into the milk.

Step 2: After extracting the coffee into the milk, discard the coffee grounds bag and add the vanilla, stirring well. Prepare an ice cream container that has been in the freezer for 6 hours; once the vanilla coffee mixture is ready, you will pour it into this container.

Step 3: Add the fresh cream to the mixture from step 2, then pour into the prepared container. Place the container in the freezer. Every 30 minutes, take it out and stir with a fork. Do this 4 times consecutively, and it will be ready to enjoy.
Source: Xinhxinh

mon_an.mo_ta: Japanese Caramel Custard – A delicious and easy-to-make dish. Unlike traditional caramel custard (flan) which is set by steaming or baking, the Japanese version is set with gelatin. It is topped with aromatic, slightly bitter coffee and can be served in small jars or glass cups. Learn how to make Japanese Caramel Custard.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 1 tsp instant coffee, hot water, condensed milk
cac_buoc: Step 1: Separate the eggs and keep the yolks. Add sugar and use a hand whisk to stir in one direction until the egg and sugar mixture is smooth and silky.

Step 2: Pour the fresh milk into a pot and heat until it just begins to simmer around the edges, then turn off the heat. Pour the milk into the egg bowl, stirring gently. Then pour the egg and milk mixture back into the pot. Keep over low heat and cook for another 5-10 minutes. Stir constantly, making sure the mixture does not boil, otherwise the eggs will cook and become lumpy.

Step 3: Place the gelatin in a bowl. If using sheet gelatin, soak it in cold water for about 15 minutes to soften. Use a ladle to scoop a little of the hot milk mixture into the gelatin bowl, stir to dissolve, then pour the gelatin back into the custard pot and stir well.

Step 4: Strain the mixture through a sieve to remove any residue. Then add the fresh cream and vanilla, stir well, and divide the mixture into small cups. Wait for it to cool, then place in the refrigerator until set.

Step 5: Mix the instant coffee with a little hot water to dissolve, then add condensed milk (or you can use caramelized sugar if you don't like coffee). After about 1-2 hours, when the surface of the custard has set, gently pour the coffee over the top. Return to the refrigerator until completely firm, then serve cold.
Source: Ngoisao

mon_an.mo_ta: Refreshing Lemon Coconut Ice Cream – fragrant with lemon yet rich with coconut, this is a wonderful treat to beat the heat. Learn how to make this delicious Refreshing Lemon Coconut Ice Cream.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Finely zest 3 green lemons and set aside in a small bowl.
Step 2: Mix the lemon zest with the lemon juice (ensure all seeds are removed) and 250ml of yogurt.
Step 3: Add the powdered sugar to the lemon mixture and stir well to create the base for the refreshing lemon coconut ice cream.

Step 4: Pour the lemon-yogurt mixture and coconut milk into a blender. Blend until completely smooth, then pour into an ice cream container that has been pre-chilled for 6-8 hours. Place in the freezer; every 30 minutes, take it out and fluff the mixture. Repeat this 3-4 times until the ice cream is soft and smooth.
Source: Kenh 14

mon_an.mo_ta: Refreshing Lemon Ice Cream – A guide to making a cool, sweet, and sour ice cream to beat the summer heat.
cac_buoc: Step 1: First, prepare the yellow lemons:
Wash the lemons, dry the peel with a clean towel, then finely zest them. You can use green lemons, but the zest can be bitter, so yellow lemons are recommended.
Squeeze the juice into a separate cup and carefully strain out the seeds.
Step 2: Pour the milk and heavy cream into a pot and heat over low heat until it reaches about 40°C. For a richer and smoother ice cream, you can use 400ml of heavy cream and omit the milk entirely!

Step 3: Whisk the egg yolks at the lowest speed, gradually sifting in the granulated sugar. Whisk until the eggs are fluffy and turn a pale yellow color. Remember to gradually increase the mixer speed while whisking.
Step 4:
Pour the milk mixture into the eggs. Pour gently and stir constantly to avoid curdling.
Strain the egg-milk mixture through a sieve and place it on the stove. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly in one direction until the mixture thickens slightly.

Step 5: Let the mixture cool completely before stirring in the lemon juice and zest. This prevents the ice cream from becoming bitter, which can happen if they are added while the mixture is still hot.

Step 6: Pour the mixture into a bowl (that has been chilled in the freezer for 4-6 hours). Place it in the freezer and use a fork to fluff the ice cream every 30 minutes. Do this 4 times consecutively, then freeze for another 2 hours before serving. For the best texture, leave it in the freezer overnight.
Source: Ngoisao

mon_an.mo_ta: Refreshing Coconut Ice Cream – An easy-to-make, refreshing treat for summer days. Learn how to make Refreshing Coconut Ice Cream.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Whisk the egg yolks with an electric mixer at low speed. When the yolks become bubbly, gradually sift in the sugar and whisk until the mixture is smooth and pale yellow.

Step 2: Heat the coconut milk and heavy cream until small bubbles appear around the edge of the pot, then turn off the heat. Wait for the milk to cool slightly, then slowly pour the coconut milk into the egg-sugar mixture, stirring gently until well combined.

Step 3: Pour the mixture from Step 2 into a small saucepan, add the tapioca starch, and stir well. Turn on low heat and stir constantly until the mixture becomes smooth and slightly thickened. Add the vanilla and turn off the heat immediately; do not overheat or the coconut ice cream will clump.
Step 4: Use the electric mixer to whisk the mixture from Step 3 until it is completely cool. This process incorporates air into the mixture, making the ice cream softer and fluffier.

Step 5: Pour the ice cream into a plastic container that has been pre-chilled in the freezer for 4-6 hours. Place the container in the freezer; every 30 minutes, take it out and fluff it with a fork. Repeat this 3-4 times for the best results.

At this point, prepare 2 coconuts with the tops cut off. Drain the coconut water and fill them with the ice cream. Sprinkle with grated coconut, strawberry syrup, or chocolate sauce to have a coconut ice cream just like at the shops.

mon_an.mo_ta: Fresh Pineapple Ice Cream – An easy-to-make dish for a fresh and energetic day. Learn how to make Fresh Pineapple Ice Cream.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Dice the ripe pineapple and toss with 1/2 tsp of salt; let it sit for 1 hour. Then, pour the milk and pineapple into a blender and blend until smooth.

Step 2: Place the heavy cream and the whisk attachment in the freezer for 10 minutes. Take them out and whip the cream with sugar until stiff peaks form; do not over-whip. Pour the pineapple mixture into the whipped cream bowl and adjust the sweetness to taste. Fold gently until well combined, then cover the surface tightly with plastic wrap.
Step 3: Every 30 minutes, take the bowl out and stir the mixture. Repeat this 3-4 times, and the fresh pineapple ice cream will be ready to serve.
Source: Ngoisao

mon_an.ten: Refreshing Taro Ice Cream for Hot Summer Days
mon_an.mo_ta: Cool pieces of taro ice cream with eye-catching colors and delicious flavors that melt in your mouth will be a favorite choice for many during these hot summer days! Take a little time to make this wonderful ice cream!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Condensed milk - 1 can (can be substituted with sugar)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients for the taro ice cream.
Peel the taro, wash it thoroughly, and cut it into small cubes.
Next, steam the taro until cooked through. Once the taro is soft and starchy, remove it from the steamer.
Step 2: Steps to make the taro ice cream.
First, place a pot on the stove. Add a little water and bring to a boil.
Next, add the steamed taro.
Then, add the yogurt, heavy cream, condensed milk, and coconut milk to cook with the taro.
Stir the ingredients well so they blend together and the taro is evenly infused. Remember to stir constantly to prevent the taro from burning.
Let the mixture cool slightly, then pour it into a blender and blend until smooth.
After that, pour the mixture into a plastic container. Close the lid tightly and place it in the freezer.
After about 2-3 hours, take the ice cream out and use a spoon to fluff it up so that it becomes soft and airy. Once fluffed, put it back in the freezer for another 2-3 hours before serving.
Finally, use an ice cream scoop to serve the ice cream into glasses and decorate beautifully. You can sprinkle some roasted peanuts and grated coconut on top to serve alongside.
Notes for perfect taro ice cream:

With this method, remember to blend the ice cream and ingredients thoroughly so everything is well combined. However, if you prefer having small chunks of taro while eating, do not blend the taro; just mash it with a spoon. Most people recommend blending for a better flavor and even distribution of ingredients.
Alternatively, if you still want small taro pieces, you can blend most of it and set aside a small portion of steamed cubes to mix in later.
If you want the ice cream to be as good as in a shop, you can add certain flavorings or food coloring for a more professional look and taste.

Taro contains no cholesterol and is low in sodium but rich in vitamins, especially essential ones the body needs. Besides vitamins and fiber, taro also contains many minerals like magnesium, phosphorus, and potassium. Potassium is vital for heart function and blood pressure regulation. Magnesium helps metabolize fats and proteins and boosts immunity. Therefore, you can enjoy taro ice cream without worrying about excessive calories.

Cool pieces of taro ice cream with eye-catching colors and delicious flavors that melt in your mouth will be a favorite choice for many during these hot summer days! Take a little time to make this wonderful ice cream!

mon_an.ten: Pandan Ice Cream with Rice Aroma
mon_an.mo_ta: Pandan ice cream with rice aroma is an incredibly delicious and easy-to-make treat for this hot summer. Using fragrant pandan leaves, this ice cream will bring back nostalgic childhood memories. Learn to cook this Pandan Ice Cream with Rice Aroma to evoke the scent of ripe rice from your youth.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Wash the pandan leaves, drain well, and tie them into a tight bundle.
Pour the fresh milk and heavy cream into a pot and heat to about 80°C. Add the pandan leaves and cook over very low heat; do not let the mixture boil.
Step 2:
Whisk the egg yolks gently, being careful to minimize air bubbles on the surface.

Slowly pour the milk mixture into the egg yolks while whisking gently. Avoid adding the milk while it is too hot, as it may curdle the eggs and ruin the texture. It is best to let the milk cool slightly after removing it from the heat.
Step 3:
Set the pandan leaves aside and strain the mixture to remove any lumps formed during the egg and milk mixing process.

Place the egg-milk mixture and the pandan leaves in a double boiler. Stir constantly until it thickens. Swipe a finger across the back of the stirring spoon; if the path remains clear, turn off the heat.

Step 4: Remove the pandan leaves. You can add a bit of food coloring for a more vibrant look. Pour the mixture into a bowl and place it in the freezer. Every 30 minutes, take the ice cream out and stir it thoroughly. Repeat this 3 times, and your Pandan Ice Cream with Rice Aroma will be ready to enjoy.

mon_an.mo_ta: Strawberry Lemon Popsicles – An easy-to-make treat using common household ingredients. You can adapt this method to make any flavor of ice cream you love. Here is how to make Strawberry Lemon Popsicles.
cac_buoc: Note: Fruit or lychee flavored gelatin powder can be purchased at supermarkets or baking supply stores.
Step 1: Dissolve the gelatin powder in hot water. Squeeze the lemons for juice and mix it into the gelatin mixture. Add your favorite flavored syrups and stir well.
Step 2: Place mint leaves and lemon zest into popsicle molds, then pour in the mixture from Step 1. Place in the freezer for 2 hours until frozen solid.
Step 3: Chop strawberries or other fruits and place them into the popsicle molds, then pour in the mixture from Step 1 to complete the Strawberry Lemon Popsicles. Freeze for 2 hours.
Source: Ngôi sao

mon_an.mo_ta: Summer weather calls for ice cream! Learn how to make this fragrant and sweet durian ice cream to treat the whole family!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Sieve the durian flesh until smooth to remove fibers (or you can use a blender).
Step 2: Add the cream and lemon juice, then mix well.
Step 3: Place the durian ice cream mixture in the freezer for 1 hour.
Step 4: Boil some water and place the bowl of white chocolate over it for 1-2 minutes until melted. Stir well with a spoon, then use a brush to coat the molds with a thick layer of chocolate.
Step 5: Place the chocolate molds in the refrigerator for 10 minutes. Then take them out and fill with the ice cream mixture.
Finally, add a layer of chocolate on top.
Step 6: Place the molds in the freezer for about 3 hours until ready to serve.
Gently pull the edges of the silicone molds to remove the ice cream treats, then arrange them on a plate for the family to enjoy.
In this recipe, I also used dark chocolate; if you like, you can make two different versions using different molds.

mon_an.mo_ta: Refreshing Yogurt Ice Cream – made with Vinamilk yogurt, this treat is both cool and tangy, making it great for digestion. Here is how to make Refreshing Yogurt Ice Cream.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Whisk the eggs with sugar until smooth. Heat the milk until scalding hot, then slowly pour it into the egg and sugar mixture. Strain through a sieve to remove any lumps. Once the mixture has cooled, add the yogurt and fold gently.

Step 2: Place the heavy cream in the freezer for 20 minutes beforehand. Then pour the heavy cream into the mixture above and fold gently but thoroughly. Add the vanilla and lemon juice, and stir for a bit longer.
Step 3: Place the mixture in the freezer. Every 30 minutes, stir the ice cream thoroughly. Repeat this 3-4 times, and your Refreshing Yogurt Ice Cream will be ready to serve.
Source: Ngôi sao

mon_an.mo_ta: Apple Ice Cream – This is a unique, delicious, and easy-to-make treat for apple lovers. In today's article, we will guide you through making delicious homemade apple ice cream for the summer. Let's check out the recipe!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel and core the apples, then cut them into small pieces. Place them in a blender.

Step 2: Add the condensed milk, fresh milk, lemon juice, and sugar to the blender and blend until smooth. Whip the heavy cream until stiff peaks form, then slowly pour the blended apple mixture into the bowl of whipped cream and stir gently.
Step 3: Pour the mixture into a container and cover tightly with a lid. Every 30 minutes, open the container and stir the ice cream. Repeat this 3-4 times to finish your unique apple ice cream.

mon_an.ten: Refreshing Matcha Ice Cream for Summer
mon_an.mo_ta: Matcha ice cream is one of my favorite treats. Today, let's follow this recipe to make a delicious batch of green tea ice cream.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Combine the milk, whipping cream, sugar, and washed pandan leaves (if using) in a pot. Heat over low heat until the mixture reaches approximately 70-80°C. Step 2: While waiting for the milk and cream mixture to heat up, separate the egg yolks into a bowl and whisk well. Step 3: Once the milk and cream mixture is hot, slowly pour it into the bowl of whisked egg yolks. Stir constantly while pouring. Step 4: Pour the mixture back into the pot and cook over very low heat, stirring constantly until the mixture is smooth and thickened. Tip: A simple way to check if the custard is ready is to run your finger across the back of the stirring spoon. If the line remains clear and the mixture does not run, it is ready; turn off the heat. Step 5: After turning off the heat, pour the mixture into the ice cream maker container. Strain the mixture through a sieve to remove the pandan leaves and any lumps to ensure the final matcha ice cream is perfectly smooth. Step 6: Mix the matcha powder with a little warm water... then pour it into the cream mixture and stir well. Place the mixture in the refrigerator to chill. Once chilled, churn the mixture in your ice cream maker according to the manufacturer's instructions. If you do not have an ice cream maker, refer to the simple tip at the end of this recipe.
The finished matcha ice cream will have a beautiful, cool green color like this.
Tips for making delicious matcha ice cream:
Using whipping cream makes the ice cream richer and creamier. If you prefer a lighter version, you can replace the whipping cream with regular fresh milk.

When heating the milk and cream mixture, use low heat to preserve the nutrients in the milk. This mixture will be added to the egg yolks, so do not let it get too hot. If it is boiling, the yolks will curdle and the ice cream will fail.
The egg and milk mixture must also be cooked over low heat to prevent the eggs from curdling.
You can add pandan leaves for aroma, or omit them if you prefer.
Matcha powder should be added last so that its fragrance is not lost during the cooking process.

If you do not have an ice cream maker, you can still make delicious matcha ice cream with this simple method: place the cream bowl in the freezer; after about 4 hours, take it out and use a spoon to fluff it up to incorporate air for a light texture, then return it to the freezer. Repeat this every 30 minutes about 3 times before serving.
Using matcha powder, you can also try making other refreshing summer treats such as: Chilled Matcha Pudding or Fragrant Matcha Lime Mousse.

mon_an.mo_ta: Vanilla Chocolate Chip Ice Cream – a simple yet delicious treat often found in famous ice cream shops. Why not try making it at home? Here is the recipe for Vanilla Chocolate Chip Ice Cream.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Whisk the eggs and sugar. Start whisking the whole eggs at low speed; once large bubbles appear, gradually sift in the sugar. Whisk until thick and pale; when you lift the whisk, the mixture should fall back slowly in ribbons. Place the whisked egg mixture over low heat, then slowly pour in the milk, stirring gently. Heat until the mixture reaches about 70°C.

Step 2: Place the whipping cream and the whisk beaters in the freezer for 10 minutes, then take them out and whip the cream until stiff peaks form. Once the egg and milk mixture has cooled, strain it through a sieve to remove any lumps, then slowly fold it into the whipped cream. Add the vanilla and mix well.

Step 3: Pour the mixture into a container that has been chilled in the freezer for 4-6 hours and cover with a lid. Every 30 minutes, open the lid and stir the ice cream. Repeat this 3-4 times until the vanilla chocolate chip ice cream is ready. Add the chocolate chips during the first stir.

mon_an.ten: Mango Ice Cream Pouches for a Refreshing Summer
mon_an.mo_ta: Mango ice cream is tart, sweet, and icy cold—a treat that not only kids but everyone will love.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel and slice the ripe mango. Place the mango pieces in a plastic bag and put them in the freezer for 3 hours until partially frozen.
Step 2: Place the cream, honey, lime juice, sugar, and mango into a blender and blend until smooth, resulting in a very thick and creamy mixture. This method prevents ice crystals from forming.
Step 3: Pour small portions of the blended mango mixture into plastic bags and seal tightly. Place them in the freezer for 6-7 hours until the ice cream is set.
With this simple method, you will have fragrant and smooth mango ice cream pouches ready to be enjoyed.

mon_an.mo_ta: This unique Japanese matcha ice cream features the aroma of green tea with a perfect balance of bitterness and sweetness. Learn to make this refreshing Japanese-style treat, which is excellent for cooling down.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Use a hand mixer at the lowest speed to whisk the egg yolks, then gradually sift 100g of sugar into the bowl. Beat until the egg and sugar mixture is fluffy; do not overbeat—the mixture is ready when you lift the beaters and it falls in ribbons that take a moment to merge back into the mixture.
Step 2:
Mix the matcha powder with the remaining 20g of sugar.

Warm the milk and maintain it between 40 - 45°C. Scoop 2 tablespoons of milk into the matcha bowl and stir well until the powder and sugar dissolve. This ensures the Japanese matcha ice cream has an even distribution of tea powder.

Step 3: Pour the matcha mixture into the milk pot and stir until the color is uniform. Next, pour in the egg and sugar mixture. Note: Keep the temperature below 40°C throughout the stirring process to prevent clumping and to ensure the mixture doesn't get too hot. Then, let it cool.

Step 4: Place the whipping cream and the mixer beaters in the freezer for 10 minutes, then take them out and whip the cream starting from low speed, gradually increasing until stiff peaks form. Stiff peaks are achieved when you lift the beaters and the cream forms a peak, and the cream does not spill when the bowl is tilted or inverted.

Step 5: Pour the matcha and milk mixture into the bowl of whipped cream, beating continuously while adding. If using a hand mixer, beat at medium speed so the cream and matcha are well combined for the most delicious and refreshing Japanese matcha ice cream.

Step 6: Transfer the mixture from step 5 into an ice cream container that has been chilled in the freezer for about 4 hours. Every 30 minutes, take the ice cream out and mix thoroughly; repeat this 3 times for a delicious result. For the best quality, leave the ice cream in the freezer overnight after the third mix.

mon_an.ten: Strawberry Ice Cream to Beat the Heat
mon_an.mo_ta: With this strawberry ice cream recipe, those hot summer days will pass by in a breeze!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, soak and wash the strawberries, remove the stems, and cut them in half. Place the strawberries, sugar, and lemon zest in a large bowl.
Step 2:
Add the vodka and lemon juice, mix well, and let macerate for 1 hour.
Step 3:
After 1 hour, put the strawberry mixture, basil leaves, ricotta cheese, and heavy cream into a blender.
Step 4:

Blend until the mixture is completely smooth. If you prefer your ice cream to have strawberry chunks, you can blend the strawberries separately or mix in strawberry jam after blending the rest of the mixture.
Step 5:
Pour the mixture into a large bowl and place it in the freezer for at least 4 hours. For the ideal consistency, it is best to chill the ice cream overnight!
Step 6:
Your ice cream is now complete. Scoop the ice cream into glasses and serve with a few fresh strawberry slices for an absolutely delicious treat!
Strawberry ice cream made with this recipe will be very rich and have a very unique, bold flavor; it won't be boring to eat like ordinary strawberry ice cream!
Strawberry ice cream made with "real" fresh strawberries will definitely be quite different!
If you mix extra fresh strawberries into the strawberry ice cream, it will look like this.
And if you mix in fresh basil leaves, the ice cream will look like this!

mon_an.mo_ta: This refreshing mango yogurt ice cream features the sweetness of ripe mangoes combined with the mild tanginess of yogurt, making it a perfect summer treat. Learn how to make this delicious mango yogurt ice cream for the upcoming summer.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel the ripe mangoes and cut them into bite-sized pieces. Place them in a blender with sugar and blend until smooth. Pour the mixture into a large bowl.

Step 2: Add honey, yogurt, vanilla, and lemon juice to the mango bowl, then use a whisk to mix well. Taste for sweetness and tartness. If you prefer it sweeter or more tart, you can adjust the sugar or lemon juice.

Step 3: Pour the mixture into a container and place it in the freezer. Every 30 minutes, take the container out and whisk the mixture thoroughly. Repeat this 4 times, then leave it in the freezer for another hour. This will make your ice cream smoother and prevent ice crystals from forming.

mon_an.mo_ta: Head to the kitchen and make this super cool and delicious milk caramel pudding to treat yourself during this sweltering hot weather!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Caramel pudding part: - 250ml unsweetened fresh milk
Milk pudding part: - 100ml unsweetened fresh milk
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Let's make the caramel pudding part first! Bloom the gelatin in cold water and let it sit for 10 minutes.
Step 2:
Heat the sugar and water over low heat until it turns a deep caramel brown, then add the whipping cream and 150ml of milk. Remember to set aside 100ml of milk for the next step!
Step 3:
Remove the caramel from the heat and stir in the bloomed gelatin.
Step 4:
Add the remaining 100ml of milk to the pudding mixture, then pour it into cups and refrigerate for 30 minutes to set.
Step 5:
While waiting for the caramel pudding to set, prepare the milk pudding part. Bloom the gelatin in water as in step 1.
Step 6:
Mix the sugar and fresh milk together.
Step 7:
Add the gelatin from step 5 into the milk.
Step 8:
Take the caramel pudding out of the refrigerator, gently pour the milk pudding on top, and refrigerate for another 15 minutes.
Garnish with whipped cream and caramel sauce to make the pudding even more appealing!
The pudding is smooth, cool, and melts in your mouth!
Coming home from the heat and having a glass of chilled pudding to enjoy is so satisfying!

mon_an.mo_ta: As autumn arrives with its hot sunny days, boost your energy with these delicious, cool, and nutritious cheese jelly yogurt bites!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 100 g cream cheese, at room temperature
6 g gelatin powder or gelatin sheets
30 g frozen blueberries (if you like a filling), or your favorite fruit
cac_buoc: Step 1: Soak the gelatin sheets in cold water for 10-15 minutes. Then, remove the gelatin and place it in a cup of hot water.
Step 2: Place the cream cheese in a bowl and whisk until smooth, then add the sugar and yogurt and whisk together.
Step 3: Take 2 tbsp of the cream mixture from step 2, add it to the gelatin water from step 1, and stir until dissolved.
Step 4: Pour the gelatin-cream mixture from step 3 into the cream bowl from step 2 and mix well. You will have a slightly liquid mixture.
Take about 1/3 cup of the cream mixture from step 4 and mix it with the blueberries. This part will be the filling.
Step 5: Pour the white cream mixture into the mold first.
Then pour the blueberry cream into the center. Place the mold in the refrigerator for a few hours to allow the jelly to set.
Presentation: Remove the cheese jelly yogurt from the mold onto a plate, garnish as desired, and enjoy.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Delicious Chocolate Sauce for Ice Cream
mon_an.mo_ta: Ice cream becomes even more delicious when topped with your own homemade chocolate sauce—it tastes amazing! Let's learn how to make chocolate sauce below!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, finely chop the chocolate.
Step 2:
Place the chocolate and espresso powder in a bowl.
Step 3:
Heat the cream over low heat until hot. Watch carefully while heating to prevent the cream from boiling over!
Step 4:
While the cream is still hot, pour it immediately into the chocolate mixture.
Step 5:
Prepare the ice cream in glasses.
Step 6:
Let the cream and chocolate sit for 30 seconds, then stir until smooth.
Step 7:
Add the marshmallows to the mixture.
Step 8:
Stir well until the marshmallows are completely melted.
Now, simply drizzle the chocolate sauce over the cold ice cream and enjoy!
The marshmallow chocolate sauce will make the ice cream richer, creamier, and incredibly appealing!
On hot days when you want to enjoy a cold ice cream, this chocolate sauce will make your treat much better!

mon_an.ten: How to Cook Bánh Canh Cá Lóc Without a Fishy Smell at Home
cac_buoc: In the daily life of people in Central Vietnam, especially in Hue city, Bánh Canh Cá Lóc is considered a popular dish deeply connected to folk culture. The following article provides detailed instructions on how to prepare and cook this attractive snakehead fish thick noodle soup. Let's explore!
I. How to cook authentic Western-style Bánh Canh Cá Lóc
1. Prepare ingredients
1 snakehead fish (about 1 kg)
10 g dried shrimp
50 g shallots
3 stalks green onions
A few sprigs of cilantro
1 tsp minced shallots
1 kg dried thick noodles (bánh canh)
1 tbsp wheat flour
3 tbsp fish sauce
A bit of white wine
3 tbsp rock sugar
3 tbsp cooking oil
Common seasonings (salt, sugar, MSG, pepper)
2. Prepare the ingredients
Prepare the fish: After buying the fish, use a knife to scrape off the slime on the surface and rinse with water several times.
Clean the fish: Use scissors to cut open the belly, remove the entrails but keep the fish fat. Use a filleting knife to remove the flesh and scrape any blood off the bones.
Process the head and bones: Rub the head and bones vigorously with a mixture of salt and white wine, then rinse with water. Cut the fish fillets into bite-sized pieces.
3. Marinate the fish
Marinate the fish: Mix the fish with 1 tbsp fish sauce, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 tsp sugar, 1/2 tsp MSG, 1/2 tsp pepper, and 1 tsp cooking oil. Toss well and let sit for 30 minutes to absorb the flavors.
4. Cook the broth

Cook the broth: Put 3.5 liters of filtered water, 10 g dried shrimp, and 50 g shallots into a pot and bring to a boil over high heat. When the water boils, skim off the foam and reduce the heat to medium. Add 1 tsp white wine, the fish head, bones, fat, and cilantro roots to the pot and simmer for 45 minutes.
Prepare the straw mushrooms: Trim the dirty roots of the mushrooms, then rub them firmly with 1 tbsp diluted wheat flour and 1 tsp salt. Rinse the mushrooms with water.

Boil water and blanch the thick noodles for about 2 minutes. Then, remove the noodles and add them to the boiling broth. When ready to eat, simply add the sautéed fish to the noodles in the broth pot, then serve in a bowl. Top with chopped green onions and cilantro for garnish and enjoy immediately.
II. How to make Bánh Canh Cá Lóc with rice flour
100 g rice flour to make the noodles
500 g pork bones
1 kg snakehead fish
5 cilantro roots
Minced chili, minced garlic, minced and sliced shallots, chopped green onions, and minced chives
Seasonings: cooking oil, fish sauce, pepper, sugar, seasoning powder, annatto oil
Pot
Pan
Knife
Cutting board
Bowl

Prepare the pork bones: Rinse the pork bones with salt water to clean, then rinse again with fresh water. To remove odors, blanch the bones in boiling water for about 3 minutes, then remove and drain. Simmer the bones: Next, place the pork bones in a pot and add 4-5 crushed shallots and 5-7 cilantro roots. These ingredients will make the broth sweeter and more fragrant. Set the stove to medium heat and simmer the bones for about 45-50 minutes.

Deodorize and wash the fish: Use salt to rub the fish body to remove the fishy smell, then rinse with clean water. Separate the bones and meat: Use a knife to cut the meat from the tail to the head, separating the bones and the flesh. For the fish bones, cut them into 2-3 sections, and for the meat, cut into bite-sized pieces.

Prepare the marinade: Place the fish bones and meat in a bowl. Next, add 1 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp seasoning powder, 1 tbsp sugar, 1/2 tbsp minced chives, 1/2 tbsp minced garlic, 1/2 tbsp pepper, 1 tbsp minced chili, and 2 tbsp annatto oil. Mix well so the fish absorbs the seasonings and leave for 20 minutes.
3. Simmer the bones and fish head
Add the fish head and bones to the pork bone broth from step 1. Simmer for 15-20 minutes until the fish is cooked and the flavors infuse into the broth.
Then, add 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tbsp seasoning powder, and 1 tbsp fish sauce to the pot, stirring gently to dissolve and blend the seasonings.
4. Braise the fish
Prepare a pan and place it on the stove. Add 2 tbsp cooking oil and heat it up.
Once the oil is hot, add the minced chives, minced garlic, minced shallots, and minced chili to the pan and sauté until fragrant.
Next, add the marinated fish to the pan and stir-fry until the meat firms up.

After the fish has firmed up, add about 200 ml of water to the pan, then lower the heat to small so the fish sauce reduces and thickens, allowing the seasonings to penetrate the meat. Once the sauce has thickened, this step is complete.
5. Cook the noodles
Bring the broth pot to a boil.
Then, add the thick noodles to the pot and cook for about 5-7 minutes until the noodles have just expanded and reached the desired softness, meaning they are cooked.
Turn off the heat and ladle the noodles into a bowl.
On top of the noodles, add some of the braised snakehead fish to create a rich flavor.
Finally, add some chopped green onions to the bowl, and the Bánh Canh Cá Lóc is complete.
III. Cooking Bánh Canh Cá Lóc with bitter herbs
1. Ingredients to prepare
1 snakehead fish (about 1.1 kg)
50 g dried shrimp
10 g shallots
10 g cilantro roots
1 tsp white wine
15 g tapioca starch
150 g rice flour
100 g straw mushrooms
Bitter herbs for serving
Seasonings:
Salt
Rock sugar
MSG
Fish sauce
Granulated sugar
Pepper
Cooking oil
2. Prepare the ingredients
1. Prepare the fish
After buying the wild snakehead fish, clean the gills and remove the entrails. Use lemon, salt, and wine to rub and remove the slime, then rinse thoroughly.
Next, use a knife to scrape off the black outer skin, rinse again, and drain.

After cleaning, cut off the fish head. Fillet the body into 2 large pieces of meat. Check and remove any remaining bones from the fillets. Next, cut the fillets into thick bite-sized slices and marinate with 1 tsp fish sauce, 1/2 tsp salt, 2 tsp cooking oil, and 1/2 tsp pepper. The fish bones after filleting will be used to cook the broth. Before using, clean off all blood vessels so the broth does not have a fishy smell.
2. Prepare other ingredients
Rinse the dried shrimp and drain.
Peel the shallots, wash them, and leave them whole. Wash the cilantro roots and drain.
Trim the black roots of the straw mushrooms, then mix with 1 tbsp wheat flour, 1 tsp salt, and water. Rub gently for about 1 minute, rinse again, and drain.
Wash the bitter herbs and drain.
3. Cook the broth

Place a pot with about 3.5 liters of water on the stove, then add the dried shrimp and 50 g shallots. Bring to a boil. Once boiling, lower the heat and add 1/2 tsp wine, the fish head, bones, and cilantro roots. Simmer for about 45 minutes. After 20 minutes of simmering, you can remove the fish head if you wish to eat it separately. In some cases, customers may specifically request the fish head.

After simmering for 45 minutes, strain out the solids and add seasonings including 2 tbsp salt, 50 g rock sugar, 10 g MSG, and 2 tbsp fish sauce. Simmer until the rock sugar is completely dissolved. Then, taste and adjust the seasonings as needed to suit your preference. Next, add the straw mushrooms and thick noodles to the pot and bring back to a boil.
4. Enjoy
Place a pan on the stove and add 2 tbsp cooking oil. When the oil is hot, add 1 tbsp minced shallots and sauté until fragrant.
Next, add the fish to the pan and stir-fry until par-cooked.

For business purposes, if you need to store the fish, you can keep it in the refrigerator and only add it to the noodle pot when a customer orders. This ensures the fish is freshly cooked in the broth right before serving.

Presentation and enjoyment: Place the fish into the cooked noodle pot, then ladle the noodles, broth, and fish into a bowl to enjoy. When eating Bánh Canh Cá Lóc, you can pair it with bitter herbs to enhance the appeal.
IV. Notes when making Bánh Canh Cá Lóc
If using wild snakehead fish, you can keep the entrails if you enjoy eating them.
When cooking broth from the head and bones, ensure all blood vessels are removed to avoid a fishy smell.

The ratio of water for kneading the rice flour dough will vary depending on the type of flour. Therefore, add water slowly to control the consistency. If the dough is too wet, add more rice flour. If it is too dry and hard to form a block, add more water.
The total boiling time for the noodles is 7-8 minutes. With this amount of dough, it should be boiled in 2 batches.
After boiling, soak and rinse the noodles in cold water to keep them chewy and prevent them from sticking together.
The cooking time for the fish broth is 30-45 minutes. During the process, frequently skim the foam from the surface.
You can also add chicken or pork bones to the pot with the fish bones to make the broth sweeter.
To clean straw mushrooms and remove odors, you can wash them with wheat flour.
Do not use iodized salt for seasoning as it often creates a bitter aftertaste. Instead, use rock sugar to create a cleaner, sweeter taste for the broth.

How to choose good snakehead fish: Choose fish that are not too large or too small, with a long body, and are still alive and swimming actively. Also, choose those with a slim, firm head. Observe the vent; if it is enlarged, the fish is not fresh or is about to die. If you cut open the belly and see a lot of fat or a foul smell, do not buy it.

mon_an.ten: Bánh đa with Pork Ribs and Meatballs
mon_an.mo_ta: Bánh đa with pork ribs and meatballs is a traditional and flavorful Vietnamese dish. The soft noodles, rich pork ribs, and savory meatballs provide plenty of energy for a long day. Get ready to explore this detailed recipe and show off your skills by making this breakfast dish! Here is the guide to making delicious Bánh đa with pork ribs and meatballs. The combination of tender noodles, fatty ribs, and tasty meatballs creates a wonderful harmony. Discover the detailed recipe and showcase your cooking for a memorable morning.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings - Seasoning salt, pepper, broth powder, cooking oil
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare ingredients
Ground pork - 200g: Rinse the ground pork under cold water. Squeeze out excess water and set aside in a separate bowl.
Pork ribs - 300g: Rinse the ribs under cold water. Cut the ribs into small pieces, about 3-4cm long.
Tomatoes - 3: Wash the tomatoes. Slice them thinly or into small wedges according to your preference.
Scallions, Vietnamese coriander - a little: Wash the scallions and Vietnamese coriander. Thinly slice the scallions. The coriander can be left whole or chopped as desired.
Green vegetables - 1/2 bunch: Wash the greens. Cut them into short sections, about 3-4cm long.
Bánh đa noodles - 200g: If using dry noodles, soak them in warm water for about 30 minutes to soften.
Piper lolot leaves - 3 leaves: Wash the leaves. Remove the stems and set the leaves aside.
Dried shallot - 1 bulb: Peel the shallot. Thinly slice or mince it.
Seasonings - Seasoning salt, pepper, broth powder, cooking oil: Use seasoning salt, pepper, and broth powder to season according to taste. Use cooking oil for processing as required by the recipe.
Step 2: Make the meatballs
Preparation: Peel and wash the shallots, scallions, and garlic. Mince the shallots and garlic. Finely chop the scallions.

Mix the meat: In a bowl, combine the ground pork, minced shallots, scallions, garlic, egg, broth powder, sugar, oil, fish sauce, pepper, and dried shallots (if using). Mix well until the mixture is homogeneous.
Shape the meatballs: Take a portion of the mixture and roll it gently in your palms to form even round balls. Continue until all the mixture is used.
Cook the meatballs: Drop the meatballs into a pot of boiling water. Simmer over low heat for about 10-15 minutes until the meatballs are cooked and float to the surface.
Remove the meatballs: Once cooked, remove the meatballs from the pot and drain.
The meatballs are now ready to be used in the Bánh đa dish.
Step 3: Assemble the Bánh đa with pork ribs and meatballs
Noodles: Rinse the noodles under cold water to remove impurities. Rinse the ribs and meatballs. Place them in separate bowls.
Cook the ribs: Place the ribs in a pot of boiling water. Simmer for about 20-30 minutes until the ribs are tender. Remove the ribs and cut into small pieces.
Cook the meatballs: In a pot of boiling water, add the meatballs and boil for 10-15 minutes until cooked through. Remove and drain.
Prepare aromatics: Wash and thinly slice the shallots and scallions.
Cook the noodles: In a large pot, bring water to a boil and add salt and a little oil. Add the noodles and cook for about 5-7 minutes until soft. Once soft, remove and drain.
Combine the dish: Arrange the cooked noodles on a large plate or in a bowl. Spread the ribs and meatballs evenly over the noodles.

Garnish: Sprinkle the shallots and scallions on top. Mix a seasoning blend of salt, sugar, and pepper, then sprinkle over the dish to taste. Serve the Bánh đa with pork ribs and meatballs hot and enjoy for breakfast.
Wishing you and your family a delicious breakfast with this sweet and clear Bánh đa dish!

Above is the method for making Bánh đa with pork ribs and meatballs for breakfast. This dish combines soft noodles, flavorful ribs, and savory meatballs to create a special taste. The combination of ingredients like shallots and scallions along with seasonings like salt, sugar, and pepper highlights the natural and attractive flavors. Bánh đa with pork ribs and meatballs is a traditional, nutrient-rich dish and an excellent choice for an energetic and delicious breakfast.

mon_an.ten: Bánh mì with Sunny-Side Up Eggs
mon_an.mo_ta: Bánh mì with sunny-side up eggs has become a familiar breakfast for many, being both delicious and convenient to take to work or school. Instead of just simple eggs, you can try variations by using many other ingredients to create unique skillet-style versions. Today, we will make this breakfast dish with you! Here is the guide to making this stylish breakfast to treat the whole family. The skillet-style bánh mì is attractive, tasty, and convenient for busy mornings.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Bánh mì - A few slices, quantity as desired
Optional fillings (you can try the following)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Add a sufficient amount of oil to a non-stick pan and heat it up. Then lower the heat.
Step 2: Gently crack the eggs into the pan. Depending on the pan size and how many eggs you want to eat, calculate the number of eggs to crack.

Step 3: Cook for a moment over low heat until you see the egg whites start to turn opaque, then gently use a small spoon to scoop the hot oil and pour it over the whites. Do this for each egg. Remember to only pour the oil over the whites.
Step 4: After about 1-2 minutes, when the whites have set, start using the spoon to pour oil over the entire egg until it reaches your desired level of doneness...
Step 5: Use a spatula to gently lift the eggs out of the pan...
... And you have beautiful, delicious sunny-side up eggs.
Presentation

Step 6: Place the bánh mì slices at the bottom, then you can spread butter, cheese, and add favorite fillings like salami or pate. Drizzle with chili sauce, then place the sunny-side up egg on top. Use a heart-shaped mold, centering the yolk, and gently cut through the egg and bread.
Step 7: Place the egg-bread slice on a plate, sprinkle with cilantro and decorate with a few mint leaves (you can add a bit of salt or pepper to taste) for a perfect, nutritious breakfast.
Notes for making Bánh mì with sunny-side up eggs

Besides the mentioned ingredients, you can also change the flavor by using cheese, beef, or meatballs (xiu mai). The important thing is to cook the tomato sauce just right—not too thick or too thin—and the flavor must be balanced to be attractive and stimulating to the palate.
Choose freshly baked, fragrant, and crispy bánh mì to make the dish even better.
For the pan, choose a non-stick pan or a cast-iron skillet to retain heat longer, helping the dish stay warm and more flavorful.

mon_an.ten: Oatmeal Cookies – A Treat for Weight Management
mon_an.mo_ta: When baked, these oatmeal cookies have a brownish color like chocolate cookies. They are crunchy and full of the flavor of oats and raisins, offering great nutrition and a sweet taste. Enjoy these oatmeal cookies with a glass of fresh milk for a nutrient-filled breakfast or a wonderful and tasty snack.
cac_buoc: Prepare ingredients for oatmeal cookies:
Prepare all necessary ingredients.
Ensure you have all the tools ready: mixing bowl, whisk, oven, baking tray, and parchment paper.
Take the butter out of the fridge and let it soften at room temperature.
Steps to make oatmeal cookies for 4 people:
Step 1: First, put the softened butter in a bowl, add granulated sugar, egg, and baking soda. Use a whisk to mix well until the ingredients are dissolved and blended together.
Step 2: Next, add the all-purpose flour and continue whisking until the ingredients are combined.
Step 3: Then, add the oats, blueberries, chocolate chips, and shredded coconut. Mix well until you get a soft mixture where all ingredients are incorporated without lumps.
Step 4: Once the dough is ready, use your hands to shape them into cookie balls as shown, then press them down slightly to flatten.
Step 5: Place the cookies on a baking tray lined with parchment paper. Bake in the oven at 180°C for 15 minutes or until the cookies are cooked and have a beautiful brown outer crust.
Step 6: Remove the cookies from the oven once done, arrange them on a plate, and enjoy.
Notes for delicious and attractive oatmeal cookies
To add more flavor, you can substitute the dry ingredients with raisins or others according to your preference.
When mixing, you should add the flour gradually so the mixture doesn't clump; it will be softer, smoother, and more cohesive.

When baked, these oatmeal cookies have a brownish color like chocolate cookies. They are crunchy and full of the flavor of oats and raisins, offering great nutrition and a sweet taste. Enjoy these oatmeal cookies with a glass of fresh milk for a nutrient-filled breakfast or a wonderful and tasty snack. Oatmeal cookies are an essential addition to your list. With just a little time in the kitchen, you have a delicious and nutritious treat. Children will love these cookies, and they provide nutrition even for picky eaters; the plate will be empty in no time. This dish is also very suitable as a dessert after a meal, especially when the whole family gathers. You will be proud of the compliments on your cooking skills. Don't hesitate to get in the kitchen and make these wonderful cookies! Wishing you and your family delicious, nutritious, and happy meals together!

mon_an.ten: Beef Shank Stew with Green Peppercorns
mon_an.mo_ta: Beef shank stew with green peppercorns is both delicious and easy to make. With familiar ingredients and a simple cooking method, you will have a bowl of fragrant beef with tender meat, soft potatoes, a slight kick from the green peppercorns, and a thick sauce. All these create an incredibly attractive dish. Let's make this dish together!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, sugar, fish sauce, dried shallots - seasonings
cac_buoc: Prepare ingredients for beef shank stew with green peppercorns:
Wash the green peppercorns and crush them in a mortar.
Rinse the beef shank and cut into large 2x2cm squares. Marinate the beef with 1 tsp cooking oil, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp sugar, and the crushed green peppercorns for about 30 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Peel the potato, wash it, and cut into large pieces for stewing.
Next, dissolve the cornstarch (or flour) in a little water.
Peel the shallots, wash them, and slice thinly.
Steps to cook delicious beef shank stew with green peppercorns
Step 1:
First, place a pan on the stove and add enough oil to submerge the potatoes (about 3-4cm).
Fry the sliced potatoes until golden brown, then remove to a bowl. Remember to turn them so they cook evenly and look attractive!
Step 2:
Next, place a pressure cooker on the stove, add a little oil to coat the bottom, then sauté the shallots until fragrant. Add the marinated beef. Stir until the beef is firm and no longer red.
Add 100ml of canned tomato purée and 1.5l of fresh coconut water. Close the lid and simmer for about 10 minutes.
Step 3:
After 10 minutes of pressure cooking, open the lid, add the pate and potatoes. Season with salt and fish sauce to taste, then continue to simmer for 10-15 minutes or until the beef is tender.
Step 4:
After 10-15 minutes, if the beef is tender and the potatoes are soft, pour in the dissolved flour mixture. Stir well and simmer over low heat. Once the sauce has thickened, turn off the stove.
Finally, ladle the stewed beef into a bowl and serve with white rice or bánh mì.
Notes for delicious beef shank stew with green peppercorns
When finished, the dish must have the characteristic aroma of green peppercorns, a slightly thick sauce, and tender beef.
You can use regular water instead of coconut water. However, using fresh coconut water makes the sauce more flavorful and rich.
If you don't want to buy canned tomato purée, you can use 2 fresh tomatoes, chop them finely, and add water to make a substitute sauce.
How to choose good beef

Fresh beef should not be dark red; the fat should be yellow and firm, not soft. Choose beef with small, soft fibers rather than large, tough ones. Finally, press the meat with your finger; it should not be sticky and should have no foul odor.

Female beef is usually tastier than male beef. If you can find young beef (bò tơ), it is even better as the meat is tender, the fat is white, and the fibers are fine. To buy good beef, look for bright red color, non-smooth fibers (unless it's young beef), small white tendons, and bright yellow fat.

Beef that is pale green with round white spots between the fibers may have parasites. Do not buy meat with a foul odor. Signs of bad beef include: dark color, deep yellow fat, yellow bones, poor elasticity, mushy texture, or a slimy surface.

mon_an.mo_ta: Phở is a traditional Vietnamese dish and perhaps the most iconic representative of Vietnamese cuisine. For Hanoians, Phở bò is an incredibly familiar staple. Here, we introduce the traditional recipes for making delicious Hanoi-style beef phở. Introduction to Hanoi Phở: Appearing during the French colonial period, it was originally known as "phở gánh" (street-side phở). The cries of phở vendors in small alleys created a characteristic beauty of Hanoi back then. Although those mobile stalls no longer exist, the value of Hanoi phở is preserved. It is famous for its clear, sweet broth and rich flavor from simmered beef or buffalo bones. Combined with chewy noodles, scallions, chili vinegar, and greens, one taste will be etched in your memory. Comparing Hanoi Phở and Nam Dinh Phở: They look similar, but you will notice the difference upon tasting. Nam Dinh phở has a significantly bolder broth due to the use of sea fish sauce during seasoning. Meanwhile, Hanoi phở broth is clear, sweet, and less fatty. Hanoi noodles are thin and soft but retain elasticity when blanched. Nam Dinh noodles are larger and thicker, often hand-cut. Discover the secrets of traditional Hanoi beef phở. Immerse yourself in the flavors of this traditional dish and become a master chef right at home.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Wash the beef bones with salt and a little wine.
Preheat the oven to 250°C for 5 minutes, then roast the bones for 10 minutes. This helps remove the gamey odor of the beef bones.
Step 2:

Place the roasted bones in a pot, cover with water, and simmer for at least 2 hours. While simmering, you can add the beef to boil until tender (if you prefer cooked beef), then remove and slice thinly.
Roast the ginger, shallots, cardamom, star anise, and cinnamon, then wash them clean.
Add all the roasted aromatics and the dried peanut worms to the simmering broth. Simmer for at least one more hour, then add seasonings to taste.
Step 3:
Peel the onion, wash, and slice thinly.
Finely chop the Vietnamese mint and scallions; thinly slice the white parts of the scallions.
Step 4:
Blanch the phở noodles in boiling water and place in a bowl.
Arrange the beef on top, pour over the hot broth, and garnish with onion, mint, and scallions (if serving rare beef, pour the boiling broth directly over the raw meat in the bowl).
Enjoy your delicious beef phở; it is surely cleaner and tastier than at a shop. Serving it with crispy fried dough sticks (quẩy) is very enjoyable!
It's not too difficult to cook a bowl of phở for the family. If you have time on the weekend, try it out!
How to cook Phở bò tái (Rare Beef Phở):
Prepare ingredients:
1.5 kg beef marrow bones
200g beef fillet
500g beef balls
Phở noodles
Shallots, scallions, onion
Lemon, ginger
Cloves, star anise, black cardamom, cinnamon or phở seasoning packs
Rock sugar, sea salt, MSG
Step 1: Prepare ingredients
Start by washing the beef bones. Soak them in water for 30 minutes with a bit of salt and lemon to remove the odor. Then, blanch the bones in boiling water and rinse again.
Wash the onion and drain. Roast the onion over low heat until fragrant.
Next, wash the beef fillet. Slice it into thin, even pieces to place on top of the phở. Finely chop the scallions.
Step 2: Cook the broth
Place the bones in a pot with 1 liter of water, 1 tbsp salt, and the roasted onion. Start simmering; use a pressure cooker if available to save time.
After simmering the bones for 30 minutes, add 1.5 liters of water. Add the beef balls, followed by cloves, cardamom, cinnamon, and star anise.
Simmer the broth over medium heat with the lid open. Frequently skim the foam to keep the broth clear and fragrant.
After 30 minutes of simmering, remove the bones and aromatics from the pot.
Season the broth: Add 1 tbsp sea salt, 1 tbsp rock sugar, 1 tbsp MSG, and stir until dissolved.
Step 3: Finish the dish
Place some phở noodles in a bowl. Arrange the rare beef slices on top and sprinkle with scallions.
Pour the boiling broth into the bowl. It is now ready to serve.
The phở is fragrant with herbs, the broth is sweet and clear, and the noodles are soft. You can add herbs and bean sprouts to enhance the flavor.
How to cook Phở bò sốt vang (Red Wine Beef Stew Phở):
Prepare ingredients
1 kg pork bones
1 kg beef flank
200g dried shallots
200g onion
100g ginger
30g garlic
200g tomatoes
200g scallions
2 packs of beef phở seasoning
Seasonings: Broth powder, pepper, annatto powder, oil, sugar, star anise, cinnamon, garlic powder, red wine.
Prepare ingredients
Wash the pork bones. Place them in a pot of water with 1 tsp salt, ginger, and scallions. Bring to a boil, then discard the water and rinse the bones under the tap.
Roast the shallots, ginger, and onion until the skin is charred. Scrape off the burnt parts and rinse.

Wash and drain the beef, then cut into squares. Marinate with 1 tsp broth powder, 1 tbsp pepper, 1 tbsp garlic powder, 2 tbsp annatto powder, 1 tbsp sugar, and 1 tbsp oil. Mix by hand so the meat absorbs the spices.
Wash the scallions and herbs, then chop. Crush the garlic and lemongrass. Peel and mince the onion. Slice the tomatoes thinly.
Peel and cut carrots into chunks.
Step 2: Cook the broth and the wine sauce

Place the prepared pork bones in a pot with 4 liters of boiling water. Add the roasted ginger, roasted onion, star anise, cinnamon, 2 seasoning packs, 2 tsp broth powder, and 2 tsp sugar. Simmer for 1 hour.
In another pot, heat 2 tbsp oil and sauté the garlic. Add the minced onion, 1 tbsp annatto powder, and sliced tomatoes. Stir well, then add the marinated beef and sear.
Add 1 tbsp five-spice powder, then pour in 200ml red wine and the star anise. Stir for 5 minutes, then add another 200ml red wine. Cover, reduce heat, and cook for 30 minutes.
Add the crushed lemongrass and carrots. Cook for another 15 minutes until carrots are soft.
Step 3: Finish
Blanch the phở noodles in boiling water and place in a bowl.
Pour the pork bone broth into the bowl first, then ladle the beef and wine sauce on top.
Garnish with scallions and herbs. Serve.
Phở bò sốt vang has a unique, unmistakable aroma. The color is eye-catching, and the broth is rich yet sweet. One taste will be unforgettable.
How to cook Hanoi Phở using seasoning packets:
1kg beef marrow bones
150g beef flank
150g beef fillet
1 onion
1 pack of beef phở seasoning
Ginger powder
Seasonings: fish sauce, rock sugar, salt, pepper
Step 1: Prepare ingredients
Wash the bones with salt and vinegar. Boil in water with 2g ginger powder for 5 minutes, then rinse with cold water.
Add 2 liters of water and the bones to a pot. Simmer on low heat for 2 hours, skimming the foam.
Once the water cools slightly, add the seasoning pack, beef flank, and 300ml more water. Simmer on low for 1 hour.
Remove everything from the pot and season with 2.5 tsp rock sugar, 1 tsp salt, and 2 tsp fish sauce.
Once the flank is cool, slice it thinly. Slice the raw beef fillet thinly as well.
Before serving, blanch the noodles and place in a bowl. Layer the flank, fillet, scallion whites, and sliced onion on top. Pour the boiling broth over and enjoy.
Step 3: Final product
When time is limited, using a seasoning pack for Hanoi phở is a great choice. It's faster with fewer steps but still tastes delicious.
The aroma stimulates the senses, the beef is tender, and the broth is sweet. It's even better with herbs and dipping sauce.
Good luck and enjoy your beef phở!
Secrets to a rich Hanoi beef phở
The secret to a good broth is simmering beef ribs, tail, or marrow bones. For a natural sweetness, add a piece of sugarcane to the pot.
When filtering the broth, leave the natural bits of meat and tendon that fall off the bones; don't over-filter. This keeps the natural sweetness.
Marrow bones can be smelly, so clean them carefully to avoid affecting the broth's flavor.
Hanoi beef phở loses its character without cinnamon, star anise, and cardamom. Ensure you use all these spices for that signature taste.

mon_an.ten: Quick and Delicious Microwave Sticky Rice
mon_an.mo_ta: 1. Choose high-quality glutinous rice, wash thoroughly, and soak in water for 4-6 hours. I usually cook this in the morning, so I soak the rice overnight. With the suggested amount (2 level cups of rice - using the measuring cup provided with the rice cooker), the result will be 4 bowls of sticky rice, perfect for my family. If you eat more or less, adjust the ingredients accordingly. 2. Place the rice in a microwave-safe bowl with a lid (I usually soak the rice directly in this bowl to save on washing up), and mix in a little salt. Add water until it just covers the surface of the rice. 3. Place the bowl in the microwave and cook at 900W for 5 minutes. After 5 minutes, open the lid, stir well, and microwave at 900W for another 5 minutes until the sticky rice is soft, tender, and fragrant.
thoi_gian: Microwaving sticky rice is a great tip for those who love sticky rice but are hesitant to buy it outside for hygiene reasons or don't want to deal with bulky steamers just to make a few small bowls for breakfast. With this super fast microwave secret, you'll have soft, fragrant sticky rice for the whole family in just 10 minutes.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Cooking time depends on the amount of ingredients and the power of your microwave. You only need to cook it once to understand your microwave's timing and adjust for future batches.

This is a basic microwave sticky rice recipe; you can mix in other ingredients. I have tried it with easy-to-cook seeds/tubers like mung beans or cassava, and the results were delicious. I am not a fan of corn, black bean, or peanut sticky rice, so I haven't tried those. However, I think corn, black beans, or peanuts take longer to soften, so they would likely need to be pre-cooked before adding to the rice, which makes it more complicated.
cac_buoc: Glutinous rice - 2 cups
Salt, pork floss, sesame/peanut salt -
Cooking time depends on the amount of ingredients and the power of your microwave. You only need to cook it once to understand your microwave's timing and adjust for future batches.

I am not a fan of corn, black bean, or peanut sticky rice, so I haven't tried those. However, I think corn, black beans, or peanuts take longer to soften, so they would likely need to be pre-cooked before adding to the rice, which makes it more complicated.

mon_an.mo_ta: You can make Bún cá rô đồng for breakfast for the whole family to enjoy; it's wonderful. Nutritious, not too complicated in terms of method or ingredients, let's get cooking!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings - Cooking oil, fish sauce, MSG, seasoning powder.
cac_buoc: Step 1: After buying the fish, clean the scales, remove the innards, toss with salt, and wash thoroughly.

Step 2: Place the fish in a steamer or parboil it. Add a tiny pinch of salt. Put the fish in a container and wait for it to cool, then place it in the freezer so the meat firms up; this prevents the fish from breaking when deboning. Separate the meat and marinate with a little seasoning powder, ginger, and turmeric powder. Put the fish heads and bones in a mortar, pound them, and strain to get the essence for the broth.
Step 3: Mix the bone broth with the fish essence. (Here I used chicken broth, so the broth has a slightly yellow color).
Step 4: Wash the tomatoes and cut into wedges. Wash the herbs, green onions, dill, and water spinach, then drain.
Step 5: Sauté the tomatoes with a little oil and shallots until fragrant. Season with a bit of seasoning powder.
Step 6: Add the tomatoes to the broth pot. Place on the stove, bring to a boil, then lower the heat to a gentle simmer. Add some julienned ginger so the soup isn't fishy.

Step 7: In another pan, fry shallots until crispy and set aside, then pan-fry the fish until golden. You should only fry half of the fish meat; for the rest, sauté with shallots until fragrant. (You should coat the fish in a layer of frying flour so it stays crispy when eaten). Remove the fried fish and place on paper towels to drain the oil.

Step 8: Season the broth to taste. Prepare the fish noodle bowls. Arrange the vermicelli in bowls, add the boiled water spinach, place some fried fish and sautéed fish on top, then slowly pour the broth over the noodles.
Wish you and your family a delicious breakfast with this fragrant Bún cá rô đồng!

mon_an.mo_ta: Rice with braised pork provides all the necessary nutrients to give you energy for work, and this decoration style will stimulate your senses!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 40ml soy sauce, 20ml honey, 20ml oyster sauce, 60ml cooking oil
cac_buoc: Preparing these ingredients is enough for 2 servings!
Step 1:
First, wash the pork, soak in salt water for 2 minutes, then rinse with clean water. Mince 3 cloves of garlic and 1 shallot.

Cut the meat into small pieces about 2 inches thick, then mix with 20g salt, 20g seasoning, 40g sugar, 40ml soy sauce, 20ml honey, 20ml oyster sauce, 20g five-spice powder, and the minced garlic and shallots.
Step 2:
Cover tightly and marinate for about 2 hours so the meat absorbs the flavors.
Step 3:
Once the meat is marinated, add 60ml of oil to a pot over medium heat. When the oil is hot, sear the meat on all sides for about 5 minutes to create a beautiful golden surface.
Step 4:
Add the coconut water, cover, and simmer on low heat for 45 minutes until the meat is tender.
Step 5:
While waiting for the meat to cook, wash and julienne the carrot.
Step 6:
Pickle the carrot with 10g salt, 20g sugar, and 15ml lemon juice; squeeze gently to absorb, then cover for 30 minutes.
Step 7:
When the meat is cooked, remove it and slice into small pieces.
Step 8:
Mix 30g cornstarch with a little water, stir to dissolve, then pour into the meat pot. Simmer on low heat, stirring gently for about 5 minutes until the sauce thickens.
Step 9:
Next, place a pan on the stove, heat it up, add the black sesame seeds, and toast briefly for about 2 minutes.
Step 10:
Wash the rice and cook it. When the rice is cooked, line a small round mold with plastic wrap and sprinkle in some sesame seeds.
Step 11:
Add a little rice and press it thin, then place some meat in the middle.
Step 12:
Cover with another layer of rice and press firmly.
Step 13:
Invert the mold onto a plate and gently pull the plastic wrap to release the rice.
Cut out a portion of the rice to reveal the meat inside. Drizzle the sauce over the meat and top with the pickled carrots to finish.
Your rice with braised pork is ready to serve!
This decoration style is perfect for those who love meticulous food presentation!
The savory braised pork eaten with hot rice and sweet and sour carrots creates a very harmonious flavor—it's delicious!

mon_an.ten: Vinegar and Oil Salad for Weight Loss
mon_an.mo_ta: This unique and attractive vinegar and oil salad with a simple preparation method will help make your daily meals more diverse and appealing. Additionally, this is a non-fattening dish that allows women to eat comfortably without worrying about weight gain. Understanding this, today's article will guide you on how to make a very effective weight-loss vinegar and oil salad. Please take a look!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings - vinegar, garlic, chili, sugar, salt, olive oil
cac_buoc: 1. How to make vinegar and oil salad

First, when you buy lettuce, remove any wilted or damaged leaves and the stems, then wash it clean. To ensure the removal of harmful substances, soak the bean sprouts and lettuce in salt water for about 15 minutes, then rinse with clean water and drain in a basket.
Wash the tomatoes and cucumbers. Peel the onion, remove the root, wash, drain, and slice into thin pieces.
Cut the cucumber in half lengthwise, remove some of the seeds, and slice diagonally. Slice the tomatoes into medium-thin pieces. If using cherry tomatoes, cut them in half.
Boil the egg in a pot of water until cooked, then slice thinly (you need to slice carefully so the egg doesn't crumble).

Next, put the onion and bean sprouts together in a bowl and toss with salt. Then pour vinegar over them and soak for about 5 minutes so the sprouts and onion stay crunchy and the onion loses its pungency. Wash and mince the garlic and chili.
Make the vinegar-oil dressing: take 1 tsp sugar, 2 tsp vinegar, 1/2 tbsp olive oil, 1/2 tsp salt, and add the minced chili and garlic; mix well in a small bowl.

Then put all the prepared ingredients: bean sprouts, cucumber, onion, and half of the sliced tomatoes into a bowl. Slowly pour the prepared dressing over the ingredients and mix thoroughly; let it marinate for about 10 minutes. During this time, toss occasionally so the seasonings penetrate evenly.

While waiting for the ingredients to absorb the flavors, arrange the lettuce around a plate and place the remaining half of the tomatoes in a circle on top of the lettuce to make the salad look more beautiful and eye-catching.
Finally, when the ingredients are well-marinated, simply place them on the decorated plate and enjoy.
2. Vinegar and oil salad with Crab Claw Herb

Utilizing fresh ingredients, the first step in making this weight-loss salad is preparing the vegetables. Peel, wash, and thinly slice the onion and shallots. After cleaning the crab claw herb, soak it in diluted salt water for 10 minutes, then rinse and drain. Wash and thinly slice the tomatoes and cucumbers.
Step 2 is to boil the quail eggs, peel them, and cut them in half.

Next, step 3 is to mix the dressing using ¼ tbsp rice vinegar, 2 tbsp filtered water, 2 tbsp sugar, ½ tsp salt, 1/3 tsp ground pepper, ½ tsp seasoning powder, and 1 tbsp sesame oil. Once mixed, stir until the sugar, salt, and seasoning powder are completely dissolved.

Finally, step 4 is to put the vegetables and quail eggs in a bowl, pour the dressing over them, and toss gently. Then, present the salad on a plate and add the quail eggs on top or around the plate as desired.

The execution time is only about 10 - 15 minutes; this vinegar and oil salad brings a fresh flavor and is suitable for those losing weight. This is also a great way to provide vitamins and minerals to the body. Try it and you won't feel bored or afraid of vegetables when enjoying this salad. Enjoy your meal!
3. Traditional vinegar and oil salad

Step 1: First, remove the base of the lettuce and separate the leaves. Discard any leaves that are too old or damaged. Soak the lettuce in diluted salt water for about 10 minutes, then remove and rinse with water. Drain, then cut into bite-sized pieces and place in a large bowl.

Step 2: Wash the other vegetables and soak them in diluted salt water. Slice the cucumber thinly. Peel the onion and slice into rings. Cut the tomatoes into slices or halves if using cherry tomatoes. Place all these ingredients into the bowl with the lettuce.

Step 3: Prepare a small bowl to mix the dressing. Mix in 2 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tbsp sesame oil, 3 tbsp filtered water, 2 tbsp sugar, 1/3 tsp salt, 1/3 tsp ground pepper, and 1 tsp seasoning powder. Stir well so all components blend together.

Step 4: Next, slowly pour the dressing mixture into the salad bowl. Toss gently to ensure the dressing coats the vegetables evenly. Let the salad absorb the seasonings for about 5-10 minutes before serving. You can also keep the salad in the fridge and serve cold to enhance the flavor.
Notes for a delicious vinegar and oil salad:
Do not soak the lettuce for too long as it will become mushy and lose its crunch and freshness.
Depending on preference, you can peel the cucumber or eat it with the skin on.
If you don't like eggs, you can replace them with chicken or salmon to ensure the salad is still nutritious without being fattening.
In addition to the mentioned ingredients, you can add any others you like, such as sweet corn, carrots, purple cabbage...
To make a crunchy salad that isn't mushy, pay attention to balancing the dressing between sour, spicy, salty, and sweet flavors.

mon_an.ten: How to Cook Mung Bean Sticky Rice with Coconut Milk in a Rice Cooker
mon_an.mo_ta: Mung bean sticky rice serves as both a Tet holiday dish and an excellent breakfast. It is best enjoyed with Vietnamese ham (giò lụa) or crushed sesame salt, smelling wonderful. The rice grains expand evenly, becoming soft, chewy, nutty, and fragrant. Making delicious mung bean sticky rice is not difficult; let's get into the kitchen to learn how to cook mung bean sticky rice with coconut milk using a rice cooker! Detailed instructions for making wonderful mung bean sticky rice with a rice cooker. Discover a simple recipe to create an attractive traditional dish with the fragrant flavor of mung beans, perfectly combined with premium coconut milk. Enjoy mung bean sticky rice with coconut milk at home with easy-to-follow instructions and easy-to-find ingredients.
cac_buoc: 1. How to cook mung bean sticky rice with coconut milk
Step 1:

Put the rice and beans in a basin, and pour in warm water to cover. Soak for 4-5 hours (or soak before going to bed and cook the next morning), depending on your time; if not, 3 hours is also fine. Pre-soaking the rice helps the sticky rice become much more tender, chewy, and soft.
Step 2:

After soaking, the rice and beans will expand; wash them gently, toss, and drain. Add salt and toss well so the rice absorbs it (use only a little salt to avoid making the rice salty after cooking; I think about 2 pinches of salt is fine), then pour the rice into the rice cooker. Add boiling water (you can add coconut milk for extra fragrance, richness, and to give the rice grains a glossy look) until it just covers the surface, close the lid, press the button, and cook as usual.
Step 3:

After about 5 minutes it will start to boil; use chopsticks to stir the rice and beans gently to ensure they cook evenly with the water and steam. Cover it, and after the rice cooker switches to "Warm," wait about 15 – 20 minutes before opening the lid and stirring the rice; it is now cooked.

Prepare a plate to serve the rice. Remember that when the rice is cooked, you should not leave it in the pot with the lid tightly closed as it will cause condensation, making the rice soggy and mushy! Fluff the rice onto the plate; you can use a mold to shape the rice into beautiful patterns.
Note:

You must soak the rice and beans before cooking and add water just to the surface to avoid the rice being mushy or too dry. Most importantly, provide enough heat for the rice to cook and expand evenly. Mung bean sticky rice is a famous breakfast and sticky rice dish of the Vietnamese people.
2. Mung bean and lotus seed sticky rice
Ingredients
500g glutinous rice
200g fresh lotus seeds
100g peeled mung beans
50g shredded coconut
50ml coconut milk
20 - 30g sugar
5g salt
Preparing rice and mung beans
Glutinous rice: Wash and soak in water for 6 - 8 hours or overnight. Then, pour the rice into a basket to drain.
Mung beans: Select the beans, removing flat or damaged ones. Wash and soak in water for 3 - 4 hours to soften. Then, remove and drain.

Fresh lotus seeds: Separate the seeds from the pod and use a sharp knife to peel the hard shell. Then, peel the thin membrane outside the seed. Next, cut the top of the seed to reveal the lotus embryo. Use a sharp skewer from the bottom of the seed to push the embryo out. Wash the lotus seeds with diluted salt water and drain.
Cooking the sticky rice

After the rice and mung beans have soaked and expanded, gently wash them once, toss, and drain. Next, place the rice, mung beans, and lotus seeds in a large bowl, add 5g salt, and mix well so the mixture absorbs the salt, creating a richer flavor for the rice.

Prepare a steamer, place the mixture in the steamer, cover tightly, and steam for about 20 - 25 minutes. Meanwhile, dissolve 20g sugar into the coconut milk and stir gently until dissolved. Mix the shredded coconut with 20g sugar.

After steaming for about 20 minutes, open the lid and check if the lotus seeds are soft. Then, add the shredded coconut to the rice and mix well. Next, drizzle the coconut milk mixture over the rice, fluff it up, and continue steaming for another 15 minutes so the rice absorbs the coconut milk, becoming soft, smooth, and well-infused.
Making sesame peanut salt

After the peanuts are roasted golden, remove the skins and crush them. Mix 3 tbsp roasted peanuts with 3 tbsp roasted sesame seeds, then use a pestle to gently grind them together. Add 3 tsp white granulated sugar and 1 tsp salt, and mix well. You can store the sesame salt in a glass jar for gradual use.

Before enjoying, open the lid to let the rice cool slightly, fluff it onto a plate, and sprinkle sesame salt on top. You can invite the whole family to enjoy this attractive dish. Besides sesame salt, mung bean lotus seed sticky rice also pairs well with pork floss, roasted meat, Vietnamese ham, or fried shallots.

This method of cooking mung bean sticky rice will create a final product of soft rice grains with a sweet, nutty flavor from the coconut, mung beans, and lotus seeds blending with the rich coconut milk. This dish brings a harmonious and attractive flavor.
3. Pandan mung bean sticky rice
Ingredients
Glutinous rice: 1 kg
Peeled mung beans: 450 gr
Shredded coconut: 300 gr
Fresh pandan leaves: 80 gr
Pandan extract: 1/2 tsp
Sugar: 100 gr
Salt: 1.5 tbsp
Roasted and crushed peanuts: 40 gr
Roasted sesame seeds: 20 gr
Preparing ingredients
After buying pandan leaves, wash them and drain. Set aside 3 - 4 leaves, and use scissors to cut the rest into small pieces.
Place the cut pandan leaves in a blender with 300ml filtered water and blend until smooth. After blending, pour the mixture through a sieve or filter to get the extract.
Extracting coconut milk
After buying the shredded coconut, mix it with 800ml filtered water, then place in a cloth bag and squeeze to get the milk. Keep this first-press coconut milk (thick milk) separate.
Next, continue to put the coconut pulp back in and add 1 liter of filtered water, then squeeze and filter to get the thin coconut milk.
Preparing beans and rice
To clean the glutinous rice and mung beans, first wash them with water.
Then, take a basin and pour in all the thin coconut milk, all the pandan extract, 1 tbsp salt, and 1/2 tsp pandan extract, then stir well.
For the peeled mung beans, pour water into a basin so the beans are covered.
Then, let the rice and mung beans soak for about 3 - 4 hours or overnight (if you have time).
After the rice and mung beans have soaked and softened, pour them through a sieve or basket to drain.
Mixing and steaming
Alternately pour the rice and peeled mung beans into a basin, then mix well to ensure the ingredients are blended.
Next, prepare a rice cooker. Line the bottom of the pot with a layer of pandan leaves, then place all the rice and mung beans into the pot.
