Pour the thick coconut milk into a pot and heat over medium until boiling. Then, turn off the heat and immediately pour the coconut milk into the pot containing the rice and mung beans.
Close the lid, select the "Cook" mode, and start cooking. When the pot switches to "Warm," continue to let it sit for about 10 minutes.
Then, open the lid and use chopsticks to fluff the rice. Close the lid and turn on the "Cook" mode again for about 3 - 4 minutes so the rice expands and softens completely, ready to enjoy.
To prepare the sesame salt, mix 100gr sugar, 40gr crushed roasted peanuts, and 20gr roasted sesame seeds in a bowl. Then, add 1/2 tbsp salt and stir well.
4. Durian mung bean sticky rice
200 gr durian (about 3 segments)
500 gr glutinous rice
250 gr mung beans
200 ml coconut milk
5 pandan leaves
A little sugar and salt.
To prepare the rice, wash it clean, then soak in water for 6 - 8 hours or overnight. After soaking, place it in a basket to drain.
For the mung beans, wash and soak in water for about 2 hours to soften. After soaking, drain and place in a steamer.
Boil a pot of water on the stove, then place the steamer with the mung beans on top, cover, and steam for 20 - 25 minutes until soft. Then, turn off the heat and let the beans cool slightly.
Once the mung beans have cooled, place them in a blender and blend at medium power for 2 minutes.
Steaming the rice

Take half of the blended mung beans and mix well with the soaked and drained rice. Add one tsp of salt to this mixture, then place in the steamer and spread evenly. Leave a small hole in the middle so the steam can circulate.

Place the pot on the stove, add 5 tied pandan leaves and 1.5 liters of water. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Next, place the steamer with the rice and bean mixture on top, cover, and steam for about 20 minutes.
Next, add the remaining half of the blended mung beans to the steamer and fluff it all together.

Put 2 deseeded durian segments into a bowl, then add 3 tbsp sugar and 200ml coconut milk. Use a spoon to stir well until the components are blended. Then, pour the durian coconut milk mixture evenly over the rice and fluff to distribute. Steam for another 10 minutes over low heat.
After completing these steps, the durian sticky rice with coconut milk is ready to enjoy.
Important notes when cooking mung bean sticky rice
Pre-soak the mung beans: Soak the mung beans in water for about 2 hours before cooking. This helps soften the beans and reduces cooking time.
Appropriate water amount: When cooking mung bean sticky rice, add the right amount of water to ensure the rice is not too dry or too watery. Usually, the ratio of water to mung beans is about 2:1.
Cook on low heat: After boiling, reduce the heat and cook on low. Mung beans need time to soften and absorb water, so cooking on low heat ensures the rice cooks evenly without burning the bottom.
Stir well: During the cooking process, stir well so the mung beans do not stick to the bottom of the pot and to ensure the temperature is distributed evenly.
Check for doneness: When the rice has thickened and the mung beans are soft, check by mashing a few beans with your fingers. If they mash easily and don't feel hard, the rice is fully cooked.

mon_an.mo_ta: Thanks to Phạm Thị Huyền for sharing this Peanut Butter Sushi Sandwich recipe. Today, we are bringing this dish to you for your reference! If your children are bored with your usual breakfast and you don't have enough time for complex dishes, here is a simple and unique suggestion for breakfast or a snack for those "picky" little ones.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fruit jam - 2 tbsp (flavor of choice: strawberry, orange, raspberry, blueberry, etc.)
cac_buoc: How to make Peanut Butter Sushi Sandwiches:
Step 1: Cut off the crusts of the sandwich bread. Use a rolling pin or a cylindrical bottle to lightly roll over the surface of the bread to make it easier to roll.
Step 2: Spread 1 tbsp of peanut butter and 1 tbsp of fruit jam onto each slice of bread.
Step 3: Roll the bread into a spiral shape. Cut each roll into 4 pieces.

The ingredients for this dish are available at most supermarkets, making them easy to find and convenient to store in the refrigerator. Although the ingredients are simple, they are packed with nutrients such as protein, fat, fiber, manganese, magnesium, and folate, providing energy for the whole morning. This eye-catching and unique dish will surely excite children and make their meal more enjoyable.

mon_an.mo_ta: This weekend, treat your family to a delicious, warm, and nutritious bowl of Xôi Thịt (sticky rice with braised pork) for breakfast!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Soak the glutinous rice for 6 to 8 hours until soft, then drain well.
Step 2: Cut the pork belly into squares and marinate with seasonings. Place the pork in a pot, add more seasonings and minced shallots, then braise until the meat is tender.
Step 3: Place the rice in a steamer, add a pinch of salt, and toss well. Cover tightly and steam for about 20 to 25 minutes until the sticky rice is cooked.
Fluff the rice, pour the prepared coconut milk over it, then cover and steam for another 5 minutes.
Step 4: Once the sticky rice is ready, scoop it into a bowl or plate and serve with the braised pork.
Enjoy this delicious and chewy Xôi Thịt with your family for breakfast!

mon_an.mo_ta: Bún Chả Lá Lốt is a traditional Vietnamese dish featuring savory flavors and a delicate combination of quality ingredients. While it is highly appealing and nostalgic for many, few know how to prepare it at home. Let's explore this guide to making delicious Bún Chả Lá Lốt to enjoy with your family! Discover the secret to making perfect Bún Chả Lá Lốt for your family meals.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Wood ear mushrooms and shiitake mushrooms - 50g
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
First, blanch the pork bones in boiling water with a little salt for 3-5 minutes, then rinse with water to use for the broth.
Next, soak the wood ear mushrooms until expanded, then mince. For fresh shiitake mushrooms, remove the stems and cut them in half.
Peel and wash the onion; mince one half and thinly slice the other half. Wash the scallions and slice into thin strips.
Wash and crush the ginger. Wash the tomatoes and cut into quarters.
For the betel leaves, discard any damaged leaves. Wash the rest and set aside, keeping a long stem on each leaf to secure the rolls. Mince any leftover or torn leaves.
Step 2: Marinate the meat

Marinate the ground meat by mixing it with the minced wood ear mushrooms, minced onion, minced betel leaves, 1/2 tsp sugar, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp MSG, and 1/2 tsp ground pepper. Mix thoroughly so the meat absorbs the flavors. Let it marinate for 15-20 minutes.
Step 3: Wrap the betel leaf rolls
Place the dark green side of the betel leaf facing down. Put a sufficient amount of meat (about 2-3 tsp) on the leaf, then roll it up tightly.
To secure the roll, tuck the stem of the leaf into the center of the roll.
If there is leftover meat, you can roll it into small meatballs to cook in the broth.
Step 4: Cook the broth
Pour 1 liter of water into a pot and add the blanched pork bones. Bring to a boil.
Add the shiitake mushrooms, crushed ginger, a bit of pepper, 2 tsp salt, and 2.5 tsp sugar. Cover and simmer for one hour.
After simmering, add 1/2 tsp annatto oil and 2 tsp MSG.
Continue cooking the broth for another 5-7 minutes. Season with 1/2 tbsp fish sauce, stir well, and adjust to your family's taste.
Step 5: Completion

Cook for another 5-7 minutes, then add the tomatoes, meatballs, and betel leaf rolls to the pot. Continue cooking for 3-5 minutes until the meatballs float, indicating the broth is finished. Place the rice noodles in a bowl and garnish with sliced onions and scallion strips. Finally, pour the broth over the noodles and enjoy.
Notes for making Bún Chả Lá Lốt:
Before simmering the bones, blanch them in boiling water for about 3 minutes to remove any impurities and odors.
If time permits, buy pork and mince it yourself or use a home grinder to ensure hygiene and quality.
Avoid using leaves that are too old or too young, as they will not provide the best flavor for the dish.

mon_an.mo_ta: Bún Tôm Hải Phòng features vibrant colors and a delicious flavor. The recipe is simple, resulting in a sweet taste from the shrimp and meat combined with a rich, savory, and aromatic broth that provides a truly satisfying meal!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Water spinach or mustard greens - 1 bunch
Garnish - Dill, scallions, shiitake mushrooms, wood ear mushrooms
cac_buoc: How to make Bún Tôm Hải Phòng

Wash the pork ribs with salt to remove odors, then rinse again. Chop the ribs into small pieces and blanch in boiling water. Rinse again, then sauté the ribs with fish sauce until fragrant and seasoned. Add water and simmer for about 30 minutes.

Rinse the shrimp with white wine to remove the fishy smell, then rinse with water. Peel the shrimp, separating the heads and shells from the meat. Place the heads and shells in a blender, blend until smooth, and strain to get the shrimp liquid for the broth.
Place the strained shrimp liquid in a pot on the stove. Season to taste and bring to a gentle simmer, then turn off the heat.
To enhance the broth, combine the shrimp liquid with the rib broth, then boil for another 10 minutes to ensure there is no fishy odor.
Marinate the shrimp meat with 1 tsp of seasoning for about 15 minutes.
Soak the shiitake and wood ear mushrooms until fully expanded, wash, and julienne. Set aside.
Sauté the shrimp meat with the mushrooms and seasonings until the shrimp is firm, then set aside on a plate.
In a pan, heat some oil and sauté the minced shallots and tomatoes until soft, then add them to the main broth pot. Blanch the greens (seasonal) and rice noodles in boiling water.
Finally, assemble the bowl by adding the noodles, scallions, greens, shrimp, wood ear, and shiitake mushrooms. Pour the hot broth over and enjoy.
How to choose fresh shrimp

To determine the freshness of shrimp, stretch the shrimp straight and hold it up to the light to check the spacing between the shell segments. Wider spacing indicates the shrimp is not fresh and may have been frozen for a long time.

Avoid buying shrimp that are slimy. These shrimp often curl into a circle rather than lying straight. To check this, press your finger on the shell and move it back and forth. If it feels gritty or sticky, do not buy them.
Shrimp legs: Check if the legs are still firmly attached to the body; the meat should be firm. Do not choose shrimp with legs that have turned black, as this is a sign they are no longer fresh.
Different types of shrimp:
Black tiger shrimp: These are farmed, have firm meat, are large, and easy to prepare. Choose live ones with a shiny, smooth shell and a clear midsection.
Iron shrimp (Kiddi shrimp): Smaller but very tasty with a deep sweetness. Choose fresh ones that are pinkish-white. If they are dark pink, they are old and not fresh.
Banana shrimp (Sea shrimp): These should be lively, pinkish-white, with clear green eyes.
Lobster: The largest type, usually chosen for steaming. Good lobsters have bright blue-green claws and a shiny shell.

mon_an.mo_ta: With simple, easy-to-find ingredients and a straightforward method, you can create a new style of sandwich that is incredibly delicious. The golden crust from the eggs, the seductive aroma of milk and cinnamon, and the perfect crunch will keep you coming back for more.
cac_buoc: How to make grilled sandwiches for 3 people:
Step 1: Prepare the ingredients.
Crack the eggs into a separate bowl.
Pour the fresh milk into another bowl.
Step 2: Cooking steps.
In the bowl of milk, add the eggs, vanilla, cinnamon, and 1/2 tsp salt.
Use a whisk to beat the ingredients together until well combined.
Preheat your oven or sandwich press. Add a little oil and grease the surface evenly.
Take a slice of sandwich bread and dip it into the milk and egg mixture.
Let the bread soak for a moment to absorb the flavors, then flip it over to soak the other side for a few seconds before lifting it out.
Quickly transfer the bread to the oven or press.
Repeat the process with the second slice of bread.
Bake for a few minutes or until the bread is fragrant and crispy.
Continue with the remaining slices of bread.
Once cooked, arrange the sandwiches on a plate, top with some whipped cream and marshmallows for decoration, and enjoy.
Tips for a delicious sandwich:
Do not bake for too long to avoid the bread becoming too dry or brittle, which makes it crumble easily.
Besides whipped cream and marshmallows, you can simply dust the bread with powdered sugar, spread jam, or serve it with fresh milk.
Because the bread absorbs a lot of liquid, it will be quite soft; handle it carefully to prevent it from breaking.
If you don't have an oven, you can pan-fry the bread in a non-stick skillet without oil.

This recipe takes only about 10 minutes, making it perfect for busy mornings. A little time in the kitchen yields a wonderful treat for family and friends. You can pair it with a glass of soy milk or fruit juice for a nutritious breakfast that isn't too heavy!

mon_an.ten: Simple Breakfast with Sausage Sandwich Rolls and Green Tea Latte
mon_an.mo_ta: Sausage sandwich rolls and green tea latte are the perfect choice for your breakfast, especially when you are short on time. These delicious sausage rolls offer a burst of flavor in every bite with chewy cheese, savory sausage, and a crispy outer crust that you will never get tired of. Biting into a sandwich and sipping a cup of green tea latte will leave you absolutely enchanted!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Tempura flour, Panko breadcrumbs - 1 pack each
Yellow mustard, honey, ketchup, chili sauce - as needed
cac_buoc: How to make crispy sausage sandwich rolls for 2 servings:
Peel the potatoes, wash them, and boil until tender.
Peel the onion, wash it, and drain well.
Dice the onion, apple, potatoes, and cheese into small cubes.
After dicing the ingredients, mix them all in a small bowl, then add yellow mustard, honey, and fresh milk. Stir well until all ingredients are thoroughly combined.
Trim the crusts off the sandwich bread and roll them out lightly with a rolling pin to make them thinner; this makes rolling easier and the bread crispier when fried.

Spread a layer of the prepared mixture onto the bread, place a sausage in the center, and roll it up. If the roll doesn't stick, you can use a bit of egg wash or a small toothpick to secure it. Do not spread the mixture too thick or it may become too greasy.
Crack the eggs into a bowl, take the yolks, and whisk well.
Dip the rolls into the egg yolk and then roll them in the breadcrumbs until evenly coated.

Brush a little cooking oil over the rolls and bake in the oven for 20 minutes at 180 °C. If you don't have an oven, you can deep-fry them in a pan. When frying, remember to turn them regularly so they cook evenly on all sides and develop a beautiful golden color. Once cooked, remove the rolls and place them on paper towels to drain excess oil.
Finally, cut the rolls into small pieces, arrange them on a plate, drizzle with ketchup and chili sauce, and enjoy.
If you are short on time, you can simplify this dish by skipping the mixed filling; instead, just spread a layer of butter on the bread, place the sausage, roll it up, and fry as described above.
Green tea latte:
Here is how to make a green tea latte for 1 serving:
First, put the matcha powder into a cup, add 60 ml of boiling water, and whisk quickly until fine bubbles appear on the surface.
Add sugar syrup to the green tea mixture according to your desired sweetness. If you like it sweet, add more; if you prefer a mild sweetness, add less.
Next, place a pot on the stove and bring 100 ml of fresh milk to a boil. Turn off the heat and use a whisk to beat vigorously to create a thick layer of foam.
Once the milk is ready, pour it over the green tea cup and enjoy.
With crispy sausage rolls and a green tea latte, you won't spend much time on breakfast but will still have a wonderful, simple meal made from familiar ingredients prepared with a fresh twist.

mon_an.ten: Nutritious Breakfast with Homemade Bánh Cuốn
mon_an.mo_ta: Homemade hot bánh cuốn with soft skins, generous meat filling, and a sweet and sour dipping sauce served with fresh herbs will give you a delicious sensation when enjoyed.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Wood ear mushrooms, shiitake mushrooms - to taste
Dipping sauce ingredients - Sugar, fish sauce, garlic, chili...
cac_buoc: The batter:

First, buy a pack of bánh cuốn flour mix from any brand available at supermarkets. Do not mix the flour according to the ratio on the package; instead, measure 1 large bowl of water (about 600 ml) to mix with 200 gr of flour. This ratio helps the cakes stay thin and chewy without breaking.
When mixing the batter, add a little seasoning salt to make the skin more flavorful.
If you like a chewier texture, you can add a small teaspoon of tapioca starch.

The filling: Peel, wash, and mince the shallots. Soak the wood ear and shiitake mushrooms in water until soft, then wash and mince them. Next, sauté the shallots until fragrant, then add the minced meat and mushrooms. Season with a little spice and stir-fry until the meat is firm and cooked through.
Steaming the cakes:

First, prepare a strictly non-stick pan. Initially, coat the pan with a thin layer of oil and then pour it out, leaving no excess oil in the pan. When the pan is moderately hot, pour a ladle of batter into the center and swirl it evenly.

Cover the lid for 1-2 minutes; when the cake looks translucent, it is cooked. At this point, quickly flip the pan to let the cake fall onto a tray greased with oil to prevent sticking. Place the filling in the center and roll it up.
The dipping sauce: Mix the dipping sauce using the formula: 2 tbsp fish sauce, 2.5 tbsp sugar, 2 tbsp vinegar, and 200 ml filtered water.
Finally, arrange the bánh cuốn on a platter and serve with Vietnamese ham (chả), fried shallots, and your choice of fresh herbs.
Notes when making bánh cuốn with a pan:
1. Do not let the pan get too hot before pouring the batter.
If the pan is too hot, the batter will cook too quickly, becoming dry, pitted, or burnt, making it difficult to roll and unappealing.
2. Do not let the pan be too cool before pouring the batter.
If the pan is too cool, the batter will just "run around" the pan without setting.
3. Do not brush too much oil on the pan.
If there is too much oil, the batter will not form a uniform flat sheet and may develop holes in the center.
4. Do not leave the cake on the pan for too long.
The cake will bubble, overcook, and lose its translucency. The pan will then become too hot, causing the next cake to cook too fast and repeating the "accident."
5. Use a cutting board to hold the cakes after steaming.

According to long-time experience, to remove the cooked cake from the pan quickly, you should tap it onto a cutting board surface. Do not tap it onto a plate, as plates are often not perfectly flat and may break if tapped firmly.
6. How to remove the cake from the pan without wrinkling or folding it.

Notice that when the cake is perfectly cooked, the edges will naturally pull away from the pan. At that moment, quickly and decisively tap the cake onto a cutting board or a large flat plate. If it's difficult, use a wooden chopstick to gently loosen the edge before flipping.
Homemade hot bánh cuốn with soft skins, generous filling, and sweet and sour dipping sauce served with fresh herbs provides a truly delicious experience.

mon_an.ten: Nutritious Breakfast with Bún Bò Viên
mon_an.mo_ta: Bún bò viên features the aroma of lemongrass and ginger blended into the broth, crispy beef tendon, and flavorful beef balls. Served with fresh rice noodles, fresh herbs, and crunchy bean sprouts, it offers a wonderful culinary experience. With just a little time in the kitchen and easy-to-find ingredients, you can prepare this delicious noodle soup for your family and loved ones.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Side herbs - Scallions, coriander, bean sprouts, mint or Vietnamese coriander
Seasoning - salt, broth mix, lime, sugar, minced lemongrass, chili oil or chili powder, garlic, cooking oil
cac_buoc: How to make nutritious Bún Bò Viên
Step 1:
First, cut the beef balls in half if they are large.
Step 2:
Wash the beef bones and beef tendon, then blanch them in boiling water to remove impurities. Rinse the bones again with cold water to ensure they are clean.
Step 3: Lightly scrape the ginger skin; peel the dry outer layer of the onions and wash them.
Char the ginger and onions until the skins are slightly blackened.
Next, place the ginger, onions, beef bones, and beef tendon into a large pot. Add filtered water and a tablespoon of salt. Bring to a boil, occasionally skimming off the foam to keep the broth clear.
Step 4:
Trim and wash the scallions and coriander, then chop them finely.
Wash the bean sprouts and leave them in a colander to drain.
Pick the leaves of the herbs and wash them thoroughly.

Step 5: If using dried noodles, soak them in cold water for about 15 minutes, then boil in a pot of water for 5–8 minutes. Turn off the heat and cover the lid as the noodles will continue to soften. Once cooled, rinse them in cold water to prevent sticking and drain in a colander.
If using fresh noodles, use clean hands to loosen the strands or blanch them briefly to refresh them.

Step 6: Next, place a small pot on the stove, add annatto oil, and sauté the garlic until fragrant. Add the lemongrass and chili powder (or chili oil), a teaspoon of fish sauce, and a little sugar. Stir for about 5 minutes, then turn off the heat and set aside.
Step 7: Once the beef tendon in the broth is tender, remove it and slice into bite-sized pieces.

Continue to simmer the bones and add the sautéed lemongrass mixture from step 6 into the pot. Season to taste. Simmer until the bones have released all their sweetness, then add the beef balls and cook for another 10-15 minutes. Reduce to very low heat to keep the broth hot until serving.

Step 8: Finally, place some noodles in a bowl, add the beef tendon and a few beef balls. Garnish with scallions and coriander, then ladle the hot broth over. Serve with bean sprouts, herbs, lime, and fresh chili (if you like it spicy).

Bún bò viên is a favorite for many. The dish, with its aromatic broth, crispy tendon, and savory beef, provides a fantastic taste. With just a little effort, you'll have a delicious meal to treat your family. Everyone will be impressed by your nutritious and tasty beef ball noodle soup!

mon_an.ten: Nutritious Breakfast with Fried Chicken Phở
mon_an.mo_ta: Fried chicken phở features a crystal-clear broth aromatic with chicken essence, paired with succulent chicken that is crispy on the outside. Served with fresh herbs, it provides a delightful breakfast experience.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Side herbs - Thai basil, mint, lime...
cac_buoc: PART 2: HOW TO MAKE FRIED CHICKEN PHỞ
Step 1: Rub the chicken with salt to remove any odors, then rinse thoroughly with water and drain. Separate the meat from the bones.
Peel, wash, and mince the shallots.

Place a pot on the stove, sauté the shallots until fragrant, then add the chicken bones and sauté briefly with fish sauce. Add water, a bit of ginger, chili, and sugar, then simmer for 20-30 minutes to make the broth.

Step 2: While waiting for the broth, marinate the chicken meat with salt and pepper for about 15 minutes. Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a pan and fry the chicken until golden brown on both sides. Remove and place on paper towels to drain.
Step 3: Blanch the phở noodles in boiling water. Divide the noodles into 4 bowls.
Briefly blanch the bean sprouts and arrange them in the bowls, then ladle the chicken broth over.
Add the fried chicken, mint, Thai basil, and coriander to each bowl. Squeeze in some lime, add extra seasoning if desired, and enjoy while hot.
How to choose good chicken:
Tips for choosing pre-slaughtered chicken:
A good chicken will have a compact, firm body and a small breast.
The skin should be naturally yellow, with darker yellow patches on the wings, breast, and back. The skin should not be bruised, pale, or have black spots or lumps.
If the skin is tough and perfectly uniform yellow while the fat is white, the chicken may have been treated with yellow dye.
The meat should be firm, fresh, and free of foul odors or antibiotic smells.

Press your finger into the body, breast, or thigh; if the meat is firm, it is good. If it is flabby, slippery, deformed, or feels water-logged, it may have been injected with water or borax; avoid buying such chicken.
Tips for choosing live chicken:
When buying live chicken, pay attention to the following:
Compare two chickens of the same size; the one that feels heavier will have firmer meat.
A healthy chicken is active, hard to catch, has bright alert eyes, a bright red comb, and smooth, shiny feathers.
The beak should be sharp, shiny, and free of discharge.
The legs should be straight, slender, and free of scratches, red spots, or missing claws.

Part the feathers to check the skin; it should be thin and soft. The body should feel firm. Yellow streaks under the breast or wings indicate a healthy bird. If you can see meat and blood vessels under the wings, the chicken is lean.
A healthy chicken will have a pink, active vent that is dry and free of abnormal discharge. If the droppings are yellow, foamy, or bloody, do not buy it as the bird is likely diseased.

mon_an.mo_ta: With just a few steps and simple ingredients, you can complete a super delicious breakfast for the whole family. This tuna sandwich is quick and easy yet provides full nutrition and an appealing taste.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Finely chop the pickled cucumbers and celery.
Step 2: Mix the tuna with mayonnaise, cucumbers, and celery. Season with salt, ground pepper, and a little lime juice to taste.
Step 3: Spread butter onto the slices of bread.
On the unbuttered side of the bread, place a slice of cheese and then scoop the tuna mixture on top.
Place a second slice of bread on top (buttered side facing out). Repeat with the remaining bread.

Step 4: Finally, heat a pan and place the sandwiches in. Pan-fry until the bread is golden and crispy. When the bread turns light brown and the cheese starts to melt, reduce the heat. Flip the sandwich once the cheese has melted. Fry until both sides are golden and crispy. Remove to a plate and enjoy immediately!
A tuna sandwich enjoyed with a glass of milk is simply wonderful!

mon_an.ten: Nha Trang Fish Cake Bánh Canh
mon_an.mo_ta: Delicious pieces of fried fish cake served with piping hot bánh canh noodles—just one sip of the broth and you'll experience the rich, savory flavors of home! Check out this simple recipe for Nha Trang fish cake bánh canh to make at home. We hope this guide helps you prepare a wonderful meal for your family. This article shares the detailed recipe and steps to create this traditional dish, featuring the bold taste of fish cakes and the delightful texture of bánh canh noodles.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings - Rock sugar, salt, fish sauce, cooking oil, red chili, ground pepper.
cac_buoc: 1. How to cook Nha Trang Cobia Head Bánh Canh

Step 1: Clean the cobia head, chop into small pieces, and wash with salt water; drain well. Marinate the fish with a bit of salt, seasoning powder, and pepper for 15 minutes to absorb the flavors. Place a pan on the stove, heat the oil, sauté the crushed shallots until fragrant, then remove the shallots and set aside; next, lightly sear the cobia head.

Step 2: Peel the radish, wash, and slice into pieces. Place them in a pot with enough filtered water to make the broth. Add seasonings such as salt, seasoning powder, rock sugar, and the sautéed shallots to the pot.
Step 3: When the radish water comes to a boil, add the seared cobia head to make the broth sweet and flavorful. Simmer over low heat so the fish releases its sweetness without breaking apart.

Step 4: Wash the straw mushrooms, soak in diluted salt water for about 15 minutes, then drain. Wash the scallion whites and drain. When the broth is ready (the fish and radish are tender), add the straw mushrooms. Once it boils again, season to taste, add the scallion whites, and turn off the heat.
Next are the steps to prepare the fish cakes!

Step 1: While the broth is simmering, shape the fish cake paste into round patties. You can buy pre-made fish cake paste at markets or supermarkets (already seasoned and very flavorful). With 500g of pre-made paste, you can form 4 round patties.
Step 2: Fry two patties: Place a pan on the stove, heat the oil, and fry each patty until golden brown on both sides; remove and drain on paper towels.

Step 3: Steam the other two patties: Bring a pot of water to a boil, place 2 patties in a steamer basket, and steam for about 15 minutes. Beat one duck egg yolk and pour it over the surface of the fish cakes, cover, and steam for another 7 minutes until cooked. The steamed fish cakes will have an eye-catching golden color.
Step 4: Once both the fried and steamed fish cakes have cooled, slice them as desired for serving.
Time to present the dish!
Blanch the bánh canh noodles in hot water for 2 minutes, then drain in a basket.
Place the noodles in a bowl, top with fish cakes, and pour the broth over them; serve hot. Add a few sprigs of cilantro, a squeeze of lime, and a small bowl of thick chili fish sauce.
Pick up a piece of fish cake, dip it in fish sauce, take a bite, and savor the heat—it's truly satisfying. Slurp a spoonful of the sweet, rich broth for a delightful experience.
The broth is naturally sweet and savory, paired with fresh, soft, and fragrant fish cakes and silky white noodles—truly irresistible.
This is a delicious bánh canh dish that can be enjoyed at any time of the day; it's flavorful, nutritious, and easy to cook.
Cooking fish cake bánh canh is not difficult; give it a try!
2. How to cook Nha Trang Tuna Fish Cake Bánh Canh
Prepare ingredients
500g pre-packaged bánh canh noodles
500g bronze featherback fish paste
500g tuna
1 kg pork bone
300g straw mushrooms
10 quail eggs
50g shrimp and crab meat
Scallions, sawtooth herb, cilantro, chili
Essential seasonings: fish sauce, sugar, pepper
Side vegetables: bean sprouts, lettuce, herbs, banana blossom
Steps to cook Nha Trang Tuna Fish Cake Bánh Canh
Step 1: Prepare ingredients
Wash the pork bones and remove odors by rubbing with salt and lime.
Wash and halve the mushrooms.
Wash the tuna and slice into bite-sized pieces.
Boil the quail eggs, peel, and set aside.
Step 2: Simmer bones and cook the broth
Place the cleaned pork bones in a pot with water along with the tuna and straw mushrooms. Simmer for about 2 hours. Start on high heat until boiling, then reduce to low heat and continue to simmer.
If foam appears while simmering the bones, use a ladle to skim it off to make the broth clearer and tastier.
Add whole shallots to the pot to remove the fishy smell and bring a natural sweetness to the broth.
Step 3: Prepare the fish cakes
In a bowl, mix the fish paste with cooking oil, minced garlic, scallions, salt, fish sauce, and seasonings to suit your family's taste. Marinate for 10 minutes.

After marinating, mix in the shrimp and crab meat, then use your hands to pound the mixture thoroughly. It is recommended to do this by hand to maintain the meat's elasticity rather than using a blender. Once pounded smooth, form the mixture into flat round patties. Steam half and fry the other half.
Step 4: Blanch the noodles
Boil water in a separate small pot, then blanch the bánh canh noodles. After blanching, you can drop them into a bowl of cold water to prevent sticking.
Step 5: Complete the dish

Arrange the noodles, fish cakes, and quail eggs in a bowl. Slowly pour the broth over them. Sprinkle with a bit of pepper, sawtooth herb, and scallions for garnish. Quy Nhon-style fish cake bánh canh is often served with raw vegetables and a side of Binh Dinh chili salt fish sauce for a signature flavor.
Notes when cooking fish cake bánh canh
If you want the broth to have a natural sweetness without using seasoning powder, you can add white radish.
Shallots are an indispensable ingredient for the broth, as they provide sweetness and neutralize fishy odors.
Fish cakes are best when pounded by hand instead of using a blender. Hand-pounding gives the fish a firmer and chewier texture.
The fish cake is the soul of the dish, so when choosing fish, remember to select the freshest pieces to create the best cakes.
How to choose fresh tuna
Choose fish with bright, transparent eyes and clear colors. If the eyes are sunken, the fish may have been frozen for a long time or transported extensively, and the meat will not be fresh.
Check the gills; if the fish is fresh, the gills will be bright red. If they are dark red or brownish-black, the fish is stale.
Press the skin (especially the belly) with your finger. If the skin has good elasticity and doesn't stay indented, the fish is fresh.

You can use a needle probe to check the tuna meat. The redder and firmer the meat, the better it is; duller meat indicates lower quality. When probing, take a sample and rub it in your palm. If a lot of water comes out and the meat is soft and mushy, it won't taste good.

mon_an.mo_ta: Churros are a familiar breakfast item for people in Spain, but they are also widely enjoyed as a favorite snack. Churros are popular in many countries such as France, the USA, Portugal, Mexico, and more. The pastry features a cinnamon-sugar coating, a crispy exterior, and a soft, buttery interior—it's truly wonderful! Let's learn how to make Spanish Churros; they are guaranteed to be delicious and can even be stored for later!
cac_buoc: Make the cinnamon sugar: Mix 120g of sugar with the cinnamon powder and set aside.
Make the Chocolate Cream for the Churros:
Step 1: Place the finely chopped dark chocolate and salt into a medium bowl. Heat the chocolate in a pan until completely melted. Stir the chocolate with the cream.
Step 2: Add the Grand Marnier liqueur, mix well, and set aside. (This is optional!)
Making the Churros:
Step 1: Combine the remaining sugar, water, butter, and ¼ tsp salt in a pot; cook over medium heat until the mixture boils.
Step 2: Reduce the heat, add the flour, and stir for a while to dry out the dough slightly, then turn off the heat.
Step 3: Mix the dough with the eggs.
Step 4: Transfer the dough into a piping bag fitted with a star tip.
Step 5: Place a pot or pan on the stove, fill with oil (about one or two finger joints deep), and once the oil is hot, pipe the dough in to fry.
Step 6: When the churros are golden brown, remove them and drain. Once slightly cooled, sprinkle with cinnamon sugar or roll the churros in the cinnamon sugar bowl.
That's all the steps for making Spanish Churros; enjoy them with the chocolate cream!

mon_an.ten: Egg Bánh Cuốn for a Nutritious Breakfast
mon_an.mo_ta: Egg bánh cuốn is incredibly delicious with a soft, fragrant outer layer and a savory egg and meat filling, creating a nutritious breakfast for your whole family!
cac_buoc: + The batter: Mix 200g rice flour and 100g tapioca starch in a bowl, then pour in filtered water to dissolve. Crack about 4 eggs into the flour and whisk well until the mixture is a thin, slightly viscous liquid suitable for spreading.
+ The filling:
Soak wood ear mushrooms in warm water until expanded, wash, and mince.
Peel and mince the garlic, shallots, and onion.
Marinate the ground pork with a bit of salt, sugar, MSG, and ground pepper to absorb the flavors.
Heat a pan on the stove, add a little oil, and sauté the garlic until fragrant. Then add all the onions, ground pork, and wood ear mushrooms, stir-frying until cooked to make the filling.

+ Steaming the rolls: Place a non-stick pan on the stove. When the pan is very hot, use a ladle to pour the batter and spread it evenly over the surface. When the batter is just cooked, remove the sheet and lay it on a tray. Place a spoonful of meat filling on one side, roll it up, and serve on a plate. Repeat until all batter and filling are used to create plates of hot, fragrant rolls.

For bánh cuốn, besides the filling and the batter, the dipping sauce is equally important; for a delicious dish, the sauce must have a mild sweetness. Depending on personal taste, a general formula is: Dissolve 1 tbsp sugar with 1/2 tbsp vinegar, 1.5 tbsp fish sauce, and 3 tbsp warm water. Stir until dissolved. Add chili and a squeeze of lime when eating.
When eating, dip each piece of bánh cuốn into the sweet, salty, and spicy sauce and enjoy.

This dish is quite simple and doesn't take much time, making it perfect for a family breakfast. On chilly days, there's nothing better than the whole family gathering to enjoy plates of hot, nutritious, and hygienic egg bánh cuốn made by your own hands to start a new day.
Homemakers, please take a little time to show off your skills with this egg roll dish for your loved ones. Good luck!

mon_an.ten: Cheese and Egg Bánh Mì Rolls
mon_an.mo_ta: Cheese and egg bánh mì rolls attract diners at first sight not only with their appealing colors but also with the delicious flavors of sausage, fresh eggs, and soft bread. Let's learn how to make this tasty dish for the whole family!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Cut off the crusts of the bread and use a rolling pin to flatten the bread until soft and thin.
Step 2:
Whisk the eggs with 1 small tsp of water and a tiny bit of seasoning!
Step 3:
Next, heat a pan over medium heat, coat with a very thin layer of oil, then pour a thin layer of egg into the pan. Quickly arrange the bread, cheese, and sausage on top.
Step 4:
Then, turn off the heat and gently roll up the egg. Afterward, turn the heat back on and roll the bread roll back and forth for about 1 minute until the egg layer is completely cooked.
Step 5:
Repeat the process with the remaining 2 rolls.
Finally, remember to let the cheese and egg bánh mì rolls cool for about 5 minutes before slicing and enjoying!

mon_an.ten: Baked Mozzarella Cheese Sandwiches for Breakfast
mon_an.mo_ta: Detailed instructions on how to make delicious baked mozzarella cheese sandwiches for breakfast. You will learn the recipe and steps to create an appealing sandwich with a rich, creamy layer of mozzarella cheese.
cac_buoc: 1. How to make delicious baked mozzarella cheese sandwiches for breakfast
The ingredients are enough for 2-4 people.
Implementation steps
Sandwich bread: Use scissors to cut off the crusts. Use a knife to trim the edges of the 8 slices of bread.
Mozzarella cheese: Slice into small, medium-thick pieces.
Eggs: Crack into a bowl and whisk.
Add a pinch of salt and pepper, then stir well.
Place the mozzarella on a slice of bread and top with another slice as shown in the photo.
Fresh milk: Pour into a large bowl and dip the cheese sandwiches into the milk so it absorbs evenly.
Remove the sandwiches and dip them into the egg bowl.
Then, coat the sandwiches in breadcrumbs, flipping them so both sides are evenly covered.
Prepare a baking tray lined with foil and arrange the breadcrumb-coated sandwiches on it.
Preheat the oven to 200°C for 5 minutes and bake the sandwiches for 15-20 minutes.
Watch the oven until the bread is done to avoid burning it. Serve on a plate and enjoy.
So, the baked cheese sandwiches are finished. Very simple and delicious, right? The bread is golden and crispy, the cheese is melted—the taste is impeccable. Your kids will surely love this dish.
2. How to make Baked Ground Beef and Cheese Sandwiches
Ingredients to prepare
200g ground beef
20g mozzarella cheese, shredded
2 tsp minced garlic
4 long, thin cucumber slices
2 sprigs of cilantro
A bit of ketchup
1 tsp soy sauce
1 tsp oyster sauce
1 tbsp cooking oil
1/2 tsp salt
How to prepare Baked Ground Beef and Cheese Sandwiches
1. Stir-fry the ground beef

To stir-fry the ground beef, use a pan and heat 1 tbsp of cooking oil. Add 2 tsp of minced garlic and sauté until fragrant, about 1 minute. Then, place 200g of ground beef in the pan and stir well. Once the beef is cooked and seasoned, add 1 tsp soy sauce, 1 tsp oyster sauce, and 1/2 tsp salt. Continue stir-frying for about 3 minutes over medium heat until the meat is fully cooked and has absorbed the flavors. Then, turn off the heat.
2. Complete the sandwich

To finish the sandwich, use a knife to cut a longitudinal slit along the side of the bread. Inside the bread, add 2 tbsp of the cooked ground beef, 4 thin cucumber slices, 2 sprigs of cilantro, 20g shredded mozzarella, and a bit of ketchup. Close the sandwich and place it in the oven; bake at 180°C for about 5-7 minutes until the bread is hot and crispy and the cheese has melted. Now, you can enjoy this delicious meal!
3. Finished product
The finished ground beef and cheese sandwich offers a crispy crust combined with the savory flavor of stir-fried beef and the richness of mozzarella cheese.
If you like spicy food, you can replace ketchup with chili sauce. To enjoy the full flavor, eat immediately after baking.
Notes when making baked cheese sandwiches
1. Choosing the bread: Choose bread with a crispy crust and soft interior. Larger and thicker bread is usually better for holding the cheese and won't fall apart when baking.
2. Type of cheese: Use a cheese suitable for baking. Mozzarella is a popular choice due to its melting ability and creamy coating. However, you can also try other cheeses for variety.
3. Preparing the bread: Slice the bread thinly or cut a slit along the side to create a pocket for the cheese and other ingredients.

4. Cheese and other ingredients: Place the cheese and other ingredients like ground meat, vegetables, and seasonings into the bread. Use an appropriate and even amount of cheese to ensure it melts uniformly.

5. Temperature and baking time: Bake at the right temperature and time for the best results. Typically, bake at 180-200°C for 5-10 minutes or until the cheese melts and the bread is an appealing golden color.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Unique and Delicious Fruit Pizza
mon_an.mo_ta: In the summer, you might prefer eating fruit over other foods. Traditional pizza with meat, vegetables, or seafood might feel heavy or make you worry about weight gain. So, try your hand at this incredibly appealing fruit pizza—you'll fall in love with both the fruit and the crust. Save this one-of-a-kind fruit pizza recipe!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Toasted black sesame seeds - 1 small tsp
cac_buoc: Making the fruit pizza crust:

Step 1: First, heat 55ml of fresh milk over low heat until it reaches about 35°C, then turn off the heat and gently sprinkle the yeast over the surface. Let it sit for 5 minutes until the yeast blooms.

Step 2: Knead the flour thoroughly with the milk and yeast for about 10 minutes, then add 15g of butter and knead for another 5 minutes. Shape the dough into a ball, place it in a covered pot, and proof in a warm place until doubled in size (about 30–60 minutes).

Step 3: Dust your hands with flour and gently punch the dough to release air bubbles, then roll it into a thin circle that fits your pizza mold. Use a fork to prick many small holes in the crust. Cover the mold with plastic wrap and proof the crust for another half hour. While waiting, grate the cheese into large shreds and prepare the toppings.
Making the fruit pizza topping:

Step 1: Melt 15g of butter. Peel the apple, cut into bite-sized pieces, and add to the pan. Sprinkle 15g of sugar over the apples and sauté gently until they absorb the sugar and smell like apple jam. Next, sprinkle the sesame seeds and add the other chopped fruits, sautéing over low heat with the apples until the liquid evaporates. Turn off the heat, drizzle with honey, and stir well.

Step 2: Whisk the egg in a small bowl and use a brush to coat the entire surface of the crust. Sprinkle a little cheese over the base. Spread the sautéed fruit evenly, and finally, top with a thin layer of shredded mozzarella. Bake at 200°C for about 10 minutes or until the crust is golden and crispy and the cheese is melted and smooth.

mon_an.mo_ta: Sausage-wrapped biscuits appeal to diners from the very first glance with their beautiful golden-brown color, soft, fresh, and moist crust. The biscuits are not dry but incredibly delicious thanks to the combination of savory ingredients like sausage, fresh eggs, and a touch of rich cheese. On a cold winter afternoon, there's nothing like nibbling on a hot, fragrant biscuit while sipping hot tea or a glass of fresh milk. Don't hesitate—get in the kitchen and make this delicious treat!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients for sausage-wrapped biscuits.
Crack the egg into a bowl and whisk.
Next, use a sharp knife to dice the sausages into small pieces.
Preheat your oven to 400°F (approximately 204°C).
Grate the cheddar cheese.
Step 2: Steps to make sausage-wrapped biscuits
First, spread the biscuit dough on a table and use a rolling pin to flatten the dough to about 10cm.
Next, use a round cookie cutter or a small bowl to cut the dough into bite-sized circles.
Spray a light layer of non-stick oil into each slot of a muffin tin so the biscuits can be easily removed after baking.

Then, place each piece of dough into the slots, pressing down gently to secure them. Add a bit of sausage to the center of each biscuit, then sprinkle a layer of cheese on top. Finally, use a spoon to pour a bit of egg into each portion to complete the filling.
Next, seal the top of the biscuits with another piece of dough. Use your fingers to press the edges firmly to completely enclose the filling.
Once prepared, place the tin in the oven for about 10-12 minutes or until the biscuits turn golden brown.
When cooked, remove from the oven and let cool slightly, then arrange on a plate and enjoy with a glass of cold orange juice.
Notes for delicious sausage-wrapped biscuits
The sealing step is quite important; if you leave the dough open, the filling can easily burst out during baking.
Instead of sausage, you can use bacon or any other type of meat. However, if you use fresh meat, remember to pre-cook it until almost done before adding it to the biscuits.
Additionally, you should microwave the sausage for about 30 seconds or use smoked sausage to ensure it is thoroughly cooked and evenly heated when the biscuits are baked.

With this method, you skip the complicated and time-consuming step of kneading dough, so just a little time in the kitchen will give you a wonderful treat. Sausage-wrapped biscuits are visually appealing with their golden-brown color and soft, moist texture. They are incredibly flavorful due to the mix of sausage, egg, and rich cheese. On chilly winter days, enjoying these hot biscuits with hot tea or milk is perfect. Don't wait—try this recipe now!

mon_an.mo_ta: The chicken sandwich with mango sauce is a unique but delicious dish featuring savory, tender seasoned chicken paired with fragrant bread and a sweet and sour sauce. Everything blends together to create a marvelous meal.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Marinate the chicken with salt and pepper; you can also add a tiny bit of curry powder.
Step 2:
Peel the onion and slice into bite-sized pieces.
Step 3:
After marinating for 15 minutes, fry or grill the chicken. If you don't like the pungency of raw onion, you should grill or fry it as well!
Step 4:
Blend the mango until smooth.
Step 5:
Then, mix the mango purée with mayonnaise and a bit of sugar or lemon juice if needed. If you want a more impressive sauce flavor, mix in a little curry powder!
You can also add chili if you like it spicy.

mon_an.mo_ta: This is a breakfast dish that is extremely popular in Korea, especially when the weather is cold. Traditionally, the bread only consisted of eggs, but later, people creatively added cheese, ham, and a few other ingredients to enhance the flavor. Let's learn how to make this treat from the land of Kimchi!
cac_buoc: The ingredients above are enough to make 6 cakes!
Let's get started to bake these perfect treats!
Step 1:
Place the flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar in a bowl according to the ratios above and mix them well.
Step 2:
Next, crack one egg into the bowl and use a fork or spoon to mix it thoroughly with the flour.
Step 3:
Then, add the unsweetened fresh milk to the bowl and use a fork to mix the batter with the milk until very smooth!
Step 4:
Continue mixing until the mixture is thick, smooth, and free of lumps.
To check the batter, use a spoon to scoop it up and pour it back down; if it falls steadily without breaking, the batter is ready!
Step 5:
Melt the butter and use it to grease the baking tray; if you don't have butter, you can use cooking oil. This step prevents the bread from sticking to the tray when cooked.
You can use a 6-slot muffin tin for this; if you can't find one, a round mold will also work.
Step 6:
For each slot, only fill the batter to 1/3 of the capacity to leave room for the other ingredients.
Step 7:
Wash and mince the parsley; finely chop the bacon for easier eating.
Add one egg to each slot along with the chopped bacon and minced parsley!
Step 8:
Set the oven temperature to 200°C and bake the tray for 10 minutes.
Step 9:
While waiting for the bread to cook, finely shred the cheese to sprinkle on top.
After 10 minutes, open the oven, sprinkle the cheese over each slot, and bake for another 3 minutes.
Tada! We have finished the delicious, rich Korean egg bread.
Finished product requirements:
The bread should be golden brown with an appealing aroma of cheese, butter, and eggs.
The bread should be soft, fragrant, and creamy.
The bread should not be dry or burnt.
This egg bread is a popular breakfast in Korea, known as Gyeran-ppang.
Egg bread is a perfect combination of eggs, cheese, bacon, and butter, creating an enchanting, slightly rich flavor that is both delicious and filling.

Korean Egg Bread (Gyeran-ppang) is a very popular winter street food in the land of Kimchi. The method is quick and nutritious, making it perfect for starting a day full of energy! It is delicious served hot or cold. Starting the morning with one of these and a glass of milk is unbeatable, right?

mon_an.ten: Pandan Sticky Rice Cake for Breakfast
mon_an.mo_ta: Changing up your daily breakfast with pandan sticky rice cake to provide energy for a morning of studying or working is a great idea.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Pandan leaves - 4 (blended with 200ml water, strained for juice)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the glutinous rice and soak it with the pandan juice for about 5 hours, then rinse with cold water. Mix a bit of salt into the rice and steam until cooked.
Once the rice is cooked, transfer it to a bowl.
Step 2: Combine coconut milk, salt, sugar, and fragrant pandan leaves in a pot and cook over low heat; turn off the heat once the sugar has dissolved.
Step 3: Pour the coconut milk mixture into the bowl of sticky rice and stir well.
Step 4: Let the sticky rice absorb all the coconut milk for 30 minutes. Then, place the rice into a mold and press down firmly.
Step 5: Place all the custard layer ingredients into a blender according to the ratios above and blend until smooth.
Strain the liquid into a pot. Place the pot on the stove and cook over low heat, stirring constantly. When the mixture thickens slightly, turn off the heat.
Step 6: Pour the blended mixture over the layer of sticky rice in the mold.
Step 7: Prepare a steamer with boiling water, place the mold inside, and steam for 25-30 minutes until the cake is set. Then, remove the mold and let it cool.
You can cut the pandan sticky rice cake into pieces, arrange them on a plate, and garnish with shredded young coconut to make it more appealing.
Sticky rice cake is a Malaysian snack; it has a rich, fragrant taste and soft, chewy rice grains that are very delicious.

mon_an.mo_ta: Beef steak is a Western dish that you can easily make at home. It is simple yet delicious and nutritious. This weekend, try your hand at making this appealing and tasty dish!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, oyster sauce, olive oil, pepper.
Potatoes, butterhead lettuce, carrots, vinaigrette, chili sauce, Italian vinegar.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Arrange the beef on a tray and sprinkle a little salt evenly on both sides. (If using local beef, you should lightly pound the meat before processing).
Marinate the beef with a little salt, pepper, and oyster sauce.
Step 2:
Continue marinating the beef with olive oil and let it sit for about 5 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Peel the potatoes, cut into strips, and deep-fry until crispy.
Step 3:
Place the beef on a grill and cook both sides over hot charcoal. Depending on your preference, you can cook it well-done or medium-rare.
Wash the lettuce and tear into small pieces; shred the carrots.
Toss the salad with a little Italian vinegar and olive oil.
Place the grilled beef on a plate and serve with potatoes, salad, chili sauce, or gravy.

mon_an.mo_ta: Bún măng vịt is a familiar dish, but not everyone knows how to prepare it to achieve the perfect, authentic flavor.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings - Salt, seasoning powder, fish sauce, MSG, cooking oil.
Rice vermicelli for serving - depending on the number of servings
cac_buoc: Step 1: Clean the duck. Cut the head, wings, and feet separately and place them in a bowl. Marinate the duck meat with a little seasoning powder, minced shallots, and julienned ginger.
Step 2: Thinly slice the fresh bamboo shoots, then boil them in a pot to reduce the sourness.

Step 3: Place a pan on the stove, sauté the minced shallots with a little oil, then add the duck head, wings, and feet to stir-fry. Next, add the bamboo shoots and stir-fry together. This method will make the broth richer and more flavorful.
Step 4: Place the remaining duck body in a pot and boil until cooked. Remove the duck, let it dry, and then chop into bite-sized pieces.
Step 5: Pour the duck boiling water into the pot with the stir-fried duck and bamboo shoots and bring to a boil. Once the broth boils, adjust the seasoning to taste.

Step 6: Place the vermicelli in a bowl, arrange the duck meat on top, and pour the broth over it. Bún vịt is served with finely chopped fresh herbs, and the duck meat is best dipped in ginger garlic fish sauce.
Bún vịt is very simple yet incredibly attractive.
Summer is duck season, so don't miss the chance to make this dish for your whole family.
Good luck with this authentic bún măng vịt recipe to treat your family to a delicious meal!

mon_an.mo_ta: You can make field crab noodle soup for any meal of the day for your family with this very simple method below.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Soak the field crabs in water for 1 to 2 hours to clean off all the dirt, then rinse thoroughly and remove the top shells. Scoop out the crab roe and set aside in a bowl.

Step 2: Put the crab meat into a blender and blend until smooth, then strain through a sieve to get the crab liquid. Add a little salt to the strained liquid, stir gently, and place on the stove over medium heat. When the crab cakes form and float, gently skim them out and set aside in a bowl.
Step 3: Cut the tofu into square pieces and fry until golden brown on both sides.
Step 4: Mince the shallots and garlic; cut the tomatoes into wedges. Sauté the tomatoes, shallots, and garlic with a little oil until the tomatoes are soft.
Then add the crab roe and stir well; turn off the heat after 3 minutes.
Step 5: Add the sautéed tomato and roe mixture into the pot of crab broth and bring back to a boil. Add some chopped scallions and turn off the heat.
Step 6: Place the blanched vermicelli in a bowl, arrange the tofu and crab cakes on top, pour the hot crab broth over everything, and serve.
Bún riêu cua is usually served with finely shredded banana blossoms, perilla leaves, and lettuce, which is very delicious.

mon_an.mo_ta: Bún thang is an extremely easy dish to make. Buy the ingredients and practice right in your small kitchen; the taste will be just as authentic as at a restaurant!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 500g pork loin bones or tube bones
100g dried shrimp, 2-3 dried squid tentacles (or peanut worms)
Scallions, Vietnamese coriander, grilled shallots and ginger, shiitake mushrooms, dried radish
Shrimp paste, seasonings, fish sauce, a bit of rock sugar, vinegar, white granulated sugar
cac_buoc: Bún thang is a familiar dish of Hanoians, loved by many. The broth is very sweet, rich, clear, and has a strong aroma of dried shrimp, giving the dish a very characteristic and irresistible flavor. Many people think it's difficult to cook this dish, but with the recipe below, we can easily enjoy bún thang right at home.
PREPARING INGREDIENTS FOR BÚN THANG
Thinly shred the Vietnamese ham and set aside.
Pick and wash the scallions and Vietnamese coriander, drain, then finely chop and set aside.
Wash the ginger and drain.
Peel the shallots, wash, then crush and mince; set aside.

Soak the dried radish in warm water for 30 minutes to expand, then rinse with clean water. Next, shred it very finely and mix with 2 tbsp vinegar and 1 tbsp white sugar. Mix well and let sit for 30 minutes to absorb the seasoning.
Clean the shiitake mushrooms, cut off the black stems, and wash.
Clean the dried shrimp and set aside. For the tiger shrimp, remove the heads, tails, and shells, devein, then wash. Place the shrimp in a mortar and lightly pound, then set aside.
Beat the eggs in a bowl, add a little seasoning powder, whisk well, and set aside.
Thoroughly wash the chicken with diluted salt water, rinse with clean water, and drain.
Wash the pork bones with diluted salt water, rinse with clean water, and drain.
STEPS TO MAKE BÚN THANG
Step 1: Grill the cleaned ginger until cooked and fragrant. Next, grill the squid tentacles on the stove until cooked; once cooled, shred them into small fibers.

Step 2: Place the chicken in a pot to boil. When it boils, add 1 tbsp seasoning powder, 1/2 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp salt, and the grilled shallots and ginger. Lower the heat to cook the chicken through. After removing and cooling, shred the chicken by hand into bite-sized pieces and set aside.

Step 3: Place the pork bones in a pot and bring to a boil with water, then discard that water and rinse the bones in cold water to remove debris. Then put the bones into the chicken boiling water and simmer (about 2–3 hours) to make the broth.

Step 4: While simmering the bones for the broth, turn on another burner and place a non-stick pan on it. When the pan is very hot, add the dried shrimp and roast until fragrant, then remove to a plate. Next, use the same pan, add a little oil to coat the surface. When the oil is hot, add the pounded tiger shrimp, add a little fish sauce, and stir-fry until the shrimp is cooked and slightly dry like shrimp floss, then remove to a plate.
Step 5: Coat the pan with oil and pour in the beaten eggs to fry them very thinly. Once cooked, remove to a plate; when the eggs have cooled, shred them into fine strips.

Step 6: When the bone broth has simmered for about 50 minutes to 1 hour, add the grilled squid tentacles, roasted dried shrimp, shiitake mushrooms, 1 piece of rock sugar, 1 tbsp seasoning powder, 1 tbsp salt, and a little fish sauce. Stir well. Continue to simmer for another 1 or 2 hours, then adjust the seasoning to taste. Add chopped scallions and Vietnamese coriander, then turn off the heat.
Step 7: Blanch the vermicelli in hot water, arrange the toppings on top, and pour the broth over. If you can eat shrimp paste, add ½ tsp of shrimp paste on top.
To cook bún thang, we have to spend quite a bit of time and effort. This is an elaborate dish that requires the cook to be meticulous and skillful.

mon_an.mo_ta: Change up your family's breakfast with this hot, delicious, and nutritious shrimp noodle soup!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Water spinach (or mustard greens) according to season
Wood ear mushrooms, shiitake mushrooms - 5-6 pieces
Seasonings - Seasoning powder, salt, MSG, cooking oil.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Clean and prepare the tomatoes, water spinach, scallions, wood ear, and shiitake mushrooms.
Cut the tomatoes into wedges; soak the wood ear and shiitake mushrooms until expanded, then shred.
Step 2: Wash the shrimp and pork ribs. Blanch the ribs, then place them in a pressure cooker and simmer until tender. Peel the shrimp, remove the heads, devein, and butterfly the backs.
Wash the shrimp heads and shells, pound them in a mortar, and strain to get the shrimp liquid.

Step 3: Sauté the shallots with a little oil, then add the wood ear and shiitake mushrooms to stir-fry. Next, add the shrimp and cook through. Season with 1 tsp seasoning powder, then remove the shrimp and mushroom mixture to a bowl.
Step 4: In the same pan, lightly sauté the tomatoes. Add a little seasoning powder to help the tomatoes soften quickly.

Step 5: When the ribs are cooked, extract the broth and combine it with the boiled shrimp liquid. When the broth boils, adjust the seasoning to taste. Lower the heat to a simmer, add the water spinach, and cook for about 1-2 minutes.

Step 6: While waiting for the broth to boil, arrange the vermicelli in a bowl, add the shrimp and wood ear on top, place the ribs and a little MSG, add some scallions, then slowly pour the broth over.
Bún tôm has the sweet aroma of shrimp and meat, the crunchiness of wood ear mushrooms, and tender, chewy peeled shrimp.
Each strand of white vermicelli immersed in the golden, delicious broth will attract even the most fastidious eaters.
Wishing you and your family success and a delicious meal with this rich bún tôm recipe!

mon_an.mo_ta: This Singaporean specialty stir-fried vermicelli dish will become much easier with this recipe!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 8-12 shrimp, peeled, heads and tails removed, deveined
Sesame oil, curry powder, soy sauce, scallions, dried chili, ground pepper
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Soak the dried vermicelli in water for about 20 minutes, then remove and drain.
Step 2:
Shred the ingredients: carrot, onion, scallions, cabbage, dried chili, and Chinese sausage. For the shrimp, wash, prepare, and let drain.
At this point, beat the eggs and fry them quickly. Once the eggs are cooked, shred them and set aside.
Step 3:

Heat a pan with a little oil, then add the Chinese sausage and shrimp and stir-fry for about 10 seconds. Next, add the dried chili, carrot, cabbage, and onion and stir-fry together for another 30 seconds.
Step 4:
Sprinkle in the curry powder.
Step 5:
Next, add the soaked and softened vermicelli. If the noodles are too long, you can cut them into bite-sized lengths.
Step 6:

Season to taste and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes. Once the noodles turn yellow from being evenly coated with curry powder, add sesame oil, soy sauce, ground pepper, scallions, and some shredded eggs. Mix everything well and stir-fry for a bit longer, then turn off the heat.
The golden stir-fried vermicelli looks mouth-watering!
The flavor is very unique and attractive!
Combine it with a glass of cold fruit juice and you have a delicious lunch.
If you don't like the flavor of Chinese sausage, you can substitute it with char siu pork, which is also excellent.

mon_an.ten: Chicken Fried Rice with Sunny-Side Up Egg
mon_an.mo_ta: Simple from ingredients to preparation, you can easily make this fried rice that is not only visually appealing but also delicious! Refer to the recipe for crispy chicken and egg fried rice in the article below! Instructions on how to make crispy chicken fried rice with a sunny-side up egg. An attractive and easy-to-make dish at home.
cac_buoc: 1. How to make crispy chicken fried rice with a sunny-side up egg
Step 1:
First, put the garlic, shallots, shrimp paste, and fresh chili into a mortar and pound into a paste. Finely chop the scallions as well!
Step 2:
To prepare the chicken: deep-fry the chicken in oil. When the chicken is cooked and the skin is slightly dry and crispy, remove it to cool and drain the oil.
Then, shred the chicken.
Step 3:
Crack the eggs into a bowl, add a little salt and pepper, and whisk well.
Step 4:
Put the sauce prepared in step 1 into a hot oil pan and stir for a few minutes until the sauce is fragrant and turns slightly brown.
Remember to choose a pan with a large diameter for easy rice frying!
Step 5:
Push the sautéed sauce to one side, and pour in the eggs from step 3. Let the eggs sit on the heat for a moment, then stir the sauce in until the eggs are infused with the sauce.
Step 6:
When the eggs are cooked, add the chicken and season with a little pepper. Then, add the rice and stir constantly so the rice is evenly mixed with the chicken.
Step 7:
Season with soy sauce and stir well so the rice absorbs the seasonings.
Step 8:
Finally, sprinkle in the scallions, stir one more time, and turn off the heat.
The special fried rice is now complete!
Serve with a sunny-side up egg for the right flavor.
This fried rice will be very attractive when eaten with a sweet and sour salad or boiled vegetables.
Replacing the sunny-side up egg with an omelet is also a great idea!
2. How to make delicious Kimchi Fried Rice
Ingredients to prepare
2 bowls of white rice
100g kimchi
1 egg
2 tbsp Korean chili paste (Gochujang)
1 cup scallions (chopped)
1/2 tbsp garlic (minced)
1 sheet of seaweed
1/2 tbsp soy sauce
2 tsp sesame oil
A little cooking oil
1 tsp seasoning powder
Processing Kimchi Fried Rice
Frying the rice

Place a pan on the stove and add a little oil to heat. Then, add the garlic to the pan and sauté until fragrant. Once the garlic is fragrant, add the scallions and 100g of kimchi, and stir them well for 2 minutes over medium heat.
After 2 minutes, add a little kimchi juice and 2 tbsp of Korean chili paste to the pan, and continue to mix well.

Next, add the white rice to the pan bit by bit, gently stirring so the rice is evenly coated with the ingredients in the pan. Once the rice is well-mixed, drizzle soy sauce over the rice and continue to stir so the rice absorbs the seasoning.
Completion
Next, add 2 tsp of sesame oil, 1 tsp of seasoning powder, and 1 sheet of seaweed to the pan, and mix everything well for about 1-2 minutes.
Then, add the scallions and continue to fry the rice for another 1 minute before turning off the heat.

In another pan, add oil and fry the egg sunny-side up. When the egg is cooked, remove it and place it on top of the finished kimchi fried rice. Now, you can enjoy the crispy chicken fried rice with a sunny-side up egg.
Finished product
The fried rice combined with Korean kimchi creates a new combination, bringing a unique flavor when enjoyed.
Although it may seem spicy, it is a dish loved by many young people when exploring Korean cuisine.
How to choose ingredients

Fresh eggs will have a dark brown, uniform shell without cracks or black spots. When touching the shell surface, if it feels rough and slightly gritty, it is a sign of a fresh egg. Conversely, if the surface is smooth, the egg has been kept for a long time.
You can also hold the egg and shake it gently near your ear to listen. If you hear a sound, it is a sign the egg is old. Conversely, if there is no sound, it is a fresh egg.
These methods help you identify fresh eggs versus old eggs, ensuring food quality and safety.
Notes when making Kimchi Fried Rice
Choose fresh ingredients: Use fresh chicken and fresh eggs to ensure the best flavor.
Prepare cold rice: Use cold rice cooked previously so the fried rice grains are separate and not sticky.
Cut ingredients small: Scallions, garlic, kimchi, and seaweed need to be cut small to be distributed evenly in the fried rice.
Stir evenly: When adding ingredients to the pan, ensure you stir evenly over medium heat so the rice and ingredients absorb each other's flavors.

Add seasonings to taste: Soy sauce, Korean chili paste, sesame oil, and seasoning powder are important seasonings to create the characteristic flavor of this fried rice. Add bit by bit and taste to adjust to your own preference.
Crispy sunny-side up egg: When frying the egg, ensure you use little oil and fry over low heat so the egg has a soft yolk and crispy white.

Mix well and absorb seasonings: When adding rice to the pan, ensure you mix well so the rice absorbs the seasonings. Drizzle soy sauce over the rice and continue to stir so the rice has uniform color and flavor.
Appropriate frying time: Fry the rice and ingredients in the pan for about 1-2 minutes to ensure the rice and ingredients absorb the flavors while still maintaining crispiness.
Enjoy while hot: Chicken fried rice with a sunny-side up egg is best when eaten hot. Enjoy immediately after completion to savor the wonderful flavor of the dish.

mon_an.mo_ta: Crispy fried sausage rice balls feature a crispy exterior and sweetness from vegetables, the aroma of curry, and a savory sausage center that is chewy and addictive. These rice balls are especially suitable for picnics, camping, or trips... the small, cute rice balls are very compact and convenient to carry while providing full nutrition. Let's find out how to make them below!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare ingredients
First, cut the bacon into small pieces.
Peel the carrots, wash, and mince.
Peel the onion, wash, and mince.
Clean the scallions, wash with clean water, then mince.
Wash the green bell pepper and mince.
Cut the sausages in half; if they are too long, you can cut them into three pieces.
Then, roll the sausages in flour and set aside on a plate.
Crack the egg into a bowl and separate the yolk.
Step 2: Execution steps
First, place a pan on the stove, add a little oil, and heat it up.
Next, add the bacon, onion, scallions, green bell pepper, and carrots to sauté briefly.
Then, add the curry powder and stir well, then add the rice and fry until cooked. Season the rice to your taste.
When the rice is fragrant and has a beautiful yellow color, turn off the heat and pour the rice into a large bowl.
Next, take a piece of floured sausage and wrap the rice tightly around it. Note that you must wrap the rice very evenly and firmly.
Then dip the rice ball into the bowl of egg yolk and quickly roll it through the breadcrumbs. Do the same until all the sausages and rice are used.
Next, place another pan on the stove and add plenty of oil to heat.
When the oil is boiling, drop the rice balls in to fry until golden. Remember to flip the rice balls frequently so they have an even golden color on both sides.
Finally, remove the rice balls to drain the oil, and blot them with paper towels once more to remove all excess oil.
Present the rice on a plate; you can stick a decorative skewer into each rice ball for a nice look, which is also very convenient for eating.
You should serve them with cucumber, lettuce, or chicory... so it's not greasy or dry.
Note:

When frying the rice balls, do not fry for too long because the rice is already cooked and the sausages are smoked and cook very quickly. Therefore, you only need to see the rice has a beautiful golden color to remove it, avoiding making the rice dry.

You should choose rice that is a bit soft and sticky, even slightly overcooked is fine. Do not choose hard or dry rice because after frying, you will find the dish a bit difficult to swallow because the rice is too dry.

When frying the rice initially, you should pay attention to covering the pan with a lid after stirring the rice. Because when we cover the lid, the rice pan will have a large amount of steam, making the rice soft and delicious. During frying, keep the heat a bit low.
When shaping the rice, you can wear gloves or use a piece of cheesecloth and perform a squeezing motion like making a rice ball so the rice sticks firmly to the sausage and doesn't fall off.

If you don't like the pungent smell of peppers, you should soak the bell peppers in diluted salt water for 15 minutes and then soak them again in a vinegar-sugar mixture. This way, the peppers will lose their pungent smell and you can eat them comfortably.

Regarding the sausages being rolled in flour, many of you wonder why this step is necessary and want to skip it to save trouble. But I think this step is quite important; the flour acts like a special glue that helps the rice bond more easily. Because the rice and sausage must be tightly attached to create a successful dish.

For those using rice for a picnic, let the rice cool down a bit and put it in a plastic box with a tight lid; this way we have a delicious lunch, providing you with full energy for an interesting picnic day.

For mothers with picky children, you can try applying the crispy fried sausage rice ball dish; the kids will be attracted by the small, fragrant rice balls and colorful Mickey Mouse skewers. The rice is not only delicious but also full of nutrients like protein and fiber, so mothers can feel secure when giving it to their children.

mon_an.mo_ta: This dish brings the fragrant, cool taste of peanut butter, roasted sesame, and cilantro! If you are tired of traditional dishes, don't hesitate to go to the kitchen and make cold noodles to please the whole family tonight!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 1 scallion, finely chopped; ½ cup shredded carrots; ½ cup thinly sliced cucumber; ½ cup bean sprouts; cilantro; roasted sesame seeds

For the sauce - 30g peanut butter; 2.5g salt; 15ml sesame oil; 15ml canola oil; 5g tahini (sesame paste); 15ml soy sauce; 2 cloves minced garlic; 15ml fresh orange juice; 30ml vinegar; 45ml pasta cooking water
cac_buoc: Step 1: Boil the noodles according to the instructions on the package. When the noodles are cooked, remove and rinse with cold water.
Step 2: Mix the sauce ingredients in a bowl.
Step 3: Finely chop the scallions, thinly slice the cucumber, and shred the carrots. Blanch the bean sprouts for 15 minutes in boiling water, then soak in ice water and drain.

Step 4: In a bowl, add the noodles and pour the sauce over them. Add the vegetables, chopped cilantro, crushed peanuts, and roasted sesame seeds on top. Add a little chili sauce, vinegar, or soy sauce as desired.
Step 5: Mix all the ingredients well in a large bowl.
And now, enjoy!

mon_an.mo_ta: Seafood Mì Quảng with eye-catching colors and delicious flavors. When enjoying it, you will feel the chewy noodles, sweet broth, hearty meat, and fresh shrimp and squid, giving you a delicious sensation.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Marinating ingredients - 1 garlic bulb; 2 chilies; 3 lemongrass stalks
Vegetables for serving - Lettuce, bean sprouts, scallions, roasted peanuts
Seasonings - good fish sauce, pepper, salt, seasoning powder, sugar
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the pork bones with salt water thoroughly to remove odors, then rinse again with water and chop into bite-sized pieces; drain. Next, blanch the pork bones in boiling water, then remove, rinse again with water, and drain.
Step 2: Clean the lemongrass and chilies, remove the roots and damaged leaves, then wash and drain; mince finely along with the garlic.
Wash the shrimp and squid with wine to remove the fishy smell, then rinse again with water; marinate with a little ginger for fragrance.

Step 3: Next, marinate the pork bones, shrimp, and squid with ½ of the minced garlic, lemongrass, and chili, along with fish sauce, seasoning powder, sugar, pepper, and ½ can of tomato paste (bought at the supermarket) for 20 minutes.
Then, place a pan on the stove, add cooking oil, and fry the annatto seeds to get annatto oil.
Step 4: Next, sauté the remaining ½ of the garlic, lemongrass, and chili until fragrant, then add the pork and stir-fry until infused with seasonings; scoop out to one side.
In the same pan, stir-fry the shrimp and squid quickly and set aside.
Step 5: Then, put the stir-fried pork bones into a pot and add coconut water to cook until the pork bones are tender.
Next, add the shrimp and squid, adjust the seasoning to taste, and add the remaining ½ can of tomato paste to the pot to create color and aroma for the broth.
Step 6: Boil water and blanch the Mì Quảng and egg noodles for 2 minutes or until just cooked, then remove and drain.
Pick and wash the various fresh herbs, then soak in diluted salt water for about 15 minutes; remove and drain.
Clean the bean sprouts and drain.
Roast the peanuts until cooked.

Step 7: Next, place the Mì Quảng noodles, egg noodles, and bean sprouts in a bowl. Scoop the shrimp, squid, and pork bones on top, then pour the broth until it just covers the noodles. Sprinkle with peanuts, add chopped scallions and chili, and enjoy.
How to choose fresh seafood
Choosing fresh squid
There are many different types of fresh squid such as cuttlefish, squid, baby squid... but if you don't know how to choose carefully, it's easy to buy stale ones.
For cuttlefish: You should choose large, thick ones with a milky white color, firm meat that is not mushy, a brown membrane covering the outside evenly, and firm tentacles.
For squid: Choose ones with bright, slightly pinkish meat, the head still firmly attached to the body, firm tentacles, and the ink sac not broken;
Do not choose squid that has turned slightly greenish-ivory, has flabby meat, the head is not firmly attached to the body, or has a very fishy smell because those are not fresh.
Choosing fresh shrimp
Good shrimp must have a firm body, hard shell, and be translucent white rather than cloudy or turning red or yellow.
The head should be firmly attached to the body, the claws still intact, and no fishy or stale smell.
Secrets to distinguish freshness depending on the type of shrimp:
Lobster: Those with translucent blue claws and a bright, shiny shell are fresh and delicious.
He shrimp: Shrimp that are still jumping, with a pinkish-white color and green eyes.
Tiger shrimp: Have a smooth, shiny shell, and the line in the middle of the shrimp body is fresh and clear;

Absolutely do not buy shrimp that have turned dark pink, the head and claws are detached from the body, or have a stale smell, as these have been kept for a long time and are not delicious and very dangerous.

mon_an.ten: Simple Homemade Japanese Somen Noodles for Babies
mon_an.mo_ta: Somen noodles are thin, white noodles made from wheat flour, typically served in glass bowls. Somen is usually eaten cold with a special dipping sauce accompanied by green vegetables, tubers, or various meats. This is why iced Somen noodles have become a particularly favorite dish during summer in Japan. But now, you don't have to go to Japan or Japanese restaurants to enjoy Somen; you can learn how to make delicious, refreshing, and extremely simple Japanese Somen noodles right at home following this recipe! This guide shows you how to cook simple Japanese Somen noodles for babies at home. You will learn how to prepare and cook delicious, nutritious Somen noodles for your baby without spending much time or effort.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: finely chopped perilla, finely chopped ginger, sliced green onions, grated ginger, white sesame seeds (toasted and lightly crushed) - seasoning
cac_buoc: 1. Ingredient preparation
Boil a deep pot of water. Add the somen noodles and spread them out.
Keep the heat on high while stirring gently with chopsticks. When the water starts to boil over, add a little cold water to prevent it from overflowing.
When the water boils again, turn off the heat and quickly transfer the somen to a mesh strainer.
Run cold water over the noodles and gently wash them by hand to remove excess starch and oil.
2. Execution steps
Pour mirin into a pot, bring to a boil, then add the water and soy sauce. Bring to a boil again, add the katsuobushi, simmer over low heat for 5 to 10 minutes, then let it cool.
Now, the somen noodles and sauce are ready. To make the dish more diverse, you can optionally add vegetables, mushrooms, or meat to the bowl, pour in the sauce, and enjoy.
Note
Somen noodles, Mirin, and Katsuobushi (dried bonito flakes) can be purchased at supermarkets.
