When adding cold water while boiling the noodles, be careful not to add too much at once to avoid a sudden temperature drop, which makes the noodles take longer to boil and become mushy or soggy.
Notes when cooking somen with tuna for babies
Choose quality ingredients: Select somen noodles, canned tuna, and other ingredients from reliable sources to ensure quality.
Ensure hygiene: Before cooking, wash your hands and ensure the workspace, cooking tools, and food are all clean.
Hygienic processing: Cook somen in boiling water and blanch briefly according to the package instructions. After cooking, remove the noodles and rinse with cold water to cool and clean them.
Check the tuna: Carefully check the expiration date on the tuna can and ensure it has no foul odor or signs of spoilage or abnormality.
Supplementary food: If you want to add nutrition for your baby, you can add green vegetables like perilla leaves, tomatoes, or other vegetables to the somen.
How to buy fresh tuna

Fish eyes: Choose fish with sparkling, clear eyes where the pupils are clearly visible. If the eyes are sunken, it's a sign the fish has been frozen for a long time or transported extensively, and the meat will no longer be fresh.
Gills: Check the gills to determine freshness. Fresh gills will be bright red, while stale fish will have dark red or even brownish-black gills.
Skin elasticity: Press your finger into the skin (especially the belly). If the skin has good elasticity and doesn't stay sunken, the fish is fresh.

mon_an.ten: Simple and Delicious Homemade Crispy Vegetarian Stir-Fried Noodles
mon_an.mo_ta: Crispy vegetarian stir-fried noodles are an attractive dish, offering a delicious and rich flavor, perfect for both vegetarian days and those on a diet. The great thing is, you can enjoy delicious vegetarian stir-fried noodles without going out, just by following simple steps at home. With easy-to-find ingredients and a simple method, you can create a wonderful vegetarian meal for the whole family! Check out our recipe for this dish in the article below! I. Crispy vegetarian stir-fried noodles with vegetables
thoi_gian: Prepare a separate bowl, mix 1 tsp tapioca starch, 1 tsp cornstarch, and 5 tbsp filtered water. Stir well and then add to the stir-fry pan. Continue stir-frying until the starch has completely dissolved, then turn off the heat.
cac_buoc: 1. Ingredients preparation
200 grams noodles
500 grams straw mushrooms
200 grams dried shiitake mushrooms
200 grams vegetarian ham
1 kg choy sum
100 grams cauliflower
1 carrot
10 grams leek (garlic chives)
10 grams pickled leek bulbs
1 chili pepper
10 grams cilantro
1/2 tsp sesame oil
1 tsp oyster sauce
5 tsp tapioca starch
1 tsp cornstarch
50 ml cooking oil
2 tbsp lime juice
Common seasonings (a little)
2. Processing steps
Step 1: Fry the noodles

First, to start the process, you need to fry the noodles. Place a pan on the stove and add 50ml of cooking oil. When the oil is hot, lower the heat and add the noodles to the pan to fry. Fry the noodles until they are golden brown, then remove and drain the oil.
Step 2: Prepare the mushrooms

Next, prepare the mushrooms. For shiitake mushrooms, soak them in water diluted with tapioca starch for about 5 minutes, then remove and rinse with clean water. For straw mushrooms, cut off the base and soak them in water diluted with tapioca starch and 2 tbsp of lime juice for 5 minutes. Then, rinse multiple times with water and drain. Finally, chop the straw mushrooms into bite-sized pieces.
To prepare other ingredients, follow these steps:
First, peel the carrot, wash it, and cut it into thin strips. Wash the cauliflower and cut into desired sizes.
Next, wash the leek and mince it. Thinly slice the chili.
Remove any spoiled parts of the choy sum, wash, and cut into segments about 3 finger-lengths long. Cut off the roots of the pickled leek bulbs and wash them.
Finally, cut the vegetarian ham into bite-sized pieces.
With the ingredients properly prepared, you are ready to continue making the delicious stir-fried noodles.
Step 3: Blanch the vegetables
Place a pot of water on the stove and add 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp sugar, and 1 tsp cooking oil. Bring the water to a boil.
Once boiling, add the prepared vegetables to the pot and blanch briefly for about 2 minutes. Then, remove the vegetables and place them in a bowl of ice water to soak for 2 minutes.
A small tip: Soaking vegetables in ice water helps keep them crunchy and preserves their natural color.
Step 4: Stir-fry the ingredients
Place a pan on the stove and add 2 tbsp cooking oil. When the oil is hot, add the leek bulbs and minced leek to sauté until fragrant.
Next, add the dried shiitake mushrooms, straw mushrooms, vegetarian ham, and sliced chili to the pan. Season with 1/2 tsp sugar, 1/2 tsp seasoning powder, 1/2 tsp MSG, 1/2 tsp pepper, and stir well.
Then, add 5 tbsp filtered water, 1 tsp oyster sauce, and 1/2 tsp sesame oil to the pan. Cook until boiling for about 2 minutes, then add 1 tsp chili sauce and stir well.
Next, add the vegetables that were soaked in cold water to the pan and stir-fry for 2 minutes.

Prepare a separate bowl, mix 1 tsp tapioca starch, 1 tsp cornstarch, and 5 tbsp filtered water. Stir well and then add to the stir-fry pan. Continue stir-frying until the starch has completely dissolved, then turn off the heat.
Step 5: Completion
First, place the stir-fried vegetables onto the plate containing the fried noodles. Then, garnish with some cilantro and chopped chili on top.
This crispy vegetarian stir-fried noodle dish will have beautiful colors. The noodles are crispy and delicious, the vegetables are perfectly cooked while maintaining their crunch and sweetness.
When eating, you can dip it in soy sauce to stimulate the taste buds and make it even more attractive!
With these steps, your crispy vegetarian stir-fried noodles with vegetables are complete and ready to enjoy.
II. Crispy vegetarian stir-fried noodles with baby corn
1. Prepare ingredients
100 grams noodles
100 grams baby corn
50 grams garland chrysanthemum (rau tần ô)
100 grams oyster mushrooms
100 grams vegetarian ham
5 stalks green onions
2 tsp vegetarian fish sauce
2 tsp chili sauce
1 tsp vegetarian seasoning powder
2 tsp sugar
A little salt
2. Processing methods
Step 1: Prepare ingredients
First, place a pot of water on the stove and bring to a boil. Then, add the noodles to the pot and parboil until slightly soft. After boiling, remove the noodles and drain.
Next, prepare the other ingredients. First, soak the baby corn in diluted salt water for about 10 minutes, then rinse multiple times with water and drain. Then, cut the baby corn in half lengthwise.
Wash the green onions and garland chrysanthemum. Mince the white parts of the green onions; cut the remaining leaves and the garland chrysanthemum into segments about 3 finger-lengths long.
Peel the carrot, wash, and cut into strips. Cut the vegetarian ham into bite-sized pieces.
Soak the oyster mushrooms in diluted salt water for about 10 minutes, then rinse with water and squeeze dry. Next, tear the oyster mushrooms into bite-sized pieces.
Step 2: Fry the noodles

First, place a pan on the stove and add 50ml cooking oil. When the oil is hot, drop the parboiled noodles into the pan and fry over low heat until the noodles are light golden. Then, remove and drain the oil.
Step 3: Stir-fry the vegetables
Next, place another pan on the stove with 2 tbsp cooking oil. When the oil is hot, add the minced green onions and sauté until fragrant.
Next, add the vegetarian ham, baby corn, and sliced carrots to the pan and stir-fry for about 4 minutes.
Then, season with 2 tsp vegetarian fish sauce, 2 tsp chili sauce, 2 tsp sugar, and 1 tsp vegetarian seasoning powder and stir well.
Next, add the mushrooms and garland chrysanthemum to the pan and stir for 2 minutes. Then, adjust the seasoning to suit your taste.
Finally, add the chopped green onions to the pan and stir well before turning off the heat.
Step 4: Completion
First, spread the stir-fried vegetables over the plate of fried noodles.
This crispy vegetarian stir-fried noodle dish has attractive colors and is very fragrant. The golden crispy noodles combined with the vegetables create a naturally sweet and crunchy flavor.
When enjoying, you will feel the harmony of the components, from the crispy noodles to the fresh taste of the vegetables. This is truly an attractive and satisfying dish.
III. How to choose fresh ingredients
1. How to buy good oyster mushrooms
Choose mushrooms with long, large, and firm stems.
Avoid buying mushrooms with black tips or bruises on the caps, especially those harvested long ago or kept in cold storage.
Avoid mushrooms with strange odors or signs of sliminess.
Carefully check the origin and expiration date to ensure safety.
2. How to buy good garland chrysanthemum
Choose garland chrysanthemum with deep green, uniform leaves that are not too large.
Avoid buying wilted, crushed, or yellowed leaves.
3. How to buy good baby corn
Choose baby corn with even kernels and moderate size, about the thickness of a finger.
The corn should be bright yellow or fresh white.
The body of the corn should be straight, not curved, and feel firm when held.
Avoid buying corn with scars, cracks, borer holes, or crushed parts.
By choosing fresh and quality ingredients, you will ensure the best flavor and nutrition for your dish.
4. How to buy good straw mushrooms
Choose straw mushrooms that are round, still in the bud stage, fresh, and uniform in size.
Black-colored straw mushrooms are usually tastier than white ones.
Avoid buying straw mushrooms that have opened wide, are mushy, or have a moldy smell.
5. How to buy good dried shiitake mushrooms
Choose shiitake mushrooms with a firm structure, not broken or crumbled.
The mushrooms should be light in color without white mold spots.
Dried shiitake should have a characteristic aroma, without moldy or strange smells.
Buy mushrooms from reputable supermarkets or grocery stores to ensure safety.
IV. Conclusion

Above is the simple yet delicious way to make crispy vegetarian stir-fried noodles at home. You just need to prepare basic ingredients like noodles, vegetables, and seasonings, then follow the guided steps. This dish is suitable for vegetarians and anyone who wants to enjoy a simple but attractive and tasty meal. Try it now and enjoy the wonderful flavor of homemade crispy vegetarian stir-fried noodles!

mon_an.ten: How to Make Delicious and Attractive Vegetable Stir-Fried Noodles
mon_an.mo_ta: If you want to save precious time and have a simple breakfast at home while ensuring nutrition, vegetable stir-fried noodles are a great choice. You don't need to go to a restaurant to make a delicious meal. Step into the kitchen and try your hand at vegetable stir-fried noodles according to this guide. This is a simple but nutritionally complete dish to help you start your day in the best way. Take advantage of your time and enjoy a simple breakfast at home with delicious vegetable stir-fried noodles. No need for restaurants; you can make this nutrient-rich dish yourself. Discover the great way to make vegetable stir-fried noodles and enjoy a delicious breakfast right with your family!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: A pinch of sugar, a pinch of salt - seasoning
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the vegetables
After buying king oyster mushrooms, wash and cut them into bite-sized slices. For snow mushrooms, if any are too long, you can cut them in half or leave them whole as desired.
For the carrot, peel and cut into thin strips. Mince the garlic after peeling. Cut the chili into rings. Wash the bok choy with water and drain.
Step 2: Blanch the vegetables and parboil the noodles

Place a pan on the stove and fill it about ⅓ with water. Next, add the carrots to the boiling water to blanch briefly, then use a strainer to remove them. Next, add the bok choy to the boiling water and blanch until the leaves turn deep green, then remove. Finally, put the noodles into the boiling water and parboil for about 2 minutes, then remove to a bowl to drain.
Step 3: Make the stir-fry sauce

Before stir-frying the noodles, prepare the sauce. In a bowl, mix 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tsp MSG, 1 tsp ground pepper, and 1 tbsp filtered water. Ensure all ingredients are well mixed.

Place a pan on the stove, add cooking oil and garlic, and sauté until fragrant. Next, add the king oyster mushrooms and snow mushrooms to the pan and stir-fry for about 3 minutes. Then, add the bok choy, carrots, and noodles to the pan and toss well.

Finally, add the prepared sauce to the pan along with a little pepper and chili. Also add some fried shallots and toss well so the noodles are evenly coated with seasonings. Once the noodles have absorbed the flavors, turn off the heat.

With this simple and quick method, you will have a delicious vegetable stir-fried noodle dish to add interest to your breakfast menu. When enjoying, you will taste the sweetness of the vegetables and the chewy noodles soaked in rich seasoning, which will surely delight you.
Notes for making delicious vegetable stir-fried noodles
Prepare vegetables correctly: Wash vegetables before use and cut them into appropriate sizes to ensure even cooking and ease of eating.
Prepare sauce to taste: Create a stir-fry sauce that suits your palate. Experiment and adjust the amount of seasonings like soy sauce, oyster sauce, pepper, MSG, and chili for the best flavor.

Toss noodles and vegetables evenly: When stir-frying, ensure you toss the noodles and vegetables well so they absorb the seasonings and cook evenly. Avoid letting the noodles or vegetables burn or cook unevenly.
Optional tofu or meat: You can add tofu or meats like chicken, shrimp, or beef to the stir-fry to increase flavor and nutrition. Prepare and cook them fully before adding to the noodles.
Enjoy hot: Vegetable stir-fried noodles are best eaten hot. Ensure you enjoy them immediately after finishing to experience the freshest flavor.
Adjust seasonings yourself: If you feel more seasoning is needed, you can add a little soy sauce, pepper, or other spices according to your taste. Customize to reach your preferred flavor profile.

mon_an.ten: Easy and Delicious Seafood Stir-Fried Glass Noodles
mon_an.mo_ta: Seafood stir-fried glass noodles is not a strange dish, but it is especially delicious with the detailed instructions in the article below; anyone who tastes it will surely nod in praise. Please check it out!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning - seasoning powder, dried shallots, garlic, pepper, cooking oil as needed.
cac_buoc: These are the ingredients you need to prepare for this delicious seafood stir-fried glass noodle dish!
Step 1:
First, wash the crab, mantis shrimp, and shrimp, then steam them until cooked. Pick the meat and set each type aside on separate plates or bowls!
Step 2:
Next, put the glass noodles in a bowl or basin, soak in warm water until soft, then remove and drain. Cut into bite-sized segments.
Step 3:
For the vegetables, wash them thoroughly. Shred the carrot, slice the onion into thin wedges, and chop the Vietnamese coriander and green onions into small segments, keeping them separate.
Step 4:
Thinly slice the dried shallots and fry them in a little oil until fragrant and golden, then set aside in a bowl.
Step 5:

Mince the dried shallots and garlic, sauté in a hot pan with a little oil, then add the crab meat, mantis shrimp, and shrimp. Season with 1 tsp seasoning powder and stir-fry until the seafood is firm. Turn off the heat, sprinkle with a little pepper, and set aside.
Step 6:

Place the pan back on the stove with more oil. When the oil is very hot, add the glass noodles and stir-fry quickly. To prevent the noodles from sticking together, you can crack an egg into the pan and stir-fry with the noodles; this makes them very loose and delicious. Season the noodles with 1/2 tsp seasoning powder.

Then quickly add the carrots and onions and toss well. Next, add the bean sprouts and green onions. Finally, add the shrimp, crab meat, and mantis shrimp back into the pan and toss everything together thoroughly. Adjust the seasoning one last time to taste.

Turn off the heat, transfer the noodles to a plate, sprinkle with the fried shallots and chopped Vietnamese coriander. Enjoy while hot with a little soy sauce or sweet and sour chili sauce for an attractive meal.

Upon completing this dish, you will see that making seafood stir-fried glass noodles is extremely simple. With the clever combination of seasonings and seafood and the reasonable adjustments of the cook, you will have a wonderful dish to change the pace for a weekend lunch.

mon_an.ten: Delicious and Attractive Seafood Mixed Rice
mon_an.mo_ta: Seafood mixed rice features familiar ingredients like clams, shrimp, radish, zucchini, and tofu, neatly presented in a rice bowl with eye-catching colors and an attractive flavor that you certainly won't be able to refuse. Let's get into the kitchen and try this delicious dish!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Soak the brown seaweed in water for at least 3 hours or overnight so it softens, making it tastier when mixed.
If using frozen seafood, soak them in salt water to thaw.
Step 2:
Next, toss the Hijiki seaweed thoroughly with salt, then rinse 2-3 times with water to reduce the saltiness.
Step 3:
Wash the radish and zucchini, peel them, and then shred into thin strips.
Step 4:
Wash the shrimp, mussels, and clams, then set them aside to drain.
Step 5:
After soaking, rinse the brown seaweed with water 2-3 times and let it drain.
Step 6:
Next, place a pot on the stove, boil 500ml of water, then add 2-3 kelp sheets and simmer over medium heat for at least 15 minutes to make kelp broth.
Step 7:

Place another pot on the stove and stir-fry the clams for 1 minute on high heat. Then add 250ml of kelp broth, 30ml fish sauce, minced garlic, green onions, and Korean chili paste (gochujang). Continue stir-frying the clams over medium heat for 2-3 minutes, then turn off the heat.
Once the clams are cooked and have released their juices, strain and set the clam cooking liquid aside.
Then stir-fry the shrimp and mussels until cooked, seasoning with salt, pepper, and sesame oil.
Step 8:
In this step, drop the Hijiki seaweed into a pot of boiling water with a little salt for 1-2 minutes until it turns green.
Step 9:

Next, stir-fry the radish and zucchini over medium heat with 15ml sesame oil for 1 minute. Then add 30ml of the clam cooking liquid, season with fish sauce, and toss for a few more minutes so the vegetables absorb the flavor and become delicious.
Step 10:
Marinate the brown seaweed with 30-45ml of the clam meat cooking liquid, 5ml sesame oil, minced green onions, and minced garlic.
Step 11:
Next, mash the tofu and mix it well with the miyeok seaweed. Season with sesame oil, minced green onions, and garlic, and mix until the ingredients are well combined.
Step 12:
To increase the variety of the dish, you can stir-fry additional vegetables according to your taste, such as bean sprouts, bok choy, kohlrabi, carrots...
Step 13:
Finally, scoop hot rice into a ceramic bowl and arrange the ingredients on top to complete.
Note:
The longer you soak the brown seaweed, the better, as it will become soft and smooth, not dry, giving the eater a sensation similar to eating fresh seaweed.
Frozen seafood can be soaked in salt water to help it thaw faster and absorb seasonings better.
Tossing Hijiki seaweed with salt helps it absorb flavor so it won't be bland when eaten.
When stir-frying seafood, you should cook it a bit longer and stir well so it absorbs the seasonings evenly and tastes better.
Seafood mixed rice has neatly presented ingredients, eye-catching colors, and an attractive delicious flavor.

mon_an.mo_ta: Lasagna is a type of pasta in sheet form. This is a famous Italian dish, and today we will introduce an interesting variation called Italian Cheese Lasagna Rolls. The method is very simple and suitable even for vegetarians. Let's get into the kitchen and try this delicious dish!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Cheddar cheese, Parmesan cheese - as desired
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare ingredients
Crack the egg into a bowl and beat it. Add a little dried basil and a tiny pinch of salt, then whisk until all ingredients are well combined.
Grate the cheddar cheese into small shreds.
Grate the parmesan cheese and then grind it into a powder.
Step 2: Execution steps
First, place a pot of water on the stove and bring it to a boil over high heat.
When the water boils, add the lasagna sheets and soak for about 20 minutes until soft, then remove.
Next, use a knife or scissors to cut the lasagna sheets into long rectangular pieces to help them cool quickly.
Then, use a spoon to scoop some tomato sauce onto the lasagna sheet and spread it over about ½ of the sheet.
Next, sprinkle some cheddar cheese over the tomato sauce, then sprinkle the powdered parmesan cheese on top.
Immediately after, use a brush dipped in the beaten egg to coat the remaining part of the lasagna sheet, then roll the lasagna sheet up.
Repeat the same process for the remaining ingredients.
After rolling all the lasagna sheets, arrange these rolls in a baking tray.
Then, sprinkle the remaining parmesan cheese over all the lasagna rolls.
Finally, place the baking tray in a preheated oven at about 160-180°C.
Bake until the cheese is completely melted, then turn off the oven.
Remove the tray and wait for the cheese lasagna rolls to cool slightly before enjoying.
Note
Besides blanching the lasagna sheets in hot water, you should read the instructions on the packaging carefully to find the best preparation method for the specific type of lasagna you purchased.

Dried basil can be added to the egg or not, depending on your preference, but you should include it to enhance the flavor. Before adding to the egg, you should chop the basil so the rolls still have the basil taste without the scent overpowering the dish.
To increase the flavor and richness, you can add some meat to roll inside the lasagna sheet or pre-sautéed fresh meat, which is also very delicious.

Italian cheese lasagna rolls are quite a unique dish for many, but once you've tasted them, it's hard to forget the flavor due to the richness of the cheeses, the light aroma of basil, and the crispy yet rich crust. This dish is very suitable for weekends when the whole family gathers, and especially suitable for lovely children.

mon_an.ten: Super Delicious Korean-Style Seafood Stir-Fried Noodles
mon_an.mo_ta: Seafood stir-fried noodles are familiar to many, with golden egg noodles, bright red shrimp, white squid, and fish balls, perfectly combined with the green of bok choy, creating an eye-catching and attractive dish. Not only beautiful, but seafood stir-fried noodles also carry a wonderful flavor that makes anyone who tastes it swoon with every bite. Check out the recipe for restaurant-quality seafood stir-fried noodles in the article below! I. Prepare ingredients for seafood stir-fried noodles
cac_buoc: 1. Ingredients for the rich sauce
60 ml soy sauce: Choose low-sodium soy sauce to control the saltiness of the dish.
60 ml honey: Creates natural sweetness for the dish.
60 ml orange juice or coconut water: Brings a gentle fruity flavor.
15 ml mirin: Sweet Japanese rice wine; if unavailable, substitute with rice vinegar mixed with honey.
30 ml sesame oil: Provides a rich aroma.
10 grams tapioca starch
2. Ingredients for the stir-fry
30 ml oil: Olive oil or vegetable oil (divided into 2 parts).
450 grams shrimp: Large shrimp, peeled and deveined to save time.
Vegetables: 200 grams broccoli (cut into bite-sized pieces), 1-2 carrots (peeled and diced), 1 red bell pepper (seeded and sliced into strips) for color and crunch.
4 cloves garlic: Minced garlic for aroma.
350 grams noodles: Choose your favorite type or spaghetti.
Seasoning: Salt and pepper to taste.
Squid
II. How to make delicious seafood stir-fried noodles
1. Prepare ingredients

Clean the fresh squid by washing it with water mixed with a bit of white wine and crushed ginger to remove the fishy smell, then drain. Cut the squid into bite-sized pieces; you can score it or cut into rings as desired.

Prepare the shrimp by using scissors to cut along the head or back, then wash clean. Choose loose instant noodles (sold by weight) to avoid excess salt. Soak the noodles in cold water for about 7-8 minutes to loosen the strands, then remove and drain in a basket.

Wash the bok choy and celery, then cut into segments. Carrots can be carved into flowers or sliced into long strips as preferred. Slice the onion into wedges, and chop the green onions and cilantro into segments.
2. Prepare the sauce

Mix the sauce by combining 1 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp chili sauce, 1/2 tbsp sugar, 1/2 tsp pepper, 1/2 tsp seasoning powder, and 6-7 tbsp filtered water. If you have instant noodle seasoning packets, you can also add them to this mixture.
Stir the stir-fry sauce mixture until dissolved, then add minced shallots, garlic, and sliced chili to create a delicious and attractive noodle dish.
3. Processing

Bring a pot of water to a boil, add crushed ginger, then add the prepared squid to the boiling water, blanch briefly, and remove to drain. Boil the shrimp, then remove to cool and peel. Sauté 1/2 of the minced shallots and garlic until fragrant. Pour the drained noodles into the pan, add 1/2 of the sauce, and toss over the lowest heat so the seasoning coats the noodles. Once done, scoop the noodles out and set aside.

Sauté the remaining shallots and garlic. Next, stir-fry the squid, shrimp, carrots, bok choy, onions, and celery in order. Pour the remaining stir-fry sauce into the pan and stir well. Add the pre-sautéed noodles, mix thoroughly, season to taste, add green onions, chili, and a bit of pepper, then turn off the heat. Serve hot.

The noodles are soft and chewy, loose without sticking; the squid is crunchy without releasing water, the shrimp is naturally sweet; the vegetables are perfectly cooked and bright green, creating a harmonious and attractive flavor. You have now completed the delicious seafood stir-fried noodles.
III. Why you should make this seafood stir-fried noodle dish

Perfect flavor combining sweet and savory: Seafood stir-fried noodles not only combine fresh seafood and crispy noodles but also have a characteristic sweet and savory flavor, creating a special culinary experience.
Simple and easy-to-find ingredients: This dish uses common daily ingredients like fresh shrimp, vegetables, broccoli, carrots, and red bell peppers, along with instant noodles.
Freedom to create: You can flexibly add different types of vegetables according to personal preference and adjust the sauce flavor as desired.
Quick and convenient: With a fast processing time, the seafood stir-fried noodle recipe is a perfect choice for busy dinners.
Nutrition: Combining fresh seafood and vegetables, the stir-fried noodles are not only tasty but also provide many important nutrients for the body.
IV. Secrets to making seafood stir-fried noodles tastier
To create a special flavor for this simple seafood stir-fry, here are some important tips you should know:
Dry the shrimp before stir-frying: Always pat the shrimp dry before cooking to prevent them from releasing water in the pan.
Use fresh or frozen shrimp: You can choose fresh or frozen shrimp. In the case of frozen shrimp, soak them in cold water to thaw faster.
Shred the carrots: Use a grater to shred the carrots into thin strips, helping them cook evenly and faster.
Add various vegetables: Besides broccoli, carrots, and red bell peppers, you can add tomatoes, mushrooms, peas, or baby corn to increase flavor and color.
Mince your own garlic: Freshly minced garlic will provide a better aroma. You can mince a lot at once and store it in the refrigerator.
Choose the right type of noodles: Chewy noodles are the best choice, but you can also try instant noodles, ramen, or spaghetti.
Experiment with the sauce: Adjust the sauce flavor to your personal preference. Add more sesame oil for a richer taste, or reduce the honey if you don't want the noodles too sweet.
V. How to choose fresh ingredients
1. How to buy fresh squid
Prioritize choosing squid with a shiny color; the body should be milky white and the brown spots should be dark brown.
Check the firmness and elasticity of the squid by touching the body. Fresh squid will have high firmness and elasticity.
Observe the eye color to choose fresh squid. Fresh squid usually has clear eyes that are not bulging or leaking yellow fluid.
2. How to buy fresh shrimp
Choose shrimp that are intact, with a straight or slightly curved shape. The head and legs should be firmly attached to the body.
Fresh shrimp usually have a shiny, smooth shell; the segment in the middle of the body should be bright and not fishy, carrying the characteristic scent of the sea.
Avoid shrimp with loose legs, dark black color, and an unpleasant stale or fishy smell.

mon_an.ten: Delicious Thai-Style Pancake Rolls with Sausage and Minced Beef
mon_an.mo_ta: A Thai street food dish you must try if you have the chance to visit. You can also make it at home for the whole family to enjoy with the pancake rolls with sausage and minced beef recipe below.
cac_buoc: This is a very popular type of pancake in Thailand, but they mainly use sweet fillings. Therefore, today we will change the flavor to something new with a savory filling.
Ingredients needed for the pancakes as shown in the image below:
Step 1:
Prepare a large bowl and mix the dry ingredients together: flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt.
Step 2:
Next, add water, egg, and honey to the mixture, stir well, and let it rest for about 10 minutes.
Step 3:
Place a pan with oil on the stove and lightly fry the sausages.
In case you cannot buy small sausages, you can buy large ones and then slice them small for frying! You can buy sausages at supermarkets or grocery stores.
Step 4:
Remove the lightly fried sausages to a plate, then sauté garlic until fragrant, followed by the minced beef, stir-frying well.
Add a little salt and oyster sauce to enhance the flavor of the beef.
Step 5:
Now we will use the batter mixture made in step 2. Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat, then brush a layer of butter around the pan and use a large ladle to pour in a spoonful of batter.
Step 6:
Next, quickly pour a little more batter on the outside (as shown in the image).

If you are skillful, you can use a spoon and work quickly to create the shape as shown; otherwise, put the batter in a bottle with a small nozzle, like a chili sauce bottle, so that when squeezed it creates that shape.
Step 7:
Then place the lightly fried sausage and stir-fried beef on top of the pancake batter.
You need to act quickly, otherwise the bottom layer of the pancake will burn; you should keep the heat at medium-low rather than high, as the pancake burns very easily.
Step 8:
Now you just need to roll the pancake up just as it finishes cooking.
Finished product requirements:
The crust has a beautiful brown color and is not burnt.
When eating, there must be the flavor of the sausage and minced beef harmonizing together.
It's quite simple, isn't it? You can definitely make this for the whole family to enjoy for breakfast; it doesn't take much time and is very nutritious.
This is a popular snack in Thailand; if you can visit, you shouldn't miss this wonderful pancake.
Don't hesitate any longer, enjoy the pancakes right away; adding chili sauce for dipping is absolutely delicious.
You can add a few lettuce leaves and cucumber to make the dish more attractive.
Just a few simple steps and you have attractive pancake rolls with sausage and minced beef. Don't hesitate to get into the kitchen and make these delicious pancakes to treat your family and friends.

mon_an.mo_ta: Pate is a familiar and beloved dish. It can be used with bread and fried eggs in the morning, combined with sticky rice, or steamed with minced meat. Additionally, you can try more complex dishes like chicken cooked with pate or pate omelets. In this article, we will share with you how to make delicious pork liver pate while ensuring food safety and hygiene. Guide to making delicious and hygienic pork liver pate. Enjoy pate with bread, fried eggs, sticky rice, or steamed with minced meat. Discover the simple way to cook pork liver pate and ensure great flavor.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Pork skin (about the size of a palm) - 1 piece
Cooking oil, seasonings, MSG, sugar, butter, pepper - ingredients
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare ingredients

After buying the liver, wash it and cut it into small pieces, then soak it in 150ml of fresh milk to clean it. The liver is the organ that metabolizes and detoxifies the body, so it can accumulate waste. In particular, pig livers that are unhealthy, have hepatitis, or cancer often contain many toxins and pathogenic viruses.
Note that when buying liver, choose fresh pieces that are uniform in color, either bright red or pink. Avoid choosing dark or yellowish liver, as that is a sign of stale or diseased liver.
The remaining milk can be used to soak shredded sandwich bread.
Step 2: Stir-fry the Pate
First, place a pan on the stove and add cooking oil. When the oil is hot, add the minced shallots and garlic to the pan and stir until fragrant.

Once the shallots and garlic are fragrant, add the ground meat and pork liver to the pan and stir-fry until the meat and liver are firm. Next, add the pork fat to the pan and continue stir-frying until the mixture is cooked.

To make the pate more flavorful, next add one tablespoon of seasoning powder, two tablespoons of fish sauce, and one tablespoon of sugar. Then, mix well so the meat and pork liver are evenly seasoned.
When the meat and liver are cooked, add a tablespoon of Tuong An butter and then place the milk-soaked sandwich bread into the pan. Stir-fry for about one minute then turn off the heat.
Step 3: Grind the Pate

At this point, we have completed about 70% of the process; now I will take the pate mixture to be ground. With this amount of pate, I will divide it and grind it in the machine 2-3 times to finish. Depending on your preference, you can choose to grind the pate into a smooth, fine mixture or leave some chunks of meat and liver. Personally, I like pate with a clear taste of meat and liver, so I will grind it moderately to achieve the desired result.
Step 4: Steam the pate

After finishing the grinding, pour the pate mixture into a bowl. To prepare for the water-bath steaming method, add pork fat on top. This way, the pate will stay soft and not dry out after the steaming process. However, if you don't like fat, you can skip this step and still maintain the delicious flavor of the pate.
On the stove, prepare a steamer and place the bowl of pate inside. Steam for about 10 minutes, and now we have a huge, super delicious bowl of pate. Let's enjoy it, everyone!
Step 5: Enjoy

This pate can be stored in the refrigerator for about 2 weeks to eat, or if frozen, it can be stored for more than 1 month. With this wonderful pate recipe, those who love pate should quickly try making and enjoying it.
Notes for making delicious pork liver pate at home

To make pate, the ingredients must be fresh and have a reliable origin. If you buy at the supermarket, choose products with a production date that matches the sale date. Or if buying at the market, go early in the morning to ensure the ingredients are still fresh. Especially, the liver for making pate must be chosen fresh to ensure quality.

When buying liver, choose the type that is dark red or purplish-pink. When touched, it should be soft and smooth. You can press your finger into the surface of the liver; if it indents and the indentation remains when you withdraw your finger, that is a sign of a good piece of liver.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Crispy Fried Dough Sticks
mon_an.mo_ta: Going for a bowl of phở or a hot bowl of pork rib congee without crispy fried dough sticks on the side is quite a disappointment, isn't it? Just dipping the dough sticks into the rich broth or eating them with sweet rib congee is enough to make you swoon. Homemade crispy fried dough sticks are clean, safe, and the recipe is extremely simple; try it right away.
cac_buoc: Prepare ingredients
Prepare a large bowl, plastic wrap, a rolling pin, and a deep frying pan or pot (about 24cm in diameter), a knife, and paper towels.
Execution steps
Step 1: Take a bowl and sift all 200g of the prepared flour.
Step 2: Then add the yeast and peanut oil, and add a pinch of salt.
Step 3: Slowly pour the cold water into the flour, mixing by hand as you pour.

Step 4: Continue kneading the dough by hand until it is smooth and no longer sticky, about 3-4 minutes. After kneading, leave the dough in the bowl, cover tightly with plastic wrap, and let it rest at an outdoor temperature of 28-30°C for about 1 hour.

Step 5: Then place parchment paper on a flat surface and put the dough on it. Use your fist to flatten the dough, then fold it over, and continue using your fist to flatten it; do this for 5-7 minutes.
Step 6: Wrap the dough tightly in plastic wrap and place it in the freezer overnight.

Step 7: Remove the dough from the freezer and let it sit at room temperature for 45 minutes to soften. Then take a clean, dry cutting board, brush a layer of peanut oil evenly on the surface, place the dough on it, and roll it into a long block about 30cm long.
Step 8: Use a rolling pin to roll the dough thin into a rectangle about 8-10cm wide, so the dough is about 0.5cm thick.

Step 9: Cut the dough into small pieces 1.5-2cm wide and 6-7cm long. Stack 2 pieces of dough on top of each other, use a skewer or the back of a knife to press lightly so the top piece sticks to the bottom piece. Continue until all the dough is used.
Step 10: Use your hands to stretch both ends of the dough piece until its length is nearly equal to the diameter of the pan (or pot), then lightly twist the two ends.

Step 11: Place the pot or frying pan on the stove, pour in oil about 3-4cm deep, and wait until the oil is hot and bubbling, then gently drop the dough sticks in. The dough sticks will initially sink in the oil, then as they puff up, they will float to the surface. Use chopsticks to gently flip them back and forth until they are golden brown on both sides and fully expanded, then remove and place on a plate lined with paper towels.
Note
When leaving the dough at room temperature to rise, note that the rising time will be shorter if it's hot and longer if it's cold, so you need to time it correctly.
You can use a smaller pan or pot, but remember to stretch the dough sticks to nearly the diameter of the pan or pot.
Before frying, the heat should be at a temperature where the oil is bubbling hot but not smoking.
If you have lard, you should use it instead of cooking oil to fry the dough sticks; frying the sticks in lard will make them crispier, fluffier, and richer than using regular cooking oil.
Fried dough sticks can be stored in the refrigerator for 2-3 days.

mon_an.ten: 3 Simple Homemade Avocado Egg Salad Recipes Everyone Should Know
mon_an.mo_ta: Avocados are not only loved for their delicious taste and high nutritional value but can also become the main ingredient in many attractive dishes, especially avocado salad. In this article, we will explore how to make avocado egg salad! I. Traditional Avocado Egg Salad
thoi_gian: Prepare the ingredients for avocado egg salad as follows:
Prepare a bowl or dish, then pour 150ml of filtered water into it.
Prepare a bowl and add the lettuce, tomatoes, onions, avocado, quail eggs, and cilantro.
Prepare a bowl and add the cherry tomatoes, lettuce, and the prepared dressing. Use chopsticks to toss well and ensure the ingredients are evenly coated.
cac_buoc: 1. Ingredients
Avocado: ½ fruit
Eggs: 2
Tomato: 1
Lettuce: 100g
Shallot: 1
Lime: 1
Olive oil: 1 tbsp
Filtered water: 150ml
2. Cooking steps
2.1. Preparation
Prepare the ingredients for avocado egg salad as follows:
Eggs: Bring water to a boil, add eggs and boil for about 10 minutes. Peel and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Lettuce: Wash thoroughly and soak in diluted salt water for about 15 minutes, then drain. Cut into bite-sized pieces.
Tomato: Wash and cut into bite-sized pieces or dice.
Avocado and shallot: Dice.
Lime: Halve and squeeze for juice.
2.2. How to make the dressing
Prepare a bowl or dish, then pour 150ml of filtered water into it.
Add seasonings such as salt, sugar, shallots, lime juice, and olive oil to the bowl.
Mix well and taste to adjust the sourness, saltiness, and sweetness to your preference.
2.3. How to toss the avocado egg salad
Layer the avocado, vegetables, and fruit in a bowl or on a plate.
Next, place the eggs on top of the layered ingredients.
Drizzle the prepared dressing over the salad.
The avocado egg salad is complete. You can garnish with herbs and serve with mayonnaise, milk, and bread.
II. How to make avocado quail egg salad
1. Ingredients
Avocado: 1/2 fruit
Quail eggs: 9
Onion: 1/4
Cilantro: a little
Olive oil: 1 tbsp
Lime juice: 1/2 tbsp
Ground pepper: 1 tsp
Salt: 1 tsp
2. Instructions
2.1. Preparing the quail eggs
Briefly rinse the quail eggs to remove dirt.
Fill a pot with enough water to cover the eggs. Boil for about 6 minutes.
Then, remove the eggs and place them in a bowl of cold water for 1 minute to cool. Peel the quail eggs.
Cut the quail eggs in half.
Prepare other ingredients:
Avocado: Peel and cut into small cubes.
Tomato: Wash, deseed, and dice.
Onion: Clean and dice. Then, soak in a bowl of diluted salt water to reduce the pungency.
Lettuce: Wash with salt water, then rinse with clean water and cut into pieces.
Cilantro: Wash with water and finely mince.
2.2. How to make the salad dressing
In a bowl, add the following ingredients in order: 1 tbsp olive oil, 1/2 tbsp lime juice, 1/2 tsp salt, and 1 tsp ground pepper.
Mix well until the seasonings and ingredients are well combined.
How to toss the salad:
Prepare a bowl and add the lettuce, tomatoes, onions, avocado, quail eggs, and cilantro.
Drizzle the dressing over the top and use chopsticks to gently toss the salad so the ingredients are evenly coated.
Then, arrange the salad on a plate and the avocado quail egg salad is ready!
It will have a sweet and sour flavor from the dressing, fresh vegetables, and richness from the avocado and eggs. This will surely be a favorite dish this summer!
If you like, you can also add a bit of mayonnaise to the salad to enhance the rich flavor.
III. How to make weight-loss avocado egg salad
Avocado: 2 fruits
Cherry tomatoes: 10
Lettuce: 100g
Mayonnaise: 1 tbsp
Vinegar: 1/2 tbsp
Salt: 1/2 tsp
Lime: 1/4 fruit
Toasted sesame seeds: a little
Ground pepper: a little
Mint leaf: 1 sprig
2. How to prepare weight-loss avocado egg salad
1. Preparing the eggs
Boil eggs: Wash 2 eggs. Place them in a pot and cover with water. Boil for 10 minutes.
Then, turn off the heat and place the eggs in a bowl of cold water for 2–3 minutes to cool. Peel the eggs and place them in a bowl.
Cherry tomatoes: Wash and cut in half.
Avocado: Peel and cut into small squares.
Lettuce: Wash with diluted salt water, then rinse with clean water and cut into bite-sized pieces.
2. How to make the salad dressing
In a bowl, add the following ingredients in order: 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp mayonnaise, 1/2 tbsp vinegar, 1/2 tsp salt.
Stir well, then add the juice of 1/4 lime. Use a spoon to stir until well combined.
3. How to toss the salad
Prepare a bowl and add the cherry tomatoes, lettuce, and the prepared dressing. Use chopsticks to toss well and ensure the ingredients are evenly coated.

Next, add the avocado and eggs to the bowl, and gently toss so the avocado and eggs don't get mashed. Then, sprinkle some toasted sesame seeds and ground pepper to enhance the flavor. Finally, garnish with a sprig of mint for aroma and aesthetic appeal.
With these steps, the salad is complete and ready to enjoy.

Avocado egg salad is truly appealing with its simple and quick preparation. Fresh, crunchy vegetables combined with a sweet and sour dressing, along with rich eggs and avocado, create a delightful experience for the palate.
IV. How to choose avocados for a delicious egg salad
1. How to choose and ripen avocados
Choose avocados with small, fresh stems to ensure they ripen evenly without being forced.
Select avocados that feel heavy for their size. The skin should be taut, without strange marks, holes, or damage. Gently squeeze to check the flesh; if it's soft yet firm, it's a good avocado.

Choose green-skinned avocados with yellow speckles, as they have a higher fat content and creamier flesh. Conversely, purple-skinned avocados may not be as rich. Look for long avocados that feel firm to ensure thick, delicious flesh.
2. Tips for natural ripening

To ripen naturally, leave them at room temperature (about 23–25°C), in direct contact with the ground, and do not put them in plastic bags. You can also place avocados next to bananas to help them ripen more evenly and quickly, enhancing the flavor.
How to peel an avocado quickly without mashing it:
Halve the avocado by running a knife straight down from the top. Then twist and gently remove the pit.
Next, cut lengthwise from top to bottom on the halved avocado. You can use your hands to peel the skin like an orange or tangerine.
See also: How to make a very effective weight-loss vinaigrette salad
V. How to buy good quail eggs
Choose quail eggs with nice, sturdy shells that are not grey and have no cracks.
To check the eggs, use a lamp or hold them up to sunlight. Hold the egg in your hand, leaving only the ends exposed. Look at the egg from one side while the other side is illuminated.
If the quail egg is fresh, you will see a transparent pink color with a pink dot in the center.
V. Notes for making avocado egg salad
Choose fresh ingredients: Select fresh avocados and quail eggs with no odor or damage. Choose fresh, crunchy vegetables without signs of wilting or bruising.
Preparing quail eggs: Quail eggs should be steamed or boiled. Then, peel and cut them into halves or thin slices as desired.
Naturally ripened avocado: Choose naturally ripened avocados for the best flavor. Leave them at room temperature to ripen, but avoid keeping them in the fridge for too long as they can become hard.
Cut vegetables evenly: When preparing vegetables like tomatoes, lettuce, and onions, cut them into small, even pieces so every bite blends well with the other ingredients.

Season the dressing to taste: When making the dressing, adjust the seasonings and flavors to suit your preference. Consider using ingredients like olive oil, vinegar, salt, sugar, and other spices to create a delicious dressing.
Toss well: When mixing the salad, toss thoroughly so the avocado, eggs, and other ingredients are evenly distributed. Ensure every part of the salad is well-coated in dressing.
Enjoy immediately: Avocado egg salad is best eaten right after preparation. Avoid leaving it in the fridge for too long as it may lose its freshness and quality.

mon_an.mo_ta: Beef braciole is a unique yet satisfying dish featuring tender beef, rich flavors, and a seared crust, paired with tomato sauce and wine for a taste that is both exotic and familiar. Let's get cooking!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: large beef fillets (regular beef cuts can also be used) - 4 pieces
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, wash and finely chop the celery. In a bowl, combine the breadcrumbs, chopped celery, both types of cheese, and 2 tablespoons of olive oil. Mix well until fully incorporated.
Step 2:

Slice the beef into thin pieces, approximately 8cm long and 5cm wide. Lay the beef slices out on a cutting board and sprinkle the breadcrumb mixture over the surface. Focus the filling in the center of the meat to make rolling easier and to prevent the filling from falling out.
Step 3:
Roll up each piece of meat starting from the smaller end, being careful to keep the filling inside. Once rolled, tie them tightly with kitchen twine and season with salt and pepper.
Step 4:

Heat a pan over medium heat and add the remaining 2 tablespoons of olive oil. When the oil is hot, add the beef rolls and sear until browned on all sides, then remove from the pan. Be sure to turn them evenly and avoid using high heat, which can burn the meat and ruin the flavor.
Step 5:
Add the white wine to the pan and stir vigorously to deglaze the browned bits. These bits contain the most flavor!
Step 6:
Meanwhile, place another pot on the stove, add the tomato sauce, and heat it up. At the same time, preheat your oven to 180°C.
Step 7:

Add the seared beef rolls to the heated tomato sauce and pour the prepared wine over them. Cover the pot tightly with aluminum foil and place it in the oven to bake for 1 hour. After 1 hour, remove the foil and bake for another 30 minutes.
If the tomato sauce does not fully cover the meat, take the pot out every 30 minutes and baste the meat with the sauce.
Once finished, remove the beef from the oven and cut into slices to serve.
This beef braciole is perfectly paired with Italian pasta.
Note:

When buying beef, choose bright red meat that is not too dark, with small fibers, a dry and smooth texture, and firm to the touch without sticking to your hands. Yellow fat indicates tender, flavorful meat. Young beef has white fat and very fine fibers. Older beef has large, dark purple fibers and grayish fat, which can be tough and take longer to cook. Female beef is generally better than male. Heifer meat is the best choice for its tenderness, white fat, and fine grain.
Avoid beef that looks pale or blue, or has white spots between the fibers, as this may indicate parasites. Do not buy meat that has an unpleasant odor.
Slicing tip: To get thin slices without tearing the meat, wrap it tightly and place it in the freezer until it firms up slightly. This makes it much easier to cut beautiful, even slices.

mon_an.mo_ta: Scotch eggs are simply eggs wrapped in minced meat and deep-fried until golden—a very popular snack in the UK! It is delightful to cut the egg open and see a runny yolk flow out, ensuring the dish isn't dry. Let's try making these Scotch eggs.
cac_buoc: INGREDIENTS FOR SCOTCH EGGS
2 eggs, soft-boiled
200g pork shoulder, finely minced
1 tbsp cumin seeds, toasted and ground
1 pinch of salt
1 pinch of ground pepper
100g all-purpose flour
1 egg, beaten
100g panko breadcrumbs
1 small head of lettuce
Vinaigrette
Mayonnaise
Cooking oil
INSTRUCTIONS:
Step 1: Soft-boil the eggs for 4-5 minutes in boiling water. Soak the eggs in cold water for about 20 minutes, then peel. Set aside.

Step 2: In a large bowl, mix the minced meat with salt, pepper, and the toasted ground cumin. Spread the meat into a 1cm thick layer on a sheet of plastic wrap placed on a flat surface. Place an egg in the center of the meat, gather the four corners of the plastic wrap, and wrap the meat evenly around the egg.

Step 3: Prepare three bowls containing the beaten egg, panko breadcrumbs, and flour. Coat the meat-wrapped eggs by rolling them in flour, dipping them in the beaten egg, and finally rolling them in the breadcrumbs. Roll the eggs gently in your palms to maintain their shape.

Step 4: Pour enough vegetable oil into a pan to half-submerge the eggs. When the oil reaches 180°C, gently place the eggs in the pan and fry for 3 minutes or until deep golden brown. Remove the eggs and place them on paper towels to drain excess oil. Cut the eggs in half before serving so the runny yolk can flow out. (Adjust boiling time according to your preference for a runny or fully cooked yolk).

Step 5: *Requirement:* The finished Scotch eggs should be evenly golden brown on the outside while remaining soft and moist on the inside. Enjoy with lettuce, vinaigrette, and a bit of mayonnaise. Good luck!

mon_an.mo_ta: A nutritious breakfast makes for a more productive day. Learn how to make char siu egg noodles for your whole family!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 1 grilled onion, halved; 500g pork belly; dry egg noodles; bean sprouts, green onions, salt, sugar, oyster sauce, soy sauce; minced shallots
cac_buoc: Step 1: Clean the pork bones. Bring water to a boil, blanch the bones for 3-5 minutes, then rinse thoroughly.

Rinse the shredded radish 2-3 times with diluted salt water. Place the pork bones, shrimp, radish, grilled onion, 5g salt, and 4-5 bowls of water into a pot and simmer for 2 hours. Occasionally skim off the foam with a spoon to keep the broth clear.
Step 2: Clean the pork belly and marinate with 15ml oyster sauce, 15g sugar, 5g salt, and 5ml soy sauce. Mix well and let marinate for 3-4 hours.

Step 3: Heat a pan with a little oil, add minced garlic and shallots, and sauté until fragrant. Add the marinated pork and sear until it turns golden brown. Pour in the remaining marinade and a little water. Bring to a boil, cover, and simmer until the meat is cooked through.

Step 4: Occasionally flip the meat during cooking so it absorbs the flavors evenly. Cook for 20-30 minutes or until the sauce thickens. Once the pork is tender, turn off the heat and let it cool slightly. Slice the meat into thin pieces.
Step 5: Bring a pot of water to a boil, blanch the egg noodles for 5 minutes or until cooked. Drain and rinse under cold water, then toss with a little oil to prevent sticking.
Wash the herbs and vegetables. Finely chop the green onions.
After the broth has simmered for 1-2 hours, season to taste. Place the noodles into bowls and top with sliced pork and shrimp. Add bean sprouts and green onions.
Pour the hot broth over the noodles and enjoy.

mon_an.ten: Duck and Dried Bamboo Shoot Soup
mon_an.mo_ta: Duck and dried bamboo shoot soup is a familiar family dish featuring crunchy dried bamboo shoots served with rice vermicelli, fresh herbs, and tender, flavorful duck. This hearty meal will give you plenty of energy for the day!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Rice wine, salt, seasoning powder, fish sauce, sugar - for seasoning
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients for the duck and dried bamboo shoot soup:
Peel and wash the fresh ginger, crush it, and mix with 5 tbsp of rice wine in a small bowl.
Next, roast the shallots, onion, and 1 ginger root until fragrant; peel and crush the roasted shallots.

Soak the dried bamboo shoots overnight until they expand. Shred them into small strips, trim off any tough parts, and soak in a bowl of cold water for 2-3 days, changing the water 2-3 times daily so the bamboo shoots soften and lose their pungency.
Rub the duck with salt, then rub the ginger-wine mixture all over to remove any gamey odor. Rinse thoroughly with cold water.
Peel, wash, and mince the shallots and garlic.
Clean and wash the herbs, then chop them finely.
Steps to make delicious duck and dried bamboo shoot soup:
First, heat 3 tbsp of oil in a pan. Once hot, sauté the minced shallots until fragrant.

Add the bamboo shoots and stir-fry until cooked. Season with 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp seasoning powder, 1 tsp sugar, and 1 tsp fish sauce. Stir well so the bamboo shoots absorb the flavors. If they look dry, add a little water and simmer over low heat.
After stir-frying, cover the pan tightly and let the bamboo shoots sit overnight to become tender.
Place the duck in a pot, cover with water, and bring to a brief boil to blanch. Remove and rinse the duck with clean water.

Place the duck, roasted onion, roasted shallots, and roasted ginger into a large pot of water. Bring to a boil and simmer until the duck is tender (about 1 hour). Skim the foam frequently to keep the broth clear. Add 2 tsp of seasoning powder to the broth for a savory taste.
Once the duck is cooked, remove it from the pot. Add the bamboo shoots to the broth and boil until they are soft. Adjust the seasoning to taste.
Finally, slice the duck into pieces or shred the meat. Place in a large bowl with the bamboo shoots, vermicelli, and herbs.
Notes for a delicious duck and dried bamboo shoot soup:
Typically, you should prepare the dried bamboo shoots 3-4 days in advance. If you are short on time, you can use fresh bamboo: slice it, boil with a bit of salt, drain, and then use for the soup.

This dish is best served with a ginger dipping sauce: crush 2 peeled ginger roots and 2 garlic cloves. Mix 2 tbsp sugar with half a bowl of boiling water, then add minced chili, ginger, garlic, and 5 tbsp fish sauce. Stir well.
Duck and dried bamboo shoot soup is usually served with rice vermicelli and fresh greens. It is a refreshing, easy-to-eat meal that can replace a main course or serve as a great breakfast.

mon_an.mo_ta: When you're tired of rice, this duck and glass noodle soup is the perfect alternative. The aroma of bamboo shoots blends with the rich duck and chewy glass noodles for a wonderful flavor!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 100 g dried bamboo shoots, soaked until soft
Seasoning: 2 tbsp fish sauce; 2 tbsp seasoning powder; 1 tbsp salt; 1 tsp sesame oil
Pepper; scallions; garlic, onion, chili, cilantro
cac_buoc: Step 1: Clean the duck by rubbing it with crushed ginger, salt, and rice wine. Rinse with cold water and drain. Rub a little more minced ginger onto the skin for extra aroma.
Step 2: Select the tender parts of the bamboo shoots, soak overnight, rinse multiple times with cold water, and squeeze dry.
Step 3: Boil the bamboo shoots in a pot of water for 25 minutes until soft. Remove, rinse with cold water, and drain.
Step 4: Heat 2 tbsp of oil in a pot and sauté the minced garlic and shallots. Add the bamboo shoots and stir-fry for a few minutes with a little sugar and fish sauce.
Step 5: Soak the glass noodles in cold water for 15 minutes until soft, then drain.
Step 6: Bring a pot of water to a simmer with ginger and leek, then add the duck. Add the remaining ginger, leek, and half of the prepared seasonings.
Step 7: Simmer over high heat to firm up the duck, skimming off any foam. After 15 minutes, add the bamboo shoots and simmer for another 15 minutes.
Step 8: Add the remaining seasonings and adjust to taste. Turn off the heat, remove the pot, and add pepper, scallions, and sesame oil.
Place some glass noodles in a deep dish or bowl, top with bamboo shoots and duck, and pour over the hot broth. Garnish with pepper, cilantro, and chili. Serve with ginger fish sauce.

mon_an.ten: Crispy Fried Sticky Rice with Savory Filling
mon_an.mo_ta: Hot pieces of sticky rice filled with minced meat and wood ear mushrooms, fried until golden and crispy. They are incredibly delicious and very easy to make!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning: Seasoning powder, seasoning salt, cooking oil
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the glutinous rice and soak overnight or for 6-8 hours with a bit of turmeric for color.
Step 2: Toss the rice with a pinch of salt. Place in a steamer and steam until soft (steaming twice makes the rice extra chewy and soft).
Step 3: Soak the shiitake and wood ear mushrooms until expanded, trim the stems, wash, and shred. Peel the carrot, wash the beans, and dice both into small cubes.
Step 4: Sauté minced shallots in a little oil, add the wood ear and shiitake mushrooms. Then add the sweet corn, carrot, and beans. Season lightly.
Step 5: In another pan, sauté minced shallots with the meat. Season with a bit of fish sauce, then mix with the vegetable mixture and set aside on a plate.
Step 6: Once the rice is cooked, spread it out on parchment paper or plastic wrap. Flatten the rice, place the filling in the center, and roll it up tightly.
Step 7: Heat oil in a pan until very hot. Fry the rice rolls until golden and crispy on all sides. Repeat with the remaining ingredients. Place the fried rice on a plate lined with paper towels.
Arrange the crispy fried sticky rice on a plate and serve with chili sauce for dipping.

mon_an.ten: Chicken Sticky Rice with Coconut Milk
mon_an.mo_ta: Chicken sticky rice with coconut milk is a family favorite. The rice is steamed until fragrant, chewy, and rich with coconut milk and chicken flavor. Served with tender chicken, lime leaves, and fried shallots, it is a truly delicious treat. Let's get into the kitchen and learn how to make this for your family!
cac_buoc: Wash the glutinous rice and soak for 8–10 hours or overnight. Drain and rinse again. Toss the rice with 1 tsp of salt to make it more flavorful when cooked.
Rub the chicken with salt, wash thoroughly to remove impurities, rinse, and drain. Peel and thinly slice the shallots, then fry them in chicken fat until golden.

Wash the shredded coconut and drain. Add 1 bowl of boiling water and squeeze to get 1 bowl of thick coconut milk. The remaining coconut pulp can be added to the steamer water to make the rice more fragrant (if not using fresh coconut, substitute with 3 tbsp of canned coconut milk).

Place the rice in the steamer. Place the chicken on top of the rice (breast side down). Cover tightly and steam for about 40 minutes until both the chicken and rice are cooked. Remove the chicken to a plate, let it cool, debone, and either slice or shred the meat.

Note: Immediately after removing the chicken, pour the coconut milk over the rice. Use chopsticks to fluff the rice gently. Cover and steam for another 10 minutes so the coconut milk absorbs into every grain, making the rice fluffy and evenly cooked.
Finally, scoop the rice onto a plate, top with the chicken, and sprinkle with julienned lime leaves and fried shallots. Serve with soy sauce, chili, and pickled vegetables.
Tips for delicious chicken sticky rice:

If using frozen chicken, the steaming time may vary. If the chicken is cooked before 40 minutes, remove it and continue steaming the rice. If it is still slightly pink after 40 minutes, remove the rice first, leave the chicken in the pot, and keep the lid closed until cooked through (with the heat off). This allows the chicken to finish cooking in the residual heat without becoming overcooked.
Pay close attention to the boiling time for the chicken and rice to avoid mushy rice or undercooked chicken.
When frying shallots, stir constantly so they don't burn. When they start turning golden, turn off the heat and remove them immediately; they will continue to brown to a perfect golden color.
Tips for choosing good pre-slaughtered chicken:
A good chicken should have a compact, firm body and a small breast.
The skin should be naturally golden, with darker yellow areas on the wings, breast, and back. The skin should not be bruised, pale, or have black spots or bumps.
If the skin is tough and bright yellow but the fat is white, the chicken may have been dyed.
The meat should be firm, fresh, and free of any foul odors or antibiotic smells.

Press on the body, breast, or thigh to check; firm meat indicates a good chicken. If the meat is mushy, slippery, or stays indented (water-bloated), it may have been injected with water or borax; do not buy such chicken.

mon_an.mo_ta: Bún Bò Huế is a famous specialty from the ancient capital. In a big city like Hanoi, it can be hard to find a truly authentic bowl. So, why wait? Head to the kitchen and make this wonderful dish to make your breakfast more delicious and interesting! Learn how to cook delicious Bún Bò Huế at home with this authentic guide. Enjoy this traditional dish with a detailed recipe and fresh ingredients.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fresh chili, chili powder - to taste
Shredded banana blossoms, raw bean sprouts, scallions, culantro - for serving
cac_buoc: 1. Traditional Bún Bò Huế Recipe
Step 1: Wash and chop the beef bones and pork hock. Divide the lemongrass into two parts: tie one part into a bundle and mince the rest. Wash the beef and drain.

Step 2: Pour 3 liters of water into a pot with 1/2 tsp salt and the bundled lemongrass. Once the water boils, add the beef and bones. After 10 minutes, add the pork hock. Simmer over medium heat, skimming the foam to keep the broth clear. Remove each type of meat as it becomes tender; do not overcook or the meat will become mushy. Once all meat is removed, strain the fermented shrimp paste into the pot and season with MSG and fish sauce to taste.
Step 3: Thinly slice the beef flank into large pieces. Remove the meat from the pork hock bones and slice it similarly to the beef.
Step 4: Cut the scallions into segments and finely chop the culantro.

Step 5: Heat oil in a pan, sauté the crushed white parts of the scallions until fragrant, then add the minced lemongrass, chili powder, annatto powder, and 1 minced fresh chili. Sauté until golden. Add half of this mixture to the broth along with half of the chopped culantro.
Arrange the vermicelli and ingredients in a bowl and enjoy!
2. Bún Bò Huế with Beef Tendon
Ingredients:
200 g beef bones.
200 g beef tendon.
300 g beef shank.
Pig blood curd and pork skin.
2 onions.
Lemongrass stalks, chili, lime, and scallions.
1 tbsp annatto seeds and sate sauce.
Thick rice vermicelli.
Shallots and garlic.
Fresh herbs for serving.
Seasonings: Oil, sugar, salt, MSG, fish sauce, and fermented shrimp paste.
Preparation:
Wash the scallions, chop the green parts, and keep the white heads whole.
Crush the lemongrass. Slice 1 onion into thin rings; cut the other onion into quarters.
Boil the pork skin until cooked, then cut into bite-sized pieces. Cut the pig blood curd into long cubes.
Fry the minced shallots and garlic until fragrant.
First, wash the bones, tendon, and beef shank. Place them in a pot and bring to a boil. Lower the heat and simmer until the meat is tender. Skim the foam frequently to keep the broth clear.
Next, slice the beef tendon into 1 cm thick pieces. Thinly slice the beef shank.
Cooking the broth:
Heat oil in a pan with the annatto seeds and stir. Be careful as they burn quickly. Once the oil is red, turn off the heat and strain out the seeds.

Bring the pot of simmered bones, tendon, and shank back to a boil. Add the fried shallots, garlic, lemongrass, white scallion heads, and the quartered onion. Add 1 tbsp of fermented shrimp paste and season to taste. Add the blood curd and some annatto oil for color, along with a little sate sauce for spice. Bring back to a boil.
Place the vermicelli in a bowl and top with the beef tendon and shank. Pour the hot broth over, then garnish with scallions, onion rings, and chili. Serve with herbs and bean sprouts.
With a sweet, savory broth and perfectly tender beef, making a bowl of Bún Bò Huế with tendon is easier than ever. Start making this delicious meal for your family today!
3. Vegetarian Bún Bò Huế
Ingredients:
500 g rice vermicelli
2 tbsp minced lemongrass
1 tbsp minced garlic
1 tbsp minced chili
2 pieces fried tofu
2 pieces vegetarian ham
10 g beancurd skin
30 g dried shiitake mushrooms
1 leek (white part)
1 sweet corn
1 jicama
1 white radish
100 g straw mushrooms
1 onion
200 g pineapple
4 lemongrass stalks
200 g bean sprouts (optional)
300 g water spinach (optional)
100 g culantro and herbs (to taste)
70 g seasonings (oil, rock sugar, vegetarian seasoning powder, salt, annatto oil...)
First, wash the dried shiitake mushrooms. Soak them in hot water with a little salt for 30 minutes until soft. Drain and squeeze out the water.
Peel the jicama, radish, and corn, then cut into bite-sized pieces. Peel the pineapple and cut into chunks.
Clean the straw mushrooms, trim the stems, and halve if large.
Peel the onion. Crush the leek and slice into rings.
Clean the herbs, bean sprouts, and greens; drain. Crush the lemongrass stalks and cut in half. Cut the tofu into small squares. Slice the vegetarian ham thinly.
Frying the tofu and other ingredients:
Heat enough oil in a pan to cover 1/3 of the tofu. Fry the tofu over medium heat until golden on all sides.
Fry the beancurd skin until it puffs up. Remove and drain both.

In a pan with 1 tbsp of oil, sauté the leek until fragrant. Add the straw mushrooms and shiitake mushrooms and stir-fry. Season with 1/2 tsp seasoning powder. Sauté for 3 minutes and turn off the heat.
Cooking the broth:
To make the sate base, heat 2 tbsp of annatto oil in a pan with minced garlic and lemongrass. Sauté until fragrant.
Season with 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp MSG, and minced chili. Stir well and turn off the heat.
For the broth, bring 1.5 liters of water to a boil. Add the corn, pineapple, jicama, radish, and onion. Simmer over medium heat for 20-30 minutes for a sweet base.
Add the sautéed mushrooms to the pot. Then add the fried tofu and vegetarian ham.
Add the crushed lemongrass stalks and simmer for another 10 minutes. Skim off any foam.
Stir in 1 tbsp of the prepared sate mixture. Adjust the amount based on your spice preference.
Add 2 tbsp seasoning powder, 2 tbsp rock sugar, and 1 tsp MSG. Adjust to your family's taste. Stir until dissolved.
Arrange the herbs and vermicelli in a bowl, pour over the hot broth, and enjoy.
Choosing fresh ingredients:
When choosing beef, look for a bright red color (not too dark) and pale yellow fat.
Choose small, soft pieces with a fine grain that spring back when pressed.
Avoid meat with small white cysts that detach easily, as these are signs of parasites. Avoid pre-cut small pieces as they are more prone to contamination.

mon_an.mo_ta: As one of the famous traditional dishes of Hanoi, Bun Thang carries a very unique culinary flavor that anyone who has the chance to taste it once will remember forever. For those who love the taste of this Hanoi specialty, today's column will introduce you to the authentic way to cook Bun Thang at home.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Scallions, Vietnamese coriander, 5 shallots, 1 knob of ginger, 20g shiitake mushrooms, 10g dried radish. - ingredients
Shrimp paste, fish sauce, seasoning powder, a bit of rock sugar, vinegar, white granulated sugar. - seasonings
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients
Clean the chicken, rub salt all over the skin, then rinse thoroughly with water.
Julienne the giò lụa.
Wash the herbs and chop into small pieces.
Peel the shallots; wash the ginger.
Cooking steps
Grill the shallots and ginger until charred, then crush them.

Place the chicken in a pot and cover with water. When the water boils, add 1 tbsp seasoning powder and the grilled shallots and ginger. Simmer on low heat until the chicken is fully cooked (about 30 minutes).
Once the chicken is cooked, remove it and soak in a bowl of cold water, then shred or slice the meat into small pieces.

Parboil the marrow bones in boiling water, then discard the first water. Sauté the bones with 1 tsp salt, then add the chicken broth and simmer until the bones are tender. - Wash the dried shrimp and toast in a pan until fragrant; grill the squid tentacles until cooked.
Add the dried shrimp, squid tentacles, and cleaned shiitake mushrooms to the broth. Add a bit of rock sugar and simmer with the chicken bones for 2-3 hours.
Beat the eggs in a bowl. Lightly coat a non-stick pan with oil and fry the eggs into thin sheets. Let the eggs cool completely, then julienne.
Boil the prawns with a little water. Once cooked, peel and crush them, then sauté with 1 tbsp oil and 1 tbsp fish sauce until golden.
Soak the dried radish in warm water for 30 minutes to rehydrate, then rinse with cold water. Mix with 2 tbsp vinegar and 1 tbsp sugar; let marinate for 30 minutes.
Finally, blanch the vermicelli in boiling water. Arrange each topping on top, add herbs, pour the broth over, and enjoy.
Notes
Authentic Bun Thang uses peanut worms (sá sùng), but as this ingredient is quite expensive, it is often replaced with dried squid tentacles.
The broth is the most important part of Bun Thang, so pay close attention when seasoning it.
To make thin egg sheets, add a bit of white wine, beat well, and tilt the pan to spread the egg evenly.
To make the bowl more attractive, cut straw mushrooms into coin shapes and place them in the center.
Shred the chicken finely so the meat is light and fluffy.
To make the bowl of Bun Thang more authentic, add a drop of giant water bug essence (cà cuống) and a bit of shrimp paste to finish.

mon_an.mo_ta: When finished, Japanese chicken curry is full of flavor and attracts diners with the intense aroma of curry, tender and savory chicken, soft-stewed orange carrots, fluffy yellow potatoes, the slight pungency of onions, and delicious green peas. All ingredients blend together in the curry sauce to create an incredibly attractive dish. Let's get into the kitchen and try making this delicious meal!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 45g unsalted butter, 60g all-purpose flour, 15g garam masala, 15g curry powder, 5g chili powder - Japanese curry roux
cac_buoc: Step 1:

Prepare the ingredients: peel and wash the onion, then dice into bite-sized pieces. Peel and wash the potatoes and carrots, then cut into bite-sized pieces. Wash the chicken, debone, and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Step 2:

To make your own curry roux, melt the butter and add the flour. Continue cooking for about 20 minutes until the mixture turns brown, then add 1 tsp chili powder, 3 tsp curry powder, and 3 tbsp garam masala. Stir for 30 seconds to 1 minute, then turn off the heat. If the roux is too thick, you can add a little water.
Japanese curry is not as pungent as Indian curry, nor as spicy as Thai curry.
Therefore, for those who prefer a milder curry, Japanese curry is an ideal choice. Conversely, if you want a flavor adventure, you must try authentic Indian curry.
Step 3:
Place a pan on the stove and heat the oil. Add the garlic and onion, stirring until the onion becomes translucent.
Step 4:
Next, add the carrots and potatoes. Stir for about 30 seconds to let them absorb the flavors, then pour in a bowl of water until the vegetables are just covered. Cover and simmer over low heat.
Step 5:
Once the potatoes and carrots are soft (test with a fork), add 2 tbsp of curry roux and the chicken to the pot.
Step 6:

Stir well to dissolve the curry roux completely. Cover and continue simmering for 5-10 minutes until the sauce reduces and thickens. Stir occasionally to prevent burning and ensure the ingredients absorb the flavors.
Step 7:
Finally, add the green peas for color and cook for another 1 minute until the peas are done. Turn off the heat, serve the curry on a plate, and enjoy with hot rice.

Japanese chicken curry is an easy-to-eat dish for beginners because the sauce is not as pungent as Indian curry or as spicy as Thai curry. It has a moderate spiciness and a gentle aroma while still carrying the essence of curry. When finished, the dish is full of flavor with tender chicken, soft carrots, fluffy potatoes, and delicious peas. All ingredients blend together in the curry sauce to create an incredibly attractive dish. Don't miss out on this delicious recipe!

mon_an.ten: Soft Black Bean Porridge for Babies - A Summer Dish
mon_an.mo_ta: Black beans are very good for the body, used as a delicious, nutritious, and affordable food in many simple forms such as sweet soup, porridge, sticky rice, or cake fillings. Black beans have a neutral property and sweet taste, helping to detoxify, nourish the kidneys and blood, and strengthen the body. In summer, cooking black bean porridge or sweet soup is excellent for cooling down. Cooking black bean porridge doesn't take much effort, offers a change of pace, is easy to eat, and very refreshing. Let's cook this together! Discover how to cook soft black bean porridge quickly for babies during summer days. This dish is not only tasty but also very nutritious.
cac_buoc: 1. How to cook soft black bean porridge for babies
Step 1: Prepare ingredients
Wash the black beans and soak in warm water for 2-4 hours to soften them for faster cooking and better texture.
Wash both the glutinous and non-glutinous rice.
Place the black beans and rice in a pot; add water until it is 3 times the volume of the rice and beans.
Step 2: Cook the porridge
Place the pot on the stove over low heat. Boil for about 15 minutes, then turn off the heat and stir well with chopsticks until the porridge is smooth and thick.
For a savory version, add fish sauce, bring back to a boil, then remove from heat. It tastes better when cooled.
For a sweet version, scoop the porridge into a bowl and add sugar to taste.
2. Black bean and pumpkin porridge for weaning
Preparation ingredients
You will need to prepare:
100g glutinous rice
400g pumpkin
150g black beans
Along with a bit of sugar and salt to create a delicious dish.
Cooking steps
Step 1: Peel and chop the pumpkin.
Step 2: Soak the black beans in water for at least 2 hours, then drain.
Step 3: Wash the rice and drain.
Step 4: In a pot, bring 1.5 liters of water to a boil over high heat. Add the black beans and pumpkin. Stir while cooking to prevent overflowing, then reduce to low heat and simmer.
Step 5: You can mash the pumpkin and black beans with a spoon, then use a sieve to strain for smoothness or use a blender. Pour the mixture back into the pot and continue cooking until it boils.
Step 6: Scoop the porridge into a bowl, let it cool, and serve while still warm.
3. Black bean and pork rib porridge for weaning
100g black beans
100g non-glutinous rice
50g glutinous rice and 100g pork ribs to create a delicious dish.
Step 1: Soak the black beans in water for at least 2 hours, then drain.
Step 2: Wash the rice and drain.

Step 3: Blanch the ribs in boiling water. Transfer the ribs, rice, and black beans to another pot and add water to simmer. Leave some space in the pot to prevent overflowing. Add more water if it dries out.
Step 4: Once the porridge is cooked, remove the ribs, debone, and mince the meat. You can serve the meat with the porridge or blend everything together depending on the baby's eating ability.
Black bean and sweet potato porridge
Half a small sweet potato, peeled and steamed.
1 tbsp cooked black beans.
2 tbsp breast milk or prepared formula.

The method is very simple: just mash the ingredients together. Then, mix in breast milk or formula to adjust the consistency to your liking. This is a quick and easy way to prepare black bean porridge for your baby.
Notes for cooking black bean porridge for babies
Suitable age: Black beans are usually introduced from 6 months onwards. Ensure the baby is old enough and consult a doctor or nutritionist.
Soaking: Before cooking, soak black beans in water for at least 2-4 hours or overnight to soften. Rinse and drain before use.
Cook thoroughly: Black beans must be completely cooked to ensure easy digestion and avoid gastrointestinal issues. Ensure the beans are soft enough to mash easily.
Introduce gradually: When serving for the first time, give a small amount and observe the baby's reaction for allergies or indigestion. Increase the amount gradually.
Combine ingredients: To increase flavor and nutrition, you can combine black bean porridge with rice, sweet potato, lotus seeds, or lean meat. Ensure ingredients are age-appropriate.
Food safety: Always ensure hygiene when preparing baby food. Wash hands, tools, and surfaces. Ensure the pot and ingredients are clean and stored correctly.
Tips for choosing fresh ingredients
To find fresh black beans, look for: uniform size, slightly pale color, and a firm texture when squeezed hard. Avoid beans with white powder on the surface, mold, or insect damage.

To distinguish rice: Glutinous rice is rounder and milky white; non-glutinous rice is longer and translucent white. When cooked, glutinous rice is sticky and keeps you full longer, while non-glutinous rice is less sticky and easier to eat.
This information will help you choose the right beans and rice for your dishes.

mon_an.ten: Pork Trotter and Lotus Seed Porridge for Postpartum Mothers
mon_an.mo_ta: Pork trotter and lotus seed porridge is a delicious dish with tender meat, sweet broth, nutty lotus seeds, and aromatic porridge. All blend together in a hot bowl with scallions and pepper to create an irresistible meal. Let's get into the kitchen to learn how to make this!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare ingredients for the pork trotter and lotus seed porridge
