Wash the rice and soak for about 2 hours until it expands.
Wash the pork trotter and chop into bite-sized pieces.
Soak the dried lotus seeds in boiling water for 25-30 minutes until they expand evenly.
Step 2: Cook the porridge
First, parboil the pork trotter. When the water boils, turn off the heat, discard the water, and rinse the trotter clean. Sauté the trotter with a bit of fish sauce and MSG to absorb the flavors.
Next, add the rice, chopped trotter, and soaked lotus seeds to a pot with water and season to taste. Use more water than usual as simmering the trotter consumes more liquid.
Cook until the porridge is smooth and the trotter and lotus seeds are very soft. Stir occasionally so the rice expands evenly and doesn't stick to the bottom.
Once the porridge is cooked, scoop it into a bowl. Add scallions, herbs, and pepper as desired.

Mussel porridge is a popular dish loved by many. However, not everyone knows how to cook it for babies so it is delicious and not fishy. To help you, here is a guide to cooking nutritious and tasty mussel porridge.
I. How to cook mussel porridge without a fishy smell
1. Prepare ingredients
Mussels 3 kg
Glutinous rice 50 g
Non-glutinous rice 150 g
Pork fat 1 kg
Dill 30 g
Vietnamese coriander 30 g
Shallots 100 g
Scallions 5 stalks
Cilantro 5 stalks
Bird's eye chilies 3 pieces
Lime 1 piece
Ginger 10 g (1 small knob)
Sea salt 3 tbsp
Fish sauce 1.5 tbsp
Cooking oil 200 ml
Common seasonings (Salt/MSG/ground pepper)
Filtered water 2.1 liters
2. Instructions
2.1. Prepare ingredients
First, soak 3kg of mussels in a basin of cold water with 3 sliced chilies and the juice of 1 lime for 3-4 hours.
Once the mussels have purged the sand, use a brush or steel wool to scrub the shells, then rinse several times with water.
Next, boil the mussels in 300ml water for 10-13 minutes over medium heat. Once they open, turn off the heat, let cool for 5 minutes, and remove the meat from the shells.
Remove the digestive sac, then toss the meat with 3 tbsp sea salt for 3 minutes. Rinse and drain. Cut into bite-sized pieces.
Soak the rice in 300ml water for 4-5 hours, drain, and crush.
Rub the pork fat with salt, wash, and cut into cubes.
Clean and finely chop the dill, Vietnamese coriander, scallions, and cilantro.
Peel and mince the ginger. Peel and thinly slice the shallots.
Finally, mix the mussel meat with minced ginger and marinate for 15-20 minutes.
2.2. Sauté the mussels and fry the shallots
Render the pork fat over low heat for 10-15 minutes until golden and crispy. Remove the cracklings, leaving about 2 tbsp of liquid fat in the pan.
Next, sauté the marinated mussels with 1/2 tsp pepper, 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp MSG, 1.5 tbsp fish sauce, dill, and Vietnamese coriander over high heat for 30 seconds.
Once seasoned, transfer to a plate.
Heat 200ml oil in another pot. Fry the sliced shallots for 2-3 minutes.
When they start to firm up, reduce heat and fry for another 2-3 minutes until golden and crispy. Turn off the heat and set aside.
Tips:
You can use oil instead of lard for frying.
For crispier shallots, add a pinch of salt and a few drops of lime juice.
2.3. Cook the porridge
Place the crushed rice in a pot with 1.5 liters of water and 2 tsp salt. Boil over high heat for 10 minutes.
When the water boils, reduce heat, stir constantly, and cook for 20-25 minutes until smooth. Season to taste and turn off the heat.
2.4. Final result
Serve the porridge in a bowl topped with sautéed mussels, fried shallots, scallions, cilantro, and ground pepper.
2.5. Enjoy
A simple yet delicious dish with aromatic herbs and savory mussels. Don't miss out on this recipe!
3. How to choose good mussels
Choosing fresh mussels is key to a delicious porridge. Here is how:
Choose mussels with intact shells that are tightly closed.
Prefer fresh over frozen for better quality.
If they close when touched, they are fresh.
Avoid those with a strong foul smell.
II. Nutritional facts
Nutritional content per 100g of mussel meat:
Energy: 172 kcal
Protein: 16 – 22g
Fat: 2.3g (polyunsaturated 1.2g, monounsaturated 0.3g)
Carbohydrates: 5 – 6g
Iron: 3.0 mg
Sodium: 314 – 353 mg
Selenium: 96 mcg
Iodine: 270 mcg
Omega-3 fatty acids: 1150mg
Zinc: 2.27 mg
Vitamin B12: 20.4mg
Also contains phosphorus, manganese, calcium, and vitamin C.
III. Health benefits
1. Nourishes the body
Rich in protein, healthy fats, vitamins, and minerals. Great for teenagers, pregnant women, and workers.
2. Supports diabetes management
Low starch and cooling properties help control blood sugar.
3. Supports erectile function
Zinc content is important for male reproductive health.
Good for goiter patients
High iodine content helps, but avoid overcooking to preserve benefits.
4. Diuretic properties
In Traditional Medicine, mussels help nourish yin, act as a diuretic, and detoxify.
5. Good for cardiovascular health
Low in bad fats and high in omega-3s.
6. Supports anemia treatment
Vitamin B12 and iron help produce red blood cells.

mon_an.ten: How to Cook Traditional Xôi Gấc: Delicious, Soft, and Vibrant Red
mon_an.mo_ta: Xôi gấc – a traditional Vietnamese dish that is not only delicious but also boasts a brilliant bright red color, symbolizing luck and happiness. Xôi gấc combines the rich flavor of coconut milk with the sweetness of sugar, creating a wonderful blend in every fragrant, chewy grain of glutinous rice. Let's explore how to cook delicious, soft, and vibrant traditional xôi gấc in the article below! Discover the simple and interesting guide to making traditional xôi gấc. The nutty richness of coconut milk, the sweetness of sugar, and the radiant red of gấc fruit blend into every delicious grain of sticky rice. Enjoy a traditional dish deeply rooted in Vietnamese culture with confidence.
cac_buoc: 1. Ingredient preparation
Step 1: Prepare the rice

Wash and rinse the rice: Gently wash the glutinous rice and rinse it in water, then pour the rice into a large bowl. Pour cold water into the bowl until the rice is submerged. Soak the rice for 6-7 hours to allow it to expand. Afterward, drain the water and let the rice dry.
Extract the gấc flesh:
Cut the gấc: Halve the ripe gấc fruit and use a spoon to scoop out the red flesh into a clean bowl. Discard the gấc shell.

White wine: Add 2 tbsp of white wine to the bowl of gấc flesh. Wear gloves and squeeze gently to separate all the gấc flesh from the seeds. Remove the seeds and keep only the flesh for cooking the sticky rice. This is how to prepare the ingredients for cooking xôi gấc.
Step 2: Mix the glutinous rice with gấc

Add the extracted gấc flesh to the glutinous rice and then add a small teaspoon of salt. Use your hands to mix well so the gấc blends into the rice, turning the glutinous rice into the red color of the gấc. Soak for about 30-60 minutes to let the rice absorb the gấc flavor before cooking.
2. Cooking the sticky rice
You can cook xôi gấc by steaming or using a rice cooker.
Method 1: Steaming

Pour water into the steamer, with the water level at ⅓ of the pot's height. Next, place the glutinous rice mixed with gấc into the steamer basket. Turn on the stove and steam for 30-45 minutes until the rice is cooked. When the rice is soft and cooked, use chopsticks to stir well to make the rice softer and smoother. Then, add 2 tbsp of white sugar and mix well. To create a glossy look for the xôi gấc, add ½ tbsp of cooking oil and steam for another 10 minutes. When the xôi gấc is soft and chewy, remove the steamer basket from the stove and decorate or serve on a plate to enjoy.
Method 2: Cooking with a rice cooker

Place the glutinous rice mixed with gấc into the rice cooker. Pour in water until it just covers the surface of the rice. Turn on "Cook" mode and cook until the rice is done. When the rice is soft and the cooker switches to "Warm" mode, add one tablespoon of cooking oil. Close the lid and turn on "Cook" mode again. When the rice cooker switches back to "Warm" mode again, the xôi gấc is ready.
3. Completion
Enjoy the hot xôi gấc with its brilliant reddish-orange color; it will be an interesting highlight, making your family's Tet holiday feast more abundant and colorful.
Requirements for traditional xôi gấc:
The xôi gấc should have an attractive aroma, be moderately dry, and not mushy.
The rice grains should not be burst, but chewy and delicious.
The gấc should be mixed evenly with the rice for an attractive color, without any remaining gấc pith.
Xôi gấc is a symbolic dish for luck, so with this very simple way to make delicious and attractive chewy xôi gấc, you can make your family's holiday meals more delicious and meaningful.
Good luck with cooking this uniquely delicious xôi gấc dish!
Notes when soaking rice for xôi gấc
Soaking time: Soak the rice in water for 6-8 hours so the rice expands, softens, and cooks easily. If the rice is not soaked long enough, the xôi may not cook evenly or may feel hard.
Water amount: Ensure the rice is fully submerged in water while soaking. Use cold water to soak the rice; do not use hot water as it can strip away the color and nutrients of the rice.
Washing the rice: Before soaking, wash the rice gently to remove bad grains. Then, rinse the rice in clean water to remove dirt or impurities.
Bleaching agents: No need to use bleaching agents or chemicals to soak the rice. Soaking in simple clean water is enough.
Storage: Ensure the rice is stored in a dry and cool place before use. High humidity rice can cause mold or fungus.

mon_an.mo_ta: Eel meat contains many vitamins and minerals such as vitamins A, B1, B6, as well as iron, sodium, potassium, and calcium, which are very good for health. Let's make a breakfast of delicious and nutritious Eel Porridge for the whole family to have an energized spirit for work and study, moms!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning powder, fish sauce, chili, pepper - as needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Debone the cooked eel meat: follow the steps for Choosing and preparing eel correctly.
Step 2: Lightly wash the glutinous rice and plain rice to avoid losing all nutrients, add the eel bone broth, add 1 tsp of seasoning powder, and cook into porridge.
Step 3: For this easy-to-make delicious dish, stir-fry the eel meat with fried shallots, minced ginger, minced lemongrass, turmeric water, seasoning powder, and fish sauce to taste.
Step 4: Ladle the porridge into a bowl, add the eel meat, chopped scallions, and cleaned herbs, then enjoy the delicious and nutritious Eel Porridge.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Delicious Mixed Fried Sticky Rice
mon_an.mo_ta: A new recipe for fried rice: instead of regular plain rice, glutinous rice is a fresh but wonderful choice. Let's learn how to make this delicious, beautiful, and extremely appetite-stimulating mixed fried sticky rice!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare and process ingredients

For glutinous rice, to achieve the desired chewiness and deliciousness after cooking, you need to soak the rice for 10 hours before processing. If you want to make this mixed fried sticky rice for breakfast or lunch, you need to soak the rice from the night before.
Step 2:
Soak the shiitake mushrooms in a small bowl of water until they expand. For the dried shrimp, also soak them in water until soft.
Then, finely dice the Chinese sausage, mushrooms, dried shrimp, scallions, garlic, and cured pork. Place all the chopped ingredients neatly on a large plate (tray).
Step 3:
For the previously soaked rice, wash it clean and drain.
Place a pan on the stove, add oil and heat it up, then add the garlic and sauté until fragrant for 30 seconds over high heat.
Continue adding the mushrooms, dried shrimp, cured pork, and Chinese sausage to fry, stirring evenly for 4-5 minutes.
Step 4:
When the ingredients are cooked, remove them all to a plate, keeping the remaining oil in the pan to fry the glutinous rice.
Step 5:
Next, add 15ml of cooking oil to the pan, add the glutinous rice to fry, add the previously prepared chicken broth, and stir until the broth evaporates.
When it dries out, continue adding chicken broth and stirring until all the prepared chicken broth is used up.

Note: When adding chicken broth to the pan, you should add it a little at a time. Avoid adding all the broth at once, as the fried sticky rice will not be delicious and can easily become mushy, scorched, or burnt.
Step 6:
When the glutinous rice is cooked, add the previously fried ingredients back into the pan and stir evenly with the cooked rice.
Add a little soy sauce for color and flavor, and season to taste.
Step 7:
Finally, add the scallions, stir for about 20 seconds, then remove the fried rice to a bowl. Enjoy this delicious dish immediately!
Finished product requirements:
The mixed fried rice should have a beautiful color, an attractive aroma, a balanced taste, and all ingredients should be cooked without being burnt.
Each grain of rice should be chewy, separate, not hard, and not scorched.
Secrets to choosing good ingredients:

Glutinous rice must have even, glossy, plump grains, with no broken grains and not many yellow grains. - Good rice will have a pleasant aroma; when chewed raw, it will taste sweet without any strange odors.
Dried shrimp should be yellow or slightly pale red; do not choose deep red ones as they contain a lot of food coloring.
Choose dried shrimp that feel bone-dry to the touch but still retain a sweet juice when eaten; that is high-quality dried shrimp.

Although the dish takes some time to prepare, it is completely easy to make, nutritious, and has a wonderful flavor. Even though it is fried rice, it provides enough nutrients for a complete meal to give you an active long day. You can learn how to make this mixed fried sticky rice to change up your daily meals, making your family's meals much more delicious. Change your palate frequently with this incredibly tasty dish!

mon_an.ten: Recipe for Chewy and Delicious Kimchi Spaghetti
mon_an.mo_ta: The wonderful combination of Asian and European flavors in this kimchi spaghetti will make you fall in love, especially when you're tired of eating rice.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: A little finely grated Parmesan cheese (optional)
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Bring a pot of water to a boil and cook the spaghetti until tender. When the pasta is done, drain it in a colander, rinse with cold water, place in a bowl, then add 2 tablespoons of oil and toss.
Step 2:
Cut the kimchi into bite-sized pieces, not too large and not too small.
Step 3:
Cut the cherry tomatoes into wedges, and slice the onion and garlic along with a few basil leaves.
Step 4:
Heat olive oil in a pan, then sauté the garlic and onion until fragrant and they turn slightly golden.
Step 5:
Now, add the cut kimchi pieces to the pan and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until the kimchi firms up and absorbs the flavors.
Step 6:
Next, add 2/3 of the cut cherry tomatoes to the pan and also stir evenly for 3-4 minutes, similar to the kimchi.
Step 7:
When the tomatoes are cooked, add the heavy cream and stir well. If you don't like your spaghetti too rich, you can omit the heavy cream.
Step 8:
Next, add the kimchi brine and continue to stir evenly.
Step 9:
Simmer the mixture over low heat so the sauce reduces and becomes thick, and the tomatoes soften. When the sauce has reduced, season with MSG, salt, pepper, seasoning powder, etc., to taste.
Step 10:
Next, add the previously boiled pasta to the pan and toss.
Step 11:
Toss gently so the pasta absorbs the sauce; you should use chopsticks and a spoon to mix more evenly!
Step 12:
Finally, when the pasta has blended with the sauce, add the remaining tomatoes, stir well, and add the basil. If you have shredded cheese, sprinkle it on to enhance the dish's deliciousness.
Tada, the kimchi spaghetti is now finished; enjoy it while it's still hot!
Finished product requirements:
The pasta should not be too chewy or too mushy and should have a beautiful golden color.
The kimchi and cherry tomatoes should be soft and cooked with their characteristic flavors.
The pasta should have the taste of kimchi and the richness of heavy cream and cheese.
The taste should be balanced, not too salty or too bland, and a little bit spicy will make it better.
You should serve the pasta on a plate and garnish with a few basil leaves on top for a beautiful look.
The flavor is excellent—rich, sour, and slightly spicy from the kimchi; it's irresistibly delicious!
This spaghetti recipe is also a great suggestion for days when you're too lazy to cook rice.
You just need to gather a few ingredients from the kitchen to have a delicious plate of spaghetti immediately!

mon_an.ten: Recipe for Authentic Beef Kimbap Omelet Rolls
mon_an.mo_ta: Instead of making kimbap the usual way, you can get creative with this bulgogi beef kimbap wrapped in egg—guaranteed to be delicious!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Cooked sticky rice (mixed with a little salt and sesame oil)
Oyster sauce, sesame oil, honey, seasonings
cac_buoc: Let's get a little creative with traditional kimbap using a golden fried egg shell and a savory, attractive sautéed beef filling! Let's get started!
Step 1:
Wash the carrot and shred it into small strips, then sauté with a little seasoning for flavor and let it cool!
Step 2:
For the beef, marinate it with 1 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tbsp sesame oil, 1 tbsp sugar (or 1 tbsp honey), a few sesame seeds, and ground pepper for 5 minutes so the seasonings soak into the beef!
Step 3:
Place a pan on the stove, add a little oil and heat it up, then sauté the beef.
As soon as the meat is just cooked, remove it immediately so the beef doesn't become tough!
Step 4:
Spread the seaweed sheet on a flat surface and spread the rice evenly over 2/3 of the seaweed sheet.
Layer the mustard green leaves, pickled radish, carrot, and bulgogi beef on top of the rice layer.
Step 5:
Now, roll the rice up gently; as you roll, press down slightly with your hands to secure the filling inside.
Step 6:
Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk well with a tablespoon of water. Add a little salt (remember to keep it light, not too salty), then strain through a sieve to remove any lumps.
Step 7:

Place a pan on the stove, add oil, and only turn the stove to medium heat so the egg cooks evenly; high heat will cause the egg to burn quickly. Pour the egg in to fry; note not to let the pan get too hot as it will turn the egg brown.
Step 8:
When the egg is 2/3 cooked, place the kimbap roll in the middle.
Gently use a spatula (or spoon or chopsticks) to roll the egg over the kimbap. When the egg is cooked, remove the egg-wrapped kimbap from the pan and continue frying until all the kimbap is used.
Step 9:
Place the egg-wrapped rice roll on a bamboo mat and use your hands to shape it so the egg is secured.
You should let the egg-wrapped kimbap cool before cutting it!
Step 10:
When the kimbap has cooled, cut it and arrange it on a plate, then enjoy immediately!
So we have finished the bulgogi beef kimbap wrapped in egg.
Finished product requirements:
The outer egg layer should have a beautiful golden color, not brown or burnt.
The inner filling should be secured and not fall out.
The kimbap should have a balanced taste, not salty, with the aroma of beef and seaweed.
The golden fried egg shell wrapping the white rice roll and the fragrant sautéed beef filling in the middle—just looking at it makes you want to eat.
You can make this dish for lunch at school or the office, or for picnics and outings with friends and family...
You can cut the kimbap into small rounds, then divide them into portions along with some fruit for dessert!

mon_an.ten: Mantis Shrimp Noodle Soup (Bún Bề Bề)
mon_an.mo_ta: Mantis shrimp has long been a rustic and simple staple for coastal residents. As tourism has flourished, visitors have come to love dishes made from top-tier seafood like horseshoe crab, oysters, and clams. Mantis shrimp is also among the most sought-after seafood by tourists, not only for its rustic appeal but also for its delicious flavor and high nutritional value. It is commonly prepared boiled, grilled, steamed, or stir-fried. Today, we will guide you through making a fragrant, hot, and sweet Mantis Shrimp Noodle Soup for a breakfast that tastes just as good as at a restaurant. Follow these simple and easy steps to enjoy the fresh flavor of this traditional dish.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Water dropwort (or water celery) - 1 small bunch
Aromatics - Green onions, culantro (or dill), dried shallots
Seasonings - Chili sauce, lime, fish sauce, seasoning powder.
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients:

Step 1: Clean the pork tail bones, place them in a pot, cover with water, and bring to a boil for 3-4 minutes. Drain the water and rinse the bones several times with cold water to remove impurities. Return the bones to the pot, add fresh water, and simmer until tender to make the broth.

Step 2: Place the mantis shrimp in a colander and shake well under running water to clean. Put the shrimp in a pot with a piece of smashed ginger and one smashed shallot. Place the pot on the stove and boil until the shrimp are cooked through.
Step 3: Use scissors to cut off the head and both sides along the body of the mantis shrimp. Peel off the hard shell to extract the meat.
Step 4: Cut the tofu into small pieces and fry until golden brown on all sides.
Step 5: Pick and wash the water dropwort, drain well, and cut into short segments.
Cooking process:
Step 1: Thinly slice the dried shallots. Using the pan used for the tofu, fry the shallots until they just start to turn golden, then remove them immediately.
Step 2: Pound or blend the mantis shrimp heads and shells, then strain the liquid into the pork bone broth.
Step 3: Blanch the rice vermicelli in hot water and place into large bowls. Blanch the water dropwort in the broth until just cooked, then place it in a corner of the noodle bowl.

Step 4: Drain most of the oil used for frying shallots into a bowl, then sauté the sliced tomatoes until soft. Use a spoon to mash them. Pour the sautéed tomatoes into the broth. Season with fish sauce and seasoning powder to taste.
Step 5: Finally, arrange the fried tofu, chopped green onions, culantro (or dill), mantis shrimp meat, and fried shallots in the bowl. Pour the hot broth over the noodles and enjoy.
Notes:
When boiling mantis shrimp, you do not need to add water as they will release their own liquid.
Choose silken tofu so that when fried, the outside is golden while the inside remains soft and smooth.
Be careful to remove the shallots as soon as they start turning golden.
Tips for delicious Mantis Shrimp Noodle Soup at home:
Choose fresh ingredients: Select fresh mantis shrimp with no foul odor and bright skin. Choose fresh rice vermicelli with a moderate chewiness.
Processing mantis shrimp: Wash and soak the shrimp in diluted salt water to remove the fishy smell. Boil or steam until tender. Once cooked, soak them in ice water to maintain firmness.
Prepare the broth: Use pork or chicken bone broth for a rich flavor. Season with salt, sugar, shallots, garlic, and fish sauce to taste.
Enhance the aroma: Add aromatics like shallots, ginger, cinnamon, pepper, and cloves to the broth to increase the fragrance.

Garnish and seasoning: When serving, add fresh herbs like cilantro, raw vegetables, red onions, fried garlic, and fried dough sticks for variety. Tofu, fried shallots, and chili oil also enhance the flavor.
Serve hot: Mantis shrimp noodle soup is best enjoyed hot. Eat immediately after preparation to enjoy the fresh taste.
How to buy fresh mantis shrimp:
Choose a reliable source: Go to trusted stores or markets known for fresh seafood. If possible, buy at seafood markets or supermarkets with reliable supplies.
Check appearance: Choose shrimp that look fresh with smooth skin and no bruises, cracks, or cloudiness. The skin should be bright, not black or blotchy.
Check the smell: Fresh mantis shrimp should have a fresh, clean scent. There should be no foul, fishy, or unpleasant odor. Check the smell before buying.
Ensure freshness: Ask the seller about the packaging date or expiration date. Choose the most recent packaging date for safety and flavor.
Hygiene requirements: Ensure the shrimp are kept in hygienic conditions and stored at the proper temperature to avoid spoilage.
Interact with the seller: Ask about the origin and storage method. This interaction provides more information and builds trust when purchasing.

mon_an.ten: Macaroni with Meatballs in Tomato Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: Macaroni with meatballs is an incredibly appealing dish, from its appearance with delicious golden-brown meatballs to the macaroni coated in a rich tomato sauce. When tasting, you will experience the sweet and fresh flavor of the meatballs, the slightly chewy macaroni, and the sweet and sour sauce. Adding a bit of creamy cheese makes this dish absolutely wonderful!
cac_buoc: How to make delicious Macaroni with Meatballs:
Step 1: Make the meatballs

Peel, wash, and finely dice the onion. Mix the onion with the ground pork, breadcrumbs, dried parsley, and beaten egg. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Mix thoroughly so all ingredients are well combined. Let the mixture rest for 15 minutes to allow the flavors to penetrate. Next, roll the meat into small balls about 2 cm in diameter.

Place a pan on the stove, add about 2 tbsp of oil, and heat over medium-low heat. Add the meatballs and fry until golden brown on both sides, then set aside. If you have an oven, you can bake the meatballs at 180°C for about 18 minutes until cooked through. When frying, do not use high heat as it will burn the outside while leaving the inside raw.
Step 2: Make the tomato sauce

If you cannot buy pre-made sauce, you can make your own: heat olive oil in a pan, sauté diced onion until soft, then add diced tomatoes. Season with salt, a little sugar, seasoning powder, and some dried parsley. Simmer over low heat until the tomatoes are soft and the sauce has thickened to your liking.
Step 3: Boil the macaroni
Bring a large pot of water to a boil, add 1 tsp of salt, and add the dried macaroni. Boil until al dente (about 11-13 minutes), then drain in a colander.
Step 4: Stir-fry the macaroni

After boiling the macaroni, place a large pot or pan on the stove and add 1 tbsp of olive oil. Add the macaroni and tomato sauce, stirring over medium-low heat. Add all the meatballs and toss until the meat and macaroni are evenly coated in sauce and simmering gently. Cook for 5-10 minutes to let the flavors meld, then adjust seasoning to taste.
Finally, scoop the macaroni onto a plate and enjoy. This dish is delicious served either hot or warm.
Notes for the perfect Macaroni with Meatballs:
If you don't like this specific macaroni shape, you can use any pasta you prefer. Note that boiling times vary for different types of pasta.
Using canned tomato sauce helps achieve a thick consistency and saves time. If you prefer a fresher taste, you can make your own sauce as instructed.
Do not make the meatballs too thick, or they will take a long time to cook and may end up burnt on the outside and raw on the inside.
To enhance the flavor and appeal, you can sprinkle some cheese on top before turning off the heat. Stir it in when eating to experience the full flavor of the dish.

mon_an.ten: Mì Quảng for an Energetic Breakfast
mon_an.mo_ta: Let's get into the kitchen and prepare a nutritious and energetic breakfast for your family. Mì Quảng is sure to be a family favorite!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Cornstarch - 90 g (cornstarch makes the noodles chewier and more elastic than tapioca starch)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Combine the rice flour, cornstarch, and water in a bowl. Let it sit for 3-4 hours until the starch settles, then pour off the clear water. Replace it with the exact same amount of fresh cold water (mark the water level before pouring off the old water). Add salt and turmeric powder, then stir well.
Note: If your rice flour is old, you should change the water twice for a better aroma.

Step 2: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Brush a little oil on a tray or plate and place it in the steamer for 2 minutes. Ladle a thin layer of batter onto the tray, steam for about 90 seconds, then pour another thin layer on top. Cover and steam for 3 minutes until cooked. Remove the tray, replace it with another, and continue steaming the batter.
Note: Steaming in two thin layers ensures the noodles have a better texture and even thickness.
Step 3: Each time you remove a tray, brush with a little oil and sprinkle with fried shallots. Wait for it to cool slightly, then roll it up before slicing into strands.
Step 4: With this Mì Quảng noodle sheet recipe, the noodles will be delicious and remain soft even if kept until the next day.

mon_an.mo_ta: A savory sausage filling wrapped in a crispy fried rice crust makes for a perfect combination for a breakfast full of energy and nutrition. Let's learn how to make these sausage rice rolls right now!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings: salt, sugar, seasoning powder, pepper, chili sauce, cooking oil
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the green beans, trim the ends, and mince finely. Peel and wash the carrots, then dice into small cubes. Peel and mince the shallots.

Step 2: Place a pan on the stove, heat the oil, and sauté the shallots until fragrant. Add the carrots and green beans, seasoning with salt, seasoning powder, and pepper. Once the vegetables are cooked, turn off the heat.
Step 3: Mix the cooked rice thoroughly with the sautéed carrots and green beans.
Cut the sausages into segments about 5 cm long and set aside.

Step 4: Spread the mixed rice on a clean flat surface, place a piece of sausage in the center, and mold the rice to completely cover the sausage. Repeat with the remaining sausage pieces until finished.

Step 5: Prepare the flour, breadcrumbs, and beaten egg in three separate bowls. Dip each rice-covered sausage into the flour, then into the egg wash. Finally, roll the rice roll in the breadcrumbs until evenly coated.
Step 6: Heat the oil and deep-fry each rice roll until they are golden brown and crispy all over.
Step 7: Once golden brown, remove and place on a rack or plate lined with paper towels to drain excess oil.
The crispy sausage rice rolls are now complete. The soft, crispy rice combined with the sweetness of the vegetables and the savory sausage creates a delicious and irresistible dish.
Serve with a drizzle of chili sauce or ketchup for extra flavor.

With this simple and quick method, these crispy sausage rice rolls are a great choice for family breakfasts, picnics, or outings. These cute little rice rolls are portable, convenient, and packed with nutrients.
Wishing you and your family a delicious meal with these attractive crispy sausage rice rolls!.

mon_an.ten: 5 Ways to Make Golden Egg Fried Rice at Home
cac_buoc: Golden egg fried rice is a simple dish that brings an appealing and exciting flavor to your meal. With just a few simple ingredients and a bit of cooking skill, you can easily make this at home. A plate of fragrant, golden fried rice enjoyed in a cozy family setting is wonderful. Check out our 5 ways to make golden egg fried rice at home!
I. Traditional Golden Egg Fried Rice
1. Ingredients
To make golden egg fried rice, you need:
3 cups of leftover rice
2 eggs
1 stalk of green onion
1 shallot.
For seasoning: 1 tbsp fish sauce, 2 tbsp cooking oil, and a little seasoning powder or pepper to taste.
2. Preparation steps
Step 1: Prepare ingredients
Peel and thinly slice the shallot. Wash the green onion, remove roots and wilted leaves, then chop finely.
Crack the eggs into a bowl, then separate the yolks of the 2 eggs into another bowl. Whisk the egg whites with 1 tsp seasoning powder and 1/2 tsp ground pepper.
Step 2: Combine rice and eggs

Add the cold leftover rice to the bowl with the egg yolks. Add 1 tsp seasoning powder, 1 tsp fish sauce, and 1/2 tsp ground pepper. Mix the rice, yolks, and seasonings thoroughly. Use a spoon to break up any rice clumps so the grains don't stick together.

This step is the secret to making the dish attractive, as the yolks provide a beautiful golden color to every grain of rice. For a deeper yellow, you can add a tiny bit of turmeric powder, but be careful not to add too much as it may affect the flavor.
Step 3: Fry the rice

Use a non-stick pan. Heat the pan before adding oil. Once the oil is hot, sauté the shallots until fragrant and they change color. Quickly pour in the whisked egg whites and stir until soft and scrambled.

Next, add the rice mixed with yolks to the pan. Fry over high heat to make the rice grains firm and dry. After about 5 minutes, add 2 tsp fish sauce and adjust seasonings to taste. Continue tossing for a few minutes until the rice is perfectly fluffy, then add green onions and turn off the heat.
Serve the fried rice on a plate and sprinkle with ground pepper. Enjoy while hot to experience the firm yet tender grains. Serve with soy sauce and chili sauce for extra flavor!
II. Simple Leftover Rice Fried Rice
To prepare this version, you need:
3 bowls of leftover rice
2 chicken or duck eggs
1 stalk of green onion and 1 shallot.
Seasoning: fish sauce, oil, ground black pepper, and seasoning powder.
Prep the green onions by washing and chopping. Peel and thinly slice the shallot.
Crack 2 eggs into a bowl, add 1 tsp seasoning powder and 1 tsp black pepper. Whisk well to combine yolks and whites.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a pan. Sauté the shallots until golden brown. Add the rice and stir over medium heat for about 5 minutes until the grains are heated through and firm.
Pour the egg mixture over the rice and stir constantly for about 5 minutes over medium heat. Season with 1 tsp seasoning powder and 1 tbsp fish sauce.
Continue tossing until the rice is fluffy and dry, then add the chopped green onions. Adjust seasoning to taste and turn off the heat.
The finished dish will have a characteristic aroma, rich egg flavor, and soft, easy-to-eat rice grains.
III. Garlic Egg Fried Rice
1 bowl of white rice and 3 cloves of minced garlic.
Seasoning: oil, fish sauce, salt, sugar, ground pepper, MSG, and seasoning powder.
2. How to make Garlic Egg Fried Rice
Crack eggs into a bowl, add 1 tsp seasoning powder, a bit of pepper, and 1/4 tsp MSG. Whisk well.
Heat a pan and coat with a little oil. Pour the eggs in and spread thinly to cook until golden on both sides. Slice the egg into thin strips or bite-sized pieces.

Add 1 tbsp oil to the pan and sauté the minced garlic until fragrant. Add the white rice and toss well. Season with 1 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tsp sugar, and 1/3 tsp MSG. Toss over medium heat for 5 minutes, then turn off the heat.
Plate the rice and top with the shredded egg. Enjoy.
For the best result, use leftover rice rather than freshly cooked rice, as it provides a better texture and is less cloying.
IV. Tomato Egg Fried Rice
To prepare this dish, you need:
1 fresh tomato
150 g tomato ketchup
1 bowl of rice
50 g green peas
1 egg
1 tsp minced shallot, seasoning powder, and soy sauce.
2. How to cook Tomato Egg Fried Rice
Score the tomato with an 'X' and blanch in boiling water. The skin will peel off easily. Dice the tomato.
Wash the peas and blanch in boiling water with a little salt until cooked.
Whisk the egg with a little seasoning powder and black pepper.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a pan. Sauté the shallots until fragrant. Add the diced tomatoes and cook over medium heat. Season with 1 tsp seasoning powder. Use a spoon to mash the tomatoes.

Add the rice and toss until the grains are firm. Pour the egg over the rice and stir for 5 minutes over medium heat. Add the ketchup and 1 tbsp soy sauce. Toss quickly so the rice is evenly coated in the red sauce.
Add the peas and toss for another 3-5 minutes. Adjust seasoning to taste and turn off the heat.
V. Butter Egg Fried Rice
4 bowls of leftover rice
10 g minced garlic
1 egg
1/2 carrot
2 chilies
50 g green beans
3 stalks of green onion
50 g butter
Fish sauce, annatto oil, MSG...
2. How to make Butter Egg Fried Rice
Peel and dice the carrot. String and dice the green beans. Chop the chilies and green onions.
Place the rice in a bowl, add the egg, and mix well.
Melt the butter in a pan. Sauté the minced garlic until fragrant.
Add the rice-egg mixture and toss constantly for 5 minutes over high heat.
Add 1 tbsp annatto oil, the carrots, green beans, chilies, and 1 tbsp fish sauce. Toss for 3-5 minutes until the flavors are absorbed.
Finally, add the green onions, turn off the heat, and the vegetable egg fried rice is ready.
VI. How to choose eggs for fried rice
You can use either chicken or duck eggs!
Fresh eggs usually have a thick shell and medium size; avoid very large eggs with thin shells.
Buy eggs with a fine powdery coating on the shell; this indicates they are fresh.
If the shell is very shiny and smooth, the eggs have been stored for a long time and should be avoided.
Fresh eggs do not make a sound when shaken gently, while old eggs will have movement inside.
VII. Notes for making egg fried rice
Use cold leftover rice instead of hot rice to make the dish tastier and prevent the rice from becoming mushy or sticky.
Be creative with various vegetables like carrots, onions, green beans, cucumbers, sausages, or Chinese sausage. These not only make the dish look better but also provide more nutrition.
Avoid using too much oil to prevent the dish from becoming too greasy.

mon_an.mo_ta: Why not try making this delicious beef cooked in beer this weekend? The attractive beef infused with the aroma of dark beer will have the whole family praising it. The meat is tender and the tendons are perfectly chewy. You should serve this dish with rice vermicelli or bread! Let's learn how to make it below.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Aromatics - A few cloves of garlic, dried chilies, a small piece of ginger
Garnish - Fresh cilantro and green onions
cac_buoc: Step 1: Cut the beef into bite-sized pieces. Dice the carrot and onion. Slice the ginger and garlic.
Step 2: Boil the beef tendon until just cooked, then rinse with clean water and cut into bite-sized pieces.

Step 3: Place the tendons in a pressure cooker with the wine, half of the mirin, and the dried chilies. Cook for about 15 minutes. Remove the tendons and set aside, keeping the cooking liquid. In another pot, heat a little oil and sauté the garlic and ginger until fragrant.
Step 4: Add the beef and sauté over high heat until seared, then add the tendons and continue to sauté.

Step 5: Add the carrots, the remaining mirin (or soy sauce), sugar, and tomato sauce. Pour in the dark beer and simmer over low heat for about 15 minutes. Finally, add the onion, stir until just cooked, and remove from heat.
Step 6: Serve the beef in a deep dish, sprinkle with pepper, and garnish with green onions and cilantro for an attractive look!

mon_an.mo_ta: Beef beer stew is a familiar dish loved for its enticing aroma, tender beef, soft carrots and potatoes, and the slight bite of onions in a rich, savory sauce. Follow these simple steps to create an incredibly delicious meal!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning - 45 ml olive oil, 3 g salt, 3 g pepper, 5 g sugar, beef bouillon cube, 15 ml Worcestershire sauce
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Wash the beef and pat dry. Cut into 2 cm cubes.
Step 2:

Heat olive oil and a small piece of butter in a pot. Once the butter has melted, add the beef in batches so the pieces don't stick together and are evenly seared in the oil and butter. Sauté until the outside is browned, then remove.
Once removed, let the meat cool slightly and cut the cubes in half if they are too large.
Step 3:
Peel and wash the onion, then dice it. Using the same pot, sauté the onion and garlic for a few minutes until soft and fragrant.
Step 4:
Add the hot beef broth and the beef bouillon cube to the pot.
Step 5:
Pour the can of beer into the pot. The beer helps tenderize the beef and removes any gamey odor.
Step 6:
Add the seared beef back into the pot.
Step 7:
Add salt, Worcestershire sauce, and sugar to enhance the flavor. Cover and simmer over low heat for 1.5 to 2 hours until the beef is tender and has absorbed the seasonings.
Step 8:

To add color and sweetness, add the carrots and potatoes. Wash, peel, and cut them into large chunks. Add them to the pot, cover, and continue simmering for about 30 minutes until the vegetables are soft and the sauce has thickened.
Before serving, sprinkle with chopped celery for garnish.
Tips for choosing good beef:

Choose bright red meat (not dark red) with fine, dry, and firm grains that don't stick to your hand. Yellow fat indicates tender, rich meat. Young beef has white fat and very fine texture. Old beef has large, dark red grains and grayish fat, and it will be tough and take longer to cook. Heifer meat is generally better than bull meat.
Avoid meat that is pale green or has white spots between the fibers (signs of parasites). Do not buy meat with a foul odor.
For stews, choose cuts with tendons like shank, tendon, tail, or thigh. Adding garlic, ginger, cinnamon, and cloves will make the dish more fragrant and nutritious.
Removing beef odor: Rub the meat with a piece of charred, peeled, and crushed ginger, then rinse with cold water.

mon_an.mo_ta: Fried rice is a familiar breakfast dish in Vietnam. Besides the usual version, would you like to try a new style from another country? If so, join me in making this delicious Japanese Fried Rice. It features a blend of eggs, meat, vegetables, and sauce, creating a very eye-catching and appetizing dish. Let's get cooking!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Soy sauce or oyster sauce - 2 tbsp
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare ingredients
Wash the rice and drain.
Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk until frothy.
Slice the green chilies into small rings.
Leave the butter at room temperature to soften.
Wash the pork and mince or grind it.
Dice the onion.
Grate or julienne the carrot.
Peel and mince the garlic.
Wash the peas and edamame and place them in a bowl.
Step 2: Execution
The Rice:
Cook the rice in a rice cooker with water about one finger joint above the rice level. (Once cooked, fluff the rice so it stays light and airy).
When the rice is done, scoop it into a bowl to cool. Once warm, place it in the refrigerator for a few hours or until completely cold.
Heat a pan with a little oil.
Pour in the beaten eggs and fry until set. Remove, let cool slightly, and chop into small bits or thin strips.
In the same pan, increase the heat and add the minced pork.
Stir quickly so the meat breaks apart and doesn't clump. You only need to sear the meat until fragrant, not necessarily fully cooked at this stage.
Finishing the dish:
Heat another pan over medium heat.
Melt the butter in the pan.
Once melted, add the onion, carrot, and garlic. Stir well.
Add the green chilies, peas, and edamame. Stir until the vegetables begin to soften.
Add the cold rice to the pan. Toss well so the rice and vegetables are combined (you can increase the heat here to make the rice crispy).
Let the rice sit for 2-3 minutes, then toss again. Repeat until the rice starts to turn golden.
Add the pre-cooked pork, fried eggs, 1 tsp pepper, and 1/2 tsp salt. Mix everything together.
Finally, add the sesame oil and soy sauce (or oyster sauce). Give it a final toss and turn off the heat.
Scoop the rice into bowls. Garnish with green onions or toasted sesame seeds if desired.
Notes for Japanese Fried Rice:
If using brown rice, it doesn't expand as much as white rice, so adjust the quantity accordingly. For white rice, a slightly sticky variety works best.
You can add other vegetables like sweet corn, chopped spinach, or seaweed.
If you don't like ground pork, you can substitute with chicken, beef, or shrimp.

mon_an.mo_ta: Egg-wrapped rice is an ideal dish for picnics, outings, or lunch with friends!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: For the fried rice: - Chicken - 250 g
Cooked rice - 2 full bowls (leftover rice works great)
For the egg wrap: - Large eggs - 8
cac_buoc: Let's start making the egg-wrapped rice!
Step 1:
Dice the chicken and marinate with salt and pepper; set aside.
Dice the onion, mince the garlic, and thinly slice the shiitake mushrooms.
Heat oil in a pan. Sauté the onion until soft, then add the garlic and mushrooms. Add the marinated chicken and cook through.
Step 2:
Once the chicken is cooked, add the rice and toss quickly to break up clumps. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Stir-fry for about 2 minutes until the rice is slightly firm, then turn off the heat and add the ketchup.
Step 3:
Stir quickly so the ketchup evenly coats the rice grains.
Step 4:
Whisk 2 eggs in a bowl with 1 tsp of milk and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Heat a little oil in a pan over medium heat. Pour in the egg mixture and tilt the pan to spread it evenly.
When the edges are set but the center is still slightly moist, place 1/4 of the rice in the middle of the omelet.
Step 5:

Gently fold the edges of the egg over the rice. Note that the egg doesn't need to cover the rice completely; be gentle so the egg doesn't tear. Place a plate over the pan and flip it over so the beautiful side of the egg is on top.
Repeat for the remaining eggs and rice. Arrange on plates and decorate with ketchup and side vegetables as desired.
Enjoy your creation!
You can also decorate or vary this dish in your own style! Good luck!

mon_an.mo_ta: Char Siu is a dish of Chinese origin with a unique delicious flavor and an eye-catching color that makes anyone who sees or tastes it want more. Today, we share this perfect Char Siu recipe. Are you ready? Let's get cooking!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Five-spice liquor (Soak 20g five-spice powder in 250ml white wine for 1 hour) - 2 tbsp
cac_buoc: Step 1:
After buying the pork, cut it into large, thin slabs. Do not cut the pieces too thick as they will be hard to cook through, and do not cut them too small as they will burn easily when roasting.
Step 2:

Marinating the meat: Combine 2 tbsp minced garlic, five-spice liquor, soy sauce, oyster sauce, dark sugar, 1 tbsp caramel sauce, honey, 2 tbsp oil, pepper, 1 tsp salt (or seasoning), 1 tbsp sesame oil, and 1 tbsp five-spice powder.
Step 3:
Mix the seasonings and meat thoroughly. Let the meat marinate for at least 2 hours.
To cook the meat, you can use an electric oven, a charcoal grill, or a gas stove.
If using an oven, preheat it to 250°C.
Step 4:
Place the meat on a wire rack over a tray and put it in the oven. Keep the remaining marinade in the bowl for basting.
Step 5:

After roasting for about 10 minutes, take the meat out and baste it with the remaining marinade. Roast for another 30-40 minutes per 1 kg of meat. Note that the finished meat should have a deep reddish-brown color on the outside.
Step 6:
The meat is best when allowed to cool completely. After half a day, it should be stored in the refrigerator to prevent spoilage.
You can slice or shred the Char Siu to serve with noodle soups, salads, or in Bánh mì with pickled vegetables.
You can also slice it to eat with hot steamed rice.
It is excellent with noodle soup.
Or served with stir-fried noodles.
It is also very delicious when eaten with lettuce and fresh herbs.

mon_an.mo_ta: Crispy fried sticky rice-crusted chicken with its delicious flavor has become a favorite for many. So how do you prepare this dish perfectly? Let's explore how to make this attractive crispy chicken at home.
cac_buoc: Preparing the ingredients for the crispy fried sticky rice-crusted chicken

Clean the dressed chicken by rubbing salt all over to remove pinfeathers and impurities, then rinse with water. Soak the chicken in a light brine for about 10 minutes, then remove and place in a colander to drain. Since it is pre-cleaned chicken, remember to re-process it thoroughly to ensure food safety and to make the dish sweeter and more fragrant.
Trim and wash the green onions, then finely chop them.
Peel and mince the ginger and shallots.
Rinse the glutinous rice and add water to a depth of about 2 knuckles + 1/2 can of coconut milk + 1/2 tsp salt. Soak for about 5 hours until the rice expands, then drain.
Cooking steps for the crispy fried sticky rice-crusted chicken
Step 1: Heat cooking oil in a pan and sauté the minced ginger and shallots until fragrant, then transfer to a bowl and set aside.

Step 2: While the pan is still hot, add more oil and heat until shimmering, then add all the green onions and toss briefly. Transfer the scallion oil to another bowl, keeping it separate from the ginger and shallots.
Step 3: Put the glutinous rice into a large bowl along with 1 tsp salt, chicken bouillon powder, and the sautéed ginger and shallot mixture; mix well.
Step 4: To make the chicken more flavorful, marinate it with a little salt and black pepper for about 30 minutes.

Step 5: Bring water to a boil in a steamer, add the glutinous rice, and place the chicken on top to steam together. Steam until the chicken is nearly cooked, then remove it to a plate. Continue steaming the rice until it is soft and sticky. Once the rice is cooked, add the remaining 1/2 can of coconut milk to make it richer and more fragrant.
Step 6: While the rice is still hot, wrap it tightly around the chicken, sealing it as completely as possible.

To make the wrapping process easier, use plastic wrap or aluminum foil. Spread the foil on a large tray, then spread the cooked sticky rice evenly to a thickness of about 1.5 cm and press it firmly into a solid layer. Place the chicken in the center and roll it up, ensuring the rice completely seals the chicken with no gaps. Let it rest for a moment, then remove the foil and wait for the rice to cool before proceeding.

Step 7: Heat enough oil in a deep frying pan to submerge at least 1/2 of the chicken. Once the oil is very hot, carefully place the rice-wrapped chicken in and fry. Fry until the outer rice crust is evenly golden brown and crispy. Remove and place in a mesh basket to drain excess oil.

With these simple steps, you have completed the delicious and rich crispy fried sticky rice-crusted chicken at home. Wait for it to cool slightly, then cut open the rice crust to enjoy. Carve the chicken and rice into bite-sized pieces, arrange them on a plate, and garnish with the rice pieces around the chicken for an attractive presentation.
Notes:
When buying chicken, choose free-range chicken for better flavor and texture.
Soak the glutinous rice long enough; otherwise, the grains will be hard and unappetizing after cooking.
When sautéing ginger and shallots, remove them as soon as they turn slightly golden. Leaving them too long will cause them to burn and smell bitter.
Wrap the rice as tightly as possible around the chicken to ensure a crispy crust while retaining the chicken's natural juices.
Use a deep pan and plenty of oil when frying to ensure the crust cooks evenly without sticking to the pan.

mon_an.mo_ta: Steamed buns (bánh bao) are a familiar dish with many variations such as meat-filled or vegetarian buns. Today, we will share how to make purple sweet potato steamed buns that are not only delicious and beautiful but also quite simple to prepare. Let's get cooking!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the purple sweet potatoes thoroughly and steam or boil until cooked (steaming is recommended to retain the sweetness and floury texture). Once cooked, peel, mash thoroughly, and pass through a sieve for a smoother texture.
Step 2: Put the mashed purple sweet potato into a large mixing bowl with 100 g of flour. Knead by hand until the mixture is pliable and smooth, forming a purple dough ball.
In a separate small bowl, combine 15 g of white sugar and 10 g of yeast with a little warm water. Wait about 5 minutes for the yeast to bloom, then mix it into the purple potato dough.
Step 3: In another bowl, mix the remaining 15 g of white sugar, 10 g of yeast, and 180 g of flour with warm water to create a white dough mixture.

Step 4: Warm the milk slightly. Add 1/2 of the milk to the white dough and mix well. Add the remaining milk to the purple dough. Place the purple and white doughs into two separate large bowls, cover tightly, and proof for about 2 hours until doubled in size.

Step 5: Once the dough has risen, pass the purple dough through a dough sheeter (or knead thoroughly) about 7–10 times until soft and smooth, then set aside. Repeat the process for the white dough. (If you don't have a machine, knead thoroughly and use a rolling pin to roll the dough thin).

Step 6: After both doughs have been rolled into equally thin sheets, lay the white dough sheet on the work surface. Brush a little clean water onto the surface, then place the purple dough sheet on top, aligning the edges. Press gently so the two layers adhere to each other. (Brushing with water helps the layers stick and prevents the buns from drying out during steaming).

Step 7: Roll the layered dough into a long log, then use a knife to slice it into pieces 5–7 cm thick. Alternatively, you can save a little purple dough, roll it into small balls to use as filling, and wrap the spiral-patterned dough sheets around them. This method creates visually appealing filled buns.
Step 8: Finally, brush a little cooking oil onto the surface of each bun and steam them for about 15 minutes.
Notes:
The finer you sieve the potato, the fluffier and smoother the buns will be.
Knead the dough very thoroughly to ensure an even texture without lumps.
Lightly oil the buns before steaming so they don't stick to the steamer basket.

mon_an.mo_ta: The fried banana sandwich is a highly nutritious and delicious breakfast option. It features layers of bread spread with protein-rich peanut butter and vitamin-packed bananas, finished with a beautiful golden crust. A breakfast consisting of this fried banana sandwich paired with a glass of milk is an excellent choice to kickstart a productive workday!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients for the fried banana sandwich.
Trim the crusts off the sandwich bread.
Peel the ripe bananas and slice them into bite-sized rounds.
Step 2: Steps to make a delicious fried banana sandwich.
First, spread a layer of peanut butter onto the surface of one slice of sandwich bread. Then, place another slice on top. Repeat with the remaining bread until finished.
Next, place a pan on the stove over low heat. Add the butter, vegetable oil, and sugar to melt.
Once the butter has completely melted, add the bananas to fry. When frying the bananas, remember to flip them evenly on both sides so they develop a beautiful golden exterior.
When the bananas turn a caramel-brown color as shown in the image, turn off the heat and remove the bananas.
Arrange the banana slices one by one across the surface of the sandwich as shown.
Finally, sprinkle a little cinnamon powder over the sandwich and it is ready to enjoy.
Tips for a delicious fried banana sandwich:
Cinnamon powder is optional; you can add it or omit it based on your personal preference.
Depending on your taste, you can place the fried bananas on top of the sandwich or sandwich them between two slices; both are delicious.
The bread crust becomes much softer and tastier when spread with peanut butter, and the fried bananas are extra special with the fragrant, golden caramel-like butter and sugar coating.
If you prefer it hotter, you can pan-sear the sandwich briefly to increase the heat and crispness.
Sandwich bread: You should buy bread from a bakery to ensure it is fresh, hot, and fragrant. Grocery store bread is often generic, light, dry, lacks aroma, and can be hard or bland.
How to choose good bananas:

You should choose a bunch that has both green and yellow fruits. Bananas ripened with chemicals will ripen uniformly across the whole bunch, so this is an important factor in choosing safe fruit for your family.
Choose bananas with black spots (often called "trứng cuốc"), wrinkled skin, yellow skin with pinkish spots, and occasional black streaks on the peel.

Naturally ripened bananas will ripen evenly from the stem to the tip. If the fruit is a beautiful bright yellow but the stem and tip are still green, the seller has likely used chemicals to force them to ripen.

mon_an.mo_ta: Grilled meatball Bánh Mì is a familiar favorite for many due to its delicious and appealing flavor. The crispy, hot bread is served with fresh, flavorful meatballs, crunchy pickled vegetables, a bit of spicy chili sauce, and sweet mayonnaise. All these elements blend together to bring you an amazing taste. Check out how to make this dish in the article below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Pickled vegetable seasoning - 2 tbsp sugar; ½ tsp salt; 3 tbsp rice vinegar; 2 tsp sesame oil
Meat mixture seasoning - 2 tbsp chopped cilantro; 1 stalk chopped scallion; 3 cloves minced garlic; 1 tbsp fish sauce; 2 tsp sugar; salt and pepper; 1 tbsp cornstarch
Baguette - 1 loaf, cut into bite-sized pieces
Chili - 1 pepper, deseeded and thinly sliced
cac_buoc: How to make restaurant-quality grilled meatball Bánh Mì
Step 1: Prepare the daikon and carrots

First, peel the carrots and daikon, then wash them with water. Shred the daikon and carrots into thin strips, place them in a bowl, and add the sugar, vinegar, sesame oil, and salt. Mix well. Let it sit for about 1 hour, mixing occasionally so the vegetables soften and absorb the seasonings.
Step 2:

While waiting for the vegetable mixture, put all the meatball ingredients into a bowl and mix well until fully combined. Next, roll the mixture into bite-sized meatballs (about 20 balls). Once shaped, place the meat on a tray and refrigerate for about 20 minutes to firm up slightly. After the meatballs have chilled, place a pan on the stove, add oil to the non-stick pan, heat the oil, and fry the meatballs until all sides are evenly golden brown.
Step 3: Presentation

Once the ingredients are ready, take the bread and slice it down one side. Spread mayonnaise on one inner side of the bread, followed by the carrot and daikon salad, then top with the meatballs, a bit of chili, and cilantro, and enjoy.
Tips for a delicious meatball Bánh Mì:

For the vegetable mixture, besides daikon, you can use kohlrabi or green papaya; both are very tasty. Remember to toss the vegetables occasionally to ensure they absorb the seasoning. After 1 hour, take the vegetables out and squeeze out the excess liquid. Be careful not to squeeze them too dry, or they will be tough when eating.
When frying the meatballs, use medium heat to ensure they cook through completely, and remember to turn them frequently for even browning.
If you like cucumbers, you can add sliced cucumbers to the Bánh Mì!
Besides pork, you can apply this method to any other type of meat such as beef, chicken, shrimp, or even squid or fish...
To make the dish even better, you can put the bread in the microwave or oven to make it hot and crispy, completing the flavor profile!

Grilled meatball Bánh Mì is a familiar favorite for many due to its delicious and appealing flavor. The crispy, hot bread is served with fresh, flavorful meatballs, crunchy pickled vegetables, a bit of spicy chili sauce, and sweet mayonnaise. All these elements blend together to bring you an amazing taste. Just spend a little time in the kitchen, prepare a few ingredients with simple steps, and you will have a wonderful, nutritious meal to treat your whole family. Enjoying a hot Bánh Mì with a glass of fresh milk is a great choice for your breakfast!

mon_an.mo_ta: Strawberry jam cereal bars transform plain cereal into something softer, sweeter, and more nutritious when combined with oats and strawberry jam. With these delicious bars, you only need to pair them with a glass of fresh milk or fruit juice for a complete breakfast. These crispy, moderately sweet, and aromatic bars will surely leave you craving more!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Whisk, cookie cutters, baking pan, oven - tools
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients for the jam cereal bars.
First, preheat the oven to 375°F, which is equivalent to 190°C.
Next, place the butter in a pot over low heat and melt it. Alternatively, you can melt the butter in the microwave.
Then, mix the strawberry jam with the prepared small amount of water.
Step 2: Steps to make the jam cereal bars.
First, mix the oats and cereal together in a large bowl.
Next, pour the melted butter into the bowl of cereal and oats, then use a whisk or spatula to mix everything thoroughly.
Next, scoop half of this cereal mixture (measure out about 3 cups) into a baking pan.
Spread the mixture evenly across the pan and use a spatula to press it firmly down into the bottom. Then, pour the strawberry jam over the surface and spread it evenly.
After that, pour the remaining cereal mixture on top and continue to spread it evenly as done before. You should now have three layers: cereal-jam-cereal.
Once the layers are set, place the pan in the preheated oven at 190°C and bake for about 15-20 minutes or until the bars are cooked through.
When the bars are done or the surface has turned a light golden brown, remove them from the oven and let them cool.
Finally, use a rectangular cutter to press firmly into the bake, cutting it into long, bite-sized strips.
Then, use a knife to cut them into smaller bite-sized pieces.
Finally, arrange the bars on a plate and enjoy with a bit of butter, cream, condensed milk, or a glass of milk.
Tips for delicious jam cereal bars:
You can change the flavor according to your preference, such as using chocolate, or for those on a diet, use weight-loss specific cereals...
The cereal bars are very crispy after baking, so if you want to make a large batch to eat gradually, store them in an airtight plastic container for about 2-3 days.

Strawberry jam cereal bars transform plain cereal into something softer, sweeter, and more nutritious when combined with oats and strawberry jam. With these delicious bars, you only need to pair them with a glass of fresh milk or fruit juice for a complete breakfast. These crispy, moderately sweet, and aromatic bars will surely leave you craving more!

mon_an.mo_ta: Sausage and cheese sandwiches are an incredibly delicious and easy-to-eat dish. These bite-sized treats feature eye-catching colors, a savory filling, and rich, aromatic melted cheese that delights the palate. Take a bite of the sandwich, a sip of milk, and you will experience the full flavor of this dish—you won't be able to stop eating!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients for the fried sausage and cheese sandwiches.
Crack the eggs into a bowl and beat well.
Allow the sausages to thaw naturally.
Wash the tomatoes and slice them into thin rounds.
Step 2: Steps to make the fried sausage and cheese sandwiches.
First, place a pan on the stove and heat a little cooking oil.
Next, fry the sausages until golden brown on both sides. Remember to flip them evenly so they don't burn and develop a crispy skin.
After frying, blot the excess oil from the sausages and slice them into thin, long strips. Divide each sausage into 4 pieces.
Add 1/2 tsp salt and 1 tsp pepper to the beaten eggs and whisk vigorously again until fully combined.
Place a slice of bread on a cutting board or flat surface, then place a slice of cheese on top. Add a layer of tomato and 4 strips of sausage, then top with another slice of sandwich bread.
Repeat the assembly process with the remaining ingredients until finished.
Once assembled, use a small, sharp knife to cut the sandwiches into small equal squares, triangles, or any shape you prefer.
Place a pan on the stove (you can reuse the pan used for the sausages). If there is too much oil, pour it out, leaving only a thin layer.
Take a square sandwich piece and dip it thoroughly into the egg mixture.
Quickly place the piece into the pan to fry. Repeat quickly with the remaining pieces.
Fry until the crust is a beautiful golden brown and quite crispy, then remove from the pan. Be sure to flip them evenly to avoid burning and to ensure an attractive crust!
Finally, arrange the sandwiches on a plate and serve immediately while hot with chili sauce, ketchup, or any sauce of your choice.
Tips for perfect fried sausage and cheese sandwiches:
Since the sandwiches cook very quickly, use low heat while frying to prevent burning.
You can substitute ingredients to your liking, such as ham instead of sausage, pâté instead of butter, or Laughing Cow cheese instead of butter.
To prevent the dish from feeling too heavy, you can tuck a piece of lettuce inside after frying to help balance the richness!

mon_an.mo_ta: Spicy beef sauce features fresh beef infused with rich spices and aromatics. Served with bread or pasta, it provides a truly wonderful dining experience!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings - salt, ground pepper, ground cumin, chili powder
cac_buoc: How to make super delicious spicy beef sauce
Recipe 1
Step 1:
Peel and wash the garlic, then place it in a blender and mince finely.
Repeat with the onions: peel, wash, chop into pieces, and blend.
Next, slice the green peppers and remove all seeds. Proceed to blend the green peppers.
Step 2:

Once the vegetables are ready, add 1 tbsp of cooking oil or lard to a pot and melt over medium heat. Do not heat the fat for too long, or the pot may burn and smoke. Add the onions and about 1 tbsp of salt. Since you are using a lot of meat, season with enough salt so the sauce isn't bland. Next, add the green peppers and stir well.
Step 5:
Finally, add the garlic on top. Stir until the onions start to turn light brown and the peppers turn light green.
Step 6:
Next, add 1.3 kg of beef. Break up the meat and stir so it mixes evenly with the previously added vegetables.
Cook over medium heat until the beef turns brown.
Step 7:
Then, add the pepper and chili powder. Adjust the amount of chili powder according to your desired spice level.
Step 8:
Next, add enough water to just cover the meat to dissolve the chili powder and pepper. Add 1 tbsp of ground cumin. You can skip this if unavailable, but cumin significantly enhances the flavor.
Step 9:
Finally, season to taste and simmer over low heat for 10-15 minutes until the liquid has mostly reduced.
Once finished, remove the sauce and enjoy it with sausages and bread.
Recipe 2:
Step 1:
Remove the sauce you just cooked and add the remaining beef, stirring until cooked through.
Step 2:
Next, chop the onions and peppers into large pieces and add them to the pot.
Add the tomato sauce and stir together.
Step 3:
Add the chili powder and cumin powder. Adjust the chili amount based on your spice tolerance.
Add a little water, season to taste, and simmer until the mixture reaches a thick consistency.
Tips for a unique spicy beef sauce:
If you want a thicker sauce, mix a few tablespoons of cornstarch with water and pour it into the simmering sauce.
Before serving, reheat the sauce and mix in some cheese.
You can enjoy this spicy beef sauce with various vegetables, or stuffed into bread or sausages—all are very appealing.
Spicy beef sauce with fresh beef, deeply seasoned and aromatic, served with bread or pasta will give you a wonderful feeling when enjoying it!

mon_an.mo_ta: Tam To Fried Rice appeals to diners instantly with its eye-catching golden rice, bright orange carrots, green vegetables, and crunchy sausages. This dish has a rich flavor and is best enjoyed hot and fragrant. This delicacy is not only perfect after a long day of work but also ideal for family gatherings, helping to enhance the cozy atmosphere.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Cooking oil, garlic, vinegar - supplementary ingredients
Seasoning salt, MSG, fish sauce, soy sauce... - seasonings
cac_buoc: Prepare ingredients for Tam To Fried Rice:
Wash the carrots and let them drain.
Peel and wash the garlic, then mince it.
Steps to make Tam To Fried Rice:
Step 1:
Shred the sausage into thin strips.
Grate the carrots into small shreds. Take 1/2 of the carrots and soak them in vinegar and garlic with a bit of seasoning.
Fry the egg into a thin omelet, let it cool, and slice into thin strips.
Step 2:
Next, sauté the garlic in a pan with a little cooking oil until fragrant.
Add the rice and fry until the grains firm up, then season with soy sauce to taste. Stir constantly so the rice absorbs the seasoning evenly.
Step 3:
When the rice is nearly done, add the egg, the remaining 1/2 of the carrots, and the sausage. Stir well to combine all ingredients.
Serve the rice on a plate, accompanied by the garlic-vinegar pickled carrots. You can garnish with extra egg and sausage to make the dish more attractive.
Tips for delicious Tam To Fried Rice:
Since this is fried rice, do not use rice that is too mushy. Use slightly dry, fluffy rice so the grains separate and become more fragrant when fried.
Because the rice is fried with soy sauce, it has a unique flavor; if you are not a fan of soy sauce, you can reduce the amount.
Besides the listed ingredients, you can adjust the components to suit your preference. You can use Vietnamese ham, grilled pork, kimchi, bok choy, spinach, bean sprouts, or any other vegetable.
If you don't like eggs, you can substitute them with vegetables or any seafood you love, such as shrimp, squid, clams, octopus, or fish.
Adjust the seasonings to your taste. If you prefer a sweeter taste, you can add a tiny bit of sugar.
Additionally, you can add some shiitake mushrooms to enhance the flavor and color of this dish!

Tam To Fried Rice might sound like a strange name, but it is familiar to many families. The dish attracts diners with its vibrant golden rice, bright orange carrots, green veggies, and crunchy sausage. It is savory and best served hot. This dish is suitable for a tired workday or a warm family reunion. With just a little time in the kitchen and familiar ingredients, you can create a wonderful meal for family and friends. You will surely receive many compliments for your cooking skills and this excellent dish.

mon_an.mo_ta: The wonderful combination of Asian and European culinary styles makes this fried rice special with a unique, unmistakable flavor. Make it quickly and enjoy!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Finely chop the shrimp cakes.
You can also substitute shrimp cakes with pork or any other favorite ingredients!
Step 2:
Finely chop the scallions and garlic!
Step 3:
Next, sauté the garlic with oil over low heat until fragrant. Add the peas and stir well.
Step 4:
Add the rice and shrimp cakes, stirring together, and season to taste.
Step 5:
Pour the rice into a baking mold and top with grated cheese.
Step 6:
Finally, place the rice in the oven for 5 minutes at about 150°C until the cheese is completely melted.
The fried rice and cheese smell wonderful now.
The melted cheese combined with the soft rice creates a very unique taste!
Must be eaten while hot to be delicious!

mon_an.mo_ta: Anyone who has tried this simple, easy-to-make, yet incredibly alluring egg fried rice will surely never forget it. This dish is ideal for breakfast as it effectively uses leftover rice and transforms it into something more delicious than ever. As simple as its name, the ingredients are just rice, eggs, and basic seasonings. Let's get started.
cac_buoc: The first step is to heat the pan; you should use a non-stick pan for easier cooking. Once the pan is hot, add 2 tbsp of oil, then add the rice and stir well. Note that you should stir the rice constantly until the moisture in the rice gradually evaporates and the grains no longer stick together and the surface feels dry before adding the eggs.
Stir the rice throughout the cooking process for a better result.
Eggs cook very quickly, so as soon as you pour the eggs into the pan, stir even faster so the eggs coat all the rice grains evenly. Add a teaspoon of salt and continue to stir for a bit longer.
Finally, add the chopped scallions to the pan before turning off the heat. Stir once more before serving the rice into bowls to enjoy.
Notes for cooking:
Making good egg fried rice isn't hard, but many people still don't know how to do it correctly. These tips will help you solve common issues.
First, egg fried rice isn't just about eggs.
For perfect egg fried rice, eggs alone are not enough. The secret is a bit of chopped scallions. Scallions help reduce the eggy smell, double the aroma of the dish, and add a beautiful green accent.
Second, not just any rice will do.

Rice used for frying should generally not be too dry but also not too moist. Once cooked, the rice should be placed in a large bowl and left at room temperature for at least 6 hours to cool and dry out. A faster way is to refrigerate the bowl of rice for about 2 hours, then fluff the grains before cooking.
Third, the ratio of rice to eggs.
Usually, the amount of rice and eggs is used in a 1:1 ratio, corresponding to 1 small bowl of rice to 1 egg.
Now you have the secrets to delicious egg fried rice. Try making it for your family tomorrow morning and don't forget to share your results in the comments below.

mon_an.mo_ta: This mixed seafood rice features vibrant colors and an irresistible aroma once cooked. The rice is fluffy and infused with savory seasonings and fresh, nutritious seafood. Served with fresh vegetables, this dish is satisfying without being heavy. With just a little time in the kitchen, you can prepare this delicious and enticing seafood rice that will keep you coming back for more!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Grapeseed oil or olive oil - 3 tbsp
Fresh cilantro and lime - for garnish
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients
Wash the chicken with salt to remove any odors, then rinse thoroughly with water. Dice the chicken into bite-sized pieces.
Wash and dice the tomatoes and onions.
Clean the shrimp and mussels. To enhance the aroma, you can marinate the shrimp with a bit of ginger and rice wine to remove any fishy scent.
How to make mixed seafood rice
Step 1:
Heat the oil in a large, deep skillet over medium heat. Add the onions and sauté, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5-8 minutes.
Step 2:
Add the chopped chicken thighs and minced garlic to the skillet with the onions. Continue to cook and stir for a few minutes until the chicken is browned but not fully cooked through.
Step 3:
Once the chicken is lightly browned, add the rice, diced tomatoes, turmeric, and saffron. Stir to combine all ingredients and cook for about 2 minutes.
Step 4:
Pour in the chicken broth, salt, and bay leaf, then bring to a boil. Reduce the heat, cover the skillet, and simmer until most of the liquid has been absorbed, about 30-40 minutes.
Step 5:
Remove the lid and arrange the shrimp and mussels on top of the rice. Cover and continue cooking until the shrimp turn pink and the mussels have opened, about 15-20 minutes.
Step 6:
Gently stir the seafood rice. If necessary, continue cooking if the rice is not yet fully tender. Season with a bit more salt if needed.
Finally, serve the rice on a plate. Enjoy it with chopped cilantro, lime wedges, and hot sauce.
Tips for delicious seafood rice
Ingredients can be adjusted based on personal preference. You can swap the meat for grilled scallops, white fish, squid, or any seafood you enjoy.
Vegetable broth can be used as a substitute for chicken broth.
If you prefer not to cook the rice this way, you can use a standard rice cooker method and add a bit of butter for extra fragrance.

The finished mixed seafood rice has an eye-catching color and a wonderful aroma. The rice is loose and flavorful, packed with fresh, nutritious seafood. Served with greens, it provides a delicious and balanced meal. With just a little effort, you'll have a fantastic seafood rice dish that everyone will love!

mon_an.mo_ta: Tuna Kimchi Rice Balls – this Japanese-Korean fusion will surely delight you. The combination of tuna and kimchi blended with sticky rice creates a truly delicious snack. Check out the recipe below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Toasted black and white sesame seeds - a pinch
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Open the canned tuna.
Place the kimchi on a plate.
Step 2:
Prepare a sieve and pour the tuna through it to drain all the soaking liquid.
Step 3:
Finely chop the kimchi into very small pieces.
Step 4:
Place a pan on the stove, add the kimchi and sauté with a little oil and the kimchi sauce for 3 minutes.
Add the tuna and Gochujang, stirring constantly for 2 minutes until the mixture starts to dry out.
Step 5:
Add the green onions and sesame oil to the pan, stirring well so the oil coats the kimchi.
Step 6:
Continue to sauté until the filling is completely dry, then turn off the heat.
Step 7:
Lay the seaweed sheets on a flat surface and cut them into 8 equal small pieces.
Step 8:
Place the cooked sticky rice in a bowl and mix in a little salt for flavor.
Make sure to mix thoroughly so the salt is evenly distributed.
Step 9:
Scoop the rice into the mold, filling it only halfway, then press down firmly with a spoon.
Step 10:
Place the prepared tuna kimchi filling in the center.
Step 11:
Cover the filling with more rice and press down firmly again.
Step 12:
Put the lid on the mold and press hard to shape the rice ball.
Step 13:
Remove the lid and gently press the center of the opposite side of the mold; the rice ball will easily fall out.
Step 14:
Finally, wrap a strip of seaweed around the rice ball, and your Tuna Kimchi Rice Ball is complete.
Final requirements:
The tuna kimchi filling should have distinct flavors of both kimchi and tuna without one overpowering the other, with an appealing color.
It should have a moderate level of spiciness.
The filling should not be watery; it must be sautéed until dry.
When eaten, the kimchi, tuna, and rice should blend together for a signature taste.
The small, cute rice balls with green seaweed and toasted sesame seeds look appetizing.
The tuna kimchi filling inside is absolutely wonderful!
These little rice balls, combining savory tuna and spicy kimchi, will surely be a favorite.
You can prepare this for lunch at school or work, or for picnics and outings.

mon_an.mo_ta: This delicious beef and kimchi fried rice is sure to be a hit with the whole family.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Beef and marinade - 150g beef; 7.5g cornstarch; 2.5ml sesame oil; 5ml soy sauce; 1 pinch sugar; 5ml rice wine
Fried rice - 4 eggs; 45ml oil; 1 medium onion; 1 red bell pepper, finely chopped; 4 bowls of rice; salt; 2.5ml sesame oil; chopped green onions; chili flakes; 1 bowl of kimchi
cac_buoc: Slice the beef into small pieces.
Prepare all other ingredients.
In a bowl, mix the beef with the marinade ingredients and let it sit for 15 minutes.
Just before frying the rice, fry the eggs sunny-side up so the yolks remain runny. Keep the eggs warm until the rice is ready.
Heat 30ml of oil in a pan, sauté the beef until slightly dry, then set aside.
Add the remaining oil to the pan and sauté the onions until translucent. Add the bell peppers and sauté for one minute, then add the kimchi.
Stir everything together, then add the rice and stir-fry continuously.

Stir-fry until the rice grains are firm, then add the beef, season to taste, and add sesame oil, green onions, and a pinch of chili flakes for heat. Stir well for a moment, then transfer to bowls. Serve the rice topped with the fried eggs!

mon_an.mo_ta: Bibimbap is a famous Korean dish featuring fragrant sticky rice, tender beef, and fresh vegetables like zucchini, carrots, spinach, and soybean sprouts. Everything is brought together with a sweet and spicy sauce, dried seaweed, and a fresh egg, creating a visually stunning and irresistibly delicious meal. Let's get into the kitchen and learn how to make this wonderful dish!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Cooking oil, salt, garlic, and toasted sesame seeds - ingredients
Beef marinade - 300g beef tenderloin, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tbsp sesame oil, 1 tbsp minced garlic, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, ½ tsp pepper
Sauce - 3 tbsp Gochujang, 1 tbsp Korean chili paste, 3 tbsp water, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tbsp sesame oil, 1 tbsp vinegar, 2 tbsp toasted sesame seeds
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients for Bibimbap
