First, wash and thinly slice the beef. Marinate the beef with the listed ingredients and refrigerate for about 30 minutes to absorb the flavors. You can also marinate it at room temperature if preferred.
Trim the roots of the enoki mushrooms and wash them.
Peel, wash, and thinly slice the carrots and zucchini.
Wash the spinach and let it drain.
Soak the shiitake mushrooms in hot water until soft, trim the stems to remove any odor, rinse, and slice into bite-sized pieces.
Prepare the Bibimbap sauce. Combine all sauce ingredients in a bowl and whisk until smooth and well-blended.
Steps to make Bibimbap

Step 1: Blanch the spinach in boiling water for about 30 seconds until cooked. Remove and place in a bowl to cool. Squeeze out excess water, chop into bite-sized pieces, and marinate with a bit of salt, sesame oil, and toasted sesame seeds for 15 minutes.
Step 2: Repeat the same process (blanching and marinating with salt, sesame oil, and sesame seeds) for the soybean sprouts and enoki mushrooms.
Step 3: Sauté the carrots and shiitake mushrooms with a bit of salt until tender and fragrant.
Step 4: Sauté the garlic until fragrant, then add the zucchini and a bit of salt. Stir-fry until just tender, then remove to a bowl.
Step 5: Heat a bit of oil in a pan. Once hot, add the marinated beef and stir-fry until the meat is firm and no longer pink. Do not overcook, as it will make the beef tough.
Step 6: Prepare 4 Korean stone bowls (dolsot) and brush a thin layer of oil inside. Place a portion of rice in each bowl and press down lightly.
Step 7: Arrange all the prepared ingredients on top of the rice.
Place the stone bowls on the stove and add an egg yolk (or a fried egg) to the center. Heat until the bottom layer of rice is hot and crispy and the egg is cooked, then remove from heat.
Step 8: Finally, drizzle the prepared Bibimbap sauce over the top, add dried seaweed, mix everything together, and enjoy!
Tips for delicious Bibimbap
You can buy Gochujang, Korean chili paste, and sesame oil at supermarkets or Korean grocery stores.
If you don't have stone bowls, you can use regular bowls and crisp the rice in a pan first, or simply serve with regular rice.
If you cannot eat spicy food, omit the Korean chili paste.
You can adjust the vegetables and the amount of sauce to suit your personal taste.

mon_an.mo_ta: This stuffed chicken dish is simple, quick, convenient, and very delicious. The harmonious blend of tender chicken, colorful vegetables, aromatic herbs, and stretchy cheese provides a nutritious and tasty meal. Spend a little time in the kitchen to prepare this wonderful dish for your family and friends!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients.
Wash the chicken breasts and pat them dry. Remove any skin or bones if present.
Use a meat mallet to pound the chicken until tender and even in thickness.
Wash the tomatoes, remove the seeds, and dice them.
Wash and dice the bell pepper and red onion.
Grate the cheese.
Pick and wash the basil leaves, then chop them finely.
Step 2: Cooking steps.
First, coat the chicken breasts with pesto sauce, ensuring both sides are evenly covered. Let them marinate for about 20 minutes.
In a bowl, combine the diced tomatoes, bell peppers, grated cheese, and chopped basil. Add the olive oil, ½ tsp salt, and a pinch of black pepper. Mix well without crushing the tomatoes.
Lay a piece of chicken flat and place the vegetable filling on top. Cover with another piece of chicken and secure the edges with toothpicks.
Repeat with the remaining chicken and filling.
Finally, place the chicken in a preheated oven at 350°F (approx. 160-170°C). Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through and has a beautiful golden-brown exterior.
Once cooked, remove the chicken and slice into smaller pieces. Arrange on a plate, sprinkle with extra parmesan cheese, and serve with pasta or bread.
Tips for perfect stuffed chicken:

Since we are using chicken breast, be careful not to overbake it to prevent it from drying out. Cooking time may vary depending on the size of the chicken pieces. Avoid using pieces that are too thick, as they take longer to cook and may remain raw inside.
This stuffed chicken dish is simple yet elegant. The combination of tender chicken, vibrant vegetables, and melted cheese makes for a nutritious meal. Give it a try for your next family gathering!

mon_an.ten: Chicken in Tomato Sauce with Cheese
mon_an.mo_ta: This chicken in tomato sauce with cheese is visually stunning with its golden chicken pieces, savory sauce, and aromatic melted cheese, offering a delightful dining experience.
cac_buoc: Step 1:

Wash the tomatoes, cut them in half, remove the seeds, and squeeze out excess water. Place them in a pot with 1/3 cup of water, bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for a few minutes.
Once the tomatoes are soft, blend them until smooth and pass through a sieve to finish the sauce.
Step 2:
Peel and mince the shallot (or onion). Heat a pot with a little olive oil and sauté the shallot until fragrant.
Add the tomato sauce, a pinch of salt, and 1/2 ladle of water.
Step 3:
Cover the pot and simmer for 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash the chicken breast and cut into strips about 1 cm thick and 5 cm long.
Step 4:
Dredge the chicken pieces in flour and arrange them on a plate. Heat oil in a pan and fry the chicken over high heat for 2-3 minutes until golden.
Note: Ensure the flour coats the chicken evenly and flip the pieces constantly to prevent burning.
Step 5:
Once the chicken is golden, add salt and the tomato sauce. Cook for another 2 minutes over high heat, then turn off the stove.
Step 6:
Add the diced mozzarella and torn basil leaves, sprinkle with black pepper, and mix well. Pour the mixture into a baking dish.
Step 7:
Sprinkle grated parmesan over the top and place in a preheated oven. Bake at 240°C for 8-10 minutes or until the cheese is melted and golden brown.
Finally, remove from the oven and serve while hot.
How to choose good chicken
Free-range chicken usually has a compact, firm body and a narrow breast.

Be careful to distinguish free-range chicken from industrial layers. Free-range chicken skin is pale yellow, with darker yellow patches on the breast, wings, and back, while industrial layers are often white or entirely yellow (possibly due to dyes).
The skin should be thin and elastic. Choose meat that looks fresh, without any foul odors or antibiotic smells, and no bruising or blood clots on the skin.
To avoid water-injected chicken, press on the thighs or breast; if it feels spongy, slippery, or deformed, do not buy it.

The chicken in tomato sauce with cheese is now ready. A few tips: If you like a smoky flavor, swap mozzarella for scamorza cheese. If you prefer not to fry, skip step 4 and cook the chicken directly in the tomato sauce.

mon_an.mo_ta: Seafood noodles with vibrant vegetables, fresh seafood, and chewy noodles in a savory broth are a perfect choice for post-holiday meals. With just a little time in the kitchen, you can create this fantastic dish! Check out the recipe below.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Dried anchovies, heads and guts removed - 10 fish
Pork - 100 g, thinly sliced and marinated with salt and pepper
Green onions - cut into long segments
cac_buoc: How to make delicious spicy mixed seafood noodles
Step 1: Make the broth:
Wash the shiitake mushrooms to remove any odors and drain.
Peel the onion, wash, and cut into wedges.
Pour 10 cups of water into a pot, add the dried anchovies, onion, and shiitake mushrooms.
Boil for 20 minutes over high heat. Then, reduce the heat and simmer for another 10 minutes. Strain the broth and discard the solids.
Step 2: Make the spicy paste:
In a small bowl, mix 3 tbsp of chili powder with 2 tbsp of vegetable oil. Adjust the amount of chili to your spice preference.
Step 3: Stir-fry and assemble
First, heat a large pan with 2 tbsp of vegetable oil and sauté the garlic and ginger until lightly browned and fragrant.
Add the pork and stir-fry for about 2 minutes. For better flavor, sauté until the meat is firm and golden.
Add the vegetables: cabbage, carrots, green onions, and mushrooms. Stir-fry for 5 minutes or until cooked through.
Add the prepared chili paste and stir well.
Add the squid, shrimp, and mussels. Stir-fry over high heat for 5 minutes, then pour in 7 cups of the prepared broth and boil for 7-10 minutes.
Season with 2 tsp salt, 1 tsp fish sauce, and ½ tsp pepper.
Add the noodles to the boiling soup and cook until they expand and are tender. Check to ensure the noodles are soft yet chewy.
Finally, add 1 tsp of sesame oil, stir, and turn off the heat.
Serve the spicy and sour seafood noodles in a bowl and enjoy while hot.
Other seafood noodle variations:
Spicy Seafood Noodle Soup
Ingredients
2 packs of Korean noodles
1 bunch of enoki mushrooms
1 small purple cabbage
1 head of broccoli
1 squid, 1 sausage, 4 shrimp, 50g beef
100g kimchi, 3 cloves garlic
Seasoning: broth powder, sugar, salt, chili powder, Korean chili paste, oil
Seasoning includes broth powder, sugar, salt, chili powder, Korean chili paste, and oil.
Preparation
Cut broccoli into bite-sized pieces, soak in salt water for 10 minutes, and rinse. Clean and drain mushrooms. Shred the purple cabbage. Mince the garlic.
Cut kimchi into bite-sized pieces. Slice the sausage diagonally. Clean the shrimp and squid. Slice the beef thinly.
Step 2: Cook the broth
Heat 1 tbsp of oil in a pot and sauté the garlic until golden. Add the kimchi and stir-fry.
Add enough water, then season with broth powder, sugar, salt, and chili powder to taste. Add the kimchi juice as well. Bring to a boil and adjust the seasoning.
Step 3: Finish the spicy seafood noodles
Once the broth boils, transfer it to a clay pot. Add the shrimp, squid, meat, and noodles. When the noodles are almost cooked, add the enoki mushrooms and cabbage. Cook until everything is done.
Enjoy the spicy seafood noodles in the clay pot to keep it hot and flavorful. The noodles should be chewy and soft, and the broth rich and spicy.
Spicy Octopus Noodles
Ingredients
1 pack of Omachi 102 Spicy Seafood noodles
1 octopus
1 sausage, beef balls
Broccoli, carrots, enoki mushrooms
Seasoning: included seasoning packs and salt
1 sausage and beef balls
Broccoli, carrots, and enoki mushrooms
Seasoning includes the provided packs and salt.
Cut broccoli into bite-sized pieces.
Trim and wash enoki mushrooms.
Slice carrots into bite-sized pieces or flower shapes.
Clean the octopus by removing the internal organs, then rub with salt to remove slime and odors.
Slice the sausage and prepare the beef balls.
Cooking the noodles
Bring 500ml of water to a boil. Add the noodles, then the octopus, sausage, beef balls, carrots, and broccoli.
Add the seasoning packs from the Omachi noodles and stir. Cook for a while, then add the enoki mushrooms. Once the mushrooms are soft, turn off the heat.
The spicy seafood noodle bowl is visually appealing with a rich broth and chewy noodles. It is a complete meal with vegetables and seafood.
Tips for delicious seafood noodles
If you don't like spicy food, omit the chili powder.
The spicy broth helps reduce the fishy smell of the seafood.
You can substitute with your favorite seafood like crab, flower crab, or octopus.
Add any vegetables you like, such as water spinach or bok choy.
Use more shiitake mushrooms for a more fragrant broth.
You can use different types of noodles like instant noodles or spaghetti. If using spaghetti, boil it in the broth before stir-frying.

mon_an.mo_ta: Mixed stir-fried noodles are easy to make, easy to eat, colorful, and delicious. Check out the recipe below!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Blanch the noodles in boiling water for about 45 seconds. Stir frequently with chopsticks so they cook evenly. Drain and rinse under cold water to prevent sticking.
Step 2: Combine soy sauce, oyster sauce, sugar, sesame oil, and pepper in a bowl and set aside.

Step 3: Heat a pan over high heat, add oil and garlic and sauté. Add the peppers, fresh shiitake mushrooms, carrots, and cabbage, then stir-fry everything for one minute. Add the cooking wine and stir-fry for 15 seconds.
Step 4: Add the noodles, stirring quickly and separating them so they don't clump. Pour in the soy sauce mixture and stir-fry for 20 seconds. Add the bean sprouts, snow peas, and green onions.
Stir-fry for another minute, then serve on a plate and enjoy!

mon_an.mo_ta: A nutritious breakfast with chicken spaghetti stir-fry. It doesn't take much time to treat your family to this delicious morning meal.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 200g chicken thigh; ½ onion; 50ml chicken broth; 30ml olive oil; 15ml soy sauce; 5g sugar
Chicken marinade - 5ml cooking wine; 5ml soy sauce; 1 pinch pepper
cac_buoc: Ingredients needed:
Step 1: Peel and finely chop the onion. Cut the tomatoes into wedges.
Step 2: Slice the chicken into small pieces and marinate with the listed ingredients for 20 minutes.
Step 3: Bring a pot of water to a boil and cook the spaghetti according to the package instructions, then drain.
Step 4: Heat oil in a pan and sauté the onion. Add the chicken and stir-fry until almost cooked. Add the tomatoes and stir well.
Add the chicken broth, soy sauce, and sugar. Cook for a moment, then add the spaghetti. Toss well and serve the chicken spaghetti on a plate!

mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried glass noodles with eel is a traditional dish with a unique and enticing flavor. The smooth glass noodles combined with savory eel create a perfect pairing. This dish is rich, flavorful, and irresistible. Let's discover how to make this delicious stir-fried glass noodles with eel! Smooth noodles meet tasty eel, stir-fried with onions, garlic, and spices for a hearty meal.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Vietnamese coriander, green onions, shallots - ingredients
Salt, fish sauce, pepper, MSG, cooking oil - seasoning
cac_buoc: 1. Prepare the ingredients
To remove the slime from the eel, rub it with salt and lemon juice. Boil the eel for about 10 minutes over high heat, then remove and cut into pieces about 2 finger-joints long.
Marinate the eel in a bowl with 1 tbsp turmeric powder, 1 tbsp salt, and 1 tsp seasoning powder. Let it sit for 20 minutes.
Peel the onion, rinse, and cut into wedges.
Peel the carrot, wash, and shred into strips about a finger's length.
Pick the Vietnamese coriander leaves, wash, and drain. Trim the stems of the wood ear and shiitake mushrooms, soak in water for 20 minutes, rinse, and slice into thin strips.
Soak the glass noodles in hot water for about 10 minutes, then drain and cut into segments slightly longer than a finger.
Marinate the glass noodles with 1 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tsp seasoning powder, and 1 tsp MSG for 20 minutes.
2. Processing
1. First, place a pan on the stove and add 2 tbsp of oil. Once hot, add the carrots, onions, wood ear, and shiitake mushrooms. Stir-fry for about 3 minutes over high heat, then remove to a plate.
2. In the same pan, add 1 tbsp of oil and sauté the minced shallots until fragrant. Add the eel and stir-fry over high heat for about 5 minutes. Once cooked, remove to a plate.
3. Add the glass noodles to the pan and season with 2 tsp salt, 1 tsp seasoning powder, and 1/2 tsp MSG. Stir well so the noodles absorb the spices.
4. Add the sautéed carrots, onions, mushrooms, and eel back into the pan. Continue to stir-fry for about 3 minutes over high heat.
5. Finally, add the chopped green onions and sawtooth coriander. Toss well, adjust seasoning to taste, and turn off the heat. Serve the stir-fried glass noodles with eel on a plate.
3. Final product
The finished dish is fragrant and appealing. You will taste the sweet, rich flavor of the eel meat.
The combination of glass noodles and mushrooms creates a wonderful texture and a well-balanced flavor.
Tips for delicious stir-fried glass noodles with eel
If you prefer dry stir-fried noodles, you can cook the broth separately and serve it on the side.
When adding broth to the noodles, only use a small amount and stir quickly so the noodles absorb the liquid without becoming mushy.
For a crispy texture, you can deep-fry the eel before stir-frying as usual.
Add some bok choy or other greens if you want to balance the richness.
Enjoy the dish while it is still hot.
How to choose the right eel
Choose medium-sized eels with two distinct colors: a yellow belly and a black back. These are usually wild-caught from canals or ponds, so their meat is firmer and more fragrant.
Avoid eels that are too small as they lack flavor. Very large eels with black bellies are often farmed, and their meat can be mushy and less aromatic.
Avoid very small eels that feel soft or have an unpleasant odor to ensure a good culinary experience.

mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried glass noodles (Japchae) is a beautiful and attractive dish that entices diners at first sight with soft noodles, rich flavors from mushrooms, spinach, carrots, and bell peppers, combined with tender, savory beef. Everything blends together to create a wonderful sensation. Let's go to the kitchen and learn how to make this dish!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Shiitake mushrooms - 2, soaked for 2-3 hours and thinly sliced
Scallions, cut into 4-5 cm lengths - 2-3 stalks
cac_buoc: Step 1: Marinate the beef and mushrooms:

Wash the beef and pat dry. Place the beef and thinly sliced shiitake mushrooms in a large bowl and mix well with 1 clove of minced garlic, 1 tsp sugar, 1/4 tsp pepper, 2 tsp soy sauce, and 1 tsp sesame oil. Stir with a spoon or mix by hand so the meat absorbs the spices. Cover and refrigerate for about 30 minutes to marinate; the meat will taste much better.
Step 2: Make the egg garnish:
First, crack the egg and separate the yolk from the white. Whisk the yolk with a small pinch of salt.
Heat 1 tsp of oil in a pan. Swirl to coat the bottom, then use a paper towel to wipe away excess oil so the egg doesn't spread too thin.
Pour the egg in to fry. Make a very thin layer, wait for it to cook, then flip and cook the other side.
Finally, let the egg cool and slice it into thin strips.
Step 3: Prepare the noodles and vegetables:
First, bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the spinach and blanch for 30 seconds to 1 minute, then remove and drain. Keep the boiling water to cook the noodles.

Rinse the spinach in cold water to prevent it from getting too mushy. Squeeze by hand to remove all excess water. Cut the spinach into 3-4 sections and place in a bowl. Mix with 1 tsp soy sauce and 1 tsp sesame oil, massaging gently.
Next, add the glass noodles to the hot boiling water and let sit for about 7 minutes until soft and expanded.
Drain the noodles and cut them into shorter, bite-sized pieces. Place the noodles in a bowl, add 2 tsp sesame oil, 1 tsp soy sauce, and 1 tsp sugar; mix well to absorb the flavors.

Once the noodles are ready, heat a pan over high heat and add 2 tsp oil along with the onion, scallions, and a pinch of salt. Stir-fry for about 2 minutes until the onions are cooked, then transfer to the noodle bowl.
Heat the pan again and add 2 tsp oil. Add the straw mushrooms and a pinch of salt. Stir-fry for about 2 minutes until soft. Turn off the heat and add to the noodle bowl.
Next, stir-fry the carrots and red bell pepper, then add them to the noodle bowl.
Finally, heat the pan and add 2 tsp oil. Add the beef and shiitake mushrooms, stir-frying until the beef is cooked and mushrooms are soft. Add to the noodle bowl.
Step 4: Mix and serve:

Add the minced garlic, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp sugar, 1/2 tsp pepper, and 2 tsp sesame oil to the bowl. Mix all ingredients together. Use your hands to mix so the ingredients soften and absorb the seasonings evenly.
Finally, add the egg strips and 1 tbsp sesame seeds, mix well, plate, and enjoy.
Tips for delicious beef and vegetable stir-fried glass noodles:
When soaking the noodles, be sure to remove them as soon as they have expanded enough because glass noodles turn mushy very quickly in boiling water.
If you are concerned about too much oil, you can blanch the vegetables until cooked instead of stir-frying them.

mon_an.mo_ta: Hai Phong style liver pâté, made with simple ingredients and a straightforward method, provides a wonderful dish, especially when enjoyed with bánh mì. Just a little time in the kitchen and you'll have a fragrant pâté to treat your family and friends!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings - Seasoning powder, MSG, oyster sauce, 1 tbsp fish sauce
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients for Hai Phong style liver pâté.
Wash the pork liver thoroughly and slice into small pieces.
Soak the liver in 100ml of unsweetened milk. This step helps detoxify the liver and removes unpleasant odors, making the liver much tastier.
Tear the bánh mì into small pieces and soak in the remaining 100ml of milk.
Peel and mince the onion and garlic.
Wash the pork skin thoroughly with water; you can rub it with a little salt to clean it and remove odors.
Wash the pork fat and let it drain.
Wash the pork shoulder and chop it into small pieces.
Step 2: Steps to make Hai Phong style liver pâté.
First, place two small pots of water on the stove. When both boil, add the pork skin and pork fat separately to cook.
For the pork fat, just blanch it briefly, then remove and dice into small cubes.
For the pork skin, boil it more thoroughly until fully cooked. Once done, remove, rinse with water, and chop finely.
At this point, remove the liver from the milk and rinse with clean water.
Next, use a blender to grind the pork skin finely first.
Then, gradually add the pork, liver, milk-soaked bread, and Laughing Cow cheese to blend together.
Heat a little cooking oil in a pan.
When the oil is hot, sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. When the mixture turns slightly golden, add the liver, meat, and bread mixture to stir-fry until cooked.
While stirring, season to taste with oyster sauce, MSG, pepper, seasoning powder, and fish sauce. Adjust the amounts to your preference.
Next, add a little white wine for aroma and to remove any remaining liver scent. Sprinkle in 1 tsp of pepper and turn off the heat.
Once the mixture has cooled slightly, put it back in the blender, add 1 egg, and blend one last time until very smooth.
Finally, prepare a steaming mold, line the bottom with slices of pork fatback, and pour the pâté mixture on top.
Steam the mold for about 2-3 hours, and your Hai Phong style liver pâté is complete.
When serving, cut into small pieces and enjoy with bánh mì for the most authentic taste.
Tips for delicious Hai Phong style liver pâté:
Instead of steaming, you can also bake the pâté in a water bath, which is also very delicious.
When eating, take only what you need; do not stir the whole batch to prevent the pâté from becoming watery and spoiling.

The key to a good pâté is not just the method but the ingredients. Buy liver early in the morning to ensure it is fresh, pink, and odorless. The pork shoulder should have a bit of fat so the pâté doesn't turn out dry.
Some people skip sautéing the aromatics and mix raw onion and garlic directly with the liver. This is not recommended as it creates a pungent smell that overpowers the pâté's fragrance.

mon_an.mo_ta: The culinary culture of this region is very diverse and unique, and Lang Son roasted duck phở is a must-mention. Today, we will guide you on how to cook roasted duck phở so you can reference and cook it at home for the most authentic taste. Discover the unique cuisine of Lang Son and enjoy this rich, simple, and easy-to-make roasted duck phở.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings - cooking oil, pepper, sugar, annatto powder, dried cinnamon, shallots, star anise, ginger, seasoning powder, oyster sauce
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare ingredients

After buying pork bones, chop them into sections and wash with water. Next, soak the bones in wine or vinegar for 3-4 hours. Then, remove and rinse again to eliminate odors. Roast the onion on the stove until slightly charred, then place it in a spice bag with star anise and cinnamon to flavor the broth.

Peel and wash the mac mat leaves, lemongrass, and shallots several times under running water. Drain and mince finely. When you get the duck, pluck it clean, especially the pinfeathers, to avoid odors. Mix five-spice powder, oyster sauce, and marinade sauce, then brush it over the duck for 5-10 minutes to let the spices penetrate (remember to push spices into the duck's cavity for flavorful and sweet meat).
Step 2: How to roast the duck

To roast the duck, set the oven temperature to 250°C and wait until it reaches the set temperature. Place the duck in the oven. To prevent the duck from burning, brush an extra layer of oil on the skin. Every 20 minutes, take the duck out and baste it with more sauce to ensure it roasts evenly and develops a beautiful rosy-gold color.

If the oven is too hot, you can lower the temperature. Repeat this process 4-5 times, then test the meat with a skewer. If the juices run clear (no red), and the skin is golden and crispy, the duck is cooked.
If you don't have an electric oven and must use wood or charcoal, ensure you rotate the duck steadily and keep it at a distance from the direct flame to avoid a smoky smell.
Step 3: Prepare the broth

First, put the pork bones into a large pot with about 4 liters of water, shallots, and ginger. When the water starts to boil and bubble, add the prepared star anise and cinnamon from Step 1. Lower the heat to a simmer to prevent overflowing and skim the foam off the surface several times to clarify the broth.

Simmer the broth for about 2 hours to extract the sweetness from the bones. Then, use a ladle or strainer to remove all bones, onions, and ginger. What remains is a flavorful broth with aromatic fat, ready to be used with the noodles, herbs, and roasted duck. This completes the roasted duck phở.
Step 4: Final product

Once finished, divide the phở noodles into serving portions and place them in bowls. Blanch the noodles first to ensure they are soft and chewy. Slice the roasted duck into bite-sized pieces and arrange them on top of the noodles as a beautiful garnish. Next, add bean sprouts and side herbs, then pour in the broth (remember to prepare lemon wedges, satay, and chili to add when eating to enhance the flavor).
Notes for making delicious roasted duck phở:
Choose fresh ingredients: Ensure you pick a fresh duck with smooth skin and no odor. For other components like noodles, herbs, and spices, choose fresh, high-quality types.
Good marination: Before roasting, marinate the duck with five-spice powder, oyster sauce, and marinade so the meat is deeply flavored.
Roast evenly: When roasting, ensure heat is distributed evenly and rotate frequently for a uniform golden color and crispy skin. Pay attention to brushing oil on the skin to prevent burning.
Prepare a fragrant broth: Besides using pork bones, you can add aromatics like shallots, star anise, cinnamon, and ginger to increase the flavor and aroma of the broth.

mon_an.mo_ta: This fragrant, hot tuna pizza is absolutely delicious with a crispy crust, mouth-filling melted cheese, fresh tuna, and colorful vegetables. Enjoying this pizza with a glass of Pepsi or Coca-Cola is a wonderful choice.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Green, red, yellow bell peppers - 1/2 each
cac_buoc: How to make Tuna Pizza for 1-2 people:
Step 1: Prepare ingredients
Wash the bell peppers, remove the cores, and slice into thin rings.
Grate the cheese.
Dissolve the baking powder in a little warm water.
Wash the asparagus, slice diagonally into 2-3 cm pieces, and blanch in boiling water.
Step 2: Steps to make Tuna Pizza
First, mix the flour, sugar, and salt in a bowl. Add the dissolved baking powder and water as needed, then knead until the dough is smooth, elastic, and no longer sticks to your hands.
Place the dough in a bowl and cover tightly with plastic wrap.
Place the bowl in the oven at 350°C for about 40 minutes to begin the fermentation process.
Take the dough out and let it rest for 20 minutes; you will see it has doubled in size.

Take the dough out and use a rolling pin to roll it out to a medium thickness. Place the dough on a rectangular or round tray as desired, then use a fork to prick the center so the crust doesn't puff up while baking.
Spread a layer of tomato sauce over the crust (amount to your liking), then sprinkle a layer of grated cheese, followed by a layer of tuna.
Add a layer of bell peppers and asparagus. Finally, sprinkle another layer of cheese. The amount of cheese depends on your preference.
Place the pizza in a preheated oven. Bake at 205°C for about 15 minutes or until the crust is cooked.
Tips for a delicious Tuna Pizza:
Remember to preheat the oven; baking times may vary depending on the oven type, so check frequently to prevent burning.
You can substitute tuna with salmon, pork, or beef according to your preference.
To remove the pungency of bell peppers, soak them in cold water with a little salt, then soak in vinegar; the smell will disappear, and the peppers will be very crunchy and delicious.
When kneading the dough, knead thoroughly so the ingredients blend well.

This fragrant, hot tuna pizza with its crispy crust, rich cheese, and fresh tuna will surely delight you. Pairing it with a soda is a great choice. This pizza isn't heavy and tastes wonderful. With just a little time and familiar ingredients, you can treat your family and friends to a fantastic meal. You'll receive plenty of compliments!

mon_an.mo_ta: With familiar ingredients and a creative twist in preparation, we've created delicious pizza cones with a crispy crust, fresh filling, and rich, creamy cheese. A touch of tangy and spicy ketchup and chili sauce makes these cones absolutely wonderful. Take some time to make this delicious dish. Check out our pizza cone recipe below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Sausage, chopped vegetables, etc. - pizza toppings
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, preheat the oven to 200°C.
If you don't have metal cone molds, wrap paper cups completely in aluminum foil, both inside and out.
Step 2:
To make the cone crust, place the kneaded pizza dough on a clean flat surface.
Knead a few more times until elastic, then roll it out to a thickness of about 3mm.
Step 3:
Next, cut the dough into squares about 5 inches (12-13 cm) for medium-sized cups. If using molds of different sizes, cut the dough so that it fits the mold when rolled.
Step 4:
Place the cone mold at one corner of the square. Slowly roll it toward the opposite corner.
Press the edges of the dough firmly onto the cone so the mold is completely covered.
Step 5:
Once prepared, turn the cones upside down and place them on a baking tray.
Bake the cone crusts for about 8-10 minutes or until they turn golden brown.
Step 6:
When the crusts are done, remove the tray from the oven. Once the cones are cool enough to handle, remove the molds from the crusts.
Step 7:
Place the baked cones into the fixed stand.
Step 8:
Use a spoon to pour sauce into the cones, filling them no more than halfway. You can use tomato sauce, meat sauce, or marinara according to your preference.
Step 9:
Next, add some ham, sausage, green vegetables, and diced onions on top of the sauce.
Step 10:
Fill the remaining space in the cones with various cheeses: cheddar, mozzarella, queso, etc.
Step 11:
Once the ingredients are ready, top the cones with chopped peppers, mushrooms, or olives.
Step 12:
Keep the cones in the stand and bake for about 5-10 minutes or until the cheese is completely melted.
Finally, when the pizza is done, remove from the oven and enjoy with ketchup and chili sauce.
Tips for delicious pizza cones:

When making the pizza base, knead the dough thoroughly so it is soft; this ensures the crust is crispy and fragrant when baked. Also, ensure the dough has enough resting time. If you don't have time to make the base, you can conveniently buy it at the supermarket.
Besides the suggested toppings, you can add any ingredients you like or make different types such as seafood pizza, beef pizza, bacon pizza, etc.
With familiar ingredients and a creative twist, we have created delicious pizza cones with crispy crusts, fresh fillings, and rich cheese. A bit of spice from chili sauce will make it even better.

mon_an.mo_ta: Fruit salad is a popular choice for many, especially those looking to lose weight or maintain a fit physique. It is not only easy to eat but also provides essential nutrients and a rich supply of vitamins. With just a little time, you can have a delicious and nutritious fruit salad ready! This article will guide you through a simple yet healthy fruit salad recipe. Let's take a look at the instructions!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients for the fruit salad.

Wash the lettuce thoroughly, remove the stems and any wilted or damaged leaves, then soak in salt water for about 5 minutes and drain. Note: do not soak for too long as it will make the leaves soggy and less appetizing.
Soak the tomatoes and orange in salt water for about 5 minutes to clean.
Cut the ripe mango in half, then use a small knife to score the flesh into squares. Finally, peel back the skin to remove the mango cubes without crushing them.
Do the same for the dragon fruit. Cut in half and score the flesh into squares.
Peel the kiwis and dice them into bite-sized pieces.
After washing the cherry tomatoes, you can either halve them or dice them.
Wipe the orange dry and zest the peel into small strips. Then, cut the orange in half. Take one half, peel off any remaining skin, and cut into squares or bite-sized pieces.
Squeeze the juice from the remaining half and strain out the seeds.
Step 2: Steps to make the fruit salad.
First, take a clean bowl and add all the fruits and orange zest. Then, add 2-3 tsp of sugar, or adjust the amount to your preference.
Next, pour the orange juice into the salad bowl. Mix the fruit gently to avoid crushing it.
Let the fruit marinate for about 5-10 minutes to absorb the sugar and orange juice.
Prepare a large bowl or plate and garnish the edges with lettuce leaves. Place the fruit mixture in the center. You can further decorate it to your liking.
Finally, enjoy this simple and delicious fruit salad.
Notes for a delicious fruit salad:
You can change the ingredients according to your preference. Feel free to add any fruit you like! This dish is easy to make but packed with nutrients:
Tomatoes help clear heat, detoxify, quench thirst, and aid digestion. They also help with glowing skin, shiny hair, a slim waist, and a healthy heart.
Oranges help boost physical strength and vision, support digestion, prevent cancer and flu, reduce the risk of cardiovascular diseases, and rejuvenate the skin.
Kiwis help with weight loss, detoxify the body, protect DNA, and are suitable for diabetic patients.
Mangoes help with glowing skin, lower cholesterol, prevent cancer, and are a massive source of nutrition.
Each dragon fruit contains about 60 calories, helps treat acne, protects hair, is good for the eyes, and prevents aging.

mon_an.ten: Lotus Leaf-Wrapped Steamed Sticky Rice with Chicken
mon_an.mo_ta: Lotus leaf-wrapped steamed sticky rice features delicious, rich chicken and rice infused with the sweetness of the meat and the earthiness of shiitake mushrooms. Served with a bit of fried shallots, it offers a wonderful culinary experience.
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients:
Wash the chicken thighs and cut them into small squares of about 1-2 cm.
Peel and wash the ginger. Clean the green onions, remove the roots and wilted leaves, then mince.
Wash the shiitake mushrooms, soak until soft, rinse again, drain, and finely chop.
Soak the lotus leaves in warm water for about 1 hour, then rinse and drain. Cut the leaves in half. If they are very large, you can cut them into 3 or 4 pieces.
Soak the glutinous rice in water for 2 hours, then drain.
Steps to make the dish:
Step 1: First, mix the chicken with the prepared sauce ingredients and place in the refrigerator to marinate.
Step 2: Mix the rice thoroughly with soy sauce. If you prefer not to use soy sauce, just mix the rice with a little salt to prevent it from being bland.
Step 3: Heat oil in a pan and sauté the mushrooms until golden and soft.
Step 4: Heat the pan again, add oil, and stir-fry the chicken. Add the mushrooms, green onions, and salt, stirring for a few minutes until cooked.
Step 5: Once cooked, mix the stir-fried mixture with the rice and stir well.
Spread out a lotus leaf, brush with oil, and place an adequate amount of the rice and meat mixture in the center. Fold the leaf into a rectangular shape and tie securely with string.
Step 6: Once the rice and chicken are prepared, steam the parcels for about 90 minutes or until cooked, then turn off the heat.
When the rice is cooked, remove and enjoy.
See also: Instructions for making salt-steamed chicken.
Notes for delicious results:
You should sauté the mushrooms in two separate batches so they don't release too much water and make the rice soggy.
The rice can be prepared the night before and kept in the freezer. In the morning, steam for about 30 minutes before eating to restore its heat and fragrance.
You can serve the sticky rice with fried shallots or scallion oil to enhance the flavor.
How to choose good chicken:
A good chicken will have a compact, firm body and a small breast.
The skin should be naturally golden, with darker yellow areas on the wings, breast, and back. The skin should not be bruised, pale, or have black spots or nodules.
If the skin is tough and uniformly golden but the fat is white, the chicken may have been treated with yellow dye.
The meat should be firm, fresh, and free of foul odors or antibiotic smells.

Press your finger into the body, breast, or thigh to check; if the meat is firm, it is good. if it is flabby, slippery, deformed, or pitted with water retention, it may have been injected with water or borax; absolutely do not buy such chicken to avoid health risks.

Lotus leaf-wrapped steamed sticky rice with delicious, rich chicken and rice infused with the sweetness of the meat and the earthiness of shiitake mushrooms, served with fried shallots, will give you a wonderful feeling when enjoying it.

mon_an.ten: Xôi vò with Mung Beans for the Full Moon Day
mon_an.mo_ta: According to Vietnamese customs, on the full moon or the first day of every lunar month, families often offer sticky rice to their ancestors. Today, we will guide you on how to cook Xôi vò for these occasions. It can also be prepared for breakfast, served savory with Vietnamese ham, sausages, and meat, or sweet with sweet soup or ice cream. With Xôi vò, everyone will surely enjoy the rich taste of mung beans and the chewy, fragrant texture of the glutinous rice. Detailed instructions on how to cook delicious mung bean Xôi vò for the full moon. A traditional menu with simple steps and easy-to-find ingredients. Enjoy the traditional flavor and prepare a special meal for the full moon day.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Soak the glutinous rice and mung beans for 8-12 hours; you can soak them overnight to let them expand. The next morning, wash them clean and drain. Mix the rice with a little salt and let it sit for 2-3 hours until completely dry (Note: this drying step is very important to ensure the rice doesn't get mushy when steamed).

Step 2: Mix the mung beans with a little salt and steam until cooked (about 15–20 minutes), then mash them finely or use a blender. If you don't have special tools, you can use a spoon to rub them through a sieve until smooth.
Step 3: Prepare the steamer and turn on the heat. Meanwhile, add 1/3 of the mashed mung beans to the rice and mix well.

Step 4: Turn off the heat to let it cool slightly, then pour the rice out into a basket for 1–2 minutes. At this point, the rice has started to soften but is not wet. Add another 1/3 of the mashed mung beans, mix well, and steam again for 5–10 minutes. Note: if the rice grains stick together, use your hands to mix in the mung beans to separate them.

Step 5: Finally, pour the twice-steamed rice into a basket and mix in the remaining mashed mung beans. At this stage, if you want it sweet, season with sugar to taste; if you want it savory, add a little more salt.
How to choose good ingredients:
1. How to choose good mung beans:
Choose peeled mung beans to achieve a smooth texture when cooked.
Select medium-sized, uniform beans; avoid overly large ones. When squeezed, the beans should feel firm and not easily crumble.
Avoid beans with strange colors, signs of mold or pests, or an unusual smell.
If buying pre-packaged beans, check the packaging and expiration date to ensure freshness.
2. How to choose glutinous rice for sticky rice:
Choose grains that are opaque white, plump, and have a light fragrance.
You can choose 'nếp cái hoa vàng' rice, as this variety is very chewy and has a special aroma.
Good glutinous rice will have a slightly sweet taste when you sample a raw grain.
Buy rice from reputable sources. Avoid rice that has turned pale yellow or has an overpowering scent, as it may have been treated with chemicals.

mon_an.ten: Braised Beef Noodle Soup for the Family
mon_an.mo_ta: With a sweet and fragrant broth, served with tender beef and blanched bok choy, this braised beef noodle soup is more delicious than ever in this chilly weather! Let's get into the kitchen to make this hot and tasty dish for the whole family to slurp up!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
After buying the beef, wash it and cut it into small bite-sized squares (like chess pieces).
Step 2:
Prepare a pot and add the beef, half an onion, 2 slices of ginger, and a bit of white wine. Simmer over low heat for 15 minutes.
Note: You don't need to cover the pot while simmering the beef; leave it open to let the alcohol evaporate.
Once the meat is cooked, remove it to a basket and rinse with cold water to clean the meat.
Step 3:
Peel the radish, wash it, and cut it into small bite-sized squares (as shown in the picture).
Step 4:
Wash and dice the tomato; finely chop the remaining half onion; slice the ginger; peel and slice the garlic.
Place a pan on the stove, add oil, and heat until very hot. Sauté the ginger and garlic until fragrant. Then add the soy sauce and mirin, stirring with a wooden spoon.
When the sauce is hot, add the beef and stir well to coat with flavor.
Step 5:
After stirring the beef for 2 minutes, add the diced tomatoes and continue to stir until the tomatoes are soft.
Step 6:

Next, add the star anise and onion, then pour in enough water to just cover the meat. Bring to a boil over high heat, then turn down to low heat and simmer for 40-50 minutes until the beef is tender and not tough.
Step 7:
Add the white radish and simmer for another 20 minutes until the radish is soft and the beef is very tender.
Step 8:
After 20 minutes, check if the meat and radish are tender, then turn off the heat.
Next, blanch the noodles and bok choy in boiling water until cooked, then place them in a large bowl.
Step 9:
Ladle the beef broth, beef, and radish over the noodles until covered.
Now, just sprinkle some fresh cilantro and black pepper on top to enhance the aroma and enjoy while it's still hot!
And there you have it, a steaming bowl of braised beef noodle soup is ready!
Finished product requirements:
The broth should be sweet and fragrant.
The beef should be tender, not too tough nor too mushy, and well-seasoned.
The radish should be soft and not crunchy.
The colors should be appealing, the flavor delicious and attractive, and the dish served hot—perfect for chilly days.
You can replace regular noodles with egg noodles, spaghetti, or even rice vermicelli to make the dish more diverse!
On a cold day, having a bowl of braised beef noodles to slurp on is truly wonderful!

mon_an.ten: Spicy and Sweet Kimchi Tofu Soup
mon_an.mo_ta: When the weather is cool, eating kimchi tofu soup is just perfect. The spicy, fragrant taste of kimchi and tofu combined with other ingredients creates a wonderful dish!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Meat - 180g pork belly (skinless), cut into bite-sized pieces; 1 tbsp rice wine or mirin; 3 pinches black pepper

Kimchi and other ingredients - ¾ cup kimchi (aged 2-3 weeks), cut into bite-sized pieces; 30g onion, thinly sliced; 5g green onion, chopped; 50g shiitake mushrooms, thinly sliced; 150g tofu, cut into 1cm thick slices; 1 cup water
Broth seasonings - 1 tbsp Korean chili flakes (coarse); 1 tbsp soy sauce; 1 tsp Korean chili powder; 3 pinches ground pepper
cac_buoc: Ingredients you need to prepare:
Note that the ingredients will increase if cooking for more people!
Step 1: Marinate the pork belly with rice wine and black pepper for 15 minutes.
Step 2: Place the kimchi in a pan and cook until softened.
Step 3: Place the meat at the bottom of the pot. Then layer the kimchi, onion, mushrooms, tofu, water, and broth seasonings in the pot (except for the green onions).
Bring the pot to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to a simmer. Cook until the meat is done. When the meat is cooked, add the green onions and turn off the heat.
Kimchi tofu soup is delicious when eaten with white rice! You can also turn this kimchi soup into a very attractive hotpot.

mon_an.ten: Pork Rib and Carrot Congee for Baby Weaning
mon_an.mo_ta: When a baby enters the weaning stage, pork rib and carrot congee is an ideal dish to include in their menu. The congee not only helps the baby receive necessary nutrients but also builds a foundation for healthy eating habits. With just a few simple steps, you can prepare this congee at home. Let's explore the recipe for pork rib and carrot congee for babies! This congee provides nutrients and sets the stage for healthy habits. Simple and easy to make at home.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the pork ribs
Wash the pork ribs with clean water to remove dirt.
Blanch the ribs in boiling water. Once the water boils, lower the heat and boil for about 5 minutes.
Remove the pot and discard the first boiling water, then rinse the ribs thoroughly with cold water to remove odors. You should wash the ribs twice to ensure the meat is delicious and fragrant.
Step 2: Sauté the pork ribs
Place the cleaned ribs in a pot and sauté with a little fish sauce so the meat absorbs the seasoning.
Step 3: Cook the congee
Wash the rice and soak it in water for at least 2 hours, then rinse again to remove impurities.
In a large pot, add the sautéed ribs and soaked rice, then add more water than the usual amount for cooking congee. Place on the stove and simmer.
Cook the congee for longer than usual to create a broth from the ribs, making the congee sweeter and more fragrant.
Step 4: Prepare the carrot
Wash and peel the carrot. Then, cut the carrot into small pieces and boil until soft.
Use a spoon to mash or finely mince the boiled carrot.
Step 5: Mince the rib meat
Remove the meat from the simmered ribs and mince it into small pieces.
Step 6: Combine congee and meat
Bring the congee pot back to a boil and add the minced rib meat and minced carrot, stirring well.
Adjust the seasoning to suit the baby's taste and safety standards.
Once the congee has thickened and the meat is cooked through, remove the pot from the heat.
Step 7: Serve the baby
Wait for the congee to cool slightly to avoid burning the baby.
Ladle the congee into a bowl and let it cool completely.
Let the baby enjoy the delicious pork rib and carrot congee.

Note: Ensure you wash your hands and cooking utensils thoroughly before preparing and cooking. Check the temperature of the congee before feeding the baby to ensure safety. If there are any unusual signs after the baby eats the congee, consult a doctor.

mon_an.mo_ta: Xôi cốm is chewy and fragrant with a gentle, beautiful green color. This dish is not at all unfamiliar but deeply rooted in the homeland; it will touch your heart the moment you taste it. Let's see how to make it in the article below! We hope this article helps you make delicious, fragrant xôi cốm.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Soak the mung beans in hot water for 2 hours, then rinse clean and drain. Mix with 1/3 tsp of salt in a small bowl. If using unpeeled mung beans, you should soak them for 3 hours beforehand and then remove the skins.
Step 2: Place the mung beans in a steamer and steam until cooked. If you don't have a steamer, you can put them in a rice cooker and cook like rice. Do not use too much water, as it will boil over.
When the beans are cooked, place them in a mortar and pestle to mash finely or crush with a spoon.
Step 3: Mix the cốm with 2 tbsp of cooking oil, then place in the steamer. Steam over low heat for 5-7 minutes until the cốm is cooked.
Step 4: Take the cooked cốm and mix it with 2 tbsp of white sugar, then steam again for 5 minutes.
Step 5: Grate the coconut into strips and marinate with the remaining sugar for 20 minutes.

Add a little oil to a pan over low heat and sauté the sugar-marinated coconut until it shrinks and firms up. You can tell it's ready when the sugar thickens and coats each coconut strip; however, do not use too much heat or the coconut will burn and turn yellow, which won't look as nice.
Step 6: Pour the sticky rice onto a wide tray and mix the xôi cốm thoroughly with the coconut and mashed mung beans.
For an attractive presentation, you can spread a lotus leaf or banana leaf at the bottom of a plate or small tray before pouring the xôi cốm on top.
Good luck to you and your family with this delicious and attractive xôi cốm recipe!

mon_an.ten: Chicken and Lotus Seed Sticky Rice for a Nutritious Breakfast
mon_an.mo_ta: With simple ingredients and an extremely easy method, you can get into the kitchen right away to show off your skills with this nutritious and delicious chicken and lotus seed sticky rice for the whole family to enjoy for breakfast!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings - 1g salt; 30g seasoning powder; 5g chili powder; 5ml oyster sauce; 10ml honey; 10ml cooking oil.
cac_buoc: The ingredients you need to prepare for a delicious and nutritious chicken and lotus seed sticky rice!
Step 1: First, chop the chicken into small pieces and wash them clean.

Use a knife to score a few lines on the surface of the meat pieces, then marinate the meat with 15g of seasoning powder, 10ml of honey, and 5g of chili powder. When the meat is scored, the ingredients will penetrate better, making the meat much more flavorful.
Step 2: Next, place a pan on the stove, add 10ml of oil, and turn on medium heat.
Place all the marinated chicken in the pan and pan-sear for about 20 minutes. Remember to turn the sides so the chicken cooks evenly and has an attractive color!

Step 3: While waiting for the chicken to cook, crush, peel, and mince 1 clove of garlic and 1 shallot. Make the marinating sauce by mixing 500ml of coconut water with 30ml of soy sauce, 15g of seasoning powder, 5ml of oyster sauce, and 10ml of oil. Stir well to combine the seasonings.
Step 4: When you see the chicken has turned golden, gently pour the sauce into the pan and continue cooking until the sauce thickens.
Step 5: Now for the sticky rice!
First, wash the lotus seeds and rinse the glutinous rice. Put the rice, lotus seeds, 1g of salt, and 300ml of coconut water (just enough to cover the rice) into a pot and cook until done.
Step 6: Peel and thinly slice 2 shallots. Place a pan on the stove, turn to high heat, and when the oil is hot, add the shallots and fry until golden, then turn off the heat.
Step 7: Next, boil the quail eggs and peel them!

Step 8: Slice the chả lụa thinly. Serve the lotus seed sticky rice with the chicken, chả lụa, and quail eggs. Sprinkle some fried shallots and cilantro on top for aroma, and your chicken and lotus seed sticky rice is finished!
Note:
You can shred the chicken into small pieces for easier eating.
Since glutinous rice absorbs a lot of water, only add enough coconut water to just cover the surface; avoid adding too much, or the rice will become mushy and the dish won't be as good!
It's that simple to have a delicious, nutritious breakfast for the whole family!

mon_an.ten: Pandan Sticky Rice in a Rice Cooker
mon_an.mo_ta: Pandan sticky rice is a delicious dish where the aroma of glutinous rice and pandan leaves blend to create a signature scent. Below is a recipe for making perfect pandan sticky rice using a rice cooker. Please take a look!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the pandan leaves, cut them into small pieces, and place them in a blender. Blend until smooth. Strain to get the pandan juice.
Step 2: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear. Drain. Pour the rice, pandan juice, and water into the rice cooker. Stir well. Then set the rice cooker to 'Cook'.
Cook until the switch flips to the 'Warm' button. Open the pot, stir the rice well, then close the lid and press 'Cook' again for another 10-15 minutes so the rice cooks evenly.
Step 3: Toast the sesame seeds until golden. Place the seeds in a bag and crush them slightly to release more aroma.
Step 4: Mix the sugar with the sesame seeds and salt; set aside.
Serve the pandan sticky rice on a plate, top with shredded coconut, sprinkle with the sesame mixture, and enjoy!

mon_an.mo_ta: Mì Quảng is a specialty dish from the Central region of Vietnam, specifically Quang Nam and Da Nang. However, over time and depending on the region, this dish has been adapted in many different ways. Let's learn how to make this wonderful noodle dish!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, seasoning powder, pepper, sugar, fish sauce, oyster sauce - seasonings
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the onion and slice into small wedges. Separate the chicken breast meat from the bones. Wash the chicken bones and pork bones. Place a pot on the stove, add both types of bones, and pour in enough water to just cover them. Turn on high heat and boil for 5 minutes to remove impurities. Discard that water. Next, add about 600ml of fresh water along with the onion, 3g of salt, and 15g of seasoning powder. Simmer over low heat for 20 minutes.

Step 2: Crush, peel, and mince the garlic and shallot. Wash the chicken meat and pork belly, then cut into bite-sized pieces. Marinate the chicken and pork with the minced garlic and shallot, 40ml of fish sauce, 10g of turmeric powder, 5g of chili powder, 20g of seasoning powder, 3g of pepper, 15g of sugar, and 10ml of oyster sauce for about 20 minutes.
Step 3: Remove the heads and peel the shrimp, then marinate with 5g of seasoning powder and 2g of pepper.

Step 4: Boil the egg and peel it. Crush, peel, and mince 1 clove of garlic. Place a pan on the stove, add 40ml of annatto oil and the minced garlic, and turn on medium heat. When the garlic is fragrant, add the marinated meat mixture and stir-fry for about 3 minutes.
Step 5: Ladle the broth into the pan until it just covers the meat. Add the egg and shrimp, continue cooking for another 20 minutes, then turn off the heat.

Step 6: Place the Mì Quảng noodles in a bowl. Scoop out the meat, shrimp, and egg and place them on top. Pour a little of the braising liquid and broth over the noodles until they are partially submerged. Add some crushed toasted rice cracker, peanuts, green onions, and various fresh herbs to eat along with it as desired.

mon_an.ten: Mixed Noodles - A refreshing dish for hot days
mon_an.mo_ta: Spicy mixed noodles with a unique sauce, delicious flavor, and attractive colors—perfect for days when you are tired of rice! Let's head to the kitchen and learn how to make this dish!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Honey, chili powder, green onions, rice vinegar, salt, pepper, sesame oil - seasonings
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the bell pepper, cucumber, onion, and green onions, then cut them into thin, bite-sized pieces.
Step 2: Sauté the onion until fragrant, then add the bell pepper and stir-fry quickly.
Step 3: Boil the noodles until cooked, then rinse briefly with cold water to keep them chewy and drain well.
Step 4: Slice the chicken into small pieces and stir-fry with sesame oil and pepper until cooked. Season to taste.
Step 5: To make the sauce, combine the peanut butter, soy sauce, warm water, toasted sesame seeds, ginger, garlic, honey, chili powder, rice vinegar, sesame oil, pepper, and salt. Mix well.
Step 6: Finally, toss the noodles with the cucumber, bell pepper, chicken, and sauce until well-coated, then enjoy!

mon_an.ten: Stir-fried glass noodles with beef for a delicious breakfast
mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried glass noodles with beef is an easy and familiar dish for everyone. This wonderful meal not only provides nutrients from the beef but also offers the crunchy and chewy texture of the glass noodles. It is truly a great dish for an energy-packed breakfast.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Carrots, fresh chili, cucumber, green onions - for serving
cac_buoc: Step 1: Soak the glass noodles in warm water until soft, then remove and drain. Remove any tendons or silver skin from the beef, wash, slice thinly, and marinate with a little salt.

Step 2: Soak the wood ear mushrooms until expanded, remove the stems, and slice into bite-sized pieces. Wash the carrots, cucumber, and fresh chili, then julienne them. Peel and slice the dry shallots.

Step 3: Heat a tablespoon of oil in a pan; when the oil is very hot, add the beef and stir-fry quickly. Once the beef is cooked, add the carrots, chili, cucumber, and wood ear mushrooms. Toss together and remove to a plate. Add another tablespoon of oil, sauté the shallots until fragrant, then add the glass noodles to stir-fry. Season to taste and stir-fry until the noodles are cooked, then mix the beef and vegetables back in. Serve hot.
Wishing everyone a delicious meal!

mon_an.ten: Spaghetti Bolognese to energize your day
mon_an.mo_ta: Italian cuisine in Vietnam is best known for spaghetti. This is a simple, easy-to-make dish with flavorful beef and chewy, firm noodles. A nutritious meal to boost your energy.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Blanch the tomatoes in boiling water, peel, remove seeds, and dice. Peel and mince the onion and garlic.

Step 2: Sauté the onion and garlic with butter or olive oil until fragrant, then add the diced tomatoes and cook thoroughly. Add the canned tomato sauce, cover, and simmer over low heat for 20–30 minutes.

If you don't have canned sauce, increase the amount of fresh tomatoes, add sugar, salt, and pepper to the mixture, and simmer until the tomatoes are soft and break down into a thick sauce. Note: You must choose very ripe tomatoes to make sauce at home.
Step 3: Once the tomato sauce has become a thick, cohesive mixture, sprinkle in the oregano. If you don't have oregano, you can skip this step, but the dish will be less aromatic.

Step 4: Add the ground beef to the sauce, adding seasoning or salt to taste. For a richer flavor, add about 2 tablespoons of whipping cream. Add a bit of pepper for aroma. Simmer thoroughly until the beef is cooked, then turn off the heat.

Step 5: Bring a pot of water to a boil and cook the spaghetti. Read the instructions on the package carefully as different types of pasta have different cooking times. On average, it takes about 8–12 minutes to reach al dente.
Note: Spaghetti is a type of pasta, so you can choose any variety labeled as such.
Step 6: Once the pasta is cooked, drain it in a colander and toss with olive oil (or regular cooking oil) to prevent the strands from sticking together.
Step 7: Depending on your preference, you can either toss the sauce with the noodles or pour the sauce over the noodles. You now have a delicious Italian meal to treat your family.

mon_an.mo_ta: Phở gà mixed with tamarind sauce features eye-catching colors and delicious flavors. The chicken is well-seasoned, and the sweet and sour dressing provides an irresistible dining experience.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fresh herbs - Lettuce, Vietnamese balm, culantro, ginger, a few star anise pods.
Seasonings - Sate, soy sauce, cooking oil, sugar, fish sauce, salt, seasoning powder
cac_buoc: HOW TO MAKE PHỞ GÀ WITH TAMARIND SAUCE

Step 1: Rub the chicken with salt, clean it, and rinse with water to remove any odors. Boil the chicken in water with a little fish sauce and salt for flavor. Add a few pieces of smashed ginger and star anise to the pot to make the broth fragrant. Boil for about 30 minutes until cooked, remove and let cool, then debone and slice into bite-sized pieces.
Step 2: Roast the peanuts until golden, remove skins, and crush lightly.
Step 3: Peel, wash, and thinly slice the shallots, then fry until golden and crispy.
Step 4: Pick and clean the lettuce, herbs, onion, and culantro. Wash and soak in diluted salt water for 15 minutes, then drain.
Wash the bean sprouts and drain.
Step 5: Shred the lettuce and finely chop the culantro. Blanch the bean sprouts and onion in boiling water until just cooked. Arrange all prepared ingredients on separate plates.
Step 6: Tamarind sauce:
Soak the tamarind in a bowl of hot water for 5 minutes to dissolve, then strain through a sieve to get the juice.

Mince the garlic and shallots. Sauté them in a pan with oil until fragrant, then add the tamarind juice. Season with 3 tbsp sugar, 2 tbsp fish sauce, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp sate, and 1 tsp seasoning powder. Stir until the sauce boils and thickens, then pour into a small bowl. When ready to eat, blanch the phở noodles in boiling water with a little salt and place into bowls.

Arrange the lettuce, Vietnamese balm, blanched sprouts, and onion. Place the chicken pieces on top, drizzle with tamarind sauce, and garnish with roasted peanuts, fried shallots, and chopped culantro.
Mix all ingredients in the bowl well so the sauce coats everything, then enjoy.
Notes for a delicious Phở gà with tamarind sauce:
How to choose good chicken (for pre-processed chicken):
A good chicken will have a compact, firm body and a small breast.
The skin should be naturally yellow, with darker yellow areas on the wings, breast, and back. The skin should not be bruised, pale, or have black spots or nodules.
If the skin is tough and perfectly yellow all over while the fat is white, the chicken may have been treated with dye.
The meat should be firm, fresh, and free of foul odors or antibiotic smells.

Press your finger into the body, breast, or thigh; if the meat is firm, it is good. If it is flabby, slippery, deformed, or pitted (edematous), it may have been injected with water or borax; avoid buying such chicken for health reasons.
With familiar ingredients and simple steps, you can create a delicious meal for your family and friends.

mon_an.ten: Italian-style beef stew with sweet potatoes
mon_an.mo_ta: In today's article, we introduce a new recipe: Italian-style beef stew with sweet potatoes. This unique, attractive, and nutrient-rich dish is a must-try for your kitchen. Give it a go!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare ingredients
Wash the beef and leave it in a large piece. Pat dry with paper towels, then rub salt and pepper evenly over the surface. Marinate for 5 minutes to let the flavors penetrate.
Peel the sweet potatoes, wash them, and cut them into medium-sized cubes (similar in size to those used for Bo Kho).
Peel the onion, wash it, and mince it.
Step 2: Cooking steps
Using a large pot, melt the unsalted butter and add the beef to sear over high heat.
When the beef starts to firm up, turn it a few times then remove it from the pot. Reduce the heat to low, add the minced onion and rosemary, and simmer for about 5 minutes to release the aroma.
Place the beef back into a large, heavy-bottomed pot and pour the onion and rosemary mixture over it.
Arrange the sweet potato cubes around the beef, pour in the dark beer, and begin stewing. Simmer for 4-5 hours until the beef is completely tender. The dish is now complete.
Notes for Italian-style beef stew with sweet potatoes:
When searing the meat with butter, remember to turn it regularly to avoid burning.
Besides sweet potatoes, you can add other vegetables you like, such as carrots, potatoes, or bell peppers.
To enhance the flavor, serve the dish with a few slices of bread.
How to choose good beef:

Fresh beef should not be dark red; the fat should be yellow and firm (avoid soft fat). Choose meat with small, soft fibers rather than large, tough ones. Finally, press the meat; it should not be sticky and should have no foul odor.

Cow meat is usually tastier than bull meat. Young beef (veal) is excellent because it is tender with white fat and fine fibers. Look for bright red meat with small white tendons and bright yellow fat.

Beef that is pale green with round white spots between the fibers may be infected with parasites. Avoid meat with a foul or fishy smell. Signs of old or poor-quality beef include dark color, deep yellow fat, yellow bones, poor elasticity, flabby texture, or a slimy surface.
Identification:
Fresh beef: Bright red, fine fibers, fragrant beef scent, pale yellow fat.
Old beef: Dark red, deep yellow fat, large fibers; very tough.
Buffalo meat: Dark red, white fat, slightly fishy smell, not fragrant.

Parasites (tapeworm cysts): Easy to spot as they look like grains of rice embedded in the fibers. They can be easily flicked out with a knife tip, unlike small white tendons which are tough and firmly attached.

mon_an.mo_ta: Have you ever tried shrimp curry with rich, sweet, and refreshing cream? Just one bite and you won't be able to resist! Let's find out how to make this dish below!
cac_buoc: Step 1: First, chop the potatoes, onion, carrot, and broccoli.
Step 2: Marinate the shrimp with salt and pepper.
Step 3: Next, sauté the butter, potatoes, and carrots first. After 5 minutes, add the onion.
Step 4: Once the vegetables are partially cooked, pour 650 ml of water into the pot.
Step 5:
Add the broccoli and shrimp once the water boils.
Tip: Adding the broccoli last helps maintain its vibrant color.
Step 6: When the shrimp and broccoli are nearly cooked, add the curry powder and stir quickly to dissolve.
Step 7: Finally, pour in the fresh cream slowly while stirring gently.
The creamy shrimp curry is now finished!
On lazy days, just making this creamy shrimp curry provides a quick yet complete meal with protein and green vegetables.

mon_an.mo_ta: Instead of regular lemon, passion fruit brings a completely different flavor with a seductive aroma and eye-catching color. Let's learn how to make passion fruit tea!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Black tea - 4 tsp or 2 tea bags
cac_buoc: Step 1: Boil the sugar with 60 ml of water to make a syrup.
Step 2: Brew the tea. You can switch to green tea if you don't like black tea.
Step 3: Strain the passion fruit to remove the seeds.
Step 4: Mix the syrup into the passion fruit juice.
Step 5: Finally, take a glass full of ice, fill it halfway with tea, then pour the passion fruit mixture on top to fill the glass. Done!

mon_an.mo_ta: A bit of pâté served with bread or sticky rice is a familiar and attractive dish. If you don't trust the quality of store-bought pâté, don't hesitate to make it yourself!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 450 g liver, chopped (chicken, pork, or veal)
cac_buoc: Place the liver, brandy, garlic, parsley, onion, ginger, cloves, cinnamon, and nutmeg into a blender and pulse several times until smooth.
Mix the liver mixture thoroughly with the ground pork, then add salt and pepper and mix again.
Line the bottom and sides of a mold with bacon slices, pour in the liver and meat mixture, and cover the top with another layer of bacon.
Place the mold in a baking tray and fill the tray with water to provide moisture during the baking process (water bath).
Place the tray in the oven at 177°C for 1.5 hours.

After removing the pâté from the oven, cover the mold with foil and place a heavy weight on top, then refrigerate. This cooling and pressing step helps the pâté firm up and achieve the proper texture.

mon_an.ten: How to make crispy fried bánh chưng without the grease
mon_an.mo_ta: When Tet comes, every family likely has many bánh chưng but cannot eat them all at once. Why not transform them into something more delicious and easier to eat? Let's learn how to make crispy, delicious fried bánh chưng that isn't greasy at all! Discover simple recipes and secrets to creating fried bánh chưng with a golden, crispy crust. Step into the world of traditional cuisine and show off your cooking skills with this attractive dish!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Soy sauce, pickled onions, Vietnamese ham (giò/chả) for serving
cac_buoc: 1. How to make crispy fried bánh chưng without the grease
Method 1:
Cut the bánh chưng normally into 8 triangular pieces.

Add a little oil (about 1 tsp) to a pan and heat it. Place the pieces in and fry all sides until they are golden brown and crispy. Using a non-stick pan will prevent the cake from breaking and help it stay crispy!
Since bánh chưng is mostly wrapped with fatty pork belly, you don't need much oil. In fact, using too much oil makes it greasy and takes longer to get crispy.
Method 2:
Instead of cutting into neat squares, simply use a knife to crumble or finely chop the cake (you can use a cutting board, though it's more cleanup!).

Heat a little oil (1/2 tsp) in a pan and add the chopped bánh chưng. Cover for about 5 minutes to let the steam soften the cake, then use a spoon or wooden spatula to press and mash the cake into a single flat pancake.
Fry until golden on both sides. Note: when flipping, add another 1/2 tsp of oil.
Fried bánh chưng is best eaten right after frying, served with pickled onions or leeks, a drizzle of soy sauce, and a few slices of Vietnamese ham—it's absolutely fantastic!
Which way do you prefer? I like both. The first method lets you enjoy the original texture and the fried texture at the same time—crispy outside, soft inside.
The second method blends everything together so every bite is crispy with only a very thin soft layer. If it's someone's first time eating it this way, they might not even realize it's bánh chưng!
2. How to fry bánh chưng with water
Ingredients:
20 g toasted sesame seeds
300 ml filtered water
Bánh chưng
Instructions:

When cutting the bánh chưng, you can use the wrapping string to divide it into 8 pieces or use a knife. Place the pieces in a pan, add 300 ml of water, and bring to a boil over medium heat. Use a tool to mash and flatten the cake into a thin layer.

Fry for about 4-5 minutes until one side is evenly golden, then flip and fry for another 3 minutes. Once finished, turn off the heat and remove from the pan. Garnish as desired, sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds, and serve with soy sauce and pickled vegetables.
Bánh chưng and bánh tét fried this way are crispy, delicious, and not greasy.
3. Deep-fried bánh chưng
Bánh chưng
Cooking oil
Instructions:
After peeling the bánh chưng, use a knife to cut it into bite-sized pieces.
Tip: Use the cake's own string to cut it instead of a knife to avoid a sticky mess that is hard to wash.
Place a pan on the stove over medium heat. Add about two tablespoons of oil and coat the pan until hot.
Arrange the pieces in the pan and fry the first side over low heat for about five minutes. Once golden and crispy, flip to fry the other side for three to four minutes.
Once golden brown, remove and place on paper towels to absorb excess oil.
Notes for making fried bánh chưng:
Oil temperature: Ensure the oil is heated to the right temperature (about 170-180°C). If the temperature is too low, the cake will absorb too much oil and become greasy.
Fry in small pieces: Cutting the cake into small pieces helps it cook evenly and become crispier.
Fry over low to medium heat: Use low to medium heat. Too high a heat can burn the surface while the inside remains cold.
Frying time: Watch carefully. Usually, each side needs 2-3 minutes or until golden and crispy.
Drain the oil: Always place the fried cake on paper towels. This makes it more appealing and less oily.
Enjoy: Fried bánh chưng is best served hot. Enjoy immediately to experience the wonderful crispy flavor.

mon_an.ten: Crispy stir-fried noodles with seafood and vegetables
mon_an.mo_ta: Crispy noodles served with stir-fried seafood and vegetables are flavorful and nutritious, sure to delight your family! Check out how to make this dish below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Clam meat (pre-processed) - 200 g (You can add beef or other seafood as preferred)
Salt, sesame oil, oyster sauce, pepper, soy sauce, seasoning powder
cac_buoc: 1. How to make delicious crispy stir-fried seafood noodles
Step 1:
Wash the shrimp, remove the veins, and drain.
Wash the clam meat and drain.
Wash the carrots, onion, long beans, and choy sum, then cut into short segments.
Wash the shiitake mushrooms, soak until soft, and trim the stems.
Step 2:
Bring a small pot of water to a boil, add 1 tsp oil and a pinch of salt. Blanch the choy sum, long beans, and broccoli, then remove and drain.
Step 3:
Use your hands to loosen the egg noodles.
Heat oil in a pan; note that the noodles must be deep-fried in plenty of very hot oil. If the oil isn't hot enough, the noodles will become tough.
Once golden, remove the noodles and place in a metal colander to drain.
Step 4:
Dissolve 2 tsp of tapioca starch in 2 tsp of cold water.
Step 5:

Heat 2 tsp of oil in a pan, sauté the garlic until fragrant, then add the carrots and shiitake mushrooms. Since carrots take longer to cook, add them first. Stir-fry vegetables over high heat and toss quickly.
When the carrots and mushrooms are cooked, add the seafood and shrimp.
Once the shrimp firms up, quickly add the blanched vegetables and broccoli. Season with a little salt, seasoning powder, soy sauce, and oyster sauce.
Toss well, then pour in the starch slurry. The mixture will become slightly thickened. Adjust seasoning to taste, turn off the heat, and drizzle with a little sesame oil and black pepper for aroma.
Step 6:
When serving, place the crispy noodles on a plate...
...then top with the stir-fried seafood and vegetables. This dish is best served hot.
This crispy noodle dish is both delicious and nutritious. I often make this when I want to save time but still have a great meal; everyone in my family loves it.
2. Chinese-style crispy stir-fried noodles
Ingredients:
Noodles: 400 g
Pork: 100 g
Fresh shrimp: 100 g
Squid: 1 piece
Choy sum: 50 g
Onion: 1 piece
Carrot: 1 piece
Tomatoes: 2 pieces
Broccoli
Celery: 100 g
Common seasonings
Instructions:
Prepare ingredients:
Shrimp: Peel, devein, and remove heads. Wash with diluted salt water and drain. Marinate with a little pepper and salt.
Squid: Wash with diluted salt water. Slice into bite-sized pieces. Marinate with pepper and salt.
Pork: Rub with salt, rinse, and slice into bite-sized pieces.
Broccoli: Cut into florets, wash, and blanch in boiling water.
Tomatoes: Wash and cut into wedges. Onion: Peel, wash, and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Celery and choy sum: Wash and cut into segments.
Carrot: Peel, wash, and julienne.
Boil water, add the noodles and blanch quickly to soften. Remove and immediately plunge into cold water for 20 seconds, then drain.
Make the sauce:
Boil chicken to make a stock for the sauce.

Heat a pan with oil. Sauté the onion briefly, then add the shrimp, pork, and squid. Stir-fry until firm, then season with 1 tbsp oyster sauce, 2 tsp seasoning powder, 1 tbsp soy sauce, and a little pepper. Toss over high heat so the ingredients absorb the flavors.
When the proteins are nearly cooked, add the prepared vegetables and stir-fry. Add 1/2 cup of chicken stock and cook until everything is done.
In a separate bowl, mix 1 tbsp tapioca starch with water. Pour this into the pan to thicken the sauce. Season to taste and turn off the heat.
Notes for delicious crispy seafood noodles:
Choose fresh ingredients: Ensure shrimp, squid, and pork are fresh for the best flavor.
Prep before cooking: Have all seafood and vegetables cleaned and cut before starting the heat.
Handle noodles correctly: Blanch noodles until just soft, then shock in cold water to stop the cooking and keep them ready for frying.
Stir-fry in order: Start with aromatics, then proteins, then vegetables to ensure everything is cooked perfectly.
Use the right seasonings: Balance the sauce with oyster sauce, soy sauce, and pepper for a rich flavor.
Ensure sauce consistency: Use the starch slurry to create a glossy, thick sauce that coats the ingredients.
Add vegetables and stock: Adding stock (usually chicken) increases the moisture and depth of flavor.
Seasoning: Always taste and adjust the sauce at the end to suit your personal preference.
Timing: Stir-fry quickly and evenly to avoid overcooking the seafood and losing the crunch of the vegetables.

mon_an.ten: Xôi Cốm: A Gift of Autumn
mon_an.mo_ta: Xôi cốm is an autumn delicacy that is incredibly easy to make and delicious. This is a traditional Hanoi recipe for fragrant sticky rice. With just 4 simple steps, you can complete this flavorful dish.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Before starting the Xôi Cốm, prepare the mung beans:
Soak the mung beans for 2 hours, then drain in a colander and mix with a pinch of salt for flavor.
Steam the mung beans or cook them in a rice cooker until soft.
Once cooked, mash or grind the beans until smooth.
Step 2:
Mix the green rice flakes with 2 tbsp of oil and place in a steamer. Do not use high heat as it may make the flakes mushy. Steam for 5 - 7 minutes until the flakes expand.
Remove the rice from the steamer, mix with 2/3 of the sugar, then steam one more time. This helps the sugar absorb evenly into the rice.
Step 3: Marinate the shredded coconut with the remaining 1/3 of the sugar. Sauté on the stove until the coconut firms up, taking care not to let it burn or turn brown.

Step 4: Serve the sticky rice on a plate, mix with a little oil and 2/3 of the mashed mung beans. Toss thoroughly so the rice is fluffy and not clumped. When eating, sprinkle the remaining 1/3 of the mung beans and the shredded coconut on top. This dish is delicious whether served hot or cold.
Source: Collected

mon_an.ten: Quang Nam Style Black Bean Sticky Rice
mon_an.mo_ta: Quang Nam Black Bean Sticky Rice is a beloved sweet dish from the Central region. Though simple, it is very satisfying. Here is how to make this authentic dish.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Clean the black beans and soak them in cold water for about 8 - 9 hours.
Step 2: Clean the sticky rice and soak it overnight in a bowl of water mixed with a little salt. Peel and mince the ginger.
Step 3: After soaking, rinse the black beans several times. Place the beans in a pot with salt and cook until soft. Add half of the sugar and simmer until the beans absorb the sweetness.

Step 4: Turn off the heat. Drain the beans and set the liquid aside. Drain the sticky rice, then soak it in the black bean liquid for about 4 hours. Once the rice has taken on a dark color, drain it in a colander.
Step 5: Mix the sticky rice and black beans together in a steamer. Steam for 20 to 25 minutes, then add the remaining sugar and fluff gently with a wooden paddle.

Step 6: Continue cooking until the rice is almost done, then add the ginger and fluff gently. Continue steaming until the rice is soft, fragrant, and fully cooked. Turn off the heat. While the rice is still warm, press it firmly into a mold to bind it. Remove from the mold and sprinkle with toasted white sesame seeds. Slice into bite-sized pieces to serve.

mon_an.ten: Honey Roasted Chicken with Sticky Rice
mon_an.mo_ta: Roasted Chicken Sticky Rice – A delicious and easy-to-make dish using basic ingredients. Follow this recipe to treat your family to a warming and flavorful meal.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Dried chili flakes (optional for spice) - 1 tsp
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the chicken with salt, trim off excess fat (if any), and pat dry with paper towels.

Step 2: Combine soy sauce, oyster sauce, seasoning powder, honey, dried chili, and shallots in a bowl. Prick the chicken slightly with the tip of a knife so the marinade penetrates better. Toss the chicken in the marinade until well coated and refrigerate overnight.

Step 3: Preheat the oven to 180°C. Place the chicken in the oven with the skin side down.
