Roast for 25 minutes, then flip the chicken skin side up and roast for another 15 minutes until the skin is golden brown and not burnt (40 minutes total). Serve the sticky rice on a plate alongside the chicken and some pickles for balance.

mon_an.mo_ta: Xôi Xéo is a simple yet iconic name that has woken up with Hanoians for generations. It features a captivating yellow color, a unique chewiness, and an unmistakable aroma of shallot oil and mung beans. Served on a leaf, drizzled with shallot oil, and topped with thinly sliced mung bean balls, every spoonful offers a perfect blend of sweet, salty, rich, and nutty flavors.
cac_buoc: Preparation
Step 1: Soak the rice with turmeric powder overnight to create the signature yellow color.
Step 2: Soak the mung beans for 4 hours, then peel and drain.
Step 3: Peel and thinly slice the shallots.
Cooking
Step 1: Drain the soaked rice and place it in a steamer. Stir occasionally to ensure the rice cooks evenly and becomes tender.
Step 2: Steam the mung beans for 15 - 20 minutes until fully cooked, then process in a blender or mash in a mortar until smooth. Let cool and press firmly into large balls.
Step 3: Fry the sliced shallots in hot oil until golden brown, then remove to a bowl.

Step 4: Once the rice is cooked, transfer to a plate. Use a knife to thinly shave the mung bean balls over the rice. Sprinkle with fried shallots and drizzle a bit of the shallot-infused oil on top for a rich, fragrant finish.

mon_an.mo_ta: Thai-style mango sticky rice features the sweetness of coconut milk, the fragrance of sticky rice, and the sweet-tart flavor of ripe mango for a unique and delicious treat.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: A pinch of salt, toasted sesame seeds
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Soak the sticky rice for 6-8 hours, then wash and drain.
Step 2:
Place the rice in a steamer and add a pinch of salt.
Step 3:
Turn on the heat to steam the rice until cooked.
Step 4:
While waiting for the rice, open the coconut milk.
Step 5:
Mix the coconut milk with white sugar in a pot and stir over heat until it just begins to simmer.
Step 6:
When the rice grains are soft and evenly cooked, turn off the heat.
Step 7:
Slowly pour the prepared coconut milk into the rice and mix well with a wooden spoon.
Step 8:
Cover tightly with a cheesecloth to let the rice absorb the coconut milk.
Step 9:
Wash, peel, and slice the mango into bite-sized pieces.
Step 10:
Serve the sticky rice on a plate, top with mango slices, and sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds.

mon_an.mo_ta: Spanish fried rice, also known as Paella, is a dish with a long history and is closely associated with the daily life of the Spanish people. In this article, we will introduce you to how to make Paella, helping you bring the signature flavors of Spain into your kitchen. With these detailed instructions, you can easily make a delicious Paella. Learn how to make a tasty and flavorful Spanish Paella with this step-by-step guide.
cac_buoc: While rice is often thought of as a specialty of Asia, in Spain, rice is actually a familiar ingredient associated with the famous traditional dish – Paella.
A Long-standing Tradition

No Spaniard wonders where or when paella appeared, because quite simply, this mixed rice dish has been closely linked to the lives of the people in the land of the bulls. Not only in Spain, but also in countries sharing a similar language system, paella has become a familiar daily dish. However, it is still believed that the oldest and most "original" type of paella originated from the Albufera lake area in the Valencian region around the 15th century. Valencian paella is also the name of the traditional recipe for paella, which is quite different from later variations.

Paella is a mixture of rice with all sorts of ingredients inside. This combination also reflects the simple origins of the dish: ancient Spanish laborers came up with a way to save leftover ingredients in the kitchen by putting them all in a large pan and frying them until fragrant. Gradually, paella was no longer a "hodgepodge" recipe but was seen as a "living museum" of Spanish culinary culture. Through the ingredients, flavors, and colors of paella, we can understand the culinary characteristics of the daily meals of the Spanish people.
From a Dish to an Enjoyable Community Activity

The name paella in Latin means "pan," referring to the method of preparing the dish in a large pan. If you are not a local, it is easy to be "overwhelmed" by the giant size of the paella pan, which in Spanish cuisine has its own name, "paella pan," to distinguish it from other small pans. A traditional paella pan has a radius of 1m and is placed on a large open-air charcoal stove. Two strong men will continuously stir the rice in the pan to cook it evenly, then it is divided into small bowls and distributed to everyone.

Like other forms of labor and cultural activities in Spain, cooking and enjoying paella creates a bond between people in the same community; everyone contributes ingredients to prepare the dish and then gathers around a large cast-iron pan. If the characteristic of French cuisine is small, elegant plates under restaurant candlelight, for the Spanish, eating in a warm collective atmosphere is the most proud feature.

Today, for hygiene reasons as well as adjustments to suit urban life, paella is less commonly presented in the traditional style, but in restaurants or family meals, people still place paella in a large pan right in the middle of the table like a hotpot, and everyone around shares this fragrant, hot dish.
Countless Variations

Paella is no different from other types of fried rice around the world with its flexible nature in ingredients, allowing chefs to freely create many different recipes. In general, cooking paella is not difficult because it does not require overly sophisticated ingredients, but paella requires high cooking techniques as all fresh ingredients must be cooked evenly on one pan surface, and even the rice is not pre-cooked but fried directly in the pan.

Standard paella is not like claypot rice or the fried rice commonly seen in Vietnam with a crispy burnt rice layer at the bottom; instead, each grain of rice must be evenly cooked and plump, with spices and ingredients fully blended together. Therefore, the man in the family usually takes charge of stirring the paella because his hands are stronger and more flexible than a woman's, suitable for continuously stirring that huge volume of rice.

Paella is sometimes not completely dry but has a sauce, which is a mixture of water added to the rice stuck at the bottom of the pan with the ingredients in the rice. If not stirred quickly, paella will have burnt rice left at the bottom, and people pour a little water in to loosen the rice and then mix it well, creating a very flavorful and unique sauce.

Besides the texture, the special thing that makes paella a specialty, standing out among thousands of fried rice and mixed rice recipes worldwide, is the Spanish-style spices and colors. The general framework for all paella recipes is four elements: rice – meat – vegetables – coloring and flavoring ingredients, producing vibrant plates of paella like a flamenco skirt in the land of the bulls. Maintaining that general framework, both traditional and modern variations of paella cannot lack the following ingredients:

Calasparra or Bomba rice – two types of rice unique to the Spanish, with a rounder and shorter shape than typical Asian rice. Both types of rice are harder and chewier than regular rice, very suitable for "jumping" on the giant pan surface without breaking. However, Asian countries can completely substitute their own rice, just stir evenly and quickly or prepare very dry cooked rice in advance.

Meat and vegetables are the most attractive components of a paella plate; meat in paella is usually chicken, beef, rabbit, lamb, sausage... types of protein familiar to the livestock life of the Spanish. Additionally, seafood paella is also a very special type of paella with a more sophisticated preparation: squid, shrimp, and oysters need faster or longer cooking times than rice, so seafood paella is not simply pouring all ingredients into the pan at once, stirring, and removing.

The harmonious coordination between meat and vegetables is also an important requirement in paella creation; meats go well with pungent herbs while seafood needs to maintain its freshness with cool, crunchy vegetables that still effectively remove the fishy smell. A popular and considered easiest-to-eat paella recipe, appearing frequently in Spanish-style restaurants, is chicken and bean paella: Nutty rice grains blended with juicy chicken, perfectly combined with fresh beans and a hint of light acidity from tomatoes.

Finally, but no less important, often considered the "soul" of paella, are the coloring ingredients. Paella plates are prominent and eye-catching thanks to the vibrant red, orange, and yellow colors that dye each grain of rice. The most common ingredient is saffron powder, which creates a yellow color and a characteristic pungent taste that the Spanish particularly love. That pungency is not very suitable for the palates of other countries, but it is rarely removed from the paella recipe; it is simply adjusted to taste, because without saffron, the Spanish essence in the rice dish is gone.

Another equally popular ingredient for coloring paella is chorizo – a spicy sausage with dried bell peppers and paprika powder, giving a beautiful deep red color. Chorizo eaten raw is very bland, but when finely chopped and mixed with rice and various chili powders, fresh bell peppers, red meat, etc., this sausage immediately turns into the "conductor" for an impressive spicy and warm symphony on the paella plate.

The impression of European cuisine is often something very luxurious and associated with aristocratic origins. But coming to paella, we approach a different view of a wild land with nomadic groups stretching across the steppes, of a popular, simple, yet still captivating culinary culture.
Instructions on how to make Paella:
Step 1: Boil the mussels; when the mussels open their mouths, remove them and set aside. Keep the boiling water to cook the rice, filtering the clear part into another container.
Step 2: In a pan, add olive oil and heat over medium heat. Sprinkle a little salt into the pan to prevent oil from splashing. Sauté the shrimp for a few minutes, then remove the shrimp and set aside.
Step 3: Next, sear the chicken and pork. Add the bell peppers and stir for 2-3 minutes. Remove the chicken and peppers to a plate.

Step 4: In the same pan, add peas and green beans and sauté for a few minutes. Add the tomatoes to the center of the pan and fry for 2 minutes. Mix in the chili powder and after 1 minute, add the pre-sautéed meat back into the pan, stirring well.
Step 5: Add 1.5 liters of water, saffron, and a pinch of salt. Mix well and simmer for 18 minutes. If necessary, add more water as desired.

Step 6: Add the rice to the pan and cook for 6 minutes over high heat. Then, place the mussels, shrimp, and peppers on top of the rice, and reduce the heat to the lowest setting. Cook for another 13 minutes until the rice is done.

Step 7: When the rice is cooked, turn off the heat and let the rice sit in the pan for about 5 minutes before enjoying. Usually, this dish is served in the pan itself, placed directly on the dining table.
Notes when making Paella
Rice type: Use rice that is chewy and absorbs water well, such as glutinous rice or Arborio rice, to ensure the Paella has the characteristic consistency and flavor.
Pan temperature: Use a heavy-bottomed pan to prevent the rice from burning or sticking. Also, adjust the heat to be even and stable, ensuring the rice cooks evenly without becoming dry or mushy.
Flavor: Use saffron and garlic to create the signature flavor for Paella. Additionally, you can add spices like pepper, black peppercorns, or basil to enhance the flavor.

Cooking order: Meat and seafood should be sautéed separately before being combined with the rice. This helps maintain the fresh taste and ensures the appropriate cooking time for each type of ingredient.
Stock: Use fresh chicken stock or seafood stock to cook the Paella to add more flavor to the dish.
Cooking time: Ensure the Paella is cooked for the appropriate amount of time. The rice should be cooked until just done, not too mushy or hard.

mon_an.ten: Irresistible Spicy Rice Cakes with Minced Meat Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: In this cold weather, enjoying chewy and hot spicy rice cakes with minced meat sauce is wonderful.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare 200g of rice cakes, then put them in a pot of water and boil for about 3-5 minutes or until the rice cakes are soft. Remove the rice cakes and drain. Do not throw away the cooking water.
Step 2: Peel and wash the carrots and onions, then cut them into bite-sized pieces.
Step 3: Sauté minced shallots with a little cooking oil until fragrant, add the minced pork and stir-fry, seasoning with a bit of seasoning powder.
Step 4: Next, add the rice cakes to stir-fry along with the onions and carrots. Slowly pour the rice cake cooking water over and bring to a boil.
Step 5: Lower the heat until the rice cakes are soft, then add the soy sauce and Gochujang sauce, simmering until the sauce thickens.
Step 6: Serve the rice cakes with minced meat sauce on a plate, add some chopped green onions, and enjoy.
In this cold weather, enjoying spicy rice cakes with minced meat sauce is truly wonderful.

mon_an.ten: Stir-fried Rice Cakes with Beef - Unique and Delicious
mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried rice cakes with beef – a variation of the Korean spicy rice cake dish with meat, vegetables, and starch. For those feeling lazy, this dish alone is enough.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 6 white mushrooms (can be replaced with other mushrooms)
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, slice the onion, mushrooms, and carrot into bite-sized thin pieces. Mince the garlic and cut the green onions into segments.
Step 2:
Soak the rice cakes in hot water for 5 minutes, then remove and drain.
Step 3:
Marinate the beef with soy sauce, sugar, rice wine, and sesame oil for 15 minutes.
Step 4:
Heat a pan, add the beef and stir-fry until just cooked through, then remove to a plate.
Step 5:
Continue to heat oil in the pan, sauté the garlic until fragrant, then add the onion, carrot, and mushrooms to stir-fry briefly. You can season with a little salt, but don't add too much.
Step 6:
Add the rice cakes and the rice cake sauce to the pan and stir-fry.
Step 7:
Finally, add the beef back in, toss briefly, and serve on a plate.

Try this stir-fried rice cake with beef to see how it differs from rice cakes with fish cakes! This dish is also very quick to make, so it can be made regularly at home or brought to the office for a very reasonable and nutritious meal.

mon_an.ten: Guide to Marinating Delicious Korean Grilled Ribs
mon_an.mo_ta: The rib marinating method below will make your party with loved ones better than ever! Please refer to it.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, peel the kiwi, peel the onion and garlic, then cut the kiwi and onion into small pieces.
Step 2:
Put the prepared ingredients into a blender and blend until smooth.
Step 3:
Add the pepper, soy sauce, sesame oil, 100ml water, rice vinegar, and sugar.
Step 4:
Mix all the ingredients together well.
Step 5:
Cut the ribs into thin slices, put the ribs into a food-grade plastic bag, then pour in the marinade.
Marinate for 8-10 hours. If preparing for a BBQ party, you should marinate the meat the day before so the meat absorbs the sauce better!
Step 6:
Grill the ribs for 2-3 minutes on each side for a medium-rare finish. If you want the ribs well-done, you can grill them longer!
Korean grilled ribs served with kimchi or cucumber salad and white sesame seeds are excellent!
Thanks to the kiwi, your grilled ribs will be soft and moist, making them extremely attractive to eat!
Refer to this grilled rib marinade recipe for BBQ parties with friends or family now!

mon_an.mo_ta: Beef stewed in coconut curry – full of color and flavor for a vibrant family weekend. Save this recipe for Beef Stewed in Coconut Curry.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients:
Peel and mince the ginger and garlic. Peel the onion, wash it, and cut it into bite-sized pieces.
Wash the beef and cut it into 1.5cm cubes. Marinate with 1 tsp of salt for 15 minutes.
Step 2: Place a pan with oil on the stove; when the oil is hot, sear the beef until the sides are golden brown, then remove to a plate.
Step 3: Using the same pan, add the onion, then add the minced ginger and garlic, curry powder, and chili powder, and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Step 4: Next, pour in the can of coconut milk, add 1 tbsp of brown sugar, 1 tbsp of soy sauce, 1/2 tbsp of fish sauce, and a little salt (adjust to taste).
Step 5: When the mixture from step 4 is simmering, add the beef to stew. Using a pressure cooker will be faster; stew for 20 minutes until the beef in coconut curry is tender.

Step 6: Wash the bell pepper, cut it in half, remove the seeds, and cut into bite-sized pieces. Wash the cherry tomatoes and drain. Pour the cherry tomatoes and bell pepper into the beef pot, cook for another 10 minutes, and it's ready to serve.
Source: PictureTheRecipe

mon_an.mo_ta: Today, we are adding a Chinese dish called "Chinese Braised Beef" to our collection. Here is the recipe and method for you to follow! With simple ingredients available in any kitchen, you can create an unforgettable dish with the sweetness of the meat and a broth infused with the aroma of cinnamon, star anise, and black cardamom. The warm, spicy flavor of this dish is perfect for cold-weather meals. Nutrition: Calories: 400 kcal; Fat: 120 grams;
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Beef brisket - 500 grams - trimmed and cubed
Oyster sauce - 1.5 tbsp (can be substituted with soy sauce)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Soak the dried mushrooms in boiling water for about 30 minutes until fully rehydrated.
Step 2: Once soaked, rinse the mushrooms thoroughly, slice them thinly, and set aside.
Step 3: Strain the stock through a sieve to remove any residue, and set aside one bowl of stock.

Step 4: Pan-sear the beef until browned on all sides. Add the shallots, ginger, and garlic. Fry for a few minutes. Then pour in the prepared stock, 2 cups of beef broth, brown sugar, soy sauce, wine, peppercorns, star anise, black cardamom, chili, and cinnamon.
Step 5: Cover the pot, bring to a boil, then reduce to low heat and simmer for about 1 hour before adding the mushrooms.
Step 6: Continue simmering for about 40 minutes until the beef is tender.
Step 7: Use a spoon or a slotted spatula to remove the beef and set it aside; discard the cinnamon, star anise, black cardamom, etc.
Step 8: Simmer the remaining broth until reduced; you can add a little tapioca starch dissolved in water to thicken the sauce.
Step 9: Pour the sauce over the beef, sprinkle with scallions and sesame seeds, and serve hot with white rice.

Chinese-style braised beef is very popular in Singapore, Malaysia, and Indonesia. This is a nutritious dish with a distinctive flavor. Depending on the region, this recipe can be adapted using fresh spices so it is not as overpowering as the original version.

mon_an.mo_ta: Tender Frog Curry – An easy-to-make dish that is rich and delicious, perfect when served with hot rice! Learn how to cook this tender and flavorful frog curry.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 50g curry paste, 15g curry powder, 30ml white wine, 3g salt, 150ml coconut milk
cac_buoc: Step 1: After purchasing the frogs, soak them in water and wash them thoroughly. Since some parts of a frog can be toxic, it is best to buy pre-cleaned frogs to ensure safety. Cut the frog into pieces and marinate with wine and curry powder for 15 minutes.
Step 2: Cut the onion in half; dice one half and thinly slice the other. Cut the tomato and potato into small pieces, and finely chop the chilies.

Step 3: Heat a pot and add the butter. Sauté the minced shallots, ginger, garlic, and diced onion until fragrant, then add the 3 dried chilies to the pot. Next, add the tomatoes and stir-fry until softened with a pinch of salt.

Step 4: Add the marinated frog to the pot along with the curry paste and a little hot water. Once the water boils, add the potatoes. Do not cover the lid; simmer over medium-low heat for 15 minutes. If there is still too much liquid, increase the heat slightly to thicken the sauce.
Step 5: Finally, add the coconut milk and simmer for another 5 minutes to finish. Serve this easy-to-make dish in a bowl; it is best enjoyed hot with bread.
Source: Kenh 14

mon_an.mo_ta: Pizza is a famous baked dish originating from Italy. Having appeared in Vietnam for a long time, pizza is now a familiar and favorite dish among many young people. Making pizza is not as difficult as people think; you just need to invest a little time and effort to create delicious, attractive pizzas for your family to enjoy without having to buy them from a shop.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Toppings: as desired; you can choose pork floss, canned fish, shrimp, scallops, clams, sausage, beef... Vegetables: tomatoes, bell peppers, onions... but cheese and tomato sauce are mandatory.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Make the pizza crust
Mix the flour with sugar, salt, and a little olive oil. Dissolve the yeast in warm water, then add it to the flour mixture and beat well until the dough rises.
Proof the dough for about 1 hour until it has doubled in size.
Knead the dough by hand and divide it into small portions. Roll them out on a cutting board to a moderate thickness, then pre-bake (about 5 minutes) at 220°C. Remove and let cool.
Step 2: Assemble the pizza
Thinly slice the bell peppers and onions, grate the cheese, and peel and devein the shrimp. Spread tomato sauce and sprinkle cheese all over the surface of the crust.
Then add the toppings (bell peppers, onions, sausage, small shrimp). Spread all the topping ingredients over the pizza.
Step 3: Bake the pizza
Place the pizza in the oven at 250°C and bake for 15 minutes. Bake until the cheese melts and the crust is golden and crispy, and your pizza is ready to eat.
As you can see, making pizza is not too difficult; with a little patience, you can make wonderful pizzas yourself!.

mon_an.mo_ta: Among all Mexican street foods, Tacos are always the number one choice for travelers due to their incredibly appealing flavor. The first tacos appeared in Mexico filled with small fish, prepared by indigenous people living in the Valley of Mexico. Over time, taco recipes became more popular and diverse. By the early 20th century, many types of tacos were popular in the US and Canada and appeared in cookbooks by 1949. There are many ways to make Tacos, but today, we will guide you through the quickest and simplest way to make beef stir-fry Tacos that still retain their Mexican essence. Let's learn how to make Tacos! Tacos, considered the most famous street food in Mexico, attract people with their crispy shells and sweet meat filling. We will share a way to make Mexican tacos at home without too much effort while still ensuring they taste as good as those from a shop.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Mix the dough

Add 150g flour, 10g cornstarch, a pinch of salt, 1/2 tsp baking powder, and 1/2 tsp turmeric powder to a bowl, then mix the ingredients well. Next, add one teaspoon of cooking oil and 130ml of water and mix thoroughly.
Once the dough is combined, knead by hand for about 10-15 minutes until the dough becomes smooth and no longer sticks to your hands.
Cover the dough tightly with plastic wrap or a lid and let it rest for 30 minutes to allow it to rise.
Step 2: Prepare the filling
Sprinkle 1/2 tsp pepper, 1/2 tsp seasoning powder, and 1 tsp soy sauce over the prepared ground beef. Mix well to let the meat absorb the flavors for about 15-20 minutes.
Next, wash the onion, peel it, and dice it. Mince the garlic. Slice the cucumber, lettuce, and tomatoes into bite-sized pieces.
Step 3: Stir-fry the filling

Place a pan on the stove and heat it. Add 1 tsp cooking oil and sauté the garlic until fragrant. Next, add the onion and beef to the pan and stir-fry over high heat until the beef is browned and cooked through.
Step 4: Roll and shape the shells

Spread a piece of parchment paper on the table and place the dough on it. Divide the dough into 2 parts. Use a rolling pin to roll each part into a thin layer and then cut into circles to create the taco shells.
Step 5: Fry the Taco shells

Place a pan on the stove and add 1 tsp cooking oil. Place the dough in the pan and cover with a lid for about 2 minutes. Then, flip the shell to sear the other side and continue covering for another 2 minutes until the taco shell is cooked and golden.
Step 6: Assemble the tacos

Place the taco shell on a plate and proceed to fill it. Start by adding cucumber, tomatoes, and lettuce to the shell, then add the beef, cheese, and a little cilantro. Finally, add chili sauce and mayonnaise. Fold the shell in half, and the taco is complete.

The result is a taco with a soft, crispy, and chewy shell combined with the sweetness of the beef, the freshness of the vegetables, and the richness of the cheese. This dish is so delicious that everyone will love it.
Notes for making Tacos
If you prefer, you can substitute pork for beef in this dish. However, you should not use chicken as it can make the filling dry and lack the rich, savory flavor.
You can buy pre-ground beef or buy a whole piece and mince it yourself.

When buying beef, choose pieces that are bright red with fine fibers and a characteristic beef aroma. The fat should be pale yellow and not sticky when pressed, and the meat should have good elasticity.
Avoid buying beef that has grain-like particles inside the fibers, as these could be parasite cysts.

Additionally, avoid beef that shows signs of sliminess, foul odors, lack of elasticity, dark spots, or a pale green tint. These are signs that the beef has been sitting for a long time or is from a dead or diseased animal.
It is best to buy a whole large piece of meat rather than pre-sliced meat, as this makes it easier to distinguish fresh, quality meat.

mon_an.ten: Thai Two-Layer Coconut and Water Chestnut Jelly
mon_an.mo_ta: Thai Two-Layer Coconut and Water Chestnut Jelly, also known as Tako Haew – a type of rich coconut jelly with crunchy water chestnuts and a hint of pandan fragrance. It is absolutely wonderful to eat in the summer! Let's explore this dish together!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Cut cardboard into 5 rectangular pieces measuring 5x7cm. Fold the pieces in half, then glue the 5 pieces together at one half of the fold. Lay the folded cardboard strip onto a pandan leaf to use as a template, then mark the length and the lines between the pieces onto the pandan leaf.
Step 2: Cut the pandan leaves into long strips according to the template, fold them in half lengthwise, and then cut the marked vertical lines along the leaf.
Step 3: Fold the first two sections of the leaf inward; on the third fold, tuck the loose end over the first section according to the pattern.
To secure it, fold the final section of the leaf in, then tuck the loose end into a section at the bottom. Use a stapler to fix it in place.
Repeat this process for all the remaining pandan leaves!
Remember to set aside about 7-10 leaves, put them in a blender with a cup of water, blend thoroughly, and then strain the liquid to create food coloring.
Step 4: To make the first jelly layer, put the jasmine water and sugar into a large pan, add 700g of rice flour, and heat while stirring constantly.
To create a beautiful green color, add a little of the prepared pandan water to the mixture and stir. Then, add the water chestnuts, stir well, and pour this mixture into 1/2 of each mold.
Step 5: To make the coconut layer for the top, bring the coconut milk to a boil in a pot, then add the remaining rice flour and a pinch of salt. Stir constantly until the flour is cooked.
Step 6: Pour the coconut jelly layer to fill the pandan leaf trays. Let them cool completely before serving.

mon_an.mo_ta: You will be completely won over by this rich and unforgettable Filipino-style beefsteak. Let's check out this new beefsteak recipe!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
In this first step, we will make the marinade. Prepare a large bowl and combine the calamansi juice + soy sauce + salt + pepper + minced garlic, then mix well.
Next, add the beef to the bowl of marinade. Use chopsticks to toss the meat so the seasoning coats all sides.
After that, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 30-60 minutes.
Step 2:
While the beef is marinating, peel and cube the potatoes. Soak the cubed potatoes in salt water for about 10 minutes, then rinse and parboil them for 10 minutes.
After 10 minutes, turn off the heat, remove the potatoes, and let them cool.
Step 3:
Once the potatoes have cooled, heat oil in a pan until very hot, then fry the potatoes until golden brown.
When the potatoes are golden, remove them and place on a plate lined with paper towels to drain the excess oil.
Step 4:
After frying all the potatoes, use the same pan. Add more oil if needed (if there is enough oil left, you don't need to add more), and fry the marinated beef from the fridge.
While frying the beef, flip it continuously for 5-7 minutes so it cooks evenly on both sides without burning.
Note: You should only fry the beef over medium heat. Avoid high heat as the meat will burn quickly and become tough, and avoid low heat as it will take much longer to cook.
Once the meat is cooked, remove it to a plate.
Step 5:
Slice the onions into rings and flash-fry them in the pan for about 15 seconds. Once done, place the onions and fried potatoes on top of the beef.
Step 6:
Now, pour the remaining marinade into the pan, add 125ml of water, and bring to a boil. Adjust the seasoning to taste for a rich sauce.
Then, drizzle the sauce over the plate of beef, onions, and fried potatoes.
Your Filipino-style beefsteak is now complete.
Final requirements:
The meat is evenly cooked, not burnt, rich in flavor, and perfectly seasoned.
The fried potatoes are cooked through and golden brown.
The onions are just cooked and not burnt.
The marinade sauce is well-balanced, not too salty or too bland.
Adding potatoes enhances the flavor and prevents the dish from being too heavy; you can also substitute fried potatoes with mashed potatoes for an equally attractive version!
Enjoy immediately while hot with steamed rice for a perfect meal.

mon_an.mo_ta: Hello everyone, today we will cook a delicious Bò sốt vang (Vietnamese Beef Stew with Red Wine) to treat the whole family. This dish is tasty, easy to make, and pairs perfectly with white rice or bread. It is also very convenient for large parties.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare ingredients
Wash the beef and cut into cubes about 1.2cm thick.
Peel the garlic, leaving the thin purple skin layer closest to the clove, then crush.
Step 2: Marinate the beef
Place the beef in a pot and marinate with 1/2 of the garlic, salt, seasoning powder, a bit of fish sauce, pepper, and 1/2 glass of red wine for 30-35 minutes.
Step 3:
Heat a little cooking oil in a pan until very hot, then sauté the remaining garlic until fragrant...
... Then add the marinated beef and stir-fry until the meat is seared and firm. Remove from heat and set the meat aside on a plate.
Step 4: Sauté tomatoes
Finely chop the tomato and remove the seeds. Heat a pan with a little oil and sauté the tomato until soft and fully broken down.
Step 5: Stew the beef

Add the seared beef, softened tomatoes, tomato sauce, and the remaining 1/2 glass of red wine into a pot. Pour in enough water to just cover the meat, then add the star anise and cinnamon sticks. Simmer until the beef is tender (about 40-50 minutes).

Next, dissolve the tapioca starch in room-temperature water and slowly pour the slurry into the pot while stirring to create a smooth, glossy sauce. Bring back to a boil, then turn off the heat. Find and remove the star anise and cinnamon sticks.
Serve the beef stew in a bowl, sprinkle with cilantro and black pepper. Enjoy hot with bread or white rice. The aroma of this dish is truly irresistible.
The finished Bò sốt vang will look like this.
Notes for a delicious Bò sốt vang:
Red wine is essential for this dish. Red wine is more fragrant and flavorful than white wine for this recipe.
If you don't have store-bought tomato sauce, you can use fresh tomatoes, cut them into wedges, and simmer them until they break down into a sauce.
Depending on your taste, adding cinnamon and star anise gives the dish a very seductive aroma.
If you have a pressure cooker, you only need to simmer for 15-20 minutes. Remember to use less water than in a regular pot.
This recipe serves 4 people; please adjust the ingredients accordingly for more guests.

mon_an.ten: Korean Grilled Chicken Wings with Kiwi
mon_an.mo_ta: Korean grilled chicken wings with an attractive sauce, tender meat, and crispy skin will be impossible to resist. Let's get into the kitchen and make this delicious dish with these instructions!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Black pepper, dried chili, cooking oil - as needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the marinade ingredients: mince the garlic and ginger, cube the kiwi, and finely chop the green onions.
Step 2: Next, put the ginger, garlic, onions, kiwi, chili, pepper, sesame seeds, and sugar into a large bowl, then add the soy sauce and rice vinegar.
Step 3: Mix all the ingredients thoroughly.
Step 4: Marinate the chicken in the sauce for 4-8 hours to allow the flavors to penetrate. (You should cover the chicken tightly to avoid absorbing odors from other foods).

Step 5: Preheat the oven to 205°C (or you can use a charcoal grill). Arrange the chicken on a tray and bake for 30 minutes. Then, flip the meat and continue baking for another 15 minutes until both sides are golden brown.
Step 6: For the remaining marinade, put it in a blender and blend until smooth!
Step 7: Pour the blended sauce into a pot and simmer until it thickens.
Step 8: Finally, place the chicken in a bowl, pour the thickened sauce over it, and toss well so the wings are evenly coated.

mon_an.ten: Chinese-Style Steamed Broccoli with Shrimp Mousse
mon_an.mo_ta: Chinese-style steamed broccoli with shrimp mousse is a delicious and attractive dish, featuring the sweetness and richness of shrimp, crunchy broccoli, and vibrant colors. Let's learn how to make this delicacy!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, pepper, seasoning, a little sesame oil and cornstarch - as needed
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Peel the shrimp and remove the veins. Lightly massage the shrimp with salt and cornstarch, then rinse clean. Pat the shrimp dry with paper towels.
Finely mince the shrimp and place in a bowl. Add rice wine, salt, pepper, seasoning, and egg whites. Use a bundle of chopsticks to vigorously whisk the mixture until it becomes sticky and springy.
Add the pork fat, sesame oil, and cornstarch. Mix well and refrigerate the shrimp mousse for 2-3 hours.
Step 2:
Cut the broccoli into small florets (about 4cm), wash them, and blanch briefly in boiling water with a pinch of salt.
Remove and immediately submerge in cold water to maintain the vibrant green color. Drain well and dust the surface with cornstarch.
Step 3:
Take the shrimp mousse out of the fridge and spread it onto the broccoli florets, about 0.5 - 0.7cm thick.
Steam the shrimp mousse over high heat for about 6 minutes.
Step 4:
While steaming, combine the sauce ingredients in another pot and bring to a boil. Once the shrimp mousse is cooked, arrange on a plate and drizzle the sauce over each broccoli floret before serving.

mon_an.mo_ta: In chilly weather, nothing is better than eating this spicy and delicious kimchi fried rice!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 1 bowl of hot rice (brown rice can be used)
cac_buoc: Here are the ingredients you need to prepare!
Step 1:
Finely chop the kimchi and green onions. Cut the pork into small pieces and marinate with soy sauce, seasoning, and pepper for 15 minutes.
Step 2:
Prepare all ingredients. For the eggs, crack them into a bowl, whisk well, and scramble them in a pan with hot oil.
Step 3:
Add the pork and green onions to a pan with oil and stir-fry. When the meat is just cooked, remove to a bowl. Sautéing with green onions will make the meat more fragrant.
Step 4:
Stir-fry the rice and kimchi together in another pan.
Step 5:
Add the cooked pork and scrambled eggs, then toss everything together.
The attractive fried rice dish is now finished!
To keep the dish from being too salty, you can serve it with some boiled vegetables to balance the flavors!
If the amount of kimchi isn't "spicy enough" for you, you can serve extra kimchi on the side!

mon_an.mo_ta: If you're wondering what to do with leftover rice rather than letting it go to waste or eating it dry, this recipe is the perfect solution for a nutritious breakfast. Check out the recipe for this delicious kimchi fried rice below.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Break up the cold rice to prevent clumping during frying.
Squeeze the excess liquid from the kimchi and chop into small pieces.
Crack the egg into a bowl and beat well.
Peel and mince the shallot and garlic.

Step 2: Place a pan over heat and add cooking oil. Once hot, sauté the shallot and garlic until golden. Add the rice and toss lightly, then pour the egg evenly over the rice and stir quickly to combine. Stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until the rice grains are firm and well-coated with the egg.

Add the chopped kimchi to the pan and fry with the rice until the grains are dry, crispy, and to your liking. Turn off the heat, add the soy sauce, oyster sauce, sesame oil, sesame seeds, and green onions. Mix well and adjust seasoning to taste.

mon_an.mo_ta: Korean Mixed Rice (Bibimbap) is a favorite for many, especially young people. However, this dish requires patience and meticulousness in preparation and presentation to make it look its most attractive. Let's learn how to make simple Bibimbap at home!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Button mushrooms or shiitake mushrooms - 100 g
Salt, oyster sauce, cooking oil - to taste
Bibimbap sauce or Korean chili paste (Gochujang) - as desired
cac_buoc: Wash the choy sum and cut into 2-finger long segments.
Peel the carrot, wash, and julienne into lengths similar to the greens.
Mix a little starch with water and wash the mushrooms to remove dirt, then slice them.

Wash the bean sprouts and drain. Sauté 1 tsp of minced garlic with oil until fragrant, then add the sprouts and stir-fry, seasoning with salt to taste. Use the remaining 3 tsp of minced garlic to sauté the choy sum, carrots, and mushrooms separately (when frying mushrooms, use oyster sauce instead of salt for better flavor). Keep each ingredient in separate piles.
Fry the egg sunny-side up or keep the yolk raw to place in the center of the bowl.
Heat a bowl or stone pot, add the rice, and flatten it with a spoon. Arrange the beef, choy sum, carrots, mushrooms, bean sprouts, and egg on top beautifully.

If using chili sauce, drizzle with sesame oil and add the sauce directly to the bowl. If using Gochujang, you can prepare a custom sauce by mixing 2 parts chili paste: 1 part sesame oil: 1 part sugar: 1 part water: 1 part roasted sesame: 1 tsp vinegar: 1 pinch of salt.
When ready to eat, mix everything thoroughly so all ingredients are well-coated with the sauce and enjoy.

mon_an.mo_ta: Korean Patbingsu features a combination of various fruits like strawberries, bananas, and kiwi for vibrant colors, along with the richness of milk and vanilla essence. This will be an incredibly attractive summer snack.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, wash the red beans thoroughly with water.
Step 2:
Put the washed beans into a heavy-bottomed pot, add water, and bring to a boil over medium-low heat for 10 minutes. Then, reduce the heat to the lowest setting and simmer for another 1 hour.
Step 3:
Once the beans are soft, pour them through a sieve and drain the water.
Return the beans to the pot, add sugar, vanilla essence, and salt, then mix gently.
Step 4:
Cook the seasoned beans over low heat for about 5 minutes. Do not cover the pot and stir gently.
Turn off the heat, let it cool, and place the stewed beans in the refrigerator.
Step 5:
Cut the fruit into bite-sized pieces.
Step 6:

Finally, scoop about 100g of the stewed red beans into a glass. Add shaved ice on top and arrange the fruit as the top layer. Drizzle with condensed milk and sprinkle with some cooked, chopped rice cakes to finish.
Enjoy your shaved ice!
You can drizzle extra syrup on top for more appeal!

mon_an.ten: Korean Spicy Pan-Fried Tofu with Egg
mon_an.mo_ta: Tofu and egg dishes are very familiar, but this Korean-style variation will surprise you with its unique preparation and flavor.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Thick tofu blocks - 2 blocks (or 6-8 regular pieces)
Seasoning: pepper, salt, sugar, sesame oil, canola oil
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, if using large tofu blocks, cut them into smaller bite-sized pieces.
Step 2:
Season the tofu with a little salt and set aside.
Step 3:
To make the sauce, mix the chili flakes, onion, sesame seeds, soy sauce, tomato sauce, a little sugar, and pepper in a bowl.
Step 4:
Add about 1/2 bowl of water and stir well.
Step 5:
Now, let's fry the tofu! Pat each piece of tofu dry before frying.
Step 6:
Place the tofu in a pan with hot oil and fry each side for about 3 minutes until just turning golden.
Step 7:
Once the tofu is evenly fried, pour the sauce into the pan and bring to a boil.
Step 8:
Once boiling, cover the pan tightly, turn the heat to low, and simmer for another 10 minutes. After 10 minutes, adjust the seasoning to taste.
Step 9:
Crack the eggs one by one into the pan and continue to cook. Cover the pan after adding the eggs so the whites set while the yolks remain soft.
Step 10:
Finally, when the eggs are cooked, sprinkle green onions on top and it's done.
This dish is excellent served with black bean sticky rice or simply plain white rice!

mon_an.ten: Authentic Chinese Pork and Shrimp Dim Sum
mon_an.mo_ta: Today, we will guide you through the sophisticated technique of making Chinese pork and shrimp dim sum. This dish uses simple ingredients but is highly nutritious and incredibly appealing.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Sugar, salt, pepper, sesame oil, water - seasonings
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Wash the pork tenderloin, pat dry, and dice into 0.5cm cubes.
Blanch the pork fat in boiling water to remove any odor, then dice into 0.2cm cubes.
Peel the shrimp, wash with salt water, pat dry, and chop finely.
Step 2:

Place the pork tenderloin in a large bowl, add salt, cornstarch, and water. Use a bundle of chopsticks to stir vigorously in one direction until the meat becomes elastic and sticky, then add the shrimp and mix well.
Add the pork fat, shiitake mushrooms, and the remaining seasonings to the bowl. Note that using too many mushrooms can make the filling taste sour!
Step 3:
Cut the wrappers into circles. Place a sufficient amount of filling (about 2 small spoons) in the center and carefully pleat the edges.
Step 4:
Place the dim sum in a steamer lined with parchment paper to prevent sticking and steam over high heat for 6 minutes. If desired, you can garnish with crab roe or minced carrots before steaming.

mon_an.mo_ta: This Korean-style spicy chicken stew with its rich and authentic spicy flavor will make you fall in love instantly! Let's learn how to make it!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Chicken, cut into pieces, skin removed - 1.5 kg
Potatoes, peeled and cut into bite-sized pieces - 450g
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, wash the chicken and let it drain.
Step 2:
Mix all the marinade ingredients together in a large bowl.
Step 3:
Add all the chicken to the marinade bowl and toss gently until thoroughly coated.
Step 4:
While waiting for the chicken to marinate, boil the kelp in water in a small pot for 5-7 minutes. Then, place the marinated chicken into a deep pot and pour in the kelp stock.
Step 5:
Do not use too much water; just pour enough stock to barely cover the surface of the chicken.
Step 6:
Bring the chicken to a boil, then lower the heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
Step 7:
Add the onions and carrots and continue to cook over medium heat for 10 minutes.
Step 8:
Next, add the potatoes to the pot, stir gently, and cook for another 10-15 minutes until the vegetables and chicken are tender.
Step 9:
When the vegetables are soft, leave the lid slightly ajar to allow steam to escape and thicken the sauce.
Step 10:
Finally, sprinkle green onions and green chilies over the chicken, stir gently, and turn off the heat.
The spicy chicken stew is now complete!
Serve on a plate with hot rice for a delicious meal!

mon_an.ten: Simple and Delicious Homemade Korean Kimbap
mon_an.mo_ta: Korean Kimbap is a famous and essential dish. It's delicious and easy to make, perfect for picnics or outings with friends. Check out the kimbap recipe below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Cooked short-grain rice (or a 2:1 mix of glutinous and regular rice)
Sausage (or grilled meat, fish, or minced beef)
cac_buoc: Step 1:

Fry the eggs. Cut the cucumber, carrots, and eggs into long strips. Boil the carrots after cutting, then mix with a little sesame oil and salt. Mix the cucumber with a little garlic vinegar. Cut each sausage into 4 long strips.
Mix the cooked rice thoroughly with sesame oil and a pinch of salt for flavor.
Step 2:
Lay out a seaweed sheet and spread a thin, even layer of rice over it, leaving a small strip at the top edge without rice.
Note: Brush a thin layer of sesame oil on the seaweed before adding rice to reduce the seaweed smell and prevent the rice from sticking.
Step 3:
Arrange the cucumber, sausage, egg, and carrot in the center, then gently roll it up tightly with your fingers.
If you can roll it tightly by hand, a bamboo mat isn't necessary, but using one helps make the kimbap firm and beautiful.
Repeat with the remaining ingredients.
Step 4:
Coat your knife with a layer of sesame oil so the rice doesn't stick while cutting.
Gently slice into bite-sized pieces and arrange on a plate.
Your Korean kimbap is finished! You can make this for lunch, picnics, or outings with friends—it's fantastic!

mon_an.mo_ta: Follow this recipe to create a spicy noodle dish with the authentic flavors of the land of Kimchi! Today's article will guide you through making delicious Korean spicy noodles.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Korean noodles - 4 servings (can use egg noodles or instant Korean noodles)
Seasonings - Pepper, broth powder, sugar, salt
cac_buoc: Preparing the broth is the first essential step!
Wash the chicken bones and blanch them in boiling water to remove impurities.
Wash the radish, peel lightly, and cut into bite-sized cubes.
Place 4-5 cups of water in a pot, add the chicken bones and radish with a pinch of salt, and simmer for 20-30 minutes. Strain the broth through a sieve.
Let's prepare the ingredients:
Wash the squid and cut into rings about half a finger thick.
Peel the shrimp and devein them.
Trim the roots of the enoki mushrooms, wash, soak in salt water for 5 minutes, then drain.
Trim the zucchini, wash, halve, and slice thinly.
Wash and thinly slice the leeks diagonally.
Wash the clam shells (soak in rice water for 30 minutes to remove sand).
Wash the pork and slice into small bite-sized pieces.
Now, let's cook the spicy noodles!
Heat oil in a pan and sauté the garlic until fragrant. Add the pork, shrimp, squid, and whole clams. Stir-fry until the meat is firm and the clams just start to open. Turn off the heat.
Blanch the noodles in boiling water until soft but not sticky, then place them in bowls.

Bring the chicken broth to a boil in a pot or stone bowl. Add chili flakes to your desired spice level, then season with sugar and salt to taste. Add the kimchi, zucchini, and enoki mushrooms and bring back to a boil. Finally, add the sautéed pork, shrimp, squid, and clams into the broth and stir. If you like it extra spicy, you can add a paste of fresh minced chilies mixed with Korean chili powder. Add the leeks and turn off the heat.
Ladle the broth over the noodles and enjoy!
This spicy noodle dish is best served hot. The heat of the chili, the sweetness of the seafood broth, the slight tang of the kimchi, and the chewy Korean noodles make it irresistible!
This is a seafood version, but if you don't like seafood, you can adapt this Jjamppong recipe with chicken or beef. Using authentic Korean noodles provides the best signature flavor.

mon_an.ten: Chilled Green Tea Ice Cream Mochi
mon_an.mo_ta: On hot days, eating green tea ice cream mochi is absolutely wonderful! Let's learn how to make this delicious treat!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Small vanilla ice cream scoops - 9-10 scoops
cac_buoc: Step 1: Thoroughly mix the mochi flour and matcha powder together, then slowly pour in the water while stirring constantly.
Step 2: Mix the sugar into the flour mixture until smooth and well combined.

Step 3: Cover the bowl tightly with plastic wrap and microwave for about 1 minute. Take it out, stir well, cover again, and microwave for another 1 minute. (If you don't have a microwave, you can steam the mixture until it thickens and becomes translucent and chewy).
Step 4: Remove the dough from the bowl and knead thoroughly until smooth. Use potato starch as a dusting flour to prevent sticking.
Step 5: Place the dough on a surface dusted with starch, then sprinkle more starch to cover the dough.
Step 6: Roll the dough out thinly, cut into small pieces, and wrap around the ice cream scoops.
Arrange the green tea mochi on a plate and enjoy. It is best enjoyed fresh! If not eating immediately, store the mochi in the freezer.

mon_an.mo_ta: Although this is a Korean dish, kimchi is very familiar to many. Try making this braised pork with kimchi this weekend to treat your family!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Wash the green onions and chop into small segments.
Clean the pork belly skin, wash, and drain. Cut into 3cm cubes. Marinate the meat with a bit of minced ginger, garlic, and kimchi juice to let the flavors penetrate.
Step 2:
Squeeze the excess liquid from the kimchi and cut into bite-sized pieces.

Place the kimchi in the pot with the pork, add the kimchi juice, water, and chili powder. Bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to medium. Simmer the pork and kimchi until tender. If the liquid evaporates too quickly, reduce the heat further or add a little more water.
Step 3:
When the pork is nearly done, add the green onions, toss quickly, and turn off the heat.
Transfer the braised pork and kimchi to a bowl or plate and garnish as desired. It's fantastic served hot with rice.

mon_an.mo_ta: This new version of ratatouille will delight you with its irresistible aroma and flavor!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 650g fresh tomato sauce (store-bought jarred sauce is fine; if making from scratch, simmer peeled tomatoes with oil and salt for about 30 minutes)
cac_buoc: Ingredients you need to prepare:
Step 1:
Clean and dice all the vegetables, including the eggplant, onions, bell peppers, and zucchinis.
Step 2:
Sauté the eggplant with olive oil (or cooking oil) and a pinch of salt. Cook over medium heat for about 10 minutes.
Step 3:
Remove the eggplant from the pot. Add the onions and sauté with a little oil and salt for 10 minutes.
Step 4:
Similarly, remove the softened onions and sauté the bell peppers with oil and salt for 5 minutes.
Step 5:
Transfer the bell peppers to a bowl and sauté the zucchinis with oil and salt for another 5 minutes.
Step 6:
When the zucchinis have softened, add all the other sautéed vegetables back into the pot. Add the minced garlic and tomato sauce, then mix well.
Step 7:
Cook the vegetable mixture until it reaches a light simmer, then reduce the heat and stew for another 40 minutes.
This version is just as appealing as the oven-baked one!
This Ratatouille is very convenient as it can be kept for up to 1 week!

mon_an.mo_ta: Many of us are aware of the wonderful health benefits of salmon. However, salmon is often limited to raw dishes with soy sauce and wasabi, pan-searing, or porridge. With this salad recipe, you have an exciting new option to enjoy fresh salmon. Salmon salad makes a wonderful appetizer for guests, who will surely be impressed by its beautiful colors and delicious taste.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Pat the salmon dry with a clean towel or paper towel, then cut into bite-sized cubes. Keep in the refrigerator while preparing the other ingredients.
Step 2: Thinly slice the shallot. Finely chop the green onions.
Step 3: In a small bowl, mix the shallot, green onions, chili garlic sauce, toasted sesame seeds, sesame oil, and soy sauce.
Step 4: Take the salmon out of the fridge, add it to the bowl with the mixture (or vice versa), and gently toss with a spoon until the fish is evenly coated.
Step 5: Finally, divide into 8 equal portions and serve immediately.

mon_an.ten: How to Make BBQ Ribs in the Microwave
mon_an.mo_ta: BBQ ribs are an appealing dish often favored at parties. You can use your microwave to cook BBQ ribs quickly and easily. Let's learn how to make super fast BBQ ribs in the microwave using this recipe. This guide uses special techniques and basic ingredients to create fragrant, tender, and flavorful BBQ ribs in just a few minutes.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare ingredients

After purchasing the ribs, wash them with diluted salt water and blanch in boiling water to remove impurities. Cut the ribs into pieces about 5cm long and 2 ribs wide. Squeeze the juice from a lemon, peel the garlic, and wash the chili and fresh peppercorns.
Step 2: Marinate the ribs

Place the ribs in a large bowl and add the prepared seasonings: minced garlic and chili, crushed fresh peppercorns, 3 tbsp honey, 1.5 tbsp seasoning powder, 1 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp MSG, 1 tsp ground pepper, 1 tbsp lemon juice, and 2 tbsp cooking oil. Mix well and let the ribs marinate for 30 minutes. You can keep the ribs in the refrigerator to marinate longer for better flavor.
Step 3: Grill the ribs in the microwave

Arrange the marinated ribs on a tray and brush a layer of oil over them. Grill in the microwave at 180°C. Grill for 15 minutes, then remove and flip the ribs over. Continue grilling for another 15 minutes. Occasionally, brush the remaining marinade over the ribs to prevent them from drying out and to keep them tender. After the second 15-minute interval, the ribs will be evenly cooked with an attractive color.
Step 4: Finish and garnish
Once the BBQ ribs are cooked, arrange them on a plate and garnish to enjoy with your family.
Notes for making BBQ ribs in the microwave
When making BBQ ribs in the microwave, keep these important points in mind:
Choose the right ribs: Select fresh baby back ribs with even fat distribution that aren't too thick.
Prepare ingredients: Wash the ribs and all spices before marinating. Ensure all ingredients are fresh.
Marinating time: To let the flavors penetrate, marinate for at least 30 minutes. If possible, marinate overnight for better results.
Select grilling mode: Use the grill mode or a combination of grill and microwave to ensure the ribs are cooked through and crispy. Adjust the heat and time according to your specific microwave.
Brush with marinade: During the cooking process, re-apply the marinade to prevent drying and enhance the flavor.
Check for doneness: After each cooking interval, check the ribs by piercing the meat with a bamboo skewer. If it goes in easily and the meat is no longer pink, the ribs are done.
Microwave safety: Follow all safety instructions for your microwave, including using protective gear like gloves when handling hot food.

mon_an.ten: Delicious and Simple Homemade Sushi Rolls
mon_an.mo_ta: Sushi is no longer a stranger to us; originating from the Land of the Rising Sun, it has become a world-famous delicacy. This dish is very easy to make; you can completely prepare it for yourself and your family to enjoy, or take it on picnics and outings. With this sushi-making method, you will have perfectly authentic Japanese-style sushi!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Japanese rice - 2 cups (if unavailable, use 1.5 cups white rice and 0.5 cups glutinous rice)
Sushi fillings - Fried egg, crab sticks, cucumber, avocado
cac_buoc: Ingredients needed for delicious sushi:
Step 1: Cook the rice
Rinse the Japanese rice thoroughly, then soak in water for 4 hours and cook as usual.
Once the rice is cooked, use a rice paddle to fluff it up and transfer to a bowl.
Mix the sesame oil, vinegar, salt, and sugar according to the ratio mentioned above, then drizzle over the rice. Mix gently so the rice is sticky but not mashed. Let the rice cool before rolling.
Step 2: Make the fried egg
Crack 2 eggs into a bowl and season with 1 tsp salt, 2 tsp sugar, ½ tsp MSG, and 1 tsp seasoning powder. Whisk the eggs quickly and evenly with chopsticks.
Add a little oil to a pan and pour in the mixture. Cover and cook until the egg is set. You can also fry the egg in a pan the traditional way.
Once the egg is cooked, cut it into long, thin strips.
Step 3: Roll the sushi

Regular roll (seaweed on the outside): First, lay out the bamboo mat, place a sheet of nori on top, and spread the rice evenly. Arrange the ingredients—cucumber, fried egg, sliced crab sticks, and avocado—then carefully roll it up tightly so it holds its shape when the mat is removed. Use a very sharp knife (moistened with a bit of water) to cut the roll into small slices.

Alternatively, you can make an inside-out roll (rice on the outside): After spreading the rice on the nori, flip it over so the rice layer is underneath the nori. Then roll the sushi just like the regular method.
Step 4:
Prepare the dipping sauce: Mix soy sauce with 1 tsp vinegar, 1 tsp sugar, and ½ tsp chili powder. Add a little cilantro for garnish.
And there you have it, delicious sushi is complete!
Tips for choosing great sushi ingredients
Buying good rice

Japanese rice is the soul of sushi, known for being soft, fragrant, and not falling apart when prepared. Choosing the right rice requires some knowledge. Here are tips for selecting authentic Japanese rice:
Shape: Japanese rice grains are round, similar to Vietnamese A Sao glutinous rice. Choose grains that are not broken and are uniform in size.
Color: Japanese rice has a natural white color. Check carefully and avoid grains that look unnaturally chalky or bleached.
Taste: Don't hesitate to bite a grain to check. Quality Japanese rice should have moderate hardness, and the rice powder should taste sweet with a natural aroma.
If you have time, try cooking a small amount first. Good Japanese rice will release a pleasant aroma, remain sticky even when cold, and have a distinct sweet aftertaste.
How to choose fresh salmon
To create perfect sushi, salmon is essential. Choose pre-filleted salmon to save time. Here are tips for picking good salmon:
Check elasticity: Gently press the flesh with your finger; if it bounces back without leaving an indentation, it is fresh.
Color: Choose salmon that is bright orange or pink. Avoid pieces with uneven or dark coloring, which indicates the fish is old or spoiled.
Scent: Fresh salmon fillets should have a dry surface and a characteristic mild scent, with no slime or unpleasant odor.
Notes for making great sushi rolls
Choose fresh ingredients: Use fresh fish, seafood, vegetables, and Japanese rice for the best flavor.
Focus on the rice: Use high-quality sushi rice like Nishiki or Koshihikari for grains that are soft and glossy but not mushy.
Prepare sushi tools: You need a bamboo sushi mat (makisu) for rolling and a sharp sushi knife for clean cuts.
Wet your hands: Before handling the rice, dampen your hands with light salt water to prevent sticking and make shaping easier.
Adjust rice amount: Place a moderate amount of rice on the nori; do not press too hard or overfill, which makes rolling difficult.
Add flavor: Add a tiny bit of wasabi or sauce on the rice layer to enhance the flavor.
Roll tightly: Use the bamboo mat to roll firmly and evenly to ensure the sushi doesn't fall apart.
Cut beautiful slices: Use a very sharp knife to cut even, firm slices without crushing the roll.
Serve with ginger and sauce: Enjoy your sushi with pickled ginger and soy sauce for the best experience.

mon_an.ten: How to Make a Unique 8-Layer Sushi Rice Tower
mon_an.mo_ta: A unique dish in both content and appearance—eye-catching, attractive, delicious, and extremely easy to make. It doesn't take much time or effort to create this "made by me" 8-layer sushi tower. Let's get into the kitchen and try this sushi tower recipe!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, finely chop the mushrooms, carrot, and cucumber.
Step 2:
Boil the mushrooms until cooked, then add a little salt, sugar, and soy sauce. Once cooked, remove and drain well.
Step 3:
Boil the carrot with a bit of salt and sesame oil. When the carrot is cooked, remove and drain as well.
Step 4:
Mix the cucumber with a little salt and sesame oil.
Step 5:
Next, fry the egg into a very thin omelet, then cut it into thin shreds.
Step 6:
Mix the rice with pepper, sugar, vinegar, and sesame oil until well combined.
Step 7:
Line a cup (about 15cm tall) with plastic wrap, then place the shredded egg at the bottom.
Step 8:

Add a layer of rice and press down firmly, followed by a layer of carrot and another layer of rice, pressing firmly again. Repeat the process with the mushrooms and cucumber until you have completed this interesting, delicious, and beautiful 8-layer sushi rice tower!
This dish is not only beautiful and unique on the outside, but also packed with nutrients from the vegetables and mushrooms, making it perfect for a balanced meal!

mon_an.ten: Korean BBQ Pork with Delicious Pear Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: Korean BBQ pork gets a fresh twist with a special pear sauce, promising an irresistible and delicious flavor!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Marinade: 1 pear, 1 small onion, 8 garlic cloves, 15g ginger, 2 green onions, 60ml soy sauce, 30g sugar, 15ml sesame oil, 5g pepper, 100ml Korean chili paste (Gochujang)
Side salad: 1 head of lettuce, 200g red cabbage, 4 green onions, 1 carrot, 3 garlic cloves, 30ml soy sauce, 30ml vinegar, 30g sugar, 15ml sesame oil
cac_buoc: Check the ingredients and prepare everything for this delicious grilled meat!
Step 1:
First, to make the marinade, peel and dice the pear and onion.
Step 2:
Place the garlic, pear, onion, and ginger in a blender and blend until completely smooth.
Step 3:
Pour the blended sauce into a bowl, then add the soy sauce, sesame oil, and pepper.
Step 4:
Finely chop the green onions.
Step 5:
Add the green onions and sugar to the sauce and mix well.
Step 6:
Slice the pork into bite-sized pieces. Place the meat and sauce into a large food-grade plastic bag and marinate for 24 hours.
After marinating, thread the meat onto skewers and grill until evenly browned.
Step 7:
To make the side salad, shred the cabbage, green onions, and carrot.
Step 8:
Mix the soy sauce, sesame oil, and sugar together. Pour over the prepared vegetables and toss well with minced garlic until the vegetables are seasoned.
When eating, wrap the meat in lettuce leaves with the salad and kimchi!
This wrap is so fun and delicious to eat!
Meat marinated with this pear sauce recipe is both tender and fragrant!

mon_an.ten: How to Cook Refreshing Seaweed and Mushroom Soup
mon_an.mo_ta: Seaweed and mushroom soup with meatballs is delicious, attractive, and healthy—perfect for cold winter days. Take some time to try this recipe; it's very easy and doesn't take much time at all!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the bones, blanch them in boiling water, then rinse again. Add fresh water and simmer to make a broth.
Step 2: Soak the shiitake mushrooms until soft, wash, and drain.
Step 3: You can either roll the ground pork into small balls or drop it directly into the boiling broth.
Step 4: Add the meatballs to the broth, bring to a boil until the meat is thoroughly cooked, and skim off any foam.
Step 5: Add the mushrooms to the boiling pot and cook thoroughly.
Step 6: Finally, add the seaweed. When the soup returns to a boil, season to taste and turn off the heat.

mon_an.mo_ta: Get in the kitchen with these super delicious Tom Yum flavored grilled chicken wings; you and your family will absolutely love them!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Finely mince the galangal, lemongrass, and shallot.
Step 2:
In a bowl, mix all the seasonings: Tom Yum paste, galangal, lemongrass, shallot, lime juice, fish sauce, and sugar.
Step 3:
Wash the chicken wings and cut them in half at the joint.
Step 4:
Add the chicken wings to the marinade bowl and marinate overnight or for at least 2 hours. Cover with plastic wrap and keep in the refrigerator.
Step 5:
Place the chicken on a grill rack, flipping once until the chicken is cooked through and golden brown on both sides.
The fragrant Tom Yum grilled chicken wings are ready!
Serve on a plate and enjoy while hot!
The grilled chicken is incredibly aromatic with the balanced sour, spicy, salty, and sweet flavors of Tom Yum.
A dish that truly captures the essence of Thai cuisine—Thai food lovers shouldn't miss this!

mon_an.mo_ta: Yardlong bean and shrimp cakes – a delicious daily dish to treat the whole family! The crunchy beans combined with sweet shrimp are a perfect match. Here is how to make them.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Blanch the beans in boiling water. Then, braid them into a circular floral spiral shape.
Step 2: Stuff the center with minced shrimp that has been marinated with salt, seasoning powder, pepper, oil, and a little minced shallot.
Step 3: Fry the shrimp-stuffed bean cakes in a pan with hot oil until golden. Note: add a little sesame oil while frying to make the dish more fragrant.
Source: Kenh14

mon_an.mo_ta: Thai-style black bean sweet soup is simple to cook but delicious, especially with the addition of rich, nutty cassava pearls that are both tasty and refreshing. Learn how to cook this familiar yet unique Thai-style dessert.
cac_buoc: Step 1: To cook the black beans, similar to the Vietnamese style, soak the beans then cook them with water and sugar until soft. Add pandan leaves while cooking to make the soup more fragrant. Season with sugar to taste.

Step 2: Peel and wash the cassava, grate it very finely, then use your hands to squeeze out the excess water. Place the cassava in a bowl and add two tablespoons of glutinous rice flour, half a teaspoon of salt, and one tablespoon of sugar. Mix well by hand until the mixture is doughy and sticky.
Step 3: To make the Thai-style version, roll the mixture from step 2 into equal-sized balls, then boil them in water. When they float to the surface, they are cooked.
Step 4: Add these cassava balls into the pot of black bean soup. Simmer over low heat so the balls can absorb the sugar. Serve in a bowl, either hot or cold.

mon_an.mo_ta: Mapo Tofu – a spicy and mouth-watering signature dish from Sichuan, China. Let's explore how to make Mapo Tofu through the content below. This article provides detailed, simple instructions from ingredient preparation to the cooking process. Create an amazing Mapo Tofu dish right at home to satisfy the whole family.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Finely mince the peeled ginger, garlic, and the white parts of the green onions. Sauté them in a pan until fragrant with the chili powder.
Step 2: Add the chili paste, oyster sauce, and sesame oil to the pan. Stir well with the ginger and garlic for about 1 minute.
Step 3: Add the ground pork and stir-fry evenly with the mixture. To make the Mapo Tofu more flavorful, remember to season with a bit of soy sauce.
Step 4: When the meat is nearly cooked, add the tofu to the pan. Since silken tofu is very delicate, stir gently or gently shake the pan to ensure the tofu is coated without breaking.
Step 5: Add a little water to the pan and simmer for about 3-5 minutes. Gently transfer to a plate and serve hot with rice. If you prefer firmer tofu, you can pan-fry it until golden before cooking.
How to choose fresh ingredients
How to choose delicious tofu

The first thing to look for when buying delicious tofu is the color. Good tofu is usually creamy white, with a characteristic aroma and the rich taste of soybeans. It should feel light in your hand, elastic, smooth, and not dry or hard.

Avoid pieces that are yellow or yellowish, as they may contain gypsum or have been sitting out for a long time. Additionally, tofu with a faint lime-like smell, a bland taste, or a dry, porous texture may contain impurities and should be avoided.
How to choose crunchy king oyster mushrooms

To choose fresh king oyster mushrooms, consider a few factors. Fresh mushrooms will have a vibrant color and a length of about 12 to 15cm. Avoid buying mushrooms that are too long, as they may be hollow and less flavorful inside.

Fresh mushrooms will have a thin layer of fuzz on the cap. The stem should be white, firm, and uniform in color. Choose mushrooms with a spherical, brown, glossy cap that has no scratches, tears, bruises, or wrinkles.
Fresh king oyster mushrooms will have a characteristic aroma, similar to almonds. Avoid buying mushrooms with an unpleasant odor or those that are crushed.
How to choose shiitake mushrooms
When choosing fresh shiitake mushrooms, there are a few things to note. The shape of dried shiitake is similar to fresh ones, but they are lighter due to the drying process.
Choose mushrooms that are not broken, with light brown caps, as the color usually doesn't change much when dried.
An important point is to observe the scent. Avoid buying mushrooms that are damp, moldy, or have a strange smell, and carefully check for any white mold spots.
This will help you choose fresh, high-quality shiitake mushrooms.

mon_an.mo_ta: It may look sophisticated, but this braised pork dish is actually easy to make. Let's get into the kitchen and prepare this famous Hangzhou (China) specialty to treat your whole family!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Shallots, ginger, star anise, cinnamon bark
Soy sauce, salt, sesame oil, rock sugar, pepper, cooking oil
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Wash all ingredients. Finely chop the bamboo shoots and mushrooms. Boil the dried preserved mustard greens briefly and drain well.
Step 2:
Wash and mince the shallots and ginger, then sauté them in a pan until fragrant. Add the dried mustard greens to the pan, stir-fry for 1 minute, then add the shiitake mushrooms.
Step 3:
Add all the chopped bamboo shoots to the pan and stir-fry with the mustard greens and mushrooms, stirring constantly.
Add a bit of soy sauce, cooking wine, sugar, and pepper; season to taste.
Step 4:
Prepare a pot of water. Add the pork, star anise, ginger, a piece of shallot, cinnamon bark, and bay leaves, then bring to a boil.
Once boiling, pour in some wine. Simmer the meat over low heat until it is no longer red inside. Add a little salt, stir to dissolve, then remove from heat and turn off the stove.

Do not remove the meat immediately; let it soak in the pot for 2 hours to absorb the flavors. Then, bring it to a boil once more. Once boiling, turn off the heat, remove the meat, and rub sesame oil over it while it is still hot.
Do not discard the cooking liquid; keep it to make the sauce later!
Step 5:
Once the pork skin is dry and cool, fry the meat in a pan until golden brown as shown in the picture. Fry with the skin side down!

After frying, place the meat on a cutting board. Let it cool slightly and slice the meat thinly (about 2 cm) in a continuous strip without cutting all the way through (as shown). To make it easier to slice, you can chill the meat in the fridge first.
Step 6:
After slicing, roll the meat back up as shown and use a toothpick to secure it so it doesn't fall apart.
Now comes the skillful part: use your fingers to gently push the center up from the inside to create a pyramid shape. Fill the inside with the bamboo, mushroom, and mustard green mixture from Step 3.
Step 7:
Place the pyramid-shaped meat into a steamer and steam for 30 minutes.
Step 8:
While waiting for the meat, trim the broccoli, wash it, and boil it. Add a little salt to the water to season it and keep the vegetables green.
Step 9:
Now prepare the sauce. Mix some of the pork cooking liquid with sesame oil and cornstarch. Simmer until thickened, then turn off the heat.
Once the meat is steamed, place it on a plate, arrange the boiled broccoli around it, and pour the sauce over the top.
Ta-da! The pyramid braised pork is finished.
This dish is not only delicious but also beautifully presented, making everyone want to try it immediately.
You can replace broccoli with bok choy for an equally attractive and eye-catching look!

mon_an.mo_ta: Roast turkey is a favorite for Christmas parties. Let's learn how to make this dish through the following article! Hopefully, this guide will help you prepare a delicious meal for your holiday feast.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Potatoes - 500 g, peeled, washed, quartered, and drained
Carrots - 300 g, washed, carved into flowers, and sliced 4-5cm thick
Onion - 1 bulb, peeled, washed, and cut into 6 wedges
Twine - Enough to tie the legs and wings
Cherry tomatoes - 500 g (mix of red and yellow)
cac_buoc: Roasting the turkey:
Clean the turkey and pat dry.

In a pot, combine the water, a bit of salt, and all the sugar. Stir to dissolve, then add the turkey and turn it over to coat with the mixture. Add more water to fully submerge the turkey. Brine the turkey in the refrigerator for at least 2-4 hours. If possible, overnight is best.
After brining, remove the turkey, rinse it, and remove the neck. Use a towel to pat the turkey completely dry.
Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Mix all the remaining seasonings together. Wear gloves and rub the spices all over the skin and inside the cavity of the turkey.
Stuff some of the vegetables into the cavity, then use twine to tie the legs and tuck the wings.
Place the remaining vegetables in a roasting tray, drizzle with olive oil, toss to coat, and spread them out evenly.
Brush a layer of olive oil and melted butter over the entire turkey skin, then place the turkey on top of the vegetables in the tray, breast side up.

Place the turkey in the oven. After about 30 minutes, take it out, brush with more olive oil and butter, and return to the oven. During roasting, take the turkey out every 10-15 minutes to baste with oil and butter, turning the bird to ensure even browning. Roast until the turkey is cooked through and the skin is golden and crispy on all sides.
Transfer the turkey to a platter and cover tightly with foil for about 15 minutes. This step prevents the turkey from drying out.
Decoration:
Wash the tomatoes and drain.
Wash the quail eggs, boil until hard-cooked, and peel.
Wash the broccoli and cut into florets. Blanch in boiling water, then immediately plunge into cold water to keep them green and crunchy.
Slice the cheese thinly and use a mold or knife to cut into flowers or desired patterns.
On a large platter, place the roasted potatoes, carrots, and onions in the center. Arrange the broccoli around them and place the turkey on top.
Place the cheese flowers on the turkey breast and scatter the quail eggs and tomatoes around.

Serve the roast turkey as the main course. For dessert, a Yule log cake with strawberry jam, decorated with strawberry Santas and three-colored jelly (green, white, red), will make your Christmas party perfect!

mon_an.ten: Gulab Jamun - Indian Rose Syrup Milk Balls
mon_an.mo_ta: These round and beautiful rose-scented dessert balls originated in India and quickly became popular in other South Asian countries like Sri Lanka, Nepal, and Pakistan.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Combine sugar, water, rose syrup, green cardamom, and saffron in a pot and simmer over low heat.
Use a wooden spoon to stir constantly until the water begins to boil.
Step 2:
You can add a few pistachios if you want the syrup to be more fragrant.
Step 3:
In a large bowl, combine the flour, milk powder, and baking powder. Then add the oil and yogurt and mix well.
While kneading, if the dough feels dry, you can add more yogurt. Avoid over-kneading or over-mixing, as this will make the dough tough and hard.
Step 4:
Apply a little oil to your hands and shape the dough into small round balls. If the dough cracks because it's too dry, add a little more yogurt or milk.
Heat oil in a pan. When the oil is moderately hot, turn the heat to low and start dropping the balls in to fry.
Step 5:
While frying, remember to stir constantly so the balls brown evenly and don't burn.
Once the balls are cooked, remove them, drain the excess oil, and drop them into the syrup to soak for at least 2 hours.
Finally, sprinkle some crushed almonds on top and serve.

mon_an.ten: Pork Tenderloin with Parma Ham and Red Wine Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: The tenderness of the pork combined with the red wine sauce creates a delicious, unique dish with an unforgettable flavor.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Wrap the pork tenderloin with two sage leaves and two slices of Parma ham, then sear briefly in a pan.
Step 2:
Heat the pan with minced garlic, red wine sauce, and chicken stock to create the sauce.
Step 3:
Pour the sauce over the pork tenderloin.
Top with butter. Serve hot.

mon_an.mo_ta: Chicken and almonds are two nutritious and delicious foods loved by people of all ages. But have you ever tried combining them in one dish? If not, why not try this almond chicken recipe. The method is quite simple but the flavor is excellent; the chicken is tender and sweet, infused with the richness of almonds and the aroma of butter. Furthermore, this is a suitable dish for those who like a bit of spice. Let's get cooking and treat the whole family this weekend.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Coriander and mint leaves - a handful of each
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Wash the chicken and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Coarsely chop or crush the almonds, but do not grind them into a fine powder.
Wash the tomatoes and cut into small pieces or wedges.
Wash the coriander and mint leaves and drain thoroughly.
Peel the garlic and ginger, wash them, then crush and mince finely.
Wash the red chilies and keep them whole.
Peel the onion and slice thinly.
Step 2: Cooking steps
First, place a pan over heat and add a little ghee to warm up.
When the ghee has melted, add the garlic, minced ginger, almonds, red chilies, pepper, cloves, coriander powder, and cinnamon. Stir quickly until the mixture becomes fragrant.
Cook the almond mixture for about 2-3 minutes, then turn off the heat and transfer to a separate plate or bowl.
Add half of the remaining ghee to the pan and heat it up. Once melted, sauté the sliced onions until fragrant. Then add the tomatoes and continue to fry with the onions.
When the onions and tomatoes are fragrant and the tomatoes have softened, add the chicken and the previously cooked almond mixture. Stir well.
At this point, season with a little salt.
Next, you can add a tiny bit of water and stir so the chicken absorbs the spices.
Simmer the chicken for about 30-40 minutes until tender. When simmering, turn the heat down to the lowest setting.
After the time is up, add the Garam Masala to the chicken and continue to stir.
Then add the fresh mint and coriander leaves to the pan and stir-fry with the chicken.
Finally, add the remaining ghee, stir for a few more minutes, and turn off the heat.
Transfer the chicken to a plate and serve hot with steamed rice!
Notes
When choosing chicken, you should choose the thigh meat as it is tastier and doesn't dry out like the breast. Thigh meat is very fresh, tender, and doesn't fall apart when cooked.
During the simmering process, pay attention to the amount of water in the pan to adjust accordingly. Do not add too much water; the final sauce should be thick and slightly reduced.
When serving, you can squeeze a little lemon juice over the chicken to enhance the flavor.
