This almond chicken dish is made in a style that suits many palates. It is perfect for chilly days because it is quite spicy and will help warm your body. The dish has a rich flavor, crunchy almonds, and a buttery aroma that will keep you coming back for more. Enjoy!

mon_an.mo_ta: Korean beef soup is a unique dish for many, but with easy-to-find ingredients and a simple method, it will surely delight you. This delicious dish features tender beef, a spicy sauce, crunchy bean sprouts, and flavorful radish. Check out how to make this dish in the article below!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel the taro and wash with cold water. Soak the taro in cold water for about 6 hours (overnight is ideal), but for this dish, 1 hour is enough to remove the sap and improve the texture.
Step 2: Soak 600g of beef brisket in cold water to remove blood and odors. Remove the beef, drain, and marinate with a little garlic and seasoning powder for 15 minutes.

Step 3: In a large pot, add a little oil and sear the beef. Add 1/2 onion, 1 green onion (split if large), 3 cloves of minced garlic, 1 tsp pepper, and 16 cups of cold water. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce to medium and simmer for 30 minutes until the beef is tender.

Step 4: While the beef is simmering, wash the bean sprouts in cold water and drain. Blanch them in boiling water for about 1 minute, then remove and drain. This keeps the sprouts crunchy and clean. You can leave them raw if preferred.
Step 5: Wash the green onions, remove any wilted parts, and cut into long segments. You can blanch them briefly.
Step 6: Wash the radish and slice into thin, bite-sized pieces.
Step 7: Once the beef is tender, remove the beef and vegetables and let cool for 20-30 minutes. Shred the beef into thin strips.
Step 8: Making the spicy sauce:
In a small bowl, mix 1 ½ tbsp chili powder, 4 tsp sesame oil, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp minced garlic, 1 tsp salt, and 1 tsp black pepper. Mix well until the ingredients are combined and not lumpy.
Step 9:
Mix the taro, bean sprouts, radish, and shredded beef with 2/3 of the spicy sauce. Toss well so everything is evenly coated.
Step 10:
Add the seasoned mixture back into the broth and simmer over medium heat for 40 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Step 11: Making the chili oil:
In a small pot, add 2 tbsp vegetable oil and 1 tbsp chili powder. Sauté over medium heat for about 1 minute. Add 2 tsp of oil and stir for another minute.
Step 12:
Once the chili oil is cooked, strain it through a fine sieve or cheesecloth to collect the infused oil.
Step 13:
Add the green onions, the remaining spicy sauce, and the chili oil to the soup. Season with a little more salt if needed. Simmer over medium heat for 10 minutes.
Step 15:
Finally, ladle the soup into large bowls and serve hot.

mon_an.ten: Delicious Korean Spicy Stir-fried Octopus (Nakji Bokkeum)
mon_an.mo_ta: Korean spicy stir-fried octopus is an attractive dish, appealing from its colorful appearance with green chilies and orange carrots to its spicy sauce. The octopus is crunchy and infused with spices, making it a perfect winter dish. Don't miss out on this recipe!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients for Korean spicy stir-fried octopus
Soak the octopus in cold salt water. If using frozen octopus, wait for it to thaw completely.
If the octopus has been frozen for a long time, you can use warm water or the microwave to defrost.

In a bowl, combine the drained octopus with 1 tbsp of sea salt and 2 tbsp of flour. Massage the octopus for a few minutes to remove slime and odors. Rinse twice with cold water. You can also rinse with a little white wine to further remove any fishy smell.
Use a knife or scissors to cut open the head/mantle and remove the internal organs. Remove the eyes and the dark beak.
Rinse the octopus twice more with water and drain completely.
Cut the octopus into bite-sized pieces.
Wash the vegetables and slice them into bite-sized pieces.
Step 2: Cooking the Korean spicy stir-fried octopus
First, mix 2 tbsp chili powder with 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tbsp shrimp paste, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp sesame oil, a little pepper, and 2 tbsp minced garlic. Stir until you have a smooth, uniform paste.
Heat a pan with oil, add the octopus, and stir-fry for about 1 minute. Remove and set aside. Do not overcook the octopus at this stage or it will become tough.
In another pan, heat oil and stir-fry the carrots for 1 minute over high heat, then add the onions and fry for another minute. Add the green onions and green chilies and sauté for 3-5 minutes.
Add the octopus back into the pan with the vegetables and pour in the mixed sauce. Cook for another 3 minutes over high heat. Season with a little salt if necessary.
Finally, transfer the stir-fry to a plate, sprinkle with sesame seeds, and enjoy.
Tips for delicious Korean spicy stir-fried octopus
You can omit the shrimp paste if you dislike the smell; replace it with a little salt or fish sauce.
If you want a more filling meal, you can add glass noodles. Boil or soak the noodles in hot water, drain, and add them to the pan about 1 minute before turning off the heat.
Do not cook the octopus for too long as it will become rubbery.
You can use this same method for other seafood like squid or shrimp.
If using frozen octopus, make sure it is very dry before stir-frying, as too much water will ruin the dish.

mon_an.mo_ta: Instead of usual chicken dishes, making Mexican-style chicken burritos will make your meal more exciting and flavorful!
cac_buoc: Step 1: First, finely chop the cucumber and onion.
Step 2: Cut the chicken breast into long, bite-sized strips, then place in a bowl and mix with flour and the egg.
Step 3: Add chopped basil and chili powder, then mix well so the chicken is evenly seasoned.
Step 4: Fry the chicken in a pan with hot oil until the pieces are golden brown.
Step 5: Warm the tortillas until slightly crisp, then lay them out. Spread a layer of mayonnaise on one side, then add the chicken, onion, and cucumber. Roll them up tightly to finish.
This spicy and attractive chicken burrito will surely delight you!
You can adjust the amount of filling to your preference!
This chicken burrito roll is a great way to change up your daily menu!

mon_an.mo_ta: Mexican meatball soup appeals to everyone with its round, flavorful meatballs and aromatic broth. The meat is fresh, tender, and sweet, leaving a lasting impression. The dish is balanced by various vegetables, adding fiber and creating a colorful, harmonious meal. This wonderful dish will showcase your cooking skills and the whole family will love it—you're sure to receive many compliments!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Zucchini - 1 piece, cut into small pieces
Chayote squash - 1 piece, cut into small pieces
Green beans - 225 g, trimmed and cut into thirds
cac_buoc: Step 1:
In a large bowl, mix the ground beef, rice, egg, green chilies, ½ tsp salt, and black pepper until well combined. Let the mixture rest for about 10 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Then, use a spoon to scoop the meat mixture and roll it in your palms to form round meatballs.
Step 2:

Place a pan over heat and add vegetable oil. When the oil is hot, add the meatballs and sear until browned on all sides, but do not cook them all the way through. Transfer the meatballs to a plate. Note: do not use heat that is too high or the outside will burn while the inside stays raw; if the heat is too low, the meat will overcook and become dry. Use medium heat to keep the meat juicy.
Step 3:

In the same pan (or a pot), add the onion, chayote, zucchini, and green beans. Sauté the vegetables over medium heat for about 5 minutes or until they begin to soften. As the vegetables release moisture, use a wooden spoon to scrape any browned bits from the bottom of the pan, then add the tomatoes and stir well.
Step 4:
Add the chicken broth to the vegetables. Carefully drop the meatballs into the soup and bring to a boil.
Once boiling, reduce the heat to medium-low. Simmer for another 20-30 minutes. When the soup is nearly finished, stir in the coriander and season with salt to taste.
Finally, ladle the soup into bowls and enjoy!
Tips for a delicious meatball soup
When searing the meatballs, do not crowd the pan; otherwise, they will steam instead of browning. Sear them in batches if necessary.
You can substitute ground pork for beef, but beef provides a richer, sweeter flavor and a better aroma for this dish.
Since the meatballs will be simmered in the soup, do not over-fry them initially to preserve their natural sweetness.
Besides serving as a soup, you can slightly adjust the recipe to create a thicker sauce to serve with bread or noodles.

Mexican meatball soup is visually appealing with its round, flavorful meatballs and aromatic broth. The meat is fresh, tender, and sweet. The dish is balanced by various vegetables, adding fiber and creating a colorful, harmonious meal. This wonderful dish will showcase your cooking skills and the whole family will love it!

mon_an.mo_ta: Korean Spicy Chicken Stew is a delicious and enticing dish featuring tender chicken wings, thighs, or breast meat. The fresh, flavorful chicken is infused with rich aromas and combined with fluffy, aromatic potatoes, slightly sweet green chilies, and the pungent aroma of onions, all brought together in a thick, savory sauce. This attractive dish, with its simple preparation, is sure to win over your family, even the pickiest eaters. Take a little time to get in the kitchen and learn how to make this wonderful dish to surprise your family and make your home meals even more appealing!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Clean the chicken and chop into bite-sized pieces, then drain well.
Peel the onions, wash them, and slice thinly.
Step 2:

Make the marinade: In a small bowl, combine 1/4 cup soy sauce, 1/4 cup minced garlic, 1/4 cup chili powder, 1/4 cup spicy chili sauce, and 1 tbsp sugar. Mix well until you get a smooth, thick, and well-blended mixture.
Step 3:
Once the mixture is ready, add the chicken and sliced onions to the sauce. Toss well to coat and marinate for 15 minutes.
Step 4:
Place a pot on the stove, add the marinated chicken, then pour in 2 cups of water and stir. Bring to a boil over high heat for 20 minutes.
Step 5:
While waiting for the water to boil, peel the potatoes, wash them, drain, and cut into bite-sized pieces. Cut them into large chunks similar to those used in a ragout.
Step 6:
Clean the green chilies and green onions, then wash and chop them finely.
Step 7:
After 20 minutes, when the chicken is cooked, add the potatoes and green chilies to the pot. Stir well, cover with a lid, and simmer for another 20 minutes over medium or medium-low heat.
Step 8:
Finally, after stewing for 20 minutes, open the lid and simmer for another 3-5 minutes to reduce the liquid and thicken the sauce.
Step 9:
Add the chopped green onions and serve the chicken on a plate to enjoy.
Notes for a perfect Korean Spicy Chicken Stew:
Besides chicken wings, you can choose your favorite parts like thighs, breast, or any other part. Remember not to chop them too large so the meat can absorb the spices.
While cooking, remember to spoon the sauce over the meat and vegetables if the liquid has reduced to ensure everything is evenly coated.
Adjust the spiciness according to your preference. If you like it spicy, add more chili; if you prefer it sweet and less spicy, reduce the chili and increase the sugar!

mon_an.mo_ta: Korean Fried Chicken attracts diners with its vibrant color and flavor, featuring tender, aromatic, and sweet meat coated in a tangy, spicy, and slightly savory sauce, providing a wonderful culinary experience. Change up your daily routine and bring a new dish to treat your family. Everyone will be amazed by your cooking skills!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Potato starch, all-purpose flour, sweet rice flour - as desired
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients for Korean Fried Chicken:
Rinse the chicken thighs in cold water, then blanch them in boiling water to remove any odors and firm up the meat.
Next, crack the eggs into a bowl and beat them well.
Peel the garlic, wash, and mince it.
Steps to make perfect Korean Fried Chicken:
First, place the chicken thighs in a large bowl and add black pepper, salt, 1/2 cup potato starch, 1/4 cup all-purpose flour, 1/4 cup glutinous rice flour, a bit of baking soda, and 1 egg.
Then, mix well by hand so the flour coats the chicken evenly.
Next, place a pan on the stove, fill it with oil, and heat it up.
After the vegetable oil has heated for about 7-8 minutes, check the temperature by dipping a piece of chicken in. If the oil bubbles, it is at the right temperature to start frying.
Fry the chicken for 10 minutes over high heat.
Then, remove the chicken from the oil and shake it gently in a strainer to drain the excess oil. Let the meat rest for a few minutes.

Next, fry the chicken a second time for another 10 minutes until all the thighs turn golden brown and crispy on the outside. Once the chicken is cooked and the skin is golden and crunchy, remove it and place it on paper towels to drain.
Make the sauce:

Heat 1 tbsp of vegetable oil and 4 cloves of minced garlic in a pan. Then, add 1/3 cup ketchup, 1/3 cup rice syrup, 1/4 cup chili sauce, 1 tbsp apple cider vinegar, and simmer the mixture for about 7 minutes. Keep the heat low until the sauce boils, then turn off the stove.
Once the sauce is ready, add the chicken thighs and toss well with a wooden spoon.
Finally, serve the chicken on a plate and sprinkle some toasted sesame seeds on top. Eat while hot.
Notes for perfect Korean Fried Chicken:
If your pan is not large enough to fry all the chicken at once, you can divide it into smaller batches to make it easier and ensure the chicken browns evenly.
If you cannot eat spicy food, you can reduce the amount of chili in the sauce to lower the heat.
This dish should be enjoyed immediately while hot for the best experience.

mon_an.mo_ta: Swedish-style baked sweet potatoes will give you a different perspective on roasted potatoes because of their characteristic aroma. Let's try making them with this guide!
cac_buoc: Ingredients to prepare:
Step 1:
Prepare a large bowl and add the cheese, then add the heavy cream.
Preheat the oven to 200 degrees C.
Step 2:
Sprinkle in some thyme leaves, pepper, and salt, then mix everything together.
Step 3:
Peel the sweet potatoes and wash them to remove all the sap.
Tip: You should choose round and slightly thick potatoes so that they look better when sliced.
Step 4:
Use a slicer to cut the sweet potatoes as shown in the picture.

Next, cover the tray with aluminum foil, then bake the sweet potatoes for 35 minutes; check to ensure the potatoes are soft and cooked.
After taking the potatoes out, remove the foil, sprinkle a layer of brown sugar on top, and continue baking for 5-10 minutes until the sugar has completely melted.

cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, boil the pasta until tender. Then, add olive oil to a pan. When the oil is hot, add the chopped sausage and sauté over medium-high heat. Stir for 5' until the sausage turns brown.
Note: Make sure to choose a pan that is oven-safe!

Chop the bell pepper and onion, then add them to the pan and sauté until soft.
Step 3:
Add the oregano and stir for 1', then season with salt and pepper.

Once the sauce begins to thicken, remove it from the heat.

This baked lasagna retains its familiar rich and creamy taste, but the flavor of the Italian sausage will be very unique and delicious!
Since we are using Farfalle bow-tie pasta, this lasagna doesn't need to be sliced!
When you mix all the cheese, the lasagna will look like this—looks appetizing, doesn't it!

mon_an.mo_ta: Pork roti is a wonderful cooking method to create a flavorful dish while keeping the pork tender and fresh. This roasted pork roll is simple to prepare and very suitable for a nutritious family breakfast. Below is the guide to making delicious roasted pork. A simple and tasty guide to making sweet and sour meatballs that go well with rice. Combining the flavor of delicious meatballs with sweet and sour sauce creates an attractive and nutritious meal.
cac_buoc: 1. Prepare the ingredients
Pork:
Rinse the pork under cold water to remove any dirt or impurities on the surface.
Then, dry the meat with paper towels or a clean cloth to remove excess water.
BBQ seasoning:
Use commercially available BBQ seasonings or make your own according to your recipe.
Before use, sprinkle BBQ seasoning on both sides of the pork and rub it in so the spices penetrate the meat.
Spices
In addition to BBQ seasoning, you can use other spices to enhance the flavor of the pork.
Common spices include salt, pepper, minced garlic, minced shallots, black pepper, thyme, or other favorite seasonings.
Sprinkle the spices on both sides of the pork and rub them in.
Kitchen twine
Use kitchen twine to keep the pork in a uniform shape and thickness while roasting.
Place the pork on a clean surface and tie the twine tightly around the meat, ensuring it is secured and holds its shape.
2. Making the roasted pork roll
Step 1:
After preparing the pork as described above, proceed to roll the meat. Place the cleaned and dried meat on a flat surface.
Using a sharp knife, butterfly the pork so it remains in one long, continuous piece. This ensures even cooking and makes it easier to roll later.

In a small bowl, mix the marinade consisting of 2 tsp salt, 1 tsp seasoning powder, 1/2 tsp sugar, and BBQ seasoning (if using). Rub the mixture onto both sides of the pork. If you want to roast it immediately, you can use a fork to prick the meat before rubbing the spices to help it absorb faster.
Next, sprinkle with herbs and rub again to ensure the seasoning is evenly distributed.
Step 2:
Roll up the marinated meat, ensuring it is rolled tightly. Use kitchen twine to tie the roll securely.
Place the meat in the refrigerator and let it marinate for at least 6 hours (or overnight) to allow the flavors to penetrate.
Step 3:
Before roasting, preheat the oven to 150ºC.
Place the pork roll in the oven and roast for about 1 hour. The roasting time may vary depending on the thickness of the meat and your preference for doneness.
Once the meat is cooked, remove it from the oven and let it cool slightly. Then, use scissors or a knife to remove the kitchen twine and slice the meat into bite-sized pieces.
This BBQ pork roll can be served hot with rice as a main dish, or sliced thinly and used in sandwiches like cold cuts.
Notes for perfect roasted pork roll:
Choose fresh pork: Select pork that is bright pink, has no unpleasant odor, and shows no signs of spoilage. Fresh pork will provide better flavor and a softer texture.
Prepare the meat: Rinse the pork under cold water to remove surface dirt. Then, dry it with paper towels. Trim excess fat and uneven skin so the meat cooks evenly.

Marinating: Before roasting, marinate the pork with a spice blend to enhance the flavor. You can use minced garlic, minced shallots, salt, pepper, sugar, BBQ seasoning, or other spices to taste. Rub the spices in and let it marinate in the fridge for at least 30 minutes.
Choice of oil/fat: When roasting, use oil or fat to brush over the surface of the pork. This prevents the meat from drying out and creates a delicious crispy crust.

Adjust roasting temperature: Set the oven to a suitable temperature, usually around 180-200°C, so the meat cooks without becoming too dry. If the temperature is too high, the meat may burn or become overly dry.
Turn the meat regularly: During the roasting process, turn the pork frequently to ensure it cooks evenly. This helps the exterior brown uniformly while keeping the inside moist.

Check for doneness: Use a bamboo skewer or press lightly on the meat to check for doneness. The roasted pork will have a beautiful golden color, a crispy exterior, and a soft interior. Ensure it is fully cooked before slicing.
Sauce: You can enjoy the roasted pork immediately after roasting, or serve it with a sauce such as sweet and sour fish sauce, BBQ sauce, or a homemade sauce to enhance the flavor.
Resting time: After roasting, let the pork rest for a bit before slicing. This allows the juices to redistribute, keeping the meat tender and flavorful.

mon_an.mo_ta: Jajangmyeon with soft, fresh noodles mixed with a signature black bean sauce and vegetables will give you a wonderful taste that never gets boring. Just spend a little time in the kitchen and you'll have a fantastic dish!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fish sauce, salt, sugar, pepper, ginger, garlic - seasoning
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients:
Clean the pork tenderloin and dice into 1.2 cm cubes.
Peel the radish, potatoes, and onions, then wash and dice into 1 cm squares.
Clean the mushrooms and slice them.
Prepare a bowl and mix the potato starch with sugar and water to prepare for the next step.
Steps to make delicious Jajangmyeon
Step 1:
First, heat a pan on the stove and add 1 tbsp of vegetable oil, then add the prepared meat and stir-fry until golden brown.

Next, heat another pan (do not add oil), add the sautéed meat along with the radish and stir-fry for 1 minute until the radish is cooked. Then, add the onions, potatoes, and mushrooms and stir-fry with the meat and radish for 3 minutes until the potatoes look slightly soft.
Step 2:
Once the mixture is sautéed, use a spoon to push all the meat and vegetables to the edges of the pan, leaving an empty space in the middle.
Add 2 tbsp of vegetable oil and 1/4 cup of black bean paste into the center of the pan. Then turn up the heat, mix everything in the pan together, and continue to stir-fry for 1 minute.
Step 3:
Next, add 200ml of water to the pan and turn the heat to high. Cover the pan and cook for about 10 minutes.
Then, pour the prepared mixture of potato starch, water, and sugar into the pan, stirring as you pour. Continue to cook and stir uncovered until the sauce becomes thick.
Step 4:
Next, add 1 tsp of sesame oil and stir for about 30s.
Step 5:

In another pot of water on the stove, bring to a boil then add the noodles. Check if the noodles are cooked, then drain well. When boiling the noodles, you can add 1 tbsp of oil so the strands do not stick together.
Once the noodles are drained, place them in a bowl or plate. Pour the sauce over the noodles and enjoy.
Notes for perfect Jajangmyeon:
In step 2, you can reuse the pan used for the tenderloin, but you must remove the excess oil and fat before proceeding.
You can rinse the cooked noodles under cold water before plating. Depending on preference, you can use different types of noodles!
The black bean sauce for Jajangmyeon can also be served with rice to make a delicious black bean rice bowl.

Jajangmyeon with soft, fresh noodles mixed with a signature black bean sauce and vegetables will give you a wonderful taste that never gets boring. Just spend a little time in the kitchen and you'll have a fantastic dish!

mon_an.ten: Tips for Making Kimchi Without the Pungent Bite
mon_an.mo_ta: Kimchi is a traditional Korean dish loved worldwide. However, when making it at home, a common issue is the kimchi becoming too pungent, making the flavor unbalanced and hard to eat. But don't worry, there are some simple tips to make kimchi flavorful without the harshness. Follow this article to save these tips! This guide covers how to create a delicious, balanced traditional Korean dish. Learn how to select ingredients, adjust fermentation time, and store kimchi for perfect results. Simple tips to keep kimchi tender, crunchy, and not too sour, bringing the joy of homemade cooking to your family.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Korean chili powder + Korean chili paste - 20g - 50g
cac_buoc: Step 1: Brining the cabbage
In a large bowl, mix 3-4 tbsp of salt and 1 tbsp of sugar with warm water to create a brine solution.
Soak the cabbage in the brine for about 4-6 hours, flipping the cabbage a few times to ensure it is evenly soaked.
Step 2: Preparing the spice paste
In another bowl, combine 2-3 tbsp chili powder, 1 tbsp garlic powder, 1 tbsp ginger powder, and 1 tbsp black bean paste.
Add 1-2 tbsp sugar and 1 tsp MSG (optional) to adjust the sweet and salty flavors.
Combine the cabbage and the spice mixture.
Remove the cabbage from the brine and drain well.
Mix the cabbage with the spice paste, ensuring every leaf is evenly coated.
Step 3: Steaming the kimchi
Bring water to a boil in a steamer.
Place the kimchi mixture in a steaming basket and steam for 10-15 minutes to kill bacteria and prevent the kimchi from being too pungent.
Step 4: Storage and fermentation
Place the kimchi in an airtight container or a ceramic jar.
Seal tightly and let the kimchi ferment at room temperature for 2-3 days to ripen naturally.
Once the kimchi has ripened, store it in the refrigerator to stop the fermentation process and keep it from becoming too pungent.
By following these steps, you will have kimchi that isn't harsh, with a mild sourness and the characteristic aroma of traditional kimchi.
After about 2 days, you can take the kimchi out to eat!
Kimchi is best within about 7 days!
Since this recipe doesn't use onions, it won't be pungent... Additionally, the scent of the shrimp will make the kimchi very flavorful!
Tips for making kimchi flavorful and not pungent
Ingredient selection: Choose fresh, young, and crunchy napa cabbage without blemishes. Wash the cabbage and soak it in diluted salt water to remove bacteria and create crunchiness.

Adjust fermentation time: Fermentation time affects whether kimchi becomes pungent. If you want tender kimchi that isn't too sour, reduce the fermentation time. This also depends on ambient temperature, so adjust according to the season and conditions.
Use the right amount of spices: The amount of salt, garlic, chili, and ginger should be adjusted to be suitable and not too strong. Taste and adjust until you achieve a mild sourness and balance.
Add sugar or apple: If the kimchi is too sour, you can add a little sugar or finely chopped apple to the mixture. This helps reduce acidity and creates a gentle sweetness.
Proper storage: Once the kimchi has ripened, seal it and keep it in the fridge. Low-temperature storage prevents air contact and stops bacteria from growing too quickly.
Ferment with other vegetables: To prevent pungency, you can ferment it with other vegetables like carrots or radishes to reduce acidity and create balance in flavor.

mon_an.mo_ta: Italian cuisine has long been world-famous for its diverse, sophisticated dishes with harmonious seasoning. Among Italian dishes, the most popular worldwide are pizza, tiramisu, and pasta, including Spaghetti. From the main ingredient of spaghetti, people can create many different dishes like Bolognese (spaghetti with minced beef sauce), Carbonara (spaghetti with cream, eggs, and bacon), or Al frutti di mare (seafood spaghetti). The following content will guide you on how to make a delicious beef tomato spaghetti. Please refer to the recipe!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Cheese - Parmesan is preferred, but any type will work
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the sauce
Trim the roots and tops of the onions, peel, wash, and cut in half.
Slice vertically. Do not separate the slices; keep them together as shown.
Then slice horizontally to get small diced onion pieces.
Wash the green chilies, remove the tops and stems.
Slice into strips.
Then dice them to a size similar to the onion pieces above.
Peel, wash, and mince the garlic.
Place the ground beef in a pot.
Turn on the heat and stir-fry over high heat. Sauté until the meat releases its juices, the liquid evaporates, and the meat is browned.
Scoop the meat into a bowl and set aside. Keep the rendered fat in the pot.
Add olive oil to the same pot. You only need about 2-3 tbsp of olive oil.
When the oil is hot, add the diced onions and green chilies.
Sauté for a few minutes; the onions and chilies will absorb the beef flavors from earlier, creating a very attractive aroma.
Then add the minced garlic.
Stir for a few minutes, then you can pour in a glass of white wine; the wine will enhance the aroma of the sauce, but it's okay if you don't have any.
Sauté for a few minutes to let it absorb.
Then add the crushed tomatoes. I used canned crushed tomatoes here. If unavailable, you can use fresh tomatoes, peeled (score them and put them in boiling water for easy peeling) and blended.
To enhance the flavor of the sauce, add a tablespoon of tomato sauce.
Then add 1 tbsp of dried thyme,
1 tbsp of dried oregano,
2 tbsp of sugar (sugar helps neutralize the acidity of the tomatoes),
and 2 tbsp of salt.
Stir well and cook until the sauce mixture heats up.
Add the pasta seasoning mix, if desired.
Then add the sautéed beef from earlier.
Stir well.
Add a few bay leaves.
Then lower the heat, cover the pot, and simmer for about 1 hour to let the flavors meld.
After 1 hour, take some minced parsley...
And add it to the sauce pot.
Add the cheese to the pot.
Cook until the cheese melts and the sauce boils. Season again to taste.
Now you have the perfect meat sauce for your pasta.
Step 2: Prepare the pasta
Boil the spaghetti for 8-10 minutes, then drain. Cooking times vary by brand, so follow the instructions on the package.
Once the pasta is cooked and drained, put it in a bowl and pour in a little olive oil...
Toss well so the olive oil evenly coats the strands.
Step 3: Presentation
When ready to eat, place a portion of spaghetti on a plate.
Ladle the meat sauce over the top.
Sprinkle with a little minced parsley...
And some shaved cheese on top...
Add a slice of garlic bread and you have a plate of delicious, authentic beef spaghetti.
A few notes for Beef Tomato Spaghetti:
Sauce seasonings can easily be bought at large supermarkets or stores selling Western ingredients. You can easily Google to find reputable addresses.
Depending on your taste, you can omit or adjust the ingredients and seasonings to suit your family's palate.

Since making the meat sauce is relatively time-consuming, you can make a large batch, divide it into small containers, and freeze them. When you want to eat, take a container out, thaw it, and microwave or heat it up to use with spaghetti.
Besides spaghetti, the meat sauce is also great for dipping bread. Just one or two slices of bread and a bowl of meat sauce make a delicious and nutritious breakfast. Give it a try.
How to choose fresh ingredients
How to choose fresh beef
Good beef is usually bright red with a firm structure, fine grain, and is neither too dry nor too mushy. Beef fat should be bright yellow, and tendons should be white and firm when pressed.
To check elasticity, press your finger into the meat. If it quickly returns to its original state, it is fresh.
Cow beef is usually tastier than bull beef. The "premium" choice is veal (young beef), which has fine grain and white fat, offering a sweet flavor.
For good veal, you can ask the butcher to grind it or take it home and use a meat grinder.
How to choose fresh onions
Choose onions that are round, fresh-looking, and not bruised.
Observe the roots. Onions with many long root fibers indicate they are still fresh.
Avoid onions that have completely lost their roots, as these are old and will spoil quickly.
How to choose fresh tomatoes:
Check the stems. Choose fruits with fresh, green, non-withered stems.
Choose medium-sized, uniform tomatoes. They should be round, with shiny skin and no scratches or insect bites.
Avoid tomatoes that are bright red but feel hard to the touch, as these have been artificially ripened.

mon_an.mo_ta: Korean Black Bean Noodles – A delicious, easy-to-make Korean specialty known as Jajangmyeon. Today's article will guide you on how to make Korean black bean noodles at home. Please take a look! Learn to cook delicious Korean Black Bean Noodles.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Black bean sauce - 1/4 cup and 1 tbsp
2 tbsp potato starch mixed with 1/2 cup water and 1 tbsp sugar to make 1 small bowl
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the pork belly and cut into small cubes. Cut the vegetables into cubes of the same size as the pork.
Making the Jajang sauce:

Step 2: Add one teaspoon of vegetable oil to a pan and fry the meat until golden brown (4–5 minutes). Drain the rendered fat. Add the radish and sauté for 1 minute. Add the potatoes, onions, and zucchini and continue to sauté for 3 minutes until the potatoes look translucent.

Step 3: Use a wooden spoon to push the ingredients to the sides of the pan to create a space in the middle. Add 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil to the center, then add 1/4 cup of black bean sauce and stir for 1 minute. Then mix everything together and continue to stir to finish the sauce for the Korean black bean noodles.

Step 4: Add 2 cups of water to the pan, cover, and cook the mixture for 10 minutes. Mix the potato starch with 1/4 cup water and 1 teaspoon of sugar. Open the lid, test a piece of potato or radish; if they are cooked, pour in the starch mixture and stir gently until the sauce thickens. Add sesame oil, stir well, and turn off the heat.
Making the Jajangmyeon:

Boil the noodles, then rinse them in cold water. Drain the noodles and place them in a bowl. Pour the Jajang sauce over the noodles. Garnish this easy-to-make dish with cucumber and enjoy immediately with kimchi or yellow pickled radish!

mon_an.mo_ta: With the heat from Korean chili paste, this grilled chicken becomes more delicious and unique than ever. You won't be able to stop after the first bite.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, ground pepper, soy sauce, sesame oil
cac_buoc: Ingredients to prepare:
Step 1:
First, mix the chili paste with the cooking oil, sesame oil, and soy sauce.
Step 2:
Cut the lemon in half and squeeze 1/2 of it into the mixture. Slice the other 1/2 and set aside.
Step 3:
Add salt, ground pepper, and minced garlic to the sauce and mix well.
Step 4:
Wash the chicken and drain. Use a knife to make diagonal scores on the meat so the sauce can penetrate easily, then marinate the chicken in the prepared sauce.
Step 5:
Marinate the meat for at least 1 hour until the flavors are well absorbed.
Step 6:
Line a baking tray with parchment paper. Place the chicken in a preheated oven at 240°C and grill for about 15 minutes.
Step 7:
After 15 minutes, take the chicken out, place the lemon slices on top, and put it back in the oven. Grill until the chicken turns golden brown.
Use a toothpick to prick the thickest part of the chicken to check if it's cooked through!
Grilled chicken made with this recipe will be rich, spicy, and very attractive!
Korean chili paste has a very different heat compared to chili powder or regular chili sauce, so your grilled chicken will have a very unique flavor!
Look how attractive these well-marinated grilled chicken pieces are!
If you don't have an oven, grilling them over charcoal is also very fragrant!

mon_an.mo_ta: Hand-rolled rice balls are called Jumeok-bap in Korean. It's a unique but very attractive dish due to the soft rice, fragrant meat, and appealing colors. Let's learn how to make this delicious dish!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Finely mince the carrots, mushrooms, garlic, and ginger.
Step 2: Heat a pan and sauté the garlic and ginger until fragrant. Then, add the carrots and sauté until slightly softened; you can add a little chicken broth to help soften the carrots.
Then add the mushrooms and sauté until cooked. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Step 3: Mix the sautéed mushrooms and carrots with the rice in a large bowl. Add sesame seeds and sesame oil to enhance the flavor.
Step 4: Place a pan on the stove, fry the bacon until cooked, then chop finely.
Step 5: Finely slice the green onions and briefly sauté them in the pan until just wilted.
Step 6: Put all the bacon, green onions, sesame oil, and sesame seeds into a large bowl with white rice and mix very thoroughly.
Step 7: Then, roll the rice from both flavors (vegetable and bacon) into small, bite-sized round balls. Finally, arrange them on a plate and get ready to enjoy.

mon_an.mo_ta: Korean Grilled Ribs – A delicious, easy-to-make dish to make your meal more interesting with a signature Korean specialty. How to make Korean Grilled Ribs.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Pepper, seasonings, ginger powder, fresh ginger, sugar, soy sauce
cac_buoc: Step 1: Grate the onion, pear, and kiwi, then mix them in a large bowl.
Step 2: Wash the ribs and drain, then cut into bite-sized pieces. Marinate the ribs with the mixture from Step 1 for 45-60 minutes at room temperature, or 2 hours in the refrigerator.

Step 3: Next, prepare another marinade: mix the Korean paste, sugar, pepper, seasonings, ginger powder, garlic powder, and sesame oil. Pour this marinade into the container of ribs from Step 2 and keep in the refrigerator for 4 hours.

Step 4: Take the ribs out of the fridge and let them come to room temperature for 15 minutes, then grill them over charcoal or in the oven. Grill this easy-to-make dish until the surface is golden brown. These ribs can be eaten with rice or wrapped in lettuce with a bit of Korean chili sauce.
Source: Beyond Kimchee

mon_an.mo_ta: Make Tteokbokki just like at the shop for those who love spicy food. Tteokbokki is the most popular snack in Korea, found all over the land of kimchi. Learn to cook delicious Korean Tteokbokki. This chewy, fragrant, spicy, and slightly sweet cake is very easy to eat.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Chicken broth (or water with broth powder) - 590ml
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients for the Tteokbokki so the cooking process is quick.
Slice the rice cakes diagonally into bite-sized pieces. Shred the cabbage and wash it.
Peel, wash, and dice the onion. Wash, peel, and thinly slice the carrot. Trim and finely chop the green onions.

Step 2: Place a pan on the stove, sauté the garlic in sesame oil until fragrant, then pour in the chicken broth, soy sauce, and other seasonings: Korean chili paste, sugar, fish sauce, and MSG. Bring to a boil.

Step 3: Add the cabbage, carrots, onions, and rice cakes to the pan and simmer, seasoning to taste. Simmer until it boils again for a while, then turn off the heat. Scoop the Tteokbokki onto a plate, sprinkle with green onions, and serve hot for the best flavor.

mon_an.mo_ta: This French-style beef stew with mushrooms will give you a new perspective and a new flavor for traditional beef stew. The beef is tender, fragrant, and browned, served with sweet, golden, and aromatic vegetables. Serve this dish with hot rice or bread for a perfect meal.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, broth powder, pepper, MSG - seasonings
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients for the French-style beef stew with mushrooms.
Wash the beef and cut into bite-sized cubes.
Wash the fresh mushrooms.
Peel the potatoes and carrots, wash, and cut into thick rounds.
Peel the onion, wash, and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Trim the roots and wilted leaves of the celery and parsley, wash, and cut into long segments.
Step 2: Steps to perform the French-style beef stew.
First, place the prepared beef in a bowl, add a little salt and pepper, and mix well. Marinate the beef for about 10-15 minutes to let it absorb the seasonings.
Next, add flour to the beef bowl so that the flour completely coats the meat.
Then, place a pan on the stove, add vegetable oil to heat over medium heat.

When the oil is hot, add the beef to fry. During frying, pay attention to flipping both sides of the beef to get a golden-brown color similar to caramel. Once the beef is cooked, set it aside in a bowl.

Next, place another pan on the stove over medium heat and add the vegetable mixture including onions, carrots, potatoes, and celery. Stir quickly until the vegetables are par-cooked. Then, add butter to the vegetable mixture so they become golden, fragrant, and softer.
When these vegetables are slightly golden, add the fresh mushrooms and continue to fry.
Add the tomato paste and continue to brown the vegetables.
When the vegetable mixture releases a strong aroma, pour in the prepared red wine, stirring constantly. Then, add the beef and stir well.
After that, pour a bowl of warm water into the beef pot so that the liquid almost covers the meat and vegetable mixture. Remember to add a few sprigs of thyme to the pot.
Next, use a sheet of parchment paper to tightly cover the mouth of the pot.
Then put the lid on tightly.
Simmer the beef for about 40 minutes or until both the beef and vegetables are tender. Turn off the heat and remember to season again to suit your taste.
Finally, scoop the beef stew into a bowl, add a little lemon juice and olive oil, stir well, and enjoy.
Notes for a perfect French-style beef stew with mushrooms.
You should not choose beef tenderloin; instead, choose cuts like beef shank, thigh, or brisket with tendon...
In addition to the prepared seasonings, you can add a little cloves or cinnamon to enhance the flavor.

We use red wine here, but some people mistakenly use white wine. Note the rule: white meat with white wine, red meat with red wine. Wine helps enhance the flavor and deliciousness many times over, and when the food is cooked, there is no smell of alcohol. Therefore, even if you don't like the smell of alcohol, do not skip this ingredient.
Using parchment paper to seal the pot mouth will retain heat better, helping the beef soften more quickly.

mon_an.mo_ta: Korean Sweet and Sour Pork, also known as Tangsuyuk, is a popular dish in both Chinese and Korean cuisine. It is often prepared for family meals on special occasions, especially for children, as the sweet and sour flavor combined with crispy fried meat is always a hit. Let's get into the kitchen and learn how to make this delicious dish!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the vegetables and fruit:
First, peel, wash, and slice all the prepared vegetables and fruits.
Step 2: Slice the pork:
Next, wash the pork and cut it into small, bite-sized pieces. Sprinkle salt and pepper on all sides of the meat. Marinate the meat for about 15 minutes to let the spices absorb.
Step 3: Fry the meat:
Heat cooking oil in a pot or deep pan to about 180 °C. The amount of oil depends on the type of pot you are using, as long as it is enough to fully submerge the meat when frying.
Step 4: Sauté the vegetables:
First, heat a pot and add 2 tbsp of vegetable oil. Sauté 1 tsp of minced garlic until fragrant, followed by the carrots and onions.
Then, add the apple, red chili, and green chili, and stir-fry over high heat for 2 minutes until the ingredients are slightly cooked.
Step 5:
Next, add 1 cup of water, ½ cup of vinegar, and ½ cup of sugar to the sautéing vegetables. Mix well and bring to a boil.
Step 6:
Then, reduce the heat and add ½ tbsp of soy sauce, ½ tbsp of salt, and a pinch of black pepper. Adjust the seasoning to your taste. Remember to stir well so all ingredients are evenly seasoned!
Step 7:

Next, in a small bowl, mix 2 ½ tbsp of starch with 1/3 cup of cold water; you can add more water to ensure the starch is completely dissolved. Mix well and let this mixture simmer over low heat to keep it warm.
Step 8:
Then, dip the pork into the starch mixture.
Step 9:
Beat 3 eggs with ¼ tsp of salt and a pinch of black pepper until well combined, then take the meat and dip it into the egg mixture.
Step 10:
Next, heat the oil prepared earlier and fry the meat for about 5 minutes or until the meat is cooked and has a beautiful golden color.
To check if the oil is hot enough for frying, drop a small piece of meat into the oil; if it floats to the surface, the oil is ready. Do not fry too many pieces at once.
Step 11:
Once the meat is cooked, remove it and place it on paper towels to drain the excess oil.
Step 12: Double fry:
After a few minutes, drop the meat back in to fry a second time for about 30 seconds to 1 minute until it turns golden brown. Make sure the meat is completely cooked through.
Continue to remove the meat and let it drain again.
Step 13:
Finally, arrange the meat on a plate and pour the prepared sauce over it. You can sprinkle some sesame seeds on top.
Notes for delicious Korean Sweet and Sour Pork:
Traditional Korean Sweet and Sour Pork is made with pork, but you can also substitute it with other meats such as chicken, beef, seafood, etc. If frying fish, your frying time will be shorter.
Carrots, zucchini, garlic, and sesame seeds are optional.
If you don't have an apple, you can use another fruit like orange or pineapple.

If you want a thicker batter on the outside of the fried meat, follow this method: Mix 1 cup of potato starch or flour with 1 cup of water (1:1 ratio) and let it sit for a while for the starch to settle. Then pour off the top layer of water and mix the remaining starch paste with 3 egg whites. Simply dip the meat into this mixture before frying for excellent crispy pieces.

mon_an.mo_ta: Japanese fried chicken is a traditional dish from the Land of the Rising Sun. This delicious dish appeals to diners not only with the rich, savory flavor of fresh chicken but also with its crispy crust. Let's spend some time making this tasty dish!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Panko breadcrumbs or frying flour - 1/2 pack
cac_buoc: Step 1: Remove the bones and skin, then slice the chicken into thin pieces.
Step 2: Coat the chicken pieces evenly with flour.
Step 3: Next, dip the chicken pieces into the beaten eggs.
Step 4: Coat the chicken pieces thoroughly with panko breadcrumbs.
Step 5: *- A*dd oil to a hot pan and fry the chicken until both sides are golden brown, then turn off the heat.
Finally, place the chicken on paper towels to drain the oil, then cut into bite-sized pieces and arrange on a plate.
You can serve the chicken with rice and vegetables...
Remember to drizzle a layer of tonkatsu sauce over the fried chicken to make it even more delicious!
In Japan, people also serve this chicken with shiitake mushroom omelets and green onions!

mon_an.mo_ta: Mango Chicken – A delicious, easy-to-make dish with flavors from Malaysia that is definitely worth a try. This fragrant and unique dish features tender chicken pieces in a soft, aromatic mango sauce.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Onion, red bell pepper, green bell pepper - 1/2 each
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the chicken breast: Wash the chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces, then place in a bowl with 1/2 tsp sugar, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp pepper, and 1 tsp cornstarch. Mix well and marinate for 30 minutes.
Step 2: Use another clean bowl to mix the sauce: ketchup, chili sauce, oyster sauce, honey, apple cider vinegar, and mango or pineapple juice. Stir well.

Step 3: Wash the bell peppers, use 1/2 of each, remove seeds, and slice into pieces. Peel and wash the onion, then slice thinly. Heat oil in a pan; once hot, sauté the onion for about 1 minute, then add the bell peppers and sauté until soft. Remove to a separate plate to keep the Mango Chicken looking beautiful.

Step 4: Using the same pan, add 1 tbsp of oil and sauté the chicken for about 10-15 minutes until cooked. Pour in the sauce and continue to simmer over medium heat. When the sauce boils, peel the mango, cut into bite-sized pieces, and add to the pan. Turn the heat to low.

Step 5: When the sauce in the pan has thickened, add the sautéed vegetables from the previous step. Stir for about 2 minutes, adjust the seasoning to your taste, turn off the heat, and serve this easy-to-make dish on a plate with hot rice.
Source: Rasamalaysia

mon_an.ten: Delicious Roast Pork for a Cozy Christmas
mon_an.mo_ta: With the roast pork recipe below, you will have a wonderful dish to enjoy with your family this Christmas!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 20 g apple cider vinegar, 20 g orange juice
7 g sugar, 20 g salt, 5 g pepper, 5 g chili powder
cac_buoc: Step 1:

Wash and pat the meat dry, then marinate with minced garlic, olive oil, apple cider vinegar, orange juice, turmeric powder, sugar, salt, and pepper. The longer you marinate, the more the flavors will penetrate the meat, so marinate overnight if possible.
Step 2:
Slice the onions, spread them evenly at the bottom of the roasting tray, and pour in the water.
Step 3:
Place the marinated meat on top of the onion layer and roast at 250 °C for 30 minutes.
Step 4:

After 30 minutes, rotate the roasting tray 180 degrees and roast for another 30 minutes. Next, lower the heat to 170 °C and cook for 3 hours. When you turn off the oven, leave the meat tray inside for another 30 minutes before taking it out.
When eating, remember to drizzle the sauce over the meat like this!
Serving it with rice and salad is perfect. Isn't it wonderful for a Christmas party?

mon_an.mo_ta: Show off your skills with Creamy Mushroom Rice Cakes – a unique Korean fusion dish. This is an easy-to-make Korean-style meal.
cac_buoc: Step 1: To make the Creamy Mushroom Rice Cakes, first we need to knead the dough. Mix the glutinous rice flour, rice flour, and salt with warm water and knead well by hand. Knead until the dough no longer sticks to your hands.
Step 2: If you like colorful cakes, you can mix the dough with a little food coloring after kneading.
Step 3: Take the dough and roll it into long strips, then use a knife to cut them into equal small segments. Then roll each small segment into a ball to prepare for the Creamy Mushroom Rice Cakes.

Step 4: Bring a pot of water (about 2L) to a boil, then drop the dough balls in. Cook until the cakes are translucent and float to the surface, which means they are cooked. Remove them and immediately place them in a bowl of cold water so the rice cakes don't stick together.
Step 5:
Chop the bacon and broccoli, then sauté them with the golden-fried garlic and onion. Season to taste.
When the ingredients are half-cooked, add the heavy cream, lower the heat, and simmer for about 4 minutes. Then add the rice cakes and simmer for another 2 minutes before turning off the heat.

mon_an.mo_ta: Omelet-wrapped stir-fried noodles (Omusoba) – A delicious and easy-to-make Japanese dish that will satisfy even the pickiest eaters.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Japanese cabbage, cut into bite-sized pieces - 1/2 head
Tonkatsu sauce (can be substituted with ketchup)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Boil the noodles in water with a pinch of salt and a little oil. Once cooked, drain in a colander. Rinse with cold water to prevent the noodles from sticking.
Step 2: Clean and prepare all vegetables into bite-sized pieces. Heat oil in a pan, sauté the garlic until fragrant, then add the vegetables and stir-fry evenly.
Step 3: In a separate pan, make an omelet using 2 eggs for each of the 4 servings to prepare for the noodle wrap.

Step 4: When the vegetables are nearly cooked, reduce the heat and add the noodles, a little water, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, and seaweed. Simmer for a few more minutes to allow the flavors to absorb.

Step 5: Divide the stir-fried noodles into 4 equal portions. Place each portion onto one half of an omelet, fold the other half over, and your easy delicious meal is ready. Drizzle with Tonkatsu sauce (or ketchup) and mayonnaise.

mon_an.mo_ta: Fans of Korean cuisine or anyone who loves spicy mixed noodles cannot miss this recipe; it is absolutely delicious!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 5 lettuce leaves, 7 perilla leaves (green or purple as preferred)
15ml soy sauce, 8ml sesame oil, 10ml vinegar, 15g sugar
A few tomato slices and 1 boiled egg for garnish
cac_buoc: Here are the ingredients you need to prepare for authentic spicy mixed noodles!
Step 1:
Slice all the vegetables including cucumber, onion, lettuce, and perilla leaves into bite-sized pieces.
Step 2:
Make the mixing sauce by stirring minced garlic, chili paste, soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, and vinegar together in a bowl.
Step 3:
Boil the noodles until just cooked. They should be soft enough but not mushy, maintaining a chewy texture.
Step 4:
Arrange the vegetables, noodles, and sauce together, then sprin-
Step 5:
Mix all the ingredients thoroughly.
Did you know the most traditional way Koreans mix this dish is by using their hands!
Now, simply plate the dish and garnish to enjoy!
Top it with tomato slices and the boiled egg!
-kle some roasted sesame seeds into a large bowl.

mon_an.mo_ta: Cheese-filled potato balls have an eye-catching appearance, a crispy outer shell, and a rich, savory flavor. The aromatic taste makes them irresistible. This dish is perfect for parties, outings, or simply a family meal. Children will absolutely love these cheesy potato balls and will keep asking for more.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients for the cheese-filled potato balls.
Peel the potatoes, wash them, and cut into small pieces.
Grate the cheese.
Step 2: Steps to make the cheese-filled potato balls.
First, steam or boil the potatoes until tender. However, steaming is recommended to retain the sweetness and nutty flavor of the potatoes.
Once the potatoes are cooked, remove them and mash thoroughly with a spoon.
Add 1/4 tsp black pepper, a pinch of garam masala (optional), and 1.5 tbsp finely chopped parsley.
Next, add 3.5 - 4 tbsp cornstarch or flour and mix well. Ensure the ingredients are thoroughly combined so the flavor is even.
Add the grated cheese and two pinches of salt. Continue mixing well; you can taste and adjust the seasoning with more salt or pepper if needed.
Use a spoon to scoop a small amount of the mixture and shape it into small balls.
Heat a pan on the stove, add oil, and bring to a boil.
Once the oil is hot, drop the balls in and fry until golden brown on all sides.
When cooked, remove the balls and place them on paper towels to drain the excess oil.
Finally, arrange the balls on a plate and serve with chili sauce or ketchup as desired.
Notes for delicious cheese-filled potato balls:
When frying, do not use excessively high heat, or the balls may puff up and burst. Turn them regularly to ensure even cooking and a beautiful golden color.
Deep frying is recommended for even browning and to prevent the balls from absorbing too much oil.
Add salt sparingly, as the cheese already contains salt, to avoid making the dish too salty.
If you want more cheese, take a spoonful of the mixture, roll it into a ball, flatten it, place a cube of cheese in the center, and seal it so the cheese is completely enclosed.
You can also use sweet potatoes instead of regular potatoes. Sweet potato balls are also very fragrant, aromatic, and rich.

Cheese-filled potato balls have an eye-catching appearance, a crispy outer shell, and a rich, savory flavor. The aromatic taste makes them irresistible. This dish is perfect for parties, outings, or simply a family meal. Children will absolutely love these cheesy potato balls and will keep asking for more.

mon_an.mo_ta: Start your morning with Bánh mì with Xíu Mại! Just one is enough to keep you full while providing protein, fats, and fiber to ensure you have enough calories for work or study. A little secret: Xíu Mại pairs best with Bánh mì, and the calorie count in this sandwich is even higher than the Phở you usually eat!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Pick and wash the cilantro; you can chop it into shorter pieces. Wash, peel, and grate the carrots. Wash the cucumbers, soak in salt water for 15 minutes, then peel and slice. Wash the tomatoes, soak in salt water, and slice thinly.
Step 2: Choose a suitable loaf of Bánh mì; if it is a long loaf, cut it to about 20 cm. Slice the bread lengthwise.

Step 3: Spread chili sauce and mayonnaise inside the bread to your taste. Layer in some cilantro, carrots, cucumbers, and tomatoes, then add the xíu mại meatballs. For the meatball recipe, you can refer to 'Delicious Fried Meatballs in Tomato Sauce'.
Step 4: Place in the oven and warm for about 5 minutes, then your fragrant Bánh mì with Xíu Mại is ready to serve!

mon_an.mo_ta: These savory baked pastries are appealing with their crispy outer crust and soft, fresh interior. With a pleasant color and a delicious filling of bacon mixed with aromatic melted cheese, they are a treat for the senses. Spend some time this weekend making this dish for your family; everyone will love it!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients for the savory baked pastries.
Cut the bacon into small squares.
Thinly slice the butter.
Crack the egg into a bowl and beat well.
Grate the cheese using a medium grater.
Step 2: Steps to make the savory baked pastries.
First, heat a pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped bacon to the pan and cook until it turns a deep pink, the fat has rendered, and the meat is fully cooked. Stir occasionally to prevent burning or sticking.
Reduce the heat to low, add 1/3 of the grated cheese to the bacon, and stir until well combined.
Add the remaining grated cheese and stir until melted.
Once the mixture is ready, pour the cheese and bacon into a small bowl and let it cool for about 1 minute.
When the mixture has cooled slightly, add the egg and stir immediately while the mixture is still warm. Mix well to combine all ingredients.
Place the egg, cheese, and bacon mixture in the refrigerator.
In a large bowl, mix half of the lard into the flour.
Add 1 tbsp of water and mix gently to form a slightly sticky dough. If the dough is too dry, gradually add more water until a cohesive dough forms.
Lightly dust your work surface with flour, being careful not to use too much to avoid altering the dough consistency.
Place the dough on the surface and roll it out thinly. Trim the edges to create a pastry sheet about 0.5 cm thick.
Spread 1/3 of the butter and the remaining 1/3 of the lard over the surface of the dough, then fold it in half.
Place the dough in the refrigerator for 5-10 minutes to prevent the fats from melting.
Remove the dough and roll it out thinly once more with a rolling pin.
Use a knife to cut the dough into 3 cm squares.
Preheat the oven to 180°C.
Take the filling out of the refrigerator; the egg, meat, and cheese mixture should now be quite firm.
Place a spoonful of filling in the center of each dough square and gently fold the edges together.
Grease a baking tray with a thin layer of lard and arrange the pastries on it.
Place the tray in the oven and bake for 20-25 minutes or until the crust is a beautiful golden brown.
Once baked, remove from the oven, plate, and enjoy.
Notes for delicious savory baked pastries:
If you prefer not to make the dough from scratch, you can use dumpling wrappers instead, though homemade dough provides a better texture and flavor.
Besides bacon, you can add sausage or any other meat filling you prefer to the mixture.
Monitor the pastries closely while baking to avoid them being underbaked or burnt.

mon_an.ten: Sweet Potato Pig Ear Cookies – A Delicious Snack
mon_an.mo_ta: This snack is a familiar childhood favorite. With this recipe, making sweet potato-flavored pig ear cookies is simpler than ever.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Purple dough: - 80g boiled and mashed purple sweet potato
1/2 tbsp lemon juice (helps the cookies stay crispier after frying)
cac_buoc: Note on ingredients: You can substitute cooking oil with butter and water with coconut milk. The amount of flour or water is not fixed, so you can add or subtract a little to achieve a smooth, pliable dough.

Step 1: Place the flour, sweet potato, egg, sugar, sesame seeds, and oil into a bowl; wear gloves to mix or knead first. Then, gradually add water and knead until the dough forms a smooth, non-sticky ball. Let the dough rest for 20-30 minutes. Repeat the same process for the white dough.
Step 2: Roll the two dough portions separately into thin sheets, then stack them on top of each other.
Step 3: Roll them up tightly. Wrap the dough log in plastic wrap and place it in the freezer for 1-2 hours.

Step 4: Remove the dough log and use a thin blade to slice it into very thin rounds (the thinner they are, the crispier and tastier the cookies will be). You can keep the dough in the freezer if you're not ready to fry them yet. When ready to eat, let the dough soften slightly before slicing.
Step 5: Heat oil in a pan until just hot (do not let the oil get too hot). Add the cookies in small batches and fry over medium heat.
Flip the cookies while frying until they are golden brown and crispy, then remove and place on a plate lined with paper towels.
Wait for the sweet potato pig ear cookies to cool completely before placing them in a plastic bag and sealing tightly to store.
Good luck and enjoy your sweet potato pig ear cookies!

mon_an.ten: How to Make Passion Fruit Tarts – Have You Tried It?
mon_an.mo_ta: Passion fruit tart is a delicious and attractive pastry with moderate sweetness, a crispy crust, and a rich passion fruit cream filling. A bit of fresh passion fruit on top helps balance the richness. Let's get into the kitchen and try making this wonderful treat!
cac_buoc: First, place the flour and sugar in a bowl and mix well.
Next, cut the butter into small pieces, add them to the flour mixture, and use your fingertips to rub them in until the mixture resembles coarse breadcrumbs.

Then, crack in the egg and knead until you have a soft, pliable dough that doesn't stick to your hands. Once the dough is ready, wrap it tightly and refrigerate for 1 hour to rest. If you have a mixer, you can use it to combine the ingredients, then take it out and knead briefly by hand.
Preheat your oven to 180°C for 10 minutes.
Next, take the dough out, dust with a little flour, and roll it thin. Line the tart molds with the dough. Press firmly so the dough adheres to the mold, being careful not to tear it.
Once prepared, blind bake the tart shells for 15 minutes (at 180°C).
When the shells are pre-baked, remove them and let them cool. Lower the oven temperature to 160°C. Move on to making the passion fruit cream.

First, combine the heavy cream, sugar, eggs, and passion fruit juice in a large bowl. Whisk steadily until the ingredients blend into a smooth, light-colored cream. If you have an electric mixer, you can use it to ensure the mixture is perfectly smooth and well-combined.

Once ready, pour the mixture into the pre-baked tart shells, filling them almost to the rim. Bake for another 13-15 minutes at 160°C. When the tarts are set, remove them, let them cool, and then refrigerate.
After 30 minutes, you can take the tarts out and enjoy.
Tips for delicious passion fruit tarts:
When mixing the filling, remember to whisk steadily so the ingredients blend well, making the mixture soft and smooth.
How to choose good passion fruit:

When buying passion fruit, choose those with slightly dry, wrinkled, and light skin; these are characteristics of the very fragrant and delicious variety grown in Da Lat. Passion fruit grown in the North is often heavy with smooth, shiny skin, but it's not as flavorful. Young fruits are also heavy and smooth-skinned, but they lack depth of flavor, have thick rinds, and very little pulp.

How to store passion fruit: Like many other fruits, wash them thoroughly, let them dry completely, place them in a sealed plastic bag, and then refrigerate. Passion fruit will lose its aroma if left in the heat.
For extracted passion fruit juice, you can freeze it into a syrup and store it in the freezer for up to a year without it spoiling.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Easy and Delicious Homemade Caramel Popcorn
mon_an.mo_ta: Instead of making regular popcorn, changing the flavor will make this snack impossible to get tired of!
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients to make the perfect caramel popcorn as shown in the picture!
Now that the ingredients are ready, let's start making this snack!
Step 1:
In this step, you will pop the corn. Read the instructions on the packaging carefully and pop it in the microwave!
Note: When microwaving, keep an eye on it so it pops fully without burning, otherwise it won't taste good!
Before popping, prepare a large tray lined with parchment paper. When the popcorn is done, pour it all onto the tray and spread it out evenly!
Step 2:
Next, prepare a pot and add the whiskey, sugar, butter, salt, and vanilla.

Place the pot on the stove over low heat. Use chopsticks or a spoon to stir until the sugar is completely melted. Continue stirring until the sugar turns a caramel brown color, then stop stirring and turn off the heat!
Step 3:
Next, remove the pot from the stove and immediately add the baking soda.
When you add the baking soda, the mixture will foam up—don't worry! Stir steadily with a spoon until the foam subsides.
Step 4:
Now, pour the mixture over the popcorn prepared in Step 1!
Pour it evenly across the tray so the mixture coats the popcorn!
Step 5:
Next, use chopsticks and a spoon to toss the caramel and popcorn together until the caramel evenly coats every piece.
Step 6:
Do not eat it immediately; wait until the caramel layer has cooled completely and hardened. Then it's ready to eat!
It's so easy, isn't it? Not difficult at all!
You can make this fragrant, rich popcorn for birthday parties or movie nights with friends—it's cheap and high quality!
If you make too much and can't finish it, don't worry. Find a clean container, put the leftover popcorn inside, and make sure to close the lid tightly so no air gets in!
The popcorn pieces are perfectly blended, fragrant, rich, and crunchy—absolutely wonderful!

mon_an.ten: How to Make Ginger-Glazed Dried Bananas
mon_an.mo_ta: This Tet, make this fragrant and incredibly easy ginger-glazed dried banana snack to treat your guests! Learn how to make these chewy and aromatic glazed bananas through the article below!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, cut the bananas into small pieces (as shown in the picture). You can use a knife or scissors; I personally find a knife easier to use.
Step 2:
Roast the raw peanuts until cooked. Adding a little salt while roasting makes the peanuts crunchier and better seasoned. If you don't have time to roast them, you can buy pre-roasted peanuts!

After roasting, wrap the peanuts in a towel to keep them crispy before crushing. Remove all the skins first, then crush them into medium-sized pieces. Don't crush them too finely, or the jam won't meet the standard!
Step 3:
Wash the ginger, peel it, and then slice it into thin julienne strips (as shown in the picture).
Step 4:
Now for the most important step to get chewy and fragrant ginger-glazed bananas.

Place a pan on the stove, add the sliced bananas, ginger, and sugar to simmer. Use chopsticks to stir so the bananas absorb the sugar. After 5 minutes, use both hands with a pair of chopsticks in each to stir effectively so the bananas are fully infused and the sugar is well-blended!
Keep the heat on low so the sugar has time to melt without burning.
Step 5:

Keep stirring continuously until the bananas start to become chewy, then add the crushed peanuts to the pan. Toss together so the peanuts stick evenly to the bananas. Once the peanuts are well-distributed, turn off the heat and let the glazed bananas cool completely before storing them in a jar.
It's so simple to have a chewy, fragrant banana treat for Tet!
Good luck and enjoy this secret to making perfect glazed bananas!
Note on choosing bananas for ginger-glazed bananas:

You should choose ripe bananas with thin, bright yellow skins; this makes the glaze sweeter and more fragrant. Avoid underripe bananas as they can be astringent and less sweet, making the snack less appealing!

The ingredients and steps are very easy and don't require as much time as other jams that need long sugar-soaking periods. Why hesitate? Start making this nutritious snack for your family's Tet holiday!

mon_an.ten: Secrets to Chewy and Fragrant Candied Papaya
mon_an.mo_ta: This candied fruit is delicious, rich in vitamin A, and perfect for serving guests. Don't hesitate to get in the kitchen and make this wonderful candied papaya!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 1 tbsp hydrated lime or lime water
Pandan juice, beet juice, or carrot juice
cac_buoc: First, to make candied papaya, you must choose large, dark green papayas with smooth, unwrinkled skin. Avoid underripe, wilted, or ripe papayas!
Now, let's get started!
Step 1:
Prepare the lime water for soaking. First, dissolve the lime in 2 liters of water (or use lime water) and let it settle, then pour off the clear liquid.
Next, add a little salt and lemon juice to the clear lime water and mix well.
Step 2:
Peel the papaya, remove the seeds, and grate or slice into strips. Don't make them too small; the length is up to you. Rinse the papaya under cold water.
Step 3:
Next, soak the papaya in the lime water mixture for 3 hours. Do not soak for too long.
After 3 hours, remove the papaya and rinse with cold water many times to thoroughly clean off the lime and lemon.
Step 4:

Bring a pot of water to a boil with a little salt. Add the papaya and boil for 5-7 minutes. If the strips are very thin, only boil for 1-2 minutes (do not overcook or the papaya will fall apart when simmering with sugar). Drain into a colander and immediately soak in an ice bath for 10-15 minutes.
Step 5:

Drain the papaya, rinse again, and let it dry slightly. Then, soak the papaya in pandan juice (or your preferred natural coloring) for a few hours until the color is absorbed. Once the papaya is green, drain it.
Note: For red, you can use beet juice, Sting energy drink, or gac fruit. For brown, use coffee or cocoa. For orange, use carrot juice, and for purple, use purple cabbage juice!
Step 6:
Place the sugar, papaya, pomelo flower water, and 100ml of cold water into a non-stick pan or pot and mix well.

Let it sit for 30 minutes to 1 hour until the sugar dissolves completely. Place the pan on the stove over medium heat for 10 minutes, then lower the heat and simmer until the sugar crystallizes around the papaya strips and they are dry, then turn off the heat.
Quick tip: Simmering the candied fruit in small batches will make it look better and taste more delicious!
Step 7: Storage:
Wait until the candied fruit is completely cool before placing it in a zip-lock bag or airtight container. Store in a cool, dry place!
And there we have it—chewy, fragrant, and incredibly attractive candied papaya!

mon_an.ten: How to Make Delicious Japanese Roasted Sweet Potatoes
mon_an.mo_ta: With the method below, you will have delicious roasted sweet potatoes in the true Japanese style! Please refer to the instructions. Japanese roasted sweet potato is a tasty and simple dish to make. Enjoy the unique flavor and aroma of roasted sweet potatoes.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Roasting with an air fryer
Prepare the sweet potatoes by soaking and washing them thoroughly, then trim the ends to fit the air fryer.
To roast, place 3 trimmed sweet potatoes into the air fryer. Roast the first time at 160°C for 15 minutes.

Next, roast a second time at 200°C for 15 minutes. Then, transfer the roasted potatoes to a plate. The result is fragrant, honey-sweet roasted potatoes with a soft, sweet, and nutty texture—perfect for cold days.
Step 2: Roasting with a cast iron skillet
To make this version, use a cast iron skillet about 22-25cm in diameter and preheat the oven to 450°F.
Prick the sweet potato all over with a fork, then microwave for about 5 minutes or wrap in aluminum foil and bake for 30-35 minutes at 450°F.
After roasting, place the potato in a large bowl and cover with plastic wrap to let it steam for 5 minutes.
In another bowl, combine the mirin, honey, vinegar, and salt.
Peel the sweet potato and cut into slices 2.5-3.5cm thick. Place the potato in the bowl and toss well with the mirin sauce.
Carefully remove the cast iron skillet from the oven (use thick oven mitts as it is very hot) and add oil to the pan.
Swirl the oil around the pan, then add the sweet potatoes and the mirin sauce all at once.
Roast for about 15-20 minutes until the mirin sauce thickens, then flip the potatoes and roast for another 5-7 minutes. Transfer the potatoes to a plate.
Add a little water to the pan and stir to loosen the remaining mirin sauce. Add butter and stir until melted, then pour this sauce over the potatoes. Sprinkle with a little salt and enjoy!
How to buy good sweet potatoes

When buying sweet potatoes, choose those that are completely intact, without cracks or chips. When held, the potato should feel heavy, firm, and not bruised. Avoid very large potatoes as they can be fibrous; instead, choose medium-sized ones for the best flavor.

Be especially careful if you see black spots or pits, as these are signs the potato has spoiled. If you want starchy, nutty, and fragrant potatoes, choose those with a layer of dust or soil on the outside. When you cut the tip, the inside should be light orange with white sap flowing out.

If you want chewy, very sweet potatoes, choose those with reddish-purple skin that has honey-like streaks on the outside. When you cut a thin slice at the tip, you will see a light yellow color and flowing sap.

Do not store sweet potatoes in the refrigerator as they will wilt and lose flavor. Instead, store raw potatoes in a cool, airy place, not sealed in plastic bags. Avoid damp or warm environments, as this can cause them to sprout. Sweet potatoes can be stored well for about 1 week to 10 days.

mon_an.ten: Secrets to Making Delicious Candied Winter Melon for Tet
mon_an.mo_ta: Candied winter melon is very simple in both ingredients and method. Making it yourself to serve guests during Tet is much tastier and more hygienic.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Dissolve the lime in 1.5 liters of cold water in a large bowl. Filter to get the clear liquid. Then, add the piece of alum to the clear lime water.
Step 2: Peel the winter melon, remove the soft seeds, and cut into finger-sized strips.
Step 3: Rinse the melon under cold water and soak it in the lime water for at least 8 hours or overnight.
Step 4: After one night, drain the melon and rinse many times with cold water until completely clean.
Spread the melon on a tray and air-dry it (you can also use paper towels to pat it dry).
Step 5: Dissolve 150g of sugar in 700ml of cold water in a pot and bring to a boil over medium heat. When the sugar water boils, add the melon and simmer over low heat.
Step 6: Simmer until the melon becomes translucent, then remove and arrange on a tray. Place the melon in the sun to dry for 1-2 hours.

Step 7: Place the remaining sugar in a pot with 100ml of cold water. Cook over low heat. When the sugar water has boiled for 2 minutes, add the sun-dried melon. Simmer until the sugar thickens slightly, then add the pomelo flower oil.
Step 8: Continue simmering until the sugar crystallizes around the melon and it is dry, then turn off the heat.
Step 9: Spread the candied melon on a tray in a sunny, breezy spot for a few hours to dry it out further.
Following these steps, you will have candied winter melon that is crispy on the outside, soft on the inside, and pure white just like at the shop.

mon_an.ten: Secrets to Cooking Delicious Black Bean Sweet Soup for Hot Days
mon_an.mo_ta: On hot days, a bowl of delicious, cold black bean sweet soup is wonderful.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Rinse the black beans, discard any floating seeds, and soak overnight. Add 1 tsp of salt to the soaking water.
Step 2:
The next day, drain the beans and place them in a pot. Cover with cold water, bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer until the beans are soft to the touch, then turn off the heat.
Step 3:

Transfer the beans to a larger pot, reserving the cooking liquid. Add the white sugar and simmer over low heat, shaking the pan gently to help the sugar dissolve quickly. Turn off the heat and cover the pot tightly for 1-2 hours.

Place the pot of beans back on the stove, simmer over low heat, occasionally adding a little of the reserved bean liquid. Simmer until the beans are soft and seasoned to your liking, then add the vanilla and turn off the heat. Use up all the reserved liquid by the time you finish!
Step 4:
Place the tapioca starch in a bowl.

Gradually pour boiling water into the starch; the mixture will be very hot. Knead slowly by hand until the dough is pliable, soft, and no longer sticks to your hands. Adjust the water amount depending on the starch's absorption.
Pull off pieces of dough and roll them into small pearls.
Step 5:
Bring a pot of water to a boil, drop the tapioca pearls in, and boil until they float to the surface, indicating they are cooked.
Immediately transfer them to a bowl of cold water to prevent sticking.
Step 6:
Place the shredded coconut in a bowl.
Rinse the grass jelly and cut into bite-sized cubes. You can buy grass jelly powder at the supermarket and make it yourself according to the instructions.
When serving, ladle the black bean soup into a glass, add grass jelly and tapioca pearls, and top with shredded coconut.

mon_an.ten: Secrets to Cooking Pumpkin Soup Delicious to the Last Bite
mon_an.mo_ta: With this cool weather, pumpkin soup is perfect. Let's go to the market for ingredients and get in the kitchen; it's very easy to make and guaranteed your whole family will finish it all.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Peel the pumpkin and potato, wash them, and cut into small pieces.
Peel the garlic, crush it, and mince.
Wash and mince the ginger.
Wash the onion and dice it finely.
Step 2:
Heat a pot and add the butter until melted.

Once the butter is hot, add the ginger and garlic and sauté until fragrant. Next, add the onion and sauté until translucent. Add the pumpkin and potato and sauté for about 1 minute, then pour in water and cook until the pumpkin and potato are tender. Remove from the heat and let it cool.
Step 3:
Once the soup has cooled, pour the mixture into a blender and blend until smooth and creamy.
Pour the blended mixture back into the pot and heat it up. Add a little pepper and salt; if it's too thick, you can add a little more water.
When the mixture boils, stir in the cream and remove from the heat.
The soup should be served hot in a bowl and is very delicious! This is not only a favorite dish for many, especially children and the elderly, but it is also very rich in vitamins and nutrients.
If you want to cook this soup for breakfast, prepare everything the night before to save time in the morning.
Good luck and enjoy!

mon_an.ten: How to Make Extra Crispy Onion Rings
mon_an.mo_ta: Onions are good for digestion and have many health benefits for both adults and children. However, many people cannot eat raw onions. So how do you make them delicious? Try making these extra crispy onion rings; they are incredibly easy. Kids especially will love this snack! Children always enjoy snacks and fried foods, so use these ingredients to make a treat for the kids or a snack for your husband. Onions are very healthy: good for digestion, helpful for brain development, and provide nutrients for calcium synthesis! So why wait? Let's make onion rings together!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel the onions, wash them, and slice into rounds about 0.5cm thick, then separate the individual rings.
Step 2: Mix the fresh milk with the frying flour and 1/4 tsp of salt, whisking until the mixture is thick and smooth.
Step 3: Heat a pan and add cooking oil. When the oil is hot enough, dip the onion rings into the batter to coat them completely, then place them in the pan and fry until golden brown on both sides.
Step 4: When the onion rings are evenly golden, remove them, drain on paper towels, and let them cool slightly before enjoying your creation!

mon_an.ten: Savory Bánh Đúc with Minced Pork
mon_an.mo_ta: Savory Bánh Đúc features a soft, slightly chewy texture and a delicate aroma, served with a flavorful minced pork and mushroom topping and a sweet and sour fish sauce for a truly satisfying meal.
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients:
Peel, wash, and mince the shallots.
Trim, wash, and thinly slice the green onions.
Soak the wood ear and shiitake mushrooms until softened, wash well, then mince or grind.
How to make delicious Savory Bánh Đúc
Step 1: Heat a pan with 2 tbsp of oil. Once the oil is hot, sauté the shallots until fragrant. Add the ground pork and stir-fry until firm and crumbly with a bit of seasoning powder or salt.
