These pickled cucumbers are crispy with a hint of spiciness from chili, sweetness and sourness from sugar and vinegar, and a rich aroma from soy sauce.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Water, sugar, soy sauce, vinegar - ingredients
cac_buoc: Step 1: Soak the cucumbers and chilies in salt water, rinse thoroughly, then cut into bite-sized rounds.
Step 2: Wash and dry a glass jar, then mix the cucumbers and chilies together and place them in the jar.
Step 3: Make the pickling liquid:

Add 1 bowl of water, 1 bowl of sugar, 1 bowl of soy sauce, and 1 bowl of vinegar into a small pot and bring to a boil for about 2-3 minutes. Then turn off the heat and wait for the liquid to cool for about 15-20 minutes.
Step 4: Pour the pickling liquid into the glass jar containing the cucumbers and chilies. Continue to let the liquid cool down further, then close the lid, making sure to seal it tightly!
Step 5: You can place the glass jar in the refrigerator and preserve it for 2-3 days before enjoying the crispy, spicy, sweet, and sour pickled cucumbers!

mon_an.mo_ta: Are you passionate about cuisine and want to explore the characteristic flavors of different regions? Dừa dầm is a traditional dessert, and when you taste it, you will feel a special and attractive flavor. Continue reading to discover how to make authentic Hai Phong style Dừa dầm at home! Explore the recipe, instructions, and secrets to creating a rich Dừa dầm dish with the signature flavors of Hai Phong.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Make the jelly

To start, mix 5 grams of jelly powder with 60 grams of sugar. In a pot, boil 800ml of coconut water over high heat. Next, add the jelly and sugar mixture to the pot, stirring well until completely dissolved.
Important note: Depending on your preference for crunchy or chewy jelly, choose the appropriate type of jelly powder.
When the mixture boils, lower the heat to medium and continue stirring for 3-4 minutes until the powder is completely dissolved. Then, pour ½ of the cooked jelly liquid into a mold.

In a small bowl, mix 30ml of unsweetened fresh milk with 30ml of coconut milk. Pour this coconut milk mixture into the remaining jelly liquid in the pot, cook over medium heat, and stir until combined.
When the clear coconut jelly layer in the mold begins to set slightly, slowly pour the milky coconut jelly layer into the mold, pouring gently from the edge to avoid breaking the previous layer.
Let it cool, wait for both layers to set, and place in the refrigerator for about 2 hours.
Then, remove the jelly from the mold and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Step 2: Make coconut tapioca pearls
First, choose firm coconut meat. Wash 100 grams of coconut meat and cut into small cubes.
Next, in a bowl, pour 100ml of boiling water into 100 grams of tapioca starch, stirring until it forms a smooth, pliable dough. Knead the dough until it reaches the right consistency.
Then, add the coconut filling and roll into small round balls.

Note: If the coconut meat is thick and firm, the pearls will have a better crunch. If the coconut meat still has some brown skin attached, use a knife to carefully remove it to avoid a bitter taste. Besides using these in Dừa dầm, you can also enjoy them with cold coconut water, sweet soups, or fruit tea - they are all delicious!
Finally, boil water in a pot and add the pearls. Wait until they float to the surface, then strain them and place them in a bowl of sugar water to cool.
Step 3: Make the coconut milk sauce

Start by dissolving 10 grams of tapioca starch in 50ml of water, stirring until completely dissolved. In a pot, combine 150ml of coconut milk, 100ml of unsweetened fresh milk, 100ml of coconut water, 60 grams of sugar, and 30ml of condensed milk.
Note: If desired, you can add a pinch of salt to the milk mixture and stir well to enhance the sweetness of the dish.

Next, place the pot over medium heat and stir constantly until the mixture reaches a light simmer. Then, add the tapioca starch water to the pot. Continue heating until the coconut milk sauce is thick and smooth, then turn off the heat (do not boil for too long).
Finally, strain the mixture through a sieve to remove any lumps and ensure the coconut milk sauce is smooth.
Step 4: Complete and garnish

First, prepare a glass or bowl. Add all the ingredients into it, including some coconut meat, young coconut, jelly, coconut pearls, and some crushed ice. Then, drizzle a layer of coconut milk sauce over the top and garnish with shredded coconut. If you like, you can sprinkle a layer of peanuts on top for aesthetics.
Note: Peanuts can overpower the delicate aroma of the coconut, so in the original version, peanuts are not added. However, depending on your preference, you can choose to add them or not.
Notes when making Dừa dầm

To avoid layer separation when making the jelly, as soon as the first layer feels slightly set to the touch, immediately pour the second layer on top. Do not wait for the bottom layer to harden completely, as this will cause the layers to slide apart and make the dish look unappealing.
For the best flavor, use fresh coconut water and fresh coconut milk instead of canned versions.
You can also add more appeal to the dish by adding pandan-flavored coconut jelly.

To make the best Dừa dầm, choose "bánh tẻ" coconuts, meaning they are neither too old nor too young. You can identify these by peeling the hard shell; you will see a light brown skin with a slight yellow tint (dark brown means it's too old). You can press your fingernail in to check the ripeness.

mon_an.mo_ta: Easy-to-find ingredients and a foolproof recipe will ensure your fried chicken strips are golden, fragrant, and so crunchy you won't be able to stop eating!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: A pinch of salt or seasoning salt
A pinch of seasoning powder, MSG
1 tsp onion powder (or finely minced onion and garlic)
cac_buoc: Prepare these ingredients to make the crispy fried chicken strips!
Step 1: Wash the chicken breast, pat dry, and cut into long strips.
Step 2: Place the meat in a bowl, add garlic powder, onion powder, seasoning powder, salt, pepper, and chili powder. Mix well and marinate for 15-20 minutes to absorb the flavors.

Step 3: Crack the eggs into a bowl and beat well. You can lightly pulse the panko breadcrumbs in a blender to make them slightly smaller. Place all the chicken strips into a bag with the flour and shake well to coat. Dip each piece of chicken into the egg, then roll it in the panko breadcrumbs so it is evenly coated.
Step 4: Once coated, set the chicken strips aside on a plate and continue with the remaining ingredients.

Step 5: Pour plenty of oil into a pot or pan and heat until hot enough. Next, fry each piece of chicken until golden brown. Flip the meat and continue frying until golden and crispy all over, then remove and place on paper towels to drain.
When eating, you can dip them in ketchup or chili sauce if you like it spicy. Each piece of crispy chicken is crunchy on the outside and tender on the inside, delicious to the last bite.

mon_an.mo_ta: Beef shank salad is a wonderful dish for many because of the fragrant, fresh beef, deeply infused with spices and served with various mixed vegetables. Starting your meal with this salad will stimulate your appetite and provide a great dining experience!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Make the dressing:

First, squeeze 1 lime to get the juice, removing all seeds to avoid bitterness. Then, in a bowl, combine 1 tbsp lime juice, 1 tbsp fish sauce, 2 tsp sugar, 1 tsp minced chili, and 1 tsp minced garlic. Mix well until the ingredients are blended. Finally, taste the dressing to ensure it has a balanced sour, spicy, salty, and sweet flavor.
Step 2: Prepare the salad:

Wash the beef and slice it thinly. Then, place the meat in a bowl and marinate with MSG, sugar, and pepper. Mix gently and let it absorb the spices for 1-2 hours to make the beef tender and more flavorful.

Trim the roots and inedible leaves from the lemongrass, then wash thoroughly. Peel the shallots, wash, and slice thinly. Pick the herbs, remove wilted leaves, wash, and chop into segments. Wash and crush the chilies. Peel and julienne the ginger and carrots. Soak the cucumber in diluted salt water, rinse, peel, remove the seeds, and cut into strips.

Next, prepare a deep, microwave-safe dish. Add 1 tbsp of cooking oil to the dish and microwave for 3 minutes until the oil is hot. Remove the dish, add the shallots and garlic, and stir well; when cooked, they will be fragrant and light golden. If you don't have a microwave, you can sauté them in a pan.

Then, add the beef to the dish and stir well with the oil, shallots, and garlic. Microwave again to cook the beef. Every 3 minutes, take the dish out and stir. On the second interval, add seasoning powder, sugar, ginger, and MSG, then stir well.

Microwave for about 6 more minutes until done. If beef is overcooked, it will be tough and lose its sweetness. Especially with shank meat, it will become dry if overcooked. Pay attention to the doneness of the meat to turn off the microwave at the right time for your preference.
Once cooked, transfer the beef to a large bowl, add the herbs, sliced cucumbers, and a bit of carrot. Pour the prepared dressing over the beef and toss well.
Step 3: Make the dipping sauce

You can prepare the dipping sauce as follows: 1 tbsp warm filtered water, 1 tsp pure fish sauce. Crush 1 knob of ginger, some herbs, crushed garlic, roasted sesame seeds, and filtered tamarind juice to create thickness. If you like it spicy, add 1-2 tsp of minced chili.

To have a proper dipping sauce, crush the garlic so it is smashed but not pulverized, enough to release its aroma when added to the sauce; the garlic and minced chili will float on top. This makes the sauce look beautiful and easy to eat.
Finally, present the beef on a separate plate, served with the dipping sauce and accompanying vegetables. Enjoy while hot.
Note: You can carve carrots, tomatoes, or chilies into flowers for decoration, as these pair well with beef for both garnish and eating.

mon_an.mo_ta: The creativity lies in the rich, fragrant, and mildly sweet peanut sauce that is absolutely captivating. You will find it hard to refuse these delicious spring rolls. Let's learn how to make Gỏi Cuốn with peanut sauce to treat the whole family!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning - Soy sauce, chili powder, ginger, garlic
cac_buoc: Step 1:
If using dried vermicelli, the first step is to soak it in cold water to soften while boiling a pot of water. If using fresh vermicelli, no soaking is needed; just use it directly for rolling.
Step 2:
Next, prepare the vegetables: finely chop the parsley, mince the garlic, thinly slice the green onions, and julienne the carrots.
Step 3:
For the asparagus, use a knife to slice them lengthwise.
Step 4:
Add a pinch of salt to the boiling water. When the water boils, blanch the shrimp until just cooked; do not overcook them. Then, remove the shrimp and immediately place them in a bowl of ice water.
Step 5:
Next, blanch the asparagus in boiling water for about 2 minutes, then remove and also place in the ice water bowl like the shrimp.
Step 6:
Once the dried vermicelli has softened, blanch it for 2-3 minutes. When the noodles are tender, drain them in a basket.
Step 7:
After soaking the shrimp in cold water, remove them and use a knife to slice them in half lengthwise as shown in the image.
Step 8: How to make the peanut dipping sauce

Prepare a large bowl and add all the sauce ingredients, mixing well. To make the sauce less thick, you can add a little hot water to make it smooth and easier for dipping. Be careful to add only a little hot water; too much will make it watery.
Step 9:
Dip the rice paper sheets into water to dampen them, then lay them on a flat surface to prepare for rolling.
Step 10:
Start rolling: first, place some rice vermicelli onto the rice paper.
Step 11:
Next, place asparagus, carrots, and parsley on top of the vermicelli. Arrange them neatly to make rolling easier.
Step 12:
Fold the bottom edge of the rice paper over the filling, then fold in the two sides and start rolling as shown in the image.
If you have ever made fried spring rolls, this rolling technique is very similar.
Step 13:

When you have rolled about 2/3 of the way, add the shrimp and continue rolling until the end of the rice paper. With this method, the shrimp will be clearly visible through the roll, making it very eye-catching!
Step 14:
The finished product is now complete. Repeat with the remaining filling and vermicelli until finished.
Time to enjoy your results!
With a slight twist in the special sauce, you will fall in love with this "familiar yet unique" dish!
This makes an excellent appetizer!
The creativity lies in the rich, fragrant, and mildly sweet peanut sauce; it's hard to resist this dish.

mon_an.mo_ta: Fried dumplings with a crispy outer shell combined with a meat and shrimp filling provide an irresistible flavor. Today we will guide you on how to make these delicious crispy fried dumplings!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Shiitake mushrooms, wood ear mushrooms - finely chopped
Carrot, cucumber, garlic, chili - for the dipping sauce
Fish sauce, sugar, soy sauce, seasoning powder, pepper, oil - seasonings
cac_buoc: Step 1: After preparing the pork, shrimp, shiitake, and wood ear mushrooms, place them in a bowl and marinate with 1 tsp seasoning powder and 1 tsp pepper.
Step 2: Wear gloves and mix the mixture thoroughly until smooth, then let it sit for 15 minutes to absorb the spices.
Step 3: Place a dumpling wrapper on a clean plate, add the filling, and fold it closed. You can use a little cold water around the edges to seal them firmly. Repeat until all ingredients are used.
Step 4: Deep fry each dumpling in oil so they become crispy. When cooked, remove and place on paper towels to drain the excess grease.

Step 5: Finally, arrange the dumplings on a plate and serve with chili sauce or sweet and sour fish sauce. Each crispy dumpling with its soft, fragrant shrimp and meat filling will keep you coming back for more.

mon_an.mo_ta: In this summer weather, enjoying a bowl of mixed fruit with ice is absolutely fantastic. You don't need to go to crowded shops; you can make it right at home. It's simple and hygienic. Check out how to make this refreshing fruit salad below! Discover the recipe for delicious, cool fruit salad at home. Enjoy the fresh taste of fruit blended with sweet aromas. Read now for the recipe and detailed steps to create an attractive, tasty bowl of fruit salad.
cac_buoc: 1. How to make fruit salad with fresh milk
Prepare ingredients:
Separate the jackfruit into segments, remove seeds, and julienne.
Peel the pear, remove the core and seeds, and dice.
Peel the watermelon, remove the white rind and seeds, and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Wash the strawberries and cut them in half.
Peel the mango and dice it to the same size as the pear.
Peel and pit the lychees.
Cooking steps:
Once the fruit is prepared, divide it into equal portions into 4 glasses. You can arrange the fruits in any order, as long as the colors look harmonious and attractive.
Next, add 4 tbsp of unsweetened fresh milk and 2 tbsp of condensed milk to each glass.
Finally, add shaved ice to the glass and enjoy. Adjust the amount of ice according to your preference.
Notes:
You can sprinkle dried coconut on top of each glass.
You can eat it immediately or cover it with plastic wrap and keep it in the fridge, adding ice only when ready to serve.
2. How to make fruit salad with yogurt
Ingredients
1 container of sweetened yogurt
1/4 watermelon
8 grapes
1 ripe mango
1/2 dragon fruit
1 apple
1 pear
2 tbsp condensed milk
4 tbsp strawberry syrup
Steps to make fruit salad with yogurt

Step 1: Prepare the fruits. First, peel the watermelon and cut into small squares. You can remove the seeds for better aesthetics. Next, wash the grapes, remove stems, and cut in half. If using seeded grapes, remove the seeds. For the mango and dragon fruit, peel and cut into bite-sized squares.

Step 2: For the final step, layer the fruits in a large bowl. Follow the rule: a layer of fruit, then a layer of yogurt. Alternate until all ingredients are used. Drizzle strawberry syrup over the surface as desired. To enhance the flavor, let the bowl sit in the fridge for about 30 minutes before serving. Before eating, mix well to enjoy the sweet flavor of the yogurt fruit salad, a delightful dessert for hot summer days.
3. How to make fruit salad with condensed milk
1 small pineapple
1/3 watermelon
1 ripe mango
10 longans
10 jackfruit segments, pitted
200ml unsweetened fresh milk
100ml condensed milk
Cooking steps

Step 1: When buying pineapple, choose pre-peeled ones to save time. Just rinse with water and cut into bite-sized pieces. For this version, cut all fruits into small pieces. Peel the watermelon and cut as desired. Dice the pear and mango. For the jackfruit, cut in half or into even long strips.

Step 2: Next, put all the fruits into a large bowl. Add the prepared fresh milk and condensed milk. Mix well so the components combine. You can adjust the milk amount to your taste. If desired, add ice cubes or refrigerate for 30 minutes to make the dish even better.
Notes for delicious and refreshing fruit salad
Choose fresh fruit: Select ripe, fresh fruits to ensure the best flavor. Check the color, aroma, and ripeness before using.
Prepare fruit correctly: Clean and prep the fruit before use. Peel and cut into small pieces or desired shapes. Remove inedible parts like seeds, stems, or skins.
Combine different fruits: Try combining various fruits to create a diverse and attractive flavor. Choose fruits with different colors, flavors, and textures for variety.
Evenly distribute milk/sweeteners: If using milk, yogurt, condensed milk, or sweeteners like honey or syrup, ensure they are mixed well into the fruit for even flavor.
Keep fruit fresh: If not eating immediately, keep it in the refrigerator to stay fresh and cold. However, it is best enjoyed right after making.
Optional toppings: If desired, you can add a bit of vanilla, herbs, or roasted cashews on top to increase flavor and crunch.
Adjust sugar levels: If you want it sweeter, add sugar or sweetener to taste. Remember that ripe fruit is naturally sweet, so taste it before adding more sugar.
Enjoy quickly: Fruit salad is best when fresh and cold. Consume shortly after making to enjoy the fresh taste of the fruit.

mon_an.mo_ta: What could be more exciting than finding sweet, crunchy Oreo cookies "hidden" inside a layer of cold ice cream in the summer heat? Try making this delicious Oreo ice cream!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Pour the fresh milk into the blender.
Step 2: Then add the heavy cream.
Step 3: Next, add the Oreo cookies; use only 4 pieces, keeping 2 pieces to use as the "filling" for the ice cream.
Step 4: Add a little sugar to make the ice cream sweeter.
Step 5: Turn on the blender to mix all ingredients until blended. About 20 seconds should be enough.

Step 6: Then add the remaining Oreo pieces into the molds as the "filling." Finally, pour the blended mixture into the molds and freeze them in the refrigerator for at least 2-3 hours before enjoying.

mon_an.ten: Mango and Black Glutinous Rice Sundae
mon_an.mo_ta: Mango and black glutinous rice is a great combination to treat friends on these hot days! Let's learn how to make this delicious dish!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Soak the black glutinous rice for about 1 hour, then change the water so it covers the rice by about 5cm. Add the corn and sugar to the same pot and steam until cooked, about 45 minutes.
After the rice has cooled completely, shape it into small balls and place them in a bowl.
Step 2: Put the mango ice cream, cold milk, and whipping cream into a bowl, then whisk vigorously until frothy. Gently pour this mixture into the bowl with the rice balls, drizzling the foam on top.
Step 3: Cut the mango into 2 halves, score a diamond pattern into the flesh without cutting through the skin, then gently push the skin up to pop the cubes out and place them in the bowl.
Peel the remaining mango, cut into bite-sized pieces, and add them to the bowl.

mon_an.mo_ta: Mango yogurt ice cream is a perfect summer snack, combining the cooling sensation of ice cream with the delightful aroma of yogurt and mango. Together, they create an incredibly tempting treat. Let's try making this ice cream!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel the mango and remove the pit.
Step 2: Put the mango flesh, sugar, salt, and lemon juice into a blender and blend until smooth. Pour this mixture into a bowl. Mix thoroughly with the yogurt.
Step 3: Pour the mango-yogurt mixture into ice cream molds and place in the freezer for at least 8 hours until firm.
Step 4: To remove the ice cream from the molds easily, run the molds under cool water for a few seconds.
The ice cream is cool, delicious with the flavor of mango and yogurt, and very attractive.

mon_an.ten: Delicious Chocolate Peanut Butter Covered Marshmallows
mon_an.mo_ta: A sweet gift for someone on a special occasion that will surely delight them. Let's learn how to make these delicious chocolate peanut butter covered marshmallows! Please refer to the recipe below.
cac_buoc: How to make chocolate-covered marshmallows:
Step 1:
First, line a 20x30cm rectangular mold with parchment paper.
Spread butter evenly over the parchment paper and other tools (cutter, spatula, etc.) to prevent sticking.
Step 2:
Dissolve the gelatin powder in 120ml of water in a large bowl.
Step 3:
Add sugar, salt, corn syrup, and the remaining 120ml of water to a pot. Cook over medium heat, stirring gently occasionally.
Step 4:
When the mixture boils (as shown in the image), stop stirring.

Cook for another 7 minutes at medium temperature; or test by dipping a chopstick into the mixture and dropping a droplet into a bowl of cold water. If the droplet forms a firm ball, it is ready. Once the mixture reaches the required state, turn off the heat and pour it into the gelatin bowl.
Step 5:
Use a hand mixer to beat the sugar and gelatin mixture until fluffy. It is ready when you lift the whisk and the mixture falls in a thick stream that stays in place or flows very slowly.
Step 6:
Pour the mixture into the tray and quickly spread it evenly. Dip a toothpick into food coloring and swirl it on the surface to create natural color veins.
Step 7:
Cover the surface with a layer of parchment paper, smoothing it out to remove air bubbles and flatten the surface. Leave at room temperature for 2-6 hours or overnight.
Step 8:
Peel off the top layer of parchment paper and sprinkle cornstarch over it to prevent sticking. Use a heart-shaped cookie cutter to cut out cute heart marshmallows, then roll them in cornstarch.
Step 9:
Use a sifter to shake off excess powder from the marshmallows.
If you want an even sweeter gift, you can make a rich chocolate peanut butter coating, which is also very quick and simple, and the result is incredibly sweet.
To make peanut butter marshmallows, prepare the following ingredients:
150g chocolate
85g peanut butter
15g butter
A few grains of salt
How to make peanut butter marshmallows:
Step 1:
Place the ingredients in a bowl and melt over a double boiler, ensuring the bottom of the bowl does not touch the water.
Step 2:
Dip the marshmallows into the chocolate peanut butter mixture.
Step 3:
Place the dipped marshmallows on a tray lined with parchment paper.
Refrigerate for 3-6 hours until the chocolate peanut butter coating hardens. When taking them out, you can use a knife to trim any excess chocolate around the edges to make the hearts look "neater"!

mon_an.ten: Simple and Delicious Homemade Milk Chews
mon_an.mo_ta: Make milk chews with simple ingredients to create smooth, melt-in-your-mouth candies. Making milk chews at home is much safer than buying them from stores. Women and girls can feel completely at ease serving these to their children or elderly family members. When making them yourself, you have full control over the ingredients, completely eliminating additives or harmful chemicals. Discover this simple milk chew recipe now! Homemade milk chews are delicious, safe, and better quality than store-bought versions. Perfect for mothers and daughters to make for children or relatives.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare ingredients
Open the condensed milk can for easy access. You can naturally soften the margarine. If you are using large paper for wrapping, prepare square pieces of the same size in advance.
Step 2: Make the milk chews
Method 1:

Simply mix the milk powder and condensed milk in a bowl, using a whisk to combine them. Mix until the milk powder is completely dissolved and the mixture is smooth and uniform. Then, add the margarine and continue mixing.
Once mixed, take a small spoonful of the mixture and shape it as desired by hand. After shaping, roll the candy in granulated sugar to coat it completely.
Finally, wrap the candy in paper and you're done.
You can enjoy these small, flavorful candies immediately or place them in a small bamboo basket or glass jar for a nice presentation.
Method 2:

You will make the candy using heat. Instead of a bowl, combine the milk powder, condensed milk, and half of the granulated sugar in a non-stick pan, ensuring the pan is thick enough. Use a spatula to mix well and place the pan on the lowest heat setting.
During the heating process, stir continuously and evenly so the candy doesn't stick to the bottom or burn.
When the mixture turns slightly brown, add the margarine and stir until completely melted. Then, cook for another 1-2 minutes before turning off the heat.

After cooking, pour the candy onto a plate to cool naturally for about 5 to 10 minutes. Do not let it cool completely; while it is still warm, you can shape it immediately. Proceed to shape the candy as in Method 1, then roll in sugar and wrap.
Notes for making milk chews
Choose quality ingredients: Use the best possible milk powder, condensed milk, and margarine to ensure the quality and taste of the candy.
Ensure hygiene: Before starting, make sure all tools, bowls, and pans are clean. This helps avoid bacterial contamination.
Stir evenly: When heating, ensure you stir constantly to prevent sticking and burning.
Control the temperature: For the heat method, control the temperature so it's just enough to melt the mixture without burning or overcooking it.
Cooling time: When pouring the candy out to cool, let it sit for 5 to 10 minutes to reach the right firmness and chewiness.
Shape carefully: Work quickly and carefully when shaping to get the desired form before the candy cools and hardens.
Proper storage: Wrap the candies in paper or store in an airtight container. Avoid exposure to air and keep in a cool, dry place.

mon_an.ten: Easy Lime Leaf Dried Chicken Strips
mon_an.mo_ta: You can hand-make your own lime leaf dried chicken strips that are both delicious and healthy. The recipe is extremely simple!
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients for these delicious lime leaf dried chicken strips!
Step 1: Wash the chicken, place it in a pot with smashed lemongrass, 1 tsp salt, enough water to cover the meat, and a few lime leaves. Boil over medium heat.
Step 2: Once the chicken is just cooked, drain it and rinse with cold water. Keep the lemongrass.
Wait for the chicken to cool, then shred it (not too small).
Step 3: Slice the turmeric, chili, and galangal, then grind them thoroughly in a mortar and pestle.
Step 4: Place the chicken in a bowl with the ground spices and the remaining seasonings. Wear gloves and mix well.
Step 5: Put the chicken in a non-stick pan and stir-fry over very low heat.
Stir occasionally until the meat is completely dry, then turn off the heat.
Wait for the lime leaf dried chicken to cool completely before storing in a bag or airtight jar for later use.

mon_an.mo_ta: Make these crispy, delicious, and rich cheese-stuffed potato balls this weekend; they are sure to delight anyone who tries them!
cac_buoc: Ingredients to prepare:
Step 1: Finely chop the bacon.
Roll up the cheese slices and cut them into segments.
Peel the potatoes, steam or boil them with a bit of salt until cooked, then place in a bowl and mash until smooth.
Step 2: Heat a pan, sauté the bacon, then remove and place on paper towels.
Step 3: Add the bacon to the mashed potatoes along with whipping cream, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
Form the mixture into equal-sized balls, flatten them, stuff a piece of cheese inside, and roll back into a ball to seal the cheese.
Dredge the cheese-stuffed potato balls in all-purpose flour, then dip in the egg, and finally coat with crispy frying flour.
Heat plenty of oil in a pan. Once hot, drop the potato balls in and fry until they are golden brown. Remove and place on paper towels.
These crispy cheese-stuffed potato balls are excellent served with ketchup!

mon_an.ten: Crispy and Rich Cheesy Shaked Fries
mon_an.mo_ta: Are you passionate about food and want to try making a simple yet incredibly attractive dish? Let me introduce you to the recipe for crispy and rich cheesy shaked fries – an irresistible snack! When fried, the potatoes become crispy and delicious, coated in a layer of rich cheese powder, creating a perfect combination. Let's discover the secret to creating these unique cheesy shaked fries! Show off your cooking skills with this simple and attractive recipe!
cac_buoc: 1. Prepare the potatoes
After buying the potatoes, peel them and soak them in diluted salt water. Next, slice the potatoes into rounds, stack them, and cut them into long rectangular strips.
Note that you should not cut the potatoes too thick, as they will be hard to cook through and won't be crispy. Ideally, cut them about 1/3 of a finger joint thick.
Once cut into the desired shape, soak the potatoes in diluted salt water for 10-15 minutes to remove the starch. Then, drain them in a basket.
2. Fry the potatoes
Place a pan on the stove and add 500ml of cooking oil. Heat the oil over medium heat until it boils.
When the oil is boiling, add the potatoes so they are fully submerged. Fry over medium heat for about 5 minutes, then remove and drain.
Let the potatoes rest for about 10 minutes, then fry a second time over higher heat. When you no longer see air bubbles around the potatoes (about 5-7 minutes), they are cooked and will be crispier.
Remove the potatoes and place them on paper towels to remove excess oil.
Note:
Do not turn off the heat before removing the potatoes, as they will absorb oil and become soft.
To prevent oil from splattering, you can add a little salt to the oil before adding the potatoes, or cover the pan while frying.
3. Finishing
Once the potatoes are crispy, place them in a bowl.
Next, add 1 tsp of salt and 1 tbsp of cheese powder to the bowl, then shake well to coat the potatoes.
Finally, add 1 tbsp of melted margarine and continue shaking well to complete the dish.
Notes for crispy cheesy shaked fries
1. Notes on frying
During the frying process, do not stir too much to avoid breaking the potatoes. After frying, remove the potatoes to drain before turning off the stove.

To keep the fries crispy for a long time, the secret is to let them cool after the first fry and store them in the freezer for 1-2 hours to harden before the second fry. If you don't have time, let them rest for 10 minutes between fries.
2. How to prevent potatoes from browning
Method 1: After peeling, immediately soak the potatoes in a bowl of cold water or lightly salted water. Note that with this method, potatoes should be cooked immediately to avoid losing flavor.
Method 2: You can also soak peeled potatoes in cold water mixed with a little vinegar. This significantly reduces dark spots.
Method 3: For potatoes that have already browned, you can briefly boil them with a little fresh milk. This helps remove dark spots and adds a fresh milky aroma.
These methods are helpful, but it's best to cook potatoes immediately after peeling to ensure flavor and freshness.
How to choose good potatoes
Choose potatoes with yellow skin, as they are usually sweeter and more fragrant than white-skinned ones.
Good potatoes have smooth, shiny skin and feel heavy in the hand. Choose medium-sized tubers.
To save time peeling, choose tubers with a full surface and few indentations.
Avoid buying sprouted potatoes, as they can be toxic.
Also, avoid potatoes with wrinkled, withered skin that feel light, as these are old potatoes.

mon_an.mo_ta: Matcha Latte is a variation of a latte using green tea powder instead of espresso. Matcha has many health benefits, so it is increasingly used in drinks and food preparation. Let's learn how to make a delicious matcha latte!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: A glass of ice cubes - ingredient
cac_buoc: Step 1: Put 15-20g of matcha powder and 15g of sugar into the shaker.
Step 2: Next, add 60ml of hot fresh milk to the shaker and stir well to dissolve the mixture. If you like it richer, you can add a little condensed milk.
Step 3: Add ice to the shaker and shake well to increase solubility and chill the drink.
Step 4: Pour the mixture into a glass and enjoy. You can garnish with a little matcha powder on top for a more attractive look.
Note: If you want to make a blended version, put the mixture into a blender instead of a shaker. To serve hot, use immediately after adding the hot milk to dissolve the mixture.
To increase flavor and nutrition, you can serve it with a little yogurt.
Good luck to everyone!

mon_an.ten: Spicy and Sour Glass Noodles for Hot Days
mon_an.mo_ta: Summer can make you lose your appetite and crave vegetables or foods with a sour, crispy, and cool taste. This spicy and sour glass noodle salad is an ideal choice for a light, delicious, and nutritious meal, or you can serve it as an appetizer when hosting guests.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Wood ear mushrooms - a few pieces
Mint leaves - 1 handful, washed and finely chopped
cac_buoc: Step 1: Finely chop the grated coconut and toast it in a pan until golden brown (be careful not to burn it, as it will smell scorched when mixed).
Step 2: Soak the wood ear mushrooms until expanded, wash well, then boil for about 2 minutes in boiling water. Remove, drain, and julienne.
Step 3: Soak the dried shrimp in hot water for a few minutes to soften, then rinse to remove any grit.
Next, put the shrimp, chili, sugar, and a pinch of salt into a blender. Squeeze the lemons to get about 110ml of juice, pour it over the shrimp-chili mixture, and blend until smooth.
Step 4: Boil the glass noodles in boiling water for a few minutes until soft, then remove and immediately drop into a bowl of cold water to prevent sticking. Drain in a basket.
Step 5: Blanch the bean sprouts in boiling water for about 30 seconds until slightly cooked and less pungent, then drain.

Finally, put the glass noodles, bean sprouts, blended shrimp, mint leaves, and wood ear mushrooms into a large bowl. Mix well, then serve on a plate and sprinkle with the toasted coconut. It's very delicious.

mon_an.ten: Homemade Bánh Đa Kê (Millet Rice Cracker)
mon_an.mo_ta: Bánh đa kê has long been a rustic snack loved by both children and adults. The dish is a delicate blend of a crispy rice cracker and a delicious mung bean filling, making it irresistible. Today, we will share the secret to making wonderful bánh đa kê at home. From preparing ingredients to the detailed process, we will explore the secrets to creating these fragrant and attractive crackers right in this article! Learn about the origin of Bánh đa kê - a familiar snack for Northerners. In the cold winter, it provides a nutty, crispy sensation that feels warm. In the summer heat, it offers a sweet, refreshing taste. Bánh đa kê is made from a rice cracker grilled over charcoal, topped with millet porridge, mashed mung beans, and a bit of granulated sugar. For more variety, add shredded coconut and sandwich it with another piece of cracker. Each bite is a wonderful culinary experience.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare ingredients
To soften the mung beans, soak them in water for about 4 hours before cooking. Soaking helps them cook faster. After soaking, rinse and drain.
For the glutinous millet, soak in limewater for about 2 hours. Then, rinse with clean water 2-3 times to clean.
For the coconut, grate the flesh and put it in a separate bowl.
Step 2: Steam the mung beans
After the mung beans are washed, place them in a steamer. Steam for 20-25 minutes until soft.
Once cooked, transfer to a mortar and pestle to mash finely, or use a blender. Place the mashed mung beans on a plate.
Step 3: Cook the millet filling
Add the millet to a pot with a little salt, ensuring the water volume is about 3 times the volume of the millet. To prevent sticking, use a thick-bottomed pot, such as a cast iron pot.
Bring to a boil, then lower the heat. Every few minutes, stir well so the millet doesn't stick or burn.
Continue cooking until the millet is very soft and mushy when pressed. The millet porridge should be thick and smooth.
Step 4: Grill the raw rice crackers
To grill raw rice crackers, prepare a charcoal stove and wait until the coals are red. Place the crackers on a grill rack and cook both sides for about 2 minutes until golden and crispy.
Besides charcoal, you can also use a gas stove or an oven with similar results.
Step 5: Complete the Bánh Đa Kê

Break a large piece of rice cracker, then spread a layer of millet porridge on the surface. Next, add a layer of mashed mung beans and a bit of white sugar. Sprinkle shredded coconut evenly, then use another piece of cracker to sandwich the filling.
And there you have it, a sweet and nutty Bánh Đa Kê!
Notes for making Bánh Đa Kê
You should choose a very thick pot for cooking to avoid burning the bottom.
The millet porridge must be thick and pasty, not too watery, or it won't stay on the cracker.
This dish has a gentle sweetness and is not overly heavy, so you won't feel greasy eating it.

mon_an.mo_ta: Grilled pineapple and shrimp skewers are a unique dish that many home cooks might not know how to make. This attractive dish is a perfect combination of sweet shrimp, bacon, the tanginess of ripe pineapple, and a rich teriyaki sauce. I guarantee that just looking at the photos will make your mouth water. As mentioned, this dish is extremely simple and the ingredients are easy to find, so update your recipe book to treat your family this weekend.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Dried chili - 1 tsp or fresh chili
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare ingredients
Minced the ginger, garlic, and green onions.
Wash the shrimp, peel, and devein. Then, marinate the shrimp with a little salt and pepper.
Slice the bacon thinly and cut the slices in half.
Peel the pineapple, remove the eyes and core, then cut into small pieces slightly longer than the shrimp.
Soak the bamboo skewers in water to make them flexible and prevent them from burning during grilling.
Step 2: Execution steps
First, prepare the sauce as follows:
Pour the teriyaki sauce into a bowl, mix in the minced ginger, green onions, and chili powder. Stir well, then add the sugar and minced garlic to finish the sauce.
Next, take a shrimp, place a piece of pineapple on top, then use a piece of bacon to wrap tightly around the shrimp and pineapple. Use a bamboo skewer to secure the ingredients.
Repeat until all ingredients are used.
Place the shrimp and pineapple skewers on a grill rack, then use a brush to coat each skewer with the sauce. Be sure to brush evenly on all sides for a beautiful color when cooked.
Place the grill rack in the oven at about 180-200°C and grill for 10-12 minutes.
Arrange on a plate and eat while hot. You can dip them in chili sauce or mayonnaise.
Notes
Besides the oven, you can also grill over charcoal.
While grilling, watch the color and remember to flip the skewers so they cook evenly.
Choose pineapples that are just ripe; even if the skin is green, the inside is sweet. This prevents the pineapple from becoming too mushy when grilled.
Ginger and garlic should be finely minced or pureed so the sauce is smooth and they don't burn or turn bitter during grilling.

mon_an.mo_ta: Treat your guests to homemade candied carrots with this delicious recipe. Anyone who tries them will be absolutely delighted.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 1kg large carrots, smooth skin, bright red
cac_buoc: To make candied carrots, alum and lime water are essential. You can buy alum at dry goods stores in markets or supermarkets. For the lime water, use quicklime, soak it in water, and then filter the clear liquid once the lime has settled at the bottom.

To learn how to make delicious candied carrots, first peel the carrots and cut them into squares or flower shapes, slightly thick (about 0.5 cm is ideal). Soak them in lime water for 2-3 hours. To make lime water, simply mix quicklime with 2L of water, stir well, wait for it to settle, and then pour off the clear liquid. Soaking carrots in lime water helps the pieces become firmer so they don't break apart during the sugar-coating process. After soaking, remove the carrots and rinse thoroughly with cold water several times to completely remove the lime smell.
Next, boil water with alum and add the carrots to cook for about 4 minutes (do not cook longer). After 4 minutes, remove the carrots, rinse with cold water, and drain.

Continuing the process, place the carrots in a large bowl, layering carrots and sugar alternately. For 1 kg of carrots, use about 500-600 g of sugar. For the best flavor, marinate the carrots in sugar for 2 hours until the sugar completely dissolves into a liquid and soaks into the carrots.

Place a pan on the stove. Once the pan is hot, add the carrot and sugar mixture. Simmer over low heat, using large chopsticks to stir constantly and evenly. This sugar-coating process must be done slowly and gradually. Do not be impatient and turn up the heat, or the candied carrots will not turn out successfully!

Continue cooking the carrots over medium heat until the sugar reduces. Occasionally stir with chopsticks so the carrots absorb the sugar. The method is quite simple, but if you aren't careful at this stage, it will burn, making the candy taste bitter or overly sweet.

Pay close attention to the pan. When the sugar becomes syrupy, lower the heat to a very low simmer. Stir constantly until the sugar crystallizes into a white coating on the carrots, then add a few drops of vanilla and turn off the heat. This stage takes quite a while, so you need to be patient. Continue stirring the carrots for a few more minutes until the sugar is completely dry. Only very low heat will cause the sugar to crystallize into powder on each piece! High heat will definitely burn the sugar.

And that's it—delicious candied carrots are finished. The method for making candied carrots is similar to other types of fruit preserves, so you can make various kinds for the Tet holiday! With the bright orange of the carrots and the smooth white of the sugar, this perfectly sweet treat is sure to be a hit. To keep them fresh for a long time, store the candied carrots in an airtight plastic bag or a glass jar. Let's learn how to make these delicious candied carrots for the whole family!

mon_an.mo_ta: Hello everyone! I am very happy and surprised to receive this coconut candy tutorial from Hang "Moon". This is exactly what I always hope for. Your contributions and sharing enrich our collection of dishes and recipes. Regarding coconut candy, there was an older post here: how to make coconut candy for Tet. Today, I'd like to post Hang Moon's tutorial for everyone to reference.
cac_buoc: Instructions:
Step 1: Choose medium-aged coconuts (neither too young nor too old), peel off the brown skin, and use a peeler to shave around the coconut to get long ribbons.
Step 2: Thoroughly wash the shaved coconut to ensure all the oil is removed. You can check by looking at the rinse water; initially, it will be milky white.
Step 3: Rinse until the water is clear and there is no oil left.
Step 4: Remove the coconut and let it drain.

Step 5: At this stage, weigh the coconut meat again; for every 1kg of coconut meat, marinate with 600g of sugar. After about 8 hours, the sugar will partially dissolve and the coconut will shrink; use chopsticks to stir so the coconut is evenly soaked and the sugar dissolves completely. Total marinating time is about 12 - 14 hours, until the coconut ribbons look translucent.

Step 6: Use a wide, thick-bottomed pan to cook the coconut. Add the coconut and sugar water to the pan. Initially, you can use high heat; once the sugar water boils, switch to low heat and stir the coconut constantly.
With 1kg of coconut, you should cook it in 2 batches. Do not cook too much at once, as it will be difficult to stir and easy to burn.
Step 7: When the sugar water is almost dry, add the vanilla extract and stir well.
From this point, you should use two pairs of chopsticks to toss the coconut continuously...
... until the sugar dries into tiny white crystals, then turn off the heat...
... spread the coconut onto a tray, toss well, and let the candy cool completely.
It can be said that coconut ribbon candy is the most popular treat during the traditional Tet holiday in Vietnam.

mon_an.mo_ta: Let's learn how to make candied starfruit with ginger to welcome the New Year! ^^ The ingredients are easy to find and the process is simple, resulting in a wonderful Tet treat without worrying about food safety, and it's definitely cheaper. Why hesitate? Let's start making it together! It is best to choose medium-sized, uniform starfruit for the best results.
cac_buoc: Separate the starfruit into individual ribs. Dissolve salt in 2 liters of water, soak the starfruit for 1 hour, then sun-dry until the water is completely gone.
Wash the fresh ginger and crush it finely with the skin on.
Before stir-frying, rinse the starfruit with warm salt water, then soak in cold water for 1 hour to soften the pieces. Next, drain well and marinate with sugar and ginger for 2-3 hours.

Use a thick-bottomed pan and add all the starfruit and ginger. Stir well over low heat until the starfruit becomes sticky and turns an amber color, then turn off the heat and let it cool completely before storing in a container.
The longest part of making candied starfruit is the sun-drying stage (it takes about 10 days in dry weather). Wishing you success and a prosperous New Year!

mon_an.ten: Assorted Candied Sweet Potatoes and Yams
mon_an.mo_ta: As Tet approaches, various types of candied treats appear more than ever. This year, check out how to make these varieties to serve your guests yourself!
cac_buoc: Have you prepared all the ingredients yet?
If everything is ready, let's start the steps to make candied potatoes!
Step 1:
Peel the potatoes first. Note that as soon as you peel them, soak them in water immediately to prevent browning!
Step 2:
Shape the potatoes. Slice them into thin pieces, then you can use flower molds or a knife to cut them uniformly.
Step 3:
Boil the potatoes. For sweet potatoes, add a few slices of ginger to the boiling water to make the candy fragrant.
For potatoes, add a tiny bit of salt.
For taro, you don't need to add anything.
Step 4:
Boil until the potatoes are just cooked, then remove and let them drain and cool.
Step 5:
Marinate the potatoes with sugar. For every 200g of potatoes, use about 50g of sugar!
Step 6:
Leave overnight (6 - 8 hours) for the sugar to dissolve completely.
Step 7:
After that, remove the potatoes and drain the liquid.
Step 8:
Place the potatoes in a pot and stir-fry over very low heat.
If the stove heat is still too high, place the pot inside a thick pan to stir-fry! Remember to stir very gently.
Step 9:
When you see a layer of dry white sugar appearing at the bottom of the pot, it means the candy is ready.
If you have an oven, you can put the candy in and set it to the drying mode (about 80°C).
Spread the candy on a clean tray to cool completely, then put it in a container for later use!
This assorted candied potato dish is not difficult to make, is it?
Don't hesitate to buy the ingredients and start making these delicious candied potatoes to treat your guests this Tet.

mon_an.mo_ta: Plum jam is a favorite because of its easy-to-eat flavor and versatility. Make this dish ahead of time for Tet or simply to enjoy with friends. Today, we will make plum jam with a simple, time-saving recipe.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the plums, soak in salt water, then pit them and keep the flesh. You can keep the pits and crush them.
Put the crushed pits into a clean bag and tie it tightly. Marinate the plum flesh and the pit bag with sugar. Cover tightly and place in the refrigerator overnight.
Step 2: Afterward, take the plums out of the fridge, put them in a pot, and stir until boiling. Skim off any foam.
Lower the heat, squeeze in the lemon juice, and stir well. When the plum jam has thickened, press or squeeze the pit bag to release the pectin. Stir once more and turn off the heat.
Note: Plum jam can be eaten directly, spread on bread, or used as a sauce for cooking various dishes.

mon_an.mo_ta: With this apricot jam recipe, your family's daily meals will become much more delicious!
cac_buoc: Note: Choose apricots that are round, fleshy, firm, ripe yellow, not bruised or rotten, with stems intact and the fine fuzz still present.
Now let's start making apricot jam!
Step 1:
First, we need to wash the apricots thoroughly!
Be sure to remove the stems from the fruit.
Then, let the apricots drain.
Step 2:
Remove the pits from the apricots.
Step 3:
Add about 50ml of water to a pot and simmer until the apricots are soft (about 15 minutes).
Step 4:
Next, we will blend the apricots until very smooth!
Step 5:
Add sugar to the blended apricots.
Step 6:
Meanwhile, take about 10g of gelatin powder and put it in a bowl.
Then mix it with about 50ml of water.
Step 7:
Now, put the blended apricots on the stove to cook! Cook over medium heat so the apricots don't burn or lose their color.
Step 8:
When the apricots boil and the sugar has completely dissolved, slowly pour in the gelatin and stir well until the mixture boils again, then turn off the heat.
You just need to let the apricot jam cool down and it's ready to eat!
Homemade apricot jam is very fragrant!
It has a golden color and a rich apricot flavor.
Store the jam in glass jars!
Apricot jam can be eaten with various types of bread...
... pastries
or used for roasting or stewing with chicken or duck—it's all very delicious!

mon_an.mo_ta: Nem chua is a specialty that everyone loves. It is perfect for gatherings with friends and family. To ensure clean and safe food, you can completely make nem chua yourself at home. Today, I'll show you how to make delicious beef nem chua at home!
cac_buoc: Steps to follow:
Use a razor to scrape the pork skin clean, wash, and drain.
Prepare a pot of water with crushed ginger and lemongrass, bring to a boil, then blanch the pork skin for 5 minutes to clean it.
Prepare a bowl of ice water, remove the blanched pork skin and place it in the bowl to make it crunchy.
Remove the pork skin, wipe dry or let drain, then slice into thin strips as shown in the photo.
Mince the garlic and chili.
Coarsely crush the peppercorns with a mortar and pestle; do not grind them into a fine powder so the nem chua retains a pungent peppery flavor.
Wash the beef, wipe dry or let drain, then cut into small pieces and mince or grind it; grind moderately so the nem doesn't become mushy.
Place the ground beef in a bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and keep in the refrigerator for about 45-60 minutes.
After about 1 hour, take the beef out, add garlic, pepper, chili, seasoning powder, and the Thai nem mix, then mix well so the beef absorbs the flavors.
Prepare a plastic container lined with plastic wrap at the bottom, pour in the seasoned beef mixture, press down firmly, and wrap tightly with the remaining plastic wrap.
Place the container in the refrigerator for about 24 hours.
After 1 day, take the nem out to check; if the meat has turned pink as shown below, it is ready.
Cut the nem chua into bite-sized pieces.
Enjoy:
Cut only as much beef nem chua as you plan to eat; store the rest in the refrigerator. It will stay delicious for several days.
Beef nem chua is both nutritious and not at all greasy, making it perfect for treating family and friends. Children especially love this beef nem chua dish.

mon_an.mo_ta: Nem chua rán is a familiar snack for people in Hanoi. The crust is crispy and golden, while the inside remains soft, fragrant, and rich. This dish is a favorite that can enchant any diner, whether the weather is hot or cold. However, everyone agrees that when it's a bit chilly, eating nem chua rán is much more appealing. Today, as Hanoi welcomes the first cold of the season, here is a recipe for very attractive nem chua rán.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the nem

To make nem chua rán, you must use "sweet" nem, which is the type of nem chua that has just been made and not yet left to ferment. You can refer to the nem chua recipe here. Note that after mixing the meat, you don't need to use banana leaves; you can shape the nem into bite-sized pieces immediately. Let the nem sit for about 3-5 hours before frying for the best taste.
Step 2: Breading

Roll each piece of nem through breadcrumbs. If you like, you can roll it through a layer of flour, then a layer of egg, and finally the breadcrumbs. This is done exactly like making cheese sticks or breaded fried meat.
Step 3: Frying

Pour oil into a pan, heat it up, then drop each piece of nem in to fry until they are golden brown. Remove and place on a rack to drain the oil. Serve with chili sauce, accompanied by green mango, cucumber, and jicama with chili salt for the best experience.
Here is the finished product.
In this cold weather, having this dish dipped in spicy chili sauce is wonderful. Give it a try!

mon_an.mo_ta: Nem chua rán – this popular snack is very easy to make with just a few simple ingredients. Check out the recipe below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 300gr pork with a bit of fat (no skin)
1 teaspoon toasted rice powder (or nem chua powder)
1/2 teaspoon pepper; 1 teaspoon sugar; 1 teaspoon oyster sauce
2 tablespoons finely chopped scallions; 1 teaspoon minced garlic
cac_buoc: Ingredients you need to prepare:
Step 1: Wash the pork, wipe dry, cut into pieces, and place in the freezer for 40 minutes. Then take it out and grind it into a smooth paste (giò sống).
Step 2: Put the meat paste, pork skin, and seasonings into a bowl and mix well.
Step 3: Spread out plastic wrap, put a bit of the mixture on it, and roll it into a long, round shape. Place in the refrigerator for 30 minutes to let the nem set its shape.
Then take the nem out and roll it through breadcrumbs.
Step 4: Heat a pan of oil on the stove. When the oil is hot, add each roll of nem and fry over medium heat.
Fry until the nem is golden and crispy, then remove to a plate lined with paper towels.
Cut the nem chua rán into pieces and serve on a plate with lettuce, cucumber, pickled vegetables, and chili sauce.

mon_an.mo_ta: Nem chua is my family's favorite snack. Back in high school, every day I went to the market, I had to buy one to dip in chili sauce for fun (at my local market, the nem chua was large and cylindrical, not the small ones from Thanh Hoa). A long piece of nem chua was over a span long and as thick as a teacup. When eating, it was sliced and dipped in chili sauce—sour, fragrant with pepper and garlic, and spicy with chili; the more you ate, the more you loved it. Later, they were wrapped into small individual pieces, which are more convenient to eat, but I limited eating them due to food safety concerns. Recently, after researching some recipes online, I've gathered some small tips to make delicious nem chua. Let's try making nem chua together!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 400gr lean meat (you can choose pork or beef; beef tastes great and seems better than pork)
Guava leaves - As needed (or đinh lăng leaves)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the banana leaves and dry them in the sun for a while so they become dry and slightly wilted, making them easier to wrap. Tear the banana leaves into small pieces suitable for wrapping nem. Wash the guava leaves and cut them into small pieces.

Step 2: Wash the pork skin, blanch briefly in boiling water, then scrape and wash clean. Rub with vinegar and white salt to make the skin very clean and remove any odor, then boil until cooked. Remove and place the pork skin in the refrigerator for a few hours to make it chewy, which makes the nem better. Then take it out and julienne it into strips about 1.5-2cm long.

Peel the garlic and divide it in half: slice one half and mince the other. Wash the chilies, remove some seeds, and slice. Toast the peppercorns; you can leave them whole or crush them slightly to mix with the meat later.
Step 3: Wash the meat, use paper towels or a cloth to wipe it very dry, then cut into small pieces and grind in a food processor until the meat is smooth and forms a ball.

Step 4: Place the meat in a bowl, add 1 tbsp fish sauce, 3 tbsp sugar, 1 tbsp ground or whole pepper (as preferred), minced garlic, and chili, then mix well. Wear gloves and mix until very smooth. It's hard to mix evenly with a spoon or chopsticks because the next step requires quite a bit of force.
After mixing the ingredients together, open the seasoning packet, which contains powder and a smaller seasoning packet. Add the powder from the large packet first and mix well.
Step 5: Then add the pork skin and mix very thoroughly.

Step 6: Next, add the seasoning from the small packet and mix well; the meat will turn grayish and start to firm up. Mix very quickly and thoroughly. Since the nem has started to harden, you'll need to increase your hand strength to mix it.
Step 7: Wrapping the nem

Spread out a banana leaf and place a guava leaf on top. Scoop a spoonful of the nem mixture, flatten it out, place a few slices of garlic and chili in the middle, and roll it up tightly. Because the nem sets very quickly, I had to recruit my husband to help with the wrapping.

If you're hesitant to wrap individual small pieces, you can use a sausage mold to wrap the nem. Put the nem mixture in and press down very firmly. As you add the meat, sprinkle sliced garlic and chili evenly throughout. After removing it from the mold, wrap the outside with guava leaves and banana leaves.
Leave the nem at room temperature for about 1-2 days (only 1 day if it's hot, but 2 days if it's cold or cool) and it will be ready to eat.

mon_an.mo_ta: When enjoying Nem Lụi, you will experience the fragrant, fresh, and flavorful meat, perfectly seasoned and served with various herbs, vegetables, and a signature dipping sauce for a wonderful sensation. With just a little time in the kitchen, you can have a delicious dish to treat your family and friends! Check out this simple and delicious recipe for homemade grilled lemongrass pork skewers. You will learn how to easily prepare and grill these fragrant skewers, infused with lemongrass and spices, right at home.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings - Salt, fish sauce, seasoning powder, pepper, and cooking oil
Side herbs - Curly lettuce, basil, Vietnamese coriander, etc.
Dipping sauce ingredients - fish sauce or soy sauce + 100g ground pork + 150g pork liver + 450ml fresh milk + tapioca starch + peanuts + chili powder and sugar
cac_buoc: Step 1:

First, place the raw pork paste, ground pork, and shallots in a large bowl with a little salt, fish sauce, seasoning powder, pepper, and cooking oil. Mix thoroughly until the ingredients are well combined, then cover and refrigerate for about 3 hours to allow the flavors to penetrate.
Step 2:
Pick through the herbs to remove roots and wilted or damaged leaves, then wash them with salt water and drain.
Wash the cucumbers, cut them in half, remove the seeds, and slice them into short strips.
Wash the lemongrass and cut into sections about 15cm long.
Step 3:

Next, grease your hands with a little oil, use a spoon to scoop the meat mixture and wrap it around the end of a lemongrass stalk, then flatten the meat slightly. Arrange the meat-wrapped lemongrass stalks on a tray lined with parchment paper. Repeat until all ingredients are used. Once prepared, place them in the oven for about 15 minutes at 180°C or until the meat is cooked through.
Step 4:
Note to brush some oil onto the meat while grilling to prevent it from drying out. Alternatively, you can use charcoal instead of an oven for a more fragrant and delicious result.
Wash the pork liver, cut into bite-sized pieces, and soak in fresh milk for about 30 minutes. Remove, drain, and mince finely.
Step 5:
Roast the peanuts and sesame seeds until golden, then crush them. Dissolve the tapioca starch in water.
Step 6:

After preparing the ingredients for the sauce, heat oil in a pan and sauté the garlic until fragrant, then add the ground pork and liver and stir-fry until cooked. Next, add the chili powder and simmer over low heat. When the meat is tender and soft, pour in the tapioca starch mixture and stir well. Once the sauce has thickened slightly, turn off the heat and add the crushed peanuts and sesame seeds.

Finally, arrange all the prepared ingredients on the table. Slice the Nem Lụi into bite-sized pieces or leave them whole. You can serve them with rice vermicelli or rice paper, meat, herbs, and the dipping sauce.
Notes for delicious Nem Lụi:
If grilling Nem Lụi over charcoal, remember to turn the skewers regularly so the meat cooks evenly without burning.
Depending on personal preference, you can use the specific Nem Lụi dipping sauce or a sweet and sour fish sauce.
When making the meat mixture, remember to mix thoroughly so the seasonings are evenly distributed.
Common side herbs include lettuce, cilantro, cucumber, star fruit or mango, pineapple, banana, or any herbs you enjoy.

Nem Lụi is fragrant, fresh, and flavorful, providing a wonderful sensation when eaten with herbs, vegetables, and the signature sauce. Just a little time in the kitchen and you have a great dish for family and friends!
Secrets to restaurant-quality Nem Lụi:

Grilled Nem Lụi combined with herbs and a special sauce creates a unique and delicious flavor. Additionally, grilled sweet potatoes are a popular snack due to their nutty aroma and the characteristic flavor of the charred skin from charcoal grilling.

To prevent the pork paste from becoming too salty, use only a small amount of fermented shrimp paste (mắm nêm); when eating, you can wrap the pork and dip it in sweet and sour fish sauce to enhance the flavor.
To prevent the grilled skewers from drying out, add pork fat or cooking oil (or cashew oil) to the meat mixture before grilling.

Using lemongrass stalks with bruised ends to wrap the meat provides the best flavor, as the essential oils from the lemongrass make the Nem Lụi more fragrant. If lemongrass is unavailable, you can use sugarcane or skewers instead.
If you have time, you can make the dipping sauce from liver for a more authentic Hue-style dish. How to make the sauce:
Use 100g ground pork and 100g pork or chicken liver, washed and sliced. Soak the liver in fresh milk for 30 minutes to remove the gamey smell, then blanch in boiling water and mince or grind finely.
Sauté minced shallots and garlic, then add the liver and ground pork and stir-fry until firm. Season to taste. Add a little water and simmer over low heat until the meat is soft.
Mix a little tapioca starch with water and stir it in to thicken the sauce. Turn off the heat, add roasted peanuts, sesame seeds, and chili powder (to taste), and stir well.
Notes for a successful Nem Lụi dish:
You can increase the binding of the meat by adding a little tapioca starch to the mixture.
Before wrapping the meat, rub a little oil on your plastic wrap or hands to prevent sticking.
You can also use the base of the lemongrass instead of toothpicks to skewer the meat for a better aroma.

This dish can be stored in the refrigerator, so you can make a large batch and keep it in the freezer. When ready to eat, simply defrost and re-grill. The meat will be thick and securely attached to the skewers.
Nem Lụi has a wonderful fragrance and is perfectly seasoned, offering a delightful experience for the palate.
This dish is succulent and very appealing.
To enjoy Nem Lụi, wrap the meat in rice paper with fresh herbs, cucumber, and pickles. Combining it with rice vermicelli will surely make you fall in love with this dish.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Lean Pork Salad with Toasted Rice Powder (Nem Thính)
mon_an.mo_ta: Nem Thính is a familiar dish for many families, featuring fresh lean pork, crispy pork skin, and chewy glass noodles, all blended together. Eaten with fig leaves and dipped in sweet and sour fish sauce, it provides a wonderful sensation. With just a little time in the kitchen, you can have this delicious dish! Refer to the recipe below to make Nem Thính at home.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Lime leaves, lime, garlic, chili, side herbs - ingredients
Fish sauce, MSG, seasoning salt, sugar - seasonings
cac_buoc: Step 1:

First, place the pork skin and lean pork in a pot and boil with a little seasoning salt. You should parboil them once to remove any odors before boiling them fully. When boiling, ensure the meat is just cooked through; boiling too long will make the meat dry.
Afterward, let the meat cool slightly, then thinly slice both the skin and the lean pork.
Remember to keep the lean pork and the skin on two separate plates.
Step 2:
Wash the lime leaves and slice them into thin strips.
Peel the garlic, wash it, and mince it finely.
Wash the chili and slice it thinly.
Step 3:
Prepare the dipping sauce: combine 1 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp lime juice, 1 tsp MSG, and the minced garlic and chili in a bowl. Add a little water. Adjust the seasoning to suit your taste.
Step 4:
Next, use a clean bowl to mix the pork skin salad.
Add a layer of skin, followed by a layer of meat and a layer of toasted rice powder.
Add a little seasoning salt and 1 tsp MSG.
Add some chili, minced garlic, and sliced lime leaves.
Then, toss all the ingredients together thoroughly.
Step 5:
Once mixed, arrange the Nem Thính on a plate and serve with aromatic leaves and the spicy-sour dipping sauce.
Notes for delicious and attractive Nem Thính:
Try to slice the pork skin while it is still warm; it will be easier to slice and not as tough.
When buying pork skin, remember to ask the butcher to clean off all the hair. This ensures the dish is not prickly or hard.
How to choose good meat:

Fresh meat: The exterior has a dry film, and the surface is slightly firm. The cut surface is bright pink, the skin is supple, the muscle fibers are firm, and it has good elasticity (when pressed with a finger, it leaves no mark upon release). The fat is bright, firm, and has a characteristic aroma. Joint surfaces are smooth and clear, and synovial fluid is transparent. The marrow clings tightly to the bone cavity and is elastic.

Stale meat: The exterior starts to feel slimy or very slimy (depending on the degree of spoilage), the cut surface is slightly wet, and elasticity is poor (pressing with a finger leaves a lasting indentation). The fat is dark, less firm, and has an off-odor. Joint surfaces are very slimy, and synovial fluid is cloudy. The marrow easily detaches from the bone and is dark or brown in color.
Old pork or sow meat: The muscle fibers are loose, dark red, and the skin is thick.

Diseased pork: The muscle fibers are loose, the fat is yellow and may contain opaque white grains. There are small dots in the liver and kidneys. The skin may have round or oval hemorrhagic patches. The skin may not be intact or may have carved-out areas (where abscesses or hemorrhages were removed).

Avoid buying pork that is too old or too young. Only buy medium-aged pork that is pink with thin skin. There are two types of lean meat: tenderloin and leg meat. Tenderloin is tastier and sweet when stir-fried but becomes fibrous and dry if overcooked. Leg meat is softer.

mon_an.mo_ta: Butter-fried corn is a delicious snack loved by many, especially children. To help you prepare this dish at home for your family, we present the secret to making it even more flavorful and attractive. Enjoy the fragrant and crunchy taste of butter-fried corn with these detailed and simple instructions. Learn how to make this dish at home and show off your cooking skills with fresh corn, aromatic butter, and blended spices. This dish is a perfect combination of fresh corn and melting butter, creating a unique and irresistible flavor. You won't be able to resist the allure of this crispy butter-fried corn.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Sweet corn - 1 bag (you can use fresh corn instead of canned corn)
Seasoning powder, cooking oil, fine salt
cac_buoc: Bước 1:

If using canned corn, simply drain it and let it dry. If using fresh corn, rinse it to remove the silk (no need to be too thorough as the silk will separate when mixing and sifting the flour). Boil water with a few tablespoons of sugar, add the corn and blanch for 1-2 minutes, then drain. Quickly rinse with cold water to keep the kernels plump and let them dry. While the corn is still hot, sprinkle in a little seasoning powder for a savory taste; if it cools down, the seasoning won't penetrate as well.
Bước 2:

Separate the egg white and use it instead of the yolk to prevent foaming during frying. Keep the corn in a colander, add the egg white, and mix by hand. Excess egg white will drain through the holes of the colander, preventing the corn from becoming too wet, which would make it soggy and waste flour.
Next, place the corn in a bowl and add the flour mixture, tossing until each kernel is evenly coated. Use a large-hole sieve to shake off excess flour; any remaining corn silk will also fall away.
Bước 3:

Heat the oil until very hot, then add the corn to fry (it tastes best when fried and served hot). It is best to leave the corn undisturbed at first; avoid stirring immediately as the flour coating can easily fall off and settle at the bottom of the pan.
Bước 4:

The flour cooks very quickly, so after a short while, you can use chopsticks to stir it gently. Once the coating is crispy and puffy, the corn is cooked. Remove the corn and place it on a plate lined with paper towels or a wire rack to drain the excess oil.
Bước 5:

If you want the dish to be extra rich and fragrant, add small pieces of butter to the pan just before removing the corn; alternatively, toss the corn with the butter immediately after taking it out. However, this may not be necessary as the custard powder already provides a buttery aroma.
How to choose fresh ingredients

When buying fresh corn, there are a few points to note. Choose ears with bright green husks and silk that is not withered or dry. Ensure the stalk is still fresh and not dried out, as fresh stalks indicate sweeter kernels.
The kernels should be glossy yellow, even, and straight, with no unusual colors. Avoid corn with dry husks or opaque white kernels, as these are usually old, starchy, and dry.
By following these criteria, you will select delicious fresh corn, ensuring sweetness and freshness for your dish.
Notes for making delicious, crispy butter-fried corn
Choose fresh corn: Select fresh, high-quality corn to ensure the best flavor. If possible, buy fresh corn from a farm or a trusted market.
Prepare the right type of butter: Use fresh, high-quality butter. The butter should be soft but not melted, so that when fried, it creates a crispy outer layer and a soft, melting interior.
Cutting the kernels: When preparing fresh corn, cut the kernels off the cob, trying to cut close to the cob to capture all the sweetness.
Heat the butter at the right temperature: Melt the butter over medium heat to ensure it melts evenly without burning.
Fry the corn evenly: When frying, spread the corn evenly in the pan so it cooks uniformly and develops a beautiful golden color.
Remove when golden: Once the corn is golden and crispy, remove it from the pan to prevent burning and maintain its crunch.
Add seasonings as desired: After frying, you can add seasonings such as salt, chili powder, BBQ seasoning, or MSG to enhance the flavor of the butter-fried corn.

mon_an.mo_ta: Green papaya salad is not only a staple in many family meals but also a favorite snack for teenagers. Let's learn how to make this delicious dish!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning salt, fish sauce, MSG... - seasoning
cac_buoc: Soak the shredded papaya in water mixed with a little lime juice for about 10 minutes to remove the sap and prevent bitterness.
Drain the papaya and squeeze out all the excess water.
Mix 2 tbsp fish sauce + 2 tbsp sugar + 1 tbsp calamansi juice (or lime juice) to make the dressing.
Mix the papaya with the shredded carrots, then gently toss with the prepared dressing.
When ready to serve, simply top with roasted peanuts.
Note: You can add Vietnamese balm (kinh giới) to make the dish more fragrant!

mon_an.mo_ta: Pineapple juice is rich in vitamins and minerals, making it very beneficial for your body. Let's make this wonderful drink!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Separate the coconut water and the coconut meat.
Blend 3/4 of the pineapple and strain to get the juice.
Cut the remaining 1/4 pineapple into small cubes and place them in the freezer until frozen. These will keep the drink cold.
Step 2:
Blend the pineapple juice, coconut water, and coconut meat with ice and a pinch of salt. If the mixture isn't sweet enough, add sugar to taste.
Pour into a glass and top with a splash of coconut milk.

mon_an.ten: Ô Mai Táo Mèo (Salted and Sugared Dried Hawthorn)
mon_an.mo_ta: With this delicious recipe for Ô Mai Táo Mèo, you can not only enjoy it as a snack but also use it to soothe a cough and calm your throat! Check out the recipe now!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fresh hawthorn (táo mèo) - 1 kg (choose firm fruits)
cac_buoc: Step 1:
After purchasing the hawthorn, wash them thoroughly with water, then remove and place in a basket to drain well.
Step 2:
Prepare 1 liter of cooled boiled water and dissolve 10g of salt in it (about 1 large spoon).
Step 3:
Now, slice the hawthorn into small pieces (as shown in the image).
As you slice each piece, immediately place it into the prepared saltwater to prevent the fruit from oxidizing and turning brown.
Soak the hawthorn for 3 hours.
Step 4:
After 3 hours, dissolve 10g of sugar in 1 liter of cooled boiled water.
Remove all the hawthorn from the saltwater and transfer them to the sugar water to soak for another 3 hours.

When the time is up, soak them in saltwater again. Remember to prepare a fresh batch of saltwater rather than reusing the old water. Then continue soaking in sugar water once more. Repeat this process until the hawthorn has been soaked in salt and sugar three times each. This helps remove all the astringency from the fruit.
Step 5:
After soaking through 3 rounds of salt and 3 rounds of sugar, place the hawthorn in a basket and let them dry. Sun-dry them for 3 to 4 days.
Note: If there is no sun on the day you dry the fruit, don't worry; you can use the dehydration or drying mode of your oven. Set the temperature to about 70°C.
Step 6:
Once the hawthorn is dry, crush the ginger. Crush 100g of ginger finely. If the process irritates your eyes, you can lightly squeeze the ginger to remove some juice so it doesn't splash.
Step 7:
Next, mix the crushed ginger with the dried hawthorn and the remaining sugar and salt. Let it marinate for about 4 hours, then dry it for one more day to finish.
Store in a clean jar for preservation and use gradually.
We have now completed the delicious Ô Mai Táo Mèo to enjoy during the Lunar New Year.
Making Ô Mai Táo Mèo takes some time, so if you want to make the effort worthwhile, you can double or triple the batch. For 2kg of hawthorn, simply double the amount of ginger, sugar, and salt.
With this method, you will have a delicious snack that is much more hygienic than store-bought versions!
The ginger and salt will soothe a sore throat, especially during the cold season when the weather changes. Sucking on a few slices of hawthorn can help reduce pain and coughing.

mon_an.mo_ta: Recently, snail stalls in Hanoi have become famous for their attractive stir-fried snails with tamarind, combining salty, sweet, sour, and spicy flavors that captivate diners. Today, we will share the guide on how to make this delicious dish. Discover the enticing flavors of this recipe.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Snails - 500g (sweet snails/ốc hương are used here, but any type of snail works well)
Glutinous rice flour - 1 tbsp (tapioca starch can be used as a substitute)
Cooking oil - as needed (add fresh chili if desired)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare ingredients

Peel and mince the garlic and shallots. Wash and slice the fresh chili. Remove the tough outer layers of the lemongrass and mince. Wash and finely shred the lime leaves. Pick and wash the Vietnamese coriander (rau răm), then drain.

Soak the ripe tamarind in warm water, then mash and strain to get the juice. Soak the snails in rice water with a few slices of chili for 3-4 hours to remove dirt and grit. Rinse with clean water and drain. Next, parboil the snails in a pot of water with 1/4 tsp of salt.
Step 2: Make the tamarind sauce
Place a pan on the stove and heat a little oil. Sauté the minced garlic, shallots, and lemongrass until fragrant.
Next, pour the tamarind juice into the pan along with 1/2 tsp salt, 4 tbsp sugar, and a bit of seasoning powder. Stir well and bring to a boil.
Meanwhile, mix 1 tbsp of tapioca starch or glutinous rice flour with 1/2 cup of filtered water, stirring until dissolved. Pour this mixture into the pan and cook over medium heat.
Adjust the seasoning to your taste. Simmer until the mixture becomes thick and flavorful.
Step 3: Stir-fry the snails
Add the prepared snails to the pan with the tamarind sauce. Stir well and cook for about 10 minutes so the snails absorb the flavors.
Continue stir-frying until the snails are fully cooked and fragrant. Add the chili and Vietnamese coriander to the pan, toss for about 1 minute, then turn off the heat.
Finally, transfer the stir-fried snails to a plate and enjoy while hot. You can serve them with salt, pepper, and lime or a ginger fish sauce to enhance the flavor.
The final product will offer sweet, chewy snail meat blended with a sweet and sour tamarind sauce, a hint of heat from the chili, and the characteristic aroma of Vietnamese coriander.
Notes for making stir-fried snails with tamarind
Besides sweet snails, you can choose other types like stone snails or mud creepers depending on your preference.
To ensure quality, it is best to soak the snails overnight to remove all mud and impurities. This saves time during preparation the next day.
When boiling the snails, only parboil them; do not overcook them, or the meat will become tough and lose its flavor.
The amount of tamarind juice can be adjusted according to your family's taste. Taste and adjust to achieve your desired flavor.
Tips for cleaning snails
Prepare the soaking water: Pour water into a large bowl or basin. Ensure there is enough water to completely submerge the snails.
Rinse the snails: Before soaking, rinse the snails with clean water to remove external mud. Use your hands or a soft brush to gently scrub the shells.

Soak in saltwater: Mix salt into the water at a ratio of about 1-2% (approx. 10-20g of salt per liter of water). Place the snails in the saltwater and soak for 1-2 hours. Salt helps clean the snails and kill potential bacteria.
Rinse again: After soaking, rinse the snails thoroughly with clean water to remove salt and remaining dirt. Use running water to rinse them well.
Final check: Check if the snails are completely clean. If you still see dust, mud, or other impurities, continue rinsing as above until they are perfectly clean.
