mon_an.mo_ta: Mango Panna Cotta is a delicious and attractive dessert with a smooth, bright yellow mango jelly layer and a white cream layer. Together they create an irresistible treat! Today's article will guide you through making this delicious Mango Panna Cotta. Discover this simple and enticing summer recipe.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Make the cream jelly layer
First, soak 7g of gelatin in 30ml of filtered water and let it bloom for about 5 minutes. You can use either leaf or powder gelatin. If using powder gelatin, soak it in 30ml of fresh milk.

Next, in a pot, combine 30g of sugar, fresh milk, and whipping cream. Heat gently and stir until the sugar is completely dissolved. When the mixture starts to steam and feels warm, turn off the heat without letting it boil.
Add the bloomed gelatin to the milk mixture and stir well. If using leaf gelatin, discard the soaking water first. If using powder gelatin, add the entire milk-gelatin mixture.
Pour the mixture into prepared molds and place them in the refrigerator. Wait until the cream layer is fully set. The time required will vary depending on the size of the molds.
Step 2: Make the mango jelly layer
Choosing ripe mangoes is crucial for this recipe. If the mangoes are very sweet, you may not need extra sugar. However, if they are slightly tart, adjust the sugar to your preference.
Next, soak the remaining gelatin to let it bloom.
Wash, peel, and pit the mango. Place the mango flesh in a blender and blend until smooth with 50ml of warm water. You can strain the mixture through a sieve if desired.

Add the gelatin to the mango sauce and stir until dissolved, then let it cool. If the mango sauce cools down before the gelatin is added, you can gently heat the mixture using a double boiler method to melt the gelatin.
Step 3: Complete the Mango Panna Cotta
Once the cream layer has set firmly, pour the mango mixture on top and let it cool. Place everything back in the refrigerator until the mango layer is fully set. Your Mango Panna Cotta is now ready.

The finished Mango Panna Cotta should look smooth and smell fragrantly of mango. When eating, you will experience a melting sensation in your mouth with a rich, creamy, and pleasantly sweet taste. This is an excellent choice for hot summer days.
With this recipe, you can also replace the mango with passion fruit, avocado, or any other fruit you love.
Notes for making Mango Panna Cotta
Mango type: Choose fully ripe mangoes that are sweet and fragrant for the best flavor.
Gelatin: Use leaf or powder gelatin as directed. Always bloom the gelatin in water or milk before use.
Heating the milk: When heating the milk and cream, do it gently and stir constantly. Do not let it boil; warm is enough.

Mango sauce: Blend the mango with warm water and strain if you want a perfectly smooth texture. Ensure the gelatin is completely dissolved and the mixture is cooled before pouring it over the cream layer.
Setting time: Leave the Panna Cotta in the fridge until the mango layer is completely firm. This time depends on the size and thickness of the dessert.
Fruit substitutions: You can easily swap mango for passion fruit, avocado, or other favorite fruits to vary the flavor.

mon_an.mo_ta: A familiar dish for gatherings, Phở Cuốn is suitable as a main meal on both hot days and breezy days. Another reason people love this dish is its simple and quick preparation. Let's follow this recipe to make delicious, nutritious, and affordable Phở Cuốn at home.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Lettuce, coriander, Thai basil, bean sprouts, mint - fresh herbs
Fish sauce, black pepper, ginger, garlic, chili, lime, sugar - seasonings
cac_buoc: Prepare ingredients
Wash the beef and slice into thin strips or thin bite-sized pieces.
Peel the onion, wash, and slice vertically into thin strips.
Roast the peanuts until golden, peel, and crush slightly.
Peel and slice the shallots. Peel and mince the garlic.
Pick and wash the fresh herbs, then drain well.
Cooking steps
Marinate the beef with fish sauce, pepper, ginger, and some of the minced garlic for 10 minutes. Set aside a little garlic for sautéing.

Place a pan on the stove, add two tablespoons of oil and heat. Sauté the remaining garlic until fragrant, then add the beef and stir-fry until just cooked through (medium-rare). Add the onions, toss briefly, and turn off the heat.
Next, fry the sliced shallots until golden and fragrant.
Prepare the dipping sauce with the following ratio: 1 tbsp sugar + 4 tbsp boiling water (stir to dissolve), then add 2 tbsp fish sauce, minced chili, minced garlic, and a squeeze of lime juice.

Finally, spread a phở sheet on a plate with the smooth side facing down. Layer with lettuce, a bit of rice vermicelli (optional), the stir-fried beef, herbs, crushed peanuts, and fried shallots. Roll the phở sheet tightly and enjoy.
Notes
When cooking the beef, do not overcook it. The best way is to toss the onions and beef together until the beef turns from deep red to a light pink.
To make the dipping sauce more attractive, mince the garlic and chili very finely so they float on the surface.

mon_an.mo_ta: Cheese sticks first appeared in the Lotteria fast-food chain from Korea. Later, many shops opened selling them at very attractive prices, becoming a hit with young people. In Hanoi, Tạ Hiện is a famous street for cheese sticks. While delicious, street versions can raise concerns about quality, origin, or reused oil. However, with this simple recipe, anyone can make golden, crispy, and delicious cheese sticks at home to satisfy their cravings while ensuring food safety.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Cheese - as desired (Mozzarella sticks or a block of cheese cut into sticks)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Place the breadcrumbs in a bowl, add the dried parsley, mix well, and set aside.
Step 2: Crack the eggs into a bowl and add a splash of milk...
Step 3: Place the flour on a separate plate.
You can mix a little salt and pepper into the flour and breadcrumbs to make the cheese sticks more flavorful.
Step 4: Remove the wrapper from the cheese sticks and cut them into bite-sized lengths.
If you don't have pre-made cheese sticks, you can buy a block of cheese and cut it into even sticks.
Step 5: Roll each piece of cheese in the flour until evenly coated.
Step 6: Dip the floured cheese stick into the beaten egg mixture until fully coated.
Step 7: Roll the cheese stick in the breadcrumbs until the outside is evenly covered.

Step 8: Arrange the cheese sticks on a plate. Repeat steps 5-7 until you have the desired amount. Place the tray of cheese sticks in the freezer for 20-30 minutes. This helps the ingredients adhere better and prevents the cheese from melting too quickly when frying.
Step 9: Fry the cheese sticks
After 20-30 minutes, place a pan on the stove and add enough oil to ensure the cheese sticks will be submerged. Heat the oil.
Gently drop the cheese sticks in. Fry until one side is golden, then flip and fry until the entire stick is golden brown and crispy.
Remove the sticks and place them on paper towels to drain excess oil.
Arrange on a plate and serve with chili sauce or tomato ketchup as desired.
Tips for delicious cheese sticks:
Adding seasonings (salt, pepper, etc.) to the flour and breadcrumbs enhances the flavor.
Mozzarella is the best cheese for this dish. If you can't find sticks, buy a block and cut it yourself.
Keep the cheese in the refrigerator until you are ready to coat it to prevent it from softening.
Freezing the coated cheese sticks is a key step to keep them from leaking or melting too fast during frying, helping them maintain their shape.
To ensure they are crispy and evenly golden, use enough oil to submerge them and keep the heat at a medium level (if too hot, the breadcrumbs will burn quickly). Flip them carefully while frying.
The perfect cheese stick should be golden and crispy on the outside, while the inside remains soft, stretchy, and fragrant with the scent of cheese, eggs, and milk.
Using the same method, you can replace the cheese with zucchini to make crispy fried zucchini.

mon_an.ten: Ripe Dracontomelon with Chili and Salt
mon_an.mo_ta: Ripe dracontomelon (sấu chín dầm) is a favorite snack for many generations in Northern Vietnam. These succulent, golden-ripe fruits seem to capture all the summer sunshine within their skins, making your mouth water just by looking at them. With every bite, you will experience a crunchy texture and a harmonious blend of sour, spicy, salty, and sweet flavors. This snack has become a signature treat of Hanoians every autumn. Let's learn how to make this classic dish with the following recipe.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Selecting the fruit

Choose ripe, plump dracontomelon with a deep yellow skin that may be slightly rough. The fruit should have an appealing aroma but must still feel firm to the touch. This ensures the snack remains crunchy.
Step 2: Preparation

Wash the fruit thoroughly. Use a knife to peel off the skin, revealing the vibrant yellow flesh. Use the tip of a sharp knife to carefully spiral-cut the flesh around the pit. Be careful not to let the slices break off completely.
Step 3: Mixing

Place the prepared fruit on a large tray or plate. Sprinkle with sugar, salt, chili powder, and finely chopped or crushed fresh chili, then toss well to combine. Let it sit for 15-20 minutes to allow the flavors to penetrate. Your famous Northern autumn snack is now ready to enjoy.

mon_an.mo_ta: Summer offers an abundance of fruit that can sometimes get boring to eat plain. Mothers can turn fresh fruits into delicious smoothies for the kids and the whole family to enjoy. Smoothies are tasty, nutritious, and very easy to make without much effort. These refreshing drinks will surely be a hit with the little ones.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Preparation
Peel the banana and cut into small chunks.
Peel the mango, remove the pit, and cut the flesh into small uniform cubes.
Choose a ripe pineapple with large, even eyes.
Peel and remove the eyes.
Slice into small pieces.
Step 2: Blending

Place the prepared mango, pineapple, and banana into a blender and blend until smooth. Add the fresh milk and condensed milk, then blend again until the mixture is well combined. Add ice and blend until the ice is fully crushed. Pour the smoothie into glasses, garnish with a slice of pineapple or mango for a nice look, and serve immediately. It tastes wonderful.
Mothers can also refer to recipes for strawberry, avocado, mango, or banana smoothies as dishes for two people.

mon_an.mo_ta: With just a few simple ingredients, you can make irresistibly crispy and spicy potato chips right at home!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
After washing the potatoes thoroughly, peel them and cut them into thin slices using a crinkle cutter knife.
Step 2:
After slicing, soak them in diluted salt water for about 10 minutes (this step helps the potatoes become more flavorful and crispier).
Step 3:
Next, put the tomato powder and chili powder into a grinder and grind them into a fine powder like this.
Step 4:
Now, remove the soaked potatoes and pat them dry with paper towels before seasoning.
Step 5:
Next, place the potatoes in a bowl and toss well with 2 tablespoons of oil and the spice mixture prepared in step 3.
Step 6:
Finally, arrange the potato slices in a single layer on a baking tray and bake for about 15 minutes (note: preheat the oven to 150°C for 3 minutes before baking).
Now you have achieved the result: crispy, flavorful snack chips!

mon_an.mo_ta: Making your own chocolates for your loved one this Valentine's Day will make the gift and the holiday warmer than ever. Let's check out this extremely simple way to make chocolate!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Condensed milk, heavy cream, or liquor
cac_buoc: Step 1:

Break the chocolate bars into small pieces into bowls; keep the white and dark chocolate in two separate bowls. Microwave each bowl for about 30 seconds. Take them out, stir well, and return to the microwave. Repeat until the chocolate is completely melted and smooth.
Add a little liquor, heavy cream, or condensed milk to the melted chocolate and stir well.
Step 2:
Prepare your heart-shaped molds. There are many beautiful chocolate molds available on the market; choose one you really like to make heart chocolates for him.

Using silicone molds will help the chocolates have a beautiful shape and prevent sticking when removed. Specifically, silicone heart molds are non-toxic, odorless, soft, easy to shape, colorfast, easy to clean, and durable for long-term use.
Step 3:
Pour the chocolate into the molds, let them cool, and then place them in the refrigerator. Once the chocolate has hardened, remove them from the molds. You now have heart-shaped chocolates.
You can mold the chocolate in two ways:
Option 1: Fill each mold separately with either white or dark chocolate.
Option 2: Pour white chocolate in first, then pour dark chocolate on top to create a two-toned heart. Remember to let the first layer set slightly before pouring the second layer!
Finished Product
After filling the molds, leave the chocolate in the refrigerator until firm before removing. We have now completed the beautiful heart-shaped chocolates for Valentine's Day. Let's admire our work!
Making heart chocolates isn't hard at all, right? With available ingredients and chocolate molds, you have cute heart-shaped candies to gift him. This sweet gift will surely touch his heart.

mon_an.mo_ta: A dish that is unique in both name and appearance, with a flavor that is beyond reproach. This is fried milk—let's learn how to make it and fall in love from the first bite!
cac_buoc: Step 1:

First, add 450ml of milk, granulated sugar, and the cinnamon stick to a pot. Heat the milk over low heat until small bubbles just begin to appear. Watch closely and do not let the milk come to a full boil to prevent it from overflowing!
Step 2:
Remove the cinnamon stick.
Step 3:
Mix the remaining 50ml of milk with the cornstarch.
Step 4:
Once the milk on the stove is hot, pour the milk and cornstarch mixture into the hot milk, stirring constantly.
Step 5:
The mixture will thicken as shown in the image. At this point, prepare a square tray and pour the mixture in. Use a spoon to spread it evenly so the surface is smooth and flat.
Leave the mixture outside for 1 hour until completely cooled, then refrigerate for 2-4 hours.
Step 6:
Prepare the egg and flour in two separate bowls. Take the tray out of the refrigerator, gently move the milk block onto a cutting board, and cut into squares.
Dredge each milk square through the egg wash and then the flour. If making a large batch and the milk loses its firmness or starts to melt, return it to the fridge for a while before continuing.
Step 7:
In a pan of hot oil, fry the milk squares until they are golden brown on both sides, then remove. Be gentle when picking them up so the milk squares do not break!
Step 8:
After frying, let the milk drain on paper towels before eating.
To make the presentation more appealing, sprinkle a layer of powdered sugar and cinnamon powder on top.
This fried milk dish originates from the Spanish dish Leche Frita!
If you don't like it too sweet, you can adjust the amount of sugar to your preference.

mon_an.mo_ta: Yogurt is very good for health, especially for women, as it beautifies the skin and provides many beneficial bacteria. Now we can transform yogurt into a new, delicious, and nutritious dish. This recipe for yogurt cubes will surely be easy for everyone to follow.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Whipping cream - 100ml (If unavailable, use 350ml fresh milk instead)
cac_buoc: Ingredients to prepare:
Step 1:
Soak the gelatin sheets in cold water.
Step 2:
Pour the condensed milk into a bowl, then add the boiling water to dissolve it.
Next, take the gelatin sheets out of the water and stir them into the mixture until dissolved.
Continue by adding the fresh milk and whipping cream, whisking until well combined.
Finally, add the starter yogurt and gently stir to incorporate. Strain the mixture through a sieve (this helps your yogurt become smoother).
Step 3:
Pour the mixture into individual jars or small glass bowls, then cover with lids.

Arrange the jars on a tray and cover them with a warm, wrung-out towel. Place the tray in an oven (turned off) to incubate for about 7-8 hours to allow the yogurt to ferment. Afterward, place them in the refrigerator to firm up.
Use a knife to cut the set yogurt into squares and place them in a glass. Sprinkle a little matcha powder on top and enjoy!

mon_an.mo_ta: This healthy sugar-free yogurt recipe will help keep you fit, especially for those looking to lose weight. Learn to cook well with this wholesome sugar-free yogurt. This easy-to-make dish will guide you through the process of making healthy sugar-free yogurt.
cac_buoc: The method for making healthy sugar-free yogurt is very simple with just 2 steps:
Step 1: Heat the unsweetened milk over low heat to about 40°C, then turn off the heat; the milk should be lukewarm. Then, add the starter yogurt and stir well until completely dissolved.

Step 2: Cover the pot, wrap it in a thick towel, and place it in a warm spot for about 4 hours until set. If the yogurt hasn't set, leave it for another 2 hours. In winter, sugar-free yogurt takes longer to set; continue keeping it warm for an additional 4 hours. Scoop into small cups and store in the refrigerator.
Now you have the recipe for healthy sugar-free yogurt.

mon_an.mo_ta: Jackfruit yogurt is a favorite snack for many, especially teenagers, because it is delicious, nutritious, and affordable. Eating this on a hot summer day is wonderful, isn't it? Why not make it at home for the whole family to enjoy together? It's a great idea. The ingredients and method are extremely easy; if you like it, you could even open a jackfruit yogurt shop at home! Come on, let's try this jackfruit yogurt recipe!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Peel the pears, dice them into small cubes, and immediately soak them in a bowl of cold water so they don't turn brown.
Next, drain the water completely and toss the pear cubes with tapioca starch until they are thoroughly coated.
Place the pear cubes in a coarse sieve and shake off any excess flour.

Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add the pear cubes and boil until the outer layer becomes translucent and the cubes float to the surface. Remove them and drop them into a bowl of cold water to prevent sticking. You now have "mock pomegranate seeds" for the jackfruit yogurt.
Step 2:
Slice the jackfruit into long thin strips.

Place crushed ice at the bottom of a bowl, then add the mock pomegranate seeds, jackfruit, and yogurt. Finally, drizzle condensed milk on top. You can add colored jelly cubes, coconut milk, and basil seeds if desired.
We have now finished the jackfruit yogurt dish!

mon_an.mo_ta: Cooling down in the summer with cups of black glutinous rice yogurt is wonderful, and the method is very easy too!
cac_buoc: Basic ingredients needed to make black glutinous rice yogurt!

Step 1: Wash the black glutinous rice thoroughly and soak in water for 3 to 4 hours. Then pour both the rice and the soaking water into a pot, adding ½ teaspoon of fine salt. Place the pot on the stove over medium heat. Once it boils for about 5 minutes, reduce the heat to a simmer, stirring occasionally so the rice doesn't stick to the bottom. As the rice expands, add more water so the grains cook thoroughly and evenly. Add a few pandan leaves to the pot for aroma.

Step 2: When the rice is soft and the mixture has thickened, add a few tablespoons of coconut milk. Stir gently to combine, then add sugar according to your taste. Let it boil for another 3 minutes for the sugar to dissolve, then turn off the heat.
Once the sugar is added, do not cook the rice for too long or the grains will become hard again. Open the lid and let the rice mixture cool.
Step 3: Open the yogurt containers and pour into a bowl, whisking until smooth and creamy.
Good luck with this sweet and delicious black glutinous rice yogurt for your family!

mon_an.mo_ta: Today, let's learn how to make delicious black glutinous rice yogurt following this recipe. Black glutinous rice is an extremely nutritious food, providing protein, amino acids, carotene, minerals, and trace elements. It can be prepared into many delicious dishes like sticky rice, rice wine, or fermented rice. Fermented black glutinous rice or black rice pudding served with yogurt has long been a favorite for many. Don't hesitate, let's get started.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Yogurt part (using fresh milk for extra flavor)
cac_buoc: 1. How to make fermented black glutinous rice
Wash the black glutinous rice, add just enough water to cover, and cook until done (or steam in a steamer). Then fluff the rice out and spread it thin so it cools quickly.
While the rice is cooking, crush the wine yeast into a fine powder and divide into two parts. When the rice has cooled but is still slightly warm, mix one part of the yeast into the rice.

Wash the lotus leaves and wipe them completely dry. Layer the rice and the remaining yeast alternately until all ingredients are used, then wrap the lotus leaves tightly. Place in a container and ferment for 2-3 days until ready.
2. How to make the yogurt (click the title for detailed yogurt instructions)
Combine fresh milk and condensed milk in a pot. Heat over low heat, stirring until it reaches a gentle simmer, then turn off the heat.
Stir until the milk cools to a lukewarm temperature (about 40-50°C), then add the starter yogurt. Stir until dissolved and pour into small jars. Cover tightly. Incubate in a warm place for 6-8 hours.
After 6-8 hours, the yogurt has fermented; take it out and store it in the refrigerator.
3. Assembling the black glutinous rice yogurt
When serving, scoop the fermented black glutinous rice (you can mix in a little sugar if desired) into a glass, add yogurt, and add ice if you like. Stir well and enjoy.

The finished product should have thick, smooth, and creamy yogurt with a balanced sweet and sour taste. The black rice grains should be plump and whole, with a deep purple color and a subtle aroma of rice wine without being too pungent or sour.
Tips for making the best black glutinous rice for this dish:
Choosing the rice is the most important step. You should choose new black glutinous rice with even, unbroken grains. Grains that are deep purple, large, and shiny are high quality.
The cooked rice must have the right moisture—not too dry and not too mushy. If it's too dry, the grains will be hard after fermentation; if too mushy, the fermented rice will fall apart.
The yeast used for fermentation must be fresh and of good quality for the best flavor.
Using lotus leaves for fermentation will make the rice more fragrant and appealing. Additionally, you can add pandan leaves while cooking the rice to enhance the aroma.

mon_an.ten: Refreshing Orange Jelly with Gelatin for Kids
mon_an.mo_ta: Learn how to make delicious orange jelly. With this recipe, you will have smooth, eye-catching orange jelly that is especially fragrant with orange juice and essential oils. Orange jelly helps replenish water and vitamin C, cooling and detoxifying the body on hot days.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Soak the gelatin in a small bowl of water for about 20 minutes (adjust the amount of water according to the instructions on the gelatin packaging). While soaking, wash the oranges and squeeze them for juice. Finely chop the peel and pulp. Place the orange peel in a pot with 1 liter of water (based on the ratio of 10g gelatin to 1 liter of water) and bring to a boil to release the orange essential oils.

Step 2: Remove and discard the orange peels. Add sugar and stir well, then pour in the soaked gelatin mixture. Stir constantly over low heat until the gelatin is completely dissolved, then turn off the heat. Pour in the squeezed orange juice from Step 1, stir well, and then pour the orange jelly into molds or directly into glasses.

When serving, you can eat the jelly directly from the glass with a spoon or flip it onto a plate for a beautiful presentation. Each piece of cool, sweet, and soft jelly melting in your mouth is incredibly appealing.
Tips for delicious orange jelly:
Jelly/gelatin powder should be soaked in water to bloom for about 15-20 minutes before cooking.
When cooking, remember to use low heat and stir constantly so the gelatin dissolves completely, ensuring the jelly is smooth and not lumpy.
Orange juice should be added last after turning off the heat and once the jelly mixture has cooled slightly to preserve the vitamins and prevent the jelly from becoming bitter.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Red Bean Jelly Everyone Will Love
mon_an.mo_ta: This fragrant, smooth, and cool red bean jelly will impress anyone who tries it for the first time! In today's article, we will guide you through the process of making red bean jelly. Please take a look!
cac_buoc: Step 1:

First, wash the beans under running water, then place them in a pot with 1.5L of water and boil for 30 minutes. Reduce to low heat and continue to simmer for about 1.5 hours until the beans are very soft.
Step 2:
Once the beans are cooked, use a wooden spoon to mash the cooked beans.
Step 3:
Add about 450ml of water to the mashed beans and strain through a sieve. Use a wooden spoon to rub thoroughly to extract the red bean paste, discarding only the outer skins.
Step 4:
Line the sieve with a piece of cloth and pour the filtered bean mixture back through it.
Step 5:
Let the bean paste sit for 1-2 minutes to drain off excess water.
Step 6:
Now, squeeze the bean paste firmly to remove all remaining water.
Step 7:
Place the squeezed bean paste into a pot along with sugar, salt, and vanilla extract, then cook over medium heat.
Step 8:
Use a wooden spoon to stir the mixture for 3-5 minutes until the sugar is completely dissolved.
Step 9:
Mix the gelatin powder with 60ml of cold water. Then add 120ml of hot water and stir until the gelatin is completely dissolved.
Step 10:
Pour the gelatin into the red bean pot and stir until everything is well combined. Finally, pour the jelly mixture into small trays, let it cool, and place in the refrigerator to set into blocks.
This red bean jelly is soft, sweet, and refreshing—a treat everyone will love.
You can add a few pieces of water chestnut to the jelly for a nice crunchy texture.
Alternatively, cut the jelly into pieces and garnish with chestnuts on top like this.
Otherwise, simply pour the jelly into beautiful molds.

mon_an.mo_ta: Among the cool and nutritious summer treats, coconut jelly is a must-mention. Pandan coconut jelly has a refreshing green color and a gentle fragrance that suits many people's tastes. Do you want to know how to make it? Refer to the coconut jelly recipe below.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Crush the pandan leaves and squeeze out the juice into a bowl.
Step 2: Mix the jelly powder thoroughly with the sugar.
Step 3: Boil ½ of the coconut water, pour in ½ of the sugar and jelly powder mixture, and boil until the powder is fully bloomed.
Step 4: Next, pour the jelly out and let it cool.
Step 5: Mix the pandan leaf juice with the remaining coconut water, bring to a boil, then pour in the rest of the sugar and jelly powder mixture. Turn off the heat as soon as the mixture boils.
Step 6: Pour the freshly cooked pandan jelly layer over the cooled white jelly layer and place in the refrigerator.
Note:
Do not cook the pandan jelly mixture for too long as it will cause the pandan juice to precipitate.
Coconuts can vary in size, but you should aim for a total of 2L of coconut water.

mon_an.ten: Refreshing Coconut Jelly in Shell for Summer
mon_an.mo_ta: With this refreshing coconut jelly, you no longer have to worry about cooling down during the summer. Here is a guide on how to make chilled coconut jelly so you can prepare it yourself for the whole family to enjoy.
cac_buoc: How to make coconut jelly 2
Prepare ingredients:
Peel the green outer skin of the coconuts, then cut off the top and pour the coconut water into a large bowl.
Cooking steps:
Mix 5g-10g of jelly powder with the sugar.
Pour the coconut water into a pot, then add the jelly powder mixture one tablespoon at a time, stirring well to dissolve.
Place the pot on the stove over medium heat, stirring constantly until the mixture begins to simmer gently, then turn off the heat.
Next, pour this jelly liquid into each of the prepared coconut shells, filling them only ¾ of the way.
Set aside about 50ml of the jelly liquid, add 3 tablespoons of coconut milk, and reheat slightly to dissolve the coconut milk.
Once the first layer has slightly cooled and set, pour the coconut milk mixture into each coconut to create a beautiful two-layer jelly.
Arrange the coconuts in the refrigerator and wait for the jelly to set and become cold before serving.
Note:
Choose young coconuts with soft flesh so that after eating the jelly, you can scrape and eat the coconut meat.
Based on this simple recipe, you can change the colors, such as making matcha jelly, to make the dish more attractive.
To make 6 coconuts, you need about 3 liters of liquid; if there isn't enough coconut water, you can add a little boiled water to the jelly mixture while cooking.

mon_an.ten: Delicious Almond Jelly with Mixed Fruit
mon_an.mo_ta: In hot weather, nothing is better than enjoying fresh almond jelly mixed with fruit. Check out this refreshing recipe below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Optional fruits: orange, mango, watermelon, lychee, kiwi, papaya, grapes...
cac_buoc: Let's look at the ingredients for almond jelly with mixed fruit!
Step 1:
Dissolve the agar powder in water and let it soak for about 5 minutes.
The amount of agar powder depends on the brand you buy, so please read the instructions on the packaging carefully!
Step 2:
Add sugar and almond milk to the pot of water and bring to a boil over medium heat.
Step 3:
Pour the cooked jelly mixture into molds and place in the refrigerator to set. Depending on your preference, you can use square or flower-shaped molds.
Step 4:
While waiting, prepare the fruit: peel, remove seeds, and cut into small pieces.
Next, mix the fruit with a little sugar water or lychee juice and chill them as well!
Step 5:
Once the jelly has set, take it out, cut it into small pieces, and mix with the fruit. It's ready to eat!
Remember to drizzle the fruit soaking liquid over it for extra flavor!

mon_an.mo_ta: Fruit jelly is a very popular summer treat, especially for children. Jelly can be modified into many types, resulting in a variety of shapes, colors, and flavors. Today, I would like to introduce a simple yet attractive dish: 3-layer fruit jelly. With two main flavors, peach and lychee, this 3-layer fruit jelly will surely delight you at first sight. Let's find out how to make it below.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Blender, glass or small white plastic cups, two small pots - tools
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare ingredients
Peel the lychees, remove the seeds, and set aside the white flesh.
Peel the peaches, use a knife to remove the flesh, and discard the seeds.
Soak the gelatin sheets in cold water for about 10 minutes to soften, then divide into two parts.
Step 2: Execution
First, place the lychees in a blender and blend until smooth, then pour into the first pot.
Next, place the peaches in the blender with 50ml of water and 10g of sugar; blend until smooth. Set aside a small amount of the blended peach puree in a bowl, and pour the rest into the second pot.
Place both pots on the stove and bring them to a boil.

Once the lychee and peach mixtures boil, turn off the heat, remove the pots, and add one part of the soaked gelatin to each pot. Stir continuously and thoroughly to ensure the gelatin dissolves completely.
Next, prepare the cups on the table. First, pour a layer of peach mixture into the cups, about 1cm deep.
Place the cups in the freezer for about 10 minutes to let the peach layer set.
After the time is up, take the cups out; you now have the peach jelly layer.
Pour the second layer into the cups using the lychee mixture, making it slightly thicker than the peach layer. Similarly, place the cups in the freezer for 10 minutes to set.
After 10 minutes, take the cups out and repeat the process until all the peach and lychee mixtures are used, alternating the white and yellow colors as described.

Finally, once the 3-layer jelly is finished, spoon a little of the reserved blended peach puree on top of each cup, add some shaved ice, and garnish with a few mint leaves for a beautiful look. Now you can enjoy it.
Note:
For the yellow jelly layer, you can substitute with fruits like mango or pineapple, as long as the fruit is sweet with only a hint of tartness.
You can adjust the thickness of the layers to your liking; thinner layers will set faster, so adjust the time accordingly.
When blending lychees, since they are very juicy and sweet, do not add extra water or sugar.
Do not add the gelatin sheets to the fruit pots while they are boiling; only add them after removing the pots from the heat. Otherwise, the setting ability of the gelatin will be reduced.

mon_an.ten: Sweet and Refreshing Fruit Jelly for Hot Summer Days
mon_an.mo_ta: Summer brings many delicious cold treats to quench your thirst, and fruit jelly is one of them. With just a few simple steps, you can have a sweet and cool fruit jelly ready to eat whenever you want.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fruit - white dragon fruit, red dragon fruit, mango (all diced)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Pour 500ml of fresh coconut water and 140g of jelly powder into a pot and let it sit for about 15 minutes (since pre-mixed jelly powder already contains sugar, no extra sugar is needed).
Step 2: Bring to a boil to dissolve the jelly powder in the coconut water, skimming off any foam to keep the jelly clear.
Step 3: Pour a thin layer of jelly into the molds, then arrange the fruit in the center. Continue pouring the remaining jelly until the molds are full.
Step 4: Wait for the jelly to cool and then place it in the refrigerator. It can be enjoyed after about 1 hour (this dish is best served cold).

mon_an.ten: Super Delicious Homemade Coffee Cheese Jelly
mon_an.mo_ta: Cheese jelly, made primarily from flexible jelly powder and cheese, is very good for the whole family's health. This is a dessert that is easy to make, fragrant, sweet, and nutritious, especially containing a lot of calcium which is good for bones. Let's learn how to make this trending coffee cheese jelly! It's food-safe and absolutely delicious!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Mix the gelatin powder, coffee, and agar powder together. Add water according to the ratio on the agar powder package (do not add more, as the package instructions usually prevent the jelly from being too fragile).
Step 2: Unwrap the cheese and arrange it in the jelly molds or ice cube trays.

Step 3: Place the mixture on the stove, stirring constantly. Add sugar to taste, let the mixture boil for about 2-3 minutes, then turn off the heat. When the mixture has cooled slightly, pour it into the molds containing the cheese.
Step 4: Place the jelly in the refrigerator until it sets, then you can take it out to serve!
Cheese jelly is very delicious when eaten with milk, sweet soup, etc. Good luck with this trending coffee cheese jelly recipe!

mon_an.mo_ta: Cheese jelly is a favorite treat for many young people, featuring the smooth texture of cheese, the fragrant scent of jelly, and very attractive colors. Let's learn how to make this delicious dish!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Agar powder or jelly powder - to taste
Molds or ice cube trays - to taste
cac_buoc: Step 1: Mix the syrup with water. If you prefer a sweeter jelly, add more sugar here!
Step 2: Soak the agar powder in the prepared liquid. Pay attention to the instructions on the packaging to get the correct powder-to-water ratio!
If you like a crunchy texture, use agar powder; if you prefer a chewy texture, use jelly powder; or if you like it soft, use gelatin.
Step 3: Arrange the cheese in the jelly molds. You should buy square cheese portions so they can be easily cut and fitted into the molds beautifully.
Step 4: Boil the jelly mixture over low heat, then let it cool for about 5 minutes.
Step 5: Divide the jelly evenly into the molds.
Step 6: You can make other jelly flavors for variety! Since the filling is rich cheese, consider choosing tart jelly flavors or coffee for a great taste.
Step 7: Finally, place the jelly in the refrigerator for about 30 minutes or until it is completely set!

mon_an.ten: Refreshing Red Dragon Fruit Yogurt Jelly for Summer
mon_an.mo_ta: Red dragon fruit yogurt jelly is eye-catching with its beautiful color, perfect for cooling down in the summer.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Flexible jelly powder (Con cá dẻo): 1 pack
cac_buoc: Step 1: Soak the jelly powder in water for about 30 minutes to bloom.
Step 2: Halve the dragon fruit, remove the skin, cut into pieces, and place in a blender. Blend until smooth with a little room-temperature boiled water, then strain through a sieve.
Step 3: Place the pot of jelly water on the stove and bring to a boil. Add sugar to taste, then divide into 2 equal parts. In each part, stir in the dragon fruit and yogurt respectively.

Step 4: Using jelly molds or glass jars, pour alternating layers of red dragon fruit jelly and yogurt jelly. Let the previous layer set on the surface before pouring the next (note that the subsequent layer must be very hot to bond with the previous one).
Step 5: After all layers have been poured into the molds, let them cool and then refrigerate for about 2 hours.
Then take them out and serve.
Good luck with this sweet and attractive red dragon fruit yogurt jelly for sunny days!

mon_an.mo_ta: Matcha yogurt jelly is a delicious and visually appealing dessert. This dish is not only perfect for parties but is also a favorite snack for many.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, soak the gelatine powder in about 20 ml of water for 10 minutes until it absorbs enough water, blooms, and feels soft to the touch.
Step 2:
Pour the remaining 130ml of water into the soaked gelatine, stir well, and place on the stove to bring to a boil.
Next, add the sugar and stir until dissolved; let it boil steadily for about 2 minutes, then turn off the heat and remove the pot from the stove.
Gradually add the matcha powder and stir until dissolved, then add the yogurt and continue to stir well.
Step 3:
Pour the jelly into small glasses or prepared molds and leave in a cool place to cool down and set.
Once the jelly has cooled and set, you should place it in the refrigerator, as this dish is best served chilled.

Note: Do not add the matcha powder while the pot is still on the stove, as the high temperature will cause the matcha to lose its color and aroma. For a better result, you can use a small sieve to strain the matcha powder so it dissolves evenly and the jelly becomes smoother.

mon_an.mo_ta: In this hot weather, nothing beats a refreshing matcha fruit jelly. Hopefully, with these instructions, you will have a cool and nutritious treat to beat the summer heat.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Gelatine powder - 2 small packets, about 14g (If gelatine is unavailable, you can substitute with agar-agar powder)
Jackfruit, longan, mango, watermelon - any fruit of your choice
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Put the matcha powder in a bowl, add one tablespoon of filtered water, and stir until the powder is dissolved.
Step 2:

Place the gelatine in a small bowl, add one tablespoon of filtered water, and stir well. Microwave the bowl for 30 seconds; if you don't have a microwave, you can use a double boiler to melt the gelatine completely.
Step 3:

Add 500 ml of water and sugar to a small pot, place on the stove and heat until very hot (note: do not let it boil). Stir until the sugar dissolves, then add the matcha mixture and the gelatine to the pot. Stir until fully incorporated. If you see any residue, strain it through a sieve once, then remove from the heat.
Step 4:
Pour the jelly mixture from step 3 into a clean glass mold, let it cool, and refrigerate for 7 to 8 hours until the jelly is completely set.
Step 5:
Remove seeds from the jackfruit and tear into bite-sized pieces. Peel and pit the longans. Place them in a bowl and keep chilled in the refrigerator.
Step 6:
Once the jelly has set, take it out and cut into small pieces.
Step 7:
When serving, place the longan, jackfruit, and matcha jelly into a small glass, and top with 1 to 2 scoops of ice cream.
Step 8:
Garnish with a cherry on top if desired. Since the ice cream and fruit are already sweet, you don't need to add sugar syrup. Mix well and enjoy cold.
Enjoy your meal!

mon_an.mo_ta: How to make sweet and refreshing fruit jelly to beat the summer heat; it is a delicious dish that is easy to make and doesn't take much prep time. - Sweet and Refreshing Fruit Jelly Recipe
cac_buoc: Step 1: The first step for Sweet and Refreshing Fruit Jelly: Soak the lotus seeds in water overnight. Peel the pineapple, remove the eyes, and cut into bite-sized pieces. Peel the tangerines and separate into segments, removing the pith.
Step 2: Boil the lotus seeds until tender, remove and let cool, then mix with the fruits and coconut jelly.

Step 3: Use the lotus seed boiling water and a bit more cold water to bring to a boil. Add rock sugar at a 5:3 ratio and cook until the sugar is completely dissolved. Let it cool, then pour over the fruit jelly bowl from step 2. If you want it cold, add shaved ice.
The Sweet and Refreshing Fruit Jelly is now complete.

mon_an.mo_ta: A familiar snack for young people and a great drinking snack for men, with a spicy, chewy, sweet, and sour flavor profile that creates an irresistible taste. Instead of going to a shop, we can enjoy it at home with this guided beef jerky recipe. Let's start learning how to make this dish!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Beef - 600g (you can choose beef shank or tenderloin for better flavor and long meat fibers)
Seasoning - Soy sauce, seasoning powder, MSG, chili powder, pepper, sugar, cooking oil.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Ginger, garlic, lemongrass: clean and mince very finely.
Beef: Slice thinly along the grain of the meat. Note: do not cut against the grain, as the jerky will crumble once finished.

Marinate the meat with: 15g five-spice powder, 2 tbsp lemongrass, 1 tbsp ginger, 1 tbsp garlic, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp seasoning powder, ½ tbsp MSG, ¼ tbsp sugar, ½ tbsp pepper, 1-2 tbsp chili powder (depending on your spice preference), 10ml honey, and ½ tbsp cooking oil. Marinate for 10 hours so the meat thoroughly absorbs the seasonings. Occasionally toss the meat to ensure it is evenly marinated.
Step 2: Making the beef jerky
First, layer the meat in a pot and simmer over very low heat for about 25-30 minutes.

Do not add water while simmering because the beef will release its own juices; adding water will make the drying process take longer. You can adjust the seasoning to taste. Cook until the beef turns from red to brown and the liquid has evaporated.
Next, use a mortar and pestle to pound each piece of beef until softened so it can be shredded by hand.

After that, place the meat in the microwave until it reaches the desired dryness. Alternatively, if you don't have a microwave, put the meat in a large pan and stir constantly over very low heat until dry. Be careful to stir continuously to prevent scorching, and keep the heat very low.
Let the beef jerky cool completely before serving, or store it in a glass jar in the refrigerator for 1-2 months while maintaining its great flavor.
Finished product requirements:
The beef jerky should be well-seasoned, with the aroma of five-spice and other seasonings blending into a characteristic flavor.
The beef should have long, beautiful fibers, not be crumbly, and not be too dry, so you can still taste the sweetness of the meat.
This beef jerky is great as a snack or a drinking snack: When eating, mix the jerky with the juice of ½ a lime and serve with herbs and cilantro to make it much more delicious.
You can also use the beef jerky to prepare various salads and green papaya salads for your daily meals.

mon_an.mo_ta: Beef jerky is a favorite snack for many, featuring flavorful, spicy beef that becomes tender with a squeeze of lime juice. Its sour, spicy, and sweet taste is a delight. With just a little time in the kitchen, you can have this delicious dish ready!
cac_buoc: Preparing the ingredients for beef jerky
Wash the beef thoroughly, pat dry, and slice along the grain into thin, large pieces.
Smash the white part of the lemongrass, then mince finely.
Mince the garlic.
Prepare the necessary seasonings.
Prepare tools: a pot for simmering, a pan.
Steps to make delicious beef jerky

Step 1: First, place the prepared beef into the pot, add the garlic, lemongrass, chili powder, five-spice powder, salt, and sugar, and mix well. Marinate the beef for about 6-8 hours so it thoroughly absorbs the flavors, making it tastier and more aromatic.

Step 2: After marinating, place the pot on the stove, add enough water to just barely cover the meat, turn the heat to medium, and simmer the beef, stirring occasionally. Be careful to stir the meat to avoid scorching or a burnt smell, which would ruin the flavor and aroma.
Step 3: Lower the heat and simmer the beef until the water has completely evaporated, then remove from the heat.
Step 4: Wait for the beef to cool completely, then use a kitchen mallet to pound the meat to soften it. Once softened, shred the beef into small strips as shown in the image!

Step 5: After shredding, put the meat into a pan over low heat and dry-roast it thoroughly until the meat is completely dry. Then, let the beef jerky cool before storing it in an airtight jar to eat gradually. Store in a cool, dry place.
Notes for perfect beef jerky
The finished beef jerky should have a beautiful deep yellow-brown color, be fragrant and well-seasoned, dry, and have a characteristic aroma.
When preparing the marinade, you can adjust the spiciness or sweetness to your liking.
Remember to slice the beef as thinly as possible so it absorbs the seasoning better and the fibers are more delicate.
To preserve the beef jerky well, you can dry-roast it again if you notice any risk of mold.
How to choose good beef:
The meat should be bright red with small, fine fibers, smell like fresh beef, and have light yellow fat.
Dark red meat with deep yellow fat and large fibers is old beef and will be very tough.
Dark red meat with white fat and a slightly fishy, non-beefy smell is buffalo meat.

Tapeworm cysts are easy to spot as they look exactly like grains of rice embedded in the meat fibers; they fall out easily if poked with a knife, unlike small white tendons which are tough and firmly attached.
Warning: Sellers may press real beef fat onto buffalo meat, rub turmeric on white buffalo fat, or rub beef fat on buffalo meat for aroma. Pre-sliced beef is more likely to contain parasites.
How to remove the gamey smell of beef:
To remove the beef smell, simply take a knob of ginger, grill it until cooked, scrape off the burnt skin, crush it, and rub it on the beef. After this, rinse with water, and the smell will be gone.

To tenderize beef, add a little salt when cooking. For tendons, thigh meat, or ribs, to speed up the process without long stewing, add a piece of pineapple, an ice cube, or an aluminum spoon to the pot.
Beef is rich in iron, protein, potassium, and amino acids... effectively supplementing energy for the muscular system and increasing body endurance. Let's learn the secrets of using this meat.
Choosing good beef
First, pay attention to the color. Buy fresh beef; do not choose dark red varieties. Beef fat should be yellow and firm, not soft.
Next, look at the grain. Choose small, soft fibers; do not buy large, stiff fibers.
Finally, press the meat with your fingertip; it should not be sticky. If it smells normal and not unpleasant, it is good.

mon_an.mo_ta: These crispy fried pork rolls are instantly appealing with their perfect thickness, golden color, and enticing aroma. The meat remains tender and fresh, while the cucumber filling provides a refreshing crunch that balances the richness. Treat yourself to these crispy rolls with a cold glass of Coca-Cola to melt away all your fatigue!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, pepper, soy sauce, sweet and sour chili sauce - for seasoning
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients.
First, mix a few teaspoons of cornstarch with a little water and set aside.
Using a very sharp, wide-bladed knife, carefully slice the meat into thin, wide sheets.
Use a meat mallet to tenderize the pork on both sides. If you don't have a mallet, use the back of a knife to pound the meat, which helps it absorb the seasoning better.
Place the meat in a bowl and mix with a little salt, soy sauce, pepper, and rice wine. Marinate for 5-10 minutes to allow the flavors to penetrate.
Wash the cucumber, soak it in salted water, then peel and cut into sticks that are moderately thick and as long as the width of the meat slices.
Step 2: Cooking the pork rolls.
Lay a slice of meat on a flat surface and place a piece of cucumber on top. Brush a little cornstarch slurry onto the edge of the meat to act as a glue, then roll the meat up tightly.
Beat the eggs in a bowl with a pinch of MSG (optional) and pepper until well combined.
Dredge each pork roll in cornstarch until fully coated, then dip into the beaten egg.
Finally, coat the roll in breadcrumbs, ensuring it is completely and evenly covered.

Heat a generous amount of oil in a pan. Once the oil is hot, carefully drop the rolls in and fry until golden brown. Remove and drain on paper towels to remove excess oil. Remember to turn the rolls frequently while frying so they cook evenly and achieve a beautiful color.
Arrange the rolls on a plate and serve with chili sauce or sweet and sour sauce.
Tips for delicious fried pork rolls:
Besides chili sauce or sweet and sour sauce, these are also delicious with mayonnaise.
You can use half a toothpick to secure the rolls so they don't unravel during frying, but remember to remove the toothpicks before serving.
Instead of cucumber, you can use carrots or onions for a different flavor!

These crispy fried pork rolls are instantly appealing with their perfect thickness, golden color, and enticing aroma. The meat remains tender and fresh, while the cucumber filling provides a refreshing crunch that balances the richness. Treat yourself to these crispy rolls with a cold glass of Coca-Cola to melt away all your fatigue!

mon_an.mo_ta: With just a few simple steps, you can make chewy, fragrant pork jerky that tastes just as good as beef jerky but at one-third of the cost. This pork jerky is perfect as a snack or for entertaining guests, being both delicious and economical. The process is similar to making beef jerky, but achieving that signature chewy texture requires a few specific tips. Follow this recipe exactly, and your pork jerky will turn out perfectly. Let's get started!
cac_buoc: With 1 kg of pork ham, you can produce about 650g of fragrant pork jerky that is 90% similar to beef jerky in flavor.
Step 1: The best cut for this dish is pork ham. Wash it thoroughly, pat dry, and slice along the grain into pieces as shown.

Step 2: Place the meat in a pot, add enough water to just cover it, and boil until just cooked through. Remove immediately (do not overcook or the meat will lose its sweetness). Keep the broth for later use.
Step 3: Once the meat has cooled slightly, shred it into pieces about the size of a chopstick. Do not shred too finely, or the meat will break apart in the following steps.

Step 4: Prepare the aromatics: peel and smash the lemongrass, then mince finely. Peel and mince the garlic. To make the jerky flavorful, the marinade is key; it must be balanced—too much will cause the meat to burn or taste too strong, while too little will leave it bland. Mix the minced lemongrass, five-spice powder, annatto powder, turmeric, sugar, MSG, a bit of good fish sauce, pepper, oyster sauce, chili powder (or chili sauce), minced garlic, and 1 tbsp of oil (the oil adds a nice sheen). Mix thoroughly; the mixture should be slightly under-salted as the flavor will concentrate once dried.
After mixing, you will have a paste like this.
Pour the mixture over the shredded meat and mix well by hand.
Ensure the meat is evenly coated as shown.

Step 5: Pour the seasoned meat back into the pot with the reserved broth (the water should just reach the level of the meat). Place on the stove over high heat. Keep the lid off so the water evaporates as quickly as possible. Avoid low heat or covering the pot, as this makes the meat mushy or prone to burning. If you have a piece of beef fat, add it now to make the final product taste 90% like real beef jerky.

Step 6: Cook until the liquid reduces and the meat becomes sticky (not completely dry). Transfer to a bowl and let it cool to allow more moisture to escape. Divide the meat into 3 plates and microwave for about 3 minutes to speed up the drying process. Next, use a high-quality non-stick pan to stir-fry the meat on the stove. (Note: Use very low heat because the meat is already dry; high heat will burn the fibers and drying it too fast ruins the texture).

You can skip the microwave step as it only saves time. If possible, use the "two-fire" method: stir-fry over low heat until the meat feels slightly firm, spread it out on a plate to let moisture escape, then stir-fry a second time for the best results. Continue until the meat is dry, fragrant, and seasoned to your liking. This double-frying step makes the dish much better.

The finished pork jerky has the exact flavor of beef jerky—chewy, sweet, and fragrant like upland smoked meat. Note: Once finished, there will be many bits of dried lemongrass; sift them out using a coarse strainer so only the meat remains. Store in a plastic bag or airtight jar in the refrigerator. It is best enjoyed within the first week but can be stored for several months. However, if kept too long, it may become dry and brittle rather than shreddable.

mon_an.mo_ta: The flavor of shrimp blends perfectly with the aroma of sweet potato. These bite-sized rolls are incredibly crispy—you won't be able to stop at just one!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning: bouillon powder, pepper, cooking oil, sea salt
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel the shrimp and remove the heads, leaving the tails intact. Mince the shallot and garlic, then marinate the shrimp with 1/2 tsp bouillon powder and 1/2 tsp pepper.
Step 2: Wash the scallions, perilla leaves, and carrot. Cut the scallions into segments and julienne the carrot.

Step 3: Peel the sweet potato and slice it very thinly. Soak the slices in water with a bit of salt for about 20 minutes until they are very soft. The potato is ready when you can roll it without it breaking.

Step 4: Place the crispy frying flour on a plate. Dredge a slice of sweet potato in the flour, lay it flat, place a perilla leaf on top, then add a shrimp, a piece of scallion, and some carrot. Roll it up tightly.
Secure the roll with a toothpick to prevent it from opening, then dredge the whole roll in the flour once more.
Step 5: Repeat the process until all ingredients are used.
Step 6: Heat oil in a pan. When the oil is very hot, drop the sweet potato wrapped shrimp in and deep-fry until golden. Remove and place on a plate lined with paper towels.
Step 7: Arrange the rolls on a plate and enjoy while they are still hot.
These crispy rolls are wonderful when dipped in spicy chili sauce.
Enjoy your cooking with this crispy sweet potato wrapped shrimp recipe!

mon_an.ten: Balut with Sweet and Sour Tamarind Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: This tamarind-sauteed balut is incredibly delicious and enticing from the very first bite. The tangy flavor of the tamarind makes this dish addictive and never boring! Check out this recipe for a savory, sweet, and sour treat. Discover the recipe and show off your cooking skills with this irresistible dish.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Place the balut in a pot with 1/3 tsp salt. Cover with water and boil for about 20 minutes until cooked.
Step 2: Briefly soak the eggs in cold water. Peel them carefully to keep the eggs intact. Pour the liquid from inside the eggs into a separate bowl and set the eggs aside.
Step 3: Clean the Vietnamese coriander; finely chop half and leave the other half whole. Smash, peel, and mince the garlic. Deseed and mince the red chili.
Step 4: Soak the ripe tamarind in 100 ml boiling water. Mash it well and strain to collect the juice.
Step 5: Heat a pan and sauté the garlic until fragrant.
Add the tamarind juice, the reserved egg liquid, salt, sugar, fish sauce, and pepper. Bring the mixture to a boil, adjust the seasoning to your taste, then set aside.
Step 6: Place the peeled eggs into a pot and pour the tamarind sauce over them. Simmer over low heat until the sauce thickens and coats the eggs evenly.
Step 7: Add the minced chili and chopped coriander to the pot. Adjust the seasoning one last time and turn off the heat.
Serve the tamarind-glazed balut on a plate while hot. It should have a balanced sweet, sour, and savory flavor.
The richness of the egg combined with the tangy tamarind and the aroma of the coriander creates a perfectly harmonious dish.
Tips for making tamarind-sauteed balut:
1. Choosing fresh balut:
Choose eggs with a bit of dust/chaff on the shell. Fresh eggs feel heavier in the hand.
To check freshness, hold the egg up to a light source. If there is no air space at the top and the inside looks full, the egg is fresh.
Avoid eggs with moldy shells, those that feel light, or those that make a sloshing sound when shaken.
2. Choosing peanuts (if serving with):
Choose large, uniform, and firm peanuts.
The skin should be a light, bright color.
Avoid rotten, shriveled, or strange-smelling peanuts.
Following these tips ensures the quality and freshness of your ingredients.
3. How to boil balut:
Start with high heat for the first 5 minutes. Then, reduce to medium heat and cook for another 15 minutes.
Avoid overboiling, as it dries out the internal juices and makes the egg tough.
Add 1 tsp of salt to the water to prevent the shells from cracking.
To peel easily, place the cooked eggs in an ice bath for 3 to 5 minutes.
Following these steps ensures perfectly cooked eggs that are easy to peel.
Note on eating quail balut:
Quail balut is nutrient-dense; however, do not overconsume as it can lead to digestive, cardiovascular, or diabetic issues. Follow these age-appropriate guidelines:
Infants under 5 months: Should not eat quail balut.
Children 5-12 months: 1-2 quail eggs per day.
Children 1-3 years: 3-4 quail eggs per day.
Adults: 5-10 quail eggs per day.
Pregnant women: Follow a doctor's advice, generally no more than 4 eggs per week.

mon_an.mo_ta: With this sweet and spicy pickled mango recipe, you'll be craving more with every bite. It's so addictive you won't be able to stop!
cac_buoc: Ingredients you need to prepare:
Step 1: Peel the mangoes, wash them, and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Step 2: Soak the mango in a bowl of diluted salt water (use cooled boiled water). Soak for 10-15 minutes, then rinse with clean water and drain well.
Step 3: Dissolve the sugar, salt, fish sauce, and chili flakes together to create a sweet, salty, and spicy sauce tailored to your taste.
Step 4: Place the mango in a large bowl, pour the spicy sauce over it, and toss well. Let it marinate for about 10 minutes before serving.
By following these steps, you will have a delicious plate of sweet, sour, and crunchy pickled mango. You can adjust the salt and spice levels to your preference.

The finished mango is crunchy and perfectly seasoned. Fresh mango with a light sweet and sour kick is very appealing. The juice released from the mango has a signature aroma; even after storing in the fridge, it won't develop a film or ferment!

mon_an.ten: Simple and Delicious Xôi Mít with Coconut Milk
mon_an.mo_ta: Golden, chewy, and sweet jackfruit segments combined with fragrant sticky rice and creamy coconut milk will make you and your family fall in love with this dish. Let's learn how to make this delicious and easy Xôi Mít!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Ripe firm jackfruit - 10 segments (you can use more as desired)
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Use a knife to cut a slit along the length of the jackfruit segment and remove the seed.
Step 2:
Crack the coconut to get the water for cooking the rice, and grate the coconut meat into small shreds.
Step 3:
Wash the rice and place it in a rice cooker. Pour in the coconut water until it is level with the rice, then add a pinch of salt for flavor.
When the rice cooker switches to Warm mode, add the shredded coconut and press the Cook button once more.
Step 4:
Once the sticky rice is cooked, use a small spoon to press the rice into each jackfruit segment (as shown), being careful not to damage the fruit.
Step 5:
Serve the Xôi Mít on a plate, sprinkle with more shredded coconut, drizzle with coconut milk, and enjoy this wonderful dish immediately.
It's so easy, isn't it?
Good luck and enjoy your meal!

This guide to cooking delicious, odor-free Bún Măng Vịt will bring a fresh culinary experience. The unique combination of duck meat and bamboo shoots creates an attractive dish that stimulates the palate. Get your ingredients ready and step into the kitchen to learn how to cook this Bún Măng Vịt right now!
I. Instructions for traditional Bún Măng Vịt
1. Prepare ingredients
1/2 Duck (about 700g)
250g Fresh bamboo shoots
500g Straw mushrooms
100g Duck blood curd
1kg Fresh rice vermicelli
100ml White rice wine
2 Ginger branches
4 Shallots (finely minced)
1 Garlic bulb (finely minced)
2 Green onion stalks
10g Cilantro
10g Vietnamese coriander
2 Chilies
Water spinach, Thai basil for serving
Cooking oil
Sugar, pepper, seasoning powder, MSG, and a pinch of salt.
2. Processing Bún Măng Vịt
2.1. Prepare the duck
Wash the duck thoroughly with water.
Rub salt all over the inside and outside of the duck.
Use smashed ginger and white rice wine to rub the duck thoroughly, then rinse again.
Next, chop the duck into bite-sized pieces and drain.
Tips to remove duck odor:
Method 1: Use salt, white rice wine, and smashed ginger to rub the duck, then rinse clean.
Method 2: Rub salt over the duck, then rub with lemon and rinse with water.
2.2. Marinate the duck
Prepare 1 ginger branch and julienne it.
Mix the duck meat with julienned ginger, 1/2 of the minced garlic, minced shallots, 1 tbsp fish sauce, 1/2 tbsp sugar, 1/2 tsp MSG, and 1 tsp pepper.
Marinate for 15 – 30 minutes to let the duck absorb the seasonings.
2.3. Prepare the bamboo shoots
Wash the fresh bamboo shoots, then boil them in water with a little salt. After about 30 minutes, remove the bamboo shoots, rinse with cool water, and cut into small pieces.
How to prepare bamboo shoots to remove bitterness and toxins:
Boil multiple times: Remove the tough outer layers, boil several times in water (2-3 times, 15 minutes each).
Soak in rice water: After boiling several times, soak the bamboo shoots in rice water, changing the water twice a day until the odor is gone.
Boil with katuk leaves: Peel the bamboo shoots, slice thinly, and boil. Boil with katuk leaves, then drain all the water and rinse with cold water before cooking.
2.4. Prepare other ingredients
Straw mushrooms: Trim the dirty ends of the stems, soak in diluted saltwater for 10 minutes, then rinse with clean water. Cut into bite-sized pieces.
Duck blood curd: Bring water to a boil, add the blood curd to cook. Then, remove and slice into bite-sized pieces.
Rice vermicelli: Bring water to a boil, blanch the noodles for about 1 minute, then drain in a colander.
Green onions and Vietnamese coriander: Trim the roots and wash clean.
Side vegetables: Clean and wash with diluted saltwater.
2.5. Stir-fry the bamboo shoots
Heat oil in a pan, wait until hot, and sauté the minced shallots until fragrant.
Add the bamboo shoots and stir-fry. When they start to soften, season with 1 tsp seasoning powder, 1 tsp sugar, 1/2 tsp salt, and stir-fry for another 2 minutes to absorb the flavors.
2.6. Stir-fry the duck
In a pot, heat 2 tbsp cooking oil. Then, add the duck meat and stir until the meat firms up.
Small tip: Stir-frying the duck helps render the fat, firms the meat, and helps it absorb seasonings better.
2.7. Cook the broth
Add 2 liters of water to the pot with the duck, and stir well.
Turn to high heat to bring to a boil, then lower the heat to a simmer for about 30 minutes until the duck is tender.
Once the meat is cooked, add the straw mushrooms, blood curd, and bamboo shoots to the pot and bring to a boil again. Adjust the seasoning to taste and turn off the heat.
2.8. Prepare the dipping sauce
Mince the remaining garlic, chili, 1 tbsp sugar, and the remaining ginger in a mortar and grind finely.
Transfer the mixture to a bowl, add 1 tbsp fish sauce and 1 tsp lime juice, and stir well.
2.9. Finished dish

Place the vermicelli in a bowl, arrange the duck meat on top, and ladle the broth along with the blood curd and bamboo shoots. Add green onions, cilantro, and sliced chili on top. Serve the Bún Măng Vịt with fresh vegetables and ginger fish sauce.
II. Instructions for cooking Bún Măng Vịt with dried bamboo shoots
1 duck (2kg)
50g dried bamboo shoots
150g ginger
50g whole shallots
1 tbsp minced shallots
3 tbsp fried shallots
200g daikon radish
1 bird's eye chili
Salt
2. Processing
2.1. How to prepare bamboo shoots to avoid bitterness and toxins
Soak dried bamboo shoots in rice water overnight, then rinse 2-3 times.
Boil the bamboo shoots in a pot of boiling water for 10 minutes. After boiling, remove and soak in cold water to cool, then drain.

Heat a pan, add 1 tbsp cooking oil. When the oil is hot, sauté the minced shallots until fragrant. Next, add the bamboo shoots to the pan, season with ½ tsp salt, ½ tsp MSG, stir well to absorb the seasonings, then turn off the heat.
2.2. Prepare other ingredients
Wash the whole shallots, grill until fragrant, remove charred parts, and rinse again.
Divide the ginger into 3 parts: one part grilled and cleaned of char, one part smashed, and the remaining part blended finely, squeezed for the pulp (discard the juice).
Peel the daikon, wash, and cut into sections. Finely mince the bird's eye chili. Wash and drain the side vegetables. Wash, drain, and finely chop the garnish herbs.
2.3. Prepare the duck
Place smashed ginger, 30g salt, and 2 tbsp white rice wine in a basin. Rub this mixture inside and outside the duck. Rinse the duck with water 2-3 times.
2.4. Cook the Bún Măng Vịt broth
Boil 5 liters of cold water in a pot, then add the duck, grilled ginger, grilled shallots, and daikon; simmer for 30 minutes.

Add 30g salt, 60g sugar, and 30g seasoning powder to the pot, stirring to dissolve. Check if the meat is cooked by piercing the thickest part of the duck with a chopstick; if no red juice runs out, it is cooked. Once cooked, soak the duck in a basin of cold water to cool, then remove, drain, and chop into bite-sized pieces.
2.5. Prepare the broth
Strain the broth through a sieve to remove the cooked vegetables. Simmer the fried shallots with 50g fish sauce and 20g MSG in the pot, bring to a boil, then turn off the heat.
Place fresh vermicelli in a bowl, arrange the duck meat on top, pour in the broth, sprinkle with herbs, and add some fried shallots. Enjoy with fresh vegetables and ginger fish sauce.
III. Notes when cooking Bún Măng Vịt
The boiling time for bamboo shoots is 10 minutes from the point the water boils for shredded shoots. For larger pieces, boil for 15 minutes.
When cooking the broth, skim the foam frequently to keep the broth clear. You can also add pork bones and chicken feet to the broth for extra flavor.
Ginger is indispensable in Bún Măng Vịt. It not only removes the duck's gamey smell but also balances the yin and yang of the dish.
To remove bitterness, you can boil the bamboo shoots twice. Use the ginger pulp to make the dipping sauce to avoid bitterness and keep the sauce clear.

Besides dried bamboo shoots, you can use fresh bamboo shoots for Bún Măng Vịt. Before use, remove the tough parts, slice thinly, soak in water for 1–2 hours, and boil 2–3 times. After each boil, remove and soak in cold water.
IV. How to choose fresh ingredients
1. How to choose good duck meat

Good duck meat has smooth skin and no strange odor. When pressed, it should feel smooth and soft; avoid flabby meat as it may have been injected with water. A good live duck should have wings pressed close to its body, bright eyes, and smooth feathers.
A good duck is usually plump with a round breast and tail, and thick neck and belly skin. Avoid ducks that are too young or too old; male ducks often have a richer flavor than females.
2. How to choose good dried bamboo shoots
Quality dried bamboo shoots are usually pale yellow or amber, glossy, and have a characteristic bamboo aroma. The surface should be wide and thick, not damp to the touch, and can be snapped.
Choose pieces of uniform size with short segments and no fibers; the tips are usually better than the base.

mon_an.mo_ta: Blood cockle congee has a pleasant color and delicious flavor. The congee is cooked with a rich aroma, combined with chewy blood cockles and fresh herbs, creating a heartwarming meal for cold winter days. Let's explore how to cook this blood cockle congee! Enjoy this delicious, visually pleasing, and flavorful dish. This guide will show you how to cook blood cockle congee to cope with the winter chill.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings - Cooking oil, premium fish sauce, MSG, pepper
cac_buoc: Nutritious Blood Cockle Congee Recipe
Step 1: Prepare ingredients
After buying the blood cockles, soak them in rice water or diluted saltwater with chili for about 1 hour to clean out sand, mud, and dirt.
Next, use a brush to scrub the outer shells clean, then rinse with clean water and drain.
Step 2: Marinate and stir-fry the meat
To marinate and stir-fry the meat, mix the minced pork with 1/2 tsp pepper, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tsp salt, and 1 tbsp minced shallots. Mix well so the meat absorbs the seasonings.

Place a pan on the stove, add cooking oil and 1 tbsp minced shallots. Sauté until fragrant, then add the marinated pork and stir-fry until cooked. Once the meat is cooked, add chopped green onions and turn off the heat.
Step 3: Toast the rice and cook the congee
To toast the rice, wash it clean and let it drain.
Then, place the rice in a pot and toast until it is evenly golden. Next, pour 1.5 liters of water into the pot and cook until the congee is soft.
To cook the cockles, prepare another pot and bring water to a boil. Add the cockles and boil for 5 minutes. As soon as the cockles open, turn off the heat immediately.
Then, remove the cockles to drain and separate the meat from the shells. Avoid boiling too long to prevent the cockle meat from shrinking.
Heat a pan and sauté the shallots until golden. Next, add the blood cockle meat to the pan and briefly stir-fry. Add salt, pepper, and MSG to taste.
Then, pour the liquid from the cockles into the congee pot, add 1/2 of the stir-fried cockle meat, and stir well. Season again with 1 tsp fish sauce and 1 tsp salt to taste.
Turn off the heat and garnish the top of the congee with the remaining stir-fried cockle meat. Add green onions and pepper, then enjoy.
Notes for cooking nutritious blood cockle congee
Choose fresh cockles: Ensure you select fresh, odor-free blood cockles to guarantee quality and high nutritional value.

Combine with blood-tonifying ingredients: Besides blood cockles, you can add blood-tonifying ingredients to the congee such as mustard greens, spinach, beetroot, black beans, or herbs like Polyscias fruticosa root, angelica root, and epimedium. This helps increase iron content and other important nutrients.
Combine with spices that increase iron absorption: Use spices like pepper, garlic, onions, or fish sauce to enhance the body's ability to absorb iron.
Do not cook too long: Ensure the congee is cooked for a short time to preserve the nutritional value of the blood cockles and other ingredients.

Combine with foods rich in vitamin C: Vitamin C helps improve iron absorption, so you can pair blood cockle congee with fruits like oranges, tangerines, kiwi, or add a little lemon juice to enhance iron absorption.
Ensure a balanced diet: Besides eating blood cockle congee, ensure you provide enough of other food groups, including green vegetables, other iron-rich foods, and quality protein sources.
How to choose good blood cockles
To choose good blood cockles, keep the following in mind:
Good blood cockles are medium-sized, not too large and not too small. Small ones easily shrink and toughen when cooked, while very large ones can be chewy.
To ensure the cockles are fresh, look for baskets where many cockles are sticking their tongues out. This indicates they are still alive and fresh.
If you are unsure whether they are alive or dead, you can tell by the smell. If the cockles have a foul odor, absolutely do not buy them, as this indicates they are no longer fresh.

mon_an.ten: Delicious Chicken Heart and Mustard Green Congee
mon_an.mo_ta: Chicken heart and mustard green congee is a delicious, nutritious dish with tender-crisp chicken hearts and sweet, fragrant congee from chicken stock. This dish harmoniously combines ingredients to create an attractive and unique flavor. It is an excellent choice for chilly days or when you want a change of pace. To make this delicious dish, refer to the instructional steps in the article below! Guide to cooking delicious chicken heart and mustard green congee. A nutrient-rich dish with crisp chicken hearts, fragrant chicken stock congee, and sweet, tender mustard greens. Suitable for chilly days and changing the palate.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Cooking oil; premium fish sauce; MSG; pepper; chili powder (optional) - seasonings
cac_buoc: Step 1: Cook the rice
Choose clean jasmine and glutinous rice to remove any grit. Wash the rice and soak in warm water for about 20 minutes to soften and expand.

Then, drain the rice into a pot and add a sufficient amount of water. Bring to a boil and reduce to low heat. When the rice starts to expand, stir well to prevent burning at the bottom of the pot. Cover and simmer slowly, occasionally opening the lid to stir and prevent boiling over.
Step 2: Prepare the chicken hearts
Peel the shallots, wash, and mince. Wash the green onions and cilantro and chop finely.
Wash the chicken hearts with diluted saltwater, then cut in half and finely chop. Remove the tough arteries and marinate with a little fish sauce for about 20 minutes.
Heat cooking oil in a pan, add the shallots, and sauté until fragrant. Next, add the chicken hearts to the pan and stir-fry until cooked.
Step 3: Finish and enjoy
During the simmering process, if the water dries up, you can add boiling water to prevent the congee from becoming too dry.

When the congee is soft, add the stir-fried chicken hearts and stir well. If the congee is still bland, add a little fish sauce and stir. Simmer for a few more minutes, then add the green onions and cilantro and stir well. Turn off the heat.

Ladle the congee into a bowl and feed it to the baby while still warm. The baby will surely love this! The process of cooking chicken heart congee for the baby is complete. This is a delicious and attractive congee that babies will enjoy. Regularly change the baby's palate with this dish.
Notes when cooking chicken heart and mustard green congee
Choose fresh ingredients: Ensure the chicken hearts and mustard greens are purchased from a reliable and fresh source. Check for freshness and quality before cooking.
Food safety and hygiene: Before handling ingredients and preparing food, wash your hands thoroughly and use clean cooking utensils. Ensure food safety to avoid the risk of bacterial infection.

Prepare ingredients correctly: Follow the ingredient preparation steps as guided, including cleaning, chopping, and marinating if necessary. Ensure components are prepared to the correct size and are suitable for the dish.
Control cooking time: Monitor the cooking time for the congee and chicken hearts to ensure the quality of the dish. Avoid overcooking, which loses the crispness of the chicken hearts and greens.

Ensure deliciousness and tenderness: Chicken heart and mustard green congee is best when the hearts are crisp yet tender and the congee is sweet and fragrant. Check the taste and tenderness of the hearts and greens before turning off the heat.
Customize to taste: You can adjust the flavor by adding seasonings such as salt, pepper, fish sauce, or your favorite spices. Taste and adjust according to personal preference.

mon_an.mo_ta: Chè bưởi is a favorite for many because it is easy to eat and has a refreshing sweet taste. Shops selling Chè bưởi are always crowded with diners. Eating out often brings concerns about food safety and hygiene, so why not start making this delicious sweet soup at home? To help you make a delicious Chè bưởi, follow the steps in this article!
cac_buoc: Prepare ingredients:
Peel the pomelo and take the pith for processing.
Cut the pomelo pith into small pieces and soak in saltwater for 1 to 1.5 hours so the pith no longer has a bitter taste.
Next, remove the pith to a colander and dry in the sun for 2 to 3 hours until it dries out; this helps the pith maintain a certain crispness when cooked.
How to make Chè bưởi:
Step 1:
Place the pomelo pith in a pot to cook, adding a little salt and sugar to make the pith more fragrant. When you see the pith turn translucent, you have finished the pith preparation stage.
Step 2:
Place the peeled mung beans in a pot and cook until soft.
Step 3:
Mix diluted tapioca starch into the mung bean pot, stir constantly until the sweet soup returns to a boil, then add sugar and the prepared pomelo pith. Mix well and turn off the heat.
Notes:

You must soak the pomelo pith in saltwater; if not, you can also soak it in limewater to completely remove the bitterness. After soaking, squeeze it very thoroughly and dry it. Cook it with sugar and water, or you can coat it in tapioca starch or arrowroot powder to ensure the pomelo pith is exactly like those at the sweet soup shops.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Delicious Chè Bưởi
mon_an.mo_ta: Chè Bưởi is a familiar dessert featuring sweet, smooth mung beans and crunchy, chewy pomelo pith. Combined with a thick sweet soup and rich coconut milk, it creates an irresistible treat. Let's get into the kitchen to learn the secret to this wonderful dessert!
cac_buoc: First, soak the mung beans in water for 1 hour until expanded, then drain in a colander.
Peel the pomelo, removing the green skin and keeping the white pith. Do not peel too close to the green skin to avoid bitterness. Dice the white pith into 1.5cm cubes or bite-sized pieces.

Next, mix the salt with the diced pith. Massage gently to avoid crushing the pith or making it too salty. Massage thoroughly for a few minutes, then place in a colander, rinse under cold water to remove the salt, and squeeze dry.

Repeat the process about 2 more times to reduce the bitterness. Taste the pith; it is ready when the bitterness and pungency are gone. If still bitter, blanch the pith briefly in water and squeeze thoroughly. Then, marinate the pith with a little sugar for 1 hour until it becomes translucent and sweet.
After that, toss the marinated pith in a large bowl with tapioca starch. This coating makes the pith crunchy and chewy and prevents it from falling apart when cooking.

Once the pith is coated, bring water to a boil and drop the pith in. When they float to the surface, stir gently. Once the pith turns translucent white, remove and drop into a bowl of cold water (ice water is better for a crunchier texture).
