The color should be bright and glossy, turning yellow or bright pink with a hint of green. Avoid oranges that are more than half green, as they were picked too early. Also, choose fruits that feel heavy for their size, as they contain more juice.
To enhance the flavor of the tofu pudding, you can add pearls and dried coconut for extra aroma.

Orange and tofu pudding soup is not only a delicious dessert to beat the summer heat but also an effective folk remedy for common summer ailments like fever, flu, and heatstroke. Eating a bowl of this soup makes you feel healthier and improves your mood. Just smelling the bowl brings a cool orange scent, and each sweet and sour orange segment blends with the silky tofu pudding that gently melts in your mouth. For families with young children who are very active, this soup is a great way to cool down and supplement vitamins and minerals. With just a little time in the kitchen and familiar, easy-to-find ingredients, you can make a bowl of orange and tofu pudding soup as good as any shop for your whole family to enjoy, and you'll surely receive many compliments!

mon_an.mo_ta: These candy cane cookies with eye-catching colors, cute shapes, familiar ingredients, and a simple method will make you want to jump into the kitchen right away. With just a little time, you'll have delicious, crunchy cookies filled with Christmas spirit, giving you a warm feeling of a peaceful holiday season.
cac_buoc: HOW TO MAKE CANDY CANE COOKIES

Step 1: First, place the butter and salt in a bowl and beat with a mixer. Then, add the sugar and continue beating until the butter turns pale cream and the sugar is dissolved. Add the peppermint and vanilla extracts and beat well.
Step 2: Next, add the egg yolk and beat until combined. Add the flour and mix with a spatula until the ingredients are well incorporated and no dry flour or lumps remain.
Step 3: Divide the dough into 2 equal parts. Leave one part plain and add red food coloring to the other, kneading by hand until the color is even.

Step 4: Place the two dough portions into plastic bags, flatten them, and roll them out to the same size and thickness. Once rolled, place both pieces in the refrigerator for 30 minutes to firm up slightly.

Step 5: Once the dough has firmed up, take them out, cut each in half, and stack them. Roll lightly so they stick together, then cut into strips about two finger-joints long. Twist the strips and roll them out, then bend one end to create the candy cane shape. Repeat with the remaining dough.
Step 6: Preheat the oven to 160°C. Place the cookies on a baking tray lined with parchment paper and put them in the preheated oven.
Bake for 15-18 minutes until done. Remove and place on a wire rack to cool before enjoying.
Notes for delicious candy cane cookies
Besides candy canes, you can create shapes like Christmas trees, bears, Santa Claus, reindeer, or any Christmas shape you like.
Adjust the amount of sugar to suit your taste!
To ensure smooth cookies, remember to mix the dough steadily to achieve a soft, smooth, and fine consistency!
If you don't want to use food coloring, you can use beetroot juice for the red color!
If not eating immediately, store the cookies in an airtight jar to keep them crunchy and delicious!

These candy cane cookies with eye-catching colors, cute shapes, familiar ingredients, and a simple method will make you want to jump into the kitchen right away. With just a little time, you'll have delicious, crunchy cookies filled with Christmas spirit, giving you a warm feeling of a peaceful holiday season. Children will be very excited with these cute candy cane shapes. You will also receive many compliments for your skill, and someone might even ask you to share the secret to these wonderful cookies.

mon_an.ten: Secret to Making Three-Layer Pumpkin Jelly
mon_an.mo_ta: With a first layer of cookie crumbs, a second layer of pumpkin jelly, and a final layer of coconut jelly, you will enjoy the full sweetness and freshness of this pumpkin jelly treat!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Coconut jelly layer - 1 packet gelatin powder, 180 ml coconut milk, 60 ml water, 50 g granulated sugar
Pumpkin jelly layer - 300 ml water (divided), 1 packet gelatin powder, 1/3 cup canned pumpkin puree, 50 g granulated sugar, 120 ml spiced rum, 120 ml heavy cream
Crust layer - 2 graham crackers, 1 tbsp butter
cac_buoc: Step 1: We will start by preparing the ingredients for this delicious three-layer pumpkin jelly!
First, place the graham crackers in a bowl or tray and crush them until very fine.
Next, melt the butter. You can put the butter in a small pot directly on the stove or place it in a small bowl and steam it over boiling water for 1-2 minutes until melted!
Prepare about 10 small white glasses on a tray. Using white glasses allows you to see the three layers and makes the dish look more attractive and appetizing!
Step 2: After preparing the ingredients, we will proceed with the steps to make this beautiful jelly:
First, we will make the coconut jelly layer as this is the bottom layer and it's delicious!
Take a small pot, pour in the coconut milk, then add the gelatin powder and stir well. Don't heat it immediately; let the gelatin bloom for about 1 to 2 minutes first!

After the resting period, place the pot on the stove over low heat. Do not use high heat as it burns easily. Use a spoon to stir constantly for about 5-8 minutes or until the gelatin is completely dissolved!
Next, add the granulated sugar and stir until dissolved. Once the sugar is gone, you can turn off the heat!
Now, use the glasses you prepared. Pour the coconut jelly into each glass and place the tray in the refrigerator. That's the first layer done!
Next, we move to the pumpkin jelly, which is the second layer. Prepare a bowl of water in a pot, add the gelatin powder, and let it bloom for 1-2 minutes before heating, just like the previous step!
Place the pot on the stove over medium heat. During heating, slowly add the pumpkin puree and stir until the mixture is well combined.
Once the mixture is smooth, turn off the heat and set the pot aside to cool down slightly!
Then, take the remaining water and stir in the rum and heavy cream until well mixed.
Pour this mixture into the pumpkin pot and stir until dissolved.
Next, take the coconut jelly tray out of the fridge and pour the pumpkin jelly into each glass. The glasses should now be about 2/3 full.
Place the glasses back in the refrigerator for about 4 hours, or overnight if not eating immediately.
The final step is the crust layer; only do this right before serving.
Combine the cookie crumbs and butter in a bowl until the crumbs are soft and moist.
Take the jelly glasses out and spoon the cookie crumbs on top to create the third layer.
Present the jelly and enjoy.
You can add a dollop of whipped cream on top like this for a more unique flavor.
Notes for making three-layer pumpkin jelly:

The time interval between the first two layers should not be too long, or they won't bond together and will remain separate, which means the dish has failed. The ideal time is to chill the first layer for 30 minutes before adding the second layer.
You can choose the cookie flavor according to your preference and adjust the amount of crumbs to your taste.
Instead of gelatin powder, you can use gelatin sheets. If using sheets, soak them in cold water first until soft; the water ratio should be 5 times the weight of the sheets.
Also, note that you should not add gelatin while the liquid is boiling, as it will lose its setting properties.

While pumpkin jelly might not seem as unique as other jellies, its vibrant warm colors will surely catch everyone's eye. More importantly, when eating, you'll experience a blend of flavors: the richness of coconut, the sweetness of pumpkin, and the crunch of the cookies. This three-layer pumpkin jelly is an ideal dessert to keep ready in your fridge to enjoy anytime.
Keep the cream chilled in the refrigerator.

mon_an.mo_ta: Bananas are rich in serotonin, N-acetyl-5-methoxy amine, and magnesium, which help reduce fatigue and relax muscles. They also help you fall into a deeper, longer, and better sleep. Honey is also very beneficial for your health. The combination of bananas and honey creates a highly nutritious and appealing dish.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel the banana. Whisk the egg, then add the crispy frying flour and stir until the batter is smooth and soft.
Step 2: Coat the banana in the batter, then fry in a pan of oil until golden brown and crispy.

Step 3: Place the banana on paper towels to absorb excess oil (to avoid greasiness). When eating, you can use a knife to cut the banana into small pieces and drizzle honey over them to enhance the flavor.

mon_an.mo_ta: With just a little time in the kitchen and some skill and meticulousness, you can have lovely Christmas tree cupcakes to welcome the holiday season! Check out how to make Christmas tree cupcakes in the article below! Discover the super cute way to make Christmas tree cupcakes. Detailed instructions to create adorable cupcakes that evoke the festive atmosphere.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Green food coloring - a few drops
Decorating tools - star tip, piping bag
cac_buoc: 1. How to make super cute Christmas tree cupcakes
Part 1: Making the cake base
Step 1: First, separate the egg yolks and egg whites into two different bowls. In the yolk bowl, add a little sugar, fresh milk, and cooking oil, then stir well until the ingredients are combined.
Then, add the dry flour mixture and stir until no lumps are visible, the ingredients are well combined, and the mixture is soft and smooth, then set aside.

Step 2: In the white bowl, add a pinch of salt and use an electric mixer to beat until small bubbles appear, then add the lemon juice and continue beating. While beating, gradually add the sugar and beat until the egg whites reach stiff peaks, then stop.

Step 3: Next, take 1/3 of the egg white mixture and add it to the yolk bowl, mixing well. Then pour the yolk mixture back into the egg white bowl, using a spatula to fold the batter from the bottom up until the mixture is uniform.
Step 4: Preheat the oven to 170°C for 15 minutes.

When the cake batter is ready, use a spoon to divide the batter evenly into each paper cup so that the batter fills about 8/10 of the cup. Then, place the tray in the oven for about 20-25 minutes until the cakes are cooked, then remove and let them cool completely.
Part 2: Finishing the cakes

Step 1: First, take the fresh cream out into a bowl and add sugar. Use an electric mixer to beat until the cream is fluffy, then stop; you can add vanilla to enhance the aroma. Then, add a little green food coloring and mix well until the color is even, then put the cream into a piping bag.
Step 2: Next, squeeze some cream onto the cupcake, then attach an ice cream cone, pressing lightly so the cone sticks firmly to the cupcake.

Step 3: Pipe the cream from the bottom up to create pine needles, gradually moving to the top, rotating while squeezing. At the top of the tree, place a yellow star-shaped candy and sprinkle some colored chocolate on the tree to create twinkling lights. Finally, sprinkle a little powdered sugar on the tree to create snow, and the Christmas tree is complete.
2. How to make cupcakes using an air fryer
Prepare ingredients
45g flour
45g sugar
30g unsalted butter
15ml fresh milk
2 eggs
Frosting part:
200g whipping cream
20g sugar
Making Cupcakes with an air fryer
Prepare a large bowl, place the butter and milk in the bowl. Heat water in a pot and place the large bowl of butter and milk over the pot to melt the mixture using the double boiler method.

Separate the egg yolks and whites. Use a whisk or electric mixer to beat the yolks, then add the melted butter and milk mixture and stir well. Note: wait for the butter-milk mixture to cool completely before mixing into the yolks to avoid cooking the eggs.

Add the flour to the bowl containing the yolk mixture, mixing well until the ingredients combine into a smooth and thick mixture. Beat the egg whites with a whisk or electric mixer, adding sugar gradually during the process so it dissolves evenly. When the egg whites are beaten to stiff peaks, stop.
Combine all the beaten egg whites into the flour mixture, folding gently until combined. Pour the batter into cupcake molds, filling only about 2/3 of the mold. Continue until all the batter is used.

Arrange the cakes in the air fryer and bake at 175°C for about 25 minutes. While waiting for the cakes to cook, put the sugar and whipping cream into a large bowl and use a mixer to beat the cream until it is firm, smooth, and does not run. Then, transfer all the whipped cream into a piping bag and place it in the refrigerator.
After the cakes have cooled, decorate the tops with the whipped cream. Now, the dish is finished and ready to enjoy.
3. How to make cupcakes using a microwave
Ingredients to prepare
Ingredients:
30 grams flour
3 grams baking powder
20 grams powdered sugar
25ml unsweetened fresh milk
25ml cooking oil
15 grams cocoa powder
5 grams decorative candies
Tools:
Microwave
Paper cupcake liners
Electric mixer
Flour sifter
Baking tray
Steps to perform
Step 1: Use a flour sifter to sift 30 grams of flour, 15 grams of cocoa powder, and 20 grams of powdered sugar into 3 separate bowls.

Step 2: Mix the sifted 30 grams of flour, 20 grams of powdered sugar, 15 grams of cocoa powder with 3 grams of baking powder and 25ml of cooking oil in a large bowl. Combine the ingredients and mix well until the mixture becomes a uniform dough.
Step 3: Crack 2 eggs into another bowl and add 25ml of unsweetened fresh milk. Stir well and slowly pour into the flour-sugar mixture from step 2.
Step 4: Use a mixing tool like a whisk to combine the ingredients from the two bowls and mix well until the mixture becomes a smooth and elastic batter.
Step 5: Prepare a baking tray and line it with paper molds. Then, pour the mixture from step 4 into each mold.

Note: Only fill the batter to 3/4 of the mold; do not overfill as the cake will continue to rise when baking. If you don't have special microwave cupcake molds, you can use ceramic cups as a substitute.

Step 6: Turn the microwave to the highest setting. Place the molds in the microwave and cook for about 2-3 minutes until the cakes are chocolate brown. Then, turn off the microwave and take the cakes out.

Step 7: Sprinkle decorative candies evenly over the cupcakes. You can also add a layer of fresh cream and fresh fruit like strawberries, grapes, or cherries on top to decorate and make the cupcakes more attractive.
4. How to make cupcakes using a steamer
Ingredients:
120g flour
100g sugar
60ml fresh milk
60ml cooking oil
1/2 tsp baking powder
1/2 tsp vanilla
A pinch of salt
Steamer
Cupcake molds
Mixing bowl
Spoon
Small bowl
Step 1: Prepare the steamer
Place the steamer on the stove and preheat it.
Step 2: Prepare the cupcake molds
Line the cupcake molds with paper liners.
Step 3: Mix the dry ingredients
In a mixing bowl, combine the flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt. Mix the dry ingredients together well.
Step 4: Combine the wet ingredients
In a small bowl, combine the eggs, fresh milk, oil, and vanilla. Whisk the wet ingredients until the mixture is uniform.
Step 5: Combine dry and wet ingredients
Pour the wet mixture into the dry mixture from step 3. Use a spoon to stir well until the ingredients are combined and the mixture becomes smooth.
Step 6: Pour batter into cupcake molds
Using a spoon, pour the mixed batter into each cupcake mold. Fill about 3/4 of the mold so the cake has room to rise while cooking.
Step 7: Cook the cupcakes

Place the filled cupcake molds into the steamer. Cover the lid tightly and cook for about 15-20 minutes, or until the cakes are fully cooked. Check the cakes by inserting a bamboo skewer; if it comes out clean, the cakes are done.
Step 8: Decorate
When the cakes have cooled completely, you can decorate the cupcakes with fresh cream, sugar, or various decorative sprinkles as desired.
Notes for cute Christmas tree cupcakes
To add more color to the Christmas tree, you can use red or yellow cream to create fruit shapes on the tree.
The process of beating the eggs and fresh cream is very important. If the egg whites are not beaten to stiff peaks, the cake will not rise and be fluffy when baked.
If you beat the fresh cream for too long, it will curdle and run, making it impossible to shape the Christmas tree.
Depending on individual taste, you can adjust the sweetness accordingly!

mon_an.mo_ta: Delicious pieces of avocado blended with fresh milk and coconut milk are enough to make you swoon with the incredibly fragrant flavor of this avocado pudding!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Coconut milk sauce: 100ml coconut milk + 10g sugar + 1 pinch of salt.
cac_buoc: Here are the ingredients you need to prepare for this delicious avocado pudding!

Step 1: Soak the gelatin sheets in a bowl of cold water for 15 minutes. Then take the sheets out and put them in a small bowl, place the bowl in a pot of boiling water to melt the gelatin using the double boiler method (keep the gelatin bowl in the hot water pot).
Step 2: Remove the pit and skin of the avocado, then put it in a blender with fresh milk + lemon juice + condensed milk + sugar and blend until smooth.
Step 3: Pour the avocado mixture into a bowl, add the melted gelatin and stir well.
Step 4: Then pour this mixture into small bowls and leave in the refrigerator for a few hours until the avocado sets.
Step 5: Put the coconut milk ingredients into a pot, stir to dissolve, place on the stove and bring to a gentle simmer, then turn off the heat and let it cool.
Serve the avocado pudding in a bowl, pour the coconut milk sauce over it; if you have jelly or cold noodles, add them to make the summer dessert more attractive.

mon_an.mo_ta: Hand-make these fragrant, warm, sweet, and slightly spicy ginger lollipops to enjoy during the Lunar New Year! Let's learn how to make this dish through the article below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Corn syrup (the type of white syrup used for modern mooncakes) - 50g
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel the ginger and grate it finely (collecting both the juice and the pulp).
Step 2: Put the sugar, syrup, ginger, water, and salt into a pot, stir to dissolve, and place on the stove over low heat.
Stir while cooking until the sugar water turns slightly yellow, then turn off the heat (cooking for about 10-15 minutes is ideal).
Step 3: Pour the candy into small silicone molds (or onto a piece of non-stick parchment paper).
Wait for the candy to cool, then remove it from the molds (if poured on paper, use a knife to cut into small squares when the candy is slightly cool).
Put the candy in a jar and store in a cool place or in the refrigerator.

mon_an.ten: Ginger-Infused Sugared Dracontomelon (Ô Mai Sấu Gừng)
mon_an.mo_ta: One of the most popular dishes made from dracontomelon is ginger-stir-fried dracontomelon. The combination of the mild sourness of the fruit, the sweetness of sugar, and the spicy heat of ginger creates a unique flavor. This dish is not only soft but also provides a warm sensation on the tip of the tongue. The method is simple and can be done at home. Follow the recipe below! Enjoy simple homemade ginger-stir-fried dracontomelon with its sour and spicy flavor. Learn the best way to make it.
cac_buoc: Method 1: Making ginger dracontomelon using a lime water soak
Step 1: Scrape the skin of the dracontomelon, soak in diluted salt water, then score the fruit.
Step 2: Soak the dracontomelon in clear lime water for 30 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with water to remove the lime smell. Then use a heavy knife to crush the fruit once.

Step 3: Wash the ginger, crush it, and mince it. Put the dracontomelon, ginger, and sugar into a wide, deep pan. For every layer of fruit, add a layer of sugar and a thin layer of ginger. Marinate for 4 hours.
Step 4: Place the pan directly on a charcoal stove to save costs, add 1 tsp of salt, and simmer over low heat. Cook until the sugar water thickens and turns an amber color.
Step 5: After simmering, spread the dracontomelon on a tray and dry in bright sunlight for 2 hours or in an oven at 100°C for 1 hour until dry.
Method 2: Making ginger dracontomelon without lime water.
Step 1: Scrape the dracontomelon clean and soak immediately in salt water; for this method, you don't need to score the fruit, just soak in salt water for 20 minutes.

Step 2: Remove the fruit to a basket, drain well, then use a heavy knife to crush them. Marinate with sugar and minced ginger. To make the ginger strands longer and prettier, you can crush and shred them.
Step 3: Marinate the dracontomelon with sugar for 6 hours so the sugar is fully absorbed; when the sugar is completely dissolved, the fruit will be crispier when cooked.

Step 4: Place the pan directly on a charcoal stove to save costs, add 1 tsp of salt, and simmer over low heat. Cook until the sugar water thickens and turns an amber color. After simmering, spread the dracontomelon on a tray and dry in bright sunlight for 2 hours or in an oven at 100°C for 1 hour until dry.

Place the finished snack into an airtight container and store in the refrigerator to keep for a long time. If you like dry golden ginger strands, after finishing the snack, crush and shred a bit more ginger, toast it in a thick pan for a while until dry, then sprinkle it over the dracontomelon; it will be as delicious and eye-catching as store-bought versions!
Notes when making ginger dracontomelon
To enjoy dracontomelon year-round, you can buy them, scrape the skin, wash, and dry them thoroughly. Then, place them in the freezer to store and use gradually.

For the processed snack, place them in a box or jar and seal tightly, then store in a cool place away from high temperatures. Do not store the finished snack in the refrigerator, as taking it out can cause condensation and affect its quality.
How to choose good dracontomelon
Choose fruits with dark green skin, without black spots or bruises.
Touch the fruit to check firmness: Ripe ones usually have slightly soft skin that can be pressed a bit but not too soft.
Check the weight: Choose heavier fruits, as this usually indicates they contain more juice and flesh.
Look for signs of freshness: Fresh ones usually have shiny skin without cracks or damage.
Check the scent: Ripe ones usually have a fragrant and fresh aroma.

mon_an.mo_ta: If you want beautiful and youthful skin, you cannot miss this incredibly fragrant, refreshing, and nutritious lotus seed milk!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Buy fresh lotus seeds, separate them, and remove the bitter hearts.
Step 2: Put the lotus seeds in a blender with 1.5 liters of water and blend until smooth. Use a filter bag or cheesecloth to strain the lotus seed milk.

Step 3: Next, wash 2-3 pandan leaves, tie them in a bunch, and drop them into the pot of lotus milk. Then add 100 g of granulated sugar and place on the stove to boil. While cooking, stir gently so the milk doesn't settle at the bottom. When the milk boils, lower the heat, skim off any foam, turn off the heat, and wait for the milk to cool.

Step 4: While waiting for the milk to boil, dissolve 10 grams of agar-agar powder and 150 grams of white granulated sugar in 1.5 liters of filtered water. Then cook over medium heat; do not stir while cooking as the jelly will release water when set. Use syrup for your desired colors. Here I use strawberry, mint, and grass jelly. After boiling, skim the foam, pour the jelly into molds, wait for it to set, and place in the refrigerator.
Step 5: When the jelly has hardened, cut it into bite-sized pieces.
Step 6: Pour the milk into a glass, add the jelly, tapioca pearls, and a little shaved ice, then enjoy. You can also keep it in the refrigerator for later use.
Good luck with this nutritious and refreshing lotus seed milk for your family!

mon_an.mo_ta: You will be swooning from the very first bite of this pandan and milk jelly; it's both refreshing and healthy for these hot summer days!
cac_buoc: Here are the ingredients needed to make this delicious pandan and milk jelly!

Step 1: Wash the pandan leaves and cut them into segments. Put them in a blender with a little filtered water and blend until smooth, then strain to get about 200ml of pandan juice. Add 1 tablespoon of granulated sugar to the pandan juice and dissolve it to keep the juice sweet, fragrant, and beautifully green.

Step 2: Mix the agar-agar powder with the granulated sugar, then add 1600 ml of filtered water to a pot, soak for about 10 minutes, then place on the stove to cook. When the jelly water boils, skim off all the foam to keep the liquid clear.
Step 3: Divide the jelly liquid into 2 parts to mix the colors as follows:
Mix the pandan juice with one part of the jelly liquid to get clear green jelly.
Mix the fresh milk with the other part of the jelly liquid to get milky white jelly.

Step 4: Pour the jelly into molds, pouring the white layer first. Wait for the white layer's surface to set, then pour the green layer on top. Or vice versa, depending on your preference. Do this alternately until the mold is full.

Step 5: Note: Agar-agar sets very quickly, so while waiting for one layer to set, the other part of the jelly liquid might thicken. Therefore, you must always keep the unpoured jelly liquid in hot water and cover it tightly. If the jelly thickens before you can pour it, put it back on the stove and heat it up; it will melt back into liquid, then you can continue pouring.
Let the jelly cool, then store it in the refrigerator; cut it into pieces when serving.
The jelly is soft yet crispy, clear, with two eye-catching green and white colors. The mildly sweet taste and the fragrant aroma of pandan blended with the creamy taste of milk are truly wonderful.
This is a delicious and refreshing jelly; add it to your nutritious menu for this summer!
Good luck and enjoy your pandan and milk jelly dessert!

mon_an.ten: Bubble Milk Tea with Cassava Starch Pearls
mon_an.mo_ta: Bubble milk tea made with cassava starch pearls is very simple and perfect for cooling down in the summer.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 70-90ml boiling hot coffee (increase if the dough is not soft enough)
Milk tea part: 2 Lipton tea bags (flavor of choice); 2 tbsp condensed milk; 80ml boiling water; 1 tbsp sugar; 100ml unsweetened fresh milk; 1/2 cup small ice cubes.
cac_buoc: Note: You can use cocoa powder for color and flavor. If using cocoa powder, use boiling water instead of coffee.
Let's get started!
Step 1: Put the cassava starch, cornstarch, and sugar into a bowl and mix together. Then slowly add the boiling hot coffee (mandatory) and stir briefly with chopsticks (as it is very hot).

Step 2: Now wear gloves and knead until the dough is smooth, elastic, and doesn't stick to your hands (knead the dough to be slightly soft; if it's too dry, the pearls will be hard). Roll into small balls and place them on a tray with a little cornstarch or cassava starch.
Step 3: Boil a pot of water; when the water is boiling, add the coffee pearls to cook.
Step 4: When you see the pearls floating, continue to cook for another 5 minutes so they become soft and cooked through.
Remove the pearls and place them in a bowl of ice water for 1 minute.
Step 5: Before taking them out, put them into the prepared bowl of brown sugar; this helps the pearls look shiny and absorb the flavor.

Step 6: Put 2 tea bags into a glass. Add boiling water and then the condensed milk, letting it sit for a while for the tea to steep. Remove the tea bags. Now add the sugar and milk and stir together. Put the milk tea into a shaker with some ice and shake vigorously (if you like foam).
Step 7: Finally, put the pearls into a glass, pour the milk tea in, and it's finished; you now have a delicious cup of milk tea.
Good luck with this method of making bubble milk tea from cassava starch for an attractive drink on sunny days!

mon_an.mo_ta: Your free weekend will be much more meaningful when you can personally go into the kitchen to practice baking and create soft, delicious cookies with the aroma of strawberries and the slight crunch of biscuits. Let's learn how to make strawberry cream glazed cookies!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Unsalted butter, softened at room temperature - 150 g
cac_buoc: Step 1: Cookie making: Put the butter, flour, salt, and baking powder into a large bowl.
Step 2: Crack the eggs and pour them in.
Step 3: Next, add the grated lemon zest, corn syrup, and vanilla.
Step 4: Turn on a hand mixer to mix the ingredients; as the machine beats, gradually add half a container of yogurt.
Step 5: When the butter and flour mixture becomes thick and well-combined, turn off the mixer.
Step 6: Wrap the dough tightly in a clean plastic bag and place it in the refrigerator for 6 to 12 hours.
Step 7: Take the dough out, knead it thoroughly by hand, then place it on a wooden board sprinkled with a little flour to prevent sticking. Use a rolling pin to flatten the dough evenly.
Next, use cookie cutters to cut the dough into round or oval pieces as desired.
Step 8: Arrange the cookies on a tray and bake in the oven at 200°C for 8 minutes, then remove and let them cool.
Step 9: Strawberry cream part: Wash the strawberries, cut them in half, and put them in a blender with 1/2 tsp of lemon zest and 2 tbsp of sugar, then blend until smooth.
Step 10: Next, pour the strawberry mixture through a sieve to remove any pulp or seeds.
Step 11: Add butter to the strawberry bowl along with 1.5 tbsp of corn syrup and 1/2 tsp of vanilla.
Step 12: Next, add the remaining 2 tbsp of sugar and use a hand whisk to mix well.
Step 13: Continue until the strawberry cream mixture is very smooth and flows in a stream when lifted.
Step 14: Use a spoon to scoop the strawberry cream and glaze the surface of each cookie evenly.
Step 15: Repeat until finished. The cookies can be eaten immediately without needing to be baked again.

mon_an.ten: Nem Chạo (Vietnamese Fermented Pork Skin Salad)
mon_an.mo_ta: Nem chạo is chewy, crunchy, and nutty, considered one of the favorite "drinking snacks" for men, but with the nutty flavor of toasted rice powder and the sweet and sour dipping sauce, it is also attractive to housewives and children. This is a delicious dish suitable for when the whole family gathers together. This dish is not too complicated and can be enjoyed immediately, unlike other types of fermented rolls, so you can easily prepare it for your family meal! Refer to the recipe below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Phrynium leaves or banana leaves - ingredient
Lemon, chili, galangal, garlic, lime leaves, herbs, culantro - ingredients
Rice wine, vinegar, sugar, pepper, fish sauce, salt, MSG - seasonings
Vong leaves, basil, young fig leaves, peppermint, Vietnamese coriander, polyscias fruticosa, guava leaves, star fruit, green banana - for serving
cac_buoc: Step 1: Scrape the pork skin clean, wash with salt water, then rinse with clean water. Wash the pork fat and pork meat and let them drain.
Step 2: Wash the accompanying leaves and herbs, place them in a basket to drain. Clean the herbs and culantro, wash, and chop finely.

Boil the pork skin and pork fat until cooked, then remove and let drain. Julienne them into strips about 0.2 cm thick and keep separate. Put the pork fat in a separate bowl and marinate with salt, rice wine, and sugar to make the fat clearer and crispier.

Step 3: Peel and mince the galangal and garlic. Put the whole piece of pork meat in a separate bowl and marinate with garlic, galangal, salt, MSG, and fish sauce for about 15 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Next, add oil to a pan; when the oil is hot, add the meat to fry, turning all sides until the meat is golden brown and cooked through. Then, remove the meat to a plate, let it cool, and julienne it.

Wash the lime leaves and julienne them. Thinly slice the chili. Mix all the pork skin, pork fat, and pork meat together with sugar, pepper, toasted rice powder, lime leaves, and chili, then squeeze in some lemon juice and mix thoroughly so everything absorbs the seasonings.
Step 4: Arrange the nem on a plate and sprinkle the chopped herbs and culantro on top. Wrap the nem chạo in the various leaves, dip in chili sauce or fish sauce, and enjoy.
Enjoy your meal, everyone!

Salted egg sponge cake is a traditional, delicious, and beloved snack in Vietnam. With simple, easy-to-find ingredients and a straightforward process, anyone can make it. In just a few basic steps, you can create your own fragrant sponge cakes that look as good as they taste. Let's explore how to make this unique treat and enjoy its full flavor through this article!
I. Traditional Salted Egg Sponge Cake
1. Prepare Ingredients
Eggs: Use 4-5 fresh chicken eggs, separating the yolks and whites. This helps create a light and airy texture for the cake.
Sugar: 100g white granulated sugar. Sugar provides a moderate sweetness and helps the cake structure stay soft and smooth.
Flour: Use 120g all-purpose flour. Flour is the main ingredient that ensures a sturdy cake structure.
Baking powder: Baking powder helps the cake rise and become fluffier.
Salt: 1/4 tsp salt. Salt helps balance the sweetness and enhances the cake's flavor.
Milk: 50ml fresh milk. Milk gives the cake a soft, smooth, and moist texture.
2. Instructions
2.1. Whisk Eggs and Sugar until Fluffy
Start by separating the egg whites and yolks into two separate bowls.
Using an electric mixer or a hand whisk, beat the egg whites until they form white, fluffy, and medium-stiff peaks.
Next, add sugar to the egg yolks and whisk until the mixture is thick, light, and pale yellow.
2.2. Mix Flour and Baking Powder
In a separate bowl, sift the flour and baking powder together to combine well.
Add the flour mixture to the egg yolk mixture, using a spatula to gently fold until no lumps remain.
Mixing should be done carefully to avoid deflating the egg bubbles.
2.3. Add Milk and Continue Stirring
After mixing the flour, add the fresh milk and stir until the batter is smooth, uniform, and lump-free.
Grease the sides and bottom of the cake mold with a thin layer of butter or cooking oil.
Pour the batter into the mold and smooth the surface.
Bake the cake at 170-180°C for about 25-30 minutes until the surface is golden brown and set.
Check with a toothpick; if it comes out clean when inserted into the cake, it is done.
2.4. Cool and Enjoy
Once baked, remove the cake from the mold and let it cool completely on a wire rack.
When the cake has cooled entirely, you can enjoy your delicious salted egg sponge cake.
II. Simple Rice Cooker Salted Egg Sponge Cake
Chicken eggs
Sugar
Flour
Baking powder
Butter or cooking oil
Salted eggs
2. Whisk Eggs and Sugar
Separate the egg yolks and whites. Place the whites in a clean bowl and the yolks in another.
Use a mixer at high speed to beat the egg whites until they form white, fluffy, soft peaks. While whisking, gradually add a little sugar to help increase the fluffiness of the whites.
For the yolks, use a mixer or whisk by hand until smooth and completely combined. Gradually add sugar to the yolks and continue whisking well.
3. Mix the Batter
In another bowl, combine the flour and baking powder. Mix the ingredients well with a spoon.
Slowly fold the whisked yolks into the beaten egg whites. Mix gently with a spatula or wooden spoon until the mixture is smooth and uniform, with no lumps.
Then, gradually fold the flour and baking powder mixture into the egg mixture. Continue mixing until the flour is completely incorporated and no lumps remain.
4. Cook the Cake in a Rice Cooker
Grease the sides and bottom of the rice cooker pot with a thin layer of butter or cooking oil.
Transfer the cake batter into the pot and level the surface.
Close the lid, turn on the "Cook" mode, and let it cook for about 30-40 minutes until the cake is evenly golden brown.
5. Decoration
When the cake is done, remove it from the pot and let it cool completely.
Use a knife to slice the cake into thin pieces.
Arrange the slices on a plate and sprinkle salted eggs on top.
The salted egg sponge cake is ready to be enjoyed. This cake can be eaten hot or cold and is perfect for breakfast, a snack, or served with tea.
III. Notes for Making Salted Egg Sponge Cake
1. Temperature of Eggs and Ingredients
Use eggs at room temperature; do not use cold eggs from the refrigerator. Room temperature helps in separating the whites and yolks and allows for better whisking.
Other ingredients like flour, baking powder, and sugar should also be at room temperature before use.
2. Whisking Technique
Egg whites must be whisked very thoroughly to create white, fluffy, and stable peaks. This ensures the cake is airy and soft.
Yolks need to be whisked until completely smooth to avoid any lumps.
3. Folding the Mixture
When folding the yolks and flour into the whites, do it gently to avoid breaking the air bubbles in the whites.
Mix until the mixture is completely smooth and uniform, with no flour lumps.
4. Cooking the Cake
It is recommended to use a rice cooker with a "Cook" function to ensure accurate temperature and cooking time.
Do not open the lid during the cooking process to prevent the cake from collapsing.
IV. How to Make Salted Egg Sponge Cake Sauce
1. Ingredients
2 egg yolks
2 tbsp fresh milk
1 tbsp cooking oil
1 tsp white vinegar
1/2 tsp salt
2. Instructions
Whisk the egg yolks in a small bowl using a whisk or an electric mixer.
Add fresh milk, cooking oil, vinegar, and salt to the yolk bowl. Continue whisking until the sauce is smooth and uniform.
If the sauce is too thick, you can add a little fresh milk to thin it out. If it is too thin, continue whisking until it reaches the desired consistency.
The flavor of the sauce can be adjusted with a bit more salt or vinegar if needed.
The sauce is ready to be used as a dip for the salted egg sponge cake. You can serve the sauce cold or warm depending on your preference.
This sauce adds a rich, creamy, and slightly tangy flavor, completing the unique taste of the salted egg sponge cake.

mon_an.mo_ta: Cherry cheesecake with its eye-catching colors and delicious flavor will attract anyone at first sight with its alternating layers of chocolate brown and light yellow. When tasted, the cake is soft, fragrant with vanilla, moderately sweet, and paired with fresh cherries that you will absolutely love. Just spend a little time in the kitchen with easy-to-find ingredients, and you will have a wonderful cake to treat your family, friends, and loved ones.
cac_buoc: How to make Cherry Cheesecake:

Step 1: First, finely grind the biscuits, then add brown sugar and mix well. In another bowl, place the dark chocolate and butter and melt them using a double boiler or a microwave until completely melted and combined. Once melted, remember to stir well so the ingredients blend together.

Step 2: Next, slowly pour the chocolate-butter mixture into the crushed biscuits, stir well to combine, then pour into a 22 cm diameter baking tray lined with parchment paper. Use a spoon to spread it evenly around the sides and bottom of the mold, then place it in the refrigerator to harden for 30 minutes to 1 hour, or until the base is sufficiently firm.

Step 3: Next, prepare the cream cheese layer. First, whisk the eggs with sugar until you get a pale yellow mixture, then add a few vanilla bean seeds for aroma. Keep whisking until the ingredients are well combined and the egg cream has a certain firmness.
Step 4: Then, press the cream cheese through a fine-mesh sieve to avoid lumps and pour it into the egg mixture bowl.
Step 5: Next, sift the cornstarch into the bowl, then add the heavy cream, condensed milk, and cherry juice one by one. Stir well so all ingredients are fully incorporated.

Step 6: Once prepared, take the cake tray out of the refrigerator, arrange the cherries in a spiral pattern, and return it to the fridge for another 15 minutes. Then, pour the cream mixture over the top and place it in a preheated oven. Bake at 180°C for 30 minutes (if using a convection oven, bake at 160°C for 20 minutes). After this time, reduce the oven temperature to 160°C and continue baking for another 30 minutes (at 140°C for 20 minutes with a convection oven).

Step 7: When the cake is fully baked, remove it from the oven and let it cool. Meanwhile, prepare the decoration layer by heating the heavy cream and butter in a small pot, then pour it over the chocolate in a bowl. Stir well to dissolve the chocolate.
Step 8: Finally, decorate by piping chocolate dollops around the cake, place a cherry on each one, and enjoy.

Cherry cheesecake with its eye-catching colors and delicious flavor will attract anyone at first sight with its alternating layers of chocolate brown and light yellow. When tasted, the cake is soft, fragrant with vanilla, moderately sweet, and paired with fresh cherries that you will absolutely love. Just spend a little time in the kitchen with easy-to-find ingredients, and you will have a wonderful cake to treat your family, friends, and loved ones. You will surely receive many compliments from them.

mon_an.mo_ta: Baked banana cake is a delicious and attractive dessert that you can bake using a compact rice cooker. This is a great choice to change up the weekend menu for the whole family. It is very simple to make; just prepare the necessary ingredients and a rice cooker. Let's learn how to make baked banana cake in a rice cooker through the article below! Enjoy the unique and tasty jellied pork skin dish with detailed instructions and important notes. Ensure safety and deliciousness with the proper way to clean pork skin. Enjoy the rich flavor of this traditional dish with family and friends.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare ingredients

Peel the bananas and cut them into round slices about 1 cm thick. Then, place the bananas in a non-stick pan with 4 tablespoons of red wine and 1 tablespoon of sugar. Stir well and let the bananas marinate in the wine and sugar.
In a clean bowl, pour the coconut milk, fresh milk, and vanilla. Add 1/2 teaspoon of salt and stir well to combine the ingredients.

Tear the bread into small pieces and add them to the coconut milk mixture. Let it sit for about 30 minutes for the bread to expand. Then, crack the egg and sift the flour into the bowl, mixing well to create a thick batter.
Step 2: Prepare the cake mixture

First, slowly pour the marinated bananas (with red wine and sugar) into the flour mixture. Mix well by hand. You can set aside a few banana slices to decorate the surface of the cake for an attractive look.
Melt the butter and add about 2 tablespoons of melted butter to the batter. Butter helps the cake stay soft, prevents it from drying out, and provides a delicious aroma.
Step 3: Cook the cake in a rice cooker

Grease the sides of the pot with a layer of cooking oil or butter to prevent sticking. Arrange a layer of bananas at the bottom of the pot, then slowly pour the batter into the rice cooker, distributing it evenly.
Turn on the "Cook" mode and wait about 15 minutes for the cooker to switch to "Warm" mode. Press the button down again.
Continue waiting for another 30 minutes for the cake to cook through, then remove it and let it cool before enjoying.

The rice cooker baked banana cake will have an even golden-brown color, a fragrant aroma, and no burnt spots. When tasting, you will notice a gentle sweetness that is not too heavy, and a soft, moist texture. You can enjoy this cake with a cup of tea or any favorite beverage to enhance the flavor.
Notes for making baked banana cake in a rice cooker
If red wine is unavailable, you can use Rum as a substitute. Rum is generally more affordable than wine.

Marinating the bananas with sugar and wine during the process will cause the bananas to ferment, giving them an attractive color and increasing the sweetness. However, if you are short on time, you can cook the bananas over low heat, stirring constantly until they absorb the wine.

Although the bananas are marinated with wine, the alcohol content will evaporate during the cooking process, making this cake suitable for children. If used appropriately, it can also provide health benefits.
Tips for choosing good bananas
Prioritize choosing medium-sized bananas with black spots; avoid those that are bruised or mushy.

Choose bunches that have both green and yellow fruits, as tree-ripened bananas are usually not treated with ripening agents. If you see bananas with thick yellow skins but raw, hard stems, do not buy them, as they may have been chemically treated.
Apple bananas (Chuối xiêm) are a type with thin yellow skins, slightly dry, and tiny dark spots. These are tree-ripened, flavorful, and have a chewy texture.

mon_an.mo_ta: Raspberry banana cake with its eye-catching appearance and delicious flavor features a soft texture and mildly sweet fruit that brings a delightful sensation to the eater.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Tools - whisk, rolling pin, fork, plastic wrap, aluminum foil, oven
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare ingredients for the baked raspberry banana cake.
Sift the flour until smooth.
Pour the warm water into a bowl, then add the dry yeast and sugar to the water and dissolve.
Peel the bananas and slice them into rounds of moderate thickness.
Wash the raspberries thoroughly with water and place them in a basket to dry completely.
Crack the egg into a bowl and separate the yolk from the white.
Step 2: Steps to make the baked raspberry banana cake.
For the crust:
First, put the flour in a bowl, add a little salt, and mix well.
Then add the unsalted butter and continue to mix well.
Next, slowly pour in the yeast water mixture prepared earlier.
Use a whisk to mix the dough thoroughly until you get a very smooth, lump-free, and uniform dough.
Finally, cover the bowl with plastic wrap and let the dough proof for about 30 minutes.
For the filling:
First, put the raspberries in a bowl, then add the following ingredients: white granulated sugar, cinnamon powder, cornstarch, and salt.
Mix the raspberry mixture well; while mixing, use a spoon to slightly crush the raspberries, but be careful not to mash them completely.
Then, place the raspberry bowl in the refrigerator.
Next step, take the proofed dough out and divide it into two parts (one small part and one large part).
Use a rolling pin to roll out each part of the dough thinly and set aside.
With the smaller piece of dough, use a knife to cut it into long strips as shown in the picture.

With the larger piece of dough, gently place it into the cake mold, and use a fork to prick around the dough so that heat and steam can escape during baking, preventing the crust from puffing up and breaking.
Next, brush a layer of egg white onto the crust; this helps the cake stay crispy and prevents it from getting soggy.
Then, arrange the banana slices to cover the bottom of the mold.
At this point, preheat the oven to 350°F (equivalent to 180°C).
Next, take the raspberry filling out of the refrigerator and use a spoon to scoop it into the mold. Be sure to spread it evenly to cover the banana slices.
Then, arrange the cut dough strips on top in a lattice pattern.

At the same time, use a knife to trim off any excess dough to make the mold look neat. For the ends of the strips that meet the bottom crust, if they don't stick, you can use a little water to help them adhere.
You can sprinkle a little more sugar or cinnamon powder according to your preference.
Finally, cover the top of the mold with a piece of aluminum foil and place it in the preheated oven. Bake the cake for 50 minutes.
When the cake is done, take it out and let it cool slightly before enjoying.
Notes for a delicious baked raspberry banana cake

When slicing the bananas, make sure to cut them a bit thick or at least not too thin, because if the slices are too thin, they will almost melt away during baking, making the crust lose its crispness and the cake less tasty.

In this recipe, you will notice that we bake the cake for quite a long time at a relatively high temperature, so covering it with a piece of aluminum foil is extremely necessary and important. It helps the cake cook evenly from top to bottom without burning the dough strips on top, so do not skip this step.

mon_an.mo_ta: With just a little time in the kitchen and easy-to-find ingredients, this simple durian crepe recipe yields a delicious treat with eye-catching colors, moderate sweetness, and a characteristic durian aroma that feels wonderful to eat. Everyone will be delighted with this fragrant cake! Check out the instructions on how to make durian crepes in the article below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Pandan juice or powder - a little
cac_buoc: How to make delicious Pandan Durian Crepes
First, put the water, coconut milk, durian flesh, pandan powder, flour, and eggs into a large bowl and mix well until all ingredients are combined.

After mixing the mixture by hand, pour it into a blender to make it smoother and more uniform. Next, turn the blender to the lowest setting to avoid over-processing the batter, which could make it watery. Then, strain the mixture through a sieve to ensure a smooth crepe batter.
Next, place a non-stick pan on the stove. When the pan is slightly hot, add a little butter, coat the surface of the pan evenly, and then reduce the heat to low.
Then, use a ladle to scoop a portion of the batter into the center of the pan, then tilt the pan so the batter spreads out into an even circle.
When the surface of the crepe looks slightly set, carefully flip it over. Since the crepe is thin, it cooks very quickly, so pay close attention to remove it in time.
When removing the crepe skin, use a paper towel to clean the pan surface and continue making the remaining crepes until the batter is finished.
Next, place a crepe skin on a clean flat surface, take a bit of mixed cream, add a little durian flesh on top of the cream, followed by another layer of cream.
Then, fold the two opposite edges of the crepe inward, then fold the remaining two sides to form a square so the cake looks both delicious and beautiful.
If you don't want to be elaborate with the square shape, you can simply roll the cake up and enjoy.
Notes for delicious durian crepes
If you don't like too many eggs, you can whisk the durian flesh separately with just 1 egg; the cake will have a stronger durian flavor.
You can replace pandan powder with matcha powder if you prefer a green tea flavor.
How to choose good durian:

You should choose fruits with even segments (the grooves are long and nearly equal in size). Do not choose distorted fruits; instead, choose those that are plump and even all around. Buy fruits that have a slight crack and a strong aroma.
+ Check if the stem is still fresh or withered. Choose fruits with hard green stems, a strong and lasting sweet aroma, and characteristic color.
+ Durian spikes: Should be large, even, less sharp, and firm. Squeeze two adjacent spikes together. If the fruit is mature, the spikes will be hard. If young, the spikes will be soft.
+ Observe how the seller opens the fruit: Mature and ripe durian will have 5 natural seams that separate easily. If the seller has to struggle to open it, the fruit is still young.

With just a little time in the kitchen and easy-to-find ingredients, this simple durian crepe recipe yields a delicious treat with eye-catching colors, moderate sweetness, and a characteristic durian aroma that feels wonderful to eat. Everyone will be delighted with this fragrant cake!

mon_an.mo_ta: Pineapple cake with its eye-catching colors is soft, crumbly, and has a certain moisture. The filling of characteristic fragrant pineapple jam along with a smooth, fresh crust will be a wonderful dessert for your family after a gathering meal!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, peel the pineapples and remove all the eyes. Then, wash the pineapples and cut them into small pieces.
Next, put the chopped pineapples into a blender with a little filtered water and blend until smooth.
Step 2:
Next, put the entire pineapple mixture into a pot and cook with sugar and cinnamon until the mixture thickens into a jam.
Let the jam cool, then put it into a piping bag as shown. If you don't have one, you can make a funnel out of cellophane and cut a small hole at the tip.
Step 3: Making the dough

First, put the butter and sugar into a mixer and beat until smooth. Then, add the egg yolks and continue beating. Next, add the fresh milk, flour, and cornstarch and mix well. Mix the mixture thoroughly so the ingredients combine into a soft, smooth dough that is not lumpy, mushy, or too dry.
Step 4:
After kneading the dough, place it in a plastic bag and roll it out to a thickness of about 0.5 cm.
Step 5:
Once the dough is rolled out, open the plastic bag and pipe a line of pineapple jam along one edge of the dough.
Then gently roll it up, remove the plastic, and cut into even sections about 5-8 cm long.
Step 6:
Next, mix 2 egg yolks and condensed milk in a bowl, whisking quickly and thoroughly to combine.

Brush this mixture over the surface of the cakes so they turn an attractive golden color when baked. Finally, bake the cakes at 180°C (preheated) for 15-20 minutes or until the cakes are done and have a golden-brown color.
When the cakes are done, remove them from the oven, arrange them on a plate, and enjoy.
Notes for delicious pineapple cakes

Before mixing the dough, you should sift the flour once to make it smooth. When mixing, add the flour gradually to avoid lumps. Remember to mix thoroughly so the dough is soft and smooth, which makes the cake fluffier when baked.
If you are hesitant to peel pineapples, you can buy pre-peeled ones.
To enhance the flavor, you can add 2 tubes of vanilla when mixing the dough to make the cakes more fragrant.
How to choose good pineapples:

Color: The stem area indicates the sweetness. If the pineapple is bright yellow from the stem to the base or has a few green spots, it is ripe and sweet. The more even the yellow color, the sweeter it is.
If the pineapple is uneven in color and has dark brown, bronze, or reddish-yellow spots, it is overripe.
Avoid green pineapples, as they are unripe and will not ripen after purchase.
Shape: Short, rounded pineapples have more flesh than long, cylindrical ones.
Pineapple eyes: Choose fruits with large and sparse eyes so that after peeling, you have a thick layer of flesh.

Aroma: To check freshness and ripeness, smell the base of the fruit. Choose those with a sweet, fresh scent. Little to no scent means it's unripe. Overripe pineapples will smell slightly sour like fermentation or vinegar, or overly sweet.

Touch: Overripe pineapples will be soft, which you can feel by hand. The skin of overripe fruit is often wrinkled. Fresh, perfectly ripe pineapples will be neither too hard nor too soft; pressing the skin will not leave a dent. Mold, leaking juice, or cracks are signs of spoilage.
Crown: A fresh green crown is preferred. Overripe pineapples often have dry, brown crowns with falling leaves.

mon_an.mo_ta: Matcha caramel flan with its unique preparation and flavor will surely be very interesting. When the cake is done, you will notice a fragrant aroma that is very pleasant and refreshing due to the matcha.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare ingredients for matcha caramel flan.
Crack the eggs into a large bowl.
Put the caramel candies into a pot and add a tiny bit of water.
Place the pot on the stove over very low heat and melt the candies completely. Once melted, pour the caramel into each prepared jar.
Step 2: Steps to make matcha caramel flan.
In the bowl with the eggs, add the white granulated sugar and whisk vigorously until the sugar is completely dissolved.
Then, add the matcha powder, fresh milk, and heavy cream and whisk together.
Whisk the mixture for a while so all ingredients are dissolved, creating a slightly liquid, smooth mixture.
Next, pour the matcha mixture into each jar, but be careful not to fill them too full.
Take a deep baking pan, pour in some warm water, then arrange the jars of cake mixture inside.
Once prepared, place the baking pan in the oven to bake the flan in a water bath. Bake for about 60 minutes at 150°C.
When the flan is done, let it cool slightly, then place it in the refrigerator for about 1 hour before serving.
When eating, you can add a little cream or a sprinkle of matcha powder on top to make the flan more attractive.
Notes for delicious matcha caramel flan
Besides the caramel method above, you can make a simpler caramel by melting sugar with a bit of water until it turns an amber color, then turn off the heat.
When baking in a water bath, ensure the water level reaches 1/3 of the height of the cake molds.

For those who do not have glass jars, you can make the flan in one large mold. In that case, wrap the sides and bottom of the mold with aluminum foil before placing it in the water tray. Once baked, remove the mold from the water tray immediately to prevent the cake from steaming and becoming mushy.
Baking matcha caramel flan (and flans in general) in a water bath allows the cake to cook gently, preventing the surface from cracking and the bottom from burning.

Matcha caramel flan with its unique preparation and flavor will surely be very interesting. When the cake is done, you will notice a fragrant aroma that is very pleasant and refreshing due to the matcha. Japanese matcha powder is always trusted for its wonderful benefits, such as helping us sleep better and improving skin and physique.
Just spend a little time in the kitchen with familiar, easy-to-find ingredients, and you will have a wonderful dessert to treat your family, friends, and loved ones!

mon_an.mo_ta: When finished, Hotteok will have a crispy outer shell with a cinnamon aroma, while the filling is crunchy and nutty from various seeds and nuts, with the sweetness of brown sugar—all blending harmoniously to create the unique Hotteok brand that no other cake has. Just spend a little time in the kitchen and you will have a wonderful treat for your family, friends, and loved ones!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Mixed nuts - chestnuts, peanuts, almonds, walnuts
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare ingredients for Hotteok
Toast the black sesame seeds until fragrant.
For the nuts: peel the chestnuts, peanuts, almonds, and walnuts, then crush or grind them into medium-small pieces.
Warm the fresh milk and let it cool until it is lukewarm.
Step 2: Steps to make Hotteok.
First, proof the dough as follows: in a large bowl, combine the flour, glutinous rice flour, 2 teaspoons of sugar, 1 teaspoon of salt, yeast, and the toasted sesame seeds. Mix everything well.

Next, add the warm milk and 1 teaspoon of cooking oil. Stir the dough until it is pliable and the ingredients are well combined. Cover the bowl tightly with plastic wrap and let the dough proof for 30 minutes.
After 30 minutes, the dough will have risen. Use a spoon or your hand to press the dough down to deflate it, then let it proof for another 10-15 minutes.
While waiting for the dough, prepare the filling:

Mix the following ingredients: 1 teaspoon of cinnamon powder, the crushed nuts, and brown sugar. Add just a tiny bit of water so the filling binds together. Use a spoon to mix well. (Note: the filling should not be mushy, just slightly bound so it is easier to handle when shaping the cakes).
When the dough has risen evenly, start making the cakes. Rub a little cooking oil or dry flour on your hands or plastic gloves to prevent sticking.
Take a small portion of dough, flatten it into a large disc, scoop some filling into the center, and then pinch it closed into a ball.
Repeat this process until all the dough is used.
After shaping the cakes, place a pan on the stove and heat some cooking oil.
Drop the cakes into the pan, use a large spatula to slowly press them down to flatten them; be careful not to press too hard or the filling might burst out.
Fry the cakes until both sides are golden brown, then remove them and drain on paper towels to remove excess oil.
Finally, arrange the cakes on a plate and enjoy.
Notes for making Hotteok
If you cannot buy glutinous rice flour, you can make your own by soaking glutinous rice for 2-3 hours and then grinding it.
The types of nuts used here are not fixed; you can substitute them as desired, such as adding cashews, which is also very delicious.
You can use butter to fry the cakes to make them much more fragrant and tasty.

When finished, Hotteok will have a crispy outer shell with a cinnamon aroma, while the filling is crunchy and nutty from various seeds and nuts, with the sweetness of brown sugar—all blending harmoniously to create the unique Hotteok brand that no other cake has. Just spend a little time in the kitchen and you will have a wonderful treat for your family, friends, and loved ones!

mon_an.mo_ta: Strawberry cream cake not only has an eye-catching appearance but also a very delicious flavor. Each layer of cool, rich, and fresh cream will make you fall in love when you taste it, especially in this autumn weather!
cac_buoc: How to make Frozen Strawberry Cream Cake
Step 1:

First, crush the Granola bars into crumbs and divide into 2 parts. Set aside half to sprinkle on top. You can put the Granola bars in a bag, remove all the air, tie it tightly, and use a mallet to crush them.
Step 2:
Next, in a bowl, mix the flour, brown sugar, and melted butter until the ingredients are dissolved and well combined.
Then, spread the mixture into a 20cm x 20cm baking tray and cover with parchment paper.
Step 3:
Once prepared, bake the crust in the oven at 177°C for 10 minutes, then remove and let it cool.
Step 4:
Next, put the egg whites and sugar in a bowl and mix well. Add the heavy cream and continue mixing for about 5 minutes until uniform.
Step 5:
In another bowl, mix the lemon juice and softened cream cheese. Beat at low speed, then slowly add the cream mixture.
Then, fold the strawberries into the cream mixture.
Step 6:
Next, sprinkle 1/2 of the Granola crumbs onto the bottom of the cake tray, then pour the strawberry cream mixture on top.
Then, sprinkle the remaining crumbs over the top.
Step 7:
Once prepared, cover the cake and place it in the freezer for at least 3 hours, then serve while still frozen.
Notes for a wonderful frozen strawberry cream cake
After a delicious meal, enjoying a piece of frozen strawberry cream cake is an ideal, refreshing, and pleasant dessert.
Frozen fresh strawberries help the cake stay crisp and provide a gentle, cool sweetness.
You can make a larger batch to store in the freezer for later use.
Cut the cake before it is completely frozen solid.
How to choose good strawberries:
Strawberries do not continue to ripen after being picked, so avoid those with white spots or green color. Choose red ones. Avoid bruised, moldy, or mushy berries.

Fresh, juicy strawberries have shiny skin, even color, a mild aroma, intact stems, green caps, and are usually heart-shaped. Avoid wet berries as sellers might have sprayed them with water to keep them from wilting.
If buying boxed strawberries, avoid boxes with stains on the bottom or moisture inside.
How to store strawberries:
Wash the strawberries and drain them well; do not remove the stems as bacteria can easily enter.
Separate bruised berries from intact ones because mold can easily spread between them.
Do not store strawberries at room temperature or under direct sunlight as they will spoil quickly; put them in a plastic bag or plastic container and they can keep for 3-4 days.

mon_an.mo_ta: Cat tongue cookies with their fun shape have a beautiful golden color and a gentle aroma. When eaten, they melt in your mouth with a crispiness that is very enjoyable. You can make cat tongue cookies as a snack or prepare them for the upcoming Lunar New Year. These lovely cookies will be a wonderful gift for your family!
cac_buoc: How to make cat tongue cookies 1
Prepare ingredients for cat tongue cookies:
Prepare necessary tools: oven, baking tray, electric mixer, parchment paper, piping bag with a nozzle (1cm diameter).
Before making the cookies, sift the flour until very fine and set aside in a bowl to reduce clumping when mixing the batter.
Steps to make wonderful cat tongue cookies
Step 1: Preheat the oven to 180°C so it is evenly heated before baking.

Step 2: Put the butter and salt in a bowl, use an electric mixer to beat until the butter is smooth and creamy. If you don't have a mixer, you can melt the butter and then stir in the salt until completely dissolved.
Step 3: Then add the sugar and continue beating until the mixture is well combined and smooth. The sugar, salt, and butter should be evenly dissolved together.

Step 4: Next, take the bowl of egg whites and slowly pour them into the mixture while stirring well. Continue mixing until the mixture is even in color, soft, smooth, and uniform. At this point, you should use an electric mixer to beat the mixture until it is soft, smooth, and holds stiff peaks. If you don't have a mixer, whisk by hand until you get a firm, cream-like consistency.

Step 5: Then, gradually add the sifted flour while mixing with your other hand. Stir until the mixture is well combined. The mixture should be uniform, smooth, lump-free, soft, and tacky without sticking to the bowl.
Step 6: To enhance the flavor, add vanilla to the mixture and stir for a while longer so the vanilla is evenly distributed.

Step 7: Once the batter is finished, put it into a piping bag and attach the nozzle. Line the baking tray with parchment paper, then pipe the batter into strips about 5cm long, spaced about 3cm apart.

Step 8: After shaping, place the cookies in the oven at 180°C. Each batch takes about 10-12 minutes to bake. The cookies will be golden all over and slightly brown around the edges. Remove them and put in the next batch until the batter is finished. Remember to keep an eye on the cookies while baking. When you see a beautiful golden-brown color, remove the batch immediately to avoid burning or making them too hard.
Notes for wonderful cat tongue cookies
When first taken out of the oven, the cookies will still be soft; you just need to wait until they cool down to harden. At that point, you can store them in a box or bag to enjoy gradually.
If not stored properly and they become soft, put the cookies back in the oven for about 5 minutes at 110°C; they will harden again and can be stored longer.

Cat tongue cookies with their fun shape have a beautiful golden color and a gentle aroma. When eaten, they melt in your mouth with a crispiness that is very enjoyable. You can make cat tongue cookies as a snack or prepare them for the upcoming Lunar New Year. These lovely cookies will be a wonderful gift for your family!

mon_an.ten: Vietnamese Grilled Bread with Chili Salt
cac_buoc: Bánh mì nướng muối ớt is a popular snack in Vietnam, especially loved by young people. With its unique blend of crispy bread, spicy chili salt sauce, and diverse toppings, this dish offers a distinctive and appealing flavor. In this article, we will share a simple and delicious way to make Bánh mì nướng muối ớt so you can prepare it right at home.
I. How to make Bánh mì nướng muối ớt using a pan
1. Ingredients
Bread: 4 baguettes
Pork floss: 4 tbsp
Pork sausages: 4
Shrimp floss: 4 tbsp
Butter: 100g
Horn chili: 1
Scallions: 50g
Quail eggs: 8
Dried shrimp: 30g
Beef sausages: 4
Mayonnaise
Shrimp satay: 2 tbsp
Chili sauce: 4 tbsp
Scallions
Sugar: 2 tsp
Minced garlic: 1 tsp
2. Instructions
2.1. Chili Salt Sauce Recipe
Soak the dried shrimp in water, then grind or pound them finely.

Melt the butter in a pan and sauté the minced garlic until fragrant. Add the dried shrimp and cook through, then add chili sauce, shrimp satay, salt, sugar, and filtered water. Stir well until the sauce thickens, then turn off the heat.
How to Make Scallion Oil:
Wash and finely chop the scallions. Melt the butter, add the scallions and stir evenly. Turn off the heat and pour the scallion oil into a bowl.
2.2. Grilling Bánh Mì over Charcoal
Flatten the bread to about 1cm thickness.
Prepare a charcoal grill with glowing red coals. Place the grill rack on to heat up, then place the bread on top. Brush with butter and the chili salt sauce.
Grill both sides until golden brown and slightly charred.
Once golden, brush more chili salt sauce and scallion oil onto the bread. Enjoy the fragrant, crispy bread straight from the charcoal grill.

Use scissors to cut the grilled bread into bite-sized pieces and arrange them on a plate. Next, garnish the bread with toppings such as pork sausage, beef sausage, pork floss, quail eggs, and shrimp floss. To enjoy, dip the bread into mayonnaise and chili sauce to enhance the flavor.
II. Instructions for the pan-fried method
Bread: 100g (equivalent to about 4 baguettes)
Sausage: 50g (sliced)
Quail eggs: 2 (peeled)
Dried baby shrimp: a little
Pork floss: a little
Butter: 1 tub (such as Tuong An butter)
Chopped scallions: 1 bowl
Shrimp satay: 1 tbsp
Cooking oil: 1/2 cup
Chili powder: 1 tsp
Mayonnaise: a little
Sugar/Salt: a little
2. Steps to follow
2.1. Marinating and Grilling the Bread
Marinating the Bread:
Start by heating 1/2 cup of cooking oil in a pan. When the oil is hot, add the scallions, stir for 1 minute, then turn off the heat and let it cool.
Brush the sauce mixture onto the bread. In a bowl, mix 1 tsp salt, 2 tsp sugar, 1 tsp chili powder, and 1 tbsp shrimp satay until well combined.
Making the Grilled Bread:
Place a grill rack on an infrared stove, select the grill mode and set to low heat. Place the bread on the rack, grill and brush with butter and the chili salt mixture on both sides.
Grilling time may vary depending on the stove's power, usually 5–7 minutes is enough.
When the bread is crispy:

Cut the bread into small pieces and arrange on a plate. Next, add the scallion oil, pork floss, sausage, quail eggs, and dried baby shrimp on top. Finally, drizzle with mayonnaise and chili sauce to make the bread attractive and ready to enjoy.
2.2. Finished Product

The bread after grilling becomes a perfect culinary creation. With the spicy chili salt flavor and crispy crust, the bread emits a rich aroma of butter, harmoniously combined with the heat of shrimp satay and the savory touch of the chili salt mixture.

The deliciousness of Bánh mì nướng muối ớt is elevated by the harmonious combination of scallion oil, quail eggs, pork floss, and creamy mayonnaise. Each bite is not only fragrant but also brings more delight to the diner.
III. How to make Bánh mì nướng muối ớt using an oven
Bread: 1 baguette
Sausage: 1
Pork floss: a little (pork or chicken)
Satay: 1 tsp
Chili salt: 1 tsp
Chili sauce: a little
Ketchup: a little
Sugar: 1/2 tsp
2.1. Prepare Ingredients
Once you have the bread, use a rolling pin to flatten it. It is important to be careful and even-handed when rolling so the bread becomes crispier and tastier after baking.
Tip: If you don't have a rolling pin, you can use a glass bottle instead.
2.2. Baking the Bread
First, mix 1 tsp satay, 1/2 tsp sugar, and 1 tsp chili salt; stir well until the mixture is combined. Then, use an oil brush to spread the satay mixture over the surface of the bread.
Turn on the oven at 100°C for 5 minutes to preheat, then place the bread and sausage in the oven and bake for about 10 minutes until the bread becomes crispy and fragrant.
After baking, place the bread on a plate and sprinkle some pork floss on the surface.
Next, cut the sausage into bite-sized pieces and arrange them on the bread. Drizzle with a little chili sauce, ketchup, and mayonnaise to create a special flavor when enjoying.
2.3. Description of Bánh Mì Nướng Muối Ớt

The bread after baking is a perfect culinary work. Crispy, hot, and fragrant, the combination of the salty-spicy chili salt, savory pork floss, and sausage creates a special flavor. The blend of chili sauce, ketchup, and creamy mayonnaise further enhances the delicious taste of the dish.
This dish is also great when served with cucumber and tomato, which helps reduce the richness and creates a harmonious balance in flavor, making the dish tastier and easier to digest.
IV. How to choose quality ingredients
1. How to choose quality pork floss

Pork floss is a food item easily faked, with 70% of ingredients sometimes coming from cassava residue and only 30% from meat of unknown origin. Additionally, many harmful chemicals are used to fake this product and deceive consumers.
When choosing pork floss, observing the color is an important factor. Choose floss that is light yellow and emits the natural aroma of roasted meat.

Additionally, you should choose pork floss that is fluffy like cotton, with small fibers that do not clump together. Avoid buying floss that is too dark yellow, has a bland or strange taste, lacks aroma, or is not fluffy, as it may be fake and could affect your health.
2. Secrets to choosing delicious satay
Satay is a common food additive made from chili powder or fresh chilies, cooking oil, and sometimes lemongrass, star anise, or cinnamon to create a characteristic and delicious flavor.

mon_an.ten: Soft Passion Fruit Glutinous Rice Cakes
mon_an.mo_ta: Passion fruit glutinous rice cakes have a beautiful color and a refreshing aroma. When enjoyed, the cakes are soft with a moderate sweetness that will make your family gathering even more special. Everyone will enjoy these passion fruit cakes and praise their deliciousness.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Tools - passion fruit strainer, rectangular cake mold
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients for the passion fruit glutinous rice cakes.
After buying the passion fruit, cut them in half and scoop out the pulp inside.
Then, put the passion fruit pulp into a mesh strainer to extract the juice and remove the seeds.
Next, mix the glutinous rice flour with the white granulated sugar.
Then, place a pan on the stove and add the butter to melt it.
Step 2: Steps to make the passion fruit glutinous rice cakes.
First, pour the passion fruit juice into the bowl of glutinous rice flour.
Then, mix the flour thoroughly until you obtain a very smooth, soft, and fine passion fruit dough mixture.
Next, brush a layer of butter all over the mold, then pour the batter into the mold. Note not to fill it too full so that when the cake rises during baking, it fits perfectly.
Then, place the mold into a preheated oven and bake at 180°C for 1 hour.
When the cake is done, let it cool naturally in the mold.
Then, remove the cake from the mold and cut it into long strips about 3cm - 5cm wide.
Continue cutting those strips into small square pieces.
Finally, roll each piece in the toasted glutinous rice flour, then arrange the cakes on a plate and enjoy.
Notes for perfect passion fruit glutinous rice cakes
Toasted glutinous rice flour is a type of flour specifically for making sticky rice cakes (bánh dẻo). If you cannot buy this type, you can toast the flour yourself.
Rolling the cakes in flour prevents them from sticking; furthermore, the toasted flour is very fragrant, which enhances the flavor of the cakes.
Besides the passion fruit flavor, you can create many other flavors to make the plate of cakes more colorful.

When baking, pay attention to adjusting the temperature and time to suit your family's oven. To check if the cake is done, insert a toothpick into the cake; if the batter no longer sticks to the toothpick, the cake is cooked.

If you like chewing passion fruit seeds as when eating fresh passion fruit, set aside a few seeds before straining the juice and mix them into the flour; it will be very interesting to eat when the cake is done.
Besides toasted glutinous rice flour, you can also roll the cakes in powdered sugar or shredded coconut, both of which are very delicious.

Passion fruit glutinous rice cakes, with two main ingredients being glutinous rice flour and passion fruit, are very simple yet create an extremely attractive flavor. These cakes have a beautiful color and a refreshing aroma; their softness and moderate sweetness will make your family gathering more special. Everyone will happily enjoy the passion fruit glutinous rice cakes and praise them.

mon_an.mo_ta: This chocolate cake appeals to diners from its appearance to its flavor, with a coconut coating on the outside and a chocolate layer creating a harmonious whole. Enjoying a piece of cake, you will feel the fluffiness and fresh softness of the crumb, the moderately sweet chocolate, and the rich, fragrant aroma of desiccated coconut. This delicious treat will make everyone admire your cooking skills!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, sift the all-purpose flour and cornstarch together until very fine.
Next, combine the butter and boiling water and let the butter melt completely. Remember to stir well so the butter melts quickly and blends with the water.
Step 2:

Then, put the eggs in a bowl and use a hand mixer to beat for about 4 minutes, until the eggs turn pale and become fluffy and airy. You can check by dropping a bit of the mixture into water; if it doesn't dissolve, it's ready.
Step 3:
Next, gradually add the granulated sugar while beating, and continue beating for about 8 more minutes until the eggs have doubled in volume.
Step 4:

Then, sift a little of the flour mixture from Step 1 into the beaten egg mixture. Use a spatula to fold gently so the eggs don't lose their fluffiness. Gradually sift all the flour into the bowl with the eggs.
Step 5:
Next, fold in the melted butter as well! Mix the mixture well so the ingredients are evenly combined and there are no lumps.
Step 6:
Before baking, line a long baking tray with parchment paper and preheat the oven to 180°C.

Then, pour the batter into the tray and bake in the oven for about 20-25 minutes or until the cake has a golden-brown crust. You can also test with a toothpick; if it comes out clean, the cake is done. When finished baking, take the cake out and let it rest in the tray for about 4 minutes, then gently remove the cake from the tray and let it cool slightly.
Step 7:
Next, cut the cake into equal square pieces.
Step 8:

To make the decorative icing, combine the butter and boiling water and let the butter melt completely. Once the butter has melted, add the cocoa powder and stir until there are no lumps and the mixture is smooth and well-blended.
Then, add the fresh milk and powdered sugar and mix well until the mixture is very smooth.
To prepare the coating, have the bowl of melted chocolate ready and put the desiccated coconut on a plate. Also, prepare a clean towel for easy wiping.
Dip the cake into a layer of chocolate. Note to only dip long enough for the chocolate to coat the cake; do not leave it in too long.
Step 9:
Next, coat all sides of the cake piece with a layer of desiccated coconut. Repeat with the remaining cake pieces until finished.
Finally, arrange the cakes on a plate and enjoy.
Notes for perfect chocolate cake
When creating the mixtures, remember to mix very well so the ingredients blend together.
Depending on your preference for sweetness, you can choose dark chocolate or milk chocolate.
If you like it cold, after the cake is fully prepared, you can put it in the refrigerator for 30 minutes before serving.

mon_an.mo_ta: Baked coconut milk mooncakes have a beautiful glossy golden-brown crust. When enjoyed, the crust is soft and carries a characteristic aroma that blends with the nutty, rich coconut milk filling. The moderate sweetness brings a wonderful sensation when tasting.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Make the crust

First, put 200g of baked mooncake syrup into a bowl, add 50g of oil, 2 tsp of Mai Que Lo liqueur, 1 tsp of peanut butter, 1 egg yolk, and 1/4 tsp of baking soda, then mix well until the ingredients are combined.
Next, sift the all-purpose flour and add it to the syrup bowl. Mix well until the dough is smooth and soft, then let the dough rest for 30 - 45 minutes.
