Then, divide the dough into equal portions according to the ratio of 2 parts filling to 1 part crust.
Step 2: Make the filling
Finely grate the coconut. Then, blanch the shredded coconut in boiling water and drain well. Next, marinate the coconut with condensed milk, adjusting the sweetness to your taste.
Marinate for a few hours, then place on the stove to simmer over low heat.

First, pour a little coconut milk into a pan, bring to a boil, then add the marinated coconut mixture and stir well. When the coconut looks translucent and sticks to the spatula, add the prepared glutinous rice flour water. Continue stirring evenly until the coconut filling is flexible and fragrant. Then, add toasted white sesame seeds and stir well to combine. Once the coconut filling has cooled, use gloves to shape the filling into small, equal balls according to the 2:1 ratio.
Finally, flatten the dough, place the filling in the center, and roll into a ball. Place into a mold, press and push firmly to create a sharp shape for the cake.
Step 3: Bake the cakes
First, preheat the oven for about 10 minutes at 180°C before baking.

Then, place the cakes on a baking tray lined with parchment paper and bake for the first time for 10 minutes. Remove the cakes, spray with water, let cool, then brush the surface with a mixture of egg yolk, a little sesame oil, and Mai Que Lo liqueur.
Once the surface is brushed, bake for a second time similar to the first. Finally, bake the cakes one more time in the same manner.
Wait for the cakes to cool completely, then place them in a box and seal tightly.
Notes for delicious baked coconut milk mooncakes
The cakes will develop a very beautiful color and become fragrant and soft 2 to 3 days after baking.
How to mix the egg wash for the crust:

The truth is many cakes look beautiful until they are brushed... then they are ruined. Incorrect brushing can easily lead to losing the cake's pattern or creating bubbles on the surface. Additionally, wrong brushing makes the surface wet and shortens shelf life as it molds easily. Conversely, a proper egg wash helps the cake achieve a glossy golden-brown color. The surface will be dry but still shiny without losing the pattern. The formula you should use is: 1 egg yolk + ½ egg white + 3 drops of sesame oil + 3 drops of dark soy sauce + ½ tsp water + ½ tsp mooncake syrup. Note: since the formula contains egg, it must be strained through a fine-mesh sieve to remove all residue!

mon_an.mo_ta: When finished, these wafers have an eye-catching color and a gentle aroma. They are crispy with a moderate sweetness that isn't overwhelming. Just spend a little time in the kitchen and you'll have a wonderful treat to serve family and friends, earning you many compliments.
cac_buoc: How to make attractive crispy wafers

Step 1: First, crack the eggs and separate the yolks and whites into two separate bowls. In the bowl with the whites, add a little sugar and beat until the sugar is completely dissolved. Remember to dissolve all the sugar so the cakes are evenly sweet and delicious.
Next, melt the unsalted butter into liquid form and pour it into the egg white mixture. Continue beating until well combined.

Step 2: Then, sift the cake flour to remove lumps and residue, which makes the batter smoother and the cakes better. After sifting, add the flour to the egg white, sugar, and butter mixture and beat well. You can use a hand mixer to beat the mixture until fluffy. Remember to beat evenly so the flour and ingredients blend together into a soft, smooth, and elastic batter.
Once the batter is ready, pour it onto a baking tray.
Step 3: Preheat the oven to 180°C and bake the cakes for 5 minutes.
Next, while the cake is still hot and soft, quickly use a chopstick to roll the cake into a tube shape. Roll gently to avoid breaking the cake.
When finished, arrange the cakes on a plate and enjoy.
Notes for delicious, crispy wafers
When beating the egg whites, remember to beat evenly until the sugar is completely dissolved.
The flour mixture should be mixed thoroughly and finely so that the finished cakes are soft, smooth, and have a certain crispness.
To enhance the flavor of the cakes, you can add a little vanilla before baking.
If you want the cakes to have attractive colors, you can add fruit syrups of your choice.
If you don't have an oven, you can use a pan following these steps:
Place a pan on the stove. When the pan is dry, add a little oil to heat it up, then wipe the pan dry.
Then, take a spoonful of batter and pour it slowly into the center of the pan from above.
Remember to keep the heat at the lowest setting so the cake cooks without burning.
When the cake is just cooked, use chopsticks to roll it up.
Process the rest of the batter in the same way.
When finished, let the cakes cool and store them in a jar to eat gradually.

When finished, the wafers have an eye-catching color and a gentle aroma. They are crispy with a moderate sweetness that isn't overwhelming. Just spend a little time in the kitchen and you'll have a wonderful treat to serve family and friends. This cake is also very suitable for a Tet holiday candy tray. Guests will be surprised to know you made these delicious cakes yourself!

mon_an.mo_ta: Breadsticks with eye-catching colors, a delicious aroma, and a crispy texture are the perfect snack to start your day of work or play! In today's article, we will guide you through the process of making these crispy and fragrant breadsticks. Please follow along!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients for the breadsticks.
Sift the flour until smooth.
Place the butter in a bowl and mash until softened.
Next, activate the yeast. Pour warm water into a bowl, then add the dry yeast and sugar, stirring until dissolved.
Let it sit for about 5 minutes or until the yeast mixture becomes foamy.
Step 2: Cooking steps for the breadsticks.
First, prepare the flour in a bowl and mix in the salt.
Add the softened butter to the flour bowl and stir well with a spoon.

Next, pour the yeast and sugar mixture into the flour bowl. If you do not have a dough mixer, stir with a spoon and then knead thoroughly by hand. Knead the dough until it forms a smooth, uniform ball that does not stick to your hands.
Cover the bowl tightly with plastic wrap. Proof the dough for about 1 hour or until it has doubled in size.
Next, transfer the dough to a work surface and cut it.
Divide the dough ball in half, then continue cutting into smaller wedges like a cake; divide the dough into 12 small portions as shown in the image.
Take one portion of dough and shape it into a long, slender stick.
Repeat this process for the remaining portions of dough.
Line a baking tray with parchment paper and arrange the dough sticks on the tray.
Cover the dough with a thick plastic sheet or a clean cloth. Continue proofing until the sticks have doubled in size.
While waiting for the dough to rise, preheat the oven to 400°F or 205°C.
Once the dough is ready, remove the cover and place the tray in the oven. Bake for about 12 minutes.
Once baked, remove the breadsticks from the oven, brush each one with a layer of melted unsalted butter, and sprinkle evenly with garlic salt.
Finally, serve and enjoy.
Notes for perfect breadsticks:
When shaping the sticks, do not make them too long; keep them around 10-15cm. If they are too long, they may break and look unappealing.
To ensure the bread is delicious, knead the dough thoroughly; this incorporates more air and helps the yeast activate better.
When activating the yeast, only use warm water—do not use cold or hot water. Hot water will kill the yeast, while cold water will prevent it from activating properly.
If you do not like garlic salt, you can substitute it with powdered sugar.
When baking, be flexible in adjusting the temperature and time to suit your home oven. Simply monitor the bread; once it turns a light golden brown, you can remove it from the oven.

mon_an.mo_ta: Enjoy these eye-catching swan butter cookies with a pleasant aroma and a soft, moist texture. Not too sweet, they provide a delightful treat for anyone! Learn how to make these swan butter cookies through the instructions below.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Knead and proof the dough using the following butter cookie recipe:
First, combine the flour and sugar in a bowl and mix well until the ingredients are blended.

Crack the egg into the bowl and mix again. Continue by adding the butter and mixing it into the flour and sugar mixture. You should use plastic gloves to knead the dough until it is very smooth. The smoother and more pliable the dough, the better your butter cookies will be! Remember to mix evenly to obtain a soft, smooth mixture where all ingredients are fully incorporated.
Next, roll the dough out to a thickness of 0.3cm – 0.5cm.
Use a round glass with a diameter of about 5cm – 7cm to cut the dough into circles.

Step 2: Each round piece of dough will form one cute little swan cookie. Fold the dough circle in half and cut a long line parallel to the fold, about 0.7cm away. Make two shorter diagonal slits below it, moving from left to right.
Step 3: Roll the top strip slightly to round the edges and curve it into a swan head shape, pinching the tip to make it pointed. Smooth the swan's chest and curve the wing slits upward naturally.
Step 4: Repeat the process with the remaining dough circles. Add a sesame seed for the swan's eye and sprinkle some white sugar on the wings to complete the shaping.
Step 5: Preheat the oven to 180°C for 15 minutes. Once the swans are shaped, place the cookies on a tray and bake for about 10–12 minutes until done.
Once baked, remove the tray from the oven, let the cookies cool completely, and then enjoy.
Notes for delicious swan butter cookies:
Instead of regular all-purpose flour, you can use cake flour or flours with 8% – 11% protein to increase the softness of the cookies.
Using Anchor butter will make the cookies more fragrant.
Depending on personal preference, you can customize the swan cookies with different flavors such as cocoa or matcha.

With just a little time in the kitchen and easy-to-find ingredients, this simple method yields beautiful and delicious swan cookies to treat your family and friends. Everyone will be full of praise because the cookies are visually appealing, easy to eat, fragrant, soft, and not too sweet, so they won't feel too heavy.

Don't hesitate any longer—get in the kitchen and make these adorable cookies right away. They are perfect for snacking in this cold winter weather, and who knows, everyone might even ask you for the recipe!

mon_an.mo_ta: These delicious cream cookies feature a crispy, beautiful golden-brown shell paired with a cool, fresh cream filling. The cookie melts into the cream in your mouth, providing a wonderful sensation. Take a little time in the kitchen to make these treats for your family. Everyone will love these tasty cookies, especially the children! This guide provides the recipe and important notes to create these attractive and delicious cream-filled cookies.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, cut the butter into small pieces and place them in a mixer (a blender or hand mixer also works) along with the cake flour, then mix well until the butter and flour are fully incorporated.
Once the mixture is uniform, transfer it to a small bowl and sift the powdered sugar and cocoa powder directly into the bowl.
Step 2:

Next, crack the eggs into a bowl, taking 2 yolks and 1 white, add the honey, and stir until the honey is completely dissolved. Then, pour the egg mixture into the flour bowl and knead thoroughly by hand. Remember to knead carefully so all ingredients are well combined.
Step 3:
Once the dough is kneaded, wrap it in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. This resting period allows the dough to settle and rise slightly.
After the time is up, remove the dough from the refrigerator, roll it out to a thickness of about 0.5cm, and use a mold to cut 24 pieces with a diameter of 8 cm.
Place the cookies on a baking tray lined with parchment paper and put them in a preheated oven. Bake at 180°C for about 18-20 minutes or until the cookies are cooked and have a golden-brown crust.
Step 4:

Next, pour the milk into a pot, add the sugar and vanilla powder or seeds, set to low heat, and cook until the mixture reaches 85°C or until small bubbles appear. Do not boil the milk, as this will destroy its nutrients and make the dish less delicious.
Once the bubbles appear, immediately pour the mixture into a bowl and place it over a large bowl of ice. Stir well to cool the mixture down, which also makes the cream smoother and tastier.

Once the mixture is cool, put it in an ice cream maker for 30 minutes. If you don't have a machine, put it in a sealed plastic container in the freezer; every 30 minutes, take it out and use a fork to fluff it up to prevent ice crystals from forming. Repeat this until the ice cream is set.
Step 5:
Next, take a mold, place one cookie inside, scoop 2 spoons of ice cream on top, and place another cookie on the very top.
Continue this process until all ingredients are used to make 12 sandwiches. Then, place all the cookies in the refrigerator for another 30 minutes to finish.
Finally, arrange the cookies on a plate and enjoy.

These delicious cookies with a crispy golden-brown shell and cool fresh cream filling will melt in your mouth, providing a wonderful sensation. Spend some time in the kitchen to make this treat for your family. Everyone will love these tasty cookies, especially the kids!
Notes for making cream-filled cookies
When making delicious cream cookies, there are several important notes to achieve great results:
Choose quality ingredients: Use fresh butter, granulated white sugar, and fine flour for the best flavor.
Soften the butter: Let the butter soften before mixing, but do not let it get too hot. You can leave it at room temperature for about 30 minutes.
Mix well: When mixing the dough, ensure the ingredients are combined evenly, but avoid overmixing to prevent the cookies from becoming hard.
Chill the dough: After mixing, chill the dough in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour to make it easier to shape and maintain its structure during baking.
Adjust oven temperature: Bake the cookies at the appropriate temperature (usually around 175-180°C) for a short time so they turn light golden and stay crispy.
Cool before serving: Let the cookies cool completely before enjoying them for the best flavor and texture.
By following these notes, you will create delicious, fragrant, and crispy cream cookies to enjoy with family and friends.
Which flour to use for delicious cream cookies
To make delicious cream cookies, you should use a fine, protein-rich flour like all-purpose flour or cake flour. These flours help the cookies have a soft and uniform structure.
All-purpose flour is a popular choice because it has enough protein to provide elasticity without making the cookies hard.
If you want the cookies to have a softer, finer structure, you can use cake flour. Cake flour has a lower protein content, allowing the cookies to rise more and have a softer texture.
Additionally, to increase the flavor and crispiness, you can add a little baking powder to the recipe if you want a fluffier and crispier texture.
Depending on your preference and purpose, you can choose the appropriate flour to make the best cream cookies for yourself.

mon_an.ten: Guide to Making Delicious Soft Cookies
mon_an.mo_ta: Soft cookies attract eaters right from their appearance with a fragrant, crispy crust; when you bite in, you will find an irresistible softness inside. Furthermore, the cookies are even better with crunchy chocolate chips that make you want to eat them forever.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients for the soft cookies.
Place the butter in a bowl and heat it in the microwave until completely melted.
Crack the eggs into a separate bowl.
Chop the dark chocolate into small pieces.
Sift the flour until smooth.
Then, preheat the oven to 375°F, which is approximately 190°C.
Step 2: Steps to make the soft cookies.
First, prepare a medium-sized bowl and add the following ingredients: butter, molasses, eggs, vanilla, and a little water.
Then, use a whisk to mix the ingredients thoroughly. This is the first mixture.
Next, take another bowl and add all the dry ingredients including: white sugar, brown sugar, all-purpose flour, baking powder, and baking soda. Mix well to create the second mixture.
Next, add the first mixture along with
the dark chocolate into the bowl of the second mixture.
Use a whisk to mix the two mixtures thoroughly until you get a very soft, smooth cookie dough without lumps.
Next, spread a thin layer of butter on the baking tray to prevent sticking, then use a spoon to scoop a sufficient amount of dough into your hand, shape it into a ball, and place it on the tray.
Repeat this process until all the dough is used.
Finally, put the tray into the preheated oven and bake for about 8-12 minutes or until the cookies are cooked and have a beautiful golden color.
Once cooked, take the cookies out to cool slightly before enjoying.
Notes for delicious soft cookies
When arranging the cookies on the baking tray, pay attention to spacing them out a bit to give them room to expand as they bake.
Also, be careful not to bake the cookies for too long to avoid losing the desired softness.
For those who do not like very sweet cookies, you can proactively reduce the amount of sugar.
Similarly, for those who do not like them too greasy, instead of greasing the tray with butter or oil, you can use parchment paper.

Soft cookies attract eaters right from their appearance with a fragrant, crispy crust; when you bite in, you will find an irresistible softness inside. Furthermore, the cookies are even better with crunchy chocolate chips that make you want to eat them forever. Just spend a little time in the kitchen and you will have a wonderful treat to serve family, friends, and loved ones. Everyone will be extremely excited about the cookies and you will receive countless compliments!

mon_an.ten: Guide to Making Delicious Strawberry Shortcake
mon_an.mo_ta: When enjoying strawberry shortcake, you will find the cake soft and fragrant with strawberry flavor, served with a bit of cool cream that brings a unique sensation without being cloying. Just spend a little time in the kitchen and you will have a wonderful dessert!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Virgin coconut oil, firm enough to flatten - 5 tbsp
cac_buoc: Steps to make strawberry shortcake:
Put the chia seeds in a grinder and grind until you get a soft, fine powder.

First, mix 3/4 cup of coconut milk with the syrup and vanilla. Then, add the ground chia seeds and use a fork to mix well into a thick mixture. Let it sit for about 20 minutes for the ingredients to meld together.

Next, in a large bowl, mix the arrowroot flour, potato starch, tapioca starch, baking powder, and salt together. Then, add the coconut oil and continue mixing. Add the coconut milk mixture from step 1 and mix all ingredients well. Gently knead the dough a few times until the ingredients are combined into a soft, smooth ball of dough.
Once the mixture is prepared, transfer the dough onto a flat surface sprinkled with a little arrowroot flour. Gently pat the dough down to a thickness of about 1.8cm, then cut into 8 equal circles.

Next, place the biscuits on a baking tray lined with parchment paper and use a brush to coat the tops with a little coconut milk. Then, bake the biscuits until golden, about 12 minutes. When the biscuits are done, remove them from the oven. They should be served while still warm or at least within the same day.
While the biscuits are baking and cooling, prepare the cream and strawberries.
First, place the strawberries in a bowl with the lemon juice and maple syrup, soaking for at least 10 minutes so the strawberries absorb the flavors, become less tart, and have a light sweetness.

Next, take the coconut milk that has been in the refrigerator overnight. Remove the solidified cream from the top and place it in a bowl for hand mixing. The liquid coconut milk at the bottom can be used for smoothies or other dishes.

Then, whisk this coconut cream until soft, which takes about 3 minutes. Mix in the vanilla and maple syrup if desired. This cream can be stored in the refrigerator for about 3 days; before using, you should re-mix it to make the cream fluffy and better.

Finally, assemble the strawberry shortcake: place one biscuit down, top with a layer of cream, a few strawberry slices, another biscuit, and another layer of strawberry cream on top. Now we are ready to enjoy this delicious dish.
Notes for a perfect strawberry shortcake:
When mixing the cake ingredients, you should mix gently and add the flours slowly so the mixture doesn't clump, making the cake softer and giving it a certain fluffiness.
In addition to strawberry flavor, you can substitute with any syrup you like such as orange, pineapple, guava, avocado, or green tea.

When enjoying strawberry shortcake, you will find the cake soft and fragrant with strawberry flavor, served with a bit of cool cream that brings a unique sensation without being cloying. Just spend a little time in the kitchen and you will have a wonderful dessert!

mon_an.mo_ta: These cream puffs feature an attractive golden-brown crust topped with a crunchy chocolate layer. They have a balanced sweetness, a soft and moist pastry shell, and a smooth, lightly sweetened fresh cream filling. On cold winter days, enjoying these cream puffs with a glass of warm milk is a wonderful experience.
cac_buoc: Step 1: First, prepare a small pot and add 200ml water, 1 tsp salt, and 125g butter. Heat at 200°C until the butter melts and the ingredients are well combined.
Step 2: Next, when the water boils, add the flour and stir constantly until the dough becomes thick and smooth, then place it in the refrigerator to cool.

Step 3: Separate the eggs to get only the yolks. Gradually add the 5 egg yolks one by one into the flour mixture. Beat well after each addition before adding the next to ensure the eggs are fully incorporated. Mix thoroughly until the mixture is smooth and soft. Once ready, transfer the mixture into a piping bag.
*Step 4:* Making the cream filling

Prepare a large bowl, whip the whipping cream and sugar until stiff peaks form, then cover with plastic wrap and place in the refrigerator. Remember to whip evenly so the sugar dissolves completely and the mixture becomes light and fluffy.
Step 5: Line a baking tray with baking paper. Pipe the pastry mixture onto the paper as shown in the image, approximately 3cm wide and 15cm long.
Step 6: Once prepared, place the tray in the preheated oven and bake for 25-30 minutes at 200°C.
While the pastry is baking, you can prepare some melted chocolate to dip the tops of the puffs.

Step 7: After baking, remove the puffs from the oven and let them cool for 5-7 minutes before dipping the tops into the melted chocolate. Poke a small hole in the bottom of each puff and pipe the cream filling inside.
Finally, arrange the puffs on a plate and enjoy.
Tips for perfect cream puffs
When mixing the pastry dough, remember to stir vigorously and long enough so the dough becomes soft, smooth, moist, and elastic.
For the filling, you can add various syrups to create different colors and flavors according to your preference.
The chocolate glaze is optional; you can skip it if you prefer. You can also get creative with different colors like white chocolate, matcha green, pineapple yellow, or beetroot pink.
The size of the puffs can be adjusted to your liking.

The finished cream puffs have an attractive golden color with a crunchy chocolate coating, a soft moist shell, and a smooth cream filling. Enjoying them with warm milk on a cold day is fantastic. With just a little time in the kitchen, you will have a delicious treat for the whole family and receive many compliments on your skills!

mon_an.mo_ta: Apple Tapioca Pie is an American favorite featuring a crispy crust, an attractive color, and a crunchy apple filling coated in a delicious sauce. Take a bite to feel the harmony between the filling and the crunchy crust; enjoying it with a cup of tea is a wonderful experience. Let's get into the kitchen and try this delicious recipe!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients for the apple tapioca pie.
Crust preparation:
Finely dice the cold butter.
Sift the flour once until very smooth.
Separate the egg yolk and beat it well.
Filling preparation:
Peel and core the apples, then cut them into small pieces and then into thin slices. Marinate the apples with cinnamon powder and a pinch of salt.
Cut the unsalted butter into small pieces.
Step 2: Steps to make the apple tapioca pie.
First, put the butter, flour, and salt into a blender and blend until fine. While blending, add vinegar and cold water. Add the water slowly to avoid splashing.
When the mixture comes together, transfer the dough to a bowl or a clean surface. Knead until the dough is very smooth and fine.
Next, divide the dough into two equal parts, wrap them in plastic wrap, and refrigerate for about 1 hour before making the pie.
Filling preparation:
Melt the butter in a pan, then add white sugar, brown sugar, and a spoonful of water. Stir constantly to prevent burning.
When the sugar has dissolved, add the apples and toss for about 2-3 minutes. Remove the apples immediately so they don't get mushy.
In the same pan, continue to simmer the remaining butter-sugar mixture over low heat.
When the mixture thickens into a dense sauce, pour it back into the bowl of apples and mix well.
Next, take one portion of the dough from the fridge, remove the plastic wrap, and place it on the table.
Place a sheet of baking paper on the table, put the dough on top, and use a rolling pin to roll it into a circle with the same diameter as the pie mold.
Repeat the same process with the second portion of dough.
Since the dough is thin and soft, it can break easily when moved; use the rolling pin to help transfer it.
Place the first layer of dough into the mold, trim the excess edges, and gently press the dough against the bottom and sides of the mold.
Next, add the apple filling and spread it evenly.
Finally, place the second layer of dough over the apple filling and trim the excess edges.
Use the beaten egg or a bit of butter to seal the edges where the two layers of dough meet.
Use a knife to make a few small slits on the top crust to allow steam to escape during baking.
Brush the top of the pie with egg yolk to give it a beautiful golden color when baked.

Place the pie in a preheated oven and bake at 175°C for about 20-25 minutes. Once the top is golden, lower the temperature slightly and continue baking for another 15-20 minutes, then turn off the oven.
When the pie is done, remove it from the oven and let it cool naturally before slicing into triangles to serve.
Tips for a perfect apple tapioca pie
For the filling, you should use a variety of apples like Granny Smith and Red Delicious for a more complex and attractive flavor. Use firm apples rather than mealy ones for the best texture.
To keep the apples from browning, soak them in diluted salt water for a few seconds after slicing, then drain well.
Since we use cold butter for the crust, it might be hard to cut. You can warm the knife slightly before cutting the butter to make it easier.
Monitor the oven frequently while baking to prevent the pie from burning.

To get clean slices, let the pie cool completely (about 2-3 hours). This allows the crust to become crispy and the filling to set. Slicing while hot will result in a soft crust and a messy filling. Be patient!
Another note: keep the dough chilled throughout the process to ensure a crispy crust.

mon_an.mo_ta: Korean Egg Bread is incredibly delicious with a soft, fragrant outer crust and a filling of egg and melted cheese that will make your mouth water. The combination of soft bread, rich cheese, and fresh eggs provides a delightful savory experience.
cac_buoc: How to make Korean Egg Bread for 3-4 people
Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
First, melt the unsalted butter in the microwave or using a double boiler.
Cut the cheese stick into 6 equal small pieces.
Sift the flour until smooth.
Preheat the oven to 400°F (approx. 200°C).
Step 2: Steps to make delicious Korean Egg Bread
Batter preparation:
In a mixing bowl, combine the melted butter, sugar, salt, vanilla, 1 egg, and milk. Whisk until well combined. Sift in the flour and baking powder, then mix until you have a smooth batter.
Next, brush or spray a thin layer of oil onto the bottom of the molds.
Divide the batter into 3 equal parts and pour into each mold. Only fill the molds about halfway.
Place 2 pieces of cheese into the batter in each mold, positioning them towards the sides to leave a space in the center. Crack one egg into the center of each mold.
Place the molds on the oven rack and bake for about 13 minutes or until the bread is cooked through and has a beautiful golden color. Remove from the oven and let cool slightly.
Finally, arrange on a plate and enjoy while still warm.
Tips for delicious and beautiful egg bread
If you prefer a firmer texture, bake for about 15 minutes, but do not bake too long to avoid drying out the bread.

Besides mozzarella, you can use other types of cheese according to your preference. In Vietnam, many use 'The Laughing Cow' cheese for an affordable and tasty alternative. You can also skip the cheese if you prefer.
Depending on your taste, you can choose different brands of butter, but high-quality brands like President or Anchor are recommended for their rich aroma and flavor.
Make sure to sift the flour carefully to avoid lumps and achieve a smoother batter.

Korean Egg Bread is delicious with its soft, fragrant crust and gooey cheese and egg center. With just a little time in the kitchen, you can make this nutritious and attractive snack to satisfy your hunger. Your family will love it, and you'll surely get many compliments!

mon_an.mo_ta: Portuguese Egg Tarts delight everyone with their delicious flavor, bright golden color, soft crust, and rich vanilla-scented custard filling. Sipping a glass of fresh milk or fruit juice while enjoying these tarts brings a sense of comfort and joy. Follow this detailed guide to make perfect Portuguese Egg Tarts at home, from ingredient preparation to the final baking process.
cac_buoc: I. How to make Portuguese Egg Tarts
Step 1:
First, heat 100ml water with 100g sugar and a pinch of salt just until dissolved (no need to boil or stir).
Step 2: Kneading the dough

In a large bowl, mix 220g all-purpose flour with 26g unsalted butter at room temperature (do not use cold butter straight from the fridge). Add one cup of water. Knead the dough thoroughly until the ingredients are well combined and smooth.
If the dough is too dry, add a little more water; start with a small amount of water first.
Once kneaded, wrap the dough in plastic wrap and refrigerate for 20 minutes.
Step 3: In a pot, combine 260ml milk and 95g white sugar. Heat until the sugar dissolves.
Step 4:
Beat 3 eggs for 1 minute, then add a small cup of full-cream milk and a teaspoon of vanilla extract.
Once the sweetened milk (from Step 3) has cooled, pour it slowly into the egg mixture while stirring constantly.
Strain the mixture once through a sieve (do not strain twice).
Place the strained custard in the refrigerator.
Step 5:
Take the dough out of the plastic wrap. Dust the work surface and rolling pin with a little flour.
Roll the dough into a flat rectangle, fold it into thirds, wrap in plastic, and refrigerate for 20 minutes.
Repeat this process 3 or 4 times. For the final two folds, fold the dough into four layers.
Step 6:
After the final rolling, take the dough out and use a circular cutter to cut it into rounds.
Wrap the dough rounds in plastic as shown and refrigerate for 20 minutes.
Step 7:
Grease the inside of the tart molds with butter.
Place a dough round into each mold and press it firmly against the sides. Apply more pressure near the rim to create a beautiful edge.
Prick the bottom of the crust with a fork to ensure even baking.
Step 8:
Take the custard out of the fridge 5 minutes before filling. Stir it again, then pour it into the prepared crusts.
Step 9:
Preheat the oven to 250°C for 15 minutes before baking.
Place the tarts on the bottom rack. Lower the temperature to 230°C and bake for 15 minutes.
Then, lower the temperature to 200°C and bake for another 10 minutes.
Turn off the oven but leave the tarts inside for 25 minutes.
After 25 minutes, place a damp towel in the oven door crack.
Remove the tarts from the oven and let them sit in the molds for 10 minutes. Then, remove from the molds and enjoy.
II. How to make egg tarts using unlaid eggs (trứng gà non)
Ingredients
220g all-purpose flour
100g unsalted butter, diced
1/4 tsp salt
2-3 tbsp cold water
3 unlaid eggs (trứng gà non)
200ml fresh milk
100g parmesan or cheddar cheese, finely grated
Salt and pepper to taste
Steps
1. Prepare the tart crust
Mix flour, butter, and salt in a large bowl. Use your fingers to rub the butter into the flour until it resembles fine crumbs.
Add cold water a little at a time and mix until the dough comes together.
Wrap in plastic and refrigerate for 30 minutes to 1 hour.
2. Prepare the filling
Melt the cheese in a pan and stir until incorporated into the filling base. Turn off the heat and let cool.
3. Bake the tart shells
Preheat the oven to 180°C.
Divide the dough into small portions. Press each portion into the tart molds.
Prick the bottom with a fork to prevent air bubbles.
Blind bake the shells (without filling) for 10-12 minutes or until light golden.
4. Finish the egg tarts
In a bowl, combine eggs and fresh milk. Whisk gently until uniform.
Place a spoonful of the unlaid egg filling into each pre-baked shell, then pour the egg and milk mixture over it.
Place the tarts on a baking tray and bake for 20-25 minutes or until the filling is set and the surface is golden brown.
Let cool and enjoy.

mon_an.mo_ta: Egyptian Mummy Hot Dogs are visually striking with their unique shape and golden color. Featuring fresh sausages wrapped in a crispy, egg-scented crust, they are a delight to eat. Get in the kitchen and make this fun treat for your family!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Mustard or chili sauce - as desired
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients for the mummy hot dogs.
Place the sausages on a plate. If using frozen sausages, let them thaw naturally.
Separate the yolk and white of one egg.
In a large bowl, combine flour, sugar, beer, salt, 2 eggs, and milk. Mix thoroughly until all ingredients are well incorporated.
Knead the dough for a long time and very thoroughly to ensure it is fresh and elastic.
Dust a flat surface with flour, turn out the dough, and knead it well by hand.

Continue kneading until the dough is smooth and elastic. Place it in a bowl, cover with a damp cloth, and let it rest for 20-30 minutes. This allows the dough to rise, making it fluffier and tastier when baked.
Step 2: Steps to make the mummy hot dogs.
First, place the dough on the table and roll it out very thin.
Use a knife to cut the dough into long, thin strips.
Take a sausage and begin wrapping the dough strips around it.
Start from the top, leaving a small gap for the 'mummy's face', then wrap the rest of the body completely. Repeat until all sausages are wrapped.
Once finished, place the mummies on a baking tray. Brush each one evenly with the reserved egg yolk.
Place the tray in a preheated oven at 180°C and bake for 15 minutes.
When the bread is cooked, remove the tray and let it cool slightly. Use a toothpick to dot mustard or chili sauce onto the face area to create eyes and a mouth.
Finally, enjoy your attractive mummy hot dogs.
Tips for delicious mummy hot dogs
To make the bread tasty, remember to knead the dough thoroughly so it is soft and elastic.

When proofing the dough, keep the bowl in a warm, draft-free place covered with a damp cloth. Usually, proofing takes longer, but for this recipe, we only need the dough to wrap the sausages, so a short rest is sufficient.
To make the bread softer, you can add a tiny amount of baking soda (about 1/3 tsp).
Adding a bit of beer to the dough helps the bread have an attractive aroma and better texture when baked.
Brushing with egg yolk is optional but gives the bread a beautiful golden color and a richer flavor.
Adjust the baking temperature to suit your specific oven; medium heat is generally best.

mon_an.mo_ta: Oatmeal is one of the most nutritious grains, rich in fiber and very gentle, making it suitable for children, the elderly, and those on a diet. Besides porridge or smoothies, oatmeal can be used to bake delicious cookies. These easy-to-make, nutrient-rich oatmeal cookies will delight you. To enhance the flavor, you can add raisins or almonds! You'll regret it if you miss out on these!
cac_buoc: Step 1: First, put the oatmeal into a large bowl, then add butter, salt, and water and mix well. Stir evenly so the ingredients are well combined. Let it sit for 5-10 minutes for the oats to absorb the water and expand. Be careful not to make the mixture too liquid, or the cookies won't form properly.
Step 2: Dust a flat surface with flour to prevent sticking. Divide the oatmeal mixture into 10 equal portions. Roll each portion into a ball by hand.
Step 3: Use a rolling pin to flatten each ball into a disc about 5mm thick and 8cm in diameter. If the dough is still sticky, add a little more flour.
Step 4: Use a cookie cutter to cut the dough into perfect circles, then arrange them on a baking tray.
Step 5: Bake the cookies for about 15 minutes, then flip them over and bake for another 5 minutes to finish.

Oatmeal is a top-tier nutritional grain. It is fiber-rich and suitable for everyone, including those on diets. These cookies are easy, healthy, and delicious. Add raisins or almonds for extra flavor! You'll definitely love these!

mon_an.ten: Crispy Fried Beef Rolls with Cheese
mon_an.mo_ta: Crispy Fried Beef Rolls with Cheese are a favorite for many. These bite-sized rolls are visually appealing with a beautiful golden breaded coating. Biting into them reveals tender beef and rich, aromatic melted cheese. With just a little time and familiar ingredients, you can create this wonderful dish for family and friends.
cac_buoc: How to make Crispy Fried Beef Rolls with Cheese for 4 people.
Step 1: Prepare the ingredients.
Wash the beef and pat dry. Slice the beef into thin, long strips. You can use a rolling pin to flatten both sides of the meat to make it more tender.
Beat the egg in a bowl.
Slice the cheese into strips that match the width of the beef slices.
Step 2: Steps to make the beef rolls.

First, lay a strip of beef on a flat surface and place a piece of cheese on top. Roll the meat tightly, ensuring the cheese is fully enclosed so it doesn't leak out. You can use a toothpick to secure the roll if needed.
Dredge the beef roll in flour until fully coated.
Next, dip the roll into the beaten egg.
Finally, coat the roll in panko breadcrumbs, ensuring it is completely covered just like the flour layer.
Heat oil in a pan. Once hot, fry the beef rolls until golden brown. Use medium heat so the meat cooks through while the crust stays beautiful.
Once cooked, remove the rolls and drain on paper towels.
Finally, arrange the fried beef on a plate and serve with chili sauce or spicy-sour sauce!
Tips for delicious beef rolls
You can apply this recipe to pork or chicken as well. The flavor will vary slightly but will still be delicious.
A small tip: add a pinch of salt and sugar to the beaten egg for a more savory taste.
If you like it spicy, you can spread a layer of chili sauce on the cheese before rolling the meat.
Make sure to use enough oil to submerge the rolls; this ensures even cooking without absorbing too much grease.
Serving with fresh herbs and vegetables will help balance the richness.

These rolls are a crowd-pleaser, especially with children who love the gooey cheese. You might even be asked for the recipe! It's a great way to earn compliments from your loved ones. Let's get cooking!

mon_an.mo_ta: These cheese-stuffed shrimp and pork patties feature a crispy outer shell and a fresh savory filling of shrimp and pork combined with rich, melted cheese.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Other ingredients - Cornstarch; Black pepper; Seasoning powder; Panko breadcrumbs; Cooking oil
cac_buoc: HOW TO MAKE CHEESE-STUFFED SHRIMP AND PORK PATTIES
Step 1: Rinse the shrimp with a little rice wine to remove the fishy odor, then rinse with clean water. Peel and devein the shrimp. Drain well, then mix with 50g of pork and grind finely.

Step 2: Transfer the shrimp and pork mixture to a bowl. Add a pinch of pepper, 1 tbsp cornstarch, and 1 tbsp seasoning powder. Mix well and let marinate for 15 minutes to allow the flavors to penetrate.
Step 3: Cut the cheese into bite-sized pieces.
Step 4: Form the shrimp and pork mixture into balls, flatten them, place a piece of cheese in the center, and roll them back into balls. Repeat until all ingredients are used.
Step 5: Place panko breadcrumbs on a plate and roll each ball in the crumbs until evenly coated.
Step 6: Place a pan on the stove, add oil, and wait until hot. Fry each patty until golden brown and crispy. Remove and place on a plate lined with paper towels.
Step 7: Finally, arrange the patties on a plate and serve with chili sauce and mayonnaise.
Tips for delicious cheese-stuffed patties
For an extra crispy and attractive crust, follow this sequence:
Dredge the ball in flour, then dip in egg, then coat in panko breadcrumbs. Repeat the egg and panko steps once more.
How to choose good shrimp:
Check the tail:

To determine freshness, stretch the shrimp out and hold it up to the light to see the space between the shell segments and the meat. Wider joints indicate the shrimp is not fresh, possibly because it was overcooked or frozen for a long time.
Avoid slimy shrimp:

Do not buy shrimp that feel slimy. These often have curved bodies rather than lying straight. To check, move your finger back and forth over the shell. If it feels gritty or sticky/slimy, do not buy it.
Shrimp legs:
Observe if the legs are still firmly attached to the body; the meat should be firm. Avoid shrimp with legs that have turned black, as this is a sign they are no longer fresh.
Choosing by variety:
Black Tiger Shrimp: Usually farmed, firm meat, large size, easy to process. Choose live ones with shiny, smooth shells and a clear midsection.
Iron Shrimp (Tôm sắt): Smaller but very tasty with a deep sweet flavor. Choose fresh ones with a pinkish-white color; deep pink indicates they have been sitting too long.
Whiteleg/Sea Shrimp (Tôm he): Should be lively, pinkish-white with green eyes.
Lobster: The largest variety, great for steaming. Look for bright blue joints and a shiny, fresh shell.

mon_an.mo_ta: Chè Ba Màu uses easy-to-find ingredients and a very simple method. It is the perfect treat to serve your family on the weekend.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Sugar syrup - 200ml water + 100g sugar, boiled and cooled.
Coconut milk - 1 can (400ml) coconut milk + 30g sugar, simmered over low heat. When it lightly boils, add a little cornstarch slurry, stir for 30 seconds, and turn off heat.
cac_buoc: Preparation:
Step 1: Cooking the red beans

Soak red beans in warm water overnight. Drain and rinse several times with cold water. Place red beans and 1 liter of water in a pot and cook until tender. Add sugar and simmer over low heat so the syrup absorbs into the beans. Cook until the liquid reduces, then turn off the heat.
Step 2: Cooking the mung beans

Soak mung beans for 4-5 hours, wash clean, and steam until cooked. Place the cooked beans, sugar, and vanilla in a non-stick pan over low heat. Stir constantly until the mixture forms a smooth, non-sticky mass, then turn off the heat.
Step 3: Cooking the jelly
Combine water, jelly powder, and sugar in a pot and dissolve. Place on the stove over low heat and cook until the liquid is clear, then turn off the heat.
Step 4:
Pour the mixture into a container. Once cool, refrigerate for a few hours until set, then cut into small cubes.
Presentation: Place shaved ice in a glass. Layer the red beans, jelly, and mung beans. Pour the sugar syrup and coconut milk over the top. Garnish with shredded coconut and crushed roasted peanuts.
Notes for making Chè Ba Màu
Notes during the cooking process
When making Chè Ba Màu, keep these important points in mind for success:
Ingredients: Choose fresh beans that are not damaged or smelling burnt. Ensure you have enough mung beans, red beans, and black beans (if using) to create the three colors.
Soaking time: Soak each type of bean separately for 4-6 hours to soften them and reduce cooking time.
Cook evenly: When boiling, use medium heat and stir regularly so the beans don't stick to the bottom or burn.
Sugar and coconut milk: Adjust the amount of sugar and coconut milk to your personal taste. Add gradually and stir well to ensure the sugar dissolves.
Reheating: If serving warm, reheat the components before eating to experience the best flavor.
Choosing ingredients
To choose high-quality mung beans:
Size and uniformity: Choose beans that are medium-sized and uniform.
Color and surface: Choose beans with a bright yellow color and a shiny surface, without any white powdery coating.
Firmness: Squeeze the beans gently; they should be firm and not easily crushed.
Avoid spoiled beans: Do not buy beans with unusual colors, signs of mold, or a foul odor.

mon_an.mo_ta: A refreshing Orange Tofu Pudding Soup featuring the fragrant scent of oranges and the silky texture of tofu pudding. This unique combination makes summer more pleasant than ever.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Tofu pudding - 1 small bowl or as desired
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients for the orange tofu pudding soup.
Divide the oranges as follows:
Zest a small portion of the skin from one orange.
Peel that same orange and separate it into segments; place on a plate.
Juice the remaining two oranges and strain out the seeds.
Thinly slice the ginger.
Mix the tapioca starch with a bowl of filtered water.
Step 2: Steps to make the orange tofu pudding soup.
First, combine the orange juice, filtered water, ginger slices, and sugar in a pot and bring to a boil.
When the juice boils, pour in the tapioca starch slurry and stir until dissolved and thickened.
Once the mixture boils again, add the orange segments. Stir very gently to avoid breaking the segments.
Finally, add the tofu pudding to the pot and turn off the heat. Do not stir much to prevent the tofu pudding from breaking apart.
Ladle the soup into bowls, ensuring each bowl has enough tofu pudding and orange segments. Sprinkle a little orange zest on top and serve.
If you prefer it cold, place the bowls in the refrigerator or mix with shaved ice.
Notes for making Orange Tofu Pudding Soup
The method is simple, so here are just a few tips on choosing ingredients.

First, to choose delicious, sweet, and juicy oranges, look for round fruits that aren't misshapen and have fresh stems. The color should be bright and shiny, turning yellow or bright pink-orange with a hint of green. Avoid fruits that are more than half green as they were picked too early. Choose fruits that feel heavy for their size.
Second, tofu pudding is very refreshing, especially in summer, but do not overconsume it. It is best not to eat more than 200g of tofu pudding per day.

This soup is not just a delicious treat to beat the heat; it is also an effective folk remedy for common summer ailments like fever, flu, or sunstroke. Eating a bowl can make you feel more energetic and improve your mood. The combination of zest and juice is excellent for relieving cold symptoms.

With just three simple steps, you have a nutritious and fragrant dessert. The scent of fresh orange is cooling, and the sweet-tart segments paired with silky tofu pudding melt in your mouth. For families with active children, this is a great way to cool down and replenish vitamins and minerals. It's as good as any shop-bought version!

mon_an.ten: Simple and Delicious Banana Sweet Soup (Chè Chuối)
mon_an.mo_ta: Chè chuối is a delicious and easy-to-make dessert featuring chewy tapioca pearls, soft ripe bananas, and a rich, fragrant coconut milk base. Topped with fresh shredded coconut and crunchy peanuts, it offers a delightful combination of textures and flavors. Follow this recipe to treat your family to a nutritious and impressive homemade dessert!
cac_buoc: Step 1: It is best to choose bananas that are just ripe. Avoid using unripe bananas as they can be astringent and ruin the flavor of the dish.
Step 2: Peel the bananas and slice them into bite-sized rounds. Marinate the slices with a pinch of salt and sugar for 15–22 minutes until well-absorbed.
Step 3: Roast the peanuts, let them cool, remove the skins, and crush them lightly.
Step 4: Rinse the store-bought tapioca pearls several times until clean. Soak them in cold water for 15-20 minutes until they expand, then drain in a colander.

Step 5: Bring the coconut milk to a boil, then slowly add the bananas. Simmer over low heat (high heat will cause the bananas to break apart) until they are soft. Stir gently occasionally to prevent sticking and ensure the bananas absorb the sweet, creamy flavor of the coconut milk.
Step 6: Add the tapioca pearls and stir gently. Continue to simmer until the pearls turn translucent and float to the surface, then turn off the heat.
Finally, ladle the soup into bowls, sprinkle with crushed peanuts and shredded coconut. This dish can be enjoyed both hot or cold.
Notes for a perfect Chè Chuối:
How to buy good bananas:
Avoid bruised or mushy bananas.
Choose a bunch with both green and yellow fruit. Naturally ripened bananas usually have uneven coloring, whereas chemically ripened ones look perfectly uniform.
Look for bananas with small black spots (freckles), wrinkled skin, and a yellow color with pinkish undertones.
Naturally ripened bananas will have ripe stems. if the fruit is bright yellow but the stem is still green, it has likely been artificially ripened.
Cooking tapioca pearls: Since pearls can remain raw in the center, always soak them first so they expand evenly. Cook until they float, then let them sit for an extra minute to ensure they are soft.
Adjust the sweetness to your preference by adding more sugar if desired.

Chè chuối is a delicious and easy-to-make dessert featuring chewy tapioca pearls, soft ripe bananas, and a rich, fragrant coconut milk base. Topped with fresh shredded coconut and crunchy peanuts, it offers a delightful combination of textures and flavors. Follow this recipe to treat your family to a nutritious and impressive homemade dessert!

mon_an.mo_ta: With this cooking method, the banana sweet soup has a light flavor, a chewy outer layer, and a soft, sweet center that is incredibly appealing.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 2 tbsp dried or fresh shredded coconut
cac_buoc: Step 1: Thinly slice the palm sugar and place it in a pot. Add 1 liter of water and bring to a boil until the sugar is completely dissolved.
Step 2: Place tapioca starch in a bowl, add a little warm water, and stir well until fully dissolved.
Step 3: Now, prepare the main ingredient: bananas.
Peel and slice the bananas into chunks. Dip each piece into the tapioca starch mixture so they are evenly coated. This creates a chewy outer layer when cooked in the boiling syrup.
This step ensures the bananas are chewy on the outside and soft and sweet on the inside!
Step 4: Boil the mixture for about 10-15 minutes until the coating is clear. Your nutritious banana sweet soup is ready.
Ladle the soup into bowls, sprinkle with coconut and peanuts, and enjoy the chewy, sweet, and refreshing treat!
Enjoy your light and fragrant banana sweet soup!

mon_an.mo_ta: To beat the summer heat, head to the kitchen and make this water chestnut sweet soup to help cool down and refresh your body.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: For coloring - use carrot juice, pandan juice, or beetroot juice.
cac_buoc: Step 1:

In a pot, combine coconut milk, cold water, sugar, a pinch of salt, and pandan leaves. Heat over low heat just until the sugar dissolves. (Do not cook too long or the coconut milk will lose its fresh aroma).
Step 2:
Dice the water chestnuts into small cubes. Soak them in pandan juice (or other natural colors) for 1 hour or longer until the color is absorbed.
Step 3:
Drain the water chestnuts in a colander.
Step 4:
Toss the water chestnuts with tapioca starch until they are evenly coated. Shake off any excess starch.
Step 5:

Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add the coated water chestnuts to boil. Once they float, continue cooking for a few more minutes until the starch layer becomes translucent, then immediately transfer them to a bowl of cold water. You will now have clear, jewel-like water chestnut pearls.
Presentation: Place crushed ice in a glass, add the water chestnut pearls, and pour the coconut milk mixture over the top.

mon_an.ten: Simple Mixed Bean Sweet Soup with Coconut Milk
mon_an.mo_ta: Hot weather increases the need for refreshing treats. This delicious, nutritious, and cooling mixed bean sweet soup with coconut milk will surely satisfy you.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the mung beans
Place mung beans and 1 liter of water in a pot. Bring to a boil and simmer for 15 minutes over low heat.
Add 50g of sugar and continue to simmer for 10 minutes.
Once the beans are soft, drain them and place them in a blender. Blend until smooth.
Step 2: Prepare the black and red beans
Drain the beans that were soaked overnight and rinse them with fresh water.

Place the black beans in a pot with 1 liter of water. Simmer over low heat for 20 minutes, then add 50g of sugar and simmer for another 10 minutes. Afterwards, soak the beans in a bowl of water for 15 minutes, then drain.
Repeat the same process for the red beans and white beans.
Note: You should soak the white, red, and black beans overnight before cooking so they soften more quickly.
Step 3: Prepare the coconut milk
Pour the coconut milk into a pan, add 50g of sugar, and simmer over low heat for 10 minutes. Stir constantly to prevent burning. Turn off the heat and set aside.
Step 4:
Layer the beans (black, white, red, and mung bean paste) into a glass or bowl, or arrange them according to your preference.
Step 5:
Finally, pour the coconut milk over the top and add shaved ice to enjoy! It's that simple!

mon_an.ten: Delicious Mixed Bean Sweet Soup with Coconut Milk
mon_an.mo_ta: With simple ingredients and a bit of kitchen skill, you can create a refreshing and fragrant mixed bean dessert to treat your family and friends on hot summer days!
cac_buoc: How to cook Mixed Bean Sweet Soup with Coconut Milk
Preparation:
Soak the white beans and black beans overnight so they become tender and not tough when cooked.
Rinse the mung beans and soak in warm water for about 2 hours. Alternatively, soak in cold water for 3-4 hours until they expand.
Steps to make the delicious mixed bean soup
Step 1: Prepare the mung beans

Bring 1 liter of water to a boil in a pot, then add the mung beans and simmer for 15-20 minutes. Add 50g of sugar and simmer for another 10-15 minutes until fully cooked. Drain the beans, then place them in a blender and blend until smooth.
Step 2: Prepare the black, red, and white beans

Drain the soaked beans. Place them in a pot with 1.5 liters of water and simmer for 20 minutes until tender, adding more water if it evaporates. Add 50g of sugar and simmer until the beans are soft and have absorbed the sweetness. Turn off the heat, let the beans soak in the syrup for 15 minutes, then scoop them into a bowl. Repeat this process for the red and white beans. Note that red and white beans are larger, so ensure they are thoroughly softened.
Step 3: Prepare the coconut milk

In a small pot, heat the coconut milk with 50g of sugar over low heat for 10-15 minutes. Stir constantly, then set aside. To serve, layer the black beans, red beans, and mung bean paste in a glass to create beautiful layers. Finally, pour the coconut milk over, top with fresh coconut, dried coconut, and peanuts. Add ice and enjoy.
Notes for a delicious Mixed Bean Sweet Soup
Choosing black beans: Select small-seeded black beans. If the inside is light green when bitten, the beans are high quality and fragrant.

Cooking beans quickly: Using a rice cooker can help soften beans very fast. Boil the beans for 5 minutes, drain the first water to remove bitterness, then add fresh water and cook again. Let it boil for 10 minutes, then switch to 'Keep Warm' for 30 minutes. Finally, switch back to 'Cook' for 20 minutes for perfectly tender beans.
Adjust the amount of sugar to suit your personal taste.
If you have time, you can add tapioca pearls or grass jelly to enhance the flavor and color of the dish.
With simple ingredients and a bit of kitchen skill, you can create a refreshing and fragrant dessert to treat your family and friends on hot summer days!

mon_an.mo_ta: Dried bananas are a favorite snack for many. With just a few simple steps, you can make your own clean, safe, and delicious dried bananas that taste just as good as store-bought ones.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel the bananas and slice them into rounds about 1cm thick.
Step 2: Mix lemon juice with water at a ratio of 1 tablespoon of lemon juice to 6 tablespoons of filtered water. Soak the banana slices in this mixture for 10 minutes, then remove and drain.
Step 3: Line a baking rack with foil and arrange the banana slices on it. Ensure the pieces do not overlap so they dry evenly.
Step 4: Bake the bananas at 125°C for 18 - 20 minutes. Check frequently; they are done when they turn a golden brown color. Store the dried bananas in a plastic bag in the refrigerator for later use.
Source: ST

mon_an.ten: Sweet and Sour Pickled Ambarella (Cóc Dầm)
mon_an.mo_ta: Pickled ambarella is a favorite for those who love snacks. This dish offers a perfect balance of sweet and sour, a hint of spice, and a satisfying crunch. With simple ingredients and a little time, you can create a wonderful treat for your loved ones. Explore this detailed guide to making ambarella snacks, including variations with beef jerky and peanuts for an amazing flavor profile.
cac_buoc: Instructions for Sweet and Sour Ambarella:
Method 1:
Preparing ingredients for Pickled Ambarella:
Remove the stems from the chili peppers, wash, and slice.
Peel the fresh ambarella (it is best to use a sharp peeler to remove only a thin layer of skin to preserve the characteristic aroma and tartness).
Cut the ambarella into halves or thirds, or carve them into shapes, then soak in a bowl of water with 3 tablespoons of salt to remove the sap.
After 20 minutes, remove the ambarella and drain well.
Steps to make Pickled Ambarella:
Prepare the pickling liquid: Boil 300ml of water with sugar, stirring until dissolved. Let it cool, then stir in the fish sauce, chili powder, sliced chilies, and 5 tablespoons of vinegar.
Place the ambarella in a glass jar and pour the liquid over them until completely submerged.
The dish is ready to enjoy after 1 day.
Notes for delicious Pickled Ambarella:
Pickled ambarella can be stored in the refrigerator for 7-10 days.
Choose young ambarella for the best crunch and easier cutting.
This dish is an excellent snack to pair with beer or rice wine.
You can apply this same method to green mango or cucumber.
Method 2:
Step 1:
Peel the ambarella, make vertical cuts around the fruit, and use the tip of the knife to wedge out small pieces.
Step 2:
Toss the ambarella pieces with sugar first. Letting the sugar absorb before adding salt is the secret to keeping the fruit crunchy. If you add salt first, the fruit will become soft and watery.
This tip applies to all types of shaken fruit snacks.
Step 3:
Once the sugar has dissolved and absorbed, add the chili salt and toss well. Adjust the amount of chili powder according to your spice preference.
Instructions for Ambarella with Beef Jerky:
1. Ingredients
Fresh ambarella - 1 piece (large)
Sugar - 150g
Fish sauce - 2 tbsp
Fine salt - 3 tbsp
Chili powder - 2 tbsp
Chili peppers - 10 pieces
2. Steps for Sweet and Sour Shaken Ambarella
Step 1: Preparation
Wash the ambarella to remove dirt, then peel thinly.
Soak the peeled fruit in diluted salt water to prevent browning and to help it absorb a light savory flavor.
Cut into bite-sized pieces (discard the pit). If using baby ambarella, cut in half or score around the fruit. Soak for 15 minutes, then drain.
Wash and slice the chilies. Keep or remove seeds based on your spice preference.
Step 2: Prepare the soaking sauce
Boil 300ml of water with sugar. Lower the heat and stir until dissolved. Let it cool completely. Add 2 tablespoons of fish sauce and chili powder, stirring well to combine.
Step 3: Jarring
Pack the ambarella into a clean plastic or glass jar (glass is preferred for health and odor prevention). Pour the sauce over the fruit until submerged and seal tightly.
Step 4: Storage
Place the jar in the refrigerator. After about 1 day, the flavors will be fully absorbed and ready to eat.
Instructions for Ambarella with Beef Jerky and Peanuts
1. Ingredients
Ambarella: 300g (baby or regular)
Beef jerky: 50g
Roasted peanuts: 30g
Granulated sugar: 3 tsp
Salt + chili: 2 tsp
2. Steps to make
Wash, peel, and slice the ambarella. Soak in ice water for 30 minutes to reduce acidity and increase crunchiness. Drain well.
Step 2: Mixing

Place ambarella in a bowl and toss with sugar until dissolved. Then add salt and chili powder (or Tay Ninh shrimp salt). Adjust to taste. Remember: sugar first, salt later to maintain the fruit's texture. Let sit for 15 minutes.
Step 3: Add beef jerky and peanuts
Finally, add the beef jerky and roasted peanuts and toss well. Note: Only add the beef jerky right before serving to prevent it from getting soggy.
Notes for delicious Ambarella snacks:
Choose young ambarella for the best crunch.
The beef jerky version is a highly recommended variation!

Whether you prefer the brine-pickled or the dry-shaken version, these snacks are perfect for those who love bold, crunchy, and spicy flavors. They are easy to make and sure to impress your friends and family!

mon_an.ten: Crispy Fried Pork Stomach with Clausena Leaves
mon_an.mo_ta: Combining the richness of pork stomach with the unique aroma of Clausena (mắc mật) leaves and a crispy fried exterior, this dish is irresistible. Get ready to show off your cooking skills and enjoy this unique culinary experience with our detailed guide. Enjoy the perfect blend of textures and flavors!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings - Oyster sauce, pepper, salt, cooking oil, chili sauce
cac_buoc: Step 1: Start by cleaning the pork stomach thoroughly to remove odors. Use vinegar or rice wine to wash the interior. Alternatively, place the stomach in a dry hot pan for 2 minutes over medium heat, then remove and scrub with vinegar and salt to remove all slime.
Step 2: Wash the Clausena leaves and divide them into two parts. Finely chop one half to stuff inside the stomach. Slice the other half to fry along with the stomach.

Step 3: Place the stomach in a heat-resistant bag and tie it tightly. Place the bag in a pot and cover with water. Add star anise and cinnamon to the water. Bring to a boil, then lower the heat and simmer for 5 minutes before removing the bag.

Step 4: Place the parboiled stomach in a bowl. Marinate with 1 tsp seasoning powder, 1 tsp pepper, 1/2 tsp oyster sauce, and half a packet of five-spice powder. Mix well and let marinate for 20 minutes.
Step 5: Heat 3 tablespoons of oil in a pan. Once hot, add the stomach and stir-fry continuously over high heat to achieve a crispy texture.
Step 6: Once the stomach is cooked and crispy, serve it on a plate with the fried Clausena leaves. Enjoy hot with steamed rice.
Notes for delicious Fried Pork Stomach:
How to choose a good pork stomach:

Visual check: Look for a stomach with an even color, no blemishes, or strange spots. Naturally, the back should be light brown (turning darker when boiled) and the inside should be off-white with a thin film. Once cleaned, it should look bright white.
Check the thickness: A good stomach is usually 2–3 cm thick. This ensures a crunchy and fragrant result. Thick stomachs usually come from large, healthy pigs.
How to clean and deodorize:
Rinse with water. Place in a pot, cover with water, and add a few drops of fish sauce. Bring to a boil just until the outer membrane starts to peel off, then remove immediately.
Let it cool, scrape off the membrane with a knife, and marinate with a few drops of fish sauce for 10 minutes. Rinse again.
Finally, boil it one more time in water with a few more drops of fish sauce. This ensures the stomach is incredibly fragrant, clean, and crispy.

mon_an.ten: Crispy Breaded Tofu Stuffed with Cheese
mon_an.mo_ta: This breaded tofu stuffed with cheese is a harmonious East-meets-West fusion. It is delicious, visually appealing, and so addictive you'll want to keep eating.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Blanch the tofu in boiling water with a pinch of salt, then remove and let cool.
Arrange the tofu, cheese, and bacon on a tray.
Step 2:
Use a knife to cut a slit into the side of each tofu block. Carefully stuff a slice of cheese and a slice of bacon into the center.
Dredge each stuffed tofu block in flour, then dip into the beaten egg.
Step 3:
Finally, coat the tofu in breadcrumbs and let sit for 3 minutes so the breading adheres well.
Deep-fry the tofu in a pan of hot oil until golden brown and crispy, then remove quickly.
Enjoy while hot and crispy!
You can also substitute the cheese with minced meat to reduce calories; it is equally delicious.

mon_an.ten: Crispy Fried Chicken with Sweet Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: This crispy fried chicken features a crunchy exterior and tender, juicy meat, all coated in a savory-sweet sauce that is sure to please.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Flour mix: 150g frying flour + 20g cornstarch + 1/2 tsp baking soda - mixed in a bowl
cac_buoc: How to make Crispy Fried Chicken with Sweet Sauce
Step 1: Wash the chicken wings with salt to remove any odors, rinse again, and pat dry. Place the chicken in a bowl with chili salt and mayonnaise. Toss well and let marinate for 15-20 minutes.
Step 2: Place the chicken wings in a plastic bag with the flour mixture and shake well to coat. You can gently press the flour onto the wings for a thicker coating.
Step 3: Heat oil in a pan. When the oil is medium-hot, fry the chicken wings in batches over medium heat.
Fry until the chicken is golden brown and cooked through, then remove and place on a plate lined with paper towels.

Step 4: In a small pan, heat 1 tablespoon of oil. Sauté the minced garlic until fragrant, then add all the sauce ingredients. Bring to a boil and stir for 5-6 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly, then turn off the heat.
Step 5: Place the fried chicken wings in a large bowl, pour the sauce over them, and toss to coat evenly.
Finally, arrange the crispy chicken on a plate, sprinkle with roasted sesame seeds, and enjoy.

mon_an.mo_ta: Cheesy grilled chicken is a delicious and enticing dish featuring tender, fresh chicken infused with bold flavors and smothered in rich, aromatic melted cheese. The combination of chicken and cheese creates a truly satisfying experience. Take a little time to learn how to make this treat for your whole family!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients for the cheesy grilled chicken.
Rinse the chicken breast and cut into bite-sized squares.
Peel, wash, and finely mince the ginger.
Peel, wash, and mince the garlic.
Trim the roots and wilted leaves from the green onions, wash, and thinly slice.
Cut the cheese into small cubes.
Step 2: Cooking steps for cheesy grilled chicken.

Make the sauce: combine chili powder, Korean chili paste, soy sauce, 2 tbsp vegetable oil, black pepper, rice syrup, garlic, and ginger in a bowl. Mix well into a sweet and spicy paste. Ensure all ingredients are thoroughly combined into a smooth mixture.
Once the sauce is ready, add the chicken and mix well by hand. Ensure the chicken is evenly coated so it absorbs the flavors better. Marinate for 10–15 minutes.

Next, place a pan over heat and add 1 tbsp vegetable oil. When the oil is hot, add the sliced rice cakes and fry for a few minutes. Flip the cakes once or twice until both sides are crispy and golden brown. Watch carefully to avoid burning, which would ruin the flavor.

Place a heavy cast-iron skillet on the stove over medium heat. Add the marinated chicken and cook for about 10 minutes until the meat firms up. If using a regular pan, it will take about 7-8 minutes. Stir occasionally to ensure the chicken cooks evenly and doesn't burn at the edges.
Next, place the fried rice cakes on top and cover with a lid.
Reduce the heat to the lowest setting and cook for another 10 minutes or until the chicken is fully cooked.
Once the chicken is done, turn off the heat and place the cheese cubes on top.
Place the skillet in the oven and broil for a few minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbling.
Finally, remove the chicken, sprinkle with green onions, and serve immediately while hot.
Notes for perfect cheesy grilled chicken:
Adjust the amount of chili to suit your taste. Add more if you like it spicy, or reduce it if you prefer a milder flavor.
Besides mozzarella, you can substitute it with any other cheese you prefer.

If the chicken becomes too dry while cooking, you can add a tiny bit of water. Remember to stir occasionally so the chicken cooks evenly without burning. Cooking until the chicken is tender and fresh will allow you to fully enjoy the dish's flavor.

mon_an.mo_ta: Korean spicy seafood noodle soup (Jjamppong) is visually stunning and flavorful, featuring a colorful bowl of various seafood and vegetables. The noodles have a perfect chewiness, and the fresh seafood pairs wonderfully with kimchi or pickled radish. Enjoying a bowl of these noodles with a delicious milk tea will give you the energy for a productive workday!
cac_buoc: How to make Korean spicy seafood noodles:
Step 1:
First, pour 8 cups of chicken broth into a pot and bring to a boil over low heat.
Step 2:
Next, soak the wood ear mushrooms in cold water for about 20 minutes, then wash and cut into small pieces. Alternatively, soak them in hot water to make them bloom faster and easier to clean.
Step 3:
Wash and julienne all vegetables except for the bamboo shoots and mushrooms.
Cut the pork into 3 small pieces.
Step 4:

Once the ingredients are prepared, boil the noodles in water until cooked, then rinse with cold water and drain. If using Korean noodles, boil them a bit longer to ensure they are cooked through and not too tough. Rinsing with cold water prevents the noodles from sticking together. You can also add 1-2 drops of oil to the boiling water to help prevent sticking.
Step 5:
Heat vegetable oil in a pot and stir-fry in this order: ginger, pork, seafood, chili flakes, vegetables, and wood ear mushrooms (cook each for 3 minutes before adding the next ingredient).
Step 6:

Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil. Add 1/2 tbsp minced garlic and season with about 1/2 tbsp salt. Add the bamboo shoots and simmer for 10 minutes over medium heat, then add a pinch of black pepper.
Step 7:
Place the noodles into a large serving bowl.
Step 8:
Pour the soup over the noodles. Only pour it while the soup is piping hot. Arrange the seafood on top and garnish with chopped green onions.
Step 9:
Finally, you can add pickled radish and a bit of vinegar, and enjoy while hot.
Notes for Korean spicy seafood noodles:
You can omit these ingredients if preferred: baby clams, bamboo shoots, wood ear mushrooms, or green onions.
If chicken broth is not available, you can make a delicious stock using: 1 chicken, 3 stalks of green onion, 1 ginger root, 7 garlic cloves, and over 15 cups of water.
If you don't like spicy food, reduce the amount of chili flakes.
Adjust the seasonings to suit your personal taste.
To make the dish more appealing, you can add other seafood like shrimp, squid, beef, or any favorite ingredients.
Enjoying these noodles with kimchi will enhance the overall flavor.

Korean spicy seafood noodle soup is visually stunning and flavorful, featuring a colorful bowl of various seafood and vegetables. The noodles have a perfect chewiness, and the fresh seafood pairs wonderfully with kimchi or pickled radish. Enjoying a bowl of these noodles with a delicious milk tea will give you the energy for a productive workday!

mon_an.mo_ta: A cool popsicle with the sweetness of cherries and the light tang of lime will bring unforgettable flavors to the eater. Below is the detailed recipe for cherry lime popsicles for the whole family to enjoy!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the cherries, remove the pits, and chop them finely. Place water in a pot and bring to a boil, then add the cherries, sugar, and lime juice. Simmer over low heat for about 10 minutes. Once the cherries are soft, turn off the heat and let it cool.

Step 2: Use a mesh strainer to filter the juice from the mixture. Pour the juice into 4 prepared plastic cups and insert a popsicle stick into each cup. Finally, place the cups in the freezer and wait for the refreshing popsicles to set.

mon_an.mo_ta: Chocolate Mascarpone Cream is a unique and eye-catching dessert with a layer of chocolate that melts in your mouth when eaten fresh or becomes a cool treat when frozen. It is served with a rich, aromatic fresh cream layer and an attractive topping that is hard to resist. This wonderful dessert is perfect for parties, birthdays, or simply as a treat to show off your skills and bring joy to your family. Children will absolutely love it. Let's head to the kitchen and follow these simple steps to create a fantastic dessert!
cac_buoc: Prepare ingredients for the delicious chocolate mascarpone cream:
First, crack the eggs and separate the yolks and whites into two separate bowls.
Steps to make the delicious chocolate mascarpone cream:
Step 1: Use an electric mixer to beat the egg yolks until the mixture is a smooth, pale yellow cream without lumps.

Step 2: Add the Marsala wine to the yolk mixture and mix well. Then, add the mascarpone and mix until you have a homogeneous mixture – let's call this Mixture A. Once the mixture is smooth and creamy, cover it with plastic wrap and keep it in a cool place.

Step 3: While waiting for the mixture to set, melt the chocolate using a double boiler, then add the butter and warmed milk. Stir well and let it cool. Stir continuously so the ingredients blend perfectly without lumps, resulting in a smooth mixture.
Step 4: Use a spoon to place one tablespoon of chocolate at the bottom of each glass, then spoon in Mixture A until the glass is 2/3 full.
Finally, top with another tablespoon of chocolate. You can sprinkle some cocoa powder on top if desired. Chill for 20 minutes before serving, or enjoy immediately.
Notes for delicious chocolate mascarpone cream:
Choose fresh free-range eggs for the best flavor. Avoid industrial eggs as they can have a fishy smell that becomes unpleasant when beaten.
When beating the cream mixture, ensure it is smooth and well-combined without lumps. To check if the mixture is ready, drop a small amount into water; if it doesn't dissolve, the cream is set.
To enhance the flavor, you can sprinkle toppings like raisins, walnuts, or cashews on the surface.
Marsala is a fortified wine from Marsala, Italy, with an alcohol content of 17–18%. If you don't have Marsala, you can substitute it with coffee liqueur or even plain coffee.

Chocolate Mascarpone Cream is a unique and eye-catching dessert with a layer of chocolate that melts in your mouth when eaten fresh or becomes a cool treat when frozen. It is served with a rich, aromatic fresh cream layer and an attractive topping that is hard to resist. This wonderful dessert is perfect for parties, birthdays, or simply as a treat to show off your skills and bring joy to your family. Children will absolutely love it. Let's head to the kitchen and follow these simple steps to create a fantastic dessert!

mon_an.mo_ta: Mango with black glutinous rice is a unique dish featuring fresh black rice with a hint of fermentation, balanced with sweetness and a slight tang, layered with fresh cream and fragrant ripe mango. It's an incredibly attractive dessert. Take some time to make this treat for your family to enjoy after a nutritious meal!
cac_buoc: Step 1:

First, soak the black glutinous rice for about 1 hour, then change the water so it covers the rice by about 5cm. Next, place the rice, corn, and sugar in a steamer and cook for about 45 minutes or until the rice is tender.
Wait for the rice to cool completely, then roll it into small balls and place them in a bowl.
Step 2:

Add the mango cream, cold milk, and whipping cream to a bowl. Use an electric mixer to beat the mixture until it becomes frothy. Gently pour this mixture into the bowl with the black rice and drizzle the foam on top. If you don't have a mixer, stir by hand until the mixture is smooth and the ingredients are well combined.
Step 3:

Cut the mango into two halves and score a crosshatch pattern without cutting through the skin. Gently push the skin to pop the cubes out and place them in the bowl. If you're not comfortable with this method, simply peel the mango and cut it into 1x1x1 cm cubes.
Peel the remaining mango, cut into bite-sized pieces, and add them to the bowl.
Finally, arrange the black rice, mango, and cream on a plate or in a bowl. Drizzle with some coconut milk, and sprinkle with peanuts and fresh coconut before serving.
Notes for delicious mango with black glutinous rice:
When steaming the rice, watch carefully to prevent it from becoming too dry or burnt. If you can't find raw black glutinous rice, you can buy pre-cooked black rice from the store.

How to choose a good mango: Look for mangoes with smooth skin, free of blemishes or dark bruises. Don't focus too much on the color, as different varieties can be green, yellow, or reddish when ripe. Color doesn't always indicate ripeness or quality.

Choose mangoes that are evenly yellow with taut skin. The area near the stem should be yellow and firm; it should not feel mushy when pressed and should feel heavy for its size. Avoid green mangoes that feel soft, as they were likely picked too early. Firm, yellow mangoes are usually sweeter. Check the skin for tiny dark spots, which are a good sign. The stem end should not be shriveled. You can check freshness by sniffing the stem; a sweet, fragrant, slightly resinous scent indicates a fresh fruit without preservatives. To check for a small pit (and more flesh), look at the small 'eye' at the bottom; a longer eye usually means a larger pit and less meat.

mon_an.mo_ta: Chick-shaped marshmallows will become a favorite for children because of their delicious taste, eye-catching colors, and cute shapes, making them a delightful treat to enjoy.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Decoration - a little white frosting, 40 candy eyes, and oval candies for beaks
Tools - 35cm x 20cm rectangular tray (or larger), foil or parchment paper, mixer or whisk, thermometer, egg-shaped cookie cutter
cac_buoc: How to make cute chick marshmallows
Step 1: Prepare the ingredients.
First, dissolve the gelatin powder in a small bowl of water for about 5 minutes, then pour the gelatin mixture into the mixer bowl.
Line the tray with foil and spread a layer of butter evenly over the surface.
Sprinkle a layer of yellow sugar over the foil.
Step 2: Making the marshmallows.
