Place a pot on the stove and add the water, white sugar, corn syrup, and salt. Stir well until the sugar is completely dissolved.
Use a thermometer to monitor the temperature; once the syrup reaches 115°C, turn off the heat.
Pour the hot syrup into the mixer bowl containing the gelatin. Turn on the mixer and blend the mixture.
Mix for about 2 minutes, then turn off the mixer and let it cool slightly. Mix a second time until the mixture is thick and glossy, then stir in the vanilla.
Pour the mixture into the tray. Put on gloves greased with a little butter to prevent sticking and spread the marshmallow mixture evenly across the tray.
Sprinkle another layer of yellow sugar on top, ensuring the entire surface is covered.
Use the egg-shaped cutter to cut out marshmallow pieces. To prevent sticking, dip the cutter in yellow sugar or grease it with butter before each cut.
As you cut each piece, dip it into the bowl of yellow sugar so it is completely coated.
Final step: Decorate each egg-shaped piece.
Attach 2 candy eyes to each piece to make the chick's eyes, then attach the beak candy. Now you have cute little chicks.
Use white frosting in a piping bag to draw zigzag lines on some chicks to create an eggshell effect.
The cute chick marshmallows are now complete.
Notes for delicious marshmallows:
Instead of gelatin powder, you can use gelatin leaves (about 6 leaves equal 9g of powder).
If you don't like the taste of corn syrup, you can substitute it with fruit syrup.
When mixing, be very careful as the mixture is extremely hot and can splash.
Yellow sugar (raw sugar) is unrefined sugar. it has a sharp sweetness and a strong sugarcane aroma. If you prefer a finer texture, you can grind the sugar before using.
Do not confuse yellow sugar with red sugar. Yellow sugar contains small amounts of nutrients like potassium, calcium, magnesium, and iron.

mon_an.mo_ta: Sesame peanut brittle features eye-catching colors, a delicious aroma, and a simple preparation. It is crunchy with a moderate sweetness that is very satisfying. Discover how to make wonderful peanut brittle with white sugar in this article. Enjoy the natural scent and superb flavor of a homemade batch that is sure to please.
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients for sesame peanut brittle:
Roasting peanuts in the oven:
First, preheat the oven to 140–150°C with top and bottom heat to stabilize the temperature.
Spread the peanuts on a tray lined with parchment paper so the peanut oil doesn't get on the tray.
Place the tray on the middle rack. Roast for 15–20 minutes until the skins crack and the peanuts are cooked through.
Note:
For blanched peanuts (no skin), the roasting time is shorter, about 12–15 minutes!
After roasting, wrap the peanuts in newspaper or parchment paper and let them sit for 10–15 minutes to make the skins easier to remove and to ensure crispness.
Open the paper and rub the peanuts gently to remove the skins. Sift them in a basket to clean away the skins.
Roasting sesame seeds:
Spread them on a tray and roast in the oven at 140°C for about 10 minutes.
Steps to make sesame peanut brittle using an oven and microwave:
Step 1: Prepare the oven by lining a 20x20cm tray with parchment paper.
Step 2: Sprinkle one teaspoon of sesame seeds onto a plate. Keep another tablespoon of sesame seeds in a separate bowl for later use.
Step 3: Combine the peanuts, sesame seeds, and shredded coconut in a bowl and mix well.

Step 4: In another bowl, combine sugar, water, and lemon juice. Microwave for about 2 minutes at 800W. Take it out, stir for 10 seconds, then return to the microwave at 800W for another 2 minutes or until the sugar turns a light honey color.

Step 5: Add the peanut mixture to the sugar and stir quickly until the peanuts are evenly coated. Pour the mixture into the prepared tray and quickly use a spoon or spatula dipped in oil to spread it out evenly. Sprinkle the remaining sesame seeds on top. Work quickly as the candy hardens very fast.
Step 6: Let the candy cool for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, grease a knife with oil. Remove the candy from the tray and cut into strips 2cm to 2.5cm wide. Then cut into smaller pieces. Let cool completely.

Finally, wrap the peanut brittle in cellophane or plastic wrap, then store in a plastic bag or airtight container. Alternatively, place them directly in an airtight container without wrapping; they will stay crunchy.
Tips for making delicious peanut brittle:
To ensure the peanut layer is even, keep the baking tray warm in the oven at 250°F and carefully tilt the pan.
When using a spoon to spread the candy, be careful not to break the small air bubbles, which keep the candy light and crunchy.
If you don't have parchment paper, you can lightly grease the tray with oil, though this may make the brittle feel slightly greasy.
Baking soda helps the candy foam and creates bubbles in the syrup, making it easier to bite and giving it an opaque color. If you want a harder, clearer brittle, you can skip the baking soda.
If using pre-roasted peanuts, avoid exceeding 300°F to prevent a burnt smell. Adding peanuts after the syrup reaches 280°F prevents them from burning while retaining their flavor.
If you want a butterscotch-like flavor without burning, add the peanuts after the syrup reaches 300°F. However, this makes the mixture cool faster and harder to spread.
If your peanuts are unsalted, add 1/4 tsp salt to the recipe when stirring in the peanuts.
Have a pan of hot water ready to soak your tools for easy cleaning.
Use a large enough pot so that when you add butter and baking soda, the syrup has room to foam up several times its original size.
To distribute peanuts evenly, pour the mixture into the pan in a zigzag motion and then tilt the pan from side to side.
It takes a while to reach 250°F, but it will rise to 300°F quite quickly. Watch it closely.
Measure the butter, vanilla, and baking soda at room temperature and have them ready to add as soon as the temperature hits 300°F. You must act fast before it hardens.
Making brittle on a humid or rainy day can make it soft or prevent it from setting.
Be patient and cook over medium heat. Turning the heat too high can burn the mixture.
Use a wooden spoon to avoid melting plastic in the hot syrup.
Ensure the candy thermometer does not touch the bottom of the pan for the most accurate reading.
How to store peanut brittle:
Store in an airtight container.
To keep peanut brittle at its best, place it in an airtight container. This keeps it crunchy by preventing air contact and minimizing moisture.
You can use glass jars with lids or plastic containers. The most important thing is that the seal is airtight.
Separate the pieces.
To ensure the pieces don't stick together, place a layer of parchment paper at the bottom of the container.
Add a layer of brittle, leaving small spaces between pieces. Place another layer of parchment paper and repeat.
Since peanut brittle is mostly sugar, it becomes sticky when exposed to moisture. Separating them prevents them from merging into one large block.
Following these steps will keep your peanut brittle crunchy and prevent sticking.

mon_an.mo_ta: These two-layer marshmallows are soft, chewy, and fluffy with a superb flavor that will make you fall in love from the first bite. Check out the recipe below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Latte Layer: Marshmallow base: - Gelatin powder - 22.5 g
Tea Layer: Marshmallow base: - Black tea - 3 bags
Mallowing powder - same as latte layer
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Prepare a large cup or mug. Add the tea bags, cinnamon sticks, crushed cardamom, allspice, cloves, and ginger. Pour in the boiling water.
Steep the tea for 30 minutes, then let it cool and strain out the solids. Ensure you have 120ml of spiced tea concentrate to make this delicious treat.
Step 2:
Once the tea has cooled completely, sprinkle in the gelatin powder and let it bloom for 5-10 minutes.
Step 3:
Prepare a small saucepan. Combine 1/2 of the corn syrup with the sugar, salt, and water. Stir to dissolve.
Place the pot over high heat and bring to a boil, stirring occasionally. The syrup needs to reach 110°C.
Step 4:
Place the remaining corn syrup into a mixing bowl.
Step 5:
Melt the bloomed gelatin from Step 2 using a double boiler or microwave it for 30 seconds.
Once melted, pour it into the mixing bowl with the corn syrup and start whisking with an electric mixer on the lowest speed.
Step 6:
Slowly pour the 110°C syrup into the mixing bowl. Increase the mixer speed to medium and beat for 5 minutes.
Then, increase to medium-high speed and beat for another 5 minutes until smooth.
Finally, turn the mixer to the highest speed and beat for 1-2 minutes.
Step 7:
After beating, the marshmallow mixture should be smooth, glossy, and triple in volume.
Step 8:
Prepare a 23 x 33 cm glass dish greased with a thin layer of oil. Pour the marshmallow mixture into the dish. Use a wooden spoon to spread it evenly and let it cool at room temperature.
Step 9:

You have finished the latte layer. For the tea layer, repeat the same steps but use the ingredients listed for the tea layer. You can create multiple alternating layers to enhance the flavor, finishing with a layer of mallowing powder on the surface.
Leave the tray in a cool place for 6 hours to set completely (leaving it overnight is best).
Step 10:
Once set, remove the marshmallow from the mold and cut into desired shapes. Toss the cut pieces in the mallowing powder to coat them.
Your two-layer marshmallows are now ready!
These soft, chewy marshmallows with a fragrant tea scent are irresistible to both children and adults!
If not used immediately, store them in an airtight jar in a cool place.
These marshmallows are perfect when dropped into a cup of hot chocolate!

mon_an.mo_ta: Fluffy sweet potatoes and nutty black sesame seeds combined with a sweet and savory syrup (maltose and soy sauce) make for an incredibly delicious and attractive snack! The method is very easy, let's try it!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Keep the skin on, wash the sweet potatoes thoroughly, cut into 5 cm chunks, and then halve them. Soak the potatoes in light salt water to remove the sap. Drain and pat dry.
Step 2:
Boil the sweet potatoes until just cooked through. Heat oil and fry the potatoes until golden brown; let them char slightly for a better aroma, but do not burn them. Arrange the potatoes on a plate.
Step 3:

Make the syrup: In a small saucepan (since the amount is small), dissolve the soy sauce, maltose, and sugar. Stir until the sugar dissolves and the syrup thickens slightly. Drizzle the syrup immediately over the potatoes and sprinkle with black sesame seeds.
Note: If eating hot, be careful as the potatoes and syrup will be very hot. If eaten warm, the syrup will be tacky; if allowed to cool completely, the syrup will run like honey.

mon_an.mo_ta: Summer is the season for many fruits, especially plums. Sweet and sour shaken plums are a perfect snack for those looking to maintain their figure.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the plums, soak in salt water for 10-15 minutes, then rinse again and drain in a basket.
Step 2: Use a knife to cut the plums in half and remove the pits.
Step 3: Prepare a large, clean, and dry bowl or basin, and add all the halved plums.
Step 4: Add about 40–45 g sugar, 1 tsp salt, and 1 tsp chili powder. Toss everything together until well combined.
Your delicious shaken plums are now ready to enjoy.

mon_an.mo_ta: Dried jackfruit is a familiar snack for Vietnamese people, available in any grocery store or supermarket nationwide. But now, you can completely handcraft your own dried jackfruit that tastes just as good as store-bought versions. Making it yourself ensures safety and is much more economical. This Tet, try making dried jackfruit to treat your guests! In today's article, we will guide you through the process of making dried jackfruit at home.
cac_buoc: To make the best and crunchiest dried jackfruit, you must choose fruit that is just ripe. Remember to choose the firm variety (mít dai) because the soft variety (mít mật) will become mushy. You can identify good jackfruit by its short, widely spaced spikes. Tap the outside; if it sounds dull and feels heavy, it is a good fruit. Peel the skin, remove the seeds, and tear the flesh into strips horizontally.
Next, mix lemon juice with filtered water at a ratio of 1 tbsp lemon juice to 6 tbsp water. Soak the jackfruit in this mixture for about 10 minutes, then remove and drain well.

The final step in making professional-grade dried jackfruit is the drying process. Line a baking tray with foil and arrange the jackfruit on it. Note: do not layer them too thickly, or they won't brown evenly, won't be as tasty, and will quickly become soggy. Turn the oven to 50°C and bake for about 4 hours. Adjust the time depending on the thickness of your jackfruit pieces. They are done when they are dry, crunchy, and have turned a golden-brown color.
If you prefer it sweet, you can add sugar. During the baking process, when you see the jackfruit slightly shriveled, prepare a plate of sugar and roll the pieces so the sugar coats the surface.
If you don't have an oven or if your oven malfunctions, you can use the following method:

Place the jackfruit in a pan and cook over low heat in layers. Wait until the jackfruit is dry, crunchy, and turns golden brown to complete the stovetop drying method. However, this method is more laborious and time-consuming; if not careful, the jackfruit can easily spoil or fail to reach the desired crunchiness compared to using an oven.
Once you have finished making the crispy dried jackfruit, place it in a plastic bag or a glass jar and store it in the refrigerator for later use.

With this simple, delicious, and cost-effective method, you won't need to spend time looking for store-bought dried jackfruit whenever you have a craving. The crunchy pieces with their intense sweetness and seductive aroma are irresistible. It is a delicious, nutritious snack that is much cheaper than pre-packaged versions. Let's get started!

mon_an.mo_ta: Wontons are a familiar snack to everyone as they are very popular and highly favored. Besides the traditional steaming method, wontons can be adapted with various techniques and ingredients. Today, we introduce fried kimchi wontons with a golden, crispy shell. The combination of canned meat and the sour, spicy, and sweet taste of kimchi gives this dish a unique and extremely attractive flavor. Let's get into the kitchen and try it. It's delicious!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients.
Pour the kimchi into a bowl and drain the liquid. Finely chop any large cabbage leaves or radish pieces to make wrapping easier.
Crack the egg into a bowl and separate the egg white.
Use a grater to shred the canned meat into small pieces for easy wrapping. If you don't like canned meat, you can use fresh minced or ground meat instead.
Step 2: Execution steps.
The filling:
Place the kimchi, cream cheese, and shredded meat into a large bowl.
Use a spoon to mash and mix the ingredients together until you get a soft, smooth, and well-combined filling.
Once the ingredients are mixed, spread a wonton wrapper on a flat surface and scoop a sufficient amount of filling into the center.

At the same time, use a small brush to apply a thin layer of egg white to the edges of the wrapper to make sealing easier and prevent it from opening. Fold the wrapper into a triangle, square, or any shape you prefer.
Continue this process with the remaining filling and wrappers until finished.
Frying the wontons.
Place a deep pan or a small pot on the stove and heat the cooking oil. You should use enough oil so the wontons are submerged and become crispy.
When the oil is hot, add the wontons and deep-fry them. Remember to flip them frequently to prevent burning.
When the wontons reach a beautiful golden color, remove them and drain on paper towels.
Finally, arrange the crispy kimchi wontons on a plate and enjoy while hot. You can dip them in chili sauce, mayonnaise, or garlic-chili fish sauce.
Notes:

You can replace canned meat with ham, cold cuts, sausages, or fresh meat according to your preference. However, canned meat provides a certain moisture that prevents the wontons from drying out and keeps the meat soft and tasty.
When frying, adjust the heat appropriately. Start with high heat, but once the oil is very hot, reduce the heat.
Deep-frying helps the wontons brown evenly and prevents them from absorbing too much oil. To save oil, use a deep pan or a small rice cooker.

Crispy kimchi wontons have a special flavor thanks to the combination of kimchi, meat, and cream cheese. They are spicy, sweet, and slightly creamy, balanced by the kimchi, making them very easy to eat and addictive.

mon_an.mo_ta: Spicy potatoes are a dish that is both familiar and unique, using common potatoes and chili powder alongside aromatic spices. These potatoes attract diners with their eye-catching orange-yellow color, mild spicy aroma, and nutty texture. It all comes together for a wonderful dish. Let's get in the kitchen and learn how to make it!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients.
Peel the potatoes and wash them thoroughly with water. Be sure to remove the potato eyes and any green parts!
Once cleaned, cut the potatoes into small, bite-sized cubes.
Step 2: Cooking the spicy potatoes.
First, place a pan on the stove and add a little cooking oil to heat up.

When the oil is hot, add the dried chilies and mustard seeds. At this point, the mustard seeds will start popping; cook until the popping stops. Stir constantly so the mustard and chilies don't burn, which would make the dish smell scorched.
Next, add the potatoes and 1 tsp of salt, stirring well. Ensure the potatoes are evenly coated with salt so they aren't salty in some spots and bland in others.

Then, add the remaining spices: turmeric powder, chili powder, chicken masala, and garam masala. Mix everything thoroughly. Stirring well ensures the potatoes absorb the spices, resulting in a beautiful color and better flavor.
Finally, cover the pan tightly to let the potatoes steam-cook, stirring occasionally with chopsticks.
When the potatoes are tender, scoop them into a bowl and enjoy while hot.
Notes for the best spicy potatoes:
When cooking the potatoes, you can add a tiny bit of water to help them cook faster and prevent sticking. Do not add too much, or it will become a stew rather than the intended dish.
If you cannot eat very spicy food, reduce the amount of chili powder, dried chilies, and mustard seeds.
For this dish, turmeric, chili powder, and salt are essential; the other powders can be omitted if you cannot find them.
How to choose good potatoes:
Choose potatoes that feel heavy, firm, and intact. Smooth skin indicates good quality and taste.
Yellow-fleshed potatoes are usually sweeter and more fragrant than white-fleshed ones.
Choose uniform-sized potatoes for even cooking.
Avoid potatoes with wrinkled skin or those that feel soft when squeezed.
Do not choose potatoes with spots, holes, black eyes, rot, or those leaking fluid.

Avoid potatoes with scratched skin as they rot quickly during storage. Most importantly, never choose potatoes with skin turning green or those that have sprouted, as sprouted potatoes are toxic and harmful to health.

mon_an.mo_ta: Grilled clams and boiled snails are simple dishes with easy-to-find ingredients, yet they offer a delicious and nutritious flavor. They are perfect for a relaxing weekend with friends or as a snack for your husband. Here is a guide to making these simple, tasty treats for a weekend gathering!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Clams, butter, minced garlic, pepper - Ingredients
Snails, a few lime leaves - Ingredients
Lemongrass and chili fish sauce for serving - Ingredients
cac_buoc: Grilled Clams with Garlic Butter:
After buying the clams, soak and wash them clean. Use a knife to pry open the shells and rinse under cold water to remove any sand inside.
Place them on a grilling rack and scoop a little butter and minced garlic onto each clam.
Place in the oven for about 5 minutes at 200°C.
Once cooked, remove and add pepper and a pinch of salt. Serve hot.
Boiled Snails with Lime Leaves:
Soak the snails in cold water, then shake and wash them thoroughly.
Place them in a pot with lime leaves and a tiny bit of water. Steam for 2 to 5 minutes until cooked.
How to make lemongrass fish sauce:
Mix 2 tbsp warm water, 1 tbsp fish sauce, and 1 tbsp sugar until dissolved.
Add 1 tbsp lemon juice, minced lemongrass, and minced chili to taste.
Adjust the seasoning until it is perfectly sweet and sour.
Serve the seafood with the sweet and sour lemongrass fish sauce.
Notes:
If you don't want to pry open raw clams, you can microwave them for 10 to 30 seconds until they open.
When making the fish sauce, stir the sugar and water until dissolved before adding the fish sauce. Finally, add the lemon, garlic/ginger, and chili so they float on top for a better presentation.

mon_an.mo_ta: This Tet, enrich your candy tray with candied red beans! They are delicious, sweet, and have an eye-catching red color that brings good luck. Instead of just store-bought sweets, why not try making this at home? The method is very simple!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Soak the red beans in warm water overnight. Then, drain them in a colander and rinse with cold water several times.
Step 2:
Boil a pot of water with a pinch of salt and baking soda. When the water boils, add the beans and cook over medium heat until tender. Once soft, drain and rinse with cold water.
Step 3:

In a pot, combine 100g sugar, 200ml water, and the red beans. Cook over low heat so the syrup slowly absorbs into the beans. Cook until the water evaporates, then turn off the heat. The beans should be soft and plump.
Step 4:

Place the beans and 150g sugar in a non-stick pan. Stir gently until the sugar melts. Then, cook over low heat (sên). Occasionally stir gently until the sugar crystallizes into a white coating around the beans and they are dry, then turn off the heat.
Step 5:
Pour the candied red beans onto a tray to cool and dry.
Once cooled, store them in a glass jar with a lid in a cool place.
With this method, you are guaranteed plump, nutty, and soft candied red beans. Serving these on a plate with a pot of tea for New Year guests is wonderful.

mon_an.mo_ta: Finished candied green papaya has a beautiful appearance with tiny sugar crystals coating each strip. The papaya is crunchy, fragrant, rich, and moderately sweet. This treat will make your Tet candy box stand out. With just a little time in the kitchen and familiar ingredients, you can make this delicious, unique treat for the whole family!
cac_buoc: How to make candied green papaya:
Step 1: Peel the papaya and remove the seeds. Shred into long or short strips as desired, then rinse with cold water to maintain crunchiness.

Step 2: Soak the papaya in clarified limewater mixed with a little salt and lemon juice for about 3 hours. Remove and rinse thoroughly with cold water several times. Soaking in limewater ensures the finished candy has a beautiful color and a crunchy texture.

Step 3: Boil a pot of water with a pinch of salt. When boiling, add the papaya and blanch for 5–7 minutes, then drain. Immediately soak the papaya in ice water for 10–15 minutes, then rinse with cold water and drain. The ice bath is crucial for maintaining the crunch.

Step 4: Place the papaya, sugar, pomelo flower water (optional), and 100ml cold water into a non-stick pan and mix well. Let it sit for 30 minutes to 1 hour for the sugar to dissolve, then place on the stove over low heat.

Step 5: While cooking, stir occasionally so the sugar absorbs evenly. When you see white sugar crystals forming around the papaya strips, lower the heat further, let it dry a bit more, then turn off the stove. Let the candied papaya cool completely before storing in a sealed bag.
Notes for delicious candied papaya:
How to choose good papaya:
If choosing papaya to eat fresh:

Choose long, heavy fruits that are evenly ripe with sticky sap at the stem; these are sweet, fragrant, have few seeds, and thick flesh. Large, round fruits that look ripe but have dry stems are often artificially ripened and will have many seeds and thin flesh.
Avoid buying papaya if it has rained in the previous few days, as the fruit will be bland.
The best variety is "two-skin" papaya: yellow skin with tiny green spots, elongated shape, and dense flesh.
If buying for salads or candy: Choose "duck-beak" (mỏ vịt) papaya that is freshly picked and still firm. If picked long ago, the flesh softens and won't be crunchy when shredded.
If choosing for cooking: Choose just-ripe papaya. Overripe papaya will turn mushy when cooked, making the broth cloudy.

Finished candied green papaya has a beautiful appearance with tiny sugar crystals coating each strip. The papaya is crunchy, fragrant, rich, and moderately sweet. This treat will make your Tet candy box stand out. With just a little time in the kitchen and familiar ingredients, you can make this delicious, unique treat for the whole family!

mon_an.mo_ta: Instead of the usual candied coconut this Tet, change things up with this simple yet wonderful candied pineapple!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Ingredients for sliced candied pineapple: - Pineapple - 2 units
Ingredients for candied pineapple balls: - 1 ripe pineapple
cac_buoc: Once you have prepared all the ingredients, let's start making candied pineapple with the instructions below!
There are two ways to make candied pineapple for your reference; choose whichever you like as both have their own unique deliciousness!
Step 1:
Peel the pineapple, making sure to cut deep enough to remove the eyes. Slice into rounds and remove the core.
Tip: If you don't know how to peel a pineapple, you can ask the seller to do it for you!
Soak the pineapple in cold water mixed with 1 tsp of salt for about 15 minutes, then remove and rinse.
Next, boil 2 liters of water with 5g of alum. Blanch the pineapple for about 10 minutes, then remove and rinse thoroughly with cold water to wash away any remaining alum.
Step 2:
After rinsing, leave the pineapple in a breezy place for about 2 hours to drain completely.
Next, place the pineapple in a clean pot and add the sugar. Let it sit until the sugar dissolves completely or leave it overnight to marinate.
Then, simmer the pineapple over low heat until the slices become translucent. Add lemon juice and continue to simmer until the pineapple is chewy and sweet-and-sour, then turn off the heat.
Step 3:
If you want the pineapple to be dry, bake it in the oven at 100°C for about 1 hour. Let it cool and store in a glass jar.
With this method, you will have an extremely attractive treat for your guests!
Pineapple Balls:
If you don't like slices, you can make pineapple balls, which are just as delicious!
Peel and remove the eyes just like the sliced version.
Finely mince the pineapple and squeeze out some of the juice. Mix the pineapple, salt, and sugar in a pot or non-stick pan.
Let it sit for about 1 hour for the sugar to dissolve, then place the pan on the stove over low heat for about 10 minutes.
Lower the heat further and continue to simmer until the mixture starts to become sticky. Add the lemon juice and honey, and simmer for another 10-15 minutes until it thickens, then turn off the heat.
Finally, let the mixture cool slightly, then roll into small balls and coat them in white sugar.
It's so simple to have delicious candied pineapple for Tet!
Although it takes some time, the effort is well worth it. Each method has its own flavor; if you have time, try both.

mon_an.mo_ta: Candied young coconut features attractive pieces with a gentle aroma. When eaten, the coconut is slightly crunchy yet chewy, infused with fragrance and moderate sweetness. This is an excellent choice for your Tet candy collection! Check out our guide for making delicious candied young coconut below!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients.

First, use a knife to split the coconut into four. Use a sturdy spoon to scoop out the young meat (since it's young coconut, it's hard to shave long, thin ribbons like mature coconut, so don't worry about keeping the pieces whole).

Next, peel off the brown outer skin and slice the coconut into bite-sized pieces or strips about the size of a chopstick (slices take a bit longer to cook). You can also use decorative cutters for better presentation.
Wash the coconut with water to remove the coconut oil. Repeat several times until the water runs clear.
Step 2: Execution steps.
First, boil a pot of water and blanch the coconut for about 1 minute. Drain well in a colander.

Next, put 1/3 of the sugar and the fresh milk into a pan. Heat over low heat until the milk is warm, stirring to dissolve the sugar. Add 1/3 of the coconut and cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally. (We cook the milk flavor first to reuse any leftover sugar for the next batch).

When the syrup thickens, reduce the heat to the lowest setting. Simmer and stir constantly so the sugar crystallizes into a white coating. Since young coconut slices are thick, if you don't dry them thoroughly, they may release moisture and become soggy after a few hours.

Once the sugar has crystallized, continue stirring on the stove for another 10-15 minutes. It is done when the inside of a piece feels dry and chewy. Place the milk-flavored coconut on a tray to cool. Add a little water and half of the remaining sugar to the pan, dissolve it, then add half of the remaining coconut.
When the syrup thickens, sprinkle in the cocoa powder, stir well, and reduce to a simmer. Repeat the same process as the milk flavor.
To avoid mixing flavors, use a different pan for the matcha flavor. Follow the same steps as the cocoa version.
To ensure the candied coconut is completely dry, after cooking, spread it on a tray, let it cool, and then place it in the refrigerator for 1-2 days.
Finally, store the candied coconut in glass jars or plastic bags.
Notes for the best 3-flavor candied young coconut:
When drying the candy on the stove, you must use very low heat and stir constantly to prevent the sugar from burning.
Depending on your preference, you can use other flavors like orange, strawberry, or pandan leaf.

mon_an.mo_ta: With no complicated methods or ingredients, candied lotus seeds are incredibly easy to make! Learn how to make them to treat your guests!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Buy lotus seeds that have been peeled and had the bitter hearts removed.
Soak the lotus seeds in water for about 30 minutes.

Step 2: Drain the seeds and place them in a pot with water. Boil until they are tender and floury but still intact, then remove and drop into a bowl of cold water. (Note: when boiling, once it reaches a boil, lower the heat to prevent the seeds from breaking).
Step 3: Once the seeds have cooled completely, drain them in a colander.
Step 4: Marinate the seeds with layers of sugar in a wide pan until absorbed.

Step 5: When the sugar has dissolved, place the pan on the stove over low heat. Simmer until the sugar forms a white coating around the seeds, the seeds separate, and they no longer feel sticky to the touch. Pour the candied seeds onto a large tray, let them cool, and store in a jar.

Small note: Use dried lotus seeds because they hold their shape better than fresh ones. You don't need to soak the seeds in sugar overnight; 45–60 minutes is enough. When boiling, do it twice to remove any remaining skin and keep the seeds white and attractive. Adding a little pomelo flower water during the sugar marination will give the candy a wonderful aroma.
It's very simple. Good luck with your lotus seed candy!

mon_an.mo_ta: Every home has sweets, fruits, and candied treats for Tet guests. This year, instead of the usual varieties, let's make some crispy, nutty candied sweet potatoes!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Peel the sweet potatoes, wash them, and cut them into long rectangular strips.
Step 2:
Mix 50g of lime in water, let the sediment settle, and pour off the clear limewater.
Soak the potatoes in the limewater for about 3 hours. Afterward, remove and rinse with clean water several times to remove the lime smell.
Step 3:
Weigh the potatoes and sugar; for every 1kg of potatoes, use about 500g of sugar.
Marinate the potatoes with sugar until the sugar dissolves completely (about 5 hours). Stir occasionally so the sugar absorbs evenly.
Step 4:
Place the potatoes and syrup in a pan and cook over low heat, stirring occasionally so the sugar absorbs and doesn't burn.
When the syrup is almost gone, turn the heat to a very low simmer and stir constantly. (In this step, you must stir continuously or they will burn and fail).
Step 5:
When the sugar crystallizes into a white coating and the pieces separate, turn off the heat.
Add a few drops of vanilla to the pan and stir for another minute.
Once finished, spread the candy on a large tray. Wait for it to cool completely before storing in an airtight jar!

mon_an.mo_ta: Soft candied kumquat is a familiar treat for many families, featuring delicious pieces with an eye-catching color. When eaten, the kumquats are chewy, soft, and smooth, with a balanced sweet and sour taste and a characteristic citrus aroma. Just spend a little time in the kitchen and you will have a wonderful batch of candied fruit!
cac_buoc: How to make delicious soft candied kumquats
Step 1: First, wash the kumquats thoroughly and soak them in diluted salt water for about 30 minutes to remove impurities. Then, rinse them again with clean water and drain.
Step 2: Next, use a knife to score 5–6 even vertical lines around each kumquat, depending on its size. Scoring helps the sugar penetrate faster and allows the juice to be extracted more easily.
Step 3: Once scored, gently squeeze the kumquats to release the juice; remove all seeds and set the juice aside.

Step 4: Dissolve 30g of slaked lime in 1.5 liters of water, let the sediment settle, and pour off the clear lime water. Soak the squeezed kumquats in this clear lime water for 4–5 hours, then remove and rinse several times with water to remove the lime smell. Soaking in lime water helps the candied kumquats become firm and chewy.

Step 5: Boil 1 liter of water with the alum, add the kumquats to blanch quickly for about 2 minutes, then remove. Rinse the kumquats again with clean water to remove any remaining alum. While rinsing, gently squeeze the kumquats to remove excess water.

Step 6: Marinate the kumquats with sugar and honey for about 30 minutes. Add the reserved kumquat juice from Step 3 and stir well. During the soaking process, stir occasionally so the kumquats absorb the sugar and honey evenly.

Step 7: After soaking, place the kumquats and the syrup in a pan to simmer. Occasionally tilt the pan so the melting sugar flows over the kumquats; stir gently to avoid crushing them. Cook over low heat until the liquid evaporates and the kumquats turn golden, then turn off the heat.
Step 8: Arrange the kumquat pieces on a wire rack with a tray underneath to catch any drips. Air-dry them in the sun until they firm up, or dry them in an oven at 100°C until dry (about 45 minutes).
Once completely dry, remove the candied kumquats and store them in a glass jar for later use.
Tips for delicious candied kumquats
How to choose good kumquats: To make the best candied fruit, choose large, juicy kumquats with a moderate sourness, thick skin, and plenty of pulp. Avoid buying bruised, spoiled, or overripe fruit.
When drying the kumquats, pay close attention to the oven time; avoid leaving them too long as it will ruin the color and cause them to burn easily.
When squeezing the juice out, do not press too hard or you will crush the fruit, which ruins the appearance of the final product.

mon_an.mo_ta: With this simple recipe, you will have a wonderful batch of jelly candy to treat your guests during the Lunar New Year! Check out our guide below. This article provides a detailed tutorial on how to make crispy and chewy agar jelly candy, a traditional and popular treat in Tet culinary culture. From ingredient preparation to the cooking process, you will find all the information needed to create delicious, attractive jelly candy for your Tet spread.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Pomelo blossom essence - A few drops
cac_buoc: 1. Instructions for making crispy agar jelly candy for Tet
Step 1:
Pour the agar-agar powder into a pot containing 1 liter of water.
Step 2:
Use a spoon to dissolve the agar-agar in the water and let it sit for about 30 minutes before cooking.
Step 3:

Place the pot on the stove and simmer over low heat until the powder is completely dissolved. Add the sugar and continue to cook over low heat until the sugar dissolves, making sure to skim off any foam.
Add a few drops of pomelo blossom essence to the pot, then turn off the heat.
Step 4:
Pour the agar mixture into various molds, adding a few drops of food coloring to each mold.
Step 5:
Use a spoon to stir until the color is completely blended. Let it cool, then refrigerate for 3-4 hours until the jelly is firm.
Step 6:
Once the jelly has set, flip it onto a cutting board. Use a crinkle cutter to slice it into strips about 6cm long, 1.5cm wide, and 1cm thick.
Step 7:
Repeat until all the jelly is cut. Do not cut the pieces too small as they will shrink during the drying process.
Step 8:

Arrange the jelly pieces on a tray. There are two drying methods: you can sun-dry the tray for 2-3 days of strong sunlight (cover with a thin mesh cloth to keep away insects). Alternatively, place them in an oven with the door slightly ajar and dry at 60°C until completely dry.
Step 9:
Place the jelly candy into clean glass jars for later use.
2. How to make chewy agar jelly candy using an air fryer
Ingredients for preparation
25g agar-agar powder (crispy or flexible type)
1 passion fruit
200g pandan leaves
50g butterfly pea flowers
30ml coconut milk
30ml coffee and 300g sugar.
How to process chewy agar jelly candy
Creating colors
Yellow: Cut the passion fruit in half and strain the juice to create yellow coloring.
Green: Wash the pandan leaves, chop them, and blend with 50ml of water. Strain through a sieve to get the extract for green coloring.
Blue: Boil 100ml of water, add 50g of butterfly pea flowers, and stir until the water turns blue. This creates the blue coloring.
Cooking the agar
Cooking the agar: In a pot, bring 1.5 liters of water to a boil.
Add 25g of agar-agar powder to the pot and stir well until the powder hydrates. Let the powder soak in the water for about 30 minutes.
Combine colors and boil: After 30 minutes, place the pot on the stove and add 300g of sugar.
Stir the mixture over medium heat until the sugar dissolves and it reaches a light boil, then turn off the heat.
Shaping
Remove the jelly from the molds, then use a knife to cut it into strips about 1/2 a knuckle thick and 1 finger long.
Drying the jelly candy
Arrange the cut jelly pieces in the air fryer.
Dry the candy at 60 - 80°C for about 20 - 30 minutes.
After 30 minutes, let the jelly cool completely, then continue drying for another 30 minutes.
Repeat this process until the jelly is completely dry; the estimated total time is about 6 - 8 hours.

In this article, we have guided you through making crispy agar jelly candy for Tet. First, prepare ingredients like agar powder, passion fruit, pandan leaves, butterfly pea flowers, coconut milk, coffee, and sugar. Next, create natural colors from the passion fruit, pandan, and butterfly pea flowers. Then, cook the agar in boiling water with sugar, stirring and soaking to let the powder bloom. Finally, mix the colors, mold the jelly, and dry it until completely firm. You will have beautiful, crispy agar jelly candy ready to enjoy with your family during the Tet season.

mon_an.mo_ta: This chewy candied mango will make your candy tray much more eye-catching. The mango pieces have a beautiful golden color, a glossy finish, and an inviting aroma. Taking a bite, you will feel the intense mango flavor filling your mouth; the pieces are chewy, flexible, and unique. With just a little time in the kitchen, you can have a new treat ready for the Lunar New Year. Everyone will be delighted by this unusual snack, and you will be beaming with pride from all the compliments!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Lime water (calcium hydroxide solution) - as needed
cac_buoc: How to make delicious chewy candied mango

Step 1: Wash the mangoes, peel, and cut into bite-sized sticks. Next, dissolve the lime water and soak the mango pieces for 4 to 6 hours. Then, remove the mango and rinse thoroughly with water. Remember to soak them for the full duration so that the mango flesh becomes translucent and retains its crunch after processing.
Step 2: Boil a pot with about 1.5 liters of water and dissolve the alum in it. When the water boils, add the mango to blanch it, then transfer to a colander to drain.

Step 3: Once the mango is drained, mix it with sugar at a ratio of 100 g of mango to 80 g of sugar so the sugar can penetrate and dissolve. You should let the mango macerate in the sugar for about 8-10 hours or overnight.
Step 4: Next, place the soaked mango into a deep pan and simmer over low heat. Occasionally stir gently so the mango does not burn at the edges.
Step 5: When the sugar liquid reduces and the candied mango looks translucent, stir more frequently until the sugar becomes syrupy and tacky, then turn off the heat.

Step 6: Arrange the candied mango on a rack to cool, then place it in the oven to dry at 100°C for about 45–60 minutes until completely dry. After that time, remove the mango and store it in an airtight jar in a cool, dry place to enjoy gradually. The candied mango should be fragrant, golden, translucent, and have an appealing chewy texture.
Notes for delicious chewy candied mango
For the mango, choose fruits that are still green, have smooth skin, feel firm to the touch, and have a certain crispness.
The length of the mango pieces depends on personal preference. You can shape them as you like.
When macerating the mango with sugar, remember to stir occasionally so the sugar absorbs evenly and to check when the sugar has mostly or completely dissolved.

When simmering the mango, do not use high heat as it will burn easily and won't become translucent, losing its eye-catching color. Pay attention when the liquid is almost gone; stir faster to prevent the edges from burning and to help the mango dry out.
Once finished, you can add a little vanilla to enhance the aroma of the dish.
The finished chewy candied mango must be golden yellow, translucent, chewy, and rich in mango fragrance.

This chewy candied mango will make your candy tray much more eye-catching. The mango pieces have a beautiful golden color, a glossy finish, and an inviting aroma. Taking a bite, you will feel the intense mango flavor filling your mouth; the pieces are chewy, flexible, and unique. With just a little time in the kitchen, you can have a new treat ready for the Lunar New Year. Everyone will be delighted by this unusual snack, and you will be beaming with pride from all the compliments!

mon_an.mo_ta: With familiar ingredients and a bit of meticulousness, you can create a stunning gingerbread house with eye-catching colors and a delicious flavor. It is a very meaningful Christmas gift for friends and relatives! Spend some time in the kitchen and show off your cooking skills! Discover detailed instructions to create sparkling gingerbread houses made from fragrant ginger flour. Refer to this guide now to create beautiful gingerbread houses and bring joy and memorable memories to your family and friends!
cac_buoc: 1. How to make a beautiful gingerbread house
Step 1: Make the dough for the house frame

First, put the granulated sugar, butter, syrup, cinnamon, and cloves into a pot over heat and stir until the mixture is completely melted. Then, add the milk, stir well, and let it cool. In another bowl, mix the flour with baking soda. When the liquid mixture has cooled, add the dry mixture and knead thoroughly, then wrap in plastic wrap and leave overnight in the refrigerator.
Step 2: House templates
Cut pieces of parchment paper to the sizes shown (2 – the parts after cutting and baking)
Two gables: measure the parchment paper to cut 3 sides with a width of 15cm, a roof length of 11cm, and a gable height of 18cm.
One back wall: a rectangle with a length of 27cm and a width of 15cm. Cut a heart shape in the middle.
One front wall: same size as the back wall (27x15cm) but with a door. The front door is slightly rounded, 6.5cm wide and 10cm high. There are two side windows 7cm high and 4cm wide.
2 roof pieces: rectangular, 27cm wide and 13.5cm high.
Step 3:

Preheat the oven to 170°C. Place the dough on a flat surface, roll it thin, then place the paper templates on the dough and use a sharp knife to cut the dough according to the patterns. Use heart cutters to cut heart shapes in the gables or the back wall. Set aside the dough from the front door. Also cut extra heart shapes to use as shingles for the roof.
Next, sprinkle the crushed mint candies into the cut-out heart shapes, then bake the gingerbread house frames for about 10 minutes.
After baking, let the cookies cool completely.
Step 4: Make the icing

Put the egg white, vinegar, and powdered sugar in a bowl and use a mixer to beat until stiff peaks form. Then, cover tightly so the mixture does not come into contact with air. Next, put the mixture into a piping bag and decorate the house frames on the windows, walls, or roof as desired.
Edible glue: melt sugar until it turns into a thick syrup with a color similar to the cookies—pay close attention as sugar burns very easily.
Step 5: Assemble the house

Assemble the heart shapes onto the roof by dipping the hearts into the melted sugar glue. Do the same to assemble the sides of the house. You can use a spoon to drizzle more sugar syrup to help the house stick more firmly.
After assembly, use the remaining icing to decorate the house with icicles and sprinkle powdered sugar to create a snow effect for a more beautiful house.
Finally, after completing these steps, you have a stunning gingerbread house for this Christmas season!

With familiar ingredients and a bit of meticulousness, you can create a stunning gingerbread house with eye-catching colors and a delicious flavor. It is a very meaningful Christmas gift for friends and relatives! Spend some time in the kitchen and show off your cooking skills!
2. Traditional Gingerbread Cookie Recipe
Ingredients
All-purpose flour: 210 g
Cinnamon powder: 3 g
Ginger powder: 5 g
Baking soda: 1/2 tsp
Unsalted butter: 85 g
Brown sugar: 50 g
Honey: 2 tsp
Egg: 1
Salt: 1 pinch
Powdered sugar: 150 g
Food coloring: as needed
Egg white: 1
Steps to make gingerbread cookies
Mix the dough
Mix the flour, cinnamon, ginger, and baking soda together to ensure a uniform mixture.
Cream 85g of unsalted butter with 50g of brown sugar. Then, add 50g of honey and stir well to create a smooth mixture.
Add 1 egg to the butter and sugar mixture, stirring well to combine.
Roll and bake
Gradually add the dry flour mixture to the butter-egg mixture, mixing well until a smooth dough forms. Then, wrap the dough in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
Roll the dough to a thickness of about 0.5cm, then use cookie cutters to create shapes as desired for the gingerbread house.
Place the cookies in the oven and bake at 165°C for about 12 - 15 minutes, until the cookies turn a light golden brown.
Make decorative icing
Beat 150g of powdered sugar with 1 egg white until the mixture is smooth and uniform.
Divide the mixture into 3 equal parts and add food coloring as desired to each part.
Pour each part of the mixture into a piping bag or icing bag to decorate the cookies as you like.
Using the piping bag, decorate the cookies according to your preference.
3. Eggless Gingerbread Cookie Recipe
Whole wheat flour: 140 g
Softened butter: 115 g
Vanilla extract: 1 tsp
Orange zest: 1 tsp
Baking powder: 1 tsp
Baking soda: 1 tsp
Powdered sugar: 240 g
Cloves: 1/8 tsp
Ginger powder: 1/4 tsp
Brown sugar: 100 g
Palm sugar: 50 g
Warm milk: 3.5 tbsp
Cinnamon: 1/4 tsp
How to make eggless gingerbread cookies
Mix the ingredients

First, in a bowl, place 115g of softened butter and use a whisk to mash it until smooth. Then, add 100g of brown sugar and 50g of palm sugar. If you don't have brown or palm sugar, you can substitute with 150g of granulated sugar.

Next, continue to stir well to combine the ingredients and spices. Then, add 1 tsp of vanilla extract and 1 tsp of finely grated orange zest. Continue mixing to ensure the components are well blended.

In another bowl, add 140g of all-purpose flour, 140g of whole wheat flour, 1 tsp of baking powder, 1 tsp of baking soda, 1/4 tsp of ginger powder, 1/4 tsp of cinnamon, and 1/8 tsp of cloves. Mix the dry ingredients well.
Then, pour 3.5 tbsp of warm milk into the bowl and continue to mix. To make the dough smoother, you can knead it directly by hand.
Once kneaded to the right consistency, place the bowl in the refrigerator to cool for 10 to 15 minutes.
Shape and bake
Start by taking the dough from the refrigerator and placing it between two sheets of parchment paper to prevent it from sticking to the rolling pin.
Next, roll the dough until it reaches a thickness of about 1/2 inch, then remove the top layer of parchment paper.
Continue by pressing cookie cutters in your favorite shapes into the dough to form the cookies.
Next, place a sheet of parchment paper on a baking tray and arrange the shaped cookies on top.
Then, place the tray in the oven and bake for about 10 minutes at 170°C.

When the cookies are baked, remove them from the oven and let them cool. Next, mix 1 egg white and 240g of powdered sugar to create royal icing. You can use a piping bag to decorate your cookies. Once the icing is ready, you can start decorating and finish the cookie-making process.

mon_an.ten: Refreshing Lychee and Aloe Vera Drink
mon_an.mo_ta: Lychee aloe vera is a rather unique drink for many, but you will love it from the first taste. With fresh, sweet aloe vera and juicy lychees served with ice or cold yogurt, it brings a refreshing sensation to the drinker.
cac_buoc: Preparing the aloe vera:
First, wash the aloe vera to remove dirt and impurities.
Next, cut off the thorns on both sides of the aloe vera leaves.
Then, cut into sections about 5cm long. Use a knife to peel off the green skin of the aloe vera. Note: peel carefully to remove all the green part as it is very bitter.
Next, rinse the aloe vera slime under running water.
After that, dice the aloe vera into small cubes and bring a pot of water to a boil. Blanch the aloe vera in boiling water to remove all slime and bitterness.
Finally, remove the aloe vera and drain. Then mix the aloe vera with 30g of sugar and store in the refrigerator.
Preparing the lychees:
Wash the lychees with water, then peel and remove the seeds. If the lychees are not clean, rinse them again with filtered water.
How to make the delicious lychee aloe vera drink
Put the cleaned lychees and half of the sugar-soaked aloe vera from the refrigerator into a blender. Blend until smooth (you can add ice if you want to drink it cold).
Then, pour the blended juice into a glass, add 1-2 teaspoons of the remaining aloe vera on top, and enjoy.
Notes for a delicious lychee aloe vera drink
How to choose good lychees
*- Color:* The exterior of the lychees should look fresh and bright, and the fruits should be uniform in size.
Flavor: When tasted, the lychee should be sweet and fragrant.

*- Seeds:* Small seeds indicate good lychees. Seeds that are easy to separate and jet black mean the lychee is perfectly ripe and should be bought. Pinkish seeds that are hard to peel from the flesh indicate the fruit is still green and will be sour.

Flesh: Thin skin, thick flesh, translucent white, soft, and juicy. If the flesh is discolored or dry, the lychee has been kept for a long time and is of poor quality. If there is a smell of alcohol or the flesh has an unusual color, absolutely do not use it.

Lychees are best when just ripe. If the skin is hard, the fruit is green; if it is soft but elastic, it is perfectly ripe. If it is soft without elasticity, the fruit is overripe and will not taste good.
Other ways to process aloe vera:
Method 1:
Cut the aloe vera into small pieces, peel off the green skin, dice it, and soak in a bowl of water mixed with a few drops of lemon juice and diluted salt water.
Gently rub each piece of aloe vera to clean off all the slime. Remove to a colander and rinse under running water while shaking well.

You can toss the aloe vera with a little sugar and put it in a jar with a lid, storing it in the refrigerator. When eating, you can take it out and use it directly; at this point, the aloe vera pieces have absorbed the sugar and have a pleasant sweet, cool taste.
Method 2:
Cut the aloe vera in half, remove the thorns on both sides, and use a sharp knife to peel the skin.
Cut the aloe vera into small pieces, depending on the dish being prepared.
Put the cut aloe vera into a bowl and use fine salt to gently massage out the slime.
After massaging with salt, rinse thoroughly with cold water until the aloe vera is no longer slimy.

Bring a pot of water to a boil, add the aloe vera to blanch quickly, then remove immediately and soak in ice water. The aloe vera will be very white, crunchy, and no longer slimy or bitter. Similar to Method 1, you can toss the aloe vera with a little sugar and store it in the refrigerator for gradual use.

mon_an.ten: Refreshing Mulberry Juice to Beat the Heat
mon_an.mo_ta: As summer begins, stay refreshed and energized with this quick and easy mulberry juice recipe. Grab your ingredients and let's get started!
cac_buoc: Prepare these ingredients for a cool and delicious mulberry drink!
Step 1: Choose fresh, plump, ripe mulberries. Wash them gently 2 to 3 times to clean, then drain well.

Step 2: Place a pot of water on the stove and bring to a boil with 1 tbsp of salt. Let the water cool slightly, then add the mulberries to blanch for about 3 minutes. This step prevents the mulberries from forming a film or fermenting during soaking or syrup making. Remove and let dry.
Step 3: Clean the glass jars, rinse with very hot water, and wipe completely dry.
Step 4: Spread a layer of mulberries at the bottom of the glass jar. Next, spread a layer of sugar over the mulberries. Repeat this process until all the mulberries and sugar are used.

Step 5: Seal the jar tightly and leave it in a cool place for about 2 days until the sugar has completely dissolved. Press to extract the juice, then strain through a sieve to collect the liquid; set the fruit pulp aside. (The pulp can be repurposed for making mulberry wine).
You can also simmer both the berries and the juice together, strain to get the mulberry syrup, and cook the fruit down into jam.

Step 6: Place the freshly strained mulberry juice in a pot on the stove and bring to a boil over low heat. Once boiling, stir gently and let it simmer for another 5 minutes, then turn off the heat. Let the juice cool completely before pouring into bottles or glass jars and storing in the refrigerator for later use.
The syrup has a very characteristic mulberry aroma. When you want to drink it, simply mix with water and add ice for a refreshing glass of mulberry juice to cool down in the summer.

mon_an.mo_ta: Have you ever tasted a delicious Papparoti? With its fragrant buttery flavor, crispy outer crust, and soft interior, Papparoti has become a unique and attractive treat. From making the signature crust to the premium filling, you will discover a simple yet exciting recipe to create these tasty buns. Let's explore how to make irresistible Papparoti in the article below! Today we will guide you through the steps; please follow along.
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients for Papparoti:
Gather all the necessary baking ingredients.
Prepare the tools: mixing bowl, electric mixer, oven, towel for proofing, plastic wrap, piping bag, and rolling pin.
Steps to make delicious and attractive Papparoti:
Step 1: Prepare the dough first
First, dissolve 40g of sugar in 70ml of warm water, add the yeast, and continue stirring until the ingredients are dissolved.

Step 2: In another bowl, add the flour, milk, and the yeast mixture. Use a mixer to blend until you get a soft, fluffy, and smooth mixture where all ingredients are well combined. If you don't have a mixer, you can whisk by hand until the mixture reaches this consistency.
Step 3: Once the mixture is well combined, add the egg and continue beating. Then, add the butter and mix again.
Step 4: When the mixture is smooth and uniform, knead for 5 minutes. Shape the dough into a ball and place it in the bowl.
Step 5: Cover the bowl with a clean towel and place it over another bowl of hot water. Proof for 30 minutes or until the dough has doubled in size.
Step 6: Prepare the filling!
Take the butter for the filling and divide it into 8 equal portions, rolling them into balls. Wrap tightly in plastic wrap and place in the refrigerator.
Step 7: Prepare the topping!
Place the butter and powdered sugar for the topping in a bowl. Use a mixer to beat until smooth, creamy, and well combined.
Step 8: Add the egg and continue to beat well.
Step 9: Next, dissolve the instant coffee in 10ml of hot water and add it to the mixture, beating well.
Step 10: Finally, add the flour and beat until the topping is uniform and well blended. Put the topping into a piping bag and refrigerate for 10 minutes to let it firm up slightly.
Step 11: Shape and bake the buns.
After 30 minutes, take the dough out. Press down on the dough with your hands to release all the air.
Step 12: Divide the dough into 8 equal portions and roll each into a ball. Flatten each portion so that the edges are thin and the center is thick.
Step 13: Place a portion of the filling in the center and roll it back into a ball. Ensure the filling is completely sealed so the butter doesn't leak out during baking.
Step 14: Place the buns on a baking tray. Pipe the topping in a spiral pattern over the buns, covering about 1/3 to 2/3 of the surface.
Step 15: Bake the buns for 15 minutes at 180°C. After 15 minutes, the buns will be evenly cooked, crispy, and smell wonderful!
Notes for perfect Papparoti:
Make sure to mix thoroughly after adding each new ingredient.
When piping the topping, do not use too much; as it bakes, covering 1/3 or 2/3 is enough for it to melt and coat the entire top of the bun.
Besides butter, you can use chocolate for the filling to enjoy a molten chocolate center.
How to tell if the dough is ready for Papparoti:
The dough should be soft, smooth, and have good elasticity.
Non-sticky: When you press into it, it should feel light but not stick to your finger when you pull away.
The dough can be stretched into a thin layer without tearing.
Check the dough using the Windowpane technique: Take a small piece of dough and stretch it out. If it forms a thin, translucent membrane that doesn't tear easily, the dough is ready.

mon_an.ten: Easy and Delicious Microwave Ricotta Cheese Recipe
mon_an.mo_ta: Making your own cheese for family breakfasts with toast, fried eggs, or fresh fruit is truly wonderful.
cac_buoc: Here are the ingredients you need to prepare:
Step 1:
First, fold the cheesecloth in half and line the inside of the pot with it, then set aside (as shown in the image).
Step 2:
Next, squeeze the lemons. If you have a juicer, use it to save time and extract all the juice; otherwise, use the manual method, as long as you have 60ml of lemon juice.
Step 3:
Prepare a glass bowl (the microwave-safe one mentioned in the ingredients), and pour the heavy cream and fresh milk into the bowl.
Step 4:
Add a little salt and the freshly squeezed lemon juice, then use a spoon to stir everything well.
Step 5:
Now, place the mixture into the microwave and microwave on high.
The ideal time is 3 minutes; if exceeded, the milk may overflow. You only need enough time for the milk to get hot and curdle.
Step 6:
When you see the milk mixture has curdled and reached a temperature of 93.3°C, it is time to press the cheese.
Step 7:

When removing the milk mixture from the microwave, do not use your bare hands; remember to use oven mitts or a thick towel to take the glass bowl out, otherwise it will be very hot and you could get burned.
Step 8:
Use a spoon to scoop the curds into the pot lined with cheesecloth for straining (prepared in step 1).
Step 9:
After scooping out all the curds, pour the remaining liquid mixture into the pot.
The curds you see on the cheesecloth are the Ricotta cheese we need.
Step 10:
Depending on your or your family's preference for soft and moist or firm and dry cheese, simply let the cheese drain for 30 minutes to 1.5 hours.
Finally, transfer the Ricotta cheese into a clean glass jar, seal tightly, keep in the refrigerator, and use within 1 week!
Above is the guide on how to make Ricotta cheese using a microwave. It's quite simple, isn't it?
But don't worry if you don't have a microwave; here is the guide for making cheese on a regular stove below!
First, mix the heavy cream + fresh milk + a bit of salt in a pot and heat on the stove until the milk is hot (do not let it boil) reaching 93.3°C, over medium heat for 15-20 minutes.

When you remove the mixture from the heat, add the lemon juice and stir gently with a spoon so the lemon juice dissolves into the milk. Let the mixture sit for 5-10 minutes for the milk to curdle and form curds.
Finally, just use a spoon to scoop the curds and pour the remaining liquid into the pot with the strainer and wait until the cheese is drained.
It's so easy to have delicious cheese; just spread a layer of cheese on toast, accompanied by some fresh fruit or fried eggs... and you have a "delicious" breakfast.

mon_an.ten: Crispy Sugar-Coated Fried Dough Sticks Recipe
mon_an.mo_ta: Sugar-coated fried dough sticks are a fun snack that is not only delicious but also very wholesome. The sticks are bite-sized, offering a crunchy texture and a light sweetness. Enjoying these sticks with a fragrant cup of tea is a wonderful choice for chilly winter afternoons. They are also perfect for a candy tray during the Lunar New Year. Let's make this dish to experience some delightful moments! Enjoy a tasty snack - crispy sugar sticks with moderate sweetness. Guide to making delicious sugar sticks at home. A perfect choice for winter afternoons and Tet holiday candy trays.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Mixing the dough
In a bowl, combine 100g glutinous rice flour, 50g rice flour, 5 tbsp sugar, and 1/4 tsp salt.
Mix the flour components well with a spoon.
Pour hot water into the flour:
Slowly pour 120ml of hot water (about 70-80 degrees Celsius) into the bowl containing the flour.
While pouring, stir the flour simultaneously to create a uniform mixture without dry flour lumps.
Step 2: Kneading and proofing the dough
Use your hands to knead the dough in the bowl, lifting the dough from the bottom and pulling it up, then pressing it down.
Continue kneading several times until the dough becomes smooth, elastic, and does not stick to your hands.
After kneading, cover the bowl tightly with a damp cloth and let the dough rest for 30 minutes to allow it to rise and soften.
Step 3: Shaping the sticks
Sprinkle a small amount of dry glutinous rice flour onto the work surface.
Take a desired amount of dough and spread it out on the work surface.
Using your palms, roll the dough into a long piece of any length.
Fold the dough piece in half and twist the two ends together, creating a rope shape.
Repeat with the remaining dough until finished.
Step 4: Frying the sticks
Pour enough oil into a pan so that the dough sticks can be submerged.
Heat the oil over medium heat to a temperature of about 180 degrees Celsius.
When the oil is hot enough, drop each dough stick into the pan.
Fry for about 2-3 minutes or until the sticks are a beautiful golden color and crispy.
Use a large tray or a plate lined with paper towels to remove the sticks from the pan and drain the excess oil.
Step 5: Sugar coating
Prepare a small pan over low heat.
Add 4 tbsp sugar and 20ml water to the pan.
Heat the pan and stir well until the sugar melts and blends with the water.
When the sugar has completely dissolved and starts bubbling, add each fried dough stick to the pan.
Use a spoon to flip and toss the sticks so they are evenly coated with the sugar layer.
Turn off the heat and let the sticks cool in the pan so the sugar layer adheres firmly.

When the dish is finished, it has a beautiful golden color, bringing sweetness and crunchiness. As you enjoy it, childhood memories might come rushing back like rain. It is no exaggeration to call it a gift from childhood.
Notes when making sugar-coated fried dough sticks

Boiling sugar and water: When boiling sugar and water to create the coating mixture, ensure the heat is on low so the sugar can melt without burning. Stir the mixture well to ensure the sugar dissolves completely without any grains remaining.

Temperature of the mixture: Once the sugar and water mixture has melted and bubbled, turn off the heat and let it cool slightly before adding the dough sticks. If the mixture is too hot, it may cause the sticks to melt or absorb too much sugar.
Tossing the sticks: When adding the dough sticks to the sugar mixture, use a spoon to flip and toss them gently. Ensure the sticks are evenly covered with a thin, attractive layer of sugar.
Cooling time: After the sticks are coated in sugar, let them cool in the pan or on a tray so the sugar layer hardens. This will create a crispy and glossy sugar shell on the sticks.

Be careful when handling hot sugar: The hot sugar mixture is very hot, so be careful not to let it spill or burn your skin. Use appropriate tools like spoons, tongs, or chopsticks to handle the sugar safely.

mon_an.mo_ta: Coconut milk yogurt is basically not much different from regular yogurt. Coconut milk yogurt is a very healthy refreshment; yogurt not only beautifies and brightens the skin but is also good for the digestive system. You should eat yogurt with fruit around 3 PM or in the morning. Additionally, after a meal, if you want to eat yogurt, you should let your body rest for 30 minutes after eating so the digestive system can function at its best. With homemade yogurt, free of preservatives and tailored to your taste, you will enjoy it thoroughly and provide your family with a healthy refreshment!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, heat the coconut milk and sweetener on the stove until boiling, then turn off the heat.
After that, pour the boiled coconut milk into a glass bowl and let it cool down to about 46 degrees Celsius.

While waiting for the coconut milk to cool, dissolve the gelatin powder in a little cold water. Then, stir the coconut milk into the gelatin water until well combined. If you cannot find gelatin, you can substitute it with a packet of jelly powder, but using gelatin will be tastier and more fragrant.
Step 2:
When the coconut milk has reached 46 degrees Celsius, add the probiotics and stir well.

Next, pour this mixture into a clean glass jar with a tight lid. Close the lid tightly and place it in a yogurt maker or a closed oven to keep light out. In an oven, setting the temperature to about 37 degrees Celsius is best, or place the yogurt jar in an insulated container with warm water, set on a heating pad at a low temperature, etc. Basically, whichever method you use, you just need to keep these yogurt jars at a temperature of about 40-45 degrees Celsius.
Step 3:

The yogurt should be fermented for at least 8 hours or even longer. You can experiment with the time for each batch to find the most suitable fermentation time. If you don't have a yogurt maker or an oven, you can leave it in the sun for about 8 hours, but wrap it in a towel or cover the top to avoid dust.
Step 4:

The yogurt at this stage is still quite thin. Once fermentation is finished, keep the lid tightly closed and place it in the refrigerator for at least 6 hours. At this point, the fermentation process will stop completely, and the yogurt will become thicker and ready to enjoy.
Finally, when the yogurt is set, take it out to enjoy.
Notes for delicious coconut milk yogurt:
If you use agar-agar powder as a thickener, you should use warm water to dissolve it in step 1.
When serving, you can add fruits like strawberries, blueberries, etc., or honey to enhance the flavor. Additionally, if you want to add color to the yogurt, you can add your favorite syrups.

mon_an.ten: Warm Corn Milk for Chilly Days
mon_an.mo_ta: What could be better than sipping a glass of warm corn milk with your family in this weather?
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel the corn and remove the silk. Place the corn in a pot and boil with 1.5 liters of water and washed pandan leaves.
Step 2: Once the corn is cooked, remove it and let it cool, then use a knife to cut the kernels off the cob. Remove and discard the pandan leaves.
Step 3: Put the corn kernels and the boiling water into a blender and blend until smooth.
Next, strain the corn mixture through a sieve. Finally, put the corn pulp into a thin cloth and squeeze firmly to extract all the liquid.
Step 4: Pour the filtered corn milk and pandan leaves into a pot and simmer over low heat. Stir constantly while cooking to prevent the milk from burning at the bottom of the pot.
When the liquid boils, add the milk and continue stirring until it reaches a light simmer, then turn off the heat.
Pour the corn milk into cups and enjoy. You can also add a little ice or serve it chilled!

A cup of corn milk contains many different vitamins such as vitamin B, B1, B5, and B3, which help the brain function well and improve forgetfulness. The high vitamin B content in corn milk helps maintain blood sugar levels so the brain can function well for a long time under high pressure. Therefore, there is no reason to refuse such a delicious and attractive drink in winter!

mon_an.ten: Sweet and Refreshing Tào Phớ for Summer
mon_an.mo_ta: "Who wants tào phớ... tào phớ here..." This street cry has become familiar to Hanoians during summer days. Tào phớ is a street food that is delicious, cheap, and refreshing. After one bowl, you will want a second to satisfy the summer heat. Have you ever thought about making a delicious bowl of tào phớ yourself just like the street vendors? It is very simple because today we will guide you on how to make sweet and refreshing tào phớ for summer, which is incredibly easy and as good as the shops. You can find Glucono Delta-Lactone (GDL) on many websites and the price is not too expensive. Making tào phớ with GDL is much faster and easier than using gelatin.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Soak the soybeans in water for about 4-6 hours, then remove the skins.

Step 2: If you have a soy milk maker, simply put the peeled beans into the machine with 800ml of water to obtain 800ml of soy milk. However, the machine's filter is often not fine enough, so you should strain it one more time to ensure the soy milk is free of residue.
If you don't have a machine, you can use a blender to grind the beans finely, then put them in a cloth bag and squeeze thoroughly to obtain 800ml of soy milk.
Boil the obtained soy milk over low heat for about 10 minutes.

Step 3: The setting mechanism of GDL requires high heat, so you should use a rice cooker liner to hold the tào phớ. Dissolve the GDL with a little water just enough to coat the bottom of the pot; only perform this step when the soy milk has boiled because GDL turns sour very quickly.
Step 4: Cover the rice cooker lid loosely to prevent condensation from dripping onto the surface of the tào phớ. Keep the pot still for about 30 minutes until the tào phớ sets.
After coating the pot, quickly pour the boiling soy milk into the rice cooker.
Use a spoon to skim off all the bubbles on the surface of the soy milk.

Step 5: Prepare the syrup by dissolving sugar in water and boiling it with a bundle of pandan leaves. Let the syrup cool and then place it in the refrigerator to chill thoroughly. You can roll the pandan leaves tightly before boiling so they can be removed more easily.

Step 6: When serving, use a flat spoon to scoop thin layers of tào phớ into a bowl. Pour the chilled syrup into the bowl and add a few slices of dried coconut. You can also replace the syrup with soy milk for a soy milk tào phớ that is just as delicious!
Enjoy your homemade tào phớ!

mon_an.mo_ta: Watermelon jelly with its beautiful appearance catches the eye, and the fragrant watermelon aroma mixed with a bit of alcohol creates an attractive flavor. Watermelon jelly is a delicious snack that brings a cool sensation to the eater. Let's learn how to make this delicious dish!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients for the wonderful watermelon jelly
Wash the lemons and cut them into two equal halves.
Next, use a melon baller to scoop out small pieces of watermelon until finished, while removing the seeds.
After scooping, put them into a large bowl for easy mixing.
Step 2: Steps to make wonderful watermelon jelly.
First, use a juicer or a manual tool to squeeze out all the lemon juice. Place a strainer over the juicer to remove all lemon seeds and pulp.
Then, pour the lemon juice into a jar to use for other purposes.
After squeezing the juice, use your hands or a knife to remove the remaining pulp from the lemon rinds until they are clean.
Next, place the lemon rinds into a muffin tin, letting the rinds touch the sides of the mold so that when we pour the jelly liquid in, the rinds will not tip over.
Then, pour the vodka and watermelon liqueur into the bowl of watermelon.
Mix the watermelon and alcohol. Use a spoon to both mix and press out more watermelon juice.
After mixing and pressing for juice, pour the water into a small pot and bring to a boil on the stove.
When the water boils, turn off the heat and remove the pot. Then, add the gelatin to the pot and use a whisk to stir until the gelatin is completely dissolved.
Then, add the watermelon juice and alcohol mixture to the pot and stir well so that the alcohol and watermelon juice blend together.
Next, pour the jelly mixture into each lemon rind, filling them almost to the top, then place the tray in the refrigerator for about 2-4 hours or until the jelly is firm.
Finally, take the watermelon jelly out, use a knife to cut each part into 4 equal small wedges, arrange on a plate and enjoy.
Notes for delicious watermelon jelly

For the lemon juice you squeezed, add 6 cups (1.40 liters) of water, 100g of sugar, and 3 teaspoons of honey. Stir the ingredients together and use it as a base for watermelon jelly. You can use this mixture to replace the vodka if desired.
If you like it sweeter, you can add a little sugar to the pot when stirring the gelatin.
In addition to gelatin, you can use agar-agar to help the mixture set.
If making jelly for children, replace the alcohol with water!

Watermelon jelly with its beautiful appearance attracts the eater, and the fragrant watermelon aroma mixed with a bit of alcohol creates an attractive flavor. Watermelon jelly is a delicious snack that brings a cool sensation to the eater.

mon_an.mo_ta: Eating jelly in hot weather is a good way to quench your thirst. We would like to introduce to you a very eye-catching and heat-relieving watermelon jelly dish.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Watermelon flavored gelatin powder - 1 pack 85g (Jello type)
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Squeeze all the lemon juice into a bowl, pour the juice into a glass jar, and store it in the refrigerator (you can use the lemon juice for other things; this recipe only uses the lemon rinds).
Step 2:
Peel out the inner lemon pulp to obtain empty lemon rinds.
Step 3:
Arrange the lemon rinds on a muffin tin or place them on the rims of small bowls so the rinds can stand upright.
Step 4:
Boil water in a small pot.
Step 5:
Add the gelatin powder and stir well until the gelatin is completely dissolved.
Step 6:
Add the vodka and stir well. Pour the jelly mixture into the lemon rinds.
Step 7:
Refrigerate for 2-4 hours until the jelly sets.
Step 8:
When serving, cut the lemons into bite-sized wedges and enjoy.

mon_an.mo_ta: Beef wrapped in mustard greens is a familiar dish for many families with delicious, eye-catching, and flavor-rich rolls featuring fresh, tender beef. It is served with various vegetables and a sweet and sour dipping sauce, providing a wonderful taste. Just spend a little time in the kitchen and you will have a fantastic dish! Refer to this recipe now.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Culantro, fish mint, basil, rice paddy herb - various herbs
Salt, pepper, soy sauce, mustard - seasonings
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients for Beef Wrapped in Mustard Greens:
Peel the ginger and carrots, wash them, drain, and then cut them into long matchsticks.
Peel the shallots and garlic, wash them, and mince finely.
Wash the beef with a little salt, drain, and cut into pieces about the size of a finger joint.

Then, add some cooking oil and massage the meat to soften it. Season with seasoning powder, MSG, and pepper; let it marinate for 15 minutes. Next, grill the beef over charcoal until medium-rare and slightly charred on the edges, then slice thinly and arrange on a plate.
Pick the mustard greens, remove the roots and wilted or damaged leaves, then wash with salted water, drain, and cut off the stems, keeping only the green leaves.
Clean the lemongrass, remove the damaged outer layers, wash, crush, and cut into 3cm segments.
Trim the roots and wilted leaves from the green onions, wash, and mince finely.
Wash the chilies, remove the seeds and stems.
Squeeze the lime for juice.
Separate the fresh green peppercorns from the stalks.
Next, take a small bowl and mix soy sauce, fresh chili, and mustard to make the dipping sauce.
Wash the shiitake mushrooms and soak until expanded.
Peel the pineapple, remove the eyes, and cut into long thin slices.
Peel the outer skin of the green banana and cut into long thin slices.
Green bananas brown easily; to prevent this, soak the slices in a bowl of water mixed with a little lime juice to help them keep a nice color.
Steps to make Beef Wrapped in Mustard Greens:
Step 1:
First, add 2 tablespoons of oil to a pan. When the oil is hot, add 1 tablespoon of minced garlic and shallots along with the ginger and lemongrass, and stir-fry quickly for about 1 minute.
Step 2:

Next, add the beef and stir-fry over high heat for about 3 minutes. When the meat is medium-rare, turn off the heat and sprinkle pepper and green onions on top so the onions keep a beautiful green color. Then, transfer the dish to a plate, spread evenly, and lightly sprinkle with more pepper.
Step 3:
Keep the mushroom soaking water, straining it to get the clear liquid without grit. Then, boil this soaking water with the finely chopped mushrooms for 10 minutes.
Step 4:

Make the salt dip for the beef: Put 3 deseeded chilies, 3 tablespoons of grain salt, and 1 tablespoon of MSG into a mortar and grind very finely, then add lime juice and fresh green peppercorns and mix well.
Finally, wrap the beef in mustard green leaves with the accompanying ingredients and enjoy.
Notes for delicious Beef Wrapped in Mustard Greens
When preparing the beef, pay attention to cooking it just to medium-rare so it is sweet, delicious, well-seasoned, and not tough.
Use fresh mustard greens with a mild pungent aroma.

Arrange the ingredients around the plate and place the dipping sauce bowl in the middle. When eating, use rice paper to wrap the mustard green leaf, beef, and various vegetables, then dip in soy sauce with mustard or sweet and sour fish sauce.
