mon_an.mo_ta: Thai mango sticky rice attracts food lovers with its soft, fragrant rice soaked in rich coconut milk, balanced sweetness, and eye-catching colors. Served with fresh mango, it offers a wonderful culinary experience. With just a little time in the kitchen, you can prepare this delicious treat for family and friends. You are sure to receive countless compliments! Discover how to make this irresistible Thai mango sticky rice with our detailed instructions. Enjoy the unique flavors of Thailand at home with this simple recipe and easy-to-find ingredients. Explore the guide to making delicious Thai mango sticky rice today!
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients for the mango sticky rice.
Wash the glutinous rice thoroughly and soak it in pandan leaf water for a few hours until the grains expand; this makes the rice stickier when cooked.
After soaking for a few hours, rinse the rice under cold water.
Steps to make mango sticky rice:
Step 1:
First, mix the glutinous rice with a tiny pinch of salt and steam for 20 minutes until cooked.
Step 2:
Peel the ripe mango and cut it into small pieces to decorate around the rice.
Step 3:
Place the coconut milk, sugar, a tiny pinch of salt, and pandan leaves (if using) in a pot and bring to a boil over low heat.
Step 4:
When the coconut milk boils, gently add the steamed rice and stir well. Continue cooking until the liquid is absorbed and the rice grains look translucent, then turn off the heat.
Step 5:
Next, pack the rice into a bowl and flip it onto a plate.
Arrange the sliced mango around the rice, sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds and shredded young coconut to complete your beautiful and delicious plate of mango sticky rice.
Finally, enjoy the mango sticky rice with any beverage you like.
Tips for delicious mango sticky rice:
How to choose good mangoes:

A good mango has a shiny skin, is large, round, plump, and free of bruises. The stem should look fresh and smell fragrant; if you see sap leaking from the stem, it means the mango was recently harvested and not treated with preservatives.
A good mango feels heavy and firm in your hand. Even if it is ripe, it should not be mushy. Choose mangoes with a plump, rounded top near the stem, as these are mature and flavorful.

Select mangoes without bruises or strange colors. Naturally ripened mangoes may have uneven coloring, and the area near the stem usually ripens faster than the tip. If a mango is chemically ripened, the stem will lack sap, the color will be perfectly uniform, and it will have a pungent rather than natural scent.

If choosing green mangoes, look for those that are slightly yellowing near the stem but still very hard and firm. These are mature green mangoes that will be crunchy. If a green mango feels soft, it is likely withered; if a ripe mango feels very soft, it is bruised.

If you want more flavor, you can add fresh coconut to the rice while steaming. You can also pour the coconut milk directly into the pot of rice and stir without boiling; the rice will still be soft, fragrant, and saturated with coconut milk.
How to choose good glutinous rice:
Choose rice grains that are uniform in size, opaque white, shiny, and not broken.
Avoid grains that look powdery, fuzzy, or yellowed.
Good glutinous rice has a natural fragrance similar to regular rice. Old rice loses its scent and does not taste as good when cooked.
You can taste a few raw grains; if they have a slight sweetness and no strange odor, it is good quality rice.

mon_an.mo_ta: Homemade pork sausage made with clean, fresh ingredients and a simple method. When enjoyed, you will experience a crunchy texture and a thin, chewy outer casing that is absolutely delicious and satisfying!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Tapioca starch or all-purpose flour - 2 tbsp
Tools - Some string, a stuffing pump, or a piping bag
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients for the pork sausage.
Wash the small intestine thoroughly with coarse salt. Put salt inside the intestine and massage it well to clean.
Massage the intestine until the yellow residue is gone. Then, use the flat side of a large knife to scrape along the length of the intestine until only a thin, translucent membrane remains.
Squeeze the lemon to get the juice, removing all seeds.
Step 2: Steps to make the pork sausage.

First, prepare the meat mixture: Put the ground pork into a large bowl and add the fish sauce, pepper, lemon juice, water, tapioca starch, sugar, and wine. Mix thoroughly by hand until the ingredients are well combined and the meat is evenly seasoned. Occasionally, pick up the meat and throw it back down into the bowl forcefully to create texture.
Cover the meat with plastic wrap and let it marinate for 20-30 minutes; you can keep it in the refrigerator.
Once the intestine is prepared into thin membranes, use a pump to blow air into it to inflate it; this makes it easier to stuff the meat. Tie both ends tightly with string.
Hang the inflated casing in the sun for a while to create a chewy and crispy texture similar to store-bought sausages.
After completing the above steps, use a piping bag to fill the meat and begin pumping it into the casing.

Cut one end of the intestine, pump the meat in slowly, and smooth it down to the bottom (the casing should look plump and feel firm to the touch). When the stuffed section is about 10cm long (or your desired length), tie it off tightly with string to separate the individual sausages.
Continue until all the meat is used, then cut the sausages apart.
Finally, steam the sausages. Prepare a steamer and arrange the sausages inside. Use a toothpick to prick about 5 small holes in each sausage so they don't burst from the steam pressure while cooking.
Steam the sausages for 20-30 minutes, then remove and let them cool. They can be eaten immediately, but they taste even better when fried or grilled and served with sweet and sour chili sauce.
Tips for delicious pork sausage:
You can use raw ham paste (giò sống) instead of ground pork. When grinding meat, choose pork shoulder for a softer and tastier result.
You can use this same method to make beef sausages, which are also very delicious.

How to choose good small intestine: The intestine should be pinkish-white, fresh in color, not bruised, and have no unpleasant odor. It should be plump and long without many breaks. Never buy frozen organs. Pay attention to the origin to avoid diseased pork or chemically treated intestines; it is best to buy from a trusted source.

Eel porridge is not only a nutritious and delicious dish for your baby, but it can also be combined with vegetables to create a rich, nutrient-dense meal that supports healthy development. In this article, let's explore how to cook nutritious eel porridge with vegetables to create a tasty and exciting meal that is great for your baby's health.
Guide to cooking delicious, nutritious, and non-fishy eel porridge for babies
1. Prepare ingredients
Freshwater eel: 500 g
Glutinous rice: 80 g
Chili: 1 fruit
Garlic: 1 bulb
Ginger: 1 bulb
Shallots: 10 g
Green onions: a little
Ginger leaves: 4 branches
Turmeric powder: 1/2 tsp
Seasoning powder: 1 tsp
Cooking oil: 1 tbsp
Fish sauce: 3 tbsp
Salt: 3 tbsp
Ground pepper: a little
2. Prepare the ingredients
First, rub the eel with a little salt for about 5–10 minutes to remove the slime, then rinse thoroughly with water.
Next, place the eel and 4 ginger leaves in a pot of water. Boil over medium heat until the eel is cooked, then remove to drain and separate the meat from the bones.
Soak the glutinous rice in warm water for about 30 minutes, then wash and drain.
Peel and mince the shallots and garlic. Clean and finely chop the green onions.
3. Cook the porridge
Boil the eel bones with 400ml of water and 1 ginger bulb. When the water boils, add 2 tbsp of fish sauce and the glutinous rice, then stir well.

When the water returns to a boil, lower the heat and leave the lid ajar. Simmer for 10 minutes, turn off the heat, and let it rest for 10 minutes. Repeat this process three times until the porridge is cooked. Remove the eel bones and ginger from the pot.
4. Stir-fry the eel
Start by adding 1 tbsp of cooking oil to a pan over medium heat. When the oil is hot, add the eel meat and stir-fry until the meat firms up.

Next, add the minced shallots, minced garlic, chili, 1/2 tsp turmeric powder, and 1 tbsp seasoning powder to the pan. Stir-fry for another 5 minutes. Before turning off the heat, add 1 tbsp of fish sauce to enhance the flavor.
5. Finished product
Ladle the porridge into a bowl. Add the stir-fried eel and chopped green onions, sprinkle with a little ground pepper, and your Nghe An-style eel porridge is complete.
This porridge is not only visually appealing but also features soft, flavorful grains and savory, fragrant eel meat that you will surely enjoy!
Tips for choosing and preparing eel without a fishy smell
1. Tips for choosing eel
Choose medium-sized eels, neither too small nor too large. Large eels are often farmed, and their meat can be mushy and less fragrant.
Choose eels with two distinct colors: a yellow belly and a black back. These eels usually have firmer and tastier meat.
Avoid eels that are stiff, curled, or shivering, as they may carry diseases.
Avoid eels with scratches, blood clots, or white tails.
Prioritize live, healthy, and active eels to ensure the best quality for your dish.
2. How to prepare eel to remove the fishy smell

Preparing eel for baby porridge is not difficult. If you are concerned about hygiene when having others prepare the meat and want to keep the nutrient-rich blood, you can do it yourself following these steps:

Step 1: Prepare a basin and add a handful of salt or half a bowl of vinegar. Place the eel inside and cover tightly so the eel thrashes around to remove the slime. Keep it in the basin for 5–10 minutes.
Step 2: If the eel is still alive, pour boiling water over it or use a pestle to tap the head lightly to kill it.
Step 3: Once the eel is dead, use a knife or newspaper to scrape off the slime from the surface, then rinse with water.
Step 4: Cut off the head and slit the belly to remove the internal organs, then rinse clean. If you want to keep the eel blood, do not cut off the head or gut it this way.
Step 5: Place the eel in a bowl with a few slices of ginger to deodorize and steam for 15–20 minutes until cooked.

Step 6: When the eel is cooked and cooled, gently remove the skin and keep only the meat and blood. The bones can be crushed, mixed with broth, and strained through a sieve to get the sweet liquid for cooking the porridge.
Step 7: You can portion the eel meat and store it in the freezer to cook for your baby gradually.

mon_an.mo_ta: This modern version of red bean sweet soup features the delicious flavors of soft, powdery red beans, fragrant jelly strands, crunchy roasted peanuts, and rich coconut milk. You will absolutely love it! With just a little time in the kitchen, you can have a wonderful dessert!
cac_buoc: How to cook modern red bean sweet soup for 4 people:
Prepare the ingredients:
Roast the peanuts until golden, remove the skins, and crush them slightly.
Wash the pandan leaves, extract the juice, and mix with 300ml of water.
Soak the red beans in water for about 5 hours. The longer they soak, the softer they become, which saves cooking time.
Mix the slaked lime with water, let it settle for 30 minutes, then pour off the clear liquid for use.
Steps to cook modern red bean sweet soup:
First, mix the rice flour, tapioca starch, and ½ tsp salt into the lime water in a clean pot.
Next, slowly pour the pandan juice into the flour mixture. Place the pot on the stove over low heat, stirring constantly until the mixture becomes translucent and thick, then turn off the heat.
Prepare a bowl of ice water. Scoop the dough into a colander or a mold with holes so that short jelly strands fall through into the ice water.
Once all the dough is used, drain the jelly strands in a basket.

Next, cook the red beans in 1.5 liters of filtered water. Bring to a boil, then turn the heat to low and simmer until the beans are soft. Add sugar and cook for another 5 minutes so the beans absorb the sweetness, then turn off the heat.
In another pot, combine 1 tbsp tapioca starch, 50g sugar, ½ tsp salt, and the coconut milk. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly until the coconut milk thickens, then turn off the heat.
Finally, ladle some red bean soup into a glass, add some pandan jelly strands, pour the coconut sauce over it, and top with roasted peanuts and crushed ice to enjoy.
Tips for delicious modern red bean sweet soup:

If you don't have a specific tool for making the jelly strands, you can do the following: After mixing the dough, knead it until smooth and elastic (adjust water depending on the flour's absorption). Hand-roll the dough into thin strands, drop them into boiling water until they float, then transfer them to a bowl of cold water.
Note: When cooking the coconut milk, only use low heat until the mixture is warm. Coconut milk burns easily, which reduces its natural fragrance.
You can use a pressure cooker to cook the red beans to save time.
If you like, you can add dried coconut or pearls to the soup to enhance the flavor.

This modern version of red bean sweet soup features the delicious flavors of soft, powdery red beans, fragrant jelly strands, crunchy roasted peanuts, and rich coconut milk. You will absolutely love it! With just a little time in the kitchen, you can have a wonderful dessert!

mon_an.ten: Aloe Vera and Lotus Seed Sweet Soup
mon_an.mo_ta: This refreshing and nutritious aloe vera and lotus seed sweet soup is perfect for enjoying on hot summer days.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Trim the two thorny edges of the aloe vera leaves, then use a sharp knife tip to peel off the green skin and any green fibers inside. Dice the flesh into small cubes and soak in water. Massage the aloe vera thoroughly with salt and lemon juice to remove bitterness and slime. Rinse under running water until completely clean, then drain.
Step 2: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Blanch the aloe vera for about 1 minute, then immediately transfer it to a bowl of ice water.
Step 3: Wash the lotus seeds and use a toothpick to remove the green embryos. Place the lotus seeds in a pot and cook until tender.

Step 4: Once the lotus seeds are soft, add the rock sugar to the pot and cook until dissolved. Add the prepared aloe vera, bring to a boil, skim off any foam, and adjust the sweetness to your preference. Let it cool, then store the soup in the refrigerator. Serve with ice if desired.
You have now completed the refreshing and nutritious aloe vera and lotus seed sweet soup!

mon_an.ten: Peppermint Mints for a Joyful Christmas
mon_an.mo_ta: These peppermint mints are guaranteed to be a "hit" this Christmas!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Peppermint extract or other essential oil of your choice - 1-2 tsp
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Mix the butter and corn syrup together in a small bowl.
Add 2 cups of powdered sugar and the peppermint extract, then beat until fully combined.
Add 1/2 tsp of peppermint extract while mixing to reach the desired flavor. Then add 1 cup of powdered sugar and continue stirring.
Place the mixture on a cutting board with the final bowl of powdered sugar. Knead until the sugar is fully absorbed and the mixture is smooth.
Step 2:

Divide the dough into 3 parts: dye one part with a few drops of red food coloring, one part with green food coloring, and leave one part white. After adding the food coloring, knead thoroughly to ensure the color is even. Divide the dough into small portions and roll them into balls about 2cm in diameter. Roll the candies in the bowl of granulated sugar.
Use a fork to gently press the balls flat.
Let the peppermint mints sit for 1 day to dry. Finally, store the candies in an airtight container and enjoy.

mon_an.mo_ta: Instead of the usual peanut butter filling, this caramel-filled version is just as delicious! Check out the recipe for these irresistible caramel chocolates below.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Unsweetened fresh milk or heavy cream - 120ml
cac_buoc: If you are a chocolate lover, you surely know Hershey's and the famous Reese’s Peanut Butter Cups, right?

Instead of the usual peanut butter filling recipe, I will introduce a newer version: caramel-filled chocolates. The advantage of this candy is that caramel fans can indulge to their heart's content. The caramel filling is guaranteed to be just as delicious as peanut butter!
Don't hesitate to start making these caramel-filled chocolates right now! Let's go!
Step 1:
We will make the caramel filling first! Prepare a small pot and add the sugar. Turn on the heat and cook until the sugar melts completely and turns into a characteristic caramel brown.
Note: Only cook over medium-low heat; do not use high heat as the sugar will burn very quickly!
Step 2:
Next, add the butter to the pot and stir until completely melted.
Add the milk and stir well to combine.
Caution: Be careful to avoid splashing, as the cold milk can cause the mixture to splatter!
Step 3:
Cook for 1 minute until the caramel boils, then remove from the heat immediately. Add the salt and stir well. Let the caramel mixture cool completely before filling.
Step 4:

Place the chocolate in a large bowl. Pour water into a pot, place the chocolate bowl on top, and set it on the stove. Heat until the water boils and the chocolate melts, stirring constantly until smooth.
Step 5:
Gently spread a layer of the chocolate mixture onto the bottom and sides of paper liners placed in a cupcake tin. Remember to set aside some chocolate for the top layer!
Step 6:
Place the mold in the refrigerator for 30 minutes to let the chocolate set.
After 30 minutes, take the tray out and pour the caramel filling into each chocolate cup, then return to the refrigerator until the caramel sets.
Step 7:

For the final step, take the tray out and pour the remaining chocolate over the filling. Return to the refrigerator until the chocolate layer is firm, and your rich caramel-filled chocolates are finished!
When ready to eat, remove the chocolates from the fridge and sprinkle with a few grains of salt or colorful sprinkles to decorate and balance the sweetness!
With just 3 trips to the refrigerator, we have delicious caramel-filled chocolates!
They look so attractive! You can take them on a picnic or have them as a snack during school breaks to recharge your energy!

mon_an.mo_ta: Ginger-sautéed star fruit preserve features sweet, sour, and chewy pieces of star fruit with a fragrant ginger aroma. Let's learn how to make this delicious preserve! With Tet approaching, let's make some ô mai to enjoy. Start with this ginger-sautéed star fruit version.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Star fruit - 800 gr (remember to choose sour star fruit)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the star fruit, trim the edges, and soak in diluted salt water for about 30 minutes.
Mix the lime with water, let it sit for 15 minutes to settle, then filter to get the clear lime water, discarding the sediment.
Wash and crush the ginger.

Step 2: Remove the star fruit from the salt water and place in a colander to drain (you can pat them dry with paper towels). Use a knife to separate the star fruit into wedges, then soak them in the clear lime water for 6-7 hours.
Step 3: After soaking for 6-7 hours, remove the star fruit and rinse thoroughly with water to remove the lime smell. Place in a colander to drain.
Add the sugar to the star fruit and marinate for 2-3 hours to infuse.

Step 4: After 2-3 hours, once the sugar has dissolved and infused, place the star fruit in a pot. Simmer over low heat for 15-20 minutes until the sugar turns an amber color, then add the crushed ginger.
Note: If foam forms in the pot, use a spoon to skim it off.

Step 5: Continue simmering until the star fruit mixture becomes thick and chewy. Turn off the heat and arrange the star fruit on a rack to drain any excess syrup. Once completely cooled, store the star fruit in an airtight container; you can keep it in the refrigerator to enjoy gradually.

mon_an.mo_ta: Sesame-Crusted Fried Sweet Potatoes – A simple, delicious dish fragrant with cinnamon and orange zest, making basic fried sweet potatoes more exciting. Learn to cook new dishes every day with these Sesame-Crusted Fried Sweet Potatoes.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients:
Mix 2 tbsp sugar and 1/2 tsp cinnamon powder in a small bowl.
Wash the sweet potatoes and soak in diluted salt water. Slice into rounds (you can slice them according to your preference).
Step 2:
Place a pot on the stove and brush a little oil on the bottom. Arrange the sweet potatoes in the pot and sprinkle the sugar-cinnamon mixture evenly over the surface.
Cover the pot and cook over low heat to allow the sugar to slowly infuse into the sweet potatoes.
Step 3: Grate the orange zest so the fried sweet potatoes have a gentle citrus aroma.

Step 4: While cooking, occasionally open the lid and flip the sweet potatoes. Since sugar burns easily, you must check frequently. When the potatoes are just cooked through, sprinkle the orange zest into the pot.
Step 5: Next, sprinkle the roasted sesame seeds into the pot. Turn off the heat, serve on a plate, and enjoy hot or cold.
Source: BeyondKimchee

mon_an.mo_ta: If you are bored with plain taro, don't worry because this special caramel taro is incredibly delicious. Check out the recipe below!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Peel and cut the taro into bite-sized pieces. Remember to wear gloves when peeling to avoid itching!
Step 2:
Prepare a pan of hot oil and lightly fry the taro. Once the taro changes color, remove it.
Step 3:
Heat the oil again, then toss the taro in quickly for about 10 seconds. Remove and drain well on paper towels.
Step 4:
Prepare another pan with about 5ml of oil. Once the oil is hot, add the sugar.
Step 5:
Stir constantly until the sugar melts, thickens, and turns brown.
Note: Do not stop stirring to prevent the sugar from burning!
Step 6:
When the sugar starts to form tiny bubbles, turn off the heat, quickly add the taro, toss well, and serve on a plate.
Once cooled, the sugar will coat the taro, making it sweet, nutty, and very attractive!
Doesn't it look delicious!
This caramel-tossed taro will be a fun treat for your friends!
Save this recipe for a snack that is interesting, easy to make, and uses simple ingredients!

mon_an.ten: How Many Calories in French Fries? How to Eat Without Gaining Weight
mon_an.mo_ta: Potatoes are a nutrient-rich food source that can be used to create many attractive and delicious dishes. However, when you are following a weight loss diet, understanding potato information is important. You will learn how many calories are in french fries and how to eat them reasonably. Explore this information for useful knowledge! I. How many calories in french fries?
cac_buoc: Studies have shown that in 100g of potatoes, there are approximately 76.7 calories, 2.2g fiber, 2g protein, and 6mg sodium. Although this calorie count is higher than the same weight of tomatoes, the nutritional value of potatoes is undeniable. Instead of just worrying about calories, we should consider how to prepare them reasonably to minimize excess calories.
For example, when preparing 100g of potatoes using different methods, the calorie counts are as follows:
Boiled or steamed potatoes: approx. 87 calories
French fries: 312 calories (quite high)
Baked potatoes: only 93 calories
Cheese-dusted fries: up to 400 calories per 100g due to the cheese and frying process
Sautéed potatoes: approx. 160 – 180 calories depending on the method, ingredients, and seasoning.
Therefore, to utilize the nutritional benefits of potatoes and minimize calories, we need to choose appropriate cooking methods and adjust the ingredients and seasonings used.
II. How to make french fries without worrying about weight gain
1. Ingredients
To make the dish delicious and attractive without worrying about calories, follow this method:

Choose good potatoes: 500g, large, fresh, no sprouts, no black spots. Using starchy potatoes is a good choice for this recipe. This type of potato has high dry matter, helping the fries achieve a crispier and fluffier texture.
Additionally, to add flavor, add 100g frying flour, 30g unsalted butter, 1 tsp sugar, and 1 tsp salt. This will make the fries more interesting and savory.
2. Steps to follow
Step 1: Prepare the ingredients by peeling and washing the potatoes.
Step 2: Cut the potatoes into long strips. If you want crispy, snack-like potatoes, slice them thinly.
Step 3: Soak the potatoes in diluted salt water for 15 minutes for an attractive color, to prevent browning, and to achieve the desired crispness. Drain well.
Step 4: Boil water in a pot and add 1 tsp sugar. Blanch the potatoes in boiling water for about 3 minutes.
Step 5: After blanching, while still firm, place the potatoes in a bowl of cold water for 10 minutes, then drain.
Step 6: Toss the potatoes in frying flour so the powder coats them evenly.
Step 7: Heat a pan and add enough oil to cover about 1/3 of the pan's height. Heat the oil until it shimmers.
Step 8: Drop the potatoes into the pan and fry over low heat for 10-15 minutes until golden brown. Then, remove from the oil.
Step 9: In another pan, melt the butter.
Step 10: When the butter is melted, add the fries and toss for 1 minute. Now you have delicious, crispy french fries.
Note: Ensure safety and follow food processing procedures.
See now: Instructions on how to make french fries using an air fryer
III. Is eating french fries good?
1. Benefits of eating french fries
1.1. Potatoes can improve immune system function
Because potatoes contain Vitamin C, a water-soluble vitamin, they support the building of connective tissues and help with recovery and wound healing.
However, to increase Vitamin C absorption, you should combine fries with dark leafy greens. These vegetables provide large amounts of Vitamin C and help improve immune function.
1.2. Improve brain development

Potatoes are also beneficial for brain development thanks to Vitamin B6. However, to ensure enough daily Vitamin B6, you should combine fries with other B6-rich sources like organ meats, fish, and poultry. This will best support brain development.
1.3. Potatoes can help reduce oxidative stress

Potatoes contain many antioxidants such as chlorogenic acid, anthocyanins, carotenoids, and caffeic acid. These substances can restore cells damaged by oxidative stress, helping to prevent some chronic diseases.
2. Harmful effects of eating too many french fries
1.1. French fries can contribute to obesity
Observational studies indicate that uncontrolled consumption of french fries can increase the risk of weight gain and obesity.
For example, eating fries daily can increase weight by up to 1.5kg, and eating them 1-2 times a week can easily become addictive and lead to weight gain if not controlled.
1.2. Risk of diabetes
Additionally, french fries can increase the risk of diabetes, especially for those who already have it, because they contain many carbohydrates that can spike blood sugar levels.
IV. Potato preparation methods for weight loss
1. Eat boiled potatoes

Boiled or steamed potatoes are effective for weight loss because they are low in calories, rich in resistant starch, and low in cholesterol. By eating boiled/steamed potatoes, you can achieve your desired physique. The great thing is they are very easy to prepare.
2. Combine potatoes with yogurt
Wash and steam, bake, or boil the potatoes.
Peel and mash (if desired), then mix with yogurt (sweetened or unsweetened). You can also replace yogurt with tofu, which is also delicious.
Combining potatoes with yogurt or tofu is not only delicious but also effective for weight loss.
3. Potato salad
Potato salad is nutritious, though slightly more complex. Here is a simple way:
Wash potatoes, then boil/steam/bake and chop or mash.
Wash vegetables like tomatoes, carrots, cucumbers, and chop them. Mince shallots.
Mix the prepared ingredients together.
Add seasoning and mayonnaise, then enjoy.
Potato salad is a great alternative to fries, helping with weight loss while ensuring nutrition.
4. Spinach and potato combination
Potatoes and spinach together create a nutritious weight loss dish. Here is a simple preparation:
Wash 1-2 potatoes and 150g spinach, then steam until cooked.
Mash the potatoes and blend with the spinach. Add a little seasoning if desired.
Serve in a bowl or plate and enjoy.
Combining potatoes with spinach is an excellent choice for nutritious weight loss.

mon_an.ten: Crispy Tuna Potato Balls for Dinner
mon_an.mo_ta: Learn how to make golden, delicious tuna potato balls according to this recipe.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Tuna - 300gr (canned tuna in oil/vinegar is OK)
cac_buoc: Peel the potatoes, soak in diluted salt water for about 15 minutes, then rinse. Place in a pot, add water and a little salt, and boil until the potatoes are soft.

Remove the potatoes, drain, and place in a bowl. While the potatoes are still hot, add about 15-20gr of butter. The heat will melt the butter; mash the potatoes and mix until the butter and potatoes are well combined.
Add garlic powder, salt, and pepper to taste, then mix well.
Next, take the canned tuna and flake it, then add minced onion, minced cilantro, and grated cheese, and mix well.
Add eggs and mix until very smooth.
Wear gloves for hygiene, then roll the potato mixture into equal-sized balls.

Place flour and breadcrumbs in two separate bowls, and beat the eggs in another bowl. Roll each potato ball through the flour, then the egg, and finally the breadcrumbs. Repeat until all potato balls are coated.
Pour cooking oil into a deep pan or small pot and heat. Drop the potato balls in and fry until golden brown and crispy, then remove and drain on paper towels before serving.
Here is the final result: golden, delicious fried potato balls. Serving them with chili sauce or ketchup is absolutely perfect.
Note these tips for choosing good potatoes for this dish:
Choose fresh potatoes that are round, feel heavy, and have smooth skin without scratches or rot.

Good potatoes show a consistent yellow color when the skin is lightly scraped (experience shows yellow potatoes are sweeter and more fragrant than white ones). Do not choose potatoes that have turned green or are sprouting, as they are harmful to health because potato sprouts contain carcinogens.

mon_an.ten: Unique Glass Noodle and Egg Kimbap
mon_an.mo_ta: A fried kimbap version with a glass noodle filling and an egg wrap will give you a brand new experience with this delicious dish!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Mix the mayonnaise with the chili paste in a bowl.
Step 2:
Beat the eggs with a little salt in another bowl.
Step 3:
Blanch the glass noodles in boiling water, then remove and drain.
Step 4:
Divide the eggs into 4 parts and fry each part into a thin sheet in a pan until cooked on both sides, then set aside on a plate.
Step 5:
Shred the vegetables and blanch the greens.
Using the same pan used for the eggs, add oil and sauté the onion until fragrant, then stir-fry the carrot, bell peppers, greens, and glass noodles over medium heat.
Step 6:
Season the noodles with salt, soy sauce, sugar, and sesame oil. Toss the ingredients well for another 3 minutes, then remove from the heat.
Step 7:
Place an egg sheet on a bamboo mat, followed by a nori sheet and the sautéed glass noodle mixture on top. Roll it up using the same technique as rolling sushi.
If you don't have a specialized bamboo mat, you can use plastic wrap as a substitute with the same method!
Step 8:
Use a knife to cut each roll into even rounds.
Now, serve and enjoy!
Before eating, remember to sprinkle some sesame seeds for extra aroma!
Glass noodle rolls are just as delicious as rice rolls!

mon_an.mo_ta: Spicy bread-wrapped potatoes are a unique fast food dish full of nutrients from starch, fiber, and vitamins. When eating, you will find the outer bread crust crispy and fragrant, while the potato filling inside is nutty and savory. However, this dish is quite spicy, so choose the right time and weather to enjoy them. Check out how to make this dish below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Other ingredients - salt, cooking oil, filtered water
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Peel the potatoes and rinse with water.
Then, cut the potatoes into medium-sized pieces.
Clean the cilantro, removing the roots and wilted leaves, rinse well, and drain. Then, finely chop the cilantro into a bowl.
Wash and finely chop the green chilies.
Step 2: Steps to make the spicy bread-wrapped crispy potatoes.
First, place the potatoes in a pot and cover with water.
Place the pot on the stove over high heat. When the water boils, add a few grains of salt and turn the heat down.
When the potatoes are cooked, remove them to a bowl to drain and cool slightly.
Then, use a spoon to mash the potatoes. You can also use a pestle to mash them faster and smoother.
Next, add the following seasonings to the potato bowl: 2 tsp salt, chili powder, green chilies, chopped cilantro, and garam masala. Mix well with a spoon so the potatoes are evenly seasoned.
Then, dip a slice of bread into a bowl of filtered water for a few seconds and lift it out quickly.
When lifting the bread, gently cup your hand to squeeze out the water absorbed in the bread.
Next, scoop two spoonfuls of filling into the center of the bread slice.
Then, skillfully roll the bread slice and press the edges together so the potato filling doesn't fall out. Repeat until all the bread and filling are used.
Once the bread rolls are ready, place a pan on the stove and add plenty of oil to heat.
When the oil is hot, drop each bread roll in to fry.
During the frying process, remember to flip them evenly so both sides have a beautiful golden color.
Once cooked, remove them to drain the oil. Blot with paper towels once more to remove all excess oil.
Finally, arrange the bread on a plate and enjoy with your favorite sauce.
Notes for delicious spicy bread-wrapped crispy potatoes

To successfully shape the spicy bread-wrapped crispy potatoes, pay attention to the bread preparation. The bread should not be too mushy or too dry; just dip the whole slice into the water and lift it out immediately.
When frying, make sure one side is completely golden before flipping to the second side to avoid breaking the bread, as the crust we use is very thin.
Additionally, do not fry the bread over high heat. Use a slightly deep pan and plenty of oil to prevent the edges from burning while the middle remains white.
Garam masala is a spice with a fruity and pungent aroma. This powder is widely used in meat and vegetable dishes; notably, it does not overpower the flavors of other spices in the dish.

mon_an.mo_ta: Pineapple cakes are a favorite for many, with a crispy crust and a perfectly sweet filling. Enjoying them with a glass of fruit juice is a wonderful experience. With just a little time in the kitchen, you'll have a delicious treat to serve family and friends!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Tools - small cake molds, thin cheesecloth
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients for the baked pineapple cakes.
Peel the pineapples and remove the eyes.
Then, shred the pineapple into very fine strips.
Next, place the pineapple in a thin cheesecloth and squeeze out the excess juice.
Cut the unsalted butter into small pieces and cream it slightly with a spoon.
Beat the eggs in a bowl until smooth.
Step 2: Steps to make the baked pineapple cakes.
Pineapple Filling
First, place a pan on the stove over low heat. Add the pineapple and stir constantly.
When the pineapple softens, add 100g of granulated sugar and stir.

Then, add 80g of maltose and stir well so the mixture combines. When the sugar is completely melted and the mixture is fragrant and turns slightly brown, turn off the heat and scoop the filling into a bowl to cool.
Cake Crust
Use a whisk to continue beating the softened butter, then slowly pour in the beaten eggs, whisking as you go.
Next, add the almond flour and milk powder and stir well.
Once the butter mixture is well combined, add the all-purpose flour and powdered sugar and knead. At this stage, you can use your hands to knead the dough more easily.
When the dough is smooth and free of lumps, stop. Wrap the bowl with plastic wrap and place it in the refrigerator for about 30 minutes.
After 30 minutes, take the dough out and divide both the dough and the filling into small portions, rolling them into balls. The dough portion must be larger than the filling.
Flatten a piece of dough, place the filling in the center, and shape it into a round cake so the filling is completely enclosed.
Repeat until all the filling and dough are used.
Next, place the dough into the molds and press down as shown in the image.

Finally, place the molds on a baking tray. Put the tray into a preheated oven at 170°C and bake for about 10 minutes or until the surface is dark golden. Remove the tray, flip the molds over, and bake the second side at the same temperature and time.
When the cakes are done, let them cool slightly, arrange them on a plate, and enjoy.
Notes for delicious baked pineapple cakes
When choosing pineapples, select ones that are very fragrant and ripe but not mushy inside.

Some may worry the filling will be too sweet, but we only use a little sugar, and maltose has almost no sweetness. The sweetness of maltose comes from the aroma of malted grains rather than sugar, so don't worry. Furthermore, using maltose makes the filling chewy and delicious. Maltose also helps the filling stay firm and not become runny from moisture.
When baking, remember to adjust the temperature and time to suit your home oven.

mon_an.mo_ta: Baked mooncakes with a soft crust, carrying the signature flavors of the Mid-Autumn season. The smooth, finely mashed pineapple filling offers a fresh aroma and balanced sweetness, creating a visually appealing and delicious treat.
cac_buoc: HOW TO MAKE PINEAPPLE JAM MOONCAKES
Step 1: Prepare the filling
Peel the winter melon, remove the seeds, wash thoroughly, and chop finely. Boil until cooked, let cool, then blend and squeeze out excess water. Chop and blend the pineapple as well.
Place all ingredients into a non-stick pan with sugar, pandan essence, and lemon juice. Cook over medium heat.

Stir-fry until the filling thickens, then reduce to low heat. Continue stirring until the filling is thick, pliable, dry, and no longer sticks to the pan. You can add a little glutinous rice flour to help the filling bind better.
Once the filling has cooled, roll into balls of about 140 g for a 200 g mold, or estimate a crust-to-filling ratio of 1:2.
Step 2: Prepare the crust
Combine the sugar syrup, oil, peanut butter, and salt in a bowl and mix until well incorporated.

Sift the flour into a bowl and create a well in the center. Pour in the syrup mixture (from step 3), wear gloves, and knead until the ingredients are combined into a smooth, pliable dough that doesn't stick to your hands. Wrap the dough and let it rest for 45-60 minutes. Afterward, knead briefly for 1-2 minutes with a little extra flour.
Finally, divide the dough into small portions of 60 g each.
Step 3: Mold the cakes
Flatten the crust dough thinly, place a pineapple jam ball in the center, and gently wrap the dough around the filling until completely sealed.

Dust the mold and the cake with a thin layer of flour. Place the cake into the mold, press firmly, then gently push the cake out. Arrange the cakes on a tray. Hold the cake in the mold for 3-5 seconds to ensure a sharper shape.
Step 4: Bake the cakes

Preheat the oven to 200°C for 15 minutes. Place the tray on the middle rack and bake for 6 minutes. Remove the cakes and spray with a fine mist of water. Let them cool for 3-4 minutes before brushing on a very thin layer of egg wash.
Return the tray to the middle rack and bake for another 7 minutes. Remove again, repeat the water spraying and egg washing process gently, then bake for a final 6 minutes until fully cooked.
Turn on the top broiler for 1-2 minutes to darken the surface and sharpen the details before removing from the oven.
Finally, take the cakes out, let them cool completely, and enjoy.
Tips for delicious pineapple jam mooncakes
You can substitute winter melon with magenta plant (lá cẩm) to create a beautiful green color and a more fragrant filling.

Egg wash mixture: Mix 1 egg yolk, 1 tbsp aromatic wine (Mai Que Lo), 1 tsp sesame oil, and 2 drops of caramel food coloring in a bowl, then strain through a sieve for a smooth liquid. This ensures the color is beautiful and not blotchy.

mon_an.mo_ta: Beef and potato croquettes with a crispy golden crust and a fresh, well-seasoned interior. These fragrant bites served with sweet and sour sauce are a true delight!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings - pepper, MSG, seasoning powder, salt, oil
cac_buoc: How to make crispy beef and potato croquettes
Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Wash the beef, drain well, and finely mince or grind.
Peel and slice the potatoes. Immediately soak them in water to prevent browning.
Peel and wash the carrots and onions, drain, and mince finely.
Wash and mince the mushrooms. If using dried shiitake mushrooms, soak in hot water until soft, remove the stems, wash again, and mince.
Divide the eggs. Crack 2 into a bowl and beat well.
Step 2: Cooking steps
Bring a pot of water to a boil with a pinch of salt, then add the potatoes and boil until tender.

Check the potatoes by piercing them with a chopstick. If they are soft and crumbly, turn off the heat. Drain all the water, then place the pot back on the heat for a moment to dry out any remaining moisture before transferring the potatoes to a bowl.
Use a large, sturdy spoon to mash the potatoes. For a smoother texture, you can use a mortar and pestle to pound them.

Heat a little oil in a pan and sauté the onions. Add the carrots and beef, stirring well. Add the mushrooms and season with a bit of MSG, seasoning powder, and pepper. Adjust the seasoning to your taste. Once cooked, transfer the mixture to a bowl.
Mix the mashed potatoes with the sautéed mixture. Crack in the remaining 2 eggs and add a bit more pepper and seasoning powder, as the potatoes will dilute the flavor.
Mix thoroughly until well combined. Shape the mixture into bite-sized balls and set aside on a large plate.
Prepare the coating: flour, breadcrumbs (or Panko), and the beaten eggs.
First, roll each ball in flour, ensuring it is well-coated. Next, dip it into the beaten eggs, and finally, coat thoroughly with breadcrumbs. Repeat until all balls are coated.
Heat a generous amount of oil in a pan so the croquettes can be submerged. Carefully drop them in to fry.
Flip them frequently while frying to ensure they turn golden brown on all sides without burning. Once they reach a beautiful golden color, remove them. Place on paper towels to drain excess oil.
Finally, arrange the beef and potato croquettes on a plate and enjoy.
Tips for crispy beef and potato croquettes
Choose fresh beef and grind it yourself. Supermarket pre-ground beef may contain unknown cuts or excess fat, which can make the dish greasy.
Dipping sauce: Chili sauce, garlic-chili fish sauce, or mayonnaise all pair wonderfully.
When choosing potatoes: Select fresh, yellow-fleshed potatoes without green spots or soft patches. This ensures a starchy, fragrant, and delicious texture.

When sautéing the beef mixture, do not overcook it; just cook until done so the onions stay intact and the beef remains tender. Do not add water during sautéing, as the moisture won't evaporate in time, making the filling mushy.

mon_an.ten: Hue Roasted Pork Tapioca Dumplings (Chè Bột Lọc Heo Quay)
mon_an.mo_ta: Enjoying Chè Bột Lọc Heo Quay, you will experience the savory taste of roasted pork combined with the light sweetness of ginger-scented syrup. The lingering richness and chewiness of the meat and dough create a unique mouthfeel. Follow this recipe to make this delicious Hue specialty!
cac_buoc: Choose roasted pork with a good balance of lean meat and little fat so the dessert isn't too greasy. Cut the pork into medium-sized cubes, then simmer with 30g of sugar and a pinch of salt until the meat is flavorful and well-absorbed.

Place the tapioca starch on a wide tray. Bring water to a boil and pour it slowly into the starch, stirring with a spoon to create a partially cooked, pliable dough. Once cooled slightly, knead by hand until the dough is smooth and no longer sticks to your hands.
Transfer the roasted pork to a plate to cool. Take a small piece of dough, flatten it, place a piece of roasted pork in the center, and roll it into a ball. Repeat until all dough and pork are used.
Bring a pot of water to a boil and drop the dumplings in. Boil until the dough becomes translucent and the dumplings float to the surface.
Once cooked, remove the dumplings and drop them into a bowl of cold water to make them clearer and chewier.
Peel the ginger, wash it, and cut it into fine matchsticks.

Bring a fresh pot of water to a boil, add sugar, and stir to dissolve. Once the syrup boils, add the ginger matchsticks and the dumplings. Simmer for 5-7 minutes so the dumplings absorb the sweetness, then turn off the heat.
Serve the Chè Bột Lọc Heo Quay in small bowls. Enjoy while hot or serve with shaved ice.
Tips for delicious Chè Bột Lọc Heo Quay
Avoid using pork that is too fatty or too lean, as it can become cloying or dry.
When simmering the pork with seasonings, ensure it has a balanced savory taste so it complements the dough and sweet syrup perfectly.
When mixing the dough, add the boiling water gradually to prevent clumping. Knead thoroughly for a smooth, soft texture that isn't too tough.
Do not use the dumpling boiling water to make the syrup, as it will be cloudy. Shocking the dumplings in ice water is essential for a translucent and crunchy-chewy texture.
If serving hot, you can mix a little tapioca starch with cold water and stir it into the syrup at the final step to create a slightly thickened consistency.
Adjust the sweetness to your family's preference, but avoid making it overly sweet.
The final dish should offer a savory-sweet balance with the warmth of ginger and a rich, chewy finish.

mon_an.mo_ta: Laotian Nem Chua features a distinctive flavor with a balanced sourness, a crunchy texture, and a hint of heat from chilies. Served with sweet and sour chili sauce, it offers a truly appetizing experience.
cac_buoc: How to make unique Laotian Nem Chua
Wash the pork with salt to remove odors, drain well, and grind finely. Knead the pork thoroughly for 10-15 minutes until it becomes smooth, elastic, and sticky.
Add half of the salt and knead for 5 minutes, then add the remaining salt and knead for another 5 minutes.
Once the meat has absorbed the salt, add the glutinous rice and minced garlic. Mix well for 10 minutes until all ingredients are fully incorporated.
Add the shredded pork skin and continue kneading for 10 minutes until the mixture forms a cohesive mass.
Lay a sheet of plastic wrap on a cutting board before rolling the Nem.

Take a 500g portion of the meat mixture and place it on the plastic wrap. Arrange a row of chilies in the center (adjust quantity to taste), then cover the chilies with meat. Roll the meat into a long cylinder and wrap tightly with plastic. Twist the ends firmly to compress the meat and remove all air.
Place the Nem in a sealed container and store in a dark place for at least 3 days.

The Nem is ready when it feels firm to the touch and does not bounce back. Depending on your taste, you can let it ferment longer for more sourness or move it to the fridge to stop the process. Consume within 1 week for the best flavor.
How to choose good pork

Fresh meat: The exterior has a dry film and the surface is slightly firm. The cut surface is bright pink, the skin is soft, the grain is firm, and it has good elasticity (pressing with a finger leaves no lasting indentation). The fat is bright, firm, and has a characteristic aroma. Joint surfaces are smooth and clear. Marrow clings tightly to the bone.

Stale meat: The exterior starts to feel slimy. The cut surface is moist with poor elasticity (pressing leaves a visible dent). The fat is dark, soft, and smells off. Joints are slimy and marrow easily detaches from the bone.
Old pork or sow meat: The meat grain is loose, dark red, and the skin is thick.

Diseased pork: Loose grain, yellow fat, and may contain opaque white specks. Small spots may appear on the liver or kidneys. The skin may have round or oval hemorrhages or be missing patches where abscesses were removed.
Avoid buying meat that is too old or too young. Choose medium-aged pork that is pink with thin skin. For lean meat, tenderloin is sweet but can become dry if overcooked; ham/round meat is softer.

mon_an.mo_ta: Continuing with the Tet holiday theme, here is a very simple recipe for candied ginger. Each fragrant, warm slice with a spicy kick on the tip of the tongue will help chase away the winter chill. Candied ginger is an indispensable part of the Tet jam tray in Northern Vietnam. Try making it with the recipe below.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Ginger - 500 g (young ginger is preferred to avoid fibrous texture)
cac_buoc: Choose large, fresh, young ginger knobs to ensure the jam isn't fibrous. Wash off any dirt, scrape off the skin with a knife, and wash again with clean water.
Dissolve salt in water. Slice the ginger into thin pieces (or use a vegetable peeler for thin shavings) and place them into the salt water. Soak for about 2 hours.
After 2 hours, drain the ginger and rinse with clean water to remove the saltiness. Bring a pot of water to a boil, add the ginger and the juice of one lemon to keep the ginger white.

Once the water boils, drain and rinse with cold water, then repeat the boiling process. Boiling helps reduce the spiciness and bitterness. The number of times you boil depends on whether you prefer it very spicy (boil fewer times) or mildly spicy (boil more times). Usually, boiling and rinsing twice is sufficient.

Mix the ginger with sugar. The ingredients provided follow the correct ratio. If you use more or less ginger, adjust the sugar according to the ratio of 10 parts ginger to 6 parts sugar. Let the ginger macerate until the sugar dissolves completely, stirring occasionally.

Use a large, thick-bottomed pan to reduce the jam. Spread the ginger evenly in the pan and turn the heat to the lowest setting. When the sugar starts to bubble, gently shake the pan by the handle to prevent burning. You can use a spoon or chopsticks to stir gently, but be careful not to break the ginger slices.

Continue cooking until the liquid evaporates and the sugar crystallizes into small white grains. When the ginger slices start to look dry, turn off the heat. Continue to stir gently, using the residual heat of the pan to finish drying the ginger.
Keep stirring until the ginger slices are completely dry.
Once the jam has cooled and the sugar has hardened into an even coating, store the candied ginger in an airtight container.
This candied ginger recipe is incredibly simple. Good luck, and may you have warm, happy moments with your family enjoying this homemade treat.
Besides this recipe, you can also use ginger to make soft ginger jam or stir-fried starfruit with ginger, which are also very delicious.

mon_an.mo_ta: These lasagna rolls are not only crispy but also rich and cheesy. This is a great way to prepare pasta without spending too much time or effort. Italian Cheese Lasagna Rolls offer a fresh flavor with soft, perfectly cooked pasta and a creamy, fragrant cheese filling, creating a truly wonderful dish.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients for the Italian Cheese Lasagna Rolls.
Crack the egg into a bowl and beat well, then add a little basil and a pinch of salt, whisking until well combined.
Grate the cheddar cheese.
Grate the parmesan cheese and grind it into a fine powder. Note that the finer the powder, the better the rolls will be!
Step 2: Cooking steps for the Italian Cheese Lasagna Rolls.
First, place a pot of water on the stove and bring to a boil over high heat.
Once the water is boiling, add the lasagna sheets and soak for about 20 minutes, then remove.
After the lasagna sheets have cooled slightly, use a knife to cut them into long rectangular pieces as shown in the image.
Next, use a spoon to spread a little tomato sauce onto the lasagna sheet. Spread the sauce over about ½ of the sheet.
Then, sprinkle a little cheddar cheese over the tomato sauce.
Follow with a sprinkle of powdered parmesan cheese on top.
Next, use a brush to dip into the beaten egg and spread evenly over the remaining half of the lasagna sheet.
Then, roll the lasagna sheet up tightly.
Repeat the process with the remaining ingredients.
Once all rolls are prepared, arrange them in a baking tray.
Next, sprinkle the remaining parmesan cheese over all the lasagna rolls.
Finally, place the baking tray in a preheated oven at 160-180°C.
Bake until the cheese is completely melted, then turn off the oven.
Once cooked, remove the tray and let the lasagna rolls cool slightly before enjoying.
Tips for perfect Italian Cheese Lasagna Rolls:
Besides blanching the lasagna sheets in hot water, you should read the instructions on the packaging carefully to determine the best preparation method for the specific type of lasagna you purchased.
Dried basil can be added to the egg or omitted based on your preference.
If you prefer a saltier and more flavorful dish, you can add a little meat inside the lasagna rolls. Using bacon is convenient and still tastes great.

These lasagna rolls are not only crispy but also rich and cheesy. This is a great way to prepare pasta without spending too much time or effort. Italian Cheese Lasagna Rolls offer a fresh flavor with soft, perfectly cooked pasta and a creamy, fragrant cheese filling, creating a truly wonderful dish.

mon_an.mo_ta: Durian Thai Sweet Soup features eye-catching colors, a delicious aroma, and a moderate sweetness. When enjoying it, you can serve it with a bit of shaved ice for a refreshing sensation. Check out this detailed guide to making fragrant Durian Thai Sweet Soup below to discover the recipe! Enjoy this delicious and colorful dessert. Detailed instructions for making it at home. Create a cool sensation when combined with shaved ice. Discover the recipe now!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Flexible jelly powder (Con Ca Deo brand) - 1 packet
Fruit toppings - jackfruit, lychee, palm seeds
Mixing ingredients - Sugar, cocoa powder, heavy cream, fresh milk, sweetened condensed milk, coconut milk, pandan juice
cac_buoc: First, dissolve 1 packet of flexible jelly powder with 1.3 liters of water and 400g of sugar, then let it soak for 15 minutes. Place on the stove and cook, stirring constantly. Alternatively, you can boil the water first; while waiting, mix the jelly powder with the sugar. When the water begins to simmer, slowly pour the mixture into the pot while stirring constantly to prevent clumping.

When the jelly liquid boils, skim off the foam and divide into 3 equal parts. Mix one part with 1 tbsp of cocoa powder and 2 tbsp of heavy cream for a brown color. Mix the second part with 5 tbsp of coconut milk and 1 tbsp of fresh milk for an opaque white color. Mix the final part with pandan juice for a green color.
Note: Keep the jelly pot on the stove over low heat to keep it simmering while mixing each part. Do not let the jelly liquid cool down, or you won't be able to mix the colors.
Mixing cocoa powder and heavy cream with the jelly liquid creates a milky brown jelly, while fresh milk and coconut milk create a beautiful milky white jelly.
Once processed, pour each colored jelly into molds. Wait for them to cool and set, then cut into bite-sized cubes.
Each packet of jelly powder combined with different coloring methods will give you eye-catching jelly plates.
If you cook one packet of agar-agar powder with 1 liter of water until done, let it cool, and then cut into long strips. This ratio will give you clear and very crunchy jelly strips.
For fresh fruits like jackfruit, longan, and palm seeds, peel them, remove seeds, and cut into bite-sized pieces. Using Thai jackfruit will make it crunchier and more delicious.
Divide the durian flesh into 2 parts. Mash one part finely to add directly to the soup when eating; use the other part to make the sauce.

Durian sauce: Mix the sauce according to this ratio: 2 tbsp durian flesh + 200ml fresh milk + 2 tbsp sweetened condensed milk + 3 tbsp sugar, stirring until well combined. Then mix in 200ml heavy cream and 100ml coconut milk to get a fragrant, rich sauce. Remember to stir well so all ingredients dissolve and blend together.
Finally, scoop the jellies and fresh fruits into a bowl or glass, top with a scoop of mashed durian, pour the sauce over it, add shaved ice, mix well, and enjoy.
How to choose durian for a delicious sweet soup:
1. Observe the shape of the fruit:

While many suggest choosing perfectly round and beautiful durians, in reality, those that are slightly misshapen or "ugly" are often less likely to be damaged and taste better. Choose durians with evenly distributed segments and long, equal-sized grooves. Avoid lopsided fruits and choose those with a "bread waist" shape and uniform size. Look for fruits with slight cracks and a strong aroma.
2. Tap the durian:

Sellers often have a special tool to check the fruit. If possible, borrow it and tap the durian a few times. If you hear a dull "thud-thud" sound, it is a good fruit. However, if you hear a hollow "clink-clink" and feel it is hard, skip it.
3. Observe the stem and thorns:

The stem shrinks over time, so choose fruits with stems that aren't too withered, as that indicates it was harvested long ago. Choose green, firm stems with a strong sweet aroma. The thorns should be large, blunt, and firm. Squeeze two thorns together; if they feel firm and mature, the fruit is ripe. For young fruit, the thorns will be soft.
4. Observe how the seller peels it:

If possible, ask the seller to help open it. Ripe and mature durians usually have 5 natural seams, making the peeling process very easy and gentle. If the durian is still green and young, peeling will be much more difficult.

mon_an.mo_ta: Lychee fruit jelly with its delicious flavor, soothing color, and light sweetness will bring you a refreshing feeling during hot summer days. Just a little time in the kitchen and you'll have a delicious treat for family and friends.
cac_buoc: Prepare ingredients for the lychee fruit jelly:
Peel the lychees, then soak them in a very diluted salt water solution. Remove the flesh and place it in a clean bowl.
Steps to make lychee fruit jelly:
First, place the lychee flesh in a blender and blend until smooth, then strain to get the juice.
Next, mix the lychee juice with cooled boiled water to make one liter of liquid. Remember to add 10 ml of honey to this mixture.
Then, warm the lychee water and stir in the gelatin powder. Cook over low heat until the liquid just starts to bubble, then stop.
Next, pour the jelly into the prepared molds and add some finely chopped lychee flesh to give the jelly a crunchy, chewy texture when eaten.
Let the jelly cool, then place it in the refrigerator for 2-3 hours to set before serving.
Tips for delicious lychee fruit jelly:
To add more attractive colors to the jelly, you can add some fruit syrups or chopped fruits.
The amount of honey can be adjusted to taste, but be careful not to add too much in the summer; the jelly should only have a light, refreshing sweetness.
Do not soak the lychees in salt water for too long, as it will make the flesh bland.
How to choose delicious lychees:

Shell: Fresh, thin shell with smooth spikes. The stems should be flexible and small. Avoid lychees with dry stems or dry spots on the shell, especially brown spots near the stem, as these are prone to pests.
Color: The exterior should be bright pink and uniform.

Appearance: Note that Thieu lychees are not as pretty as hybrid lychees. Thieu lychees are smaller, about 70% the size of hybrids. They are round and uniform, while hybrids are large, succulent, elongated, and have large seeds.
Flavor: When tasted, the lychee should be sweet with a characteristic aroma.

Seed: Small seeds indicate a good lychee. If the seed is easy to separate and shiny black, the lychee is perfectly ripe. If the seed is pinkish and hard to peel from the flesh, the fruit is still green and will be sour.

Flesh: Thick, translucent white, soft, and juicy flesh. If the flesh is discolored or dry, the lychee is old and of poor quality. If it smells like alcohol or the flesh has an unusual color, do not use it.

Cool lychee jelly with its delicious aroma, soothing color, and light sweetness will bring a refreshing feeling on hot summer days. Just a little time in the kitchen and you'll have a treat for family and friends. The kids will love your cool jelly. You can also add this jelly to sweet soups to enhance the flavor.

mon_an.ten: Tips for Eating Instant Noodles Without Health Concerns
mon_an.mo_ta: We all know the harmful effects of instant noodles, but with these tips, you can reduce the impact on your health! Today's article provides tips on how to eat instant noodles without worrying about acne or toxicity. Instant noodles are a favorite for many due to their taste and convenience, taking only 3-5 minutes to prepare. Usually, we just pour hot water, add seasoning, and cover for a few minutes.
cac_buoc: However, many studies show that the chemical additives used to create instant noodles include: texture enhancers, food coloring, flour bleaching agents, preservatives, and seasoning packets. Additionally, the oil used for frying noodles often contains trans fats, which are harmful to health. It is very difficult for authorities to control these issues, even with modern testing equipment.

Therefore, Dr. Dao Huy Phong – Director of the Food and Nutrition Research Center, states that those "addicted" to instant noodles should supplement them with healthy foods like green vegetables and proteins from meat or eggs to compensate for the lack of vitamins, fiber, and protein. This helps the body handle the burden of harmful substances from the noodles.

Furthermore, Dr. Phong suggests that consumers should choose noodles with fewer chemical additives by checking the ingredients on the packaging. Additives often have codes like E621 (MSG), E102 (tartrazine coloring), or chemical names that most consumers wouldn't recognize.
So, when eating instant noodles, instead of just "soaking" them, we should cook them. Here is a method home cooks can follow:
Blanch the noodles before cooking:
Before cooking, boil a pot of water, drop the noodles in to blanch for about 30 seconds to one minute, then drain in a colander.
Bring a fresh pot of water to a boil, then add the blanched noodles back in. Quickly turn off the heat so the noodles don't get mushy.
Do not use the provided seasoning packet:
You can use external seasonings like salt, MSG, or homemade broth powder. Using external seasonings helps limit the unhealthy oils and additives.
Add green vegetables and meat to make the noodles better:

Choy sum, broccoli, bean sprouts, or beef, shrimp, chicken, and eggs not only make the bowl more appealing but also ensure you get necessary nutrients. Additionally, adding plenty of green vegetables will minimize the fat intake.
Note: If adding these foods, cook them in the water before adding the noodles.
With this method, the noodles might not be "instant" in the truest sense, but they will limit the unhealthy oils and additives.

mon_an.ten: Grilled Squid with Salt and Chili
mon_an.mo_ta: Grilled squid with salt and chili features eye-catching colors and a delicious flavor. The fresh squid, thoroughly marinated in spices, will make your family meal much more enjoyable! Discover how to make this dish in the article below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning - salt, MSG, chili powder, pepper, cooking oil
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients:

For the squid: remove the ink sac, the backbone, and the hard part of the beak, then rinse with water. You can wash the squid with rice wine to remove the fishy smell, then rinse again with water. Once cleaned, drain the squid well.
Peel the ginger, wash, slice thinly, and crush.
Wash the chilies and crush them.
Pick the fresh herbs and Vietnamese coriander, removing roots and wilted leaves, then wash and drain.
Cut off both ends of the cucumber and rub the ends together to remove the sap. Soak in diluted salt water to keep it crunchy and kill microorganisms.
Prepare one skewer for each squid. Wash the skewers and soak them in a basin of water; this prevents the bamboo from burning during grilling.
How to make Grilled Squid with Salt and Chili:
Step 1: Marinate the squid.

First, mix the crushed chilies + 1 tsp chili powder + 3 tbsp cooking oil + 1 tsp seasoning powder + 1 tsp salt + 1/2 tsp pepper with the squid. Let it sit for about 30 minutes to allow the spices to penetrate.
Step 2: Grill the squid.
After 30 minutes, thread each squid onto a skewer.

Prepare a charcoal grill: Place the skewered squid on the grill rack. Every 5 minutes, brush the marinade onto the squid. Do this twice, turning the skewers constantly and maintaining a medium heat so the squid cooks evenly.
When the squid is fragrant and turns a light golden color, remove it to a plate.
Finally, arrange the grilled squid on a plate and garnish with cucumber, Vietnamese coriander, and fresh herbs.
Tips for delicious Grilled Squid with Salt and Chili:
The dish is best served hot. It can be dipped in green chili salt (available at supermarkets), chili sauce, or any dipping sauce you prefer.

How to choose fresh squid: There are two main types: cuttlefish and squid. Cuttlefish have large, flat, oval bodies. Choose large ones with thick, firm, milky-white flesh and an intact brown outer membrane. Squid have cylindrical, elongated bodies and thinner flesh. Choose squid with bright, slightly pink flesh, tentacles firmly attached to the body, and an unbroken ink sac. Generally, less fresh squid will turn a pale greenish color, have soft flesh, loose heads, and a very fishy smell. Check the tentacles; if they are limp and about to detach, the squid is old. Bigfin reef squid is particularly good for grilling.
If your family members don't like it too spicy, reduce the amount of chili.
With just a little time in the kitchen, you'll have a delicious grilled squid dish to treat your family!

mon_an.ten: Delicious and Healthy Homemade Strawberry Jam
mon_an.mo_ta: Instead of buying store-bought jam, you can absolutely make your own delicious and healthy strawberry jam for yourself and your family!
cac_buoc: The ingredients for making strawberry jam are shown in the image!
Step 1:
Wash the strawberries and remove the stems.
Step 2:
Place the strawberries in a pot with sugar and macerate for 30 minutes. The sugar will soften the strawberries, making them much easier to mash with a fork later.
Step 3:

Add the lemon juice and place the pot on the stove. Bring to a boil, then lower the heat and simmer for another 30 minutes (lemon juice helps the jam thicken quickly). Remember to stir the pot and skim off the foam to keep the jam clear.
Step 4:

To test if the jam is ready, place a spoon in the freezer for 15 minutes. Drop a small amount of jam onto the cold spoon and swipe your finger through it; if it leaves a clear path without the jam running back together, it is done. The jam may look a bit runny at first but will thicken further once refrigerated.
Sweet strawberry jam served with bread is simply incomparable.
It also makes a very meaningful gift!

mon_an.ten: Chewy Candied Orange Peel to Soothe Sore Throats
mon_an.mo_ta: Each piece of candied orange peel is chewy, soft, and fragrant with an attractive color. When eating, you will enjoy a sweet taste with a slight zest on the tip of your tongue. Candied orange peel is delicious and helps prevent sore throats during the cold season.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Orange peel - 200g (choose yellow oranges for a beautiful color; 200g of peel requires about 4 - 5 oranges)
Powdered sugar - 50g (for coating; if unavailable, you can grind granulated sugar, or skip this ingredient if preferred)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the orange peel

Wash the oranges and let them drain in a basket or dry them with a clean towel. Cut off the ends and slice into wedges. Separate the peel and cut into long strips about 0.5 cm thick. Use a crinkle cutter or a wavy knife to make the peels look more attractive.
Step 2: Process the ingredients

Place the orange peels in a pot, cover with cold water, and bring to a boil over high heat. Lower the heat and simmer for about 5 minutes, then drain the peels and rinse thoroughly with cold water. Repeat this process a few times until the bitterness is removed or reaches your desired level; I usually do this 2-3 times as my family likes a bit of zest.
Mix cold water with a bit of salt (season it like a soup), then soak the peels overnight. Drain and rinse with cold water to remove the saltiness, then toss in a basket to dry.
Step 3: Marinate the orange peel
Place the orange peel, sugar, honey, and orange juice into a pot. Stir well and macerate for about 8 hours. Occasionally stir during the process so the peels absorb the flavors evenly.
After 8 hours, the sugar will have completely dissolved into a liquid as shown.
You can adjust the amount of sugar to taste. I find this ratio of peel to sugar appropriate since I will also add a sugar coating later.
Step 4: Candy the peel

After 8 hours, place the pot on the stove to candy the peel. Bring the mixture of orange peel, sugar water, and honey to a boil. Once boiling, lower the heat to the lowest setting and simmer until the orange peels become translucent and the syrup thickens and becomes tacky, then turn off the heat. Stir gently and regularly during the process so the peels absorb the syrup evenly.
The cooking time depends on the thickness of the peel. If the liquid dries out before the peels are translucent, you can add a little water and continue simmering until done.
Step 5: Dry the jam
If you do not like a sugar coating, simply arrange the orange peels on a wide tray lined with paper (or a rack with a tray underneath to catch drips) and leave them until they are completely dry.
My family likes a sugar coating, so as soon as Step 4 is finished, quickly transfer the peels to a plate of powdered sugar. Roll them to coat evenly, then let them dry.

Drying time depends on factors like the softness of the jam and air humidity. If the air is too humid and the jam won't dry, you can place the tray in the refrigerator or a dehydrator/oven at 100-110°C for about 10-20 minutes. Watch closely during drying to prevent the jam from becoming too dry and losing its chewiness.
This article uses recipes and images adapted from Savourydays and Afamily.
It's quite simple, isn't it? Candied orange peel is an easy snack that uses available ingredients and helps prevent respiratory illnesses during cold days.
Good cooking – Delicious dishes

mon_an.ten: Warm Sweet Potato Milk Soup for Cold Days
mon_an.mo_ta: Sweet potato milk soup is sweet, creamy, and fragrant. This is due to the unique combination of sweet potatoes and fresh milk.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Prepare the ingredients. Wash the sweet potatoes and steam until cooked through.
Step 2:
Peel the potatoes and mash them in a small bowl. Prepare a mixture of 50 ml of milk and a little squeezed ginger juice; set aside.
Step 3:
Pour the remaining fresh milk into a pot and heat it up. Add the milk powder and mashed potatoes, then stir well.
Step 4:
Add sugar to suit your preference. Maintain medium heat and stir constantly to prevent the mixture from clumping.
Step 5:
When the milk boils and bubbles start to form, turn off the heat. Pour the mixture into the cup of prepared milk and ginger juice, and let it sit for about 5 minutes.
Step 6:
Sweet potato milk soup is sweet, creamy, and fragrant. This is due to the unique combination of sweet potatoes and fresh milk.

mon_an.mo_ta: Mini pizzas are delicious, fancy, and very affordable. When eating, you will experience a crispy crust, fresh toppings, savory seasoning, and a rich layer of cheese. Just spend a little time in the kitchen to have a wonderful treat for your family and friends!
cac_buoc: How to make mini pizzas for 2 people:
Step 1: Prepare the ingredients.
Wash the tomato and slice it into thin rounds.
Crack the eggs into a bowl and beat them.
Peel and mince the garlic.
Thinly slice the bacon (skip this if using pre-sliced bacon).
Grate the mozzarella cheese or use pre-shredded cheese from the supermarket.
Cut the English muffins in half.
Step 2: Cooking steps.
First, preheat your oven to 350°F (equivalent to 180°C).
Next, line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.
Arrange the muffin halves on the tray and place them in the oven. Bake for a few minutes until they are hot and crispy, then remove from the oven.
Once the muffins are toasted, add the milk, black pepper, salt, and garlic to the beaten eggs and mix well until combined.
Melt one teaspoon of butter in a pan over the stove.
Once the butter has melted, fry the eggs until golden. Ensure the eggs are cooked on both sides and break them into smaller pieces while frying.
Using the prepared baking tray, layer the ingredients onto the muffins: 1-2 tomato slices, 1 slice of bacon, fried eggs, and a sprinkle of shredded cheese on top.
Repeat this process with the remaining muffins and toppings until all ingredients are used.
Finally, return the pizzas to the oven and bake for about 1 minute or until the cheese has melted.
Carefully use a spatula to transfer the pizzas to a plate and enjoy while hot.
Notes for delicious mini pizzas:
Some people prefer to shred the toppings to make them look more like traditional pizza; feel free to be flexible to suit your taste.
Mini pizzas can be served with chili sauce and tomato sauce.
A small note: do not bake the muffins for too long during the first toast to avoid drying them out.
Besides the ingredients above, you can customize your pizza with any toppings you love.

Mini pizzas are delicious, fancy, and very affordable. When eating, you will experience a crispy crust, fresh toppings, savory seasoning, and a rich layer of cheese. Just spend a little time in the kitchen to have a wonderful treat for your family and friends!

mon_an.mo_ta: Cheese yogurt, with its rich and creamy cheese flavor blended into fresh, cool yogurt, will give you a delicious sensation when enjoyed.
cac_buoc: How to make cheese yogurt for 4 people
Prepare the ingredients:
First, place the cheese in a bowl and mash it to prepare for double boiling.
Prepare the necessary tools: a pot, a stirring spoon, a sieve, about 13 glass yogurt jars, a styrofoam box or a yogurt maker.
Steps to make cheese yogurt for 4 people:
Step 1: Place the cheese in a bowl and set it over a pot of water to double boil until completely melted. Alternatively, you can melt the cheese in a microwave.

Step 2: Add the condensed milk, fresh milk, and melted cheese to a pot. Place over medium heat and stir constantly until the mixture is warm, then remove from heat. Remember to stir well so the ingredients blend together!
Step 3: Once the mixture is prepared, pour the starter yogurt into the warm mixture. Stir thoroughly and carefully until the yogurt is completely dissolved.
Step 4: Slowly filter the mixture through a sieve to ensure it is smooth and free of lumps.
Step 5: After sieving, divide the yogurt evenly into glass jars and place them in a styrofoam box. Pour warm water into the box (or yogurt maker) until it reaches about 2/3 of the height of the jars.
Step 6: Incubate the yogurt for about 8 hours to ferment if using a styrofoam box; if using a machine, follow the manufacturer's instructions.
Step 7: Once incubation is complete, place the yogurt in the refrigerator to chill!
After chilling for 1 – 1.5 hours, you can take it out and enjoy.
Notes for delicious cheese yogurt:
Just like making regular yogurt, when heating the condensed milk, fresh milk, and cheese, only make it warm. Do not make it too hot because the starter culture will die, and the yogurt will not set.
If the mixture accidentally gets too hot, wait for it to cool down before adding the yogurt starter.
When incubating, make sure to seal the styrofoam box tightly.
Depending on your preference, you can adjust the chilling time. For a soft, chewy texture, chill for 1 – 1.5 hours; for a firmer texture, leave it for 2 – 3 hours.
Note that you should not eat yogurt on an empty stomach or immediately after a main meal. It is best enjoyed after a nap or about 30 minutes after a main meal.
Cheese yogurt, with its rich and creamy cheese flavor blended into fresh, cool yogurt, will give you a delicious sensation when enjoyed.

mon_an.mo_ta: Basil fried chicken with a crispy outer crust and juicy, well-seasoned meat, served with a sweet and sour dipping sauce, provides a wonderful eating experience. Just a little time in the kitchen and you'll have a fresh snack to treat your family and friends.
cac_buoc: How to make irresistible basil fried chicken

Wash the chicken, drain well, pat dry with paper towels, and cut into bite-sized cubes. Marinate the chicken with soy sauce, wine, sugar, minced garlic, and 1 teaspoon of five-spice powder. Let it marinate for 30 minutes, then add 1 beaten egg and the cornstarch; mix well. Stir thoroughly so the ingredients are well combined, which helps the chicken stay soft and juicy when fried.
In another bowl, mix the sweet potato starch, garlic powder, and the remaining 1 teaspoon of five-spice powder to use as a coating. Mix well so the powders are fully combined.
Dredge each piece of chicken in the coating mixture until finished, then let the chicken rest for a moment while you prepare other things.
Wash the basil leaves and finely chop them.
Heat oil in a pan and fry the chicken until golden. Remove the chicken and place it on a plate lined with paper towels to absorb excess oil. For long-lasting crispiness, double-fry the chicken.

Using the same pan, pour out most of the oil, leaving just a little. Stir-fry the basil leaves, then add the chicken and toss well. If serving adults, turn off the heat and sprinkle with a little chili powder; skip this step for children.
Finally, arrange the chicken on a plate and enjoy.
Notes for perfect basil fried chicken:
Besides chicken breast, you can choose any part you like, such as thighs or wings.
When mixing the coating, stir well and measure ingredients accurately so the crust is crispy and flavorful after frying.
How to choose good chicken:
A good chicken will have a compact, firm body and a small breast.
The skin should be naturally yellow, with darker yellow areas on the wings, breast, and back. The skin should not be bruised, pale, or have black spots or nodules.
If the skin is tough and uniformly bright yellow but the fat is white, the chicken may have been treated with dye.
The meat should be firm, fresh, and free of foul odors or antibiotic smells.

Press on the body, breast, or thigh to check; firm meat indicates good quality. If the meat is flabby, slippery, deformed, or pitted (indicating water injection), do not buy it to protect your health.

Basil fried chicken with a crispy outer crust and juicy, well-seasoned meat, served with a sweet and sour dipping sauce, provides a wonderful eating experience. Just a little time in the kitchen and you'll have a fresh snack to treat your family and friends.

mon_an.ten: Refreshing Three-Layer Fruit Jelly for Summer
