mon_an.mo_ta: Three-layer fruit jelly has a light sweetness and the refreshing aroma of peaches and lychees. Served with a bit of shaved ice, it helps cool your body and makes you feel much more comfortable.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Tools - blender, glass or small white plastic cups, two small pots
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients for the three-layer fruit jelly.
Peel the lychees and remove the seeds to get the white flesh.
Wash the peaches, peel them, and remove the pits to get the flesh.
Soak the gelatin sheets in cold water for about 10 minutes until soft, then divide into two portions.
Step 2: Steps to make the three-layer fruit jelly
First, place the lychees in a blender and puree until smooth, then pour into the first pot.
Next, place the peaches in the blender with 50ml of water and 10g of sugar; puree until smooth. Set aside a small amount of the peach puree in a bowl, and pour the rest into the second pot.
Place both pots on the stove and bring them to a boil.

Once the lychee and peach mixtures boil, turn off the heat, remove the pots, and add one portion of soaked gelatin to each pot. Stir constantly and thoroughly until the gelatin is completely dissolved.
Prepare the cups on the table. First, pour a thin layer of peach mixture into the cups, about 1cm thick.
Place the cups in the freezer for about 10 minutes to let the peach layer set.
Once the peach layer has set, remove the cups; you now have the peach jelly base.
Pour the second layer, the lychee mixture, into the cups. This layer should be slightly thicker than the peach layer. Similarly, place the cups in the freezer for 10 minutes to set.
After 10 minutes, take the cups out and repeat the process until all the peach and lychee mixtures are used, alternating the white and yellow colors as described.
Finally, once the three-layer jelly is complete, spoon a bit of the reserved peach puree onto each cup, add some shaved ice, garnish with a few mint leaves, and enjoy.
Notes for delicious three-layer fruit jelly:
For the yellow jelly layer, you can substitute with similar colored fruits like mango or pineapple, as long as the fruit is sweet with only a hint of tartness.
The thickness of the layers can be adjusted to your liking; thinner layers set faster. Adjust the time accordingly.
When blending lychees, since they are very juicy and sweet, do not add extra water or sugar.

Additionally, do not add the gelatin sheets while the fruit mixture is still boiling on the stove; only add them after removing the pot from the heat. Otherwise, the setting power of the gelatin will be reduced.
Depending on your preference, you can change the colors of this jelly by using different fruits and following the same steps.
Three-layer fruit jelly has a light sweetness and the refreshing aroma of peaches and lychees. Served with a bit of shaved ice, it helps cool your body and makes you feel much more comfortable.

mon_an.mo_ta: After a hard day's work, enjoying a glass of mango pineapple yogurt smoothie will help you recharge your energy to enjoy leisure activities with your family.
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients
Wash and peel the ripe mango. Cut the mango into small cubes about the size of two fingers. Avoid cutting too close to the pit as the fibers can ruin the texture of the smoothie.
Peel the pineapple, remove the eyes, cut in half, and use 1/2 of the fruit. Slice the pineapple into bite-sized pieces.
How to make the mango pineapple yogurt smoothie
First, place the chopped mango and pineapple into a blender and puree until smooth. If you don't have a blender, you can place them in a bowl and mash them thoroughly with a ladle.
Next, add the fresh milk to the blender with the fruit mixture. If you prefer a thinner or less sweet smoothie, you can add more milk and a few ice cubes to taste.
Add the 2 containers of yogurt and blend for about 3 minutes until the ingredients are well combined. If you have mint leaves, add a few to the blender for a cool, refreshing flavor.
Finally, pour the mango pineapple yogurt into glasses and refrigerate for about 20 minutes before serving.
Notes for a delicious mango pineapple yogurt smoothie:
How to choose good mangoes:

When buying mangoes, choose those with nice skin that is not bruised or dark. Look for mangoes with an even yellow color, firm skin, and a golden, firm stem area that doesn't mush when pressed. Avoid green mangoes that feel soft, as they were likely picked too early. Firm, golden mangoes from the bottom of the tree are usually sweeter. To check freshness, snap the stem and smell it; a sweet, aromatic scent with essential oils indicates freshness without preservatives. To check for meatiness, look at the small eye at the tip of the tail; the longer the eye, the larger the pit and the less meat.
How to choose good pineapples:

A good, fresh pineapple has an intact shape and bright color. Choose pineapples that look fresh, still have some bloom on the skin, and are not bruised. The stem should look freshly cut, and the fruit should feel heavy and firm.
If you want a pineapple that is just ripe, choose one with a few green eyes; it will be sweeter than one that is overripe.

After a hard day's work, enjoying a glass of mango pineapple yogurt smoothie will help you recharge your energy to enjoy leisure activities with your family. With easy-to-find ingredients and a simple method, this smoothie's signature aroma and refreshing taste will provide a wonderful experience. It also provides plenty of nutrition and vitamins for your health.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Delicious Chilled Sữa Chua Nếp Cẩm at Home
mon_an.mo_ta: Sữa chua nếp cẩm is a favorite snack for many young people, featuring fragrant black glutinous rice with an eye-catching color and moderate sweetness. The cool yogurt blends with a bit of condensed milk and fresh tapioca pearls for a wonderful experience. Check out how to make it at home in the article below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fine salt, filtered water - filtered water
cac_buoc: How to make the yogurt:
First, pour the condensed milk into a large bowl and add the boiling milk, stirring well. Then, add 2 cans of boiled milk that has been cooled.
Stir the starter yogurt in its container, then pour it into the milk mixture and stir thoroughly.

Next, pour the mixture into glass jars and close the lids. Boil a pot of water, then place the yogurt jars in the pot so the water does not enter the jars. Let it sit for about 4 hours to ferment, then move the yogurt to the refrigerator.
How to make the black glutinous rice:
Wash the black glutinous rice, removing any husks or damaged grains, then soak in a pot for 2 – 3 hours.

Next, place the rice in a rice cooker, add water until it just covers the rice, and close the lid. When it boils, add the pandan leaves and cook until the rice is tender and thickened. Stir occasionally while cooking to ensure the rice is sticky.
Add the sugar and stir for another 4-5 minutes so the rice absorbs the sweetness. Do not cook for too long or the rice will become hard again.
Finally, turn off the heat and let the rice cool. The cooked black glutinous rice has a sweet, slightly fermented taste and a wonderful aroma.
How to assemble:
Spoon the cooked black glutinous rice into a cup, add the prepared yogurt, a bit of condensed milk, fresh coconut, and tapioca pearls, then enjoy with shaved ice.
Notes for delicious sữa chua nếp cẩm:
You can buy black glutinous rice at the store; however, choose the type where the husk isn't over-polished, as removing too much husk loses the nutrients.
Choose large, round, unbroken grains so the rice is tastier and doesn't become mushy.
When enjoying, you can add any ingredients you like, such as dried coconut or red beans, to vary the dish.

Sữa chua nếp cẩm is a favorite snack for many young people, featuring fragrant black glutinous rice with an eye-catching color and moderate sweetness. The cool yogurt blends with a bit of condensed milk and fresh tapioca pearls for a wonderful experience. Just a little time in the kitchen with familiar ingredients and you'll have a cool treat for your family and friends. Everyone will praise it and ask for your secret!

mon_an.ten: Guide to Making Crispy Shaken Bananas
mon_an.mo_ta: Crispy shaken bananas are a favorite snack for many young people, featuring crunchy banana slices with moderate sweetness and a fragrant banana aroma. They are nutritious and keep you full for a long time. Here is the recipe for crispy shaken bananas you should know!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Shaking seasoning mix - 1 tsp chili salt, 1/2 tsp sugar, 1 tsp chili powder, 1 tsp toasted coriander and crushed dried basil
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Peel the green bananas and soak them in water mixed with the juice of 1 lemon and 1 teaspoon of salt to release the sap and prevent browning.
Next, use a knife or a mandoline to thinly slice the bananas into the same water.
Then, remove the bananas and rinse with warm water so they don't become too stiff and break easily during processing.
Step 2:
After soaking in warm water, remove the bananas and place them on a wooden board lined with paper towels to dry.
Use more paper towels to pat the top surface until completely dry to prevent oil splattering during frying.
Step 3:

Next, place a small pot or a deep pan on the stove and add plenty of oil. When the oil is hot, lower the heat to medium and fry the bananas in small batches. When the edges start to turn golden, stir gently and increase the heat. When the slices are slightly firm and golden (do not let them get too dark or they will be bitter), quickly remove them and place on a plate lined with paper towels to drain excess oil.
Continue until all the bananas are fried.
Step 4:
Sift the powdered white sugar slowly over the bananas. Toss the bowl so the sugar coats them evenly.
Alternatively, you can prepare a chili salt seasoning for shaking: mix 1 tsp chili salt, 1/2 tsp sugar, 1 tsp chili powder, and 1 tsp toasted coriander with crushed dried basil.
After frying, sprinkle this seasoning mix over the bananas and toss well.
Finally, arrange the bananas on a plate and enjoy.
Notes for perfect crispy shaken bananas:
After processing, store the shaken bananas in a glass jar or a tightly sealed plastic bag to use gradually.
Besides bananas, you can make shaken taro in the same way; it is guaranteed to be very attractive.
In addition to the two seasoning mixes above, you can experiment with cheese powder, seaweed, or salted plum powder.

How to choose green bananas: Choose a bunch with a deep green color and smooth, evenly curved fruit. If there are slight yellow spots, it's even better. The lighter the green of the skin, the younger the banana.

mon_an.mo_ta: Spicy pork jerky is a fantastic snack made from fresh pork, deeply marinated with spices. Its chewy texture and mild heat provide a wonderful experience for anyone who tries it.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Marinade - 1 tbsp chili powder; 1 tbsp oyster sauce; 1 tbsp fish sauce
cac_buoc: Step 1: Rinse the pork with salt to remove any odors, then rinse again with clean water. Let the meat drain, pat it dry, and slice into large pieces along the grain, about 5mm thick.
Step 2: Wash the lemongrass and chilies, then cut into short segments. Peel and wash the garlic. Peel the ginger, wash, and slice.
Step 3: Place the lemongrass, garlic, chili, and ginger into a blender. Cover and pulse until finely minced, but not necessarily a smooth paste.
Step 4: Pour the minced aromatics into a bowl, add all the prepared marinade ingredients, and mix well to create the pork marinade.

Step 5: Place the pork in a large bowl and pour the marinade over it. Wear gloves and massage the meat thoroughly to ensure it is evenly coated. Marinate for at least 2 hours, or ideally 6-8 hours in the refrigerator for better flavor penetration.
Step 6: Once marinated, arrange the meat slices on a wire rack. Place the tray in the oven at 100°C, propping the oven door open slightly with a chopstick to allow steam to escape.
Dry for about 20-30 minutes, then remove to flip the pieces. Continue drying until the pork jerky reaches your desired dryness.
Finally, remove the jerky from the oven, let it cool, and enjoy.
How to choose good pork

Fresh meat: The exterior has a dry film and the surface is slightly firm. The cut surface is bright pink, the skin is soft, the muscle fibers are firm, and it has good elasticity (pressing with a finger leaves no lasting indentation). The fat is bright, firm, and has a characteristic aroma. Joint surfaces are smooth and clear. Bone marrow clings tightly to the bone and is elastic.

Stale meat: The exterior starts to feel slimy (depending on the degree of staleness), the cut surface is slightly wet, and elasticity is poor (pressing with a finger leaves a visible indentation). The fat is dark, less firm, and has an off-odor. Joints are slimy and the fluid is cloudy. Marrow easily detaches from the bone and is dark or brown.
Old pork or sow meat: The meat fibers are loose, dark red, and the skin is thick.

Diseased pork: The meat is loose, the fat is yellow and may contain opaque white grains. Small spots may appear on the liver or kidneys. The skin may have round or oval hemorrhages or may be uneven where abscesses were removed.

Avoid buying meat that is too old or too young. Choose medium-aged pork with pink meat and thin skin. There are two types of lean meat: tenderloin and ham. Tenderloin is tastier and sweeter for cooking but can become dry and fibrous if overcooked. Ham meat is softer.
For pork hock, choose the hind leg as it has more meat and softer skin.
If buying pork fat to render into lard, choose large leaf fat that is white with a hint of pink.

mon_an.ten: Chicken, Cabbage, and Vietnamese Coriander Salad
mon_an.mo_ta: In the summer, I often go to Hai Thuong Lan Ong Street for snacks and am addicted to the chicken and cabbage salad there. Since I had ingredients ready at home—home-raised chicken, a pot full of Vietnamese coriander, and a kitchen stocked with cabbage and carrots—plus the need to balance out the heavy Tet holiday food, I decided to make this salad for the family. Everyone loved it, so I couldn't sleep and had to post this recipe right away to share with everyone!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Chicken - 1 large bowl of shredded chicken (I use the white meat from boiled chicken; you can use any part, thigh meat works well too)
Onion - 1 piece (any type, but red onion adds great color)
Vietnamese coriander (rau răm) - 1 handful (can add cilantro or Thai basil if desired)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel and thinly slice the onion. Place in a bowl and soak with vinegar, sugar, and fish sauce at a ratio of 1 vinegar: 2 sugar: 1 fish sauce for about 15 minutes to reduce the pungency. You can substitute vinegar with lime juice. Ensure the mixture is more sweet than sour to keep the onion crunchy.
Step 2: Thinly shred the cabbage, wash, and drain well.
Step 3: Peel the carrot, wash, and shred into thin strips.
Step 4: Wash the cucumber, halve it, remove the core, and shred into strips.
Step 5: Prepare the dressing
Mince the garlic and chili...

...then mix with sugar, fish sauce, and lime juice. My family likes a balance of mild vinegar sourness and lime aroma, so I use a ratio of 2 fish sauce: 2 sugar: 1/2 lime juice: 1/2 vinegar. Adjust the seasoning to your taste. The dressing is the most important part; a good fish sauce mixture makes the dish.
Step 6: Mix the salad

Combine the chicken, shredded cabbage, carrots, onions, cucumbers, and chopped Vietnamese coriander in a large bowl. Pour the dressing from Step 5 over and toss well. Adjust seasoning to taste. You can squeeze in more lime for extra aroma.
Finally, add the crushed roasted peanuts and toss again.

Besides serving on a regular plate, you can serve this chicken and cabbage salad on a large rice cracker (bánh đa) for a rustic touch. The rice cracker can be eaten along with the salad, which is very delicious.
You can also use similar ingredients to make the shredded chicken salad recipe I shared previously.

mon_an.ten: Sweet and Sour Crispy Jellyfish Salad
mon_an.mo_ta: The weather is cool, and for some reason, I'm craving jellyfish salad! It might seem odd—some people even like eating ice cream in winter—so I decided to write this recipe for those who share my unique cravings. Let's get into the kitchen and learn how to make this crispy, delicious jellyfish salad.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning salt, sugar, MSG - to taste
cac_buoc: Step 1: Roast the peanuts, remove the skins, and crush them. Wash the green mango and carrot, peel, and shred into strips (you can use a grater). Wash the herbs and tear into short pieces.
Step 2: Rinse the jellyfish with warm water and squeeze dry.
Step 3: Slice the pig ear into long, thin strips.
Step 4: Combine the jellyfish, pig ear, peanuts, mango, carrot, and herbs. Add seasoning salt, sugar, MSG, chili, and lime juice to taste, then toss everything together.
Step 5: Arrange the sweet and sour crispy jellyfish salad on a plate and enjoy.

mon_an.ten: Plum Syrup and Salted Dried Plums
mon_an.mo_ta: Using plums as the main ingredient, you can make two treats: salted dried plums (ô mai) for snacking and plum syrup for a refreshing summer drink! Follow the instructions below.
cac_buoc: Here are the ingredients you need to prepare!
Step 1:
First, wash the plums thoroughly and soak them in salt water for about 1 hour. Then, remove and drain.
Step 2:
Make vertical scores around each plum down to the pit.
Step 3:
Next, mix the plums with sugar and let them sit in a cool place for about 4-5 hours (until the sugar has completely dissolved).
Step 4:
Place the plums on the stove and simmer over medium heat. Note that you do not need to stir the plums while they are cooking!
Step 5:
Simmer until the plums have slightly shriveled, then turn off the heat.
Step 6:
Remove the plums from the pot and let them drain completely.
Step 7:
Take the collected liquid and the liquid remaining in the pot, bring it to a boil once more to create the plum syrup.
Step 8:
To make the salted dried plums (ô mai), dry the plums in an oven at 80 - 100°C for about 1 hour.
Step 9:
Finely crush the ginger, squeeze out the juice, and mix the ginger pulp with salt. Toss this mixture with the dried plums to finish the ô mai.
If you don't have an oven, you can mix the plums with the ginger-salt mixture and stir-fry over low heat until the fruit becomes firm and dry.
Now your plum syrup and ô mai combo is ready!
Simply mix the syrup with a little water and ice for a refreshing drink!
Plum juice is excellent for quenching thirst!
Homemade ô mai is very safe and clean!
The plums are thick and delicious to eat!
You can also use the syrup to make plum soda!

mon_an.mo_ta: These delicious banana pancake rolls provide a nutritious breakfast for the whole family! Enjoying them with a glass of milk or hot soy milk is wonderful. Start your day with energy and passion! These delicious banana pancake rolls provide a nutritious breakfast for the whole family! Enjoying them with a glass of milk or hot soy milk is wonderful. Start your day with energy and passion!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Chocolate syrup, cooking oil - For serving
cac_buoc: Step 1: Beat the egg in a bowl until smooth. Add the milk and whisk together, then add the pancake mix and stir until well combined.
Step 2: Peel the bananas and cut into short segments.

Step 3: Place a pan over the heat with a little oil. Use a tablespoon to pour the batter into the pan. Fry for 2 minutes until golden, flip and fry for another 1 minute. Flip again, place a banana segment in the center, and fold the left and right sides of the pancake over to hold the banana. Since the pancake is soft while hot, it is easy to fold.
Step 4: Place the rolls on a plate and drizzle with chocolate syrup.
Wishing everyone success with this delicious dish!

mon_an.mo_ta: Making mozzarella cheese sticks for kids is a favorite for many mothers. Most children love cheese sticks because of their crispy texture and delicious flavor. However, buying them from street vendors can be worrying regarding food hygiene. Why not make them yourself? Follow this recipe for delicious homemade mozzarella cheese sticks. Making mozzarella cheese sticks for kids is a favorite for many mothers. Most children love cheese sticks because of their crispy texture and delicious flavor. However, buying them from street vendors can be worrying regarding food hygiene. Why not make them yourself? Follow this recipe for delicious homemade mozzarella cheese sticks.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Cut the cheese into rectangular sticks of moderate thickness. Do not cut them too thin (they will break during coating) or too thick (they will be too heavy/greasy).

Step 2: Prepare 3 large bowls. The first for flour. The second for the beaten eggs mixed with 2-3 tablespoons of milk for extra richness. The third for breadcrumbs. You can add a pinch of salt to the eggs or flour if you prefer a saltier taste.
Step 3: Dredge the cheese sticks in flour, then dip into the egg mixture. You can repeat this process once more for a thicker crust.
After the egg wash, roll the sticks in breadcrumbs. Ensure the breadcrumbs coat every part of the cheese stick.
Step 4: For the best crispiness, place the coated cheese sticks in the freezer for about 1 hour. If you are in a hurry, you can skip this step.

Step 5: Remove the cheese from the freezer and begin frying. Use enough oil to ensure the sticks are submerged. Heat the oil until very hot, then turn the heat down slightly and begin frying until golden.

mon_an.mo_ta: This skillet pizza dip is both familiar and unique, featuring a crispy crust, rich and stretchy cheese, fiber from spinach, tender chicken, tangy tomatoes, and the mild sweetness of onions. This dish is perfect for large parties or gatherings with friends and loved ones. Everyone will enjoy this hot, fragrant pizza with a soda while chatting.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, preheat your oven to 177°C.
Step 2:
Thaw the spinach and squeeze out all excess water until dry.
Mix the spinach with the Alfredo sauce, then add 1/2 of the shredded mozzarella, 2/3 of the chicken, and 2/3 of the tomatoes.
Stir until the mixture is well combined and the ingredients are evenly distributed.
Step 3:
Grease a non-stick skillet with oil, then open the tube of pizza dough.
Step 4:
Roll out the dough and cut it into 12 squares using a knife or a pizza cutter.
Step 5:
Brush the egg white onto the pizza dough squares. Cut each mozzarella stick into 4 equal pieces.
Place one piece of cheese on each dough square, then wrap the dough around it and roll into a small ball.
Step 6:
Once the dough balls are rolled, place them around the edge of the skillet to form a ring (using all 12 balls).
Spoon the spinach mixture into the center of the dough ring.
Step 7:
Brush olive oil over the dough balls and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Sprinkle the remaining mozzarella over the dip in the center.
Top with the remaining chicken, tomatoes, and any extra cheese. Place the skillet in the oven.
Step 8:
Bake for 32-35 minutes until the pizza crust turns golden brown, the cheese is melted and bubbly, or until the pizza is fully cooked.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before serving.
Finally, serve the pizza dip with chili sauce or ketchup.
Notes for a perfect skillet pizza dip
You can sprinkle your favorite toppings onto the pizza such as bacon, mushrooms, onions, sausage, or seafood. (If using seafood, ensure it is cleaned and seasoned before baking).

This skillet pizza dip offers a crispy crust and rich, fragrant cheese combined with healthy spinach and tender chicken. It's a great dish for social gatherings. Sharing this hot meal with friends will help wash away the fatigue of a long workday. Get in the kitchen and show off your skills—your guests will surely be impressed!

mon_an.mo_ta: Refreshing Mango Pudding – Another recipe for pudding lovers. This easy-to-make mango treat is incredibly fragrant and delicious! Here is a simple recipe for a refreshing Mango Pudding.
cac_buoc: Step 1: To make the Refreshing Mango Pudding, first soak the gelatin leaves in the milk until they soften.
Step 2:
Take a portion of the mango and cut it into small cubes; place these into the pudding cups.
Puree the remaining mango until smooth.
Step 3: Place a small saucepan on the stove, add the milk and gelatin mixture, and heat over low heat until the gelatin is completely dissolved.
Step 4: Keep the heat at the lowest setting, add the sugar, heavy cream, and mango puree. Stir well for a moment, then turn off the heat.
Step 5: Pour the mixture into cups or molds and refrigerate for 2 hours until set. However, for the best texture, the mango pudding should be left in the refrigerator overnight.
Source: Kenh14

mon_an.mo_ta: Fried Battered Vegetables – A great afternoon snack for relaxing and chatting with friends. This recipe is simple yet offers a unique and tasty flavor!
cac_buoc: For this Fried Battered Vegetable snack, you can vary the types of root vegetables according to your and your family's preferences.
Step 1:
Wash the potatoes and sweet potatoes, removing any eyes.
Shred them into thin strips, or use a grater to save time.
Step 2:
Soak the shredded potatoes and sweet potatoes in diluted salt water to prevent them from browning.
Then, remove and drain in a basket.
Step 3: Next preparation steps:
Wash the radish and carrot, peel them, and shred into strips.
Wash the pumpkin, peel, and shred into strips.
Step 4:
Mix all the vegetables together in a large bowl.
Gradually add the flour and cold water (use water from the fridge) so the batter doesn't become too thin. Add sugar and a pinch of salt to taste.

Step 5: Heat a pan of oil. When the oil is hot, scoop portions of the vegetable mixture into the pan and fry until golden brown on both sides. Once fried, remove to a plate lined with paper towels to drain excess oil. Serve with chili sauce or ketchup.
Source: BeyondKimchee

mon_an.mo_ta: If you are a snack lover, this recipe is for you! Spicy garlic roasted seaweed is fragrant, savory, and crunchy with a salty and spicy kick. While you can buy this snack easily, homemade versions ensure better hygiene and quality. By making it yourself, you know exactly where your ingredients come from. It's safe, affordable, and can be adjusted to your personal taste! Let's learn how to make this attractive snack for cold days.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Tay Ninh shrimp salt - to taste
cac_buoc: Step 1: Cut the dried seaweed (the type used for soup) into small pieces and place in a bowl.
Step 2: Peel and mince the garlic and ginger. Wash the chilies; crush some and mince the rest.

Step 3: Place a pan on the stove with a little oil. Sauté the ginger and garlic over low heat until fragrant. When they turn golden, add the crushed and minced chilies (adjust to your spice preference), toss quickly, then add 1 tablespoon of Tay Ninh shrimp salt.

Step 4: Turn off the heat immediately. Quickly add the seaweed and toss well so the spices coat the seaweed evenly. You can add sugar while it's still hot if you like a hint of sweetness. Let it cool naturally before storing in a jar for later use 😀 though in my house, it's usually gone before it even makes it into the jar!
Note: The residual heat of the oil after turning off the stove is enough to make the seaweed crispy and absorb the spices; keeping the heat on will easily burn the seaweed and make it bitter.

mon_an.mo_ta: This eye-catching 3-layer yogurt parfait is an easy-to-make treat featuring a delightful combination of familiar snacks. Learn how to make this beautiful 3-layer yogurt dessert!
cac_buoc: 3-Layer Yogurt Parfait
Step 1: Pour the yogurt into the bottom of the glass. Wait a moment for the yogurt to settle evenly, then place it in the freezer for 15 minutes.
Step 2: Place the cookies in a bag and the pistachios in another bag. Use a rolling pin or mallet to crush the contents of both bags into crumbs.
Step 3: Peel the mango, cut into small pieces, and blend until smooth. If the mango is tart, you can add a little sugar for sweetness.

Step 4: Now for the presentation: Take the yogurt glass out of the freezer. Sprinkle a layer of cookie crumbs, followed by a layer of pureed mango. Repeat until the glass is nearly full, then top with a scoop of mango ice cream and a sprinkle of pistachios. Your yogurt dessert is now complete.

mon_an.mo_ta: Enjoy these smooth, cool, and slightly creamy soft yogurt cubes—an incredibly attractive treat for hot days.
cac_buoc: Step 1: First, soak the gelatine leaves in ice-cold water for about 15 minutes until they soften.

Step 2: Place a pot on the stove and add the fresh milk, sugar, and condensed milk. Heat while stirring until the sugar dissolves (note: do not bring to a boil; turn off the heat as soon as the sugar has dissolved).
Step 3: Once the sugar has dissolved, turn off the heat. Remove the soaked gelatine leaves from the cold water and stir them into the warm milk mixture until fully dissolved.
Step 4: Next, add the yogurt and whipping cream to the mixture and stir well. Strain the mixture through a sieve before pouring it into your preferred molds or containers.
Step 5: Place the molds in the refrigerator for at least 5 hours to allow the yogurt to set before removing it from the molds.
To serve, simply cut the soft yogurt into bite-sized squares and place them in a glass or bowl along with fruits such as watermelon, kiwi, dragon fruit, strawberries, blueberries, or mango.
Finally, sprinkle a little cocoa powder on top to complete this delicious soft yogurt treat!
Good luck with making this refreshing soft yogurt with fruit for sunny days!

mon_an.mo_ta: This multi-layered jelly with three flavors and colors characteristic of the Christmas season will delight everyone, especially children. Try making this 3-color jelly to welcome the upcoming holiday season.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Glass tray - Size of your choice (a 23cm x 23cm tray was used here)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Mix 50ml of room temperature water with 250ml of boiling water, then add the gelatin powder and stir until dissolved.

Step 2: Pour one pack of strawberry jelly powder into the mixture and stir until the water turns a beautiful red. If the powder doesn't dissolve completely, you can heat it over low heat for a few minutes until fully dissolved.
You can add food coloring if desired (if you cannot find strawberry or lime jelly powder, you can use red and green food coloring as substitutes).
Step 3: Pour the strawberry jelly solution into the glass tray. The thickness of the layer depends on the tray size. Let it cool, then place the tray in the refrigerator until the jelly sets.
Step 4: Mix 2 packs of gelatin powder with 125ml of cold water.
Step 4: Mix 1 can of condensed milk with 250ml of boiling water.
Step 5: Pour the gelatin mixture into the bowl of prepared milk from step 4, add another 125ml of boiling water, and stir well until the powder is completely dissolved.

Step 6: Take the tray out of the refrigerator and pour the milk jelly layer over the set strawberry layer. Pour gently to avoid bubbles and try to keep the layers even in thickness (using a glass tray makes it easier to compare the layers). Let it cool, then return the tray to the refrigerator.
Step 7: Repeat steps 1-3 using the lime jelly powder to create a green layer, then pour it over the set milk layer from step 6.
Repeat the process with the remaining ingredients, alternating the red, white, and green layers until the tray is full. Refrigerate for about 2 hours until completely set.
Once set, remove the jelly and cut into bite-sized squares for a festive and appetizing treat.

This 3-color jelly is delicious and easy to make. You can serve it alongside strawberry Santas or a Yule log cake for a beautiful family Christmas party. It also makes a great refreshing snack for hot days.
Additionally, you can try making coconut jelly or fruit jelly using similar techniques. They are also very appealing.
A few tips for 3-color jelly:
You can use store-bought jelly powders, agar-agar powder, or gelatin leaves.
To create colors, you can use food coloring or natural fruit juices for a more appealing and safe option—for example, strawberry juice for red, and pandan leaf extract or matcha powder for green.

mon_an.mo_ta: This crispy fried chicken is thoroughly marinated and tossed with toasted rice for a unique, fragrant crunch that will keep you coming back for more! Let's learn how to make this dish.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Chicken part - 300g chicken breast or skinless thigh; 1 tsp fish sauce; 1/2 tsp sugar; 1 tsp oyster sauce; 1/3 tsp pepper; 70g crispy frying flour
Toasted rice part - 50g rice; 2 lime leaves; 1 tbsp sliced lemongrass; 1/2 tsp dried chili flakes; 1/3 tsp salt
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the chicken, pat dry, and cut into relatively large pieces. Marinate with sugar, oyster sauce, pepper, and fish sauce. Mix well and let sit for 20 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Then, place the chicken in a plastic bag with the frying flour and shake well to coat.
Step 2: Place the rice, lime leaves, and lemongrass in a pan and toast over medium-low heat.

When the rice is golden and fragrant, turn off the heat and let it cool. Place the rice, lime leaves, lemongrass, salt, and dried chili in a blender and grind into a powder. Transfer the toasted rice powder to a bowl.
Step 3: Heat oil in a pan. Once hot, fry the chicken in small batches over medium heat. When the crust is golden and crispy, remove and place on a plate lined with paper towels.
Step 4: While the chicken is still hot, place it into the bowl of toasted rice powder and toss well to coat.
Serve the toasted rice chicken on a plate. It is delicious when eaten hot with chili sauce.

mon_an.mo_ta: Bananas are a healthy and versatile fruit. Today, we will guide you through making "Honey Roasted Bananas." The sweetness of the honey combined with the creamy texture of the banana will make you fall in love with this dish!
cac_buoc: Step 1: First, peel the bananas and place them in a pan to fry.
Fry both sides of the bananas until they turn golden.
Step 2: Squeeze the lemon juice into the pan and turn the heat down to low.
Step 3: Finally, transfer the bananas to a plate and drizzle honey evenly over them. Place them in the oven or microwave at 160°C for about 10 minutes.
Can you smell that wonderful aroma of roasted bananas yet?
Enjoy your delicious honey roasted bananas!

mon_an.mo_ta: These golden, crispy potato balls coated in instant noodles are a dish that children will surely love. It doesn't take much time, and the simple method yields a delicious, unique, and eye-catching flavor. This isn't just for kids; it's a great snack for all ages. Let's find out how to make them!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Peel the potatoes, chop them, and steam or boil until tender.
While the potatoes are still hot, mash them thoroughly (do not blend).
Add the cornstarch, salt, pepper, sugar, and green onions. Mix well, then form into bite-sized round balls.
Step 2:
Roll the potato balls in the bowl of crushed instant noodles until they are evenly coated. (You can also roll them in toasted sesame seeds if desired).
Step 3:
Heat oil in a pan. When the oil is hot, add the noodle-coated potato balls and fry over medium heat.
Fry until the noodles and potatoes are golden and crispy, then remove and place on a plate lined with paper towels.
Serve the crispy potato balls on a plate. They are best enjoyed hot with chili sauce and ketchup.
With just 3 steps in about 15 minutes, we have finished these golden crispy noodle-crusted potato balls.
(Thanks: Dao Lam Anh)

mon_an.mo_ta: Try making hot chocolate with toasted marshmallows—featuring a rich chocolate flavor and the special chewy texture of toasted marshmallows. Learn how to make this delicious treat.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Melt the unsalted butter and pour it onto a small plate. Place the finely crushed cookies on another small plate next to it.
Step 2: Dip the rim of each glass into the melted butter, then dip it into the cookie crumbs. This creates a delicious and beautiful cookie crust on the rim of the glass.

Step 3: Break the 70% dark chocolate into small pieces and place them into the glasses. Note that 1 liter of milk makes about 7 servings. Heat the milk on the stove until it is very hot but not boiling, using low heat and stirring occasionally.

Step 4: If you have an oven, arrange the marshmallows on a tray lined with parchment paper and bake at 160°C until the tops are lightly browned. If you don't have an oven, you can skewer the marshmallows and toast them over a stove flame until lightly charred.

Step 5: Pour the hot milk into the glasses and stir until the chocolate is completely melted. Top with the toasted marshmallows and drizzle a little chocolate syrup over the surface for a beautiful finish.

mon_an.mo_ta: This fried noodle-wrapped shrimp dish is not as greasy as you might think; it is incredibly crunchy, nutritious, and delicious. You'll be eating them until the very last one! Check out the recipe below.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Dipping sauce - 50g mayonnaise; 1 lemon; 2 tbsp sweet chili sauce
cac_buoc: Step 1:
In a bowl, mix the mayonnaise, lemon juice, and sweet chili sauce, then set aside.
Step 2:
Peel the shrimp and remove the heads, leaving the tails intact.
Step 3:
Season the shrimp with salt and pepper. This allows the shrimp to absorb the flavors for a richer taste.
Step 4:
After marinating the shrimp, boil the spaghetti until just tender (al dente).
Step 5:
Once the noodles are cooked, drain them and immediately rinse with cold water.
Step 6:
Drain the noodles thoroughly.
Step 7:
Take the marinated shrimp and the noodles. Wrap the noodles around each shrimp so they are tightly covered and won't come apart.
Step 8:
Next, roll the noodle-wrapped shrimp in all-purpose flour.
Step 9:
Heat oil in a pan until very hot, then deep-fry the shrimp.
Step 10:
When the shrimp are golden brown and crispy, remove them and place on paper towels to drain excess oil.
Arrange the shrimp on a plate and sprinkle with cilantro.
Take a bite and enjoy the sweetness of the shrimp and the crunch of the noodles—absolutely wonderful!
Delicious and very easy to make!

mon_an.mo_ta: Though a humble and familiar dish in Vietnamese households, this caramelized shrimp and pork belly dish has its own special value. It offers a harmonious sweet and salty flavor with an attractive color, making it perfect to eat with steamed rice.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the shrimp, trim the whiskers, and drain. Marinate with ½ tsp salt, 1 tsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp brown sugar, ½ tsp minced garlic, and 1 tsp annatto oil (if you want a beautiful orange color).
Step 2: Slice the pork belly into small pieces. Marinate with ½ tsp salt, 1 tsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp brown sugar, and ½ tsp minced garlic. Add a little annatto oil if desired.
Step 3: Let the shrimp and pork marinate for 15 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Step 4: Place the pork in a pot with a little fish sauce (about 1 tsp). Turn the heat to low and leave the lid off, searing the pork until both sides are browned and the fat renders.
Step 5: Once the pork is seared, add the chopped shallots and cook for about 1 minute until fragrant.

Step 6: Add the shrimp and season with more pepper, fish sauce, and salt to taste. Stir for a moment, then add 1–2 tbsp of sugar. Cover and simmer for about 5 minutes until the shrimp are cooked and golden. When the liquid has reduced to a thick, savory glaze, turn off the heat. Adjust the seasoning and serve.

mon_an.mo_ta: This simple chocolate popcorn recipe will help you upgrade your daily snack. Why not try making this fragrant, unique, and attractive chocolate popcorn?
cac_buoc: Step 1:

Place half of the butter in a microwave-safe bowl and microwave on defrost mode until melted. Add the corn kernels to the melted butter and microwave on the highest setting. After about 3 minutes, take it out and shake well, then microwave for another 2 minutes until popped. Transfer the popcorn to a tray to cool.
Step 2:

Place the remaining butter and the finely chopped chocolate in a bowl. Microwave for 1 minute until melted. Alternatively, you can melt them using a double boiler by placing the bowl over a pot of simmering water. Once melted, add the sugar and stir until completely dissolved.
Step 3:
Pour the chocolate mixture over the popcorn and toss until every kernel is evenly coated. Sprinkle with vanilla powder to enhance the aroma.
The chocolate popcorn is now ready. Enjoy your snack!

mon_an.ten: Homemade Soft and Fragrant Beef Jerky
cac_buoc: Beef jerky is a popular snack loved for its characteristic aroma and savory, spicy taste. Although it is easily available in stores and supermarkets, there are often concerns regarding price and food hygiene. In this article, we will share how to make standard homemade beef jerky, perfect for snacking or as a "drinking snack" during gatherings with friends.
I. Instructions for making traditional soft beef jerky
1. Ingredients
Beef: 500g
Garlic: 1 bulb
Shallots: 10 bulbs
Ginger: 1/4 piece
Lemongrass: 8 stalks
Five-spice powder: 1 tsp
Turmeric powder: 1 tsp
Annatto powder: 1 tsp
Curry powder: 1 tsp
Chili powder: 2 tbsp
Vinegar: 2 tbsp
Oyster sauce: 2 tbsp
Cooking oil: 1 tbsp
Fish sauce: 1 tbsp
Common spices: a little (Salt, sugar, seasoning powder)
2. Preparation steps
2.1. Prepare the beef
Treat the beef: To remove the odor of the meat, rub 2 tbsp of vinegar and a little salt onto the beef for about 5–7 minutes, then rinse 2–3 times with clean water and let it drain.
Slice the beef: Once drained, slice the beef into large pieces about 0.5cm thick. Cut along the grain to ensure the right chewiness and a better appearance.
Prepare the aromatics: Wash the lemongrass, remove the top and bottom, then mince. Peel the shallots and garlic, then mince finely. Peel and mince the ginger.
2.2. Marinate the meat

Marinate the beef: Mix the beef with shallots, garlic, lemongrass, ginger, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 tbsp seasoning powder, 1 tbsp fish sauce, and 1 tbsp cooking oil. Add 1 tsp five-spice powder, 1 tsp turmeric powder, 1 tsp annatto powder, 1 tsp curry powder, 2 tbsp chili powder, and 2 tbsp oyster sauce.
Infuse the meat: Mix the beef thoroughly with the spices, then cover with plastic wrap and place in the refrigerator for about 8 hours or overnight to let the flavors penetrate.
2.3. Dry the beef
To stabilize the oven temperature, preheat the oven to 100°C for 10 minutes.
Arrange the beef on a baking tray and place it in the oven; dry at 100°C for 30 minutes.
After the time is up, remove the beef and use a rolling pin to flatten the meat thinly, then rearrange it on the tray and put it back in the oven. Continue drying at 100°C for 60 minutes.
2.4. Storage
Once the beef jerky has cooled completely, place it in a glass jar and seal the lid tightly. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.
Before serving, you can squeeze a little lime or calamansi over the beef jerky to make it even more appetizing.
2.5. Finished product

The beef jerky slices are attractive with a delicious chewiness, the natural sweetness of the meat, and a rich spice flavor, making them perfect for snacking or as a side dish for drinks with friends.
II. Methods for drying beef jerky
1. Drying beef jerky in the oven
To dry the beef in an oven, preheat the oven to 100°C for about 10 minutes.
Arrange each slice of beef on a tray and dry at 100°C for 30 minutes. Every 7–10 minutes, open the oven to ensure the meat dries evenly.
After 30 minutes, take the jerky out, lightly pound or roll it thin, then continue baking for another 30 minutes until completely dry. Drying time may vary depending on the power of your home oven.
2. Drying beef jerky in an air fryer
Preheat the air fryer for 3–5 minutes.
Arrange the meat in the basket without overlapping, set the temperature to 140°C, and dry for 40 minutes. Flip the meat regularly so it cooks and dries evenly.
These drying methods allow you to use available appliances to create delicious and nutritious beef jerky.
After the mentioned time, check the dryness of the beef. If it hasn't reached the desired dryness, increase the temperature to 160°C and dry for an additional 5–10 minutes.
3. Making beef jerky with a non-stick pan
If you don't have an oven or an air fryer, you can still make beef jerky at home using a non-stick pan.

Heat the pan and add the beef, cooking over low heat. Every 5–10 minutes, flip the meat to ensure it doesn't burn. Continue this process until the liquid has completely evaporated and the beef becomes dry and firm.
4. Finished product after drying

After completing the homemade process, you will enjoy beef jerky with a slightly crispy exterior, the aroma of lemongrass, the heat of chili, and an interior that retains its sweet chewiness and deep spice flavor.

You can leave the beef in whole slices or shred it, add a little lime juice on top, and enjoy. This jerky is perfect for snacking, pairing with beer, or mixing into various salads for a unique and delicious culinary experience.
III. Notes for making delicious beef jerky
1. Pre-processing beef to remove odors
Soak the beef in white wine for 15 minutes, then rinse with clean water.
Place the beef in a pot of water and heat for about 3–5 minutes, then remove and rinse to eliminate odors. Note: only heat to about 50°C, do not boil.
Rub the beef with lemon or vinegar for 5–7 minutes, then rinse with clean water.
Grill 1 ginger root, crush it, rub it onto the beef, then rinse clean.
These methods help remove odors and clean the beef before processing, making the dish more fragrant and appealing.
2. Use plastic bags or airtight containers
Place the beef jerky in plastic bags or airtight containers, seal tightly, and store in a dry place. Avoid damp areas to prevent the jerky from softening or molding.
2.1. Refrigeration
If you plan to consume the jerky soon, you can store it outside or in the refrigerator compartment for easy access.
For long-term storage, dry the beef jerky thoroughly before storing it in the freezer. Jerky can be preserved for about 3–6 months under these conditions.
2.2. Periodic air-drying
If not stored in the refrigerator, after about 2–3 weeks, take the jerky out to air-dry again to prevent mold and extend shelf life.
2.3. Using a vacuum sealer
If possible, place the jerky in plastic bags and use a vacuum sealer to remove air, then store in the refrigerator. This helps the jerky last longer and maintain its best flavor.
These measures will help you preserve your beef jerky effectively and make it easy to use whenever needed.

mon_an.ten: Fetal Chicken Eggs in Tamarind Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: Fetal chicken eggs in tamarind sauce – featuring a rich tamarind glaze and creamy fetal eggs, this is a snack everyone loves. Learn how to make this delicious dish.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Vietnamese coriander (rau răm), sugar, chili powder, fish sauce, garlic
cac_buoc: Step 1: Gently wash the fetal chicken eggs and boil them in water with a pinch of salt until cooked. Let the eggs cool, then peel and place them in a bowl.
Step 2: Place the tamarind paste in a bowl, add a little hot water, and soak for 10 minutes. Use a spoon to mash the pulp, then strain to get the tamarind juice for the sauce.

Step 3: Heat a little oil and sauté the minced garlic until fragrant. Pour the tamarind juice into the pot, add sugar, fish sauce, and chili powder, then bring to a boil. Season to taste. Add the eggs and simmer until the tamarind sauce thickens and coats the eggs, then turn off the heat. When serving, garnish with Vietnamese coriander and crushed roasted peanuts. Serve hot.

mon_an.mo_ta: Delicious and safer than store-bought, why hesitate to head to the kitchen and make these crispy spicy salt shaker potato chips right now? Let's get started!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel and wash the potatoes, then slice them into thin rounds. Rinse again to remove starch and soak in a bowl of diluted salt water for 15 minutes. Drain and pat dry with a clean towel.
Step 2: Mix the chili powder and salt together in a bowl and set aside.

Step 3: Pour plenty of oil into a pot and heat it up. Drop the potato slices in to fry. Do not overcrowd the pot; fry in batches until golden and crispy. Remove and place on a plate lined with paper towels, repeating until all potatoes are fried.

Step 4: Place the crispy fried potatoes into a plastic bag and sprinkle the prepared chili salt mixture over them. Adjust the amount of spice to your family's preference. Tie the bag and shake well. Transfer to a plate and enjoy immediately.
And there you have it, your homemade shaker fries are ready!

mon_an.mo_ta: Make your own cheese crackers to snack on while watching movies with friends or your partner—it's fantastic. Learn how to make these delicious homemade crackers and show off your skills.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Prepare small cookie cutters. If you cannot find them, you can cut aluminum cans to create your own shapes for these homemade cheese crackers.
Step 2:
Grate the cheese and place it in a food processor. Add flour, butter, and salt, then blend into a fine powder.
Add water and continue blending until a uniform dough forms.
Step 3:
Wrap the dough from step 2 in plastic wrap. Place in the refrigerator for 20 minutes to let the dough rest; this makes the crackers more fragrant when baked.
Step 4:
Roll the dough out thinly, then use the cutters to create individual cracker pieces.
Arrange the dough on a tray lined with parchment paper and bake in the oven at 180°C for 15 minutes.

mon_an.mo_ta: Homemade crispy dried bananas – an attractive snack for the afternoon. Learn how to make these delicious crispy dried bananas.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel the bananas and slice them thick or thin according to your preference; however, thicker slices will take longer to dry.

Step 2: Halve the lemon, squeeze for juice, and remove seeds. Mix the lemon juice with filtered water at a ratio of 1 tbsp lemon juice to 6 tbsp water. Soak the banana slices in this mixture for 10 minutes, then remove and drain thoroughly.
Step 3: Place a layer of parchment paper on the baking rack and arrange the bananas so both sides can dry. Note: do not overlap the banana slices.

Step 4: Bake the bananas at 125°C for 18 - 20 minutes. Check frequently; when the bananas turn yellow or brown, they are done. You can store the dried bananas in a plastic bag in the refrigerator for later use.
Source: Ngoi sao

mon_an.ten: How to Cook Grass Jelly in 5 Minutes
mon_an.mo_ta: Black grass jelly is a popular ingredient in many sweet soups (chè). The jelly is cool with a mild sweetness, providing a refreshing sensation. This jelly paired with various sweet soups is the perfect choice for a summer refreshment!
cac_buoc: What is Grass Jelly?

Grass jelly, also known by names like "sương sáo" (in the South), "thạch đen" (in the North), or "đường khoảnh" (in the Central region), is a refreshing dish made from the leaves of the grass jelly plant. The plant, scientifically named Mesona chinensis Benth, belongs to the Lamiaceae family and is widely grown in East Asian countries like Vietnam, China, and Taiwan. This plant is easy to grow and can be harvested year-round, though the highest yield is usually during the rainy season.
After harvesting, the stems and leaves are used to process grass jelly. The process involves washing, drying, grinding, and filtering to create the raw material for cooking the jelly.
What is Grass Jelly made from?
Grass jelly is a dessert made from the leaves of the grass jelly plant. This plant belongs to the Mint family and is primarily found in East Asian countries like Taiwan, China, and Vietnam.

The grass jelly plant is an herb with an average height of 30-60cm, sometimes up to 1m, and has a short lifespan. The stem is covered in white fuzz with few branches. The leaves grow symmetrically, are egg-shaped and elongated at the tip, with thick, serrated edges.

The flowers grow in clusters at the top, each about 10-13cm long, and are white or pink. The fruit is small and elongated, about 0.7mm. The plant can be harvested year-round, especially during the rainy season.
After harvesting the stems and leaves, they are usually washed and dried for medicinal use or ground and filtered to cook into grass jelly.
What to eat Grass Jelly with?
The way to serve grass jelly is similar to other sweet soups. You can enjoy grass jelly combined with sugar syrup, coconut milk, or fresh milk.
Additionally, you can add toppings like coconut jelly, milk tea, chia seeds, basil seeds, pearls, or any ingredient you like to create an attractive dessert. It is truly wonderful on hot days!
Where to buy Grass Jelly plants and powder?

You can buy grass jelly plants and powder at local food markets or stores. If you want the plant, look at nurseries, flower markets, or garden centers. These places often have plants available for you to grow at home.

For grass jelly powder, you can find it at stores selling food processing ingredients or seafood markets that provide diverse culinary ingredients. Additionally, online stores or e-commerce platforms are places where you can easily find grass jelly powder.
Instructions for cooking Grass Jelly in 5 minutes
Step 1:
First, prepare an amount of water suitable for the amount of jelly you need, following the ratio on the instructions. For 1 pack, use 100g sugar and 800ml water.
Next, add the sugar to the pot and stir well, then add the jelly powder and stir until the powder dissolves and the mixture thickens. Add the powder slowly to avoid clumping.
Step 2:

Place the pot with the dissolved ingredients on the stove. Continue to stir while cooking. Cook until the jelly liquid is thick and fully cooked, then remove from heat. If you are afraid of clumping, you can mix the sugar and jelly powder together in a bowl first. Once the water is hot, slowly pour the mixture in while stirring constantly until fully dissolved.
Step 3:
After the jelly is cooked, pour it into a bowl to cool, then cut into bite-sized pieces.
If you want to shape the jelly, pour it into available molds like flowers or cubes at this stage.
Step 4:

Once made, you can store the grass jelly in the refrigerator. You can eat black grass jelly with shaved ice or coconut milk; both are delicious. Enhance the flavor with some fresh coconut. You can also serve it with milk tea or other sweet soups.
Distinguishing Sương Sâm, Sương Sa, and Sương Sáo
| | Sương Sâm | Sương Sa | Sương Sáo |
| Scientific Name | Cynanchum auriculatum | Houttuynia cordata | Mesona chinensis Benth |
| Family | Apocynaceae | Saururaceae | Lamiaceae |
| Characteristics | Climbing vine, herbaceous | Herb, short stem | Herb, short stem |
| Leaf Color | Bright green, heart-shaped | Bright green, heart-shaped | Blackish-green, egg-shaped |
| Flavor | Bitter, toxic (raw) | Fragrant, slightly spicy | Odorless, sweet finish |
| Habitat | Asia | Asia | Asia |
| Application | Medicine, cosmetics | Spice, medicine | Jelly, drinks |

mon_an.ten: Special Spicy Xíu Mại for Cold Days
mon_an.mo_ta: These delicious meatballs (xíu mại) can be served with rice or bread—both are excellent!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, finely chop the ham!
Step 2:
Finely chop the onion, zucchini, and carrot as well.
Step 3:
To make the sauce for the xíu mại, mix ketchup and chili sauce together.
Note: If you cannot eat spicy food, you can omit the chili sauce!
Step 4:
Place the ground meat, finely chopped vegetables, egg, and cornstarch into a large bowl.
Step 5:
Mix the mixture well, slowly adding water until it reaches a thick consistency.
Step 6:
Roll the mixture into small, bite-sized balls.
Step 7:
Pour oil into a frying pan, wait until the oil is very hot, then drop each meatball in and fry until golden brown.
Step 8:
After frying, place the meatballs on paper towels for 5-7 minutes to drain all the excess oil!
Step 9:
Pour the prepared sauce into the pan, heat it quickly, then toss the meatballs in the sauce until coated. We are finished!
Now your delicious, hot xíu mại meatballs are ready to serve!

mon_an.ten: Fried Sticky Rice Balls for Winter Days
mon_an.mo_ta: Fried sticky rice balls (Xôi chiên phồng) are not only a famous specialty of the Southern provinces but are also loved nationwide and introduced to many foreign guests during culinary exchanges. The rice is very crispy, retaining the fragrant and chewy taste of glutinous rice, the richness of mung beans, and the light sweetness of sugar. It is called "chiên phồng" (fried-puffed) because the cake puffs up like a ball when fried. This dish is delicious and unique, but creating a beautiful ball requires patience, skill, and steady hands to rotate the rice in hot oil to create a perfectly round, golden-brown cake that is cooked through. The size depends on the amount of rice the chef puts into the pan. The process involves many meticulous stages, from selecting ingredients to cooking, kneading, and frying. To ensure it puffs up, you must choose fragrant, chewy glutinous rice and uniform mung beans. Mung beans add richness and creaminess. After being soaked and cleaned, the rice and beans are cooked; during the process, the rice must be stirred so it expands and cooks just right. Cooking the rice is crucial: if undercooked, it won't puff much; if overcooked, it loses the elasticity needed to puff and become crispy. Let's explore the recipe for these warm Fried Sticky Rice Balls!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Soak the glutinous rice and mung beans in water for about 4-6 hours until soft and expanded. Using hot water will be faster. Then drain through a sieve.
Step 2: Steam the mung beans until soft and mash them finely. Mix the beans thoroughly with the glutinous rice, sugar, and salt.

Step 3: Place the rice and beans into a steamer and steam for about 20 minutes, then drizzle the coconut milk over the rice. Fluff with chopsticks, cover, and continue steaming until the rice is soft and cooked through.

Step 4: Spread the sticky rice onto a tray or flat surface. While the rice is still hot, use both hands to knead it into a very smooth mass. Drizzle a little oil onto the rice, knead and press firmly until the mixture is elastic and soft, no longer sticking to your hands or the tray. Shape it into a long cylinder. To avoid burning your hands, wear 2-3 layers of plastic gloves. Use a knife coated with oil to cut the rice into thin slices about 0.5 cm thick.

Step 6: Wait for the oil to get very hot, then drop each rice slice in to fry. Initially, the rice will sink; after a moment, it will float and begin to puff. Use a large spoon to press the rice down. When it just starts to float, press lightly; as it floats more, press harder. Do not fry too many at once as they tend to stick together. When the balls are straw-yellow on both sides, remove them.

Now, start enjoying. This dish is best served hot. The crispy, fragrant taste of the fried sticky rice provides a very interesting sensation. These balls are often served with fried, grilled, or roasted dishes like roasted quail, grilled chicken, or roasted pigeon. You can also flatten them and decorate beautifully; everyone is sure to love them!

mon_an.mo_ta: Those who love snacking certainly cannot miss roasted sausage and vegetables. This snack is attractive not only for the delicious taste of the sausage but also for the freshness of the vegetables. Today, we will guide you through this appealing dish! Those who love snacking certainly cannot miss roasted sausage and vegetables. This snack is attractive not only for the delicious taste of the sausage but also for the freshness of the vegetables. Today, we will guide you through this appealing dish!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Green, yellow, red bell peppers - 1/2 each
cac_buoc: Step 1: Cut the carrots into bite-sized cubes and blanch them briefly in boiling water.
Step 2: Peel the baby potatoes and boil them until just tender.
Step 3: Cut the bell peppers into square pieces.
Step 4: Slice the sausages into 2cm thick rounds.
Step 5: Heat the butter and add the potatoes and bell peppers, stir-frying quickly over high heat.
Step 6: Next, add the sausages, stir well, and season with seasoning powder.
Step 7: Sprinkle with dried herbs and mix well.
Step 8: Place everything into a ceramic bowl and put it in the oven for about 15 minutes.
Step 9: When the vegetables and sausages are slightly browned and fragrant, they are ready.
Step 10: Serve with soy sauce.

mon_an.mo_ta: A smoothie is a healthy drink that also helps cool you down on hot summer days or dry days. It's a wonderful treat. This is a coffee-scented cream dish with a rich layer of fresh cream and the aroma and crunch of toasted coconut. It's an easy-to-make delicious treat for sweltering summer days.
cac_buoc: Time to make the creamy Thai-style coconut smoothie!
Step 1: First, pour the condensed milk into a large cup, then pour in the hot coffee. Stir well until the condensed milk is completely dissolved.
Step 2: Once the condensed milk has dissolved, add the fresh milk and vanilla extract and continue to stir well.
Step 3: Place the mixture from step 2 in the refrigerator and keep cold for about 8 hours.

Step 4: After 8 hours, take the mixture out and pour it into a mold, then place it in the freezer for about 4 hours until it sets. During these 4 hours, every 30 minutes, open the freezer, take the mold out, and fluff the mixture once to prevent it from turning into solid ice.
Continue this process; when you taste it, you will find the effort truly worthwhile.
Step 5: Place a pan on the stove. When the pan is hot, add the coconut and stir constantly until the coconut is dry and turns a beautiful golden color. Note: do not add oil to the pan!

Step 6: Pour the whipping cream into a bowl and use an electric mixer to beat it. When the cream starts to show tiny bubbles, slowly add the sugar. Increase the speed until stiff peaks form. When you lift the whisk and the cream stays in place without dripping, the whipped cream is ready.

Step 7: Take the coffee mixture from step 5 out of the freezer and scoop it into glasses. Next, scoop some whipped cream on top, sprinkle with the toasted coconut, and your delicious homemade treat is complete.

mon_an.mo_ta: Strawberry Jelly Variation – a sweet and tangy dessert that is easy to eat. Learn how to make this delicious Strawberry Jelly Variation.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the strawberries, place them on a cutting board, and trim the tops and bottoms so the strawberries can stand upright. Note: Cut the tops relatively deep, but only trim the bottoms slightly to prevent the jelly from leaking out.
Step 2: Use a small spoon to scoop out the core of the strawberry. Repeat with the remaining strawberries and place them neatly on a tray lined with parchment paper.

Step 3: Mix the agar powder with 3/4 cup of boiling water and stir for 2 minutes until the powder is completely dissolved. Continue to pour the liqueurs into the agar mixture to create the strawberry jelly base.
Step 4: Pour the jelly mixture into each strawberry (remember to fill them to the top as the jelly will shrink when it sets). Place the tray in the refrigerator for 4 hours.

Step 5: Sprinkle a little sugar onto a plate and grate some lemon zest onto it. Slice thin lemon rounds for decoration. Rub a lemon slice around the rim of the strawberry. After rubbing, roll the rim of the strawberry in the plate of sugar and grated lemon zest. Then, arrange or style them as you like.
Source: Buzzfeed

mon_an.ten: How to Make Long-Lasting Salted Lemons at Home
mon_an.mo_ta: Lemons have many uses, but salted lemons are just as versatile. Salted lemons can be used to make refreshing summer drinks, aid in weight loss, and effectively treat coughs, colds, and digestive issues. Prepare a jar of salted lemons for your family now. ## Ingredients: Fresh lemons: 1kg
cac_buoc: Wash the lemons with diluted salt water.
Use a needle to prick the surface of the lemons all over.
Use a knife to scrape off the outer zest to remove the bitterness for the salted lemons.
Rinse the lemons thoroughly and drain.
Prepare a basin of clean water mixed with alum.
Boil a large pot of water, drop the lemons in, and then remove them.
Remove the lemons and drop them into the basin of cold alum water to soak overnight.
After one night, remove the lemons and rinse them again with cold water.
Spread the lemons out to sun-dry for about 4-5 hours until the skin shrivels and turns a light yellowish-brown, then arrange them in glass jars.
Dissolve salt into a pot of water to make a strong brine, boil it, and let it cool.
Pour the brine into the jar until the lemons are completely submerged.
Note: Use a plate or a water bag to weigh them down so the lemons do not float above the surface.
Seal the jar tightly and place it in the sun.
Soak for about 1 month before use. Properly made salted lemons will have a pleasant aroma and can be stored for a long time without spoiling.
After 1 month, you will have a jar of delicious salted lemons for the whole family to enjoy.
How to serve: Place a salted lemon in a glass, mash it with sugar, add a bit of fresh lemon juice and the desired amount of water. Add ice and enjoy.
Tips for making long-lasting salted lemons
1. Tips for choosing good, juicy lemons

Choose "chanh giấy" (local thin-skinned lemons) to ensure the fruit turns a beautiful golden color when finished. Good lemons have a characteristic mild fragrance; conversely, if they have a pungent or chemical smell, they may have been treated with pesticides, which is not good for your health.

Choose medium-sized lemons that feel heavy for their size. These contain more juice, are fresher, and of higher quality. Additionally, lemons with smooth, shiny skin will have a higher vitamin content than others.
2. Handling white scum

If white scum appears during the process, it is because the water is not salty enough. You can handle this by skimming off all the white scum, adding more salt, and continuing to sun-dry. Alternatively, you can rinse the lemons with warm water, prepare a new brine mixture, and restart the soaking process.
How to store salted lemons

Glass jars used for salted lemons must be cleaned and rinsed with boiling water to completely remove dirt and bacteria. Then, the jar should be sun-dried or left to dry completely before adding the lemons and cooled brine.
After sealing, sun-dry the jar for about 10 days and then store it in a cool, dry place. After 1 month, the salted lemons will be ready to use for drinks.
Health benefits of salted lemons
Improves digestion and reduces bloating
Salted lemons or hot salted lemon water can reduce abdominal bloating, enhance digestion, and effectively treat flatulence and indigestion.
Relieves colds, coughs, and dissolves phlegm
The essential oils in the lemon peel help clear the airways, and the saltiness can disinfect and immediately relieve an itchy throat. Therefore, salted lemons are often used to make lozenges.
Additionally, using hot water or sucking on salted lemons helps dissolve phlegm effectively.
Supports the digestive system
Salted lemons have a positive effect on the digestive system. People with chronic intestinal diseases often use salted lemons regularly to improve their condition and enhance digestion.
Refreshing and cooling the body
Salted lemons help cool the body and provide essential minerals. Especially on hot summer days, a glass of warm salted lemon water will quench thirst and quickly restore energy.
Weight loss and maintaining shape

Combined with exercise and standard weight loss methods, warm salted lemon water can help effectively reduce fat across the entire body (including the face, chin, belly, arms, legs, neck, buttocks...).

mon_an.ten: How to Make Refreshing Watermelon Lemon Snow for Summer
mon_an.mo_ta: Watermelon has long been known as a sweet, cooling fruit that hydrates the body, especially during hot days. Let's make Watermelon Lemon Snow to cool down this summer.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Choose a ripe watermelon with a withered stem that feels heavy and sounds hollow when tapped. You can ask the seller to sample it to ensure it is sweet.
Wash the watermelon, cut into small pieces, remove the seeds, and set aside in a bowl.
Step 2: Wash the lemons and squeeze for juice.
Step 3: Blend the lemon and watermelon mixture.
Pour the lemon juice into a blender.
Add sugar (adjust the amount to your taste; be careful not to add too much as the watermelon is already sweet, and over-sweetening will mask its refreshing flavor).
Then add the watermelon...
Close the lid and blend until very smooth.
Step 4: Pour the mixture into a tray or a lidded container. Use a sieve to filter out any remaining seeds so the final lemon snow is smooth and free of black specks.

Cover the container or wrap tightly with plastic wrap and place in the freezer for 2-3 hours. After 2-3 hours, when the mixture begins to freeze (it will freeze and harden around the edges first), take it out and use a spoon or fork to scrape the surface, then return it to the freezer.
After another 30-45 minutes, take it out and scrape the surface again. Repeat this process several times until the mixture is light and fluffy.
When serving, scoop the watermelon lemon snow into glasses. You can add a few strips of lemon zest on top for fragrance and decoration.
Making watermelon lemon snow is quite simple, isn't it?! Here are some small cooking tips:

You should remove the mature black seeds; the young white seeds can be left in as they will be pulverized during blending. However, if there are many black seeds, you can skip the de-seeding step and blend everything together. After blending, simply strain the liquid through a fine sieve to remove the black seeds and residue.
You can add a little grated lemon zest to the lemon and watermelon mixture for extra fragrance.
Besides watermelon, you can try making cantaloupe or honeydew lemon snow using the same method.

On a side note, I want to share recommendations from emergency doctors for hot summer days. I hope this information helps you avoid risks caused by extreme heat. Note that doctors recommend eating melons like cantaloupe, watermelon, cucumber, etc., to supplement vitamins and water for the body.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Delicious and Refreshing Fruit Ball Sweet Soup
mon_an.mo_ta: The combination of various fruits with rich, fragrant coconut milk and chewy rice balls creates an irresistible flavor for this fruit ball sweet soup.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fruits - watermelon, kiwi, dragon fruit, cantaloupe. Use a melon baller to create spheres.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Put the coconut milk and sugar in a pot and heat until the sugar dissolves, then turn off the heat.
Step 2: Place the glutinous rice flour in a bowl, then gradually pour in the hot coconut milk. Knead for 5-7 minutes until the dough is smooth and elastic.
Step 3: Roll the dough into small marble-sized balls. Bring a pot of water to a boil and drop the balls in to cook.
Step 4: When the balls float to the surface, cook for another 5-7 minutes, then remove them and soak in a bowl of cold water.

Step 5: Put the water, sugar, and a tiny pinch of salt into a pot over medium heat. When the water boils and the sugar dissolves, turn off the heat and let it cool. Transfer the rice balls into the syrup along with the fruit balls.
Scoop the fruit sweet soup into glasses with a few ice cubes and garnish with mint leaves to complete.
The chewy, sweet, and fragrant rice balls combined with fresh, crunchy fruit create a light flavor that gets better with every bite.
Wishing you and your family a refreshing fruit ball sweet soup for the sunny days!

mon_an.ten: How to Make Fragrant and Refreshing Chè Thái for Summer
cac_buoc: Chè Thái is a widely popular dish. With its rich, delicious flavor and variety of toppings, this sweet soup is always enticing. On hot summer days, enjoying a cold glass of Chè Thái is truly wonderful. Below is a simple way to make Chè Thái for those who want to handcraft a delicious glass for themselves and their families. Check out this recipe for authentic shop-style Chè Thái!
I. Instructions for Traditional Chè Thái
1. Prepare ingredients
Coconut jelly: 20 grams
Pear: 1 fruit
Jackfruit: 50 grams
(Optional: add longan, rambutan, or other fruits as desired)
Strawberry syrup: 2 tbsp
Black grass jelly powder: 50 grams
(Available at supermarkets)
Tapioca starch: 100 grams
Pandan leaves: 1 bunch
Sugar: 10 grams
(To taste)
Coconut milk: 100 ml
Unsweetened milk: 300 ml
Condensed milk: 100 grams
Durian flesh: 100 grams
2 tsp jelly powder
2. Cooking method
2.1. Prepare ingredients
Peel the longan and shred the jackfruit.
Dice the pear into small cubes, then soak in ice water.
Mix the pear with 2 tbsp strawberry syrup.
2.2. Make grass jelly
Mix the black grass jelly powder with filtered water, bring to a boil, and stir well.
Add sugar and banana essence, stir until simmering, then pour into molds to set.
2.3. Make pandan jelly
Blend pandan leaves with filtered water and strain through a sieve.
Mix the jelly powder with sugar, boil water, and stir in the jelly mixture until dissolved.
Add the pandan water and banana essence, stir well, and pour into molds to set.
Blend the coconut milk, unsweetened milk, condensed milk, and durian flesh.

To assemble, cut the grass jelly and pandan jelly into bite-sized pieces. Place the fruits, jellies, grass jelly, coconut jelly, and pear cubes into a bowl, then pour the durian coconut milk over them. Just add ice and you can enjoy it immediately.
II. How to Make Delicious Durian Chè Thái
5 fresh durian segments
1 pear
1 bunch pandan leaves
Coconut jelly
1 pack black grass jelly powder (50g)
1 pack jelly powder (10g)
Red food coloring or strawberry syrup
100g tapioca starch
100ml coconut milk
300ml unsweetened milk
1 can condensed milk
Jelly molds
Assorted fruits (jackfruit, lychee, pomegranate, etc.)
Rock sugar, banana essence
2. Cooking steps
Step 1: Make red "pomegranate seeds"
Peel the pear, dice into small cubes, and soak in 100ml ice water for about 30 minutes to keep them crunchy.
Drain the pear and put it in a bowl with 2 tbsp red food coloring or strawberry syrup. Mix well so the pear turns red.
Add 100g tapioca starch to the bowl and toss until the pear is evenly coated.
Boil the pear in water until it floats, then remove and soak in ice water.
Step 2: Make grass jelly and pandan jelly
Pour 50g grass jelly powder into 200ml filtered water to dissolve.
Boil 800ml water, then add the grass jelly mixture to the pot. Stir well until dissolved, then add sugar and banana essence.
When the grass jelly boils, turn off the heat and pour into prepared molds.
Besides making grass jelly from powder, you can also use pre-packaged grass jelly.
Blend pandan leaves with 200ml filtered water and strain.
Mix 100g sugar with 10g jelly powder.
Boil 1000ml water, then add the jelly powder and stir well. When the mixture boils, add the pandan water and a few drops of banana essence.
Turn off the heat, wait for the mixture to cool, and pour into prepared molds.
Step 3: Make durian coconut milk
Prepare a blender, add 5 fresh durian segments, 100ml coconut milk, 300ml milk, and 1 can condensed milk.
Blend until the mixture is smooth and well combined.
Step 4: Finish
Layer the coconut jelly, pandan jelly, and grass jelly in a bowl.
Add the prepared fruits (lychee, jackfruit, pomegranate seeds, etc.).
Pour the durian coconut milk over.
Top with ice and enjoy immediately.
Durian Chè Thái with rich coconut milk brings a fresh, creamy, and aromatic fruit flavor that is even more enticing when enjoyed with cold ice, creating a refreshing and pleasant sensation.
III. How to Make Shredded Chè Thái with Coconut Milk
2 packs jelly powder (24g each)
30g condensed milk
120g creamer powder
50g coconut milk powder
250g whole milk
120g whipping cream
1 bunch fresh pandan leaves
Step 1: Make the jelly portion
Mix 24g jelly powder with about 150g sugar.
Boil 200ml water in a pot. When boiling, reduce heat and stir in the jelly powder mixture until dissolved.
Stir until it boils, then turn off the heat.
Mold 1: Pour 30g condensed milk and 70g coconut milk into a mold, then mix with ⅓ of the jelly mixture.
Mold 2: Pour ⅓ of the jelly mixture into a mold, add a few drops of pandan essence, and mix well.
Mold 3: Pour the remaining portion into a mold and leave as is.
Place all 3 molds in the refrigerator to set.
Step 2: Make the coconut and pandan sauce
Prepare a pot, add 1 bunch of pandan leaves and 500ml filtered water. Boil over medium heat with 150g sugar.
When the water turns yellow, add the creamer powder, coconut milk powder, coconut milk, whole milk, and whipping cream.
Stir well and heat until the mixture boils, then turn off the heat and let cool.
You have now completed the shredded Chè Thái with coconut milk for hot summer days.
IV. Conclusion

From making smooth jellies and harmonizing them with fragrant coconut milk to preparing bright fresh fruits as highlights for every spoonful. The meticulous shredding and decoration also contribute to the visual appeal of each dish. Finally, a few drops of delicate banana essence complete the unique flavor. With this simple method, you can enjoy authentic Chè Thái at home, just like at a professional shop.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Refreshing Coconut and Kumquat Drink
mon_an.mo_ta: A popular affordable refreshment in Saigon is coconut and kumquat water (dừa tắc). The mildly sweet coconut water combined with the gentle fragrance of kumquat will surely enchant you from the first taste.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the kumquats, remove leaves and stems, then cut in half and squeeze for juice, discarding the seeds. Thinly slice the kumquat peels.
Step 2: Marinate the sliced peels and kumquat juice with 3-4 tbsp sugar and 1/3 tsp salt. Let sit for about 1 hour until the sugar is completely dissolved and the peels are infused.

Step 3: To make a high-quality glass of coconut kumquat, first you must choose sweet, refreshing "xiêm" coconuts that are not too old, as the coconut meat will be hard and less tasty. Chop off the top of the coconut, pour the water into a separate container, then use a spoon to scoop out the coconut meat. Place both the water and the meat in the refrigerator to chill.

Step 4: Put the kumquat and sugar mixture into a pot and simmer over low heat until the mixture is slightly syrupy and the peels turn a shiny golden color. Turn off the heat, let cool, and store in the refrigerator. Take it out to mix when ready to drink.
Step 5: When serving, pour the coconut water into a glass, add the coconut meat and 1-2 tbsp of the kumquat syrup, and stir well. Add ice if desired.

With just a few simple steps, you have a refreshing glass of coconut kumquat with the light sweetness of fresh coconut water, a bit of tang from the kumquat, a hint of salt, and a gentle kumquat aroma.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Rich and Fragrant Candied Coconut for Tet
mon_an.mo_ta: Continuing the Tet menu theme, today we have Candied Coconut (mứt dừa) for the New Year. I remember as a child, every house had rectangular or square boxes of Tet jam. Wealthier families had larger boxes with floral patterns and transparent lids. My sibling and I were mesmerized by them, especially the colorful coconut ribbons skillfully rolled into beautiful roses. Now we know those bright colors were just food coloring, but back then they were magical. Today, due to hygiene concerns, homemade Tet jams are more popular. Mothers and grandmothers share recipes that are both delicious and safe for the family. Today, let's go into the kitchen and learn how to make fragrant candied coconut for Tet!
