cac_buoc: Choose "bánh tẻ" coconuts (medium-aged), neither too young nor too old. When buying, you can ask the seller for advice. If buying fresh whole coconuts, shake them; if you hear water sloshing loudly, the coconut is old and won't make good jam. Remove the husk, drain the water, and crack the shell to get the meat. The easiest way to remove the meat is to heat the shell over a flame so it pulls away. If you buy pre-extracted coconut meat at the market, skip this step.
Peel off the brown skin from the coconut meat, rinse with water, then use a peeler to shave along the curve of the meat to get long ribbons.

Once shaved, put the coconut in a basin and wash thoroughly to remove the coconut oil. You can also blanch it briefly. I usually just wash it many times; at first, the water will be cloudy due to the oil.
Wash until the water is completely clear.
Then transfer to a colander and drain thoroughly.
At this step, weigh the coconut meat again and add sugar. The ratio is 600g of white granulated sugar for every 1kg of coconut meat.

Marinate until the sugar is completely dissolved (usually takes 12-14 hours). During this time, the sugar will melt; occasionally stir with chopsticks so the coconut absorbs the sugar evenly. After 12-14 hours, the sugar is dissolved and the coconut becomes translucent.

After marinating, place a pan on the stove to simmer the coconut. Use a wide, thick-bottomed pan. Divide the coconut into small batches; do not overcrowd the pan or it will be hard to stir and the jam may burn. For 1kg of coconut, I usually cook it in 2 batches.
Initially, cook over high heat and stir well. When the syrup boils, reduce the heat to the lowest setting and continue to stir.
When the syrup is almost evaporated, add the vanilla and stir well.
Then use two pairs of chopsticks to toss and flip the coconut continuously.
Toss until the sugar crystallizes into tiny white grains, then turn off the heat.
Spread the coconut on a large tray, toss well, let cool, and store in an airtight container for later use.
It's that simple! You now have fragrant, rich, and creamy candied coconut for your family's Tet treat tray.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Refreshing Mango Pudding
mon_an.mo_ta: How to make refreshing mango pudding to cool down on hot summer days. Learn to make beautiful and delicious mango pudding. Let's teach you how to make this summer treat right now!
cac_buoc: Step 1: The first step in making Mango Pudding is:
Crush the biscuits and blend them finely, then add the melted butter and blend until the mixture is smooth.
Spoon the biscuit crumbs into cups and place them in the refrigerator.
Step 2: Add the gelatin powder to hot water and dissolve completely. Then pour in the mango juice and stir well.
Step 3: Continue making the Mango Pudding:
Place the cream cheese, heavy cream, and sugar in a large bowl and mix well until smooth.
Pour half of the mango-gelatin mixture into the cream cheese bowl and continue to mix well.
Step 4: Pour the mango cream cheese mixture into the cups over the biscuit layer. Be careful not to fill the cups to the top.

Step 5: For the final step, pour the remaining mango-gelatin mixture into the cups to create a beautiful orange third layer. Then refrigerate for at least 2 hours. If you can leave it overnight, it will taste the best.

mon_an.ten: How to Make a Golden Smoothie
mon_an.mo_ta: How to make a Golden Smoothie – made from beautiful yellow-colored fruits, hence the name Golden Smoothie. Learn how to make this delicious Golden Smoothie.
cac_buoc: Peel the fruits and cut them into small pieces so they blend quickly and smoothly.
Crush the ice.
Place the fruits into a blender along with the milk and ice.
Blend until smooth, then pour into a glass and serve cold.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Delicious Banana Coffee Smoothie
mon_an.mo_ta: A banana coffee smoothie is not only delicious and enticing but also helps you feel refreshed on hot days. Try this wonderful banana coffee smoothie recipe to enjoy during the sunny season!
cac_buoc: Step 1: To make the banana coffee smoothie, first place the banana and ice cubes into a blender and blend until smooth.
Step 2: Add the vanilla and coconut milk, then blend until creamy.
Step 3: Pour this delicious smoothie into a glass and enjoy immediately while it's cold!

mon_an.mo_ta: Strawberries are packed with Vitamin C, which helps boost the immune system and acts as a highly effective antioxidant. Consequently, they can increase resistance and prevent inflammation in the body. They also help whiten teeth, benefit cardiovascular health, prevent various dangerous diseases, and serve as a great friend to your skin. When summer arrives, a glass of strawberry smoothie helps you cool down and quickly forget the sweltering heat and outdoor frustrations. Today, let's join the kitchen to make this strawberry smoothie!
cac_buoc: Wash the strawberries thoroughly and soak them in diluted salt water for about 15 minutes. Place the strawberries in a blender and blend until small.
Add condensed milk and fresh milk, then blend until smooth with the strawberries.
Add ice and blend together.
Blend until the ice is finely crushed.
Pour the smoothie into a glass.
Garnish with a strawberry for a beautiful look. Now you have a sweet, cool, and nutritious glass of strawberry smoothie. It's ready to drink and very delicious!
How to choose delicious strawberries
When choosing strawberries, avoid picking ones that are too large.
The berries should look plump, have a uniform color, and emit a fragrant aroma.
Pick up the strawberry; it should feel firm. Soft berries are bruised and will mold very quickly.
The skin should be shiny without dark spots or mold.
The stems should be intact and bright green.
Choose dry, clean strawberries. Avoid wet ones as sellers might have sprayed them with water to keep them from wilting.

Strawberries only ripen while on the plant; once picked, they stop ripening. Therefore, choose fully ripe berries rather than green ones. Once bruised or molded, strawberries spoil quickly and will immediately spread to neighboring berries.
If you find a bruised berry in the basket, quickly separate it from the good ones to prevent spoilage.

mon_an.ten: Chilled Pineapple Mint Smoothie for Summer
mon_an.mo_ta: Pineapple is not only a delicious fruit but also very good for your health. It contains no cholesterol and is rich in fiber, Vitamin C, digestive enzymes, and essential minerals for the whole family (such as calcium, potassium, iodine, etc.). Therefore, eating pineapple provides nutrients that boost resistance, stimulate digestion, and enhance bone development. In particular, pineapple is excellent for supporting weight loss. Today, let's learn how to make a chilled pineapple mint smoothie to beat the summer heat. With this recipe, you will have a cool, tangy, and delicious drink. Let's get started.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel the pineapple and remove the eyes. Cut it into 4 or 6 pieces, remove the core, and chop into small chunks. Put 1/2 of the pineapple into a blender and blend until smooth. For the remaining 1/2, put it through a juicer to extract the juice. Keep both ingredients in the refrigerator to chill.
Step 2: Wash the mint leaves and place them in a pitcher. Add brown sugar and squeeze in the juice of two lemons (remember to remove the seeds!).
Use a wooden spoon to muddle the mint leaves until fragrant and to help the lemon juice dissolve the sugar.
Step 3: Add the pineapple juice and the blended pineapple pulp into the mixture. The pineapple drink is now ready.
When serving, pour the pineapple juice into a glass and add ice to keep it cold. You can add a little soda water if you like.

Although pineapple is very healthy, be careful not to overindulge, as too much can be harmful (experience shows that more is not always better). Some cases require limiting pineapple intake, especially for those with stomach aches. Pineapple is acidic; eating it can increase the activity of harmful bacteria in the stomach (H. pylori), leading to dangerous inflammation or ulcers.
A few tips for a delicious pineapple smoothie:

Buy good pineapples, peel them thoroughly, and remove all eyes before processing. If the eyes aren't removed, they can cause irritation. You should also remove the core to prevent a stinging sensation on the tongue.
Using brown sugar will be tastier and more refreshing than white granulated sugar.
If you don't have a juicer, you can put all the pineapple into the blender and blend it until smooth.

mon_an.ten: Rose Ice Smoothie - A Symbol of Love
mon_an.mo_ta: The Rose Ice Smoothie is a drink considered a symbol of love due to its combination of light acidity, spiciness, bitterness, astringency, and sweetness all blending together. Do you want to prepare this unique smoothie yourself to express your passionate and intense feelings for your "special someone"? Let's get started and experience it!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Crushed ice, straws, roses for decoration - ingredients
cac_buoc: Step 1: Remove the pits from the salted plums. Squeeze the calamansi for juice, discard the seeds, and keep the peels of 2 fruits to blend.
Step 2: Combine the salted plums with the plum liquid, calamansi juice, 2 calamansi peels, sugar, vodka, and crushed ice in a blender. Blend until very smooth.
Step 3: Pour the smoothie into a glass, add a straw, place a rose on top for decoration, and enjoy while cold.

mon_an.mo_ta: In the hot summer weather, enjoying a delicious, chilled smoothie with your favorite flavor is truly wonderful, isn't it? To help you make delicious smoothies for yourself and your family, today we will guide you through another way to make a super tasty mango milk smoothie.
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients for the mango milk smoothie:
Wash the mango and cut the cheeks as close to the pit as possible.
Next, use a round-tipped knife to score a grid pattern into the mango flesh down to the skin, then gently push or scrape with the knife so the mango cubes fall out.
Steps to make the mango smoothie:
Step 1: Put ice cubes into the blender and blend for 10 seconds, then add the mango pieces.
Step 2: Use a spoon to measure 100ml of fresh milk and add it to the mango.
Step 3: Pour in 30 ml of yogurt and blend until smooth, until the mango smoothie is fine and bright yellow.
Step 4: Finally, pour the mango smoothie into a glass and decorate to make it eye-catching.
Notes when making mango milk smoothie:

You should choose mangoes that are just ripe; this way, when cutting, they won't be crushed or watery. If the mango is overripe, it often has a sour taste and fibers that prevent the smoothie from being smooth.
If you like it very cold, you can add more ice cubes to the glass or store it in the refrigerator for 2-3 hours.

mon_an.ten: Refreshing Passion Fruit Syrup for the Family
mon_an.mo_ta: I love passion fruit; it has a very refreshing, delicious, and nutritious characteristic aroma. However, fresh passion fruit isn't always available at home. Making your own passion fruit syrup allows you to use it for refreshments, baking, or making jam, and it keeps for a long time. It has been proven that passion fruit is full of vitamins A and C, iron, potassium, and other nutritional components as well as beneficial bioactive compounds. Passion fruit seeds are an excellent source of fiber, and the mucilage surrounding the seeds gives it its special aroma. However, despite its many benefits, using it too frequently or in high doses can lead to side effects such as fatigue, nausea, drowsiness, and vomiting. Sometimes it causes dizziness and arrhythmia.
cac_buoc: Wash the passion fruit thoroughly, then cut them in half.
Use a spoon to scrape the pulp into a sieve. Press firmly so the juice flows through completely.
Put the seeds into a bowl, add 200ml of filtered water, stir well to dissolve any remaining pulp, and pass through the sieve to get a second extraction.
Put the seeds back in the bowl, add another 100ml of filtered water, stir, and strain for a third extraction.
In total, after three extractions, you should collect about 500ml of passion fruit juice. Add the granulated sugar to the juice and stir well.
Pour the mixture into a pot and simmer over low heat. During the process, skim off any foam to keep the syrup clear.
Simmer until the liquid begins to thicken, about 15 minutes after it starts boiling.
Turn off the heat, let it cool, and pour into bottles. Store in the refrigerator.
You can make a passion fruit drink by mixing the syrup with filtered water at a 1:1 ratio. Stir well and add ice to enjoy.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Refreshing Lemon Soda for Summer
cac_buoc: Chilled lemon soda is a popular drink on hot summer days. The combination of fizzy soda water and tangy lemon juice, with a touch of sugar syrup, creates an irresistible sweet and sour flavor. Making lemon soda is very simple, allowing everyone to create this drink at home. Let's try it now!
I. Traditional Lemon Soda Recipe
1. Ingredients
To make a delicious and cool glass of lemon soda, you need to prepare:
One can of soda water
One fresh lemon
30 grams of granulated sugar and ice cubes.
2. Steps to make the soda
Step 1: Squeeze a fresh lemon to get the juice.
Step 2: In a glass, combine the sugar and lemon juice in a 1:1 ratio. Then, add ice cubes until the glass is full, letting the ice reach the rim. Next, pour the soda into the glass until full.
Step 3: Before drinking, use a spoon to stir the mixture well.
Step 4: Besides the above method, you can add new flavors by adding fruit syrups such as strawberry, mint, blueberry, and many others. Enjoy this lemon soda and savor the wonderful taste of summer.

With just a few simple steps and easy-to-find ingredients, you can create your own refreshing lemon soda at home. The tangy lemon flavor blending with the sweet sugar in a cold soda is surely the perfect choice for hot summer days. Good luck and enjoy a wonderful summer.
II. Mint Lemon Soda Recipe
To make a delicious glass of mint lemon soda, prepare the following:
180 ml soda water (any type)
3 tablespoons mint syrup
2 lemons and some ice cubes.
2. Steps to make mint lemon soda
Squeeze the lemon: Start by cutting the lemon in half. Use your hands to squeeze out the juice. After squeezing, you can drop a piece of lemon peel into the glass for aroma.
Mix the soda: In the glass, mix 3 tablespoons of mint syrup and fill the glass with ice. Then, pour 180ml of lemon soda (equivalent to 1/2 can) into the glass until full.

Garnish and enjoy: Use a knife to cut the remaining lemon into thin slices and place them in the glass as decoration. Finally, insert a straw and stir well. You now have a visually cooling green mint lemon soda ready to beat the summer heat.
III. Salted Lemon Soda Recipe
150 ml lemon soda
1 salted lemon (chanh muối)
1/2 fresh lemon
2 tablespoons sugar and some ice.
2. Steps to make salted lemon soda
Mash the salted lemon: First, take one salted lemon and use a spoon to mash it in the glass.
Mix the salted lemon soda: Next, add 2 tablespoons of sugar, 150ml of lemon soda, and squeeze the juice of half a fresh lemon into the glass. Stir well to dissolve the sugar.
Add ice and garnish: Next, add a sufficient amount of ice to the glass. Garnish the rim with a lemon slice.
Enjoy: You now have a chilled salted lemon soda, perfect for quenching your thirst on hot days.
IV. Notes when making lemon soda
After opening the can, wait about 1 minute for the soda to release some CO2. The evaporation process can also carry away some preservatives that are not good for health.
To ensure flavor and quality, use the soda within 1 week of opening.
Do not consume too much soda as it can cause weight gain and, more dangerously, edema and water retention in the body.
V. How to choose fresh lemons
Aroma: Choose lemons that have a light, natural citrus scent. This is usually a sign of a fresh lemon.
Skin: Choose lemons with smooth, shiny skin that is not bumpy or lumpy. The skin should have a nice color without dark spots or serious damage.
Size and weight: Choose medium-sized lemons, not too small or too large. However, a lemon that feels heavy for its size usually contains more juice, indicating higher freshness and quality.
Color: Avoid choosing lemons that are dark green or have yellow spots on the skin. Fresh lemons are usually light yellow or light green.
By following these criteria, you will be able to buy fresh, high-quality lemons for your food and drinks.
V. Benefits of lemon soda

Drinking soda can help reduce hydrochloric acid levels in the stomach and provide relief for people with stomach aches. However, drink soda in reasonable amounts and avoid abuse, as too much can thin the stomach lining. Additionally, when having difficulty digesting food, especially after eating greasy meals, soda can aid digestion.
For lemon soda, urological researchers have found that lemon or orange-flavored sodas contain high levels of citrate salts. This type of salt can prevent the formation of kidney stones.
VI. Conclusion

In summer, nothing is better than a cool, refreshing glass of lemon soda. Making lemon soda is not only simple but also very interesting. You just need to prepare soda, salted lemon, sugar, and ice. When mixing, let the CO2 dissipate slightly and use the soda within a week for quality. With the tanginess of lemon, the aroma, and the light sweetness of sugar, lemon soda is an attractive drink for hot days. Enjoying lemon soda is a great way to quench your thirst and enjoy the joyful summer!

mon_an.ten: Delicious Mixed Fruit Soda for Hot Summer Days
mon_an.mo_ta: This is a Sangria-style soda, inspired by the famous Spanish fruit wine. Both children and adults can enjoy it because the wine is replaced with a new soda mix method. Therefore, you can choose this mixed fruit soda for special occasions, birthdays, or simply as a dessert after a meal to aid digestion! Refer to our recipe below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Ripe plum - 1 fruit, cut into 8 thin slices
Soda or sparkling mineral water - 3 cups
Apple - 1 fruit, cut into 8 thin slices
cac_buoc: Step 1: Besides orange, lemon, grape, and apple, you can choose any fruit you like except for bananas!
Step 2: Put all the fruit and juices into a large pitcher and keep in the refrigerator for at least 3 hours so the flavors can fully meld.
Step 3: Take the preparation from step 2, simply add the soda, and stir well. Divide into glasses and drink immediately.
Add ice to keep the drink very cold and delicious!

mon_an.mo_ta: When the weather is hot, having a glass of iced soda to cool down is incredibly refreshing!
cac_buoc: Ingredients to prepare:
Step 1:
First, we need to dice the peaches into very small pieces.
Note: use ripe peaches! Fresh or canned peaches both work.
Step 2:
Macerate the peaches with sugar for about 10 minutes. Then, place the peaches on the stove and cook over very low heat.
Step 3:
When the sugar turns a light amber color, turn off the heat. If you continue cooking, the syrup will become bitter!
Step 4:
After that, blend the peaches until very smooth to get caramel-flavored peach syrup!
Step 5:
Now, whip the fresh cream!
Step 6:
Start mixing: put about 2-3 tablespoons of peach syrup into a large glass. You can use a glass jar to hold the drink; it looks quite cool!
Step 7:
Fill the glass with ice.
Step 8:
Next, slowly pour the soda in and top with whipped cream.

If you don't fill the glass with ice, you can hold a spoon against the side of the glass and slowly pour the soda onto the spoon. This way, the soda won't mix with the syrup, creating a beautiful two-layered drink.
It's incredibly refreshing to drink!
The method is very easy for a delicious, cool, and healthy glass of soda!

mon_an.ten: Pandan Soy Milk for Chilly Weather
mon_an.mo_ta: A cup of hot soy milk in the morning during this weather will make you feel much warmer. Check out the pandan soy milk recipe below!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Spread the beans out on a large tray and pick out any spoiled beans.
You must remove spoiled beans because if they remain, the soy milk will lack its characteristic fragrant aroma.
After sorting, put all the good beans into a pot and add water until it covers the beans by 4-5 cm.
Step 2:
Stir gently by hand to clean the beans, then discard the first water and add fresh water to soak the beans.
Step 3:
Soak the beans for 6 hours until they expand as shown in the picture.
Next, rub off any remaining skins and drain the beans!
If you want to drink soy milk in the morning when you wake up, soak the beans the night before!
Step 4:
Wash the pandan leaves and cut them into small segments.
Step 5:
Put the beans and pandan leaves into the blender and add water; the appropriate amount of water is 2/3 of the blender's capacity!
Step 6:
After adding water, simply press the button and let the blender do its job.
When the bean and pandan mixture is smooth, turn off the machine.
Step 7:

Pass the mixture through a sieve to extract the liquid. You can use a sieve, but for speed and efficiency, use a large sterilized cheesecloth. Simply put the mixture in and squeeze by hand until all the liquid is out. Sieves often fail to extract all the liquid.
Step 8:
Rinse the blender with water, then put the pulp back in, add water to 2/3 capacity, and blend the pulp again.
Once the pulp is smooth, extract the liquid again as done in step 7.
Step 9:
Now, simply pour the extracted liquid into a pot and simmer over medium heat. Watch the stove carefully so the milk doesn't boil over!
When the milk is hot and starts to form a skin on the surface, add a pinch of salt and sugar to taste. Stir well to dissolve the sugar and salt.
We have now finished the warm pandan soy milk!
Finished product requirements:
The soy milk should have the characteristic aroma of soybeans with a hint of pandan fragrance.
The milk should have a uniform, beautiful green color from the pandan leaves.
On chilly days, nothing is better than drinking a cup of hot soy milk.
The warm soy milk with a lingering pandan scent will bring a sense of delight with just one sip.
You can make a batch of about 1 liter and use it for 2-3 days!
Waking up every morning to a warm cup of soy milk will get you ready for the new day.

mon_an.ten: Delicious Mung Bean Milk with Coconut Milk
mon_an.mo_ta: Mung beans are very good for health and have a cooling effect. The following recipe will help you make a drink that is both delicious and nutritious, suitable for an afternoon snack or for refreshment. The method for making mung bean milk with coconut milk is simple and easy to remember. Check out the recipe below! Delicious and attractive mung bean milk with coconut milk. Instructions on how to make smooth mung bean milk combined with the characteristic aroma of coconut milk. A nutritious and appealing drink for the whole family.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fresh milk, coconut milk - as desired
cac_buoc: Rinse the mung beans thoroughly, remove any spoiled ones, and soak for 3-4 hours with a little salt. Then drain and rinse again.
Wash the pandan leaves and tie them into a bundle.
Next, put the beans in a pot, add cold water until it is about one finger joint above the beans, and simmer until the beans are soft. Skim off foam occasionally.
Then pour the bean mixture into a blender and blend with sugar. If the mixture is too thick, you can add a little water.
Pour the mixture back into the pot and add the pandan leaves. Simmer while stirring constantly, adding coconut milk to taste.

Finally, cook for about 15-20 minutes and adjust the seasoning to your taste. Remove from heat, discard the pandan leaves, and let cool. Pour into a glass bottle, store in the refrigerator, and use as desired.
How to make Almond Sesame Mung Bean Milk:
Ingredients
200g peeled mung beans
Roasted sesame seeds
50g roasted almonds
Water
500ml fresh milk or soy milk
100g rock sugar
A little condensed milk
Steps to perform
Wash the mung beans and soak in water for 2 to 3 hours until they expand.
Put the soaked mung beans in a pot with 1 liter of water and boil. Skim off any foam on the surface.
Continue to simmer the mung beans over low heat for about 15-20 minutes until soft.
When the beans are soft, add 500ml of fresh milk, water, or soy milk to the pot. Then, add the roasted sesame and almonds and stir well to prevent the milk from burning.
Pour the cooked milk mixture into a blender and blend until all ingredients are smooth. You can strain the liquid through a sieve for smoother milk or use it directly.
How to make Pandan Mung Bean Milk:
300g peeled mung beans
White granulated sugar
A pinch of salt
1 small bundle of pandan leaves
Fresh milk
Ice
Wash the mung beans, remove spoiled ones, and soak in water with a little salt for 3-4 hours. After soaking, rinse again with cold water.
Wash the pandan leaves and tie them into a bundle.
Place the mung beans and water in a pot so the water is about one finger joint above the beans. Simmer over medium heat until the beans are soft. Skim off foam during the process.
When the beans are soft, pour into a blender with some sugar and blend until smooth. If too thick, add a little water while blending.

Put the blended mung beans and pandan leaves into a pot and simmer while stirring well. You can add a little cold water during cooking, but don't add too much to avoid diluting the milk too much when mixed with fresh milk later.
Simmer for 10-15 minutes and add sugar to taste.
When finished, pour the mixture into a glass bottle to cool. When ready to use, mix the mung bean base with fresh milk in an appropriate ratio and enjoy.
How to make Lotus Seed Mung Bean Milk:
200g fresh lotus seeds
Sugar
How to cook mung bean milk with lotus seeds
Peel the outer membrane of the fresh lotus seeds and remove the bitter germ inside. Wash the lotus seeds.
Wash the mung beans and soak in water for 4 to 6 hours until they expand evenly.
Place the lotus seeds and soaked mung beans in a pot with 1 liter of water and simmer for 20 minutes until soft.
Let the lotus seeds and mung beans cool, then put them in a blender with some sugar and blend until smooth.
Remove the mixture from the blender and add a little milk to enjoy. If you want to drink it cold, you can add ice.
Health benefits of mung beans:

Provides nutrients: Mung beans are a rich source of fiber, protein, B vitamins, and minerals such as potassium, magnesium, and iron. Consuming mung beans helps provide essential nutrients for the body.
Supports digestion: The fiber in mung beans helps enhance digestive function, reduce constipation, and maintain digestive health.
Weight management: Mung beans are low in fat and high in fiber, helping you feel full longer and supporting weight loss or maintenance.
Blood sugar control: The combination of fiber and protein in mung beans helps control blood sugar levels, reducing the risk of diabetes.
Boosts cardiovascular health: Mung beans contain antioxidants and unsaturated fats that help reduce the risk of heart disease and blood lipid issues.
Supports the nervous system: B vitamins in mung beans play an important role in nervous system function, helping maintain mental alertness and reduce stress.
Boosts resistance: Mung beans contain antibacterial and antiviral substances that help strengthen the body's immune system and resistance.

mon_an.ten: How to make a delicious and nutritious milkshake with a blender
mon_an.mo_ta: Hot summer days are here, so let's beat the heat with a cool and delicious milkshake. With just some ice cream, fresh milk, and your favorite fruit or candy, you can transform them into this wonderful drink.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, pour the fresh milk into the blender. Depending on your preference, you can choose full-fat, low-fat, or fat-free milk.
Next, add 2 scoops of ice cream to the blender. You can choose any flavor, such as strawberry, mint, orange, lemon, grape, watermelon, vanilla, chocolate, soursop, etc.
Step 2:
Add fruit, candy, chocolate, or Oreo cookies to the blender.

To enhance the flavor of the milkshake, you should pair the fruit with a suitable ice cream flavor; for example, strawberries go well with vanilla ice cream, and bananas usually go with chocolate ice cream. For candies, cookies, or chocolate, you should chop them into small pieces as shown in the picture before adding them to the blender.
Step 3:
Add a little syrup (to taste) or 2 tablespoons of your favorite powdered milk to the blender.
Note: Using flavored ice cream like chocolate or durian to make a milkshake might not be as delicious as using vanilla ice cream paired with chocolate or durian flavored syrup!
After adding all the ingredients to the blender, proceed to blend from low to high speed. Remember to cover the lid carefully so the ingredients do not splash out.
Step 4:
Once the mixture is smooth, pour it into a glass or cup, decorate as you like, and enjoy it immediately.
After using the blender, clean it with water to maintain the machine and make it last longer!
Below are a few milkshake flavors you can refer to!
Vanilla milkshake is very simple to make.
Or a rich and creamy chocolate malt milkshake!

mon_an.mo_ta: How to make coffee jelly – A simple and delicious treat that is both refreshing and addictive in this summer weather. A great recipe for an addictive coffee jelly.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Place 5g of gelatin powder in a small bowl, add a little water, and stir well until dissolved.
Step 2: Brew the coffee powder with boiling water, then add sugar and stir until completely dissolved. You can adjust the amount of coffee to your liking for this easy-to-make treat.
Step 3: Place the gelatin bowl in the microwave (600W) for about 20 - 30 seconds until melted, then pour it into the coffee mixture.
Step 4: Stir thoroughly and pour the mixture into an aluminum tray (or a large cup). Place it in the refrigerator for 2 hours to half a day until set.
Note: When serving the coffee jelly, you can mix it into iced milk coffee or coffee-flavored milk tea; it will be much more delicious.
Source: Ngoi sao

mon_an.ten: How to make refreshing orange jelly for the whole family
mon_an.mo_ta: Oranges are one of the fruits with high nutritional value, rich in vitamin C, which is very good for children in particular and everyone in general. This orange jelly will surely be a delicious and cool gift that is not difficult to make for your whole family to enjoy. Let's get started.
cac_buoc: Prepare all the ingredients mentioned above for about 4-5 servings.
Step 1: Preparation
Wash the oranges and cut them in half.
Prepare an orange juicer, a pot, and a tray.
Step 2: Execution
Juice the oranges (use a juicer that filters out seeds and pulp) and set the peels aside.
Repeat for all the cut oranges.
Keep the fresh orange juice aside for later use.
Use your hands to push the orange peel inside out to expose the inner pith and use a knife to remove it.
Turn the hollowed orange peels back to their original shape as shown below.
Place the orange peels in a tray, fitting them closely together so they don't tilt when the jelly liquid is poured in.
For the jelly liquid: Place the orange gelatin in a small pot with some water (200ml) and let it bloom for 1-2 minutes.
Place the pot on the stove and stir the orange gelatin water over low heat until the gelatin is completely dissolved.
Remove the pot from the heat to cool slightly, then add 1 cup of whipped cream vodka (200ml) and stir well until combined. (If you don't like the taste of whipped cream vodka, you can skip this step)
Pour this jelly liquid into each orange peel, filling them ONLY halfway.
Place the tray in the refrigerator for about 2-3 hours until the orange jelly sets.
Put the remaining water (150ml) and coconut milk into a pot, then sprinkle the gelatin powder in and let it bloom naturally for 1-2 minutes.
Place the pot on the stove over low heat and stir until the gelatin is completely dissolved. Turn off the heat and remove to cool slightly.
Add the remaining whipped cream vodka (150ml) to the coconut jelly pot and stir well. (If you don't like the taste of whipped cream vodka, you can skip this step)
Take the tray of set orange jelly out and pour the coconut jelly liquid on top.
Return the tray to the refrigerator for another 4 hours until the coconut jelly layer is firm.
When both layers of jelly have set, take the tray out and cut each half-orange into 4 equal small wedges as shown in the picture.
Arrange the orange jelly wedges on a plate and enjoy. They look very eye-catching and attractive 😀

mon_an.ten: How to make refreshing orange apple tea for summer
mon_an.mo_ta: How to make orange apple tea – A simple, cool, and extremely creative treat. Instructions on how to make refreshing orange apple tea for summer. A simple recipe to create a delicious and invigorating glass of orange apple tea.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients:
Wash the apple, peel, core, and cut into small pieces.
Wash the orange peel thoroughly, soak in salt water to clean. Remove and drain or wipe dry with a clean towel. Slice into bite-sized pieces (use the peel or not as preferred).
Step 2: Boil a pot of water, then add the orange and apple at the same time to extract their flavors. Add sugar to the water and season to taste.
Step 3: Use the boiled fruit water to steep the tea bags to create this easy-to-make drink!
Step 4: Divide the tea into 2 parts:
One part is poured into ice trays, topped with mint leaves, and placed in the freezer.
The other part is mixed with the orange and apple pieces and kept in the refrigerator to cool.
When serving the orange apple tea, pour some tea into a glass and add a few tea-ice cubes; the tea will be cool without being diluted.
Notes for making refreshing orange apple tea
Choose fresh ingredients: Use fresh apples and oranges to ensure the best flavor and quality for the tea.
Peel apples in salt water: When peeling apples, soak them in diluted salt water to prevent them from browning.
Use a blender or strainer: To get clear apple juice, after blending the apples, you can use a nut milk bag or a fine strainer to extract the juice.
Choose quality tea bags: Select good tea bags that suit your taste to ensure a great tea flavor.
Add apple and vanilla flavor: Use a drop of apple and vanilla extract to enhance the aroma and appeal of the tea.
How to choose good apples
Observe the apple skin

Choose apples with bright colors, glossy skin, and a smooth feel. If you prefer sweet apples, choose those with a dark color and small white spots on the skin. Avoid apples that are dull, bruised, cracked, or insect-damaged.
Pay attention to the size

Choose medium-sized apples, slightly larger than a tennis ball. Avoid choosing apples that are too small or too large. Overly large apples may have been treated with growth stimulants, while very small ones are often sour or prematurely ripened.
Observe the stem
Choose apples with fresh, new stems that are firmly attached to the fruit. Avoid apples with missing or dried stems.
Feel the apple

A good, ripe apple will be round, firm, and feel heavy in your hand. When pressing the apple, if it feels hard and juicy, it is a good apple. Try flicking the apple; if the sound is loud and clear, it is crisp and delicious.
Smell the apple
Ripe and delicious apples usually have a characteristic aroma. Unripe apples will be less fragrant and often taste sour and slightly acrid.

mon_an.ten: How to make delicious and refreshing strawberry lemon tea
mon_an.mo_ta: Strawberry lemon tea is a wonderful creation in the world of beverages, bringing a marvelous harmony of pure tea aroma, light tartness from fresh lemon, and sweetness from strawberries. It is not just a simple refreshing tea, but a wonderful experience for the palate, bringing excitement and satisfaction. Every sip of strawberry lemon tea is an enchanting journey of flavor. Let's discover how to make delicious strawberry lemon tea now! Enjoy strawberry lemon tea - a sophisticated blend of tea, fresh lemon, and sweet strawberries. Experience exciting tastes and pure aromas in a wonderful glass of drink.
cac_buoc: 1. Preparation
Water: Boil 400ml of water.
Sugar: The amount of sugar depends on your taste. You can adjust it according to your personal preference.
Strawberries: Wash the strawberries under cold water. Cut them into small pieces for easy decoration and enjoyment later.
Lemon: Wash the lemon under cold water. Cut it in half or into thin slices for garnish and flavor.
Ice: Prepare crushed ice or ice cubes as needed. Place ice in a glass or cup to cool the strawberry lemon tea.
2. Making the strawberry lemon tea
Step 1: Create a simple syrup
Prepare a small pot and place it on the stove.
Boil 1 cup of sugar and 1 cup of water in the small pot.
When the sugar begins to melt, stir well to ensure it is completely dissolved in the water.
Continue boiling the sugar water for a few minutes to ensure the simple syrup is fully blended.
Turn off the heat and let the syrup cool.
Step 2: Prepare the strawberries
Wash the strawberries under cold water to remove dirt and bacteria.
Remove the stems and cut the strawberries small for easy blending.
Place the prepared strawberries and 1 cup of water into a blender.
Turn on the blender and process until the mixture is completely smooth.
To remove seeds and any strawberry chunks, filter the mixture through a fine-mesh sieve.
Step 3: Prepare the lemon juice
Take the lemon and cut it in half.
Use a lemon press or a reamer to extract the juice from the lemon.
Remove seeds and any pulp from the lemon juice.
Step 4: Combine the ingredients
In a large 2-liter pitcher, combine 1 cup of simple syrup, the strawberry juice, and the lemon juice.
Next, add 3 cups of water to the pitcher to create a liquid mixture.
Stir well to ensure the ingredients are blended and the flavor is evenly distributed.
Step 5: Enjoy
Prepare large glasses or juice glasses.
Place some ice cubes in each glass to cool the juice.
Pour the strawberry lemon tea mixture from the pitcher into each glass with ice.
Garnish each glass with a lemon slice and fresh strawberries for extra appeal.
Add a few mint leaves for a pop of color and aroma.
Use a straw and enjoy the delicious and fresh strawberry lemon tea.
So we have finished a nutritious and cool glass of strawberry lemon tea. It's quite simple, isn't it!
You can replace strawberries with other fruits according to your preference.
Notes for making delicious strawberry lemon tea
Choose fresh strawberries: Select strawberries with bright colors, no bruises, and a characteristic aroma. This ensures the strawberries you use are fresh and provide good flavor for the juice.
Use fresh ingredients: Ensure you use fresh ingredients for the simple syrup, lemon juice, and strawberry juice. This ensures the flavor of the strawberry lemon tea is fresh and natural.

Boil sugar until completely dissolved: When boiling sugar to make syrup, ensure you stir well so the sugar dissolves completely. This helps ensure the syrup blends evenly into the tea without feeling grainy.

Strain the strawberry mixture: After blending the strawberries, strain the mixture through a fine sieve to remove seeds and chunks. This gives the tea a smooth consistency and a better drinking experience.
Adjust sugar and water: The flavor of strawberry lemon tea can be adjusted to personal taste. If you want it less sweet or more concentrated, you can adjust the sugar and water as desired.

Use cold ice: Before pouring the tea into the glass, ensure the glass is filled with ice to cool the juice. Ice helps maintain the cold temperature and increases the refreshment when enjoying the tea.

mon_an.ten: How to make trendy hand-pounded lemon tea
mon_an.mo_ta: Hand-pounded lemon tea is an attractive drink for young people today. With a simple method and common ingredients, this special version of lemon tea has the unique flavor of aromatic lemons. Discover how to make delicious hand-pounded lemon tea that young people love through the article below!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Wash half a lemon with salt and water. Then, cut the lemon into thin slices.

Place the lemon slices and some ice or ice cubes into a specialized glass. Use a specialized muddler or pestle to pound vigorously, crushing the lemon so the essential oils from the peel are released, providing aroma and extracting the lemon juice onto the ice cubes.
Step 2: Mix the lemon tea
Add 80ml of brewed Lipton tea to the glass containing the pounded lemon.
Next, add 15ml of honey and stir well. You can adjust the amount of tea and honey to your taste.
Transfer the lemon tea into a shaker and add ice. Shake well to combine.
Step 3: Completion
Pour the shaken hand-pounded lemon tea into a glass and add ice.
Finally, garnish with a lemon slice for a finishing touch and enjoy the delicious lemon tea.
Notes for making hand-pounded lemon tea
With the above recipe, use fresh lemons from Guangdong to give the drink a special aroma and avoid bitterness.
Guangdong perfume lemons have a bumpy outer skin, an oval shape, and a thick peel. They carry a characteristic fragrance, a combination of lemon, pomelo, and lemongrass.
Many people remove the outer peel of lemons for fear of bitterness. However, this type of aromatic lemon has essential oils that release fragrance through the peel, so there is no need to peel it.

When using fresh Guangdong lemons in hand-pounded lemon tea, you will notice a very slight bitterness, along with a characteristic aroma and mild tartness. Combined with the gentle sweetness of honey, you will have a wonderful drink. This dish is especially suitable for quenching thirst on hot days.
If you cannot find Guangdong perfume lemons, you can try with yellow lemons or green limes.
With hand-pounded lemon tea, you can customize the taste by adjusting the amount of Lipton tea, honey, and ice cubes. You can also add white pearls or fruit jelly to make the drink more interesting.
As you can see, hand-pounded lemon tea has a simple recipe and uncomplicated ingredients.
Some benefits of lemon tea
1. Detoxify and purify the body

Lemon tea has detoxifying properties, helping to remove toxins accumulated in the body and clean the internal organs. The citric acid in lemon tea helps reduce liver damage and cools the body on hot summer days.
2. Enhance skin health

Vitamin C in lemon tea has anti-aging properties and protects the skin from the effects of UV rays in the summer. Additionally, vitamin C stimulates collagen production and helps reduce the formation of facial wrinkles.
3. Antioxidant and anti-inflammatory

The vitamin C in lemons acts as an antioxidant, helping to prevent certain infections and strengthen the immune system. Furthermore, the anti-inflammatory components in citrus lemons help reduce the risk of degenerative diseases.
4. Prevent cancer
Drinking lemon tea can reduce the risk of stomach cancer, breast cancer, and colon cancer. The antioxidants in lemons inhibit the growth of cancer cells at various stages.
5. Improve cardiovascular health

Drinking lemon tea in the summer helps reduce the risk of stroke and high blood pressure caused by heat. The vitamin C in lemons can prevent atherosclerosis, lower blood pressure, and improve cardiovascular health.
6. Support digestion

Lemon mixed with warm water has a cleansing effect and improves digestive health. Lemon tea helps maintain a healthy digestive system by soothing, removing toxins and waste, and enhancing the absorption of beneficial substances from food.
7. Soothe sore throat and cough

Mixing lemon tea with warm water and honey can soothe a sore throat, reduce coughing, and improve sleep quality. Drinking lemon tea in the summer helps cool the body and provides a better night's sleep. Lemon tea also has the ability to reduce cold and flu symptoms, soothe sore throats, and reduce the severity of colds.
8. Enhance mental health
Citrus fruits have effects in treating anxiety disorders and Alzheimer's, helping to reduce the risk of mental illness. The aroma of lemon tea also has the ability to improve mood and reduce stress.

mon_an.ten: How to make authentic peach tea to beat the summer heat
mon_an.mo_ta: Quenching your thirst with peach tea on a summer day will make thirst and fatigue disappear quickly. Let's learn how to make peach tea for the whole family to enjoy!
cac_buoc: Let's choose fresh and delicious peaches to make peach tea!

Step 1: When buying peaches, remember to choose those with a yellow-pink color, still firm, not too ripe or too green. Wash the peaches, score them into wedges, then remove the pits and soak the peaches in a bowl of diluted salt water.
Step 2: Peel the peaches until all are finished.
Step 3: Put half of the sugar into a pot, add a little water, and turn on the stove to cook until the sugar water turns golden (caramelized).
Step 4: When the sugar water is ready, add 800ml of water to the pot along with the remaining sugar, stir well, and bring the sugar water to a boil.

Step 5: Finally, add the peeled peaches. Bring to a boil, then turn the heat to low and cook for a few more minutes until the peach slices become slightly translucent. Turn off the heat, then scoop the peaches out and drop them into a bowl of ice water to soak until cool; this way, the peaches will be very crunchy and not mushy.
Step 6: Let the sugar syrup cool completely, then arrange the peaches in a clean glass jar. Pour the sugar syrup into the peach jar and store in the refrigerator for later use.

When serving, simply scoop the peaches into a glass, add some filtered water adjusted to your preferred sweetness, and add some ice cubes. You now have a delicious, cool glass of peach tea for the whole family to beat the summer heat!
Good luck with this refreshing, delicious, and easy-to-drink peach tea recipe for your family!

mon_an.ten: How to make refreshing lychee mint tea to banish the heat
mon_an.mo_ta: We often know mint tea for its cooling and stress-relieving effects. Based on that formula, I've modified it slightly to add flavor and color to create lychee mint tea. The method for making lychee mint tea is extremely simple, and its deliciousness is no less than what you find at beverage shops. Make yourself a glass of lychee mint tea using the recipe below.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt - a pinch - Wash the raspberries.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Preparation
Peel the lychees and remove the seeds.
Wash the mint leaves and shake off the excess water.
Wash the raspberries.
Wash the lemon and cut it into round slices.
Step 2: Execution
Take a tall glass pitcher, pour 500ml of boiling hot water into the pitcher, and drop in 2 Lipton tea bags to extract the tea.
Next, take a small pot, add 600ml of water, and add 300g of sugar to dissolve.
Place the pot on the stove and bring to a boil.
When the water boils, drop the fresh mint leaves in to cook together (remember to save a few fresh leaves for garnish).
When the water boils again, turn off the heat and pour the mint water into another glass pitcher; now we have the mint water part.
Finally, mix the mint water into the Lipton tea pitcher.
Add the lychees, raspberries, and lemon to the tea pitcher. Use chopsticks to stir so the flavors blend together.
Place the tea pitcher in the refrigerator, or if you want to drink it immediately, pour the tea and fruit into a glass, add crushed ice, and garnish with a few mint leaves on top for appeal.
Notes
Raspberries can be replaced with strawberries.
The amount of sugar for the tea also depends on your sweetness preference.

When straining the mint water into the pitcher, only let the mint leaves soak in the water for a few minutes; if left too long, the tea will be slightly bitter and the pungent taste of the mint leaves will make it harder to drink.

If you cannot eat the lemon peel because it is slightly bitter, take some coarse salt and rub it on the lemon peel; this will remove the essential oils on the peel and the lemon peel will no longer be bitter.

mon_an.ten: How to cook winter melon soup with minced pork at home
mon_an.mo_ta: Winter melon soup with lean pork is a traditional soup in Vietnamese cuisine, offering a delicious and nutritious flavor. This soup features a harmonious combination of fresh winter melon and savory lean pork, creating a simple yet extremely attractive dish. Let's learn how to cook authentic winter melon soup with lean pork! Winter melon is also known as ash gourd or white gourd. When young, the fruit is green with fine hairs. Over time, the fruit turns lighter, speckled with white "stars" and a layer of wax. It belongs to the gourd family. Our people have a saying: "The gourd should love the melon, though of different species, they share the same trellis." Winter melon is used in many delicious dishes and is also an ingredient for beauty and weight loss. Today, to add to the menu, let's cook winter melon soup with lean pork; this dish is easy to make, fast, convenient, delicious, cool, and nutritious. On a hot summer day, a bowl of winter melon soup is truly satisfying. Instructions on how to cook winter melon soup with lean pork, a delicious and nutritious traditional soup. Discover the simple and detailed recipe to create a fragrant pot of soup, harmoniously combining fresh winter melon and savory lean pork.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Culantro - as needed (also known as sawtooth herb)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Preparation
To remove odors, wash the purchased pork with diluted salt water. Then, rinse several times with water and drain.
Next, use a knife to remove any excess fat from the meat and slice the meat into small thin slices before mincing finely.
To save time, you can also use a meat grinder to mince it instead of hand-chopping.
For the winter melon, peel and wash it. Next, slice the winter melon horizontally into round pieces about 1/2 a finger-joint thick, then divide each round piece into 4 parts.
For the green onions and cilantro, remove the roots and peel, then wash and chop finely.
Place the white parts of the onions along with 1/2 teaspoon of pepper into a mortar and grind finely to create a pounded mixture.
Step 2: Processing

Place a pot on the stove, adjust the heat to medium, and add 2 teaspoons of cooking oil. Wait until the oil is hot, then add the pounded onion and pepper mixture and sauté until fragrant for about 1 minute. Next, add the minced meat to the pot and stir-fry for about 2 minutes.
When the meat is firm and fragrant, add 1.5 liters of water to the pot and bring to a boil over high heat.

When the water boils, adjust to low heat, skim off the foam on the surface, then add the winter melon. Season the pot with a mixture of: 2 teaspoons of salt, 3 teaspoons of MSG, 1 teaspoon of sugar, and 1 teaspoon of fish sauce. Simmer the pot for about 5-7 minutes until the winter melon is tender. If necessary, taste the broth to adjust the saltiness.
Finally, turn off the heat and add the chopped green onions and cilantro to the pot. The winter melon soup with lean pork is finished and ready to enjoy.
How to choose good winter melon

For soup, do not choose old winter melons with white powder on the skin because they will taste sour rather than sweet when cooked. Old melons are better for making jam. Choose firm, heavy fruits with stems that are not withered. Winter melons with large stems are young, bright in color, and smooth. Small, young, straight fruits with dark green skin and fine hairs are best. These are usually soft and produce very sweet broth when boiled or cooked in soup.
Store winter melon in a plastic bag in the refrigerator; it will keep for about 4 days without losing quality.
How to choose fresh pork
When buying meat, choose pieces that are light pink or light red. When cutting across the meat with a knife, you will see the muscle fibers contract and the surface is dry.
Choose pieces of meat with a characteristic aroma. Use your hand to press the meat; if the fibers feel firm and have good elasticity, that is a good sign.
Avoid buying pieces of meat with strange odors, flabby texture, a glossy surface, or signs of sliminess. These are bad signs indicating the meat is no longer fresh or was not stored correctly.

mon_an.ten: How to cook refreshing black bean sweet soup for summer
mon_an.mo_ta: On hot summer days, a glass of refreshing black bean sweet soup is a wonderful choice to cool down and enjoy a delicious dessert. Black bean sweet soup is not only delicious but also offers many nutritional benefits. With just a few simple steps, you can prepare black bean sweet soup at home. Let's cook black bean sweet soup for the whole family during these scorching summer days. Instructions on how to cook refreshing black bean sweet soup for summer. Enjoy a delicious and nutritious dessert from black bean sweet soup at home.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Preparation
When buying black beans, clean and soak them carefully to ensure the beans are soft and tender when cooked, avoiding hardness or broken beans.

To do this, pour the black beans into a basin and cover with water. During the soaking process, damaged beans will float, and you can discard them, keeping only the sunken beans. Then, rinse the beans 2-3 times to clean, then soak the beans in water mixed with 1 teaspoon of salt for about 4-6 hours or overnight. After soaking, drain the beans in a colander.
For the pandan leaves, wash them and tie them into a bundle to use during the cooking process.
Step 2: Cooking the black bean sweet soup

Place a pot on the stove and add the black beans along with 1.5 liters of water. Start cooking over high heat. When the water begins to boil and foam appears, use a ladle to skim all the foam out of the pot. Reduce the heat to low and simmer the beans for about 20 minutes until tender. Then, turn off the heat, cover the lid, and let the beans sit for another 15 minutes.

After sitting, use a slotted spoon to scoop the beans into a pan, leaving the bean water in the pot. Next, add 200g of sugar to the pan and place it on the stove over low heat to simmer (rim) the beans. This method helps the beans quickly absorb the sugar, becoming soft and sweet without being hard, even when stored in the refrigerator. While simmering the beans, use chopsticks to gently stir to avoid crushing them. When the sugar is completely dissolved, continue simmering for another 5 minutes until the beans have absorbed the sugar and the liquid becomes thick. The total simmering time for the beans is about 10 minutes.

Then, pour the beans back into the water pot. If you want more liquid, you can add about 300ml of water to the pot. Turn on the stove and cook the soup over high heat. When the soup boils, reduce the heat and add 1/3 teaspoon of salt and 1 tube of vanilla for aroma. Cook for another 2 minutes, then turn off the heat.

Alternatively, for every 100g of beans, use 1.5 small bowls of water (about 5 bowls of water), bring to a boil over high heat, then turn the heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes until the beans are soft.

Scoop the beans into a small colander, rinse with cold water, then place a pan on the stove and stir-fry with 1/2 of the sugar until it feels sticky. Keep the heat very low so the sugar penetrates deep into the beans so they don't break and aren't bland.
Step 3: Making the coconut milk

Pour 400ml of coconut milk, 50g of sugar, 1/3 teaspoon of salt, and the pandan leaves into a pot. Place the pot on the stove and cook over low heat. While cooking, stir well to ensure the ingredients are blended.

To make the coconut milk thick, dissolve 1 tablespoon of cornstarch in 1 tablespoon of filtered water. When the coconut milk pot boils, slowly pour the cornstarch mixture into the pot and stir gently until the coconut milk thickens to the desired consistency. Then, turn off the heat and let it cool.

When serving, scoop the sweet soup into a glass or bowl, then drizzle the coconut milk on top; the amount of coconut milk can be adjusted to personal preference. Finally, sprinkle shredded coconut and crushed roasted peanuts on top. This sweet soup can be enjoyed hot or cold, both are very delicious.

Thus, you have successfully cooked black bean sweet soup with coconut milk; the soup has a faint aroma of pandan leaves, the beans are soft and nutty, absorbed with sugar without being hard or crushed. The coconut milk should be rich and creamy, and the soup should have a moderate sweetness, creating a pleasant feeling when enjoyed.
This is a complete glass of black bean sweet soup decorated with flowers that makes you want to eat it immediately.
Tips for delicious black bean sweet soup:

To cook black bean sweet soup, the most important step is choosing good black beans: round, even, plump, not rotten or flat. You can refer to how to choose good black beans in the black bean porridge recipe.

I like my black beans to be deeply sweet, so I usually stir-fry the beans separately with sugar. If you don't like that, you can add sugar directly to the pot of black bean soup. Note that when cooking the soup, you must not add sugar from the beginning; you must wait until the black beans are soft before adding sugar. Adding sugar from the beginning will prevent the beans from softening, and the dish will not be good.
Try dropping a few jasmine blossoms into the pot of black bean soup, and use jasmine flowers to decorate the glass before eating. Guaranteed the dish will have an extremely attractive aroma.

mon_an.mo_ta: Nước mát is a traditional folk drink that has existed for a long time, known for its excellent cooling and detoxifying effects during the hot season. The ingredients consist of easily accessible and affordable medicinal herbs found at vegetable stalls. The preparation is simple, economical, and beneficial for the body. Why not try making it for the whole family to beat the heat this summer? There are many types of cooling drinks; today, we will learn how to cook one using cogon grass roots, sugarcane, plantain, and more.
cac_buoc: The recipe for the cooling drink is as follows:
Wash all the herbs thoroughly and cook them with 2-3 liters of water.
Add a bit of rock sugar to create a light, pleasant sweetness.
Keep the water boiling for about 10–15 minutes, then turn off the heat and let it cool before serving.
Notes:
The drink should have a mild sweetness from the rock sugar, not too sweet.
Keeping it chilled in the refrigerator makes it taste better; do not serve with ice as it will dilute the flavor.
Besides cooling and detoxifying the body, this drink has medicinal benefits for conditions such as mouth sores, dizziness, headaches, and insomnia.

However, due to potential interactions with certain modern medicines and its diuretic properties, long-term or excessive use may cause electrolyte imbalance or mineral depletion (such as Ca, K). Therefore, do not use this drink as a total replacement for plain water.

mon_an.mo_ta: On a hot summer day, nothing is better than a fragrant, ice-cold glass of fruit tea! It is guaranteed to instantly refresh your spirit and chase away the fatigue of the heat. Don't hesitate—let's learn how to make this refreshing fruit tea right now!
cac_buoc: Soak and wash the apple, then dice it.
Peel the pineapple, remove the eyes, and dice it.
Bring 500 ml of water to a boil, then add the apple and pineapple. Continue boiling until it bubbles again, then turn off the heat.
Wash the orange peel thoroughly with a bit of salt and slice it thinly.
Place the orange slices and the tea bag into a pot. Pour in the hot apple and pineapple water and steep until the tea strength suits your taste.
Wait for the tea to cool, then place it in the refrigerator.
Add honey to taste and enjoy this fragrant, cool drink!
Source: ST

mon_an.mo_ta: Learn how to make sweet and crunchy pickled dracontomelon (sấu) without any film forming, perfect for summer. With this recipe, you only need dracontomelon and sugar. It is extremely simple and does not require additives like alum or lime water to stay crunchy, making it healthier.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the fruit
Wash the dracontomelon and scrape off the skin. Once scraped, drop them immediately into cold water to prevent browning.
Wash the peeled fruit again.

Using a sharp, pointed knife, spiral-cut the flesh of the fruit. Drop them immediately into a bowl of boiled water that has cooled. After cutting all the fruit, change the water (also use cooled boiled water) and soak for about 10 minutes.
Drain the fruit thoroughly in a basket.
Step 2: Pickling with sugar
Use a large pot big enough to hold all the fruit. Layer the fruit and sugar alternately until finished. Note: The top layer must be sugar.
Cover tightly and place in the refrigerator for 8-10 hours. The fruit will release its juice and the sugar will partially dissolve.
Wash the pickling jar, rinse with boiling water to sterilize, and wipe dry. Pick out each fruit, shake off excess sugar, and place into the jar. Set the remaining sugar syrup aside.
Wash the ginger and slice thinly or crush it. I prefer julienned ginger for a better look.

Add the ginger to the pot of sugar syrup and place on the stove over low heat. Stir constantly until the sugar is completely dissolved. Once it boils and the sugar has melted, turn off the heat to get the syrup. Let it cool completely.
When the syrup is completely cold, pour it into the jar of dracontomelon. Let it sit for about 2 days before using to make drinks.

The final product should have a beautiful golden color, the fruit must be crunchy with a balanced sweet and sour taste, and the syrup should be thick and clear without any film. To serve, put ice in a glass, add the syrup and fruit, add water as desired, and stir well.
Tips for delicious pickled dracontomelon:

Choosing the fruit: Choose even-sized fruits without bruises. The best ones for pickling are "bánh tẻ" (medium-aged), which have thick flesh, small seeds, and slightly rough skin. Avoid shiny, smooth ones as they are too young and will become mushy. Overly mature ones have thin flesh and won't be crunchy.
You should scrape the skin so the pickle isn't bitter or acrid. Be careful with hygiene; use cooled boiled water for the final rinses to limit harmful bacteria.
In shops, they might leave the fruit whole with slits or spiral-cut them. You can choose your preferred method. I follow my mother's spiral-cut method.
Yellow granulated sugar (đường hoa mai) is the best choice for this recipe. You can find it in most supermarkets.

mon_an.mo_ta: Summer wouldn't be complete without a glass of sweet and sour pickled dracontomelon (sấu) to cool down and provide energy. This recipe is not difficult at all. Let's make a jar for yourself and your loved ones!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Choose green, round dracontomelon without bruises. Use a knife or a specialized peeler to remove the skin. Cut into a spiral shape.
Step 2: Wash the fruit and soak in a bowl of water mixed with salt (or lime water). After 10 minutes, remove and rinse again with cooled boiled water.
Step 3: Place the fruit in a jar or large bowl that has been rinsed with boiling water. Layer the fruit and sugar alternately.

Step 4: Drain the released juice into a pot, add a small pinch of salt and the julienned or crushed ginger. Boil this to create a fragrant syrup. Cover and leave in a cool place until the sugar dissolves.
Step 5: Once the syrup has boiled for about 3 minutes, turn off the heat. Wait for the syrup to cool completely before pouring it back into the jar with the fruit.

mon_an.mo_ta: In the sweltering heat, everyone wants a cold drink to cool down. Lemonade has long been a favorite refreshment. Today, let's upgrade the classic recipe with this Strawberry Lemonade—a chilled, heat-beating drink.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Make the simple syrup
Combine sugar and water in a pot. Stir over heat until the sugar dissolves and the mixture becomes slightly syrupy.
Step 2: Wash the strawberries and remove the stems. Divide into two portions. Juice one portion and cut the other into quarters.
Slice one lemon thinly. Juice the remaining lemon.
Step 3: Add the lemon juice, strawberry juice, and strawberry pieces into a pitcher. Add ice, pour in the simple syrup, and top with soda water until the ice is covered.

When serving, add a few mint leaves to the glass or directly into the pitcher for fragrance and color. This drink is vibrant, fragrant, and refreshing. Note: Drink this immediately after mixing so the soda doesn't lose its carbonation. You can prepare the ingredients in advance and keep them in the fridge, then add ice and soda when ready to serve.

mon_an.mo_ta: Lemon tea is a very familiar drink for young people, often enjoyed on the sidewalk with sunflower seeds. While many stalls exist, the hygiene can be a concern. Instead of going out, learn how to make this cool mint lemon tea at home. This recipe offers a familiar yet unique taste that is perfect for quenching your thirst on hot days.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Boil 3 liters of water, setting aside about 100ml. Pour the rest into a pitcher and steep the tea bags for about 15 minutes.
Step 2: Put the sugar in a pot with the reserved 100ml of water. Boil and stir until the sugar dissolves and the syrup thickens slightly. Pour this into the tea pitcher.
Step 3: Wash the mint leaves, crush or juice them, strain through a sieve, and add to the tea.
Step 4: Slice the lemons thinly, add them to the pitcher, and stir well.

To serve, put ice in a glass, pour in the tea, and garnish with fresh lemon slices and mint leaves. This tea is fragrant and refreshing, combining the tartness of lemon, the tannins of tea, and the aroma of mint. I used yellow lemons here, but regular limes work just as well.

mon_an.mo_ta: Mango and lemon are very healthy fruits. Let's make mango lemonade to boost your energy and help reduce the summer heat!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Peel the mango and remove the pit. Cut the flesh into small pieces and place in a blender.
Add sugar, salt, and lemon juice to the blender and blend until smooth.
Step 2:
Pour the pureed mango into a large bowl and add the cold water. Stir well with a spoon.
Pour the mango lemonade into glasses, add lemon slices and ice cubes, and enjoy!
*Note:* When adding water, start with only 3/4 of the amount to prevent it from becoming too diluted. Taste and adjust to your preference.

mon_an.mo_ta: A dessert with a memorable name: Chè Ba Màu (Three-Color Dessert) – featuring the three characteristic colors of red beans, white beans, and mung beans. When mixed, the beans are soft and nutty, blending with the mung bean paste and rich coconut milk for a delicious treat that will leave you wanting more!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Pandan extract or green food coloring - for decoration
cac_buoc: Step 1: Sort through the red beans, white beans, and mung beans to remove any bad seeds. Place each type in a separate bowl and soak overnight.
Step 2: Cover the mung beans with water and simmer over low heat until soft. Add about 50g of sugar (don't add too much as it will be mixed with other beans).
Once the beans are soft, let them cool slightly, then blend until smooth in a blender.
Pour the mung bean paste into a bowl, let it cool completely, and store in the refrigerator.
Step 3: Place the soaked red beans in a pot, cover with water, and bring to a boil.
If you have a thermal cooker (thermo pot), boil the beans for 10-15 minutes, then place in the thermal pot and close the lid. Leave for 3-4 hours until tender. (If not, use a pressure cooker).

When the beans are soft, add a small bowl of water and 100g of sugar. Simmer over low heat so the sugar absorbs into the beans. Adjust to taste, turn off the heat, transfer to a bowl, cool, and refrigerate.

Step 4: Place the white beans in a pot, cover with water, and simmer until soft. Gradually add the remaining 100g of sugar. (Wait until the beans are soft before adding sugar, otherwise they will become tough).
Simmer until the sugar is absorbed, turn off the heat, transfer to a glass bowl, cool, and refrigerate. (If using a thermal cooker, follow the same method as the red beans).

Step 5: Pour the coconut milk into a small pot and add cornstarch, sugar, and 1/2 tsp salt. Simmer over low heat, stirring constantly until the cornstarch dissolves and the sauce thickens. Pour into a glass bowl, cool, and refrigerate.
Step 6: Combine jelly powder with 800ml of water in a pot. Simmer over low heat, stirring until the powder dissolves.
Once dissolved, gradually add the remaining 50g of sugar. Stir until melted, then add 1 tsp of pandan extract or 1-2 drops of green coloring.
Step 7: Pour the jelly into a clean glass bowl and let it set. Once completely cool, refrigerate. When ready to serve, cut the jelly into short strips.
To serve, scoop some red beans and white beans into a glass. Add the mung bean paste, jelly strips, and a few teaspoons of coconut milk. Mix well and add ice as desired.

mon_an.mo_ta: Chè cốm is a simple, easy-to-make, and delicious dessert. In just 10 minutes, you can have a fragrant, refreshing, and attractive treat for the whole family. Let's get cooking!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Tapioca starch or arrowroot powder - 40 gr
cac_buoc: Step 1: Rinse the green rice under cold water and drain. (You can also use fresh green rice).

Step 2: Put the water, rock sugar, and pandan leaves in a pot and cook until the sugar dissolves. Add the green rice and simmer over low heat. Add a tiny pinch of salt for a balanced sweetness. When the soup boils, stir in the dissolved starch until the soup thickens, then turn off the heat.
Adjust the sweetness to your liking. To serve, ladle the soup into a bowl and top with coconut milk. (You can add fresh coconut for extra flavor).

mon_an.ten: Lima Bean Sweet Soup with Pearls
mon_an.mo_ta: Lima bean sweet soup with pearls – featuring a homemade pearl recipe that is delicious, colorful, and hygienic. This familiar lima bean soup gets a fresh twist with these handmade pearls.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Sort the lima beans to remove any bad ones, rinse well, and soak overnight.
Peel the outer skin of the beans. Steam the beans until cooked. For dried lima beans, this usually takes 10-15 minutes. Check by pressing a bean; it should be soft but not mushy.

Step 2: Wash the magenta plant and drain well. Boil the leaves in water until the color is released (about 7-8 minutes). Remove the leaves, turn off the heat, and keep the colored water for the pearls.

Step 3: Place the tapioca starch in a large bowl. Gradually pour in the hot magenta plant water, stirring with a spoon until the starch and water combine. The mixture will be hot and slightly crumbly. Continue mixing until cool enough to handle, then knead by hand into a smooth, pliable dough.

Step 4: Pinch off small pieces of dough and roll into small balls. You can add bits of coconut flesh as a filling if desired. Boil the pearls in water for 3 minutes, then remove and rinse under cold water so they don't stick. Drain.
Step 5:
Wash the pandan leaves and tie them into a bundle.
Bring a pot of water to a boil, then add the pandan leaves and pearls. Add rock sugar to taste and simmer over low heat.

Step 6: Add the cooked lima beans to the pot. Bring to a boil and adjust the sugar to taste. Simmer for a bit longer so the beans absorb the sugar without breaking apart. You can add a little tapioca starch dissolved in water if you prefer a thicker consistency.
Source: Ngôi sao

mon_an.ten: Refreshing Mung Bean and Longan Sweet Soup
mon_an.mo_ta: Mung bean and longan sweet soup is a traditional Vietnamese dessert, offering a refreshing and appealing flavor. With the perfect combination of fragrant mung beans, juicy fresh longans, and rich coconut milk, this dessert easily wins over anyone who tries it. Let's explore how to cook this refreshing mung bean and longan sweet soup in the article below! A guide to making refreshing mung bean and longan sweet soup, a traditional Vietnamese dessert. Discover the secrets to creating a delicious mung bean and longan flavor.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the mung beans

After washing the mung beans, soak them overnight to expand. Next, place the mung beans in a pot and add cold water until the water just covers the surface of the beans. Boil until the water reaches a rolling boil, while using a large wooden spoon to gently press the beans, helping them become soft and fluffy.
Step 2: Cook the lotus seeds
To begin, wash fresh lotus seeds with water and use a toothpick to remove the lotus embryos. If using dried lotus seeds, soak them in water for about 6-8 hours until they soften and expand.

Start heating a pot on the stove and add the lotus seeds along with 500ml of filtered water. Simmer over low heat and continue cooking until the lotus seeds bloom and become soft and creamy without breaking apart. Use a slotted spoon to remove the lotus seeds from the water, then add 500g of rock sugar to the cooking water and stir well until the sugar dissolves.

You can adjust the amount of added water to balance the sweetness according to your taste. Next, slowly drop the softened lotus seeds and 3 vials of vanilla into the pot to bring out a wonderful aroma.
Continue simmering over low heat so the lotus seeds absorb the sugar for about 10 minutes, then remove them to a separate bowl for later use.
Step 3: Prepare the longan
Begin this step by washing and peeling the outer skin of the longans. Use a small knife tip to gently separate the flesh from the seed to obtain beautiful longan pieces without tearing them.
Note: Choose large longans with thick, dry flesh to provide a crunchy texture when eaten.
Next, stuff the cooked lotus seeds into the center of the pitted longans. Repeat until all the longan flesh is filled with lotus seeds.
Step 4: Cook the fresh mung bean and longan sweet soup
Pour all the prepared lotus seed-stuffed longans back into the sweet soup pot to soak in the sweetness for about 5 minutes, then turn off the heat.
Let the soup cool and store it in the refrigerator for about 1 hour before enjoying.
Ladle the soup into bowls, sprinkle with some shredded fresh coconut, and enjoy immediately.

The result is a bowl of fresh, refreshing longan sweet soup with golden lotus seeds in the center. The lotus seed water is refreshing; just one bite allows you to feel the natural, attractive flavor of the sweet longan.
Notes when eating fresh lotus seed and longan sweet soup:
If you want to use the soup to treat insomnia, keep the lotus embryos during preparation.
Lotus seed and longan sweet soup has many benefits, but consume it in moderation, not exceeding 28g/day.
Eating too many lotus seeds can cause bloating and indigestion, and is particularly unsuitable for people with heart disease. Lotus seeds can cause heart rhythm disturbances and lead to stroke.
Tips for simmering lotus seeds to soften quickly
Wash the lotus seeds: First, wash the lotus seeds with water to remove dust and impurities.
Soak the lotus seeds: If using dried lotus seeds, soak them in warm water for about 30 minutes to soften them before cooking.
Prepare the pressure cooker: Place the pressure cooker on the stove and pour the soaked lotus seeds into the pot. Add water so the water level just covers the seeds.

Cook the lotus seeds in the pressure cooker: Close the pressure cooker lid tightly and heat over medium to high heat. When the pressure cooker starts to hiss and the pressure indicator shows, reduce the heat to low and cook for about 10-15 minutes.

Release pressure: After cooking for the specified time, turn off the heat and wait for the pressure in the pot to release naturally. When the pressure valve has completely dropped and there is no remaining pressure in the pot, carefully open the lid.

Check for softness: Check the lotus seeds to see if they have reached the desired softness. If the seeds are still hard, you can cook them once more in the pressure cooker for a shorter time. Note: When opening the pressure cooker lid, follow safety regulations and ensure the pressure has fully released before opening.

mon_an.ten: Lotus Seed and Black Bean Sweet Soup
mon_an.mo_ta: Lotus seed and black bean sweet soup – the nutty taste of lotus seeds and black beans, with a hint of warm fresh ginger. How to make lotus seed and black bean sweet soup.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Black beans - 1/2 small bowl, soaked in cold water for 8h
cac_buoc: Step 1: After the black beans have soaked and expanded in cold water, rinse them clean, then place them in a pot and simmer until cooked through.
Step 2: Wash the dried lotus seeds, bring a pot of water to a boil, then add the lotus seeds and simmer until they are soft and floury, then turn off the heat.
Step 3: Soak the tapioca pearls in cold water for 10 minutes to expand, then pour into a colander to drain; these will be added when the lotus seed and black bean soup is cooked.

Step 4: Pour the black beans and lotus seeds into a single pot (including the cooking liquid from both), bring back to a boil, then add the rock sugar. Lower the heat and stir gently until the sugar dissolves, being careful not to crush the beans. Then add the tapioca pearls, cook for another 2 minutes, and turn off the heat.
When serving, ladle the soup into bowls and add a few shreds of grated ginger. This soup can be enjoyed hot or cold.
Source: Ngoi sao

mon_an.mo_ta: Creamy taro sweet soup for a less sweltering summer afternoon. Taro has cooling properties, making it very refreshing for hot summer days. A heat-relieving dessert. Learn to cook a delicious, chewy, and creamy taro sweet soup.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Wash the taro and cut into square pieces.
Place the taro in a pot of cold water and simmer until tender. Skim off the foam continuously as it boils.

Step 2: Place the dried tapioca pearls in a pot of cold water and boil until they expand and float to the surface. Remove them and immediately place them in a bowl of cooled boiled water so the pearls do not stick together. This completes the preparation for the creamy taro sweet soup.
Step 3: When the taro is soft (to save time, you can use a pressure cooker. When the taro is cooked, do not open the lid immediately; wait until the pressure has fully released).
Add sugar and season to your desired sweetness.
Dissolve the tapioca starch in a small bowl of water. Stir this into the taro soup pot. Pour the starch mixture while stirring constantly to prevent the taro soup from clumping.

Step 4: Finally, add the tapioca pearls and coconut milk, stirring well. Ladle into bowls and eat hot or store in the refrigerator to chill. If serving with ice, season the soup to be sweeter so it doesn't become bland as the ice melts.

mon_an.mo_ta: Easy corn sweet soup – with an extremely simple method that is no less delicious. Corn has cooling properties and is very good for heat relief. Learn how to make this easy corn sweet soup.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Sweet corn or glutinous corn - 2 - 3 cobs
cac_buoc: Step 1: Shave the corn kernels from the cob and remove any remaining corn silk. Keep the corn cobs to boil for a sweet broth.

Step 2: Pour your desired amount of water into a pot, add the corn kernels and cobs, and boil together. Use a pressure cooker to save time. When the corn is soft, remove the cobs. Stir the sugar into the pot. Simmer over low heat so the corn absorbs the sugar.

Step 3: Dissolve the tapioca starch with a little water, stirring until completely smooth. Then slowly pour the starch mixture into the corn soup pot, stirring constantly so the starch does not clump. Turn off the heat. In a separate pot, combine the coconut milk, salt, a little sugar, and cornstarch; simmer over low heat until the coconut milk thickens, then turn off the heat.
When serving, ladle the soup into bowls and drizzle the coconut sauce on top. It can be eaten hot or with shaved ice.
Source: Ngoi sao

mon_an.ten: Aloe Vera and Mung Bean Sweet Soup
