mon_an.mo_ta: Aloe vera and mung bean sweet soup – refreshing for summer heat; furthermore, aloe vera also has skin-beautifying and acne-clearing properties. Learn to cook this healthy aloe vera and mung bean sweet soup.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Learn how to clean the slime and keep aloe vera crunchy:
Wash the aloe vera leaf, peel off the skin, and cut into square pieces.
Prepare a bowl of water with a little lemon juice and a few ice cubes. Soak the aloe vera for about 10 minutes; this removes the slime and keeps it crunchy and fragrant.
Step 2:
Soak the peeled mung beans in water for 5 minutes, then rinse clean.
Place the mung beans and 700ml of water in a pot and simmer until tender. To cook quickly and save gas, you should use a pressure cooker or a rice cooker.
To keep the soup clear, skim off all the foam when the water boils. When the beans are soft, add the sugar and stir constantly until dissolved.

Step 3: After the mung beans are soft and the soup is sweetened to your taste, turn off the heat and stir in the vanilla gently. Wait for the soup to cool slightly before adding the drained aloe vera. Adding aloe vera while the soup is too hot will make it less crunchy. It is now complete; you can enjoy it hot or cold.
Source: Phunuonline

mon_an.mo_ta: Nutritious refreshing sweet soup – healthy and ice-cold for summer days. Learn how to cook this nutritious refreshing sweet soup.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Soak the dried lotus seeds, then drain. Soak the dried longan in hot water until expanded. Wash the raisins and remove any grit. Briefly rinse the red dates and soak them in hot water as well.

Step 2: Place a small pot on the stove, dissolve 1 tsp of jelly powder in 200 ml of water, bring to a boil, then pour into a bowl and wait for it to cool into jelly; do not add sugar to the jelly. Place another pot on the stove; when hot, add 1/2 of the sugar to create a caramel, being careful not to let it get too dark or the soup will taste bitter. Then pour in about 400ml of water and add the remaining sugar. Season to taste.

Step 3: When the water boils, add the lotus seeds, followed by the longan, raisins, and dates, and a tiny pinch of salt. Simmer over low heat until the lotus seeds are soft and the dates and longan have absorbed the sugar. Once it tastes right, remove from heat. After the jelly has cooled, cut it into small pieces and add to the soup. This can be served hot or cold.

mon_an.ten: Red Bean and Jelly Sweet Soup
mon_an.mo_ta: Red bean and jelly sweet soup – a fresh take on the traditional red bean soup recipe. Learn how to make this lucky red bean and jelly sweet soup for the upcoming exam days.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Soak the red beans for 4 hours until they expand and soften. Then simmer the beans until tender and add sugar to dissolve. Stir gently so the beans do not break apart.
Step 2:
Soak the gelatin leaves in a bowl of cold water.
Remove the red beans to another bowl, keep the bean liquid, then add 1 gelatin leaf to the liquid and heat until dissolved. Turn off the heat and let it cool until set.

Step 3: Melt the other gelatin leaf using a double boiler until dissolved, then mix it with the coconut water and let it set. This completes the preparation of ingredients for the red bean and jelly sweet soup.

Step 4: When serving, cut the coconut jelly and red bean jelly into bite-sized pieces. Place them in a bowl with the red beans, coconut milk, condensed milk, and shaved ice! Your bowl of sweet soup is ready.
Source: Kenh14

mon_an.ten: Delicious Mango and Tapioca Pearl Sweet Soup
mon_an.mo_ta: The sweet and fragrant mango flavor blended with the rich, cold coconut milk makes this mango and tapioca pearl sweet soup truly irresistible! This delicious and nutritious drink will make your summer much cooler!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Soak the dried tapioca pearls in cold water for about 1 hour. When the water boils, add the pearls to cook.
Once the water boils, reduce the heat and simmer the pearls until they become translucent. Stir frequently during cooking so the pearls do not stick together, and add more water if necessary.
When the pearls are cooked, remove them and rinse under cold water, then rinse again with filtered water, or you can leave them soaking in water.

Step 2: Peel the mango and use a melon baller to scoop out round mango spheres. If you don't have the tool, you can cut the mango into small squares. Place these mango pieces in the refrigerator. Puree the remaining mango in a blender.

Step 3: Boil the coconut milk and filtered water at a 2:1 ratio, then add the tapioca pearls. Season with sugar to taste, wait for it to boil again, then turn off the heat. Pour in the pureed mango and stir well. Finally, mix the mango and pearl mixture with the initial diced mango pieces. Adjust the sweetness to your liking, and the mango pearl sweet soup is finished!

This mango pearl sweet soup is delicious served cold; you can put it in the fridge for a while before eating. If you want to eat it immediately, add ice! However, if serving with ice, you should make it slightly sweeter and thicker so it remains balanced as the ice melts.
Enjoy your meal!

mon_an.mo_ta: Start your fruit party with the warm and sweet melody of bright red watermelon and ripe yellow mango in these lovely glasses! Fruit cocktail with candy sprinkles will be an indispensable drink at your parties!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Choose ripe mangoes – select fruits with shiny skin and bright yellow color; do not take those with dark bruised skin, wrinkled skin, or soft spots. The head of a ripe mango is yellow and firm; on the belly of the mango, near the very tip of the tail, there is a small eye, which indicates a small-seeded mango.
Step 2: Peel the mangoes and wash them clean.
Slice the mangoes. Juice one part, and use a spoon to scoop the remaining part into round spheres.
Step 3: Next, halve the cantaloupe and watermelon. Juice one part, and use a spoon to scoop the remaining part into round spheres.
Step 4: Wash the basil leaves.
Step 5: Mix the watermelon juice, cantaloupe juice, and mango juice with Rum and simple syrup, then stir well.
Step 6: Pour into glasses, adding the mango, watermelon, and cantaloupe spheres to each glass.
Garnish with basil leaves on top.
Then, sprinkle candy bits on the surface and enjoy.

Tips for choosing watermelon and cantaloupe: Lift the fruit in your hand; if it feels light, it has little juice, is spongy, or dry. Choose fruits that are firm, heavy for their size, and have bright, deep colors.

mon_an.mo_ta: This Christmas, everyone is probably wondering what to give to their lovers, friends, or relatives. Eggnog is the perfect drink for a peaceful Christmas night with the rich flavor of eggs and milk, and the aroma of cinnamon and rum. This drink will add warmth to your Christmas.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Whipped cream and cherries - For garnish
cac_buoc: Step 1: Crack the egg yolks into a bowl, add the white sugar, and use an electric mixer or a hand whisk to beat until the sugar dissolves and the yolks turn pale yellow and fluffy.
Step 2: Mix the fresh milk and cinnamon powder in a heavy-bottomed pot. Place on the stove and heat slowly until the milk mixture is hot and steaming slightly but not boiling.
Step 3: Pour the milk mixture from Step 2 into the yolk bowl from Step 1, stirring constantly with a ladle so the mixture blends together.

Step 4: Next, pour the mixture from Step 3 back into the pot, place on the stove, and stir continuously with a wooden spoon. Simmer over low heat until the mixture begins to thicken slightly and coats the back of the spoon. Do not let it boil as it will clump.
Turn off the heat, add the vanilla extract and rum to the egg-milk mixture, and stir well. Let it cool, then place in the refrigerator.
Step 5: When serving, pour into glasses; you can top it with whipped cream and garnish as desired.
If you add whipped cream on top, you can reduce the amount of sugar since whipped cream usually contains added sugar.

mon_an.ten: Delicious and Refreshing Coconut Smoothie Recipe
mon_an.mo_ta: A refreshing and delicious glass of coconut smoothie will help you get through these hot sunny days much easier!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Place the young coconut meat, coconut milk, sugar, lime juice, and pineapple into a blender and blend until smooth.
Step 2: Put ice into a glass, pour in the coconut smoothie, and garnish with a few carved apple slices to complete your delicious coconut smoothie.
Enjoy your nutritious and refreshing coconut smoothie!

mon_an.ten: Guide to Brewing Refreshing Rose Tea
mon_an.mo_ta: Rose tea is refreshing, delicious, not too sweet, and wonderful with a few ice cubes. This drink is great for health and cools you down on hot days. What is rose tea? Rose tea is a special herbal tea for women, made from fresh petals and rosebuds. There are two popular types: fresh rose tea and dried rose tea. You can easily prepare rose tea at home if you have the necessary ingredients. Simply add 200g of clean rose petals to 300ml of water, or adjust the amount of flowers and water to your preference. Benefits of rose tea: Boosts the immune system: Rose tea is a rich source of micronutrients such as vitamin B, vitamin C, calcium, and potassium. This helps strengthen resistance, improve metabolism, and prevent common colds. Reduces stress and anxiety: Research has shown that rose tea has a calming effect, supporting depression treatment and improving sleep quality. Beautifies skin and improves physique: Rose tea contains vitamin A, vitamin E, quercetin, gallic acid, and flavonoids, which help firm the skin, fight aging, and reduce subcutaneous fat accumulation. Supports the liver and digestive system: Pectin and fiber in rose tea stimulate digestion, improve detoxification, and remove toxins from the body. Improves cardiovascular health and supports cancer prevention: Substances like anthocyanins, catechins, EGCG, polyphenols, and cyanidin-3-O-β-glucoside in rose tea have been studied for their ability to eliminate free radicals, improve blood circulation, and prevent certain cardiovascular diseases and cancers. Rose tea is not only a delicious drink but also brings many health and beauty benefits. Enjoy this refreshing rose tea recipe to soothe the summer heat. Discover how to combine fresh roses and pure ingredients to create a fragrant and cool glass of tea. Immerse yourself in the seductive aroma and enjoy the cooling benefits of this wonderful rose tea.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Bring water to a boil in a pot, then add the rose tea and simmer over medium heat for about 20-30 minutes.
Step 2: Once the tea has fully infused, add sugar and cook for another 10 minutes before turning off the heat. Strain the liquid and discard the tea residue.
Step 3: Let the tea cool for 15 minutes.
Presentation: Place ice in a glass, pour in the tea, then squeeze in some lime juice. Garnish the rim with a lime slice for an attractive look.
Good luck with this rose lime tea, a refreshing drink for hot days!
How to prepare and preserve roses for tea
Store rose tea in an airtight box or jar
To store rose tea, use a box or jar with a tight-fitting lid to prevent air from entering. Ideally, use tin boxes or jars with an internal metal lid for better preservation.
Place the tea container in a dry place, free from moisture and odors from other herbs or chemicals. This helps the tea retain its aroma and quality.
Before adding new tea to the container, ensure the old tea is finished. Adding new tea to the same container can cause a loss of aroma and purity.
Store rose tea in the refrigerator

Some people store rose tea in the refrigerator to prevent mold. However, placing rose tea in the refrigerator can cause condensation when taken out, leading to moisture and rapid spoilage of unused tea.

Furthermore, drying rose tea before refrigerating can cause it to absorb strange odors and lose its original fragrance. Therefore, if you want to refrigerate rose tea, it is best to divide it into small portions and only take out the amount needed, then continue storing the rest in the refrigerator.
How to use rose tea for health

Rose tea is most effective when used at the right time. During daily activities or meals, drink tea after eating and after exercise to reduce fat absorption, stimulate digestion, and replenish necessary water for the body.
Additionally, you can enjoy rose tea early in the morning to boost blood circulation and create momentum for a new day, or during stressful times to relax the mind and soothe fatigue.
Notes when using rose tea
Although rose tea has many health benefits, do not overconsume it. Limiting daily intake to 5 to 20g of rose tea is optimal.
Do not drink rose tea on an empty stomach as it can cause an acid-alkaline imbalance in the stomach and disrupt the body's metabolism.
Avoid combining rose tea with green tea as it can reduce the effectiveness of the rose tea and affect its overall quality.
Pregnant women should not drink rose tea because it can stimulate blood circulation and cause uterine contractions, which can be dangerous and lead to miscarriage.

mon_an.ten: Nutritious and Refreshing Watermelon Smoothie Recipe
mon_an.mo_ta: Smoothies are perfect for beating the heat in this hot weather, and a watermelon smoothie is an option you can't miss. With this recipe, you'll have a delicious, refreshing, and highly nutritious drink.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Remove the rind and seeds from the watermelon and set aside in a bowl.
Step 2: Place the watermelon along with all other ingredients and ice cubes into a blender and blend until smooth.
Step 3: Pour the smoothie into a glass, sprinkle crushed cookies on top, and enjoy! With this watermelon smoothie method, your whole family will have a wonderful drink for the hot season!

mon_an.ten: Kiwi Smoothie Recipe for Beautiful Skin and Summer Refreshment
mon_an.mo_ta: We all know the skin-beautifying effects of kiwi. A kiwi smoothie is refreshing, nutritious, and good for your skin—there's no reason not to choose this drink on hot days.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel the kiwi and place it in a blender with sugar, ice, and soda water.
Step 2: Blend the mixture until smooth.
Step 3: Pour the kiwi smoothie into a glass and garnish with mint leaves and a kiwi slice on the rim.

mon_an.ten: Refreshing Mango Smoothie with Coconut Jelly Recipe
mon_an.mo_ta: Mango smoothie with coconut jelly is a drink you can't miss this summer to soothe the heat. This recipe is incredibly easy!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel and slice the mango.
Step 2: Add 100g of granulated sugar.
Step 3: Next, add 3 tsp of condensed milk and 200ml of fresh milk. (Adjust sugar and milk to your preferred sweetness).
Step 4: Add 2 tsp of honey. Honey will make the mango smoothie much more fragrant and delicious.

Step 5: If serving immediately, add ice cubes and blend together; otherwise, blend until smooth and pour into a glass. Before pouring the smoothie, place coconut jelly in the glass, then pour the mango smoothie over it. Stir well before enjoying your delicious mango coconut jelly smoothie.
Hope you and your family enjoy this wonderful dessert with this mango coconut jelly smoothie recipe!

mon_an.ten: Honey Lime Water Recipe - A Summer Weight Loss Drink
mon_an.mo_ta: Lime water mixed with honey not only helps with weight loss but also promotes smooth skin and prevents sore throats. Try these 2 simple honey lime water recipes to improve your health.
cac_buoc: Method 1:
Pour 300ml of warm water into a cup.
Squeeze 1/2 to 1 lime (depending on your sourness preference).
Add 2 tsp of pure honey.
Stir well until the honey dissolves and drink.
Drinking this in the morning is very good for health.
Method 2:
Wash the lime thoroughly.
Dissolve 2 tsp of salt in a basin of clean water and soak the lime for 30 minutes.
Slice the lime thinly (keep the peel).
Layer the lime slices in a glass jar, pouring honey over each layer.
Close the lid, refrigerate, and use gradually.
Every morning, mix 3-4 tsp of this honey lime mixture with a small cup of warm water; drinking it upon waking is great for digestion.

mon_an.mo_ta: Unique Watermelon Drink Recipe – Learn to make a new, sweet, and refreshing drink for hot summer days. Watermelon combined with cucumber brings a unique twist to help beat the heat.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Peel the watermelon and cucumber, then cut into small pieces. For the watermelon, remove the seeds.
Place cucumber and watermelon in a blender and blend until smooth for this unique watermelon drink.
Step 2: Strain through a sieve to remove any pulp.
Step 3: Squeeze the limes for juice, remove seeds, and mix with honey. This adds a refreshing, mild tartness and aroma.
Step 4: Add the honey-lime mixture to the strained watermelon juice. You can chill it or serve with ice for a great summer refresher.

mon_an.mo_ta: Peach tea is a famous drink among Saigon's youth. You can easily make it yourself with the recipe below.
cac_buoc: Ingredients to prepare for a delicious and refreshing peach tea:
Step 1:
Slice each peach piece into 4 parts.
Step 2:
Put sugar into a pot. Use a pot with a thick bottom.
Step 3:
Add the peaches to the pot and let them sit for about 5 minutes to allow the sugar to partially dissolve.
Step 4:
Place the pot on the stove over medium heat until the sugar is completely melted and slightly syrupy. This keeps the peaches from getting mushy and makes them crunchier when added to cold water.
Step 5:
Let the peaches cool completely, then store them in a glass jar for later use.
Step 6:
Brew the tea and steep for about 3 minutes until the tea leaves have fully infused.
This amount of peaches is enough for about 10-15 cups of tea. You can find canned peaches in large supermarkets or baking supply stores.
Step 7:
Fill a glass with peaches and ice.
Step 8:
Finally, pour the tea into the glass. If you prefer it very cold, shake the tea with ice in a shaker before pouring.
Your delicious and refreshing drink is now complete!
If it's not sweet enough, you can add more sugar syrup.
The peach slices have a balanced sweet and sour taste with a nice chewy texture.
Enjoy this wonderful drink with your best friends!

mon_an.ten: Refreshing Mango Pudding Recipe for Summer
mon_an.mo_ta: Mango pudding is delicious, refreshing, and very easy to make—perfect for treating friends and family on a hot day!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Soak the gelatin leaves in fresh milk until softened.
Step 2:
Cut the mango into cubes, then place a few pieces at the bottom of the pudding jars.
Step 3:
Blend the remaining mango until smooth.
Step 4:
Place a pot on the stove, add the milk and gelatin mixture, and heat over low heat until completely dissolved, then turn off the heat.
Step 5:
Add egg yolks and sugar, stirring gently. Turn the heat back to low and stir gently until the milk just begins to simmer, then turn off the heat.
Step 6:
Add whipping cream to the mixture, followed by the blended mango from step 3, and stir all ingredients well.
Step 7:
Pour the pudding into the prepared trays and jars with mango pieces, then refrigerate until set.
This fragrant and cool mango pudding is ideal for sunny days!

mon_an.ten: Refreshing Cucumber Syrup Recipe for Summer
mon_an.mo_ta: Summer will be much cooler with a glass of refreshing cucumber syrup to replenish energy, cool down, and detoxify the body!
cac_buoc: Ingredients to prepare for cucumber syrup:
Step 1:
Mix water and sugar, then heat over low heat until the sugar is completely dissolved.
Step 2:
Meanwhile, wash the cucumbers thoroughly and grate them finely.
Step 3:
Add the grated cucumber to the hot sugar water, mix well, and let it sit for about 30 minutes.
Step 4:
Strain to collect the cucumber syrup. Store the syrup in the refrigerator.
Step 5:
To prepare the drink, you will need: 1 lime, a few mint leaves, 200ml water, and 30ml of this cucumber syrup.
Step 6:
Place mint leaves in a glass and muddle them.
Step 7:
Add ice, water, squeezed lime juice, and the syrup, and it's done.
The drink looks so refreshing!
The light aroma of cucumber is very pleasant.
Coming home from the sun and having a glass of this cool syrup is amazing!
If stored well, this syrup can be used for about 1 month.

mon_an.mo_ta: Lychee season is almost over, so let's learn how to make this cool and delicious lychee mint tea to enjoy the last flavors of the season! This refreshing taste is guaranteed to be unforgettable!
cac_buoc: To make this drink, first take a clean glass jar. Place the tea bags inside and pour in a little boiling water to warm the jar and rinse the tea. Next, discard this first rinse. Pour the remaining hot water into the jar, wait about 5 minutes, then remove the tea bags. Set the brewed tea in a cool place to let it cool down quickly.

Pour 100 ml of water into a small pot, add sugar and stir to dissolve, then place on the stove and bring to a boil. Once the water boils, add the washed mint leaves. Wait for the water to boil again, then turn the heat down to low and simmer for 1 to 2 minutes before turning off the heat. You now have the mint syrup.

Wash the lemon and rub the peel with a little grain salt to remove the bitterness, then use a knife to slice the lemon into thin rounds. Peel the lychees and remove the seeds. Gently wash the raspberries (or strawberries) under the tap and drain.
Add the mint syrup to the tea jar, then add the fruit including raspberries, lemon, and lychees. Stir well, then store in the refrigerator and use as needed.

mon_an.mo_ta: Iced Tamarind – A delicious, easy-to-make treat for hot summer days. Learn how to make this refreshing Iced Tamarind drink.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Put the tamarind into a bowl, add about half a bowl of hot water, and soak for about 10 minutes. Use a spoon to mash the tamarind until it dissolves completely, then discard the seeds and keep the tamarind pulp.
Step 2: Peel and finely crush the ginger. Peel and finely mince the pineapple. Roast the peanuts until cooked, remove the skins once fully cooled, and toast the sesame seeds until fragrant.

Step 3: Pour the tamarind pulp into a pot, add the pineapple, sugar, and ginger. Bring to a boil, then lower the heat. Stir constantly until the mixture becomes clearer. Season with sugar to your taste for a balanced sweet and sour flavor. Continue cooking until the mixture thickens, then turn off the heat, let it cool, add the toasted sesame seeds, and mix well.
Step 4: Once the mixture has cooled completely, transfer it to a jar for later use. To preserve this dish longer, store it in the refrigerator.
When serving, use a clean spoon to scoop some tamarind into a glass, add ice, and sprinkle some peanuts on top. Mix well and serve cold.
Source: Ngoi sao

mon_an.mo_ta: Detox your body with these 4 types of water to help quickly eliminate toxins, purify your system, and achieve a balanced body over time.
cac_buoc: Lemon and Mint Recipe
Instructions:
Pick through the mint leaves, discarding any wilted or damaged ones, then wash them with warm water.
Wash the lemon with warm water and slice it.
Place everything into a jar, pour in 500 ml of filtered water, and store in the refrigerator for 4 - 6 hours.
After drinking the first round of water, refill with more filtered water, keep in the fridge for 1 hour, and continue drinking.
Lemon and mint water helps you feel refreshed while cleaning the digestive system.
Apple and Cinnamon Recipe
Wash the apple and cut it into slices.
Place the apple and cinnamon into a jar, add 500 ml of filtered water, and store in the refrigerator for 4-6 hours before use.
Use this in the same way as the first recipe.
Lime, Berry, and Mint Recipe
First, wash all the fruits.
Thinly slice the lime.
Halve the berries if desired.
Place everything into a jar, add 500 ml of filtered water, and store in the refrigerator for 4-6 hours before enjoying.
Red Grapefruit, Orange, and Cucumber Recipe
First, wash all the fruits and slice them.
Place everything into a pitcher and pour in 500 ml of filtered water. Keep in the refrigerator for 4 - 6 hours before use.
Notes for effective detox water
The fruit used in detox recipes must be fresh and clean.
After finishing the water, discard the fruit pulp. Do not eat it.
For the best detox results, you should eat plenty of green vegetables, drink lots of filtered water, limit starch, and avoid red meat.
Detox water needs to be chilled for 4-6 hours so the nutrients from the fruit can infuse into the water.

mon_an.mo_ta: Plum and lychee tea uses familiar ingredients and a simple method to create a delicious flavor and attractive color. With just a little time in the kitchen, you will have a wonderful tea to quench your summer thirst!
cac_buoc: How to make sweet and cool plum lychee tea for summer
Step 1: Wash the ripe plums, drain, and cut into thin slices about 1cm thick.
Step 2: Peel the lychees and remove the seeds. Peel the pineapple, remove the eyes, and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Step 3: Place all the prepared fruits into a clean bowl.

Step 4: Pour 1 kg of granulated sugar over the plums and lychees. Toss gently, then cover with plastic wrap and store in the refrigerator for 6-8 hours or until the sugar has completely dissolved. Macerating the fruit in sugar helps reduce acidity and creates a deep sweetness.

Step 5: Transfer the lychee and plum mixture along with the sugar syrup into a pot. Bring to a boil, then lower the heat and simmer for about 5 minutes. Stir gently while cooking to combine the ingredients.
Step 6: Brew the tea bags with the plum and lychee liquid. Pour the tea into glasses or a pitcher; add ice if you like it cold and enjoy.
Notes for a delicious plum lychee tea
You can adjust the amount of sugar to suit your personal taste!
How to choose good plums:

Choose fresh plums that still have their stems or leaves if possible. Select attractive fruits that are not bruised, crushed, damaged, or rotten. Avoid plums with insect marks or fingernail punctures.
Look for plums with taut, smooth skin covered in a thin layer of white powdery bloom.
Avoid plums that are too green or too deep red; choose those with a mix of both colors for a balance of crunch and sweetness. Uniformly round, unblemished fruits are usually better.
How to store and process fresh plums
Store fresh plums in the refrigerator to keep them fresh and tasty. Avoid hot, high-temperature, or humid areas which cause them to overripen quickly.
Before eating, wash plums thoroughly with salt water. They can then be used in various recipes.
To ensure you get sweet and safe plums, buy them from reputable fruit shops or supermarkets to guarantee quality and origin.
How to choose good lychees:
*Color:* The exterior should look fresh and bright, with fruits of uniform size.
Flavor: When tasted, the lychee should be sweet and fragrant.

*Seeds:* Small seeds indicate a good lychee. If the seed is easy to separate and dark black, the lychee is perfectly ripe. If the seed is pinkish and the flesh is hard to peel, the fruit is still green and will be sour.

Flesh: Look for thin skin and thick, translucent, soft, and juicy flesh. If the flesh is discolored or dry, the lychee is old and of poor quality. If it smells like alcohol or the flesh has an unusual color, do not use it.

mon_an.mo_ta: Starting a new day with a glass of homemade milk is wonderful. Today, let's change our palate with peanut milk; it is incredibly fragrant and sweet. Peanut milk provides a lot of protein, so don't miss out.
cac_buoc: Soak the peanuts for about 2-3 hours after buying.
Boil the peanuts in water for about 2-3 minutes. Then, rub them thoroughly to remove the outer skins.
Put the peanuts and water into a blender and blend until smooth.
Use a clean cloth to strain the peanut liquid, squeezing firmly to extract all the milk.
Pour the strained peanut milk into a pot and simmer over low heat.
Cook for about 5-10 minutes, then add the fresh milk and sugar (adjust sugar to your taste).
Pour into a container to cool, and add a few ice cubes to serve cold.
Transfer to a bottle and store in the refrigerator.
Good luck!

mon_an.mo_ta: Red beans are considered a natural food that is not only good for the body but also has beauty benefits. They contain many B vitamins and antioxidants which help the skin stay bright and reduce wrinkles. There are many delicious red bean dishes like red bean sweet soup, red bean sticky rice, or red bean stewed with bones. Today, we will share a red bean beverage recipe. Regularly consume red beans to provide essential nutrients!
cac_buoc: Steps to cook red bean milk:
Wash the red beans and remove any damaged ones. Soak overnight so the beans expand.
Put the soaked beans into a blender with about 500ml of water. Note that using too much water will make the milk thin and less flavorful.
After blending smoothly, strain the mixture through a clean, thin cloth. Squeeze tightly to extract all the bean essence.
Place the extracted bean liquid on the stove and bring to a boil over low heat, watching carefully so it doesn't boil over.
Wash the pandan leaves and tie them into a bundle, then add them to the pot.
Simmer for about 10 minutes, then add the fresh milk and sugar to suit your family's taste.
Turn off the heat, let it cool, then store in the refrigerator to drink gradually.

mon_an.mo_ta: Many people use brown rice as a dietary staple and to treat certain ailments. Besides cooking it as regular rice, brown rice can be processed into porridge, powder, or refreshing drinks. Today, we share a delicious brown rice milk recipe that you are sure to love!
cac_buoc: Do not wash the brown rice; simply pick out any impurities and then roast it over low heat until fragrant.
Bring 300ml of water to a boil, then add the brown rice and cook until soft. Be sure to cook over low heat.
Put the cooked brown rice into a blender and blend until smooth.
Strain through a sieve or a clean cloth, pressing firmly to extract all the starch from the rice.
Pour the remaining 700ml of water into a pot, add the fresh milk and rock sugar, and bring to a boil. Then add the filtered brown rice liquid. Simmer over low heat for another 5-10 minutes.
Let the milk cool and store it in the refrigerator; it can be used for 3-4 days.

mon_an.mo_ta: Learn to make nutritious corn milk – providing many nutrients and vitamins for the body. A great way to make a healthy and skin-beautifying drink.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Sticky corn or American sweet corn - 2 ears
Soy milk or unsweetened fresh milk - 120ml
cac_buoc: Wash the corn, remove all the silk, and shave the kernels off the cob.
Place all the shaved corn into a blender with 1/2 of the filtered water. Strain the mixture into a pot. Add the remaining 1/2 of the water along with the fresh milk and sugar.
Add the vanilla and simmer over low heat until it boils. Remember to stir constantly during cooking so the corn milk doesn't burn. Pour into a bottle and keep in the refrigerator to drink gradually.
Source: Ngoi sao

mon_an.mo_ta: Corn milk is a favorite drink for both children and teenagers. A corn ear contains over 80 beneficial substances, including fiber, vitamins, minerals, protein, sugar, starch, antioxidants, and healthy oils. A delicious, cold glass of corn milk is not only good for health but also helps you have beautiful, smooth skin. The milk has the creamy sweetness of fresh milk and the fragrant aroma of corn; it is delicious served either hot or cold. Make this for your family this weekend!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel the corn, remove the silk, and rinse briefly.
Do not discard the silk and husks; select the young green leaves, wash them, and tie them into a bundle.
Step 2: Bring a pot of water to a boil and cook the corn and the bundle of leaves until the corn is done.
Step 3: Once the corn is cooked, remove it, let it cool, and strip the kernels from the cob.
Step 4: Take about 2 liters of the corn boiling water (if there is sediment, strain it to make the water clear).
Step 5: Pour the corn water and the kernels into a blender and blend until smooth (if it's too thick, you can add a little more water).
Step 6: Next, strain the mixture to get the corn milk.

Step 7: Finally, cook the corn milk. As soon as it boils, add about 1/2 of the fresh milk and season with sugar for a light sweetness (you can make it sweeter if you prefer). If you want it creamier, add more milk, but be careful as too much milk will mask the corn aroma. Turn off the heat.

mon_an.mo_ta: Drinking smoothies in the summer is the best way to cool down; it's beneficial for health, good for the skin, and very refreshing. A fruit smoothie topped with whipped cream will surely delight your whole family.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Yogurt - 990ml (330ml or one container for each type of fruit)
Heavy cream or whipping cream - 250g (liquid, 35-36% fat)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the strawberries and remove the stems. Set aside 2 strawberries for garnish. Blend the strawberries with 330ml of yogurt until smooth. Pour into a glass (use a wide-mouthed glass of about 200ml). Peel the bananas and cut into small pieces. Blend with 330ml of yogurt. Pour into a glass, keeping two slices for garnish. Do the same with the avocado (or kiwi). Remember to only fill the glasses to about 1-1.5 cm from the rim.
Step 2: Use a hand mixer to whip the heavy cream with the vanilla sugar until stiff peaks form.
Step 3: Use a spatula to spread the whipped cream over the top of the fruit and yogurt smoothies until it reaches the rim.
Step 4: Level the cream at the rim of the glass. Place a strawberry on top of the cream layer. Press gently so the strawberry stands upright.

With these ingredients, you will have 6 smoothies: 2 pink strawberry glasses, 2 pale yellow banana glasses, and 2 pale green avocado (or kiwi) glasses, all topped with a rich cream layer and attractive garnishes.

The mild tartness of the yogurt blends perfectly with the fresh fruit and the richness of the cream. You can substitute yogurt with fresh milk, though it will lack the tartness. Using yogurt also means you don't need extra sugar. Yogurt also aids digestion.

Remember to put the yogurt and cream in the refrigerator for 4-6 hours before making. The cream must be very cold to whip easily. If the yogurt is cold, the smoothie will be ready to serve immediately.
You can use many different types of fruit.
Good luck with this easy fruit and cream smoothie for the whole family!

mon_an.ten: Delicious Green Tea Milk Tea Guide
mon_an.mo_ta: Green tea milk tea is a unique drink, from its vibrant color to its refreshing flavor. Depending on your favorite fruit syrup, you can create milk teas in various colors. Enjoying a glass of milk tea with its light sweetness, gentle tea aroma, and chewy pearls will surely make you fall in love with it!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fresh milk, almond milk, or condensed milk - as needed
cac_buoc: How to make green tea milk tea:
Step 1:
First, pour 2 cups of prepared water into a pot. Bring the water to a boil over high heat. Next, add the dried tapioca pearls and stir gently until the pearls float to the surface.
Step 2:
Set the heat to medium and cook the pearls for 12-15 minutes. Then, turn off the heat, cover the pot, and let the pearls sit in the pot for another 12-15 minutes.
Step 3:

While waiting for the pearls, you can make a simple sugar syrup to sweeten the milk tea and preserve the pearls: Pour ½ cup of water into a pot and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce the heat, add the sugar, and stir until completely dissolved. Once finished, set aside to cool.
Step 4:
Bring another cup of water to a boil and add the tea bags. You can use one bag for a mild tea flavor or two bags for a stronger taste.
Steep the tea bags in the hot water for about 15 minutes, then set aside to cool. This step can be done during or before cooking the pearls to ensure the tea is not too hot when served.
Step 5:

Once the pearls are cooked, remove them and place them in a small bowl. Next, pour the sugar syrup over them until the pearls are fully submerged. Let them sit until they reach room temperature, at least 15 minutes, or keep them in the refrigerator.
Pearls are best used within a few hours of cooking, but they can be stored in the refrigerator for a few days. Note that pearls will become hard and crunchy if left for too long.
Step 6:
Pour the prepared green tea into a large glass. Add the bowl of pearls in syrup. You can add fruit juice, cream, milk, or simply water to adjust the flavor and enjoy.
Tips for a perfect glass of green tea milk tea

If you want to enjoy cold green tea milk tea, combine the green tea, milk, fruit juice, etc., in a cocktail shaker. Note: do not add the pearls to the shaker. Add a few ice cubes and shake for about 20 seconds, then pour into a glass. Add the pearls and enjoy.

If you are short on time and want to speed up the pearl cooking process, cook them for only 5-10 minutes and use them immediately after they cool. Because of the short cooking time, the pearls will not last long and will harden after a few hours, but they will be very delicious if eaten immediately.
If you cook too many pearls and cannot finish them, store them with the syrup in the refrigerator. This method can preserve the pearls for up to several days.

mon_an.ten: How to Pickle Sấu Without Mold
mon_an.mo_ta: In the middle of a hot summer day, taking a sip of cold sấu water allows you to feel the crunchy texture and tartness of the sấu fruit mixed with the sweetness of sugar and the pleasant aroma of ginger slices—it is truly refreshing.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Brown sugar or white sugar - 1 kg
cac_buoc: How to pickle delicious sấu
Step 1:
Choose green sấu that are round and not bruised. Use a knife or a specialized peeler to remove the skin, then cut the fruit into a spiral shape.
Step 2:
Wash the sấu and soak them in a bowl of salt water. After 10 minutes, remove the sấu (do not soak for too long as they may become mushy), then rinse them once more with cooled boiled water.
Step 3:
Next, place the sấu into a jar or a large bowl that has been rinsed with boiling water. Layer them by alternating 1 layer of sấu and 1 layer of sugar.
Step 4:

Drain the sấu juice into a pot, add a small pinch of salt and the sliced or crushed ginger. Boil this mixture to create an aroma for the sấu water. Cover and leave in a cool place until the sugar dissolves.
Step 5:
When the sấu water has boiled for about 3 minutes, turn off the heat. Wait for the liquid to cool completely before pouring it back into the jar with the sấu fruit.
After some time, you will have a jar of delicious sấu water with crunchy fruit and a balanced sweetness.

In the middle of a hot summer day, taking a sip of cold sấu water allows you to feel the crunchy texture and tartness of the sấu fruit mixed with the sweetness of sugar and the pleasant aroma of ginger slices—it is truly refreshing.
Tips for a great jar of pickled sấu
How to choose good sấu:
To buy fresh green sấu, inspect each fruit carefully.
Do not pick fruits with dark spots or bruises. Good sấu have a slightly rough skin. Choose green sấu with thick flesh to get more fruit meat.
Shiny, smooth sấu are not ideal because they are too young and will rot quickly.
Avoid choosing sấu that are too old as they will have large seeds and less tartness.
How to store sấu:
To store sấu for year-round use, keep them in the freezer and follow these tips:

You should scrape the skin (do not peel deeply), wash them, and let them dry completely until the surface is slightly shriveled. Many people only cut the stems to let the sap out, dry them, and put them in the freezer. This works, but if the skin isn't scraped, the sấu will taste bitter when added to soup. Furthermore, it is easier to scrape the skin while they are fresh. If you freeze them and then thaw them to scrape the skin, the sấu will be mushy and difficult to handle.

Note: do not put all the sấu into one large bag. If you use a large bag, every time you open it to take some out, moisture enters and causes the whole block to stick together. Instead, divide the sấu into many small bags for easier access.
For ripe sấu, the fruit no longer has sap, so you don't need to cut the stems or scrape the skin. Just wash, dry, and store them the same way as green sấu.

mon_an.mo_ta: In the middle of a hot summer day, enjoying a glass of delicious, cold plum tea will bring a sense of refreshment and wash away all the fatigue after a long day of work!
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients for plum tea:
Wash the plums. If the plums are small, keep them whole and score 4 lines around them. If they are large, halve them and remove the pits.
Halve the lime and squeeze for juice. Remember to remove the seeds.
Steps to brew delicious plum tea
First, pour water into a pot, bring to a boil, then turn off the heat.
Place the tea bags into the pot, cover, and steep for 10 minutes until the tea is well-infused.
Next, mix the lime juice with sugar, stirring until the sugar is partially dissolved.
When the tea has cooled slightly, add the plums and soak until they soften.
Once the plums are soft, transfer them to a clean bowl. Continue to simmer the tea over low heat until it boils again, then turn off the heat.
Ladle the tea into a clean glass, add the plums, 1 teaspoon of lime juice, and ice, then enjoy.
Tips for a delicious pot of plum tea
You should use ripe, juicy purple plums with red flesh to brew the tea; this will give the plum tea a beautiful color and a special aroma.
Depending on your taste, you can adjust the amount of sugar and lime juice to suit your preference.
When adding plums to the tea pot, you should only soak them for about 1 minute so they do not become too mushy.
How to choose good plums
Choose fresh, beautiful plums that are not bruised, crushed, or rotten. Additionally, avoid plums with insect bites or fingernail marks as they are prone to bacterial infection.

The outer skin of good plums is usually plump and smooth. Fresh plums have fresh stems or come in clusters and are not soft to the touch. Do not buy plums that are too green or overripe; choose those with a mix of green and red. If the fruit is covered in a white powdery coating, it is a fresh plum. Choose plums that are uniform in size, round, and not deformed.

Note that after buying plums, you should store them in the refrigerator at 4°C to keep them fresh. Do not leave plums in hot, humid places as it will affect the quality. Before eating, wash the plums with salt water. When you bring them home, sort through them once more to remove any rotten or damaged fruits.

Plums are considered a "hot" fruit in traditional terms, so avoid eating too many at once or during extremely hot weather. Consuming too many can cause rashes, itching, or allergies. Due to this property, people with "internal heat" or pregnant women should not eat too many plums.

Furthermore, even sweet plums are acidic. Therefore, eating this fruit on an empty stomach can affect the stomach and intestines. It is best to eat plums when full or after a meal; absolutely avoid eating them when hungry to prevent stomach pain.

mon_an.mo_ta: Singaporean Ice Kachang is a signature dessert of Singapore. With colorful shaved ice, fruits, and various toppings hidden underneath, it is a delightful and easy-to-make treat for children. Ice Kachang is a famous traditional Singaporean dessert consisting of a layer of finely shaved ice covered with sweet ingredients like sugar, thick syrup, condensed milk, preserved plum, red beans, and various jellies. It is often garnished with other flavorings such as chestnuts, biscuits, and various fresh fruits. Ice Kachang has a cool, sweet, and attractive flavor, making it perfect for hot days. It is commonly sold at street stalls, food courts, and cafes in Singapore. Not just a dessert, Ice Kachang is a symbol of the unique culinary culture of the Lion City. It has become a national dish that attracts the interest of tourists visiting the country. This guide shows you how to make Ice Kachang—a delicious and popular shaved ice dessert. You will learn the simple steps from preparing ingredients to shaving ice, mixing syrups, and decorating. With this guide, you can create delicious Ice Kachang at home and enjoy a signature cold dessert from Singapore.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Red beans, sweet corn, grass jelly, shredded jelly, cendol - 50g each
Red, brown, green, and yellow syrups - 4 tbsp
cac_buoc: Cendol is another Singaporean dessert made of green rice flour jellies mixed with coconut milk and shaved ice, featuring a characteristic pandan aroma and palm sugar. You can buy these at stores selling Singaporean dessert ingredients.

Step 1: Prepare the ingredients: Boil the red beans until soft, then mix with 50g of sugar to infuse. Boil the sweet corn until tender. You can make the jelly yourself or buy it ready-made, then cut into bite-sized pieces. Wash, peel, and cut the various fruits into bite-sized pieces.

Step 2: Boil 100ml of water with 100g of sugar until dissolved. Divide the water into 4 parts. Add a few drops of red, brown, yellow, and green syrup to each part and stir well; these will be drizzled over the shaved ice in the Singaporean Ice Kachang.

Step 3: Scoop the red beans, jelly, shredded jelly, cendol, and fruit into a bowl or deep plate. Top with shaved ice, then drizzle the colored syrups over it. Add the sweet corn, condensed milk, and fresh milk on top to complete this easy and refreshing treat.

mon_an.ten: Making Delicious Mango Smoothie for the Family
mon_an.mo_ta: This mango smoothie is both delicious and sweet, yet very easy to make. Take a little time to prepare this drink to treat your whole family.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Blood orange - 1 fruit (or substitute with sweet orange if unavailable)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Rinse the dried tapioca pearls and place them in a pot. Add enough water as shown in the illustration. Place the pot on the stove over medium heat. When the water boils, turn the heat to low and continue to simmer for about 15 minutes until they become translucent. To prevent sticking, make sure to stir constantly! Afterward, drain the pearls into a bowl of cool water.

Step 2: Halve the orange, turn each segment inside out, and separate them into small pieces in a bowl as illustrated. Peel the mango and cut it into small cubes about half a fingertip in size. At this point, remove the pearls from the cold water bowl used in Step 1.

Step 3: Put the mango into a blender, add sugar, coconut milk, and a little fresh milk for extra aroma. Blend until the mixture is smooth. Turn off the blender, add the pearls and mix well, then sprinkle in the orange pieces from Step 2. Place this mixture in the refrigerator for about 20-30 minutes.

Finally, take the mixture out of the fridge, garnish with a mint leaf and a few small mango pieces on top. You now have a beautiful smoothie with the tartness of orange and the rich sweetness of mango.

mon_an.mo_ta: Combining ice cream and jelly creates an incredibly appealing drink with a fragrant aroma, the coolness of ice cream, a unique taste, and attractive colors. Let's learn how to make this delightful beverage!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Boil water with sugar and jelly powder, then divide into 2 parts.
Step 2: Mix one part of the mixture with coffee powder.
Mix the other part with matcha powder.
Step 3: Next, place the jelly in the refrigerator to set, then cut into small pieces.
Step 4: Finally, just pour fresh milk into a glass, add the jelly and ice cream, and enjoy.

mon_an.mo_ta: Strawberry orange juice is a very cooling drink that helps beat the summer heat. In this article, we will guide you through making this refreshing beverage. Please take a look!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Halve the oranges, squeeze for juice, and remove the seeds. Dilute the orange juice slightly and sweeten it so that the drink won't be too sour when the strawberries are added.
Step 2: Remove the leaves from the strawberries, wash them, and soak in diluted salt water for 15 minutes. Drain and slice the strawberries.
Step 3: Peel the cantaloupe and use a melon baller to cut the fruit into beautiful spheres.
Step 4: After preparing the orange juice, add the strawberries and cantaloupe to the glass. Add ice to make the drink even more refreshing.

mon_an.mo_ta: Sweet and sour strawberry drink – a refreshing beverage to make summer days cooler. After a hot day, coming home to a cold glass of strawberry juice is truly thirst-quenching.
cac_buoc: To prepare this sweet and sour strawberry drink, choose Da Lat strawberries to ensure food safety for your family.
Step 1: Pour boiling water into a glass jar to sterilize it, pour the water out, and place the jar upside down on a clean towel to dry. Then, fill the jar about halfway with cooled water.
Step 2:
Remove the stems from the strawberries, wash them, and soak in salt water to remove all dirt. Drain them completely.
Add a layer of sugar, then a layer of strawberries - daily delicious cooking guide
Step 3: Continue layering the sugar and strawberries until you run out of ingredients.

Step 4: Finally, pour the rice vinegar into the jar, seal the lid tightly, and leave it in a well-ventilated room for 6 days until ready to drink. When serving, you can add more sugar, water, and ice to taste.
Source: Blog Sina

mon_an.mo_ta: Pineapple mint juice provides vitamin C and is very cooling and easy to drink. Check out our recipe for this refreshing summer beverage below!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel the pineapple, remove the eyes, and cut into bite-sized pieces. Pick the mint tips and young leaves, wash, and drain. Place them in a glass and use a hand blender to blend the pineapple and mint mixture.
Step 2: Fill the glass with ice, then add filtered water and syrup to make the drink sweet and refreshing.
Step 3: Stir well before drinking and garnish with mint leaves for a beautiful look and aroma.

Note: If you don't have a hand blender to blend directly in the glass, you can put the pineapple, mint, water, and syrup into a regular blender. Alternatively, you can mash the ingredients with a spoon; the pineapple mint drink will still be delicious.

mon_an.mo_ta: Refreshing kumquat coconut water is sweet, sour, fragrant with kumquat, and rich with coconut flavor. Learn how to make this delicious drink.
cac_buoc: Step 1: To cook this well, once you have the fresh coconuts, split them and pour the water into a large bowl. Halve the coconut shells and use a spoon to scoop out the meat. Since these are fresh coconuts, the meat is thin and very creamy, so be gentle when scooping it out.
Step 2: Wash the kumquats, drain, halve, and remove the seeds. Squeeze the juice into a separate bowl and keep the peels to add to the refreshing kumquat coconut water for aroma.

Step 3: Add the coconut meat and water to a glass, add a pinch of salt, and pour in the kumquat juice. Stir with a spoon while pouring and stop once the coconut water reaches your desired sourness. Add the squeezed kumquat peels to the glass. When serving, add some ice cubes or crushed ice to make the drink extra refreshing.
Source: Xinhxinh

mon_an.mo_ta: Skin-Glowing Carrot Juice – A healthy juice recipe for your skin and overall health. Carrots are rich in vitamins and minerals. This recipe introduces two carrot-based juice combinations. This easy-to-make Skin-Glowing Carrot Juice is a perfect choice for the whole family, featuring two variations: carrot with orange or carrot with pomegranate.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Preparation: Wash the carrots, peel, and drain. Cut into medium-sized pieces and juice them.
Step 2: Deseed the pomegranate and juice the seeds.
Step 3: Halve the oranges, squeeze for juice, and remove the seeds. Set aside to mix with the carrot juice.
Step 4: First variation: Mix the orange juice with half of the carrot juice. Stir well with a spoon to combine. Serve with ice if desired.
Step 5: Second variation: Mix the pomegranate juice with the remaining half of the carrot juice. Stir well and serve with ice for a healthy, easy-to-make drink.

mon_an.mo_ta: Pomegranate and Lemon Juice – healthy for the whole family, especially for men. Learn how to make this refreshing Pomegranate and Lemon Juice.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the lemon, drain, and slice.
Step 2: Deseed the pomegranate and juice the seeds to make the base.
Step 3: Pour the pomegranate juice into a pitcher and add a few lemon slices. Serve chilled with ice.
Source: Ngôi sao

mon_an.ten: Pear and Red Date Weight Loss Tea
mon_an.mo_ta: Pear and red date weight loss tea – a delicious and healthy beverage. This drink not only aids weight loss but also helps treat coughs and flu while cooling the body.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel the ginger, wash, and slice thinly.

Step 2: Wash the pear. For this weight loss tea, choose high-quality, large pears that are pesticide-free so you don't have to peel them; however, if you're unsure, peel them for safety. Quarter the pear and remove the seeds.
Step 3: Finely chop the red dates.

Step 4: Place the pear, red dates, ginger, and cinnamon in a pot with 3 small bowls of cold water. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer for 1 hour. Turn off the heat, strain the liquid, and add sugar or honey as desired. You can enjoy this drink hot or cold depending on your preference and health condition.

mon_an.mo_ta: Refreshing Plum Syrup – An easy-to-make specialty for hot days. When plums are in season and affordable, making a jar of plum syrup is both cheap and delicious. Here is how to make Refreshing Plum Syrup.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Choose plums that are not bruised or overripe. Remove the stems and wash thoroughly with water to remove all dirt. For extra crispness, you can soak them in limewater. Drain well.
Step 2: Cut the plums into bite-sized pieces and remove the pits. Do not peel the plums, as the syrup won't be as flavorful and the plum pieces won't stay crisp.

Step 3: Use a clean, dry jar. Layer the plums and sugar alternately until finished. End with a layer of sugar on top. Seal the lid tightly to prevent environmental spoilage and store in a cool place. Once the sugar has completely dissolved, move to the refrigerator for longer storage.
Source: afamily

mon_an.ten: Sugarcane and Water Chestnut Cooling Drink
mon_an.mo_ta: Sugarcane and water chestnut drink to cool down on summer days. This is a very healthy beverage as it uses natural sweeteners, making it a great thirst-quencher for the whole family. This drink helps detoxify and cool the body; if you suffer from insomnia, you can add lotus seeds to help you sleep better.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Peel the sugarcane and the water chestnuts. If you buy pre-peeled water chestnuts, give them a quick rinse.
Slice the water chestnuts and cut the sugarcane into bite-sized pieces for the drink.

Step 2: Place the sugarcane, water chestnuts, rock sugar, and about 3-4 liters of water into a pot and bring to a boil. Then reduce the heat to low and simmer for another 30 minutes before turning off the heat. If you want it faster, use a pressure cooker and slightly reduce the amount of water.
Note: You can also add traditional ingredients such as red dates, licorice, or lotus seeds to tailor the drink to your family's health needs.

mon_an.mo_ta: A refreshing, simple, and easy-to-make cocktail is a summer essential. Let's get started on this Oro Mojito!
cac_buoc: Place 2 mint leaves in a glass with sugar and muddle them. Squeeze in the lime and stir to dissolve the sugar.
Add ice to the glass, then add rum, lime juice, and soda water; stir well.
Garnish with lime slices and mint leaves.
This refreshing drink recipe is very simple; however, you should choose fresh ingredients for the best result! Good luck!

mon_an.mo_ta: Watermelon jelly – a delicious, easy-to-make treat for the upcoming summer days. Refreshing watermelon jelly to beat the heat.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Start by preparing the ingredients:
Peel the watermelon and cut as desired. In the photo, a melon baller is used for beautiful watermelon spheres.
Step 2: Soak gelatin in cold water for 15 minutes to soften. Melt the gelatin sheets using a double boiler.

Step 3: This easy-to-make dish will be even better when made with unsweetened fresh milk. Mix the milk with 1/3 of the gelatin and 80g of sugar, stir well, and quickly pour into cups. Wait 15 minutes for the milk mixture to set.

Step 4: Dissolve 20g of sugar in a little filtered water with the remaining gelatin. For better color and aroma, you can add vanilla or replace the filtered water with watermelon juice. Arrange the watermelon in the cups and pour the gelatin mixture over them. Wait another 15 minutes to set, and you will have watermelon jelly. This dish is much better served cold.

mon_an.mo_ta: Summer is sweltering with harsh, bright sunshine. You want to beat the heat with a drink that is both refreshing and nutritious. Head to the kitchen and make this simple yet delicious 6-layer smoothie right away!
cac_buoc: Blend half of the soursop flesh with sugar; blend the other half with 10ml of blue curacao syrup.
Next, blend the mango with a little sugar. Juice the carrots and watermelon. Juice the pineapple and blend it with 10ml of blue curacao syrup. Keep each type separate.
Then, pour each type of juice into the glass one by one to create multiple layers.
Finally, garnish with a straw and a red acerola cherry. Stir well before drinking.
Good luck and enjoy your drink!

mon_an.mo_ta: Strawberry Lemon Smoothie – A delicious and easy-to-make treat for beauty. A cooking guide on how to make a refreshing summer strawberry lemon smoothie.
cac_buoc: Step 1: [Cooking Guide] Wash the lemons and let them drain, halve them, and squeeze for juice, removing the seeds; mix the lemon juice with granulated white sugar and filtered water, stirring until the sugar dissolves.

Step 2: Hull the strawberries, wash them, and soak in diluted salt water for 15 minutes, then drain. Put the strawberries and a few ice cubes into a blender, blend until very smooth, and strain for the juice.
Step 3: Pour the lemon juice into a glass and taste to adjust. If it's too sour, add more sugar to this easy-to-make dish.
Step 4: Slowly pour the strawberry juice on top so the strawberry lemon smoothie separates into two beautiful colored layers.

mon_an.mo_ta: Strawberry Smoothie – A delicious, easy-to-make treat that is refreshing and good for the skin, perfect for quenching thirst on hot summer days. Learn how to make cooling summer smoothies like this Strawberry Smoothie.
cac_buoc: Step 1: [Cooking Guide] How to wash strawberries: Hull the strawberries, wash under running water, then soak in diluted salt water for 15 minutes. Note: You should choose Da Lat strawberries, then remove the strawberries and place them in a basket to drain.
Step 2: Put the strawberries into a blender with condensed milk, fresh milk, and ice cubes; blend until the strawberry smoothie mixture is smooth.
And finally, you'll have a delicious, skin-beautifying treat like this:

mon_an.mo_ta: Smoothies are a very healthy drink for everyone. Instead of just making a single-flavor smoothie, you can combine different fruits to create a wonderful rainbow smoothie. The taste is also very special due to the combination of various fruits. This rainbow smoothie will help you impress everyone, especially the kids! Smoothies are a very healthy drink for everyone. Instead of just making a single-flavor smoothie, you can combine different fruits to create a wonderful rainbow smoothie. The taste is also very special due to the combination of various fruits. This rainbow smoothie will help you impress everyone, especially the kids!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Blend each layer separately in a blender until smooth.
Step 2: Pour each portion into different bowls.

Step 3: Use the same-sized spoon for each smoothie portion to scoop into a glass. Choose a tall, slender glass. Carefully layer the smoothies in the following color order: purple, green, yellow, orange, and red.

mon_an.ten: Lemon, Celery, and Root Vegetable Smoothie
mon_an.mo_ta: With lemons rich in vitamin C and a strong sour taste, and celery which has cooling effects, improves appetite, and helps lower blood pressure, this combination with other root vegetables creates a Lemon, Celery, and Root Vegetable Smoothie that is refreshing, anti-aging, health-protecting, and appetizing. Let's learn how to make this nutritious smoothie!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash all vegetables and fruits. Squeeze the lemon for juice. Peel and cube the carrot. Cut the celery into segments. Soak the apple in salt water, remove seeds, and cube.
Step 2: Put everything into the blender, blend until smooth, add honey, and mix well.
Step 3: Pour into a glass, garnish, and enjoy your Lemon, Celery, and Root Vegetable Smoothie.

mon_an.mo_ta: Anyone who has ever tasted strawberries surely cannot forget their seductive flavor. Yogurt also aids digestion very well. The delicious taste of strawberries combined with yogurt creates a smoothie that couldn't be more wonderful. Today, I will guide you on how to make a strawberry yogurt smoothie! Anyone who has ever tasted strawberries surely cannot forget their seductive flavor. Yogurt also aids digestion very well. The delicious taste of strawberries combined with yogurt creates a smoothie that couldn't be more wonderful. Today, I will guide you on how to make a strawberry yogurt smoothie!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Condensed milk, coconut oil - For mixing
Shaved ice, sugar, lemon - For mixing
cac_buoc: Step 1: Remove the strawberry stems and soak them in diluted salt water. Then, rinse again, drain, and cut the strawberries in half.
Step 2: Put the strawberries in a blender with the yogurt, 1/2 small pack of fresh milk, 1 tsp of condensed milk, 1 tsp of coconut oil, and 1 tbsp of sugar.

Step 3: Take a bit of lemon zest, slice it thinly, and add it to the blender (lemon zest makes the smoothie more fragrant and helps treat coughs; however, use only a little or the smoothie will be bitter!).
Step 4: Blend for about 1 minute; once the smoothie looks smooth and fine, you can pour it into a glass.
Step 5: Cut a strawberry in half and add it to make our smoothie glass more attractive :D.
P.S.: Share this delicious smoothie recipe so your friends and family can also make a wonderful, healthy smoothie!

mon_an.ten: Refreshing Summer Papaya Coconut Milk Smoothie
mon_an.mo_ta: Papaya coconut milk smoothie contains plenty of vitamin C and carotene, which will help you feel less tired after a hard day's work. It also improves digestion and is good for the skin in cold weather, so don't hesitate to make a glass to sip on! Let's do it!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash and peel the papaya, cut in half, and remove seeds. Cut 1/2 of the papaya into small cubes.
Step 2: Put all ingredients into a blender and blend until smooth.
Step 3: Pour into a glass, add ice, and enjoy. You can also enjoy the papaya coconut milk smoothie without ice or warm it up in the oven.

mon_an.mo_ta: Jackfruit and Mango Smoothie – refreshing and thirst-quenching with the intense aroma of jackfruit and mango. Learn this delicious recipe for a post-meal dessert.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Jackfruit - A few segments, seeds removed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel the mango and cut it into small pieces. Shred the jackfruit into small pieces as well.
Step 2: Put the yogurt, condensed milk, jackfruit, mango, and ice cubes into the blender jar to prepare the smoothie.
Step 3: Blend the mixture until smooth. Pour into a glass and enjoy while cold.
Source: Ngoi Sao

mon_an.mo_ta: Raspberry Smoothie – another delicious and beautiful smoothie recipe. An easy-to-make dish that is great for your skin and health, providing plenty of vitamin C.
cac_buoc: Step 1: How to make raspberry juice: Wash the raspberries and drain. Then put them in a blender with a little sugar and blend until smooth. Once blended, strain to get the juice and discard the pulp.
Step 2: Squeeze the 4 yellow lemons for juice. Then blend the lemon juice and bottled orange juice with a bit of sugar and ice cubes until smooth.
Step 3: After a few minutes, you will have a delicious thick mixture for the raspberry smoothie.
Step 4: Scoop a little raspberry juice into a glass.
Step 5: Then add the lemon and orange mixture to the glass. You now have a wonderful, easy-to-make smoothie.

mon_an.mo_ta: Delicious Peach Syrup for Tea – An attractive and fragrant daily treat that will make your tea much tastier. Here is how to make this delicious peach syrup.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the peaches thoroughly so that when peeling, the fuzz doesn't stick to the flesh. Slice the peaches into wedges and then dice them into small cubes.

Step 2: Place the diced peaches in a bowl and add 230g of sugar, mixing well. It takes about 2 hours for the sugar to dissolve and soak into the peaches. Then, cover with plastic wrap and keep the bowl in the refrigerator for about 4 days.
Step 3: At this point, strain the peaches through a sieve to get a slightly thick liquid without any lumps. Mix in the apple cider vinegar to complete this daily treat.
You should store the syrup in the refrigerator to keep it longer. When drinking tea or other soft drinks, add a little peach syrup to the glass for a better aroma.
Source: Kenh14

mon_an.ten: Refreshing Mulberry Syrup for Sunny Days
mon_an.mo_ta: Refreshing Mulberry Syrup for Sunny Days – It's the season for ripe, delicious mulberries. Make some mulberry syrup to preserve the cool, sweet moments of summer. Learn to make this great drink. Get creative with the gifts of nature this summer.
cac_buoc: Whenever you come home from work or school, making a glass of this refreshing mulberry syrup will make you feel instantly refreshed and cool.
Step 1: Wash the mulberries, removing any green or bruised ones. Place in a clean basket to drain.
Step 2: Mix the sugar and mulberries in a large bowl. Leave the bowl in a cool place for the mulberries to release all their juices.
Step 3: Soak the mulberries for about 2-3 days until the sugar is completely dissolved. While waiting for the sugar to absorb, you can learn to cook many other delicious dishes.
Step 4: Use a sieve and a spoon to press the mulberry juice, using a large bowl to catch the juice.
Step 5: Filter the mulberry juice through a clean cloth to remove all residue and pulp; your mulberry syrup is waiting for you.
Step 6:
Pour the mulberry juice into a pot and bring to a boil to sterilize. When the water boils, turn the heat to low, skim off the foam, and simmer for another 10 minutes before turning off the heat.
Let the mulberry syrup cool completely before pouring it into small jars for cold storage.

mon_an.ten: Refreshing Summer Orange and Lemon Soda
mon_an.mo_ta: It's orange season, so let's drink orange juice! But is a plain glass of squeezed orange juice too simple? Let me show you how to make a wonderful, refreshing Orange and Lemon Soda!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the oranges and lemon, then squeeze for juice.
Step 2: Add the orange juice, lemon juice, honey, and soda water, then stir well. Add sugar to suit your taste.
Step 3: Pour into a glass, garnish, and enjoy your Orange and Lemon Soda.

mon_an.mo_ta: Matcha Yogurt – An easy-to-make dish that is good for your health, especially for strengthening your digestive system's resistance. Matcha yogurt is a perfect combination of green tea and yogurt, being both healthy and uniquely flavorful.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Put the matcha powder into a cup, pour in a little boiling water, and dissolve. Then strain through a fine-mesh sieve to remove any lumps so the matcha yogurt is smooth.
Step 2: Put the condensed milk into a large bowl. Pour 140ml of very hot boiling water into the bowl and stir until the condensed milk is completely dissolved.

Step 3: Use the condensed milk can to measure the fresh milk; add 1.5 cans of fresh milk to the bowl. For this easy recipe, the ratio is 1/2 can condensed milk : 1/2 can hot water : 1.5 cans fresh milk.
Step 4: Let the unsweetened yogurt sit out until it reaches room temperature, then pour it into the milk mixture and stir well.
Step 5:
Add the matcha water to the mixture and stir well.
Scoop this mixture into clean, dry jars. After filling, close the lids tightly for jars that have them.
Step 6:
Use a sealed pot, fill it with hot water at about 50°C, and arrange the yogurt jars so the water covers 1/3 of the jar height.

Cover with a clean cotton towel, close the pot lid tightly, and incubate for 8-10 hours until the yogurt sets. Then take them out for about 1 hour to cool before placing them in the refrigerator. The purpose of leaving the yogurt out for 1 hour is to balance the temperature so the yogurt doesn't separate.
Source: Ngoisao

mon_an.mo_ta: Creamy Iced Limeade – a refreshing drink that harmoniously blends the tartness of lime with the sweetness of milk, making it a popular choice for hot summer days. Upon tasting, you will be captivated by the natural aroma of fresh lime and the rich creaminess of milk, creating a truly refreshing and delicious sensation. Follow the recipe below to make this thirst-quenching creamy iced limeade for those sweltering summer days! Enjoy a delicious summer treat with this simple recipe. The wonderful flavors of condensed milk, lime juice, and ice cubes will soothe the summer heat.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Pour the condensed milk into a glass and add hot water, stirring well until the milk is dissolved.
Step 2: Wash the limes and drain. Cut the limes in half and squeeze for juice, removing the seeds. Set aside 1 lime to slice thinly for garnishing the refreshing glass of iced limeade.
Step 3: Slowly add the lime juice to the milk glass, adjusting the sweet and sour balance to suit your taste. Add shaved ice to the glass and enjoy while cold.
Note: You can also put condensed milk, ice cubes, lime juice, and a bit of fresh milk into a blender and blend until smooth; the creamy iced limeade made this way is also very delicious.
Learn more about the benefits of lime:

Limes offer many health benefits and are very low in calories, supporting the weight loss process for women. A lime weighing about 70 grams contains only about 20 calories but is rich in vitamin C, vitamin B6, potassium, calcium, and fiber.

Consuming limes not only helps improve the immune system but is also a powerful aid in maintaining youthful skin for women thanks to the high vitamin C content. Additionally, limes provide other benefits such as:
Supporting cardiovascular health.
Preventing kidney stones.
Protecting the body against anemia.
Reducing the risk of cancer.
Improving digestive health.
Take advantage of the comprehensive benefits of limes to enhance your health and maintain a healthy lifestyle.
How to drink creamy iced limeade properly
To drink creamy iced limeade correctly and enjoy its wonderful flavor, you can follow these steps:
1. Prepare a glass and spoon: Use a glass with enough capacity to hold the drink and a spoon for stirring.
2. Shake well: If you have stored the limeade in the refrigerator, shake the glass well before drinking to ensure the milk and lime juice mixture is evenly combined.
3. Enjoy slowly: Savor the drink slowly to fully feel the sour, sweet, and cold sensations. You can use a spoon to stir and blend the flavors.
4. Combine with lime slices: If you like, garnish the glass with a few lime slices to add freshness and appeal.
5. Drink ice cold: Creamy iced limeade is usually served with ice cubes to keep it cold. Therefore, enjoy it while it is still cold to experience the refreshing feeling.
With the steps above, you can drink creamy iced limeade properly, enjoying the delicious flavor and feeling its coolness.
Who can drink creamy iced limeade
Creamy iced limeade is a popular drink suitable for many people. Below are the groups of people who should drink it:
People wanting to boost their immune system: It contains a lot of vitamin C, an important antioxidant for the immune system. Drinking it can help enhance health and support the immune system.
People who like cold drinks: It is usually served cold with ice cubes. This makes it a great choice for those who enjoy refreshing and cool beverages.
People needing vitamin C supplementation: It is a natural source of vitamin C, an important nutrient for health. People needing more vitamin C in their diet can benefit from drinking it.
People needing to quench their thirst: This is a delicious and cold thirst-quenching drink. It can soothe thirst and bring refreshment on hot days.
Creamy iced limeade is a popular drink suitable for many people.

mon_an.mo_ta: Fragrant Red Bean Milk – A delicious, easy-to-make dish that gives women bright, smooth, and beautiful skin. How to make Fragrant Red Bean Milk.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Soak the red beans in a bowl of water overnight until soft. Discard any flat, damaged, or moldy beans.
Step 2: Blend the red beans finely in a blender, then strain to get the liquid; discard the residue, or you can use the residue to cook with sugar for a thick red bean sweet soup.
Step 3: Pour the red bean milk into a pot, add a few washed pandan leaves, and simmer over low heat. Occasionally use a ladle to skim off the foam on top.

Step 4: When the red bean milk boils, simmer for about 5 more minutes, then pour into a pitcher and wait for it to cool. Pour this easy-to-make delicious drink into a glass, mix with sugar, a bit of fresh milk, and a few ice cubes.
Source: Xinhxinh

mon_an.ten: Egg and Honey Milk for Cold Days
mon_an.mo_ta: The cold wind is back, and children can no longer drink cold water for fear of coughing. So, mothers, let's make Egg and Honey Milk for your kids! Here is a very simple way to make a nutritious cup of milk rich in calories and protein for your children!
cac_buoc: Step 1: For this easy-to-make dish, put all ingredients into a blender, blend well, and pour into a cup.
Step 2: Place in the oven or microwave to warm up.
Step 3: Decorate and let your child enjoy the Egg and Honey Milk for cold days!

mon_an.mo_ta: Creamy Avocado Jelly – A delicious, easy-to-make dish that is also good for the skin. Usually, you are used to avocado smoothies, mashed avocado, or fried avocado, so this avocado jelly will surely delight you. Creamy Avocado Jelly.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Jackfruit, coconut milk, shaved ice to serve with the jelly
cac_buoc: Step 1: How to prepare the avocado: Cut the avocados in half, remove the seeds, then use a spoon to scoop out the flesh and put it into a blender. Add fresh milk and condensed milk, and blend until smooth.

Step 2: Dissolve the jelly powder, sugar, and 600ml of cold water in a small pot. Use a ladle to stir until the jelly powder dissolves. Let it sit for about 15 minutes, then place on the stove and bring to a boil over very low heat until the jelly powder and sugar are completely dissolved. Remove the pot from the heat, add vanilla, and let it cool slightly. You can adjust the amount of sugar to suit your preference.
Step 3: Pour the blended avocado mixture into the jelly pot from Step 2. If the mixture is lumpy, put it back into the blender and blend one more time.
Step 4: When the avocado mixture has cooled, pour it into molds and leave in the refrigerator overnight to make the delicious creamy avocado jelly.
To make the avocado jelly even better, you can add jackfruit, shaved ice, and coconut milk to make the dish tastier and more refreshing.

mon_an.ten: Coffee and Milk Jelly with Jackfruit
mon_an.mo_ta: Coffee and Milk Jelly with Jackfruit – a summer heat-reliever made from easy-to-make and addictive jellies. How to make Coffee and Milk Jelly with Jackfruit.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 7g coffee powder, 5g jelly powder, 300ml cold water, 40g sugar
5g jelly powder, 200ml fresh milk, 100ml water, 2 tbsp condensed milk, 30g sugar
300ml canned coconut milk, 2 tsp sugar, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp tapioca starch
cac_buoc: Step 1: Mix the coffee powder with hot water until completely dissolved. Put the jelly powder into cold water, then add the granulated sugar and prepared coffee into a small pot. Place on the stove and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly so the jelly doesn't clump. Once the jelly powder and sugar have dissolved completely, turn off the heat.

Step 2: How to make the milk jelly: Put the jelly powder, milk, filtered water, sugar, and condensed milk into another small pot. Cook over medium heat while stirring constantly until the jelly powder and sugar dissolve, then turn off the heat.

Step 3: Use a ladle to scoop a little coffee jelly into a cup or mold, then scoop a little milk jelly on top of the coffee jelly layer until the mold is full. Let it cool and place in the refrigerator until the jelly is completely firm.

Step 4: Make the coconut milk for the coffee and milk jelly with jackfruit: Put the canned coconut milk into another small pot, add salt, sugar, and tapioca starch. Place on the stove over low heat until the coconut milk mixture thickens, then turn off the heat and scoop the coconut milk into a separate bowl.
Step 5: Rinse the basil seeds several times until clean, soak until they expand, then pour into a strainer to drain. Remove the seeds from the jackfruit and tear into thin strips.
Step 6: Once the jelly is completely firm, remove it from the molds and cut into bite-sized pieces.

Step 7: When serving, add shaved ice to a glass, scoop the coffee and milk jelly, basil seeds, and some jackfruit on top. Pour over the coconut milk and drizzle with a little condensed milk. Mix well and serve cold.

mon_an.mo_ta: Two-Layer Strawberry Jelly – visually appealing and delicious with a sweet two-layered jelly cup. Learn to cook delicious Two-Layer Strawberry Jelly.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Put the heavy cream, fresh milk, and sugar into a pot. Heat over medium heat, stirring constantly until almost boiling. Wash the strawberries, cut them in half, and blend until smooth with a little water. Filter the strawberries through a sieve to get the juice and discard the pulp.
Step 2: Dissolve the gelatin powder in boiling water and let it sit for 15 minutes to dissolve, then stir well. Divide this mixture into 2 parts. Mix one part with the milk mixture.
Step 3: Tilt a small cup and pour the milk-gelatin mixture into it. Refrigerate for 2 hours until set to form one half.

Step 4: Mix the remaining gelatin with the strawberry juice. Then pour it over the surface of the milk jelly cup from Step 3. Place back in the refrigerator for another 2 hours to have a delicious two-layer strawberry jelly.
Source: Ngoi sao

mon_an.mo_ta: Eye-Catching Watermelon Jelly – especially beautiful and delicious to add vibrant colors to your summer. Learn to cook delicious Eye-Catching Watermelon Jelly.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Cut the watermelon in half lengthwise. Use a spoon to scoop out the flesh into a small bowl. Remove the seeds and then juice the watermelon flesh.
Step 2: Mix the sugar, jelly powder, and Jello powder in a bowl (if you don't have Jello powder, you can buy a pack of watermelon jelly powder at the supermarket).
Step 3: Pour the water and watermelon juice into the powder mixture and whisk (using a hand mixer) for 2 minutes so the watermelon jelly has an even color.

Step 4: Pour the jelly mixture into the two halves of the watermelon rind. Pour carefully so the liquid doesn't spill out. Use a tray and some cloth to support the bottom of the watermelon. Place in the refrigerator for about 4 hours until set.
Step 5: Then take the jelly out of the refrigerator and use a knife to cut the watermelon jelly into slices as you like. It is now complete. Enjoy your meal!
Source: Buzzfeed

mon_an.mo_ta: Summer Watermelon Jelly is for the hot summer. Watermelon jelly dispels the summer heat after every meal. Learn to cook delicious Summer Watermelon Jelly with a short processing time that is still incredibly tasty.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Soak the gelatin in cold water for about 15 minutes.
