Slice the watermelon, remove the seeds, and blend until smooth. Filter through a sieve to get the juice so the Summer Watermelon Jelly is clear and beautiful.
Step 2:
Put the white wine and sugar into a pot, heat, and stir until the sugar is completely dissolved. Simmer over low heat for about 10 minutes.
Squeeze the water out of the soaked gelatin and drop it into the wine and sugar mixture, stirring until the gelatin is completely dissolved.
Step 3: Let the mixture cool, then add the watermelon juice and stir well.
Step 4: Pour into molds, cover with plastic wrap, and place in the refrigerator for about 4 hours until the Summer Watermelon Jelly is ready to eat.

mon_an.mo_ta: In this article, we will share how to make coconut jelly, a sweet and refreshing treat for summer days. Let's refer to the recipe for delicious and refreshing coconut jelly in the article below! Instructions on how to make delicious, cool, and refreshing coconut jelly for summer. Discover how to make delicious and refreshing coconut jelly in our article now.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Cook the coconut milk layer

In a pot, dissolve 1 teaspoon of jelly powder into 300ml of fresh coconut water, stirring well. Turn on the stove and add 250ml of coconut milk and 1/8 teaspoon of salt to the pot. Cook over low heat to prevent the jelly from clumping. Next, add 4 tablespoons of sugar (adjust the amount of sugar to taste). Add 1 small pandan leaf for aroma and bring to a boil. Turn off the heat as soon as it boils.
Step 2: Cook the jelly

Prepare another pot, dissolve 1 teaspoon of jelly powder into 500ml of fresh coconut water, stirring well. Turn on the stove over low heat and add 3 tablespoons of sugar. Next, add 1 small pandan leaf for aroma and bring to a boil. Turn off the heat as soon as it boils.
Step 3: Create the jelly layers
The process of pouring the jelly is very important to ensure the aesthetics and flavor of the dish. Note that both jelly mixtures must be kept warm to avoid clumping and affecting the quality.

Pour a layer of coconut milk jelly into a container and place it in the refrigerator for about 5 minutes to set. Next, pour a layer of coconut water jelly into the container, using a spoon to pour gently so as not to damage the coconut milk layer, and refrigerate for about 7 minutes to set. Repeat the process of pouring other layers until the container is full, with each layer needing 7-8 minutes to set.
Step 4: Completion

The coconut jelly is formed from many alternating layers, creating an attractive and eye-catching appearance. With the coolness and sweet flavor of coconut water, coconut jelly will surely be loved by everyone. When taking the jelly out of the refrigerator, you can use a knife to trim the rounded corners, creating bite-sized and neat pieces. Then, you can serve it for everyone to enjoy.
Notes for making delicious coconut jelly
Below are some important notes when making delicious and cool coconut jelly:
Ensure it boils at the right time: When cooking the coconut milk and jelly, bring the mixture to a complete boil. This helps ensure that the jelly will set firmly and not be too soft.

Control the amount of sugar: Depending on personal preference, you can increase or decrease the amount of sugar in the recipe to adjust the sweetness of the coconut jelly. Taste and adjust the sugar to suit your palate.
Use fresh coconut water: For a fresh and fragrant flavor, use fresh coconut water instead of canned coconut water. If possible, you can get the water directly from fresh coconuts.
Pour the jelly layers carefully: When pouring the layers, ensure both jelly mixtures are still warm. This helps avoid clumping and ensures the quality of the dish.

Beautify the jelly: If you want the coconut jelly to look more appealing, you can use a knife to trim the rounded corners and create bite-sized pieces. This adds to the attractiveness of the dish and creates a sense of enjoyment when eating.
Remember to follow the above notes to make a delicious, refreshing, and attractive coconut jelly for everyone to enjoy.

mon_an.mo_ta: Pandan Leaf Jelly – A delicious, easy-to-make dish with the fragrance of pandan, the richness of creamy milk, and a very refreshing taste. Learn to cook delicious Pandan Leaf Jelly.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the pandan leaves and drain. Put the pandan leaves into a blender and blend until smooth with 200ml of filtered water. Strain to get the clear green liquid and discard the pulp.

Step 2: Next, add the jelly powder, sugar, the remaining 200ml of cold water, and the pandan extract into a pot. Stir well to dissolve the jelly powder and let it rest for about 15 minutes. Then place the pot on the stove over low heat, stirring constantly until the jelly and sugar are completely dissolved.

Step 3: Dissolve the sugar, fresh milk, and jelly powder in a small pot. Let it sit for about 15 minutes, then place the pot on the stove, stirring constantly until the jelly powder is completely dissolved to make the two-colored pandan leaf jelly layers.
Step 4: Scoop a little milk jelly into a cup, place it in the refrigerator to let the surface set, then gently scoop the pandan jelly on top and return to the refrigerator to set.

Step 5: Continue scooping the jelly layers as you like to get the desired easy-to-make delicious dish. During the process, if the jelly in the pot solidifies, simply reheat it over low heat until it melts again.
Source: Ngoi sao

mon_an.mo_ta: Delicious Fruit Jelly – a refreshing and simple fruit jelly treat for every home. Learn how to make this delicious Fruit Jelly.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the various fruits, pat dry, and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Step 2: Prepare your favorite molds, arrange the fruit inside, and place them in the refrigerator.

Step 3: Mix the sugar and jelly powder in a bowl. Pour the apple juice into a pot and place it on the stove. Add the sugar and jelly mixture, stir until dissolved, and bring to a boil for about 5 minutes. Turn off the heat and continue stirring until the bubbles disappear.
Step 4: Slowly pour the jelly mixture into the molds containing the fruit. Wait for the mixture to cool, then refrigerate for 3 hours or overnight until set.
Source: Ngôi sao

mon_an.mo_ta: Fragrant Mango Jelly – a treat for the whole family with a clear jelly layer surrounding sweet mango pieces. How to make Fragrant Mango Jelly.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Dissolve the mango-flavored jelly powder (available at supermarkets) and tapioca starch in filtered water, then bring to a boil.
Step 2: Peel the ripe mango and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Step 3: Pour the mixture from Step 1 into the molds until about 70% full, then place the mango pieces in the center.
Step 4: Wait for the jelly to cool, then refrigerate the mango jelly overnight.
Source: Ngôi sao

mon_an.mo_ta: Refreshing Fruit Tea – An easy-to-make treat for hot summer days. With this cool and wonderful drink, you will save a lot of money and effort while still having delicious drinks just like at a shop.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients:

Wash the fruit and soak in salt water to remove any residue on the skin, then drain. Remove the eyes from the pineapple and dice. Core the apple, soak in very diluted salt water, and dice. Dice the strawberries. Thinly slice the lemons (you can use yellow lemons or local limes).
Step 2: Pour water into a kettle or pot, then add the apple, strawberries, and pineapple and bring to a boil.
Step 3: Turn off the heat or unplug the kettle. While the water is still hot, add the tea bags and let steep for 5 minutes to release the tea flavor.
Step 4: Once the tea has cooled, add the lemon slices and honey. Serve hot or cold as desired. If serving with ice, add a bit more honey so the fruit tea doesn't become too bland.
Source: Kenh14

mon_an.mo_ta: Fragrant Jasmine Peach Tea – Cool down on sunny days with the blended aroma of peach and jasmine; a delicious drink suitable for many.
cac_buoc: When choosing peaches, select firm varieties; avoid fuzzy peaches as they can leave fuzz in the tea, which is unpleasant.
Step 1: Soak the peaches in diluted salt water to clean the skin. Drain or pat dry. Cut into bite-sized pieces.

Step 2: Place the jasmine flowers, brown sugar, and water in a pot. If you like, you can add tea leaves; note that you should choose plain tea without added scents to keep the cooling tea's original flavor.
Step 3: Heat the tea until it reaches a gentle simmer, then add the peaches.
Step 4: Simmer on low heat for about 20 minutes, then turn off the heat. You can enjoy this tea hot or cold for a refreshing effect.

mon_an.mo_ta: Basic Mojito – The delicious and cool drink from the shops can now be brought home and self-prepared, tasting just as good. Learn the recipe for a Basic Mojito.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Halve the lemons and squeeze the juice into a small glass, removing any seeds or pulp.
Step 2: Wash the mint leaves and use only the fresh ones, discarding any wilted leaves. Muddle the mint leaves with sugar to release the fragrant mint flavor.

Step 3: Mix the rum, soda water, and lemon juice in a medium glass. Add the muddled mint and sugar mixture, then add about 150ml of filtered water. Strain the mixture through a sieve to remove the mint residue. Serve in a glass with ice cubes, a fresh lemon slice, and a sprig of mint.
Source: Inspiredtaste

mon_an.mo_ta: Lemon Tea – An easy-to-make refreshing treat for a cool summer. This article will guide you on how to make lemon tea at home to cool down effectively. Enjoy your summer with this homemade lemon tea guide.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Tea bags or other tea types
cac_buoc: Method 1: Homemade Summer Lemon Tea
Step 1: Prepare the ingredients:
Place the tea bag in a cup and slowly pour in boiling water. Adjust the strength of the tea to your preference. Wait about 5-7 minutes for the tea to steep, then remove the tea bag.
Halve the lemons, squeeze for juice, and remove seeds. Keep one lemon (yellow or green) to slice thinly for garnish.

Step 2: Mix the sugar, tea, and lemon juice to suit your taste. If you want a more distinctive aroma, you can add honey or jasmine flowers. Pour the lemon tea into a pitcher with ice. When enjoying this treat, pour it into a glass, have some melon seeds, and enjoy a good chat!
Method 2: Kumquat Lemon Tea
Ingredients:
Use about 20g of dry tea (approx. 1.5 tbsp)
2 lemons
2 kumquats
1 tbsp sugar and some ice.
Instructions:
Steeping the tea:
First, place 20g of dry tea (approx. 1.5 tbsp) in a glass. Pour 150ml of hot water (about 70-80°C) into the glass and let it steep for 15 minutes.
Next, filter the tea by pouring it through a sieve to remove the leaves.
For the lemons, lightly scrub the peel and wash them. Cut the lemons into 4 parts and remove the seeds.
Mixing the tea:
Squeeze the lemon juice into the filtered tea. Add 1 tbsp of sugar and stir well.
Finally, add ice to the glass, stir, and enjoy your delicious lemon tea!
Using familiar kitchen ingredients and simple variations, we have created a delicious, Vitamin C-rich refreshing drink. Try this simple kumquat lemon tea at home!
How to choose fresh lemons:
When buying lemons, prioritize medium-sized fruits that feel heavy for their size. The skin should be smooth and shiny without being rough or lumpy.
Choose bright green lemons with thin skin that look fresh and have no signs of mold.
Avoid dark green lemons with dry, soft skin or yellow spots. These are usually old; the juice may have an off-odor and lack the expected acidity and fragrance.
Notes for making lemon tea at home:
When making lemon tea, choose high-quality, fresh dry tea that fits your taste. Select fresh lemons with smooth skin.
Pay attention to the water temperature. Use water at 70-80°C to ensure the tea extracts well. Steeping time is also important—about 3-5 minutes for the best flavor.
After steeping, strain the tea leaves for a clear liquid without bitterness. You can add sugar or honey to taste.
Finally, add ice to cool the drink and enjoy the fragrant flavor.

mon_an.mo_ta: Learn how to make delicious grass jelly milk tea with this recipe. Grass jelly milk tea is an attractive drink/snack for hot summer days.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Tea - As needed (Loose leaf or tea bags of your favorite flavor)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Make the grass jelly
Put the grass jelly powder into a pot and add a little water...
Stir well until the powder is completely dissolved.
Turn on the stove, add the remaining water while stirring, bring to a boil, then turn off the heat. Pour the mixture into a rectangular tray, let it cool, then refrigerate until set.
Step 2: Cook the milk tea

Pour the milk into a pot and bring to a simmer over low heat (just small bubbles). Add the loose tea or tea bags and simmer for about 2 minutes to let the tea steep and blend its flavor and aroma into the milk. Add sugar, honey, or condensed milk to sweeten if desired.
Step 3: Presentation

Once the milk tea is done, strain it through a sieve, let it cool, and refrigerate. When serving, cut the grass jelly into small, neat cubes and place them in a cup. Pour in the prepared milk tea and serve immediately.
Here is the final result! ^^
Tips for delicious grass jelly milk tea:

When making the jelly, check the instructions carefully as different brands require different water ratios. The ones I usually buy use a 1:20 ratio (1g powder to 20ml water). Always dissolve the powder in a little water first before adding the rest to cook.
Do not boil the milk over high heat; only use low heat until it just starts to simmer before adding the tea.
You can use loose tea or flavored tea bags (orange, peach, jasmine, lotus...). If using tea bags, remember to jiggle the bag in the milk to help it dissolve.

Both the grass jelly and milk tea must be cooled before refrigerating (the jelly sets as it cools). Never put a hot tray into the fridge as it can damage the appliance. You can place the tray in a bowl of cold water to speed up the cooling process.

mon_an.ten: Red Date Tea: Benefits and Recipes
mon_an.mo_ta: Red date tea has long been known as a nutritious drink beneficial for health. Do you truly understand its benefits and how to brew it perfectly? Refer to this article for answers and recipes. What are red dates?
cac_buoc: Red dates, also known as jujubes, are a popular health food in China. Once dried whole, they are packaged for long-term storage while retaining their nutritional benefits.
Red dates are used in many dishes, with red date tea being a favorite for daily consumption.
Is drinking red date tea daily good?
In traditional medicine, red dates are considered a tonic because they contain protein, calcium, phosphorus, iron, and vitamins A, C, B1, B2, etc. Benefits include:
Improving insomnia: The nutrients have a sedative effect, helping reduce insomnia, fatigue, and stress.
Boosting blood circulation: With a sweet-sour taste and warm property, they tonify the spleen and stimulate blood flow, improving liver, spleen, and stomach health.
Preventing cancer and protecting the liver: High in Vitamin C and flavonoids, they act as antioxidants to fight free radical damage.
Good for pregnancy: Expectant mothers can drink it for better skin (Vitamins C and E), blood enrichment, and cold prevention. It is safe for both mother and baby.
Ways to brew red date tea:
Step 1: Red date tea with ginger, cinnamon, and pear
Ingredients: 6 red dates, 3 slices ginger, 10g cinnamon, 20g pear.

Method: Boil 1 liter of water. Slice the ginger and add to the pot. Add cinnamon or thin pear slices. Add the red dates. Simmer for 4 hours on low heat. Strain and discard the solids. Serve in a cup. Add honey or sugar for more flavor.
Step 2: Red date tea with goji berries
Ingredients: 2 red dates, 5 goji berries.
Method: Rinse the dates and goji berries. Slice the dates. Place both in a cup. Pour 200ml boiling water over them and cover. Steep for 10 minutes, then enjoy.
Step 3: Red date tea with chrysanthemum
Ingredients: 2 red dates, 1 tbsp dried chrysanthemum flowers.
Method: Rinse the dates and flowers. Slice the dates. Place in a cup and add 200ml boiling water. Cover for 10 minutes, then enjoy.
Step 4: Red date tea with ginger
Ingredients: 2 red dates, 5 slices ginger.
Method: Rinse the dates and ginger. Slice the dates. Place in a cup and add 200ml boiling water. Cover for 10 minutes, then enjoy.
Notes for brewing:
Always slice the red dates to ensure the sweetness and nutrients are fully released. Avoid boiling over high heat to preserve vitamins.
Avoid red dates if you are taking anti-epileptic medication.
Diabetics should limit consumption due to carbohydrate content which can raise blood sugar.
Fresh dates last a few weeks in the fridge (best within 3-4 days), while dried dates last several months.
When to drink:
After waking up: Helps restore energy, detoxify, and stabilize blood pressure after sleep.
After fatty meals: Helps digestion and prevents bloating.
Ideally, drink daily and about 30 minutes before bed. In the evening, use the second or third steep so the tea is lighter and doesn't affect sleep.

mon_an.mo_ta: Honey Apple Tea – for those who want to sip tea and snack on apple bits at the same time. Learn how to make Honey Apple Tea.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the apple, peel, and dice into small cubes.
Step 2: Boil 400ml of water with 80ml of honey over medium heat. When the water boils, turn off the heat and add the tea bags. Let steep for 5 minutes so the tea is fully infused and fragrant.
Step 3: Add the diced apple and stir. Wait for the tea to cool. Add ice and enjoy. Garnish with mint leaves to make the tea more appealing!
Source: Afamily

mon_an.mo_ta: Homemade Egg Coffee – An easy-to-make treat that harmoniously combines the bitterness of coffee, the richness of egg, and the sweetness of honey and condensed milk. A delightful choice for rainy days.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Separate the egg yolk and white into two different cups. Beat the yolk first: add a few drops of honey and whisk with a mixer until fluffy, fragrant like cake batter, and pale yellow.
Step 2: Clean the whisk, then beat the egg white. Add a little sugar and a few drops of honey, then whisk thoroughly until the white is stiff and smooth like foam with a rich aroma.
Step 3: Brew hot black coffee and pour into a cup (add sugar if desired). Immediately pour the beaten yolk in first, then scoop the fluffy egg white on top.
Step 4: You can stir it or enjoy each layer separately. Avoid over-stirring as it makes the bottom coffee layer cool down quickly and the egg may become fishy and hard to drink.
Source: Ngôi sao

mon_an.mo_ta: Homemade Strawberry Syrup – An easy-to-make, sweet, and delicious treat to quench your summer thirst. Here is how to make Homemade Strawberry Syrup.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the strawberries, remove the hulls, and cut them into quarters.
Step 2: Place the strawberries and water in a pot and bring to a boil. Once it starts boiling, reduce to low heat and continue to simmer for about 15 minutes.
Step 3: Simmer until the water turns red, then turn off the heat and let it cool. Strain to collect the strawberry juice. Be gentle and do not mash the strawberries so the syrup remains clear!
Step 4: Pour the strawberry juice back into the pot and boil with sugar for about 5 minutes over high heat. Let the syrup cool completely before bottling; it is now ready for use!
Source: Xinhxinh

mon_an.ten: Homemade Strawberry Shrub for Hot Days
mon_an.mo_ta: Cool down this summer with homemade strawberry syrup mixed with ice and water; it helps refresh the body and restore energy!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 250ml red wine vinegar (available at specialty import stores)
cac_buoc: Ingredients you need to prepare for the strawberry syrup:
Step 1:
First, remove the hulls and cut the strawberries into quarters.
Step 2:
Place the strawberries in a bowl, sprinkle with sugar, and mix well.
Step 3:
Cover the bowl tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate until the strawberries begin to release their juices.
This process can take from 5-6 hours to several days; the longer you leave it, the more juice will be extracted!
Step 4:
Once the strawberries have released their juice, strain and press them to collect the extract.
Step 5:
If there is any undissolved sugar left in the bowl, pour it into the collected strawberry juice.
Step 6:
Pour in the red wine vinegar.
Step 7:
Transfer the mixture into a jar, seal the lid tightly, and shake well. Keep it refrigerated and check back in a few days to ensure all the sugar has dissolved.
After about 1 week, your strawberry shrub is ready to enjoy!
Just mix it with ice!
Doesn't our glass of strawberry syrup look attractive!
Mixing this syrup with soda makes a wonderful refreshing drink!
This strawberry syrup can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 1 year!

mon_an.mo_ta: Make this beautiful and delicious Watermelon Cake for the whole family; everyone is guaranteed to love it! Let's get started!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Cut a horizontal round from the middle of the red watermelon about 5-6cm thick and peel off the green rind. Cut other rounds for the cake layers with diameters decreasing by 1cm, 2cm, and 3cm respectively, alternating between yellow and red colors.
Step 2: Stack the watermelon layers on top of each other; you can use toothpicks to secure them so they don't slide. Decorate with blueberries or black grapes as desired.
Step 4: Arrange on a platter and enjoy your beautiful and delicious Watermelon Cake.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Green Tea Pudding for March 8th
mon_an.mo_ta: Green tea powder (also known as matcha) originating from Japan has long been famous for its miraculous benefits such as anti-aging, cancer prevention, detoxification, weight loss, maintaining physique, skin beauty, and preventing cardiovascular diseases. Let's cook green tea pudding for International Women's Day as a wish for women to always stay young and healthy.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Garnish: Optional, use one or a combination of the following:
Stewed red beans or canned red beans - as desired
cac_buoc: Step 1: Place cold water in a tray and soak the gelatin sheets for about 15 minutes... Then remove the gelatin sheets.
Step 2: While the gelatin is soaking, cream the cheese with the egg yolk until the mixture is smooth and turns a pale yellow.
Step 3: Simultaneously, place the matcha powder, sugar, and milk in a pot and stir to dissolve.

Turn on the heat to low and cook until the mixture simmers, then turn off the heat. Note to use low heat so the mixture only lightly simmers. Add the soaked gelatin from Step 1 and stir well. The hot milk will completely dissolve the gelatin.
Strain the milk and green tea mixture through a sieve to get a smooth, uniform liquid.
Step 4: Gradually pour the green tea milk mixture into the egg and cheese mixture, stirring gently to combine.
Pour the mixture into small serving cups or a tray and place in the refrigerator for about 4 hours until the pudding sets.
Step 5: Presentation:
When serving, take the small cups out and top with a bit of whipped cream and stewed red beans (sautéed with sugar) or canned red beans.

Alternatively, use a knife to gently loosen the edges of the mold and flip the green tea pudding onto a plate. Garnish with red beans and cherries; you can drizzle a little fruit syrup for aroma and extra flavor.
Green tea pudding pairs perfectly with red beans or black beans; the aroma of milk and green tea blends wonderfully with the nutty flavor of red beans. Give it a try.
Tips for delicious and beautiful green tea pudding:
You should strain the mixture of milk, matcha, and gelatin before mixing with the eggs and cheese to ensure the cake is smooth and free of lumps.
Since we only pour hot liquid into the egg and cheese mixture without re-cooking, the eggs are only cooked by the residual heat; therefore, be sure to choose high-quality, clean eggs.
If you don't have small molds or cups, you can use small bowls or even a large tray. If using a large tray, cut into bite-sized pieces before decorating with red beans, cream, or fruit jam.

mon_an.ten: How to Arrange a Beautiful Orange Platter
mon_an.mo_ta: Let's learn how to arrange an eye-catching orange platter! Your whole family is sure to love it!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the oranges and cherries.
Step 2: Cut the orange lengthwise into 4 wedges. Peel the skin from both ends of 2 wedges and set aside; peel the other 2 wedges completely.
Step 3: Use a knife to carve the two fully removed peels into crab legs.
Step 4: Tuck the crab legs into the ends of the orange wedges. Use toothpicks to attach cherries as crab eyes. Arrange the beautiful orange platter and enjoy.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Soft and Refreshing Hang Cot Coconut Jelly
mon_an.mo_ta: Hang Cot coconut jelly is famous in Hanoi for being fragrant, sweet, and refreshing. On hot days, nothing beats a piece of Hang Cot coconut jelly. Today's article will guide you through making this delicious treat to serve your family. We hope this helps you have a great dish for the summer.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Coconuts - 2 Siamese or ' lửa' coconuts (I usually choose 'lửa' coconuts for more juice and deep sweetness)
Jelly powder - 10g (Choose flexible jelly powder, agar-agar, or gelatin sheets)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Pierce the coconuts and pour the water into a large bowl. With two coconuts, I get about 1400-1500 ml of coconut water.
Step 2: Use a sharp knife to cut a circular lid on top of the coconuts.

Step 3: Mix the jelly powder with the sugar. You can adjust this step to taste: add more sugar for sweetness, more powder for a firmer crunch, or less powder for a soft, melt-in-your-mouth texture. I prefer it soft and not too sweet, so I mix 10g agar-agar with 100g sugar.
Step 4: Pour the agar and sugar mixture into the coconut water, stir to dissolve, and let it sit for 10-15 minutes to bloom.

Step 5: Pour about 1000ml of the coconut water mixture from Step 4 into a pot. Bring to a boil while stirring, then reduce to low heat for about 5 minutes until the powder is completely dissolved and the liquid is clear. Turn off the heat.
Step 6: Pour the jelly liquid into the two empty coconut shells.
Step 7: Place the coconuts in a bowl of water to cool quickly. Once cooled, refrigerate for 15-20 minutes until the jelly sets.
Step 8: Repeat Step 5 for the remaining coconut water and jelly powder. Once dissolved, turn off the heat and stir in the coconut milk.
Step 9: Pour the coconut milk jelly layer into the coconuts on top of the clear layer from Step 7. Let cool, then refrigerate for 1-2 hours.
After 1-2 hours, you have a refreshing coconut jelly dish as good as Hang Cot's but hygienic.
If not using the coconut shell, you can use cups or molds for a beautiful presentation.
If you don't use agar-agar, you can substitute with gelatin powder or sheets. For sheets, soak in cold water to soften before adding to the coconut water and heating to dissolve.

mon_an.ten: How to Make a Pomelo Dog for Mid-Autumn Festival
mon_an.mo_ta: Learn how to make a pomelo dog to decorate the five-fruit tray for the Mid-Autumn Festival feast.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Colored paper, ribbon - For the nose and collar
Toothpicks - To secure the pomelo segments
cac_buoc: Cut the papaya to form the dog's body so it is proportional to the orange head. Cut a flat section on the bottom for stability.
Use toothpicks to pin the orange to the papaya body to create the frame. Be careful to ensure the head is secure.
Peel the pomelos, keep the rinds, and gently separate the segments. Use a small toothpick to fluff out the juice vesicles to make the 'fur' look more realistic.
Use toothpicks, folded in half, to pin the fluffed pomelo segments onto the prepared frame.
Cut the pomelo rind to make ears and a tail, attach pomelo vesicles to them, and pin them to the body.
Cut colored paper for the nose and tongue, use custard apple seeds for the eyes, and tie a ribbon for the collar.
Here is the finished product. It looks adorable, doesn't it?
A few tips for a beautiful pomelo dog:
Choose pomelos with easy-to-peel rinds and dry (but not too dry) vesicles for better shaping.
The body can also be made from banana stems, papaya, or watermelon. If using papaya or watermelon, choose oblong shapes.
The head can be an orange or an apple. Just ensure it is large and round.

mon_an.ten: Flavorful Sweet and Sour Fried Chicken
mon_an.mo_ta: Sweet and sour fried chicken is an attractive dish that delights with the tenderness of fresh chicken and the balanced sweet, sour, and slightly spicy flavors. It makes for a very appealing meal. Treat your family to this delicious dish!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients: wash the cilantro, peel the shallots and garlic, and slice the ginger.
Step 2: Place all ingredients (except the chicken) and spices into a blender and process until smooth.
Step 3: Marinate the chicken with the blended mixture for about 20 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Step 4: Next, steam the chicken for about 15 minutes, or microwave for 2 minutes, then drain well.
Step 5: Finally, fry the chicken until golden brown and it's finished.

mon_an.mo_ta: Learn how to make quick cucumber kimchi—extremely fast and delicious for family dinners. This sour, spicy, and colorful kimchi helps balance heavy meals and warms the heart on cold days. Let's get started!
cac_buoc: Wash the cucumbers, soak in diluted salt water, then drain. Trim the ends, rub the cut ends to remove bitterness, and discard the tips. Cut the cucumbers in half, then into quarters.
Peel and shred the carrot. Peel and thinly slice the onion. Wash the chives and cut into lengths equal to the cucumbers.
Mix all the sauce ingredients together in a small bowl.
Pour the sauce over the vegetables in a large bowl and toss well using gloves to ensure even coating. Let it sit for about 15 minutes to marinate before serving.
Here is the finished dish. It looks delicious already!
To choose the best vegetables for cucumber kimchi, refer to tips on selecting fresh produce.

mon_an.mo_ta: With this simple recipe, you can easily make delicious ginger-sautéed salted plums (ô mai) to snack on during the Lunar New Year.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the plums

Prepare lime water for soaking. Mix slaked lime with water at a ratio of 5g lime per 1L water. Let it settle, pour off the clear liquid, then add more water to the sediment and repeat until you have enough liquid. For 1kg of plums, you need about 2-3 liters.
Wash the plums and score them around the circumference so the sugar absorbs better. Soak them in the lime water for 8-10 hours.
To save time, you can prepare the lime water and soak the plums overnight.
Step 2: Marinate the plums
Remove the plums from the lime water, rinse thoroughly to remove the lime smell, and drain in a colander. Place them in a pot and toss with sugar for 6-8 hours.
After 6-8 hours, the plums will release juice and the sugar will dissolve. Add 1/2 of the ginger (washed and minced or crushed) to the plums, mix well, and let sit for 15-20 minutes.
I usually marinate the plums directly in the pot I will use for cooking to save on washing up.
Step 3: Sautéing the plums

Turn on the heat and bring the pot to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce to the lowest setting and simmer until the plums firm up and the syrup becomes thick and tacky. Add the remaining 1/2 of the minced ginger, stir well, and cook for another 5 minutes.
Step 4: Drying

Once sautéed, spread the plums on a wide tray to air dry or oven dry. If air drying, cover with a mesh food cover to keep flies away. Drying in the sun is best; otherwise, dry at room temperature. If using an oven, dry at 100°C for 1-1.5 hours, ensuring the convection fan is on to let moisture escape.
With this simple method, you have delicious ginger-sautéed plums to enjoy during Tet. Store them in glass jars in the refrigerator for long-term use.
Additionally, you can try recipes for ginger-sautéed starfruit or ginger jam!

mon_an.mo_ta: Let's make Ocean Margarita jelly with the flavor of tequila and an eye-catching ocean blue color to cool down.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Squeeze the lime juice into a pot, add sugar and water, and stir until dissolved. Then add the gelatin and soak for about 5 minutes.
Step 2: Place on the stove and cook over low heat, stirring constantly until the gelatin is completely dissolved, then turn off the heat.

Step 3: Add the tequila and blue curacao, stir well, and pour into molds. Let it cool, then refrigerate until the jelly sets before removing from the molds. Cut into bite-sized pieces and sprinkle with granulated sugar or roll them in sugar to complete your Ocean Margarita jelly.

Enjoy your finished Ocean Margarita jelly. With less than 15 minutes of preparation and processing, and an extremely easy method, you have cool, sweet, and sour jelly pieces with a fragrant tequila aroma. What are you waiting for? ^^
Since this jelly contains tequila and blue curacao, please note that it should not be served to young children.
A few tips for the perfect Ocean Margarita jelly:

You can choose to sprinkle sugar on top, dip each jelly cube into a prepared plate of sugar, or sprinkle sugar after cutting. Note that you should cut the jelly first before adding sugar. If you sprinkle sugar before cutting, the sugar may follow the knife blade down, making the surface of the jelly less smooth and beautiful.

Gelatin sheets can be replaced with gelatin powder or agar-agar powder. Note that each type of powder or gelatin has a different preparation formula (e.g., how many grams of powder/gelatin to mix with how much water), so you should adjust the amount of ingredients accordingly.
With gelatin as a basic ingredient, you can also refer to recipes for coconut jelly, rainbow jelly, and fruit jelly.

mon_an.mo_ta: Instructions on how to make a delicious mixed vegetable salad with a diverse combination of vegetables and bright colors. This salad is not only tasty but also visually appealing, making it a perfect choice for healthy and nutritious meals. Let's learn how to make this vibrant and delicious mixed vegetable salad according to the recipe.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Make the dressing
Mince or grate the garlic. Mix all the dressing ingredients in a bowl, taste, and adjust the seasonings if necessary.
Step 2: Prepare the vegetables
Finely shred the white and purple cabbage, then wash them. Peel and wash the carrot, then finely chop or use a julienne peeler. Wash the bell pepper and cut into strips.

Melt the butter in a pan, then add the crushed instant noodles, chopped cashews, and sesame seeds. Stir until the mixture turns light golden brown, then turn off the heat. This will take about 4-5 minutes. Let the mixture cool slightly before adding it to the salad.
Step 3: Mix the salad
Place all ingredients in a bowl, add the dressing and lime juice if desired, then toss well to complete your delicious salad.
Notes for making mixed vegetable salad
Choose fresh ingredients: Select fresh vegetables and tubers with no signs of spoilage. Ensure all ingredients are thoroughly washed and sanitized before use.
Uniform cutting size: Cut the vegetable components into small pieces or thin shreds to create consistency and make it easier to eat. This also helps balance the flavor and quality of the salad.

Flavor notes: When making the dressing, consider the correct ratio of fish sauce, sugar, lime, and other ingredients to create a balanced and attractive flavor. Taste and adjust according to your own preference.

Mix thoroughly: When tossing the salad, ensure the vegetables and dressing are well combined. Use chopsticks or a spoon to toss gently from bottom to top to avoid breaking or crushing the ingredients.

Storage time: The salad is best enjoyed immediately after mixing. If you need to store it for a short time, cover it tightly and keep it in the refrigerator. However, note that vegetables may lose their freshness and crunch after a long period.

mon_an.mo_ta: Yogurt is a favorite snack for many people. From yogurt, we can prepare many dishes such as fruit yogurt, passion fruit yogurt, coffee yogurt, cocoa yogurt, yogurt ice cream... Today, we would like to introduce you to a recipe for making delicious yogurt from fresh milk.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Sterilize the jars. Boil water and submerge the cleaned yogurt jars to sterilize them (only for glass/heat-resistant jars). Alternatively, you can rinse the cleaned jars with boiling water to kill bacteria. Step 2: Put the condensed milk and fresh milk into a pot, heat over low heat until the milk is warm, stirring constantly to dissolve the condensed milk. When the mixture reaches about 80°C, turn off the heat. Continue stirring for a few minutes to let the mixture cool down to about 40-50°C. Take the starter yogurt out of the fridge to bring it to room temperature, stir with a spoon until smooth, then slowly pour it into the milk mixture. While pouring, stir gently so the starter dissolves and the beneficial bacteria disperse into the yogurt mixture. Step 3: Pour the mixture into the yogurt jars. Let them sit for a moment to cool further. Step 4: Incubate the yogurt. Place the jars in an incubator; you can add hot water to the incubator to maintain heat for fermentation. If there is a rack, you can pour hot water directly into the container; if not, pour water into jugs and place them inside with the yogurt, then seal and incubate for 6-8 hours. If you don't have an incubator, you can use a foam box, a pot, or any container and wrap it tightly with towels for 6-8 hours. After 6-8 hours, the yogurt is fully fermented; take the jars out and store them in the refrigerator.

The finished yogurt should be soft, smooth, and mildly tangy. If made correctly, the yogurt will be soft yet very thick; you can turn the jar upside down and the yogurt will not fall out. Some tips for delicious yogurt:

Using both fresh milk and condensed milk makes the yogurt more fragrant and creamy. If you prefer, you can replace fresh milk with hot water or condensed milk with sugar. When using condensed milk and fresh milk, choose unsweetened fresh milk because the condensed milk is already sweet enough; using sweetened milk will make the yogurt too sweet. Using whole milk will make the yogurt even creamier.
Starter yogurt is a very important ingredient. If buying starter yogurt, choose the plain, unsweetened type. After making yogurt once, you can keep one jar to use as a starter for the next batch.
When eating, you can add fruit, syrup, or any other ingredients to serve with the yogurt.

mon_an.ten: Lotus Seed and Longan Sweet Soup
mon_an.mo_ta: Lotus season is here; let's cook a refreshing, thirst-quenching, and extremely nutritious lotus seed and longan sweet soup according to this recipe.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Sugar - 300g (Use rock sugar; if unavailable, use granulated white sugar)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Simmer the lotus seeds

Choose fresh, even, and plump lotus seeds. Peel, remove the bitter core (embryo), and wash. Place the lotus seeds in a pot of boiling water, then turn the heat to low and simmer until the seeds are soft. Add sugar, stir to dissolve, and cook for another 10 minutes for the seeds to absorb the sweetness. Turn off the heat and add 1/2 of the jasmine flowers to infuse the aroma. Let it cool.
Step 2: Peel the longans

Wash the longans before peeling. Peel the longan skin carefully so the flesh remains intact and does not tear. Use a sharp knife to gently cut a circle around the stem of the seed, avoiding bruising the flesh. Then gently squeeze and push the seed out through the cut. You can use a spoon handle (like the metal ones used for phở) to peel the flesh very quickly and beautifully.
Step 3: Stuff the seeds into the longans

Stuff the cooked lotus seeds into the longan flesh. At this point, the longan flesh wraps around the lotus seed, looking like a freshly peeled, white, round, and beautiful longan. Add the remaining jasmine flowers to the container of stuffed longans, cover tightly, and store in the refrigerator to infuse the fragrance.
Step 4: Presentation

When the lotus seed syrup has cooled, place the stuffed longans into bowls, add ice, and ladle the cooled lotus seed simmering liquid from Step 1 over them. You can garnish with a jasmine flower on top to create a fragrant aroma for the bowl of sweet soup.
Here is the final lotus seed and longan sweet soup.
Some secrets for a delicious sweet soup:

Using Hung Yen longans is best; they have thick flesh, are not too watery, and are crunchy, sweet, and fragrant. Southern longans are too watery and the flesh is soft, not crunchy. Thai longans have thick flesh but are less fragrant than Hung Yen longans.

Fresh lotus seeds are best for this soup. You can buy fresh lotus pods to shell and de-core yourself, or ask the seller to do it to save time. During the season, my family often buys several kilograms of fresh lotus seeds, peels and de-cores them, then freezes them to eat year-round. Frozen lotus seeds still retain their aroma when cooked and are better than buying dried seeds from the market.

The secret to simmering lotus seeds quickly is to put them in while the water is cold, bring to a boil over high heat, then lower the heat to a simmer. Only add sugar after the seeds are soft. Do not add sugar at the beginning or before the seeds are cooked, as they will become hard or waxy and won't soften.

I've seen many online instructions suggesting putting the stuffed longans into boiling sugar water and cooking for 5 minutes. However, I recommend that if you want the longan flesh to stay crunchy and sweet, do not do this. Just putting longans in boiling water makes the flesh soft, so my family usually waits for the liquid to be completely cool before ladling it into the bowl. The longan flesh will remain very crunchy and sweet.

mon_an.ten: Chicken and Baby Corn Soup for Babies
mon_an.mo_ta: Let's try making chicken and baby corn soup according to this recipe. Please take a look!
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients:
Remove fat and skin from the chicken breast, wash it, and mince the garlic and ginger. Peel the onion, wash, and chop finely.
How to cook chicken and baby corn soup:

Heat cooking oil in a pot, then add the chopped onion and cook for 2-3 minutes until the onion starts to become fragrant and turns from white to translucent. Next, add the minced garlic and ginger and stir well. When the mixture is fragrant, add the chicken and sear briefly.

Add broth (chicken broth is recommended for aroma; if unavailable, bone broth can be used instead), bring to a boil, then lower the heat and simmer for about 10 minutes (turn the chicken over while cooking so it cooks evenly).
Remove the chicken to a plate, let it cool, then shred it into bite-sized pieces.

Add baby corn to the broth, bring to a boil, then lower the heat and cook until the corn is soft. Add seasonings (including sugar, salt, pepper, soy sauce, a bit of vinegar, and sesame oil) to taste and stir well.

Separate the egg white and whisk it. Before adding, gently stir the soup in one direction, then slowly pour in the egg white while continuing to stir in the same direction to create beautiful egg ribbons.

Mix 1 tablespoon of tapioca starch with a little water, then slowly pour it into the soup while stirring until thickened. Add the shredded chicken, green onions, and black pepper, stir well, and turn off the heat. You have now finished the chicken and baby corn soup.

Here is the finished dish. The chicken and baby corn soup looks very attractive. This dish can be cooked for babies during weaning or used as an appetizer for a meal. Every time my family eats chicken, the white meat is often left over because no one likes it; this soup, along with shredded chicken salad or cabbage chicken salad, is a great way to use up available ingredients. Give it a try.

mon_an.mo_ta: In the summer, bowls of chilled Chè chuối nước cốt dừa will be a family favorite. This sweet dessert is a harmonious combination of ripe bananas and rich coconut milk, topped with crunchy roasted peanuts.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Use tree-ripened bananas that are firm, not overripe or mushy, and avoid unripe ones as they will taste astringent when cooked. Peel the bananas and cut into bite-sized rounds. Marinate with a pinch of salt and sugar for 15 - 20 minutes. The salt helps the bananas stay firm and enhances the flavor.
Step 2: Roast the peanuts until golden brown, then crush them coarsely.
Step 3: Rinse the tapioca pearls, soak in cold water for about 15 minutes until expanded, then drain in a colander.
Step 4: Pour the coconut milk into a large pot, gradually add the bananas, cover with a lid, and simmer over low heat until the bananas are soft.

Step 5: Add the tapioca pearls to the pot and wait until they float and turn translucent, indicating the dessert is ready. Adjust the sugar to taste and turn off the heat. If serving cold, add a bit more sugar so it doesn't taste bland when ice is added. If serving hot, use less sugar.
When serving, ladle into bowls and sprinkle with roasted peanuts and shredded coconut.

mon_an.mo_ta: A delicious and nutritious dish for this autumn weather that will warm your heart. Check out this recipe for incredibly creamy and delicious baked crab with cheese—one bite and you'll be hooked!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Add olive oil to a pan and sauté the shallots over medium heat.
Step 2:
Mix the sautéed shallots with cream cheese, mayonnaise, sour cream, 100g of Parmesan, dill, and salt.
Step 3:
Fold the crab meat into the mixture from step 2.
Step 4:
Brush the baking tray with butter and spread the crab mixture evenly.
Step 5:
Sprinkle the remaining cheese over the surface of the crab.
Step 6:
Bake in the oven at 425 degrees for 20-30 minutes until the surface turns brown and bubbly.
And there you have it, your creamy baked crab is finished!
A hot bowl of baked crab is perfect for chilly weather!
It tastes absolutely amazing when served with bread!

mon_an.ten: Shrimp and Pomelo Weight Loss Salad
mon_an.mo_ta: Shrimp and pomelo salad provides essential nutrients, improves skin, and supports weight loss for those on a diet. Don't hesitate to make this dish right away!
cac_buoc: It is no surprise that pomelo is always ranked as a top food for skin and fitness. However, eating plain pomelo can get boring, so why not try incorporating it into a daily meal?
Shrimp and pomelo salad is very easy to make!
Step 1:
First, prepare the ingredients as follows:
Separate the pomelo segments.
Wash and peel the shrimp.
Finely chop the chili and cilantro.
Step 2:
Next, bring a pot of water to a boil and cook the shrimp until done.
You can add a pinch of salt to season the shrimp.
Step 3:
Mix the lemon juice, fish sauce, sugar, chili, cilantro, and water together.
Step 4:
Add the pomelo and crushed peanuts, then toss well with the prepared dressing.
Step 5:
After plating the pomelo, place the shrimp on top and sprinkle with fried shallots.

When eating, remember to mix everything well so the shrimp absorbs the dressing! If you are feeling lazy about separating all the pomelo sacs, just break them into bite-sized pieces. You can also use pink pomelo for this salad as it works just as well!

mon_an.mo_ta: Gỏi thập cẩm is a family favorite featuring crunchy vegetables paired with fresh pork, crispy pig ears, and shrimp, all blended with a sweet and sour dressing. Step into the kitchen and show off your skills with this wonderful dish! Discover detailed instructions for making delicious mixed salad at home, from selecting ingredients to plating.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Chili lime fish sauce - a little
Vietnamese coriander, celery, cilantro - a little
Pepper + salt + sugar + MSG - salad dressing mix
cac_buoc: 1. Ingredient Preparation
Pork: After purchasing, wash the meat and bring water to a boil. Add a pinch of salt and boil the meat until cooked. Once done, remove, let cool, and slice thinly.

Shrimp: Wash the shrimp, then add a pinch of salt and dry-sear in a pan. Peel the shrimp, leaving the tails intact. You can also boil them with lemongrass and ginger to enhance the aroma and keep them sweet.

Pig ears: Wash the ears, then soak in warm water with a pinch of salt and 1 tbsp of alum for 15 minutes. Rinse thoroughly to remove any odors. Boil until cooked, then drain and slice thinly. Marinate with ½ cup of vinegar and 1 tbsp of sugar. Squeeze dry before use. Soaking with alum and sugar provides a crunchy texture and a sweet-sour flavor.
Cucumber: Wash, remove the core, and keep the green skin. Shred into thin strips and marinate with 1 tbsp of sugar and vinegar.
Carrot: Peel, wash, and shred thinly. Marinate with 1 tbsp of sugar and vinegar.
Vietnamese coriander: Remove stems and wilted leaves, wash, and chop finely.
Pickled leeks: Wash and shred.
Cilantro: Remove stems and wilted leaves, then wash.
Tomato: Carve into a flower for decoration.
Chili: Wash and shred to mix into the salad. Carve one chili into a flower.
Lime: Squeeze for juice.
Prawn crackers: Fry until lightly white and crispy.
White onion: Peel, wash, and slice thinly crosswise. Soak in vinegar and sugar. Squeeze dry before use.
Shallots: Peel, wash, and slice thinly lengthwise, then fry until golden.
Peanuts: Roast until golden, peel, and crush coarsely.
2. Making the Mixed Salad
Step 1: Mix the ingredients

In a large bowl, combine 1/2 of the pork, 1/2 of the shrimp, 1/2 of the pig ears, lotus rootlets, cucumber, carrot, onion, 1/2 of the fried shallots, celery, pickled leeks, Vietnamese coriander, and the dressing mix. Toss well by hand to ensure everything is combined. Season to taste.
Step 2: Prepare the dipping sauce
The dipping sauce is the highlight of this dish. In a bowl, combine 3 tbsp lime juice, 2 tbsp fish sauce, 3 tbsp sugar, 1/2 tsp MSG, 1/2 tsp salt, and 1 tbsp fried garlic. Stir until well combined.
Step 3: Presentation

Finally, arrange the salad on a plate. Interleave the shrimp, pork, and pig ears, then add cilantro, tomato, and the chili flower for beauty. Drizzle the chili fish sauce over the top and toss lightly before enjoying.
Chili fish sauce mixture: Combine 3 tbsp lime juice + 2 tbsp fish sauce + 3 tbsp sugar + 1/2 tsp MSG + 1/2 tsp salt + 1 tbsp fried garlic. Mix well until the ingredients are fully incorporated.
Next, plate the salad. Arrange the shrimp + pork + pig ears interleaved with cilantro + tomato, chili flower + fried shallots + peanuts.
Finally, drizzle the chili fish sauce over the top, toss gently when eating, and enjoy.

mon_an.ten: Quick-Pickled Figs with Lemongrass and Chili
cac_buoc: Quick-pickled figs are a traditional dish essential for family meals, especially during Tet holidays. If you love this dish and are looking for a way to pickle figs so they stay crunchy without turning dark, check out these secrets below!
I. How to make quick-pickled figs without bitterness
1. Ingredients
1 kg figs
1 galangal root
2 horn chilies
2 garlic bulbs
600 ml fermented vinegar
1 lime
190 ml fish sauce
210 gr sugar
3 tbsp salt
2. Instructions
Wash and soak the figs in diluted salt water for about 20 minutes, then cut into bite-sized thin slices. Soak in a mixture of diluted salt and lime for 20 minutes, then rinse.
Soak the figs in 500ml of fermented vinegar and 1 tbsp of salt for 30 minutes to reduce the astringent taste.
Peel and shred the galangal, mince and slice the garlic, and deseed the horn chilies.
3. Pickling
Boil 190ml fish sauce, 210gr sugar, and 100ml fermented vinegar in a pot. Cover and cook until the sugar dissolves, then let it cool completely.
Place the drained figs into the cooled vinegar-sugar mixture, add the galangal, chili, and garlic. Toss well to absorb the flavors, then transfer to a glass jar.
Note:
To avoid chemical leaching from plastic, use glass jars instead of plastic ones for fermentation.
Before use, sterilize the glass jar by rinsing it thoroughly with boiling water.
If you don't need to store them for long, you don't have to transfer them to a glass jar.
4. Finished Product
When finished, the pickled figs will have a characteristic aroma of garlic, galangal, and fish sauce.
When tasting, the pickled figs offer a full range of crunchy, sour, astringent, salty, sweet, and spicy flavors. They are unbeatable when paired with boiled snails, fried spring rolls, or bánh chưng.
II. Sweet and Sour Quick-Pickled Figs
Sticky figs: 1 kg
Galangal: 1 root
Lemongrass: 3-4 stalks
Garlic: 1 bulb
Seasoning: Sugar, sea salt, chili.
2. Instructions
Step 1: First, choose sticky figs that are still in clusters and uniform in size. After buying, remove the stems and wash. You can leave them whole or slice them as desired.

Step 2: The secret to preventing the figs from turning black is to soak them in diluted salt water with a bit of lime or vinegar for about 30 minutes. Then, rinse them several times until the seeds are gone.

Step 3: Prepare the remaining ingredients. Remove the tough outer layers of the lemongrass, wash, and mince. Wash the galangal, garlic, and chili; use 2/3 of the amount to crush or mince. Slice the remaining 1/3 of the galangal, garlic, and chili to make the dish more attractive.

Step 4: Boil 1 liter of water in a pot. Add 40g salt and 5g sugar, stirring to dissolve. Turn off the heat and wait for the water to cool completely before adding the minced galangal, garlic, and chili.

Step 5: To finish, prepare a clean glass jar or container. Layer the prepared galangal, garlic, and chili with the figs, then pour in the cooled brine. Place a small plate on top to weigh down the figs, ensuring they stay submerged and absorb the flavors evenly.
After about 2-3 days, you can enjoy the spicy, sweet, and sour pickled figs, which are golden, crunchy, and free of bitterness or discoloration.
III. Benefits of eating figs and storage tips
Figs contain calcium which supports those with dairy allergies and prevents osteoporosis. The fiber in figs aids digestion and reduces intestinal irritation.
Potassium, omega-3, and omega-6 in figs help maintain blood pressure and are good for cardiovascular health. Tryptophan supports sleep and helps eliminate sleep disorders.

To store pickled figs, keep them in the refrigerator after preparation to keep them crunchy and fragrant. The maximum storage time is 1 week for health safety. To prevent the figs from darkening while soaking, you can place them in a plastic bag under the water level.
IV. How to choose good figs
When buying figs, choose sticky figs still on the cluster with fresh stems and uniform size.
If the figs are separated, choose those with a bright green color, round shape, concave navel, and a pinkish interior, which indicates they are fresh and delicious.
Avoid figs that are wilted, have black spots, or are bruised, as these are signs they were harvested long ago and are no longer fresh.
For quick-pickling, sticky figs are preferred because they are sweeter, crunchier, and less astringent than common figs.

mon_an.ten: Fun Apple Shapes for Kids' Birthdays
mon_an.mo_ta: Using apples, you can create adorable shapes to decorate your child's birthday party, making it even more special. The kids will surely love them. Check out these fun apple shaping ideas for your child's birthday.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
You can cut the apple in half or leave it whole, then use a pen to draw the bear's eyes and mouth.
Next, peel off the outer skin except for the eyes and mouth areas. Cut small apple slices of moderate thickness, then carve out the bear's legs, arms, and ears (as shown in the picture).
Step 2:
Use black olives or black grapes to attach to the pupils and nose to make the bear stand out.
Use toothpicks to pin the parts together.
You can make these to decorate fruit platters for children's birthdays.

mon_an.ten: Refreshing Malva Nut Gum and Basil Seed Drink
mon_an.mo_ta: Malva nut gum with basil seeds is a popular Southern Vietnamese refreshment known for its cooling properties, making it excellent for heat relief and treating constipation. Nothing beats a glass of this for cooling down. Discover how to make delicious and cool malva nut gum with basil seeds at home with these detailed instructions. Experience the fresh taste of basil seeds and how to combine them into an exciting drink. Enjoy the refreshing and satisfying feeling of homemade, energy-filled malva nut gum and basil seeds.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Pour the palmyra fruit into a bowl. If you cannot find canned palmyra fruit, you can use water boiled with rock sugar to serve with the malva nut gum and basil seeds.
Step 2: Rinse the basil seeds to clean them, then soak in cold water for about 10 minutes until they expand. Pour into a mesh strainer to drain.
Step 3: Soak the malva nut gum for 10 - 12 hours until fully expanded, then shake off any dirt or sand. Rinse again thoroughly, keeping only the expanded gum.
Step 4: When serving, place the malva nut gum and basil seeds in a glass along with shaved ice, syrup, and chopped fresh fruit. Squeeze 1 calamansi over it for fragrance.
Notes for making malva nut gum and basil seeds
Choose quality ingredients: Ensure you select fresh malva nut gum that is not spoiled and has no unpleasant odor. Pandan leaves should also be washed and fresh, showing no signs of damage.
Soak the gum for the correct time: Soaking malva nut gum in water overnight helps it absorb water better and creates a richer flavor.

Boil the gum water correctly: When boiling the water, cover the lid and simmer on low heat so the water doesn't evaporate too quickly. Let the water boil for a while before turning off the heat, and let the temperature drop slightly before proceeding to the next steps.
Correct amount of sugar and salt: Add the right amount of rock sugar and salt to the malva nut gum water to create a balanced flavor. Adjust the sugar according to your taste.

Combine with basil seeds: Basil seeds are nutritious and add thickness to the drink. Add basil seeds to the water after it has boiled and soak for another 2 minutes so the seeds expand and form a gel.
Keep the gum in clean conditions: After making the drink, store it in a sealed bottle in the refrigerator. Ensure the bottle and all tools used are clean to avoid bacteria and contamination.
Use within a short time: The drink is freshest when used within 2-3 days of making. Avoid keeping it longer than this to ensure the best quality and flavor.
How to choose fresh ingredients
Choose fresh malva nut gum: Select newly harvested gum that comes in pinkish-white strands. Avoid gum that has been stored too long, as it may have an unsuitable sour smell.
Consider the shape and structure: Malva nut gum that is opaque white and formed into round lumps is usually very hard. These require a longer soaking time to expand. Consider this when purchasing.

Soak before use: Before using, soak the gum in warm water. The ratio should be 1 liter of water to 1 tablespoon of gum. Ensure you don't use too little water, as the gum may not expand fully and could cause intestinal obstruction when consumed.

Use correctly and in moderation: Malva nut gum is a healthy food but must be used correctly and in the right dosage. Follow the instructions and only use the recommended amount to avoid negative effects on the body.

mon_an.mo_ta: Dried beef salad is a street food snack that you can never get tired of. However, with just a little time, you can make it at home to enjoy with everyone.
cac_buoc: Ingredients to prepare:
Step 1:
Pick the herbs, removing the roots and old stems. Wash thoroughly, soak in diluted salt water for about 10 minutes, then shake off the water and let drain.
Step 2:

Peel the papaya and carrot, wash, and shred into strips. Mix with 2 teaspoons of salt and squeeze firmly to drain all water. This method helps the papaya and carrot stay crunchy and maintain a beautiful color.
Step 3:
Peel and mince the garlic. Finely slice the chili.
Step 4:
Mix the sweet and sour dressing: 3 tsp vinegar, 2 tsp sugar, 1 tsp fish sauce, and 1 tsp filtered water, plus the garlic and chili (this ratio can be adjusted to taste).
Step 5:
Roast the peanuts until cooked.
Step 6:
Remove the skins and crush the peanuts slightly or split them in half (do not crush them too finely).
Step 7:
Shred the dried beef into small strips.
Step 8:
Toss the papaya, carrot, dried beef, and herbs together with the dressing. Sprinkle peanuts on top, and your dried beef salad is finished.
To keep the salad delicious, you should prepare all ingredients beforehand and only mix them right before eating so the peanuts don't get soggy and the salad maintains its vibrant colors!
With this extremely simple method, you will have a wonderful dried beef salad that is just as good as the shops, while ensuring food safety and hygiene. Good luck and enjoy your meal!

mon_an.ten: Chicken Salad with Onions and Carrots
mon_an.mo_ta: Shredded chicken salad is a wonderful dish, easy to prepare with accessible ingredients, suitable for parties or daily family meals. Discover the instructions for making this delicious chicken salad with onions and carrots in the article below! Explore how to make a great shredded chicken salad with easy-to-find ingredients. A simple yet attractive dish, perfect for parties or families. Create a unique culinary experience with this tasty shredded chicken salad.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Chicken meat - 250g (use chicken breast or the white meat part)
Onion - 1/2 bulb (adjust based on size; if small, use 1 whole bulb)
cac_buoc: 1. Ingredient preparation
First, rub a little salt on the chicken surface for 3-5 minutes, then rinse several times with water to clean.
Wash the carrots, peel, and shred into thin strips.
Peel the onion, cut in half, and slice into thin strips. To reduce the pungency, soak the onion in a bowl of ice water for 10-15 minutes, then drain.
Remove seeds from the horn chili and cut into thin strips. Peel the ginger, wash, and crush.
Wash the Vietnamese coriander and lime leaves and let drain. Crush 4 lime leaves, finely shred the rest, and chop the Vietnamese coriander into sections.
How to prep and deodorize chicken: You can briefly blanch the chicken with crushed papaya leaves for 3-5 minutes to clean the skin. Then, pluck any remaining feathers and rinse thoroughly.
Alternatively, you can blanch the chicken with starfruit leaves using the same method.
To remove odors, use diluted vinegar or lime juice mixed with salt and rub it on the meat surface for a few minutes.
2. Making the dressing
Prepare the salad dressing:
In a bowl, combine 3 tbsp warm filtered water, 2 tbsp sugar, and 1/2 tsp salt. Stir well for about 2 minutes.
Once the sugar dissolves, add 1.5 tbsp lime juice, 1.5 tbsp vinegar, and 3 tbsp fish sauce. Stir well to combine all ingredients into the sauce.
3. Boiling and shredding the chicken
Place a pot on the stove with 500ml water, 1/2 chicken, 20g crushed ginger, and 4 crushed lime leaves. Cover and cook over medium heat for about 15-20 minutes.
When the chicken is cooked, turn off the heat and let it sit in the pot for 5-7 minutes to cool. Then, remove the bones and shred the meat into bite-sized pieces.
4. Roasting peanuts
Roast the peanuts until golden. Wrap them in a towel for a while to loosen the skins, rub off the skins, and crush slightly.
5. Mixing the salad

In a bowl, toss together the chicken, onion, carrot, chopped cilantro, mint, and 1/2 of the crushed peanuts. Pour the dressing from step 2 over it, toss well, and let sit for a moment for the flavors to absorb.
Step 7: Presentation
Transfer the salad to a plate, sprinkle the remaining peanuts and a few cilantro sprigs on top for garnish.

My family usually uses chicken breast for this salad to use up available ingredients (since we don't like plain boiled white meat), but you can use any part of the chicken. Additionally, using the same method but adding simple ingredients like cabbage or cucumber, you can make a chicken and cabbage salad.
This shredded chicken salad can be served as an appetizer for daily meals or a refreshing dish for your Lunar New Year menu alongside pickles, shrimp and pineapple salad, or pickled onions.
Notes for a delicious shredded chicken salad
Choose fresh chicken: Select fresh, high-quality chicken to ensure the salad is tasty and safe.
Prep and boil correctly: Before boiling, prep the chicken by removing feathers and cleaning thoroughly. Boil over medium heat with ginger and lime leaves so the flavors penetrate the meat.
Shred into bite-sized pieces: After boiling, let the chicken cool for a few minutes before shredding. Ensure the meat is tender and bone-free.
Prepare fresh ingredients: Use fresh carrots, onions, horn chilies, Vietnamese coriander, and dressing ingredients.
Ensure balanced flavors: When mixing the dressing, ensure the lime juice, vinegar, fish sauce, and sugar are well-balanced. Stir thoroughly so the sauce coats all ingredients evenly.
Enjoy immediately: The salad is best when eaten right after mixing. Ensure the vegetables are fresh and crisp.
Adjust seasoning to taste: Depending on personal preference, you can adjust the amount of seasoning like salt.
How to choose fresh ingredients
Check the skin: Fresh chicken has a bright yellow, attractive skin without bruises or blood spots on the surface.
Meat color: Choose chicken with bright pinkish-red meat, not too dark. This indicates the meat is fresh and of good quality.
Softness and elasticity: Press the meat with your finger to feel the texture. Fresh chicken will be noticeably soft yet elastic, springing back when pressed.
Avoid slimy meat: Do not buy chicken that feels slimy or greasy. This indicates the chicken is oxidized and no longer fresh.
Avoid water-injected chicken: Be cautious of chicken that looks large but feels too light. This may indicate it has been injected with water to increase weight.

mon_an.ten: Crunchy Water Celery Salad (Nộm Vó Cần)
mon_an.mo_ta: During a visit to a friend's house in Huong Canh – Vinh Phuc, I learned a local specialty called 'nộm vó cần', or simply water celery salad. It features the mild acidity of vinegar, the aroma of garlic and quality fish sauce, the sweetness and fragrance of molasses crackers, and especially the characteristic pungency of water celery. Water celery is rich in fiber which promotes bowel movements and stimulates digestion, making it perfect for balancing nutrition after the Lunar New Year. Additionally, it contains trace elements like iron and zinc, which help enrich the blood and soften blood vessels. Let's check out how to make this crunchy and delicious water celery salad.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Water celery - 1 bunch (choose white-stemmed, thin-stemmed varieties with few leaves for better taste)
Molasses crackers (Bánh đa mật) - As needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Mixing the dressing

For salad dishes, the dressing is the most important step that determines success. The water celery salad dressing consists of quality fish sauce, vinegar, sugar, a bit of lime for fragrance, chopped chili, and minced garlic (if desired). Mix well until it suits your taste.
Step 2: Preparing the water celery

Clean the water celery by removing roots and leaves, cut off the old stems, wash with water, and drain. Then, take a handful of celery and use a sharp knife to cut diagonally into uniform diamond-shaped pieces.
Step 3: Frying the molasses crackers

I'm not sure if other regions produce this type of cracker, but the molasses crackers I asked my friend to buy in Huong Canh have a beautiful amber color, are sprinkled with sesame seeds, and have a mild sweetness with a ginger aroma. It fits the salad perfectly. Dip the crackers in water to soften, then cut into bite-sized strips (you can ask the seller to cut them for you to save this step). Pour oil into a small, deep pan—enough to submerge the crackers—and heat it up. Turn the heat to low, add the crackers, and stir until they are fragrant, crunchy, curled, and turned amber. Remove and drain on paper towels.
Step 4: Frying the pork belly (can be replaced with thinly sliced Vietnamese ham)
Briefly boil the pork belly, julienne it, then pan-fry until golden and crispy on the edges.
Step 5: Roast the peanuts until golden, then wrap in a towel for a while to make peeling easier. Peel and crush the peanuts.
Step 6: Mixing the salad

Place the celery in a large bowl, pour in the dressing, and toss gently with chopsticks so the celery absorbs the flavors without being crushed. Let it sit for 5 minutes, then add the fried pork belly, crushed peanuts, crispy molasses crackers, and chopped cilantro, and toss again. Serve on a plate, garnish with a few cilantro sprigs and a handful of molasses crackers on top or around the plate, and your water celery salad (locally called 'vó cần') is complete.

mon_an.mo_ta: Kimchi-style pickled vegetables – An especially attractive daily dish for kimchi fans. How to make Kimchi-style Pickled Vegetables.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Clean the mud off the lotus root, using a chopstick to push mud out of the small holes. Peel and slice into bite-sized pieces, then soak in cold water.

Step 2: Peel the carrot and use a crinkle cutter to slice into attractive long pieces; do the same with the white radish and kohlrabi. For the cucumber, wash thoroughly and remove the sap from both ends. Cut lengthwise, remove the seeds, and slice into small pieces.
Step 3: Toss the vegetables with salt while preparing the chili mixture for the kimchi-style pickling.
Step 4: To make the chili paste, wash and peel the ginger, then slice it. Wash the chilies, remove seeds and stems, and place in a blender. Add the ginger and blend until the mixture is smooth.

Step 5: Place the vegetables in a bowl, add white vinegar, fish sauce, and sugar. Finally, add the blended chili and ginger mixture and toss well. Remember to wear gloves so the fish sauce smell doesn't stick to your hands and to ensure hygiene. Keep the dish in a dark place for 1-2 days before it's ready to eat.
Source: Kenh14

mon_an.mo_ta: Enoki Mushroom Salad – This is a low-oil, high-fiber dish that is very good for health. Refer to our method for this dish in the article below. We hope this article helps you easily make a delicious meal. Enjoy! Learn how to cook a delicious Enoki Mushroom Salad.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Trim the roots of the enoki mushrooms, wash, and soak in diluted salt water for about 15 minutes to make them cleaner and crunchier. During soaking, you can separate the mushroom strands. Boil a small amount of water, add the mushrooms and cook for 2 minutes, then remove and drain.

Step 2: Wash the tomato and cut into wedges. Soak the wood ear mushroom in hot water until expanded, then wash, remove the stem, and julienne to mix with the enoki salad. To make the dish more nutritious, you can add other vegetables like carrots or greens.

Step 3: Place the enoki mushrooms, wood ear mushrooms, and tomatoes in a large bowl. Season with 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp vinegar, and 1 tsp sugar, then toss thoroughly. Let sit for 15 minutes to absorb the flavors. When serving, scoop onto a small plate and garnish with a few herb sprigs.

mon_an.mo_ta: Fresh Sprout Salad – An easy-to-make, fresh dish served as an appetizer for a simple, high-fiber dinner. A simple appetizer: Fresh Sprout Salad.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Cooking oil, salt, garlic, black pepper
cac_buoc: Step 1: Preparing the beef:
Wash the beef, slice into bite-sized pieces, and marinate with garlic, oil, and salt for 15 minutes.
Heat oil in a pan, sauté some garlic until fragrant, then add the beef and stir-fry until cooked. Transfer to a small bowl and sprinkle with a little black pepper for aroma.
Step 2: Pick the lettuce leaves, removing any damaged ones, wash with water, and soak in diluted salt water for 15 minutes. Drain well. Boil the eggs until hard-cooked, peel, and cut in half.

Step 3: To make this easy dish, sprouts are essential. Trim the roots of the sprouts, wash, and soak in diluted salt water if store-bought; if home-grown, no salt soak is needed. Place in a basket to drain completely.
Step 4: Mix the sweet and sour dressing using the ratio: 1 fish sauce : 1 sugar : 1 vinegar : 3 filtered water : 2 olive oil. You can add chili or adjust the seasoning to your family's preference.

Step 5: Arrange the curly lettuce on a plate, top with eggs, beef, and sprouts, then drizzle the dressing over it. You can also use mayonnaise or a vinaigrette as a substitute. Toss the Fresh Sprout Salad well and enjoy.
Source: Ngoi sao

mon_an.mo_ta: This colorful salad is extremely eye-catching and very simple to make.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salad vegetables: Choose vegetables of your choice, ensuring a variety of colors to make the salad vibrant. Today I chose:
Bell peppers - 90g (choose all three colors: green, red, yellow)
Peanuts - As desired, roasted and crushed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the salad ingredients
Wash all vegetables and dice them into small cubes.
Cook the beans, carrots, and bell peppers (green, red, yellow).

Tip: You can par-cook the beans, carrots, and peppers by blanching them in boiling water or, more simply, place them in a sealed container or wrap the plate with plastic wrap and microwave for about 30 seconds at 800-1000W.
Soak the wood ear mushrooms in water until fully expanded. Boil water, blanch the wood ear and other mushrooms (to remove the mushroom odor), then chop finely.
Wash the shrimp, boil until cooked, then peel, devein, and chop small.
Step 2: Arrange the salad
Use two circular molds, one large and one small. Place the small mold inside the large one as shown.
Tip: I use cake pans as molds to arrange the salad.
Arrange the vegetables and fruits in the ring-shaped space between the molds. You can arrange the ingredients however you like to create a harmonious and eye-catching color pattern.
Step 3: Toss the salad
Mix the fish sauce, vinegar, and sweet soy sauce to taste, then drizzle over the surface of the salad...
... Then sprinkle some roasted crushed peanuts on top and lift the molds out to finish.

The colorful salad looks very appealing. The various vegetables and fruits not only create attractive colors but also provide vitamins and fiber for the family. This dish is especially effective for children who are picky about vegetables, as they will be very interested in this colorful meal. Parents can prepare the ingredients and let the kids help place them in the molds and drizzle the dressing; they will really enjoy it.
Tips for the colorful salad:
You can use any ingredients to create colors for the dish. Suggested vegetables and fruits:
Red: red bell peppers, cherry tomatoes;
Orange: Carrots, oranges;
Yellow: yellow bell peppers, potatoes, mangoes;
Green: green bell peppers, peas, cucumbers, broccoli;
Purple: taro, purple cabbage, grapes;
Pink: Shrimp, salmon.
You can replace roasted crushed peanuts with other nuts to suit your taste and ingredients, such as pine nuts, walnuts, or hazelnuts.
Similarly, you can replace shrimp with other proteins like salmon, crab meat, or chicken as desired.
Additionally, you can try the tangy shrimp and pineapple salad which is also very attractive!

mon_an.mo_ta: Shrimp and pineapple salad is a harmonious blend of flavors (mild acidity from vinegar, tomatoes, and pineapple, fragrant onions and mint, a hint of garlic pungency, and a light spicy kick) and colors (green, red, orange, purple...). Let's try making this attractive, vitamin-rich dish. Allergy: Shrimp.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Pineapple - 1 fruit (Choose a large, unbruised pineapple with even eyes. Keep the leaves at the top for a beautiful presentation)
Salad greens - 150g (you can choose any greens to your taste, such as spinach, lettuce, shredded carrots, or shredded purple cabbage)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the pineapple shell serving tray

Wash the pineapple and cut it in half lengthwise. Keep the leaves at the top to make the salad look beautiful later. Use a fruit scoop to create small pineapple spheres, which makes the salad look better. If you don't have a specialized scoop, use a sharp knife to cut along the inside of the shell and remove the flesh. Be careful not to cut through the shell.
Use a spoon to scrape the remaining pineapple inside the shell to create a clean, beautiful pineapple tray.
Step 2: Prepare the greens and shrimp for the salad.
Cut the pineapple flesh into bite-sized pieces. If you used a scoop in step 1, you already have spheres and can skip this.
Wash the salad greens; depending on the ingredient, shred or cut into bite-sized pieces. Wash and halve the cherry tomatoes. Wash and finely chop the green onions and mint.
Place all ingredients into a bowl and add the prepared pineapple.
Wash the shrimp, peel, and devein. Boil water, cook the shrimp until just done, then remove and drain.
Step 3: Mixing the salad

Before eating, add the dressing ingredients (olive oil, salt, vinegar, pepper, chili, and minced garlic) to the bowl of greens and shrimp from step 2. Toss well and adjust the seasoning to your taste.
If you're not used to it, you can mix the dressing in a separate bowl first, taste it, and then pour it over the salad when ready to eat.
Step 4: Presentation
Place the salad into the pineapple shell prepared in step 1, arrange the shrimp on top, and your attractive Shrimp and Pineapple Salad is complete.

In less than 15 minutes, you have finished a delicious Shrimp and Pineapple Salad. This dish is truly a symphony of colors and flavors. You can serve it as an appetizer at a party, a refreshing dish for the Lunar New Year, or even a meal to cool down during the bright summer sun.

mon_an.mo_ta: Egg Salad - This is a delicious, simple, and nutritious salad that provides plenty of fiber for heart health. Check out the recipe below!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Hard-boil the eggs and peel them. Wash the vegetables, peel, and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Step 2: For the dressing, you can use oil and vinegar or peanut butter; both are delicious. If you prefer a creamy egg salad, use mayonnaise.
Step 3: Toss the eggs and vegetables with the dressing, and your delicious dish is ready!

mon_an.mo_ta: Strawberry smoothies are an excellent refreshing drink for the summer. Strawberries offer many health benefits, such as boosting the immune system, protecting the eyes, fighting cancer, and managing weight. Drinking a strawberry smoothie daily will help you maintain a strong immune system, a fit body, and beautiful skin!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Strawberry, strawberry-banana, or vanilla ice cream (optional) - 1/2 tsp
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, pour the orange juice into the blender, or you can use juice made from crushed oranges. The orange juice adds a tartness that blends perfectly with the sweetness of the strawberries.
Step 2: Add strawberries

Next, you can use fresh or frozen strawberries; using frozen ones means you won't need as much ice later. If using fresh strawberries, wash them thoroughly and remove the green hulls before adding them to the blender.
Step 3: Add yogurt
Then, add the yogurt to make the smoothie creamy and highlight the strawberry flavor. You can also add ice cream or strawberry syrup if desired.
Step 4: Add ice
After adding the yogurt, add the ice. If you used frozen strawberries in Step 2, you can reduce the amount of ice to 1/2 cup.
Step 5: Blend

Blend the mixture for about 5 seconds, stop, and then blend again. Repeat until the ingredients are smooth and well combined. During the process, you can use a spoon to push down any strawberries or ice that get stuck.
Listen to the sound of the blender: if it's very noisy, continue blending until the sound softens. Give it one final stir with a spoon to ensure everything is completely mixed.
Step 6: Add milk
You can add the milk at the end or mix it directly with the orange juice earlier. Use non-fat (2% milk) or whole milk to make the smoothie creamier.
Step 7: Enjoy
Pour the smoothie into a glass and enjoy.
