mon_an.mo_ta: How to cook a smooth, creamy, and delicious potato soup with very simple ingredients.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Cajun seasoning - To taste (available at many online spice shops)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Cut the bacon into small pieces.
Peel, wash, and dice the onion.
Trim the roots and wash the celery; slice the stalks lengthwise if they are large, then chop finely.
Peel, wash, and finely chop the carrots.
Peel, wash, and dice the potatoes into small cubes.
Step 2: Cook the potato soup
Place a pot over medium heat and add the chopped bacon.
Stir well until the fat is rendered and the bacon becomes crispy.
...Then remove to a plate and set aside.
Drain most of the fat into a bowl, then add the diced onion, leeks, and carrots to the pot.
Sauté the vegetables for about 5 minutes, then add the diced potatoes and stir well.
Season with salt...
...and pepper.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat and simmer for about 10 minutes until the potatoes and other ingredients begin to soften.
While simmering, mix the starch with milk until you have a smooth mixture.
Slowly pour this into the pot, stirring constantly, and cook for about 5 minutes until the soup thickens.
After 5 minutes, the soup should be thickened and the vegetables soft.
Lower the heat to low. Ladle about 2/3 of the soup into a blender and blend until smooth and consistent...
...Then pour the blended mixture back into the pot.
Add 1/4 to 1/2 cup of heavy cream (adjust to preference) to the pot.
Stir gently (keep the heat low) for about 2 minutes, tasting and adjusting the seasoning. You can add a bit more pepper to enhance the flavor.
Add a bit of Cajun seasoning if desired for extra flavor.
Wash and finely chop the parsley.
Add it to the pot and stir well.
Grate the cheese...
Then sprinkle it over the bowl of potato soup...
Top with the crispy bacon prepared earlier, and your delicious potato soup is ready.
This potato soup can be served as an appetizer or as a delicious breakfast with bread for the whole family.
Tips for a great potato soup:
Note that you should use slightly more salt than usual because potatoes absorb a lot of salt (a common tip to fix over-salted food is adding a potato). Otherwise, the dish may taste bland.
I prefer using chicken broth, but you can use any broth you like (beef or pork).

To make chicken broth, simmer chicken bones in cold water using a pressure cooker without seasoning. Add appropriate aromatics (e.g., onion for pork broth, ginger for chicken or beef), but use them sparingly so they don't overpower the soup's aroma. You can make broth in advance and store it in containers or bottles in the freezer to save time.
With potatoes as a main ingredient, you can also try making a potato omelet—a unique, delicious, and nutritious dinner option.

mon_an.mo_ta: Instructions on how to make refreshing rainbow agar-agar jelly to quench your thirst on hot days. A great addition to your dessert menu.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Sugar - 200g (adjust to taste; if using fruit syrups, reduce the sugar as they are already sweet)
White liquor - To taste (use vodka or rum)
Yogurt - 2 tubs (can be replaced with coconut milk)
Food coloring or fruit syrups - Choose vibrant rainbow colors
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Soak the agar-agar powder in water for about 15 minutes to allow it to hydrate and bloom.
Step 2: Add sugar and stir well.
Step 3: Cook the jelly and pour into molds
We will create layers of different colors for the rainbow effect, starting with purple.

Take about 1/12 of the agar and sugar mixture, bring to a boil, and stir until the powder is completely dissolved and the liquid is clear and smooth. Add grape syrup for color and about 2 tbsp of vodka or rum. The liquor helps the jelly stay clear and fragrant. If you don't have grape syrup, use food coloring, adding it slowly until you reach the desired shade. Pour the mixture into the mold and place it in the refrigerator until the surface is set. Do not let it get too hard, or the layers won't stick together; however, if it's too soft, the layers will bleed. It should be slightly tacky to the touch, which usually takes 15-20 minutes. Once the jelly reaches the right firmness, it's time for the second layer.

Repeat the process for the second layer: take another 1/12 of the mixture, boil until dissolved, then add yogurt or coconut milk and turn off the heat. Let it cool slightly before pouring it over the first layer. This yogurt layer acts as a transition to help the colors blend beautifully.
Repeat this process until all colored layers are finished (each color consists of two parts: a colored layer and a yogurt layer). Place the mold in the refrigerator to let the jelly set completely.
Step 4: Unmold the jelly
When ready to eat, gently remove the jelly from the mold and place it on a plate to enjoy your eye-catching rainbow jelly.
Tips for delicious rainbow jelly:

Using food coloring is the simplest way, but I prefer natural ingredients like fruit syrups or juices (syrups result in clearer jelly). Suggested natural colors: Red (strawberry, cherry); Orange (orange); Yellow (lemon or pineapple); Green (kiwi, avocado); Blue (blueberry); Purple (grape).
The yogurt or coconut milk layer in between creates a smooth transition between colors, just like a real rainbow.

Monitor the firmness carefully before pouring the next layer. If it's too hard, layers will separate; if it's not set enough, colors will mix. Also, ensure the new mixture has cooled slightly before pouring it into the mold.
Adding white liquor (vodka, rum, or cooking wine) helps the jelly stay clear and prevents cloudiness.

I usually leave the jelly in the fridge for at least half a day so the layers bond into a solid block. If it's hard to unmold, dip the mold briefly in warm water (just warm, not hot) to slightly melt the outer edge for easier release.
If you don't have a large mold, you can pour the layers into cups or a tray and cut them into bite-sized pieces.
You can also try making fruit jelly, coconut jelly, or three-layer jelly (perfect for Christmas).

mon_an.mo_ta: Let's make sweet and refreshing fruit agar-agar jelly for hot days.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonal fruits - Choose any favorites, such as:
cac_buoc: Step 1: Make the jelly
Stir the agar-agar powder into water and soak for about 15 minutes. Depending on the brand, the amount and soaking time may vary, so check the package instructions.
After 15 minutes, add sugar and stir until it reaches your desired sweetness.

Place the mixture on the stove, bring to a boil, and stir until the agar powder is completely dissolved and the liquid is clear. Turn off the heat, add the milk, and stir well. I enjoy almond jelly with fruit, so I use almond milk and a bit of almond extract here. You can use regular fresh milk, fruit-flavored milk, or chocolate milk instead.
As mentioned, add a little almond extract (if liked) to enhance the aroma.
Pour the mixture into a mold and let it cool and set. You can put it in the fridge to speed up the process.
Tip: I use a flower-shaped mold for a beautiful presentation.
Step 2: Prepare the fruits

Wash, peel, and pit the fruits (if necessary). If they are large, cut them into bite-sized pieces. I used grapes, lychee, raspberries, pear, kiwi, orange, and pink grapefruit. You can vary the fruits based on the season and preference.
Place the fruits in a bowl and mix well...
...Then drizzle with a little fruit syrup.
Step 3: Presentation and serving

Once the jelly is completely set, gently run a knife around the edge of the mold and flip the jelly onto a deep plate. Arrange the fruits around it beautifully. You can drizzle more syrup or fruit juice on top if desired.
Tips for delicious and beautiful fruit jelly:
You can use fresh milk, fruit milk, or soy milk (omit almond extract if you don't like the flavor). You can also use cocoa powder or chocolate to make chocolate jelly.
Vary the fruits by season. For the best look, choose fresh fruits with diverse colors.
If you don't have a flower mold, a regular rectangular mold or a food container works fine. Once set, cut the jelly into small bite-sized cubes...
...Then mix with the fruits for a lovely presentation.
Another great tip: you can use silicone or plastic ice cube trays as molds. I have trays shaped like flowers, stars, and animals that work perfectly for making jelly.
To serve, simply pop the jelly out, mix with chopped fruit, and drizzle with your favorite fruit juice.
Additionally, you can try recipes for coconut jelly or three-color jelly, which are also very delicious and attractive.

mon_an.ten: Strawberry Santa Claus Decorations for Christmas
mon_an.mo_ta: As Christmas approaches, nothing is more wonderful than decorating your home to create a warm and joyful atmosphere. One fun decorating idea you can try is making Santa Claus figures out of strawberries. The image of Santa with his red coat, white beard, and a gift bag on his back always evokes the joy of the holiday season. Let's learn how to decorate Strawberry Santas! This is a unique idea to bring a festive spirit to your Christmas. Explore this decoration idea to bring joy and warmth to your holiday!
cac_buoc: Select strawberries that are uniform in size, ripe red, and not bruised. Wash them thoroughly and place in a basket to drain.

Use a sharp knife to trim the stem end flat so the strawberry can stand upright, then cut horizontally about 1/3 of the way down from the pointed end. The tip will be used as Santa's hat, and the larger base will be the body.
Next, prepare the cream filling for decoration.
If using whipped cream: place the cream in the freezer for about 5 minutes, then pour into a bowl, add sugar to taste, and use a hand mixer to beat until stiff peaks form.
If using buttercream: let the butter soften at room temperature, beat until smooth, then add condensed milk to taste and use a hand mixer to beat until fluffy.

Place the cream on top of the 2/3 strawberry base. You can use a spoon to spread it, but for a better look, use a piping bag with a star tip. Method: insert the star tip into a piping bag or a clean plastic bag with a small hole cut at the tip, fill with cream, and pipe onto the desired position.
Place the remaining 1/3 strawberry tip on top. Pipe small dots of cream to decorate the hat tip and buttons as shown in the image.
Melt the chocolate and put it into a piping bag (similar to the method above) with a small round tip to draw Santa's eyes and mouth.
Notes when making Strawberry Santa Claus decorations for Christmas:
Choose fresh strawberries: Select ripe, firm berries without damage or cracks. This ensures your Santas look fresh and attractive.
Hygiene process: Before starting, ensure the strawberries and decorating tools are washed clean. This ensures food safety and prevents the spread of bacteria.
Arrange carefully: When inserting bamboo skewers or sticks into the strawberries, do it gently and precisely to avoid damaging or dropping the fruit.
Use safe accessories: If using accessories like bamboo skewers, ensure they are cleaned and have no sharp splinters. This helps avoid unwanted accidents, especially when children are involved.
Adjust size: When making strawberry Santas, consider the size of each decorative part. Ensure they are proportionate to the size of the strawberry for a balanced and harmonious look.

Ensure food safety: If you intend to eat the decorations, ensure the strawberries are washed and free from any additives. Also, pay attention to storage time and temperature to ensure food safety for everyone.

mon_an.mo_ta: Balut with tamarind sauce features a rich sweet and sour flavor and the fragrant aroma of laksa leaves; just looking at it is enough to make you crave it. Sipping on this dish during winter is... simply wonderful! Let's learn how to make it!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Other seasonings: chili sauce, garlic, oil, sugar, fish sauce, MSG - as needed
cac_buoc: Wash the balut eggs thoroughly, then boil them in a pot with a little salt. Once cooked, remove and soak in a bowl of clean water to cool. Peel the eggs and let them drain.

Once the eggs are dry, take 1/2 cup of breadcrumbs, quickly roll the eggs in the crumbs, then flash-fry them in oil. Use high heat so the eggs don't become tough, and fry very quickly just to lightly sear the outer layer. Frying with breadcrumbs keeps the egg intact (preventing the yolk and embryo from separating) and allows the crumbs to naturally thicken the tamarind sauce later without needing extra starch. Once fried, remove to a plate lined with paper towels to drain excess oil.

Peel the sour tamarind and place it in a bowl. Pour in boiling water and wait 10 minutes for the pulp to soften. Mash the tamarind to extract the juice, then strain through a sieve and discard the solids.
Place a pan on the stove and sauté the minced garlic. When the garlic is golden, add the chili sauce and stir well until combined into a beautiful red color.

Pour the tamarind juice into the pan, then season with 1 tbsp sugar and 2 tbsp fish sauce. When the tamarind sauce boils, add the balut eggs. Gently turn them over so they absorb the seasoning until the sauce thickens and becomes syrupy, then turn off the heat.
Arrange on a plate, sprinkle with crushed peanuts, and enjoy your Balut with Tamarind Sauce!

mon_an.mo_ta: This lettuce salad with a mild sweet and sour vinaigrette is very easy to eat. Not only is it delicious, but it's also a lifesaver for those looking to lose weight. If you love vegetables, especially salads, refer to the recipe below. This guide provides simple steps and easy-to-find ingredients. You can easily make this salad at home for family meals or light parties.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Wash the lettuce thoroughly and drain.
Step 2:
Wash the tomatoes, drain, and slice into 0.5 cm thin rounds. Slice the onion lengthwise into 0.5 cm thick pieces.
Soak the onion and bean sprouts in vinegar. Boil the egg until hard-cooked, then cut into six wedges. Halve the cucumber and slice diagonally.
Mince the garlic and chili, then soak them in vinegar. 15 minutes before serving, arrange the lettuce on a plate.

Mix the onion and bean sprouts with sugar, salt, garlic, chili, vinegar, and olive oil, then place them on top of the lettuce. Arrange tomatoes and boiled eggs around the edges. Drizzle the vinaigrette (oil, vinegar, garlic, chili, salt) over the lettuce.
Requirements:

Ingredients should not be crushed; oil and vinegar should be evenly absorbed, maintaining the natural crunch of the ingredients. It should be fragrant with garlic, with a balanced sweet, sour, spicy, and salty taste.
How to buy fresh ingredients:
How to buy fresh lettuce:
You can choose any type of lettuce you like, such as Carol, butterhead, or romaine, for this dish.
When buying lettuce, choose heads with vibrant green leaves that feel firm when squeezed, have a light fragrance, and have long, thick stems.
Additionally, clean lettuce (pesticide-free) usually has green outer leaves and inner layers that turn pale green to white.
Avoid buying lettuce with wilted leaves, stems that are turning yellow, or those that emit a slight foul odor. these are signs the lettuce has been stored too long or is decomposing.
How to buy fresh tomatoes:
Choose tomatoes with bright red, even skin that is smooth and juicy. They should feel firm in your hand.
Freshly picked tomatoes will have stems that are still green and firmly attached. Naturally ripened tomatoes have a subtle, pleasant fragrance.
Avoid tomatoes that have a pungent smell or no smell at all, or those with wrinkled skin. These are often signs of forced ripening and won't taste as good as fresh ones.
See also: Guide on how to make boiled egg salad.

mon_an.mo_ta: Whether you are a wise homemaker or simply a cooking enthusiast, you surely want to know small but incredibly effective tips to make kitchen work simpler. Today, we will solve this for you with 10 essential kitchen tips to help you cook better.
cac_buoc: 1. Tips for cooking porridge:

When cooking porridge, you should soak the rice for 1 hour beforehand, then rinse it clean. Add a small handful of glutinous rice to cook along with it. When the pot starts to boil, add a tablespoon of cooking oil to prevent it from overflowing and to enhance the flavor.
2. Tips for boiling pasta:

Pasta is a favorite for many. To boil it perfectly, wait until the water starts to simmer with small bubbles, then add the pasta and stir so it is fully submerged. Add 1 tbsp of olive oil and stir. Cover the lid until the water boils, then add a little cold water. Bring it back to a boil, remove from heat, drain, and rinse with cold water.
3. Tips for seasoning with salt:

For dishes containing root vegetables, add salt earlier so it can penetrate the vegetables. For boiled greens, you should only add salt just before removing the pot from the heat to prevent nutrient loss.
4. Tips for using soy sauce:
Soy sauce contains sugar, so if added too early, the sugar can break down and create a sour or bitter taste. Therefore, soy sauce should only be added just before taking the dish off the stove.
5. Seasoning with MSG:

Using too much MSG can be harmful, so you should only add a small amount when the dish is nearly finished. Additionally, do not add MSG directly; dissolve it in a little stir-fry liquid or broth first before mixing it into the dish.
6. Use extra water when stir-frying:

When stir-frying, vegetables often become dry and lose their nutrients through evaporation. To retain nutrition, when the pan is hot, add 2-3 tbsp of water so the steam can cook the vegetables through without losing the natural juices of the produce.
7. Tips for steaming fish:
When steaming fish, if you rub a little beaten egg over the fish, it will absorb the nutrients from the egg, making the fish meat softer, more fragrant, and more nutritious.
8. How to remove fishy odors:
To thoroughly remove fishy smells, soak the fish in a solution of 1 liter of water mixed with 3 tbsp of white wine and crushed ginger.
9. How to fry without oil splattering:

To prevent oil from splattering, sprinkle a little flour into the pan before adding the meat or fish. If you want fried foods to have a beautiful golden color—especially spring rolls—squeeze a few drops of lemon juice into the oil while heating it.
10. How to use cooking oil and animal fat:

You should use cooking oil for frying or cooking seafood because oil is better at neutralizing fishy odors. When stir-frying vegetables, use animal fat (lard) to give the greens a glossy finish and a better aroma.

mon_an.ten: 9 Effective Ways to Fix Over-Salted Food
mon_an.mo_ta: In daily cooking, accidentally making a soup too salty is very common. So, how do you rescue a salty dish? Check out these 9 quick and effective ways to fix over-salted food in the article below!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Reduce saltiness with an egg white
Add an egg white to the soup and bring it back to a boil.
The egg white will absorb the excess salt, making the soup less salty.
Use a ladle to scoop out the cooked egg white floating on top to keep the broth clear.
Step 2: Reduce saltiness with rice
Put some cooked rice into a clean cloth, tie it tightly, and drop it into the soup pot.
The rice will help absorb the salty taste of the broth.
Step 3: Reduce saltiness with honey
Add a little honey, but do not add too much as it will change the flavor profile and lose the dish's appeal.
Step 4: Reduce saltiness with aromatic vinegar
Adding a small amount of aromatic vinegar will help gradually reduce the saltiness of the dish.
Step 5: Reduce saltiness with sugar
Adding a moderate amount of sugar to the soup will also help mellow out the salt.
Step 6: Reduce saltiness with fresh lemon
Add a little fresh lemon juice to the dish to cut through the saltiness.
Note: Do not add lemon juice to dishes containing dairy products, as the acidity will cause the dairy components to curdle.
Step 7: Reduce saltiness with potato
Potatoes will absorb the excess salt without ruining the flavor of the soup.
Step 8: Reduce saltiness with plain yogurt
For dishes containing dairy like cheese, cream, or rich curries, reduce the saltiness by adding plain yogurt.
Step 9: Reduce saltiness with water
Adding water to soup is the most common method.
However, adding water will dilute the broth and may make it less flavorful.

mon_an.mo_ta: Braised pork belly is a familiar dish that everyone surely knows. But have you ever tasted Braised Pork Belly with Taro? Let's explore this dish together!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Soy sauce, sugar, caramel sauce - As needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Slice the pork into bite-sized pieces. Blanch the pork to clean it, then remove and set aside to drain.
Step 2: Peel the taro, wash thoroughly, and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Step 3: Fry the pork over high heat until golden brown on all sides.
Step 4: Place the pork in a pot, add soy sauce, sugar, caramel sauce, minced shallots, and 2 star anise petals, then pour in enough water to cover the meat.
Step 5: Add the taro to the pot with the pork and simmer over low heat until the liquid has almost evaporated and thickened.
Step 6: Transfer to a bowl and enjoy the Braised Pork Belly with Taro with hot rice.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Delicious Grilled Coconut Honeycomb Cake
mon_an.mo_ta: When mentioning traditional desserts in Vietnamese culinary culture, grilled coconut honeycomb cake is a choice that cannot be missed. With its sweet coconut flavor and soft texture, it has become a favorite for many. Today, we will guide you on how to make delicious and attractive Grilled Coconut Honeycomb Cake using a charcoal stove, Saigon style! Learn how to make this delicious cake right at home. Enjoy the sweet coconut aroma and soft texture of the cake with our simple tips and instructions.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Preparation
To make grilled coconut honeycomb cake, first prepare the oven and preheat it to 160°C. Place the cake mold in the oven to preheat.

In a clean pot, pour the coconut milk, 1/4 cup of water, and sugar. Heat over high heat and stir well with chopsticks until the sugar is completely dissolved and the mixture turns opaque. Turn off the heat and let the mixture cool.

Take a large bowl and crack 6 eggs into it. Use a fork to whisk in one direction until the eggs are combined. Be careful not to over-whisk or beat too hard to avoid creating air bubbles, which affect the cake's texture.
After whisking the eggs, add vanilla and cooking oil and whisk to combine. Then, pour in the coconut milk mixture from the previous step and whisk until dissolved.

In another bowl, mix the tapioca starch and baking powder, then sift until smooth. Add the dry flour mixture to the wet mixture from the previous step and mix well until all ingredients are combined. Perform this action quickly and decisively but do not over-mix to avoid creating air bubbles.
Step 2: Baking the cake

After preheating the mold, take it out and use a brush to apply a layer of cooking oil around the mold. Next, pour the batter into the mold. This method helps the cake rise immediately upon contact with the hot mold, creating the honeycomb texture.

Place the cake in the oven and bake for 35 minutes. When the surface is light golden and a bamboo skewer comes out clean, the cake is done. Let the cake cool completely before removing it and placing it on a wire rack.
With these simple steps, you have created delicious and attractive grilled honeycomb cakes.
Notes for making grilled coconut honeycomb cake
Prepare the mold: Ensure the mold is clean and preheated before pouring the batter. This helps the cake rise evenly and create a honeycomb texture.

Whisking eggs: When whisking eggs, ensure you whisk evenly and in one direction so the eggs combine uniformly with other ingredients. Avoid whisking too hard to prevent too many air bubbles, which affect the cake's texture.
Mixing flour: When mixing the dry flour into the wet mixture, mix well but do not over-mix. This helps prevent the formation of air bubbles and ensures a soft, smooth texture for the cake.

Oven temperature: Set the oven to a stable temperature and bake the cake for the time specified in the recipe. Check the cake frequently to ensure the surface is slightly golden and the cake is fully cooked.

Storing the cake: Once the cake is baked, let it cool completely before removing it from the mold and placing it on a rack to cool entirely. Store the cake in an airtight container to keep it fresh for a long time.

mon_an.ten: Secrets to Choosing Fresh Shore Crabs, Sea Crabs, Snails, and Mussels
mon_an.mo_ta: Seafood dishes like shore crabs, sea crabs, snails, and mussels have become popular and well-loved. However, you don't always pick crabs, snails, or mussels as fresh and delicious as desired. To enjoy the unique and tasty flavors of these seafood types, there are some secrets to choosing fresh ones that we want to share with readers today. Learn the right way to pick them to enjoy the unique flavors of seafood and satisfy every palate.
cac_buoc: 1. Secrets to choosing fresh sea crabs

To choose fresh sea crabs, there are several important indicators. First, when pressing the crab's apron, you should feel firmness without any signs of sinking or breaking. The color of the shell and claws is also a key factor. Good crabs usually have darker colors, and the shell color matches the claw color.

You should also observe the color of the apron and the underside of the claws. Mature crabs usually have brighter aprons and claw undersides, while young crabs look pale. Additionally, the spikes on the shell are an indicator; they are larger, longer, and harder on mature crabs.

Finally, to choose crabs with lots of roe, look for female crabs that have spawned multiple times. Factors such as the shape of the apron and the red roe color visible in the apron and shell can also help you identify crabs with plenty of roe.
2. Secrets to choosing fresh snails

First, when touching the snail's opening, if they retract deep inside, it is a sign that the snails are alive and fresh. If the snail has a foul smell and the operculum is retracted deep inside, the snail is definitely dead. Drop the snails into a basin of water; live snails will float with their openings facing downward.

Observing the snail's operculum can also help distinguish between fat and thin snails. To clean snails, you can soak them in rice water for about 2 hours to remove mud and dirt. Using chili powder, fresh chilies, or vinegar mixed into the soaking water also helps clean the snails.
3. Secrets to choosing good shore crabs
Compared to field crabs, female shore crabs are usually preferred because they have more meat and a sweeter flavor.
Female shore crabs have large aprons that cover most of their belly, while males have quite small aprons located right in the center of the belly.
When buying shore crabs, choose those that are still alive, healthy, and move vigorously when caught.
Avoid buying dead shore crabs, those with foam, unpleasant odors, or those missing legs or claws.
4. Secrets to choosing fresh mussels
Observe the shells: Choose mussels with bright, beautiful shells without signs of damage like cracks or breaks.
Check the smell: Fresh mussels do not have a foul or unpleasant odor. Be careful to avoid buying mussels with a burnt or "piggy" smell.
Check the shell closure: If buying packaged mussels, check if the packaging is torn or open. Ensure the mussels are tightly sealed to keep them fresh.
Check the mantle: Look at the mantle (the part covering the body) to see if it is bright pink without signs of decomposition.
Purchase time: If possible, buy mussels early in the morning or at the end of the day when the freshest supply arrives.
Buy from reliable sources: Choose to buy mussels from reputable stores, seafood markets, or suppliers to ensure the origin and quality of the mussels.

mon_an.mo_ta: You want to change the menu for your family with phở, bún, or miến... but making a good broth is one thing; knowing the specific spices to add for that signature aroma is another. Here are a few secrets so you can prepare a pot of broth with authentic restaurant flavor.
cac_buoc: Making a delicious broth requires its own culinary secrets. Let's take a look!
Simmering time
The cooking time for different types of broth depends on the ingredients.
For example, chicken and pork broth used to be cooked for 4-6 hours (because animals were mostly free-range with firm meat and deep flavor), but now the time is shorter.
Beef broth specifically needs longer simmering, from 8 to 10 hours. Seafood broth should not be cooked for more than 45 minutes, or it will become cloudy and sour.
Simmering method
The first condition for a clear, sweet broth is choosing fresh, high-quality ingredients and using proper processing techniques.
For example, with chicken and pork broth, do not use head bones as they make the water stale. Instead, use hip and tail bones for a sweet and fragrant result.
Before simmering, pork and chicken meat/bones should be blanched in boiling water (bring water to a boil, add bones, then discard this water) to remove odors and keep the broth clear.
For beef bones, especially marrow bones, roasting them at high heat before simmering makes the broth more fragrant, clear, and delicious.
Cooking technique
Place the blanched bones in cold water, bring to a quick boil over high heat, then lower the heat to a simmer for a few minutes until the foam hardens, then skim it off.
After that, maintain a gentle simmer throughout the process.
Specific spices to add.
Beef broth
Beef broth is incomplete without cinnamon sticks, black cardamom, star anise, ginger, and dried shallots.

Place shallots and ginger under a grill until cooked but not burnt (the red skin of the shallot helps clarify the water and adds color). Break star anise into petals, break cinnamon into small pieces, use only the fragrant dry yellow seeds of the black cardamom (rubbed clean with a towel), crush them, wrap in a clean cloth, and add to the pot.
You will often see a layer of fat on top of beef broth; it serves to retain heat and preserve the aromatic essential oils.
Chicken broth
Chicken broth usually contains shallots, crushed peppercorns, ginger, shiitake mushrooms, and mushroom stems. Chicken broth is used for bún thang, stews, and various soups...
Note: How to fix cloudy broth
Whisk egg whites and add to the broth (when the broth has cooled), place on the stove, and stir while heating so the impurities stick to the egg.
Mince meat (matching the type of broth), mix with egg whites and shiitake mushrooms, then add to the cool broth to make it clearer and tastier.
If chicken broth is cloudy, adding more chicken bones and continuing to simmer will also help clarify and improve the flavor.

mon_an.ten: Beef Stew with Lotus Root and Sweet Corn
mon_an.mo_ta: Opening the series of dishes to celebrate Vietnamese Women's Day on October 20th is Beef Stew with Lotus Root and Sweet Corn. This dish is simple, easy to make, and nutritious—perfect for husbands who want to cook for their wives! Unlike fried dishes that are hard to master and easy to burn, this one is extremely simple with easy-to-find ingredients. Let's start cooking for your beloved wife; we will help you succeed!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning powder, minced ginger - as needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the beef and cut into cubes. Wash all vegetables. Peel the lotus root and slice thinly (about 5 mm). Cut the sweet corn into 3cm segments. Wedge the tomato. Cut the broccoli into bite-sized pieces. Soak shiitake mushrooms in hot water, wash, and julienne.

Step 2: Place a pan on the stove, add cooking oil, and stir-fry the beef with minced ginger. Add boiling water, then lower the heat to a simmer until the meat is tender. Season with two teaspoons of seasoning powder.

Step 3: Once the meat is cooked and seasoned, add the corn to sweeten the broth. Cook for about 5 minutes, then add the tomato, shiitake mushrooms, and lotus root over medium heat. Cook for another 10 minutes, then add the broccoli. Adjust seasoning to taste, turn up the heat to bring to a boil, then turn off the stove.
Step 4: Serve the Beef Stew with Lotus Root and Sweet Corn, garnish, and serve hot.

mon_an.ten: Fastest Ways to Remove Odors from Plastic Containers
mon_an.mo_ta: After some time, plastic containers can absorb food odors, making cleaning and deodorizing difficult...
cac_buoc: Plastic containers are essential in the kitchen for storing leftovers, spices, herbs, and sweets. However, they can retain food smells over time. Here are some tips to banish those stubborn odors:

The easiest way is to use a strong-scented dish soap to scrub the entire interior. However, if the smell persists, you may need to use undiluted bleach. Pour it into the container and soak for about two hours.

Use the bleach solution to wipe the lid as well. Then, rinse both the container and lid with clean water, dry them, and check for any remaining odor. Usually, this method removes even the most "stubborn" smells.

Coffee beans can also be used to eliminate odors like onion, garlic, or curry. Simply wash the container, place a few coffee beans inside, and close the lid tightly. After a few hours, the food smell will be replaced by the aroma of coffee.
A less common but effective method is freezing. After washing and drying, place the plastic container in the freezer for a day or longer.
Placing thin lemon slices inside the container for a few days is another secret to removing fishy smells.
Additionally, you can mix baking powder with vinegar to create a thick paste and use it to scrub the smelly containers. This is considered a very effective deodorizing method.

mon_an.mo_ta: These fried sweet potato balls will make your whole family fall in love at first bite. They are not difficult to make and can be prepared whenever you have free time.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Coating - 60g sesame seeds; 2.5g glutinous rice flour, water
cac_buoc: Step 1: Steam the sweet potatoes until cooked, then mash them. Add glutinous rice flour, all-purpose flour, and sugar. Mix until the dough is smooth and soft.

Step 2: Take a small amount of dough, roll it into a ball, flatten it, and place a piece of Nian Gao in the center. Fold the edges to seal and roll back into a ball, ensuring the filling is completely enclosed.
Step 3: Mix sesame seeds and glutinous rice flour in a small bowl. Dip the sweet potato ball into water, then roll it in the sesame mixture until evenly coated.
Step 4: Heat oil for frying, then drop the balls in and fry until golden brown.
Remove the fried sweet potato balls and place them on paper towels to drain excess oil. Enjoy while still warm!
Good luck!

mon_an.mo_ta: With this beef with sesame sauce, your family will have a nutritious and delicious meal. Using simple ingredients, you can show off your skills by making this at home today.
cac_buoc: Ingredients to prepare:
250g thinly sliced beef
15ml white wine
1 knob each of ginger and garlic, minced
1 tsp tapioca starch or cornstarch
30ml water
22ml soy sauce
8g sugar
12g sesame seeds
10ml sesame oil
How to make beef with sesame sauce:
Place the beef in a bowl, add the wine, minced ginger, garlic, and starch, then mix well. In a separate bowl, mix the water, soy sauce, and sugar; set aside.
Toast the sesame seeds in a pan, stirring constantly until they turn golden brown, then remove.

Heat sesame oil in a pan, add the beef and stir-fry briefly, then pour in the soy sauce mixture. Bring to a boil and stir until the sauce thickens and coats the meat. Add the toasted sesame seeds, mix well, and turn off the heat.
Simply serve the beef with sesame sauce over hot rice and enjoy.
Good luck with this beef with sesame sauce recipe!

mon_an.mo_ta: Banana blossoms are very affordable and can be used in many delicious dishes. This crispy fried version is simple, unique, and tastes quite similar to fried chicken. They are crispy on the outside and flavorful on the inside; the combination of eggs and seasoned flour will make it unforgettable. Let's make fried banana blossoms.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Kentucky fried chicken breading mix - 2 packs
cac_buoc: This amount of crispy fried banana blossoms serves 5-6 people.
Step 1: Prepare the ingredients.
You can soak the banana blossoms in a bowl of diluted salt water to prevent them from browning.
Before processing, rinse the banana blossoms with water.
Then, peel off the dark purple outer layers until you reach the white part as shown in the photo.
Cut the banana blossom in half lengthwise.
Rửa búp chuối lại một lần nữa cho sạch.
Step 2: Execution.
Place the banana blossoms in a pot and cover with water.
Place the pot on the stove over high heat until it reaches a rolling boil, then cook for about 10 minutes.
After 10 minutes, remove the banana blossoms to a plate to cool or a basket to drain.
Once cooled, slice the banana blossoms lengthwise into smaller pieces.
Arrange these pieces in a large plastic container, avoiding stacking them; if the container is small, divide them into 2-3 containers.
Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk until frothy, then pour over the banana blossoms.
Next, add two packs of Kentucky breading mix and 1 tsp of chicken powder and mix thoroughly.
Use a deep pan for frying. Add enough oil to submerge the banana blossom pieces.
Heat the oil until very hot.
Once the oil is hot, drop each piece of banana blossom in to fry.
Flip the pieces frequently and fry over medium heat so they turn golden brown on both sides.
When they are golden and crispy, remove to a plate lined with paper towels to absorb excess oil.
Drizzle with chili sauce or tomato sauce; it looks attractive and tastes much better.
Enjoy while hot.

mon_an.ten: Mango Salad with Shrimp and Pork
mon_an.mo_ta: Salads and "nộm" are always loved for their easy-to-eat sweet and sour flavors. Mango salad with shrimp and pork attracts diners not only with the tartness of the mango but also the richness of the seasoned shrimp and pork. It all creates a wonderful dish. Today, we will guide you on how to make delicious mango salad with shrimp and pork at home. Discover the detailed guide to enjoy the fresh taste of mango and the sweetness of shrimp and pork in this unique salad.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Vietnamese coriander or mint, crushed roasted peanuts, fried shallots - ingredients
cac_buoc: Peel the mango and shred into medium-sized strips.
Boil the shrimp, peel, and tear into 2-3 pieces.
Boil or soak the dried shrimp until soft, drain, then crush or grind finely.
Boil the pork and cut into strips.
Finely chop the herbs.
Mix all the dressing ingredients together until well combined. Depending on whether the mango is sour or sweet, adjust the amount of sugar and lime juice accordingly.
Mix all the ingredients and the prepared dressing together, adjust seasoning to taste, then transfer to a plate and top with roasted peanuts and fried shallots.
Tips for choosing fresh ingredients for mango salad with shrimp and pork
To make a delicious salad, choosing fresh ingredients is crucial. Here are some tips:
Mango: Choose firm, ripe mangoes with bright colors that are slightly soft to the touch. Avoid overripe mangoes or those with signs of wilting or cracking.
Shrimp: Choose fresh shrimp with bright shells, no black spots, and no foul odor. Shrimp should have firm bodies and not be curled or broken.
Meat: Choose fresh meat without unpleasant odors. If using chicken, choose meat that is pink and not dark.
Fresh herbs: Select fresh, green herbs without signs of wilting or discoloration.
Spices: Ensure spices like garlic, chili, sugar, and fish sauce are all fresh.

mon_an.mo_ta: In just 10 minutes, you can make fresh, high-quality mayonnaise at home. It's hygienic and just as good as store-bought versions. Let's learn how to make it!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 15 ml red wine vinegar or white vinegar
cac_buoc: Step 1: Place the egg, mustard, vinegar, and salt in a mixing bowl. Turn on the mixer for 20 seconds.

Step 2: Slowly add the oil drop by drop until you have used about ¼ of the oil. At this point, the mixture will begin to thicken. Continue adding the remaining oil in a slow, steady stream until finished.
Once all the oil has been added, use a spatula to scrape down the sides and bottom of the bowl (for about 10 seconds). The mayonnaise should now be stiff and hold its shape on the spatula.
Finally, transfer the mayonnaise to the refrigerator to store and use as needed!

mon_an.ten: Braised Chicken with Coca-Cola and Glass Noodles
mon_an.mo_ta: This dish attracts everyone with its eye-catching colors: golden chicken, orange carrots, and white onions. The chicken is tender and flavorful. This is a must-try recipe for home cooks to bring warmth and closeness to family meals. You won't regret treating your family to this delicious Coca-Cola braised chicken!
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients:
Peel or scrub the potatoes, wash them, and cut them into bite-sized pieces. Do not cut them too small as they will turn mushy when stewed, or too large as they won't become tender.
Peel the carrots and cut them into pieces about two-thirds the size of the potato chunks.
Peel the onion, wash it, and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Cooking steps:
Step 1:
First, soak the glass noodles in water to soften them for a better texture.
Step 2:
Wash the chicken thoroughly with salt and cut into bite-sized pieces. Blanch the chicken in boiling water to clean it and remove any odors.
Step 3:
In a large pot, bring the Coca-Cola to a boil over medium heat. Season with soy sauce, rice wine, garlic, and ginger to taste and to enhance the aroma.
Step 4:
Add the chicken to the pot. If you like spicy food, add a few chilies to boost the flavor!
Step 5:

Bring the pot to a boil until the chicken is well-infused with the spices. During the process, remember to skim off the foam constantly so the sauce stays clear and appetizing. The broth will also taste better.
Step 6:
Once boiling, add the prepared vegetables. Cover the pot and continue to simmer over low heat so the meat becomes tender and the vegetables cook through and absorb the flavors.
Step 7:
After about 20 minutes, when the chicken is tender, add the prepared glass noodles to the pot. Cook for a short while longer, then turn off the heat.
Finally, sprinkle some toasted sesame seeds over the dish before serving to make it more attractive.

This dish attracts everyone with its eye-catching colors: golden chicken, orange carrots, and white onions. The chicken is tender and flavorful. This is a must-try recipe for home cooks to bring warmth and closeness to family meals. You won't regret treating your family to this delicious Coca-Cola braised chicken!
Notes:
When braising chicken with Coca-Cola, do not use high heat as the meat may remain raw inside while becoming mushy outside, and the liquid will evaporate too quickly. Maintain a steady medium heat.
Similarly, when stewing the root vegetables, use only low heat so they become tender without the sauce drying out, allowing the vegetables to absorb the seasoning.

mon_an.mo_ta: Beef stew with potatoes is not only attractive due to its delicious flavor—featuring the sweetness of beef, the starchiness of potatoes and carrots, and the freshness of onions—but also its vibrant colors. Learn how to cook this delicious dish for your loved ones!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Minced garlic, dried parsley, black pepper - ingredients
cac_buoc: Step 1: Heat a pan with a little oil and sauté the bacon and onion until golden.
Step 2: Add the beef, minced garlic, and parsley to the pan and stir well. Season to taste.
Step 3: Add the carrots and wine to the pan. Cook for 5 minutes, then add enough water to cover the meat. Cover and simmer over low heat for about 1.5 hours.
Step 4: Next, add the potatoes, mushrooms, and tomato paste. Stir well, cover, and simmer for 40 minutes over low heat. Occasionally stir with chopsticks to prevent burning at the bottom.
Step 5: Remove the lid and let it boil for another 20 minutes until the sauce thickens.
Step 6: Enjoy this wonderful beef stew with some bread!

mon_an.mo_ta: Fresh squid is a favorite for many due to its natural sweetness. These fried calamari rings maintain that sweetness and tender texture while offering a crispy outer shell. It's a perfect snack, appetizer, or side dish for family meals.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Cooking oil, ground pepper, salt, rice wine, fresh ginger, mayonnaise - seasonings
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients
First, pour boiling water over the squid, then rub with salt and scrub the exterior to remove slime.
Next, cut the squid into bite-sized rings and let them drain.
Once drained, marinate the squid with a little salt, pepper, and rice wine for about 15 minutes to infuse flavor and remove the fishy scent.
After 15 minutes, prepare two separate bowls for the frying flour and panko breadcrumbs. Use wide bowls for easy dipping.
Beat the eggs in a separate bowl.
Cooking steps
Step 1: Fill a pan with enough oil to submerge the squid and heat until boiling. You can use a small, deep pot to save oil. Deep-frying ensures the squid is crispy and has an attractive color.
Step 2: Dip each squid ring into the flour, coating evenly, then dip into the egg wash, and finally roll in the panko breadcrumbs.
Once coated, drop the squid into the hot oil and fry for about 2-3 minutes until they turn golden brown.
Step 3: When the squid is beautifully golden, remove and place on a plate lined with paper towels to drain excess oil before serving.
Notes
To balance the richness, serve the fried calamari with a side salad, chili sauce, and mayonnaise.
Monitor the heat carefully while frying; overcooking will make the squid rubbery and the crust burnt.
Successful fried calamari should be golden and crispy on the outside, tender and sweet on the inside. It's a great dish for both adults and children.

How to choose fresh squid: There are two main types: cuttlefish and squid. Cuttlefish are thick and oval-shaped; choose large, firm ones that are milky white. Squid are cylindrical and thinner; choose ones with bright, slightly pinkish flesh where the head is still firmly attached to the body. Avoid squid that has turned greenish, has soft flesh, or a very fishy smell.
Dried squid: Choose medium-sized ones (100-150g). They should be thick, light pink, flat, and covered in a thin layer of white powder. They should feel dry and firm with a characteristic aroma.

mon_an.ten: Grilled Shrimp with Salt and Chili
mon_an.mo_ta: Do you love BBQ as much as I do? Every weekend, my family has to have a BBQ feast, and Grilled Shrimp with Salt and Chili is a must. The crispy shells and savory salt-chili coating combined with sweet shrimp meat are irresistible. Let's make this foolproof recipe!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings: Sea salt, sugar, pepper, cooking oil
Tools: Bamboo skewers, charcoal grill or oven
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients:
Trim the shrimp whiskers, remove the vein, wash, and drain.
Mince or blend the garlic and chilies. Adjust the amount of chili to your spice tolerance.
Soak the bamboo skewers in cold water so they don't burn while grilling. This is a crucial step to prevent charred skewers.
Step 2: Marinate the shrimp
In a bowl, mix the minced garlic and chili with 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp pepper, 1/2 tsp sugar, 2 tsp oil, and 1 tsp lemon juice. This creates a very flavorful marinade.
Place the 500g of shrimp in a large bowl and pour the marinade over them. Use gloves to toss and ensure every shrimp is evenly coated. Marinate for 30 minutes.
After 30 minutes, take the skewers out of the water. Skewer each shrimp straight from the tail to the head. Repeat until finished.
Step 3: Grill the shrimp
I personally love grilling over charcoal because it brings out the best aroma and flavor.

FOR CHARCOAL GRILL: Arrange the shrimp on the grill grate and flip constantly for even cooking. While grilling, brush a mixture of butter and oil on the shrimp to make them shiny and fragrant. When the shrimp turn bright red and golden, they are ready. Don't overcook them or the meat will lose its sweetness.
FOR OVEN: You can skip the skewering. Arrange the shrimp on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake at 180°C for 10-15 minutes until golden red.
In just 45-60 minutes, you have a delicious dish. The shrimp are golden-red with crispy shells and sweet, tender meat. This is perfect for daily meals or weekend BBQs.
For the dipping sauce, mix: Soup powder (seasoned salt) + pepper + sugar + chili sauce + lime/kumquat juice. Adjust to get a balanced sour-spicy-sweet taste.
Tips for success:
Using sea salt for the marinade is better as iodized salt dissolves into liquid too quickly.
Fresh black tiger shrimp are best for grilling. Look for shiny, bright shells; they might even still be alive.
You can wipe off the excess salt layer before eating if it's too salty for your taste.

mon_an.mo_ta: This meatloaf features a soft, sweet ground meat exterior surrounding whole eggs. When sliced, it looks beautiful and tastes incredible. The process is simple and doesn't take much time—let's try it together!
cac_buoc: Cooking steps:
Peel the carrot, wash the onion, and dice them finely.
Wash the pork, chop it, and grind it finely.
Crumble the bread into small pieces.
Crack one egg into a bowl and beat it well.
Boil the remaining three eggs. Once cooked, place them in cold water for easy peeling.
Peel the boiled eggs and set them aside.
Prepare a pan, add the butter, and melt it.
Sauté the onion until fragrant and slightly translucent.
Add the carrots and peas, and sauté until just cooked.
Transfer the sautéed vegetables to a bowl to cool.
In a large bowl, combine the ground pork, the beaten egg, breadcrumbs, 1 tsp salt, and 1/4 tsp pepper. Mix well so the meat absorbs the seasoning.
Add the cooled vegetables to the meat mixture and mix again.
Prepare the mold by lining it with foil. Add half of the meat-vegetable mixture and spread it evenly.
Note: Press down lightly to make the mixture firm.
Place the 3 boiled eggs in a row in the mold as shown.
Cover with the remaining meat mixture and smooth the surface.
Fold the excess foil over to seal the meatloaf.
Preheat the oven for 10 minutes at 200°C.
Place the mold in the oven and bake for 15-20 minutes. Watch the color and adjust the time based on the thickness of your mold.
After 20 minutes, once the meat is cooked, remove the foil and slice the loaf into rounds.
The exterior should be golden and slightly crispy while the inside remains soft and sweet. The meat should be firm and hold the egg tightly.
Each slice will have a beautiful egg center!
Arrange the meatloaf on a plate and enjoy with fresh greens and cherry tomatoes.
This modern twist on meatloaf is not only delicious but also visually stunning, making everyone want to dive in immediately.

mon_an.mo_ta: In the summer, when fried foods are less appealing due to the heat, steamed dishes become the perfect light, cooling, and delicious alternative. Try this unique steamed egg with clams recipe for a family dinner.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the clams. Soak them in diluted salt water for 30 minutes to 1 hour to let them spit out all the sand. Rinse again.
Step 2: Place a pot on the stove with 1/2 bowl of water mixed with a small cup of rice wine. Add the clams once the water boils and cook until they just open their shells, then turn off the heat.

Step 3: Crack the eggs into a bowl. Beat gently so they are mixed but not foamy. Add a bit of seasoning, then add water (the amount of water should be 1.5 times the volume of the eggs) and stir. Strain through a sieve for a smooth texture.
Step 4: Arrange the clams around a bowl with the openings facing up, then pour the egg mixture in.
Step 5:

Bring water to a boil in a steamer. Place the bowl in and steam until the eggs are set (check by inserting a toothpick; if no cloudy liquid comes out, it's done). Garnish with green onions and serve hot.
Here is the final result!

The steamed eggs should be fragrant, not fishy, with a beautiful pale yellow color. They should be soft, smooth, and without air bubbles on the surface. To achieve this, beat the eggs gently and always strain them before steaming. During steaming, use a toothpick to check for doneness.
The clams must be fragrant and free of sand. To ensure this, soak them thoroughly in salt water with a few slices of chili, and use rice wine when boiling to neutralize any fishy odor.

mon_an.mo_ta: Seafood pasta is one of the quick and tasty dishes on my list, perfect for both weekends and busy weekdays. Let's make this attractive seafood pasta for the whole family!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Tomato sauce or diced tomatoes - as desired
Garlic, parsley, thyme, dried basil - ingredients
cac_buoc: Step 1: Dice the onion.
Peel the shrimp, removing the heads but leaving the tails on.
Soak and wash the clams, then boil until they open.
Mince the garlic.
Step 2: Heat oil in a pan, sauté the garlic until fragrant, then add the onion and sauté together.
Step 3: Add 4-5 tbsp of tomato sauce and stir well.
Step 4: Add the shrimp and clams to the pan.
Step 5: Sprinkle with dried parsley, thyme, and basil according to your preference.
Step 6: Add about 1-1.5 tbsp of white wine, stir, and season to taste.
Step 7: Bring a pot of water to a boil with a pinch of salt and 1 tsp olive oil. Cook the pasta until al dente, then drain in a colander. Do not rinse with cold water.
Once drained, add the pasta to the pan with the shrimp and clams and toss well.
Step 8: Transfer to a plate and serve hot.
Enjoy your meal!

mon_an.mo_ta: Clam and tofu soup is a simple yet nutritious dish. It features the sweet taste of clams, silky tofu, and a wonderful broth. Let's get into the kitchen and learn how to make it!
cac_buoc: Clean the clams thoroughly. Slice the tofu into bite-sized pieces.
Next, bring a pot of water to a boil and season to taste (you can add satay or miso paste to the broth for extra flavor).
Finally, add the tofu to the pot. When the water returns to a boil, add the clams. Once the water boils again and the clams open, turn off the heat.

mon_an.mo_ta: Ginger and lemongrass chicken is an attractive and unique dish. In this article, we will explore the recipe for this specialty. It's perfect for cold weather—let's cook this for your family. Here is the guide for delicious ginger and lemongrass chicken!
cac_buoc: 1. Prepare the ingredients

First, to clean and remove the odor from the chicken, prepare a solution of salt and vinegar (or salt and lemon) in a 2:1 ratio. Rub this solution thoroughly over the chicken, massage firmly, then rinse with water. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and place them in a large bowl.
Peel and clean the ginger and shallot. Slice the ginger into matchsticks and mince the shallot.
2. Cooking the chicken
Step 1: Marinate the chicken to infuse flavor
Mix the minced ginger, 2 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp bouillon powder, 1 tsp MSG, and 1 tsp sugar with the chicken. Toss well and marinate for 30 minutes to 1 hour.
Step 2: Sauté aromatics

Place a pan over low heat. Add oil and wait until hot. Add the shallots and sauté until fragrant. Add the lemongrass and stir until aromatic. Finally, add the ginger and chili and mix well. Add them in this order as they have different cooking times. Once fragrant, remove them from the pan and set aside.
Step 3: Braise the chicken with ginger and lemongrass
Place the pan back on the heat with a little more oil. Do not use too much oil as it will make the dish greasy. When the oil is hot, add the chicken pieces one by one to avoid splashing.

Once the chicken is in the pan, add the ginger and lemongrass matchsticks. For a nice brown color, you can add a little caramel sauce. Stir the chicken well to absorb the aromas. Add about ½ cup of water. Stir and flip the chicken to cook evenly.

Cover the pan to retain heat and cook faster. After 3-5 minutes, open the lid and flip the chicken. Season with more fish sauce and cover again. Wait 10-15 minutes for the chicken to cook through. Flip the chicken again and add the previously sautéed aromatics.
Cook until the liquid reduces and the sauce becomes slightly thick. Turn off the heat and sprinkle with shredded lime leaves. The fragrant ginger and lemongrass chicken is ready.
Tips for a better dish:
Choose fresh chicken: Ensure the chicken is fresh and high-quality for the best flavor.
Marinate long enough: Marinate for at least 30 minutes so the meat absorbs the herbs and spices.
Use fresh ginger: Use fresh ginger instead of dried for a better aroma and refreshing taste.
Slice ginger thinly: Thin matchsticks blend better with the meat and seasoning.
Choose fresh lemongrass: Fresh lemongrass provides a characteristic fragrance.
Fry correctly: Use medium heat so the chicken cooks through without drying out. Add pieces slowly to the pan.
Cover while cooking: Keeping the lid on helps retain moisture and flavor.
Balance with fish sauce and sugar: Use a bit of both to create a perfect salty-sweet balance.

mon_an.ten: Beautiful and Delicious Five-Color Braised Pork Ribs
mon_an.mo_ta: Would you like to refresh your family meal with five-color braised pork ribs? This dish features vibrant colors, a rich sauce, and crunchy vegetables that pair perfectly with steamed rice. Learn how to make these five-color braised ribs below.
cac_buoc: Ingredients for five-color braised pork ribs (serves 4):
Pork ribs: 300g
Red bell pepper, green bell pepper: 1 large each
Onion: 1 bulb
Green onions
Chili, ginger, garlic
Lettuce: 1 head
Shallot: 1 bulb
Seasonings: fish sauce, salt, seasoning powder
Instructions for five-color braised pork ribs:
Preparing the ingredients:
Peel, wash, and finely chop the onion.
Wash the bell peppers and dice them.
Finely chop the garlic and ginger.
Dice the shallot.
Blanch the ribs in boiling water to remove impurities, then rinse with cold water.
Cut the ribs into bite-sized pieces, about 3-4 cm long.
Marinate the ribs with 1 tsp salt, ½ tsp pepper, and 1 tbsp soy sauce for at least 15 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Cooking steps:
Step 1: Heat 1 tbsp of oil in a pan, add the vegetables and stir-fry with seasoning powder until cooked, then remove and set aside.

Step 2: Sauté the shallots in oil until fragrant, then add the ribs. Stir-fry until the meat is cooked and browned on the edges. Add enough water to barely cover the ribs, then add soy sauce and caramel sauce. Cover and braise for about 20 minutes until the ribs are tender.
If the sauce dries out, you can add a little more water to prevent the ribs from burning.
Step 3: Add the stir-fried vegetables back into the pan, toss well, cook for another 5 minutes, and turn off the heat.
Notes for making five-color braised pork ribs:
When stir-frying the vegetables, do not overcook them, as they will become mushy and lose their fresh crunch.
To make the sauce thicker, you can mix a little cornstarch with water and pour it into the pan while braising the ribs.
The longer the ribs are braised, the more tender and delicious they become.

mon_an.ten: Authentic Northern-Style Jellied Pork and Dongpo Pork
mon_an.mo_ta: Jellied pork is a highly attractive dish and a staple in Vietnamese family meals, known for its enticing aroma, tender meat, and well-absorbed seasonings. If you haven't made jellied pork for this year's Lunar New Year, try it now. Refer to the recipe below to treat your whole family to this delicious dish. Discover how to cook authentic Northern-style jellied pork with detailed instructions and secrets on this website. Enjoy the rich flavors of this traditional dish right at home.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Wood ear mushrooms, shiitake mushrooms - ingredients
Seasonings - seasoning powder, fish sauce, black pepper, cooking oil
cac_buoc: 1. How to cook authentic Northern-style jellied pork (Thịt đông)
Step 1:
Clean the pork shank and pork skin, removing any hair. Wash and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Mince the shallots.
Soak the shiitake and wood ear mushrooms until soft, then slice into thin strips.
Step 2:
Marinate the meat with 1 tbsp seasoning powder, 1 tbsp fish sauce, a bit of salt, and 1/3 of the minced shallots for 25-30 minutes to let the flavors penetrate.
Step 3:
Sauté 1/3 of the shallots with cooking oil until fragrant.
Add the meat and stir-fry until it firms up.

Pour in water to cover the meat. Use the mushroom soaking water (strained to remove sediment) as well. Bring to a boil, skim off the foam, and simmer for 30-40 minutes until the meat is tender. Continue skimming any foam that rises during the simmering process.
Step 4:
Sauté the remaining shallots with a little oil.
Add the shiitake and wood ear mushrooms, stir-fry until firm, and season slightly.
Step 5:
When the meat is almost done, add the mushrooms. Boil for another 3-5 minutes, then turn off the heat. Stir in the black pepper.
Sprinkle black pepper and place sliced carrots or cilantro at the bottom of a bowl for decoration.
Wait for the meat to cool slightly, then ladle it into the bowl and place it in the refrigerator to set.
2. How to cook jellied chicken
Ingredients:
700g chicken
Wood ear mushrooms
Shiitake mushrooms
Seasonings: salt, black pepper, seasoning powder
Half a chicken
Instructions:
Step 1: Prepare ingredients
Wash the chicken and cut into bite-sized pieces. A small tip: place the chicken in the fridge for a while before cutting to make it easier and prevent the meat from tearing.
Marinate the chicken with fish sauce, seasoning powder, and black pepper for 20-30 minutes.
Wash the wood ear and shiitake mushrooms, soak in water to expand, then slice them.
Step 2: Cooking the jellied chicken
In a pot, lightly stir-fry the chicken for about 10 minutes. Add the mushrooms and stir-fry for another 5 minutes. Add a bit of seasoning powder and stir well.
Pour in filtered water until the chicken is submerged. Bring to a boil, then reduce to low heat and skim the foam so the jelly stays clear. Adjust seasoning to taste.
Cover and simmer on low heat for about 30 minutes, then turn off the heat.
Step 3: Preservation
Place the chicken into prepared molds and put them in the refrigerator. Let it set for 4 to 6 hours so the ingredients jellify and the flavors meld.
When serving, only take out the portion needed and do not put leftovers back into the main pot.
3. How to make Dongpo Pork (Thịt kho Đông Pha)
Authentic ingredients:
1kg pork belly
3 stalks green onion
1 knob ginger
Garlic, shallots, cinnamon, star anise, cardamom (a little of each)
Seasonings: Soy sauce, dark soy sauce, Shaoxing cooking wine, rock sugar
Instructions for Dongpo Pork:
Step 1: Prepare the meat

Clean the pork skin by scraping it with a knife, then rinse. This removes impurities and excess hair. Heat a pan and sear the pork skin until golden brown. This process softens the skin and keeps it intact during cooking.

After searing, place the meat in boiling water with a little wine for 3 minutes to remove impurities and reduce odors. Cut the meat into 4cm large squares. You can use heat-resistant cotton string or banana fiber to tie the meat to maintain its square shape after braising.
Step 2: Braise the meat
Use a clay pot for this dish. If desired, line the bottom with a bamboo mat to prevent burning.

Place green onions at the bottom, then layer ginger slices, garlic, and shallots. Finally, place the meat on top, skin side down. Add ½ cup soy sauce, ¼ cup dark soy sauce, 1 cup Shaoxing wine, 1 cup water, and 50g rock sugar. Bring to a boil over high heat, skim the foam, then reduce to low heat. Cover and simmer for about 2 hours.
Halfway through, flip the meat so it absorbs the seasonings evenly. Add the cinnamon, star anise, and cardamom at this stage for an enticing aroma.
Step 3: Steam the meat

Once the meat is braised and has a beautiful color, place the pot in a steamer and steam for another 30 minutes to make the meat extra tender and flavorful. This process thickens the sauce with the rendered fat, creating a wonderful dish.

After steaming, the Dongpo Pork is ready. Serve on a plate with some blanched bok choy. The contrast between the red meat and green vegetables is very appealing. Thanks to the long simmering time, the meat is incredibly tender and melts in your mouth. This dish is excellent served with hot rice.

mon_an.ten: Mouthwatering Ways to Grill Pork Patties Without a Charcoal Stove
mon_an.mo_ta: Grilled pork patties (chả nướng) are a favorite for many, but not everyone knows how to grill them perfectly. Below are several ways to grill them without a charcoal stove, avoiding smoke and charcoal odors. Method 1 – Pan-grilling:
cac_buoc: Heat a pan and add a little fat or oil. Place the meat slices and hand-formed patties into the pan over medium heat until both sides are golden brown. Meat slices usually cook faster than minced patties. A non-stick pan is best for this method. If the meat sticks, add a little more oil. Note: Since you are 'grilling,' do not use too much oil, or it will become fried meat instead.
Method 2 – Oven-grilling:

Preheat your oven to 400°F (204°C). Use the Broil setting to cook with top heat. Meanwhile, soak bamboo skewers in water so they soften and don't break or burn in the oven. Thread the meat onto the skewers. It's best to alternate lean meat with fatty pieces so that as the fat renders, it keeps the lean meat moist, fragrant, and tender. For minced patties, shape them into rounds and place them on a baking tray. Place in the preheated oven and grill until golden brown on both sides. Check every 2-3 minutes as the broil intensity varies by oven.
Method 3 – Electric grill:

This is the best method as it closely mimics traditional Vietnamese grilling, just using an electric element. Arrange the meat slices and patties on the grill rack. Remember to alternate fatty and lean pieces so the melting fat coats the lean meat, making it tender and fragrant. Grill until both sides are evenly golden brown.

mon_an.ten: Simple and Delicious Dipping Sauce for Nem Rán
mon_an.mo_ta: Nem rán (fried spring rolls) is a staple for Lunar New Year and daily Vietnamese meals. It can be served at any occasion without getting boring. The dipping sauce is the essential element that determines whether your spring rolls are a success. There are specific secrets to mixing a great sauce that not everyone knows. To master it, you must remember the tips below. These detailed instructions will help you successfully mix a bowl of sauce that is perfectly savory, sweet, sour, and spicy. Try it now and feel the harmony of flavors with every bite of nem rán.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Mince the garlic and chili

Start by peeling the garlic and removing the seeds from the chili, then mince them finely. This ensures the flavors are distributed evenly and creates a more beautiful bowl of sauce. If you only crush the garlic or slice the chili, the sauce won't be uniform, and the bits won't float attractively on the surface.
Step 2: Follow the golden ratio for a delicious sauce

Remember this golden ratio: 1 sour - 1 sweet - 1 fish sauce - 4 water. This means if you use a small spoon as a measure, you will need: 1 spoon lime juice + 1 spoon sugar + 1 spoon fish sauce + 4 spoons filtered water. If you want to make a larger batch, simply increase the quantities while maintaining the same ratio.

After mixing, taste and adjust to your preference. However, with this golden ratio, your sauce should already be quite balanced. Just before serving, add the minced garlic and chili, and sprinkle with a little black pepper for the perfect flavor.
Good luck to everyone!

mon_an.ten: Simple and Flavorful BBQ Meat Marinade
mon_an.mo_ta: Grilled dishes are always appealing due to their unique aroma and flavor, but the most important step to achieving perfect grilled meat is the marinade. Meat must be marinated correctly to reach its full potential. Let's learn how to marinate BBQ meat below!
cac_buoc: How to choose meat for grilling
Beef: You should choose ribeye, top round, shoulder, or shank for the best grilling results.

Pork: Choose cuts with both lean meat and fat so the meat stays tender. Avoid cuts that are too lean as they will dry out, but ensure there isn't so much fat that it becomes greasy. A marbled cut with slightly more lean than fat is ideal.
Chicken: Choose tender chicken; you can either chop it into pieces or grill it whole.
Additionally, remove any silver skin or gristle and lightly score the meat before grilling to prevent it from shrinking or becoming misshapen.
Tips for a delicious BBQ marinade: Please take note of the following!

You don't need too many seasonings for pork; just basic aromatics like five-spice powder, shallots, and garlic are enough. For chicken, adding some minced lemongrass to the marinade makes it much more delicious.

Use a standard rice bowl as a measuring tool for the marinade. For example, a standard ratio (for reference) is: 1.5 bowls fine yellow sugar + 1 bowl oyster sauce + 1 bowl soy sauce (or fish sauce). Mix everything and marinate the meat; the liquid should almost cover the surface of the meat for the best flavor. You can also add minced shallots, garlic, chili, oil, MSG, or honey to make the meat more attractive and flavorful.
It is best to marinate the meat 24 hours in advance and keep it in the refrigerator. This allows the flavors to penetrate deeply. If you are short on time, marinate for at least 30 minutes.
A little white wine or cooking wine will make the grilled meat more fragrant and help the seasonings penetrate better.
To tenderize the meat, you can add coconut water, milk, or a bit of baking soda.
Avoid using rock sugar for marinating; granulated sugar is better as it helps prevent the meat from burning too quickly.
Tips for grilling
You can briefly blanch the meat in boiling water or broth before grilling; this makes the meat firmer and crispier after grilling.
When grilling, do not flip the meat too often. Let one side brown completely before flipping to the other side.
If using an oven, place a glass bowl of water inside. The evaporating steam will prevent the meat from becoming dry and hard.
Place a piece of bread next to the grill; if fat splatters out, the bread will help absorb it.

mon_an.ten: Braised Silken Tofu with Baby Corn
mon_an.mo_ta: Braised Silken Tofu with Baby Corn – A simple, refreshing, and delicious dish that pairs perfectly with rice. Discover how to make this dish with the recipe below! Cooking guide: Braised Silken Tofu with Baby Corn.
cac_buoc: For this braised silken tofu and baby corn dish, you can use scallops; however, if they are unavailable, you can substitute them with clam meat. Similarly, for the Korean chili paste, you can use sweet and sour chili sauce or ketchup instead.
Step 1:
Rinse the silken tofu and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Rinse the peas and baby corn. Cut or split the baby corn lengthwise depending on your family's preference. Peel, rinse, and thinly slice the onion.

Step 2: Rinse the scallops, drizzle with a little white wine and minced ginger, let sit for 15 minutes, then rinse again and drain. Heat a little cooking oil in a pan, sauté the onion until fragrant, then add the scallops and stir-fry for 3 minutes before removing and setting aside.

Step 3: Using the same pan, add more oil and stir-fry the baby corn and peas until cooked. Add the silken tofu and Korean chili paste along with other seasonings, adjusting to taste. During the cooking process, if the dish becomes too dry, you can add a little water. Since silken tofu is very delicate, do not stir too much; simply simmer over low heat so the tofu absorbs the flavors.

Step 4: Finally, add the onion and scallops and continue to cook. Keep on low heat for about 3-5 minutes then turn off the heat and sprinkle with chopped green onions. Transfer the dish to a plate and serve hot with steamed rice.

mon_an.mo_ta: This sour fish cake soup features fresh, sweet fish balls paired with crunchy bamboo shoots, the gentle acidity of pineapple and tomatoes, and fresh herbs to create a truly refreshing experience.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Green onions, Vietnamese coriander, dill - for serving
cac_buoc: Refresh your palate after the holidays with this cooling sour fish cake soup.
Step 1: Rinse the tomatoes and okra; drain well. Wedge the tomatoes and slice the okra.
Slice the pineapple into bite-sized pieces.
Trim the roots and wilted leaves from the green onions, Vietnamese coriander, and dill. Rinse, drain, and chop finely.
Step 2: Rinse the fresh bamboo shoots and blanch them briefly to remove bitterness and toxins.
Step 3: Prepare 300g of fish paste (use featherback fish paste and roll into small round balls).

Step 4: Peel, rinse, and crush the shallots. Sauté the shallots with a little oil, add the tomatoes and stir-fry briefly, then add the pineapple and bamboo shoots. Season with 1 tsp seasoning salt and 1 tsp seasoning powder.

Step 5: When the tomatoes have softened, pour in 1 large bowl of water and bring to a boil. Once the broth is boiling, drop the fish balls in. When the fish cakes are cooked, they will float to the surface. Add 1-2 slices of bird's eye chili if you like it spicy and cook for another 1-2 minutes.
Step 6: Add the okra and cook for 1-2 more minutes or until the okra is tender. Add 1 tbsp MSG (optional), then ladle the soup into a bowl and enjoy.
How to choose good fish:
Fish with white or yellow flesh is usually tastier. Black-colored fish are often from stagnant ponds and the meat is less flavorful.
When buying fish, don't be afraid to get your hands dirty to ensure quality. Check the gills; if they are bright red, the fish is fresh. If they are pale or dark, the fish is stale.

Try to buy fish that are still swimming. If buying chilled fish, be very careful. Look at the exterior: if it is slimy and shiny, the eyes are transparent, scales are intact, and gills are pink, it is fresh. If the fish is sticky, has sunken eyes, loose scales, pale color, non-elastic flesh, or a bloated belly, it is stale.
Distinguishing fresh fish from stale fish:
A few tips to help you pick the best fish at the market.
Eyes: Fresh fish have bulging, transparent eyes with elastic corneas. Stale fish have sunken, cloudy eyes with wrinkled or torn corneas.
Anus: Fresh fish have a deep, pale white anus and a flat belly. Stale fish have a pink or bruised red anus that protrudes, and a bloated belly.
Gills: Fresh gills are bright red, fit tightly, and have no slime or foul odor. Stale gills are gray, loose, slimy, and smell bad.
Scales: Fresh fish have shiny scales that cling tightly to the body with no slime or odor. Stale fish have dull scales that fall off easily and smell.
Additionally, fresh fish have closed mouths, while stale fish have slightly open mouths. Fresh fish meat is firm and elastic, leaving no finger indentation when pressed. Stale fish is the opposite.

mon_an.ten: Mexican Avocado Salad for Weight Loss
mon_an.mo_ta: Science has proven that avocado is a highly effective fruit for weight loss and overall beauty for women. Avocado dishes are popular worldwide, especially this Mexican-style avocado salad which is both nutritious and delicious. Add this to your menu if you want to lose weight or simply want a light meal, as avocados are excellent for family health. This recipe is very simple with easy-to-find ingredients.
cac_buoc: Ingredient preparation
Pick and wash the cilantro along with the other prepared vegetables.
Finely mince the shallot and garlic.
Halve the cherry tomatoes and then dice them; chop the cilantro.
Peel the avocado and cut into pieces.
Squeeze the lime for juice.
Cooking steps
Step 1: Place the avocado pieces in a bowl and add the lime juice. Use a fork to mash the avocado.
Step 2: Add the shallot, tomatoes, cilantro, and garlic to the mashed avocado. Add ½ tsp salt and a bit of pepper to taste, then mix all ingredients thoroughly.
Step 3: Adjust the seasoning to your taste and serve with your family.
Notes
Choose avocados that are just ripe—soft to the touch but not mushy.
When mashing, you don't need to make it perfectly smooth; leaving some small chunks makes it tastier.
You can add a little olive oil to make the salad richer while remaining healthy.

mon_an.ten: Easy Healthy Home-Cooked Meals for Office Workers
mon_an.mo_ta: How to prepare healthy meals that ensure full nutrition while maintaining your physique. This article suggests simple, easy-to-make healthy dishes. Please take a look.
cac_buoc: Brown rice, fried chicken breast, asparagus, carrots, and egg
Ingredients:
100g brown rice
100g quality chicken breast
3 – 4 asparagus stalks
1/2 carrot
1 chicken egg
Seasoning: Salt, pepper
Preparation:
Rinse the brown rice briefly, add water to the rice cooker, and cook until done. (Use slightly more water for brown rice than for regular white rice).
Wash the chicken breast and slice thinly into bite-sized pieces. Wash the asparagus and cut into bite-sized lengths.
Boil the egg, peel, and slice lengthwise. Carve the carrot into flowers and boil until tender.
Sauté the asparagus in a pan with a little oil. When the asparagus is nearly cooked, add the chicken and stir-fry together. Season to taste.
Serve the brown rice on a plate, top with the stir-fried chicken and asparagus, the egg, and carrots, then enjoy.
Brown rice, shrimp, broccoli, carrots, and mushrooms
1 broccoli floret
5 peeled and deveined shrimp
10g shimeji mushrooms
Cut the broccoli into bite-sized pieces. Slice the carrots into flowers. Wash and boil them until cooked.
Season the shrimp with a little salt and pepper, then pan-fry until golden and crispy; set aside. Briefly sauté the mushrooms and set aside.
Arrange the brown rice, shrimp, carrots, broccoli, and mushrooms beautifully on a plate and enjoy.
Salmon, avocado, egg, sweet potato, green beans, and strawberries
200g-300g fresh Norwegian salmon
1 small purple sweet potato
1/2 avocado
100g green beans
2 strawberries
Peel the avocado and slice the flesh into bite-sized pieces.
Peel the sweet potato and wash the green beans, then boil or steam until cooked.
Season the fresh Norwegian salmon with a little salt and pepper, then pan-sear until golden. Note: use only a small amount of oil.
Once the fish is golden, place it on a plate and garnish with sliced avocado, sweet potato, green beans, and strawberries for dessert.
Chicken breast salad with roasted sesame dressing
Ingredients to prepare:
Chicken breast
Avocado
Purple cabbage
Carrots
Lettuce
Bean sprouts
After preparing the ingredients, place them all in a bowl and toss well with ready-made roasted sesame dressing for a delicious and nutritious meal.
Beef wrapped asparagus – an Eat Clean meal for work
Beef is a protein-rich food beneficial for health, making it a favorite in many Eat Clean diets today.

For beef wrapped asparagus, you only need a little beef, asparagus, garlic, and honey. Prepare and marinate the beef with sesame oil, honey, and minced garlic. Let it sit for 5 minutes to absorb the flavors, then wrap thin slices of beef around the asparagus stalks.
Place in the oven for about 3-4 minutes until the meat and asparagus are cooked, and your healthy meal is ready.
These are the easy healthy dishes we wanted to share. We hope you gain useful knowledge to protect and improve your health. Good luck!.

mon_an.mo_ta: Szechuan Chicken is a familiar dish for many families because it is not difficult to make. With easy-to-find ingredients, you can create a visually stunning dish with flavorful, tender chicken, soft rice noodles, century egg, and a delicious sauce. Let's explore this wonderful dish!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Rinse the celery and chop finely.
Peel the shallot, rinse, and mince.
Peel the ginger, rinse, and mince.
Rinse the chili and mince.
