Step 3: Place a pan on the stove with a little oil, add the carrots and stir-fry until they are soft.
Step 4: Add the mushrooms and tofu to the pan. Season with soy sauce, salt, and seasoning powder.
Step 5: Finally, add the bean sprouts and stir-fry, adjusting the seasoning to taste. Quickly add the herbs once cooked, toss briefly, and turn off the heat. This dish is best served hot.

mon_an.mo_ta: If you are a fan of vegetarian food, you cannot miss this fried rice. Let's learn how to make vegetarian fried rice for the whole family!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, wash the fresh shiitake mushrooms and bell pepper, then dice them into small pieces.
Step 2:
Blanch the green beans in boiling water for about 2 minutes, then remove and set aside.
Add the cold rice to a pan with heated oil. Use a spoon to break up the rice grains.
Add the fresh shiitake, red pepper, and green beans; fry for 3 - 5 minutes or until the ingredients are soft. During this process, stir constantly to ensure everything is heated evenly.
Add a little salt and soy sauce to make the vegetarian fried rice more flavorful!
And that's it, this vegetarian dish is finished in less than 10 minutes!

mon_an.ten: Silken Tofu with Shiitake Mushroom Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: On full moon days, vegetarian dishes are very popular. We would like to introduce this delicious silken tofu with shiitake mushroom sauce to everyone.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings - vegetarian oyster sauce, soy sauce, salt, sesame oil.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Trim the tough stems of the shiitake mushrooms, wash them, and soak in diluted salt water for about 15 minutes to clean.

Step 2: Rinse the silken tofu, slice it, and arrange on a plate. Cover with plastic wrap and cook in the microwave for about 2 minutes. Alternatively, you can cook the tofu by blanching it in boiling water with a pinch of salt.
Step 3: After soaking, drain the mushrooms and slice them thinly.
Step 4: Trim the roots of the scallions and cilantro, wash, and chop finely. Keep the white parts of the scallions separate.

Step 5: Place a pan on the stove and add 1 tbsp of sesame oil. When the oil is hot, sauté the white parts of the scallions until fragrant. Next, add the mushrooms and stir-fry until cooked, then add vegetarian oyster sauce and soy sauce, stirring well. Dissolve 1 tbsp of cornstarch in a little water, pour it into the pan, stir well, and season to taste.
Step 6: Once the mushrooms are cooked, turn off the heat and stir in the chopped scallions and cilantro.
Step 7: Pour the mushrooms and sauce over the cooked silken tofu. Use a spoon to drizzle the sauce evenly over the tofu pieces so they absorb the flavor.

mon_an.mo_ta: As a popular staple in Asian diets, tofu offers many health and beauty benefits such as reducing belly fat, improving skin, blood, and hair health, and supporting menopausal women. It also helps prevent atherosclerosis and is a common vegetarian dish. This guide to making tofu at home will help you avoid the health risks of store-bought tofu that might contain gypsum. The recipe and method are extremely simple and can be done regularly. You will need pressing tools: a basket, a plastic box with holes, or a specialized tofu mold. Besides the mold, you need a piece of cloth to wrap the tofu and a heavy object to press the water out.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Choose plump, high-quality soybeans. Wash the beans to remove dust and discard any hollow or damaged seeds. Soak the beans in water for 4-12 hours (minimum 4, maximum 12) until the skins come off easily when squeezed. It is not strictly necessary to remove all the skins.
Step 2: Place the beans and water in a blender and blend thoroughly.

Step 3: Line a basin or pot with a large piece of cloth. Pour the blended soy milk into the cloth, gather the corners, twist, and squeeze firmly to extract the milk. The soy pulp (okara) will remain in the cloth.

Note: You should use a cheesecloth or fine muslin as the weave density is ideal for filtering. If the cloth is too loose, the milk will contain pulp; if it is too thick, it will be difficult to extract the milk.

Step 4: Once filtered, add salt to the soy milk, stir to dissolve, and bring to a boil on the stove. You must watch it closely as soy milk boils over very easily. Measure the vinegar into a small bowl; with one hand, stir the soy milk in the pot, and with the other, slowly pour in the vinegar. You will see small curds beginning to form. Cover the pot and let it sit for 20-30 minutes. During this time, you can stir once or twice, but do so very gently. After resting, the tofu will have fully coagulated into curds (tofu brain) and a pale yellow whey. Place a sieve on the surface so the clear liquid flows into it, then use a spoon to scoop this liquid out. This liquid is now acidic whey, which can be saved for the next batch to use as a coagulant instead of vinegar.

Step 5: After removing the clear liquid, the curds will be very thick. Proceed to mold the tofu. Line the mold with a cloth and spoon the curds in. Fold the edges of the cloth neatly and put the lid on. Place a heavy object on top of the mold and press for 15-20 minutes.
Step 6: After pressing, gently lift the corners of the cloth to remove the tofu from the mold.
The tofu can be eaten immediately while still warm or used in other dishes as desired. Good luck!

mon_an.mo_ta: These vegetarian crispy fried rings are extremely easy to make and turn out crunchy and delicious, perfect for a vegetarian menu.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Peel the onions, wash them, and slice them into rounds about 1 cm thick.
After slicing, separate the rings from each other.
Step 2:
Pour the panko breadcrumbs into a deep plate so they don't spill when coating the onions.
Next, mix the tempura flour with water. Add the water gradually while stirring until you get a smooth, slightly thin batter.
Note: To check if the batter is the right consistency, dip a chopstick into the bowl; when you lift it, the batter should drip down steadily without breaking.
Step 3:
Dip the onion rings into the wet batter, then roll them in the panko breadcrumbs until the surface is completely coated.
Step 4:
Turn on the stove, heat the oil in a pan until very hot. Add the onion rings to the pan and fry until they turn an even golden brown, then remove to a plate.
You should use paper towels to absorb excess oil from the onions.
Step 5:

Once drained, transfer to another plate and serve while hot. If they cool down, they will lose their crispness. You can serve them with rice, but they are best enjoyed with chili sauce, ketchup, or mayo.
This dish is a great addition to a vegetarian diet; you can rotate it with other dishes to keep your meals interesting!

mon_an.mo_ta: This is an attractive vegetarian dish to choose for your menu at the beginning of the lunar month. You can find the ingredients for this dish at any vegetarian food store.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Wash the vegetarian squid and cut into strips about half a finger long. Marinate with minced garlic and shallots, fish sauce (vegetarian), and sate sauce.
Cut the baby corn in half lengthwise. Slice the carrots into 4cm long sticks. Cut the scallions into segments and lightly crush the chilies.
Blanch the carrots and baby corn in salted water, then remove and soak in cold water.
Step 2:
Sauté the ginger, chili, and shallots until fragrant. Add the vegetarian squid and stir-fry, then add the baby corn and carrots. Season to taste and finally add the scallions.
When stir-frying this vegetarian dish, use high heat so the vegetables don't release too much water, keeping the dish flavorful and crunchy.

mon_an.mo_ta: Learn how to make delicious homemade shiitake mushroom floss as a healthy alternative for your baby.
cac_buoc: Wash the dried shiitake mushrooms and soak them in warm water until softened.
Cut off the hard part of the stems (the root end).
Place the mushrooms in a pot of water and boil. Simmer for 7-10 minutes until the mushrooms are soft and any impurities are removed, then turn off the heat. Drain the mushrooms in a colander.
Squeeze them very dry.
Wash your hands thoroughly (or wear gloves for hygiene) and shred the mushrooms into small fibers.

Place the shredded mushrooms in a mortar and pound them until they become fluffy. Once fluffy, add fish sauce and salt to taste, along with a little cooking oil to make the mushrooms glossy and prevent them from drying out. Marinate for about 10 minutes to absorb the flavors, then place in a pan to roast.
Roast the mushroom floss over low heat until it turns golden brown, then turn off the heat. Let it cool completely before storing it in a clean, airtight jar.

Mushroom floss is light and very good for health, especially for those on a diet or with cardiovascular disease or diabetes. This is also a unique dish to replace fish or meat floss for babies during the weaning stage. The final product should be fluffy, loose, and evenly golden. The seasoning should be well-balanced, and the fibers should be glossy and attractive rather than dry. Mushroom floss can be served with steamed rice, sticky rice, or porridge. For vegetarians, you can replace fish sauce with soy sauce or just use seasoning salt.
A few tips for making mushroom floss quickly and deliciously:
Mushroom stems must be boiled for 7-10 minutes to remove any harmful bacteria.
Shredding and pounding the mushrooms while they are still warm will be faster and require less effort. When pounding, use the pestle to smear around the mortar to make the floss fluff up faster.

mon_an.mo_ta: "Going to ceremonies all year round is not as important as the Full Moon of the First Lunar Month." This ancient saying affirms the importance of the first full moon in the spiritual life of Vietnamese people. Also known as the Lantern Festival or Thuong Nguyen Festival, it is the first full moon of the new year and is considered the best time to pray for peace for the rest of the year. Furthermore, as the economy develops and life becomes more competitive, people face more risks. Therefore, on these days, not only Buddhists but also many people flock to temples to perform rituals to pray for a peaceful and prosperous new year. Visiting temples on this day has become an indelible spiritual anchor in Vietnamese culture. Along with visiting temples, families also have the habit of eating vegetarian food on the full moon and the first day of the lunar month.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Green beans - 4 pieces (can be replaced with yardlong beans)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare ingredients
Soak the bean curd skin until soft, drain, and pat dry with paper towels or a clean cloth. Cut into two pieces the same size as the seaweed sheets (about 20cm square).

Peel and wash the taro, then cut into small pieces. Wash the mung beans, soak until soft, drain, and toss with a little salt. Place them in separate bowls. Steam the mung beans and taro in a steamer (keep them separate). Once soft, pound each ingredient separately in a mortar. When pounding the taro, mix in a little salt to taste.
Soak the wood ear mushrooms until expanded, trim the stems, wash, and julienne. Mix well with the mashed taro.
Take 1 carrot, peel, wash, and cut a long strip with a length equal to the side of the seaweed sheet.
Trim the ends of the green beans or yardlong beans and wash them.
Blanch the carrot strip and green beans in boiling water, then immediately plunge them into cold water to keep their colors vibrant and attractive.
Step 2: Layering the ingredients
Lay a piece of bean curd skin on a flat surface (a cutting board or tray) and spread the taro and wood ear mixture evenly over it.
Similarly, spread the mung beans evenly over a seaweed sheet, then place the seaweed sheet on top of the taro-covered bean curd skin.
Place the carrot strip in the center of the mung bean layer. From the center point towards the edges, place 2 green beans or yardlong beans.
Fold the bean curd skin in half and press gently so the ingredients stick together.
Step 3: Cooking
Deep-fry the roll in vegetable oil until golden, or more simply, steam it for 5-7 minutes until cooked through.
Step 4: Presentation

While waiting for the roll to fry or steam, prepare the plate, carrots, and chili for decoration. Carve the remaining carrot into a peacock's head and body, use a bird's eye chili for the beak, and thin slices of chili pinned to the head for the crest.
Once the roll is cooked, remove it and use a sharp knife to cut it into 1cm thick slices. Carefully arrange them on the plate to create a beautiful five-color peacock tail shape.
Tips for making peacock tail ham:
You can substitute ingredients according to your preference, such as replacing taro with purple sweet potato or mung beans with millet.

This dish is often steamed, but I prefer frying it in vegetable oil. When fried, the bean curd skin becomes crispy and golden, which looks beautiful and tastes great. That is why I categorize this as both a steamed and fried dish. Try frying it for a change; you will surely love it.
This dish can be served with a little soy sauce and a few slices of chili for garnish.

mon_an.ten: Stir-fried Tofu with Mushrooms and Eggplant
mon_an.mo_ta: An easy-to-make delicious dish – Stir-fried Tofu with Mushrooms and Eggplant for an appetizing meal. Add another nutritious tofu dish to your repertoire. This recipe uses readily available and low-cost ingredients, making it a tasty and easy-to-eat meal.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Garlic, cooking oil, fish sauce, oyster sauce, seasoning powder, ginger
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the tofu, cut into bite-sized pieces, and drain. Heat oil in a pan and fry the tofu until golden, then remove to a plate lined with paper towels.
Step 2: Wash the eggplant, cut into bite-sized pieces, and soak in diluted salt water to prevent browning. Drain well.
Step 3: Trim the mushroom stems, wash, and soak in diluted salt water. Drain well.
Step 4: Heat a pan and pan-sear the eggplant on both sides until slightly charred. Remove to a plate.
Step 5: Add a little oil to the pan, sauté the ginger and garlic until fragrant, then add the tofu and mushrooms. Season with salt and seasoning powder, stir well, and cook for 5-7 minutes.
Step 6: Add the eggplant to the pan. Drizzle with a little oyster sauce and adjust the seasoning to taste. When the eggplant is fully cooked, add the chopped green onions and stir well.
The delicious Stir-fried Tofu with Mushrooms and Eggplant is now complete.

mon_an.mo_ta: Tofu, a familiar ingredient in every family, can be transformed into something more interesting than just lemongrass fried tofu. This recipe for tofu with scallion sauce will enhance the appeal of your meal. Below, we share a simple and delicious recipe for you to enjoy a fresh flavor for your family dinner.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fish sauce - 1 tbsp (use vegetarian fish sauce for a vegan version)
cac_buoc: Step 1: To make tofu with scallion sauce, start by washing and cutting the tofu into bite-sized pieces, then drain well.

Step 2: Wash the green onions and use only the green parts, finely chopped (the white parts can be used for other dishes). In a large bowl, mix the dipping sauce using 6 tbsp water, 2 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp sugar, and 1 tsp MSG. Stir well and add the chopped green onions.

Step 3: Heat a pan and add oil to fry the tofu. To avoid oil splatters, pat the tofu dry with a towel before frying. Deep-fry the tofu so it cooks evenly, with a light golden crispy skin and a soft interior.

Step 4: When the tofu is golden brown, remove it and immediately drop it into the bowl of scallion fish sauce. Tofu is more delicious when hot. Finally, remove the tofu to a plate and garnish with more green onions. The dish will have a sweet and salty taste, with a chewy exterior and a rich, soft interior.
Notes for delicious tofu with scallion sauce:
When buying tofu, choose pieces that are creamy white, soft to the touch, not dry or hard, and free from sour smells or sliminess. Fresh tofu usually has a rich soy aroma and is not spongy when cut.
For the best flavor, use green onions with small bulbs and leaves that are not too pungent. The onions must be fresh and green.
If you are on a low-fat diet, you can use an air fryer to fry the tofu instead of deep-frying.
A few tips for the best results:
The secret to puffy, crispy fried tofu is to wait until the oil is very hot before adding the tofu and to deep-fry it. I often use a small non-stick pan or even a small pot to fry the tofu.
If you don't have a non-stick pan, let the tofu brown thoroughly on one side before flipping so it doesn't stick or break.
You can use vegetarian fish sauce to make this a delicious vegan dish. You can also refer to other vegan dishes like Peacock Tail Ham or Vegetarian Hủ Tiếu.
This is our method for making tofu with scallion sauce. We hope this article helps you create a great dish for your family. If you have any questions, please contact us for detailed answers.

mon_an.ten: How to Boil Bamboo Shoots to Remove Bitterness and Toxins
mon_an.mo_ta: Boiling bamboo shoots incorrectly can make them bitter and unappetizing. In this article, we will share information on how to boil bamboo shoots without bitterness, and how to select and boil them to ensure the best flavor. Learn how to prepare, choose, and boil bamboo shoots to ensure a delicious taste. Avoid bitterness and enjoy a great meal with these detailed instructions.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fermented soybean paste (Tương bần) - As needed
cac_buoc: Method 1: Boil multiple times to reduce bitterness. After peeling the fresh bamboo shoots, boil them in water several times, rinsing with clean water each time until the shoots are soft and no longer bitter, then proceed with cooking.

Method 2: Soak bamboo shoots in rice water to remove bitterness. After boiling 2-3 times, place the bamboo shoots in rice water for 2 days. Change the rice water regularly to prevent fermentation and odors. Wash thoroughly before using.
Method 3: Soak bamboo shoots in lime water to reduce bitterness. Peel and soak the shoots in lime water. Boil several times until the water in the pot is no longer cloudy. Wash thoroughly and cook.

Method 4: Boil with Katuk leaves (rau bồ ngót) to remove bitterness. After boiling the shoots with Katuk leaves once, drain the water and rinse with cold water. Rinse again with cold water before cooking.

Method 5: Boil with rice water and chili. Boil fresh bamboo shoots with their skins on and add a few deseeded chili slices to the rice water. Wash thoroughly and continue boiling 2-3 times before use.

Method 6: Soak overnight in filtered water to soften and reduce toxins. After peeling the outer leaves and slicing or shredding, soak the bamboo shoots in clean water overnight. Change the water regularly and wash thoroughly the next day before cooking.
Notes:
When boiling or cooking bamboo shoots, keep the lid open so that toxins can evaporate instead of being absorbed back into the shoots.
Before drying bamboo shoots, soak fresh shoots in salt water. When using dried bamboo shoots, wash and blanch them before cooking.
Pickling bamboo shoots is also a method to reduce toxicity and bring a unique flavor to the dish.
How to choose fresh, non-bitter bamboo shoots:
To avoid bitter and toxic shoots, you must choose fresh ones.

Select fresh shoots with thin skins that are not withered, yellowed, crushed, or spotted. The shoots should be thick, uniform in size, not warped, crisp, juicy, young, and have a characteristic aroma.

If the shoots are unusually white or yellow, or have a foul smell (a sign of chemical soaking), do not use them. People with malaria, physical weakness, or malnutrition should avoid eating bamboo shoots. Regardless of how delicious they are, do not eat them too frequently.
How to boil fresh bamboo shoots to detoxify:
If you are wondering how to remove toxins from fresh bamboo shoots, follow these steps. First, buy fresh, high-quality shoots. Peel and wash them.
Use a knife to slice the bamboo into thin, even layers. Place them in a pot and boil for about 10 minutes once the water is boiling. Do not cover the pot. This allows toxins to evaporate quickly.
However, avoid boiling for too long, as this can make the shoots mushy and ruin the texture of hotpots or stir-fries.
These are the secrets to boiling bamboo shoots without bitterness. Visit us regularly for more recipes and kitchen tips!
Step 1: Prepare ingredients
Boil the hủ tiếu noodles until tender, then drain in a colander.
Peel and wash the carrot. Score symmetrical lines around the carrot and slice thinly to create beautiful flower shapes.
Trim the stems of all mushrooms, wash, and drain. Halve the straw mushrooms and slice the king oyster mushrooms diagonally.
Clean and wash the green onions and culantro, then chop finely.
Step 2: Cook the broth

Pour the vegetable broth into a pot, bring to a boil, and season to taste. Add the carrots and mushrooms and boil thoroughly until all ingredients are soft. Note: Mushrooms should be boiled for at least 10 minutes to ensure any toxins are neutralized.
Step 3: Presentation

Place the noodles in a bowl. Use a spoon to scoop out the carrots and various mushrooms from the broth and arrange them beautifully on top of the noodles. Top with chopped green onions and culantro, then pour the hot broth into the bowl. Serve hot.
A few tips for vegetarian hủ tiếu:

Since this is a vegetarian dish without meat, using brown rice hủ tiếu noodles adds more nutrition. Brown rice is rich in starch, protein, fat, fiber, and vitamins like B1, B2, B3, B6, and beneficial acids. Using brown rice helps regulate blood pressure, reduce bad cholesterol, and prevent heart disease. However, regular hủ tiếu noodles are also fine.

There are many ways to make vegetarian broth. You can make it from mushrooms, vegetables, roots, seeds, or fruits. Simply simmer the ingredients until the sweetness is extracted. We will have a separate guide on making delicious vegetarian broth.
When adding mushrooms, make sure to boil them thoroughly for at least 10 minutes to eliminate any harmful toxins, molds, or bacteria.
You can also try other delicious vegetarian dishes like Peacock Tail Ham or Tofu with Scallion Sauce (using vegetarian fish sauce).

mon_an.ten: Vegetarian Stir-fried Rice Vermicelli with Vegetables
mon_an.mo_ta: Vegetarian stir-fried vermicelli is a very popular dish in Vietnamese culinary culture. With simple ingredients like fresh vegetables, fresh tofu, fried vegetarian items, and soy sauce. In this article, we will guide you on how to make soft, delicious stir-fried vegetarian vermicelli at home! Enjoy a flavorful vegetarian meal with fresh, soft rice vermicelli and vegetables. Learn how to prepare the ingredients and follow the detailed steps to create a nutritious dish.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare ingredients
Wash all vegetables and bean sprouts, then cut into bite-sized pieces. Shred the carrots and king oyster mushroom.
Heat a pan with oil. Add the vegetables and mushrooms and stir-fry over high heat until cooked. If you want to reduce oil, you can blanch the vegetables and mushrooms instead.
Fry the tofu until both sides are golden brown. If you bought pre-fried tofu, you can skip this. Slice the tofu into thin strips.

In a pot, bring water to a boil and add the vermicelli and noodles. Add 1/3 tsp salt and 1 tsp cooking oil. Boil the vermicelli for about 2 minutes and the noodles for about 5 minutes. Ensure the vermicelli remains chewy and not mushy.
Step 2: Stir-fry the vermicelli
After boiling, remove the vermicelli and noodles, soak in cold water, and let cool.
Prepare a simple vegetarian mixing sauce by combining soy sauce, water, sugar, lime juice, and chili in a bowl until well blended.
Once the vermicelli and noodles are cool, place them in a large bowl, add the vegetables, mushrooms, and tofu. Mix well so all components are combined.
Step 3: Prepare the dipping sauce

To make the dipping sauce more flavorful, prepare a small bowl and mix 1 tbsp warm water, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 3 tsp sugar, 1 tsp lime juice, 1 tsp vinegar, and a little vegetarian seasoning powder. Stir until completely dissolved. Add sliced chili if you like it spicy.
If you don't like soy sauce, you can substitute it with a vegetarian fish sauce made from simmered pineapple juice, sugar, soy sauce, and salt. This sauce is still light and delicious.
Step 4: Final product
To present the stir-fried vermicelli attractively, arrange it evenly on a plate. Top with 2 spring rolls and 2 fried wontons. Garnish with a sprig of cilantro and a sprinkle of whole roasted peanuts.
Place the dipping sauce bowl next to the plate.

Stir-fried rice vermicelli is best served hot when the noodles are soft and the sauce is well absorbed. You can use this recipe for full moon days or the first of the month. It is also a great way to vary your daily family meals.
Notes for making vegetarian stir-fried rice vermicelli:
Buddhists avoid the "Five Pungent Spices": onions, garlic, chives, leeks, and asafoetida. Therefore, do not use these spices if cooking for religious reasons.
To reduce fat, you can boil the vegetables instead of stir-frying them, then mix them with the vermicelli.
For a vegetarian dish, do not use meat broth, animal fat, or any non-vegetarian ingredients.
You can substitute vegetables according to your preference, as long as they are vegan.
Stir-fried vermicelli should be eaten within the day and not left overnight to prevent it from spoiling.
Fried items can be added for extra flavor, but you can skip them if preferred.
You can also substitute with brown rice vermicelli or vegetarian noodles according to your taste. The preparation method remains the same.

mon_an.mo_ta: Start the new month with a nutritious vegetarian dish. Introducing delicious and crispy breaded fried tofu that is absolutely fantastic.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: For the sweet chili sauce: - Sugar - 3 tbsp
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Pat the tofu dry with paper towels, then cut into 2.5 cm cubes.
Step 2:
Add the remaining ingredients (except for the sweet chili sauce ingredients) into a large bowl.
Mix everything well.
Step 3:
Add the tofu.
Toss the tofu in the flour mixture until fully coated.
Step 4:
Preheat a frying pan, add 3/4 cup vegetable oil and bring to a boil. Carefully place the breaded tofu pieces into the pan to avoid oil splatters.
Fry the tofu until all sides are golden brown (about 5 minutes). Gently remove the tofu.
Step 5:
Place the fried tofu on paper towels to drain. Then, transfer the tofu to an oven at nearly 100°C to keep warm.
Step 6:
Now make the sweet chili sauce: mix all sauce ingredients in a small saucepan.
Cook the sauce for about 5 minutes, whisking constantly until it thickens. Turn off the heat, cover, and keep warm.
Step 7: Arrange the crispy fried tofu on a plate, pour the sweet chili sauce into a bowl, and enjoy!

mon_an.mo_ta: Crispy beer-battered button mushrooms are a unique dish with soft, smooth mushroom flesh infused with beer flavor, blended with egg and spices, and a crispy outer shell. This delicious dish is perfect for home parties or a cozy family meal after a long day!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: All-purpose flour or frying flour - 1 cup
cac_buoc: Instructions for making beer-battered fried button mushrooms
Step 1: Prepare ingredients
Wash the fresh parsley and mince it finely.
Melt the butter in a microwave or on the stove so it is liquid and won't clump when frying.
Crack the egg into a bowl, separating the yolk and the white.
Trim the stems of the button mushrooms, wash thoroughly with cold water, and let them dry completely.
Step 2: Cooking process
First, sift the flour and salt into a large bowl, then add the minced parsley and mix well until combined.

Next, add the melted butter and beer to the egg yolk bowl and whisk vigorously so the butter doesn't clump and blends with the egg and beer. Do not add too much beer, or the mixture will be too thin and the beer smell will overpower the mushroom flavor.

Create a well in the center of the flour mixture and pour in the egg yolk mixture. Use a whisk or hand mixer to blend until the batter is smooth and lump-free. If the mixture is too thick, add a little more beer for the right consistency.
Once the mixture is smooth, let the batter rest for half an hour to rise.
Next, use a hand mixer to beat the egg white until it forms stiff peaks. If you don't have a mixer, you can do this by hand. Whisk steadily for a smooth and quick result.
After the egg white is stiff and the batter has rested, fold the egg white into the batter until smooth.
Finally, heat oil in a deep pan or small pot. Use enough oil so the mushrooms can be deep-fried until crispy and golden.
When the oil is hot, dip each mushroom into the batter to coat completely, then quickly drop into the oil.
Fry until the outer shell is a beautiful golden brown, then remove. Remember to flip them so they cook evenly and don't burn.
Once cooked, remove the mushrooms and place them on paper towels to remove excess oil.
Finally, arrange the beer-battered mushrooms on a plate and eat while hot. You can enjoy them with chili sauce or sweet and sour sauce.
Notes:
When frying, do not use too high a heat to prevent the mushrooms from burning or drying out quickly.
Besides button mushrooms, you can use the same method for boneless fish or meat.

mon_an.ten: Vegetarian Lotus Seed and Shiitake Mushroom Soup
mon_an.mo_ta: Let's cook a quick lotus seed and shiitake mushroom soup for the first day of the month. We hope this recipe helps you create a delicious dish for your family!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare ingredients
Wash the lotus seeds and remove the bitter germ (if any), then drain.
Peel and wash the carrot. Use a sharp knife to score the sides to carve flowers, then cut into 1cm thick slices.
Trim the stems of the mushrooms, wash, and drain.
Trim the roots of the cilantro, wash, and chop finely.
Step 2: Cook the soup
Place the lotus seeds in a pot with cold water, bring to a boil, and season with salt and seasoning powder to taste. Lower the heat and simmer until the lotus seeds are soft.
Add the mushrooms and boil for 5-7 minutes, then add the carrots and cook until tender. Finally, add the cubed silken tofu. Adjust the seasoning to taste and turn off the heat.
Step 3: Presentation
Scoop the mushrooms, lotus seeds, and carrots into a bowl, arrange them beautifully, sprinkle with chopped cilantro, and pour the broth over. Serve hot.
A few tips for a delicious vegetarian mushroom soup:
You can use fresh or dried lotus seeds. Fresh lotus seeds make the soup more fragrant and save time (no need to soak or simmer as long as dried ones).
I usually buy lotus seeds in season (around May), peel them, remove the germ, and store them in the freezer. This way, they can be kept for up to a year without losing much flavor. Give it a try.
Mushrooms should be boiled for 7-10 minutes to ensure they are cooked and any toxins are neutralized for safety.

Silken tofu is very soft and breaks easily, so add it last to keep the soup looking good. Drop it in gently and do not stir with a spoon or chopsticks. When serving, use a ladle to gently lift the tofu into the bowl.

If you don't want a vegetarian version, you can use bone broth or cook the soup with pork ribs or meat paste balls. The lotus seed mushroom soup will still be very delicious. This is a great vegetarian dish for the start of the month.
You can also refer to other attractive vegetarian recipes like Vegetarian Hủ Tiếu or Peacock Tail Ham.

mon_an.ten: Fried Vegetarian Spare Ribs with Lemongrass and Chili
cac_buoc: Fried vegetarian spare ribs with lemongrass and chili is a savory and appealing dish that offers an exciting flavor while remaining fresh. The vegetarian ribs are crispy in the mouth, combined with a fragrant layer of lemongrass and chili, creating a perfect dish. In just a few minutes, you will have this delicious meal ready.
I. Traditional Method for Fried Vegetarian Spare Ribs with Lemongrass and Chili
1. Prepare ingredients
4 pieces vegetarian spare ribs
2 lemongrass stalks
2 chilies
Minced shallots
Seasonings: cooking oil, vegetarian seasoning powder, sugar, MSG, chili sauce, and annatto powder (or turmeric powder).
2. Cooking steps
Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
First, after purchasing the vegetarian spare ribs, soak them in a bowl of cold water.
Once the ribs have softened, wash them and squeeze out the excess water.

Prepare a small amount of filtered water, then add 1 tsp of vegetarian seasoning powder and 1 tsp of annatto powder. Stir well and pour this mixture over the ribs so the seasoning absorbs into the pieces.
Afterward, squeeze the ribs again to remove excess liquid.
Use scissors to cut the ribs into small pieces or halves depending on your preference.
Wash the lemongrass and chilies, then mince them finely.
Step 2: Fry the ribs
Place a pan on the stove and add enough cooking oil so it is about 1 finger-joint deep.
When the oil is hot, place all the vegetarian ribs into the pan and fry over medium heat.
Fry the ribs until they are golden brown and crispy on both sides.
Remove the ribs from the pan and drain the oil on a plate lined with paper towels.
Next, you can proceed with the following steps to finish and enjoy these delicious fried vegetarian ribs at home.
Step 3: Sauté the ribs with lemongrass and chili
Place another pan on the stove and add 1 tbsp of cooking oil. Then, add a bit of minced shallots to the pan.
When the shallots are fragrant and golden, add the minced lemongrass and stir well with chopsticks.
Once the lemongrass is golden and fragrant, add the minced chilies, 1 tsp of vegetarian seasoning powder, 1 tsp of sugar, ½ tsp of MSG, ½ tbsp of chili sauce, and 1 tbsp of filtered water to the pan.
Stir all ingredients until the sauce thickens, then add the fried vegetarian ribs to the pan.
Fry the ribs over low heat and toss well so the seasoning coats every piece.
Finally, when the ribs are evenly coated with seasoning, turn off the heat and transfer the fried ribs with lemongrass and chili to a plate.
Finished product

The finished fried vegetarian spare ribs with lemongrass and chili will have an attractive color. With the spicy kick from lemongrass and chili, and the crispy, savory texture of the ribs, this dish offers a perfectly balanced salty and sweet flavor. Enjoying these ribs with hot rice will enhance the deliciousness.
II. Restaurant-Style Fried Vegetarian Spare Ribs with Lemongrass and Chili
1 pack vegetarian spare ribs
2 tbsp minced lemongrass
3 garlic cloves
1/2 liter cooking oil
1 tsp chili sauce
1 tbsp vegetarian fish sauce
1 tsp vegetarian seasoning powder
1 tbsp sugar
2. Processing method
2.1. Prepare the vegetarian ribs
After buying the vegetarian ribs, soak them in water for about 1 hour or until soft. Change the soaking water 2-3 times to reduce the floury smell.
Once soft, squeeze out the water by hand and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Tips:
Changing the soaking water helps remove the floury odor from the ribs.
Squeezing out all the water helps reduce oil splattering during frying and makes the ribs crispier.
2.2. Fry the ribs
Place a pan on the stove and add 1/2 liter of cooking oil. Wait until the oil is hot.
When the oil is hot, add the vegetarian ribs and fry over medium heat. Stir constantly to ensure the ribs do not burn.
Fry until the ribs are golden and crispy. Then, remove them from the pan and place on paper towels to remove excess oil.
Tip: Remove the ribs while the oil is still hot, as they will absorb less oil. Do not turn off the stove before removing the ribs.
2.3. Sauté with lemongrass and chili
Using the same pan used for frying, pour out most of the oil, leaving about 1 tsp.
Next, add minced chili and garlic to the pan and sauté until fragrant.
Add the minced lemongrass and stir-fry with the chili and garlic.
Next, add 1 tbsp of vegetarian fish sauce, 1 tsp of vegetarian seasoning powder, 1 tbsp of sugar, and 1 tsp of chili sauce to the pan. Stir well to combine the seasonings.
When the sauce mixture boils and thickens, add the fried ribs to the pan and toss well so the ribs are coated with lemongrass, chili, and seasonings. Keep the heat low during this process.
Once the ribs are evenly coated, turn off the heat.
2.4. Finished product

You have now completed the fried vegetarian spare ribs with lemongrass and chili. The chewy, sweet ribs combined with the aroma of lemongrass and the spicy-sweet sauce create a very attractive vegetarian dish. Enjoy with white rice and boiled vegetables to enhance the flavor.
III. Notes when making fried vegetarian spare ribs with lemongrass and chili
Check the ribs: Before starting, check the vegetarian ribs to ensure they are soft and suitable for frying. If necessary, soak in water for about 1 hour.
Squeeze dry: After softening, squeeze out the water by hand to remove excess moisture. This helps the ribs fry crispier and prevents oil splattering.
Ensure hot oil: When frying, make sure the oil is sufficiently hot before adding the ribs. This helps them fry evenly without absorbing too much oil.
Stir carefully: While sautéing lemongrass and garlic, always stir carefully to avoid burning. Keep the heat at medium and stir well.
Seasoning and sauce: When adding seasonings and sauce, stir well to blend the flavors. Only add the fried ribs once the sauce has boiled and thickened so they absorb the flavor.
Enjoy: Once finished, enjoy the ribs with white rice and boiled vegetables to fully appreciate the delicious taste of this vegetarian dish.
IV. Where to buy vegetarian spare ribs

Currently, you can easily find vegetarian spare ribs at supermarkets, large grocery stores, or reputable vegetarian food stores nationwide. The price for 150g of vegetarian spare ribs ranges from 50,000 – 60,000 VNĐ (price updated in August 2021).
When buying, choose bags with full information on origin, expiration date, and nutritional ingredients printed on the packaging. This ensures peace of mind regarding quality.

To ensure safety, choose famous brands trusted by many and sold at reputable locations. Avoid buying bags with torn packaging, deflated bags, or those showing mold spots on the ribs to ensure the product is in the best condition.

mon_an.ten: Simple Home-Style Sweet and Savory Braised Vegetarian Spare Ribs
mon_an.mo_ta: Vegetarian spare ribs, made from plant-based ingredients, have become a versatile and easy-to-find ingredient at vegetarian stores or supermarkets. Don't miss the chance to enjoy sweet and savory braised vegetarian ribs, a unique and attractive combination. This dish is not only delicious and unique, but the preparation is also extremely simple. Refer to the instructions below to show off your cooking skills with this tasty, nutritious, and special vegetarian dish. Sweet and Savory Braised Vegetarian Spare Ribs: An appealing dish featuring fresh vegetarian ribs, skillfully braised with bold sweet and savory seasonings. Enjoying this dish, you will experience a perfect blend of unique flavors, nutrients, and richness.
cac_buoc: I. How to make sweet and savory braised vegetarian spare ribs
1. Prepare ingredients
100 g vegetarian spare ribs.
Horn chilies, scallions, and garlic.
Seasonings including vegetarian seasoning powder, sugar, vegetarian fish sauce, and chili sauce.
2. Cooking steps
2. 1. Prepare the ingredients

Start by soaking the purchased vegetarian ribs in cold water for about 45 - 60 minutes to soften them. Then, use your hands to squeeze the ribs firmly to remove water, and cut them into small, bite-sized pieces crosswise.
For the garlic, peel, crush, and mince finely.
2. 2. Fry the ribs

Fry the ribs over medium heat for about 3-5 minutes until both sides are evenly golden brown, then remove them from the pan. Next, to take advantage of the hot oil, scoop a little oil into a bowl and add chopped scallions to make scallion oil.
2. 3. Braise the ribs

Start by adding the minced garlic, chili, and scallion whites to the pan and sauté until fragrant. Then, add 2 tsp of sugar, 1 tsp of vegetarian seasoning powder, 1 tsp of chili sauce, 2 tsp of vegetarian fish sauce, and 30 ml of filtered water to the pan.

Cook until the sauce thickens, then pour all the fried ribs from the previous step into the pan, toss well, and turn off the heat. Finally, transfer the ribs to a plate and top with a bit of scallion oil. The sweet and savory braised vegetarian ribs are now complete.
2.4. Finished product

Sweet and savory braised vegetarian ribs is an attractive vegetarian dish with a wonderful combination of ingredients. The dish offers a chewy texture, a salty taste intertwined with a hint of sweetness from the ribs, along with the aroma and richness of the scallion oil.
II. How to make sweet and savory braised vegetarian ribs with lemon
6 pieces vegetarian spare ribs.
5 tbsp cooking oil.
3 tbsp lemon juice.
2 tbsp chili sauce.
3 tbsp sugar.
1 tsp salt.
2 garlic cloves.
1 horn chili.
2. Prepare the ingredients
Soak the vegetarian ribs in cold water for about 45 - 60 minutes to soften them. Then, use your hands to squeeze out the water, rinse with cold water, and squeeze once more.
Once dry, cut the ribs into bite-sized pieces crosswise.
Peel 2 garlic cloves, crush, and mince. Wash the horn chili and mince it. Note to keep the chili and garlic separate, do not mix them.
3. Fry the ribs
To fry the ribs, place a pan on the stove and add 3 tbsp of cooking oil, then heat until the oil begins to shimmer. Next, add the cut ribs to the pan to fry.
Adjust the heat to medium and stir constantly to ensure the ribs do not burn. When all sides are golden brown, remove the ribs from the pan and place them on a plate.
4. Make the sauce
To make the sauce, first place a pan on the stove and add 2 tbsp of cooking oil. Then, add the minced garlic and chili and sauté them.
When the garlic and chili are fragrant, add 3 tbsp of lemon juice, 3 tbsp of granulated sugar, 2 tbsp of chili sauce, and 1 tsp of salt to the pan. Stir the mixture well.
Set the heat to medium and continue stirring until the mixture boils and begins to thicken.
5. Braise the ribs
Once the mixture in the pan has thickened, add the fried ribs and braise evenly for about 5 minutes. Then, turn off the heat and serve the braised ribs on a presentation plate.
Notes when making braised vegetarian ribs
Vegetarian ribs: Choose fresh ribs that are not too hard. If they are dry or hard, soak in cold water for 45 – 60 minutes to soften before use.
Squeeze water: Before frying, squeeze all water out of the ribs to avoid oil splattering and to prevent losing the crispiness.
Fry the ribs: Ensure you use medium heat when frying to ensure they cook evenly without burning. Turn them constantly to ensure an even golden brown color.
Braising mixture: When braising, ensure the mixture has thickened before adding the ribs. This helps the sauce coat the ribs better and provides a better flavor.
Braising time: Braise for about 5 minutes to ensure the mixture absorbs evenly and creates a rich flavor.

mon_an.mo_ta: Tofu with vegetable sauce is prepared from mostly vegetable ingredients; however, this easy-to-make vegetarian dish is very savory and particularly suitable for rainy days. At the beginning of the month, let's head to the kitchen to make this delicious dish for the whole family to enjoy.
cac_buoc: Step 1:

Leave the tofu blocks whole, wash gently under clean running water. To make the dish look attractive, use a serrated knife to trim a thin layer off the four edges of the tofu block. Then drain and sprinkle 1/2 tsp of vegetarian seasoning powder on both sides of the tofu.
Remove the tough ends of the asparagus, peel the fibrous part near the base, wash, and cut into 1 cm pieces. Wash the green beans and cut into pieces the same size as the asparagus.
Peel the carrots, wash, and cut into 1x1 cm cubes.
Wash the fresh shiitake mushrooms and dice them to the same size as the carrots. Wash the corn kernels.
Wash the celery, drain, and mince.
Step 2:

Make the sauce: Heat the oil, then add the carrots, green beans, celery, asparagus, shiitake mushrooms, and corn kernels in order and stir-fry until cooked. Next, season with sweet bean sauce, soy sauce, broth, vegetarian seasoning powder, and sugar; simmer until the sauce thickens.
Steam the tofu until hot, then arrange on a plate and pour the hot sauce over it. Garnish with celery. Enjoy while hot.

mon_an.ten: Refreshing Red Cabbage and Apple Salad
mon_an.mo_ta: For those who enjoy vegetarian food, this refreshing red cabbage and apple salad is a perfect choice. Apples are a fruit rich in vitamins good for health, also suitable for those wishing to lose weight. This guide will help you make this easy and delicious dish.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Honey, apple cider vinegar, salad oil - 2 tsp each
cac_buoc: Let's learn how to make this easy and delicious dish!
Step 1: Shred the red and green cabbage, wash thoroughly, and place in a large bowl.
Step 2: Wash the carrot, peel, julienne, and then finely chop. Finely chop the scallions. Add the carrot and scallions to the bowl with the cabbage.
Step 3: Take the celery leaves, wash, finely chop, and add to the bowl.
Step 4: Wash the apple, peel, julienne, and add to the bowl.
Step 5: Prepare a glass jar, add the honey, apple cider vinegar, lime juice, salad oil, salt, pepper, and chili powder. Close the lid and let the dressing sit for 30 minutes to infuse.
Step 6: Pour the dressing mixture into the bowl and toss the cabbage salad thoroughly. Let it marinate, and you have completed the refreshing red cabbage and apple salad.

mon_an.mo_ta: Crispy potato-wrapped sausages will make you want to eat them again after just one try; each piece is crunchy and rich with the sausage inside. This dish is even better when eaten with chili sauce or ketchup. Refer to the recipe below!
cac_buoc: Ingredients to prepare:
Step 1:
After buying the potatoes, peel them and slice them as shown in the picture. Then place the peeled potatoes in a bowl of water mixed with salt and soak for 15 minutes to remove the sap.
After draining the potatoes, boil them until cooked.
A tip to check if the potatoes are cooked is to use a chopstick to pierce them; if it goes through easily, they are done.

When the potatoes are cooked, drain all the water from the pot and place it back on the stove. Heat over low heat to prevent the potatoes from burning or becoming too mushy. You must watch the pot carefully; only heat for about 1 minute then turn off the stove, otherwise the potatoes will burn!
Step 2:
Put the boiled potatoes in a large bowl, add a little salt, then use a potato masher, a sturdy spoon, or a ladle to mash the potatoes until smooth.
Step 3:

To ensure food safety and hygiene, you should use clean plastic gloves. Roll the mashed potatoes into balls, then flatten them, place a sausage in the center, then wrap it up and use your hands to squeeze and shape it into a block as shown below.
Step 4:
Repeat the process until all the potatoes and sausages are used.
Step 5:
Put the panko breadcrumbs on a large plate, then roll the potato-wrapped sausages through the crumbs so they are completely coated on the outside.
Step 6:
To make the dish taste right, you should use a deep pot or a non-stick pan on the stove. Add enough cooking oil to partially submerge the potatoes.
Heat the oil until very hot, then drop each potato ball into the pot. Roll them gently so they turn golden brown on all sides.
You should fry over medium heat; do not use too low a heat as it will cause the potatoes to absorb oil and break apart easily.
Step 7:
When the potatoes are evenly golden brown on all sides, remove them and place them on a plate. You should place them on paper towels to absorb excess grease.
This dish is best enjoyed hot. You can skewer the potatoes (if liked) and serve with ketchup or chili sauce for a very delicious treat!

mon_an.ten: Braised Mackerel with Garlic and Chili
mon_an.mo_ta: Braised mackerel with garlic and chili makes for a delicious meal. Mackerel is a saltwater fish rich in nutrients such as DHA and Omega-3, which are excellent for the development of children and women. This dish is easy to prepare and enjoy for the whole family, offering a highly nutritious option.
cac_buoc: Step 1: To prepare the Braised Mackerel with Garlic and Chili, first:
Wash the mackerel thoroughly. Lightly grill both sides in a microwave (grill mode) or over charcoal.
Peel and crush the garlic. Wash the chilies, slice lengthwise to remove seeds, and mince. If cooking for children, reduce the amount of chili.
Step 2: In a small bowl, mix the following: fish sauce, sugar, garlic, chili, water, and a pinch of seasoning powder.

Step 3: Turn on the heat. Place the mackerel and the sauce mixture from step 2 into a pan. Simmer on low heat so the fish absorbs the flavors. Occasionally flip the fish to ensure even seasoning for a better taste. Simmer until the sauce has almost reduced, then turn off the heat.
Once the fish is cooked, turn off the heat and transfer to a plate. Pour the remaining sauce over the fish, sprinkle with a little pepper, and serve hot with steamed rice.

mon_an.ten: Simple and Delicious Cheese-Stuffed Fish Balls
mon_an.mo_ta: Cheese-stuffed fish balls are a unique and nutritious dish featuring soft, flavorful fish meat and a melting cheese center. With its attractive colors and simple preparation, this dish is perfect for family parties or everyday meals. Let's get into the kitchen and learn how to make this delicious treat!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Cheese slices (square slices, such as cheddar or mozzarella) - 50 gr
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, cut the cheese into bite-sized cubes. Be careful not to let the cheese crumble while cutting!
Step 2:

Clean and dry the featherback fish, then grind it finely. If you prefer a bit of texture, you can grind it coarsely. Season the fish with salt and pepper to taste. You can also add some chopped dill to the mixture to enhance the flavor and reduce any fishy scent.
Step 3:
Take a portion of the fish paste in your hand, flatten it, and place a piece of cheese in the center.
Step 4:
Roll the fish into a ball. Ensure the fish completely encloses the cheese so it doesn't leak out during frying.
Repeat until all the fish paste is used.
Step 5:
Place the flour on a plate, then coat each fish ball in a layer of flour.
Step 6:
Continue this process for all the fish balls.
Step 7:
Prepare a pan with oil for frying. Use a small, deep pan to save oil and ensure the fish balls are fully submerged, which makes them crispier and tastier.
Step 8:
When the oil is hot, add the fish balls and fry until the outer shell is golden and firm. Do not fry for too long, or the cheese might melt and leak out.
Step 9:
Once fried, remove the fish balls and place them on paper towels to drain excess oil. Arrange on a plate with fresh greens and enjoy.
Notes for making cheese-stuffed fish balls:
When frying, use a deep pan to save oil and ensure the fish is crispy. Flip the fish balls regularly so they cook evenly on both sides without burning!

How to choose good featherback fish: Fresh featherback fish is usually translucent, white with light pink streaks, and occasionally spots of red blood. Once scraped, the meat should be shiny and beautiful, not dull or bluish (a bluish color often comes with a foul odor).

When kneading the fish paste, do it thoroughly and for a long time until it becomes very sticky and feels heavy in your hand. Cooked featherback fish should be fragrant and springy. The fish is cooked when it floats to the surface; if not eating immediately, remove it anyway. Reheat it just before serving, as leaving it in a simmering pot for too long will make the texture mushy.
If you don't like featherback fish, you can substitute it with other types like carp or tuna. However, carp is a great alternative as its meat is firm, fragrant, and not easily tiring to eat.

mon_an.ten: Crispy Fried Fish Balls with Mayonnaise Filling
mon_an.mo_ta: With this recipe for crispy fried fish balls with mayonnaise filling, you will not only provide a delicious meal for your family but also a treat that kids will love! Check out our guide on how to make this dish below.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Bronze featherback fish paste (or other fish) - 250g
Mayonnaise, pepper, cooking oil, seasoning powder
cac_buoc: Ingredients you need to prepare for this dish:
Step 1:
Trim the roots of the dill, wash, and finely chop.
Wash the chili, remove seeds, and mince.

Combine the fish paste, pork paste, dill, and chili (omit if cooking for children) in a large bowl. Add pepper and seasoning powder, then use a spoon to mix and pound the mixture until smooth and elastic.
Step 2:

Wear plastic gloves and grease your hands with a little oil. Take a spoonful of the fish mixture, flatten it in your palm, place a dollop of mayonnaise in the center, then roll it into a ball and coat it in instant porridge or breadcrumbs.
To make shaping easier, you can freeze the mayonnaise beforehand until firm.
Step 3:
Heat oil in a pan. Once the oil is hot, add the fish balls and fry over medium heat until golden brown.
Step 4:
Once cooked, remove the fish balls and place them on a plate lined with paper towels to drain, then serve. This dish is delicious served hot with ketchup or chili sauce.

mon_an.mo_ta: Scallops are not only delicious but also highly nutritious. This has made them a versatile ingredient prepared in many different styles, offering a variety of flavors. Today, we will guide you through making attractive crispy fried scallops, a wonderful choice for treating your family. Enjoy this flavorful and enticing dish. Follow this guide to create a unique meal for your loved ones. Scallops are both tasty and healthy, making them a popular choice for various recipes. Discover how to make these delicious and appealing crispy scallops.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Preparing the scallops
After purchasing the scallops, use a pointed knife to gently pry open one side of the shell. Then, slide the knife gently under the meat to remove it from the shell.

Remove the dark parts, muscle fibers, small cartilage, and the stomach surrounding the white meat. Keep only the white meat (the scallop). Wash the meat with salt water and vinegar, then blanch briefly in boiling water for 2 - 3 minutes and rinse with cold water; drain well.

A quick and simple way to shuck scallops is to use a specialized shucking knife and a sharp knife to remove the meat from the shell. Once the shell is open, slide the knife gently underneath to detach the meat. Remove the dark parts surrounding the white meat, as this is the digestive tract, which includes a black sac and an intestine filled with grit. Also, remove the cartilage, as it is not used in this dish.
After detaching the meat from the shell, remove it gently, keeping the mantle (the frill), the white scallop, and the red roe.
For pre-shucked scallop meat, soak it in diluted salt water and vinegar for about 10 minutes after purchasing, then blanch in boiling water for 2 - 3 minutes and rinse with cold water; drain well.

To remove the fishy odor, after shucking, you can soak the scallops in water mixed with salt and lemon juice. You can also rub them with rice wine or vinegar. Another effective way is to blanch the meat in boiling water with a bit of crushed lemongrass and ginger for 1 - 2 minutes.
Step 2: Marinating the scallops
Marinate the scallops by mixing 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tbsp sugar, 1/2 tbsp seasoning powder, and a little ground pepper. Toss well and let the scallops absorb the flavors for 15-20 minutes.
Next, dredge the scallop meat in crispy frying flour, ensuring they are evenly coated.
Step 3: Frying the scallops
Then, dip the scallops into the bowl of beaten eggs and coat them with a layer of breadcrumbs.
Heat 100ml of cooking oil in a pan and add the scallops to fry over medium heat. Fry until golden brown on both sides, then remove and drain well.
Arrange the breaded scallops on a plate and garnish to create an attractive presentation.

The breaded scallops have an eye-catching golden crust, crispy on the outside while the meat inside remains tender and sweet, creating a delightful flavor. It is incomparable when dipped in a bit of chili sauce or plum sauce.
This breaded scallop dish is sure to become a favorite for many. Don't hesitate to try it and experience it for yourself!
How to choose fresh scallops
You can choose to buy whole scallops and shuck them yourself, or buy pre-shucked scallop meat available at stores and supermarkets.
It is advisable to purchase scallops from reputable stores and supermarkets.
If buying whole scallops, choose live ones with shells that are tightly closed and not gaping open.
Avoid buying dead, damaged, or undersized scallops.
When buying shucked scallops, choose those with a fresh scent and firm meat, without any unpleasant odors. The meat should be translucent and not overly slimy.
If choosing packaged scallops, pay attention to the expiry date on the packaging and select those with firm meat that is not watery, slimy, or foul-smelling.

mon_an.mo_ta: Have you ever tried skewering tofu to look like BBQ meat? Let's gather the ingredients and start making this unique sesame-glazed tofu dish right away!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 50gr crushed roasted peanuts, 15gr white sesame seeds, 15gr black sesame powder
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Rinse the tofu and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Step 2:
Then, coat the tofu with black sesame powder (mixed with a little water).
Step 3:
Next, mix the garlic sauce with a little water and the mashed silken tofu.
Step 4:
Crush the roasted peanuts and mix with white sesame seeds and a bit of chili powder.
Step 5:
Heat oil in a pan and fry the tofu; once it's evenly golden brown, it's ready!
Step 6:
Simply brush the sauce over the tofu and coat it with the roasted peanuts.
Enjoy!

mon_an.mo_ta: On cold winter days, fried beef with sesame seeds is a wonderful choice to make your family meal more diverse and appealing. With an eye-catching golden-brown color, this beef dish radiates a fragrant aroma from cumin and a hint of heat from chili, creating a harmonious combination of spices. Follow this guide to make fried beef with sesame seeds! This dish features a beautiful golden-brown color, the scent of cumin, and spicy chili. It makes family meals tastier and more abundant during the cold winter. Try this unique dish now!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Wash the beef tenderloin and pat dry. Then, cut the meat into small square pieces, about 2cm in size.
In a bowl, add the cut beef along with 2 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tbsp cornstarch. Mix well so the beef is evenly marinated. Next, place the beef in the refrigerator to marinate for about 30 minutes.

Prepare a mixture of white sesame seeds, 1 tsp salt, ½ tbsp cumin powder, and 1 tsp chili powder. Mix this mixture well and divide it into two parts. Take half of this sesame mixture and mix it thoroughly with the marinated beef.
Step 2: Cook the fried beef with sesame
Use bamboo toothpicks to skewer each piece of beef. You can also skewer 2 pieces of meat on the same toothpick, as long as the meat is secure and does not fall off.

Place a pan on the stove and turn the heat to high to heat about 300ml of cooking oil. Once the oil is hot, gently drop the beef skewers into the pan to fry. Reduce the heat to medium and turn the meat to cook evenly. Ensure the meat is completely submerged in oil and the oil is bubbling before frying. Otherwise, the meat will become tough and unappetizing.

After about 2 minutes, remove the meat from the pan and drain the oil. You can use paper towels to speed up this process. Once the meat is fully drained, add the remaining half of the sesame mixture and stir well to coat the meat with spices.
Continue frying the meat in the pan for about 1 more minute. Then, remove the meat to drain and present the dish.
Fried beef with sesame seeds served with herbs will be delicious. With the meat fully infused with spices, you don't need any additional dipping sauce to enjoy its rich flavor.

Next, put the meat into a mixing bowl, marinate with 1 tbsp cornstarch and 2 tbsp soy sauce for about 20 minutes to absorb. Then, mix 1 tbsp chili powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tbsp cumin powder, and some white sesame seeds in a small bowl. Divide this spice mixture in half; mix one half with the beef and marinate for at least 15 minutes, and set the other half aside.
Notes for cooking fried beef with sesame
When buying beef, place it in the freezer for about 30 minutes before processing. This helps the meat firm up, making it easier to slice into pieces.
Choose Korean chili powder to give the beef a more beautiful color and reduce the pungent smell. This type of chili is often used to make kimchi.
How to choose fresh beef

Fresh beef is not dark red; the fat must be yellow and firm, not soft. Choose small, soft meat fibers and avoid large, tough ones. Finally, check by pressing the beef with your hand; if it's not sticky and has no foul odor, it is good.

Cow meat is usually tastier than bull meat. If possible, choose young beef (veal), as it is soft, has white fat, and a fine texture. To buy good beef, look for bright colors, fibers that aren't too fine (unless it's young beef), small white tendons, and bright yellow fat.

Beef that is pale green or has round white spots between the fibers may be infected with flukes or parasites. Also, avoid buying beef with a foul smell. Other signs of poor quality beef include dark colors, deep yellow fat, yellow bones, poor elasticity, mushy meat, and a slimy surface.
Fresh beef has a bright red color, small fine fibers, a characteristic beef aroma, and light yellow fat.
Dark red beef with deep yellow fat and large fibers is usually from an old cow, which is tough and chewy.
Dark red meat with white fat and a slightly fishy, non-aromatic smell is buffalo meat.

Identifying parasite cysts in meat is easy, as they look like grains of rice nestled in the meat fibers. If you poke them with a knife tip, the cysts will fall out immediately, unlike small white tendons which are tough and firmly attached.

mon_an.ten: Steamed Fish with Egg – A Unique Dinner Dish
mon_an.mo_ta: Today, let's try making steamed fish with egg, a unique dish for your family dinner according to this recipe.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the carrots, asparagus, and shiitake mushrooms, cut them into short, bite-sized pieces, and julienne them. Similarly, julienne the ham. Crack the eggs into a bowl and beat well.
Step 2: Prepare the fish
Wash the fish fillet, cut into thin slices, then marinate with wine, ginger, salt, sugar, and cooking oil for about 10 minutes.
After about 10 minutes, once the fish has absorbed the spices, take it out and roll it with the carrots, shiitake mushrooms, ham, and asparagus.
Step 3: Pass the eggs through a sieve for a smooth texture, then mix 2/3 of the eggs with 50 ml of water and steam in a double boiler for about 7-10 minutes.

After 7-10 minutes or when the egg surface has set, arrange the fish rolls on top and pour in the remaining 1/3 of the eggs. Continue steaming for about 10 minutes until the fish and eggs are cooked through. Turn off the heat, and your steamed fish with egg is complete.

Note that steamed fish with egg must be eaten hot to be delicious. When serving, sprinkle a few slices of chili and ground pepper on top for decoration and to enhance the flavor (I love spicy food, so pepper/chili is a must for me, but you can skip this if you can't eat spicy). Drizzle a bit of lemon juice and soy sauce over the dish to make it even more savory.

The final requirement for the steamed fish is that the fish and vegetables must be just cooked, and the egg should be soft, smooth, and not pitted. Here are some tips for a delicious steamed fish with egg:

Similar to making flan, you should beat the eggs very gently in one direction to avoid incorporating air which creates bubbles, making the steamed egg pitted and less appetizing. Before steaming, pass the eggs through a sieve to remove air bubbles for a more beautiful dish.

While steaming, you must frequently open the lid to prevent condensed water from dripping onto the egg surface. Alternatively, you can cover the pot with a clean towel. The towel will absorb the condensation so water doesn't drip onto the eggs.
Slicing the fish is a very important step. To cut thin, even slices without breaking the meat, you need to use a very thin and sharp knife. You can chill the knife before slicing to make it easier.

mon_an.ten: Creamy Ground Beef and Potato Hash
mon_an.mo_ta: If you are wondering what to cook for dinner because the old dishes have been repeated too many times, then quickly get into the kitchen to learn how to make this new and delicious creamy ground beef dish! This will definitely be an attractive new dish for your family that you shouldn't miss!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
First, peel the potatoes and wash them with water, then dice them into small cubes.
Wash the beef and mince or grind it; however, do not grind it into a paste. Mincing is better for flavor, but if using a grinder, pulse it briefly so the meat still has small chunks.
Wash the cilantro and chop it finely.
Peel the onion, wash it, then slice it thinly or dice it (dicing makes the dish look better and taste more delicious).
Step 2: Execution steps
First, put the potatoes in a small pot and add enough water to cover them.
When the pot of potatoes reaches a rolling boil, add a little salt and cook for about 3 more minutes before turning off the heat.
Next, pour the potatoes into a colander to drain completely. Then, place a pan on the stove and add butter to melt.
Once the butter is completely melted, add the onion and sauté until fragrant, soft, and slightly golden.

After that, add the potatoes to sauté together. Cook the potatoes for about 5-10 minutes until they are soft and golden brown. If the potatoes have a slightly crispy exterior, the dish will be even more appealing.
Next, add the minced beef and continue to stir well until the beef is fully cooked.
At this point, you can season with salt and pepper to suit your taste.
Then, add the cream to the pan and stir for about 1 minute.
Finally, crack the eggs into the center of the beef and potato mixture. In this step, do not stir anymore; leave it until the eggs are cooked to your liking, then turn off the heat.
Carefully transfer the food to a plate, keeping the eggs in the center of the beef and potato mixture as they were.
You can garnish with a little cilantro and it's ready to enjoy.
Notes

When adding the beef, remember to reduce the heat to medium or low to prevent the meat from drying out. Maintain this heat level until the end so the ingredients cook evenly without the beef becoming too dry or the potatoes and onions becoming too mushy.
Additionally, the doneness of the eggs depends on your preference, whether you like them well-done or sunny-side up.
When sautéing the potatoes, stir evenly to ensure they cook through and develop a beautiful golden-brown crust.
This creamy ground beef dish should be eaten immediately while hot; if it cools down or sits for too long, the eggs will have a fishy smell and the dish will lose its flavor.

mon_an.mo_ta: Pigeon meat contains over 22% protein, 1% lipid, and minerals. It has a salty taste, neutral property, is slightly warm, non-toxic, and helps nourish the five internal organs, enhance blood circulation, strengthen vitality, and stimulate digestion. Pigeon meat is neutral, so it can be used regardless of whether the illness is cold or hot, or whether the constitution is yin or yang deficient. Pigeon meat is very suitable for the elderly, pregnant and postpartum women, and children with slow development. The best pigeons are squabs under 1 month old, which can be used for porridge, sticky rice, or steaming. Today, let's make a simple yet delicious and nutritious stuffed pigeon!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Cooking oil, sugar, pepper - as desired
cac_buoc: Step 1: Clean the pigeon, remove the head, and debone it. First, make a longitudinal cut down the middle of the back, then follow the backbone with a knife to separate the spine from the meat. Then, use your hands to push the wing and thigh bones out and cut them away slowly.
Step 2: Finely dice the carrots and boil the lotus seeds until soft. To make lotus seeds soften quickly, soak them in warm water before boiling.

Step 3: Mix the red dates and lotus seeds into the ground pork, season with spices, and stuff the mixture into the pigeon. Steam for about 8 minutes, then use kitchen twine to tie the bird's body tightly and fry until golden brown.
Step 4: Once the pigeon is cooked, slice it into rounds, arrange on a plate lined with lettuce, and garnish with mint.
Enjoy your stuffed pigeon!

mon_an.mo_ta: For office moms, dinner usually prioritizes speed and simplicity because time is very limited. Therefore, today I will guide you through making a very delicious, nutritious, affordable, and quick dish for dinner: crispy sesame shrimp. The dish is very tasty with sweet shrimp meat and a rich, fragrant sesame coating, served with chili fish sauce that makes it impossible to stop eating. Notably, this dish only takes about 20 minutes to prepare, so it will surely satisfy you.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Pepper, cooking wine, salt, seasoning powder - to taste
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Wash the tiger prawns, peel the shells, and remove the black veins on the back.
Crack the duck egg into a bowl and separate the white.
Peel the ginger and crush or julienne it.
Toast the white sesame seeds until fragrant.
Step 2: Execution steps
First, use paper towels to pat the prawns completely dry.
Then marinate the prawns with the following spices: 2 tsp pepper, 2 tsp seasoning powder, 1/2 tsp salt, 2 tsp cooking wine, and julienned ginger.
Mix the ingredients well so the prawns absorb the spices and marinate for 5 minutes.
Next, dissolve the cornstarch into the bowl of egg white to create a batter that is neither too thin nor too thick.
Hold a prawn by the tail and dip it into the cornstarch mixture, ensuring the batter coats the entire prawn evenly.
Then roll it in the bowl of toasted sesame seeds until the sesame coating completely covers the prawn.
Repeat this process until all prawns are coated.
Place a pan on the stove and heat the cooking oil.
When the oil is hot, drop the prawns in to fry until cooked.
During frying, remember to turn the prawns frequently. When they turn a beautiful golden color and smell fragrant, remove them and drain the oil.
Pat the prawns with paper towels once more to remove all excess oil.
Present on a plate and enjoy.
Notes
When mixing the batter, if you find there is too little egg white making it too thick, add a little water.
Using cooking wine to marinate the prawns helps remove the fishy smell and enhances the flavor. However, if you don't like it, you can omit this ingredient.
Besides white sesame, you can use black sesame seeds.
Similarly, if you don't have cornstarch, you can substitute it with all-purpose flour.
Do not fry the prawns for too long because they cook very quickly; overcooking will make the shrimp dry and the sesame seeds may burn, losing the flavor.
Good luck and enjoy your crispy sesame shrimp!

mon_an.mo_ta: Salmon omelet is a very delicious and novel dish combining eggs and salmon. Outwardly, this omelet looks exactly like a regular fried egg, but upon tasting, you will notice the distinct deliciousness of the salmon filling. Let's make this salmon omelet together.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients before making the salmon omelet:
Dice the onion (about 1cm cubes or as desired).
Dice the green bell pepper (about 1cm cubes or as desired).
Crack the eggs into a bowl and beat well.
Grate the cheese using a grater.
Salmon: If using frozen skinless and boneless salmon fillets => Dice the salmon into 1cm pieces.
(If the salmon still has skin and bones: Remove the skin, debone and remove any remaining pin bones, then dice).
When sautéing the salmon, do not cook it for too long to avoid losing its nutrients.
Step 2: Make the salmon omelet:
Heat a pan over high heat, then add 1 tbsp of butter to the hot pan to melt.
Add the onion, green bell pepper, and salmon to the melted butter; sauté for about 2-3 minutes (do not sauté too long or the salmon will lose nutrients). Then, scoop the mixture into a separate bowl.
Add 2 tbsp of fresh milk to the bowl of eggs and beat until bubbles form.
Heat the pan and add the remaining 1 tbsp of butter to melt, then pour in the egg mixture, spreading it evenly across the pan surface and wait for the egg to set for about 1 minute.
Pour the previously sautéed onion, bell pepper, and salmon mixture onto 1/2 of the egg surface.
Keep the heat on low, then sprinkle the grated cheese over the salmon mixture.

Then fold the omelet in half (if you like, you can drizzle a layer of chili sauce and mayonnaise on the egg surface before folding) and fry over low heat for about 1 more minute, then turn off the heat.
Use a spatula to lift the salmon omelet intact onto a plate and enjoy immediately while hot with chili sauce.

The salmon omelet with its fragrant golden egg layer and sweet salmon and vegetable filling makes the flavor very balanced and attractive. This dish is very good for children as it provides many nutrients, so mothers should add salmon omelet to their children's menu right away.

mon_an.mo_ta: The finished Nem Rươi has an eye-catching golden-brown color on the crust along with a delicious and unique flavor. This delicacy will enrich your list of ragworm dishes.
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients:
Peel the carrots, wash them, and shred them into small strips as you would for regular meat spring rolls.
Peel the onion and jicama, wash them, and dice them finely.
Wash the piper lolot leaves and slice them into small strips to mix with the ragworms.
Rinse the wood ear and shiitake mushrooms with cold water, then soak them in hot water until they expand. Once expanded, take them out and wash again with fresh water to reduce the odor.
Soak the glass noodles in water until soft, wash them, and cut into small pieces about 2cm long.
Separate the rice paper sheets beforehand so they don't stick and to make wrapping faster.
Step 1:
Pour the fresh ragworms into a bowl of cold water and stir gently to clean.
Step 2:
Then pour the ragworms through a sieve to drain away the dirty water.
Step 3:

Next, heat water until very hot (about 70°C, do not let it boil), then pour it into the bowl of ragworms to wash. Use chopsticks to stir gently to clean the ragworms. Then, lift the ragworms out and let them drain.
Step 4:
Take out the ingredients prepared above.
Step 5:
Then mix all the prepared ingredients together with a bit of salt and pepper. Remember to mix well so the ingredients blend and absorb the spices evenly!
Step 6:

Once the mixture is well blended, start wrapping the spring rolls. Take a sheet of rice paper, put a moderate spoonful of filling inside, and wrap it firmly. Be careful to wrap with moderate pressure; if it's too tight, the spring rolls may burst when frying.
Step 7:

Next, place a pan on the stove and add oil. When the oil is hot, lower the heat and add the spring rolls to fry until golden. You should deep-fry them so the spring rolls turn evenly golden and delicious. Do not flip them too many times while frying as they might break, and remember to flip both sides to ensure even browning.
Step 8:

Once fried, place the spring rolls on paper towels to remove excess oil, then garnish on a plate with herbs and enjoy. You can serve them with rice vermicelli, sweet and sour fish sauce, and fresh greens.
The finished Nem Rươi has an eye-catching golden-brown color on the crust along with a delicious and unique flavor. This delicacy will enrich your list of ragworm dishes.
Notes:
When buying ragworms, choose large, mature ones (more red than green) that are very fresh. Ask the seller to take them from the top of the basket, as they usually place the freshest ones there.

Besides Nem Rươi, ragworms can be prepared into many other delicious dishes such as: chả rươi (ragworm omelet with meat and tangerine peel, served with lemon chili fish sauce), ragworm stir-fried with water bamboo (this vegetable is in season at the same time as ragworms), and ragworm sauce (this sauce is often kept until Tet to dip chicken, which is excellent).

mon_an.mo_ta: Ruốc (called chà bông in the South) is a popular and familiar dish for Vietnamese people. Ruốc can be eaten with rice, porridge, or bread. With the traditional method, it takes a lot of effort, especially the tiring and time-consuming task of pounding the meat. With this method, you will still have fluffy, light, and golden ruốc without the hard work of using a mortar and pestle. This ruốc can also be served with dishes for children. Give it a try!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the pork: Blanch the pork in boiling water, then wash it clean and cut into large pieces along the grain.

Step 2: Put the meat in a pot, add a little filtered water, fish sauce, and seasoning powder. Simmer until the meat is cooked and has absorbed the spices. When the water has evaporated, turn off the heat.
Step 3: Remove the meat to a plate, put on gloves, and use your hands to shred the meat into fibers.
Step 4: Put the shredded meat into a pan and stir until the meat turns golden.
Step 5: After that, put the meat into a blender and pulse to fluff up the meat.

Step 6: Put the fluffed meat back into the pan, add cooking oil to make it shiny and prevent it from drying out, then sauté until it reaches your desired golden color. Turn off the heat, let it cool, and store in an airtight container for later use.
Some notes for delicious ruốc:
You should choose pork tenderloin for long fibers and no fat; the finished product will have longer and more beautiful strands.
With this method, you should quickly shred the meat while it is still hot. Hot meat is much softer and easier to shred.

mon_an.mo_ta: Sweet and sour pork ribs are a special dish loved by many children. The tender ribs are marinated in a rich sweet and sour sauce, which creates a truly wonderful experience when paired with hot rice. The method for cooking sweet and sour ribs is also very simple and easy to follow. Save this recipe for delicious sweet and sour ribs now! Detailed instructions on how to make sweet and sour ribs will change the flavor profile of your family meals, bringing a unique and interesting blend of tastes. Discover this recipe to show off your cooking skills and enjoy delicious sweet and sour ribs with your family at home!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Spices - Salt, sugar, seasoning powder, MSG, pepper
cac_buoc: 1. Prepare the ingredients

Clean the ribs: Use salt or lemon to rub the meat surface of the pork ribs. Then, rinse the ribs with clean water to remove the salt or lemon, and let them drain. Next, chop the ribs into bite-sized pieces.

Blanch the ribs: Prepare a large basin or pot, pour boiling water in so the ribs are submerged. Blanch the ribs in boiling water for about 5 - 10 minutes, then remove and rinse with cold water to remove impurities.
Wash and drain: Rinse the ribs with clean water to remove any remaining residue. Then, let the ribs drain in a dry, airy place.
2. Marinate and fry the ribs
Prepare the seasoning: In a bowl, mix 1/3 tsp salt, 2 tsp seasoning powder, 1/3 tsp MSG, 1 tsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp sugar, 1/3 tsp ground pepper, 5g minced garlic, and 10g minced shallots.

Marinate the ribs: Place the ribs in a bowl and sprinkle the prepared seasoning over them. Toss well so the ribs are evenly coated. Marinate for about 15 - 20 minutes to allow the spices to penetrate.
