After refrigerating, take the mixture out and shape it into bite-sized, pretty round patties.

Next, take a chicken mushroom patty and roll it through a layer of flour, then dip it into the egg bowl, and finally roll it through a layer of breadcrumbs. Remember to roll carefully so the breadcrumbs cover the patty completely. Do the same for the remaining chicken mushroom patties.
Finally, we will fry the patties.
Add cooking oil to a pan and place it on the stove to heat up. You should use a fair amount of oil for better frying.
When the oil is boiling, add the chicken mushroom patties and fry until golden brown. Pay attention to flip the patties frequently so they have an even brownish-gold color on both sides.
When finished frying, remove the patties onto a paper towel to absorb all the excess oil.
Arrange the patties on a plate and eat hot with chili sauce or mayonnaise as desired.
Notes
When preparing the chicken, if there is any skin or bone left, remember to remove it all.
You can add mashed potatoes to the dish to enhance the flavor.

When frying the chicken mushroom patties, be careful not to fry for too long because the ingredients are mostly already cooked and cook very easily; frying too long will make the patties dry. Additionally, do not turn the heat too high to avoid burning the outside of the patty while the inside is not thoroughly heated. When frying, remember to flip both sides evenly so the patties cook evenly and have a beautiful color.

mon_an.ten: Delicious Beef Rolls with Enoki Mushrooms
mon_an.mo_ta: Beef is a nutrient-rich ingredient beneficial for body development. In addition to high protein content, beef also provides iron, zinc, and vitamins B2, B6, and B12, which are good for the immune system and promote red blood cell regeneration. The iron in beef helps quickly recover blood cells and is necessary for providing oxygen to cells in the body. According to traditional medicine, beef has a sweet taste and neutral properties, which help tonify the spleen and stomach, supplement qi, nourish blood, and strengthen tendons and bones. It is used for symptoms of spleen and stomach deficiency such as weakness and weight loss, indigestion, bloating, loss of appetite, edema, back pain, knee fatigue, diabetes... There are many ways to prepare beef, and today we will guide you on how to make beef rolls with enoki mushrooms, a wonderful dish!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, pepper, garlic, cooking oil - as needed
Teriyaki sauce, sugar, butter - as needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Slice the beef into thin slices and marinate with salt, pepper, and garlic. Cut the enoki mushrooms into 4 cm segments and boil until cooked.
Step 2: Spread out the beef slice, place the mushrooms on top, and roll it up.
Step 3: Pan-sear the beef rolls until just cooked through.

Step 4: After arranging the pan-seared beef on a plate, add Teriyaki sauce, a little sugar, and butter to the same pan and cook until it reaches a slightly thick consistency, then drizzle evenly over the beef rolls.
Enjoy your beef rolls with enoki mushrooms!

mon_an.ten: Delicious and Attractive Crispy Fried Chicken Breast
cac_buoc: In the diverse world of culinary arts, crispy fried chicken breast is always a popular choice with its rich flavor and simple preparation. For those who love cooking, making this dish at home not only brings creative joy but also offers a unique culinary experience. Let's explore how to make delicious crispy fried chicken breast at home, from preparing the ingredients to the main execution steps, to enjoy a tasty and rich meal right in your cozy kitchen!
I. Guide to making traditional crispy fried chicken breast
1. Prepare ingredients
Breadcrumbs: 300 grams
Tapioca starch: 20 grams
Chicken breast: 500 grams
All-purpose flour: 120 grams
Pepper: 1/2 teaspoon
Salt: 1/2 teaspoon
Eggs: 2 eggs
2. Processing steps
2.1. Prepare ingredients
Place 300 grams of breadcrumbs and 20 grams of tapioca starch into a blender to grind the mixture finely.
Wash the chicken breast and cut into small pieces.
In a bowl, mix 120 grams of flour, 1/2 teaspoon of pepper, and 1/2 teaspoon of salt using a whisk.
In another bowl, beat 2 eggs well.
Dredge the chicken piece in flour first, then transfer to the egg, and finally coat with the breadcrumb and tapioca starch mixture.
2.2. Dip and fry the chicken until crispy
II. Guide to making crispy fried chicken breast like at a restaurant
2 chicken breasts (about 500 grams)
120 grams all-purpose flour
300 grams breadcrumbs (or panko)
2 chicken eggs
Seasonings: Sugar, cooking oil, salt, seasoned salt, pepper
Tools: Spoon, bowl, pan, plate, oil absorbent paper
2. Steps to process crispy fried chicken breast
Step 1: Prepare ingredients
Start by washing the chicken breast, then cut into long strips about 1.5cm wide and continue to cut into suitable small squares. Beat the eggs combined with 2 tablespoons of water.
Step 2: Mix the flour
Mix 120 grams of flour with 1 tablespoon of seasoned salt, 1/4 teaspoon of salt, and 1/2 teaspoon of pepper. Place 300 grams of breadcrumbs (or panko) in a separate bowl.
Step 3: Bread the chicken breast
Start by dipping each prepared chicken breast piece into the flour mixture, followed by the beaten egg, and finally the breadcrumbs.

Note: If you have time, you can place the breaded chicken breast in the freezer for about 30 minutes to 1 hour so that it tastes better when fried. If not, let them sit at room temperature for about 10-15 minutes before starting to fry.
Step 4: Fry the chicken breast

Heat the oil in a pan on the stove (about 400ml oil). Then, drop each breaded chicken breast piece into the pan to fry, remembering to flip carefully to ensure they don't burn. Fry until the chicken breast is cooked and has a beautiful golden color, then remove and place on a plate lined with oil absorbent paper. This process is complete.
Step 5: Finished product

The dish after completion will have a very attractive golden appearance. When enjoying, you will feel the crispy outer shell surrounding the chicken meat inside, which is delicious and firm. You can enjoy the dish with chili sauce, mayonnaise, or other types of sauces to enhance the flavor.
III. How to choose fresh chicken breast for crispy frying

To cook a delicious dish, choose chicken breast pieces with white skin, as this is from a mature chicken, the meat is tastier and firmer. Young chicken often has softer meat and is easily bở (mushy/crumbly).
If you buy skinless chicken breast, look at the fat layer on the meat. Choose the white fat part to ensure the meat is tastier.

Choose pieces without many white stripes on the meat surface. The more stripes there are, the less fat and protein there is. These stripes also make it harder for the meat to absorb seasonings and sauces during processing.
IV. Notes when making crispy fried chicken breast
1. Prepare the chicken breast
Wash and prepare the chicken breast before starting.
Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces to ensure it cooks evenly and the frying time is shorter.
2. Bread evenly
Ensure the chicken breast is evenly coated with flour, egg, and breadcrumbs so the outer shell is crispier and more attractive.
3. Choose suitable frying oil
Use cooking oil with a high smoke point like sunflower oil or flaxseed oil to fry the chicken breast safely and get a beautiful crispy shell.
4. Flip the chicken breast evenly
When frying, remember to flip the chicken breast evenly so both sides cook and do not burn.
5. Check oil temperature
Ensure the oil has reached the right temperature before dropping the chicken breast in to fry to avoid excessive oil absorption or uneven cooking.
6. Frying time
Fry the chicken breast until it is golden brown and attractively crispy.
7. Use oil absorbent paper
After frying, remove the chicken breast to a plate lined with oil absorbent paper to soak up excess oil and keep the crispy shell from becoming greasy.

mon_an.ten: Nutritious and Attractive Purple Cabbage Soup
mon_an.mo_ta: Purple cabbage soup with a very eye-catching color. Cabbage soup provides many vitamins and minerals, both supplementing nutrients and bringing a new taste for your baby.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Wash the purple cabbage, then chop it finely. Peel the onion, remove the root, and dice it.
Wash the garlic and mince it. Remove the roots from the dill, wash it, and also chop it finely.
Dissolve the tapioca starch in a little water until completely melted.
Step 2:
Boil the quail eggs, peel them, and cut them in half.
Heat the butter in a pot until completely melted, add the garlic and sauté until fragrant. Then add the chopped onion and continue to sauté for a while over low heat.
Add the cabbage and sauté for a few minutes, pour in the broth just enough to cover the vegetables, cover the pot, and cook until done.
Step 3:
Put the cooked mixture into a blender, blend until smooth, then strain to remove the pulp.

Pour the liquid back into the pot, mix with the fresh milk, cook over low heat until the soup slightly boils again, add the tapioca starch, and cook until the soup thickens. Season with a little salt to taste.
Ladle the soup into a cup, sprinkle with a little dill, add the quail eggs and nutritional oil, and mix well. Serve to the baby while warm.
Good luck with this soup!

mon_an.mo_ta: These fried tofu sushi pieces are shaped like charming little pouches. Each rice ball is a burst of color with green bell peppers, yellow cheese, pink crab sticks, and black sesame seeds standing out against the white rice. Beyond the visual appeal, this dish is savory and delicious as the seasonings permeate both the tofu pockets and the rice. Children will be delighted to see their mother prepare such a unique and attractive treat for the whole family.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Tofu seasoning - ¼ cup water, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp rice wine, 1 tbsp brown sugar
Rice seasoning - 2 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tbsp vinegar, and ½ tsp salt
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Fried tofu: Cut off one edge of the 15 fried tofu pieces. Blanch the tofu in boiling water to remove excess oil, rinse with cold water, and squeeze dry.
Step 2:

Prepare the sauce: Mix ¼ cup water, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp rice wine, and 1 tbsp brown sugar until well combined. Bring this mixture to a boil in a pot, then add the squeezed tofu. Simmer over medium heat until the liquid has completely reduced, then press the tofu pieces flat.
Step 3:

Cook the mixture: Boil 2 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tbsp vinegar, and ½ tsp salt, then pour it into a bowl of cooked rice. Finely dice the green bell pepper, crab sticks, and 1 slice of cheese. Add the bell pepper, crab sticks, cheese, and toasted sesame seeds to the rice and mix well. Use cooking gloves to ensure the ingredients are evenly distributed!
Step 4:
After squeezing the tofu dry, fold the top 1/3 of the tofu opening outward to create a small pouch shape.
Step 5:

Use a cutter to shape the remaining cheese into small flowers. Roll the seasoned rice into balls, place them inside the tofu pouches, and garnish with the small cheese flowers for a beautiful presentation.
Enjoy your meal!

mon_an.mo_ta: Pigeon meat contains over 22% protein, 1% lipid, and various minerals. It has a savory taste and warm properties, acting as a tonic for the internal organs, enhancing blood circulation, and stimulating digestion. Pigeon meat is neutral in nature, making it suitable for various constitutions. It is especially beneficial for the elderly, postpartum women, and developing children. Let's learn how to cook this simple yet delicious and nutritious pigeon sticky rice!
cac_buoc: Soak the glutinous rice in cold water for 4 - 4.5 hours to allow the grains to absorb water, then drain well.
Mix the rice thoroughly with sugar, salt, and lard, then steam until cooked. Spread the rice out to cool.
Thinly slice the shallots and fry until golden brown.

Debone the pigeon. Mince or finely chop the meat (you can also mince the soft bones if desired), then grind in a mortar with seasonings. Sauté in a pan until golden and fragrant, adding a bit of fish sauce for aroma.
Mix the pigeon meat with the sticky rice and steam for a second time.
Transfer the sticky rice to a plate and sprinkle the fried shallots on top. (If you prefer, you can sauté the shallots directly with the pigeon meat).
You won't be able to forget the delicious aroma of this pigeon sticky rice. Enjoy your meal!

mon_an.ten: Nutritious Squid and Carrot Congee for Babies
mon_an.mo_ta: Squid congee is an easy-to-make dish using simple yet nutrient-rich ingredients like fresh squid and carrots. These healthy foods are excellent for a baby's development and are easily enjoyed through this delicious congee. Mothers and home cooks should not hesitate to try this wonderful recipe for their little ones!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning powder, fish sauce, MSG, pepper - seasonings
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the squid for the delicious squid and carrot congee

Peel off the outer skin of the squid. Use a knife to slit the belly, then scrub with salt and white wine to remove the fishy odor. Rinse thoroughly with clean water until the smell is completely gone!

Once cleaned, drain the squid and slice into bite-sized pieces. Marinate with seasonings and a splash of fish sauce. You can add a little ginger for aroma, but remember to remove all ginger pieces before serving as it may be too spicy for the baby.
Step 2: Cooking process for a tasty squid and carrot congee
First, peel the shallots and rinse them. Mince the shallots and fry them in oil until golden brown, then scoop them out into a small bowl and set aside.
Next, sauté the squid in the remaining oil over high heat. Stir-fry quickly until just cooked so the squid retains its sweetness. Do not overcook, as the squid will become tough and lose nutrients.
Next, peel and rinse the carrots, then boil them until tender while still retaining their vitamins.

If the baby is older, you can mince the sautéed squid and carrots. For younger babies who cannot chew pieces yet, blend them into a smooth puree. When blending, chop the squid and carrots first and use some of the carrot boiling water to ensure the mixture is soft, smooth, and not dry.
Next, bring a pot of plain white congee to a boil. Add the minced (or pureed) squid and carrots, stirring well. Season to taste.
Finally, add finely chopped dill and remove from heat! Ladle the congee into a bowl, top with a spoonful of fried shallots, and serve to the baby.
Notes for a delicious baby squid congee:
How to choose fresh squid:

There are two main types of fresh squid: cuttlefish and squid. Cuttlefish have a thick, oval-shaped body. Choose large ones with thick, firm, creamy white flesh and an intact brown outer membrane. Squid have a cylindrical, thinner body. Choose those with bright, slightly pinkish flesh, where the head is still firmly attached to the body and the ink sac is not broken. Generally, less fresh squid will turn a pale greenish color, have soft flesh, a loose head, and a very fishy smell. Additionally, check the tentacles; they should feel firm to the touch.

Squid and carrot congee is easy to make and highly nutritious: Squid is rich in protein, fats, sugar, minerals, and various amino acids. Carrots are high in carotene (pro-vitamin A), which the body easily converts into Vitamin A in the intestines and liver. Carrots also provide Vitamins B, C, D, E, folic acid, potassium, and pectin fiber (which helps lower cholesterol). Minerals like calcium, copper, iron, phosphorus, and sulfur in carrots are more easily absorbed by the body than many supplements. These healthy ingredients are perfect for a baby's growth!

mon_an.mo_ta: This wonderful clam congee features sweet and savory clam meat, rich nutritional value, and the warmth of pepper. The fragrant congee combined with fried shallots and fresh herbs creates an irresistible dish. Let's get into the kitchen and learn how to cook this amazing meal!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fried shallots, scallions, Vietnamese coriander - ingredients
Salt, pepper, seasoning powder, fish sauce, MSG - seasonings
cac_buoc: Wash the rice thoroughly and soak in water overnight. For a more fragrant congee, toast the rice before soaking. Once the soaked rice has expanded, drain it in a colander.

Next, soak the clams in cold water for about 15 minutes to remove sand (you can add a few chilies to help the clams release grit). Place the clams in a pot and boil with a pinch of salt until they open their shells, then turn off the heat.

Remove the clams from the pot and extract the meat. Discard the dark digestive part and rinse the meat clean. If the clams are large, slice them into bite-sized pieces. Marinate the meat with a bit of fish sauce, pepper, seasoning powder, and oil to let the flavors infuse. Strain the clam boiling liquid to get a clear broth, discarding the sediment at the bottom.

Return the clam broth to the stove, add the rice, and bring to a boil over high heat. Cover tightly until the rice grains bloom. Check the consistency; if it is too thick, add a little boiling water and season with salt to taste. Simmer over low heat until the rice is soft and turns into congee. Stir occasionally to prevent the rice from sticking to the bottom and burning.

In a dry pan, heat some oil and fry the sliced shallots until fragrant. Once cooked, remove the shallots to a plate to cool. In the same pan, sauté the clam meat until firm; since it will be eaten with congee, season it to be slightly salty. Finely chop the scallions and Vietnamese coriander.
Finally, ladle the cooked congee into a bowl. Top with scallions, Vietnamese coriander, fried shallots, and the sautéed clam meat. Sprinkle with pepper and chili powder (if desired) and enjoy.

mon_an.ten: Beef and Bean Sprout Congee for Baby Weaning
mon_an.mo_ta: Beef and bean sprout congee is a perfect dish for a child's development, featuring nutrient-rich beef, refreshing bean sprouts, and fiber from young sponge gourd. All these ingredients blend together in a hot, flavorful, and nutritious bowl of congee. Mothers, let's learn how to make this delicious dish!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Rinse the beef thoroughly and slice it thinly.
Peel and rinse the garlic, then mince it.
Marinate the sliced beef with minced garlic, 1 tbsp oil, and seasoning powder. Mix well and let it sit for 15 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Peel the sponge gourd, rinse it, and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Step 2: Sauté the minced garlic until fragrant, then add the beef and stir-fry over high heat. Add the sponge gourd and stir-fry quickly until the gourd is cooked and the beef remains tender.
Step 3: Mince or blend the sautéed beef and gourd mixture.
Step 4: Rinse the bean sprouts and mince them.
Step 5: Place the rice in a pot and fill with water. Add 2 tsp of salt and bring to a boil. Lower the heat and cook until the congee is soft, then stir in the minced beef, gourd, and bean sprouts.
Step 6: Finally, season to taste and remove from heat. Ladle the congee into a bowl and serve.

mon_an.ten: Nutritious Beef and Greens Porridge for Babies
mon_an.mo_ta: Beef and greens porridge is an incredibly nutritious dish, perfect for a baby's development. It features tender, fresh beef with a rich aroma and fiber from green vegetables, all blended into a warm, delicious bowl of porridge. Mothers, what are you waiting for? Let's get into the kitchen and learn how to cook this wonderful porridge for your little ones! Cooking this nutritious beef and greens porridge is a great way to provide essential nutrients for your beloved baby. Discover this tasty recipe that will help your baby grow healthy and strong.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoned salt, fish sauce, MSG, pepper... - seasoning
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the beef thoroughly and slice it thinly.
Step 2: Peel the garlic, wash it, and mince it finely.
Step 3: Marinate the thinly sliced beef with 1 tsp of minced garlic, 1 tsp of cooking oil, and some seasoning powder. Let it sit for 15 minutes to allow the beef to absorb the flavors.
Step 4: Sauté the garlic until fragrant, then add the beef and stir-fry over high heat until just cooked through.
Step 5: Once the beef is cooked, mince the stir-fried beef or grind it in a blender.
Step 6: Wash the greens thoroughly to remove all dirt, then mince or pulse them in a blender.

Step 7: Finally, place the pot of white porridge on the stove. Add a little water if it's too thick, then stir in the minced beef and minced greens. Season to taste and wait for the porridge to boil and the greens and beef to be fully cooked before removing from the heat.
Notes when cooking beef and greens porridge:

Baby's age: Ensure the porridge is appropriate for your baby's age. Infants under 6 months old are usually only given simple weaning foods like rice porridge. Beef and greens porridge is suitable for babies from 8 months and older.
Ingredient selection: Choose fresh tenderloin beef and clean, fresh greens. Limit the use of seasonings and MSG containing additives, preservatives, or artificial colors.
Preparation: Finely mince the beef and greens so the baby can eat easily. Clean and peel radishes, carrots, and potatoes.

Processing beef: Ensure the beef is cooked thoroughly to avoid the risk of bacterial infection. You can cook the beef in boiling water before adding it to the porridge or cook it together with the porridge to ensure the meat is tender.
Processing greens: Stir-fry the greens briefly to retain their nutritional value and crispness.
Simmering: Simmer the porridge over low heat so it cooks evenly without burning. Stir frequently while cooking to prevent sticking and ensure no lumps are left.
Check temperature: Before feeding your baby, check the temperature of the porridge to ensure it is not too hot and is safe for the baby.

Storage and shelf life: If there is leftover porridge, let it cool and store it in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours. Limit the use of porridge that has been kept for several days to ensure food safety.
Portion size: Ensure the baby's portion size is appropriate for their nutritional needs and age.
Adjusting taste: If necessary, adjust the taste of the porridge to suit the baby's preferences and needs. However, limit the use of salt and strong spices for young children.

mon_an.ten: Delicious Weaning Porridge for Babies from 6 Months Old
mon_an.mo_ta: A recipe for weaning porridge for children from 6 months old that helps even stunted children gain weight, providing 4 essential nutrients: carbohydrates, protein, fats, vitamins, and minerals. A small tip to increase breast milk supply that is simple and more effective than expected.
cac_buoc: Thankfully, the baby is growing so fast. It's already been 6 months. Usually, when a baby turns 6 months old, mothers begin to introduce them to the rich world of Vietnamese cuisine. But lately, the baby hasn't been gaining weight steadily, and the mother is short on milk, so she regretfully introduces weaning foods. I know the baby's digestive system is still delicate at this stage. But don't worry, with plenty of knowledge, I will cook weaning porridges that are both nutritious and scrumptious.
Step 1: What can my baby eat for weaning?
The first weaning porridges for a baby must be completely pureed, moving from liquid to gradually thicker consistency, and ensuring the 4 food groups as follows:

Fats: Lipids are abundant in oil, fat, butter... providing a concentrated source of energy and helping absorb vitamins A, D, E, K, and developing nerve cells. Children from 0 to 12 months need 1.5-2.3 grams/kg of body weight/day.

Protein: Amino acids in protein molecules are absorbed from the intestines into the blood to synthesize specific proteins, which are basic materials for cells, muscles, bones, teeth, digestive juices, and hormones. The requirement for children under 1 year old is 2-3 grams/kg of body weight/day. Protein-rich foods include eggs, milk, soy, seafood, and meat.

Carbohydrates: Account for more than 60% of total energy in the diet. The energy needed in weaning porridge for children from 4 months old is 10-15 grams/kg of body weight/day. Starchy foods include potatoes, rice, sugar, and corn.

Vitamins and minerals: Your baby will be healthy and gain weight quickly thanks to weaning porridges made from vegetables, grains, and liver. Vitamins A, B1, B2, B12, C, E, iron, calcium, zinc, copper, manganese, phosphorus, and enzymes help develop the brain, transport oxygen, aid the digestive system, and strengthen resistance.

Water accounts for up to 75% of a child's body weight. The average daily water requirement for children under 1 year old is 120-150 ml/kg of body weight. On hot days, children need 2-3 times more water than usual.
Step 2: How to preserve weaning food
Handling pureed food that hasn't been cooked yet is very simple. Put it in a container, wrap it in plastic, and place it in the freezer; it can be stored for up to 30 days.
What about food for daily use? Plastic containers or glass jars are ideal choices and can be stored in the refrigerator for 2 days.

When serving weaning porridge to your baby, remember to warm it up and check the temperature so the baby doesn't get burned. If there is leftover food, throw it away; don't be frugal because harmful bacteria can grow easily and cause illness.

In the beginning, children need to get used to small amounts of finely pureed weaning food. Once the baby consumes fruits and vegetables well, mothers can introduce various meats into the diet. When teething, seafood, beans, and nuts (walnuts, almonds, cashews) will help the child grow strong and healthy.
Step 3: Notes when cooking weaning porridge
Do not cook rice with cold water. The rice grains will swell, causing nutrients to expand and dissolve into the water, losing the sweet aroma.

Do not feed the baby the same food repeatedly. Porridge starts to spoil at room temperature after 2 hours. When stored in the refrigerator, spoilage microorganisms still exist as spores and are only destroyed when boiled. Furthermore, if reheated many times, the vitamins in the vegetables will decompose and the taste will become unpalatable.
Do not defrost meat with hot water. Mothers should defrost in the refrigerator, soak in cold water, or use a microwave because high temperatures help harmful bacteria grow quickly.

Watery vegetables and fruits: Limit storing these in the refrigerator. If left for a long time, these foods will develop black spots and lose their flavor. It's best to cook vegetables and fruits on the day they are fresh.
Pumping 400 ml/time, the baby is chubby thanks to a small tip on Facebook.
Step 4: Weaning porridge for children 6-9 months old

Fresh rice paste: A basic weaning dish that provides immediate energy, enhances metabolism, stimulates gastric juice secretion, and helps the digestive system absorb lipids and proteins better. How to make:
Soak 15g of young rice for about 2 hours in warm water. Then puree with 3 tbsp of water.
Pour the mixture into a pot, add 8 tbsp of water, cook over low heat, and stir constantly until the paste boils and thickens, then leave on the heat for about 2 more minutes.
Millet porridge: Rich in B vitamins and carotene minerals, good for the eyes and skin. How to make:
Soak millet in a 1:10 millet-to-water ratio for 30 minutes. Drain the millet, put it in a pot, add water, and cook for 40 minutes until smooth and pureed.
From 7 months old, children start teething and need protein-rich foods from meat and vitamins from vegetables. The paste can be cooked as a thicker pureed porridge.
Mashed egg yolk: A weaning food rich in iron, and vitamins A, D, E. How to make:
Boil the egg for 10 minutes, mash the yolk, add water, and mix until pasty. Initially, feed the baby about 1/8 of a yolk, then gradually increase to 1/4, 1/2, and the whole yolk.
Note: Before boiling, wash the eggshell thoroughly because the tiny pores on the shell contain many bacteria. When meeting hot water, these pores expand, allowing bacteria to "invade" deeper inside.

Chicken, mushroom, and cabbage soup: An excellent food source providing 68% of protein needs. For babies from 6 months old, mothers should add chicken to the weaning menu for benefits such as muscle development, improved blood circulation, strong bone formation, healthy brain development, and a strengthened immune system. Preparation:
Wash the chicken and boil it, discarding the first water. Put the shredded meat, cabbage, sliced mushrooms, once-washed rice, and sesame oil into a pressure cooker.
When it boils, simmer for about 10 more minutes.

Shrimp floss porridge with Japanese soy sauce: Feeding children this porridge regularly helps bones become firm and healthy and stimulates fast tooth growth. Mothers, remember to peel the shrimp and remove the vein thoroughly.

To make delicious shrimp floss that the baby won't get tired of all week, prepare 1kg of black tiger shrimp, 1/2 tsp sugar, 1 tsp cooking oil, and Japanese soy sauce. Wash the shrimp, drain, remove legs and shells, and roast with the mixture. When cooked, pound the shrimp and roast until dry, fragrant, and golden brown.
Cook the porridge until soft, add vegetables and shrimp floss, and enjoy.
How to pump more milk? See the secret trick now!
Obsessed with low milk supply after birth! What should a mother do to have milk for her baby?
Low milk supply or losing milk when going back to work: No longer a mother's worry.
Step 5: Weaning porridge for babies from 10-12 months old
A 1-year-old baby usually has 8 to 10 incisors and can chew soft food. Take this opportunity to expand the baby's palate with delicious weaning porridges such as:
Rib and carrot porridge: A rib porridge so soft it melts in the mouth, making even adults crave it.
Wash and chop the ribs into pieces. Peel and dice sweet potatoes and carrots.
Simmer the ribs for 30 minutes, removing odors by adding a little ginger.
Remove the bones, add carrots and sweet potatoes, simmer until soft, and mash.
Add 1 bowl of rice to the vegetable mixture and cook into porridge. Shred the meat and mix it in, and you have completed a delicious weaning porridge for your baby.
Chicken and lotus seed porridge: A weaning porridge that has a calming effect, helps the baby sleep well, and stimulates the taste buds. How to make:

Wash the chicken breast and thighs and marinate with seasonings. Then, put the chicken, lotus seeds, and rice into a pot and simmer until it boils, then lower the heat to a very low simmer for about 30 minutes until the porridge is thick and smooth.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Uniquely Delicious and Simple Coconut Water Steamed Shrimp
mon_an.mo_ta: Shrimp is a very popular food in Vietnamese family cuisine and can be prepared into many delicious dishes such as fried breaded shrimp, lemongrass steamed shrimp, shrimp porridge, grilled shrimp... However, you cannot miss coconut water steamed shrimp, a super delicious, fragrant, and attractive dish. Let's explore how to make coconut water steamed shrimp with a fresh and delicious flavor through the article below. Discover how to make fragrant and attractive coconut water steamed shrimp with instructions. Enjoy the fresh taste of coconut water steamed shrimp, a popular and tasty dish in Vietnamese family meals.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fish sauce, salt, seasoning powder, salt and pepper lime dip - as needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the shrimp
After buying the shrimp, cut off the whiskers and wash them before draining.
Next, wash the lettuce and green onions with water.
For the tomatoes and cucumbers, wash and slice them thinly.
With the fresh coconut, trim the top and cut it to collect the water separately, then use the shell to arrange the shrimp for decoration, creating a beautiful dish.
Step 2: Steam the shrimp with coconut water
Pour the coconut water into a pot and boil for about 4 minutes.
Add the minced shallots to the pot and season with salt and seasoning powder to taste. Stir well for about 2 minutes until the shallots are cooked and the seasonings are dissolved.
Next, add the shrimp to the pot and cook over high heat until the shrimp turn red, about 1 minute. Then, turn off the heat.
Remove the shrimp and let them drain.
Take the previously trimmed coconut and arrange the shrimp around the rim of the coconut.
Pour the steaming liquid into the coconut and it's finished.
Arrange the vegetables on a plate to serve alongside.
Step 3: Prepare the dipping sauce
In a mortar, place 1 tbsp of grain salt, 1 tbsp of sugar, 1/2 tbsp of black pepper, 1/2 tbsp of MSG, and 3 chili peppers. Grind until the spices blend into a thick paste.
Then, pour the spice mixture into a small bowl and add 2 tbsp of lime juice. Next, add some finely chopped Vietnamese coriander and mix well.
With these steps, you have completed the dipping sauce for the coconut steamed shrimp.
Step 4: Finished product

The coconut water steamed shrimp dish is truly simple, isn't it? The shrimp will have a beautiful orange color and a characteristic shrimp aroma. When enjoying it, you will feel the tenderness and sweetness of the shrimp meat, especially when combined with coconut water, the sweetness of the shrimp is enhanced.
You can enjoy this dish with salt, pepper, and lime or various seafood dipping sauces; they are all wonderful. Make this dish right away for the whole family to enjoy!
How to choose fresh shrimp

Fresh shrimp are identified by these characteristics: the legs are transparent and tightly attached to the body. The body of fresh shrimp has a slight curve, firm meat, and is not oversized or water-bloated. The tails of fresh shrimp will be neatly folded together.

If the tail is flared or loose, and the tail fin is missing, the shrimp has been dead for a long time and is no longer fresh. Fresh black tiger shrimp have a transparent turquoise shell, a slight shine, and a ridge running along the middle of the body. Fresh banana shrimp are pinkish-white with green eyes and are still alive. Fresh lobster has a shiny shell, green tint, and clear brownish-black patterns. The larger the lobster meat, the sweeter and firmer it is.
A tip to check for fresh shrimp is to pull the tail and head straight, then hold it up to the light. If the distance between the shell joints is wide, the shrimp has been dead for a long time.
You can choose black tiger shrimp, giant river prawns, lobster, or any type of shrimp you like. The important thing is that the shrimp must be fresh, alive, and feel firm.

mon_an.ten: The Simplest Guide to Cooking Chicken Porridge for Babies
mon_an.mo_ta: Let's cook a delicious chicken porridge for your baby during the changing seasons! Hopefully, this guide on how to cook chicken porridge will help you have a delicious dish to treat your family.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Side ingredients (only for chicken porridge fans, babies should not eat these)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Boil the chicken

Clean the chicken, rub it with salt and ginger, then rinse. Place in a pot with a few grains of salt for flavor and aroma, and boil until tender. You can add a few slices of ginger to make the chicken fragrant. When the chicken is cooked, remove it and set aside to drain. The fatty and sweet chicken broth will be used to cook the porridge in the next steps.

Small tip: You can choose to buy half a chicken or just the breast or thigh meat to cook the porridge according to your taste. Thigh meat is sweeter and more fragrant, but chicken breast is more nutritious. To balance it out, you can buy 2 thighs and 1 breast for a delicious porridge.
Step 2: While the chicken is boiling, mix the glutinous rice and plain rice together, then wash and remove any grit or dirt.
Step 3: Put the cleaned rice into a pot, add a little water, bring to a boil, then lower the heat and simmer gently.
Step 4: When the chicken is done boiling, pour the fragrant, fatty chicken broth into the porridge pot, bring to a boil, then lower the heat to a simmer until the rice is soft and broken down.
Step 5: Wash the green onions and chop them finely. Peel the ginger, wash it, and mince it.
Step 6: After the boiled chicken from Step 1 has drained and cooled slightly, shred it into small pieces (remember to remove the bones so the baby doesn't choke).
Step 7: When the porridge is soft, add the green onions, minced ginger, and shredded chicken...
... Then stir well.
...and season again to taste, then turn off the heat. You have now completed a very delicious chicken porridge for your baby.
Some small tips for a delicious baby chicken porridge:

You should mix glutinous rice and plain rice; the glutinous rice will create a more attractive aroma for the porridge. But be careful not to use too much glutinous rice, or the porridge will be too sticky and quickly become cloying.
Adding a few grains of salt and a few slices of ginger when boiling the chicken in Step 1 will make the chicken more flavorful and fragrant.
Using warm water to cook the porridge in Step 3 is to prevent the porridge from boiling over.

When cooking porridge, remember not to add salt to the pot too early, as the rice will be hard to soften and the cooking time will be longer. Therefore, in Step 3, absolutely do not add salt or seasoning, partly for the reason above and partly because the chicken broth already contains salt. If you season the porridge before adding the chicken broth, it may become too salty. You should wait until the end to season to your taste.

If you have a pressure cooker, it's best for cooking porridge—it's both fast and fuel-efficient. With a pressure cooker, you just need to tighten the lid, bring to a boil, and simmer for about 10 minutes until the rice is soft. If you don't have a pressure cooker, using a regular pot will take much longer.

Green onions bought from the market often contain many pesticides, which are not safe for babies. I often grow green onions in foam boxes or small pots on the terrace; they grow very well, saving money and ensuring safety. Mothers should give it a try.

Besides cooking for babies, mothers can use chicken porridge to change the menu for the whole family; it will be very delicious. When eating, you can serve chicken porridge with fried dough sticks, fried shallots, and other seasonings like pepper, chili powder, or pickled vegetables, salted eggs... it will be very tasty. However, mothers should not give babies these spicy seasonings because their stomachs are still weak; eating spicy things like pepper or chili powder is not good for them. You can also change the baby's menu with scallop and pumpkin porridge according to the recipe.

mon_an.mo_ta: Steamed Clams with Egg – A delicious, easy-to-make, attractive, and unique dish packed with nutrients for the whole family. Learn the delicious way to make Steamed Clams with Egg.
cac_buoc: When the clams are freshly bought, discard any dead ones and soak the clams in water with a bit of crushed chili so they release all dirt, then rinse again with water. Boil the clams until cooked.

Step 1: After the clams have boiled and opened their shells, carefully remove them and pick out the meat, placing it in a heat-resistant bowl. Beat the eggs in a bowl with 1 tsp of seasoning powder and 2 tbsp of cooking oil. Wash and finely chop the green onions to decorate the steamed clams and eggs.

Step 2: Pour the beaten egg mixture into the bowl containing the clams, sprinkle green onions on top, then steam for 15 minutes. Note that if you use a microwave, you should use a low power setting so the dish cooks slowly. If you use high heat, the eggs will puff up and won't be as tasty.
Source: Xinhxinh

mon_an.mo_ta: Avocado is a fruit with high protein content, very good for women's skin care and providing nutrition for those who are thin or have a loss of appetite. Let's make a nutritious smoothie for everyone!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the avocado, halve it, remove the pit, peel it, and cut it into chunks. Put all the avocado and other ingredients into a blender together.
Step 2: Pour into a glass, decorate, and enjoy your delicious and nutritious Avocado Smoothie.

mon_an.ten: Delicious Shrimp and Pumpkin Soup for Babies
mon_an.mo_ta: Mothers, let's learn how to cook delicious shrimp and pumpkin soup for babies according to the recipe. This shrimp and pumpkin soup is both tasty and easy to make, helping mothers supplement nutrients and vitamins for their babies while enriching the baby's menu and providing a frequent change of pace. The dish is fragrant and has an eye-catching color that will be very attractive to children.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Heavy cream - 250ml (can be replaced with fresh milk)
Olive oil (or cooking oil) - As needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare ingredients

Wash the shrimp, peel them, and leave the tails on 3 shrimp for a beautiful presentation later. Use a knife to slit the back of the shrimp and remove the black vein. For the three shrimp with tails, thread the tail through the slit in the middle of the body for an attractive look. Mince the remaining shrimp. Marinate the shrimp with a little pepper and seasoning powder or seasoned salt to absorb the flavor.
Peel the pumpkin, remove the seeds, wash, and slice thinly.
Peel the onion, wash, and mince it.
Wash the cilantro and chop it finely.
Step 2: Cook the shrimp and pumpkin soup

Heat a pan, add olive oil (or cooking oil) and 1/2 slice of butter. Add 1/2 of the minced onion and sauté until fragrant, then add the pumpkin and a little seasoning powder or seasoned salt and stir-fry briefly so the pumpkin absorbs the flavor. Then add the broth and cook until the pumpkin is soft. Use a spoon to mash it or put it in a blender to puree until smooth. Pour back into the pot and bring to a boil.
While waiting for the pumpkin soup to boil, add the remaining oil and butter to a pan, sauté the rest of the onion until fragrant, then add the shrimp and stir-fry briefly.
When the pumpkin soup boils, add the milk and the briefly stir-fried shrimp. Season to taste, sprinkle with chopped cilantro, and turn off the heat.
Step 3: Presentation
Ladle the pumpkin soup into a deep plate or bowl, arrange the 3 shrimp with tails pointing up for a beautiful look, sprinkle a few culantro leaves on top, and serve hot.
Here is the finished shrimp and pumpkin soup.
Some secrets for a delicious shrimp and pumpkin soup:

Using heavy cream to cook the soup will make the shrimp and pumpkin soup richer and creamier. If you don't like it too rich, you can adjust the ratio of fresh milk and heavy cream or replace all the heavy cream with fresh milk. Near my house, they only sell 1L cartons of heavy cream, so after cooking, I have to store the cream in the refrigerator. You should not keep opened heavy cream in the refrigerator for too long; it's not good. I usually use it all within about 1 week. Besides cooking soup, you can use heavy cream to make ice cream or cakes.
When cooking for babies, I usually use olive oil to make the dish both delicious and healthy. However, if you don't have olive oil, you can use regular cooking oil as a replacement.

mon_an.ten: How to Cook Sea Crab Porridge to Help Babies Gain Weight Quickly
mon_an.mo_ta: Sea crab porridge is a wonderful dish, especially suitable for little ones who need to gain weight. It features pieces of crab meat sautéed with fragrant shallots, rich in nutrients, blended with the sweetness of carrots and sweet corn. This dish will quickly become a favorite for your baby. Mothers, don't hesitate to learn how to make this delicious dish!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the crab and boil it with lemongrass and a little ginger.

When the crab is cooked, let it cool slightly and then remove the crab meat carefully, avoiding any sharp shell fragments left in the meat. Since the babies are still small, you should only feed them the meat and not the crab roe!

Step 2: Wash the corn and cut the kernels off the cob. Then, puree the corn kernels with 90ml of water, filter out the pulp, and use the corn water to cook the porridge to increase the sweetness and flavor of the dish.

Step 3: Place the pot of corn water on the stove and cook with the rice. While cooking, add 1/2 a carrot to sweeten the broth. Finely mince the remaining 1/2 carrot according to the texture the baby can eat.
After 45 minutes—when the porridge is cooked—remove the stewed carrot chunk and add the finely minced carrot to cook through.
Step 4: Next, when the porridge is almost ready to be turned off, finely mince the crab meat.
Then, place a pan on the stove and add olive oil. When the oil is hot, sauté 1/2 a minced dried shallot until very fragrant, then add the crab meat and stir-fry quickly.
Step 5: Finally, pour the carrot porridge into a bowl, sprinkle the crab meat sautéed with fragrant shallots on top, add a few drops of Gac oil, and let the baby enjoy!

mon_an.ten: How to Make Super Delicious Meatballs in Tomato Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: Meatballs in tomato sauce can be said to be extremely delicious, quick, and still ensure a tasty meal. Refer to our way of making this dish through the article below!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Tear the sandwich bread into small pieces. Add the ground meat, 1/2 of the minced garlic, minced onion, salt, chili powder, pepper, all-purpose flour, and egg, and mix very well.
Pour the milk into the above mixture, mix well again, then cover the bowl with plastic wrap and place in the refrigerator for 30 minutes.

Step 2: Take the mixture out of the refrigerator and form the meat into bite-sized balls. Place a pan on the stove, add a little cooking oil, and lightly fry the meatballs until the surfaces are golden.

Step 3: Sauté the remaining minced garlic until fragrant, then add the meatballs and the washed, chopped, and deseeded tomato. Add the broth and simmer over low heat for 10 minutes to make the meatballs in tomato sauce rich and delicious.
Step 4: Add the tomato sauce and cook until the sauce thickens and the meatballs are evenly coated. Ladle onto a plate and serve hot with rice.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Fragrant and Rich Steamed Eggs with Straw Mushrooms
mon_an.mo_ta: Just add a few straw mushrooms to the familiar egg dish and steam it in a steamer, and you have a delicious, easy-to-make dish of steamed eggs with straw mushrooms to treat the whole family. This fragrant and rich dish, with its simple combination of eggs and straw mushrooms, provides high nutritional value and is good for health due to the steaming method. Learn to cook well with this unique new dish!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Pick the roots and old leaves off the cilantro, wash it, and let it drain. Finely mince the lean meat.
Step 2: Wash the straw mushrooms, soak them in salt water, and then slice them thinly so they cook quickly when steamed.
Step 3: Crack the eggs into a bowl with the minced meat, stir well, then add the straw mushrooms and chopped green onions. Add seasoning and pepper to taste.

Step 4: Place the bowl of eggs, meat, and mushrooms into a steamer and steam for about 30 minutes. Remove the egg bowl from the steamer and eat while hot. You have finished cooking the fragrant and rich Steamed Eggs with Straw Mushrooms.

mon_an.mo_ta: Get into the kitchen and create a wonderful plate of fried eggs with minced pork. The combination of eggs and minced meat makes this dish an attractive choice. The method and ingredients are very simple, and the secret to a delicious fried egg dish lies in the frying technique. Discover how to make delicious fried eggs with minced pork without spending too much time or effort through this recipe! This guide for fried eggs with pork is a nutritious dish for children. Simple and quick to prepare, it provides essential protein and fats for a child's development.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning - Fish sauce, ground pepper, chili sauce, and MSG.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Green onions: After purchasing, trim the roots and remove wilted leaves, wash thoroughly, and finely chop.
Shallots: Peel, crush, and mince.
Eggs: Crack 2 eggs into a small bowl, then use chopsticks to beat the yolks and whites together.
Step 2: Prepare the sauce
Mix the following seasonings to create the sauce: 2 tsp fish sauce, 1 tsp sugar, 1/2 tsp chili sauce, a bit of ground pepper, and 2 tsp filtered water.
When mixing, ensure the ingredients are well combined.
Step 3: Fry the eggs and minced pork
Place a non-stick pan on the stove and pour in 2 tbsp of cooking oil.
Add the shallots to the pan and sauté until fragrant.
Next, add the minced pork to the pan and stir-fry over high heat until the meat firms up.
Once the meat is firm, add the eggs to the pan.
Step 4: Gently swirl the pan so the eggs evenly cover the minced pork
Adjust the heat to low to ensure the meat and eggs cook evenly.
When the eggs are partially set, pour the bowl of sauce into the pan and continue frying.
Continue frying until the eggs are completely cooked.
Once the eggs are done, sprinkle green onions on top and turn off the heat.
Finally, you have completed the fried eggs with minced pork. Enjoy this delicious dish with family and friends!
Step 5: Finished product

After completing the above steps, you can present the fried eggs with minced pork on a plate and get ready to enjoy. This dish does not require complex ingredients or advanced cooking techniques, yet it still delivers a delicious flavor.

The plate of fried eggs with minced pork will have the yellow of the eggs, the brown of the meat, and the green of the onions, creating a perfect harmony. The dish has a savory flavor, very suitable for pairing with white rice.
Enjoy this fried egg with minced pork dish and the wonderful flavor it brings!
Notes for making delicious fried eggs with minced pork

To succeed in making fried eggs with minced pork, there are several important factors to note. First, use a pan with a good non-stick coating and ensure there is enough cooking oil. If the pan is not non-stick or is of poor quality, the meat and eggs may stick to the bottom, making it look unappealing and easy to break when serving.

If you want the eggs to be moist, you can mix the sauce into the eggs before frying. However, if you prefer them drier, you can skip the sauce and instead add seasonings directly to the eggs while beating them and to the meat while stir-frying. During the frying process, flip both sides of the eggs to ensure they are evenly cooked and have a beautiful golden color.
By following these factors, you will be able to successfully make fried eggs with minced pork and achieve the desired results.
IV. How to choose fresh ingredients
1. How to choose minced pork
To choose minced pork, there are several methods you can apply. Here are the ways to select minced pork appropriately:

Buy pre-ground meat at the market: Although you can find pre-ground meat at the market, this method does not guarantee hygiene and safety, as you do not know exactly which part of the meat was ground or if it was handled hygienically.

Buy a piece of pork and have it ground on the spot: Another way is to buy a piece of pork and ask the seller to grind it for you. Or you can buy the pork and take it home to grind yourself using a meat grinder or by hand-mincing.

Find minced pork at specialty food stores: Currently, some stores specializing in meat and raw foods, supermarkets, and shopping centers also provide minced pork. Buying meat here ensures hygiene and peace of mind, though the price may be higher than at the market.
Through the above methods, you can choose to buy minced pork appropriately and ensure hygiene and quality.
2. How to buy good eggs

Check the shell: If you are buying commercial eggs, choose those with thick shells and dark colors. This usually applies to commercial eggs as they are often raised in controlled conditions resulting in thicker shells. If you are buying free-range eggs, choose those with rough, hard shells and a thin layer of powder around them.

Shake the egg: Gently shake the egg and listen for any movement inside. If the egg sloshes or makes a sound, it may be old and should not be purchased. Conversely, if there is no sound, the egg is fresh and is a good choice to buy.

Check the expiration date: For commercial eggs, check the expiration date on the carton. Avoid buying eggs that have expired or are near their expiration date as they may spoil before you can use them all.

mon_an.ten: Beautiful and Delicious Shrimp Egg Rolls
mon_an.mo_ta: A delicious and unique steamed shrimp egg roll dish for family meals. Each spiral-shaped piece is extremely eye-catching with the golden yellow of the eggs, the pink of the shrimp, and the red of the carrots, providing full nutrition for the whole family. This tasty dish is also very attractive to children. Give it a try!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the shrimp filling

Clean the shrimp, peel, and mince or grind finely. Use a spoon (if using a machine) or a pestle (if pounding by hand) to mash the shrimp until the meat is smooth and sticky to increase binding. Marinate with a little seasoning powder and pepper to taste.
Peel the carrots, wash, shred, then finely mince and mix into the shrimp.
Step 2: Fry the eggs
Crack the eggs into a bowl and beat with a little seasoning powder and pepper.
Heat a pan, add a little oil to coat the surface, then pour in the eggs, tilting the pan to spread the eggs thinly and evenly. Once the eggs are cooked, turn off the heat.
Step 3: Roll the eggs
Once the omelet is cooked, place it on a clean cutting board (or a flat surface) to cool slightly...
... Then use a spoon to spread the shrimp and carrot mixture from step 2 evenly over the egg surface. Note to leave about 0.5-1cm of the outer edge clear for rolling.
Gently roll the egg up to enclose the filling inside.
Step 4: Steam the eggs

Place the egg rolls in a steamer and steam for about 10-15 minutes. Adjust the time depending on the amount of ingredients. Usually, when a toothpick inserted comes out clean, the shrimp inside is cooked. Turn off the heat, arrange on a plate, and serve hot.
Small tips for shrimp egg rolls:
I learned this from my cousin who is a preschool teacher. According to her, kids will really love this dish.
My family usually cuts the rolls into bite-sized rounds and arranges them to show off the beautiful spiral layers.
You can replace the shrimp filling with other fillings like raw sausage paste (giò sống), featherback fish paste, chicken, or beef... they are all very delicious.
You can separate the egg yolks and whites. Fry the yolk first, then pour the white on top, then spread the shrimp on the white and roll it up to make the dish even more beautiful.
After steaming, you can also wrap a sheet of seaweed around the egg pieces for a very tasty variation.

mon_an.mo_ta: Fried eggs with baby clams – exceptionally nutritious and incredibly easy to make. How to make fried eggs with baby clams.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, pepper, seasoning powder, fish sauce, shallots
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the baby clam meat and drain in a colander.
Step 2: Beat the eggs with 2 tsp fish sauce, a little pepper, 1 tsp cooking oil, 1 tsp cold water, 1/2 tsp seasoning powder, and chopped green onions.
Step 3: Sauté the shallots and minced lemongrass in a hot pan until fragrant, then add the clam meat and stir-fry until cooked to make the filling for the dish.

Step 4: Pour the egg mixture over the cooked clam meat, cook over low heat so the eggs cook gradually without drying out. When the eggs have set and thickened, flip them over. Wait until both sides are golden, then remove to a plate and serve hot to avoid any fishy smell.
Source: Ngoi sao

mon_an.mo_ta: Homemade Banana Custard – A delicious, easy-to-make dish prepared by mom, both nutritious and meaningful for the little ones at home. Cooking lesson on how to make homemade banana custard for kids.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Ripe banana or other fruit - 1 fruit
cac_buoc: Step 1: Blend the peeled and sliced ripe banana, heavy cream, and cornstarch in a blender until smooth.
Step 2: Put the fresh milk and baby formula into a small pot, cook over low heat, stirring constantly while heating the custard.

Note: For dishes cooked for children, especially porridge, powder, or custard, you should use a separate pot for the baby. Children's taste buds are very sensitive; they can distinguish flavors that we cannot perceive. If you use a pot used for braising fish or cooking soup to cook for the baby, they may refuse to eat.

Step 3: When the milk is hot, slowly pour in the blended mixture from step 1, stirring constantly until the mixture thickens. Turn off the heat, then scoop into small bowls or glass jars, let cool, and store in the refrigerator.
Source: Tap chi yeu bep gia dinh

mon_an.ten: 3 Dishes for People with Low Blood Pressure
mon_an.mo_ta: As stress, fatigue, and pressure from work, family, and social relationships increase, the rate of people suffering from low blood pressure is rising. Some people with low blood pressure readings often show no symptoms, so they tend to be subjective and accept living with the condition. However, they are always bothered by headaches, dizziness, and lightheadedness in their daily lives. To prevent and treat it well, diet is also an effective treatment. What should you pay attention to in your diet when you have low blood pressure? This article will help you understand this issue better. 1. Dietary regimen for low blood pressure patients
cac_buoc: Patients should eat regularly and have full meals, especially breakfast with heart-healthy foods. Divide into many small meals with protein-containing foods such as: biscuits, cereals, Vitamin C from fruits like oranges, tangerines, pineapple... Vitamin B group like milk, meat, fish... to help boost metabolism and improve memory. Avoid letting the body get hungry as it can cause blood sugar to drop suddenly.

Contrary to people with high blood pressure, low blood pressure patients should eat foods containing more salt. The sodium content in salt can help your blood pressure rise gradually, but in cases of heart disease, you need to consult a doctor.
Increase foods like chicken, fish, and vegetables in the menu.
People with low blood pressure can use more coffee or strong tea but should not overindulge.
Add honey, milk, and sweetened lemon water to the menu.
Avoid dehydration; drink enough water every day, especially after exercising or in hot weather to provide sodium and potassium for the body.

Patients need to supplement iron for the body found in foods such as: animal liver, lean meat, shrimp, fish, shiitake mushrooms, wood ear mushrooms, cereals, amaranth, grape juice, lotus seeds, hawthorn, beans, pomegranate... to improve anemia.

For those who have a loss of appetite, spices like ginger, garlic, pepper, butter, etc., can be added to stimulate gastric secretions, promote digestion, and excite blood vessels to increase blood pressure.
2. Foods patients should avoid
Avoid alcoholic beverages which cause dehydration and loss of salt in the body.
Carrots can lower blood pressure or cause dizziness and headaches.
Avoid eating tomatoes as they lower blood pressure, causing dizziness.
Chestnuts, hawthorn, and royal jelly have the effect of contracting the heart and dilating arteries, which drops blood pressure.
In addition, you should also abstain from celery, mung beans, red beans, watermelon, onions, etc., which can lower the patient's blood pressure.
3. Some dishes that support the treatment of low blood pressure
Recipe 1: Eggs with Velvet Antler Powder
Ingredients:
1 egg
0.3g velvet antler powder
Preparation: Crack the egg into a bowl, add the velvet antler powder, stir well and fry until cooked; eat as a daily breakfast.
Recipe 2: Beef Stew with Goji Berries
10g goji berries, 6g cistanche, 10g dodder seed
1 beef kidney, 100g beef, 1 dog kidney, 50g chicken.

Preparation: Clean the beef and dog kidneys, cut in half and soak in cold water for 30 minutes; slice the beef and chicken, put the herbs into a cloth bag and tie tightly. Then put everything into a pot and simmer over low heat until tender, then remove the herb bag, add pepper, julienned fresh ginger, and seasonings; divide into several portions to eat during the day.

Used for the 'heart and spleen deficiency' type: Manifested by great fatigue, palpitations, shortness of breath, dizziness, limb exhaustion, blurred vision or sweating, poor appetite, slow digestion, pale tongue, pale complexion, and loose stools.
Recipe 3: Pork Stomach Stew with Lotus Seeds
1 pork stomach
40 fresh lotus seeds.

Preparation: Clean the stomach, remove the hearts from the lotus seeds, put them inside the pork stomach, tie the opening tightly, add enough water, simmer until tender; once cooked, take out the stomach, slice it, and mix with the lotus seeds, adding fresh ginger, pepper, and seasonings to serve as a dish.
Additionally, you can use some types of tea such as cinnamon-soaked licorice, poria-soaked kimchi, lotus seed and red date tea, etc., to help prevent and ward off low blood pressure.
4. Some ways to help improve low blood pressure
Get enough sleep: Low blood pressure patients need to get plenty of sleep, about 9–11 hours/day. This is also something family members should note to avoid restricting the patient's sleep.

Wake up correctly: Explaining why this is necessary, experts analyze as follows: When sleeping, blood concentrates in the stomach area, causing temporary cerebral anemia. If a person with low blood pressure wakes up suddenly, they may faint. Therefore, waking up correctly is very important. To do this, when waking up, the patient should lie for a while longer and perform a few simple movements (can move the joints of the limbs). Then sit up slowly, keep the limbs on the bed, then slowly put the legs off the bed while continuing to sit. When standing up, hold onto a chair and stand like that for a while.

Increase physical exercise: Exercises are very beneficial for people with low blood pressure, such as walking, swimming, and sports games. However, patients should not choose sports that are too intense, and many cases of the condition have disappeared after a period of practice.

Use Polyscias fruticosa tea: According to traditional medicine records, the roots and leaves of Polyscias fruticosa have a sweet, cool, slightly bitter taste, which helps clear blood vessels and nourish the blood. This improves low blood pressure, increases blood circulation to the brain, and helps improve memory. You can refer to TRC Polyscias fruticosa tea here.

mon_an.ten: Sweet and Sour Chicken Salad – Weight Loss Menu
mon_an.mo_ta: This sweet and sour chicken salad is delicious, and you can eat as much as you want without worrying about weight gain!
cac_buoc: Ingredients needed:
Step 1:
Boil the chicken until cooked, then shred into bite-sized pieces. Prepare the sauce: mix chili sauce with salad dressing or mayonnaise.
Step 2:
Boil the peas until cooked. Blanch the bean sprouts in boiling water.
Step 3:
Thinly slice the onion into strips and chop the chilies. You can lightly sauté them if you cannot stand the pungency of raw onions!
Step 4:
Put the onion, chilies, sauce, chicken, peas, and bean sprouts into a bowl and mix well. You can add a bit of lemon juice if you like an extra mild sour taste!
Finished product:

Sweet and sour chicken salad is a dish familiar to everyone, but the combination of chicken with bean sprouts and peas will bring you a refreshing and surprisingly delicious experience! Making chicken salad this way is quick, colorful, and looks very eye-catching and attractive! Just looking at it makes your mouth water!

mon_an.mo_ta: Each dish from the land of Kimchi is presented with many colors and rich spices... highlighted by the fiery chili taste, bold seasonings, and enjoyed with a bit of soju. Spicy grilled octopus is truly a delicious dish not to be missed if you want to explore this land.
cac_buoc: 2. Clean the octopus and take the tentacles. Next, wrap the tentacles around skewers and lightly grill them.
3. Finely mince the onion and put it in a bowl. Add chili sauce, chili powder, soy sauce, sesame oil, minced garlic, salt, and pepper, then mix well.
4. Brush the mixed mixture onto the octopus, then grill over charcoal. Once the octopus is cooked, sprinkle some white sesame seeds on top and serve hot.

mon_an.ten: Quick Spaghetti Recipe for Busy Days
mon_an.mo_ta: If one day you are too busy to cook a full meal? You still need full nutrition and energy but don't have enough time to cook a meal with soup, savory dishes, stir-fries...? Don't worry, we will help you! This quick spaghetti recipe for busy days will ensure enough nutrition and energy for you while still being extremely fast and delicious! Try it on your next busy day!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Thinly slice the smoked sausages and onion, halve the cherry tomatoes, and crush the garlic.

Step 2: In a large pot, sequentially add the tomatoes, onion, sausages, spaghetti, and basil leaves. The pasta will still be hard at this point and might not fit in the pot, but don't worry—just pour in enough water to cover the ingredients. Then, season to taste.

Step 3: Cook the pot of pasta over medium heat until the water boils. At this point, the pasta will gradually soften; you can use chopsticks to press the pasta down into the water. Next, cover the lid and lower the heat, occasionally opening the pot to stir so the pasta strands cook evenly.

Step 4: After about 10 minutes, the water will gradually evaporate; you can take out a strand of pasta to test for doneness. Depending on whether you like your pasta soft or slightly al dente, you can continue cooking for a few more minutes.

Step 5: Finally, remove the pot from the heat and drain any excess cooking water if the pasta is cooked but the water hasn't fully evaporated. Sprinkle with grated parmesan cheese, mix everything up, and you're done.
Our quick spaghetti is now complete!

mon_an.ten: Secret to Sweet and Non-Pungent Pickled Shallots
mon_an.mo_ta: Usually, people use fresh shallots for traditional pickling, but my family has a secret for pickling with purple shallots—it's extremely delicious, not pungent at all, and the color is beautiful. Everyone, give it a try!
cac_buoc: Peel the shallots and trim the roots; note not to wash the shallots.
Wash the sour starfruit, chop it, squeeze out the juice, and keep the pulp separately. You should choose ripe starfruit to get more juice.
Layer the shallots and coarse salt alternately in a bowl.
Then pour the squeezed starfruit juice over until the shallots are submerged.

Cover the top with the starfruit pulp, close the container, and leave for about 1 day. Doing this will give the pickled shallots a beautiful red color. Occasionally turn the shallots so the color is even.

After one day, pour a portion of vinegar into two small bowls. Take out a few shallots at a time and put them in the first bowl of vinegar for the first rinse, then move them to the second bowl for a second rinse, then place them in a colander to drain.

When the shallots are dry, layer them in a glass jar, sprinkle a layer of sugar on top, and repeat until all shallots are used. Note that the top layer must be sugar. Usually, I use about 200gr of sugar.
Leave for about half a day for the sugar to turn into liquid.

Boil the remaining sugar and vinegar until dissolved, let it cool completely, then pour into the jar. Use a weight or bamboo slats to press down so the shallots are submerged in the liquid. Leave for about half a day and they are ready to use.
If made this way, the pickled shallots will have a sweet and sour taste and retain a very beautiful red color. You can store them in the refrigerator to eat gradually.
If you don't like the sweet taste, you can still pickle shallots the traditional way and use the sour starfruit to make ginger-sautéed starfruit treats, which are also delicious.
Happy cooking @.

mon_an.mo_ta: A variation with luncheon meat rice sliders for a quick but no less delicious meal. A cooking lesson for an extremely simple dish that anyone can make. This easy-to-make luncheon meat rice slider is a great idea for busy days.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Open the meat can and remove the meat to prepare for the rice sliders later.
Put the rice into the empty meat can, pressing it down firmly to make the rice compact.
Step 2:
Slice the luncheon meat into bite-sized pieces.
Place the meat in a pan with a little oil, heat it up, and lightly fry until the surfaces are golden.
Step 3: Shake the meat can to remove the rice for the sliders. Cut the rice into bite-sized rounds with a thickness similar to the meat.

Step 4: Cut the seaweed into strips 1 cm wide. Place a piece of golden-fried meat between 2 pieces of rice, and wrap it with a seaweed strip. When eating, you can serve with chili sauce or mayonnaise to make the rice dish more flavorful. For those who like sesame seeds, you can sprinkle some on the rice surface; it will be much more fragrant.

mon_an.mo_ta: Pineapple is a fruit that is very beneficial for the body. It is not only used for dessert but also to create attractive savory dishes. The combination of pineapple and beef creates an irresistible and delicious beef roll dish.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Halve the pineapple and scoop out the flesh, keeping the shell intact for decoration. Cut the pineapple flesh into strips; crush the remaining flesh and squeeze to extract the pineapple juice.

Step 2: Slice the beef into thin pieces, then marinate with coconut milk, curry powder, and seasoning powder for about 5 minutes. Spread the beef slices on a plate, place a pineapple strip on top, and roll tightly (do not roll too loosely as they may fall apart when frying).
Step 3: Pan-fry the beef rolls in a pan with a little oil until medium-rare, place them in the pineapple shell, sprinkle with sesame seeds, and enjoy.
Tip: Using a bit of fragrant coconut milk when marinating the beef will help the dish become tender, sweet, and aromatic.
Enjoy your meal!

mon_an.mo_ta: Beef is a nutrient-rich food that can be used to prepare many delicious dishes, from main courses like steak, beef rolls with enoki mushrooms, and beef soup to stir-fries and snacks like beef jerky or papaya salad with dried beef. Today, I will share with you a way to cook an extremely delicious and attractive beef stew.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Beef - 500 g (choose tenderloin for a soft and fragrant texture)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Cube the beef into bite-sized pieces and marinate with a little pepper and salt. My secret is to add a little cooking oil to the marinade to keep the beef tender and fragrant.
Place the beef in a pot, add water, onion, ginger, and salt; let it soak for a while, then drain. Keep the soaking water to cook the meat later.
Step 2:
Wash the celery. Peel and wash the carrot. Peel and wash the onion. Dice all these ingredients.
Wash the tomato and cut into wedges.
Step 3: Heat the cooking oil and sauté the tomatoes for about 2 minutes until soft.
Then add the tomato sauce and stir well for about 3 minutes.
Step 4: Add the soaking water from step 1 until the beef is just covered, bring to a boil, then add the cubed beef.
Next, add thyme (optional) and a bit of beef stew seasoning.
Cover and simmer over low heat for about 40 minutes until the beef is tender.
Step 5: Heat a pan, add butter, and once melted and hot, sauté the onion until fragrant. Then add the carrots and celery, a pinch of salt, and stir-fry until cooked.
Step 6: Once the beef has simmered for 40 minutes and is tender, pour the sautéed vegetables from step 5 into the pot and simmer for another 5-10 minutes.
Season to taste, then turn off the heat, sprinkle with black pepper, and serve hot.
It's quite simple, isn't it? You can enjoy this beef stew with white rice or bread; both are delicious.

mon_an.mo_ta: Crispy Fried Avocado is a unique and flavorful dish. This daily cooking guide features fresh avocado that is nutty, creamy, and rich.
cac_buoc: Let's start making Crispy Fried Avocado:
Step 1:
Peel the avocados and cut into slices.
Whisk the egg.

Step 2: Dip the avocado slices into the egg, then coat them in the bowl of panko breadcrumbs. Place a pan on the stove, add cooking oil, and once hot, drop each breaded avocado slice in. Fry until golden brown, then remove and place on a tray or plate lined with paper towels.
Serve with chili sauce or ketchup; both are very tasty.

mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried beef with green mango is a unique yet simple and easy-to-make dish. The beef becomes more tender and sweet when combined with crunchy, sour, and slightly sweet slices of green mango, making it a very refreshing meal.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning powder, cooking oil, pepper - to taste
cac_buoc: Step 1: Slice the beef thinly, marinate with oyster sauce for about 10 minutes, then dust with cornstarch and sear until the surface is browned. Peel the mango, remove the pit, and slice diagonally. Peel the onion and cut into large cubes. Wash the green and red bell peppers, remove the seeds, and cut into cubes.

Step 2: Place a pan on the stove, sauté the garlic until fragrant, then briefly sauté the ginger. Add the bell peppers and onion, season with 2 tsp of seasoning powder to taste. Add the mango and seared beef, toss everything together, sprinkle with 1 tsp of pepper, turn off the heat, and transfer to a plate. Mix well before serving.

mon_an.mo_ta: Meat-wrapped broccoli is a nutritionally balanced dish. The green vegetable provides fiber while the meat provides protein. Together, they create a wonderful dish that isn't heavy from oil and is very delicious!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Cut the broccoli in half and wash it. Then use a small knife to separate the florets.
Note: Keep the stems a bit long so the florets do not crumble.
Step 3: Blanch the broccoli in a pot of boiling water with a little salt for 1-2 minutes; then rinse with cold water.
Step 4: Mix the meat, shallots, egg, breadcrumbs, milk, and nutmeg thoroughly.
Step 5: Wrap the meat mixture around each floret, leaving the stem exposed to serve as a handle.
Step 6: Briefly sear in a pan with oil, then wrap tightly in aluminum foil.
Step 7: Bake at 200°C for about 15 minutes.
Tip: You can replace broccoli with long-cut carrots or other vegetables, as long as they have a 'handle'.

mon_an.mo_ta: A new dish with a unique combination that creates an extraordinary flavor to make your family meal warmer and more joyful! Spicy grilled pomfret should be paired with roasted sweet potatoes and a few lemon slices for the perfect taste!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Minced chili, minced ginger - 1 tsp each
cac_buoc: Step 1: Mix all the above spices in a large bowl to make the sauce; use 2/3 of it to marinate the fish for 5 minutes.

Step 2: Place the fish fillets on a grill, using a charcoal, electric, or induction stove. Grill until the bottom side is slightly golden, then gently flip and baste with a little sauce. Wait 3 minutes, then flip again and baste with more sauce. Continue until the fish is fully cooked.
Step 3: Arrange the Spicy Grilled Pomfret on a plate, garnish with lemon slices, and enjoy with roasted sweet potatoes or rice.

mon_an.mo_ta: Have you ever tried steaming three different types of eggs together? With this guide, you will have a delicious and highly nutritious dish.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 1 stainless steel tray (can be replaced with a foil-lined tray)
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, prepare the tray. You can use a stainless steel tray or a foil-lined tray as shown in the picture.
Step 2:
For the fresh chicken eggs, separate the whites and yolks. Beat the yolks until smooth. Note: do not let the eggs foam, as this will cause bubbles on the surface when steaming.
Cut the salted eggs and century eggs into small pieces and arrange them in the tray. Pour in the egg whites and lightly steam until the whites set.
Step 3:
Next, pour the beaten yolks over the top and steam for 20 minutes. Note: leave the lid slightly ajar while steaming so that condensation does not drip onto the eggs.
This is incredibly delicious when served with hot rice!

mon_an.mo_ta: Tender beef slices coated in a crispy layer and tossed in a rich sweet and sour orange sauce make this dish both fragrant and delightful. Everyone is sure to love it. Let's explore the recipe for Orange Beef Stir-fry!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Scallions, garlic, ground chili, cooking oil - ingredients
cac_buoc: 1 Prepare the ingredients:
First, wash the oranges thoroughly and zest the outer peel. Squeeze the juice from the 2 oranges and set aside.
Wash the beef and slice into bite-sized pieces.
2 Execution steps:
Sprinkle baking soda over the beef, mix well, and place in the refrigerator for 30 minutes to marinate. Baking soda helps the beef become more tender and flavorful.
To make the sauce, combine the soy sauce, sugar, sake, and vinegar with the squeezed orange juice. Add 4 tablespoons of cornstarch as well!
After marinating the beef, add 2 egg whites to the meat, then add the remaining cornstarch and mix until each piece of meat is evenly coated.
Fry the beef in a pan with hot oil until the outer layer turns golden and crispy.
After frying, remove the beef to a plate to drain the oil, then season with salt and pepper to taste.
In another pan, add a little oil. When the oil is hot, sauté the scallions, orange zest, and ground chili. Pour in the sauce prepared in step 4 and simmer until the sauce thickens.
Finally, add the fried beef, a little sesame oil, and toss well so the beef is evenly coated in the sauce, then turn off the heat.
The Orange Beef Stir-fry attracts diners with its aromatic orange scent and fragrant beef blended in a vibrant orange sauce. Everything creates a wonderful dish!
See also: Guide on how to make stir-fried beef with lemongrass
Note:
How to choose good beef:
Fresh meat: Has a characteristic red color, light yellow fat, good elasticity, and a dry, smooth surface.
Poor quality or spoiled meat: Usually dark in color, dark yellow fat, yellow bones, poor elasticity, flabby texture, slimy surface, and a foul odor.
How to slice beef correctly:

Slice across the grain so the meat isn't chewy, using a sharp, thin knife. You can put the meat in the freezer for 1–2 hours before slicing; once the meat firm up, it will be easier to slice. Stir-fried beef is better the thinner it is sliced. For Orange Beef Stir-fry, slice into bite-sized cubes.
Choosing good oranges:
Shape: Choose fruits with a balanced shape, not lopsided, with a fresh stem. The peel around the stem should be thick and raised while the center of the stem is slightly indented.

Color: Choose fruits with bright, shiny colors, turning yellow or bright pink with a hint of green. If green covers more than half the surface, do not choose it as it was picked too early. Naturally ripe oranges are slightly yellow at the bottom, while those that are evenly colored may have been artificially ripened.
Weight: Choose oranges that feel heavy for their size. If it feels light, it has little juice and is pithy or dry.

For King Oranges (Cam sành): Do not choose ones that are too large with very bumpy skin or bright yellow on one side, as these are sunburnt, resulting in thick skin, dry flesh, little juice, and no sweetness.

mon_an.mo_ta: Today, I will reveal the secret to making special spicy tuna cakes to add to your list of delicious dishes.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Tuna - 200g (if using fresh tuna, use only the meat, remove skin and bones)
Annatto oil - optional (can be substituted by sautéing chili for color)
cac_buoc: If you have plenty of time for shopping and preparation, you can use fresh (or frozen) tuna, remove the bones and skin, then grind or pound it finely. However, since I work all day and don't have much time, I use canned tuna in oil for convenience (though it's not as good as fresh fish). If using canned fish, simply remove the fish and place it in a bowl.
