Remove seeds from the chili (to reduce heat), then mince or grate the chili, garlic, and ginger and add them to the fish.

Add chopped scallions and cilantro, and a little fish sauce, then mix very thoroughly. If you have annatto oil, add it for a beautiful color. You can also sauté chili to create color and increase the spiciness of the fish cakes.
Beat the eggs and add them to the fish bowl, mixing well.
Shape the fish into equal round balls and flatten them (similar to a cookie shape but thicker).
Heat cooking oil in a pan, then gently drop each tuna cake in and fry until golden brown on both sides. Remove to a plate.

Prepare the dipping sauce: Mix 1 tbsp sugar, 3 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp chili paste, juice from about 1/4 lime, 2 tbsp filtered water, minced chili, and garlic. Add lime pulp and chopped cilantro, then stir well to complete the sweet and sour dipping sauce for the spicy tuna cakes.
Here is the finished product on the plate. Looks appetizing, doesn't it? Give it a try!

For this dish, cooks in coastal areas have a great advantage. While we only have canned or frozen fish, they have plenty of fresh seafood caught straight from the sea. Once when I visited Rach Gia – Kien Giang, I saw them preparing the ingredients for fish cakes at the market. They fillet the fish by cutting along the back and slowly removing the spine, then use a tool like a spoon handle to scrape the meat. When brought home, you just need to pound it in a mortar or squeeze it in a plastic bag to get a fragrant ingredient (pounding and squeezing makes the fish cakes chewier). Thinking about this makes me so envious of those in coastal regions—they can eat fresh seafood that is both delicious and cheap!

mon_an.mo_ta: Fried frog sausage – a rustic, countryside dish that is incredibly delicious; you'll want to eat it again the moment you taste it!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Wash the frog legs with water and a bit of crushed ginger to reduce the fishy smell. Remove the meat from the bone and mince finely.
Soak the dried pig intestines in water for about five minutes to soften, then drain. Wash and finely mince the culantro and dill. Crush the white peppercorns.
Step 2:
Mix the minced frog meat, ground pork, culantro, dill, and peppercorns together. Season with soy sauce, seasoning powder, sugar, and MSG; let marinate for 15 minutes.
Stuff this mixture into the intestines, packing it tightly. Tie both ends and steam until cooked.
Step 3:
Next, place a pan on the stove with plenty of oil. Fry the frog sausage until golden brown, remove, and slice into bite-sized rounds. Serve with salt, pepper, and lime or soy sauce.

mon_an.ten: Green Mango Salad with Dried Squid
mon_an.mo_ta: This green mango salad with dried squid will win you over from the first bite with the characteristic aroma of grilled squid, fragrant Thai basil, and the pleasant tartness of green mango.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash and finely chop the Thai basil. Peel, slice, and fry the shallots until fragrant. Peel the roasted peanuts and crush them slightly.
Step 2: Peel the mango and shred it into a clean bowl.
Step 3: Place the dried squid in a grilling rack and grill over charcoal or a gas stove.
Wrap the squid in clean paper and use a mallet to pound it until soft, then shred it into small strips and flash-fry in oil to make it crispy.
Step 4: Prepare the dressing: 2 tbsp fish sauce + 2 tbsp white sugar + 1 tsp MSG + 1 chopped ripe chili + a little lime juice; adjust to taste.
Step 5: When mixing the salad, add the squid, basil, and roasted peanuts. Finally, pour the dressing over and toss well. Mix about 5-10 minutes before serving so the mango retains its crunch.
Step 6: When serving, sprinkle the fried shallots on top and garnish with a few sprigs of basil for presentation.
This dried squid mango salad is a perfect snack for hot days.
Enjoy this sweet, sour, and easy-to-eat green mango salad with dried squid with your family!

mon_an.ten: Baked Kimchi and Potatoes with Cheese
mon_an.mo_ta: A unique and delicious dish that will make you want more after just one try. It is only slightly difficult to find the ingredients, but the preparation is quite easy. Let's learn how to make baked kimchi with cheese and potatoes!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 450°F. Cut the potatoes into long wedges and place them on a baking tray. Toss the potatoes with olive oil, chili powder, salt, and pepper to taste.
Step 2: Bake the potatoes for 45 minutes, tossing them gently a few times during the process.
After the potatoes have baked for about 30 minutes, prepare the other ingredients.
Step 3: In a skillet over medium heat, cook the bacon until crispy. Remove the bacon and set aside in a separate bowl.
Step 4: Add the kimchi, sliced onion, and sugar to the pan. Sauté for about 10 minutes.

Step 5: Arrange the potatoes on the baking tray and sprinkle half of the cheese on top. Spread the kimchi mixture over it, then finish with the remaining cheese. Bake in the oven for 1-2 minutes until the cheese is melted.
Step 6: Sprinkle green onions and bacon on top and enjoy!

mon_an.mo_ta: An incredibly delicious chicken dish featuring a hint of Thai spiciness combined with the savory, tender taste of fresh chicken and fragrant basil. Let's learn how to make this wonderful dish!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fish sauce, soy sauce, sugar - seasonings
cac_buoc: Step 1: Chop the chicken wings into small pieces.
Step 2: Mince the garlic and fry until fragrant.
Step 3: Add the chicken wings to the pan and stir-fry with the garlic.
Step 4: Season with chili, soy sauce, fish sauce, and sugar to taste.
Step 5: Add the Thai basil, stir-fry briefly, and it's done.

mon_an.mo_ta: Chicken feet curry is easy to cook, delicious, and affordable. The chicken feet are simmered until tender and flavorful, looking very attractive with an indescribably good taste. Let's get in the kitchen and make this dish!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Clean the chicken feet and chop into bite-sized pieces. In a hot pan with oil, sauté the minced lemongrass and chili until fragrant, then add the chicken feet and stir-fry, seasoning to taste.

Step 2: Pour in the broth mixed with curry powder and bring to a boil. Add the cauliflower cut into bite-sized pieces, peas, bruised lemongrass stalks, and sliced chili. Simmer over low heat until the chicken feet are tender.
Step 3: Garnish with scallions and herbs. Serve hot with bread. Chicken feet curry is an aromatic dish with eye-catching colors and an indescribably delicious flavor.
Enjoy your meal!

mon_an.mo_ta: Today, we are adding crispy breaded fried potatoes to the menu—delicious, crunchy, and very beautiful. Please refer to the recipe and method below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Mashed potatoes - 1 pack of 300g pre-mashed chilled potatoes; if unavailable, boil potatoes and mash them with a spoon or mallet
Cooking oil - enough for deep frying
cac_buoc: Step 1: With the ingredients ready, beat the eggs in a small bowl and arrange all ingredients in separate bowls for easy access.
Step 2: Using a tool or your hands, roll the mashed potatoes into round balls about 2-2.5cm in diameter.
Step 3: Dip the potato ball into the beaten eggs.
Step 4: Roll it in the breadcrumbs until evenly coated.
Step 5: You can dip it back into the egg bowl again.
Step 6: Then roll it in the breadcrumbs a second time to ensure the potato ball is thoroughly and thickly coated.
Step 7: Place the breaded potato balls on a tray and continue until all ingredients are used. Place the tray in the refrigerator for about 20-30 minutes.
Step 8: Frying: Drop each potato ball into hot oil and fry until golden brown and crispy, then remove to a plate.
Note: You should use a heavy-bottomed pan to prevent burning; it only takes 3-4 minutes for the balls to turn golden! When removing, use paper towels to absorb excess oil.
And here is the final result! Hot, crispy, and beautiful, isn't it?

mon_an.mo_ta: Fried meat-stuffed squid is a simple yet delicious dish made from squid, perfect for the chilly weather these days. Today, we would like to guide you through making this fried meat-stuffed squid dish.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the squid by removing the head and skin (note: remove the eyes and ink sac from the tentacles). Wash thoroughly with white wine and crushed fresh ginger to remove the fishy smell, then pat dry and marinate with seasonings to taste.
Step 2: Mince or grind the pork. Soak the shiitake and wood ear mushrooms until expanded, and soak the glass noodles until soft, then finely chop all of them.
Step 3: Finely mince the shallots, garlic, and ginger, then fry until golden.
Step 4: Mix the minced meat and mushrooms with the fried shallots, garlic, ginger, and dill until the mixture becomes sticky and well-combined.

Step 5: Stuff the meat and mushroom mixture into the squid. Note that when stuffing, you should add a little at a time and press firmly; do not overfill as the meat will expand during cooking. Use a bamboo toothpick to secure the open end of the squid so the filling doesn't fall out.
Step 6: Once the squid is stuffed, steam it briefly until cooked through and let it cool. Then dip it in beaten egg and roll it in flour before frying until golden brown.
Step 7: Let the fried squid rest for a moment to drain excess oil, then slice into pieces and garnish on a plate with vegetables.
Here is the result!

mon_an.ten: 2 Ways to Make Healthy Salmon Avocado Salad
mon_an.mo_ta: Avocado salad combined with salmon is not only a favorite choice for many but also offers rich flavors and nutritional benefits for health. It is guaranteed to satisfy every diner. Let's explore 2 ways to make healthy salmon avocado salad in the article below! I. Discover how to make Smoked Salmon Avocado Salad
thoi_gian: Prepare the dressing: In a large bowl, combine the ingredients to create the salad dressing: 50ml unsweetened yogurt, 50ml mayonnaise, and 50g Pommery mustard. Once all ingredients are added, mix them well together.
cac_buoc: 1. Prepare ingredients
Smoked salmon: 100g
Fresh avocado, sliced: 100g
Pomelo segments: 50g
Cherry tomatoes: 5g
Black olives: 5g
Green olives: 5g
Unsweetened yogurt: 50ml
Mayonnaise: 50ml
Pommery mustard: 50g.
2. Preparation steps
2.1. Ingredient preparation

Slice the smoked salmon into thin strips, about 1cm wide and following the length of the available slices (from 5-7cm). Slicing the salmon helps the meat absorb seasonings better, ensuring the ingredients are evenly infused to bring a delicious flavor to the dish.

Peel the pomelo, separate each segment, and break them into small pieces. Be careful when cutting to keep the shape of the pomelo segments intact. The combination of small pomelo segments, greens, and meat will create a unique refreshing sour flavor.

Remove the skin and pit of the avocado, then dice into cubes. Choose delicious wax avocados that are just ripe, with light green flesh. Score the avocado vertically and horizontally, then flip the skin up and gently scoop the flesh into a bowl.
Slice the cherry tomatoes into thin, bite-sized pieces. Bright red cherry tomato slices will make the salmon salad look attractive.
Slice the green and black olives similarly to the tomatoes.
2.2. Processing

Prepare the dressing: In a large bowl, combine the ingredients to create the salad dressing: 50ml unsweetened yogurt, 50ml mayonnaise, and 50g Pommery mustard. Once all ingredients are added, mix them well together.

Mix the salad: Place all ingredients, including the chopped smoked salmon, diced avocado, tomatoes, and olives, into the dressing bowl. Once everything is in, toss gently so the ingredients blend with the seasonings while still maintaining their natural structure.

Present the salad: Arrange the salad attractively on a plate using a circular mold. Place the mold on the plate, then gently fill it with the salad. Once enough salad is placed, slowly lift the mold to avoid damaging the shape. Before plating the salad, you can also puree fresh avocado and create a circular stroke on the plate for decoration. This will create a perfect picture for the dish.
Salmon avocado salad can be combined with other raw vegetables or served with crispy toasted bread to enhance the flavor.
II. Discover how to make Traditional Salmon Avocado Salad
200g salmon
1 avocado
1 radish (thinly sliced)
8 cherry tomatoes
¼ cucumber
200g lettuce
1 lemon
Minced garlic, finely chopped parsley
Seasonings:
Vinegar
Salt
Pepper
Sugar
Olive oil
2. Preparation steps
Step 1: Prepare ingredients
First, wash the fish, vegetables, and roots, then drain. Next, slice the cucumber into small pieces, cut the cherry tomatoes in half, and slice the avocado into bite-sized long pieces.
Step 2: Fry the salmon
Place the fish in a bowl and marinate with ½ tsp salt, ½ tsp pepper, 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp minced garlic, and 1 tsp minced parsley.
Then, fry the fish in 1 tbsp olive oil, cooking each side for about 7 minutes over medium heat. When the fish is golden brown, let it cool and then cut into bite-sized pieces.
Step 3: Prepare the dressing

In a small bowl, blend salt, pepper, sugar, vinegar, 5ml yellow lemon juice, grated lemon zest, minced garlic, and minced parsley. After mixing well, add 2 tbsp olive oil and stir until a homogeneous consistency is reached.
Step 4: Complete the salmon avocado salad
Arrange the vegetables on a plate, then drizzle the dressing evenly over the top. Next, add the salmon and combine the components on the plate into a complete salad.

The final result is a wonderful salmon avocado salad, a harmonious combination of the freshness and crispness of vegetables, the richness of avocado, and the natural sweet flavor of salmon. All these ingredients are evenly infused in the sweet and sour dressing, creating a special richness that makes you want to enjoy it forever.
III. Notes when making salmon avocado salad

Choose fresh ingredients: Select fresh salmon and just-ripe avocado to ensure the best quality and flavor for your salad. Use fresh vegetables and choose pomelo with crunchy, sweet segments and a slight tartness to create freshness and appeal for the salad.

Limit oil and sugar: To keep the salad a healthy dish, limit the amount of oil and sugar in the dressing. Use olive oil and vinegar sparingly to maintain natural flavors and avoid excessive greasiness. If you want to add sugar, use a small amount and preferably choose a natural sweetener like stevia.

Use a diverse mix of greens: Add variety and nutrition to the salad by using a diverse mix of greens such as lettuce, kale, Vietnamese coriander, parsley, or bok choy. This helps provide fiber, vitamins, and minerals for your meal.
Fry the salmon gently: When frying the salmon, use little oil and fry gently to retain the fresh flavor and nutrients in the fish.

Combine flavors: Add other ingredients like chia seeds, sunflower seeds, or pistachios to add crunch and nutrition to the salad. You can also add seasonings like pepper, minced garlic, and chopped parsley to increase the flavor and excitement of the salad.

Adjust seasoning levels: When making the dressing, customize the amount of seasonings like salt, pepper, garlic, and parsley according to your own taste. Taste and consider to achieve a proper balance and the best flavor.

mon_an.mo_ta: Welcome summer with this extremely appetizing pickled dracontomelon in fish sauce recipe.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Boil the fish sauce
Combine fish sauce and water in a pot at a ratio of 4 parts fish sauce to 1 part water. Bring to a boil, then turn off the heat and set aside to cool.
Step 2: Prepare the dracontomelon

While boiling the fish sauce and waiting for it to cool, prepare the dracontomelon. Wash the fruit, scrape the skin, then soak in water mixed with a little salt for about 10 minutes to prevent browning and reduce acidity.
Then remove the fruit, rinse again with cooled boiled water, and place in a basket to drain completely.
Step 3: Pickle the dracontomelon

When the fish sauce has cooled and the dracontomelon is dry and the surface has tightened, arrange the fruit in a jar, add sliced garlic and chilies, then pour in the fish sauce mixture. Use a bamboo grate to press down so the fruit is completely submerged in the fish sauce. Pickle for about 1 week before eating.

After 1 week, the pickled dracontomelon will have a beautiful golden color and a fragrant aroma of fruit, garlic, and fish sauce. When eaten, it has a mild sour, salty, and spicy taste that is very palatable. The fruit is crunchy and not mushy. This dish can be served like a pickle during meals, and the fish sauce can be used as a dipping sauce for water spinach.
Please note a few points for a delicious result:

You must calculate the amount of water and fish sauce so that when poured into the jar, the fruit is fully submerged. Usually, for 1kg of fruit, I use about 1 liter of fish sauce. You should choose a high-quality fish sauce so the dish isn't overly salty. It might feel a bit expensive using so much good fish sauce, but don't worry, the pickling sauce can be reused as a very tasty dipping sauce later.
The amount of chili and garlic can be adjusted to your taste. If you like it spicy, add more chili; if you like the pungent aroma of garlic, add more garlic.
You can also try the sugar-pickled dracontomelon method or other pickled vegetable recipes using similar techniques.

mon_an.mo_ta: Beef rolls with baby corn is a quite unique dish due to the creative combination of baby corn and beef. Tender slices of beef wrap around pork paste and crunchy baby corn inside. Everything is encased in a crispy fried crust. With one bite, you can taste the ultimate deliciousness of beef blending with other ingredients. What are you waiting for? Let's get into the kitchen and make this wonderful dish right away!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Thinly sliced beef brisket (or thinly sliced beef tenderloin) - 300g
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare ingredients for the beef rolls with baby corn
Peel the garlic, wash it with water, and mince it.

Next, spread the thinly sliced beef out on a flat surface. Use a mallet to lightly pound the beef slices so they become more tender and delicious when cooked. Marinate the beef with a little oyster sauce and minced garlic for about 15 minutes to absorb the flavors. If your beef is still a whole block, you can place it in the freezer until firm; this makes it much easier to slice into even, thin sheets.
Crack the egg into a bowl and beat it well.
Wash the baby corn and let it drain. If any baby corn is too large, you can cut it in half so the rolls aren't too bulky and look more attractive.
Step 2: Cooking stages for delicious beef rolls with baby corn.
First, spread out a marinated beef slice and use a spoon to spread a thin layer of raw pork paste over it. Do not spread it too thick, or the roll will look very bulky.
Then, place a piece of baby corn on top and roll it up tightly. You should roll it firmly so it doesn't fall apart when frying, but not so tight that the meat stays raw inside.
If you are using thinly sliced beef brisket, squeeze a bulb of garlic for its juice, mix it with oyster sauce, and brush a thin layer of this mixture over the beef rolls. Marinate for 15 minutes.

After the beef has marinated, roll each beef roll through the crispy frying flour, then quickly dip it into the beaten egg, and finally coat it with breadcrumbs. Ensure the breadcrumbs evenly cover the entire roll.

Next, place a pan or a pot on the stove and pour in enough oil for deep frying. When the oil is hot, add the prepared beef rolls to fry. Note: wait for the oil to boil before adding the meat, then lower the heat so the inside cooks through without burning the outer coating. Remember to turn them evenly so both sides are golden brown and not burnt.
Once the meat is cooked and the coating is golden and crispy, remove them and place on paper towels to absorb excess oil.
Finally, slice the rolls diagonally, arrange them on a plate, and serve hot. You can enjoy them with chili sauce or mayonnaise to fully experience the delicious flavors of this dish!
Notes for delicious beef rolls with baby corn
When frying the meat, remember to use low heat. As soon as the outer coating turns golden, remove them immediately so the meat doesn't dry out and lose its flavor.
This delicious dish can be served with raw vegetables or rice vermicelli to make it even better and less greasy.

mon_an.mo_ta: Fried chicken thighs this way is a quite new method compared to conventional frying. With this technique, the chicken thighs are completely deboned, resulting in sweet, tender meat that thoroughly absorbs the marinade. The fried meat is both fragrant and savory, making it very delicious and palatable when eaten with rice. Additionally, the fried chicken thighs are served with vegetables, so they don't feel greasy or overly fatty. The preparation is quite simple and doesn't take much time, so even busy mothers can make it. Let's explore the recipe below.
cac_buoc: New style fried chicken method 1
Step 1: Prepare ingredients
Cut the carrots into bite-sized rounds.
Peel the outer skin of the broccoli stems and cut into bite-sized florets.
Wash the chicken thighs, then use scissors to cut them in half lengthwise and remove all the bones.
Use the back of a knife to lightly pound the chicken meat to make it more tender. If the thighs are too large, you can cut them into smaller pieces.
Crush the ginger.
Step 2: Execution steps

Place the chicken thighs in a bowl and add the following seasonings: soy sauce, oyster sauce, sugar, salt, cooking wine, and ginger in the quantities mentioned above. Mix well so the meat is evenly coated and marinate for about 30 minutes.
While waiting for the meat to marinate, bring a pot of water to a boil and add a little salt.
When the water boils, add the carrots and broccoli to blanch them briefly.
Then remove the vegetables and drain. Arrange them on a large plate, pushing them to one corner to keep it neat.
Next, remove the meat to another plate to drain off excess marinade.
Place a pan on the stove and add a little cooking oil.
When the oil is hot, place the chicken in to pan-sear.
Once the first side is done, flip to the second side and continue frying.
When the meat is cooked through and has a slightly charred golden color, remove it and drain excess oil.
When the meat has cooled slightly, slice it into small strips along the length of the piece.
Arrange the meat on the plate with the vegetables, add some white rice, and it's ready to enjoy.
You can drizzle a little chili sauce over the chicken or sprinkle with some black pepper.
Notes
For the chicken, you can choose based on preference: if you have elderly family members, you can choose broiler chicken; otherwise, free-range chicken is great, and both are delicious.
Pounding the meat before frying helps the chicken absorb seasonings more easily, making it much more tender and tasty.
Additionally, wine is a seasoning that helps enhance the flavor of the dish, and you don't need to worry as the alcohol scent will disappear once the food is cooked.
The accompanying vegetables can be substituted according to your preference. However, for carrots and broccoli, only blanch them briefly so they taste much better.

mon_an.mo_ta: Salted eggs are a popular ingredient used in many dishes, from simple white porridge to salted egg fried shrimp. They are also used as fillings for various cakes like sponge cakes, mooncakes, or cupcakes. Salted eggs are convenient, nutritious, and delicious. You can learn how to make salted eggs at home and store them in the refrigerator for 1 to 2 weeks to enjoy gradually.
cac_buoc: Step 1: After buying the eggs, wash them thoroughly and let them drain.
Step 2: Pour 1.5 liters of water into a pot, add salt, and bring to a boil. Stir while heating until the salt is completely dissolved, then turn off the heat and let it cool.
Step 3: Dry the eggs and soak them in a bowl of liquor for about 1 hour.
Then, arrange the eggs in a clean glass jar and pour in the cooled salt water along with 80ml of liquor.
Step 4: Seal the lid tightly and leave the jar in a sunny spot for 35-45 days to have delicious salted eggs.

mon_an.mo_ta: Seafood dishes are always enticing, and crawfish is no exception. Have you ever tried cooking irresistible garlic butter crawfish? With its sweet, savory flavor and a hint of garlic spice, this dish will surely make your whole family fall in love from the first bite. Let's explore how to cook garlic butter crawfish, a unique and attractive dish that the whole family will enjoy! ### What is CRAWFISH? Crawfish is a well-known name for a species of freshwater lobster that is quite small in size.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Cajun seasoning + Louisiana Boil Liquid - 120g + 100 ml
Cayenne pepper powder + MSG - 3 tsp + 1 tsp
Canned orange juice - 1 liter or 5 fresh oranges, juiced
Sweet corn - 4 ears, washed and cut into segments
Smoked sausages - 10 sausages, cut into segments
Potatoes - 6 potatoes, cut into segments (or baby potatoes as desired)
Water (using entirely orange juice is better) - Add as needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients

After buying the clams, to clean them and reduce the fishy smell, you can soak them in rice water with a few slices of chili to remove grit and mud. Soak for about 2 hours, then remove and wash clean.
Next, place the clams in a pot with a little water, put it on the stove, and boil. Boil for about 10 minutes until the clams open their mouths, then turn off the heat.
After boiling, remove the clams and separate the meat. Use a knife to cut the meat into bite-sized pieces. Peel the shallots and slice them thinly. Slice the lemongrass and chili.
Wash the Vietnamese coriander and dill, then chop them finely. Wash the green onions, remove the roots, and chop finely.
Step 2: Cook the garlic butter crawfish
Bring a pot of water to a boil (using entirely orange juice is very delicious; otherwise, mix orange juice and water to suit the amount of crawfish).
Add the onions + seasonings (crawfish powder, spicy oil, chili powder, Cajun seasoning) + orange peel (optional).
Add butter and MSG, then season to taste.
Next, add the crawfish and cook for 10-20 minutes depending on the quantity.
Turn off the heat and let the crawfish sit in the pot for about 10 minutes.
Remove the crawfish and set aside; drain some of the cooking liquid if there is too much. Add the corn, potatoes, and sausages and cook for about 10 minutes.
Place the potatoes, corn, and sausages on top of the crawfish.
In another pot, sauté the minced garlic until fragrant, add a little butter to melt, then pour this mixture into the previous cooking broth.
Dissolve tapioca starch in water, then add it to the pot to thicken the sauce and make it fragrant.
Adjust the seasoning of the sauce. Pour the sauce over the crawfish, corn, potatoes, and sausages. Serve.
Enjoy while hot, accompanied by bread if desired.
Note: Louisiana seasoning sets are quite salty and spicy, so season gradually. Adding too much will ruin the flavor.
Above is the detailed and delicious recipe for garlic butter crawfish that anyone can make. Enjoy your crawfish!

mon_an.ten: Sweet and Savory Okra and Bean Sprout Soup
mon_an.mo_ta: Okra is a delicious and healthy food; eating it regularly helps reduce the risk of cardiovascular disease, diabetes, obesity, and even cancer. Okra can be combined with many types of food. Today, we introduce the okra and bean sprout soup, which is both delicious, easy to make, and good for your health. Learn how to make this sweet and savory soup through these detailed instructions. Okra and bean sprout soup is a traditional, simple, and tasty soup. This article provides easy preparation and cooking steps. Enjoy this sweet and savory soup in your daily meals.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the okra and cut into 1cm segments. Place the bean sprouts in a basket, toss and shake a few times to remove roots and hulls, then wash clean.
Step 2: Wash the tomatoes and cut into wedges. Wash the bell peppers, remove the stems and seeds, and cut into 1.5cm x 2cm rectangles.

Step 3: Sauté the tomatoes until soft, then add the okra and stir-fry. Add fish sauce and seasoning powder, stirring well. Next, add the bell peppers and stir until they are slightly wilted, then add water. Let the soup boil for about 1 minute.
Step 4: Add the bean sprouts to the soup. When it returns to a boil, turn off the heat.
Notes for making okra and bean sprout soup
Okra and bean sprouts: Choose fresh okra with small seeds and bright green bean sprouts. Wash them thoroughly before use to remove dirt and impurities.
Soaking: Okra and bean sprouts often need to be soaked in water for 15-20 minutes before cooking to soften them and reduce toughness.
Water: Use clean water for the soup; if possible, use filtered water to ensure the best quality.
Seasoning: Consider using salt, sugar, fish sauce, and MSG to create a balanced flavor. Taste and adjust the seasoning to suit your preference.
Cooking time: Okra and bean sprouts cook quickly, so check them frequently to avoid overcooking, which makes them lose their crispness.
Adding herbs: You can add aromatic herbs like basil, culantro, or cilantro to the soup to enhance the flavor. If desired, add green onions and fried garlic for a signature aroma.
Serving: This soup is usually served with hot white rice. You can also enjoy it with bread or rice vermicelli according to your preference.
How to buy fresh okra
Choose well-shaped okra: Select pods that are well-shaped, not distorted or deformed. Fresh okra is usually straight and uniform.
Check the color: Fresh okra should be bright green without black spots or bruises on the surface. Avoid pods that are yellow or showing signs of wilting.
Touch the okra: When touched, it should feel soft and elastic. Fresh okra feels light and not rigid.
Check the stem: The stem should be fresh and green. If the stem is dry or shows signs of wilting, the okra may be old and no longer fresh.
Scent: Fresh okra has a fresh and fragrant scent. Check the aroma before buying to ensure quality.
Where to buy: Purchase fresh okra from reliable stores, markets, or supermarkets with a fresh supply and guaranteed hygiene.

mon_an.ten: Water Spinach Soup with Shrimp Paste
mon_an.mo_ta: Water spinach soup with shrimp paste is a combination of fresh water spinach and savory shrimp paste, making it a popular and favorite dish in family meals. Today, we will guide you through a simple and easy way to make this soup. You will discover the step-by-step process, from choosing quality water spinach and shrimp paste to the flavorful cooking process. This traditional Vietnamese soup combines the bold flavors of fresh water spinach and aromatic shrimp paste. Learn the process of selecting ingredients, cooking, and creating delicious flavors in every step.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Start by selecting the tips of the water spinach, wash them thoroughly, and drain.
Mince the chili and garlic.
Step 2: Stir-fry minced meat with shrimp paste

On the stove, heat one tablespoon of cooking oil in a pan. When the oil is hot, add the minced chili and garlic and sauté until fragrant. Next, add the minced meat to the pan and stir-fry for about 3 minutes. Season with one tablespoon of seasoning powder and one tablespoon of shrimp paste, stirring well so the flavors penetrate the meat. Stir-fry for another 2 minutes and turn off the heat.
Step 3: Cook the water spinach soup with shrimp paste
1. Pour water into a pot: Heat a pot of water; the amount depends on how much soup you want to make. Typically, use about 1.5-2 liters of water for one pot of soup.
2. Bring to a boil: Once the water boils, reduce the heat to medium.
3. Add water spinach: Add the water spinach and the prepared minced meat with shrimp paste to the pot.

4. Season: Add seasonings to the pot according to your taste. Usually, salt, sugar, and seasoning powder are the basic ingredients to create a good flavor. You can also add a bit of pepper and minced garlic to enhance the aroma.
5. Stir well: Stir gently to blend the seasonings into the water and water spinach.
6. Simmer: Reduce the heat to low and simmer the soup for about 5-7 minutes. Ensure the water spinach is tender but still retains its freshness.

7. Check and adjust seasoning: Taste the soup and adjust the seasoning if necessary. If you want a stronger shrimp paste aroma, you can add more shrimp paste to taste. Add it teaspoon by teaspoon and stir well until the desired flavor is reached.
8. Turn off the heat: When the water spinach is cooked and the soup tastes good, turn off the heat.
Notes for making water spinach soup with shrimp paste
When making this soup, there are some important notes to ensure it is delicious and safe:
Choose fresh ingredients: Select fresh water spinach without signs of wilting. Choose high-quality shrimp paste that is not spoiled or foul-smelling.
Clean the ingredients: Wash the water spinach thoroughly and drain before use. Ensure other ingredients like chili and garlic are finely minced and clean.
Ensure the meat is fully cooked: When stir-frying the minced meat with shrimp paste, make sure the meat is completely cooked for food safety.
Stir thoroughly: During the stir-frying process, ensure you stir evenly and thoroughly so the ingredients cook uniformly without burning.

Cook just enough: This soup should be cooked for a short time to maintain the freshness and color of the water spinach. Avoid overcooking so the spinach doesn't lose its crispness and bright green color.
Season to taste: Add seasoning powder and shrimp paste in moderation, not too salty or sweet. Check and adjust the flavor before turning off the heat.

mon_an.mo_ta: Duck legs with orange sauce is loved for the perfect combination of duck meat and a slightly tangy orange sauce that prevents the dish from feeling greasy, making it ideal for those looking to limit cholesterol.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Clean the duck legs, marinate with salt and oyster sauce, and let sit for 15 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Step 2:
Cut the King orange in half, squeeze the juice and set aside. Remove the pith and membranes, peel the outer skin and julienne it. Boil the peel thoroughly about 2 times to reduce the bitterness.
Step 3:
Cut the carrots, chayote, and potatoes into bite-sized pieces. Julienne the horn chili. Halve the cherry tomatoes.
Step 4:

Lightly fry the duck legs, then place them in a pot with broth. Add the carrots, chayote, potatoes, orange peel, horn chili, and cherry tomatoes. Season with sugar, seasoning powder, fish sauce, and minced shallots to taste. When the water boils, reduce the heat to low and simmer for about 30 minutes until the duck is tender.
Step 5:
Make the orange sauce: Melt the butter, sauté the minced garlic until golden, then add the orange juice and simmer over low heat. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Step 6:
Arrange the duck legs and vegetables on a deep plate, pour the orange sauce over them, and sprinkle with minced cilantro.
Small Tip
To reduce the bitterness in the King orange peel, you must boil it once, then remove and squeeze out all the water. Add fresh water and boil thoroughly a second time.

nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Yellow lemon juice - 30ml (yellow skin is less bitter than green)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Steep the dried tea leaves in boiling water.
Step 2: Debone the chicken, use a meat mallet to pound the chicken until tender, then marinate with salt, soy sauce, wine, and sugar.
Step 3: Pour the tea (strained of leaves) into the chicken and marinate for about 30 minutes so the flavors are well absorbed.
Step 4: Drain the marinade from the chicken and let it dry for 10 minutes.
Step 5: Place the chicken in a pan with hot oil, pour 1/2 of the lemon juice over the surface of the meat. Cook over low heat and cover with a lid until one side is golden brown.
Step 6: Flip the chicken and pour the remaining 1/2 of the lemon juice on top. Continue frying until the chicken turns golden, then remove to a plate.

Step 7: After removing the chicken, make the sauce by adding a little cornstarch, tea water, soy sauce, and minced chili to the oil remaining in the pan. Stir well and heat until slightly thickened, then turn off the heat.
Finally, drizzle the sauce over the golden fried chicken to create an attractive dish.
Golden roasted chicken thighs with the characteristic aroma of lemon and tea will make your family dinner more enjoyable. Happy cooking!

mon_an.mo_ta: According to Traditional Chinese Medicine, chicken meat is sweet and neutral in property, effective in treating thinness due to poor appetite, diarrhea, diabetes symptoms, edema, low milk supply in women, and physical weakness after illness. Chicken can be prepared in many ways, from simple boiling, braising, to stir-frying. More elaborate methods involve cooking with aromatics or simmering until tender to extract the essence. Today, we will guide you in making a new style of salt-crusted chicken, perfect for entertaining guests! To make the best salt-crusted chicken, you should choose meaty parts like thighs, wings, or breast.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Sea salt, pepper, seasoning powder, fish sauce, MSG - as needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Usually, if making salt-crusted chicken at home, you should make a jar of pre-mixed roasted salt. To make the salt mixture, first wash the glutinous rice, white rice, and mung beans thoroughly. Soak the rice and beans in water for 15-20 minutes to let them expand slightly. Then, drain each type thoroughly and toast until fragrant. Toast the white and glutinous rice until cooked but not browned. You can toast the mung beans until golden and fragrant. Toast the sea salt until dry, then grind finely.

Step 2: Put all the rice, salt, and mung beans into a blender. Grind into small bits; it doesn't need to be as fine as flour! Once ground, let the powder cool, then put it in a glass jar and seal tightly for later use.

Step 3: To make the chicken flavorful, marinate it first. Marinate the chicken with a little seasoning powder, fish sauce, MSG, pepper, oil, and egg yolk. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and leave it in the refrigerator for about 30 minutes before frying. Cut the lemongrass into segments about 3 inches long and use a sharp knife to shred them into thin fibers; julienne the lime leaves.

Step 4: Place a clean pot on the stove and pour in oil to fry the chicken before crusting it with salt. First, add the lemongrass and lime leaves to the pot to fry. The lemongrass and lime leaves will make the oil very fragrant. Remove the golden-fried lemongrass and lime leaves and set them aside on a plate. Coat the marinated chicken in cornstarch (or tapioca starch) and drop it into the hot oil to fry.

Step 5: Fry the chicken until the outside is golden and fragrant. If you fry it too long, the chicken will become too dry! Once finished, while the chicken pieces are still hot, put all the chicken into a clean, dry pan (no oil), toss well with the roasted salt mixture (about 3 tablespoons) and the fried lemongrass and lime leaves.
Enjoy your meal!

mon_an.mo_ta: Frog meat provides many nutrients good for our health. Help your family gain more energy for studying and working with this unique and delicious clay pot braised frog dish!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Soy sauce, sliced chili, 1.5 cups water
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Clean 3 frogs and chop into bite-sized pieces.
Peel 1 bulb of garlic and smash it.
Cut 3 slices of ginger into bite-sized pieces.
Cut 100g of broccoli into bite-sized pieces.
Cut 1/4 carrot into bite-sized pieces.
Soak 4 shiitake mushrooms in water until soft, then wash clean.
Cut 2 stalks of green onions into segments.
Step 3:
Marinate the frog with seasoning powder, fish sauce, soy sauce, and ground pepper; let it absorb the seasonings.
Place the frog in a clay pot and fry until golden, then add the ginger, garlic, and water; simmer until just cooked.
Add the broccoli, carrot, and shiitake mushrooms and cook until done. Pour in the cornstarch dissolved in cool water to create the desired thickness, then sprinkle with ground pepper.
Serve hot with soy sauce and chili.

mon_an.ten: Chicken Breast with Passion Fruit Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: Chicken with passion fruit sauce is a relatively unique dish for many, but it will be appealing from the first taste with its tender, flaky chicken meat blended in a flavorful passion fruit sauce. The ingredients blend together to create an irresistibly attractive dish. Today's article guides you on how to make chicken breast with passion fruit sauce for kids, which is both delicious and unique. Enjoy a tasty and novel meal for your child with this guide. This dish is not only delicious but also nutritious and suits a child's palate. Refer to our guide now to make this dish.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Chicken meat - 400 g (breast, thigh, or wing)
Seasonings - Salt, pepper, oil, seasoning powder
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients for the chicken with passion fruit sauce:
First, wash the chicken clean; you can rub it with a little salt to reduce slime and odor, then rinse again with water. Next, cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces.
Then, marinate the chicken with 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp pepper, and 1 tsp seasoning powder. Mix well and marinate for about 10 minutes to let the chicken absorb the flavors.
Peel the shallots, wash them, and mince finely.
Strain the passion fruit to get the juice, keeping the seeds separate.
Steps to make the delicious chicken with passion fruit sauce:
Step 1: Pan-sear the chicken
After 10 minutes of marinating, steam the chicken until the meat is tender.
Next, place a pan on the stove and add a little oil. When the oil is hot, add the steamed chicken and pan-sear until it turns golden brown, then turn off the heat.

If you don't like the steam-then-fry method for a crispy skin, you can grill the chicken. If grilling, brush a thin layer of honey on the outside before grilling so the chicken has a beautiful color and attractive aroma. Grill until the skin is a beautiful golden color.
Step 2: Make the sauce:
First, melt the unsalted butter in a pan, then add the shallots and 2 tablespoons of white wine and cook to reduce. When the wine, butter, and shallots are fragrant, add the passion fruit juice.
Next, season with 1/2 tsp seasoning powder to achieve a balanced sweet and sour taste.
Finally, add a few passion fruit seeds and cook until the sauce reaches your desired thickness. Taste one last time to ensure it's right, then turn off the heat.
Step 3: Presentation and enjoyment:
Finally, place the pan-seared or grilled chicken on a plate, pour the passion fruit sauce over it, and enjoy.
Notes for a perfect chicken with passion fruit sauce
If you do not like passion fruit seeds, you do not need to add them.

How to choose good chicken: Prepared free-range chicken usually has a compact, firm body and a narrow breast. Industrial layer chickens look very similar to free-range chickens, so distinguish them carefully. Free-range chicken skin is pale yellow and only deep yellow in certain areas like the breast, wings, and back, while industrial chickens are white or yellow all over. To identify if a chicken has been dyed, observe: if the skin is yellow but the fat inside is white, it has been dyed with chemicals. Free-range chicken skin is thin, smooth, and highly elastic. Choose meat that looks fresh, without a foul smell or antibiotic odor, and no bruises or blood clots on the skin. Avoid dark-colored chickens as they may have died before being processed. Additionally, to avoid water-injected chicken, press on suspected areas (mainly thighs and breast); if it feels mushy, slippery, or deformed, avoid buying it.
You should choose thigh or breast parts to enhance the deliciousness of the dish.
How to buy fresh ingredients
How to choose fresh chicken breast
Chicken breast with many white fibers indicates low protein and high fat content. Choose pieces with a natural pale pink color; avoid white (chemically soaked) or dark (spoiled) meat.
Use your hand to feel the softness. Fresh, high-quality meat is soft and elastic, returning to its original shape quickly after being pressed.
Avoid buying chicken breast with a foul odor, strange color, or slimy discharge.
How to choose good passion fruit
Choose fruits with a deep purple or reddish-brown color. Darker colors are usually more fragrant, delicious, and sweeter.
To know if a passion fruit is ripe, observe the outer skin. Wrinkled and dented skin, along with a soft feel when held gently, are usually signs of a ripe fruit.
Avoid choosing soft, leaky passion fruits with a sour smell, as they are usually spoiled and not suitable for this dish.
Also, avoid fruits with shiny, beautiful skin that feel heavy, as they are unripe and not suitable for the dish.

mon_an.mo_ta: Potatoes are a common ingredient in many family meals. They are available year-round, sold in many places, and easy to prepare. Nutritionists have analyzed the food value of potatoes, showing that their composition is quite balanced in terms of essential nutrients for human needs. Potatoes are a high-nutrition food (rich in vitamins C, B6, fiber...), especially the potassium content, which nutritionists rank at the top of the list of 20 raw vegetables containing the most potassium. The nutrients in potatoes can rival those in cow's milk. The vitamin C content in potatoes is twice that of a peeled apple. The fiber in potatoes is soft and does not irritate the stomach lining, making it useful for treating ulcers caused by excessive gastric acid. Home cooks usually prepare familiar potato dishes like bone soup, fried, stir-fried, or steamed potatoes. Today, we will guide you on how to make delicious and unique Hasselback potatoes with smoked bacon.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel fresh potatoes and wash them clean. Slice the potatoes into moderately thin slices without cutting all the way through the tuber.
Step 2: Wrap the potatoes in foil and bake in the oven at 220°C for about 40 minutes.
Step 3: Cut the smoked bacon into thin, fan-shaped slices.
Step 4: Mix pepper, a pinch of salt, and 1/2 tablespoon of oil, then let it marinate for 10 minutes. Stuff each slice of bacon between the potato slices.
Step 5: In a small bowl, mix soy sauce with 1 tablespoon of curry powder and a little oil.
Step 6: Then, brush the prepared sauce over the surface and bake again at 180°C for about 10 more minutes.
Enjoy your meal!

mon_an.ten: Pork Ribs with Creamy Mushroom Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: These pork ribs feature a crispy exterior paired with a rich, aromatic mushroom sauce. The chewy mushrooms and unique creamy texture will surely delight your palate. Don't miss out on adding this delicious dish to your family menu!
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients for the pork ribs with creamy mushroom sauce.
Rinse the ribs and pat dry. Marinate with a bit of salt and pepper for about 15 minutes to let the flavors penetrate. Then, dredge the ribs in flour until evenly coated.
Clean the straw mushrooms and slice them thinly.
Wash the potatoes thoroughly to remove any dirt from the skin.
Steps to create the delicious pork ribs with creamy mushroom sauce:

Step 1: Place the cleaned potatoes into a pot of salted water. Bring to a boil and cook until tender (about 12-15 minutes depending on size). Before removing from the heat, stir in the coleslaw dressing to let it soak into the potatoes. Drain the potatoes in a colander.

Step 2: Mix half a cup of sour cream and 1/4 cup of chicken broth into the potatoes. Season with salt and pepper to taste (you can add a bit of butter for extra aroma). Mix well until the potatoes are well-seasoned and the mixture is soft, smooth, and well-blended.

Step 3: While waiting for the potatoes to set, heat olive oil in a pan. Once the oil is hot, fry the floured ribs until golden brown. Ensure you flip them regularly so they cook evenly and develop a beautiful crust. Fry over low heat to ensure the inside is fully cooked.

Step 4: Using the same pan, sauté the mushrooms and onions until the mushrooms are cooked (about 5 minutes). Add the remaining chicken broth, increase the heat, and stir well. Add the rest of the sour cream and stir continuously until you achieve a smooth, consistent, and slightly thickened sauce.

Step 5: Finally, remove from heat, adjust seasoning to taste, and pour the sauce over the ribs. Serve with the mashed potatoes. If you prefer the ribs to be fully coated, toss them directly into the sauce before removing from the heat, then plate and enjoy.
Tips for delicious pork ribs with creamy mushroom sauce:
When buying ribs, look for three things: color, smell, and elasticity.
Fresh ribs should be light pink, have no unpleasant odor, and the meat should feel dry and springy when pressed.
Additionally, choose ribs with small, flat bones. These usually have more meat and less bone than those with large, round bones.
If you want to make sweet and sour ribs, braised ribs, or fried ribs: choose lean cuts with little to no fat. Ribs with cartilage are even better. Pork loin ribs are the best choice for these dishes.
Pork ribs with creamy mushroom sauce, featuring crispy meat and a rich mushroom flavor, will bring a delightful sensation to your meal. Don't forget to include this in your home cooking list!

mon_an.mo_ta: Spicy salted squid is a unique dish for many. It offers a crunchy texture with a gentle spicy kick, making it a perfect companion for boiled meat or instant noodles!
cac_buoc: How to make irresistible spicy salted squid
Step 1:
If using frozen squid, thaw and clean them thoroughly.
Remove all innards and eyes, clean well, and place in a bowl.
If using fresh squid, rinse them with rice wine to reduce the fishy smell, then rinse again with water until clean.
Step 2:
Scrub the squid well to remove any remaining membranes or fat.
Step 3:
Once scrubbed clean, rinse the squid twice with water and let it drain completely.
Step 4:
Mix the squid with 1/4 cup of salt. Transfer the squid into a glass jar and sprinkle another 1 tbsp of salt on top.
Step 5:
Press the squid down as firmly as possible to squeeze out all the air. Seal the lid and keep in the refrigerator for 1 month.
Step 6:
After 1 month, take the squid out, rinse thoroughly, and drain.
Step 7:
Prepare the seasoning: mix chili powder, corn syrup, fish sauce, scallions, garlic, ginger, chilies, sesame seeds, and sesame oil in a bowl. Stir well to combine all ingredients.
Step 8:
Pat the squid dry or let it drain well, then slice into thin pieces. Add them to the seasoning bowl and toss thoroughly.
Step 9:
Place the seasoned squid back into a glass jar and store in the refrigerator. Serve as needed.
Tips for delicious spicy salted squid
You can adjust the quantity of squid. For every 150g of cleaned fresh squid, use 1 tbsp of coarse salt.
This spicy salted squid is used as a side dish in daily meals.
If you prefer it less spicy, you can reduce the amount of chili in the seasoning mix.
This dish is salted similarly to sweet and sour fermented shrimp. It pairs perfectly with boiled meat, instant noodles, or any dish you like.
How to choose good squid:
There are many types of fresh squid like cuttlefish, calamari, or baby squid, but you must choose carefully to avoid stale ones.
For cuttlefish: Choose large, thick-bodied ones with an opaque white color. The meat should be firm, not mushy, with an even brown membrane outside and stiff tentacles.
For calamari: Choose those with bright, slightly pinkish flesh. The head should be firmly attached to the body, tentacles should be stiff, and the ink sac should be intact.
Avoid squid that has turned a pale greenish color, has soft flesh, a loose head, or a very fishy smell, as these are no longer fresh.
With just a little time and careful seasoning, you'll have a unique, fresh dish to treat your family and friends. You will love the novel taste of this spicy salted squid. Let's cook and enjoy!

mon_an.mo_ta: Have you ever tried boiled meatballs? This dish is delicious because of its specially formulated dipping sauce, making the meal much more appealing.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Dipping sauce - 15g chopped scallions; 15g chopped cilantro; 7ml soy sauce; 7ml sesame oil; 1 clove garlic, crushed; Salt; 2 fresh chilies, sliced; 2 tbsp meatball cooking liquid
Seasoning - 5ml soy sauce; Salt; 5g five-spice powder; 15ml sesame oil
cac_buoc: Step 1: In a bowl, mix the ground pork with 15ml of water. Stir in one direction so the water is fully absorbed into the meat.
Add the chopped scallions, ginger, cornstarch, and other seasonings. Mix well in one direction for 2-3 minutes until the meat mixture becomes sticky. Let the meat rest for 5 minutes, then stir again.
Step 2: Shape the meat into small, bite-sized round balls.
Bring a pot of water to a boil, then drop the meatballs in. Gently stir the balls and cook over high heat until the water returns to a boil. As soon as it boils again, lower the heat.
Remove the meatballs from the pot.
Step 3: In a small bowl, combine all the dipping sauce ingredients and stir well. Add a little of the meatball cooking liquid to the sauce to adjust the flavor to your liking.
Finally, garnish the meatballs with cilantro and serve with the dipping sauce.

mon_an.mo_ta: Have you ever braised tofu with Coca-Cola? It sounds unusual, but give it a try—it's a fantastic idea. This article will guide you through making this unique and tasty dish. Check it out!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning - Scallions, chili, black pepper, ginger, soy sauce
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, cut the tofu into bite-sized squares. If you like a porous texture, you can place the tofu in the freezer for about 30 minutes!
Then, marinate the tofu with a bit of black pepper.
Step 2:
Finely chop the scallions, fresh chili, and ginger.
Step 3:
Fry the tofu until golden brown on all sides, then drain all the excess oil from the pan.
Step 4:
Pour in the Coca-Cola and season with soy sauce to taste. Simmer over medium heat until the liquid is reduced by half, then add the scallions, ginger, and chili. Cook for another 5 minutes.
It looks absolutely tempting—why wait to enjoy it?

mon_an.mo_ta: Potatoes are a staple in many family meals. When mashed and stuffed with a filling of meat, vermicelli, and wood ear mushrooms, they become highly nutritious and flavorful. Let's head to the kitchen and learn how to make these crispy fried potato balls!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Tapioca starch or arrowroot powder - 2 large tbsp
Salt, seasoning powder, MSG, chili sauce - to taste
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel the potatoes, wash them, and cut into large chunks.

Step 2: Soak the mushrooms and vermicelli in water until soft, then finely chop and mix with the minced pork. Season with salt and MSG. Briefly sauté the mixture in a pan to cook the meat beforehand, which will speed up the frying process later.
Step 3: Once the potatoes are boiled soft, drain the water and let them dry. Place the potatoes in a bowl and mash them thoroughly with a spoon.
Step 4: Once the potatoes are smooth, add the starch and water mixture and mix well. Season with a tiny bit of salt. Divide the potato mash into 20 portions (roughly 1 large tablespoon each).
Step 5: Take each portion, flatten it into a disc, place the filling in the center, then wrap the potato around the filling and roll into a ball.
Step 6: After rolling, they should look like this.
Step 7: Roll the potato balls through tapioca starch or frying flour one more time.

Step 8: Heat a deep pan with plenty of oil for even browning. Fry over medium heat, turning them gently so they stay round and turn golden brown. When they are golden and feel crispy to the touch with chopsticks, remove them from the oil.
Step 9: Finally, arrange on a plate and serve!

mon_an.mo_ta: Hello dear readers, have you started your Tet holiday yet? Everyone must be busy preparing for the New Year, but don't forget to cook delicious treats for your family! Today, I'd like to add Candied Orange Peel to your Tet menu, hoping to give you a new choice for your holiday cooking.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Yellow orange peels - Adjust quantity as desired; here I used peels from 6 oranges
cac_buoc: Read the instructions and follow the process photos to understand how to make this treat.
Step 1: Separate the peel from the fruit and slice into long strips.
Step 2: Place the peels in a pot, cover with water, and boil for 10 minutes. Drain the water and repeat this process 2 more times. This step helps reduce the bitterness of the peels.

Step 3: Squeeze the juice from 2 oranges, mix with sugar, and add the peels. Let them soak for about 1 hour to absorb the sugar. Simmer over low heat, stirring occasionally, until the peels become translucent and the syrup is almost evaporated.
Step 4: Remove the peels and arrange them separately. Dry in the oven at 100°C for about 30 minutes until they are no longer sticky to the touch.

Step 5: Melt the chocolate using a double boiler, adding a bit of butter for shine. Dip each piece of candied peel into the chocolate and place on parchment paper until the chocolate sets completely. Store in an airtight container.
(Source: Ngoisao.net)
The final result will look like this:

mon_an.mo_ta: Five-color salad is a delicious and attractive appetizer favored by many families. Let's make these simple yet tasty salads on a warm winter day. Discover how to make a simple yet flavorful five-color beef salad. This dish combines eye-catching colors from vegetables with the savory taste of beef, offering a wonderful sensory experience.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Cilantro, sawtooth herb, Thai basil - 1/2 bunch
Fine salt, sugar, vinegar, garlic, chili, chili sauce, decorative vegetables.
cac_buoc: 1. Vegetarian Five-Color Salad
Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Peel the kohlrabi, wash, and shred into thin strips.
Peel the carrot, wash, and shred into thin strips.
Peel the green mango and shred into thin strips.
Wash the cucumber and shred into thin strips.
Wash the purple cabbage and shred into thin strips.
Roast the peanuts until crispy and crush them slightly.
Wash and finely chop the cilantro.
Deseed the sweet chili and mince it.
Step 2: Mix the salad
Place all ingredients in a clean bowl: kohlrabi, carrot, cucumber, green mango, purple cabbage, roasted peanuts, and cilantro.
Wear plastic gloves and toss the ingredients together.
Let the ingredients rest for 3 minutes while preparing the dressing.
Step 3: Make the sweet and sour dressing
In a bowl, mix 2 tbsp white sugar, 1 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tsp MSG, lime juice, minced garlic, and minced chili.
Stir well until the sugar dissolves.
Taste and adjust the sweet and sour balance.
Slowly pour the dressing over the vegetable mixture from step 2.
Wear plastic gloves and toss the salad with the dressing.
Step 4: Completion
Arrange the salad on a plate, then top with beef jerky, roasted peanuts, and cilantro.
Enjoy immediately.
2. Five-Color Fruit Salad
Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Peel the mango and shred into thin strips.
Peel the beans (?) and shred into thin strips.
Trim the ends of the cucumber, soak in salt water, then shred into thin strips.
Peel the pineapple, remove the eyes, and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Deseed and mince the sweet chili.
Roast and crush the peanuts.
In a bowl, combine the shredded mango, beans, cucumber, pineapple, cilantro, and roasted peanuts.
Wear plastic gloves and toss all ingredients together.
Step 3: Mix the dressing
In a bowl, mix 2 tbsp sugar, 3 tbsp fish sauce, minced garlic, minced chili, and lime juice.
Stir all ingredients together.
Taste the dressing to adjust to your personal preference.
Slowly pour the dressing into the salad mixture from step 2.
Plate the fruit salad, top with beef jerky, and enjoy.
Tips for a delicious five-color salad
Five-color salad is simple, tasty, and easy to make. To ensure it's appealing, keep these tips in mind:
Choose fresh ingredients: Using fresh produce provides natural sweetness and vibrant colors. Select vegetables that are firm and show no signs of wilting or damage.
Proper preparation: Each vegetable has its own prep method. Prepare them correctly to remove any pungent or bitter tastes, enhancing the natural flavor.
Mixing the dressing: The dressing is the soul of the salad. You can follow a traditional recipe or get creative. Ensure a balance of sour, spicy, and sweet flavors.
Toss evenly: When mixing, ensure the ingredients are well-coated with dressing. However, do not toss too forcefully to avoid bruising or crushing the vegetables.

mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried pork with potatoes is a simple yet very rice-friendly dish. It's not only delicious but also extremely easy to make. Check out the recipe below!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Wash the pork and slice thinly.
Marinate the pork with salt, pepper, a pinch of sugar, 1 tbsp soy sauce, and a little oil. Mix well and let sit for 15 minutes.
Step 2:
Peel the potatoes and slice them about 0.5cm thick. Heat oil in a pan and fry the potatoes.
Once golden brown, remove and set aside on a plate.
Step 3:

Return the pan to the stove with a thin layer of oil. Sauté the minced shallots until fragrant, then add the pork. Stir-fry quickly until the meat is firm and cooked. If the pan is too dry, add a splash of water, then add the fried potatoes back in.
Turn up the heat and toss gently to avoid breaking the potatoes. Adjust seasoning to taste, stir-fry for about 5 minutes, then sprinkle with chopped scallions and turn off the heat.
Step 4:
Transfer to a plate and serve with hot rice.

mon_an.mo_ta: You can transform a mundane daily boiled pork dish into something fresh and exciting with these cucumber rolls.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the meat
I don't use ozone cleaners; instead, I clean the meat manually. This method is very effective.

Wash the meat. Bring a pot of water to a boil, drop the meat in, bring back to a boil, then remove and rinse thoroughly with cold water. This removes odors and any impurities. The meat will smell fresh and delicious.
Step 2: Boil the meat
After cleaning, place the meat in a pot with a few slices of crushed ginger, 1 crushed shallot, and a bit of rice vinegar. This keeps the meat white and fragrant.

Flip the meat occasionally for even cooking. Do not overcook; it should be just tender to keep its sweetness. Test by piercing the thickest part with a chopstick; if no pink juice runs out, it's done.
Remove the meat and submerge it in a bowl of cooled boiled water to keep it white and firm, then let it cool on a plate.
Slice the meat into thin strips about 3 cm wide and 7-10 cm long.
Step 3:
Wash the cucumbers, cilantro, lettuce, and scallions. Soak in salt water for 10 minutes for hygiene.
Cut the cucumbers lengthwise into 3 cm sections, then into thin sticks matching the width of the meat slices.
Cut the scallions into 3 cm lengths as well.
Step 4: Mix the dipping sauce
Peel garlic, deseed chilies, and pound them into a paste in a mortar.
Peel the lime, separate the segments, and remove the white pith.
Mix rice vinegar with the garlic, chili, and lime segments so they float.
Add sugar and fish sauce, stirring until the sugar dissolves. If too salty, add a little cooled boiled water.
The flavor should be a harmonious balance of sour, sweet, spicy, and salty.
Add the toasted sesame seeds to the sauce.
Finally, add some chili sauce for a perfect dipping experience.
Step 5: Roll the meat with vegetables
Lay a slice of meat flat, place 2-3 cucumber sticks, 2 scallion pieces, 1/2 a lettuce leaf, and some cilantro in the middle. Roll tightly so the edges are sealed. Now you have a refreshing pork roll.
Arrange on a plate. You can drizzle the sauce over the rolls or serve it on the side.
The savory meat, fresh vegetables, and legendary sauce will make your family meal much warmer.
This dish is also perfect for parties. Good luck!
Here is the final result.
Secrets for delicious boiled pork rolls with cucumber:
The meat must be a solid piece that can be sliced thin and long without breaking. Pork belly or lean rump meat works best.
Choose straight, young cucumbers with white tips. Look for those with a waxy white coating, as they are freshly picked and sweeter.
The dipping sauce is the most important part; adjust the sour, spicy, salty, and sweet levels to suit your family's taste.
You can substitute or combine cucumbers with other vegetables like carrots or green mango.

mon_an.mo_ta: Each bite of these rich, creamy bacon cheese rolls is irresistible. Your family will love them and never get tired of the flavor. When you have some free time, try making these attractive rolls for everyone.
cac_buoc: First, lay 5 strips of bacon neatly side-by-side on a flat surface.
Next, place 2 slices of bread with cheese sandwiched between them on top of the bacon strips and roll them up from the bottom.
Then, arrange the remaining 5 strips of bacon similarly to step 1, but in the opposite direction (perpendicularly).
Continue wrapping the bacon to completely seal the two open ends of the bread.
Heat a pan with a little butter and fry the bacon roll until golden brown on all sides.
Wait for the bacon cheese roll to cool slightly, then slice into pieces and enjoy.

mon_an.mo_ta: We present to you steamed shrimp with luffa – a unique, delicious, and attractive dish. Anyone seeing this dish will be captivated by the vibrant green of the luffa, the bright red of the shrimp, accented by red chili, the golden-brown of fish sauce and soy sauce, and the white of the garlic. All these colors create a perfect dish that stands out on a white plate. Not only that, but the dish is also incredibly fragrant, sweet, refreshing, and packed with nutrients.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the shrimp, peel, and remove the heads. Keep the tails intact for a beautiful presentation later. Use a knife to remove the dark vein on the back. Curl the shrimp and thread the tail through the body (refer to the finished dish photo for details). Marinate the shrimp with a squeeze of lemon juice, a bit of broth powder, and pepper for fragrance.
Step 2: Wash the luffa, peel it, and cut into 5cm segments. Use a knife or a small spoon to hollow out the center.
Step 3: Place the shrimp into the hollowed-out luffa segments.
Step 4: Place the shrimp and luffa in a steamer and steam until the shrimp turn bright red and are fully cooked.

Step 5: While waiting for the shrimp to cook, prepare the dipping sauce. Finely mince the garlic and chili, then mix well with the remaining ingredients. Once the shrimp are cooked, drizzle the sauce over them so the dish absorbs the delicious flavors.
Here is the finished dish. It looks incredibly appetizing, doesn't it?
Secrets for perfect Steamed Shrimp with Luffa:

When choosing shrimp, select fresh ones that are still jumping, large, uniform, and firm without any sliminess. Do not choose shrimp that are slimy or have legs that are no longer firmly attached to the body, as these are no longer fresh.
For luffa, choose angled luffa (mướp hương) that are small and long with a rough skin, vibrant green color, and a light white powdery coating, indicating they are young and freshly picked.

After washing the shrimp, you can rub them with a layer of lemon or vinegar to make them less slippery and easier to peel. You must remove the black vein on the back as it is the shrimp's excretory system; removing it will make the steamed shrimp taste much better.

mon_an.mo_ta: Grilled lemon shrimp skewers bring a breath of fresh air to your family meals. When the whole family gathers to grill shrimp and chat together, it's wonderful. This dish can be served as a snack or with rice; it's savory and attractive! With everyday ingredients and a bit of creativity, we can create a new and exciting dish. It doesn't take much time—only about half an hour to prepare everything! So why wait? Let's learn how to make it right now!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Minced chili, minced garlic - 1 tsp each
Olive oil, salt, pepper - as needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Soak the bamboo skewers in hot water for 15 minutes, then wash them clean.

Step 2: Wash the lemons, zest them, and squeeze for juice. Wash the cilantro and mint, then chop. Put the lemon zest, juice, herbs, garlic, and chili into a blender and blend until smooth. Pour the sauce into a bowl, add 1 small tbsp of olive oil, a bit of salt and pepper, and mix well.
Step 3: Peel the shrimp and remove the veins, leaving the tails on. Marinate the shrimp with 1/3 of the sauce for about 10 minutes. Thread about 4-5 shrimp onto each bamboo skewer.
Step 3: There are many ways to grill shrimp; here is how to grill them using a non-stick pan:

Place the pan on the stove and heat it up. Place the shrimp skewers in the pan and brush the remaining sauce over them. Grill for 4-5 minutes per side or until the shrimp are cooked through, then enjoy immediately!
You can also use a microwave or a charcoal grill; eating them hot right off the grill creates a cozy atmosphere! Good luck with your Grilled Lemon Shrimp Skewers!

mon_an.mo_ta: I recently came across this crab meat egg roll dish and found it absolutely delicious, so today I am determined to guide you through it. If you love eggs but want something unique and different, come take a look!!!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Cooking oil, fish sauce, broth powder, pepper
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel the potatoes, wash, and dice them. Trim the roots of the green onions, wash, and chop finely. Blanch the potatoes briefly, drain, and then stir-fry in a pan. Season with a bit of broth powder to taste, sprinkle in the green onions, turn off the heat, and transfer to a large bowl.
Step 2: Grate the cheese into shreds. Steam the crab meat until cooked, shred it, and mix well with the stir-fried potatoes, 2/3 of the cheese, and a bit of pepper.
Step 3: Crack the eggs into a bowl, add the remaining cheese, 2 tsp of fish sauce, and 1 tsp of broth powder, then whisk well.

Step 4: Place a pan on the stove and pour in the eggs to fry. When the eggs are almost set, place 1/2 of the mixture from Step 2 in the center, roll up both sides, flip to ensure even coloring, and then serve on a plate. Use the remaining mixture from Step 2 to garnish the outside of your unique and delicious Crab Meat Egg Rolls!

mon_an.mo_ta: Let's cook this potato omelet—unique, delicious, and full of nutrients for the whole family's dinner.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Peel the potatoes, wash, and slice thinly. Wash the tomato and cut into small pieces. Peel the onion and chop finely. Cut the bacon or salami into bite-sized pieces.
Step 2: Sauté the potatoes

Heat a pan, add about 2 tbsp of oil, and sauté the onion for about 2 minutes over low heat. Then add the potatoes and sauté over low heat with a bit of salt and pepper to taste. Cover the pan so the potatoes cook faster; this will take about 5 minutes. Remember to stir the potatoes regularly and evenly so they don't burn.
Step 3: Crack the eggs into a bowl, add a little salt, pepper, and milk, then whisk gently until well combined. Add the cooked potatoes, tomatoes, peas, and bacon or salami, and stir well.

Step 4: Add about 2 more tbsp of oil to the pan, pour in the egg mixture, and reduce the heat to low. Fry for about 10-15 minutes until the mixture slowly sets. While frying the eggs, preheat your oven to 160°C.

Step 5: Gently use a spatula to transfer the omelet to a tray to put in the oven. Sprinkle some thinly grated cheese, a few thyme leaves, and parsley on top to make the dish more fragrant and attractive, then bake for about 10 minutes until the eggs are fully cooked. You can test by inserting a toothpick; if it comes out clean, the eggs are done.
Take the omelet out of the oven and cut it into triangles. You can sprinkle more thyme and parsley on top for garnish.

This potato omelet is inspired by the Spanish tortilla with some minor adjustments to suit family tastes. You can freely add or remove ingredients as you like. Here are some tips for a delicious potato omelet:
When sautéing the potatoes in Step 2, remember to use low heat and stir constantly so the potatoes don't scorch, which would ruin the dish. Also, stir gently so the potatoes don't get crushed.
I like adding a bit of milk to the eggs; it makes the omelet very fragrant and delicious when fried or baked. Give it a try.
For the final step of putting the eggs on a tray for the oven, you can add a bit of grated cheese on top to enhance the aroma. If you don't like cheese, you can skip this step.

If you don't have an oven, you can use a non-stick pan to fry the eggs. When the top is dry and the bottom is golden brown, gently use a spatula and chopsticks to flip the omelet and continue frying the other side until golden. If you like, you can add cheese on top after flipping.
Using the same basic ingredient of potatoes, you can also try a smooth, creamy, and delicious potato soup.

mon_an.mo_ta: Have you ever heard of jellied pork skin? This is a unique and attractive dish in Vietnamese cuisine. Jellied pork skin is not only delicious but also has many nutritional benefits. Today, we will guide you through a simple recipe to create a fragrant, smooth, and flavorful jellied pork skin. Discover the simple recipe to make this unique dish at home and enjoy its wonderful taste.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the pork skin

When at the market, choose pork skin that has been cleaned of hair. Wash the skin, scrape off any remaining hair or dirt, and trim away all the fat attached to the skin. Next, place the skin in a pot of boiling water and add the wine. Blanch for 3-5 minutes, then remove.

After removing the skin, scrape the outer surface again to ensure it is clean. Flip it over and trim off any remaining fat. To prevent the dish from being too greasy, it is essential to remove all the fat.
Finally, cut the pork skin into bite-sized pieces and tie them into knots using green onion stalks.
Step 2: Simmering to jellify

Add the pork skin and water to a pressure cooker at a ratio of 100g of skin to 200ml of water. Then add soy sauce, star anise, cinnamon, onion, ginger, and sugar. Bring to a boil and skim off any foam. Seal the pressure cooker and simmer for about 20 minutes until the pork skin is tender.

Tip: If you don't have a pressure cooker, you can use a regular pot. However, the cooking time will be longer and more water will evaporate, so be sure to add a bit more water when using a regular pot.
Step 3: Cooling to set
Once cooked, release the pressure and open the lid (skip this if using a regular pot). Remove the aromatics like cinnamon, ginger, star anise, and onion, then sprinkle in some pepper and stir well.

Next, pour the pork skin and broth into a container and let it cool. Since the dish contains a lot of pork skin, it may set naturally as it cools if the weather is cool. However, in hot weather, you need to place the container in the refrigerator and wait until it is completely set.
Notes for making jellied pork skin
Choose fresh ingredients: Select fresh, high-quality pork skin. It should be thoroughly cleaned and free of unpleasant odors.
Food safety: Ensure food safety during preparation and processing. Wash your hands, tools, and work surfaces before starting. Ensure the pork skin is fully cooked to avoid bacterial risks.
Adjust seasoning: Taste the broth before letting it set. If necessary, adjust seasonings like salt, sugar, pepper, and soy sauce to suit your taste.

Cooling the dish: After cooking, place the skin and broth in a container and let it cool. Ensure it is completely cool before letting it set. If the weather is hot, keep it in the fridge for food safety.
Proper storage: Once successfully set, store the jellied pork skin in the refrigerator to extend its shelf life. Ensure the container is tightly sealed and not in direct contact with air.
How to clean pork skin properly
Wash the pork skin: Rinse the skin under cold water. Use a soft brush to gently scrub and remove any dirt, debris, or fat patches.
Remove hair: Use a sharp knife or a razor to shave the hair off the skin. Be careful and gentle so as not to tear or damage the skin underneath. Try to completely remove all hair and follicles.
Trim the fat: If there is still fat attached, use a clean cloth or knife to scrape the fat off the surface. This helps remove excess fat and cleans the skin.
Rinse again: After shaving and trimming the fat, wash the pork skin one more time to ensure it is clean and free of any remaining residue.

mon_an.ten: Secrets to Delicious Homemade Giò Lụa for Tet
mon_an.mo_ta: With these secrets for making Giò Lụa, you can completely make this delicious dish right at home for your family to enjoy or to treat guests! Let's get started!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning - 1 tbsp fish sauce; 1/2 tsp broth powder; 1/2 tsp sugar; 1 tsp white pepper (white pepper prevents the roll from turning dark)
Ice cold water (must be very cold) - 50ml
Fresh banana leaves for wrapping - (can be replaced with aluminum foil)
cac_buoc: Before proceeding with the steps to make Giò Lụa, note that the ground pork must have both lean and fat; if you use only lean meat, the roll will be dry and much less tasty.
How to choose meat: The fresher the meat, the better the roll. Ideally, buy meat directly from a slaughterhouse. You can use pork shank (which is soft and not greasy), loin, or ham.
Okay, the ingredients are ready, let's start making Giò Lụa now!
Step 1:

After grinding the pork, place it in the freezer for about 45 minutes; this is the ideal time for the meat to reach the right firmness. You can also leave it until it is very cold and feels slightly firm to the touch, but avoid letting it freeze solid!

Once the time is up, take the meat out and grind it again in a food processor with the cornstarch (or tapioca starch), baking powder, sugar, broth powder, white pepper, and fish sauce. Run the processor for 15 seconds.

Continue by adding a little ice cold water, pulse for 10 seconds, then add more ice water. Pulse again for 10-15 seconds, pause, and continue adding water and grinding. Do this until all 50ml of ice water is used and the meat turns a pale pink color and reaches a pasty, elastic consistency.
Step 2: Wrapping with banana leaves.
Using banana leaves is the standard way, as the deliciousness of Giò Lụa comes partly from the aroma of the leaves during steaming.
Before wrapping, wash the leaves and let them drain. If they are still wet when you are ready to wrap, use a towel to wipe them dry.
Pick out 2-3 leaves and cut them into pieces about 15cm wide to wrap the two ends of the roll.
Lay 2 leaves side-by-side vertically, then place 2 more leaves on top horizontally.

Place the freshly ground meat in the center of the leaves and roll them up. You can use a string to hold the middle if your grip is weak. Seal the two ends by folding the leaf over and standing the roll upright.

Fold the leaf ends down, place two small strips of leaf in a cross shape over the ends, and tie with a bamboo string. Do the same for the other end, then tie two more strings around the middle to secure the roll tightly.
Step 3:
After wrapping, place the roll in a steamer for about 1 hour. Add the roll only when the water is already boiling!
When cooked, remove the roll and let it cool naturally. When first wrapped, the roll may look wrinkled, but after steaming, it will expand into a plump, appetizing shape.

Note: To check if it's cooked, poke a small toothpick into the roll; if meat sticks to it or liquid comes out, it's not done. Steam a bit longer. Especially note: do not rush to put the roll in cold water to cool it down. This will only cause water to seep in, making the roll dark and crumbly. Let it cool naturally. Right after steaming, it will be as bouncy as a ball, then it will settle into its traditional shape.
