Simmer the chicken bones to make a broth. Marinate the chicken meat with a little fish sauce, MSG, and seasoning powder for 30 minutes (do not use too much fish sauce or the dish will be too salty and lose its delicate flavor).
Step 2: Soak the wood ear and shiitake mushrooms until expanded. Finely slice the wood ear mushrooms and halve the shiitake mushrooms.
Step 3: Sauté minced shallots until fragrant, then add the chicken and stir-fry.
Season to taste and stir-fry until the chicken is firm, then pour in the bone broth. When the water boils, skim off the foam to ensure the aspic looks clear and beautiful.
Simmer until the chicken is completely tender, then add the wood ear mushrooms, shiitake mushrooms, and pepper. Cook for another 10 minutes and turn off the heat. Allow the chicken aspic to cool.
Step 4: Carve the carrot into flower shapes and place them at the bottom of the bowls. Ladle the chicken mixture into the bowls, cover, and refrigerate for 4-5 hours until set.
Chicken aspic is a perfect dish for cold days, especially during the Lunar New Year. It is best served with pickles, especially pickled onions, and hot rice.

mon_an.ten: Vietnamese Pork Aspic – A Traditional Dish
mon_an.mo_ta: Pork aspic – a traditional Vietnamese dish for generations. Explore how to make this delicious and easy recipe!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Wood ear mushrooms, pepper, salt, MSG, fish sauce - to taste
cac_buoc: Step 1: Clean the pork shank and pig ear, cut into small pieces, and marinate with pepper, salt, MSG, and fish sauce for about 1 hour.
Step 2: Soak the wood ear mushrooms and slice them into pieces about two finger-widths wide. (Soak in cold water to maintain their crunch).
Step 3: Place the marinated meat in a pot, add water, and simmer. When it boils, reduce the heat, leave the lid ajar, skim off the foam, and continue simmering until the meat is tender.
Step 4: Once the meat is tender, add the wood ear mushrooms and cook for another 15 minutes, then turn off the heat (do not overcook the mushrooms or they will lose their texture).
Step 5: Pour the meat into bowls, let cool, and then refrigerate. (In cold weather, the meat may set naturally even without a refrigerator).
Step 6: Pork aspic - a traditional Vietnamese dish that is wonderful when served with hot rice and pickled onions or vegetables.

mon_an.mo_ta: Making cinnamon pork pâté at home is not difficult; the result is incredibly fragrant, delicious, and safe. You can easily make this dish to change up the menu for your family. Learn how to make homemade chả quế here.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the pork, remove the skin, and cut into bite-sized pieces. Place in a bowl and put in the freezer for 10-15 minutes.

Step 2: Remove the meat from the freezer and grind it finely in a food processor. If there is a lot of meat, divide it into 2-3 batches. Once ground, put all the meat back into the processor with 2 tsp tapioca starch, 3 tsp fish sauce, and baking powder (dissolved in 2 tsp water), then blend thoroughly. Once smooth, add 3 tsp oil and 3 tsp cinnamon powder, then stir well with chopsticks for about 5 minutes.
Step 3: Place the meat mixture onto plastic wrap and wrap tightly. Place in the refrigerator for 15-20 minutes to make the pâté more elastic and chewy.
Step 4: Remove the meat mixture from the fridge and steam for about 20 minutes, then turn off the heat. Place the pâté on a plate and remove the plastic wrap.

Step 5: Heat oil in a pan until very hot, then fry the cinnamon pâté over low heat until golden brown on all sides. Let it cool slightly before slicing into bite-sized pieces. Arrange on a plate and enjoy.

mon_an.mo_ta: During Tet in Northern Vietnam, Giò Thủ is an essential dish. To make this delicious dish at home, check out the article below. Today, we will guide you through the process of making Northern-style pig ear head cheese for Tet!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Black pepper - 50g (adjust to taste; we like it spicy and fragrant, so we use 50g)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Toast the peppercorns (use white peppercorns) until fragrant, then crush them (do not grind into a fine powder; just crush them so they are fragrant but still in large pieces for marinating).
Step 2: Peel and mince the shallots.
Step 3: Prepare the meat:
Clean the pork, tongue, snout, and ears thoroughly with water. Boil some water, set aside a little to soak the mushrooms (see Step 4), and blanch all the meat.
Blanching helps remove impurities and makes the meat easier to process. This is a good practice for any pork or bone dish.
After blanching, remove the meat and clean it again (scrape off hair, remove the mucous membrane from the tongue, etc.), then rub with sea salt to remove odors. Rinse with cold water and drain.
Slice all the meat components into long, thin strips.
Place the sliced ingredients into a large bowl.
Marinate the meat with the crushed pepper from Step 1 and minced shallots from Step 2.
Add a bit of fish sauce and seasonings to taste, then marinate for 30 minutes. Note: Marinate with aromatics (pepper, shallots) first, then add salty seasonings (fish sauce, salt) for better flavor.
Step 4: Prepare mushrooms
Use the hot water from Step 3 to soak the wood ear and shiitake mushrooms until soft. Rinse, remove stems, and slice into strips.
Step 5: Sauté the meat
Clean and dry a pan, then heat it on the stove. Add a little oil (only a small amount as the meat will release fat) and sauté the minced shallots until fragrant.
Turn the heat to the highest setting and add the marinated meat from Step 3.
Stir-fry constantly over high heat until the meat is firm and the fat begins to render.
Once the fat renders, add the sliced wood ear and shiitake mushrooms from Step 4.
Continue to stir-fry until the mushrooms are cooked. Adjust seasoning to taste and add more pepper before turning off the heat for extra aroma.
Step 6: Molding the giò.
While the meat is still hot, pack it into a giò mold.
Add the meat gradually, pressing down firmly with a spoon after each addition to ensure there are no air pockets.
Once all the meat is in the mold, attach the lid and tighten the screw firmly.
Tilt the mold to drain any excess fat. Let the giò cool completely before removing it from the mold.

If you don't have a mold, you can use a plastic bottle (1.5L) with the top cut off to pack the meat, or wrap it traditionally. Traditionally, you can use areca palm sheaths or banana leaves, wrapping tightly and securing with bamboo slats and ties.
When serving, slice the giò into bite-sized pieces and arrange beautifully on a plate.
If not eating immediately, wrap in plastic wrap (or keep in the traditional leaves) and store in the refrigerator.

The final Giò Thủ should be crunchy (from the wood ear, ears, snout, and tongue) and fragrant (from the meat, pepper, and shiitake). The roll should be firm, crispy but not hard, and rich without being greasy. Serve with high-quality fish sauce and traditional pickles or sweet and sour pickled onions.

mon_an.ten: Shiitake Mushroom and Meatball Soup (Canh Mọc)
mon_an.mo_ta: Shiitake mushroom and meatball soup is a delicious, nutrient-rich dish. Learn how to cook this hot, fragrant soup for Tet holidays or weekend family gatherings.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Bone broth - 400-500ml (Chicken broth is best for a low-fat option)
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Carve the kohlrabi and carrots into flower shapes and slice thinly (or just cut into bite-sized pieces if you prefer).
Soak the shiitake mushrooms in warm water until soft, then trim off the stems.
Mix the raw pork paste with a little pepper, then stuff it into the mushroom caps, shaping the paste into a rounded mound (mọc).
Step 2:
Cook the stuffed mushrooms in the chicken broth.
Add the sliced scallions and ginger to the broth for aroma. Boil until just cooked through (5-6 minutes) then remove. (Do not overcook or the meatball may detach from the mushroom).
Alternatively, you can steam the stuffed mushrooms to ensure they stay intact.
Step 3:
Add the carrots to the broth and cook for 5-10 minutes, then add the kohlrabi and cook for another 5 minutes.
Cook until just tender to maintain a slight crunch. Season with salt and fish sauce to taste.
Step 4:
Place the kohlrabi and carrots in a bowl, arrange the stuffed mushrooms around them, and pour the broth over until just covered. Garnish with cilantro.
Canh mọc is an easy-to-cook soup rich in vegetables, perfect for treating your family.
Enjoy your meal with this refreshing and easy-to-eat shiitake mushroom soup!

mon_an.mo_ta: The fragrant aroma of steaming sticky rice in the fresh morning air is an unforgettable memory. Coconut sticky rice is soft and fragrant, with plump grains blended with rich, shredded coconut. The coconut oil coats each grain, making it soft and sweet. Chewing slowly, you will experience the perfect harmony of sweetness, richness, and aroma. Don't miss this dish for your Tet meals!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the glutinous rice and soak in cold water overnight to expand, or soak in slightly warm water for about 3 hours for a faster result.
Step 2: Once the rice has expanded, rinse under a strong stream of water and drain well.
Step 3: Shred the coconut meat into thin strips.
Step 4: Set up a steamer and pour a little water into the bottom. Bring the water to a boil. Mix the rice with the shredded coconut.
Step 5: When the steamer starts producing steam, add the rice mixture, spread it evenly, and reduce the heat slightly.

Step 6: Steam the rice for about 15 minutes, then use chopsticks to fluff it up. Drizzle 2 tsp of cooking oil over the surface and mix well to prevent the rice from drying out and to give it a glossy finish. Steam for another 10 minutes until cooked. Check by ensuring the grains are fully expanded and the texture is soft and sticky. The aroma of coconut and rice should be fragrant.
Step 7: Transfer the rice to a large bowl, add sugar, and mix well. This must be done while the rice is still hot so the sugar dissolves completely.
Step 8: Add the toasted sesame seeds and mix well. Pack the rice into a small bowl, pressing down firmly. Flip the bowl onto a flat plate to unmold. This sticky rice can be enjoyed hot or cold.

mon_an.mo_ta: Sweet fried pumpkin cakes are a crispy and nutritious afternoon snack. With just 4 simple steps, you can have a wonderful treat to enjoy in the afternoon.
cac_buoc: Learn to cook a simple new dish - Sweet Fried Pumpkin Cakes:
Step 1: Peel the pumpkin, wash, and slice into thin matchsticks for a beautiful presentation. Place the pumpkin in a bowl and toss with salt. Mixing with salt helps the pumpkin stay crispy!
Step 2: When the pumpkin releases water, drain it all off so the cakes don't become mushy when frying.
Step 3: Mix the flour and sugar into the pumpkin. If the mixture is too thick, you can add a little milk or water.
Step 4: Heat oil in a pan. When hot, scoop spoonfuls of the pumpkin mixture into the pan, flatten them out, and fry until golden brown. Flip occasionally to ensure even cooking.
Your afternoon snack of Sweet Fried Pumpkin Cakes is now complete!

mon_an.mo_ta: Korean cuisine has traveled all over the world and is very popular in Vietnam. One of the most favorite Korean snacks among Vietnamese youth is Tteokbokki (spicy rice cakes). Today, we will guide you on how to make this dish! It is delicious and not difficult to prepare at all!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Add a pinch of salt to the rice flour, then slowly pour in the water and mix well.
Step 2: Knead the dough thoroughly until it is smooth and even.
Step 3: Place the kneaded dough into a steamer and steam for about 20 minutes. Line the lid with a towel or soft cloth so that condensed water does not drip onto the dough.
Step 4: Once steamed, let the dough cool, then continue to knead thoroughly for about 10 - 15 minutes. Roll the dough into long cylinders.
Step 5: Use a knife to cut into long pieces or rounds as desired.
From here, you can use these rice cakes to make any Tteokbokki dish you like!
Good luck to everyone!

mon_an.mo_ta: Savory fried rice balls have long been a familiar snack for chilly winter afternoons. The crispiness and fragrance of these cakes leave a lasting impression. Let's make this dish together!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, seasoning powder, black pepper, shallots
cac_buoc: Let's learn how to cook delicious savory fried rice balls, a perfect afternoon snack:
Step 1: Wash the sweet potatoes, cut into small pieces, steam until cooked, and mash thoroughly.

Step 2: Mix a bit of salt with the glutinous rice flour, rice flour, and mashed sweet potato in a large bowl. Slowly add hot water (about 80°C). Knead the dough until pliable, then wrap tightly with plastic wrap for about 30 minutes.

Step 3: Soak the wood ear mushrooms and glass noodles in hot water in two separate bowls until expanded. Drain and wash the wood ear mushrooms, remove the stems, and finely chop. Cut the glass noodles into short strands. Wash, peel, and julienne the carrots, then finely chop.

Step 4: Mix the ground pork with the glass noodles, wood ear mushrooms, and carrots. To make the filling savory and flavorful, add minced shallots, black pepper, 2 teaspoons of salt, and half a teaspoon of seasoning powder. Use a spoon to divide the mixture into small, elongated balls.
We are halfway through making this afternoon snack; let's continue!
Step 5: Divide the dough into small portions, flatten them, place the filling in the center, and wrap it up.
Step 6: Shape the balls carefully so the crust is not broken, avoiding the balls bursting while frying.
Step 7: Fry the balls until golden brown on all sides. Use chopsticks to turn them constantly so they do not burst.

Step 8: Once golden brown, remove and place in a metal basket to drain the oil. Prepare the dipping sauce as follows: Mix fish sauce, sugar, vinegar, and water in a 1:1:1:5 ratio, then add the chili and green papaya. The savory fried rice ball snack is now complete.

mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried pumpkin with shrimp is a delicious and nutritious dish that is very good for your health, helping you regain energy after a tiring workday.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Dried shrimp - 1 cup (fresh shrimp can be used)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel the pumpkin, wash, and cut into slightly thick cubes.
Step 2: Soak the dried shrimp until soft, then wash thoroughly to remove any grit.
Step 3: Place a pan on the stove, heat the cooking oil, and sauté the garlic until fragrant. Add the shrimp and stir-fry until almost cooked.

Step 4: Next, add the pumpkin and stir-fry together, tossing well. Add a little water, then cover the pan and let it boil for a few minutes. Season with salt and a little sugar, and cook until the pumpkin is tender and has absorbed the seasonings.

Pumpkin is a source of vitamin A, which plays an important role in vision, bone growth, and reproduction, participates in protein synthesis, regulates the immune system, and protects the skin. Pumpkin also contains a substance necessary for brain activity called glutamic acid, which plays an important role in nourishing the nerves and assisting metabolic reactions in nerve and brain cells.

mon_an.mo_ta: Grilled meat is an incredibly delicious and attractive dish. With just a few steps of marinating the meat with spices and putting it on the grill, you have a delicious grilled meat dish immediately. It only takes a little time for the ingredient preparation; let's see the secret to making authentic Korean-style grilled meat below!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
After washing the meat with salt, slice it into thin pieces about 0.5cm thick. Slicing it thin like this allows the meat to cook quickly and evenly, and the marinade will penetrate better.
Step 2:
Puree 60g of onion, then mix it thoroughly with the sliced meat.
Step 3:
Add all the remaining marinade ingredients (except the toasted sesame seeds).
Mix the meat well with the seasonings, then place it in the refrigerator for about 30 minutes so the meat absorbs the flavors evenly.
Step 4:

While waiting for the meat, light the charcoal until it glows red, then place the grill rack on top. After the meat has marinated long enough, take it out and grill until both sides are golden and the meat is cooked through. Arrange on a plate and sprinkle with a little toasted sesame seeds.
Step 5:
Make the dipping sauce: Combine all the dipping sauce ingredients, mix well, and adjust the seasoning to your taste.
Step 6:
Once the meat is grilled, serve it with raw vegetables: lettuce, cucumber... dipping it in the sauce will be very delicious.

mon_an.ten: Da Lat Style Grilled Rice Paper
mon_an.mo_ta: Da Lat grilled rice paper has become a famous and popular snack among young people. Due to its popularity, this dish has appeared in Hanoi and Saigon, giving young people the chance to enjoy it without traveling to Da Lat. So why not try making grilled rice paper at home? It's not difficult at all. Let's discover how to make this dish in the characteristic Da Lat style! Explore how to make Da Lat grilled rice paper at home and enjoy the unique, delicious, and memorable flavor.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients

Peel the shallots, wash, and slice thinly. In a pan, heat 2 tablespoons of cooking oil, then sauté the shallots until golden brown. Remove and drain the oil. Wash the lemongrass, crush, and chop finely.

In the pan, add 1 tablespoon of oil and sauté the lemongrass for 1-2 minutes, then pour into a small bowl. Clean the green onions, chop finely, and sauté half of the onions with cooking oil to make scallion oil. (You should use a bit more oil here so that when the oil is rich, the flavor will be more delicious and creamy, and avoid overcooking the onions).
Step 2: Grilling the rice paper

Light the charcoal stove and wait for the coals to glow red before placing the grill rack on the stove. Place the rice paper on the rack and toast it briefly. Then, add a little lemongrass, a spoonful of sate, a spoonful of scallion oil, and a spoonful of fermented shrimp paste onto the rice paper. At that point, crack three quail eggs (or one chicken egg) onto the surface. Use a brush to quickly stir the eggs and seasonings together, spreading the ingredients evenly over the rice paper.
Note: You should grill the rice paper over low heat to avoid burning and to give the ingredients time to cook.

Once finished, sprinkle some finely chopped green onions on the surface and drizzle a bit of chili sauce and mayonnaise in a circular pattern. Rotate the rice paper so it cooks evenly, then place it on a plate to enjoy.
Notes for making delicious Da Lat grilled rice paper
Choose fresh ingredients: Ensure that shallots, lemongrass, and green onions are fresh and show no signs of wilting or drying out.
Process seasonings correctly: When sautéing shallots and lemongrass, wait until the oil is hot before adding them to the pan. Sauté the seasonings briefly to avoid losing the golden color or burning.

Ensure temperature and grilling time: Grill the rice paper over low heat to prevent burning and to ensure the ingredients are cooked evenly. Check carefully to make sure the rice paper is not burnt or overcooked.

Skillfully spread the seasonings: Use a brush to stir the eggs and seasonings quickly and evenly on the rice paper. This helps the ingredients spread across the entire surface and brings out the delicious flavor.

Enjoy fresh: When finished, sprinkle finely chopped green onions on the surface and serve with chili sauce and mayonnaise to create an extra special flavor. Place the grilled rice paper on a plate and enjoy immediately while still hot for the best experience.

mon_an.mo_ta: This weekend, treat your family to a change of pace with Bún Thịt Nướng (Vietnamese Grilled Pork with Rice Vermicelli) instead of the usual daily rice meal! Follow the recipe below to make this delicious dish.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Sweet and sour dipping sauce - As needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: After slicing the pork, place it in a bowl.
Step 2: Mix the minced onion and garlic with sugar, fish sauce, and soy sauce; stir well until the sugar dissolves. Pour this marinade over the pork and marinate for at least one hour or overnight.
Step 3: Place the meat in the oven at 375°F for about 10-15 minutes, flipping the meat once halfway through. Alternatively, you can grill the meat over charcoal for a very fragrant result.
Step 4: Arrange the herbs, rice vermicelli, grilled pork, and spring rolls in a bowl, then add the cucumber and pickled vegetables.
Step 5: Pour the sweet and sour fish sauce over the top, sprinkle with roasted peanuts, and enjoy!
Step 6: Your family's weekend will be more exciting as everyone gathers to make Bún Thịt Nướng.
Step 7: Wishing your whole family a delicious meal!

mon_an.ten: How to Make Restaurant-Style Salt-Roasted Peanuts
mon_an.mo_ta: Salt-roasted peanuts are not only a popular "drinking snack" loved by men, but also a common snack enjoyed by women and children alike. Let's discover how to make these savory, salty, and crunchy salt-roasted peanuts. Just paired with a bit of white rice, you have a truly delicious dish.
cac_buoc: The first step is to place a pan on the stove and let it heat up for a while. Then, add the peanuts to the pan to roast. Lower the heat to ensure the peanuts do not burn.

Next, roast the peanuts evenly to ensure all kernels cook at the same rate. Roast for about 7-9 minutes. When the peanuts start to crack but the skins haven't fully detached, add about 1-1.5 tbsp of oil to the pan and continue to stir. Keep the heat low so the oil gradually coats the peanuts.

This process will create crunchy and nutty peanuts. Taste a peanut to check if it is fully cooked, nutty, and slightly crunchy (since the peanuts are still hot, they won't be as crunchy as they will be after cooling).

Once the peanuts are evenly golden brown, remove them from the heat to cool, but continue to stir by hand because the pan is still hot. If you don't stir, the peanuts may burn. Alternatively, you can stir them in the pan and then transfer them to a large bowl so you don't have to stir constantly (the bowl is already cool, so there's no risk of burning).
While the peanuts are still slightly warm, add the seasoning salt and toss well so it adheres to the peanuts. For 200g of roasted peanuts, you can add about 1-1.5 tbsp of seasoning salt.

Usually, people add the seasoning salt as soon as the peanuts come off the stove. However, by doing this, the salt attaches quickly, but when the peanuts cool, the salt falls off and no longer sticks well.
After mixing well, wait for the peanuts to cool completely before putting them in an airtight jar. By roasting and storing them this way, the peanuts will stay crunchy and delicious.
Tips for crunchy roasted peanuts you should know:

Add the peanuts and oil to the pan at the same time and lower the heat. This helps the peanuts cook evenly and have a beautiful color. Avoid adding oil before heating the pan, as the peanuts will burn on the outside while remaining undercooked on the inside.
When roasting, stir constantly to ensure all kernels are evenly cooked.
It is important to monitor the roasting time to prevent the peanuts from burning and becoming inedible. Adjust the roasting time accordingly.
Once the peanuts are evenly golden brown, remove them from the heat to cool, but continue to stir by hand because the pan is still hot. If you don't stir, the peanuts may burn.

When the peanuts have cooled, add dry salt or seasoning salt in the appropriate amount to avoid being too salty or too bland. Mix well so the salt adheres to the peanuts. Thanks to the cooking oil, the salt will stick to the kernels.
Roasted peanuts will become soft after about 12 hours. If during the roasting process you spray a little white wine and mix well, the peanuts can be preserved for several days.
Finally, place the peanuts in a jar and close the lid tightly. This way, the peanuts will remain fragrant and crunchy for many days.

mon_an.ten: Cozy Duck Hotpot with Fermented Bean Curd
mon_an.mo_ta: Gathering with the whole family around a steaming pot of duck hotpot with fermented bean curd will make family bonds even warmer. Don't hesitate to buy the ingredients and make this dish right away!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings: 2 tbsp broth powder; 2 cubes rock sugar; 2 tbsp fish sauce; 1 tbsp white wine; 1 tsp sugar; 1/2 tsp salt.
Pepper, minced ginger, minced garlic, minced shallots, chili.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Clean the duck with ginger and salt, rinse with cold water, and chop into bite-sized pieces; drain well. Marinate the duck with wine, 1/2 jar of fermented bean curd, 1/2 of the broth powder, fish sauce, 1 tsp sugar, a little minced garlic, minced ginger, minced shallots, and pepper.
Step 2: Mix the duck thoroughly with the seasonings.
Step 3: Place the meat in the refrigerator overnight.
Step 4: Wash the taro, cut into small pieces, season with a little salt, drain, and lightly fry.
Step 5: Sauté the ginger, shallots, and garlic until fragrant, then add the duck and stir-fry over high heat until the meat firms up.
Step 6: Pour in the coconut water and cook for a few minutes so the duck absorbs the sweetness of the coconut water.
Step 7: After a few minutes, add boiling water until the duck is submerged. Bring to a boil, skim off the foam, then reduce the heat, add rock sugar, and simmer until the duck is tender.

Step 8: Then, add the fried taro and the remaining 1/2 jar of fermented bean curd; adjust the seasoning to taste. Cook for a few more minutes until the taro and duck are just cooked, then turn off the heat.
Step 9: While the duck is cooking, shred the water spinach and soak it in water with a little lime juice, then drain and place on a plate.
Step 10: Blanch the rice vermicelli until hot.
Step 11: Transfer the duck and fermented bean curd broth to a hotpot to keep warm and use it to dip the water spinach.
Step 12: Prepare the dipping sauce: mash 4 cubes of fermented bean curd with 1 tbsp minced ginger, 1/2 tbsp minced garlic, a few chili slices, 1 tbsp sugar, and the juice of 1/2 a lime until smooth.
Step 13: Place vermicelli in a bowl, top with water spinach, duck, and taro, then pour the hot broth over it and serve with the fermented bean curd dipping sauce.

mon_an.mo_ta: Summer is the season for fresh, tender green water spinach. Besides simple boiling or stir-frying, this beef and water spinach salad is an exciting suggestion for your family meal.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Bean sprouts, salt, fish sauce, sugar, half a lime, garlic, chili, roasted peanuts.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Pick the tender tops of the water spinach (if the stems are too thick, you can split them into halves or thirds), wash thoroughly, blanch briefly, then remove and submerge in a bowl of ice water to keep the spinach green and crunchy for the salad.
Step 2: Wash the bean sprouts and drain well.
Step 3: Slice the beef into very thin pieces, then quickly stir-fry in a pan over high heat with fragrant sautéed shallots. Once the meat is slightly seared, turn off the heat.

Step 4: Place the water spinach and bean sprouts in a large bowl, add an appropriate amount of salt and let it sit for 3-4 minutes to absorb. Next, add the beef and pour over the sweet and sour fish sauce (formula: 2 tbsp fish sauce + 2 tsp boiling water + 1 tbsp sugar + juice of half a lime + minced garlic and chili; mix the mixture until well combined).
Step 5: Finally, sprinkle with roasted peanuts and toss everything together so the peanuts release their fragrance into the salad.

mon_an.ten: Central Vietnam Style Stir-Fried Snails with Lemongrass and Chili
mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried snails with lemongrass and chili, an icon of Vietnamese cuisine, lingers in the hearts of many diners with its attractive, spicy, and bold flavors. It's not complicated; just prepare enough ingredients and spices, and you can completely make this dish at home. Don't miss the detailed instructions in the article below! I. How to make Central Vietnamese stir-fried snails with lemongrass and chili.
thoi_gian: Prepare the apple snail meat by removing the innards, using only the heads, and washing thoroughly.
cac_buoc: 1. Ingredients to prepare
1kg snails (choose the type of snail according to personal preference)
5 stalks of fresh lemongrass
Garlic
Fresh chili and chili powder
Young lime leaves
Seasonings including salt, fish sauce, cooking oil, sugar, and MSG.
2. Processing steps
Step 1: Selecting and preparing the snails
Select fresh snails according to your secret tips.
Prepare the snails thoroughly. If the snails have been kept overnight, soak them in a bucket or basin full of water and cover tightly to prevent them from crawling out.
Step 2: Preparing the ingredients
Wash the snails thoroughly after soaking, avoiding shaking them too hard so the meat doesn't break.
Wash the lemongrass and chili. For the lemongrass, use only the base, discard the tops, and bruise slightly.
Chop the chili into medium pieces and mince the garlic.
Step 3: Cooking the stir-fried snails with lemongrass and chili
Place 1 small tsp of cooking oil in a pan (a wok or curved-bottom pan is recommended). When the oil is hot, add the garlic, chili, and prepared lemongrass to the pan and stir well.
Stir-fry for about 1 minute until the garlic, chili, and lemongrass are fragrant, then add the snails to the pan and stir well.
Season with 1 tbsp salt, 3 tbsp sugar, and 1 tsp MSG. Stir-fry for about 12-15 minutes so the snails absorb the spices.
To prevent the lemongrass and chili from burning, do not stir-fry the snails for too long. If you have a large quantity of snails, divide them into separate batches.
Finally, sprinkle lime leaves over the snails to add more aroma and appeal. Your Central Vietnamese style stir-fried snails with lemongrass and chili are complete.
II. Other types of snails and ways to stir-fry with lemongrass and chili
1. How to make stir-fried apple snails with lemongrass and chili
1.1. Prepare ingredients
300g apple snail meat (shells removed)
3 stalks of lemongrass
1/2 horn chili
2 cloves of garlic
3g ginger
2g lime leaves (about 3 leaves)
1/2 tsp turmeric powder
1.2. How to process
1.2.2. Prepare ingredients
Prepare the apple snail meat by removing the innards, using only the heads, and washing thoroughly.
Wash the snail meat with salt water mixed with a bit of crushed ginger and white wine to clean and reduce the fishy smell.
Bruise and mince the lemongrass, garlic, and horn chili.
Cut the lime leaves and ginger into thin strips.
1.2.3. Marinating the snails
Marinate the apple snails with 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp seasoning powder, 1/2 tsp ground pepper, 1 tbsp fish sauce, and 1/2 tbsp turmeric powder.
Mix well and marinate for about 10 minutes.
1.2.4. Processing
First, sauté the lemongrass in 1 tbsp of oil until it turns golden, then add the garlic and sauté together for about 30 seconds.
Add the snails to the pan and stir-fry for about 5 minutes, then season to taste.
Reduce the heat and continue to stir-fry until the snails firm up, then add the chili and lime leaves, toss well, and turn off the heat before serving.
1.2.5. Finished product
The plate of stir-fried snails will have attractive colors combined with the light aroma of lemongrass and lime leaves, creating a special appeal.

When enjoying, you will immediately feel the chewiness of the snails, the sweet and slightly spicy taste, which is especially delicious when paired with rice. Don't hesitate to enjoy it, as this is a dish that makes you crave more rice!
2. How to make stir-fried jumping snails with lemongrass and chili

Jumping snails belong to the large and medium sea snail family in the Stromboidea superfamily, commonly found in many coastal areas of Vietnam. With rich nutritional content, jumping snails become the source material for many delicious and unique dishes, most notably stir-fried jumping snails with lemongrass and chili.

Stir-fried jumping snails with lemongrass and chili is a perfect combination of crunchy, sweet, and fatty snail meat with the characteristic aroma of lemongrass. To enhance the flavor, you can add green chili salt when enjoying this dish.
3. How to make stir-fried mud creepers with lemongrass and chili

Mud creepers, a species of sea snail in the Potamididae family, usually live naturally in mangrove forests or on coastal mudflats. They are known as a precious specialty with high nutritional value. Among the dishes made from mud creepers, stir-fried mud creepers with lemongrass and chili is one of the most popular.

Stir-fried mud creepers with lemongrass and chili will bring a stimulating spicy flavor combined with the chewy and sweet-crunchy texture of the snail meat. When enjoying, you can pair these snails with ginger fish sauce or green chili salt to create an irresistible flavor.
III. How to make dipping sauce for stir-fried snails with lemongrass and chili

To create a delicious and attractive flavor for snail dishes, the dipping sauce often plays an important role. Most snail dishes are enjoyed with ginger fish sauce. However, each region has its own recipe for ginger fish sauce, carrying the local characteristic flavor. Here is how to prepare Central Vietnamese style ginger fish sauce to eat with snails:
Ingredients:
Fish sauce
Chili, garlic, ginger, lemongrass, lime leaves, lime
Boiled water, cooled
Vinegar, sugar
How to make:

Step 1: Wash the chili, ginger, lemongrass, and lime leaves. Thinly slice the lime leaves and squeeze 2 tbsp of juice from the lime. Mince the chili, lemongrass, and garlic. Then, finely grind the ginger, chili, garlic, and lemongrass.

Step 2: In a bowl, mix 2 tbsp fish sauce, 3 tbsp sugar, ½ tbsp vinegar, and 2 tbsp cooled boiled water. Stir well and add the minced lemongrass, garlic, and chili. Finally, add 2 tbsp lime juice and the lime leaves, mixing well to complete this delicious ginger fish sauce.
IV. Notes when making stir-fried snails with lemongrass and chili
To execute the stir-fried snails with lemongrass and chili perfectly, you need to pay attention to some important points in choosing and processing this attractive dish:
The freshness of the snails directly affects the flavor of the dish. Choosing fresh snails will keep the meat crunchy and chewy at just the right level.
The cleaning process for the snails must be done thoroughly. If the mucus and dirt are not completely removed, the dish will not be truly delicious.
You can adjust the spiciness of the dish to suit your family's taste.

When stir-frying the snails, it should take about 12-15 minutes. This helps avoid making the snails too tough and also ensures that ingredients like lemongrass do not burn, thereby preserving the natural flavor of the dish.

mon_an.mo_ta: Mozzarella sticks are a snack that children and teenagers alike love to eat. With one bite, the stretchy cheese pulls into long strands, offering a fragrant, crispy, and unique flavor. However, eating them at street stalls may not guarantee hygiene. Therefore, this daily cooking guide will show you how to make rich and crispy Mozzarella sticks right at home! This article provides detailed instructions on ingredients and the process of making Mozzarella sticks. Through simple and easy-to-follow steps, you can enjoy this unique dish in your own family space.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Cut the Mozzarella cheese

Use a knife to cut the Mozzarella cheese into sticks of moderate thickness, about 1 to 2cm. You can cut along the length or width of the Mozzarella block as you prefer. The ideal length for a cheese stick is about the length of a pinky finger.
Step 2: Prepare the coating
Pick the parsley leaves, remove any wilted ones, and wash them thoroughly with water. Let the parsley drain and then mince it finely. Wash the peppercorns and grind them into a powder.
Next, whisk 2 eggs in a bowl, then add a bit of ground pepper and whisk well until the mixture is fully combined.

Prepare two separate bowls: one containing breadcrumbs and one containing all-purpose flour. Next, add the minced parsley to both bowls of flour/crumbs and mix well. You can add a pinch of salt and pepper to the flour to enhance the flavor.
Step 3: Coat the cheese

Once the coating is prepared, dredge each cheese stick through the flour, then the egg mixture, and finally the breadcrumbs. To ensure an even coating, use your hands to roll each stick so the breading adheres firmly and covers the entire surface of the cheese.

After coating, place all the cheese sticks in the freezer for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Then, take them out and repeat the coating process once more. Although it takes extra time, this ensures the cheese is crispy, delicious, and won't leak out during cooking.
After the second coating, put the cheese sticks back into the freezer. Wait for about 1.5 to 2 hours before taking them out to use.
Step 4: Fry the cheese
Place a pan on the stove and pour in enough oil; heat until the oil is hot. Then, add the cheese sticks to the pan and fry in the hot oil for about 3-4 minutes until the crust is golden brown.
Once fried, remove the cheese from the pan and place them on a plate lined with paper towels to drain. Now, you have finished making delicious cheese sticks just like at the shops!
Step 5: Finished product
The fried cheese sticks make a wonderful snack with a crispy, fragrant, and rich taste. This is an excellent choice to enjoy and share with friends during happy conversations.
Tips for better Mozzarella sticks
To achieve an even golden color and crispiness, ensure you use enough oil to completely submerge the cheese sticks.
To prevent the cheese from melting and leaking while frying, you should place them in the freezer for 1-2 hours before starting the frying process.

During frying, use high heat and place 2-3 pieces of cheese in the pan at a time to ensure you can remove them promptly. Low heat can cause the oil to soak in or the cheese to leak before the crust browns.
Notes when making Mozzarella sticks
Type of cheese: Choose high-quality Mozzarella cheese with high elasticity and a rich flavor. This helps the sticks stay crispy on the outside and soft on the inside after frying.
Cutting the cheese: Cut the cheese into sticks of relatively uniform thickness and length to ensure they cook evenly and avoid burning the outside while the inside is not yet hot.

Flour and eggs: Prepare the flour, eggs, and breadcrumb mixture. Before dredging the cheese through the layers, ensure the cheese sticks are dry and not moist. This helps the coating stick firmly to the cheese and creates a crispy crust after frying.

Frying process: Use cooking oil at a high temperature to fry the cheese quickly and achieve a beautiful golden color. Ensure the oil is hot before dropping the cheese into the pan. Avoid frying for too long; it only takes about 2-3 minutes for each stick to turn golden brown.
Cooling time: After frying, let the cheese sticks cool for a few minutes on paper towels to remove excess oil. This helps keep the cheese crispy and prevents the outer shell from softening.
Enjoy immediately: Mozzarella sticks are freshest and crispiest when enjoyed right after frying. Therefore, eat them as soon as possible to enjoy their wonderful flavor.

mon_an.ten: Northern-Style Spicy and Sour Frog Hotpot
mon_an.mo_ta: The hotpot broth is fragrant with lemongrass and shiitake mushrooms, combined with the sour and sweet taste of frog meat. You can sit with friends, sipping on this frog hotpot while chatting during these cold winter days. Check out the authentic Northern-style spicy and sour frog hotpot recipe below. You will find the recipe and detailed steps to create a rich, spicy, and attractive frog hotpot with true Northern flavors.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Minced garlic, minced chili, minced lemongrass - 2 tsp each
Sawtooth herb, rice paddy herb, scallions - 50 gr each
Water spinach stems, river leaves, shredded banana blossom, bean sprouts, scallion heads, bird's eye chili - side vegetables
cac_buoc: 1. Instructions for Northern-Style Spicy and Sour Frog Hotpot

Step 1: Clean the frog meat, keep the skin on, and marinate with a bit of salt, pepper, chili, and minced lemongrass; leave for 15 minutes to absorb the flavors. Next, dredge the frog in a thin layer of crispy frying flour. Fry the frog in a pan with plenty of oil until golden and crispy, then remove and drain on paper towels.

Step 2: Scrape the skin off the tamarind, wash it, and place it in a pot with a bowl of water for about 20 minutes. Then, strain through a sieve to get the tamarind juice. Cut the tomatoes into wedges. Finely chop the rice paddy herb and sawtooth herb.

Step 3: Sauté the minced garlic, chili, and lemongrass until fragrant, then pour in the pork broth, tamarind juice, and tomatoes; cook over medium heat. When the broth boils, season with sugar, fish sauce, and seasoning powder to taste. Next, add the sawtooth herb, rice paddy herb, scallion heads, and bird's eye chili; simmer for about two more minutes.
Step 4: Arrange the crispy fried frog on a plate, serve with vermicelli, vegetables, and chili fish sauce on the side.
Quick tip: After cleaning the frog's innards, rub it thoroughly with rock salt and minced chili, then rinse under plenty of water to remove slime and the fishy odor!

Spicy and sour frog hotpot has a unique, stimulating flavor with a blend of sour and spicy notes. When enjoying this hotpot, you can pair it with vegetables like shredded water spinach, okra, etc. To ensure the frog doesn't fall apart and stays tender, keep the hotpot at a low simmer throughout the meal. When eating, you can add the frog, tofu, and piper sarmentosum leaves into the pot in batches to avoid overcooking and losing the crispiness.
2. Frog Hotpot with Piper Sarmentosum Leaves (Lá Lốt)
1. Ingredients
Frog meat: 600g
Tofu: 2 blocks
Fresh bamboo shoots: 300g
Tofu skin: 100g
Piper sarmentosum leaves (lá lốt): 100g
Tomatoes: 2
Lemongrass: 2 stalks
Minced shallots: 1 tbsp
Minced garlic: 1 tbsp
Chicken broth: 1.5 liters
Fresh turmeric water: 2 tbsp
Seasoning: 10g (salt, fish sauce, MSG, rice vinegar, ...)
2. Processing the leaves
2.1. Prepare the ingredients
Lemongrass: Smash and cut into 5cm lengths.
Tofu: Cut into 6 small cubes.
Tomatoes: Cut into wedges.
Piper sarmentosum leaves: Remove the tough stems, then chop as desired.
Sawtooth herb and scallions: Cut into 1.5cm lengths.
Bamboo shoots: Slice and boil for 20-30 minutes to remove toxins and reduce bitterness.
Frog meat: Chop into bite-sized pieces.
2.2. Marinate the frog
Mix the frog meat thoroughly with 2 tbsp of fresh turmeric water and 1 tbsp of salt, then marinate for 5-10 minutes.
2.3. Stir-fry the frog
First, sauté 1 tsp of minced shallots and minced garlic with 1 tbsp of oil until fragrant.
When the aromatics are fragrant, add the frog meat and stir-fry.

After stir-frying the frog for 1 minute, add the boiled bamboo shoots, 1 tsp of seasoning powder, 1 tbsp of fish sauce, and 1 tbsp of sate sauce. Stir the mixture well until the frog meat firms up, then add the sawtooth herb and scallions, stir briefly, and turn off the heat.
2.4. Cook the hotpot broth
Sauté the remaining lemongrass, shallots, and garlic with 2 tbsp of oil until fragrant.
Once fragrant, add the tomatoes and stir until they soften.
Next, add the chicken broth, 1 tbsp of seasoning powder, 1 tsp of MSG, 1 tbsp of sugar, and 3 tbsp of vinegar. Adjust the seasoning to your taste and wait for the water to boil.
How to choose fresh frog meat

Instead of choosing farmed frogs, you should buy wild field frogs because farmed frog meat often contains more water, is mushy, and has a bland taste. Meanwhile, wild field frog meat is firm, chewy, and sweeter.
To choose a good frog, look for these characteristics: bright eyes, slender head, muscular appearance, patterned skin that is bright yellow or black, and a white or yellowish belly.
Select frogs that are large and plump, as skinny ones have little meat and many bones.
If using pre-processed frog meat, choose pieces that are still pinkish, elastic, not mushy, and have no off-odor.

mon_an.mo_ta: Duck hotpot is a favorite dish for many families; with simple ingredients, you can prepare any dish from duck. Enjoying a hot, spicy, and attractive duck hotpot with the whole family is wonderful. Follow this detailed spicy duck hotpot recipe below.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning: 1 tsp pepper; 1 tbsp sugar; 1 tsp seasoning powder; 1 tbsp fish sauce
A few chilies, various side vegetables for dipping.
cac_buoc: Wash the pickled mustard greens and squeeze them dry. Mince the fresh ginger and rub it all over the duck, then rinse with water and chop into bite-sized pieces. Mince the garlic, shallots, and pepper.
Place the duck meat in a large bowl, marinate with garlic, shallots, pepper, and fermented bean curd for about 15–20 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Place a pan on the stove, heat the cooking oil, then sauté the minced shallots and garlic until fragrant. Add the pickled greens and stir-fry for about 3 minutes.

Next, add the duck meat and stir-fry until firm. Pour in about 4 bowls of cold water and cook over medium heat until the duck is tender. You can adjust the seasoning to your taste and then turn off the heat.
Transfer the hotpot to a portable burner, place it on the dining table, and serve with vegetables and vermicelli. You have now completed the simple homemade spicy duck hotpot.

mon_an.ten: Vietnamese Savory Dog Meat Stew (Rượu Mận)
mon_an.mo_ta: Dog meat is a favorite for many, especially men. With the chilly winter weather, it's great to enjoy dishes made from dog meat. Show off your skills with this super delicious Rượu Mận recipe to invite the whole family to enjoy. ### Nutritional value of Rượu Mận Nutritional value of the Rượu Mận dish.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Shrimp paste, fermented rice (mẻ), MSG, seasonings
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients

Wash the galangal and scrape the skin; peel 1-2 outer layers of the lemongrass. Next, finely chop the lemongrass and galangal, then place them in a mortar to pound or use a blender to mince them. Slice the dog meat into bite-sized pieces, then set aside for marinating.
Step 2: Marinate the meat

Marinate the dog meat with the galangal, lemongrass, and seasonings to taste, adjusting the saltiness as you would for daily cooking. The meat should be evenly mixed with galangal, lemongrass, salt, MSG, shrimp paste, and a tablespoon of fermented rice. Let the meat marinate for about 30 minutes so the spices penetrate the meat.
Step 3: Cook the meat

Place the marinated dog meat into a pot (using a clay pot will make the meat softer and more delicious), cook over low heat and stir well. When the pot boils, add a little white wine and simmer for about 30 minutes. Before turning off the heat, you can add a little dog blood to the pot and simmer for another 3-5 minutes.
Step 4: Complete the delicious Rượu Mận
After turning off the heat, wait until mealtime and then turn the stove back on to reheat the meat. The meat will have a better aroma and be more tender if cooked twice.
How to enjoy and preserve Rượu Mận
After finishing the Rượu Mận dog meat dish, to ensure the best flavor and quality, you need to know how to serve and store it properly.

1. Ways to eat Rượu Mận: Some popular variations include stir-frying Rượu Mận with water spinach, shiitake mushrooms, or grilling Rượu Mận with soy sauce. When preparing dishes from Rượu Mận, be careful to maintain the characteristic flavor of the dish.
2. How to preserve Rượu Mận to maintain flavor and quality
To keep the flavor and quality of Rượu Mận, note the storage: You should store Rượu Mận in the refrigerator, placed in a zip bag or airtight container to avoid losing its aroma and flavor.

mon_an.mo_ta: During the end-of-year occasions and Tet holidays, families often organize year-end parties and gatherings to enjoy traditional Tet dishes. Sweet and sour pickled papaya is a simple, quick dish that brings an interesting experience to the palate. Today, we will share how to make crunchy sweet and sour pickled papaya, creating a special attraction for your party. Instructions for making delicious crispy sweet and sour pickled papaya at home. Pickled papaya is a simple, quick dish that brings an interesting experience to the palate.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
To prepare the papaya, first, peel it with a knife, then wash it and cut the papaya in half. Use a spoon to scrape out the seeds and pulp inside.
Next, prepare a basin of water and dissolve one tablespoon of rock salt in it. Place the papaya in the basin and wash it, then remove and place it in a basket to drain.

Next, prepare another basin of clean water and dissolve two tablespoons of rock salt. Use a peeler to shred the papaya into small strips and put them into the basin. Mix well and soak for about 5 minutes, then rinse again with clean water. Remove and let drain in a basket.
Peel the carrot, wash it, and use a peeler to shred it into small strips. Let the carrot drain.
Finally, slice the garlic and chili into thin pieces.
Step 2: Prepare the sweet and sour liquid

In a pot, mix 1 liter of vinegar with 400g of sugar and stir until the sugar is completely dissolved. Next, add 2 tablespoons of rock salt and 110ml of fish sauce to the pot. Bring to a boil and ensure the sugar and salt are completely dissolved. Then, let this mixture cool.
Once cooled, prepare a glass jar and place the papaya and carrot inside. Add the chili and garlic to the jar. Then, pour the cooled fish sauce mixture into the jar.
Use a heavy object to press the papaya down and ensure that the papaya is completely submerged in the liquid.
Place the papaya jar in the refrigerator and let it sit for at least one day before using.
Step 3: Enjoy

After one day, when you open the papaya jar, you will smell the characteristic aroma of garlic, papaya, and chili, combined with the distinct scent of fish sauce. These aromas make you want to eat immediately. When enjoying, you will feel the saltiness from the fish sauce combined with the spiciness of the chili, along with the crunchiness of the papaya.

Eating sweet and sour pickled papaya with fried or grilled dishes is very delicious. Besides helping to prevent greasiness, this dish also provides fiber and vitamins for the body. The meal becomes more refreshing and easier to digest.
How to choose crunchy papaya

To choose papaya, select fruits with an elongated shape and a yellow skin with small green spots. Usually, papayas with a very shiny, smooth skin are those treated with chemicals and do not ripen naturally.
To check for crispiness, when held, the papaya should feel firm, full-fleshed, and hard. The stem should still be fresh and have sap flowing.
To make the dish look attractive, choose papayas that are just beginning to ripen. The flesh will have an attractive reddish-pink color while still maintaining its crunchiness.
Additionally, avoid buying papaya on rainy days or during the rainy season, as papaya in this weather is often not as sweet or delicious as expected.
How to preserve pickled papaya
After being placed in a glass jar, the sweet and sour pickled papaya can be stored in the refrigerator for about 1 month.

If you do not want to store the pickled papaya in the refrigerator, during the preparation process, after shredding and soaking in salt water, rinse and sun-dry the papaya strips so they become firm and preserve better. For the finished pickled papaya, keep it in a cool place away from direct sunlight. This helps preserve the papaya for about 2 weeks.
When eating, use clean chopsticks to take the papaya out of the jar. Avoid using chopsticks that have been used to eat other food, as this can cause the pickled papaya to spoil easily.

mon_an.ten: Pan-Seared Chicken Thighs with Teriyaki Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: This weekend, try making Japanese-style pan-seared chicken thighs with teriyaki sauce for the whole family to enjoy!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 100ml Kikkoman soy sauce (available at supermarkets, made from soybeans, wheat, and salt)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the seasonings; wash the chicken thighs and remove the bones.
Step 2: Marinate the chicken with 1 tablespoon of cornstarch.

Step 3: Place a pan on the stove and add 2 tablespoons of cooking oil. When the oil is hot, sauté the garlic and ginger until fragrant. Then, add the chicken thighs and fry until both sides are golden brown.
Step 4: Once the chicken is evenly golden, add all the remaining ingredients.
Step 5: Cook on high heat for a few minutes, then lower the heat to a gentle simmer.
Step 6: When the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened slightly, adjust the seasoning to taste, turn off the heat, and remove the pan from the stove.
Serve the teriyaki chicken thighs on a plate. This dish is very delicious when eaten with hot rice.

mon_an.mo_ta: Beef salad with pickled eggplant is a simple yet very attractive and palate-stimulating dish. With the characteristic flavor of beef combined with the crunchiness of pickled eggplant and the distinct aroma of various herbs, the dish becomes even more appealing. Let's learn how to make this attractive dish together!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Lemongrass, calamansi, chili, garlic, pineapple - as needed
Various fresh herbs (perilla, fish mint,...) - as needed
cac_buoc: Make the dressing: Mince the pineapple, lemongrass, garlic, and chili; add 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tbsp fish sauce, and the juice of 3-4 calamansi to create a sweet, sour, salty, and spicy mixture that fits your taste.

Process the beef: Slice the beef into bite-sized pieces, marinate with seasonings and oyster sauce for 30 minutes, then stir-fry in a pan. Afterward, put it in a bowl and add a little dressing to mix and let it absorb. Note: marinate slightly bland because more dressing will be added later.
Pickled eggplant: Slice into bite-sized pieces.
Fresh herbs: Wash the fish mint and perilla, cut into bite-sized pieces, place in a large bowl and mix with the remaining dressing, add sliced calamansi and sliced lemongrass, then toss well.
Place the herbs on a plate, arrange the meat and eggplant on top, and decorate with sliced calamansi.

mon_an.ten: Refreshing Shrimp and Bean Sprout Salad
mon_an.mo_ta: The meal will be even more delicious with this unique shrimp and bean sprout salad, which pairs well with many dishes. Don't hesitate to make this dish right away!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 2 tbsp white vinegar, ½ tsp sugar
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the shrimp, remove the heads, peel the shells, and marinate the shrimp with a little seasoning powder and pepper.
Step 2: Place a pan on the stove, sauté minced shallots with a little cooking oil, then add the shrimp and stir-fry until just cooked.

Step 3: Wash the bean sprouts. Peel and wash the carrot and bell pepper, then julienne them. Soak them in diluted salt water, then remove. Blanch them quickly in boiling water, then immediately soak them in a bowl of cold water.
Step 4: Place the vegetables into a clean bowl, add a little pepper, white vinegar, salt, and a little cooking oil, then toss everything together.
Step 5: Finally, add a little chopped cilantro and the shrimp, then mix well.
Step 6: Serve the shrimp and bean sprout salad on a plate and enjoy.
Shrimp and bean sprout salad is a quick dish but very attractive and full of nutrition.

mon_an.ten: Duck Hotpot with Dracontomelon (Vịt Om Sấu)
mon_an.mo_ta: Gathering with the whole family around a fragrant and rich pot of duck hotpot with dracontomelon is wonderful. Go buy the ingredients and start now! Refer to our recipe for the best Hanoi-style duck hotpot with dracontomelon in the article below. Discover the best way to cook duck hotpot with dracontomelon in Hanoi. Detailed instructions on the recipe, ingredients, and steps. Enjoy the characteristic flavor of duck hotpot with dracontomelon in the capital city of Hanoi.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Tofu skin, sate sauce - as needed
Shiitake mushrooms, enoki mushrooms - as needed
cac_buoc: 1. How to cook the best Hanoi-style duck hotpot with dracontomelon
Step 1: Clean the duck and chop into bite-sized pieces.
Step 2: Peel the outer layer of the lemongrass and slice diagonally; julienne the ginger. Wash the dracontomelon. Peel the carrot and taro and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Step 3: Marinate the duck meat with 1 tsp seasoning powder, minced shallots, lemongrass, and minced ginger. Marinate for about 30 minutes to let the duck absorb the flavors.

Step 4: Sauté minced shallots with oil, add the lemongrass and stir-fry, then add the duck meat and sear briefly. Season with a bit of good fish sauce and stir until the meat firms up. Stir the duck quickly over high heat so the meat doesn't become tough. Add a little seasoning to taste.
Step 5: Prepare some bone broth and pour it into the pot with the stir-fried duck (if you don't have bone broth, just pour in 2 large bowls of water and simmer over low heat).
Step 6: Wash various vegetables and soak them in diluted salt water. Then remove and drain.

Step 7: Now you just need to place the duck hotpot in the middle, with tofu, dipping vegetables, and vermicelli on the side. When the hotpot boils, add the mushrooms, taro, carrot, and quail balut; simmer over low heat and invite the whole family to enjoy.
2. How to cook duck hotpot with dracontomelon in an electric pressure cooker
Ingredients to prepare
1 duck (about 1.2 kg), cleaned.
7 dracontomelon fruits.
200 g various side vegetables.
100 g shiitake mushrooms.
100 g enoki mushrooms.
1 taro (medium size).
2 pieces of tofu skin.
3 tsp sate sauce.
1 carrot.
13 quail balut eggs.
2 stalks of lemongrass.
2 blocks of tofu.
1 kg rice vermicelli.
Prepare the ingredients
Clean the duck meat by rinsing with salt water and draining, then chop into bite-sized pieces.
Peel the outer layer of the lemongrass and slice diagonally, julienne the ginger, and mince the garlic and shallots. Wash the dracontomelon and let drain.
Peel the carrot and taro, then cut into bite-sized pieces.
Marinate the duck meat with 1 tsp seasoning powder, minced shallots, lemongrass, garlic, and minced ginger. Let marinate for about 30 minutes to let the duck absorb the seasonings.
Wash the vegetables and soak in diluted salt water. Then, remove and drain.
Cook the duck hotpot

Place a pot on the stove and heat it. Sauté minced shallots in oil, then add the lemongrass and stir-fry until fragrant. Next, add the duck meat and stir-fry quickly until the meat changes color. Season with a bit of good fish sauce and stir until the meat firms up. Stir quickly over high heat so the meat doesn't become tough. Season to taste.

Prepare some bone broth and bring to a boil in the pot. Add a piece of white radish and scallion roots to the broth to make the hotpot sweeter and clearer. Then, remove the radish and pour the stir-fried duck into the pot. Season to your taste.

On the dining table, place the duck hotpot in the middle, with tofu, dipping vegetables, and vermicelli on the side. When the hotpot boils, you can add the mushrooms, taro, carrot, and quail balut into the pot, then simmer over low heat and invite the whole family to enjoy immediately. The hotpot carries the aroma of lemongrass, a hint of dracontomelon, and a rich flavor.
Wishing you and your family a delicious meal with this fragrant duck hotpot with dracontomelon!
Notes on choosing and preparing duck
When buying duck, choose those that have just been slaughtered, with yellow skin that is not too dark or blotchy.
To check the quality, use your hand to press the duck meat. If the meat feels elastic and firm, it is a good choice.
Avoid choosing ducks with many bruises on the skin, mushy meat, or an unusual foul odor.
Effective ways to deodorize duck meat:
Use rock salt to rub all over the duck's body, then rinse. Next, use a mixture of wine and sliced ginger to rub and massage the duck, then rinse several times with water and drain.
Another way to deodorize is to use a mixture of salt, lemon, or vinegar to rub all over the duck, then rinse and drain.

mon_an.ten: Easy Chili Salt Grilled Chicken Wings
mon_an.mo_ta: Chili salt grilled chicken wings are both delicious and easy to make; prepare them to enjoy this weekend!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 1 tbsp fish sauce; a pinch of salt
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the chicken wings with vinegar and salt, chop into 3 pieces. Mince the shallots and garlic.
Step 2: Place the chicken wings in a bowl with all the above seasonings, mix well, and marinate for at least 30 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Step 3: Preheat the oven to 200°C, arrange the chicken wings on a baking tray, and place them in the preheated oven.

Step 4: Every 10 minutes, flip the chicken wings and continue grilling while brushing the remaining sauce mixture onto the wings. The total grilling time is about 40-50 minutes or until the wings are evenly golden brown.
Remove the chili salt grilled chicken wings and enjoy immediately while hot.
Wishing you and your family a delicious meal with this appetizing garlic and chili grilled chicken wing recipe!

mon_an.mo_ta: With just a few simple steps, you can make these fresh and delicious lettuce meat wraps that everyone will love.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 1 piece of lean pork belly (about 1 kg)
Fresh rice vermicelli, lettuce, shredded carrots, assorted herbs, sliced cucumber, chives (blanched briefly in boiling water).

Dipping Sauce: 2 heaping tbsp hoisin sauce; 1 tbsp peanut butter; 1 minced chili; 1 clove minced garlic; 1 minced shallot; 1 tbsp crushed roasted peanuts; 100-140ml water; 1 tsp sugar; 1/3 tsp seasoning powder.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Place a pan on the stove, add 1 tbsp oil, and wait until hot. Sauté the shallot and garlic until fragrant. Add the hoisin sauce and stir-fry for 1 minute. Next, add the peanut butter and stir well. Finally, pour in the water and seasonings, stirring together. Bring to a boil, adjust the seasoning to taste, and turn off the heat.

Step 2: Wash the pork belly and scrape the skin clean. Bring a pot of water to a boil and parboil the pork for 5 minutes. Remove and rinse the meat. Refill the pot with water, vinegar, salt, lemongrass, shallots, and the pork. Cook over medium heat for about 45-50 minutes.

Note: Cooking time depends on whether the meat is in a large block or smaller pieces. Do not overcook the meat or it will lose its texture. Once cooked, remove the meat and soak it in an ice bath for 2 minutes before slicing.
Step 3: Once the meat has cooled, slice it into thin pieces.
Step 4: Lay a lettuce leaf on a plate, then layer the pork, herbs, cucumber, a bit of vermicelli, and carrots. Gently roll it up. Use a chive leaf to tie the middle to secure it.
Arrange the lettuce wraps on a plate and serve with the peanut hoisin dipping sauce.

mon_an.mo_ta: Bún thịt nướng is a familiar street food favorite. In summer, enjoy it with tangy dipping sauce and crunchy pickled vegetables; in winter, pair it with hot grilled pork and a slightly sweet sauce. It is delicious and very easy to make. This recipe will help you make Bún thịt nướng at home that tastes even better than the roadside stalls with just a little bit of skill. Discover how to make this dish in the article below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Lettuce, basil, parsley, culantro - 150 g fresh herbs for serving
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the meat and soak it in diluted salt water for 10 minutes to firm up the texture. Slice the pork belly into large but very thin pieces. Finely mince the pork shoulder.

Peel the tough outer layers of the lemongrass, wash, and slice thinly. Grind the lemongrass in a blender or mortar, mix with 50ml of filtered water, and use a cloth to squeeze out the lemongrass juice.
Peel and mince the onion.

Step 2: Prepare the marinade: Mix 3 tsp seasoning powder, 3 tsp sugar, and 3 tsp MSG. Add 1 tbsp fish sauce. Divide the marinade into two equal parts. Mix one part with the minced meat and let it marinate for 30 minutes.

Mix the remaining marinade with the lemongrass juice and minced shallots. Wear plastic gloves and rub this mixture onto both sides of the thin pork shoulder slices. The longer the meat marinates, the better the flavor will be.

Peel the carrots and papaya, then slice into flowers or shred. Soak them in cold water or diluted sugar water to keep them crunchy. Drain and mix with sugar, vinegar, salt, lime, and chili. Prepare these vegetables last so they don't release too much water.

Step 3: Grilling: Before grilling, squeeze 1/2 tbsp lime juice into the meat to enhance the aroma and help it char better. Mix well, arrange the pork shoulder slices on a grill rack, and grill until golden on both sides. Shape the minced meat into ping-pong-sized balls, flatten slightly, and grill. Once cooked, transfer the meat to a plate.
Step 4: Prepare the dipping sauce: Mix 2 parts fish sauce, 1 part lime juice, and 1.5 parts sugar. Dissolve the ingredients together, then add minced chili and garlic. Adjust to your taste.
Arrange the vermicelli, grilled meat, and washed herbs with a bowl of dipping sauce for each serving. When eating, dip the meat and vermicelli into the sauce and enjoy with the fresh herbs.

mon_an.mo_ta: With these fragrant fried fish cakes served with a signature tamarind dipping sauce, your whole family is sure to be impressed!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the fish, steam until cooked, then use a spoon to mash it finely.
Step 2: Place the fish in a bowl and add 2 tbsp crispy frying flour, 1 egg yolk, chopped scallions, a bit of pepper, and a bit of seasoning powder. Mix the ingredients thoroughly.
Step 3: Shape the fish into small balls and fry until golden and crispy.
Step 4: Remove the fish cakes and place them on a plate lined with paper towels to drain excess oil.

Step 5: Making the tamarind sauce: Prepare 2 tbsp tamarind juice (dissolve tamarind powder in a little water, simmer, and strain). Add 1 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 wedge of cheese (mash the cheese before adding), 2 tbsp fish sauce, and 2 tbsp sugar. Bring the mixture to a boil. Dissolve a little tapioca starch in water and pour it into the pot, stirring until the sauce thickens slightly. (Adjust the quantities to your preference). Pour into a small bowl and add chili if you like it spicy.
Now, simply dip the crispy fish cakes into the tamarind sauce and enjoy.
Enjoy your meal with these flavorful fried fish cakes and savory tamarind sauce!

mon_an.ten: Spicy and Sour Chicken Hot Pot
mon_an.mo_ta: If you enjoy a hot pot with a special healthy flavor, you might choose chicken with medicinal herbs or 'Lẩu gà lá giang'. But if you want a balance of mild sweet and sour with a hint of spice, go for Spicy and Sour Chicken Hot Pot. This is truly a delicious dish for cold winter days that brings everyone closer together! Follow our recipe below to make this dish.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Banana blossom, dill, mustard greens, water spinach - for serving
Salt, seasoning powder, fish sauce, black pepper, sugar, chili sauce - for seasoning
cac_buoc: Wash the chicken with diluted salt water and chop into bite-sized pieces.
Blanch the chicken bones in boiling water, then place them in a pot to simmer for the broth. Simmer for about 1 hour.
Bruise the lemongrass and cut into sections. Wash all the hot pot vegetables and let them drain.
Wash and wedge the tomatoes.
Peel the taro, cut in half, and steam until cooked.
Wash the straw mushrooms and soak them briefly.
Arrange the mustard greens, bitter herbs, banana blossom, water spinach, and tomatoes on a plate.

Place a pot on the stove, sauté the garlic and bruised lemongrass with a little oil, then add the canned tomatoes and stir-fry. Add chili sauce, galangal, and chopped onion, stirring well. Add the chicken and sauté until firm, then add the straw mushrooms.
Finally, pour in the chicken broth and season with fish sauce, lime juice, sugar, salt, and seasoning powder to taste. Once the hot pot boils, dip the vegetables in and enjoy hot.
Enjoy this meal with your family!

mon_an.ten: Sweet and Spicy Stir-fried Star Fruit (Ô mai khế)
mon_an.mo_ta: This stir-fried star fruit snack is sour, spicy, and fragrant with ginger. Each chewy piece is perfect when paired with a cup of green tea. This simple 5-step recipe will help you create this wonderful traditional treat.
cac_buoc: Let's learn how to make Sweet and Spicy Stir-fried Star Fruit:

Step 1: Dissolve the slaked lime in a basin of cold water. Stir well, let it settle for 15 minutes, and collect the clear lime water. Wash and finely crush the ginger. Wash the star fruit and soak in diluted salt water.
Step 2: Remove the star fruit, slice vertically into sections, and drain. Soak in the clear lime water for 6-7 consecutive hours.
Step 3: After soaking, remove the star fruit, rinse thoroughly with clean water, and drain. Marinate the star fruit with sugar for 2-3 hours.
Step 4: Place the star fruit and the dissolved sugar water into a pot. Simmer over low heat for 15-20 minutes. When the mixture turns an amber color, add the ginger.
Step 5: Continue simmering until the mixture becomes thick and chewy, then turn off the heat. Arrange on a rack to drain any excess syrup.
Your Sweet and Spicy Stir-fried Star Fruit snack is now complete.

mon_an.mo_ta: A delicious and easy-to-make chicken dish that will keep you coming back for more!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Place the chicken breast in a plastic food bag and use a meat mallet to pound it until tender and about 1.5cm thick.
Step 2:
Wash the mushrooms and finely mince them in a food processor. Meanwhile, heat a pan, add butter until melted, then add the mushrooms and sauté for 3 minutes.
Next, add the minced garlic to the mushrooms and sauté for another 10 minutes. Turn off the heat and season with a little salt and pepper to taste.
Step 3:
On each piece of chicken breast, place about 15-30g of cheese, then layer the mushrooms on top of the cheese.
Step 4:
Roll the chicken tightly and secure with toothpicks.
Step 5:
Preheat the oven to 200°C. Meanwhile, heat a pan with a little oil and sear the chicken for 3-4 minutes until golden. Then, transfer the chicken to the oven and bake for another 15 minutes.
Finally, remove the chicken, let it cool slightly, remove the toothpicks, and slice into thin pieces. Garnish with chopped parsley and serve.
Doesn't it look fresh and delicious?
The sweetness of the chicken blends perfectly with the aroma of the mushrooms, making it irresistible.
Sprinkle some chopped parsley to make the plate more vibrant.
This dish is both nutritious and incredibly unique!

mon_an.mo_ta: Pineapple is sweet and sour, has neutral properties, and helps with thirst, digestion, and bowel movements. It is often used for anemia, mineral deficiency, indigestion, and arthritis. Beef is rich in iron, which helps supplement blood and prevent anemia. The combination of these two foods creates a highly nutritious Beef Shank Stew with Pineapple!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the beef and cut into cubes.
Cut the tomatoes into wedges.
Slice the pineapple into fan shapes.
Marinate the pineapple with 1 tbsp sugar to reduce the acidity.
Step 2: Place the beef, 2 stalks of lemongrass, 3 cloves of garlic, and a few slices of ginger into a pot. Add enough water to cover.
Bring the mixture to a boil for 10 minutes. Remove the meat and set aside; keep the cooking liquid in a bowl.
Sauté minced garlic in oil until golden and fragrant, then add the parboiled beef and stir-fry. Add the pineapple and stir-fry together, seasoning with a little fish sauce.
After stir-frying for 2-3 minutes, pour in the reserved cooking liquid.
Cover and simmer over medium heat for 15-20 minutes. Add the tomatoes and season to taste. Let the stew boil for another 5 minutes, then add scallions and cilantro before turning off the heat.
Final Result:

The Beef Shank Stew with Pineapple will have a sweet and sour taste from the pineapple and tomatoes, savory fish sauce, tender beef, and the aroma of lemongrass and ginger. It pairs perfectly with rice.

mon_an.mo_ta: Sweet cabbage leaves wrapped around a mixture of meat, wood ear mushrooms, and crunchy glass noodles, steamed and then simmered in tomato sauce. This savory and attractive dish is a must-have for your family's daily menu.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, sugar, pepper, shallots, seasoning powder, scallions, and garlic - for seasoning
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the cabbage, separate the leaves, and use a knife to trim down the thick center ribs.
Wash the scallions and let them drain.
Step 2: Soak the wood ear mushrooms until soft, then trim the stems and mince. Soak the glass noodles until soft and chop finely.
In a bowl, mix the minced pork with the wood ear mushrooms, glass noodles, a small tsp of salt, a bit of pepper, and minced shallots. Marinate for 15 minutes.
Step 3: Bring a pot of water to a boil, blanch the scallions briefly, then plunge them into cold water.
Boil the cabbage leaves for about 3 minutes until they are slightly softened.
Step 4: Use a spoon to place a portion of the meat mixture onto a cabbage leaf.
Fold the edges and roll tightly. Use a blanched scallion leaf to tie it secure. Repeat until all meat and cabbage are used.
Place the cabbage rolls in a steamer and steam for 5 to 8 minutes.
Step 5: Puree the tomatoes. Heat a little oil, sauté the garlic until fragrant, then add the tomatoes and stir-fry. Season with a little sugar and salt.

Place the steamed cabbage rolls into the tomato sauce and simmer over low heat. Adjust the seasoning to taste. Simmer until the sauce thickens, then transfer to a plate. Sprinkle with pepper and chopped scallions. Serve with rice.
Enjoy your meal!

mon_an.ten: Cabbage Rolls with Shrimp and Pork in Tomato Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: Cabbage rolls with shrimp and pork – an easy-to-make dish that is sweet from both the vegetables and the seafood. Here is how to make it.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the cabbage and blanch it in boiling water until soft. Be sure to trim the thick center rib of the leaves to make them easier to roll!
Step 2: Peel and devein the shrimp. Marinate the minced pork with a little salt, pepper, and minced shallots.

Step 3: Place the shrimp and meat in the center of a cabbage leaf and roll tightly. If you are worried about them unrolling, you can use blanched scallion leaves to tie them or secure them with toothpicks. If using toothpicks, remember to remove them before eating!
Step 4: Sauté the tomatoes until soft and season to taste. Arrange the cabbage rolls in the pan and simmer until the meat is fully cooked.

mon_an.mo_ta: Is gaining weight as hard as you think? Changing your daily palate with eye-catching, fragrant, and nutritious dishes is a way to help you gain weight quickly. Add these attractive honey-glazed ribs to your menu today!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the ribs and drain. Marinate the ribs with honey, soy sauce, and lime juice for 20 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Step 2: Place the ribs on a baking tray and bake in the oven at 180°C for about 10 minutes.
Step 3: The ribs are cooked but not yet golden. Turn on the top broiler for another 3 minutes. The meat will turn a very appetizing color.

Step 4: Wash and peel the potatoes. Cut into 8 wedges and soak in cold water with a little salt. Drain the potatoes, place them in a bowl, cover loosely with a paper towel, and microwave for 5 minutes.
Step 5: The potatoes should be just tender. Place them in a pan with 1 tbsp oil and fry until golden on both sides. Remove and place on paper towels to drain.
Step 6: Transfer the ribs to a plate, serve with the salad and potatoes, and sprinkle with a little pepper for aroma.

mon_an.mo_ta: Although called "fried," these crispy zucchini slices are actually baked in the oven. With this recipe, you can make oil-free "breaded" snacks from various vegetables that will appeal to every family member, including children who are usually picky about eating greens. Try this delicious, attractive, and healthy dish for yourself right now.
cac_buoc: Preheat the oven to 170°C.
Wash the zucchini, remove the seeds, and cut into finger-sized sticks.
Mix the salt and pepper thoroughly with the breadcrumbs; crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk well; place the flour on a separate plate.
Dredge the zucchini sticks evenly in flour, dip them into the egg wash, then coat them with breadcrumbs until evenly covered.
Arrange the breaded zucchini on a baking tray and bake for about 20-25 minutes.
The zucchini is ready when it turns an even golden brown.
Remove to a plate and serve hot. You can dip them in mayonnaise to enhance the flavor.

Using this method, you can make not only delicious breaded zucchini but also snacks from almost any vegetable like yardlong beans, cauliflower, eggplant, sweet potatoes, potatoes, or any other vegetable you like.

mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried pumpkin with garlic is exceptionally nutritious, helps reduce headaches, and features the wonderful aroma of sautéed garlic and pumpkin. Check out this delicious recipe for stir-fried pumpkin with garlic below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning - Salt, pepper, fish sauce, seasoning powder
Green onion, washed and finely chopped - 1 stalk
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the pumpkin, peel it, remove the seeds, and cut into bite-sized pieces. To cook the pumpkin quickly, you should slice it somewhat thinly.
Step 2: Peel and crush the garlic. To save time, you can crush the cloves before peeling; the skin will come off much faster.
Step 3: Sauté the garlic in a medium-thick bottomed pot until fragrant. Once the garlic is aromatic, add the pumpkin to stir-fry. This ensures the dish is flavorful and well-infused with garlic.
Step 4: After adding the pumpkin, season with salt, fish sauce, and seasoning powder. Stir-fry briefly to let the flavors absorb, then pour in a little water to prevent burning.
Step 5: Cook until the pumpkin is soft. Turn off the heat, then sprinkle green onions and black pepper on top!

mon_an.ten: Tips for Making Bánh Cuốn from Rice Paper
mon_an.mo_ta: Bánh cuốn is a beloved traditional dish in Vietnamese cuisine. Today, we will share a simple way to make bánh cuốn without using flour batter, saving time while still producing delicious and easy-to-eat rolls using rice paper.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning - Seasoning powder, fish sauce, black pepper
cac_buoc: Step 1: The Filling
Use pre-ground pork or grind your own from pork shoulder.
Soak the wood ear mushrooms until soft, trim the stems, wash, and mince. Mince the onion, shallots, and green onions as well.

Sauté the minced shallots until fragrant, then add the pork and stir-fry until firm. Next, add the wood ear mushrooms, onion, and a bit of seasoning powder and fish sauce for flavor. Stir-fry until the meat is cooked, then add green onions and black pepper. Stir well and set aside.
Step 2: The Wrapper
In a large bowl of water, add cooking oil according to the ratio in the ingredients section.

Submerge each sheet of rice paper into the water one by one. Do not drop many sheets at once to prevent them from sticking together. It is best to do 3 sheets at a time so they are easy to retrieve and don't get too soft.

Submerge the rice paper and wait until it becomes soft and slightly translucent. Then, wear gloves and gently lift the paper out. Note that a soaking time of about 1-2 minutes is enough; do not leave them too long as they may become mushy and tear easily.
Step 3: Rolling and Steaming
Spread the rice paper onto a tray that has been lightly greased with oil, then sprinkle the filling on top and roll it up. Arrange the rolls on a plate and continue until you have the desired amount.
Finally, place the rolls in a steamer and steam for about 5 minutes to cook through, keeping them moist and smooth. If you don't want to steam, you can microwave them for a few seconds.
Step 4: Making the Dipping Sauce
You can mix the dipping sauce directly according to the ratio in the ingredients and use it immediately. However, this guide will show you how to boil the sauce step-by-step:
