Mix water, fish sauce, sugar, and vinegar in a pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, reduce to low heat, and adjust the taste to your preference.

Turn off the heat, add minced garlic, chili, and a bit of black pepper. The dipping sauce is now complete. Note: if you don't have vinegar and use lime instead, let the sauce cool before squeezing the lime to avoid bitterness. Conversely, if using vinegar, you can add it from the start and boil it.
Step 5: Enjoy

When eating, sprinkle fried shallots over the dipping sauce to enhance the aroma. You can also sprinkle fried shallots directly onto the rolls and serve with Vietnamese ham (chả or giò) and fresh cilantro to complete the dish.
Note: To keep the rolls soft and prevent them from sticking together after rolling, you can brush a layer of scallion oil on the outside.
Tips for making delicious bánh cuốn from rice paper:
Choose quality rice paper: Select fresh, smooth rice paper without tears. Good rice paper makes rolling easier and more beautiful.
Prepare filling and seasoning: The filling can be ground meat, shrimp, mushrooms, or vegetables as desired. Mince ingredients like onions, shallots, garlic, green onions, and pepper to add flavor.

Careful rolling: Spread the rice paper on a tray and brush with scallion oil. Place the filling in the center and roll neatly. Roll slowly and gently to avoid tearing. Roll firmly but not too tight to maintain softness.
Steam for the right time: Place the rolls in the steamer for 5-7 minutes. Check after steaming; if they are cooked and smooth, they can be removed.
Adjust dipping sauce to taste: Mix the sauce according to personal preference using fish sauce, sugar, lime, garlic, chili, and pepper. Season until it suits your palate.
Serve with garnishes: When eating, sprinkle fried shallots, green onions, and fresh herbs like sawtooth coriander and bean sprouts to increase flavor and enjoyment.
Skill and patience: Making bánh cuốn requires skill and patience. Practice to improve your rolling technique and ensure the rolls are delicious and attractive.
Timing: When making bánh cuốn, dedicate enough time to each step. Do not rush to ensure the rolls are made meticulously and with quality.

mon_an.mo_ta: Zucchini is a nutrient-rich vegetable that is very good for your health. Dishes made from zucchini, though simple, are incredibly delicious due to the natural sweetness of this vegetable. This stuffed zucchini dish, besides the wonderful taste of fresh vegetables and meat, is also visually appealing, making your family meal more attractive!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the zucchini, cut into segments about two finger-joints long, then use a spoon to scoop out a portion of the core.
Step 2: Soak the dried shrimp until soft, wash, and grind finely with the pork, ginger, and white parts of the green onions. Mix this mixture with diced bamboo shoots and 1 tsp of cornstarch.
Step 3: Next, dissolve the soy sauce, rice wine, and sugar with 1 tsp of cornstarch.
Mix half of this soy sauce mixture into the meat; keep the other half for the sauce.
Step 4: Sprinkle a little cornstarch over the zucchini pieces.
Step 5: Stuff the meat mixture into the zucchini and steam until cooked (Do not pack too tightly, or the meat won't be tender and may become dry and heavy).
Step 6: When the zucchini is cooked, remove to a plate.

Bring the chicken stock to a boil, stir in the remaining half of the sauce mixture, add oyster sauce and a bit of cornstarch, then simmer until the sauce thickens slightly. Season to taste and add a bit of pepper if desired.
Finely chop the green onions, sprinkle over the zucchini, pour the prepared sauce on top, and serve hot.

mon_an.ten: Tips for a More Attractive Sour Baby Clam Soup
mon_an.mo_ta: The harmonious combination of the sourness of starfruit, the sweetness of baby clams, and the aroma of Vietnamese coriander will make this sour clam soup even better; your whole family will love it.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the clams thoroughly upon purchase, then soak them in a large bowl of water. You can add 2 chopped chilies to help the clams release grit more effectively.
Step 2: Put the clams in a pot and boil. When the water boils, turn down the heat, add a little salt, and use chopsticks to stir well so the clam meat separates from the shells.
Step 3: Pour the clams into a colander. Let the boiling water settle, then pour off the clear broth into a separate container and discard the sediment.
Step 4: Place the boiled clams in a basket and rinse in a large bowl of water to collect the meat. Wash the meat clean and drain.

Step 5: Wash and wedge the tomatoes. Trim the roots and old stems of the green onions and Vietnamese coriander, then wash. Wash the starfruit, trim the edges, and slice. Peel, wash, and thinly slice the shallot.

Step 6: Place a pot on the stove and add a tablespoon of oil. When the oil is hot, sauté the shallot until fragrant, then add the clam meat and a bit of seasoning. Stir-fry until firm, then remove to a separate bowl.

Step 7: Add another tablespoon of oil and sauté half of the tomatoes until soft. Add the clam broth and bring to a boil. Once boiling, add the remaining tomatoes and starfruit. Cook for another 2 minutes, then add the sautéed clam meat and season to taste.
Turn off the heat, stir in the chopped green onions and Vietnamese coriander, and serve the soup in a large bowl.

mon_an.ten: Irresistible Tofu with Shrimp and Tomato Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: The rich flavor of tomato sauce blends with every fiber of the shrimp meat, along with soft pieces of tofu. Tofu with shrimp and tomato sauce is a perfect dish for a delicious family meal!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, pat the tofu dry. Wash the shrimp, peel them, and cut into small pieces. Wash and finely chop the green onions.
Step 2:
Marinate the shrimp with salt and pepper.
Step 3:
Cut the tofu into cubes.
Mix the tomato sauce, soy sauce, and chili powder together to prepare for cooking.
Step 4:
Heat a little oil in a pan, add the shrimp, stir-fry until just cooked, then remove.
Step 5:
Add the tofu and the sauce mixture to the pan. Stir gently so the tofu is well-coated in the sauce.
Step 6:
Add the shrimp back in, stir well, and simmer for a bit longer until the sauce thickens and absorbs into the tofu. Sprinkle with green onions and turn off the heat.
This tofu dish is very flavorful and tastes great with hot rice!
Slightly spicy and rich in flavor, this tofu with shrimp and tomato sauce will surely be a hit!
If you like it spicy, you can add more chili to the sauce!

mon_an.ten: How to Make Delicious Honey Soy Roasted Chicken Wings
mon_an.mo_ta: Let's prepare these delicious honey soy roasted chicken wings to treat the whole family. The process is very simple; follow these steps for super tasty honey soy roasted chicken wings! Enjoy this dish at home with an easy method. It makes a great party snack when inviting friends over.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Apple wine - 2 tbsp (or sake, or good white wine)
cac_buoc: 1. Ingredient Preparation
Chicken wings:
Take 500g of chicken wings and wash them under cold water.
Use a paper towel or cloth to pat the wings dry to remove excess water.
Sauce:
In a small bowl, mix 3-4 spoons of yogurt (or fish sauce), 2 spoons of olive oil, 2 spoons of soy sauce, 2-3 spoons of honey, and 1 spoon of lemon juice.
Add 2-3 cloves of minced garlic, 1/2 spoon of pepper, and 1/2 spoon of chili powder.
If desired, add salt to taste. Remember that soy sauce and fish sauce already contain salt, so check the flavor before adding more.
Marinate the wings:
Place the wings in a large bowl.
Pour the prepared sauce over the wings.
Mix well, ensuring every piece is evenly coated.
If time permits, let the wings marinate for at least 1 hour to let the flavors penetrate. Otherwise, you can roast them immediately.
Herbs and lemon:
Prepare herbs like cilantro, Vietnamese coriander, or cabbage leaves for garnish and freshness.
Slice a lemon thinly for garnish and for squeezing over the wings before eating.
2. Execution Steps
Prepare the sauce: In a small bowl, mix the yogurt (or fish sauce), olive oil, soy sauce, honey, lemon juice, minced garlic, pepper, chili powder, and salt. Stir until well combined.
Marinate the wings: In a large bowl, place the wings and pour the sauce over them. Mix well to ensure even coating.
Note: If time permits, marinate for at least 1 hour.
Prepare the grill: Turn the heat to medium and prepare the grill. If you don't have a grill, you can use an oven.

Roast the wings: Place the wings on the grill or in the oven and cook for about 15-20 minutes, or until they turn golden brown and are cooked through. Note: Flip the wings regularly to ensure even cooking on both sides.
Presentation: Once the wings are cooked and have an attractive color, arrange them on a plate and garnish with herbs and lemon slices.
Enjoy: The honey soy roasted chicken wings are ready. You can serve them as an appetizer or with white rice and fresh vegetables.
Tips for the best honey soy roasted chicken wings:
When making this dish, keep these points in mind for the best results:
Choose fresh wings: Ensure you buy fresh, high-quality wings for the best flavor and safety.
Marinate evenly: Ensure the wings are well-marinated beforehand. If possible, soak them for at least 1 hour or longer.
Choose the right temperature: Use medium heat. This helps the wings cook through without burning or drying out.
Flip frequently: While roasting, flip the wings often to ensure even color and flavor on all sides.
Check for doneness: Check by looking for a beautiful golden-brown color and using a skewer to pierce the meat. If the juices run clear, the wings are done.

mon_an.ten: Secrets to Crispy Green Rice Spring Rolls
mon_an.mo_ta: Green rice spring rolls (chả giò cốm) are perfect for weekend meals or family parties! The dish is not too complicated to make, and you can easily treat your whole family to this!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Chili sauce, dark soy sauce, seasoning powder
cac_buoc: Step 1: Sauté the filling

Heat a pan with a little oil and sauté the minced shallots and garlic until fragrant. Add the roasted duck and stir-fry until hot, seasoning with 1 tbsp of dark soy sauce and 1 tbsp of seasoning powder.
Finally, add the peanut butter to make the filling more flavorful. Remove from heat and let cool.
Step 2: Rolling
Mash the sticky rice and roll it out into thin sheets.
Place a layer of steamed green rice flakes on top, then add the filling. Roll it up and pinch the two ends closed.
Finally, dredge the roll through tapioca starch, then the beaten egg, and finally the breadcrumbs. Drop into a pan of oil.
Fry until golden brown.
Step 3: Presentation
Decorate a plate with tomatoes, cilantro, and salad greens, then arrange the spring rolls on top.
Serve this dish with chili sauce.

mon_an.ten: Secrets to Delicious Braised Tofu with Egg
mon_an.mo_ta: Braised tofu with egg is a simple dish, easy to prepare from the ingredients to the cooking process. You can easily treat your family to this as its flavor pairs perfectly with white rice.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Mix the soy sauce, sugar, and water in a bowl, stirring until the sugar dissolves.
Step 2:
Wash the tofu and cut into small pieces. Then, pour the egg yolk into a plate and whisk until smooth. Dip each piece of tofu into the egg yolk.
Step 3:

Place a pan on the stove, heat the oil, and fry the tofu until golden brown on both sides. Pour the soy sauce, water, and sugar mixture over the tofu. Bring to a boil so the seasoning absorbs into the tofu. Add green onions, simmer for a while, then remove and serve.
Step 4:
The perfect braised tofu with egg will have an attractive golden color. Transfer the tofu to a plate and enjoy while it is still hot!
It is exceptionally delicious when eaten with hot rice.

mon_an.ten: Secrets to Crispy Fried Chicken with Ginger Soy Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: If you don't have plans for this weekend's family meal, try going to the market for ingredients to make this fried chicken with ginger soy sauce. With these instructions, you will surely have a delicious dish that appeals to the whole family.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
To make the marinade: mix 1/2 tsp of grated ginger, 1 tbsp of dark soy sauce, and 1 tbsp of wine in a bowl.
Wash the chicken thighs, remove the bones, and cut into bite-sized pieces about 2-3 cm square.
Step 2:
Place the chicken in the ginger soy sauce and let it marinate for 5-10 minutes.
Remove the chicken to a colander (discard the marinade), let it drain, and use a clean towel to pat it dry.
Step 3:
Dredge the chicken through a layer of dry flour, then fry in hot oil until golden brown. Remove and drain the excess oil.
Place the chicken on a plate and garnish with boiled asparagus, tomatoes, and lettuce for an attractive look. This dish pairs best with ketchup.

mon_an.ten: Secrets to Rich and Flavorful Braised Fish with Galangal
mon_an.mo_ta: There is nothing better than enjoying a bowl of hot, fragrant braised fish with galangal and steamed white rice on a cold day like this!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the fish with water and rice wine to remove the fishy smell. Marinate the fish with a bit of seasoning to let it absorb the flavors.
Step 2: Wash the pork belly, slice into 2cm thick pieces, and marinate with a bit of seasoning.
Step 3: Wash and peel the galangal. Slice one half and finely grind the other half.

Step 4: Layer the galangal slices at the bottom of the pot. Arrange the fish on top, followed by the pork belly. Add a little water to the ground galangal, squeeze out the juice over the fish, then add the ground galangal pulp to the pot as well.
Step 5: Add seasonings including soy sauce, fish sauce, MSG, chilies, and caramel sauce to the fish, then place in an electric braising pot for about 30 minutes.
Step 6: When the fish is done, remove it to a plate along with the pork belly and galangal slices.
Enjoying this braised fish with hot rice is very delicious and makes for a satisfying meal.

mon_an.ten: How to Cook Authentic Northern-Style Red Tilapia Sour Soup
cac_buoc: Red tilapia sour soup is a popular dish loved by many families. To cook a delicious red tilapia sour soup, besides using fresh ingredients, you also need an accurate recipe. If you are passionate about this sour soup, prepare the ingredients and follow the instructions for cooking red tilapia sour soup below!
Instructions for Traditional Red Tilapia Sour Soup
1. Prepare ingredients
Red tilapia (1 fish)
Tomatoes (2 fruits)
Pineapple (1/4 fruit)
Bean sprouts (a handful)
Elephant ear stalks (1 stalk)
Okra (8 pieces)
Tamarind pulp (30g)
Sawtooth herb (4 sprigs)
Rice paddy herb (4 sprigs)
Shallot (1 bulb)
Fish sauce (1 tbsp)
Cooking oil (1 tbsp)
Common seasonings (a little: salt, pepper, sugar, broth powder)
2. Processing steps
2.1. Prepare ingredients
Wash the pineapple, shallots, and herbs, then finely chop.
Cut the tomatoes into wedges.
Wash the okra and slice diagonally.
Prepare the tamarind by mixing it with 100ml of hot water, then use a spoon to strain out the seeds.
Peel the elephant ear stalks by placing them in a bowl of diluted salt water, soak for about 5 minutes, and rinse with water. Then, cut into diagonal slices.
How to prepare elephant ear stalks without causing itching:
Wash the elephant ear stalks to remove mud and peel off the outer fibrous skin.
Use a knife to cut away the inner curved part of the stalk.
Cut the stalks into bite-sized diagonal pieces, toss with sea salt, and let sit for about 15 minutes.
Rinse the stalks in cold water, squeeze dry, then blanch in boiling water before cooking.
2.2. Prepare the red tilapia
Scale the fish, remove the fins, and gut it to remove the internal organs.
Wash the fish and rub salt onto the body for about 10 minutes, then rinse clean and cut into chunks about 2 fingers thick.
How to prepare red tilapia to remove the fishy smell:
First, clean the fish by scaling and carefully removing the entrails.
Clean off any blood clots and white membranes inside the fish's belly.
Rub sea salt on the fish for about 10 minutes and rinse with water. You can also soak the fish in diluted lemon juice with a little salt for 10 minutes before rinsing.
Using vinegar or white wine to wash the fish also helps effectively deodorize the fishy smell.
2.3. Boil the soup pot
Place a pot on the stove and add 1 tbsp of cooking oil. When the oil is hot, add the shallots and sauté until fragrant.

Pour 2 liters of water into the pot. When the water boils, add the fish and cook for about 8–10 minutes until the fish is cooked through. Then, add the tomatoes and tamarind juice, and cook for another 5 minutes.
Continue adding the elephant ear stalks and okra to the pot, cooking for 5 more minutes.

After 5 minutes, season the pot with 2 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp salt, 1 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tsp broth powder, and 1/3 tsp pepper. Adjust the seasoning to taste, then add the bean sprouts and herbs before turning off the heat.
2.4. Finished product

The red tilapia sour soup with its sweet and sour tamarind broth, perfectly cooked fish that is neither mushy nor fishy, combined with the attractive colors of pineapple, tomatoes, okra, and elephant ear stalks, served with fish sauce for dipping, promises to be a delicious and appealing meal that will surely satisfy your guests!
Instructions for Red Tilapia Soup with Sour Bamboo Shoots
1 red tilapia (1kg)
450g sour bamboo shoots
3 tomatoes
2 shallots
3 cloves garlic
100g dill, green onions, Vietnamese coriander
1 tbsp sugar, 1 tbsp fish sauce, MSG, seasoning salt, broth powder, and a pinch of ground pepper
2.1. Prepare the fish
Clean the fish, cut into chunks, rub with sea salt, rinse, and drain.
Marinate the fish with 1 tbsp broth powder, 1 tbsp fish sauce, and 1/3 tsp ground pepper. Mix well and let the fish absorb the seasonings for 15–20 minutes.
Prepare other ingredients:
Rinse the bamboo shoots to reduce acidity and drain.
Mince the shallots and garlic.
Wash the tomatoes and cut into wedges.
Wash and finely chop the dill, Vietnamese coriander, and green onions.
2.2. Pan-sear the fish
Heat a pan and add 3 tbsp of cooking oil. When the oil is hot, place the fish pieces in to pan-sear until the flesh firms up, then remove and set aside.
2.3. Cook the fish soup with sour bamboo shoots

Heat about 1 tbsp of oil in a pot. When the oil is hot, add the minced shallots and garlic and sauté until golden brown. Then, add 2/3 of the tomatoes along with the sour bamboo shoots and stir-fry for about 1 minute. Next, place the fish in, cover, and simmer for about 3 minutes.
After simmering, pour about 2.5 liters of water into the pot and boil for about 15 minutes. During the boiling process, skim off the foam to keep the broth clear.

After boiling for the required time, adjust the seasonings (MSG, seasoning salt, fish sauce) to suit your taste. Next, add the remaining tomatoes and cook for another 5 minutes. Finally, add the dill, Vietnamese coriander, and green onions, stir well, and turn off the heat to complete the dish.
How to choose fresh ingredients for red tilapia soup
1. How to choose fresh red tilapia
To make the menu more appealing, you should choose fresh red tilapia with clear eyes; when touched, it should feel shiny, the skin should be pink, and the scales should be firm and intact.

If the slime on the fish skin becomes sticky, the eyes are sunken and cloudy, the scales are easily detached, the skin is white or dark, the flesh is soft and lacks elasticity, or it even floats on the water, these are signs of stale fish and should not be purchased.
2. Buying elephant ear stalks for delicious fish soup
Choose fresh stalks with light green outer skin that is smooth, not rough or peeling.
You should choose stalks that are still whole and dry, avoid buying pre-cut ones, and stay away from stalks that are darkened or show signs of being crushed.

mon_an.ten: Secrets to Cooking Perfectly Flavorful Snakehead Fish Sour Soup
mon_an.mo_ta: Snakehead fish sour soup brings the signature flavors of the Mekong Delta, with the rich taste of snakehead fish, the tanginess of tamarind and pineapple, and the distinct aroma of sawtooth herb, all creating the deliciousness of this hometown dish.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Other herbs such as sawtooth herb, rice paddy herb, bean sprouts, red chili
cac_buoc: Required ingredients:
Step 1: Clean and prepare the vegetables: peel and cut the elephant ear stalks into sections; chop the okra. Cut the tomatoes into wedges. Slice the pineapple.
Step 2: Peel and mince the garlic and shallots. Place a large pot with cooking oil on the stove over medium heat, then sauté the garlic and shallots until fragrant.
Step 3: Add the snakehead fish, turning the pieces until the flesh becomes opaque.
Step 4: Pour in 1.2 liters of water along with the tamarind paste, okra, elephant ear stalks, rice paddy herb, sawtooth herb, and bean sprouts, and cook for about 10 minutes.
Step 5: Add the tomatoes and pineapple, and season with 40g salt, 30g sugar, and 40g broth powder. Cook for another 5 minutes then turn off the heat.
Step 6: Serve the *snakehead fish sour soup* in a bowl and eat with rice. You can add a little chili for a spicy kick.
Note:
Do not cook the soup for too long, as it will cause the fish meat to fall apart.
If you want a richer flavor, you can replace salt with fish sauce, but the broth will not be as clear and beautiful.
Wishing you and your family a delicious and appetizing meal with this snakehead fish sour soup recipe!

mon_an.ten: Secrets to Cooking Perfect Potato and Pork Rib Soup
mon_an.mo_ta: Potato and pork rib soup is a traditional, delicious, and appealing dish. To create a perfect bowl of soup, there are special secrets. Let's explore the secrets to making authentic potato and pork rib soup and enjoy this wonderful flavor! Discover the secrets to cooking perfect potato and pork rib soup. Select fresh ingredients, cook the ribs until tender and fragrant, and adjust the seasonings correctly to create a rich flavor. Enjoy this delicious and nutritious traditional soup at home.
cac_buoc: Step 1: After buying the ribs, wash them and let them drain. Boil water in a pot, then add a little salt and MSG to blanch the ribs, which helps remove impurities and prevents the bones from becoming dry.
Step 2: Rinse the blanched ribs and place them in a pot to sauté with seasoning salt, MSG, and pepper. Sauté for about 3-4 minutes so the ribs absorb the seasonings.

Step 3: Peel and wash the potatoes and carrots, then cut them into bite-sized pieces. For convenience, you should cut the potatoes and carrots into small squares to ensure they cook through and are easy to eat. Add the potatoes and carrots to the pot to sauté with the ribs.

Step 4: Sauté the minced shallots and garlic until fragrant, then add the ribs and potatoes at the same time and pour in enough water. When the water boils, keep the heat low so the potatoes and ribs become tender and evenly cooked. During the cooking process, skim off the foam to remove any odors from the bones.
Step 5: Simmer the ribs for about 30 minutes. During the simmering process, you can add more water if necessary to prevent the soup from becoming too salty or burning.
Step 6: After simmering, ladle the soup into a bowl and garnish with cilantro or other herbs according to your preference. Finally, you can enjoy this soup with your family.
Notes for cooking delicious potato and pork rib soup
When making perfect potato and pork rib soup, please keep the following in mind:
Choose fresh ingredients: Select fresh potatoes and ribs that are not spoiled to ensure the best flavor for the soup.
Prepare the ribs: Wash the ribs thoroughly before use. Blanch the ribs with salt and MSG to clean and remove impurities.
Process the ribs: Sauté the ribs with seasoning salt, MSG, and pepper so the ribs absorb the flavors and become more fragrant.
Prepare potatoes and carrots: Peel, wash, and cut potatoes and carrots into bite-sized pieces. Note to cut them into small squares for even cooking and ease of eating.

Cook the soup correctly: Sauté shallots and garlic, then add the ribs, potatoes, and carrots. Pour in enough water and simmer for about 30 minutes until the soup is tender and the flavors are well-blended.

Skim foam and check water: During the cooking process, skim off the foam to remove odors from the bones. Check the water level in the pot and add more if needed to avoid the soup being too salty or burning.
Garnish and enjoy: Ladle the soup into a bowl and garnish with cilantro or other herbs. Enjoy the soup hot with your family and savor the wonderful flavor.

mon_an.ten: Secrets to Cooking Delicious Porridge at Home
mon_an.mo_ta: Do you want to take better care of yourself and your family? Want your daily family meals to no longer be boring? Want to care for a sick person better but don't know how to cook delicious porridge? Today we will share with you some secrets for cooking delicious porridge at home—they are very useful!
cac_buoc: To make delicious porridge, you need to monitor the heat carefully, prevent overflow, and sometimes know how to cook porridge quickly.
How to cook porridge until tender and delicious:

When cooking porridge with mung beans mixed with rice, if you want the porridge to soften quickly, you just need to crush a little alum and add it in. This method will save a lot of time, fuel, and effort.
How to make white porridge more fragrant and appealing:

Many people think white porridge is always bland no matter how it's cooked, but in fact, white porridge has its own unique flavor. To make white porridge more fragrant, before turning off the stove, you should add a few slices of tangerine peel to the pot and then remove them; the porridge will have a much more seductive aroma.
How to prevent porridge from overflowing:

To limit the porridge from overflowing during cooking, besides monitoring for medium heat, you also need to note the timing of adding the rice. You should not add rice to cold water and then boil it, nor add it when the water is already boiling; instead, add it when the water temperature is between 50-60°C. You should also add a little salt to the rice when cooking.
How to cook porridge using a thermos:

This is a traditional method often used, especially when visiting sick people in the hospital where cooking conditions are unavailable. Simply wash a little rice (rice usually occupies 1/4 of the thermos), then pour boiling water into the thermos (do not fill it to the top to avoid overflowing when the rice expands), then close the lid and leave it for a few hours; the porridge will be tender and still hot. Then, just pour the porridge out and serve as usual.
How to cook porridge from leftover rice and still have it taste good:

Utilizing cooked rice to make porridge is also a way to save time. Note: before cooking, rinse the rice through cold water so the porridge won't be sticky or burn. The resulting porridge will be just as delicious as if cooked from raw rice!

mon_an.mo_ta: Refresh your family's menu with this high-energy, nutrient-rich crab soup—it is a fantastic idea for any meal!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Wash the crab and boil until cooked; reserve the cooking liquid to use as broth for the soup.
Soak the crab in cold water to cool quickly, then peel and pick out the meat.
Step 2:
Wash the asparagus, remove the tough ends, and cut diagonally into 2cm pieces.
Soak the wood ear mushrooms until soft, wash, and shred into thin strips. Whisk the egg, and dissolve the tapioca starch in 2 tbsp of water.
Step 3:
Bring the crab broth to a boil, then add the asparagus and wood ear mushrooms.
When the water returns to a boil, add the crab meat to cook together.
Step 4:
Next, add the whisked egg while stirring quickly and steadily to cook the egg evenly and create beautiful ribbons; once the soup boils again, pour in the tapioca starch slurry to thicken.
Season to taste, ladle into bowls, and serve hot.

This asparagus crab soup features the sweetness of crab meat, crab broth, and the very special sweetness of asparagus; your whole family is sure to love it, as it tastes even better and is higher quality than restaurant versions!
Enjoy your meal!

mon_an.ten: Simple and Delicious Stir-Fried Shrimp with Zucchini
mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried shrimp with zucchini is an extremely easy and time-saving dish that still provides full nutrition for the body. Discover our simple way to make this dish through the content below. Hopefully, this article will help you have a delicious dish to treat the whole family!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Peel and devein the shrimp, then drain; peel the zucchini, split in half, and slice into bite-sized pieces, but not too thin or they will become mushy when stir-fried.
Blanch the shrimp in boiling water and drain.
Step 2:
Heat a pan with a little oil, sauté the garlic until fragrant, then add the zucchini and stir-fry briefly, seasoning with a bit of seasoning powder.
Next, add the blanched shrimp and stir-fry, adjust the seasoning to taste, then turn off the heat and add pepper, tossing well to enhance the aroma and flavor of the dish.
Step 3:
Remove to a plate and serve hot with rice.

mon_an.ten: Savory and Fragrant Bò Kho with Coconut Water
mon_an.mo_ta: Beef stew with coconut water – A bowl of delicious beef rich in coconut flavor, complemented by the beautiful colors of carrots, is truly an attractive dish for your family meal. Let's discover how to make this appealing beef stew with coconut water!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, pepper, sugar, beef seasoning powder - seasoning
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the beef, cut into bite-sized squares, and marinate with: 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tbsp pepper, 1 tbsp salt, 1 tbsp minced shallots, 1 tbsp minced garlic, and the bò kho seasoning packet; let sit for 15 minutes to allow the beef to absorb the flavors.
Step 2: Carve the carrots into flower shapes and slice 1 cm thick.

Step 3: Sauté the minced shallots, chili, garlic, and lemongrass stalks until fragrant, then add the beef and stir-fry until firm; pour in the coconut water and simmer until tender, then season to taste.
Note: Bò kho with coconut water is usually served with bread and salt, pepper, and lime.
Enjoy your meal, everyone!

mon_an.ten: Stir-Fried Beef Balls with Bok Choy and Shiitake Mushrooms
mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried beef balls with bok choy and shiitake mushrooms is a delicious, easy-to-make dish featuring the sweet aroma of beef balls, the crunch of bok choy, and the flavor of shiitake mushrooms. Check out this recipe from Sổ Tay Nấu Ăn now!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Blanch the bok choy in boiling water to maintain its beautiful color. Remove, drain, and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Soak the shiitake mushrooms until expanded, then wash and trim the stems. Cut large mushrooms in half.
Peel and mince the garlic.

Step 2: Briefly boil the beef balls until cooked. If you prefer them more fragrant, you can lightly fry the beef balls and drain the oil; it will be very delicious. You can leave the beef balls whole or cut them small as desired. This completes the preparation for the Stir-fried beef balls with bok choy and shiitake mushrooms.
Step 3: Place a pan on the stove, add a little oil, and sauté the garlic until fragrant. Once the garlic is fragrant, add the shiitake mushrooms and stir-fry for about 5 minutes.
Step 4:
Add the bok choy along with about 1/2 tsp of seasoning powder and oyster sauce.
Then add the beef balls and adjust the seasoning to taste.
The stir-fried beef balls with bok choy and shiitake mushrooms dish is now complete; serve hot with rice.

mon_an.mo_ta: A little twist in preparation with familiar ingredients like pumpkin blossoms, pork, shrimp, and wood ear mushrooms will bring you a very interesting dish of fried stuffed pumpkin blossoms! Check out how to make this dish through the article below!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Finely chop and mince the lean pork. Mince the shrimp and finely chop the wood ear mushrooms. Season with a little seasoning powder, sugar, and salt, then mix well to absorb the flavors.
Step 2: Add the egg to the above mixture and mix until very smooth.
Step 3: Drain the pumpkin blossoms well, then stuff the meat mixture into each blossom.
Step 4: Next, add oil to a pan; when the oil is hot, add the pumpkin blossoms and fry until golden brown.

Step 5: Crispy fried pumpkin blossoms are a quite unique variation. The savory taste of the meat mixed with the sweetness of the blossoms and the spiciness of chili sauce will surely be a delicious and exotic dish for you.
Note: If you want it extra crispy, you can add a coating of batter on the outside before frying.

mon_an.ten: Broccoli and Cauliflower in Coconut Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: Not only is broccoli rich in fiber, but coconut is also a very healthy fruit. Combining these two ingredients creates a delicious broccoli and cauliflower dish in coconut sauce. Let's try making it for the whole family!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the broccoli and cauliflower, drain, and cut into bite-sized pieces. Marinate with minced leek, seasoning powder, soy sauce, and pepper. Toss well and let sit for 10 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Step 2: Put the crispy frying flour into a bowl and mix with a little water.

Step 3: Heat the oil, then reduce to low heat. Dip each piece of broccoli and cauliflower into the batter and drop into the hot oil. Fry until golden brown. Then, remove the broccoli and cauliflower and place them on a plate lined with paper towels.

Step 4: Place another pan on the stove, add the coconut milk, and simmer over low heat until thickened. Add the fried broccoli and cauliflower to the coconut sauce, cook briefly, then turn off the heat.

mon_an.mo_ta: If you want a dish that is rich in fiber and protein, don't miss this Shredded Chicken and Broccoli Salad! This dish is appealing not only for the sweetness of the broccoli but also for the savory shredded chicken and vibrant colors. Don't hesitate to spend a little time on this delicious recipe!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Cut the broccoli into bite-sized pieces and soak briefly in diluted salt water to clean. Blanch the broccoli in boiling water, then plunge into cold water to keep it crunchy.
Step 2: Steam the chicken until cooked, let cool, and shred. Peel the carrot, trim into decorative shapes, and slice. Peel the onion, thinly slice, and toss with salt and the carrots.
Step 3: String the green beans and cut into sections; blanch in hot water, then immediately soak in cold water to preserve the green color.
Step 4: Dressing: Whisk together the mustard, vinegar, sugar, pepper, seasoning powder, and a little cooking oil.
Step 5: Place the broccoli, carrots, green beans, onions, microgreens, and shredded chicken in a large bowl. Add the dressing and toss well for about 3 minutes before serving.

mon_an.mo_ta: Broccoli is a cancer-fighting superfood that is refreshing, easy to eat, and simple to prepare. In just 15 minutes, you can have a delicious "Stir-fried Broccoli with Shrimp" dish for the whole family. Check out the recipe below!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the shrimp, peel, remove the heads, and devein. Marinate with a bit of minced shallots, pepper, and seasoning powder for about 5 minutes to absorb the flavors.

Step 2: Cut the broccoli into bite-sized florets, then wash and drain. Peel the carrot, wash, slice thinly, and carve into flower shapes if desired. Peel and thinly slice the onion. Cut the celery and green onions into sections.
Step 3: Heat oil in a pan and sauté the garlic until fragrant. Add the shrimp and stir-fry until golden and firm, then remove to a plate.

Step 4: Using the same pan, add a little more oil and heat it up. Sauté the minced shallots, then add the broccoli and carrots. When the vegetables are almost cooked, add the sautéed shrimp and onions, stirring well. Season with a bit of seasoning powder and pepper. Finally, add the celery and green onions, toss well, and serve on a plate.
This is an easy-to-eat, light dish that helps refresh your palate while providing essential vitamins and calcium. Good luck and enjoy your meal!

mon_an.mo_ta: Rustic Bún Chả – a familiar and incredibly delicious dish with rich, savory flavors. How to make rustic Bún Chả.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Meat marinade: 2 tbsp honey, 1/2 tsp pepper, 2 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tsp salt
Rice vermicelli, shredded water spinach, Vietnamese balm, perilla, lettuce, culantro for serving
cac_buoc: Step 1: Crush the white parts of the green onions, finely slice the shallots, and mince the lemongrass. Transfer the meat to a large bowl, add the prepared onions and lemongrass, add the marinade mixture, mix well, and cover tightly for 5 - 6 hours to let the meat marinate.

Step 2: Peel the carrot and green papaya, wash, and slice into bite-sized pieces. Marinate with a pinch of salt for 10 minutes, then squeeze out the water and soak in sugar and vinegar for a balanced sweet and sour taste. Mix the dipping sauce with the ratio: 1 fish sauce, 1 sugar, 1 vinegar, and 5 water, along with minced garlic and chili.
Step 3: Wash the herbs; soak the shredded water spinach in ice water with a little salt to prevent browning to serve with the rustic Bún Chả.

Step 4: Use a spoon to scoop some meat mixture into your hand, flatten it, and clamp the meat between bamboo chopsticks. Grill the meat over charcoal or in an electric oven until golden brown. When serving, add some green papaya and carrots into the dipping sauce bowl with the grilled pork, and serve with fresh herbs and rice vermicelli.

mon_an.mo_ta: Hue-style Bún Hến – a rustic dish from the poetic land of Hue. Bún Hến is a signature dish of Central Vietnam, not only evoking delicious flavors but also carrying the deep culinary culture of Hue. In this guide, we will explore how to make authentic and delicious Hue Bún Hến! Learn how to make Hue Bún Hến with a flavorful broth. Discover the characteristic taste of Central Vietnam in this cultural culinary dish.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Thai basil, banana blossom, shredded water spinach, shredded banana stalk, taro stem
Roasted sesame seeds, crispy fried pork rinds
Hue fermented shrimp paste - 1 small bowl
cac_buoc: Step 1: Preparing the ingredients

Cooking Hue Bún Hến requires many stages. First, if the clams are still in their shells, wash and boil them. Then, separate the meat into a bowl. Boil the clams with ginger and lemongrass to bring out a wonderful aroma. Next, mix the clam meat with salt and vinegar, massage gently to remove grit and sand, rinse again with clean water, and drain.

For pre-processed clam meat, rinse it with clean water. Next, marinate the clam meat with fish sauce, seasoning powder, pepper, and onions, then stir well. To let the spices penetrate the meat, you should wait for about 10 minutes.

Additionally, to make the Hue Bún Hến even more delicious, pay attention to other ingredients like pork rinds and shrimp crackers. They need to be fried. Cucumbers should be washed, peeled, and sliced thinly. Blanch the vermicelli in boiling water. Roast the peanuts until golden brown. Wash the bean sprouts and blanch them in boiling water. Finally, pick the herbs to garnish the dish for a fresh look.
Step 2: Stir-frying the clams

Once the clam meat has absorbed the seasonings, proceed to stir-fry by adding cooking oil to a pan and sautéing minced garlic and onions. Then, add the clam meat to the pan and stir-fry thoroughly. Add 2 tbsp of sate or annatto oil and continue to stir. When the mixture is fragrant and the clam meat turns golden, add green onions and turn off the heat. You can take the liquid from boiling the clams, bring it to a boil, and season to taste to serve as a side broth.
Step 3: Making the delicious dipping sauce for Bún Hến
Hue fermented shrimp paste is the key factor that creates the rich and signature flavor of Hue noodles. You can use the paste pure or mix it with hot boiling water.
To make the sweet fish sauce, dissolve sugar and fish sauce in boiling water. Then, add thinly sliced garlic and fresh chili.
Next, sauté garlic and onion in oil until fragrant, then add chili paste and stir well.
Seasonings for the clam broth can include salt and seasoning powder.
Step 4: Finishing the Hue Bún Hến

The final step is to complete the Hue Bún Hến dish. Start by placing the vermicelli in a bowl, then add bean sprouts and herbs on top. Next, add the clam meat and sprinkle with roasted peanuts. Pour in the fermented shrimp paste sauce and mix well. This is an authentic bowl of Bún Hến with a simple cooking method.

When you take your first bite of Bún Hến, you will taste the sweet aroma of the clam meat and the fermented shrimp paste blending together, providing a delicious sensation. The secret is to serve it with pork rinds or shrimp crackers to enhance the flavor of the Hue noodle bowl.
Secrets to making delicious, authentic Hue-style Bún Hến

To create a perfect bowl of Bún Hến, besides the cooking method mentioned above, you need to know how to choose fresh clams. When touching the shells, live clams will feel heavy, have tightly closed shells, and no foul odor. Choose those clams and discard any that are dead or smell bad. Avoid choosing clams with crushed or broken shells as mud and sand can seep inside, making it difficult to clean the meat. Limit buying frozen clams and try to buy fresh ones from the market.

A useful tip to help you clean the clams is to soak them in rice water. Then, add a few drops of rice vinegar or chili and soak for 3 to 4 hours. During this time, the clams will purge all the mud. When separating the clam meat, once the water boils, you can use chopsticks to stir a few times so the meat floats to the top, making it easier to collect.
Above are the shared tips on how to cook authentic Hue-style Bún Hến. Now, you can try cooking this wonderful dish and enjoy it right away!

Although authentic Hue-style Bún Hến may seem difficult, it is actually quite easy to cook. With the support of electric noodle cookers like those provided by Nguyen Khoi, we are certain that your cooking process will become much lighter and faster.

mon_an.mo_ta: New-style Spring Roll Noodle Bowl – a unique twist on a classic. This dish is also known as chả giò in Southern Vietnam. Learn how to make this delicious version using rice paper (pastry style) instead of the traditional dried rice paper used in basic spring roll recipes.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Green onions, cilantro, salt, fish sauce, seasoning powder, black pepper
Sweet and sour dipping fish sauce, roasted peanuts
Rice paper (also known as pía pastry crust, available in supermarkets)
cac_buoc: The ingredients are enough for 50 spring rolls; consider adjusting the quantities to suit your meal!
Step 1: Prepare the ingredients:
Peel the carrots, potatoes, and sweet potatoes; wash and soak them in salt water to prevent browning, then drain.
Peel the jicama, wash, and drain.
Shred the carrots, potatoes, sweet potatoes, and jicama into thin strips.
Step 2:
Wash each Napa cabbage leaf, slice thinly, and drain thoroughly. Trim the green onions and cilantro, remove any wilted leaves and roots, wash, and chop finely.
Soak the glass noodles until soft, then cut into short pieces.

Step 3: Mix the ground pork, glass noodles, and eggs with the vegetables prepared in the previous steps. Season with 1 tsp seasoning powder, 2 tbsp fish sauce, and black pepper, then mix well to combine.

Step 4: Spread a sheet of rice paper on a cutting board and fold one corner up into a triangle (if you cannot find this specific pastry crust, you can use regular dried rice paper). Place a small amount of filling onto the paper and roll tightly.
Step 5: Continue rolling until all the filling is used.
Step 6: Place a pan on the stove and pour in enough oil to submerge the spring rolls. When the oil is hot, slowly drop the rolls in and fry until golden brown.
While frying the spring rolls, wash the lettuce, soak in salt water, and drain. Peel the cucumber and shred into strips.

Step 7: Prepare the sweet and sour dipping sauce to your taste. Arrange the rice vermicelli, lettuce, and cucumber in a bowl. Pour in the dipping sauce and top with the sliced spring rolls to enjoy your delicious meal.
Source: Ngoi sao

mon_an.ten: Shrimp and Crab Rice Noodle Soup
mon_an.mo_ta: Shrimp and Crab Rice Noodle Soup – an attractive and delicious dish for family weekends. Learn how to cook this flavorful Bún riêu cua tôm.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Lettuce, Vietnamese balm (kinh giới), bean sprouts, 4 tomatoes
cac_buoc: Step 1: Simmer the pork ribs with the pork skin. While simmering the broth, fry the tofu until golden brown on all sides. Cut the tomatoes into wedges.

Step 2: Soak the dried shrimp in hot water until soft, then pound into a paste. Mix the shrimp paste, ground pork, black pepper, seasoning powder, and minced shallots with 2 eggs, then let the mixture marinate.
Step 3: When the ribs are slightly tender, add 2 tbsp of annatto oil. Next, add the tomatoes and 2 bún riêu seasoning cubes to create the signature flavor, then adjust the seasoning to taste.
Step 4: Add the fried tofu to the pot. Scoop portions of the raw meat and shrimp mixture into the boiling broth until finished, then simmer for another 20 minutes.

Step 5: Shred the lettuce; wash the Vietnamese balm and bean sprouts thoroughly. To serve, place rice vermicelli in a bowl, pour over the broth with the meatballs, tomatoes, and tofu, and serve with the fresh herbs.
Source: Kenh14

mon_an.ten: Braised Goby Fish with Pickled Leeks
mon_an.mo_ta: Braised Goby Fish with Pickled Leeks – An easy-to-make dish where sand goby fish absorbs the flavors of chili and crunchy pickled leeks, making it uniquely delicious. Learn how to make this savory braised dish.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, sugar, annatto oil, fish sauce
Chili peppers, shallots, garlic, green peppercorns
cac_buoc: Step 1: Scale the goby fish and clean the innards. Marinate the fish with 1/2 tsp salt for about 15 minutes. Pound the garlic, shallots, and green chilies into a fine paste.
Step 2: Wash the fresh pickled leeks and drain. If using sweet and sour jarred leeks, rinse them several times to reduce the acidity, squeeze out excess water, and drain.

Step 3: Heat 1 tbsp fish sauce and 1 tbsp sugar in a pot. Boil until the sugar turns an amber color, then add the pounded garlic, shallots, and green peppercorns from Step 1. Stir well. After 30 minutes of marinating, turn on the heat, drizzle 1 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tsp annatto oil, and whole chilies over the fish. Boil for 10 minutes, then uncover and simmer on low heat so the fish absorbs the spices.

Step 4: Simmer for another 25-30 minutes, then add the pickled leeks. Shake the pot gently to distribute them and adjust the seasoning to your preference. When braising the fish, do not add water as it will make the fish fishy; the sugar and fish sauce will provide enough liquid when covered. Simmer for another 10 to 15 minutes until the liquid reduces. Turn off the heat, add chopped green onions, and serve on a plate as a savory dish with rice. Note: Do not cover the pot after adding the leeks to keep them crunchy.
Source: Ngoi sao

mon_an.mo_ta: Crispy puffed green rice flakes wrap around tender fish fillets, stimulating the palate with a rich, nutty flavor. Green rice crusted fried fish is a nutritious and exciting dish that never gets boring! It is truly a wonderful meal.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Cooking oil, seasoning powder, pepper - for seasoning
cac_buoc: Step 1: Cut the snakehead fish into batons, then rinse with ginger and white wine to remove any fishy odor.
Step 2: Marinate the fish with seasoning powder, pepper, shallots, and garlic for about 5 minutes.
Step 3: Crack the eggs into a small bowl and beat well.
Step 4: Dust the fish evenly with flour, dip into the beaten egg, roll in the green rice flakes, and drop into a pan of hot oil. Fry until the rice flakes puff up and become crispy.
Step 5: Serve the fried fish with tamarind sauce or sweet and sour chili sauce.
Enjoy this delicious dish with your family!

mon_an.ten: Grilled Pomfret with Galangal and Lemongrass
mon_an.mo_ta: Grilled Pomfret with Galangal and Lemongrass – a fragrant dish perfect for a casual gathering with friends. This grilled fish recipe is a classic yet incredibly tasty way to enjoy pomfret.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, green onions, seasoning powder, cooking oil
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the pomfret: Clean the fish, remove the gills, and gut it carefully to avoid breaking the gall bladder. Wash the inside of the cavity thoroughly. Use a knife to score several lines on the body of the fish so it marinates better and cooks faster.
Step 2:
Peel the galangal, wash, and pound finely. Mix the galangal and minced lemongrass together.
Add a little salt and seasoning powder to the galangal-lemongrass mixture, then rub it evenly over the fish. Marinate for about 30 minutes.
Step 3: Place the fish on a baking tray lined with foil. Bake at 100°C, cooking each side for 40-50 minutes depending on the size of the fish.

Step 4: Occasionally during the grilling process, take the fish out and brush with a layer of oil mixed with chopped green onions to make the surface golden, glossy, and more fragrant. Once golden brown and cooked through, remove from the oven and serve hot. Grilled fish is excellent dipped in fish sauce or used in rice paper wraps.
Source: Ngoi sao

mon_an.mo_ta: Tomatoes are very healthy, and when combined with pork, they create a crispy fried stuffed tomato dish with a savory, sweet, and sour flavor that is delicious when served with hot rice.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Place the meat in a bowl along with the finely chopped onions and one finely chopped scallion. Add salt, sugar, pepper, and seasoning powder, then mix well with one tablespoon of sesame oil to let the ingredients absorb the flavors.
Step 2: After washing the tomatoes, cut them in half horizontally and remove the seeds inside. Stuff the meat into the tomatoes, making sure not to pack it too tightly.

Step 3: Place a pan on the stove over medium heat. Once the pan is hot, add oil. When the oil is hot, add a crushed clove of garlic (peeled); once the garlic turns golden, remove it. Place the tomatoes in the pan, fry over medium heat with the meat side down until cooked through. Then flip to the tomato side.
Step 4: When the dish is cooked, remove to a plate and serve with hot rice, soy sauce, chili, cucumber, and lettuce; adding a soup dish completes the meal.

Note: If you have guests, you can microwave the tomatoes for 1 minute to cook the meat inside first. This helps you fry them faster without the tomatoes falling apart, making the presentation much more beautiful.

mon_an.mo_ta: Anchovies Braised with Galangal – A delicious, easy-to-make dish for those who love braised fish. This recipe features the spicy and aromatic flavor of galangal and chili, with anchovies thoroughly infused with spices, perfect for enjoying with hot rice.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Garlic, chili peppers, chili powder, shallots
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the anchovies:
For fresh anchovies: Wash the fish with diluted salt water, or rub salt directly onto the fish to remove slime. Then rinse with water and marinate with a bit of salt for 1 hour.
For dried anchovies: Since dried anchovies are already salty, there is no need to marinate them. Simply wash the fish and soak in a bowl of cold water for 30 minutes to reduce the saltiness.

Step 2: Scrape the skin off the galangal, rinse, and then chop or pound it to make it easier. Divide the galangal into two halves: squeeze one half for its juice, and keep the other half to cook with the fish.

Step 3: Next, place the fish in a clay pot. Add the galangal pieces, galangal juice, two tablespoons of fish sauce, two tablespoons of brown sugar, one teaspoon of salt, chili powder, whole chili peppers, and chopped shallots. Mix well and marinate for about 1-2 hours so the anchovies absorb the flavors.

Step 4: Place the pot on the stove, occasionally stirring gently with chopsticks. Simmer over low heat until the fish is infused with spices, then adjust the seasoning to your taste. Turn off the heat and serve the dish on a plate as a savory course with rice.
Source: Ngoisao

mon_an.mo_ta: Braised Fish with Coconut Meat – An easy-to-make, nutritious dish that is non-fattening, featuring the rich aroma of coconut and the tanginess of pineapple. Discover the detailed instructions for this delicious braised fish. Enjoy the bold flavor of the fish combined with the sweetness of coconut meat, creating an attractive and unique dish.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fish sauce, salt, sugar, black pepper, chili powder
cac_buoc: 1. Prepare ingredients
Mackerel (or other fish): Take 2 steaks of mackerel (or other fish) and wash with cold water. Remove and drain.
Pineapple: Take 1 medium slice of pineapple, peel, and remove the eyes. Then, cut the pineapple into small pieces.
Coconut meat: Peel the coconut and take the inner meat. Cut the meat into thin strips or smaller pieces depending on preference.

Fish sauce, salt, sugar, black pepper, chili powder: Prepare a small bowl, mix 1-2 tbsp fish sauce, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp sugar, 1/4 tsp pepper, and 1/4 tsp chili powder. Stir well until the ingredients dissolve into a spice mixture.
Scallions, shallots, chili peppers: Wash the scallions and chili peppers, then finely chop. Shallots can also be finely chopped or left whole depending on taste.
2. Cooking the braised fish with coconut meat
Step 1: Mix the mackerel with 1 tsp salt in a large bowl, then toss well to let the fish marinate for about 30 minutes, helping the fish absorb flavor and making the dish more savory.

Step 2: Prepare a braising pot and layer the ingredients at the bottom: mackerel, pineapple pieces, shallots, coconut meat, 2 tbsp fish sauce, minced chili, 1 tbsp sugar, and a bit of chili powder (depending on spice preference). Bring to a boil over high heat.
Step 3: When the braising liquid boils, add a bit of fresh coconut water and toss gently so the fish is evenly coated with spices.

Step 4: Continue to simmer the fish over low heat for about 30-40 minutes until the liquid reduces and thickens. Re-season to taste and add scallions, cooking for another 2 minutes before turning off the heat.

Step 5: Transfer the braised fish to a plate and garnish with a bit of pepper and a few sprigs of cilantro on top to make the dish more appealing. You have now completed the delicious braised fish with coconut meat to serve your family.
Notes for delicious braised fish with coconut meat

Choose the right fish: Mackerel is a popular choice, but you can also use other types like herring, snakehead fish, or basa, depending on preference and availability. Choose fresh fish without any off-smells to ensure quality.
Proper fish preparation: Before use, wash the fish with cold water to remove dirt. You can also marinate the fish with salt for a short time to remove the fishy smell and enhance the flavor.
Prepare fresh coconut meat: When choosing coconut, select fresh ones with white inner meat and enough coconut milk to create a rich, sweet flavor. Peel and cut into thin strips or small pieces.

Cook for the right amount of time: When braising, use low heat and cook for 30-40 minutes so the fish is tender, spices are absorbed, and the liquid thickens. Monitor the process and avoid overcooking to prevent the fish from falling apart.
Season to taste: Once the fish is cooked, adjust the salt, sugar, fish sauce, and pepper according to your family's taste. Taste and adjust before turning off the heat.
Add scallions and cilantro: Near the end, add scallions and cook for 2 more minutes to add aroma and freshness. You can also garnish with cilantro for an attractive touch.

mon_an.mo_ta: Today, let's make braised fish with pineapple as an alternative to fried or steamed fish dishes which can be greasy. The fatty, tender texture of the fish combined with pineapple and a hint of chili makes this braised dish irresistibly attractive. There are many ways to prepare fish, such as frying, sour soup, soup with bamboo shoots, tomato sauce, steaming, or braising. For braising specifically, you can vary the accompanying ingredients to create dishes like Cá Kho Tộ, pepper braised fish, fish with fermented greens, or fish with green bananas. Today, we reveal a very appealing version: Braised Fish with Pineapple (Ca kho dua). Let's get cooking.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Onions - Scallions: a few stalks, shallots: 1 bulb
cac_buoc: Clean the fish, cut into bite-sized pieces, and drain or pat dry with a towel/paper towel. Marinate the fish with a bit of pepper, salt, fish sauce, and seasoning powder. Let sit for about 5 minutes to absorb.
While waiting for the fish, prepare the other ingredients. Remove the core from the pineapple and cut into thin, bite-sized slices.
Finely chop the chili and scallions. Separate the white parts and the green leaves of the scallions. Peel and mince the shallots, mixing them with the white scallion parts.
Heat a pot, add sugar and stir until it turns an amber caramel color, then add a little water and stir until the sugar dissolves completely to get a beautiful caramel sauce.
Pre-made caramel sauce is available, but I still prefer making it myself with sugar for quality and better color.
Add the fish to the pot of caramel sauce, tossing until the fish is evenly colored.
Once the fish is colored, add fish sauce, seasoning powder, salt, the white scallion parts, and shallots. Layer the pineapple on top, then place on the stove and simmer over low heat.

Remember to cook over low heat so the pineapple releases its juice and infuses into the fish along with the other spices. Simmer until the liquid reduces and the fish is well-seasoned. Sprinkle with chopped green scallions and pepper, then serve on a plate. Eat hot with rice.
Note that you should add the pepper last before turning off the heat so it retains its aroma and makes the dish more appealing.
Here is the final product ^^

Braised fish with pineapple is very simple, isn't it? Besides braising with fish, pineapple can be eaten as a fruit, made into a summer smoothie, or used in salads (like a refreshing Shrimp and Pineapple Salad) which are also very delicious. Try the super-fast and attractive Shrimp and Pineapple Salad recipe!

mon_an.mo_ta: Today I would like to introduce a delicious, easy-to-make addition to your braised dishes: Braised Fish with Galangal. The basics remain the same, but my mother innovated by adding a few things to make it even more appealing. I believe everyone has their own way of braising fish... Give this method a try! I'm sure everyone will love it 😉
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fish - 1 fish about 1kg (any type you like: carp, grass carp, snakehead, etc.)
Green tea leaves - 1 small handful (to remove fishy odors and enhance flavor; optional)
Seasonings - Fish sauce, salt, soy sauce, oyster sauce
cac_buoc: Heat a pot, add about 3 tbsp of sugar and stir until it turns an amber caramel color, then add a little water and stir until the sugar dissolves completely to get a beautiful caramel sauce.
Pre-made caramel sauce is available, but I still prefer making it myself with sugar for quality and better color.
Clean the fish and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Wash the pork belly (I usually boil water and drop the meat in to remove impurities, then rinse with water; this prevents scum during cooking), and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Scrape and wash the galangal, then slice thinly or pound it (I usually slice it thinly because I like eating the crunchy, nutty galangal pieces after braising).
Shallots (leave the skins on for a better aroma), crush and mince.

Place the fish and pork in a bowl, marinate with pepper, chopped chili, sliced galangal, minced shallots (with skins), 1 tbsp fish sauce, ½ tsp salt, 1 tbsp soy sauce, a bit of oyster sauce (to enhance flavor; optional), and the caramel sauce made above. Toss well and let sit for 20-30 minutes to absorb.

While waiting for the fish, steep the green tea leaves in about 1 bowl of water. This water will be used for braising to remove the fishy smell and add aroma. If you don't have green tea leaves, you can skip this step.

Once the fish and pork are marinated, take a pot and place the sliced galangal (used in the marinade) at the bottom. Add the fish and pork, pour in the marinade, and place on the stove. Bring to a boil over high heat, then lower to a simmer for 5-10 minutes.
Then pour in the steeped green tea water. If you don't have tea water, use a bowl of hot water; note: never use cold water as it will make the fish smell fishy.

Bring to a boil, season to taste (note that the liquid will reduce, so don't over-season or it will become too salty), then lower the heat and simmer for about 30 minutes until the liquid reduces and the fish is well-seasoned. Sprinkle with pepper and serve hot with white rice.
This recipe is from Candy - candycancook.com!
Besides this version, you can also try braised fish with pineapple to vary your family meals! Good luck and enjoy!

mon_an.mo_ta: Attractive Cá Kho Tộ – A daily delicious dish from mother's kitchen. How to make attractive Cá Kho Tộ.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare ingredients: Wash the ginger, mince half and julienne the other half; wash the fish and marinate with fish sauce, salt, seasonings, sugar, pepper, and the minced ginger for 2 hours; wash and chop the scallions; slice the chili thinly.
Step 2: Add sugar to a pot and heat until it melts into a golden brown color, then add a bit of boiling water. Add the julienned ginger, arrange the fish in the pot, and pour in the marinade.

Step 3: Cook over high heat, flipping both sides of the fish, then turn the heat to low and braise until the liquid is nearly gone. When serving, transfer the fish to a claypot, pour the sauce over it, sprinkle with scallions and chili, and reheat on the stove.
Source: Kenh14

mon_an.ten: Grilled Fish with Rice Paper Rolls
mon_an.mo_ta: Grilled fish with rice paper rolls is a unique and delicious dish that is becoming a popular choice in many restaurants and homes. Try making this dish and enjoy wonderful family moments following these instructions! A unique and popular dish that will bring a great culinary experience to you and your family.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Snakehead or basa fish - 1 whole fish
Fish sauce, salt, sugar, pepper, seasoning powder
2 tbsp honey, 1 tsp oyster sauce, 1 tsp annatto oil
Accompanying herbs: - Vietnamese coriander, mint, herbs
Cucumber, vermicelli, rice paper for rolling
Sweet and sour fish sauce or fermented shrimp paste sauce
cac_buoc: 1. Prepare ingredients
Gut the fish, remove gills and scales. Then, wash the fish with diluted salt water and drain. Use a knife to score a few lines across the body of the fish.
Peel, wash, and mince the ginger. Use half of the ginger to rub over the fish and let sit for 15 minutes, then rinse and dry. Use the remaining ginger to stuff into the scored lines on the fish.
Wash and dice the tomatoes.
Wash the cucumber and soak in diluted salt water for 15 minutes for food safety. Then, drain and slice thinly.
Wash the lettuce and soak in diluted salt water for 15 minutes, then drain.
Trim the scallions, remove old leaves, and wash. Cut into segments, then sauté with a bit of oyster sauce and microwave for 30 seconds to cook.
Roast the peanuts, then remove the skins.
Peel the onion, wash, and cut into wedges.
2. Instructions for making grilled fish with rice paper rolls

Start by spreading the onions evenly at the bottom of a baking tray. Next, place the fish on top of the onions and sprinkle the body with two teaspoons of salt, two teaspoons of fish sauce, one teaspoon of seasoning powder, and a little pepper. Use your hands to rub this mixture all over the fish. Wrap the fish and leave it in the refrigerator overnight so that when grilled, the meat will be tender and more delicious.

Next, grill the fish in the oven. Mix cooking oil, oyster sauce, and honey in a bowl. Then, brush this mixture onto the fish. Place the fish in the oven and grill for about 30 to 45 minutes at 200 degrees C. Periodically, you can brush a little oil on the fish to keep it from drying out.
3. Make the dipping sauce
While waiting for the fish to cook, mix 1 tsp sugar, 1/2 tsp lemon juice, 1 tbsp fish sauce, and about 3-4 tbsp water in a bowl. Add minced chili and garlic. Season to taste.
4. Finishing and serving
Place the grilled fish on a plate, served with vermicelli, cucumber, cilantro, lettuce, and rice paper for rolling. Serve with the spicy and sour fish sauce.
Notes for making grilled fish with rice paper rolls
Choose fresh fish: Select fresh fish that is not spoiled or has an unpleasant odor. Ensure the fish is cleaned, gutted, and descaled before use.
Fresh ginger: Using fresh ginger to rub on the fish helps remove the fishy smell and enhances the flavor. Ensure the ginger is peeled and washed before use.
Marinating time: Marinate the fish in the refrigerator for at least 2 to 4 hours or overnight. This allows the fish to absorb the flavors and become tender when grilled.

Grilling temperature and time: Grill the fish at 200 degrees C for about 30 to 45 minutes. Adjust the time depending on the size and thickness of the fish to ensure it is cooked through without being too dry.
Prepare the dipping sauce: A good dipping sauce is a crucial part of this dish. Combine sugar, lemon juice, fish sauce, and spices according to personal taste. Adjust the seasoning as needed.
Enjoying: Once the fish is grilled, present it on a plate with vermicelli, cucumber, cilantro, lettuce, and rice paper. Use the dipping sauce to enhance the flavor.
Food safety: Always follow hygiene and food safety rules. Wash all ingredients before use and ensure the grilling temperature is sufficient to kill bacteria.

mon_an.mo_ta: Mackerel with Tamarind Sauce – An easy-to-make dish that is savory, sweet, and sour, packed with healthy nutrients. Learn how to make Mackerel with Tamarind Sauce.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Cut the fish into medium slices, marinate with seasonings for about 30 minutes, then fry until golden brown on both sides. Remove the fish to a plate and set aside.

Step 2: Place the dried tamarind in a bowl, add a little more than half a bowl of boiling water, let sit for 10 minutes, then use a spoon to mash the tamarind pulp. Strain the tamarind juice and discard the seeds/pulp.

Step 3: Using the same pan used for the fish, drain most of the oil, then add minced garlic and shallots and sauté until golden and fragrant. Remove and set aside with the fried fish so the aromatics don't burn when making the sauce.

Step 4: Add one tablespoon of oil to the pan, pour in the tamarind juice, and season with fish sauce, spices, and sugar. Bring to a boil, add the onion, and adjust the seasoning to taste before adding the fish. Simmer over low heat, occasionally flipping the fish so it absorbs the sauce on both sides. When the tamarind sauce begins to thicken, sprinkle with pepper and minced chili. Place the fish on a plate, pour the tamarind sauce over it, and top with the golden fried garlic and shallots. Serve hot with rice.
Source: Ngoisao

mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried Beef with Eggplant – A simple and quick preparation that is still delicious and full of necessary nutrients. Check out how to make this dish in the article below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Chili peppers, scallions, perilla leaves, salt, pepper
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Place the beef in the freezer for 10 minutes, then remove, wash, and cut into strips. Freezing the beef slightly makes it easier and neater to slice.
Place the beef in a bowl, then add peeled and minced ginger and garlic. Next, add soy sauce, sesame oil, pepper, and cooking oil, and marinate for 30 - 60 minutes.
Step 2:
Wash the eggplant and cut into bite-sized pieces. Then soak in diluted salt water to prevent browning.

Trim the scallions, wash, and cut into segments the same length as the eggplant. Slit the chili peppers lengthwise, remove seeds, and chop finely (adjust the amount of chili to your spice preference).

Step 3: Add oil to a pan; once hot, add the eggplant and stir-fry, seasoning with salt to taste. When the eggplant is cooked, add the scallions and chili, toss quickly, then turn off the heat and transfer to a plate.
Step 4: Using the same pan, stir-fry the beef and season to taste.

Step 5: When the beef is cooked, return the stir-fried eggplant to the pan and toss quickly. Turn off the heat, transfer the dish to a plate, and mix in the toasted sesame seeds. Sprinkle with thinly sliced perilla leaves on top. The dish is now complete and should be served hot.

mon_an.ten: Fish Ball Soup with Bamboo Shoots and Tomatoes
mon_an.mo_ta: Fish balls are often enjoyed by children after school, or served as fried fish balls for dinner. Today, we bring a more interesting combination for the familiar fried fish balls: Fish Ball Soup with Bamboo Shoots and Tomatoes. Learn to cook this delicious dish.
cac_buoc: The steps to make Fish Ball Soup with Bamboo Shoots and Tomatoes are as follows:
Step 1: Fry the fish balls in a pan of oil until golden brown, then remove to a plate lined with paper towels.
Step 2: Shred the sour bamboo shoots into strips, cut the tomato into wedges, and cut the scallions into short segments.
Step 3: Place a pot on the stove over medium heat, add a little oil, sauté the white parts of the scallions until fragrant, then add the bamboo shoots and tomatoes to stir-fry.
Step 4: Pour cold water into the pot, season to taste, and cover to bring to a boil.
Step 5: Once the bamboo shoots are tender, add the fried fish balls and bring back to a boil. Adjust the seasoning, add the scallion leaves, turn off the heat, and ladle into a bowl.

mon_an.mo_ta: A familiar dish made special with the addition of Korean chili paste. This stir-fried cabbage with pork belly offers a unique twist while maintaining its delicious essence. Give it a try!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning - pepper, salt, seasoning powder, fish sauce
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Cut the cabbage into bite-sized pieces. Wash and drain well.
Slice the pork belly into small pieces (about 1cm). Marinate with a bit of pepper, salt, and fish sauce for better flavor.
Peel and mince the garlic.
Step 2:
Heat a pan with cooking oil. Once the oil is hot, sauté the garlic until fragrant, then add the dried chili and Korean chili paste. Stir for 1 to 2 minutes.
Add the pork and stir-fry until firm and well-seasoned, then add the cabbage.
Adjust seasoning to taste, turn off the heat, and serve on a plate. It is delicious when served hot with rice.

mon_an.mo_ta: Sweet and refreshing calabash gourd combined with the savory sweetness of mussels creates an attractive and nutritious dish. Let's learn how to make it!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning powder, pepper, cooking oil - ingredients
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the mussels thoroughly to remove all mud and dirt. Place them in a pot with just enough water to cover and boil until cooked, or microwave for about 30s until they open. Extract the meat and remove the black intestinal part.
Step 2: Peel the gourd, wash away the sap, and julienne or use a peeler to create long shreds.
Step 3: Wash the green onions and Vietnamese coriander, then chop them finely. Keep the white parts of the green onions separate.
Step 4: Place a pan on the stove, sauté the white parts of the green onions in oil until fragrant, then add the mussels and stir-fry until seasoned. Remove the mussels and set aside in a bowl.
Step 5: Reheat the pan with oil and add the gourd, stirring quickly. Sprinkle with a little seasoning powder to taste (use sparingly as the mussels are already seasoned).

Step 6: The gourd cooks very quickly; once the shreds soften and are just cooked through, return the stir-fried mussels to the pan. Sprinkle with chopped green onions and Vietnamese coriander, stir well, and remove from the heat.

mon_an.mo_ta: A refreshing and easy-to-make dish with simple ingredients. This detailed guide will surely make your whole family fall in love with these beef mustard green wraps.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Wrap fillings - Pineapple, cucumber, carrot, green banana, ginger (optional: sour starfruit).
cac_buoc: Step 1: Slice the beef tenderloin into pieces about 1cm thick. Marinate the beef with minced garlic, a little salt, pepper, and oyster sauce. Rub the seasoning evenly onto the surface and marinate for about 30 minutes.
Step 2: Meanwhile, prepare the wrap fillings.
Peel the green banana, slice into small long strips, and soak in a bowl of diluted salt water to prevent browning.
Peel and slice the carrots.
Slice the cucumber, pineapple, and starfruit into pieces of roughly equal length for a beautiful presentation and easy wrapping.
Wash, peel, and julienne the ginger.
Step 3: Place a pan on the stove with enough oil to coat the surface. Once the pan is hot, add the beef to pan-sear. Press the meat against the pan surface so it absorbs heat quickly, then flip.
Step 4: After about 3 minutes, the beef should be cooked through and slightly golden on the surface.
Step 5: Slice the beef into long rectangular strips for easy wrapping.
Wash the mustard greens and shake dry. Place the vegetables and fruits onto a mustard leaf, add a piece of beef, wrap it up, and enjoy. You can use rice paper as an outer layer for easier eating.
Serve the beef mustard green wraps with soy sauce mixed with a little mustard (if you like heat) or a bowl of ginger dipping sauce.

mon_an.ten: Easy and Tender Black Pepper Beef
mon_an.mo_ta: Black pepper beef is a nutritious and easy-to-prepare dish, popular for family meals. This recipe provides details on how to prepare it correctly to preserve nutrients and improve health. Let's take a look! I. Ingredients for Black Pepper Beef
cac_buoc: Beef tenderloin: 300g
Flour: 2 tbsp
Onion: 1
Green bell pepper: 1
Red bell pepper: 1
Ginger: 1 piece
Garlic: 1 bulb
Black pepper: 70g
Cooking oil: 4 tbsp
Soy sauce: 2 tbsp
Oyster sauce: 2 tbsp
Olive oil: a little
Common spices: a little (salt, pepper, sugar)
II. Instructions
1. Prepare the beef
Wash the beef with diluted salt water, rinse with clean water, and drain. Use a paper towel or clean cloth to pat the meat dry.
Slice the meat into thin pieces against the grain to prevent it from being tough. Lightly pound the meat with a mallet to tenderize it and help it absorb spices.
Marinate the meat with 2 tbsp of flour and mix well. For extra tenderness, add a little olive oil. Next, add 1/2 tsp salt and 1/2 tsp pepper, mix well, and let it marinate for 10-15 minutes.
Note:
Beef has very little odor; you can place it in the fridge for 20-30 minutes to firm it up for easier slicing.
Do not over-wash the beef to avoid losing water-soluble nutrients during preparation.
2. Prepare other ingredients:
Wash the bell peppers, halve, remove seeds, and slice into thin strips.
Peel the onion, halve, and cut into small wedges along the length of the bulb.
Peel and wash the ginger, then julienne. Peel and mince the garlic.
3. Stir-fry the vegetables
Place a pan on the stove, add 2 tbsp oil, and heat. When the oil is hot, add the bell peppers and onions; stir-fry over high heat for about 4-5 minutes.
4. Make the sauce
To make the sauce, prepare a small bowl and mix 2 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp oyster sauce, 2 tsp sugar, and 50g of crushed black pepper. Stir until the mixture is dissolved.
To cook the beef, place a pan on the stove with 2 tbsp oil and heat. When the oil is hot, add the beef and stir-fry until just firm, then remove from the pan.
Use the remaining oil in the pan to sauté the ginger and garlic until fragrant. Pour the prepared sauce into the pan and bring to a boil.
Add the stir-fried beef back into the pan, toss well to coat with the sauce, then add the remaining black pepper and mix.
Arrange the stir-fried vegetables on a plate, top with the beef, and enjoy.

Black pepper beef is a popular and nutritious dish. The beef is fragrant and tender, while the vegetables are fresh and crunchy. The rich sauce with a spicy kick is very appealing. Try it now and serve with a side of chili soy sauce.
III. Tips for the best Black Pepper Beef
Choose beef fillet or tenderloin for the best flavor. Look for a bright red color and meat that feels elastic to the touch.
The beef should be sliced into large pieces about 0.3cm thick and lightly pounded to tenderize before cutting into bite-sized pieces.
Peppercorns should be toasted until fragrant and only coarsely crushed.
Before tenderizing, lightly stroke the mallet horizontally to prevent the beef from sticking to it.

When marinating, add a little cornstarch and oil to keep the meat tender and sweet. Avoid using too much salt as the "salt hardens meat" rule applies; it can make the beef tough by drawing out moisture.
IV. How to choose fresh ingredients
1. Choosing beef
Observe the color: fresh beef is bright red, not dark red, and the fat is usually pale yellow.
Choose small, tender pieces with fine grain that spring back when pressed.
If you see small white cysts that fall off easily, it might be parasites. Avoid buying pre-cut small pieces as they are harder to inspect.
2. Choosing sweet bell peppers
"Male" bell peppers usually have 3 lobes at the bottom. These are better for cooking (stir-frying) as they have a firmer structure and bolder flavor.
"Female" bell peppers usually have 4 lobes at the bottom. They are softer and sweeter, making them ideal for raw dishes like salads.
Choose peppers with smooth, thick, shiny skin and intact stems. Good peppers should feel heavy for their size with vibrant colors.
Avoid peppers with cracked, bruised, or uneven skin, as these are signs of poor quality.

mon_an.mo_ta: Braised fish is a rustic yet incredibly delicious dish. While many types of fish can be used, meaty varieties like grass carp or common carp are best. Braised carp with galangal is a smart choice for chilly days. The sweetness of the fish combined with the pungent aroma of galangal makes winter meals warmer. Discover this detailed guide to making flavorful braised carp with fresh galangal.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Preparation:

Clean the fish, cut into 3cm steaks, then marinate with salt for 15-20 minutes. Rinse the fish again and drain. Wash and thinly slice the galangal. Wash the sugarcane, cut into 4-5cm lengths, and split into quarters. Wash and halve the chilies.
Step 2:
Cooking:

Place the sugarcane and galangal at the bottom of the pot. Layer the fish on top along with ground pepper, whole peppercorns, chilies, sugar, MSG, oil, salt, and fish sauce. Dissolve the caramel sauce, pour it over the fish, and simmer over low heat so the fish absorbs the flavors. Cook for about 3-4 hours. The fish is ready when it has a deep color, a firm texture, and the sauce has thickened. Do not let it burn.
Finished product requirements:
The fish should have an amber (cock's wing) color.
The fish steaks should be tender but not falling apart.
Fragrant with the scent of galangal and pepper.
Tips for buying delicious carp
When buying live carp, observe these factors:

Shape: Choose carp with a thick body and a balanced ratio from head to tail. Avoid those with bloated bellies, as they may have too much fat, large entrails (farmed), or be full of eggs, which often results in less sweet meat.
Scales: Scales should be even, bright, and free from bruises or fraying.
Size: Choose river carp which are longer and slightly slimmer than those raised in ponds. Farmed carp are usually round and fat even if they aren't very heavy.
When buying pre-cut fish:
Priority should be given to pieces cut from a live, swimming fish. Focus on the section where the body is still attached to the head to ensure freshness.
Check the head: The head should still have fresh blood, no foul odor, and no signs of slime from sitting too long.
