Check the meat: The flesh should have good elasticity, look firm and fresh, not soft, and have no abnormal color changes.
By following these tips, you can select high-quality fish to ensure the best flavor for your dish.

mon_an.mo_ta: Braised carp with pickled greens is a familiar dish for many, as it is delicious, easy to eat, and suitable for both hot and cold weather. Served with rice vermicelli and fresh herbs, the combination of the mild sourness from the pickles and the sweetness of the carp makes it a wonderful family meal regardless of the temperature.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Pork fat (select a portion with a little meat attached)
Ginger, shallots, turmeric, green onions, dill, chili.
cac_buoc: Step 1:

Pork cracklings are delicious when braised with fish, so you should buy pork fat, wash it, slice it into pieces, and fry until the fat is rendered. Remove the cracklings and set them aside; the rendered fat will be used to fry the fish.
Step 2:
Scale, gut, and clean the carp. Score a few lines on the surface of the fish. Rub a little salt inside the cleaned belly and pat dry.
Place the fish in the pan and fry until the skin is golden. For this dish, you can choose to fry the fish or not. However, lightly frying it is recommended to reduce the fishy odor.
Step 3:
Wash the tomatoes, cut them into wedges, and stir-fry with the pork fat (or cooking oil).
Step 4:
Squeeze the excess water from the pickled greens and add them to the pan to stir-fry; season to taste. Add julienned ginger and crushed bird's eye chili if you prefer it spicy.

Once the greens are cooked, if you want to increase the sourness, you can add a small bowl of rice vinegar (if using homemade pickles, you can use the pickling liquid, but be careful to adjust the saltiness as the liquid is already salty).
Add enough water so that when the fish is added, it is partially submerged.
Step 5:
When the braising liquid boils, add the carp, pork cracklings, and a little turmeric powder (or crushed fresh turmeric) to simmer together.
Step 6:

Flip the fish once during the braising process so it absorbs the sour, spicy, and salty flavors evenly on both sides. Flip gently to avoid breaking the fish. Once the flavors are well-absorbed, sprinkle with chopped green onions and dill, then remove from the heat.

Step 7: Braised carp with pickled greens is best served hot, so people often place the fish on a stainless steel platter or keep it in the pot over a burner while eating. You should serve this with rice vermicelli and fresh herbs to balance the sour, spicy, and hot flavors. If desired, you can garnish with fried shallots before serving!

mon_an.mo_ta: In hot weather, homemade sweet and sour pickled eggplant served with rice or soup is absolutely wonderful! Let's explore how to make this dish!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salted Vietnamese eggplant (cà bát muối nén) - 2 fruits
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, slice the eggplant into bite-sized pieces. If you like them crunchy, make sure to choose mature eggplants!
Step 2:
Use filtered water to rinse the eggplant. Since this type of salted eggplant is usually very salty, you need to rinse it about twice until the saltiness is reduced.
Step 3:
Squeeze gently so that if the salted eggplant has mature seeds, they will be pushed out!
Step 4:
Drain all the water and let the eggplant pieces dry. At this step, you should squeeze lightly so the eggplant doesn't stay waterlogged.
Step 5:
Now, peel and mince the garlic!
Step 6:
Mix the eggplant thoroughly with sugar, chili, and garlic. If you like the taste of soy sauce, you can add 1 tbsp here.
Step 7:
Let the eggplant marinate for about 10 minutes and it's ready to eat!
Now, serve it with rice!
Menu suggestion for a rustic meal: sweet and sour pickled eggplant, boiled water spinach, fried tofu, caramelized pork, stir-fried shrimp with starfruit, braised fish...
Salted Vietnamese eggplant (cà bát) always has a characteristic flavor: more fragrant and intense than small eggplants (cà pháo).
The eggplant is marinated to be sweet and sour, making it very appetizing with rice!
If you don't finish it, you can cover it tightly and store it in the refrigerator for later use!

mon_an.mo_ta: Salmon with passion fruit sauce is a delicious and nutritious dish. You can completely prepare this European-flavored dish at home with simple, easy-to-find ingredients. Refer to our authentic recipe below! Discover a simple and tasty way to cook salmon with passion fruit sauce at home. This guide provides detailed steps, necessary ingredients, and tips to create a signature dish with the sweet and sour taste of passion fruit and fresh salmon.
cac_buoc: 1. Prepare ingredients
Passion fruit: Cut in half, use a spoon to scoop out the pulp, strain through a sieve, and keep 1 tbsp of seeds to add back to the strained juice.

Make the passion fruit sauce: Put the passion fruit juice in a pot over low heat, add 5 tbsp sugar, 1/2 tsp salt, and 25g unsalted butter; stir well and adjust to taste. Simmer the mixture until slightly thickened.
2. Fry the fish

While waiting for the sauce to thicken, place a pan on the stove with a little oil. When the oil is hot, add the cleaned salmon fillet and season with a little salt and pepper. Pan-sear both sides, then add 25g unsalted butter and 1 rosemary sprig; baste the fish with the butter sauce to cook evenly. Finally, remove the fish from the pan.
3. Stir-fry asparagus
Place another pan on the stove with a little oil. Add the asparagus and stir-fry quickly, adding a pinch of salt to maintain its green color.
Drizzle the passion fruit sauce over the plate containing the salmon and asparagus. This salmon dish can be served with boiled potatoes mashed with mayonnaise.
Finally, you have a complete Western-style salmon with passion fruit sauce ready to serve your family.
Tips for buying ingredients
1. Buying good salmon
Choose salmon with a black back, white belly, shiny scales that are tightly packed and not peeling. Additionally, the eyes should be bright, not red or cloudy.
Press the flesh lightly with your finger; it should feel firm and elastic, not soft or mushy.
You should buy salmon from reputable stores, seafood specialists, or supermarkets. Choose salmon weighing 6-7 kg each, as these are mature fish with sweet and flavorful meat.
2. Buying fresh passion fruit
Choose passion fruits with a dark purple or reddish-brown outer skin. The darker the skin, the sweeter and more fragrant the fruit.
Good passion fruit will have wrinkled skin, feel light in the hand, and have a characteristic aroma.
Fruits with smooth, shiny skin that feel heavy are fresh and have a tartness suitable for making sauce.
Avoid buying fruits that are wrinkled on the outside but are leaking fluid or are mushy, as these are old and spoiled.
III. Notes for making salmon with passion fruit sauce
1. Selecting fresh salmon
Choose salmon with a black back, white belly, and shiny, intact scales.
Eyes must be bright, not red or cloudy.
Press the flesh; it must feel firm and elastic.
Preparing the salmon:
Clean the fish, remove fins, tail, skin, and bones.
Cut the fish into bite-sized pieces.
2. Preparing the passion fruit sauce
Choose soft, ripe passion fruits with wrinkled skin and a strong aroma.
Squeeze to get the juice.
Season the sauce with passion fruit juice, salt, pepper, and sugar to taste.
Combining salmon and passion fruit sauce:
Dip the salmon pieces into the passion fruit sauce.
You can quickly glaze it on the stove or cook it with the sauce.
Do not cook for too long to maintain the freshness of the salmon.
IV. Nutritional value of salmon with passion fruit sauce
Salmon contains many beneficial nutrients. Every 100g of salmon has about 200 calories, is low in saturated fat, but very rich in protein.
Salmon is also a rich source of vitamin B12, potassium, iron, and vitamin D. Vitamin B12 in salmon helps maintain healthy blood and nerve cells and supports DNA production.
Additionally, salmon is high in omega-3 fatty acids. These fatty acids help reduce risk factors for cardiovascular disease, cancer, dementia, and Alzheimer's.
Experts recommend that adults eat seafood at least twice a week, especially omega-3 rich fish like salmon. For pregnant women and children, adding salmon to the diet is also very important.

mon_an.mo_ta: Braised fish with canarium fruits – a characteristic rustic dish of the highland people, is an attractive delicacy with a rich and fragrant flavor. With the wonderful combination of fresh fish and sweet, nutty canarium fruits, this dish not only captivates every diner but also brings a culinary experience steeped in highland culture. If you want to discover how to make this unique dish, let's explore the detailed recipe below! Braised fish with canarium fruits is a simple rustic dish. The rich flavor of the braised fish combined with the unique taste of the canarium fruits highlights the flavors of the homeland.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: White or black canarium fruits (trám) - 0.5 kg
cac_buoc: 1. Prepare ingredients
Step 1: Prepare the canarium fruits
First, soak the canarium fruits in water for one to two hours, then wash and scrub them to remove the sap.

Next, heat water until it begins to shimmer but has not reached a full boil. Note: do not let the water get too hot, as boiling water will make the fruits hard and unevenly cooked. Place the fruits in the water, stir well, then remove and cover tightly to cool gradually. Afterward, use a knife to separate the pulp from the pit and discard the seeds.
If you want a more intense flavor, you can crush fresh canarium fruits to get the pulp and discard the seeds. This makes the dish tastier than using the steeping method.
Step 2: Prepare the fish
Choose fresh fish and clean the inside by removing the entrails. If using small fish, you can keep them whole. For large fish, cut them into small steaks.
Step 3: Prepare the meat
If using pork belly, clean the meat as usual and then slice it into pieces about 1.0 cm thick.
Thus, we have completed the basic preparation steps. Next, we will proceed to cook this dish to enjoy the special flavor of the highlands.
If you want the canarium fruits to be more flavorful, simply crush the fresh fruits to get the pulp and discard the seeds; it's better than steeping them.
2. Braise the fish
Arrange the prepared ingredients in the pot in this order: first the fish, then the canarium fruits, and finally the meat. Note that the top layer should still be fish.

Place the pot on the stove and add the diluted sweet soy sauce, ensuring it covers the surface of the fish. Add a little fish sauce, chili, and caramel sauce; bring to a boil then reduce the heat so the liquid simmers down until only about 1 bowl of liquid remains, blending with the fish fat. When you hear a sizzling sound at the bottom of the pot, the braise is ready.

When the canarium fruits and fish are braised together, the acidity from the fruits permeates the fish, making it tender and richly flavored. The sweetness from the soy sauce and the protein from the fish also soak into the fruits, reducing their astringency and increasing their sweetness. The canarium pieces offer a sweet, sour, and buttery flavor. When eaten with freshly cooked, warm white rice, this dish becomes a simple, rustic, yet delicious meal that brings back fond memories of the countryside.
When serving, you can transfer the fish, meat, and canarium fruits to a plate, and pour the braising liquid into a separate bowl for dipping boiled vegetables.
3. Finished product
The braised fish is still moist with sauce but firm and chewy, fragrant, and rich. The flavor of the canarium fruits completely removes any fishy smell.

The braised canarium pieces take on a reddish-yellow hue from the caramel sauce, blended with shimmering fat, looking very beautiful. The pieces are plump, even larger than fresh ones. They are very soft and velvety in the mouth with an added rich, buttery taste.

The braising liquid is also delicious. It has a golden-red color, shimmering with fat and slightly thickened. It is salty, sweet, nutty, and rich—perfect for dipping boiled water spinach, cabbage, or kohlrabi.

Braised fish with canarium fruits is perhaps the simplest braised fish dish to prepare. It doesn't need spices like ginger, galangal, dried tea leaves, shallots, or starfruit. It only requires fish, pork belly, and canarium fruits.
Tips for a delicious braised fish with canarium fruits

This dish is best made with fresh canarium fruits. Fresh fruits can be stored in the freezer for up to a year to be used gradually, so you don't have to wait for the season. In my family, during the season, my mother usually buys several kilos to both salt and freeze for the whole year.
Any type of fish can be used, but grass carp is particularly delicious.
White canarium fruits with thick pulp are usually used for braising.

To marinate half a kilo of canarium fruits, you need half a liter of high-quality fish sauce; eating these fruits can be more expensive than eating meat. To get a good batch, the drying process is very important.

Buy fresh fruits, steep them, then split them lengthwise into 2 pieces, remove the seeds, and arrange them on a tray to dry under strong sunlight. Occasionally flip the pieces so they dry evenly on both sides.

Dry for 2-3 days until the pieces are shriveled, then wash and let them dry completely. Once dry, boil half a liter of good fish sauce, add a little sugar and MSG, then let it cool to about 50-60 degrees. While still quite warm to the touch, put the fruits in a jar, pour the fish sauce over them, cover tightly, and add a few slices of chili.
After about 10 days, the fruits will be cured. At this point, the pieces will have plumped up again, looking dark brown with a purple tint rather than bright yellow.
These marinated canarium fruits can be kept for 2-3 months without refrigeration.

mon_an.mo_ta: Fish and bamboo shoot soup will bring your family a wonderful meal with its refreshing, mild taste and no fishy flavor. The sweet, tender fish meat blends with the crunchy, sour bamboo shoots to create a perfect combination. Let's explore and make this dish to create an attractive and delicious meal for your family. This guide for fish and bamboo shoot soup will help you make this refreshing dish at home.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Snakehead fish - 1 fish approx. 400-500g (you can use other fish if preferred)
A few stalks of green onions
Culantro or rice paddy herb - Herbs
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare ingredients
Prepare the fish:
To save time, you can ask the seller to clean the snakehead fish, then just rinse it with water. To remove the fishy smell, use these tips:
Method 1: Soak the fish in lemon juice or vinegar mixed with warm water for 3-5 minutes.
Method 2: Use kitchen ash to rub away the slime and odor from the fish body, then rinse with clean water.
Method 3: Soak the fish in rice water mixed with salt for 15-20 minutes, then rinse with clean water.
Method 4: Marinate the prepared fish with white wine for 2-5 minutes, then rinse with clean water.
Prepare other ingredients:
Peel and wash the garlic and shallots, then crush and mince them. Remove the stems from the chili, wash, and slice.
Wash the lemongrass, crush it, and cut it into 2-finger-long segments. For the fresh coconut, crack it to get the water.
Wash the tomatoes and cut them into wedges. Peel the pineapple and remove the eyes, then wash and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Peel the outer layer of the giant elephant ear (bạc hà), wash, and slice diagonally. Rinse the bamboo shoots and squeeze dry.
For the accompanying herbs (green onions, cilantro, rice paddy herb), remove wilted leaves and wash. Soak them in salt water for 5 minutes, then drain and cut into segments.
Step 2: Stir-fry ingredients
Place a pot on the stove over medium heat, add 1 tbsp cooking oil and wait until hot. Once the oil is hot, add the shallots, garlic, and lemongrass and sauté until fragrant.
When the aromatics are fragrant, add the tomatoes and pineapple to the pot and stir-fry for about 2 minutes. Then, add the bamboo shoots and continue stir-frying for another 3 minutes.
Next, season with 1 tbsp chili paste (sa tế), 1 tbsp seasoning powder, 1 tbsp salt, 1 tbsp MSG, 4 tbsp rock sugar, and sliced chili. Stir well to dissolve the seasonings.
Step 3: Cook the soup

Add the coconut water to the pot with the bamboo shoots. If there isn't enough coconut water, add filtered water until the level is about 2 finger-widths above the bamboo shoots. Turn the heat to high and bring to a boil.

Once the water is boiling, add the snakehead fish to the pot and cook for about 5 minutes until the fish is done. Re-season to adjust the sour, sweet, and salty flavors to your family's taste. Finally, add the green onions, cilantro, and rice paddy herb, and the soup is finished!
Step 4: Finished product
When enjoying the snakehead fish and bamboo shoot soup, gradually add the washed accompanying herbs to the pot. This will give you a fragrant and attractive pot of soup.

The fresh broth combined with rice vermicelli makes the dish even more delicious. With its sour and spicy flavor, firm sweet fish meat, and crunchy fresh herbs, you can serve it with a small bowl of spicy fish sauce to enhance the flavor.
Good luck and enjoy your fish and bamboo shoot soup!
Notes for making fish and bamboo shoot soup
Choose fresh fish: Ensure you select fresh fish to guarantee the flavor of the soup. The fish should be cleaned and scaled before use.
Use fresh bamboo shoots: If possible, use fresh bamboo shoots instead of dried ones. Fresh shoots provide a better crunch and flavor for the soup.

Prepare the bamboo shoots: If the shoots are young, peel the outer layer and use a bit of salt to remove the characteristic odor. If they are old, cut off the tough base and slice into small pieces before use.

Process the fish: Before adding the fish to the pot, remove the head, tail, and the white lines (veins) to reduce the fishy smell. If necessary, you can marinate the fish with salt and pepper before cooking.
Add spices: Besides basic seasonings like salt, sugar, and seasoning powder, you can add garlic, shallots, and chili to increase the soup's flavor.
Cooking time: Simmer the soup long enough for the fish to be tender and the bamboo shoots to soften. Usually, 15-20 minutes is sufficient.
How to choose fresh snakehead fish
Good snakehead fish are usually medium-sized, not too large or too small. The body should be elongated, not too round; when touched, it should feel firm and not mushy.

Additionally, you can check the fish's vent to determine freshness. Fresh fish will have a small, tight vent, while dead or stale fish will have a larger, distended vent, and sometimes may have been treated with chemicals.
Avoid buying fish that feel soft when pressed, have too much belly fat, or have a foul odor. This indicates the fish is not good or has been dead for a while and should not be used.

mon_an.mo_ta: Baby clam and gourd soup is a delicious, rustic, and incredibly simple dish. This fragrant, refreshing, and nutritious soup is perfect for a hot day. Let's make this for the whole family.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients

Soak and wash the clams thoroughly, then boil them in a pot of water. Filter and set the broth aside. Remove the shells; marinate the clam meat with a bit of pepper, fish sauce, and salt for about 10 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Tip: You can refer to the guide on how to soak and shell clams in the recipes for 'Stir-fried clams with chives' or 'Baby clam and banana blossom soup'.
Peel the gourd, wash it, and either finely chop it or use a grater to shred it into small strips.
Wash the carrot and grate it into strips as well.
Wash the green onions and dill, then cut them into bite-sized pieces.
Step 2: Stir-fry the clams
Heat oil in a pan, sauté the minced shallots until fragrant, then add the clams and stir-fry briefly. Remove and set aside.
Step 3: Cook the soup

Place the clam broth on the stove, bring to a boil, then add the carrots and bring back to a boil. Maintain the heat for 1-2 minutes before adding the gourd. When the water boils, add the stir-fried clams, adjust the seasoning to taste, sprinkle with the chopped green onions and dill, then turn off the heat. Ladle the soup into a bowl and serve hot.
Tips for a delicious baby clam and gourd soup:

You can find quick and easy ways to prepare clams in the stir-fried clams with chives or baby clam and banana blossom soup recipes. When cooking, remember that a little salt was added during boiling and the clams were marinated with fish sauce and salt, so season the soup carefully to avoid making it too salty.

Just like marinating any other ingredient, the secret to delicious cooking is 'aroma first, taste second.' This means marinating with aromatic spices like pepper, garlic, cinnamon, or star anise first, followed by fish sauce and salt.

Stir-frying clams with fish sauce brings out a better aroma, so I prefer using it. It tastes great in the soup. However, some people dislike using fish sauce in soup as they claim it leaves a bitter aftertaste. Adjust the seasonings based on your family's preference.

When buying gourd, choose ones with dark green skin and white spots. The gourd should look fresh, not too old or too young, and have a uniform shape rather than bulging at the end; these are usually meaty with fewer seeds.
Do not cook the clams for too long, as they will become mealy, lose their natural sweetness, and turn rubbery.

mon_an.mo_ta: Luffa is a nutrient-rich vegetable known for its skin-brightening properties, making it a great food to eat during the summer to combat the sun's rays. You can enjoy it in this nutritious, sweet, and visually appealing luffa and shrimp soup!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Stock powder, fish sauce, salt, MSG... - seasonings
cac_buoc: Peel the luffa, cut it in half lengthwise, and slice diagonally into bite-sized pieces to make the soup look more attractive.
Place the dried shrimp in a bowl and cover with warm water. Soak for about 20 minutes until softened.
Gently squeeze the shrimp with your hands to remove any sand or grit, then squeeze dry. Lightly crush the shrimp in a mortar.
Sauté some minced shallots with a very small amount of oil, then add the dried shrimp and enough water for the soup (you can use bone broth for extra flavor) and bring to a boil.
Once the pot boils, lower the heat to a simmer to extract the sweetness from the shrimp. Add the luffa and season to taste.
When serving, sprinkle with a little black pepper and chopped green onions.
Finally, ladle the soup into a bowl and enjoy.

mon_an.ten: Sweet and Sour Clam Soup with Pineapple and Bean Sprouts
mon_an.mo_ta: This recipe for sweet and sour clam soup with pineapple, bean sprouts, and lemongrass is very quick and simple, yet it's an incredibly easy-to-eat and delicious dish featuring sweet clam meat and a hint of tartness from pineapple and tomatoes. This colorful bowl of soup is very appealing and will surely earn compliments from everyone! Let's explore how to make this dish with Món Ngon Mỗi Ngày. Enjoy the wonderful flavors of this sweet and sour clam soup. Detailed instructions on how to make the best clam soup, creating an attractive dish with a unique blend of fresh pineapple, refreshing bean sprouts, fragrant lemongrass, and a signature sweet and sour taste.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Ingredients - Green onions, Vietnamese coriander, shallots
cac_buoc: Step 1: Slice the pineapple into small bite-sized pieces, cut the tomatoes into wedges, and thinly slice the shallots.
Wash and finely chop the Vietnamese coriander and green onions.
Step 2: Wash the clams thoroughly and boil them until they open their shells. Remove the clam meat and wash it clean. Set the clam broth aside to use as the soup base.

Step 3: Sauté the shallots until fragrant, add the tomatoes and stir, adding a pinch of salt. Then add the clams and stir-fry until fragrant (do not overcook to keep the clams sweet). Scoop the stir-fried clams into a bowl and set aside.
Pour the clam broth into the pot, add the dracontomelon (sấu), and bring to a boil. Once the sấu is soft, add the pineapple and the stir-fried clam meat, then cook for another 4-5 minutes.
Step 4: Sprinkle the green onions and Vietnamese coriander on top and stir well. Add 1 tablespoon of fish sauce for a richer flavor, then turn off the heat.
Enjoy your meal!
Notes for making clam and pineapple soup:
Choose fresh clams: Select fresh clams that have no foul odor and tightly closed shells. If any clams do not open after boiling, discard them as they may not be safe to eat.
Prepare the pineapple: Choose a ripe, juicy pineapple with a golden color and characteristic aroma. Peel and remove the eyes before using.
Use fresh ingredients: Ensure the bean sprouts are fresh with no signs of spoilage. If the bean sprouts have tough parts, peel and remove them.
Wash thoroughly: Before using, wash the clams, pineapple, and bean sprouts with clean water to remove dirt and impurities.

Add lemongrass and sourness: Lemongrass and sour agents are two important components of this soup. Lemongrass can be bruised or finely chopped to enhance the aroma. Sourness can be added from lime juice or vinegar.
Cook for the right amount of time: When cooking the soup, ensure the clams are cooked through but not overcooked, as they can lose their natural sweetness.

mon_an.mo_ta: Fish cakes are a favorite for many. Instead of the usual fish cakes you eat daily or buy at shops, why not try making your own crispy, fragrant, and delicious fried version?
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Cut the fish fillet into small pieces.
Cut the carrot and onion into small pieces.
Place the fish in a blender.
Step 2:

Next, add the carrot, onion, garlic, and pork to the blender and process until finely minced. If the mixture is too dry, you can add a few tablespoons of water. Finely chop the green onions, dill, and fresh chilies.
In a bowl, combine the minced fish and meat mixture, chilies, egg, frying flour, salt, pepper, green onions, and dill. Mix well until you have a thick, sticky paste.
Step 3:
Place a pan on the stove and heat the cooking oil. Shape the fish paste into small patties and place them in the pan. Fry until both sides are golden brown.
These fish cakes are very fragrant and crispy, making them impossible to resist. They pair perfectly with chili sauce.

Braised fish cakes have become a familiar and beloved dish thanks to their delicious flavor and simple preparation. You don't need to be a professional chef; just follow these simple steps to have a wonderful meal that is sure to be a 'rice-killer.' Enjoy the joy of cooking and share it with your loved ones!
I. How to make flavorful braised fish cakes
1. Prepare ingredients
400g Fish cakes
6 cloves Garlic
1 Horn chili
2 stalks Green onions
3 tsp Fish sauce
1 tbsp Chili sauce
1 tbsp Oyster sauce
1 tbsp Cooking oil
Common seasonings (sugar, salt, ground pepper) a little
2. Steps to make braised fish cakes
2.1. Prepare the fish cakes
After buying the fish cakes, use a knife to cut them into bite-sized strips.
Peel the garlic, wash, crush, and mince it.
Wash the chili, cut off both ends, remove the seeds, and slice into strips.
Remove the wilted leaves and roots of the green onions, wash, and chop finely.
2.2. Prepare the sauce
In a bowl, pour in about 100ml of filtered water.
Add 1 tbsp chili sauce, 1 tbsp oyster sauce, 3 tsp fish sauce, 1 tsp sugar, and 1/2 tsp MSG.
Stir well until all seasonings are fully combined.
2.3. Braise the fish cakes
Place a pan on the stove, add 1 tbsp cooking oil, and wait until hot.
Add the minced garlic to the pan and sauté until fragrant.
Next, add the fish cakes to the pan and stir well.
When the fish cakes are slightly firm, pour the prepared sauce into the pan and braise for about 20 minutes.
Cook until the sauce boils, then reduce the heat and continue braising until the sauce reaches your desired thickness.
Add the sliced chili, 1 tsp ground pepper, and green onions to the pan, then stir well.
Adjust the seasoning to suit your family's taste and braise for another 3 minutes before turning off the heat.
2.4. Finished product

The finished pepper-braised fish cakes have an attractive aroma and eye-catching color, making the meal more appetizing. When enjoyed, the fish cakes are soft, chewy, and flavorful, combined with the rich sauce that will keep your family coming back for more.
II. How to make braised fish cakes with quail eggs
500g Basa fish cakes
200g Quail eggs
Shallots
Garlic
Green onions
Cilantro
Seasonings to prepare:
Sugar
Stock powder
MSG
Soy sauce
Fish sauce
Cooking oil
Ground pepper
2. Steps to braise with quail eggs
Step 1: Prepare ingredients
Cut the fish cakes into small bite-sized pieces.
Boil the quail eggs in water for about 10 minutes until cooked, then peel them.
Peel and mince the shallots and garlic.
Wash and chop the green onions and cilantro.
Here are some tips for peeling quail eggs quickly and easily:
To peel quail eggs quickly, add a little salt to the boiling water.
Once the water boils, lower the heat and cover the pot for about 5 minutes so the eggs don't dry out.
During boiling, use chopsticks to stir in a clockwise direction so the yolks stay centered, which looks better when cut.
To check if the eggs are cooked, try picking one up with chopsticks. If it's easy to pick up, it's done.
Once cooked, soak in cold water or run under cold water to cool. Place the eggs in a container with a little water, cover, and shake vigorously to help the shells loosen.
Step 2: Marinate the quail eggs
Place the eggs in a bowl and add ½ tbsp soy sauce. Stir well and marinate for about 5 minutes.
Step 3: Fry the fish cakes
In a pan, add 100ml cooking oil. When the oil is hot, add the fish cakes and fry over medium heat. Fry until they puff up and are golden brown on both sides. Remove and drain on paper towels.
Step 4: Make the caramel color
Before braising, you need to make the caramel color. In a pan, add 3 tbsp sugar and 1 tbsp water. Cook until the sugar mixture is almost yellow, then lower the heat.
When the sugar turns a deep amber color, add 3 tbsp water to the pan. Stir the mixture well and turn off the heat.
Step 5: Braise fish cakes with quail eggs
In a pot, add about 1 tbsp cooking oil and heat until hot. Add the minced shallots and garlic and sauté until fragrant.
Next, add a few green onions and stir-fry. Then, turn off the heat.
In the pot, add 1 cup of water and the prepared caramel sauce. Turn on medium heat and bring the liquid to a boil.
When it starts boiling, add the fish cakes to the pot. Season with ¼ tbsp MSG, 3 tbsp fish sauce, and ½ tsp stock powder.
Next, add the quail eggs to the pot and braise for about 10 minutes.
After braising for 10 minutes, turn off the heat. Sprinkle some ground pepper, cilantro, and green onions over the dish. The dish is now complete.
III. Notes for making braised fish cakes at home
Choose fresh ingredients: Ensure the fish cakes and quail eggs are purchased from reputable sources to ensure a delicious and safe meal.
Prepare ingredients correctly: Cut fish cakes into bite-sized pieces and finely mince shallots and garlic. Prepare boiled and peeled quail eggs.
Boil quail eggs for the right time: Boil for about 10 minutes to cook completely. Cool and peel before use.
Fry fish cakes evenly and crisply: Ensure the oil is hot enough before frying. Fry over medium heat until puffed and golden on both sides. Drain well.
Make caramel color with the right technique: Cook sugar and water until amber. Lower the heat before adding more water to avoid splashing.

Braise over low heat: Once the caramel sauce is in the pot, cook over medium heat. When boiling, add fish cakes and season to taste. Braise for about 10 minutes over low heat so the flavors penetrate the fish cakes.

mon_an.ten: Fish Cake Balls with Quail Eggs
mon_an.mo_ta: A flavorful and perfect 'rice-killer' dish that we want to introduce to you is fish cake balls with quail eggs. With simple ingredients and an easy process, let's get into the kitchen to make this for your whole family!
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients as shown in the picture!
Once all necessary ingredients are ready, let's start making the fish cake balls with quail eggs!
Step 1: First, we will make the fish paste
After buying the grass carp fillet, wash and cut it into chunks. For the pork, slice it into thin pieces (as shown above).
Next, put everything into a large bowl. Add one tablespoon of fish sauce, minced shallots, a bit of pepper, and MSG.
Step 2:
Mix all the ingredients in the bowl thoroughly. Marinate for 30 minutes so the fish and meat absorb the flavors.
While waiting for the fish to marinate, wash and boil the quail eggs. Soak the wood ear mushrooms in hot water until they expand.
Step 3:
After 30 minutes, put the fish and meat into a blender and grind until smooth. Note: do not add water; grind it dry.
Transfer the minced fish to a bowl. To make the paste smoother, you can use your hand to slap or knead the paste until it becomes soft and elastic.
Step 4: Now that the fish paste is ready, we will prepare the tomato sauce
Wash the tomatoes and cut them into wedges.
Wash the green onions and chop them finely.
Step 5:
Peel the boiled quail eggs and rinse them again. Trim the stems off the soaked wood ear mushrooms, wash, and chop them into small pieces.
Step 6: Time to use the fish paste.
Take a small amount of fish paste, flatten it in your palm, place a quail egg in the center, and roll it into a ball. One fish cake ball is complete.
Step 7:
Repeat the process with the remaining fish paste and quail eggs, placing them neatly on a clean plate.
Step 8:
Heat a pan with oil until very hot, then fry each fish cake ball until golden. Note: you don't need to fry them until very dark; just a light golden color is enough.
Step 9:
In another pan, heat some oil. When hot, add minced shallots and sauté until fragrant.
Next, add the tomatoes and stir-fry. Add a little salt, MSG, or stock powder to help the tomatoes soften quickly, then add the chopped wood ear mushrooms and continue to stir-fry.
Step 10:
Add the fried fish cake balls to the pan.
Stir gently so the fish balls don't burn.
Step 11:
Add a little water and season to suit your family's taste.
Simmer until the sauce thickens slightly, then add the green onions, stir well, and add a bit of MSG for a better flavor.
Step 12:
Finally, turn off the heat and transfer the fish cake balls with quail eggs to a plate or bowl.
Enjoying this delicious dish with hot rice is absolutely wonderful!

mon_an.mo_ta: Cốm is made from young glutinous rice. The best cốm comes from young rice that is still milky and hasn't fully plumped up like ripe paddy. In Hanoi, the Dịch Vọng fields specialize in this crop. The rice is expensive and the process of making cốm is very elaborate, so fresh cốm currently costs over 200,000 VND per kg. This is a specialty of Vòng village in Hanoi. Today, let's prepare this Chả cốm dish. There are two ways: the first is mixing cốm with minced meat and pork paste to fry directly.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Cooking oil or olive oil - as needed
cac_buoc: How to make Chả cốm
Step 1: Prepare ingredients;

In a large bowl, combine the pork paste, 2/3 of the green rice, fish sauce, and ground pepper. Mix and knead thoroughly with a spoon so the rice and meat blend together. Let it sit for about 5 minutes for the rice to expand. If using dry green rice, you must soak it in a little boiling water to soften it first, or mix it with an egg for a nice texture.
Step 2: Prepare the dipping sauce

While waiting for the meat to marinate, prepare the sauce: put 3 tablespoons of fish sauce in a bowl. Peel the lemon, separate the segments, and add the pulp to the bowl. Add chopped or crushed chilies according to your taste. Mix the fish sauce, lemon, chili, and garlic; you can add a little sugar and cooled boiled water to taste.
Step 3: Frying the Chả cốm directly

Use a spoon to take small portions, roll them into balls, and then flatten them. Roll the patties in the remaining green rice or sprinkle more on the surface. You can use flower or leaf molds to make the patties more attractive.
Heat oil in a pan over low heat and fry the patties until golden brown on both sides.
Remove and place on paper towels to drain excess oil.
Line a plate with a lotus leaf cut into a flower shape and arrange the patties on top. Serve hot.
Method 2: Steaming before frying
Wrap the meat mixture in a lotus leaf. To create a nice shape, place the lotus leaf into a square, rectangular, or round container, pour the mixture in, press firmly with a spoon, and wrap it up.

Place the mold in a steamer and steam for about 10 minutes. Remove the cake, cut into desired shapes, then fry until golden and serve hot. Arrange as in the first method. Using lotus leaves makes the dish more attractive, elegant, and deeply Vietnamese. This dish can also be served with chili sauce.

For delicious and fragrant Chả cốm, choose lean pork without fat. Fresh green rice is preferred for better aroma. If fresh rice is unavailable, dry rice works too, but remember to soak it in cooled boiled water to soften it first; otherwise, it won't blend with the meat and will be too hard to eat.
Do not use onions or garlic in the mixture to preserve the characteristic aroma of the green rice.

mon_an.mo_ta: On hot summer days, if your family is tired of fried or stir-fried dishes, steamed lotus seed meatloaf is an excellent choice.
cac_buoc: Step 1:

Mix the ground pork and pork paste thoroughly, kneading for a while to create a chewy texture. After soaking in water to soften, cut the glass noodles into short sections and thinly slice the wood ear mushrooms. Wash the lotus seeds and peas, then boil until cooked. Drain the seeds and peas well.
Step 2:
Mix the wood ear mushrooms and glass noodles into the meat mixture, season to taste, and let marinate for about 20 minutes.
Step 3:
Mix the peas and lotus seeds into the meat and pork paste mixture. Place in a bowl or a ceramic/glass dish and steam for 20 minutes.
Step 4:
Beat 1 egg yolk and brush it evenly over the surface once the meatloaf is cooked. Steam for another 5 minutes. Serve hot with chili sauce.
Step 5:
Lotus seeds are highly nutritious and also serve as a traditional medicine.

mon_an.ten: Grilled Pork with Galangal and Fermented Rice
mon_an.mo_ta: In this winter weather, enjoying rich grilled pork with galangal and fermented rice served with hot rice or rice vermicelli is wonderful. Let's get into the kitchen and make this dish following these instructions! Discover how to make delicious and nutritious grilled pork with galangal and fermented rice. Detailed guide with steps for ingredient preparation, seasoning, and grilling. Enjoy the characteristic flavor of pork combined with the aroma of galangal and fermented rice. This dish is not only tasty but also provides nutrition for your meal.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fish sauce, shrimp paste, sugar, oil, lemon, chili, Thai basil, green onions
cac_buoc: After preparing the ingredients, let's process them:
Choose pork belly with the ribs removed so the meat is thick and lean. Wash, drain, and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Peel the galangal, slice thinly, and crush or grind it. Finely chop the green onions.
Mash the fermented rice (mẻ) through a sieve.
Let's start cooking!
Step 1:
Marinate the pork with shrimp paste, fish sauce, sugar, oil, turmeric powder, galangal, fermented rice, and green onions for about 1 hour to absorb the flavors.
Step 2:
Arrange the meat on a grilling rack and grill over medium charcoal, turning both sides until the meat is golden brown and fragrant.
While grilling, you can brush some of the marinade onto the meat to enhance the aroma and color.
Step 3:

*How to mix the shrimp paste:* Cut a lemon in half and squeeze for juice. In a bowl, combine shrimp paste, lemon juice, and sugar. Stir until the sugar dissolves and the paste becomes frothy. Adjust to taste.
Serve with the prepared shrimp paste and Thai basil.
Note:
If you don't like pork belly, you can choose pork shoulder, but avoid using pork leg as it will become dry after grilling.
This grilled pork dish can be served with rice or vermicelli. The dipping sauce can be replaced with chili-lime fish sauce if preferred!
2. Grilled pork with galangal and fermented rice using an air fryer
Prepare ingredients
600g Pork belly
1 Galangal root
2 Lemongrass stalks
2 tbsp Fermented rice (strained)
1 tbsp Turmeric powder
2 tbsp Cooking oil
1 tbsp Shrimp paste
2 tbsp Fish sauce
1 tbsp Sugar
1 tbsp Ground pepper
Steps to prepare
1. Prepare ingredients
To grill pork belly with an air fryer, first soak the pork in diluted salt water for 5-10 minutes, then wash and drain.
Next, cut the pork belly into bite-sized squares, about 1.5-2 cm thick, to ensure the meat doesn't dry out. Avoid cutting too thin to keep the meat juicy and tender.
Peel the galangal, wash, and grind or mince it. Similarly, for the lemongrass, remove the base, peel the outer layer, wash, and mince.
2. Marinate the meat

To marinate the pork belly, combine the meat with a spice mixture including minced galangal, minced lemongrass, 2 tbsp strained fermented rice, 1 tbsp shrimp paste, 2 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp pepper, 1 tbsp turmeric powder, 1 tbsp sugar, and 2 tbsp cooking oil.
Mix these ingredients for about 5 minutes, then marinate for about 1 hour so the meat absorbs the seasonings.
3. Grill with an air fryer
Line the air fryer basket with foil and arrange the marinated meat inside.
Start by grilling at 180°C for about 10 minutes. Then, open the fryer and flip the meat to ensure even cooking.
Continue grilling at 180°C for another 25 minutes until the meat is cooked through and has an attractive golden-brown color.
4. Finished product
Once finished, you can serve the grilled pork with shrimp paste, fresh herbs, and rice vermicelli for a perfect combination.
The grilled pork is complete with an inviting aroma and color. The meat is fragrant, tender, and not dry, with well-balanced seasoning. Sharing this with your family will surely captivate everyone.
This is a simple yet attractive dish. If you are hesitant, try it and experience its unique flavor. You will be surprised and satisfied with the special taste it brings.
Notes on choosing pork
When buying pork, choose pieces that are light pink or deep red, have good elasticity, and feel dry to the touch.
Prioritize buying pork from reputable supermarkets and stores with clear origins.
Avoid buying pork that is pale, has an unpleasant odor, or poor elasticity, as these are signs of spoiled meat.

mon_an.ten: Stir-fried Pork Knuckle with Coconut Milk
mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried pork knuckle with coconut milk is not only a delicious dish for family meals but also a favorite for husbands during drinking sessions! Check out how to make this dish in the article below! Instructions on how to make delicious stir-fried pork knuckle at home, Western Vietnamese style. Simple steps using easy-to-find ingredients to help you create a rich dish with the characteristic flavors of the Mekong Delta. A perfect menu for a diverse and tasty lunch or dinner.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Common seasonings - a little (stock powder/ sugar/ salt)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the aromatics: finely mince the shallots, garlic, lemongrass, and chili.
Step 2:
Thinly slice ½ of the onion lengthwise into bite-sized pieces.
Char the pork knuckle skin until slightly singed, then separate the meat from the bone.
Slice the meat into bite-sized pieces, trying to keep the meat and skin attached.
Step 3:

Marinate the meat with: ½ of the minced garlic, lemongrass, chili, and shallots, along with stock powder, MSG, fish sauce, fermented soybean paste, and curry powder. Let sit for 20-30 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Step 4:
Sauté the remaining ½ of the shallots, garlic, lemongrass, and chili until fragrant. Turn the heat to high and add the marinated meat, stirring well. Keep the heat high.
Step 5:
Next, pour in the coconut milk and stir well.
Step 6:
When nearly cooked, add the sliced onion.
Step 7:
Finally, transfer to a plate, serve hot, and sprinkle crushed roasted peanuts on top.
How to choose good ingredients
How to choose good onions
When choosing onions, select bulbs with thin, shiny skins, uniform color, and that feel dry and firm to the touch. Good onions will have tight, smooth skins without dark spots.
Avoid onions that have sprouted, have alternating hard and soft spots, or uneven coloring, as these are signs they are not fresh and may be bitter.
Round-shaped onions are usually the best, and if the onion has many long roots, it is a sign of freshness.
How to choose delicious wood ear mushrooms
For this dish, you can use either white or black wood ear mushrooms. To choose good ones, look for large, thick caps with few small mushroom buds at the base.
The top of the mushroom should be a deep amber color and slightly shiny, while the underside should be the color of coffee with milk.
If you see white mold, absolutely do not buy them as it is a sign of spoilage.
How to prepare pork knuckle without odor
Method 1: First, blanch the pork knuckle in boiling water for 2-3 minutes, then rinse with cold water. This helps remove unwanted odors.
Method 2: Alternatively, you can use about two tablespoons of lemon juice (or vinegar/wine) to rub over the surface of the knuckle, let it sit for 2-3 minutes, then rinse clean with cold water.
Both methods help ensure the pork knuckle is clean and odor-free.
Notes for making stir-fried pork knuckle
Choose fresh pork knuckle: Select ones with even pink color, no foul odor, and clean white fat. Ensure the skin is not too thick or too thin.
Slice thinly: When slicing the knuckle, cut into thin slices so it cooks evenly and faster. Slices should be about 4-5 cm wide.
Marinate: Before stir-frying, marinate with aromatics and seasonings to enhance the flavor.
Stir-fry evenly: Ensure the meat is tossed evenly in the pan so it cooks thoroughly while maintaining its texture.
Use high heat: When stir-frying, the pan temperature needs to be high enough to cook the meat quickly and keep it from becoming soggy.
Add signature seasonings: To bring out the Western Vietnamese flavor, you can add ingredients like fermented soybean paste, honey, roasted peanuts, and turmeric powder.
Garnish and enjoy: When presenting, garnish the dish with fresh herbs, green onions, and fresh chilies for color, and enjoy with hot rice.

mon_an.ten: Chạo Tôm: Grilled Shrimp Mousse on Sugarcane and Lemongrass
mon_an.mo_ta: Chạo tôm is a Hue dish, originating from the ancient royal kitchens created by skillful chefs. Thus, we can consider Chạo tôm an ancient and unique royal dish. Today, we can enjoy delicious Chạo tôm without taking too much time to prepare. With familiar everyday ingredients and just a little preparation time, you will have a plate of golden, flavorful Chạo tôm with a royal touch. Perfect for a cool day, served with green banana slices, sour starfruit, lettuce, and herbs wrapped in rice paper—nothing could be better! Let's learn how to make grilled Chạo tôm!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Pepper, sugar, seasoning powder, fish sauce - to taste
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel the shrimp, remove the veins, heads, and tails, then grind into a fine paste. Wash and finely chop the lean pork and fat, then grind. (Can substitute with raw pork paste).

Step 2: Mix the ground shrimp and pork with crushed pepper, minced shallots, garlic, a bit of sugar, salt, and 1 tsp fish sauce. Knead and mix thoroughly until the mixture is springy and elastic. Peel the sugarcane and cut into 15 cm segments (If sugarcane is unavailable, use regular sugarcane, peeled, quartered, and cut into 15 cm segments).
Step 3: Wear disposable gloves and mold the shrimp mousse around each sugarcane stalk, about 1 cm thick and 10 cm long.
Step 4: Arrange the shrimp mousse sticks in a steamer, steam until cooked, then remove and let cool.
Step 5: Grill the shrimp mousse until golden brown.
Step 6: Arrange the Chạo tôm on a plate and enjoy with rice paper rolls, green banana, sour starfruit, lettuce, and herbs—a perfect match!

mon_an.ten: Thai-Style Stir-Fried Mussels with Coconut Milk
mon_an.mo_ta: Want to know how to make delicious Thai-style stir-fried mussels with coconut milk but don't know where to look? Today, we will show you step-by-step how to create an attractive and flavorful Thai dish. Mussels, which are small and delicious, are stir-fried with fresh coconut and signature spices. This dish combines spicy, sour, and sweet flavors, creating a wonderful combination. Detailed instructions on how to make super delicious Thai-style stir-fried mussels. Enjoy this attractive dish with its spicy, sour, and sweet flavors, as the tasty mussels are stir-fried with fresh coconut milk and characteristic spices.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
To prepare the ingredients for Thai-style stir-fried mussels, follow these steps:
Prepare the mussels: Wash the mussels and remove the heads and tails. You can leave them whole or cut into small pieces as desired.
Sauté the curry paste: Heat a large pan with a little cooking oil. Add green curry paste and stir-fry for a few seconds so the mussels absorb the curry flavor.
Stir-fry the mussels: Place the mussels in the pan and stir-fry over high heat for about 2-3 minutes until cooked and golden.
Add coconut milk: Pour coconut milk into the pan with the mussels and stir well. Bring to a boil and reduce to low heat.
Seasoning: Add fish sauce to the pan and stir well to let the seasoning soak into the mussels.
Basil and cilantro: Add basil leaves and cilantro to the pan. Stir well to blend the flavors and aromas.
Continue stir-frying: Continue stir-frying for a few minutes until the mussels are tender and the seasoning is well absorbed.
Check and adjust: If necessary, taste the stir-fried mussels. Add seasoning like salt, sugar, or fish sauce to adjust to your taste.
Presentation and enjoyment: Serve the stir-fried mussels on a plate and garnish with fresh basil and cilantro. This dish is usually served with steamed rice or bread.
Step 2: Cooking
Mussels: Wash the mussels and remove the heads and tails. You can leave them whole or cut into small pieces as desired.
Green curry paste: In a large pan, heat a little cooking oil and add green curry paste. Stir-fry for a few seconds so the mussels absorb the curry flavor.
Mussels: Place the mussels in the pan and stir-fry over high heat for about 2-3 minutes until cooked and golden.
Coconut milk: Add coconut milk to the pan and stir well with the mussels. Bring to a boil and reduce to low heat.
Fish sauce: Add fish sauce to the pan and stir well to let the seasoning soak into the mussels. If needed, adjust the amount of fish sauce to your taste.
Basil and cilantro: Add basil leaves and cilantro to the pan, stir well to blend the flavors and aromas.
Continue stir-frying: Continue stir-frying for a few minutes until the mussels are tender and the seasoning is well absorbed.
After completing the steps above, serve the Thai-style stir-fried mussels on a plate and enjoy while hot. This dish is often eaten with steamed rice or bread to enjoy its unique flavor.
Once the dish is finished, scoop it into a bowl. It looks delicious, doesn't it!!!
Some tips for delicious stir-fried mussels:

For the best stir-fry, first choose very fresh mussels, ensuring none are dead or smelly. Choose mussels of uniform size. Note that for seafood, do not choose dead or spoiled items, as they can cause food poisoning because seafood decomposes and creates toxins harmful to digestion and the body when dead.

Mussels must be soaked and washed thoroughly to remove all dirt. If the shells are dirty, you can use a sponge to scrub them clean. Then soak the mussels in rice water or diluted salt water, adding a few slices of chili to help the mussels release all grit.
When stir-frying, you can replace plain water with broth (if available) to make the dish richer.

mon_an.mo_ta: Exploring and experimenting with new dishes every day is a wonderful way to bring variety and excitement to our meals. Today, we will discover a unique delicacy – Stir-Fried Snails with Green Bananas. With just a few simple ingredients like mature green bananas, snails, and various spices, you can create an attractive and flavorful dish. Let's learn how to make this unique and interesting meal for your lunch or dinner. This guide shows you how to prepare stir-fried snails with green bananas, featuring fresh snails and savory spices to create a delicious meal for the whole family.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients

When buying snails, choose large, uniform ones for fat and crunchy meat. Soak the snails in rice water for 3-4 hours to remove mud and eliminate any fishy odor. Drain the snails and crack the shells to extract the meat. Wash the snail meat with diluted salt water, keeping only the heads and discarding the innards and tails.

Finely mince the dried shallots and garlic. Wash the chili, slice thinly, and mince. Peel the green bananas, cut into chunks, and soak in diluted salt water to prevent browning. Pick and wash the piper lolot and perilla leaves, then shred them. Crush the roasted peanuts.
Wash the pork fat, cut into bite-sized pieces, and fry until the fat is rendered and the pieces become crispy cracklings. Remove the cracklings and set aside to drain.
Step 2: Marinate the ingredients

Once the snails are drained, marinate them with ½ of the minced shallots and garlic, 1.5 tsp seasoning powder, 1 tsp MSG, 1.5 tsp turmeric powder, ½ of the sliced chili, 1 tbsp cooking oil, 1 tsp pepper, and ½ tsp chili powder for 20 minutes to absorb the flavors.
After soaking the bananas in salt water, blanch them in boiling water and then soak them in a solution of water mixed with 2 tsp turmeric powder. After 20-25 minutes, remove and drain.

Heat oil in a pan and sauté the minced garlic until fragrant, then add ½ tsp chili powder for color. Add the marinated snails and stir-fry over high heat. Once the snails are cooked, remove them and set aside on a plate.

In the same pan, sauté the remaining minced garlic and 1 tsp chili powder, then add the bananas to stir-fry. Add 1 bowl of water (just enough to nearly cover the bananas) and turn the heat to medium. Season with 1.5 tsp seasoning powder, 1 tsp MSG, and 1 tsp pepper. Cover and simmer until the bananas are tender. When the water has reduced, add the stir-fried snails and toss well for about 2 minutes. Adjust the seasoning to taste. Finally, add the pork cracklings, perilla leaves, piper lolot leaves, and ½ of the roasted peanuts. Mix well and turn off the heat.
Place the stir-fried snails and bananas on a plate, sprinkle with a little pepper, a few slices of red chili, and the remaining roasted peanuts.

mon_an.ten: Steamed Rice with Fish and Mushrooms
mon_an.mo_ta: This is a dish that evokes a sense of home whenever it's mentioned, rich with the flavors of fish, mushrooms, and aromatic spices. Let's make this savory steamed rice with fish and mushrooms!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Sesame oil and a little cilantro/scallions
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Soak the mushrooms until fully expanded, wash thoroughly, and slice thinly.
Step 2:
Slice the fish fillet. Mix the fish and mushrooms with a pinch of salt, soy sauce, julienned ginger, cooking oil, a tiny bit of sugar, and a little cornstarch. Toss well to coat.
Step 3:
Rinse the rice lightly and drain. Mix the rice with 1 tsp of oil and a tiny pinch of salt.
Step 4:
Add water until it just covers the surface of the rice (do not add too much water, as the fish will release juices into the rice later).
Step 5:
Place the pot on the stove and cook until the water has just evaporated, then add the marinated fish and mushrooms.
Spread the fish evenly over the surface of the rice, cover with a lid, and continue cooking until both the rice and fish are fully cooked.
Note: If the taste is too light when serving, add a few drops of soy sauce, sesame oil, ground pepper, and chopped scallions/cilantro and mix well for a fragrant and delicious meal.
You can also cook this dish in an electric rice cooker; a clay pot or saucepan is not strictly necessary.

mon_an.mo_ta: Five-color mixed fried rice is a delicious and crowd-pleasing dish. Let's prepare this visually appealing and tasty meal at home!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Cooked rice (cold or hot) - as desired
Dried shallots, scallions, cilantro - as needed
Black pepper, cooking oil, fish sauce, soy sauce - seasonings
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Break up the rice so the grains are separate and dry. (You should choose a rice variety that is firm and not too sticky or mushy for the best fried rice).
Slice the sausages into thin diagonal rounds or small pieces.
Dice the onion and red bell pepper.
Finely chop the scallions, mince the dried shallots, and roughly chop the cilantro.
Step 2:
Add a little oil to a pan and sauté the sausages until the edges are slightly charred. Season lightly and transfer to a separate plate.
Continue by sautéing the vegetables—okra, red bell pepper, and onion—one by one until they are just cooked through, ensuring they stay crisp and not mushy. Season to taste.
Once sautéed, transfer the vegetables to a separate plate.
Step 3:

Heat cooking oil and sauté the minced shallots until fragrant. When the shallots turn golden, crack the eggs into the pan and stir quickly. While the eggs are still soft and not yet fully set, add the rice. Increase to high heat and toss quickly. Add the chopped scallions and mix well.
Step 4:
Add seasonings and a splash of fish sauce to the pan to taste, then continue tossing.
When the rice grains are firm and slightly toasted, add the sautéed vegetables and sausages. Toss everything together until well combined and the flavors meld into the rice.
Transfer the rice to a plate and garnish with cilantro. Sprinkle with black pepper before serving to enhance the flavor.

mon_an.mo_ta: Have you ever made crab fried rice? If not, give it a try; it is a unique and delicious dish.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 2 tbsp minced ginger; 2 cloves minced garlic; 2 bowls white rice; 1 pinch white pepper; 45ml fish sauce; 15ml soy sauce; 15ml cooking wine; Salt to taste; 2 eggs, beaten; 1 bowl shelled crab meat; 2 scallions, chopped; Cilantro, finely chopped; Lemon wedges, 3-4 tbsp oil
cac_buoc: Heat the cooking oil in a pan over medium heat. Sauté the ginger for 30 seconds, then add the garlic and sauté until fragrant.
Add the rice and turn the heat to high. Fry the rice for 3 minutes or longer until well combined.
Add the pepper, fish sauce, soy sauce, and cooking wine to the pan. Season with a little salt to taste. Stir the rice constantly so the ingredients are evenly absorbed.
Pour in the eggs and stir quickly and evenly so the eggs coat the rice grains.

Before adding the crab, use a spoon or wooden spatula to push the rice to the sides of the pan, then add the crab to the center. Stir well. Once the crab meat is heated through, add the scallions and cilantro, fry for a bit longer, then remove to a bowl and enjoy.
You can serve the rice with chili sauce, chili oil, or soy sauce as desired!

mon_an.mo_ta: This shrimp and egg fried rice recipe is perfect for using up leftover cold rice and items in your fridge like scallions and tomatoes. This is a dish you will definitely want to eat many times because it is simple to make and very delicious. Refer to our recipe for flavorful shrimp and egg fried rice in the article below!
cac_buoc: Step 1:

Crack the egg into a bowl and whisk well with a little salt for flavor. Place a pan on the stove, heat the oil, add the egg, and stir constantly to make scrambled eggs. Remove the eggs to a separate bowl.
Step 2:
In another pan, sauté the garlic with the onion or shallots (optional), then add the tomatoes and sauté until soft. Add the peas and stir-fry for about 3-5 minutes until cooked. Season to taste.
Step 3:

Add the peeled shrimp and stir until they just turn pink, then add the rice and eggs. Toss the pan well to mix all ingredients, then adjust the seasoning to taste. Stir once more and turn off the heat.

mon_an.ten: Quick and Delicious Pork Rib Rice
mon_an.mo_ta: With this pork rib rice recipe, you will have a very quick, nutritious, and attractive meal for your family!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Wash the ribs and blanch them with the scallion whites and 2 slices of ginger to remove any odors.
Step 2:
Marinate the ribs with five-spice powder, soy sauce, salt, and a little sugar for about 30 minutes.
Step 3:
While waiting, soak the mushrooms until soft, then finely chop them along with the carrot.
Step 4:
Fry the ribs until golden brown on both sides, then add the carrots and mushrooms and sauté for about 1 minute.
Step 5:
Wash the rice, add water, then add the ribs and mushrooms to the pot and turn on the stove to cook.
Note: You only need to add the same amount of water as you would for cooking normal rice!
When the rice is cooked, you can fluff it and serve!
Since this is cooked in a rice cooker, you don't have to watch it or worry about it burning!
Just leave it on the keep-warm function to have hot pork rib rice ready to eat anytime.
The fragrant, tender ribs infuse the rice, making it very delicious!

mon_an.ten: Steamed Tofu with Shrimp for Weight Loss
mon_an.mo_ta: Tofu and shrimp are two foods that provide full nutrition without the worry of gaining weight! Let's look at how to make this incredibly fragrant steamed tofu with shrimp below!
cac_buoc: Weight loss with tofu
Tofu and soy-based products have long been known for their skin and hair benefits. Additionally, it is very effective for weight loss.
Common tofu is rich in protein; the digestion process converts it into amino acids which aids digestion, making it an extremely effective weight-loss food.
Tofu contains plenty of vitamin E, calcium, and minerals, which not only help with weight loss but also promote a healthy physique and smooth skin.

It also contains vitamin B, glucose, protein, starch catalysts, oxidation catalysts, iron, phosphorus, and many other nutrients. Regularly eating tofu can help the body eliminate toxins and promote normal metabolism, making it the best dish for eliminating fat.

Tofu contains a large amount of plant protein, which creates a feeling of fullness, making it a weight-loss plant with many advantages. Tofu also contains rich plant micro-elements that can eliminate excess water and improve digestive function, especially in reducing belly fat.
Applying a diet with tofu dishes regularly will help achieve quick weight loss results without much worry, as the dishes are easy to make and very familiar to Vietnamese style.
Weight loss with shrimp

The main reason shrimp can help you lose weight is its low calorie content. Every 85.05g of shrimp provides only 101 calories. Due to this low calorie count, you can burn off the calories in shrimp relatively easily through exercise.
For example: 12 minutes of swimming or 10 minutes of basketball is enough to burn 101 calories.
Shrimp is the protein of the sea and one of the best weight-loss foods. Shrimp is low in calories and provides other nutritional benefits that contribute to a successful diet.

Just 4 large shrimp provide enough protein for the day, helping you control hunger, reduce snacking, and stay full longer. Additionally, seafood is generally not too fatty and requires little oil to cook; it should be boiled or grilled to limit oil sources that are not good for weight loss.

Shrimp is rich in protein, vitamin D, vitamin B3, and zinc. Zinc supplementation helps increase circulating leptin levels. Leptin is a hormone that plays an important role in fat storage and appetite. The iodine in shrimp helps thyroid function control the metabolic rate. Iodine deficiency can lead to slow thyroid activity, resulting in weight gain or hindering weight loss.
How to prepare the dish: Steamed Tofu with Shrimp
Ingredients:
Tofu, shrimp, scallions, cilantro, chili, seasoning
Preparation:
Finely mince the shrimp. Cut the tofu in half horizontally (Choose firm tofu so it doesn't break when cut).
Finely mince the scallion whites, blanch a few scallion stalks, and cut the rest into strips. Finely mince the cilantro. Cut the chili into fine threads.
Execution:
Mix the following: shrimp, minced meat, scallion whites, cilantro, 1/2 tsp MSG, 1/3 tsp salt, and 1/3 tsp pepper.

Place the shrimp and meat mixture on one side of a tofu slice, sandwich it with another slice, cut in half, and use a blanched scallion stalk to tie the tofu piece. Place in a steamer and steam until cooked. When the tofu is cooked, remove it and keep the steaming liquid.

Sauté minced ginger until fragrant, add 1/2 cup of the tofu steaming liquid, season with 1/2 tsp soy sauce, 1/3 tsp bouillon, 1/2 tsp sugar, 1/4 tsp MSG, and cornstarch water until the sauce thickens slightly, then turn off the heat.
Serving:
Place the tofu on a plate, top with chili, scallions, and roasted sesame seeds, then pour the sauce over. Serve hot with rice.
Using the steaming liquid to make the sauce makes the dish more flavorful.

mon_an.ten: Fried Tofu with Quail Eggs and Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: A delicious, simple dish suitable for family meals, especially tasty when eaten with hot rice. Let's learn how to make this fried tofu with quail eggs and sauce!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning - scallions, chili, soy sauce, sugar
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, cut the tofu into pieces about 2cm thick.
Step 2:
Use a cutter to remove a portion from the center of each tofu piece. Note that the cutter should only be slightly larger than a quail egg yolk!
Step 3:
Add oil to a pan and when hot, gently place the tofu in.
Step 4:
Next, crack an egg into the center of each tofu piece and fry until both sides of the tofu are golden brown.
Step 5:

Once the tofu is fried, drain the excess fat from the pan, then add 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp sugar, a little water, and minced garlic and chili. Continue cooking for about 10 minutes until the tofu has absorbed the sauce.
Serve on a plate and sprinkle with scallions!

mon_an.mo_ta: Learn how to make delicious egg tofu at home, ensuring food safety for the whole family with this recipe. This egg tofu dish is extremely simple to make using common kitchen ingredients: soybeans and eggs. Give it a try!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Soak the soybeans in water until plump, then rub off the skins.
Step 2: Put the soybeans into a soy milk maker, add water according to the machine's instructions, and start the machine.
Step 3: Once the cycle is finished, strain the soy milk and let it cool.
Step 4: Lightly whisk the eggs until combined, then add the soy milk and stir well.

Step 5: Strain the mixture through a sieve to remove all bubbles, then pour it into a mold; you can line it with plastic wrap for easier removal later. Place the tray in a steamer and steam for about 10 minutes over medium heat, then cook for another 5 minutes over low heat until the tofu is set and firm, then turn off the heat.
Step 6: Remove the tofu from the mold and cut into bite-sized pieces.

Here is the sliced egg tofu after steaming. Today I was in a bit of a rush, so the tofu isn't perfectly smooth and has some holes :p This is because the eggs were whisked too vigorously, creating bubbles, and the straining wasn't thorough enough, so the soy milk and egg mixture still had air bubbles before steaming. It might not look as good, but the quality is unchanged. Standard egg tofu should have a smooth, silky surface similar to flan. Therefore, remember to whisk the eggs very gently and strain out all air bubbles. When steaming, cover the pot with a clean towel under the lid to prevent water from dripping and pitting the surface. Egg tofu can be eaten immediately after steaming or used in dishes like tofu in tomato sauce, tofu with green onions, tofu with meat sauce, or added to hotpots.

mon_an.mo_ta: Tofu can be prepared in many delicious ways, such as in sauces or fried. These simple steps will guide you on how to make fried tofu balls—a delicious and attractive vegetarian dish.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Sesame oil, sugar, pepper, seasoning powder, salt, cooking oil - seasonings
cac_buoc: Step 1: Cut the tofu into small pieces, place them in a thin cloth, and mash them (or use a spoon to mash). Squeeze out excess water so the mixture isn't watery and has better binding.
Step 2: Peel and shred the carrot, then season with a pinch of salt.
Step 3: Wash and finely chop the cilantro.

Step 4: Put the tofu in a bowl, wear plastic gloves, and mash again until smooth. Add the carrot, cilantro, flour, cornstarch, and egg, then mix thoroughly. Next, add 1/2 tsp sugar, 1/2 tsp white pepper, 1/2 tsp seasoning powder, 1 tsp salt, and 1 tsp sesame oil. Use your hands to mix everything again so the ingredients absorb the seasonings.

Step 5: Place a pan on the stove, add enough oil for deep frying. When the oil is very hot, roll the tofu mixture into balls and fry until golden. Fry over low heat until the tofu turns a deep golden brown, then remove and drain on paper towels.
Arrange the fried tofu balls on a plate and garnish with a bit of cilantro or carved carrots for a beautiful presentation.

mon_an.mo_ta: A special sauce and familiar spices make this stir-fried tofu and bean sprout dish better than ever. You will surely be delighted from the very first bite.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Korean-style fish cake - 1 sheet (can be replaced with regular fish cake)
Sauce - 30g chili paste, 40g ground dried chili, 15ml soy sauce, 15ml oyster sauce, 30g sugar, 1/4 ginger root (minced), 2 garlic cloves (minced), pepper
cac_buoc: Step 1:

First, we will fry the tofu. The secret to preventing oil from splattering is to cut the tofu into small pieces and pat them dry, as the water in the tofu is the main cause of splattering during frying.
Step 2:
Fry all sides of the tofu until they are evenly golden.
You should use a large pan to fry more tofu at once, and you can use the leftover oil to stir-fry the bean sprouts.
Step 3:
In a bowl, combine all the sauce ingredients and mix well.
Step 4:
Add shallots and dried shrimp to the pan with the fried tofu and stir-fry together. Next, add some chili paste to increase the spiciness.
Step 5:
To make the stir-fried tofu more attractive, the flavor of fish cake is essential. Cut the fish cake into small pieces and add them to the stir-fry.
Step 6:
Now, just add the bean sprouts to the pan, along with a bit more chili paste and 300 ml of water.
Step 7:
Cover the pan and cook for 5 minutes so the ingredients are evenly cooked and absorb the flavors. You should only cook over medium heat, then turn the heat to low when nearly finished.
Step 8:
Next, open the lid and add the shredded wild betel leaves to the pan, along with some fresh chilies. (You can add more fresh chilies if you like it very spicy).
Step 9:
Add 70ml of water to the bowl containing the sauce made in step 3, add a little cornstarch, mix well, and pour the entire sauce mixture into the pan with the tofu and bean sprouts.
With this sauce, the stir-fried tofu will become extremely delicious and have a characteristic flavor.
After pouring the sauce into the pan, continue to simmer for another 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly so the seasonings penetrate the tofu!
The delicious and eye-catching stir-fried tofu with bean sprouts is now complete. Why hesitate to enjoy it right away?
Final requirements:
All ingredients are just cooked through, not raw.
Fried tofu has a beautiful, even golden color, not burnt or dark brown.
Bean sprouts are just cooked, neither tough nor too soft.
The dish has eye-catching colors that stimulate the appetite.
The colors are harmonious and beautiful, stimulating the other senses; just looking at it makes you want to eat it immediately.
If you don't like spicy food or cannot eat spicy, you can replace the chili paste with tomato paste; it won't be spicy but will still have a very beautiful color.
This dish is excellent when served with hot rice.
Stir-fried tofu with bean sprouts is not difficult to make; just skillfully combine the ingredients and your tofu dish will look "vibrant" instantly!

mon_an.ten: Soy Sauce Fried Chicken with Crispy Skin
mon_an.mo_ta: Soy sauce fried chicken with its attractive color and unforgettable flavor—tender, sweet meat combined with crispy chicken skin—will delight anyone who tastes it. Let's get in the kitchen and learn how to make this delicious dish!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Mix the soy sauce with maltose and rice wine, then set aside.
Step 2: Debone the chicken thighs.
Step 3: Marinate the chicken with a little salt and pepper for about 5 - 10 minutes to let the meat absorb the flavors.

Step 4: Heat a pan and add the chicken to fry. Be sure to place the skin-side down and place a heavy plate on top of the chicken pieces so the skin fries evenly (You should use plenty of oil and use fairly high heat).
Step 5: When the skin is golden and crispy, flip the meat and continue frying until the meat is cooked through.
Step 6: Drain all the oil from the pan, then pour in the soy sauce mixture. Be careful not to pour the soy sauce directly onto the chicken skin!
Next, simmer over high heat until the soy sauce thickens slightly, then turn off the heat.
Finally, arrange the chicken on a plate and drizzle the remaining soy sauce from the pan over the surface of the meat.

mon_an.mo_ta: Ginger braised chicken is a rustic dish that every family loves because the chicken is tender, the spices are well-absorbed, and the braising liquid is perfectly sweet and salty—great for dipping vegetables or cucumbers. Let's get in the kitchen and make this delicious dish!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Add sugar to a hot pan over medium heat for about 5 minutes until the sugar melts completely, then reduce the heat and stir for another 4-5 minutes. Then, turn off the heat, remove from the stove, and add water. When the caramel starts to thicken, put it back on the stove to reheat briefly.
Step 2: Mince the onion, julienne the ginger, and mince the garlic.

Step 3: Prepare a hot pan with a little oil, then sauté the ginger and onion until fragrant for about 1 minute. Next, add the garlic and sauté for another minute, then remove the onion, garlic, and ginger from the pan.
Step 4: Marinate the chicken with salt for about 20 minutes to let the meat absorb the seasoning.
Step 5: Put the chicken into the pan used for the aromatics and fry until the chicken turns golden brown on all sides.

Step 6: Next, add the caramel, fish sauce, a little salt, pepper, and chili powder. Reduce the heat to low and braise for about 20 minutes, then add the sautéed onion, ginger, and garlic back in to complete the dish.

mon_an.mo_ta: On the weekend, you might wonder what delicious dish to prepare for the whole family. If you haven't decided yet, let's learn how to make salt-roasted chicken. The saltiness combined with the heat of the chili makes this dish both tasty and unique for your meal. Take a little time to try this recipe!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the chicken and drain well. Use a knife to make a few scores on the skin so the meat absorbs the spices quickly (Choose fresh chicken with high elasticity).
Step 2: Prepare the marinade: combine 2 tbsp cooking oil, ½ tsp white wine, 1 tbsp salt, 2 tbsp chili, and the minced garlic in a small bowl. Mix well until the seasonings are fully dissolved.

Step 3: Pour the marinade over the chicken and rub the mixture evenly over the body to ensure it is well-coated. Marinate for about 3 hours for the flavors to penetrate, or leave it overnight for even better results.

Step 4: Preheat the oven to 200°C with both top and bottom heat for 10 minutes. Place the chicken on a tray lined with parchment paper and roast for about 30 minutes. Every 10 minutes, take the chicken out and baste with the sauce. After 30 minutes, baste one last time and roast for another 20 minutes. Remove from the oven, chop into bite-sized pieces, and enjoy your chili-salt roasted chicken.

mon_an.mo_ta: Baked sweet and sour chicken is a dish that immediately evokes a sense of deliciousness, with tender, sweet chicken meat and a tangy sauce that pairs perfectly with rice. Let's explore how to make this dish.
cac_buoc: Ingredients:
Chicken part:
500g chicken
1/2 tbsp salt
1/4 tsp black pepper
1/4 tsp garlic salt
3/4 cup cornstarch
2 large eggs
1/2 cup cooking oil
Sweet and sour sauce part:
1 cup sugar
1/3 cup ketchup
1 tsp garlic salt
1/2 cup rice vinegar
Soy sauce
Instructions:
Step 1: Prepare the ingredients for the baked sweet and sour chicken
Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces, wash, and drain well.
Crack the eggs into a bowl and beat well.
Preheat the oven to 325°F (equivalent to 165°C).
Step 2: Proceed with the following steps
Place the chicken, cornstarch, salt, pepper, and garlic salt in a large bag; shake gently until the chicken is fully coated.
Heat 1/4 cup of oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Dip the chicken into the egg mixture and place in the hot oil.
Fry both sides of the chicken for about 2 minutes per side. (Do not over-fry to avoid drying out the meat, as it will still be baked later).
Place a sheet of foil on a baking pan.
Once fried, remove the chicken to drain excess oil, then place it in the baking pan.
Mix all the sauce ingredients in a medium bowl, stirring well to combine.
Pour a portion of the sauce over the chicken and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the pan, flip the chicken pieces over, and pour the remaining sauce on top. Bake for another 15-20 minutes.
Arrange the chicken on a plate. Serve hot with rice and green vegetables.
The crispy, hot chicken pieces soaked in sweet and sour sauce will keep you coming back for more. This dish is perfect for cool days.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Delicious and Simple Gà Ủ Muối at Home
cac_buoc: Gà ủ muối (salt-brined steamed chicken) is currently a trending dish on social media, attracting many young people. The chicken is golden, tender, and retains its characteristic sweet flavor even when served cold. To save costs, you can refer to these simple ways to make delicious gà ủ muối at home!
I. Traditional Delicious Gà Ủ Muối
1. Ingredients
Ri chicken: 1 bird weighing about 1.5kg.
Ginger: 3 knobs
Lemongrass: 6 – 7 stalks
Onion: 1 bulb
Shallots: 4 bulbs
Seasonings: Turmeric powder, sea salt, sugar, seasoning powder, peppercorns, ground pepper, chili, lime leaves.
2. Preparation Steps
2.1. Prepare the chicken

To create a delicious gà ủ muối, choose a Ri chicken weighing about 1.5kg, not too large. Have the chicken cleaned thoroughly at the market. Use sea salt to rub all over the surface to remove impurities. Rinse several times with clean water and drain.
2.2. Prepare the vegetables

During the salt-steaming process, the chicken is cooked whole. Next, prepare the vegetables. Peel and slice the ginger. Clean the lemongrass. Peel the onion and shallots. Slice half of the onion and leave the other half whole. Keep the shallots whole. Wash the lime leaves and drain. Wash the fresh chilies and keep them whole.
2.3. Marinate the chicken

The marinade is crucial for the color and flavor of the dish. Mix the following in a bowl: 1 tsp turmeric powder, 2 tsp seasoning powder, 2 tsp sugar, 1 tsp ground pepper. Wear gloves and rub the mixture all over the chicken, massaging for a few minutes.
Then, stuff the cavity with half an onion, shallots, lime leaves, a few ginger slices, 2 halved lemongrass stalks, and some peppercorns. Marinate for at least 30 minutes.
II. Delicious Smoked Gà Ủ Muối
1. Ingredients
Free-range chicken: 1 whole bird
Fresh turmeric: 1 knob
Lemongrass: 5 stalks
Rice: 200g
Sea salt
Seasonings: cooking oil, sugar, salt, and other spices.
2. Steps to make the chicken
Step 1: Prepare ingredients
