Wash the chicken with diluted salt water. Rub salt on the skin to remove odors.
For the fresh turmeric, peel and pound it finely. Add 1 tsp salt and 2 tbsp cooking oil, then mix well.
Trim the lemongrass, remove old outer leaves, and wash. Cut into finger-length segments.
Step 2: Marinate the chicken
Once drained, place the chicken in a small basin and rub the turmeric mixture over the entire body. Rub thoroughly to ensure even absorption. Marinate for 10 minutes.
Step 3: Salt-steaming preparation
While waiting, prepare the salt for smoking. Line the bottom of a large pot with foil. Spread a layer of sea salt to cover the bottom.
Next, spread a layer of rice and 4 tbsp of sugar over the salt. Ensure it is spread evenly to cover the bottom. Finally, add a layer of lemongrass segments on top.
Step 4: Smoking process
Place the chicken on a steaming rack inside the pot. Cover the pot mouth with foil to prevent steam from escaping, then put the lid on. Turn on the stove to start smoking.
To ensure the chicken is flavorful and cooked through, smoke over medium-low heat. The process takes about 30 minutes.
Step 5: Garnish and enjoy

Turn off the heat and transfer the chicken to a plate. For parties, you can garnish before serving. The smoked chicken has a golden color from turmeric, crispy skin, and sweet meat. Serve with red chili salt for extra flavor.
III. Restaurant-Style Herbal Gà Ủ Muối
Ri chicken: 1 bird weighing about 1.5kg
Ginger: 2 knobs
Shallots: 6 bulbs
Seasonings: Turmeric powder, sea salt, pink curing salt, sugar, seasoning powder, cinnamon, star anise, peppercorns, ground pepper, bay leaves, lime leaves, chili.
Step 1: Prepare the chicken
Clean the chicken as described in Methods 1 and 2.
Step 2: Prepare and marinate

Toast the bay leaves, cinnamon, star anise, and peppercorns until fragrant. Peel, wash, and grill the ginger and shallots until fragrant, then crush lightly. Wash lime leaves and chili. Create the marinade by mixing 2 tsp seasoning powder, 2 tsp salt, 1 tsp sugar, and 1/3 tsp pink curing salt. Pink salt is key for the pinkish meat color, but do not use too much.
Mix well and rub over the whole chicken, including the cavity. Wrap in plastic wrap and marinate for at least 1 hour.
Step 3: Cook the chicken

In a large pot, add the herbs (bay leaves, cinnamon, star anise, peppercorns), 1 tsp turmeric powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp seasoning powder, and 1 tsp sugar. Bring to a boil until fragrant, then add the chicken.

Simmer on low heat for about 30 minutes, adjusting for the chicken's weight. Once cooked, remove and let cool before serving. The chicken will have a beautiful peach-pink meat, bright yellow crispy skin, and a fragrant herbal aroma.
IV. How to Choose Good Chicken for Gà Ủ Muối

For live chicken: Depending on preference, choose a rooster or a hen. Roosters usually have firmer, chewier meat. Choose a bird with bright, active eyes and a bright red comb. The beak should be sharp without discharge. Legs should be slender, straight, with bright yellow skin.
For pre-processed chicken: Choose a bird with thin, light yellow skin, which may be darker on the back, wings, and breast. The skin should be free of bruises or blood clots.
V. How to Clean Chicken to Remove Odors
To clean chicken quickly and remove odors, you can use various methods. First, ensure all feathers and the oil gland at the tail are removed.
Alternatively, use a 2:1 ratio of vinegar and salt, rub it over the chicken, and rinse. You can also use lemon or ginger for the same effect.

mon_an.mo_ta: We are often familiar with making bean sprouts from mung beans, but soybean sprouts are a very healthy food containing Isoflavones, Vitamin E, etc., which few people use as a daily dish. Soybean sprouts can be prepared into many delicious dishes like soup, salad, stir-fry, etc. Let's learn how to make soybean sprouts at home right now!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the soybeans and soak them in water for about 24 hours.
Step 2: Pick out any damaged beans floating on the surface or broken beans, then pour the soybeans into a basket or tray with many small holes at the bottom.
Step 3: Rinse the soybeans under running water for a moment; the water will drain through the holes. Then place the basket of soybeans inside a larger glass basin.

Step 4: Cover the basin with a dark cloth. Using black cloth is best to completely block the light, as too much light will turn the sprouts green instead of a beautiful yellow. Then cover with another layer of cloth on the outside.
Step 5: Every 3-4 hours, take the basket out and water the beans. After 4-6 days, the soybean sprouts will be long enough to eat. Homemade soybean sprouts are fresh, plump, and safe.

mon_an.ten: Crispy and Unique Gỏi Cổ Hũ Dừa
mon_an.mo_ta: A dish that provides full nutrition for the whole family without being fattening at all! Let's learn how to make crispy coconut heart salad!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Cucumber: 1, small carrot: 1, onion: 1/2, Vietnamese coriander, coriander.
Seasonings - fish sauce, salt, sugar, vinegar, chili, cooking oil.
cac_buoc: Ingredients to prepare:
Step 1: Choose the tender part of the coconut heart, discard the tough parts, slice thinly, and soak in cold water. Then rinse again and drain.
Step 2: Wash the pork, boil with a bit of seasoning, then slice thinly. Wash the shrimp, trim the antennae, boil, peel, and leave the tails intact for presentation.
Step 3: Peel the onion, wash, slice thinly, and soak in vinegar and sugar to remove the pungency.
Step 4: Wash the cucumber, halve, and slice diagonally. Peel the carrot, wash, and julienne. Trim the Vietnamese coriander and coriander, keeping the tender parts, and wash.
Step 5: Roast the peanuts, peel, and crush slightly. Peel and mince the garlic. Wash and slice the chili. Squeeze the lime for juice. Peel and slice the shallots, then fry until fragrant.

Step 6: Prepare the dressing by mixing 1.5 tbsp fish sauce, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 tbsp lime juice, minced garlic, and chili. Note that you can adjust the ratio according to the type of fish sauce and your taste.

Step 7: Place the coconut heart, carrot, cucumber, and onion in a large bowl. Slowly pour 2/3 of the dressing over and toss well; let sit for 5 minutes to absorb. Then add the shrimp, pork, and the remaining dressing, tossing again and seasoning to taste.
Step 8: Transfer the salad to a plate, sprinkle with chopped herbs, roasted peanuts, and fried shallots on top. Serve with a side of sweet and sour fish sauce and crispy, rich prawn crackers.

mon_an.ten: Chicken and Cabbage Salad (Gỏi Gà Bắp Cải)
cac_buoc: Discover this refreshing chicken and cabbage salad, perfect for summer! Tender, sweet chicken combined with crunchy cabbage and a tangy sweet-and-sour fish sauce will delight your taste buds. With these instructions, you can easily make this dish at home. Follow the guide below to learn how!
I. Traditional Chicken and Cabbage Salad
1. Ingredients
1 kg chicken (about 1/2 a chicken)
500g cabbage (1/2 a head)
1 carrot
A few lime leaves
6 shallots
3 garlic cloves (minced)
1 chili (minced)
1/2 lime
4 tbsp fish sauce
2 tbsp cooking oil
A little salt and sugar
2. Cooking Steps
2.1. Prepare the ingredients
Clean the chicken by removing any remaining feathers and organs. Rinse with water, then rub the meat with salt for 2-3 minutes to clean thoroughly. Rinse again with water.

Place the chicken in a pot and add enough water to cover it. Add 1 tsp salt and 2 peeled shallots. Place the pot on the stove. Turn the heat to high until the water boils, then reduce to low heat and simmer for about 15 minutes until the chicken is tender and cooked through.
To ensure crispy skin and white meat, remove the chicken once cooked and rinse under cold running water. Then, soak the chicken in a bowl of ice water for about 15 minutes.
Next, shred the chicken into bite-sized strips.
Prepare other ingredients:
Cabbage: Thinly shred the cabbage and wash thoroughly with clean water.
Carrot: Peel the carrot, wash, and julienne into thin strips.
Lime leaves: Wash the lime leaves and cut into long thin strips, about 2 finger-lengths long.
Shallots: Peel the remaining shallots, rinse, and slice thinly.
2.2. Fry the shallots

Place a pan on the stove and heat 2 tbsp of cooking oil. Add the sliced shallots and stir constantly over low heat until they turn a light golden color. Once golden, turn off the heat and let them sit for 3 minutes. Then, scoop the shallots out into a small bowl.
2.3. Mix the salad
In a bowl, whisk together 4 tbsp fish sauce, 2 tbsp sugar, minced garlic and chili, and the juice from 1/2 a lime. Stir well until the sugar dissolves and the ingredients are well combined.
In a large mixing bowl, add the cabbage, carrots, shredded chicken, fried shallots, and shredded lime leaves.

Next, pour the prepared fish sauce mixture over the ingredients and toss gently for about 3 minutes so everything is evenly coated. Taste and adjust the seasoning if necessary. The chicken and cabbage salad is now ready.
2.4. Finished Product

The chicken and cabbage salad looks beautiful. The chicken is tender and chewy with a natural sweetness. The cabbage and carrots are fresh and crunchy. The aroma of lime leaves and crispy fried shallots creates a harmonious blend. This salad is deeply infused with an attractive sweet and sour flavor.
To enhance the experience, serve the salad with shrimp crackers and a small bowl of sweet and sour fish sauce. This will stimulate your palate even more!
II. Shredded Chicken and Cabbage Salad (Gỏi Gà Xé Phay)
250g cabbage
1 whole chicken
50g onion
100g carrot
Vietnamese coriander (rau răm), lime, chili
Shallots, minced garlic, herbs
Seasoning: fish sauce, sugar, salt
2. Cooking Steps
Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Prepare the chicken: After purchasing, rinse the chicken with water. Rub the meat with a little salt and ginger to reduce any odor. Rinse thoroughly.
Prepare the cabbage: Thinly shred the cabbage. Wash and place in a colander to drain.
Prepare the onion: Peel the onion, wash, and cut in half. Slice thinly and soak in a bowl of ice water for about 5 minutes to reduce the pungency. Drain well.
Prepare the carrot: Peel the carrot, wash, and julienne into small strips.
Prepare the herbs: Pick the Vietnamese coriander leaves and wash. Do the same for the lime leaves.
Prepare the dressing: Squeeze the lime for juice. Wash the chili, mince some, and slice the rest.
Step 2: Boil the chicken
Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add the chicken and cook until done. Once cooked, turn off the heat.
Remove the chicken and once it has cooled slightly, shred the meat for use.
Step 3: Make the dressing
In a bowl, combine 2 tbsp sugar, 2 tbsp fish sauce, and 2 tbsp lime juice. Stir until the sugar dissolves.
Add the minced garlic and minced chili to the bowl and mix well.
Step 4: Mix the salad
Toss the shredded chicken with the ingredients. Add a little dressing and mix well so the chicken absorbs the flavor.
Next, add the julienned carrots, onions, lime leaves, and cabbage along with the remaining dressing. Toss well to combine all ingredients.
Step 5: Add Vietnamese coriander and toss
Transfer the salad to a plate and sprinkle with fried shallots and sliced chili. The chicken and cabbage salad is complete and ready to enjoy.
Step 6: Finished Product

The finished salad features a vibrant mix of colors from the chicken and vegetables. It has the characteristic crunch of cabbage, the slight pungency of onions, and the chewiness of chicken. On the weekend, the whole family can gather to enjoy this chicken salad served with congee for a wonderful meal.
See also: Guide on how to make Beef and Eggplant Salad
III. How to Choose Fresh Ingredients
1. For live chicken
Choose chickens with bright red combs, alert eyes, and active movement. Feathers should be smooth and close to the body; the beak should be sharp, small, and free of discharge.
The legs should be slender with shiny yellow skin. When parting the feathers, the skin should be soft, thin, with some large yellow patches under the wings and breast.
Avoid buying chickens with ruffled feathers, a lethargic appearance, or a foul odor, as these may be sick and the meat will not taste good when cooked.
2. For pre-processed chicken
Choose chickens with evenly yellow skin, with deeper color on the wings, breast, or back. The body should be compact, firm, with a narrow breast.
Pre-processed chicken should have thin, smooth skin with good elasticity and no bruises or dark blood spots.
Avoid buying if the meat is dull, soft, slimy, or has a foul odor, as the quality cannot be guaranteed.
3. How to choose cabbage for salad
Good cabbage is round, slightly dark green, and the outer leaves are fresh and not crushed.
When buying, pick it up to check the weight. Fresh cabbage usually feels heavy for its size and has a moderate weight.
Avoid flat or oval-shaped cabbage, pale colors, or those that feel too light or have wilted, yellowing outer leaves. These signs indicate the cabbage is old and no longer fresh.
4. How to choose good carrots
Good carrots are medium-sized, straight, with smooth skin and feel heavy when held.
Choose carrots with fresh green stems still firmly attached to the root. This indicates they were recently harvested.
Carrots with a deep orange-red color and a small inner core will be sweeter than those with a large core and pale color.
Avoid very large carrots with thick shoulders and large cores, as these are signs of being old and fibrous. Also, avoid soft, wilted, or deformed carrots.
IV. Notes for Making Chicken and Cabbage Salad
Choose fresh chicken: Buy chicken with a bright red comb, bright eyes, and smooth feathers. Avoid those with odors, pale skin, or abnormal signs.
Choose fresh cabbage: Buy bright green cabbage with fresh outer leaves; avoid wilted, yellowed, or damaged heads. Cabbage should be medium-sized.
Prepare chicken and cabbage: Wash both thoroughly with cold water to remove dirt. Shred the chicken into small pieces or strips as preferred. Cabbage should be shredded thinly for easy eating.
Boil the chicken: Boil water in a large pot, add the chicken and cook for 15-20 minutes until the meat is tender and cooked through. Remove and let cool.
Combine: Mix the boiled chicken and cabbage in a large bowl. You can add other ingredients like scallions, herbs, shallots, chili, and seasonings like salt, sugar, fish sauce, and vinegar to taste.

mon_an.ten: Crunchy Pork Tongue and Papaya Salad
mon_an.mo_ta: Instead of the usual stir-fries or deep-fried dishes, change your menu with a salad; Pork Tongue and Papaya Salad is a fantastic idea. Discover how to make this incredibly crunchy and delicious salad with us in the article below!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel the carrot and papaya, then shred into thin strips. (Rinse the shredded carrot and papaya with cooled boiled water).
Step 2: Wash the assorted herbs and soak them in cooled boiled water with a little salt.
Step 3: Clean the pork tongue and slice thinly into bite-sized pieces.

Step 4: Prepare the dressing: Mix 2 tbsp fish sauce, 2 tbsp white sugar, 1 tsp MSG, 1 chopped ripe chili, a little lime juice, and minced garlic. Adjust the seasoning to your preferred sweet and sour taste.
Step 5: Place the sliced pork tongue in a mixing bowl along with the carrot and papaya.
Step 6: Slowly pour the dressing over the mixture, add chopped herbs, and toss well.
Step 7: Transfer the pork tongue and papaya salad to a plate. Garnish with a few sprigs of cilantro for a nice presentation.
This pork tongue and papaya salad is very crunchy and gets better with every bite.
In this hot weather, just a plate of this salad is enough to make you feel refreshed.

mon_an.mo_ta: Shrimp and Water Mimosa Salad is a simple yet nutritious dish, as both shrimp and water mimosa are rich in calcium and fiber, which are essential for the body. Let's get into the kitchen and make this for your family!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fermented shrimp sauce (mắm tôm chua) - 1 tbsp
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, select young, fresh green water mimosa stalks. Wash them thoroughly and snap them into short segments.
Step 2:

Boil a pot of water. When it boils, add the water mimosa and blanch briefly to remove the astringent taste. Immediately remove and plunge into a bowl of cold water to preserve the green color. You must act quickly so the greens don't overcook and lose their crunch.
Step 3:
Clean the shrimp and boil them in a mixture of vinegar, sugar, and a pinch of salt. Peel and set aside to drain.
Wash the Vietnamese coriander (rau răm).
Thinly slice the onion and soak it in a little vinegar and sugar.
Step 4:

Prepare the dressing: Soak the tamarind pulp in boiling water and stir well to extract the juice. Take 3 tbsp tamarind juice and mix with 2 tbsp sugar, premium fish sauce, and minced garlic and chili. For a more savory flavor, you can add 2 tbsp of fermented shrimp sauce (mắm tôm chua).
Step 5:
Place the water mimosa and shrimp in a large bowl. Toss with the Vietnamese coriander, peanuts, and dressing. Adjust the seasoning to taste.
Step 6:

Transfer the salad to a plate; it is best enjoyed immediately. The dish is attractive with the green of the vegetables mixed with the red of the shrimp and chili. With one bite, you will experience a unique flavor: slightly sweet and sour, spicy from the chili, and especially the distinct aroma and crunch of water mimosa.

mon_an.ten: Green Mango Salad with Beef Jerky
mon_an.mo_ta: Making green mango salad with beef jerky is very simple; anyone can make this delicious dish at home with a taste as good as any restaurant. Let's explore the recipe right now!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Finely chop the spearmint (húng lủi).
Roast the peanuts with ½ tsp salt until golden and crunchy, then peel and crush them slightly.
Peel the green mango and carrot, then shred them into strips.
Step 2: Prepare the dressing
In a bowl, combine 2 tbsp sugar, 2 tbsp lime juice, and 2 tbsp fish sauce. Stir until the sugar is dissolved and the flavors are blended.
Then, add minced garlic and minced chili, stir again, and it's done.
Step 3: Mix the salad
Place the green mango, carrot, spearmint, and peanuts in a bowl. Pour the dressing over and toss well. Let it sit for about 5 minutes to absorb the flavors before serving.
Presenting the Green Mango Salad with Beef Jerky
This salad is perfect as a snack, party appetizer, or a side dish for family meals. The balanced sweet and sour taste is sure to stimulate the palate.
As you can see, the method is very simple. Save this recipe to cook more often.
Good luck with your Green Mango Salad with Beef Jerky and enjoy this delicious treat with your family!

mon_an.ten: Vietnamese Caramelized Pork and Dried Shrimp Dip (Kho Quẹt)
mon_an.mo_ta: When I first went to Saigon, I was obsessed with Kho Quẹt—salty, sweet, and spicy. It's delicious with boiled vegetables or scorched rice (cơm cháy). I also love it with hot white rice. Sometimes I don't need any other food and can finish a whole bowl of rice because it's so good. After much tinkering, I finally learned how to make it (slightly different from the Southern style as I use less sugar to suit Northern tastes). Today, I'm revealing the recipe for a delicious Kho Quẹt.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Preparation
Soak the dried shrimp in water until soft, then rinse and dice.
Wash the pork fat and cut into small cubes. Wash the pork shoulder (blanch it in boiling water first), then mince it.
Step 2: Cooking the Kho Quẹt

Add a tablespoon of oil to a pan, add the diced pork fat and stir until the fat renders and turns into crispy rinds (tóp mỡ). Add the minced pork and shrimp and stir-fry until firm. Then, add about 4 tbsp sugar, 6 tbsp fish sauce, and sliced chilies. Stir until the sugar dissolves and simmer over low heat until the sauce thickens. Sprinkle with black pepper and turn off the heat. You have now finished the famous Southern dip.
Here is the final product. The requirement for a good Kho Quẹt is that the pork rinds must be crispy, the meat and shrimp fragrant, and the taste perfectly balanced between salty, sweet, and spicy.
Tips for a delicious Kho Quẹt:

You should choose neck fat for the rinds to be crispy without being too greasy. When frying the rinds, use medium-low heat to render all the fat. Do not use high heat, or the rinds will burn before the fat is fully rendered. For the meat, choose a cut with some fat like pork shoulder or pork belly so it's rich, tender, and not dry. In this recipe, I reduced the sugar by about 1/3; if you like it sweeter, feel free to add more to your taste.

mon_an.mo_ta: Let's make crispy and delicious fried potato and pork cakes! This dish is easy from the ingredients to the method!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
After steaming the potatoes until cooked, peel them, mash them, and knead until smooth and pliable.
Step 2:
Mix the mashed potatoes with the minced pork, salt, sugar, and finely chopped scallions and cilantro.
Step 3:
Use your hands to shape the potato mixture into fun shapes or use a mold to press them.
Step 4:
Dip the cakes into beaten egg, then roll them in breadcrumbs. Heat oil in a pan and fry until golden brown over medium heat.
Step 5:
Remove the potato and pork cakes and drain on paper towels. Arrange on a plate and serve hot.

mon_an.ten: Crispy Fried Potato and Beef Croquettes
mon_an.mo_ta: These hot potato and beef croquettes have a golden, crispy outer shell and a fragrant, soft, and attractive interior. Today we will guide you through making these piping hot croquettes!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel the potatoes and cut into quarters. Place them in a pot of water with a little salt and boil until soft. Once cooked, drain the water but keep the potatoes in the pot. Turn the heat back on for 20-30 seconds to evaporate any remaining moisture, then turn off the heat and let cool slightly. Mash the potatoes thoroughly in a large bowl (the smoother the mash, the better the dish).

Step 2: Peel and finely mince the carrot. Peel and finely chop the onion. Soak the shiitake mushrooms until soft, then mince. Mince the beef. Heat a little oil in a pan. Sauté the onion until translucent and fragrant. Add the carrot and sauté until soft. Then add the mushrooms and beef. Once the beef is just cooked, turn off the heat.

Step 3: Pour the sautéed beef mixture into the bowl of mashed potatoes and mix well. Add salt, MSG, and pepper to taste, and mix again. Once the mixture is smooth and even, let it cool slightly and then roll into bite-sized balls.

Step 4: Crack the eggs into a bowl and beat well. Place flour and breadcrumbs into two separate bowls. Dip each potato-beef ball into the egg, then roll in flour, dip back into the egg, and finally roll in breadcrumbs. Repeat until finished. This double-coating makes the croquettes tastier and more fragrant.

Step 5: Pour plenty of oil into a pot and heat until very hot. Once the oil is shimmering, lower the heat. Drop the balls in and fry until golden brown on all sides. (Note: Do not crowd the pot as it will lower the oil temperature and the croquettes won't brown evenly).
When the crispy potato and beef croquettes are done, remove them to a plate lined with paper towels to drain. Serve on a plate, garnish with cilantro and tomatoes, and enjoy hot with chili sauce!

mon_an.ten: Sweet and Sour Stir-Fried Pork Tongue
mon_an.mo_ta: Are you bored with the usual boiled pork tongue recipe? Today, we will guide you on how to make Sweet and Sour Stir-Fried Pork Tongue to make your family meal more exciting and attractive!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Oyster sauce, chili sauce, pepper, scallions, cilantro, tapioca starch, sugar, fish sauce, vinegar, salt - seasoning
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the tomato and cut into wedges. Clean the scallions and cilantro, removing old leaves and roots, then chop finely. Peel and mince the shallot and garlic.
Step 2: Place the pork tongue in a pot of water and bring to a boil.
Step 3: Drain the water, use a knife to scrape off the white membrane on the surface of the tongue, then rinse thoroughly with water.
Step 4: Slice the pork tongue into bite-sized pieces. Marinate with 1 tbsp oyster sauce and 1 tsp salt.
Step 5: Heat oil in a pan, sauté the shallot and garlic until fragrant, then add the pork tongue and stir-fry briefly.
Step 6: Prepare a sauce by mixing 6 tsp vinegar, 2 tsp sugar, 1 tsp fish sauce, and 1 tsp chili sauce.
Step 7: Pour the sweet and sour mixture and the tomatoes into the pan with the tongue. Simmer over very low heat until the tongue absorbs the spices and the liquid reduces.

Step 8: Mix 1 tsp tapioca starch with 3 tbsp water. Use a spoon to mash the tomatoes in the pan. Pour in the starch mixture and cook until the sauce thickens. Add the chopped scallions and cilantro, toss well, and turn off the heat.
Step 9: Transfer the pork tongue to a plate and sprinkle with pepper. Serve hot with rice.

mon_an.ten: Steamed Fermented Snakehead Fish with Pork Rinds
mon_an.mo_ta: Steamed fermented snakehead fish with pork rinds is fragrant and rich; the fish and meat are tender and blend perfectly with ginger and herbs to make your family meal more attractive. Especially on cold winter days, eating hot rice with this dish is guaranteed to be excellent. Let's learn how to make this delicious dish! Discover the detailed guide from choosing ingredients to properly rendering pork rinds. This dish brings a bold flavor combined with crunchy rinds. Enjoy a unique traditional dish, perfect for family parties or special occasions.
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients
Wash the pork belly and blanch it briefly to clean and reduce odor, then cut into small cubes.
Wash the scallions and cut into segments.
Peel the ginger, wash, and julienne into strips.
Wash the pork fat and cut into small pieces.
Peel the garlic, wash, and mince.
Wash the cilantro and herbs with salt water and chop finely.
Steps to make Steamed Fermented Snakehead Fish with Pork Rinds:
Step 1: Place the pork fat in a pan over low heat so it doesn't burn. Stir so it doesn't stick and the fat renders out. Cook until the rinds shrink and become golden and crispy, then remove them.

Step 2: Leave a little oil in the pan and sauté the garlic until fragrant. Add the pork belly and stir-fry, seasoning with 1 tsp sugar and 1 tsp seasoning powder. Stir until the meat is cooked, browned, and slightly charred on the edges, then turn off the heat.
Step 3: Place the pork belly and the fermented fish in a bowl, sprinkle ginger on top, and steam for 15 minutes over high heat until the meat is tender.

Step 4: Once the meat has absorbed the fish flavors, remove from the steamer. Sprinkle with scallions, cilantro, pepper, herbs, and the pork rinds. Add these while still piping hot so the scallions can slightly cook.
Notes for making Steamed Fermented Snakehead Fish with Pork Rinds
This dish is best enjoyed hot with steamed rice. When hot, it is soft, rich, fragrant, and not at all greasy.
Fry the pork rinds thoroughly to render all the fat so they aren't greasy, but be careful not to burn them as they will taste bitter.

For the meat, choose pork belly rather than just lean meat; lean meat alone won't be rich enough, while too much fat will be overwhelming. Sautéing the meat until slightly charred gives it a beautiful color and better texture.
Sprinkle the scallions and herbs immediately after removing from heat to help them cook slightly and balance the dish.
How to choose good meat:

Fresh meat has a dry outer membrane and a slightly firm surface. The cut surface is bright pink, the skin is soft, the grain is firm, and it has good elasticity. The fat is bright, firm, and has a characteristic aroma. Joint surfaces are smooth and clear. Marrow clings tightly to the bone and is elastic.

Stale meat: The exterior starts to feel slimy. The cut surface is moist, and elasticity is poor (finger indentations remain). Fat is dark and soft with an off-odor. Joints are slimy and marrow is loose and dark.
Old pork or sow meat: The grain is loose, dark red, and the skin is thick.
Diseased pork: Loose grain, yellow fat, or white spots in the meat. Small spots may appear on the liver or kidneys. The skin may have circular or oval hemorrhages.
For rendering fat, choose large leaf fat that is white-pink in color.
How to buy good pork belly
Look for pieces with a dry outer membrane and a light red or bright pink color. When cut, the meat should be pinkish-white, slightly glossy, and the fat layers should be bright white and firm.
Choose a piece with a balanced ratio of fat and lean meat. This makes the dish delicious without being too greasy.
Choose pieces where the lean and fat layers are firmly attached. When you press the meat and release, it should spring back without leaving a dent.
Avoid meat with a stale or foul odor. Avoid pieces that are too dark, bruised, or have blood clots.
How to buy good snakehead fish
Size and shape: Choose fish that are medium-sized with a long, tapered body, not too flat.
Scales: Check the scales; they should be intact, black-yellow with blue floral spots.
Meat: Good fish will have firm flesh with good elasticity that doesn't feel mushy when pressed.
Eyes: Check the eyes; they should be clear, not cloudy or swollen.
Color: Fresh fish usually has a bright red color inside the gills without brown or dull spots.
Anus: The anus of fresh fish is usually smaller than that of stale fish, and fresh fish has only a mild fishy smell.

mon_an.ten: Caramelized Minced Pork with Fermented Shrimp Paste (Mắm Tép Chưng Thịt)
mon_an.mo_ta: Caramelized minced pork with fermented shrimp paste is a favorite for many; it's savory, fragrant, and incredibly appetizing. You can make a large batch and use it throughout the week. This dish is very easy and doesn't take much time, so instead of buying pre-made versions, try making it yourself for better quality and flavor. If you don't know how, let's get started with the recipe below.
cac_buoc: Introducing two ways to make this dish for you to choose from:
Method 1
Ingredients:
200g ground pork
2 large tbsp fermented shrimp paste (mắm tép)
1 garlic bulb, 2 shallots, 2 lemongrass stalks
30g sugar
Instructions:
Step 1: Finely mince the shallots, garlic, and lemongrass.
Step 2: Heat oil in a pan and sauté the shallots, garlic, and lemongrass. You should sauté the shallots for about 1 minute first before adding the garlic and lemongrass so everything cooks evenly.
Step 3: Sauté until everything is golden brown.
Step 4: Add the ground pork to the pan and stir well.
Step 5: Stir-fry the meat over high heat until cooked, then add the fermented shrimp paste.
Step 6: Continue stirring the meat with the paste over high heat until the liquid has evaporated.
Step 7: Add the sugar. You can adjust the amount of sugar to suit your taste.
Step 8: Keep stirring the meat evenly over high heat for about 3 more minutes, then turn off the heat.
Step 9: Enjoy the fragrant caramelized pork.
Method 2
300g ground pork shoulder
1 small piece of galangal, 3 lemongrass stalks, 3 garlic cloves, 2 shallots, 1 chili
3 tbsp fermented shrimp paste (mắm tép)
Peel the galangal; place galangal, garlic, shallots, and chili into a blender and mince finely.
Place the ground pork in a pan and stir-fry until the water evaporates.
When the meat starts to brown and render its fat, add the minced galangal and lemongrass mixture. If there isn't enough fat, you can add 1 tbsp of cooking oil.
Stir-fry until the galangal is fragrant and golden, then add the fermented shrimp paste.
Continue stir-frying for about 3 minutes until the mixture turns a glossy golden brown, then turn off the heat.
Your caramelized minced pork with fermented shrimp paste is now ready!
Requirements for the dish
The dish should have an attractive glossy brown color. When eating, there should be no fishy smell from the shrimp paste; instead, it should smell of shallots, galangal, and lemongrass.

The method is very fast and simple, isn't it? Your family members will surely love this dish. It doesn't take much time, and you can make it once to use for the whole week. In the hot summer, you should store the dish in the refrigerator to prevent it from spoiling. When ready to eat, enjoy it cold or reheat it.

mon_an.mo_ta: Asparagus with crab meat sauce is a nutritious dish made from two healthy ingredients, asparagus and crab, which are excellent for your health.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 1 tsp MSG, 1 tsp seasoning powder, 1/3 tsp sugar, 1 tbsp tapioca starch, 2 tbsp cooking oil
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Clean the crab meat and drain well.
Trim the woody ends of the asparagus, peel off the tough outer skin, wash, and cut into bite-sized pieces. Blanch in boiling water, then remove and set aside.
Dissolve the tapioca starch in a little cold water.
Step 2:

Heat the cooking oil in a pan. Add the soy sauce, MSG, seasoning powder, and sugar, then bring to a boil. Add the crab meat and stir-fry for about 5 minutes. Pour in the starch mixture to create a light thickness.
Arrange the asparagus on a plate, pour the crab meat sauce over it, and garnish with a tomato flower.

mon_an.mo_ta: A nutritious dish that helps the whole family recharge for studying, working, and playing. Let's look at how to make Mì Vịt Tiềm! In today's article, we will guide you through the recipe for this delicious braised duck noodle soup.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning - 80ml soy sauce; 40g seasoning powder; 80g sugar; 5g pepper
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the shiitake mushrooms and bok choy. Trim the mushroom stems and separate the bok choy hearts.
Step 2: Use rice wine and ginger to rub and remove the odor from the duck. Marinate the duck with 60ml soy sauce, 20g seasoning powder, 60g sugar, and 5g pepper for about 15 minutes.
Step 3: Place a pan on the stove, add a little oil, and turn to high heat. When the oil is hot, gently place the duck in to sear the skin until golden brown.
Step 4: Slice 4–5 pieces of ginger. Toast the ginger and herbs in a pan until fragrant.
Step 5: Clean the pork bones and parboil them in boiling water for about 5 minutes to remove impurities. Discard the dirty water.
Step 6: Pour 1.5 liters of clean water into the pot with the bones, ginger, and herbs. Simmer for about 45 minutes.

Step 7: Strain the broth. Using that broth, continue to simmer with the duck and shiitake mushrooms for another 45 minutes. Season with 20ml soy sauce, 20g seasoning powder, and 20g sugar, then turn off the heat. While the broth is cooking, blanch the bok choy for about 1 minute and remove.
Step 8: Blanch the egg noodles in boiling water for about 2 minutes until soft. Arrange the noodles and bok choy in a bowl, then serve with the braised duck and broth.
Note:
After deodorizing the duck with rice wine and ginger, rinse it several times with clean water so the meat doesn't retain too much wine smell.
During the simmering process, remember to skim off the foam to keep the broth clear.
Enjoy your delicious Mì Vịt Tiềm with your family!

mon_an.mo_ta: The mention of beer-steamed fish might make you think of a complex recipe only found in restaurants, but its rich flavor and natural sweetness will surely delight your family. Our simple yet delicious method will help you create an attractive and tasty meal. Let's try it out!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fresh ginger, pepper, salt, sugar, fish sauce, lemongrass, lemon, garlic, chili, rice paper - seasoning
Basil, bean sprouts, dill, marjoram - raw vegetables
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients for the delicious steamed fish
Wash the ginger and lemongrass, crush them, and mince finely.
Clean the fish, make a few light scores on the body, cut into chunks, and marinate with salt, lemongrass, and ginger for about 30 minutes.
Wash the tomatoes and cut them into wedges.
Trim the roots of the dill, wash, and chop finely.
Wash the celery and cut into segments.
Cut the scallions in half; split the bulbs into two or three pieces depending on their size.
Cooking steps
Step 1: Prepare the steamer. Layer the marinated lemongrass and ginger at the bottom of the pot, place the fish on top, and pour in the beer so it covers the lemongrass.
Step 2: Steam until the fish is cooked, then add the scallions, dill, celery, and tomatoes. Leave for 3-5 minutes then turn off the heat.
Step 3: Prepare the dipping sauce for the beer-steamed fish with: fish sauce, garlic, ginger, sugar, lemon juice, and chili in a 1:1:1:1:1:1 ratio.
Note
Before cooking, marinate the fish with a little salt to firm up the flesh so it doesn't break apart and tastes better.
To prevent the fish from sticking and to remove any fishy odor, layer the lemongrass and ginger at the bottom of the pot.
If you have young children, choose grass carp for steaming as it has more meat and is easier to eat.
How to choose fresh fish:

First, you should buy fish that are still swimming. Look at the appearance: if it is still slimy and shiny, the eyes are transparent, the scales are not loose, the gills are still pink, and the fish sinks when put in water, it is fresh. If the exterior is sticky, the eyes are sunken, the scales fall off easily, the color is pale, the flesh is not elastic, the belly and anus are swollen, and the fish floats, it is stale.
Another way to distinguish fresh from stale: a fresh fish has a pale white anus that is tucked into the belly, while a stale one has a protruding, bruised purple anus.
Identifying contaminated fish
Homemakers need to know how to choose fish to ensure meals are delicious and safe.
The gills are the respiratory organ, like human lungs; most toxins likely concentrate here. Toxic gills are not bright or smooth, but rough and dark crimson.
Severely contaminated fish may have an irregular shape, a large head with a small tail, a hunched back, or even tumors. Some may have yellow skin and a green tail.
The eyes of contaminated fish are often cloudy, losing their normal brightness, and some may even protrude.
Normal fish have a fishy smell; contaminated fish will have unusual odors like garlic or kerosene.
Distinguishing fresh and stale fish
A few tips to help you buy good fish at the daily market.
Eyes: Fresh fish have bulging, transparent eyes with elastic corneas. Stale fish eyes are sunken, cloudy, and the cornea is wrinkled or torn.
Anus: Fresh fish have a deep-set, pale white anus and a flat belly. Stale fish have a pink or dark red protruding anus and a bloated belly.
Gills: Fresh gills are bright red, firmly attached to the gill arches, not slimy, and have no foul odor. Stale gills are gray, loose, slimy, and smell bad.
Scales: Fresh fish have shiny scales that stick firmly to the body, with no discharge or odor. Stale fish scales are dull, easily peel off, and have an odor.
Additionally, fresh fish have a tightly closed mouth, while stale fish have a slightly open mouth. Fresh fish meat is firm and elastic, leaving no finger indentation. Stale fish is the opposite.

mon_an.mo_ta: We will combine beef and pumpkin to treat the whole family to a pumpkin stew that is both sweet and healthy. The pumpkin becomes soft, smooth, and creamy after simmering, which combined with the beef will surely have everyone slurping it up! Check out the recipe for this sweet and refreshing pumpkin stew below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning salt, fish sauce, MSG... - seasoning
cac_buoc: Wash the beef and slice into bite-sized pieces.
Place the beef in a pot, add about 1 bowl of water, and simmer over low heat.
When the beef is tender, remove the meat to stir-fry with the onion, pumpkin, and a little salt for about 5 minutes.
Next, add the beef broth back in and cook until the vegetables are completely soft.
Finally, season to taste, add chopped scallions and culantro, then turn off the heat!
Total time: 55 minutes
Preparation time: 15 minutes
Cooking time: 40 minutes
Total: 55 minutes
Ingredients:
Pumpkin - 500 gr
Beef tenderloin - 300 gr
Onion - 1/4 bulb
Scallions - a few stalks
Seasoning salt, fish sauce, MSG... - seasoning
Instructions:

mon_an.mo_ta: Sour baby clam soup—this rustic and easy-to-cook dish is loved by many. Show off your cooking skills for your loved ones to enjoy a great meal.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, seasoning powder, dried shallots - ingredients
cac_buoc: Soak the baby clams in a bowl of cold water with a little salt for about 1 hour. Then rinse several times until very clean.

Bring a pot of water to a boil, drop the clams in and cook until they open their shells. Turn off the heat, let cool, pour the clam broth into a separate clean bowl, pick out the clam meat, and discard the shells.
Wash the tomatoes and cut into wedges.
Wash and finely chop the dill.
Heat two teaspoons of oil, sauté the minced shallots until fragrant, add the tomatoes and stir-fry for about 3 minutes.
Pour the clam broth and clam meat into the pot and bring to a boil. Season with two teaspoons of salt and half a teaspoon of seasoning powder; adjust to your taste.
Finally, turn off the heat, sprinkle with chopped dill, and serve the soup with rice.

mon_an.mo_ta: Pork rib and tamarind soup is an easy-to-make and easy-to-eat dish. The sweet rib broth combined with the sour taste of tamarind will win over your whole family. Check out our recipe below!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Wash the ribs and chop into small pieces.
Wash the tomatoes and cut into wedges.
Scrape the skin off the tamarind and wash it.
Wash and chop the scallions.
Step 2:
Place the ribs in a pot, cover with water, and bring to a boil for about 2 minutes. Turn off the heat, drain, and rinse the ribs again to remove any scum; this is the cleaning step.
Put the ribs back in the pot with about two bowls of water. Bring to a boil, then lower the heat to simmer until the ribs are cooked and the broth is sweet.
Step 3:
Add the tamarind fruit.
When the ribs are tender and the broth is sweet, add the tomatoes and cook for another 10 minutes. Season to taste, add the scallions, and serve hot.
The hot soup with the aroma of scallions and the sweet and sour taste of simmered ribs and tamarind will make you want to enjoy it immediately as an appetizer for your family meal.

mon_an.mo_ta: Beef and vegetable stew is not only delicious and sweet from the beef and vegetables but also very nutritious. With tender, flavorful beef, you can even cook this for people recovering from illness as it is very good for health. Give it a try!
cac_buoc: How to make beef and vegetable stew
Step 1: Prepare ingredients
Cut the corn into small segments.
Peel and slice the lotus root.
Peel the tough outer skin of the broccoli stems and break into small florets.
Dice the tomato.
Wash the beef and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Step 2: Cooking steps
Place the beef in a large pot with a little ginger and cover with water.
When the beef starts to cook through, remove it and place it in another pot, adding fresh water and a little wine.
Add the corn and lotus root, cover, and simmer for about 90 minutes over medium-low heat.
Next, add the tomato and broccoli, and cook for another 5 minutes.
Finally, season with a little salt to taste and turn off the heat. Serve the beef and vegetable stew in a bowl with hot rice.
Note
If you cannot find lotus root and corn, you can substitute them with carrots and potatoes.
You can also apply this recipe with chicken for those who do not eat beef.

mon_an.mo_ta: Shrimp and starfruit sour soup is a perfect dish for hot summer days, featuring sweet shrimp, tangy starfruit, and aromatic herbs. It is a very visually appealing dish. Let's learn how to make it!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Rice paddy herb, culantro, scallions - garnish
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients: trim the shrimp legs and antennae, keep the heads and shells, then wash clean. Soak and wash the starfruit and tomato, then slice the starfruit and cut the tomato into wedges. Soak, wash, and chop the herbs.

In a pot, sauté the minced shallots until fragrant, then add the shrimp and stir-fry until just cooked. Add the tomato and starfruit, toss briefly, then pour in 1 bowl of water. Cook until the water boils, season to taste, turn off the heat, sprinkle with herbs, and serve.

mon_an.mo_ta: Crispy beer-marinated chicken is a unique dish where the chicken is marinated with beer and spices. After frying, each piece of chicken is very crispy and fragrant, and the garlic-chili stir-fry sauce makes it even more attractive! Don't miss this delicious dish in your cooking list!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Garlic, dried chili, ginger, ground pepper, five-spice powder, seasoning, bay leaves (optional) - ingredients
cac_buoc: Step 1: Chop the chicken wings into bite-sized pieces.
Step 2: Marinate the chicken with ginger, garlic, and pepper.
Step 3: Add the beer and soy sauce, and marinate for about 1-2 hours.
Step 4: Drain off the beer marinade, then add the flour and crack the egg into the chicken, mixing well.
Step 5: Fry the chicken in a pan with plenty of oil until the skin is crispy and golden brown. Remove and drain on paper towels.
Step 6: In a pan with hot oil, sauté the ginger, garlic, and dried chili until fragrant.
Step 7: Add the chicken, five-spice powder, pepper, and bay leaves, and toss well.
Step 8: Finally, when the chicken has absorbed the spices, add the roasted peanuts, toss thoroughly, and turn off the heat.

mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried chicken with peanuts is a simple dish in both preparation and ingredients; however, the flavor it brings is very special—a harmony of heat from chilies, richness from soy sauce, crunch from peanuts, and tenderness from the chicken. This dish served with rice on chilly days is wonderful!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning - rice wine, soy sauce, vinegar, starch water (tapioca starch mixed with a little water), salt, egg white, sugar, MSG, cooking oil
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Wash the chicken breast and cut into small squares.
Mix the egg white, rice wine, salt, and starch water, then marinate the chicken in this mixture.
Step 2:
Finely mince the ginger and scallions, and slice the chilies.
To make the sauce: combine a little of each—rice wine, sugar, MSG, starch water, vinegar, soy sauce, and minced ginger—in a small bowl and mix well.
Step 3:
Heat a little oil in a pan and sauté the scallions and garlic until fragrant, then add the marinated chicken and chopped chilies to stir-fry.
Step 4:

Pour in the sauce and mix well. Cover and cook until the sauce boils, then add the peanuts. Toss well so the sauce coats the peanuts, then turn off the heat and serve on a plate. This dish is excellent served hot with rice.
Now, enjoy the results!

mon_an.mo_ta: Mắm kho quẹt is an enticing dish featuring tender, flavorful pork and crispy, savory dried shrimp simmered in a thick, concentrated fish sauce. It is served with steamed rice, and especially with scorched rice (cơm cháy), providing a wonderful culinary experience. Let's head to the kitchen to prepare this delicious treat for your family!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Small chilies, sliced into rounds - 4-5 pieces
cac_buoc: Step 1: Clean the pork belly and remove the skin. Cut the pork into small, bite-sized pieces, then marinate with a bit of minced shallots and a pinch of seasoning salt. Let it sit for 15 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Step 2: Soak the dried shrimp in water for 10 minutes until they soften and expand. Drain them in a colander.

Step 3: Place a pan on the stove. Add a tiny bit of oil; once the oil is slightly hot, add the pork and stir-fry over medium heat. Stir continuously until the pork renders its fat and turns golden brown, then add the shallots and garlic and sauté for 2 minutes.

Next, add the shrimp and stir-fry for 5-6 minutes until the shrimp are soft and flavorful. Finally, pour in the fish sauce mixture along with the dried chili flakes. Reduce to low heat and simmer until the sauce thickens into a glaze and the meat and shrimp have a beautiful color. Add the green onions and sliced chilies, toss well, and turn off the heat.
Finally, scoop the mắm kho quẹt onto a plate or into a bowl. Serve with scorched rice or steamed rice to fully enjoy the flavors of the dish.
Notes for a delicious mắm kho quẹt:

You should marinate the pork before cooking to make it more flavorful. When stir-frying the pork, remember to stir evenly so the meat doesn't burn and the fat renders out, giving the pork a crispy golden exterior and an attractive color.
Remember to soak the dried shrimp before use so they soften and cook evenly.
How to choose good pork:
External appearance:

Fresh pork will have a dry outer membrane and a bright red or dark red, glossy color. The fat should have a normal color and firmness. Conversely, if the meat is stale, it will be slightly dark or pale green and dull. Stale meat may also feel slimy and have an unpleasant odor.
The cut surface:
For fresh meat, the cut surface is normal, bright, and dry. For spoiled meat, the cut surface is dark and slightly wet.
Firmness and elasticity:
Fresh meat is usually firm with high elasticity. When you press your finger into the meat, it should not leave a dent and should not be sticky. Stale meat is the opposite.
Regarding bone marrow:

If the bone is fresh, the marrow will stick firmly to the bone wall and be clear and elastic. When the bone is stale (left for over 8 hours), the marrow will loosen from the bone canal, look dark, and smell foul.

Even after cooking, you can still tell if the meat is high quality. If the broth is clear with large fat bubbles and a fragrant aroma, the meat was fresh. If the broth is slightly cloudy, smells bad, and has tiny fat specks, the meat was less fresh or stale.

Mắm kho quẹt is an enticing dish featuring tender, flavorful pork and crispy, savory dried shrimp simmered in a thick, concentrated fish sauce. It is served with steamed rice, and especially with scorched rice, providing a wonderful culinary experience. Let's head to the kitchen to prepare this delicious treat for your family!

mon_an.ten: Stir-fried Glass Noodles with Dried Squid
mon_an.mo_ta: This is a simple dish that doesn't require complex ingredients or cooking methods yet remains highly attractive. Check out the detailed instructions below to make the best stir-fried glass noodles with dried squid!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Coriander, green onions, shallots, pepper, seasonings, cooking oil.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Soak the dried squid in hot water until it expands.
Soak the glass noodles in cold water until soft.
Fry the eggs into a thin omelet.
Step 2:
Julienne the squid, ham, eggs, kohlrabi, and carrots.
Cut the glass noodles into sections.
Finely chop the green onions and coriander.
Crush and mince the shallots.
Step 3:
Sauté the minced shallots in a pan with oil until fragrant, then add the squid and a bit of seasoning. Stir-fry until firm, then remove to a plate.

Stir-fry the kohlrabi and carrots until parboiled, then add the glass noodles and toss well until cooked. During the stir-frying process, remember to add seasonings and toss quickly so the dish cooks evenly and absorbs the flavors.

Once the noodles and kohlrabi are just cooked, add the eggs, ham, and the previously sautéed squid. Toss everything together, then add the green onions and half of the coriander. Stir well and it's done.
Step 4:
Transfer the stir-fried glass noodles with dried squid to a large plate and sprinkle the remaining coriander on top.
Good luck and enjoy your meal!

mon_an.mo_ta: The rustic dish of snails cooked with green bananas and tofu offers a delightful sense of satisfaction. Let's get into the kitchen and learn how to cook this delicious meal! The weather in the days leading up to Tet brings a chilly atmosphere that feels incredibly pleasant. There is nothing better than the whole family gathering together to enjoy ốc nấu chuối đậu, featuring the characteristic flavors of Northern Vietnam. Quickly learn the recipe below to show off your skills during the upcoming holidays! Enjoy the chilly pre-Tet days with your family with this authentic Northern-style snail dish. Learn the simple recipe and enjoy the unique flavors of this coastal-inspired dish right at home.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Piper lolot leaves, perilla, green onions - as needed
Seasonings, cooking oil, minced shallots and garlic - as needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the snails

To make this dish, you can choose between apple snails, black snails, or stone snails—types that have delicious, crunchy meat. Before use, soak the snails in rice water with a few halved chilies to clean out the mud and increase the richness of the snail meat. After soaking for several hours, wash the snails thoroughly and blanch them quickly in boiling water for about 1 minute, stirring so the trapdoors fall off.

Next, remove the snails and keep the boiling liquid for later use. Once the snails have cooled, extract the meat, remove the intestines, and scrub with salt to clean, then rinse with water. Marinate the snail meat with 2 tsp seasoning powder, 1 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp sugar, 1/2 tbsp turmeric powder, and 1/2 tbsp ground pepper.
Step 2: Prepare the pork belly and tofu

Choosing pork belly will make the dish richer and more attractive. After buying the meat, wash it with diluted salt water and rinse again. Next, slice the meat into bite-sized pieces and marinate with 2 tsp fish sauce, 1 tsp seasoning powder, 1/2 tsp ground pepper, 1/2 tbsp strained fermented rice water, and a bit of turmeric powder for 15-20 minutes. After marinating, you can sear the meat in a pan for even color and remove it to drain the fat.
For the tofu, rinse it and cut into small bite-sized pieces. Then, fry the tofu in a pan or use an air fryer to save time.
Step 3: Prepare the vegetables

Peel the green bananas, then cut them into batons or thick diagonal slices as desired. Immediately soak the bananas in water mixed with lime juice. This step prevents the bananas from turning black and makes the dish look more appealing. After soaking, drain and marinate with 1 tsp fish sauce, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 tbsp fermented rice water, and a bit of turmeric powder.
Mince the shallots. Trim the roots of the green onions, wash, and chop finely. Pick the perilla and piper lolot leaves, wash them, and chop finely. Remove the stems from the chilies and slice them.
Mix the tapioca starch with a little water and stir well to use later to create a thick consistency for the dish.
Step 4: Cook the snails with bananas and tofu

Place a pot on the stove, add oil, and sauté the minced shallots until fragrant. Next, add all the marinated snails and green bananas to the pot and stir-fry quickly to firm them up. Then, pour the snail boiling liquid into the pot and bring to a boil. Add the pork belly, lower the heat, and cover to simmer for 15 minutes until the ingredients are tender. Then, add the fried tofu to the pot and continue cooking for another 5-7 minutes.

Taste the soup and adjust the seasoning to your preference. If you need more acidity, add more fermented rice water until the desired sourness is reached. Then, slowly pour the dissolved cornstarch into the pot while stirring constantly. At this point, the soup will have a nice thick consistency.
Finally, add the perilla, piper lolot leaves, green onions, and chilies to the pot and bring to a boil. Once the soup has boiled, you can turn off the heat; the ốc nấu chuối đậu is complete.
Notes for making ốc nấu chuối đậu:
Some people keep the banana peels after stripping them and stir-fry them with the dish to create a unique flavor.
The secret to a naturally thick consistency is to boil 2 bananas, mash them finely, and add them to the pot. Avoid using too much starch as it can make the dish too gooey.
Authentic Northern-style ốc nấu chuối đậu uses shrimp paste and is not cooked with tomatoes like in some other regions.
To keep the bananas from turning black, you can soak them in diluted lime juice or lime water (nước vôi).
If you don't have rice water, you can add a bit of wheat flour when soaking the snails to help them taste richer.

mon_an.mo_ta: Shrimp curry with easy-to-find ingredients and a simple preparation method is incredibly delicious. There's no reason not to cook this for your family! Refer to the recipe in the article below!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Peel the shrimp, remove the heads, and devein the back and belly.
Marinate the shrimp with a bit of minced garlic and lemongrass, some seasoning powder, seasonings, and 1 packet of curry powder.
Step 2:
Peel the sweet potato, cut into pieces, and soak in a bowl of diluted salt water to prevent browning.
After about 10 minutes, fry the potatoes in a pan until slightly golden on all sides (or just until the surfaces are firm), then remove to a plate.
Step 3:
Cut the carrot and onion into pieces similar in size to the sweet potato.
Mince the garlic, crush the lemongrass and cut into sections. Pick and wash the basil leaves.
Step 4:
Sauté the lemongrass and garlic until fragrant, then add the shrimp and stir-fry briefly.
Step 5:
Pour about 1 small bowl of water into the shrimp pot, bring to a boil, then add the potatoes and carrots. Simmer the mixture for a few minutes, then add the onion and coconut milk.
Add more seasoning powder and seasonings, simmer for a few more minutes, then add the basil leaves.
Step 6:
Transfer the shrimp curry to a bowl. It is delicious served with rice, bread, or rice vermicelli.

mon_an.mo_ta: Head to the kitchen to prepare delicious squid dishes for your family to enjoy on the weekend. They will surely be satisfied with your talent. Below is the guide on how to make crispy fried meat-stuffed squid!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Wood ear mushrooms, shiitake mushrooms - soaked, julienned
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients:
Clean the squid, separating the body and the tentacles. Mince the tentacles to mix with the meat.
Soak the wood ear and shiitake mushrooms until they expand. Wash and chop finely.
Peel, wash, and mince the onion.
Trim the roots of the green onions, wash, and cut into small sections.
Execution steps:
Step 1: Mix the minced pork, wood ear mushrooms, shiitake mushrooms, green onions, dill, and onion with pepper and seasoning powder to taste. Marinate for about 20 minutes.
Step 2: Keep the squid bodies whole and stuff the meat mixture inside.
Attach the tentacles back and use a toothpick to secure the opening of the body.

Step 3: Add cooking oil to a pan. Fry until golden on both sides. At the beginning of frying, you should use low heat and cover with a lid so the squid and meat can cook through evenly. Then open the lid, increase the heat, and fry until the squid is slightly charred and golden.
Eat while hot, dipping in chili sauce and mayonnaise.
Notes for making delicious crispy fried meat-stuffed squid:
Do not over-fry, or the squid will become tough.
Only stuff the meat moderately—not too tight and not too loose. (If stuffed too tight, the squid will burst or tear when frying. If too loose, the meat will fall out when sliced).

mon_an.mo_ta: The sweet and chewy texture of squid combined with the sweet and sour tamarind sauce and a hint of fragrant ginger creates a special appeal for this dish. Let's get in the kitchen and learn how to make this delicious meal!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning powder, fish sauce, salt, pepper, sugar, cooking oil - as needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Soak the tamarind in hot water until soft, then press through a sieve to collect the pulp. Peel and wash the ginger; julienne half and mince the other half. Peel, wash, and mince the garlic. Wash and slice the chili.
Step 2: Clean the squid, rub briefly with the minced ginger, then rinse with a bit of rice wine to remove the fishy smell. Let the squid drain, then cut into bite-sized rings.
Step 3: Marinate the squid with a bit of seasoning powder, pepper, and half of the tamarind pulp. Cover with plastic wrap and keep in the refrigerator for about 15 minutes to let the flavors absorb.

Step 4: Place a pan on the stove, add 1 tbsp of oil, and sauté the minced garlic until fragrant. Add the squid and stir-fry until firm. Next, add the remaining tamarind sauce, a bit of fish sauce, and sugar. Adjust the seasoning to taste and simmer for 1-2 minutes until the sauce thickens.
Finally, turn off the heat, add the julienned ginger and chili, and toss well. Serve the squid in tamarind sauce on a plate and enjoy!
Note:
How to choose fresh squid:
There are many types of fresh squid like cuttlefish, squid, or baby squid, but if you don't know how to choose carefully, you might buy stale ones.
For cuttlefish: Choose large, thick-bodied ones that are milky white, firm, not mushy, with an even brown membrane on the outside and firm tentacles.
For squid: Choose ones with bright, slightly pinkish flesh, heads still firmly attached to the body, firm tentacles, and intact ink sacs.
Avoid squid that has turned a greenish-ivory color, has soft flesh, loose heads, or a very fishy smell, as these are no longer fresh.
How to clean squid safely:
Gently pull the head and tentacles away from the body and set aside. Clean the squid thoroughly under running water.
Gently pull the transparent quill (backbone) out of the body. Use your fingers to clean the inside of the body under running water.

Cut the tentacles just above the eyes. Use a knife or scissors to remove the beak (squid have a beak near the eyes like a bird's beak). You can also squeeze the area near the eyes firmly to pop the beak out. This part is inedible and should be discarded.
If desired, you can peel off the skin and fins.
To remove the fishy smell, after cleaning, you can wash the squid with a bit of rice wine, then rinse again with fresh water.

The finished squid in tamarind sauce has an eye-catching color and a delicious flavor, with chewy, crunchy squid coated in a sauce that is perfectly sweet and sour. This dish is perfect with hot rice, especially during the cold winter!

mon_an.mo_ta: Meat-stuffed mushrooms in tomato sauce is a simple yet nutritious dish featuring sweet pork and fragrant mushrooms in a vibrant sauce. This wonderful dish is perfect for autumn days! Let's head to the kitchen and try it!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, pepper, seasoning powder, a bit of MSG - as needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Soak the shiitake mushrooms in diluted salt water, wash thoroughly, and remove the stems.
Step 2: Marinate the minced pork with minced white parts of green onions, seasoning powder, and MSG. Let it sit for 10 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Step 3: Scoop small spoonfuls of meat and stuff them into the mushroom caps.
Step 4: Heat a pan, add oil, and lightly pan-fry the stuffed mushrooms.
Step 5: Cut the tomatoes into wedges.
Step 6: Add oil to a pan, sauté the tomatoes, season to taste, and add a little water.
Step 7: Finally, add the mushrooms and simmer over low heat so they absorb the tomato sauce. The dish is now complete.

mon_an.mo_ta: A dish imbued with the poetic essence of Hue; the mention of stir-fried lotus rootlets with pork recalls a place where even everyday meals reflect the characteristic sophistication of the ancient capital. Check out our recipe below!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Wash the pork, slice into bite-sized pieces, and marinate with 1 tsp of seasoning powder for 5 minutes.
Step 2:
Wash the lotus rootlets and cut into sections; split the thicker ones in half.
Step 3:
Soak the lotus rootlets in diluted lemon water to keep them white, then rinse and drain.
Step 4:
Peel and wash the carrot, then julienne thinly.
Wash the green onions and cut into sections.
Step 5:
Heat the oil, sauté the minced garlic until fragrant, add the pork and stir-fry until cooked. Add the carrots and lotus rootlets, then season with fish sauce and seasoning powder to taste.
Finally, add the green onions and toss well.
How to choose lotus rootlets for stir-frying:

To get good lotus rootlets, choose fresh ones with stems that are neither too large nor too thin. Stems that are slightly dark or have mud attached indicate they haven't been bleached and are safe to use. Avoid buying pure white ones as they may have been bleached.
Additionally, do not buy lotus rootlets that are mushy, bruised, waterlogged, or rotten. When touched, they should not feel slimy or limp.
Preparing lotus rootlets:

To keep them white and crunchy, first clean the lotus rootlets with fresh water. Then, break them into small sections about 4–6 cm long. Next, soak them in a mixture of 100 ml vinegar and 2 liters of water. You can cover them with plastic wrap and keep them in the refrigerator or a cool place for a few hours. This method helps remove dirt and ensures the lotus rootlets are crunchy.

mon_an.mo_ta: Today, we will join you in the kitchen to make "Nộm sứa tai heo" (Jellyfish and Pork Ear Salad). This is a dish that is not only beautiful but also very enticing. If you love salads, follow this recipe.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fresh or pre-processed bagged jellyfish - 400 g
cac_buoc: Rinse the jellyfish multiple times to remove the saltiness. Then, blanch the jellyfish in boiling water mixed with turmeric powder and drain.
Singe the pork ear over a low flame, especially in hairy areas, then use a knife to scrape it clean. Wash with salt water, boil until cooked, and slice into thin, bite-sized strips.
Roast the peanuts until cooked, rub off the skins, and discard them. Crush the peanuts, making sure they are not ground too finely.
Squeeze the lime for juice and remove the seeds.
Thinly slice the starfruit.
Peel the outer layer of the lemongrass and thinly slice the tender bulb part.
Wash the onion, slice thinly, and soak in ice-cold water.
Remove seeds from the chilies and chop finely.
Pick and wash the basil leaves, then drain.

Next, put the jellyfish + pork ear + basil + starfruit + lemongrass + onion + chili into a bowl. Add the fish sauce + lime juice + sugar and toss well. Set aside for about 15 minutes to let the flavors absorb. During this time, toss occasionally for even seasoning.
When ready to eat, arrange on a plate, sprinkle with roasted peanuts, and serve immediately.

mon_an.mo_ta: This mango and vegetable salad is very good for the body because the combination of vegetables and fruits provides many nutrients and helps cool the body down on hot days. Discover our recipe below!
cac_buoc: Preparation:
Before starting, clean and prepare all the ingredients!
Step 1: Peel the green mango and shred it into small strips, placing them in a clean bowl.
Step 2: Peel and shred the carrot.
Step 3: Clean the bean sprouts by removing the roots. (You can skip this if you're short on time).
Step 4: Arrange the green mango, carrot, and bean sprouts in a large bowl.
Step 5: Mix the dressing: 2 tbsp fish sauce + 2 tbsp white sugar + 1 tsp MSG + 1 chopped ripe chili + a little lime juice. Adjust to your taste.
Step 6: Add 1/2 of the shredded coconut and toss well.
Step 7: Slowly pour in the dressing and mix well so the ingredients absorb the flavors. Then add the rest of the shredded coconut and some crushed roasted peanuts.
Step 8: Add the chopped herbs and toss one last time.
Step 9: Transfer the mango and vegetable salad to a plate. We have now finished this delicious and refreshing dish!

mon_an.mo_ta: Beef is considered a very healthy food and can be prepared in many different ways. Today, we will guide you on how to make delicious stir-fried beef pho just like at a restaurant.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Blanch the pho noodles in hot water, let them cool, and then loosen the strands.
Thinly slice the onion into wedges.
Step 2:
Marinate the beef: Thinly slice the beef and marinate with: 2 tsp light soy sauce; 2 tsp cooking wine; 1 tsp sugar; 2 tsp sesame oil.
Marinate for 15-20 minutes so the meat absorbs the flavors.
Step 3:
Sauté minced garlic in a hot pan with oil, then add the beef and stir-fry first.
When the beef is mostly cooked, add the pho noodles to stir-fry together. Pho noodles cook quite quickly; reduce to medium heat and stir-fry evenly so the noodles stay loose and don't clump together.
You can add a little water if it's too dry, then adjust the seasoning to balance the flavor of the noodles and beef.
Stir-fry until the liquid has evaporated, then sprinkle with scallions and serve on a plate.
Finally, you have completed a hot and delicious *stir-fried beef pho* dish that is as attractive as any restaurant's.

mon_an.mo_ta: Tuna salad – a delicacy for gourmets that you can easily make yourself to treat the whole family. It is not only delicious but also very good for your health.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning - garlic, olive oil, salt, toasted sesame seeds, pepper
Sauce ingredients - mayonnaise, soy sauce, wasabi, lemon juice
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Mix the mayonnaise with soy sauce, wasabi, and lemon juice to suit your taste.
Step 2:
Wash the tuna and marinate with salt, pepper, and toasted sesame seeds for 10 minutes.
Step 3:
Thinly slice the garlic and fry until golden and crispy.
Step 4:
Place the tuna in a frying pan; when the meat turns white, flip it over. We need to sear it quickly so the outside is cooked while the inside remains rare.
Step 5:
Next, slice the tuna into pieces about 1cm thick.
Step 6:
Wash the vegetables and slice the onion into small rings.
Toss the vegetables with olive oil and a pinch of salt.
Step 7:
Place the tuna on top and drizzle with the sauce to complete this fresh and delicious salad.
Garnish with a few slices of lemon and tomato for extra appeal!

mon_an.mo_ta: With this extremely simple yet perfectly flavored recipe for braised pork belly with daikon, your family won't be able to stop eating once they start!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning: salt, broth powder, pepper, coconut caramel sauce, fish sauce, cooking oil.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the pork belly, rub slightly with a bit of salt, then rinse and drain. Slice into bite-sized pieces. Marinate the meat with a little broth powder, pepper, coconut caramel sauce, and some minced shallots (set aside the rest for sautéing).
Step 2: Peel the daikon, remove both ends, wash, and cut into 3-4cm chunks, then quarter them lengthwise.

Step 3: Place a pot on the stove, add a tablespoon of oil, and sauté the remaining minced shallots until fragrant. Add the marinated meat and stir until firm. Once the meat is seared, add boiling water to cover the surface, add a bit of seasoning, and simmer over low heat. The braising time depends on how tender you want the meat.

Step 4: About 7-8 minutes before the meat is fully tender, add the daikon to braise together. When the daikon is soft, add a little fish sauce for aroma and adjust the seasoning to taste. Turn off the heat, add julienned ginger, and sprinkle with a little pepper.
Braised pork belly with daikon is delicious when served hot with white rice.
The tender, fatty, and savory pork belly combined with the sweet daikon and the spicy, fragrant ginger is truly irresistible.
Enjoy your meal with this easy-to-eat braised pork belly with daikon!

mon_an.ten: Braised Pork Belly with Straw Mushrooms
mon_an.mo_ta: Braised pork belly with straw mushrooms is simple from ingredients to preparation. This dish is incredibly savory when served with hot rice; let's get into the kitchen and make this for the whole family!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning - Fish sauce, broth powder, sugar, coconut caramel sauce, pepper, salt.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the pork belly with a bit of salt, drain, and slice into small pieces. Note: When braising with straw mushrooms, slice the meat slightly smaller than for other braised dishes.

Step 2: Marinate the meat with minced shallots, fish sauce, broth powder, coconut caramel sauce (or caramel sauce), and a little sugar for 15-20 minutes to absorb the flavors. If you are not used to the seasoning ratios, you can use a pre-packaged braised meat seasoning mix.
Step 3: Trim the stems of the straw mushrooms, remove any bruised parts, wash, and soak in rice water with a bit of salt for about 30 minutes to keep them clean and white.
If you don't have rice water, use plain water with a bit of salt. Then, drain in a colander, rinse with clean water, and let dry.
Step 4: Place a pot on the stove and stir-fry the meat until firm.
Step 5: When the meat is firm, add enough boiling water to cover the surface. Braise over medium heat until the water is almost evaporated and the meat is tender.
Step 6: Add the straw mushrooms and stir well, braising for another 5-7 minutes. Adjust seasoning to taste. Turn off the heat, sprinkle with chopped scallions, sliced chili, and a bit of pepper.

mon_an.mo_ta: Beef rolls with mustard greens are a perfect combination of sweet beef and the pungent spice of mustard greens. Served with accompaniments like pineapple, cucumber, green banana, and ginger, along with a sweet and sour spicy dipping sauce, this dish creates a rich blend of flavors that leaves a lingering tingle on the tongue. It is a perfect dish that balances all taste elements for a wonderful culinary experience. Enjoy the harmony of sweet beef and spicy greens, fresh sides, and a flavorful sauce for an unforgettable meal.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning - to taste (salt, pepper, soy sauce, mustard)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare ingredients
Beef:

Choose tenderloin to ensure the dish is soft and not chewy. Wash the beef with diluted salt water, then slice into finger-sized pieces for easy rolling. Marinate the meat with broth powder, MSG, salt, pepper, and a little oil to soften. Grill the meat over charcoal until medium-rare with slightly charred edges, then set aside.
Accompaniments:
Pineapple: Wash, peel, remove eyes, and cut into small pieces or long strips.
Green banana: Wash, peel the outer skin, and cut into long thin strips.
Sour starfruit: Wash, trim the edges, and slice into long thin strips.
Carrot: Peel, wash, and slice into long thin strips.
Shiitake mushrooms: Soak until soft, keep the soaking water, boil, and chop small.
Mustard greens: Wash, remove the stems, and keep the leaves whole.
Aromatics:
Ginger: Wash, peel, slice, and mince.
Cilantro: Wash, pick the leaves, discard roots and outer skin.
Chili: Wash and remove seeds.
Shallots: Peel and mince.
Step 2: Processing

Marinate the beef: Place the beef on a plate and sprinkle with 1 tsp sea salt and 2 tsp ground pepper. Rub thoroughly so the salt and pepper cover the meat surface. Marinate for 15 minutes. Note: Use only sea salt and ground pepper to preserve the characteristic flavor of the beef. If the meat is too thick, you can cut it into 2 or 3 parts so the seasoning penetrates better.
Pan-sear the beef: In a pan, heat about 5 tbsp of cooking oil. When the oil is hot, add the marinated beef and sear over medium heat.
When the meat is golden brown on both sides, remove and let it rest for 2-3 minutes before cutting into small pieces.
Pro tips:
Avoid using butter for searing to prevent burning.
Letting the meat rest for 2-3 minutes helps the surface firm up while keeping the inside tender and juicy.
Make the dipping sauce: In a bowl, combine 1 tsp chopped chili, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tbsp warm water, and a little mustard. Stir well until the sugar dissolves.

Finish the dish: After searing, slice the beef into bite-sized thin pieces. Lay out a mustard green leaf, add beef, cilantro, cucumber, carrot, and a bit of ginger. Roll it up and dip in the mustard soy sauce to enjoy.
Notes for making Beef Rolls with Mustard Greens
Choose fresh beef: Select tender beef with not too much fat. Lean meat is the best choice for this dish.

Marinate thoroughly: Before cooking, marinate the beef with a mixture of minced garlic, minced shallots, salt, pepper, fish sauce, and a little sugar. Ensure the meat is evenly coated and let it sit for at least 30 minutes.
Cook the beef correctly: Cook the beef over medium heat to ensure it cooks evenly without drying out. Turn frequently and cook until browned and just done.
Fresh mustard greens: Choose fresh, crisp leaves. Before using, soak the leaves in cold water to clean and keep them fresh.
Add fresh vegetables: Besides cilantro, lettuce, carrots, and cucumber, you can add other herbs like basil, scallions, or saw-leaf herb to enhance the flavor and variety.
Roll tightly: When rolling, make sure to roll tightly so the roll doesn't tear and the ingredients don't fall out.
Flavorful dipping sauce: Prepare a delicious sauce to accompany the rolls. You can add minced garlic, minced chili, sugar, fish sauce, and a bit of lemon juice or vinegar for a unique taste.

mon_an.ten: Stir-fried Beef with Pickled Mustard Greens
mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried beef with pickled mustard greens is a rustic yet nutritious dish. The sweet and savory beef combined with the crunchy texture of the pickled greens brings a unique and delicious flavor. This dish is not only suitable for family meals but also a favorite for husbands when gathering with friends.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fish sauce, broth powder, MSG, pepper, sugar - Seasoning
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the beef, slice thinly, and marinate with a bit of MSG, broth powder, and pepper. Let it sit for 15 minutes to absorb the seasoning.
Step 2: Squeeze the excess water out of the pickled mustard greens and rinse them if they are too salty or too sour.
Step 3: Slice the tomato into wedges.
Step 4: Lightly crush the scallions and celery, then cut into sections.
Step 5: Peel and crush the garlic.
Step 6: Sauté half of the garlic until fragrant, add the beef to stir-fry separately, then transfer to a plate.
Step 7: Sauté the remaining half of the garlic, add the pickled mustard greens and stir-fry. Season with 1/2 tbsp broth powder, 1 tsp MSG, and a few drops of fish sauce for aroma.

Step 8: Add a little water to help the seasonings dissolve, then add the tomatoes to stir-fry together. Finally, add the beef, scallions, and celery, and toss everything together. Turn off the heat, transfer to a plate, sprinkle with pepper, and serve hot.

mon_an.mo_ta: With a crispy fried exterior and savory, tender, fragrant chicken, this dish is guaranteed to make your family meal much more attractive! Let's learn how to make these broccoli stuffed chicken rolls!
cac_buoc: Here are the ingredients you need for this dish!
Step 1:
Place the chicken in a food storage bag and use a meat mallet to pound it until tender and thin.
Next, marinate the chicken with pepper for about 20 minutes.
Step 2:
Finely chop the onion and sauté it with butter for about 5 minutes, then add minced garlic and sauté for another 30 seconds.
Step 3:
Add the chopped spinach and stir for about 1 minute.
Note: You must drain the spinach thoroughly before adding it to the pan!
Step 4:
In another pan, stir-fry the broccoli with a little seasoning for about 2 minutes, then set aside on a plate.
Step 5:
Mix all the cheese ingredients together: Cream cheese + shredded Mozzarella + minced chili.
Step 6:
Spread 1/4 of the cheese mixture over the chicken surface, followed by the stir-fried vegetables. Then, roll it up tightly.
Step 7:
Wrap the roll in a layer of foil and place it in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour.
Step 8:
Remove the chicken from the fridge and dredge it through flour, then dip in beaten eggs, and finally coat with breadcrumbs.
Step 9:
Heat oil in a pan over medium heat, then fry the chicken for 1-2 minutes until it turns golden brown.
Step 10:
After frying, place the chicken on a wire rack to drain excess oil. When it has cooled slightly, slice into bite-sized pieces.
The rich and attractive chicken rolls are now complete!
The crispy chicken combined with various flavors will surely delight you.

mon_an.mo_ta: Savory chicken pieces served with flavor-absorbed bamboo shoots will make this braised chicken with bamboo shoots an attractive dish for your meal.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fish sauce, salt, chili, pepper, broth powder
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Wash the chicken with diluted salt water and let it drain in a colander.
Chop the chicken into bite-sized pieces. Marinate with minced shallots, about one teaspoon of fish sauce, half a teaspoon of broth powder, and a pinch of pepper. Marinate for 1 hour.
Step 2:
