Trim off the tough parts of the fresh bamboo shoots and slice into bite-sized pieces.
Cover with cold water and boil for 5 to 10 minutes to remove the sourness.
After boiling, rinse with cold water and drain.
Step 3:
Heat two teaspoons of annatto oil, sauté the garlic until fragrant, and fry the chicken until golden on both sides.
Next, add the bamboo shoots. Pour a little cold water into the pot. Add one teaspoon of fish sauce, one teaspoon of salt, a little broth powder, and chili powder.
Cover the pot and simmer over low heat so the bamboo and chicken absorb the seasonings.
Step 4:
Once the chicken and bamboo are tender, adjust the seasoning to your taste. Turn off the heat and sprinkle with chopped scallions. Serve on a plate with rice.

mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried pork with tofu is very simple and easy to make. It is a perfect choice when you want a nutritious dish but don't have much time to cook.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fried tofu - cut into small squares
Shallots, cooking oil, pepper, seasoning, fish sauce
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Cut the tofu into small squares and fry until golden.
Transfer to a bowl and toss with 1/2 tsp salt so the tofu absorbs the flavor.
Step 2:
Shred the carrot.
Wash the bean sprouts and drain.
Clean the chives and cut into 3cm sections.
Step 3:
Slice the pork shoulder into strips and marinate with a little oil, pepper, and seasoning.
Sauté the minced shallots until fragrant, then add the pork and stir-fry until firm.
Add the carrots and stir for 2 minutes, then add the bean sprouts and stir-fry for another 2 minutes. Season to taste.
Step 4:
Remember to use high heat so the bean sprouts do not release too much water!
When the sprouts are just cooked, add the tofu and toss.
Step 5:
Finally, add the chives, turn off the heat, and add a dash of fish sauce for extra flavor.
Transfer the dish to a plate and don't forget to sprinkle a little pepper on top.

mon_an.mo_ta: Pan-seared pork might seem familiar, but making it perfectly delicious is truly an art!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 2 cubes fermented bean curd (chao) with 1 tbsp of its liquid
cac_buoc: Step 1: Slice the onion into small wedges. Mince the garlic, chili, and shallot. Mix the fermented bean curd, its liquid, and soy sauce together in a small bowl. Cut the scallions into sections.
Step 2: Wash the pork and slice into bite-sized pieces, not too thin. Marinate the meat with a little pepper and salt.

Step 3: Place the pork in a non-stick pan over medium heat. When the fat begins to render and the edges are slightly charred, pour in the bean curd mixture and simmer over low heat for 7-8 minutes so the meat absorbs the flavors.
Step 4: Finally, add the scallions, onion, shallot, garlic, and minced chili. Toss well and simmer for a few more minutes until the meat has a beautiful color and is fragrant, then turn off the heat.
Transfer the pan-seared pork with fermented bean curd to a plate. This dish is excellent when served with hot rice.
The fatty meat and the aroma of the fermented bean curd make this a very rice-consuming dish.

mon_an.ten: Pan-seared Pork Belly with Húng Lìu Five-Spice
mon_an.mo_ta: This fragrant and hot pan-seared pork belly with húng lìu will make your family meal much more attractive. You can also serve it with fresh herbs and rice vermicelli for an irresistible taste! Let's learn how to make húng lìu marinated pork belly!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Wash the pork thoroughly after purchasing and let it drain.

Marinate the meat with minced onion and garlic, 1 tbsp húng lìu powder, 1/2 tbsp white sugar, and 1 tbsp fish sauce (for 600-700gr of meat). Marinate for 2-3 hours to let the spices penetrate the meat.
Step 2:
Add 1 tbsp of cooking oil to a pan and fry until golden brown on both sides. Fry over medium heat and cover with a lid so the meat cooks through to the inside.
Step 3:
Once the meat is cooked, remove to a plate and slice into bite-sized pieces.
Serve the hot meat with fresh herbs; it is delicious.

mon_an.ten: Stir-fried Veal with Celery and Leeks
mon_an.mo_ta: With simple ingredients and preparation, you can easily make stir-fried veal with celery and leeks for your family to enjoy during dinner.
cac_buoc: Ingredients to prepare:
Step 1: Peel the outer layer of the onion, wash, and slice thinly; trim the roots of the celery and leeks, remove damaged leaves, wash, and cut into sections. Wash the tomatoes and cut into wedges.
Step 2: Thinly slice the young veal, then marinate with ½ tsp seasoning powder, 1 tbsp cooking oil, and minced shallots and ginger.
Step 3: Sauté the shallots with a little oil until fragrant, then add the veal and stir-fry over high heat. Stir-fry for about 2-3 minutes, then remove the veal to a plate.
Step 4: Using the same pan, add the tomatoes and onions to stir-fry, followed by the celery and leeks. Stir-fry over high heat to keep the vegetables green.
Step 5: Add the veal back in and toss well. Re-season to taste.
Turn off the heat, add green onions and MSG, then serve the stir-fried veal with celery and leeks on a plate and enjoy while hot.
Wishing you and your family a delicious meal!

mon_an.mo_ta: Learn how to make delicious five-color stir-fried pork with eye-catching colors, perfect for a family dinner gathering following this great recipe. Discover the recipe for making delicious five-color stir-fried pork with attractive and appealing colors for a reunion dinner.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
After buying the pork, wash and slice it into bite-sized pieces, then place in a bowl. Next, add seasoning powder, fish sauce, and minced shallots. Mix well so the meat is evenly seasoned.
For the broccoli, wash and chop into small pieces.

Peel the carrot, wash, and slice thinly; you can carve it into flower shapes. Wash the corn and bell peppers and slice into long strips. Pick and wash the celery, then cut into short sections. Wash the fresh mushrooms. Finally, peel and slice the onion.
Step 2:

Place a pot of water on the stove and bring to a boil. Then, add the vegetables to the pot and blanch quickly, then remove and place in a bowl of cold water to keep the vegetables crunchy and the colors vibrant. Note that celery, bell peppers, and onions do not need to be blanched.
Step 3:

Next in the process of making five-color stir-fried pork, place a pan on the stove, pour in oil, and heat it up. Once the oil is hot, add garlic and sauté until fragrant. Next, add the vegetables (except celery) and a little seasoning powder to the pan, stir-fry over high heat and toss quickly.
When the vegetables are nearly cooked, add the meat, onion, and celery to the pan and toss together. Season the dish to your own taste and then turn off the heat.
Once finished, present the five-color stir-fried pork on a plate and serve as a savory dish with white rice.
Step 4:
After cooking, the five-color stir-fried pork will have the bright colors of the vegetables and maintain its crunch without being crushed. The taste of the dish will be well-balanced.
Note that when stir-frying over high heat, the dish may become dry. To avoid this, you can add a little water to the pan to prevent the food from sticking and burning.
Notes for making delicious five-color stir-fried pork for dinner
Choose fresh meat: Use fresh pork, chicken, or beef that is not spoiled to ensure the dish is delicious and safe.
Prepare ingredients: Vegetables should be chosen fresh, washed, and sliced evenly to help them cook uniformly and maintain beautiful colors.

Temperature and cooking time: Ensure the pan is heated before adding oil, then heat the oil before adding the meat to stir-fry. Stir-fry the meat over high heat to cook quickly and maintain tenderness. Also, do not cook for too long to avoid the meat becoming tough and dry.
Coordinate seasonings: Use seasonings like garlic, shallots, stir-fry seasoning, fish sauce, seasoning powder, or various sauces according to taste to enhance the flavor of the dish.
Toss quickly: Toss the pan quickly and evenly to ensure the meat and vegetables are cooked uniformly, avoiding burning or crushing.

Keep the crunch of the vegetables: When adding vegetables to the stir-fry, remember to let them cook while still maintaining their crunch. Do not stir-fry for too long so the vegetables do not become mushy and lose their freshness.
Enjoy quickly: Five-color stir-fried pork is most delicious when enjoyed immediately after cooking. Present the dish on a plate and enjoy with warm white rice.
Following these notes will help you create a delicious, attractive five-color stir-fried pork dish that maintains the crunch and fresh colors of the vegetables.

mon_an.mo_ta: An extremely attractive dish, simple from ingredients to preparation, not complicated yet delicious and easy to eat. Let's get into the kitchen and try making this flavorful sweet and sour fried shrimp that goes great with rice!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Cut off the sharp tips of the heads and tails of the shrimp, wash, and drain. Marinate the shrimp with a tiny bit of salt.
Step 2: Place a pan of oil on the stove; when the oil is hot, add the shrimp and fry over high heat.
When the shrimp turn red, they are cooked; remove the shrimp to a plate/bowl.
Step 3: Place a pan on the stove, add 1 tbsp of oil; when the oil is hot, add the garlic, shallots, and the remaining seasonings and sauté for 1-2 minutes.
Then add the sweet and sour chili sauce and boil for 2 minutes. Finally, add the fried shrimp and toss well so the sauce coats the shrimp, then turn off the heat.
*Presentation:* Serve the sweet and sour fried shrimp on a plate, garnish with cucumber flowers. This dish is wonderful when served hot with rice.

mon_an.ten: Steamed Shiitake Mushrooms Stuffed with Shrimp
mon_an.mo_ta: Steamed shrimp with shiitake mushrooms, a delicious dish with the characteristic sweet and chewy taste of shrimp and featherback fish paste blended with the attractive aroma of shiitake mushrooms, is one of my family's favorites. The dish is both fragrant and nutritious for the whole family's dinner. Please refer to the recipe for cooking steamed shrimp with shiitake mushrooms.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning - As needed (pepper, sugar, soy sauce, seasoning powder)
cac_buoc: Prepare ingredients

Soak the shiitake mushrooms until expanded, then briefly boil the mushrooms in water with a few slices of ginger to reduce the odor and make them more fragrant and attractive. Wash and trim the mushroom stems, setting them aside.
Boil the pork back fat until cooked, then mince finely.

Wash the shrimp, peel, and mince the shrimp meat. Also place the featherback fish paste in a mortar and grind until smooth. Mince the white parts of the green onions. Mix the shrimp, fish paste, and minced onions thoroughly; season with pepper and fish sauce to taste, then add the minced pork fat and egg white and mix well. Let it sit for about 15 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Divide the shrimp mixture into equal portions and stuff them into the mushrooms.
Steam the shrimp:
Place all the shrimp-stuffed mushrooms into a steamer and steam for about 5 minutes until the shrimp and mushrooms are cooked.
Make the accompanying sauce:

Sauté the green onion whites and julienned ginger until fragrant. Add bone broth, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp seasoning powder, 1/2 tbsp sugar, then add the julienned carrots and chili; boil until the carrots and chili are cooked. Then add 1 tbsp tapioca starch (dissolved in a little cold water) to thicken the sauce, then turn off the heat.
Presentation: Arrange the steamed shrimp-stuffed shiitake mushrooms on a plate, pour the hot sauce over them, sprinkle with pepper and cilantro, and serve hot.
Here is the finished product of steamed shrimp-stuffed shiitake mushrooms for everyone!

Looking for a delicious, savory meal featuring the signature flavor of braised shrimp? By following these simple steps and the specific recipe provided, you can enjoy an excellent dish of savory braised shrimp that everyone will praise. Check out how to make it in the article below!
I. Traditional Savory Braised Shrimp
1. Ingredients
300g fresh shrimp.
2 chilies.
4 shallots.
4 garlic cloves.
2 tbsp cooking oil.
2 tbsp fish sauce.
1/2 tbsp chili sauce.
1/2 tbsp oyster sauce.
A little sugar or MSG.
2. Instructions
Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Shrimp: Wash the shrimp and soak in dilute salt water for 2–3 minutes. Remove and drain. Peel, remove the heads, and devein. Place the shrimp in a bowl.
Chilies: Divide the 2 chilies into two parts. Mince one part and slice the other into rounds.
Shallots and garlic: Peel and mince the shallots and garlic.
Step 2: Marinate the shrimp
In the bowl with the shrimp, add 1/2 tbsp sugar, 1/2 tsp MSG, 1/2 tbsp fish sauce, 1/2 tsp minced chili, 1/2 tbsp minced garlic, and 1/2 tbsp minced shallots.
Mix well so the shrimp are evenly coated and let marinate for 15 minutes.
Step 3: Make the sauce
In a small bowl, combine 1.5 tbsp fish sauce, 2 tbsp sugar, 1/2 tbsp oyster sauce, and 1/2 tbsp chili sauce. Stir well until the seasonings are dissolved and blended.
Step 4: Braise the shrimp
Place a pan on the stove and add 1 tsp sugar and 2 tbsp cooking oil. Heat the oil and sugar together. Lower the heat and stir constantly so the sugar doesn't burn.
When the sugar turns brown, add the shrimp to the pan. Stir well to coat the shrimp in the caramel oil. Turn the heat to medium and cook until the shrimp are lightly cooked and start to change color.

Once the shrimp are lightly cooked, pour the sauce into the pan. Lower the heat and simmer for about 20 minutes until the shrimp absorb the flavors and the sauce thickens. Remember to turn the shrimp frequently for even absorption.
Finally, once the braising is complete, top with sliced chilies, stir once more, and turn off the heat.
Through this process, the savory braised shrimp will have a wonderful flavor and be ready to enjoy.

Savory braised shrimp is truly a fantastic dish, with a rich, spicy, salty, and sweet flavor profile. As the shrimp are braised with the seasonings, the flavors penetrate deep into each shrimp, creating an irresistible and unique taste. Enjoy this dish with hot steamed rice for a perfect combination. A bite of savory shrimp with rice creates a beautiful harmony of flavors for an unforgettable culinary experience.
II. Sweet and Savory Braised Shrimp
Step 1: Ingredients
400g fresh shrimp.
2 shallots.
2 stalks green onions.
1 green chili.
Common seasonings (sugar, ground pepper, MSG).
With these ingredients, you will have everything needed to make a flavorful and exciting version of braised shrimp.
Step 2: Prepare the ingredients

First, treat the fresh shrimp by tossing them with salt and rinsing under cold water 2 to 3 times to remove any odors. Use scissors to trim the whiskers and tails, remove the dark waste in the head, and pull out the vein along the back. Rinse again and leave in a colander to drain.
Next, prepare the green onions by trimming the roots, removing wilted leaves, washing, and dicing. Peel the shallots, wash, and slice thinly.
Step 3: Marinate the shrimp
To marinate, combine the shrimp with a mixture of 2 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp MSG, and sliced green chili. Let the shrimp sit for 10 to 15 minutes.
By following these steps, your shrimp will be prepped and marinated, ready for the braising process.
Step 4: Sweet and savory braising
Place a pot on the stove and add 2 tbsp cooking oil. Heat over medium heat. Once the oil is hot, add 1 tbsp sugar and wait for it to melt and turn into an amber caramel color.
Next, add the sliced shallots to the pot and sauté until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the marinated shrimp to the pot and stir well. Braise over medium-low heat for about 5 minutes. Ensure the shrimp absorb the seasonings, become firm, and turn an attractive orange-red color.
Adjust the seasoning to suit your taste. Turn off the heat and sprinkle with a little ground pepper and diced green onions. Toss well to coat the shrimp with the onions.

The result is sweet and savory braised shrimp with a beautiful orange color, garnished with green onions for an appealing look and delicious aroma. The dish features the signature taste of fish sauce combined with the sweetness of sugar; the shrimp are deeply flavored, tender, and not dry. It is especially delightful when served with hot rice and spicy chili fish sauce.
III. Notes for making braised shrimp
To ensure the dish is delicious, the most important factor is using fresh shrimp. You can choose river shrimp, white shrimp, or small-to-medium tiger prawns, but they must be fresh.

Fresh shrimp are those that are still alive and active. Avoid choosing shrimp that are too large, as they can become tough when braised. If you use dead shrimp, they may become mushy and won't produce a good result.
Ensuring the use of fresh shrimp is key to achieving the best flavor for this dish.
IV. Benefits of eating shrimp

Shrimp is not only delicious but also offers many health benefits. It is a source of high-quality protein, vitamins, and minerals. Notably, shrimp is low in calories and fat, making it an excellent choice for weight-loss diets. Shrimp also contains omega-3 fatty acids, which are beneficial for cardiovascular health and particularly important for the development of young children.

Besides using shrimp for braising, a small tip for home cooks is to use the shrimp heads and shells to make broth. This not only saves ingredients but also creates a flavorful soup that makes the meal more special and rich.

mon_an.mo_ta: A delicious and nutritious dish with easy-to-find ingredients and a simple method: braised shrimp with quail eggs. We all know shrimp is packed with nutrients, especially calcium, and quail eggs also offer many health benefits. There's no reason not to head to the kitchen and make this for the whole family!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 200g tiger prawns (cleaned, peeled, heads removed, tails left on)
1.5 tbsp fruit jam (to taste, orange jam used here)
Seasonings: Olive oil, white wine, salt, and 1 small piece of ginger
cac_buoc: Ingredients you need to prepare:
Step 1:
First, heat a pan with a little olive oil. Add 1/2 tbsp fruit jam, stir quickly for a few seconds, then add the shrimp to stir-fry.
Step 2:
When the shrimp meat has turned golden on both sides, add the remaining fruit jam and toss well.
Step 3:
When the sauce starts to simmer, add the quail eggs to the pan.
Season with a splash of white wine, 1/2 tsp salt, and minced ginger. Stir constantly for about 5 minutes over medium heat so the eggs and shrimp absorb the flavors.
Step 4:
Finally, add the kiwi, toss gently for about 1 minute, then turn off the heat.
Arrange the shrimp on a deep plate or in a wide-rimmed glass. Garnish with a sprig of mint for an attractive look.
And there you have it—a delicious and nutritious dish is complete!

mon_an.mo_ta: Looking for a delicious and simple dish for your family meal? Try this orange glazed shrimp – a wonderful dish with a fresh and appealing flavor. With just a few simple ingredients like shrimp, orange juice, and some seasonings, you can create a fragrant and nutritious meal. Explore this recipe and show off your cooking skills! Enjoy this tasty orange shrimp with our simple guide. Choose fresh shrimp and combine them with a delicious orange sauce for a great culinary experience.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Vinegar, cooking oil, salt, pepper, sugar, seasoning powder
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
First, peel the shrimp, remove the heads and tails, and slit the back to remove the black vein. Wash the shrimp with dilute salt water to remove any fishy odor. Place in a colander to drain.
Next, separate the egg whites. Wash the oranges; peel 4 of them and squeeze for fresh juice. Keep 1 orange for decoration.
Step 2: Marinate the shrimp

Once the shrimp are drained, place them on a plate and add 2 tbsp cornstarch, 1 tbsp salt, 2 tbsp seasoning powder, and 1 tsp ground pepper. Pour in the egg whites and mix well. Let the shrimp marinate for about 15 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Step 3: Fry the shrimp

Heat a pan and add enough oil for frying. When the oil is hot, fry the marinated shrimp. This process is very fast; just fry until the shrimp are firm and have a beautiful golden color. Remove and place on a wire rack to drain excess oil.
Step 4: Make the orange butter sauce
Next, heat a pan and add a piece of butter. Add the orange juice and bring to a boil. Once the butter has melted, stir well to combine the orange juice and butter. Turn off the heat.
Step 5: Garnish and serve
Place the fried shrimp on a plate and drizzle the orange butter sauce over them. Garnish with a few cilantro leaves and thin orange slices. Serve with hot rice and enjoy immediately.
Notes for making orange glazed shrimp
When making this dish, keep the following in mind:

Choosing fresh shrimp: You don't necessarily need large shrimp, but choose ones with thick, firm bodies to ensure a sweet and crunchy texture. A tip for picking fresh shrimp is to look at the legs. If the legs have turned black, the shrimp are no longer fresh and should be avoided.

Choosing ripe oranges: When buying oranges, choose ripe ones with yellow spots on the skin. The stems should be intact and of medium size. The orange should feel heavy and firm in your hand. Carefully selected oranges will make the sauce much more flavorful.
With these tips, you can enjoy a fresh and attractive orange glazed shrimp dish.

mon_an.mo_ta: During a cold winter like in Hanoi, meals with spicy, hot dishes are always favorites. This spicy stir-fried shrimp is the perfect and most delicious dish you should try. Though simple in preparation and ingredients, the flavor is incredibly appealing, meeting the 'delicious-nutritious-affordable' standard that Vietnamese homemakers aim for. Let's get into the kitchen and learn how to make this simple yet amazing spicy shrimp!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients

Peel all the shrimp, remove the black vein along the back, then rinse with warm water and pat dry. To remove any fishy smell, you can rinse the shrimp with a little white wine before washing with fresh water.
Wash the green bell pepper and dice into small pieces.
Wash the green chilies and slice into small rounds.
Leave the butter at room temperature to soften.
Step 2: Cooking steps
First, place a pan on the stove over medium heat.
Add the butter and melt for about 3 minutes or until completely liquefied.
Next, add the shrimp along with the remaining ingredients: bell pepper, green chilies, spicy sauce, 1/2 tsp salt, and 1 tsp pepper.
Stir the shrimp mixture thoroughly.

The cooking time will take about 20 minutes or slightly longer. During the stir-frying process, you don't need to stir constantly; just toss every 3-5 minutes so the shrimp absorb the seasonings and develop a nice color.
When the liquid has reduced, taste and adjust the seasoning to suit your family's preference. If you like it very spicy, add more chilies.
Finally, scoop the food onto a plate, garnish with a few sprigs of cilantro, and serve while hot.
Notes
Rinsing the shrimp with warm water helps the meat contract and become firmer. Depending on preference, you can leave the shells on or off, but peeling them helps the seasonings penetrate more easily.

Similarly, when adding Tabasco sauce, estimate the spice level you can handle to add an appropriate amount. If you don't have this sauce, you can substitute it with a mixture of tomato sauce and chili sauce. Use more chili sauce for heat or more tomato sauce for tanginess.
How to choose good shrimp

Check the tail: To determine freshness, stretch the shrimp out and hold it up to the light to see the space between the shell segments and the meat. Wider gaps indicate the shrimp is no longer fresh, as it may have been cooked too long or frozen for a long time.

Avoid slimy shrimp: Do not buy shrimp that feel slimy. Most of these will have bodies curled into a circle rather than lying straight. To check, press your finger on the shell and move it back and forth. If it feels gritty or sticky/slimy, do not buy them.

Shrimp legs: Observe if the legs are still firmly attached to the body; the meat should be firm. Additionally, do not buy shrimp with legs that have turned black, as this is a sign they are no longer fresh.

mon_an.mo_ta: I learned this butter-fried onion omelet recipe from my cousin a long time ago, and I still love it. It has a wonderful aroma of pepper, butter, and onions—rich, creamy, and unique. In my opinion, it's much tastier than a regular fried egg. It's also very fast, taking at most 5 minutes. Another plus is its versatility; it's great for breakfast, packing in a lunch box (since it's neat and pretty), or as a party side dish. Let's learn how to make this easy and delicious dish!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Whisk the eggs together with the diced onion, salt, and pepper.
Step 2:
Set the heat to medium. Add the butter to the pan. Once the butter has just melted, pour in the egg mixture.
Step 3:
Wait for the surface of the egg to set, then roll it up. I use chopsticks to roll the egg. If you aren't used to it, you can use a spoon to hold the egg while using chopsticks to roll.
Step 4:
Once the egg is cooked, arrange it on a plate and cut into small rounds. You can sprinkle with a bit more salt and pepper.

mon_an.mo_ta: Everyone is likely familiar with scrambled eggs and tomatoes, so today let's refresh the menu with this rolled omelet with tomato sauce recipe! With just two main ingredients—fried eggs and mashed tomatoes—this dish looks much more appealing!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, MSG, seasoning powder - as desired
cac_buoc: First, crack 2 eggs into a bowl, beat well, and fry in a pan until cooked. Then, cut the omelet into long strips.

In a pan with hot oil, sauté the garlic until fragrant, then add the tomatoes and stir-fry briefly. Turn the heat to low and simmer for about 10 minutes; once the tomatoes are soft, use a fork to gently mash them.

Finally, lay the egg strips on a plate, pour the tomato sauce over them, and roll them up. Repeat with all egg strips, arrange them on a plate, and drizzle the remaining tomato sauce around them to finish.

mon_an.ten: Braised Quail Eggs with Pork and Mushrooms
mon_an.mo_ta: Enrich your family's daily meals with this delicious dish of braised quail eggs with pork and mushrooms!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Wash the shiitake mushrooms and soak them in warm water until fully expanded.
Strain the soaking water to remove sediment and keep the liquid to use for simmering.
Select large, intact mushroom caps, trim off the stems, and set aside. Finely mince the stems and any remaining mushrooms.
Mix the ground pork and minced mushrooms with a bit of seasoning or seasoning powder; let marinate for 15 minutes.
Boil the quail eggs and peel off the shells.
Step 2:

Use the pork and mushroom mixture to wrap around each quail egg, then place them onto the mushroom caps. You can use your hands to smooth the meat surface while helping the egg, meat, and mushroom bind together better.
Step 3:
Heat a pan with a little cooking oil and lightly pan-fry the meat-wrapped quail eggs.
Step 4:
Season the mushroom soaking liquid to taste, add the pan-fried meat-wrapped eggs, cover, and simmer for about 30 minutes.
The quail eggs wrapped in pork and mushrooms are savory and fragrant with the scent of shiitake; they are delicious when served with hot rice.

mon_an.ten: Sweet and Sour Stir-Fried Quail Eggs
mon_an.mo_ta: Sweet and sour stir-fried quail eggs is an incredibly appealing dish featuring fresh quail eggs prepared with a tangy-sweet flavor, combined with wood ear mushrooms and bell peppers to create a very eye-catching meal. Learn how to make this delicious dish to treat your family!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Green onions, minced ginger and garlic, cornstarch - ingredients
Vinegar, soy sauce, vegetable oil, rice wine, broth, seasonings - ingredients
cac_buoc: Step 1: Boil the eggs until cooked and drain well. Then, fry the eggs until golden brown and remove from the pan.

Step 2: Wash the wood ear mushrooms and bell peppers, then chop them small. Combine the minced ginger and garlic, rice wine, vinegar, soy sauce, seasoning powder, salt, sugar, and broth, then mix well.
Step 3: Prepare a hot pan with a little cooking oil. Pour in the prepared soy sauce mixture, then add the bell peppers and wood ear mushrooms and stir-fry evenly.
Next, add the golden-fried quail eggs to stir-fry together.
Step 4: Pour in the water mixed with a little cornstarch and stir well.
Step 5: Finally, sprinkle in the green onions, stir-fry for about 5-7 minutes, season to taste, and turn off the heat.

mon_an.mo_ta: Learn how to make a delicious chive omelet for dinner following this recipe. This dish is tasty, quick to prepare, and ensures nutritional health. Let's cook together!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Preparation
Wash the pork and grind or mince it finely. Marinate the meat with a bit of pepper and fish sauce.
Wash the chives and chop them small. Dice the red chili.
Crack the eggs into a bowl, beat well, then add the chives and 2-3 tablespoons of mayonnaise and whisk together.
Step 2: Frying the omelet

Heat a non-stick pan with a little cooking oil. Add the pork and stir-fry until firm, spreading it evenly across the pan. Pour the egg mixture over the meat, spreading it evenly, and sprinkle the red chili on top. Cover and fry for about 2 minutes until the eggs are cooked, then turn off the heat. Serve on a plate; it is very delicious when eaten hot with white rice.

mon_an.ten: Steamed Eggs with Minced Pork for Kids
mon_an.mo_ta: As requested on our fan page, we introduce a delicious steamed egg dish with pork and corn for a family dinner. This simple steamed egg and minced pork recipe is a nutritious and tasty meal for your beloved baby.
cac_buoc: 2.1. Marinating the meat
Place the minced pork in a bowl.
Add 2 tablespoons of salted egg white, 1 tablespoon of cooking wine, and 2 tablespoons of cornstarch to the bowl.
Mix well and let the meat marinate for 10 minutes.
2.1. Preparing ingredients
Crack 3 eggs into a bowl and beat well.
Add 300ml of chicken broth to the egg bowl and continue to beat well.
Cut the century egg and salted egg yolk into small cubes and place them in two separate bowls.
Wash the green onions and slice them into thin strips.
2.2. Steaming the eggs with meat
Place the meat in a deep dish and use a spoon to spread it evenly.
Use chopsticks to pick up each piece of century egg and salted egg yolk, spreading them evenly over the meat surface.
Pour the egg mixture into the meat dish through a fine-mesh sieve.
Cover the dish with plastic wrap and steam for 10 - 12 minutes.
After steaming, simply drizzle 1/2 tablespoon of soy sauce and 2 tablespoons of cooking oil over the surface. Garnish with some green onions, and the steamed egg dish is complete.
Notes when making steamed eggs with minced pork for kids
Ingredients: Ensure you use fresh, high-quality meat, choosing a type suitable for your baby's age and preferences. Mince the meat carefully to ensure there are no bones or impurities.
Seasoning: Use simple seasonings suitable for babies, avoiding strong spices or high sodium content. Limit salt and ensure cooking wine is used in appropriate amounts.
Steaming time: Ensure the eggs and meat are fully cooked but not overcooked to avoid losing nutritional value. A steaming time of 10–12 minutes is usually sufficient.
Hygiene: Before cooking, ensure your hands and work surfaces are clean, and all cooking utensils are washed. Use tools and pans made of materials safe for babies.
Temperature check: Ensure the steamed eggs and minced pork are cooked through to the center before feeding the baby. Use a chopstick or tongs to check the temperature.
Cut into small pieces: Before feeding the baby, cut the steamed eggs and minced pork into small, easy-to-eat pieces to avoid choking hazards.
Test the temperature: Before feeding the baby, test the temperature of the food on your wrist or lip to ensure it is not too hot.
How to choose fresh and safe meat for babies
Color: Fresh pork usually has a bright color; the meat is light pink or light red, and the fat is white to slightly ivory.
Surface check: Choose pieces of meat with a dry surface, soft skin, and a distinct structure of meat and fat that still cling tightly together. The meat should also have a characteristic pork scent.
Elasticity check: When buying, you can press lightly on the meat. If the meat returns to its original shape without leaving a dent after you remove your finger, it is fresh.
Signs to avoid: Avoid buying pork with these signs: bruises, pale or overly dark color, a glossy surface, feeling slimy to the touch, or having a fishy or spoiled odor.
Grinding the meat: If you buy meat at the market, you can ask the seller to grind it. Alternatively, you can buy the meat and use a home meat grinder to grind it yourself.
Some notes when feeding babies steamed eggs with minced pork
When feeding your baby this dish, keep the following points in mind to ensure safety and nutrition:

Appropriate age: Ensure the dish is suitable for your baby's age. Steamed eggs with minced pork are usually introduced when the baby is over 8 months old and has passed the initial food transition stage.
Appropriate size: Cut the steamed eggs and minced pork into small, easy-to-eat pieces. This helps the baby avoid choking and makes digestion easier.
Side dishes: Steamed eggs with minced pork can be served with sides like vegetables, potatoes, or cooked rice. Ensure side dishes are also prepared and cut appropriately for the baby.
Supervision: Always supervise your baby while eating. Ensure the baby eats slowly and chews thoroughly before swallowing. Avoid letting the baby eat alone, especially when they are very young.
Storage: If there are leftovers, store them in the refrigerator and use within 24 hours. Check the scent and condition of the food before feeding it to the baby to ensure safety.

mon_an.mo_ta: Chicken breast is a very healthy food source, rich in nutrients. However, if not prepared correctly, it can easily become dry, crumbly, and unappetizing. If you are looking for a delicious, easy-to-make chicken breast dish, refer to this recipe for super tender pan-seared chicken breast! I. Instructions for super tender pan-seared chicken breast
cac_buoc: 1. Prepare ingredients
2 chicken breasts
20g basil (leaves only)
2 garlic cloves
3 shallots
3 chilies
20g cashews
Seasonings: olive oil, salt, sugar, and a bit of pepper
2. Steps to make pan-seared chicken
Step 1: Prepare ingredients

First, wash all the necessary ingredients. After washing, use a towel or paper towel to pat dry, then use a knife to score several parallel lines on the surface of the chicken to help the seasoning penetrate better.
Step 2: Make the sauce
First, slice the shallots and mince the garlic. Next, put the basil leaves, shallots, and garlic into a blender.

At the same time, add the prepared ingredients including cashews, chilies, 1 teaspoon of sugar, 1 tablespoon of olive oil, and 1 teaspoon of salt. Turn on the blender and process until you get a smooth, fine mixture.
Step 3: Pan-sear the chicken
First, sprinkle 2 teaspoons of salt and pepper over the chicken, then rub it in by hand. Next, place a pan on the stove and add 1 tablespoon of olive oil.

When the oil is hot, place the chicken breast in the pan to sear. Cover the pan with a lid to ensure the chicken doesn't dry out. Once one side has turned golden brown, flip the chicken and continue searing until cooked through. Then, remove the chicken from the pan.
Step 4: Enjoy

The pan-seared chicken breast has a rich, fragrant flavor from the sauce, combined with the beautifully golden-brown meat. Chicken breast prepared this way will be tender and slightly chewy rather than crumbly. You can enjoy it with hot rice; this flavor is sure to surprise you.
II. Instructions for Sweet and Sour Lemon Pan-Seared Chicken Breast
Chicken breast: 2 pieces
Tomatoes: 2
Onion: 1/2
Lemongrass: 1 stalk
Red chili: 1
Ginger: 1 knob
Shallots: 3
Garlic: 30g
Salt: 1/3 teaspoon
Pepper: 1/4 teaspoon
Cooking oil: 1 tablespoon
Seasoning powder: 1/2 teaspoon
MSG: 1 teaspoon
Oyster sauce: 1 tablespoon
Lemon: 1/2
Honey: 1 tablespoon
2. Steps to make Sweet and Sour Lemon Pan-Seared Chicken Breast
2.1. Prepare the chicken
Remove the skin and wash the chicken breast with clean water.
Rub salt over the meat to remove any fishy odor, then rinse with clean water and drain.
Next, marinate the chicken with the following seasonings:
Marinate with 1/3 teaspoon of salt, 1/2 teaspoon of MSG, and 1/4 teaspoon of pepper.
Rub the seasoning evenly on both sides of the chicken. Pat the meat gently so the spices penetrate.
Let the chicken marinate for about 20 minutes.
Tips to remove odors from chicken breast:
Use a mixture of rice wine and crushed ginger to rub and squeeze the chicken piece once more to remove odors and impurities. Then rinse and drain.
You can also soak the chicken in lemon water for 15-20 minutes, then remove, rinse with cold water, and drain.
2.2. Pan-sear the chicken
Place a pan on the stove over medium-low heat. Add 1/2 tablespoon of cooking oil; when hot, add the chicken.
Add the crushed lemongrass, 20g of garlic, and 1 peeled shallot to the pan.
Flip the chicken frequently so both sides are golden brown. When cooked, turn off the heat.
2.3. Prepare vegetables
Clean the tomatoes and onion, drain, and dice into bite-sized pieces. Peel and slice the remaining ginger and shallots. Deseed and mince the chili.
2.4. Make the sauce
Place a pan on the stove and add 1/2 tablespoon of cooking oil. Sauté the tomatoes, shallots, and ginger until fragrant. When the tomatoes are slightly cooked, add the onion and stir well.
Season with 1 tablespoon of oyster sauce, 1/2 teaspoon of seasoning powder, and 1/2 teaspoon of MSG; stir to absorb the flavors.
Add about 100ml of water, stir well, and bring to a boil. Finally, add the juice of 1/2 lemon and 1 tablespoon of honey, then stir well.
2.4. Completion
When the sauce has thickened, add the pan-seared chicken and cook for another 5 minutes so the chicken absorbs the sauce.
Once the chicken has absorbed the sauce, you can garnish the dish by adding a few thin lemon slices and sprinkling some cilantro on top.
III. Notes for pan-searing chicken breast
1. Choose fresh chicken
Use fresh chicken breast, not frozen.
Check the color, smell, and elasticity of the meat to ensure freshness.
2. Prepare the chicken
Rinse the chicken under cold running water.
Slice the chicken into bite-sized pieces, about 150-200g per piece.
Let the chicken drain completely before searing.
3. Choose the right pan and oil
Use a large, heat-resistant pan like cast iron or induction-compatible pans.
Use cooking oil with a high smoke point like olive oil, canola oil, or soybean oil.
4. Pan-sear correctly
Heat the pan, add oil, and wait for it to shimmer.
Place the chicken in the pan; do not overcrowd the meat.
Sear each side for about 3-5 minutes to get a crispy crust.
5. Finish the dish
When the chicken is just cooked through, add it to the sauce and cook for another 5 minutes.
Garnish with ingredients like lemon and cilantro to enhance the flavor.
IV. How to choose fresh chicken

To choose good chicken breast, look for pieces with an even white skin color. This is a sign of a mature chicken, which will have tastier, firmer meat. When you press the meat, it should feel elastic and not mushy.
Conversely, avoid pieces with many white stripes. The more white stripes there are, the less fat and protein the meat contains. When cooked, meat with many white stripes is also harder to marinate.

mon_an.ten: Pan-Seared Duck Breast with Peppercorn Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: With a rich aroma and the characteristic color of pan-seared duck breast, complemented by an eye-catching brown sauce, everything blends harmoniously to create an incredibly attractive dish. Check out our recipe for pan-seared duck breast with peppercorn sauce in the article below!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Clean the duck breast, pat dry, cut into bite-sized pieces, and marinate with salt and pepper for 15 minutes.
Place in a steamer and steam for 10 minutes.
Step 2:
Heat a pan and add 1/2 tablespoon of unsalted butter.
Once the butter melts, add the duck breast and pan-sear until the skin is golden and crispy.
Step 3:
Peel the white radish and use a round mold to cut it into shapes.
Add 1 tablespoon of butter to a pan, then add the radish and cook with 100ml of brown stock.
Step 4:
Add the agar to 150ml of water, stir until completely dissolved, then place on the stove and stir until it bubbles; add the tomato sauce and mix well.
Once the mixture boils again, pour a thin layer into a mold and let it cool. Use a round mold to cut into pieces.
Wash the olives and mince them finely. Place the minced olives in the center and fold.
Step 5:
Pour the remaining brown stock into a pan and bring to a boil, add the minced rosemary and stir well, then season with a bit of salt and pepper to taste.
Arrange the pan-seared duck breast on a plate, serve with the cooked radish and brown sauce, and garnish with a fresh rosemary sprig.
Quick tips:
Use ginger and rice wine to rub the duck to remove odors, then rinse and drain.
Score the duck skin in a diamond pattern, then tilt the knife to slice the duck into 1cm thick pieces to help it absorb seasoning and stay tender.

mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried duck with bell peppers is a delicious, easy-to-make, and easy-to-eat dish that is very eye-catching due to the combination of bell peppers, carrots, and pineapple. Let's learn how to make it!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Debone the duck and slice the meat into bite-sized pieces.
Cut the bell pepper into squares or rectangles.
Slice the pineapple.
Carve the carrot into flowers, slice, and blanch until cooked.
Crush and mince the shallots and garlic.
Step 2:
Heat one tablespoon of oil and sauté the shallots and garlic until fragrant.
Add the duck meat along with 1/2 teaspoon of seasoning powder and stir-fry until firm.
Add the bell peppers, pineapple, and carrots.
Season with 1 teaspoon of seasoning powder.
Step 3:
Stir-fry the meat and vegetable mixture until just cooked.
Remove the meat to a plate and sprinkle with pepper.
Serve hot with white rice.

mon_an.ten: How to Boil Easy-to-Peel Eggs without Cracking
mon_an.mo_ta: Boiling eggs, though seemingly simple, is a skill not everyone masters to ensure they are easy to peel, delicious, and retain their nutritional value. In this article, we will reveal the most optimal egg-boiling methods. I. Tips for boiling beautiful, easy-to-peel eggs
cac_buoc: Step 1: Use salt to boil eggs

This simple trick has been passed down through generations. Just add about one teaspoon of salt to the boiling water, and the shell will come off easily without any trouble. This helps the eggs look clean and attractive.
Step 2: Use lemon to boil eggs
If you have lemons at home, use them to boil eggs. Simply add a few lemon slices to the water, and after the eggs are cooked, try peeling them.
You will be surprised by the results lemon provides.
Step 3: Use vinegar to boil eggs
After boiling the eggs, don't rush to pour the water away. Add a teaspoon of vinegar to the pot and stir for a few minutes.
You will easily peel the boiled eggs without difficulty. You can also add vinegar during the boiling process, but remember to stir well.
Step 4: Shocking eggs in ice water
After boiling, waiting for eggs to cool naturally can take a long time. However, to shorten the wait and make peeling easier, you can apply the ice water soaking method.

Soaking eggs in ice water after boiling creates a temperature shock, helping the shell separate easily from the egg inside. To ensure safety and limit bacteria, use pre-boiled water to cool down first, then add ice to soak the eggs.
Step 5: Boil eggs with warm water and vinegar

Another method to help prevent eggs from cracking is boiling them with warm water and vinegar. Why is this effective? According to scientists, warm water helps the egg protein coagulate quickly. Meanwhile, the acid in vinegar helps thin the shell, making peeling much easier.

To do this, first heat water on the stove over low heat. When the water is warm, add the eggs to the pot along with 1/2 teaspoon of white vinegar. Cover and boil for 4–7 minutes, depending on the number of eggs. Then, turn off the heat.
Don't remove the eggs immediately; let them sit in the pot for another 5 minutes. You will be surprised by the results.
Step 6: Prick a small hole at the end of the egg

This is known as the Jacques Pépin method, where you create a hole at the large end of the egg to release the air bubble inside. People often use a needle wrapped around a chopstick for easier handling. By creating this tiny hole, the white and yolk won't leak out due to the needle's small size.

When boiling, the air bubble gradually occupies space inside the egg. Releasing this air allows the egg white to take up that space without cracking the shell. For best results, make the hole slightly larger.
Once the water is boiling, simply drop the pricked eggs in and boil as usual. This method helps the eggs stay perfectly round and smooth without cracking when peeled.
II. How many minutes is enough to boil eggs

Unlike chicken or duck eggs, these eggs are significantly smaller, making the failure rate or undesirable results higher. In reality, the boiling time depends on the quantity of eggs. For a perfect batch, note these timing guidelines.

If you are boiling 40 eggs or fewer, the perfect time for them to be just cooked is 6–8 minutes. However, if you want to boil 40 to 100 eggs at once, it will take about 9–10 minutes. For larger quantities, from 100–200 eggs, the time will be 10–12 minutes. Note that the boiling time is calculated from the moment the water starts to boil.
III. Notes for easy-to-peel boiled eggs
Choose fresh eggs: Ensure the eggs you choose are fresh to guarantee quality and cooking results.
Boil the water: Bring the water in the pot to a boil before adding the eggs. This ensures they cook evenly and maintain their shape.
Add eggs gently: When placing eggs in the pot, do it gently so as not to break the shells.
Time the boiling: Boiling time depends on the quantity and desired doneness. Use a stopwatch or countdown timer to follow the exact time.
Cooling process: After boiling, shock the eggs by soaking them in cold water or an ice bath to make peeling easier later.
Peel carefully: When peeling, ensure you do it carefully so as not to damage the egg and to keep its shape intact.
Check doneness: Before serving, check the doneness by touching the shell to assess the firmness of the yolk.
IV. Conclusion
By following these boiling methods, you will have beautiful, easy-to-peel boiled eggs ready to enjoy. Try applying them and experience the satisfaction of a perfect boiled egg!

mon_an.mo_ta: Bò kho is one of the most delicious dishes, and knowing how to cook it is a secret of many resourceful home cooks. Currently, there are many different ways to prepare bò kho, but the five-spice version remains a favorite. There is nothing better than eating bò kho with hot rice in the winter.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Beef flank - 600g (Choose the flank part with some tendon to make the stew better. The beef will be tender, chewy, and crunchy all at once.)
Carrots, peeled and carved into flowers - 300g
cac_buoc: Step 1:
To remove the odor of the beef, use white wine mixed with ginger to rub the meat, then rinse thoroughly and blanch in boiling water. This step helps eliminate the gamey smell of the beef.
Step 2:
Cut the beef into bite-sized pieces. You should cut them into squares or rectangles!
Step 3:
Marinate the beef flank with 2 teaspoons of salt, 1 teaspoon of sugar, 1/2 teaspoon of pepper, 1 tablespoon of bò kho powder, and 1 teaspoon of annatto oil. Marinate for 30 minutes.
Step 4:
Wash the carrots, peel them, and cut into 5cm chunks. Crush the lemongrass. Lightly toast the star anise and cinnamon until fragrant.
Step 5:

Sauté the minced garlic, shallots, and ginger until fragrant. Add the beef and stir well, adding 2 teaspoons of annatto oil for a beautiful color. Once the beef is firm, add the lemongrass and pour in enough water to cover the meat. Add the star anise and cinnamon to the pot.
Step 6:

When the meat is tender, remove the star anise, cinnamon, and lemongrass. Season with 1 tablespoon of seasoning powder. Dissolve 3 teaspoons of cornstarch in a bowl of cold water and pour it slowly into the pot. Add the carrots and cook for another 5-10 minutes, then turn off the heat.
Finished Product:

Ladle the bò kho into a bowl, sprinkle with some ground pepper, chopped culantro, and Thai basil. Serve hot with bánh mì. With this recipe, you will have a bò kho dish that is suitable for rice, noodles, or bánh mì. The beef is tender but not falling apart, with a chewy and crunchy texture from the tendon. The dish is thick and has an attractive color. Bò kho is an excellent suggestion for every family in any season or weather.

mon_an.mo_ta: Bún riêu cua đồng is a familiar dish to many Vietnamese people, appealing to diners not only with its soft, delicious rice noodles and fragrant crab roe but also with the slight crunch of fried shallots and fresh, clean herbs. All these wonderful flavors are combined in a simple, easy-to-make, and extremely attractive dish. Discover our recipe for bún riêu cua đồng in the article below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Dried shallots, scallions, garlic, rice vinegar, shrimp paste, and spices. - spices
cac_buoc: Step 1: Cut the tofu into small pieces and fry until golden brown. Wash the scallions and cut them into finger-length pieces. Next, cut the tomatoes into wedges and sauté them briefly with cooking oil (note: use high heat when sautéing).
Step 2: Preparing the paddy crabs:
Wash the crabs, remove the abdominal flaps, and set the top shells aside. Use a small pick to scrape the crab fat from the shells into a clean bowl and set aside.

Next, grind or pound the crab bodies finely with a few grains of salt. Transfer the ground crab to a large bowl, mix with water, and use your hands to gently squeeze so the crab meat dissolves into the water (do not squeeze too hard as this will break the meat and lose nutrients).
Step 3: Gently pour the water mixed with crab meat into a pot. Repeat the process of adding water, squeezing gently, and straining about 2 times until only the hard shells remain in the bowl.

Add a bit of seasoning including salt, seasoning powder, and sugar to the filtered crab water and place it on the stove over medium heat. Stir gently so the crab meat clumps together and floats to the surface, then scoop it out and set aside in a bowl.
Step 4: Add the previously sautéed tomatoes to the pot of crab broth. Season the broth with a tablespoon of shrimp paste and other spices to taste, then continue to simmer over low heat.

Soak the dried shrimp until soft, then grind them finely in a blender. Mix the ground shrimp, ground pork, eggs, minced shallots, garlic, and seasoning powder to make the meatballs. Use a spoon to drop small portions of the mixture into the boiling broth. When the meatballs float to the surface, add the fried tofu.
Step 5: Just before serving, add the rice vinegar and adjust the seasoning to taste.

Finally: Sauté the dried shallots until fragrant, then quickly pour in the crab fat, stir well, and turn off the heat. This is called the coloring oil and can be added directly to the pot or into each individual bowl when serving.
Place the noodles and scallions in a bowl. Ladle the broth and coloring oil over them to enjoy a Northern-style bún riêu cua. This dish can be served with a plate of fresh herbs and vegetables.

mon_an.mo_ta: Today we will show you an easy-to-make and extremely appetizing dish for dinner: Cá kho sấu. This is a delicious braised dish featuring the rich, fatty taste of fish and pork belly, the sweetness of sugarcane, the aroma of pepper, and the sourness of dracontomelon combined with the spiciness of chili and other spices to create a harmonious, bold flavor of sour, spicy, salty, and sweet. Let's treat your family to this unique and delicious dish.
cac_buoc: 1. Making the caramel sauce:

Place about 4 tablespoons of sugar in a pot, add 1 tablespoon of water and lemon juice (optional), and boil until the sugar turns a dark amber color, then turn off the heat. If you prefer not to do this step, you can buy pre-made caramel sauce at the market.
2. Preparing the ingredients:
Wash the scallions and cut into sections. Crush the white parts of the scallions.
Peel the sugarcane and slice into thin strips (to line the bottom of the pot).
Blanch the pork in boiling water, wash it, and cut into thick strips.
Clean the fish, wash it, and cut into bite-sized pieces. You can remove the head to cook sour soup and cut the rest in half.
Marinate the fish and pork with pepper, seasoning powder, salt, caramel sauce, minced shallots and garlic, and fish sauce for about 15 minutes to let the flavors penetrate.
Peel the dracontomelon, wash them, and leave whole or cut in half.
3. Braising the fish:

Layer the sugarcane at the bottom of the pot, then add the dracontomelon, pork, fish, chili, 2 tablespoons of annatto oil, and 2 bowls of boiling water. Turn on the heat to high to firm up the fish. Once boiling, reduce the heat to low and simmer for about 10 minutes, then flip the fish so both sides absorb the seasoning. Continue simmering over low heat until the fish and dracontomelon are tender and the sauce has thickened. Add the scallion sections, pepper, and chili, then turn off the heat.
Serve on a plate and eat hot with white rice.

The finished dish should have tender fish that has absorbed the spices. The pork belly should be soft, with its fat rendered and blended into the fish. The dish should have an attractive color and a balanced sour, spicy, salty, and sweet taste.
Some tips for a delicious braised fish:

Marinate the fish and pork for at least 15 minutes before cooking. When marinating, place the crushed white scallion parts inside the fish belly. Do not peel the shallots; just cut off the roots and braise them with their skins on to reduce the fishy smell.

Lining the bottom of the pot with sugarcane provides a fragrant aroma and a sweetness that balances the sourness of the dracontomelon and the spiciness of the chili. Furthermore, it prevents the fish from sticking to the pot.
You can use store-bought caramel sauce, but it is recommended to make your own from sugar for better quality.
Shopping tip: Buy a whole fish; use the head for sour soup or pickled mustard green soup, and use the body for braising.
Add the black pepper just before turning off the heat to preserve its aroma and enhance the dish.

mon_an.mo_ta: The weather is getting cold; let's learn how to cook this spicy, delicious Cá ngừ kho nước mía for a warm dinner according to this recipe.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Shallot - 1 bulb, a few scallion stalks
Spices - To taste (pepper, fish sauce, annatto oil, cooking oil)
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients
Cut the tuna into thin, bite-sized slices. Marinate with pepper, salt, and fish sauce for about 15 minutes.
Blanch the pork belly in boiling water, wash it, cut into thick strips, and marinate with a little pepper and fish sauce.
Peel the pineapple, remove the eyes, and cut into 0.5 cm thick slices.
Minced the shallots and garlic. Cut the scallions into sections.
Pound the white scallion parts and chili together.
Braising the fish

Heat cooking oil, sauté half of the minced shallots and garlic until fragrant, then remove and set aside. Pan-sear the fish over high heat until the meat is firm and both sides are slightly golden, then remove and place in the braising pot.

Add more oil to the pan, sauté the remaining shallots and garlic, then add the pork belly and stir quickly until firm. Add the pounded scallion and chili mixture, stir together, then transfer everything into the pot with the fish.

Add the pineapple slices and sugarcane juice to the pot and turn on the heat. Braise over high heat until the meat and fish are firm, then adjust the seasoning to taste. Lower the heat to a simmer until the meat and fish are cooked through and have absorbed the spices. When the sauce has reduced and thickened slightly, add crushed white pepper, sprinkle with scallions and dill if desired, and turn off the heat. Serve hot with rice.

Here is the finished dish. Thanks to the sugarcane juice, there is no need for caramel sauce, yet the fish still has a beautiful amber color. The tuna is fragrant, rich, and spicy-hot, with a thick, savory sauce that is perfect with rice.

mon_an.mo_ta: Pumpkin and peanut soup is a nutritious dish that is very good for your family's health. Let's learn how to cook this healthy dish!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 1 tsp seasoning powder, ½ tsp sugar, ½ tsp pepper, 1 tsp minced shallots, 1 tbsp fish sauce, 5 g rice paddy herb, 5 g culantro.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Choose a small, green-skinned pumpkin. Wash, peel, and use a serrated knife to cut it into thin slices.
Step 2:
Marinate the ground pork with seasoning powder, pepper, sugar, and minced shallots. Roll into small round meatballs.
Crush the peanuts.
Step 3:
Bring a pot of water to a boil, add the peanuts and meatballs, and cook for 15 minutes until the peanuts are soft. Add seasoning powder to taste for a sweet broth.

Add the pumpkin and cook for another 10 minutes until just tender. Add the rice paddy herb, culantro, and fish sauce, stir well, and turn off the heat. Ladle the soup into a bowl, sprinkle with pepper on top, and serve hot with rice for a wonderful meal.
Note:
To make the soup more fragrant, you can sauté the shallots or leeks (if available) to marinate with the meat instead of the usual way; it will be much tastier and have a more distinctive aroma.

mon_an.mo_ta: Learn how to cook winter melon soup with shrimp according to this recipe. This refreshing, sweet soup thanks to the shrimp and vegetables, combined with the aroma of scallions and cilantro, is not only delicious but also very eye-catching.
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients
Wash the culantro and cilantro. Wash the scallions and finely mince the white parts.
Peel the shrimp, remove the heads and tails, and mince finely with the minced white scallion parts. Marinate with a little pepper and soup powder for 10 minutes, then roll into small balls.
Peel the carrot, wash, carve into flowers, and slice thinly.
Wash the winter melon, remove the ends, and cut into long, thin slices.
Divide the scallion leaves into two parts: mince one part along with the culantro and cilantro; blanch the other part briefly in boiling water and drain.
Place a shrimp ball in the middle of a winter melon slice and roll it up. Use a blanched scallion leaf to tie and secure it.
Cooking the soup
Bring water to a boil, add seasoning powder and soup powder to taste (if you have broth, use bone broth for a sweeter taste).

Add the carrots and winter melon shrimp rolls, bring to a boil, and cook for about 5 minutes until the shrimp is cooked (you can test by piercing a toothpick through the shrimp ball; if it doesn't stick, it's done).
Sprinkle with the minced scallions and cilantro, then turn off the heat. Ladle the soup into a bowl and serve hot.
Here is the finished dish. With this method, you will have a delicious, sweet soup in just 15 minutes.

mon_an.mo_ta: Sour soup is very popular in Vietnamese family meals, especially favored in summer to help cool the body. We will introduce you to this delicious sour squid soup recipe.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 1 tomato, 1 small ball of tamarind, a few sprigs of rice paddy herb, culantro, garlic, chili.
Spices - sugar, salt, fish sauce, white wine, cooking oil.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel the taro stems, slice them, massage briefly with a bit of salt, wash, and drain. Peel the pineapple, remove the eyes, and slice. Cut the ends off the okra and slice diagonally in half. Wash the tomato and cut into wedges. Remove the roots from the rice paddy herb and culantro, then wash. Wash the bean sprouts.
Step 2: Soak the tamarind in boiling water for about 5 minutes until soft. Then press through a sieve to extract the pulp. Peel, wash, and mince the garlic. Wash and slice the chili.
Step 3: Clean the squid and wash with a little white wine to remove the fishy smell. Drain and cut into rings.

Step 4: Place a pan on the stove, heat the oil, and sauté the minced garlic until fragrant. Scoop out half of the fried garlic and set aside. Then add the squid and a little fish sauce to the pan and stir-fry. Once the squid is cooked, remove to a plate and set aside.
Step 5: Bring a pot of water to a boil, add salt, tamarind pulp, and sugar, seasoning to taste. Note that Southern-style sour soup does not use seasoning powder or MSG!

Step 6: Once seasoned to taste, add the vegetables in order: pineapple, tomato, taro stems, okra, and bean sprouts. When the vegetables are cooked, add the stir-fried squid back in, add a tablespoon of fish sauce, and adjust the seasoning. Turn off the heat, ladle the soup into a bowl, and sprinkle the chopped rice paddy herb, culantro, sliced chili, and fried garlic on top.
Now you have a delicious, refreshing bowl of sour squid soup for your family's summer meal.

mon_an.mo_ta: Cook this pickled mustard green and beef soup according to our recipe. With this method, you will have a mildly sour, delicious soup that is very appetizing on hot days.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel, crush, and mince the shallot and garlic. Thinly slice the beef, marinate with a little oil and spices to soften, and add some minced shallot and garlic. Wash the tomatoes and cut into wedges. Wash the scallions and cilantro, then cut into sections.
Step 2: Place a pot on the stove, add oil, and sauté half of the remaining minced shallot and garlic, then add the beef and stir-fry until cooked.
Step 3: Squeeze the liquid out of the pickled mustard greens and drain.

Place a pan on the stove, sauté the remaining shallot and garlic, then add one tomato (cut into wedges) and stir. Add a few grains of salt to soften the tomato, then add the pickled greens and stir-fry, seasoning to taste.

Next, transfer the sautéed pickles and tomatoes into the pot with the beef and water, and bring to a boil. Add the remaining tomato wedges and simmer for about 10 minutes until the beef and pickles are tender. Adjust the seasoning to taste, add the scallions and cilantro, and turn off the heat.
Pickled mustard green and beef soup is a delicious, easy-to-make dish with simple ingredients that doesn't take much time. Here are some secrets for a great soup:
If the pickles are too sour or salty, you can rinse them and squeeze them dry before cooking.

Choose fresh beef; if you like tendon, you can choose a cut with tendon and stew it until soft. When marinating the beef, mix in a tablespoon of oil first, then add the minced shallot and garlic, and finally the spices. Adding oil helps the beef stay tender. Marinate with aromatics before adding other spices.

Do not season the soup immediately when adding water because the beef is already marinated and the pickles/tomatoes were seasoned during stir-frying. Therefore, wait until the soup is finished to adjust the seasoning. You can add a tiny bit of sugar to balance the sourness. Adding a bit of fish sauce will make the soup more fragrant and delicious. Note that you should only add fish sauce just before turning off the heat, otherwise the soup may turn bitter and overly sour.

mon_an.mo_ta: The change of seasons is when the body feels tired and resistance decreases. Make this chicken and shiitake mushroom soup for your family to enjoy and nourish their bodies!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Soak the goji berries to clean off any sand.
Soak the shiitake mushrooms until they expand, then trim the stems.
Thinly slice the carrot. Cut the broccoli into bite-sized pieces.
Step 2: Simmer the chicken bones to make a sweet broth.
Step 3: Bring the chicken broth to a boil, then add the goji berries and shiitake mushrooms. Simmer until soft, then add the carrots.
Next, season the soup with 1 tablespoon of seasoning powder, 1/2 tablespoon of salt, and 1 tablespoon of sugar to taste.
Step 4: Add the broccoli, cook until done, then turn off the heat.
Step 5: Ladle the chicken and mushroom soup into a bowl and serve hot.

mon_an.mo_ta: This stuffed bell pepper soup features crisp, mildly spicy bell peppers filled with meat and vegetables, giving you a beautiful, delicious, and nutritious bowl of soup. Refer to our cooking method in the article below!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Soak the wood ear mushrooms in warm water, wash, and drain. Then finely chop them along with the carrot and onion.
Step 2: Wash the bell peppers, cut off the tops (keep them to use as lids), and remove the seeds.

Step 3: Place the ground meat in a bowl and mix well with the wood ear mushrooms, carrot, and onion. Season with pepper, salt, seasoning powder, and a bit of minced garlic. Use your hands to knead the meat until it is elastic and the spices are well absorbed!
Step 4: Stuff the meat into the peppers, pressing firmly so the meat isn't loose and won't fall out during cooking (do not pack too tightly or the meat will become dry and less tasty).
Step 5: Heat a pot with a little oil, then sauté the shallots and garlic until fragrant. Add enough water for the soup.

Step 6: Once the water is boiling, add each stuffed pepper. Cook for about 10 minutes until the peppers and the meat inside are cooked through. Adjust the seasoning to taste, then turn off the heat. Ladle into a bowl and serve hot.

mon_an.mo_ta: This mustard green and meatball soup, with the sweet taste of the greens and the fragrant, slightly warm spiciness of ginger, helps make meals on hot days much more pleasant!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Mustard greens, cleaned and washed - 1 bunch
Shallot, ginger, salt, sesame oil, cornstarch, cooking wine - spices
cac_buoc: Peel and mince the ginger, then mix it with the pork in a 1:4 ratio. Add 1 tablespoon of cornstarch, 1 egg, ½ teaspoon of salt, and 1 teaspoon of sesame oil, then mix well to let the flavors penetrate.

Next, bring a pot with about 1 large bowl of water to a boil. When the water boils, drop the mustard greens in to blanch until just cooked, then remove to a plate and set aside. Use scissors to cut the greens into small segments.

Bring the pot of water back to a boil. Roll the meat into bite-sized balls and drop them into the boiling water one by one. Use a spoon or chopsticks to gently move the meatballs to prevent them from sticking to the pot.

Wait for the water to boil again, then lower the heat and simmer until the meatballs are thoroughly cooked. When the meatballs float to the surface, they are done. Skim off any foam to keep the broth clear.

Finally, add the chopped mustard greens back into the pot. Sprinkle with a little seasoning powder to taste, drizzle with 1 tablespoon of sesame oil, and turn off the heat once it boils again. Ladle the soup into a bowl and serve hot.

mon_an.ten: Vegetable and Ground Pork Soup – A Refreshing Dish for Summer
mon_an.mo_ta: Hello everyone! Today, I'm sharing a recipe for Vegetable and Ground Pork Soup. This dish is easy to cook, visually appealing, and highly nutritious. The savory aroma of the meat blends perfectly with the vegetables, making it irresistible. On hot summer days, a refreshing bowl of soup is essential to provide energy and keep the body feeling fresh. Today, we will explore how to cook this simple yet flavorful and nutritious soup. It not only quenches thirst but also brings a delicious and attractive addition to your family meal. Let's learn the recipe and show off your cooking skills this summer! Here is the guide to making a delicious, cooling vegetable and ground pork soup for those sweltering days. A flavorful and nutritious soup to soothe your thirst and provide a tasty highlight for the family dinner.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings - salt, fish sauce, broth powder, black pepper to taste
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients

Clean the pork, blanch it in boiling water, then rinse with cold water. I usually prepare meat this way to remove any odors and ensure it smells fresh when cooked. Thinly slice the meat, put it in a blender/grinder, then transfer to a bowl and marinate with pepper and a bit of fish sauce.
Peel the carrots and potatoes, carve them into flower shapes, and slice into rounds.
Wash the cauliflower and break it into small florets. Peel the green husks off the baby corn, remove the silk, and wash thoroughly.
Step 2: Cook the delicious vegetable and pork soup
Heat a little cooking oil in a pan and sauté the minced shallots until fragrant. Add the marinated meat and stir-fry until just cooked, then remove the meat and set aside on a plate.
Place a soup pot on the stove, add cooking oil, and lightly sauté the carrots, potatoes, and baby corn with 1 small teaspoon of salt.

Pour in filtered water and simmer until the carrots and potatoes are tender. Add the cauliflower and onions, bring to a boil, then add the sautéed meat back into the pot. Simmer for about 5 minutes. Add the broth powder, finely chopped green onions, and culantro. Remove from the heat, serve the soup in a large bowl, and enjoy while hot.
How to choose delicious pork
Choose fresh cuts of pork with a bright color. Good meat will be pale pink or light red, and the fat will be white or slightly off-white.
To check for freshness, press your finger into the meat. If it has good elasticity and returns to its original shape without leaving a dent after you withdraw your hand, it is fresh.
Additionally, choose pork where the meat and fat layers are distinct but tightly connected. When touched, they should feel difficult to separate.
To ensure quality, buy pork in whole pieces and ask the butcher to grind it on the spot, or take it home and use your own meat grinder. This ensures the meat is fresh and clean.

mon_an.ten: Canh Riêu Cua: Delicious, Nutritious, and Affordable
mon_an.mo_ta: Canh riêu cua can be enjoyed with rice or rice vermicelli. The soup features the natural sweetness of crab and the tanginess of fermented rice and doc fruit, making it very appetizing. Let's make this crab soup following the recipe below.
cac_buoc: Place the crabs in cold water with a little salt, stir, and wash thoroughly. Remove the top shells, mouths, and aprons. Grind the crab bodies finely, add cold water, filter to get the crab liquid, and discard the residue (repeat this 2-3 times). Use a toothpick to extract the yellow roe from the top shells and set aside.
Wash and slice the tomatoes into wedges. Roast the doc fruit until cooked, then peel off the skin.

Wash the starfruit, trim the edges, and slice lengthwise into long pieces. Mash the fermented rice and shrimp paste, then strain to get the liquid. Wash and finely mince the pork fat. Wash the green onions and mince the white bulbs.
Sauté the minced shallots and pork fat, then add the crab roe to create a colored oil; set aside. Lightly stir-fry the starfruit and tomatoes, then set aside.

Add the shrimp paste and salt to the filtered crab liquid, stir well, and bring to a boil. When the crab meat floats to the surface and forms a cake, skim it off and set aside. Finally, add the doc fruit, starfruit, fermented rice liquid, and tomatoes to the pot and cook until tender, then return the crab meat to the pot. Season with fish sauce and salt to taste. When eating, mash the starfruit and doc fruit to release their sourness. Add the prepared crab roe color. Serve hot with raw vegetables and herbs.
Finished product requirements: The broth should be clear with a slightly pale pink hue. The crab meat should form firm cakes that are not broken, with a balanced, mild sour taste.

mon_an.mo_ta: Today, I'll introduce you to a recipe for a seaweed and shrimp soup that is both delicious and healthy.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings - As needed (salt, pepper, broth powder)
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients
Peel the prawns (leave the tails on), remove the black veins, and wash. Marinate with 1/2 tsp broth powder.
Soak the seaweed until expanded, drain, and cut into 4cm lengths.
Trim the tough ends of the choy sum, wash, and cut into 4cm lengths (same as the seaweed).
Cut the soft tofu into 1cm cubes. Shred the ginger and carrots.
Cooking the soup
If you have broth, use it to make the soup sweeter; otherwise, use filtered water. Add 1 tsp broth powder and bring to a boil. Add the choy sum, carrots, and prawns and bring back to a boil.
Add the seaweed and stir quickly, then add the tofu and shredded ginger. Adjust the seasoning to taste, stir gently, and turn off the heat. Ladle the soup into a bowl and serve hot.
Here is the finished soup, everyone. Try making this seaweed soup to boost your family's health.
Note these tips for a better soup:
Add the seaweed only after the prawns and choy sum are cooked so the seaweed stays crunchy and doesn't get mushy.
Soft tofu is very delicate, so add it last and stir gently to avoid breaking it.
Adding ginger helps remove the fishy smell of the seaweed and enhances the flavor of the prawns.

mon_an.ten: Pork Rib and Pickled Mustard Green Soup
mon_an.mo_ta: When I was a child, my mother said I was a picky eater who only ate what I liked. And when I liked something, I would eat it continuously until I got bored. Sometimes, if that dish wasn't there, I wouldn't eat at all. My parents really struggled with my eating habits. In this cold weather, I remember how I used to only love pork rib and pickled mustard green soup; without it, I'd eat plain rice rather than any other soup (and back then, pickled greens weren't available year-round like now, only in season). I'd always beg my mom to cook it, and my poor parents had to eat the same thing every day, even going to the neighbors to ask for pickles when we ran out just to cook for their daughter. Now that the weather has turned cold again, I suddenly crave that flavorful, rich soup from the old days. Let's get into the kitchen and learn how to make this delicious pork rib and pickled mustard green soup.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings - As needed (pepper, salt, fish sauce, sugar, cooking oil)
cac_buoc: Preparation
Peel and mince the shallot. Wash the tomato and cut into wedges. Wash and chop the green onions.
Wash the pork ribs. Bring water to a boil, blanch the ribs, then rinse them clean. Marinate the ribs with a little pepper, 1 tsp minced shallot, and salt to let the flavors sink in.
Cooking the soup

Sauté the shallot until fragrant, then add the ribs and stir-fry until firm. Add the pickled mustard greens and stir-fry together to absorb the seasonings. Add water and the smashed ginger, bring to a boil, then lower the heat and simmer until the ribs and greens are tender.

Add the tomatoes and adjust the seasoning to taste. You should add a little sugar to balance the acidity of the pickles. Stir in the chopped green onions and turn off the heat. Ladle into a bowl and serve hot.

mon_an.ten: Delicious Chicken and Straw Mushroom Congee
cac_buoc: Chicken congee is certainly a delicious and familiar dish in Vietnamese family meals. Surprisingly, making chicken and straw mushroom congee is very simple! This article will provide all the information from choosing ingredients and buying chicken to preparation and how to cook chicken straw mushroom congee quickly at home!
I. Quick Pressure Cooker Method for Chicken and Straw Mushroom Congee
1. Prepare ingredients
Chicken: 1 bird
Rice: 1/2 cup
Straw mushrooms: 200g
Lemon: 1 fruit
Green onions: a little
Cilantro: a little
Sea salt: a little
Common seasonings: a little (including sugar, salt, MSG, and broth powder)
2. Instructions
2.1. Prepare the ingredients
Chicken:
To remove the odor from the chicken, you can use salt and lemon. Sprinkle sea salt and squeeze lemon juice all over the chicken, then rub for about 5 minutes. Rinse the chicken with clean water.
Another tip is to use diluted vinegar to wash the chicken instead of salt and lemon.
Additionally, after buying the chicken, you can dip it in boiling water and use tweezers to pluck out any fine feathers to reduce the smell.
Another way to remove the odor is to cut off the oil gland (the parson's nose) at the tail of the chicken.
Prepare straw mushrooms:
Use a knife to trim the stems of the straw mushrooms. Then, soak the mushrooms in diluted salt water for about 10 minutes.
Rinse the mushrooms again and drain.
Prepare rice:
Wash the rice to clean off any dust, then put it in a colander to drain.
Place a pan on the stove and toast the rice until it turns evenly golden, then turn off the heat.
Prepare herbs:
Remove any wilted leaves from the onions and cilantro, wash, and chop finely for the final seasoning.
2.2. Cook the congee
Prepare the pressure cooker and place the toasted rice and the chicken inside. Pour in 3 liters of water, then select the simmer/stew mode for 25 minutes.

After 25 minutes, release all the steam from the pressure cooker and let it sit for another 10 minutes before opening the lid. Remove the chicken to a plate to cool. Once cooled, shred the chicken into bite-sized pieces.
Transfer the congee from the pressure cooker to a regular pot. Next, add the prepared straw mushrooms, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 tbsp salt, 1.5 tbsp broth powder, and 1/2 tsp MSG to the congee pot.
Place the pot on the stove and cook for another 10 minutes. Adjust the seasoning to taste, then turn off the heat and add the chopped herbs and pepper.
Notes
During the cooking process, do not open the pressure cooker lid to check or season.
To avoid burns from the pressure cooker, after simmering for the required time, unplug it, release the valve, and wait at least 5 minutes before opening the lid.

To ensure the mushrooms are just cooked and retain their sweetness without being too soft, transfer the congee to a regular pot first. Then add the mushrooms and other ingredients and season to taste.
2.3. Finished product

You have now completed the chicken and straw mushroom congee using a pressure cooker, a delicious and nutritious dish. When eating, you can add the shredded chicken back into the congee or use half of the chicken to make a salad (gỏi); both ways are delicious.

The congee has a sweet flavor thanks to the straw mushrooms and the chicken bone broth. The mushrooms are cooked to a crunchy, chewy texture, while the chicken is tender and sweet, sure to please every member of your family.
II. Traditional Method for Chicken and Straw Mushroom Congee
200 grams white rice
1/2 tin of condensed milk can (used as a measure)
1.2 kilograms chicken (1/2 a large chicken)
400 grams straw mushrooms
1 cabbage
3 stalks green onions
5 cloves garlic
4 lemons
3 tbsp cooking oil
1/2 tbsp fish sauce
A little common seasoning (salt, sugar, broth powder, MSG, pepper)
2. Ingredient processing
Chicken: After cleaning, rub salt all over the chicken for about 3 minutes to remove dirt and odors. Rinse the chicken and drain.
Straw mushrooms: Cut the mushrooms in half and soak in diluted salt water for about 3 minutes. Then, wash 2-3 times with clean water and drain.
Garlic: Peel and mince the garlic.
Green onions: Trim the roots, wash, and chop finely.
Cabbage: Remove the core and shred the leaves into thin, bite-sized strips. Place in a bowl of salt water, toss well, and soak for about 3 minutes. Rinse with clean water afterward.
Lemon juice: Squeeze the juice from 4 lemons into a bowl, removing all seeds. Add 4 tbsp sugar to the lemon juice and stir until the sugar is completely dissolved.
2.2. Mix the cabbage salad
