Combine ingredients: Drain the cabbage and place in a large bowl. Pour the lemon-sugar mixture over it and toss well until the cabbage softens and absorbs the dressing. Stop once this result is achieved.
2.3. Boil the chicken

In a pot, add 1.2 liters of water along with 3 tbsp broth powder and 1 tbsp MSG. Stir well to dissolve the seasonings and bring the water to a boil. Place the chicken in the pot and boil over medium heat for about 15 minutes or until the chicken is cooked. Remove the chicken from the broth.
Let the chicken cool for about 2 minutes, then shred it into bite-sized pieces.
2.4. Sauté the mushrooms
In a pan, add 3 tbsp cooking oil and the minced garlic. Sauté until the garlic is fragrant.
Next, add the straw mushrooms to the pan and toss well. Then, add 1 tsp MSG, 1/2 tbsp broth powder, 1/3 tbsp salt, 1 tbsp sugar, and 1/2 tbsp fish sauce to the pan.
Stir-fry over high heat for about 5 minutes until the mushrooms are cooked. Once the mushrooms are done, turn off the heat and transfer them to a bowl.
2.5. Toast the rice and cook the congee
First, wash the rice with cold water 2 to 3 times. Then, put the rice in a pot and toast over medium heat for about 2-3 minutes until the rice turns light yellow, then turn off the heat.

Remove the cooked chicken. Next, add the toasted rice to the chicken broth and cook over low heat for about 30 minutes until the rice is soft and tender. Then, add the sautéed straw mushrooms to the pot and cook for another 3 minutes.
Finally, add the chopped green onions and stir well. Adjust the seasoning to your taste, then turn off the heat. The congee is finished.
2.6. Completion
To enjoy, ladle the congee into a bowl and sprinkle some pepper on top.
For the salad, simply place the shredded chicken in the center of a plate and surround it with the mixed cabbage. The dish is complete!
III. How to Buy Fresh Ingredients
1. How to choose fresh straw mushrooms
Choose mushrooms that are still in the bud stage, not yet bloomed, fresh, slightly round or cylindrical in shape, and uniform in size. Avoid choosing mushrooms that are too large or too small.
When choosing straw mushrooms, prioritize those with a black or gray color, as they usually have a better flavor than the white variety.
Limit buying straw mushrooms that feel hard when pressed, as this may indicate they are old and no longer tasty.
2. How to choose fresh cabbage
Good cabbage will feel heavy and firm when picked up. it should also be of moderate size and not too heavy or too light for its size.
Fresh cabbage usually has a deep green color, a round shape, and is not flattened or oval.
Avoid buying cabbage with bruised outer leaves or a pale white color, as this may be old cabbage that is fibrous and not tasty.

mon_an.ten: Pandan Rice Porridge with Salted Duck Eggs
mon_an.mo_ta: Pandan rice porridge with salted duck eggs is a unique and delicate traditional Vietnamese dish. Simple yet flavorful, this dish not only provides a comforting feeling but also brings a delicious taste to your meal. To cook a perfect pot of pandan porridge, you need to prepare ingredients such as fresh pandan leaves, savory salted duck eggs, white glutinous rice, and appropriate seasonings. Let's explore how to cook this wonderful dish in the article below! This guide provides detailed ingredients and step-by-step instructions for you to showcase your culinary skills with this sophisticated Vietnamese porridge.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Rice - 1/2 cup white rice and 1 handful glutinous rice
cac_buoc: 1. Ingredient preparation
Rice: Wash 1/2 cup white rice and 1 handful glutinous rice under cold water to remove dust and impurities. Then, let the rice drain for a short time.
Pandan leaves: Wash 1 bunch of pandan leaves to remove dirt. Then, finely chop the pandan leaves. Cut the leaves lengthwise to make them compact and easy to eat.
Salted duck eggs: Prepare 4-5 salted duck eggs. It is recommended to use high-quality salted duck eggs with good flavor.
Salt: The amount of salt can be adjusted to taste. It is recommended to use about 1/2 tsp salt, then adjust further if necessary.
2. Processing
Step 1: Wash 200g glutinous rice and soak in water for about 30 minutes to soften the rice for cooking. Then, discard the soaking water and rinse the glutinous rice again to remove impurities.
Step 2: Take 4-5 fresh pandan leaves, wash, and finely chop them. Cut the leaves lengthwise to make them compact and easy to eat.

Step 3: Boil water in a large pot. Then, add the soaked glutinous rice to the pot and bring back to a boil. Reduce to low heat and simmer the porridge for about 20-25 minutes until the rice is soft and cooked. While cooking, make sure to stir the porridge regularly to prevent it from burning at the bottom.

Step 4: While the porridge is cooking, prepare 4-5 salted duck eggs. Bring water to a boil, then drop the salted duck eggs into the boiling water and cook for 7-10 minutes. The salted duck eggs will become soft with a beautiful yellow color. Then, remove the eggs and let them drain.

Step 5: When the rice is cooked, add the finely chopped pandan leaves to the porridge pot. Cook for another 5-7 minutes so the pandan leaves soften and release their characteristic flavor. Pandan leaves will bring a natural aroma and special taste to the porridge.
Step 6: Add the cooked salted eggs to the porridge and cook for another 1-2 minutes to warm them up. The salted duck eggs will enhance the savory and interesting flavor of the porridge.

Step 7: Before turning off the heat, add seasonings such as salt, pepper, and sugar to the porridge according to your taste. Mix well so the seasonings blend into the porridge and create a balanced flavor.
Step 8: Remove the porridge from the pot and garnish with scallions and fried shallots (if desired). Scallions will bring a bright color and fresh taste to the porridge.
With these detailed steps for cooking pandan rice porridge with salted duck eggs, you now have a delicious and flavorful traditional dish to enjoy with your family and loved ones.
Notes for cooking delicious pandan rice porridge with salted duck eggs

Wash the rice: Before cooking, wash the rice thoroughly to remove impurities and dust. Rinse the rice several times until the water runs clear. This helps the porridge have a clear and appetizing appearance.
Soak the rice: Soak the rice in water for about 30 minutes before cooking. Soaking helps the rice soften during cooking, giving the porridge a smooth texture.
Boil the water: Boil water in a large pot. Ensure there is enough water to cook the porridge without it overflowing when boiling.

Reduce to low heat: After the rice has been added to the boiling water, reduce to low heat to let the porridge cook gradually. Ensure you stir the porridge frequently to avoid burning the bottom of the pot.

Cooking time: Cook the porridge for about 20-25 minutes until the rice is soft. This may vary depending on the type of rice and the heat level. Check the softness of the rice to determine if the porridge is fully cooked.

Pandan leaves: Add the chopped pandan leaves to the porridge after the rice is soft. Cook for another 5-7 minutes to soften the leaves and release their flavor. Ensure not to cook for too long so the pandan leaves do not become mushy or lose their color.
Salted duck eggs: Cook the salted duck eggs in separate boiling water before adding them to the porridge. Ensure the salted duck eggs are cooked soft within the correct time and are not overcooked.

mon_an.ten: Spicy Tofu Stir-fry for Cold Days
mon_an.mo_ta: The weather is getting cold again, so let's cook spicy stir-fried tofu, a dish full of nutrients, spicy, and piping hot, which is perfect with rice for cold days. Let's try it with this recipe.
cac_buoc: Peel the ginger and garlic, wash, and mince them. Wash and mince the chili. Trim the roots of the scallions, wash, and mince them, keeping the white and green parts separate.

Wash the tofu, cut into bite-sized pieces, and pat dry. Place a pan on the stove, heat it up, and add cooking oil. Wait about 2 minutes for the oil to get hot, then fry the tofu until golden on all sides and remove to a plate.

Pour out some of the oil from the pan (to make the dish less greasy), then add the chili, garlic, ginger, and the white parts of the scallions to sauté until fragrant. Then add the minced meat and stir-fry with a little seasoning until the meat is firm.

Next, add the satay sauce and stir well until the meat is evenly colored, then add sugar and soy sauce, stirring for a while to let the meat absorb the flavors, then add about half a bowl of water and bring to a boil.

Add the fried tofu, stir gently, bring back to a boil, then add vinegar. Season to taste, sprinkle the remaining scallions on top, and turn off the heat. Transfer to a bowl or a deep plate. Serve hot with white rice for the best taste.
Here is the finished spicy stir-fried tofu, enjoy your meal everyone! ^^

mon_an.mo_ta: Discover how to prepare delicious pan-seared pork liver with a golden, crispy outer layer and a soft, smooth interior infused with well-absorbed seasonings. In just 15 minutes, you will have an attractive savory dish to complete a perfect family meal. Let's get into the kitchen and make it now! Explore how to cook delicious and unique roasted pork ribs with a simple method. This versatile dish pairs well with white rice, sticky rice, or bread. Try it and enjoy the wonderful flavor today!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the liver

After washing the liver under running water and removing any clotted blood, slice the liver into pieces about 1 - 1.2cm thick to prevent it from drying out during cooking. Next, soak the liver in unsweetened fresh milk for about 25 - 30 minutes.
Step 2: Marinate the liver

To marinate the liver, mince the garlic and marinate 4/5 of the minced garlic with the soaked pork liver. Then, add 1 tsp seasoning powder, 1/4 tsp pepper, 1 tbsp fish sauce, and 2 tbsp red wine. Marinate the liver in the seasonings for about 30 minutes.
Step 3: Fry the liver

To fry the liver, sauté the remaining minced garlic until fragrant, then remove the garlic. Next, put the marinated pork liver into the pan and fry over medium-low heat. When the liver is evenly cooked, increase the heat to sear the edges until slightly charred, then remove and sprinkle with the fried garlic. You now have a delicious pan-seared liver dish to enjoy.
Step 4: Finished product

After frying, place the liver on a plate and garnish to make the dish look appealing. The garlic-seared pork liver has the characteristic rich, buttery taste of liver combined with the fragrant aroma of garlic. This dish is very suitable for family meals.
Notes when making pan-seared pork liver
Tips for preparing pork liver:
Wash the liver directly under running water and use a knife to score it to remove residual blood. Then, soak the liver in salt water for 10 minutes to half an hour to help neutralize toxins.
After soaking, wash thoroughly and squeeze out all clotted blood in the liver before cooking it completely.
Notes when eating pork liver:

Pork liver is high in copper, iron, and some other metallic elements. When combining liver with vegetables, they can cause a loss of vitamin C due to the oxidation of metal ions, leading to a loss of nutrients in the vegetables.

Pork liver is high in cholesterol. Consuming too much pork liver can increase cholesterol levels in the body and cause many serious health problems such as cardiovascular disease, high blood pressure, atherosclerosis, etc.
How to buy safe pork liver
Choose reliable sources: Select reputable stores, supermarkets, or restaurants known for providing safe food. If possible, buy liver from trusted sources with food safety certification.
Check quality: Inspect the liver before buying to ensure it has a bright color and no foul or strange odor. Avoid buying liver that shows signs of spoilage or poor hygiene.

Ensure storage conditions: Ask the store or supplier to ensure proper storage conditions. Liver should be stored at the appropriate temperature and packaged or wrapped tightly to avoid contact with bacteria or other harmful agents.

Consider the origin: If possible, find out the origin of the liver. Prioritize liver from sources with safe farming and processing procedures, without the use of prohibited substances or harmful veterinary drugs.

Comply with hygiene regulations: Ensure that the store or supplier complies with hygiene and food safety regulations. This ensures that the liver is handled and stored correctly to avoid the risk of infection or contamination.

mon_an.ten: Hanoi-style Crab Paste Hot Pot with Beef and Cartilage
cac_buoc: Crab paste hot pot with beef is a popular and beloved dish with a rich, attractive flavor and a simple preparation method. To master the way to make a delicious crab paste hot pot with beef, please refer to the following guide!
I. Instructions for traditional crab paste hot pot with beef
1. Prepare ingredients
Beef shank: 500g
Ground field crab: 500g
Crab fat: 50g
Fried tofu: 100g
Straw mushrooms: 50g
Tomatoes: 2 pieces
Bánh đa (brown rice noodles): 500g
Minced shallots: 1 tbsp
Fried shallots: 1 tbsp
Scallion: 1 stalk
Side vegetables: a little (shredded water spinach/shredded banana blossom/Malabar spinach)
Shrimp paste: 1 tbsp
Fish sauce: 2 tbsp
Rice vinegar (giấm bỗng): 3 tbsp
Rock sugar: 1 tbsp
Cooking oil: 1 tbsp
Cashew oil: 1 tbsp
Seasoning powder/MSG: a little
2. Execution steps
2.1. Prepare ingredients
Wash and slice the beef shank into bite-sized pieces, then place in the refrigerator until ready to use.
Wash the side vegetables, remove damaged or insect-eaten parts, then cut into bite-sized pieces.
Trim the mushroom stems and wash with water, then drain.
2.2. Make the crab paste
Place 500g of ground field crab in a bowl, add 2 liters of water, stir well, and filter through a sieve to get the crab water.
Boil the crab water in a pot with 1 tsp salt over low heat for about 20 minutes until the crab paste forms into floating chunks.
Turn off the heat, scoop the crab paste into a bowl, and keep the water to cook the hot pot broth.
2.3. Sauté the crab fat
Heat a pan over medium heat, add 1 tbsp cooking oil. Once the oil is hot, add 1 tbsp minced shallots to sauté until fragrant, then add the crab fat and sauté over low heat for 5 minutes.
Once the crab fat is sautéed, add it to the bowl of crab paste along with 1 tbsp fried shallots to complete the topping.
2.4. Cook the hot pot broth

Using the pan used for the crab fat, place it on the stove over medium heat and add 1 tbsp cashew oil. When the oil is hot, add 1 tbsp minced shallots and sauté until fragrant, then add the tomatoes and sauté for about 2 minutes until softened.

Place the pot containing the crab broth on the stove over high heat to boil. Add the sautéed tomatoes, straw mushrooms, 2 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp rock sugar, 1 tbsp seasoning powder, 1 tbsp MSG, 3 tbsp rice vinegar, and 1 tbsp shrimp paste.
Bring back to a boil and season to taste, then add scallions and turn off the heat.
2.5. Completion

Pour the hot pot broth into an electric hot pot. When eating, dip the beef, crab paste, bánh đa, fried tofu, and side vegetables, and enjoy immediately. Now you have a delicious pot of crab paste hot pot with beef.
II. Instructions for crab paste hot pot with beef and pork cartilage
500g field crab
500g pork bones
400g fresh beef
200g pork cartilage
200g ear sausage (giò tai - optional)
6 blocks of tofu
4 tomatoes
Balut eggs, quantity depending on the desired sweetness of the broth
Dried shallots, ginger
Fish sauce, sugar, seasoning powder, a little rice vinegar, and shrimp paste.
Water spinach, banana blossom, perilla, enoki mushrooms, and some extra perilla, scallions...
Can add tofu skin, rice vermicelli
Add cooking oil or cashew oil
2. Ingredient preparation steps
2.1. Prepare the crab
After buying field crabs, place them in a basin with a little grain salt and wash several times to clean.

Remove the shells, separate the aprons, and scoop out the yellow crab fat separately. Wash the crab bodies again, then place in a mortar with a little grain salt and grind finely until the crab meat sticks together due to the salt's effect on the proteins.

Add about 1.5 – 1.8 liters of water to the mortar, use your hands to squeeze the crab meat thoroughly to dissolve it, then let it settle and filter to get the water. Continue grinding and filtering several times to extract all the crab meat.

Place the crab meat water in a pot over medium heat and stir constantly in one direction to prevent the meat from sticking to the bottom. When the crab meat starts to separate and float, reduce to low heat, scoop the crab meat into a bowl, and press firmly to separate the water completely. The crab broth can be used as the hot pot base.
Sauté some cashew oil with dried shallots, add the crab fat to the pan to simmer until seasoned and it turns a beautiful golden-brown color.
2.2. Tofu and fried shallots
Cut the tofu into bite-sized pieces, fry until golden and crispy, then remove to a plate.

Peel and slice the dried shallots evenly, then fry until golden and crispy. In the process of making fried shallots, the most important thing is to adjust the timing: when the shallots become dry, slightly golden, and turn a light yellow, turn off the heat immediately, remove the shallots from the oil quickly, and place them on paper towels, spreading them evenly. Once cooled, they will become golden and very crispy.
2.3. Cook the broth
Start the hot pot broth by blanching the pork bones, washing them, and simmering over low heat for about 1 hour to create a naturally sweet broth, then filter to get the clear broth.

In a pot, heat 3 tbsp cashew oil and sauté the dried shallots until fragrant, then add 1/2 of the tomatoes to the pot, season with a little fish sauce, and sauté briefly for color. Next, pour the bone broth and crab broth into the pot, then add the sautéed tomatoes and the remaining tomatoes. To finish, add the fried tofu, tofu skin, crab paste, sautéed crab fat, and a bit of fried shallots.

Season with salt, fish sauce, shrimp paste, seasoning powder, and a little sugar for a mild flavor, then slowly add the rice vinegar until it suits your taste. Adding the rice vinegar last helps the hot pot have a clean sour taste and preserves the aroma of the dish.
2.4. Add dipping items

Prepare the dipping items by slicing the beef thinly and marinating it with a little shredded ginger and cooking oil to make the beef soft and sweet. Slice the pork cartilage thinly, cut the ear sausage into bite-sized pieces, and you can add small sausages (optional) to the list of ingredients.

The requirement for a complete hot pot is that the broth must have a mild, clean sour taste from the rice vinegar and the characteristic aroma of crab paste. When enjoying, the beef is cooked rare and sweet, the pork cartilage is crunchy, the tofu is golden and crispy, along with fresh green vegetables, creating a characteristic, rustic, and attractive flavor that embodies the countryside essence.
Refer now: How to cook delicious sweet and sour tamarind leaf crab hot pot
III. How to choose fresh ingredients
1. How to choose fresh beef shank
To choose the right beef shank, you should select meat that is bright red with white tendons and bright yellow fat.

To check the freshness of the beef, you can press lightly on the meat. Fresh beef should be firm and have good elasticity, not making your hand feel sticky or slimy. Fresh meat has no unpleasant odor or any strange smell.
When preparing beef hot pot, you should choose the upper tendon part of the beef like the shank. Additionally, you can use beef thigh, ribs, tendons, or tail to create an attractive beef hot pot.
2. How to choose delicious field crab meat

You can buy pre-ground field crab at supermarkets or reputable fresh markets. When buying, remember to ask for the crab fat to enhance the flavor of the dish. Alternatively, you can buy live crabs to grind at home or use a blender.

To choose suitable live field crabs, look for crabs with a dull purple-gray color; the shell should be brighter. To choose meaty crabs, select males with small, pointed aprons; to choose crabs with more fat, select females with larger aprons, known as "yếm bông".

Choose live field crabs that move quickly, with all claws and legs intact and flexible. When pressing on the apron shell, if you see air bubbles, the crab is fresh. Do not buy field crabs with red eyes, hairy bellies, or spots on the back of the head.
IV. Notes when making crab paste hot pot with beef
To make the best crab paste hot pot with beef and pork cartilage, the most important thing is to choose good quality rice vinegar (giấm bỗng).
The preparation of dipping items can be flexibly changed depending on each person's taste and preference.

When choosing field crabs, it is best to buy them at the beginning or end of the lunar month because this is when the crabs are usually fattier and have more meat. In the middle of the month, crabs often molt and are thinner. When preparing the crab, it should be hand-ground and filtered carefully to get more meat, which helps the crab paste form thick and attractive chunks when cooked.

mon_an.ten: Pork Cartilage Hot Pot for Warm Winter Days
mon_an.mo_ta: Hot pot is a very familiar dish, loved and used by many in family meals, parties, or gatherings with friends. To prepare a truly delicious hot pot, let's get into the kitchen and start making pork cartilage hot pot. Are you ready? This dish is very suitable for cold winter days! Let's learn how to cook pork cartilage hot pot through the article below! Instructions for cooking delicious, fragrant pork cartilage hot pot for a warm winter. Learn the steps to prepare ingredients, seasonings, and how to process a rich pork cartilage hot pot. This hot pot will bring warmth and a characteristic flavor to family meals or parties with friends on cold days.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Garland chrysanthemum, watercress, water spinach, napa cabbage, mushrooms - for dipping
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the pork ribs and cut them into 2 – 2.5cm pieces. Blanch the ribs in boiling water to remove dirt and odors. Then, drain the ribs and marinate them with 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp seasoning powder, and 1/2 tsp pepper. Stir-fry the ribs for 7 minutes to let the seasonings absorb.
Step 2: Clean the vegetables, soak them in salt water, then rinse with water and drain. Cut the tomatoes into wedges.

Step 3: After the ribs are seared, pour in a sufficient amount of water, and add the satay sauce and tomatoes. Keep the heat low so the ribs cook through to the inside and become softer. Add 3 tsp salt + 2 tsp seasoning powder + a little pepper and stir well so the seasonings are evenly absorbed.
Step 4: After 30 minutes, you have an attractive pork cartilage hot pot broth. Add the vegetables, wait for them to cook, and enjoy!
A delicious hot pot will help bring you and your loved ones closer together!
P/S: Please share this attractive recipe with your relatives and friends so everyone can become an expert chef for their family!
Tips for cooking delicious pork cartilage hot pot
Choose fresh pork cartilage with a beautiful red color to ensure a better flavor when cooked.
Avoid choosing ribs with too much bone; ribs that are not too hard with ivory-white cartilage usually have a better flavor.
Stir-fry the cartilage first so the seasonings penetrate, making the dish more flavorful and well-balanced.

Add coconut water to the hot pot broth to enhance the delicious flavor. You can also try variations like crab paste cartilage hot pot, kimchi cartilage hot pot, or cartilage simmered with dracontomelon (sấu) for something new.
Prepare a variety of dipping ingredients such as chicken or pork stomach to make the hot pot meal more attractive.
Wash the dipping vegetables carefully so they don't get crushed, and you can soak them in a little salt water before eating.
Simmer the ingredients until just cooked, but avoid over-simmering so as not to lose the natural sweetness.

Pork cartilage hot pot has a delicious flavor, crispy ribs, and sweet broth. This will be an attractive and unforgettable meal for your family. Save the recipe and try cooking it for your family right now.
How to buy delicious pork cartilage

One way to choose good ribs suitable for each dish is to pay attention to their freshness. When choosing ribs, you should look at the color to evaluate the freshness. Fresh young ribs are usually light pink; when pressed, the ribs will feel elastic and have no rancid smell.

When choosing ribs, prioritize pieces with small and flat bones. This type of rib has more meat and fewer bones than large, round ribs. However, do not choose ribs that are too small. If the rib bone is too small, it may have been taken from a small pig, and it may not be tasty or of guaranteed quality (as there are many cases where pigs have not reached the standard but are slaughtered due to illness).

mon_an.ten: Spicy and Sour Kimchi Pork Trotter Stew
mon_an.mo_ta: This Kimchi Pork Trotter Stew features a vibrant red broth with the signature spicy and sour flavors of kimchi, paired with silky soft tofu. It's a delicious dish that will leave you craving more. Let's get into the kitchen and make it!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Pork trotter, cut into small pieces - 500 g
Japanese silken tofu (or soft tofu) - 2 tubes
Seasoning salt, fish sauce, MSG... - seasonings
cac_buoc: Step 1: Clean the pork trotters and boil them for about 2 minutes. Discard the first boiling water, rinse the trotters thoroughly, then sauté them in a pot with fish sauce until fragrant. Add water and simmer for about 30 minutes.
Step 2: Next, add the silken tofu cut into bite-sized pieces.
Step 3: When the pot returns to a boil, add the kimchi. Adjust the seasoning to taste and turn off the heat.
Kimchi Pork Trotter Stew has a spicy, slightly sour flavor, perfect for serving with hot rice on cold days.

mon_an.ten: Braised Pork Ribs with Lotus Root
mon_an.mo_ta: Lotus root is known for its cooling properties and nutritional benefits, helping to improve blood circulation and promote better sleep. It can be used in salads, fried dishes, or stews. Today, we introduce a highly attractive recipe for Braised Pork Ribs with Lotus Root.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings - as needed (Pepper, chili sauce, seasoning powder, sugar)
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients:
Blanch the pork ribs, then rinse them clean. Marinate with 1 tbsp minced garlic, 1 tbsp minced shallot, 1/2 tsp pepper, and 1 tbsp seasoning powder for 15 minutes to absorb the flavors.

Choose round, even lotus roots (for soups, braises, and stews, choose roots with 7 holes; for stir-fries and salads, choose those with 9 holes). Peel the outer skin and immediately soak the lotus root in water mixed with vinegar for about 10 minutes to prevent browning. Then, rinse with cold water to keep them white and crunchy. Cut into bite-sized cubes.
Wash the horn chili and green onions. Julienne the chili and cut the green onions into segments.
Braise the ribs with lotus root:
Heat 1 tbsp of cooking oil and add 3 tbsp of sugar. Cook until the sugar turns a deep amber color, then add the ribs and toss to coat for color.

Add enough water to just cover the ribs, then add the lotus root. Season to taste and braise over low heat for about 20 minutes until the liquid has mostly reduced. Add 1 tbsp of chili sauce and stir until the sauce thickens, then turn off the heat. Transfer to a plate, sprinkle with pepper, and serve hot with rice.

Seaweed and tofu soup is a light, refreshing dish that is highly popular in Korea. This soup is not only delicious but also nourishing and detoxifying, especially for those experiencing physical weakness. With easy-to-find, affordable, and nutritious ingredients, seaweed and tofu soup is an excellent choice to refresh your family menu. Let's explore how to cook this soup simply and without any fishy smell!
I. How to cook seaweed and tofu soup without a fishy smell
1. Ingredients
50g dried seaweed
Silken tofu – 200g
Shrimp heads – 10 pieces
Green onions – 3 stalks
A pinch of salt, sugar, and MSG
2. Cooking steps for delicious seaweed and tofu soup
2.1. Preparation
Seaweed:
Place the dried seaweed in a bowl with 1 liter of clean water and soak for 15–20 minutes until expanded.
Then, rinse the seaweed with clean water 2–3 times and drain in a colander.
Shrimp heads:
Trim the whiskers from the shrimp heads, remove the internal waste, and wash thoroughly.
Silken tofu:
Cut the tofu into bite-sized pieces.
Green onions:
Peel the outer layer of the green onions, remove the roots, and wash thoroughly.
Cut off the white parts and thinly slice the rest.
Cooking the soup:
Boil about 1 liter of water in a pot over high heat for 5 minutes. Once boiling, add the shrimp heads and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes.
When the shrimp heads turn from gray to deep orange, add the silken tofu and stir gently. Wait 5–7 minutes for the tofu and shrimp heads to cook through.
Season the soup with 2 tsp MSG, 2 tsp sugar, and 1/2 tsp salt.
When the soup returns to a boil, add the seaweed and cook over medium heat for another 3–5 minutes until cooked. Taste and adjust seasoning to your preference, then turn off the heat.
Ladle the soup into a bowl and garnish with chopped green onions. The seaweed and tofu soup is ready.
2.2. Finished dish
The delicious and light silken tofu seaweed soup is now complete. When enjoying it, you will taste the subtle sweetness of the broth, the aroma of the seaweed, and the soft texture of the tofu.
This soup pairs perfectly with hot steamed rice!
II. How to cook seaweed and tofu soup with vegetables
Dried seaweed (soup variety) – 1 tbsp,
Silken tofu – 300g,
Pork – 300g,
Carrot – 1/2 piece,
Corn – 1/2 ear,
Ginger – 1 piece,
Soy sauce – 1 tbsp,
Salt/MSG – a pinch.
2. Cooking steps for seaweed and tofu soup with vegetables
Place 1 tbsp of dried seaweed in a bowl of filtered water to soak until expanded.
To remove the fishy smell and sliminess of the seaweed, add 1/2 piece of crushed ginger and a pinch of salt to the soaking water.
Cut the silken tofu into bite-sized pieces; you can cut them slightly thick to prevent them from breaking during cooking.
Peel the carrot, wash, and dice into small cubes.
Shuck the corn, remove the silk, and shave off the kernels.
Wash the pork and blanch it briefly in boiling water to remove impurities.
Note: When preparing, avoid shaking the seaweed vigorously to prevent it from breaking apart.
2.2. Simmering the broth
Next, proceed with the following cooking steps.
Place a pot on the stove and add about 500ml of filtered water. Bring to a boil.
Add the pork to the pot along with 1/2 piece of crushed ginger and 1 tsp salt.
Simmer the pork over low to medium heat for about 25–30 minutes.
While simmering, remember to skim the foam to keep the broth clear.
Once the pork is cooked, remove it and slice it thinly to add back to the soup or serve as boiled pork.
You can now use this pork broth to finish the soup or for other dishes as needed.
2.3. Cooking the seaweed soup
Add the corn and carrots to the pot of broth, lower the heat, and cook for 5–7 minutes until the vegetables are tender.
Next, add the soaked seaweed and silken tofu to the pot, then season with 1 tbsp soy sauce, a pinch of salt, and a pinch of MSG.
Lower the heat and cook for another 3–4 minutes so all ingredients absorb the flavors.
Once the soup is finished, adjust the seasoning to your family's taste, then turn off the heat.
2.4. Finished dish

Silken tofu seaweed soup combined with vegetables creates an attractive blend of colors. The sweet broth from the vegetables harmonizes with the fresh aroma of the seaweed and the creamy, nutritious silken tofu. This soup is not only visually appealing but also offers a wonderful culinary experience.
III. How to choose good seaweed
1. How to choose high-quality seaweed
Choose seaweed with a deep green color, as this indicates it is fresh and free of preservatives.
Look for seaweed leaves with many small holes on the surface, as this is young seaweed which has a better flavor.
Additionally, prioritize buying seaweed with a clear origin and a valid expiration date.
Avoid buying seaweed that is dark purple or past its expiration date.
2. How to choose fresh, high-quality tofu
Prioritize choosing tofu pieces that are ivory white. If the tofu is yellow or shows signs of yellowing, avoid it as it may contain gypsum. The yellower the tofu, the more likely it contains gypsum.
Choose tofu that feels light and soft to the touch. Pure tofu has a characteristic aroma, while tofu containing gypsum may smell like lime or have no scent at all.
If the tofu feels heavy, firm, and has a very rigid square shape, avoid buying it as it may contain a lot of gypsum.
By applying these principles, you will be able to select fresh, delicious, and high-quality seaweed and tofu.
IV. Tips for cooking seaweed and tofu soup without a fishy smell
Soak seaweed for the right amount of time: Before use, soak seaweed in water for 5–10 minutes until expanded and soft. This helps remove the fishy smell and softens the greens.
Wash seaweed thoroughly: Before use, rinse seaweed under cold water to remove any dirt or residue that could cause bitterness or a fishy smell.

Cook tofu first, then add seaweed: To keep the tofu flavorful and prevent a fishy smell, cook the tofu before adding the seaweed. Then, in the final stage, add the seaweed to the pot and cook briefly to maintain its fresh flavor.
Do not overcook: Seaweed cooked for too long can become mushy and lose its fresh flavor. Cook the seaweed briefly, only until it retains its crunch and bright color.

Use seasonings wisely: You can add seasonings like salt, sugar, fish sauce, soy sauce, or seasoning powder to enhance the flavor. However, remember to use them sparingly so as not to overpower the pure taste of the seaweed and tofu.
Enjoy promptly: Seaweed and tofu are best when freshly cooked. Enjoy the dish while it is still hot to appreciate the fresh flavor and the crunch of the seaweed and tofu.

mon_an.mo_ta: Sweet and sour ribs are always a favorite for children and the whole family. The thick, savory sauce clinging to tender, juicy ribs is sure to stimulate everyone's taste buds. Have you mastered the recipe for this dish yet? Refer to the sweet and sour ribs recipe below.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Sugar, salt, pepper, garlic, soy sauce, vinegar, seasoning powder, tapioca starch - seasonings
cac_buoc: Preparation
Separate the egg and keep the white.
Cut the ribs into bite-sized pieces.
Marinate the ribs with 1 tbsp sugar, ½ tsp salt, ½ tsp seasoning powder, soy sauce, pepper, and minced shallots for about 10 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Mix with the egg white and coat the outside with tapioca starch.
Cooking steps
Step 1: Heat cooking oil in a pan, stir-fry the bell peppers and onions over high heat. Toss quickly until just tender, then remove to a plate.
Step 2: Heat oil in the pan, fry the ribs until golden brown, then remove and drain well.
Step 3: Prepare the sauce: mix ½ tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tbsp sugar, ½ tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp seasoning powder, ½ cup water, and 1 tbsp ketchup; stir well. You can add minced chili if desired.
Step 4: Sauté the garlic until fragrant, add the ribs and the sauce. Cook over medium heat, stirring well at first, then simmer on low heat for 10 minutes to let the flavors absorb.
Add the stir-fried onions and bell peppers, then season to taste.
Finally, transfer the ribs to a plate and garnish with herbs.
Notes
Choose spare ribs with plenty of meat and cartilage.
The sauce can be adjusted to your taste, but should maintain a balance of salty, sour, and mild sweet flavors.
Simmering the sauce until it is thick and glossy will make the dish more appealing.

mon_an.ten: Braised Pork Ribs with Star Fruit
mon_an.mo_ta: You are likely very familiar with sweet and sour stir-fried ribs and their harmonious flavors. Today, we suggest a way to refresh your family's dinner menu with a tangy and spicy rib dish: braised pork ribs with star fruit. Let's check out how to cook these hot, appetizing braised ribs for a cold, rainy day.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Bird's eye chilies - 2 (adjust to desired spiciness)
Seasonings - as needed (sugar, fish sauce, soy sauce, salt, cashew oil)
cac_buoc: Preparation
Wash the star fruits and slice into 3mm thick rounds. Slice the long chili. Mince the bird's eye chilies, shallot, garlic, and lemongrass. Cut the green onions into segments.
Cut the ribs into bite-sized pieces, blanch in boiling water to remove impurities, then rinse clean.

Marinate the ribs with pepper, 1/3 of the minced shallot, garlic, and lemongrass mixture, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp fish sauce, 1/2 tsp soy sauce, and cashew oil (if using). Let sit for 15 minutes to absorb the flavors.

Make the caramel sauce: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a pan, add 3 tbsp sugar, and cook until the sugar turns amber. Add a little water and stir until completely dissolved to make the caramel sauce. Pour into a separate bowl.
Braising the ribs

Heat the pan, add 2 tbsp oil, and sauté the shallot, garlic, lemongrass, and bird's eye chilies until fragrant. Add the ribs and stir-fry until firm. Add the coconut water, caramel sauce, 1/2 tbsp fish sauce, and 1/2 tbsp soy sauce. Cover and braise over low heat for about 20 minutes until the ribs are tender.

Add the sour star fruit and sliced long chili. Braise for another 10 minutes until the ribs and star fruit absorb the seasonings, the star fruit is soft, and the sauce thickens. Sprinkle with green onions and crushed white pepper, then turn off the heat. Transfer to a plate and serve hot with rice.

The braised ribs with star fruit are now ready to be served. The final dish should feature tender, fragrant, and well-seasoned ribs. The star fruit should be soft with its tartness infused into the meat. The sauce should be a glossy amber color, beautifully coating the ribs and star fruit.

mon_an.ten: Refreshing Telosma Cordata Soup for Summer
mon_an.mo_ta: On a hot summer day, nothing beats a bowl of Telosma cordata soup. It helps cool your body down better than spicy or fried foods. Let's make this treat for the whole family!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Separate the flowers into small clusters, blanch briefly in boiling water, and drain.
Step 2:
Bring the stock to a boil, then season with seasoning powder and sugar. Add cornstarch dissolved in water to thicken the soup.
Step 3:
Whisk the eggs and drizzle them into the pot to create ribbons. Add the sliced crab sticks and Telosma cordata flowers.
Step 4:
Sprinkle with pepper and add a dash of sesame oil before serving.
Cook quickly to keep the flowers crunchy.

mon_an.mo_ta: Braised shrimp with Thai basil is a delicious, aromatic dish featuring savory-sweet shrimp, the heat of bird's eye chilies, and a thick, flavorful sauce that is perfect over white rice. On a cold day, gathering with family to enjoy this dish is wonderful. Let's get cooking!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings - As needed (pepper, salt, sugar, soy sauce, chili sauce, caramel sauce)
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients
Wash the basil and shred it. Crush the shallot and garlic. Wash and mince the chilies.
Peel the prawns and remove the heads (keep the tails), then devein along the back. Marinate the prawns with a little pepper, half of the shallots, garlic, Thai basil, and salt for about 15 minutes.
Roast the peanuts and remove the skins.
Braising the shrimp

Heat annatto oil in a pan, sauté the crushed shallots and garlic until fragrant, then add the prawns and stir-fry until firm. Add caramel sauce, soy sauce, chili sauce, and a little water. Simmer until the prawns are firm and well-seasoned, and the sauce has thickened. Add the remaining Thai basil, toss well, and turn off the heat.
Presentation
Transfer the shrimp to a plate, sprinkle with roasted peanuts, and serve hot with white rice.

mon_an.mo_ta: Learn how to make delicious sweet and sour shrimp with tomato sauce. This dish has an eye-catching color and a rich, savory flavor that goes perfectly with rice. The sweet and sour tomato sauce coats the shrimp, softening the shells and making them delicious while providing calcium. Give it a try!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Cornstarch - Optional (if a thicker sauce is desired)
cac_buoc: Wash the shrimp, trim the whiskers and the sharp point on the head. Keep the shells on and use a toothpick to remove the black vein from the back. Marinate the shrimp with 1/2 tsp salt, 1 tbsp white wine, and half of the crushed shallots and ginger for 15 minutes.
In a bowl, mix the sugar, tomato sauce, and vinegar. Heat cooking oil in a pan, then add the shrimp and stir-fry until cooked.
When the shrimp turn red, push them to one side of the pan. Add the remaining crushed and minced shallots and ginger, sauté until fragrant, then toss everything together.

Pour in the prepared sauce and stir well. Simmer over low heat for a few minutes, stirring so the shrimp absorb the flavors. Increase the heat and cook until the sauce reduces and thickens. Sprinkle with chopped green onions and turn off the heat. Serve hot with white rice.
Here is the finished dish on the plate.
Sharing some tips for delicious stir-fried shrimp:

Choose fresh shrimp. If using farmed shrimp, squeeze out the waste from the head, not just the vein on the back. Some sea shrimp may contain parasites (flat and round, about 1cm in diameter, living under the shell on the sides of the head); missing just one can make the whole dish smell fishy. Prepare them carefully for the best aroma!

How to remove the shrimp vein: Bend the head down slightly and use a toothpick to hook the vein at the junction of the head and body, then pull it out. If the vein breaks, insert the toothpick into the back to pull out the rest. If you are not used to this, use scissors to snip along the back shell to make it easier.
Stir-fry the shrimp until the meat is firm before adding the sauce.

mon_an.mo_ta: Revealing the secret recipe for a fragrant and delicious beef marinade. This soft, aromatic, and rich grilled beef is perfect for family gatherings. You can also use this recipe to upgrade your weekend grilled skewers.
cac_buoc: 1. Make the marinade
Place all marinade ingredients into a blender and blend until smooth. You now have a quick and simple BBQ sauce.
2. Prepare the ingredients:
Wash the beef and cut into 3cm cubes, about 1cm thick. Wash the zucchini, bell pepper, and onion, then cut them into pieces similar in size to the beef.
3. Marinate the beef
Pour the marinade over the beef and let it sit for at least 2 hours for the best flavor. Marinate the vegetables only 30 minutes before grilling to prevent them from becoming mushy.
Thread the beef and vegetables onto skewers. Let them sit for 15 minutes to drain.

Light the charcoal until glowing, then place the skewers on the grill. Grill until the meat is tender and golden brown on the outside. Once the vegetables are also charred and cooked, remove from the grill.
Honey BBQ Beef Marinade
Step 1: Prepare ingredients and seasonings for delicious BBQ beef.
Servings for 4 people:
Beef: 1kg
Garlic: 3 cloves
Fresh chilies: 2
White sesame seeds: 50g
Seasoning powder: 1 tbsp
Gungon Traditional BBQ Sauce: 5 tbsp
Honey: 2 tbsp
Sesame oil: 2 tbsp
Pepper: 2 tsp
Five-spice powder: 1 tsp
Step 2: Prepare the ingredients
Wash the beef and pat dry. Place the beef in the freezer for 15 minutes to make it easier to slice.
After 15 minutes, take the beef out and slice into bite-sized pieces.
Wash and mince the garlic and chilies.
Toast the white sesame seeds in a pan until fragrant.
Note: Use low heat when toasting sesame seeds and check frequently to avoid burning.
Step 3: Marinate the BBQ beef.
Mix the minced garlic and chilies, 1 tbsp seasoning powder, 5 tbsp traditional BBQ sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp sesame oil, 2 tsp pepper, 1 tsp five-spice powder, and 50g toasted sesame seeds.
Toss well, cover with plastic wrap, and place in the refrigerator.
Marinate for about 30 minutes so the spices penetrate before grilling.
Satay Beef Marinade Recipe
Step 1: Prepare ingredients and seasonings (serves 4).
Lemongrass: 3 stalks
Coriander: 20g
Cooking oil: 1 tbsp
Soy sauce: 1 tsp
Satay sauce: 4 tbsp
1/2 tbsp fish sauce
Step 2: Prepare the ingredients.
Wash the beef and pat dry. Place in the freezer for 15 minutes for easier slicing.
After 15 minutes, slice the beef into bite-sized pieces.
Wash and mince the garlic, chilies, and lemongrass.
Wash and chop the coriander.
Step 3: Marinating method for grilled beef.
Marinate the beef with 1 tbsp seasoning powder, 1 tbsp soy sauce, and 1/2 tbsp fish sauce.
Mix well, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Heat a pan on the stove. Add 1 tbsp cooking oil and sauté the minced lemongrass, garlic, and chilies until golden and fragrant.
Once fragrant, add the chopped coriander and 4 tbsp satay sauce to the pan. Stir well and turn off the heat.
Let the mixture cool slightly, then use it to marinate the seasoned beef.
Mix well so the beef absorbs the mixture, then proceed to grill.
Choosing good beef is a crucial step before marinating to ensure the best flavor.
Soy Sauce Beef Marinade
Beef: 1 kg
White sesame seeds: 50g
3 cloves garlic
3 shallots
2 fresh chilies
2 tbsp sesame oil
2 tbsp oyster sauce
1/2 tbsp sugar
1 tsp seasoning powder
1 tbsp soy sauce
2 tsp ground pepper
1/3 tsp five-spice powder
Wash the beef and pat dry. Place in the freezer for 15 minutes (this helps with slicing and creates a better texture).
Wash and mince the garlic, shallots, and chilies.
Toast the white sesame seeds in a pan until fragrant. Note: Sesame seeds burn easily, so use low heat and check often.
Step 3: Marinate the beef.

Marinate the beef with minced shallots, garlic, chilies, 2 tbsp sesame oil, 2 tbsp oyster sauce, 1/2 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp seasoning powder, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tsp ground pepper, 1/3 tsp five-spice powder, and toasted sesame seeds.
Mix well, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate.
Marinate for about 30 minutes before grilling.

Here is the finished grilled meat. People often alternate meat and vegetables on the same skewer, but since they have different cooking times (meat takes longer), I prefer to skewer them separately. Grill until just cooked and golden on all sides. When serving, remove from skewers and arrange on a plate together.
Grilling over charcoal is the tastiest, though it can be a bit of a hassle and not everyone has the space for it. If you can't use charcoal, you can use a portable burner, infrared grill, or an oven.
How to choose fresh beef
Select soft cuts with plenty of marbling (fat veins) and minimal large fat chunks or gristle. Gristle and large fat cook unevenly. Soft meat with fine marbling results in a tender dish.
Prioritize tenderloin, rump, or shoulder cuts as they are lean and easy to slice into grains. These are ideal for grilling.
Choose fresh beef over frozen. Long-term frozen meat can affect the flavor.
Look for bright red meat. Avoid dark brown pieces, as they may be old and unsafe.
Press the meat with your finger to check elasticity. If it doesn't spring back or leaves a dent, the meat may be spoiled.

mon_an.ten: Authentic Stir-Fried Choy Sum with Beef
mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried choy sum with beef is a very easy dish, commonly served in daily family meals. Let's make it! A special highlight of Vietnamese culinary culture, this dish harmoniously combines fresh choy sum with savory beef, providing both rich flavor and essential nutrients. Follow the guide below for an authentic taste.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Cooking wine with ginger slices - 1 tbsp
Green onions, soy sauce, oyster sauce for stir-frying
Garlic, thinly sliced and minced - 1 bulb
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Pick the choy sum leaves, wash thoroughly, and cut into sections about 3 finger-lengths long. Peel, wash, and mince the garlic.
Wash the beef. To remove the gamey odor, rub the meat with a crushed ginger knob for about 2 minutes.

Rinse the beef with diluted salt water, then rinse again with clean water. Marinate the beef with minced garlic, 1/2 tbsp seasoning powder, 1/2 tbsp oyster sauce, and 1/2 tsp MSG; let it sit for 30 minutes.
Step 2: Cooking
Heat a pan and add 1 tbsp cooking oil. Once hot, add the marinated beef and stir-fry over high heat for about 2 minutes until seared and firm. Remove the beef and set aside in a bowl.
Next, add the choy sum to the same pan and stir-fry for about 2 minutes.
Finally, return the beef to the pan and stir-fry with the choy sum for another 1 minute. Adjust the seasoning to taste and turn off the heat.

To serve, arrange the dish on a plate and sprinkle with a bit of ground pepper to enhance the aroma. Stir-fried beef with choy sum is simple and quick yet very appealing. The beef is tender and sweet, the greens are crunchy, and the seasoning is perfectly balanced. This dish pairs wonderfully with white rice.
Tips to remove beef odor:
Method 1: Grill a knob of ginger, scrape off the charred skin, then crush it and rub it over the beef. Let it sit for 3 minutes before rinsing with clean water.
Method 2: You can also use vinegar or white wine to briefly rinse the beef. This effectively cleans and deodorizes the meat.
Using these methods, you can ensure your beef is clean and odor-free.

mon_an.ten: Stir-fried Bok Choy with Shiitake Mushrooms in Oyster Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried bok choy with shiitake mushrooms – simple, easy to make, and refreshing for hot summer days. Check out this guide on how to make delicious stir-fried bok choy with shiitake mushrooms in oyster sauce. We hope this recipe helps you prepare a wonderful dish for your family. Enjoy the cooking process! Learn how to make this tasty vegetable stir-fry.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the baby corn, remove all silk, and cut either horizontally or vertically. Wash the shiitake mushrooms, remove the stems, soak in diluted salt water, then drain and cut in half. Cut the bok choy into sections, keeping the stems and leaves separate.
Step 2: Heat oil in a pan. Once the oil is hot, sauté the minced garlic and ginger until fragrant.

Step 3: Add the shiitake mushrooms to the pan first, followed by the bok choy stems, then the baby corn. Stir-fry well. Next, add the bok choy leaves along with the sesame oil and oyster sauce. Season to taste.
Step 4: Cover the pan for about 2 minutes, then turn off the heat. Transfer to a plate and enjoy.

mon_an.mo_ta: Sweet and sour spinach salad – healthy and delicious. Let's learn how to make this dish through the following guide!
cac_buoc: To make a delicious sweet and sour spinach salad, choose fresh, green spinach to retain all nutrients. Miso paste and Korean chili paste can be purchased at Korean grocery stores.
Step 1:
Trim the spinach roots and wash thoroughly with cold water, handling gently to avoid bruising the leaves.
Blanch the spinach in boiling water with a pinch of salt for 1 minute to keep it green and remove impurities.
Step 2: Remove the spinach and rinse immediately with cold water. This helps the vegetable stay green and crunchy after blanching.
Step 3:
Gently squeeze the spinach by hand to remove excess water.
Place the spinach in a bowl and loosen the leaves so they are not tangled.
Step 4: Add the miso paste, chili paste, sautéed minced garlic, sesame oil, and toasted sesame seeds to the bowl.
Step 5: Wear disposable gloves and mix the seasonings thoroughly with the spinach. Let it sit for about 15 minutes, and it will be ready for dinner.

mon_an.ten: Stir-fried Bok Choy with Shiitake Mushrooms
mon_an.mo_ta: During these hot summer days, stir-fried bok choy with shiitake mushrooms is an excellent choice with its refreshing flavor. The combination of sweet bok choy, the characteristic aroma of shiitake mushrooms, and oyster sauce will surely impress any diner. Let's cook this fragrant and attractive dish for dinner: Discover stir-fried bok choy and shiitake mushrooms - a nutritious and healthy dish.
cac_buoc: First, trim the roots of the bok choy and place them in a basin of clean water to thoroughly wash each leaf. Dirt often hides in the base of the leaves, so wash them carefully.
After washing, let them drain.
Next, prepare the shiitake mushrooms. Remove the stems and cut into pieces or thick slices as desired. Also, prepare minced garlic, ginger, and chili for later use.
Bring a pot of water to a boil, adding a little salt and vegetable oil. Blanch the shiitake mushrooms in the boiling water for about 2 minutes.
Blanching the mushrooms helps remove any musty smell and prepares them for the next cooking steps. After blanching, remove and drain.

In a hot pan, pour in a little vegetable oil. First, sauté the garlic and red chili until fragrant, then add the bok choy and stir-fry for about 1 minute until bright green. Once the vegetables have softened slightly, add salt to taste and continue stir-frying until the salt dissolves and coats the vegetables. Then, remove the vegetables from the pan.
In the same pan, add a little more vegetable oil and sauté the minced ginger and garlic. Then, add the sliced shiitake mushrooms and stir-fry over low heat until fragrant.
To the pan, add 1g soy sauce, 2g cooking wine, 3g fish sauce, and 5g oyster sauce. Stir-fry until the seasonings dissolve, then toss the mushrooms to coat them evenly.
Next, pour a little water into the pan, switch to low heat, and simmer for 2 minutes, ensuring they are fully cooked to bring out the umami flavor of the shiitake mushrooms.
Arrange the stir-fried bok choy on a plate, then place the sautéed mushrooms in the center. You will have a beautiful and delicious dish of stir-fried bok choy with shiitake mushrooms.
The final result features crunchy green vegetables combined with smooth, soft, and fragrant mushrooms.
This is a wonderful nutritious dish that offers excellent flavor and will surely be loved by the whole family.
Notes for making Stir-fried Bok Choy with Shiitake Mushrooms:
This is a delicious and easy dish to make. Here are some important notes:
Clean the bok choy: Trim the roots and wash each leaf carefully. Dirt often sticks to the base, so be thorough.
Blanch the mushrooms: Before stir-frying, blanch the shiitake mushrooms in boiling water for 2 minutes. This removes odors and helps them absorb seasonings. Drain well afterward.
Sauté aromatics: Sauté garlic and red chili in a hot pan until fragrant. Add the bok choy and stir-fry for 1 minute until bright. Ensure the greens soften slightly before adding salt.
Stir-fry mushrooms: In the same pan, sauté minced ginger and garlic. Add the blanched mushrooms and stir-fry over low heat until fragrant.
Simmer with seasonings: Add soy sauce, cooking wine, fish sauce, and oyster sauce. Stir until dissolved. Add a little water and simmer for 2 minutes to fully cook and develop the umami flavor.
Presentation: Arrange the greens on a plate and place the mushrooms in the center for a beautiful look.
Following these notes will help you create an attractive and easy home-cooked meal.

mon_an.mo_ta: Quick beef shank and starfruit soup to make your meal more enjoyable. With a simple cooking method and easy-to-find ingredients, your whole family can enjoy a hot and delicious bowl of soup.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the sour starfruit, trim the edges, and slice. Clean the green onions and Vietnamese coriander, removing old leaves and roots, then chop finely.
Step 2: Wash the beef shank and slice thinly. Place the beef in a pot and boil for about 5 minutes; remember to skim off the foam as it boils.

Step 3: Next, add the sour starfruit to the pot, season with 1 tsp of salt, and simmer until the beef is tender. Once the beef is soft, add a little seasoning powder, simmer for another 3 minutes, then turn off the heat and add the green onions and Vietnamese coriander. Ladle into bowls and serve hot.
The quick beef shank and starfruit soup is now complete.

mon_an.mo_ta: Zucchini shrimp rolls soup – a delicious daily dish that provides plenty of nutrients for the whole family. Here is how to make it.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel 2 carrots and wash them. Carve flowers from one carrot and slice into rounds, reserving a small piece to finely dice.

Step 2: Marinate the raw ham paste with 1 tsp seasoning powder and 1/2 tsp pepper. Add the diced carrots and mix well. Next, wash and soak the shiitake mushrooms until soft, then remove the stems. Stuff the ham mixture into the mushroom caps.
Step 3: Clean the shrimp, peel them while leaving the tails intact, and marinate with 1/2 tsp pepper. Slice the zucchini into thin strips. You can keep the skin on for a more attractive look.

Step 4: Peel the remaining carrot and cut into rectangular sticks slightly longer than the width of the zucchini strips. Lay a zucchini strip flat, place a shrimp and a carrot stick on top, then roll it up and secure with a toothpick. Blanch the chives in boiling water. Tie a chive leaf around each roll, then remove the toothpick.

Step 5: Place a pot on the stove, bring water to a boil, then add the stuffed mushrooms, shrimp rolls, and sliced carrots. Season to taste, bring back to a boil, turn off the heat, and sprinkle with ground pepper. Serve the soup hot.
Source: Kenh14

mon_an.mo_ta: Pumpkin and pork soup – especially attractive with the sweetness of pumpkin, shrimp, and pork, making it an easy-to-eat and nutritious soup for the family. Learn how to make this delicious soup.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel the pumpkin, remove the seeds, and cut into bite-sized pieces. Peel and devein the shrimp, then wash thoroughly.
Step 2: Coarsely crush the shrimp in a mortar; ensure the pork is finely ground. Peel and crush the garlic.
Step 3: Place a pot over heat, add 2 tbsp of oil and sauté the garlic until fragrant. Add the shrimp and pork, stir-frying briefly with a pinch of salt so the soup isn't bland.

Step 4: Add the pumpkin next, along with some salt, and stir-fry briefly so the pumpkin absorbs the seasoning. Pour in enough water to cover the pumpkin and bring to a boil. Lower the heat and season to taste.
Step 5: Wash and finely chop the green onions. Once the pumpkin is tender and soft, add the green onions, turn off the heat, and ladle the soup into a bowl. Serve with rice.
Source: Kenh14

mon_an.mo_ta: Winter melon and shrimp soup – simple, quick, and extremely delicious. Learn how to cook this refreshing soup.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning powder, fish sauce, green onions, cilantro
cac_buoc: Step 1: Remove shrimp heads, peel, and devein. Wash thoroughly and drain. Wash and finely chop the green onions and cilantro.
Step 2: Peel the winter melon, cut in half, remove the core, and slice into 1cm thick pieces. This thickness ensures the melon stays sweet and doesn't get too mushy when cooked.

Step 3: Place a pot on the stove, add a little oil and the winter melon. Add a pinch of salt and seasoning powder to stir-fry the melon and shrimp for better flavor. After stir-frying for about 5 minutes, pour in the bone broth and bring to a boil. Season to taste. Once boiling, cook for another 2 minutes, then turn off the heat and add the green onions and cilantro.

mon_an.ten: Winter Melon Soup with Shrimp and Pork
mon_an.mo_ta: Winter melon soup with shrimp and pork – delicious and beautiful for an enhanced meal. Learn how to cook this tasty soup.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Raw ham paste or ground pork - 100g
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the dried shrimp, soak until soft, then chop or mince. Mix the shrimp with the ham paste or ground pork, seasoning with a bit of salt, seasoning powder, and minced shallots. Bring a pot of water to a boil and add the meat mixture formed into small balls.
Step 2: Slice the winter melon into sections or rounds as desired for the soup.
Step 3: Peel and slice the carrot into rounds. When the meat is cooked, add the carrots. Once the carrots are soft, season the soup with 1/2 tbsp salt, a pinch of sugar, and 1/2 tsp seasoning powder.

Step 4: Season to taste, then add the winter melon. Since winter melon is naturally sweet, do not add too much sugar. Watch closely as winter melon cooks very quickly; let it boil for 1-2 minutes then turn off the heat. Serve hot with rice.
Source: Ngoi sao

mon_an.ten: Nutritious Garland Chrysanthemum Soup with Ground Pork
mon_an.mo_ta: Garland chrysanthemum soup with ground pork is both simple and delicious, saving a lot of time for home cooks. Check out how to cook this soup below!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Wash the garland chrysanthemum and leave the stalks whole, or cut in half if they are too long.
Pork: Mince or grind the pork, then marinate with 1/4 tsp salt and 1/4 tsp seasoning powder for about 10 minutes.
Finely julienne the fresh ginger.
Crush and mince the shallot.
Step 2:
Measure the amount of water needed for your family into a bowl, then pour it into a pot and bring to a boil.
Step 3:

Place a pot on the stove, add 2 tsp of cooking oil and heat it up. Sauté the shallot until fragrant, add the pork and stir quickly. After 1 minute, pour in the boiling water and season with 1/2 tsp salt and 1/2 tsp seasoning powder to taste. When the water returns to a boil (keep the heat high), add the garland chrysanthemum, then remove from heat and serve in a bowl.

mon_an.ten: Refreshing Watercress Soup with Ground Pork
mon_an.mo_ta: Watercress soup with ground pork – a delicious and cooling soup for summer days. Refer to the recipe below! Learn how to cook this refreshing soup.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Clean the watercress. Depending on your family's preference, you can chop it small or leave the stalks whole. Wash the watercress twice, then soak in diluted salt water for about 15 minutes before draining.
Step 2: Peel and finely slice the shallot. Sauté it in a soup pot until fragrant, then add the ground pork and stir-fry with a pinch of salt.
Step 3: Add the watercress once the pork is cooked through. At this point, add more salt so the vegetables in the soup are well-seasoned.
Step 4: Stir-fry the vegetables for about 5 minutes, then add water to the pot. Season to taste and wait for the soup to boil before serving.
Quick tip: You can use meatballs or ground shrimp instead of pork to make this soup even more appealing.

mon_an.ten: Vietnamese Sour Fish Soup (Canh Chua Cá)
mon_an.mo_ta: Canh chua cá is a traditional, flavorful, and enticing dish loved by many. In this article, we will guide you on how to cook a delicious and easy sour fish soup at home. Through detailed steps, you will create a fragrant pot of soup with a clear sour taste, spicy kick, and attractive colors. Let's explore how to cook this special dish! A guide to making delicious sour fish soup at home, detailing ingredient preparation and how to balance the clear sour and spicy flavors.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fish - 500g (Red tilapia, carp, or snakehead are recommended. You can use the whole fish, the head and tail, or fish steaks)
Tamarind - 2 fruits (can be replaced with 4-5 dracontomelon fruits or 1 grilled and peeled garcinia multiflora)
Seasonings - Fish sauce, salt, pepper, broth mix, chili to taste
cac_buoc: 1. Prepare the ingredients

Clean the fish by removing the innards and scales, then cut into chunks. Rub gently with grain salt, lemon, or white wine to remove the fishy odor. Marinate the fish with fish sauce, broth mix, and minced garlic for 10 minutes to allow the flavors to penetrate.

Peel and mince the ginger. Halve the chilies, remove seeds, wash, and slice thinly. Pick and wash the green onions and dill, then chop finely. Peel the pineapple, remove the eyes, and slice into small pieces. Soak the tamarind in hot water, mash, and strain to get the tamarind juice. Wash the tomatoes and cut into wedges. Wash the okra and slice diagonally.
2. Cook the sour fish soup

1. Turn on the stove and place a pan over the heat. Add a little cooking oil and heat it up. Sauté the garlic over medium-low heat until golden, then remove and set aside. Next, add the fish to the pan and lightly sear both sides so the meat stays firm and doesn't smell fishy when cooked. Remove the fish and set aside in a bowl.

2. Add a bit more oil to the pan, sauté the shallots, then add half of the tomatoes to create color. Add the pineapple to the pan and stir-fry together, seasoning with 1/2 tsp salt for about 3-5 minutes.

3. Pour 1-1.2 liters of filtered water and the tamarind juice into a pot, then bring to a boil. When the water is warm and starts to bubble, add the fish. Season with 2 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp sugar, and 1/2 tsp salt. When the water boils, lower the heat and skim off the foam with a spoon.

4. After 5 minutes, once the fish is cooked, add the remaining tomatoes and the sautéed pineapple-tomato mixture into the pot and continue cooking. A few minutes later, add the okra and cook for 2 minutes, then add the bean sprouts, 1/2 tbsp fish sauce, and 1 tsp broth mix.
5. Before turning off the heat, add the chopped green onions and dill to the pot and adjust the seasoning to suit your taste.
Notes for a more flavorful sour fish soup
Select fresh fish with firm meat and clear, bright eyes. Fresh fish ensures the deliciousness of the dish and food safety.
You can choose freshwater fish like snakehead, salmon, red tilapia, carp, basa, catfish, or sturgeon; or saltwater fish like stingray, cobia, or mackerel for this soup.
Cook the fish only until just done. Avoid overcooking as the meat will become mushy and lose its firmness.
During cooking, skim off the foam rising to the surface to keep the broth clear.
The soup should have a clear sweet and light sour taste, with white, tender fish meat that isn't mushy. It should be free of fishy odors or clashing spices for a pleasant dining experience.
Sour fish soup is a nutritious dish for daily family meals, especially on hot days. Enjoy it with raw vegetables and rice vermicelli to enhance the flavor.

mon_an.mo_ta: Sour soups are always a favorite because they are very easy to eat. To add to your repertoire of easy-to-make delicious dishes, today we will guide you through making sour clam soup—a dish with a fragrant, mild sour taste that doesn't take much time to prepare! Cooking Northern-style sour clam soup is not just about making a traditional dish, but also a journey to discover the unique culinary culture of this region. By harmonizing the sour, sweet, and aromatic components, this soup will captivate anyone with its rich, fresh, and authentic Northern flavor.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Dracontomelon (Sấu) - 2 fruits (or a bit of tamarind pulp) if you prefer it more sour
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients
After buying the clams, clean them thoroughly as previously instructed.
Remove tomato stems, wash, cut into wedges, and remove seeds.
Wash the starfruit, remove the stems and edges, then slice into bite-sized pieces.
Clean the dill, wash, and cut into 3-4cm lengths.
Peel the shallots, wash, and mince finely.
How to cook clam soup with tomatoes and dill
Place the cleaned clams in a pot to boil until they open. Remove the clam meat from the shells. Strain the boiling liquid to get a clear broth.
Place a pan on the stove, add a little oil, and sauté the minced shallots. Add the clam meat and stir-fry briefly, seasoning with a little ground pepper and MSG.

In a pot, sauté shallots until fragrant, then add the tomato wedges and stir-fry until slightly softened. Add the starfruit and sauté briefly. Pour the clear clam broth into the pot and bring to a boil.
When the broth boils, add the sautéed clam meat, season to taste, and stir gently. Once it boils again, turn off the heat and scatter the chopped dill over the soup.

The clam soup with tomatoes and dill is complete, offering an attractive clear sweet and sour flavor. This dish is simple, easy to make at home, and suitable for both hot summer days and chilly winters.
How to choose fresh clams
When buying clams, choose those with hard shells that are tightly closed, have no foul odor, and feel heavy in your hand. These characteristics indicate freshness.
If you see clams with open mouths that close quickly when touched, they are still alive and should be selected.
To clean clams quickly, you can use these methods:
Soak clams in a mixture of diluted salt water and a few red chili slices for 1-2 hours.
Soak clams in a bowl of water with 1 tbsp sesame oil and 1 tbsp fine salt for 2 hours.
Soak clams in a mixture of 3 tbsp rice vinegar diluted in water for 40 minutes.

A simpler way is to wash the clams multiple times after purchase. Place them in a bag and keep them in the refrigerator's cool compartment for about half an hour; the clams will open their mouths naturally. Then just rinse them again with clean water.
To cook the soup, bring water to a boil in a pot, then turn off the heat and add the clams. Cover tightly and let sit for about 15 minutes.

mon_an.mo_ta: Refreshing Beetroot Soup – very good for low blood pressure, helps maintain blood pressure, and acts as a blood tonic. Learn to cook this nutritious and simple soup for the whole family to enjoy.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients:
Wash the beetroot, peel it, rinse again under the tap, and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Shred the napa cabbage and wash thoroughly. Peel the shallots, wash, and slice thinly. Pick the cilantro, wash, drain, and chop finely.
Step 2: Place the ground pork in a bowl (mince by hand if you don't have a grinder). Add 1 small tsp salt and a bit of pepper to the pork, mix well, and marinate for 15 minutes.
Step 3: Add a little oil to a pot, sauté the shallots until fragrant, then add the pork and stir-fry briefly. Pour in water for the soup; the amount depends on your family's preference.
Step 4:
Wait for the water to boil, then add the beetroot. Once it boils again, lower the heat and simmer slowly until the beetroot is cooked through.

Once the beetroot is soft, add the napa cabbage. Adjust the seasonings to taste. When both the beetroot and cabbage are cooked, turn off the heat, sprinkle with pepper and cilantro, then serve in a bowl with rice.

mon_an.ten: Lotus Root and Pork Rib Soup
mon_an.mo_ta: Lotus Root and Pork Rib Soup – a unique dish that is both sweet and cooling, perfect for hot summer days. Check out the recipe below! Learn how to make this delicious lotus root and rib soup.
cac_buoc: Peel the lotus root and wash thoroughly several times to remove all mud. Use a small chopstick to clean the holes inside the lotus root. Cut into bite-sized pieces.
Wash the ribs and blanch them in boiling water once to remove impurities. Wash and finely chop the green onions. Peel and slice the ginger to make the soup more fragrant and easier to eat.

Place a pressure cooker on the stove. Sauté the ribs and ginger briefly with salt, then pour in enough water to just cover the ingredients. Close the lid and cook until the ribs are tender and the meat starts to pull away from the bone.

Once the pressure has released, slowly open the lid and add the lotus root. This time, there is no need to use pressure; just simmer normally. Adjust the seasonings to taste. When the lotus root is soft, turn off the heat, sprinkle with green onions, and serve hot in a large bowl with rice.

mon_an.ten: Crab Soup with Jute Leaves and Luffa
mon_an.mo_ta: This crab soup is enticing thanks to the vibrant green of the vegetables, the rich and fatty taste of field crabs, and the clear, sweet broth. Just add a bowl of salted eggplants and you have a quintessential Northern Vietnamese meal. Don't hesitate—treat your family to this wonderful crab soup! Check out the recipe below and discover useful tips for cooking crab soup with jute leaves and luffa. Use these simple suggestions to create a perfect dish.
cac_buoc: 1. When buying field crabs, choose firm ones with plenty of meat. Avoid soft-shell crabs. Shake them with salt and wash thoroughly.
2. Separate the top shells (carapace) and set aside. Remove the apron (the flap on the underside).

3. Pound the crab meat finely; add a few grains of salt while pounding to prevent splashing. If using a blender, blend the meat until fine. Filter the ground crab meat with two bowls of water to get the liquid.
4. Use a toothpick to scoop the crab fat (roe) from the carapaces into a small bowl. Add a little water to rinse it.
5. Heat the crab liquid. Initially, use chopsticks to stir gently so the crab meat doesn't stick to the bottom.
6. Cook the crab liquid over low heat; the crab meat will gradually float and clump together into clusters.
7. While waiting for the soup to boil, pick and finely chop the jute leaves. Peel the luffa and slice into bite-sized pieces.

8. When the soup boils and the crab clusters have formed, add the luffa and jute leaves. Pour in the bowl of crab fat from step 4 and the shrimp paste (if using). Stir very gently to avoid breaking the crab clusters. When the soup returns to a boil and the vegetables are just cooked, adjust the seasonings and broth mix to taste. Turn off the heat and serve in a bowl, placing the crab clusters on top for a nice presentation.
Crab soup with jute leaves and luffa is delicious whether served hot or cold. Just add a bowl of salted eggplants and white rice for a classic Northern meal.
Tips for cooking crab soup with jute leaves and luffa
1. Tips for a better soup
When cooking this soup, here are some tips for a rich and delicious result:
Choose fresh crabs: Select fresh crabs with bright shells and no foul odor. Clean them thoroughly to remove all impurities.
Prepare vegetables correctly: Wash the jute leaves and luffa, remove any wilted parts, and cut into even pieces.
Season to taste: Add salt, pepper, sugar, and fish sauce to create a balanced flavor. Season gradually and taste frequently.
Add the crab fat at the end: To keep the crab fat from overcooking and losing its flavor, add it near the end of the process. Ensure it is just cooked through to maintain its smooth texture.
2. Easy way to process field crabs
Step 1: Soak the crabs in rice water for 10-15 minutes to remove mud. Rinse with clean water 3-4 times. Drain in a colander.
Step 2: Once drained, place them in a large bowl or basin and put them in the freezer for 15-30 minutes to make them go dormant. This makes separating the shells much easier.
Step 3: Take the crabs out, remove the carapaces and aprons. The body meat is used for the soup base.
3. How to buy good field crabs
To choose fresh field crabs, prioritize those with bright, shiny shells and fat bodies. They should have all their legs and claws and be moving vigorously.
Choose female crabs as they have more roe, which makes the soup sweeter and more fragrant. Female crabs have a wider, oval-shaped apron.
Avoid crabs with soft shells, hairy bellies, or those that are weak and immobile, as these are signs of dying crabs, which will have mushy meat or a foul smell.

mon_an.mo_ta: Crab Soup with Water Mimosa – a rustic and favorite summer dish that provides calcium and helps cool the body. Learn how to cook this delicious Crab Soup with Water Mimosa.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Cooking oil, broth mix, salt, MSG - As needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the crabs twice with water. Separate the shells and remove the aprons. Use a toothpick to scoop out the crab fat from the carapaces and set aside. Grind or pound the legs and bodies. Add a little salt during the process to enhance the flavor. Add water and filter to get the clear crab liquid.
Step 2: Clean the water mimosa, wash several times with water, and drain. Cut the tomatoes into wedges. Mince the shallots.
Step 3: Sauté the shallots in oil, then add the tomatoes and stir-fry briefly. Add the crab fat and sauté until fragrant, seasoning with 1/2 tsp salt.

Step 4: Pour the tomato mixture into the pot of crab liquid. Add 1/2 tsp salt and cook over low heat so the crab meat forms clusters. Once the clusters have formed, scoop them out and set aside so they don't break during the rest of the cooking.

Step 5: Add the water mimosa, season to taste, and cook for another 2 minutes until the greens are done. Turn off the heat and add a little MSG. When serving, pour the soup into a bowl and place the crab clusters on top. This makes the dish look beautiful and keeps the crab meat intact.
Source: Xinhxinh

mon_an.mo_ta: Not only refreshing and delicious, but tofu and shrimp soup is also highly nutritious, providing a large amount of calcium. On hot days when you feel fatigued and lose your appetite, a bowl of this nutritious soup helps replenish nutrients and makes the meal more enjoyable! Let's explore the recipe for this tofu and shrimp dish. A simple guide to creating a fragrant and cooling soup for the summer.
cac_buoc: Cut the silken tofu into bite-sized cubes.
Wash the shrimp, peel, and remove the heads, keeping the tails. Use the tip of a knife to devein the back.
Marinate the shrimp with a little wine for about 5 minutes before cooking.
Bring a pot of water to a boil and blanch the tofu briefly to remove the raw soy smell. This simple step makes your soup much more fragrant!
Heat a pan with 1 tbsp oil, sauté the ginger until fragrant, then add the shrimp and stir-fry.
When the shrimp changes color and the meat firms up, add the tofu. Note: Do not use chopsticks to stir; instead, hold the pan handle and shake gently to coat the tofu without breaking it.

Pour 1 small bowl of water into the pan. Once it boils, lower the heat. Add soy sauce, salt, and pepper to taste, stirring gently to dissolve. Simmer for another 1-2 minutes, then sprinkle with chopped cilantro and turn off the heat.
This soup is not only refreshing but also highly nutritious due to its high calcium content. Therefore, it is an excellent choice for families with elderly people and children.

The soup has a natural, pleasant sweetness. The tofu is silky, and the shrimp is fragrant and firm because it was sautéed before simmering. This small step makes the flavor stand out. On hot days, this bowl of soup helps restore energy and makes the rice easier to eat!
Notes for cooking a delicious and refreshing tofu and shrimp soup
Choose fresh ingredients: Ensure the tofu, shrimp, and other ingredients are fresh. Use dried seaweed specifically for soup to ensure the best flavor.
Proper preparation: Before cooking, process the shrimp heads by removing the whiskers and cleaning the inside. Cut the silken tofu into small, even cubes. Clean and chop the green onions.
Cook over medium heat: When the water boils, lower the heat to medium so the soup cooks evenly without losing the natural flavors of the ingredients.
Season appropriately: Use salt, sugar, and broth mix to create a balanced and attractive flavor. However, avoid over-seasoning to preserve the natural freshness of the soup.
Short cooking time: Tofu and shrimp soup cooks very quickly. Do not overcook, or the shrimp and tofu will lose their freshness and texture.
Garnish and enjoy: Before serving, add chopped green onions for color and aroma. The soup should be enjoyed hot, either on its own or with steamed rice.

mon_an.ten: Simple Homemade Tofu and Egg Soup
mon_an.mo_ta: Tofu and Egg Soup – A quick, simple, and delicious dish for beginners. This article will guide you through making this simple soup at home. Enjoy! Learn how to make this tasty Tofu and Egg Soup.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the tomatoes and green onions. Peel and thinly slice the tomatoes, then place them in a pot and sauté with a little salt and oil until soft.
Step 2: While waiting for the tomatoes to soften, finely chop the green onions. Rinse the tofu, drain, and cut into small cubes.
Step 3: Add 1 bowl of water to the softened tomatoes, season to taste, and wait for the water to boil. While waiting, crack the egg into a small bowl and whisk well.
