Step 4: Gently pour the whisked egg into the boiling tomato soup, stirring constantly to create beautiful egg ribbons. Add the tofu and adjust the seasoning. Once the soup boils again, add the green onions and turn off the heat.

mon_an.mo_ta: Papaya and pork rib soup is refreshing and sweet, with tender papaya and flavorful ribs. It's a nutritious addition to your family menu! This dish features soft papaya and savory ribs for a cooling and delicious meal.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the ribs. Bring a pot with 250ml of water and a pinch of salt to a boil. Blanch the ribs for 2-3 minutes, then remove and discard the blanching water.
Step 2: Bring a pot with about 700ml of water to a boil, then add the blanched ribs. Simmer the ribs for about 30 minutes to create a sweet broth.
Step 3: Peel the papaya, wash, and cut into chunks.
Step 4: Finely chop the green onions and cilantro.
Step 5: When the ribs are just tender, add the papaya and cook for another 10 minutes. Season to taste and turn off the heat.
Ladle the papaya and rib soup into a bowl and sprinkle with green onions and cilantro.

mon_an.mo_ta: If you have some time for cooking, why not try making honey-glazed chicken wings that both adults and children will love? This dish not only has a beautiful color but is also very nutritious!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, pepper, sugar, garlic, chili - Seasonings
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the chicken wings with salt and blanch briefly in boiling water. Drain in a colander. Use a knife to make small slits along the wings. Marinate with salt, sugar, and pepper. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Step 2: The next day, take the chicken out and coat each wing with a thin layer of tapioca starch (this makes the skin crispy and prevents oil splashing).
Step 3: Place a pan on the stove and heat the oil. Once the oil is hot, deep-fry the chicken wings over high heat until golden. Remove and place on paper towels to absorb excess oil.
Step 4: Mix the fish sauce, honey, and chili sauce together (1).

Step 5: Return the chicken to the pan, pour in the sauce mixture (1), and toss quickly so the mixture coats the wings evenly. Once the sauce has fully glazed the meat, remove to a plate. This step must be done quickly to prevent burning.
Step 6: Serve the chicken wings with lettuce, tomatoes, and cucumber as desired.
Enjoy your meal!

mon_an.mo_ta: A soup that combines the creamy richness of taro with the savory sweetness of chicken, guaranteed to bring delight to your family weekend meal. Don't miss out on this "Chicken and Taro Stew"!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Minced shallots, scallions, cilantro - for garnish
Salt, sugar, pepper, cooking oil; MSG. - seasonings
cac_buoc: Step 1: Cut the chicken thigh into bite-sized pieces; marinate with 1/2 tbsp salt, 1/4 tbsp sugar, 1/4 tbsp MSG, 1/2 tbsp pepper, and 1 tbsp shallot juice; let it absorb the flavors.
Step 2: Cut the taro into cubes and lightly fry. Carve the carrots into flower shapes and slice 1cm thick. Wash and finely chop the scallions and cilantro.

Step 3: Sauté 1 tbsp of minced shallots until fragrant, stir-fry the chicken until firm, then pour in the chicken stock. Cook for about 5 minutes, then add the carrots and taro and cook until the vegetables are tender. Finally, season with 1/2 tbsp salt, 1/4 tbsp sugar, and 1/2 tbsp MSG. Add onions, adjust the taste to your liking, and turn off the heat.
Step 4: Ladle the soup into a bowl, sprinkle with scallions, cilantro, and pepper. Serve hot with rice.
Quick tip:
Choose straight taro roots that are starchy, without many eyes, and have fresh stems.

mon_an.ten: Braised Chicken Wings with Daikon Radish
mon_an.mo_ta: With this delicious chicken wing marinade, this braised chicken wing and radish dish will have you eating several bowls of rice; it is simply unstoppable.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 400g white radish (daikon), peeled and cut into bite-sized pieces

1 carrot, cut into bite-sized pieces; ½ onion (wedged), 3 slices of ginger; 3 tablespoons light soy sauce; 3 tablespoons dark soy sauce; 1 tablespoon rice wine; 1 tablespoon minced garlic; 1 tablespoon sugar; 1 teaspoon sesame oil; 1 teaspoon sugar; salt, pepper to taste; scallions
cac_buoc: Ingredients needed for this savory and rice-enhancing braised chicken wing and radish dish!
Step 1: Wash the chicken wings and marinate them with 1 tablespoon of soy sauce, rice wine, sesame oil, sugar, salt, and pepper for 30 minutes.
Step 2: Add a little oil to a pan over medium heat; sauté the ginger and garlic until fragrant.
Then add the chicken wings and fry until they turn golden brown.
Step 3: Add the white radish, onion, and carrot to the pan and toss. Add the remaining seasonings (soy sauce, sugar) and enough water, then bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer on low heat for 20 minutes or until the radish and carrots are tender.
Remove the braised chicken wings and radish to a plate, sprinkle with scallions for garnish, and enjoy!

mon_an.mo_ta: Garlic Fried Chicken Wings – for the talented home cook to show off their skills with delicious dishes for the whole family. How to make Garlic Fried Chicken Wings.
cac_buoc: Step 1: After buying the chicken wings, wash them and make a few scores so they cook quickly. Cut the wings in half and soak them in diluted salt water. Peel and mince the garlic.

Step 2: Blanch the chicken wings briefly so they cook faster later. Remove and drain. Marinate the wings with half a teaspoon of salt, half a teaspoon of sugar, one teaspoon of fish sauce, and a little pepper. Mix well and marinate for several hours so the garlic fried chicken wings are flavorful.

Step 3: Coat the outside of the chicken wings evenly with a layer of tapioca starch. Place a pan of oil on the stove; when the oil is hot, fry the chicken wings until golden on both sides, then remove to a plate lined with paper towels.

Step 4: Use the same pan, remove most of the oil, sauté the garlic until fragrant, then pour the chicken wings back in. Toss well so the garlic coats the chicken pieces evenly. Transfer to a plate, serve hot with rice, dip in chili sauce, and eat with cucumber salad.
Source: Ngoi sao

mon_an.mo_ta: Sesame Fried Chicken Wings – fragrant with sesame and a hint of crispy lemongrass. Learn to cook this delicious chicken wing dish; though familiar, it is refreshed when fried with aromatic sesame seeds.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, sugar, fish sauce, honey, oyster sauce, cooking oil
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the chicken wings: Wash the wings, cut them in half, and use a knife to score the meat so they cook faster when fried. Blanch the wings for 3 - 5 minutes to release impurities. Then marinate the wings with: 2 tablespoons minced lemongrass, 2 tablespoons fish sauce, 2 tablespoons honey, 1 teaspoon salt, 1 teaspoon sugar, a little oyster sauce, and minced garlic. Mix well and marinate for 4 - 5 hours.
Step 2: After marinating, roll the chicken wings in tapioca starch, coating them evenly.
Step 3: Continue rolling the chicken wings in sesame seeds to prepare for frying.

Step 4: Place a pan of oil on the stove; to save oil, you can use a small pot. When the oil is hot, drop the sesame-coated chicken wings in and fry until golden on all sides. When the chicken wings turn a beautiful even golden color, remove them to a plate with paper towels and serve hot with rice. This dish can be dipped in chili sauce or tomato sauce.
Source: Ngoi sao

mon_an.mo_ta: Sour Baby Clam Soup – A delicious, easy-to-make dish familiar to Northern people on hot summer afternoons. A family meal with a bowl of sour soup featuring the sweetness of clams and the aroma of herbs will be a tasty, easy dish this summer. Learn to make Sour Baby Clam Soup to cool down during summer meals.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Baby clams in shell (or clam meat from the supermarket) - 500g
cac_buoc: Prepare the clams: Soak the clams in diluted salt water for 1 hour to clean them. Then scrub the shells. Bring a pot of water to a boil and drop the clams in; cook until the clams open their shells. Set the clam broth aside in a large bowl and pick the clam meat into another small bowl.
Step 1: Wash the tomatoes and cut them into wedges. Place a pot on the stove, add a little oil, and sauté the sliced dried shallots until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and stir-fry briefly.
Step 2: Pour the clam broth in and bring to a boil; season with salt and seasoning powder. Once boiling, add the clam meat and re-adjust the seasoning for the sour clam soup.
Step 3: Wash the dill, drain, and chop finely. When the soup boils evenly, turn off the heat, sprinkle in the dill, and enjoy with rice once the soup has cooled slightly.

mon_an.ten: Baby Clam and Banana Blossom Soup
mon_an.mo_ta: Join us in cooking Baby Clam and Banana Blossom Soup – a rustic, unique, but very delicious dish, especially suitable for hot sunny days.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the clams

Clams are the most important ingredient; choose clams of uniform size, not too big or too small. Wash the clams, remove any dead ones floating on the surface, then soak them in a basin of water so they open and release mud.

After about 3-4 hours, remove and wash the clams. Put them in a pot with cold water and cook over medium heat (not too high so the water doesn't boil over). When the water boils, stir well and add a few grains of salt. When the shells separate and open completely, the clams are cooked. Remove the pot, pour the broth into a large bowl, and cover to keep warm (to save time and fuel later).
Pick out the clam meat, then rinse the meat with the clam broth to clean it. Marinate with a little fish sauce and seasoning powder.
Step 2: Prepare the banana blossom and herbs
Thinly slice the banana blossom and soak it in a basin of water mixed with a little vinegar and salt so it stays white and doesn't turn brown.
Wash the tomatoes and cut into wedges. Pick and wash the herbs, removing roots and old parts, then chop finely.
Step 3: Cook the soup

Sauté the minced shallots until fragrant, add the clam meat and stir-fry for about 3 minutes with fish sauce until fragrant, then remove to a separate bowl. Pour the clam broth into the pot, bring to a boil, add the tomatoes and banana blossom, and bring back to a boil. Season with seasoning powder to taste, then add the cilantro and culantro and turn off the heat.
A few tips for a delicious baby clam and banana blossom soup:

To make the soup delicious, the selection and preparation of clams is most important. Choose clams that are not too big or small (too small is a hassle to pick). Clams must be fresh; dead ones will smell and ruin the dish. Choosing white clams will result in a sweeter taste.

You can use rice water to soak the clams; they will release all the mud and slime. You can also add a few grains of salt and a sliced bird's eye chili or place a metal knife in the soaking basin to help the clams release mud faster. This secret applies to all types of mussels, clams, and even snails.

Adding a few grains of salt to the boiling pot and stirring will help the shells release the meat faster. Remember to only boil until just cooked; overcooking makes them chewy and loses their characteristic sweet aroma.
After picking the clams, you can remove the waste from larger clams and rinse them with warm clam broth. Do not use cold water, or the clams will become fishy.

Banana blossoms have sap and turn brown quickly when exposed to air. Therefore, to keep them white and crisp, immediately soak them in water with salt and vinegar after slicing. This is the secret to a perfect dish!

mon_an.ten: Baby Clam Soup with Sour Starfruit
mon_an.mo_ta: Baby Clam Soup with Sour Starfruit – rustic and popular for its refreshing and attractive qualities. Learn the recipe for Baby Clam Soup with Sour Starfruit.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning powder, salt, sugar, fish sauce, cooking oil
cac_buoc: Step 1: Rinse the clam shells with water until clean. Soak the clams in water mixed with ground chili for about 30 minutes to release dirt, then scrub clean again. Discard any that are already open.
Step 2: Boil the clams until they open, strain and keep the clear broth. Pick the clam meat from the shells and discard the shells.
Step 3: Wash the sour starfruit, remove the edges, and slice into star shapes. Wash the tomatoes and cut into wedges.

Step 4: Place a medium pot on the stove with oil and sauté the shallots until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and a little salt to stir-fry first, then pour in the clam broth. Add more water according to your family's needs. Season to taste.
Step 5: When the soup boils, add the clam meat and starfruit. Cook until it boils again, then turn off the heat. Sprinkle with scallions, ladle into a bowl, and serve hot.

mon_an.ten: Refreshing Baby Clam and Loofah Soup
mon_an.mo_ta: Clams and loofah are both cool and nutritious ingredients. Combining them in a soup is wonderful. Let's cook baby clam and loofah soup for the whole family during these hot summer days.
cac_buoc: How to make baby clam and loofah soup:
Prepare the ingredients:
Wash the clams several times with water. Soak them in a basin of water with white salt and 2 chopped chilies for 1-2 hours to release sand.
Peel the loofah and slice diagonally or lengthwise into bite-sized pieces.
Mince the shallots.
Cut the scallions and culantro into sections.
Steps to make the soup:
Step 1: Pour the clams into a pot and boil until they open their shells.
Separate the clam meat from the shells and wash with water. Strain the clear clam broth to use for the soup.
Step 2: Add oil to a pot, sauté the shallots, add the clam meat and stir-fry. Season with 1 tbsp fish sauce and 1 tbsp seasoning powder; stir-fry for 5-7 minutes until the clams are firm.
Step 3: Add the loofah and stir-fry, adding a little salt to taste. Toss until the loofah is evenly cooked.
Step 4: When the loofah is parboiled, pour in the clam broth and bring to a boil. You can add more plain water depending on the desired amount of soup.
When cooking loofah, be careful not to overcook it as it becomes mushy and loses its appeal.
Adjust the seasoning, add fresh scallions and culantro, then turn off the heat.
A bowl of vibrant green baby clam and loofah soup will surely make your family meal more attractive and eliminate the feeling of appetite loss on hot summer days.

mon_an.mo_ta: Bitter Melon and Pork Soup – An easy-to-make dish with many benefits from bitter melon, bringing you abundant health. Learn how to cook Bitter Melon and Pork Soup.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, pepper, seasoning powder, sugar, fish sauce
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the bitter melon, remove the core, and slice thinly or cut into sections for stuffing, depending on your preference.
Step 2: Marinate the minced pork with shallots, seasoning powder, and pepper for aroma. You can also add wood ear mushrooms or shiitake mushrooms to make the meat more fragrant and the soup tastier.

Step 3: Place a pot of cold water on the stove. When the water boils, roll the meat into small balls and drop them into the water. Wait until the meatballs float, indicating they are cooked. You can also stuff the meat into the bitter melon sections.
Step 4: Once the meatballs float, add the bitter melon to the pot. Season with seasoning powder, salt, and fish sauce. If you cannot handle the bitterness, you can add a little sugar.
Step 5: After the bitter melon is tender to your liking, turn off the heat and sprinkle with chopped scallions. Ladle the soup into a bowl and enjoy with rice and other delicious dishes.

mon_an.mo_ta: Stuffed Bitter Melon Soup is a very delicious and nutritious soup. The mild bitterness of the melon harmonizes with the sweet broth scented with scallions and cilantro. Let's get into the kitchen to prepare this dish!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Choose short bitter melons with large bumps; they will be less bitter. Cut the bitter melon into sections about 5-8cm long and use the handle of a spoon to remove the core.

Step 2: Finely mince the pork and mix well with the featherback fish paste, shredded or minced wood ear mushrooms, white scallion heads, 1 teaspoon MSG, 1 teaspoon sugar, 1 teaspoon seasoning salt, a little pepper, and a little fish sauce.
Step 3: Stuff the meat mixture into the bitter melon sections.

Step 4: Boil the pork bones to make broth. When the broth is boiling vigorously, add the stuffed bitter melon. Add 1 tablespoon of salt, cover, and cook over low heat for about 5 minutes until the bitter melon is tender. Turn off the heat, add 1 teaspoon of MSG and chopped scallions and cilantro.

Step 5: When cooking the soup, adding a small chili to the pot will help the spiciness of the chili offset the bitterness of the melon. This method is for those who do not like the bitter taste of bitter melon.

mon_an.mo_ta: Malabar spinach soup with clams – a quick and refreshing dish for busy days. Learn to cook this delicious, low-fat soup that is perfect for cooling down in the summer.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Pick the Malabar spinach leaves, wash thoroughly several times with water, then drain. If the leaves are large, you can cut them in half.

Step 2: Prepare the clams: Wash the clams multiple times, then soak them in a bowl of water so they release all the sand. Once clean, place them in a pot with julienned ginger and bring to a boil until the clams open their shells, then turn off the heat.
Step 3: Filter the clam broth to remove any grit and bring it back to a boil. Once boiling, add the Malabar spinach and season with a bit of salt to taste.

Step 4: While waiting for the water to boil, remove the clam meat from the shells. When the greens are cooked, add the clam meat to the pot, bring to a boil once more, and turn off the heat. The dish is now complete; serve hot with rice.
Source: Ngoisao

mon_an.ten: Malabar Spinach Soup with Dried Shrimp
mon_an.mo_ta: Malabar spinach soup with shrimp – a delicious addition to a summer meal. Learn how to cook this tasty Malabar spinach and shrimp soup.
cac_buoc: Pick the Malabar spinach leaves and young tips, wash thoroughly, and finely chop.
Soak the dried shrimp in water until soft, or grind them finely to make them easier to eat and more flavorful.

Place the Malabar spinach and dried shrimp into a pot, add a bit of seasoning, and stir for a moment to let the flavors absorb. Add water and bring to a boil. Once boiling, turn off the heat and ladle into a bowl. This is very delicious when served with pickled eggplant.

mon_an.ten: Luffa and Peanut Soup for Weight Loss
mon_an.mo_ta: A simple dish that meets many criteria: delicious, sweet, refreshing, nutritious, and helps you control your weight for a slim waistline. Today's article will guide you through cooking a delicious luffa and peanut soup.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Luffa - 3 fruits (choose fragrant luffa for a much better aroma)
Cooking oil or olive oil - Optional
cac_buoc: Soak the peanuts in warm water. Once the skin starts to peel off, drain and place them in a mortar to crush slightly.
Peel the luffa, wash, and cut into bite-sized pieces.

Add the peanuts to a pot and sauté briefly with a little salt. I find that oil isn't necessary since peanuts already contain natural oils (if you still want to use oil, use olive oil to reduce unhealthy fats).
Add enough water for the soup, bring to a boil, and season to taste. Continue to simmer for about 5 minutes until the peanuts are soft.
Once the peanuts are soft, add the luffa to the pot and bring back to a boil until the luffa is cooked.
When the luffa is cooked, remember to re-season to taste because the luffa can make the broth slightly bland. Add chopped scallions and cilantro, then remove from the heat and serve hot.

A little secret: I often add dried shrimp to this soup (without protein, it feels like something is missing). Wash the dried shrimp, grind them, and sauté them with the peanuts from the very first step. Adding dried shrimp makes the soup more nutritious and aromatic without causing weight gain :P If you prefer a vegetarian version, the original recipe is already very delicious. Give it a try!

mon_an.ten: Clam Soup with Tofu and Vietnamese Coriander
mon_an.mo_ta: Learn how to cook clam soup with tofu and Vietnamese coriander according to this recipe.
cac_buoc: Soak the clams in water with a bit of salt and a few slices of chili in a dark place for at least 1 hour to release all sand, then rinse clean. Boil the clams until they open, then remove the clams and let the broth sit so the sediment settles. Remove the clam meat and set aside.
Peel and mince the shallot. Wash the tomato and cut into wedges. Wash and chop the Vietnamese coriander. Mince the chili.

Sauté the minced shallot until fragrant, add the clam meat and sauté briefly with a bit of seasoning, then set aside. Next, sauté the tomatoes and chili to create color. Pour in the filtered clam broth (avoiding the sediment) and bring to a boil. Add the cubed tofu, bring back to a boil, then return the clams to the pot. Season to taste, stir in the Vietnamese coriander, and turn off the heat. Ladle the clam soup into a bowl and eat while hot.
Clam soup with tofu and Vietnamese coriander is not only visually appealing but also very delicious for the whole family.

mon_an.mo_ta: Katuk soup with pork – an easy-to-make dish for those learning to cook. A delicious and simple soup that pairs perfectly with pickled eggplant. Learn how to cook Katuk soup with pork.
cac_buoc: Strip the katuk leaves from the stems, wash them, and crush them slightly by hand so the leaves aren't tough or hard when cooked. Drain in a colander.
Wash the pork and mince it. Place a pot on the stove with a little oil, sauté the peeled and sliced shallots until fragrant, then add the pork and sauté with a bit of salt.
When the pork is cooked, add the katuk and sauté together. Season with a little salt or seasoning powder to make the soup more flavorful.
Pour in enough water to cover the greens and bring to a boil. Re-season this easy dish to taste. When the greens are tender, turn off the heat and sprinkle in a little MSG to finish.
Note that katuk cooks quickly, so do not boil it for too long; this preserves the nutrients and prevents the leaves from becoming mushy and unappealing.
Source: Kenh14

mon_an.ten: Katuk Soup with Shrimp and Pork
mon_an.mo_ta: Katuk soup with shrimp and pork – a refreshing and easy-to-make dish popular in summer. Cooking it with shrimp and pork adds extra nutrition.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the shrimp and pork:
Wash the shrimp, peel, remove the heads, and devein. Mince the shrimp.
Wash the pork, cut into pieces, and grind finely. Mix the shrimp and pork in a bowl with a bit of salt and pepper.
Step 2: Strip the katuk leaves, wash twice with water, and crush them slightly.
Step 3: Sauté the shallots in a pot with oil, then sauté the shrimp and pork mixture until cooked. Add filtered water and bring to a boil.
Step 4: Add the katuk to the pot and season with salt and seasoning powder to taste. Wait for the water to boil once more, and this easy dish is ready.

mon_an.mo_ta: This sour fish soup features the natural sweetness of fish and the characteristic aroma of dill. While it has sour and sweet notes, they are very mild, serving only to enhance the rich flavor of the fish.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning: cooking oil, seasoning powder, salt, MSG.
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients:
Step 1: Wash and cut the scallions, Vietnamese coriander, and dill into sections. Peel and julienne the ginger. Wash and wedge the tomatoes.
Step 2: Clean the carp and cut into sections.
Step 3: Lightly pan-fry the carp with a little oil.
Step 4: Sauté the shallots in oil, then add the tomatoes and sauté briefly. Add ½ tsp of salt so the tomatoes soften quickly. Pour in cold water and bring to a boil. Season to taste.
Step 5: When the water boils, add the pan-fried fish and simmer over low heat to extract the sweetness.
Step 6: When the soup is nearly done, add the pickled mustard greens. This way, the greens won't become overcooked. (If you prefer a richer flavor, you can sauté the greens with the tomatoes).
Step 7: Cook for about 4 more minutes. (Add chili slices if you like it spicy). Add the scallions, dill, Vietnamese coriander, and MSG. Turn off the heat and serve the carp soup in a bowl.

mon_an.mo_ta: Cook this delicious and easy sour pork rib soup for dinner. This recipe yields a bowl of soup with a mild, fragrant sourness. It's refreshing for hot days and very appetizing when it's cold.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Wash the ribs, bring water to a boil, and blanch the ribs briefly. Remove and rinse with cold water to remove impurities.
Wash the tomatoes; cut half into wedges and finely chop the other half.
Peel and mince the shallot. Wash the scallions and cilantro (including sawtooth herb and parsley). Keep the white scallion heads separate; chop the rest. Slit the white scallion heads into quarters.
Step 2: Cook the soup

Heat a little oil in a pan, sauté the minced shallot until fragrant, then add the chopped tomatoes. Add a little salt to help the tomatoes soften. Once soft, add the ribs and sauté until cooked, seasoning the meat. Add the dracontomelon (sấu) and pour in water. Bring to a boil, then lower the heat and simmer until the ribs are tender (use a pressure cooker for speed). When the ribs are soft, add the tomato wedges, re-season to taste, then add the chopped herbs and white scallion heads before turning off the heat. Remove the sấu, mash them to release the sourness into the soup, then ladle into a bowl. Serve hot with rice or rice vermicelli.
Notes for a delicious sour pork rib soup:
Choose young ribs with a bit of fat for tenderness and flavor. Blanching the ribs in boiling water first ensures the broth stays clear and free of fishy odors.
Sautéing the tomatoes and ribs before adding water helps the meat absorb the seasoning and creates a beautiful color. Add the tomato wedges at the end for a better presentation.
Using a pressure cooker saves time and energy; 10 minutes of pressure is usually enough for tender ribs. If using a regular pot, bring to a boil then simmer on low heat.

For sour soups, add a little fish sauce just before turning off the heat to enhance the aroma. Be careful not to over-season earlier so you can add about 1 tbsp of fish sauce at the end. Don't add fish sauce too early, or the soup may turn bitter.

mon_an.ten: Sweet and Sour Pork Rib Soup
mon_an.mo_ta: This sweet and sour pork rib soup features the aroma of pineapple and the vibrant color of tomatoes. It can be served with rice or rice vermicelli.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning - Fish sauce, seasoning powder + salt + sugar + pepper
cac_buoc: Step 1: Cut the ribs into bite-sized pieces, rinse with cold water, then blanch in boiling water for 4 minutes. Drain in a colander.
Step 2: Slice the tomatoes and pineapple. Roughly chop the scallions and cilantro.
Step 3: Heat 1 tbsp of oil in a pot. Sauté the cilantro roots, scallion whites, garlic, and shallot until fragrant. Add the ribs and sauté briefly with 1 tbsp of fish sauce.
Step 4: Add 2-3 bowls of cold water, bring to a boil, and skim off the foam.
Step 5: When the ribs are tender, add the pineapple and tomatoes. Season to taste and cook for another 5 minutes before turning off the heat.
Ladle the sweet and sour rib soup into a bowl, then add the chili, scallions, and cilantro. Don't forget to sprinkle with a little pepper.
Good luck and enjoy this attractive sweet and sour rib soup for your summer meal!

mon_an.ten: Refreshing Pork Rib and Bitter Melon Soup
mon_an.mo_ta: Pork rib and bitter melon soup – exceptionally delicious and nutritious. Follow this recipe to make a cooling summer soup.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the bitter melon and soak in diluted salt water for 15 minutes, then drain. Halve the melon, remove the core, and cut into bite-sized pieces. Soak the pieces again in salt water, then blanch briefly to help the melon retain its beautiful color.

Step 2: Wash the ribs and place them in a pot of water. Bring to a boil, then turn off the heat. Discard the water and rinse the ribs thoroughly. Place the ribs in a clean pot and simmer until the meat is tender and starts to pull away from the bone. Be sure to skim the foam frequently to keep the broth clear.

Step 3: Slice the ginger and peel the garlic. Add the ginger and garlic to the rib pot, followed by the bitter melon. Simmer over low heat until all ingredients are tender. Season to taste and turn off the heat. You can add some goji berries to make the soup more visually appealing!

mon_an.mo_ta: Beef is both delicious and highly nutritious. Simply adding a few stalks of smashed lemongrass for aroma along with some red tomatoes will give you a fragrant, tasty pot of soup. Today, we will guide you through making this Beef and Tomato Soup. Beef is both delicious and highly nutritious. Simply adding a few stalks of smashed lemongrass for aroma along with some red tomatoes will give you a fragrant, tasty pot of soup. Today, we will guide you through making this Beef and Tomato Soup.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Green onions, cilantro, and shallots - For garnish
Fish sauce, salt, seasoning powder, and pepper - Seasoning
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the beef with diluted salt water and place it in a basket to drain.
Use a meat grinder to finely mince the beef. In a bowl, mix the meat with half a tsp of salt, a little pepper, and finely chopped shallots. Mix well and marinate for 15 to 30 minutes.
Step 2: Remove the fibrous outer layers of the lemongrass and cut into short segments.
Cut the tomatoes into wedges and smash the lemongrass with the back of a knife.
Step 3: Finely chop the green onions, Vietnamese coriander, and cilantro, then set aside in a bowl.
Step 4: Pour about 3 small bowls of filtered water into a pot, add the lemongrass, and boil for about 15 minutes. Pour the water into a bowl and set aside.
Pour cooking oil into the pot, sauté the shallots until fragrant, then add the tomatoes and stir-fry until cooked.
Add the lemongrass-infused water to the tomato pot and continue to bring to a boil.
Season the soup with about half a tsp of salt, two tsp of fish sauce, and half a tsp of seasoning powder, then bring to a boil.
Adjust the seasoning to suit your taste.
Step 5: Next, add the beef to the soup pot and boil for about 3 minutes; do not cook for too long or the beef will become tough.
Turn off the heat, and finally add the chopped green onions, cilantro, and Vietnamese coriander to the pot. Ladle into a bowl and serve with rice.
Enjoy your delicious meal!

mon_an.ten: Sweet and Refreshing Daikon and Pork Soup
mon_an.mo_ta: Lean pork soup cooked with daikon is a delicious and nutritious dish. Daikon helps regulate blood pressure, enriches the blood, and has cooling properties. The following content will guide you on how to cook daikon soup with meat. Please refer to the recipe! This soup brings a unique flavor by combining fresh daikon with sweet, savory meat.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel the daikon, wash, and cut into bite-sized pieces. Wash the green onions and cilantro, then chop finely. Peel the shallots, wash, and slice thinly.

Step 2: Marinate the ground lean pork with a bit of salt and pepper for 30 minutes. Place a pot on the stove, heat a little cooking oil, and sauté the shallots until fragrant. Add the meat and stir-fry until cooked.
Step 3: Pour water into the pot with the meat, season with a little salt, and cook until the water boils.

Step 4: Add the daikon to the pot. Cook until the daikon is tender, then adjust the seasoning to taste. Add the green onions and cilantro, then turn off the heat. You have finished cooking the Lean Pork and Daikon Soup.
How to choose fresh ingredients
1. How to buy fresh pork ribs
When buying ribs, choose pieces with a natural light red color that are elastic when lightly pressed.
For a delicious soup, choose ribs that have a mix of fat and lean meat. Additionally, prioritize flat and small bones to ensure the ribs have more meat.
Avoid buying ribs with unusual dark bruises, unpleasant odors, or a pale purple color. These are signs that the ribs have been sitting for a long time.
2. How to buy good daikon
When buying fresh daikon, choose roots that are intact with smooth skin, free of scratches or strange black spots.
The shape of the daikon should be straight and gradually taper toward the tail. When held, it should feel heavy in the hand and have a certain firmness when squeezed.
Buy daikon that still has its leaf stems attached; the stems should be firmly fixed to the root, the leaves should be fresh green, and ideally, the root should still have its fine root hairs.
Avoid choosing daikon that is too large, bloated, soft, missing leaf stems, or has wilted leaves.
Notes for cooking daikon and pork soup
When cooking daikon soup with meat, keep a few important points in mind to ensure the soup has a sweet and refreshing flavor.
Select fresh daikon: Choose daikon with smooth skin and no damage. The radish should maintain a beautiful fresh white color.
Prepare good meat: Use high-quality meat that is tender and fresh. Choosing meat with a bit of fat will increase the sweetness and richness of the soup.

Cooking technique: Before boiling the soup, you can steam the meat to retain its flavor and reduce excess fat. Then, simmer the daikon and meat in the broth until the meat is tender and the daikon is soft and sweet.
Appropriate seasoning: Use seasonings like salt, sugar, and seasoning powder, along with natural aromatics like onions and garlic to enhance the soup's flavor.
Enjoy hot: Daikon and pork soup is best enjoyed hot, served with white rice or fresh rice vermicelli.
By following these notes, you can create a sweet and refreshing daikon and pork soup that will satisfy everyone in the family.

mon_an.ten: Thai Spicy and Sour Shrimp Soup
mon_an.mo_ta: Say goodbye to the Lunar New Year with this Thai-style spicy and sour shrimp soup (also known as Tom Yum). It is pleasantly tart, fragrant, and very appetizing with rice. Allergy: Shrimp.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Shrimp - 1 bowl of fresh shrimp, peeled and deveined
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Wash the shrimp, peel, and devein by slicing along the back.
Wash the green onions, cilantro, and enoki mushrooms. Trim the lemongrass base, wash, and smash. Wash the lime leaves.
Step 2: Place a pot of water on the stove and bring to a boil. Tie the lemongrass into a knot and drop it into the pot (knotting it makes it easier to remove later). Boil for about 5 minutes.
Step 3: Add the mushrooms and lime leaves to the pot, then add the shrimp.
Step 4: Add chili paste and fresh chili to the soup according to your taste...
... Then season to taste, add the chopped green onions and cilantro, turn the heat to high to bring the soup back to a boil, then turn off the heat.
Small tip: When cooking sour soup, I often add a little fish sauce before taking it off the stove; the fish sauce makes the sour soup more savory and aromatic. You can try it out.
Step 5: Ladle the soup into a bowl, squeeze in lime juice until you reach the desired sourness, and you have a delicious bowl of Thai Spicy and Sour Shrimp Soup.
Some useful information for Thai Spicy and Sour Shrimp Soup:

I really love Thai food with its characteristic sour, spicy, and fragrant flavors, especially Tom Yum. Previously, when living with Thai friends, they often brought Tom Yum seasoning cubes to cook soup, which was delicious and fast. When they ran out of seasoning, they could still cook an attractive Tom Yum soup using available natural ingredients while maintaining the dish's signature flavor. In Vietnam, Tom Yum seasoning packets are now sold, but since the quality is uncertain, I often use natural ingredients like lemongrass, chili, and lime leaves to create the flavor for this delicious soup.

Thai Spicy and Sour Shrimp Soup is cooked very quickly and simply, making it a great addition to your family menu. The final requirement is that the shrimp must be just cooked—sweet and crunchy, not dry. The broth should be pleasantly tart with the aroma of lime, lemongrass, and the spiciness of chili or chili paste. This soup can be eaten hot with rice or rice vermicelli, and it is very tasty.
If you like sour soups, you can also refer to sour clam soup or sour fish soup, which are also very attractive.

mon_an.mo_ta: Sour Shrimp and Starfruit Soup – A delicious, easy-to-make dish from Central Vietnam. Using sour starfruit instead of tamarind or dracontomelon, this hot bowl of soup offers the gentle tartness of starfruit. Learn how to cook this fragrant soup with wild betel leaves, rice paddy herb, and culantro.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Green onions, salt, seasoning powder, fish sauce, shallots
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the shrimp: Trim the legs; keep the shells on for small shrimp, but for larger ones, peel and devein them, then wash thoroughly.
Step 2:
Trim the edges of the starfruit, wash, and cut into 0.5cm thick slices. Wash the tomato and cut into wedges; drain. Wash the wild betel leaves and slice into thin strips.

Pick and wash the rice paddy herb and culantro under running water to remove dirt, then chop finely. Wash the green onions and cut into segments; peel and thinly slice the shallots to make the dish fragrant.

Step 3: Place a pot on the stove with 2 tbsp of oil. When the oil is hot, sauté the shallots until fragrant. Add the shrimp and stir-fry until they turn pink. Then add the tomatoes and starfruit, stirring well. Add water (to your serving size) and bring to a boil. Season with salt and fish sauce to taste.

Step 4: Once the soup boils and the ingredients are cooked, add the rice paddy herb, wild betel leaves, culantro, and green onions. Stir quickly and turn off the heat. Sprinkle with a little pepper, ladle the soup into a bowl, and enjoy while hot.
Source: Ngoi sao

mon_an.mo_ta: Mussel and Gourd Soup – simple, easy to cook, yet very delicious and perfect for a summer lunch. Learn how to cook Mussel and Gourd Soup.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, fish sauce, shallots, green onions, pepper, annatto oil
cac_buoc: Step 1: Soak the mussels in water and scrub the shells clean. Soak them in a bowl of water to release all grit, then boil the mussels until they open their mouths. Remove the meat, discard the shells, and strain the boiling liquid to use as soup broth.

Step 2: Heat two tsp of annatto oil, sauté the white parts of the green onions and the shallots until fragrant. Add the mussel meat and stir-fry for about 2 minutes, then add about 2 small bowls of the mussel broth and bring to a boil.
Step 3: Wash the gourd; you can either chop it or shred it into thin strips for the soup.

Step 4: Add the prepared gourd to the pot and adjust the seasoning to taste. Gourd cooks quickly and retains heat for a long time; as soon as the soup boils, turn off the heat and sprinkle in some green onions. If any gourd pieces are still white, push them down with chopsticks and they will finish cooking. Ladle into a bowl and serve with hot rice.
Note: If you like a sour soup, you can add tomato wedges when stir-frying the mussel meat; this will give the soup a tart flavor and a beautiful color.

mon_an.ten: Spicy Fried Anchovies with Garlic and Chili
mon_an.mo_ta: For a long time, crispy fried anchovies dipped in fish sauce have been an indispensable, humble yet delicious part of Vietnamese meals. To refresh this familiar dish, we introduce Spicy Fried Anchovies with Garlic and Chili. The anchovies are fried until crispy—edible even with bones—and coated in a fragrant, spicy layer of garlic and chili. This is an easy-to-make dish for home cooks.
cac_buoc: Get your pen and paper ready to record this easy and delicious Spicy Fried Anchovies with Garlic and Chili recipe:
Step 1: Wash the anchovies, remove the heads and innards. Wash again and drain. Marinate the fish with 1 tsp of salt for flavor.
Step 2: Sprinkle tapioca starch over the fish and use your hands to coat them evenly.
Step 3: Fry the anchovies until golden brown and crispy. Remove to a plate lined with paper towels.
Step 4: In a clean bowl, mix the honey, fish sauce, and chili powder.
Step 5: Peel and mince the garlic. Heat oil in a pan and sauté the garlic until fragrant. Then pour in the honey mixture and bring to a boil.
Step 6: Add the fried anchovies to the pan and toss well. Wait until the mixture thickens and coats the fish, then turn off the heat, transfer to a plate, and serve hot.

mon_an.ten: Quick and Delicious Chả Lá Lốt for Dinner
mon_an.mo_ta: Let's make Chả Lá Lốt (Grilled Pork in Wild Betel Leaves), a dish that is both delicious and quick for dinner. Add this fragrant recipe to your family menu.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Peel and mince the shallot.

Blanch the pork shoulder in boiling water, wash it, then mince or grind it. Marinate the minced meat with the minced shallot, pepper, and a little fish sauce. Let it sit for about 15 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Pick the wild betel leaves, remove the stems, wash, and pat dry.
Once the meat is marinated, place a portion of meat in the center of a wild betel leaf and roll it up. Continue until all the meat is used.
Step 2: Fry the Chả Lá Lốt
Add cooking oil to a pan and heat it. Place the rolls in the pan and fry over low heat until the meat is cooked and the leaves are golden brown on all sides, then remove and arrange on a plate.

The final requirement for Chả Lá Lốt is that it should be fragrant, golden, and slightly charred on the outside. The leaves should be crispy, and the meat inside should be tender but not greasy. Chả Lá Lốt can be served with white rice, dipped in garlic-chili soy sauce, or eaten with rice vermicelli.
A few secrets for delicious Chả Lá Lốt:

Choose pork shoulder with some fat so the rolls are tender and not dry or overly greasy. Marinate the meat with pepper and shallots first, then add fish sauce for aroma. Using fish sauce makes the dish more fragrant.
The wild betel leaves must be wiped completely dry before rolling. If the leaves are wet, the oil will splatter when frying, which is messy and can cause burns.

Do not use too much oil when frying to avoid making the dish too greasy. Furthermore, since pork shoulder has fat between the muscle fibers, the fat will render out during frying, helping the Chả Lá Lốt become fragrant and beautifully colored.

mon_an.mo_ta: Chicken feet are a favorite snack for many because of their crunchy and attractive texture. In this chilly weather, sitting with friends, sipping some warm wine, and enjoying "boneless chicken feet" is truly wonderful.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the bell peppers and cut into bite-sized pieces; wash the cherry tomatoes and cut them in half.

Step 2: Sauté the leeks with 1 tbsp of oil, then add the cherry tomatoes and stir. Add the boneless chicken feet and season with seasoning powder and sugar to taste. Finally, add ketchup and chili sauce, tossing well for color and flavor absorption.

mon_an.ten: Beef Shank and Lotus Seed Congee
mon_an.mo_ta: Beef Shank and Lotus Seed Congee – a hot, fragrant, and sweet dish featuring beef shank cooked with nutty lotus seeds. Learn how to make Beef Shank and Lotus Seed Congee.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, pepper, Vietnamese coriander, green onions, cilantro
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the beef shank and place it in the freezer for 15 minutes to firm up slightly, then take it out and slice into bite-sized pieces. Cover the meat with cold water, add two tsp of salt, bring to a boil, and simmer until the beef is tender. If the water dries up, add a little filtered water.

Step 2: Rinse the mung beans several times, then soak them in warm water for 30 minutes to 1 hour. Wash the dried lotus seeds (if using fresh ones, remove the bitter embryos). Bring a pot of water to a boil, add the lotus seeds and cook for 15-20 minutes, then add the mung beans and cook until both are soft.

Step 3: Rinse the rice and let it drain in a basket. Heat a pan and toast the rice until the grains firm up. Next, put the rice in a small pot, cover with cold water, and boil until the grains bloom. Drain the bloomed rice in a colander and discard the boiling water.

Step 4: Combine the beef shank, its cooking broth, mung beans, and lotus seeds in a large pot. Add the rice (use the water from cooking the beans and lotus seeds as well), bring to a boil, and season to taste. Simmer over low heat until the rice is soft.
Step 5: Finally, turn off the heat, add chopped Vietnamese coriander, green onions, and cilantro. Ladle into a bowl, sprinkle with a little pepper, and serve hot.
Source: Ngoi sao

mon_an.ten: Lotus Seed and Beef Shank Congee
mon_an.mo_ta: Lotus Seed and Beef Shank Congee is a hot, delicious bowl of porridge that is very good for people suffering from insomnia. Learn how to cook this Lotus Seed and Beef Shank Congee.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Before cooking the Lotus Seed and Beef Shank Congee, prepare the ingredients. Wash the beef shank and slice into bite-sized pieces. For prettier slices, you can put the meat in the freezer for a while to firm it up. Cover the meat with cold water and boil until tender. You can use a pressure cooker to save time.
Step 2: Rinse the mung beans and soak them in warm water for 30 - 60 minutes.
Step 3: Wash the dried lotus seeds (or fresh ones with the embryos removed), then simmer until tender. After 15 minutes of simmering, add the mung beans and continue cooking until both are soft.
Step 4: Rinse the white rice and glutinous rice, then drain. Toast them briefly in a hot pan. Put the rice in a pot with cold water and boil until the grains bloom, then drain through a clean sieve.

Step 5: Combine the beef shank, beef broth, lotus seeds, mung beans, a little lotus seed cooking water, and the rice in a large pot. Bring to a boil and season to taste. Simmer over low heat until the rice is soft and tender.

Step 6: Pick and wash the Vietnamese coriander, cilantro, and green onions, then chop finely. When the congee is cooked, add the herbs to the pot. Turn off the heat and serve hot, sprinkling a little pepper on top when eating.

mon_an.mo_ta: The Bombay duck meat is soft and translucent, melting on the tongue when eaten. The characteristic sweet taste of Bombay duck and fresh squid combined with the slightly sour and spicy flavor of the hotpot broth will truly captivate you. Let's follow the instructions to make this Bombay duck hotpot below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fresh squid - 500g (or any seafood you prefer)
Shallots, tamarind, fish sauce, chili, seasoning powder, salt, cooking oil
cac_buoc: Step 1:

After purchasing the marrow bones, chop them into bite-sized pieces and wash them thoroughly. Place them in a pot of water with a little dissolved salt, boil for 2 minutes, then discard the water. This step helps remove impurities from the bones.
Wash the bones with cold water to remove any remaining residue and odors, then return them to the pot and simmer to make the broth for the hotpot.
Step 2:
After cleaning the Bombay duck, soak it in salt water for 30 minutes so the fish does not break apart during cooking.
After 30 minutes, remove the fish to a basket to drain, then cut each fish into 2 pieces and place them on a plate.
Step 3:
In this step, we will prepare the squid. Clean the fresh squid and soak it in white wine for 15-20 minutes to reduce the fishy smell, then remove it to a basket to drain.
Cut the fresh squid into pieces and arrange them on a plate.
Step 4:

For the hotpot vegetables, you have many choices such as celery, crown daisy, mugwort, napa cabbage, mustard greens, bok choy, etc. However, the traditional vegetable for Bombay duck hotpot in Vung Tau is sprout greens.
Pick and wash the vegetables thoroughly, then soak them in salt water for 20 minutes. Remove the sprouts to a basket to drain. When eating, arrange the vegetables on a plate for dipping.
Step 5:
Trim the roots and remove any wilted or dirty leaves from the green onions and dill. Wash them thoroughly and divide into two portions. Cut one half into 2-3 cm segments; finely chop the other half.
Step 6:
Wash the tomatoes and cut them into wedges.
Peel and wash the shallots, then crush and mince them finely.
Step 7:
Soak the tamarind in hot water for about 5 minutes until soft, then use a sieve to mash and extract the pulp.
Step 8:
Place a pot on the stove and add 2 tablespoons of cooking oil. When the oil is hot, sauté the minced shallots until fragrant, then add the tomato wedges and stir-fry until softened.

Once the tomatoes are soft, pour the previously simmered bone broth into the pot and bring to a boil. Add seasonings including MSG, fish sauce, seasoning powder, the tamarind pulp, and a bit of chili; adjust the taste to be slightly sour and spicy, then turn off the heat.
The broth preparation is complete. Place the pot on the hotpot stove and add the finely chopped green onions and dill.
Step 9:
Prepare the ingredients for dipping: Bombay duck, fresh squid, segmented green onions and dill, hotpot vegetables, and chili fish sauce on the dining table.
Place the hotpot in the center. When the broth boils, add the fish and squid, cover the lid, and wait for it to boil again. Add the vegetables to cook and enjoy.
You can add enoki mushrooms, shiitake mushrooms, or tofu to the hotpot to enhance the flavor. Dipping the fish in soy sauce, chili sauce, or chili fish sauce is equally delicious.

Bombay duck hotpot offers soft, translucent fish meat that melts on the tongue, combined with the sweetness of fresh squid and the sour-spicy notes of tamarind and chili, creating an unforgettable flavor.

mon_an.ten: Lotus Seed and Lima Bean Sweet Soup
mon_an.mo_ta: Lotus Seed and Lima Bean Sweet Soup – A delicious, easy-to-make, and nutty dessert for summer days that has a very good sedative effect. Learn how to cook this delicious sweet soup.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the dried lotus seeds; if using fresh lotus seeds, peel them and remove the lotus embryos. Bring a pot of water to a boil and briefly parboil the lotus seeds.
Step 2: Soak dried lima beans until they expand, remove the outer skin, and wash them. Place the beans in a steamer and steam until they are soft and tender.

Step 3: After parboiling the lotus seeds, mix them with the steamed lima beans in a pot. Add filtered water and rock sugar, turn off the heat, and cover the lid for 2-3 hours to let the beans absorb the sugar.

Step 4: Place the pot back on the stove and simmer over low heat. Adjust the sweetness to your preference. Once the lotus seeds and lima beans are cooked to your liking, turn off the heat and add the vanilla. Let it cool and store in the refrigerator, or scoop into glasses with ice and serve cold.
Source: Ngoi sao

mon_an.ten: Sweet and Sour Stir-fried Chicken Gizzards with Pineapple
mon_an.mo_ta: With just a few simple steps, you will have a delicious sweet and sour stir-fried chicken gizzard dish with pineapple, perfect for serving with rice, especially in this winter weather. Let's make this dish together. The crunchy gizzards combined with the sweet and sour taste of pineapple will make your meal more enjoyable.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Green onions, salt, pepper, seasoning powder, garlic
cac_buoc: Let's start cooking the sweet and sour stir-fried chicken gizzards with pineapple:

Step 1: Wash the chicken gizzards thoroughly, cut them in half, and then into bite-sized pieces. Place the gizzards in a medium bowl, add 1 teaspoon of salt and seasoning powder, mix well, and marinate for a while.
Step 2: Peel the pineapple, remove the eyes, wash, and slice into pieces about 8mm thick. Heat a pan with a little oil and sauté the garlic until fragrant. Add the pineapple and stir-fry briefly.

Step 3: Add the chicken gizzards and stir-fry, seasoning to taste. Cook until the gizzards are done, then turn off the heat. Add some chopped green onions, toss quickly, and transfer to a plate. The sweet and sour stir-fried chicken gizzards with pineapple is now complete.

mon_an.mo_ta: Lotus Leaf Steamed Rice – especially loved by many families for the nutty flavor of lotus seeds and the fragrance of fresh lotus leaves. Learn how to cook this delicious Lotus Leaf Steamed Rice.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fish sauce, salt, sugar, seasoning powder
cac_buoc: Step 1: Use fragrant rice to cook the rice, making it slightly dry. Wash the shrimp, peel and devein them, wash again, then marinate with a little salt and pepper.
Step 2: Wash the lotus seeds and parboil them until soft but not mushy. Dice the carrot and green beans, then blanch them in boiling water. Drain well.

Step 3: Heat a pan, sauté the minced shallots and garlic until golden, then add the shrimp and stir-fry briefly. Add the carrots and green beans. Stir well and season with fish sauce, seasoning powder or sugar, and salt.

Step 4: Add the cooked rice and lotus seeds, stirring gently so the lotus seeds don't break. Mix the rice mixture well and season to taste. Wash the lotus leaves and line a large bowl with them. Decorate the bottom with a few carrot flowers.

Step 5: Pour the rice into the leaves and fold the edges neatly. Steam for 15 minutes. After steaming, place on a plate to cool slightly. Use a sharp knife to cut the four corners of the leaf evenly and fold them back. Serve the lotus leaf steamed rice with soy sauce and fresh chilies.
Source: Ngoi sao

mon_an.mo_ta: Potato and Sausage Rice – extremely attractive for providing energy for a full day of activity. Learn how to cook this delicious Potato and Sausage Rice.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Green onions, garlic, toasted sesame seeds
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the rice; slice the sausage and potatoes thinly; mince the garlic and onion; chop the green onions. Sauté the onion and garlic in a hot pan with oil until the garlic is golden and crispy, then remove and set aside in a bowl.

Step 2: Put the rice in a pot, add water just covering the surface of the rice, add 1 tablespoon of cooking oil, and cook over low heat. Note: cook the rice on a regular stove, not a rice cooker! You can use a rice cooker liner and cook on a gas stove for speed and to prevent burning. When the water boils, stir with a spoon, lower the heat to the minimum, and cook for another 15 minutes until done.
Step 3: In a hot pan with oil, fry the potatoes until golden. Add the onion to the pan with the potatoes and sprinkle with a little salt.
Step 4: Push the potatoes to one side and add the sausage. Fry the sausage until just cooked and the edges turn brown.

Step 5: When the rice is just cooked, open the lid and arrange the sausage and potatoes on top. Keep them to one side, leaving a corner free. Crack the egg into the remaining corner, cover, and cook over low heat. Once the egg is cooked, open the lid and sprinkle with green onions and sesame seeds. To make the sauce, heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a pan, add soy sauce, sugar, and the fried garlic and onion from step 2, and stir well. Pour the sauce over the rice and enjoy.
Source: Kenh14

mon_an.mo_ta: Colorful rice balls will help you have a lunch box that is not only visually appealing but also very nutritious. With just a few simple steps, you have completed this easy-to-make delicious dish. Please refer to our guide on how to make colorful rice balls in the article below!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
In a bowl, mix the rice with a little salt and pepper; remember to mix thoroughly!
Take the yolks from the boiled eggs and mash them finely.
Boil the broccoli until cooked, then mince it very finely.
Cut the ham into bite-sized pieces and mince it finely as well.
Step 2:
Take 1/3 of the rice into another bowl, mix with the minced ham, and shape into small rice balls.
*Colorful Rice Balls - *Tip: To prevent sticking to your hands, you should apply a little olive oil to your hands; if not available, you can use cooled boiled water.
Step 3:
Take another 1/3 of the rice into a different bowl, mix with the egg yolks, and shape into bite-sized rice balls.
Step 4:
Directly add the minced broccoli to the remaining 1/3 of the rice and shape into small rice balls.

mon_an.ten: Fried Rice with Pork Belly and Pineapple
mon_an.mo_ta: More unique with fragrant pork belly fried rice placed inside an eye-catching golden pineapple, it looks so stimulating you'll want to eat it immediately!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 50g pork belly (marinated with salt, sugar, and five-spice powder)
10g corn kernels, 20g green bell pepper, 20g yellow bell pepper, 20g carrot
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Wash the pineapple, keep the skin intact, cut it in half, and scoop out all the flesh inside.
Step 2:
Dice the pineapple flesh, sausage, bell peppers, onion, and carrot.
Step 3:
Heat oil in a pan. When the oil is hot, add the diced ingredients and stir-fry evenly.
Step 4:
Add seasonings, pepper, chili powder, and ketchup to taste, then mix quickly.
Step 5:
Stir-fry for a few more minutes, then add the rice and toss thoroughly for about 5 minutes!
Step 6:
Slice the pork belly into bite-sized pieces and fry until golden brown on both sides.
The unique, hot, and sweet pineapple rice dish is now complete!
The flavor of this special "bowl" makes the dish even more delicious!
You can replace the internal ingredients with other ingredients as you like!

mon_an.mo_ta: This delicious and easy-to-make pork rib rice dish will have everyone praising it endlessly!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings - Fish sauce, salt, seasoning powder, MSG
cac_buoc: Step 1: Soak the shiitake mushrooms until soft and slice thinly. Peel, wash, and dice the carrot. Wash the ribs with vinegar, cut into bite-sized pieces, then fry until golden and slightly charred on the edges.

Step 2: Sauté minced shallots and julienned ginger with a little oil, then add the fried ribs and stir-fry briefly. Season with a little fish sauce, 3 tablespoons of soy sauce, and ½ teaspoon of seasoning powder; adjust to taste.
Step 3: Add the mushrooms and carrots to the ribs and stir well. Add enough water to just cover the surface of the ribs, then transfer to a rice cooker and bring to a boil.

Step 4: Add the washed rice, ensuring the water level is just above the rice as when cooking regular rice. If you cannot estimate the water level, you can remove the ribs first, add the rice to check the water, and then put the ribs back in. This method ensures the rice is neither dry nor mushy. Press the "cook" button as usual. When the rice is done, open the lid and fluff the rice with chopsticks.
Step 5: Serve the rib rice on a plate and enjoy while it is still hot.
The rice is sweet and fragrant, and the ribs are very tender and delicious. With just a few basic steps, you have a nutritious rib rice dish for busy days.
Good luck with this delicious pork rib rice recipe!

mon_an.ten: Perfect Home-style Braised Fish with Pork
mon_an.mo_ta: Braised fish with pork is a familiar and much-loved dish. Braised fish with pork features the irresistible aroma of fish blended with the rich, fatty taste of pork. Let's discover the recipe for this delicious dish!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fish sauce, sugar, pepper, etc. - seasonings
cac_buoc: Ingredient Preparation
Clean the fish thoroughly with water and salt, then cut into bite-sized chunks.
Wash the pork belly and slice into thick pieces.
Wash the galangal and slice thinly. Wash the tea leaves and drain.
Cooking Steps

Step 1: Line the bottom of the pot with a layer of fresh tea leaves and sliced galangal. Do not make it too thick or too thin. If it's too thin, the fish may burn and stick to the pot; if it's too thick, the fish will take longer to cook and the flavor may be overpowered.
Step 2: Next, add the fish, pork, galangal, fish sauce, and pepper to the pot. Marinate for 15-20 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Step 3: On the top layer, add some slightly crushed fresh tea leaves.
Step 4: Place the pot on the stove and cook over high heat. When the liquid in the pot is nearly evaporated, add caramel sauce and continue cooking over medium heat.
Step 5: Cook until the liquid is almost gone, then turn off the heat and let it cool.
Step 6: Continue cooking the pot over low heat until the liquid evaporates and the ingredients are tender and well-cooked.
Notes
Remember to clean the fish very thoroughly; grass carp is a great choice for braising. Proper cleaning prevents fishiness and removes slime, making the dish more fragrant.
Braising the pork with the fish until tender makes it more delicious.
Besides pork, you can also braise fish with bananas. Braised bananas become soft and flavorful.
If you don't like using commercial caramel sauce, you can use traditional bitter caramel (kẹo đắng) as it has a specific sweet-salty balance and provides an attractive aroma.
Braised fish with pork or bananas is perfect with hot rice on cold winter days. This dish will enhance your family meal and surely earn compliments. Get in the kitchen and try it!
How to choose fresh fish:
Fresh fish eyes are bulging and translucent; stale fish eyes are usually sunken and cloudy.
For fresh fish, the vent is deep inside, pale white, and the belly is flat. Conversely, stale fish has a pink or dark red protruding vent and a bloated belly.
Fresh fish gills are reddish-pink, not slimy, and have no foul odor. Stale fish gills are gray and slimy.
The mouth of fresh fish is tightly closed, while stale or spoiled fish has a slightly open mouth.
Fresh fish meat is firm and elastic, leaving no finger indentation when pressed.

mon_an.ten: Delicious Boiled Shrimp with Cinnamon and Star Anise
mon_an.mo_ta: Shrimp contains a lot of calcium which is very good for the body. Instead of regular boiled shrimp, it will be more delicious with a little star anise, cinnamon, and pepper. Let's see the secret to this boiled shrimp dish!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Poaching liquid - 1 green onion; 5g salt; 15g white peppercorns; 4-6 star anise; 2 pieces of cinnamon; 30ml cooking wine; 2 liters of water
cac_buoc: Step 1: Add the water and all poaching liquid ingredients to a pot. Bring to a boil until the salt dissolves, then lower the heat and simmer for 15 minutes.
Step 2: Wash the shrimp.
Once the poaching liquid is ready, scoop half of it into a bowl and add ice to create a soaking liquid for the shrimp.
Place the shrimp into the remaining liquid in the pot and boil until the shells turn pink and the shrimp curl up.
Then, remove the shrimp and soak them in the bowl of chilled poaching liquid prepared earlier.
Soak for about 10-15 minutes, then remove the shrimp and enjoy. You can serve these cinnamon and star anise boiled shrimp with salt, pepper, and lime or chili sauce!

mon_an.ten: Shrimp Shumai Recipe for a Delicious Meal
mon_an.mo_ta: These sweet and savory shrimp shumai will make your family meal even more delicious.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings: salt, sugar, oyster sauce, soy sauce, pepper
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, peel the shrimp, remove the heads and tails, devein them, and place them in a bowl.
Step 2:
Add 2 tbsp of egg white, 1 tbsp of cornstarch, and a pinch of salt. Mix well by hand and set aside.
Step 3:

Place the small shrimp and pork fat into a blender and pulse briefly so they are no longer in large chunks. If you want to be more careful, you can also mash them by hand. Note that if mashing by hand, you should mash the ingredients separately before mixing them together!
Step 4:
Add 4 finely chopped green onion whites, cornstarch, egg white, ginger juice, rice wine, and seasonings to the mixture from step 3, then blend until smooth.
Prepare a steamer and line the bottom of the steaming tray with a layer of napa cabbage.
Step 5:
Prepare the shumai wrappers and place a small amount of the mixture from step 4 in the center.
Step 6:
Add 1 shrimp from the mixture in step 2.
Step 7:
Add another 1 tsp of the shrimp mixture from step 4.
Step 8:
Finally, place another shrimp from step 2 on top. Make sure the outer side of the shrimp faces up for a more beautiful presentation.
Step 9:
Once the water boils, turn off the heat and arrange the shumai in the steamer, making sure they do not touch each other. Cover with a damp cloth and then close the lid.
Step 10:
Turn the heat back on and steam the shumai over high heat for 8 minutes.
When eating, serve with a bit of vinegar and mustard!

mon_an.ten: Irresistible Sweet and Sour Orange Chicken Recipe
mon_an.mo_ta: Orange chicken attracts diners not only with the fragrant aroma of fresh oranges, the richness of the chicken, and the sweet and sour sauce but also with its appealing color. Let's get into the kitchen and follow the instructions.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Soy sauce, sesame oil, green onions, white sesame seeds - for garnish
cac_buoc: Step 1: Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces, then place the meat in a food-grade plastic bag. Mix the egg whites, cornstarch, rice vinegar, baking powder, and salt in a bowl, then add to the chicken.
Step 2: Seal the bag and marinate the chicken for about 30 minutes to let the flavors penetrate the meat.
Step 3: To make the sauce, grate the orange zest and squeeze the oranges for juice!
Step 4: Sauté the ginger and orange zest in a pan with hot oil.
Step 5: Add all the sauce ingredients to the pan except for the green onions and white sesame seeds. Simmer until the sauce thickens.
Step 6: In another pan, deep-fry the chicken until it turns golden brown on all sides. Once fried, remove the chicken and drain the excess oil.
Step 7: Add the chicken to the sauce prepared in step 5, then sprinkle green onions and white sesame seeds on top for garnish.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Simple and Authentic Cucumber and Carrot Salad
mon_an.mo_ta: Cucumber is a familiar, refreshing, and easy-to-eat ingredient. To enrich your parties or family meals, add this simple cucumber salad to make the meal more diverse and memorable. Let's find out more in the article below! I. Instructions for making crispy sweet and sour cucumber salad
cac_buoc: 1. Prepare ingredients
Cucumbers: 3-4
Carrot: 1
Roasted peanuts
Garlic, chili
Herbs: Cilantro, basil
Sugar, fish sauce, salt, and lime or vinegar.
2. Preparation steps

Step 1: To make a crispy cucumber salad, start by keeping the cucumber skin on. Wash the cucumbers and soak them in diluted salt water for about 15 minutes, then rinse and drain. Cut off both ends of the cucumbers to avoid bitterness, halve them, and optionally remove the seeds. Next, slice the cucumbers into bite-sized pieces.

Step 2: Peel the carrot, wash it, and shred it into small strips. Peel and mince the garlic along with the horn chili. Wash the herbs and chop them finely. Crush the roasted peanuts and remove the skins.
Step 3: Prepare the dressing by combining 2 tbsp sugar, 2 tbsp fish sauce, and 1 tbsp lime juice or white vinegar. Stir until the mixture dissolves, then add the minced garlic and chili.

Step 4: Mix the sliced cucumbers and shredded carrots in a bowl, pour the prepared dressing over them, add the herbs, and toss well. Let it sit for about 7-10 minutes, then serve the cucumber and carrot salad on a plate, sprinkling peanuts on top for garnish before enjoying.
II. Instructions for making crispy cucumber and carrot salad
Cucumbers: 5
Carrot: a little (about a small section)
Garlic: 10 grams
Chilies: 2
Basil: a little
Roasted sesame seeds: a little
Lime juice: 1 tbsp
Seasoning: 10 grams
2. Preparation
2.1. Prepare the carrot
Peel the carrot, then use a peeler to create long, thin strips.
In a bowl, mix the carrot with 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp sugar, stirring well so the carrot absorbs the seasoning.
Let the carrot marinate for about 3 minutes, then rinse with water and soak in a bowl of ice water to make it crispier.
2.2. Prepare other ingredients
Halve the cucumbers and use a spoon to remove the seeds. Use a knife to cut the cucumbers into slices about 1cm thick.
Place the sliced cucumbers in ice water and soak for about 20 minutes to make them crispy.
Pick the basil leaves, remove any damaged ones, wash, and chop them.
Peel and mince the garlic; remove the stems and mince the chilies.
2.3. Prepare the dressing
Place a pot on the stove, add 2 tbsp sugar, 2 tbsp vegan fish sauce, and 1 tbsp lime juice. Stir until the mixture boils and the sugar dissolves completely, then turn off the heat.
Pour the lime-sugar fish sauce into a bowl, then add the minced garlic and chili and stir well.
2.4. Mix the salad

After soaking, drain the cucumbers and carrots and place them on a plate, then add the herbs on top. Pour the prepared dressing evenly over the entire plate, then sprinkle roasted sesame seeds on top to finish the dish.
The cucumber and carrot salad with its rich dressing, blending sweet and sour flavors with crispy, refreshing carrots and cucumbers, creates an irresistible appeal!
III. Instructions for making crispy pig ear and cucumber salad
Cucumbers: 3
Onion: 1
Pig ear: 300g
Garlic, shallots, chili
Herbs: Basil, Vietnamese coriander
Sugar, fish sauce, salt, MSG, lime or vinegar, and a little ground pepper
2. How to make crispy pig ear and cucumber salad

Step 1: Prepare the cucumbers and carrots following the previous instructions. Peel the onion, slice it thinly, and soak it in a bowl of ice water mixed with 2 tbsp vinegar to soften it and reduce the pungency. Wash and mince the garlic and chili. Pick, wash, and chop the herbs.

Step 2: Prepare the pig ear by rubbing it with sea salt and vinegar to remove odors and clean any dirt. Boil a pot of water, add 3 shallots and 1/2 tsp salt, and boil the pig ear. Once cooked, remove it and immediately soak it in a bowl of ice water until cool. This is the secret to making the pig ear crispy and more attractive with a nice color. Then, slice the pig ear thinly.

Step 3: To prepare the dressing for the cucumber salad, combine the following in a bowl: 2 tbsp sugar, 2 tbsp fish sauce, 2 tbsp lime juice or vinegar, 1 tsp MSG, and 1/2 tsp ground pepper. Stir until the sugar and MSG dissolve, then add the minced garlic and chili.

Step 4: Add the pig ear, cucumbers, carrots, and onions to a bowl, then pour the dressing over them. Wear gloves and mix all ingredients thoroughly so they are well-coated and seasoned. After about 5 minutes, add the herbs, toss again, and serve on a plate.
IV. How to buy cucumbers that are not bitter
Choose cucumbers with a bright green, uniform color, without bruises or yellow spots, as these are signs of old or spoiling cucumbers.
Choose straight cucumbers that are not overly curved. Long, uniform-sized cucumbers usually have denser flesh and are crispier than short, round ones.
Select cucumbers that feel heavy for their size, have smooth skin without bumps, and prioritize smaller ones as they are often sweeter than large cucumbers.
Avoid buying cucumbers with unusual shapes like bulging in the middle or having a tail larger than the head (and vice versa), as these are signs of old cucumbers with many seeds and tough flesh.
If you accidentally buy bitter cucumbers, you can peel them to remove the bitter part.

mon_an.ten: Meatballs Stuffed with Quail Eggs in a Unique Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: There are many recipes for quail egg meatballs, but the sauce makes this one stand out. It will make the dish taste completely different. Let's see if this sauce recipe differs from the versions you already know!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings - 0ml soy sauce, 5ml wine, 5g salt, 8g sugar, half an egg white, 5g flour, one star anise.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Finely grind the pork belly and mince the lotus root.
Step 2:
Place the meat in a large bowl and add minced scallions, minced ginger, wine, soy sauce, salt, sugar, egg white, and a little flour.
Then, mix everything thoroughly in one direction.
Step 3:
Next, add the minced lotus root and continue to mix well.
Step 4:
Take a portion of the ground meat and place a quail egg in the center. Roll it into a ball; about 200-250g of meat per ball is sufficient.
Step 5:
Prepare a pan of hot oil and add the meatballs. Fry until the meat turns golden, then remove and drain.
Step 6:
Add a little water to a pot, then add star anise, soy sauce, and a little sugar.
Step 7:
Heat until the water is almost boiling, then add the fried meatballs. When the water boils again, switch to low heat. Simmer for a while until the liquid in the pot begins to thicken.
Step 8:
Prepare a pot of boiling water and blanch some greens until cooked to serve on the side.
You can replace quail eggs with chicken egg yolks!
This dish is delicious when eaten with hot rice and boiled vegetables.

mon_an.ten: Radish Stir-fry with Eggs – A Weight Loss Recipe
mon_an.mo_ta: Radish stir-fry with eggs is not only delicious but also provides nutrition and is low in calories, making it a perfect choice for those looking to lose weight. With the wonderful combination of fresh radishes and rich eggs, this dish will satisfy your taste buds without worrying about accumulating too many calories. Let's learn how to prepare and cook this dish to enjoy its unique flavor and health benefits! Instructions for cooking radish stir-fry with eggs - a delicious and weight-loss-friendly dish combining fresh radishes and fragrant eggs. Enjoy the unique flavor and health benefits of this dish.
cac_buoc: 1. Prepare ingredients
After buying the radishes, peel, wash, and cut them into sections about 2 finger-joints long. Place the prepared radishes in a bowl.
Put the radishes in a pot and add enough water to cover them. Bring to a boil, then cover and keep on the stove for another 3 minutes to let the radishes cook through.
After boiling, remove the radishes from the water and drain before use.
2. How to make radish stir-fry with eggs
Pour 2 tbsp of cooking oil into a pan and heat it up. When the oil is hot, add the boiled radishes and stir-fry for about 3 minutes over high heat.
Then, lower the heat to medium. Crack 2 eggs into the pan and stir-fry evenly, stirring constantly for about 2 minutes so the eggs coat the radishes.
Season with 2 tsp seasoning powder and 1 tsp MSG. Continue to stir-fry so the seasonings penetrate the radishes and eggs. If needed, you can adjust the seasoning to your taste.

Once finished, present the radish stir-fry on a plate and sprinkle some ground pepper on top for a finishing touch. This stir-fry is simple yet delicious. When eating, you can serve it with a bit of soy sauce and a few chili slices to enhance the flavor and provide a diverse culinary experience. A meal with radish stir-fry will be interesting and nutritious.
Notes on buying fresh eggs
Check the egg surface: Choose eggs with a white powdery layer on the shell. When holding the egg, it should feel firm and not slippery, which indicates the egg is fresh.

Check by candling: Try candling the egg under a light to observe the inside. A fresh egg will have a transparent pink yolk with a pink dot in the center. The air cell in the egg should be no more than 1 cm in diameter and surrounded by a fixed, non-moving line.
Avoid abnormal eggs: Do not buy eggs with uneven colors, blood spots, or parasites inside.
Listen for sound when shaking: Old eggs often make a sound when shaken. Avoid buying eggs that make noise, as it is a sign they have been kept for a long time and are no longer good.
Check color and smell: Do not buy eggs with dull, cloudy gray colors or a faint foul odor. This indicates the eggs are no longer fresh.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Delicious Chili Garlic Stir-fried Crab
mon_an.mo_ta: Chili Garlic Stir-fried Crab – we will guide you on how to make chili garlic stir-fried crab from simple, familiar ingredients transformed into a delicious new dish. Check out our method for this dish in the content below!
cac_buoc: Step 1: How to prepare the crab: Clean the crab, cut into pieces, and remove the sharp tips of the legs. For large claws, use the back of a heavy knife to lightly crack them. Then place in a basket to drain. If you want to eat them crispy and whole, use field crabs instead.
Step 2: Peel and wash the ginger. Slit the chilies and remove some seeds. Mince the ginger and chilies.

Step 3: Marinate the crab meat with a little seasoning powder and salt for flavor, then add some frying flour and toss well to coat the crab. Heat oil in a pan, sauté the garlic until golden, then remove immediately. Next, fry the crab until golden brown. Once cooked and golden, remove the crab and drain the oil.

Step 4: Using the same pan used for frying the crab, add the crab back along with the fried garlic, minced shallots, ginger, and chilies. Mix well and stir-fry together. Then, season to taste, add green onions, toss well, and turn off the heat. Serve on a plate and enjoy while hot.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Mixed Stir-fried Rice Vermicelli
mon_an.mo_ta: Make mixed stir-fried rice vermicelli for the weekend – A delicious, easy-to-make dish for you to show off your cooking skills to your loved ones. Learn to cook delicious meals with simple yet tasty dishes like this.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, oyster sauce, seasoning powder, green onions
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients:
Soak wood ear mushrooms in hot water until expanded, then rinse with cold water, remove the stems, and julienne.
Wash the broccoli and cut into small pieces. Trim the roots of the green onions, wash, and cut into sections.
Peel and julienne the carrot; peel the onion and cut into wedges.
Step 2:
Peel and devein the shrimp, then wash and drain. Sauté garlic in a pan with oil, then add the shrimp and stir-fry briefly until just cooked. Turn off the heat and remove to a plate.
Beat the eggs with a little fish sauce for aroma, then fry into a thin omelet. Place on a cutting board and shred into strips.
Step 3: Soak the rice vermicelli in a bowl of water. If using warm water, pay attention to the time, otherwise the noodles will easily become mushy, making the stir-fry less enjoyable.

Step 4: Place a pan on the stove, sauté garlic and green onions, then add the carrots and broccoli in turn and stir-fry until cooked. Then add the wood ear mushrooms, shrimp, and onion along with a little oyster sauce.

Step 5: Finally, add the eggs and rice vermicelli. Stir-fry gently, season to taste, and monitor the cooking time so the vermicelli doesn't get mushy. When the noodles are soft, the dish is complete. Serve on a plate and enjoy hot with your family.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Sea Bass Fillet with Pineapple Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: Sea bass fillet with pineapple sauce is a combination of meat, fish, and seafood... fruit-based dishes not only bring a unique flavor but also provide many vitamins and nutrients during cold weather. Check out how to make this dish in the article below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Oil for frying, fish or chicken stock
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Marinate the sea bass fillet with salt and pepper; let it sit for 10 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Step 2:
Peel the pineapple and remove the eyes. Cut 2 thin slices for garnish and dice the rest. Wash the lettuce and cherry tomatoes, then drain.
Step 3:
Pineapple sauce: Heat 1 tbsp of oil, sauté the minced garlic until golden, add the diced pineapple and stir-fry gently over low heat. Season with vinegar, sugar, and seasoning powder to taste.
Step 4:

Mix 50g of flour with the egg and enough stock to make a thick batter. Coat the sea bass with the flour mixture, then roll in panko breadcrumbs. Drop into a pan of hot oil and fry until golden brown. Remove and drain the oil.
Step 5:
Place the pineapple slices on a plate, top with the fried sea bass, and pour the pineapple sauce over it. Serve hot with lettuce and cherry tomatoes.
Quick tip
Coating the fish in the cooked flour mixture before frying helps reduce the amount of moisture escaping from the fish, preventing it from drying out.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Delicious Yardlong Bean Stir-fry with Shrimp and Pork
mon_an.mo_ta: Mentioning yardlong bean stir-fry with shrimp and pork immediately brings to mind a nutritious dish with vitamins from vegetables and protein from meat and shrimp, perfectly seasoned and beautifully presented.
