Just thinking about it makes me crave it. Let's learn how to cook this dish according to the recipe.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings - As needed (fish sauce, salt, pepper)
cac_buoc: Prepare ingredients
Wash the dried shrimp, soak until soft, then crush them.
Peel and mince the shallot and garlic. Remove seeds from the chili and mince it.
Mince or grind the pork shoulder, then marinate with minced shallot, pepper, fish sauce, and seasoning powder to taste.
Trim the ends and remove the strings from the yardlong beans, break into 5cm lengths, and wash.
Wash and cut the green onions and cilantro into sections.
Stir-fry the beans with shrimp and meat
Blanch the beans in boiling water and remove immediately to keep them green.
Sauté half of the minced garlic and shallots, then add the yardlong beans and toss well. Season with pepper and seasoning powder to taste, then remove to a plate.

Continue by sautéing the remaining minced garlic, shallots, and chili. Add the minced meat and crushed dried shrimp, stir-fry until cooked. Add the chopped green onions and cilantro, toss well, then pour the mixture over the plate of stir-fried beans.

mon_an.ten: Snow Pea Stir-fry with Shrimp and Mushrooms
mon_an.mo_ta: A simple stir-fry for family meals that is nonetheless very attractive. This dish has high nutritional value. Snow pea stir-fry with shrimp and mushrooms features the crisp sweetness of snow peas, the light sweetness of mushrooms, and the delicate sweetness of shrimp. Let's learn to cook this delicious dish!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Green onions, salt, fish sauce, seasoning powder, pepper
cac_buoc: Snow pea stir-fry with shrimp and mushrooms is great with rice; grab your notebook to write down the recipe.

Step 1: Remove the strings from both sides of the snow peas. Wash and drain. Trim the roots of the shimeji mushrooms, wash, and soak in diluted salt water for 15 minutes. Then remove and drain. Wash the green onions and cut into 2cm lengths.
Step 2: Peel and devein the shrimp, wash, and lightly crush them.
Step 3: Place a pan on the stove, add oil, sauté the garlic, and briefly stir-fry the shrimp.

Step 4: Add the snow peas and stir-fry quickly over high heat for about 3 minutes. Then add the mushrooms and stir-fry together. Season with salt, fish sauce, and seasoning powder to taste. Stir-fry for another 7 minutes, then turn off the heat and add the green onions, tossing briefly until wilted. Serve on a plate and the snow pea stir-fry with shrimp and mushrooms is complete.

mon_an.ten: Steamed Silken Tofu with Shiitake Mushrooms
mon_an.mo_ta: Let's make Steamed Silken Tofu with Shiitake Mushrooms – a delicious and easy-to-make dinner recipe. This steamed dish is refreshing yet packed with nutrition for a family meal.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Wash the shiitake mushrooms and remove the stems. You can use a sharp knife to carve a star shape on the mushroom caps for a beautiful presentation.
Peel the ginger, wash it, and slice it thinly.
Slice the silken tofu into pieces about 1cm thick. Slice the ham into pieces of the same size as the tofu.
Keep the bok choy whole, wash thoroughly, blanch until cooked, then split lengthwise.
Step 2: Make the sauce
Mix 2 tbsp oyster sauce, 1/2 tbsp sugar, 1/2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp water, 1 tbsp tapioca starch, 1 tbsp sesame oil, and ground pepper. Heat the mixture until it boils and thickens.
Step 3: Steam the tofu and mushrooms
Add water to a steamer and bring to a boil.

Take a deep plate and arrange the bok choy around the edge (cut side down). Then, layer the silken tofu, ham, ginger, and shiitake mushrooms on top. Add a few slices of chili and pour the sauce prepared in step 2 over everything.
Once the water is boiling, place the plate in the steamer for about 10-15 minutes, then turn off the heat. Remove and serve hot.

This steamed tofu dish is a perfect harmony of ingredients, providing essential nutrients like animal protein, plant protein, fiber, vitamins, and minerals. The silken tofu is soft and cool, fragrant with mushrooms and ginger, balanced by the sweetness of the bok choy and a hint of heat from the chili. It is truly an irresistible dish.

Tips: Using silken tofu is best because it is soft, smooth, and melts in your mouth, making it perfect for steaming. However, if silken tofu is unavailable, regular tofu can be used. You can also replace the ham with fresh meats like pork belly. Since this dish involves pouring sauce and the ingredients release juices during steaming, remember to use a deep plate so the sauce and the natural sweetness from the meat, mushrooms, vegetables, and tofu can blend together. When eating, drizzle this sauce over the tofu and meat for the best flavor.

mon_an.mo_ta: This Crispy Shrimp-Wrapped Tofu is very easy to prepare, yet its flavor is delicious, unique, and highly appealing. Let's try making this for the whole family!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Minced the pork. Peel and mince one portion of the shrimp. Pat the tofu dry, mash it thoroughly, and place it in a bowl with 1 tbsp tapioca starch, 1 tbsp oyster sauce, and ½ tsp seasoning powder.
Step 2:
Mix the mixture well.
Step 3:
Peel the remaining shrimp, leaving the tails intact.
Step 4:
Take a portion of the tofu-meat mixture, flatten it out, place a whole shrimp in the center, and roll it into a ball.
Step 5:
Repeat until all ingredients are used.
Step 6:
Beat the egg in a bowl. Place the frying flour and breadcrumbs into two separate bowls. Roll each ball through the flour.
Then dip into the egg and finally coat with breadcrumbs.
Step 7:
Heat oil in a pan and deep-fry the shrimp balls until golden brown.
Step 8: Once the crispy shrimp-wrapped tofu is cooked, remove to a plate lined with paper towels and enjoy while hot.
Dip in chili sauce for a wonderful snack.
Enjoy your crispy shrimp-wrapped tofu!

mon_an.ten: Steamed Tofu with Shrimp and Mushrooms
mon_an.mo_ta: Steamed Tofu with Shrimp and Mushrooms – an easy-to-make dish to turn a boring menu into something more interesting.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, pepper, oyster sauce, seasoning powder, dried shallots
Soy sauce, sweet and sour chili sauce, sugar - 1 tbsp each
Sesame oil, oyster sauce - 1 tsp each
cac_buoc: Step 1: Remove the silken tofu from the package, use a clean towel to pat dry, and cut into equal matchbox-sized pieces.

Step 2: Prepare the ingredients: Trim the mushroom stems, wash, and soak in salt water for 15 minutes. Mince 2/3 of the mushrooms and leave the remaining 1/3 whole. Wash and finely chop the green onions.

Step 3: Peel and devein the shrimp, wash, then coarsely crush them. Mix the shrimp and minced pork with the egg, minced shallots, pepper, salt, tapioca starch, and a bit of seasoning powder. Mix well and marinate for 30 minutes so the dish is flavorful.
Step 4: Scoop a small amount of the shrimp and meat mixture onto the surface of one tofu piece, then gently place another tofu piece on top. Place in a steamer and steam for about 20-25 minutes.

Step 5: In a small pot, sauté the shallots until fragrant, add the remaining mushrooms and stir-fry. Slowly pour in the sauce mixture and simmer until thickened. Adjust the seasoning to taste and add chopped green onions. To serve, arrange the tofu on a plate, pour the sauce over it, and enjoy hot with rice.

mon_an.ten: Braised Tofu with Pickled Mustard Greens
mon_an.mo_ta: Braised Tofu with Pickled Mustard Greens – a delicious and easy dish to refresh your daily menu.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, sugar, fish sauce, dried shallots, green onions
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients:
Wash the tofu and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Wash the pickled mustard greens and squeeze out the excess water to reduce acidity and saltiness. Cut into bite-sized pieces.

Step 2: Place the minced pork in a bowl, add a tsp of salt, a little pepper, and minced shallots. Mix well and marinate for 15 minutes. Heat a little oil in a pot, sauté the shallots until fragrant, and stir-fry the meat until cooked.

Step 3: Add the tofu and Korean chili paste to the pot with the meat, shake the pot gently to combine, and cover with a lid. Cook for another 10 minutes, then open the lid, drizzle in some fish sauce and sugar, and continue to simmer over low heat.

Step 4: Add the pickled mustard greens. If the pot is dry, add a little filtered water and continue to cook for about 25-30 minutes. Adjust the seasoning to taste, top with green onions, and turn off the heat. Serve the braised tofu and pickled greens hot with rice.
Source: Ngoi sao

mon_an.ten: Braised Tofu with Pork Paste Balls
mon_an.mo_ta: Braised Tofu with Pork Paste Balls – a savory dish featuring a unique combination of pork paste and tofu. Check out our recipe below. We hope this helps you create a delicious meal for your family. Learn to cook this dish for a relaxing day.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Wood ear mushrooms - A few pieces
Fish sauce, sugar, seasoning powder, pepper
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients. Wash the silken tofu and cut into cubes.

Step 2: Soak the wood ear mushrooms until expanded, wash, remove the stems, and mince finely. Wash and finely chop the cilantro. Mix the wood ear mushrooms and cilantro with the pork paste, then add some minced shallots, pepper, and salt. Mix well.
Step 3: Heat oil in a pot, sauté the garlic and satay chili, then add the tofu and stir-fry gently.
Step 4: Cook for about 2 minutes, then add about half a bowl of cold water. When it boils, use a spoon to scoop the pork paste mixture from step 2 into the pot and add the broccoli to cook together.

Step 5: Simmer over low heat for about 12 minutes, then season to taste. Cook for another 15 minutes so the tofu and pork paste absorb the flavors. Dissolve tapioca starch in a bowl of water, pour slowly into the pot, and stir gently. Cook until the sauce thickens slightly, then turn off the heat and add chopped green onions. Serve the braised tofu and pork paste hot with rice.

mon_an.ten: Fried Tofu with Lemongrass and Chili
mon_an.mo_ta: Fried Tofu with Lemongrass and Chili for a delicious dinner that doesn't take too much time. Let's learn how to cook this unique dish!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fish sauce, sugar, soy sauce, fresh chili
cac_buoc: Let's make Fried Tofu with Lemongrass and Chili for tonight's dinner.
Step 1: Rinse the tofu with water, cut into bite-sized pieces, and drain well.
Step 2: Peel and mince the garlic. Trim the lemongrass, wash, and mince finely. Mix the lemongrass, garlic, and minced chili together in a small bowl.
Step 3: Fry the tofu until all sides are golden brown. Remove to a plate lined with paper towels to absorb excess oil.
Step 4: Sauté the garlic, chili, and lemongrass mixture until fragrant. Add 2 tbsp fish sauce and 1 tbsp sugar, and bring to a simmer.
Step 5: Add the fried tofu to the pan and cook until the tofu is evenly coated and infused with the flavors. Serve on a plate, eat hot with rice, and dip in soy sauce mixed with garlic and chili.

mon_an.ten: Tofu with Minced Meat Sauce – A Dish for Every Home
mon_an.mo_ta: The perfect combination of refreshing tofu, sweet and sour tomatoes, and savory minced meat creates an incredibly attractive dish. Get into the kitchen and make this delicious meal! This is a wonderful, appealing dish suitable for the whole family. Discover the recipe and steps to create a rich dish that harmonizes soft tofu with flavorful minced meat sauce.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning powder, fish sauce, salt, cooking oil - seasonings
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash and dice the carrot and onion. Cut the tomatoes into wedges. Wash and halve the straw mushrooms. Wash the tofu, cut into bite-sized pieces, and drain.
Heat oil in a pan, fry the tofu until crispy, and remove to a plate.

Step 2: Add a little more oil to the pan and sauté the minced shallots until fragrant. Next, add the tomatoes, carrots, and minced meat and stir-fry. When the sauce begins to thicken, add salt, seasoning powder, and fish sauce to taste. Add the onion and straw mushrooms and stir-fry quickly.
Step 3: When the sauce is thick and the meat is cooked, add the fried tofu to the pan and sprinkle with green onions.
Step 4: Stir quickly, turn off the heat, and arrange on a plate for decoration.
How to choose fresh ingredients
Choosing fresh pork

When choosing whole pieces of pork, color is the first important factor. Good pork is bright pink, not too red or pale. Avoid pork that is pale, greenish, or has a foul odor, as this indicates it is spoiled.
Good pork is firm and highly elastic. You can check by pressing your finger into the meat. If it quickly returns to its original shape without being slimy or leaking fluid, it is good meat.
Choose pork shoulder (nạc dăm), which has a balance of fat and lean meat to ensure the dish is neither dry nor too greasy.
You can grind the pork yourself at home or buy pre-minced meat. If buying pre-minced, choose reputable stores or supermarkets. Ensure the meat is kept refrigerated and the packaging is intact.
Choosing good tofu
When buying silken tofu, choose products with intact packaging that is not torn or damaged. This ensures the tofu is kept in the best condition.
Be sure to read the expiration date printed on the packaging. This helps you avoid buying expired products.
Choosing fresh eggs
When buying eggs, choose those with a uniform shell color, without cracks or black spots. This indicates the eggs have been handled well.
When holding an egg and touching the shell, you should feel a slightly rough surface. This indicates the egg is fresh.
When holding an egg up to the light, if you see a small air cell and the yolk is in a fixed position and doesn't move much, it is a fresh egg.
Limit buying eggs with pale shells and many black spots, as this may indicate they are no longer fresh.
You can also try gently shaking the egg near your ear. If you hear a loud sound, the egg has been sitting for a long time.
Notes when making Tofu with Minced Meat Sauce
Choose fresh tofu: Buy tofu with a bright color, no cracks, and no signs of spoilage. Fresh tofu will have a better sweetness and texture.
Choosing minced meat: Use fresh pork or chicken as desired. Choose meat with little fat and a soft texture for the best results.

Prepare other ingredients: Depending on your taste, you can add vegetables like onions, garlic, carrots, mushrooms, or seasonings like salt, sugar, pepper, soy sauce, or scallion oil to enhance the flavor.
Processing: When frying tofu, use medium heat to ensure it cooks evenly without burning. When stir-frying minced meat, make sure to break it up and combine it with seasonings for a rich flavor.
Cooking time: Tofu cooks quickly, so check the doneness of the tofu and meat to ensure they are cooked just right.
Enjoy hot: Tofu with minced meat sauce is best enjoyed immediately after cooking. The crispy tofu and sweet, savory meat will provide a great experience for everyone.

mon_an.ten: Simple Stir-Fried Tofu with Onion and Ginger
mon_an.mo_ta: Next is an interesting variation with tofu. Golden fried tofu stir-fried with onions and ginger will bring surprising delights. Learn to cook with this simple dish. The rich tofu pieces are eaten with sweet onions and warm, spicy ginger. This dish uses very simple cooking methods and ingredients.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, sugar, oyster sauce, garlic, fish sauce
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the tofu, cut into bite-sized pieces, and fry until golden on all sides. Remove from the pan to a plate lined with paper towels.
Step 2: Wash, peel, and finely slice the ginger. Peel the onion and cut into wedges. Wash the green onions and cut into 2cm lengths. Peel and crush the garlic.
Step 3: Place a pan on the stove, add a little oil, and when hot, sauté the garlic until fragrant. Add the ginger and onion and stir-fry.

Step 4: Add the tofu to the stir-fry. Season with a little salt, fish sauce, oyster sauce, and sugar to taste. Mix the tapioca starch with water and pour into the pan. Cook until the sauce thickens, then turn off the heat. Stir in the green onions.
The steps for this simple stir-fried tofu with onion and ginger are now complete. This dish is best served hot with rice.

mon_an.ten: Spicy Stir-Fried Tofu with Minced Meat
mon_an.mo_ta: With familiar ingredients like tofu and minced pork, we can still create new dishes like this Spicy Stir-Fried Tofu with Minced Meat. This is a delicious, easy-to-make dish that saves a lot of cooking time. Let's learn this new recipe!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, sugar, oyster sauce, soy sauce, seasoning powder, fish sauce, pepper
cac_buoc: Here are the steps to cook Spicy Stir-Fried Tofu with Minced Meat:
Step 1: Wash the tofu and cut into bite-sized pieces. Place in a colander to drain. Heat oil in a pan and fry the tofu until golden on all sides. When cooked, remove to a plate and let cool slightly.

Step 2: Peel and mince the garlic. Wash, peel, and mince the ginger with the garlic. Place the minced pork in a bowl, marinate with 1 tsp salt, a little pepper, and 1 tsp fish sauce. Mix well and let sit for a while.
Step 3: Heat oil in a pan and sauté the garlic and ginger until fragrant. Add the meat and stir-fry until cooked, then remove to a small bowl.
Step 4: Using the same pan, add 1 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp water, 1 tsp sugar, and satay chili to taste. Bring to a boil. Once boiling, add the fried tofu.

Step 5: Add the stir-fried meat back into the pan. Continue to cook, adding a little oyster sauce, until the sauce thickens. Adjust the seasoning to taste. Add chopped green onions, stir well, and turn off the heat. Serve the spicy stir-fried tofu on a plate and enjoy while hot.

mon_an.mo_ta: Tofu in satay sauce with its characteristic spicy kick is an extremely attractive dish that goes perfectly with rice on cold days. The balance between meat, tofu, and the heat of the satay makes this an irresistible dish.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Tofu - 1 box of fresh tofu (can be replaced with regular tofu, but silken is better)
Minced lean pork - 150g (choose pork shoulder for tenderness)
cac_buoc: Preparation
Peel, crush, and mince the shallots. Wash and finely chop the green onions and cilantro.
Cut the tofu into small cubes.
Peel the tomatoes (score the skin and dip in boiling water for easier peeling), remove seeds, and dice.
Execution:
Step 1: Heat oil in a pan and sauté 2/3 of the minced shallots until fragrant.
Step 2: Add the meat, season to taste, and stir-fry over high heat.
Step 3: When the meat is firm and cooked, remove and set aside.
Step 4: Add another tbsp of oil to the pan, sauté the remaining shallots, then add the tomatoes and seasonings to taste.
Step 5: Stir-fry the tomatoes thoroughly until they soften into a sauce.
Step 6: Add the stir-fried meat from step 3 back in, add the oyster sauce and satay, and stir for about 2 minutes so the meat and tomatoes absorb the flavors.
Step 7: Add enough water to just cover the meat and bring to a boil.
Step 8: Add the tofu.
Step 9: Gently shake the pot and simmer for about 5 minutes for the tofu to absorb the seasonings.
Note: Absolutely do not use chopsticks to stir the tofu; fresh tofu is very soft and breaks easily. Using chopsticks will ruin the presentation.
Step 10: Add the chopped green onions and cilantro, then serve hot.

mon_an.mo_ta: Squid Stir-fry with Mushrooms – A delicious and easy-to-make dish using very familiar ingredients from your kitchen. Learn to cook basic and simple dishes like this flavorful squid stir-fry.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Green onions, garlic, fish sauce, sugar, pepper, salt
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients for the Squid Stir-fry with Mushrooms
Peel and wash the carrot, then julienne. Peel and wash the onion, then cut into wedges.
Trim the mushroom stems, soak in diluted salt water for 15 minutes, then remove and drain. Cut into bite-sized pieces.
Trim the roots of the green onions and cut into segments.
Step 2: Clean the squid to remove any fishy odor and slime. Cut the squid into bite-sized rings.

Step 3: Heat oil in a pan. Once the oil is hot, sauté the garlic until fragrant, then add the squid and stir-fry until just cooked. Season with salt and other seasonings to taste, then remove to a plate and set aside. Keep the squid juices in the pan.
Step 4: Using the same pan with the squid juices, first lightly stir-fry the carrots, then add the onions and mushrooms and stir-fry until cooked. Adjust the seasoning.

Step 5: Once the vegetable mixture is fully cooked, add the squid back in. Stir-fry quickly over high heat, then add the green onions and toss briefly. Serve the dish on a plate and enjoy hot with rice.
Source: Ngoisao

mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried Pork with Pickled Greens – A simple and easy-to-make dish for beginners. A guide on how to cook Stir-fried Pork with Pickled Greens.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash and slice the lean pork. Squeeze the pickled greens to remove excess liquid (reducing sourness and saltiness), then cut into bite-sized pieces. Halve the bell pepper, remove the seeds, and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Step 2: Place a pan on the stove, add a little cooking oil, and stir-fry the pickled greens first. Since the greens are already salty, there is no need to add extra seasoning yet.
Step 3: Add the lean pork to the pan and stir-fry with the pickled greens so the flavors meld together.
Step 4: Season the pork. Note that while stir-frying, the saltiness and sourness from the pickled greens will transfer to the meat, so be careful not to over-season.
Step 5: Add the bell pepper last. Once the bell pepper is cooked, turn off the heat. Serve the stir-fried pork and pickled greens on a plate and enjoy while hot.
Source: Kenh14

mon_an.mo_ta: Chicken is always a delicious meal for everyone, and the drumstick is the best part because the meat is firm, fragrant, and tender. Chicken can be prepared in many delicious ways, and crispy fried chicken is a favorite for many. Today, we share how to make delicious and unique crispy breaded fried chicken for the whole family to enjoy.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Wash the drumsticks; you can remove the skin or keep it depending on your preference. Marinate them with 100ml of milk, seasoning powder, and coconut milk for 2 hours.
Step 2:

Place the chicken and the remaining 100ml of milk in a pot. Bring to a boil, then reduce to very low heat. Cover and simmer until the chicken is just cooked through. Remove the chicken, let it cool, and drain. Whisk the egg.
Step 3:
Dredge the chicken in frying flour, then dip it into the whisked egg. Let it sit for about 15 minutes to dry slightly.
Step 4:
Roll the chicken in a thin layer of breadcrumbs, dip it back into the egg, and roll it in breadcrumbs again until the meat is completely coated.
Step 5:
Heat a pan with oil and deep-fry the chicken until golden brown and crispy.
Step 6:
Finally, remove the chicken and drain on paper towels. Enjoy while hot!

mon_an.mo_ta: Pan-Seared Chicken with Rock Sugar – This is an attractive and easy-to-make dish. The chicken is pan-fried until golden and crispy on both sides while remaining tender and fragrant inside. This article will guide you through the process.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Boil the chicken with a little salt and garlic until just cooked. Remove and drain well.
Step 2: Place the rock sugar in a pan and melt it completely over low heat, then add the chicken.
Step 3: Gently shake the pan and flip the chicken continuously so it is evenly coated and turns golden.

Step 4: When both sides are seared golden brown, add soy sauce and a little water. Simmer until the liquid has completely reduced. If you like it spicy, add some chili powder at this stage. Serve on a plate and enjoy hot.

mon_an.mo_ta: Chicken and Potato Stew is a simple yet nutritious dish, featuring the sweetness of chicken combined with the soft, creamy texture of potatoes. This dish will surely make your family meal even better! ## Chicken and Potato Stew is a simple yet nutritious dish, featuring the sweetness of chicken combined with the soft, creamy texture of potatoes. This dish will surely make your family meal even better!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Chop the chicken into bite-sized pieces. If using boneless chicken breast, simply cut into cubes.

Step 2: Heat oil in a pot and sauté the ginger until fragrant. Add the chicken and stir-fry, then add the carrots, potatoes, and onions to sauté together. Season with 2 tsp of salt and pepper. Stir-fry for about 5 minutes until the chicken firms up, then add enough water to cover. Add the tomato wedges.
Step 3: Increase the heat to bring the soup to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer gently until the meat and potatoes are tender. Adjust the seasoning to taste.
Next, add the chopped celery and turn off the heat.
Ladle the soup into a bowl and serve hot with rice or bread; both are excellent.

mon_an.mo_ta: Turmeric braised chicken is a nutritious dish, especially beneficial for pregnant women, new mothers, children, and the elderly. The chicken has a rich flavor, a unique aroma, and an eye-catching color that the whole family will love! Unlike other chicken dishes, this one is simple and quick to prepare. Why wait? Try this dish for your family meal today!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, pepper, fish sauce, sugar - to taste
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel and wash the fresh turmeric; slice one half and crush the other half.
Step 2: Wash the chicken and cut into bite-sized pieces. Marinate with a bit of fish sauce, salt, pepper, and sugar for 20-30 minutes.
Step 3: Peel and crush the garlic. Sauté the garlic in a little oil until fragrant, then add the chicken and stir-fry until the meat firms up.
Step 4: Add enough water to just cover the chicken, season to taste, and braise over medium heat.
Step 5: When the sauce thickens, turn off the heat, transfer to a plate, and serve hot.

mon_an.mo_ta: Soy sauce braised chicken is an easy-to-make and particularly attractive dish with flavorful chicken and beautiful golden skin. In this guide, we will show you how to make delicious soy sauce braised chicken. Let's get started!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the green onions and cut into long segments. Wash, peel, and slice the ginger; peel and thinly slice the shallots. Place all these ingredients into a pot.
Step 2: Add water and soy sauce to the pot at a 1:1 ratio, then add 15g of sugar and 1 tbsp of maltose. Note: do not add too much water, or the chicken will not achieve a beautiful amber glaze!
Step 3: Place the pot on the stove and bring to a boil. Once the mixture boils, add the chicken thighs, turn the heat to low, and simmer for 8 minutes to cook one side.

Step 4: Flip the chicken over, adjust to medium heat, and continue simmering for 5 minutes. Turn off the heat and let it rest in the pot for 15 minutes. Then, remove the chicken to a cutting board and chop into bite-sized pieces.

mon_an.mo_ta: Soy sauce fried chicken is a delicious and easy-to-make dish for busy days with 4 simple and quick steps. Learn how to cook this for a tasty and nutritious meal.
cac_buoc: Step 1: In a separate bowl, combine the rice wine, soy sauce, and maltose, then mix well. If maltose is unavailable, you can substitute it with honey or palm sugar.
Step 2: Debone the chicken, then marinate with a bit of salt and pepper for 15 minutes to allow the flavors to penetrate the meat.
Step 3:
Heat oil in a pan. Once the oil is hot, place the chicken in, making sure the skin side is in contact with the pan surface.
Place a heavy plate on top of the chicken pieces. This kitchen hack ensures the skin is pressed down and becomes extra crispy.
Flip the chicken once it turns golden brown. Cook until it is about 3/4 done.

Step 4: Drain all the excess oil from the pan, then pour in the soy sauce mixture from Step 1. Remember to keep the skin side facing up, not touching the sauce, to prevent it from getting soggy and losing its crunch. Simmer until the sauce thickens, then remove the chicken to a cutting board, slice into bite-sized pieces, and serve hot.

mon_an.mo_ta: Delicious pineapple chicken is an easy and tasty dish for the whole family on a busy weeknight. Learn to cook this dish with the appealing flavor of pineapple and high nutritional value from chicken.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Scallions, fish sauce, salt, seasoning powder, pepper
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Wash the chicken and cut into bite-sized pieces. Marinate with a bit of salt and pepper. Dredge the chicken in a bowl of tapioca starch to create a thin coating.
Heat a deep pan with oil. When the oil is hot, fry the chicken until golden and crispy.

Peel and core the pineapple, then chop into small pieces. Deseed the green bell pepper, wash, and cut into squares. Peel the onion, wash, and cut into wedges. This completes the preparation for the Pineapple Chicken.

Step 2: Remove most of the oil from the pan, leaving just enough to sauté the minced garlic until fragrant. Add the pineapple and cook until softened. Depending on the sweetness of the pineapple and your family's taste, season with fish sauce, seasoning powder, and salt. Simmer for 5 - 8 minutes until tender.

Step 3: Add the onion and bell pepper to the pan and stir-fry. Once they are cooked, add the fried chicken and adjust the seasoning to taste. The Pineapple Chicken is now complete. Sprinkle with some chopped scallions and serve hot.

mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried chicken gizzards with vegetables – a delicious and easy-to-make dish for the whole family. Check out the recipe below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, oyster sauce, chili paste (sa te), seasoning powder
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients:
Wash the cucumber, peel, and slice diagonally into 0.5cm thick pieces. Peel the onion, wash, and slice thinly like the cucumber.
Peel the carrot, wash, and shred into strips. Wash the bell pepper, cut in half, remove seeds, and slice thinly.
Peel and mince the garlic. Trim the roots of the scallions, wash, and cut into sections.
Step 2: Wash the chicken gizzards thoroughly. Rub them with a teaspoon of salt, let sit for 5 minutes, then rinse again and cut each gizzard in half.

Step 3: Heat oil in a pan and sauté the garlic until fragrant. Add the gizzards and stir-fry, adding a bit of chili paste and oyster sauce. Next, add the carrots to the pan, as they take longer to cook than the other vegetables.

Step 4: When the carrots are nearly cooked, add the bell peppers, followed by the onions and cucumbers. Adjust the seasoning to taste. Once all ingredients are cooked through, sprinkle with scallions and black pepper, turn off the heat, and serve on a plate.

mon_an.mo_ta: With simple ingredients and a quick method, you can rapidly prepare a delicious dish for your family. The aroma of lemongrass combined with a hint of chili makes the chicken fragrant and enticing, especially perfect for rainy or chilly days. Let's explore how to make this dish! Enjoy the wonderful flavors of chicken dishes like fried chicken, ginger-braised chicken, and lemongrass-boiled chicken. Discover lemongrass and chili chicken stir-fry, the perfect choice for cold days. Simple and concise, you can make this delicious dish at home.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, sugar, pepper, MSG, cooking oil, fish sauce - Ingredients
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare ingredients
To start, first wash the chicken and use a filleting knife to remove the lean meat, then cut into bite-sized pieces.
A small tip: you can use the chicken bones to cook soup or simmer stock for noodle dishes and porridge.
Next, wash the lemongrass and slice thinly, cutting the upper part of the stalk in half. The horn chili also needs to be washed and sliced thinly.

To keep the chicken clean and odorless, you can soak the meat in diluted salt water for about 10 minutes, then rinse with clean water. You can also use white wine and crushed ginger mixed in a 1:1 ratio to rub on the chicken and rinse thoroughly. Another method is to mix vinegar and salt in a 2:1 ratio, rub this mixture onto the chicken several times, then rinse thoroughly with clean water.
Learn more details about simple and effective ways to deodorize chicken.
Step 2: Marinate the chicken
First, place the prepared chicken in a bowl. Add 1 tsp MSG, 1 tsp salt, and 1 tsp fish sauce to the bowl, then mix well. To let the mixture absorb the flavors, let it sit for about 15 minutes.
Step 3: Stir-fry the chicken
Next, place a pan on the stove and add 1 tbsp cooking oil. When the oil is hot, add the lemongrass and chili to the pan and sauté until fragrant.
Then, pour the marinated chicken into the pan and stir-fry over medium heat to sear the meat. Cover with a lid and cook for about 2-3 minutes so the meat cooks evenly.
Next, add 1 tsp turmeric powder to the pan to give the meat a beautiful golden color. Stir well again and adjust the seasoning to taste. Then, turn off the heat.
Finally, transfer the meat to a plate and sprinkle some roasted sesame seeds on top to make the dish more eye-catching.
Notes for making flavorful lemongrass and chili chicken
Use fresh chicken: Choose fresh, high-quality chicken to ensure the best flavor for your dish.
Prepare the chicken: Wash the chicken and remove skin, bones, and excess fat. Slice the meat into bite-sized pieces to help it cook quickly and evenly.
Choose fresh ingredients: Lemongrass and chili should be washed and finely sliced. If you like spicy flavors, you can keep the seeds; otherwise, remove them to reduce the heat.
Preheat the pan before stir-frying: Let the pan heat up evenly before adding oil; this helps the chicken not to stick and ensures quick stir-frying.

Stir-fry the chicken before adding lemongrass and chili: First, stir-fry the chicken in hot oil until the meat is seared and golden. Then, add the lemongrass and chili to the pan and stir-fry for a short time to let the aroma of lemongrass and the heat of chili spread evenly.
Ensure even cooking: When stir-frying chicken with lemongrass and chili, make sure to move the pan evenly and stir the meat frequently to achieve even doneness for each piece.

Season and cook thoroughly: Add seasonings like salt, sugar, fish sauce, and MSG according to personal taste. While cooking, let the dish simmer over low heat so the spices penetrate the meat and create a rich flavor.
Add roasted sesame to enhance flavor: Before serving, you can sprinkle some roasted sesame seeds on top of the chicken to increase the flavor and visual appeal of the dish.
Enjoy hot: Lemongrass and chili chicken is best enjoyed while piping hot. Serve on a plate and enjoy with white rice or stir-fried noodles.
How to choose fresh, high-quality chicken

To choose fresh chicken, first observe its color. Fresh chicken should be light pink, and the surface of the meat must be dry. Use your hand to press lightly on the meat to check its softness and elasticity.
Avoid buying chicken that is pale or has bruises or black spots, as these may be signs that the meat has been sitting for a long time and is no longer fresh.
To ensure quality, prioritize buying chicken at reputable stores and supermarkets that guarantee hygiene. This helps you get fresh chicken that is safe for your health.

mon_an.mo_ta: Sweet and sour chicken offers tender, fragrant pieces of chicken with an attractive tangy and sweet sauce. This dish will be even more wonderful when eaten with hot rice in a cozy family atmosphere. ##
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash and cut the chicken into small pieces about 1-1.5cm. Then, place the chicken in a large bowl, add salt and ground pepper, mix well, and let marinate for about 15 minutes.
Step 2: Next, add the cornstarch and mix well so the chicken is fully coated in flour.
Step 3: Prepare the sweet and sour sauce: put all the prepared sauce ingredients into a bowl and stir well until the mixture is completely dissolved.
Step 4: Prepare a pan of hot oil, add the chicken and fry quickly until the chicken turns golden brown, then remove the chicken.
Step 5: Preheat the oven to 160°C, brush a thin layer of oil on the baking tray, add the chicken, and drizzle the sweet and sour sauce evenly over the surface of the chicken pieces.
Bake for about 55 minutes; while baking, take the chicken out and stir well every 15 minutes.

Finally, just prepare a bowl of hot rice, arrange the chicken on top, then sprinkle some roasted sesame seeds and chopped green onions, and serve with some lettuce for extra vitamins. Sweet and sour chicken made this way will provide tender, fragrant chicken pieces with a very attractive tangy and sweet sauce.
Good luck and enjoy your meal!

mon_an.mo_ta: Five-spice stir-fried liver - supplements iron and minerals, which are very good for the health of young children and women. Check out how to make five-spice stir-fried liver in the article below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning - Salt, seasoning powder, pepper, five-spice powder, sugar, garlic
cac_buoc: Step 1: Ingredient preparation:

Soak the pork liver in unsweetened fresh milk for 15 minutes. Soaking pork liver in milk helps deodorize the fishy smell, cleans the liver, and removes toxins present in the liver. Rinse again with water.
Blanch the liver for 3 minutes in boiling water.
Step 2: Wash the liver once more until very clean, then slice into bite-sized pieces. Marinate the liver with a bit of salt, pepper, and five-spice powder, mix well, and marinate for 15 minutes.
Step 3:
Peel the onion, wash, and cut into wedges.
Mince the garlic to make the five-spice stir-fried liver more fragrant; wash and finely chop the green onions and cilantro.
Step 4: Heat cooking oil in a pan and sauté the garlic until fragrant, then add the liver and stir-fry until cooked.

Step 5: To complete this dish, add the onions and continue stir-frying, adjusting the seasoning to taste. When the onions are cooked, add the cilantro and green onions, stir quickly and evenly, then turn off the heat.

mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried crab with oyster sauce – each piece of delicious crab is coated in a rich sauce. Learn to cook a great dish for snacks or to eat with hot rice.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Soy sauce, salt, pepper, seasoning powder
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the fresh crab:
Wash the fresh crab, remove the apron, and cut in half.
Wash the ginger, peel, and crush finely. Remove the roots from the green onions, wash, and cut into segments. Peel and mince the garlic.

Step 2: Use a plastic bag or a clean plastic container, put the crab and 2 tablespoons of tapioca starch inside, and shake well so the starch coats the crab body evenly. Then remove the crab to a plate, shaking off excess starch.
Step 3:
Place a pan of oil on the stove; when the oil is hot, add the crab and fry until cooked, about 8 - 10 minutes. Then remove to a plate lined with paper towels to absorb excess oil.
Mix the oyster sauce mixture: 1 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp soy sauce, and half a tsp seasoning powder, stirring until well combined.

Step 4: Leave a little frying oil in the pan, sauté a bit of garlic and ginger until fragrant, then add the crab and the mixture prepared in the step above and stir well. Cook until the sauce coats the crab pieces evenly and the sauce thickens, then turn off the heat, sprinkle with some green onions, transfer the stir-fried crab with oyster sauce to a plate, and serve hot with rice or as a snack.
Source: Ngoisao

mon_an.mo_ta: Simple Braised Vietnamese Ham – A delicious and particularly easy-to-make dish for those who are just learning to cook! Teaching you how to make Simple Braised Vietnamese Ham.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Cut the ham into bite-sized pieces; peel and finely slice the shallots. Just peel the garlic.
Step 2: Pan-fry the ham until golden brown on all sides; with this step, ham slices that have been in the refrigerator for a long time will lose any stale smell and be replaced by a delicious aroma.

Step 3: Mix the ham with fish sauce, soy sauce, sugar, caramel sauce, shallots, and garlic. Pour a small bowl of water into the pot and braise the ham until the water is almost gone and the sauce is slightly thickened.
Source: Kenh14

mon_an.mo_ta: Considered one of the "superfoods," broccoli contains many vitamins – especially vitamin C, which is very good for the whole family's health. Especially in cold weather like this, you should increase vitamin C to help boost the body's resistance. Combining broccoli with pork kidney, you get a beautiful, delicious, and very appetizing stir-fry dish; best of all, stir-fried broccoli with pork kidney is made very quickly, so it will help you minimize time in the kitchen!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel and wash the carrots, slice into thin bite-sized pieces, and carve into shapes if desired.
Cut the broccoli into small pieces, wash, and drain. Slice the green stems like the carrots.
Peel and thinly slice the shallots.

Step 2: Wash the pork kidney, carefully filter out the white part inside, score diagonally, then cut into bite-sized pieces and marinate with 1 tsp seasoning powder for about 15 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Step 3: Heat a pan with 1 tbsp cooking oil and sauté the shallots until fragrant.
Add the pork kidney and stir-fry until cooked, then remove to a plate and set aside.
Step 4: In the same pan used for the kidney, continue heating the cooking oil and add the carrots to stir-fry briefly.
Add the broccoli stems and stir-fry together.
After about 1 - 2 minutes, add the remaining broccoli florets and onion (if using) and stir-fry, then season with 2 tsp seasoning powder.
Step 5: When the broccoli is cooked, transfer to a plate. Add the pork kidney back in, stir well, adjust the seasoning to taste, and turn off the heat.
Sprinkle with a little pepper for aroma, then transfer to a plate and serve hot.

mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried shrimp with baby corn is not only simple and easy to make but also brings health benefits with the wonderful combination of fresh shrimp, baby corn, and light, nutritious vegetables. In particular, preparing stir-fried shrimp with baby corn is very quick and convenient, helping to save time for people with busy lives. With its great flavor, this dish will surely satisfy every family member, bringing a truly delicious and memorable dinner. Let's find out how to make stir-fried shrimp with baby corn in the article below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fish sauce, MSG, seasoning powder - seasoning
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare and marinate the shrimp

After buying the shrimp, perform preparation steps such as peeling, removing the head and tail, and removing the black vein on the back. Next, soak the shrimp in diluted salt water for about 5 minutes, then rinse with clean water and drain.

To marinate the shrimp, place them in a clean bowl and mix well with 1 tsp seasoning powder and 1 tsp oyster sauce. Marinate for 10 - 15 minutes so the shrimp absorbs the seasoning. For the green beans, remove the strings, soak in diluted salt water for 10 minutes, then rinse and cut diagonally into bite-sized pieces.
For the dried shiitake mushrooms, soak them in warm water for about 7 - 10 minutes or boil in boiling water for 3 - 5 minutes to soften and remove dirt. Rinse with cold water, drain, and cut in half.
Baby corn needs to have the silk removed and the tough ends cut off. Then, soak the baby corn in diluted salt water for about 15 minutes, wash, and split lengthwise in half.
Next, peel the carrots, wash, and cut into long strips. Peel and mince the shallots and garlic. For the chili, green onions, and onion, you also need to peel, wash, and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Step 2: Cook the stir-fried shrimp with baby corn
Place a pan on the stove and turn on medium heat. Add 2 tbsp cooking oil to the pan and wait until the oil is hot. Then, add the minced shallots and garlic to the pan and sauté until fragrant.

Next, add the shrimp and shiitake mushrooms to the pan and stir-fry for about 1 minute until the shrimp firms up slightly. Next, add the onion, green beans, carrots, and baby corn to the pan, along with 1 tsp salt. Then, stir everything for 5 - 7 minutes.

Add 1 tsp fish sauce, 1 tsp ground pepper, green onions, and chili to the pan, and stir-fry for another 1 - 2 minutes to finish. The stir-fried shrimp with baby corn will have attractive colors thanks to the combination of vegetables like beans, carrots, shiitake mushrooms, baby corn, and green onions.

The dish is not only attractive in taste but also takes advantage of the freshness of the shrimp combined with the sweet flavor from the vegetables. To increase the appeal, you can dip the stir-fried shrimp with baby corn in a bit of spicy and salty garlic-chili soy sauce.
How to choose shrimp for stir-fried shrimp with baby corn

When buying shrimp, choose fresh ones with transparent outer shells. The tail of the shrimp should be folded together, not spread out. The legs of the shrimp should be firmly attached to the body and carry the natural scent of seawater, without a fishy smell.

Fresh shrimp that have not been treated with chemicals usually have a slightly curved body and firm meat but are not unusually plump. The shell joints on the shrimp body should be flexible and not loose. The head should not fall off and should be firmly attached to the body.
Limit buying shrimp with dark patches or uneven colors. If the shrimp body has turned black or the legs are no longer firmly attached to the body, those are stale shrimp and should be avoided.
When picking up a shrimp, if you see slime coming out, the body curved into a circle, and the shell feels gritty, do not buy it.

mon_an.mo_ta: Crispy Fried Squid Salad – A delicious and easy-to-make dish from familiar ingredients that can be turned into something new. Teaching you how to make Crispy Fried Squid Salad.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Crispy frying flour, all-purpose flour - 1 tbsp
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the cucumber, onion, and mint, then drain. Remove the cucumber seeds and cut diagonally, then marinate with a little salt and sugar and mix well. Thinly slice the onion, soak in ice water or water mixed with diluted vinegar for about 10 minutes, then remove and squeeze out the water.

Step 2: Clean the squid, score diagonally, and cut into bite-sized pieces of 2x4cm. Mix the crispy frying flour and all-purpose flour in a small bowl, and coat the squid with a thin layer of flour. Prepare a pan of hot oil, fry the squid until golden and crispy, then remove to a plate lined with paper towels.

Step 3: Mix the mayonnaise, chili sauce, and sesame oil in a bowl. Pour the prepared sauce into a bowl with the cucumber, onion, ginger, shredded chili, mint, roasted sesame, and fried squid, and mix well.
Step 4: Transfer the crispy fried squid salad to a plate, decorate with more mint and roasted sesame; it should be eaten immediately so the squid remains crispy.
Source: Mon ngon Viet Nam

mon_an.ten: Sweet and Sour Pig Ear Salad
mon_an.mo_ta: Sweet and Sour Pig Ear Salad – the crunchiness of the pig ear and the rich flavor of the salad dressing. Refer to our way of making this dish in the article below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Green onions, ginger, pepper, soy sauce, chili paste (sa tế)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the pig ears and then blanch them to make shaving the hair easier; shave off all hair, rub with salt to clean thoroughly, then rinse with water. Set a pot of water to boil the pig ears. Note to add a few green onion roots, sliced ginger, whole peppercorns, and a pinch of salt to the boiling water!
Step 2: After the pig ears are cooked through, immediately remove them and soak in a bowl of boiled and cooled cold water; this way, the pig ears will be much crunchier.
Step 3: Make the sweet and sour pig ear salad dressing: The dressing will consist of: 3 parts soy sauce, 1 part sesame oil, 1 part chili paste, 2 parts sugar, and 1 part vinegar.

Step 4: Slice the pig ear into bite-sized pieces and mix with the seasoning mixture above. When presenting on a plate, sprinkle more roasted sesame and coarsely crushed roasted peanuts to make the dish more delicious. Can be served with fried shrimp crackers.

mon_an.ten: Green Mango Salad with Dried Squid
mon_an.mo_ta: Green Mango Salad with Dried Squid – A delicious, easy-to-make, and attractive sweet and sour snack made of dried squid and green mango that is very easy to eat. How to make Green Mango Salad with Dried Squid.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fish sauce, sugar, garlic, Vietnamese coriander (rau răm)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the green mango and carrot, then peel them; next, shred them into strips. Peel and thinly slice the onion. Place these vegetables in separate bowls; for the carrot and green mango, add a little salt, soak for 15 minutes, then squeeze dry. Soak the onion in a bowl of cold water mixed with a little salt. After 15 minutes, also squeeze out the water and put in a dry bowl.

Step 2: Grill the dried squid until cooked, wrap in newspaper, and use a mallet to pound it soft, then shred into small strips. Use one part to mix into the salad and the other part to eat with chili sauce.

Step 3: Prepare the green mango and dried squid salad dressing: Dissolve sugar, a little filtered water, vinegar, and lime juice in a small bowl; add minced garlic and chili and stir well, then add fish sauce so the sour, salty, and sweet taste fits your palate. Mix into the mango, carrot, and onion along with the roughly chopped Vietnamese coriander.
Step 4: Next, add the shredded squid and mix well, then transfer the dish to a plate, sprinkle crushed roasted peanuts on top, and decorate according to your preference.
Source: Ngoisao

mon_an.ten: Stir-fried Baby Clams with Chives – A Rustic Countryside Treat
mon_an.mo_ta: Baby clams are a very common and readily available ingredient in every rural region of Vietnam. From baby clams, Vietnamese people have created many attractive dishes such as baby clam soup, baby clams with rice crackers, baby clam salad, baby clam rice, baby clam noodles, stir-fried baby clams with lemongrass and chili, etc. Let's try this incredibly fragrant stir-fried baby clams with chives (hen xao he) recipe.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the baby clams

After purchasing, wash the clams and soak them in water with a little salt and a few slices of chili for a few hours to let them release all the mud. Rinse again with clean water and put them in a pot to boil. When the clams are cooked and their shells open, turn off the heat. Use a slotted spoon to scoop the clams into a basket, then separate and set aside the meat (sift the clams like you would sift rice). Repeat until all clams in the pot are processed.
Step 2: Prepare the ingredients
Cut the chives into segments; finely chop the red bell peppers, pickled mustard greens, shallots, and garlic.
Step 3: Cooking
Heat a pan, add a little cooking oil, and sauté the minced shallots and garlic until fragrant.
Once the shallots and garlic are golden and fragrant, add the baby clams and stir-fry.
Stir-fry until the clams firm up, then add the chopped bell peppers and pickled mustard greens.
Add soy sauce and season to taste.
Stir well so the clams and ingredients absorb the seasonings, then add the chive segments.
Add chili sauce; if you like it spicy, you can add a few slices of fresh chili and stir-fry together.
Continue to stir-fry for about 1 minute then turn off the heat. Remove from the pan and serve hot. Before turning off the heat, sprinkle a little black pepper for aroma.
You can enjoy stir-fried baby clams with chives (hen xao he) with white rice as a main dish or as a snack with toasted rice crackers like a rustic countryside treat; both are delicious.

mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried Beef with Tonkin Jasmine – An easy-to-make delicious dish that is both tasty and has a sedative effect, helping to reduce headaches very well for women. Learn how to cook Stir-fried Beef with Tonkin Jasmine.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the Tonkin jasmine flowers and let them drain. Slice the beef thinly across the grain, then marinate with some minced garlic and ginger.

Step 2: Place a pan on the stove, add a little cooking oil. When the oil is hot, add the beef to stir-fry; since the beef is already marinated with garlic and ginger, there is no need to sauté garlic first. Stir-fry the beef on high heat until nearly cooked. Season with a little oyster sauce to taste, then remove to a plate.

Step 3: Use the same pan to stir-fry the Tonkin jasmine flowers, also seasoning with oyster sauce to taste. When the flowers are nearly cooked, return the beef to the pan and stir-fry for a little longer, then turn off the heat. Serve this easy-to-make dish on a plate and enjoy while hot.
Source: Kenh 14

mon_an.mo_ta: These rich and fragrant seaweed egg rolls, combining refreshing seaweed and bonito flakes, make your meal truly delicious. Let's explore how to make this dish! Learn how to make beautiful seaweed egg rolls with simple instructions. Add a unique and attractive dish to your meal.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Soak wood ear mushrooms in water until soft, wash, and shred. Peel the carrot, wash, and dice finely. Crack the duck eggs into a bowl, add a little seasoning powder, and beat well until dissolved.
Step 2: Wash the peeled shrimp with diluted salt water, then dice finely.
Step 3: Put the shrimp, wood ear mushrooms, and carrot into a bowl, season with a little seasoning powder and pepper, then put into a blender and blend until smooth.
Step 4: Place a pan on the stove, heat 2 tablespoons of oil, then pour in the eggs to make an omelet. Tilt the pan in a circular motion so the eggs spread into a thin, even layer.
Step 5: When the egg is cooked, remove it to a wide tray. Use a spoon to spread the blended shrimp mixture evenly over the surface of the egg.
Step 6: Next, place the seaweed sheet on top, press lightly to stick it to the filling layer, then roll it up tightly.
Step 7: Place in a steamer and steam for about 10 minutes or until the egg is fully cooked.
Step 8: Use a sharp knife to cut into small rounds and enjoy while hot.
Enjoy your meal!
Notes for making seaweed egg rolls
Choose fresh seaweed: Select seaweed with bright colors, no foul odor, and no damage. This ensures the seaweed brings the best flavor to the dish.
Prepare eggs correctly: Ensure the eggs are cracked into a bowl and whisked thoroughly. If using quail eggs, boil them first and peel the shells.
Roll tightly and secure: When layering the egg on the seaweed, roll tightly and apply a layer of egg to the excess seaweed edge to keep the roll secured and prevent it from coming apart when frying.

Fry at the right temperature and time: Ensure the oil in the pan is sufficiently heated before adding the seaweed egg rolls to fry. Fry at medium heat to ensure the seaweed and eggs cook evenly without burning. Fry for a short time to prevent the seaweed and eggs from overcooking and losing crispness.
Cut into small pieces: Once fried, use a sharp knife to cut the seaweed rolls into bite-sized pieces. This makes it easier to enjoy and adds to the visual appeal.
How to choose good ingredients for seaweed egg rolls
1. How to choose clean eggs

For commercial chicken eggs, the shell is usually dark brown, uniform in color, with no cracks or black spots. However, if eggs have been kept for a long time, the shell may be pale with many black spots. For garden-raised chicken eggs, you cannot rely on shell color to determine freshness, as the shell is often pale or slightly white even when fresh and delicious.

You can touch the shell surface to feel it. If the shell is rough and slightly grainy, it is a sign of a fresh egg. Conversely, if the shell is smooth and slick, the egg may have been kept for a long time. When a hen first lays an egg, the tiny pores on the shell surface have not closed yet, which is why it feels rougher.

Hold the egg up to a light source (like a light bulb or sunlight) and look through the shell. A fresh egg will have a small air cell, a round and immobile yolk centered in the shell, with an orange or light pink color. Transparent egg white is a sign of a fresh egg.
In contrast, if the egg has a large air cell, a red yolk with visible veins, it is a sign of an old egg.

Additionally, you can hold the egg and shake it gently near your ear. If there is a sound, it is a sign of an old egg. Furthermore, the louder the sound (the egg moving inside), the more likely it is spoiled or underdeveloped. Conversely, if there is no sound, it is a sign of a fresh egg.
2. How to choose seaweed

The most common seaweed for making seaweed egg rolls is Nori, which can easily be found at Asian stores or supermarkets. Additionally, there are other types like Kombu or Wakame, depending on your personal preference and culinary style.
Choose high-quality seaweed; organic seaweed or seaweed from reliable sources is recommended to ensure safety and the best flavor.
Check the expiration date: Look at the expiration date on the seaweed packaging to ensure it is still fresh.
If you are concerned about the product's origin, check the source information on the packaging to know exactly where it was produced.
Choose seaweed with bright colors, without gray patches or unusual color changes. The shape of the seaweed should be intact, not torn or damaged.
If possible, read reviews and feedback from previous customers to get an overview of the product's quality and flavor.
Purchase seaweed from reputable food stores, supermarkets, or online from trusted suppliers to ensure product quality.

mon_an.mo_ta: Honey glazed chicken breast is extremely special because of its delicious sauce—a more than wonderful combination that will make you want to enjoy it forever!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Toasted white sesame seeds - A little
Sauce ingredients: 2 tbsp ketchup, 4 tbsp honey, 1.5 tbsp soy sauce
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the chicken breast and pat dry, then cut the meat into bite-sized square pieces and place in a bowl. Add a little salt, white pepper, and seasoning powder; mix well and marinate for 15 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Step 2: Put the honey sauce ingredients into a small bowl and stir the mixture well.
Step 3: After 15 minutes, add the tapioca starch to the chicken bowl, cover tightly, and shake well so the meat is evenly coated with a thin layer of starch.
Step 4: Place a pan of oil on the stove and heat it. When the oil is hot, add the chicken pieces and flash-fry for about 2 minutes, then remove and drain the oil.

Step 5: Place a clean pan on the stove with 1 tablespoon of oil. When the oil is hot, pour in the bowl of sauce and bring to a boil. Shake the pan gently and add all the fried chicken pieces, tossing well, then turn off the heat.
Sprinkle a little toasted white sesame seeds on top, then transfer the honey glazed chicken to a plate to enjoy while still hot.
Wishing you and your family a delicious meal with this fragrant honey glazed chicken breast!

mon_an.mo_ta: Sweet orange soup is a very unique dish that you can eat without getting bored. The refreshing tartness combined with the intense orange aroma will give you a heavenly feeling. Let's learn how to make this fragrant and cool dessert! You can use orange powder instead of fresh orange juice.
cac_buoc: Peel the orange to get the segments, removing the seeds.
Put the water, orange juice, and sugar into a pot and bring to a boil.
Dissolve the tapioca starch with a little water, pour slowly into the pot, and stir constantly until the soup boils and thickens slightly.
Add the orange segments and turn off the heat.
Add the tofu pudding and stir gently.
Add ice and enjoy your results!

mon_an.ten: Sweet and Sour Stir-fried Chicken Liver
mon_an.mo_ta: When meat dishes have become boring for the family, switch to using chicken liver to prepare meals like stir-fried chicken liver with bean sprouts or sweet and sour stir-fried chicken liver! Besides being a delicious dish, chicken liver also provides iron and Vitamin A for the body, so let's learn how to make this tasty dish! The chicken liver should be intact, light pink, and firm to the touch. Remove the cucumber seeds so they don't get mushy.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning: fish sauce, sugar, pepper, cooking oil, etc. - As needed
cac_buoc: 1. Preparation:
Clean the chicken liver, cut into bite-sized pieces, and marinate with 1/2 tbsp seasoning powder, 1/3 tbsp pepper, 1 tbsp minced shallots and garlic, 1 tbsp sugar, and 1 tbsp fermented rice vinegar.

Shred the carrot. Halve the cucumbers, remove the seeds, and cut into 0.5cm thick slices. Cut scallions into segments. Dissolve the tapioca starch in 1/3 cup of water. Shred the horn chili and soak in water.
2. Execution:
Mix the stir-fry sauce: 2 tbsp fermented rice vinegar, 1 tbsp sugar, and the dissolved tapioca starch.
Place a pan on the stove, sauté the shallots and garlic until fragrant, stir-fry the chicken liver over high heat, then add the carrots to stir-fry.
Pour in the sauce, add fish sauce; when the sauce thickens, add the cucumbers, scallions, and cilantro.
Adjust seasoning to taste and turn off the heat.
3. Serving:
Arrange on a plate, garnish with cilantro, sprinkle with pepper, and serve hot with rice.

mon_an.ten: Sweet and Sour Stir-fried Hủ Tiếu
mon_an.mo_ta: Sweet and Sour Stir-fried Hủ Tiếu – An easy-to-make delicious dish for an active and energetic new day with an incredibly tasty meal. Refer to our sweet and sour stir-fried hủ tiếu recipe in the article below! Learn how to cook Sweet and Sour Stir-fried Hủ Tiếu.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Large hủ tiếu noodles, blanched and drained - 1 bag
Large shrimp, peeled with tails intact - 400g
Chicken breast, washed and thinly sliced - 200g
Chives, washed and cut into short segments - 1 bunch
Fried tofu, cut into long strips - 1 block
cac_buoc: Soak the tamarind in 1/4 cup of hot water and mash it, then strain to remove the pulp, keeping only the tamarind juice. Put the tamarind juice in a pot and bring to a boil with fish sauce and sugar to make the sauce.

Place a pan on the stove. When hot, add oil and sauté the shallots and garlic, then add the preserved radish to stir-fry with the shrimp and chicken. When the shrimp and chicken are nearly cooked, pour in all the sauce and stir-fry until the sauce coats everything and the seasonings are absorbed, then add the fried tofu and hủ tiếu noodles to stir-fry together. Adjust seasoning to taste, add the chives or scallions, turn off the heat, and then add the bean sprouts to toss. This way, the sprouts won't become mushy or watery, remaining crunchy for a delicious sweet and sour stir-fried hủ tiếu.

In another small pan, add a little oil, add the eggs, and stir to scramble them into small pieces. Once cooked, mix the eggs into the stir-fried hủ tiếu. Adding eggs directly while stir-frying the noodles would make the noodles sticky and mushy.
Serve the dish on a plate, sprinkle some roasted peanuts on top, squeeze a piece of lime over it, and mix well (if you like it slightly tart). Serve with soy sauce and sliced chilies.

mon_an.ten: Cơm Hến – Hue Style Baby Clam Rice
mon_an.mo_ta: Cơm hến is a wonderful combination of cold rice and baby clams stir-fried in oil with rich seasonings. Additionally, the dish is enriched by the harmony of clam broth, fermented shrimp paste, banana blossoms, pennywort, herbs, bean sprouts, and pork cracklings. You can make this dish yourself at home with the authentic recipe shared in this article. Discover the secret to making authentic Hue-style baby clam rice! Learn how to make delicious Cơm hến with detailed and simple instructions. Enjoy this traditional Hue specialty in your home with easy steps and easy-to-find ingredients.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning - seasoning powder, sugar, MSG, ground pepper
cac_buoc: 1. Prepare the Baby Clams
After purchasing the clams, remove any dead or damaged ones. Wash the clams and soak them in a basin of rice water with a few slices of chili to help remove the mud and sand inside.

Place a pot of water on the stove and bring to a boil. Then, add the prepared clams and boil until cooked. Add one teaspoon of sea salt to the boiling water. When the clams have fully opened their mouths, turn off the heat and set the clam broth aside. Then, soak the clams in cold water to separate the meat.
2. Mix the Rice
First, prepare a large bowl and add 1 bowl of white rice, 2 tsp seasoning powder, 1 tsp MSG, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp ground pepper, 2 tsp sesame oil, 2 tsp chili powder, and 3 tsp soy sauce.

Next, use your hands to gently crumble the rice to ensure the grains are separated and not clumped. Simultaneously, mix all the ingredients in the bowl. Then, place the rice bowl in the refrigerator for about 10 minutes to make the rice tastier.
3. Stir-fry the Clams
After mixing the rice, place a pan on the stove over medium heat, then add 2 tbsp of cooking oil to heat up.
Next, when the oil is hot, add 2 tsp of minced garlic to the pan and sauté until fragrant.
Then, add 250g of boiled clam meat to the pan, along with 2 tsp of minced lemongrass, 1 tsp of minced chili, 4 tsp of soy sauce, 2 tsp of oyster sauce, 1 tsp of ground pepper, and 1 tsp of sugar.
At the same time, increase the heat to high and use a flat spatula to stir-fry evenly for 5 minutes.
After stir-frying, adjust the seasoning to taste and turn off the heat. Then, display the food on a plate and enjoy.
4. Fry the Rice
Next, place a new pan on the stove over medium heat, then add 2 tbsp of cooking oil to heat up.
When the oil has reached the right temperature, add 2 tsp of minced garlic to the pan and sauté until fragrant.
Next, add all the mixed rice to the pan and fry for about 5 - 7 minutes, until the rice is evenly golden.
Then, add 2 stalks of washed and finely chopped scallions to the pan. Toss the rice and scallions together, then turn off the heat.
Finally, transfer the fried rice and the cooked clams to a plate and complete the dish.
5. Completion
The clam fried rice has become attractive with its brilliant golden color and seductive aroma that no one can ignore!

The rice grains are fried not too dry, remaining soft and smooth while blending with a gentle salty taste. When combined with the delicious clams, it creates a wonderful combination! If you like, you can enjoy it with chili sauce for extra flavor!
Secrets to authentic Cơm hến

To have a plate of crispy, delicious, and evenly golden fried rice, you should apply a few methods. First, use high heat and continuously toss the rice by hand to ensure it is fried evenly. Also, choose a cast iron pan or a deep-bottomed pan to easily toss the ingredients.
To avoid a greasy, indigestible feeling, limit the use of too much cooking oil.
You should use cold rice for better fried rice. If you use freshly cooked hot rice, spread it out to let the steam escape and cool down a bit before you start frying.

The clam cleaning process is very important: after clams are caught from the river, they need to be washed and soaked in rice water or cold water with a few slices of chili to remove slime and dirt. Soaking time usually lasts 1 to 2 days. Then, the clams are washed clean to prepare for boiling.

When boiling clams, they need to be placed in a large pot or pan with enough water to cover the surface, then brought to a boil. Stir occasionally to ensure they cook evenly and avoid burning at the bottom. Cook at a high temperature so the clam meat becomes firm and tender, retaining its characteristic delicious flavor. When the shells open, the clams are removed and the meat is separated for use in the rice dish.
How to choose fresh ingredients
1. How to choose rice for delicious Cơm hến

The first extremely important step in the process of cooking clam rice is choosing the right rice. Choose a type of rice that is not moldy, with white, sticky, and fragrant grains. This ensures the best quality and flavor for the dish.

Before cooking, wash the rice about 3 times with clean water. This process helps remove impurities sticking to the outside of the grains and helps the grains absorb some water, making them softer and easier to expand when cooked.
2. How to choose good baby clams
Usually, fresh clams are those with intact outer shells, mouths not open, and no excessive fishy smell.
Avoid choosing clams with broken or cracked shells because they are easily infected with bacteria and are not good for health.
Additionally, limit buying frozen clams or those kept in plastic bags, as they will not be fresh and are prone to being treated with chemicals.

mon_an.mo_ta: Foil-wrapped roasted chicken is fragrant and tender, with the pungent aroma of leeks and the rich flavor of the evenly absorbed sauce; anyone who sees it will surely crave it! We will guide you on how to make this delicious dish!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Rice wine, soy sauce, pepper, honey - for marinating
cac_buoc: Step 1: Debone the chicken!

Step 2: After deboning, use a toothpick to lightly prick all over the chicken skin. Then, flip the chicken over and marinate with soy sauce, salt, and pepper for about 15-20 minutes to absorb the seasonings.
Step 3: Next, wash the leeks and cut them into long segments. Spread a sheet of aluminum foil on a cutting board, then arrange the chicken and leeks on top.
Step 4: Wrap the foil, twisting tightly at both ends so the chicken doesn't fall out during roasting.
Step 5: Mix soy sauce with honey to make the marinade sauce. If you use store-bought marinade, you can skip this step!
Step 6: Preheat the oven to 200°C, then put the chicken in to roast for 20 minutes.

After roasting for the required time, take the chicken out, brush the marinade made in step 5 evenly over the meat, then put it back in the oven and roast at 180°C (pay attention to the color of the chicken to avoid burning!).

Step 7: After taking the chicken out of the oven, let it sit for a while to cool down slightly. When it can be handled, cut the chicken into rounds, arrange on a plate, sprinkle pepper on top, and serve immediately.

mon_an.mo_ta: Golden brown chicken pieces, deeply sweet and fragrant with toasted sesame seeds, will conquer even the most demanding diners. Let's get into the kitchen and make "Honey Glazed Chicken"!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Mix the ketchup, soy sauce, honey, dried chili, sesame oil, and brown sugar together. Stir well until the brown sugar is completely dissolved.
Finely chop the onion and garlic.
Step 2: Heat a deep pan and pour in cooking oil. Sauté the onion for a few minutes until soft.
Next, add the minced garlic and sauté for another 1 or 2 minutes.
Step 3: Place the chicken breast pieces into the pan and pour in the sauce mixture.

Add a little water to the pan. Cover the pan and leave it on low heat. If you want the meat very tender, you can simmer for 1 hour. After simmering for about 30 minutes, flip the meat to ensure it absorbs the sauce evenly. When the chicken has reached your desired tenderness, remove the meat to a plate to cool. Turn the heat to high and boil the sauce.
Step 4: Finely chop the scallions and toast the sesame seeds until golden.
Step 5: Mix the cornstarch with a little water until dissolved. Pour the starch into the sauce to thicken it and turn the heat down.
Finely slice or shred the chicken breast. Put the chicken back into the sauce and cook until the meat is evenly golden.
Sprinkle sesame seeds and scallions on top to garnish the dish.

mon_an.ten: Southern-Style Vietnamese Braised Pork with Eggs
mon_an.mo_ta: A simple, familiar, and very easy-to-make dish. Today, we will introduce a recipe that meets all these criteria: Southern-style Vietnamese Braised Pork with Eggs.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, sugar, fish sauce, pepper, chili, caramel sauce - seasonings
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the pork and cut into square pieces about 2 fingers wide. Marinate the meat with the prepared seasonings for 15 minutes to allow the flavors to penetrate evenly.

Step 2: Heat a pan and stir-fry the pork until the meat is firm. Transfer to a pot, add coconut water and peeled hard-boiled eggs. Simmer over low heat for 40 minutes. Once the sauce has thickened, turn off the heat and serve.
Note: If you are cooking Southern-style, you should increase the amount of sugar in the marinade to suit the Southern palate.

mon_an.mo_ta: Beef shank with orange sauce is a delicious, flavor-packed dish featuring the richness of fresh beef, the sweet and sour taste of oranges, and the aroma of onions. All these elements create an incredibly attractive and irresistible dish. This recipe is simple and very easy to make—let's get into the kitchen and try it! Enjoy the signature taste of restaurant-quality beef shank with orange sauce with our detailed instructions. Prepare and cook beef shank like a pro with simple steps, from selecting fresh ingredients to processing and making the enticing orange sauce.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Concentrated orange sauce (sold in bottles at supermarkets) - 200 ml
Seasoning powder, a bit of sugar, cooking oil - seasonings
cac_buoc: Step 1: Keep the beef shank whole, wash it, and remove the silver skin. Use a toothpick to prick the beef shank evenly. Marinate the beef shank with seasoning powder for about 15 minutes to absorb the flavors. Leave it as is and sear it briefly in oil until the meat is firm.

Step 2: Squeeze the King oranges for juice. Halve the Navel orange and cut into thin slices (for garnish). Place the beef shank in a pot, pour in enough water to just cover it, bring to a boil, and skim off the foam. Then add seasoning powder, King orange juice, and a tiny bit of sugar (depending on whether the oranges are sour or sweet). Simmer over low heat until tender, then remove, let cool, and place in the refrigerator for about 15 minutes to firm up the beef for easier slicing.

Step 3: Bring 200ml of orange sauce and 100ml of the beef cooking liquid to a boil. Season with a little seasoning powder and add diluted cornstarch to achieve a moderate thickness. Slice the beef, arrange on a plate, and garnish with the sliced oranges. Pour the orange sauce over it and serve hot. Serve with soy sauce or salt and pepper.
Enjoy your meal!
How to choose fresh ingredients for Beef Shank with Orange Sauce
How to choose fresh beef tenderloin
To ensure you choose fresh beef, observing the color of the meat is very important. Fresh meat is usually bright red, not too dark, with pale yellow fat and white tendons.
Choose small, soft pieces with fine grain that are elastic when pressed.
If you see small white cysts that easily detach, it may be a sign of parasites. Avoid buying small pre-cut pieces as they often contain more parasites.
How to choose fresh Navel oranges
Good oranges will still have the stem attached firmly; it should not be loose or fall off even when touched.
Choose oranges with fresh skin that feels smooth and shiny, and releases essential oils when gently squeezed.
Choose oranges that are round, feel heavy in the hand, and have a yellow bottom. Pay attention to the stem; if it is sunken compared to the surrounding surface, the orange has lost its moisture.
Avoid oranges with soft, wrinkled skin or dark brown spots, as these are usually not fresh and show signs of rotting or bruising.
How to choose fresh carrots
Fresh carrots are medium-sized, straight, tapering towards the tail, with smooth skin, and feel firm and heavy.
Choose carrots with a bright dark orange color and fresh green stems firmly attached to the body.
Do not choose carrots with wilted stems, bruised bodies, sliminess, dark spots, or those that feel soft when pressed.
Avoid oversized carrots with thick shoulders and stems at the base, as these are old, fibrous, and less nutritious.
Notes when cooking Beef Shank with Orange Sauce
Selecting fresh beef shank: Choose fresh beef shank with a bright color, not dull or dry. The meat should be soft and fine, without a hard outer membrane or tough tendons.

Preparation and processing: Rinse the beef shank under cold water to remove dirt and impurities. Then, slice the beef into bite-sized pieces of equal size to ensure even cooking. Note the fat layer and outer membrane; you may need to remove them if they are not suitable for your dish.

Combining seasonings: Use appropriate seasonings to enhance the flavor. You can use salt, pepper, garlic, onion, black pepper, or other spices you like. In particular, the orange sauce is the key component of this dish, providing a fresh, sweet, and sour flavor.
Fast cooking method: To ensure the beef is delicious and tender, cook quickly over high heat. Use a little cooking oil to sear the beef in a hot pan until golden and cooked through.

Creating the orange sauce: While cooking the beef, you can add fresh orange juice to the pan. Ensure the amount of juice is sufficient to create a sauce that coats the beef evenly. You can also add a little sugar or honey to mellow the acidity of the orange and create a balanced flavor.
Once the beef is cooked, you can add other vegetables such as carrots, potatoes, mushrooms, or onions to enrich the dish.
Enjoy: When the beef shank with orange sauce is cooked and fragrant, turn off the heat and enjoy immediately. This dish is usually served with white rice, bread, or noodles.

mon_an.ten: Vietnamese Fish Soup with Elephant Ear Stalks
mon_an.mo_ta: Vietnamese fish soup with elephant ear stalks is a traditional dish known for its fresh and rich flavors. This soup becomes an irresistible meal when enjoyed with hot steamed white rice. Let's cook this delicious dish using the method below! Here is a guide to making a tasty fish soup with elephant ear stalks using simple ingredients. The soup is fresh and flavorful, combined with fresh herbs and spices to create a quintessential Vietnamese dish. Enjoying this hot soup with white rice offers a wonderful culinary experience.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
First, to soak the sour tamarind, boil some water and soak the tamarind for 5 minutes. Then, use a tool to mash the tamarind and extract the juice.
For the fish, wash it thoroughly, remove the gills and entrails, then cut the fish into chunks and let it drain.
Next,
peel the outer skin of the elephant ear stalks and slice them into 3-4cm thick pieces, then rinse with water.
Using your hands, rub salt into the elephant ear stalks twice to clean them. Note: wear gloves to avoid skin irritation or itching.

Once finished, boil a small pot of water, then pour the boiling water into a basin and soak the elephant ear stalks in it. This step helps prevent the stalks from causing an itchy sensation on the tongue when eaten.
For the tomatoes, cut them into wedges; mince the garlic; slice the okra diagonally; trim the roots of the bean sprouts; and slice the pineapple into 0.3cm thick pieces.
Step 2: Processing

After completing the preparation steps, the next step is to place a pot on the stove and add a little oil. Wait until the oil is hot, then add the garlic and sauté until fragrant. Next, add the chili, sliced pineapple, and tomato wedges to the pot and stir-fry.

When the tomatoes have softened, add 1 bowl of tamarind juice and 1 tsp of seasoning powder to the pot, then add enough water for the fish. Once the ingredients are soft, use a ladle to mash them and remove the tomato skins and seeds.

When the water starts to boil, add the snakehead fish to the pot and cook until the fish is done. Once the fish is cooked, remove the elephant ear stalks from the soaking water and gently squeeze them dry, then drop them into the boiling fish soup along with the okra and bean sprouts.
Step 3: Finished product

Simmer for about 2 more minutes to ensure all ingredients are evenly cooked, then turn off the heat. Once the soup is ready, ladle it into a bowl and add some rice paddy herb and green onions to enhance the flavor. Enjoy this snakehead fish soup with rice vermicelli or steamed rice.

After more than 20 minutes, you will have a bowl of snakehead fish soup with elephant ear stalks that is both delicious and visually appealing. The soup will have green hues from the vegetables and stalks, along with red accents from the chili and tomatoes.
