The rich flavor of the snakehead fish and tamarind juice will make the meal even more appetizing.
Notes when cooking fish soup with elephant ear stalks

In Northern Vietnamese sour fish soup, the souring method primarily avoids using rice wine lees vinegar or fermented rice. Instead, fruits like elephant ear fruit, thanh tra fruit, tamarind, or starfruit are used to create the acidity.
Northern sour fish soup maintains a rustic character and is usually seasoned with green onions and dill.

Depending on your taste, you can choose to lightly pan-fry the fish before cooking or add the fish directly into the boiling broth. This is also a secret to preventing the fish from having a fishy smell in the soup pot.

mon_an.ten: Crab Soup with Malabar Spinach for a Refreshing Summer
mon_an.mo_ta: Summer is back, and there is nothing better than enjoying a cool and delicious bowl of crab soup with Malabar spinach. With the fresh, cooling taste of Malabar spinach combined with fresh crab meat, this soup is sure to delight food lovers. Not only is it a tasty dish, but crab soup with Malabar spinach also brings freshness and a cooling effect to the body on hot days. Let's explore the simple recipe to create a wonderful bowl of crab soup for the summer! Here is the guide to cooking a delicious and refreshing crab soup with Malabar spinach. Enjoy a fresh soup with the flavor of fresh crab and cool Malabar spinach.
cac_buoc: 1. Prepare the field crab

First, starting with 300g of field crab, use your hands to remove the carapaces and aprons, then wash the crabs several times with water until clean and let them drain. Meanwhile, use a spoon to scoop the crab roe from the carapaces into a separate bowl. Next, prepare a blender and pour the drained crabs along with 300ml of filtered water into the machine, then blend the mixture for about 3 minutes on medium speed.
When the mixture is smooth, turn off the machine and use a sieve to strain the crab shell residue, keeping only the crab broth for cooking.
2. Prepare other ingredients
Next, with 300g of Malabar spinach, pick the young leaves and remove any bruised or wilted ones.

Then, soak the Malabar spinach in diluted salt water for about 10 minutes, rinse 1-2 times with water to clean, and let it drain. Use a knife to cut the spinach into segments about 1-2 finger-lengths long.
Finally, peel the shallots and mince them.
3. Sauté the crab roe

After preparing the ingredients, place a pan on the stove and add 1 tbsp of cooking oil, then heat the pan over medium heat. Wait until the oil is hot, add the minced shallots to the pan, and sauté until fragrant for about 3 minutes.
Next, add the bowl of crab roe to the pan and use a flat spatula to stir-fry evenly for 3-5 minutes until the roe becomes slightly thickened and concentrated. Then, turn off the heat.
4. Cook the soup
At first glance, the bowl of crab soup with Malabar spinach stands out with eye-catching colors from the crab clusters and the freshness of the green vegetables, instantly attracting everyone!
In particular, the crab clusters are soft and sweet, combined with the fresh taste of the vegetables and the rich broth, making it a truly indispensable dish on the dining table!
Tips for preparing field crab without a fishy smell
Step 1: First, soak the field crabs in rice water for about 10 minutes, then rinse 2-3 times with clean water and let them drain.
Step 2: Place the washed crabs in a bowl and put the bowl in the freezer for about 15-20 minutes.

Step 3: Use your hands to separate the carapaces and aprons from the crabs, then use a spoon to scoop all the crab roe from the carapaces into a separate bowl. To prevent the crab broth from containing shell fragments, you should strain it multiple times. If you don't have a blender, you can place the crabs in a mortar and use a pestle to pound them into a paste. However, this method will take more time.
How to choose fresh ingredients
1. How to choose field crabs

Select crabs with bright, shiny shells and plump bodies that have all their legs and claws, showing they are active and healthy. Prioritize female crabs as they have more roe, adding more sweetness and aroma to the soup. Female crabs usually have an oval-shaped and wider apron.

Avoid choosing crabs with soft shells, hairy bellies, or weak crabs that cannot move. These may be signs of crabs that are not fresh, dead, or have mushy meat and an unpleasant odor. Buy whole, live field crabs to ensure the meat is fresh; avoid buying pre-ground crab meat to prevent using old meat that could affect your health.
2. How to buy fresh Malabar spinach and luffa
Choose Malabar spinach with fewer leaves, small leaves and tips, and stems and leaves that are fresh green.

Avoid choosing Malabar spinach with large, thick stems and leaves that are dark green and glossy. These signs often indicate that the vegetables have been treated with pesticides and are not safe for consumption.
To ensure the luffa is fragrant, soft, and sweet, choose luffa during the summer, from April to the end of June.
Select medium-sized luffa, from 200g to 400g, to ensure a sweet flavor and less fiber. Good luffa usually has few black spots on the skin, a light green color, and clear green veins.

Avoid choosing luffa with yellowish-green skin, or fruits that are too hard or too large, as these are signs of old luffa that won't taste good. Conversely, if the luffa is too small and the veins are not yet clear, avoid it as it is immature and less sweet.

Purple yam soup is a traditional Vietnamese dish with a rich, nutritious flavor that is easy to cook. Additionally, its high nutritional value and beautiful appearance have made it a popular choice in the menus of most Vietnamese families. Preparing this soup is very simple; with just a little creativity in the ingredients combined with purple yam, you will have a wonderful new soup to enjoy with your family. Check out some ways to cook purple yam soup through the content below. Please take a look!
I. How to cook purple yam soup with minced pork
1. Ingredients for the soup
300g packaged purple yam
100g ground pork
Shallots and green onions,
Culantro and rice paddy herb.
Seasonings including seasoning powder, salt, sugar, fish sauce, and pepper.
2. Cooking steps
Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
After buying the pork, wash it, cut it into small pieces, and then mince it finely.
Peel the outer skin of the purple yam, wash it under water, then cut it into small bite-sized pieces. You can also use a spoon to scrape the yam into a smooth paste, making the soup easier to eat.
Peel the shallots and cut them into thin slices. Wash the green onions, remove the white parts, crush them, and mince them.
Wash the culantro and rice paddy herb, then mince them.
Step 2: Marinate the pork
Place the pork in a bowl along with some minced green onions, sugar, seasoning powder, salt, and pepper.
Mix well so the spices blend together and marinate for about 10 minutes so the meat absorbs the flavors.
Step 3: Fry the shallots
Place a pot on the stove and add a little cooking oil. When the oil is hot, add the shallots and fry until they are golden and fragrant. Then, remove the fried shallots from the pot.
Sprinkling fried shallots over the soup after cooking will provide a delicious and distinctive aroma.
Step 4: Cook the soup
Continue using the pot used for frying shallots, add the remaining green onions, and stir well until fragrant. Then, add the marinated pork to the pot.
Use chopsticks to stir the meat until it firms up. Then, remove the meat and place it in a bowl.
Place a pot of water on the stove and bring it to a boil. Once the water is boiling, add the purple yam to the pot.

Cook the purple yam in the boiling water for about 5 minutes. Then, add the pork. Cook until the water boils again and the purple yam is tender. Finally, season the soup to taste, then turn off the heat.
After ladling the soup into a bowl, add the culantro, rice paddy herb, and fried shallots on top. Sprinkle with a little pepper and enjoy immediately.
Purple yam soup is very delicious; you should pair this soup with white rice and other savory dishes to enjoy an even better flavor.
II. How to cook purple yam soup with shrimp
1. Preparation ingredients
Purple yam: 250g
Shrimp: 200g
Green onions: a little
Shallots: 3 bulbs
Fish sauce: 1 tbsp
Cooking oil: 1 tbsp
Seasonings: a little (sugar, salt, MSG, seasoning powder, pepper)
Rice paddy herb: a little
2. How to process the purple yam
First, completely cut off the antennae of the shrimp, then peel the shells and remove the waste as well as the shrimp vein.
Next, wash the shrimp with diluted salt water to remove the fishy smell.
Step 2: Mince the shrimp
Wash the green onions after buying and cut them small.
Mince the shrimp by chopping them together with the green onions. You can also put the shrimp in a blender to make them smoother and softer, then mix with the chopped green onions.
Step 3: Marinate the shrimp

Place the shrimp in a bowl, then marinate with 1 tsp sugar, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp seasoning powder, and 1/3 tsp ground pepper. Mix well and marinate the shrimp for at least 5 minutes so the spices penetrate the meat.
Step 4: Prepare the purple yam
Peel and wash the purple yam.
Then, you can prepare the purple yam in one of the following 3 ways:
Use a knife to cut into thin slices, then cut into small pieces.
Use the blade of a knife to scrape or grate the purple yam (this method helps the soup have a stickier and thicker texture).
Use a spoon to scrape the purple yam similarly to the method above.
Step 5: Sauté the shallots
Cut the shallots into thin slices.
Place 1 tbsp of cooking oil in a pot on the stove and heat it up. Reduce the heat to low.
Add the prepared shallots to the pot and sauté until they turn golden and have a characteristic aroma.
After sautéing, remove the shallots from the pot to use in the soup.
Step 7: Sauté the purple yam

Reuse the pot and oil after frying the shallots. Set the heat to low and add the prepared purple yam, sautéing for about 10 seconds so the yam gets a bit of golden color and the surface feels slightly cooked.
Step 8: Cook the soup
Next, increase the heat to medium and pour 500ml of filtered water into the pot to boil.
When the soup boils, use a teaspoon to scoop the minced shrimp and drop them into the soup pot. This will create small shrimp balls, making the soup look more appealing.
After about 8 minutes, when the shrimp are cooked, add 1 tbsp of fish sauce and adjust the seasonings to suit your taste.
Next, ladle the soup into a bowl.
Step 9: Complete the soup
On the surface of the soup in the bowl, sprinkle fried shallots, rice paddy herb, and a little pepper.
Now, the soup is complete and ready to be enjoyed.
III. How to buy fresh ingredients
1. How to choose good meat for the soup
Fresh meat has a bright pink color, not pale. Choose pieces of meat that are firm to the touch, have good elasticity, are not mushy or soft, have no strange slime, and no spoiled smell.
If you want to use ground meat, still apply the selection method above to choose fresh ground meat portions. You can buy pre-ground meat or mince it yourself.
2. How to choose good shrimp for the soup

Choose fresh shrimp that are still alive and jumping. Fresh shrimp usually have a slightly curved body, dark color, and shiny shells. Avoid shrimp with a pale color, as they may have been caught a long time ago.
Fresh shrimp usually have a firm body, the meat is not mushy, and the legs, shell, or head have not detached.
If desired, you can also use dried shrimp as a substitute for fresh shrimp in this dish.
Note: Choosing fresh meat and shrimp is important to ensure the quality and good flavor of your soup.

mon_an.mo_ta: Let's get in the kitchen to make this whole braised chicken to treat the whole family; it's incredibly attractive and the flavor is delicious!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, enough to wash the chicken
Sauce - 1 knob ginger, sliced; 4-5 scallions; 1-2 rock sugar cubes; 400ml water; 100ml soy sauce
cac_buoc: Step 1: Rub salt on the outside and inside of the chicken, rinse with clean water. Pat dry.
Step 2: In a pan, add all the sauce ingredients and bring to a boil. Cook until the sugar dissolves.
Add the chicken to the sauce. Use a spoon to baste the chicken with the sauce, then simmer on low heat for 20 minutes.
Step 3: Open the lid and continuously spoon the sauce over the chicken for 10 minutes. The chicken will gradually develop a beautiful brown color.
Step 4: When the chicken is cooked, remove it and let it cool for 15-20 minutes, then chop into bite-sized pieces! Braising the chicken this way makes the meat very fragrant and sweet!

mon_an.ten: Salmon with Sweet and Sour Peach Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: The unique and special sauce is the secret to the delicious and attractive flavor of this salmon with sweet and sour peach sauce. Let's try making this wonderful dish!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
In this first step, clean the salmon fillet after purchase, then place the fish on a baking tray.
Note: You must brush a thin layer of oil on the baking tray so the fish doesn't stick when removed!
Step 2:
Next, place all the canned peaches in a sieve to drain. You don't need to keep much liquid, just 15ml of the peach syrup, and set the peaches aside.
Step 3:
Prepare a small pot and add the butter, brown sugar, and peach syrup.
Step 4:
Place the pot on the stove over medium heat until the brown sugar and butter are completely melted, then turn off the heat!
Note: Do not cook over high heat as the sugar will burn; stir the mixture occasionally with a spoon while heating!
Step 5:
Remove the pot from the heat, then add the mustard powder, olive oil, and soy sauce.
Step 6:
Next, add the minced fresh ginger, a pinch of salt, and pepper to taste, then mix the mixture well with a spoon.
Step 7:
Once the sauce is thoroughly mixed, use a brush to coat the salmon fillet in the tray from Step 1 with 1/2 of the sauce mixture.
Step 8:
Then, add the drained peach slices to the remaining sauce and mix well to coat.
Step 9:
Then, pour all of this sauce over the fish.
Step 10:

Preheat the oven to 220°C for 10 minutes, then bake the fish for 15-18 minutes depending on the thickness of the fillet. If the fish is thin, it will take less time; if it is thicker, it will take longer.
When the fish is cooked, remove the tray, place it on the upper rack, and flip the fish over. Continue baking for another 5-7 minutes.
Note: Keep an eye on the fish to prevent it from burning!
Step 11:
When the time is up, remove the fish from the oven. It is done when the peach sauce is slightly charred at the edges, thickened, and evenly coats the fish.
Let the fish cool for about 5 minutes, then sprinkle chopped parsley on top to finish the sweet and sour peach salmon!
Finished dish requirements:
The fish meat is tender and fully cooked inside.
The outside of the fish is not burnt and has a light brown color.
The sauce is thick, not watery, and clings to each piece of fish.
The peaches are soft but not mushy, with their characteristic orange-yellow color.
Enjoying this dish with hot rice is absolutely wonderful!

mon_an.mo_ta: The changing seasons are perfect for making this delicious, savory, and spicy mackerel that goes perfectly with rice; you won't be able to resist its flavor.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 1/2 tsp pepper; 1 tsp seasoning powder; 1/3 tsp curry powder
3 tbsp fish sauce, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 tbsp chili sauce, 2 tbsp water, 1 tbsp vinegar
cac_buoc: After purchasing the ingredients, prepare them all!
Wash the mackerel fillets and cut them into squares as shown!
Mix 3 tbsp fish sauce, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 tbsp chili sauce, 2 tbsp water, and 1 tbsp vinegar together in a bowl.
Mince the shallots, garlic, and chili!
Step 1: Place the fish in a bowl with pepper, frying flour, curry powder, and seasoning powder; mix well.
Step 2: Place a pan of oil on the stove; once hot, fry each piece of fish over medium heat.
Fry until the fish is golden and crispy, then remove to a plate lined with paper towels.
Step 3: Place another pan on the stove, add 1 tbsp of oil, and once hot, sauté the garlic and chili until fragrant. Pour in the fish sauce mixture and boil for 3 minutes over medium heat.
Step 4: Finally, add all the fish and toss well for 2-3 minutes until the sauce coats the fish, then turn off the heat.
Serve the spicy mackerel on a plate with rice and garnish with some greens. Sprinkle a few scallions to make the dish more appealing.
Wishing you and your family a delicious meal with this spicy mackerel recipe!

mon_an.mo_ta: This weekend, let's get in the kitchen and treat the whole family to these delicious and attractive sweet and sour chicken wings!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 1 minced horn chili; 3 minced garlic cloves; 3 tbsp sweet chili sauce; 1 tbsp fish sauce; 1 tsp seasoning powder; 1 chopped scallion; 1 minced shallot
cac_buoc: Ingredients to prepare:
Step 1: Wash the chicken wings and drain. Marinate the meat with a little salt, pepper, and fish sauce for 20 minutes.
Step 2: Place a pan of oil on the stove; when the oil is slightly hot, fry the wings over medium heat. Once golden, remove to a plate lined with paper towels.
Step 3: Place a pan on the stove, add 1 tbsp of oil, and once hot, sauté the garlic, shallots, chili, and the remaining seasonings for 1-2 minutes.
Add the sweet and sour chili sauce and boil for 2 minutes. Finally, add the chicken wings and toss well until the sauce coats the wings, then turn off the heat.
Presentation: Serve the sweet and sour chicken wings on a plate, decorated with cucumber flowers and lettuce. This dish is delicious served hot with rice and is suitable for everyone.

mon_an.mo_ta: Taro soup with ground pork is a delicious and nutritious dish that provides essential nutrients; the nutty taro and ground pork blend with scallions and sawtooth herb to create an inviting aroma. Let's learn how to cook this dish below!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Mince the shallots and sauté them in cooking oil until fragrant.
Add the ground pork and stir quickly until evenly cooked.
Step 2:
When the meat is just cooked, add the taro and stir well with 3 tsp of seasoning powder.
Pour water into the pot depending on how much broth you want and bring to a boil. Remember to skim the foam to keep the broth clear.
Wait until the taro is soft and floury, then season with seasoning powder or fish sauce to taste and turn off the heat.
Step 3:
Finely shred the sawtooth herb and cut the scallions into sections.
Sprinkle the sawtooth herb and scallions into the hot soup pot, then ladle into bowls; it's a delicious soup to serve with rice.
Good luck and enjoy your meal!

mon_an.mo_ta: Treat your family to this delicious and easy-to-make purple yam soup with meat this weekend!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Choose purple yams with a vibrant color, peel, and cut into sticks about the size of a chopstick, 3–5cm long.
Step 2:
Cut the pork shoulder into the same shape as the yam, then marinate with minced garlic, seasoning powder, and pepper.
Step 3:

Sauté the minced garlic in oil, sear the meat briefly, then add 1 liter of water. Cook the meat for about 5 minutes, season with 2 tsp of seasoning powder, then add the yam and cook for another 3 minutes until the yam is tender.
Step 4:
Turn off the heat and add 1 tbsp of fish sauce for aroma. Serve in a bowl and garnish with cilantro and pepper.

mon_an.mo_ta: Stuffed bitter melon soup is a simple, easy-to-make dish that is very good for your health. Give it a try!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Glass noodles - 1/2 cup, soaked in warm water for 10 minutes, drained and cut into 2-3 cm lengths
Wood ear mushrooms - 1/4 cup, soaked in warm water for 10 minutes, drained and thinly sliced
cac_buoc: Step 1: In a large bowl, mix the ground pork, fish sauce, sugar, black pepper, salt, shallots, wood ear mushrooms, and glass noodles thoroughly.
Step 2: Wash the bitter melon and blanch in boiling water for about 1 minute to reduce the bitterness if you prefer a milder taste. The bitter melon will turn a deep green color.
Cut the bitter melon into small circular rounds. Use a spoon or knife to remove the core.
Step 3: Scoop 1-2 tbsp of the pork mixture and stuff it into the center of the cored bitter melon rounds.
Step 4: Wash the shallots, place them in a pot with water, and bring to a boil.
Step 5: Once the water boils, add the stuffed bitter melon to the pot and reduce the heat. Simmer for about 15 minutes or until the pork is fully cooked.

You should add salt to the pot for a more savory flavor. When the bitter melon is tender, serve in a bowl and garnish with chopped green onions or parsley. This dish is very refreshing when served with steamed rice.
Enjoy your meal!

mon_an.mo_ta: The sweetness of the shrimp blends perfectly with the refreshing taste of pennywort, making this soup more delicious than ever.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Wash the pennywort thoroughly. Wash the shrimp, peel, remove the heads and devein, then smash them slightly.
Step 2:
Sauté the minced shallot in oil until fragrant, then add the shrimp and stir-fry until firm.
Step 3:
Add water and bring to a boil. Add the pennywort, wait for it to boil again, then season with 3 tsp of seasoning powder. Remove from the heat and serve in a bowl.
With just 3 simple steps, we have finished this dish. Easy, right?

mon_an.mo_ta: The combination of sweet beef balls and the rich aroma of mushrooms creates a dish that is not only delicious but also easy to digest and perfect for the cold winter winds.
cac_buoc: *Step 1:* Cook a pot of mung bean congee according to the number of servings. The smoother the congee, the more delicious it is.

*Step 2:* Finely mince the beef (you can buy pre-minced beef at the supermarket), season it, and roll into balls, placing one white peppercorn inside each ball. The mild heat and aroma of the pepper will make the beef balls tastier.
Dice the carrots.
Cut each slice of fried tofu into 8 pieces.
Place a pan on the stove, add cooking oil, and when the oil is hot, sauté the shallots. Then add the shiitake mushrooms and stir-fry briefly, seasoning with salt, MSG, and fresh chili.
Step 3: When the congee is ready, add the carrots and boil for about 5 minutes. Then add the beef balls and tofu, wait for another 4 minutes, and finally add the shiitake mushrooms.
Step 4: Wait for the congee to boil again and season to taste.
Wishing everyone a delicious meal!

mon_an.mo_ta: These crispy chicken-stuffed tofu bites look irresistible, and the ingredients and method are extremely easy. Why hesitate to try this dish?
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 1/3 green bell pepper, 1/3 red bell pepper
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, finely dice the bell peppers and onion.
Step 2:
Next, mix the chicken, raw tofu, onion, peppers, and cornstarch together. Be sure to season with a little salt so it is not bland!
Step 3:

For the fried tofu puffs, cut off one end and flip the inside out to create a small pouch. Then, stuff the chicken mixture inside and pinch the end shut. You can use a toothpick to secure the pouch so it doesn't open.
Step 4:

Finally, heat a pan until very hot and deep-fry the tofu on high heat until crispy. Once fried, place the tofu on paper towels to absorb excess oil, which helps the dish stay crispy longer and makes it less greasy.
Enjoy this dish while it's hot; it's wonderful dipped in chili sauce or fish sauce!

mon_an.mo_ta: German sauerkraut is a very popular winter dish in Germany. The method is incredibly simple—let's all try making this sauerkraut! You will find simple steps and easy-to-find ingredients to create a delicious sauerkraut just like in Germany.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, shred the cabbage. You can shred it thick or thin as you like. Use a sharp, pointed knife to cut the hard cabbage more easily.
Step 2:
For the sauerkraut to have a rich sour flavor, you need the right ratio of cabbage to salt. For every 700g of cabbage, use 1 tbsp of salt!
Step 3:
Put the weighed cabbage and 1 tbsp of salt into a large bowl or clean bucket. Use your hands to mix well so the cabbage absorbs the salt.
Step 4:
Take a large lid, place it inside the bucket, and press down firmly to compress the cabbage. Then, store the cabbage in a cool place for 24 hours.
Step 5:
Fill a glass jar or a sealed bag with water and place it on top of the cabbage in the bucket as a weight. Then, continue to store the bucket in a cool place to begin the fermentation process.

The fermentation process will last about 2 to 5 weeks. You should check the sauerkraut every day to ensure it doesn't get moldy. Since sauerkraut releases an odor, you can loosely cover the bucket after a few days of marinating to reduce the smell.
Step 6:
After each week, you can taste a little of the sauerkraut to check the acidity. For Vietnamese-style pickles, it only takes about 3-5 days to be edible.
Step 7:
When the sauerkraut has reached your desired acidity, you can stop the fermentation process by putting it in the refrigerator or transferring it to jars to eat gradually.
Sauerkraut goes very well with rye bread and German sausages!
Sauerkraut is a very popular winter dish in Germany.
Notes for making easy and delicious German sauerkraut:
Choose fresh cabbage: Select cabbage with bright colors and no damage. Ensure the cabbage is cut into appropriate pieces for the fermentation process.
Use airtight glass jars: Choose glass jars with tight lids to ensure the best fermentation. This helps the sauerkraut last longer and maintain its flavor.
Ensure hygiene: During the process, maintain good hygiene. Wash all tools and choose fresh ingredients.
Check and adjust: Check the cabbage daily during fermentation. If you see any signs of mold or spoilage, remove the affected part and adjust the salt and water if necessary.
Store in the refrigerator: Once the desired acidity is reached, pack the cabbage into glass jars and keep them in the fridge. This helps the cabbage stay fresh and extends its shelf life.
Enjoy appropriately: German sauerkraut can be used in daily meals or paired with fried or grilled dishes. Enjoy your delicious sauerkraut as part of a balanced diet that suits your taste.
How to buy fresh ingredients:
Choose reliable markets or supermarkets: Go to traditional markets, supermarkets, or trusted stores. Ensure you choose reputable places that guarantee product quality.
Check appearance: Inspect the ingredients. Choose fruits, vegetables, or foods with bright colors, no cracks, mold, or damage.
Check the scent: Scent is an important indicator of freshness. Choose ingredients with a fresh, fragrant aroma and no strange smells.
Check firmness/softness: Depending on the ingredient, check its texture. For example, when buying cabbage, choose heads that feel firm and not too soft.
Buy in season: Choose seasonal ingredients to ensure the best quality and flavor. Seasonal items are usually reasonably priced and fresher.
Read product information: If buying packaged or processed products, read the labels for production dates, expiration dates, ingredients, and storage instructions.
Interact with sellers: Ask for advice from sellers or staff to get more information and choose the best ingredients.
Buy only what is needed: Buy only the necessary amount to avoid waste and ensure ingredients are fresh.

mon_an.mo_ta: This special beer marinade recipe will give you delicious, savory crispy chicken pieces to enjoy with friends or with rice in a family meal!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Ground pepper, five-spice powder, seasonings, bay leaves (optional)
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, chop the chicken wings into bite-sized pieces.
Step 2:
Next, marinate the chopped wings with ginger, garlic, and pepper so the chicken is fragrant.
Step 3:
Add the beer and soy sauce, then marinate the chicken for about 1-2 hours.
Tip: From my experience, marinating the chicken with draft beer is tastier than canned beer, but if you can't get draft beer, canned beer is fine!
Step 4:
When the time is up, pour off the marinade liquid, then add the flour and crack the egg into the bowl with the chicken. Mix well with chopsticks.
Step 5:
Heat oil in a pot until very hot; using a pot helps save oil! When the oil is hot, add the chicken wings and deep-fry until the skin is crispy and golden brown.
Then, remove the wings and drain the oil. You should use paper towels to remove excess grease.
Step 6:
Place a pan on the stove, heat it up, then add cooking oil. When the oil is hot, sauté the ginger, garlic, and dried chili until fragrant.
Step 7:
Now, add the fried chicken wings along with the five-spice powder, pepper, and bay leaves. Toss well.
Step 8:
Once the chicken has absorbed the seasonings, add the roasted peanuts, toss thoroughly, and turn off the heat.
This fried chicken dish has a very unique flavor thanks to the special beer marinade!
Finished product requirements:
The wings should be crispy, fully cooked, not raw, not burnt, and have a beautiful golden-brown color.
The chicken should be savory with the aroma of fried garlic, five-spice, pepper, bay leaves, and a subtle hint of beer.
The chicken will have a crispy outer layer and tender, flavorful meat, perfect with rice or as a snack during a late-night football match.

mon_an.mo_ta: If you love roasted chicken but don't have an oven, don't worry anymore. You can make roasted chicken using just a rice cooker. This sesame roasted chicken recipe will delight you. Let's see how it's done!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings - 1 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp water, 1 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp honey
cac_buoc: Ingredients you need to prepare for this dish:
Step 1:
First, put the soy sauce, fish sauce, and honey into a small bowl and stir well to make the marinade.
Step 2:

Next, wash the chicken thighs thoroughly and pat dry with paper towels. Then, place the chicken in the prepared marinade, use a spoon to coat the chicken evenly, and marinate in the refrigerator for about 30 minutes.
Tip: You should use a toothpick or fork to prick a few holes in the chicken thighs so the marinade can penetrate faster and deeper into the meat.
Step 3:
Next, slice the ginger very thinly, cut the green onions into sections, and line the bottom of the rice cooker with some of them.
Place the chicken and the marinade into the rice cooker and press the "Cook" button. Wait until the cooker switches to "Warm," then use chopsticks to flip the chicken over.
Step 4:

After flipping the chicken, add 2 more tablespoons of water to the pot and press the "Cook" button again. When it switches back to "Warm," add the remaining green onions, press the button once more, and wait until it returns to "Warm." The chicken is now cooked and ready to be removed.

Before serving, you should shred the chicken into small pieces and sprinkle toasted sesame seeds on top to enhance the flavor and make the dish look appealing. You can also save the remaining sauce in the pot to serve with greens or hot rice.

mon_an.mo_ta: Garlic tossed chicken is a familiar dish based on a standard roasted chicken recipe but with a twist in preparation, resulting in tender chicken meat and a golden, crispy, fragrant coating of garlic and breadcrumbs.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Chicken wings - 9 pieces (adjust based on the number of people)
Seasonings - soy sauce, sugar, salt, cooking wine
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Wash the chicken wings and drain. Place them in a large bowl with a little soy sauce, sugar, salt, and cooking wine. Mix well and marinate for one hour.
Line a baking tray with foil, place the marinated chicken on it, and brush a layer of oil over the wings. Then, place the chicken in a preheated oven at 200°C and bake for 20 minutes.
When the chicken has turned brown and is cooked through, remove it and place it on paper towels to drain any excess oil.
Step 2:

Prepare a pan with hot oil and sauté the minced garlic until fragrant. When the garlic turns golden and crispy, remove it. Add the breadcrumbs to the oil and fry briefly; be careful not to let them burn.
Step 3:
Before serving, place the chicken on a plate with some stir-fried vegetables.
Sprinkle the garlic and breadcrumbs evenly over the chicken and serve hot with rice.
Good luck and enjoy your meal!

mon_an.mo_ta: With the method below, this salted egg yolk soft-shell crab dish made by you will earn endless praise from your family.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Wash the soft-shell crab, marinate with a little salt and pepper, and let it sit for 10 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Beat the egg, then add the crab and mix well. Coat the crab in tapioca starch until evenly covered.
Step 2:
Place a pan on the stove. When the oil reaches 180°C to 200°C, add the crab and fry until golden and crispy. Remove and drain on paper towels.
Steam the salted egg yolks until cooked, then use a large spoon to mash them finely.
Step 3:
Using another pan, sauté the butter and garlic until fragrant, then add the mashed salted egg yolks. Season with salt, pepper, and seasoning powder to taste.
Add the crispy fried crab, keep the heat low, and toss well so the salted egg yolk coats the crab evenly.
Tip: Do not boil the salted eggs; only take the yolks and steam them. When tossing the salted eggs with the crab, use low heat and stir constantly, otherwise the salted eggs will burn easily.

mon_an.mo_ta: With a translucent outer skin revealing the pink shrimp filling inside, this steamed há cảo recipe will make your family meals much more appealing.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Dumpling flour - 200g (can be substituted with 100g tapioca starch mixed with 100g rice flour)
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, prepare a large bowl and add 180g of flour, a pinch of salt, and then pour in the water.

Note: When pouring water into the flour, pour it slowly bit by bit and use chopsticks to stir well until the dough thickens. Avoid pouring all the water at once, or the dough will not reach the desired consistency and the dumpling skin will not be good.
Step 2:
Once the dough has come together into a sticky, thick, and pliable mixture, cover the bowl with a damp towel and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Step 3:
After 5 minutes, remove the towel. The dough should be firmer now. Sprinkle the remaining 20g of flour in and knead until the dough is smooth and dry.
Step 4: Making the filling
First, wash the shrimp, peel them, and mince them finely.
Wash the carrots and dice them into small cubes.
Wash the ginger and green onions, then mince them finely.
Step 5:
Now, place the shrimp, meat, ginger, and green onions in a bowl and mix well until the mixture is fully combined.
Step 6:
Next, add the diced carrots and continue to mix well.
Step 7:
Once the dough is smooth, roll it into long strips and cut them into segments as shown in the image.
Step 8:
Use a rolling pin to flatten the dough segments into thin, round circles to wrap the filling.
Step 9:
Once the dough is rolled thin, use a spoon to place a spoonful of filling in the center of the dough circle. Fold it in half and use your fingers to press the edges firmly together so they stick.
Repeat until all the filling is used.
Step 10:
Peel and wash the remaining carrot, then cut it into thin slices. Arrange the carrot slices in the steamer basket, then place each dumpling on top of a carrot slice.
Steam for about 6 minutes. They are done when the skin becomes translucent and no longer has the white color of raw flour.
Step 11:
Now, you can arrange them on a plate or serve them directly in the steamer basket and enjoy!
These steamed shrimp dumplings should be enjoyed while hot to be at their best!
You can serve há cảo with fish sauce, soy sauce, or chili sauce as you like!
With the translucent skin and the pink shrimp filling inside, it looks truly appetizing, doesn't it!
You can be creative and vary the fillings; if you are vegetarian, you can substitute with vegetarian ingredients to suit your taste.

mon_an.ten: Two Quick and Famous Thai-Style Steamed Clam Dishes
mon_an.mo_ta: The characteristic sweetness of fresh clams combined with the spiciness of chili, the aroma of lemongrass, the heat of ginger, or the richness of coconut milk is wonderful. Let's start making these two quick and famous Thai-style steamed clam dishes following the recipe below.
cac_buoc: For these 2 dishes, note that when you buy clams, you must soak them immediately in water mixed with a little salt. Let them sit for 1-2 hours so they spit out all the sand and become clean.
After that, rinse them with water and let them drain. Do not soak them for too long; some people soak them for 8 hours, and the clams die.
First is the extremely simple SPICY AND SOUR THAI STEAMED CLAMS.
Ingredients to steam 1 kg of Clams:
5 tsp minced lemongrass.
2 tsp minced chili (adjust spiciness to taste).
4 tsp spicy chili sauce, the spicier the better (for attractive color).
1 cup vinegar.
1/2 cup sugar.
A little water spinach to serve with.
Let's get started.
Put all ingredients into a clean pot. Season with 2 tsp seasoning powder and 1/2 tsp salt, adjusting for a balanced salty taste.
Then add the clams and cover the lid immediately.
When the clams have almost all opened their shells, add the water spinach, toss a few times, and it's done.
Enjoy immediately.

The Thai steamed clams are sour + spicy + sweet, with the broth and spices soaking into the crunchy water spinach. Additionally, if you like, you can add instant noodles, but don't put them directly in as it might get too salty.
Next is PATTAYA STEAMED CLAMS.
Ingredients to steam 1kg of clams:
3-5 tamarind pods (mash to get 1/2 cup of juice).
1/3 cup sugar.
5k worth of grated coconut squeezed for a very thick coconut milk.
3 stalks of lemongrass.
1 small piece of galangal.
A little chili sauce (adjust spiciness to taste).
A few Thai basil leaves.
Let's go.
Peel the tamarind and mash it with about 1/2 cup of warm water.
In a clean pot, add 3 smashed lemongrass stalks + all the thinly sliced galangal + chili sauce, depending on your spice tolerance. Add 2 tsp seasoning powder + 1/2 tsp salt + 1/3 cup sugar.
Then add the tamarind water and the clams into the pot, and cover the lid.
After the clams slightly open their shells, pour in the coconut milk, bring to a boil again, and enjoy.
The Pattaya Steamed Clams are sour + spicy + creamy, incredibly delicious and easy to make. Make it right away, everyone!

mon_an.mo_ta: With a crispy outer shell, soft savory potato inside, and a rich cheesy flavor, you will be hooked after the very first bite.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning Step 2: - Cut cheese into small cubes, about the size of a sugar cube. - salt, pepper, cooking oil
cac_buoc: Required ingredients:
Step 1:
Peel the potatoes, boil until tender, then mash them. Mix the mashed potatoes with the egg and a bit of salt and pepper.
Step 2:
Cut the cheese into small cubes, about the size of a sugar cube.
Step 3:
Wrap the potato mixture around a cheese cube and roll into a round ball.
Step 4:
Roll the potato ball through a layer of breadcrumbs.
Step 5:
Wrap a slice of bacon around the potato ball and use a skewer to secure it.
Step 6:
Place a pan on the stove, heat the oil, and drop the skewers in to fry until golden brown. You should use paper towels to absorb excess oil.
Serve on a plate and enjoy immediately!
The rich cheese flavor blending with the bacon will make the dish absolutely delicious.

mon_an.ten: Delicious Glass Noodle Soup with Meatballs
mon_an.mo_ta: Treat your family this weekend to this attractive glass noodle soup with meatballs!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 30g water chestnuts; 5g minced ginger; 2 scallions, white parts minced, green parts chopped; 1 egg yolk; 2.5g sugar; 10ml cooking wine; 2.5g salt; 3 tsp minced garlic; 1 pinch pepper; 3 tsp soy sauce; 2 tsp cornstarch; 4 tbsp canola or vegetable oil; 300ml chicken broth; napa cabbage leaves, shredded; 2 packs dried glass noodles; 5 baby bok choy, split
cac_buoc: Step 1: Slice the tofu and blanch in hot water for 30 seconds. Remove and drain, then transfer the tofu to a paper towel to dry completely.
Place the tofu in a bowl and use a fork to mash it, then set aside.

Step 2: In a large bowl, combine the minced meat, mashed tofu, diced water chestnuts, minced ginger, minced scallion whites, egg yolk, sugar, cooking wine, salt, 2 tsp pepper, ½ tsp white pepper powder, 2 tsp soy sauce, and 1 tsp cornstarch. Mix well to combine. Refrigerate for about 30 minutes.
Step 3: Afterward, shape the meat into small round balls. There should be about 5-6 meatballs.

Step 4: Heat cooking oil in a pan over medium heat. Fry the meatballs until golden brown (about 3 minutes), then flip and fry for another 3 minutes. Remove the meatballs and place on paper towels to drain excess oil.
Step 5: In a bowl, combine the chicken broth, ¼ tsp pepper, 1 tsp soy sauce, 1 tsp cornstarch, and 1 tsp minced garlic. Mix well and set aside.

In a large pot, heat 1 tsp of oil over medium heat. Add the bok choy and napa cabbage, season with salt, and stir-fry for 3 minutes. Add the meatballs to the pot, then pour in the chicken broth mixture and bring to a simmer. Cover, reduce heat to low, and cook until the meatballs are done, about 10 minutes.
Step 6: Meanwhile, soak the glass noodles in warm water for about 5 minutes until soft. Drain in a colander.
Step 7: Add the glass noodles to the pot, cover, and simmer for about 5-7 minutes.
When serving, transfer the noodles to a bowl, sprinkle with chopped scallion greens, and enjoy!

mon_an.ten: Simple and Delicious Fried Fish with Tomato Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: Sweet and sour fish with tomato sauce is not only delicious but also nutrient-rich and low in fat. Mixing the fish with the sweet and sour sauce and enjoying it with hot rice and a small bowl of soup will give you a delicious and warm meal with your family. Let's follow this recipe to enjoy this wonderful dish together! Sweet and sour fish with tomato sauce - a tasty, nutritious, and low-fat dish. Mixing the fish with the sweet and sour sauce, served with rice and soup, will provide a truly delicious and warm family meal.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, seasoning powder, pepper, fish sauce - seasonings
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare ingredients
After washing the fish with diluted salt water, let it drain.
Next, wash and cut the other ingredients: slice tomatoes into wedges; cut scallions and dill into segments; peel, crush, and mince the garlic and shallots; peel and julienne or mince the ginger.

To fry the fish, pour oil into a pan and heat it up. Then, place the fish in the pan and sear it. Flip evenly so both sides are cooked and fry until the fish is light golden. Once the fish is cooked, turn off the heat and set the fish on a plate. Frying helps the fish become fragrant and gives it a characteristic rich taste.
Step 2: Fry the fish

Start by frying the fish: pour oil into a pan and heat it. Once the oil is hot, drop the fish in to sear. Flip evenly so both sides are cooked and fry until the fish is light golden, then turn off the heat and remove the fish to a plate. Frying makes the fish fragrant and provides a rich flavor when eaten.
Step 3: Tomato sauce

To prepare the tomato sauce, use 2 tbsp of the oil used for frying the fish, pour it into the pan, and sauté the shallots until fragrant. Next, add the garlic and ginger, stirring until the shallots, garlic, and ginger are a beautiful golden brown. Then, add the tomatoes to the pan and stir-fry together. To make the dish look more attractive, set aside a few tomato wedges to add near the end.
Next, place the fish into the tomato sauce, season to taste, and add 1/2 tsp of pepper. Set the pan over low heat and flip the fish so both sides absorb the seasoning.
Once the fish is tender and the tomato sauce has thickened and smoothed, add the remaining tomatoes and cook for another 1 minute. Then, add the scallions and dill, stirring evenly.
Finally, place the fish on a plate and pour the tomato sauce over it. The sweet and sour fish with tomato sauce is complete and ready to be enjoyed.
Step 4: Finished product

The fish has a deep golden color, and the tomato sauce is a bright reddish-orange, accented by the green of the scallions. The dish is fragrant with the bold flavor of sea fish. When tasting, you will clearly feel the harmonious blend of salty and sweet.
A small tip: pay attention to ensure the quantity of ingredients is just enough for one meal. Both fish and tomatoes, if left overnight, can turn into harmful substances that are not good for health.

Additionally, after finishing the dish, you can use dry tea leaves to remove the fishy smell from the pots and pans, then rinse with water. Also, use vinegar or rice water to clean the cutting board and knife after processing the fish.
Notes when making fish with tomato sauce
Choose fresh fish: Select fresh, high-quality fish to ensure the best flavor. Checking for bright, clear eyes is a sign of fresh fish. Also, determine if the fish has been cleaned and scaled.

Prepare ingredients: Wash the fish and cut into suitable pieces. Wash tomatoes, onions, and other herbs before use. Prepare seasonings like garlic, chili, salt, sugar, and pepper according to your taste.

Fry or sauté the fish: You can choose to fry or sauté the fish before adding the tomato sauce. When frying, ensure the oil is hot enough so the fish cooks evenly and has an attractive golden color. If sautéing, ensure the fish is tender but not overcooked and dry.

Using tomato sauce: Prepare a simple tomato sauce by sautéing shallots and garlic, then adding tomatoes. Season with spices and pepper to taste. When the sauce has thickened, add the fish and mix well so it absorbs the flavors.

Add herbs: To make the dish fresher and more appealing, add scallions, cilantro, or other herbs at the end of the cooking process. Herbs will create a fresh green color and enhance the refreshing flavor.

mon_an.ten: Stir-fried Field Crabs with Piper Lolot Leaves
mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried field crabs with piper lolot leaves is a rustic and popular dish in Ninh Binh, carrying the bold flavors of the countryside. The golden-brown crabs along with green lolot leaves look very eye-catching, and the aroma of crab, leaves, and lemongrass makes the dish even more appealing. You will love the crispy crab pieces dipped in salt, pepper, lime, and chili. This dish goes very well with rice on cold, rainy days. This simple yet flavorful dish is also very attractive for those who enjoy drinking; sitting by the meal and sipping on crab dipped in chili salt is wonderful. Let's get cooking! Try making this dish and enjoy the unique flavor at a party or a family meal.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fish sauce, salt, pepper, MSG, cooking oil - as needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare ingredients

After buying the crabs, soak them in water for about 10 minutes and change the water once; continue changing until the water is no longer cloudy. Then, add a little salt to the water and soak the crabs for another 10 minutes. After soaking, let the crabs drain.

Next, place the field crabs in a bowl and add 1/2 tbsp seasoning powder, 1/2 tbsp minced scallions, 1 tbsp minced garlic, and 1 tbsp minced shallots. Mix the ingredients together and marinate the crabs for about 30 minutes.
Step 2: Processing

First, rinse the field crabs with water. Then, remove the carapace (top shell) and the apron (the flap on the belly). Next, wash the piper lolot leaves and cut them into small strips of about 5-10mm. Separate the carapace and apron, keeping the roe and eggs (the fatty layer on the crab's back). Place the cleaned crabs in a bowl and marinate with 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp sugar, and 1/4 tsp MSG for about 10 minutes to absorb the flavors.

To make the dish fragrant and delicious, mix fish sauce and the marinade into the crabs and let sit for 10 minutes. Then, add a little oil to a pan and cook the crabs. Remember to stir constantly so the crabs cook evenly without burning.
Next, when the crabs are cooked, add the piper lolot leaves and continue to stir-fry with the crabs. Stir evenly for about 5 minutes until the leaves are slightly cooked and drier.

Once the crabs are done, arrange them on a plate and garnish with a few fresh lolot leaves. You can also use rice paddy herb and chopped fresh chili to garnish and serve with the dish for extra flavor.
Step 3: Finished product:
To add more flavor, you can use dipping sauces like chili sauce, soy sauce, or fermented soybean paste. Each type of sauce will bring a unique and different taste experience.

By trying this dish, you will experience the special flavor of fresh, crispy fried crabs along with the characteristic aroma of piper lolot leaves. The harmonious and sophisticated combination of this dish will create a wonderful culinary experience, suitable for parties or family weekend meals.
Enjoy your meal!
Notes when making stir-fried field crabs with piper lolot leaves
Choose fresh crabs: Ensure you choose fresh crabs with no foul odor and hard shells. Choosing fresh crabs will ensure the best flavor for the dish.
Fresh lolot leaves: Choose fresh, green leaves that are not wilted or torn. Fresh leaves will provide the characteristic aroma and create a crispy layer for the crabs after frying.
Stir evenly: When frying the crabs, stir them constantly so they cook evenly and do not burn or become too dry. This ensures the crabs maintain proper tenderness and moisture.
Heat the oil: Before adding the crabs to the pan, ensure the oil is sufficiently hot. This helps the crabs fry quickly and maintain the crispiness of the shell.

Frying time: Ensure you do not fry the crabs for too long to avoid them becoming too dry and losing their freshness. The lolot leaves should also be fried long enough to cook slightly and release a strong aroma.

mon_an.ten: Nutritious and Fragrant Herbal Chicken Soup (Gà Tần Thuốc Bắc)
mon_an.mo_ta: Chicken is a white meat with high protein that is easy to metabolize. It contains essential proteins, vitamins A, B1, B2, B6, B12, E, PP... and many necessary trace elements such as K, Na, Ca, Fe, Mg, Mn, Cu... According to Traditional Chinese Medicine, chicken is sweet, warm, tonifying, and strengthens the stomach and bones. In particular, traditional medicine and folk experience suggest that black-boned chicken (gà ác), which has black skin and feathers, has higher nutritional value than regular chicken. For example, every 100g of black chicken has about 22.3g of protein and 2.3g of lipid, while regular chicken has about 18.2 – 20.3g of protein but up to 7.5 - 10.5g of lipid. According to TCM experience, black chicken meat helps increase endurance, improves immune function, and strengthens resistance. When adding medicinal herbs, the dish gains the effects of those herbs. For instance, adding ginseng increases the stimulation and endurance of ginseng... Let's get into the kitchen! You can freely choose the type of chicken that fits your budget!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the Chinese medicinal herbs in the herbal soup pack. If using a pre-packaged herbal mix from the supermarket, you should reduce the amount of Job's tears (white seeds shaped like corn but smaller). Do not use too many Job's tears in the chicken stew because they have high water absorption and will soak up the sweet juices from the chicken, making the dish less flavorful. Wash the chicken and lightly sear it over a flame. This step helps the chicken skin stay firm and not tear during stewing, and also makes the chicken more fragrant.
Step 2: Place the chicken in a ceramic pot or a stewing vessel along with the washed medicinal herbs. Sprinkle a little seasoning over the chicken, and finally cover the top with mugwort.

Step 3: Place the chicken pot into a larger pot of boiling water and double-boil (steam) for about 1 - 1.5 hours depending on the thickness of the container. If using a pressure cooker, you only need to stew for about 30 minutes.
Enjoy your delicious herbal chicken soup!

mon_an.ten: Korean-Style Sweet and Sour Stir-Fried Beef
mon_an.mo_ta: Korean-style sweet and sour stir-fried beef will make your weekend more interesting! Let's learn how to make this Korean-style sweet and sour beef dish!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Peel and mince the garlic.
Marinate the beef with a little cooking oil for about 5 minutes!
Step 2:
Stir-fry the beef in a pan with salt and pepper for about 1 minute, then add the garlic.
Step 3:
When the beef is almost cooked, add the chili paste, vinegar, and sugar to the pan and stir-fry until the meat is fully cooked.
Serve with rice or bread; both are delicious!
Enjoy your meal!
Instructions on how to make stir-fried beef with onion and pineapple
Instructions on how to make stir-fried beef with lemongrass and chili

mon_an.ten: Delicious Braised Duck in "Fake Dog Meat" Style (Vịt Giả Cầy)
mon_an.mo_ta: If you don't want to eat dog meat but love its characteristic savory flavor, here is a tip: making duck in the "giả cầy" style still provides a delicious taste similar to dog meat. To improve family meals, mothers shouldn't hesitate to cook this dish. It's guaranteed to please the whole family.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Turmeric, galangal, garlic, shallots, coconut water, lemon, saw-leaf herb, cilantro - as needed
MSG, salt, caramel sauce, shrimp paste, cooking oil - as needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the duck upon purchase, rub the outside and inside with salt and lemon, then rinse with ginger wine to remove any gamey odor. Lightly sear the duck over charcoal or use a grill rack over a gas stove until the skin is slightly charred and fragrant.

Step 2: Chop the duck into bite-sized pieces. Marinate the duck with 1 tsp MSG, 1 tsp salt, 1 tbsp minced turmeric, 1 tbsp shrimp paste, 1/2 tbsp minced garlic, 1 tbsp minced shallots, 1 tbsp minced galangal, and 3 tbsp caramel sauce.

Step 3: Mix the seasonings well and let the duck marinate for about 30 minutes before cooking. Add 1/2 tbsp minced garlic to the pot when the oil is hot, then add the duck and stir-fry. When the meat is firm, pour in the coconut water. Simmer over low heat until the duck is tender.

Step 4: When the liquid has slightly reduced and turned a thick golden color, adjust the seasonings to taste. Then add 1 tbsp of minced galangal to maintain the characteristic aroma of galangal, making the dish more fragrant.
Step 5: Finally, add chopped cilantro and saw-leaf herb, then turn off the heat. Serve the vịt giả cầy in a bowl while hot with rice or rice vermicelli.
Good luck with your vịt giả cầy dish!

mon_an.ten: Crispy Fried Squid with Rich Coconut
mon_an.mo_ta: Crispy fried squid with coconut will give you a slightly unique, rich, and creamy taste from both the fried coating and the coconut—a delicious dish suitable for parties and gatherings.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Clean the squid, peel off the outer skin, cut into segments about 50cm long, then use scissors to score a flower pattern on about 1/3 of the squid ring.
Next, put the grated coconut in a hot pan and toast until dry.
Step 2:
Mix the frying flour and eggs into a bowl of filtered water; you must mix very well so the batter is smooth.
Dip the squid into the batter, roll it through the toasted coconut, then drop it into a pan of hot oil. Deep-fry so the squid pieces cook to a beautiful golden color.
Fry until the squid is golden, then remove and let the oil drain.
You have now completed the coconut fried squid dish. You can serve it with chili sauce or ketchup, and it pairs wonderfully with beer or wine.

mon_an.ten: How to make delicious homemade Nem cua bể
mon_an.mo_ta: Nem is always a delicious and popular dish. There are many different ways to make nem with various ingredients. Today, I will guide you on how to make Nem cua bể. This dish carries the rich flavor of the sea, with crispy rolls blending with chewy, fragrant crab meat, served with fresh herbs—it's truly wonderful. Nem cua bể is usually wrapped in large, durable rice paper, which becomes very crispy when fried and stays crunchy for a long time. Let's head to the market to prepare the ingredients for this delicious dish!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Garlic, shallots, green papaya, carrot - ingredients
Fish sauce, seasoning powder, pepper, salt, vinegar, lime - seasonings
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the sea crab, boil until cooked, and pick out the meat. Wash the pork and mince it. Steam the salted egg until cooked, take the yolk and mash it finely.

Step 2: Peel the kohlrabi and carrots, wash, and julienne finely. Soak the glass noodles and wood ear mushrooms in hot water until expanded, soaking each in a separate large bowl. For the wood ear mushrooms, wash them again and trim the stems to remove any odor. Cut the glass noodles into short segments and mince the wood ear mushrooms. Wash and finely chop the bean sprouts.

Step 3: In a large bowl, combine the pork, crab meat, salted egg, carrots, kohlrabi, mushrooms, and bean sprouts. Crack in the chicken egg and mix thoroughly. Season with salt, seasoning powder, and pepper, then stir again so everything is evenly marinated.
Step 4: Mix vinegar and lime juice in a small bowl. Dip the rice paper in this mixture to make it crispier when fried.
Next, spread the rice paper on a flat surface, place the filling in the center, flatten it out, and fold the four corners to form a square.

Step 5: Heat oil in a pan. Wait until the oil is very hot before adding the nem to fry. Turn all sides until the nem is golden brown, evenly cooked, and very crispy, then remove to a plate lined with paper towels. Use a knife to cut the nem into halves or quarters depending on your preference. Arrange raw vegetables on a plate and place the nem on top.

Step 6: Prepare the sweet and sour dipping sauce: Peel the green papaya and carrot, wash, and slice thinly. Add a bit of fish sauce, lime juice, sugar, seasoning powder, and enough broth to a pot and bring to a boil. Once boiling, add the sliced papaya and carrots to blanch briefly so they absorb the flavors. Pour the dipping sauce into a small bowl. You can add sliced chili to the sauce if you like.
Good luck to everyone!

mon_an.ten: How to make fresh and attractive potato salad
mon_an.mo_ta: Potato salad is simple, easy to make, doesn't take much time in the kitchen, and is very delicious and nutritious. Let's go shopping and get into the kitchen to make this dish right away.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 1 tbsp yogurt, 1 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tbsp sour cream
cac_buoc: Ingredients to prepare:

Wash the potatoes, place them in a pot, and cover with water. Place on the stove and boil until cooked. (Boil for about 15-20 minutes; if a chopstick can easily pierce through the potato, it is cooked). Only boil until just cooked; do not overcook or the potatoes will become mushy when cut. Drain all the water. Rinse the potatoes with cold water to cool them quickly. Peel, halve the potatoes, and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Divide the potatoes into two parts for two types of salad.
I. POTATO SALAD WITH BACON AND SAUSAGE

Step 1: Slice the bacon into strips. If you bought pre-sliced thin bacon, just cut across into 0.5-1cm strips. If you bought a large piece, first cut it into 1cm thick slices, then slice thinly to 2-3mm. If bacon is unavailable, other types of smoked meat can be used.
Peel and finely chop the onion.
Peel the sausages. Cut into 5cm segments. Use a small knife to score a cross at both ends of each sausage piece, about 1cm deep. (When fried, the ends will bloom beautifully).
Step 2: Place the bacon in a hot pan and stir well. No need to add oil or fat, as the fat from the meat will render out. Stir-fry until the meat is firm and golden. Remove the meat to a large bowl.

Add the onion to the pan with 1 tbsp of oil and stir-fry until the onion is firm and golden. Remove the onion and pour the fat/oil from the pan into the bowl with the meat. Next, add the sausages to the hot pan without adding oil. Stir-fry for about 10 minutes until the edges are charred and the ends bloom. Remove to a plate.
Step 3: Finely chop the dill. Halve the lime.

Step 4: Put the potatoes in the large bowl and mix well with the fried bacon and onion. Squeeze half a lime into the bowl. Add the chopped dill and mix gently. Remember to mix lightly so the potato pieces stay intact and don't get mashed. Season to taste. If you prefer it more sour, squeeze the remaining lime half.
Step 5: Arrange the potatoes on a plate. Place the sausages around them. Garnish the plate with vegetables.
II. POTATO SALAD WITH MAYONNAISE AND YOGURT
Step 1: Put the yogurt, mayonnaise, and sour cream in a bowl; use a fork or a small whisk to mix well. Sprinkle with pepper and a little salt, then mix again. Season to taste.
Step 2: Put the potatoes in a large bowl. Pour the mayonnaise+yogurt+sour cream mixture over them. Toss gently so the mixture coats each potato piece evenly. Sprinkle with chopped dill.
Step 3: Transfer the potatoes to a plate. Garnish the plate with vegetables.

These two salads go very well with bread. Potato salad can be eaten immediately. If preferred, you can refrigerate it for a few hours before serving. The salad will be cooler and more suitable for hot days.

mon_an.ten: How to make delicious Western-style braised pork ribs
mon_an.mo_ta: Western-style braised pork ribs is a rich, traditional, and delicious dish that everyone loves. With just these simple steps, you can enjoy a wonderful plate of Western-style braised pork ribs. Try cooking it according to the instructions in the article below! A guide on how to make delicious Western-style braised pork ribs in 100 words. Steps range from preparing ingredients, cutting and frying the ribs to adding seasonings and simmering. Discover the rich, fragrant flavor of traditional Western-style braised pork ribs.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fish sauce, filtered water - 2 tbsp each
Pepper, green onions, cooking oil, caramel sauce - ingredients
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients

After washing the pork ribs, drain them and cut into bite-sized pieces. Next, blanch the ribs in boiling water for about 2 minutes to remove impurities and odors. Then, remove the ribs and wash them again until clean, then drain. Peel, crush, and mince the garlic and shallots.
Remove the stems and seeds from the chilies, then julienne them. Wash the green onions and cilantro and cut them into segments.
Step 2: Marinate the ribs
Once the ribs are prepared, place them in a bowl and add 1 tsp pepper, 1 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp sugar, and 1/2 of the minced shallots and garlic. Mix well and marinate for about 1 hour.

The next step is to make the caramel sauce. To create the caramel sauce, put 1 tbsp of sugar in a pan and heat over low heat so the sugar melts slowly. When the sugar turns an amber color, quickly add 1/2 cup of water to the pan, bring back to a boil, then turn off the heat and let the caramel sauce cool.
Step 3: Braise the ribs
Using a clay pot, add 1 tbsp of cooking oil and sauté the remaining minced shallots and garlic with 2 tsp of chili powder until fragrant.

Add the marinated pork ribs to the pot and stir-fry over low heat for about 10 minutes. When the ribs are slightly firm and have changed color, add the caramel sauce (just made), peppercorns, and julienned chilies to the pot and toss well with the ribs. Simmer for another 5 minutes, then add filtered water until the meat is just covered. Cover and simmer over low heat for 30-40 minutes until the ribs are tender and fragrant. Before turning off the heat, remember to season again with salt, MSG, and seasoning powder to reach your desired taste.

After finishing the braising process, remove the ribs to a plate and sprinkle with a little pepper, green onions, and cilantro segments to add attractive color to the dish. Braised pork ribs with pepper become incredibly delicious when enjoyed with hot white rice.
Notes for delicious Western-style braised ribs:
You can adjust the seasonings to suit your family's taste.
While simmering the ribs, occasionally skim off any foam to make the ribs tastier, less odorous, and more fragrant!
You can replace the ribs with other ingredients like pork belly, silver rasbora fish, climbing perch, or goby fish; they are all very delicious.
When lightly frying the ribs, remember to brown both sides so the ribs have a beautiful color and a crispy exterior.
When simmering the ribs over low heat, occasionally stir them so the ribs can absorb the seasonings evenly, making them tastier when eaten with rice.
This Western-style braised rib dish is wonderful when eaten with hot rice!
Notes on choosing good pork ribs:

When choosing ribs, you should select those with flat and small bones. These ribs will have less bone and more meat than those with large, round bones. Also, note not to choose ribs that are too small. Small rib racks are cut from small pigs, which are not as tasty and sometimes not guaranteed (as sometimes the pig is still small and not ready for slaughter but is sick, so people slaughter it for sale :|).
How to choose good ribs for each dish:

For sweet and sour stir-fried ribs, braised, or fried... you should choose lean ribs with little or no fat. Ribs with cartilage (baby back ribs) are very delicious. For these dishes, loin ribs are the best choice.
For soups, porridge, or noodle dishes: choose ribs with both lean meat and fat so that when eaten, they are soft, fragrant, and rich.

Specifically for pork chops (cốt lết), you should choose pieces with a thick loin and little fat for softer and tastier meat. Pork chops are best for dishes like grilling, frying, roasting, simmering, or smoking.
Secrets to making delicious Western-style braised pork ribs:
To enhance the flavor of this dish, choose ribs with a little fat so that when braised, the dish has a rich taste and the pleasant crunch of cartilage.
To choose fresh ribs, press the ribs with your hand to feel the elasticity; the meat should be dry, light pink in color, and have no foul odor.
Before processing, blanch the ribs in boiling water to remove odors and impurities.
Marinate the ribs before braising so the dish is more flavorful and well-seasoned. The amount of seasoning like pepper and chili can be adjusted according to your taste.

If you want the dish to have a light sweetness, you can braise the ribs with coconut water. With this attractive and flavorful braised rib method guided above, you can create many different dishes like ribs braised with green peppercorns, sweet and sour braised ribs, cartilage ribs braised with pepper, and more. Good luck and bring delicious meals to your whole family during cold rainy days.

mon_an.ten: How to make irresistibly delicious tamarind glazed ribs
mon_an.mo_ta: The delicious taste of tamarind glazed ribs will leave you ecstatic, making you want to eat forever. The dish is extremely simple in both ingredients and method, so don't hesitate to try it.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings - sugar, pepper, turmeric powder, salt.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the ribs, marinate with seasonings and pepper, and leave for 15 minutes to absorb.
Step 2: Finely mince the shallots and garlic, then sauté with cooking oil until very fragrant.

Step 3: Filter out the shallot and garlic bits, keeping the infused oil. Use this exact oil to fry the ribs. This method helps the ribs retain the fragrance of the sautéed aromatics without getting bitter from burnt bits sticking to the meat during frying. Fry the ribs until golden on both sides, then remove and set aside to drain excess fat.
Step 4: Using another pan, add a little oil and sauté the tomatoes until soft.
Step 5: Then, add the tamarind paste, season with a bit of salt and sugar to taste, then add the ribs and simmer until the liquid is nearly evaporated and the sauce has thickened.
Place the tamarind glazed ribs on a plate and pour the sauce from the pan over them. Tamarind glazed ribs will be a delicious treat for the whole family.
Enjoy your meal with this flavorful and delicious tamarind glazed rib recipe!

mon_an.ten: How to make crispy five-spice rolled pig ears
mon_an.mo_ta: Let's get into the kitchen to make crispy five-spice rolled pig ears for your family, especially for your husband, as this dish is very good for health and helps reduce fatigue.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 1 stalk lemongrass, crushed; 1 tbsp cooking wine; 1/2 tsp five-spice powder; 1 tbsp oyster sauce; 2 cloves garlic; 2 star anise; 1 cinnamon stick; 2 lime leaves; 3 stalks green onion; 1 piece ginger, sliced; 1 tsp seasoning powder; 7 peppercorns; 3 tbsp soy sauce; 1/3 tsp salt; 1 tsp brown sugar; 1 tsp dark soy sauce; 500 ml fresh coconut water; a few dried chilies (optional)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Use a knife to scrape clean any dirt on the pig ears, then wash thoroughly with cold water. Roll the pig ears from the outside in and tie tightly with string.

Step 2: Put about 1 liter of cold water in a pot with the wine, lemongrass, ginger, salt, and lime leaves. Bring to a boil for 5 minutes, then add the rolled and tied pig ears and boil for 10 minutes. After 10 minutes, remove the pig ears and rinse with cold water.

Step 3: Arrange the green onions at the bottom of the pot, then place the pig ears in the pot along with all the remaining seasonings like soy sauce, dark soy sauce, seasoning powder, star anise, cinnamon... and fresh coconut water.

Place on the stove over medium heat and cook until the liquid thickens and the pig ears turn an amber color, then turn off the heat. Remove the pig ears to a plate, wait for them to cool, and place in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours or overnight. This time allows the pig ears to hold their round shape so they don't unravel when sliced.

*Presentation:* Slice the pig ears into rounds and arrange on a plate, garnish with cucumber flowers, lettuce, and chili to make it more attractive. The pig ears are crispy and fragrant with cinnamon and star anise, making it a very appealing dish for those who enjoy a drink.

mon_an.ten: How to make irresistibly delicious crab temaki
mon_an.mo_ta: A new way to enjoy crab that you cannot miss. Check out the instructions for making wonderful crab temaki below!
cac_buoc: Ingredients you need to prepare for temaki:
Step 1:
First, wash the cucumber and cut it into thick strips as shown in the picture!
Next, mix the mayonnaise with wasabi in a 4:1 ratio!
For the crab, wash it and boil in a pot until cooked, then separate the crab meat and set aside.
You should let the crab cool slightly before picking the meat to make it easier!
Next, peel the avocado, remove the pit, and slice the avocado into thin pieces.
Step 2:
Arrange these ingredients on a plate: sushi rice, crab meat, avocado, masago, wasabi mayonnaise, sriracha sauce, seaweed, and roasted sesame seeds.
We will proceed to wrap them to create a wonderful temaki dish!
Step 3:
Take a sheet of seaweed and place a handful of rice at one end. Place the rice diagonally and spread it thinly! (As shown in the picture)
Step 4:
Next, use a spoon to spread the crab roe evenly over the rice.
Step 5:
Then add the crab meat and a slice of avocado on top.
Step 6:
After that, just add the pre-mixed mayonnaise+wasabi and sriracha. Be sure to drizzle the sauce evenly!
Step 7:

Now start rolling diagonally according to the shape of the rice until the seaweed is finished. When you reach the end, dab 1-2 grains of rice to seal the seaweed; this prevents the filling from falling out.
So the crab temaki is now complete! It's very simple, isn't it? You can definitely prepare this nutritious dish for the whole family yourself!
Finished product requirements:
Crab meat is just cooked, not too mushy.
The product is beautifully wrapped, not crushed or falling apart.
If you are not used to eating it plain, you can dip this dish in ketchup or chili sauce for a better taste!

mon_an.ten: How to make simple and delicious braised pork belly with sesame
mon_an.mo_ta: Braised pork belly with sesame is a fairly easy dish to make with tender, fresh, and flavorful pork belly marinated for hours, combined with golden, soft, and fragrant roasted sesame. Braised pork belly with sesame served with hot rice will be an excellent choice for you after a tiring workday. Let's get into the kitchen and learn how to make this delicious dish!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning powder, MSG, fish sauce, cooking oil, sugar - seasonings
cac_buoc: Prepare ingredients for braised pork belly with sesame
Pick and remove the roots and wilted leaves of the green onions and cilantro, then wash, drain, and finely chop.
Wash the horn chilies; julienne 2 and slice 3.
Peel the shallots and garlic, wash, and mince finely.
Trim the roots and wilted leaves of the lemongrass, wash, and mince finely.
Toast the white sesame seeds over low heat until golden brown.
Wash the pork belly and cut into bite-sized pieces.

Then, marinate the meat with 1/2 of the minced shallots, garlic, and lemongrass + 1/2 of the roasted sesame + 1.5 tbsp fish sauce + 1 tsp seasoning powder + 1 tsp MSG + 2 tbsp honey + 1 tsp pepper with 1 tbsp cooking oil. Marinate for about 3-4 hours so the meat absorbs the seasonings, making it tasty, flavorful, and tender when eaten.

Prepare the caramel sauce: Put 2 tbsp of sugar in a pan, turn the heat to a very low simmer, and heat until the sugar melts completely and turns a deep amber color. Add 1/2 small cup of water, bring to a boil, pour into a bowl, and let cool.
Steps to perform braised pork belly with sesame

First, place a pan on the stove, add 3 tbsp of cooking oil and bring to a boil, then add the remaining minced shallots, garlic, and lemongrass and sauté until fragrant. Then, add the marinated pork belly and stir well. Braise the pork belly over low heat, continuing to stir until the meat is firm, then add the prepared caramel sauce along with 50ml of fresh coconut water. Stir a few more times, cover, and turn the heat to a very low simmer to braise the meat.
After 15 minutes, taste and adjust the seasonings; if it's too light, add more seasoning to make the dish more flavorful!

Finally, when the braised meat releases an attractive aroma and the sauce has thickened to coat each piece of meat with a beautiful deep amber color, add the remaining roasted sesame seeds and stir well. Sprinkle 1/2 tsp of pepper on top and turn off the stove.
Scoop the meat onto a plate, sprinkle the chopped green onions and julienned horn chilies on the surface, and enjoy.
Notes for delicious braised pork belly with sesame:
How to choose good pork belly: select pieces that have all 3 layers of meat, are fresh with bright colors, and have a certain elasticity when pressed.
Before marinating, you should blanch the meat in boiling water so the pieces become plump and attractive, don't dry out, and have less odor.
To make the pork belly delicious in every bite, you should marinate the meat overnight in the refrigerator and take it out to cook when needed.

mon_an.ten: How to make unique and tasty stir-fried beef with bitter melon
mon_an.mo_ta: Besides bitter melon with eggs or stuffed bitter melon, stir-fried beef with bitter melon is also a favorite dish for many families, featuring tender, fresh, flavorful beef served with crunchy bitter melon that is slightly bitter but still has its own unique taste. The combination of beef and bitter melon gives the diner a wonderful sensation. Let's get into the kitchen and learn how to make this delicious dish!
cac_buoc: Step 1:

Wash the bitter melon and cut it in half. Then, remove the seeds inside and cut into pieces. To remove some of the bitterness, sprinkle them with a little salt and let sit for 10 minutes. Then wash and set aside in a bowl.
Step 2:
Peel the carrot, wash, and cut into bite-sized pieces or carve into flower shapes and slice for stir-frying.
Step 3:
Peel the garlic, wash, and mince finely.
Step 4:
Next, soak the fermented black beans for about 20 minutes. Then, drain and chop into small pieces.
Step 5:

Wash the beef and slice thinly. Then, marinate with the regular soy sauce, sugar, cornstarch, and cooking oil prepared above for about 10 minutes so the beef absorbs the seasonings, making it tastier when cooked.
Step 6:
Place a pan on the stove, add cooking oil, and heat. Then, stir-fry the beef until just cooked, remove to a plate, and set aside.
Step 7:
Next, in another pan, add a bit more cooking oil. When hot, add the garlic and black beans and sauté until fragrant.
Step 8:
Then, add the bitter melon and carrots to stir-fry together. Stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes until the vegetables are soft. At that point, add the chicken stock and the beef to cook.
Step 9:
Cook until the liquid in the pan is slightly thickened, then season with salt and pepper to taste.
Step 10:
Finally, present on a plate, drizzle a little sesame oil over the stir-fry, and it's ready to enjoy.
Notes for delicious stir-fried beef with bitter melon:
1. How to remove bitterness from bitter melon:
To make bitter melon (also known as khổ qua) less bitter, you can:
Soak the bitter melon in cold water or ice.
If it's still bitter, you can cut the melon into pieces, marinate with a little salt, and then soak them in cold water again.

Bitter melon has the characteristic of being bitter itself but not making other ingredients cooked with it bitter. The vitamin C content in bitter melon is very rich, and it has the effect of clearing heat, improving eyesight, and detoxifying because it has cooling properties.
2. How to choose good beef:

Choose beef with small, soft fibers; do not buy large, tough fibers. Finally, press the beef fibers; if it doesn't stick to your hand and has no foul odor, it is good. Female beef is usually tastier than male beef. If you can choose young beef, it's even better because the meat is soft, the fat is white, and the fibers are fine. To buy good beef, look for a bright red color, fibers that are not too fine (unless it's young beef), small white tendons, and bright yellow fat.

Beef that is pale green with round white spots between the fibers is infected with flukes or tapeworms. You should also not buy meat that has a foul odor. Signs of bad beef: dark color, deep yellow fat, yellow bones. Poor elasticity, mushy meat, and a slimy surface.
Dark red meat with deep yellow fat and large fibers is old, very tough beef.
Dark red meat with white fat and a slightly fishy, non-fragrant smell is buffalo meat.

Tapeworm cysts are easy to spot because they look exactly like grains of rice nestled in the meat fibers; if you prick them with a knife tip, they fall out immediately, unlike small white tendons which are both tough and firmly attached to the meat.

mon_an.ten: How to make stir-fried beef with chilies, delicious to the last bite
mon_an.mo_ta: Hot stir-fried beef with chilies is very suitable for rainy weather, serving well as both a drinking snack and a main dish with hot rice.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Beef, high quality, cut into thin strips - 150g
10ml soy sauce; 2.5ml sesame oil; 5ml cornstarch; 5ml cooking oil
30ml cooking oil; 3 cloves garlic, sliced; 8 stir-fry chilies, long, cut into thin long strips; 1 red chili (stir-fry type), also cut into long strips.
15ml wine; 2.5g salt; 5ml soy sauce; white pepper
cac_buoc: Step 1: Slice the beef into thin, long strips.
Step 2: Put all the beef marinade ingredients into a large bowl, mix well, and let marinate for 30 minutes at room temperature.

Step 3: When marinated, add cooking oil to a pan over high heat until the oil is smoking hot. Add the beef and stir-fry until golden brown. If the pan is thin, the beef will have a very nice slight char. Turn off the heat, remove the beef to a separate bowl, leaving a little oil in the pan.
Step 4: Reheat the pan over high heat, add the garlic and chilies to stir-fry. Sauté for about 20 seconds, then add the wine.
Stir-fry for another 20 seconds, then add the beef back in. Add a little salt, sugar, soy sauce, and pepper. Turn the heat to the highest setting and stir-fry for another 1-2 minutes.
