If you like a bit more sauce, add a tiny bit of water. Transfer the stir-fried beef with chilies to a plate and enjoy!

mon_an.ten: How to make excellent sweet and sour fried pork with pineapple
mon_an.mo_ta: Sweet and sour fried pork with pineapple, with the aroma and sweetness of pineapple combined with tomato sauce infused into every piece of meat, will make it impossible for you not to try it.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Tomato sauce, vinegar, sugar, soy sauce, salt, pepper
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Choose a medium-sized pineapple with large, even eyes; that is a good pineapple. Then peel, remove the eyes, and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Wash the pork with salt, then rinse clean and cut into bite-sized pieces; place in a bowl.
Beat the egg and add it to the bowl of meat, marinate with 1 tsp of salt and pepper, and wait for it to absorb.
Dredge the meat through the frying flour; only a thin layer of flour coating the outside of the meat is needed.
Step 2:

Place a pan on the stove and wait until very hot, add cooking oil and wait for it to boil, then add the meat to fry. Initially, use medium heat so the meat cooks from the inside, then increase the heat to brown the outer crust. Once the meat is fried and cooked, remove to a plate.

Sauté the crushed garlic in the same pan used for the meat. Then, add the tomato sauce, 1 tsp salt and pepper, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp vinegar, and ½ bowl of water. Stir until all seasonings are dissolved, adjust the sweet, sour, and salty taste to your preference, then bring to a boil.

Next, add the pineapple to stir-fry with the sauce. Sauté until the pineapple is soft and has absorbed the seasonings, then add the meat and toss together. Simmer for a few minutes, stirring gently so the meat is coated in the sauce.
So we have finished this wonderful dish!

mon_an.mo_ta: Salt-crusted fried chicken is a familiar favorite for many families. The chicken is tender and fresh, with a crispy outer crust coated in savory roasted salt, complemented by the aromatic scent of lemongrass and lime leaves. There is nothing better than enjoying this delicious dish with a family meal. Let's get into the kitchen and prepare this treat for everyone!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Pepper, seasoning powder, fish sauce, MSG - seasonings
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients for the salt-crusted chicken:
First, thoroughly wash the glutinous rice, non-glutinous rice, and mung beans.
Soak each type of rice and the mung beans separately in warm water for 15-20 minutes to allow them to expand evenly; this makes cooking faster and improves the texture.
Afterward, drain the rice well and roast until fragrant. Stir constantly while roasting to prevent burning or uneven cooking.
Roast the mung beans until golden brown.
Next, roast the sea salt until dry and then grind it finely.
Grind all the roasted rice, salt, and mung beans into a fine powder. Let it cool, then store the excess in a glass jar and seal tightly.
Wash the lemongrass and cut into 3-finger-long segments, then shred lengthwise. Wash the lime leaves and slice into thin strips.
Crack the egg into a bowl, separating the yolk and the white.

Wash the chicken thoroughly, chop into bite-sized pieces, and marinate with 1 tsp seasoning powder, 1 tbsp fish sauce, a pinch of MSG, pepper, cooking oil, and the egg yolk. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes to let the flavors penetrate.
Steps to make salt-crusted fried chicken:
Place a pan on the stove and add cooking oil. Once the oil is hot, add the lemongrass and lime leaves. Once fragrant, remove them and set aside.
Coat the chicken pieces in a layer of tapioca starch and fry them. Use enough oil to submerge the chicken so it becomes crispy and turns a beautiful golden color.
Once the chicken is golden and crispy, remove it and place it in a separate pot.
Toss the chicken with 3 tbsp of the roasted salt powder you prepared earlier and the fried lemongrass and lime leaves. Shake well for a moment until the powder evenly coats the chicken pieces.
Notes for making salt-crusted fried chicken:

Usually, the roasted salt and rice mixture is made in a large batch and stored in an airtight jar to be used for other dishes like salt-crusted duck or salt-crusted frog, as this mixture keeps for a long time.

When grinding the rice and salt mixture, you only need to grind it into small bits, not a fine dust. Let the rice cool before grinding to avoid damaging the machine or turning the rice into mush, which would ruin the texture.
Only fry the chicken until the outside is golden; frying for too long will make the meat dry.
How to choose good chicken:

Prepared free-range chicken usually has a compact, firm body and a narrow breast. Industrial layers look similar, so distinguish them carefully. Free-range chicken skin is pale yellow, with darker yellow patches on the breast, wings, and back, while industrial chickens are often white or entirely yellow (possibly due to harmful dyes).
To check for dyes, observe the skin: if the skin is yellow but the fat underneath is white, it has likely been treated with chemicals.
The skin should be thin, smooth, and elastic. Choose fresh-looking meat with no foul or antibiotic smell, and no bruises or blood clots on the skin.
Avoid chicken that looks dark or bruised, as it may have died before being processed.
To avoid water-injected chicken, press on areas like the thighs or breast; if it feels mushy, slippery, or deforms easily, do not buy it. Water is often mixed with borax before injection.

mon_an.ten: Crispy Pork with Green Rice Flakes
mon_an.mo_ta: Crispy pork with green rice flakes, featuring the seductive aroma of tender pork and the fragrant scent of green rice, will surely keep you coming back for more.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Wash the pork tenderloin, pat dry, and slice into thin, large, even pieces. Marinate with a little salt or seasoning powder for about 15 minutes. Crack the egg into a bowl and whisk well.
Step 2:
Dip each piece of meat into the egg. Then roll it in the green rice flakes until evenly coated on both sides.
Step 3:
Heat 1-2 tbsp of oil in a pan and fry the meat over medium heat.
When the meat is golden brown on both sides, remove and place on a plate lined with paper towels for 2-3 minutes. Arrange on a serving plate and serve hot.

mon_an.ten: Braised Pork Belly with White Radish
mon_an.mo_ta: In chilly weather, nothing beats braised pork with white radish, especially when served with hot steamed rice. The ingredients and method are incredibly simple—let's get cooking! Check out the recipe for delicious braised pork with white radish below.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Sugar, seasoning powder, MSG, fish sauce, salt
cac_buoc: 1. Instructions for making braised pork with white radish
Step 1:
Wash the pork belly with diluted salt water, drain, and marinate with 1 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp MSG, 1 tbsp salt, 1 tbsp pepper, and crushed shallots.
Heat sugar in a pan until it turns dark brown, then add a little water to make caramel sauce. Alternatively, you can use store-bought caramel coloring.
Step 2:
Peel the radishes and cut into 2cm chunks.
Toss the radish with a bit of salt to remove any bitterness and enhance the flavor.
Mix the pork and radish together, pour in the prepared caramel sauce, and marinate for about 15 minutes.
Step 3:
Simmer over low heat, adding a little water until the pork and radish are just submerged. Season to taste.
Add sliced chili. Wait about 30 minutes until cooked through.
Braised pork with white radish served with hot rice is guaranteed to be a crowd-pleaser.
2. How to make braised pork with white radish without making caramel sauce
Ingredients:
300 grams pork belly.
3 white radishes.
1 stalk scallion.
2 chilies.
2 shallots.
1 tbsp fish sauce.
Common seasonings: seasoning powder, MSG, pepper, sugar, and salt.
Preparation
Prepare the ingredients:

First, to remove the odor from the pork belly, soak it in diluted salt water for about 5 minutes, then rinse with cold water and drain. Cut the meat into bite-sized pieces, about 1/3 of a finger joint thick.
Wash the white radish, peel, and cut into bite-sized chunks.
Wash and finely chop the scallions. Peel and mince the shallots. Wash the chilies and drain.
Marinate the meat:
Place the pork belly in a bowl and marinate with the minced shallots, 1 tsp salt, 1 tbsp seasoning powder, and 1/2 tsp MSG. Mix well so the meat absorbs the spices and let it sit for 15 minutes.
Braising the pork:
Place a pot on the stove and add the marinated meat. Turn the heat to medium and stir-fry for about 5 minutes until the meat firms up.
Add 1/3 cup of water to the pot, then add all the radish. Stir once to combine, cover, and simmer over low heat for about 10 minutes.
Once the meat and radish are cooked (after about 10 minutes), add 1 tsp sugar and 1 tbsp fish sauce, and stir well.

Simmer for another 2 minutes, then adjust the seasoning to taste. Turn off the heat and serve on a plate. Garnish with chopped scallions, ground pepper, and whole chilies. The braised pork with white radish is complete.
The dish is attractive, with a strong aroma from the scallions and pepper. The radish is cooked just right, retaining its characteristic crisp-sweetness. The pork is tender and slightly fatty.
This dish is truly delicious with rice. It will surely satisfy your family!
Good luck with this fragrant and attractive braised pork and radish dish!
How to buy quality ingredients
How to buy good pork belly:
Choose pieces with a balance of meat and fat to ensure it isn't too greasy.
Fresh pork belly usually has opaque white fat and pinkish-red meat. The exterior should have a dry membrane and not feel sticky to the touch.
Press the meat with your finger. Fresh meat will feel elastic and firm.
Fresh meat has a characteristic raw smell. Spoiled meat will smell foul or strange.
Avoid pieces with very thin fat layers, as they may come from pigs raised with lean-meat agents.
Avoid meat that is mushy, lacks elasticity, or has strange blood spots on the surface.
How to choose fresh white radishes:
Choose medium-sized radishes that are elongated towards the tail. Radishes with fat tails often contain too much water and lack flavor.
Fresh radishes should still have their stems and roots attached; the stems should be fresh and not wilted. This indicates they were recently harvested.
Avoid radishes with rotten stems but shiny skin, as they may have been treated with preservatives. These are neither tasty nor healthy.

mon_an.ten: Meatballs Stuffed with Quail Eggs in Tomato Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: Meatballs stuffed with quail eggs in tomato sauce is a delicious and nutritious dish that will greatly enrich your family meal. Let's learn how to cook it!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, sugar, fish sauce, pepper, dried shallots, soy sauce, garlic.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Place the ground pork in a bowl, mix with one small tsp salt, two small tsp fish sauce, pepper, and finely chopped shallots. Use a spoon to mix until smooth. Step 2:
Peel and finely mince the onion.
Wash, peel, and finely mince the jicama. Step 3:
Mix the onion and jicama into the meat bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours. Step 4:
Boil the quail eggs until cooked, then peel. Step 5:
Wash the tomatoes and mince them, or use a blender to puree them for the sauce. Step 6:
After marinating, scoop the meat into balls, flatten them, place a quail egg in the center, and wrap the meat around it. Repeat until all meat and eggs are used. Step 7:
Heat a steamer, arrange the meatballs inside, and steam for 5 to 6 minutes until the meat surface sets. Step 8:
Once steamed, set the meatballs aside.
Place a pan on the stove, add a little oil, and sauté the shallots and garlic until fragrant. Add the pureed tomatoes and bring to a boil; simmer for about 5 minutes. Step 9:
Add the steamed meatballs to the tomato sauce, cover, and season with fish sauce, sugar, and soy sauce to taste. Simmer over low heat. Remember to taste and adjust the seasoning!

Simmer until the tomato sauce thickens, then turn off the heat. Add chopped scallions and serve on a plate as a savory dish with rice. We have finished the meatballs stuffed with quail eggs in tomato sauce! This dish is perfect with rice. Enjoy!

mon_an.mo_ta: Are you looking for a way to make a nutritious sweet and sour braised shrimp dish that provides extra calcium for your meal? The shrimp is braised in a sweet and sour mixture combined with spices to create a unique flavor. This dish is especially rich in calcium, an important mineral for bone and tooth health. In this article, we will share the recipe for this nutritious dish. With detailed and easy-to-follow instructions, this sweet and sour shrimp will make your meal exciting and healthy.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Sugar, vinegar, white wine - 1 tbsp (15ml) each
A little water and cornstarch (optional for thick sauce), 1/2 tsp salt
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Trim the shrimp whiskers and remove the black vein, then rinse with salt water to reduce the fishy smell. Rinse again with clean water and drain.
Marinate the shrimp with 1 tsp seasoning powder, ½ tsp salt, and ½ tsp ground pepper for about 20 minutes. Do not use too much salt or seasoning as shrimp absorbs flavors easily.
Peel and mince the garlic and shallots.
Wash and finely chop the chili and scallions.
In a bowl, combine ½ small bowl of water, 1 tbsp sugar, 2 tbsp chili sauce, and 1 tbsp vinegar to make the sweet and sour sauce. Stir well to dissolve and adjust the taste to your preference.
Step 2: Cook the sweet and sour braised shrimp
Place a pan on the stove, add oil, and wait until hot. Set heat to medium. Sauté half of the minced garlic and shallots until fragrant.
Add the marinated shrimp and stir-fry quickly until the shrimp firms up. Add 2 tsp sugar and 2 tsp fish sauce, and continue stirring until the shrimp is cooked. Transfer the shrimp to a plate.
Place another pan on the stove, add oil, and sauté the remaining garlic and shallots. Once golden and fragrant, add the prepared sweet and sour sauce and bring to a boil over medium heat.
Add the cooked shrimp back into the sauce. Reduce heat to low and toss the shrimp regularly so they absorb the sauce without burning.
When the sauce starts to thicken, add the chopped scallions, chili, and 1 tsp lime juice. Stir well and turn off the heat. The sweet and sour braised shrimp is done!
Note: During cooking, ensure the heat is low so the shrimp has time to absorb the flavors without drying out, and toss frequently for even coating.
Step 3: Finished product

This dish takes very little time, but for the best result, you need bright red shrimp that are well-coated in the fragrant sauce. To get a perfect score, remember the notes during preparation and do not skip any key seasonings.
This braised shrimp is best served hot. You can garnish with lettuce or green vegetables to highlight the attractive red color of the shrimp on the plate.

mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried shrimp with tofu is very easy to eat and will make your family's daily meals much more flavorful.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Green bell pepper, sliced into strips - 1 pepper
Sauce - 2.5ml hoisin sauce; 2.5ml oyster sauce; 1.5ml soy sauce
cac_buoc: Step 1: Roll the tofu in cornstarch.
Step 2:

In a non-stick pan, heat olive oil over medium heat and fry the tofu. Fry until golden brown. Turn off the heat and place the tofu on paper towels. Heat a little oil in the pan, add garlic and sauté until fragrant. Then add the shrimp and stir-fry for 1 minute or until they turn pink.
Add the green bell pepper and stir-fry for 1 minute. Then add the fried tofu and the sauce mixture.
Transfer the stir-fried shrimp and tofu to a plate and serve with hot rice!
Wishing you success and a delicious meal!

mon_an.mo_ta: This is still an egg roll, but a new twist that will give you the confidence to serve it at dinner parties or small family gatherings. The dish is more attractive with its eye-catching appearance. The golden egg wraps around the pale pink steamed meat, accented by the green of the scallions, making it not only beautiful and delicious but also showcasing the skill and sincerity of the cook. Let's get in the kitchen and make meat-stuffed egg rolls!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Ground pork or raw pork paste (giò sống) - 150g (ground meat is harder to bind when rolling)
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Wash the mushrooms and drain.

Dissolve the tapioca starch in 1 small bowl of broth, then pour into a deep pan and bring to a boil. Season with a little seasoning powder, then add the mushrooms. Wait for it to boil again and turn off the heat, as mushrooms cook very quickly.
Step 2:
Mix the ground meat thoroughly with 1 egg, minced ginger and scallions, a few diced mushrooms, 2 tsp cornstarch, and a little seasoning powder until it forms a sticky paste.
Step 3:
Whisk the remaining eggs. Heat a non-stick pan with a little oil and pour in a very thin layer of egg.

When the egg starts to set, lower the heat so it cooks through without burning; if the heat is too high, the egg will burn easily. Use a wooden spatula to flip and fry the other side, then turn off the heat. Make 2-3 such thin egg sheets.
Spread the fried egg sheet on a wide plate. Scoop the meat filling onto the egg and use a spoon to spread a thin, even layer across the entire surface.

Lift the edge of the egg and slowly roll it up like a spring roll, using moderate pressure—not too tight and not too loose. If it's too tight, the roll may burst during steaming; if too loose, it will fall apart. Repeat with the remaining egg sheets.
Step 4:
After rolling, place the egg rolls in a steamer. Steam for about 15 minutes since the meat layer is quite thin and the egg is already cooked.
Let them cool slightly, then remove and use a sharp thin knife to cut into 1cm thick slices.
Step 5:
Arrange the egg slices to cover the inside of a large bowl, like "tiling" the bowl. Fill the remaining space with the mushrooms from Step 1.

Place the bowl back into the steamer and steam for 3-4 minutes after the water boils again to help the egg and mushrooms bind together. Remove the bowl, place a plate on top, and flip it over, similar to how you would plate sticky rice.
Sprinkle some finely chopped scallions on top for garnish. You can add a bit of ground pepper for aroma.

Thanks to the steaming method, the flavor of the meat-stuffed egg rolls is light and natural. During seasonal transitions when immunity is low, you can change your family's palate with this slightly elaborate dish—refreshing the taste buds and adding nutrition without being greasy.
Wishing you success and a delicious meal with these meat-stuffed egg rolls!

mon_an.ten: Roasted Duck with Fermented Bean Curd
mon_an.mo_ta: Gathering the whole family on the weekend to make roasted duck with fermented bean curd is wonderful, isn't it?
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Rub the duck with rice wine and ginger, then rinse thoroughly with water. Remove all pinfeathers and any lung tissue attached to the bones.
Step 2:
Debone the duck breast. Marinate the duck with the fermented bean curds, minced shallots, minced garlic, honey, and MSG for 15 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Step 3:
Place on a grill rack for about 15–20 minutes until the meat is golden brown and slightly charred at the edges. Serve with lettuce, herbs, and a dipping sauce made of fermented bean curd and satay.

mon_an.ten: Chicken Sticky Rice Wrapped in Lotus Leaves
mon_an.mo_ta: You can make this lotus leaf sticky rice during your free time to treat the whole family; it's best made the night before for breakfast the next morning. This dish is quite easy to make and tastes excellent.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: For the sauce - 0ml light soy sauce; 2.5g pepper; 15ml oyster sauce; 2.5g five-spice powder; 15g minced ginger; 15ml cooking wine; 5g cornstarch
Boneless chicken thighs, cut into small pieces - 4 pieces
Lotus leaves - 5 leaves, soaked in warm water for 1 hour, washed, and halved
cac_buoc: Step 1: In a medium bowl, mix the chicken with the sauce ingredients. Then place in the refrigerator.
Step 2: Soak the rice for 2 hours, drain, and mix the rice with soy sauce. Set aside.
Step 3: Heat a pan and add 30ml oil. When the oil is almost smoking, add half of the mushrooms and sauté until golden and soft. Turn off the heat and set aside.
Do the same with the remaining mushrooms. (The reason for sautéing in two batches is to prevent the mushrooms from releasing too much water). Set the mushrooms aside.

Step 4: Heat the pan over medium heat and add 1 tbsp oil. Add the chicken and stir-fry. Mix in the mushrooms, scallions, and salt, then stir-fry for a few minutes until the ingredients are well combined.

Step 5: Mix the chicken mixture with the soaked rice. Spread a little oil on the surface of the lotus leaves, then place a sufficient amount of the rice mixture in the center and fold the leaf into a rectangle.
Repeat with the remaining ingredients.
Step 6: Place in a steamer and steam for about 90 minutes.
You can eat this chicken sticky rice with chili sauce. If you have leftovers, you can store them in the freezer; when ready to eat, re-steam for about 30 minutes.

mon_an.mo_ta: Shrimp-stuffed mushrooms is one of the few dishes that is simple in both ingredients and preparation, yet the flavor is not inferior to more elaborate dishes. If you are busy and have little time for housework, add this dish to your family menu to make every meal more interesting and delicious. Let's look at the recipe.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Gently remove the stems from the mushroom caps by hand.
Step 2: Finely mince the shrimp with a bit of salt and pepper.
Step 3: Stuff the minced shrimp into the mushrooms, pressing firmly with a spoon so the filling doesn't fall out during frying.
Step 4: Coat the pan with oil and place the mushrooms shrimp-side down to fry first. Then flip and fry the mushroom caps.

Step 5: Mix the sauce ingredients together (except for the cornstarch) and bring to a boil. Then, dissolve the cornstarch in a little water and pour it in to thicken the sauce; add a little salt if it tastes bland.
Step 6: Arrange the mushrooms on a deep plate and pour the sauce over them. More simply, you can just eat the mushrooms with chili sauce and hot rice, which is also very delicious.
In just 6 steps, you have quickly prepared a wonderful plate of shrimp-stuffed mushrooms. Not complicated to make, but very beautiful in presentation and flavor.

mon_an.mo_ta: These crispy garlic fried ribs will delight your family with their crunchy breaded coating and tender meat. Check out the recipe below!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Wash and drain the ribs.
Place the ribs in a bowl and marinate with cooking wine, sugar, soy sauce, minced ginger, and chopped green onions for 30 minutes.
Step 2:
Dredge each piece of rib in cornstarch.
Step 3:
Heat oil in a pan and fry the ribs until golden brown or until fully cooked (7-8 minutes).
Once the ribs are golden brown, remove them and place on a plate lined with paper towels to drain excess oil.
Step 4:
Toast the breadcrumbs in a dry pan until golden brown.
Step 5:
Add the fried ribs to the pan and toss with the breadcrumbs until evenly coated.
Serve on a plate and enjoy with chili sauce or ketchup!

mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried mixed vegetables with shrimp is a familiar dish, but the technique is key to getting the flavor just right. Let's learn how to cook it!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the shrimp. Marinate the shrimp with rice wine, oyster sauce, sugar, sesame oil, salt, and pepper for 15 minutes.
Step 2: Dice the celery. Mince the garlic and finely chop the onion.
Step 3: In a large pan, add oil and sauté the garlic until fragrant. Add the shrimp and stir-fry until almost cooked, then remove from the pan.
Step 4: In another pan, add a little oil and sauté the celery until softened.
Step 5: Add the corn, shrimp, and onion, and stir-fry until the shrimp is fully cooked.
Add a little sesame oil, salt, and pepper to taste. Serve the stir-fried shrimp on a plate and enjoy with rice.

mon_an.mo_ta: Sweet broth, tender melon, and savory shrimp-meat filling make this a satisfying yet light dish. Perfect for a quick, nutritious meal that melts away the day's fatigue.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel and wash the winter melon, then cut into short segments. Finely chop the green onions.
Step 2: Soak the glass noodles until soft, drain, and cut into short pieces.
Step 3: Wash and peel the shrimp, then mince them finely. Mix the shrimp, glass noodles, and ground meat with a little salt, seasoning powder, and pepper.
Step 4: Use a spoon to scoop out the melon pulp, leaving a little at the bottom to prevent the filling from falling out.
Step 5: Stuff the shrimp and meat mixture into the melon segments.

Step 6: Arrange the melon pieces in a pot, add water to just cover them, bring to a boil, and simmer until the melon is tender. Season to taste. Do not use fish sauce, as it can make the winter melon broth sour.
Step 7: Once the melon is cooked, add the green onions, bring to a final boil, then turn off the heat. Serve in a bowl with rice.

mon_an.ten: Fish Ball and Mustard Green Soup
mon_an.mo_ta: This refreshing, low-fat fish ball and mustard green soup is perfect for summer. Let's find out how to make it!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Pick and wash the mustard greens, then cut into segments if necessary.
Step 2:
Add water to a pot and bring to a boil. Add the fish balls and simmer on low heat for about 10 minutes until cooked.
Step 3:
Add the mustard greens and sliced ginger, and cook for another 5 minutes until the greens are tender. Season with seasoning powder, salt, and pepper to taste.
Step 4:
Once the greens are cooked, turn off the heat, remove from the stove, and serve in a bowl with hot rice.

mon_an.mo_ta: A refreshing and easy-to-eat luffa and tofu soup for hot sunny days.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning - 1 tsp seasoning powder; 1 tsp sugar; 1 tbsp fish sauce; 1/3 tsp pepper.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel the luffa and cut into rounds.
Step 2: Mince the shrimp. Marinate the shrimp with seasoning powder, the white parts of the green onions, and pepper.
Step 3: Cut the tofu into bite-sized pieces.
Step 4: Place a pot on the stove, add 1 tbsp oil, and sauté the shallots until fragrant. Add the shrimp and stir-fry quickly until firm, then add 2 bowls of water.
Step 5: When the soup boils, skim off the foam to keep the broth clear.
Step 6: Add the luffa, tofu, egg noodles, and remaining seasonings. Cook for a few minutes, adjust the seasoning to taste, and turn off the heat.
Serve the soup in a bowl, arranging a few shrimp on top for a more appealing look. This dish is delicious on its own or served with rice.

mon_an.mo_ta: Spicy Squid Stir-fry – the name alone suggests a hint of heat. This dish is perfect for a weekend family treat or as a great snack for your husband!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, prepare the squid: remove the ink sac, innards, and backbone; score the surface and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Shred the horn chili. Slice the carrot into bite-sized pieces and blanch briefly.
Wedge the onion. Wash the leek and cut into sections.
Step 2:

Place a pan over heat and add oil. When the oil is hot, sauté the minced garlic until golden, then add the squid and stir-fry quickly. Add the carrots, onions, leeks, horn chili, and spicy chili sauce, then toss well. Season with seasoning powder, sugar, and soy sauce to taste.
Transfer the squid to a plate and serve with hot rice.

Small tip: You can add a little white wine while stir-frying to enhance the aroma. Adjust the amount of spicy sauce to your taste, but don't use too little, as the dish is called 'Spicy Squid Stir-fry'—it wouldn't be right without that signature heat!

mon_an.mo_ta: With the fresh and fragrant flavor of mangosteen, this salad is sure to captivate food lovers. Not only that, mangosteen salad is packed with nutrition and antioxidants. In this article, we will share 2 delicious mangosteen salad recipes. Try making this tasty salad and enjoy it with your family. Preparation: 20m
thoi_gian: Preparing mangosteen correctly: Soak the mangosteen in diluted salt water to clean it and remove the sap. Then, peel the outer skin to get the flesh inside. Use running water while peeling and soak the flesh in salt water to keep it fresh and white.
cac_buoc: Processing: 30m
Prepare ingredients
Chicken: 500gr
Mangosteen: 1 kilogram (just ripe)
Vietnamese coriander and basil: 50 gram
Peanuts: 100 gram
Chili: 2
Lime: 1
Garlic: 3 bulbs
Shrimp
Pork
How to make Gỏi gà măng cụt
1. Traditional Gỏi gà măng cụt
Step 1: Prepare the mangosteen
First, prepare a bowl of diluted salt water and soak the mangosteen. Use a small pointed knife to slowly peel the outer skin and extract the flesh.
Once extracted, wash the flesh and slice into rounds or separate into individual segments.
Next, dissolve 1 liter of water with 1/2 tbsp sugar and 1/2 tbsp vinegar. Soak the mangosteen in this mixture and place in the refrigerator.
Step 2: Prepare meat and other ingredients
After washing the chicken, place it in a pot and cover with water. Add 1 tsp salt and 2 shallots. Boil for about 20 minutes until cooked. Once cooked, remove and let cool.
Wash the Vietnamese coriander and basil, then chop finely.
Roast the peanuts, peel, and crush slightly.
Finally, mince the garlic and chili.
Step 3: Make the dressing
First, squeeze the lime for juice. Mix the lime juice with 3 tbsp sugar and stir until the sugar is completely dissolved.
Next, pour 1 tbsp fish sauce into the lime and sugar mixture. Stir well to combine.
Finally, add the minced garlic and chili to the mixture and mix well.
Step 4: Mix the salad
To mix the salad, once the chicken has cooled, shred it and follow these steps:
First, put the chicken in a large bowl. Next, add the mangosteen, Vietnamese coriander, basil, and the sweet and sour fish sauce. Mix gently for about 5 minutes so the ingredients absorb the flavors.
Note that for the best results, you should mix the salad just before eating.
The combination of the sweet-tart mangosteen and shredded chicken creates a delicious salad that never feels heavy. It is especially wonderful when paired with a bit of sweet and sour dipping sauce.
2. Shrimp and Pork Mangosteen Salad
Step 1: Prepare ingredients
To prepare young mangosteen, follow these steps:
Wash the young mangosteen and soak in diluted salt water for 15 minutes to clean the sap.
Peel the outer skin and extract the flesh.
A helpful secret is to peel the mangosteen under running water to prevent the sap from sticking to the fruit. Then, soak the peeled flesh in salt water.
Rinse the soaked mangosteen and drain, then slice into bite-sized pieces.
Marinate the prepared mangosteen with vinegar and sugar (or a lime-sugar mixture) to your taste.
Step 2: Prepare other ingredients
Wash the pork belly and blanch in boiling water. Rinse again to ensure it is clean.
Wash the tiger shrimp and remove the black veins.
Slice the onion into rounds. Soak the onion in ice water to reduce the pungency. Then, soak in lime juice and sugar to flavor.
Mince one red chili for the fish sauce. Shred another red chili for mixing into the salad.
A helpful tip: when blanching the meat, add a tablespoon of vinegar. This helps the meat stay white and crunchy.
Step 3: Boil the shrimp and pork
To make the sweet and sour fish sauce, follow these steps:
Boil the pork belly until cooked. While boiling, season with a little salt and add a few shallots to remove odors.
Boil the shrimp. Remove heads, peel, and butterfly the shrimp.
Step 4: Mix the sweet and sour fish sauce
Similarly, you can mix the dressing with a fish sauce to sugar ratio of 1:1.
Boil the fish sauce and sugar over low heat. Let the mixture thicken and become rich. Then, let it cool.
Add the prepared calamansi juice, pepper, and minced chili to the pot of fish sauce. Season the sauce to your taste.
Notes when making Gỏi gà măng cụt
Choose fresh ingredients: Select fresh chicken and fresh young mangosteen to ensure the best flavor for the salad.
Prepare mangosteen correctly: Soak in diluted salt water to clean and remove sap. Peel under running water and soak the flesh in salt water to keep it fresh.
Boil chicken for the right time: Boil until cooked and tender, but avoid overcooking to prevent the meat from becoming dry.
Cut ingredients evenly and thinly: When cutting chicken and mangosteen, slice them thinly for easy eating and a delicate texture.
Preserve freshness: Mix the salad right before serving to keep the components fresh and crunchy. Do not mix too early or the ingredients will lose their texture.
Ensure hygiene: During preparation and mixing, maintain good hygiene by washing hands, tools, and work surfaces.
Season appropriately: Adjust the seasoning to your taste. Add sweet and sour fish sauce, lime, sugar, garlic, chili paste, or other spices to create a balanced flavor.
How to choose delicious mangosteen

The bottom of the fruit: At the bottom of the mangosteen, you will see a small flower shape with several petals. Count the petals to determine the number of segments inside. Usually, the number of segments corresponds to the number of petals. If you want more segments, choose a fruit with more petals.

Yellow sap on the skin: Prioritize fruits with yellow sap streaks on the skin. This indicates the mangosteen is very sweet. Also, choose fruits with rough, brownish-grey skin, as they often taste better.
The rind: You can check the ripeness by gently pressing the rind. If it feels uniformly soft, the fruit is ripe, sweet, and not spoiled.

mon_an.mo_ta: Today, let's head to the kitchen and change things up with "Japanese-style Beef Rolls" – a traditional dish from the Land of the Rising Sun!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, pepper, flour, Teriyaki sauce or soy sauce - as needed
Green and red bell peppers - 1/2 each
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel and wash the carrots, then cut them into bite-sized long strips. Trim and wash the green beans, then cut them to the same length as the carrots.
Step 2: Slice the green and red bell peppers into long strips.
Spread a thin slice of beef on a cutting board or flat surface. Season with a little salt and flour, place a few pieces of carrot, green bean, and bell peppers on top, then roll up tightly.
Step 3: Spread a second slice of beef on the board, place the first roll on it, and wrap it with the second layer of meat.
Step 4: Sprinkle a little salt, pepper, and flour over the beef rolls. Roll them around so the meat is evenly coated.
Step 5: Place the rolls in a pan and fry over low heat, seasoning with teriyaki sauce or soy sauce.
Step 6: Once the beef rolls are browned on all sides, turn off the heat, remove the rolls, and slice them in half. Enjoy with hot rice.

mon_an.mo_ta: Braised Pork with Taro – a fresh addition to your daily menu. Learn how to cook this rich, nutty, and savory dish that goes perfectly with rice.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, chili powder, sugar, fish sauce
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients: Peel the taro, wash thoroughly, and cut into halves or quarters depending on the size.
Step 2:
Wash the pork and cut into bite-sized pieces. Place the meat in a pot of cold water, bring to a boil, then turn off the heat and drain. Rinse the meat thoroughly (blanching helps remove impurities).
Marinate the pork with a little salt, pepper, and fish sauce.

Step 3: Add cashew oil to a pot and sauté the minced garlic until fragrant. Cashew oil is used in this dish to give it a beautiful golden color. If you don't have cashew oil, you can use caramel sauce, though cashew oil adds a unique aroma. Add the pork and stir-fry until the meat firms up.

Step 4: Add the taro to the pot with the meat. Add fish sauce and stir-fry for a while so the taro and meat absorb the flavor. Then, pour in a little coconut water (or filtered water) and some chili powder. Once it boils, lower the heat and simmer gently until the taro is soft.

Step 5: Occasionally stir gently so the braised dish absorbs the spices evenly. Adjust the seasoning to taste. Once the taro is very soft and tender, turn off the heat. Add some chopped cilantro and shredded scallions, stir gently, and serve. Enjoy hot with rice.
Source: Ngoisao

mon_an.mo_ta: Fried Potato Balls – a delicious treat for kids. Here is a new recipe for making crispy and tasty potato balls.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the potatoes: Wash the skins, peel them, and wash again. Slice into medium pieces and boil with a pinch of salt until cooked through. Once cooked, remove and drain in a colander.

Step 2: Add the room-temperature butter to the bowl of potatoes (if using cold butter, leave it in the kitchen for 30 minutes beforehand). Mash the potatoes and butter together, then add garlic powder (or finely minced garlic), salt, and pepper; continue mashing and mixing. Next, add the ground pork, minced onion, finely chopped celery leaves, shredded cheese, and 1 egg, then mix everything thoroughly.
Step 3: Shape the potato mixture into bite-sized round balls. Place the flour, breadcrumbs, and the remaining 2 beaten eggs into 3 separate plates to prepare for frying.
Step 4: Roll each potato ball through the plates in this order: first the flour, then the egg wash, and finally the breadcrumbs.

Step 5: Pour cooking oil into a pan. When the oil is hot, drop the potato balls in and fry until golden brown on all sides. Remove and place on a plate lined with paper towels. These should be served hot with tomato sauce or chili sauce for the best flavor.
Source: PictureTheRecipe

mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried Potatoes and Green Beans – A simple and easy-to-make dish for home cooks with limited time. This refreshing recipe is perfect for a light family dinner.
cac_buoc: To make the dish creamier, choose local starchy potatoes as they are fluffier and richer than other varieties.
Step 1:
Wash and peel the potatoes thoroughly. Julienne the potatoes.
Rinse the julienned potatoes in cold water to prevent browning.
Step 2: Remove the strings from both sides of the green beans, wash, and drain. Slice the beans diagonally.
Step 3: Heat oil in a pan and sauté the minced garlic until fragrant. Add the potatoes and stir-fry.
Step 4: Depending on whether you prefer the green beans soft or crunchy, time when to add them to the pan with the potatoes.

Step 5: Season to taste, then cover with a lid so the beans and potatoes cook through evenly. Once cooked, sprinkle with black pepper and turn off the heat. When serving, toss with toasted sesame seeds for extra aroma.
Source: BeyondKimchee

mon_an.mo_ta: Spicy chicken curry is a delicious and easy-to-make dish. The chicken pieces are marinated in rich spices, making them incredibly flavorful. It is best served with hot steamed rice. Let's learn how to cook this spicy curry for the whole family!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, seasoning powder, MSG, sugar, fish sauce
Shallots, garlic, chili powder, lemongrass powder, cornstarch
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Wash the chicken thoroughly.
Peel and wash the taro and sweet potatoes, then cut them into bite-sized pieces and soak them in diluted salt water. Drain in a colander.
Peel, wash, and mince the shallots and garlic.
Step 2:

Marinate the meat: 1 pack curry powder + 1 pack curry paste + 2 tbsp seasoning powder + 3 tbsp sugar + ½ tbsp salt + 1 tbsp fish sauce + 2 tbsp minced shallots and garlic + 1 tbsp chili powder + 1 tbsp lemongrass powder + 1 tbsp MSG.
Mix everything well and cover with plastic wrap. Marinate for about 2 hours to let the spices penetrate the meat.
Step 3:

Add oil to a rice cooker, press the "Cook" button to heat the oil, then sauté 1 tbsp of minced shallots and garlic until fragrant. Add the marinated chicken and stir well, cooking for 15-20 minutes until the chicken absorbs the spices.
Step 4:
Add 1 liter of water along with the sweet potatoes and taro. Cook for another 20 minutes until the tubers are soft.
Finally, add coconut milk and 1 bowl of dissolved cornstarch slurry. Cook for another 5 minutes then unplug the cooker.
This dish is perfect when served with hot rice!
Note: You can also use a regular pot to cook this dish following the same steps.

mon_an.mo_ta: A weekend full of activities requires plenty of energy. This stir-fried macaroni with bacon will satisfy the whole family's needs!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, chop the mushrooms, bacon, and broccoli. Mince the onion and garlic.
Step 2:
Next, boil the macaroni until cooked.
Step 3:
Then, briefly blanch the broccoli in boiling water.
Step 4:
Now, sauté the bacon with onion, garlic, and olive oil.
Step 5:
Add the mushrooms and sauté until cooked. Season with salt and pepper to taste and add a little water.
Step 6:
Next, add the macaroni to the pan and stir-fry with the mushrooms and bacon.
Step 7:
Finally, add the broccoli and toss everything together.
Serve on a plate and enjoy!
This dish is very light and not as heavy as baked macaroni dishes.

mon_an.ten: Pan-fried Tofu with Soy Sauce Glaze
mon_an.mo_ta: Pan-fried Tofu with Soy Sauce Glaze – A simple and attractive dish made even better with a rich, fragrant layer of soy sauce. Learn how to make this dish by drizzling a savory sauce over the tofu to enhance its flavor.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the tofu:
Rinse the tofu with water and pat dry.
Cut the tofu into bite-sized cubes and sprinkle with a little salt to season and prevent sticking to the pan.
Step 2: Heat oil in a pan; you don't need too much oil for pan-frying. Once the oil is hot, add the tofu and fry until golden on all sides.

Step 3: Prepare the glaze: Mix 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp chili powder, minced garlic, chopped green onions, and toasted sesame seeds. Arrange the fried tofu on a plate, drizzle the mixture over it, and serve hot with rice.
Source: BeyondKimchee

mon_an.mo_ta: Make this beef salad for the whole family to enjoy. Learn how to make this sweet, sour, crunchy, and fragrant beef salad that everyone will love.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, sugar, fish sauce, chili, garlic, lime
Fresh herbs, fried garlic, peanuts, sesame seeds
cac_buoc: Step 1: Place the beef in the freezer for 10 minutes for easier slicing. Remove, wash, and slice into thin pieces. Boil a pot of water and blanch the beef until medium-rare, or place the beef in a bowl and squeeze lime juice over it to "cook" it rare.
Step 2:

Peel, wash, and thinly slice the shallots. Soak them in water with a few drops of vinegar to remove the pungency. Peel and julienne the carrot and cucumber. For the cucumber, toss with 1 tsp salt, let sit for 5 minutes, then squeeze out the excess water.
Remove the tough outer layer of the lemongrass and slice thinly.
Toast the sesame seeds and peanuts separately in two pans. Once the peanuts are toasted, let them cool, remove the skins, and crush coarsely.

Step 3: Prepare the dressing: Pound the garlic and chili with 3 tsp sugar. Mix in about 2 tbsp fish sauce and a few drops of lime juice. The mixture should be slightly thick; adjust the sourness and saltiness to your liking.

Step 4: Place the beef in a clean bowl. Add the cucumber, carrot, onion, pickled leeks, toasted rice powder, and the dressing. Toss well with chopsticks or by hand using clean plastic gloves. Add the lemongrass and adjust the seasoning. Top with peanuts and sesame seeds. Serve the beef salad on a plate, garnished with fried garlic and chopped herbs. Serve with rice or shrimp crackers.

mon_an.mo_ta: During cold winter days, nothing is better than a steaming hot pot to warm the body and awaken the senses. Among many choices, Coconut Water Chicken Hot Pot is an excellent option. With the rich, sweet flavor of coconut water and tender chicken, this hot pot offers both warmth and a wonderful culinary experience. Let's learn how to make it!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Medicinal herb pack for hot pot, shiitake mushrooms - 1 pack
Mustard greens, celery, water spinach, scallions - 1 bunch each
Straw mushrooms, oyster mushrooms, enoki mushrooms - 150g each
Corn, beans, taro, fried tofu skin - as needed
Lemongrass, chili, satay, curry powder - as needed
Ginger, garlic, pepper, fish sauce, salt, oil - as needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Start by peeling and mincing 2 shallots.
Wash the lemongrass to remove dirt. Slice one stalk thinly and cut the rest into 3-inch segments.
Pick the tips and young leaves of the Malabar spinach, wash, and drain.
For the crown daisy, pick the tips and young leaves, wash, and drain.
For the watercress, remove wilted leaves and tough stems. Soak in diluted salt water for 5 minutes, rinse, and drain.
Wash the chicken and rub with salt to remove odors. Rinse and drain. Chop the chicken into bite-sized pieces and arrange on a large plate.
In a small bowl, mix 1 tsp seasoning powder and 1 tbsp fish sauce.
Place the peeled shallots and segmented lemongrass on the chicken plate. Pour the fish sauce mixture over and toss well. Marinate for 30 minutes to let the chicken absorb the flavors.
Step 2: Sauté the chicken
Heat a pot and add 2 tbsp oil. Once hot, add the sliced lemongrass and minced shallots. Sauté over high heat until fragrant.
Add the marinated chicken and stir-fry for 7 minutes over high heat until the meat firms up. Add 400ml coconut water and 300ml filtered water. Cover and cook for 15 minutes over medium heat.
To keep the broth clear, use a ladle to skim off any foam or impurities.
Continue cooking over medium heat for 10-15 minutes, then add 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp seasoning powder. Stir well.
Finally, add the prepared vegetables to the pot, and the coconut water chicken hot pot is ready.
Step 3: Finished product
The freshly cooked hot pot releases the aroma of lemongrass and coconut water. Enjoy the sweet broth and tender, well-seasoned chicken.
This hot pot is excellent when paired with rice vermicelli or noodles. Don't forget a side of chili salt for the full experience.

mon_an.ten: Lẩu Gà Hấp Hèm (Chicken Hot Pot with Fermented Rice)
mon_an.mo_ta: The characteristic sourness of fermented rice (hèm) permeates every fiber of the firm, fatty, and tender chicken. This hot pot is served with green mustard, napa cabbage, scallions, and a side of lime-chili salt. Check out this recipe to treat your family!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Chicken and pork bone broth - 1 liter
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Finely blend the fermented rice. Use freshly distilled fermented rice; if kept too long, it becomes overly sour and loses its flavor.
Step 2:

Marinate the chicken with basic seasonings and two tablespoons of blended fermented rice for 20 minutes. Steam the chicken for 25 minutes until cooked. Let it cool and chop into pieces. Arrange cabbage at the bottom of the hot pot and place the chicken pieces back into the shape of a whole bird on top.
Step 3:
Prepare the broth: Simmer bones, onion, and grilled dried squid. Season to taste and add the remaining fermented rice. Serve with rice vermicelli.
Enjoy this dish in a hot pot style.
Finished product:
The chicken is perfectly steamed, and the broth is sweet and clear with a light sour note from the fermented rice. Serve with various vegetables.
Dipping sauce: Mixed soy sauce (minced garlic, minced chili, black vinegar, sugar, chili sauce).

mon_an.mo_ta: BBQ hot pot has become a popular dining style. Instead of spending time simmering bones for broth or washing piles of greens, you just need to select fresh ingredients, marinate them skillfully, and grill them with vegetables for an attractive meal. Here is how to make a weekend BBQ hot pot at home!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Grilling vegetables: pumpkin, onion, tomato, okra, corn
1 tub of margarine, 1 small bowl of cooking oil
Cast-iron pan, alcohol stove or gas stove. You can also use a grill over charcoal.
cac_buoc: Clean the pork belly and wild boar meat. Place in the freezer for 20 minutes, then slice into 3x5 cm pieces. Marinate with BBQ sauce, ketchup, minced shallots, garlic, lemongrass, and a bit of sugar. You can substitute ketchup and BBQ sauce with caramel sauce and honey.

Cut the ribs into individual segments and marinate like the pork. You can steam the ribs first so they grill faster. Clean the fish, fillet it, and marinate with minced ginger and seasonings. Wrap the fish around enoki mushrooms for a better look and crunchier texture.
Clean the small intestines with salt and vinegar, scrape the inside, and cut into segments. Marinate with minced ginger, a bit of seasoning, and oyster oil.

Use tender beef shoulder or rump. Slice into large thin pieces, tenderize with a meat mallet, then marinate with oyster oil, a little sugar, honey, garlic, and minced lemongrass. All ingredients should be marinated for at least one hour; for better flavor, marinate in the fridge for 4 to 8 hours.
Trim the shrimp whiskers, wash, and drain.
Peel, wash, and thinly slice the vegetables.
Trim the mushroom stems, wash in diluted salt water, and drain.
Arrange all ingredients on plates.

Heat a cast-iron pan on the stove. Add a tablespoon of oil and a small scoop of margarine. Once melted, cover the pan with ingredients to grill. Flip after a few minutes until fragrant. Serve with sliced cucumber and toasted bread. Dipping sauces can include soy sauce, lime-chili salt, mayonnaise, or ketchup.
For a more sophisticated version, you can make a tamarind dipping sauce.
Slice the pork belly thinly and marinate with seasonings.
Thinly slice the fish fillets, roll with enoki mushrooms, and tie with blanched green onions.
Grilled wild boar meat is also very fragrant.
Presentation is important to make the dish look more appetizing.
When eating, add oil and margarine to the pan, grill the ingredients until cooked, and enjoy hot with your preferred dipping sauce.

mon_an.ten: Field Crab Hot Pot with Sour Bamboo Shoots
mon_an.mo_ta: Field Crab Hot Pot with Sour Bamboo Shoots – A unique twist on crab hot pot. The sour bamboo shoots make it very refreshing for summer while providing plenty of calcium. Learn how to cook this delicious dish.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fish sauce, seasoning powder, salt, pepper, lime, chili
Side vegetables: water spinach, mustard greens
Fried tofu, rice vermicelli, crab cakes (optional)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Place the crabs in a basin, rinse with water, and use chopsticks to stir in a circular motion to clean them. Separate the shells, collect the roe, and keep the legs/bodies; discard the top shell and the apron. Keep the roe separate and add a few drops of lime juice to remove the fishy smell.

Step 2: For the roe, sauté with minced shallots until fragrant, then set aside in a small bowl. Grind or blend the crab bodies with a bit of salt to help the crab meat clump together. Filter the mixture through a sieve to get the crab liquid and discard the solids.

Step 3: Prepare the ingredients: Peel and slice the taro stems, soak in salt water for 15 minutes, then squeeze dry. Rinse the sour bamboo shoots, boil them, and squeeze out the water to remove any processing chemicals. Wash and diagonally slice the okra. Wash the green onions; slice the whites lengthwise and chop the green parts. Wash and drain the culantro.

Step 4: Heat a pot with annatto oil, sauté minced shallots, then add tomatoes and stir. Add a teaspoon of salt to help the tomatoes soften. Add the sour bamboo shoots and pineapple to braise for 10 to 15 minutes. Add about two bowls of cold water, then add tamarind or rice vinegar. Season to taste and simmer on low heat for 15 minutes. Add the filtered crab liquid from Step 2 and continue to simmer on low heat.

Step 5: Transfer the bamboo shoot broth to a hot pot cooker. Add the crab meat clumps and the sautéed roe. Once boiling, add okra, taro stems, green onions, culantro, soft tofu, and side vegetables. Serve with rice vermicelli and fish sauce with fresh chili.
Source: Ngôi sao

mon_an.ten: Stir-fried Fresh Bamboo Shoots with Pork
mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried Fresh Bamboo Shoots with Pork – Crunchy fresh bamboo stir-fried with tender pork. This is an easy, affordable, yet nutritious and delicious meal.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Cooking oil, green onions, shallots, fish sauce, cornstarch, black pepper, satay chili
cac_buoc: Step 1: Trim the tough parts of the fresh bamboo, shred into bite-sized strips, and rinse. Blanch in boiling water then squeeze out the sour water. Peel, wash, and thinly slice the shallots. Clean the green onions and cut into segments.

Step 2: Wash the pork as a whole piece to retain nutrients, then slice thinly. Start the cooking process: Heat a pan, sauté the shallots until fragrant, then add the pork and stir-fry until lightly cooked.
Step 3: Add the fresh bamboo shoots to the pan with the pork. Add a bit of salt, seasoning powder, and fish sauce, then stir-fry evenly. If you like it spicy, add a bit of satay chili.
Step 4: Once the bamboo and pork are fully cooked, turn off the heat. Add the green onions and black pepper, tossing for a moment. The Stir-fried Fresh Bamboo Shoots with Pork is now complete.

mon_an.mo_ta: Bò Lúc Lắc is always a favorite for many, as the beef cubes are sautéed until perfectly tender and juicy, infused with rich marinade, and served with vegetables and a savory sauce that goes perfectly with rice. The recipe is very simple; please refer to our guide below!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Cut the beef into small cubes. Mix the dry seasonings together (you can substitute with a mixture of soy sauce, oyster sauce, and sesame oil).
Step 2: Mix the prepared seasoning with the beef for about 5 – 10 minutes. Massage the meat gently while mixing to make it more tender and help it absorb the flavors better.
Step 3: Wash and clean the vegetables, then cut the tomatoes, onions, and bell peppers into small pieces similar in size to the beef cubes.

Step 4: Sauté the minced garlic until fragrant, then add the beef and stir-fry quickly over high heat. Add the vegetables and stir-fry together, tossing constantly so the vegetables absorb the seasoning. When the meat is almost cooked, pour in the pineapple juice. Stir-fry until the meat is cooked through and the liquid has reduced, then turn off the heat.

mon_an.ten: Vegetarian Stir-Fried Glass Noodles with Mixed Vegetables
mon_an.mo_ta: For a weekend lunch, if you want to change your menu, this light vegetarian stir-fried glass noodle dish is a great suggestion. The ingredients are easy to find in your kitchen, and the cooking time is extremely quick. Check out how to make this vegetarian stir-fried glass noodles with mixed vegetables! This guide provides a delicious and simple recipe. It's a harmonious combination of soft glass noodles, fresh vegetables, and delicate vegetarian flavors.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, sugar, seasoning powder, pepper, fish sauce
Green onions, cilantro, dried shallots, chili powder
cac_buoc: Step 1: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt, fry until golden, then cut into long, thin strips.
Step 2: Wash the red cabbage and shred it finely.
Step 3: Wash and peel the cucumber, then julienne it. Wash the bell pepper, remove the seeds, and slice into strips.
Step 4: Soak the glass noodles in a bowl of water for 10 minutes to soften. Then, blanch the noodles briefly in a pot of boiling water. Remove and place in a colander to drain.
You are halfway through cooking this light vegetarian stir-fried glass noodle dish.
Step 5: Peel and wash the carrot, then julienne it. Heat oil in a pan, sauté the dried shallots until fragrant, then add the carrots to stir-fry.
Step 6: Add the red cabbage and stir-fry together. Add a little chili powder. Stir-fry until the cabbage and carrots are just barely cooked.
Step 7: Add the cucumber, eggs, and bell pepper, tossing well and seasoning to taste.

Step 8: Add the glass noodles and toss gently to mix with the vegetable mixture. Adjust the seasoning one last time; once cooked, turn off the heat and add some green onions and cilantro. Serve while hot.
Notes when making vegetarian stir-fried glass noodles with mixed vegetables
Use vegetarian ingredients: Ensure all ingredients used are vegetarian, containing no meat, seafood, animal-based seasonings, or any animal products.

Prepare ingredients: Before starting to cook, prepare and process all ingredients. Wash the vegetables and cut them into appropriate sizes and shapes. Ensure everything is ready before you begin cooking.
Ensure hygiene: Always maintain hygiene during the cooking process. Wash your hands before and after handling vegetarian ingredients to avoid contamination.

Cooking time: When cooking vegetarian glass noodles, check the exact cooking time for each ingredient. Some ingredients like vegetables may only need a short cooking time to maintain freshness and color.

Vegetarian seasonings: Use vegetarian seasonings such as soy sauce, vegetarian bouillon, vegetarian fish sauce, and vegetarian seasoning powder to enhance the flavor. Consider the seasoning balance to ensure a suitable taste.
Adapt to taste: Depending on personal preference, you can adjust the flavor by adding spices like pepper, onion, garlic, chili, ginger, or other seasonings to create a dish that suits your taste.

mon_an.ten: Stir-Fried Glass Noodles with Young Jackfruit
mon_an.mo_ta: A novel stir-fried glass noodle dish with young jackfruit for your daily menu. This is a special combination of sweet, fragrant, and crunchy young jackfruit with chewy glass noodles. This bold combination makes for a delicious dish that is easy to make and eat. Does this unique combination pique your curiosity? To find out, let's record the recipe for this delicious dish.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Wood ear mushrooms - A few pieces
Salt, fish sauce, chili powder, seasoning powder
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel the young jackfruit, wash off the sap, blanch briefly in boiling water, then remove and shred into small pieces; let drain.
Step 2: Soak the glass noodles in cold water, then cut into 3 or 4 sections so they aren't too long. To make the noodles soft, you can soak them for about 20 minutes.
Step 3: Soak the wood ear mushrooms in hot water until expanded, wash, remove the stems, and julienne.

Step 4: Place a pan on the stove, add a little cooking oil and heat it up. When the oil is hot, sauté the dried shallots until fragrant, then add the jackfruit and stir-fry for about 5 minutes. Add fish sauce, seasoning powder, chili powder, and salt, tossing well. Season to your personal taste.
Step 5: Add the wood ear mushrooms to cook together. Then add the glass noodles and toss well, adjusting the seasoning one more time.

Step 6: Once the noodles are cooked, add green onions cut into 2 cm lengths, toss well, turn off the heat, and add a little MSG. Serve on a plate and eat while hot. You have now completed the easy-to-make Stir-Fried Glass Noodles with Young Jackfruit.

mon_an.mo_ta: Fish is a familiar food in Vietnamese family meals. Fish has high protein content, good quality, and balanced amino acids. Fish contains more minerals and vitamins than meat, especially fish liver which is rich in vitamins A, D, and B12. Today we introduce a special fish dish: "Beer-Steamed Fish." It sounds elaborate, but the method is actually very simple and the ingredients are easy to find. On chilly rainy days, the whole family gathering around a hot plate of beer-steamed fish is wonderful. To make this dish delicious, the most important part is choosing the fish; suitable types include snakehead fish, mackerel, grass carp, or common carp. The larger the fish, the better; you can steam it whole or in steaks depending on the number of diners.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Canned or draught beer - as needed
Dill, ginger, lemongrass, cucumber, pineapple - as needed
Fish sauce, salt, sugar - as needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Finely slice the ginger, thinly slice the lemongrass, and chop the dill while keeping the stems intact.
Clean the fish, remove the head, make diagonal scores on the body, then marinate with the above aromatics plus fish sauce and salt. Stuff ginger and lemongrass into the scores.
Marinate for 20-30 minutes.
Step 2:

Prepare the steamer; you can use a rice cooker for convenience. Pour in the beer and place the steaming rack inside, then place the plate of fish on top, cover, and steam. It will be cooked in about 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and arrange the cucumber, carrots, and pineapple on a plate to serve as accompaniments.
Step 3: After 20 minutes, open and serve immediately.
Enjoy your meal!

mon_an.ten: Stir-Fried Mussels with Lemongrass and Chili
mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried mussels with lemongrass and chili is not only delicious but also very nutritious. The preparation method for this stir-fry is truly simple; just spend a little time cooking and you can treat your family to a wonderful meal. Let's head to the market for ingredients and get into the kitchen!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning powder, fish sauce, cooking oil, pepper - Seasoning
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Soak the mussels in water to release all slime and dirt. Add a few slices of red chili to the water.
Place the mussels in a pot of water and boil until they open. Once cooked, remove them, take out the meat, and discard the black digestive tract.
Slice the mussel meat into small pieces and marinate with a little fish sauce and pepper. Mix well and let sit for 15 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Step 2:
Peel the onion, wash, and cut into wedges.
Wash the bell peppers, remove stems and seeds, and slice into bite-sized strips.
Wash and slice the lemongrass.
Peel and mince the dried shallots and garlic.
Wash and finely chop the green onions and Vietnamese coriander.
Step 3:
Heat oil, sauté half of the minced garlic and shallots until fragrant, then add the mussels and stir-fry quickly. When the mussels are nearly done, turn off the heat and remove to a plate.
Continue to sauté the remaining shallots, garlic, lemongrass, and chili. Then add the bell peppers and onions and stir-fry until cooked.
Add the mussels back into the pan, season to taste, sprinkle with the chopped herbs and green onions, toss well, and turn off the heat immediately.
Serve the stir-fried mussels on a plate, enjoy hot with rice crackers or steamed rice.
Enjoy your meal and success with this dish!
Notes when buying mussels
To know if a mussel is alive, touch the shell lightly. If it slowly closes, it is alive. Choose those mussels.
Pay attention to the smell. Fresh mussels do not have an overly fishy or strong, unpleasant odor. This is a sign of freshness.
Avoid buying mussels with crushed, broken, or chipped shells. Such mussels are often diseased or contain harmful bacteria. Stay away from them to ensure your health.
Limit buying frozen mussels, as they are often not fresh and may have been treated with chemicals. It is best to choose fresh, high-quality mussels without chemical processing.

mon_an.mo_ta: Dried squid with tamarind sauce makes a perfect snack for drinks. The chewy dried squid and the sweet and sour tamarind sauce stimulate the palate. This is an easy-to-make dish that gentlemen love. It is simple to prepare with 4 quick steps. If you have dried squid sitting around and don't know what to do with it, this is a great cooking suggestion for you!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Chili, annatto oil, fish sauce, chili powder, sugar, garlic
cac_buoc: Let's start making the snack Dried Squid with Tamarind Sauce:
Step 1: Before cooking, we must grill the squid first. Shred the squid into bite-sized pieces. A small tip: the finer the shreds, the more attractive the dish will be!

Step 2: You can buy dried tamarind at supermarkets or dry goods stores. Take a small amount of dried tamarind and soak it in a bowl of very hot water until it dissolves, then strain to get the tamarind juice.

Step 3: Using a small mortar, add peeled garlic, deseeded minced chili, and 3 tablespoons of sugar (add more if you like it sweeter) and grind into a thick paste. Season with fish sauce so the taste is slightly sweet.

Step 4: Place a pot or pan on the stove, heat 2 tablespoons of annatto oil (annatto oil gives the dish a beautiful color). Pour in the fish sauce mixture and tamarind juice, and bring to a boil. Then add the dried squid and stir well. When the sauce thickens and coats the squid, turn off the heat and serve. You can make a large batch of this dish and keep it in the fridge to eat gradually!

mon_an.ten: Grilled Squid with Salt and Chili
mon_an.mo_ta: Grilled squid with salt and chili – rich in flavor and spicy from the chili, very suitable as a snack for drinks. How to make Grilled Squid with Salt and Chili.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the fresh squid and let it drain.
Step 2: Mix the salt, chili powder, seasoning powder, and 1 teaspoon of oil together. Finely chop the green onions, mix with 1 teaspoon of oil, and microwave for 30 seconds to cook the onions.
Step 3: Mix the fresh squid with the salt and chili mixture so the grilled squid is evenly seasoned and delicious.

Step 4: Next, skewer each squid head onto a grilling stick. Grill over charcoal until golden brown, or in an oven at 180 °C for 10 to 12 minutes; do not overcook or the squid will become tough. Occasionally brush the scallion oil mixture over the surface. When cooked, remove and serve hot.
Source: Ngoisao

mon_an.ten: Crispy Fried Squid with Honey Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: Those who love squid certainly cannot miss this crispy fried squid with honey sauce, featuring the rich aroma of honey and the crispy, chewy texture of the squid. This dish will surely captivate anyone who tries it!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Clean the squid, let it drain, marinate with 1 teaspoon of seasoning powder, and let sit for 15 minutes to absorb the flavors.

Step 2: Wash the lettuce and let it drain. Shred the carrot and red cabbage, then toss with a little salt. Slice the onion into strips and soak in a little vinegar. When the carrot and cabbage have absorbed the salt, rinse them briefly with boiling water to reduce the saltiness. Then, remove the onion and let it drain.
Step 3: Crack the egg into a bowl and whisk thoroughly. Use a rolling pin to crush the breadcrumbs until fine.
Step 4: Heat oil in a pan, dip the squid into the egg, then roll in the breadcrumbs, and drop into the pan to fry until golden.
Step 5: Make the sauce: stir the mayonnaise with 1 teaspoon of seasoning powder and the honey.
Step 6: Serve the squid with the sauce, cabbage, onion, carrot, and lettuce.
Enjoy your meal!

mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried squid with napa cabbage – simple with the crunch of seasoned napa cabbage, the sweetness of baby corn, and tender, fragrant squid. Discover how to make wonderful stir-fried squid with napa cabbage with detailed instructions and easy steps. Enjoy an attractive and sophisticated dish that combines the freshness of squid and the crispness of napa cabbage.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Oyster sauce, salt, seasoning powder, fish sauce, pepper, garlic
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients:
Cut the napa cabbage into bite-sized pieces, wash, and drain.
Wash the baby corn, remove all silk, and cut into bite-sized pieces. Peel and crush the garlic, then mince finely.
Peel and wash the carrot, then julienne. Remove the roots from the green onions, wash, and cut into sections. Peel the dried shallots, wash, and slice thinly.
Step 2: Clean the squid: Remove the ink sac and innards, then wash thoroughly to remove slime. Cut into rings and let drain.
Step 3: Heat oil in a pan. When hot, sauté the shallots and garlic until fragrant, then add the squid to stir-fry until cooked. Season with salt, oyster sauce, and seasoning powder to taste.
Step 4: Use the same pan. Add the carrots and baby corn to stir-fry first until nearly cooked, then add the napa cabbage. Season with chili sauce (or satay), salt, and fish sauce to taste.

Step 5: Return the squid to the pan with the vegetables, add the green onions, and toss quickly. Adjust the seasoning and quickly turn off the heat. Stir-frying squid for too long will make it tough. Sprinkle with a little pepper before serving.
Notes when stir-frying squid with napa cabbage
Choose fresh squid: Select fresh squid to ensure the flavor and quality of the dish. Fresh squid will have vibrant color, elastic flesh, and no foul odor.
Prepare squid correctly: Before stir-frying, clean the squid and peel off the outer membrane. If the squid is large, you can cut it into smaller pieces so it cooks evenly.

Control the temperature: When stir-frying squid, ensure the heat is not too high. If the heat is too high, the squid can become dry and hard. Use medium heat so the squid cooks evenly and stays tender.
Stir-fry for a short time: Squid cooks quickly, needing only about 2-3 minutes. Stir-frying for too long can cause it to burn and lose its tenderness.
Add napa cabbage last: When the squid is cooked, add the napa cabbage and green onions. Napa cabbage softens quickly, so adding it at the end keeps it crunchy and maintains its fresh color.
Seasoning: To add flavor, include red chili, garlic, shallots, fish sauce, sugar, pepper, and salt. However, adjust the amounts to your personal taste to ensure it's not too salty or sweet.
Presentation: After stir-frying, arrange the dish on a plate and garnish with fresh cilantro or green onions. This adds color and aroma.
How to buy fresh ingredients
1. How to buy fresh squid
Before buying, learn about common types of squid and how to identify freshness. This helps you choose quality squid.
Go to a reliable seafood market or supermarket: Choose a trustworthy shopping location. Ensure the vendor has good hygiene standards and provides fresh squid.
Check the appearance: Fresh squid usually has bright colors, no cracks, no peeling skin, and no foul odor.
Check elasticity: Press lightly on the body. If it returns to its original shape quickly and is not deformed, it is a good sign of freshness.
2. How to buy good napa cabbage

Napa cabbage is best from September to April. During this time, it will have light green leaves at the top, gradually turning bright white from the stem to the base. Avoid dark green leaves as they are old, not sweet, and not crunchy. These are also less nutritious. Furthermore, do not choose leaves that are crushed or have dark spots.
To ensure quality and safety, buy from reputable sources like large supermarkets. Avoid street vendors or carts where the origin and safety are not guaranteed.
Size and weight: Choose a size and weight that fits your needs. Ensure it is not too small or too large, and not too light or too heavy compared to the standard.

mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried squid with pickled greens – a novel combination of pickled mustard greens and fresh squid.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Green onions, pepper, seasoning powder, fish sauce, salt, dried shallots
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients:
Squeeze the pickled greens to reduce the saltiness.
Peel and wash the carrot, then slice into bite-sized pieces. You can carve them into flowers for a more vivid presentation.
Remove the roots from the green onions, wash, and cut into sections. Peel the dried shallots, wash, and slice thinly.
Step 2: Clean the squid to remove slime and fishy odor. Remove the innards. Rinse again, drain, and cut into rings. Marinate the squid with salt, seasoning powder, and a little pepper for 15 minutes.
Step 3: Heat oil in a pan, sauté the shallots until fragrant, then add the squid to stir-fry until cooked; adjust the seasoning. Then remove to a separate plate, keeping the juices in the pan.
Step 4:
Use the squid juices to stir-fry the carrots until nearly cooked, seasoning to taste.

Add the pickled greens to stir-fry with the carrots; since the greens are already salty, you may not need much extra seasoning. Stir-fry until the greens are cooked, then add the squid back in and toss well. Add the green onions, toss for a moment longer, then turn off the heat.
Source: Ngoisao

mon_an.ten: Pork Rib and Fish Cake Noodle Soup
mon_an.mo_ta: Pork Rib and Fish Cake Noodle Soup – a unique noodle dish featuring sweet pork ribs and chewy fish cakes, served with spicy chili sauce and fresh herbs. Learn how to cook this delicious noodle dish for a relaxing weekend.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Culantro, green onions, onion, shallots, cilantro, curly lettuce
Salt, seasoning powder, chili sauce for serving
cac_buoc: Prepare the broth: Clean the pork ribs, chop into bite-sized pieces, and parboil in a pot to remove impurities.
Prepare the fish cakes according to the recipe: Fish cakes
Step 1:

Place the pork ribs, peeled and quartered apple and pear, dried shrimp, and 1 tsp of salt into a pot. Add cold water and simmer until the ribs are tender. When the water boils, skim off the foam to keep the broth clear.
Pick and wash the accompanying vegetables, then finely chop them.

Step 2: Bring a pot of water to a boil and blanch the noodles until just tender—not too chewy or too soft—to ensure the dish is delicious. Drain the noodles in a colander, rinse with cold water, and set aside. (You can also replace egg noodles with dried rice noodles or rice vermicelli).
Step 3: Wash the tomatoes, cut into wedges, and stir-fry for about 3 minutes. Then, add the sautéed tomatoes to the pot with the pork ribs.
Step 4: Place a portion of noodles into a bowl, add green onions, and pour the pork rib broth over. Add the ribs, fish cakes, and tomatoes, then serve hot.
Source: Ngoi sao

mon_an.mo_ta: Soy Sauce Chicken Dry Noodles – An easy-to-make, flavorful dish with a savory sauce reduced from soy sauce and chicken. A new and unique noodle recipe for your kitchen.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Ginger, soy sauce, salt, sugar, seasoning powder, oyster sauce, white wine
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Peel the ginger, wash, and julienne.
Mix 4 tbsp sugar, 1.5 small bowls of water, 0.5 small bowl of soy sauce, 2 tsp white wine, and 0.5 tsp five-spice powder. Stir well.

Step 2: Prepare the chicken: Wash the chicken; you can chop it into pieces or leave it whole. Score the skin with a knife (if using a large chicken; small ones don't need this). Place the chicken and the mixture from Step 1 into a container or sealed pot, then refrigerate for 6-7 hours, or ideally overnight, to let the chicken marinate. If you don't have much time, prick the chicken with a fork—the more you prick it, the faster it absorbs the spices—and let it sit for 30-60 minutes.
Step 3: Wash the bean sprouts and chives, then blanch them in boiling water to clean them and maintain their color. Boil the quail eggs in water with a little salt, peel, and set aside.

Step 4: Finely mince the garlic and sauté until fragrant. Place the marinated chicken in a pan and sear both sides. Pour the marinade into the pan to simmer with the chicken. Add a little oyster sauce and cook for about 15 minutes, then adjust the seasoning to taste. Cover the pan and occasionally flip the chicken so it absorbs the flavors evenly.
Step 5: Blanch the noodles, then drain in a colander and rinse with cold water to prevent sticking. Let them drain completely.
Step 6: To serve, place the noodles in a large bowl, add chopped chives, bean sprouts, and quail eggs. Drizzle with the sauce and top with the chicken for a delicious, easy meal.

mon_an.mo_ta: Mushrooms are not only delicious but also very beneficial for your health. Each type of mushroom brings its own unique flavor, creating a special and tasty family meal. Today, we will guide you through making Five-Color Stir-Fried Mushrooms.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Red and yellow bell peppers - 1/2 each
cac_buoc: Step 1: Trim the stems of the button mushrooms; if the caps are large, cut them in half. Do the same with the baby corn, cutting large ones in half for bite-sized pieces. String the snap peas and slice the red and yellow bell peppers into long strips.
Step 2: Bring a pot of water to a boil, add a pinch of salt, and blanch the baby corn and snap peas briefly. Remove and immediately soak them in a bowl of cold water to preserve their vibrant colors.
Step 3: Peel and devein the shrimp. Stir-fry them with minced shallots and fish sauce until firm, then remove to a separate plate.
Step 4: Add cooking oil to the pan and stir-fry the mushrooms and the red and yellow bell peppers. Season to taste.

Step 5: When the mushrooms are nearly cooked and have absorbed the seasoning, add the baby corn and snap peas to the pan. At this stage, you can add a bit of oyster sauce to enhance the flavor and give the dish a beautiful glossy finish.
Step 6: Finally, add the shrimp back in, toss quickly, and turn off the heat. Serve the five-color stir-fried mushrooms on a plate and enjoy with your family!

mon_an.ten: Fish Soup with Fermented Rice and Turmeric
mon_an.mo_ta: Introducing a recipe for Sour Fish Soup with fermented rice. You will have an incredibly attractive and delicious soup with the golden hue of turmeric and fish against the milky white background of fermented rice, accented by the red of tomatoes and the green of onions and dill. This mildly sour and fragrant soup is perfect with rice on hot summer days. If you like, you can serve it with rice vermicelli, lettuce, and chopped cilantro for a perfect weekend meal.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning - Fish sauce, salt, pepper, seasoning powder
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare ingredients:

Clean the fish. If using fish steaks, wash and scrape off the black membrane inside the belly to reduce the fishy smell. If using a whole fish, remove the gills and entrails, then wash and drain well.
Wash the tomatoes and cut into wedges.
Trim the roots of the green onions and dill, wash, and cut into segments.
Peel and mince the shallot.
Peel the turmeric, pound it, and squeeze out the juice; set aside.
Wash and thinly slice the chili.
Step 2: Fry the fish.
Once the fish is dry, place it in a pan with hot oil. Pan-fry until both sides are lightly golden, then remove and drain on paper towels.
Step 3: Cook the soup.
Sauté the minced shallot with a little oil in a pot, then add an adequate amount of water. Bring to a boil and season with fish sauce and salt to taste, then add the turmeric juice.

Add the fried fish to the boiling pot and let it boil vigorously, then lower the heat to a simmer for about 15 minutes to allow the fish to release its sweetness. Add the tomatoes and bring back to a boil.

When the water is boiling, scoop a little broth into a bowl, add the mashed fermented rice, stir to dissolve, and pour it back into the pot (remember to strain through a sieve). Adjust the seasoning to taste and turn off the heat.
Step 4: Presentation

Place the fish in a large bowl and pour the broth until it almost covers the fish. Sprinkle the chopped green onions and dill on top, then continue pouring the hot broth over them to lightly blanch the herbs until the bowl is full. Sprinkle a little pepper on top for aroma. If you like it spicy, add a few slices of horn chili to enhance the flavor.
Tips for a delicious Fish Soup with Fermented Rice and Turmeric:
You can choose any type of fish, such as carp, red tilapia, grass carp, snakehead fish, or even sea fish like mackerel. However, this soup is best when cooked with snakehead fish (cá lóc).
While you can use steaks or whole fish, using a medium-sized whole fish fried golden and served in a long oval deep dish makes for a very attractive presentation.

In Step 2, only pan-fry the fish until the skin is golden; do not over-fry, or the meat will become dry and lose its sweetness after simmering. Ensure the fish is completely dry before frying to prevent oil splattering.
There are two ways to handle tomatoes: you can sauté them first or add them raw as described above (adding them raw keeps the wedges intact and saves cleaning an extra pan).
The amount of fermented rice depends on its acidity. Add it gradually and taste as you go. Always strain it through a sieve to avoid leftover rice grains in the soup.
When adjusting the seasoning before turning off the heat, avoid using more fish sauce as it can increase the acidity too much. Use salt or seasoning powder instead.
You can also try other sour soup recipes like Vietnamese fish sour soup, Thai spicy and sour shrimp soup, or clam sour soup!
