mon_an.ten: Northern-Style Snail Stew with Green Bananas and Tofu
mon_an.mo_ta: Snail stew with green bananas and tofu is a dish deeply rooted in Northern Vietnamese heritage, creating a unique harmony of flavors. It combines the crunch of snails, the starchiness of green bananas, the richness of pork belly, and the crispy-fried tofu. Not everyone knows how to make this dish authentically. Follow this guide to create a flavorful soup featuring fresh snails, starchy green bananas, and delicious tofu. Simple preparation for a family meal!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Snails - 1 kg (Apple snails, mystery snails, or rice snails)
Wild betel leaves (lá lốt) - As needed
Ginger leaves or lime leaves - As needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Clean and boil the snails

First, soak the snails in rice water or cold water with a few slices of chili for 4-5 hours to remove dirt and slime. Use a knife to cut off the tail end of the shell and extract the meat. Wash the snail meat with diluted salt water. Next, soak the snail meat in vinegar for about 15 minutes to whiten it and increase its crunchiness. Rinse and drain.

Once drained, place the snail meat in a bowl and marinate with a little seasoning powder, minced garlic, turmeric powder, a bit of fermented rice, and 1/2 tsp shrimp paste. Stir well and let it marinate for 10 minutes.
Step 2: Prepare other ingredients
Wash the tofu and cut into bite-sized pieces. Heat oil in a pan and fry the tofu until all sides are evenly golden.

Peel the green bananas and cut into bite-sized pieces. Soak them in lemon water for about 10 minutes to prevent browning and remove sap. Then, lightly fry the bananas so they cook through without breaking and develop a better flavor.

Wash the pork belly and slice into small pieces. Sear the pork in a pan until the surfaces are slightly golden. Remove the pork to drain excess oil. Marinate the pork with turmeric powder and a little seasoning to make it more flavorful.
Step 3: Cook the snails with bananas and tofu
Heat oil in a pan and sauté some minced shallots until fragrant. Add the snails and stir-fry until cooked. Season to taste, then remove the snails to a bowl.
Next, sauté the tomatoes until soft, then add the bananas, a bit of fermented rice, and turmeric powder. Stir well for 3-5 minutes to combine the flavors.
Pour 2 cups of water into the pot (enough to cover the bananas), bring to a boil, and season to taste.

Once the water is boiling, add the snails and pork back into the pot and cook together for 4-5 minutes, then add the tofu. When everything is cooked, turn up the heat and add chopped green onions, wild betel leaves, and perilla. Toss quickly and remove from heat to serve.

When enjoying this dish, you will taste the mild acidity of the fermented rice, the golden color of turmeric, the aroma of shrimp paste, and the fragrance of wild betel and perilla leaves. The pork is tender, the snails are crunchy, and the tofu remains intact. This dish can be served with rice vermicelli or steamed rice. With a little care, you will have an authentic Northern-style snail stew.
II. How to buy fresh ingredients
1. How to choose fresh apple snails
To pick fresh snails, use these tips:
Observe the water; if the snail's mouth is open and closes quickly when touched, it is healthy.
Choose snails with shiny black shells, no scratches, and no lines. Lines on the shell may indicate the snail is unhealthy.
Fat snails have the operculum (trapdoor) thick and close to the edge of the shell, while thin ones have it retracted deep inside.
Check the bottom of the shell; it should not have tiny holes, which indicate calcium deficiency or parasites.
To save time, you can buy pre-extracted snail meat from reputable sources. Check the origin, production date, and expiry date.
2. How to choose good tofu
Choose tofu blocks that are ivory white and feel light in the hand.
Soybean tofu should feel soft and smooth to the touch and have a characteristic fragrance.
Avoid hard, heavy blocks, as they may contain gypsum.
Chemically treated tofu is often pure white; do not buy it.
For safety, you can also make your own tofu at home.
3. How to choose fresh green bananas
Any variety of green banana works, depending on preference.
Good green bananas have a bright green, glossy skin, even curvature, and are about the size of two fingers. They should feel very firm when pressed.
Choose bananas with fresh stems that still have sap, as they are newly harvested.
Avoid ripe bananas for this dish, as they will become too soft and lose their characteristic starchiness when cooked.
Avoid bananas with blackened stems, dried sap, wrinkled skin, or pale green color, as they are old or under-developed.

mon_an.mo_ta: Nem nướng Nha Trang – a signature delicacy of Nha Trang that has become popular across the country. Let's discover how to make Nem nướng Nha Trang with Số Tay Nấu Ăn in the article below! Learn how to cook this authentic Nem nướng Nha Trang.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Meat marinade: 3 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tsp salt, 3 tbsp sugar, 1/2 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp pepper, 2 tbsp tapioca starch, 2 tsp annatto oil, and shallots
Dipping sauce: 150g shrimp, 150g ground pork, 100g pork liver, 1/2 bowl sticky rice, 1/2 bowl fermented soybean paste, salt, sugar, annatto oil, shallots, and fish sauce
Accompanying vegetables: Herbs, Vietnamese coriander, mint, cucumber, green starfruit
Rice vermicelli, rice paper for wrapping, chilies, crushed roasted peanuts
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the pork fat and dice it into small cubes. Place the ground meat in a bowl, add the fat, the marinade mixture, and minced shallots. Mix well and knead thoroughly with a large spoon until the meat mixture becomes elastic. Cover tightly and refrigerate overnight.

Step 2: Grease your hands with oil. Use a spoon to scoop a portion of the meat mixture and wrap it evenly around a bamboo skewer. Grill over charcoal until golden brown or use an electric grill. If using an oven, bake at 160°C for 10 - 15 minutes per side, brushing the surface with a little oil while grilling to prevent the meat from drying out.

Step 3: Rinse the sticky rice several times until the water runs clear. Soak the rice in a bowl of cold water overnight or for about 5 hours. Next, place the sticky rice in a pot, add a bowl of filtered water, and bring to a boil. Once the rice is soft, transfer it to a bowl and mash it thoroughly with a spoon.
Step 4: Peel and devein the shrimp, then coarsely pound them. Place the ground pork in a bowl. Wash and finely mince the pork liver to prepare the signature dipping sauce for Nem nướng Nha Trang.

Step 5: Heat three tsp of annatto oil and sauté the minced shallots until fragrant. Add the shrimp and stir-fry for 3 to 5 minutes. Then add the ground pork and pork liver, stir-fry until cooked through. Transfer the mixture to a blender or meat grinder and blend until completely smooth.

Step 6: Gradually pour the soybean paste into the pan while stirring constantly with chopsticks. Season with sugar, salt, and fish sauce to taste, adjusting to your preference. Simmer for 10 to 20 minutes until the mixture thickens, then turn off the heat. Ladle the dipping sauce into small bowls, add crushed roasted peanuts, and you can add fresh chilies or spicy chili sauce.

Step 7: Clean the various raw vegetables served with this dish. For the cucumber and green banana, cut them into bite-sized pieces; soak the green banana in cold water immediately after cutting to prevent browning.
Step 8: When serving, arrange the meat on a plate with rice vermicelli, lettuce, and accompanying herbs. Wrap them in rice paper and dip into the prepared sauce.

mon_an.mo_ta: Ngao nấu riêu (Clam sour soup) carries the characteristic traits of Northern Vietnamese cuisine: a light sweetness that preserves the natural flavor of the main ingredients.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fresh clams - 500g, soaked in water with chili to remove sand
Green onions - 3 stalks, cut into segments
cac_buoc: Wash the clams thoroughly, then place them in a pot of water and boil until they have all opened.
Next, separate the clam meat from the shells and set the broth aside in the pot.
Place a pan on the stove, sauté the minced shallots in oil until fragrant, then add the tomatoes and stir-fry until soft before adding the clams to sauté.
Add the water and reserved clam broth to the pot and bring to a boil. Pour the sautéed clams into the broth and season with the seasoning mix and MSG to taste.
When the soup returns to a boil, add the green onions, Vietnamese coriander, and dill, then remove from the heat, ladle into a bowl, and serve hot.
Tips
Soak the clams in rice water or water with chili for 1 to 3 hours before processing to remove all sand.
Boil the clams with very little water. As soon as the clams begin to open, turn off the heat immediately, as overcooking will make the clam meat shrink and lose its flavor.

mon_an.mo_ta: Spicy Stir-fried Clams – a recipe for a tongue-numbing spicy dish to warm up gloomy days. A simple and delicious way to cook Spicy Stir-fried Clams.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Crush some chilies and set aside in a small bowl. Clean the clam shells and soak them in water with the crushed chilies for about 1 hour to let the clams purge any grit. Cut dried chilies into pieces; finely chop green onions, lemongrass, and garlic; julienne the ginger; cut bell pepper into small pieces.
Step 2: Boil the clams until they open; discard any that remain closed. Then, rinse the clams in cold water and set aside.
Step 3: In a pan with hot oil, sauté the lemongrass, ginger, garlic, dried chilies, and chili powder until fragrant to give the spicy stir-fried clams a rich aroma.

Step 4: Add the clams and bell peppers, then toss well to coat the clams with the seasonings. Add about 2 tbsp of rice wine, salt, and soy sauce; season to taste and continue tossing until the clams are well-infused with flavor, then turn off the heat. Transfer to a bowl and enjoy hot with your family.
Source: Kenh14

mon_an.mo_ta: Cauliflower is a simple, familiar ingredient in many families' daily meals. That's why people will be curious and intrigued when asked if they've tried breaded fried cauliflower. Let's make this unique dish together! Cauliflower is a simple, familiar ingredient in many families' daily meals. That's why people will be curious and intrigued when asked if they've tried breaded fried cauliflower. Let's make this unique dish together!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Cut the cauliflower into florets, wash thoroughly, then blanch in boiling water for 2-3 minutes.
Step 2: Add water to the flour and stir until it forms a thick, smooth batter.
Step 3: Add curry powder and mix well.
Step 4: Dip the cauliflower florets into the batter.
Step 5: Pour the breadcrumbs onto a plate and roll the cauliflower to coat evenly.
Step 6: Fry the cauliflower in hot oil until golden brown, then remove and place on a plate lined with paper towels to drain excess oil.
Step 7: To make the dipping sauce, put mayonnaise in a bowl, add chili sauce, and stir well.
Enjoy this wonderful dish with your family!

mon_an.mo_ta: Refreshing Napa Cabbage Meatballs – a fresh combination of napa cabbage and minced meat makes for a unique meatball dish for hot summer days. A delicious recipe for Refreshing Napa Cabbage Meatballs to cool down your sunny day meals as it uses no oil.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Preparation:
Wash and finely chop the napa cabbage. Add 1 tbsp of salt to the cabbage, mix well, and let it sit for 15 minutes. Salting helps make the cabbage crisp.
Squeeze out the excess water from the cabbage by hand and set the squeezed cabbage aside in another bowl.

Step 2: In a bowl, combine: minced meat, napa cabbage, egg, minced garlic, minced ginger, chopped green onions, 1/2 tsp pepper, and 1 tbsp soy sauce. Wear plastic gloves and mix the ingredients thoroughly.
Step 3:
Shape the mixture into uniform round balls. Evenly sized meatballs will make the dish look more appealing and ensure they cook at the same rate.
After shaping, coat each meatball with a layer of cornstarch.
Step 4: Bring water to a boil, then drop each meatball in.
Step 5: When the meatballs float to the surface, they are cooked; quickly remove them and place on a plate. This dish should be served hot with soy sauce for dipping.
Source: BeyondKimchee

mon_an.ten: Refreshing Opo Squash Soup with Shrimp
mon_an.mo_ta: It doesn't take much time to prepare a bowl of sweet and refreshing opo squash soup with shrimp for the whole family. This hot soup releases the fragrant aroma of chopped green onions and sawtooth herb as soon as it is served. It features a natural sweetness balanced by the warm scent of ginger and garlic. This soup is perfect with rice; just a few spoonfuls of broth enjoyed with some pickled eggplants will make your rice bowl disappear in no time!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Green onions, sawtooth herb - for garnish
Salt, seasoning powder, sesame oil, ground black pepper - to taste
cac_buoc: Step 1: Trim the legs off the shrimp, keep the shells on, and wash thoroughly.
Score the skin of the squash to release the sap, trim both ends, wash again, and then slice or shred into small strips. Peel and thinly slice the fresh ginger. Finely chop the leeks.
Step 2: Heat a pan with a thin layer of oil. Add the chopped leeks and sauté for a few seconds until fragrant, then add the shrimp and stir-fry quickly and continuously.
When the shrimp turn light pink, pour in 1 tbsp of fish sauce and toss quickly so the shrimp absorb the flavor. Add the squash and stir-fry briefly.
Step 3: Pour in boiling water and season with a little salt and seasoning powder to taste. Wait for it to return to a boil, then turn off the heat immediately as opo squash cooks very quickly.
Ladle the squash and shrimp soup into a bowl, then sprinkle some pepper and chopped green onions and sawtooth herb on top.

mon_an.ten: Salt and Chili Roasted Crab Claws
mon_an.mo_ta: Firm, sweet crab meat combined with the spicy kick of salt and chili makes this a favorite dish for many families during the changing seasons. Let's learn how to make salt and chili roasted crab claws to treat your family!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fresh chili, garlic, minced lemongrass - 50 g
Seasoning - Sea salt, shrimp salt, MSG
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the crab claws and steam them until cooked. Once cooked, remove and let them cool, then slightly crack the shells so the seasoning can penetrate the meat during cooking.

Step 2: Finely mince the fresh chili and garlic and place them in a bowl. Add the minced lemongrass and mix well with 2 tbsp sea salt, 2 tbsp shrimp salt, 1/2 tbsp MSG, and a little water to form a thick paste.
Step 3: Place a pan over heat. Add the crab claws and the salt-chili mixture. Stir well so the claws are coated in seasoning and the salt mixture dries up.
Step 4: Finally, transfer the crab claws to a plate. Serve hot with Vietnamese coriander and a side of lime-salt-pepper dipping sauce.

mon_an.mo_ta: A quick and easy stir-fried chayote with egg for a delicious lunch, featuring a unique combination of crunchy-sweet chayote and fragrant eggs. This recipe will guide you through the detailed steps to create a flavorful and attractive dish. Enjoy the fresh taste of chayote blended with eggs and aromatic spices.
cac_buoc: There are only 2 simple cooking steps for this dish:

Step 1: Wear plastic gloves before peeling the chayote to avoid the sap. After peeling, wash thoroughly, cut in half, remove the seed, and shred into bite-sized strips. Peel, wash, and thinly slice the shallot.

Step 2: Place a pan on the stove with a little oil. Once the oil is hot, sauté the shallots until fragrant, then add the chayote and stir-fry with a little salt, seasoning to taste. Once the chayote is cooked, crack the egg into the pan and stir constantly until the egg is fully cooked. Turn off the heat and sprinkle with a little pepper for aroma.
You have now completed the stir-fried chayote with egg.
How to choose fresh ingredients
How to choose fresh chayote

Fresh chayote usually has a light green skin without dark bruises or unusual colors. When pressed, it should feel firm, not soft or heavily bruised. Avoid buying chayote with too many ridges on the surface or a strong chemical smell, as it may have been treated with pesticides.
How to choose fresh, quality eggs

Quality eggs usually have a dark brown, evenly colored shell without unusual spots. When touched, fresh eggs feel slightly rough and sandy. Conversely, if the shell is too smooth, the egg may be old. Avoid eggs that are cracked or make a sound when shaken, as these are signs they are no longer fresh.
Tips for stir-fried chayote with egg
When choosing chayote, prioritize young, green ones with shiny skin and no fibers, as they will cook quickly and stay tender.

To choose fresh chicken eggs, you can feel the shell. If it feels rough, sandy, has no black spots or cracks, and the color is dark, it is fresh. If the shell is smooth, it is old. You can also hold the egg near your ear and shake it gently; if you hear a sound, it is old and should not be purchased.
To avoid getting chayote sap on your hands, wear plastic gloves while peeling.

mon_an.ten: Roasted Silkworm Pupae with Garlic Chives
mon_an.mo_ta: Silkworm pupae are a nutritious, high-protein dish with a rich, buttery flavor that is a favorite for many. While many are familiar with pupae roasted with lime leaves, today we introduce a version with garlic chives that is equally attractive. This guide provides detailed instructions from preparation to cooking. Enjoy this delicious dish in your daily meals.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning - To taste (pepper, fish sauce, sugar)
cac_buoc: Ingredient preparation:
Clean the silkworm pupae, rinse, and drain well.
Peel and mince the shallot.
Trim the roots of the garlic chives, wash, and cut into 5 cm segments.
Peel the carrot, wash, then julienne into segments the same length as the chives.
Roasting the pupae:
Heat a pan, sauté the shallots until fragrant, then add the pupae to roast. Add seasonings including fish sauce, sugar, and pepper. Once the pupae turn golden, add the carrots and stir well.
When the carrots are cooked, add the garlic chives and 1 tbsp of mayonnaise (if desired), then turn off the heat. Sprinkle with pepper, transfer to a plate, and serve hot.
How to buy good silkworm pupae
To buy fresh silkworm pupae for this dish, follow these suggestions:
Choose reliable markets or shops: Go to traditional markets, seafood shops, or reputable supermarkets. Ensure the source is trustworthy and guarantees product quality.
Check for freshness: Choose pupae with shiny shells, bright colors, and no foul odor. Avoid pupae that are brown or have an unpleasant smell.
Appropriate size: Select pupae of a size suitable for your dish. Smaller pupae usually have a sweeter taste and softer meat, while larger ones are chewier.
Interact with the seller: Ask for advice from the seller or staff regarding the origin, quality, and the best way to choose them.
Refer to local tips: If possible, learn tips from locals on how to pick fresh pupae. They can provide useful information to help you make the best choice.
Buy only what you need: Purchase only the necessary amount to avoid waste and ensure freshness.
Remember, choosing fresh pupae is vital for the success and flavor of this dish.
Notes when making roasted silkworm pupae with garlic chives
Choose fresh pupae: Ensure they are cleaned and fresh. Avoid brown, hard-shelled, or smelly pupae.
Prepare fresh chives: Chives should be washed and cut into small pieces.
Short cooking time: Pupae cook quickly, so have all ingredients ready before you start roasting.
Stir evenly: When roasting, ensure you stir constantly so they cook evenly without burning or becoming too dry.
Use low heat: Adjust the heat to low so the pupae cook through evenly without burning.
Add appropriate seasonings: You can add garlic, onion, or chili to enhance the flavor.
Eat hot: This dish is best served hot, so enjoy it immediately after cooking.
Serving suggestions: This dish pairs well with steamed rice, rice vermicelli, or as a snack at parties.

mon_an.ten: Cabbage Salad for Cool Summer Days
mon_an.mo_ta: On sweltering summer days, oily dishes can be unappealing. People often gravitate towards fresh, easy-to-eat salads. Today we introduce a simple cabbage salad. The sour and spicy flavors are enhanced by the crunch and color of carrots, the aroma of garlic, and the richness of peanuts. To make a great cabbage salad, remember to shred the cabbage and carrots very thinly!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Sugar, vinegar, white salt - to taste
cac_buoc: Step 1: Thinly shred the cabbage. Peel and julienne the carrots. Wash the cabbage thoroughly and drain well.
Step 2: Place the carrots and cabbage in a bowl, add 2 tbsp white vinegar, mix well, and let sit for 30 minutes to absorb.
Step 3: Prepare the dressing: 1 tbsp salt, 2 tbsp sugar, minced chili, and 1 tbsp minced garlic.
Step 4: Add chopped Vietnamese coriander to the cabbage, pour in the dressing, mix well, and drain off any excess liquid. When serving, sprinkle roasted peanuts on top.
Enjoy your meal!
Chicken Cabbage Salad Recipe
1. Ingredients
Ingredients for chicken cabbage salad include:
Large chicken thighs: 2 pieces (about 350 - 400 g of meat)
Fresh cabbage: 250 g
Small carrot: 1 piece
Small onion: 1 piece
Cilantro and mint: 1 bunch (can replace Vietnamese coriander)
Lime: 1 piece
Seasoning: Fish sauce, sugar, pepper, fresh chili (or chili sauce)
1 knob of ginger (optional: fried shallots or crushed roasted peanuts)
With these ingredients, we can create a delicious and nutritious salad.
2. How to prepare chicken cabbage salad
Step 1: Prepare the chicken

Boil the chicken with crushed ginger to enhance the flavor. Once the water boils, reduce to low heat and simmer until just cooked through. Let the chicken cool before shredding into bite-sized pieces (do not shred too small).
To enhance the flavor, marinate the chicken with a little seasoning powder and pepper.
Step 2: Prepare the onion
Halve the onion and slice thinly. Mix the onion with 2 tbsp sugar and 1 tbsp vinegar or lime juice. Let it soak for 15-20 minutes to reduce the pungency.
Step 3: Prepare the cabbage
Shred the cabbage thinly and wash. After draining, toss the cabbage with 1 tsp salt. Let sit for 10 minutes, then squeeze out all excess water.
Step 4: Peel and julienne the carrot. For the herbs (Vietnamese coriander, cilantro, mint), pick the leaves, wash, and chop finely. Remove seeds from the chili and slice thinly.
Step 5: Make the dressing
Squeeze the juice from 1 lime. Mix sugar with the lime juice until you have a balanced sweet and sour mixture.
Slowly add fish sauce to the mixture until it reaches the desired saltiness. Finally, add fresh chili and stir well.
Depending on your family's taste, you can use this ratio: 1 part fish sauce, 2 parts vinegar, 3 parts sugar (adjust as needed). Add chili sauce if you want more heat.
Step 6: Place the chicken, cabbage, carrot, and onion in a mixing bowl. Toss with the prepared dressing. Add the herbs and pepper. Mix all ingredients together to absorb the flavors.
Step 7: Transfer the chicken cabbage salad to a plate. Top with fried shallots and roasted peanuts to finish.
Dried Beef Cabbage Salad Recipe
Ingredients
Fresh cabbage: 1/4 head
Dried beef: 100 g
Shallots: 2 bulbs
Cooking oil: 1 cup
Fish sauce: 1 cup
Sugar: 1 cup
Limes: 2 pieces
Garlic: 2 bulbs
Chili: 2 pieces
MSG: 1 cup
Thai basil
How to prepare dried beef cabbage salad
Step 1: Prepare ingredients
Shred the dried beef.
Thinly slice Vietnamese pork roll (chả lụa) into strips.
Wash and thinly shred the cabbage; drain well.
Peel, wash, and julienne the carrot.
Wash, peel, and julienne the green mango.
Pick the mint leaves, wash, and drain.
Step 2: Dressing
Prepare the dressing: mix 1 tbsp sesame oil with 1 tsp sugar and 2 tbsp lime juice. Adjust the seasoning to your preference.
If not eating immediately, marinate the carrot and cabbage in 1/3 of the dressing for 15 minutes.
Step 3: Finishing

Arrange on a large plate with the dressing bowl in the center. Place the vegetables, pork roll, and dried beef around the bowl. When ready to eat, toss everything with the dressing. Sprinkle with roasted sesame seeds and enjoy immediately.
You can add papaya, kohlrabi, lotus root, boiled meat, or roasted peanuts to enhance the flavor. However, limit the use of shrimp as it may overpower the dried beef flavor.
Dried beef is already spicy and salty, so you usually don't need much extra seasoning, but you can add chili, salt, or fish sauce to taste.
General notes for cabbage salad
Chicken cabbage salad is popular and easy to eat, but it may not be suitable for everyone:
People who have recently had surgery, have digestive issues, bloating, indigestion, or open wounds should avoid chicken.

For cabbage, people with thyroid disorders or goiters should limit consumption. Those with stomach pain should only eat cabbage when it is fully cooked. People with severe kidney failure should also avoid large amounts of cabbage.

mon_an.ten: Spicy and Sour Mustard Green Salad
mon_an.mo_ta: Spicy and Sour Mustard Green Salad – provides plenty of fiber and minerals while being extremely easy to eat. Learn how to make this delicious salad.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 1 tsp sugar, 2 tsp lime juice, 1 tsp fish sauce
cac_buoc: Step 1: Trim the roots and remove any yellowed leaves from the mustard greens. Wash thoroughly and soak in diluted salt water for 15 minutes. Boil water and blanch the greens until they reach your desired tenderness.
Step 2: Once the greens are cooked, remove them to a colander to cool and drain. Meanwhile, prepare the dressing, adjusting it to your taste.
Step 3: Slit the chili, remove seeds, and chop finely. Peel and crush the garlic, then mince finely. Crushed roasted peanuts add a rich flavor.

Step 4: Arrange the mustard greens in a deep dish, add the chili, garlic, and pepper, then drizzle with sesame oil and the dressing. Top with crushed roasted peanuts to complete the spicy and sour mustard green salad.

mon_an.mo_ta: Pork Stomach Salad – A delicious, easy-to-make dish featuring crunchy stomach combined with the mild tartness of starfruit and the aroma of lemongrass. This recipe will guide you through making pork stomach salad with onions.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Clean the pork stomach:
Wash the stomach, turn it inside out to remove excess fat, scrape clean, wash again thoroughly, and turn it back.
Drizzle with 1 tbsp fish sauce, vinegar, and salt; marinate the stomach for about 30 minutes.
Remove the stomach to a colander and scrub thoroughly to remove all slime. Rinse with water until completely clean.
Boil the stomach, paying close attention to the timing; if overcooked, it will become tough and difficult to eat.
Step 2:
Wash the starfruit, trim the edges, and slice into thin strips. Squeeze out some juice to reduce the sourness. Peel the outer layers of the lemongrass, wash, drain, and slice thinly.
Peel the onion, wash with water to reduce the pungency, and slice into thin strips. Soak the onion in a bowl of ice water to make it crispier and less pungent.
Step 3:
Peel and wash the carrot, then julienne. Add 1 tsp sugar, salt, and vinegar to the carrot bowl, marinate for 15 minutes, then squeeze dry.
Pick the herbs (Vietnamese coriander and cilantro), wash, and drain. Chop finely for mixing.
Step 4:
Slit the chilies, remove seeds, and chop finely. Use a mortar and pestle to grind the chilies with 2 tbsp sugar into a paste. Transfer to a bowl and add 2 tbsp fish sauce.

In a large bowl, combine the pork stomach, carrots, onions, starfruit, herbs, and chili powder (adjust chili powder to your spice preference). Pour the dressing over the salad and let it sit for 15 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Finally, sprinkle roasted peanuts over the salad just before serving.

mon_an.ten: Green Papaya Salad with Pork Ears
mon_an.mo_ta: Green Papaya Salad with Pork Ears – A delicious and easy-to-make dish featuring the crunch of green papaya and the chewy texture of pork ears. Perfect for a sunny day.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fish sauce, salt, lime, vinegar, sugar
Vietnamese coriander, garlic, chili powder, fresh chilies
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the green papaya by washing, peeling, and shredding it. Soak the shredded papaya in ice water to make it crunchier.

Step 2: Wash the pork ears with diluted salt water. Boil the ears with a little vinegar to keep them crunchy and remove any odor. Watch the boiling time carefully; if overcooked, they lose their crunch. Once cooled, slice into bite-sized pieces.
Step 3:
Drain the papaya well. Wash and chop the Vietnamese coriander.
Peel and mince the garlic. Slit the chilies, remove seeds, and mince. This completes the preparation for the green papaya and pork ear salad.
Step 4: Mix 3 tbsp fish sauce, 2 tbsp sugar, and 2 tbsp filtered water. Add the garlic and chili to the fish sauce mixture. Pour this over the bowl containing the papaya and pork ears.
Step 5: Wearing plastic gloves, toss everything well and squeeze in a few drops of lime juice. Adjust the seasoning to your taste. The dish is now ready to serve.
Source: Ngoi sao

mon_an.mo_ta: Green Papaya Salad – An attractive and simple dish to enhance your meal. Learn how to make this delicious Green Papaya Salad.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Soak the shredded papaya in water with a little lime juice for about 10 minutes to remove all the sap. This step prevents the salad from being bitter.
Step 2: Remove the papaya and squeeze out all the water.
Step 3: Mix 2 tbsp fish sauce + 2 tbsp sugar + 1 tbsp kumquat (or lime) juice to make the dressing.
Step 4: Mix the papaya with shredded carrots, then gently toss with the dressing.
Step 5: When ready to serve, simply top with roasted peanuts, herbs, and chopped Thai basil.
Source: Kenh14

mon_an.ten: Shredded Chicken Salad with Cucumber and Carrots
mon_an.mo_ta: Shredded Chicken and Cucumber Salad – A delicious, oil-free, and easy-to-digest dish. It's a great way to use leftover chicken from the fridge to create a fresh new meal that you can eat without getting bored.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the chicken breast: Remove the skin, wash, and place in a pot with cold water. Add peeled garlic, a slice of ginger, a few leek stalks, and optionally a bay leaf. Bring to a boil and cook until done.
Step 2: Once the chicken is cooked, use a fork or your hands to shred it into small pieces.

Step 3: Wash the cucumbers and soak in diluted salt water for 15 minutes. Keep the skin on, halve them, remove the seeds, and slice thinly. Toss with 1/2 tsp salt and let sit for 15 minutes to keep them crunchy, then squeeze out the excess water.
Step 4: Peel, wash, and thinly slice the onion. Soak the onion in water with a little vinegar for 15 minutes to reduce the pungency.
Step 5: Crush the roasted sesame seeds and place them in a bowl with 1 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp lime juice, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, and 2 tsp mustard. Stir well.
Step 6: Place the chicken, cucumber, and onion in a bowl. Using plastic gloves, toss with the dressing from Step 5. Let it sit for 15-30 minutes to absorb the flavors before serving.

mon_an.mo_ta: Chicken and banana blossom salad – a refreshing new dish for the whole family to enjoy during hot summer days. It is both cooling and rich in fiber. Enjoy the wonderful flavors of this salad with our guide on how to make a delicious chicken and banana blossom salad. Discover this simple and detailed recipe to create this attractive dish.
cac_buoc: Step 1: To prepare this delicious dish, wash the chicken and place it in a pot of cold water to boil. Add ginger and grilled shallots to the pot to make the chicken more fragrant. When the water boils, skim off the foam to keep the broth clear. Once the chicken is cooked, remove it and let it cool. Shred the chicken into small pieces by hand.
Step 2: Remove the tough outer layers of the banana blossom. Slice it thinly and immediately soak it in a bowl of cold water mixed with diluted vinegar or lime juice to prevent it from browning.

Step 3: Finely crush the garlic and chili. Dissolve 2 tbsp sugar, 2 tbsp fish sauce, and 2 tbsp lime juice or vinegar together. Mix in the crushed garlic and chili to create the dressing for the salad.

Step 4: Drain the soaked banana blossom and squeeze out the excess water by hand. Combine the banana blossom and shredded chicken in a clean bowl. Mix thoroughly with the dressing and let it sit for 15 minutes to absorb the flavors. When serving, transfer to a bowl and top with coarsely crushed roasted peanuts and finely chopped basil.
Tips for making chicken and banana blossom salad
You can choose any part of the chicken for this salad; however, chicken breast is usually more tender and tastes better when shredded compared to other parts.
To enhance the flavor, you can simmer the dressing briefly before mixing it with the other ingredients. This helps the mixture become thicker and more savory, creating a truly delicious salad.
When making the dressing, use palm sugar to bring a characteristic flavor to the dish.
To ensure consistency, try to slice all the mixing ingredients into pieces of similar size. This makes the salad more visually appealing from every angle.
How to choose good banana blossoms

Banana blossoms that have been peeled and shredded naturally turn dark or yellowish-brown and are not as crunchy or stiff as those soaked in chemicals. Therefore, pay close attention when buying to avoid confusion.
Good banana blossoms usually have a deep red color, fresh skin, and a layer of white powder on the outside. When you pick them up, they should feel heavy and firm.
To ensure safety and quality, it is best to buy whole banana blossoms and prepare them yourself. This allows you to control the processing and ensure the blossom meets safety and quality standards.
Notes when making chicken and banana blossom salad
Chicken is a common food in every family, but it is not suitable for the following people:
People with open wounds or those who have recently had surgery.
People with kidney stones.
People currently suffering from chickenpox.
People with digestive issues, indigestion, etc.
Additionally, chicken should not be combined with foods such as dog meat, carp, shrimp, etc.

To store the salad, use plastic wrap or place it in a container with a tight lid before putting it in the refrigerator. However, it is best to eat the salad immediately, as leaving it for too long will cause the water from the ingredients to leak out, making the dish soggy and losing its freshness and appeal.

mon_an.ten: Fresh Bamboo Shoot and Beef Salad
mon_an.mo_ta: Fresh bamboo shoot and beef salad – simple yet delicious to cool down the summer heat. Learn how to cook this tasty fresh bamboo shoot and beef salad.
cac_buoc: Step 1: To cook this dish, shred the fresh bamboo shoots into bite-sized strips. Rinse with cold water and boil for 3 minutes, then rinse again with cold water. Continue to boil the bamboo shoots a second time until they reach the desired tenderness.

Step 2: Peel and wash the onion, then slice it thinly. You can soak the onion in ice water or diluted vinegar for 15 minutes to reduce the pungency. Drain and squeeze out the water. Marinate the onion with a bit of sugar, salt, and vinegar for 15 minutes.

Step 3: Wash and thinly slice the beef. Marinate the beef with a little cooking oil, salt, oyster sauce, black pepper, and minced garlic and ginger for 15 minutes to make the salad flavorful. Heat a pan, sauté the garlic until fragrant, then stir-fry the beef until medium-rare.

Step 4: Mix the bamboo shoots and onions in a clean bowl. Add a little salt (for dishes with fresh bamboo shoots, avoid using fish sauce as it makes the bamboo more sour), sugar, and chopped chili. Once the bamboo and onions have absorbed the flavors, transfer to a plate. Arrange the beef on top, followed by crushed roasted peanuts and finely chopped herbs.
Source: Megafun

mon_an.mo_ta: Unique snail salad – a delicious dish made from easy-to-find ingredients that results in an incredibly attractive meal. Learn to cook this novel snail salad, where crunchy, fresh ingredients combine in one wonderful dish.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Green onions, salt, toasted sesame seeds
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the snails after buying: Soak the snails in rice water to release all grit, then wash thoroughly. Boil the snails until cooked, extract the meat into a separate bowl, and discard the cooking water.

Step 2: Wash the cabbage and let it drain before shredding. Wash the carrot and cucumber, soak in diluted salt water for 15 minutes, then drain, peel, and slice thinly. Mince the garlic, chop the green onions, and thinly slice the onion.

Step 3: For this easy-to-make dish to be delicious, the most important part is the dressing: Mix 2 tbsp vinegar, 2 tbsp chili paste, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp salt, and 1 tbsp toasted sesame seeds in a small bowl until well combined.

Step 4: Arrange the ingredients prepared in steps 1, 2, and 3 together. Use plastic gloves to mix everything thoroughly. Let it sit for 15 - 30 minutes so the unique snail salad can absorb the flavors.
Source: BeyondKimchee

mon_an.mo_ta: Sweet and sour jellyfish salad – an easy-to-make, cooling, and refreshing dish for sweltering summer days. Today's article will guide you through the process of making this salad.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, sugar, vinegar, fish sauce, chili, garlic, lime
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the jellyfish: If using pre-packaged jellyfish from frozen food stalls or supermarkets, cut it into bite-sized pieces and drain well.
Step 2: Peel the pineapple, remove the eyes, and julienne. Then, use your hands to squeeze out the excess juice. Note: Choose a slightly green pineapple so it doesn't get mushy when squeezed.

Step 3: Wash the cucumbers and soak in salt water for 15 minutes. Drain well. Do not peel the cucumbers; simply julienne them to make the salad look more attractive. Toss the cucumber with a little salt to keep it crunchy, then squeeze out the water.

Step 4: Peel the garlic, remove the chili seeds, and crush them finely. Transfer to a bowl and mix with 2 tbsp fish sauce, 2 tbsp sugar, and 2 tbsp lime juice. Season to taste. Arrange the salad on a plate and pour the dressing over the top.

mon_an.ten: Pig Ear Salad with Green Mango and Cucumber
mon_an.mo_ta: Green mango and pig ear salad – the crunchiness of the pig ear and green mango makes it both delicious and easy to eat. Check out our recipe for pig ear salad with green mango, cucumber, and carrots below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Chili, garlic, lime, sugar, fish sauce
Coarsely crushed roasted peanuts, fried shallots
cac_buoc: Step 1: Clean the pig ear by scraping off all hair. Wash with diluted salt water. Boil the pig ear with a pinch of salt. While boiling, pay attention to cook it just until done so it remains crunchy. After boiling, remove the ear and submerge it in a bowl of cooled boiled water, then slice into strips.
Step 2: Peel and julienne the green mango, carrot, and cucumber. For the cucumber specifically, massage it with a little salt to maintain its crunch.

Step 3: Pick the herbs, wash, and chop finely. Prepare the dressing: Mix the dressing with a ratio of 2 parts sugar : 1 part fish sauce : 1 part lime juice. Stir until the sugar is completely dissolved. Add the finely minced garlic and chili to the dressing.
Step 4: Combine the pig ear, mango, carrot, and cucumber in a large bowl. Pour the dressing over and mix well, then let it sit for 15 minutes.
Step 5: When serving, transfer to a plate and top with crushed roasted peanuts, fried shallots, and fresh herbs. Enjoy with fried shrimp crackers.

mon_an.ten: Sweet and Spicy Tamarind Stir-Fried Sweet Snails
cac_buoc: Today, we will introduce you to a recipe for tamarind stir-fried sweet snails with authentic flavors, helping you create an attractive dish right at home. With detailed instructions and simple steps, you will be able to enjoy the wonderful sweet and sour flavors of this amazing dish. Get ready to discover how to make these tamarind stir-fried sweet snails to enjoy delicious seafood at home!
I. How to make delicious sweet and sour tamarind stir-fried sweet snails
1. Prepare ingredients
500g fresh sweet snails
50g sweet and sour tamarind sauce
3 lemongrass stalks
Vietnamese coriander (rau răm)
Salt and green chili to taste
Cooking oil
2. Prepare ingredients
Step 1: Process the ingredients
Wash 500g of sweet snails after purchasing and drain well.
Cut 3 lemongrass stalks into sections and smash them.
Wash the Vietnamese coriander to serve as a garnish.
Step 2: Stir-fry sweet snails with sweet and sour tamarind sauce
Place a pan on the stove and add 1 tsp of cooking oil and the smashed lemongrass. Heat until the lemongrass becomes fragrant, then add the sweet snails to the pan along with 1 tbsp of filtered water.
Next, add 1.5 tbsp of tamarind sauce to the pan and stir well for 10 minutes over high heat. When the tamarind sauce has reduced and thickened, turn off the heat.
Step 3: Finished product
Transfer the sweet snails to a plate. Garnish the dish with some Vietnamese coriander and serve with green chili salt dipping sauce to enhance the flavor.

After completing the above steps, you have a delicious and irresistible dish of tamarind stir-fried sweet snails. The snail meat is both chewy and sweet, evenly infused with the sweet and sour tamarind sauce. This will surely be a dish that your family loves. You can enjoy this dish in a cozy family atmosphere or share it with friends during gatherings. Enjoy this wonderful dish and discover the unique flavors of tamarind stir-fried sweet snails!
II. How to make delicious stir-fried sweet snails with tamarind and corn
1. Prepare ingredients
400g sweet snails
1 ear of corn
1 ginger root
1 tbsp minced garlic
1 tbsp minced chili
40g butter
2. Steps to make delicious stir-fried sweet snails with tamarind and corn
2.1. Process the sweet snails
Put all the purchased sweet snails into a basin of rice water and soak for 2-3 hours to remove the grit inside the snails.
Then, rinse the sweet snails thoroughly with clean water.
2.2. Process the corn
Peel the corn and break it in half to separate the kernels.

To separate corn kernels quickly, you can use a small tip: Use the tip of a pair of scissors to pierce the core of the corn kernels. This part is soft and porous, allowing you to perform the process gently.
Next, rotate the tip of the scissors clockwise and counter-clockwise a few times. The corn will break apart, making it easy for you to separate each kernel.
2.3. Blanch the snails
Put the sweet snails into a pot of boiling water with a little salt and a few slices of ginger.
Boil for about 5 minutes, then remove the snails and set them aside to drain.
Note:
Avoid adding too much ginger to the pot, as this can make the sweet snails absorb bitterness from the ginger, losing their delicious taste.
When boiling, you should skim off the foam regularly to clean the snails and enhance the flavor.
Stir-fry the sweet snails:
Add butter to the pan and stir until the butter is completely melted.
Next, add garlic and chili and sauté until fragrant.
When the garlic and chili are golden brown, you can add the corn kernels and stir-fry briefly.
Add sweet snails and seasonings:
Add all the sweet snails to the pan and season with 2 tbsp of fish sauce and 1 tbsp of sugar. Stir-fry until the corn kernels are tender.
When the corn is cooked and the sweet snails are evenly stir-fried, you can turn off the heat.

Once completed, the sweet snail dish will bring you an interesting experience. Fresh, crunchy sweet snails perfectly combine with sweet corn kernels that have been stir-fried until tender. Every time you enjoy it, you will feel the aroma of butter and the characteristic, attractive flavor from garlic and chili. Try it now and discover the unique harmony of these ingredients!
III. Tips for choosing and preparing fresh sweet snails
1. Tips for buying fresh sweet snails

For the best dish, choose snails that are still alive and fresh. You can use your hand to touch the mouth of the snail – live and fresh snails will immediately retract their operculum and close their mouths. Avoid choosing snails that smell bad, have the operculum deeply recessed, or leak slimy fluid, as those are dead or old snails.
In addition, you should choose medium-sized sweet snails, as they will be more fragrant and delicious when eaten.

To check if the snails are still alive, you can drop them into a basin full of water. If the bottom of the snail turns upward and you feel it is light, it is a dead snail and should be discarded to avoid affecting the other live snails.
Additionally, you can look at the operculum. Snails with the operculum close to the outer edge are fat and plump, while thin snails have the operculum recessed inside.
How to prepare snails to clean out dirt:

There is a simple way to remove grit from snails. Just soak the snails in rice water with a few slices of chili for about 2-3 hours. The spiciness of the chili will help the snails quickly expel dirt.

You can also soak snails in water with lime juice to effectively remove slime and mud. However, avoid soaking snails in vinegar, as vinegar will lose the characteristic aroma of the snails and make them less delicious.

mon_an.ten: Spicy Sautéed Moon Snails with Sate Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: Moon snails stir-fried with sate – fragrant with lemongrass and spicy chili, perfect for enjoying on cool days. Instructions for making super spicy and delicious sate stir-fried moon snails. Enjoy this hot and spicy dish with white rice or bread. This guide helps you create a super spicy and delicious moon snail dish at home.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Sugar, garlic, dried shallots, fish sauce, chili powder, and fresh chilies
cac_buoc: Method 1: Instructions for making super spicy and delicious sate stir-fried moon snails

Step 1: Prepare the moon snails: Soak the moon snails in a bowl of cold water with a few slices of chili to let the snails release all dirt, soak for about 4 to 5 hours. After soaking, scrub the snail shells many times until clean, then put the snails in a pot of water and boil for about 5-8 minutes.

Step 2: Peel and mince the garlic and shallots, and finely chop the green onions. Heat a pan with oil, and when the oil is hot, sauté the shallots, garlic, and lemongrass until fragrant so the sate stir-fried moon snails will be aromatic.

Step 3: Add the snails to the pan, add a teaspoon of fish sauce, a teaspoon of sugar, and chili powder, and stir-fry together for about 5-10 minutes until the lemongrass and seasoning mixture coats the snails evenly. Then turn off the heat, sprinkle with some green onions, transfer to a plate, and serve hot.
Method 2: Instructions for making super spicy and delicious sate stir-fried moon snails
Ingredients
300g moon snails, 5 lemongrass stalks
1 tsp chili sate
2 tbsp margarine and common seasonings to taste.
Processing method
Prepare ingredients
After buying moon snails, soak them in water for about 30 minutes to remove sand. Then, rinse the snails again with water and shake gently to remove any remaining sand.

Next, place a pot on the stove and pour in about 500ml of filtered water. Put the snails in the pot to blanch. When the snails are just cooked and the operculum has opened, remove them and let them cool. Then, use a fork or bamboo toothpick to pull the snail meat out.

Next, cut off the digestive tract at the tail of the snail and cut the snail meat into bite-sized slices. For the lemongrass, peel off 1-2 outer layers and wash clean. Then, slice the lemongrass from the stalk.
Stir-fry the dish

Place a pan on the stove and add 2 tbsp of margarine. When the butter is completely melted, add the prepared snail meat to the pan and stir-fry over medium heat. Add 1 tbsp of sugar, 1/2 tsp of MSG, and salt to taste, then stir well so the snails absorb the seasonings.

Next, add the sliced lemongrass and 1 tsp of chili sate to the pan. Adjust the seasoning to taste and stir well for about 1 minute before turning off the heat. The stir-fried moon snails will have an attractive aroma of lemongrass and butter. The snail meat will be crunchy and chewy, evenly seasoned. When enjoying, you can pair it with some bread and chili salt to enhance the wonderful flavor.
Notes when making sate stir-fried moon snails with lemongrass and chili
Choose fresh snails: Select fresh moon snails that do not have a bad smell and are not spoiled.
Prepare snails correctly: Before stir-frying, soak the snails in water for about 30 minutes to remove sand and wash them clean. Then, remove the tail part and slice the snail meat.
Prepare ingredients: Have the lemongrass, chili sate, margarine, and other seasonings like sugar, salt, and MSG ready according to the recipe.

Stir-fry snails over medium heat: Ensure the pan is over medium heat and the butter is completely melted before adding the snails. Stir-fry for a short time to avoid losing the crunchiness of the snails.
Adjust seasonings: Add sugar, MSG, salt, and chili sate according to your own taste. Blend the flavors of lemongrass and chili to create a spicy and delicious taste.

Stir well and do not overcook: When stir-frying, stir the snails and seasonings well so the snails absorb the flavor. However, do not cook for too long to avoid making the snails too soft and losing their crunch.

Enjoy while hot: Sate stir-fried moon snails with lemongrass and chili are best enjoyed while still hot. When the snails are still crunchy and the flavor is spicy, enjoy the dish in its freshest state.
How to choose fresh moon snails

To get fresh and fat moon snails, choose snails whose operculum is close to the outside; when still, the snail body tends to poke its head out, and when there is movement, it will retract and the operculum will close.
Avoid buying dead snails, as they will have an unpleasant smell. To check, you can drop the snails into water; dead snails will float to the surface and their mouths will face up.

Avoid choosing snails that are too large, as experience shows that the larger the snail, the tougher and less sweet the meat will be. Instead, choose moon snails slightly larger than a thumb, which are just right and more delicious. Select medium-sized snails with thick operculums that are fresh and firm to ensure the best quality.

mon_an.ten: Steamed Snails Stuffed with Pork and Ginger Fish Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: This guide helps you create a delicious and attractive dish of snails stuffed with meat, a rustic dish loved by many snail enthusiasts. With just a little skill, you will have a unique meal following this simple stuffed snail recipe. Discover how to make simple and attractive stuffed snails according to the instructions. Enjoy a rich, delicious, and unique rustic dish.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Ginger, garlic, lemongrass, seasoning powder, sugar, fish sauce
cac_buoc: Step 1: Process the snails
After buying apple snails, to remove slime and dirt, place them in a basin and soak in one liter of rice water for about 1-2 hours.
Next, scrub the snails with clean water 2-3 times, ensuring they are completely clean before boiling.
Wash one lemongrass stalk and cut the base into thin slices; cut the leaf part into sections about 3 finger-joints long. Peel and wash the ginger, then crush it lightly.

Add the cut lemongrass and crushed ginger to the pot containing the snails, and add about 1 liter of water so the water just covers the snails. Boil for about 15 minutes over medium heat until the water boils, then turn off the heat.

Place the snails in cold water, then use a fork to extract the snail meat, removing the tail and dirty parts. Wash with salt and vinegar, then rinse 2-3 times with water to remove slime. Next, cut the snails into small pieces and put them in a bowl for later use.

Wash the remaining 6 lemongrass stalks and cut off the leaves, keeping only the leaf part. Separate small lemongrass leaves from the cut part to insert into the snails. Next, mince 4 lemongrass stalks and cut 2 lemongrass stalks into thin slices for the dipping sauce.

Finely chop 4 lime leaves and cut the remaining 2 lime leaves into thin strips to add to the dipping sauce. Mince 2 chilies and the remaining ginger root, dividing them into 2 parts. One part is for marinating the snail meat filling and the other part is for making the dipping sauce.
Step 2: Marinate the snail meat filling

Mix 300g of minced lean pork, 50g of raw pork paste, 2 tbsp of minced garlic, 2 tbsp of minced shallots, the minced lemongrass, chili, lime leaves, and ginger into the bowl of snail meat, then stir well.
Add 1/2 tbsp of fish sauce, 1/2 tbsp of seasoning powder, 1 tsp of MSG, 1 tsp of sugar, and 1 tsp of ground pepper to the bowl and mix well until the snail meat filling reaches a pliable consistency.

A tip to make stuffing the snails easier is to use raw pork paste in the filling, which makes the meat stuffed into the snails chewier and more elastic. If you don't have raw pork paste, you can leave the snail meat filling mixture in the refrigerator for about 15-25 minutes so the filling becomes firm and easy to stuff.
Step 3: Stuff the snails and steam
Place a lemongrass leaf inside the snail shell and proceed to push the snail meat filling mixture into the mouth of the snail, one by one until the filling fills the mouth of the shell.
Place all the stuffed snails into a dedicated steamer and steam for 10 minutes until the snail meat filling is evenly cooked.
Step 4: Make dipping sauce and finish

Add 5 tbsp of sugar, 105ml (7 tbsp) of fish sauce, 2 tbsp of filtered water, and 2 tbsp of lime juice to a bowl, then stir well. Next, add the minced chili, remaining ginger, and thinly sliced lime leaves on top of the mixture and mix well.

The stuffed apple snail dish brings an attractive delicious flavor, with the fatty sweetness of the pork shoulder and raw pork paste, along with the crunchy chewiness of the snail meat. The pungent aroma of lemongrass and chili blends together, which when combined with the ginger fish sauce, creates an irresistible sensation.
Notes when making stuffed snails
Choose fresh snails: Select fresh apple snails that are not spoiled. Avoid using snails that have a bad smell or unknown origin.
Prepare clean snails: Wash the snails thoroughly to remove any dirt. Use rice water or salt water to clean the snails and remove slime.
Choose fresh ingredients: Use fresh pork shoulder and raw pork paste for the filling. Ensure other ingredients like lemongrass, chili, lime leaves, and ginger are also fresh and not wilted.
Stuff the meat evenly: Ensure the meat is stuffed evenly into the snails carefully and tightly. This helps the dish have a uniform structure and taste good.
Steam snails for the right time: Steam the snails long enough for the meat to cook without being overcooked. Steaming time is usually about 10-15 minutes, depending on the size of the snails.

Combine appropriate seasonings: Choose seasonings like sugar, fish sauce, seasoning powder, MSG, pepper, etc., to create a great flavor for the dish. If you like, you can add a little lime juice to increase the aroma.
Serve with ginger fish sauce: Prepare the dipping sauce according to your own taste. Usually, ginger fish sauce is preferred for dipping stuffed snails.
Enjoy hot: Stuffed snails are best eaten hot. Enjoy the dish immediately after completion to enjoy the best flavor.
How to choose fresh snails
Choose live snails: Select snails that are still alive. Touch the operculum of the snail and observe. If they immediately retract inside and the operculum closes tightly, they are fresh snails.

Check meat quality: Choose snails that have a lot of meat. Observe the operculum; if the operculum is close to the outer edge and reveals a little meat inside, that is a good sign. Also, check the snail shell to see if it is chipped.
Check the scent: When picked up and smelled, the snail should have a natural scent, without a foul or strong fishy smell.

Avoid dead snails: Avoid choosing dead snails that have a strong foul fishy smell. Observe the operculum; if the operculum is recessed far inside and feels very light when picked up, it is a sign the snail is no longer alive. These snails will have an unpleasant smell when eaten, will not be delicious, and can cause food poisoning.

mon_an.ten: Stir-Fried Fish Cakes with Bell Peppers
mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried fish cakes with bell peppers – quick and easy yet very delicious. Check out how to make this dish in the article below! We invite you to refer to it. Learn to cook delicious stir-fried fish cakes with bell peppers for mothers to give children who don't like fish a tasty and easy-to-eat dish.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Rinse the fish cakes with hot water to melt away excess grease on the surface.
Cut into bite-sized pieces.
Step 2:
Peel and crush the garlic; peel the onion and wash or soak it in water for a while so that your eyes don't sting when slicing thinly.
Peel and julienne the carrot.
Wash the bell pepper, cut in half, remove seeds, and slice thinly about 0.5cm.
Step 3: Start the cooking process:
Sauté the garlic in a pan with a little oil; after the garlic is fragrant, add the carrots and stir-fry for about 2 minutes.
Then pour in the bell peppers and onions to stir-fry together. Add a little salt to season the vegetable mixture.
Step 4: Add the fish cakes and stir-fry. Then add 2 tsp of oyster sauce and stir evenly.
Note: To make them crispier, you can lightly fry the fish cakes beforehand. However, frying the fish cakes will make the dish more oily and greasy.
Step 5: Re-season the dish to suit your family's taste. When cooked, turn off the heat, add toasted sesame seeds, stir well, and serve on a plate while hot.

mon_an.mo_ta: Sweet and sour pickled chilies are a very popular condiment in Vietnamese meals, especially in cold weather like this. Making this chili vinegar is not difficult; you just need fresh ingredients and the best secret is to have a jar of fragrant and attractive pickled chilies. Today, we introduce the recipe for delicious pickled chilies in vinegar so you can make your own jars of delicious chili vinegar while ensuring food safety and hygiene.
cac_buoc: Wash the chilies thoroughly to remove all dirt on the skin. Then, use a soft towel to dry them completely or spread them out on a large tray or basket to dry naturally.
Slice the chilies into large pieces and filter out all the seeds inside. For small chilies, just slit them to remove the seeds without having to slice them small.
Put the chilies into a clean jar (it is best to choose a glass jar), arranging them evenly and beautifully.

Place a pan on the stove, add all the remaining ingredients to the pan and boil for a few minutes, then turn off the heat and wait for the vinegar-sugar mixture to cool completely before pouring it into the chili jar. The amount of vinegar must submerge all the chilies in the jar.
Close the lid of the pickled chili jar tightly and shake vigorously so the vinegar soak permeates the entire jar.
Put the jar of delicious pickled chilies in the refrigerator to preserve and use gradually in meals or when cooking.

mon_an.mo_ta: Add Garlic Stir-fried Pumpkin Vines to your menu. Discover detailed instructions to cook delicious stir-fried pumpkin vines at home. An easy-to-make dish with wonderful flavor for everyday meals.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Pumpkin vines - amount as desired (about 5-7 stems)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the pumpkin vines

Choose fresh pumpkin vines and remove the tough fibers from the stems, stalks, and leaves to ensure the greens are not chewy when stir-fried. After washing and draining, lightly bruise the leaves to make them tender and help them absorb seasonings better. Next, peel, crush, and mince the garlic.
Step 2: Stir-fry the pumpkin vines

Heat oil in a pan, then add the minced garlic and sauté until fragrant. Next, add the prepared pumpkin vines to the pan and season to taste. Stir-fry for about 4 minutes, then turn off the heat and serve the greens on a plate.
Step 3: Finished product

When finished, the stir-fried pumpkin vines will have an eye-catching green color and a pungent aroma from the garlic. Enjoying this dish, you will feel the combination of the crunchy texture of the vines and the rich aroma of the garlic. This dish not only provides vitamins and fiber but also helps relieve colds and supports healing.
Tips for choosing ingredients:

Choosing greens: When buying at the market, do not choose vines that are overly large, lush green, and perfectly uniform. Such greens may have been treated with stimulants, which are unhealthy and less flavorful. Naturally grown pumpkin vines have slightly more rugged stems and varying thicknesses. (If you have a small home garden, you won't have to worry about this! ^^)

Garlic is a natural antibiotic and very good for health, so our family likes stir-fried pumpkin vines with plenty of garlic for extra flavor. Garlic must be crushed to release its aroma; do not just slice it. Sliced garlic looks better, but it doesn't taste as good. If you prefer, you can crush half and slice the other half. Additionally, you should only peel the outer skin of the bulb; keep the thin skins on the cloves when stir-frying with the greens for a much better aroma. If your garlic has sprouted, remove the green germ in the center of the cloves before cooking.

Many people sauté all the garlic at once before adding the greens, but our family only sautés 1/2 of the garlic at the start. The remaining half is added once the greens are cooked; toss quickly and turn off the heat. This makes the dish more fragrant, and eating partially raw garlic is very healthy.
When stir-frying, I like to add a bit of oyster sauce to make the dish more appealing.
Tips for crunchy and green stir-fried pumpkin vines:
Heat the oil well: Before adding the vines to the pan, heat the oil to a high temperature. This helps the greens cook quickly and retain their crunch.

Stir-fry quickly on high heat: When adding the vines to the pan, stir-fry quickly and vigorously to maintain the crunch and bright green color. Avoid overcooking to prevent the greens from becoming soft and dull.
Season at the end: Once the vines are cooked, add seasonings like salt, sugar, or seasoning powder to taste. Adding seasonings at the end helps enhance the flavor and color of the dish.
Applying these tips will give you a crunchy, delicious stir-fried pumpkin vine dish with bright colors and an attractive flavor.
Tips for crunchy and green stir-fried pumpkin vines

mon_an.mo_ta: A very simple and familiar dish, but with your creativity, you can create something truly unique. Today we will guide you through "Stir-fried Water Spinach with Clams," a delicious, unique, and nutritious dish.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Knorr mushroom and seaweed seasoning - 3 tsp
cac_buoc: Step 1: Soak the clams in rice water for 2 hours to remove sand. Remove and steam until open. Extract the clam meat and marinate with Knorr fish sauce and 1 tsp of Knorr seasoning; let sit for 10 minutes.

Step 2: Pick the water spinach, removing excess leaves and tough stalks. Wash thoroughly, blanch quickly, then shock in cold water and remove immediately to keep the green color. Peel and mince the garlic.

Step 3: Heat the cooking oil and sauté the minced garlic until fragrant. Add the water spinach and clams, tossing well. Season with Knorr seasoning to taste. Stir-fry quickly until the greens are cooked, then turn off the heat.

mon_an.ten: Southern-style Fried Pork Ribs with Fish Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: If you are wondering what to cook for today's family meal, choose this savory Southern-style fried pork ribs with fish sauce. This is a simple dish with easy-to-find ingredients and quick preparation, yet it is delicious enough to satisfy even the pickiest eaters. Let's get into the kitchen and cook! Learn how to make excellent fried ribs with fish sauce at home with simple ingredients.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare ingredients

Ribs: Use a knife to chop the pork ribs into bite-sized pieces. Soak the ribs in diluted salt water or rub with salt to clean and remove odors. Alternatively, blanch the ribs in boiling water for 2-3 minutes, then rinse 1-2 times with clean water. Drain well and prepare the marinade: 1 tsp MSG, 1 tsp sugar, and 1/2 tsp garlic powder. Mix well and marinate the ribs for 10-15 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Lettuce: Separate the lettuce leaves and soak them in diluted salt water for 5-10 minutes to kill bacteria. Rinse again with clean water and drain.
Tomatoes: Remove the stems, wash, and slice into thin rounds to serve with the ribs.
Step 2: Make the fish sauce glaze
Peel the garlic, crush, and mince. Remove the stem from the chili, wash, and mince.
Prepare a small bowl for the sauce. Combine 3 tbsp fish sauce and 3 tbsp chili sauce. Stir well until the chili sauce dissolves, then add the minced chili and half of the minced garlic.
Step 3: Fry the ribs
Heat a pan and add 3-4 tbsp of cooking oil. Once the oil is hot, add the ribs to fry.

Adjust the heat to medium so the ribs cook through without burning the outside. Flip the ribs during frying to ensure they are golden brown on all sides. Once cooked, remove the ribs and set aside for glazing.
Step 4: Glaze the ribs with fish sauce
Add the remaining minced garlic to the pan and sauté until fragrant. Pour the prepared sauce into the pan and bring to a boil. Add 1 tsp of lime juice to enhance the flavor.
When the sauce begins to thicken, add the ribs to the pan and toss well to coat. Continue cooking until the sauce has almost evaporated and glazed the ribs, then turn off the heat.

Garnish the plate with sliced tomatoes and lettuce leaves for an attractive look. These garlic fish sauce ribs have a vibrant color, a fragrant garlic aroma, tender meat, and a rich flavor. Serve with white rice for the best experience.
Secrets to better fried ribs with fish sauce
Choose fresh ribs: Select fresh pork ribs with pinkish-white fat. Chop them into small, even pieces to ensure even cooking.
Marinate well: Before frying, marinate the ribs in a spice mixture to infuse flavor. Common ingredients include fish sauce, minced garlic, pepper, sugar, and other spices to taste.
Fry at the right temperature: Wait for the oil to reach the correct temperature before adding the ribs. Fry on medium heat to ensure the meat stays tender while the outside browns. Flip frequently.
Drain excess oil: After frying, let the ribs drain on paper towels or a rack to remove excess oil. This keeps them from being too greasy and maintains a crispy exterior.
Combine with aromatics and greens: Garnish with minced garlic, green onions, and chili. Serve with fresh vegetables like tomatoes and lettuce to balance the flavors.
How to make savory Southern-style fried pork ribs with fish sauce
Notes when buying ribs
Avoid buying very small ribs, as they often come from young, immature pigs. The meat from these pigs is lower quality and less flavorful.
Instead, choose flat ribs, as they have more lean meat and better quality. Fresh, standard ribs should be bright red, not too pale or too dark.
To check freshness, press the meat with your finger; it should be elastic. There should be no discharge or foul odor.

mon_an.mo_ta: Savory braised pork ribs is a Southern-style dish where sweetness is the highlight. Each piece of rib is a harmony of sweet and salty, braised to a golden brown with an attractive aroma. It is rich and flavorful, perfect when eaten with white rice.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Prepare the sauce: Mix 3 tbsp fish sauce, 2 tbsp granulated sugar, 1 tsp pepper, and 1/2 cup water. Stir until the sugar is completely dissolved.
Step 2:
Wash the ribs and chop into small pieces. Place in a pan and sauté with a little seasoning powder. Sauté until the meat firms up, then pour in the prepared sauce.
Step 3:
Lower the heat and braise the ribs until the liquid has reduced and thickened.
Step 4:
Transfer the ribs to a bowl, sprinkle with chopped green onions, and serve with hot rice.

mon_an.mo_ta: Pork ribs in tamarind sauce – a blend of rich ribs and sweet and sour tamarind, perfect for family meals. How to make pork ribs in tamarind sauce.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the ribs, marinate with spices and pepper, and let sit for 15 minutes to absorb.

Step 2: Take 1 large tablespoon of dried tamarind, add a little hot water, let sit for 10 minutes, then mash with a spoon to dissolve the pulp. Strain to get the tamarind juice and discard the solids.

Step 3: Mince the shallots and garlic, then sauté in oil until very fragrant. Strain out the shallot and garlic solids, keeping the flavored oil. Use this oil to fry the ribs. This method ensures the ribs smell like fried aromatics without having burnt bits stuck to them. Fry the ribs until golden on both sides, then remove and drain excess fat.

Step 4: Using another pan, add a little oil and sauté the tomatoes until soft. Add the tamarind juice, season with spices and sugar to taste, then add the ribs. Simmer until the liquid is nearly gone and the sauce has thickened. Serve on a plate and enjoy hot with rice.

mon_an.ten: Grilled Pork Ribs with Fermented Bean Curd and Sate
mon_an.mo_ta: Grilled pork ribs with fermented bean curd and sate – an easy-to-make dish with golden, fragrant ribs that will delight the whole family.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Mix the fermented bean curd, sate, sugar, and cashew oil in a small bowl to make the marinade.
Step 2: Wash the ribs and keep them in long strips. Marinate the ribs with the bean curd mixture for about 2 hours for a rich flavor. During marination, toss occasionally to ensure even coating.

Step 3: Grill the ribs over charcoal or in an oven. Since the marinade contains sugar, be careful to brush with a layer of oil occasionally to prevent burning. This easy dish can be served hot with white rice or as a snack with drinks.
Source: Ngoi sao

mon_an.ten: Savory Sweet and Salty Braised Pork Ribs
cac_buoc: Savory braised ribs are perfectly seasoned and combined with other spices to create a signature flavor that makes any meal more delicious. Don't miss this recipe for fragrant, seductive braised ribs – an irresistible taste experience!
I. Instructions for simple savory braised ribs
1. Prepare ingredients
300g pork ribs, cut into small pieces
10g minced shallots
10g minced garlic
300ml water
Seasonings: oyster sauce, caramel sauce, seasoning powder, and cooking oil
2. Steps to make savory braised ribs
Step 1: Prepare ingredients

Start by washing the ribs and cutting them into bite-sized pieces. Marinate the ribs with minced garlic, minced shallots, oyster sauce, caramel sauce, and seasoning powder. Mix well and let rest for 10 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Step 2: Braise the ribs

Heat oil in a pot, then add the ribs and sauté until firm. Pour in the water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and skim off any foam, then simmer on low heat for about 20 minutes until the liquid reduces and the ribs are coated in a thin glaze.
Step 3: Completion
The delicious savory braised ribs are ready. The ribs have an attractive golden-brown color and a seductive aroma from the garlic and shallots. Each piece is tender and sweet, coated in a rich sauce.
Step 4: Enjoy
Enjoy the savory braised ribs with fresh vegetables, crunchy cucumbers, and hot rice for a warm and satisfying meal.
II. Instructions for sweet and savory braised ribs
Pork ribs: 600g (choose loin ribs with small bones and plenty of meat)
Shallots: 2 bulbs
Garlic: 1 bulb
Seasonings: salt, sugar, seasoning powder, fish sauce
Additional: honey, pepper, sesame oil
2. Execution steps
Step 1: Prepare the ribs and ingredients
Wash the ribs and chop into bite-sized pieces. Bring a pot of water to a boil, add the ribs and 1 tsp of salt, and cook for 5 minutes. Remove the ribs, rinse again to remove impurities, and drain.
Peel the shallots and garlic, wash, and mince.
Step 2: Marinate the ribs
Place the drained ribs in a large bowl with the minced shallots and garlic.
Marinate with 1 tsp salt, 2 tsp sugar, 1 tsp seasoning powder, 1 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp honey, 1/2 tsp pepper, and 1 tbsp sesame oil for 15–20 minutes.
Step 3: Braise the ribs

Heat a pot on the stove. Add one spoonful of sugar and 2 tbsp of water; cook until the sugar melts and turns dark amber, then add the marinated ribs. Adjust to medium heat and stir well until the meat firms up.
When the ribs have taken on a golden color on both sides, add 1 tsp fish sauce, a little soy sauce, chili powder, sugar, and garlic. Stir well and add enough water to cover the surface of the ribs.
Set the heat to high to bring the liquid to a boil, then cover the pot and braise for 30–40 minutes. During the process, stir occasionally so the meat absorbs the spices evenly.
When the ribs are tender and the sauce has thickened, add some chopped green onions, stir, and turn off the heat. Serve on a plate.
The final result is a dish of braised ribs infused with deep sweet and salty flavors, the aroma of garlic, shallots, and honey, and a hint of heat from the chili.
III. How to choose fresh ingredients
When selecting pork ribs, it is important to choose those with a bright color. The meat should be firm and elastic with no strange odors.
To choose good ribs with plenty of meat, look for small, flat bones. Avoid very small ribs as they may come from young pigs and lack quality.
To ensure safety, buy ribs from reputable supermarkets or stores with clear origins and quality certification.
IV. Notes for making delicious braised ribs
Choose quality ribs: Select ribs with bright colors and firm meat for the best flavor.
Marinate evenly: Marinate with salt, sugar, aromatics, honey, fish sauce, and pepper to help the meat absorb flavors.
Braise correctly: Bring the liquid to a boil before adding the ribs, then cover and simmer for the required time.
Rich sauce: Ensure the braising liquid has a balanced sweet, salty, and spicy flavor.
Sufficient time: Braise long enough for the meat to become tender and flavorful while maintaining its appeal.
Enjoy with hot rice: Braised ribs are best enjoyed with steaming hot rice for a cozy meal.

mon_an.ten: Northern-style Sweet and Sour Pork Ribs
mon_an.mo_ta: Sweet and sour pork ribs – absolutely delicious. This is a favorite dish for many due to its fragrant, rich, and savory sweet and sour taste. This article will guide you through a simple Northern-style recipe to make at home. Simple instructions for sweet and sour ribs in your own kitchen.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare ingredients:

Wash the ribs and chop into bite-sized pieces. Place ribs in a pot with cold water just covering the surface, bring to a boil, then turn off the heat. Discard this water as it contains impurities. Rinse the ribs again and put them back on the stove for a second boil. For this second time, add enough water to cover the ribs; this will help them cook faster and make the meat easier to pull from the bone. Once boiling, simmer on low for 25 minutes.
Peel and mince the garlic.
Step 2: Once simmered, remove the ribs and drain in a colander. You can save the broth to cook soup with greens.
Step 3: Mix the sauce:
Use this foolproof ratio: 1 fish sauce : 1.5 sugar : 1.5 vinegar. You can add chili powder to taste and 1 small spoon of cashew oil for a beautiful color. Stir until well combined.

Note: This formula is perfect for 300g of ribs to be fragrant but slightly light, suitable for snacking with a cold beer. If you want a richer flavor for rice, increase the quantities but keep the 1:1.5:1.5 ratio.

Step 4: Place the ribs in a pan to fry. Use oil and flip frequently so the ribs are lightly browned but not burnt. Once golden, add the garlic and 1 small spoon of oil. Toss quickly until the garlic is fragrant and coats the ribs.

Step 5: Pour the sweet and sour sauce into the pan and toss quickly. Since the formula contains no extra water, the sauce will thicken and become syrupy. Toss until the ribs are a deep amber color, then turn off the heat. This process takes about 5-7 minutes.
Note: If there is too much oil or liquid in the pan before adding the sauce, quickly pour out the excess so the sauce can glaze the ribs properly.
Cooking secrets
Choose loin ribs with plenty of meat for the best flavor. After washing, you can use a knife to score a line along the meat near the bone.

This helps the meat stay tender during simmering and prevents it from being tough when stir-fried with the sauce. When marinating, use onion and garlic juice so the ribs absorb flavor faster without the bits burning during frying.
Marinate with fish sauce for a better aroma than salt. Marinate dry spices first, then liquid ones to ensure they dissolve and penetrate the meat better.
How to choose fresh ingredients
Choose fresh ribs
Wash the ribs with water.
Place a pot on the stove with a little salt.
When the water boils, add the ribs and blanch for 3–5 minutes.
Remove and drain.
Marinate the ribs with 2 tsp fish sauce, 1 tsp sugar, and 1 tsp seasoning powder for 15 minutes.
Choose bell peppers
Choose peppers with a shiny, smooth, thick skin and the stem still firmly attached.
They should feel heavy for their size, indicating they are nutrient-dense.
They should have bright, vibrant colors.
Avoid soft, bruised, dull, or cracked peppers, as these are signs of spoilage.

mon_an.mo_ta: Nutty lotus seed soup – a hot and mildly sweet soup that will make the whole family want seconds. How to make nutty lotus seed soup.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the lotus seeds and remove the bitter germ. Place them in a pot of boiling water and cook until tender. Keep the cooking water.
Step 2: While the seeds are boiling, peel and devein the shrimp. Rinse and coarsely crush them with 1 tsp salt and a little pepper. Marinate for 30 minutes.
Step 3: Soak the shiitake mushrooms until soft, remove the stems, and rinse. Dice or slice them according to your preference. Rinse the tofu, drain, and dice into small cubes.

Step 4: Heat cooking oil and sauté minced shallots until fragrant, then add the shrimp and cook through. Add the lotus seeds and their cooking water to the pot and bring to a boil. Add the mushrooms and simmer for 10-15 minutes. Then add the tofu and simmer on low heat.

Step 5: Whisk the egg white. Dissolve the tapioca starch in a little water. Once the soup has boiled for about 5 minutes, adjust the seasoning to taste, then quickly pour in the starch mixture while stirring. Cook until the soup thickens slightly.

Step 6: Pour the egg white into the pot while stirring in a clockwise direction with a chopstick to create thin ribbons. Adjust the seasoning one last time. Turn off the heat, add chopped cilantro, and serve in bowls. Drizzle with a few drops of sesame oil and a pinch of pepper. Mix well and serve hot.
Source: Ngoi sao

mon_an.mo_ta: Easy spicy stir-fried tiny shrimp – an attractive and simple dish for family meals. Discover how to make this dish through the article below!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the shrimp, remove the whiskers and heads, and drain. Marinate the shrimp with salt. Wash the chili and slice into small pieces.
Step 2: Sauté the shallots in oil until fragrant, add the shrimp and toss quickly. Add a little sugar to give the shrimp a beautiful color. Season with fish sauce and other spices.
Step 3: When the shrimp turn red, add 1 tbsp of cooking oil and toss well. Add the chili, toss once more, and turn off the heat.
Step 4: When serving, squeeze some lime juice over the shrimp for the perfect authentic flavor!

mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried baby shrimp with basil – a fragrant and unique twist on the classic recipe that makes the dish much more appetizing. Discover how to make this dish in the article below!
