This recipe transforms basic baby shrimp with simple, easy-to-find ingredients into a flavorful new meal.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the shrimp: Wash the shrimp thoroughly, then trim the whiskers and heads (depending on the size of the shrimp). Toss the shrimp with 1 tsp of salt and let sit for about 10 minutes.
Step 2: Clean the green onions, dried shallots, and basil. Drain well and finely chop them for the dish.

Step 3: Heat oil in a pan. Once hot, sauté the dried shallots until fragrant, then add the shrimp. Stir-fry over high heat to prevent the shrimp from releasing too much water, and drizzle in a little fish sauce. Stir well until the shrimp are cooked, then season with sugar and salt to taste. Simmer for a short while longer before turning off the heat. Finally, add the green onions and basil, tossing quickly until wilted, then serve the dish in a bowl.

mon_an.ten: Braised Pork Belly with Dried Radish
mon_an.mo_ta: Braised pork belly with dried radish – a perfect combination of rich, fatty pork belly and the chewy, crunchy texture of dried radish. In today's article, we will guide you through making this delicious dish. Follow along to learn how to cook this savory pork belly and dried radish meal.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the dried radish: Wash the radishes, remove the stems, and slice vertically into small strips. Dry the radish strips under the sun until they shrivel up, then store for use.

Step 2: Keep the pork belly in large pieces, parboil them, and then slice into matchbox-sized pieces to keep the dish rich and juicy. Add a little oil to a pan and lightly sear the pork until golden. Add 1 tsp caramel sauce, 1 tsp seasoning powder, 1 tbsp fish sauce, a few star anise, fresh chili (if you like it spicy), and 2 small bowls of filtered water. Cover and simmer until the meat is tender.

Step 3: Soak the dried radish in cold water for about 20 minutes, then drain. When the liquid in the pork pot has almost reduced, add the radish and stir. Continue braising for about 10 minutes, then turn off the heat. Sprinkle with black pepper and serve in a bowl with hot rice.

mon_an.ten: Braised Pork Belly with Quail Eggs
mon_an.mo_ta: This braised pork belly and quail egg dish features tender meat and flavorful eggs, making it a rich and nutritious addition to your family meal during the cold winter months.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Gia vị: Salt, fish sauce, sugar, cooking oil, chili flakes or chili powder, dried shallots, black pepper
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Boil the quail eggs until cooked, then peel off the shells.
Step 2:
Wash the pork belly and slice into bite-sized pieces. Place the meat in a bowl with one tsp of sugar and a bit of black pepper. Mix well and marinate for 30 - 45 minutes.
Step 3:
Heat two tbsp of sugar and one tbsp of water in a pot. When the sugar turns golden brown, add the shallots and sauté until fragrant.
Step 4:
Add the pork belly and stir-fry. Drizzle a little fish sauce into the pot, stir well, and cover tightly for about 5 minutes.
Step 5:
Add the quail eggs to the pot. Season to taste and simmer over low heat so the meat and eggs absorb the flavors. If you prefer it spicy, you can add chili powder.
Step 6:

Cook until the meat and eggs are well-seasoned. Adjust the seasoning one last time to your preference, then turn off the heat. Sprinkle some black pepper on top and serve on a plate as a savory dish with rice.

mon_an.ten: Sweet and Savory Braised Pork Belly
mon_an.mo_ta: Sweet and savory braised pork belly – a rich and easy-to-eat flavor profile. Discover our recipe in the article below. We hope this helps you create a delicious dish to treat your family. Please follow along.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning - Sugar, seasoning powder, fish sauce, black pepper
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the pork belly, pat dry, and slice into pieces of medium thickness. Marinate the pork with 3 tbsp of granulated sugar and peeled garlic cloves. Mix well and let sit for about 30 minutes to absorb the flavors.

Step 2: Sauté the minced garlic until fragrant, then add the pork and stir-fry for about 5 minutes. Once the meat firms up, add 4 tbsp of fish sauce, 1 tsp of sugar, and ground pepper, then simmer over low heat. Add 1/2 cup of filtered water and continue simmering on low heat until the pork is cooked through and flavorful.

Step 3: Cook until the meat is firm and has a beautiful golden color. Slice the chili into strips and add them just before serving. Transfer to a clay pot and keep on low heat until the sauce thickens to your liking.

mon_an.ten: Pork Belly Stir-fried with Pineapple Juice
mon_an.mo_ta: This delicious and rich braised pork belly with pineapple features the sweet aroma of the pork and the light acidity of the pineapple, making it very appetizing for chilly early winter days.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Green onions - a few stalks, thinly sliced for garnish
Seasoning - Cooking oil, fish sauce, black pepper, chili, seasoning powder
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the pork belly and drain. Boil the meat until cooked so it doesn't shrink during the main cooking process. Let it cool, then slice into 1cm thick pieces.
Step 2: Peel the pineapple and extract the juice.
Step 3: Sauté the finely chopped shallots in a hot pan with a little oil until fragrant. Add the pork and stir-fry, seasoning to taste with chili and the pineapple juice.
Step 4: Cover and simmer for about 15 minutes until the meat firms up and the sugar in the pineapple juice becomes syrupy and turns a deep golden color.
Step 5: Season one last time; the dish is successful if it has a balanced sweet, spicy, and slightly sour taste.
Step 6: Remove the meat to a plate and garnish with green onions and tomato slices on the side.
Enjoy your meal!

mon_an.mo_ta: After a busy workday, set aside your tasks and enjoy a warm family moment with a delicious meal. Add this nutritious "Beef Stew with Taro" to your menu!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Black pepper, seasoning powder, sugar, fish sauce, salt - seasonings
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel the taro, wash thoroughly, soak in salt water, and slice into thick pieces.
Step 2: Slice the carrot into rounds.

Step 3: Wash the beef, soak in salt water for about 5 minutes, and cut into cubes. Place in a pot, season, and stew until tender. Add the taro and carrots, cook for another 10 minutes, then add MSG and black pepper.

mon_an.mo_ta: Fragrant braised beef – a delicious daily dish served with bread is an excellent choice for cool days like these. Here is how to make fragrant braised beef.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Ginger, star anise, cinnamon, black cardamom, chili
cac_buoc: Step 1: For the best results, choose beef shank or flank. Leave the beef in a whole piece, dip it into boiling water for about 30 seconds, then remove, wash, and cut into bite-sized cubes.

Step 2: Wash the tomatoes and soak in diluted salt water for 15 minutes to clean them. Drain, cut into cubes, and sauté until soft. To soften them quickly, sauté with a pinch of salt; the tomatoes will be more flavorful and break down faster.
Step 3: Next, add cinnamon, star anise, black cardamom, a little chili (if you like your braised beef spicy), and 1 bowl of water to the pot and bring to a boil.

Step 4: Add the beef along with a little salt and sugar to the pot and cook until the meat is tender. To save time, you should use a pressure cooker for this daily dish so it cooks faster and the beef becomes more tender and fragrant without losing too much liquid.
Source: Kenh14

mon_an.mo_ta: In today's article, we will guide you on how to make a unique and delicious homemade beef with orange sauce. Please refer to the recipe below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Minced ginger, minced garlic, salt, black pepper
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Wash the orange and drain or pat dry with a clean towel. Zest the orange.
Cut the orange into thin slices with the peel intact. Peel and mince the garlic.
Step 2: Mix the sauce: Dissolve the tapioca starch in water to form a paste, then add soy sauce, orange juice, minced ginger, orange zest, and sugar. Mix well.
Step 3:
Place the beef in the freezer for 10 minutes to make it easier to slice against the grain. Then wash the beef and slice thinly. Marinate the meat with a little salt and pepper for 15 minutes.
Dredge the beef in cornstarch until evenly coated.
Step 4: Heat oil in a pan and lightly fry the beef until it turns a beautiful brown color.
Step 5: Heat another pan with oil. When hot, sauté the garlic until fragrant. Pour in the sauce mixture and bring to a boil.
Step 6: Add the beef and orange slices to the sauce pan and toss well until the beef is coated in the sauce, then turn off the heat. Serve the beef with orange sauce on a plate and eat while hot.

mon_an.mo_ta: Sweet and sour beef – a familiar and easy-to-make dish, but with a slight twist in ingredients, it becomes a delicious new meal. Learn how to cook this familiar yet unique sweet and sour beef.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Roasted sesame seeds, green onions, salt
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the beef:
Wash the beef and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Peel and wash the onion; cut 1/2 into wedges and grate the other half.
Trim the mushroom stems, wash, and soak in diluted salt water for 15 minutes. Drain and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Step 2: Place the grated onion in a separate bowl, add 1 tbsp of sugar, 2 tbsp of soy sauce, minced garlic, and minced pineapple. Mix well to create the marinade for the sweet and sour beef.
Step 3: Add the beef to the mixture from step 2, mix thoroughly, and marinate for about 1 hour.

Step 4: Heat oil in a pan. When hot, stir-fry the beef over high heat for about 3 minutes, then add the sliced onions. Stir-fry for another 3 minutes before adding the mushrooms. Once the mushrooms are cooked, sprinkle in some green onions. Turn off the heat, serve this easy dish on a plate, sprinkle with roasted sesame seeds, and enjoy hot with rice.
Source: BeyondKimchee

mon_an.mo_ta: Beef meatballs in soy sauce – delicious beef meatballs combined with a rich soy and pineapple sauce. Check out the recipe in the article below! A great dish for family meals that stimulates curiosity and appetite in children.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Button mushrooms, stems removed, washed and minced - 100g
Bell pepper, seeds removed, washed and finely chopped - 1/4 piece
Green onions, washed and finely chopped - A few stalks
cac_buoc: Step 1: Make the meatballs: Place all the meatball ingredients into a medium bowl and mix thoroughly.
Step 2: Prepare a baking tray brushed with oil. Shape the mixture into meatballs and arrange them on the tray. If you don't have an oven, you can pan-fry them in a skillet.
Step 3: Preheat the oven for 10 minutes. Place the meatball tray inside and bake at 250°C for about 18 - 20 minutes until the surfaces are firm.
Step 4: Mix all the sauce ingredients in a small bowl. Pour the mixture into a small pan and bring to a boil.

Step 5: Gently drop the meatballs into the pan. Use a spoon to coat each meatball evenly with the sauce. Simmer for about 5 - 7 minutes, then turn off the heat and sprinkle some roasted sesame seeds into the pan. Serve on a plate and eat hot with rice.

mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried beef with pineapple is a nutritious dish with vibrant, attractive colors. The tender, fragrant beef combined with the refreshing sweet and sour taste of pineapple will make your family meal much more enjoyable. ## Stir-fried beef with pineapple is a nutritious dish with vibrant, attractive colors. The tender, fragrant beef combined with the refreshing sweet and sour taste of pineapple will make your family meal much more enjoyable.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Slice the beef into medium-thin pieces; do not slice too thin as the meat can easily fall apart and become dry. Marinate the meat with 1 tsp of minced garlic and shallots, and 2 tsp of oyster sauce.
Step 2: Cut the pineapple into bite-sized pieces. Cut the tomato into wedges. Cut the green onions into 4-5cm segments.
Step 3: Place a pan on the stove, add 1 tbsp of cooking oil, sauté the garlic until fragrant, then add the beef and stir-fry until about 70% cooked. Remove to a plate.

Step 4: Using the same pan, add more oil and sauté the garlic until fragrant. Add the pineapple to stir-fry first, then add the tomatoes and 1 tbsp of water. Season with 2 tsp of oyster sauce, 1 tsp of sugar, and 1 tsp of MSG.
Step 5: When the tomatoes and pineapple are soft, return the beef to the pan. Stir well until the liquid reduces slightly, then add the green onions and turn off the heat.
Step 6: Serve the dish on a plate, sprinkle with ground pepper, and enjoy with hot rice.
Good luck with this dish!

mon_an.ten: Stir-fried Beef with Onions and Pineapple
cac_buoc: Stir-fried beef with onions is a familiar dish in Vietnamese households. With its delicious flavor and high nutritional value, it is an excellent choice for family meals. In the article below, we will guide you through making stir-fried beef with onions in just a few simple steps so you can prepare a delicious meal for your family.
I. Simple and Delicious Stir-fried Beef with Onions
1. Ingredients
Beef: 300 grams
Onion: 1 bulb
Cooking oil: 2 tbsp
Common seasonings (salt, broth mix, MSG): a little
2. Instructions
2.1. Preparation
Beef: Wash thoroughly and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Onion: Peel, wash, and cut into wedges about 1/2 a finger joint thick.
2.2. Cooking
Add the beef to a pan with 1 tbsp of cooking oil, 1 tsp of broth mix, 1/2 tsp of MSG, and 1 tsp of salt. Stir-fry quickly over high heat for 1 minute until the meat firms up.
Add 4 tbsp of filtered water and stir-fry for about 2 minutes until the beef is cooked through. Then, remove the beef to a plate.
Heat 1 tbsp of cooking oil in the pan and add the onions to stir-fry for about 1 minute.
Season with 1 tsp of broth mix and stir-fry quickly over high heat for about 2 minutes.
Add the stir-fried beef back in and toss for about 3 minutes to absorb the seasonings.
Adjust the seasoning to taste and turn off the heat.
Tip: Sprinkle a little ground pepper when plating to enhance the flavor.
2.3. Finished Product

The stir-fried beef with onions is finished in just a few minutes—fast and simple. The beef is cooked just right, infused with seasoning and the natural sweetness of the onions. Each bite offers a pleasant crunch, and the dish is light and appetizing.
II. Stir-fried Beef with Onions and Carrots
500g beef
1 carrot
1 onion
1 garlic bulb
1 ginger root
A little celery
Seasonings:
Cooking oil
Oyster sauce
Sugar
Salt
Ground pepper
MSG
Broth mix
Step 1: Preparation
Beef: Wash the beef, slice thinly, and place in a bowl.
Garlic: Peel and mince.
Ginger: Wash and mince.
Carrot: Peel, wash, and cut into long strips or desired shapes.
Onion: Wash and cut into wedges.
Celery: Trim the roots, wash, and cut into 4-5 cm segments.
Step 2: Marinating the Beef
In a bowl, combine the beef with 1 tbsp of broth mix, 1 tsp of sugar, 1 tbsp of cooking oil, 1/2 of the minced garlic, 1/2 of the minced ginger, and 1/2 tsp of MSG.
Mix well and marinate for about 20 minutes to let the meat absorb the flavors before stir-frying.
Step 3: Stir-frying
Place a pan on the stove and add 1 tbsp of cooking oil. When the oil is hot, stir-fry the beef for about 1 minute until firm, then remove to a plate.
Add another 1 tbsp of cooking oil to the pan. When hot, sauté the remaining minced ginger and garlic until fragrant.
Next, add the carrots and stir-fry with 1 tbsp of oyster sauce, 1/2 tsp of sugar, 1 tsp of broth mix, and a little filtered water. Stir-fry the carrots for 4-5 minutes.
Then, add the onions and stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes.
When the onions are just cooked, add the beef back in. Adjust the seasoning to taste, then add the celery, toss once more, and turn off the heat.
Step 4: Finished Product
The stir-fried beef with onions and carrots has beautiful colors; the beef is tender and blends perfectly with the attractive vegetables.
III. Stir-fried Beef with Onions and Tomatoes
Beef: 400g
Tomatoes: 2 fruits
Green onion/cilantro: 2 stalks
Shallots: 2 bulbs
Cooking oil: 1 tbsp
Fish sauce: 1/2 tsp
Common seasonings (salt, pepper, sugar, broth mix, MSG): a little
2.1. Beef
To reduce the gamey odor, soak the beef in diluted salt water for about 5 minutes, then rinse with clean water.
Use a clean paper towel to pat the surface dry, then use a knife to slice the meat against the grain into bite-sized pieces and place in a bowl.
Other tips to effectively remove beef odor:
Rub a little ginger on the surface of the beef, then rinse.
Soak the beef in water mixed with a little white wine for 3-5 minutes, then remove and drain.
Onions and Tomatoes:
Peel the onion, trim the root, wash, and cut into wedges.
Wash the tomatoes and cut into wedges similar to the onion.
Green onions, cilantro, and shallots:
Trim the roots of the green onions and cilantro, remove any yellow or wilted leaves, wash, and chop finely.
Peel the shallots, slice thinly, and place in a small bowl.
Once the ingredients are prepared, you can proceed to cook the dish.
2.2. Marinating the Beef
After slicing the beef, place it in a bowl and marinate with:
1 sliced shallot
1 tsp broth mix
1/2 tsp fish sauce
1 tsp sugar
A little ground pepper
1 tsp MSG
Mix well with chopsticks and marinate for 10-15 minutes in the refrigerator to let the meat absorb the seasonings.
2.3. Stir-frying Beef with Onions and Tomatoes
Place a pan on the stove, add 1 tbsp of cooking oil, and once hot, sauté the remaining shallots. Then, add the marinated beef and stir-fry for about 3 minutes over high heat.

Add the sliced onions and tomatoes, stir-frying quickly. Season with 1 tsp of sugar and 1 tsp of salt. Lower the heat and stir-fry for another 5-7 minutes, adjusting the seasoning to taste. Sprinkle with ground pepper, green onions, and cilantro, toss well, and turn off the heat.

This stir-fried beef with onions and tomatoes is simple yet sure to be a crowd-pleaser, featuring tender beef with a balanced blend of sour, salty, and sweet flavors. It is a nutritious meal for the whole family.
IV. How to Buy Fresh Ingredients
1. How to Buy Fresh, Tender Beef
Prioritize beef with a bright red color, small grain, and a surface that is not too smooth. Avoid meat that is pale, greenish, slimy, or soft, as these may be signs of old or spoiled beef.
When pressed lightly, fresh beef should have slight elasticity and a dry surface. Avoid pieces that are too mushy.
Choosing fresh beef ensures your dishes are delicious and safe for health.
2. How to Buy Fresh Onions
Prioritize medium-sized onions with a round shape. Round onions are usually sweeter and crunchier than long ones.
Choose bulbs with long roots, smooth skin, and skin that tightly clings to the bulb. These are signs of fresh onions that are sweet and not hollow or spongy.
Avoid onions with short or cut roots, or loose skin. Such onions have been stored for a long time and will be spongy and lose their sweetness.

mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried beef with basil – no need for elaborate ingredients, yet you can still create many delicious dishes. Simple but tasty meals like Stir-fried Beef with Basil.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the beef:
Place the beef in the freezer for 10 minutes to make slicing easier and neater. Wash the meat and slice into bite-sized pieces.
Pick the basil leaves, wash, and drain. Peel the onion and cut into wedges.
Step 2: Dissolve the oyster sauce, fish sauce, and sugar in a small bowl, ensuring the sugar is fully dissolved.

Step 3: Mince the garlic; remove seeds from the chili and mince as well (adjust the amount of chili to your spice preference). Sauté the garlic and chili in an oiled pan to make the stir-fried beef fragrant.
Step 4: Add the beef and stir-fry over high heat until tender, then remove to a separate bowl.
Step 5: Use the same pan to stir-fry the onions with the sauce mixture from Step 2 until the onions are cooked.
Step 6: Add the beef and basil leaves back into the pan with the onions. Stir-fry for about 1 minute, then turn off the heat. Transfer to a plate and serve hot with rice.
Source: BeyondKimchee

mon_an.mo_ta: Bò xào lăn is a dish you'll crave even after finishing; it's an irresistible addition to your family menu, and for the husbands, it's an ideal drinking snack. Instructions for cooking delicious and simple bò xào lăn. Learn the stir-frying technique, preparation steps, and how to create bold flavors for this attractive beef dish.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Tender beef, large slices (use beef tenderloin for tenderness) - 300 gr
Peanuts, toasted sesame rice crackers - For serving
Salt, pepper, sawtooth herb, garlic, and green onions. - seasonings
cac_buoc: Step 1: Preparation

After buying the beef, wash it to remove any odor and slice into thin pieces. Next, place the meat in a clean bowl and marinate with ½ tsp ground pepper, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp tapioca starch, and 1 tbsp cooking oil. Crack an egg into the bowl and mix well. Marinate for about 10 minutes to let the flavors penetrate.

Prepare the vegetables: Wash the broccoli and cut into small florets, then halve them into bite-sized pieces. Wash, peel, and slice the carrots. For a better presentation, you can carve them into flowers or use a wavy knife. Finally, wash and chop the fresh chilies and green onions.
Step 2: Stir-frying

To stir-fry, bring water to a boil and blanch the prepared carrots and broccoli. Wait 1-2 minutes, then remove and soak them in a bowl of ice water to keep them crunchy and preserve their natural color.
Next, place a pan on the stove and add cooking oil. Briefly stir-fry the beef over high heat until firm, then transfer to a plate.

Using the pan over medium heat, add the crushed garlic, crushed ginger, and chopped green onions. Add about 1 tbsp soy sauce, ½ tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tsp sugar, and 2 tbsp filtered water, then stir well.
Next, add the vegetables, beef, chili, and 1 tbsp of diluted tapioca starch to the pan and stir-fry for about 10 minutes.
Then, add about 1 tsp of lemon juice and toss for about 5 minutes. Adjust the seasoning to your taste and turn off the heat.
Step 3: Finished Product:

In less than 15 minutes, you have completed a delicious bò xào lăn. This dish is not only impressive with its beautiful colors but also offers a fragrant and bold flavor. If you are looking for a great beef dish to add to your family meal, try this bò xào lăn immediately.

mon_an.ten: Simple and Delicious Stir-fried Beef with Lemongrass and Chili
mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried beef with lemongrass and chili is a traditional Vietnamese dish with bold, delicious, and attractive flavors. The appeal of this dish lies not only in its taste but also in the wonderful combination of sweet beef, fragrant lemongrass, and spicy chili. Follow the recipe in this article! Instructions on how to cook irresistible stir-fried beef with lemongrass and chili. Discover the process from ingredient preparation to combining flavorful beef, aromatic lemongrass, and pungent chili. A bold, attractive dish in the Vietnamese culinary style.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Green and red chili - to taste
Broth mix, seasonings, pepper, sesame oil, cooking oil - seasonings
cac_buoc: Step 1: Preparation
After washing, trim the tough base of the lemongrass and slice thinly. Next, mince the lemongrass and combine it with one chili to create a fragrant and spicy flavor.
Next, peel the garlic and shallots, then crush and mince them. Soak the beef in diluted salt water for about 10 minutes, then rinse with clean water. Slice the meat into bite-sized pieces.
Next, marinate the beef with 1 tbsp oyster sauce, 1/2 tsp ground pepper, and 2 tbsp soy sauce. Toss well and let the beef absorb the seasonings for about 15 minutes.
Step 2: Cooking
Start by placing a pan on the stove over high heat. Once the pan is hot, add the minced lemongrass and chili and toast for about 5 minutes to bring out their characteristic aroma.
Next, add 2 tbsp of cooking oil to the pan and sauté the minced garlic and shallots until fragrant.
Once the shallots and garlic are fragrant, add 1/2 tbsp of five-spice powder and the marinated beef to the pan. Mix well and stir-fry for about 2-3 minutes until the meat firms up.
Then, season with 1/4 tbsp salt, 1 tbsp sugar, and 2 tbsp broth mix, and stir-fry for about 4-5 minutes. Adjust the seasoning to ensure it is to your taste, then turn off the heat.
Step 3: Finished Product
Stir-fried beef with lemongrass and chili is an attractive dish, featuring a unique combination of fresh, sweet beef and the fragrant aroma of lemongrass and chili.

This is a popular stir-fry suitable for any family meal. You can enjoy stir-fried beef with lemongrass and chili with hot rice, and it is even more delightful when paired with bread or fresh rice vermicelli.
Let's show off your cooking skills and enjoy this wonderful dish right at home!
Notes when preparing stir-fried beef with lemongrass and chili
Choose fresh beef: Ensure you select fresh beef with no odor and a nice color. If possible, choose a cut with fine grain and not too much fat.

Prepare ingredients: Wash the lemongrass and chili before processing. You need to trim the tough base of the lemongrass, slice thinly, and mince. The chili also needs to be minced to create a spicy flavor.

Marinate the beef: Before stir-frying, marinate the beef with oyster sauce, ground pepper, and soy sauce so the seasonings penetrate the meat. Toss well and let the meat marinate for at least 15 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Handle garlic and shallots: Peel, crush, and mince the garlic and shallots before use. This helps the seasonings permeate the dish effectively.
Heat the pan: When stir-frying, heat the pan before adding the minced lemongrass and chili. Toast them for about 5 minutes to enhance the aroma.
Stir-fry the beef: After adding the beef to the pan, stir-fry for a short time (about 2-3 minutes) until the meat firms up. Ensure you toss the meat constantly to avoid burning or overcooking.
Instructions for Stir-fried Beef with Onions and Pineapple
Instructions for Bò Xào Lăn

mon_an.mo_ta: Pork rolls with vegetables in tamarind sauce – a delicious dish with a beautiful and appetizing presentation. Learn how to make these flavorful Pork Rolls with Tamarind Sauce.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Sugar, fish sauce, chili, green onions
cac_buoc: Step 1: Julienne the cucumber and carrot. Place the tamarind in a bowl, add a little boiling water, and mash until dissolved. Strain to get the tamarind juice and discard the seeds.

Step 2: Wash the pork belly with diluted salt water. Place the pork in a pot of cold water, bring to a boil, then turn off the heat. Discard the water and rinse the pork clean. Add fresh water and a pinch of salt, then boil for about 8 minutes, depending on the thickness of the meat. Turn off the heat and cover the pot tightly to let the pork finish cooking through.

Step 3: Pour the tamarind juice into a small pot and bring to a boil. Add a little chili powder and finely chopped green onions. Season with about one teaspoon of fish sauce and one teaspoon of sugar. Simmer until the tamarind mixture thickens. Adjust the seasoning to your taste; it should be a balanced sweet and sour flavor.

Step 4: Once the pork has cooled, remove it and slice it into thin or thick strips lengthwise for easy rolling. Place a slice of pork on a plate, top with a few strips of cucumber, carrot, and Thai basil, then roll it up. You can use a toothpick to secure the roll.
Pour the prepared tamarind sauce onto a plate and arrange the pork rolls on top. Serve with the tamarind dipping sauce. This makes a lovely and impressive appetizer for guests.
Source: Ngoi sao

mon_an.mo_ta: Using simple ingredients and familiar chicken, try making this lemon chicken dish. It is quick, nutritious, flavorful, and very beautiful!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Crack the egg into a bowl.
Step 2: Add the soy sauce, wine, sesame oil, and a bit of lemon zest to the egg.
Step 3: Whisk the egg well to combine all the seasonings.
Step 4: Wash the chicken and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Add all the chicken to the egg mixture prepared in step 3.
Step 5: Spread the cornstarch on a deep plate and add a pinch of salt.
Dredge each piece of chicken into the starch.
Step 6: Continue until all the chicken pieces are evenly coated with cornstarch.
Step 7: Heat cooking oil in a pan.
Add the chicken and fry.
When the chicken is golden brown, remove and place on paper towels to drain excess oil.
Step 8: Grate the lemon zest into a pot along with the juice of 2 lemons.
Add the sugar and a small bowl of water.
Step 9: Stir the lemon water mixture and turn on the heat. Stir gently with a spatula while cooking to prevent the mixture from sticking to the bottom.
Season to taste.
Simmer for about 5 minutes, then turn off the heat.
Step 10: Place a dry pan on the stove and heat it up.
Add the chicken, pour the lemon sauce over it, and toss well for about 3 minutes before turning off the heat.
Step 11: Sprinkle chopped green onions and toasted sesame seeds over the chicken.
Transfer to a plate and serve hot with rice.

mon_an.mo_ta: While rare-lime veal is a well-known dish, today we will put a twist on it by using mountain pork instead. Let's try making this Mountain Pork with Lime Salad together.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Smash the ginger and 2 stalks of lemongrass, then divide into 2 portions. Mince the remaining lemongrass stalk.
Step 2: Peel and thinly slice the green banana, then soak in water mixed with salt and vinegar to prevent browning; drain well. Wash and slice the sour starfruit. Toast the sesame seeds until golden.

Step 3: Wash the pork and use a knife to scrape the skin clean. Bring water to a boil, add one portion of ginger and lemongrass, then blanch the pork for 2-3 minutes to remove impurities and odors. Rinse again with clean water.

Step 4: Steam the pork with the remaining ginger and lemongrass until cooked through (about 10-15 minutes after the water boils; check by piercing with a chopstick—if no pink juice runs out, it is done). Immediately drop the meat into a bowl of ice water to keep it white and tender.
Step 5: Use a sharp knife to slice the cooked mountain pork very thinly and place it in a bowl.

Step 6: Squeeze half a lime into the bowl, add sugar, salt, sesame oil, half of the toasted sesame seeds, and chopped chili. Mix well using gloves. Adjust the seasoning to your taste, then arrange on a plate and sprinkle the remaining sesame seeds on top. You can enjoy this dish with sour starfruit and green banana, or dip it in ginger soy sauce for a perfect flavor combination.
Note: Although this dish is called 'rare-lime' pork, since the main ingredient is pork, you must steam it until fully cooked to ensure food safety.

mon_an.mo_ta: Pork Preserved in Fish Sauce – An easy-to-make, delicious dish that is very palatable for the whole family, especially as a snack for husbands to enjoy with friends. Learn how to make Pork Preserved in Fish Sauce.
cac_buoc: How to choose good pork: Select ham or knuckle meat with thin skin and a moderate fat layer. Tie the meat tightly with kitchen twine so it maintains a nice round shape after cooking. Boil the pork starting from cold water with a pinch of salt. This dish can also be made with beef, though pork provides a nicer color.
How to prepare the fish sauce mixture:

Combine the fish sauce and sugar in a medium-sized pot. Let it soak for 2-3 hours until the sugar partially dissolves, then turn on low heat. Stir constantly until the sugar is completely dissolved. Once dissolved, let it simmer gently for 2 minutes, then turn off the heat and let the sauce cool completely. If the sauce is still warm, the meat will mold quickly.
Sterilize the glass jar. Choose a jar size that leaves about 5cm of space from the rim once the meat and sauce are added.
Preserving the meat:

Quick method: For this method, remove the twine and slice the pork into thin pieces. Layer the meat in the jar with garlic, then pour the fish sauce over it. The sauce must be 3-4cm higher than the meat. Let it sit in a cool place for about 1 day before eating.
Longer method: Keep the meat block whole, place it in the jar, and pour the sauce over. Let it soak for 3-4 days before eating.
The longer the pork is soaked in fish sauce, the saltier it will become; however, the skin will become more translucent and crunchy. Adjust the soaking time based on the temperature and weather.
If any mold or film appears on the surface during the process, discard the sauce, boil a fresh batch, and pour it back in.
Serving suggestions:
This dish can be served with pickled vegetables or wrapped in rice paper with herbs and dipped in a light sweet and sour dipping sauce.

mon_an.mo_ta: Spicy Grilled Pork – featuring a bold, spicy, and aromatic flavor. How to make Spicy Grilled Pork.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Pour sesame oil into a pan and toast the black and white sesame seeds. Once cooled, crush them coarsely.
Step 2: Put the chili paste in a bowl. Peel and mince the garlic. Add the sugar and garlic to the chili paste and mix well.
Step 3: Wash the pork and pat dry. Use a toothpick to prick small holes in the meat so the seasonings can penetrate deeply for a flavorful result.
Step 4: Add the chili paste mixture, crushed sesame seeds, 1 teaspoon of salt, and black pepper to the pork. Using gloves, rub the marinade all over the meat. Marinate for 30 minutes to 1 hour.

Step 5: Line a baking tray with foil and brush with oil to prevent the meat from drying out. Place the meat on the tray, pour the remaining marinade over the top, and bake at 200°C for 30 minutes. Once cooked, remove and slice into bite-sized pieces. Arrange on a plate and garnish with chopped green onions.
Source: Ngoi sao

mon_an.mo_ta: If you are tired of traditional pork preparations like boiling, braising with eggs, or frying, this recipe offers a fresh take. This soy-glazed pork is incredibly aromatic and enticing, yet simple to prepare and time-efficient. Follow this recipe to create a wonderful family dinner with rich, savory, and delicious soy-glazed pork.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Minced garlic and ginger - 1 tsp each
Olive oil, sesame oil, soy sauce, sugar, chili garlic fish sauce, water - seasonings
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
After purchasing the pork, rub it thoroughly with salt, rinse with water, and let it drain in a colander. Next, blanch the pork.

Place a deep pan on the stove, add the pork, and pour in enough water to submerge it. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Blanch the pork for about 5-7 minutes until the meat firms up, then turn off the heat.
Remove the pork and place it in a bowl of ice water or rinse under cold water to cool. Use a dry towel to pat away any excess water and fat. Next, cut the pork into 2-3cm bite-sized pieces.
Wash the ginger, keep the skin on, and cut into thin slices.
Wash the scallions carefully to avoid bruising the leaves.
Step 2: Braise the meat until tender
Use the same deep pan from earlier. Layer the scallions and ginger at the bottom of the pan to form a base, then place the pork on top.

Next, pour in 240ml soy sauce, 200g rock sugar, and 500ml Shaoxing wine (specifically used for Chinese dishes). Place the pan over high heat; once it boils, skim off the foam. Cover the pan, reduce the heat to medium, and simmer for about 90 minutes.
Note: If Shaoxing wine is unavailable, you can substitute it with rice wine.
Step 3: Stir-fry the pork with soy sauce

Add the pork to the pan and stir-fry evenly until the meat is cooked through and has a beautiful golden color. Once the meat is cooked, add the soy sauce. You can adjust the amount of soy sauce to suit your personal taste.

After adding the soy sauce, you can season with salt, sugar, and pepper to adjust the flavor. If you prefer a sweeter dish, add a little sugar. If you prefer it saltier, add salt. Continue to stir-fry so the meat is evenly coated in the sauce.
If you wish to add vegetables, toss them into the pan and stir-fry for a few more minutes until cooked but still crunchy. Once the dish is finished, turn off the heat and serve on a plate.
Enjoy your delicious soy-glazed pork!
Notes for making soy-glazed pork
Choose fresh pork: Select high-quality fresh pork to ensure the best flavor. Check the meat to ensure there is no foul odor, no discoloration, and no signs of spoilage.
Proper preparation: Before cooking, rub the meat with salt and rinse with water to remove dirt and impurities. Then, let the meat drain in a colander or on paper towels.
Cut the meat thinly and evenly: To ensure the meat cooks quickly and evenly, cut it into thin, uniform slices. This also helps the meat absorb the spices and sauce better.
Choose quality soy sauce: Use a high-quality soy sauce to bring out the best flavor. You can choose premium brands or make your own from fresh ingredients.
Cook for the right amount of time: To ensure the meat is tender and well-infused with sauce, cook it for a sufficient amount of time. Avoid overcooking, which can make the meat dry and tough.
Adjust seasonings: The flavor of the soy-glazed pork can be customized by adding salt, sugar, pepper, garlic, onions, and other spices. Taste and adjust to suit your palate.
Add fresh vegetables: If desired, you can add fresh vegetables like scallions, chili, onions, or carrots to add color and crunch to the dish.
Proper storage: Once finished, store the soy-glazed pork in the refrigerator to prevent bacterial growth and ensure food safety. Avoid storing for too long to maintain the best flavor.
How to prep pork to remove odors
Fresh pork has the following characteristics: bright pink lean meat that is elastic and firm when pressed.
Avoid choosing pork that is mushy, discolored, watery, or has a foul smell, as these are signs that the meat is old.
When making rice balls, you should choose pork with a mix of lean and fat, such as shoulder or pork belly. This will make the dish more tender and delicious.
To completely remove the odor of pork, blanch the meat in boiling water for about 2 minutes before processing, then remove and rinse with cold water.
Another tip is to add a little white wine to the water when soaking the pork. Alcohol is very effective at eliminating odors.

mon_an.mo_ta: Black Pepper Pork Stir-fry – spicy, aromatic, and unique. How to make Spicy Grilled Pork.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 1 onion, 2 star anise, 5 garlic cloves, 1 small knob of ginger
1 tsp ketchup, 1 tbsp black bean sauce (available at supermarkets)
3 tsp brown sugar, 2 tsp soy sauce
cac_buoc: Step 1: Place brown sugar in a bowl, add black pepper, ginger powder, chili powder, and salt; mix well. Rub this spice mixture all over the pork, massaging it in so the meat is evenly seasoned. Marinate for 30 minutes to 1 hour.

Step 2: Heat oil in a pan and fry the meat until cooked through. While waiting for the meat to cook, combine black bean sauce, soy sauce, chili oil, ketchup, and rice vinegar in a small bowl. Stir the sauce mixture well. Once the meat is cooked, remove and drain the excess fat, then slice the spicy grilled pork into bite-sized pieces.
Step 3: Peel the onion, wash the bell pepper, and cut into bite-sized pieces. Peel and julienne the ginger. Finely chop the spicy red chili.

Step 4: Turn on the stove, pour cooking oil into the pan, and add star anise and ginger. Add the fresh chili and onion, stir-fry for about 3 minutes, then pour in 1/2 of the sauce mixture from Step 2 and stir well. Add the bell pepper and stir-fry for another 3 minutes before adding the meat. Pour in the remaining 1/2 of the sauce and stir-fry vigorously for about 2 minutes. Turn off the heat, transfer to a plate, and serve hot.

mon_an.mo_ta: Grilled Pork with Chives – A simple and attractive dish for busy meals. Check out how to make this dish in the article below! Learn to cook a simple grilled dish from basic ingredients that still delivers delicious flavors.
cac_buoc: To ensure the grilled pork with chives is delicious and not dry, you should choose cuts of meat that contain some fat.
Step 1: Mix the miso paste, soy sauce, sugar, ground pepper, and minced garlic into a thick paste.
Step 2: Wash the chives and chop them finely, then mix them into the paste from Step 1.

Step 3: Prepare the meat: wash the pork and slice into bite-sized pieces; do not slice too thick or too small to ensure the best quality. Mix the meat with the mixture from Step 2 and marinate for 30 - 60 minutes.

Step 4: Prepare the grill rack by brushing it with a little cooking oil and butter. Arrange the meat on the rack and roast in the oven at 200°C for 20 minutes. Remove the rack, flip the meat over, and roast for another 10 minutes. If the meat is cooked through, stop roasting. Serve the dish on a plate and enjoy while hot.

mon_an.mo_ta: Crispy Roasted Pork Belly – An easy-to-make dish with skin as crispy as store-bought versions that the whole family will love. Learn to cook Crispy Roasted Pork Belly to make your meals more enjoyable.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the meat marinade first:

Marinate the meat with 1 packet of five-spice powder, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 tbsp salt, and half a tsp of pepper. Wear plastic gloves and rub the spices evenly over the surface of the meat; let it sit for 30 minutes.

Step 2: Scrape the skin clean of hair, wash, and use a clean towel to pat the skin dry. Use a toothpick or a sharp fork to prick many holes on the surface of the skin so it absorbs the seasoning better and becomes crispier. The more you prick, the crispier the skin will be. Marinate the skin with 2 tsp salt, 1 tsp vinegar, and lemon juice; rub evenly and marinate for 30 minutes.

Step 3: Place the meat in the oven at 200°C and roast for 20 minutes. Take it out, blot the oil on the skin, then brush on another layer of the vinegar, lemon, and salt mixture. Continue roasting for another 15-20 minutes until the skin crackles and pops. If you don't have an oven, you can use a frying pan with oil. This dish is best served hot with chili garlic fish sauce.
Source: Phunutoday

mon_an.mo_ta: Caramelized pork belly (Thịt rang cháy cạnh) is a familiar and easy-to-prepare dish for many families. It is the perfect choice for a family meal on any occasion, especially when you need a quick suggestion for your daily menu. Follow the recipe below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Chili paste or fresh chili - to taste
cac_buoc: 1. Prepare the ingredients
This dish is best made with pork belly, which combines both lean meat and fat from the pig's belly. The preparation and cooking process usually takes about 30 - 40 minutes.
Preparation steps:

Wash the pork belly with diluted salt water, then slice thinly and marinate with salt and fish sauce. Slicing the meat thinly is important because thin slices absorb spices better and create a more pleasant texture. Thin slices also help the fat render out during cooking, preventing the dish from being too greasy.
Mix 3 tbsp fish sauce with 1⁄2 tsp black pepper.
Peel the garlic and shallots, then mince them.

Note: After slicing the meat into bite-sized pieces, blanch it in boiling water for about 30 seconds to sear the surface. This process makes the pork more aromatic and prevents foam from forming during cooking.
2. First stir-fry to render fat and brown the edges
First, add 1 tbsp of oil to a hot pan and swirl it around to prevent the meat from sticking.

Next, add the meat to the pan and stir constantly until the fat begins to render and the edges of the meat start to brown and crisp. Note: When frying meat with skin, be careful of oil splattering; you may want to cover the pan or stand back.
Once the fat has rendered out, reduce the heat to low.
3. Second stir-fry and seasoning
When the meat is browned, add 2 tbsp fish sauce, 2 tbsp caramel sauce, 1 tbsp sugar, and 1 tsp salt to the pan. Stir well so the meat absorbs the seasonings.
Next, add the minced shallots and stir. Simmer over low heat until the sauce thickens, then add the seasoning powder and chopped scallions, stirring well. Adjust the seasoning to your taste.
4. Finish and enjoy
To finish, transfer the caramelized pork belly to a plate, sprinkle with black pepper, add chili if desired, and enjoy with hot steamed rice.
III. Notes for making caramelized pork belly

You can add ingredients to this dish that suit the culinary characteristics of different regions. Scallions, lemongrass, chili, or shrimp paste are popular choices for seasoning, but the method remains largely the same.

Pork belly is considered the ideal cut for this dish. When buying, choose fresh meat from a recent slaughter. Fresh pork is usually bright red or dark red, dry to the touch, not sticky, elastic, and has even muscle fibers. Also, look for pork belly with thin skin, white fat, and a balanced ratio of lean to fat so it isn't too greasy. Too much fat is cloying, while too much lean meat can result in a dry dish.
Although this is a humble dish, it always brings a cozy, familiar feeling to every Vietnamese family. Home cooks can follow these simple steps to create delicious meals for their families.
IV. How to buy fresh ingredients
1. How to choose fresh pork belly
To choose fresh pork belly, focus on these points:
Select pieces with a bright pink color and high elasticity; it should not leave an indentation when pressed.
Fresh meat will be firm, uniform in color, not slimy, and free of unpleasant odors.
Choose meat with a balanced lean-to-fat ratio, thick skin, and a fat layer about 1.5 – 2cm thick. The lean meat should be firmly attached to the fat layer for the best results.
2. Effective ways to deodorize meat
To effectively remove the odor from meat, follow these steps:
Clean it more thoroughly by blanching the meat in boiling water, then rinsing it with cold water.
Use white wine to wash the meat and soak it for about 5 minutes; this is a very effective way to eliminate odors.
Alternatively, you can boil the meat with a crushed shallot to effectively remove any smell.

mon_an.ten: Meatballs Stuffed with Quail Eggs in Tomato Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: Meatballs Stuffed with Quail Eggs in Tomato Sauce – for mothers who want to change the menu for their children. This dish uses very little oil, promoting health for the whole family. A nutritious, easy-to-prepare, and low-fat dish.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, sugar, fish sauce, black pepper, shallots, soy sauce, garlic
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the pork: Wash the lean pork (choose a cut with a little fat), slice into small pieces, and mince or grind finely. Place in a bowl and mix with 1 tsp salt, 2 tsp fish sauce, pepper, and minced shallots; stir well.
Step 2: Peel the onion and jicama, wash, and mince finely. Mix the jicama and onion into the ground meat thoroughly. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 2-3 hours.
Step 3: Boil the quail eggs in cold water with a pinch of salt, then peel them to use as the filling for the meatballs.
Step 4: Wash the tomatoes, drain, and peel. Then use a blender to puree them until smooth.
Step 5: Take the meat out of the refrigerator. Use a spoon to scoop a portion of meat, flatten it, place a quail egg in the center, and wrap it tightly. Repeat until all the meat is used.
Step 6: Place the meatballs in a steamer and steam for about 5-6 minutes until the surface of the meat sets, then arrange them on a plate.

Step 7: Heat a pan with about 2 tbsp of oil. Sauté the garlic until fragrant, then add the tomato puree and a pinch of salt; cook for about 5 minutes. Add the meatballs to the tomato sauce, season with fish sauce, sugar, and soy sauce to taste, and simmer over low heat. Cook until the tomato sauce thickens, then turn off the heat, sprinkle with chopped scallions, and serve hot on a plate.
Source: Ngôi sao

mon_an.mo_ta: Sweet and sour meatballs are enticing not only for the savory flavor of the meat but also for the perfect blend of tartness and sweetness in the sauce. This is a must-try dish that offers a special appeal. Spend some time and try cooking this to experience it! Sweet and sour meatballs are a delicious dish with the aroma of meat and the tangy-sweet flavor of the sauce. Discover how to make this and create a meal that is both tasty and attractive!
cac_buoc: Mix the ground pork, scallions, ginger, salt, soy sauce, egg, and cooking wine in a bowl, then knead the minced meat mixture thoroughly.
Dissolve cornstarch in water, then pour it into the meat bowl and knead until the mixture can be formed into uniform meatballs.

Let the European-style toast cool on a rack to ensure it becomes crispier before serving. These whole wheat toasts have a crispy crust and soft interior, making for a delicious breakfast. If you are passionate about home baking, try this unique toast recipe.

Heat cooking oil, then add minced garlic, chili, scallion whites, and ginger; sauté until fragrant. Add broth (chicken stock or vegetable stock) and bring to a boil, then add the fried meatballs. Season the sweet and sour sauce with soy sauce, vinegar, salt, white sugar, and cornstarch slurry. Boil until the sweet and sour sauce evenly coats the fried meatballs.

Scoop the sweet and sour meatballs into a bowl and serve with white rice. This is a nutritious and appealing dish for children. Especially when a child is picky, this is a great way to help them eat better and consume more rice during the meal.
Notes for making Sweet and Sour Meatballs
Choose fresh ingredients: Use fresh pork and other ingredients like scallions, ginger, garlic, and chili to ensure the best flavor for the dish.
Knead meatballs evenly: When mixing the meat, scallions, ginger, and spices, ensure you knead thoroughly so each meatball has a consistent flavor and texture.

Check for doneness: When frying the meatballs, check carefully to ensure the inside is cooked through without being raw or overcooked. Meatballs should have a beautiful golden color and maintain a crispy exterior.

Cook the sauce to the right level: When making the sweet and sour sauce, follow the correct ratios of soy sauce, vinegar, salt, sugar, and cornstarch slurry to create a balanced and attractive flavor.
Serve while hot: Sweet and sour meatballs are best enjoyed hot, so prepare your white rice and enjoy immediately after finishing.

Serve with vegetables and garnishes: To make the dish more diverse, you can add fresh greens, tomatoes, cilantro, or garnishes like pepper, fried garlic, and chopped chili to enhance the flavor and excitement of the meal.

mon_an.mo_ta: Braised Mackerel with Black Pepper – A simple and delicious claypot fish dish that pairs perfectly with white rice. Learn how to make this aromatic Braised Mackerel with Black Pepper.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, pepper, scallions, shallots, sugar, fish sauce
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the mackerel, remove the innards, clean the belly thoroughly, and cut the fish into 3 or 4 short segments.

Step 2: Marinate the fish with half a teaspoon of salt and let it sit for 15 minutes. Heat 2 tsp sugar with 3 tsp water; cook until the sugar turns an amber color, then quickly add the fish and toss so the caramel coats the fish.

Step 3: Simmer over low heat, seasoning the fish with fish sauce, salt, sugar, chopped shallots, and oil. Occasionally flip the fish so it absorbs the seasonings evenly. If the liquid reduces too much, remember to add a little boiling water.
Step 4: When the braising liquid has almost completely reduced, turn off the heat and sprinkle black pepper and chopped scallions over the surface. Serve on a plate with white rice.
Source: Ngôi sao

mon_an.mo_ta: In traditional cooking, dishes combined with Thai basil are widely prepared because basil is affordable and aromatic, making the meal very enjoyable. Try learning to cook this fragrant Chicken Stir-fry with Thai Basil.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fish sauce, sugar, seasoning powder, chili powder, black pepper
cac_buoc: Step 1: Pick the young leaves of the Thai basil, discard damaged or insect-eaten leaves, wash thoroughly, and drain in a colander. Wash the fresh ginger, peel, and julienne.
Step 2: Wash the chicken, remove any remaining pinfeathers, and chop into bite-sized pieces. Marinate the chicken with a teaspoon of salt so the stir-fry is more flavorful.

Step 3: Place a pan on the stove, add 2 tsp of oil, and sauté the garlic until fragrant. Add the chicken and stir-fry. Add fish sauce, sugar, salt, and pepper; season to taste. Cover the pan to let the chicken cook through.

Step 4: Once the chicken is cooked, quickly add the Thai basil and stir-fry for a moment until the basil is wilted. Turn off the heat and transfer the dish to a plate. The process of cooking chicken stir-fry with Thai basil is now complete.

mon_an.mo_ta: A simple stir-fry that isn't too expensive during times of inflation, featuring crunchy pork heart and sweet chayote. Stir-fried pork heart with chayote is a nutritious dish that brings a delicious meal to your family. Learn how to make this dish below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Scallions, salt, seasoning powder, black pepper, shallots, fish sauce - seasonings
cac_buoc: Step 1:
After washing the heart, cut it in half and slice thinly lengthwise, removing all internal blood clots.
Marinate the pork heart in a bowl with a little salt and pepper; mix well and let it sit for about 15 minutes to absorb the seasonings.
Step 2:
Peel the chayote, wash it, and slice into bite-sized pieces.
Step 3:
Peel the onion and slice it thinly.
Step 4:
Heat the cooking oil and sauté the shallots until fragrant. Add the pork heart and stir-fry quickly over high heat for about 5 to 8 minutes until the heart is cooked.
Step 5:
Add the chayote and onion to the pan. Drizzle in a little fish sauce, 1 tsp salt, and 1/2 tsp seasoning powder. Stir-fry gently until the chayote is cooked through.
Step 6:
Turn off the heat, add chopped scallions, transfer to a plate, and sprinkle a little black pepper on top. Serve as a stir-fried dish with rice.

mon_an.ten: Fried Shrimp with Green Rice Flakes
mon_an.mo_ta: Fried black tiger shrimp with green rice flakes is a popular dish known for its vibrant color and delicious flavor. Let's get started on this simple and nutritious dish for the whole family! Fried black tiger shrimp with green rice flakes is a popular dish known for its vibrant color and delicious flavor. Let's get started on this simple and nutritious dish for the whole family!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Celery, coriander, horn chili, cucumber, lettuce - For garnish
Minced shallot and garlic, pepper, oil, salt - Seasoning
Seasoning powder, oil, plum sauce - Seasoning
cac_buoc: Step 1: Remove the black veins from the shrimp, peel the shells while leaving the tails intact. Rinse briefly with salt water, make a shallow cut along the belly to straighten the shrimp, then pat dry.
Step 2: Mix the seasoning mixture including: 1 tbsp minced shallot and garlic juice, 1/3 tsp seasoning powder, and 1/2 tsp pepper. Marinate the shrimp for 5–10 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Step 3: Crack the eggs into a bowl and beat well.
Step 4: Finely mince the celery and chili.

Step 5: Dredge the shrimp in flour, then dip into the egg to create a thin coating. Next, roll the shrimp in the green rice flakes, pressing gently so the flakes adhere evenly to form a coating around the shrimp.

Step 6: Place a pan on the stove and add oil. When the oil is hot, add the coated shrimp and fry over medium-low heat until the rice flakes puff up and turn golden (do not over-brown or the green color will be lost). Remove and drain on paper towels.
Step 7: Arrange the fried shrimp on a plate and serve hot with chili sauce or plum sauce.

mon_an.mo_ta: After a hard day's work, you want to prepare a quick, simple, and easy-to-make meal for the family that is still full of nutrients. Salted egg yolk fried shrimp is the perfect dish for the whole family that we would like to introduce to you today. Allergy: Shrimp
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: White wine - 1/2 small cup (to remove the fishy smell of the shrimp)
cac_buoc: Wash the shrimp, peel, remove the heads, and devein. You can prepare the shrimp in advance, keep them in the refrigerator or freezer, and thaw them when cooking. Rinse with white wine to remove the fishy smell, then marinate with 1 tbsp of cornstarch.
Place the salted egg yolks in a bowl and mash them finely.
Wash the green onions and chop them finely.
Place a pan on the stove over high heat, add a little oil. When hot, add the shrimp and stir-fry quickly. Once the shrimp are cooked and turn pink, remove them to a bowl.

Return the pan to the stove, add oil, and heat it up. Pour in the mashed salted egg yolks and stir until the yolks thicken and become foamy. Add the shrimp back in and toss well so the egg yolks coat the shrimp evenly. Season to taste, add green onions and pepper, then turn off the heat. Serve on a plate with hot rice.
Note: Since salted egg yolks are already salty, you should not season the shrimp while stir-frying; wait until the very end to adjust the seasoning.

mon_an.ten: Crispy Fried Shrimp and Crab Balls
mon_an.mo_ta: Crispy fried shrimp and crab balls are excellent for those who need a calcium boost but don't like the hassle of peeling shells. This is a healthy and easy-to-eat dish, especially for the elderly and children.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Crab - 1 whole or pre-processed crab meat
Salt, pepper, seasoning powder, fish sauce, sugar
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Wash the crab, steam until cooked, then extract the meat and set aside in a bowl.
Peel and devein the shrimp, wash with diluted salt water, and drain. Coarsely grind or mince the shrimp (do not mash into a paste).
Step 2: Mix the pork paste, crab meat, and shrimp in a large bowl. Add a little salt, pepper, seasoning powder, and fish sauce. Mix well so the mixture absorbs the seasonings.
Step 3:
Use a spoon to scoop the mixture and shape into even, bite-sized balls.
Beat the egg white and place the breadcrumbs in a separate bowl.
Roll each ball in the egg white.
Step 4: Then roll the balls in the breadcrumbs until evenly coated.
Step 5: Place a deep pan on the stove and add oil. When the oil is hot, drop the balls in and fry until golden brown. Remove and place on a plate lined with paper towels to absorb excess oil.

mon_an.mo_ta: Garlic butter stir-fried shrimp – exceptionally delicious and a great way to save cooking time. Check out our recipe for garlic butter shrimp in the article below!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel and devein the shrimp, wash them, and then pat dry.
Step 2: Soak and wash the dill, then chop it finely. Peel and mince the garlic and shallots.
Step 3: Heat a pan and add the butter. Add the shallots, garlic, and dill, sautéing until fragrant to enhance the flavor. Then, add the shrimp and stir-fry evenly.
Step 4: When the shrimp are cooked, season with fish sauce and pepper to taste. Stir-fry for about 1 more minute, then turn off the heat.

mon_an.mo_ta: Spicy simmered shrimp – a new twist to make your meal more appetizing. A nutritious and cost-effective recipe for home cooks.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Soak the dried chili in warm water for about 10 minutes until soft, then chop finely.
Sauté the garlic and dried chili until fragrant, then add red peppercorns, fermented rice, sugar, soy sauce, and water. Bring to a boil, then pour into a separate bowl to use as the sauce.
Step 2:
Wash the shrimp, peel, devein, and butterfly them.
Lightly fry the shrimp in a hot pan with oil until they are beautifully golden.
Step 3:
Roast the peanuts until cooked.

Pour the sauce from Step 1 back into the pan, add the peas and stir-fry for about 3 minutes until cooked. Add the shrimp and peanuts. Simmer for 3–5 minutes until the shrimp absorb the sauce, then add chopped green onions, toss quickly, turn off the heat, and serve hot.

mon_an.mo_ta: Sweet and Sour Shrimp – a special and flavorful dish with a unique sweet and sour sauce. Learn how to make delicious Sweet and Sour Shrimp.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 30g sugar, 10ml white wine, 100ml water, 10g chili sauce
cac_buoc: Step 1: Mix the cornstarch with filtered water and place in the refrigerator for about 2 hours; if you have time, you can leave this mixture overnight.

Step 2: Clean the shrimp, peel and remove the heads, then devein by slicing along the back. Remove the starch mixture from the refrigerator, drain off the excess water on top, then mix the remaining starch with the egg white and cooking oil. This is the secret to keeping the shrimp's outer coating crispy even after being tossed in the sauce.
Step 3: Coat the shrimp evenly in the batter. Heat the oil until hot, then fry the shrimp over high heat until golden brown and crispy.
Step 4: Mix the ketchup, chili sauce, white wine, water, sugar, and a pinch of salt together. Sauté the ginger and garlic until fragrant, then pour in the sauce mixture and simmer for about 1 minute.

Step 5: Add the shrimp and toss quickly for about 2 minutes, then pour in the cornstarch slurry (cornstarch mixed with water) and cook for another 1 minute. Add the scallions and turn off the heat. Serve on a plate and enjoy while hot to keep the shrimp delicious and crispy.
Source: Kenh14

mon_an.ten: Irresistible Sweet and Sour Crispy Fried Shrimp
mon_an.mo_ta: Cold winter days become much warmer when you enjoy hot rice with a bit of sweet and sour sauce and the delicate flavor of crispy fried shrimp. Today, we will guide you through making this delicious and appetizing "Sweet and Sour Crispy Fried Shrimp" dish.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Minced ginger, garlic, and shallots - for seasoning
cac_buoc: Step 1: Mix the potato starch with water and place it in the refrigerator for about 2 hours. If you have time, you should leave this mixture overnight!
Step 2: Wash the shrimp, peel off the shells and heads, then cut along the back to remove the vein.

Step 3: Take the starch mixture out of the refrigerator, pour off the excess water on top, then mix the remaining starch paste thoroughly with the egg white and cooking oil. This is the secret to keeping the shrimp's outer crust crispy even after being tossed in the sauce.
Step 4: Add the shrimp into the starch mixture and coat them evenly.
Step 5: Heat the oil until hot, then drop the shrimp in and fry over high heat until golden brown.
Step 6: Mix the ketchup, chili sauce, rice wine, water, sugar, and a pinch of salt together.
Step 7: Sauté the minced ginger and garlic until fragrant, then pour in the sauce mixture and simmer for about 1 minute.
Step 8: Add the shrimp and toss quickly for about 2 minutes. Pour in the cornstarch and water mixture (slurry), simmer for another 1 minute, then add the green onions and turn off the heat.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Sweet and Tangy Stir-Fried Shrimp with Pineapple
mon_an.mo_ta: This sweet and sour stir-fried shrimp with pineapple will have your family constantly praising its deliciousness. The shrimp are prepared to be firm and sweet, fully infused with the sweet and sour sauce and the seductive aroma of pineapple. When enjoyed with hot rice, the flavor becomes indescribably wonderful. Don't hesitate, try making this dish now! Follow the instructions below for a truly great experience! Discover how to make stir-fried shrimp with pineapple through our guide and experience its rich flavors.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, seasoning powder, MSG, cooking oil - to taste
cac_buoc: 1. Prepare the ingredients
After buying the shrimp, wash them, peel the shells, remove the heads, and devein them.
For the pineapple, peel it, remove the eyes, and wash it. Then, use a knife to cut it into bite-sized pieces.
2. Make the stir-fried shrimp with pineapple

Place a pan over medium heat and add one tablespoon of cooking oil. Wait for the oil to get hot, then add the pineapple to the pan and stir-fry until cooked. Stir-fry for about 3 minutes until the pineapple is tender. Once cooked, remove the pineapple to a plate.

Using the same pan, add another tablespoon of cooking oil and heat it up. Next, add the prepared shrimp to the pan along with 2 teaspoons of MSG, 2 teaspoons of seasoning powder, and 1/2 teaspoon of salt. Stir-fry everything over medium heat for about 5 minutes until the shrimp are cooked and have absorbed the seasonings.

When the shrimp are cooked, add the pineapple back into the pan and stir-fry for about 1 more minute. Taste and adjust the seasoning to your preference. Then, turn off the heat and enjoy the delicious stir-fried shrimp with pineapple immediately!
3. Finished dish

The finished stir-fried shrimp with pineapple is a masterpiece with attractive colors and wonderful flavors. The orange-red color of the shrimp combines with its natural inner sweetness, coated in a balanced layer of seasoning. The vibrant yellow of the pineapple brings a light sourness mixed with natural sweetness, creating perfect harmony in this stir-fry.
This dish will surely delight your whole family and make you want to eat more rice.
Good luck to everyone!
How to choose ingredients
1. How to choose fresh and delicious shrimp
Fresh shrimp have a transparent outer shell and a fresh sea scent, without any fishy smell. Avoid buying shrimp with dark patches or inconsistent coloring.
Fresh shrimp usually have their tails folded together. If the tail is spread out, it may indicate that the shrimp have been injected with chemicals or water to appear plump. Avoid buying such shrimp.
Fresh shrimp have legs firmly attached to the body. If you see the legs have turned black or are no longer firmly attached, avoid buying them, as this is a sign that the shrimp are no longer fresh.
Following these principles will help you choose fresh, delicious shrimp and ensure the freshness and safety of your meal.
2. How to choose fresh and delicious pineapple
Delicious ripe pineapples usually have an eye-catching yellow color, sometimes mixed with a bit of green. These are fully ripe pineapples with a moderate sweetness.
Choose pineapples that are slightly rounded and short. These fruits have more flesh than long-shaped ones.
Buy pineapples with larger eyes. These are mature fruits that ripened naturally rather than being forced.
When choosing pineapple, if it is just ripe, you will feel a moderate softness when touching it. The skin of a ripe pineapple usually has some light wrinkles.
Avoid buying pineapples with a deep dark yellow color, as these are often overripe and may be rotten inside.
Notes for making stir-fried shrimp with pineapple
Choose fresh shrimp: Select shrimp with transparent shells, no fishy smell, and good color. Ensure the shrimp are not spoiled or chemically treated.
Properly prepare the shrimp: Remove the shells and clean the shrimp thoroughly, removing the digestive tract on the back. Rinse with cold water and pat dry before use.
Prepare the pineapple: Peel the pineapple and cut into bite-sized pieces. Remove the core and the hard parts.

Stir-fry the shrimp and pineapple: Before stir-frying, heat the pan and add oil. Add the shrimp to the pan and stir-fry briefly until evenly cooked. Then, add the pineapple and stir-fry a bit longer so the pineapple softens and blends with the shrimp.

Ensure the dish's deliciousness: Season with salt, sugar, MSG, or fish sauce to adjust the flavor to your personal preference. Avoid over-seasoning so the shrimp and pineapple retain their natural flavors.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Delicious Five-Color Stir-Fried Shrimp
mon_an.mo_ta: Five-color stir-fried shrimp – colorful and highly nutritious for the whole family. Learn to cook this eye-catching and delicious stir-fry dish.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the fresh shrimp: Peel the shrimp, remove the vein, but leave the tail intact for presentation. Marinate with a little seasoning powder.

Step 2: Prepare the vegetables: Wash the bell pepper, remove the seeds, and cut into bite-sized pieces. Wash the carrot and cucumber, then soak in diluted salt water for 15 minutes; drain and slice thinly, keeping the skin on. Cut the onion into wedges. Soak the shiitake mushrooms until expanded, remove the stems, and wash clean.

Step 3: To maintain beautiful colors, blanch the bell peppers, carrots, and cucumbers in boiling water first. Heat a pan with oil, sauté the minced garlic until fragrant, then add the shrimp and stir-fry until cooked. Remove the shrimp and set aside on a plate.

Step 4: Using the same pan, stir-fry the vegetables one by one, starting with the carrots. When nearly cooked, add the bell peppers, onions, and cucumbers. Next, add the shiitake mushrooms and season to taste. When the vegetables are cooked, add the shrimp back in, toss quickly, and turn off the heat. Serve the five-color stir-fried shrimp on a plate and enjoy hot with rice.

mon_an.mo_ta: Scrambled Eggs with Tomatoes – A simple and easy-to-make daily dish that provides a delicious meal for the whole family while saving time. Here is how to make Scrambled Eggs with Tomatoes.
cac_buoc: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt. Wash the tomatoes, peel them, and slice thinly. Wash and finely chop the green onions. Note: It is recommended not to add garlic to egg dishes, as it can cause indigestion or bloating, and in some cases, may lead to discomfort.
There are 2 ways to prepare this scrambled egg and tomato dish:

Method 1: After beating the eggs, fry them in a hot pan. Once cooked, remove to a plate and use chopsticks to break them into small pieces. Stir-fry the tomatoes with a little salt until soft. Once the tomatoes are tender, add the eggs and green onions back in, stir-fry briefly, then turn off the heat. Serve on a plate and enjoy while hot.

Method 2: Stir-fry the tomatoes with a little salt first until soft. Once the tomatoes are tender, pour in the beaten eggs. Stir constantly so the eggs and tomatoes blend together. Finally, add the green onions and serve on a plate to eat hot.
Source: Kenh14

mon_an.mo_ta: Anabas rice vermicelli soup has long been a favorite for many, featuring a sweet and fragrant broth served with crispy fried fish, tomatoes, and green onions. Learn to cook this delicious noodle soup; it is easy to make and doesn't require too much effort.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Trim the leaves, roots, and tough parts of the water celery. Wash thoroughly and cut into bite-sized pieces. Briefly stir-fry until just cooked.
Step 2: Fillet the tilapia, keeping the bones separate. Wash the fish fillets, cut into bite-sized pieces, and fry until crispy. To make the dish better, you can cut the fish into long strips.
Step 3: Cut the green onions into segments, slicing the white parts lengthwise. Pick and wash the dill, drain well, and chop finely. Wash the tomatoes and cut into wedges.
Step 4: Place the fish bones in a pot of water, add the tomatoes, and simmer to make the broth. Add a bit of crushed ginger for fragrance. Season to taste.

When serving, place the rice vermicelli in a bowl and top with water celery, tomatoes, green onions, and dill. Ladle the hot broth over and enjoy while hot. Your anabas rice vermicelli soup is now complete.

mon_an.mo_ta: Make your own clean chili sauce at home for those who love spicy food but want to avoid unhygienic commercial versions. Learning to cook this clean chili sauce is not difficult; it contains no food coloring or preservatives.
cac_buoc: Making clean chili sauce at home is not difficult with this super easy recipe:
Step 1:
Wash the chilies, drain thoroughly, and chop. If you prefer it less spicy, remove the seeds.
Wash the tomatoes, chop, and remove the seeds.
Peel and wash the onion. Peel the garlic and ginger. Chop all these ingredients.
Step 2: Place all the prepared ingredients into a blender and blend until smooth with the water.
Step 3: Pass the blended mixture through a sieve to ensure it is smooth and free of lumps.

Step 4: Pour the sieved mixture into a pot and bring to a boil. Lower the heat, add sugar and salt, and cook for about 15 - 20 minutes. When the mixture has thickened, add about 1/2 tsp of tapioca starch (dissolved in a little water) and stir well.
Once the homemade chili sauce has cooled completely, pour it into a glass jar, seal tightly, and store in the refrigerator.

mon_an.ten: Northern-Style Fish Soup with Pickled Greens
mon_an.mo_ta: Fish soup with pickled greens is a familiar dish to Vietnamese people. It is a rustic, easy-to-make meal that suits many tastes. It is especially delicious during cool weather! Refer to our recipe for Northern-style fish soup with pickled greens. Discover this simple and authentic formula. This soup brings the wonderful flavor of fresh fish combined with the tangy taste of pickled greens. Make it now to enjoy an attractive and easy traditional dish at home.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings - fish sauce, salt, MSG, cooking oil
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, clean the fish and marinate with a little salt.
Rinse the pickled mustard greens under running water and let them drain.
Pick and wash the green onions and dill, then cut into segments.
Wash the tomato and cut into wedges.
Peel and thinly slice the shallots.
Step 2:

Place a pan on the heat and add oil. Once the oil is very hot, fry the fish until golden brown on both sides. Note: The pan must be completely dry before adding oil, and the oil must be very hot before adding the fish to prevent sticking.
Sauté the shallots in oil until fragrant, then add the tomatoes and stir briefly. Add the pickled greens and stir-fry. During this process, add a little seasoning to make the greens more flavorful.
Once the greens are cooked, add enough water for your family's needs and bring to a boil for about 20 minutes.
When the greens are tender, add the fried fish (submerge it under the greens) and simmer for another 10 minutes.
While simmering the fish to absorb the flavors, adjust the seasonings to your taste. When the soup is ready, add the green onions and dill, then ladle into a bowl.
We have now finished the fish soup with pickled greens!
Notes for cooking:
Choose fresh fish: Select fresh fish, such as grass carp, to ensure the best flavor for the soup.
Prepare good pickled greens: Pickled mustard greens should be fresh and of good quality. Check to ensure they are not wilted or showing signs of spoilage.
Appropriate seasoning: Use oil, seasoning powder, and MSG to highlight the soup's flavor. You may not need extra salt as the pickled greens are already salty.
Cooking time: Simmer the fish for 10-15 minutes after the soup boils to ensure it is cooked through but not too soft.
How to buy good grass carp:

A simple way to choose the best grass carp is to look for those that are still swimming. Fresh fish will have a streamlined, firm body with a balanced head and torso. When placed in water, they should sink immediately and splash strongly.

Additionally, check the eyes. Fresh fish have bright, sparkling eyes and bright red gills. The scales should not fall off easily when touched. If you flip the fish over and the belly is flat and the anus is pale white, it is a sign of freshness.
Avoid buying fish with white, sunken, lifeless eyes. Fish with scales that fall off easily, pale pink or foul-smelling gills, and bloated bellies are signs that the fish is no longer fresh.
Grass carp usually weigh between 2 – 3kg each and are relatively higher in price compared to other types of carp.

mon_an.ten: Roasted Duck Breast with Salted Lime Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: Roasted duck breast with salted lime sauce is likely a familiar dish to many. However, you might wonder how to make it delicious, flavorful, and attractive in both presentation and taste. Today, we will share the secret to making this dish perfectly!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, pepper, peppercorns, cooking oil - seasonings
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the duck breast, pat dry, and marinate with a little salt and pepper. Place the duck breast on a tray with the licorice and roast at 170°C for about 7-10 minutes. (Do not roast for too long or the meat will become dry).
Step 2: Salted lime sauce: Finely blend the salted lime and sauté it. Season with maltose, salt, and pepper to taste.
Step 3: Wash and chop the carrots, asparagus, and perilla leaves. Heat the cooking oil and stir-fry the vegetables until just tender. Add a pinch of salt and peppercorns to taste.
Step 4: Slice the duck breast and arrange it on a plate. Serve with sprouts, stir-fried vegetables, and pickled ginger. Decorate with the roasted rice cracker.

mon_an.ten: Crispy Shrimp Rolls in Tofu Skin
mon_an.mo_ta: Refresh your fried shrimp repertoire with these golden, crispy, and delicious tofu skin shrimp rolls following this recipe.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Black tiger shrimp - 12 pcs (Adjust quantity as desired)
Flour - 1 tbsp (rice flour, all-purpose flour, or cornstarch)
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients: Choose fresh black tiger shrimp of uniform size. Wash, remove heads, peel (leave the tails on for presentation), and remove the black veins. Set aside.

In a bowl, combine 3 tbsp chili sauce, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1/2 tbsp vinegar, 1 tbsp sesame oil, 1 tbsp sugar, 3 cloves of minced garlic, the zest and juice of 1/2 lemon, 1/2 tsp pepper, and 1/2 tsp salt. Mix well. You can adjust the seasonings to your taste.
Add the peeled shrimp to the bowl, toss well, and let marinate for 15-30 minutes to absorb the flavors.

While the shrimp is marinating, soak the tofu skin in water until soft. Remove and pat dry (to prevent oil splattering during frying). Cut the tofu skin into right-angled triangles. Place a shrimp on a piece of tofu skin, fold the top edge over, and roll it up as shown in the image.
Mix the flour with a little water to create a paste. Apply a bit of this paste to the edge of the tofu skin to seal the roll securely.
Heat oil in a deep pan or small pot. Once hot, slowly drop each tofu skin shrimp roll in and fry until golden brown and crispy.
Remove the shrimp and place them on a plate lined with paper towels to drain excess oil. Arrange on a serving plate and enjoy.

mon_an.mo_ta: This braised fish dish features the pungent, slightly bitter taste of chive bulbs combined with the rich, spicy flavor of the fish. Braised hemibagrus with chive bulbs is truly a unique and flavorful dish for the family!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Minced shallot and garlic, green onions
Salt, sugar, pepper, annatto oil, fish sauce, cooking oil, MSG
cac_buoc: Step 1: Preparation:

Slice the fish into 2cm thick pieces. Cut the pork belly into finger-sized strips. Marinate the fish and pork with: 1 tbsp minced shallot and garlic, 1/2 tbsp sugar, 3 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp MSG, 2 tbsp annatto oil, and 1 tbsp crushed chive bulbs. Let sit for 10 minutes.
Slice the pineapple into 5mm thick pieces. Cut the horn chili into diamonds, crush the bird's eye chilies, and cut the green onions into segments.
Step 2: Cooking:

Make a caramel sauce with 1 tbsp oil and 2 tbsp sugar. Sauté 1 tbsp of chive bulbs until fragrant. Add the fish and pork, searing until firm. Add the pineapple, chilies, crushed black pepper, and 1/2 cup coconut water. Simmer over low heat without a lid. Occasionally turn the fish for even cooking. Braise until the sauce thickens slightly. Turn off the heat, then garnish with green onions and diamond-cut horn chili.
Step 3: Serving:
Serve with hot steamed rice. Accompany with fresh vegetables and cucumber.
Small tips:
Hemibagrus is quite slimy and has a characteristic fishy smell, so it should be treated with lemon juice (or vinegar), the skin scraped, and rinsed multiple times with cold water.
Braising without a lid makes the fish firm, but remember to turn the fish so it absorbs the seasonings evenly.

mon_an.ten: Steamed Octopus with Ginger and Green Onions
mon_an.mo_ta: Steamed octopus with ginger and green onions – a chance for home cooks to show off their skills by making a great snack for the gentlemen. Learn to cook this delicious dish featuring authentic Vietnamese flavors.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, fish sauce, garlic, chili, sugar
