cac_buoc: Step 1: Remove the ink sac from the octopus. Rub thoroughly with salt to remove the fishy smell and slime. Let sit for 5 minutes then rinse well with water.
Step 2:
Peel and wash the ginger, then julienne into fine strips.
Trim the roots and old leaves from the green onions. Split the white parts lengthwise and cut the rest into segments.
Step 3: Steam the octopus, green onions, and ginger over boiling water. It is best to keep the octopus whole to maintain its sweetness and crunch.
Step 4:
Once the octopus turns a darker color, it is cooked. Remove to a cutting board and slice into bite-sized pieces. The dish is now complete.

Prepare a thick dipping sauce: Mince the garlic and chili with a little sugar in a mortar and pestle. Transfer to a bowl, then add fish sauce and a bit of filtered water. This creates a very delicious, thick dipping sauce.

mon_an.ten: Thai-style Stir-fried Cabbage with Beef and Tomato
mon_an.mo_ta: Thai-style stir-fried cabbage with beef and tomato is an interesting new addition to the Vietnamese meal. With a unique preparation method that ensures both delicious flavor and nutrition, this dish features the natural sweetness of cabbage and the savory taste of beef. Ladies, get your pens and paper ready to note down this new recipe!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fish sauce, salt, seasoning powder, pepper, cooking oil
cac_buoc: Step 1: Thinly shred the cabbage and soak in diluted salt water for about 15 minutes to keep it crisp. Drain in a colander.
Step 2: Roast the peanuts until golden, remove skins, and crush coarsely. Wash the tomato and cut into wedges; set aside. Wash the green onions, remove wilted parts, and chop finely.
Step 3: Mix the ground beef with a small teaspoon of salt, minced garlic, and a bit of oil for a glossy finish. Let marinate for 30 minutes.

Step 4: Start the cooking process for the Thai-style stir-fried cabbage and beef. Place a pan on the stove, add a little oil, then add the tomato wedges with a pinch of salt. Sauté until the tomatoes soften.
Step 5: Next, add the beef to the pan and stir-fry briefly to combine with the tomatoes.

Step 6: Finally, add the cabbage, turmeric powder, and seasonings to the pan. Stir well and cover with a lid. Cook for about 10 minutes until the cabbage is tender. Sprinkle with green onions and stir again. Turn off the heat and serve in a bowl while hot.

mon_an.mo_ta: Cabbage rolls with shrimp are very easy to make and visually stunning. This dish is guaranteed to enrich your family meal.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Round cabbage leaves - 4 leaves (adjust quantity as needed)
Seasoning - a bit of wine, soy sauce
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Trim the base of the 4 cabbage leaves, keeping them about 6-7cm long. Cut the carrot into small matchsticks, about 4-5cm long.
Peel and devein the shrimp, wash them, and marinate with a little wine to remove the fishy odor.
Step 2:
Boil a small pot of water. Blanch the cabbage leaves briefly until soft, then remove to a colander. Do not overcook them, or they will be difficult to roll.
Next, blanch the carrots briefly and then plunge them into cold water to maintain their vibrant color.
Finally, blanch the cilantro stems briefly so they become soft and pliable.
Step 3:
Lay a cabbage leaf flat, place one shrimp and 2-3 carrot sticks on top. Roll tightly and tie with a cilantro stem. Repeat until all shrimp and cabbage are used.
Step 4:
Once finished, arrange the cabbage rolls on a plate. Place in a steamer for about 10 minutes. Remove and serve hot with chili soy sauce or prepared fish sauce.
Good luck and enjoy your meal!

mon_an.mo_ta: Tofu and pork patties are a rustic, delicious, and visually appealing dish with a golden-brown color. The patties are soft, fresh, and well-seasoned, perfectly complemented by a sweet and sour dipping sauce. With just a little time and familiar ingredients, you can create this wonderful dish for family and friends.
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients for the delicious fried tofu and pork patties:
Wash the pork thoroughly, drain, and mince finely. Alternatively, you can buy pre-ground pork.
Trim the roots and wilted leaves from the green onions, wash, and chop finely.
Peel the carrot, wash, and dice into very small cubes.
Rinse the white tofu with water, drain, and mash finely.
Peel the garlic, wash, and mince.
Peel the onion, wash, and dice into small cubes.
How to make fried tofu and pork patties:
Step 1:
First, combine the pork, tofu, onion, garlic, green onion, carrot, salt, soy sauce, pepper, sesame oil, and 1 egg in a large bowl.
Mix the mixture thoroughly until all ingredients are well combined.
Step 2:
Next, divide the mixture into 16 portions. Roll each into a ball and then flatten slightly into a patty shape.
Step 3:
Coat each patty with flour and place on a plate.
Step 4:
In a separate bowl, whisk together 1 egg, 1 egg yolk, and a small pinch of salt until well blended.
Step 5:
Place a pan on the stove over medium heat and add the cooking oil.
Dip each patty into the egg wash and then place in the pan to fry.
Fry for about 1 minute per side or until the patties turn golden brown and are cooked through. Add more oil if necessary to prevent burning.
Step 6:
Once cooked, remove the patties and place them on paper towels to drain excess oil. Arrange on a plate. Serve the tofu and pork patties with chili sauce or sweet and sour fish sauce.
Tips for delicious fried tofu and pork patties:

You can keep the fried patties in the freezer for several days and re-fry them before eating. If making them in advance, just fry them lightly first, then fry them again when ready to serve for a better taste.
You can make the patties less salty to serve them as a savory pancake snack.
You can prepare a dipping sauce to your liking, such as soy sauce, chili sauce, or any other favorite condiment.

Tofu and pork patties are a rustic and delicious dish that attracts everyone with its golden appearance and savory aroma. The texture is soft and fresh, soaking up the seasonings and the sweet-sour fish sauce. With just a bit of effort using common ingredients, you have a great dish to treat your loved ones. Everyone will surely enjoy it and give you many compliments.

mon_an.mo_ta: Bò cuốn lá lốt is a delicious and easy-to-make dish, perfect for a mid-week family meal. Learn how to make this unique version of beef wrapped in wild betel leaves.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Diced pork fat - a small amount
Oyster sauce, sesame oil, sugar, salt, seasoning powder, pepper
Wild betel leaves (lá lốt) - washed and drained
cac_buoc: Step 1: Mix all ingredients together: ground beef, pork fat, minced lemongrass, shallots, fresh milk, cornstarch, oyster sauce, sesame oil, salt, sugar, seasoning powder, and pepper. Mix thoroughly and refrigerate for about 2 hours or overnight.

Step 2: Lay a wild betel leaf flat with the shiny side facing down. Place a portion of the meat mixture on the leaf and roll it up. Secure with a toothpick to prevent it from opening. Heat oil in a pan; once hot, fry the rolls until golden brown and cooked through.

Step 3: Remove the rolls and place them on a plate lined with paper towels to absorb excess oil. This dish can be served with vermicelli, various fresh herbs, or wrapped in rice paper according to your preference.
Source: Ngoi sao

mon_an.mo_ta: When the weather is cool, there's nothing better than the whole family gathering around a steaming pot of broth to dip, roll, and eat! Let's make it right now!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Pineapple, green banana, carrot, cucumber - as needed
Lemongrass, lettuce, mint, cilantro, bean sprouts, etc. - as needed
Sugar, salt, fish sauce - as needed
Lemon, garlic, chili, onion - as needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the beef and slice it very thinly. You can marinate it with a bit of seasoning, ginger, and garlic. Arrange on a plate.
Step 2: Wash all the vegetables and fruits. Place the vegetables in a colander to drain. Peel the fruits and cut them into strips about the size of a chopstick and 5cm long. Arrange on a plate.

Step 3: Cut the vermicelli into manageable pieces and place on a plate. Prepare the dipping sauce with the ratio: 1 part fish sauce + 1.5 parts sugar + lemon juice for a light sourness + minced garlic and chili. Mix well.

Step 4: Prepare the vinegar broth in a hot pot: Blend 1/4 of a pineapple and strain for the juice. Pour the juice into the pot, add about two bowls of bone broth (or water), the coconut water, 1 chopped onion, and 1/3 bowl of vinegar. Season with a bit of fish sauce and salt. Bring to a boil, then adjust the vinegar and seasonings for a balanced sweet and sour taste. Add two crushed lemongrass stalks.
Step 5: Enjoy the Bò Nhúng Dấm: Dip the beef into the boiling broth until cooked, then use rice paper to roll the beef with the vegetables and fruits. Dip into the sauce and eat with vermicelli!

mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried snails with bamboo shoots is a very rustic dish loved by many families. The snails are crunchy and well-seasoned, paired with slightly sour-sweet bamboo shoots and the aroma of wild betel leaves and perilla. Check out the recipe below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings - Shallots, chili, wild betel leaves, perilla, salt, seasoning powder, vinegar, cooking oil, turmeric powder
cac_buoc: Step 1: After buying the snails, wash them and soak them in water with 2 chopped chilies so they release all slime and dirt.

Step 2: Wash the snails again. Use a knife to cut off the tail end, then use a sharp tip to pry the mouth and extract the snail meat. Remember to remove the black digestive part, keeping only the head. Rub the snail meat with a bit of salt and vinegar to clean the slime and grit, then rinse with cold water and drain.
Step 3: Marinate the snail meat with seasoning powder and a bit of turmeric powder (or turmeric juice) for 10-15 minutes.
Step 4: Slice the tofu into pieces. Trim and wash the wild betel leaves and perilla, then chop finely. Peel, wash, and mince the shallots.
Step 5: Trim the tough parts of the bamboo shoots, shred them into strips, and blanch briefly with a bit of salt. Rinse thoroughly with cold water and drain.
Step 6: Heat 1 tbsp of oil in a pan. When very hot, sauté the minced shallots until fragrant, then add the snails and stir-fry until cooked. Transfer the snails to a separate plate.
Step 7: In the same pan, add 1-2 tbsp of oil. When hot, add the bamboo shoots and stir-fry until firm. Add the tofu and stir well, seasoning to taste.
Next, return the cooked snails to the pan with the bamboo shoots. Stir for another minute, then turn off the heat. Add the chopped wild betel leaves, perilla, and a few chili slices, tossing quickly.
Finally, arrange the dish on a plate and enjoy while hot.
How to choose good snails:
Choose live snails to ensure freshness. A simple way to tell is to touch the operculum (trapdoor); if it retracts deeply, the snail is alive.
Dead snails have a foul smell and the operculum is pulled far inside. You can also test by dropping them in water; if the tail floats upward and it feels light, it is dead and should be discarded.

Choose plump snails for a crunchy and rich taste. Plump snails have the operculum close to the edge, while thin ones have it recessed. Conversely, for small snails (ốc hương), smaller ones are often more fragrant.
Tips for cleaning snails:
Soak in rice water: Soak for 2-3 hours; the snails will release slime and dirt. Then just rinse a few times with clean water.
Soak with a knife: Drop a small metal knife into the soaking water. The smell of the metal stimulates the snails to release mud and dirt faster and more thoroughly.
You can also soak snails in water mixed with vinegar and minced fresh chili for 2-3 hours. However, snails cleaned this way should be cooked immediately to maintain freshness.

Note: If you want to keep the shells for stuffing, do not crush the tail because the juices will leak out during steaming. Use a small knife to gently pry the mouth, use a chopstick to push the meat in slightly, then shake the snail vigorously. The meat will fall out. Discard the muddy end part. Rub the remaining meat with vinegar and rinse with cold water.

mon_an.mo_ta: A light and refreshing soup featuring tender pork, crunchy enoki mushrooms, and green onions in a clear, savory broth.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients for the meat and mushroom soup:
Wash the pork belly with salt to remove odors, then rinse with clean water.
Trim the roots of the enoki mushrooms and wash them under the tap. Be gentle to avoid crushing the mushrooms.
Trim the roots and wilted leaves from the green onions, wash, and chop finely.
Step 2: Cooking steps:
First, place a pot on the stove and bring some filtered water to a boil.
Once boiling, blanch the pork briefly, then remove and set aside to drain.
Discard the blanching water, rinse the pot, and add fresh filtered water.
Add the meat seasoning packet to the pot and stir until dissolved.
Add the enoki mushrooms and the pork to the pot. As soon as the water returns to a boil, turn off the heat immediately and sprinkle in the green onions.
Finally, ladle the soup into a bowl and serve hot.
Tips for a delicious meat and mushroom soup:
Blanching the pork first helps keep the broth clear and free of impurities. This is also a necessary step to ensure the meat is clean.

Since we are using a seasoning packet, the broth is already flavorful. If you use too much water, you may need to adjust the seasoning. A standard serving is measured by the size of your large soup bowl.
Choose fresh pork belly with a bright pink color and no odor. If you prefer less fat, you can use lean pork. Beef is also a great alternative that pairs well with this soup.

When cooking, turn off the heat as soon as it boils and open the lid, as enoki mushrooms cook very quickly and can become mushy. The thinly sliced pork is also already partially cooked from blanching.
When buying mushrooms, pay attention to the origin and expiration date.

If you are concerned about a fishy smell, after blanching the meat, you can sauté it briefly with a bit of fish sauce and seasoning before adding the water. Once the water boils and the meat is cooked, add the enoki mushrooms, let it boil again, then turn off the heat and add green onions. With this method, you don't need the seasoning packet.
Meat and mushroom soup with fresh pork and crunchy enoki mushrooms is a light, refreshing dish that provides a gentle and comforting feeling when enjoyed hot!

mon_an.mo_ta: Phở chiên phồng delights diners with fresh rice noodle sheets deep-fried until crispy and puffed, served with savory beef and greens for a naturally sweet and satisfying taste. This nutritious dish provides everything you need for a productive day. Your family and friends will surely be impressed by your culinary skills once they taste this delicious meal. Discover how to make it with our guide below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Baby bok choy or sprouts - 1 bunch
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients for the phở chiên phồng:
Rinse the beef, drain well, and slice thinly.
Marinate the beef with 2 tsp of salt. Mix well so the beef absorbs the seasoning.
Wash all vegetables. Peel the tomatoes and onions, rinse, and cut into wedges. Carve the carrots into flowers and slice thinly; cut the celery and leeks into 2-inch pieces.
Peel the garlic, rinse, and mince finely.
Steps to make phở chiên phồng for 4 people:
Step 1: First, take a stack of rice noodle sheets about 1cm thick and use scissors to cut them into 3cm squares.

Step 2: Place a pan over medium heat, add the crushed garlic and sauté quickly. When fragrant, add the beef and stir-fry until it is no longer red, then remove to a bowl. Note: do not overcook the beef or it will become tough.
Step 3: Next, stir-fry the greens, season with salt, add the juices from the sautéed beef, and cook until tender, then remove to a bowl.

Step 4: Stir-fry the carrots for about 2 minutes, then add the tomatoes and onions and stir for another 1 minute. Finally, add the celery, leeks, and a bit of oyster sauce, stir-frying quickly over high heat. Transfer to the bowl with the sautéed beef.

Step 5: Take a deep pot and add oil to a depth of 4-5cm. Once the oil is hot, drop the cut noodle squares in; they will begin to puff up on both sides. When they are golden and crispy, quickly remove them and place on paper towels to drain.
Step 6: Finally, arrange the fried rice noodles on a plate, pour the stir-fried beef and vegetables over the top, and enjoy.
Tips for delicious phở chiên phồng
Do not use a knife to cut the rice noodles; using a knife can cause the edges to stick together and prevent them from puffing properly.
Stir-fry the vegetables in order: those that take longer to cook should go in first to ensure everything is evenly done.
Phở chiên phồng can be a bit rich; you can serve it with pickled cucumbers to balance the flavors.
Since the beef is already seasoned, only add a tiny bit of seasoning when stir-frying the vegetables to avoid making the dish too salty.
When frying the noodles, remember to flip them so both sides cook evenly and reach a beautiful golden color.

With familiar ingredients and a little time in the kitchen, you can create this fragrant phở chiên phồng. It attracts everyone with its fresh noodles, crispy golden crust, and the natural sweetness of beef and greens. This dish offers full nutrition for an effective workday. Everyone will praise this wonderful meal and your excellent cooking skills.

mon_an.mo_ta: Fried chicken rice is a simple, delicious, and nutritious lunch option that is easy to prepare. Let's get into the kitchen and make this dish right away. Today's article will guide you through making super attractive fried chicken rice at home!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning - Soy sauce, salt, sugar, oyster sauce, white wine
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Wash the chicken and use scissors to cut down the middle, along the bone.
Step 2:
Carefully debone the chicken thighs.
Step 3:
Use a knife or a meat mallet to pound the chicken until tender.
Step 4:
Place the chicken in a large bowl, add sliced ginger, white wine, oyster sauce, salt, sugar, and soy sauce, then mix well.
Step 5:
Marinate the chicken for about 30 minutes to allow the flavors to penetrate.
Step 6:
Prepare a pan with hot oil, then add the chicken and fry until it turns golden brown.
Step 7:
Flip the chicken over and fry until both sides are evenly golden.
Step 8:
Slice the chicken into bite-sized pieces, and blanch the carrots and broccoli to serve on the side.
Add a bowl of hot rice and you have a fully nutritious and quick meal!
When frying the chicken, remember to turn it frequently so it cooks evenly!
The longer you marinate the chicken, the tastier it will be!

mon_an.mo_ta: In traditional cuisine, taro is considered a balanced, sweet, and highly nutritious food. When prepared with pork, it creates a unique yet incredibly delicious flavor. Quickly add this dish to your recipe notebook!
cac_buoc: Let's start making this savory Steamed Pork with Taro!
Step 1: Peel the taro carefully and cut into bite-sized pieces or 1cm thick batons. Wash and finely mince the green onions and ginger.
Step 2: Slice the pork belly into small pieces across the grain.
Step 3: Mix the pork belly thoroughly with the minced green onions and ginger.
Let's move on to the next steps!
Step 4: Add the taro to the pork mixture, then add soy sauce, sesame oil, and star anise. Mix well and marinate for about 30 minutes so the pork and taro absorb the flavors.
Step 5: Once marinated, arrange the pork slices and taro pieces alternately in a dish. Steam in a steamer over high heat for about 1 hour.
Enjoy the result with a bowl of hot white rice or as an interesting snack.

mon_an.mo_ta: What could be better than making a light and sweet Bún sườn non for the whole family to enjoy on the weekend? This dish features a naturally sweet broth cooked with fresh vegetables to enrich your meal. It is a simple yet satisfying noodle soup.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the pork ribs and parboil them in water to remove impurities. When the water boils, turn off the heat, discard the water, and rinse the ribs again.

Step 2: Peel and wash the pumpkin, then cut into bite-sized pieces. Remove the eyes from the pineapple, wash, and slice. Peel the onion and cut into large wedges. Wash the dried lily flowers, soak until expanded, trim the ends, and soak in diluted salt water. Wash and finely chop the lettuce and cilantro.
Step 3: Place the ribs in a large pot, add water and the onion, and bring to a boil. Add 1 tbsp of salt and a small piece of rock sugar, then simmer for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
Step 4: Add the pineapple and lily flowers to the broth. Simmer for another 15 minutes, then add the pumpkin. Adjust the seasoning to taste.
Step 5: When all ingredients are cooked, turn off the heat and add green onions to the pot. To serve, place vermicelli in a bowl, ladle the broth, ribs, and vegetables over it, and eat while hot.
And that concludes the cooking of our light and sweet Bún sườn non.

mon_an.mo_ta: Salmon is a premium ingredient that can be used in many attractive dishes. We recommend these Grilled Salmon Vegetable Rolls. They aren't difficult to make, look very colorful, and taste amazing. Let's check out the recipe.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Red, green, and yellow bell peppers - 1 each
Black pepper, salt, olive oil - A pinch
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Wash the vegetables and drain well.
Finely slice the mushrooms and bell peppers, then place them in a bowl. Toss with black pepper, seasoning powder, and a bit of salt so they are well-seasoned for grilling.
You can adjust the types of vegetables according to your preference.
Step 2:
Slice the salmon into long, thin strips for easy rolling.
Lay each salmon slice out and brush both sides with oil.
Place a piece of each vegetable on the salmon and gently roll it up. Note: roll tightly to prevent the vegetables from falling out.
The colors of the salmon rolls look very appetizing like this.
Repeat until all salmon and vegetables are used.
Step 3:
Grill the salmon vegetable rolls.
Oven roasting: Preheat the oven to 200°C for 5-10 minutes. Place the salmon in and roast at 180°C for 15 minutes (use top and bottom heat for even cooking). Watch the oven to avoid overcooking.
Charcoal grilling: Arrange the rolls on a grill grate over hot coals. Monitor and flip them regularly until cooked through.
The result should look like the picture. Doesn't it look mouth-watering? 😀
Once the rolls are fragrant and cooked, sprinkle with roasted sesame seeds for a nutty, attractive finish.
This dish is best served hot with green wasabi and soy sauce with fresh chili!
Grilled Salmon Vegetable Rolls are easy to make, fragrant, and uniquely delicious. Make them for your friends and family to enjoy.

mon_an.mo_ta: Try a new twist on crispy fried fish. The fish is fried until crunchy on the outside while remaining sweet and tender inside, then stir-fried with aromatic bell peppers in a rich sweet and sour sauce. This dish will make everyone in the family want seconds. Learn to cook this delicious meal today. If your kids aren't fans of fish, this sweet and sour version will definitely have them competing for the last bite. Get your pen and paper ready to note down this easy recipe.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, pepper, seasoning powder, vinegar, oyster sauce
cac_buoc: Step 1: Rinse the fish fillet, cut into bite-sized cubes, and marinate with a little pepper and salt. A longer marinating time will make the fish more flavorful.

Step 2: Wash the bell peppers, remove seeds, and cut into cubes similar in size to the fish. Peel and wash the onion (to reduce eye irritation) and cut into wedges. Wash and finely chop the green onions.
Step 3: Put tapioca starch in a bowl and dredge the fish pieces to coat them with a thin layer. Tapioca starch makes the fish crispier than other types of flour.
Step 4: Use a deep pan to fry the fish until golden brown. Once cooked, remove and place on a plate lined with paper towels.
Step 5: Drain most of the oil from the pan, then sauté the onions followed by the bell peppers. Season with salt and oyster sauce to taste.
Step 6: Add the fried fish back into the pan, add a little vinegar, and adjust the seasoning. When the dish is ready, sprinkle with green onions. The sweet and sour fried fish is now complete.

mon_an.mo_ta: Enjoy the flavor of this curry with grilled chicken just once, and you'll remember it forever!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning: salt, pepper, dried rosemary (optional), cooking oil
cac_buoc: Are you ready to start making this attractive curry with grilled chicken?
Let's begin with the instructions below!
Step 1:
The first step is to prepare the ingredients!
Peel the potatoes, onion, and pumpkin, then cut them into small squares as shown in the picture!
Step 2:
Place a pan on the stove, add oil and heat until hot. Add some onion and sauté until fragrant.
Next, add the chopped thigh meat and stir-fry with the onion until fragrant.
Now, add all the prepared vegetables and stir-fry everything together for about 2 minutes so they cook evenly.
After that, pour in enough water to just cover the ingredients and simmer over low heat for 15 minutes until everything is tender.
Step 3:
While waiting, take the time to prepare the curry base!
It's very simple: just mix the curry powder with hot water and stir with a spoon until it forms a thick paste as shown in the picture.
Step 4:
Add the curry mixture to the pot, bring to a boil for a few more moments, then turn off the heat.
Step 5:
Marinate the chicken breasts with melted butter, salt, pepper, and rosemary.
Step 6:
Grill the chicken on a rack until just cooked through and slightly browned as shown.
If you don't want to grill, you can pan-fry the chicken!
It tastes much better when served hot!
Look how attractive it is, let's enjoy it right away!

mon_an.mo_ta: Tired of meat, bánh chưng, and sausages all week? Change your palate with this savory sauced fish that goes perfectly with rice!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Peas, corn, diced carrots (mixed in a small bowl)
Sauce: 3 tbsp tomato sauce, 2 tbsp apple cider vinegar, 1 tbsp white wine, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp salt
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Clean the fish scales and score a few diagonal lines on both sides to help the seasoning penetrate easily.
Step 2:
Sprinkle a little salt and wine on both sides of the fish, making sure to get it into the scores so the flavor absorbs deeply.
Step 3:
Crack the egg into a bowl, add 1 tsp cornstarch, 1 tsp flour, and a little water, then mix well.
Step 4:
Coat the fish thoroughly in the egg mixture.
Step 5:
Fry the fish until it is evenly golden brown.
Step 6:
In another small bowl, combine the sauce ingredients and mix well; set aside.
Step 7:
Pour the sauce into a pan and bring to a boil, then add the peas, corn, and carrots. Season with salt and sugar to taste.
Step 8:
Lay a bed of green onions on a plate, place the fish on top, and pour the sauce over it.
Now it's time to enjoy! Remember to coat the fish evenly with the sauce so the flavors soak in before eating!

mon_an.mo_ta: Thai-style fried beef is delicious, crispy on the outside, and tender and sweet on the inside—it sounds irresistible. It doesn't take much time; just about 30 minutes in the kitchen and you'll have a unique Thai-style fried beef dish for your family. Let's learn how to make it.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning, pepper, dried shallots and garlic, cilantro, chili powder, satay sauce
cac_buoc: After preparing all the ingredients, let's start the process:
Clean the beef, remove any silver skin or tendons, cut into 2cm thick slices, and pound until tender.
Peel and mince the shallots and garlic. Crush and mince the lemongrass.
Marinate the beef: add the minced shallots, garlic, and lemongrass, then add 1 tbsp coconut milk, 1 tbsp satay sauce, a bit of chili powder, pepper, and seasoning.
Mix well and let it marinate for 15-20 minutes.
Beat the egg and mix it into the marinated beef.
Add the frying flour and toss until the beef is well coated.
Dredge each piece in panko breadcrumbs.
Deep-fry the beef in hot oil.
While frying, flip the meat pieces so they cook evenly.
Fry until the meat is golden, then remove to a plate (or rack) lined with paper towels.
Note: beef cooks very quickly, so do not fry for more than 2-3 minutes. If left too long, the dish may become dry and tough.
Finally, slice into smaller pieces and arrange on a decorative plate. When sliced, the beef should be golden brown on the outside but still slightly pink on the inside to meet the standard.
You have now completed the Thai-style fried beef, featuring the tender sweetness of the meat, the richness of coconut milk, and the signature spicy kick of Thai cuisine.

mon_an.mo_ta: This sesame fried beef dish, with its attractive golden-brown color and fragrant spices, will make your family meals even better as the weather starts to turn cold. Let's explore the recipe for this enticing Sesame Fried Beef.
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients (Serves 4)
Cut the beef into 1.5cm cubes.
Marinate with 1 tbsp cornstarch and 2 tbsp soy sauce for about 20 minutes to absorb the flavors.
In a small bowl, mix 1 tbsp chili powder (adjust to your spice tolerance; Korean chili powder works well), 1 tsp salt, 1 tbsp ground cumin, and some white sesame seeds.
Divide this spice mixture in half: mix one half with the beef and keep the other half separate.
2. Execution:
Use sharp toothpicks to skewer each piece of beef.
Heat a pan with enough oil for deep-frying. Once the oil is hot, drop the beef skewers in to fry. Lower the heat so the meat browns evenly.
Fry the meat for about 2 minutes, then remove to a basket lined with paper towels to drain excess oil.
Transfer the beef to a bowl and toss well with the remaining spice mixture (chili powder + cumin + sesame seeds + salt).
Then, return the beef to the hot pan and fry for 1 more minute before removing to drain.
Serve the sesame fried beef on a plate garnished with fresh greens.
The greens serve as both decoration and a side to make the dish tastier.
Sesame fried beef is a savory dish perfect for cold days, with golden-brown skewers that are fragrant with cumin and rich with the nutty taste of roasted sesame.

mon_an.mo_ta: The combination of beef and shrimp creates an incredibly attractive and wonderful dish. Grilled beef-wrapped shrimp, with tender beef on the outside and firm, sweet shrimp inside, will be a captivating highlight for your party table or family meal. Follow the recipe below to add this delicious dish to your repertoire!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Beef tenderloin (tender and better for grilling) - 300g
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Wash the beef and place it in the freezer for about 5 minutes to firm up, making it easier to slice.
Slice into thin pieces about 0.5 cm thick; this makes rolling the shrimp easier and ensures the beef isn't too thick, which would take longer to cook.

Marinate the beef with two tsp of cooking oil, a little pepper, one tsp of oyster sauce, one tsp of white granulated sugar, and half a tsp of seasoning powder. Mix well and let sit for about 30 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Step 2:
Peel the shrimp, leaving the tails intact. Remove the black veins on the back, wash thoroughly, and pat dry.
Marinate the shrimp in a bowl with a little salt and pepper.
Step 3:
Spread the beef slices out on a clean cutting board.
Step 4:
Place a shrimp on each beef slice and roll it up tightly by hand.
Repeat until all shrimp and beef are used.
Step 5:
Finely chop the green onions and mix them in a small bowl with a little cooking oil and oyster sauce.
Step 6:
Heat a charcoal grill if available, or use an oven preheated to 180°C for 5-10 minutes.
Arrange the beef-wrapped shrimp on dong leaves or green banana leaves (if available), then place them on the grill rack.
Grill over charcoal or place in the oven.
Step 7:
Grilling over charcoal: Occasionally brush the prepared scallion oil mixture onto the surface of the meat. Flip the rolls regularly and continue brushing with oil.
Watch the grill and flip both sides so the shrimp-wrapped beef cooks evenly from the inside out.

If using an oven: Bake for about 5 minutes, then remove to brush with the scallion oil mixture. Return to the oven and continue baking until the surface is evenly cooked. Monitor the oven to time the cooking of the beef outside and the shrimp inside.
Once the grilled beef-wrapped shrimp is cooked, remove and serve hot. It is delicious when paired with chili sauce and cucumber.

mon_an.mo_ta: Check out this delicious cured salmon recipe below to bring a new flavor to your family meals!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Juice from ½ lemon (lime can be substituted)
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Spread plastic wrap over a tray. Make sure to use multiple layers!
Step 2:
Wash the salmon, pat it dry, and place it on the plastic-lined tray.
Step 3:
Mix the wine and lemon juice together, then drizzle over the salmon.
Step 4:
Next, finely zest the lemon and sprinkle it over the fish.
Step 5:
Season the salmon with salt, sugar, pepper, and coriander seeds.
Step 6:
Finally, spread the finely chopped dill all over the salmon.
Step 7:
Wrap the salmon very tightly with the plastic wrap.
Step 8:

Place a heavy object on top of the fish and store it in the refrigerator for at least 5 hours; 3 days is best for flavor. You can use two wooden cutting boards wrapped in plastic to press the fish tightly during the curing process.
Remove the excess seasoning from the fish and slice the salmon very thinly before serving!
This Gravlax dish looks beautiful, doesn't it?
Enjoy this cured salmon with bread!

mon_an.mo_ta: Salmon with lemon sauce is a delicious way to prepare salmon. The method is not difficult, and the eye-catching colors and balanced flavors will make you want to eat it again and again. Here is the guide to making this super delicious honey lemon salmon.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Marinate the salmon with a little salt and pepper. Let it sit for at least 15 minutes to absorb the seasoning.
Step 2:
Heat a non-stick pan with a little olive oil. Place the salmon in the pan to sear, skin-side down first.
Sear the skin side for about 5 minutes; keep the heat low and watch carefully to prevent burning.
Next, flip to the other side and sear for about 2 minutes, then turn off the heat.
Remove the seared salmon and place it on a plate.
Step 3:
Wash the pan used for frying with hot water until clean.
Add butter and honey to the hot pan, then add the soy sauce.
Step 4:
Squeeze the two lemons to get the juice, removing any seeds.
Pour the lemon juice into the pan with the butter, honey, and soy sauce. Simmer and stir the mixture over medium heat for a few minutes until the sauce thickens slightly.
Taste the sauce and adjust the seasoning to suit your preference.
Step 5:
Place the seared salmon back into the pan with the sauce. Spoon the sauce over the fish and simmer briefly so the salmon absorbs the honey lemon sauce.
Step 6:
Honey lemon salmon is best served hot with steamed rice.
Presentation: Serve hot rice on a plate, place the salmon on top, drizzle with extra sauce, and sprinkle with a little chopped cilantro. Enjoy!

Salmon is considered a superfood with high levels of protein and easily absorbable amino acids, which are great for the cardiovascular system and reducing stroke risk. On a weekend evening, head to the kitchen to make this quick and attractive honey lemon salmon for the whole family to enjoy.

mon_an.mo_ta: Chả cá Lã Vọng is a famous Hanoi delicacy. The fish usually used is hemibagrus (cá lăng), a sweet and delicious fish with few bones. Preparing delicious Chả cá Lã Vọng is not difficult; let's explore the recipe together.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 4 tbsp fermented rice (mẻ), 1 tbsp shrimp paste, 2 tbsp sugar, 1/4 tsp turmeric powder
cac_buoc: Prepare all ingredients:
Step 1:
Strain the fermented rice (mẻ) to get the smooth liquid.
Step 2:
Prepare the fish, pat it dry with a towel, and cut into bite-sized pieces. Be sure to keep the fish fat!
Step 3:
Marinate the fish with galangal and the prepared seasonings for 30 minutes to 1 hour.
Step 4:
While waiting, thinly slice the shallots. Keep the dill sprigs whole or cut them into long segments.
Step 5:
Grill the fish over charcoal until both sides are slightly charred.
If the fish looks dry while grilling, brush on a little cooking oil to keep the pieces tender!
Step 6:
Put the fish fat in a pan and fry until it completely melts.
Step 7:
Add the grilled fish to the pan of melted fat.
Quickly add the dill and shallots, tossing gently, and it's ready to eat.
Chả cá Lã Vọng is best enjoyed immediately while hot!
Add some whole roasted peanuts, serve with vermicelli and a bit of shrimp paste mixed with lime and sugar until frothy for a truly delicious Chả cá Lã Vọng experience.

mon_an.mo_ta: Mackerel fish cakes feature a beautiful golden exterior and fresh, flavorful fish inside. Infused with characteristic aromas and seasonings, they are delicious when served with sweet and sour fish sauce or chili sauce.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings - Seasoning powder, salt, fish sauce, pepper, MSG
cac_buoc: HOW TO MAKE MACKEREL FISH CAKES
Step 1: Wash the mackerel with salt and rinse again with clean water. Use a knife to fillet the fish, removing the bones, then use a spoon to scrape the meat into a bowl.
Step 2: Next, add the ground pork to the fish and marinate with a little fish sauce, seasoning powder, sugar, and pepper. Mix well and let sit for 15 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Step 3: Peel the shallots, remove the roots, wash, and mince finely.
Clean the green onions and dill, removing roots and wilted leaves, wash, and chop finely.
Step 4: Once marinated, put the fish mixture into a blender. Add the minced shallots and 1-2 tbsp of cooking oil, then cover and blend until smooth.
Step 5: Add the chopped green onions and dill, then blend for a few more pulses until the ingredients are well combined, then turn off the machine.

Step 6: Once the fish is finely ground, take small portions and roll them into balls, then flatten them into patties. Place the fish cakes in a steamer and steam for about 15 minutes until just cooked. Turn off the heat and let them cool slightly.

Step 7: Heat a pan on the stove with a few tablespoons of cooking oil. When the oil is hot, add the steamed fish cakes and fry until both sides are golden brown. Remove and place on paper towels to drain excess oil.
Finally, arrange the fish cakes on a plate and enjoy.
How to choose fresh mackerel: To select good mackerel, keep these points in mind:
Mouth: A fresh fish will have its mouth closed, not open; stale fish is the opposite.
Eyes: Fresh fish eyes are slightly bulging, transparent, and the cornea is elastic. Stale fish eyes will be sunken, cloudy, torn, and lack elasticity.
Gills: Fresh mackerel gills are bright pinkish-red, stick closely together, and have no slime or foul odor. Stale gills are dull red (turning gray), separated, and smell bad.

Body: Mackerel is different from some other fish as it has no scales. Pay attention to the skin color. Fresh skin is shimmering silver with patterns; it should feel elastic when pressed. Stale fish skin is scratched, soft, dull, and leaves an indentation when pressed.
How to choose fish not treated with Urea
If the icing process isn't cold enough, fish easily becomes stale and soft. To keep it longer, some traders use Urea. Choosing fish without Urea is more difficult.

Urea-treated fish looks very fresh, with clear eyes and brighter red gills than usual, but the body feels soft when pressed and lacks elasticity. It will have a strange chemical smell rather than the characteristic fishy scent.

mon_an.mo_ta: Chả rươi features an eye-catching color and delicious flavor. When eaten, the exterior is crispy while the interior is savory, infused with seasonings and a natural sweetness that delights the palate.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Green onions, dill, fresh chili - seasonings
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, wash the tangerine and let it dry. Peel the tangerine and let the peel dry out slightly. This makes the peel more fragrant and less bitter.
Step 2:
Next, finely mince the tangerine peel (the finer the better).
Clean the green onions and dill, removing roots and wilted leaves, then wash, drain, and chop finely.
Wash the fresh chili and mince it.
Step 3:
Prepare a large bowl of cold water and drop the sandworms in to wash. Then, lift them out and drain.
Step 4:

Next, heat water until very hot (about 70°C, do not boil), then pour it over the sandworms to clean them. Use chopsticks to stir very gently to clean! Be careful not to stir vigorously or the sandworms will break.
Step 5:
Once cleaned, lift the sandworms out and repeat Step 4 one more time, then drain.
Once cleaned, sandworms can be stored in the freezer for later use!
Step 6:
Next, use chopsticks or a whisk to beat the sandworms until they are broken and mashed.
Step 7:
Mix the mashed sandworms with the tangerine peel, green onions, dill, fresh chili, and a bit of seasoning.
Step 8:
Wash the pork with salt to remove any odor, drain, and grind finely.
Add the pork and egg to the mixture along with a little salt and MSG, then mix well by hand until all ingredients are fully combined.
Step 9:
Heat a pan on the stove, add plenty of oil, and wait until it is very hot, then lower the heat.
Step 10:
Spoon the sandworm mixture into the pan.
Step 11:
Fry until the patties are cooked and golden brown, then flip to cook the other side.
Once cooked, remove and place on paper towels to drain excess oil. Arrange on a plate and serve with sweet and sour dipping sauce or chili sauce.
Tips for delicious Chả rươi: The longer you fry them, the chewier they become, so don't rush. Fry slowly until the crust is golden and slightly crispy.
How to choose fresh sandworms (rươi)

Method 1: Look at the color. This is quite accurate and easy. Fresh sandworms are active, with pink, red, or green colors. Usually, the ones on top are large, plump, and fresh. Those that are pale, small, or weak are stale or dying; they are usually found at the bottom of the basket.

Method 2: Identify by the scent. This is used by many home cooks with high accuracy. If color is hard to judge, smell them. A fresh batch has a pleasant, characteristic fishy scent mixed with fresh silt. If you smell an unpleasant, foul odor, it is a bad batch and should be avoided.

Hanoi's Chả rươi is famous for its delicious, rich flavor that excites all the senses. Besides enjoying it at restaurants, you can try making it simply at home. In the following article, we will share the recipe for delicious Chả rươi.
I. Preparation of ingredients
Sandworms (Rươi): 1 kg
Pork shoulder: 300 g
Eggs: 4 (chicken or duck eggs)
Green onions: 3 stalks
Chili: 2 fruits
Herbs
Lolot leaves
Tangerine peel
Cooking oil
Seasonings: MSG, pepper, salt, seasoning powder, fish sauce
II. Cooking instructions
Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Start by washing all ingredients, then finely chop the herbs, green onions, lolot leaves, and chili.
Next, clean the tangerine peel and slice it into very thin, small shreds.

If using fresh sandworms, place them in a basin of water and wash gently by hand to avoid breaking them. Then, pour hot water (60°C) into the basin and soak. When mud, hair, and legs start to fall off and the sandworms float, scoop them out of the water.
For frozen sandworms, move them from the freezer to the fridge to thaw naturally. Avoid soaking in water or using a microwave to thaw, as this can cause bacterial contamination and be dangerous.
Step 2: Combine sandworms with other ingredients
Once the sandworms are cleaned, place them in a large bowl and add the following seasonings:
1/2 tsp MSG
1/2 tsp pepper
1 tbsp seasoning powder
1 tbsp salt.
Mix the mixture well so the ingredients blend together. Then, add the minced pork, 4 eggs, herbs, tangerine peel, and chopped chili to the bowl. Stir well until all components are evenly combined.
Step 3: Fry the Hanoi Chả rươi
Once the mixture is ready, add 2 tbsp of cooking oil to a pan and heat until the oil is hot.
Then, pour the sandworm mixture into the pan and fry over low heat.
Cover the pan and fry for about 5 – 7 minutes. Fry until the Chả rươi is cooked through and has a beautiful golden color.
Reduce to very low heat, uncover the pan, and continue frying until both sides are golden brown. Then, turn off the heat.
Step 4: Enjoy the Chả rươi

After finishing the cooking process, present the Chả rươi on a plate and serve with herbs. To enjoy the characteristic rich and fragrant flavor, you should eat Chả rươi while it is still hot. With its attractive golden color, Northern-style fried Chả rươi will be a wonderful dish for family meals.
II. Tips for making delicious Chả rươi

The best places to buy sandworms are in Hai Duong, Hai Phong, and Quang Ninh, especially Hai Duong where the sandworms are fatter and larger than in other provinces. To buy good sandworms, you should go to seafood hubs, wholesale markets, or specialty stores in these provinces.
To clean sandworms properly without damaging them:

First, put the sandworms in a basin of cold water and wash gently to remove dirt and debris. Continue washing thoroughly to ensure complete cleanliness. Remove any that have been dead for a long time or are crushed.
Then, lift them out to drain. Next, place the sandworms in a bowl of hot water (about 40°C) to remove the fine hairs. Repeat this process until all hairs are gone.
Note: Wash the sandworms gently; strong pressure can crush them and burst their bellies, ruining the dish.
Safe thawing for frozen sandworms
To safely thaw frozen sandworms, follow these steps:
Move the sandworms from the freezer to the fridge and leave them for about 1 – 2 hours. Observe until they are soft and have a rosy color, then they can be used for cooking.
With this thawing method, the sandworms retain their nutritional value and ensure health safety.
Note:
Do not thaw sandworms using a microwave or by leaving them at room temperature. This can change the temperature too quickly, affecting the quality and potentially losing nutritional value.
III. How to store after cooking Chả rươi
1. Refrigeration
After cooking, if there are leftovers, store the Chả rươi in the refrigerator.
Place the Chả rươi in an airtight container to avoid contact with air.
Refrigerated Chả rươi can stay fresh for a few days.
2. Seal and store properly
Ensure the Chả rươi is sealed tightly after opening the original packaging.
Use plastic bags or airtight food containers to store the Chả rươi.
3. Freezer storage (if needed)
If you want to store Chả rươi long-term, you can place it in the freezer.
Ensure it is sealed tightly and not in direct contact with ice to avoid freezer burn.
4. Regular checks
Regularly check the stored Chả rươi to ensure there are no signs of spoilage or rancidity.
Use the Chả rươi shortly after purchase to ensure the best flavor and quality.

mon_an.mo_ta: This pumpkin rice dish attracts diners first with its appearance, featuring the bright yellow of the pumpkin blending with the eye-catching purple of the sticky rice. Upon tasting, the pumpkin is sweet and tender, infused with seasonings alongside fragrant, chewy rice. The special dipping sauce creates a unique flavor that makes the dish unmistakable. With just a little time in the kitchen and familiar ingredients, you'll have a wonderful dish to treat your family and friends.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fish sauce or soy sauce - 3 tbsp
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, pour the rice into a pot. Add water, wash the rice thoroughly, and drain.
Step 2:
Next, add 1 cup of water and a pinch of salt to the pot with the washed rice and cover. Soak the rice for about 30 minutes to allow it to expand.
Step 3:
Bring the pot of rice to a boil over high heat for about 5-6 minutes, then uncover, reduce the heat to low, and simmer for about 10 minutes.
Step 4:
Next, add 1/3 cup of peas to the hot rice and stir well.
Step 5:
Cut off the top of the pumpkin as shown.
Scoop out all the pumpkin seeds from the inside.
Step 6:
Next, remove the pits from the jujubes; wash them with water if necessary.
Place the jujubes at the bottom of the pumpkin, then add a layer of glutinous rice followed by the raisins.
Add more glutinous rice to fill the cavity of the pumpkin.
Finally, sprinkle the chestnuts and peas on top.
Step 7:
Place the pumpkin in a steamer and steam for about 30-40 minutes until the rice is fully cooked, then remove.
Step 8:
Prepare the dipping sauce by mixing 3 tbsp of fish sauce, 2 tsp of vinegar, 1 tbsp of finely chopped green onions, and 1 tsp of minced chili.
Step 9:
Finally, cut the pumpkin into 4 or more wedges, place on a plate, and enjoy with the dipping sauce.
Tips for delicious Sweet Pumpkin Rice

The pumpkin is a crucial part of this dish; its sweetness and aroma will infuse the rice, so choose a pumpkin that is ripe, sweet, and fresh. Avoid those with spots or blemishes on the skin. You should choose the '2-skin' variety (bí 2 da), which is round and beautiful, with a green layer under the skin and orange-red flesh; this type is waxier and tastier. Look for those with a stem 2cm – 5cm long.
Additionally, you can add other favorite ingredients like black beans, potatoes, etc.
Instead of glutinous rice, you can use regular white rice, which is also very appealing.

This pumpkin rice dish attracts diners first with its appearance, featuring the bright yellow of the pumpkin blending with the eye-catching purple of the sticky rice. Upon tasting, the pumpkin is sweet and tender, infused with seasonings alongside fragrant, chewy rice. The special dipping sauce creates a unique flavor that makes the dish unmistakable. With just a little time in the kitchen and familiar ingredients, you'll have a wonderful dish to treat your family and friends. You will receive countless compliments from your loved ones. You might even get a bit big-headed from all the praise! And who knows, someone might ask for your secret to this wonderful dish. Don't hesitate—get in the kitchen and make this delicious meal now!

mon_an.mo_ta: Hainanese Chicken Rice features fresh, delicious chicken with a characteristic aroma and perfectly chewy rice cooked in sweet chicken broth and rich fat, providing a delightful culinary experience. With just a little time in the kitchen, you can have a wonderful dish to treat your family and friends! Check out the recipe for this amazing Hainanese Chicken Rice in the article below!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Boil the chicken
Clean the chicken thoroughly. Rub a little salt all over the chicken, then rinse under running water until clean.
Stuff the chicken with ginger slices and green onions.

Place the chicken in a large pot. Add water and bring to a boil over high heat. Once the water starts boiling, reduce the heat to the lowest setting. Simmer for about 20-25 minutes or until the chicken is cooked (less time if the chicken is small).

When the chicken is cooked, turn off the heat, remove it from the pot, and immediately drop it into a basin of ice water to cool and firm up the meat. Remove the ginger and green onions from the cavity. Keep the chicken broth for further use.
Step 2: Cook the rice
30ml chicken fat or 30ml vegetable oil; 3 cloves garlic, minced; 2 cups rice, washed and soaked in cold water for 10 minutes; 500ml chicken broth; 2.5ml sesame oil; 5g salt

*- Stovetop method:* Drain the soaking water from the rice. Heat a pot, add ginger and garlic, and sauté until fragrant. Add the rice and stir for about 2 minutes, then add sesame oil and mix well to combine. Add 500ml of chicken broth and a pinch of salt, then bring to a boil. Reduce the heat and simmer for 5-10 minutes or until the rice is cooked.
*- Rice cooker method:* If you have a rice cooker, pour the sautéed aromatics and rice into the cooker. Add about 550ml of chicken broth and a little salt. Press the cook button.
Note: You can adjust the amount of water to suit the type of rice you are using.
Step 3: While waiting for the rice to cook, remove the chicken from the ice water and rub a little sesame oil over the skin. Then, chop the chicken into bite-sized pieces.
Step 4: Make the dipping sauce
Combine the dipping sauce ingredients in a blender, blend until smooth, and pour into a small bowl for serving.
Step 5: Make the soup
Divide the chicken broth into small bowls, add salt to taste, and sprinkle with a little finely chopped green onion.
Step 6: Enjoy
To serve, place the chicken on a plate, add chili sauce, soy sauce, sliced cucumber, and a bit of cilantro for garnish, then enjoy.
How to choose good chicken
Tips for choosing pre-slaughtered chicken
A good chicken will have a compact, firm body and a small breast.
The skin should be golden, with darker yellow areas like the wings, breast, and back. The skin should not be bruised, pale, or have black spots or nodules.
If the skin is tough and uniformly golden while the fat is white, the chicken may have been treated with yellow dye.
The meat should be firm, fresh, and free of foul odors or antibiotic smells.

Press your finger into the body, breast, or thigh to check; if the meat is firm, it's good. If the meat is flabby, slippery, deformed, or leaves a water-filled indentation, it may have been injected with water or borax; absolutely do not buy such chicken.

mon_an.mo_ta: The Vu Lan season is here; let's make a vegetarian Korean mixed rice (Bibimbap) following this recipe. Enjoy a delicious Bibimbap with detailed and simple instructions. Learn the recipe and necessary ingredients to create a fragrant and attractive bowl of Korean mixed rice.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Assorted vegetables - A little of each (enoki mushrooms, spinach, bean sprouts, etc.)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Peel and wash the vegetables, removing roots. Shred the carrots and shiitake mushrooms.
Blanch the dried daylilies, enoki mushrooms, bean sprouts, and spinach in boiling water.
Keep each ingredient separate and mix them with a little sesame oil and salt.
Make a sunny-side-up egg: Heat a pan, add oil, and fry the egg over low heat until the white is set and the top is just cooked.
Remove the egg, add more oil if needed, then sauté the carrots and shiitake mushrooms with a little salt to taste until cooked.
Step 2: Assemble the Bibimbap
Brush a layer of sesame oil around the stone bowl (tộ), then add the rice.
Arrange the prepared ingredients on top attractively.
Place the sunny-side-up egg on top. Place the bowl on the stove and heat until the ingredients are hot and you hear the oil and rice sizzling, then turn off the heat.
How to buy and choose fresh ingredients
How to buy quality beef
Fresh beef will be bright red with some white veins and yellow fat.
To check the quality, gently press the meat. If it is firm and elastic without feeling greasy, it is a good choice.
Choose pieces of beef that are tender, small-grained, and not too smooth.
Avoid beef that is pale green or dark red, has dark yellow fat, or white spots. Especially avoid meat with a strange odor or that feels flabby and slimy.
How to choose fresh carrots
When buying carrots, choose those with a bright orange color. The skin should be glossy, smooth, and free of blemishes or strange spots.

Regarding the stem, good carrots will still have the stem attached and it should be bright green. Avoid those with crushed, broken, or missing stems. Also, avoid those with leaves growing from the base, as this can reduce sweetness and nutrients.
To ensure freshness, choose medium-sized carrots. Do not buy very large ones that feel light, as this indicates they are old and won't taste good.
How to choose good bean sprouts
For good bean sprouts, choose those with many long roots.
Safe and delicious sprouts often don't look perfect. Because no chemicals are used, the stems may be curved and not glossy. However, these are safe for your health.
Avoid sprouts with thick, smooth stems or unusual lengths, as these may have been treated with chemicals.
Ingredient preparation tips
How to prepare and deodorize beef
There are several quick ways to remove the odor from beef.
The first way is using wine. After buying, wash the meat with water, then rinse with wine or soak it in wine for 15 minutes. This not only reduces the odor but also makes the meat more tender.
The second way is using roasted shallots. Instead of using garlic, you can roast a dry shallot, peel and mince it, then marinate the beef with the roasted shallot.
If using large pieces for stewing, you can deodorize by soaking the meat in cold water and heating it up (but not boiling), then removing the meat to cool.
These methods will help remove odors and improve beef quality simply and effectively.
Tips for soaking dried shiitake mushrooms

Method 1: If you have enough time, soak the mushrooms in water for 1-2 hours to expand, then rinse with clean water and drain before cooking. For faster results, soak in warm water (60-80°C) for 7-10 minutes.
Method 2: This is faster. Simply rinse the mushrooms, then boil them in a pot of water for 3-5 minutes.
Both methods effectively prepare the mushrooms; choose the one that fits your schedule.

mon_an.mo_ta: Salt and pepper field crabs feature eye-catching colors and a delicious flavor. When eating, you will experience the crunchiness of the crabs, infused with seasonings along with a hint of sourness and saltiness from the roasted salt, all blending together to create a wonderful dish!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning - Salt, sugar, pepper, cooking oil
cac_buoc: How to make Salt and Pepper Field Crabs
Step 1: After buying the field crabs, wash them thoroughly, remove the carapaces and aprons, then drain.
Step 2: Wash the lemongrass and chili, drain, and julienne.
Trim the roots and remove any wilted leaves from the green onions and Vietnamese coriander, then mince them; crush the garlic.

Step 3: Place a pan on the stove and add enough cooking oil to deep-fry the crabs. When the oil is very hot, add the crabs and fry until golden brown. To ensure the crabs are evenly cooked and crunchy, use medium heat and avoid setting it too high or too low.
Step 4: When the crabs are golden brown on both sides, remove them to a plate lined with paper towels.
Then, mix the chili salt and sugar in a ratio of 1 part salt to 2 parts sugar.

Step 5: Sauté the garlic in a pan with a little oil until fragrant. Add the crabs and stir-fry with the garlic, then add the salt-sugar mixture and toss well until the crabs are evenly coated. Add the julienned lemongrass and chili, stir together, and turn off the heat.
Finally, sprinkle some green onions and Vietnamese coriander on top, toss well, serve on a plate, and enjoy with sweet and sour chili sauce!
Tips for delicious Salt and Pepper Field Crabs
How to choose good crabs
Crab color: Field crabs are usually dull gray, with a lighter-colored carapace.
Healthy, fresh crabs: Choose crabs that move quickly, have strong claws pointing upwards, are plump, and have all their legs. Press on the apron; if you see air bubbles, the crab is fresh.

Distinguishing male and female crabs: The simplest way is to observe the apron. A small apron indicates a male crab, while a larger one indicates a female. Choose females for more roe and males for more meat.
Checking for meatiness: Flip the crab over and press the apron; if it doesn't sink, the crab is meaty. If it sinks, the crab is hollow and watery, with less meat, and may have an unpleasant smell.
Best time for crabs: Crabs are fattest, meatiest, and sweetest at the beginning and end of the month. The middle of the month is usually when crabs molt, making them thin and less meaty.
Tips for preparing crabs

To make preparing the crabs easier, besides breaking the claws or wearing gloves, you can place them in ice-cold water. In cold water, the crabs will become dormant, so you won't have to worry about them pinching your fingers.
To prevent a fishy smell, sauté the crab roe until fragrant before cooking.
When choosing field crabs, avoid using them for cooking if you see the following signs:
Field crabs with 4 or 6 legs: Edible field crabs usually have two large claws and eight legs. However, some have only six or four legs; be cautious of these.
Crabs with red eyes
Crabs with a hairy underbelly or a bone-like structure inside the belly
Crabs with star-shaped spots on the back or striped legs

mon_an.mo_ta: Mapo Tofu is one of the ten most famous dishes in China. If you have the chance to visit, you cannot miss this renowned delicacy. Let's learn how to make this famous dish to treat your whole family!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 1 garlic bulb, 3 green onions, 1/4 ginger root
1 tbsp chili oil, 1 tbsp oyster sauce, 1/2 tbsp sesame oil
cac_buoc: Step 1: Mince the ginger, garlic, and the white parts of the green onions, then sauté until fragrant with chili powder. Step 2: Add the chili oil, oyster sauce, and sesame oil to the pan and stir with the ginger and garlic for about 1 minute. Step 3: Now, add the ground meat and stir-fry. Remember to season with soy sauce to taste! Step 4: When the meat is nearly cooked, add the tofu to the pan. Step 5: Stir gently and shake the pan frequently so the tofu is evenly coated in the sauce. Add a little water, reduce to low heat, and simmer for about 3 - 5 minutes before turning off the heat. This dish is best enjoyed while hot! The signature spicy flavor is unique to Mapo Tofu!

mon_an.mo_ta: This creamy chicken curry recipe offers a delightful new experience—it's absolutely delicious!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning 1 - 15g brown sugar, 8g curry powder, 15g black pepper, 15g salt, 15ml cooking oil
Seasoning 2 - 15ml oyster sauce, 15g brown sugar, 60g curry powder
Sour cream (or unsweetened yogurt or whipping cream)
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, cut the chicken into small pieces and score them with longitudinal cuts so the meat absorbs the sauce easily.
Step 2:
Put all of Seasoning 1 into a bowl, add the chicken, mix well, and marinate for at least 1 hour.
Step 3:
Wash the sweet potatoes and carrots, boil in water for about 20 minutes, then turn off the heat and let them sit for 15 minutes. Rinse the vegetables with cold water and drain.
Step 4:
Sauté the onion and ginger in the pot until fragrant.
Step 5:
Add the chopped onion and butter, then mix well.
Step 6:
Add the marinated chicken and vegetables to the pot.
Step 7:
Pour in enough water to cover the meat, add Seasoning 2, and simmer until the liquid has mostly reduced and thickened.
When eating, drizzle some sour cream on top!
Sour cream gives the braised chicken a slightly tangy and creamy flavor that is very appealing; when mixed with the braising sauce, it becomes extremely aromatic!
It would be wonderful served with hot rice!
This unique chicken recipe will surely have the whole family wanting more!

mon_an.mo_ta: Korean spicy cheesy chicken, with its spicy kick and rich cheese, is incredibly aromatic and enticing. It's guaranteed to be addictive. So, why not get started on this dish right away?
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: ½ cup Korean red chili flakes (available at supermarkets)

15ml soy sauce; 45ml vegetable oil; 2.5g black pepper; 60ml rice syrup, sugar, or honey; 6 cloves garlic, minced; 10g ginger, minced; 450g mozzarella cheese, cut into small pieces; 1 stalk green onion, chopped; 60ml water; 1 bowl sliced Korean rice cakes (optional – available at supermarkets)
cac_buoc: Cheese is the key ingredient for Korean spicy cheesy chicken; prepare 450g of mozzarella cheese cut into small pieces.
Step 1:
Mix the chili flakes, chili paste, soy sauce, 30ml vegetable oil, pepper, garlic, rice syrup, and ginger in a bowl.
Mix the mixture thoroughly to combine the sweet and spicy flavors.
Then add the chicken and mix thoroughly by hand.
Step 2:
Heat a pan with 15ml vegetable oil.
Then add the rice cakes and fry for a few minutes.
Step 3:
Put the chicken mixture into a cast-iron skillet, cover with a lid, and cook on high heat for 10 minutes.
If using a regular frying pan, it only takes 7-8 minutes.
Stir well with a wooden spoon, then place the rice cakes on top of the chicken.
Lower the heat to the lowest setting. Cover and simmer for another 10 minutes or until the chicken is fully cooked.
Step 4:
While the chicken is simmering, preheat the oven to medium heat.
Once the chicken is cooked, top it with cheese and place the pot in the oven for a few minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbling.
Then, remove the cheesy spicy chicken, sprinkle with green onions, and enjoy!
And that's it—Korean spicy cheesy chicken is ready in just 4 steps. It's so addictive and enticing, you won't be able to resist!

mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried chicken is a familiar dish, but this Thai-style version with a spicy sauce, chicken, and vegetables makes for a delicious and nutritious meal for you and your family.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning - soy sauce, oyster sauce, fish sauce, sugar, sesame oil, chili paste (sate), fresh chili, pepper
cac_buoc: Ingredients you need to prepare:
Step 1:
First, wash the chicken and cut it into bite-sized pieces. Then, crush the ginger and squeeze out the juice.
Marinate the chicken with ginger juice for about 15 minutes.
Step 2:
Next, coat the chicken evenly with cornstarch, then add soy sauce and mix well. Marinate for another 15 minutes.
Step 3:
Heat a little oil in a pan, then add the chicken and sear it.
Step 4:
Peel and wash the carrot, then slice into small pieces and stir-fry with oyster sauce. Set the carrots aside and continue using the pan for the next step.
Step 5:
Deseed and wash the bell peppers, then cut into small pieces and stir-fry in the pan until cooked. Add the roasted peanuts and stir-fry together.
Step 6:

Then, add the chicken to the pan with the bell peppers and peanuts. Add the carrots and stir-fry for another 3 minutes, then add the oyster sauce, fish sauce, sugar, sesame oil, chili paste (sate), and pepper one by one. Season to taste.
Step 7:
Finally, sprinkle with green onions and fresh chili, and your dish is complete!
Ta-da! This dish is absolutely delicious when served with hot rice!

mon_an.mo_ta: If you have leftover chicken during Tet, quickly make this delicious and easy shredded chicken salad for a refreshing change of pace that isn't greasy at all!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 1 cup Vietnamese coriander and mint, roughly chopped
Dressing: 2 tbsp sugar, 2 tbsp lime juice, 2 tbsp fish sauce, sliced chili; mix together in a small bowl.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the chicken and boil with a pinch of salt until cooked. Shred the meat.
Step 2: Thinly slice the onion and shred the carrot, then marinate with 2 tbsp sugar, 2 tbsp vinegar, and 2 tbsp lime juice. Leave in the refrigerator for 20 minutes.

Step 3: Place the chicken in a bowl. Drain the onions and mix them in first. Then add the cabbage, the dressing, and chili, and toss together. Finally, add the Vietnamese coriander and fried shallots and mix well. Season to taste to finish.
Serve the chicken salad on a plate, garnish with cilantro, and sprinkle with black pepper and fried shallots.

mon_an.mo_ta: Giò lụa, a traditional Vietnamese dish, always appears on every family dining table during the Lunar New Year. However, in today's modern life, as everyone is busy keeping up with the pace of society, the trend has shifted toward industrialization in cooking. This also affects how giò lụa is made. This article will guide you on how to make delicious, chewy, and crispy giò lụa without using borax for the Tet holiday. Learn how to make Giò Bò as good as the store-bought version with detailed recipes and secrets. Giò lụa, a traditional Vietnamese dish, is indispensable in the family meal during Tet.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning - Shallots, garlic, chili, pepper, fish sauce, sugar
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Clean the beef and place it in the freezer for about 1-2 hours.
Select about 50g of beef fat and cut into small pieces. Cut the remaining beef into small pieces as well. Place them in the freezer to firm up for about 1-2 hours.

On the stove, boil about 150ml of water in a pot. Add the remaining 50g of fat to the pot and blanch briefly. Then, add 1 tbsp sugar and continue boiling for about 3 minutes. Remove the fat and let it cool slightly, then mince finely.
Mix the minced fat with 1 tbsp sugar. Leave this mixture to dry in the wind or under sunlight for about 1 hour to dry it out, which makes the giò crispier.
Once the beef is frozen firm, take it out and slice it small.
Step 2: Grind the beef
Place all the sliced beef into a blender and grind finely. Once finished, place the meat mixture back in the freezer.
Next, place the frozen pork fat into the blender and grind finely.

Take the ground beef from the freezer and place it in the blender with the ground fat. Blend quickly to ensure the mixture is even. Add 30ml fish sauce, 1 tsp sugar, and 1/3 tsp MSG. Blend again to ensure the mixture is well mixed.

Use a pestle to crush 2 ice cubes. Add to the blender and grind together for about 10 seconds. Open the lid and use chopsticks to stir gently to loosen the meat, which reduces the load on the blender. Continue blending about 3 times like this until the meat becomes smooth and elastic. Then, add 2 tbsp cornstarch and 1 tbsp baking powder to the blender.
Step 3: Marinate the giò
Clean the dill and chop it finely.
Prepare a large basin and put ice in it to chill the basin. Then, pour the ice water out.
Place the finely ground beef into the chilled basin.
Add the dill and the sun-dried minced fat into the basin with the beef, then mix well until the mixture is fully combined.
Step 4: Wrap the giò bò
Wash the banana leaves, then boil them briefly to make them soft and easy to wrap without breaking. You can also lightly singe the leaves over a flame to soften them.
Stack 2-3 layers of banana leaves diagonally, and line the bottom with a layer of plastic wrap (heat-resistant).

Brush a layer of cooking oil on the banana leaf, then place a portion of the meat in the center and roll it up tightly. Fold the two ends of the giò so the banana leaf seals it completely, then use string to tie it firmly, but not too tight—just enough to keep the giò snug inside the leaf.
Step 5: Steam the giò bò

Bring a pot of water to a boil. When the water is simmering, place the giò in to steam. Cover the pot and cook over high heat for about 5 minutes. When the giò expands, reduce the heat to medium and steam for another 15 minutes.
After that, flip the giò to ensure even cooking and steam for another 10-15 minutes over medium heat.

Turn off the heat and leave the giò in the pot to rest for another 10 minutes. During this time, the giò bò will cool naturally and the released juices will be reabsorbed, keeping the meat fresh and retaining its characteristic sweetness. Once cooled, you can cut it into bite-sized pieces.
Step 6: Finished product

The giò bò has a delicious aroma, a chewy texture, and blends the natural sweetness of beef with the light richness of pork fat—a wonderful combination! To make the dish more flavorful, you can prepare a little salt and pepper for dipping.
Notes for delicious beef sausage

Choosing beef: When boiling the sausage, you must time it correctly; if left too long, the sausage will overcook, the surface will become porous and unattractive, and the flavor will suffer. If removed too early, the inside will be undercooked and raw.
Store the beef sausage in the refrigerator for gradual use!
How to choose good beef:
Choose beef using your senses

To choose good beef, observe carefully: the meat must be bright red, not dark, and the beef fat should be bright yellow and firm. You should choose fine-grained, soft meat with white tendons. To check the freshness, press your finger into the meat; if it is elastic and not sticky, it is good meat.
Distinguishing old beef from young beef

Old beef has large grains, a purplish-red color, and grayish fat, while young beef has fine grains, soft meat, a bright red color, and white fat. Choose meat with a pleasant aroma; if it smells foul or has spots or dark red patches (like a chicken that wasn't bled properly), the meat is not good.
Distinguishing buffalo from beef

Both buffalo and old beef have large grains and a darker red color than young beef, so distinguish them by the color of the fat. Old beef fat is grayish (dark yellow), while buffalo fat is white. Usually, you can tell buffalo and beef apart immediately because buffalo meat is generally darker than old beef.
Distinguishing water-injected meat

Usually, water-injected meat looks wetter and glossier than non-injected meat. Non-injected meat looks dry to the naked eye; parts exposed to air will dry out (in summer, if left for 15 minutes without cutting, it will appear to sear slightly and won't be sticky).
Choosing meat according to purpose

If you want to make beef au vin (bò sốt vang), choose meat with many tendons for a crunchy texture; for stews, choose beef shank; for stir-fries, round steak is best. Depending on your purpose, choose the cut that fits your budget and is easiest to prepare.

mon_an.mo_ta: Jellyfish salad with banana blossom is a favorite dish not only for many families but especially during hot summer days. When eating, you will experience the slight astringency of the banana blossom, the freshness of the jellyfish, and the cooling sensation it brings. Notably, this dish also ensures full nutrition for the meal. Let's learn how to make jellyfish salad with banana blossom in the article below! Instructions for making delicious and visually appealing jellyfish banana blossom salad for hot summer days. Discover how to prepare this family favorite, combining the light astringency of banana blossom, fresh jellyfish flavor, and refreshing nutrition.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients

After buying the jellyfish, rinse it with clean water mixed with a little diluted salt. Next, blanch the jellyfish in boiling water for about 3 minutes, then remove and place in a bowl of cold water to maintain crispiness. Drain in a colander.
For the banana blossom, slice it thinly and soak in water mixed with a little salt and vinegar for 5 minutes to remove sap and prevent browning. Then, rinse with clean water and drain.
For accompanying ingredients like cucumber and mango, peel, wash, and cut into bite-sized pieces. Shred the carrot, cut the onion into wedges, and finely chop the herbs.
Peel and wash the chili and garlic, then mince them. Roast the peanuts and crush them slightly.
Step 2: Marinate with spices

First, squeeze the lime for juice, ensuring there are no seeds to avoid bitterness. Then, in the lime juice, add 1/3 cup vinegar, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp MSG, and 1 tsp salt. Stir well until the spices are completely dissolved.
Next, add the minced garlic and chili to the mixture and stir. Taste and adjust to suit your personal preference.
Step 3: Preparation
First, arrange all the prepared vegetables like mango, cucumber, carrot, onion, banana
blossom, and cilantro in a bowl. Then, add the prepared dressing and toss well.
Finally, add the jellyfish and mix thoroughly. Serve on a plate and sprinkle peanuts on top for extra flavor.

Jellyfish salad with banana blossom is a colorful dish that combines sweet, sour, and refreshing flavors. The crunchy texture of the jellyfish along with the various vegetables creates a special appeal that is never boring.
Notes for making refreshing jellyfish banana blossom salad
When working with fresh jellyfish, you should first wash it thoroughly with water and cut it open to remove toxins inside.

Next, cut the jellyfish into small pieces and soak in diluted salt water. Rinse and continue soaking about 4-5 times. This simple preparation helps reduce mercury, ensures deliciousness, and prevents the jellyfish from shrinking.
When making the salad, you can add ingredients like fresh shrimp, pork ear, starfruit, green banana, mango, etc., to enhance the flavor.
Only use jellyfish when the meat has turned light red or light yellow.
Adjust the amount of seasoning, especially chili, to suit everyone's taste.
Jellyfish salad can be served with rice or as an appetizer at a party; it is also a popular snack for men.
This dish is particularly suitable for enjoying on hot summer days.
How to choose good banana blossoms
When buying banana blossoms, choose whole ones that are not crushed and haven't lost their outer skin. The skin should be dark red and covered with a fine layer of white powder.
When holding a banana blossom, if it feels heavy, firm, and the skin feels hard and crisp when squeezed lightly, those are good signs.
Avoid choosing blossoms with strange colors, dark bruising, or those that turn yellowish-brown when shredded. Also, avoid buying blossoms that have lost the white powder layer on the outer skin.

mon_an.ten: Crispy Fried Pumpkin Blossoms Stuffed with Shrimp and Fish
mon_an.mo_ta: On weekends or whenever you have free time, head to the kitchen to make these crispy fried pumpkin blossoms stuffed with shrimp and fish to treat the whole family!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 12 pumpkin blossoms, with pistils and stems intact - Gently wash to avoid tearing the petals
Minced fish fillet (can be substituted with giò sống) - 100g
Minced dill (can be substituted with green onions)
½ tsp fish sauce; ½ tsp salt; ½ tsp sugar; ground black pepper
Batter: 100ml water; 50g all-purpose flour; 10g rice flour. Mix the flour and rice flour, then slowly add water, mix well, and let rest for 10 minutes.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Mix all the stuffing ingredients together.
Step 2: Use a small spoon to stuff the mixture inside the pumpkin blossoms. Then dip the stuffed blossoms into the batter.
Step 3: Heat oil in a pan, lower the heat, then place the stuffed blossoms into the pan. Fry until the blossoms are golden brown and crispy.
Remove the stuffed blossoms and place them on paper towels to drain the oil. Serve hot with chili sauce or your favorite dipping sauce!

mon_an.mo_ta: With just a can of tuna from the supermarket and some easy-to-find ingredients, you can make these super attractive, crispy tuna-stuffed potato balls!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Filling: 1 can of tuna (250g); 1 minced shallot; 1/2 tsp pepper; 1/3 tsp salt; 1/3 tsp sugar; 2 eggs, beaten in a bowl; 200g breadcrumbs set aside.
cac_buoc: Ingredients you need to prepare for these delicious crispy tuna-stuffed potato balls.

Step 1: Place a pan on the stove, add 1 tbsp oil, and heat. When the oil is hot, sauté the shallots until fragrant, then add the tuna and stir-fry until loose. Season to taste, turn off the heat, and let cool.
Step 2: Peel the potatoes and cut into medium pieces.
Step 3: Boil or steam the potatoes until cooked.
Step 4: Mash the potatoes with a spoon (do not blend). Add cornstarch, egg yolk, butter, a little pepper, and a little seasoning powder to the mashed potatoes and knead well.
Step 5: Take a small amount of the potato mixture, roll into a ball, then flatten it. Place a little tuna in the center, then roll back into a ball or shape into long logs.
Step 6: Dip the potato balls into the beaten eggs, then roll them through the breadcrumbs.
Continue until all the potato mixture is used.
Step 7: Heat a pan of oil. When the oil is slightly hot, add the potato balls and fry over medium-high heat (but not too high).
Step 8: When the potato balls are golden and crispy, remove them to a plate lined with paper towels.
Serve the potato balls on a plate with a side of ketchup or chili sauce.
This dish is very delicious when eaten hot and is perfect for children.

mon_an.mo_ta: Making French fries with an air fryer is a popular modern method because it saves time and uses very little oil while still producing delicious fries with a crispy golden crust.
