This article will guide you through the process! This simple and fresh approach to air fryer French fries reduces grease but preserves the full flavor of the potatoes. Prepare your ingredients and let's start making these tempting fries.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the potatoes
First, peel the potatoes and wash them under running water. Ensure every side is thoroughly cleaned to remove any dirt or debris.
Next, use a knife to cut the potatoes into bite-sized strips. Meanwhile, soak the cut potatoes in a bowl of diluted salt water for about 5 minutes.
Then, drain the salt water and rinse the potatoes several times with clean water until the water is no longer cloudy. Let the potatoes drain well.

Finally, bring 500ml of water and 1 tsp of salt to a boil in a large pot. Once boiling, add all the drained potatoes and blanch for about 2 minutes. Remove the potatoes, rinse with cold water, and drain.
Step 2: Mix the potatoes
Once the potatoes are dry, place them in a bowl and add 3 tbsp of cooking oil. Use a spoon to toss the potatoes evenly with the oil.
Next, take a Ziploc bag and place all the mixed potatoes inside. Put the bag in the freezer for about 3 - 4 hours until the potatoes are frozen through.
Note: To prevent the potatoes from sticking together or breaking when frozen, ensure they are spread out evenly in the Ziploc bag rather than bunched up at the bottom.
Step 3: Air fry the potatoes
Start by placing all the frozen potatoes into the air fryer basket. Use chopsticks to spread them out evenly, then set the temperature to 140°C and fry for about 8 minutes.
Next, remove the basket and use chopsticks to toss and flip the potatoes. Continue frying at 160°C for 10 minutes.
After that, take the potatoes out and toss them again. Fry for another 10 minutes at 160°C.
Finally, when the potatoes are golden and crispy, turn off the air fryer and transfer the fries to a plate to enjoy immediately.
How to prevent potatoes from browning
Method 1: Soak the potatoes in diluted vinegar or lemon juice, then wrap them in plastic wrap and place them in the freezer. When ready to use, simply take them out and rinse with clean water.
Method 2: During preparation, keep the potatoes submerged in a bowl of cold water.
How to fix blackened potatoes:
Method 1: Simply use a knife to peel away the blackened parts, then soak them in cold water for 5 – 7 minutes.

Method 2: Place a pot on the stove with a little fresh milk (sweetened or unsweetened) and add the blackened potatoes. Simmer over medium heat for 5 – 7 minutes. Turn off the heat, remove the potatoes, and rinse.
Notes for air fryer French fries
Preparation: Before frying, ensure potatoes are peeled and cut into even pieces. Wash thoroughly to remove starch and impurities.
Quantity: Do not overcrowd the air fryer basket. Leave enough space for air and heat to circulate during the frying process.
Oil: Some air fryers require a small amount of oil to achieve crispiness. Read your air fryer's manual for the recommended amount of oil.
Temperature and Time: Follow the air fryer's instructions to set the appropriate temperature and time. Usually, air frying requires slightly higher settings than traditional methods.
Toss and Shake: During the cooking process, toss or shake the basket to ensure the fries cook evenly and achieve a uniform golden color without burning.
Check for doneness: Check if the fries are done using a chopstick or skewer. When they are beautifully golden and look crispy, try a piece to ensure they are cooked through.

mon_an.mo_ta: This shredded chicken noodle salad combines various ingredients like bean sprouts, roasted peanuts, green onions, cilantro, garlic, vinegar, and soy sauce. Everything blends perfectly with the noodles and chicken to create an exquisite dish that you will enjoy until the very last bite.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Pour enough water into a small pot to submerge the chicken breast, then add ginger and chopped green onions. Bring to a boil, add the chicken, wait for the water to return to a boil, cover with a lid, and turn off the heat. Let the chicken soak in the pot for about 22-25 minutes.
While waiting for the chicken, prepare the remaining ingredients.
Step 2: Prepare the sauce by mixing all the sauce ingredients in a bowl.
Step 3: Boil the noodles according to the package instructions. Drain and rinse with cold water. If the noodles stick together, toss them with 1-2 tsp of cooking oil.

Step 4: Place the noodles in a bowl, followed by the shredded chicken, julienned cucumber, blanched bean sprouts, roasted peanuts, green onions, and cilantro. Pour the sauce over everything and toss well.
Now, simply enjoy your shredded chicken noodle salad!

mon_an.mo_ta: Braised Chicken with Chestnuts is a unique dish that will delight anyone from the first bite. The chicken is tender and flavorful, while the chestnuts are soft, floury, and deeply infused with spices. This delicious meal is visually appealing and so tasty that you'll never get tired of it!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fish sauce, cooking oil - as needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients.
Wash the chicken wings with salt to remove any odors, then rinse again with water. Chop the wings into bite-sized pieces.
Peel and wash the ginger, then slice thinly.
Break the cinnamon and star anise into small pieces.
Wash and finely chop the chilies.
Wash and slice the leek.
Boil the chestnuts for about 20 minutes or until cooked, then let them cool and peel off the shells.
Peel, wash, and mince the shallots.
Step 2: Cook the chicken wings with chestnuts.
First, bring a pot of water to a boil and parboil the chicken wings. You can add ginger to the water to enhance the aroma.
Once the chicken is cooked through, remove and drain.
Next, heat a little oil in a pan and sauté the shallots and leeks until fragrant. Add the star anise, cinnamon, peppercorns, chili, and ginger and stir-fry together.
When the mixture is fragrant, add the chicken wings and stir well.
Add 2 tbsp of cooking wine and stir-fry with the chicken. Be sure to stir continuously and evenly.
When the chicken wings turn a beautiful golden color, add the chestnuts, soy sauce, and sugar. Stir-fry for 1-2 minutes.
Pour hot water into the pan until the chicken wings are just submerged. Reduce the heat to low and cover with a lid.
When the liquid has reduced, taste and adjust the seasoning to your preference.
Stir a few more times so the chicken and chestnuts are evenly glazed, then turn off the heat.
Finally, transfer to a plate and serve hot with steamed rice.
Notes for Braised Chicken with Chestnuts
You can use any type of chicken, but broiler chicken wings are recommended as they are tender and meaty.
The cooking wine helps enhance the flavor without leaving a strong alcohol scent, so do not worry about the smell.
Star anise and cinnamon also add depth to the dish. However, do not over-use star anise as it can be overpowering or cause discomfort if used in excess.
Adjust the amount of chili to suit your spice tolerance.
If you don't have white peppercorns, you can use ground black pepper.

When buying fresh chestnuts, choose carefully as they only last about 10 days in natural conditions. Look for hard, shiny, bright brown nuts with fresh-looking fuzz. The inside should be fragrant, ivory-white, and not blackened at the tip. If you shake them and they don't rattle, they are fresh.

mon_an.ten: Crispy Tofu Skin Rolls with Minced Meat
mon_an.mo_ta: Tofu skin is a popular ingredient, most commonly used in hot pots. If you think tofu skin is only good for hot pot, try these crispy fried tofu skin rolls with minced meat to experience a truly delicious and attractive flavor!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Minced ginger and shallots - as needed
Seasoning: pepper, fish sauce, salt, seasoning powder, MSG
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Place the minced pork in a bowl. Add the chopped green onions.
Add the seasonings: a bit of seasoning powder and a bit of pepper.
Crack an egg into the bowl.
Mix thoroughly. Marinate for 30 minutes.
Step 2:
Keep the tofu skin sheets whole.
Bring a pot of water to a boil.
Quickly dip the tofu skin into the boiling water and remove immediately (this softens the skin, making it easier to roll).
Step 3:
Spread out each tofu skin sheet.
Spread the meat mixture evenly on top.
Roll the tofu skin up tightly.
Step 4:
If you prefer them fried, fry the rolls until golden and crispy, similar to frying spring rolls.
Alternatively, prepare a steamer and steam the rolls for about 20 minutes.
Step 5:
After steaming or frying, cut the rolls into bite-sized pieces and arrange them on a plate.
Serve with chili fish sauce or soy sauce.
With just 5 simple steps, you have a delicious and unique dish for dinner.

mon_an.mo_ta: Fried stuffed squid is a familiar and attractive dish for many families. The filling is soft and flavorful, while the squid is crispy and chewy. These delicious squid bites, paired with dipping sauce or chili sauce, provide a wonderful culinary experience. Spend some time in the kitchen to treat your family, especially for large gatherings. You will surely receive many compliments!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, sugar, pepper, seasoning powder - to taste
cac_buoc: First, rub the squid with a little ginger wine to remove the fishy odor, then rinse thoroughly and drain. Marinate with 1/2 tsp salt, rubbing it inside and outside the squid; let sit for 15 minutes.
Finely chop the squid tentacles.
Soak the wood ear and shiitake mushrooms until soft, wash, and finely chop.
Peel, wash, and dice the onion.
Clean and finely chop the green onions.
Soak the glass noodles until soft, then cut into 2cm lengths.

Next, mix the ground pork with all the chopped ingredients to make the filling. Season with a little sugar, pepper, and seasoning powder. Mix well so the ingredients absorb the spices. Stuff the filling into the squid bodies (stuff a little at a time, pressing firmly, but do not overfill as the meat will expand and spill out during cooking). Secure the openings with toothpicks.
Place the stuffed squid in a bowl and steam for 15 minutes. Remove and let cool slightly.
Heat cooking oil in a pan. When the oil is hot, fry the squid over high heat, turning all sides until golden brown and lightly charred on the edges.
Finally, remove the squid and drain the excess oil. Slice into rings, arrange on a plate, and enjoy.
Tips for delicious fried stuffed squid
To preserve the natural sweetness of the squid, you can skip the steaming step and fry them directly, but use low heat if doing so.
Fried stuffed squid is delicious when served with sweet and sour fish sauce or chili sauce.
How to choose fresh squid:
There are many types of squid like cuttlefish, tube squid, etc., but you must choose carefully to avoid stale ones.
For cuttlefish: Choose large, thick-bodied ones that are milky white, firm, and not mushy. The brown outer membrane should be intact, and the tentacles should be firm.
For tube squid: Choose ones with bright, slightly pinkish flesh. The head should be firmly attached to the body, tentacles firm, and the ink sac unbroken.
Avoid squid that has turned a pale greenish color, has soft flesh, a loose head, or a very fishy smell, as these are no longer fresh.

Fried stuffed squid is a familiar and attractive dish for many families. The filling is soft and flavorful, while the squid is crispy and chewy. These delicious squid bites, paired with dipping sauce or chili sauce, provide a wonderful culinary experience. Spend some time in the kitchen to treat your family, especially for large gatherings. You will surely receive many compliments!

mon_an.mo_ta: Sandworm season is here! Take the opportunity to visit the market and buy some sandworms to make this nutritious Nem Rươi for your family. Check out the recipe below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Lolot leaves, ginger leaves, Vietnamese coriander, green onions, dill, dried tangerine peel, chili, starfruit.
cac_buoc: Ingredients you need to prepare:

Step 1: If using fresh sandworms, place them in a bowl of clean water, then use a strainer to gently lift and wash them to avoid breaking them. If using frozen sandworms, let them thaw before processing. If you have extra sandworms, wash them, drain well, and divide into boxes or small bags for later use.

Step 2: Wash and finely chop the aromatic herbs: ginger leaves, green onions, dill, Vietnamese coriander, dried tangerine peel, lolot leaves, and starfruit. Soak wood ear mushrooms in hot water until expanded, wash, drain, and julienne. Peel, wash, and shred the carrot.

Step 3: Place all the chopped herbs and vegetables into a large bowl. Add the minced meat, sandworms, eggs, 1 tsp MSG, 1 tsp seasoning powder, 1 tbsp fish sauce, ½ tsp pepper, and a bit of gac oil. Beat well until all ingredients are thoroughly combined.
Step 4: Take each rice paper wrapper and roll the sandworm mixture until finished.
Step 5: Heat oil in a pan until very hot, then place each roll into the pan and fry until golden brown.
Step 6: When the rolls are golden on both sides, remove them to a plate lined with paper towels. Arrange on a serving plate and prepare a delicious fish sauce for dipping.
Wishing you and your family a delicious meal with this crispy and fragrant Nem Rươi!

mon_an.ten: Avocado Salad with Roasted Sesame Dressing for Weight Loss
mon_an.mo_ta: Change your palate and balance your nutrition with a delicious salad. Get in the kitchen and make this simple yet nutritious avocado salad with roasted sesame dressing, which helps with weight loss and skin health. This guide shows you how to make a weight-loss-friendly avocado salad for beautiful skin and a perfect physique. Enjoy a tasty and nutritious meal during your weight loss journey.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Carrot: Wash, drain, and peel the carrot. Cut into bite-sized squares.
Cucumber: Wash, peel, and remove the seeds. Dice into bite-sized cubes.
Avocado: Remove the pit, peel, and dice into cubes similar to the carrot and cucumber.
Apple: Wash, drain, and remove the core. Cut into squares or cubes like the other ingredients.
Microgreens: Wash the greens and soak in diluted salt water for 10-15 minutes, then rinse and drain.
Step 2: Boil the carrots
Place the diced carrots in a pot with enough water to cover them. Place on the stove over medium heat.
Boil for about 5-7 minutes until the water boils vigorously. Continue boiling for 1 more minute.
Remove the carrots and drain well.
Step 3: Roast the sesame seeds
Place 3 tbsp of sesame seeds in a pan and roast over low heat for 3-5 minutes until they turn golden and fragrant.
Step 4: Mix the salad
Place all the prepared ingredients from Step 1 into a large bowl, then toss gently and evenly.
Add 3 tbsp of roasted sesame dressing to the bowl and mix gently and thoroughly.
Next, add the roasted sesame seeds and mix again. Let the salad sit for 3-5 minutes so the dressing can absorb before serving.
Step 5: Finished product

The avocado salad with roasted sesame dressing has vibrant colors and a pleasant aroma from the avocado and dressing. The cucumber and apple provide a sweet crunch, the carrot is earthy, and the fresh microgreens pair perfectly with the rich dressing.
Everything creates a nutritious and delicious avocado salad that is hard to resist.
III. How to buy fresh ingredients for avocado salad
1. How to choose creamy, non-bitter avocados
Choose avocados with firm skin, green color, and tiny yellow speckles.
Select fruits with small, fresh stems that feel heavy for their size.
Avoid avocados with very large stems or those that feel mushy to the touch, as these are signs of over-ripening or internal spoilage.
2. How to choose fresh carrots
Choose medium-sized carrots that are straight with smooth skin.
Buy bright-colored carrots with small cores that feel firm in your hand.
Avoid very large, misshapen carrots or those with cracked or bruised skin.
3. How to choose delicious, crunchy apples
Select apples with a deep red, uniform color and no blotches.
Choose apples that feel firm and heavy; when tapped lightly, they should produce a clear, hollow sound.
Avoid apples with withered stems or no stems, and those that lack a fresh aroma.
4. How to choose good cucumbers without bitterness
Shape: Choose long, slender, straight cucumbers of uniform size. Avoid those that are too large, too small, or too young, as they may be bitter.
Skin: Fresh cucumbers will have a thin layer of white powder on the outside and small bumps on the skin. This is a good sign.
Color: Buy bright green cucumbers. Dark green ones often have sap at the ends and can be bitter.
Additionally, choose cucumbers with fresh stems and the flower nub still attached at the tail. These young cucumbers are usually sweeter.
IV. Nutrition in roasted sesame dressing
Roasted sesame dressing is a popular salad dressing often used in weight loss diets. It offers a unique flavor profile combining sour, sweet, creamy, and aromatic notes.

Main ingredients include soybean oil, soy sauce, vinegar, sesame seeds, sesame oil, egg yolks, and mustard extract. Each ingredient provides health benefits individually, though some nutrients may be lost during processing.

A 10g serving of roasted sesame dressing provides about 38.7 kcal, 3.6g of fat, and 0.3g of protein. When used in moderation, it supports weight loss. However, excessive consumption can lead to weight gain due to its calorie and fat content. Use it as a flavor enhancer while limiting the quantity.
V. Notes when making avocado salad
Choose fresh ingredients: Select ripe avocados and fresh greens. Ensure they are not withered or showing signs of long storage.

Use dressing in moderation: Roasted sesame dressing is relatively high in calories and fat. Limit the amount used to avoid unwanted weight gain. Use it to enhance flavor rather than drenching the salad.
Combine avocado with fresh vegetables: Add greens like lettuce, tomatoes, watercress, and carrots. These are high in fiber and low in calories, aiding weight loss and skin health.

Limit high-calorie additions: Avoid adding too many high-calorie ingredients like extra roasted seeds or high-fat cheeses. Focus on fresh vegetables to increase nutritional value without the calories.
VI. Conclusion

This guide provides the steps to make an avocado salad with roasted sesame dressing for weight loss and healthy skin. Additionally, drinking enough water and combining the salad with a healthy diet and exercise is key to achieving the best results.

mon_an.ten: Easy and Delicious Homemade Chicken Breast Avocado Salad
mon_an.mo_ta: Chicken breast avocado salad is an attractive and nutrient-rich dish, harmoniously combining fresh greens and tomatoes, the creamy sweetness of ripe avocado, and the savory flavor of marinated grilled chicken. This is a perfect blend of nutrients, offering a captivating taste for any meal. Try this easy and delicious recipe today! I. Traditional Chicken Breast Avocado Salad
thoi_gian: Prepare the avocado and other ingredients: Choose ripe, soft avocados. You can slice or mash them depending on your preference. Wash and chop greens like lettuce and other salad leaves.
cac_buoc: 1. Prepare ingredients
Ingredients for chicken breast avocado salad include:
Chicken breast (300g)
Lettuce (1 head)
Cherry tomatoes (5 fruits)
Red leaf lettuce (1 head)
Shallot (1 bulb)
Milk (1 tbsp)
Vegetable oil (2 tbsp)
Seasoning (salt, pepper, olive oil, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, sesame oil)
Garlic, rosemary, and cilantro.
2. Steps to make chicken breast avocado salad
Step 1: Prepare the chicken breast

Wash the chicken breast and soak it in milk for about 10 minutes, then rinse with water. Next, marinate the chicken with minced garlic, salt, ground pepper, rosemary, and mustard. Let it marinate for 10 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Step 2: Prepare the vegetables

Soak the lettuce and cherry tomatoes in diluted salt water for about 5 minutes, then rinse several times. Halve the cherry tomatoes. Thinly slice the shallot and soak in a bowl of lemon juice or vinegar for 5 minutes to reduce the pungency.
Step 3: Cook the chicken breast

Place a pan on the stove, add a little oil, and heat. Pan-fry the chicken breast for 10-12 minutes until cooked through. Let the chicken cool, then shred or slice it into small pieces to mix with the salad.
Step 4: Mix the salad
Place all the vegetables in a large bowl, then add about 3 tsp olive oil, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp vinegar, and the chopped shallots. Season with sugar, salt, and sesame oil to taste.
Step 5: Presentation and enjoyment
Place the salad on a plate and top with the cooked chicken. Toss well before eating to combine all ingredients.
II. Chicken Breast Salad with Mayonnaise
200g chicken breast
400g lettuce
200g peas
200g microgreens
1 red bell pepper
5 tbsp ketchup
2/3 tbsp mayonnaise
1/3 tbsp seasoning powder
2. Preparation steps
Step 1: Prepare the chicken breast
Wash the chicken breast under cold water.
Rub salt onto the chicken breast.
Boil the chicken until just cooked, not too soft or too tough.
After boiling, shred the chicken into strips (not too thin) for the salad.
Step 2: Prepare the lettuce and bell pepper
Separate the lettuce leaves and wash thoroughly.
Remove the stem and seeds from the bell pepper.
Slice the bell pepper into bite-sized strips.
Bring water to a boil and blanch the bell pepper for 1-2 minutes to soften.
Step 3: Prepare the peas
Wash the peas.
Boil until cooked.
Step 4: Mix the ingredients
In a large bowl, combine the shredded chicken, lettuce, blanched bell pepper, and boiled peas.
Add the mayonnaise and ketchup.
Toss well to ensure all ingredients are evenly coated.
Step 5: Enjoy
After mixing, you can enjoy the salad immediately.
Present on a plate or in a bowl as desired.
See also: 3 Simple Homemade Avocado Egg Salad Recipes
III. Chicken Breast Avocado Salad with Roasted Sesame Dressing
Chicken breast: Use 300g, wash and cut into small bite-sized pieces.
Lettuce: Use 2 heads, separate leaves and wash thoroughly. Chop or tear into small pieces.
Tomatoes: Use 2 tomatoes, wash and slice (or use 6-7 cherry tomatoes, halved).
Cucumber: Use 1 cucumber, wash, trim the ends, and slice thinly.
Quail eggs: Use 10 eggs, boil and peel. Halve them.
Avocado: 2 fruits
Roasted sesame dressing: Use 4 tbsp. You can buy it pre-made or make your own by blending roasted sesame seeds with sesame oil, garlic, sugar, salt, and other spices.
2.1. Prepare ingredients
Lettuce: Wash several times, drain, and arrange on a plate.
Tomatoes: Wash and cut into bite-sized pieces. If using cherry tomatoes, halve them.
Cucumber: Peel and slice thinly.
Quail eggs: Boil, peel, and halve. Arrange on the bed of lettuce.
Avocado: Slice or dice.
2.2. Boil the chicken
Boil the chicken breast until cooked, then remove and drain.
How to remove chicken odor:
Method 1: Use a mixture of vinegar and salt. Rub on the chicken or soak for 3-5 minutes, then rinse.
Method 2: Use lemon juice and salt. Rub on the chicken or soak for 3-5 minutes, then rinse.
2.3. Mix the salad
Before serving, drizzle 4 tbsp of roasted sesame dressing over the salad. Ensure it is evenly distributed.
2.4. Finished product

The salad has a sweet and sour flavor and vibrant colors. It is a perfect combination of greens, tomatoes, eggs, and the signature sesame dressing. This simple dish adds a refreshing touch to any meal.
IV. Notes for chicken breast avocado salad
Choose fresh ingredients: Ensure the chicken is fresh with no odor. Avocados, greens, and spices should also be fresh for the best flavor.
Prepare the chicken: Wash and trim excess fat. Boil until the meat is no longer pink. Do not overcook to avoid dry meat.
Cutting the chicken: Once cooled, slice or shred the chicken. Keep pieces uniform for a better mouthfeel.
Prepare avocado and greens: Choose ripe, soft avocados. Slice or mash as preferred. Wash and chop all greens thoroughly.
Salad dressing: Prepare according to the recipe or use pre-made dressings like mayonnaise or balsamic. Adjust to your taste using olive oil, apple cider vinegar, honey, garlic, and lemon juice.
Mixing: In a large bowl, toss the chicken, avocado, greens, and dressing together gently until evenly coated.
V. Conclusion
Making chicken breast avocado salad at home is simple and delicious. It provides protein from the chicken and healthy fats from the avocado. Enjoy this wonderful, healthy meal right at home.

mon_an.ten: Healthy Low-Fat Avocado Salad for Weight Loss
mon_an.mo_ta: Avocado salad is a favorite for many. When combined with salmon, it not only enhances the flavor but also provides essential nutrients. This salad will satisfy any diner. Check out this healthy low-fat avocado salad recipe for weight loss below! I. Avocado Salmon Salad Guide
cac_buoc: 1. Prepare ingredients
200g salmon
1 avocado
1 radish (thinly sliced)
8 cherry tomatoes
¼ cucumber
200g lettuce
1 lemon
Minced garlic and finely chopped parsley.
You also need seasonings like vinegar, salt, pepper, sugar, and olive oil.
2. Preparation steps
Step 1: Prepare ingredients
Wash the fish, vegetables, and roots, then drain. Slice the cucumber into small pieces, halve the cherry tomatoes, and cut the avocado into long bite-sized slices.
Step 2: Pan-sear the salmon
Marinate the salmon with: ½ tsp salt, ½ tsp pepper, 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp minced garlic, and 1 tsp chopped parsley. Massage gently and marinate for 10 minutes.
Heat a pan with 1 tbsp olive oil and sear the salmon for about 7 minutes on each side over medium heat. Let it cool slightly and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Step 3: Prepare the dressing
In a bowl, combine salt, pepper, sugar, vinegar, 5ml lemon juice, lemon zest, minced garlic, and chopped parsley. Mix well, then add 2 tbsp olive oil and stir.
Step 4: Complete the avocado salmon salad
Arrange the vegetables on a plate, drizzle with the dressing, and toss. Finally, place the salmon on top.
This salad offers a perfect balance of fresh vegetables, creamy avocado, and naturally sweet salmon, all tied together by a tangy dressing.
II. Avocado Salad with Roasted Potatoes
1 kg baby potatoes
5 shallots
1 tomato
1 package microgreens
A little olive oil
2 containers unsweetened yogurt
A little salt
A little apple cider vinegar and honey.
2. Preparation steps
Wash the avocado and cut into bite-sized pieces. Peel and thinly slice the shallots. Wash and chop the tomato. Next, roast the potatoes.
Roast the potatoes
Wash the potatoes and place in a microwave or oven at 200-210°C for about 20 minutes. Let them cool and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Mix the salad
Mix mustard, vinegar, honey, pepper, and salt in a jar. Close the lid and shake well until combined.
Place the microgreens in a large bowl, then top with sweet corn, avocado, and the cooled roasted potatoes. Drizzle the dressing over and toss well.
Once mixed, arrange on a plate and garnish as desired. This salad is great for daily meals or as a party appetizer.
III. Avocado Beef Salad
250g lettuce
50g aromatic herbs (Thai basil/marjoram/mint)
1/2 cabbage
1 tomato
1/2 onion
200g beef
1 chili and 10g garlic.
2. How to prepare avocado beef salad
2.1. Marinate the meat
Marinate the whole piece of beef with salt, oil, pepper, garlic, and shallots for 15 minutes.
Thinly slice the onion and soak in lemon juice for 5 minutes to reduce the pungency. Drain and keep in the fridge for extra crunch.
Wash all vegetables. Cut lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Slice the avocado into half-moons (thick enough to avoid mashing). Slice the tomato. Boil the corn kernels.
2.2. Prepare dressing and sear the beef
Mix the dressing: 1 tbsp fish sauce, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 tbsp sugar, pepper, chili, and lemon.
Pan-sear the marinated beef. Cook to medium-rare or medium to keep it juicy and tender. Slice into thin pieces.
2.3. Mix the salad
Toss the avocado, herbs, lettuce, tomato, onion, and corn. Add the cooked beef. For extra richness, add a little oil from the searing pan into the salad.
Arrange on a plate and garnish with herbs. This savory salad with creamy avocado and a hint of sourness is both delicious and nutritious.
IV. How to choose fresh ingredients and ripen avocados
1. How to choose good avocados

Prioritize avocados with green skin and yellow speckles, as they are usually waxier and creamier. Purple-skinned avocados are often less creamy. Choose long-shaped fruits that feel heavy and firm, indicating thick flesh.
2. Tips for ripening avocados
To ripen naturally, leave them at room temperature (23-25°C) on the floor, not in a plastic bag. You can place them next to bananas to help them ripen faster and more evenly.

mon_an.mo_ta: Nowadays, Russian Salad (Olivier Salad) is becoming increasingly popular in Vietnamese cuisine. This rich and creamy salad is a favorite for all family members. Let's learn how to make a delicious Russian Salad!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Canned peas and sweet corn - 1 can
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel and wash the potatoes and carrots, then boil until cooked.
Step 2: Wash and hard-boil the eggs, then peel. Separate the yolks and the whites.
Step 3: Let all boiled ingredients cool. Dice the carrots, potatoes, and egg whites into small cubes.
Step 4: Dice the ham and pickled cucumbers into similar small cubes.
Step 5: Place the potatoes, carrots, egg whites, ham, pickles, peas, and sweet corn into a large bowl.
Step 6: Add the egg yolks, salt, pepper, and mayonnaise to the bowl and mix well.
Step 7: Arrange on a plate and enjoy! Making Russian Salad is very easy, isn't it!

mon_an.ten: Delicious Stir-Fried Blood Cockles with Garlic, Butter, and Chili
mon_an.mo_ta: Let's cook stir-fried blood cockles with garlic and chili – a delicious weekend treat for the whole family. These cockles are fragrant with garlic and lemongrass, spicy with chili, and absolutely irresistible.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Soak and wash the blood cockles thoroughly. Bring water to a boil, blanch the cockles briefly, then remove one side of the shell.
Slice the pickled leeks lengthwise; wash and finely chop the Vietnamese coriander.
Peel and mince the garlic.
Crush the lemongrass and slice thinly.
Peel, wash, and julienne the ginger.
Step 2: Stir-fry the cockles
Heat oil in a pan, fry 1/2 of the minced garlic until golden brown, then remove and set aside.

Continue by sautéing the ginger, lemongrass, and the remaining garlic until fragrant. Add 1 tbsp sugar, 2 tbsp chili sauce, 1 tbsp sesame oil, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, seasoning powder, and seasoning salt, then bring to a boil.

Add the blood cockles and stir-fry over high heat until evenly coated with the sauce. Add the fried garlic and chopped leeks, then toss well. Add the chopped Vietnamese coriander and turn off the heat. Serve on a plate; it's delicious with steamed white rice.

Here is the finished dish. The cockle meat should be firm and sweet, fragrant with garlic, lemongrass, and ginger. The accompanying sauce should be a well-balanced blend of sour, spicy, salty, and sweet.
A few secrets for delicious stir-fried blood cockles:

The most important thing is to choose fresh cockles. When buying, look for those with their tongues sticking out; if they close their shells when touched, they are fresh. Avoid cockles that are too large or too small. Small ones shrink too much when cooked :P. Large ones can be tough. Therefore, choose medium-sized, uniform cockles that feel heavy and are tightly closed.
Blanch the cockles in boiling water over high heat so they cook without losing their sweetness. If the shells are hard to open, gently rub the mouth of the shell to make them easier to separate.

mon_an.mo_ta: This braised pork ribs with potatoes dish features firm yet tender, fall-off-the-bone meat, crunchy rib cartilage, and soft, floury potatoes infused with rich spices. Enjoying hot braised ribs with steamed rice in this cold weather is an excellent choice.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare ingredients for braised pork ribs with potatoes.
Peel the potatoes, wash them, and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Pick and discard the roots and wilted leaves of the cilantro, wash, drain, and chop finely.
Separate the green onions into white parts and green parts.
Cut the white parts into segments and finely chop the green parts.
Wash the pork ribs with water and drain.
Step 2: Cooking steps for braised pork ribs with potatoes.
First, add a little cooking oil to a pot and heat over medium heat.
Add the pork ribs and sear them until they are slightly golden.
Next, add the dried chilies, fish sauce, white peppercorns, sate sauce, and soy sauce, then stir well.
Stir the ribs for about 2 minutes, then add a small bowl of water.
When the water boils, reduce the heat to low. Simmer the ribs for about 15 minutes, then add the potatoes and the white parts of the green onions, tossing a few times.
Cover the pot and simmer for another 20 minutes or until the potatoes are tender.
When the potatoes are soft and the braising liquid has reduced to a thick sauce, turn off the heat.
Finally, scoop the ribs and potatoes into a bowl, sprinkle with chopped green onions and cilantro, and enjoy with hot rice.
Notes for a perfect braised pork ribs with potatoes dish:

For the ribs, you should choose loin ribs as they have plenty of tender meat. Choose fresh ribs with no odor and a bright pink color. If you like a crunchy texture, choose ribs that include cartilage.
For potatoes, choose medium-sized tubers with bright yellow skin (no green tint), firm to the touch, and a bright yellow interior when scraped.
After peeling, soak the potatoes immediately in water to remove starch, prevent browning, and stop oxidation.
If you prefer a darker color, you can add a bit of oyster sauce or caramel sauce (coconut caramel sauce).

This braised pork ribs with potatoes dish features firm yet tender, fall-off-the-bone meat, crunchy rib cartilage, and soft, floury potatoes infused with rich spices. Enjoying hot braised ribs with steamed rice in this cold weather is an excellent choice. With just a little time in the kitchen and simple ingredients, you can have a wonderful dish for the whole family. You will surely receive many compliments!

mon_an.ten: Potato Dumpling Soup with Meat Filling
mon_an.mo_ta: A soft, fragrant potato layer on the outside and a delicious meat filling inside – a perfect combination that makes this potato dumpling soup impossible to resist!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Spices: pepper, seasoning powder, salt, unsalted or salted butter
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the bones, blanch in boiling water, then simmer to make a broth.
Step 2: Boil the potatoes until very soft, mash thoroughly, and let cool.

Step 3: Marinate the ground beef with a little seasoning powder, minced shallots, and pepper for 10-15 minutes. Once the broth boils, skim the foam; when the bones are tender and the broth is sweet, remove the bones. Season to taste and keep the broth simmering so you can drop the dumplings in immediately.

Step 4: Put the mashed potatoes in a large bowl, add a pinch of salt and a tablespoon of melted butter (if using salted butter, omit the salt). Mix well, then slowly add the glutinous rice flour and knead until the dough is smooth and pliable (it may still be slightly sticky; usually it's kneaded while the potatoes are hot, but if it's too sticky, wait for it to cool to reduce stickiness).

Step 5: Divide the dough into equal pieces. Flatten a piece of dough in your hand (use dry glutinous rice flour if it sticks), place the beef filling in the center, fold the edges, roll into a ball, and drop immediately into the simmering broth. Repeat until finished.
Step 6: When the potato dumplings are soft and float to the surface, turn off the heat. Sprinkle with green onions and cilantro, ladle into bowls, add a bit of pepper, and serve hot.
Enjoy!

mon_an.ten: Pork Belly with Vegetables in Sweet and Sour Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: Pork belly with vegetables provides both protein and fiber. The pork is tender and fresh with a crispy exterior, smothered in a fragrant sweet and sour sauce. It's served with slightly pungent onions, colorful bell peppers, and sweet-tart pineapple. All ingredients blend together to create a wonderful sensation.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Pork belly or pork shoulder - 250 g
Ketchup, soy sauce, salt, pepper, cooking oil - ingredients
cac_buoc: Step 1:

Wash the pork belly and cut into bite-sized pieces. Marinate with a little pepper and soy sauce for about 10 minutes. Then, mix the marinated meat with the egg white; this helps the cornstarch adhere better.
Step 2:
Roll the meat in cornstarch, applying only a very thin layer! Then, fry until golden.

Heat a pan with oil; when the oil is hot, drop the meat in. Be careful not to use too high a heat, as it can burn the outside while leaving the inside raw. Flip the meat evenly so both sides cook and look appealing.
Step 3:
Peel and wash the onion, then cut into bite-sized pieces.
Wash the green and red bell peppers and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Peel the pineapple, remove the eyes, and cut into bite-sized pieces. You can buy pre-peeled pineapple to save time.
Heat a pan with oil, sauté minced garlic until fragrant, then add the vegetables and stir-fry with ketchup until everything is cooked and well-seasoned.
Step 4:

Once the meat is golden, remove it to a plate lined with paper towels to reduce greasiness. Then, add the meat to the pan with the vegetables and toss briefly so it absorbs the flavors without losing its crispiness. Season with a little sugar, salt, and pepper to taste.
Notes for a perfect pork belly with vegetables:
When coating the meat in cornstarch, keep the layer moderate; if it's too thick, the meat won't be as tasty and will take longer to cook.
When frying, use medium heat and flip occasionally so the meat cooks evenly and develops a beautiful golden-brown, crispy crust.
Besides pork belly, you can substitute with chicken, beef, or any meat you prefer.

Pork belly with vegetables provides both protein and fiber. The pork is tender and fresh with a crispy exterior, smothered in a fragrant sweet and sour sauce. It's served with slightly pungent onions, colorful bell peppers, and sweet-tart pineapple. All ingredients blend together to create a wonderful sensation. Take some time to make this for your family. It's not too difficult, rich in flavor, and sure to be a hit. Show off your cooking skills and enjoy the compliments!

mon_an.mo_ta: Korean cuisine is incredibly rich and diverse. A favorite among young people is fried sesame pork belly wrapped in lettuce. It's not difficult to make and the flavor is absolutely delicious. Let's try this recipe together.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Honey, soy sauce, sesame oil, toasted sesame seeds
cac_buoc: Peel the garlic and wash the ginger, then mince both.
Wash the pork and slice into thin, bite-sized pieces.
Marinate the meat with garlic, ginger, chili paste, honey, and soy sauce for at least 15 minutes to allow the flavors to penetrate.
Use a non-stick pan to fry the meat, brushing a thin layer of oil onto the surface.
Heat the pan and add the meat. Flip the pieces regularly and cook until golden brown on both sides.
When the meat is cooked, remove to a plate.
Sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds and toss so the seeds coat the meat.
Garnish with cilantro on top.
Serve hot with fresh vegetables, especially lettuce leaves to wrap the meat, and dip in chili paste for the best flavor.

The golden, fragrant meat with the nutty taste of sesame will make your family meal much more attractive. Korean-style fried sesame pork belly is easy yet wonderful, so don't hesitate to start cooking.

mon_an.mo_ta: Grilled pork-wrapped shrimp and pineapple is a unique combination. The aroma of pineapple, meat, and shrimp blending with the marinade creates an intoxicating scent that will surely captivate you from the first bite. Here is how to make it perfectly!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Marinade sauce (BBQ marinade available at supermarkets) - 1 tbsp
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Peel and mince the ginger; wash and finely chop the green onions.
Step 2:
Pour the marinade into a large bowl, add the ginger, green onions, and dried chili, then mix well.
Step 3:
Add the minced garlic and 2 tsp sugar, then use a whisk to blend the sauce mixture until smooth.
Step 4:
Peel the pineapple, remove the eyes, and cut into bite-sized pieces (as shown in the image).
Step 5:
Wash the shrimp, peel off the shells and heads, and remove the black vein on the back. Place a piece of pineapple on top of each shrimp.
Step 6:
Wash the pork belly and slice into long, thin strips. Use a bamboo skewer to pierce through the shrimp and pineapple, then wrap the pork belly strip around the outside.
Step 7:
Repeat until all ingredients are used, then arrange the skewers on a baking tray.
Step 8:
Use a brush or spoon to coat the meat with the sauce mixture and grill for 10-15 minutes.
Step 9:
Remember to flip the meat occasionally and brush on more sauce so the spices penetrate evenly and prevent burning.
The grilled skewers should have a beautiful golden color when finished; they are best served hot.
This dish can be eaten with rice vermicelli and dipping sauce, or it's also very good with steamed rice.

mon_an.mo_ta: Thai Pandan Chicken (Gai Hor Bai Toey) is a traditional Thai dish with a unique and attractive flavor. It is not only delicious but also very beautiful when presented. This dish has a simple recipe and is very suitable for daily family menus. Let's discover the secrets and show off your skills. This detailed guide makes it easy to prepare this fragrant dish.
cac_buoc: After preparing all the ingredients, follow these steps:

Wash the chicken and cut into bite-sized squares. Prepare the marinade by mixing fish sauce, coconut milk, oyster sauce, seasoning salt, sugar, garlic, shallots, and oil. Once it forms a thick sauce, marinate the chicken for at least 1 hour.
Next, wash the pandan leaves and drain. Once the chicken has absorbed the spices, wrap the chicken in the pandan leaves as shown in the illustration.
Heat a pan and fry the chicken until the meat is golden and the pandan leaves turn a light brown. Alternatively, you can bake the chicken at 200°C for about 15 minutes.
After frying, remove the chicken and place it on a plate lined with paper towels to reduce excess oil.
To make the dipping sauce, heat sugar and water in a small pot until the sugar dissolves. Then, add soy sauce and toasted sesame seeds and let cool.

The final result is fragrant, tender chicken that is well-seasoned with the distinct scent of pandan. The dipping sauce is rich and flavorful. Enjoy this dish hot with white rice, especially during cool autumn days.
Notes for making Thai Pandan Chicken:
Choose fresh, high-quality chicken. Cut into uniform squares to ensure even cooking.
Pandan leaves must be washed and dried before use to ensure they are fragrant and clean.
When marinating, let the meat sit for at least 1 hour so it becomes tender and more flavorful.
When wrapping the chicken, ensure it is wrapped tightly and neatly so the meat doesn't fall out during cooking.
When frying, use medium heat so the chicken cooks through without burning or drying out. If using an oven, monitor the time carefully.
When serving, pair the chicken with the rich dipping sauce and fresh herbs for a refreshing and delicious meal.

mon_an.mo_ta: In Vietnamese cuisine, eggs are a delicious, nutritious, and affordable staple. Today, we introduce the Korean Egg Roll (Gyeran-mari) to bring a unique and characteristic flavor of Korean cuisine to your table. Korean cuisine is famous for dishes like kimbap and kimchi, but the egg roll is also a familiar and attractive dish. Here is the recipe to get you started.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Spices: fish sauce, sugar, pepper, cooking oil, etc.
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients
Peel the onion and carrot, wash, and finely dice. (The smaller the dice, the faster they cook)
Remove seeds from the bell peppers, wash, and dice as small as the carrots and onions.
Wash and finely chop the green onions.
Step 1:
Crack the eggs into a large bowl, add 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp sugar, 1/2 tsp pepper, and whisk well. Then add the diced vegetables and stir again.
Step 2:

Heat a pan with 2 tbsp oil. When the pan is hot, slowly pour a sufficient amount of the egg mixture to cover the bottom of the pan. Spread it thinly and keep the heat low so the carrots and other vegetables cook through.
Step 3:
Fry until the bottom is set and the top is slightly tacky. Use a spatula to gently lift and roll the egg. Let it cook for a few seconds, turning it to ensure it's cooked through.
Step 4:
Remove the roll from the pan and repeat until all the egg mixture is used. Let the rolls cool for about 5 minutes. Then, use a knife to slice into bite-sized pieces and enjoy.
Notes for a better Korean Egg Roll:
This Korean-style egg roll is delicious with chili fish sauce, chili sauce, or soy sauce.
You can substitute bell peppers with other colorful vegetables like sweet corn or shiitake mushrooms depending on your taste. The smaller you chop the vegetables, the better the dish will be.

The recipe is simple and the presentation is beautiful. Adding a bit of cilantro will make the family meal more colorful and appealing, especially for children. Feel free to add other ingredients to suit your family's taste. Enjoy your meal!

mon_an.mo_ta: Gather around the family table to enjoy a roasted duck that tastes just as good as the one from the shop!
cac_buoc: Wash the duck thoroughly inside and out. Heat oil in a pan over medium heat and sear the duck to make the skin golden and crispy.
For the parts that don't touch the pan, ladle hot oil over them until the skin is evenly golden. Turn off the heat and remove the duck.
Prepare a pot large enough to fit the whole duck. Transfer 15ml of oil from the pan and sauté the garlic and ginger for 1 minute. Add the sugar and stir until completely dissolved.

Add the wine, soy sauce, dark soy sauce, vinegar, star anise, cloves, bay leaves, orange peel, peppercorns, and water. Stir well, then place the duck in the pot. The sauce should cover half the duck; add more water if necessary.
Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat and simmer for 50-60 minutes so the duck absorbs the spices. Remember to flip the duck halfway through so both sides are tender and flavorful.
When the duck is cooked, lift it out and drain any liquid from the cavity.
Preheat the oven to 220°C. Meanwhile, brush the honey mixture evenly over the entire duck.
Place the duck in the oven and roast for 12-15 minutes until the skin is crispy. Watch the oven carefully to avoid burning.
Remove the duck, let it cool slightly, then chop into bite-sized pieces. you can serve it with the braising liquid as a dipping sauce for extra flavor.

mon_an.ten: Crispy Fried Sticky Rice with Savory Pork and Dried Shrimp Dip
mon_an.mo_ta: Crunchy, hot sticky rice dipped in a perfectly salty savory sauce (Kho Quet) – this combination is enough to make you melt!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: A few shallots, a few chilies
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the shrimp and pork and drain. Peel the shrimp; dice the pork.
Step 2: Place the pork in a pan and stir until the fat renders and the meat is slightly golden and crispy.
Step 3: Prepare some thinly sliced shallots and minced chilies.

Step 4: Sauté some minced shallots in the rendered pork fat until fragrant, then add the shrimp and pork. Stir until the shrimp is firm, then season with 2 tbsp good fish sauce, a bit of sugar, and a splash of water.
Remove the shrimp and pork mixture to a plate.
Step 5: In the same pan, add more shallots and chilies and sauté until fragrant.
Step 6: Return the shrimp and pork mixture to the pan and toss well. Simmer the Kho Quet over low heat until the liquid reduces and becomes thick and syrupy.
Turn off the heat, sprinkle with a bit of pepper and chopped green onions.
Step 7: Wash the glutinous rice, toss with a pinch of salt, and place in a rice cooker with the appropriate amount of water. Cook as you would regular sticky rice.
Step 8: While the sticky rice is still hot, spread it onto a tray lined with plastic wrap, flatten it, and fry into thin cakes until golden and crispy. Remove to a plate lined with paper towels.
Now, simply serve the Kho Quet dip with the crispy fried sticky rice and enjoy.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Pickled Sesbania Flowers with a Rustic Flavor
mon_an.mo_ta: Have you ever tried pickled sesbania flowers? The crunchy texture of the flowers combined with a characteristic sour and slightly bitter taste, along with bean sprouts and chives, creates a rustic flavor that not many pickles can match. In today's article, we will guide you on how to make delicious pickled sesbania flowers.
cac_buoc: Prepare these ingredients to start making this delicious pickled sesbania flower dish!
Step 1:
In this first step, pick the sesbania flowers, removing the stems and any bruised or wilted flowers. We only pickle the flowers, not the stems!
After picking, wash them thoroughly.
Step 2:
Similarly with the bean sprouts, pick out and discard any crushed sprouts and any remaining bean skins!
Next, wash the bean sprouts and let them drain completely!
For the chives, remove any bruised or wilted leaves, wash them clean, and then cut the chives into sections about 3-4cm long.
Step 3:
Once the ingredients are washed, mix the sesbania flowers, bean sprouts, and chives together in a clean bowl.
Step 4:
Next, prepare a clean and dry ceramic or glass jar. You should not use plastic jars for pickling, as it is not good for your health and the pickles will not reach their full flavor!
Then, place the mixture of sesbania flowers, bean sprouts, and chives into the jar, and add a few slices of diagonally cut chili!
Take the clear settled part of the rice water and mix it with 1 tbsp of salt and 1/2 tbsp of sugar. Stir well and pour into the jar until the flowers are just submerged.
Use banana leaves or taro leaves to cover, or if unavailable, you can use the jar lid. After 1-2 days, it will be ready to eat!
The special point of this pickled sesbania flower dish is that we use rice water for pickling instead of regular plain water!
This pickled sesbania flower dish is even better when served with gỏi cuốn (spring rolls)!
Not only is it delicious, but this dish is also attractive with the yellow of the sesbania flowers, the white of the sprouts, the green of the chives, and a touch of red from the chili.

mon_an.ten: How to Cook Stir-Fried Pigeon with Pickled Eggplants
mon_an.mo_ta: In the diverse world of cuisine, every country has signature dishes with unique flavors. Among them, stir-fried pigeon with pickled eggplants is a fascinating dish originating from Vietnamese culinary culture. This dish brings freshness and uniqueness to your meal. Let's explore and show off your cooking skills to enjoy this special dish! This guide shows you how to cook stir-fried pigeon with pickled eggplants—a signature Vietnamese dish. Utilizing simple ingredients like fresh pigeon, pickled eggplants, salt, and spices, you will experience the bold and unique flavor of this dish.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Garlic, green onions, dried shallots, pepper - as needed
Sesame oil, fish sauce, salt, sugar, cooking oil - as needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
The pigeon should be pre-processed (plucked, singed over fire, internal organs removed), then chopped into small pieces.
Halve the pickled eggplants, remove the seeds, keeping only the flesh. Wash and squeeze them to reduce the sourness.
Peel the garlic; mince 1 bulb and leave 2 bulbs as whole cloves.
Mince the dried shallots.
Trim the roots of the green onions, wash, and cut into 5-7cm sections.

Marinate the pigeon meat with a bit of minced garlic, minced shallots, fish sauce, sugar, ground pepper, sesame oil, and some brine from the pickled eggplants. Let the meat absorb the flavors for 15-20 minutes.
Squeeze the eggplants dry, then marinate them with a bit of minced garlic, fish sauce, and sugar. Mix well and let them sit for 15-20 minutes.
Step 2: Cooking the stir-fried pigeon and eggplants
Pour cooking oil into a pan and heat it up, then add the whole garlic cloves and fry until golden and fragrant. Remove the garlic and set aside on a plate.

Next, add the pigeon meat to the pan and fry over medium heat until the meat is firm and has a nice color. Once fried, remove the pigeon to a separate plate, then drain most of the oil from the pan, leaving about 1 tsp.

Next, add the pickled eggplants to the pan and stir well, then add the pigeon meat, fried garlic, and green onions. Stir everything together. Season to taste, then turn off the heat and serve on a plate. This dish should be enjoyed while hot; the pigeon meat should be sweet, tender, and not dry. The spices blend together to create a special flavor that brings a fresh and attractive culinary experience to the meal.
Notes when making stir-fried pigeon with pickled eggplants
When making this dish, there are some important notes to ensure it is delicious and safe:

Choose fresh ingredients: Ensure the pigeon and pickled eggplants are purchased from reliable and fresh sources. Check that the pigeon has a bright color and no foul odor, and the eggplants have a bright color without signs of spoilage.
Hygiene: Before processing, clean the pigeon and eggplants by rinsing thoroughly under cold water to remove dirt and bacteria.
Pre-processing: Pluck, singe, and eviscerate the pigeon before cooking. Halve the pickled eggplants and remove the seeds, keeping only the flesh.

Seasoning and marinating: Marinate the pigeon with minced garlic, shallots, fish sauce, sugar, pepper, sesame oil, and eggplant brine so the meat is evenly seasoned. Marinate the eggplants with minced garlic, fish sauce, and sugar to enhance their characteristic flavor.

Processing and quick cooking: When frying the pigeon, use medium heat so the meat firms up while maintaining a good color. Stir-fry the eggplants, pigeon, and spices together to ensure the flavors meld. Adjust the seasoning to suit your taste.
See also: How to make mixed-stuffed pigeon meat

mon_an.ten: How to Cook Sweet and Refreshing Crab Riêu Soup for Summer
mon_an.mo_ta: Crab riêu soup (Canh riêu cua) is a favorite dish for many families during hot summer days. Enjoying a bowl of fragrant, cool crab soup with some fresh herbs and crunchy pickled eggplants will make your family meal much more appetizing!
cac_buoc: How to cook sweet and refreshing crab riêu soup for summer

After buying the crabs, put them in cold water with a little salt, stir, and wash clean. Then, remove the top shells, mouths, and aprons. Grind the crab bodies, add cold water, filter to get the crab liquid, and discard the residue (repeat this 2-3 times). Next, use a toothpick to scrape the yellow fat (roe) from the shells and set it aside.
Wash the tomatoes, halve them, flick out the seeds, and slice into wedges. Grill the dọc fruit until cooked, then peel off the skin.

Wash the sour starfruit, trim the edges, and slice lengthwise. Mash the fermented rice (mẻ) and shrimp paste, then filter for the liquid. Wash and finely mince the pork fat. Wash and mince the white parts of the green onions.
Next, sauté the minced onions with pork fat and the crab roe to create a colored oil, then set aside. Then, sauté the starfruit and tomatoes briefly and set aside.

Add the shrimp paste to the filtered crab liquid, stir well, and bring to a boil. When the crab meat rises to the surface in clusters (váng thịt), skim it out and set aside. Next, add the dọc fruit, starfruit, fermented rice liquid, and tomatoes to the pot and cook until tender, then add the crab meat back in. Season with fish sauce and salt to taste. When ready to eat, mash the starfruit and dọc fruit into the soup. Add the prepared colored roe oil. Serve hot with lettuce and aromatic herbs.
Notes for a sweet and refreshing crab riêu soup
The broth should be clear with a slightly pale pink tint. The crab meat should float in firm clusters, not broken, with a balanced mild sour taste.
How to choose good crabs:
To choose meaty crabs, select males with pointed aprons; to choose crabs with lots of roe, select females with large, rounded aprons.
During the full moon (13th to 16th of the lunar month), crabs tend to be thin. Crabs with more orange-colored alum staining are usually firmer.
Field crabs: Purple-brown ones are used for bún riêu, canh bún, canh riêu...

Choosing field crabs: Around the beginning of autumn is when field crabs are fattest. When buying, choose crabs with strong claws that point upward and try to pinch when touched, with all legs intact, moving fast, large and plump bodies, and bluish shells. They should be blowing bubbles constantly. Remember that dead field crabs cannot be eaten.
No matter how busy you are, do not let the seller choose for you; select them yourself, and clean and grind them at home. This makes the soup cleaner and sweeter.

When grinding the crab meat, use a small mortar to pound it and then filter. Remember to add a pinch of salt during the pounding process. When first placing the pot on the stove, use long chopsticks to stir continuously. Once the water is warm, reduce to low heat and keep the lid slightly ajar to prevent the crab meat from boiling over.

When extracting the crab roe, sauté it with fragrant dried shallots before adding it back to the pot to enhance the aroma. Then pour it into the filtered crab water; this makes the soup very fragrant and gives the roe an attractive golden color. When adding vegetables, do not dump them in all at once; choose one corner to submerge them gently so as not to break the crab meat clusters.

mon_an.ten: How to Cook Delicious Hot Beef and Seaweed Soup
cac_buoc: If you love Korean cuisine, you are likely familiar with seaweed soup. Cooking beef and seaweed soup is simple yet delicious, attractive, and provides many health benefits. Explore this article to learn how to cook beef and seaweed soup – a delicious soup with signature Korean flavors.
I. Traditional Beef and Seaweed Soup Recipe
1. Ingredients
150g dried seaweed
100g beef tenderloin
4 cloves garlic
Cooking oil
Salt
Soy sauce.
2. How to cook beef and seaweed soup
Step 1: Prepare ingredients
Soak the dried seaweed in warm water for 20 minutes until it expands. Once fully expanded, use scissors to cut it into bite-sized pieces.
Rinse the seaweed 3-4 times and drain to remove the fishy smell and reduce saltiness.
Step 2: Cooking the soup
Place a pot on the stove, add 2 tbsp of cooking oil and minced garlic, and sauté until fragrant. When the garlic turns golden, add the beef and stir-fry until firm.

Next, add the seaweed to the pot and stir-fry with the beef. Pour in enough water to nearly fill the pot and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce the heat and continue to simmer until the beef is tender.
Season the soup with 1 tbsp of soy sauce or to taste. Then, turn off the heat.
Step 3: Enjoy
Ladle the beef and seaweed soup into a bowl and serve with white rice.

Enjoy the beef and seaweed soup while it is still hot and fragrant. By carefully preparing the seaweed, there will be no fishy smell. The tender beef combined with the savory broth creates a simple yet highly nutritious dish for the family.
II. Beef, Seaweed, and Tofu Soup Recipe
1. Ingredients
1 pack dried seaweed
200g chicken bones
500g beef shank
1 block soft tofu
200g Udon noodles
Green onions: 4 stalks
Garlic: 4 cloves
Soy sauce: 2 tsp
Sesame oil: 1 tbsp
Ginger: 4 slices
Seasonings: Salt, pepper, bouillon powder (to taste)
2. How to process beef, seaweed, and tofu soup
2.1. Prepare and marinate the beef
To remove the beef's odor, soak it in water mixed with 1 tbsp of salt for about 15 minutes, then rinse and drain. Use a knife to slice the beef into thin, bite-sized pieces.
Marinate the beef with 1 tsp of soy sauce and 1/4 tsp of pepper. Mix well and let the beef absorb the flavors for 15-20 minutes.
2.1. Prepare other ingredients
To help the seaweed expand evenly and remove the fishy smell, soak it in a bowl with 200ml of cold water and 4 slices of ginger for 20-30 minutes until soft.
Then, remove the seaweed, rinse with cold water, and drain. Next, cut the seaweed into small pieces about one finger-joint long.
Soak the chicken bones in salt water for 15 minutes, then rinse with cold water and drain.
Rinse the tofu with water, then cut into cubes about one large finger-joint thick.
Blanch the Udon noodles in boiling water, then remove and rinse with cold water; drain.
Prepare the green onions by washing and chopping them. Crush the garlic, then mince finely.
2.2. Cooking the soup

Place a pot on the stove and boil about 2 liters of filtered water. Add the chicken bones and bring to a boil. Then, reduce the heat and simmer the bones for 30 minutes to 1 hour to extract the sweetness. Afterward, remove the chicken bones from the pot.
Place a pan on the stove, add 1 tbsp of sesame oil, and heat it up.

Next, add the minced garlic, seaweed, and marinated beef to the pan and stir-fry over high heat until the beef is seared. Then, pour all the chicken broth into the pan, cover, and cook for about 10 minutes.
After 10 minutes, add the tofu and Udon noodles to the pan, cover, and cook for another 5 minutes.
Next, add 1/2 tsp of bouillon powder and 1 tsp of soy sauce to the pan, then stir well. Sprinkle with chopped green onions and adjust the seasoning to taste to finish the soup.
2.3. Finished product

With just a few simple steps, you will have a delicious and attractive beef, seaweed, and tofu soup. The broth is clear and sweet, the tofu is soft, and the beef is well-seasoned, combined with the crunch of the seaweed to create an irresistible dish!
III. How to properly prepare seaweed
1. Using salt

Soak dried seaweed in cold water for 15-20 minutes until soft. Then, remove, rinse, and squeeze out the water. Next, gently massage the seaweed with salt for 1-2 minutes, then rinse again with clean water. Using salt helps remove the fishy smell and some of the slime.
2. Using fresh ginger
Soak dried seaweed in cold water with a bit of minced ginger for 15-20 minutes until soft. Then, remove, rinse, and proceed with cooking.
3. Removing fishy smell with vinegar
Soak seaweed in cold water for 15-20 minutes until soft. Next, add a little vinegar and massage gently for 1-2 minutes, then rinse with clean water.
4. Marinating with sesame oil
Soak dried seaweed in cold water for 15-20 minutes until soft. Then, rinse and drain. Next, cut the seaweed and marinate it with salt, bouillon powder, and sesame oil before cooking.
IV. How to buy fresh beef
1. How to choose fresh beef
Choose beef that is bright red with yellow fat and white tendons. When pressed, the beef should feel firm and have a characteristic beefy smell.
Choose meat with small, fine grains that are elastic when pressed. Avoid meat with large grains, dark red color, and deep yellow fat.
Limit choosing meat that is pale green, has white circular spots in the grains, strange odors, slime, or feels soft and leaves a dent when pressed.
2. How to prepare beef to avoid toughness
When slicing beef, slice it thinly and across the grain. Slicing beef correctly helps it cook faster and prevents toughness.
You can also place the beef in the refrigerator for 20-30 minutes before processing. This makes the meat firmer and easier to cut.
Additionally, you can marinate the beef with a little cooking oil to make it softer and prevent toughness.

mon_an.ten: How to Cook Delicious Sweet and Sour Crab Hotpot with Tamarind Leaves
mon_an.mo_ta: Crab hotpot with tamarind leaves is a rustic, nutritious dish. Although this is a signature hotpot from the Mekong Delta, its flavor is very easy to enjoy and can satisfy diners from all regions. The ingredients are easy to find, and the cooking method is both fast and simple. Let's give it a try.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Side vegetables - Water spinach, water mimosa, taro stems, etc.
Seasonings - Fish sauce, salt, pepper, sugar, rice vinegar
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Wash and scrub the crabs clean, remove the shells and aprons, and quarter the bodies.
Pick and wash the various vegetables. Wash the tomatoes and cut into wedges. Mince the garlic, chili, and lemongrass. Lightly crush the tamarind leaves.
Peel the taro stems, slice diagonally, rub with salt to remove slime and prevent itching, then rinse with cold water.
Step 2: Cooking the crab hotpot with tamarind leaves
Sauté the minced shallots, garlic, and lemongrass until fragrant. Add the chili for color, then add the tomatoes and sauté until soft. Then, add the crabs and stir-fry briefly.

Season with spices and add the tamarind leaves along with about 3 tbsp of fermented rice vinegar to create a natural sourness for the hotpot. Simmer for 5-10 minutes until the crabs are cooked, then remove the crabs to a separate plate. Use the hotpot broth to dip the vegetables. Serve with rice vermicelli and salt-pepper-lime or fish sauce as desired.
Notes for a delicious crab hotpot with tamarind leaves:
Do not simmer the crabs for too long; the acid in the vinegar and tamarind leaves will make the crab meat mushy and less tasty. Just 5-10 minutes until the crabs are just cooked is enough.
Crush the tamarind leaves so they release their sour flavor and the broth doesn't become messy with broken leaves.

mon_an.ten: How to Roast Delicious Pork Tenderloin
mon_an.mo_ta: Roasting pork tenderloin is an excellent way to create a flavorful and appealing dish for parties or gatherings. When roasted correctly, it develops a crispy outer crust that protects the tender, juicy, and flavorful meat inside. The process requires patience and skill, from selecting fresh meat and marinating with the right ratios to adjusting the temperature and roasting time. Here is a guide on how to roast pork tenderloin to perfection following this detailed recipe. Learn how to roast delicious pork tenderloin with step-by-step instructions covering meat selection, marinating, and proper timing and temperature. This roasted pork tenderloin will feature a crispy crust and tender meat, creating an irresistible flavor.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Choose the right pork tenderloin

To roast delicious pork, choose fresh meat with a pink hue. Pork loin, being leaner, can easily become dry and tough regardless of how you cook it, especially when you want it well-done for safety. Therefore, buying fresh meat and cooking it promptly is crucial to achieving a medium-done result and perfect flavor.
Discard any pork that is grey, unevenly colored, or has a strange odor. Fresh pork should be bright pink and free of unpleasant smells.

Raw or undercooked pork can contain Trichinella spiralis, which causes Trichinosis. In the US, there are about 11 cases of Trichinosis annually, mostly from consuming wild game. However, there is no need to worry excessively or avoid pork entirely. Instead, be careful when selecting meat and ideally purchase from reliable sources like supermarkets.
Step 2: Prepare the tenderloin
Pork tenderloin should be pink, clean, and have very little fat. If the piece has too much fat, trim off the excess.
To prevent the spread of bacteria in the kitchen, do not wash raw meat in the sink. Instead, use paper towels to pat the meat dry.
Step 3: Consider marinating before roasting

Pork tenderloin, being lean, easily absorbs flavors from marinades, dry rubs, or any seasoning. You can marinate the meat according to your preference, using homemade blends or store-bought products. To marinate, place the seasoned meat in a sealed bowl or a Ziploc bag and refrigerate overnight or for at least 4 hours before roasting. Here are some marinade suggestions for pork tenderloin:

For a traditional sweet and sour marinade, mix 1/4 cup olive oil, 1 minced garlic clove, 1 tbsp salt, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp brown sugar, and 1 tsp dried chili powder. Adjust quantities to taste. Rub the marinade over the pork and leave overnight, turning the meat regularly to ensure even absorption.

For a sweet and spicy marinade, mix 1 cup fresh orange juice, 1 tbsp ketchup, 1 tbsp Dijon mustard, 1 tsp garlic powder, chili powder, white sugar, paprika, and Worcestershire sauce. Add a handful of chopped cilantro to the mixture.
For a sweet BBQ pork marinade, mix 2/3 cup white sugar, 1/2 cup brown sugar, 1/2 tsp dried chili powder, five-spice powder, salt, and pepper. Add 2-4 tbsp apple cider vinegar to the mixture.
Step 4: Bring the pork tenderloin to room temperature

After the pork has marinated overnight in the refrigerator, let it sit at room temperature for about 1 hour before roasting to ensure even cooking. If the meat is still cold when it hits the heat, it will be difficult to achieve uniform doneness.
You can place the meat on a kitchen counter while you prepare the grill or oven. This allows the meat to warm up gradually, ensuring proper cooking time and quality.
Step 5: Apply a dry rub to the exterior

Some people prefer to remove the meat from the marinade and apply a dry rub before roasting. Depending on the marinade used, you can choose a bold or mild dry rub. The dry rub creates a caramelized crust and adds depth of flavor. You can prepare your own or use a pre-made mix. Before applying the rub, brush a little olive oil on the meat to help the spices stick better.
Here are some simple dry rubs you can use:
Rub 1-2 tbsp olive oil over the meat, then sprinkle with coarse salt and black pepper.
Rub 1-2 tbsp olive oil over the meat, then apply a mixture of 1 tbsp dried oregano, turmeric powder, coriander powder, garlic powder, and bay leaf.

Rub 1-2 tbsp olive oil over the meat. Toast cumin seeds, mustard seeds, and coriander seeds in a dry pan. Once fragrant, turn off the heat and crush them in a mortar and pestle or with a knife. Mix the crushed spices with 1 tsp dried chili powder, 2 tbsp chopped fresh rosemary, salt, and pepper. Finally, rub this fresh herb mixture onto the meat.
By using these dry rubs, you can bring a unique flavor to your roasted pork tenderloin.

Final result: You can serve the roasted meat with white rice and pickles to balance the richness. Alternatively, slice it thinly and wrap it in rice paper with fresh herbs, pineapple, and cucumber for a delicious treat.

mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried napa cabbage with pork is not only simple but also very easy to make, perfect for those who want a quick and delicious lunch or dinner. The bright, crisp, and sweet napa cabbage combined with savory pork creates a harmonious balance of flavors. With just a few simple steps and easy-to-find ingredients, you can have a restaurant-quality dish at home. This traditional Vietnamese home-cooked meal features crunchy napa cabbage and rich pork belly. Discover this simple recipe to create a tasty meal for your family.
cac_buoc: 1. Prepare the pork
To prepare the pork before cooking, you have several options:

Take some salt and rub it onto the surface of the pork for 3-5 minutes. Then, rinse the meat several times with clean water and let it drain. Next, use a knife to cut the pork into bite-sized thin slices.
Tips to remove pork odor:
Method 1: Blanch the pork by boiling water and placing the meat in for 3-5 minutes. Then, rinse it several times with clean water.
Method 2: Use a mixture of salt and white wine to rub the meat for about 5 minutes, then rinse with clean water 1-2 times.
Method 3: A common method is to soak the pork in rice water for about 15 minutes.
These methods will help remove odors and prepare the pork for a more fragrant dish.
2. Prepare other ingredients
After purchasing the napa cabbage, cut off the base and cut it into bite-sized pieces. Next, soak the cabbage in diluted salt water for 5-10 minutes, then rinse 1-2 times with clean water and drain.
For the green onions and cilantro, remove the roots and any wilted parts, then wash them under running water and drain.
Next, use a mortar to crush 3 white parts of the green onion with 1/2 tsp ground pepper. Use a pestle to grind them finely. Finally, cut the remaining green onions and cilantro into sections.
3. Stir-fry the cabbage with pork
Once the ingredients are ready, place a pan on the stove and heat 2 tbsp of cooking oil over medium heat. When the oil is hot, add the crushed onion and pepper mixture and sauté until fragrant.

Next, add 200g of pork to the pan and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes. When the pork has slightly firmed up, season with 1 tsp MSG (optional), 1/2 tbsp sugar, 1/2 tbsp fish sauce, 1/2 tsp seasoning powder, and 1/2 tsp salt. Continue to stir-fry for 3 minutes.
When the pork has absorbed the seasonings, add 300g of napa cabbage to the pan and stir-fry for another 3-5 minutes.

When the cabbage is just cooked and looks slightly translucent, adjust the seasoning to your taste. Then, add all the green onions and cilantro, give it a quick toss, and turn off the heat. Finally, plate the dish and enjoy.
How to choose fresh ingredients
1. How to choose fresh meat
Color: Fresh pork has a bright red or pink color, not dull or turning unusual colors.
Firmness and elasticity: When pressing the meat with your finger, it should feel firm and have good elasticity like rubber. The surface should not be slimy or too soft.

Avoid buying pork with unusual signs: Avoid meat that is dark or has strange small spots. Pay special attention if the pork has an unusual foul odor, as this may indicate it has been treated with chemicals for preservation.
To ensure food quality and safety, choose fresh pork with the above characteristics.
2. How to choose fresh napa cabbage
Color and leaves: Fresh napa cabbage has thin white leaves with light green tips. The surface should not be rough and should be free of small spots caused by insects.

Size and weight: Choose medium-sized cabbage, neither too large nor too small. When picked up, it should feel heavy for its size, and the leaves should be tightly packed together, not loose or falling apart.
Avoid buying dark green cabbage: Cabbage that is too dark green is usually old; its sweetness and crispness have decreased, and the nutritional content is no longer at its peak.

mon_an.mo_ta: Chicken and vegetable stew – A simple and delicious dish using skinless chicken breast as a rich protein source. You can freely combine ingredients to make the soup more nutritious! Check out how to cook this refreshing and sweet chicken vegetable stew in the article below. A great cooking guide for Chicken and Vegetable Stew.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Clean all vegetables, peel them, and dice them into bite-sized pieces, not too small or too large. Cut the tomatoes and onions into wedges.

Step 2: Sauté the potatoes, carrots, and onions. Then, add chicken bones and water to the pot and bring to a boil. Alternatively, you can simmer the chicken bones separately to make a clear broth first before adding the vegetables.

Step 3: Simmer over low heat for 15 minutes until the vegetables are soft, then add the celery to the pot. Season one last time to taste. Since the soup contains carrots and chicken bones, it has a natural sweetness, so you don't need to add MSG.

mon_an.mo_ta: Spicy Fried Chicken Wings – an irresistible dish for a delicious meal. No need to go to a fast-food restaurant when you can make these perfect chicken wings at home. A great recipe for Spicy Fried Chicken Wings.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Preparation:
Wash the chicken wings and remove the skin if desired. If you prefer them rich, keep the skin on!
Marinate the wings with grated ginger, 1 tsp salt, and 1 tsp pepper. Mix well. Place in a plastic bag and marinate in the freezer for about 30 minutes.
Step 2: Peel the garlic, chop the onion, and place them in a blender with the ginger. Blend until smooth.
Step 3:
Place the blended mixture into a pot along with the Gochujang, sugar, rice wine, ketchup, soy sauce, vinegar, and corn syrup (quantities as listed in the preparation section).
Place the pot on the stove, stir the mixture until it boils, then turn off the heat.
Step 4:
Remove the chicken wings from the freezer and pour cornstarch into the bag. Shake well to coat the chicken evenly, then remove and shake off any excess flour.

Heat oil in a pan. When the oil is hot, drop the wings in to fry. Only fry a sufficient amount at a time so the chicken cooks properly; overcrowding will make the chicken take longer to cook and the meat may become soggy.
Remove the wings and place them on a plate lined with paper towels.
Step 5: Put the fried wings into the sauce pot. Cook over medium heat until the sauce coats the wings and thickens. Serve hot with rice or as a snack.
Source: BeyondKimchee

mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried Chicken Wings with Basil – A daily delicious dish full of flavor and color that enhances your meal without taking much time to prepare and cook. How to make Stir-fried Chicken Wings with Basil.
cac_buoc: Step 1: After purchasing the chicken wings, wash them with water and chop them into bite-sized pieces or leave them whole according to your family's preference. Pick the young basil leaves and wash them clean.
Step 2: Mince the garlic and sauté until fragrant. Next, add the chicken wings to the pan and stir-fry with the garlic.

Step 3: Season with chili, soy sauce, fish sauce, and sugar to taste. Finally, add the basil leaves and stir-fry briefly before turning off the heat. Since basil leaves cook very quickly, watch the time so they don't become mushy.
Transfer the dish to a plate and enjoy hot with your family!
Source: Kenh14

mon_an.ten: Refreshing Bitter Melon and Shrimp Summer Soup
mon_an.mo_ta: Bitter melon and shrimp soup is a favorite for many families on hot summer days, featuring fresh shrimp, fiber-rich and healthy bitter melon, and a refreshing broth. With just a little time in the kitchen, you'll have a delicious dish to treat your family and friends!
cac_buoc: How to make bitter melon and shrimp soup for 4 people:
Prepare ingredients for bitter melon and shrimp soup:
Peel, rinse, and mince the garlic.
Trim the roots and wilted leaves of the scallions, rinse, and chop finely.
Rinse the shrimp with water, then rinse with wine to remove the fishy odor, and rinse again with water. Once prepped, mince the shrimp.
Rinse the bitter melon.
Steps to make bitter melon and shrimp soup:
Step 1:
Cut the bitter melon in half, remove the seeds, and slice into thin pieces.
Step 2:
Next, place the bitter melon in a colander, sprinkle with a little salt, toss well, and let sit for 10 minutes. Then rinse and drain. This helps remove some of the bitterness.
In a small pot, heat the cooking oil and sauté the garlic until fragrant.
Add the shrimp and stir-fry until firm, then pour in a sufficient amount of water for the soup and bring to a boil.
Step 3:
Add the bitter melon and cook for 3 minutes.
Add salt, sugar, and fish sauce to taste, then simmer for a few minutes before adding the chopped scallions and black pepper.
Finally, ladle the soup into bowls and enjoy.
Notes for a delicious bitter melon and shrimp soup
Bitter melon soup will have a slightly bitter taste, so if you are not used to it, use less bitter melon so the soup isn't too bitter.
Do not overcook, as it will make the bitter melon more bitter and lose the natural flavor of the dish.
When choosing bitter melon, select long, straight ones that are firm with no signs of being soft or mushy. After slicing, soak them in diluted salt water to remove toxins and reduce bitterness.
Other ways to remove the bitterness of bitter melon:
Method 1: Remove the white pith
Cut the bitter melon lengthwise and completely remove the white pith closest to the flesh. The bitterness will be significantly reduced.
Method 2: Cold treatment
Keep the bitter melon at -8°C or chop it and soak it in ice water for a while.
Method 3: Soaking in water
