Halve the bitter melon, remove the seeds, slice thinly, and rinse with cold water. While rinsing, gently squeeze the bitter melon with your hands. Change the water 3-4 times; the bitter melon will be less bitter and sweeter.
Method 4: Cook with other foods

Stir-frying bitter melon with chili will reduce the bitterness. Alternatively, rinse and thinly slice the bitter melon, heat a pan (or pot) without oil, stir-fry until cooked, and leave it in the pan. Only when stir-frying with other dishes should you take the cooked bitter melon out to mix and season.
Method 6: High-temperature treatment

Blanch the bitter melon in boiling water before use. The bitter compounds are destroyed at temperatures above 80°C. If rinsed again with cold water, the bitterness will be completely gone. However, high-temperature treatment has the downside of losing many precious nutrients in the bitter melon.

mon_an.mo_ta: With the fragrant aroma of mushrooms, the bright orange of carrots, the reddish-brown of beef, and the green of scallions, all combine to create an appealing and wonderful dish to enjoy! Refer to the beef and enoki mushroom soup recipe below. Let's get started!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Rinse the beef fillet, pat dry with a clean towel, slice thinly, and marinate with 1/2 tsp of seasoning powder.
Step 2:

Trim the roots of the enoki mushrooms, separate into small clusters, soak in diluted salt water, rinse, and drain. Peel the carrots, rinse, and dice into large cubes. Trim the roots of the scallions, rinse, and chop finely.
Step 3:

Sauté the minced garlic with 1/2 tsp of seasoning powder until fragrant. Pour in the broth. Season with salt, sugar, and 1 tsp of seasoning powder. When the broth boils, add the beef and mushrooms; do not cover the lid, and bring back to a boil. Turn off the heat, then add pepper and scallions.

mon_an.mo_ta: A delicious and easy-to-make dish – Sour Mushroom Soup makes your meal more appetizing. Learn to cook this dish with the crunchiness of mushrooms and taro stems, and the gentle sourness of pineapple and tomatoes.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Rinse the tomato and cut into wedges. Peel the taro stems, slice into bite-sized pieces, and massage with salt several times to remove the itching sensation. Prepare these for the sour mushroom soup.

Step 2: Trim the roots of the enoki mushrooms and soak in diluted salt water for 15 minutes. Then remove and drain. While the mushrooms are soaking, rinse and finely chop the scallions and sawtooth herb.

Step 3: Remove the eyes from the pineapple, rinse, and slice into bite-sized pieces. Place a pot on the stove and sauté the chopped shallots with a little oil until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and pineapple, stir-frying with a pinch of salt to soften the tomatoes quickly.
Step 4: Add water to the pot from step 3. When the water boils, add the mushrooms. Season with salt and sugar to taste. Cook until it boils, then reduce to low heat and simmer.
Step 5: Finally, add the taro stems to the pot, bring back to a boil, and season one last time to taste.

mon_an.ten: Mustard Greens Soup with Ground Pork
mon_an.mo_ta: Mustard greens soup with pork – delicious and easy to eat when combining refreshing mustard greens with pork meatballs and the aroma of ginger. Refer to the recipe for mustard greens soup with ground pork below! Learn how to make this delicious soup.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Trim the roots of the mustard greens, rinse, and soak in diluted salt water for 15 minutes. Cut them into halves or thirds so they aren't too long, then drain.
Step 2: Mix the ground pork with some minced shallots and seasoning. Form into small meatballs.
Step 3: Boil a pot of water with a little seasoning and a few slices of ginger. When the water boils, drop the meatballs in and cook until the water returns to a boil.
Step 4: Add the mustard greens and season to taste. Cook for a moment until the greens are just tender, then turn off the heat. Ladle into bowls and serve hot with rice.

mon_an.ten: Pork Rib and Lotus Root Soup
mon_an.mo_ta: Sweet and refreshing Pork Rib and Lotus Root Soup. This soup is perfect for cool summer days. The sweetness of the ribs and the crunchy lotus root will be a favorite combination for this easy-to-make dish.
cac_buoc: With just 4 simple steps, you'll have a sweet and refreshing Pork Rib and Lotus Root Soup:
Step 1: Peel the lotus root, rinse, and slice into bite-sized pieces. Ensure all mud inside the lotus root holes is completely removed and rinsed clean.
Step 2: Rinse the pork ribs. Place them in a pot of cold water to blanch; when the water boils, turn off the heat and discard the water. Add fresh water to start the soup.
Step 3: Add the lotus root to the pot with the ribs. Simmer for about 40 minutes until the ribs and lotus root are tender. To save time and fuel, you should use a pressure cooker. Season to taste.
Step 4: When the ribs and lotus root are tender, add scallions and cilantro, stir briefly, and turn off the heat. The steps for Pork Rib and Lotus Root Soup are now complete.

mon_an.mo_ta: A delicious and easy-to-make Pork Rib and Taro Soup for a more appetizing meal. Learn how to cook this tasty soup.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Rinse the pork ribs and chop into bite-sized pieces. Place in a pot of water, bring to a boil, then drain and discard the water. Rinse the ribs again until clean. Place the ribs back in a pot with fresh water; you can use a pressure cooker to save gas. Add salt and minced shallots, then cook until the ribs are tender.
Step 2: Trim the scallions and sawtooth herb, rinse, and chop finely. Peel the taro, rinse, and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Step 3: Add the taro to the pot with the ribs and season again. Cook until the taro is tender.
Step 4: Turn off the heat, add the scallions and sawtooth herb, stir well, and add a little MSG and black pepper to enhance the flavor of the Pork Rib and Taro Soup.

mon_an.ten: Korean-Style Beef, Tomato, and Bean Sprout Soup
mon_an.mo_ta: Beef, tomato, and bean sprout soup cooked in Korean style brings a new twist to a familiar dish. It is an easy-to-make and easy-to-eat dish for the upcoming hot summer days. Refer to the recipe for beef and bean sprout soup below! Without many ingredients or a complicated process, you will have a novel beef and bean sprout soup with a distinct Korean culinary style.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Rinse the beef and slice into bite-sized pieces. Marinate the beef with crushed ginger, crushed garlic, a little salt, black pepper, and cooking oil. Mix well and let the beef absorb the flavors.
Step 2: Soak and rinse the bean sprouts in diluted salt water.
Step 3: Add cooking oil to a pot and sauté the beef for about 2 minutes.

Step 4: Add water to the pot. When it boils, skim off the foam. Season to taste, then add the bean sprouts, chili powder (depending on your spice preference), and scallions. Turn off the heat and ladle the soup into bowls.
The beef and bean sprout soup is now finished.

mon_an.ten: Ground Pork Soup with Mushrooms and Tomatoes
mon_an.mo_ta: Ground pork soup with mushrooms and tomatoes is perfect for hot days. This daily recipe features the natural sweetness of mushrooms combined with the sourness of tomatoes and ground pork, making it an easy-to-make dish for sunny days.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Marinate the ground pork with a little salt and black pepper.
Step 2: Rinse the tomatoes and cut into wedges.
Step 3: Trim the mushroom stems, rinse, and soak in diluted salt water for 15 minutes, then drain in a colander. Trim the scallions and cut into sections. Peel, rinse, and thinly slice the shallots.
Step 4: Place a pot on the stove, add a little oil, sauté the shallots until fragrant, then add the pork and stir-fry until cooked. Next, add the tomatoes and seasoning and stir-fry together.

Step 5: Pour cold water into the pot, bring to a boil, and season to taste. Once the soup boils, add the mushrooms and cook until it boils again, then add the scallions. Turn off the heat, and the Ground Pork Soup with Mushrooms and Tomatoes is complete.

mon_an.ten: Thai-Style Hot and Sour Shrimp Soup
mon_an.mo_ta: Thai-style hot and sour shrimp soup – an addictive dish for anyone visiting Thailand. Learn how to cook this delicious Thai soup.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Lemongrass, galangal, shallots, lime leaves, scallions, cilantro, fresh chilies
cac_buoc: Prepare the marrow bones for the broth: Blanch the bones in boiling water, then simmer in a pressure cooker until tender to save gas.
Step 1: Peel the shrimp, remove the heads, devein, and rinse clean. The shrimp heads can be added to the broth for extra sweetness.

Step 2: Rinse the lemongrass, cut in half, and bruise. Peel and thinly slice the galangal. Rinse the lime leaves. Slice and mince the shallots. Cut the tomatoes into wedges. Soak the straw mushrooms in salt water, trim the stems, and cut in half for the soup.
Step 3: Heat oil in a pan, sauté the shallots until fragrant, then add the tomatoes and lightly sauté. Add the shrimp and stir-fry until just cooked.

Step 4: Pour the broth into a pot along with the galangal, lemongrass, and shallots. Season and bring to a boil, then add the shrimp and tomatoes. When the water boils again, add the mushrooms and lime leaves; cook until just done, as overcooking will make the shrimp mushy and lose their sweetness. Add sate sauce, coconut milk, and lime juice, bring to a boil, sprinkle with scallions and cilantro, then remove from the heat.
Source: Ngoi sao

mon_an.ten: Quick and Easy Grilled Chicken Feet
mon_an.mo_ta: Quick grilled chicken feet – simple and delicious for him to snack on during Euro or World Cup seasons. Discover how to make this dish through the recipe below! Learn how to make quick grilled chicken feet.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning - Honey, seasoning powder, oyster sauce, cooking oil, minced garlic
cac_buoc: Step 1: Rinse the chicken feet, soak in diluted salt water for 10 minutes, or rub salt directly onto the feet to clean. Then blanch the chicken feet in water with crushed ginger for fragrance, then remove and drain.

Step 2: Prepare the grilling sauce: mix honey, seasoning powder, oyster sauce, and minced garlic. Marinate the chicken feet for 2-3 hours to absorb the flavors. If you are short on time, use a fork to prick small holes in the feet and marinate for 30 minutes to 1 hour.
Step 3: Grill the chicken feet over charcoal or in an oven, occasionally brushing with oil to make them shiny and delicious.
This dish can be served with chili sauce or salt and lime juice.

mon_an.mo_ta: Once finished, Jokbal features the deep amber hue of Korean soy sauce, the natural sweetness of vegetables, and a mild kick from dried chilies. Each slice of meat is savory, deeply flavorful, and paired with a crispy, aromatic skin. This delicious dish is perfect with steamed white rice, especially during the chilly days of autumn. Check out our recipe below to make it yourself!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Korean dark soy sauce - a bit
½ tsp pepper, 1 tbsp salt, caramel sauce, 2 tbsp rice wine, 2 dried chilies - seasoning
Star anise, cinnamon, licorice, goji berries, astragalus, Job's tears, rehmannia - medicinal herbs
Apple, pumpkin, radish, pineapple, onion - fruits and vegetables
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients:
Scrape any hair off the trotters, wash thoroughly, and soak in cold water for 1 hour. Soaking in cold water helps the skin become crispier when cooked.
Cooking steps:
Step 1:
First, wash the marrow bones thoroughly to remove any odors. Then, blanch them in boiling water to remove impurities and any remaining smell.

Once the marrow bones are blanched and cleaned, simmer them to make a broth (simmer for about 3–4 hours). To enhance the flavor, you can add some shiitake mushrooms or a bit of cinnamon while simmering the bones.
Step 2:
Blanch the trotters once over high heat with soy sauce, garlic, ginger, and ground coffee to remove any gamey smell and impurities. Once the water boils, remove the trotters and wash them clean.
Step 3:
Next, place all the seasonings, medicinal herbs, and fruits into a clean cloth bag and tie it securely.
Step 4:
Arrange the prepared ingredients and the blanched trotters in a large pot, cover tightly, and simmer for about 1 hour 30 minutes or until the trotters are tender.
Step 5:

Finally, when the trotters are cooked, remove them and place on a rack to drain and cool slightly. Slice the trotters into bite-sized pieces and arrange them on a plate. You can garnish by sprinkling roasted sesame seeds over the layered meat before serving.
Instructions for milk-braised trotters
How to make salt-cured trotters
Notes for a perfect Jokbal:

How to choose good trotters: Go to the market early in the morning to pick fresh trotters that don't have an unpleasant smell. Choose trotters with a pinkish hue, shiny skin, and firm elasticity (loose skin indicates old meat). It is recommended to choose the front trotters as they are firmer, tastier, and more aromatic.
When using chilies, choose dried whole chilies. If you use chili powder, it will stick to the meat, making it look less appealing and affecting the texture.

Once finished, Jokbal features the deep amber hue of Korean soy sauce, the natural sweetness of vegetables, and a mild kick from dried chilies. Each slice of meat is savory, deeply flavorful, and paired with a crispy, aromatic skin. This delicious dish is perfect with steamed white rice, especially during the chilly days of autumn. Just spend a little time in the kitchen, prepare some familiar ingredients, use basic cooking techniques, and put your heart into it to create a wonderful dish with attractive colors and perfect flavor that everyone will love. What are you waiting for? Let's get cooking!

mon_an.mo_ta: A modern twist on honey roasted chicken rice with a rich, savory flavor for the whole family to enjoy. Learn how to cook this delicious Honey Roasted Chicken Rice.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Leftover rice, cooked dry and kept overnight in the fridge - 1 large bowl
Ketchup, honey, oyster sauce, salt, sugar, soy sauce, seasoning powder
cac_buoc: Step 1: Chop the chicken into bite-sized pieces. Place the chicken in a clean bowl, add 2 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp ketchup, 1/2 tsp salt, 2 tsp oyster sauce, and 1 tbsp sugar. Mix well and marinate overnight to let the flavors penetrate. The next day, place the chicken in the oven at 180°C for 30 to 35 minutes per side, flipping occasionally so the chicken cooks evenly. If the pieces are large, increase the roasting time.
Step 2: Wash and dice the onion. Wash the curly lettuce, cucumber, and tomato, then drain. Slice the cucumber and tomato into rounds.

Step 3: In a small bowl, mix 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp ketchup, and 1/2 tsp seasoning powder. Heat 3 tsp cooking oil and sauté the diced onion from Step 2 until fragrant for the honey roasted chicken rice.

Step 4: Add the rice to the pan, using a spatula to break up any clumps. Stir-fry for about 6 to 7 minutes, then pour in the sauce mixture from Step 3. Stir well and adjust seasoning to taste. Turn off the heat, scoop the rice into a small bowl, and press down firmly with a plastic spoon.

Step 5: When serving, unmold the rice bowl onto one side of a plate. Add the cucumber, lettuce, tomato, and roasted chicken. You can drizzle some store-bought sweet and sour dressing over the lettuce.
Source: Ngoi sao

mon_an.ten: Steamed Pork Ribs with Sticky Rice
mon_an.mo_ta: With simple ingredients and techniques, Steamed Pork Ribs with Sticky Rice is a new experience you must try—the combination is truly wonderful!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Ginger, garlic, soy sauce, pepper, oyster sauce
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, wash the ribs. Finely mince the garlic, chilies, and ginger, setting aside a small portion of the chilies and ginger to mix with the sticky rice later.
Step 2:
Marinate the ribs with soy sauce, oyster sauce, pepper, garlic, chilies, ginger, and a bit of sugar to taste for about 2 hours so the ribs are fully infused with flavor.
Step 3:
Peel the potatoes and cut them into bite-sized cubes.
Step 4:
Crush the sticky rice slightly. Finely grind the remaining chilies and ginger, then mix them into the crushed sticky rice.
Step 5:
Coat the potatoes and ribs evenly with the sticky rice mixture prepared in Step 4.
Step 6:
Once the ribs and potatoes are coated in rice, arrange them in a steamer and steam for 45 minutes.
Steamed ribs are not greasy but remain deeply flavorful—guaranteed to be a favorite!
The savory steamed ribs paired with the fragrant, chewy rice layer outside make it even more appealing...
These steamed ribs are delicious when served with hot rice!
Try this twist to make your steamed ribs even better!

mon_an.mo_ta: Special Pineapple Fried Rice – A daily delicacy presented inside a fragrant pineapple shell to make the dish even more eye-catching. Here is how to make Special Pineapple Fried Rice.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 10g corn kernels, 20g green bell pepper, 20g yellow bell pepper, 20g carrot
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the pineapple, keep the skin on, cut it in half lengthwise, and scoop out the flesh. Dice the pineapple flesh, sausage, bell peppers, onion, and carrot.
Step 2: Heat oil in a pan. Once hot, add the diced ingredients and stir-fry evenly. Add seasoning, pepper, chili powder, and ketchup to taste, then mix quickly.
Step 3: Stir-fry for a few more minutes, then add the rice. Toss the special pineapple fried rice thoroughly for about 5 minutes.
Step 4: Wash the pork belly, slice into bite-sized pieces, and marinate with salt, sugar, and five-spice powder for 30 minutes. Pan-fry the pork until golden brown on both sides.
Step 5: Once the rice is cooked, scoop this delicious dish into the hollowed-out pineapple half and serve with the golden fried pork.
Source: Kenh14

mon_an.mo_ta: Shrimp and Crab Fried Rice – A daily dish that provides a calcium boost for the whole family. How to make Shrimp and Crab Fried Rice.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel and devein the shrimp, then mince them. Boil the mixed vegetables until tender. Chop the green onions.
Step 2: Sauté minced garlic in a pan until fragrant, then add the shrimp and stir-fry briefly. Next, add the crab meat and toss.
Step 3: Add the white rice and mix well, seasoning to taste. Add a little annatto oil to give the shrimp and crab fried rice a beautiful golden color.
Step 4: Stir-fry until the rice grains are slightly dry, then add the vegetables and butter, mixing well. Finally, add the green onions and pepper, then turn off the heat.
Source: Ngoi sao

mon_an.ten: Savory Braised Pork with Water Chestnuts
mon_an.mo_ta: Your family meal will be much better with this savory, crunchy, and flavorful braised pork with water chestnuts!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, slice the pork into bite-sized pieces and blanch them in boiling water for about 30 seconds.
Step 2:
Next, sear the pork over high heat until all sides are golden brown.
Step 3:
Add 2 star anise pods, a few green onion whites, and several ginger slices to the pan.
Step 4:
Season with soy sauce, sugar, and caramel sauce.
Step 5:
Pour in enough water to cover the meat and bring to a boil over high heat.
Step 6:
When the liquid has reduced by half, add the water chestnuts and stir well. Continue to simmer until the sauce has almost completely reduced.
Add a bit of pepper to make the dish more aromatic!
This savory braised dish is guaranteed to be a real rice-puller!
The pork and water chestnuts take on a beautiful color!
The slight crunch makes it very enjoyable to eat!

mon_an.mo_ta: If you love KFC fried chicken, why not cook it yourself? We will share the simplest guide to making crispy KFC-style fried chicken at home. Create a golden, crunchy crust and amazing flavor with simple, easy-to-find ingredients for chicken that is crispy on the outside and tender on the inside.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, seasoning powder, garlic powder - Seasoning
cac_buoc: 1. Prepare the chicken

To clean the chicken after buying, wash it thoroughly with clean water. Then, soak the chicken in a diluted salt solution for about 5 minutes, rinse, and drain. To remove any gamey smell, you can also rub the meat with sea salt, crushed ginger, and a bit of white wine, then rinse and drain.
Next, use the tip of a sharp knife to prick a few holes in the chicken thighs or make small slits to help the seasoning penetrate easily. This also helps the thighs cook more evenly when frying.
2. Marinate the chicken
Place all the prepared chicken into a large bowl.

In another bowl, mix 1 tbsp lemon juice or vinegar into 500ml fresh milk and let it sit for 5-6 minutes until it curdles (buttermilk style). Once curdled, stir gently and soak the chicken in the milk for about 20 minutes, then remove and drain.
After the milk soak, add 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp MSG, 1 tsp pepper, and 1 tsp chili powder to the mixture and marinate the chicken for about 15 minutes. Use your hands to massage the spices into the meat.
3. Prepare the coating

Divide the frying flour into two equal parts. Keep one part dry. For the other part, place it in a large bowl, crack in the egg, and add 200ml fresh milk, whisking until smooth to create a wet batter. You can mix extra pepper, salt, chili powder, and garlic powder into the dry flour part. Lightly crush or grind the breadcrumbs so they adhere better to the chicken.
4. Coat the chicken
Dip each piece of chicken into the wet batter (flour, milk, egg, and spices). Ensure the batter coats the chicken evenly. Next, dredge the chicken in the dry flour mixture.
Then, take a zip-top bag and pour in about 30g of breadcrumbs. Place the flour-coated chicken into the bag and shake well. Repeat until all chicken pieces are coated.
Step 5: Fry the chicken

Place a pan on the stove, wait for it to get hot, then pour in 600ml of cooking oil and heat it up. Once the oil is hot, fry each piece of chicken over high heat for 2 minutes, then reduce to low heat and fry for another 8 minutes until the chicken is fully cooked.
Step 6: Finish

Remove the golden-brown chicken and place it on a plate lined with paper towels to drain the oil. This dish can be enjoyed immediately. You can dip it in chili sauce mixed with cream sauce for extra flavor.
Tips for crispier fried chicken

For great KFC-style chicken, choose fresh chicken. Look for pieces with thin skin and a characteristic golden hue. When touched, the meat should feel smooth and elastic, not lumpy. High-quality fresh chicken will be naturally pink inside and firm rather than mushy.
Avoid buying chicken that is pale, grayish-dark, or has bruises. These are signs that the chicken has been sitting for too long or was diseased.

mon_an.mo_ta: Quickly buy the ingredients to make these lemongrass grilled ribs; this delicious and easy dish will win over even the pickiest family members!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the ribs and pat them dry. Cut them into slightly long pieces. Mince the garlic. Wash the lemongrass, bruise it, and mince finely.
Step 2: Place the ribs in a plastic bag with all the seasonings above, tie it shut, and shake well to coat. Marinate the ribs overnight or for at least 1 hour.

Step 3: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Add 1 tbsp of cooking oil to the bag of ribs and mix well; this prevents the ribs from drying out while grilling. Arrange the ribs on a tray and place them in the oven.
Step 4: Every 15 minutes, flip the ribs and use a brush to baste them with the remaining marinade. Grill until the ribs are evenly golden brown and cooked through.
Remove the lemongrass grilled ribs and enjoy immediately.
Wishing you and your family a delicious meal with these savory lemongrass grilled ribs!

mon_an.mo_ta: There's nothing better than a snack on a rainy day. Check out this recipe for crispy fries. This is an easy-to-make dish perfect for the whole family to munch on. These fries are unique, stay crispy for a long time, are very fragrant, and fry up very quickly.
cac_buoc: Step 1: To make these unique crispy fries, first grate the peeled and washed potatoes into shreds. Soak them in diluted salt water for a few minutes to increase crispiness and prevent browning.
Peel, wash, and finely mince the onions.
Step 2: Drain the potatoes in a colander. Place the potatoes and onions in a clean cloth (a muslin cloth is best), bunch it up, and squeeze out as much liquid as possible.
Step 3: Transfer the potato and onion mixture to a bowl. Mix thoroughly with salt, egg, and pepper. Form the potato mixture into small, bite-sized balls or patties.

Step 4: Heat cooking oil in a pan. Once hot, fry the potato pieces until golden brown on both sides. When golden, remove and place on a plate lined with paper towels. Serve with chili sauce or mayonnaise.

mon_an.mo_ta: Sweet and Sour Pork Stomach – An attractive daily dish with the sweet and sour flavors of dried tamarind and pineapple, combined with the crunchy texture of pork stomach. How to make Sweet and Sour Pork Stomach.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Place the cleaned pork stomach in a pot and cover with water. Add a tablespoon of salt, one crushed ginger root, a tablespoon of vinegar, and a little rice wine. Cover and boil for about 20 minutes. Open the lid and test with a chopstick; if it pierces through easily, it's tender. Once cooked, remove the stomach and immediately soak it in a bowl of cold water.

Step 2: Slice the pork stomach into bite-sized pieces. Sauté shallots and garlic until fragrant, then add the pineapple and stir-fry for about 1 minute. Add the pork stomach and stir-fry for another minute, then add all the remaining ingredients and toss until the sauce coats everything evenly.
Step 3: Adjust the seasoning with sugar, salt, and pepper to taste. Once everything is cooked through and well-combined, turn off the heat. Scoop the dish onto a plate and serve hot.
Source: Kenh14

mon_an.mo_ta: Breaded Fried Tofu – A delicious, easy-to-make dish that is crispy and healthy. Learn how to make this tasty Breaded Fried Tofu.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Rinse the silken tofu with water and use a clean towel to pat it dry.
Step 2: Beat the eggs; place the flour and breadcrumbs into two separate small bowls.
Step 3: Dredge each piece of tofu in the flour, dip into the egg, and then coat thoroughly in the breadcrumbs to ensure an even, crispy crust.
Step 4: Heat oil in a pan; as soon as a piece of tofu is breaded, carefully drop it into the hot oil. Fry until golden brown, then remove to a plate lined with paper towels.
Step 5: To complete this easy dish, prepare a dipping sauce from soy sauce, lime juice, and minced garlic and chili.
Source: Kenh14

mon_an.mo_ta: Fried Tofu with Scallion Oil – An easy-to-make dish served with shrimp paste and Vietnamese balm (kinh giới); a simple dish that becomes incredibly attractive. Check out the recipe below! Step into the culinary world with this easy traditional recipe. Enjoy the creamy tofu combined with fresh scallion oil.
cac_buoc: 1. How to make delicious fried tofu with scallion oil and peanuts
Ingredients
5 blocks of tofu
50g scallions
50g peanuts (roasted)
1 tbsp fish sauce
500ml cooking oil
A bit of common seasonings (sugar, salt, seasoning powder, MSG)
How to prepare fried tofu with scallion oil and peanuts
Preparation
Prepare a pan and pour in 200ml of cooking oil. Place the pan on the stove and heat the oil.
When the oil is hot, carefully place each piece of tofu into the pan. Fry until they are hot and golden brown on both sides.
After about 5 minutes of frying, once the tofu is cooked, remove to a plate. Let it cool slightly, then cut each piece in half for easier eating.
Remove wilted leaves and roots from the scallions. Wash and finely chop them.
Marinating and frying the tofu
In a bowl, mix 1/3 tsp salt, 1/3 tsp MSG, 1/3 tsp seasoning powder, 1/2 tsp sugar, 1 tbsp fish sauce, and 2 tbsp water. Stir until the seasonings are completely dissolved.
Gently drizzle this sauce over the halved tofu pieces, ensuring both sides are coated. Marinate for 15-20 minutes.
After 20 minutes, place a pan on the stove and pour in about 200ml of cooking oil. Place the tofu pieces back into the pan. Fry and flip them frequently until golden brown on both sides.
After 20 minutes, when the tofu is golden brown, remove to a plate.
Making the scallion oil and finishing
Place a pan on the stove and add 100ml of cooking oil. Add 1/3 tsp salt and 1/3 tsp MSG. Wait for the oil to get hot.
Once the oil is hot, add the prepared scallions and stir well to fry them evenly.
Fry the scallions for about 2 minutes. Then, add 1 tsp sugar and continue frying for another 4 minutes until the scallions are cooked and turn dark green. Turn off the heat.
Finally, drizzle the scallion oil and peanuts over the fried tofu. The dish is complete. Enjoy!
Final product

The final result is Fried Tofu with Scallion Oil and Peanuts, featuring attractive colors. The crispy golden-brown tofu blends with fragrant scallion oil and crunchy peanuts, creating a rich and satisfying combination.
To make it even more delicious, you can dip the tofu in a bit of ketchup or chili sauce for extra flavor.
2. How to make fried tofu with scallion oil and meat floss
Tofu: 5 blocks
Chicken floss: 50g
Scallions: 50g
Chili: 1
Cooking oil: 300ml
Fish sauce: 1/2 tbsp
Common seasonings: a bit (sugar, seasoning powder, ground pepper)
Steps to make fried tofu with scallion oil and meat floss
Preparation
Scallions: Wash the scallions, remove wilted leaves and roots. Separate the white parts and finely chop the green parts.
Tofu: Briefly rinse the tofu and cut into bite-sized squares.
Making the scallion oil
Mix 1/2 tbsp sugar, 1/2 tbsp seasoning powder, 1/2 tbsp fish sauce, and 1/2 tsp ground pepper in a bowl. Stir well and marinate for 10 minutes.
Heat 100ml of cooking oil in a pan. Once hot, pour the hot oil into the bowl of prepared scallions.
Frying the tofu and finishing
Use the same pan from the scallion oil. Add about 200ml of cooking oil and wait for it to get hot. Carefully add the tofu and fry, flipping all sides until golden and crispy.
After about 7 minutes, when the tofu is golden on all sides, remove the tofu from the pan and drain the oil.
Once drained, arrange the tofu on a plate. Drizzle the scallion oil over the tofu, add sliced chili, and sprinkle chicken floss on top for flavor and presentation.

The final result is Fried Tofu with Scallion Oil and Meat Floss, with a wonderful aroma and attractive colors. The tofu has a crispy crust and a soft, creamy interior, perfectly paired with savory scallion oil and salty meat floss. This makes it especially appealing, particularly for children.
Tips for delicious fried tofu with scallion oil
Ingredients: Choose fresh, high-quality tofu. It should have the right moisture to ensure a crispy crust and soft interior.
Washing: Rinse the tofu before use to remove any dust or impurities.
Marinating: Marinate with salt, pepper, and minced garlic to enhance the flavor. Let it sit for 15-20 minutes.
Check oil temperature: Ensure the oil is hot enough (about 170-180°C). Test by dropping a small piece of tofu; if it floats and browns quickly, it's ready.
Fry evenly: Flip the tofu pieces to achieve an even golden color and crispiness.
Drain oil: After frying, let the tofu drain on paper towels or a wire rack to remove excess oil.
Fragrant scallion oil: Prepare the oil by heating it with seasonings before pouring over the scallions for a signature aroma. Mix with the fried tofu to add flavor.

mon_an.mo_ta: With just a small twist in ingredients and method, you'll have a wonderful dish for your family meal! Try this fried tofu with egg recipe below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Dipping sauce: - 15ml sesame oil, 15ml water, 15ml soy sauce, 15g chopped scallions, 1 chili, 2-3 sprigs of cilantro, 5g toasted white sesame seeds
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Finely chop the scallions and place in a bowl. Crack in 1 egg and whisk well. Add a little salt and pepper.
Step 2:
Cut the tofu blocks in half, then coat with a layer of cornstarch.
Step 3:
Dip the tofu into the egg and scallion mixture until all sides are evenly coated, then remove.
Step 4:
In a pan with hot oil, fry the tofu until golden brown on all sides.
To make the sauce, mix all ingredients in a small bowl, adjusting the amount of chili to your preference.
And our fried tofu dish is done!
If plain fried tofu with soy sauce is too common, just add some scallions and eggs for a delicious treat for the whole family!
It's delicious when dipped in the sauce!
The tofu is coated in egg, making it creamy and especially crispy!
Make this fried tofu with egg for your family right away!

mon_an.mo_ta: If scallion or carrot omelets are too familiar, why not try this easy and refreshing Potato Omelet?
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fish sauce, salt, pepper, seasoning powder
cac_buoc: Grab a pen and paper to note down the recipe for this Potato Omelet:
Step 1: Peel the potatoes, wash, remove the eyes, and slice into bite-sized pieces.
Step 2: Crack the eggs into a bowl with chopped scallions, seasoning powder, salt, fish sauce, and pepper. Add just enough to taste.
Step 3: Heat oil in a pan, sauté the scallions until fragrant, then add the potatoes and fry until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
Step 4: Pour in the beaten eggs, cover with a lid to cook the bottom, then use a spatula to flip the omelet. Once the other side is golden brown, your delicious potato omelet is complete.

mon_an.ten: Steamed Stuffed Tofu with Soy Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: Sharing a way to upgrade your daily tofu dishes. Are boiled or fried tofu getting boring? Then try this Steamed Stuffed Tofu with Soy Sauce! A delicious recipe for stuffed tofu.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Scallions, soy sauce, dark soy sauce
cac_buoc: Step 1: Mix the ground meat with soy sauce, sugar, cornstarch, a little cooking oil, and 1/2 tbsp of water. Mix well until the meat becomes tacky and well-combined.
Step 2: Place the tofu in a bowl and steam it. Note: add just enough water to the steamer, ensuring it doesn't overflow into the tofu bowl.

After steaming for 1-2 minutes, remove the tofu and let it cool, then cut into large blocks. Use a knife to make a small cut in each block, then use a spoon to scoop out some tofu to create a hole for the stuffing.

Step 3: Stuff the prepared meat mixture into each tofu block. Arrange the tofu in a bowl and steam for 8-10 minutes until both the meat and tofu are fully cooked. Once done, pour the liquid released from the tofu into a small bowl.
Step 4: Add soy sauce and oyster sauce to a pan over low heat. Season to taste, then slowly add the cornstarch slurry. Simmer until the mixture boils and thickens slightly.
Arrange the tofu on a plate, garnish with blanched bok choy, and drizzle the soy sauce over the top. Your Steamed Stuffed Tofu with Soy Sauce is now ready!
Good luck!

mon_an.mo_ta: This spicy fried goby fish dish features a striking golden-brown color accented with bits of red chili. The fish is perfectly crispy and thoroughly seasoned, offering a delightful crunch and savory flavor. With just a little time in the kitchen, you can prepare this delicious meal to treat your family and friends!
cac_buoc: How to make delicious spicy fried goby fish
Step 1: Clean the goby fish by removing the innards. Wash them thoroughly with a bit of rock salt to reduce any fishy odor, then rinse again with water and let drain.

Step 2: Place the goby fish in a bowl. Add 3 tsp of tapioca starch, 1 tsp of seasoning powder, and 1 tsp of pepper. Toss gently so the starch and seasonings coat the fish evenly. Let the mixture marinate for about 15 minutes before frying.
While waiting for the fish to marinate, prepare the other ingredients:
Peel the lemongrass and garlic, remove the ends, wash, drain, and mince finely.
Wash the chilies and mince them finely as shown below.

Step 3: Place a pan on the stove. Add cooking oil. To give the fish a beautiful color, add 1 tbsp of annatto oil; this ensures the fish looks very appetizing once fried. When the oil is hot, add the fish and fry over medium heat.
Fry until the fish is crispy and golden brown, then remove and place on a plate lined with paper towels to drain excess oil.
Step 4: Using the same pan, add a little oil and sauté the minced garlic, lemongrass, and chili over medium heat.
Once the mixture is fragrant, add the goby fish and toss well. Add a bit of seasoning powder and toss again so the fish is evenly coated.
Finally, arrange the fish on a plate and enjoy with chili sauce, sweet and sour dipping sauce, or any sauce of your choice.
Tips for delicious spicy fried goby fish
For this dish, use seasoning powder instead of fish sauce, as fish sauce can make the fish lose its crispiness.
For the best flavor, choose river goby fish. Smaller gobies are preferred as their meat is firm and fragrant, and you can usually eat the bones.
How to choose fresh fish:
Choose fish that are white or yellow for the best meat quality. Black-colored fish are often from ponds or ditches and have less desirable meat.
Don't be afraid to get your hands dirty when buying fish. Check the gills; if they are bright red, the fish is fresh. If they are pale or dark, the fish is stale.

Buy fish that are still swimming. If buying dead fish, be very careful. Look for a shiny slime layer, clear eyes, intact scales, and pink gills. If you place the fish in water and it sinks, it is fresh. If it feels sticky, has sunken eyes, loose scales, a pale color, inelastic meat, or a bloated belly and anus, and floats in water, it is stale.
Another way to tell: a fresh fish has a pale, retracted anus, while a stale one has a protruding and bruised anus.

The finished spicy fried goby fish has an eye-catching golden color with red chili accents. The fish is crispy and well-seasoned, providing a wonderful dining experience. With just a bit of effort, you have a tasty dish for your loved ones!

mon_an.mo_ta: These vegetable shrimp cakes are visually appealing with their fresh appearance and vibrant colors. When eaten, you will experience the snappy texture of the shrimp and the natural sweetness of the vegetables, making for a very appetizing dish.
cac_buoc: How to make delicious vegetable shrimp cakes
Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Wash the corn and use a knife to strip the kernels.
Shell the edamame to get the whole beans.
Peel the carrot, wash, and let drain.
Wash the shrimp with rice wine to remove the fishy smell, then rinse with water and peel. Use a toothpick to remove the black vein on the back, then mince the shrimp.
Similarly, finely mince the corn, edamame, and carrot.
Step 2: Cooking process

First, place all ingredients in a large bowl. Season with salt, seasoning powder, and pepper to taste. Finally, add 2 tbsp of tapioca starch to act as a binder. If you don't have tapioca starch, you can use an egg. Mix the mixture thoroughly by hand until all ingredients are well combined and seasoned.
Next, shape the mixture into bite-sized round patties. You can then either fry or steam them as follows:
To fry: Lightly coat a hot pan with oil and fry the shrimp cakes until golden brown on both sides.
If you prefer to avoid oil: Place them in a steamer for about 10 minutes or until cooked through.
Finally, arrange the shrimp cakes on a plate, garnish beautifully, and serve with chili sauce or sweet and sour fish sauce.
Tips for delicious vegetable shrimp cakes
If you cannot find edamame, you can substitute with green peas.
Do not grind the shrimp into a complete paste; mincing them by hand allows you to enjoy the snappy texture of the shrimp meat.
Fried shrimp cakes are crispy and incredibly fragrant. Serve hot with garlic-chili fish sauce, or simply dip in chili sauce or ketchup.
Steamed shrimp cakes are equally delicious, as the natural sweetness of the corn, edamame, carrots, and shrimp is perfectly preserved.
General tips for choosing fresh shrimp
Check the tail

To determine freshness, stretch the shrimp and hold it up to the light to see the gap between the shell segments and the meat. Wider gaps indicate the shrimp is not fresh, possibly due to being overcooked or frozen for a long time.
Avoid slimy shrimp

Do not buy shrimp that feel slimy. These often curl into a circle rather than lying straight. To check, rub your finger over the shell from front to back and vice versa. If it feels gritty or sticky, do not buy them.
Shrimp legs
Check if the legs are still firmly attached to the body; the meat should be firm. Avoid shrimp with legs that have turned black, as this is a sign they are no longer fresh.

mon_an.mo_ta: Korean spicy braised chicken attracts diners with its characteristic orange color and a variety of vegetables. The chicken is tender, fresh, and deeply infused with spices, while the braising liquid is packed with flavor.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Chicken - 1.5 kg, cut into bite-sized pieces
Carrots - 2 roots, cut into bite-sized pieces
Potatoes - 450 gr, cut into bite-sized pieces
cac_buoc: How to make Korean spicy braised chicken
Step 1:
First, wash the chicken with salt to remove the fishy odor, rinse with water, and let drain.
Step 2:
Mix all the marinade ingredients in a large bowl until well combined.
Step 3:
Add all the chicken to the marinade bowl and toss gently until the chicken is evenly coated.
Step 4:
While waiting for the chicken to marinate, boil the kelp in a small pot of water for 5-7 minutes to make a stock. Then, place the marinated chicken into a deep pot and pour in the kelp stock.
Step 5:
Be careful not to use too much water; just pour enough stock to barely cover the surface of the chicken!
Step 6:
Bring the chicken to a boil, then lower the heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
Step 7:
Add the onions and carrots, and continue to cook over medium heat for 10 minutes.
Step 8:
Add the potatoes to the pot, stir gently, and cook for another 10-15 minutes until the vegetables and chicken are tender.
Step 9:
When the vegetables are tender, partially open the lid to let the steam escape and allow the sauce to thicken.
Step 10:
Finally, sprinkle scallions and green chilies over the chicken, stir gently, and turn off the heat.
Serve the dish on a plate and enjoy with steamed rice or bread—it's absolutely delicious!
Tips for perfect Korean spicy braised chicken
How to choose good chicken:
A good chicken will have a compact, firm body and a small breast.
The skin should be naturally yellow, with darker yellow areas on the wings, breast, and back. The skin should not be bruised, pale, or have black spots or lumps.
If the skin is tough and uniformly bright yellow while the fat is white, it may have been treated with yellow dye.
The meat should be firm, fresh, and free of foul odors or antibiotic smells.
Press the body, breast, or thigh; if the meat is firm, it is good. If it is mushy, slippery, or deformed (indicating water injection), do not buy it.
When mixing the marinade, stir thoroughly so the ingredients blend well and the chicken absorbs the flavors evenly.
Besides rice or bread, you can serve this with noodles or add tteokbokki (rice cakes) during cooking for an extra treat.
You can also add kimchi to enhance the flavor of the dish.
Korean spicy braised chicken is visually appealing with its signature Korean color and mixed vegetables. The chicken is soft, fresh, and flavorful, making every bite delicious.

mon_an.mo_ta: Salt-baked chicken impresses diners with its unique cooking method and attractive color. Once cooked, the chicken is fragrant and the meat is incredibly tender and well-seasoned, providing a wonderful culinary experience!
cac_buoc: Step 1: After cleaning the chicken, wash it with salt to remove any odors, then rinse again with water. Let the chicken drain and pat it dry with paper towels.

Next, brush cooking wine all over the chicken, including the cavity. Rub the ginger powder and pepper mixture thoroughly over the skin and inside the cavity. Massage well to ensure the chicken absorbs the seasoning and removes any odors.

After massaging, tie the legs together. Place the chicken upright on a large bowl or cup so any liquid inside the cavity can drain out. Leave the chicken (uncovered) in the refrigerator overnight to dry out the skin.
Step 2: The next day, remove the chicken from the refrigerator at least 1-2 hours before cooking.
Place ginger slices inside the cavity and brush cooking oil all over the skin.
Step 3: Wrap the chicken in a large sheet of parchment paper. Then wrap it again with another sheet, leaving the opening at the breast side. Set aside.
Step 4: Add 1.25kg of coarse salt to a dry pan and stir for 15 minutes over medium heat until the salt turns light brown.
Pour some salt into another pot to a depth of about 0.75cm. Place the wrapped chicken in the center.
Cover the chicken with the remaining salt, ensuring it is completely buried.
Cover with a lid and cook over medium heat for 35 minutes. Turn off the heat and keep the lid closed, letting the chicken sit for another 30–40 minutes until the salt is only warm.
Finally, gently remove the chicken. Pour any collected juices back over the meat for extra flavor and enjoy.
How to choose good chicken:
For pre-processed chicken:
A good chicken has a compact, firm body and a small breast.
The skin should be golden yellow, especially on the wings and back, without bruises or dark spots.
Avoid chicken with tough, unnaturally yellow skin and white fat, as it may be dyed.
The meat must be firm and fresh without any strange odors.
Press the meat to check for firmness; avoid mushy or water-bloated meat.
For live chicken:
Between two chickens of the same size, the heavier one usually has firmer meat.
A healthy chicken is alert, hard to catch, has bright eyes, a bright red comb, and smooth, shiny feathers.
The beak should be sharp and clean without discharge.
The legs should be straight, slender, and free of scratches or strange red spots.
Thin skin with firm meat and yellow patches under the breast/wings indicates a good, lean chicken.
The vent should be pink and move well, without signs of wetness or abnormal droppings.
Check under the wings for injection marks (small red dots or localized swelling), which indicate water has been injected to increase weight; do not buy such chickens.
A healthy chicken's crop should not be rock-hard.

mon_an.mo_ta: Thịt đông (Vietnamese Pork Aspic) features fresh pork deeply infused with spices. Served with hot rice and pickled vegetables, this dish is so appetizing you'll finish your rice pot in no time!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Shiitake mushrooms, wood ear mushrooms - 30 gr
cac_buoc: Step 1: Clean the pork shank by scraping off any hair, then wash with salt to remove odors and rinse thoroughly. Drain and cut into matchbox-sized pieces.

Step 2: Clean the pig ear by scraping and rubbing with salt and vinegar. Rinse, drain, and slice thinly. If the pork shank has too much fat, trim some off. If you don't like pig ear, you can substitute it with a piece of pork skin (palm-sized) to ensure the dish sets properly.

Step 3: Boil a pot of water with a little salt, crushed shallots (or white scallion ends), and crushed ginger to blanch the meat. Blanching with aromatics helps clean the meat and remove odors. After blanching, rinse the meat under cold water and drain. Marinate the meat with 1 tbsp of high-quality fish sauce for 30 minutes.

Step 4: Soak the shiitake and wood ear mushrooms until soft, then slice them (not too finely, or they will lose their crunch when cooked). Heat a pan with a little oil and sauté the mushrooms with a bit of seasoning powder, then set aside.
Step 5: In the same pan, sauté the pork shank and pig ear until the meat firms up, adding a little seasoning powder during the process.

Step 6: Transfer the sautéed meat to a pot. You can use a pressure cooker to save time. Pour in enough water to cover the meat. When it boils, skim off the foam thoroughly to ensure the aspic is clear and not cloudy. Once skimmed, close the pressure cooker lid.

Step 7: After 15 minutes of cooking until the meat is tender, open the lid and add the sautéed mushrooms and crushed roasted pepper. Simmer for another 10 minutes (no need to close the pressure cooker lid).
Step 8: While waiting, carve some carrot flowers and place them at the bottom of your containers for a beautiful presentation when the aspic is unmolded.

When the meat is done, remove from heat and let it cool slightly. Place the carrot flowers at the bottom of the containers, pour in the cooked meat mixture, cover tightly, and refrigerate for 4-6 hours until set.
Once the aspic has set, it is ready to serve. Use a knife to gently loosen the edges of the container to unmold the aspic onto a plate easily.
Tips for delicious Thịt đông
Do not cook the dish too salty, as it is best enjoyed dipped in high-quality fish sauce with extra pepper and served with sour pickles.
Choosing the meat:

Pork shank is the best choice because it provides the natural gelatin needed for the dish to set. You can also add some pork skin to help with the setting process, which can be removed after cooking if desired.
Some families add chicken to enhance the aroma and clarity of the aspic.
Adding pig ear provides a pleasant crunchy texture to the dish.

mon_an.mo_ta: Fried duck with galangal is a unique and exciting choice for many families, and you will be hooked from the very first bite. With fresh duck meat, crispy skin, and a signature aroma, this dish is sure to captivate any diner. Simply spend a little time in the kitchen and follow this guide to have a delicious and attractive dish on your table. Discover how to make savory fried duck with galangal featuring fresh meat, crispy skin, and bold flavors. A simple guide to creating a unique dish that your family will love.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings - salt, seasoning powder, cooking oil, pepper, chili powder, white wine
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients

Peel the galangal and wash the shallots before crushing them. Wash the chilies, drain, and mince. Remove the tough outer layers of the lemongrass, crush the base with a mortar, and shred into small fibers.

Rinse the duck meat with water, then use lemon or wine combined with crushed ginger to rub both the inside and outside of the duck to remove any odors. Rinse the duck again with water; you can also use coarse salt or vinegar to rub the entire body.
Finally, chop the duck into small, bite-sized pieces.
Step 2: Marinate the duck

In a large bowl, combine the chopped duck with ½ tbsp sugar, 1 tsp MSG, 1 tsp sesame oil, and seasoned salt. Sprinkle some pepper into the marinade. Next, add 2 tbsp tapioca starch, 1 tbsp crispy frying flour, 2 tbsp cornstarch, and the minced galangal and chilies prepared earlier.

Add the shredded lemongrass and a splash of wine. Use your hands to mix all ingredients thoroughly, ensuring the meat is evenly coated. Then, add a little turmeric powder and mix again. Let the duck marinate for 20-30 minutes to allow the flavors to absorb evenly.
Step 3: Fry the duck

Place a large pan on the stove and heat the oil until hot. Once the oil is boiling, add the marinated duck to the pan and stir well. Wait until the meat turns an even golden brown on all sides, then remove the meat from the pan and turn off the heat.
Step 4: Finished product

The finished fried duck with galangal will have a signature aroma from the galangal and lemongrass, with a crispy exterior. The meat will be tender and succulent without being dry, complemented by the rich flavor of the duck fat. To enhance the flavor, you can serve it with fresh herbs or a dipping sauce.
Notes for perfect fried duck with galangal
Successfully cooked duck must be aromatic, evenly seasoned, free of odors, and not tough.
This dish should be eaten while hot.
How to choose fresh duck:
Choose duck with light yellow skin, no bruises, and an even color. The body should be intact without scratches.
You can use your hands to check the elasticity of the meat to see if it is firm. Avoid choosing ducks that are too old; good ducks usually have full feathers, breasts, and rounded oil glands.
Note to choose ducks with thick skin on the belly and neck; when picked up, they should feel heavy.
Avoid choosing ducks that have laid many eggs, as their bellies may sag, and the meat will be tough and less flavorful.

mon_an.mo_ta: Braised pork belly with coconut features an eye-catching color and delicious aroma. The pork is tender and melts in your mouth, while the fresh coconut meat is soaked in seasonings, making you finish your rice pot before you know it!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings - seasoned salt, fish sauce, MSG, pepper, etc.
cac_buoc: How to make delicious braised pork belly with coconut

Step 1: Wash the pork belly with salt to remove odors, then rinse with water and slice into pieces about 1cm thick. Next, blanch the pork in boiling water, remove and drain. Marinate with minced shallots, pepper, and a bit of fish sauce; mix well and let sit for 15–20 minutes to absorb the flavors. For the coconut meat, scrape off the brown outer skin, wash, and slice into thin strips about 5 cm long; set aside for braising.

Step 2: Caramelize the sugar: First, place a pot on the stove over low heat. Once the pot is dry, add 2 tbsp sugar and a little water. Stir constantly as the sugar melts and gradually changes color. You must stir evenly so the sugar doesn't burn; it is ready when it turns an amber color.

Step 3: Once the caramel is ready, add the pork and stir well to firm up the meat. Then add the coconut meat and stir together. Pour in enough water to just cover the meat and season to taste. Simmer until the sauce thickens, the meat is tender, and the coconut is evenly colored. Turn off the heat and add some chopped green onions for color.
Notes for delicious braised pork belly with coconut
This braised pork with coconut is very delicious and goes perfectly with white rice.
How to choose good pork:

Fresh pork: The exterior has a dry film, and the surface is slightly firm. The cut surface is bright pink, the skin is soft, the muscle fibers are firm, and it has good elasticity (pressing with a finger leaves no mark when released). The fat is bright, firm, and has a characteristic aroma. Joint surfaces are smooth and clear. Marrow clings tightly to the bone and is elastic.

Stale pork: The exterior starts to feel slimy. The cut surface is slightly wet, and elasticity is poor (pressing leaves a lingering indentation). The fat is dark, less firm, and has an off-odor. Joint surfaces are slimy and cloudy. Marrow easily detaches from the bone and is dark or brown.
Old pork or sow meat: The muscle fibers are loose, dark red, and the skin is thick.

Diseased pork: Loose fibers, yellow fat mixed in the meat which may contain opaque white grains. Small spots may be present in the liver or kidneys. The skin may have round or oval hemorrhages or be unevenly pitted.

You should not buy pork that is too old or too young. Only buy medium-aged pork that is pink with thin skin. There are two types of lean meat: tenderloin and leg meat. Tenderloin is tastier and sweet for stir-frying but can become dry if overcooked. Leg meat is softer.
For pork hock, choose the hind leg as it has more meat and softer skin.
If buying pork fat to render into lard, choose large leaf fat that is slightly pinkish-white.

mon_an.mo_ta: Garlic fried pork is incredibly aromatic and visually appealing. The pork has a crispy exterior while the meat remains fresh, tender, and well-seasoned. Serving it with sticky rice and cucumber will balance the richness and make your meal more enjoyable.
cac_buoc: How to make garlic fried pork
Step 1: Wash the pork with salt to remove odors, then rinse again with water. Slice the pork into bite-sized pieces.
Step 2: Place the pork in a bowl with all the prepared seasonings (except for the fried garlic). Wear gloves and mix well. Let it marinate for about 15 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Step 3: Heat a pan with oil (not too much oil is needed). When the oil is just hot, add the pork in small batches and fry over medium heat.
When the pork is golden and crispy, remove it and place it on a plate lined with paper towels to drain excess oil.
Step 4: Soak glutinous rice overnight and steam until cooked.
Toss the fried pork with the fried garlic and serve on a plate alongside the sticky rice, lettuce, and cucumber garnishes. Enjoy.
How to choose good pork

Fresh pork: The exterior has a dry film, and the surface is slightly firm. The cut surface is bright pink, the skin is soft, the muscle fibers are firm, and it has good elasticity (pressing with a finger leaves no mark when released). The fat is bright, firm, and has a characteristic aroma. Joint surfaces are smooth and clear. Marrow clings tightly to the bone and is elastic.

Stale pork: The exterior starts to feel slimy. The cut surface is slightly wet, and elasticity is poor (pressing leaves a lingering indentation). The fat is dark, less firm, and has an off-odor. Joint surfaces are slimy and cloudy. Marrow easily detaches from the bone and is dark or brown.
Old pork or sow meat: The muscle fibers are loose, dark red, and the skin is thick.

Diseased pork: Loose fibers, yellow fat mixed in the meat which may contain opaque white grains. Small spots may be present in the liver or kidneys. The skin may have round or oval hemorrhages or be unevenly pitted.
Do not buy pork that is too old or too young. Only buy medium-aged pork that is pink with thin skin. Tenderloin is sweet but can be dry if overcooked; leg meat is softer.
For pork hock, choose the hind leg for more meat and soft skin.
If buying fat to render, choose large leaf fat that is pinkish-white.

With just a little time in the kitchen and simple, easy-to-find ingredients, you can make this aromatic garlic fried pork. The crispy skin and tender, seasoned meat served with sticky rice and cucumber will make for a perfect meal. Don't hesitate to show off your skills and treat your family and friends to this delicious dish.

mon_an.ten: Stir-fried Duck with Small Bamboo Shoots
mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried duck with small bamboo shoots features tender duck meat soaked in seasonings paired with crunchy, sweet bamboo shoots that will make you finish your rice in no time! Discover our recipe for stir-fried duck with small bamboo shoots in the article below. We hope this helps you create a delicious dish to treat your whole family.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings - seasoned salt, oyster sauce, soy sauce, pepper
cac_buoc: Wash the duck meat with salt and lemon/kumquat to remove odors, then rinse again with water. Drain and slice the duck into thin pieces. Marinate with 1/2 tsp seasoned salt, 1 tsp oyster sauce, and 1/2 tsp pepper. Mix well and wait 15 minutes for the duck to absorb the seasonings.

Rinse the bamboo shoots with water, then boil them briefly. Drain the water and set aside. For the wild betel leaves, remove the stems and wilted leaves, wash, and shred into strips. For the green onions, remove the roots and wilted parts, wash, and drain; separate the white parts and the green leaves, then chop. Mince the chili.

Next, place a pan on the stove, add cooking oil, and heat it up. Add the white parts of the green onions and sauté until fragrant. Then, add the duck meat and stir-fry over high heat so the meat firms up and the duck skin releases its fat. Remove the stir-fried duck to a separate bowl.

Use the same pan and the rendered duck fat to stir-fry the bamboo shoots. Season with 1 tsp soy sauce and about 1 tsp seasoned salt (adjust to taste). Stir well so the bamboo shoots absorb the seasonings.
Once the bamboo shoots are seasoned, return the duck to the pan along with the chili, green onions, and wild betel leaves. Stir-fry with the bamboo for about 1 minute, then turn off the heat.
Finally, present the dish on a plate and enjoy.
Notes for delicious stir-fried duck with bamboo shoots:
After stir-frying the duck, if there is too much fat in the pan, you should pour some out to make the dish less greasy.
How to choose good duck:

When buying, choose mature and plump ducks with rounded breasts, thick neck and belly skin, and full feathers (the tips of the wings should just cross over each other). These ducks are easier and faster to pluck.
Avoid choosing young ducks as the meat will be soft and not firm, and it takes a lot of time to remove the pinfeathers. Young ducks have large, soft beaks. Old ducks have small, hard beaks.
Ducks that have laid many eggs also have very aromatic meat; their lower bellies will sag. Unlike chicken, for duck, it is better to choose a male duck as they are tastier than females.
To check if a duck is healthy, check the vent to ensure it is clean and not showing signs of diarrhea.
Generally, choose a duck that is just mature—not too young or too old—for the best flavor and easier preparation.
Besides the method above, you can remove duck odors by rubbing the meat with salt, pepper, crushed ginger, and a bit of white wine for 30 minutes before rinsing and cooking.

Bamboo and chili are a great pair that stimulates the appetite, but they can be a challenge for children or those who cannot eat spicy food. You don't necessarily have to use chili, or you can replace it with a milder variety.

mon_an.mo_ta: After fish sauce fried chicken wings, this recipe guide introduces an extremely easy way to make BBQ grilled chicken thighs using the following formula.
cac_buoc: Preheat the oven to 200°C.

Wash the chicken thighs and debone them, being careful not to tear the skin. Slice into bite-sized pieces. Marinate the chicken with a bit of pepper, seasoning powder, and a little oil to let it absorb.
Line a tray with parchment paper or aluminum foil. Arrange the chicken thighs on the tray, skin side down. Place in the middle rack of the oven and bake.

Repeat the process once more, then take the chicken out and brush the sauce over it. Increase the oven temperature to 250°C and bake for about 5 more minutes until the sauce turns an attractive golden brown and the chicken is fully cooked (about 10 minutes total).

Mix all the sauce ingredients together and heat them on the stove. After the chicken thighs are grilled, use a brush to coat the meat side with sauce, then gently flip the skin side up (be careful not to tear the skin). Brush the sauce evenly over the skin and bake for another 5 minutes. Remove from the oven, arrange on a plate, and serve hot.

mon_an.mo_ta: Savory spicy grilled chicken thighs for a cozy weekend family meal. This spicy grilled chicken dish will satisfy everyone. This easy-to-make dish brings a spicy and aromatic flavor that is very appealing!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Put the olive oil, fresh chilies (stemmed and deseeded), peeled garlic, lemon juice, salt, pepper, and oregano into a blender and blend until smooth.
Step 2:
Wash the chicken thighs and make a few shallow cuts so the sauce can penetrate and the meat cooks faster.
Mix the chicken with the mixture from Step 1 and marinate for at least 1 hour.
Step 3:
Preheat the oven for 10 minutes at 200°C so the dish cooks more thoroughly.
Arrange the chicken on a baking tray lined with foil. Bake in the oven for 20 minutes.
Step 4: After 20 minutes, take the tray out, brush on another layer of sauce, and bake for another 15 minutes. Spicy grilled chicken thighs are best enjoyed while hot.

mon_an.ten: Chicken Thighs with Fresh Mushroom Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: With just a little time and 3 simple cooking steps, you will have a delicious and easy-to-make dish of chicken thighs with fresh mushroom sauce.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel the pumpkin, remove the seeds, wash, and cut into bite-sized pieces. Trim the mushroom stems, wash, and cut in half. Wash the chicken thighs, boil for about 5 minutes, then set aside in a bowl.

Step 2: Place a pan on the stove, add oil and heat it up. When the oil is hot, add the chicken thighs and fry until golden. While cooking, add star anise, white wine, soy sauce, and fresh ginger slices.

Step 3: Lower the heat and add a small bowl of water to the pan along with the pumpkin. When the pumpkin is soft, add the mushrooms. Briefly toss the chicken thighs with the mushroom sauce and season to taste. You can add some chopped green onions for aroma.

mon_an.mo_ta: Chicken rolls with sticky rice is an incredibly attractive dish for your family meal, featuring delicious chicken, eye-catching colors, and savory seasonings combined with soft sticky rice and crunchy carrots inside. This dish will delight your family and surprise them with your talent!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients for chicken rolls with sticky rice.
Peel the carrots, wash, and dice into small cubes.
Wash the chicken thighs to remove odors, then use a sharp knife to debone them. Use a meat mallet to flatten the chicken meat so it becomes softer and easier to roll with the rice.
Next, marinate the chicken with white pepper, a little salt, and mirin for 20 minutes. Occasionally stir the meat so the seasonings absorb evenly.
Let the steamed sticky rice cool down.
Step 2: Steps to make chicken rolls with sticky rice.
First, place a pan on the stove and heat some cooking oil.
When the oil is hot, sauté the carrots until cooked, then add the sticky rice and stir well.
Season with soy sauce, sugar, and salt. Cook for about 2 minutes until the rice absorbs the flavors, then turn off the heat. Remember to stir constantly so the seasonings are evenly distributed.
Next, spread a sheet of aluminum foil on a flat surface and sprinkle a little flour on top. Place one chicken thigh in the center of the foil and add 1/2 of the sticky rice mixture inside.
Slowly roll the chicken meat up, then wrap the foil tightly around it, twisting both ends securely.
Repeat the process with the remaining chicken and rice until all ingredients are used.
Prepare a steamer on the stove. Once the water has been boiling for 1-2 minutes, place the two chicken rolls inside and cover tightly. Steam the chicken for about 20 minutes over low heat.
Finally, heat a little oil in a pan. Remove the foil and fry the two chicken rolls until the skin turns an attractive golden brown.
Place the cooked chicken on paper towels to drain excess oil, then slice the rolls into bite-sized pieces and serve immediately while hot.
Notes for perfect chicken rolls with sticky rice
Instead of sticky rice, you can use regular rice, but it should be a slightly sticky variety.
If preferred, you can use chicken breast or tenderloin instead of thighs.
The steaming time will depend on the size of the chicken rolls.
If you want to avoid oil, you can skip the frying step and slice it right after steaming.
To make the filling more flavorful, you can add minced wood ear mushrooms and shiitake mushrooms.

Chicken rolls with sticky rice is an incredibly attractive dish for your family meal, featuring delicious chicken, eye-catching colors, and savory seasonings combined with soft sticky rice and crunchy carrots inside. This dish will delight your family and surprise them with your talent!

mon_an.mo_ta: To create a delicious, savory soy sauce steamed chicken with a unique flavor, you need a special secret. Let's learn how to make this flavorful dish in the article below! Savory soy sauce steamed chicken with a unique secret. Discover this attractive dish that combines the signature flavor of soy sauce. Enjoy the aroma and sweetness of steamed chicken, a great choice to change your palate.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, sugar, seasoning powder - as needed
cac_buoc: 1. Prepare the ingredients

Wash the chicken and pat dry. Place the chicken in a large pot and add 5 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp sugar, 1/2 tbsp sesame oil, 1 tbsp white wine, and 1 tsp seasoning powder. Toss well to let the seasonings penetrate the chicken for about 30 minutes.
Wash the ginger, remove dirt, and peel. Slice into thin strips.
Wash the onion, peel, and slice into thin strips.
Wash the green onions, removing the roots and green leaves.
2. Marinate the chicken

Once the chicken is drained, use a sharp knife to make light scores on the meat surface to help the seasonings absorb faster and more evenly. Marinate the chicken with soy sauce, white wine, ginger, green onions, and 1 tbsp oyster sauce for about 15 minutes (if using a whole chicken, marinate in the refrigerator for 4-5 hours).
3. How to make soy sauce steamed chicken

Place a pan on the stove, add oil, and sauté the minced shallots and garlic until fragrant. Next, add sugar and cook until it turns an amber color. Quickly place the marinated chicken into the pan and stir until the meat firms up. Turn off the heat and transfer the chicken to a deep dish.
Steaming method:

Place a steamer on the stove, adding a few slices of ginger and a bit of soy sauce to the water. Steam the chicken for about 15-20 minutes until the meat is tender and no pink juice runs out when pierced. Once this is achieved, the chicken is done.
Microwave method:

Place the seared chicken in a microwave-safe dish or bowl. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and place in the microwave. Set to medium heat and cook for 8 minutes, then let it rest for 5 minutes. Next, microwave on high for 5 minutes to ensure the chicken is cooked through.
This method is quick and convenient for medium portions but is not suitable for a whole chicken.
4. Finished product

When finished, the soy sauce steamed chicken will have a beautiful golden-brown color. The meat will be tender and succulent, with a gentle soy sauce aroma and bold flavor. Once done, chop the chicken into bite-sized pieces and arrange on a plate. Garnish with green onions, chili strips, and a bit of pepper for color and appeal.

For the best flavor, soy sauce steamed chicken should be eaten hot. It can be served with white rice or bread. Additionally, serve with cucumber, lettuce, and herbs like perilla and basil to create balance and freshness for the meal.
Secrets for delicious soy sauce steamed chicken

To make the dish delicious, choose fresh free-range chicken and prepare it carefully to remove any odors. If using a whole chicken, choose one weighing about 1.5kg with a compact, firm body and little fat.

During steaming, keep the lid tightly closed to maintain even heat. Halfway through the steaming time, open the lid and wipe away the condensation underneath (for a whole chicken, do this after about 10 minutes). This ensures the chicken doesn't become too waterlogged.
When the steaming water boils, reduce the heat to low so the chicken cooks slowly, preventing the skin from cracking and keeping the meat from becoming dry or tough while retaining moisture.

mon_an.mo_ta: Savory braised chicken with quail eggs – especially easy to eat and delicious for any meal. Learn this great recipe for savory braised chicken with quail eggs.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Soy sauce, fish sauce, sugar, whole peppercorns
cac_buoc: Step 1: Boil the quail eggs starting from cold water with a pinch of salt. While the eggs are boiling, clean the chicken and chop into bite-sized pieces.
Step 2: Peel the ginger and shallots, wash, and slice thinly. Once the quail eggs are cooked, soak them in cold water for 5 minutes to cool and make them easier to peel, then remove the shells.
Step 3: You can optionally fry the eggs until golden. Doing this will make the braised chicken and eggs more flavorful and aromatic.

Step 4: Put the chicken, eggs, ginger, shallots, caramel sauce, and seasonings into a pot. Add about 1/2 a small bowl of water and place on the stove to braise. Initially, use high heat, but once it boils, lower the heat to the minimum!
Step 5: Braise the meat for about 30 minutes until the sauce slightly thickens and becomes syrupy. Transfer to a bowl and enjoy hot.
Source: Kenh14

mon_an.mo_ta: This fried chicken with tamarind sauce is incredibly delicious. The crispy chicken pieces paired with a rich, tangy tamarind sauce create an irresistible flavor that you won't be able to resist!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fried chicken: - 500g chicken wings, 15g minced garlic, 15g minced shallots, Salt, pepper, fish sauce, 50g crispy frying flour
Tamarind sauce: - 70g ripe tamarind, 15g minced garlic, 15g shallots, Sugar
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, combine the fried chicken ingredients (except the frying flour) including the chicken, garlic, shallots, salt, pepper, and fish sauce. Mix well and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Step 2:
After marinating, remove the chicken, chop into bite-sized pieces, and place in a clean bowl. Add the crispy frying flour and shake well until each piece is evenly coated.
In a pot of very hot oil, fry the chicken until golden brown on all sides.
Step 3:
Once the chicken is golden and cooked through, remove it and place on a plate lined with paper towels to drain excess oil.
Step 4:
To make the tamarind sauce, first soak the tamarind in warm water, mashing it to release all the pulp. Then, strain the tamarind liquid through a sieve to remove seeds and solids.
In another pan, sauté the shallots and garlic until golden and fragrant. Pour in the tamarind liquid and simmer until the sauce thickens.
Step 5:
Place the fried chicken into a small pot with a lid and pour in the tamarind sauce. Cover the pot and shake well so the chicken is evenly coated in the sauce.
This fried chicken with tamarind sauce is guaranteed to disappear as soon as it's served!
When serving, sprinkle some chopped green onions on top for a beautiful presentation!
Each piece of chicken is crispy on the outside yet moist and tender on the inside, coated in a sweet and sour tamarind sauce—who could resist!
Start cooking now to treat your family this holiday!

mon_an.mo_ta: Honey Lemon Chicken might be a new dish for many families, but it will soon become a favorite with its delicious, hot chicken infused with the tartness of lemon, the sweetness of honey, and an eye-catching color. Spend a little time in the kitchen to make this tasty treat for your family!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Toasted sesame seeds, thinly sliced green onions, lemon zest, lemon slices - for garnish
cac_buoc: How to make Honey Lemon Chicken for 4-5 people:
Step 1: Prepare the ingredients.
Remove the skin and bones from the chicken breast, wash with water, and pat dry with paper towels. Once dry, cut the chicken into small bite-sized squares.
For the sauce lemon, grate the zest.
Step 2: Cooking steps.

Place the chicken breast, soy sauce, and rice vinegar into a large plastic bag and shake well until the chicken is evenly coated. Place in the refrigerator for at least 10 minutes (or several hours if you have time) to let the flavors penetrate the meat.
When ready to cook, remove the chicken from the marinade, drain well, and transfer to a separate plate.
Next, season both sides of the chicken with a little salt and pepper.
In another bowl, whisk the honey lemon sauce ingredients together until well combined.

Heat a pan over medium heat and add oil. When the oil is hot, add the chicken and stir-fry for 5-7 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through and no longer pink inside, stirring occasionally. Once cooked, use a slotted spoon to transfer the chicken to a separate plate to drain.
Next, pour the honey lemon sauce into another pan. Cook over medium-high heat for 2-3 minutes until the sauce begins to boil and thicken. You can add a bit of chili sauce if you want a spicy kick.
Add the chicken back into the pan and toss well until each piece is coated in a thick layer of sauce.
Finally, turn off the heat and transfer the honey lemon chicken to a plate. Garnish with lemon slices, toasted sesame seeds, etc., and enjoy while hot.
Tips for delicious Honey Lemon Chicken:
You can use chicken thighs or wings instead of breast meat according to your preference.
The longer you marinate the chicken, the more flavorful the dish will be.

Cooking the chicken with the sauce as in this recipe helps keep the breast meat from drying out compared to regular frying or boiling. Furthermore, the chicken is thoroughly marinated and infused with sour, spicy, salty, and sweet flavors, ensuring it's more appetizing than ever. This evening, win over your family's hearts with a hot plate of honey lemon chicken. Everyone will surely enjoy it and give plenty of compliments!

mon_an.mo_ta: Chicken with Scallion Oil – An easy-to-make delicious dish to make your meal more attractive and appetizing. A great recipe for Chicken with Scallion Oil.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Clean the chicken and place it in a pot. Pour in enough water to just cover the chicken, then add the onion, 1/2 ginger slices, and about 1 teaspoon of salt. Bring to a boil over high heat. Once cooked, remove the chicken and submerge it in cold water; remember to save the chicken broth!
Step 2: Brush a thin, even layer of sesame oil over the chicken. Wait until the chicken has cooled completely, then chop into pieces and arrange on a plate.
Step 3: Finely chop the green onions and mince the ginger, then sauté them briefly with cooking oil in a hot pan to create the sauce for the scallion oil chicken.

Step 4: Add 1-2 tablespoons of chicken broth to the bowl of sautéed onions and ginger. Mix in sesame oil, soy sauce, and seasonings, then stir everything together. Crush the toasted sesame seeds and roasted peanuts to serve alongside.
Source: Kenh14

mon_an.ten: Crispy Fried Chicken and Tofu Balls
mon_an.mo_ta: Crispy Fried Chicken and Tofu Balls – to make your holiday meal more lively. This delicious dish will especially help children enjoy their rice more.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Begin with ingredient preparation:
Remove skin from the chicken, wash, drain, and chop finely.
Wash the tofu, drain well, and also chop finely.
Peel the onion, wash, and cut into wedges.

Step 2: Place the chicken, tofu, onion, and egg yolk into a blender. Add salt and flour so that the chicken becomes smooth and binds together when blended. To make the chicken balls better, you can mix in a little tapioca starch or cornstarch.
Step 3:
Pour the blended mixture into a bowl, cover tightly with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for 20 minutes.
Remove from the refrigerator, form the mixture into small balls, and roll them through the panko breadcrumbs to create the Crispy Fried Chicken and Tofu Balls.

Step 4: Heat a pan of oil on the stove. When the oil is hot, drop the chicken balls in and fry until golden brown. Once golden and cooked, remove to a plate lined with paper towels to absorb excess grease. When eating with rice, they can be dipped in chili sauce or ketchup, which kids love.

mon_an.mo_ta: Glazed Chicken Meatballs – especially delicious with a rich, savory sauce. How to make Glazed Chicken Meatballs.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients:
Wash the bell pepper, cut in half, remove seeds, and mince.
Wash the tofu, pat dry, and mash.
Peel the ginger, mince it, mix with a little water, then strain to keep the ginger juice in a separate bowl. Wash the celery and chop finely.
Step 2: Mix the ground chicken, bell pepper, celery, tofu, and ginger juice together with the egg. Add pepper and salt, then mix well for the glazed chicken meatballs.
Step 3: Form the chicken into even-sized balls. Heat oil in a pan and fry each chicken ball until golden brown on all sides.
Step 4: Mix all the sauce ingredients together in a small bowl. Once the chicken balls are fried, remove them to a plate lined with paper towels.

Step 5: Remove excess oil from the pan, return the chicken balls to the pan, and pour in the sauce. Simmer until the sauce thickens and glazes the chicken balls, then remove from heat and serve hot with rice.
Source: Megafun

mon_an.mo_ta: Japanese cold noodles are a signature dish of Japan, loved by many during the summer. This recipe will guide you on how to make Japanese cold noodles at home. Enjoy!
