cac_buoc: Step 1: Bring water to a boil and cook the soba noodles according to the package instructions; they usually cook quickly, in about 5 minutes. Once cooked, drain in a colander and rinse under cold water. Place the noodles on a bamboo tray or plate with a few ice cubes to keep them cold.

Step 2: If using whole sheets of toasted seaweed, use scissors to cut them into thin strips. Finely chop the scallions. Finely grate the ginger or daikon radish (if you don't have a specialized grater, you can mince them very finely).

Step 3: To serve: Pour the dipping sauce into a small bowl. When eating, take a portion of noodles with some seaweed and scallions, dip them into the sauce, and enjoy cold. If you like a spicy kick, you can mix the grated ginger, daikon, or wasabi into the dipping sauce.

Note: The ingredients for this dish can be easily found at Japanese or Korean grocery stores. Dried soba noodles are often packaged in boxes or plastic bags containing several small bundles; each bundle is equivalent to one serving, making it easy to portion while cooking.

mon_an.mo_ta: Enoki mushrooms are light, sweet, and crunchy, while beef is savory and delicious. These two ingredients combine to create an easy-to-make and incredibly tasty dish. Check out our recipe for stir-fried beef with enoki mushrooms below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning powder, salt, oyster sauce, pepper
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel, crush, and mince the garlic. Wash, peel, and julienne the carrot. Trim the roots off the enoki mushrooms, rinse them, and soak in salt water for 15 minutes. Thinly slice the beef.
Step 2: Marinate the beef with seasoning powder, salt, oyster sauce, and minced garlic so it absorbs the flavors.

Step 3: Place a pan over the heat, add the beef and stir-fry quickly over high heat until seared. Add the carrots and chili, stir-frying until almost cooked, then add the enoki mushrooms. Season to taste.
Transfer to a plate and garnish with a fresh chili flower for a beautiful presentation.

mon_an.mo_ta: Tender and sweet chicken cooked to perfection with a crunchy breaded crust. It is delicious when dipped in a bit of chili sauce or ketchup. Make this restaurant-style breaded chicken at home for a perfect weekend treat!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, pepper, seasoning powder, cooking oil
cac_buoc: Let's make Crispy Breaded Chicken together!
Step 1: Wash the chicken breast, pat dry, and cut into bite-sized pieces. Use a meat mallet to tenderize the meat, then marinate with seasoning powder and pepper.
Step 2: Beat the egg in a separate bowl; pour the breadcrumbs and cornstarch into two other bowls.
Step 3: Dip the chicken pieces into the cornstarch, then the egg, and finally the breadcrumbs.

Step 4: Place a pan on the stove, add oil and heat it up, then drop the chicken pieces in to fry until golden. Note: Do not fry too many pieces at once, as the heat will not be sufficient to cook the chicken quickly, resulting in a mealy texture. Once cooked, quickly remove the chicken to a plate lined with paper towels.
And that's it, your Crispy Breaded Chicken is finished.

mon_an.mo_ta: Making five-color mango sticky rice is much easier than you think. Using natural ingredients, we can create this exquisite and beautiful dish!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 2 bowls Thai glutinous rice or high-quality sticky rice (measured with a rice bowl)
2-3 ripe Cat Chu mangoes (or other ripe mangoes of your choice)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Soak the glutinous rice for 5-8 hours or overnight (wash thoroughly before soaking so you can steam it immediately after draining). Drain well.
Step 2: Place a pot on the stove with water and a few pandan leaves. Once the water boils, place the steamer on top, add the rice, and steam for 15-20 minutes until cooked. Remove from heat.

Step 3: Place another larger pot on the stove. Pour in 1 can of coconut milk (400ml), add 6-8 tbsp sugar, 1/2 tsp salt, and a few tied pandan leaves. Stir to dissolve the sugar and salt. When the coconut milk boils, add all the cooked sticky rice and stir quickly (lower the heat to prevent burning).

Step 4: Once the rice has absorbed all the coconut milk, turn off the heat. Transfer the rice to a large bowl, cover tightly, and let it rest for 10-15 minutes to allow it to fully absorb and fluff up.

Blue color from Thai dried butterfly pea flowers: put a few dried flowers in a bowl, add very hot water, and steep for 10 minutes until the desired color is reached. Try to get the most concentrated color, then slowly pour it into the boiling coconut milk, lower the heat, add the cooked sticky rice, and mix well.

Follow the exact same method as above. Once you have the colored extract, wait for the coconut milk to boil and then add the color. Yellow from gardenia seeds. Pink from red yeast rice powder or a bit of beetroot juice. Green from pandan leaves (blend the leaves and strain for the juice).

When making multiple colors like this, divide the sticky rice and coconut milk into portions. You can pre-mix the coconut milk with sugar and salt according to the ratio above, then take a portion for each color.

Step 5: To make the coconut sauce for serving: pour 1 can of coconut milk (400ml) into a small pot, add 5 tbsp sugar, 1/2 tsp salt, and a few tied pandan leaves (to add aroma). Stir well and bring to a boil, then lower the heat.
Step 6: Put 5g of tapioca starch in a bowl, add a little water, and stir to dissolve. Quickly pour the mixture into the coconut milk pot and stir until thickened. Remove from heat and let it cool.
Roasted sesame seeds. Cut the mango only when ready to eat to prevent it from browning and drying out.

Step 7: Presentation: Press the coconut sticky rice into a small bowl, then gently flip it onto a large plate. Drizzle the coconut sauce on top and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Slice the mango into large pieces or bite-sized chunks and place them on the side.

This is the quickest and simplest way to cook it; if you want to make it more colorful and elaborate like mine, just add your favorite colors. The method is the same: add the coloring to the boiling coconut milk before mixing in the sticky rice.
Note: Adjust the amount of sugar to your preference. However, use only a small amount of salt; for every 400ml of coconut milk, add only 1/2 tsp of salt to enhance the flavor and richness.

Adjust the ingredients based on the number of people in your family. If you don't have canned coconut milk, buy mature coconut, grate the flesh, add a little water, squeeze for the milk, then boil and let it cool.

mon_an.mo_ta: Bò nướng lá lốt is a favorite dish for many because it can be prepared on a grill, a cooking method that gives the food a delicious smoky flavor. If you are looking for a unique culinary option to treat your family and friends at upcoming parties, try making bò nướng lá lốt.
cac_buoc: 1. Ingredient preparation
After buying the beef, wash it thoroughly and then grind it (or use a meat grinder to save time).
Peel the shallots and garlic, then mince them together with the lemongrass, chili, and ginger.
For the betel leaves, remove any damaged or diseased leaves, then wash and drain. Take about 5-7 leaves and mince them finely.
2. Marinating the meat
To make the bò nướng lá lốt flavorful, pay close attention to the marinating process. This is the crucial stage that determines the flavor of the dish.
First, peel the shallots and slice them thinly. Peel and crush the garlic finely.
Next, cut the lemongrass into small pieces.

Then, mix the shallots, garlic, and lemongrass together, mince them, and combine with the beef. Mix well so the beef absorbs the flavors, making the dish tastier and preventing it from drying out during grilling.

Next, prepare the following seasonings: 1.5 tsp pepper, 1.5 tsp sugar, 1/2 tsp seasoning powder, 1.4 tsp MSG, and 1 tsp honey. Mix all these seasonings thoroughly and marinate the beef for 15-20 minutes.
Finally, add some roasted and crushed peanuts to the mixture, then mix well with the beef.
3. Wrapping the meat
Place a teaspoon of meat in the center of the ribbed side of a betel leaf.
Fold the edges of the leaf inward from both sides and roll it up. This process is similar to rolling spring rolls.
Once rolled, use the stem of the leaf to pin the edge in place (or use a toothpick).
4. Grilling the beef rolls
Turn on the oven and preheat for about 5 minutes until it reaches 225°C.
Place the beef rolls in the oven and grill for 10 minutes.
Tip: If you don't have an oven, you can also cook the beef rolls in a microwave or an air fryer at the same temperature.
5. Finished product
After roasting the peanuts until fragrant, peel and crush them.
Then, arrange the beef on a plate and sprinkle the crushed peanuts on top. Your bò nướng lá lốt is now ready for the whole family to enjoy.
Preparing the mắm nêm dipping sauce for the bò nướng lá lốt

When enjoying bò nướng lá lốt, the dipping sauce is essential. First, prepare a pineapple by peeling and removing the eyes. Mince half of the pineapple and pour 150ml of fermented anchovy sauce (mắm nêm) into a bowl. Add the minced pineapple to the sauce. Add 1 to 1.5 tsp sugar, the juice of 1 lime, and 2 minced chilies. Mix all the ingredients together well.

Next, arrange the beef rolls on a plate. Add some roasted peanuts, fresh herbs, and rice vermicelli sheets. Use rice paper to wrap the herbs, vermicelli, and a beef roll together, then dip into the sauce.

Bò nướng lá lốt is a familiar and easy-to-eat dish. To fully experience its appeal, wrap the beef in rice paper with fresh herbs, sour starfruit, and green banana, then dip it into the salty, sweet, sour, and spicy sauce. Serving it with fresh herbs makes the dish wonderful and refreshing.
How to choose ingredients for bò nướng lá lốt
1. Choosing fresh and delicious beef
Color and surface: Fresh beef will be deep red, uniform in color, and have a shiny cut surface.
Smell: The meat should have a characteristic fresh meat smell, with no strange odors.
Moisture: When touched, fresh meat should have a dry film and not stick to your hand. It should be elastic and not leave a dent when pressed.
Avoid water-soaked beef: Do not buy meat that feels water-logged, as this indicates it has been soaked in water.
2. Choosing fresh and delicious wild betel leaves
Color and size: Choose dark green leaves with large blades. These are easier to roll and provide a better aroma when cooked.
Thickness and integrity: The leaves should be thick and not torn to ensure they hold the meat well during rolling and grilling.
3. Choosing delicious and aromatic peanuts
Size and shape: Choose peanuts that are large, round, and uniform in size.
Color and smell: Good peanuts will have a bright reddish-brown skin and a characteristic mild peanut aroma.
Avoid damaged nuts: Do not buy peanuts that are worm-eaten, moldy, or have unusual spots on the surface.
Following these criteria will help you select fresh beef, betel leaves, and peanuts to create a delicious and attractive bò nướng lá lốt dish.

mon_an.mo_ta: Pickled apricots are delicious on their own, but they are even more special when combined with braised fish. Check out the instructions for this unique and tasty dish below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fresh fish - 500g (choose your favorite type of fish)
cac_buoc: Ingredients needed to make braised fish with apricots:
Step 1:
Clean the fish thoroughly, pat dry, and cut into bite-sized chunks.
For fish and seafood in general, you should pat the ingredients dry to minimize any lingering fishy odor in the dish.
If you prefer firm fish pieces, use sea fish like mackerel or scad. If you prefer the fish to melt in your mouth, use freshwater fish!
Step 2:
Cut the lemongrass into 5cm lengths and bruise them. For the galangal, simply slice it.
Step 3:
Layer the lemongrass and galangal to completely cover the bottom of the pot. This prevents the fish from burning during the braising process.
Step 4:
Next, arrange the fish in the pot and add the soy sauce, caramel sauce, apricot syrup, and pickled apricots. Place the apricots on top to prevent them from breaking apart.
Step 5:
Pour in enough water to cover the fish and place the pot on the stove to braise.
Step 6:
Once the water reaches a rolling boil, reduce the heat to the lowest setting and continue to simmer.
Note: Do not add cold water to the pot during the braising process, as this will make the fish smell fishy.
Step 7:
Braise until the liquid has almost evaporated and becomes slightly thickened.
This braised fish is best enjoyed with hot steamed rice!
It is so easy to make a nutritious dish for the whole family that never gets boring!

mon_an.mo_ta: If you are used to store-bought egg cakes, today let's head to the kitchen and show off your skills with this homemade version of custard cake. With its beautiful golden appearance, soft and smooth texture, rich flavorful filling, and a light dusting of sugar on top, this cake will surely delight anyone who tries it. Refer to the custard cake recipe right now!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Lemon juice or white wine vinegar - 1 tsp
Powdered sugar for decoration - as desired
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, place the butter in the microwave on high power for 40-50 seconds or melt it in a pan. Pour the melted butter into a small bowl and let it cool completely.
Next, crack the eggs and separate the yolks and whites into two different bowls.
Then, add the sugar to the bowl containing the egg yolks.
Step 2:

Use an electric mixer to beat the mixture for 10 minutes until it is pale yellow, smooth, and fluffy. If you don't have a mixer, you can whisk by hand, but remember to whisk steadily so the mixture is as smooth as if using a machine for a better bake.
Next, add the cold water and vanilla extract, and continue mixing until you have a smooth, fine consistency.
Step 3:
Add a pinch of salt and the cooled melted butter to the mixture, then mix for a few more minutes until the butter is incorporated and the salt is dissolved.
Next, sift the flour through a fine-mesh strainer to ensure there are no lumps, then use the mixer to combine. Meanwhile, pour the milk into a pot and heat it over low heat.
Step 4:
When the milk is lukewarm (about 30-40°C), turn off the heat, pour it into the batter, and mix at the highest speed for 1 minute.
Note: It is crucial that the mixture is not lumpy; if it is, strain it through a sieve and discard the lumps.
For the egg whites, use a mixer to beat them until stiff peaks form, then add the lemon juice or white wine vinegar. Stir well to combine.
Step 5:
Once the egg whites are whipped, gently fold the two mixtures together.
Next, grease a 20x20 cm baking pan with water or butter and line it with parchment paper.
Step 6:

Once prepared, pour the batter into the pan. Place the pan in a preheated oven and bake at 150°C for 80 minutes (or 130°C for 70 minutes if using a convection oven) until the surface is golden brown or the cake is fully cooked.
When the cake is done, let it cool completely at room temperature. Then, cover the pan with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
Step 7:
After chilling for 2 hours, take the cake out of the refrigerator, remove it from the mold, and peel off the parchment paper.
Next, use a very sharp knife to cut the cake into small squares.
Finally, sprinkle a little powdered sugar on top for decoration.
You can enjoy the cake with a cup of tea to enhance the flavor.
Tips for a delicious cake:
When beating the egg whites, remember to whisk steadily so the mixture is soft, smooth, and fluffy.
When baking, keep an eye on the time and the cake to prevent it from burning, which would ruin the flavor.

mon_an.mo_ta: Braised carp with pickled greens is a familiar family dish featuring tender, fresh, and flavorful carp, crunchy pickled greens, soft pork belly, and fragrant pork fat cracklings that will make you finish your rice pot in no time! Just a little time in the kitchen and you'll have a wonderful meal for the whole family!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Ginger, shallots, turmeric, green onions, dill, chili - seasonings
cac_buoc: Ingredient preparation
Wash the pork belly with water and drain. You should also buy a little extra pork fat to slice thinly and render into cracklings for frying the fish.
Scale the carp and wash it with salt to reduce the fishy smell, then rinse with clean water and drain.
Wash the tomatoes and cut them into wedges.
Steps to make braised carp with pickled greens.

First, place a pan on the stove and heat some oil. When the oil is very hot, lightly fry the carp. Remember to brown both sides evenly. You don't need to fry it too thoroughly, just until the sides are golden. Remove the fish and set aside on a plate.
Next, fry the pork fat until the fat is rendered and it turns into crispy cracklings, then remove them.
After that, pour out some of the rendered fat and stir-fry the pork belly until the edges are browned.
Once the pork belly has a nice color, remove it. Add the tomatoes to the pan and sauté until soft, then add the pickled greens and stir well.
Next, place a pot on the stove and add the pickled greens, pork belly, and tomatoes. Add sliced ginger and chili if you like it spicy. Pour in one bowl of water to simmer.

Once the liquid is boiling, add a little turmeric powder, the pork cracklings, and the carp. Flip the fish gently to avoid breaking it. Simmer for 15-20 minutes until the fish is cooked through and seasoned on both sides, then garnish with green onions.
Finally, serve the fish on a deep plate so it stays soaked in the spicy and sour braising liquid, and enjoy with hot rice.
Good luck with this wonderful dish!
Tips for perfect braised carp with pickled greens
Depending on your preference, you can season the fish to be light or slightly salty.
If you like green bananas, you can add them to the braise for extra flavor.
When frying the fish, do not overcook it; just a quick fry to reduce the fishy smell is enough.
How to choose good carp:
You should choose river carp for better meat quality.

When choosing, look for a fish with a thick body from top to bottom rather than a thick belly. A thick belly usually means it's full of eggs or fat, or it's a farm-raised fish with large intestines, which often results in less sweet meat.

Specifically for carp, river carp are always long-bodied, not round like pond carp. When buying, remember to choose the longer, thicker ones for better sweetness and aroma. Don't just go for the heaviest one, as farm-raised fish grow very fast, have large guts, and lots of fat, making them round but the meat isn't as sweet due to industrial feed and short growth time.

For pre-cut fish steaks, be careful as it's easy to buy fish that has been dead for a long time. There are two ways to choose: either ask the seller to cut a piece from a large, swimming fish, or look closely and only buy pieces where the body is still attached to the head and the gills are still moving. This ensures the fish you buy is fresh.

mon_an.mo_ta: A meal with pickled eggplants, a bowl of sour soup or crab soup with jute leaves, and a plate of water spinach stir-fried with garlic is simple yet very appealing. Additionally, if you want to eat them immediately, you can try the sweet and sour quick-pickled method, which is both delicious and time-saving. Pickled eggplants will make your family meals much more appetizing. Spend a little time to make this wonderful dish!
cac_buoc: Ingredient preparation
Thai eggplants:

After buying the eggplants, leave them in a cool place for half a day or sun-dry them for 2 hours to wilt them. Then, trim the stems (don't cut too close to the fruit) and soak them in a bowl of lightly salted water for 15 minutes to remove toxins.
Next, wash the eggplants with cold water and drain.
Peel the garlic, wash it, and crush it.
Remove the stems from the chilies, wash them, and slice them.
Peel the ginger, wash it, and julienne it.
How to pickle crunchy and delicious eggplants

First, boil 1 liter of water with 1 tbsp sugar and 3 tbsp salt; the taste should be slightly saltier than regular soup. Let it cool to about 30°C. If you want them to sour faster, you can add 1 tbsp of fish sauce.

Next, clean the glass jar and dry it thoroughly; you can also use ceramic or porcelain jars. Sprinkle a thin layer of salt and crushed garlic at the bottom of the jar, then layer the eggplants on top. Add a few slices of red chili for color and a mild spicy kick. Repeat until finished.

Then, pour the prepared salt and sugar solution over the eggplants until they are completely submerged. Add a few more tablespoons of salt, julienned ginger, and sliced chilies on top. Note: Do not stir the top layer of salt; let it dissolve naturally if the initial brine wasn't salty enough.

Next, use a small plate or a plastic bag filled with water to weigh down the eggplants so they don't float above the water. Eggplants that float will turn black, losing their aesthetic appeal and crunchiness.
With this method, you can enjoy this rustic yet attractive dish after just 2-3 days.
Tips for a crunchy and attractive jar of pickled eggplants
You should only pickle about 1kg at a time; pickle more once you've finished. Do not leave the eggplants in the brine for too long; if a white film forms, it can be harmful to eat.
Requirements for the dish:
The finished pickled eggplants should have an attractive white color and not be blackened.
When eaten, they should have a balanced salty taste, a mild spicy kick, and be fragrant and crunchy.

You can serve pickled eggplants with shrimp paste, fermented shrimp sauce, chili-garlic fish sauce, or mix them with other types of fermented fish sauces; they are all very suitable and stimulate the appetite.

A meal with pickled eggplants, a bowl of sour soup or crab soup with jute leaves, and a plate of water spinach stir-fried with garlic is simple yet very appealing. Additionally, if you want to eat them immediately, you can try the sweet and sour quick-pickled method, which is both delicious and time-saving. With just a few simple steps and easy-to-find ingredients, you will have a jar of crunchy, fragrant, and attractive pickled eggplants. This dish will make your family meals much more appetizing. Spend a little time to make this wonderful dish!

mon_an.mo_ta: Shrimp curry is no longer a strange dish to many because of its delicious flavor and attractive color. Fresh, crunchy shrimp are bathed in a fragrant curry sauce with a mild spicy kick, along with onions and green chilies. Everything blends together to create an irresistible dish. Let's get into the kitchen and learn how to make this delicious meal!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Chili powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, tomato powder - 1 tsp each
cac_buoc: Step 1: Ingredient preparation
Wash the shrimp, peel off the shells, remove the black veins and whiskers, then rinse again and drain.
Wash the tomatoes and cut them into small squares.
Peel the onions, wash them, and cut them into small squares.
Peel the ginger, crush it, and mince it.
Wash the green chilies and chop them finely.
Wash the coriander leaves, drain, and chop them finely.
Step 2: Steps to make the shrimp curry.
First, place a pan on the stove and add 3 tbsp of vegetable oil to heat up.
When the oil is hot, add the cinnamon sticks, cloves, and cardamom pods to the pan.
Then, use a wooden spoon to stir constantly for about 30 seconds to 1 minute, then add the onions and green chilies, stirring continuously.
Sauté the onion mixture for about 5 minutes or until the onions are light brown, fragrant, and cooked through.
Next, add the crushed ginger and 2 tbsp of fried garlic to the pan. Stir well so the onions absorb the flavors.
Then, add the following spices to the pan one by one: turmeric powder, red chili powder, coriander powder, and half a teaspoon of garam masala.
Use a spoon to stir the ingredients for 5 minutes while reducing the heat to low, then add the tomatoes and stir until they soften.
Next, add the tomato powder and cumin powder. Stir well with a spoon, then pour in 300ml of hot water.
Maintain low heat, cover the pan, and simmer for about 10-15 minutes.
After this time, open the lid and add the shrimp, then increase the heat.
Season with 2 tsp of salt, stir well, and add the remaining hot water.
Cover the pan again and lower the heat. Simmer the curry for another 10-15 minutes before turning off the stove.
Finally, ladle the shrimp curry onto a plate and garnish with some fresh coriander leaves.
Tips for a delicious shrimp curry:

If you cannot find black tiger shrimp, you can use smaller shrimp, but they must be very fresh. Good shrimp have slightly bluish meat when peeled. Avoid using frozen shrimp as the meat will be mushy and not as tasty.
If you cannot eat spicy food, you can reduce the amount of chili, but do not omit it entirely as it will affect the authentic flavor of the curry.

mon_an.mo_ta: Braised mackerel in coconut water is a delicious variation of the traditional braised fish dish. The fish pieces have an eye-catching color, a tender texture, and are deeply infused with savory spices and the fragrant aroma of young coconut water. This dish is so appetizing it will have you finishing your rice pot in no time. Let's make this treat for the whole family!
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients for the braised mackerel in coconut water.
Wash the mackerel thoroughly, drain, and cut into slices about 5cm thick.
Peel the shallots and garlic, wash them, and mince finely.

Next, marinate the fish with fish sauce, salt, pepper, sugar, MSG, and the minced shallots and garlic for 30 minutes to allow the flavors to penetrate. Occasionally flip the fish to ensure both sides are evenly seasoned.
Crack open the Siamese coconut and pour the water into a small bowl.
Clean the green onions by removing wilted leaves and roots, wash, and cut into sections.
Wash the chili and slice it thinly.
Steps to make delicious braised mackerel in coconut water:

Step 1: First, place a pan on the stove. Once the oil is hot, sauté the garlic until fragrant, then add the mackerel and fry until golden brown. Remove and place on a plate. Be sure to flip the fish evenly to avoid burning and to maintain an attractive appearance.

Step 2: Next, bring fish sauce, MSG, sugar, and fresh coconut water to a boil. Once boiling, add the pre-fried mackerel along with a bit of lard to make the fish richer and tastier. Lower the heat and simmer the fish on the stove.
Step 3: Braise the fish until the coconut water begins to reduce and thicken. Turn off the heat and sprinkle with fresh green onions and chili to finish the dish.
Finally, arrange the fish on a plate and enjoy with hot rice.
Notes for delicious braised mackerel in coconut water:
You should choose young Siamese coconuts; the water from young coconuts makes the braised mackerel taste better. If you enjoy eating coconut flesh, you can also add it to the pot with the fish.
When frying the mackerel, use a non-stick pan to prevent the fish from sticking and to keep the slices intact.
During the braising process, keep the heat low so the fish cooks evenly and absorbs the seasonings for a richer flavor.
Additionally, you can add other ingredients like pork belly to braise with the fish.
How to choose good fish:
Choose fish that are white or yellow for the best meat quality. Black fish are often from stagnant ponds and do not taste as good.

When buying fish, don't be afraid to get your hands dirty, as being hesitant can lead to buying poor-quality fish. Check the gills; if they are bright red, the fish is fresh. If they are pale or dark, the fish is stale. How to pick fresh fish? It's best to buy fish that are still swimming. If buying dead fish, be very careful. Look at the exterior: if it's still slimy and shiny, the eyes are transparent, the scales are intact, and the gills are pink, the fish is fresh. If you put it in water and it sinks, it's fresh. If the exterior is sticky, the eyes are sunken, the scales fall off easily, the color is pale, the flesh lacks elasticity, the belly and anus are swollen, and it floats in water, the fish is stale. Distinguishing fresh from stale: a fresh fish has a pale white anus that retracts into the belly, while a stale one is protruding and bruised.
Identifying contaminated fish:
The gills are the respiratory organ of the fish, much like human lungs; most toxins likely concentrate here. Contaminated gills are not smooth or bright; they are coarse and dark red.
Heavily contaminated fish may lose their shape, having a large head and small tail, a hunched back, or even tumors. Some may have yellow skin and a green tail.
The eyes of contaminated fish are often cloudy, losing their normal brightness, and some may even protrude.
Normal fish have a fishy smell, but contaminated fish will have unusual odors like garlic or kerosene.

mon_an.mo_ta: With just a little time in the kitchen and familiar ingredients, you can prepare a delicious bowl of Canh Chua Cá Lóc. This soup features a rich flavor with tender, sweet snakehead fish and crunchy taro stems. The sweet and sour broth served with hot rice will provide a wonderful dining experience.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Snakehead fish, cut into steaks - 500 g
Sawtooth herb, rice paddy herb, bean sprouts, red chili - aromatic herbs
cac_buoc: Prepare ingredients for Canh Chua Cá Lóc:
First, clean and prepare the vegetables: peel the taro stems (bạc hà), cut into sections, and wash with water. Wash the okra and cut into small pieces.
Remove the stems and any bruised parts from the tomatoes, wash, and cut into wedges.
Peel the pineapple, remove the eyes, and slice into bite-sized pieces.
Peel the shallots and garlic, wash, and mince the garlic finely.
Steps to make Canh Chua Cá Lóc:
Step 1:
First, place a large pot with oil on the stove over medium heat. When the oil is hot, sauté the shallots and garlic until fragrant.
Next, add the snakehead fish and sear all sides until the flesh turns opaque white.
Step 2:
Next, pour in 1.2 liters of water along with the tamarind, okra, and pineapple. Cook until the water boils, then add the taro stems.
Step 3:
Wait about 10 minutes or until the taro stems are nearly cooked, then add the tomatoes and the rest of the pineapple. Season with 40g salt, 30g sugar, and 40g seasoning powder.
Cook for another 5 minutes then turn off the heat. Before turning off the stove, you can adjust the seasoning one last time to suit your taste.
You can also add a little chili for a spicy kick.
Finally, ladle the soup into a bowl and enjoy while hot.
Notes for delicious Canh Chua Cá Lóc:
Be careful not to overcook the soup, as it will cause the fish meat to fall apart and lose its natural sweetness.
If you want a richer flavor, you can substitute fish sauce for salt, but the broth will not be as clear.
To make the taro stems tastier, you can lightly sauté them before adding them to the pot so they absorb the seasonings better.
How to choose good fish:
Choose fish that are white or yellow for the best meat quality. Black fish are often from stagnant ponds and do not taste as good.
You should also check the gills; if they are red, the fish is fresh, but if they are pale or dark, the fish is stale.

Try to buy fish that are still swimming. If buying dead fish, be very careful. Look at the exterior: if it's still slimy and shiny, the eyes are transparent, the scales are intact, and the gills are pink, the fish is fresh. If you put it in water and it sinks, it's fresh. If the exterior is sticky, the eyes are sunken, the scales fall off easily, the color is pale, the flesh lacks elasticity, the belly and anus are swollen, and it floats in water, the fish is stale.

With just a little time in the kitchen and familiar ingredients, you can prepare a delicious bowl of Canh Chua Cá Lóc. This soup features a rich flavor with tender, sweet snakehead fish and crunchy taro stems. The sweet and sour broth served with hot rice will provide a wonderful dining experience.

mon_an.ten: Fried Chicken Wings with Fish Sauce and Garlic
mon_an.mo_ta: Fried chicken wings with fish sauce and garlic is a familiar dish in many families because it attracts diners with its crispy golden skin, eye-catching color, and minced garlic topping. The meat is tender, fresh, and fully infused with seasoning. Serving these wings with hot rice is an excellent choice when you're undecided on what to eat! This guide provides simple yet delicious steps from preparing the chicken to frying and adding the garlic-chili fish sauce. Enjoy a flavorful, savory, and attractive dish for family and friends.
cac_buoc: Instructions for simple and delicious fried chicken wings with fish sauce and garlic:
Wash the chicken wings with salt to remove odors and ensure the meat is fresh.
Next, heat a pan of oil. Once very hot, sauté the minced garlic for 5 minutes until fragrant, then turn off the heat.
In a bowl, mix the sugar, vinegar, and ¼ cup of water. Stir well until the ingredients are combined. Once the mixture is ready, turn the stove back on and pour the mixture into the pan.
Next, combine the fish sauce, lime juice, and chili sauce in a clean bowl. Heat the previous mixture in the pan, then add the fish sauce mixture and bring to a boil before turning off the heat.
Once prepared, pour the boiled mixture into a sealed plastic container and place it in the refrigerator for 30 minutes to cool and slightly thicken.

Next, prepare a baking tray and place the chicken wings on it. Drizzle the chilled garlic fish sauce mixture over the wings. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and marinate overnight in the refrigerator.
Once the wings have marinated overnight, remove them and let them sit at room temperature for 15 minutes. Pour rice flour into a bowl and dredge each wing in the flour.
Next, turn on the stove and fry the wings until they turn golden brown, about 10 minutes. Once cooked, remove the wings and place them on a plate lined with paper towels to drain excess oil.
Pour the remaining half of the sauce into a pan and simmer over high heat for 1 minute or until slightly thickened. Add the fried wings and toss for a few minutes, then turn off the heat.
Finally, arrange on a plate and enjoy with hot rice.
How to make fried chicken with butter garlic fish sauce:
1. Prepare ingredients
Chicken wings: 800g.
Butter: 20g.
Garlic: 1 bulb.
Chili: 2 fruits.
Green onion: 1 stalk.
Seasonings: Ground pepper, oyster sauce, cashew oil, chili sauce, tapioca starch, salt, sugar, MSG.
2. Instructions for butter garlic fish sauce chicken
2.1. Prepare ingredients
Step 1: To remove the chicken's odor, rub salt on the surface for 5-10 minutes, then wash and drain.
Step 2: Peel and mince the garlic.
2.2. Marinating
Marinate the chicken with 2 tsp sugar, 1.5 tsp seasoning powder, ½ tsp salt, 2 tsp fish sauce (add garlic powder if available for more flavor), mix well, and leave for 30 minutes.
2.3. Prepare the sauce
In a bowl, mix 1.5 tbsp sugar, 2 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp oyster sauce, ½ tbsp chili sauce, 1 tbsp cashew oil, and 2 tbsp cold water. Stir until completely dissolved.
2.4: Frying the chicken
Before frying, place the marinated wings in a small bag with a little tapioca starch. Shake well to coat the wings evenly.
Heat the pan, add garlic and sauté until light golden, then remove the garlic. Next, fry the wings until golden brown on all sides. Once fried, remove and drain the oil.
Return the pan to the stove and melt the butter completely. Add the prepared sauce and stir well. Toss the wings in the sauce until it reduces and coats the wings evenly.
Finally, add the previously removed garlic and chopped green onions, then stir well. The dish is complete.
How to make fried chicken with garlic and chili fish sauce:
Chicken wing drumettes: 200g (or other parts as preferred).
Chili: 3 fruits (minced).
Garlic: 6 cloves (minced).
Fish sauce: 1 tbsp.
Cooking oil: 2 tbsp.
Salt/sugar: A little
Step 1: Wash 200g of chicken wing drumettes with diluted salt water and drain.
Step 2: Place the chicken in a bowl, add 1/2 tsp salt. Mix well and marinate for 15 minutes.
How to prepare chicken to remove odors:
Method 1: After washing with water, rub white wine over the chicken and marinate for 10 minutes. Rinse again with water.
Method 2: Mix salt and vinegar in a 2:1 ratio. Rub this mixture on the chicken for 3-5 minutes, then rinse with water. This will remove any odors.
2.2. Frying the chicken
Step 1: Turn the stove to medium heat, add 2 tbsp oil to the pan and wait for it to get hot.
Step 2: Once the oil is hot, add the drumettes to fry. Flip them regularly so they cook evenly.
Step 3: Fry for about 7 minutes until both sides are golden brown and fragrant. Remove the chicken.
2.3. Mix the garlic chili fish sauce
In a bowl, combine 3 minced chilies, 6 minced garlic cloves, 1 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp sugar, and 1 tbsp filtered water. Mix well until the seasonings are combined.
2.4. Completion
Turn the stove back to medium heat and place the pan on it.
Step 1: Add the garlic chili sauce mixture and the chicken to the pan.
Step 2: Toss the chicken in the mixture until the sauce coats the meat and starts to thicken. About 3 minutes of tossing is enough.
Step 3: Once the chicken is glazed and attractive, turn off the heat.
After completing these steps, the fried chicken wings with fish sauce and garlic are ready to be enjoyed.
Notes for perfect fried chicken wings with fish sauce and garlic:
Clean the chicken wings thoroughly before processing to ensure the dish is fragrant and free of odors.
Adjust the garlic fish sauce according to your family's taste; however, a balanced flavor will make the dish more enjoyable without making you too thirsty.

If you don't have an oven, follow these simpler steps: Fry the prepared chicken until cooked, crispy on the outside, and golden. Then, simmer the prepared garlic fish sauce with the fried chicken for a few minutes until the meat is evenly coated and the sauce is slightly thickened.
Besides wings, you can use any other part of the chicken, but wings and drumsticks usually yield the best results.

mon_an.mo_ta: Chicken wings with mushroom sauce is a fairly simple and easy-to-make dish using basic ingredients. Once prepared, the wings have an attractive color and delicious flavor, with tender chicken paired with crunchy, fragrant shiitake mushrooms. This wonderful dish will have you finishing your rice pot before you know it!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Sesame oil, soy sauce, ginger, wine, pepper, sugar, salt, and sesame oil - seasonings
cac_buoc: How to make delicious chicken wings with mushroom sauce:
Step 1: Prepare the chicken wings.

Wash the fresh chicken wings with salt water to remove odors, then rinse again with water. Prepare a large bowl, add the wings, and marinate with one spoon of white wine, sesame oil, salt, sugar, pepper, and minced ginger. Mix well so the ingredients combine. Let the wings marinate for 30 minutes.
Step 2: Prepare the seasonings.

Peel and wash the dry shallots, then slice or mince them to sauté later. Soak dry shiitake mushrooms in clean water for 20 minutes until they expand. Then wash them. You can also soak them in hot water to speed up the process. After soaking, wash the mushrooms thoroughly and trim the stems to remove any odors.

Step 3: Prepare a pan, place it on the stove, and add oil. When the oil is very hot, fry the chicken wings until golden brown on both sides. Once cooked, remove the wings to a clean plate lined with paper towels to drain the oil. When frying, do not use heat that is too high, as it can cook the outside while leaving the inside raw. Remember to flip both sides for a beautiful color!

Step 4: Next, take a new pot and add the chicken wings to braise with the shiitake mushrooms. Add oyster sauce and half a bowl of room-temperature boiled water to the pot. Simmer the meat over low heat until the liquid has almost evaporated. Occasionally stir with cooking chopsticks to prevent the wings from sticking or burning. Once the wings are fully cooked, turn off the heat, arrange beautifully on a plate, and enjoy.
Notes for delicious chicken wings with mushroom sauce:
Besides wings, you can prepare this dish with other parts like drumsticks or chicken breast.
If you love shiitake mushrooms, feel free to add as many as you like.
Before turning off the heat, you can add green onions to enhance the flavor and color of the dish.
How to choose good chicken:
A good chicken will have a compact, firm body and a small breast.
The skin of a free-range chicken should be bright yellow, with darker yellow areas like the wings, breast, and back. The skin should not be bruised, pale, or have black spots or lumps.
If the skin is tough and uniformly bright yellow but the fat is white, the chicken may have been treated with yellow dye.
The meat should be firm, fresh, and free of foul odors or the smell of antibiotics.

Press on the body, breast, or thigh to check; if the meat is firm, it is good. If the meat is flabby, slippery, deformed, or pitted (indicating water injection), it may have been injected with water or mixed with borax. Absolutely do not buy such chicken to avoid health risks.

mon_an.mo_ta: Baby clam soup with starfruit has a sour, sweet, and slightly spicy flavor. The clam meat is tender, fresh, and well-seasoned. Enjoying this sour clam soup will provide a refreshing feeling during hot summer days. With just a little time in the kitchen and simple, easy-to-find ingredients, you can have a wonderful soup to treat your family and friends.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Green onions, dill - a few stalks
Seasonings - sugar, fish sauce, salt, MSG
cac_buoc: Prepare ingredients for baby clam soup with starfruit:

Wash the baby clam meat and soak it in water mixed with salt to remove all dirt and impurities. Then, marinate the clam meat with 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp MSG, and 2 crushed bird's eye chilies. Mix well so the clams absorb the seasoning.
Wash the tomatoes and cut them into wedges.
Wash the starfruit, trim the edges, and cut into thin star-shaped slices.
Clean the green onions by removing roots and wilted leaves, then wash and cut into sections.
Clean the dill by removing roots and wilted leaves, then wash and cut into sections.
Wash the large chili and cut into sections.
Wash the bamboo shoots, squeeze out the sour liquid, and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Peel the garlic, wash, and mince finely.
Steps to make baby clam soup with starfruit:
Step 1: First, place a pot on the stove, add about 2 tsp of cooking oil, and heat it. When the oil is hot, add the minced garlic and sauté until golden and fragrant.
Next, add all the clam meat and stir-fry until the clams firm up slightly and absorb the seasonings.

Step 2: Add the sour bamboo shoots, starfruit, and tomatoes to the pot. Stir-fry together and add 1 tsp sugar and 1 tsp salt. You should add the tomatoes first to soften them, then add the bamboo shoots and starfruit.
Step 3: Once the ingredients have absorbed the seasonings, pour in 1 liter of clam broth (or water) and add the crushed large chili. Bring to a boil.
Step 4: Once boiling, lower the heat and add the green onions and dill. Add 1 tbsp fish sauce, half a spoon of MSG, and 1 tbsp of fried shallots for aroma, then turn off the heat.
Finally, ladle the soup into a bowl and serve hot.
Notes for delicious baby clam soup with starfruit:
Marinating the clams is optional, but it helps the clam meat have a richer, sweeter flavor.

How to choose good baby clams: There are many types, but mainly two: farm-raised in ponds and river clams. Usually, river clams are slightly smaller than farm-raised ones, but they are hard to distinguish if you aren't an expert. River clams often have sand in their mouths, while farm-raised ones have mud. To choose good clams, look at the shells. Choose batches where the shells are quite shiny or smooth. Clams can be light or dark in color, but those with clean shells are better as they live in clean water. Clean shells also save you time when washing them.

Baby clam soup with starfruit has a sour, sweet, and slightly spicy flavor. The clam meat is tender, fresh, and well-seasoned. Enjoying this sour clam soup will provide a refreshing feeling during hot summer days. With just a little time in the kitchen and simple, easy-to-find ingredients, you can have a wonderful soup to treat your family and friends. Everyone will be delighted with this refreshing soup!

mon_an.ten: How to Make Delicious Spanish Mackerel Fish Cakes
mon_an.mo_ta: Spanish mackerel fish cakes are a familiar dish in many Vietnamese families. These small, eye-catching, and fragrant cakes are made from fresh ingredients, making it easy to please even the most demanding diners. With just a little time in the kitchen, you can create this rustic yet delicious dish! Follow the recipe below to make it yourself.
cac_buoc: How to make delicious Spanish mackerel fish cakes (serves 3-4)
Step 1: Prepare ingredients.
Wash the outer skin of the mackerel. Gut the fish, remove the internal organs, and take the two fillets. Debone the fish to keep only the meat, then wash again, drain, and marinate with salt.
Step 2: Prepare the grinder.
After marinating, put the fish into a blender and grind until smooth.

Once the fish is finely ground, transfer it to a bowl and mix in the scallions, dill, and seasonings to enhance the flavor. Use your hands to mix the mixture thoroughly until all ingredients are well combined.
Step 3: Shaping
Once the mixture is smooth, put it in a bowl and begin shaping the fish cakes. Shape them into bite-sized pieces!
Step 4: The fish cakes should be shaped into flat rounds, about 1/4 the size of your palm, to be bite-sized.
Step 5: Fry the fish cakes.

First, heat a pan of oil on the stove. Wait until the oil is very hot, then begin adding the shaped fish cakes to fry. Fry until golden brown on both sides. Once golden, remove the cakes and place them on a plate lined with paper towels.
Finally, arrange the fish cakes on a plate and enjoy while hot.
Notes for perfect Spanish mackerel fish cakes:
Remember to clean the mackerel thoroughly to remove any fishy odor.
When mixing the mixture, mix evenly by hand so the fish absorbs the seasonings and ingredients.

When frying the fish cakes, remember to flip them regularly so they cook evenly and have an attractive color. Do not use heat that is too high, as this will cause the cakes to be cooked on the outside but raw on the inside.
Besides Spanish mackerel, you can use any other type of fish to make cakes; just ensure the fish meat is not too mushy.
How to choose fresh fish:
When buying fish, choose those with white or yellow colors for the best meat. Black-colored fish are often from ponds or ditches and the meat is less tasty.

When buying fish, do not be afraid to get your hands dirty, as being hesitant makes it easy to buy poor-quality fish. Pull back the gills to check; if the gills are still red, the fish is fresh, but if they are pale white or dark, the fish is stale.

You should buy fish that are swimming actively; if buying dead fish, be extremely careful. Look at the fish's appearance: if it is still slimy and shiny, the eyes are transparent, the scales are not falling off, the gills are still pink, and the fish sinks when placed in water, it is fresh. If the exterior has sticky fluid, the eyes are sunken, the scales fall off easily, the color is pale, the meat is no longer elastic, the belly and anus are swollen, and the fish floats in water, then it is stale.
Another way to distinguish fresh and stale fish: a fresh fish has a pale white anus that is retracted into the belly, while a stale fish has a protruding and purple anus.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Pure Traditional Coconut Oil at Home
mon_an.mo_ta: Coconut oil is a very beneficial essential oil with many uses. With just a little time, you can have a jar of pure, fragrant, clear, and safe oil. Learn how to make pure traditional coconut oil at home with detailed instructions. Enjoy the benefits of natural coconut oil through a simple and easy-to-follow process.
cac_buoc: Method 1: How to make coconut oil at home
First, use the back of a knife to strike along the equator of the coconut to break it in half. Pour the coconut water into a separate jug to drink as a refreshment.
Next, use a mallet to tap gently around the shell to loosen the meat. Collect the coconut meat, peel off the gray outer skin, and grate the coconut into small shreds.
Then, pour 2 liters of boiling water into a basin and add all the grated coconut shreds. Soak for as long as possible. This process helps the coconut release its oil into the hot water.
After 4-5 hours, scoop the coconut meat out into another basin. Keep the water containing the coconut oil separate.
Next, use the cheesecloth to squeeze the coconut shreds thoroughly so no oil is wasted.

Then, put the coconut shreds into a blender, grind them finely, and soak them again with the remaining 1 liter of boiling water. Squeeze the liquid from the pulp again using the cheesecloth. Discard the pulp and keep all the liquid collected from the soaking sessions.
Place a clean cast iron pan on the stove. Once the pan is dry, use a large spoon to scoop the coconut soaking water into the pan and bring to a boil over high heat.

When the coconut milk boils, reduce to low heat and continue to simmer until the water evaporates completely, leaving behind coconut oil and residue. Simmer until the residue is slightly browned and sticks to the bottom of the pan, then turn off the heat.
After that, let it cool and filter the residue to collect the oil. Continue simmering all the coconut milk to obtain the oil as described above.
Once the oil has cooled, pour it into an airtight container immediately to avoid leaving the coconut oil exposed to the air for many hours.
Method 2: How to make cold-pressed coconut oil at home
Prepare ingredients
Mature coconut meat.
Hot boiling water.
Tools: Blender, cloth towel, and glass jar.
Steps to make cold-pressed coconut oil
Step 1: Use a blender to grind the mature coconut meat with hot boiling water until smooth.
Step 2: Use a cloth towel to filter the coconut milk, squeezing hard to extract all the oil and remove the pulp.
Step 3: Pour all the coconut milk into a glass jar and seal tightly. After one day, the coconut milk will naturally separate into layers, with a thick white layer on the surface.

Step 4: Place the jar of coconut milk in the refrigerator for about 2-3 hours for the white layer to solidify. Completely remove this layer and keep the remaining part in the glass jar; that is the pure coconut oil.
Method 3: How to make coconut oil using a rice cooker
500g pre-grated dried coconut
500ml boiling water
Sieve or cheesecloth for filtering
Spoon or chopsticks for stirring
Glass jar to store the finished coconut oil
Rice cooker
Steps to perform
Step 1: Grate the coconut and soak it in 500ml of boiling water for about 15-30 minutes to let the coconut absorb the water.
Step 2: After soaking, filter and squeeze the coconut thoroughly to get as much milk as possible. Use a sieve or cheesecloth to filter and prepare for cooking.
Step 3: Pour the collected coconut milk into the rice cooker, press the "cook" button, and bring the coconut milk to a boil.
Step 4: After 40 minutes, the coconut milk will become thick and start to separate the oil. Close the rice cooker lid to prevent oil from splashing out and continue cooking for about 20 more minutes.
Step 5: When the coconut residue has concentrated and settled at the bottom of the rice cooker with a reddish-brown color and the oil has a faint aroma, turn off the rice cooker.
Step 6: Proceed to extract the coconut oil into a clean bowl or glass jar for storage.
Notes when making coconut oil

Choosing coconuts for oil: The best coconuts for making oil are mature coconuts with brown husks still on the tree. The chosen fruits must be old with dark brown husks and feel firm to the touch. Note that you should not confuse dried coconut with desiccated coconut. Desiccated coconut consists of tiny, crunchy pieces often used in sweet soups.

Grinding coconut meat: Note that this step needs to be done immediately. After peeling and washing the coconut, you should grind it right away to get the meat. Avoid peeling and washing the coconut then storing it for several days before making the oil. This will significantly affect the aroma, hygiene, and quality of the coconut oil.

Storing coconut oil: Store the oil in a cool, dry place, away from direct sunlight. Coconut oil will solidify at low temperatures; when using, you can soak the container in hot water to melt the oil easily. Pure oil can be stored for 1-2 years. Storing in the refrigerator is also worth noting. This is the way to keep the coconut oil fragrant and of the best quality throughout use; only store it in the cool compartment of the fridge.
Distinguishing between hot-pressed and cold-pressed coconut oil
The hot-press extraction method uses heat to separate water from the oil. The resulting coconut oil is yellow and has a slightly strong or pungent smell.
However, this method is only suitable for small-scale production, and the oil still contains impurities after extraction, resulting in a short shelf life.
In contrast, the cold-press extraction method uses cold temperatures to separate water from the oil. The resulting coconut oil is clear white and has a gentle aroma.
This method can be applied to mass production; the extracted oil is pure, allowing for long-term storage and high nutritional value.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Delicious Sweet and Sour Pickled Mustard Greens
mon_an.mo_ta: Pickled mustard greens are a familiar dish for many families, featuring fragrant and crunchy greens. Eating them with meat provides a wonderful sensation! Let's learn how to make delicious sweet and sour pickled mustard greens! Discover the method with detailed instructions. Enjoy this traditional dish with its unique flavor, combining sour and sweet notes. Explore simple steps and easy-to-find ingredients to create fragrant sweet and sour pickled mustard greens at home.
cac_buoc: Prepare ingredients for pickling:
When you buy mustard greens, separate each leaf and wash with water to remove dirt and sand. You should wash them 2-3 times to remove all sand and dust.
Next, arrange the mustard greens on a tray to sun-dry for one day until slightly wilted.
Clean the scallions, remove roots and wilted leaves, then dry them until wilted along with the greens.
After that, wash the greens and scallions again, then chop into bite-sized pieces about 5cm long. Wash once more and let drain.
Peel the garlic, chili, and galangal, remove any damaged parts, wash, drain, and slice thinly.
Steps to make delicious pickled mustard greens

Step 1: First, prepare the pickling brine as follows: Mix warm boiled water, sugar, salt, and a little MSG. Stir until dissolved, then taste; it should be both salty and sweet. Mix the seasoning at a ratio of 3 tablespoons of grain salt and 1 tablespoon of sugar per 1 liter of water.

Step 2: Next, place the mustard greens into a jar, add the brine until the greens are submerged, and sprinkle the galangal, garlic, chili, and scallions on top. Then, use a plate to weigh down and press the greens so they sour faster.
Step 3: Finally, seal the jar and let it sit for about 2-3 days until the greens are sour and yellow, then they are ready to eat!
Notes on eating pickled greens to avoid poisoning:
Sweet and sour pickled mustard greens are a delicious traditional dish. However, to ensure health safety, please note a few points when eating them.
Choose fresh greens: Ensure you choose fresh mustard greens that are not wilted, rotten, or showing signs of damage.
Use safe fermentation methods: The fermentation process must be conducted cleanly and hygienically to avoid the growth of harmful bacteria.

Check the sourness and smell: Before eating, check the sourness and smell of the greens. If there is a foul or strange odor, or if it is excessively sour, avoid eating to ensure you do not get poisoned.
Store properly: Pickled greens should be stored in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Seal tightly and keep in the refrigerator if necessary.
Eat in moderation: Pickled greens should be eaten in moderate amounts; do not consume too much at once to avoid negative effects on digestion.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Flavorful and Delicious Lemongrass Chili Braised Chicken
cac_buoc: Lemongrass chili braised chicken is a popular dish in Vietnamese meals across all regions. However, the preparation method may vary slightly by area. This article will share several recipes for making attractive, delicious lemongrass chili chicken that suits many people's tastes.
I. Instructions for traditional lemongrass chili braised chicken
1. Prepare ingredients
Lemongrass: 4 stalks
Red chili: 4 fruits
Turmeric powder: 1/2 tbsp
Fish sauce: 1 tbsp
Grain salt: 1 tbsp
Common seasonings (salt, seasoning powder, MSG): a little
With these simple ingredients, you can prepare a delicious and flavorful lemongrass chili braised chicken dish.
2. Preparation steps
2.1. How to prepare ingredients
First, wash the lemongrass, remove the old outer layers, and mince finely. Chop the red chilies.

Wash the chicken and let it drain. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces, then marinate with the minced lemongrass, chili, 1/2 tbsp turmeric powder, 1 tbsp seasoning powder, 1 tsp salt, and 1/2 tsp MSG. Mix well and marinate for about 2 hours so the chicken absorbs the seasonings.
2.2. How to braise the chicken
After marinating, put the chicken in a pot, place on the stove, and stir-fry until the meat firms up. Add about 1/4 cup of water (rice cup), cover, and braise for 15 minutes over medium heat.
Finally, add 1 tbsp fish sauce and adjust the seasonings (salt, seasoning powder, MSG) to taste. The lemongrass chili braised chicken is now finished and ready to be served.
2.3. Finished product
The lemongrass chili braised chicken is complete, featuring a beautiful color, rich flavor, and spicy aroma. Serving it with hot rice is a wonderful combination.
When eating, you will feel the pungent heat of the chili and the characteristic fragrant aroma of the lemongrass. This is truly a top-tier delicious dish.
Good luck with preparing this lemongrass chili braised chicken and enjoy it with family and friends.
II. How to make irresistible Central Vietnam style lemongrass chili braised chicken
500g chicken
3 stalks lemongrass
2 horn chilies
Ginger, garlic, shallots
150ml fresh coconut milk
Cilantro
Fish sauce, seasoning powder, salt, a little pepper, and cooking oil.
2. Preparation steps
Step 1: Prepare the ingredients. Mince the garlic, shallots, and fresh ginger. Finely chop the chili and cut the lemongrass into sections then smash them.
Step 2: Marinate the chicken with seasonings. Use plastic wrap to cover the bowl of chicken and leave it in the refrigerator for about 30 minutes.
Step 3: Place a pot on the stove, sauté the minced garlic, shallots, lemongrass, and chili until fragrant. Then, add the chicken and stir-fry until firm. Season to taste.

Step 4: Once the chicken is firm, pour the coconut milk into the pot and simmer over low heat until the chicken is tender. When the coconut milk has thickened, scoop the chicken out, adjust the seasoning, and garnish with a little cilantro for aroma.
III. How to make Five-Spice lemongrass chili chicken
1. Ingredients to prepare
Chicken: 900g
Minced lemongrass: 50g
Fresh chili: 1 fruit
Shallots: 3 bulbs
Five-spice powder: 2 tsp
Chili powder: 1 tsp
Fish sauce: 2 tbsp
Cooking oil: 1 tbsp
White wine: a little
Common seasonings (salt, pepper, sugar, seasoning powder, MSG): a little
2.1. Prepare the ingredients
Chicken:
Step 1: Rub white wine over the chicken for 3-5 minutes to remove the gamey smell.
Step 2: Rinse the chicken with water several times and drain.
Step 3: Chop the chicken into small bite-sized pieces.
After completing these steps, the chicken is ready for the next stages of making the lemongrass chili braised chicken.
Shallots:
Peel and wash.
Mince or slice.
Chili:
Chop finely.
2.3. Marinate the chicken
In a large bowl, combine:
The prepared chicken
Minced shallots
25g minced lemongrass
2 tsp five-spice powder
1 tsp chili powder
1 tbsp fish sauce
1 tsp salt
1 tbsp sugar
A little ground pepper
1 tsp MSG
1 tsp seasoning powder
Mix the mixture well and marinate for about 20 minutes so the meat is evenly seasoned.
2.4. Cooking the Five-Spice chicken
Heat the oil until hot before cooking the chicken.
Add the remaining lemongrass and chopped chili, sauté until golden and fragrant.
Add the marinated chicken, stir well for about 10 minutes over high heat until the meat firms up.
Add boiling water until it almost covers the surface of the chicken, then braise over high heat for about 10 minutes.
Season the pan: 1 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tsp salt, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp MSG, 1 tsp seasoning powder. Mix the ingredients and seasonings well, then continue braising until the liquid reduces.
Taste and adjust seasonings to your liking, then turn off the stove.
2.5. Finished product
The lemongrass braised chicken has an eye-catching color and a fragrant aroma from the five-spice powder. The chicken is tender, sweet, and perfectly seasoned.
IV. How to choose fresh chicken
1. How to choose delicious fresh chicken
Step 1: Choose chicken parts like the breast or upper thigh. Choose meat that is pink, fresh, and has good elasticity when pressed lightly.
Step 2: Good chicken will have thin skin that looks fresh and smooth, possibly with a bit of white or slightly yellow fat.
Step 3: Do not buy chicken that shows signs of leaking fluid or has an unusual fishy or foul smell.
Selecting fresh, high-quality chicken is the first important step to having a delicious and safe five-spice lemongrass chicken dish.
2. How to clean chicken and remove odors
Soak the chicken in diluted salt water for about 10 minutes, then remove and rinse with clean water.
Use white wine and crushed ginger in a 1:1 ratio, then rub it all over the chicken surfaces and rinse thoroughly.

Mix a solution of vinegar and salt in a ratio of 2 parts salt to 1 part vinegar. Rub this solution all over the chicken surface, then scrub several times. Afterward, rinse the chicken very thoroughly with clean water.
Using white wine, ginger, vinegar, and salt to marinate the chicken aims to remove the fishy smell, clean the meat surface, and tenderize the meat, making the dish more appealing.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Irresistible Foil-Wrapped Roasted Chicken
mon_an.mo_ta: Foil-wrapped roasted chicken attracts diners from its appearance to its flavor. Each piece of chicken has an eye-catching golden-brown color, a pleasant aroma, and tender meat soaked in seasonings. Served with hot rice, it makes for an incredibly delicious meal. With just a little time in the kitchen, you can have this delicious dish ready. Discover how to make irresistible foil-wrapped roasted chicken with detailed instructions. The chicken is marinated with delicate spices, then roasted in foil to maintain its tenderness and enhance its special flavor. This dish is not only simple to prepare but also offers an exquisite and attractive taste.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: White wine, soy sauce, pepper, honey - wine marinade seasonings
cac_buoc: How to make attractive foil-wrapped roasted chicken
Step 1: Wash the fresh chicken with salt to remove dirt and odors. Then, rinse again with water and debone, keeping only the tender meat.

Step 2: Next, use a sharp toothpick or a clean fork to prick the chicken, creating small holes so that it roasts more evenly and absorbs the seasonings better. Then, marinate the chicken with soy sauce and salt for 15–20 minutes so the meat is flavorful and well-seasoned.

Step 3: Clean the leeks, removing the roots and wilted leaves, then wash with water. Next, spread out a sheet of foil and arrange the chicken evenly on top. Place a section of leek in the middle of the meat, then roll the foil up tightly and securely.
Step 4: Next, wrap the meat in foil, twisting the two ends tightly.
Step 5: Roasting the meat
Preheat the oven to 200°C, then roast the meat for 20 minutes or until cooked through. Remember to check the oven frequently to prevent the meat from burning!
Step 6: Prepare the dipping sauce

Take a small bowl and add the following seasonings: soy sauce, minced garlic, thinly sliced chili, and a bit of fresh honey for a light, sweet taste. Mix the mixture well so the ingredients blend together for a delicious dipping sauce.
Step 7: Once the meat is cooked, remove it to a tray to cool. Next, peel off the foil layer from each roll and use a clean cutting board to slice the meat into bite-sized pieces.
Finally, arrange the meat on a plate and enjoy.
Tips for making foil-wrapped roasted chicken like a pro
Choose free-range chicken with a firm body and small breast.
The chicken skin should be bright yellow and darker at the armpits and thighs.
Carefully check the chicken body for scratches or bruises.

For roosters: Choose those with bright red combs and alert, non-sluggish eyes. Feathers should be shiny and close to the body. The beak should be sharp with no discharge. Legs should be straight and slender; the skin on the legs should be evenly yellow and shiny. Spurs should be short, not too long.

For hens: Select those with bright red combs, yellow legs, smooth feathers, and small pores. Press lightly on the breast; it should feel full. When pressing the lower part of the breast, if the bone is soft, it is a young hen. Avoid choosing hens with hard, scaly legs, ruffled feathers, large pores, small necks, white or gray skin, many bumps, and a large anus, as these are signs of an old hen that has laid many eggs.
Paying attention to these details will help you choose fresh chicken for an attractive roasted chicken dish.
Some notes when making foil-wrapped roasted chicken
Choosing chicken: Select fresh free-range chicken with tender meat and no damage. The meat should be fresh pink and have no unpleasant odor.
Preparing seasonings: Use seasonings like garlic, chili, salt, pepper, sesame oil, and fish sauce to marinate the chicken. Ensure the seasonings penetrate the meat to create a characteristic flavor.
Foil: Use specialized aluminum foil to wrap the chicken. Foil helps retain moisture in the meat and enhances the flavor.

Roasting chicken: Roast the chicken over charcoal or in an oven at a moderate temperature. Turn and flip frequently so the meat cooks evenly and does not dry out. When roasting, ensure the foil is tightly sealed to retain moisture and flavor.
Checking for doneness: Use a sharp knife to pierce the chicken. If the juice running out is clear and not pink, the chicken is cooked.

Side dishes: Enjoy foil-wrapped roasted chicken with ginger fish sauce, pepper sauce, or sweet and sour fish sauce. You can also add fresh herbs, rice vermicelli, and seasonings to create diverse flavors.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Delicious Stuffed Roasted Chicken
mon_an.mo_ta: Stuffed roasted chicken is a quite delicious dish that attracts diners with its beautiful golden-brown skin, the aroma of honey-brushed chicken, tender fresh meat, and a nutritious, flavorful stuffing inside. Everything blends together to give you a wonderful sensation when eating. Let's get into the kitchen and learn how to make this delicious dish!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Parsley, sage - a little of each
Salt, pepper, seasoning powder, MSG - seasoning
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients for the stuffed roasted chicken.
Wash the chicken thoroughly with water and let it drain.
Cut the sandwich bread into small bite-sized squares.
Next, finely mince or grind the pork.
Wash the oyster mushrooms and button mushrooms and cut them in half.
Clean the celery, remove wilted or damaged leaves, wash with water, and chop finely.
Do the same with the onions.
Peel and crush the garlic.
Wash the parsley and sage, then chop finely.
Preheat the chicken broth in the microwave and set aside.
Step 2: The stages to make delicious stuffed roasted chicken
First, preheat the oven to 275°F or 135°C.
When the oven is hot, place the bread on a baking tray and bake for a few minutes or until the bread is completely dry and crunchy.
Next, place a pan on the stove and add a little cooking oil.
When the oil is hot, add the minced pork and stir-fry until just cooked through, then turn off the heat and pour the meat into a small bowl.

Then, place a pan on the stove and add about 1/3 of the prepared butter. Melt the butter and add the mushrooms, stir-frying evenly. When stir-frying, remember to stir constantly so the mushrooms don't burn and cook evenly!
When the mushrooms turn golden, add the remaining butter to the pan. At the same time, add the vegetables including celery, onions, sage, parsley, and a little salt and pepper.
Stir the vegetables thoroughly for about 5 minutes until they are just cooked through but still retain their crunch.
Next, add the bread to the vegetable pan and continue to stir well.
Then, add ¾ of the chicken broth to the vegetable and bread mixture; add it slowly and stir until the bread becomes moist and absorbs the liquid. Then, you can turn off the stove.
At this point, increase the oven temperature to about 325°F or 160°C.
Next, use a spoon or your hands to stuff the prepared filling into the turkey, occasionally pouring a little more chicken broth in as well.

After stuffing the chicken, brush a thin layer of honey over the turkey to increase the richness and create a beautiful color for the dish. Then, place the chicken in a roasting pan lined with foil and put it into the preheated oven. Roast the chicken for several hours or until completely cooked through.
When the turkey is cooked, turn off the oven but do not take the chicken out immediately; let it cool in the oven for about 20 minutes before removing.
Finally, take the chicken out and enjoy.
Notes for perfect stuffed roasted chicken
Adding chicken broth to the stuffing helps the chicken meat absorb more moisture, making it tender, not dry, and faster to cook.
Besides minced pork, you can use sausage or pork liver. When cooked, the filling will be very similar to pâté and taste delicious.
If you cannot buy turkey, you can use regular free-range chicken, but note that the roasting time for regular chicken is shorter than for turkey!
When gutting the chicken, whether it is live or bought from the market, remember not to cut it wide open but only make a small hole (mổ moi); this makes stuffing the chicken easier.
The roasting time for turkey depends on the size of the bird you choose.
To help the chicken cook more easily, you should use a knife to make a few small slashes in thick parts of the meat like the thighs or breast.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Delicious Black Pepper Roasted Chicken
mon_an.mo_ta: Black pepper roasted chicken attracts diners from its appearance with golden-brown pieces of chicken, tender meat, and rich seasonings, providing a wonderful sensation when enjoyed.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning - seasoning powder, salt, black pepper, cooking oil
cac_buoc: How to make delicious black pepper roasted chicken

Step 1: Wash the chicken drumsticks briefly, then rub with a bit of salt and vinegar, and rinse again thoroughly; pat dry. Washing the chicken with vinegar and salt helps remove the gamey smell and makes the meat more fragrant.
Peel, wash, and mince the shallots and garlic.

Step 2: Next, place the drumsticks in a bowl and season with a little salt, seasoning powder, black pepper, and the minced shallots and garlic. Wear gloves and massage the chicken so it absorbs the seasonings. Marinate for at least 30 minutes, or cover tightly and leave in the refrigerator overnight for better flavor.

Step 3: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Add 1 tablespoon of cooking oil to the bowl of meat and mix well; this prevents the meat from drying out while roasting. Arrange the drumsticks on a wire rack, with a baking tray underneath to catch the juices during roasting.

Step 4: Every 10 minutes, take the drumsticks out and flip them to roast the other side. Roast until the meat is cooked through and slightly charred. You can use a toothpick to pierce the middle of the drumstick to check for doneness; if you pull the toothpick out and no pink juice appears, the meat is cooked.
Once the drumsticks are cooked, remove them, arrange on a plate, and enjoy immediately while hot.
Notes for delicious black pepper roasted chicken
Depending on your home oven, adjust the roasting time accordingly.
Besides drumsticks, you can use a whole upper thigh or any part of the chicken you prefer.
How to choose good chicken: (for pre-processed chicken)
Free-range chicken is usually compact, firm, with a narrow breast.

Egg-laying hens look similar to free-range chicken, so you need to distinguish them clearly. Free-range chicken skin is pale yellow and only dark yellow in certain spots like the breast, wings, and back, while egg-laying hens are white or yellow all over (possibly due to toxic dyes).
Free-range chicken skin is thin and highly elastic. Choose meat that looks fresh, has no foul smell or antibiotic odor, and no bruises or blood clots on the skin.
Additionally, to avoid buying water-injected chicken, pay attention and press your finger on suspected areas (mainly thighs and breast); if it feels mushy, slippery, or deformed, avoid it.
And who knows, someone might ask you for the secret to making this wonderful chicken dish!

mon_an.ten: How to Make Delicious Stir-Fried Chicken with Mushrooms
mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried chicken with mushrooms attracts diners from its appearance to its content. The chicken is fragrant and golden-brown, blending with the dark brown of the mushrooms, the green and red of the bell peppers, bright green asparagus stalks, yellow ginger, and purple shallots. When enjoying the dish, you will find the chicken tender and juicy, the mushrooms chewy, and the accompanying vegetables keep the dish from being heavy. With just a little time in the kitchen and easy-to-find ingredients, you can have a delicious, attractive dish that no one can refuse.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 20ml soy sauce; 15ml cooking wine; pepper - meat marinade
cac_buoc: How to make simple yet delicious stir-fried chicken with mushrooms
Step 1:

Wash the chicken with water to remove dirt and reduce the gamey smell. After washing, drain and dice into small bite-sized pieces. Then, place the chicken in a large bowl and marinate with a little cooking wine and pepper until seasoned. Marinate for 30 minutes so the meat is evenly flavored!
Step 2: Prepare the aromatics:
Wash the mushrooms and dice into bite-sized pieces.
Wash the bell pepper, cut lengthwise, remove seeds, and dice.
Wash the asparagus, drain, and chop finely.
Peel the garlic and ginger, wash, and crush finely.
Step 3:
Place a pan on the stove and add a little cooking oil. When the oil is hot, add the garlic and sauté until golden and fragrant. Next, add the asparagus and stir-fry quickly until cooked.
Step 4:
When the above mixture is cooked, add the chicken and stir-fry until tender. Remember to taste before adding more seasonings, as undercooked chicken will be chewy.
Step 5:

Then, add seasonings to taste: add the diced bell pepper, 2 tablespoons of oyster sauce, and 1/2 teaspoon of salt, and stir-fry evenly. Cook over medium heat so the chicken cooks through without burning; when finished, the chicken should be fresh and not mushy.
Finally, turn off the stove and arrange the stir-fried chicken and mushrooms on a plate. Sprinkle with a little pepper for aroma and garnish with a few sprigs of cilantro.
Notes for delicious stir-fried chicken with mushrooms
Remember to marinate the chicken for a while so it absorbs the seasonings, making it tastier when enjoyed.
For a delicious dish, you can choose chicken breast or thigh meat and debone it. You can also use any part of the chicken you like.
Besides the vegetables mentioned above, you can add or substitute any vegetables you prefer, as long as the dish includes mushrooms.
When eating, remember to add a little pepper to make the dish fragrant and attractive.

Stir-fried chicken with mushrooms attracts diners from its appearance to its content. The chicken is fragrant and golden-brown, blending with the dark brown of the mushrooms, the green and red of the bell peppers, bright green asparagus stalks, yellow ginger, and purple shallots. When enjoying the dish, you will find the chicken tender and juicy, the mushrooms chewy, and the accompanying vegetables keep the dish from being heavy. With just a little time in the kitchen and easy-to-find ingredients, you can have a delicious, attractive dish that no one can refuse.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Delicious Stir-Fried Pork Tongue with Galangal and Lemongrass
mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried pork tongue with galangal and lemongrass is a familiar dish for many families, featuring crunchy, delicious pork tongue soaked in seasonings along with the fragrant aroma of sautéed galangal and lemongrass that will stimulate your taste buds. With just a little time in the kitchen, you can have a wonderful dish to treat your family, friends, and loved ones.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning - Cooking oil, seasoning powder, oyster sauce, MSG, salt
cac_buoc: Prepare ingredients for stir-fried pork tongue with galangal and lemongrass:
Wash the pork tongue with lime or kumquat and salt to remove the gamey smell, then rinse again with clean water.
Peel the galangal, wash, and shred into strips.
Remove the old outer layers and roots of the lemongrass, wash, and slice thinly.
Wash the lime leaves and chop finely.
Steps to perform stir-fried pork tongue with galangal and lemongrass:
Step 1:

First, blanch the pork tongue in boiling water to clean it. After blanching, use a knife to thoroughly scrape off the white film on the tongue, as this film contains a lot of odor; if left, the tongue will smell after cooking. Scrape the throat area and both sides of the tongue, then rinse under running water and drain. Next, use half a lime to squeeze the juice and rub with grain salt thoroughly to remove the odor and whiten the tongue. Scrub well and rinse 1-2 times under running water, then drain to prepare for cooking.
After that, slice the pork tongue into thin bite-sized pieces.
Step 2:
Next, marinate the pork tongue with 1 teaspoon of turmeric powder, 1 teaspoon of seasoning powder, 1 tablespoon of oyster sauce, and some minced shallots. Stir well so the tongue is evenly seasoned.
Then, cover and place in the refrigerator for about 30 minutes to let the tongue absorb the seasonings.
Step 3:
Next, sauté the shallots with a little cooking oil until fragrant, add the lemongrass to stir-fry, and then add the galangal to stir-fry together.
Then, season with ½ teaspoon of salt and 1 tablespoon of turmeric powder, then add the pork tongue to stir-fry. Stir-fry over high heat so the tongue does not become chewy.
Adjust the seasonings to your taste.
Finally, add the MSG and chopped lime leaves, stir well, and turn off the stove. Arrange the stir-fried pork tongue on a plate and enjoy while hot.
Notes for delicious stir-fried pork tongue with galangal and lemongrass
When cleaning the pork tongue, besides the methods mentioned, you can use vinegar to ensure the tongue is not smelly.
How to choose good pork tongue: When buying, choose a fresh one with a thick, round tongue, bright color, and the part near the throat should be evenly white without blood clots.
Besides stir-frying, you can also boil the pork tongue and serve with salt and pepper, or make sweet and sour stir-fry, lemongrass chili stir-fry, grilled tongue, or spicy and sour tongue salad...
