Stir-fried pork tongue with galangal and lemongrass is a familiar dish for many families, featuring crunchy, delicious pork tongue soaked in seasonings along with the fragrant aroma of sautéed galangal and lemongrass that will stimulate your taste buds. With just a little time in the kitchen, you can have a wonderful dish to treat your family, friends, and loved ones. You will receive compliments from everyone for this creative dish and its novel flavor.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Simple and Delicious Rice Paper Rolls with Vermicelli
mon_an.mo_ta: Bún cuốn bánh tráng – a traditional Vietnamese dish characterized by a thin, smooth layer of rice paper, with fresh vermicelli and meat or shrimp filling inside. When combined with sweet and sour fish sauce, fried garlic, and fresh herbs, this dish offers a unique and interesting flavor. Follow the article below to master the simple recipe for rice paper rolls with vermicelli! These rolls are attractive with thin rice paper, fresh meat, herbs, and delicious dipping fish sauce. Enjoy the unique and light flavor of these rolls now!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning: Salt, seasoning powder, fish sauce, sugar, pepper
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare ingredients
1. To prepare, first wash the pork ear or pork belly and boil until cooked. Then, remove and let cool or soak in ice water to make it crunchier.
2. Next, whisk the eggs with a little salt. You can use an eggbeater to make the eggs fluffier. Then, fry the eggs as thinly as possible so that the rolls will be tastier and more beautiful.
3. For the pork sausage, steam or boil it briefly and then slice into thin strips matching the size of the fried egg strips.
4. Peel the carrots and cucumbers, soak in salt water, then slice into strips and drain.
5. Wash the accompanying herbs and let them drain.
6. Finally, wash the garlic and chili, then mince finely or use a blender to grind them.
Step 2: Prepare the dipping sauce
The dipping fish sauce plays an important role in the success of the rolls, so you cannot skip this stage. The way to prepare the sauce may vary according to regional tastes.
You can follow a popular formula with the following ratio:
1 part sugar + 0.5 part vinegar + 1.5 parts fish sauce + 4 parts warm boiled water

After combining the ingredients until well blended, continue to sprinkle the minced garlic and chili into the mixture. For convenience and hygiene, you should mix the sauce in a large bowl, then transfer to individual small bowls for each person.
Step 3: Rolling

This step determines the final appearance of the dish. First, spread the rice paper on a clean plate. Next, layer lettuce, cilantro, vermicelli, pork ear, sausage, egg, cucumber, carrot... and roll tightly. Ensure the rolls look neat and attractive.
Some notes when making rice paper rolls with vermicelli:
When making simple rice paper rolls, there are some important notes to ensure success:
Choose fresh rice paper: Choose thin, smooth, and fresh rice paper to ensure the rolls are soft and do not tear when rolling.
Prepare ingredients: Prepare ingredients like fresh vermicelli, herbs (such as fish mint, mint), and prepared chicken or shrimp. Ensure all ingredients are washed and ready before you start rolling.

Storage and enjoyment: The rolls should be eaten immediately after rolling to prevent the rice paper from drying out and getting cold. If storage is needed, place the rolls in an airtight container and keep in the refrigerator. When eating, enjoy the rolls with dipping fish sauce and fresh herbs.

mon_an.mo_ta: Salt-steamed chicken is a simple yet flavorful and aromatic dish. With this guide, you can enjoy a delicious and nutritious meal at home. This rock salt-steamed chicken is perfect when served with white rice and fresh raw vegetables. Let's start cooking and enjoy the wonderful taste of this chicken recipe! This guide shows you how to make salt-crusted steamed chicken that retains its natural sweetness at home. A simple yet deeply flavorful and fragrant dish.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Rock salt - half a rice bowl
Salt, pepper, lime, seasoning powder - as needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare ingredients
1.1. Prepare the chicken
To save time, you can buy pre-processed chicken. After purchasing, rub the chicken with rock salt to remove odors and slime, then rinse thoroughly and drain.
Tips for quick and odorless chicken preparation:
Method 1: Mix salt and vinegar, rub the mixture evenly over the chicken, let it soak for 3 to 5 minutes, then rinse and drain.
Method 2: If vinegar is unavailable, use lime juice mixed with salt and follow the same steps as above.
Method 3: A simple and effective way is to cut off the oil gland (tail) of the chicken, use tweezers to pluck any remaining feathers, rinse well, and drain.
1.2. Prepare other ingredients
Start by cutting off the base of the lemongrass, rinse, and drain. Smash two stalks and cut them into finger-length segments. Mince the remaining two stalks and place them on a plate.

Peel and rinse the shallots; mince two bulbs and thinly slice the other two. Peel the ginger, rinse, and julienne. Remove the stems from the chilies and rinse; mince one chili (like the lemongrass) and slice the other.
Rinse the lime leaves, drain, and julienne. Zest the lime and squeeze for juice; rinse the zest and cut into thin strips.
Pick the young leaves of the Vietnamese coriander, discard damaged or yellow leaves, rinse, and drain in a basket.
Step 2: Make the marinade

Mix the marinade according to this formula: 1/2 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp ground pepper, 1/2 tbsp seasoning powder, 1/2 tbsp fish sauce, along with the minced shallots, lemongrass, and chili. Mix well until the spices are combined.
Next, use a knife to score a few lines on the chicken, especially on thick parts like the breast and thighs, to help the spices penetrate better.
Finally, rub the spice mixture over the chicken surface and marinate for about 30 minutes.
Step 3: Steam the chicken with salt
First, spread a layer of rock salt at the bottom of the pot, then arrange the lemongrass segments on top of the salt layer.
Next, place the marinated chicken into the pot, scatter Vietnamese coriander around it, and place the sliced shallots, sliced chilies, ginger, and lime zest on top of the chicken.
Place the pot on the stove, cover with a lid, and steam for about 30 minutes over medium heat.
While the chicken is steaming, prepare the dipping sauce. In a mortar, mix: 1/2 tbsp rock salt, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp ground pepper, 1/2 tsp MSG, and minced chili.
Use a pestle to grind the spices together, then add lime juice and stir until the spices are completely dissolved.
Step 4: Finished product
Once the chicken is cooked, remove it to a plate and sprinkle julienned lime leaves on top for a beautiful presentation before serving.

The salt-crusted steamed chicken not only has an attractive color but also a wonderful aroma. The meat is tender and sweet, with a light scent of lemongrass and the tanginess of lime juice. When paired with a bit of dipping sauce or green chili salt, the dish becomes better than ever.

mon_an.mo_ta: Vịt nấu chao is a favorite dish for many families, featuring tender, fresh duck meat infused with spices and soft, fluffy taro in a sweet broth. Enjoying Vịt nấu chao with some rice vermicelli and fresh raw vegetables is an excellent choice for you!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning - salt, fish sauce, seasoning powder, shallots, garlic, pepper
cac_buoc: Prepare ingredients:
Peel the ginger, rinse, and mince or crush it.

Rinse the duck with salt, then rinse again with water. Chop the duck into bite-sized pieces. To remove the gamey odor, marinate the chopped duck with crushed ginger and rice wine for about 20 minutes.
Peel the taro, rinse, and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Pick the lettuce, remove the roots and damaged leaves, wash with salt water, and drain.
Peel the shallots and garlic, rinse, and mince.
Steps to make Vịt nấu chao
Step 1:

After 20 minutes of deodorizing the duck, place the pieces in a large bowl. Add minced shallots and garlic, 2 cubes of red fermented bean curd, 2 cubes of white fermented bean curd, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp sugar, 1/2 tsp seasoning powder, and pepper. Mix well and marinate for about 2 hours so the meat absorbs the flavors.
Step 2:
Heat a little oil in a pan, sauté the garlic until fragrant, then add the marinated meat mixture. Start with high heat; once it boils, reduce to low heat and simmer for about 20 minutes.
After 20 minutes, add fresh coconut water until it just covers the meat. Simmer on low heat, season to taste, and continue cooking.
Step 3:
Add the taro to the pot. Simmer until the taro is soft, then taste and adjust the seasoning for a balanced flavor. Turn off the heat and sprinkle green onions on top.
Step 4: Prepare the dipping sauce:
Mix 2 cubes of white fermented bean curd with 1 tsp sugar and a few drops of lime juice. Mash the bean curd until smooth and place in a separate bowl.
Finally, serve the Vịt nấu chao in a bowl and enjoy.
Tips for a delicious Vịt nấu chao
Vịt nấu chao can be served with rice vermicelli, instant noodles, or white rice.
When eating with rice vermicelli, you should briefly blanch the noodles in hot water to ensure food safety.
How to choose good duck:

When buying, choose mature and fat ducks with a round breast, thick neck and belly skin, and full feathers (the tips of the two wings should just cross each other). These ducks are easier and faster to pluck.
Avoid young ducks as the meat will be mushy and not firm, and it takes a lot of time to remove the downy feathers. Young ducks have large, soft beaks. Old ducks have small, hard beaks.
Ducks that have laid many eggs also have very fragrant meat; their lower belly will sag. Unlike chicken, for duck, it is better to choose a male as the meat is tastier than the female.
To check if a duck is healthy, check the vent; if it is clean and not stuck with runny droppings, the duck is not sick.
In general, choosing a duck is not too difficult; pick one that is just mature—not too young or too old—for the best flavor and easy preparation.

mon_an.ten: Duck Stew with Dracontomelon and Taro
mon_an.mo_ta: Duck stew with dracontomelon is a familiar dish to many. This delicious dish attracts diners with tender, fresh duck meat infused with flavors, blended in a sweet and sour, aromatic broth. It is wonderful when served hot with rice vermicelli. Don't hesitate to get into the kitchen and learn how to make this delicious dish! This guide for Northern-style duck stew with dracontomelon and taro is a great way to enjoy this traditional meal. The result is a fragrant dish with a balanced sweet and sour taste and rich flavors.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Ingredients - Ginger, garlic, shallots, lemongrass, galangal, lime, culantro
Seasoning - salt, sugar, fish sauce, chili
cac_buoc: Prepare ingredients for duck stew with dracontomelon:
First, rinse the duck with clean water.
Crush the ginger and mix with salt, rub it all over the duck to clean, then rinse with cold water. Rub with lime to completely remove the gamey odor, then rinse thoroughly with water.
Once the duck is clean and drained, chop it into matchbox-sized pieces or bite-sized pieces so they are just right when the meat shrinks during stewing.
Peel the shallots, garlic, and lemongrass; rinse, smash, and thinly slice.
Wash the taro, boil for about 5 minutes, then rinse with cold water, peel, and set aside in a clean bowl.
Scrape the skin off the dracontomelon and soak them in a bowl of cold water. Then, lightly smash them.
Stages to make delicious duck stew with dracontomelon

First, marinate the duck with 1 tsp seasoning powder, ½ tsp pepper, and half of the minced shallots, garlic, and lemongrass for 30 minutes. If you don't like seasoning powder, you can use MSG or salt for a rich flavor.
Next, heat a pan and add 3 tbsp cooking oil. When the oil is hot, sauté the remaining shallots, garlic, and lemongrass until fragrant, then add the duck meat and stir-fry until the meat is firm.
Add the lightly smashed dracontomelon and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, then add enough water to cover the meat.
Stew the duck over low heat until the meat is slightly tender, then add the taro and continue stewing until the taro is soft (about 30 minutes).
Before turning off the heat, add some culantro and green onions to enhance the flavor.
Tips for a delicious duck stew with dracontomelon
You can replace the water with coconut water to make the dish more fragrant, rich, and delicious.
When stewing the taro, avoid stirring too much to prevent the taro from breaking apart.
When mashing the dracontomelon, do it one by one and taste; stop when the sourness is just right. Adjust seasonings, sprinkle with culantro, rice paddy herb, and chili, then serve in a bowl.
To enhance the color, you can add tomatoes; they provide color and increase the acidity. If using tomatoes, sauté them until soft after the aromatics are fragrant, then add the duck.
How to choose good duck:
Choose mature and fat ducks with a round breast, thick neck and belly skin, and full feathers. These are easier to pluck.
Avoid young ducks as the meat is mushy and plucking downy feathers is time-consuming. Young ducks have large, soft beaks; old ducks have small, hard beaks.
Ducks that have laid many eggs have fragrant meat and a sagging lower belly. For duck, males are generally tastier than females.
Check the vent to ensure it is clean and free of droppings to ensure the duck is healthy.
Choose a duck that is just mature for the best taste and convenient preparation.
Notes for authentic Northern-style duck stew with dracontomelon and taro
Select fresh ingredients: Choose fresh duck and fresh green dracontomelon for the best flavor.
Prepare the duck: Wash the duck thoroughly and marinate it well to absorb the spices.
Process the dracontomelon: Scrape the skin and wash well. Ensure they are sour and crunchy for the characteristic flavor.
Cook evenly: Simmer over low heat so the duck and dracontomelon soften evenly. Check that the duck is fully cooked before turning off the heat.
Add appropriate seasonings: Use the right amount of salt, sugar, fish sauce, and other spices for a balanced taste.
Garnish and serve: Serve in a bowl garnished with culantro and rice paddy herb for color and freshness. Enjoy hot to feel the rich, sweet, and sour flavors.

mon_an.mo_ta: Thai-style steamed squid might not be a familiar dish for many families, but from the first bite, you will surely praise its deliciousness. The dish features attractive colors, a pleasant aroma, moderate spiciness, and crunchy, fresh squid infused with spices. Just spend a little time in the kitchen and you'll have a wonderful dish to treat your family and friends!
cac_buoc: Prepare ingredients for Thai-style steamed squid
Clean the fresh squid, remove the skin and innards. Place the squid in a bowl, pour in rice wine, and rub gently to remove the fishy odor. Cut the squid into rings about 1cm thick.
Peel the garlic and onion, remove the roots, wash, and mince.
Wash and finely slice the chilies.
Clean the celery, remove the roots and wilted leaves, wash, discard the leaves, and cut the stalks into finger-length pieces.
Steps to make Thai-style steamed squid:
Step 1: Place the sliced onion, chilies, celery, and minced garlic in a bowl. Add the Thai chili paste and salt, then mix well so the ingredients absorb the spices.
Step 2: Put on gloves, pour the mixture over the squid, and rub thoroughly to marinate.
Step 3: Cover the bowl tightly and place it in the refrigerator for 30 minutes to marinate. Occasionally take it out, stir, and return to the fridge.
Step 4: After 30 minutes, take the squid out. Prepare a microwave-safe steaming container and line it with a few lettuce leaves. Pour the marinated squid mixture into the container.
Step 5: Cover the lid and place in the microwave at 700W for 2 minutes or until the squid is cooked.
Finally, take the squid out, arrange on a plate, and enjoy with sweet and sour dipping sauce, chili sauce, or any sauce you like!
Tips for perfect Thai-style steamed squid
If you cannot find Thai chili paste, you can use regular chili sauce, though Thai paste provides the authentic flavor.
If you prefer raw lettuce, you don't need to line the container with it before microwaving.
Squid cooks very quickly, so do not overcook it; 2 minutes is enough!
How to choose fresh squid:

There are two main types: cuttlefish and squid. Cuttlefish are large and flat, almost oval. Choose large ones with thick, firm, milky-white flesh and an even brown membrane outside. Squid are cylindrical, longer, and thinner. Choose squid with bright, slightly pinkish flesh, heads firmly attached to the body, and intact ink sacs. Generally, less fresh squid will turn slightly greenish-ivory, have mushy flesh, loose heads, and a very fishy smell.

Thai-style steamed squid might not be a familiar dish for many families, but from the first bite, you will surely praise its deliciousness. The dish features attractive colors, a pleasant aroma, moderate spiciness, and crunchy, fresh squid infused with spices. Just spend a little time in the kitchen and you'll have a wonderful dish to treat your family and friends!

mon_an.ten: Grilled Squid with Spicy and Sour Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: Grilled squid with spicy and sour sauce attracts diners with both its appearance and flavor. Fresh, delicious squid with eye-catching colors and a crunchy texture is deeply infused with flavor. Spend some time in the kitchen to make this delicious dish for your family!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fish sauce, salt, sugar, vinegar - seasonings
Chili, garlic, green onions, lettuce - ingredients
BBQ marinade sauce, oyster sauce, cooking oil - seasonings
cac_buoc: How to make grilled squid with spicy and sour sauce (serves 3-4)
Step 1: Prepare ingredients

Rinse the fresh squid under running water. Remove the head, innards, and backbone, then score the surface for a beautiful look. Prepare a large bowl, rub the squid with salt and vinegar to remove the fishy odor. Rinse again with water and drain.
Peel the carrot, wash, and dice.
Wash the tomatoes and cut into wedges.
Wash the green onions and lettuce for serving and garnish. You can soak them in diluted salt water for 5 minutes.
Peel the garlic, wash, and mince.
Step 2: Process the grilled squid with spicy and sour sauce
First, preheat the oven to 190 °C. Grill the squid for 10 minutes.
Next, mix the sauce: cooking oil, chili powder, 1 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp oyster sauce, minced garlic, 1 tbsp sugar, salt, and vinegar. Stir in 100ml of filtered water. Mix well until combined.
Heat oil in a pan and pour in the mixture. Add the tomatoes and simmer until they soften into a thick sauce.
Once the sauce is ready, add the grilled squid to the pan and toss in the hot sauce.
Cook until the squid is fully coated, then remove to a plate and pour the remaining sauce over the top.
Tips for delicious grilled squid with spicy and sour sauce
When preparing, remember to clean the squid thoroughly to remove the fishy smell, making the dish tastier.
When grilling, watch carefully to prevent burning and flip the squid to ensure it cooks evenly on both sides.
Serve with lettuce and cilantro to enhance the flavor and reduce the richness.
How to choose good squid:
There are many types like cuttlefish, squid, or bobtail squid, but you must choose carefully to avoid stale ones.
For cuttlefish: Choose large, thick ones that are milky white with firm flesh and a hard tentacle part.
For squid: Choose those with bright, slightly pinkish flesh, heads firmly attached, hard tentacles, and intact ink sacs.
Avoid squid that has turned greenish-ivory, has mushy flesh, or a very fishy smell, as these are no longer fresh.

Grilled squid with spicy and sour sauce attracts diners with both its appearance and flavor. Fresh, delicious squid with eye-catching colors and a crunchy texture is deeply infused with flavor. Spend some time in the kitchen to make this delicious dish for your family!

mon_an.ten: Stir-fried Squid with Spicy and Sour Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried squid with spicy and sour sauce features beautiful colors, a thick golden-brown sauce, and crunchy squid that is not too tough. The dish is infused with a rich spicy, sour, and sweet flavor, served with vegetables for a delightful meal.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Green and red chilies - 10 of each
cac_buoc: How to make stir-fried squid with spicy and sour sauce for 3-4 people
Step 1: Prepare ingredients.
First, rinse the squid with water, then rinse with rice wine to reduce the fishy odor, and finally rinse again with clean water.
Bring a pot of water to a boil, blanch the squid briefly, then immediately submerge it in a bowl of ice water for 10-15 minutes before draining. Once drained, cut the squid into bite-sized rings.
Peel the onion, wash, and chop.
Clean the green onions, remove roots and wilted leaves, and cut into long segments.
Remove the stems from the chilies; leave small ones whole and cut long ones in half.
Peel the garlic and leave the cloves whole.
Peel the ginger, wash, and smash.
Step 2: Cooking steps
Heat a pan with a little cooking oil.
Sauté the garlic, ginger, green and red chilies, and onion until fragrant.
Once aromatic, add the squid and stir well. Add vinegar, sugar, a pinch of salt, and 2-3 tbsp of oyster sauce. Stir-fry constantly for about 2-3 minutes, then turn off the heat.
Add the green onions, toss briefly, then remove to a plate and serve.
Tips for stir-fried squid with spicy and sour sauce
Serve the stir-fry immediately with hot rice; if it cools down, the squid may develop a fishy smell.
This dish is quite spicy due to the amount of chilies. If you cannot handle the heat, reduce the number of chilies or substitute with bell peppers and only use a few hot chilies.
Only cook the squid for about 2 minutes; overcooking will make it very tough and difficult to chew. Since the squid was already blanched, you don't need to worry about it being undercooked.

The blanching and ice-water soaking step helps the squid achieve a certain crunchiness and chewiness that is very delicious. Alternatively, you can blanch the whole squid and turn off the heat immediately to keep it crunchy for a faster stir-fry.
Cleaning squid can be complicated, so you can ask the seller to do it. At home, rub it with a bit of vinegar or rice wine to further deodorize.
When buying squid, choose those with bright, slightly pinkish flesh and heads firmly attached. Firm tentacles are a sign of freshness.

Stir-fried squid with spicy and sour sauce features beautiful colors, a thick golden-brown sauce, and crunchy squid that is not too tough. The dish is infused with a rich spicy, sour, and sweet flavor, served with vegetables for a delightful meal.

mon_an.mo_ta: Crispy seafood spring rolls are a family favorite due to their delicious taste. When eating, you will experience a crunchy crust and a fresh, well-seasoned seafood filling. Enjoying these with sweet and sour dipping sauce or chili sauce will make for a wonderful meal!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Rinse the squid with rice wine to reduce the fishy odor, then rinse with water and drain. Finely mince the squid or use a food processor to grind it.
Step 2:
Rinse the shrimp with rice wine, then rinse with water. Boil the shrimp until just cooked, then peel and remove the heads.
Step 3:
Peel the onion, wash, and slice thinly.
Peel the carrot, wash, and shred into thin strips.
Clean the green onions, remove roots and wilted leaves, wash, and mince.
Step 4:
In a large clean bowl, combine the squid, onion, carrot, seasonings, and egg. Mix well until the ingredients are fully combined and seasoned.
Step 5:
Lay a rice paper wrapper on a flat surface. Spoon some filling onto the wrapper, place a shrimp on top, and gently roll it up. Repeat until all ingredients are used.
Step 6:
Once wrapped, place the spring rolls in a container and refrigerate for about 2 hours before frying.
Step 7:
Heat a generous amount of oil in a pan. While waiting for the oil to get hot, prepare the crispy frying flour in one bowl and the breadcrumbs in another.
Step 8:
Roll each spring roll in the crispy frying flour, then the breadcrumbs, and place into the hot oil. Fry until golden brown. Use medium heat and flip them to ensure they cook evenly without burning.
Step 9:
Once the spring rolls are cooked and crispy, remove them to a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil. Serve on a plate with chili sauce or sweet and sour dipping sauce.
Tips for delicious crispy seafood spring rolls:
Besides fresh shrimp, you can use frozen shrimp if you are short on time. However, fresh shrimp provides a better texture and natural sweetness.
How to choose good squid:
There are many types like cuttlefish or squid; choose carefully to avoid stale ones.
For cuttlefish: Choose large, thick ones that are milky white with firm flesh and hard tentacles.
For squid: Choose those with bright, slightly pinkish flesh, heads firmly attached, and intact ink sacs.
Avoid squid that has turned greenish-ivory, has mushy flesh, or a very fishy smell.

Crispy seafood spring rolls are a family favorite due to their delicious taste. When eating, you will experience a crunchy crust and a fresh, well-seasoned seafood filling. Enjoying these with sweet and sour dipping sauce or chili sauce will make for a wonderful meal!

mon_an.mo_ta: Nem rán is a favorite dish for many families, especially during family gatherings, holidays, and full moon days. Nem rán attracts diners with both its appearance and flavor. The crispy, golden-yellow crust and the fragrant, rich filling make it irresistible. This delicious dish will complete your warm and tasty family meal. Let's learn how to make it in the article below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fish sauce, pepper, MSG, cooking oil, salt - seasonings
Wood ear mushrooms, shiitake mushrooms - 100 g
Lettuce, cilantro, and other herbs - for serving
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare ingredients.
Peel the carrot, wash, and cut into matchsticks or shred.
Peel the onion, wash, and mince.
Soak the bean sprouts to remove hulls, rinse, and drain.
Soak the glass noodles in water until soft, drain, and cut into 2-3 cm segments.
Soak the wood ear and shiitake mushrooms in hot water until soft and expanded, rinse, and cut into matchsticks.
Clean the green onions, remove roots and wilted leaves, wash, and mince.
Rinse the pork and mince it. You can also buy pre-ground meat from the market or supermarket.
Step 2: Mix the filling.
Prepare a large pot or bowl for all the ingredients.
Add all the prepared ingredients and crack 3-4 eggs into the bowl. Add a bit of salt, MSG, and pepper, then mix everything until well combined.
Step 3: Wrap the spring rolls.
Once the filling is ready, start wrapping.
Use rice paper wrappers (available at markets or supermarkets). Choose round, slightly moist, and soft wrappers so they don't break. This ensures the rolls are crispy. Roll from the top down.

Place a tablespoon of filling on the wrapper. Roll it up like a scroll. When you reach the halfway point, fold in the two sides and continue rolling to the end. Roll firmly but not too tightly, as over-tightening can cause the rolls to burst or become dry when frying.
Step 4: Fry the spring rolls.
Heat oil in a pan and add the spring rolls when the oil is hot.
Note: Fry over low heat so they don't burn, and flip them to ensure they are evenly cooked and golden. Use enough oil to prevent them from sticking to the pan.
When the spring rolls are golden brown and crispy, remove them to a paper towel-lined plate to absorb excess grease. Once drained, arrange them on a plate and garnish beautifully.
Step 6: Prepare the dipping sauce
Peel the garlic, wash, and mince very finely.
Wash the chilies, remove seeds, and mince very finely.
You can also thinly slice some chili for the sauce.

Mix the dipping sauce according to the ratio 1:1:1:5 (1 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tbsp vinegar, 5 tbsp filtered water). Dissolve the fish sauce, sugar, and vinegar first, then add the garlic, chili, and a sprinkle of pepper. The sauce should have a balance of sweet, sour, and salty flavors.
Finally, enjoy the Nem rán with the sweet and sour dipping sauce!

mon_an.ten: Kohlrabi and Carrot Salad with Pig's Ear
mon_an.mo_ta: This crunchy kohlrabi and carrot salad features well-marinated pig's ear, nutty roasted peanuts, and a sweet and sour fish sauce that creates a delightful sensation. With its fresh flavor and unique combination, this dish is a perfect choice for hot summer days. First, prepare fresh kohlrabi and pig's ear. Shred the kohlrabi and pig's ear into thin strips. Then, mix with shallots, chili, fish sauce, sugar, and lime to create a unique flavor. This crunchy kohlrabi and carrot salad with pig's ear will make your meal more delicious and attractive. The content below will guide you through the process. This sweet and sour salad is perfect for summer. Follow the instructions for this crunchy salad now!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning - sugar, fish sauce, salt, vinegar
cac_buoc: 1. Prepare ingredients for the salad:
Prepare the kohlrabi and carrot by washing, peeling, and shredding them into strips. To save time, you can use a julienne peeler. Mix in 1 tsp of salt and let it sit for 30-45 minutes.
Next, peel the roasted peanuts. Wash the cilantro and spearmint, then drain. Wash the chilies, remove seeds, and slice thinly.
Use a thin cloth or cheesecloth, place the soaked carrots and kohlrabi inside, and squeeze gently to remove excess water.
2. Make the dressing

The dressing is crucial for a delicious salad. In a bowl, combine 1 tbsp filtered water, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp lime juice, and ½ tsp vinegar. Once mixed, add the sliced chili and minced garlic, then stir well to blend the flavors.
3. Mix the salad
Pour a portion of the dressing over the squeezed kohlrabi and carrots, then toss well so the salad absorbs the flavors.
Add ½ of the roasted peanuts, ½ of the cilantro, and ½ of the chopped spearmint, then continue to toss. Let the salad marinate for about 10 minutes.
Then, arrange the salad on a plate and sprinkle the remaining peanuts, cilantro, and spearmint on top. Finally, enjoy your delicious salad.
How to boil pig's ear perfectly:
1. After buying the pig's ear, use a knife to scrape off all hair and dirt inside the ear canal. Rub with lime or vinegar, then soak in a bowl of cold water to prevent darkening and remove odors.
2. Place the pig's ear in a pot of cold water with a squeeze of lime juice and boil until just cooked.
3. After boiling, remove the ear and place it in the refrigerator for 30 minutes to 1 hour before slicing. Use a very sharp, thin knife to slice it into thin, crunchy pieces for the best texture.
4. If you don't use the fridge, you can immediately drop the boiled ear into a bowl of ice water until completely cooled. This keeps the ear white and crunchy.
Notes for making kohlrabi and pig's ear salad
Choose fresh kohlrabi: Pick kohlrabi with smooth skin, no bruises, no soft spots, and no unpleasant smell. It should be large, ripe, and crunchy.
Wash thoroughly: Before use, wash the kohlrabi with cold water to remove dirt and impurities.
Shred thinly: Use a sharp knife or peeler to shred the kohlrabi into thin, even strips. This makes the salad crunchier and easier to eat.
Squeeze dry: After soaking in salt water, squeeze out the water to remove excess moisture. This prevents the salad from becoming watery and keeps the kohlrabi crunchy.
Use fresh dressing: Select fresh ingredients for the dressing. Adjust the ratio of water, sugar, lime juice, vinegar, chili, and garlic to suit your taste.
Enjoy immediately: The salad is best when eaten right after mixing. This preserves the crunchiness of the kohlrabi and the fresh flavors.

mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried macaroni with pork – with the aroma of seasoned pork and the golden hue of the macaroni, creates an incredibly attractive dish. Refer to the instructions below to make this dish. Enjoy a simple, delicious, and rich meal with crunchy macaroni and sweet, savory pork. A special recipe to change up your daily menu.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare ingredients
After buying the pork, rub it with a little salt for 2-3 minutes, then rinse under running water.
Next, blanch the meat in boiling water for about 5 minutes, then drain. Once drained, use a knife to cut the meat into thin, bite-sized pieces.
For the onion, peel, wash, and cut into wedges.
Clean the green onions, remove roots, wash, and mince.
Peel and mince the garlic and shallots.
Step 2: Boil the macaroni
Place a pot on the stove and pour in 500 ml of water, then add 1 tsp salt and 1 tbsp cooking oil. Bring the water to a boil.
Once boiling, add 120 g of macaroni and boil for about 15 minutes over medium heat. Finally, use a slotted spoon to remove the macaroni and drain.
Step 3: Cooking
Place a pan on the stove and add 3 tbsp cooking oil. When the oil is hot, add the minced shallots and garlic and sauté until fragrant.
Next, add all the prepared pork to the pan and stir-fry quickly over medium heat. Season with 1 tsp seasoning powder, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/3 tsp MSG, and 1/2 tsp sugar, then stir well.

Add the onion to the pan and continue to stir-fry quickly. Taste and adjust the seasoning to your preference. Next, add the boiled macaroni to the pan and finally, add the chopped green onions and 1/2 tsp ground pepper. Turn off the heat.

Transfer the dish to a plate and you have a simple yet delicious portion of stir-fried macaroni with pork. The perfectly chewy macaroni combined with tender, flavorful pork makes it a great alternative to rice. Try making this in your kitchen!

mon_an.mo_ta: A plate of leek salad served with bread for breakfast provides plenty of nutrients and aids in weight loss. Leeks are also a superfood with incredible health benefits. With just a little time in the kitchen and simple, easy-to-find ingredients, this fuss-free recipe requires no frying or complex processing, giving you a nutritious and energy-boosting meal in no time.
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients for the leek salad:

Trim the roots and remove any wilted or damaged leaves from the leeks. Cut off the tough, fibrous outer leaves, keeping only the white stalks and tender green parts. Wash thoroughly, then slice thinly and finely chop.
Grate the cheese into small shreds.
Remove the stems from the tomatoes and wash them. Pick the herbs, removing roots and wilted leaves, then wash thoroughly.
Slice the bread into bite-sized pieces to serve with the salad.
Cooking steps:
Step 1: First, mix the grated cheese and chopped leeks together in a large bowl.
Step 2: Add the mayonnaise and mix until well combined and creamy. Season with salt to taste.
Step 3: Arrange the salad on a plate, garnish with cherry tomatoes and herbs for a beautiful presentation. Your simple leek salad is now ready.
Tips for a delicious and easy-to-eat leek salad:
You can toast the bread until warm and crispy before serving with the salad to enhance the flavor.
Leek salad pairs best with bread. Simply spread the salad on the bread and enjoy with fresh vegetables if desired.
The salad can be stored in the refrigerator for a few days while maintaining its freshness.

How to choose leeks: Leeks are available year-round, but they are at their best, freshest, and most nutritious when harvested in winter and early spring. Choose firm leeks with fresh roots, white stalks, and vibrant green leaves that are not bruised or yellowed. Avoid overly large stalks; look for those with a diameter of 3.5 - 4 cm. Fresh leeks can be stored in the refrigerator for 2 days to 1 week.
Notes on consuming leeks:
There are many ways to prepare leeks. However, the highest concentration of antioxidants is preserved when they are steamed.

Cooked leeks left overnight can become harmful. It is best to eat them immediately after cooking and avoid long storage. If left for too long, the nitrates can convert into nitrites, which may cause poisoning. Additionally, leeks are not recommended for young children with poor digestion.

A plate of leek salad with bread for breakfast is nutritious and supports weight loss. Leeks are a healthy food with surprising benefits. This salad can also serve as an appetizer for family meals. With simple ingredients and a straightforward method—no frying or complex steps—you can prepare a meal that provides both nutrition and energy quickly. Everyone will find it delicious, light, and satisfying enough to power through a productive day.

mon_an.ten: Pork Ribs with Toasted Rice Powder
mon_an.mo_ta: There are countless ways to prepare pork ribs, but this unique version with toasted rice powder is sure to be a refreshing change. It is incredibly appetizing and pairs perfectly with rice. Let's see how to make it!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Star anise, toasted and ground - 2 pieces
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Cut the pork ribs into bite-sized pieces, wash thoroughly, blanch in boiling water, then drain well.
Step 2:
Marinate the ribs with oyster sauce, soy sauce, salt, sugar, and pepper. Mix well and let sit for 20 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Step 3:
Place the cornstarch in a plastic bag, add the ribs, and shake well to create an even coating of flour around each piece.
Step 4:
Toast the rice and star anise in a pan until golden and fragrant, then let cool. Remove the star anise and grind the rice into a fine powder (thính).
Step 5:
Heat oil in a pan. Once the oil is hot, add the ribs and fry over medium heat. When the ribs are cooked through and golden brown, remove and place on a plate.
Step 6:
Heat 1 tbsp of oil in a pan. Once hot, add the lemongrass, chili, garlic, green onions, and 1/2 tsp of salt. Stir-fry until fragrant for about 3 minutes.
Finally, add the fried ribs and toasted rice powder, toss well to coat, and turn off the heat.
This dish is incredibly delicious when served with hot steamed rice!

mon_an.mo_ta: Discover the simple steps and secrets to making delicious beef with tamarind sauce, so you can easily enjoy this dish with family and friends at home. Get ready to explore how to create a superb tamarind beef dish and take your palate to a new level with the recipe below! Learn how to make restaurant-quality beef with tamarind sauce in just a few simple steps. Enjoy the tender texture of beef combined with the signature sweet, sour, and refreshing flavor of tamarind sauce. Discover the secrets and easy-to-find ingredients to create a professional and attractive dish right at home.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare ingredients
First, use salt water or white wine to remove any odors from the beef. Next, rinse the meat and slice it into thin, bite-sized pieces.
Peel and mince the garlic to make garlic paste. Peel and mince or blend the shallots.

Next, marinate the beef with ½ of the minced garlic and shallots, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp oyster sauce, ¼ tbsp salt, ¼ tbsp MSG, and ½ tbsp pepper. Let the meat marinate for 15-20 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Peel and wash the onion. You can cut half of the onion into wedges and the other half into small cubes. Wash and finely chop the scallions after removing the roots, and thinly slice the chili.
Step 2: Processing
2.1. Prepare the tamarind sauce
In a bowl, combine 50g of tamarind with 1/2 cup of hot water. Mash the tamarind to dissolve it, then strain to remove the seeds and pulp, keeping only the juice.
Next, place a pan on the stove and heat 1 tbsp of cooking oil. Once the oil is hot, add the diced onions and stir-fry.
When the onions become soft and translucent, add the prepared tamarind juice to the pan. Then, add 1 tbsp oyster sauce and 2 tbsp sugar, stirring well to completely dissolve the seasonings.

In a small bowl, whisk 1 tsp of tapioca starch with water. Turn the heat to medium and simmer the tamarind water until it bubbles slightly for about 6-8 minutes. Then, add the starch mixture to create a thickened consistency. When the mixture boils again, stir well until the sauce reaches the desired thickness, then turn off the heat.

The finished tamarind sauce will bring a unique combination of flavors, from the light sourness of tamarind and the saltiness of oyster sauce to the sweetness of sugar and onions. This sauce is not only suitable for beef but can also be used in many other recipes such as grilled meat, grilled ribs, and more.
2.2. Stir-fry with tamarind
Place a pan on the stove and pour in one tablespoon of cooking oil. When the oil is hot, add the remaining minced shallots and garlic to the pan and sauté until fragrant and golden.
Next, add the beef to the pan and stir-fry quickly for about 2 minutes, then add the onion wedges. While stir-frying, toss well until the onions soften and the beef is just cooked through.
Add the previously prepared tamarind sauce to the pan and stir well until the meat and sauce are well combined.
Then, add the chili and scallions to the pan, toss quickly, and turn off the heat.

Transfer the stir-fried tamarind beef to a plate and enjoy. The beef in tamarind sauce will have a soft, tender texture without being dry, and the tamarind sauce will create a beautiful brown glaze that coats the beef evenly. The fresh, tender meat combined with the thick sauce and crunchy, sweet onions creates a wonderful flavor. Tamarind beef is best enjoyed while hot.
Notes for a hot and delicious tamarind beef dish

Note that stir-fried beef should not be left on the heat for too long as it will lose its flavor and become tough. You should only stir-fry the meat and onions until just cooked and then remove from the heat immediately.
If tamarind juice is not available, you can buy ripe tamarind fruit, blanch it in boiling water, mash it, and strain it to get the clear juice.
Tamarind beef should be eaten while still piping hot to maintain the aroma and deliciousness of the dish.
How to choose good beef:

When buying beef, you should choose bright red meat, not too dark, with small fibers, dry, smooth, firm, and not sticking to your hands. If the fat is yellow, the meat will be soft and fatty. Young beef has white fat, soft meat, and very fine fibers. Old beef has large, purple-red fibers and grayish fat. Old beef is tough and takes a long time to soften. Female beef is usually tastier than male beef. If you can choose heifer beef, it's even better because the meat is soft, the fat is white, and the fibers are fine.
Beef that is pale green or has white spots between the fibers is infected with flukes or tapeworms. You should not buy meat that has a foul odor.
Distinguishing between buffalo meat and beef
You can immediately identify buffalo meat: the meat is pale pink, the fibers are large, the color is deep red, but the fat is whiter than beef fat.

mon_an.mo_ta: This cheesy baked chicken dish attracts diners with its crispy exterior while the inside remains very soft and flavorful. The chicken breast will no longer be dry but very sweet and fragrant with the taste of cheese mixed with tomato sauce.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare ingredients for cheesy baked chicken.
Wash the chicken breast, then remove all bones and skin.
After that, slice the chicken into thin, large, and fairly long pieces.
Grate the mozzarella cheese into shreds.
Grate the parmesan cheese into a powder (you can buy it pre-grated to save time).
Crack the eggs into a bowl and beat them.
Next, mix the breadcrumbs with the dried basil and flour on a separate plate.
Then, place the parchment paper onto the baking tray.
Step 2: Steps to make cheesy baked chicken.
First, use paper towels to pat the chicken completely dry.
Next, dip the chicken in the following order: dredge the chicken evenly in flour, dip it into the beaten eggs, and finally coat it with a layer of breadcrumbs.
Next, place a large pan on the stove and heat the cooking oil.
When the oil is hot, drop each piece of chicken in to fry.

During the frying process, pay attention to flipping the chicken to fry both sides evenly. We don't need to fry the chicken too thoroughly or cook it completely because there is still a baking step. You only need to fry until the breading is slightly golden and fragrant.

Next, place the fried chicken pieces on the parchment paper and spoon tomato sauce onto each piece, making sure to cover the meat completely. Then, sprinkle mozzarella cheese and parmesan cheese respectively over the chicken.
Final step, place the chicken in the oven and bake for 35 minutes at 180°C.
When the chicken is cooked and the cheese has melted, arrange the chicken on a plate and serve with rice or tomato sauce pasta; both are very delicious.
Notes for delicious cheesy baked chicken

When making this dish, note that we do not fry the meat until fully cooked, only lightly sear it to avoid drying out the chicken when baking again, as chicken breast is already drier than other parts.
For those who don't like breast meat, you can use chicken thighs for this dish; it's also very tasty!
To make the dish tastier and less heavy, you should serve it with some green vegetables.
Additionally, if you don't have both types of cheese, using just one type is fine.
Similarly, if breadcrumbs are unavailable, use white panko breadcrumbs as they are easier to find.

This cheesy baked chicken dish attracts diners with its crispy exterior while the inside remains very soft and flavorful. The chicken breast will no longer be dry but very sweet and fragrant with the taste of cheese mixed with tomato sauce.

mon_an.mo_ta: Salt-crusted chicken is a favorite dish for many families, featuring tender, fresh chicken with a crispy outer crust and a light salty taste that melts in your mouth, accompanied by the aroma of lemon leaves and lemongrass that elevates the dish. You will love this delicious dish from the first bite. Let's get into the kitchen and show off your cooking skills with this wonderful dish!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Pepper, seasoning powder, fish sauce, MSG - seasonings
cac_buoc: Prepare ingredients for salt-crusted chicken:
First, soak the glutinous rice, jasmine rice, and mung beans for 3-4 hours. After the rice has expanded, rinse the glutinous rice, jasmine rice, and mung beans thoroughly.
Then, soak the rice and mung beans separately in warm water for 15-20 minutes.
Once the rice is drained, toast it until fragrant.
Drain the mung beans and toast until golden.
Dry-roast the sea salt and grind it finely.
Next, grind all the rice, salt, and mung beans into a fine powder, let it cool, pour the excess into a glass jar, and seal tightly.
Wash the lemongrass, cut into 3-finger-long segments, and shred lengthwise; wash the lemon leaves and slice into thin strips.
Crack the egg into a bowl and separate the yolk.

Wash the chicken with salt, then chop into bite-sized pieces. Marinate with 1 tsp seasoning powder, 1 tbsp fish sauce, a bit of MSG, pepper, cooking oil, and the egg yolk. Cover and keep in the refrigerator for 30 minutes. Remember to marinate the chicken for a while so the meat absorbs the spices, making it tastier when eaten.
Steps to make salt-crusted chicken:

First, place a pan on the stove and pour in cooking oil. When the oil is hot, add the lemongrass and lemon leaves to the pan. Once the oil is fragrant, remove the lemongrass and lemon leaves and set aside.
Next, dredge the marinated chicken in tapioca starch and fry until golden.
When the chicken is golden and crispy, remove it and place it in another pot. While frying, remember to flip the chicken evenly so it cooks through and has a beautiful color.

Then, toss the chicken with 3 tbsp of the roasted salt powder you just made and the previously fried lemongrass and lemon leaves. Stir for a while longer so the rice powder coats the chicken pieces evenly.
Finally, present the chicken on a plate and enjoy.
Notes for excellent salt-crusted chicken:

Usually, we make a large batch of the salt and rice powder at once and store it in a sealed jar to use for many dishes like salt-crusted duck, salt-crusted frog, etc., as this mixture can be preserved for a long time.
When grinding the rice-salt mixture, you only need to grind it small, not into a fine dust. Let the rice cool before grinding to avoid damaging the machine.
Chicken used for this dish should be meaty parts like thighs, wings, or breast.
Only fry the chicken until the outside is golden; if fried too long, the salt-crusted chicken will become dry.
How to choose good chicken:
Prepared free-range chicken usually has a compact, firm body and a narrow breast.

Egg-laying hens look very similar to free-range chickens, so distinguish them carefully. Free-range chicken skin is pale yellow and only deep yellow in some places like the breast, wings, and back, while egg-laying hens are white or yellow all over (possibly due to harmful dyes).

To identify if the chicken has been dyed, observe: if the skin is yellow but the fat layer inside is white, it has been dyed with chemicals. Free-range chicken skin is thin, smooth, and highly elastic. Choose chicken that looks fresh, has no foul or antibiotic smell, and has no bruises or blood clots on the skin.

To buy good chicken, avoid those with dark skin as they may have died before processing. Additionally, to avoid water-injected chicken, use your hand to press on suspected areas (mainly thighs and breast); if it feels mushy, slippery, or deformed, avoid buying it.

mon_an.mo_ta: Cheese-stuffed shrimp with golden, crispy shrimp balls; when eaten, the fresh shrimp meat is flavorful and blends with the rich, creamy cheese, served with sweet and sour sauce for a wonderful experience.
cac_buoc: Step 1: After buying the shrimp, rinse them with a bit of wine to reduce the fishy smell, then rinse again with water. Peel the shrimp and devein them; remember to cut off the tails and set them aside (for decoration). Mince the shrimp meat.
Step 2: Put the minced shrimp into a bowl, add 2 tbsp cornstarch, 1 beaten egg, 1/2 tsp salt, and 1 tsp pepper. Mix thoroughly until the ingredients are well combined and form a thick, sticky paste.

Step 3: Cut the cheese into small pieces. Take a small amount of the shrimp mixture from Step 2 in your palm, flatten it slightly, place a few pieces of cheese in the center, and roll it into a ball so the shrimp fully encloses the cheese. Repeat until all shrimp and cheese are used.
Next, dip the shrimp balls into the egg wash -> dredge in crispy frying flour -> coat with breadcrumbs, then insert the shrimp tails into the balls.

Step 4: Prepare a deep frying pan (or a small pot so the oil doesn't spread out too much) and place it on the stove. Once hot, pour in the cooking oil (use enough oil to ensure the shrimp are deep-fried). When the oil is hot, add the cheese-stuffed shrimp balls and fry over medium heat until they are an eye-catching golden brown. Remove and place on paper towels to drain.
Finally, arrange the fried shrimp balls on a plate and enjoy with chili sauce, ketchup, or any sauce of your choice.
Notes for making crispy fried cheese-stuffed shrimp
If you don't want to keep the shrimp tails, you can skip the step of inserting them.
How to choose fresh shrimp:
Check the shrimp tail

To determine the freshness of shrimp, stretch the shrimp straight and hold it up to the light to see the width between the joints on the shell and the meat. Wider joints indicate the shrimp is no longer fresh because it may have been overcooked or frozen for a long time.
Avoid buying slimy shrimp

Do not buy shrimp that have become slimy. Most of these shrimp will curl their bodies into a circle rather than lying straight. To check this, press your finger on the shell and move it back and forth a few times. If you feel grit under your fingers or notice the shrimp are slimy and sticking together, do not buy them.
Shrimp legs

Observe whether the shrimp legs are still firmly attached to the body; the meat must be firm. Additionally, avoid buying shrimp with legs that have turned black, as this is a sign they are no longer fresh.

mon_an.mo_ta: Once prepared, these sweet and sour fermented shrimp become a wonderful dish for many families with eye-catching colors, fresh and chewy shrimp meat infused with sweet and sour flavors. Enjoying a piece of shrimp with some rice vermicelli, wrapped in various herbs, will give you a fantastic sensation. Just a little time and you'll have a delicious dish to treat the whole family!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning powder, MSG, etc. - basic seasonings
cac_buoc: How to make delicious sweet and sour fermented shrimp

After buying the shrimp, remove the heads, devein, and squeeze out the waste from the head. Rinse thoroughly with water (2-3 times until the water runs clear). Shake in a colander to drain, then place in a large bowl or basin and pour in about 150ml white wine. Toss the shrimp with the wine, then remove and drain. This helps reduce the fishy smell and makes the dish more flavorful.

Next, place a small pot on the stove and bring the fish sauce and sugar to a boil (you can add 1 tsp MSG if liked), then let it cool. Wash the galangal, drain, and julienne. Peel the garlic, wash the garlic and chili, drain, and slice. (The amount of galangal, garlic, and chili is up to your preference).

When the shrimp are drained and the fish sauce mixture has cooled, mix the shrimp, galangal, garlic, chili, and 1 tbsp white wine together. Pack them into a glass or plastic jar, closing the lid tightly, and keep in a cool place for 3-4 hours (carefully layer the shrimp and spices into the jar, ensuring the shrimp do not float to the top).

After that, place the jar in the sun for about 1 week to allow the shrimp to ferment. Put it out in the sun in the morning and bring it in at night; repeat for 1 week. Once the shrimp are ready, bring them inside to a cool place; when they taste sour enough, store them in the refrigerator for long-term use.
Notes for making delicious sweet and sour fermented shrimp
The fermentation speed depends on the temperature; if the weather is sunny and warm, it will be ready in about 6 days. In cold weather, the jar needs to sit longer.
How to choose fresh shrimp:
To have delicious shrimp, you should choose those with firm bodies, hard shells, and a clear white color rather than cloudy, red, or yellow.
The head should be firmly attached to the body, claws should be intact, and there should be no fishy or spoiled smell.
Tips for distinguishing freshness by shrimp type:
Lobster: Those with clear blue claws and a fresh, shiny shell are the best.
Banana shrimp: Should be lively, with a pinkish-white color and green eyes.
Tiger shrimp: Should have a smooth, shiny shell with fresh and clear segments in the middle of the body.
Absolutely avoid buying shrimp that have turned deep pink, with heads and claws detached from the body and a spoiled smell, as they are not tasty and can be very dangerous.

Once prepared, these sweet and sour fermented shrimp become a wonderful dish for many families with eye-catching colors, fresh and chewy shrimp meat infused with sweet and sour flavors. Enjoying a piece of shrimp with some rice vermicelli, wrapped in various herbs, will give you a fantastic sensation. Just a little time and you'll have a delicious dish to treat the whole family!

mon_an.mo_ta: Crispy coconut shrimp rolls appeal to diners from the very first glance with their eye-catching color. Upon tasting, you will experience a crunchy outer shell and fresh, flavorful shrimp meat perfectly seasoned for a delicious sensation.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Rice paper wrappers, halved diagonally - 12 sheets
cac_buoc: Step 1:

Rinse the shrimp with salt, a little wine, and ginger to remove the fishy smell. Then, rinse again with clean water. Next, peel the shells and remove the heads, leaving the tails intact. Dry the shrimp with paper towels. Use the tip of a knife to keep the shrimp lying flat as shown in the image.
Step 2:
In a large bowl, mix the shrimp with 2 tbsp Sriracha and 1 tbsp honey. Let marinate for about 15 minutes to allow the shrimp to absorb the flavors.
Step 3:
Next, mix the mayonnaise with lime juice, cilantro, and 1 tbsp Sriracha. Add salt and pepper, then set aside. This will be the dipping sauce once finished.
Step 4:
After that, completely coat the shrimp in the finely shredded coconut.
Step 5:
Cut the rice paper sheets in half diagonally. Place one on a flat surface with the main tip pointing to the left (as shown).
Step 6:

Place the shrimp on the lower part of the rice paper. The tail should stick out, then roll the paper around the shrimp; halfway through, fold the main tip in (as shown) and continue rolling until finished.
Step 7:
Next, place a pan of oil on the stove and heat the oil to 300°C. Once the oil is hot, drop the shrimp in and fry all sides until golden and crispy. This step takes about 2 minutes.
When finished frying and the shrimp are cooked, place them on a rack to drain excess oil.
Finally, arrange the shrimp on a plate and enjoy with the sauce while they are still crispy!
How to choose delicious shrimp:
Check the shrimp tail

To determine the freshness of the shrimp, pull the shrimp straight and hold it up to the light to see the width between the joints on the shell and the meat. Wider joints indicate the shrimp is no longer fresh, as they may have been cooked too long or frozen for an extended period.
Avoid buying slimy shrimp

Do not buy shrimp that have become slimy. Most of these shrimp will have bodies curved into a circle rather than lying straight. To check this, use your finger to press on the shell and move it back and forth a few times. If it feels gritty under your fingers or the shrimp are slimy and sticking together, do not buy them.
Shrimp legs

Observe whether the shrimp legs are still firmly attached to the body; the meat should be firm. Additionally, avoid buying shrimp with legs that have turned black, as this is a sign they are no longer fresh.
Choose by variety
There are many types of shrimp, each raised in different environments, so the selection and preparation methods vary:

Black tiger shrimp: These are farmed, so the meat is firm, the size is quite large, and they are easy to prepare. When choosing, the shrimp must still be alive. Look for a shiny, smooth shell and a clear, fresh spine for the best quality and firmest meat.

Iron shrimp: These are smaller than other types but very delicious, with a deep sweet flavor when cooked. Pay attention when choosing these. Healthy and delicious ones are fresh with a white-pink color; if they are deep pink, they have been sitting too long and are no longer fresh.
White shrimp (sea): When inspecting, these should be lively, white-pink in color with green eyes; that is a sign of fresh, healthy shrimp.
Lobster: This is the largest variety, often chosen for steaming. Healthy, delicious lobsters have clear blue claws and a fresh, shiny shell.

mon_an.mo_ta: Rainbow shrimp stir-fry attracts diners with its eye-catching colors from green, red, and yellow bell peppers, along with green onions and golden-brown shrimp. Upon tasting, you will find fresh shrimp perfectly seasoned alongside the natural sweetness of the vegetables.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings - sugar, seasoned salt, fish sauce, MSG...
cac_buoc: How to make Rainbow Shrimp Stir-fry for 4-5 people
Step 1: Prepare the ingredients for the rainbow shrimp stir-fry.
Peel the ginger, rinse, and mince finely.

Rinse the fresh shrimp with wine to reduce the fishy smell, then peel the shells, remove the heads, and pull out the black vein along the back. Rinse again with clean water. Once prepared, mix the shrimp with the minced ginger to enhance the aroma of the dish.
Slice the green, red, and yellow bell peppers into long, thin strips as shown in the image.
Peel the onion, rinse, and cut into small wedges.
Trim the roots and wilted leaves from the green onions, rinse thoroughly, and chop finely.
Peel the garlic, rinse, and mince finely.
Step 2: Cooking steps for the rainbow shrimp stir-fry.
First, add a little cooking oil to a pan—just enough to coat the surface with a thin layer—and place the pan over medium heat.
Use a wooden spoon to check the oil temperature; if bubbles form around the spoon, you can start cooking.
Next, add the minced garlic and sauté until fragrant, then add the onion and stir with the garlic for 10 seconds or until the onion turns a light golden color.
Add the shrimp and stir-fry until the meat is firm, then add the mixture of green, red, and yellow bell peppers and stir-fry until cooked.
Next, season the dish with 2-4 tbsp oyster sauce and 1 tsp sugar. Continue to stir-fry so the shrimp absorbs the seasonings.
Stir-fry the shrimp for another 1-2 minutes, then taste the dish to see if it suits your palate and adjust as necessary.
Finally, add the green onions and black pepper to the dish, toss a few times, and turn off the heat.
Scoop the shrimp and vegetables onto a plate and serve with hot rice.
Notes for a delicious rainbow shrimp stir-fry
If you don't have much time to go to the market for fresh shrimp, you can buy pre-packaged shrimp from the supermarket to skip the preparation step.
To add color to the dish if you don't like bell peppers, you can substitute them with other vegetables like carrots, peas, or baby corn; the flavor will be just as unique and attractive.
When stir-frying the shrimp, absolutely do not add water to the pan to avoid making the bell peppers and onions mushy.

Rainbow shrimp stir-fry attracts diners with its eye-catching colors from green, red, and yellow bell peppers, along with green onions and golden-brown shrimp. Upon tasting, you will find fresh shrimp perfectly seasoned alongside the natural sweetness of the vegetables. Just a little time in the kitchen and you'll have a wonderful dish to treat your family and friends!

mon_an.mo_ta: Shrimp in savory tomato sauce, with its simple preparation and delicious, rich flavor, is sure to be a perfect dish to enjoy with rice for the whole family! Let's learn how to make this flavorful shrimp dish to make your family meals even more appealing!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings: 1 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tsp sugar, 1 tsp ketchup, 3 tbsp water, 1 small piece of ginger, 2 scallion sections.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Trim the legs and antennae off the shrimp.
Step 2: Use a knife to score a line along the back of the shrimp to remove the vein. Then, slightly open the cut so the shrimp can easily absorb the seasonings.
Step 3: Heat a pan with 2 tbsp cooking oil, add the 2 scallion sections and a few ginger slices, and sauté until fragrant; when the scallions and ginger are lightly browned, remove them from the pan.
Step 4: Add the shrimp to the pan and fry until they change color, then flip to fry the other side. Add the soy sauce and sugar, and stir well.
Step 5: Add the ketchup and sprinkle julienned ginger into the pan, then toss well.
Step 6: Add a little water and cover with a lid. Simmer on low heat until the sauce thickens slightly, then turn to high heat, adjust the seasoning to taste, and turn off the stove.
Finally, simply plate the shrimp and pour the sauce over them.

Shrimp in savory tomato sauce is one of the delicious shrimp dishes you cannot miss. The dish has a balanced sweet and sour taste and is very savory, making it perfect for serving with rice for the family dinner.

mon_an.mo_ta: Grilled meat-stuffed squid is incredibly fragrant and attractive, making it a perfect choice for a family weekend treat.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Filling - 225g ground pork; 5ml fish sauce; 5g bell pepper; 5g sugar; 2.5g salt; 1 minced shallot; 1 small portion of glass noodles (soaked until soft, cut into 4cm lengths); 1 small portion of wood ear mushrooms (soaked until soft, finely chopped)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Clean the squid thoroughly and let it drain.

Step 2: In a bowl, mix the pork, fish sauce, sugar, pepper, salt, shallot, wood ear mushrooms, and glass noodles together. Gently stuff this mixture into each squid. Do not overfill, or you won't be able to secure the head. Use toothpicks to pin the top of the squid so the filling doesn't fall out.
Step 3: Spray a little olive oil over the stuffed squid, then sprinkle with a bit of salt and chili powder.

Step 4: Heat a grill pan with 15ml of vegetable oil. Place the squid on the pan to grill. Cover with a lid and reduce the heat to low. Flip occasionally so the squid cooks evenly. The cooking time depends on the size of the squid.
When the squid is cooked through, remove it and slice into bite-sized pieces. Grilled meat-stuffed squid is best enjoyed while hot!

mon_an.mo_ta: Bún ốc is a familiar dish for many families because it is refreshing to eat. The crunchy, fresh snails served with rice vermicelli and fresh herbs create a wonderful sensation. Just a little time in the kitchen and you'll have a delicious meal to treat your family and friends!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Side herbs - Scallions, perilla, lettuce, bean sprouts, shallots, ginger
Seasonings - Rice vinegar (giấm bỗng), shrimp paste, broth powder, sugar, fish sauce, salt, MSG
cac_buoc: How to make Bún ốc for 4 people
Ingredient preparation
Wash the tomatoes and cut them into wedges.
Trim the roots and wilted leaves from the scallions, wash them, and chop into 2cm pieces.

For the fresh herbs like perilla, lettuce, and cilantro: trim the roots and damaged leaves, wash once, then soak in diluted salt water for 15 minutes to remove dirt. Rinse again with clean water. Let the perilla and scallions drain, then chop finely.
Soak the snails for a few hours if possible, then wash them clean. You can soak them with chili to help the snails release slime.
Peel the shallots, wash them, and crush them.
Wash the pork bones thoroughly to remove any odors.
Execution steps:
Boil the snails in a pot with just enough water and a few slices of ginger and lemongrass for fragrance. Once the snails open their mouths, remove them and extract the meat from the shells.

To flavor the bones, place the pork bones in a pot, bring to a boil, then remove and rinse clean with water. Next, sauté the shallots until fragrant, add the bones and stir-fry with fish sauce and MSG to absorb the flavor. Add 2 liters of water to the pot and simmer for about 30 minutes over low heat. Remember to skim the foam to keep the broth clear.
After preparing the broth base, take a large pot and combine the broth, snail boiling water, rice vinegar, and a little broth powder, then bring to a boil.
Sauté shallots in a pan with oil until golden, then add the tomatoes and stir-fry until soft. Add the snail meat and broth powder, stirring quickly for 3 minutes.
Cut the tofu into small squares. Heat oil in a pan and fry the tofu until golden brown on all sides.
Finally, adjust the seasoning of the broth to taste.
Blanch the rice vermicelli in boiling water to remove any odor and soften the strands.

To serve, place the vermicelli in a bowl, then top with snails, scallions, perilla, and fried tofu. If you like, add a little shrimp paste for a rich flavor, pour over the broth, and serve with fresh herbs.
Tips for a perfect Bún ốc
Do not boil or stir-fry the snails for too long, as they will become rubbery.
Ways to clean snails:
Step 1: Soak in rice water: Use rice-washing water to soak the snails for 2-3 hours; the snails will release slime and dirt into the water.
Then, simply rinse the snails several times with clean water.
Step 2: Soak with a knife: Drop a small metal knife into the soaking water. The smell of the metal in the water stimulates the snails to release mud and dirt faster and more thoroughly.
Step 3: Soak the snails in water mixed with vinegar and minced fresh chili for a few hours. However, snails soaked this way should be cooked immediately to maintain freshness.

Step 4: For large snails (ốc nhồi), do not break the tail end because the juices will leak out during steaming. Use a small knife to gently pry the mouth open, use a chopstick to push the meat inward slightly, then shake the snail firmly. The meat will fall out. Discard the muddy part at the end. Rub the remaining snail meat thoroughly with vinegar and rinse with cold water until clean.

mon_an.mo_ta: Cucumber Kimchi – An easy-to-make dish that is crunchy and mildly sour. This recipe ensures a crispy texture to make your dinner more enjoyable.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the cucumbers under running water, then soak them in diluted salt water for 15 minutes. Remove and place in a basket to drain completely. If the cucumber skin is still wet, the kimchi will get moldy. Cut the cucumbers into bite-sized pieces, mix with 2 tbsp of salt, and let sit for 30 minutes. Do not rinse with cold water and do not discard the salt.

Step 2: Peel and wash the ginger, then crush it finely. Peel and mince the garlic. Wash the scallions and chives and let them drain completely. Peel, core, and mince the apple to prepare for the kimchi.

Step 3: In a bowl, mix the chili flakes, crushed ginger and garlic, minced apple, and the salted cucumbers. Add 1 tsp of sugar. Wear plastic gloves and mix well. Pack the cucumbers into a sealed jar and store in a cool place. To prevent the dish from becoming too sour, store it in the refrigerator to slow down fermentation.

mon_an.mo_ta: Squid and tofu cakes with a crispy outer shell and a soft, fresh, well-seasoned interior will give you a delicious sensation when enjoyed!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Gia vị - Cooking oil, broth powder, pepper, fish sauce
cac_buoc: How to make delicious crispy squid and tofu cakes

Step 1: Peel the outer membrane of the fresh squid, remove the inedible parts from the tentacles, and wash once with water. Then, use rice wine to wash the squid to deodorize the fishy smell, pat dry, and dice.
Step 2: Gently wash the tofu under running water, pat dry, and mash it finely.
Peel the carrot, wash it, drain, and finely mince.

Step 3: Next, put the tofu, squid, and carrot into a large bowl. Add ½ tsp salt, 2 tbsp crispy frying flour, 1 tsp pepper, 1/2 tbsp fish sauce, and the egg. Mix well until the ingredients are combined and the squid is evenly seasoned.
Step 4: Take a small amount of the mixture in your hand and roll it into small, bite-sized balls.

Step 5: Prepare three separate bowls for the panko breadcrumbs, crispy frying flour, and beaten egg. Roll each ball through the flour, then the egg, and finally the panko breadcrumbs. Repeat until all the mixture is used.

Heat a pan on the stove, pour in oil, and when the oil is hot, place the coated cakes into the pan. Deep-fry until golden brown on all sides. Occasionally flip the cakes so they cook evenly and achieve an attractive color.
Once cooked, remove the squid and tofu cakes and place them on a plate lined with paper towels to drain the oil. Arrange on a serving plate and enjoy with sweet and sour dipping sauce.
How to choose fresh squid
Look at the color
For fresh squid, the brown parts should be a deep, dark brown rather than pale. The white parts should be opaque like milk. Both colors should be shiny and glossy.
Feel the firmness

Press your finger into the body of the squid. Fresh squid usually has firm meat with high elasticity. This means after pressing and releasing, the squid quickly returns to its original shape. If it's not fresh, the meat will be soft and flabby, and the indentation will remain for a while.
Observe the eyes
This is a very effective method. Fresh squid usually has very bright, clear eyes; you can even see the pupils clearly. If the squid is no longer fresh, the eyes will be blurry and cloudy.
Check the tentacles

Flip the tentacles over to see the round suckers. If the suckers are all present and firmly attached to the tentacles, the squid is very fresh. If the suckers are falling off, the squid is no longer good. Additionally, fresh squid has firm tentacles, while stale squid will have limp, soft tentacles.

mon_an.mo_ta: Mantis shrimp and prawn cakes attract diners with their eye-catching colors and rich, savory, fresh taste. With just a little time in the kitchen, you can have a unique dish to treat everyone and receive countless compliments!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings - Scallions, dill, pepper, broth powder, cooking oil
cac_buoc: How to make mantis shrimp and prawn cakes

First, wash the mantis shrimp with rice wine to remove the fishy smell. Peel the shells, then steam the whole mantis shrimp and prawns separately until cooked. Next, mix the minced mantis shrimp, fish paste, raw ham paste, and seasonings together until well combined.

Using your hands, shape the mixture into flat patties. Place a whole mantis shrimp and a prawn in the center of each patty, then wrap and shape them neatly so they look attractive. Repeat until all ingredients are used.
Prepare a steamer and steam the cakes for about 15 minutes. Once cooked, remove them to a plate to cool, then deep-fry in oil until golden brown on all sides.
Finally, serve the mantis shrimp and prawn cakes on a plate and enjoy with garlic chili fish sauce while hot.
How to choose good mantis shrimp:
Choose live ones

Mantis shrimp have a unique appearance with many legs, a greenish-white or opaque white color, and two claws similar to a shrimp's. To choose good ones, simply pick those that are still alive, look healthy, move quickly, and feel heavy in your hand! It is best to buy them at seafood markets or large central markets with dedicated seafood sections.
Choose mantis shrimp with eggs

When choosing, pick up the mantis shrimp and flip it over. If you see a reddish-pink streak at the tail, pick those immediately. These have eggs and will be very fragrant and rich when boiled or roasted.
How to peel mantis shrimp
Mantis shrimp meat is delicious and sweet, but the shell is hard and sharp. You might cut your hands if you aren't careful. To peel them easily, follow these instructions:

Use scissors to cut off the head (you can keep it if you like), then flip the belly side up. Hold the shrimp slightly tilted and use scissors to cut along one side of the shell edge. Hold the body with one hand and peel off the hard shell with the other. Then, use your hand to lift the meat away from the belly shell.

With simple ingredients and an easy method, you have a fresh mantis shrimp and prawn cake dish to treat your family and friends. Everyone will be delighted by the fragrant, colorful, and rich cakes. Just a little time in the kitchen and you'll have a unique dish and receive many compliments!

mon_an.mo_ta: Clay pot chicken rice features tender chicken infused with spices, wood ear mushrooms, shiitake mushrooms, and crunchy bamboo shoots. The rice, cooked in chicken broth, offers a savory and satisfying meal.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Ginger, shallots, garlic, chili, lemongrass - aromatics
Seasoning - sugar, salt, pepper, MSG, oyster sauce
cac_buoc: How to make clay pot chicken rice
Clean the chicken with water, salt, and lemon to remove odors. Boil with a slice of ginger and a pinch of turmeric powder for about 15 minutes, then remove and drain.
Rinse the rice and drain. Heat 1 tbsp of oil in a pan, sauté julienned ginger, minced garlic, and shallots until fragrant, then add the rice and lightly toast.
Add the chicken broth to the rice cooker with a bit of pepper and seasoning salt, then cook until the rice is done.
Next, slice the boiled chicken into long strips. Soak the shiitake mushrooms
until they expand and julienne them; blanch the bamboo shoots and julienne as well.

Heat 2 tbsp of oil in a pan and sauté minced garlic and lemongrass. Stir-fry the chicken, mushrooms, and bamboo shoots, seasoning until cooked through. Add the cooked rice, adjust the seasoning to taste, then transfer to the prepared clay pot, heat it up, and enjoy.
Tips for delicious clay pot chicken rice
How to choose good chicken (pre-slaughtered)
A good chicken should have a compact, firm body and a small breast.
Free-range chicken skin is golden, darker on the wings, breast, and back; it should not be bruised, pale purple, or have dark spots or nodules.
If the skin is tough and uniformly golden but the fat is white, the chicken may have been dyed yellow.
The meat should be firm and fresh, with no odors, rancid smells, or antibiotic smells.

Press the body, breast, or thighs; firm meat indicates good quality. If it is mushy, slippery, or deformed (pitted as if water-logged), it may have been injected with liquid or mixed with borax; absolutely do not buy it to avoid health risks.
Tips for choosing live chicken
Note the following points:
Compare two chickens of the same size; the heavier one will have firmer meat.
A healthy chicken is active and hard to catch, with bright, alert eyes, a bright red comb, and shiny, smooth feathers that are not ruffled.
The beak should be sharp and shiny, with no discharge.
The legs should be straight, slender, and even, with no scratches, broken claws, red spots, or unusual marks.

Part the feathers to check for thin, soft skin. The body should feel firm, not mushy, with large yellow patches under the breast and wings. Visible meat and blood vessels under the wings indicate firm meat without excess fat.
A healthy chicken has a pink, active vent with no wetness or abnormal droppings. If the droppings are yellow and foamy, slimy, or bloody, do not buy it as it is diseased and unsafe for your family.

Check for water injection by lifting the wing; many small red dots or a swollen, black injection site that spreads over time indicates the chicken was injected to increase weight. Absolutely do not buy it.
A healthy chicken with good digestion will not have a hard crop.

Avoid chickens with a pale or purple comb, lethargy, discharge from the beak, a bloated crop, dull eyes, drooping wings, a tired appearance, or a hanging head. Ruffled feathers, wrinkled skin, scrawny body, cold feet, or a pale/soiled vent are signs of disease, which is dangerous to your health.

mon_an.ten: Chicken Rolls with Green Rice Flakes
mon_an.mo_ta: Chicken rolls with green rice flakes is a unique and delicious dish. The golden, crispy skin wraps around a savory filling blended with the nutty, rich flavor of green rice flakes, providing a delightful experience from the very first bite.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Shiitake and wood ear mushrooms - 30 g
Shallots and garlic - a few bulbs
Cooking oil, seasoning powder, pepper - as needed
cac_buoc: HOW TO MAKE CHICKEN ROLLS WITH GREEN RICE

Step 1: Clean the chicken with salt to remove odors, rinse with water, drain, and debone while keeping the piece intact. Pat the meat dry with paper towels and flatten the meat inside the skin for easier rolling.
Step 2: Soak the wood ear and shiitake mushrooms in hot water until soft. Rinse and mince them.

Rinse the green rice flakes to soften, then mix in a bowl with ham paste, minced mushrooms, garlic, and shallots; add 1 tsp pepper and 2 tsp seasoning powder, mixing thoroughly until well combined. Let the mixture marinate for 15-20 minutes.
Step 3: After 15 minutes, spread the chicken piece on a cutting board and use a spoon to spread the green rice and ham mixture evenly over the inside of the chicken.
Step 4: Roll the chicken tightly and secure it with kitchen twine.
Step 5: Mix a little oyster sauce with soy sauce and brush it over the chicken skin to create a golden color.
Step 6: Steam the chicken rolls for 15 minutes. Once cooked, remove and let drain.

Step 7: Heat oil in a pan and fry the chicken rolls until the skin is golden and crispy, then place on paper towels. Once completely cooled, slice into bite-sized rounds, arrange on a plate, and serve with sweet and sour dipping sauce.
Tips for delicious chicken rolls with green rice
Besides sweet and sour fish sauce, you can enjoy the chicken with lemon-pepper seasoning salt, sweet and sour sauce, or ketchup.
How to choose good chicken
Pre-slaughtered chicken
Free-range chicken usually has a compact, firm body and a narrow breast.
