Rinse the chicken with water mixed with white wine, minced ginger, and a bit of salt to deodorize the meat and enhance the flavor, then pat dry.
Squeeze the lime for juice.

Mix the chopped chili, 2 tsp minced shallots, 2 tsp minced lemongrass, 1 tsp seasoning powder, ½ tsp MSG, 1 tsp cooking oil, and ½ tsp pepper. Rub this mixture all over the chicken and let it marinate for 30 minutes. Ensure the ingredients are well combined and rubbed evenly so the meat absorbs the flavors.
Steps to make steamed chicken with lemongrass:
Step 1:
Spread a layer of rock salt about 0.5 cm thick across the bottom of a heavy-bottomed pot.
Layer the crushed lemongrass, whole lime leaves, and julienned ginger on top of the salt.
Step 2:
Place a plate on top of the aromatics to create a 2cm gap, then place the chicken on the plate. Cover tightly and steam over medium-low heat for 40-45 minutes.
During steaming, ensure the lid is tightly sealed so the chicken cooks by steam. Flip the chicken after 20 minutes to ensure even cooking.
Step 3:
Once the chicken is cooked, remove it to a plate, chop into bite-sized pieces, and arrange them to resemble the shape of a whole chicken for an eye-catching presentation.
Top with the shredded lime leaves and a few slices of chili.
Step 4:
Make the dipping salt: mix 1.5 tsp fine salt, ½ tsp MSG, ½ tsp pepper, some sliced chili, and 1 tsp lime juice to serve with the chicken.
See also: Instructions for making salt-crusted steamed chicken
Tips for delicious steamed chicken with lemongrass
Dish requirements: The chicken should be just cooked through, with a strong aroma of lemongrass, lime leaves, and ginger. The meat should be tender, sweet, and lightly seasoned.
How to choose good chicken:

Free-range chicken (gà ta) usually has a compact, firm body and a narrow breast. Be careful to distinguish it from industrial layers. The skin of free-range chicken is pale yellow, with darker yellow patches on the breast, wings, and back, whereas industrial chickens are often white or entirely yellow (possibly due to dyes).
To check for dyes, observe if the skin is yellow but the fat underneath is white; if so, it has been chemically dyed.
The skin should be thin, smooth, and elastic. Choose fresh-looking meat without foul odors or antibiotic smells, and no bruises or blood clots on the skin.

Avoid chickens with dark, bruised skin as they may have died before processing. To avoid water-injected chicken, press on the thighs or breast; if it feels mushy, slippery, or deforms, do not buy it. Water is often injected with borax by some vendors.

mon_an.ten: Pan-Seared Salmon with Sweet and Sour Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: Each piece of salmon is infused with a delicious sweet and sour sauce, making it more flavorful and appetizing than ever!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: A pinch of salt, seasoning powder, pepper
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the salmon and pat it dry. Place a pan on the stove and add butter. Once the butter melts, add the salmon and pan-sear until both sides are just cooked, then remove to a plate.

Step 2: Finely chop the green onions and mince the garlic. For the sauce: combine ketchup, sugar, chili sauce, fish sauce, salt, pepper, seasoning powder, vinegar, and water in a bowl and stir until dissolved.
Step 3: Using the same pan, sauté the garlic until fragrant, then pour in the sauce mixture. Stir and bring to a boil until the sauce thickens, then add the salmon back in.
Step 4: Use a spoon to baste the salmon with the sauce so it absorbs the flavors evenly. Sprinkle with chopped green onions and turn off the heat.
Serve the pan-seared sweet and sour salmon on a plate and enjoy immediately with hot rice.
Good luck and enjoy this unique sweet and sour salmon recipe!

mon_an.mo_ta: Pork Kimchi Stew is a favorite for many because of the crunchy kimchi, sweet broth, fresh pork, soft tofu, a bit of egg, and that characteristic spicy kick. Enjoying kimchi stew with hot rice is a wonderful choice!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients for the Korean kimchi stew
Remove the heads and guts from the anchovies.
Finely chop the kimchi.
Peel, wash, and mince the garlic.
Trim and wash the green onions, then chop them.
Peel, wash, and finely dice the onion.
Wash the pork and slice into bite-sized pieces.
Peel the radish, wash, and slice thinly.
Step 2: Steps to make Korean Pork Kimchi Stew
First, place the anchovies, radish, kelp, and 1 liter of water in a pot. Cover and bring to a boil.
Once boiling, lower the heat and simmer for 20 minutes. Turn off the heat, strain the broth, and discard the solids.
In a small bowl, mix the chili powder and sesame oil together.
Heat a clay pot (Korean style) over high heat for 3-4 minutes. If using a regular pot, heat for 1-2 minutes.
Add the vegetable oil, onion, and garlic. Stir for 1 minute until fragrant, then add the pork. Stir-fry for 3 minutes until the meat is no longer pink and has a nice exterior.
Add the kimchi and stir for 1 minute, then add about 120ml of the prepared broth. Cover and simmer for 7 minutes over medium heat.

Add salt and sugar, stirring well. Cut the tofu and use a spoon to gently break it into smaller chunks in the pot. You can add more broth at this point if desired. Sprinkle some extra chili powder on top if you like it spicier.
Finally, crack an egg on top and let the pot boil for 1 more minute. Garnish with chopped green onions and serve.
Tips for delicious Korean Pork Kimchi Stew
Some ingredients might be hard to find in regular stores, so visit a Korean grocery store.
This dish is best served with hot rice. Due to its spicy and warming nature, it is perfect for cool or chilly days.
Adjust the amount of chili powder to your taste to avoid making it too spicy to eat.
To suit Vietnamese tastes and remove any fishy smell, you can lightly pan-fry the anchovies before simmering them for broth.
If you don't like eggs in your stew, you can omit them. You can also add enoki mushrooms for a nice crunch.

The kimchi stew is visually appealing with its characteristic Korean colors. The spicy heat, soft kimchi, and savory pork served with hot rice will give you a wonderful dining experience. Just a little time in the kitchen and you have a great dish for family and friends!

mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried chicken with mushrooms features the vibrant colors of various vegetables. The chicken is tender, fresh, and rich, fully infused with seasonings for a wonderful dining experience.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Marinade - 20ml soy sauce; 15ml cooking wine; black pepper
cac_buoc: How to make simple and delicious stir-fried chicken with mushrooms (serves 3-4)

Step 1: Wash the chicken with salt to remove any odor, then rinse again with clean water. Once drained, dice the chicken into bite-sized pieces. Place the chicken in a large bowl and marinate with cooking wine and black pepper until infused. You can marinate for 30 minutes for the best flavor.
Step 2: Prepare the aromatics and vegetables
Wash the king oyster mushroom and dice it.
Wash the bell pepper, remove the seeds, and dice it.
Wash the asparagus, drain, and chop into small pieces.
Peel the garlic and ginger, wash, and crush/mince them.
Step 3: Place a pan on the stove and add a little oil. When the oil is hot, sauté the garlic until fragrant and golden. Add the asparagus and stir-fry quickly until cooked.
Step 4: Add the chicken and stir-fry until tender. Make sure to test the meat; if not cooked thoroughly, it can be tough.
Step 5: Add seasonings to taste, then add the diced bell pepper, 2 tbsp oyster sauce, and 1/2 tsp salt. Stir-fry and toss evenly. Cook over medium heat so the chicken cooks through without burning.
Once the chicken is done, arrange the dish on a plate and serve.
Tips for a perfect stir-fried chicken with mushrooms
How to choose good chicken:
Free-range chicken (gà ta) usually has a compact, firm body and a narrow breast.

Be careful to distinguish it from industrial layers. Free-range chicken skin is pale yellow and only dark yellow in places like the breast, wings, and back, while industrial chickens are often white or yellow all over (possibly due to dyes).
To check for dyes, see if the skin is yellow but the fat underneath is white; if so, it has been chemically dyed.
The skin should be thin, smooth, and elastic. Choose fresh-looking meat without foul odors or antibiotic smells, and no bruises on the skin.
Avoid chickens with dark, bruised skin as they may have died before processing.
To avoid water-injected chicken, press on the thighs or breast; if it feels mushy or slippery, do not buy it. Water is often mixed with borax by some vendors.
Besides chicken thigh meat, you can also use chicken breast or any other part of the chicken for this recipe.

mon_an.ten: Pan-Seared Duck Breast with Plum Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: Just hearing the name Pan-Seared Duck Breast with Plum Sauce, you can already imagine how appealing the sweet and sour flavors soaking into each piece of seared duck will be. So, don't hesitate any longer—let's get started on this dish.
cac_buoc: Steps to make Pan-Seared Duck Breast with Plum Sauce
Wash the plums, cut them in half, and twist the two halves in opposite directions to separate them and remove the pits as shown below.
Peel and wash the ginger, then mince it finely. Add it to a pot with the plums, sugar, and a little water.
Place the pot on the stove and turn on low heat, simmering until the plum sauce thickens.
Keep the duck breast in a whole piece and use a knife to score the skin as shown below.
Note: Do not cut deep into the meat.
Sprinkle five-spice powder evenly on both sides of the meat.
Use your hands to gently rub the five-spice powder so it absorbs evenly into the duck breast.
Prepare a pan and heat a little oil.
Place the duck in the pan and fry over low heat until the meat is golden brown on both sides.
Once the duck breast is cooked, remove it to a cutting board, let it cool, and slice it into thin, bite-sized pieces.
Arrange the meat on a plate, drizzle the plum sauce over the top, and enjoy.

This pan-seared duck dish is best for its sweet and sour plum sauce, fragrant with ginger, which permeates every fiber of the duck meat and brings a very unique flavor. Plums are currently in season, so buy some and make this dish right away.

mon_an.ten: Fried Frog and Piper Lolot Leaf Patties
mon_an.mo_ta: With just a little time in the kitchen and simple, easy-to-find ingredients, you can have delicious fried frog patties with eye-catching colors and a wonderful aroma that will make your meal delightful. Today's article will guide you on how to make these fragrant fried frog patties for kids; please take a look!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning - Pepper, MSG, seasoning powder, cooking oil
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients for fried frog patties:
Clean the frog meat after buying (I usually ask the seller to do this at the market).
Wash the pork belly with salt to reduce the odor, then rinse with water and remove the skin.
After that, finely mince both types of meat and the shallots, then place them in a bowl.
Finely chop the piper lolot leaves.
Trim the roots and wilted leaves from the green onions, wash them, and mince finely.
Steps to make fried frog patties:
Step 1: First, mix the meat with the green onions, minced piper lolot leaves, 1 tbsp seasoning powder, ½ tsp pepper, and 2 eggs. Remember to mix well so the ingredients blend together.
Step 2: Next, shape the mixture into round patties or wrap them in piper lolot leaves.

Step 3: Place a pan on the stove, pour in oil, heat until very hot, then drop the patties in to fry. Flip them evenly on all sides, keeping the heat at a medium level so the patties don't burn and cook through the inside.
When the patties turn a beautiful golden color, remove them and place them on paper towels to drain excess oil.
Finally, arrange the patties on a plate and enjoy.
Notes for delicious fried frog patties:
To make the frog patties tastier, you should choose young frogs with small bones and plenty of cartilage for a crispier texture.
Serve the patties with fish sauce mixed with sliced chili, sweet and sour sauce, chili sauce, or any dipping sauce you prefer.
How to choose good frogs:
According to experienced cooks, the best type of frog is the field frog. These are frogs that live in the wild. This type is very fragrant, with firm, meaty, and flavorful flesh.
Pay attention to the season: Field frog meat is best from September and October onwards. At this time, the frogs are very fat as they store fat for a long winter hibernation.
Main identification features: Field frogs usually have slender heads, bright eyes, large and muscular thighs, yellowish or white bellies, and black or bright yellow spotted back skin...

When buying frogs, choose large ones with yellow skin. Such frogs are fat. It is best to choose live frogs; you can buy them and ask the seller to clean them for you, rather than buying frozen ones. This is because frog meat should be processed immediately after cleaning; if left for too long, it loses its aroma and the meat becomes bland.

Notes on preparation: For a delicious dish, before cooking, the frog meat must be marinated with spices, especially lemongrass, chili, and ginger, to enhance the aroma. To prevent the meat from being fishy, wash it in water mixed with salt, pat dry, and then process. In particular, you need to cook the frog meat thoroughly because wild-caught frogs are prone to parasites.

With just a little time in the kitchen and simple, easy-to-find ingredients, you can have delicious fried frog patties with eye-catching colors and a wonderful aroma that will make your meal delightful.

mon_an.ten: Vịt Nấu Giả Cầy (Mock Boar Style Stewed Duck)
mon_an.mo_ta: Vịt nấu giả cầy is a simple yet very attractive dish with its own characteristic flavor. Hot pieces of duck meat, thick fatty sauce, deeply infused with spices and the fragrant aroma of galangal, are perfect for a family meal after a tiring workday. With just a little time in the kitchen and familiar, easy-to-find ingredients, you'll have a wonderful dish to treat your family, friends, and loved ones.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning - Turmeric powder, shrimp paste, sugar, fish sauce, salt, seasoning powder
cac_buoc: Top of Form
Prepare the ingredients for the stewed duck:

Wash the duck with salt, rub lemon on the outside and inside, and remove all pinfeathers. Peel and wash the ginger, then crush it finely. Mix with salt and rub onto the duck until the gamey smell is gone.
Next, lightly roast the duck over charcoal, or if charcoal is unavailable, use an oven or a grill rack over a gas stove until the skin is slightly charred and fragrant.
Peel and wash the galangal, then pound it finely.
Peel and wash the garlic, then mince it.
Steps to make Vịt Nấu Giả Cầy:
Step 1: First, chop the roasted duck into bite-sized pieces.

Step 2: Next, marinate the duck with 1 tbsp pounded galangal, ½ tbsp minced garlic, 3 tbsp fermented rice, 1 tbsp salt, 1 tbsp shrimp paste, 1 tsp turmeric powder, and 3 tsp seasoning powder. Mix well so the duck absorbs the spices and let it marinate for 30 minutes to 1 hour.

Step 3: After marinating, place a pot on the stove over high heat. Add 1 tbsp oil, heat until hot, then add ½ tbsp minced garlic and sauté until fragrant. Add the duck meat and stir-fry until firm, then pour in enough water to just cover the meat. Cover the pot and simmer over low heat until the meat is tender, cooking for about 30 minutes, then turn off the heat.

Step 4: When the water has slightly reduced and turned a thick golden color, adjust the seasoning to taste. Add another 1 tbsp of minced galangal to maintain the characteristic aroma, and stir well. Add ½ tsp sugar for a mild sweetness and simmer until the sauce is thick and glossy.
Step 5: Finally, turn off the heat, ladle the meat into a bowl, garnish with fresh herbs, and serve hot with rice or rice vermicelli.
Notes for delicious Vịt Nấu Giả Cầy:

To cook a good pot of this dish, choose mature, fat ducks with round breasts, thick neck and belly skin, and full feathers. Wash the duck with salt and ginger wine to remove any odor and make the meat more fragrant.
If possible, use straw to singe the duck until the skin is evenly golden and slightly charred; this gives the meat a wonderful straw aroma.
For a fragrant and sweet broth, you can use coconut water instead of plain water to simmer the meat.

Vịt nấu giả cầy is a simple yet very attractive dish with its own characteristic flavor. Hot pieces of duck meat, thick fatty sauce, and fresh duck meat deeply infused with spices and the fragrant aroma of galangal are perfect for a family meal after a tiring workday. With just a little time in the kitchen and familiar, easy-to-find ingredients, you'll have a wonderful dish to treat your family, friends, and loved ones.

mon_an.ten: Gỏi Gà Măng Cụt (Mangosteen Chicken Salad)
mon_an.mo_ta: Mangosteen is a famous specialty from Binh Duong and has become a favorite fruit for many. Today, we will guide you on how to make a delicious Gỏi Gà Măng Cụt.
cac_buoc: 1. How to prepare the mangosteen
Prepare a bowl of diluted salt water and soak the mangosteens in it. Use a small pointed knife to slowly scrape off the outer skin to extract the mangosteen flesh inside.
Wash the extracted mangosteen flesh, then cut into flower-shaped rounds or separate into individual segments.
Dissolve 1/2 tbsp sugar and 1/2 tbsp vinegar in one liter of water. Soak the mangosteen in this mixture, then store it in the refrigerator.
2. How to prepare the chicken and other ingredients
Wash the chicken and place it in a pot to boil. Pour in enough water to cover the chicken, then add 1 tsp salt and 2 shallots. Boil for about 20 minutes, then remove and let cool.
Wash the Vietnamese coriander and basil, then slice them thinly.
Roast the peanuts, peel them, and crush them slightly.
Mince the garlic and chili.
3. How to make the sweet and sour fish sauce
Squeeze the juice from 1 lime and mix it with 3 tbsp sugar. Stir to dissolve the sugar.
Next, pour fish sauce into the lime-sugar mixture. Stir well to combine.
Add the minced garlic and chili to the mixture and mix well.
4. How to mix the salad
Once the chicken has cooled, shred it for the salad. To keep the salad fresh, you should only start mixing just before eating.
Place the chicken in a large bowl, then add the mangosteen, Vietnamese coriander, basil, and the sweet and sour fish sauce. Toss gently for about 5 minutes so the ingredients absorb the seasoning.
5. Finishing the salad

The finished Gỏi Gà Măng Cụt has the light sweetness of mangosteen combined with shredded chicken, creating a delicious salad that isn't heavy. Serve with a bit of sweet and sour fish sauce. It's truly a wonderful salad!
III. Notes when making Gỏi Gà Măng Cụt
Choose fresh ingredients: Ensure you choose fresh chicken and just-ripe mangosteens to guarantee the flavor and quality of the salad.
Prepare mangosteen correctly: Clean the mangosteen and peel the outer skin before use. Cut into rounds or segments for easier eating.
Boil chicken for the right time: Boil the chicken for about 20 minutes until cooked, then let it cool before shredding.
Mix the salad evenly: When mixing, toss gently so the ingredients are evenly coated. Start mixing only when you are ready to eat to prevent the salad from becoming soggy.
Store correctly: If not finished, store the salad in the refrigerator to keep the ingredients fresh and safe.
Sweet and sour fish sauce: Follow the instructions to achieve a balanced flavor. Taste and adjust to your own preference.
The chicken broth can be used to cook straw mushroom porridge, making a great accompaniment to the mangosteen salad. This porridge is not only delicious but also helps beat the heat on hot days.
IV. How to choose mangosteen for a good salad

The bottom of the fruit: On the bottom of the mangosteen, there is a small flower shape with several petals. You can count these petals to know the number of segments inside. Choosing a bottom with many petals is better.

Yellow sap streaks: Prioritize fruits with yellow sap streaks on the outer skin. This is a sign that the mangosteen is very sweet. Additionally, fruits with grey, rough, and shriveled skins often have better flavor.
The shell: Check if the mangosteen is ripe and sweet by pressing and squeezing around the shell. If the shell feels uniformly soft, it is ripe, sweet, and not spoiled.
By following these guidelines, you can select and check mangosteens to ensure you get ripe, sweet, and fresh fruit.

Green mangosteens are harvested from April to June in the South. Because they are rare and the peeling process is complex, peeling 1-2 kg of green mangosteen can take 1-1.5 hours. Furthermore, the amount of flesh obtained after peeling is not much, usually only about 400-500g from 2 kg of fruit. However, when eaten, the mangosteen is delicious and full of sweet, sour, spicy, and nutty flavors... very attractive. Therefore, this dish is called the "Queen of Salads" and is loved by many. Sometimes, 1 kg of pre-peeled mangosteen can cost up to half a million VND.

Green mangosteens have hard shells and a lot of sap. When peeling, you must do it under running water to remove all the sap, then soak them in cold water mixed with lime juice and salt to keep them white and crunchy. If making a large amount, you can place them in vacuum bags and store them in the refrigerator to keep them fresh and white for a long time.
This dish is best and most authentic in Lai Thieu, Binh Duong, where mangosteen has long been considered a "tribute specialty for kings."
Besides mixing with chicken, green mangosteen can also be mixed with shrimp to create a delicious and novel flavor.

mon_an.mo_ta: Fresh kohlrabi and shrimp salad with crunchy kohlrabi and carrots, delicious fresh shrimp, deeply infused with spices, plus the nutty richness of roasted peanuts and the aroma of accompanying herbs, brings a delightful sensation to the diner. Discover how to make this dish through the article below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Garlic, chili, lime - a little of each
Sugar, salt, chili sauce - to taste
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the shrimp with wine to remove the fishy smell. Then, rinse with clean water. Next, devein the shrimp by cutting along the back, wash again, and boil in water until just cooked, then remove immediately. Let the shrimp cool, peel them, and slice in half lengthwise, then cut into shorter segments and place on a plate.
Step 2: Peel the kohlrabi and carrots, wash them, and shred into strips. Roast the peanuts, remove the skins, and place them in a plastic bag to crush slightly into about 3 pieces per nut.

Step 4: Next, add 1 tsp salt to the kohlrabi and carrots, then massage thoroughly until soft. Let sit for about 20 minutes, then squeeze out all the water so the salad is dry and won't release liquid when mixed.
Step 5: Wash the chili. Peel and wash the garlic, then mince both the chili and garlic. Pick the young herb tips, wash them, drain, and cut into short segments.

Step 6: Next, prepare the dressing: combine filtered water, lime juice, fish sauce, chili sauce, and sugar. Stir until the sugar is completely dissolved, then add the minced chili and garlic last. You can taste and adjust to your preference.

Step 7: Finally, put the kohlrabi and carrots in a bowl and fluff them up. Add the shrimp along with the herbs and the dressing, then toss everything thoroughly. Let it sit for about 10 minutes to absorb the flavors before transferring to a plate. Sprinkle the crushed roasted peanuts on top and enjoy.
Notes for a delicious kohlrabi and shrimp salad:
Only sprinkle the peanuts on top when serving to prevent them from getting soggy and losing their crunch.
How to choose fresh shrimp in general:
Check the shrimp tail

To determine the freshness of shrimp, stretch the shrimp out and hold it up to the light to see the width between the joints on the shell and the meat. Wider joints indicate the shrimp is no longer fresh as it may have been cooked too long or frozen for a long time.
Avoid buying slimy shrimp

Do not buy shrimp that feel slimy. Most of these shrimp will have bodies curled into a circle rather than lying straight. To check this, press your finger on the shell and move it back and forth a few times. If it feels gritty under your fingers or the shrimp are slimy and stick together, do not buy them.
Shrimp legs

Observe whether the shrimp's legs are still firmly attached to the body; the meat must be firm. Additionally, you should not choose shrimp with legs that have turned black, as this is a sign they are no longer fresh.

mon_an.mo_ta: This dish is a gift for those who love chicken wings but don't know how to cook them. Chicken wings in mushroom sauce are delicious with the flavor of shiitake mushrooms, and the wing meat is sweet and tender. It can be enjoyed as a snack with drinks or as a main dish with hot rice. Let's follow this daily delicious cooking guide for this dish!
thoi_gian: Prepare the necessary ingredients for hot chicken wings with mushroom sauce with our cooking guide!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: White wine, ginger, salt, sugar, pepper
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the chicken wings after buying; if there are any pinfeathers left, pluck them clean. Use a sharp toothpick to poke holes in the wings so they absorb the seasoning better.
Step 2: Mix sesame oil, wine, minced ginger, salt, and pepper, then add the chicken wings to marinate.
Step 3: To allow the wings to absorb the seasoning evenly, let them sit for 30 minutes.
Step 4: Heat cooking oil in a pan, then sauté the culantro, garlic, and green onions until fragrant.
Continuing the daily delicious cooking guide for hot chicken wings with mushroom sauce!
Step 5: Add the chicken wings to the pan to fry.
Step 6: When one side of the wings has turned a beautiful golden brown, flip them over and continue frying until cooked through.
Step 7: Mix soy sauce and sugar together, then pour the mixture into the pan with the frying wings. Simmer over low heat.
Step 8: Soak the mushrooms until soft, wash them, trim the stems, and add them to the pan with the chicken. Simmer until the mushrooms are cooked, then remove the pan from the heat.

mon_an.ten: Stir-Fried Sweet Snails with Garlic, Chili, and Lime Leaves
mon_an.mo_ta: A weekend evening with fragrant stir-fried sweet snails with garlic, chili, and lime leaves as a snack after dinner is just perfect. The snail meat is crunchy, stir-fried with fragrant garlic and chili, and a hint of lime leaf aroma. Learn to cook this delicious dish; eat while inhaling the spicy aroma, especially on cold winter days.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Garlic, fish sauce, fresh chili, chili powder, sugar
cac_buoc: Here is how to make Stir-Fried Sweet Snails with Garlic, Chili, and Lime Leaves:
Step 1: Before eating, rinse the sweet snails and soak them for a few hours to let them release all the grit. Once clean, place them in a pot of water to parboil. Drain in a colander.
Step 2: Wash the lime leaves and slice them into thin threads.

Step 3: Peel the garlic, slit the chilies, and remove the seeds. Place the garlic, chili, and sugar in a mortar and pound into a fine paste. Then pour into a bowl, add fish sauce, and mix into a thick sauce.
Step 4: Place a pot on the stove, add the snails and the fish sauce mixture from step 3. Marinate for 15 minutes, then turn on the heat to cook.
Step 5: Add chili powder and sautéed garlic. Cook over high heat for about 7 minutes, stirring constantly so the snails absorb the seasoning.
Step 6: Turn off the heat, sprinkle a few lime leaves on top, stir well with chopsticks, and serve hot. Thus, the stir-fried sweet snails with garlic, chili, and lime leaves are complete.

mon_an.ten: Ốc Om Chuối Đậu (Snail Stew with Green Bananas and Tofu)
mon_an.mo_ta: Ốc om chuối đậu is a familiar dish for many families due to its delicious flavor. The bananas are soft and starchy, the tofu is crispy yet chewy, the pork belly is attractive, and the snails are crunchy. Add a bit of broth and you have an unbeatable meal. Check out how to cook snail stew with green bananas and pork belly!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Green onions, perilla leaves, turmeric, shallots, seasoning - ingredients
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare ingredients
Trim the roots and damaged leaves from the green onions and perilla, wash them under running water, and chop finely.
Peel the green bananas and soak them in a bowl of water to remove the sap.
Extract the snail meat from the shells, wash thoroughly, and rub with salt in a separate bowl. Rub the salt carefully to remove all the slime so the snails will be tastier and more fragrant.
Step 2: Fry the tofu.

Fry the white tofu until golden brown on both sides, then cut into square pieces. If you want it crispier, cut the tofu into bite-sized pieces first, then deep-fry them, making sure to flip the pieces so they cook evenly and have a beautiful crust.

Step 3: Wash the pork belly and cut into thick strips. Stir-fry the pork until the edges are slightly charred for better flavor, then add the bananas and sauté together for 5-7 minutes until the bananas soften.
Step 4: Next, add the snails to the pan to sauté, then season to taste. Once the snails are firm, pour in enough water to cover the surface. Turn the heat to medium to simmer.

Step 5: When the bananas are nearly tender, add the tofu to simmer along. You can add more seasoning to suit your taste. Also, remember to add a little turmeric powder to give the dish a more attractive color. To make the dish more fragrant and appealing, you can add a little fermented rice (mẻ), but be careful to only add a small amount.

Step 6: When the pot is cooked and the broth is bubbling, add the green onions and perilla leaves and cook for another 2-3 minutes, then turn off the heat. Avoid overcooking the herbs until they are mushy.
Finally, ladle the stew into a bowl and enjoy while hot.
Notes for a delicious snail stew with green bananas:
How to choose snails:
Apple snails (also known as ốc nhồi): the shell is blackish, shiny, without stripes, the spire is prominent and evenly spiraled, and the shell is hard.
Choose live snails: when you touch the operculum (trapdoor), the snail should retract it deep inside.

Dead snails have a foul smell and the operculum is recessed deep inside. You can also test for dead snails by dropping them into a bowl of water; if the tail floats upward and it feels light, it is dead and should be discarded.
Cleaning snails:
Soak in rice water: Use rice-washing water to soak the snails for 2-3 hours; the snails will release slime and dirt into the water. Then just rinse the snails several times with clean water.
Soak with a knife: Drop a small metal knife into the soaking water. The smell of the metal in the water stimulates the snails to release mud and dirt faster and more thoroughly.
You can also soak snails in water mixed with vinegar and minced fresh chili for 2-3 hours. However, snails soaked this way should be processed immediately to maintain their freshness.

mon_an.ten: Phở Gà Trộn (Soy Sauce Shredded Chicken Phở)
mon_an.mo_ta: Phở gà trộn with soy sauce – full of attractive and delicious flavors. Let's find out how to make this dish through the content below! Our cooking guide for Soy Sauce Shredded Chicken Phở.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning - Salt, fish sauce, sugar, garlic, dark soy sauce, soy sauce, red vinegar
Herbs - Green onions, cilantro, basil, Vietnamese coriander
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the ginger and pat dry. Then lightly roast the shallots and ginger over an open flame. Wash the chicken and pluck any remaining pinfeathers. Place the chicken in a pot, add the roasted ginger and shallots, and 1 tbsp salt. Bring to a boil, skimming the foam occasionally to keep the broth clear.

Step 2: Peel and mince the garlic, fry until fragrant, then remove to a small bowl. Blanch the phở noodles in boiling water until soft, rinse with cold water, then drain in a colander. Drizzle a bit of the fried garlic and oil over the noodles to prevent sticking.
Step 3: Coarsely crush the roasted peanuts. Mix the soy sauce dressing: 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp dark soy sauce, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 tsp red vinegar, and a bit of fried garlic. Stir the mixture well.
Step 4: Once the chicken is cooked, remove it and place it in a bowl of cold water so the skin stays crunchy, then chop into bite-sized pieces or shred by hand.
Step 5: Season the broth to taste, ladle some into a bowl, and sprinkle with green onions and cilantro.

Step 6: To serve, place the noodles in a bowl, add the chicken, drizzle with fried garlic, add roasted peanuts, green onions, and cilantro. Pour over some of the prepared soy sauce mixture and serve with bean sprouts, lime, chili, fresh herbs, and the bowl of broth on the side.

mon_an.ten: Phở Trộn Sốt Me (Tamarind Sauce Mixed Phở)
mon_an.mo_ta: If you've ever loved stir-fried phở, you might change your mind after eating this tamarind mixed phở. This is a suitable dish for those who like sweet and sour flavors for a quick lunch. Let's start learning how to cook this delicious dish right away. Mixed phở is a low-fat dish because it isn't stir-fried or deep-fried, and it still retains the chewy and soft texture of the noodles. Combined with sweet and sour tamarind sauce, you'll surely be addicted to this easy-to-make delicacy.
cac_buoc: Let's get started with the daily delicious cooking guide!
Step 1: After buying dried tamarind from the supermarket, cut a small block and soak it in a bowl of very hot water to dissolve.
Step 2: Thinly slice the beef and marinate with minced garlic, salt, and a bit of oil to give the meat a nice color.
Step 3: At this step, separate the phở noodle strands so they are loose; they will taste better when mixed.

Step 4: Set a pot of water to blanch the bean sprouts. You should put the sprouts in while the water is cold, then turn off the heat and remove them as soon as the water boils. If you like them crunchier, you can soak them in cool boiled water for a while before draining.
We're halfway through cooking the tamarind mixed phở for sweet and sour fans, let's continue:
Step 5: Use a strainer to filter the tamarind water. To filter more thoroughly, use a spoon to press down gently so the tamarind pulp passes through the strainer; this will make the sauce thicker.

Step 6: Add minced garlic and 1 tbsp butter to a pan and sauté until fragrant. Then pour in the tamarind water. Be sure to add salt and sugar to taste. If you want the sauce thicker, add a little cornstarch or tapioca starch.
Step 7: When the sauce has boiled for about 1 minute, quickly turn off the heat and add the phở noodles, tossing them to absorb the sauce.
Step 8: Now it's time to stir-fry the beef until cooked.
Step 9: It's time to present the dish. Place the noodles in a bowl and top with some boiled bean sprouts. Then add the beef and Mexican mint. The dish is now complete.

mon_an.mo_ta: Shrimp Salad – a refreshing dish to serve with noodles and a great choice for a summer dinner. You can grill or sauté the shrimp with butter instead of boiling them to give the salad a richer and more unique flavor! Here is how to make Shrimp Salad.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Ginger, lime, chili, fish sauce, sugar
cac_buoc: Prepare the sauce: Combine fish sauce, sugar, chili, garlic, and ginger in a small pot. Turn on high heat and stir the mixture until the sugar is completely dissolved. Strain through a sieve to remove the solids, then squeeze in the lime juice.

Prepare the vegetables: Wash the herbs, bean sprouts, cucumber, and carrots. Peel and slice the onion, shallots, and garlic. Shred the cucumber and carrots into strips. Mix all the vegetables together, then pour the sauce over and toss well.

Clean the shrimp, peel, and remove the black veins. You can sauté, grill, or simply boil the shrimp until cooked. Arrange the vegetables on a plate, place the shrimp on top, and garnish with mint leaves for an attractive look.
Source: Kenh14

mon_an.mo_ta: Braised pork ribs with pineapple is a perfect dish for summer meals, offering a refreshing sweet and sour flavor. Learn to cook this simple yet delicious dish with our guide. Check out the recipe now!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Green onions, salt, fish sauce, sugar, dried shallots
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Cut the ribs into pieces, wash thoroughly, then place in cold water and bring to a boil. Remove the ribs and wash away any impurities.
Peel the pineapple, remove the eyes, and cut into large chunks so they don't break apart too much during braising.
Step 2: Boil the ribs a second time for about 15 - 20 minutes until the meat starts to pull away from the bone.
Step 3: Transfer the ribs to another pot, add chopped shallots, caramel sauce, and pineapple. Season with 2 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp salt, and a bit of the rib broth.

Step 4: Simmer the ribs until they absorb the flavors, then adjust the seasoning to taste. Chop some green onions to sprinkle over the dish and turn off the heat. Serve hot with rice for a delicious meal.

mon_an.mo_ta: Coca-Cola glazed pork ribs – a unique sweet and savory dish perfect for a family meal. To make this dish delicious, follow the instructions below! Learn how to cook Coca-Cola glazed pork ribs.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the ribs with salt water, rinse again with fresh water, and drain. Marinate the ribs with 1 tbsp seasoning powder, 2 tbsp fish sauce, and shallot juice (crush the shallots to extract the juice and discard the pulp).
Step 2: Marinate the ribs for about 15 minutes to let the flavors penetrate. Peel the onion, wash, and cut into medium wedges.

Step 3: Place a heavy-bottomed pan on the stove and add the ribs. Stir until the surface of the meat is seared and dry; note that you do not need to add cooking oil. Once the ribs are seared, pour in the Coca-Cola. Turn the heat to high until it boils, then reduce to a simmer, stirring occasionally so the ribs absorb the liquid.

Step 4: Simmer until the liquid in the pot has completely evaporated, then adjust the seasoning to taste. Add the onions to sauté together, turn the heat to high, and stir the ribs constantly. Add a little oil and toss well to give the ribs an attractive glossy finish, then turn off the heat. If you like the onions softer, you can add them a bit earlier before turning off the stove.

mon_an.ten: Vegetable Soup with Pork Paste Balls
mon_an.mo_ta: Vegetable soup with pork paste balls (Canh Mọc) uses easy-to-find ingredients and a simple method, yet the flavor is incredibly delicious and satisfying. This refreshing soup provides fiber and nutrition from fresh vegetables and savory pork balls, all in a naturally sweet broth that you'll never tire of. This article will guide you through the process.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Soak the shiitake mushrooms in warm water until they expand, then rinse several times and trim off the stems to remove any odor.
Boil the quail eggs and peel them. You can add a pinch of salt to the boiling water to make peeling easier.
Cut the broccoli into small, bite-sized florets and wash thoroughly.
Peel the kohlrabi and carrots, wash them, carve into flower shapes (optional), and slice thinly.
Peel the ginger, wash, and slice thinly.
Trim the roots and wilted leaves from the green onions and cilantro, wash, and chop finely.
Step 2: Cooking steps
First, mix the raw pork paste thoroughly with a bit of pepper.
Next, stuff the pork paste into the caps of the shiitake mushrooms. Be careful not to overstuff or make them too large, as it won't look as nice.
Place the pot of bone broth on the stove, add a bit of ginger and green onion, bring to a boil, then add the stuffed mushrooms. Boil for about 5 – 6 minutes, then remove the pork balls.
Next, add the carrots and boil for 4 – 5 minutes, then add the kohlrabi, broccoli, and quail eggs. Adjust the seasoning to taste.
Finally, scoop the cooked vegetables into a bowl, add the cooked pork balls, pour the broth over, and enjoy!
Tips for a delicious soup:
You can buy raw pork paste at the market or supermarket, or make it yourself by finely grinding lean pork.

If you are not eating the soup immediately, you should boil the vegetables and pork balls separately. When ready to serve, arrange the vegetables, pork balls, and quail eggs in a bowl and pour the hot broth over to prevent the vegetables from becoming mushy.
If the soup will be eaten immediately after cooking, you can cook the vegetables and pork balls together to make the broth sweeter.
Besides the stuffing method, you can also finely chop wood ear mushrooms and shiitake mushrooms, mix them with the pork paste, roll them into small balls, and boil them similarly.

mon_an.ten: Braised Pork Belly with Bamboo Shoots
mon_an.mo_ta: Today's article will guide you on how to make braised pork belly with bamboo shoots. Following this recipe will surely make you finish your rice; the delicious, flavorful pork belly combined with the tangy taste of sour bamboo shoots is simply irresistible!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Shallots, salt, seasoning powder, pepper, sugar, coconut caramel sauce, fish sauce
cac_buoc: Step 1: Choose pork belly for the best flavor. Wash the meat, drain, and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Step 2: Peel, wash, and crush the shallots. Marinate the meat with shallots, seasoning powder, pepper, a little sugar, and coconut caramel sauce. Let it sit for 25-30 minutes to absorb the spices.
Step 3: Choose the crunchy part of the sour bamboo shoots. Trim off the tough base, wash, slice, and boil for about 5 minutes with a pinch of salt. Then remove, rinse with cold water, and drain.
Step 4: Marinate the bamboo shoots separately with a bit of seasoning and coconut caramel sauce for about 15 minutes.

Step 5: Place a pot on the stove, add the meat and stir until firm, then add the bamboo shoots and stir-fry together for 3-5 minutes. Add about 1/2 a bowl of hot water until it almost covers the meat, then season to taste.
Simmer over low heat until the meat is tender and the sauce thickens. Turn off the heat, add 1/3 tbsp of fish sauce for aroma, and adjust the seasoning one last time.
Serve the braised pork belly and bamboo shoots on a plate and enjoy hot with rice.

mon_an.mo_ta: Beef Stew with Sweet Corn – A delicious daily dish that is easy to make. The rich, savory aroma of beef combined with the sweetness of corn creates a wonderful meal. Here is how to make Beef Stew with Sweet Corn.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the beef and place it in the freezer for 15 minutes to firm up the surface, making it easier to slice. Cut the beef into bite-sized cubes and blanch them in boiling water.

Step 2: Sauté the garlic until fragrant, then add the beef and stir-fry with a pinch of salt. Add the corn and 1 small bowl of water. Be sure to add a few slices of ginger and a bit of black cardamom to the pot!
Step 3: When the water has nearly evaporated, add the chopped tomatoes and simmer until everything is tender. Serve the dish in a bowl and enjoy hot with rice.
Source: Kenh14

mon_an.ten: Beef Salad with Onion and Cucumber
mon_an.mo_ta: Beef mixed with onion and cucumber brings a refreshing change to your meal with its sweet and sour flavors. While home cooks usually stir-fry beef with onions, today we introduce this unique salad. Learn to cook this attractive beef, onion, and cucumber salad for the whole family using easy-to-find ingredients.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Wash the green chili, slit and remove seeds to reduce heat, then finely slice.
Peel and shred the cucumber.
Wash the Thai basil and herbs, soak in salt water to clean, then drain. Peel, crush, and mince the garlic.

Step 2: Peel the onion and rinse with water to reduce pungency, then slice thinly. Marinate with a bit of salt, sugar, and vinegar for 15 - 20 minutes to remove the sharp bite and make the salad delicious.
Step 3: Wash the beef, slice thinly, and marinate with some crushed garlic, minced ginger, cooking oil, and salt. Mix well.
Step 4: Stir-fry the beef until tender in a pan with hot oil. Note: do not add too much seasoning at this stage as more will be added during mixing.
Step 5: Toss the herbs, Thai basil, cucumber, and onion with the beef. Season with fish sauce, vinegar, and sugar to complete the sweet and sour Beef Salad with Onion and Cucumber.

mon_an.ten: Baked Beef Meatballs in Tomato Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: Baked beef meatballs in tomato sauce is a nutritious dish that is incredibly easy to make with simple ingredients. Fresh tender beef in a sweet and sour sauce with a pleasant aroma and eye-catching color—all blending together to create a wonderful meal. Spend some time making this delicious dish!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients for the baked beef meatballs in tomato sauce.
Wash the beef and grind or finely mince it. If you don't have a grinder, you can ask the butcher to wash and grind it for you when purchasing.
Peel the onion, rinse, and chop very finely.
Rinse the white rice until clean.
Step 2: Steps to make the baked beef meatballs in tomato sauce.
First, preheat your oven to 117 °C.

Next, place the minced or ground beef into a large bowl and add the white rice, chopped onion, ½ cup of water, black pepper, salt, and garlic powder. Mix the meat mixture thoroughly until all ingredients are well combined.
Then, use a spoon to scoop a sufficient amount of the meat mixture and roll it into a ball. Repeat with the remaining mixture until finished.
After that, brush a thin layer of cooking oil onto a baking tray to prevent sticking and arrange the meatballs on the tray. Be careful not to place them too close together to avoid sticking.
Once the meatballs are arranged, prepare the sauce.
Pour the Worcestershire sauce into a bowl, then add the tomato sauce and water, stirring until dissolved.
Next, pour the prepared sauce all over the meatballs. Cover the tray with a sheet of aluminum foil and place it in the preheated oven.
Bake the meat for about 45 minutes or until cooked through.
Then, remove the foil and check the meat; if it is not yet done, bake for another 15 minutes.
When the meatballs are cooked, transfer them to a plate and enjoy while hot.
Notes for perfect baked beef meatballs in tomato sauce:
With this method, you can substitute the beef with different types of meat like pork or chicken depending on your preference.
If you cannot find canned tomato sauce, you can simmer fresh tomatoes yourself; although it takes more time, the quality is excellent and very tasty.
When baking, keep an eye on the meat as oven calibrations vary; adjust the temperature and time to suit your specific oven. It is best to check the meat after about 30 minutes.

mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried beef with garlic chives features fragrant beef combined with the pungent flavor of chives, creating an irresistible attraction. Although the preparation is simple, it is very appealing. Let's learn how to make this delicious dish!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Minced ginger and garlic - as needed
Pepper, fish sauce, seasoning powder, cooking oil
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the beef and slice into bite-sized pieces. In a large bowl, marinate the meat with a bit of seasoning powder, a splash of fish sauce, 1 tbsp minced ginger, 1 tbsp minced garlic, and 1/2 tbsp pepper (adjust to taste).
Step 2: Wash the garlic chives and cut into sections.
Step 3: Heat cooking oil in a pan, sauté the garlic until fragrant, then add the beef to stir-fry. Once the beef is just cooked through, remove it to a plate.

Step 4: Add a little more oil to the same pan, stir-fry the garlic chives until almost cooked, then return the beef to the pan. Toss well, season to taste, and turn off the heat. Serve the Stir-fried Beef with Garlic Chives on a plate and enjoy hot with rice.
Note: Only flash-fry the chives; overcooking will make them soft and less flavorful.

mon_an.mo_ta: Honey-glazed crispy fried pork features a crunchy breaded crust and the sweet aroma of honey. It is perfect for a chilly day or served cold on a cool summer afternoon. This dish is a standout for its delicious flavor.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Green onions, salt, pepper, honey, fish sauce, chili powder
cac_buoc: Step 1: Cut the pork shoulder into 3 large pieces and rinse with water. Pat the meat dry with paper towels. Next, lightly pound the meat with a mallet or the back of a knife.
Step 2: Marinate the meat with a little salt and pepper for about 1 hour to let the flavors penetrate.
Step 3: Dredge each piece of meat in tapioca starch.
Step 4: Beat the eggs in a bowl. Dip the meat into the egg wash.
Step 5: Coat the meat thoroughly with panko breadcrumbs.
Step 6: Place a pan on the stove, add enough oil, and fry the meat until golden brown on all sides. Remove and place in a basket or on a plate lined with paper towels.
Step 7: Use a knife to slice the meat into bite-sized pieces.

Step 8: Prepare the sauce mixture: combine 2 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp fish sauce, and a bit of chili powder, then stir well. Wash and finely chop the green onions. Heat the honey mixture, then add the meat pieces and simmer until the sauce thickens. Serve hot with rice. Your Honey-Glazed Crispy Fried Pork is now complete.

mon_an.ten: Spicy Braised Chicken – Piping Hot and Delicious
mon_an.mo_ta: This traditional Korean spicy braised chicken is not only delicious due to the tender meat and natural sweetness from the vegetables but also because of the rich, flavorful sauce. Notably, this dish is quite spicy, making it perfect for cold winter days. Talented home cooks, don't hesitate to spend a little time in the kitchen to make this wonderful meal!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients for the spicy braised chicken
Peel the onions, potatoes, and carrots, wash them thoroughly with water, drain, and cut into bite-sized cubes.
Clean the green onions, remove the roots and wilted leaves, then cut into large segments.
Wash the chicken thighs thoroughly and let them drain.
Step 2: Cooking steps for the spicy braised chicken.
First, place a pot of water on the stove and bring it to a boil over high heat.
Once the water is boiling, add the chicken thighs to blanch for about 5-10 minutes, then turn off the heat and remove the chicken.
After that, rinse the chicken with cold water to clean it and firm up the meat; this also helps reduce odors and impurities.

Once the chicken is ready, take a large bowl and combine all the sauce ingredients: soy sauce, liquid sweetener, spicy chili sauce, pepper, salt, sesame oil, and minced garlic. Mix well until all ingredients are fully combined.
Next, prepare a medium-sized pot, preferably one with a thick bottom.
Layer the potatoes and carrots at the bottom of the pot, then place the chicken thighs on top along with the spicy sauce. Once prepared, cover the pot tightly and cook over high heat.
Occasionally open the lid to check the doneness of the chicken, potatoes, and carrots. If the liquid has reduced too much, you can add a little water.
Wait until everything is almost tender, then add the onions and cook for another 5 minutes. Note that you do not need to cover the pot during this stage.
Finally, season again to taste if necessary, sprinkle green onions on top, and turn off the heat.
Once the chicken is cooked, ladle the spicy braised chicken into a bowl and serve immediately while hot.
Notes for a delicious spicy braised chicken dish

You can replace the chicken thighs with other parts like breast or body depending on your preference, but thighs are best because they don't dry out when simmered and remain very tender, sweet, and fresh.
Blanching the chicken thighs helps remove any fishy odors and impurities.
When the pot reaches a rolling boil, remember to reduce the heat to prevent the sauce from drying out too quickly before it can penetrate the meat and vegetables.
Be careful not to add the onions too early to prevent them from becoming mushy or having a pungent smell.

mon_an.mo_ta: If you are familiar with stir-fried beef with pickled greens, try this stir-fried chicken version. It is incredibly delicious and offers a unique twist! Show off your cooking skills to your husband with this dish.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, sugar, fish sauce, ginger, garlic, green onions
cac_buoc: Now for the steps to cook this delicious Stir-fried Chicken with Pickled Greens.

Step 1: Wash the ginger, peel, and crush it. Peel and crush the garlic. Wash the chicken, cut into bite-sized pieces, and mix with garlic and ginger for aroma. Season with 1 small tbsp of fish sauce, a little granulated sugar, and 1 small tsp of salt; mix well.
Step 2: Rinse the pickled greens and squeeze out the sour brine. Cut into bite-sized pieces.
Step 3: Wash the zucchini, peel, remove the seeds, and slice thinly.

Step 4: Place a pan on the stove with a little cooking oil. When the oil is hot, sauté some garlic until fragrant, then add the chicken and stir-fry until cooked, drizzling in a little fish sauce. Cover the pan to let the chicken cook through and absorb the seasonings.
Step 5: Next, add the zucchini and stir-fry together, tossing gently for about 7 minutes.
Step 6: Finally, add the pickled greens and season to taste. When the Stir-fried Chicken with Pickled Greens is cooked, turn off the heat, transfer to a plate, and serve while hot.

mon_an.mo_ta: Grilled Chicken Skewers – carrying the characteristic flavors of Thailand. Learn how to cook this new dish to treat the whole family.
cac_buoc: The spices for Grilled Chicken Skewers can be purchased at Thai specialty stores or supermarkets.
Step 1: Combine soy sauce, turmeric powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, chili sauce, lime juice, and peanut sauce in a clean bowl; mix well.
Step 2: Clean the chicken breast and place it in a plastic bag. Pour the mixed marinade into the bag and shake well to coat. Refrigerate for 2 hours.
Step 3: After marinating, remove the chicken and thread onto skewers.
Step 4: Heat oil in a pan and grill the chicken evenly on both sides. When cooked, remove to a plate and serve hot with peanut sauce mixed with a squeeze of lime juice.
Source: PictureTheRecipe

mon_an.mo_ta: Braised Pork with Potatoes – rich and delicious for those looking to gain weight! Learn how to make Braised Pork with Potatoes.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the pork belly; if the skin is still on, scrape it clean. Cut the pork belly into bite-sized pieces, blanch in a pot of water to clean, then marinate with a little seasoning and let it sit to absorb.

Step 2: Sauté the ginger and finely chopped white parts of the green onions in a pot. Add the pork and stir-fry briefly, then add the potatoes. In a separate pan, combine a little sugar and tomato sauce; cook until the sugar turns a caramel color, then add it to the pot.

Step 3: Simmer over low heat until the liquid in the pot is slightly thickened and the meat is fully cooked, then sprinkle with cilantro and turn off the heat. Serve the braised pork and potatoes in a deep dish with hot rice.
Source: Kenh14

mon_an.mo_ta: Fragrant chewy grilled pork will fill your kitchen with a wonderful aroma. The meat is both flexible and chewy, with a sweet, salty, and fragrant taste just like beef jerky. Today I will introduce how to make this dish. Let's learn how to cook this delicious chewy grilled pork for your daily meals right now!
cac_buoc: Let's learn how to make chewy grilled pork!
Step 1: Grind the pork finely; if you mince it by hand, the meat will not be as smooth as when using a machine.
Step 2: Place the pork in a bowl and marinate with soy sauce, salt, sugar, pepper, and a little cooking oil for a nice sheen.
Step 3: Spread the pork evenly on aluminum foil; using a wooden rolling pin will help make it even and beautiful for a better texture.
Step 4: After spreading the meat, leave it on the foil and bake in the oven at 200°C for 15 minutes.
Step 5: Remove the meat from the oven, brush a layer of honey over it, and return it to the oven for about 7-8 minutes so the meat absorbs the honey.

mon_an.ten: Crispy Fried Pork with Pineapple Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: Crispy Fried Pork with Pineapple Sauce – featuring a crispy batter and the delicious sweet and sour taste of pineapple sauce. Learn how to make Crispy Fried Pork with Pineapple Sauce.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the pork belly and cut into bite-sized pieces. Marinate the meat with a little pepper and soy sauce for about 10 minutes, then mix with the egg white; this helps the cornstarch adhere better to the meat.
Step 2: Roll the meat through the cornstarch, applying only a very thin layer! Then, fry until golden brown.

Step 3: Wash and prepare the vegetables by cutting them into bite-sized pieces according to your family's preference. Sauté minced garlic, then add the vegetables and stir-fry with ketchup until everything is well-coated and cooked through.

Step 4: Once the meat is fried golden, remove it to a plate lined with paper towels to reduce greasiness. Then, add the meat to the pan with the vegetables and stir-fry briefly so the meat absorbs the flavors without losing its crispiness. Remember to add a little sugar, salt, and pepper to make the dish more delicious.
Source: Kenh14

mon_an.ten: Sweet and Sour Pork Tenderloin – A Perfect Rice Mate
mon_an.mo_ta: Sweet and sour pork tenderloin is a favorite dish for many people and families. Each piece of meat is fragrant with an attractive color, tender on the inside with a certain crispness on the outside, served with various vegetables. The sweet and sour taste makes the dish exciting and stimulates the appetite. This dish is so appealing that eating it with a bowl of hot rice might make you finish the whole pot without realizing it! Just spend a little time in the kitchen to prepare this irresistible, delicious meal.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Ketchup, rice vinegar, salt, white wine, sugar, water, cornstarch - sauce
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Wash the pork tenderloin and cut into thick slices. Add 10ml wine, 1g salt, and 2g five-spice powder; marinate for about 10 minutes to let the meat absorb the flavors and develop a nice aroma.
Step 2:
Next, crack the egg into a bowl, beat it, then add it to the marinated meat and mix well. Make sure to mix thoroughly so the meat and egg are fully combined!
Step 3:
After that, coat the meat in a layer of cornstarch.
Step 4:
Prepare a pan with hot oil. When the oil is boiling, add the meat to fry. When the outside looks slightly dry or has a light golden crust, remove the meat and drain the oil.
Step 5:
After the first fry, let the meat drain, then put it back into the pan to fry a second time until the outside is evenly golden. Double-frying helps the meat become crispier and more fragrant.
Step 6:
Next, add the chopped bell pepper and onion to the pan and stir-fry briefly to remove the pungent smell, then remove and set aside.
Then, mix all the sauce ingredients together.
Step 7:
Next, add a little oil to a pan. Once the oil is hot, add the sliced green onions and ginger, then add the ketchup and chopped pineapple to the pan as well!
Step 8:

After that, add the golden-fried meat, the sautéed bell pepper and onion, and the sauce. Season to taste and stir-fry everything together for a while until all ingredients are cooked. Turn off the heat, arrange on a plate, and enjoy.
Notes for a delicious sweet and sour pork tenderloin
Remember to wash the meat thoroughly and mix the ingredients well so the meat absorbs the flavors and removes any odors.
When frying the meat, remember to flip the pieces so they cook evenly. Do not fry for too long as it will make the meat dry and tough.
Adjust the sweet and sour levels according to your personal preference.
Besides tenderloin, you can use any part of the pork, but tenderloin provides the best texture and is less likely to be dry.

The sweet and sour taste makes the dish exciting and stimulates the appetite. This dish is so appealing that eating it with a bowl of hot rice might make you finish the whole pot without realizing it! Just spend a little time in the kitchen to prepare this irresistible, delicious meal.

mon_an.mo_ta: Baked Teriyaki Meatballs – An easy-to-make delicious dish for the whole family to enjoy Japanese flavors. Learn how to make simple and tasty Baked Teriyaki Meatballs.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Combine all the initial meatball ingredients in a large mixing bowl and mix thoroughly.
Step 2: Roll the meat into equal-sized balls. Arrange each meatball on a baking tray treated with non-stick spray or brushed with oil. Bake the meatballs at 175°C for 15 minutes until cooked through.
Step 3: Place the teriyaki sauce ingredients in a small saucepan. Turn on the stove to medium heat, stirring while cooking to dissolve the sugar. Simmer until the sauce thickens.

Step 4: After 15 minutes of baking, use a small brush to coat the meatballs with the sauce and return them to the oven for another 5–10 minutes. Serve this easy-to-make dish on a plate and enjoy hot with rice.

mon_an.mo_ta: The appeal of ribs is showcased through countless colorful dishes. Today I want to introduce a new dish: Fragrant Coffee-Glazed Grilled Ribs. This dish combines the deliciousness of grilled ribs with the enticing aroma of coffee, making it an attractive meal for the whole family to cook together.
cac_buoc: Let's start cooking this delicious dish:
Step 1: Wash the ribs with water and cut into small pieces about the size of a matchbox. Place them in a bowl and marinate with a little salt and sugar for flavor.
Step 2: Mix the coffee with hot water, 1/2 tbsp sugar, 1 tbsp cornstarch, 1 tbsp salt, and ketchup. Place a pan over low heat, pour the mixture in, and cook until thickened.
Step 3: Wash the cucumber and carrot, peel, and julienne. Marinate the carrot and cucumber with 3 tbsp sugar, 1 tbsp vinegar, and 1/2 tbsp salt to make a quick pickle.
Step 4: Preheat the oven for 10 minutes at 200°C. Arrange the ribs on a tray and bake at 170°C for 30 minutes to create the fragrant grilled ribs.
Step 5: After 30 minutes, remove the ribs from the oven. In a pan, sauté the ribs with the coffee sauce prepared in step 2. Cook until the sauce completely coats the ribs, then turn off the heat.
Step 6: Toss the pickled carrots and cucumbers again, then serve alongside the ribs.

mon_an.mo_ta: Squid is a highly nutritious seafood with a price that fits the budget of many Vietnamese families, making it an easy-to-make delicious dish. Dinner will be cozier with this fragrant, crunchy, and chewy stir-fried squid with garlic chives; it also makes a great snack for your husband.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Garlic chive flowers and leaves - 1 bunch
cac_buoc: Starting the process of cooking this delicious stir-fried squid with chives!

Step 1: Wash the squid with water to remove the fishy smell (you should thoroughly clean the inside and peel off the outer membrane if using frozen squid). Use a knife to score diagonal lines about 1cm apart. Then cut into small square pieces.
Step 2: For the chives, wash them and cut into 4cm lengths.
Step 3: Wash the bell pepper and slice into strips.
Step 4: After cutting, blanch the squid in boiling water so it opens up beautifully and doesn't fall apart during the stir-fry process later.
Step 5: Place a pan over medium heat. When the pan is hot, add cooking oil along with the ginger and shallots; sauté until fragrant. Add the squid and stir-fry over high heat.
Step 6: Add 2 tbsp of soy sauce to the pan, then add the bell pepper and chives to stir-fry together.
Your dish is almost finished; let's complete the final step!
Step 7: Toss the mixture evenly in the pan over high heat for about 1-2 minutes, then stop. Transfer to a plate and your dish is complete!

mon_an.ten: Braised Pork Belly with Straw Mushrooms
mon_an.mo_ta: Braised pork belly with mushrooms is a family favorite featuring tender pork, vibrant colors, and savory flavors combined with crunchy, aromatic straw mushrooms. You'll finish your rice in no time with this delicious dish!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fish sauce, seasoning powder, sugar, coconut caramel sauce, pepper, salt - seasonings
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the pork belly with a bit of salt to remove impurities and odors. Drain and slice into bite-sized pieces. For this dish, slice the pork slightly smaller than other braised dishes, about 2 index finger joints long.
Step 2: Peel, wash, crush, and mince the shallots. Trim the roots and wilted leaves from the green onions, wash, and thinly slice.

Step 3: Marinate the pork with a bit of seasoning powder, pepper, coconut caramel sauce, a little sugar, and the minced shallots for 15-20 minutes to let the flavors penetrate. Mix well so the meat absorbs the spices evenly and develops a beautiful color when cooked.

Step 4: Trim the stems and bruised parts of the straw mushrooms, wash, and soak in lightly salted water for about 20 minutes to keep them clean and white. If you have rice water, use it for soaking for the best results. Drain in a colander. Remember to trim the stems to remove any earthy smell.

Step 5: Once the mushrooms are prepared, place a pot on the stove and sear the pork until firm and golden brown. When the meat is seared, add about 1/2 cup of boiling water to the pot and simmer on low heat for 10-15 minutes.

Step 6: Add the straw mushrooms and stir well, braising for another 10-12 minutes so the mushrooms absorb the seasonings. Once the meat and mushrooms are cooked, turn off the heat, add the sliced green onions and 1/2 tbsp of high-quality fish sauce to make the dish more aromatic. Stir and season to taste.
Finally, serve the dish on a plate, sprinkle with a little pepper, and enjoy with hot rice!
Notes for delicious braised pork belly with straw mushrooms:
Depending on how tender you want the meat, adjust the braising time accordingly, but mushrooms should be braised for about 10 minutes to absorb the flavors while remaining sweet and crunchy.
How to choose good pork belly:
Pork belly: Choose pieces with thin skin, white fat, and plenty of meat. Select medium-sized pork rather than large, and look for firm fat rather than grainy fat.
Choose pieces with thin skin, white fat, and plenty of meat. Select medium-sized pork rather than large, and look for firm fat rather than grainy fat.
Fresh pork will have a dry outer membrane and a bright red or dark red, glossy color. If the pork is slightly pale green, bruised, or even black and dull with a slimy surface, it is not fresh.
Healthy pork usually ranges from light pink to dark red.

The meat should be firm, not mushy, with good elasticity and no leaking fluids or slime. When pressed with a finger, it should create a dent that disappears immediately when the finger is removed. The muscle fibers should be even.
The cut surface should be dry and slightly tacky; the skin should be soft, and the fat should be transparent white to slightly ivory without a rancid smell.
Good pork, when boiled, produces clear broth with large fat bubbles, smells aromatic, and has no strange odors.
Choose pieces with thin skin, fresh pink color, firm texture, a moist appearance, and no smell other than the natural scent of meat.

mon_an.ten: Soy Sauce Braised Quail Eggs for Dinner
mon_an.mo_ta: Soy sauce braised quail eggs are the perfect choice for dinner. With a unique and delicious flavor, this dish is enough to refresh your evening meal. Prepared with simple ingredients like quail eggs, garlic, shallots, red chili, oil, and basic seasonings, you will have an aromatic dish in no time. Let's cook this attractive soy sauce braised quail egg dish for dinner following this easy recipe. A simple and tasty guide for a meal with family and friends!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Boil the eggs
Prepare a pot large enough so the eggs are fully submerged. Place the pot on the stove and bring the water to a boil.
Once the water is boiling, gently place the eggs into the pot. Ensure the water covers the top of the eggs.
Start timing and boil the eggs for 10 minutes from the moment the water returns to a boil.
Once the eggs are cooked, turn off the heat and discard the hot water. Keep the eggs in the pot, rinse with cold water to clean off any residue.
Next, soak the eggs in cold water until completely cooled before peeling.
By following these steps, you will have perfectly boiled, clean eggs that are easy to peel.
Step 2: Fry the quail eggs
First, place a non-stick pan on the stove and heat it up. Once the pan is hot, add enough oil to submerge the eggs.
Place the eggs in the pan and fry until they are evenly golden brown. Then, remove the eggs and place them on paper towels to absorb excess oil.
Note: Pat the eggs dry with a paper towel before frying to prevent oil splattering and burns.
Step 3: Braise the quail eggs in soy sauce
Dissolve cornstarch in ½ cup of filtered water. Then, add ketchup, soy sauce, dark soy sauce, oyster sauce, sugar, and salt, stirring until the mixture is uniform.
Place a new pan on the stove and add oil. Sauté the minced shallots and garlic in the hot oil until fragrant.
Next, pour the sauce mixture into the pan and bring to a boil.
Add the quail eggs to the pan and stir well until the sauce thickens.
Finally, turn off the heat; the sweet and savory braised quail eggs are finished.
After these steps, you will have an attractive and flavorful soy sauce braised quail egg dish ready to enjoy.
Notes when making soy sauce braised quail eggs
When making this dish, here are some important notes to consider:
Choose fresh quail eggs: Ensure you select fresh eggs for the best flavor.
Check the shells: Before boiling, check the shells for cracks. If cracked, discard them to prevent water from seeping into the egg.
Peel carefully: When peeling the eggs after boiling, do it carefully to avoid damaging the shape. You can peel them under cold water to make it easier.
Dry the eggs before frying: Ensure the eggs are patted dry with a paper towel or clean cloth before frying to avoid oil splatters.
Heat the oil sufficiently: When frying, heat the oil to the right temperature so the eggs cook evenly and develop an attractive golden color.
Safety when frying: Always pay attention to safety. Avoid overheating the oil and use a non-stick pan to prevent sticking.
Stir evenly: During the cooking process, stir the eggs in the sauce frequently to ensure they absorb the flavors and sauce evenly.
Season to taste: Adjust seasonings like salt, sugar, soy sauce, oyster sauce, and ketchup according to your preference to create a rich and delicious flavor.

mon_an.mo_ta: Quail eggs in tamarind sauce is an easy-to-make, delicious dish with a pleasant sweet and sour taste. Learn how to cook this tasty Quail Eggs in Tamarind Sauce dish.
cac_buoc: Let's make this delicious Quail Eggs in Tamarind Sauce:
Step 1:
Place the quail eggs in a pot of cold water and boil until cooked.
Once cooked, transfer the eggs to a bowl of cold water to cool, then peel them clean.
Step 2: Place a pan on the stove, add a generous amount of oil, and when the oil is very hot, fry the quail eggs until golden brown.
Step 3: Prepare the tamarind sauce:
Place the tamarind in a separate bowl, pour in a little hot water to dissolve it, then strain to get the juice.
To the tamarind juice, add a little soy sauce, sugar, minced garlic, and a bit of chili. Season to taste.

Step 4: Add oil to a pot, sauté the ginger until fragrant, then pour in the mixture from Step 3. Bring to a boil, then add the fried quail eggs. Simmer until the sauce thickens, then turn off the heat. This dish should be served hot with rice.
Note: If you want the sauce to be thicker, you can add a little tapioca starch, cornstarch, or arrowroot powder slurry after the eggs have absorbed the sauce.

mon_an.ten: Sweet and Sour Stir-fried Quail Eggs with Wood Ear Mushrooms
mon_an.mo_ta: Quail eggs are used in many dishes, but stir-frying them with wood ear mushrooms in a sweet and sour sauce is a unique and novel combination. With crunchy wood ear mushrooms and rich quail eggs blended in a sweet and sour sauce, this dish will delight you from the first bite. It is especially quick for busy people. Enjoy the crunchy texture and rich flavor in this fast meal for busy days.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Vinegar, soy sauce, cooking oil, rice wine, broth, seasonings
cac_buoc: 1. Ingredient preparation
Quail eggs:
Wash 10 quail eggs and drain.
Boil the eggs in a pot of water until cooked.
After boiling, remove and drain.
Green and red bell peppers:
Wash 1 green bell pepper and 1 red bell pepper.
Cut the peppers in half lengthwise.
Remove the seeds and stems.
Next, cut the peppers into bite-sized pieces.
Wood ear mushrooms:
Wash 10 pieces of wood ear mushrooms.
Use a knife to cut them into bite-sized pieces.
Green onions:
Wash the green onions and cut into short segments.
Ginger and garlic:
Peel the ginger and garlic.
Wash them.
Mince the ginger and garlic into a fine mixture.
Cornstarch:
Prepare a small amount of cornstarch.
Vinegar, soy sauce, oil, rice wine, broth, seasonings:
Prepare a large bowl.
Pour the vinegar, soy sauce, oil, rice wine, broth, and other seasonings into the bowl and mix well.
2. Cooking the stir-fry
Step 1: Wash and boil the quail eggs. Then, remove, drain, and fry until golden brown on all sides in a pan with oil.
Step 2: Prepare other ingredients by washing and cutting the bell peppers and wood ear mushrooms into bite-sized pieces. Clean and mince the ginger and garlic.
Step 3: Mix the ginger, garlic, vinegar, rice wine, soy sauce, salt, sugar, and seasoning powder in a large bowl.

Step 4: Heat a little oil in a pan. Add the mixture from Step 3 and stir well. Next, add the bell peppers, wood ear mushrooms, and quail eggs to the pan, stir-frying until cooked. Dissolve a little cornstarch in water and pour it into the pan, stirring until the ingredients are coated in a thick sauce.
Step 5: Sprinkle green onions into the pan and stir for about 5-7 minutes. Season again to taste and then turn off the heat.
The process of making sweet and sour stir-fried quail eggs with wood ear mushrooms is now complete. Enjoy your meal!
Notes when making this dish:
Quail eggs: Choose fresh eggs that are not cracked. Wash before boiling for hygiene. Boil until cooked, but do not overcook to avoid drying them out.
Wood ear mushrooms: Select fresh mushrooms without any foul odor or wilting. Wash thoroughly before prepping.
Bell peppers: Choose fresh green and red peppers with vibrant colors. Remove seeds and stems before use.
Ginger and garlic: Choose fresh ginger and garlic. Peel, wash, and mince finely.
Cornstarch: Used to thicken the sauce. Dissolve in water before adding to the pan to avoid lumps.
Pan: Use a heavy-bottomed, heat-resistant pan to prevent burning and ensure even heat distribution.
Stir-fry order: Sauté the aromatics and other ingredients before adding the eggs and mushrooms. Ensure everything is well mixed.
Seasoning: Adjust salt, sugar, and other seasonings to your personal taste. Be careful not to add too much to maintain the sweet and sour balance.
Cooking time: Stir-fry long enough for the eggs and mushrooms to be heated through, but not so long that they become dry.

mon_an.mo_ta: Homemade Rice Pizza – an appealing twist where familiar rice becomes an irresistible pizza slice. Learn how to make this creative Homemade Rice Pizza.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Take the cooked rice, shape into rounds, and flatten them to about 1cm thick. Spread tomato sauce on one side of the rice base.
Step 2: Place thinly sliced cheese on top, followed by the corn, onion, and celery.
Step 3: Sprinkle another layer of cheese on top. For the top layer, you should use finely shredded cheese so that it melts evenly and looks better when baked.
Step 4: Finally, place the rice pizza in the oven and bake for 6-8 minutes at 200°C.
Remove from the tray and eat while hot so the rice remains crispy and aromatic.
Source: Xinhxinh

mon_an.ten: Stewed Duck with Lotus Seeds – A Healthy Dish for Diabetics
mon_an.mo_ta: Stewed duck with lotus seeds is an incredibly nutritious dish, especially beneficial for those with diabetes. The duck meat is tender and melts in your mouth, paired with nutty lotus seeds, fragrant shiitake mushrooms, and a naturally sweet, flavorful broth. This delicious meal with its appealing colors is sure to delight you! High in protein and fiber, it is an excellent choice for health-conscious diners looking to help manage blood sugar levels.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Shallots, garlic, seasonings, broth mix, soy sauce, pepper, salt, cooking wine - as needed
cac_buoc: 1. Prepare the ingredients
First, clean the duck thoroughly and rub it gently with salt, wine, or ginger to remove any gamey odor. Then, chop the meat into bite-sized pieces.

Next, rinse the other ingredients with water. Before stewing, blanch the lotus roots and lotus seeds in boiling water to ensure they cook quickly without falling apart. Peel the carrots and carve them into flower shapes. Thinly slice the green onions for garnish.
2. Cooking process
Step 1: Sauté the meat and ingredients

Heat a pot or pan and add a little cooking oil. Add the duck meat and stir-fry until it turns a light golden brown. Next, add the carrots, lotus seeds, and lotus roots to the pot and sauté together for a few minutes.
Step 2: Stew the duck and lotus seeds

Pour in enough water to just cover the ingredients. Add salt, sugar, fish sauce, and pepper to taste. Cover the pot and simmer over low heat for about 1-1.5 hours until the duck is tender and the aroma fills the room.
Step 3: Final touches
Once the duck is cooked, add the eggs to the pot and cook for a few more minutes until the eggs are done. Before turning off the heat, add the green onions and stir well.
Step 4: Enjoy
Tips for a delicious stewed duck with lotus seeds
1. How to choose good duck meat

When buying duck, choose mature, plump ducks with a round breast, thick neck and belly skin, and full plumage (the tips of the wings should just cross over each other). These ducks are easier to clean and take less time to pluck.
Avoid young ducks as the meat will be soft and not firm, and plucking the downy feathers will be time-consuming. Young ducks usually have large, soft beaks. Older ducks have smaller, harder beaks.

Ducks that have laid many eggs also have fragrant meat; these usually have a sagging lower belly. Unlike chicken, if you want flavorful duck meat, choose a male duck as they generally taste better than females.
To check the duck's health, check the vent area; it should be clean and free of discharge, indicating the bird is healthy.
2. Cooking notes
Simmer on low heat: Ensure you stew the duck on low heat so the food has time to cook through without burning or drying out.
Keep the lid closed: When stewing, keep the lid tightly closed to retain moisture and preserve the flavors inside.
Check the water level: Make sure there is enough liquid to cover the ingredients. If necessary, add more water if the pot starts to run dry.
Check for doneness: Regularly check the tenderness of the duck by piercing the meat with a skewer. If the skewer goes in easily with no resistance, the meat is done.
Adjust seasoning: If needed, you can adjust the seasonings during the stewing process. Taste and add salt, sugar, fish sauce, or pepper according to your preference.
Keep warm: Once the duck is cooked, keep it warm by leaving the pot on the stove over very low heat or using a warming tray.

mon_an.mo_ta: Duck is a nutrient-rich food that is great for your health. Learn how to cook this delicious Five-Spice Braised Duck for the whole family to enjoy. This dish features the aromatic scent of five-spice powder, ginger, and lemongrass—perfect when served with a bowl of hot rice during the chilly weather of Hanoi.
cac_buoc: Start your cooking journey with this delicious Five-Spice Braised Duck for the whole family!
