Step 1: Peel the garlic and shallots, then crush and mince them. For the lemongrass, take 2 stalks and shred them lengthwise; thinly slice the remaining 3 stalks.

Step 2: Clean the duck and cut into bite-sized pieces. Marinate with ½ tbsp sugar, ½ tbsp broth mix, 1 tbsp fish sauce, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 packet of five-spice powder, the minced shallots and garlic, and the sliced lemongrass. Mix well and let it marinate for 30 minutes.
Step 3: Heat cooking oil in a pan. Once hot, add the shallots, garlic, and shredded lemongrass. Sauté until fragrant, then add the duck meat and stir-fry until the meat is firm and seared.
Step 4: Transfer the duck to a pot, add water, and simmer until the meat is tender. Continue cooking until the sauce thickens, then turn off the heat.
The Five-Spice Braised Duck is now complete. Enjoy a cozy dinner with this flavorful dish!

mon_an.ten: Vịt nấu giả cầy – A Unique and Savory Delight
mon_an.mo_ta: Vịt nấu giả cầy is a simple yet enticing dish with a very distinctive flavor profile. The duck meat is tender and rich, featuring crispy yet chewy skin in a thick, savory sauce infused with the fragrant aroma of galangal—perfect for cold days. With just a little time in the kitchen, you will have a wonderful meal to treat your family and friends!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings - turmeric powder, shrimp paste, sugar, fish sauce, salt, broth mix
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients for Vịt nấu giả cầy:
Clean the duck with salt, then rub lemon juice on the outside and inside. Remove all downy feathers. Crush the ginger, mix with salt, and rub it over the duck's body until the gamey odor is gone.
Lightly grill the duck over charcoal. If charcoal is unavailable, you can use an oven or a gas stove grill rack until the skin is slightly charred and aromatic.
Peel and wash the galangal, then pound it finely.
Peel and mince the garlic.
Steps to make Vịt nấu giả cầy:
Step 1:
Chop the grilled duck into bite-sized pieces.
Step 2:

Once the duck is chopped, marinate it with 1 tbsp pounded galangal, ½ tbsp minced garlic, 3 tbsp fermented rice (mẻ), 1 tbsp salt, 1 tbsp shrimp paste, 1 tsp turmeric powder, and 3 tsp broth mix. Mix the duck thoroughly with the seasonings and let it marinate for 30 minutes to 1 hour.
Step 3:

Place a pot on the stove over high heat. Add 1 tbsp cooking oil and heat until shimmering, then sauté ½ tbsp minced garlic until fragrant. Add the duck meat and stir-fry until the meat is firm, then pour in enough water to barely cover the meat. Cover the pot and simmer over low heat until the meat is tender.

Note: When the liquid has reduced and turned a golden, thick consistency, taste and adjust the seasoning. Add another 1 tbsp of minced galangal to maintain its signature aroma and stir well. Add ½ tsp sugar for a subtle sweetness and continue cooking until the sauce is thick and glossy.
Cook the duck for about 30 minutes or until the meat is very tender.
Step 4:
Finally, turn off the heat, ladle the meat into a bowl, garnish with fresh herbs, and serve hot with rice or rice vermicelli.
Tips for a delicious Vịt nấu giả cầy
To cook a great pot of Vịt giả cầy, choose a mature, plump duck with a round breast and thick skin. Clean the duck with salt and ginger wine to eliminate odors and enhance the fragrance.
If possible, singe the duck with straw until the skin is golden and slightly charred; this gives the meat a rustic straw-smoked aroma.
For a sweeter and more flavorful broth, you can use coconut water instead of filtered water.

The dish is successful when the duck is tender but not falling apart, the skin is not too tough, and the meat is fragrant with galangal, fermented rice, and shrimp paste. If serving with vermicelli, you can season it slightly saltier.

Vịt nấu giả cầy is a simple yet attractive dish. The meat is tender and fatty, the skin is crispy and chewy, and the overall aroma is unmistakable. This hot, rich dish is perfect for cold weather. Spend a little time in the kitchen to create this wonderful treat for your loved ones!

mon_an.ten: Stir-fried Winter Melon with Shrimp and Pork
mon_an.mo_ta: Winter melon is a food known for its ability to cleanse the body and improve skin health. Let's add Stir-fried Winter Melon with Shrimp and Pork to our daily menu! Let's learn how to make this dish together!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Cooking oil, fish sauce, broth mix, ginger, green onions - as needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel the winter melon, wash, and slice into thin pieces. Wash and mince the ginger.
Step 2: Wash the lean pork and slice thinly. Wash the shrimp, peel (leaving the tails on), and remove the black veins.

Step 3: Stir-fry the pork until almost cooked, then add the shrimp. Once the shrimp turn opaque, add the winter melon and ginger. Stir-fry until the melon is coated in oil and softened, then season with fish sauce and broth mix to taste. Add green onions and turn off the heat.
Step 4: Arrange the Stir-fried Winter Melon with Shrimp and Pork on a plate and enjoy.

mon_an.ten: Secrets to Extra Crispy Fried Chicken Patties
mon_an.mo_ta: While this dish may seem familiar, not everyone knows the secret to making fried chicken patties that are truly fragrant and super crunchy. Check out the tips below to make your dish even better!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Wash, peel, and finely mince the carrots and ginger.
Step 2:
Finely mince the chicken breast.
Step 3:
Mix the carrots and ginger thoroughly with the minced chicken.
Step 4:
Place the mixture in a large bowl. Add 1 egg white, salt, pepper, and a small teaspoon of cooking oil. Use chopsticks to mix all ingredients together well.
Step 5:
Prepare 3 small bowls: one with breadcrumbs, one with cornstarch, and one with a beaten egg.
Shape the chicken mixture into small patties or balls, then dredge them through the cornstarch, dip in the egg, and finally coat with breadcrumbs.
Step 6:
Heat oil in a pan. Once hot, add the chicken patties and fry until golden brown.
Step 7:
Remove the chicken and drain well on paper towels.
Prepare a side of chili sauce, ketchup, and mayonnaise for dipping!
The golden, crispy chicken mixed with vegetables looks so appetizing!
You can enjoy these with rice or as a standalone snack.

mon_an.mo_ta: This crispy fried basa fish features a stunning golden-brown crust that is incredibly crunchy and fragrant, while the fish inside remains sweet and tender. It is perfect when dipped in spicy chili sauce. This dish will be a hit with the whole family, especially for children who are picky eaters or usually dislike fish!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Pepper, chili powder, salt, hoisin sauce - Seasonings
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients for the crispy fried basa fish.
Rinse the basa fillets, pat dry, and cut into bite-sized squares.
Crack the eggs into a bowl and beat well.
Step 2: Cooking steps for the crispy fried basa fish.
First, marinate the basa with pepper, chili powder, and a pinch of salt. Sprinkle the seasonings evenly on both sides of the fish.
Next, brush a layer of hoisin sauce onto both sides of the fish.
Let the fish marinate for 10-15 minutes to absorb the flavors, making the meat more fragrant and savory.
After marinating, take a piece of fish and dredge it in the flour, turning it over to ensure a thick coating.
Next, dip the fish into the beaten eggs and quickly transfer it to the bowl of breadcrumbs. Ensure the breadcrumbs coat the fish evenly for a crispy crust when fried.
Repeat this process until all the fish is coated.
Next, place a pan on the stove and heat a generous amount of cooking oil. You should use enough oil to submerge the fish slightly so it becomes crispy without absorbing too much grease.
When the oil is hot, drop each piece of fish in to fry until golden.
Let one side turn completely golden before flipping to fry the second side. Remember to flip occasionally to prevent burning!
Once cooked, remove the fish and drain on a wire rack, then pat with paper towels to remove any excess oil.
Finally, arrange the fish on a plate and enjoy with chili sauce, hot sauce, or sweet and sour fish sauce. Eat while hot to maintain the best flavor and crunch.
Tips for perfect crispy fried basa fish:
To make this dish delicious, use fresh basa instead of frozen basa for better sweetness and food safety.
You can also substitute basa with other boneless white fish like tilapia or mackerel.
Additionally, you can use panko breadcrumbs instead of regular breadcrumbs for extra crunch.

A small tip for frying: instead of a pan, you can use a small rice cooker. Since the rice cooker is deep, you can use plenty of oil to let the fish float and brown evenly. This also helps the fish stay very crispy and less greasy.

This crispy fried basa fish features a stunning golden-brown crust that is incredibly crunchy and fragrant, while the fish inside remains sweet and tender. It is perfect when dipped in spicy chili sauce. This dish will be a hit with the whole family, especially for children who are picky eaters or usually dislike fish!

mon_an.mo_ta: With just a few simple steps, you can make this savory braised pork with fish sauce and sate. It is rich, slightly spicy, and incredibly appetizing with rice.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 700 g pork belly, choose a slightly fatty cut
200 g dried shrimp; 2 tbsp minced garlic; 2 shallots, thinly sliced; 1 tbsp sate sauce; a few chili peppers (to taste); 3 scallion whites
3 tbsp brown sugar (60 g), 5 tbsp high-quality fish sauce, 3 tbsp water mixed together in a bowl
cac_buoc: Step 1: Soak the dried shrimp in warm water for about 20 minutes, then drain.
Step 2: Rinse the pork, remove the skin, and cut into bite-sized pieces. Marinate the pork with a pinch of salt.
Step 3: Place the pork in a pan over medium-low heat. Stir-fry until the fat begins to render. At this point, add the garlic and shallots and sauté for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Next, add the dried shrimp and the fish sauce mixture. Braise over low heat for 10-15 minutes until the pork absorbs the flavors.
Finally, add the sate sauce, chili, and scallions. Continue to braise for another 5-7 minutes until the pork develops a beautiful, glossy color. Season to taste and turn off the heat.
The braised pork with sate is savory, glossy, and has an attractive golden-brown color.
Transfer the braised pork to a bowl or a heat-retaining pot. Enjoy with steamed rice, or use it as a dip for scorched rice (cơm cháy), sticky rice, or boiled vegetables.

mon_an.mo_ta: Crispy Fried Beef Rolls – A delicious daily dish that is crunchy on the outside with a fragrant beef aroma and a soft tofu filling. Here is how to make Crispy Fried Beef Rolls.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Soak the shiitake mushrooms until soft, rinse, and dice. Peel the carrot and dice it as well. Rinse and finely chop the scallions.
Step 2: Blanch the tofu in boiling water, then mash it with a spoon. Sauté the carrots, mushrooms, and scallions in a pan, then add the mashed tofu and season with 1/2 tsp salt and 1/2 tsp pepper.

Step 3: Rinse the beef and place it in the freezer for 10 minutes before slicing thinly. If you cannot slice it thin enough, slice it slightly thicker and use a meat mallet to gently pound it so the beef rolls are thin without tearing. Roll the beef around the sautéed tofu filling.
Step 4: Once rolled, dredge each roll in flour to dry, then dip into the beaten egg, and finally coat with breadcrumbs. Fry in a pan with hot oil until golden brown.
Step 5: Once the beef rolls are golden, remove them to a plate lined with paper towels. Sauté the Tonkin jasmine flowers to serve alongside this dish to balance the richness.
Source: Kenh14

mon_an.ten: Beef Carpaccio with Lime and Onions
mon_an.mo_ta: Beef carpaccio with lime and onions is a unique dish that combines the sweetness of tender fresh beef with the refreshing, sour flavors of lime and onions. The method is very simple, perfect for beginners exploring the culinary arts. Let's discover how to make this simple yet delicious beef carpaccio through the article below! This dish combines the savory taste of rare beef with the freshness of lime and onions. You only need a few simple steps to create this attractive dish. It is not only delicious but also very nutritious.
cac_buoc: How to make beef carpaccio for a family of 4
Rinse the beef and slice it into thin, wide pieces.
Squeeze the limes and strain for juice.
Thinly slice the onion.
Mince the garlic and chili.
Crush the roasted peanuts.
Next:
Place the beef in a bowl with the lime juice and toss well so the lime juice penetrates the meat.
The beef will "cook" in the acid after 3 hours; stir the beef once every hour to ensure even contact with the lime juice. It is ready when the beef is no longer red and has turned opaque.
After 3 hours, drain off the lime juice. Add 3 tsp salt, 2 tsp sugar, and a bit of pepper.
Add the onion, garlic, and chili, then toss well with the beef.
Add the roasted peanuts to the bowl and mix thoroughly.
The delicious beef carpaccio is now complete.
The sweetness of the beef combined with the sourness of the lime creates an incredibly attractive flavor for the whole family to enjoy.
How to buy fresh beef
Color and condition: Prioritize beef that is bright red, not pale green or dark red. The grain should be soft and small, not too fine.
Firmness and elasticity: Gently press the beef with your finger. Fresh beef will be firm and elastic, not sticky to the touch. Furthermore, fresh meat should not have an unpleasant or unusual odor.
Fat and white spots: Avoid buying beef with dark yellow fat. Also, limit buying pieces that have white spots on the muscle fibers. When touched, the meat should not feel mushy or slimy.

mon_an.mo_ta: Have you tried this unique dish yet? Stir-fried beef with crispy potatoes is guaranteed to be a favorite because of its novelty. Let's learn how to make it!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Ginger, garlic, seasoning powder, fish sauce, cooking oil - as needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Rinse the beef, slice thinly, and marinate with minced ginger, minced garlic, fish sauce, and seasoning powder.
Step 2: Clean the celery and cut into segments. Rinse the tomatoes and cut into wedges.
Step 3: Peel and wash the potatoes, then prepare them according to the method for making crispy golden fried potatoes.
Step 4: Sauté the garlic until fragrant, add the beef and stir-fry until cooked, then remove to a plate and set aside the beef juices.

Step 5: Add the fried potatoes to the pan and sauté with the beef juices until absorbed, then add the tomatoes and season with fish sauce and seasoning powder to taste. Add the celery and stir-fry, then finally return the beef to the pan and toss everything together over high heat.
Step 6: Arrange the Stir-Fried Beef with Crispy Potatoes on a plate and enjoy.

mon_an.mo_ta: For those who love Korean dramas, you surely haven't forgotten the fried rice omelet in the movie 'Rooftop Prince' that Park Ha prepared for the Joseon Crown Prince. Although it looks complicated, it is surprisingly easy to make. Check out the recipe below! This breakfast will provide plenty of energy and nutrition to start your day. Learn to cook this delicious meal.
cac_buoc: A delicious fried rice omelet for breakfast—are you ready to learn? Here is the guide for this daily tasty dish!
Step 1: Crack the eggs into a bowl, add a pinch of salt, and beat well.
Step 2: Soak the shiitake mushrooms in hot water until soft, then dice. Rinse the sponge gourd and dice. Rinse the shrimp, peel, devein, and dice.

Step 3: Blanch the carrots and peas in boiling water to keep their color bright. Heat oil in a pan; when hot, add the corn, carrots, peas, and sponge gourd. Then add the shrimp and mushrooms, stirring until all ingredients are just cooked.
Step 4: Add the rice to the pan and season to taste. Once the fried rice is ready, scoop it into a bowl.
Step 5: Use a flat-bottomed pan, add oil, then pour in the eggs. Spread evenly across the pan and cook both sides until done.
Step 6: When the omelet is fully cooked, place the fried rice on one half of the egg.
Step 7: Carefully fold the other half of the egg over the rice. Remove the entire roll from the pan.

mon_an.ten: Stir-Fried Salmon with Green Beans and Mushrooms
mon_an.mo_ta: Delicious and nutritious salmon stir-fried with green beans and mushrooms makes this dish more attractive and appetizing than ever! Check out our recipe for stir-fried salmon with green beans and mushrooms below. We hope this helps you have a great dish to treat your family.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Marinate the salmon with 2 tbsp of soy sauce, then set aside while you prepare the other ingredients.
Step 2: Rinse the green beans and cut into 2 cm segments. Rinse the mushrooms and slice thinly.
Step 3: Add 1 tsp of sesame oil to a pan, add ½ of the ginger and garlic along with the salmon. Cook for 8-10 minutes over medium heat until the fish is cooked through.

Step 4: In another pan, add the remaining sesame oil, then add the green beans, mushrooms, and the remaining garlic and ginger. Stir-fry for 5 minutes until the beans and mushrooms are tender. Add the salmon to the vegetable pan, toss gently, and add a splash of lime juice.
Transfer to a plate and sprinkle roasted sesame seeds over the dish.
Garnish with a bit of cilantro or chopped scallions. Serve this dish while hot.
Enjoy your meal with this stir-fried salmon with green beans, mushrooms, and soy sauce!

mon_an.mo_ta: This savory garlic braised dried fish is delicious and enticing from the very first bite due to the seductive aroma of garlic, the spiciness of chili, and the chewy, sweet texture of the dried fish. This dish is excellent with hot rice, cucumber, and various herbs. Treat your family to this delicious yet affordable meal!
cac_buoc: Rinse the fish in hot water to soften it and reduce saltiness. Remove the heads, scales, and cut into bite-sized pieces (if the fish are small, leave them whole).
Mince the garlic and chili, then mix with the sate sauce and a little water.
Heat the cooking oil until very hot, then lightly fry the fish.
Drain most of the oil, pour in the prepared sauce mixture, and simmer over low heat until the liquid has evaporated, then turn off the heat.

mon_an.ten: Crispy Fried Mackerel in Tomato Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: This crispy fried mackerel in tomato sauce is both delicious and savory. It's incredibly fragrant and perfect when enjoyed with rice.
cac_buoc: Step 1: First, let's prepare the fish!
Rinse the mackerel with diluted salt water to reduce the fishy smell, then cut the fish into square pieces.

Step 2: Next, grind the galangal with a little water, then squeeze out the galangal juice. Pour the juice evenly over the fish, add a bit of fish sauce and pepper so the seasonings penetrate each piece.

Step 3: Marinate the fish for about 5 minutes. Meanwhile, mix the frying flour with a little water. Once marinated, dip each piece of fish into the batter and place in a pan of hot oil. Fry until both sides are golden and crispy.
Step 4: Once the fish is golden, remove to a plate lined with paper towels to remove excess oil.

Step 5: Next, drain most of the oil used for frying (if there isn't much left, you don't need to drain it). Add the tomatoes and sauté in the oil with a little water. Simmer for about 5 minutes until the tomatoes are very soft.

Once the tomatoes are soft (you can check by pressing with a chopstick or tasting), add the fried fish. Toss very gently so the fish doesn't break. Simmer for another 5 minutes, season with fish sauce and salt to taste, and sprinkle with some chopped scallions before turning off the heat.
Transfer the fried mackerel in tomato sauce to a plate. Remember to serve hot with rice for the best taste.
Additionally, you can serve this with rice vermicelli; the tomato sauce poured over the noodles is absolutely delicious!
Good luck and enjoy this appetizing mackerel in tomato sauce with your family!

mon_an.mo_ta: Mackerel in tomato sauce is a delicious dish that many families cook today. In today's article, let's learn how to make this dish. Please take a look!
cac_buoc: Step 1: To make the sauce, finely chop the onion and tomatoes. Place the onion and tomatoes in a pot, stir quickly, add fish sauce, pepper, and a little water, then simmer until soft.
Step 2: Place a pan on the stove, add oil, and when hot, add the fish. Fry until both sides are golden brown, then remove and drain the oil.
Step 3: Once the fish is cooked, place it on a plate, pour the tomato sauce over it, and sprinkle with chopped scallions for garnish. Serve hot with rice.
Good luck with your mackerel in tomato sauce!

mon_an.ten: Baked Cabbage Rolls with Meat Filling
mon_an.mo_ta: Baked cabbage rolls are a delightful dish featuring a unique preparation method and savory flavor. With an eye-catching appearance, the crispy cabbage leaves wrap around a fresh, well-seasoned meat filling that becomes incredibly delicious when baked. Let's get into the kitchen and learn how to make this wonderful dish!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Tomato sauce - 470 ml for the sauce
Tomato sauce - 125 ml for the meat marinade
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients for the baked cabbage rolls.
Wash the cabbage thoroughly and keep it whole.
Cut off the hard stem at the top and remove any old or damaged outer leaves.
Crack the egg into a bowl.
Squeeze the lemon to get about 2 tablespoons of juice, removing any seeds.
Wash the beef and pork, then mince or grind them finely; keep the two types of meat separate.
Peel, wash, and finely chop the onion.
Rinse the rice and let it drain.
Step 2: Cooking steps for the baked cabbage rolls.
First, place a large pot of water on the stove (large enough to fit the cabbage). Boil the water over high heat without adding salt or anything else.
Once the water boils, place the cabbage in the pot and blanch for about 2 minutes or until the leaves soften.
Remove the cabbage and let it drain and cool down.
Carefully peel off the cabbage leaves; you will need about 12 large leaves. Be gentle to avoid tearing them.
Take a cabbage leaf and use a small, sharp knife to cut away the thick, hard white rib on the leaf. Be careful not to cut through the leaf, or you won't be able to wrap the meat.
Repeat this process for the remaining leaves.
Prepare a small bowl and combine the following: tomato sauce (for the sauce part), brown sugar, lemon juice, and Worcestershire sauce. Stir well until the ingredients are fully incorporated.
In a larger bowl, combine the pork, beef, the remaining tomato sauce, onion, dried parsley, long-grain rice, pepper, salt, chili powder, and the egg. Mix thoroughly until well combined.
Spread a cabbage leaf on a clean surface or cutting board and spoon an appropriate amount of filling onto the leaf.
Roll the cabbage leaf tightly like a spring roll, ensuring the meat filling does not fall out.
Use a small toothpick to secure the outer edge of the roll. Repeat with the remaining cabbage leaves.
Preheat your oven to 350°F (180°C).
Prepare a baking tray and pour half of the prepared sauce mixture into the bottom.
Arrange the cabbage rolls in the tray, placing them close together so they maintain their shape during baking.
Finally, pour the remaining sauce over the top of the cabbage rolls.
Cover the tray tightly with aluminum foil and place it in the oven. Bake for 60 to 90 minutes.
After the first 60 minutes, check if the rolls are cooked through. If they are done, you can stop; otherwise, continue baking for another 30 minutes.
Once cooked, remove the tray from the oven, discard the foil, and let it cool slightly before serving the rolls on a plate.
Notes for perfect baked cabbage rolls:
If you don't have an oven, you can stew the cabbage rolls in a rice cooker with the sauce or simmer them in a pan like a regular braised dish.
In this recipe, I use a mix of beef and pork for a richer flavor, but you can use 100% pork or 100% beef if preferred.
For the long-grain rice, you can substitute with brown rice or slightly sticky rice for extra texture.

mon_an.ten: Pan-Seared Salmon with Soy Sauce Glaze
mon_an.mo_ta: A simple and easy-to-make dish featuring a very special sauce that creates an irresistible flavor for this pan-seared salmon!
cac_buoc: Once the ingredients are ready, let's start making this delicious pan-seared salmon!
Step 1:
First, prepare the special sauce. Get a pot ready to simmer the sauce mixture.
Add all ingredients to the pot except for the salmon, oil, and salt. This includes brown sugar + soy sauce + mirin + vinegar + mustard + cornstarch + dried chili + water.
Use chopsticks, a spoon, or a whisk to stir the mixture thoroughly.
Step 2:
Turn on the heat and simmer the mixture for about 1 minute over medium heat. Stir with a spoon; once the mixture has thickened, turn off the heat.
Step 3:
Wash the salmon fillets, then season with salt to reduce the fishy scent and sliminess. Make sure to season both sides evenly.
Step 4:
Place a pan on the stove, add oil, and heat until very hot. Place the salmon in the pan to sear.
After about 3-4 minutes, flip the salmon to ensure it cooks evenly on both sides.
Step 5:
When all sides are cooked through and have a golden-brown color (as shown in the image), remove the fish and place it on a plate lined with paper towels to drain the excess oil.
Step 6:
To serve, arrange the fish on a clean plate and drizzle the prepared special sauce evenly over the salmon fillets.
Garnish with a few sprigs of cilantro or serve with boiled broccoli on the side to make the dish more attractive!
It's so simple to have a delicious and nutritious salmon dish to treat your whole family!
Final requirements:
The salmon should be cooked through with an even, beautiful golden color and not burnt.
The fish meat should be tender.
The soy-mustard sauce should be thick and glossy, not too watery, with a balanced flavor.
The sauce should have a pungent, spicy kick.
Salmon is a very nutritious food for the whole family. The tender seared meat combined with the spicy sauce creates a harmonious and rich flavor for your family meal!
You should eat the fish while it is still hot to fully enjoy its flavor!

mon_an.mo_ta: Coca-Cola braised chicken wings sound delicious with the unique coke flavor, and the method is not difficult at all. Let's explore how to make these fried and braised wings.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning: 5ml soy sauce, 5ml rice wine, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 tbsp fish sauce
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients:
Wash the chicken wings and use a knife to make small scores along the wings so the meat absorbs the seasoning better.
Marinate the wings with salt, rice wine, and shredded ginger for about 10 minutes.
Finely chop the green onions and shred the ginger.
Instructions:
Pour oil into a pan. When the oil is hot, fry the chicken wings until both sides turn golden brown and the meat firms up.

Pour the Coca-Cola into the pan and reduce the heat to low. Simmer gently so the wings absorb the sauce. After 8-10 minutes, turn the heat to high to reduce the sauce until it thickens and coats the wings.
Add soy sauce to deepen the color of the sauce, fry for a little longer, then turn off the heat.
The chicken wings will be tender and fragrant, coated in a thick, glossy Coca-Cola glaze.
Sprinkle with green onions and serve hot. This can be enjoyed as an afternoon snack or served with white rice.

mon_an.ten: Refreshing Flower Crab Soup with Water Spinach
mon_an.mo_ta: Flower crab soup with water spinach is both nutritious and refreshing, making it an easy-to-eat dish for a healthy lunch!
cac_buoc: *Flower crab soup with water spinach* is a delicious dish often prepared by coastal people for daily meals. The sweetness of the crab broth combined with humble water spinach creates an excellent bowl of soup.
Step 1: After buying the crabs, use a brush to scrub and wash them clean. (You can remove the top shell and use scissors to cut the crabs in half or leave them whole for cooking).
Step 2: Pick the tender tips of the water spinach, remove some leaves, wash thoroughly, and snap into bite-sized lengths. Peel, wash, and mince the shallot.

Step 3: Place a pot on the stove, add cooking oil, and sauté the minced shallot until fragrant. Quickly add the crabs and stir until they turn red, then pour in water to make the soup. Season with salt and broth powder to taste and bring to a boil.
Step 4: When the crabs are just cooked, quickly add the water spinach. Wait for the soup to return to a boil; once the greens are cooked, it is done.
Transfer the crab and water spinach soup to a bowl, add 1 teaspoon of MSG, and enjoy while the soup is still hot.
Wishing you and your family a delicious meal with this attractive flower crab and water spinach soup to change up the menu!

mon_an.mo_ta: A new dish for your family menu, these shrimp and squid rolls are sure to delight every family member!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: For the rolls: - Rice paper (bánh đa nem)
1 tbsp Taiwanese rice wine (can be substituted with regular rice wine)
Sugar, pepper, chopped green onions, minced garlic
For the sauce: - 1 tbsp chili sauce, 1 tbsp ketchup
1 tsp minced garlic, chopped green onions
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Finely chop or grind the shrimp and squid.
Step 2:
In a large bowl, mix the ground shrimp and squid with tapioca starch, green onions, garlic, rice wine, sesame oil, salt, sugar, and pepper.
Add half of the cornstarch (15g) and mix well.
Step 3:
Dampen the rice paper with water, add the filling, and roll into small, bite-sized pieces.
Roll the pieces through the remaining cornstarch.
Step 4:
Heat the oil and deep-fry the rolls until they are golden brown and crispy.
Step 5: Make the sauce
Simply mix the chili sauce, ketchup, and soybean paste with sugar and minced garlic, then sprinkle chopped green onions on top.
In this transitional weather, enjoying a hot, unique Taiwanese-style shrimp roll with the flavors of shrimp and squid dipping into the sauce is truly wonderful!
Make it for your family right away!

mon_an.mo_ta: Regular egg meatloaf is already delicious, but let's add a twist with taro to create a new, unique, and fragrant dish that makes your family meal more diverse and attractive. Let's explore the recipe for taro egg meatloaf now.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Cut the taro into finger-sized pieces. Place in a bowl with 1 tablespoon of water, a bit of salt, and pepper. Steam until cooked, then remove and mash finely.
Step 2:
Separate the egg into yolk and white.
Soak the wood ear mushrooms until soft, then slice into thin strips.
Finely chop the cilantro.
Peel the shrimp, remove the heads and veins, and chop finely.
Step 3:
Mix the shrimp, pork, taro, wood ear mushrooms, and egg white with 1/2 teaspoon of MSG, 1 teaspoon of salt, 1 teaspoon of sugar, 1/2 teaspoon of pepper, and the cilantro.
Step 4:
Grease a medium bowl with oil, add the mixture, press it down firmly, and steam for 15 minutes.
Step 5:
Finally, brush the egg yolk over the top. Continue steaming without a lid until the yolk is set.
So, after 5 simple steps that don't take much time, we have finished the Taro Egg Meatloaf.
It looks very attractive, doesn't it? Don't hesitate to make this for your dinner tonight! 😀

mon_an.mo_ta: Chewy chicken feet coated in a sweet and spicy sauce will make anyone fall in love with this dish. Let's get into the kitchen and make spicy stir-fried chicken feet.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, clean the chicken feet and cut them into bite-sized pieces.
Step 2:
Add the star anise, cinnamon, soy sauce, chicken feet, and 200ml of water to a pan and bring to a boil.
Then, lower the heat and simmer the chicken feet for about 30 minutes. Remove and drain.
Step 3:
In a small bowl, mix the ketchup, Gochujang, and sugar together.
Step 4:
Heat a pan with a little oil and sauté the garlic until fragrant. Add the chicken feet and the sauce, tossing well to coat, then set aside.
Step 5:
Next, toast the white sesame seeds until fragrant.
Step 6:
Transfer the stir-fried chicken feet to a plate and sprinkle the toasted sesame seeds on top to finish.
And there you have it, the Korean-style spicy chicken feet are complete!
It's very delicious and attractive; just looking at it makes you crave this spicy stir-fried chicken feet dish.

mon_an.ten: Restaurant-Style Beef and Pickled Mustard Green Fried Rice
mon_an.mo_ta: Just hearing the name makes you want to eat it right away! Every time I go out for fried rice, this is the only dish I order. The fried rice is rich, the pickles are tart and crunchy, and the beef is fragrant. Making this dish is quite simple; let's learn how to make this easy and delicious beef and pickled mustard green fried rice!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Ingredients - Minced shallots, carrots, green onions, cilantro, garlic, minced ginger
Seasoning - Cooking oil, fish sauce, broth powder, salt
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the beef, slice into thin bite-sized pieces, and place in a bowl to marinate with some minced garlic, minced ginger, fish sauce, and broth powder.

Step 2: Squeeze the liquid out of the pickled mustard greens, rinse them, and squeeze again. This prevents the pickles from being too sour and keeps the dish from becoming soggy. Wash and finely chop the green onions. Peel, wash, and dice the carrots. Pick the roots off the cilantro, wash, and drain.
Step 3: Put the rice in a large bowl, crack the egg into it, and mix the rice and egg thoroughly.

Step 4: Heat oil in a pan, add the shallots and sauté until fragrant, then add the beef to stir-fry. When the beef is almost cooked, add the pickled mustard greens and stir-fry until the leaves soften. Add the carrots, stir-fry for another minute, then transfer to a plate.

Step 5: Add oil to the pan, add the rice, and fry until the grains are firm and slightly crispy. Add the plate of stir-fried beef and pickles back in, toss well, add the green onions, and turn off the heat.
Step 6: Plate the rice and you are ready to enjoy your beef and pickled mustard green fried rice!

mon_an.mo_ta: A quick and easy meal with pork rib and mushroom rice that will surely have your whole family praising your cooking skills!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, pan-sear the pork ribs with oil in a pan over high heat.
Step 2:
When the meat is browned on the edges, lower the heat and add the minced ginger, garlic, and a little sugar.
Tips: Adding the ginger and garlic later is a small trick to prevent them from burning during the cooking process.
Step 3:
Cook the ingredients for a few minutes, then add the diced carrots, soy sauce, and a little water. Stir together.
Simmer until the liquid has slightly reduced (about 5-10 minutes).
Step 4:
Next, wash the rice and put it into the rice cooker. Add a little salt and pepper for flavor.
Tips: Use the water from soaking the dried shiitake mushrooms and add a bit more water to cook the rice!
Step 5:
Pour the ribs and sauce into the rice cooker and press the COOK button as you would for normal rice!
Step 6:
Finally, when the rice is almost cooked, open the lid and add the peas. Continue cooking until all ingredients are fully done.
A simple yet very attractive dish, isn't it?
You can also apply this cooking method to glutinous rice; it's very delicious and suitable.

mon_an.mo_ta: Frog meat is a delicious, nutritious, and easy-to-prepare ingredient. Mothers have countless ways to cook it to suit the family's taste. Today, we introduce the delicious and nutritious butter garlic fried frog legs, which are simple to make. Your whole family is guaranteed to love the fragrant aroma of this dish.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Honey, broth powder, pepper, cooking oil - as needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the parsley, drain, and mince finely.

Step 2: Clean the frog legs and pat dry. Marinate with 4 tablespoons of honey, 1 tablespoon of broth powder, ½ teaspoon of ground pepper, 2 tablespoons of cooking oil, and 2 teaspoons of minced parsley. Marinate for about 1 hour (during this time, toss the frog legs about 3 times to ensure they absorb the seasoning evenly).
Step 3: Arrange the frog legs on a baking tray brushed with oil. Place in the oven for about 20 minutes, then remove the meat.
Step 4: Melt 100g of butter, sauté the minced garlic until fragrant, add the frog legs, toss, and sprinkle with a little minced parsley. Fry quickly to capture the aroma of the butter.
Step 5: Arrange on a plate and serve.
Enjoy your meal!

mon_an.mo_ta: Spicy braised chicken is a traditional Korean dish with a simple and easy-to-follow recipe, from ingredient preparation to the cooking steps. If you love spicy food or Korean cuisine, these spicy braised chicken drumsticks are the perfect choice. Today, we will guide you through the recipe for these delicious Korean spicy braised chicken drumsticks!
cac_buoc: Prepare the chicken:
10 chicken drumsticks (or more/less depending on your preference)
1 onion
1 carrot
6 potatoes
2 green onions
Prepare the sauce:
1/3 cup soy sauce
2 tbsp liquid sweetener (available in supermarkets)
1 tbsp minced garlic
1 tbsp sesame oil
2 tbsp Korean chili paste (gochujang)
1 tsp black pepper
1 tsp salt.
Steps to make Spicy Braised Chicken Drumsticks
Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Wash the chicken drumsticks and drain well.
Peel the potatoes and carrots, then cut into bite-sized chunks.
Slice the onion; finely chop the white parts of the green onions.
Step 2: Cooking instructions
First, clean the chicken by bringing a pot of water to a boil over high heat.
When the water boils, blanch the drumsticks for 5-10 minutes. This removes odors and any impurities from the meat.
Remove the chicken and immediately rinse with cold water.
Once the chicken is prepared, take a large bowl to mix the sauce.
Combine all ingredients: garlic, soy sauce, gochujang, liquid sweetener, salt, sesame oil, and pepper. Stir well until the seasonings are fully dissolved.
Now, proceed to braise the chicken.
Place a medium-sized pot on the stove and heat a little cooking oil.
Add the potatoes and carrots and stir-fry until they are slightly firm.
Arrange the chicken drumsticks on top of the potatoes and carrots.
Pour the sauce mixture over the top, ensuring it is evenly distributed throughout the pot.
Cover the pot and turn the heat to high. Once it reaches a rolling boil, reduce to low heat and simmer until the potatoes and carrots are cooked through.
Uncover, add the onion, and cook for another 5 minutes before turning off the heat.
Serve the chicken, potatoes, and carrots on a plate. Pour the sauce over them and garnish with chopped green onions.
Serve the spicy braised chicken hot with rice or bread.
Notes for making Korean Spicy Braised Chicken:
Depending on your preference, you can substitute drumsticks with other chicken parts.
If you don't like raw green onions, add them to the pot and stir before removing it from the heat.
If you cannot find liquid sweetener, you can substitute it with sugar, coconut caramel sauce, or a combination of sugar and oyster sauce.

It only takes about 30-45 minutes to have a steaming hot dish ready for the family. The chicken is tender and sweet, the vegetables are soft, and the rich sauce pairs perfectly with hot rice and kimchi for a Korean meal right at home.

mon_an.mo_ta: Grilled lemongrass chicken is a wonderful dish in both appearance and flavor. When grilled, the chicken wrapped in lemongrass creates an attractive golden skin with a characteristic aroma. You will experience the rich taste of chicken combined with a sweet, fragrant finish. If you want to learn the recipe for this dish, check out the details below. You will surely find satisfaction in every serving. Beautiful, appealing, and delicious—discover the detailed recipe now!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning - salt, shallots, pepper, seasoning powder
cac_buoc: 1. Prepare the chicken
Clean the chicken: Remove all feathers and pinfeathers carefully. Rub some salt or lemon on the skin to clean and reduce odors. Rinse thoroughly with water and drain.
Debone: Use a small, sharp knife to carefully remove the cartilage near the tail, but keep the wing and thigh bones.
Vinegar and salt solution: To remove odors, mix vinegar and salt in a 1:2 ratio and rub it all over the chicken. Rub several times and rinse thoroughly with clean water.

Rub with lemon and salt: Rub lemon slices and a little salt on the meat. Alternatively, crush 1 ginger knob and mix with a little white wine, then massage onto the chicken and let it sit for 30 minutes before cooking.
2. Marinate the chicken

Marinade mixture: 50g minced garlic, 3 tbsp minced chili, 1 tbsp sesame oil, 3 tbsp sugar, 2 tsp salt, 1 tsp MSG, and 4 tbsp cooking oil. Mix well and rub evenly on both the inside and outside of the chicken. Marinate for 20-30 minutes to let the flavors penetrate the meat.
3. Grill the chicken
To grill the chicken, prepare the charcoal grill first and wait until the coals are glowing red. Place the grill grate on top and begin grilling.
Use skewers to thread the chicken lengthwise. Place the chicken on the grill and flip frequently, brushing with oil to prevent burning.
Grill until the chicken turns a toasted golden brown.
4. Make the dipping sauce
Dipping sauce:
Place 50g minced lemongrass and 20g river leaves (lá giang) into a blender and blend until smooth.
Pour the mixture into a bowl.
Add 1 tbsp minced chili, 1 tsp salt, and 1 tbsp sugar.
Mix all ingredients together to create the dipping sauce.
Make scorched rice with scallion oil:
Put cold rice into a plastic bag and use a rolling pin to flatten it until it becomes thin and sticky.
Line a mold with parchment paper and place the flattened rice inside.
Place the mold into an air fryer and fry for about 20 minutes.
Finely chop green onions and place them in a bowl.
Add 1/2 tsp salt to the bowl, then pour in hot oil and mix well.
Hope you succeed in making the dipping sauce and scorched rice.

The chicken has a crispy outer skin and perfectly seasoned meat. Dipping it in the lemongrass salt provides a spicy kick from the lemongrass and a slight tang from the river leaves, making the dish unique and appealing.
Tips for delicious Grilled Lemongrass Chicken
1. For live chicken
Choose chicken with a bright red comb, shiny feathers, and a healthy pink vent without any strange discharge.
The legs should be slender, evenly yellow, and not wrinkled. The crop should not be hard, which indicates a healthy bird.

Part the feathers to check the skin. It should be thin, soft, and the body should feel firm, not flabby, when squeezed. Look for large yellow patches under the breast and wings. Visible meat and blood vessels under the wings indicate a lean, firm bird.
2. For pre-processed chicken
Choose meat that looks fresh and has no foul or strange odors. There should be no blood clots or bruising on the skin. Avoid chicken with dark or dull skin, as it may have died before processing.
To avoid water-injected chicken, press on areas like the thighs and breast. If it feels flabby, slippery, or deformed, do not buy it.
If the skin is yellow but the fat inside is white, the chicken has been dyed and should be avoided.

For good free-range chicken (gà ta), choose pieces with pale yellow, thin, smooth, and elastic skin, with darker yellow only on the breast, wings, and back. The body should be compact and firm with a narrow breast.
For frozen chicken in supermarkets, check for a reliable origin and the expiration date on the packaging to ensure quality.

mon_an.mo_ta: Kimchi chicken stew delights diners with tender, fresh chicken and a rich aroma, served with slightly bitter yet sweet radish and soft kimchi in a flavorful broth. This dish is an excellent choice when served with hot rice! Check out the recipe for this irresistible kimchi chicken stew below!
cac_buoc: Wash the chicken, remove any pinfeathers from the skin, and rinse again with salt. Once drained, chop the chicken into bite-sized pieces. You can use chicken breast, but thighs provide a better flavor and texture.
Marinate the chicken with pepper, salt, and minced shallots for 30 minutes to let the flavors soak in. Mix well to ensure the ingredients are combined.
Cut the kimchi into bite-sized pieces.
Peel the radish, wash it, and slice into rounds about 1cm thick.

Place a pot on the stove and add cooking oil. Once hot, stir-fry the chicken until firm and golden. Add the white radish, julienned ginger, and the kimchi juice from step 1. Simmer on low heat with the lid closed.

Cook the chicken and radish for about 25 minutes, then add the kimchi. Season to taste, add chopped green onions, and turn off the heat. If the pot becomes too dry during cooking, you can add a small cup of water.
Finally, ladle the chicken and kimchi into a bowl, garnish as desired, and serve hot.
Tips for a delicious Kimchi Chicken Stew
When stir-frying the chicken, make sure it is firm and slightly golden on the outside before adding the other ingredients!
How to choose good chicken:

Tips for pre-processed chicken: A good chicken will have a compact, firm body and a small breast. The skin should be bright yellow, with darker yellow areas on the wings, breast, and back. The skin should not be bruised, pale, or have black spots or lumps. If the skin is tough and uniformly bright yellow while the fat is white, it may have been dyed. The meat should be firm, fresh, and free of foul odors or antibiotic smells. Press the breast or thigh; if it is firm, it is good. If it is flabby, slippery, or stays indented, it may have been injected with water or borax—do not buy it.
Tips for live chicken:
When observing and choosing:
Compare two chickens of the same size; the one that feels heavier will have firmer meat.
A healthy chicken is active, hard to catch, has bright eyes, a bright red comb, and shiny, smooth feathers.
The beak should be sharp and shiny without any discharge.
The legs should be straight, slender, and free of scratches, sores, or strange red spots.

Part the feathers to see thin, soft skin. The body should feel firm, not flabby. Look for yellow patches under the breast and wings. Visible meat and blood vessels under the wings indicate a lean bird.
A healthy bird has a pink, active vent that contracts well, with no wetness or abnormal discharge. If the droppings are yellow, slimy, or bloody, do not buy it as it is diseased.
Check for water injection by flipping the wing to look at the armpit. Small red dots or dark, swollen areas indicate the bird has been injected to increase weight; avoid these birds.

mon_an.mo_ta: This Korean-style fried chicken recipe is sure to be a hit with your whole family!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, cut through the skin and tendons at the base of the drumstick.
Step 2:
Push the chicken meat upward to the top to form a round ball (lollipop style).
Step 3:
Place the shaped drumsticks in a bowl and marinate with Korean chili powder.
Step 4:
Add the minced garlic and ginger, then mix well.
Step 5:
Add the beaten egg, all-purpose flour, and cornstarch to the bowl.
Step 6:
Mix the chicken thoroughly until well coated with the seasonings.
Step 7:
Heat cooking oil over medium heat.
Step 8:
Fry each drumstick for 3-5 minutes until golden brown and cooked through, then remove.
Step 9:
In another pan, combine the chili paste for the sauce with water and stir well.
Step 10:
Bring the mixture to a boil, then add the honey. Stir and continue to simmer until the sauce thickens.
Step 11:
Slowly pour the sauce over the fried chicken.
Step 12:
Gently toss so the sauce evenly coats the fried drumsticks.
Arrange the drumsticks on a plate and get ready to eat!
The drumsticks are rich in sauce and look like unique lollipops!
Garnish with some chopped green onions to make it look beautiful.

mon_an.mo_ta: If you are a fan of grilled dishes, you cannot miss this delicious and appealing rotisserie chicken. The method is very simple to achieve a glossy golden chicken with an irresistible aroma. Discover how to make this delicious rotisserie chicken easily with the recipe below. The wonderful flavor will be impossible to resist.
cac_buoc: Let's start making this delicious rotisserie chicken!
Step 1:
After cleaning the chicken, rinse it with water and let it drain completely.

While waiting for the chicken to dry, prepare a bowl and mix the minced onion, garlic, fish sauce, kumquat juice, salt, chili powder, ginger, pepper, brown sugar, and 2-3 stalks of lemongrass. Stir until all ingredients are well combined.
Step 2:
Prepare a large pot that can fit the whole chicken. Place the drained chicken inside and pour the marinade mixture evenly over it.
Wear clean plastic gloves and rub the chicken several times to ensure the seasonings penetrate the entire surface.
Step 3:
Prepare a food-grade plastic bag. Put the marinated chicken and all the remaining marinade from the pot into the bag. Tie it tightly and shake the bag to help the marinade soak in.
Place the bag in the refrigerator overnight or for at least 4-6 hours to let the flavors fully develop.
Small tip: If you want to serve this for lunch, marinate it the night before. If you want it for dinner, marinate it in the morning or at noon.
Step 4:
Preheat the oven to 200°C. You can use a Halogen oven or a standard oven.
Take the chicken out of the fridge, remove the plastic bag, and stuff the lemongrass from the marinade plus the remaining stalks into the chicken's cavity.
Pour the leftover marinade from the bag into a bowl and mix with a little cooking oil. Use a brush or gloved hand to rub half of this mixture onto the chicken skin.
Place the chicken on a roasting rack or skewer it for the rotisserie.
Step 5:
Roast the chicken for 2 hours. Every 30 minutes, brush the remaining marinade onto the skin. This step ensures the skin becomes beautifully golden and glossy.
After 2 hours, do not remove the chicken immediately; leave it in the oven for another 30 minutes to ensure it is cooked through evenly.
Step 6:
After 30 minutes, remove the chicken to a large tray. Use a knife to chop it into bite-sized pieces, arrange on a plate, and enjoy with your family!
And there you have it, the fragrant and beautiful rotisserie chicken is complete!
It's so simple, right? The ingredients are easy to find at any market or supermarket, and it doesn't take too much active time to create a nutritious meal!
Final result requirements:
The chicken should be evenly golden, not burnt, with crispy skin.
The meat should be fragrant with lemongrass and kumquat and well-seasoned.
If you don't have an oven, you can grill it over charcoal; it just takes a bit more effort but results in a delicious flavor!
Serve with hot rice or roasted vegetables for a perfect meal!
How to choose fresh chicken:
When buying chicken, choose parts with characteristic bright yellow skin. It should feel soft, smooth, and thin to the touch.
Fresh chicken will have a natural pinkish-red color, not suspiciously pale or dark. The meat should feel firm and elastic, springing back when pressed.
Avoid chicken that feels flabby, has bruises, or has meat turning a greenish-purple color. These are signs of diseased or old meat.

mon_an.mo_ta: Japanese people love noodles, even though rice remains the main component of their daily meals. There are many types of noodles in Japan, but the four most popular are Udon, Soba, Somen, and Ramen. However, Udon is perhaps the most quintessentially Japanese. Udon is a wheat noodle with thick strands—the thickest among common Japanese noodles. The diameter is usually about 1cm, roughly the size of a chopstick. However, there are many regional variations; some places make them thicker or thinner. It also depends on the weather; in summer, many places make thinner Udon to make it easier and more refreshing to eat cold. Today, we will introduce the perfect recipe for the chewiest noodles. Let's learn how to make chewy Udon noodles!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Put the flour and salt into a large bowl, add warm water, and mix quickly and evenly. Initially, the dough will be crumbly, but keep mixing until it forms a ball.

Step 2: Once the dough forms a ball, place it in a Ziploc bag. Roll the dough thin, then fold it in half. Repeat this process 12-15 times until the dough is smooth, beautiful, and elastic. Let the dough rest for 2 to 4 hours.
Step 3: Roll the dough thin and cut it into strands about 2/3 the thickness of a chopstick, as they will expand when cooked. Prepare a bowl of ice water.
Step 4: Boil the noodles for 5-7 minutes, then immediately transfer them to the ice water. Submerge them completely, then lift them onto a plate.

A very interesting note is that Japanese people often use their feet to knead the dough; you can do the same! Just wear clean socks and, in my opinion, use a second Ziploc bag just in case you step too hard and break the bag! Good luck with your chewy Udon noodles!

mon_an.mo_ta: Enjoy chewy, crunchy glass noodles with flavorful shrimp. This stir-fried glass noodle dish will surely make your whole family want more! Discover the recipe for this delicious dish below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning - salt, seasoning powder, sugar, pepper
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the pork belly, remove the skin, and slice thinly. Boil the shrimp until cooked, peel, and set aside in a bowl.
Step 2: Slice the chili and shallot. Cut the green onion into segments.
Step 3: Soak the glass noodles in cold water for 7-8 minutes, then drain in a colander.
Step 4: Place a pan on the stove, add 1 tbsp oil. Once hot, sauté the chili, shallot, and garlic until fragrant.
Step 5: Add the pork and stir-fry until firm and the fat renders. Next, add the shrimp and toss quickly for 1-2 minutes.
Step 6: Finally, add all the seasonings along with the glass noodles and cherry tomatoes. Toss everything together. Season to taste and turn off the heat.
Serve the stir-fried glass noodles on a plate, garnish with a bit of green onion and cilantro to finish.

mon_an.mo_ta: Strawberry jam is delicious and has many uses, from breakfast with bread to making cakes or eating with biscuits. While canned jam is widely available, it may not be as hygienic or might be too sweet for your taste. So why not try making your own? Let's learn this very simple and delicious strawberry jam recipe!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the strawberries and remove the stems. Cut large strawberries in half.
Step 2: Zest the lemon and squeeze the juice into a bowl.
Step 3: Combine water, sugar, and cornstarch in a pot; stir well and bring to a boil.
Step 4: Add the lemon juice and zest to the pot.
Step 5: Add the strawberries to the pot and mix well.
Step 6: Finally, simmer the strawberries for about 5 minutes or longer until they are soft and broken down.

mon_an.mo_ta: Mushrooms are a delicious hotpot accompaniment and can be prepared in many other attractive ways. Today, we introduce meat-stuffed shiitake mushrooms to change up your family meal. The soft minced meat combined with the aroma of shiitake is irresistible. Let's get started.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Pork marinade: 1 egg white, 1 tbsp cooking wine, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tbsp sesame oil, 1 tbsp cornstarch, pepper
cac_buoc: Prepare all ingredients as shown in the photo:
Cooking steps
Soak the mushrooms in hot water for 15 minutes to rehydrate.
Trim the stems and rinse the mushrooms again with water.
Soak the dried shrimp in hot water for a while, then mince.
Mince the garlic and water chestnuts.
Marinate the ground pork with the seasonings: egg white, cooking wine, soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, cornstarch, and white pepper.
Add the water chestnuts, dried shrimp, and cilantro to the bowl of ground meat and mix well.
Let it sit for at least 15 minutes for the meat to absorb the flavors.
After 15 minutes of marinating, dust the inside of each mushroom cap with a little cornstarch, then fill with the meat mixture.
Prepare a pot of water for steaming.
Place the stuffed mushrooms on the steamer rack and steam for about 10 minutes until cooked through.
Make the sauce: In a small pot, bring a mixture of the mushroom soaking liquid, salt, white pepper, and a little cornstarch to a boil.
Simmer the mixture over medium heat until the sauce thickens.
Transfer the steamed mushrooms to a plate and pour the delicious sauce over them. Garnish with a bit of cilantro.
Good luck and enjoy your meat-stuffed shiitake mushrooms.

mon_an.mo_ta: You have probably made spring rolls many times, but have you tried this Thai-style chicken version? Let's learn how to make this special dish together. Join us in making Thai-style chicken spring rolls!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Garlic, minced ginger, white sesame seeds
Cornstarch, fish sauce, soy sauce, lime
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the chicken breast and dice it. To save time, you could grind it, but this makes the chicken lose flavor and the spring roll filling becomes dry and less tasty.
Step 2: Prepare the ingredients: Peel the garlic, scrape the ginger, and mince both. Using a mincing tool will make this much faster.
Trim the lemongrass, wash, slice thinly, and mince very finely. Dice the bell pepper. Wash the mustard greens, drain, and shred into thin strips.
Step 3: Now, put all the minced ingredients (except the chicken) into a mixing bowl. Set aside half of the shredded greens to use later.

Step 4: Add all the seasonings: 1 tbsp chili paste (reduce if you don't like it spicy); 2 tsp soy sauce; 1 tsp fish sauce; ½ tsp cornstarch and the lime juice (save a small wedge for later), then mix well.
After mixing the ingredients with the seasonings, add the diced chicken and mix again. This helps preserve the natural sweetness of the chicken.
If you prefer a richer taste, add a tiny bit of salt, mix well, cover the bowl, and place it in the refrigerator for about 30 minutes or longer to let the chicken absorb the flavors.

Step 5: Once marinated, take the chicken out and mix again before cooking. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a pan. When the oil is very hot, add the filling and stir-fry over high heat. Stir constantly and quickly so the meat separates and doesn't stick to the pan. This takes about 5-7 minutes. Once cooked, transfer to a bowl.
Wait for the chicken to cool completely before squeezing in the remaining lime juice and adding the rest of the shredded greens; mix well.

Spread a spring roll wrapper on a flat surface. If using pastry-style wrappers (vỏ bánh pía), brush with a thin layer of olive oil before wrapping. Fold the long edges on both sides in about 2cm. Adjust the fold based on the size of your wrapper. This ensures the roll is easy to wrap, firm, won't burst when frying, and has an attractive puffiness.
Spoon a tablespoon of chicken filling into the center, then lift the edge and roll from the top down.
When halfway rolled, fold the two sides in again to keep the filling from spilling out. Then continue rolling as before.
Finally, crack an egg into a bowl, beat with 1 tbsp water, then use a brush to coat the spring rolls with the egg wash. Sprinkle white sesame seeds on top.
Heat enough oil for deep-frying and fry the rolls over medium heat until golden and crispy. You can also bake them. Preheat the oven to 200°C and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
Good luck with this Thai-style chicken spring roll recipe!

mon_an.ten: Beef Shank and Green Mango Salad
mon_an.mo_ta: This green mango and beef shank salad features the signature aroma of lime, garlic, chili, fish sauce, and herbs. Combined with the crunch of the mango and the sweetness of boiled beef shank, it is sure to make your family meal more appealing. This dish is simple to prepare and very refreshing. Let's learn how to make this delicious, crunchy, and tangy salad!
cac_buoc: After preparing all the ingredients:
Execution:
Step 1:
Pick the cilantro and basil, removing old leaves and stems.
Soak, wash thoroughly, drain, and then finely chop.
Step 2:
Slice the beef shank into very thin pieces; marinate with a bit of seasoned salt and broth powder for about 15 minutes.
Then, marinate the beef with a little cooking oil to keep the meat tender.
Step 3:
Wash the green mango and carrot, peel them, and then julienne into small strips.
Step 4:
Massage the green mango and carrot with 1 tsp of salt.
Then, squeeze out all the liquid released from the mango and carrot.
Step 5:
Sauté the garlic until fragrant, add the beef shank and stir-fry until just cooked, then remove the beef to a plate.
Step 6:

Mix the sweet and sour fish sauce dressing with a ratio of 1 fish sauce: 2 sugar: 1 vinegar: 1 lime juice: ½ tbsp sesame oil, then add minced garlic and chili (or adjust the fish sauce to achieve a sour, spicy, salty, and sweet balance according to your taste).
Step 7:
Place the beef shank, carrot, and green mango together in a large bowl.
Pour the fish sauce mixture prepared in step 6 over them and mix well.
Step 8:
Just before eating, toss the salad with the herbs and toasted sesame seeds.
And that's it, the delicious green mango and beef shank salad is finished.

Green mango and beef shank salad served with shrimp crackers is a favorite dish for my family gatherings, especially in the summer. This dish becomes simple and quick if you boil the beef shank the day before and store it in the refrigerator; the next day, you just need to take it out, slice it, and mix the salad. You can use half of the beef for the salad and keep the rest for breakfast noodles or phở, which is very tasty and convenient.

mon_an.mo_ta: Salmon sushi is a very popular dish not only for Japanese people but also highly favored by Vietnamese people, especially the youth. You can completely make this dish at home, achieving the right flavor without taking much time. Let's learn how to make this salmon sushi!
cac_buoc: Cut the seaweed in half.
Spread out the bamboo mat and place the seaweed on top.
Wet your hands with filtered water or rice vinegar so the rice doesn't stick to your hands.
Take a portion of rice and spread it evenly over the seaweed (leave about 1cm of seaweed at the top).
Spread a little wasabi on the rice if you can eat spicy food. (Optional)
Next, place the salmon along the length of the seaweed.
Roll the bamboo mat until the end of the seaweed.
Open the bamboo mat, and you have a complete and delicious sushi roll.
Dip the knife in warm water so the rice doesn't stick when cutting.
Cut the sushi into small, bite-sized pieces.
Enjoy!
So, very quickly, we have completed the delicious salmon sushi. It doesn't take too much time and ensures nutritional value; please take some time to make this dish for your whole family.
(According to Ricette.giallozafferano.it)

mon_an.ten: Pork Belly Braised in a Coconut Shell
mon_an.mo_ta: Each piece of pork belly braised with delicious coconut water will surely make your whole family finish their bowls of rice in the blink of an eye!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings - sugar, fish sauce, seasoned salt, broth powder, cooking oil.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Slice the pork belly into bite-sized pieces; marinate the pork with 2 tbsp oyster sauce, 1/2 tsp pepper, a bit of minced shallot, 1 tbsp fish sauce, ½ tsp broth powder, and ½ tsp seasoned salt. Marinate for about 30 minutes to let the meat absorb the flavors.

Step 2: Cut a thin layer off the top of the coconut, keep the coconut lid, pour the coconut water into a bowl. Soak the dried mushrooms until soft and wash them. Peel and wash the carrot, then cut into 1-2 cm thick pieces. Slice the pineapple thinly. Wash and finely chop the green onions.
Step 3: After marinating, place a pan on the stove with a little oil and sear the pork until the edges are slightly browned. When the meat is firm and some fat has rendered, it's ready.

Step 4: Layer the pork alternately with carrots, mushrooms, and pineapple into the coconut shell, then fill the shell with coconut water. Put the coconut lid back on, secure it tightly with toothpicks, and place it in a steamer. Steam for about 20-25 minutes or until the meat is tender.
Step 5: Sprinkle with a little chopped green onion, then transfer the meat to a bowl and serve with white rice.
Pork belly braised in a coconut shell has the sweet, tender, and fragrant taste of meat, coconut water, and mushrooms blending together.
The tenderness and sweetness in every piece of meat will make the meal extraordinarily appealing.
Good luck and enjoy your meal with this unique pork belly braised in a coconut shell for the whole family!

mon_an.ten: Minced Beef Wrapped King Oyster Mushrooms
mon_an.mo_ta: Minced beef wrapped mushrooms will surely be a dish your whole family loves. The meat is soaked in the flavors of the sauce and fragrant pepper, making it very appetizing with rice. Let's explore this recipe for minced beef wrapped mushrooms.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Marinade: 1 tbsp chopped scallion whites, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 3 tbsp sugar, 3 tbsp glutinous rice flour, 2 tbsp minced garlic, pepper, sesame oil to taste.
Sauce: 3 tbsp water, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp sesame oil, honey.
cac_buoc: Execution steps
Marinade: 1 tbsp chopped scallion whites, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 3 tbsp sugar, 3 tbsp glutinous rice flour, 2 tbsp minced garlic, pepper, sesame oil to taste.
Mix well with the ground beef and let it sit for at least 15 minutes to allow the beef to absorb the seasonings.
Cut the king oyster mushrooms into bite-sized pieces.
After 15 minutes, take a sufficient amount of beef, wrap it around the mushroom piece, leaving the two ends of the mushroom exposed.
Sauce: Mix 3 tbsp water, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp sesame oil, and honey in a bowl.
Add cooking oil to a pan, wait for the oil to get hot, then add the beef-wrapped mushrooms and fry until golden brown on all sides.
When the beef is golden brown, pour in the sauce, reduce to low heat, and turn the beef pieces over so they are evenly coated in the sauce.
When the sauce has thickened, remove the beef-wrapped mushrooms to a plate and drizzle the remaining sauce over the meat.
If you like it spicy, sprinkle some more pepper over the minced beef wrapped mushrooms.
Very fragrant and delicious, enjoy while still hot.

mon_an.mo_ta: Quick Beef Jerky – A delicious and easy-to-make dish for the 2014 World Cup season for him to snack on while waiting for the next match with a cold glass of beer. Delicious cooking lesson: Quick Beef Jerky.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Lemongrass, garlic, sugar, five-spice powder, oyster sauce, salt
Chili powder or crushed fresh chili
cac_buoc: Step 1: Slice the beef into thin pieces about 3-4mm thick, along the grain, in large sheets so it is easy to shred after drying.
Step 2: Finely mince the lemongrass and garlic; mince or crush the fresh chili.
Step 3: Marinate the beef with the prepared seasonings in a covered bowl; keep in the refrigerator for 8 hours for this quick beef jerky method.

Step 4: Place all the beef and the marinade into a small pan, cook over low heat, and cover with a lid. Occasionally flip the meat so it absorbs the flavors evenly. Cook until the liquid has evaporated.

Step 5: Use a mallet to flatten and soften the beef pieces, then place them in the oven to dry for 10 minutes at 100°C until the beef reaches your desired dryness. Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool, then store in the refrigerator to keep it for a long time.

mon_an.mo_ta: Crispy beef sticks offer the natural sweetness of beef combined with a crunchy outer crust, making your family meal even more delicious and attractive. Let's make this dish together.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Mix the melted butter with 50g of flour, a pinch of salt, and 450ml of hot milk. Stir well over low heat for 5 minutes until the mixture becomes a smooth dough.
Step 2:
Next, combine the ground beef, minced onion, manis ketiap (sweet soy sauce), cilantro, and pepper in a bowl and mix thoroughly.
Step 3:
Add the dough mixture to the meat, mix again, and shape into small rolls.
Step 4:
Prepare a bowl of egg yolks, a bowl of flour mixed with a little water, and a plate of panko breadcrumbs to coat the sticks.
Step 5:
Dip the sticks into the flour mixture, then the egg yolks, and finally the breadcrumbs. Deep-fry in hot oil until golden and crispy.
If you prefer not to fry, you can bake them in the oven at 180°C for 5 minutes! Let's enjoy your Crispy Beef Sticks.

mon_an.mo_ta: Szechuan spicy stir-fried pork is famous for its hot flavor from a blend of chilies and peppercorns. With this traditional cooking secret, anyone who tries it will never forget it. Let's explore the recipe for this spicy stir-fried pork.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 1-2 green chilies, scallions, pepper, 1 ginger root, sesame oil
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Wash the pork and cut it into small, bite-sized cubes.
Break the broccoli into small florets.
Thinly shred the green chilies and ginger.
Finely chop the scallions.
Step 2: Cook the spicy stir-fried pork
First, proceed to marinate the pork.
Prepare a large bowl for easy mixing, then add the pork, half of the ginger, and the scallions. Toss well.
Next, add the seasonings: sugar, soy sauce, cooking wine, and a little cornstarch. Mix thoroughly.
Marinate for at least 25-30 minutes so the meat absorbs the flavors.
While waiting for the meat, prepare a steamer, add some water, and bring it to a boil over high heat.
Once the water boils, steam the broccoli for about 10 minutes. Before turning off the heat, sprinkle a pinch of salt over the broccoli to keep it green and enhance its sweetness.
When the marinating time is up, remove the ginger and scallions from the meat before stir-frying.
Place a pan on the stove and heat a little sesame oil.
When the oil is hot, add the pork and stir a few times. Let the meat cook, stirring occasionally.
Stir-fry until the pork turns a beautiful golden brown, then remove the meat and discard any excess oil.
Keep the same pan on the stove, add the pepper and shredded chilies, and sauté until fragrant.
Then, add the stir-fried pork back into the pan and continue to toss for about 1-2 minutes.
Serve the meat on a plate alongside the steamed broccoli.
Notes for making Szechuan spicy stir-fried pork:
When stir-frying the meat, do not use heat that is too high; keep it at a medium level so the meat cooks evenly and achieves a beautiful color.
After marinating, the meat has absorbed the flavors of the ginger and scallions. You should remove them before stir-frying because if cooked together, they will burn and ruin the aroma of the meat.
You can adjust the amount of chili and pepper according to your spice tolerance.
Do not choose completely lean meat to avoid it becoming too dry, but also avoid too much fat as it can be greasy.
The amount of cornstarch added to create texture and color should only be about 1 tablespoon; do not use too much, and adjust based on the amount of meat.
This Szechuan spicy pork dish suits the Vietnamese palate very well and is a great affordable option for daily meals. Make this dish to enrich your family's menu.

mon_an.mo_ta: Shrimp can be prepared in countless ways to create delicious dishes, including the familiar fried shrimp in family meals. Today, we introduce Crispy Noodle-Wrapped Shrimp, which is not only delicious and attractive but also traditionally believed to help improve height. Let's see how to make it below.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Cooking oil, mayonnaise, chili sauce, salt, pepper
cac_buoc: After preparing the ingredients, proceed with the steps to make Crispy Noodle-Wrapped Shrimp as follows:
Step 1:
Rinse the shrimp in cold water and peel them.
Raw shrimp can be difficult to peel; you can place them in the freezer for about 30 minutes, then take them out to peel more easily.
Once peeled, season the shrimp with a little salt and pepper.
Step 2:
Soak the noodles in warm water until soft.
Then, wrap the noodle strands around each shrimp as if you were winding yarn or thread.
Step 3:
Place a pan on the stove. Once the pan is dry, add the cooking oil.
When the oil is hot enough, drop the shrimp in to fry.
Fry over medium heat. Use plenty of oil so the dish fries evenly and becomes crispy without burning, which actually uses less oil in the end.
Serve hot, dipped in mayonnaise and a bit of chili sauce.
You can make this Crispy Noodle-Wrapped Shrimp dish weekly to make family meals more attractive and effectively support height growth.

mon_an.mo_ta: Shrimp is a highly nutritious food. From its natural sweetness, many delicious dishes with wonderful flavors can be prepared. Today, we will guide you on how to make a unique and delicious Steamed Shrimp with Glass Noodles to treat your whole family!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Minced garlic and chili - to taste
Seasoning - Soy sauce, salt, oyster sauce
cac_buoc: After preparing enough ingredients for 2-3 servings:
Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Remove the heads and shells of the tiger prawns. Use a knife to gently butterfly the back of the shrimp, then use your hands to open it up.
Soak the glass noodles until soft and expanded.
Mince the chilies.
Mince the garlic.
Step 2: Cooking steps
Cut the glass noodles in half for easier eating, then arrange them on a plate.
Arrange the shrimp in a circle on top of the noodles, with the tails pointing outward for a beautiful presentation.
Using a pan, add a little cooking oil and sauté half of the minced garlic until golden brown.
Then add all the remaining garlic and chilies and stir well. Add a little water, soy sauce, oyster sauce, and salt to the pan. Wait for the sauce to boil, then turn off the heat.
Drizzle the sauce evenly over the plate of shrimp and noodles.
Steam the shrimp and noodles over boiling water for about 6-8 minutes.
And that's it, our dish is finished.
Notes for making Steamed Shrimp with Glass Noodles:
Do not steam for too long, or the noodles will become tough and the shrimp will lose its natural sweetness.

This dish is visually appealing, with soft and chewy glass noodles and fragrant, sweet tiger prawns blended with the rich taste of sautéed garlic and onions. The process is simple and doesn't take much time. Treat your family and guests to this unique and attractive dish!
Good luck and enjoy your meal with this Steamed Shrimp with Glass Noodles!

mon_an.mo_ta: Chinese-style shrimp in lobster sauce is a unique and delicious dish that is quick and easy to make. Although we use large tiger prawns instead of actual lobster, the essential ingredient is fermented black bean sauce—a sauce used to prepare lobster dishes in Cantonese cuisine—which is why it is called shrimp in lobster sauce. Let's explore the recipe.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 3 tbsp Lee Kum Kee black bean garlic sauce (or other Chinese fermented black beans)
cac_buoc: After preparing enough ingredients for 5-6 servings, proceed as follows:
Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Peel the shrimp, remove the digestive tract on the back, rinse thoroughly, and drain.
Wash the pork and mince or grind it finely.
Crack the eggs into a bowl and beat them thoroughly; the more foam, the better.
Peel the garlic and mince it.
Do the same with the ginger.
Peel the onion and dice it finely.
Cut the green bell pepper into squares and finely chop the green chili.
Dissolve the cornstarch in 240ml of water.
Chop the scallions for garnish.
Step 2: Cook the dish
First, place a pan on the stove and add 2 tablespoons of oil to heat.
Once the oil is hot, add the ground pork and stir well.
The pork may clump when ground, so stir continuously to break it apart.
When the pork starts to turn golden, add the minced garlic and ginger.
Stir-fry until the pork turns a light brownish-gold, then turn off the heat and remove the pork to a separate bowl.
Next, using the same pan, add the remaining 2 tablespoons of oil and heat.
When the oil is hot, add the fermented black bean sauce.
Simmer over low heat until the sauce boils, then add the shrimp, green bell pepper, green chili, and onion.
Just like with the pork, stir the ingredients well and cook until the shrimp turn light pink.
Then, add the cooked pork back into the pan.
Next, pour in the chicken broth. Increase the heat and bring the broth to a rolling boil.
Then, add the beaten eggs.
Add the soy sauce and stir well.
Next, thicken the sauce by adding the cornstarch mixture prepared earlier.
Add the white pepper and stir the shrimp sauce well.
Taste and adjust the seasoning to your preference.
Finally, turn off the heat and sprinkle scallions on top.
Serve the shrimp and sauce in a bowl and enjoy.
Notes for making Chinese-style shrimp in lobster sauce:
This dish should be eaten hot to be delicious; if it cools down, it may become fishy.
While fresh shrimp is best, you can use frozen shrimp, though the quality and taste will not be as good.
During the cooking process, do not use heat that is too high to prevent the sauce from evaporating too quickly before it can penetrate the shrimp, meat, and vegetables.
Follow the sequence correctly, adding seasonings one by one rather than all at once, to make it easier to adjust the flavor.
This dish offers a very rich and delicious flavor. Explore Chinese cuisine right in your own kitchen with this Chinese-style shrimp in lobster sauce.

mon_an.mo_ta: Soy sauce marinated eggs are a delicious and easy-to-make dish. With a perfect blend of sweet and salty flavors, this dish served with rice or noodles will leave a lasting impression. To prepare this dish, gather the following ingredients.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Onion - Chili - Chives or green onions - Shallots - 1/2 onion - 4-5 peppers - 10 stalks - 2 bulbs
cac_buoc: How to make soy sauce marinated eggs:
Step 1: Gently wash each egg. If the eggs were in the refrigerator, let them reach room temperature before boiling.

Step 2: Boil water and add 2 tbsp vinegar and 1 tsp salt. Once boiling, place each egg onto a large spoon and gently lower them into the pot; dropping them too hard may cause the shells to crack. From the moment the eggs are added, boil for 7-8 minutes (for a soft-boiled consistency), then remove and place in a bowl of ice-cold water to stop the cooking process. This method also makes the eggs easier to peel.
Step 3: Soak the eggs until completely cool before removing them from the water.
Step 4: Wash and finely chop the green onions or chives. Finely dice the onion and shallots. Slice the chilies.
Step 5: Mix the marinade: combine the soy sauce, water, wine, and corn syrup (or honey) in a pot and bring to a boil. Season to taste and let it cool completely.
Step 6: Mix the chopped green onions or chives, onion, shallots, chilies, sesame oil, and toasted sesame seeds into the cooled sauce. Peel the eggs.

Step 7: Arrange the eggs in a container, pour the sauce over them, and marinate for about 6 hours before serving, or store in the refrigerator overnight. These soy sauce marinated eggs can be enjoyed as a snack or served with hot rice.

mon_an.mo_ta: Everyone will love enjoying this three-color steamed egg dish that is both delicious and visually appealing.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Separate 2 salted duck egg yolks into a small bowl; place the salted duck egg whites into a large bowl.
Continue by separating 2 chicken egg yolks into another small bowl; place the chicken egg whites and the remaining 2 whole chicken eggs into the large bowl.
Step 2: Peel and finely chop the century egg. Finely chop the 2 salted duck egg yolks, though they do not need to be minced too finely.
Step 3: Add the salted duck egg yolks and century egg to the large bowl of eggs. Add sugar, 1 tbsp white wine, white pepper, seasoning powder, and 50ml water, then whisk thoroughly until dissolved.

Step 4: Line the mold with plastic wrap, then pour the egg mixture into the mold. Pour water into a steamer and bring to a boil. Place the mold inside, cover, and steam over low heat for about 20 minutes or until the eggs are set.
Step 5: Take the 2 reserved chicken egg yolks and mix with 1 tbsp white wine and 30ml water; whisk until well combined.
Once the egg mixture in the steamer is cooked through, pour the yolk mixture evenly over the surface. Cover and steam for another 3 minutes until the top layer is cooked, then turn off the heat.
