Step 6: Remove the mold and let it cool completely before cutting the eggs into bite-sized pieces. Serve on a plate with rice.
Good luck with this beautiful and tasty three-color steamed egg recipe!

mon_an.ten: Green Mango Pickled in Chili Fish Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: For meals with too much meat, fish, or greasy fried foods, this green mango pickled in chili fish sauce offers a delicious, refreshing flavor to balance the meal. It features a full profile of sour, spicy, salty, and sweet flavors. Besides being a popular snack for young people, it can also be served as a side pickle with main dishes. Let's learn how to make it!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Chili flakes with seeds - As needed
cac_buoc: Prepare all ingredients as shown.
Prepare the ingredients:
Peel the mangoes, slice into bite-sized strips, and soak in diluted salt water for about 1 hour.
Slice the chilies and remove all seeds.
Execution steps:
Bring a pot of water to a boil on the stove.
Blanch the mango briefly, then quickly submerge in cold water to maintain crispness. Drain in a colander.
Mix the mango with 250g of sugar and let it macerate overnight (at least 6-8 hours).
During this process, the sugar will draw out quite a bit of liquid from the mango.
Drain this liquid into a pot and mix with 2 tbsp fish sauce and the remaining 100g of sugar.
Place the pot over medium heat, stir until the sugar is completely dissolved, then turn off the heat and let it cool completely. You can adjust the seasoning to your taste at this step.
Prepare a clean, dry jar. Arrange the mango slices neatly in the jar, add the fresh chilies and chili flakes, then pour in the cooled sauce.
Marinate the mango for a few hours before enjoying.
And that is how we finish the green mango pickled in chili fish sauce.
Wait a little longer and enjoy this crunchy mango dish! 😀
Notes for making green mango pickled in chili fish sauce:
When blanching the mango in boiling water, only dip it in briefly; do not leave it too long or the mango will become mushy.
When taking mango out to eat, use a clean, dry spoon or chopsticks to prevent mold from forming in the jar.

This crunchy mango with its sour, spicy, salty, and sweet flavors is very addictive. During the Lunar New Year, serving this with boiled meat is the perfect combination to cut through the richness. Moms, make a jar of this to keep in the fridge and enjoy whenever you like.

mon_an.mo_ta: Teriyaki sauce is a signature Japanese sweet and savory sauce, often used for frying or grilling meat and fish to add color and flavor. Teriyaki is made from readily available ingredients like soy sauce, mirin, and sugar. If you want to prepare a Japanese dish that requires teriyaki sauce but don't have any on hand, you can make it yourself at home. The process is not difficult; follow this recipe! If you cannot find mirin, you can substitute it with sake.
cac_buoc: Making Teriyaki sauce is very simple; you can do it in just two steps:
Step 1: Place all ingredients into a small saucepan and stir well.
Step 2: Bring the mixture to a boil. Once boiling, reduce the heat and simmer for about 4 minutes over low heat until thickened.
Once the sauce is thick and glossy, simply let it cool and it is ready to use!

mon_an.mo_ta: Let's head to the kitchen to learn how to cook Eggplant with Minced Pork Sauce to refresh your family's menu on a cool, rainy day!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the eggplant, cut into sections 5-7 cm long and 1 cm thick, then soak in a bowl of diluted salt water.
Step 2: Drain the eggplant and place in a large bowl. Sift cornstarch over it and toss well to create an even coating.
Step 3: Fry the eggplant until golden brown, then remove.
Step 4: Drain the excess oil from the pan, leaving just a little. Add the garlic and sauté until fragrant.
Step 5: Add the pork and stir-fry until firm, then add the chili paste, XO sauce, and finely chopped bell pepper.
Step 6: When the sauce boils, add the eggplant, season to taste, and toss well. Simmer this easy dish for about 3-4 minutes over low heat.
Step 7: Turn off the heat, arrange the dish on a plate, and garnish with chopped green onions to make it more appealing!
Source: ST

mon_an.ten: Flower Crab Soup with Sour Bamboo Shoots
mon_an.mo_ta: Flower crab soup with sour bamboo shoots is a favorite for many families during summer. The tender, fresh, and nutritious crab meat combined with pineapple and mildly sour bamboo shoots in a refreshing broth creates a wonderful flavor. Let's learn how to cook this delicious dish!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fish sauce, seasoning powder, salt, pepper, lime - seasonings
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Wash the crabs thoroughly, then remove the aprons. Use a spoon to scoop out the roe into a small bowl and squeeze a few drops of lime juice over it to remove the fishy smell.
Next, cut the crab bodies in half and set aside in a bowl.
Step 3:
Peel the pineapple, remove the eyes, and slice it. To save time, you can buy pre-peeled pineapple.
Remove the stems from the tomatoes, wash them, and cut into wedges.
Step 4:

Heat two tablespoons of cooking oil in a pan, sauté the minced shallots until fragrant, then add the crab roe and stir gently. Do not stir too much, as the roe may break or crumble, making the dish less attractive.
Step 6:
Add about two small bowls of filtered water to the pot and bring to a boil over low heat.
Step 7:
In a small pan, sauté more minced shallots until fragrant, add the tomatoes and stir well. Add a teaspoon of salt to help the tomatoes soften quickly.
Step 8:
Add the sour bamboo shoots and pineapple to the pan to simmer together for 8 to 10 minutes. If you do not like sour bamboo, you can use only pineapple, as it provides enough acidity for the soup.
Step 9:

Pour the tomato, bamboo, and pineapple mixture into the crab pot. Bring to a boil and cook for 4 - 7 minutes. As the pineapple and tomatoes release their sweet and sour juices and the crab meat adds natural sweetness, you won't need much extra seasoning. Adjust the taste to your preference.
Step 11:
Finally, turn off the heat and stir in the chopped green onions and culantro. Ladle the soup into bowls and serve with rice or vermicelli.
Notes for a delicious crab soup with sour bamboo:
How to choose good crabs:

There are many types of crabs such as red crabs, three-spot crabs, and blue swimmer crabs... but the blue swimmer crab is the tastiest, meatiest, and most nutritious. This seafood is rich in vitamins, especially vitamin D. To buy good crabs:
Avoid buying dead or chilled crabs because they lose their firmness and flavor during the icing process. Choose vendors who keep live crabs in oxygenated tanks to ensure the best meat quality.

A good crab should have a bright color, not dull, and feel heavy for its size. If you like roe, choose females; if you prefer meat, choose males. For males, press the apron; if it doesn't dent, the meat is firm. For females, press the legs; if they are firm and not soft or hollow, it is a good crab.

Females have a large, semicircular apron. If they have spawned many times, they will be thin and less tasty; in this case, the apron won't fit tightly against the belly and can be easily pried open. Males have smaller aprons; choose those with aprons that fit tightly.

Do not choose crabs that are too large or too small; medium-sized ones, about the size of a hand, are usually meatier. Whether male or female, choose those with aprons tightly pressed against the body, as these are young adults that haven't spawned much, ensuring firmer meat.

Select very firm crabs about the size of an adult's hand that do not dent when the apron is pressed. If you are hesitant to touch them, look for crabs with reddish aprons and curled legs, as fresh crabs will contract their legs rather than stretching them out.

mon_an.mo_ta: Stuffed bitter melon soup is perfect for cooling down the whole family on hot summer days.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 3 wood ear mushrooms, soaked and expanded
Seasonings: seasoning powder, soup powder, cooking oil, pepper.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Place 150g ground pork, finely chopped wood ear mushrooms, and 1 egg white into a clean bowl. Add some minced shallots, ½ tsp pepper, and ½ tsp seasoning powder, then mix well.
Step 2: Use a knife to cut the tops of the bitter melons without severing them completely, then wash them again.
Step 3: Gently stuff the meat mixture into the melons, repeating until all ingredients are used. Blanch the bitter melons briefly, then cut them into small pieces about 2-3 cm long.

Step 4: Sauté the minced shallots with a little oil, then pour in the bone broth and bring to a boil. Season to taste. Drop each piece of bitter melon into the pot. When the soup boils, skim off any foam.
Step 5: Finally, sprinkle with chopped green onions and 1 tsp of MSG, then pour the soup into a bowl and enjoy.
Enjoy your refreshing stuffed bitter melon soup with your family for a summer meal!

mon_an.mo_ta: Oxtail hotpot is a famous dish known for its rich flavor and tender, chewy meat. However, not everyone can cook a perfectly flavored oxtail hotpot. Today, we will share the basic steps to cook an oxtail hotpot as delicious as those in restaurants. From selecting fresh ingredients and preparing the right spices to the cooking techniques that create a bold and attractive hotpot. Learn how to choose ingredients, prepare seasonings, and cook a flavorful, authentic oxtail hotpot at home.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Northern-style fermented soybean paste (tương bần), MSG, seasoning powder, sugar, salt - seasonings
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients

After purchasing the oxtail, rinse it briefly with water and place it in a bowl with a little rice wine and crushed ginger to remove odors. Soak for 5 minutes, then rinse again with clean water and chop into bite-sized pieces.
For the beef tendons, rinse with water, then soak in diluted salt water for about 5 - 7 minutes. Remove and rinse again with clean water, then drain.
Clean the lotus root, peel the outer skin, and cut into thin slices about 1 - 2cm thick.
Peel the taro, wash, and cut into small bite-sized pieces.
Wash the lemongrass and cut into 3cm segments.
Step 2: Deodorize the oxtail

Place a pot of water on the stove and heat it up, then add the crushed ginger. Once the water boils, add the beef tendons and oxtail to the pot. Cook for about 5 - 10 minutes to remove the odors from the tail and tendons.
To remove the odor from the beef tendons first, you should remove them from the pot before adding the oxtail to the boiling water.
Step 3: Stew the tendons and oxtail

First, wash the beef tendons with diluted salt water. Then, boil a pot of water and add the tendons along with the smashed lemongrass, cooking for about 5 - 7 minutes. Once done, remove the tendons and cut into bite-sized pieces. Place the tendons in another pot with 500ml of water and simmer for about 20 - 25 minutes until tender. Then, let them cool and set aside.

Next, place the marinated oxtail in a pot with 1 liter of water and the lemongrass segments, simmering for about 15 minutes. Then, turn off the heat, let it cool, and remove the oxtail. Keep the simmering liquid to use as broth.

In a pan, sauté minced shallots and garlic with one tablespoon of cooking oil until fragrant. Next, add the simmered oxtail and tendons to the pan and stir-fry evenly for 5 minutes. Then, turn off the heat.
Step 4: Cook the hotpot

Place a pot on the stove, then add garlic, shallots, and smashed lemongrass to the pot and sauté until golden and fragrant. Next, add the marinated oxtail and beef tendons to the pot along with 1 liter of water, and cook for about 15 minutes.
Then, add the taro and lotus root to the pot and continue cooking until the water boils again. Season to taste, then continue to simmer over low heat until all ingredients are tender.
If you prefer, you can stew the tendons and oxtail in a pressure cooker to make the ingredients softer. Once finished, the oxtail hotpot is complete. Bring it to the table and enjoy the result.
Depending on your preference, you can choose different side vegetables such as water spinach, lettuce, mustard greens, or enoki mushrooms, etc.
Step 5: Finished product

Keep the hotpot hot and dip the side vegetables into homemade dipping sauce for a delicious flavor. When enjoying, the combination of tender meat and chewy beef tendons, along with the sweet and nutty flavor of the taro, makes the hotpot dish attractive and special.
How to choose good oxtail
To buy good oxtail, choose meat that is bright red. Bright red oxtail meat is a characteristic of high-quality oxtail.
The fat in the oxtail should be bright yellow, the tendons should be white and feel firm when pressed. If the fat feels soft when pressed, you should avoid buying it.
Finally, use your hand to press the oxtail. If the oxtail is good, the meat will have good elasticity, will not be mushy, and will have no foul odor.

mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried bamboo shoots with mushrooms not only makes the meal more delicious and gives the digestive system a chance to rest due to its easy digestibility, but also helps stimulate the appetite when you feel like you have lost your sense of taste. You can also adapt this easy-to-make dish into a vegetarian version by omitting the chicken broth for meatless days! Instructions on how to cook delicious stir-fried bamboo shoots with mushrooms - A tasty and easy-to-make dish. Enjoy the wonderful flavor of fresh bamboo shoots and fragrant mushrooms when they are stir-fried evenly. This article provides detailed instructions on the process of cooking stir-fried bamboo shoots with mushrooms, from ingredient preparation to the execution steps.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Soak the shiitake and wood ear mushrooms in warm water for about 30 minutes until they expand and soften. Remove the wood ear and shiitake mushrooms, wash away any dirt under running water, and drain. Tear the bread into small pieces.

Step 2: Peel the bamboo shoots, remove the tough parts, and slice diagonally. Boil the bamboo shoots with a bit of salt to remove acidity and toxins. Let it boil for about 3-5 minutes, then pour the bamboo shoots out, rinse with cold water, and drain.
Step 3: Heat oil in a pan, add the bamboo shoots, and stir-fry briefly. Add the shiitake mushrooms, wood ear mushrooms, and bread, and toss lightly.

Step 4: Add the broth, wait until it boils, then reduce the heat to a simmer so the bamboo shoots cook until tender. When the liquid has reduced, season to taste, add chopped green onions, stir well, and turn off the heat.
Step 5: Arrange the Stir-Fried Bamboo Shoots with Mushrooms on a plate; serving hot with rice on a rainy day is absolutely wonderful!
Notes for cooking delicious stir-fried bamboo shoots with mushrooms
Prepare fresh ingredients: Choose fresh bamboo shoots and fresh mushrooms with no signs of spoilage. Clean them thoroughly before use.
Slice bamboo and mushrooms evenly: Slice the bamboo into rounds and the mushrooms into thin slices. This helps the bamboo and mushrooms cook evenly and quickly.
Sauté fragrant lemongrass: Sauté the lemongrass in hot cooking oil until fragrant to create a signature flavor for the dish.
Stir-fry bamboo and mushrooms quickly: When stir-frying bamboo and mushrooms, ensure high heat and stir-fry quickly to keep them crisp and prevent them from becoming mushy.
Ensure moderate spiciness: Add chili at the end of the stir-frying process and toss for about 30 seconds. Check the flavor and adjust the spiciness according to personal taste.
Sprinkle toasted sesame seeds on top: Toast the sesame seeds until golden and fragrant, then sprinkle them over the stir-fried bamboo and mushrooms to enhance the flavor and decorate the dish.
Enjoy hot: Stir-fried bamboo shoots with lemongrass and chili is best enjoyed immediately after cooking. While still hot, the bamboo and mushrooms will retain their crispness and wonderful flavor.
How to cook delicious stir-fried bamboo shoots with mushrooms
When choosing bamboo shoots for the dish, note the following factors:
Condition of the bamboo: Choose fresh bamboo shoots with no yellow leaves and no spots on the surface. The bamboo should have thin skin, not be withered, and not be curved.

Appearance characteristics: Bamboo shoots should be stout with even segments. To the naked eye, the bamboo should have thin, crisp skin and contain a lot of water. Avoid choosing bamboo that is too white or yellowish-brown. Bamboo should have visible veins and not feel sticky to the touch.
Smell and taste: Fresh, delicious bamboo shoots must have a characteristic aroma. Avoid choosing bamboo with a foul odor or an unusually bright white or deep yellow color.
Note:
If the bamboo is unusually white or deep yellow and has a foul odor, do not use it.
For people suffering from malaria, malnutrition, or physical weakness, bamboo shoots should not be used as food, as they can negatively affect their health condition.
Paying attention to the above factors will help you choose fresh, delicious bamboo shoots and ensure the safety of your dish.

mon_an.ten: Stir-Fried Chicken with Lemongrass and Chili
mon_an.mo_ta: Chicken comes in many varieties: Ri chicken, Dong Cao chicken, black chicken, fighting chicken... Among them, Ri chicken (local chicken) and black chicken have high-quality, nutrient-rich meat. Traditional medicine believes that chicken meat has a sweet taste, warm properties, is non-toxic, and has a high tonic effect for people with long-term illnesses, or those with a cold and weak stomach who cannot absorb food. Additionally, chicken meat can treat hemorrhaging, dysentery, boils, and dispel wind. Therefore, chicken is often used for those who are thin, losing weight, exhausted, have indigestion, poor appetite, diarrhea, edema, painful urination, vaginal discharge, low milk supply after childbirth, or diabetes. There are many ways to make a delicious chicken dish; the simplest can be boiling, braising, or stir-frying... More elaborate methods include cooking with aromatics or simmering to extract the essence. Today, we will guide you on how to cook a wonderful stir-fried chicken with lemongrass and chili! Discover the guide to making delicious stir-fried chicken with lemongrass and chili with a unique recipe. Enjoy a fragrant, spicy, and attractive dish. Show off your cooking skills and satisfy your family and friends with this flavorful lemongrass and chili chicken!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fish sauce, salt, pepper, seasoning powder, cooking oil - as needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Chop the chicken into bite-sized pieces and marinate with salt, seasoning powder, and ground pepper.
Step 2: Smash the lemongrass and mince it, slice the chili into rings, and add them to the chicken to marinate together.

Step 3: Place a pan on the stove, heat the oil until very hot, then add the chicken and stir-fry until the meat firms up. Stir evenly and quickly (using high heat will make the chicken firmer, but if you don't stir constantly, the outside may burn while the inside remains undercooked; therefore, it is best to use medium heat when starting to stir-fry, then increase to high heat once cooked to firm up the chicken).

Step 4: When the chicken is almost cooked, mix a little sugar with some fish sauce and add it to the pan. Stir-fry until the sugar turns golden brown, then turn off the heat and arrange the chicken on a plate.
Enjoy your meal with the stir-fried lemongrass and chili chicken!
Secrets to making the lemongrass chicken dish attractive
2.1. Secrets to making delicious stir-fried lemongrass and chili chicken
To make your lemongrass chicken truly attractive, apply these secrets:
Choose fresh chicken: Select fresh chicken with no odor and pink skin. Ensure the chicken is clean and does not have too much fat.

Marinate thoroughly: Before cooking, marinate the chicken with lemongrass, garlic, salt, sugar, pepper, and other seasonings. To let the flavors penetrate, marinate for at least 30 minutes or, if possible, overnight in the refrigerator.
Cook the chicken with the right technique: Stir-fry the chicken at a high temperature to achieve a crispy skin and a beautiful golden color. Ensure the chicken is cooked evenly and not burnt.

Combine with herbs and garnishes: Present the lemongrass chicken on a plate, sprinkled with herbs like basil, cilantro, or lime leaves. Add garnishes like green onions, fresh chili, and fried garlic to enhance the flavor.
2.2. How to choose and buy fresh chicken
Appropriate size and weight: You should choose chickens of moderate size and weight, not too small or too large. This ensures the chicken is processed evenly and maintains its freshness.
Check the chicken skin: A fresh, delicious chicken usually has shiny golden, smooth, and thin skin. Pay attention to the smoothness and color of the skin, and feel the elasticity when touched.

Color and state of the meat: The meat inside the chicken should be a natural reddish-pink color, without many blue-purple patches or other unusual colors. Check the surface of the meat to ensure there are no signs of color change or spoilage.
2.3. How to prepare and deodorize chicken meat
Cut off the oil gland at the tail: One of the sources of chicken odor is the oil gland at the tail. You can cut this part off to reduce unwanted smells.

Use a mixture of vinegar and salt: Soak the chicken in a mixture of vinegar and salt for about 3 – 5 minutes. This mixture will help deodorize and make the chicken fresher. Then, remove the chicken and rinse thoroughly before use.

Use lime juice: If you don't have vinegar, you can substitute it with lime juice. Rub lime juice over the surface of the chicken and leave it for about 5 minutes before rinsing. Lime juice will help deodorize and bring a fresh flavor to the chicken.

mon_an.mo_ta: Start your week with this simple yet enticing dish! Stir-fried choy sum with garlic is a rustic favorite, featuring crunchy, sweet greens and the rich aroma of garlic. It makes any meal more interesting without requiring much effort, allowing you more time for your busy schedule. Discover this delightful and straightforward dish where the crisp greens and fragrant garlic perfectly complement each other.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fish sauce, seasoning powder, cooking oil - as needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients

After purchasing the choy sum, inspect and remove any damaged leaves. Soak the greens in diluted salt water for about 10 minutes to remove impurities. Then, rinse thoroughly with clean water and drain. You can keep the leaves whole or cut them into smaller pieces according to your preference.
For the garlic and ginger, peel and crush the garlic, and finely mince the ginger to use in the dish.
Step 2: Stir-fry the choy sum with garlic
Place a pan on the stove over medium heat. Add about 2 tbsp of cooking oil and wait until hot. Add the crushed garlic and sauté until fragrant and golden brown.

Next, add the prepared choy sum to the pan and stir-fry quickly for about 30 seconds so the greens soften and get a beautiful glossy coating of oil. Add 4 tbsp of filtered water to the pan to prevent sticking and help the greens cook through until tender.

Stir-fry for about 3 minutes, then season with 1 tsp seasoning powder and 1/2 tsp MSG. Toss well so the greens are evenly coated with seasonings. Continue stir-frying for another 2 minutes. Finally, taste and adjust the flavor to your liking, then turn off the heat.
Step 3: Finished product

In just 5 minutes, the stir-fried choy sum with garlic is complete. The fresh green stalks retain their vibrant color and delicious crunch, blending with the aroma of the sautéed garlic. The result is a visually appealing dish full of flavor that stimulates the palate.
Notes for making stir-fried choy sum with garlic
Preparing the greens: After buying, pick off damaged leaves and soak in diluted salt water for 10 minutes to remove dirt. Rinse well and drain before cooking.
Sautéing the garlic: Wait until the oil is hot before adding the crushed garlic. This helps release the characteristic aroma for the dish.
Stir-fry quickly: When adding the choy sum, stir-fry quickly for 30 seconds to soften and coat them in oil. Add a little water to prevent scorching and ensure the greens cook evenly.
Balanced seasoning: Add seasoning powder and MSG, tossing well so the greens absorb the flavors. Adjust the seasoning to suit your personal taste.
Ensure crunchiness: Stir-fry for about 3 minutes to ensure the greens stay crisp and don't become overcooked or lose their freshness.
Following these notes will help you create an attractive and delicious rustic dish. Try it and enjoy with your family and friends!

mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried napa cabbage with sausages – a perfect choice for children who dislike green vegetables. Learn how to cook this simple, delicious stir-fry for your little ones.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Separate the napa cabbage leaves, split them into quarters, wash thoroughly, and drain.
Thinly slice the sausages. If the children can eat spicy food, wash the chilies, split them to remove seeds, and mince.
Peel and slice the garlic. Trim the roots of the green onions, wash, and cut into short segments.
Step 2: Heat a pan with oil on the stove. Once the oil is hot, sauté the green onions and garlic until fragrant.
Step 3: Add the napa cabbage and stir-fry over high heat to maintain its beautiful color and prevent it from turning dull. Once the cabbage has softened, add 1 tbsp of soy sauce.

Step 4: If the children can handle heat, you can add a little chili to the pan. The spiciness will make the dish more appetizing. Since sausages are already salty, they shouldn't be cooked for too long. Once the cabbage is cooked, add the sausages, toss quickly, and turn off the heat.
Source: YukiFood

mon_an.mo_ta: Carp and tofu soup is a delicious fish-based dish, perfect for chilly days. If you are looking for a dish that is tasty, nutritious, and easy to cook, this is the recipe for you. Let's try making this unique and flavorful dish today.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Ginger, green onions, pepper, chili - as needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Clean the fish and cut into suitable chunks. Clean thoroughly with salt, wine, and ginger. Pan-fry the fish until golden brown on both sides, then turn off the heat.
Step 2: Cut the tofu into bite-sized pieces. Soak the glass noodles in cold water until soft, then drain.
Step 3: Pour broth (or water) into the pan with the fried fish. Add a few slices of ginger and 2/3 of the tofu. Bring to a boil over high heat.
Step 4: When the broth turns a milky white color, add the remaining tofu and the glass noodles. Season to taste and wait for the noodles to cook through.
Add some chopped green onions, pepper, and chili according to your family's taste. Your delicious and unique carp and tofu soup is ready! Enjoy your meal!

mon_an.mo_ta: This cool weather is perfect for Chicken and Mushroom Stew – a wonderful dish to cook for your mother! It is highly nutritious yet easy to make. Preparing this for your mother and family on October 20th would be fantastic. She will surely be happy to see you in the kitchen; let's get started!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning powder, fish sauce, chili, pepper - as needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Select good mushrooms. Clean the chicken and chop into bite-sized pieces. Marinate with ginger, lemongrass, fish sauce, and salt. Soak the shiitake mushrooms in hot water for 10 minutes and rinse. Trim the roots of the oyster mushrooms and blanch them in boiling water. Peel the carrot, carve into flower shapes, and slice thinly.
Step 2: Stir-fry the chicken to absorb the seasonings and become fragrant. Add about 1 liter of water and simmer for about 40 minutes over medium heat.

Step 3: Add more boiling water if the liquid is low. Season with fish sauce and seasoning powder to taste. Add the mushrooms and carrots, and cook for another 10 minutes. Add chili and pepper according to your preference.
Step 4: Serve the Chicken and Mushroom Stew in a bowl and present it to your beloved mother!

mon_an.mo_ta: Kimchi Tofu Soup – An easy-to-make dish with a mild sourness and a hint of spice that will warm your stomach on rainy days. Here is how to cook a delicious Kimchi Tofu Soup.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the pork belly and slice it very thinly. Rinse the tofu, drain, and slice into pieces about 1cm thick.
Step 2: Sauté the minced ginger and garlic until fragrant. Peel the onion, cut into wedges, and sauté with the ginger and garlic.
Step 3: Next, add the pork belly and stir-fry until nearly cooked. At this stage, remember to add a little salt to season the meat.

Step 4: Roughly chop the kimchi and add it to the pan. Pour in enough water to cover the ingredients and boil over medium heat for 10-15 minutes. Finally, add the tofu, bring back to a boil, and season with a bit of sugar and sesame oil. Ladle the kimchi tofu soup into bowls and serve hot.
Source: Kenh14

mon_an.mo_ta: During hot summer days, everyone looks for cooling, easy-to-eat dishes. Today, I'd like to share a delicious and very simple recipe: clam and tofu soup. Let's cook it together! - Introducing a dinner menu featuring clam and tofu soup.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Clean the clams thoroughly. Cut the tofu into bite-sized pieces.

Step 2: Bring a pot of water to a boil and season as desired. Once boiling, add the cleaned clams. When the water returns to a boil, add the tofu. Continue cooking for about 5 minutes, then turn off the heat.
Step 3: After turning off the heat, adjust the seasoning, add chopped green onions or chives, and enjoy the soup.
Tip: This clam and tofu soup is best enjoyed while hot to ensure a great taste without any fishy aroma.

mon_an.mo_ta: Clam and pineapple soup is a familiar favorite featuring tender, fresh clams and the tangy sweetness of pineapple in a refreshing broth. It's a perfect meal to cool down. Let's get in the kitchen and prepare this for the whole family!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Vietnamese coriander, dill, green onions - herbs
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients

Wash the clams thoroughly. To clean them better, soak them in rice water for a few hours before processing to remove grit. Place the clams in a pot and boil until they open their shells, then turn off the heat. Strain the broth into a separate container and pick the clam meat into a bowl.
Once the clams have cooled slightly, remove the dark digestive part to prevent bitterness, then rinse the meat again.
Peel the pineapple and carefully remove the eyes to avoid irritation. Slice into bite-sized pieces.
Wash the tomatoes and cut into wedges.
Peel and thinly slice or crush the shallots. Wash and mince the ginger.
Clean the Vietnamese coriander and green onions, removing wilted leaves, then wash and chop finely.
Step 2: Cooking the soup

Heat a pan with a little oil. Once hot, sauté the shallots until fragrant. Add the clam meat and stir-fry for a few minutes with some seasoning. When the meat firms up, add the tomatoes and sauté until soft. Remove the clam meat and tomatoes to a bowl. (Note: Do not overcook the clam meat or it will lose its sweetness).

Pour the clam broth into a pot, add the crushed dracontomelon (sấu), and bring to a boil. Once the sấu is soft, add the pineapple and the sautéed clam mixture. Cook for about 5 minutes until the clams are cooked through and the pineapple is tender. Finally, add the green onions and Vietnamese coriander, adjust the seasoning to taste, stir well, and turn off the heat.
Tips for a great clam soup:
Remember to remove the digestive part of the clams after boiling to avoid bitterness. Rinse thoroughly afterward.
Do not over-fry the clam meat as it can become tough and lose its natural sweetness.
Adjust the number of sấu or pineapple based on your preference for sourness.
How to choose and clean clams:
+ Choosing clams: Buy clams with hard shells that are tightly closed. If a shell opens easily by hand, the clam is dead. For open clams, touch them; if they move or close, they are fresh.
+ Cleaning clams: After washing the outside, soak them in a bowl of lightly salted water (like seawater) with 2 chopped chilies for 1-2 hours. The clams will spit out all the sand and mud.

mon_an.mo_ta: With its appealing colors and rich flavor, this soup is an excellent choice for family meals. Premium pork ribs are simmered until tender, infusing into the soft, smooth pieces of cassava. The sweet, fragrant broth creates a harmonious combination. This hot, savory soup will leave every diner satisfied. Discover the recipe for this hearty Pork Rib and Cassava Soup now!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings - Salt, seasoning powder, fish sauce
cac_buoc: 1. Prepare the ingredients
Cassava: Peel and wash the cassava. Slice into thin rounds or strips as preferred.
Pork ribs: Wash the ribs and cut into small bite-sized pieces. You may want to trim off excess fat before cooking.
Green onions: Wash and chop into small segments to enhance the flavor and color of the soup.
Seasonings: Prepare salt, seasoning powder, and fish sauce to taste.
2. How to cook the soup

Step 1: Choose waxy cassava with small, elongated roots about 2-3cm in diameter. Cut off both ends, peel, and wash. Cut into segments and remove the fibrous core. Soak in lightly salted water for 2-3 hours, changing the water periodically to remove toxins. Then, boil the cassava in a pot for 5-6 minutes to ensure all toxins are eliminated.

Step 2: Wash the pork ribs and chop into bite-sized pieces. Blanch the ribs in boiling water with a pinch of salt for 2 minutes, then turn off the heat. Rinse the ribs with cold water. Place the ribs in a pot and simmer until tender.
Step 3: Prepare the green onions by washing and chopping them.

Step 4: When the ribs are nearly tender, add the cassava and a bit of seasoning powder to the pot. Continue cooking until the cassava is soft. Add 1/2 tbsp of fish sauce for aroma and adjust the seasoning to taste. Turn off the heat and add the chopped green onions.
This soup is best enjoyed hot. The tender ribs and waxy, fragrant cassava create a wonderful culinary experience.
Notes for a delicious Pork Rib and Cassava Soup
Choose fresh ingredients: Select fresh cassava and premium pork ribs to ensure the best flavor.
Careful preparation: Thoroughly wash the cassava and ribs. Trim excess fat from the ribs to keep the broth clear.
Simmer on low heat: Use low heat so the ingredients cook evenly and retain their natural flavors.
Check for doneness: Ensure the ribs and cassava are tender before final seasoning. The ribs should be soft but not falling apart, and the cassava should be waxy and sweet.
Do not overcook: This soup doesn't need excessive cooking time once the ingredients are added, to avoid losing the texture of the cassava.
Season to taste: Balance the salt, seasoning powder, and fish sauce. Always taste and adjust for your family.
Add green onions at the end: Fresh green onions add color and aroma. Add them right before serving to keep them vibrant.
Serve hot: This soup is best served steaming hot for the most comforting experience.

mon_an.mo_ta: On a cold day, nothing beats a steaming, fragrant bowl of soup! Today, we introduce Beef and Vietnamese Coriander Soup to bring warmth to your family meal. With tender beef and a perfectly balanced broth, your whole family will love it!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning powder, fish sauce, cooking oil, pepper - as needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Thinly slice the beef and marinate with fish sauce, pepper, ginger, and minced shallots.
Step 2: Clean the Vietnamese coriander and green onions, then chop finely. Wash the tomato and cut into wedges.

Step 3: Sauté the tomato with a little oil, then pour in water and bring to a boil. Season with fish sauce and salt to taste. Add the beef, and once the water returns to a boil, add the herbs and turn off the heat.
Step 4: Ladle the soup into a bowl and enjoy!

mon_an.mo_ta: Meat and Fresh Mushroom Soup – A refreshing and healthy daily dish. Here is how to make it.
cac_buoc: Clean all types of mushrooms thoroughly, drain, and slice into bite-sized pieces.
Bring a pot of meat or chicken broth to a boil and season to taste.
Add the mushrooms to the pot. You can also add some tofu and minced meat for extra flavor.
When the mushrooms are cooked, add some chopped green onions and turn off the heat.
Source: Kenh14

mon_an.mo_ta: In the past, my grandmother used to cook Pumpkin and Pork Bone Soup for me, and it was delicious. Now that I live far away, I can no longer eat her cooking. When I crave it, I have to cook it myself, but it never tastes quite as good as hers. She said this soup is very nutritious and told me to eat plenty of it, but I didn't pay much attention then; I just loved the sweet taste of the bone broth, the fragrant pumpkin, and the rich, nutty flavor of the peanuts! Today, I would like to share my grandmother's recipe for your reference. This article provides a simple and detailed guide on how to prepare pumpkin and pork bone soup, a delicious and nutritious dish.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning powder, fish sauce - as needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Soak the mung beans in hot water for about 20 minutes. Then rinse well and drain.
Step 2: Chop the bones into bite-sized pieces. Peel the pumpkin and cut into bite-sized chunks. Wash the peanuts, remove the skin, and split them in half. Wash the basil and drain.

Step 3: Blanch the bones in boiling water for a while to remove impurities, then discard the water and rinse the bones with boiling water. Briefly stir-fry the bones with fish sauce and seasoning powder, then add enough water to cover and simmer for about half an hour. Add the pumpkin, mung beans, and peanuts, stew for another 20 minutes, then season with fish sauce and seasoning powder to taste and turn off the heat.
Step 4: Serve the Pumpkin and Pork Bone Soup in a bowl, garnish with a few sprigs of basil, and enjoy.
How to choose fresh ingredients
How to choose quality pork ribs

When buying ribs, choose pieces with a natural light red color and elasticity when pressed lightly. For a delicious soup, choose ribs with a mix of fat and lean meat, and prioritize flat, small bones to get more meat. Avoid buying ribs with unusual dark spots, unpleasant odors, or a pale purple color, as these are signs of old meat.
How to choose fresh pumpkin

When choosing pumpkin for soup, select round fruits with firm green stems about 2 finger-joints long. The fruit should feel heavy, firm, and have no cracks or scars. Avoid buying pumpkins with cracks on the body or those that are leaking fluid, as they will not taste good when cooked.
Tips for cleaning pork ribs and removing odors
Method 1: Pour enough clean water into a pot to cover the ribs. Boil for 2-3 minutes, then remove the meat and rinse with water.
Method 2: Mix sea salt into water and stir until dissolved, then soak the ribs in this solution for 25-30 minutes. Once finished, remove the ribs and rinse well.
Method 3: Soak the ribs in salt water and optionally add a few slices of crushed ginger or a few drops of white wine.
Notes when making nutritious pumpkin and pork bone soup
Choose fresh ingredients: Select fresh bones and pumpkin without signs of spoilage, rot, or staleness. This ensures the soup has a good flavor and retains its nutrients.
Prepare the bones correctly: Before use, simmer the bones first to remove foam and residue. This helps the soup stay clear and clean.
Use plenty of vegetables and herbs: Add greens and herbs like cilantro, culantro, or basil to the soup to enhance the flavor and provide extra nutrients.
Do not overcook: To keep the flavor and nutrients intact, the soup should be cooked for a short time. Cooking too long can lose the nutritional value of the ingredients.
Do not use too much seasoning: Avoid using too much salt, sugar, or strong spices so as not to lose the natural taste and nutrition of the soup.
Add other nutritious foods: Besides bones and pumpkin, you can add other nutritious foods like mushrooms, carrots, or potatoes to increase the nutritional content of the soup.

mon_an.mo_ta: Kimchi Tofu Pancakes – spicy, crispy, and rich with the creaminess of tofu and kimchi; this combination is definitely worth a try. Learn how to cook delicious Kimchi Tofu Pancakes.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Kimchi can be very spicy and store-bought versions are sometimes a bit salty; you can rinse the kimchi with filtered water, squeeze dry, and chop it small to suit your personal taste. Mash the tofu and mix it with flour, water, and the egg; stir well to form a smooth, well-combined mixture.

Step 2: Mix the tofu mixture thoroughly with the chopped kimchi. Since kimchi already contains sour, spicy, salty, and sweet flavors, you don't need to add much seasoning; you can add a little salt or sugar depending on the taste of your kimchi.

Step 3: Finally, add the onion, chives, and fresh chili and mix well. Heat a pan, use a paper towel to wipe it with a little oil, then scoop spoonfuls of the batter into the pan. Fry both sides until golden and they are ready to serve.
Source: Kenh14

mon_an.mo_ta: Beef and Potato Croquettes are an attractive dish featuring tender, fresh beef blended with smooth mashed potatoes, crunchy onions, carrots, and fresh mushrooms. Everything is encased in a crispy, golden-brown crust. Let's get into the kitchen to learn how to cook this delicious dish!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Pepper, MSG, seasoning powder, salt - seasonings
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients for the beef and potato croquettes.
Rinse the beef and grind or mince it finely.
Peel the potatoes, wash them, and cut into chunks. Immediately soak the potatoes in water so they don't turn brown.
Peel the carrots and onions, wash them, and mince finely.
Wash the mushrooms and mince them. If using dried shiitake mushrooms, soak them in hot water until soft, trim the stems to remove any odor, rinse again, and then mince.
Next, crack 2 eggs into a bowl and beat them.
Step 2: Cooking steps for beef and potato croquettes.
First, place a pot of water on the stove, add a little salt, and boil the potatoes until tender.

To check if the potatoes are cooked, poke them with a chopstick. If the potatoes are soft and the chopstick pierces through easily, they are done; turn off the heat. Remove the potatoes to a bowl and let them cool slightly.
Next, use a large, sturdy spoon to mash the potatoes until smooth.

Then, place a pan on the stove and add a little oil. Sauté the onions, then add the carrots and beef, stirring well. Next, add the mushrooms and season with a bit of MSG, seasoning powder, and pepper. Taste the filling to suit your preference. Once the mixture is cooked, transfer it to a bowl.

Next, mix the mashed potatoes thoroughly with the sautéed mixture, crack in 2 more eggs, and add a bit more pepper and seasoning powder. The potatoes will dilute the flavor, so extra seasoning is needed.
Use your hands to mix the mixture thoroughly so everything is well-seasoned. Then, shape the mixture into bite-sized balls and set them aside on a large plate.
Next, roll each ball in flour, making sure it is well-coated. Then dip the ball into the beaten eggs and finally coat it thoroughly with breadcrumbs. Repeat until all the mixture is used.
After coating, place a pan on the stove and add enough oil to submerge the croquettes. Drop each ball in to fry.

Remember to turn them frequently so they turn golden brown on all sides without burning. Cook over medium heat; do not use high heat to avoid the outside burning while the inside remains uncooked. When the croquettes are a beautiful golden color, remove them. Place on paper towels to drain.
Finally, arrange the beef and potato croquettes as desired and serve with mayonnaise, chili sauce, or garlic fish sauce. Serve hot to fully enjoy the flavor.
Notes for delicious beef and potato croquettes.
When choosing beef, you should pick fresh meat and grind it yourself. Supermarket pre-ground meat may contain unknown cuts or too much fat, which can make the dish greasy.
Similarly, if you don't have breadcrumbs, you can use panko instead.
When choosing potatoes: select new potatoes with a bright yellow color, no green spots, and a firm texture. This ensures they aren't bitter and will be fragrant and starchy.

When sautéing the beef mixture, do not cook it too long; just until done so the onions don't get mushy and the beef doesn't get tough. Some people add water when sautéing the filling, but you should avoid this. Since the sautéing time is short, the water won't evaporate, making the filling mushy and less tasty.

mon_an.mo_ta: Fried Salmon with Rice – suitable for families with young children and those looking to lose weight, as salmon provides many nutrients beneficial for brain development. Learn how to cook delicious Fried Salmon with Rice.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Chili sauce, soy sauce, honey - 1 tbsp each
cac_buoc: Step 1: Rinse the salmon, pat dry with paper towels, and marinate with a little salt and pepper to make the meat fragrant and flavorful.

Step 2: Slice the lemon. Heat oil in a pan to fry the fish. While frying, you can add a few lemon slices to the pan to remove the fishy odor. When the fish is cooked, remove to a plate, let cool, and cut into bite-sized pieces.

Step 3: Peel and mince the garlic. Mix the sauce to drizzle over the salmon rice: Combine honey, chili sauce, soy sauce, vinegar, lime juice, sesame oil, and toasted sesame seeds in a small bowl and stir well.
Step 4: Serve hot rice on a plate, garnish with some washed and drained fresh herbs.
Step 5: Arrange the fried fish on top, drizzle with the prepared sauce, and serve while hot.
Source: BeyondKimchee

mon_an.mo_ta: The ingredients and method aren't too difficult for you to make Teriyaki Chicken Rice for the whole family. With this delicious marinade recipe, the chicken pieces will be better than ever!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Marinade: 125ml water, 30ml soy sauce, 30g brown sugar, 30ml mirin
Glaze: 30ml honey, 30ml dark soy sauce, 30ml mirin, 30ml sake
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, to make the marinade, put the soy sauce, mirin, and brown sugar into a heavy-duty food-grade plastic bag.
Step 2:
Add the water, then place the chicken into the bag.
Step 3:
Marinate the chicken for about 2-3 hours, or up to 1 day!
Step 4:
To make the glaze, put the soy sauce, honey, mirin, and sake into a small pot.
Step 5:
Simmer over medium heat until the sauce just comes to a boil; it will thicken and become glossy.
Step 6:
Grill the chicken on a BBQ rack, continuously brushing the glaze made in the previous step evenly over both sides of the chicken.
Step 7:
Wash the peas, then stir-fry them with garlic.
Step 8:
Cut the chicken into pieces, scoop rice into a bowl, arrange the chicken and peas on top, then sprinkle some toasted black sesame seeds over everything.
Finally, drizzle more sauce over it and you can enjoy!
This teriyaki chicken rice dish looks delicious enough to make you hungry just by looking at it!
You can also use other vegetables to serve with the chicken rice!

mon_an.mo_ta: Cheese Rice Balls – A delicious and easy-to-make dish to change up meals for your little one. The rice is fried until golden, with stretchy cheese that provides plenty of calcium for children. How to make delicious dishes for your baby: Cheese Rice Balls.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Briefly sauté the finely chopped green onions and minced de-seeded fresh chili.
Step 2: Scoop the warm rice into a large bowl and mix with the toasted sesame seeds and the sautéed onion and chili mixture. Then mix in the shredded cheese and a pinch of salt.
Step 3: Roll the rice into even round balls for this easy-to-make dish. Then roll each rice ball through a layer of flour.
Step 4: After coating with flour, dip the rice ball into the egg yolks and finally roll it in breadcrumbs. Apply just enough coating; do not let too much breading build up.
Step 5: Pour oil into a pan, heat until hot, then drop each rice ball in to fry until golden brown. Cheese rice balls are best enjoyed while hot and dipped in ketchup.
Source: BeyondKimchee

mon_an.mo_ta: Simple from ingredients to preparation, so you don't have to worry about difficulties when making these fried meatballs. Let's get started with the recipe below!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, put the ground meat into a large bowl to prepare for mixing.
Step 2:
Crack 2 eggs into a bowl and beat them well.
Step 3:
Mix the ground meat and eggs together thoroughly.
Step 4:
Peel the water chestnuts and mince them into small pieces.
Step 5:
Then, mix them into the meat mixture.
Step 6:
Place a pan on the stove, pour in plenty of oil, and let it get hot. Once the oil is hot, shape the meat into balls and drop them into the pan.
Step 7:
Repeat until all the meat is used. Fry over low heat until the outside is an even golden brown.
Step 8:
After frying, remove the meatballs and pat them dry to remove excess oil. In another pan, add the chicken broth, soy sauce, seasonings, and star anise and bring to a simmer.
Step 9:
Once the mixture is hot, put the meatballs back into the pan, cover, and simmer over low heat until the meatballs are evenly coated with a layer of soy sauce glaze.
This savory meatball dish will surely make you love it from the first bite!
The meatballs are soft yet crunchy, and the soy sauce glaze is wonderful!
It goes very well with hot rice!
Meatballs might seem simple and boring, but with just a little twist, they become much more delicious!

mon_an.mo_ta: Pineapple Yogurt Smoothie is a very healthy drink with fresh pineapple rich in Vitamin C, great for detoxifying the body and reducing excess fat. Fresh yogurt helps your digestive system function better. A glass of pineapple yogurt smoothie every day will help improve your skin and maintain a youthful physique!
cac_buoc: Peel the fresh ginger, rinse with water, and slice thinly.
Peel the pineapple, remove the eyes, and cut into small pieces. You should choose ripe, fragrant yellow pineapples for a delicious smoothie with natural sweetness.
Next, put the ingredients including the chopped pineapple, yogurt, honey, and sliced ginger into a blender. Blend until the mixture is smooth.
Finally, pour the smoothie into a glass, garnish with mint leaves, and enjoy.

mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried Okra with Dried Shrimp is simple yet delicious and unique! With a quick preparation method that doesn't take much time and easy-to-find ingredients, this is the number one choice for a busy cook! Furthermore, okra has many benefits; besides supporting the digestive system, it also helps with weight loss thanks to its high fiber and low calorie content! Let's learn how to make this dish right away; it's both good for you and easy to make!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Shrimp paste, seasoning powder, pepper, cooking oil - as needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Soak the dried shrimp in warm water (about 50 degrees) until soft, rinse, drain, and then crush them. Wash the okra, trim both ends, and slice diagonally.
Step 2: Peel and mince the garlic. Sauté the minced garlic with a little oil until fragrant.

Step 3: Add the okra to the pan, season with 2 tsp seasoning powder, 1 tsp shrimp paste, and 1 tsp sugar (optional). Once the okra has absorbed the seasoning, add the dried shrimp and stir-fry for about another 3 minutes.
Step 4: Remove the Stir-fried Okra with Dried Shrimp to a plate and sprinkle with 1/2 tsp pepper for fragrance.

mon_an.mo_ta: While the weather is still warm, let's try making this Steamed Tofu with Shrimp. What could be better than eating steamed dishes with plenty of vegetables when it's hot! Show off your skills right now!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Sesame oil, pepper, sugar, soy sauce, seasoning powder - as needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Crack the eggs into a bowl, set aside two yolks, and beat the remaining eggs until combined.

Step 2: Mix the shrimp, peas, mushrooms, carrots, and tofu with 1/3 tbsp each of seasoning powder, pepper, and sesame oil; add a little sugar if desired. Pour in the beaten eggs and mix well with the ingredients.
Step 3: Beat the two reserved egg yolks.

Step 4: Divide the mixture into small bowls and steam. When the eggs are nearly cooked, dab away any excess water on the surface, then brush a layer of egg yolk on top and steam with the lid slightly ajar so the eggs cook while keeping their bright color.
Quick tips:
Ingredients must be well-drained so the dish doesn't become watery when steamed.
While steaming, pay attention to venting the steam frequently so the Steamed Tofu with Shrimp doesn't become spongy.

mon_an.mo_ta: Fried silken tofu – a novel dish that satisfies the whole family's cravings. Here is how to make Fried Silken Tofu.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Tomato, green and red bell peppers - 30g each
Seasoning powder, pepper, sugar, minced garlic, vinegar, cooking oil
cac_buoc: Step 1: Slice the egg tofu into 1.5cm thick rounds. Drain well as silken egg tofu is usually refrigerated.

Step 2: Beat the egg. Dip the tofu slices into the egg wash, then coat them in panko breadcrumbs. Heat oil in a pan and fry the tofu until golden brown on both sides. Once golden, remove and place on a plate lined with paper towels.
Step 3: Wash the tomato. Halve the green and red bell peppers, remove the seeds, and dice 30g of each along with the tomato.

Step 4: Drain most of the oil from the pan. Sauté the minced garlic until fragrant, then add the bell peppers and tomatoes. Stir-fry quickly and season with seasoning powder, sugar, and vinegar to achieve a balanced sweet and sour taste. Turn off the heat and stir in a little sesame oil.
Step 5: Arrange the tofu on a plate. Top each piece with the sautéed tomato and bell pepper mixture. Finally, sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds and black pepper. Serve hot.
Source: Compiled

mon_an.mo_ta: Today's easy recipe is fried meat-stuffed tofu. A simple yet delicious dish where the savory tofu absorbs the sweetness of the meat. Let's get started! - Easy fried meat-stuffed tofu with wonderful flavor.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Cut the tofu into small squares or rectangles and fry until golden brown on all sides.
Step 2: Marinate the ground meat with green onions, pepper, and seasonings.
Step 3: Remove the tofu and let it cool slightly. Cut into triangles and make a slit in the middle of each piece. Stuff the marinated meat into the tofu and arrange them in a heat-resistant tray.
Step 4: Mix soy sauce, oyster sauce, and minced chili together, then drizzle over the tofu. Place the tray in a steamer for 10-15 minutes until the meat is cooked through. Remove and enjoy your dish.
Good luck with this simple yet delicious dish!

mon_an.mo_ta: Salt and Pepper Tofu – A delicious and easy-to-make dish to refresh your daily menu. Learn how to make tasty Salt and Pepper Tofu.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, seasoning powder, black pepper, green onions
cac_buoc: Step 1: Rinse the fresh tofu, cut into bite-sized pieces, and place in a colander to drain. Sprinkle a little salt and pepper over the tofu and marinate for about 30 minutes. Peel the onion and cut into wedges. Rinse and finely chop the green onions.
Step 2: Mix 1 teaspoon of salt, 1/2 teaspoon of seasoning powder, and a little pepper in a small bowl and set aside.
Step 3: After marinating, coat the tofu evenly in a thin layer of tapioca starch to ensure a crispier texture when fried.
Step 4: Heat a pan and add cooking oil. Once the oil is hot, fry the tofu until golden brown on both sides. Remove and serve on a plate lined with paper towels to drain.
Step 5: Pour out the excess oil. Using the same pan, stir-fry the onion and green onions for about 3 minutes. Add the salt mixture from step 2 and stir well.

Step 6: Quickly add the fried tofu and toss gently until the salt mixture evenly coats the tofu. Turn off the heat and serve this easy-to-make dish on a plate. Enjoy hot with rice. If desired, serve with soy sauce and chili for extra flavor.
Source: Ngôi sao

mon_an.ten: Tofu with Sweet and Sour Shrimp Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: Tofu with sweet and sour shrimp sauce is a traditional dish in Vietnamese cuisine, offering a fragrant, sweet, and tangy aroma. In this guide, we will explore how to make this tofu dish in a simple and delicious way. From selecting fresh ingredients to the signature sweet and sour shrimp sauce recipe, this dish will surely satisfy your taste buds. Let's get started and discover the unique flavor of tofu with sweet and sour shrimp sauce! A simple and tasty guide to making tofu with sweet and sour shrimp sauce. Discover the unique flavor of this dish today.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
After purchasing the shrimp, peel them, remove the veins, and wash them thoroughly. Next, finely mince the cleaned shrimp.
For the tofu, wash 3 pieces and drain well. Then, cut each piece of tofu in half and use a spoon to scoop out a hole in the center.
For the green onions, trim the roots, wash, and chop finely. For the shallots and garlic, peel and mince them.
Step 2: Marinate the ingredients

To marinate, prepare a bowl and add 50g of minced meat and the minced shrimp. Next, season with 1 tsp MSG, 1.5 tsp seasoning powder, 1 tsp sugar, 1/2 tsp pepper, 1 tsp minced shallots, and 1 tsp cornstarch. Mix the ingredients and spices thoroughly.
Step 3: Stuff and fry the tofu

Next, stuff the filling into the tofu. Place a sufficient amount of the marinated filling into each piece of tofu. You can also attach a shrimp tail in the middle for decoration. Continue stuffing all the prepared tofu pieces.

Note: Handle gently to avoid tearing the tofu. Once the tofu is stuffed, place a pan on the stove and add cooking oil. When the oil is hot, place each piece of tofu into the pan and fry until both sides are golden brown.
Step 4: Completion

You can reuse the oil pan by adding garlic and sautéing until fragrant. When the garlic starts to smell aromatic, add 2.5 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tbsp ketchup, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp MSG, and water to the pan. Stir well until the mixture dissolves.

Next, add the fried tofu to the pan and toss evenly so the tofu absorbs the flavors. When the dish is ready, sprinkle green onions on top for garnish. The dish will have an attractive color and a fragrance that fills the kitchen. In just a few minutes, you have a delicious tofu with shrimp and meat dish to enjoy with your family!
How to store sweet and sour tofu
In reality, most dishes are best and most flavorful when cooked and eaten immediately while hot. Sweet and sour tofu is no exception, so it should be enjoyed right after cooking.

However, if you have leftovers, you can put them in a container and store them in the refrigerator. Note that the dish will not retain its original flavor as when freshly cooked. The best storage time is 2-3 days because tofu can easily turn sour.

mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried dishes using green beans are a favorite choice for many families, as this ingredient is not only nutrient-rich but also offers many health benefits. Let's make this delicious and attractive stir-fried green beans with dried shrimp right now! A guide on how to make irresistibly delicious stir-fried green beans with shrimp. A simple yet flavorful dish using fresh green beans and tasty shrimp. Let's start cooking and enjoy it with family and friends!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients

To prepare the ingredients for the stir-fried green beans with shrimp, first trim both ends and remove the strings from both sides of the green beans. Then, wash the beans 2-3 times with water and cut them into short segments, about 2 finger joints long.
For the dried shrimp, rinse them briefly with water and place them in a bowl of cold or warm water to soak for 5-10 minutes to soften, then drain.
Next, peel and wash the garlic and shallots, then mince them. Trim the roots, wash the green onions and cilantro, then chop them finely. Remove the stems from the chili, wash, and slice thinly.
This will prepare the necessary ingredients for your stir-fried green beans.
Step 2: Stir-fry the green beans with dried shrimp

Place a pan on the stove and add 3 tbsp of cooking oil. Heat the oil over medium heat. When the oil is hot, add the minced garlic and shallots to the pan and sauté until they turn golden and fragrant.
Next, add the dried shrimp to the pan and stir well for about 3-5 minutes so the shrimp absorbs the aroma of the garlic and shallots.
Then, add the cut green beans to the pan and continue to stir constantly until the beans are just cooked and have a bright green color.
Reduce the heat to low and add 2 tsp seasoning powder, 1 tsp MSG, and 1 tsp sugar to the pan. Then, gently stir for about 5 minutes so the green beans and dried shrimp absorb the seasonings.
Adjust the seasoning to suit your taste. Then, turn off the heat and serve the dish on a plate.
Step 3: Finished product

Finally, add the chopped green onions, cilantro, and sliced chili on top to make the dish more attractive and eye-catching. The stir-fried green beans with shrimp will emit an appealing aroma with the bright green color of the beans and the vibrant colors of the herbs and chili.
The green beans are crisp and sweet without being too soft, while the dried shrimp are tender and well-seasoned. When paired with hot rice, this dish is truly delicious and enticing!
Notes for making irresistibly delicious green beans
Choose fresh green beans: Select fresh green beans without cracks and with a nice color. Fresh beans will retain their crispness and sweetness better when stir-fried.
Wash the green beans thoroughly: Before use, wash the green beans with water to remove dirt and impurities.
Soak the dried shrimp: If using dried shrimp, soak them in cold or warm water for 5-10 minutes to soften them before stir-frying.
Stir evenly while frying: When stir-frying, ensure the green beans and shrimp are tossed evenly in the pan so they cook uniformly and do not burn.
Seasoning: Add seasonings like seasoning powder, MSG, and sugar to enhance the flavor of the dish. Remember to season to taste and do a final taste test before turning off the heat.

Garnish and enjoy: Before serving, add green onions, cilantro, and sliced chili on top to make the dish more appealing. Enjoy the hot stir-fried green beans with shrimp along with hot rice for a wonderful experience.

mon_an.mo_ta: You certainly won't be able to resist the irresistible flavor of these chili salt grilled chicken drumsticks. The chicken is marinated in rich seasonings, making it delicious from the very first bite.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 1 tbsp fish sauce; a pinch of salt
A splash of dark soy sauce
cac_buoc: Let's look at the ingredients you need to make these delicious and attractive chili salt grilled chicken drumsticks!

Step 1: Wash the chicken drumsticks with vinegar and salt to remove any odors, then pat dry. Place the drumsticks in a large bowl with the above seasonings (except for the cooking oil), mix well, and marinate for at least 1 hour to let the flavors penetrate the meat.
Step 2: Once the chicken is well-marinated, add the cooking oil and mix well. Preheat the oven to 200°C for 10 minutes. Arrange the drumsticks on a baking tray and place them in the preheated oven.
Step 3: Flip the drumsticks every 10 minutes so the meat cooks evenly. Bake for about 40-50 minutes until the chicken is evenly golden brown.
Remove the chili salt grilled chicken drumsticks and enjoy immediately while hot.

mon_an.mo_ta: Honey glazed chicken thighs attract diners at first sight with their glistening golden skin, the aroma of honey and spices, and tender meat that melts in your mouth. How could such a delicious dish be missing from your cooking list? Let's get into the kitchen and show off your skills!
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Preheat the oven to about 218°C.
While waiting for the oven to heat up, line a baking tray with aluminum foil and spray or brush a little cooking oil on top to prevent the food from sticking to the foil during baking.
Step 2: Make the sauce
In a small bowl, mix the honey, sesame oil, soy sauce, garlic, ginger, and black pepper together. Stir well until all ingredients are dissolved and well combined.
Step 3:
Wash the chicken thighs, cut them into slightly large pieces, and let them drain. You can wash the chicken with salt to remove any odors.

Next, place the prepared chicken on the foil-lined tray and pour the sauce over it. Alternatively, you can put the chicken in a plastic bag, pour the sauce in, and toss until evenly coated. For better flavor, you can keep the bag in the refrigerator for 3-4 hours to let the meat fully absorb the seasonings.
Then, arrange the chicken thighs on the prepared baking tray.
Step 4:

Bake the chicken thighs for about 40 minutes. Check the chicken after the first 20 minutes. If dark charred spots appear, cover the chicken with another sheet of foil and place it back in the oven. This helps retain moisture and slows down the browning process on the surface.
Step 5:
When the chicken is cooked through, remove the tray from the oven and let it cool for 5-10 minutes before enjoying.
Notes for perfect honey glazed chicken:
You should use two layers of foil on the tray to prevent the sauce from overflowing during baking.
The leftover sauce from the cooking process is also delicious when served with rice!
Besides drumsticks, you can substitute any other part of the chicken you prefer!
How to choose good chicken (for pre-slaughtered chicken): To make the dish better, you can choose chicken based on these tips:
A good chicken will have a compact, firm body and a small breast.
The skin of free-range chicken is golden, with deeper yellow areas on the wings, breast, and back. The skin should not be bruised, pale, or have black spots or rashes.
If the skin is tough and evenly golden but the fat is white, the chicken may have been dyed.
The meat should be firm, fresh, and free from foul odors or antibiotic smells.

Press your finger into the body, breast, or thigh to check; if the meat is firm, it is good. If the meat is flabby, slippery, deformed, or pitted (indicating water injection), it may have been treated with chemicals or borax. Absolutely do not buy such chicken to avoid health risks.

mon_an.mo_ta: Pandan wrapped chicken is a popular dish in Thailand. The chicken is thoroughly marinated, then wrapped in pandan leaves and fried, creating a unique and fragrant flavor. Let's learn how to make this dish!
cac_buoc: Wash the chicken and cut into bite-sized squares (about the size of two fingertips), then marinate with coconut milk, oyster sauce, minced garlic, and crushed coriander seeds for about 1 hour.
Wash the pandan leaves and wipe them dry.

Cross the two ends of a pandan leaf together and place a piece of chicken in the middle. Then fold the two ends down and tuck them inside to secure, as if you are using the leaf to tie the chicken. Alternatively, you can roll the leaf around the meat and secure the end with a toothpick.
Heat oil in a pan and fry the chicken until golden brown.
This dish is served with soy sauce mixed with a little sugar and toasted sesame seeds.

mon_an.mo_ta: The drizzling rains of February are always damp and cold, often making family meals feel less cozy. To recharge for a new day and warm up the atmosphere, why not try making spicy stir-fried chicken? Let's cook this delicious dish together!
cac_buoc: Here are the steps to make spicy stir-fried chicken:
Step 1: Wash the chicken drumsticks, debone, and cut into small pieces. Slice 3 thin pieces of ginger.
Step 2: Prepare a pot of water, add the ginger slices and a bit of rice wine, and bring to a boil. Then, blanch the chicken for about 2 minutes.
Step 3: Mince the garlic and the remaining ginger; finely chop the green onions.
Step 4: Heat oil in a pan and sauté the minced ginger and garlic until fragrant. Then, add the minced chili.

Step 5: Add the chicken to the pan and stir-fry with sugar and soy sauce. Use high heat until the sauce reduces and thickens slightly, then turn off the heat. Now you have a delicious and quick meal for the whole family!

mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried pork with bean sprouts – a delicious daily dish featuring the crunchiness of bean sprouts and the sweetness of meat. It is a simple, time-saving dish for busy days. Discover how to make delicious stir-fried bean sprouts with meat at home with these detailed instructions. Enjoy a traditional dish of Vietnamese culinary culture, combining fresh bean sprouts and tender meat. Easy-to-understand instructions and simple recipe steps will help you create a tasty, attractive, and flavorful meal.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the bean sprouts and soak them in diluted salt water for 10 minutes to clean. Then, remove and drain in a colander. Wash and finely chop the green onions.

Step 2: Wash the lean pork and slice into bite-sized pieces. If you are not confident with your knife skills, you can place the meat in the freezer for 10 minutes before slicing it thinly to make the dish easier to eat.
Step 3: Peel and crush the garlic. Heat a pan and sauté the garlic until fragrant, then add the pork and stir-fry, seasoning to taste. Transfer the meat to a plate.

Step 4: Use the same pan to stir-fry the bean sprouts. Since bean sprouts contain a lot of water and cook quickly, stir-fry them rapidly and season to taste. When the sprouts are cooked, add the meat back in, stir well for a moment, then toss in the green onions. Turn off the heat and transfer the stir-fried bean sprouts and meat to a plate. Serve hot with rice.
Note: Bean sprouts nowadays often contain preservatives; you should buy them from trusted sellers or grow them yourself at home.
Tips for making stir-fried pork with bean sprouts:
Choose fresh ingredients: Use fresh bean sprouts and high-quality meat to ensure the dish's quality.
Prepare ingredients before cooking: Wash the sprouts and meat, cut them into small pieces, and prepare all necessary seasonings before starting.
Stir-fry quickly on high heat: Stir-fry the sprouts and meat over high heat for a short time to maintain the crunchiness of the sprouts and the tenderness of the meat.
Stir evenly and do not overcook: When stir-frying, ensure even color and cooking for both the sprouts and the meat. Do not overcook the sprouts to keep their natural crunch.
Appropriate seasonings: Use seasonings like garlic, onions, salt, pepper, and fish sauce to enhance and blend the flavors.
Add final seasonings: When the dish is almost finished, you can add a bit of fish sauce, sugar, or soy sauce to adjust the flavor to your preference.
Enjoy immediately: Stir-fried bean sprouts with meat should be enjoyed right after cooking to maintain the crunchiness of the sprouts.
How to choose fresh ingredients:
1. How to choose fresh pork:

To buy fresh pork, pay attention to these points: Good pork usually has bright pink lean meat, opaque white fat with some translucency, and a dry surface. It should feel firm and elastic when pressed. Buy meat where the lean and fat parts are distinct but tightly attached. Avoid meat that looks dull, watery, smells foul, or has bruises and blood clots.
2. How to choose fresh bean sprouts:

When buying bean sprouts, choose those with long, thin stems, well-developed roots, and an off-white color. These are naturally grown without stimulants and will be crunchier and more flavorful. Avoid sprouts treated with chemicals, which are often abnormally large, shiny, and brittle. Alternatively, you can grow your own at home.
3. How to choose fresh tomatoes:
To buy fresh tomatoes, look for those with a bright red color, juicy, shiny, and even-toned. The stem should be fresh and firmly attached, indicating they were recently harvested.
Vine-ripened tomatoes have a characteristic faint aroma, and when cut in half, the seeds are yellow rather than green. Avoid mushy tomatoes with wrinkled skin, as they are old or overripe.

mon_an.mo_ta: A simple peach and lime smoothie made with easy-to-find ingredients that is both budget-friendly and refreshing for the hot summer. It provides essential vitamins and nutrients to keep your family healthy all season long. Make this refreshing drink for everyone to enjoy right away! Everyone will surely praise this cool, sweet, and fragrant treat.
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients for the peach lime smoothie:
Wash the peaches, peel them, cut into bite-sized wedges, and remove the pits.
Squeeze the limes for juice and remove the seeds.
Steps to make the peach lime smoothie:
Step 1: First, place the peaches in a blender and blend until smooth.
Step 2: Once the peaches are very smooth, add the lime juice, sugar, and filtered water, then blend again for a moment to combine all ingredients thoroughly.
Step 3: Add the agave syrup or honey and stir well. Pour into glasses and garnish with a peach slice.
Notes for a delicious peach lime smoothie:
Agave syrup is a sweetener made from the agave plant. This syrup is suitable for dieters. If unavailable, you can substitute it with honey or sugar.
When squeezing the limes, do not press too hard; the essential oils from the peel can make the juice bitter.
Depending on your family's taste, you can adjust the sweetness and the amount of ice used in the smoothie!
How to choose peaches:
Size: Chinese peaches are usually larger than Vietnamese ones, with a smooth, shiny skin and very little to no fuzz.
In contrast, Vietnamese peaches are quite small, very fuzzy, and not as visually appealing as Chinese peaches.
Before eating or processing, you must wash off all the fuzz on the skin to avoid a scratchy sensation on the tongue.
Color: Chinese peaches often have a pale pink, attractive color, while Vietnamese peaches are green with a hint of pale pink.

Vietnamese peaches, besides looking different, have a natural fragrance, a crunchy texture, and a slightly tart taste with white or yellowish flesh. Chinese peaches do not stay crunchy for long, usually have yellow flesh, and become soft and less sweet when eaten.
To choose fresh local peaches, pick those that are just ripe—not too green and not too mushy—with a natural light fragrance.
To check the firmness or crunchiness, press the skin lightly. Avoid peaches that are too soft as they may have been stored for too long.
Note: To avoid buying Chinese peaches, avoid buying out-of-season fruit or those with overly flashy colors or strange varieties that haven't appeared on the local market before.

A simple peach and lime smoothie made with easy-to-find ingredients that is both budget-friendly and refreshing for the hot summer. It provides essential vitamins and nutrients to keep your family healthy all season long. Make this refreshing drink for everyone to enjoy right away! Everyone will surely praise this cool, sweet, and fragrant treat.

mon_an.ten: Refreshing Small Crab Soup with Luffa and Jute Leaves
mon_an.mo_ta: Small crab soup cooked with luffa and jute leaves is a rustic dish that is always loved for its delicious and cooling flavor. Making this soup is not difficult at all! Let's explore the recipe.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings: Seasoned salt, MSG, seasoning powder
cac_buoc: Step 1: Clean the crabs, remove the top shells, and rinse with salt.
Step 2: Place the crabs in a blender or grind with a mortar until fine, then filter with water to get the desired amount of broth.
Step 3: Pick the tender tips of the jute leaves, discarding damaged leaves. Peel the luffa. Wash everything and drain.
Step 4: Finely chop the jute leaves. Halve the luffa and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Step 5: Place the crab broth on the stove over low heat. Add a little seasoned salt.
When the soup boils, add the jute leaves and luffa and cook for about 2-3 minutes. Adjust the seasonings to taste. Once cooked, turn off the heat. Serve the crab soup in a bowl.

Small crab soup with luffa and jute leaves is perfect for summer. This sweet and savory soup pairs excellently with pickled eggplants. Furthermore, this soup is very beneficial for lactation in breastfeeding mothers!
Good luck and enjoy this appetizing crab soup on a summer day!

mon_an.ten: Crispy Meatballs with Salted Egg Yolk
mon_an.mo_ta: With a crispy outer shell and a rich salted egg yolk inside, the wonderful combination of these meatballs will surely delight the whole family!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings: soy sauce, cornstarch, sesame oil, white wine
cac_buoc: Step 1:

First, place the ground pork in a bowl and add 10g of cornstarch, scallions, ginger, and garlic, then mix well. Since the salted egg is already salty, you don't need to add more salt. If you prefer a bolder flavor, add about 1 small tsp of soy sauce.
Step 2:
Soak the salted egg yolks in 90ml of wine for about 15 minutes, then bake at 150°C for 7-8 minutes.

Once the yolks are cooked, take them out, let them cool slightly, and begin shaping. Grease your hands with a layer of sesame oil, take a portion of meat, flatten it, and place a salted egg yolk in the center.
Step 3:
Roll into a smooth ball. Repeat until all eggs and meat are used.
Step 4:
Place the desiccated coconut on a plate and roll each meatball until evenly coated.
Step 5:
Next, skewer the meatballs onto short sticks.
Step 6:
Deep-fry the meatballs until the meat is cooked through and the coconut is golden brown. Drain well on paper towels.

mon_an.ten: Gỏi Cuốn Tôm Thịt (Shrimp and Pork Spring Rolls)
mon_an.mo_ta: Instructions for making attractive Gỏi Cuốn Tôm Thịt will be shared below, helping you create a delicious snack that many families love. You will gain a unique preparation secret to make this dish appealing for both family and friends. Get ready to start the process now! Learn to cook delicious food every day for your family. This is a familiar snack for many households. Discover the unique and tasty secrets for the whole family.
cac_buoc: 1. Prepare the meat
After buying the pork, wash it thoroughly with water to remove any odors. Use a little salt to rub all over the meat, then rinse 2-3 times with water and drain.
Next, place the meat in a pot and pour in enough water to submerge it. Add 1 tsp of salt and bring to a boil over high heat. Boil for 3-5 minutes, then turn off the heat.
To remove impurities and keep the meat fresh, rinse it again with cold water after removing it from the pot.

Then, return the meat to the pot. Pour in water to submerge and add 1 tsp of salt. Turn the heat to medium and boil for 30-40 minutes until the meat is tender. Turn off the heat, remove the meat to a plate, let it cool, and then slice into thin, bite-sized pieces.
2. Prepare the shrimp
When you buy shrimp, you can leave them whole or remove the heads as desired. Rinse the shrimp several times with water, then place them in a pot.
Place the pot on the stove and add a little water. Cover and turn the heat to medium. Cook the shrimp until they turn red, ensuring you stir them occasionally.
Afterward, remove the shrimp and let them cool. Peel the shells and slice the shrimp in half lengthwise along the back. Remove the black veins and arrange the prepared shrimp on a plate.
3. Prepare other ingredients

Trim the roots of the chives and wash them. For the accompanying herbs, pick the fresh leaves and soak them in diluted salt water for about 10 minutes. Then, rinse the herbs several times with water and drain in a basket.
Next, peel the garlic and remove the chili stems. Briefly rinse the garlic and chili, then mince them finely.
4. Rolling the spring rolls

Start by spreading a thin rice paper sheet on a plate. Dampen the rice paper slightly with water to make it easier to roll. Next, layer the herbs, vermicelli, pork, shrimp, and chives on the rice paper, then roll tightly.

Continue until all ingredients are used. In a bowl, combine 2 tbsp of sugar and 2 tbsp of filtered water, stirring until the sugar dissolves completely. Then, add 3 tbsp of lime juice and 5 tbsp of fish sauce, and stir well.
