Finally, add the minced garlic and chili to the bowl and stir. This completes the dipping sauce. Arrange the spring rolls and dipping sauce on a plate and serve.
Gỏi cuốn tôm thịt is a nutritious and easy-to-eat dish that doesn't feel heavy, making it perfect for a family weekend meal.
It tastes wonderful when dipped in sweet and sour fish sauce. So, let's get into the kitchen and make it!
To make this dish, please follow the steps below:
How to buy shrimp and pork for Gỏi Cuốn Tôm Thịt
1. How to buy fresh meat
Choose meat that is pale pink or light red, with fat that is clear white or slightly ivory. You should choose meat with a bit of fat or marbled fat so it isn't too greasy or too dry.
Fresh pork has good elasticity when pressed. After releasing your finger, the meat should return to its original shape without leaving a dent.
Avoid meat that is pale, has a foul odor, or feels slimy. These are signs of spoiled or old meat.
2. How to choose fresh shrimp
Choose shrimp that do not feel slimy to the touch. Look for shrimp with transparent shells and heads that are firmly attached to the body, as these are signs of freshness.
Fresh shrimp usually have their legs and tails tucked together. Shrimp with splayed legs and tails may have been injected with chemicals, so you should avoid those.

mon_an.ten: Southern Style Crispy Pickled Red Onions
mon_an.mo_ta: With this simple pickling method, you will have a jar of red onions that are tastier than ever to accompany your daily meals!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 600gr sour starfruit (choose ripe ones for more juice)
White vinegar (keep a whole bottle ready for washing and making the brine)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel the red onions and trim the roots (do not wash with water to prevent spoiling).

Wash the starfruit, wipe each one dry, and slice thinly (ripe starfruit provides more juice). Squeeze the sliced starfruit for juice and set the pulp aside; if it's hard to squeeze, use a blender to make it easier.
Step 2: Prepare a large plastic container or bowl. Layer the onions and sea salt alternately until finished.
Step 3: Pour the starfruit juice over the onions until almost submerged, then spread the starfruit pulp on top and cover with a lid.
Step 4: Let it sit for 1 day and 1 night, occasionally opening to stir so the starfruit juice penetrates the onions.

Step 5: After one day, remove the onions and rinse them twice with vinegar (pour some vinegar into a bowl, drop a few onions in to rinse, repeat until finished, then discard that vinegar and use fresh vinegar for a final rinse).
Place the onions in a colander to drain.

Step 6: Boil 300ml of vinegar with 250gr of white sugar and 1/2 tsp of fine salt until dissolved, then let it cool. Wash the glass jar and rinse with boiling water, then dry thoroughly. Arrange the onions in the jar, pour in the cooled vinegar mixture, and use a weight to keep the onions submerged. Seal tightly and wait 4-5 days before eating.
Because vinegar pickling makes the onions sour quickly, once they are ready, remove them from the brine and store in a sealed container in the refrigerator.

Note: If you like them ready-to-eat, add 1/2 tsp of salt to the brine. If you prefer to dip them in sauce later, omit the salt from the brine since the onions already absorbed salt during the first step. Adjust according to your preference.

mon_an.mo_ta: These delicious cookies are always a favorite for children, especially with their sweet and tart strawberry jam filling. Every child will want to taste these. These crispy cat's eye cookies will move even the most demanding diners. The sweet and sour jam center will satisfy you; let's learn how to bake them!
cac_buoc: Let's start learning how to make delicious cat's eye cookies!

Step 1: Choose a clean cutting board or a clean metal surface. Mix the flour, sugar, and salt together on the surface. Create a well in the center of the flour mixture and add the egg yolks, softened butter, vanilla, and grated lemon zest. Mix until the dough forms a smooth mass. Preheat the oven to 176°C.
Step 2: Roll the dough to a thickness of about 0.7 cm and use a cookie cutter to cut out shapes.

Step 3: Place the cut dough pieces onto parchment paper. Use a smaller round cutter to cut out the center of half the cookies to create the "cat's eye." You only need to do this for half of the cookies.
Step 4: Once finished cutting, bake for 8-9 minutes at 176°C until the cookies are a light golden color.
Step 5: Heat the strawberry jam in a pan over medium heat until it melts into a liquid consistency.
Step 6: Spoon a small amount of jam onto the solid cookies (without holes), then place a cookie with a hole on top to assemble. Let the jam set, and your cookies are finished.
The delicious cat's eye cookies are now complete. When presented on a plate, they will look like this:

mon_an.ten: Savory Braised Fish with Green Bananas
mon_an.mo_ta: On cool early autumn days, enjoying rustic braised fish with green bananas and white rice is wonderful! Let's make this delicious dish for the whole family! It's guaranteed to be beyond reproach!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Clean the fish, rub with sea salt, rinse off the slime, and cut into chunks. Marinate the fish with about 1 tsp of fine salt for 30 minutes to firm up the flesh and absorb the flavor.
Step 2: Peel the outer green skin of the bananas, soak them in water with a bit of rice vinegar to prevent browning, and cut into chunks.
Step 3: Slice the pork belly into bite-sized pieces and marinate with salt, MSG, seasoned salt, caramel sauce, and a bit of fish sauce.
Step 4: Once the fish is marinated, begin the braising process. First, layer the green bananas at the bottom of the pot, followed by the pork belly, and finally the fish.
Step 5: Add water, fish sauce, and caramel sauce over the fish and bring to a boil over high heat.
Step 6: Then, reduce the heat and simmer gently until the meat, fish, and bananas are tender and have absorbed the seasonings.
Serve this easy-to-make dish on a plate and enjoy with white rice!

mon_an.ten: Quick and Crispy Korean Cucumber Kimchi
mon_an.mo_ta: To help balance out greasy meals, today's article will guide you on how to make quick and crispy Korean cucumber kimchi. Please take a look!
cac_buoc: Here are the ingredients you need to prepare for this crispy cucumber kimchi!
Step 1: Cut the cucumbers into relatively large pieces.
Step 2: Add salt and massage gently for 3-5 minutes, then rinse with cold water. Pat dry with a towel.
Step 3: Place the cucumbers in a bowl, add finely grated ginger along with all the remaining seasonings, and mix well using gloves.
Step 4: Store the cucumber kimchi in the refrigerator for 1-2 hours before serving.
With these simple steps, you have a refreshing cucumber kimchi to balance your family meal.

mon_an.mo_ta: Noodles are delicious and easy to eat; however, commercial noodles may not guarantee quality and can contain harmful ingredients. Let's get into the kitchen and learn how to make fresh noodles that are both delicious and safe for the whole family!
cac_buoc: Place 300g of flour, salt, and turmeric powder in a large bowl. Crack the eggs into the center of the flour and gradually incorporate the flour. If the dough is too dry, add filtered water slowly.
Knead the dough thoroughly to create a very pliable and smooth mass.
Let the dough rest for 30 minutes.
Dust a flat surface like a table with a little flour, place the dough on it, and cover with a layer of dusting flour to prevent sticking. Knead the dough once more.

Use a rolling pin to roll the dough thin, then fold it and roll again; repeat several times until the dough is very elastic. During the rolling process, add more dusting flour as needed to prevent sticking.
Once you have a very smooth and elastic dough, you can shape it as desired: use small molds, cut into strands, or use a noodle press to create strands quickly.
After shaping the noodles, place them on a large tray, spread them out in a thin layer, and air-dry for about 30 minutes. (Noodles that are too hard or too soft will not cook well).
Boil the noodles for about 2-4 minutes until cooked; boiling for too long will make them mushy.
Enjoy this easy-to-make dish with broth or stir-fry them.

mon_an.ten: Savory Stir-fried Minced Meat with Mushrooms
mon_an.mo_ta: With the simplest ingredients, you can create an incredibly delicious dish. The aroma of the mushrooms blends with the sautéed meat; eating this with hot rice is absolutely wonderful!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings - seasoning powder, seasoned salt, MSG, cooking oil, pepper
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the lean meat and mince it. Marinate the minced meat with 1 tsp of seasoning powder and some minced dried shallots.
Step 2: Soak the shiitake and wood ear mushrooms in cold water for about 20 minutes, then trim the stems, wash, and chop finely.
Step 3: Place a pan on the stove, add a little oil and some minced shallots, then add the minced meat and stir-fry.
Step 4: When the meat is firm, add the shiitake and wood ear mushrooms and stir-fry together. Season to taste.
Step 5: Finally, add 1 tsp of MSG (optional), 1 tsp of pepper, and some chopped scallions. Transfer the stir-fried meat and mushrooms to a bowl and serve with hot rice.
Enjoy this simple yet appetizing minced meat and mushroom dish with your family!

mon_an.ten: Shrimp Simmered with Salty Pickled Vegetables
mon_an.mo_ta: Simple ingredients to create an incredibly delicious dish that will surely make your family finish the whole pot of rice!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 1 stalk green onion, chopped; 2 garlic cloves, minced
cac_buoc: Step 1: Clean the shrimp and remove the heads. Marinate with a little fish sauce, sugar, and pepper.
Step 2: Place a pan on the stove, add 2 tbsp oil and 1 tbsp sugar to make caramel. When the sugar turns brown, add the shallot, garlic, and chili and sauté until fragrant.
Step 3: Add the shrimp along with all the seasonings and stir-fry for 4 minutes, then add the bowl of pickled vegetables to sauté together.
Step 4: Cover and simmer on low heat until the sauce thickens and the meat has a beautiful brown color. Season again to taste and turn off the heat.
Serve the simmered shrimp and pickled vegetables on a plate and garnish with green onions. This dish is delicious with hot rice on cold days.

mon_an.ten: Egg Rolls with Mushrooms and Asparagus
mon_an.mo_ta: Egg rolls with mushrooms and asparagus are extremely easy to make, nutritious, and delicious. The combination of soft, fragrant eggs, sweet mushrooms, crunchy asparagus, and a smooth, glossy sauce creates a very unique flavor. The beautiful presentation will make your meal more attractive than usual. Don't hesitate to learn how to cook this delicious dish right now!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel the tough ends of the asparagus and wash thoroughly. Trim the roots of the mushrooms and wash.
Step 2: Prepare a bowl, crack the eggs into it, and add salt and pepper to taste.
Step 3: Heat cooking oil in a pan and fry the eggs. Fry them in several batches to roll the mushrooms and asparagus. Remove the fried eggs to a plate.
Step 4: In a pan, add a little oil and sauté the asparagus. Add salt and pepper to taste, then set aside.
Step 5: In the same pan, heat a little oil and sauté the mushrooms until soft.
Place the mushrooms and asparagus onto the egg sheets and roll them up. Repeat until all ingredients are used.

Step 6: Mix the tapioca starch with a little water. Prepare a pot, add soy sauce, mirin, and sugar, and bring to a simmer. Add the starch mixture, stir well, and cook until the mixture thickens slightly. Pour this sauce over the egg rolls and enjoy!

mon_an.mo_ta: Red tilapia fillets coated in flour, fried until crispy, and stir-fried with a very special herb—Thai basil—creates a unique new fish dish. This dish features the fragrant aroma of Thai basil blended with the natural sweetness of the fish, while the crispy outer layer makes the red tilapia more attractive and delicious than ever. Try this tasty dish now!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Turmeric powder, frying flour - as needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Preparation:
Cut the red tilapia fillet into 2x4 cm thick slices and marinate with 1/2 tsp turmeric powder.
Halve the Thai basil leaves. Cut the dill and green onions into segments. Deseed the horn chili and slice diagonally.
Step 2: Execution:
Coat the fish in frying flour and deep-fry until golden brown, then remove and drain the oil.
Sauté 1 tbsp minced garlic until fragrant, then add the Thai basil, horn chili, and green onions to stir-fry.
Add the fried fish and toss well, then add 2 tbsp water and bring to a simmer.
Add the dill, stir well, and turn off the heat.
Arrange the stir-fried fish with Thai basil on a plate and serve hot. Enjoy your meal!
Source: ST

mon_an.mo_ta: A bowl of clam and seaweed soup is rich in nutrients and refreshing, making it perfect for your family dinner on hot summer days. Let's get into the kitchen to learn how to make this cool clam and seaweed soup.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Green onions, cilantro, shallots - as needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Soak the clams for 1-2 hours before cooking.
Step 2: Soak the seaweed in water for about 10 minutes to expand. Peel and slice the shallots. Trim and wash the green onions and cilantro.
Step 3: Wash the clams thoroughly and boil them in a pot until they open their shells, then remove them. Let the cooking liquid settle, then decant the clear broth. Wash the clam meat.
Step 4: Sauté the shallots with a little oil until fragrant, then add the clam meat. Add a little fish sauce and salt, stir-fry until the clams absorb the flavor, then pour in the clam broth.
Step 5: Remove the seaweed from the water and wash it. When the soup boils, add the seaweed.
Step 6: Add chili and seasonings according to your family's taste. When the soup boils again, add the chopped green onions and cilantro, then turn off the heat.
Step 7: Ladle the soup into a bowl and serve hot.

mon_an.mo_ta: If you eat chicken frequently, you shouldn't miss this wonderful crispy lemon chicken; you'll never get tired of it!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Lemon sauce: 160ml chicken stock, 60ml lemon syrup and 8-10 lemon slices (in the syrup), 15g honey, 20g cornstarch, 3-4 fresh lemon slices
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, cut the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces.
Step 2:
Whisk the egg white until frothy, then mix with soy sauce, grated ginger, and sesame oil. Marinate the chicken for about 10 minutes.
Step 3:
Next, coat each piece of chicken in the crispy coating powder.
Step 4:
Deep-fry the chicken in a pan of oil until golden and crispy, then remove and drain.
Step 5:
Mix the lemon sauce ingredients in a large bowl.
Step 6:

Add 15ml oil to a pan, heat it up, then pour in the lemon sauce and cook until it thickens slightly. When the sauce begins to simmer and bubble, drop in a few fresh lemon slices to increase the acidity.
Step 7:
Finally, add the chicken and toss well so the sauce coats the crispy chicken evenly.
Now, enjoy this delicious crispy chicken!
Serve on a plate and sprinkle some toasted sesame seeds on top.
It's perfect when eaten with white rice...

mon_an.ten: Chicken Salad with Banana Blossom, Onion, and Vietnamese Coriander
mon_an.mo_ta: Chicken salad is a familiar dish for many families, featuring tender, fresh chicken rich in flavor and aroma, blended with various herbs, onions, and young banana blossoms to provide a wonderful sensation. Spend a little time in the kitchen to make this delicious dish for your family! Check out our recipe for chicken salad with banana blossom, onion, and Vietnamese coriander in the article below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Sugar, fish sauce, pepper, fermented rice vinegar, salt - seasonings
cac_buoc: Step 1:

Clean the chicken with salt and water, then boil until cooked. When boiling, you can add crushed ginger and a few shiitake mushrooms to enhance the flavor. Once the chicken is cooked, remove it and soak it in a bowl of cold water; this helps the meat stay firm and prevents it from darkening, keeping it a beautiful white color. However, do not soak the chicken for too long as it will lose its sweetness!
Then, shred the chicken into small strips.
Step 2:
Wash the banana blossom, slice it thinly, and soak it in cold water mixed with a little salt. If you cannot buy a whole banana blossom, you can buy pre-sliced ones at the market.

Peel the onion, wash it, and slice it into thin strips. Soak it in cold water mixed with a little salt to reduce the pungency and keep the banana blossom white. Soak the onion and banana blossom for about 15 minutes, then remove and drain.
Wash the horn chili, slice it into small rings, and crush it together with the Vietnamese coriander.
Step 3:
In a large bowl, mix 2 tbsp chicken broth (from step 1), 4 tbsp fermented rice vinegar, ½ tbsp MSG, ½ tbsp salt, ½ tbsp pepper, and 1 tbsp sugar together and stir well.
Step 4:

Next, add a little salt, pepper, and MSG to the shredded chicken and mix well. Then, add the banana blossom, Vietnamese coriander, horn chili, onion, and the dressing, and toss everything together to absorb the flavors.
Finally, arrange the chicken salad on a plate and enjoy.
Notes for a delicious chicken salad:
When boiling the chicken, be careful not to overcook it, as it will become mushy and lose its chewiness and crunch.
Remember to mix the chicken thoroughly with the seasonings so the meat is tender and flavorful.
How to choose good chicken:

For pre-processed chicken: A good chicken will have a compact, firm body and a small breast. The skin should be bright yellow, with darker yellow areas on the wings, breast, and back. The skin should not be bruised, pale, or have black spots. If the skin is tough and uniformly bright yellow but the fat is white, the chicken may have been treated with yellow dye. The meat should be firm, fresh, and free of foul odors or antibiotic smells. Press your finger into the body, breast, or thigh; if the meat is firm, it is good. If it is flabby, slippery, deformed, or pitted (edematous), it may have been injected with water or borax; absolutely do not buy such chicken.
For whole live chicken: Compare two chickens of the same size; the one that feels heavier will have firmer meat.
A healthy chicken will be very active, hard to catch, with bright, alert eyes, a bright red comb, and smooth, shiny feathers.
The beak should be sharp, shiny, and free of discharge.
The legs should be straight, slender, and uniform, without scratches, sores, broken claws, or unusual red spots.

Part the feathers to see thin, soft skin; a gentle squeeze should feel firm. There should be large yellow streaks under the breast and wings. Under the wings, you should see meat and blood vessels, indicating a lean chicken.
A healthy chicken will have a pink, pulsing vent that is not wet or showing abnormal droppings. If the droppings are yellow, foamy, slimy, or bloody, do not buy it as it is diseased.

Check if the chicken has been injected with water to increase weight by flipping the wing to check the armpit; if there are many small red dots or the area around a puncture is swollen and black, it has been injected.
A healthy chicken with good digestion will not have a hard, distended crop.

mon_an.ten: Two Ways to Make Dracontomelon Pickled in Chili Fish Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: Dracontomelon pickled in chili fish sauce is a very popular dish due to its pleasant sour and salty taste, garlic aroma, and attractive spicy chili kick. This dish is perfect when eaten with boiled morning glory. Let's explore two ways to make it.
cac_buoc: Method 1:
Ingredients for dracontomelon pickled in chili fish sauce:
300g green dracontomelon (sấu)
300ml regular fish sauce
50ml boiled water, cooled
2 garlic heads
7-8 bird's eye chilies
Salt, sugar, glass jar
Note: Choose dracontomelon that are neither too young nor too old (bánh tẻ) for the best crunch.
Instructions:

Wash the dracontomelon. Use a knife to scrape off the bitter outer skin. This is the secret to keeping them crunchy. If you want to eat them sooner, you can score the fruit into 4 sections to help the sauce penetrate faster.
As you finish scraping each fruit, drop it immediately into a bowl of water mixed with a little salt to prevent browning. Soak for about 1 hour to reduce the acidity.
Drain the dracontomelon and rinse with cold water several times. Bring a pot of water to a boil and pour it over the fruit to blanch them. Wait for the fruit to drain completely.
Rinse the glass jar with boiling water and let it dry or wipe it dry. This prevents mold from forming.
Pour 300ml fish sauce into a clean pot, add 100ml water and a few tablespoons of sugar, then bring to a boil. In this method, we add sugar to prevent the dish from being too salty or harshly sour.
Wash the chilies, remove stems, and slice. Peel and slice the garlic or leave the cloves whole.
Layer the dracontomelon in the jar, alternating with garlic and chili. Pour in the cooled fish sauce mixture and seal the lid. It can be eaten after about 3 days.
The result should be sour, salty, fragrant with garlic, and spicy. If done correctly, the fruit will be very crunchy and the liquid will be clear.
Method 2:
Ingredients:
600g green dracontomelon (bánh tẻ)
500ml high-quality fish sauce
150ml filtered water
5 garlic heads
12-15 chilies
2 tsp salt
Step 1: Choose uniform dracontomelon that are neither too young nor too old.
Wash and peel the fruit.
Step 2: Soak the fruit in salt water for 30 minutes to remove the sap.
Remove and blanch once with boiling water to prevent mold. Drain thoroughly.
Wash the chilies and remove stems.
Peel the garlic; leave whole, halve, or slice thinly as preferred.
Step 3: Combine fish sauce and water in a pot, boil for 2 minutes, then add the chili and garlic. Remove from heat and let the mixture cool completely.
If using a saltier fish sauce, you can increase the water ratio or add a little sugar to mellow the flavor.

Step 4: Prepare a clean glass jar, rinse with boiling water, and drain. Layer the dracontomelon in the jar and pour the cooled fish sauce mixture over them. Ensure the liquid completely covers the fruit.
Seal the lid and pickle for 4 to 5 days until the flavors are fully absorbed, then it is ready to serve.

mon_an.mo_ta: On a hot summer day, just one cold smoothie will bring a sense of refreshment and dispel all fatigue after a hard day's work.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 1/4 cup each: orange juice, pomegranate juice
cac_buoc: How to make the Fruit and Green Vegetable Smoothie:
Step 1:
First, wash the fruits, peel them, and chop them into small pieces (small enough for the blender).
Trim any wilted or damaged leaves from the greens, wash them, and chop them for easier blending.
Step 2:
Next, put all prepared ingredients into the blender and blend until smooth.
Step 3:
Finally, pour the smoothie into a glass and enjoy. You can add a little ice to make it colder.
2. Red Fruit Smoothie:
(So named because it combines red-colored fruits). Preparation time: 10 minutes
How to make the Red Fruit Smoothie:
Step 1:
Wash all prepared fruits, drain, and cut into small pieces.
Step 2:
Next, place them in the blender and blend for about 1 minute until the mixture is smooth and creamy.
Step 3:
Finally, pour into a glass and enjoy.
3. Apple, Strawberry, and Banana Smoothie:
Preparation time: 10 minutes
Step 1:
Wash the apples; you can soak them in salt water to disinfect. After soaking, rinse again with water, drain, and cut into small pieces.
Remove the stems and leaves from the strawberries, wash them, and halve or chop them.
Peel the banana and cut into small pieces for blending.
Step 2:
Next, put the prepared ingredients into the blender and blend for about 1 minute until smooth.
Step 3:
Finally, pour the smoothie into a glass and enjoy.
Notes for a delicious fruit smoothie:
If you want it cold, you can add crushed ice while blending.
You can adjust the ingredients to best suit your taste.
How to choose good strawberries:
Strawberries do not continue to ripen after being picked, so avoid those with white or green spots. Choose bright red ones. Avoid bruised, moldy, or mushy berries.

Fresh, juicy strawberries are shiny, uniform in color, have a light fragrance, and still have their green stems and caps attached. Avoid wet berries as sellers may have sprayed them to prevent wilting.
If buying boxed strawberries, avoid boxes that are dirty on the bottom or damp inside.
How to store strawberries:
Wash and drain strawberries. Do not remove the stems as bacteria can easily enter.
Separate bruised berries from whole ones as mold spreads easily.
Do not store at room temperature or in direct sunlight. Place them in a plastic bag or container in the fridge; they can keep for 3–4 days.

mon_an.ten: Salmon and Mashed Potato Cakes for Toddlers
mon_an.mo_ta: Salmon cakes with mashed potatoes are crispy on the outside and sweet and savory on the inside, featuring rich salmon and fluffy potatoes blended with dill and pepper for a wonderful aroma. These cakes can be used as a snack for picky eaters or as a main dish for family meals. Let's learn how to cook this delicious dish!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients for the salmon and mashed potato cakes.
Allow the salmon to thaw naturally. If you can get fresh salmon, the dish will be even better.
Wash, peel, and chop the potatoes into bite-sized pieces.
Trim and wash the herbs, then chop them finely.
Melt the unsalted butter in the microwave or on the stove.
Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk until well beaten.
Step 2: Steps to make the salmon and mashed potato cakes.
Step 1:
First, place the prepared potatoes in a medium pot and cover with water.
Place the pot on the stove over medium heat for about 20 minutes or until the potatoes are cooked through.
Once cooked, drain the potatoes, let them cool, and then mash them thoroughly.
Step 2:
Prepare another pot with enough water and bring to a boil.
When the water boils, add the salmon and cook for about 8 minutes, then remove and drain. Let it cool slightly.
Once the salmon has cooled, shred the meat by hand. Remove any skin or bones found during this process.
Step 3:
Prepare a large bowl and combine all ingredients: salmon, mashed potatoes, dill, 1 tsp salt, 1 to 1.5 tsp pepper, and the melted butter.
Use a spoon to mix the ingredients thoroughly so they are evenly seasoned.
Scoop a portion of the mixture into your hand and shape it into a medium-sized round patty.
Repeat until all the mixture is used.
Place the patties on a plate and refrigerate for about 20 minutes to firm up.
Step 4:
Set out the bowls of flour, beaten eggs, and breadcrumbs on the table.
Dredge each patty in the flour, dip it into the egg wash, and finally coat it with a layer of breadcrumbs.
Repeat for all remaining patties.
Heat oil in a pan on the stove.
When the oil is hot, fry each patty until golden brown. Flip them during frying to ensure both sides are golden brown.
Once cooked, remove the cakes and place them on paper towels to drain excess oil.
Finally, arrange the cakes on a plate and enjoy with tomato sauce, mayonnaise, chili sauce, or any dipping sauce you like.
Notes for delicious salmon and mashed potato cakes:
If salmon is unavailable or not preferred, you can substitute it with another type of fish.
Chilling the cakes before frying helps them stay firm, making the coating and frying process easier and faster.
When frying, only cook for a short time since most ingredients are already cooked. Use low or medium heat to keep the cakes crispy without drying them out.

mon_an.ten: Baked Mooncakes with Black Sesame and Salted Egg Yolk
mon_an.mo_ta: Baked mooncakes with black sesame and salted egg yolk feature a soft, characteristic crust and a unique filling with fresh salted egg yolk, all blending together to provide a delicious sensation.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 15g toasted glutinous rice flour + 25ml oil - mixed together in a small bowl
5 salted egg yolks - soaked in wine and ginger, then baked for 5 minutes at 200°C
cac_buoc: Part I. Making the filling

Step 1: Soak the red beans for 4-8 hours until they expand, then rinse and cook until tender. Once the beans are cooked and cooled, place the beans, sugar, and black sesame in a blender and blend until smooth.

Step 2: Transfer the blended mixture to a non-stick pan with the oil and toasted glutinous rice flour mixture. Stir-fry over low heat for about 15 minutes. When the filling starts to thicken, add the flour-oil mixture and continue to cook until the filling forms a cohesive mass that does not stick to the pan.
Step 3: Once the filling is ready, turn off the heat. Let it cool slightly, then divide into small portions and wrap each around a salted egg yolk.
Note: When cooking the filling, use low heat. Black sesame filling takes longer to cook down than other bean fillings.
Part II. Making the crust
Step 1: Combine the sugar syrup, vegetable oil, baking soda, peanut butter (if using), and egg in a bowl. Whisk until the ingredients are well blended.

Step 2: Place the flour in a large bowl, make a well in the center, and pour in the syrup mixture. Knead until the dough is smooth and elastic. The dough is ready when it can be stretched without breaking. Cover with plastic wrap and let the dough rest for 45-60 minutes.
Part III. Dividing the dough and filling

Step 1: Once the dough has rested and the filling is ready, weigh the dough and filling at a ratio of 1:2 (1 part dough to 2 parts filling). For a 200g mold, use 70g of dough and 130g of filling (including the egg yolk).

Step 2: Roll the dough into a ball. Flatten the dough, place the filling in the center, and wrap the dough around it, rolling it back into a ball. For a better appearance, use a rolling pin to flatten the dough evenly.
Step 3: Brush a thin layer of oil into the mold, place the filled dough ball inside, and press firmly to distribute it evenly. Remove the cake from the mold and place it on a baking tray.
Step 4: Arrange all the cakes on the tray, ready for baking.
Part IV. Baking the cakes

Step 1: Preheat the oven to 200°C with top and bottom heat for 10 minutes. Place the tray in the middle rack and bake for 10 minutes. After 10 minutes, remove the tray. Once the cakes have cooled slightly, spray a thin mist of water over them. Let them dry, then use a brush to apply the egg wash mixture to the surface.

Step 2: Return the tray to the oven and bake for another 10 minutes at 180°C. After 10 minutes, remove the tray again, let the cakes cool slightly, spray with water, let dry, and brush with the egg wash again. Bake for a final 10 minutes.
Once baked, let the cakes cool completely before enjoying or packaging.
Notes for delicious black sesame salted egg mooncakes:
Egg wash mixture: 1 egg yolk + ½ egg white + 3 drops sesame oil + 3 drops dark soy sauce + ½ tsp water + ½ tsp mooncake sugar syrup.

mon_an.mo_ta: These shell-shaped cakes are not too sweet, featuring the soft, fragrant aroma of butter and milk. With their attractive appearance and eye-catching color, they pair perfectly with healthy drinks like unsweetened soy milk or corn milk for a nutritious and delightful breakfast. Take a little time in the kitchen to make these treats for your family!
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients:
First, sift the all-purpose flour, cornstarch, and baking powder through a fine-mesh sieve into a large bowl. Whisk well. Be sure to sift thoroughly to ensure the flour is smooth and lump-free.
Next, prepare shell-shaped molds by greasing them with butter and dusting with a little flour. Tap the molds upside down to remove any excess flour.
Melt the butter. In a large bowl, combine the melted butter, honey, and fresh milk. Stir until dissolved, then add the vanilla.
Separate the egg white and egg yolk into two different bowls.
Steps to make delicious shell cakes:

First, use a hand mixer to beat the egg white with sugar until frothy. Add 1 tbsp of vinegar and continue beating until the mixture forms stiff peaks. To check, drop a small amount into water; if it does not dissolve, it is ready.

Next, fold the egg yolk into the egg white mixture and whisk evenly. While whisking, gradually add the butter mixture one spoonful at a time. Beat until the mixture is soft, smooth, and well-combined.
Sift the flour mixture into the egg bowl. Use a spatula to fold gently from the bottom up until the flour is fully incorporated.
Let the batter rest and rise for 10 minutes.
Mix the batter once more, then pour it into the prepared shell molds. Only fill 2/3 of each mold so the cakes have room to rise while baking.

Place the cakes in a preheated oven at 180°C (preheated for 15 minutes). Bake for 10 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from the oven, let them cool in the molds for about 5 minutes, then turn them over onto a plate to serve and enjoy.
Tips for delicious shell cakes:
During the process, you can omit the baking powder and instead beat the egg mixture until very fluffy; this will also help the cakes become light, airy, and perfectly moist.
Baking temperature may vary depending on your oven; adjust accordingly until the cakes turn golden brown.
To check if the cakes are done, insert a toothpick; if it comes out clean, the cakes are ready.

These shell-shaped cakes are not too sweet, featuring the soft, fragrant aroma of butter and milk. With their attractive appearance and eye-catching color, they pair perfectly with healthy drinks like unsweetened soy milk or corn milk for a nutritious and delightful breakfast. Take a little time in the kitchen to make these treats for your family!

mon_an.ten: Crispy Fried Pork and Tofu Patties
mon_an.mo_ta: Crispy fried pork and tofu patties are a dish that feels both unique and familiar, using everyday ingredients like tofu, meat, and carrots but prepared in a new way. This dish attracts diners with its beautiful golden-brown exterior and a crispy crust that gives way to a fresh, flavorful, and aromatic meat filling. The blend of vegetables ensures it never feels too heavy. With just a little preparation time, you will have a delicious and appealing dish to treat your family after a long day. Everyone will surely enjoy this simple yet wonderful meal! Let's learn how to make it in the guide below.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Eggs - 2 whole eggs and 1 egg yolk
cac_buoc: Ingredient preparation:
Rinse the pork and grind it finely. If you don't have a grinder at home, you can ask the butcher to wash and grind it for you. Choose meat with a little fat so the patties are not too dry.
Rinse the tofu with water.
Peel and wash the onion and garlic. Finely dice the onion and mince the garlic.
Peel and wash the carrot, then finely mince or dice it.
How to make delicious pork and tofu patties:
Step 1:
First, combine the pork, tofu, onion, garlic, scallions, carrot, salt, soy sauce, pepper, sesame oil, and 1 egg in a large bowl.
Mix the mixture thoroughly until all ingredients are well combined. Let it sit for 15 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Step 2:
Divide the mixture into 16 portions. Roll them into balls and then flatten them slightly into patty shapes.
Step 3:
Coat the patties with flour and place them on a plate.
Step 4:
In a bowl, beat 1 egg and 1 egg yolk with a small pinch of salt.
Step 5:
Place a deep skillet on the stove. Heat the pan over medium heat and add cooking oil.

Dip each patty into the egg wash, then place it in the skillet. Fry until the patties turn golden brown and are cooked through. Add more oil if necessary to prevent burning. Flip them regularly to ensure they cook evenly and do not burn or stay raw inside.
Step 6:
Finally, once the patties are cooked, remove them and place on paper towels to drain excess oil. Enjoy while they are still crispy.
Tips for perfect fried pork and tofu patties:
You can keep the fried patties in the freezer for several days and reheat them before eating. If you plan to store them for several days, just lightly fry them until the crust is partially cooked.
You can make the patties less salty to serve them as a savory pancake snack, which is also very appealing.
You can serve them with dipping sauce, soy sauce, chili sauce, or Ajimayo sauce.

mon_an.mo_ta: Durian Chè Thái features a signature flavor, vibrant colors, fresh fruits, and the sweet aroma of durian combined with shaved ice, providing a refreshing sensation.
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients for Chè Thái:
Deseed the durian; set aside a small amount of flesh and blend the rest with fresh milk and 1 tbsp of sugar.
Deseed the jackfruit and slice lengthwise into strips.
Scoop out the avocado flesh and slice into pieces.
Peel the bananas and slice into bite-sized pieces.
Peel the rambutans.
How to cook Chè Thái:
First, dissolve the jelly powder in water with sugar. Then, simmer the jelly over low heat, stirring gently to prevent the powder from settling at the bottom of the pot.
Next, pour the jelly into a bowl, add food coloring or fruit syrup if desired, and stir well. Place the jelly in the refrigerator until set.
After 1 hour, remove the jelly and use a crinkle cutter knife to cut it into strips similar in size to the jackfruit strips.
Finally, place all the prepared jelly and fruit into individual cups, pour in the durian milk, add some shaved ice, and enjoy.
Tips for delicious Chè Thái

Chè Thái is characterized by the fresh, naturally cool flavor of fruits. Therefore, the fruit components can be varied according to your preference, such as adding diced watermelon, pitted longans, or pineapple. These are typical summer fruits, so you will have fewer concerns about preservatives.
Fruit is best sliced right before serving to prevent it from browning or spoiling.
How to choose delicious jackfruit
Based on the shape of the fruit
This is a fairly easy step to observe. You should choose jackfruit that is evenly shaped without any dents or depressions. Dents often indicate the fruit is worm-eaten, hard, or very fibrous.
Check the spikes
Good jackfruit has large, even spikes. The spikes should not be long or sharp, and the distance between them should be wide.
With these spike characteristics, you will find fruit with many sweet segments.
Based on the stem
Like many other fruits, you can identify quality by the stem. For jackfruit, the stem helps distinguish between varieties.
Specifically: For Tố Nữ jackfruit, choose a stem about 0.5 cm long. For Tây jackfruit, choose a stem 1-1.5 cm long.
Check the quality by sound
When you lift the jackfruit and it feels heavy, tap or flick the rind. If it makes a dull thudding sound, it is a good jackfruit.
Check the softness of the rind and identify by the signature aroma
If the rind feels soft when pressed, the jackfruit is ripe; a hard rind with firm spikes indicates it is still green.

Additionally, naturally ripened jackfruit always has a very attractive aroma. This is in contrast to chemically ripened jackfruit, which may have a yellow rind but remains very hard, has a strange smell, or a very faint aroma, and you might even feel the hard texture of unripe fruit.
A small note: if you are buying pre-packaged segments, choose bags with a vibrant golden yellow color.

mon_an.mo_ta: With very easy-to-find ingredients and a very low cost, you can make this rich and flavorful sweet and sour tofu for a more appetizing meal!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 1 garlic bulb, minced; 1 tsp minced ginger; scallions, chopped (separate the white parts and green leaves)
Sweet and sour sauce: 2 tbsp ketchup; 6 tbsp water; ½ tbsp cornstarch; ½ tbsp sugar; ½ tbsp soy sauce; ½ tbsp vinegar
cac_buoc: Step 1: Mix the sweet and sour sauce ingredients together in a bowl.
Step 2: Cut the tofu into small cubes. Heat the oil in a pan, then add the tofu and fry until golden brown on all sides. Remove and drain.
Step 3: Remove most of the oil, leaving about 1 tbsp in the pan. Sauté the garlic, scallion whites, and ginger until fragrant. Then pour in the sweet and sour sauce mixture and bring to a boil.
Return the tofu to the pan and simmer over low heat until the sauce evenly coats the tofu.
Garnish with scallion greens, transfer the sweet and sour tofu to a plate, and serve with hot rice.

mon_an.mo_ta: Tandoori grilled chicken is a dish that is both familiar and exotic. Familiar with fresh chicken and exotic with the tandoori sauce. The chicken is tender and moist, deeply infused with sauce, aromatic when grilled, and melts in your mouth for a wonderful experience. Take some time to make this delicious dish!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fresh ginger - 2 tbsp, peeled and minced
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, mix all the sauce ingredients together in a large bowl. Remember to mix well so the ingredients dissolve and blend together.
Step 2:
Next, use a sharp knife to make 3-4 deep scores into each drumstick. This will help the chicken absorb the seasoning more evenly.

You can choose to remove or keep the skin. However, you should keep the skin because it becomes crispy and very fragrant after grilling. Note that grilling with skin is slightly more difficult as it can burn easily; you need to pay attention and turn it frequently.
Step 3:

Place the chicken in a large pan and marinate with the sauce for at least 12 hours but no more than 2 days. A long marinating time helps the sauce penetrate the meat, making the chicken tender and aromatic without drying out.

Afterward, take the chicken out 3-4 hours before grilling. This is a crucial step because if you grill it immediately after taking it out of the fridge, the internal temperature will be too low, making it hard to cook through while the outside burns.
Step 4:
Preheat the oven to 260°C.
Shake off any excess sauce before placing the chicken in the oven.
Turn the chicken frequently to prevent burning. Grill for about 45 minutes. You can use a meat thermometer to check; the temperature near the bone should reach 74°C when finished.
Finally, remove the chicken, cut into bite-sized pieces, and enjoy.
Tips for delicious Tandoori Grilled Chicken
Before grilling, remember to take the chicken out 3-4 hours in advance so it cooks through to the center.
While grilling, pay attention to turning the chicken so it cooks evenly and doesn't burn on the outside while remaining raw inside.
Besides direct grilling, you can wrap the chicken in aluminum foil to help it achieve an appealing color while keeping the meat moist and fresh.
How to choose good chicken (pre-slaughtered):
Free-range chicken usually has a compact, firm body and a narrow breast.
The skin is pale yellow, with darker yellow patches only in areas like the breast, wings, and back.
To identify if the chicken has been dyed, observe: if the skin is yellow but the fat layer underneath is white, it has been treated with chemicals.
The skin should be thin, smooth, and highly elastic. Choose meat that looks fresh, without a foul smell or antibiotic odor, and no bruises or blood clots on the skin.
To buy good chicken, avoid birds with dark or discolored skin, as these may have died before being processed.

Additionally, to avoid water-injected chicken, press on areas like the thighs or breast; if it feels flabby, slippery, or deformed, avoid buying it. Water injected into chicken is often mixed with borax.

mon_an.ten: Vietnamese Lotus Root Salad with Shrimp and Pork
mon_an.mo_ta: Vietnamese Lotus Root Salad with Shrimp and Pork is a traditional Vietnamese dish that is fresh, savory, and not too heavy. This salad is a perfect combination of traditional flavors and freshness, satisfying the palate of you and your family. Let's explore how to make this delicious salad. A traditional Vietnamese dish, fresh and flavorful.
cac_buoc: Bước 1: Prepare the ingredients

After washing, devein the shrimp to remove the black vein. Next, place the shrimp in boiling water and cook for about 5-7 minutes until done. Remove the shrimp and soak them in cold water, then drain and peel.
Wash the pork belly before boiling. Add a little salt to the water to enhance the flavor. Once the meat is cooked, remove and slice into bite-sized pieces.
Wash the lotus root, cut into sections, and soak in water mixed with a little vinegar and alum for about 15 minutes. Rinse the lotus root with cold water and drain.
Wash, peel, and julienne the carrot.
Wash and thinly slice the onion.
Cut the celery into sections and finely chop the Vietnamese coriander.
Finally, place a pan over low heat, add a little salt and the peanuts, and roast until cooked. Peel the peanuts.
Bước 2: Cook the sauce and mix the salad

Place a pan on the stove and turn on the heat, then add 4 tablespoons of fish sauce, 1/3 tablespoon of salt, 2 tablespoons of sugar, and 1/2 tablespoon of MSG. Stir well until the ingredients dissolve and form a slightly thickened mixture, then pour this mixture into a bowl.
Add 1 tablespoon of chili sauce and 1 tablespoon of lime juice to the mixture and stir well.

Next, put the shrimp, pork belly, carrot, lotus root, onion, Chinese celery, and Vietnamese coriander into a clean bowl. Drizzle the dressing over the ingredients and toss well, then let it sit for about 5-10 minutes to allow the sauce to absorb.
Transfer the lotus root salad to a plate, arrange the shrimp and pork on top, sprinkle with roasted peanuts, and garnish with a little cilantro to complete the delicious and crunchy lotus root salad.
Bước 3: Final product

Once finished, the lotus root salad can be enjoyed with shrimp crackers, and when served with sweet and sour fish sauce, the dish becomes even more flavorful. Try your hand at making this for your family now to create wonderful and cozy moments!
Tips for a delicious lotus root salad:
You should only add the roasted peanuts just before eating so they don't get soggy.
Since the salad will release water if left for a long time, remember to drain the liquid from the bottom to keep the salad delicious and crunchy!
Tips for choosing good ingredients for the salad
Here are some tips to help you choose fresh and delicious shrimp:
Choose shrimp with bright shells that are not dark or cloudy.
Check the shell texture: Choose shrimp with smooth shells that are not cracked or peeling.
Check the smell: Fresh shrimp usually have a mild seafood scent and no unpleasant or foul odors.
Prioritize buying live shrimp: If you want to buy live shrimp, choose ones with strong tails, long legs, and active movement.
Use your resources: Ask the seller or someone with experience for advice to select the best shrimp.

mon_an.ten: Delicious Jellyfish and Banana Blossom Salad
mon_an.mo_ta: Jellyfish and banana blossom salad is a perfect dish for hot summer days, featuring fresh, crunchy jellyfish and flavorful young banana blossom with a mild tartness, sour starfruit, and roasted peanuts for a wonderful sensation. Take a little time to make this delicious dish for your whole family!
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients for the jellyfish and banana blossom salad:

Wash the banana blossom, slice thinly, and soak in diluted salt water to remove the sap and tartness. If you cannot buy whole banana blossoms, you can buy pre-sliced ones, but pay attention to choose young, fresh ones.
Soak the jellyfish in plain or warm water, squeezing gently to remove salt and slime. Change the water every 15 minutes to remove the saltiness. Repeat 4-5 times, then remove and drain.
Wash and finely chop the fresh chilies.
Wash the starfruit, remove the outer edges, and slice crosswise. Slice thinly so the salad has a moderate sourness.
Clean the herbs, removing the roots and yellowed leaves, then wash and soak in salt water for about 3 minutes. Rinse again and chop finely.
Steps to make the jellyfish and banana blossom salad:
Step 1: To make the jellyfish crunchier, boil a pot of water with a few grains of salt. When the water boils, blanch the jellyfish briefly, then remove quickly and drain.
Step 2: Prepare the dressing:
Mix ½ small bowl of fish sauce with minced chili, minced garlic, lime juice, a little sugar, and vinegar, then stir well until dissolved.
Step 3: Rub the skins off the roasted peanuts and crush them slightly, just enough to split the peanuts in half or into small pieces.

Step 3: Next, put the banana blossom, jellyfish, herbs, and starfruit into a large bowl, pour the dressing over, and toss well to absorb the seasonings. Toss evenly and let sit for about 1 minute for the jellyfish to absorb the flavors.
Finally, transfer the salad to a plate, sprinkle with peanuts, and garnish with a little cilantro on top.
Tips for a delicious jellyfish and banana blossom salad:
This salad should be eaten immediately after preparation because the ingredients will become soft and soggy if left for too long.
The salad will release water after mixing, so you should drain that liquid to keep the salad from getting wet.
If fresh jellyfish is not available, you can use ready-to-eat jellyfish as a substitute.
How to choose ready-to-eat jellyfish:
Choose jellyfish pieces that are about 6-8 cm wide (if the jellyfish is too large, it won't be as crunchy and will hold too much water inside).
Look for a bag with a moderate amount of preservative liquid; if there is too much liquid, the actual amount of jellyfish will be small. The bag should look relatively full.

Jellyfish and banana blossom salad is a perfect dish for hot summer days, featuring fresh, crunchy jellyfish and flavorful young banana blossom with a mild tartness, sour starfruit, and roasted peanuts for a wonderful sensation. Take a little time to make this delicious dish for your whole family!

mon_an.mo_ta: Crispy vegetable-stuffed potato balls are a delicious and enticing dish, featuring a crunchy golden exterior and a savory filling of fresh meat blended with sweet corn, carrots, and fiber-rich peas. The soft, flavorful potato mash makes this a must-try recipe for any home cook. Head to the kitchen and give it a try!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Sweet corn and green peas - a small amount of each
A pinch of salt, ½ tsp black pepper, ½ tsp sugar - seasoning
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients.
Peel and wash the potatoes, then slice them. Immediately soak the slices in a bowl of water with a pinch of salt to prevent browning.
Wash the beef and finely mince or grind it.
Mince the shallots.
Peel, wash, and finely dice the carrot.
Crack the eggs and separate the whites into a bowl.
Cut the unsalted butter into small pieces.
Place the sweet corn and green peas in a bowl to reach room temperature.
Step 2: Cooking process.

Bring a pot of water to a boil and cook the green peas until tender. Once cooked, remove and soak them in an ice bath for 10-15 minutes to firm up. Repeat the same process for the carrots and sweet corn.
Bring another pot of water to a boil and cook the potatoes until tender. Transfer the cooked potatoes to a bowl and let them cool slightly. Use a wooden spoon to mash them until very smooth.
Mix in 10 g of flour, cornstarch, butter, egg yolks, a pinch of salt, pepper, and sugar. Mix thoroughly until the potatoes are well-seasoned and the texture is smooth and fine.
Heat a small amount of oil in a pan. Sauté the shallots until fragrant, then add the beef and stir-fry.

When the beef is nearly cooked, add the sweet corn, green peas, and carrots. Season to taste. Once the meat and vegetables are just cooked through, turn off the heat and transfer the mixture to a bowl.

Take a spoonful of the mashed potato in your hand. Roll it into a ball, then flatten it. Place a spoonful of the filling in the center and carefully shape the potato back into a ball, ensuring the filling is completely sealed inside. Repeat until all the potato and filling are used.
Dredge each potato ball in a layer of flour, dip it into the egg whites, and finally coat it with panko breadcrumbs.
Heat a generous amount of oil in a pan.
Once the oil is hot, carefully drop the potato balls in to fry. Turn them occasionally during frying to ensure all sides are golden brown and evenly cooked.
Once cooked, remove the balls and place them on paper towels to drain excess oil.
Arrange the potato balls on a plate and serve with chili sauce, garlic-chili fish sauce, or mayonnaise.
Tips for perfect vegetable-stuffed potato balls:
When frying, use medium heat; if the heat is too high, the potatoes will burn easily.
Use enough oil to completely submerge the potato balls. If you use too little oil, the potatoes will absorb more grease, making them heavy and less appetizing.
To preserve the natural sweetness and nutrients of the potatoes, you can steam them instead of boiling, though this will take more time.

mon_an.mo_ta: Thai hot pot with its signature sour and spicy flavors is always a favorite. To experience this attractive dish right away, let's head to the kitchen and make a delicious Thai hot pot! Experience the simple yet flavorful sour and spicy taste of a mixed Thai hot pot at home with instructions from the Cooking Handbook.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Instant noodles, rice vermicelli - as desired
Galangal, lemongrass, lime leaves, ginger - aromatics
cac_buoc: 1. Prepare the ingredients
Cut the tofu into small cubes for later use.
Slice the beef thinly; the thinner it is, the faster it cooks and the more tender it will be.
Remove the heads and tails of the shrimp, though if you prefer to eat them, just wash them thoroughly without cutting.
Mince the garlic, shallots, lemongrass, chili, lime leaves, and onion; cut the tomatoes into wedges.
After washing the corn, cut it into small chunks, each about 3 cm long.
Cut the napa cabbage into small pieces, each about 4 cm long.
Wash the mustard greens and mushrooms, then cut them into bite-sized pieces.
2. Prepare the broth
Place a pot on the stove and heat it, then add 1 tbsp of cooking oil. Once the oil is hot, sauté the minced garlic, minced shallots, lemongrass, and lime leaves until fragrant.
When the garlic and shallots are fragrant, add the tomatoes and stir-fry well. Next, add 2 tbsp of chili paste and 2 sliced chilies, then stir well.
Once the tomatoes have softened, add the bone broth. Add 2 tbsp of sugar, 1 tsp of salt, 1 tbsp of fish sauce, and 3 tbsp of tamarind juice.
Bring to a boil, then strain the broth through a sieve to collect only the liquid.
3. Completion
Place the hot pot on the stove and add clams, shrimp, octopus, fish balls, some tomato wedges, tofu, and beef tenderloin. Then, add the hot pot broth and bring to a boil.

Once the broth is boiling, add the corn first to increase the sweetness of the broth. Then, you can dip your favorite vegetables into the pot and start enjoying the hot, delicious Thai hot pot. With just a few simple steps following the instructions above, you will have an attractive and tasty Thai hot pot. Enjoying the sour and spicy flavor of hot Thai hot pot on cold rainy days is truly a wonderful experience!
Notes for making delicious Thai hot pot

Ingredients: Choose fresh, high-quality ingredients. Buy meat with alternating lean and fat, with clear origin. Shrimp should have transparent shells, no fishy smell, and avoid those with dark patches or inconsistent colors.

Broth: Prepare a delicious broth with suitable flavors. Use aromatics like garlic, shallots, lemongrass, and lime leaves to create the signature scent of Thai hot pot. You can add chili paste, fish sauce, sugar, and tamarind juice to adjust the flavor to your preference.
Spices: Use characteristic Thai hot pot spices like chili, chili powder, and Thai hot pot seasoning to create a spicy, rich flavor.

Raw vegetables: Diversify the vegetables to add flavor and nutrients. Include varieties such as water spinach, cabbage, napa cabbage, cilantro, basil, celery, bok choy, and mushrooms for freshness and variety.

Cooking method: Boil the broth before adding ingredients. Corn should be added first to sweeten the broth. Dip fresh food into the pot in batches and wait until just cooked. Avoid overcooking to maintain freshness and crunchiness.
How to choose fresh ingredients
1. How to choose fresh beef brisket
Select portions where lean and fat are evenly distributed, with clear origin and source.

For imported frozen beef brisket, you can buy it at supermarkets or food stores. Check the packaging to ensure it is intact, check the expiration date, and observe for signs of sliminess, crushed meat, or a pale green tint.
2. How to choose fresh shrimp
Fresh shrimp have transparent shells and a slight scent of the sea, without a fishy smell. Avoid buying shrimp with dark patches or inconsistent colors.
Fresh shrimp usually have tails folded together. If the tail is spread out, the shrimp may have been injected with chemicals or water to make them look larger.

The legs of fresh shrimp should be tightly attached to the body. If the legs have turned black or are no longer firmly attached, it is a sign that the shrimp are no longer fresh and should not be purchased.
Paying attention to these details will help you choose fresh meat and shrimp, ensuring quality for your meal.

mon_an.mo_ta: Change your palate with this delicious, unique, and easy-to-eat steamed fish with soy sauce. This dish is not only suitable for family meals but also an excellent choice for parties or casual gatherings. If you are tired of oily fried fish, try steaming it with soy sauce. This method preserves all the natural sweetness of the fish, allowing you to enjoy it without feeling greasy. Explore this simple and interesting recipe to show off your cooking skills and enjoy a fragrant steamed fish with soy sauce.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Carp (can substitute with red tilapia or mackerel) - 1 fish
Ginger 1 knob, onion 1 bulb, some green onions - Ingredients
Soy sauce, oyster sauce, sugar, fish sauce, MSG, pepper - Seasoning
cac_buoc: 1. Prepare the fish

Using a knife, slit the belly of the fish and remove the inedible internal organs. Next, cut off the fins and clean all the scales on the surface. To remove dirt and fishy odors, rub some white wine over the entire surface of the fish. Let the fish rest for about 10 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with clean water.

Peel and wash the ginger, then cut it into small pieces. Remove the roots from the green onions and dill, then wash them. Rinse the vegetables and cut them into sections about the length of a finger joint.
2. Marinate the fish

To marinate the fish, prepare a seasoning mixture including: 2 tsp seasoning powder, 2 tsp chili powder, 1/2 tsp pepper, 1/2 tsp MSG, 1/2 tsp salt, 3 tsp sugar, and 1 tsp sesame oil. Mix all these seasonings well and rub them evenly over the surface of the fish, inside and out.

Additionally, use the sliced ginger, sliced shallots, sliced fresh chilies, and chopped green onions. Stuff half an onion into the fish's belly. Let the mixture marinate for about 30 minutes. You can also marinate first and then stuff the fish.
3. Cook the steamed fish with soy sauce
Step 1: Prepare the soy sauce
In a pot, mix 300 ml of soy sauce with 300 ml of filtered water (1:1 ratio).
Add the sliced ginger, chopped green onions, and the remaining 1/2 onion.
Bring the mixture to a boil on the stove, then turn off the heat.
Adjust the seasoning to your family's taste.
Step 2: Prepare the steamer
Step 3: Steam the fish
Place the fish in the steamer and steam for 20 minutes.
After 20 minutes, open the steamer and pour the soy sauce over the fish.
Continue steaming for another 20 minutes to complete.
The instructions for making steamed fish with soy sauce are above; it's delicious, isn't it!
Enjoy your meal and success with this steamed fish with soy sauce!
How to choose fresh fish for steaming
Check the eyes: The eyes should be bright, clear, and not cloudy. This is a sign of fresh fish.
Check the scales: The scales should be shiny, not dry or peeling. Avoid choosing fish with dark or dull scales.
Check the smell: Fresh fish usually has a fresh scent, without any foul or musty odors. Avoid fish with unpleasant smells.
Check the skin condition: The skin should be smooth, without bruises or damage. This is a sign of fresh fish.
Check the elasticity: When pressing on the body, the skin should spring back immediately and not leave a dent. This indicates the fish is still fresh.
Trust the source: If possible, buy fish from reputable and reliable sources such as trusted seafood markets or fish shops.
Consult the seller: Ask the seller about the fish's origin, time, and storage method to ensure you buy fresh fish.
Check other ingredients: If you buy processed or packaged fish, check other ingredients such as squid, shrimp, raw vegetables, egg yolks, cabbage... to ensure quality and freshness.

mon_an.ten: Braised Fish with Sour Bamboo Shoots and Pork Belly
mon_an.mo_ta: In the diverse world of cuisine, braised fish with bamboo shoots is not only delicious but also a rich, traditional Vietnamese dish. With a unique combination of fresh fish and crunchy, sweet bamboo shoots, this dish wins hearts with its characteristic and attractive flavor. Let's cook this delicious meal! This guide shows you how to make flavorful braised fish with bamboo shoots, featuring the perfect blend of fresh fish and crisp bamboo. Prepare the necessary ingredients and follow these simple steps to create a traditional Vietnamese favorite. Enjoy the distinct and enticing taste of hot braised fish with bamboo shoots served with fresh steamed rice.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fermented soybean paste (tương bần) - as needed
Seasoning powder, pepper, sugar - as needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients

When buying fish, you can choose fresh pre-cleaned varieties. After bringing it home, wash the fish thoroughly with salt water and a little white vinegar. Once cleaned, drain the fish and cut it into chunks about 3 cm thick. Next, marinate the fish with half a teaspoon of salt and let it sit for one hour.
For the sour bamboo shoots, cut them into sections, remove the tough parts, and use your hands to shred the bamboo into short strips. Wash the bamboo several times to clean it.
Next, briefly blanch the bamboo in boiling water to remove the sour odor, then pour it into a colander to drain.
Step 2: Cook the braised fish with bamboo shoots

Heat 2 teaspoons of cooking oil with 2 teaspoons of sugar. When the sugar turns into an amber caramel color, quickly add the finely chopped shallots and galangal, then stir well. Next, add the fish and bamboo shoots to the pan and continue to stir together. This process will color the braised fish and provide an attractive flavor.

Then, add fish sauce, salt, sugar, and bird's eye chilies (if you want the dish spicy). Keep the heat low and cover the pot. If possible, cook the braised fish over charcoal or use a clay pot to enhance the flavor. Bring to a boil to let the spices infuse; once the liquid in the pot reduces, you can add a little boiling water and simmer until the fish is firm and the bamboo shoots have absorbed the seasonings. When the desired result is achieved, turn off the heat and sprinkle some pepper over the surface.
Finally, remove the fish and bamboo shoots to a plate and enjoy immediately with hot rice. A meal combining braised fish and rice will be irresistible.
Enjoy your meal, everyone!

mon_an.mo_ta: Basa fish contains an abundant amount of fat, and the fat in this species is healthy fat, helping with safe weight gain without harming the cardiovascular system or blood pressure like some other weight-gain foods. Basa fish also contains a large amount of DHA, which is very good for human health. DHA helps convert cholesterol into derivatives that do not cause blood vessel blockage, reducing heart arrhythmias, menstrual cramps in women, and pre-eclampsia. In addition to omega-3 fats, basa fish also contains many minerals such as iron, phosphorus, zinc, copper, calcium, trace elements like fluorine, selenium, cobalt, manganese, and many vitamins. These compounds help strengthen health and effectively improve weight for thin people. The amount of bad cholesterol in basa fish is very low, posing no threat to the heart during weight gain. Therefore, with basa fish, thin people can feel secure about increasing their body weight. In particular, the fat part of basa fish contains many good fats and is where full nutrients are stored. From basa fish, you can prepare many attractive menus such as basa fish simmered with fermented rice, basa fish in tamarind sauce... Today, we will guide you through making nutritious basa fish cakes, which are great for those who are thin or weak.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Thaw the basa fish partially; it is best when it is still slightly slushy like ice cream. Fillet the meat and cut the fish into 3cm cubes.
Step 2: Put each piece of fish into a food processor and grind until smooth.
Step 3: After adding all the fish, add the dill, fish sauce, cornstarch, tapioca starch, sugar, a pinch of salt, and white pepper. Grind for about 1 more minute, then turn off the machine.
Step 4: Remove the fish paste and fry until golden brown; it looks very beautiful and tastes delicious.
Enjoy your meal!

mon_an.ten: Delicious Steamed Squid with Ginger and Lemongrass
mon_an.mo_ta: When you are tired of stir-fried or grilled dishes, try changing your palate with this simple steamed squid with ginger. Not flashy or pretentious, yet never bland. It only takes a few minutes to prepare, and you'll have a fragrant dish of steamed squid with ginger and lemongrass. Check out this delicious recipe now! Enjoy incredibly tasty steamed squid with ginger and lemongrass with these simple instructions. This dish brings a rich and savory flavor with the perfect combination of fresh squid, ginger, and lemongrass.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Oyster sauce, seasoning powder, cooking oil, pepper, sugar, salt-pepper-lime dip - as needed
cac_buoc: 1. How to make steamed squid with ginger and lemongrass
Step 1: Clean the squid after purchasing.
Step 2: Marinate the squid with oyster sauce, seasoning powder, cooking oil, pepper, and sugar to let it absorb the flavors.
Step 3: Place the squid in a deep plate and steam.
Step 4: When nearly cooked, add chopped scallions, julienned ginger, and sliced onion, then continue to steam for about 5 more minutes until ready. Serve hot with salt, pepper, and lime.
2. Steamed squid with ginger and scallions
Ingredients to prepare
Fresh squid: 500g - You can use tube squid, baby squid, or bigfin reef squid.
Ginger: 1 piece, about 100g.
Scallions: 100g.
Red horn chilies: 6 pieces.
Fresh greens to serve: 1 cucumber, 1 fig (optional), herbs, cilantro, lettuce.
Garlic: 1 bulb.
Fresh lime: 1 fruit.
Seasonings: Seasoning powder, fish sauce, sugar, white wine.
Ingredient preparation

Squid: Prepare and wash with water mixed with white wine and crushed ginger to reduce the fishy smell and make it more fragrant when steamed. Cut the squid into 3cm rings and lightly score the body. If using small baby squid, leave them whole.
Ginger: Peel, wash, and divide into 3 parts. Slice 2/3 into thin strips, leave the rest whole.
Scallions: Trim and wash, drain, and cut into 5cm sections.
Horn chilies: Remove stems, wash, split, and remove seeds. Slice 3 chilies thinly, leave the rest whole.
Garlic: Peel, wash, and drain.
Fresh lime: Squeeze for juice.

Fresh greens: Trim and wash, drain. Rub the cucumber ends, slice into 3cm pieces. Peel the fig and slice thinly, soak in water with a little lime to keep it white. Arrange the greens and other vegetables on a plate for an attractive presentation.
Cooking method

Once the squid has absorbed the seasonings, mix it with the julienned ginger, sliced chilies, and scallion sections. Place this mixture in a steamer and steam over boiling water for about 10 minutes until the squid is just cooked through. Note: do not steam too long so the squid doesn't lose its crunchiness. After steaming, arrange the steamed squid with scallions and ginger on a plate beautifully.
Next, prepare the dipping sauce, which is a crucial step. Note that for steamed squid, a ginger-lime-garlic fish sauce is the best choice. Here is how to make it:
Place 3 horn chilies, the remaining ginger, and garlic in a mortar and pound finely. You can slice the chili and ginger first to make pounding easier.

Then, put the pounded mixture into a bowl and mix in 5 tablespoons of fish sauce and 2 tablespoons of lime juice. Stir well until you have a delicious and rich ginger fish sauce. You can adjust the sugar, chili, and fish sauce to suit your family's taste.
3. Squid steamed with lemongrass, ginger, and beer
Fresh squid: 500g
Ginger: 2 bulbs
Lemongrass: 5 stalks
Fresh beer: 300ml
Soup powder: 1/2 teaspoon
Ground pepper: 1/2 teaspoon
Ginger: Peel and crush, then mince finely.
Lemongrass: Peel off the outer layer, wash, and crush.
Squid: Wash and use a knife to score several horizontal lines on the body.

Next, marinate the squid by mixing it with minced ginger, crushed lemongrass, 1/2 teaspoon of soup powder, and 1/2 teaspoon of ground pepper. Stir well to let the squid absorb the spices for about 15 minutes.
Steaming the squid
Steaming: Place the steamer on the stove and heat it up. Then, add a little water along with the fresh beer into the steamer. Place the marinated squid in the steamer and steam for about 10 minutes.
Finished product: After steaming, the squid will have a blended aroma of beer, lemongrass, and ginger.
How to choose fresh egg squid
To buy fresh squid, first observe the color. Fresh squid has a shiny color; the brown parts will be dark brown, and the body will be milky white.
When touching the squid body, feel for firm meat with high elasticity. When pressed, the squid should quickly return to its original shape without leaving a dent.
Additionally, fresh squid has clear eyes that do not bulge, with distinct pupils and no signs of yellowing or leaking fluid. Non-fresh squid often has cloudier eyes and may leak fluid.
Furthermore, fresh squid has the head, tentacles, and arms firmly attached to each other. Meanwhile, non-fresh squid often has these parts soft and easily detached.
How long does it take to steam squid with ginger?
The steaming time for squid with ginger depends on the size and type of squid you use. Typically, small squid can cook in 5-7 minutes, while large squid may take 10-12 minutes.

To check if the squid is cooked, you can use a sharp knife or chopstick to poke the squid. If it goes in easily and the squid is an opaque white color, it means it's cooked. However, be careful not to steam too long as the squid will become tough and lose its crunch.
What is good to dip steamed squid in?

Steamed squid with ginger is usually served with ginger fish sauce, a type of sauce that is fragrant, rich, and blends perfectly with the ginger flavor. Ginger fish sauce helps highlight the natural flavor of the squid.
To make ginger fish sauce, you can mix the following:
Ginger: Peeled and minced.
Garlic: Minced or pressed.
Fish sauce: According to your taste; you can adjust the amount as preferred.
Sugar: Add a little sugar to balance the sour, salty, and sweet flavors.
Lime juice: Used for aroma and freshness.
Fresh chili: Add finely chopped fresh chili to increase the heat and flavor.
Mix all the above ingredients and stir well until you achieve a delicious ginger fish sauce mixture. Then, you can use this sauce to dip the steamed squid.
Alternatively, you can dip steamed squid in sweet and sour fish sauce, soy sauce, or fish sauce mixed with garlic, chili, lime, and sugar. The choice depends on your personal taste and preference.
What vegetables to eat with steamed squid with ginger?
Steamed squid with ginger is often paired with fresh vegetables to create a balance of flavor and nutrients. Here are some popular choices:
Fish mint: Provides freshness and crunch.
Vietnamese coriander (rau răm): Brings a fragrant and refreshing taste.
Herbs: Such as cilantro, rice paddy herb, or Vietnamese balm to create layers of aroma.
Water spinach: Quickly sautéed to keep its crunch.
Bok choy: Provides green freshness and nutrients.
Spinach: Has a characteristic aroma and crunch.
Lettuce: Provides freshness and crunch.
Kale: Creates a good mouthfeel and sharp color.
Thai basil: Brings a special and fresh flavor.
Additionally, you can add other types of greens or raw vegetables like tomatoes, cucumbers, scallions, and fresh chilies to add variety and color to the dish.
Depending on personal preference, you can freely choose suitable vegetables to accompany the steamed squid.
How many calories are in steamed squid with ginger?
The number of calories in steamed squid with ginger depends on the size and type of squid, as well as the amount of ginger and other ingredients used. Here is an estimate for a standard serving:
Squid: About 100-150 calories depending on size and type.
Ginger: About 2-4 calories for one tablespoon of minced ginger.
Other ingredients like fish sauce, sugar, chili, garlic, etc.: Can contribute 5-20 calories depending on the amount used.

In total, a standard serving of steamed squid with ginger may contain about 120-200 calories. However, note that this information is only an estimate and can change based on the cooking method and the ratio of ingredients in your recipe. For more accuracy, you can use online tools or mobile nutrition apps.

mon_an.ten: Irresistible Sweet and Sour Stir-fried Squid
mon_an.mo_ta: Why hesitate? Get into the kitchen and show off your skills with this fresh, attractive, and incredibly fragrant sweet and sour stir-fried squid!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings - pepper, salt, seasoning powder, sugar, sesame oil
cac_buoc: Ingredients you need to prepare for a delicious sweet and sour stir-fried squid!

Step 1: Remove the heads from the fresh squid, discard the ink sacs, leave them whole and wash thoroughly. During washing, add a few drops of sesame oil to the squid to remove the fishy smell. Next, soak the fresh squid in salt water for about 5 minutes so that it remains crunchy and firm when stir-fried.
Step 2: Remove the squid and drain, then marinate with seasonings and oyster sauce for 15 minutes to let the flavors absorb.
Step 3: Wash the tomatoes and onions and cut them into wedges. Wash the scallions and celery and cut them into sections.
Step 4: Place a pan on the stove, heat the lard, and sauté the scallion whites until fragrant. Next, add the onions and tomatoes in turn and stir-fry quickly over high heat.
Step 5: When the tomatoes and onions are just tender, add the squid and stir-fry quickly and evenly over high heat.
Step 6: Squid cooks very quickly, so you only need to stir-fry for a few minutes. Once the squid is cooked, sprinkle with scallions, celery, pepper, or satay, then turn off the stove.

Transfer the sweet and sour stir-fried squid to a plate and serve hot with white rice. The squid is crunchy with a characteristic sweetness blended with the sweet and sour taste of tomatoes and onions, along with the aroma of scallions and celery, creating a very appetizing dish.
This plate of sweet and sour stir-fried squid will surely please the whole family.

mon_an.ten: Delicious Chicken Salad with Onions, Vietnamese Coriander, and Carrots
mon_an.mo_ta: Chicken and onion salad is a very easy dish to make and eat because of its simple ingredients and seasonings. The salad is fresh and attractive with crunchy onions and carrots, served with flavorful chicken mixed with a bit of Vietnamese coriander and a sweet and sour taste that brings a wonderful sensation. Spend a little time making this delicious salad to treat your family! Check out the recipe for this super delicious chicken salad with onions, Vietnamese coriander, and carrots now! Enjoy a tasty chicken salad with the savory flavor of chicken, the sweet crunch of onions and carrots, and the richness of peanuts. Simple and easy-to-follow recipe.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Sugar, vinegar, MSG, soup powder - seasonings
cac_buoc: Step 1: Boil the chicken

To remove the odor from the chicken, after buying it, you should wash the meat with diluted salt water, then rinse with clean water. Place the chicken in a pot of water and bring to a boil. Adjust the time so as not to overcook it. Ideally, when the water boils, turn off the heat and leave the chicken in the pot for about 5-10 minutes so the meat continues to cook gradually and retains its characteristic fragrance and sweetness.

When the chicken has cooled, use your hands to shred it into small pieces (thick strips) and marinate with lime juice, a little sugar, and seasoning powder. Massage the chicken thoroughly so the spices penetrate each piece, creating a richer flavor for the chicken and onion salad.
Step 2: Prepare the ingredients

First, peel and wash the onions, then slice them thinly crosswise. To remove the pungency of the onions and keep them crunchy, immediately after slicing, soak the onions in ice-cold water for a few minutes, then remove, drain, and mix with lime juice and 5 tablespoons of sugar. Let the onions soak in the lime juice and sugar for about 15-20 minutes, then pour into a colander.
Wash the carrots, then shred them into thin strips.
Wash the Vietnamese coriander, select fresh, green leaves, and drain.
Wash the lime leaves and drain.
Wash the limes, remove seeds, and squeeze for juice.
Peel the garlic, then crush or mince it finely.
Wash the chilies and remove seeds.
Roast the peanuts until cooked and fragrant, let cool, peel, and crush slightly.
Step 3: Mix the chicken and onion salad
First, put the shredded carrots into a large bowl and mix well with lime juice and 2 teaspoons of sugar. Use your hands to mix thoroughly so the carrots absorb the seasoning.

Next, add the onions and chicken to the bowl, and season with the following ratio: 2 teaspoons of sugar, 2 teaspoons of MSG, 1 teaspoon of seasoning powder, lime juice, minced garlic and chili, and a little pepper. Mix well until all components are fully combined.

Then, add the Vietnamese coriander, thinly sliced lime leaves, and crushed roasted peanuts to the bowl and continue to mix. Afterward, taste the salad to check the flavor; if necessary, you can adjust the seasonings to suit your palate.

To let the chicken and onion salad absorb the flavors, wait for 3-5 minutes. Then, arrange it on a plate, sprinkle more roasted peanuts on top, add a bit of Vietnamese coriander and a chili flower for decoration.
Tips for making chicken and onion salad without pungency
To make the salad without the onion pungency, you can apply these tips:
Use fresh onions: Choose fresh onions that do not have a strong pungent smell from the start. Check onions by looking for bright skin that is not withered or showing signs of damage.
Cool the onions: After peeling and slicing the onions thinly, soak them in ice-cold water for about 15-20 minutes. This helps remove part of the pungency and makes the onions crunchier.

Use lime juice: Before mixing the onions with other spices, mix them with lime juice. Lime juice not only helps remove the pungency but also makes the onions fresher and creates a characteristic flavor for the salad.
Marinating time: After mixing the onions with other seasonings, let the salad rest in the refrigerator for about 15-30 minutes so the onions absorb the spices and soften slightly.
Notes for a delicious chicken and onion salad:

You can use chicken breast, tenderloin, or thighs depending on your preference. If you have elderly family members, you might buy industrial chicken as the meat is not tough; otherwise, using free-range chicken (gà ta) will be tastier.

Soaking onions in ice water helps them stay crunchy, and massaging them with vinegar also helps reduce the pungency and heat. However, it may not disappear completely. Some people, especially men, like it that way, but if you cannot handle it, soak the onions in a bit of warm water for just a few minutes so they don't become mushy.
Adjust the spiciness and sourness according to your preference.

mon_an.ten: Korean Braised Beef Short Ribs with Vegetables
