mon_an.mo_ta: This Korean braised beef short ribs dish is incredibly nutritious, featuring tender beef, bold spices, and a rich, thick sauce served with vegetables and hot rice. Simple and easy to prepare, this wholesome meal is a wonderful gift for your family after a long day of work.
cac_buoc: Bước 1:
First, rinse the shiitake mushrooms and soak them in warm water for 4-6 hours until they expand fully, ensuring they are soft and fragrant when eaten.
Bước 2:
Next, soak the beef short ribs in a large bowl of cold water for about 30 minutes. Change the water several times to remove any odors and blood.
Bước 3:
Bring a large pot of water to a boil and add the beef ribs. Continue to boil for 5-10 minutes.
Bước 4:
After 5-10 minutes, discard the boiling water and rinse the ribs with cold water to remove impurities and debris.
Bước 5:

Next, prepare a large pot and combine 2 cups of water, 4 tbsp soy sauce, 8 minced garlic cloves, thinly sliced onion, 1 tbsp rice wine, and 1 tbsp brown sugar. Add the rinsed beef ribs to this mixture.
Bước 6:
Bring the pot to a boil on the stove for about 20 minutes.
Bước 7:

While waiting for the mixture to boil, peel the carrot and daikon radish, then rinse them. Cut the carrot and radish into 5 cm pieces and round off the edges to create rounded shapes. Cut the shiitake mushrooms into bite-sized pieces.
Bước 8:
After boiling for 20 minutes, open the lid and add the carrots, radish, and shiitake mushrooms. Simmer over low heat for about 1 hour or until all ingredients are tender.
Bước 9:
After 1 hour, open the lid and check if the meat is fully cooked by piercing it with a chopstick; if it goes through easily, the meat is done.
Bước 10:
Finally, add the corn syrup, sesame oil, and black pepper, then heat the pot over high heat. Mix well and continue cooking until the sauce reduces, then serve.
Tips for delicious Korean braised beef short ribs:
You can add chestnuts or ginkgo nuts to enhance the flavor of the dish.

In step 8, while the beef ribs are simmering on low heat for 1 hour, use a wooden spoon to stir the mixture frequently. Ladle the sauce from the bottom over the top so the flavors are evenly absorbed and the ribs at the bottom do not burn. Occasionally flip the ribs to ensure the meat is well-seasoned.
Besides beef ribs, you can also prepare this dish similarly with pork ribs or chicken wings and thighs.

This Korean braised beef short ribs dish is incredibly nutritious, featuring tender beef, bold spices, and a rich, thick sauce served with vegetables and hot rice. Simple and easy to prepare, this wholesome meal is a wonderful gift for your family after a long day of work.

Braised tofu with fish roe is a delicious, nutritious, and easy-to-make dish that doesn't take much time. Here is the recipe for this tasty dish to help you diversify your family meals. Let's find out the recipe.

Ingredients: - Tofu, cut into squares - 300g - Fish roe - 200g - A few chili peppers, fresh ginger thinly sliced, white peppercorns, fresh garlic greens cut into sections - Soy sauce, fish sauce, sugar, salt. - Instructions: Step 1: Heat oil in a pan, add the tofu and fry until golden brown on all sides, then remove to a plate. dau-rim-trung-ca-cho-com-toi-het-veo Step 2: Reheat the pan, drain off excess oil, leaving only a thin layer to coat the surface if there is too much oil. Add white peppercorns and stir-fry until fragrant, then remove to a separate bowl. After washing the fish roe, pat the surface dry with paper towels and use your hands to peel off the thin membrane surrounding the roe sacs to prevent splattering and breaking during frying. Heat oil in the pan (use the same oil you just used to fry the peppercorns for extra aroma) and fry the fish roe until golden brown on both sides. The fish roe will become much firmer after frying, but do not mash them; instead, use a spatula to separate them into bite-sized pieces. dau-rim-trung-ca-cho-com-toi-het-veo (1) Step 3: Add soy sauce and half a small bowl of boiling water. Wait for it to boil before adding the tofu, ginger, and chili. Cover and simmer over low heat for 2 minutes. Add the fragrant stir-fried white peppercorns, season with salt, sugar, and fish sauce to taste, and simmer for another 3–4 minutes for the tofu to absorb the flavors. Finally, add the chopped garlic greens, stir briefly, and turn off the heat. dau-rim-trung-ca-cho-com-toi-het-veo (2) Braised tofu with fish roe has an eye-catching golden color, accented with the fresh green of the garlic greens, which will surely be a highlight for your family meal. dau-rim-trung-ca-cho-com-toi-het-veo (3) Braised tofu with fish roe is a humble yet delicious and attractive dish with soft, fragrant tofu and savory fish roe. Though simple, it is nutritious and healthy, especially for the elderly and children, and will surely delight everyone in your family!

mon_an.mo_ta: Salads and slaws are refreshing dishes that help balance out a summer meal. Today, we will guide you through a simple, quick, and delicious recipe for chicken and banana blossom salad. Let's get cooking!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Lime leaves, onion, Vietnamese coriander, garlic, chili, peanuts, cilantro, herbs, lettuce, tomato, black pepper
cac_buoc: Step 1: Boil the chicken until cooked, shred it, and season with a bit of salt and pepper.
Step 2: Mix shredded carrots with dissolved vinegar and sugar. Add minced garlic, minced chili, salt, fish sauce, and lime juice. Season to a balanced sweet and sour taste and mix well.
Step 3: Rinse the banana blossom, squeeze dry, and mix with the carrots.

Step 4: Add the chicken and mix. Then add lime juice, vinegar, sugar, garlic, chili, and pepper, and toss well. Once the salad has absorbed the sweet, sour, salty, and spicy flavors, add the herbs, cilantro, and Vietnamese coriander. Toss gently for fragrance and presentation.
When serving, transfer the chicken and banana blossom salad to a plate. Garnish with tomato and lettuce, and sprinkle roasted peanuts on top.

With just 4 simple steps, you have finished a delicious and crunchy chicken and banana blossom salad. This dish is perfect as a snack or appetizer. Don't hesitate to make this salad to make your family meal more appealing! 🙂

mon_an.mo_ta: In traditional medicine, winter melon is known for its cooling properties, helping to detoxify and refresh the body. It is also great for weight loss and skin health. On hot days, a bowl of winter melon soup makes a meal much more pleasant. Let's explore this recipe for Clam and Winter Melon Soup, a refreshing dish perfect for sunny days.
cac_buoc: Clam and Winter Melon Soup (Method 1)
Step 1: Soak the clams in rice water for several hours to release grit. Rinse thoroughly. Boil the clams until they open, then use chopsticks to stir and separate the meat from the shells.
Step 2: Remove the clam meat to a bowl and discard the shells. Keep the cooking liquid for the soup. Marinate the clam meat with a bit of seasoning powder, shallots, and pepper for 15 minutes.
Step 3: Choose small, firm winter melons with dark green skin and fine hairs for the best flavor. Peel, remove the seeds, rinse, and slice into bite-sized pieces.

Step 4: Sauté the shallots until fragrant, then add the clam meat and stir-fry until aromatic. Pour in the boiling clam broth, add the winter melon, and wait for the soup to come to a boil. Season to taste and turn off the heat. Ladle the soup into a bowl and garnish with chopped green onions.
Method 2: Clam and Winter Melon Soup
1. Ingredients
300g fresh winter melon
500g clams
Green onions and shallots
Seasonings: soup powder, fish sauce, MSG, seasoning powder, pepper, and other spices.
2. Instructions
Step 1: Preparation
First, soak the clams in rice water or clean water with a few sliced chilies to help them release dirt and sand. Soak for about 1 hour, or ideally from morning to evening for maximum cleanliness.
Next, peel the winter melon, remove the seeds, rinse, and drain. Cut into bite-sized batons.
Mince the shallots and finely chop the green onions.
Step 2: Boiling the clams

After cleaning the clams, rinse with cold water and place them in a pot. Add enough water to cover the clams. Bring to a boil and cook for about 2 minutes after the water boils. Check if the clams have opened, then turn off the heat and let cool slightly. Do not let the water boil over. Skim off the foam from the surface.
Once cooled, remove the clams from the shells. Keep the meat and discard the shells. Pour the clam broth into a large bowl, being careful to leave the sediment at the bottom of the pot behind.
Step 3: Cooking the soup
Clean the pot used for boiling the clams, then heat a little oil. Sauté the minced shallots until fragrant.
Pour the clam broth back into the pot. Add more water if needed to adjust the serving size. Add a bit of soup powder and bring to a boil.
Once boiling, add the winter melon and continue to cook. After about 5 minutes, turn off the heat. Add MSG, seasoning powder, and a bit of pepper. Finally, add the green onions and stir well.
Enjoy your meal!
Notes for cooking Clam and Winter Melon Soup
Select fresh clams and firm winter melon with smooth skin.
Properly soak and rinse the clams to remove all grit.
Peel, de-seed, and cut the winter melon into batons.
Boil the clams just until they open (about 2 minutes). Use the broth for the soup base but discard the sediment.
Adjust seasonings like soup powder, fish sauce, and pepper to taste without overpowering the natural sweetness of the ingredients.
Cook the winter melon for about 5 minutes so it is tender but still retains a slight crunch. Overcooking will make it mushy and lose nutrients.

mon_an.mo_ta: With just a few simple steps, you can make a savory minced beef dish that pairs perfectly with rice!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Marinade: 2 chopped green onions; 1 small piece of minced ginger; ½ tsp salt; 1 tbsp sesame oil
Other ingredients: 6-8 slices of green chili; 2 red chilies; ½ red onion; 2 cloves minced garlic; ½ tsp salt; 1 tbsp soy sauce; ½ tbsp black vinegar
cac_buoc: Step 1: Mix the minced beef with the marinade ingredients in a bowl and let it sit for 15 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Step 2: While waiting for the beef, prepare the other ingredients: slice the green and red chilies, chop the red onion, and mince the garlic.
Step 3: Heat about 2 tablespoons of oil in a pan. Add the minced beef and stir-fry until it is just browned. Stir constantly to prevent the meat from clumping. Remove the beef to a bowl.

In the same pan, add the garlic and onion and sauté until fragrant. Add the red and green chilies and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes. Return the beef to the pan. Add the soy sauce, salt, and black vinegar, and stir-fry for another 1-2 minutes.
The stir-fried minced beef is now ready! Serve it on a plate and enjoy with hot steamed rice!

mon_an.ten: Green Papaya Salad with Dried Beef
mon_an.mo_ta: When it comes to green papaya salad with dried beef, one immediately thinks of the bold, spicy flavor of the beef combined with the crunchy texture of the papaya, creating an irresistible dish. This salad is refreshing and never feels heavy or greasy like fried or stir-fried dishes. To achieve the authentic flavor of this salad, follow the recipe below. It is not difficult at all.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Roughly chopped rice paddy herb - As needed
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Place a pan of oil on the stove. Once the oil is very hot, add the dried squid and flash-fry for about 3-5 seconds, then remove immediately to prevent burning.
The squid may not be crispy at first, but it will become very crunchy once it cools (if not using squid, you can skip this step).
Step 2:
Place the papaya, carrot, and shrimp into a large bowl and mix well.
Add 1/2 cup of fish sauce and toss together.
Finally, add the pepper, chili, minced garlic, crispy fried squid, dried beef, and herbs, then toss lightly.
Adjust the seasoning to taste and you are finished.
Transfer the salad to a plate and garnish with extra herbs for presentation.
This special dried beef papaya salad is simple to make but incredibly delicious and easy to eat.

mon_an.mo_ta: Today we will guide you through making an exceptionally crispy and delicious water spinach salad. We hope this article helps you create a wonderful dish to treat your family. Let's explore the method together! Discover how to make authentic Northern-style water spinach salad with detailed instructions. Enjoy a fresh, light, and attractive salad.
cac_buoc: 1. Instructions for traditional water spinach salad
Step 1: Pick the water spinach, removing leaves and tough stems, keeping only the tender stalks. Shred the stalks into thin strips and soak them in cold water until they curl up.
Step 2: Julienne the pork roll, crush the peanuts, remove chili seeds and julienne. Peel the garlic and slice; fry half until golden and mince the other half. Pick and finely chop the herbs.
Step 3: Dressing: Whisk together sugar, fish sauce, filtered water, vinegar, chili, and minced garlic until the sweet and sour flavors are balanced.

Step 4: Drain the water spinach thoroughly. Place in a bowl or deep plate with herbs, onion, and horn chili. Pour the dressing over, arrange the pork roll on top, and sprinkle with fried garlic and roasted peanuts. Toss well just before eating.
Small tip: Only toss the salad right before serving; mixing too early will cause the water spinach to release water and lose its crispness.
2. Water spinach salad with baby river shrimp
Ingredients
300g water spinach
200g baby river shrimp
50g peanuts
1 horn chili
1 lime
1 garlic bulb
2 tbsp fish sauce
1 tbsp sugar
1 tsp pepper
Preparation
Prepare the water spinach, peanuts, garlic, and chili, and mix the fish sauce according to the simple instructions for water spinach salad.
Cut the fragrant water spinach stalks, keeping the fresh and intact leaves. Wash, drain, and chop finely.
Roasting shrimp and making the dressing
Roast the shrimp and prepare the dressing as follows: First, mix 2 tbsp of fish sauce

into the spice mixture and marinate for 5-10 minutes to let the flavors penetrate. Place a pan on the stove with 1 tbsp of cooking oil and roast the shrimp, stirring constantly until they turn light pink and are cooked through. Turn off the heat.

Next, prepare the dressing by mixing sugar with lime juice until dissolved. Gradually add fish sauce to the mixture and stir well. Then, add a little MSG and stir. Finally, add the minced garlic and chili and mix well.

Place the squeezed-dry water spinach into a large basin, then add the roasted shrimp and half of the herbs. Gradually pour in the dressing and toss until seasoned to taste. Once the flavor is perfect, transfer to a plate and sprinkle the remaining herbs and crushed roasted peanuts on top. Finally, serve and enjoy.
3. Water spinach salad with beef
Ingredients
100g beef
Ingredients including water spinach, peanuts, chili, garlic, lime, and the fish sauce mixture are prepared similarly to the previous water spinach salad recipe.

When using beef for the salad, prepare the meat as follows: Grill a piece of ginger, scrape off the charred skin, and crush it. Rub it thoroughly over the beef. The ginger scent will effectively remove the gamey smell of the beef.

Next, slice the beef into very thin pieces to ensure they don't crumble and aren't chewy. If you see parallel lines running along the meat, use a knife to cut perpendicular to those lines; this is how to slice against the grain.
Boiling the meat

Prepare a pot of boiling water, add the sliced beef, and boil until cooked. Once cooked, remove and drain. Depending on your family's preference, you can cook the beef thoroughly or just blanch it quickly.

To finish the dish, place the water spinach and beef into a large basin and drizzle the fish sauce mixture over them. Toss until combined. When serving, don't forget to sprinkle roasted peanuts on top to add richness to the dish.
Enjoy your meal!
How to buy fresh water spinach
Choose stalks that are dark green, about the size of a chopstick, with small, slightly firm tips. When buying, try snapping a stalk; if it is crunchy, it is good quality.
Water spinach is best during its peak season from April to June. During this time, it grows in favorable conditions and farmers usually don't use too many chemicals.
Avoid buying stalks that are unusually large or unnaturally bright green, as they may be grown out of season or using growth stimulants.

mon_an.mo_ta: Daily, most of us eat dishes containing a lot of oil, which can make meals feel heavy and boring. Today, we will guide you on how to make kohlrabi and carrot salad to help balance out meat and fish-heavy meals. Kohlrabi and carrot salad, a refreshing and nutritious dish, has become a popular choice in many family menus. With a harmonious combination of fresh kohlrabi and vibrant carrots, this salad offers a blend of sweet, sour, and crunchy flavors. Not only is it delicious, but it is also a great source of fiber, vitamins, and minerals. Let's explore the recipe and simple method for making kohlrabi and carrot salad to enjoy a fresh and nutritious meal.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Sugar, MSG, salt, vinegar - as needed
Garlic, chili, dried shallots - as needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Preparation
After buying the kohlrabi, first peel off the tough outer layer with a knife, then wash it with water.
Next, use a knife to slice the kohlrabi into thin slices, then julienne into small strips. If you have a peeler or mandoline, use it to save time.

Kohlrabi contains a lot of water, so to make the salad crunchy, you need to remove the internal moisture. A simple tip is to add two teaspoons of salt to the shredded kohlrabi, mix well, and soak for about 1 hour. The salt will help draw out the water. Peel the garlic and chili, wash, crush, and mince. Wash the fresh chili, slice lengthwise, and cut into thin rings.

Pick through the cilantro and basil to remove wilted leaves and wash thoroughly. Then, soak the herbs in salt water for 10-15 minutes to disinfect. After soaking, remove and drain. Finely chop half of the herbs and keep the rest whole.

For the peanuts, heat a large pan on the stove, add a little salt, and stir. About 1 minute later, add the peanuts to the pan to roast. Roasting peanuts with salt helps them cook faster and more evenly. Afterward, rub off the skins and crush lightly. A tip for delicious roasted peanuts: while they are still hot, wrap them tightly in a newspaper; once cooled, just rub lightly and the skins will fall off.

Peel the carrots, wash, and shred into small strips. Next, mix 1/2 tbsp sugar and 1/2 tbsp salt into the carrots, then let them sit for about 15 minutes to draw out water and become crunchier. Squeeze out the excess water and soak with 5 tbsp of vinegar; soaking longer is better to develop the sourness.
Step 2: Making the dressing
Prepare a small bowl and add 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp lime juice, 1/2 tsp vinegar, along with the minced chili and garlic. Mix these ingredients well.
Next, add 2 tbsp fish sauce and 3 tbsp filtered water to the bowl. Use chopsticks to stir the mixture until the sugar is dissolved. You can taste and adjust the dressing to suit your palate.
Step 3: Mixing the salad

After preparing the dressing, drizzle it evenly over the squeezed-dry kohlrabi and carrots. Toss well so the vegetables absorb the seasoning. Next, add 1/2 of the roasted peanuts, 1/2 of the chopped cilantro, and 1/2 of the chopped basil, then continue to toss well. Let the salad sit for about 10 minutes to allow the flavors to penetrate.
Then, transfer the salad to a plate and garnish the surface with the remaining roasted peanuts, cilantro, and whole basil leaves. Now you can enjoy the dish.
Quick and delicious, isn't it? Try making this authentic kohlrabi and carrot salad today! Enjoy your meal!

mon_an.mo_ta: Kimchi Fried Rice Rolls – A delicious and easy-to-make dish for girls to show off their culinary skills, whether they are experts or beginners. Learn how to make Kimchi Fried Rice Rolls.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Clean the ingredients and chop them finely. Heat oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the minced beef and stir-fry until golden brown (about 2 minutes). Add 15ml of cooking oil, then add the vegetables. Stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Step 2: Add the rice and soy sauce, then fry the rice until it reaches your desired firmness and texture. Finally, add the roasted sesame seeds.
Step 3: Remove the rice to a bowl, let it cool, then shape into small bite-sized balls.
Step 4: Spread out a kimchi leaf, place a fried rice ball on top, and roll it up. Repeat until all the kimchi and rice are used! Make small rolls for easy eating!
Source: Megafun

mon_an.mo_ta: Durian jelly mooncakes attract diners with their beautiful yellow and white appearance. When eaten, the jelly is cool and refreshing, carrying a rich durian flavor. This jelly dish will help you wash away fatigue after a long day of work!
cac_buoc: How to make durian jelly mooncakes
Step 1: After buying the durian, remove the seeds and set the flesh aside. Then, place the durian and coconut milk in a blender, blend until smooth, and strain through a sieve for a fine texture.
Step 2: Next, add water, sugar, and jelly powder to a pot, dissolve them, and place on the stove to cook over low heat.
Step 3: While cooking, stir until the jelly is dissolved, then add the durian and coconut milk mixture and stir until well combined.
Cook for another 1-2 minutes then turn off the heat.
Step 4: Next, pour a thin layer of the durian jelly into the mold. Place the jelly pot back on the stove to keep it warm.

Step 5: While waiting for the durian jelly to set, quickly cook the clear jelly. Put all the clear jelly ingredients into a pot, stir to dissolve, and cook over low heat. Stir occasionally until the jelly is clear and dissolved, then turn off the heat. Then, pour a layer of the clear jelly mixture onto the newly set durian jelly layer.
Step 6: Continue to monitor the layers; when a layer has just set but is still warm, gently pour the next layer.
After filling the mold, place it in the refrigerator for a few hours to chill and set completely before serving.
How to choose a delicious durian
Observe the shape of the durian:

Many people suggest choosing durians that are perfectly round and beautiful, but according to orchard experience, those that are slightly misshapen or ugly are often less likely to be damaged and taste better than the pretty ones. Choose fruits with evenly divided segments (the grooves are long and almost equal in size), avoid lopsided fruits, and look for those with a "waistline" that is evenly thick. Choose fruits that have slightly cracked open and have a strong aroma.
Tapping

Durian sellers usually have a specialized tool to test the durian. If possible, borrow it and tap the fruit a few times; if it makes a "thump thump" sound, it is guaranteed to be good. If it makes a "clink clink" or high-pitched metallic sound, put it down and do not buy it.
Observe the stem and thorns:

The longer a durian is kept, the more the stem shrivels; therefore, choose fruits with stems that are not too withered. Choose fruits with firm green stems, a long-lasting sweet aroma, and characteristic color. Thorns should be large and even, not too sharp, and firm. Squeeze two adjacent thorns together; if the fruit is mature, the thorns will be hard. If the fruit is young, the thorns will be soft.
Watch how the seller opens the fruit:

If possible, ask the seller to help open the durian. For mature and ripe durians, the 5 segments will naturally separate, and the seller can open them very gently and easily. If the seller has a very difficult time opening it, the durian is still green or young.

With just simple, easy-to-find ingredients and a straightforward method, you have a delicious, cool jelly dish to treat your family, friends, and loved ones. Everyone will be absolutely delighted with your refreshing jelly!

mon_an.mo_ta: Crispy Fried Pork Noodles – An easy-to-make dish that upgrades your daily instant noodles. Learn how to make delicious Crispy Fried Pork Noodles.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the pork, slice into 8mm thick pieces, and tenderize with a meat mallet. Marinate the pork with salt and pepper for about 10 minutes.
Step 2: Dip the pork into the beaten egg, then dredge in flour. Heat oil in a pan, fry the pork over medium heat until golden brown, then drain.

Step 3: Add 2 tbsp sugar and 2 tbsp water to a pan. Cook until the sugar dissolves and turns golden brown, then add a little cooking oil and sesame oil. Add chopped green onions and sauté for the crispy fried pork noodles. Once fragrant, add half a small bowl of water and 6 tbsp soy sauce.

Step 4: Simmer the mixture for about 2 minutes, then add the pork. Turn the heat to high and cook for another 2 minutes before removing the pork. Soak the shiitake mushrooms until soft, then simmer them in water to make the noodle broth. Wash the leafy greens and blanch them until cooked but still bright green. Serve and enjoy this easy and delicious dish.
Source: Kenh14

mon_an.ten: Super Easy and Delicious Stir-fried Glass Noodles with Minced Pork
mon_an.mo_ta: This stir-fried glass noodle dish with minced pork is simple from ingredients to preparation but tastes amazing. Let's learn how to make it for the whole family!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: A handful of leafy greens (your choice)
Seasoning: oyster sauce, seasoning powder, sugar, pepper.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Julienne the horn chili. Cut the leafy greens into bite-sized pieces, julienne the carrot, and slice the shallot. Mince the garlic.
Step 2: Soak the glass noodles in cold water for 5-7 minutes, then drain in a colander.
Step 3: Crack the eggs into a bowl and beat well. Heat a pan with a little oil; once hot, scramble the eggs and set aside in a bowl.
Step 4: Blanch the greens and carrots in boiling water for a few minutes, then drain.
Step 5: Heat 1 tbsp of oil in a pan. Once hot, sauté the shallot and garlic until fragrant, then add the minced pork and stir-fry until firm with a bit of oyster sauce and sugar.
Step 6: Once the pork is cooked, add the glass noodles and stir-fry for a few minutes.
Step 7: Add the greens and carrots, tossing everything together. Adjust the seasoning to taste. Finally, add the scrambled eggs, mix well, and turn off the heat.
Transfer the stir-fried glass noodles with minced pork to a plate, garnish with cilantro and julienned chili to finish.
Enjoy your success and a delicious meal with this simple yet tasty stir-fried glass noodles with minced pork recipe!

mon_an.mo_ta: Shrimp is rich in protein, potassium, phosphorus, magnesium, iodine, and vitamin A. Its soft, easily digestible meat makes it a nutritious food suitable for the elderly and those with physical weakness. Shrimp is also known for its strong lactation-promoting effects and contains high levels of phosphorus and calcium, which are excellent for pregnant women and young children. Regularly eating shrimp shells can help the elderly prevent osteoporosis. Traditional medicine considers shrimp to be warm in nature and sweet in flavor, providing benefits for kidney health, vitality, lactation, and detoxification. There are countless shrimp dishes, and today, we will guide you through making simple yet delicious crispy fried shrimp!
cac_buoc: Wash the shrimp, peel the shells, and devein them, leaving the tails intact. Use a knife to gently butterfly the back so the shrimp absorbs the seasoning easily.
Place the shrimp in a bowl, add cooking wine, salt, and pepper, then marinate for 10 minutes.
Beat the eggs in a bowl and dip the shrimp in.
Next, roll the shrimp in the panko breadcrumbs.
Prepare a pan with hot oil, fry the shrimp until golden brown, then remove and place on paper towels to drain the excess oil.
Now, show off your decorating skills to make the dish look more appealing.
How to choose fresh shrimp
When buying shrimp, choose fresh ones with transparent shells and a light scent of the sea; avoid shrimp with dark patches or inconsistent coloring.
To check the condition of the shrimp, press lightly and move your finger over the shell. If it feels gritty or if the shrimp shows signs of sliminess, avoid buying it.
Fresh shrimp usually have their tails folded together. If the tail is fanned out, it is a sign that the shrimp may have been injected with chemicals or water to make them look plump.

Check the legs of the shrimp; fresh shrimp usually have legs firmly attached to the body. If you see the legs have turned black, avoid buying them. Additionally, if the legs are no longer tightly attached to the body, it is a sign the shrimp is no longer fresh.
Choosing fresh shrimp by following these guidelines will ensure you have delicious and safe shrimp for your meal.

mon_an.mo_ta: Sweet and Sour Shrimp Pasta – unique and nutritious for a relaxing day. Learn how to cook delicious Sweet and Sour Shrimp Pasta.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Peeled and deveined black tiger shrimp - 200g
cac_buoc: Step 1: To start this delicious recipe, place a pan on the stove and add oil and butter, heating until melted. After the shrimp are peeled, deveined, washed, and drained, add them to the pan and stir-fry with minced garlic, seasoning, bouillon powder, sugar, and salt. Stir well until the shrimp firm up and absorb the seasonings.

Step 2: Place a pot of water on the stove to boil the pasta, adding a little salt and oil so the noodles stay glossy and beautiful. Boil until cooked, then remove and rinse with cold water and a bit of oil, then drain.

Step 3: After sautéing the shrimp in step 1, remove the shrimp to a bowl, keeping the butter and oil in the pan to make the sauce for the sweet and sour shrimp pasta. Add the chopped tomatoes and black pepper to the pan and simmer until the mixture thickens.

Step 4: Add the pasta to the pan with the tomato sauce and stir-fry, then add the shrimp back in and mix well. Sprinkle with a little parsley to enhance the aroma. Serve on a plate and enjoy while hot; you can add extra tomato sauce if desired.
Source: Budgetbytes

mon_an.mo_ta: Mushrooms are a nutritious food for us, containing high levels of protein and all the essential amino acids that the body cannot synthesize on its own—even more than beef and soybeans. Additionally, mushrooms contain fats, fiber, and more. Thanks to this abundant nutrition, they are prepared into medicinal dishes that support the treatment of conditions such as atherosclerosis, obesity, and diabetes. There are many dishes made from mushrooms, ranging from elaborate to simple. Today, we will introduce you to a simple and easy-to-make stir-fried bok choy with mushrooms. This dish is simple, not greasy, yet retains high nutritional value. Here is the guide for simple stir-fried bok choy with mushrooms—a delicious dish combining the sweetness of mushrooms with the crunchiness of bok choy.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Cooking oil, fish sauce, seasoning powder - As needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Soak the shiitake mushrooms in hot water, wash thoroughly, and slice into long strips. Wash the straw mushrooms and cut them in half.
Step 2: Remove old leaves from the bok choy and wash thoroughly.

Step 3: For this easy-to-make delicious dish, sauté the garlic in oil, then add the straw mushrooms and shiitake mushrooms and stir-fry for 1 minute. Next, add the bok choy, stir-fry over high heat, season with fish sauce and seasoning powder, and toss until the bok choy is cooked.
Step 4: Arrange the stir-fried mushrooms and bok choy on a plate and serve hot with white rice.
How to buy fresh ingredients
1. How to choose mushrooms

To choose fresh, delicious, and nutritious mushrooms, you need to note a few important points. Choose mushrooms with bright colors that are not peeling and have a characteristic mushroom aroma. Avoid buying mushrooms with darkened or wrinkled caps; instead, choose those with a thin layer of fuzz covering the cap.
Carefully check the stems of the mushrooms before buying. The stems should be firm and uniform in color. The body of the mushroom should be hard and not mushy or damaged.

There are several popular types of mushrooms you can use for many delicious dishes, such as straw mushrooms, shiitake mushrooms, enoki mushrooms, wood ear mushrooms, king oyster mushrooms, etc. Refer to these and choose the type of mushroom that suits the dish you want to cook.
2. How to buy bok choy
Observe the leaves: Choose bok choy with bright green, smooth, and glossy leaves. Avoid plants with darkened, rotten, falling, wilted, or yellowed leaves.
Check the stems: Bok choy may come with or without roots, but the stems must be greenish-white or light green. Avoid plants with rotten or yellowish-black stems.

Check weight and size: Good, fresh bok choy usually feels heavy when held. The weight should be proportionate to the size; do not choose large plants that feel light, as these are often old and have been stored for a long time.
Notes when making stir-fried bok choy with mushrooms
Choose fresh ingredients: Select bright green bok choy and fresh mushrooms with no signs of spoilage.
Prepare the ingredients: Wash the bok choy and cut into small pieces. Mushrooms also need to be washed and sliced.
Stir-fry quickly on high heat: Use high heat to stir-fry the mushrooms and bok choy. Stir-fry quickly for a short time to keep the ingredients crunchy and preserve the flavor.
Add seasonings: You can add seasonings such as minced garlic, green onions, salt, pepper, soy sauce, or fish sauce to enhance the flavor of the dish.
Cook evenly: When stir-frying, pay attention to ensure the bok choy and mushrooms are cooked evenly while still maintaining the crunchiness of the greens.

mon_an.mo_ta: This soy sauce braised chicken recipe is incredibly flavorful and perfect with rice—discover the secret to making it better than ever right here!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: A few cloves of minced garlic
Soy sauce, dark soy sauce, a pinch of sugar, seasoning powder, salt, rice wine, white pepper
cac_buoc: Here are the ingredients you need to prepare for this flavorful braised chicken!
Step 1: Wash the chicken thighs, pat dry, and place in a bowl with a bit of salt, white pepper, and seasoning powder. Marinate for about 15 minutes.
Step 2: Peel and mince the garlic, wash and julienne the ginger, thinly slice the chili, and cut the green onions into segments; set aside on a plate.

Step 3: Place a pan on the stove. Once hot, add 1 tablespoon of cooking oil. Place the chicken thighs in the pan to fry. Fry the skin side first until golden brown before flipping. Continue frying the other side until golden, then remove to a cutting board.
Step 4: Slice the chicken thighs into bite-sized pieces.

Step 5: Reheat the same pan. If there is no oil left, add 1 more tablespoon. Add the garlic and ginger, sauté until fragrant, then add soy sauce, dark soy sauce, sugar, seasoning powder, and rice wine. Bring to a boil.

Step 6: Add the chicken and chili to the pan, tossing well to coat the meat in the sauce. Simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens, then stir in the green onions. Adjust seasoning to taste and turn off the heat.
Serve the soy sauce braised chicken on a plate and enjoy with hot rice.
Good luck with this delicious and savory soy sauce braised chicken recipe!

mon_an.mo_ta: Cucumber and bean sprout salad is a familiar family favorite because of its refreshing taste. The crunchy cucumbers and bean sprouts are infused with a fragrant, sweet and sour dressing. This dish brings a cool, appetizing sensation to your summer meals! This simple and fresh salad is the perfect light accompaniment. Enjoy it on hot summer days to feel refreshed and nourished.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Vietnamese balm (kinh giới), cilantro, fresh chili
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients

To make a delicious and crunchy cucumber salad, start by washing the cucumbers and soaking them in diluted salt water for about 15 minutes. Then, rinse them again with clean water. Drain well, trim the ends, halve them lengthwise, and slice thinly on a diagonal.

After slicing, place the cucumbers in a bowl with a little salt and massage gently so they soften and absorb the salt. Let sit for 15 minutes, then squeeze out the excess water so the salad stays dry.
Next, wash the garlic, chili, cilantro, and basil; drain and mince. Squeeze the lime for juice and remove the seeds. Peel and shred the carrot. Peel the roasted peanuts and crush them.
Note: If the cucumbers have many seeds, you should scoop some out to make the salad crunchier.
Step 2: Mixing the cucumber and bean sprouts

To assemble the salad, place the carrots and cucumbers in a large bowl. Add sugar, lime juice, fish sauce, minced garlic, minced chili, and herbs. Wear gloves and mix well, tasting as you go to adjust the flavor. Let it sit for 10 minutes to fully absorb the dressing.
Finally, transfer the salad to a plate or bowl and sprinkle the crushed peanuts on top. You can now enjoy the crunchy cucumber salad with its stimulating sweet and sour flavor.
Notes for a perfect cucumber and bean sprout salad:
Once the salad is mixed, do not let it sit for too long as it will become soggy and watery, losing the crunch of the cucumber and sprouts.
Additionally, you can add a little extra fresh lime juice for aroma.
When buying bean sprouts, avoid old or wilted ones, as they will ruin the taste of the dish.
How to choose good cucumbers:
Regarding color, choose cucumbers with a bright green skin. Good cucumbers are usually even in color without dark spots or yellowing.
Regarding shape, choose straight ones with little to no curving.
Long, evenly sized cucumbers are usually denser and crunchier than short, round ones.
Choose cucumbers that feel heavy for their size, are firm but slightly yielding, and have smooth skin without bumps.
Small cucumbers often taste sweeter than large ones.
Avoid cucumbers that bulge in the middle or have uneven ends, as these are old, seedy, and watery.
Yellow spots on the skin indicate the cucumber has been kept too long and may be spoiled or bitter.
Sometimes you may see a thin white powder on the cucumber; this helps retain moisture. If you buy these, wash them thoroughly with water mixed with lime, vinegar, or warm water.

If the skin is thin and clean, you can slice and use it immediately after washing. However, taste a piece first; if it is bitter, you must peel it. Smaller cucumbers are less likely to be bitter than large ones.
Tips for crunchy cucumber and bean sprout salad
Slice the cucumbers thinly and cut the bean sprouts into short segments. To make them crunchier, soak them in diluted salt water for 15-20 minutes, then rinse and drain.
To make the salad more appealing, add herbs like cilantro, basil, or shredded cabbage. Wash and chop the herbs finely.
Mix the cucumbers, bean sprouts, and herbs in a large bowl. Add sugar, fish sauce, lime juice, minced garlic, and minced chili, then toss well.
To let the flavors develop, keep the salad in the refrigerator for 15-30 minutes before serving. This helps the vegetables absorb the dressing and become crunchier.
Before serving, sprinkle with some green onions and crushed roasted peanuts to enhance the flavor and texture.

mon_an.mo_ta: Crispy Breaded Fish Fillets – A delicious and easy-to-make dish. These deboned, breaded fillets are much easier to eat for those who don't like picking through fish bones. Today's article will guide you through making crispy fried fish fillets. Please take a look!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the fish fillets and carefully remove any remaining bones. Use a clean towel to pat them dry, then season the fish with a little salt and pepper.
Step 2: Crack the egg into a small bowl. Whisk it together with 3 tablespoons of flour and 3 tablespoons of cold water. Dip each piece of fish into this egg and flour mixture.
Step 3: Roll the fish in the breadcrumbs, pressing gently so the crumbs adhere. Repeat until all fillets are coated.

Step 4: Place a pan of oil over medium heat. Once the oil is hot, drop the fish fillets in and fry until golden brown on both sides. Once the fillets are cooked and golden, remove them to a plate lined with paper towels. Serve hot with rice and dip in chili sauce or ketchup.

mon_an.mo_ta: Instead of cooking each type separately, why don't we try stir-frying them all together! We guarantee you'll have a wonderful mixed vegetable dish!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fish sauce, seasoning powder, cooking oil - as needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel, wash, and cut the pumpkin into bite-sized pieces.
Step 2: Wash all vegetables. Cut the yardlong beans into 5cm segments. Cut the bok choy into bite-sized pieces. Slice the eggplant into 8 wedges.
Step 3: Boil the pumpkin until nearly cooked. Blanch the other vegetables briefly in boiling water.

Step 4: Thinly slice the shallots and sauté in oil until fragrant. Add the vegetables and stir-fry for about 3 minutes, then add the pumpkin and season to taste. Turn off the heat, arrange the mixed vegetables on a plate, top with ketchup, and serve hot.

mon_an.mo_ta: Today I found tomatoes at a great price, so I bought quite a lot! I decided to make a salad, even though some might think it's odd to eat salad in winter. I think it's perfectly fine! In cold weather, we often forget to drink water, which makes our skin dull. Eating salad is great for supplementing vitamins, fiber, and hydration to keep your skin glowing and prevent dryness. Let's get started! How about you? Want to make this simple, skin-healthy Tomato and Sweet Corn Salad?
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Mayonnaise, vinegar or lemon juice - as needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Remove the corn kernels, wash them, and boil until cooked. Drain and let cool.
Step 2: Wash and slice the tomatoes. Wash and finely chop the cilantro and basil. Wash and dice the bell pepper.
Step 3: Put all the vegetables into a bowl or deep plate. Add olive oil, mayonnaise, a pinch of fine salt, and vinegar or lemon juice. Mix well and adjust to your taste.
Step 4: Garnish and enjoy your Tomato and Sweet Corn Salad for beautiful skin! ^^

mon_an.ten: Sweet and Sour Tomato Pork Ribs
mon_an.mo_ta: Just thinking about this dish makes me crave it. The sight of sitting down to enjoy every single rib with its attractive aroma is so tempting. My family has this at least once a week. Today, let's go into the kitchen and learn how to cook tomato-glazed ribs. Discover how to cook this dish to treat your whole family. Here is a detailed guide and important notes for the process. An attractive choice for family meals that brings culinary joy every day.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Lard or cooking oil - as needed
Seasoning - as needed (fish sauce, salt, pepper, sugar, vinegar)
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients:

People often chop ribs into double segments, but I find that inconvenient for eating. It is best to chop them into single ribs so they are easier to eat and absorb the marinade better. Wash the ribs thoroughly, blanch them in boiling water, then rinse with cold water. Marinate the ribs with a bit of pepper, salt, sugar, fish sauce, and oil; let sit for 20 minutes.
Wash the tomatoes and slice them thinly.
Wash and finely chop the green onions and cilantro.
Cooking the ribs:
Heat a pan with oil or lard, sauté the shallots until fragrant, then scoop the fried shallots into a small bowl.
Add the marinated ribs to the pan and fry until they are slightly golden brown, then remove to a bowl.

Add the sliced tomatoes to the pan and stir until soft, then return the ribs to the pan. Add 1 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp vinegar, and 1 tbsp sugar. Stir well, simmer until the ribs are coated, then lower the heat and cook until the tomatoes and ribs are well combined.
Add the green onions and cilantro, toss well, and turn off the heat. Transfer the ribs to a plate, sprinkle the fried shallots on top, and garnish with a few sprigs of cilantro.
Notes when preparing the ribs:

To ensure the ribs are tender and not tough or dry, pay attention to the cleaning step. I usually wash them, then blanch them in boiling water to remove impurities while retaining the sweetness, then rinse again before marinating.
Do not fry them immediately; marinate them first so the flavors penetrate the meat.
Add sugar to the sauce to balance the acidity of the tomatoes and other seasonings.
Tips for a better tomato sauce:
When cooking the sauce, keep these important points in mind to ensure a delicious result:
1. Choose ripe tomatoes: Use fresh, ripe tomatoes for the best color and flavor. Choose bright red ones without damage.
2. Blend or chop: Depending on preference, you can blend the tomatoes for a smooth sauce or chop them for a chunkier texture.
3. Use fresh aromatics: Fresh shallots and garlic provide the best flavor. Ensure they are finely minced before use.
4. Cook on low heat: When simmering the sauce, turn the heat down to allow the flavors to meld and the sauce to penetrate the meat evenly. High heat can burn the sauce and alter the flavor.
5. Balance the flavors: Add salt, sugar, pepper, and other spices to taste. Adjust the sugar and acid (vinegar) to create a perfect sweet and sour balance.
6. Cooking time: The sauce needs time to develop its flavor. Simmer until the tomatoes are fully broken down and the sauce reaches your desired thickness.
This is the final result. Golden, fragrant, with a perfect balance of sweet and sour, and the wonderful aroma of shallots and pepper.

mon_an.mo_ta: Homemade Mayonnaise – A daily favorite. Learn how to make this familiar sauce to serve with your mixed vegetables.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Pour the oil and egg yolks into a tall cup or a bowl. Submerge an immersion blender or hand mixer until it touches the bottom.
Step 2: Turn on the blender and hold it still until you see the mayonnaise start to emulsify. The mixture will quickly become thick and smooth.

Step 3: Add the garlic, salt, and pepper to the mixture, then slowly lift the blender toward the top of the cup without turning it off. Once the garlic and seasoning are fully incorporated, turn off the machine.

Making mayonnaise with a blender or mixer is more stable and successful than whisking by hand, which takes a long time and can easily fail. Making it at home with available ingredients shows off your skills and is better for your family as it contains no preservatives.
Source: Ngoisao

mon_an.mo_ta: Braised Pork Belly with Sugarcane – A unique and delicious daily dish. Here is how to make it.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Marinade: 15g sugar, 15ml rice wine, soy sauce
Braising sauce: 45ml oyster sauce, 30g granulated sugar, 30-45ml rice wine
cac_buoc: Step 1: Clean the pork skin thoroughly. Blanch the meat in boiling water to remove impurities, then boil it in water with a pinch of salt for 25-30 minutes until cooked.

Step 2: Mix the sugar, rice wine, and soy sauce together. Marinate the boiled pork belly in this mixture for 3 minutes on each side. Use a fork to prick many small holes in the skin to help it crisp up. Place the sugarcane on a baking tray, sprinkle with a layer of sugar, and roast in the oven at 180°C for about 7-8 minutes. This makes the sugarcane fragrant and sweeter. If you don't have an oven, you can grill it over gas or charcoal, but keep the peel on while grilling and remove it afterward.
Step 3: In a pan of hot oil, deep-fry the marinated pork belly until it turns golden brown, then remove and drain on paper towels.

Step 4: Sauté the green onions, ginger, garlic, chili, and roasted sugarcane in a pot. Mix the braising sauce ingredients together and pour them into the pot. Add the pork belly, toss to coat in the sauce, then add water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to a simmer and cook for about 1 hour.

Step 5: Occasionally flip the meat during the cooking process so the sauce absorbs evenly. Once the meat is tender and the sauce has thickened, turn off the heat, remove the meat to a clean cutting board, and slice into bite-sized pieces.
Source: Kenh14

mon_an.mo_ta: Ginger braised beef is a familiar dish for many families. The beef is tender, flavorful, and aromatic, simmered in a thick sauce. Served with hot rice, it provides a wonderful culinary experience. Let's get into the kitchen to learn how to make this delicious dish!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fish sauce, pepper, seasoning powder, salt, sugar, cooking oil, caramel sauce - as needed
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients for the ginger braised beef:
First, wash the beef and let it drain.

Next, grill 1 ginger root until fragrant, scrape off the charred skin, and crush it. Rub this ginger onto the beef. Rub it thoroughly so the beef absorbs the ginger aroma and removes any odors. Then, rinse the beef with cold water.
Next, cut the beef into 2x2cm cubes.
Marinate the beef with 1 teaspoon of salt, 1 tablespoon of sugar, 1 teaspoon of pepper, and 1 teaspoon of caramel sauce for about 1 hour to let the flavors penetrate.
Peel the remaining ginger root and slice it into thin julienne strips.
Peel the shallot, wash, and mince.
Steps to make the delicious ginger braised beef:
Step 1:

Place a pot on the stove, add 2 tablespoons of oil, and heat. Once the oil is hot, sauté the shallots until fragrant, then add the ginger and stir-fry for about 3 minutes until the ginger is soft and aromatic.
Step 2:
Add the beef to the pot and stir-fry with the ginger, tossing quickly to sear the meat.
Step 3:
When the beef is seared, add enough cold water to cover the meat. Bring to a boil, then season with 1 teaspoon of seasoning powder and 1 tablespoon of fish sauce.
Step 4:

Finally, cover the pot and continue to simmer over low heat until the ginger is tender and the beef is soft (similar to making beef stew). Once cooked, transfer the beef to a plate, sprinkle with a little pepper, and enjoy with hot rice.
Notes for a perfect ginger braised beef:

Tips for buying beef: Fresh beef is not dark red; the fat should be yellow and firm. Choose meat with small, soft fibers rather than large, tough ones. Finally, press the meat; it should not be sticky and should have no foul odor.

Female beef is often tastier than male beef. If you can find young beef (tơ), it is even better as the meat is soft, the fat is white, and the fibers are fine. Look for bright red color, white veins, and bright yellow fat.
Avoid beef that is pale green or has white spots between the fibers (signs of parasites). Do not buy meat that smells bad, is dark in color, has dark yellow fat, or feels mushy and slimy.
To save time, you can stew the beef in a pressure cooker for 30 minutes.
Remember to marinate the beef for at least 30 to 60 minutes so the meat is flavorful, tender, and aromatic when eaten.

mon_an.mo_ta: Savory Beef with Vegetables – An easy-to-make dish where the beef is tender and flavorful, stir-fried with various vegetables and delicious seasonings. Here is the guide for this savory dish.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, seasoning powder, oil, oyster sauce, soy sauce, green and black peppercorns, shallots, garlic, sugar
Green onions, cut into short segments
1 tsp tapioca starch mixed with water
cac_buoc: Step 1: Coarsely crush the green and black peppercorns. Wash the beef, slice into bite-sized pieces, and tenderize. In a bowl, marinate the beef with the crushed peppercorns, starch, 1 tablespoon of soy sauce, 1 teaspoon of oyster sauce, and 1 teaspoon of sugar. Mix well and marinate for 1 to 2 hours.

Step 2: Peel the carrot, wash, and slice diagonally. Wash the onion and cut into wedges. Wash the green onions and cut into short segments. Wash the Napa cabbage, remove the tough outer leaves, and slice diagonally.

Step 3: Heat oil and sauté the garlic and shallots. Add the beef and stir-fry over high heat so the meat doesn't release too much water. Once cooked, remove to a bowl. Using the same pan, add the carrots and stir-fry until nearly tender, adding a little soy sauce and cold water to help them soften. Once the carrots are soft, add the Napa cabbage and onion, seasoning with a little salt.

Step 4: Return the beef to the pan. Cook over high heat until it boils again, then add oyster sauce, seasoning powder, sugar, and soy sauce to taste. Pour in the starch slurry and stir until the sauce thickens. Adjust seasoning one last time, turn off the heat, add green onions, and serve on a plate with rice.
Source: Ngoisao

mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried beef with bitter melon is a familiar dish for many families, featuring tender, flavorful beef and the distinct bitter-yet-sweet taste of bitter melon, offering a unique culinary experience!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 1 tbsp cooking oil, 2 tsp regular soy sauce, 1 tsp cornstarch, 1 tsp sugar - for marinating the beef
cac_buoc: Steps to make delicious stir-fried beef with bitter melon
Step 1:

Wash the bitter melon and cut it in half. Remove the seeds and slice into pieces. To reduce the bitterness, sprinkle them with a little salt, toss well, and let sit for 10 minutes. Then rinse with water and drain.
Step 2:
Peel the carrots, wash them, and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Step 3:
Peel the garlic, wash, and mince finely.
Step 4:
Soak the fermented black beans for about 20 minutes. Then, drain and chop into small pieces.
Step 5:
Wash the beef, drain, and slice thinly. Marinate the beef with regular soy sauce, sugar, cornstarch, and cooking oil in a small bowl; mix well and let sit for 10 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Step 6:
In a pan, heat some cooking oil. Stir-fry the beef until cooked, then remove to a plate.
Step 7:
In another pan, add a bit more oil. Once hot, sauté the garlic and black beans until fragrant.
Step 8:

Add the bitter melon and carrots to the pan. Stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes until the vegetables soften, then add the chicken stock and the cooked beef. If you don't have chicken stock, use water; this helps prevent the stir-fry from burning or sticking to the pan.
Step 9:
Cook until the liquid has thickened into a light sauce, then season with salt and pepper to taste.
Step 10:
Finally, transfer the stir-fry to a plate, drizzle with a little sesame oil, and it's ready to enjoy.
Recipe for Stir-fried Beef with Onion and Pineapple
Recipe for Thịt Bò Xào Lăn
Tips for delicious stir-fried beef with bitter melon:
Other ways to reduce bitterness in bitter melon:
Cold treatment: Place the bitter melon in the freezer at -8 °C or slice it and soak in ice water for a while.
Soaking: Halve the bitter melon, remove seeds, slice thinly, and rinse with cold water. Gently squeeze the slices while rinsing, changing the water 3-4 times to make it less bitter and sweeter.
How to choose good beef:

Fresh beef should not be dark red; the fat should be yellow and firm, not soft. Choose small, tender meat fibers rather than large, tough ones. Finally, press the meat; it should not be sticky and should have no unpleasant odor.

Cow meat is usually better than bull meat. Young beef (veal) is even better as it is tender with white fat and fine fibers. To buy good beef, look for a bright red color, non-fine fibers (unless it's young beef), small white tendons, and bright yellow fat.

Beef that is pale green or has round white spots between the fibers may be infected with flukes or parasites. Avoid meat with a foul smell. Signs of bad beef include: dark color, deep yellow fat, yellow bones, poor elasticity, mushy texture, or a slimy surface.

mon_an.ten: Stir-fried Beef with Potatoes and Tomatoes
mon_an.mo_ta: Let's cook this delicious stir-fried beef with potatoes for a family dinner. This is an easy-to-make dish where tender, sweet beef combines with the earthy flavor of potatoes and a touch of rich, creamy mayonnaise to create a perfect meal. Let's get started on this attractive stir-fry.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients:
Wash the potatoes, cut into wedges like tomato slices, then marinate with 1/4 tsp salt and a little pepper.
Peel and mince the garlic.
Wash the beef, slice thinly, and marinate with half of the minced garlic, pepper, seasoning powder, and salt to taste.
Add 1 tbsp of mayonnaise and mix well. Set aside to marinate.
Wash the tomato and cut into wedges (divide into 4-6 parts depending on size).
Trim the celery roots, wash, and cut into segments.
Step 2: Cook the beef and potatoes.

While waiting for the beef to marinate, place the potatoes in a microwave-safe bowl with a little water. Microwave for 8-10 minutes on high power until cooked. If you don't have a microwave, steam the potatoes until just tender.

Heat oil in a pan and pan-sear the potatoes until they are a beautiful golden brown, then remove to a plate and set aside. Add a little more oil to the pan if needed, sauté the remaining garlic until fragrant, then add the beef and toss well. Add the tomatoes and potatoes, then season the stir-fry with 1 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tbsp fish sauce, and 1-2 tbsp mayonnaise. Mix well, add the celery segments, toss again, and turn off the heat.
Step 3: Presentation
Arrange the potatoes and tomatoes alternately around the plate, placing the beef and celery in the center for a beautiful look. Serve hot with white rice.
Tips for delicious stir-fried beef with potatoes:

Choose fresh beef, such as fillet or rump, for a tender stir-fry. Prepare the beef first so it stays fresh and absorbs the spices. When marinating, add pepper, garlic, and oil before the other seasonings to make the beef more fragrant. Marinating with 1 tbsp of oil helps the beef stay glossy, tender, and not dry after stir-frying.

You can leave the potato skins on for a unique, slightly chewy texture. Pre-cooking the potatoes ensures they are soft and saves frying time. Since beef needs to be stir-fried very quickly to avoid becoming tough, pre-cooking the potatoes prevents them from being raw. You can use a microwave for speed, or steam/parboil them if a microwave is unavailable.
Stir-fry the beef over high heat very quickly; only cook until just done so it remains tender and fragrant. Avoid overcooking, as the meat will become dry and tough.

mon_an.mo_ta: Fried pork is a dish that is both familiar and unique, attracting diners with its beautiful golden crispy crust and tender, flavorful meat. Today, we will guide you through a new style of fried pork—simple to make and an excellent choice for meals when you don't have much preparation time but still want something delicious and appealing.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Salt, pepper, seasoning powder - for seasoning
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the meat
Wash the pork loin with water and drain. Use a knife to make 6–8 shallow scores on each edge of the meat so it doesn't curl up when frying.
Next, tenderize the meat using the back of a knife. Alternatively, you can use a fork to prick the meat so the marinade absorbs better and the meat becomes more tender.
Step 2: Marinate the meat
Marinate the meat with salt and pepper for about 30 minutes so it absorbs the flavors fully. If you prefer, you can use seasoning powder or MSG instead of salt.
Step 3: Breading
Crack the eggs into a bowl and beat until the yolks and whites are combined. Place the flour and panko breadcrumbs into two separate bowls or plates.
Coat the marinated meat in flour, then dip into the beaten eggs, and finally roll in the panko breadcrumbs.
Step 4: Fry the meat

Place a pan or a deep pot on the stove, add oil, and once the oil is hot, add the breaded meat to fry. Use medium heat; do not use high heat as the meat may burn. Flip the meat to ensure both sides are evenly golden and have a beautiful color.
Once the meat is cooked, remove it and place on paper towels to drain excess oil.
Step 5: Make the scallion oil sauce
Mix a little oil (or lard), a pinch of salt, seasoning powder, and fish sauce with finely chopped green onions. Heat in the microwave for about 20 seconds.
Step 6: Decorate the dish

Place the fried meat on a plate and drizzle the scallion oil sauce over the sliced pieces. For a better aroma, sprinkle some toasted sesame seeds on top. You can serve the meat with chili sauce or mayonnaise.
Tips for delicious new style fried pork
To make the meat delicious, remember to tenderize it before frying!
Marinate the meat for 30 minutes before frying so it absorbs the spices, making it crispier and more flavorful.
How to choose good pork:

Fresh meat will have a dry outer membrane and a bright red or dark red, glossy color. The fat should have a normal color and firmness. Conversely, stale meat will look slightly dark or pale green, lack gloss, may be slimy, and have an unpleasant odor.
Fresh meat has a bright, dry cut surface, while spoiled meat has a dark and slightly wet cut surface.
Fresh meat is firm and highly elastic. When pressed with a finger, it should not leave a dent or feel sticky. Stale meat will behave the opposite way.

New style fried pork is a dish that is both familiar and unique, attracting diners with its beautiful golden crispy crust and tender, flavorful meat. This simple dish is a great choice for busy days when you want a delicious and attractive meal.

mon_an.mo_ta: Occasionally, we should spend a little time making something more elaborate! Today, let's make these delicious and easy cabbage meat rolls.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Green onions, shallots, wood ear mushrooms, ginger, garlic chives - as needed
Fish sauce, seasoning powder, cooking oil, pepper
cac_buoc: Step 1: Separate the cabbage leaves, trim the thick ribs to make them thinner (for easier rolling), wash, soak in salt water for 15 minutes, then rinse again.
Peel and finely slice the shallots.
Wash and finely chop the green onions.
Clean and mince the ginger.
Wash the garlic chives.
Soak the wood ear mushrooms in hot water until expanded, then wash and mince finely.
Step 2: Blanch the cabbage leaves, then remove to cool and drain. Dip the garlic chives into the boiling water until wilted, then immediately submerge in cold water.
In a large bowl, combine the pork, shallots, green onions, ginger, and wood ear mushrooms. Add fish sauce, seasoning powder, 2 tsp cooking oil, and a bit of pepper (if liked); mix well.
Step 3: Lay a cabbage leaf on a clean cutting board, add the meat mixture, carefully roll it up, and tie with a garlic chive.
Step 4: Arrange the rolls in a steamer and steam for about 15 minutes.
Step 5: Arrange on a plate and enjoy your delicious and easy Cabbage Meat Rolls!

mon_an.mo_ta: Refresh your family meal with these delicious, nutritious, and beautiful Steamed Stuffed Tomatoes! Let's learn how to make them!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Green onions, wood ear mushrooms, shiitake mushrooms - As needed
Fish sauce, salt, pepper, chili - As needed
cac_buoc: Step 1: Choose tomatoes with stems still attached. Carefully wash them without losing the stems, then cut across the top. The stem part should be cut thinner to serve as a lid. Use a small spoon to scoop out the pulp from the remaining part, leaving the shell.
Step 2: Soak shiitake and wood ear mushrooms in hot water until expanded, then wash and mince. Wash and finely chop the green onions.
Step 3: Mix the pork, mushrooms, and green onions with a bit of fish sauce, salt, pepper, and chili (chili is optional).
Step 4: Using food prep gloves, stuff the meat mixture into 8 of the tomatoes and cover with their lids.
Step 5: Place the stuffed tomatoes in a steamer and steam until cooked.
Step 6: While the tomatoes are steaming, finely chop the remaining two tomatoes and the pulp from Step 1. Sauté with shallots and any leftover meat mixture to make a sauce.
Step 7: Once the tomatoes are steamed, carefully arrange them on a plate, pour the sauce over them, and serve hot with rice.

mon_an.mo_ta: Orange Chicken – A refreshing and easy-to-make dish with a sweet and sour orange sauce that is incredibly fragrant. Here is the recipe for delicious Orange Chicken.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the chicken, drain, and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Step 2: Crack the eggs into a bowl, whisk well, add chili sauce and salt, and mix. Add the chicken to the egg mixture and marinate for 5 minutes.
Step 3: Put the flour, pepper, and salt in a deep plate, mix well, then coat each piece of chicken in the flour mixture to ensure the orange chicken becomes crispy.
Step 4: Heat oil in a pan and fry the chicken until cooked and golden, then remove to a plate to drain. In a bowl, mix the mayonnaise, ketchup, and orange juice.
Step 5: Drain off excess oil, return the chicken and the sauce from Step 4 to the pan. Simmer until the sauce thickens. Turn off the heat and sprinkle with some green onions. Serve hot.

mon_an.mo_ta: These buffalo chicken meatballs attract diners with their soft, airy, and fresh chicken texture, infused with a rich aroma and a unique buffalo sauce. To enhance the flavor, you can serve these meatballs with bread. Spend some time making this wonderful dish for your family; it's a new yet delicious meal that children will surely love! Let's explore this dish below.
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, preheat your oven to 204 °C. Wash the chicken, drain, and cut into small pieces. Then, grind the chicken. Cutting it small first makes the grinding process faster and more even.

Next, mix the ground chicken with the egg, breadcrumbs, salt, onion powder, pepper, and 1/3 cup of green onions. You can use your hands to mix so the seasonings are evenly distributed, making the meat tastier and the color more appealing. Let the chicken sit for 20 minutes to marinate.
Step 2:

After 20 minutes, take small portions of the chicken and roll them into about 20 meatballs with a diameter of 2-3cm. Roll them firmly to ensure they don't break apart. Note: Roll them just firm enough so the meat remains fluffy and tender, not hard and dry after baking!
Place the meatballs on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake for 5 minutes until the meat firms up.
Step 3:
Next, remove the meatballs and place them in a slow cooker or pot.
Pour the buffalo sauce over the meatballs, cover the pot, and simmer for about 2 hours or until the meat is tender and fragrant.
Step 4:
Finally, remove the meat, arrange on a plate, and serve with mayonnaise.
Add the remaining green onions and enjoy while hot!
Notes for making buffalo chicken meatballs:
Baking the meatballs first firms them up so they don't fall apart in the pot and gives them a nice golden-brown exterior.
When simmering, you don't need high heat; use medium or low heat, just enough for the sauce to penetrate the meat.
Besides chicken, you can use pork or beef... depending on your family's preference.
Remember to let the meat marinate for 20 minutes after mixing for better flavor and aroma.

mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried Chicken with Cucumber – An easy-to-make dish for leisurely days when you want to cook something special for the family. Here is the recipe for Stir-fried Chicken with Cucumber.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Oyster sauce, shallots, pepper, fish sauce, chili, sugar, green onions
cac_buoc: Step 1: Debone the chicken and remove the skin, then cut into bite-sized pieces. Add 1 tsp salt and some pepper to the chicken, mix well, and marinate for 15 minutes.
Step 2:
Wash the cucumber, soak in salt water for 15 minutes, then drain. Halve it, remove the seeds, and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Peel the fibrous skin off the taro stems, slice diagonally into thin pieces, soak with salt, and squeeze well to remove the irritants.
Wash and chop the green onions; peel and thinly slice the shallots. Trim the mushroom stems, wash, and soak in diluted salt water for 15 minutes.

Step 3: Heat oil in a pan, sauté the shallots until fragrant, then add the chicken and stir-fry until cooked. Season with chili to your taste and add a little oyster sauce. Next, add the mushrooms and stir-fry for another 5 minutes.
Step 4: Add the cucumber and taro stems to the pan. Adjust the seasoning to taste. When the taro stems are cooked, turn off the heat and add the green onions. Serve hot with rice.

mon_an.mo_ta: Stir-fried Chicken with Fried Potatoes – a uniquely delicious dish. The crispy, nutty fried potatoes paired with chicken are very rich and flavorful. Learn how to make Stir-fried Chicken with Fried Potatoes.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fish sauce, seasoning powder, salt, pepper
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel and wash the onion, then cut into wedges. Peel and slice the ginger. Peel and wash the potatoes, cut into bite-sized pieces, and soak in salt water for 20 minutes to prevent browning and make them crispier.
Step 2: Drain the potatoes. Heat oil in a pan and fry the potatoes until golden brown. Remove to a plate and drain excess oil.

Step 3: Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and marinate with 1 tsp salt and a little pepper for 30 minutes. Sauté garlic in a pan with oil, add the chicken and stir-fry for 5 minutes, then add 1 tsp black bean sauce and toss well. Season with 2 tsp fish sauce, 1/2 tsp seasoning powder, and 1/2 tsp salt. Cover the pan and simmer over low heat.

Step 4: Add the ginger, onion, and fried potatoes to the pan. Toss gently so the potatoes don't break. Stir-fry over low heat for about 8 minutes, then turn off the heat, transfer to a plate, and enjoy hot.

mon_an.mo_ta: If your family is bored with traditional chicken dishes like boiled, stir-fried, or braised... try your hand at these grilled chicken skewers this weekend! The sweet, fragrant grilled chicken infused with spices is truly irresistible! Let's make Thai-style Grilled Chicken Skewers!
cac_buoc: Soak the bamboo skewers in cold water beforehand (this prevents them from burning during grilling).
In a clean bowl, combine 2 tbsp soy sauce, turmeric powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, 1 tsp chili sauce, lemon juice, a pinch of salt, and 1 tbsp peanut sauce.
Use a spoon to mix the seasonings thoroughly.
Wash the chicken breast, drain, and cut into equal long strips. Place them in a plastic bag.
Pour the marinade into the bag with the chicken and shake well to coat. Place in the refrigerator to marinate for about 2 hours.
After marinating, remove the chicken and thread onto the bamboo skewers.
Preheat a grill pan, lightly grease with a thin layer of oil, and grill the chicken skewers, turning occasionally so they cook evenly.
Once the chicken is cooked, remove and sprinkle with some crushed roasted peanuts. Serve with peanut sauce and a squeeze of lemon.

mon_an.mo_ta: Each piece of pork is braised to a golden brown, sweet and tender. One bite will have you hooked! It is best served with hot steamed rice.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 1 piece ginger; 2 cinnamon sticks (optional); 1 star anise
1 tbsp dark soy sauce (or caramel sauce)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Scrape the skin, wash the pork thoroughly, and cut into large square pieces.
Step 2: Blanch the pork in boiling water with a pinch of salt and lemon juice for 4-5 minutes, then rinse under cold water. Tie the pieces with kitchen twine in a cross pattern (optional).
Step 3: Add water to a pot along with the seasonings, tea bags, shallot, garlic, ginger, and scallions. Stir well and bring to a boil over medium heat.
Step 4: Once the water boils, taste and adjust the seasoning, then add the pork. Begin simmering the pork; remove the tea bags after about 15 minutes.

While simmering, occasionally skim off the foam to keep the sauce clear and looking more appetizing. When the sauce has reduced slightly and the pork is tender with a beautiful color, turn off the heat.
Transfer the Dong Po pork to a plate and garnish with a few chili slices and shredded scallions.
This dish is delicious served with rice or wrapped in greens to balance the richness.

mon_an.mo_ta: Braised pork is always a favorite in Vietnamese families. Today, we introduce a savory braised pork with coconut recipe that is guaranteed to make your whole family eat heartily!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Fish sauce, salt, pepper - to taste
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the pork, cut into bite-sized pieces, and marinate with fish sauce, salt, pepper, and minced shallot.
Step 2: Peel the brown skin off the coconut meat, rinse, and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Step 3: Heat 1 tsp of sugar with a little water until it turns a caramel color, then add the marinated pork and a bit of cooking oil. Stir well to coat the meat evenly with the caramel sauce.

Step 4: Cook for about 10 minutes, then add the coconut meat and the fresh coconut water. My mother says adding coconut water makes the coconut meat tender and the pork more fragrant. I have tested it, and it truly is much more delicious!

Step 5: Continue to simmer until the coconut absorbs the sauce. Occasionally open the lid and stir well. When the liquid has almost evaporated, check and adjust the seasoning to suit your family's taste.
Step 6: Serve the savory braised pork with coconut and enjoy!

mon_an.ten: Boiled Pork with a Tasty New Twist
mon_an.mo_ta: Boiled pork is a familiar dish, but to make it more delicious and exciting, this recipe will help you create a truly wonderful version!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Garlic sauce: 5-8 cloves garlic, 1 scallion (white part, minced), 15g ginger (minced), a pinch of salt, 70ml warm water
Chili sauce: 60ml chili oil, 15ml soy sauce, 15ml vinegar, 5g sugar
cac_buoc: Step 1:

First, place the pork belly, ginger slices, and scallion in a pot. Add enough water to cover the meat and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce to medium heat and simmer for 30-40 minutes.
Step 2:
To make the garlic sauce, combine the ginger, garlic, minced scallion, and a little salt in a small bowl. Add warm water and let it soak for 5-10 minutes.
In a separate bowl, mix the chili sauce ingredients and set aside.
Step 3:
Once the pork is cooked, remove it and let it cool slightly. Then, slice the pork as thinly as possible.
Step 4:
Start plating! Arrange the cucumber on a plate, then layer the pork on top.
Step 5:
First, pour the garlic sauce over the pork and wait 30 seconds for it to absorb. Then, pour the chili sauce over it.
This style of boiled pork is heart-meltingly good just to look at...
It is incredibly appetizing when eaten with hot rice!
If you like it extra spicy, prepare an extra bowl of chili sauce for dipping!
It looks so tempting!

mon_an.mo_ta: Soy-Braised Meatballs – A delicious and easy dish for moms to showcase their culinary skills. How to make Soy-Braised Meatballs.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: tsp salt, 1 tsp sugar, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 1 bowl hot water
A little chicken stock, ground pepper, a little cooking wine, tapioca starch
cac_buoc: Step 1: Put the ground pork into a large bowl and mix with minced ginger, scallions, and garlic. Beat the eggs and pour them into the meat bowl, mixing thoroughly. Then add a little wine, salt, sugar, and tapioca starch.
Step 2: Finely chop the water chestnuts and mix them into the ground pork mixture from Step 1.

Step 3: Use your hands to roll the meat into even-sized balls. Heat oil in a pan; once hot, drop the meatballs in and fry until cooked through. When the meatballs turn golden brown, remove them to a plate lined with paper towels.

Step 4: Prepare another pot, add soy sauce, star anise, and sliced leeks. Then add the meatballs to the pan along with pepper, hot water, and the prepared chicken stock. Stir gently, cover, and simmer for a while until the sauce thickens slightly, then turn off the heat. Serve the meatballs in a bowl, garnish with herbs, and serve hot with rice.
Source: Trí thức trẻ

mon_an.mo_ta: Braised duck with ginger is a choice for many families because of the fresh, flavorful, and tender duck meat. Eating it with hot rice or vermicelli mixed with the thick braised sauce provides a delightful culinary experience. Let's learn how to make this delicious braised duck with ginger!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Duck - Half a bird, medium size
Seasoning powder, fish sauce, caramel sauce - seasonings
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Peel the garlic and shallots, wash them, and mince them. Peel the ginger, wash it, and cut it into thin strips.
Next, rub the duck with 1/2 of the sliced ginger to remove the gamey odor, then rinse again with salt.

Once the duck is clean, chop it into bite-sized pieces and marinate with the remaining 1/2 of the shallots, garlic, and ginger. You can add a little salt and MSG and marinate for about 30 minutes so the duck absorbs the flavors.
Step 2:
Next, add a little oil to a pan. When the oil is hot, pan-sear the duck pieces; this helps render the fat from the skin and firms up the meat.
Wait until the duck skin is slightly charred and golden, then remove and set aside. Remember to drain off the excess duck fat if there is too much.
Step 3:
Next, heat a little oil in a pot and sauté the ginger, shallots, and garlic until fragrant.
Then, add the duck meat and stir-fry until the meat is firm.
Step 4:

Once the duck is firm, pour in enough water to cover the meat. Season with 2 tbsp fish sauce and 1 tsp caramel sauce. Turn the heat to high and stir so the meat absorbs the seasoning. When the water boils vigorously, lower the heat to a gentle simmer. You can adjust the amount of fish sauce to suit your family's taste.
When the braising liquid has reduced by about half, taste and adjust the seasoning again.
Continue braising until the sauce is slightly thickened, then turn off the heat and sprinkle with a little pepper and scallions.
Finally, transfer the duck to a plate and serve with hot white rice or vermicelli.
Notes for a delicious braised duck with ginger:
Remember to clean the duck thoroughly to remove odors, otherwise it will diminish the flavor of the dish.
Pay attention to marinating the duck for at least half an hour so the flavors penetrate deeply.
While simmering, keep an eye on the pot to prevent burning. Occasionally stir the duck so it cooks evenly.
How to choose good duck:

When buying, choose mature and plump ducks with a round breast, thick neck and belly skin, and full feathers (the tips of the wings should just cross over each other). These ducks are easier and faster to pluck.
Avoid young ducks as the meat will be soft and not firm, and it takes a lot of time to remove the downy feathers. Young ducks have large, soft beaks. Mature ducks have smaller, hard beaks.
Ducks that have laid many eggs also have very fragrant meat; these have a sagging lower belly. Unlike chicken, for duck, it is better to choose a male as the meat is tastier than a female.
To check if a duck is healthy, check the vent area; if it is clean and free of runny droppings, the duck is healthy.

mon_an.mo_ta: In chilly weather, enjoy this delicious bacon-wrapped grilled chicken that the whole family will love. Crispy on the outside, chewy meat filling with grilled chicken and bacon flavors—kids will surely adore it. Let's learn how to cook this tasty dish! Bacon-wrapped grilled chicken is certainly not difficult for moms to cook, and it carries an irresistible aroma. Let's get cooking!
cac_buoc: Let's start making the delicious bacon-wrapped grilled chicken!
Step 1: First, slice the chicken into thin pieces, then add salt and ground pepper and marinate for 30 minutes.
Step 2: For the vegetable filling, cut them into long strips.
Step 3: Spread out a piece of chicken, place the vegetables on top, and roll it up tightly.

Step 4: Next, lay 3 slices of bacon together, place the chicken roll on top, and roll it up very tightly. Wrap it tightly in foil and bake in the oven at 200°C for 25 minutes. If you don't have an oven, you can grill it in a pan or over charcoal.
Step 5: Remove the grilled meat from the foil and pan-fry until golden brown.

mon_an.mo_ta: Fried Shrimp with Pineapple Sauce – A delicious and easy dish to try instead of your usual shrimp recipes! Learn how to make this unique and tasty Fried Shrimp with Pineapple Sauce.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 5ml soy sauce, 30ml vinegar, 2 tbsp sugar, 30ml pineapple juice, 200ml water
1 tsp cornstarch, 1 tbsp water (to mix with cornstarch)
