cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel the shrimp, keeping the tails intact, and devein. Butterfly the back of the shrimp but do not cut all the way through, just enough for the meat to spread out. Marinate the shrimp with ginger wine, salt, and pepper.
Step 2: Beat the eggs in a bowl with the cornstarch. Dip each shrimp into the egg and starch mixture.
Step 3: Prepare a pan with hot oil. Drop the shrimp in and fry until golden and cooked through. Remove to a plate lined with paper towels so the dish isn't too greasy.

Step 4: Make the sauce: Place all sauce ingredients in a pan. Reduce to medium heat. Mix 1 tsp cornstarch with 1 tbsp water in a small bowl, then pour into the pan. Cook until the sauce thickens, then turn off the heat and stir in the diced pineapple.
Step 5: To serve this easy dish, arrange the shrimp on a plate and pour the sauce over them. Serve hot.
Source: Trí thức trẻ

mon_an.mo_ta: Along with braised pork, tôm kho tàu is a signature Southern dish featuring the sweet, fragrant, and rich taste of coconut water. When cooking, Southerners often use coconut water to create a light, sweet depth. Today, let's learn how to cook Southern-style braised shrimp.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
Peel and mince the garlic. Wash the scallions and cut into segments; mince the white parts and keep separate.

Wash the shrimp and peel them, leaving the tails for presentation. Remove the heads and set the tomalley (gạch) aside. Butterfly the backs and remove the black veins. Marinate the shrimp with a little pepper, minced scallion whites, minced garlic, salt, fish sauce, and sugar.
Step 2: Braise the shrimp
Mash the shrimp tomalley until smooth, then add lemon juice, sugar, oil, pepper, fish sauce, and seasoning powder. Steam this mixture over a water bath, stirring until it thickens.

Place the shrimp in a pan with oil and sear until the meat firms up and turns slightly golden, then remove and place in a braising pot. Pour the tomalley mixture evenly over the shrimp, add annatto oil for a beautiful color, and add a few chili slices if you like it spicy. Pour in the coconut water and bring to a boil, then lower the heat to a simmer. During the braising process, turn the shrimp so they absorb the seasonings evenly. Continue cooking until the sauce thickens slightly and turns a beautiful amber color, then sprinkle with scallions and pepper and turn off the heat.
Step 3: Presentation
Transfer the shrimp to a deep plate and pour the braising sauce over them. Garnish with chopped scallions, pepper, and chopped cilantro. Serve hot with white rice.
The finished dish should have a beautiful golden-brown amber color, firm and sweet shrimp meat, a balanced flavor, and the aroma of coconut water, pepper, and scallions.
Tips for delicious Tôm Kho Tàu:

Choose medium-sized, firm shrimp with shiny shells that are not watery or slimy. Choose shrimp with dark shells and a heavy feel, as they usually have more tomalley. Use shrimp without eggs for firmer and chewier meat.
To make the shrimp chewier and more flavorful, marinate them with a bit of scallion, garlic, and spices, then sear them over high heat before braising.

mon_an.ten: Sweet and Sour Shrimp with Tofu
mon_an.mo_ta: Sweet and Sour Shrimp with Tofu – a harmonious dish that stimulates the appetite. The flavor of the shrimp infuses into the tofu, making it absolutely delicious! Learn how to cook Sweet and Sour Shrimp with Tofu.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Peel the shrimp, remove the heads, wash thoroughly, and drain.
Step 2: Cut the tofu into bite-sized pieces and fry until golden brown.

Step 3: Sauté minced garlic until fragrant, add tomato sauce with a little sugar and salt. Cook for about 1 minute, then add the shrimp and tofu. Stir-fry until the shrimp is cooked. Transfer to a plate and serve hot with rice.
Source: Kenh14

mon_an.mo_ta: Crispy sesame-crusted shrimp features sweet, tender shrimp meat combined with fragrant cornstarch and a nutty, crunchy sesame coating. Spend a little time in the kitchen to make this delicious dish for your loved ones. Everyone will surely finish it and ask for more!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Pepper, cooking wine, salt, seasoning powder - seasonings
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients for the crispy sesame-crusted shrimp.
Wash the tiger shrimp, peel them, and remove the black veins. Note: keep the tails intact.
Crack the egg and separate the white into a bowl.
Peel the ginger, wash it, and crush or julienne it.
Toast the white sesame seeds until golden.
Step 2: Cooking steps for the crispy sesame-crusted shrimp.
First, use a paper towel to pat the shrimp completely dry.
Next, marinate the shrimp with: 2 tsp pepper, 2 tsp seasoning powder, 1/2 tsp salt, 2 tsp cooking wine, and the ginger. Mix well and let sit for about 5 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Next, mix the cornstarch with the egg white. Stir well until you get a smooth batter that is neither too thin nor too thick.
Hold a shrimp by the tail and dip it into the batter, ensuring it is evenly coated. Then roll it in the toasted sesame seeds until fully covered.
Repeat this process for all the shrimp.
Next, heat cooking oil in a pan.
When the oil is hot, drop the shrimp in to fry.
While frying, turn the shrimp frequently and maintain medium heat so they cook through. When the shrimp are a beautiful golden color and fragrant, remove them and drain on paper towels.
Finally, arrange the shrimp on a plate and enjoy with chili sauce, dipping sauce, or sweet and sour fish sauce as desired.
Notes for delicious crispy sesame-crusted shrimp:
If the batter is too thick because the egg white was small, add a little water to reach the right consistency.
Using cooking wine to marinate helps remove the fishy smell and enhances the flavor. You can omit this if you prefer.
You can substitute black sesame seeds for white ones.
Similarly, if you don't have cornstarch, all-purpose flour works as well.
Do not over-fry the shrimp as they cook quickly; overcooking will make them dry and the sesame seeds may burn.

Crispy sesame-crusted shrimp features sweet, tender shrimp meat combined with fragrant cornstarch and a nutty, crunchy sesame coating. Spend a little time in the kitchen to make this delicious dish for your loved ones. Everyone will surely finish it and ask for more!

mon_an.ten: Shrimp and Asparagus Stir-fry with Sesame Oil
mon_an.mo_ta: Asparagus is not only useful for decoration and flower arranging but is also a highly nutritious food, rich in vitamins and minerals. It is considered the "king of vegetables" for its benefits in preventing cardiovascular diseases and cancer, and its positive effects on the urinary tract and male vitality. Asparagus can be prepared in many ways, but stir-frying it with fresh ingredients and spices creates a flavorful dish while retaining its natural crunch and sweetness. Today, we introduce the simple, savory, and easy-to-make Shrimp and Asparagus Stir-fry with Sesame Oil.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning salt and powder - to taste
cac_buoc: Step 1: Mix 2 tsp olive oil, seasoning salt, and 1 tsp sesame oil in a bowl. Heat a pan and stir-fry the asparagus with this oil mixture until softened, about 5-7 minutes.
Step 2: Mix the soy sauce, vinegar, and remaining sesame oil; set aside.

Step 3: Add the remaining olive oil to the pan over medium heat. Once hot, add the shrimp and 1/4 tsp chili powder (adjust to taste). Stir-fry until the shrimp turn opaque, then add the asparagus from Step 1 and stir-fry for another minute.
Step 4: Serve the Shrimp and Asparagus Stir-fry with Sesame Oil on a plate. Sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds and serve with steamed rice and the soy sauce mixture from Step 2.

mon_an.mo_ta: Ham Omelet Rolls are a unique yet simple dish. Let's learn how to make them!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Green onions, fish sauce, salt - to taste
cac_buoc: Mix the rice flour, seasoning salt, 200ml beer, 100ml cold water, and 1/2 tsp salt. Stir well and let it rest for about 10 minutes.
Whisk the eggs with a little seasoning powder, fish sauce, and finely chopped green onions.
Heat a pan and fry the eggs into a thin golden omelet. Remove to a plate. Next, pour the batter and spread thinly like making bánh xèo; once cooked, remove to a plate.
Place the omelet on the bottom, followed by the crepe layer, and finally the ham. Roll it up tightly.
Slice the rolls into bite-sized pieces and serve. You can serve with a small bowl of chili soy sauce or chili sauce for extra flavor.

mon_an.mo_ta: Let's make these delicious Fried Meatballs in Tomato Sauce for a happy and cozy family meal! This is a very simple way to make wonderful meatballs!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Finely chopped onion - 1 small dipping sauce bowl
Shiitake or wood ear mushrooms - a little
Pepper, fish sauce, salt, cooking oil - to taste
cac_buoc: Step 1: Soak the mushrooms in hot water for about 15 minutes, then wash, squeeze dry, and mince. Wash one tomato and mince it. Wash the green onions and cilantro.
Step 2: Mix the pork, onion, chopped green onions, minced tomato, and mushrooms with a bit of fish sauce, salt, and pepper. Use clean plastic wrap to shape the meat into bite-sized balls.
Step 3: Deep-fry the meatballs until golden and fragrant, then remove and drain the oil.

Step 4: Sauté the shallots, the remaining two tomatoes (chopped), and garlic with a little water; bring to a boil. While waiting for the sauce to boil, mix 1 small tbsp of tapioca starch with 1 tbsp of water in a bowl. Slowly pour the starch mixture into the sauce while stirring constantly; bring to a boil.
Step 5: Add the meatballs and simmer for 2 to 3 minutes to absorb the tomato sauce. Season to taste and turn off the heat.
Step 6: Serve the meatballs on a plate, garnish with cilantro and chopped green onions. Best enjoyed with bánh mì!

mon_an.mo_ta: The cold air arriving right now makes us crave something hot and spicy. Let's skip the usual chicken and ham and treat the family to this spicy beef stew to chase away the early winter chill.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Marinade spices: 4 star anise, 6 dried chilies, 1 tsp peppercorns, 1 cinnamon stick, 1 tsp cumin seeds, 2 cloves, 1 dried orange peel, 4 bay leaves, black cardamom
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Cut the beef into long strips, about 2.5 cm thick. Peel the radish and cut into cubes (1.5 x 1.5 cm).
Step 2:
Blanch the beef in boiling water. Remove, soak in cold water, and drain.
Step 3:
In a pan, mix 2 tbsp cooking oil with chili paste, garlic, ginger, and rock sugar. Heat over low heat until fragrant.
Step 4:
Add the beef and toss with the marinade spices. Then add the soy sauce and rice wine. Stir-fry for another 2 minutes.
Step 5:
Transfer the beef and all the marinade to a large, deep pot. Add the remaining dry spices and broth. Place the pot on the stove and simmer for about 1 hour or more until the beef is tender.
Step 6:
Next, add the radish to the pot. Season with a little salt. Continue simmering for about 30 minutes until the radish is soft.
Ladle into bowls, sprinkle with chopped green onions and cilantro, and enjoy.

mon_an.mo_ta: 'Grilled Beef in Perilla Leaves' is a snack that always has a very appealing aroma. It is very easy to make, highly nutritious, and great for your health. Let's get into the kitchen and make this wonderful dish together!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Sweet and sour fish sauce or mắm nêm - for dipping
Fresh herbs, rice paper - for serving
cac_buoc: Step 1: Mix the beef with minced lemongrass, minced garlic, seasoning powder, sugar, ground pepper, five-spice powder, and 1 tbsp cooking oil.
Step 2: Place the beef on a perilla leaf, roll tightly, and thread onto skewers.
Step 3: Grill the beef rolls over charcoal until cooked.
Step 4: Finely chop the green onions and place in a ceramic bowl. Heat the oil until boiling, then pour it over the onions to make scallion oil.
Step 5: Roast the peanuts until golden and crush them. Sort and wash the fresh herbs, then shake dry.

Step 6: Arrange the grilled beef on a plate, drizzle with scallion oil, sprinkle with peanuts, and serve with rice paper and fresh herbs. Add rice vermicelli if desired. Dip in sweet and sour fish sauce or mắm nêm.
Tips:
Place the beef on a perilla leaf, roll tightly, and thread onto skewers.
Grilling the beef rolls over charcoal provides better flavor.
This dish is best served hot.
Final result: The dish should have the aroma of perilla leaves, the savory and rich taste of beef, a clean and light flavor, and an appealing color.

mon_an.mo_ta: For gatherings with friends or family, this sate grilled beef is a perfect suggestion. The meat is sweet, tender, spicy, and fragrant in every fiber. Not only is it simple to make with easy-to-find ingredients, but it is also an attractive and highly nutritious dish.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning powder, MSG, sugar, soy sauce, fish sauce
Red and green bell peppers, cut into 2-inch pieces - Optional
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Slice the beef tenderloin into pieces about 1 cm thick.
Marinate the beef with 1 tsp MSG, 1 tsp seasoning powder, 1/2 tbsp soy sauce, and 1/2 tbsp fish sauce. Mix well and let it rest for at least 30 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Step 2:
Prepare a pan with hot oil.
Add the following mixture to the pan: 2 tbsp minced shallots, 2 tbsp minced garlic, 2 tbsp minced lemongrass, and 2 tbsp minced chili.
Stir constantly until the mixture bubbles and is cooked through.
Add 2 tbsp minced cilantro and 1 tsp chili powder, stir well, then turn off the heat.
Pour the mixture into a clean bowl.
Step 3:
Place the beef in a hot pan with oil and pan-sear.
Use a pastry brush to spread a layer of the sate sauce (the mixture from step 2) onto the surface of the beef.
Brush an additional layer of condensed milk on top to make the meat fragrant, rich, and appealing.
Step 4:
Prepare a baking tray and arrange the beef on top. Sprinkle lemongrass evenly over the surface of the meat.
Preheat the oven to 180°C for about 10 minutes.
Place the tray in the oven and bake at 180°C for 20–30 minutes.

Watch the oven; after 20-30 minutes when the meat is cooked, remove it and cut into hot slices. (You can add the 2-inch bell pepper pieces to the oven during the last 5-10 minutes to roast and serve with the beef).
Your delicious, hot sate grilled beef is now complete.

mon_an.mo_ta: Honey roasted pigeon is a unique dish offering a delicious and attractive flavor. When enjoying this dish, you will experience the harmony between the sweetness of honey and the characteristic aroma of pigeon. Let's learn how to make this tasty honey roasted pigeon through the article below! The tender pigeon meat is marinated and roasted until cooked, then drizzled with honey to create a smooth, golden glaze. This dish is a perfect choice for parties or special occasions.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Green onions - 2 stalks, cut into 3-4cm lengths
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
When buying the quail, clean it and remove any remaining feathers. Then, use salt to rub the body of the quail and rinse multiple times with clean water to remove the fishy smell, then drain.
If the quail is large, you can split it in half for easier cooking.
Peel and mince the garlic.
Wash the accompanying vegetables before use.
Step 2: Marinate the pigeon

In a bowl, place the prepared marinade ingredients, including 1 minced garlic bulb, 1 tbsp five-spice powder, 4 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, and 2 tbsp garlic powder. Use chopsticks to mix well until the seasonings are completely dissolved.
Once the marinade is ready, place the quail in the bowl and toss well. Leave for 15 to 30 minutes so the quail absorbs the flavors evenly.
Step 3: Roast the pigeon
After marinating the quail, you can grill it over charcoal or in an oven. Before roasting, brush a layer of cooking oil evenly over all sides of the quail.
If using an oven, place the skin side of the quail up on the rack and roast at 500°F for about 20 minutes. Then, flip the quail and continue roasting for another 10 minutes until cooked through.

If using a charcoal grill, arrange the quail on the grate and grill, flipping once every 2-3 minutes to cook evenly. Continue grilling for about 15 minutes until the quail has a beautiful golden color on all sides.
Once roasted, place the quail on a plate and add the accompanying vegetables. Note: do not use too high a heat to avoid burning the meat.
Step 4: Finished product
The honey roasted quail brings an irresistible aroma. With crispy skin that isn't burnt and sweet, flavorful meat inside. Surely, your family will enjoy this special dish!
Notes for making honey roasted pigeon
Prepare fresh pigeon: Choose fresh birds, clean them, and handle any remaining feathers. If necessary, chop in half for easier processing.

Marinating: Mix the marinade ingredients like honey, garlic, soy sauce, and other spices thoroughly. Ensure the pigeon is evenly coated and left for a sufficient time to let the spices penetrate the meat.

Roast at the right temperature: If using an oven, a temperature of about 500°F (260°C) is suitable for roasting pigeon. If using charcoal, adjust the fire so it is not too strong to prevent the meat from burning.
Brush with oil: Before roasting, brush a layer of oil on all sides of the pigeon to keep the meat tender and prevent it from drying out.

Monitor roasting time: Roasting time depends on the size of the pigeon. Flip the quail and roast both sides evenly to ensure it is fully cooked. Check the meat by poking the thigh to see the level of doneness. Suitable roasting time is usually around 20-30 minutes.
Let the meat rest: After roasting, let the pigeon rest for a few minutes before serving. This helps the meat retain its tenderness and better flavor.

mon_an.ten: Quick Breakfast Fried Eggs with Tomato Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: Today we bring you a recipe for quick tomato sauce fried eggs, full of nutrients for breakfast. This dish will provide you with abundant energy during busy year-end days, as all its components contain important nutrients. Tomato sauce fried eggs will give you a delicious, colorful, and nutritious portion to start a fresh day. Let's find out more through the article below! Enjoy this quick breakfast for a fast and high-energy meal. This nutrient-rich dish will provide nutritional balance and satisfy your taste buds.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Cherry tomatoes - 8 (choose both yellow and red for a vibrant look)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the eggs
Crack the eggs into a bowl, add a pinch of salt, and beat well.

Place a pan on the stove, add oil, and heat it up. Then, pour the beaten eggs into the pan and swirl to coat the surface. Use a spatula to gently lift an edge so the raw egg on top flows underneath. When the eggs are slightly set, fold them in half and remove to a separate plate.
Step 2: Prepare the tomato sauce
Wash the tomatoes and cut them in half.
Peel and mince the garlic and ginger.

Heat the pan, add oil, and sauté the minced garlic and ginger until fragrant. Next, add the brown sugar and stir well. Add the tomatoes to the pan and toss. Cook for about 1 minute until the tomatoes are soft, then add soy sauce, vinegar, and sesame oil.
Step 3: Presentation
Finally, spoon the tomato sauce prepared in step 2 over the eggs from the previous step. Sprinkle some chopped parsley on top. A nutrient-complete breakfast for the family is ready.
Notes for making quick tomato sauce fried eggs
Use fresh eggs: Choose fresh eggs to ensure the best flavor for the dish.
Ensure a non-stick pan: Before pouring eggs into the pan, make sure the pan is sufficiently heated and coated with oil to prevent sticking.
Pay attention to egg doneness: For perfect eggs, check the set of the whites and ensure the yolks maintain your preferred level of softness.
Select fresh tomatoes: Use bright-colored, ripe tomatoes to create a flavorful sauce.
Adjust seasoning to taste: You can add seasonings like onion, garlic, or chili as desired to enrich the flavor of the tomato sauce.
Beautiful presentation: When serving, drizzle the tomato sauce evenly over the eggs and sprinkle with chopped parsley to enhance the color and flavor.
Enjoy immediately: This dish should be eaten right after completion to enjoy the fresh taste of the eggs and tomato sauce.

mon_an.ten: Steamed Squid with Lemongrass and Lime Fish Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: With nutritious and delicious squid steamed with fragrant lemongrass and a homemade lime fish sauce, no one can resist this wonderful combination. Let's learn this steamed squid dish quickly!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning sauce - 1 tbsp fish sauce; 3 tbsp lime juice; 1.5 tbsp sugar; 1/4 tsp pepper; 2 tbsp minced chili and garlic; 1 tbsp minced cilantro, all mixed in a bowl
cac_buoc: Here are the ingredients needed to prepare Steamed Squid with Lemongrass and Lime Fish Sauce!
This is the lime fish sauce after mixing all the seasonings!

Step 1: Thinly slice the ginger. Cut green onions into segments and bruise the lemongrass. Tear the lime leaves into small pieces and place everything on a plate. Clean the squid and arrange them on top of the lemongrass bed.
Step 2: Boil a pot of water. When the water boils, place the plate of squid in to steam for 15 minutes until cooked.
Step 3: Turn off the heat, remove the plate, and slice the squid into rings.
Serve the squid on a plate, drizzle with the lime fish sauce, and add a few cucumber slices to complete the dish.
It's very quick and simple, isn't it? Learn how to make it to treat your whole family!

thoi_gian: Delicious Cooking sends you a recipe for an extremely cool smoothie. Very simple, in less than 5 minutes, you will have a refreshing, creamy, and delicious avocado smoothie to beat the summer heat and enrich your menu.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the avocado, cut in half, use a knife to remove the pit and any skin stuck to the pit area.
Step 2: Then, use a spoon to scoop out the flesh and cut it into small pieces.
Step 3: Peel the bananas and cut into small pieces. You can put the sliced bananas in the freezer to let them harden and use them instead of ice.
Step 4: Wash the mint leaves.
Step 5: Put all ingredients including avocado, bananas, mint leaves, yogurt, and fresh milk into a blender. If you haven't frozen the bananas, add a little purified ice.
Step 6: Squeeze in about 1 tbsp of lime juice.
Step 7: Turn on the blender and blend until the avocado smoothie mixture is completely smooth, then turn it off.
...Then pour the avocado smoothie into a glass; you can garnish with a few mint leaves on top for a nice look.
Choosing and preparing the avocado is the deciding factor for a good smoothie. Pay attention to the following points:
The avocado must be ripe and soft to the touch for the smoothie to be fragrant and creamy. If you use a green avocado, the smoothie will be bitter and hard to eat.

You should choose wax avocados (bơ sáp) with a long, curved shape. Choose mature avocados (usually the stem falls off easily when touched). Don't choose round ones because although they look better and larger, the pit is very big, there isn't much flesh, and they aren't as delicious as the long wax avocados.
Ripe avocados are very easy to peel and pit; you just need to use a knife or spoon to gently lift them out. Be careful not to let any of the skin or the seed coat get mixed into the flesh.

Adding banana is my secret tip for a delicious avocado smoothie. You can freeze the bananas beforehand and use them instead of ice cubes when making the smoothie :p If you don't have time to freeze them, add some purified ice to blend with the avocado for a cool drink.

When blending, be careful not to blend for too long. I usually just pulse for a few seconds and stop; if the smoothie hasn't reached the desired consistency, I continue. Running the blender for too long can cause the motor to overheat and burn out.
If you don't have honey, you can substitute it with sugar or condensed milk.
Don't hesitate any longer, make your own avocado smoothie following this recipe!

mon_an.ten: Crab and Amaranth Soup for Hot Days
mon_an.mo_ta: Instead of the usual jute leaf crab soup, you can use amaranth to cook this dish. The sweetness of the amaranth combined with the distinct flavor of the crab is a perfect match!
cac_buoc: Let's start making crab and amaranth soup!

Step 1: Clean the field crabs, separate the shells, and scrape out the roe. (How to choose good field crabs: choose those with large, strong claws. If you touch them, they should have all their legs, move quickly, and have a large, plump body. Avoid dead crabs as they can be toxic.)
Step 2: Pick the red amaranth, removing damaged leaves and tough stems, keeping only the tender parts. Wash thoroughly and soak in diluted salt water.

Step 3: Place the crab meat in a mortar with a little salt and pound into a fine paste, then filter with water to extract the liquid and discard the residue. Strain 2-3 times to ensure the crab liquid is free of grit.
Place the pot on the stove, add 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp broth mix (or adjust to your taste). Stir well so the crab solids do not settle at the bottom.
Step 4: Drain the amaranth and chop into bite-sized pieces; avoid chopping too large as it may be tough.
Step 5: When the crab soup boils, reduce the heat and add the amaranth. Cook for about 2-3 minutes or until the greens are tender.
Step 6: Ladle the crab and amaranth soup into a bowl. It is delicious when served with a few pickled eggplants.
Enjoy your meal with this crab and amaranth soup recipe!

mon_an.mo_ta: With this recipe, you will have a wonderful grilled rib feast or a perfect home-cooked meal. Learn how to make these apple juice marinated ribs now!
cac_buoc: Here are the ingredients needed for these irresistible apple juice marinated grilled ribs!
Step 1:
First, use a fork to prick the surface of the ribs evenly, then marinate the ribs with five-spice powder.
Step 2:
Mix the rice vinegar, hoisin sauce, oyster sauce, ground chili, and honey in a bowl. The vinegar will help make the ribs more tender.
Step 3:
Place the ribs in a thick food-grade plastic bag, then pour in the sauce mixed in step 2. Marinate the ribs for about 3-4 hours, or ideally overnight, so the sauce penetrates deeply.
Step 4:
After marinating, remove the ribs and set aside the marinade. Grill the ribs over charcoal for about 30 minutes.
Step 5:
After 30 minutes, remove the ribs, wrap them in foil, and place them back on the grill.
Step 6:
Pour the apple juice into the foil, wrap it tightly, and continue grilling for another 30 minutes.
Step 7:
After 30 minutes, remove the ribs from the foil and place them back on the grill rack.

Brush a layer of the reserved marinade from step 4 over one side of the ribs, grill for 5 minutes, then flip and brush the other side. Continue brushing the sauce onto the ribs for about 30 minutes. After the final basting, grill for another 10 minutes.
By basting continuously, your grilled ribs will stay moist and won't dry out.
Slice the ribs and enjoy!
Eating these grilled ribs with white rice and some boiled vegetables is absolutely fantastic!

mon_an.mo_ta: Chinese dishes are famous for being rich and oily, but this recipe introduces a Sichuan-style braised tofu and pork that isn't greasy at all! Refresh your daily meals with this Chinese-style dish. With simple ingredients like pork, tofu, soy sauce, a bit of ginger, and about 15-20 minutes, you'll have a delicious, unique, and nutritious meal for the whole family.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings: sugar, soy sauce, fish sauce, pepper
cac_buoc: Slice the tofu and pork belly into large, thin pieces.
After slicing the pork, parboil it briefly.
Then, pan-fry the pork slightly to render out some of the fat.
Arrange the pork and tofu in alternating layers in a deep bowl.

Wash, peel, and mince the ginger. Mix it with sugar, soy sauce, and high-quality fish sauce, then pour it over the tofu and pork. Steam the bowl. Since the pork was already parboiled and pan-fried, you only need to steam for about 10 minutes for the meat and tofu to be cooked and seasoned.
After steaming, drain the liquid from the bowl into a pan. Mix the cornstarch with a little water, add it to the pan, and bring to a boil until the sauce thickens.
Finally, pour the sauce over the pork and tofu dish and serve hot with white rice.

Tofu is a simple dish often included in family meals. However, with a little creativity, you can make many delicious dishes from it. In this cold early winter weather, hot braised tofu dishes are a perfect choice. Sichuan-style braised tofu is a specialty sold in most Chinese restaurants. The dish is fragrant with herbs, the meat is tender, and the tofu is rich. Recently, many people have started enjoying making this at home. The characteristic spiciness and rich flavor are very appealing. Drizzling spoonfuls of the sauce over hot rice is simply unbeatable.

mon_an.mo_ta: We invite you to try Singapore-style fried rice. With its fresh and unique flavor, this dish will surely bring a new taste to you and your family. Join our cooking column today to learn how to make it!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Carrots, onions, green chilies, garlic, green onions
cac_buoc: Step 1: Clean the tiger prawns, peel, remove heads, and devein. Rinse the prawns under cold running water for 15-30 minutes to give the meat a desired crunch. Slice the Chinese sausages. Dice the char siu. Soak the dried shrimp in warm water until soft, then rinse clean.

Step 2: Peel and dice the carrots, then blanch them in boiling water. Peel and dice the onion. Wash, deseed, and dice the bell peppers. Peel and mince the garlic. Boil the peas until cooked. Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk well. Finely chop the green onions and cilantro.
Step 3: Take the rice and fluff it with a spoon. Drizzle with annatto oil and mix well.

Heat a pan and add cooking oil. Sauté the garlic and onions until the onions become translucent. Add the char siu, Chinese sausage, dried shrimp, carrots, tiger prawns, bell peppers, and peas, then stir well.

Next, add 1/2 of the whisked eggs and stir. When the eggs begin to set, add the rice and stir constantly so the grains separate. Season with 1/2 tsp MSG, 1 tsp broth mix, 1/2 tsp sugar, and 1/2 tsp soy sauce. Stir until the rice is hot and fluffy, then add the remaining eggs and mix well. Fry the rice over high heat; when the rice feels light and the grains start to jump in the pan, it is ready.

Step 4: Add the green onions, cilantro, 1 tsp soy sauce, and garlic oil, then stir well. Scoop the fried rice onto a plate, garnish with cilantro sprigs, sprinkle with pepper, and serve with soy sauce and sliced chilies.
Pro tip: For the best fried rice that isn't mushy or sticky, fluff the rice in a bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for 4 hours or overnight before cooking.

mon_an.ten: Stir-Fried Frog with Lemongrass and Chili
cac_buoc: Frog meat is highly nutritious. 100g of frog meat contains 75g water, 20g protein, 1.1g lipids, 3.9g ash, 22mg calcium, 159mg phosphorus, 1.3mg iron, and various vitamins, providing about 92kcal. Traditional medicine states that frog meat has cooling properties and helps recovery after illness or childbirth. Let's get into the kitchen to learn how to make stir-fried frog with lemongrass and chili—not only nutritious but also incredibly flavorful with the heat of chilies and the persistent aroma of lemongrass.
Delicious Curry Stir-Fried Frog with Lemongrass and Chili
Ingredients:
1 kg frog meat
5 stalks lemongrass
2 chilies
1 stalk green onion
A few sprigs of cilantro
1 bulb garlic
2 shallots
A little white wine
1 tsp curry powder
1 tbsp cooking oil
1 tbsp fish sauce
Common seasonings (salt, pepper, sugar, MSG, broth mix)
Preparation:
To clean and remove the gamey odor of the frog meat, rinse it in a diluted white wine solution for about 5 minutes. Then, rinse with clean water several times and drain.
Next, chop the frog into bite-sized pieces. Wash the lemongrass and chilies, then mince them. Finely chop the green onions and cilantro.
Peel and mince the shallots and garlic.
Marinating:

Place the frog meat in a bowl and add 1 tsp curry powder, 1 tsp salt, 1.5 tbsp sugar, 1.5 tsp broth mix, a little pepper, and the minced shallots. Mix in the minced lemongrass and chilies. Let the frog marinate for 15–30 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Cooking:

Heat 1 tbsp of cooking oil in a pan. Add the minced garlic and some lemongrass, sautéing over low heat for about 5 minutes until fragrant. Next, add the frog meat and stir-fry over medium heat for about 10 minutes.
Then, add 1 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp sugar, and 1 tsp broth mix to the pan. Stir well and adjust the seasoning to taste. Finally, sprinkle with pepper, green onions, and cilantro. Turn off the heat.
Transfer the stir-fried frog to a plate and it's ready to enjoy!

This curry stir-fried frog with lemongrass and chili offers a rich, aromatic flavor. The frog meat is cooked to a perfect chewy-sweet texture. It is excellent when served with a bowl of white rice and some fresh greens.
With just a few minutes of preparation, you have an attractive dish. Try it now and enjoy this special flavor!
How to buy fresh frog:

To ensure the meat is fresh and nutritious, prioritize buying live frogs over frozen ones. Look for frogs that are large, well-proportioned, and have yellowish-brown skin. These are signs of freshness.
Avoid frogs that move slowly or seem sluggish, as these are often farmed. Farmed frog meat is usually not as firm or high-quality as wild-caught field frogs.

mon_an.mo_ta: Batter-fried shrimp – a new way to enjoy shrimp and bring variety to your family meals. Let's learn how to make these crispy treats!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Vegetables: herbs, fresh chili, ginger, garlic
Seasonings: yeast, all-purpose flour, tapioca starch, sugar, vinegar, fish sauce, pepper
cac_buoc: Step 1: Preparation:
Clean the fresh shrimp (4-5 per 100g), peel and remove the heads while keeping the tails. Use a knife to score the belly along the body, then pat dry.
Dissolve the yeast in warm water, mix with the flour and 1/2 of the tapioca starch. Stir until it reaches a porridge-like consistency, then let the batter proof for 1-2 hours.
Peel and mince the garlic. Crush and mince the ginger.
Carve 1/2 of the chili into a flower for garnish; mince the remaining 1/2 after removing the seeds.
Step 2: Marinating:
Mix the shrimp with ginger, pepper, and seasoning to marinate.
Step 3: Cooking:

When the batter has risen sufficiently, dip the shrimp into the batter and drop them into a pan of very hot oil. Fry until the shrimp are golden and cooked through, then remove. Ensure the oil is deep enough to submerge the shrimp to prevent burning.
Once the batter is golden and crispy, remove the shrimp to a plate.

Making the sauce: Mix boiled water with fish sauce, vinegar, sugar, garlic, and chili to create a balanced sweet, sour, salty, and spicy sauce. Bring to a boil, add a little tapioca starch to thicken, and add a drop of frying oil for a glossy finish.
4. Presentation:
Arrange the shrimp on a plate and decorate with herbs, cilantro, and the chili flower. Serve with the dipping sauce.
Final requirements: The shrimp should be evenly coated, the batter crispy and golden. The shrimp meat should be just cooked and not dry.
Good luck and enjoy this crispy batter-fried shrimp dish!

mon_an.mo_ta: Featherback fish cooked in a sour broth is wonderful, both nutritious and refreshing for a family meal. Check out our recipe below!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Herbs: green onions, Vietnamese coriander, dill
Seasonings: broth mix, salt, MSG, cooking oil
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the tomatoes and okra. Wedge the tomatoes and slice the okra. Wash and finely chop the green onions, Vietnamese coriander, and dill.
Step 2: Rinse the sour bamboo shoots and parboil them briefly to reduce bitterness and remove toxins.
Step 3: Prepare 300g of fish paste and roll them into small round balls.
Step 4: Sauté the minced shallots in a little oil, add the tomatoes and stir-fry briefly. Next, add the pineapple and bamboo shoots. Season with 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp broth mix.

Step 5: When the tomatoes are soft, pour in a large bowl of water and bring to a boil. Once the broth is boiling, drop in the fish balls. When the fish cakes are cooked, they will float to the surface. Add 1-2 slices of chili if you like it spicy. Cook for another 1-2 minutes.
Step 6: Add the okra and cook for 1-2 more minutes or until the okra is tender. Season with 1 tbsp MSG and ladle the soup into a bowl.
Your meal will be much more appealing with a bowl of featherback fish cake sour soup like this.
Wishing you and your family a delicious meal with this appetizing soup!

mon_an.ten: Braised Beef with Soy Sauce and Mushrooms
mon_an.mo_ta: This braised beef recipe, cooked with soy sauce, mushrooms, wine, and ginger, will surely leave an irresistible charm for anyone who tastes it!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings: soy sauce, fish sauce, salt, sugar, white wine
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, we will prepare the fresh beef. After buying, wash it thoroughly and then slice the meat into thick strips (batonnet style), as shown in the picture!
Slicing the beef this way looks attractive and helps it braise faster!
Step 2:
Next, soak the shiitake mushrooms in cold water for about 10-15 minutes until they are soft and expanded!
Step 3:
For the green onions, wash them and cut into sections about 2cm long!
Step 4:
Next is the ginger. Simply peel, wash, and slice thinly (as shown in the picture).
Step 5:
Once all ingredients are prepared, get a clean pot. Add the beef, cleaned mushrooms, green onions, and ginger. Then pour in enough water to just cover the surface of the beef.
Cook over medium heat so it cooks evenly; do not use high heat right from the start!
Step 6:
Continue cooking until the water in the pot shows signs of reducing. At that point, add the soy sauce and stir well so the meat absorbs the flavor.
Add a little more water if needed so the beef is saucy but doesn't burn. Simmer for another 10 minutes, then taste to see if the beef is tender and seasoned to your liking!
Turn off the heat, arrange the beef on a deep plate, and enjoy immediately.

mon_an.ten: Fish Simmered in Garlic and Chili Fish Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: On a cool day, head to the kitchen to make this savory and rich fish simmered in garlic and chili fish sauce.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings: 2 tbsp fish sauce + 1 tbsp sugar + 5 tbsp water + 1 tbsp minced chili + 1 tsp minced garlic + 1 thinly sliced shallot + 1 stalk green onion (chopped) + 1/3 tsp pepper. Mix all these seasonings together in a bowl.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the fish and pat dry. Score a few small lines on the body of the fish. Rub a little salt all over.
Step 2: Add 1 tbsp of oil to a non-stick pan. When the oil is hot, fry the fish over medium heat.

Step 3: When the fish is golden brown on both sides, pour in the fish sauce mixture. Cover and simmer over low heat until the garlic and chili sauce thickens and coats the fish, then turn off the heat.
Transfer the simmered fish to a plate and serve with hot rice; it's delicious.

mon_an.mo_ta: Crispy fried stuffed tofu is a unique and very attractive dish to change up your family's menu.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 150g ground chicken (you can also use shrimp, fish, or pork)
1 tbsp minced white parts of green onions
cac_buoc: Step 1: Place the ground chicken and all seasonings into a bowl and mix well.
Step 2: Cut the tofu puffs in half and turn them inside out. Add the white inner parts of the tofu into the chicken bowl and mix together.
Step 3: Stuff a small amount of the meat mixture into each inside-out tofu piece and press to seal.

Step 4: Heat a pan with oil (you don't need too much). When the oil is just hot, add the stuffed tofu and fry over medium heat. When the tofu has a golden, crispy outer shell, remove to a plate lined with paper towels.
Serve the crispy stuffed tofu on a plate with lettuce and cucumber. This dish is eaten with rice and dipped in sweet and sour fish sauce.

mon_an.mo_ta: Let's get into the kitchen and make this delicious and easy braised pork with bamboo shoots!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 150g dried bamboo shoots (soaked and boiled until tender)
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, pour water into a pot, add the sliced pork, and blanch for about 1 minute. Remove and drain.
Step 2:
Add a little oil to a pan, then add the sugar and cook over low heat until the sugar melts and turns golden brown.
Step 3:
Add the blanched pork and stir well.
Step 4:
Add the soy sauce, stir well, and simmer over low heat so the pork absorbs the seasonings.
Step 5:
Now, add enough water to just cover the meat.
Step 6:
Add the bamboo shoots to the pot, season with a little salt to taste, and simmer for 60-90 minutes.
Step 7:
Finally, when the sauce has reduced and the pork and bamboo shoots have turned golden brown, it is done.
Braised pork with bamboo shoots served with white rice—a "mom's home-cooked" classic—is ready to enjoy!
Transfer the pork and bamboo shoots to a bowl and garnish with some chopped green onions.
The method is simple, but the result is incredibly fragrant and delicious!

mon_an.ten: Refreshing Taro and Pork Rib Soup
mon_an.mo_ta: Taro and pork rib soup features the nutty aroma of taro combined with the rich, savory flavor of simmered ribs. Served with fluffy white rice, it is a perfect dish for chilly days. This hearty meal is easy to prepare and very nutritious. Let's get into the kitchen and cook this together. This refreshing taro and pork rib soup guide offers a traditional recipe with a deep yet fresh flavor. Explore this recipe to enjoy a delicious, cooling soup right at home.
cac_buoc: Cut the ribs into bite-sized pieces, wash thoroughly, and blanch in boiling water. Marinate with seasonings for 5-10 minutes.
Peel the taro and cut into bite-sized cubes or rectangles.

Stir-fry the ribs until the meat firms up, then add water and simmer over low heat. Skim off the foam for a clear broth. When the broth is clear and fragrant, add the taro and continue to simmer; taro cooks quickly and only needs 7-10 minutes.
Season the soup to taste, stir in the chopped culantro, and remove from the heat. Serve the soup in a large bowl and enjoy.
How to choose fresh ingredients
How to choose good taro
Shape: Choose tubers with a round, even shape and rough skin with many root hairs and soil on the surface. Select medium-sized ones, not too large or too small.

Weight: If it feels heavy, the taro may contain a lot of water, making it bland when cooked. Conversely, a light tuber usually has less water and higher starch content, providing a nuttier and better flavor.
Taro eyes: Observe the pits on the surface; the more pits there are, the nuttier and better the taro. Taro with few pits and smooth skin is usually not as good.
Color and texture: When looking at the cut surface, look for purple veins and deep red spots, which indicate a good tuber. If the inside is pale, the taro is likely not very good.
Choosing good ribs
Color and thickness: Choose pork ribs with a bright color, ranging from pink to light red, with a thickness of about 1.5 – 2 finger joints. Bright color is a sign of freshness.
Aroma: Fresh pork ribs will have a natural meaty scent without any fishy or foul odors. Choose pieces with a pleasant aroma.
Elasticity: Gently press the meat with your finger. If the meat is not elastic and leaves a deep indentation, it may be a sign that the meat is old and no longer fresh.
Bones and size: Select ribs with small, nice-looking bones, as these usually have more meat and fewer bones than larger ones.
Avoid signs of spoilage: Avoid ribs that are pale or too dark, have a slimy outer layer, or a rancid smell. These are signs of spoiled or old meat.
Tips to remove odors from ribs
Boiling water: You can blanch the pork ribs in boiling water for 2 – 3 minutes, then remove and rinse again with fresh water.
Using deodorizing ingredients: Use natural ingredients like shallots, white wine, vinegar, ginger, or lemongrass. When boiling the ribs, add one of these to effectively remove odors.
Using straw: During the blanching process, you can add 4 – 5 pieces of straw and blanch for 2 – 3 minutes. Then, rinse with water.
Refreshing Taro and Pork Rib Soup recipe
Notes for cooking delicious taro and pork rib soup
Choose fresh ingredients: Select taro with smooth skin, free of bruises or cracks. Choose pork ribs with a bright color, not dull or foul-smelling.
Pre-processing: Wash and peel the taro. Pork ribs can be blanched to remove foam and impurities. Then, rinse the ribs with cold water.
Use natural seasonings: Use seasonings like shallots, garlic, chili, culantro, and ginger to enhance the soup's flavor. These ingredients also help cool the soup and remove rib odors.

Cooking time: When cooking taro and pork rib soup, use low heat and cook for a moderate amount of time to maintain the freshness of the ingredients. If cooked too long, the ribs may become too soft and the taro will fall apart.

Combine with fresh herbs: To increase the refreshing quality of the soup, add fresh herbs like cilantro, culantro, or basil before turning off the heat. Fresh herbs help balance the flavors and provide a fresh sensation.

mon_an.mo_ta: Stuffed bitter melon soup is a favorite dish in Southern Vietnam due to the cooling properties of the bitter melon and the savory sweetness of the meat filling.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Soak wood ear mushrooms in water until soft, wash, and mince. Trim the green onions; crush and mince the white parts. Keep the green leaves separate. Peel, wash, and mince the shallots. Trim and wash the cilantro.

Step 2: Wash the pork shoulder and grind it very finely so the filling isn't dry. You can also substitute with pork paste (giò sống) at a ratio of 2 parts ground pork to 1 part pork paste, or use featherback fish paste. Mix the pork, mushrooms, shallots, and white onion parts with a bit of seasoning powder and pepper; marinate for 15 minutes.

Step 3: While the meat is marinating, prepare the bitter melon. Choose freshly picked, straight ones. To make it easier to remove the core and keep the dish looking nice, bring a pot of water to a boil. Add 1 tsp of salt and blanch the bitter melon for about 1 minute. Turn off the heat and immediately shock the bitter melon in cold water.
Step 4: Use a knife to make a longitudinal slit on one side and scoop out all the seeds and pulp.

Step 5: Stuff the filling firmly into the bitter melon. The filling should slightly overflow the opening. Use a green onion leaf to tie the bitter melon so the filling doesn't fall out during simmering.

Step 6: Boil the bone broth. If unavailable, use plain water seasoned with a bit of seasoning powder. When the water boils, add the bitter melons one by one. Bring to a boil over high heat, skim off all the foam for a clear broth, then simmer until tender.
You must time the cooking carefully; if undercooked, the bitter melon skin will be hard and difficult to eat. If overcooked, the skin will become mushy and lose its appeal.
Once served in a bowl, garnish with a bit of green onion, cilantro, and ground pepper to enhance the color and aroma.

Not only a dish for good luck, but simmered bitter melon is also very cooling and nutritious. The bitterness in the fruit acts as a remedy to clear heat, detoxify, and effectively treat heat rash and sores.

mon_an.mo_ta: Let's cook a delicious clam spaghetti for the family.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Tomatoes - 10 cherry tomatoes or 2 regular tomatoes
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the clams
Soak the clams to remove sand, then wash them. Place them in a pot with a little water or white wine and boil until they open. (Use very little liquid as clams release their own juice).
Step 2: Prepare the spaghetti
Boil the spaghetti until cooked, then drain and rinse with cold water. Let it drain in a colander and set aside in a bowl. Check the package instructions for the boiling time.
Step 3: Dice the onion, mince the garlic, and wash and halve the cherry tomatoes. If using regular tomatoes, chop them finely.
Step 4: Place a pan on the stove, heat the olive oil and butter, then sauté the garlic until fragrant before adding the onion.
Next, add the tomato sauce...
Then add the clams and chopped tomatoes, stir well, season to taste, and toss so the clams and tomatoes absorb the flavors.
You can add a few slices of fresh chili if you like heat.
Finally, add the cooked spaghetti, toss for about 5 minutes to let the pasta absorb the sauce, then turn off the heat.
Serve on a plate and enjoy. The final result will look like this.

The requirement for a good clam spaghetti is that the clams must be free of sand. The clams should be just cooked through—tender and sweet, not dry or rubbery. The seasoning should be balanced. A little spiciness from the chili makes it even better (this depends on personal taste; if you can't eat spicy food, you can omit the chili). You can also sprinkle some basil or mint leaves on top for a great aroma.
Here are some tips for a great clam spaghetti:

As mentioned, the clams must be clean. To remove sand, place the clams in a wide tray, pour in a light salt solution until almost covered, and keep them in a dark place so they spit out the sand. Adding a few slices of chili can stimulate them to release sand faster. This salt and chili soaking method also works for other seafood like snails or small clams.

When boiling clams, use only a little water to keep them sweet. Using white wine makes them more fragrant. Turn off the heat as soon as the shells open; do not overcook them, as they will be stir-fried again with the tomatoes and can become tough and lose their sweetness.
Wait until you have added the clams and tomatoes before seasoning, as clams are naturally salty. If you season too early, the dish may become too salty, which isn't good for your health.
If you don't have tomato sauce, you can substitute with blended or finely chopped tomatoes mixed with a little vinegar and sugar to taste.
Using the same clams, you can also try making a hot clam sour soup, which is also delicious and visually appealing.

mon_an.mo_ta: A familiar yet unique dish – let's learn how to make a perfect pork rib sour soup. Master this delicious recipe with us.
cac_buoc: How to make pork rib sour soup

This dish may seem simple, but if not done correctly or with the right combination of spices, your soup will lack its characteristic flavor and sourness. To make this pork rib sour soup, please follow these steps:
Wash the tomatoes and green onions; cut the tomatoes into wedges. For the ribs, rinse them thoroughly with water to remove impurities. Wash and thinly slice the ginger.

Place the ribs and ginger in a pot of water and bring to a boil, making sure to skim off the foam. Once the ribs are tender, add the tomatoes. When the tomatoes have softened, season to taste, garnish with chopped green onions, and serve in a bowl.
We have now completed this simple yet delicious soup. Good luck!

mon_an.ten: Garlic Sauce Grilled Pork for Weekend Gatherings
mon_an.mo_ta: Here is an incredibly easy yet delicious recipe for garlic sauce grilled pork. This simple dish is a perfect addition to any home cook's repertoire for family meals.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Pork tenderloin - 500g (use the fillet for the best flavor and tenderness)
Cooking oil - as needed (use sesame oil for extra fragrance)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the meat and ingredients
Choose pork tenderloin for its tenderness and aroma. Wash the meat, then use kitchen twine to tie it into a firm, round shape.
Peel and mince the shallots and garlic.
Step 2: Marinate the meat
Place all the sauce ingredients into a zipper bag or food-grade plastic bag.
Shake the bag by hand to mix the ingredients thoroughly.
Add the prepared meat to the bag, seal it, and shake well so the marinade coats and penetrates the meat. Place it in the refrigerator to marinate for 4-6 hours.
Step 3: Grill the meat

Preheat the oven to 200°C for about 10 minutes. Remove the marinated meat from the fridge and place it on a tray lined with foil. Pour the marinade over the meat, wrap it tightly, and place it in the oven. Grill for about 45 minutes until cooked through. You can use a toothpick or skewer to test for doneness; if red juice runs out, the meat needs more time. Note: every 15 minutes, open the oven and turn the meat so it browns evenly.

Once the meat is golden brown and cooked, remove it from the oven, cut off the twine, and let it rest for about 15 minutes to cool slightly. While waiting, prepare the dipping sauce to serve with the grilled pork.
Step 4: Cook the sauce
Pour the broth into a pot.
Collect the remaining juices from the foil and add them to the pot.
Add cornstarch to thicken the sauce.
Turn on the heat and bring the mixture to a boil, stirring constantly. Once the mixture boils and the sauce thickens, turn off the heat.
Step 5: Presentation
After the sauce is finished and the meat has cooled, slice the pork into thin, bite-sized pieces.
Arrange on a plate and drizzle the sauce over the top.
Garnish with chopped green onions for a beautiful look. This dish is delicious served hot with rice or bread.

The finished garlic sauce grilled pork should have a golden-brown color, be perfectly cooked (not raw or burnt), and have a prominent garlic aroma. You can refer to the following tips for a perfect dish:

When buying meat, choose pieces with a fresh color, no unpleasant odor, and good elasticity (it shouldn't leave a deep indentation when pressed). The best cut for this dish is the pork tenderloin (fillet), as it is lean but very tender and doesn't dry out. If tenderloin is unavailable, regular loin is also fine.

If you don't have an oven, you can pan-fry the meat in oil until golden on all sides. If using this method, you don't need to tie the meat. Before frying, remember to scrape off any bits of onion or garlic to prevent them from burning. Good luck with your garlic sauce grilled pork!
You can also check out our recipe for grilled meat skewers.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Nutritious and Delicious Milk-Stewed Pork Shank
mon_an.mo_ta: Milk-stewed pork shank is not only a delicious dish but also offers many nutritional benefits. By combining fresh pork shank with rich, sweet milk, we create a dish high in calcium, protein, and collagen. Stewing the pork shank in fragrant, spiced milk makes it melt-in-your-mouth tender. Let's roll up our sleeves and get into the kitchen. Discover how to stew pork shank in milk to create a fragrant, silky-smooth dish. Enjoy this delicious milk-stewed pork shank with family and friends today!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients
After buying the pork shank, singe it over a flame to remove impurities, then scrape clean and wash again with diluted salt water; let it drain.
Peel and wash the carrots and potatoes, then cut into bite-sized pieces. Wash the leeks and cut into 5cm segments. Peel and mince the garlic, and peel and cut the onion into wedges.
To stew the pork shank, prepare a pressure cooker. Place the cleaned pork shank into the pot along with the onion, garlic, heavy cream, and fresh milk. Simmer on low heat for about 1 hour.

Pour in enough broth to cover the meat and add a few bay leaves. During the stewing process, skim the foam frequently and lower the heat to simmer for about 2 hours in a regular pot, or 1 hour in a pressure cooker.
Step 2: Make the sauce
To complete the dish, prepare a special sauce that creates its signature flavor. First, melt the butter in a pan. Add the garlic and sauté until fragrant.

Once the garlic is golden, add a little flour to the pan and stir until smooth. Next, add the heavy cream, fresh milk, and a bowl of the braising liquid from the pork shank. Continue cooking for about 3 minutes until the sauce thickens. Season with a bit of salt to taste.
Step 3: Finished product
Place the pork shank on a deep plate and drizzle the sauce evenly over it. You can enjoy the stewed pork shank with mashed potatoes, salad, or bread.
The final result should be tender pork that has absorbed the seasonings, paired with a rich, creamy, and smooth sauce. The dish should be satisfying without feeling too heavy.
Notes on buying good pork shank
Choose fresh pork: Check that the shank is a fresh pink color, not dark red or dull. Avoid buying shanks that are dark or show signs of spoilage.
Check the smell: Fresh pork shank will have a mild scent, with no foul or unpleasant odors. Avoid meat with strange or off-putting smells.
Examine the skin: The skin should be smooth, without signs of damage, bruising, or swelling. It should also have a thin layer of fat, indicating good quality.
Check elasticity: When pressing the shank, if the skin springs back quickly without leaving a dent, it is a sign of freshness.
Buy from reliable sources: Purchase pork from trusted stores or suppliers that follow hygiene and quality regulations.
Note the origin: If possible, choose pork from reliable origins with guaranteed quality and no contamination.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Fragrant and Tender Grilled Boneless Chicken Thighs
mon_an.mo_ta: When you have more time on the weekend, make these delicious five-spice grilled boneless chicken thighs for the whole family. Let's learn how to make this dish! With a special blend of garlic, chili, honey, and soy sauce, the boneless chicken thighs will become fragrant, attractive, and tender in every fiber. Discover this recipe and create a flavorful, hearty meal for your family! Learn how to make these incredibly attractive grilled boneless chicken thighs at home with a simple and effective recipe.
cac_buoc: Step 1: To prepare the boneless chicken thighs, you can ask the butcher to debone them or wash the purchased thighs yourself and let them drain. Use a knife to slice down the thigh to remove the bone.
Step 2: After deboning, cut the chicken thighs into halves to make them easier to skewer.

Step 3: Prepare the seasoning mixture by peeling and crushing the garlic. Squeeze the juice from the ginger and set the pulp aside. Mix the ginger juice and crushed garlic with the chicken thighs to marinate.
Step 4: Add chicken marinade powder or five-spice powder to the bowl to achieve the authentic grilled chicken flavor.

Step 5: Next, add the ginger pulp and soy sauce to the bowl, mix well, and let the chicken marinate to absorb the flavors. For a bolder taste, you can add salt or seasoning powder. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and place it in the refrigerator to marinate for about 6 hours.
Step 6: Wash the skewers and soak them in water for about 10 minutes. Then, thread the chicken onto the skewers, ensuring the meat is balanced and not leaning to one side.

Step 7: Place the chicken skewers on a baking tray, which can be lined with foil to prevent sticking. Turn on the oven to 180-200°C and grill for about 15 minutes. Then, brush honey evenly over the chicken and grill for another 5 minutes.
Step 8: Finally, arrange the chicken on a plate and enjoy this delicious dish.
Notes for making grilled boneless chicken
Wash the chicken thighs thoroughly before starting to ensure hygiene and remove impurities.
When slicing the meat to remove the bone, be careful not to damage the structure of the meat. Ensure the thigh retains its shape and tenderness.
Before marinating, extract the juice from the ginger to use in the seasoning mix. The ginger pulp can also be used to add texture to the dish.
When marinating the chicken, leave it in the fridge for about 6 hours so the flavors penetrate deeply. This helps the seasoning reach the core of the meat for better flavor.
When skewering the chicken, ensure it is balanced and not lopsided. This helps the meat grill evenly and look more attractive.
Before grilling, ensure the temperature and time are correct. Grilling for too long can dry out the chicken, while too little time will leave it undercooked.
When brushing honey on the chicken, ensure it is spread evenly over the surface. The honey will create a beautiful glaze and provide a sweet flavor.
After grilling, let the chicken rest for a short time before serving. This helps the meat retain its tenderness and best flavor.

mon_an.ten: How to Make Savory Stir-Fried Frog with Chili
mon_an.mo_ta: With this delicious stir-fried frog with chili recipe, you will have a highly nutritious addition to your family menu that will have everyone impressed!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings: soy sauce, sugar, white wine, salt, ground pepper
cac_buoc: Step 1:
Wash the frog legs and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Step 2:
Place pickled ginger, garlic, soy sauce, sugar, and white wine into a large bowl. Marinate the meat for at least 20 minutes.
Note: Pat the frog legs very dry before marinating so the meat absorbs the seasonings better and tastes more delicious.
Step 3:
Finely chop the pickled chilies, ginger, and onion.
Step 4:
In a pan with hot oil, sauté the garlic until fragrant.
Step 5:
When the garlic turns slightly golden, add the onion.
Step 6:
Next, add the chilies and stir-fry for a moment.
Step 7:
Then, add the frog legs.
Step 8:

Add a little wine, cover the pan, and braise for a while. Finally, season with a little salt, pepper, seasoning powder, and a dash of soy sauce. Cook until the liquid in the pan reduces and thickens, then turn off the heat.
The eye-catching stir-fried frog with chili is now complete!
Nothing beats eating this with a bowl of hot rice on a cold day!
If you are tired of meat and fish all week, changing the flavor for the weekend will make the family meal more exciting!
It looks delicious just by looking at it!

mon_an.mo_ta: In just a few minutes of preparation, you'll have a savory dish of stir-fried beef with oyster mushrooms for your meal. Today's article will guide you through making this dish. Enjoy!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasonings - salt, pepper, sugar, soy sauce, cooking oil, oyster sauce
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the beef, drain, and slice thinly. Marinate with 1/2 tsp salt, 2 tsp soy sauce, 1 tsp oyster sauce, 2 tsp sugar, 1 tsp cooking oil, 1/2 tsp pepper, and 1/2 tsp minced garlic. Let it sit to absorb the flavors.

Step 2: Trim the stems of the oyster mushrooms, tear into smaller pieces, wash, and drain. Bring a pot of water to a boil, add a little salt and a small crushed piece of ginger. Blanch the oyster mushrooms in the boiling water, then pour into a colander to drain.
Doing this ensures the mushrooms won't release too much water when stir-fried and will remain crisp and delicious.

Step 3: Peel the carrot, carve into flower shapes, and slice into rounds. Soak the shiitake mushrooms until expanded. Cut the green onions into segments. Sauté the garlic until fragrant, then add the beef and stir-fry quickly over high heat. Add the shiitake and oyster mushrooms, stir-frying quickly until just cooked. Finally, add the green onion segments and turn off the heat.
Serve the oyster mushrooms on a plate, sprinkle with a little pepper, and enjoy hot with rice and soy sauce for a delicious and attractive meal.
Wishing you and your family a wonderful meal with stir-fried beef and oyster mushrooms!

mon_an.mo_ta: Gather the ingredients to make this incredibly delicious, piping hot seafood kimchi hotpot to enjoy with your family and friends in this chilly weather!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 2 minced garlic cloves; 1 small shallot, minced
Seasoning: salt, fish sauce, sugar, broth powder
1 stalk green onion, cut into sections; 1 horn chili, sliced; 2 tomatoes
cac_buoc: Step 1: Clean the shrimp, octopus, and squid. Score the squid and slice thinly. Slice the sausages.
Slice the mushrooms and fish cake. Wedge the tomatoes.
Step 2: Place a pot on the stove, add 2 tbsp oil, and sauté the shallot and garlic until fragrant.
Step 3: Add the kimchi and stir-fry for 4-5 minutes.
Step 4: Add 3 bowls of water and the mushrooms. Once the water boils, add the squid, octopus, shrimp, and the remaining ingredients; cook for a few more minutes.
Step 5: Season to taste and turn off the heat.
Transfer the kimchi hotpot to a portable stove to keep warm; serve with extra mushrooms and vegetables for dipping.

mon_an.ten: Baked Cheesy Chicken with Rich Creamy Sauce
mon_an.mo_ta: Seriously, you will be hooked! These delicious baked chicken pieces paired with a rich, creamy cheese sauce create a perfect harmony of flavors.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Honey sauce: 50ml water + 25g Korean chili paste + 30g honey
cac_buoc: Step 1:
First, use a whisk to combine the egg, chili paste, soy sauce, cornstarch, sugar, salt, and pepper.
Step 2:
Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces.
Step 3:
Add the chicken to the batter and toss gently to coat evenly.
Step 4:
Deep-fry the chicken in oil over medium heat until golden brown.
Step 5:
Remove the chicken and place on paper towels to drain. Then, fry the chicken a second time over medium heat for about 2 minutes; remove and set aside to drain.
Step 6:
Mix the honey, water, and chili paste to make the sauce. Toss the fried chicken in the sauce until well coated.
Step 7:
Mix the two types of cheese and spread a layer at the bottom of a baking pan. Arrange the fried chicken on top and cover with the remaining cheese.
Step 8:
Preheat the oven to 220°C. Bake the chicken until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Doesn't this crispy fried chicken covered in stretchy cheese look tempting?
The melted cheese is so gooey, rich, and fragrant!
The chicken is crispy and infused with a perfectly balanced sweet and spicy sauce!
If you like skewers, it's great served that way too...

mon_an.mo_ta: Salt-roasted chicken is simple, easy to make, and served hot to preserve the natural sweetness and enticing aroma of the chicken.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the chicken and pat dry.
Step 2: Rub the cooking salt all over the chicken. Mix the ginger powder and turmeric powder together and rub evenly onto the chicken.
Step 3: Roast 2kg of coarse salt in a pan for 10 minutes until the salt is dry and hot.
Wrap the chicken tightly in parchment paper.
Spread 3 tbsp of the roasted salt at the bottom of a cast-iron pot, then place the chicken on top. Pour the remaining roasted salt over it until the chicken parcel is completely covered.
Place the pot on the stove and cook for 40 minutes, then turn off the heat. Keep the lid closed for another 30-40 minutes, then remove the chicken and chop into bite-sized pieces or shred to serve.
Once cooled, the salt can be stored in a glass jar for future use.

mon_an.mo_ta: Each piece of pork belly is sliced with the skin intact and fried until it's as crunchy as a snack! Learn how to make crispy pork belly with this recipe.
cac_buoc: Step 1: Wash the meat. Boil a pot of water with the lemongrass, shallot, ginger, salt, pepper, and fish sauce for 3 minutes, then add the pork and simmer over medium heat.
Boil for about 15 minutes, then remove the meat. Place on a plate, pat dry, and leave overnight in the refrigerator or a cool, airy place (ensure the skin side is facing up).
Step 2: The meat will be very dry the next day.
Slice into bite-sized pieces.
Step 3: Place the meat in a plastic bag and shake with the frying flour.
Step 4: Heat a pan with oil (not too much needed). Once the oil is hot (but not smoking), add the meat and fry over medium heat.
Step 5: Stir occasionally and continue frying until the skin crackles and the meat is golden and fragrant; remove to a plate lined with paper towels.
Serve the crispy pork belly with lettuce and cucumber.
This dish is excellent with rice or vermicelli and a bowl of sweet and sour chili fish sauce.
Good luck making this crispy pork belly for your family!

mon_an.mo_ta: With a special sauce, these spicy stir-fried clams become uniquely and irresistibly delicious!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 45g fermented black beans (can substitute with black bean paste)
cac_buoc: Prepare the ingredients for the spicy stir-fried clams with special sauce as shown in the picture!
Step 1:
Soak the clams in salt water for 30 minutes to purge sand, then rinse thoroughly with water.
Step 2:
Soak the fermented black beans in water for 30 minutes to reduce saltiness, then rinse. If using store-bought black bean paste, skip this step.
Step 3:
Finely chop the garlic, shallot, and chili.
Step 4:
In a bowl, mix the stir-fry sauce: water, soy sauce, oyster sauce, cornstarch (or flour), and sugar.
Step 5:
Sauté the shallot, garlic, and fermented black beans (or black bean paste) over high heat for a few minutes until fragrant.
Step 6:
Add the clams and stir-fry for another 3 minutes.
Step 7:
Pour in the sauce from step 4 and the white wine; cook until the clams open and the sauce thickens slightly.
Add chopped green onions and chili for color!
Nothing beats spicy clams on a cool day!

mon_an.mo_ta: Golden fried egg squid with a salty, chewy texture and the aroma of garlic and ginger, served with chili sauce for an ultimate treat.
cac_buoc: Wash the squid.
Peel and wash the ginger and garlic; mince finely. Set half aside and squeeze the other half for juice.

Marinate the squid with the ginger-garlic juice, pepper, and seasonings for 10 minutes (Note: always marinate with aromatic ingredients first before adding taste-enhancing seasonings like salt and sugar).
Once marinated, remove and drain (or pat dry with paper towels). Place the squid in a bowl and toss with tapioca starch until evenly coated.
Heat oil in a pan; once hot, fry the squid until golden brown, then remove and drain excess oil.

Pour out most of the oil (save it for fried rice if desired). Sauté the minced garlic, ginger, and fresh chili until golden, then add sugar, seasoning, and chili sauce. Stir well, then add the squid and toss quickly to coat before serving.
Serve hot with chili sauce.
Golden, delicious fried squid is great with rice or as a snack for your husband. Enjoy your cooking!

mon_an.ten: Stir-Fried Snails with Piper Lolot Leaves
mon_an.mo_ta: Crunchy, savory snail pieces blended with the fragrance of piper lolot leaves and a hint of chili heat make this dish truly enticing. Check out the recipe below! Enjoy the wonderful texture of these stir-fried snails with this detailed guide. Impress your family and friends with this dish. Ensure the snails are evenly cooked and crunchy. Discover the recipe now!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Seasoning - Pepper, salt, broth powder, vinegar, cooking oil
cac_buoc: 1. Guide to making crunchy stir-fried apple snails with piper lolot leaves
Step 1: Soak the snails in water with a few chili slices for 2-3 hours to remove dirt and slime.

Step 2: Rinse the snails, crack the tails, and boil. When the water boils, stir with chopsticks until the snails open, then turn off the heat. Drain and let cool. Extract the meat, remove the digestive tract, and rub with a bit of salt and vinegar to clean. Rinse thoroughly and drain; cut large snails in half.
Step 3: Marinate the snail meat with a bit of broth powder, pepper, and a pinch of turmeric powder for 10 minutes.
Step 4: Pick the piper lolot leaves, discarding old stems and bruised leaves. Wash and julienne into 0.5cm strips.
Step 5: Peel, wash, bruise, and mince the shallots. Wash and slice the chilies.
Step 6: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a pan. Once hot, sauté the shallots until fragrant, then add the snails and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until firm; do not overcook or they will become tough.
Step 7: Add a splash of fish sauce for aroma and season to taste. Add the piper lolot leaves, toss, turn off the heat, and top with sliced chilies.
2. Guide to making delicious stir-fried mud snails with piper lolot leaves
Ingredients for mud snails
1 kg mud snails
50g piper lolot leaves
50g perilla leaves
1 stalk lemongrass
2 bird's eye chilies
2 garlic cloves and lemon.
Also, prepare seasonings including oil, fish sauce, salt, MSG, and vinegar.
Preparing the mud snails
First, to clean the snails, soak them in a diluted vinegar solution with lemon slices and chili to deodorize. Let them soak for 2-3 hours.
Then, rinse the snails with clean water. Extract the meat from the shells and rub with ½ tsp salt to remove odors and slime. Finally, rinse again and drain.
Preparing other ingredients
First, wash the piper lolot and perilla leaves and drain. Remove damaged leaves and cut piper lolot into bite-sized pieces. Shred the perilla leaves.
Next, peel the garlic and cut the lemongrass into sections. Mince both.
Finally, remove chili stems and chop.
Stir-frying the snails
Start by heating oil in a pan. Once hot, add garlic and lemongrass to sauté until fragrant.
Next, add the cleaned snails and stir-fry quickly. Add seasonings: 3 tsp fish sauce and ½ tsp MSG. Mix well and stir-fry over medium heat for 3-5 minutes to absorb the flavors.

When the snails are slightly firm, add the piper lolot leaves and sliced chilies; stir well and continue cooking until done. Finally, add the perilla leaves and stir briefly. Adjust seasoning to taste and turn off the heat.
Notes for making stir-fried snails with piper lolot leaves
Choose fresh snails: Ensure you select fresh mud snails with no odor and intact shells.
Clean thoroughly: Before cooking, remove mud and impurities by soaking in vinegar and lemon water. Rub the meat to remove slime and odor.
Prepare other ingredients: Prepare the leaves, garlic, lemongrass, and chilies as instructed. Wash and chop for easy stir-frying.
Stir-fry evenly and not too long: Use medium heat so they cook evenly without drying out. 3-5 minutes is enough for them to absorb seasoning and firm up.
Add leaves at the end: To keep the aroma and texture of the piper lolot and perilla leaves, add them near the end of the process.
Taste before finishing: Before turning off the heat, taste and adjust the seasoning. Use fish sauce, MSG, salt, and vinegar for a balanced flavor.

mon_an.ten: Salt-Roasted Chicken for a Weekend Reunion
mon_an.mo_ta: Everyone will be impressed by the delicious, enticing, and unique flavor of this salt-roasted chicken.
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: 1 ½ tbsp ginger powder; ½ tbsp white pepper; 2 tsp salt (mixed in a bowl)
cac_buoc: Step 1: Clean the chicken and pat dry with paper towels.
Brush cooking wine all over the chicken, including the cavity. Rub the ginger powder mixture inside and outside the skin.
Tie the legs together and place the chicken on a large bowl or cup so any liquid in the cavity can drain out. Leave the chicken (uncovered) in the refrigerator overnight to dry the skin.
Step 2: The next day, remove the chicken from the fridge at least 1-2 hours before cooking.
Place ginger slices in the cavity and brush oil all over the skin.
Step 3: Wrap the chicken in a large sheet of parchment paper. Then wrap it again with another sheet, leaving the breast side open. Set aside.
Step 4: Roast 1.25kg of coarse salt in a dry pan for 15 minutes over medium heat until it turns light brown.
Place a 0.75cm layer of salt in another pot. Place the chicken parcel in the center.
Cover the parcel with the remaining salt to ensure it is completely buried.
Đậy vung lại, nấu lửa vừa trong 35 phút sau đó tắt bếp, đậy vung, ủ thêm 30 – 40 phút nữa, cho đến khi muối chỉ còn ấm.
Gently remove the chicken; it will be very hot, so be careful not to get burned.
Unwrap the chicken and enjoy. Pour any juices from the parcel over the meat for extra flavor!
Note: For this method, you need an amount of salt equal to the weight of the chicken.
After use, discard the greasy salt and keep the clean salt for next time.
The chicken bones can be used to make soup.

mon_an.mo_ta: Autumn has arrived in Hanoi, a season of peace and romance. The cool weather is perfect for enjoying a fragrant Thai hotpot with family or friends. Here is the secret to a delicious, rich Thai hotpot for the weekend.
cac_buoc: 1. Making the bone broth

Clean the pork bones, blanch in boiling water, then rinse to remove impurities and odors. Place bones in a pot with water and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat and simmer to extract the sweetness for the broth.
2. Preparing the ingredients
Clean the squid and score in a diamond pattern, then cut into bite-sized pieces.
Wash the clams and soak in water with a bit of salt and sliced chili. Cover with a colander and soak for 30 minutes to purge sand, then rinse.
Wash the shrimp and trim the antennae if desired.
Wash the beef and use a sharp knife to slice thinly.
Arrange the shrimp, squid, beef, and clams attractively on a plate.

Wash and wedge the tomatoes. Peel the pineapple, remove eyes, and slice. Bruise the lemongrass and cut into sections. Wash and slice the galangal. Score the tops of the straw mushrooms for decoration and wash. Clean the vegetables and cut into sections; separate the napa cabbage leaves and cut into bite-sized pieces. Arrange all on plates.
3. Cooking the hotpot
Sauté minced garlic until fragrant, then add tomatoes, pineapple, galangal, and lemongrass. Stir-fry until softened, then add the bone broth.
Add the Thai hotpot seasoning packet and stir well, then add shallots, straw mushrooms, and lime leaves. Season to taste. For extra sourness, add lime juice. Add satay chili oil if you like it spicy.
When eating, dip the ingredients into the boiling broth until cooked and serve hot. Serve with soy sauce, salt-pepper-lime, or fish sauce as preferred.

mon_an.mo_ta: Field crab soup with taro is perfect for summer weather. Let's head to the market for fresh ingredients to treat your family to this daily meal!
cac_buoc: Step 1: Clean the crabs, separate the shells, and scoop out the roe. Grind or pound the crab bodies with a pinch of salt, then strain with water to get the crab extract. Filter 2-3 times to ensure no grit remains.

Step 2: Clean the tomatoes, taro, onions, coriander, and water mimosa. Wedge the tomatoes. Parboil the taro before peeling and cutting into bite-sized pieces (this makes peeling faster and prevents itching).
Step 3: Sauté the minced shallot in oil, add tomatoes and stir-fry briefly, then add the crab roe. Add ½ tsp broth powder to soften the tomatoes.

Step 4: Place the crab extract in a pot, add 2 tsp broth powder and ½ tsp salt (adjust to taste). Stir well before heating (this helps the crab solids form a firm cake). When the soup boils and the crab solids float to the top, scoop them out and set aside.

Step 5: Add the sautéed tomatoes to the pot, then add the taro and cook for 3-5 minutes or until the taro is tender. Add the water mimosa and chopped green onions and coriander. Add 1 tsp MSG and transfer to a serving bowl.
A summer meal with field crab soup, water mimosa, and taro is truly delicious.
Enjoy this flavorful field crab and taro soup with your family!

mon_an.ten: Seafood Hotpot for a Cozy Weekend
mon_an.mo_ta: Seafood hotpot is the ultimate choice for family gatherings or year-end parties. When food safety is a common concern, preparing a delicious homemade hotpot for the whole family is unbeatable. Let's head to the kitchen and show off your skills with this wonderful dish! Seafood hotpot is the best option for reunions or festive celebrations. Nothing beats a fragrant, home-cooked hotpot for your loved ones. Let's get cooking!
nguyen_lieu_dung_cu: Grass carp fillet (or salmon; if using grass carp, choose one over 2 kg, buy the body and head, fillet the meat and use the bones and head for broth) - 300 g
Side vegetables: Water spinach, Mustard greens, Onion
cac_buoc: Step 1: Prepare the seafood and hotpot ingredients

Seafood: Wash the shrimp and trim the whiskers. Clean the squid and cut into bite-sized pieces. Fillet the grass carp and slice the meat; set aside the bones to simmer with the pork bones for the broth. Marinate the fish fillets with a little seasoning powder and thinly sliced lemongrass.

Clean the shiitake mushrooms.
